chinese: 起初，神創造天地。
english: At the first God made the heaven and the earth.

chinese: 地是空虛混沌，淵面黑暗；神的靈運行在水面上。
english: And the earth was waste and without form; and it was dark on the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God was moving on the face of the waters.

chinese: 神說：要有光，就有了光。
english: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

chinese: 神看光是好的，就把光暗分開了。
english: And God, looking on the light, saw that it was good: and God made a division between the light and the dark,

chinese: 神稱光為晝，稱暗為夜。有晚上，有早晨，這是頭一日。
english: Naming the light, Day, and the dark, Night. And there was evening and there was morning, the first day.

chinese: 神說：諸水之間要有空氣，將水分為上下。
english: And God said, Let there be a solid arch stretching over the waters, parting the waters from the waters.

chinese: 神就造出空氣，將空氣以下的水、空氣以上的水分開了。事就這樣成了。
english: And God made the arch for a division between the waters which were under the arch and those which were over it: and it was so.

chinese: 神稱空氣為天。有晚上，有早晨，是第二日。
english: And God gave the arch the name of Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, the second day.

chinese: 神說：天下的水要聚在一處，使旱地露出來。事就這樣成了。
english: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven come together in one place, and let the dry land be seen: and it was so.

chinese: 神稱旱地為地，稱水的聚處為海。神看著是好的。
english: And God gave the dry land the name of Earth; and the waters together in their place were named Seas: and God saw that it was good.

chinese: 神說：地要發生青草和結種子的菜蔬，並結果子的樹木，各從其類，果子都包著核。事就這樣成了。
english: And God said, Let grass come up on the earth, and plants producing seed, and fruit-trees giving fruit, in which is their seed, after their sort: and it was so.

chinese: 於是地發生了青草和結種子的菜蔬，各從其類；並結果子的樹木，各從其類；果子都包著核。神看著是好的。
english: And grass came up on the earth, and every plant producing seed of its sort, and every tree producing fruit, in which is its seed, of its sort: and God saw that it was good.

chinese: 有晚上，有早晨，是第三日。
english: And there was evening and there was morning, the third day.

chinese: 神說：天上要有光體，可以分晝夜，作記號，定節令、日子、年歲，
english: And God said, Let there be lights in the arch of heaven, for a division between the day and the night, and let them be for signs, and for marking the changes of the year, and for days and for years:

chinese: 並要發光在天空，普照在地上。事就這樣成了。
english: And let them be for lights in the arch of heaven to give light on the earth: and it was so.

chinese: 於是神造了兩個大光，大的管晝，小的管夜，又造眾星，
english: And God made the two great lights: the greater light to be the ruler of the day, and the smaller light to be the ruler of the night: and he made the stars.

chinese: 就把這些光擺列在天空，普照在地上，
english: And God put them in the arch of heaven, to give light on the earth;

chinese: 管理晝夜，分別明暗。神看著是好的。
english: To have rule over the day and the night, and for a division between the light and the dark: and God saw that it was good.

chinese: 有晚上，有早晨，是第四日。
english: And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.

chinese: 神說：水要多多滋生有生命的物；要有雀鳥飛在地面以上，天空之中。
english: And God said, Let the waters be full of living things, and let birds be in flight over the earth under the arch of heaven.

chinese: 神就造出大魚和水中所滋生各樣有生命的動物，各從其類；又造出各樣飛鳥，各從其類。神看著是好的。
english: And God made great sea-beasts, and every sort of living and moving thing with which the waters were full, and every sort of winged bird: and God saw that it was good.

chinese: 神就賜福給這一切，說：滋生繁多，充滿海中的水；雀鳥也要多生在地上。
english: And God gave them his blessing, saying, Be fertile and have increase, making all the waters of the seas full, and let the birds be increased in the earth.

chinese: 有晚上，有早晨，是第五日。
english: And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.

chinese: 神說：地要生出活物來，各從其類；牲畜、昆蟲、地上的野獸，各從其類。事就這樣成了。
english: And God said, Let the earth give birth to all sorts of living things, cattle and all things moving on the earth, and beasts of the earth after their sort: and it was so.

chinese: 於是神造出野獸，各從其類；牲畜，各從其類；地上一切昆蟲，各從其類。　神看著是好的。
english: And God made the beast of the earth after its sort, and the cattle after their sort, and everything moving on the face of the earth after its sort: and God saw that it was good.

chinese: 神說：我們要照著我們的形像、按著我們的樣式造人，使他們管理海裡的魚、空中的鳥、地上的牲畜，和全地，並地上所爬的一切昆蟲。
english: And God said, Let us make man in our image, like us: and let him have rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over the cattle and over all the earth and over every living thing which goes flat on the earth.

chinese: 神就照著自己的形像造人，乃是照著他的形像造男造女。
english: And God made man in his image, in the image of God he made him: male and female he made them.

chinese: 神就賜福給他們，又對他們說：要生養眾多，遍滿地面，治理這地，也要管理海裡的魚、空中的鳥，和地上各樣行動的活物。
english: And God gave them his blessing and said to them, Be fertile and have increase, and make the earth full and be masters of it; be rulers over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over every living thing moving on the earth.

chinese: 神說：看哪，我將遍地上一切結種子的菜蔬和一切樹上所結有核的果子全賜給你們作食物。
english: And God said, See, I have given you every plant producing seed, on the face of all the earth, and every tree which has fruit producing seed: they will be for your food:

chinese: 至於地上的走獸和空中的飛鳥，並各樣爬在地上有生命的物，我將青草賜給他們作食物。事就這樣成了。
english: And to every beast of the earth and to every bird of the air and every living thing moving on the face of the earth I have given every green plant for food: and it was so.

chinese: 神看著一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，有早晨，是第六日。
english: And God saw everything which he had made and it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

chinese: 天地萬物都造齊了。
english: And the heaven and the earth and all things in them were complete.

chinese: 到第七日，神造物的工已經完畢，就在第七日歇了他一切的工，安息了。
english: And on the seventh day God came to the end of all his work; and on the seventh day he took his rest from all the work which he had done.

chinese: 神賜福給第七日，定為聖日；因為在這日，神歇了他一切創造的工，就安息了。
english: And God gave his blessing to the seventh day and made it holy: because on that day he took his rest from all the work which he had made and done.

chinese: 創造天地的來歷，在耶和華神造天地的日子，乃是這樣，
english: These are the generations of the heaven and the earth when they were made.

chinese: 野地還沒有草木，田間的菜蔬還沒有長起來；因為耶和華神還沒有降雨在地上，也沒有人耕地，
english: In the day when the Lord God made earth and heaven there were no plants of the field on the earth, and no grass had come up: for the Lord God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no man to do work on the land.

chinese: 但有霧氣從地上騰，滋潤遍地。
english: But a mist went up from the earth, watering all the face of the land.

chinese: 耶和華神用地上的塵土造人，將生氣吹在他鼻孔裡，他就成了有靈的活人，名叫亞當。
english: And the Lord God made man from the dust of the earth, breathing into him the breath of life: and man became a living soul.

chinese: 耶和華神在東方的伊甸立了一個園子，把所造的人安置在那裡。
english: And the Lord God made a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had made.

chinese: 耶和華神使各樣的樹從地裡長出來，可以悅人的眼目，其上的果子好作食物。園子當中又有生命樹和分別善惡的樹。
english: And out of the earth the Lord made every tree to come, delighting the eye and good for food; and in the middle of the garden, the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

chinese: 有河從伊甸流出來，滋潤那園子，從那裡分為四道：
english: And a river went out of Eden giving water to the garden; and from there it was parted and became four streams.

chinese: 第一道名叫比遜，就是環繞哈腓拉全地的。在那裡有金子，
english: The name of the first is Pishon, which goes round about all the land of Havilah where there is gold.

chinese: 並且那地的金子是好的；在那裡又有珍珠和紅瑪瑙。
english: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

chinese: 第二道河名叫基訓，就是環繞古實全地的。
english: And the name of the second river is Gihon: this river goes round all the land of Cush.

chinese: 第三道河名叫底格里斯，流在亞述的東邊。第四道河就是伯拉河。
english: And the name of the third river is Tigris, which goes to the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.

chinese: 耶和華神將那人安置在伊甸園，使他修理，看守。
english: And the Lord God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to do work in it and take care of it.

chinese: 耶和華神吩咐他說：園中各樣樹上的果子，你可以隨意吃，
english: And the Lord God gave the man orders, saying, You may freely take of the fruit of every tree of the garden:

chinese: 只是分別善惡樹上的果子，你不可吃，因為你吃的日子必定死！
english: But of the fruit of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you may not take; for on the day when you take of it, death will certainly come to you.

chinese: 耶和華神說：那人獨居不好，我要為他造一個配偶幫助他。
english: And the Lord God said, It is not good for the man to be by himself: I will make one like himself as a help to him

chinese: 耶和華神用土所造成的野地各樣走獸和空中各樣飛鳥都帶到那人面前，看他叫甚麼。那人怎樣叫各樣的活物，那就是他的名字。
english: And from the earth the Lord God made every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and took them to the man to see what names he would give them: and whatever name he gave to any living thing, that was its name.

chinese: 那人便給一切牲畜和空中飛鳥、野地走獸都起了名；只是那人沒有遇見配偶幫助他。
english: And the man gave names to all cattle and to the birds of the air and to every beast of the field; but Adam had no one like himself as a help.

chinese: 耶和華神使他沉睡，他就睡了；於是取下他的一條肋骨，又把肉合起來。
english: And the Lord God sent a deep sleep on the man, and took one of the bones from his side while he was sleeping, joining up the flesh again in its place:

chinese: 耶和華神就用那人身上所取的肋骨造成一個女人，領他到那人跟前。
english: And the bone which the Lord God had taken from the man he made into a woman, and took her to the man.

chinese: 那人說：這是我骨中的骨，肉中的肉，可以稱他為女人，因為他是從男人身上取出來的。
english: And the man said, This is now bone of my bone and flesh of my flesh: let her name be Woman because she was taken out of Man.

chinese: 因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
english: For this cause will a man go away from his father and his mother and be joined to his wife; and they will be one flesh.

chinese: 當時夫妻二人赤身露體，並不羞恥。
english: And the man and his wife were without clothing, and they had no sense of shame.

chinese: 耶和華神所造的，惟有蛇比田野一切的活物更狡猾。蛇對女人說：　神豈是真說不許你們吃園中所有樹上的果子麼？
english: Now the snake was wiser than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said to the woman, Has God truly said that you may not take of the fruit of any tree in the garden?

chinese: 女人對蛇說：園中樹上的果子，我們可以吃，
english: And the woman said, We may take of the fruit of the trees in the garden:

chinese: 惟有園當中那棵樹上的果子，神曾說：你們不可吃，也不可摸，免得你們死。
english: But of the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, God has said, If you take of it or put your hands on it, death will come to you.

chinese: 蛇對女人說：你們不一定死；
english: And the snake said, Death will not certainly come to you:

chinese: 因為神知道，你們吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你們便如神能知道善惡。
english: For God sees that on the day when you take of its fruit, your eyes will be open, and you will be as gods, having knowledge of good and evil.

chinese: 於是女人見那棵樹的果子好作食物，也悅人的眼目，且是可喜愛的，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子來吃了，又給他丈夫，他丈夫也吃了。
english: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and a delight to the eyes, and to be desired to make one wise, she took of its fruit, and gave it to her husband.

chinese: 他們二人的眼睛就明亮了，才知道自己是赤身露體，便拿無花果樹的葉子為自己編作裙子。
english: And their eyes were open and they were conscious that they had no clothing and they made themselves coats of leaves stitched together.

chinese: 天起了涼風，耶和華神在園中行走。那人和他妻子聽見　神的聲音，就藏在園裡的樹木中，躲避耶和華　神的面。
english: And there came to them the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the evening wind: and the man and his wife went to a secret place among the trees of the garden, away from the eyes of the Lord God.

chinese: 耶和華神呼喚那人，對他說：你在那裡？
english: And the voice of the Lord God came to the man, saying, Where are you?

chinese: 他說：我在園中聽見你的聲音，我就害怕；因為我赤身露體，我便藏了。
english: And he said, Hearing your voice in the garden I was full of fear, because I was without clothing: and I kept myself from your eyes.

chinese: 耶和華說：誰告訴你赤身露體呢？莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那樹上的果子嗎？
english: And he said, Who gave you the knowledge that you were without clothing? Have you taken of the fruit of the tree which I said you were not to take?

chinese: 那人說：你所賜給我與我同居的女人，他把那樹上的果子給我，我就吃了。
english: And the man said, The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me the fruit of the tree and I took it.

chinese: 耶和華神對女人說：你作的是甚麼事呢？女人說：那蛇引誘我，我就吃了。
english: And the Lord God said to the woman, What have you done? And the woman said, I was tricked by the deceit of the snake and I took it.

chinese: 耶和華神對蛇說：你既作了這事，就必受咒詛，比一切的牲畜野獸更甚。你必用肚子行走，終身吃土。
english: And the Lord God said to the snake, Because you have done this you are cursed more than all cattle and every beast of the field; you will go flat on the earth, and dust will be your food all the days of your life:

chinese: 我又要叫你和女人彼此為仇；你的後裔和女人的後裔也彼此為仇。女人的後裔要傷你的頭；你要傷他的腳跟。
english: And there will be war between you and the woman and between your seed and her seed: by him will your head be crushed and by you his foot will be wounded.

chinese: 又對女人說：我必多多加增你懷胎的苦楚；你生產兒女必多受苦楚。你必戀慕你丈夫；你丈夫必管轄你。
english: To the woman he said, Great will be your pain in childbirth; in sorrow will your children come to birth; still your desire will be for your husband, but he will be your master.

chinese: 又對亞當說：你既聽從妻子的話，吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那樹上的果子，地必為你的緣故受咒詛；你必終身勞苦才能從地裡得吃的。
english: And to Adam he said, Because you gave ear to the voice of your wife and took of the fruit of the tree which I said you were not to take, the earth is cursed on your account; in pain you will get your food from it all your life.

chinese: 地必給你長出荊棘和蒺藜來；你也要吃田間的菜蔬。
english: Thorns and waste plants will come up, and the plants of the field will be your food;

chinese: 你必汗流滿面才得糊口，直到你歸了土，因為你是從土而出的。你本是塵土，仍要歸於塵土。
english: With the hard work of your hands you will get your bread till you go back to the earth from which you were taken: for dust you are and to the dust you will go back.

chinese: 亞當給他妻子起名叫夏娃，因為他是眾生之母。
english: And the man gave his wife the name of Eve because she was the mother of all who have life.

chinese: 耶和華神為亞當和他妻子用皮子作衣服給他們穿。
english: And the Lord God made for Adam and for his wife coats of skins for their clothing.

chinese: 耶和華神說：那人已經與我們相似，能知道善惡；現在恐怕他伸手又摘生命樹的果子吃，就永遠活著。
english: And the Lord God said, Now the man has become like one of us, having knowledge of good and evil; and now if he puts out his hand and takes of the fruit of the tree of life, he will go on living for ever.

chinese: 耶和華神便打發他出伊甸園去，耕種他所自出之土。
english: So the Lord God sent him out of the garden of Eden to be a worker on the earth from which he was taken.

chinese: 於是把他趕出去了；又在伊甸園的東邊安設基路伯和四面轉動發火燄的劍，要把守生命樹的道路。
english: So he sent the man out; and at the east of the garden of Eden he put winged ones and a flaming sword turning every way to keep the way to the tree of life.

chinese: 有一日，那人和他妻子夏娃同房，夏娃就懷孕，生了該隱(就是得的意思)，便說：耶和華使我得了一個男子。
english: And the man had connection with Eve his wife, and she became with child and gave birth to Cain, and said, I have got a man from the Lord.

chinese: 又生了該隱的兄弟亞伯。亞伯是牧羊的；該隱是種地的。
english: Then again she became with child and gave birth to Abel, his brother. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a farmer.

chinese: 有一日，該隱拿地裡的出產為供物獻給耶和華
english: And after a time, Cain gave to the Lord an offering of the fruits of the earth.

chinese: 亞伯也將他羊群中頭生的和羊的脂油獻上。耶和華看中了亞伯和他的供物，
english: And Abel gave an offering of the young lambs of his flock and of their fat. And the Lord was pleased with Abel's offering;

chinese: 只是看不中該隱和他的供物。該隱就大大的發怒，變了臉色。
english: But in Cain and his offering he had no pleasure. And Cain was angry and his face became sad.

chinese: 耶和華對該隱說：你為甚麼發怒呢？你為甚麼變了臉色呢？
english: And the Lord said to Cain, Why are you angry? and why is your face sad?

chinese: 你若行得好，豈不蒙悅納？你若行得不好，罪就伏在門前。他必戀慕你，你卻要制伏他。
english: If you do well, will you not have honour? and if you do wrong, sin is waiting at the door, desiring to have you, but do not let it be your master.

chinese: 該隱與他兄弟亞伯說話；二人正在田間。該隱起來打他兄弟亞伯，把他殺了。
english: And Cain said to his brother, Let us go into the field: and when they were in the field, Cain made an attack on his brother Abel and put him to death.

chinese: 耶和華對該隱說：你兄弟亞伯在那裡？他說：我不知道！我豈是看守我兄弟的麼？
english: And the Lord said to Cain, Where is your brother Abel? And he said, I have no idea: am I my brother's keeper?

chinese: 耶和華說：你作了甚麼事呢？你兄弟的血有聲音從地裡向我哀告。
english: And he said, What have you done? the voice of your brother's blood is crying to me from the earth.

chinese: 地開了口，從你手裡接受你兄弟的血。現在你必從這地受咒詛。
english: And now you are cursed from the earth, whose mouth is open to take your brother's blood from your hand;

chinese: 你種地，地不再給你效力；你必流離飄蕩在地上。
english: No longer will the earth give you her fruit as the reward of your work; you will be a wanderer in flight over the earth.

chinese: 該隱對耶和華說：我的刑罰太重，過於我所能當的。
english: And Cain said, My punishment is greater than my strength.

chinese: 你如今趕逐我離開這地，以致不見你面；我必流離飄蕩在地上，凡遇見我的必殺我。
english: You have sent me out this day from the face of the earth and from before your face; I will be a wanderer in flight over the earth, and whoever sees me will put me to death.

chinese: 耶和華對他說：凡殺該隱的，必遭報七倍。耶和華就給該隱立一個記號，免得人遇見他就殺他。
english: And the Lord said, Truly, if Cain is put to death, seven lives will be taken for his. And the Lord put a mark on Cain so that no one might put him to death.

chinese: 於是該隱離開耶和華的面，去住在伊甸東邊挪得之地。
english: And Cain went away from before the face of the Lord, and made his living-place in the land of Nod on the east of Eden.

chinese: 該隱與妻子同房，他妻子就懷孕，生了以諾。該隱建造了一座城，就按著他兒子的名將那城叫作以諾。
english: And Cain had connection with his wife and she became with child and gave birth to Enoch: and he made a town, and gave the town the name of Enoch after his son.

chinese: 以諾生以拿；以拿生米戶雅利；米戶雅利生瑪土撒利；瑪土撒利生拉麥。
english: And Enoch had a son Irad: and Irad became the father of Mehujael: and Mehujael became the father of Methushael: and Methushael became the father of Lamech.

chinese: 拉麥娶了兩個妻：一個名叫亞大，一個名叫洗拉。
english: And Lamech had two wives; the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

chinese: 亞大生雅八；雅八就是住帳棚、牧養牲畜之人的祖師。
english: And Adah gave birth to Jabal: he was the father of such as are living in tents and keep cattle.

chinese: 雅八的兄弟名叫猶八；他是一切彈琴吹簫之人的祖師。
english: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all players on instruments of music.

chinese: 洗拉又生了土八該隱；他是打造各樣銅鐵利器的(或作：是銅匠鐵匠的祖師)。土八該隱的妹子是拿瑪。
english: And Zillah gave birth to Tubal-cain, who is the father of every maker of cutting instruments of brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.

chinese: 拉麥對他兩個妻子說：亞大、洗拉，聽我的聲音；拉麥的妻子，細聽我的話語：壯年人傷我，我把他殺了；少年人損我，我把他害了(或作我殺壯士卻傷自己，我害幼童卻損本身。)
english: And Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, give ear to my voice; you wives of Lamech, give attention to my words, for I would put a man to death for a wound, and a young man for a blow;

chinese: 若殺該隱，遭報七倍，殺拉麥，必遭報七十七倍。
english: If seven lives are to be taken as punishment for Cain's death, seventy-seven will be taken for Lamech's.

chinese: 亞當又與妻子同房，他就生了一個兒子，起名叫塞特，意思說：神另給我立了一個兒子代替亞伯，因為該隱殺了他。
english: And Adam had connection with his wife again, and she gave birth to a son to whom she gave the name of Seth: for she said, God has given me another seed in place of Abel, whom Cain put to death.

chinese: 塞特也生了一個兒子，起名叫以挪士。那時候，人才求告耶和華的名。
english: And Seth had a son, and he gave him the name of Enosh: at this time men first made use of the name of the Lord in worship.

chinese: 亞當的後代記在下面。〈當神造人的日子，是照著自己的樣式造的，
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day when God made man, he made him in the image of God;

chinese: 並且造男造女。在他們被造的日子，神賜福給他們，稱他們為人。〉
english: Male and female he made them, naming them Man, and giving them his blessing on the day when they were made.

chinese: 亞當活到一百三十歲，生了一個兒子，形像樣式和自己相似，就給他起名叫塞特。
english: Adam had been living for a hundred and thirty years when he had a son like himself, after his image, and gave him the name of Seth:

chinese: 亞當生塞特之後，又在世八百年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Seth, Adam went on living for eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 亞當共活了九百三十歲就死了。
english: And all the years of Adam's life were nine hundred and thirty: and he came to his end.

chinese: 塞特活到一百零五歲，生了以挪士。
english: And Seth was a hundred and five years old when he became the father of Enosh:

chinese: 塞特生以挪士之後，又活了八百零七年，並且生兒養女。
english: And he went on living after the birth of Enosh for eight hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 塞特共活了九百一十二歲就死了。
english: And all the years of Seth's life were nine hundred and twelve: and he came to his end.

chinese: 以挪士活到九十歲，生了該南。
english: And Enosh was ninety years old when he became the father of Kenan:

chinese: 以挪士生該南之後，又活了八百一十五年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Kenan, Enosh went on living for eight hundred and fifteen years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 以挪士共活了九百零五歲就死了。
english: And all the years of Enosh were nine hundred and five: and he came to his end.

chinese: 該南活到七十歲，生了瑪勒列。
english: And Kenan was seventy years old when he became the father of Mahalalel:

chinese: 該南生瑪勒列之後，又活了八百四十年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Mahalalel, Kenan went on living for eight hundred and forty years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 該南共活了九百一十歲就死了。
english: And all the years of Kenan's life were nine hundred and ten; and he came to his end.

chinese: 瑪勒列活到六十五歲，生了雅列。
english: And Mahalalel was sixty-five years old when he became the father of Jared:

chinese: 瑪勒列生雅列之後，又活了八百三十年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Jared, Mahalalel went on living for eight hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 瑪勒列共活了八百九十五歲就死了。
english: And all the years of Mahalalel's life were eight hundred and ninety-five: and he came to his end.

chinese: 雅列活到一百六十二歲，生了以諾。
english: And Jared was a hundred and sixty-two years old when he became the father of Enoch:

chinese: 雅列生以諾之後，又活了八百年，並且生兒養女。
english: And Jared went on living after the birth of Enoch for eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 雅列共活了九百六十二歲就死了.。
english: And all the years of Jared's life were nine hundred and sixty-two: and he came to his end.

chinese: 以諾活到六十五歲，生了瑪土撒拉。
english: And Enoch was sixty-five years old when he became the father of Methuselah:

chinese: 以諾生瑪土撒拉之後，與神同行三百年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Methuselah, Enoch went on in God's ways for three hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 以諾共活了三百六十五歲。
english: And all the years of Enoch's life were three hundred and sixty-five:

chinese: 以諾與神同行，　神將他取去，他就不在世了。
english: And Enoch went on in God's ways: and he was not seen again, for God took him.

chinese: 瑪土撒拉活到一百八十七歲，生了拉麥。
english: And Methuselah was a hundred and eighty-seven years old when he became the father of Lamech:

chinese: 瑪土撒拉生拉麥之後，又活了七百八十二年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Lamech, Methuselah went on living for seven hundred and eighty-two years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 瑪土撒拉共活了九百六十九歲就死了。
english: And all the years of Methuselah's life were nine hundred and sixty-nine: and he came to his end.

chinese: 拉麥活到一百八十二歲，生了一個兒子，
english: And Lamech was a hundred and eighty-two years old when he had a son:

chinese: 給他起名叫挪亞，說：這個兒子必為我們的操作和手中的勞苦安慰我們；這操作勞苦是因為耶和華咒詛地。
english: And he gave him the name of Noah, saying, Truly, he will give us rest from our trouble and the hard work of our hands, because of the earth which was cursed by God.

chinese: 拉麥生挪亞之後，又活了五百九十五年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Noah, Lamech went on living for five hundred and ninety-five years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 拉麥共活了七百七十七歲就死了。
english: And all the years of Lamech's life were seven hundred and seventy-seven: and he came to his end.

chinese: 挪亞五百歲生了閃、含、雅弗。
english: And when Noah was five hundred years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

chinese: 當人在世上多起來又生女兒的時候，
english: And after a time, when men were increasing on the earth, and had daughters,

chinese: 神的兒子們看見人的女子美貌，就隨意挑選，娶來為妻。
english: The sons of God saw that the daughters of men were fair; and they took wives for themselves from those who were pleasing to them.

chinese: 耶和華說：人既屬乎血氣，我的靈就不永遠住在他裡面；然而他的日子還可到一百二十年。
english: And the Lord said, My spirit will not be in man for ever, for he is only flesh; so the days of his life will be a hundred and twenty years.

chinese: 那時候有偉人在地上，後來神的兒子們和人的女子們交合生子；那就是上古英武有名的人。
english: There were men of great strength and size on the earth in those days; and after that, when the sons of God had connection with the daughters of men, they gave birth to children: these were the great men of old days, the men of great name.

chinese: 耶和華見人在地上罪惡很大，終日所思想的盡都是惡，
english: And the Lord saw that the sin of man was great on the earth, and that all the thoughts of his heart were evil.

chinese: 耶和華就後悔造人在地上，心中憂傷。
english: And the Lord had sorrow because he had made man on the earth, and grief was in his heart.

chinese: 耶和華說：我要將所造的人和走獸，並昆蟲，以及空中的飛鳥，都從地上除滅，因為我造他們後悔了。
english: And the Lord said, I will take away man, whom I have made, from the face of the earth, even man and beast and that which goes on the earth and every bird of the air; for I have sorrow for having made them.

chinese: 惟有挪亞在耶和華眼前蒙恩。
english: But Noah had grace in the eyes of God.

chinese: 挪亞的後代記在下面。挪亞是個義人，在當時的世代是個完全人。挪亞與神同行。
english: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was an upright man and without sin in his generation: he went in the ways of God.

chinese: 挪亞生了三個兒子，就是閃、含、雅弗。
english: And Noah had three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

chinese: 世界在神面前敗壞，地上滿了強暴.。
english: And the earth was evil in God's eyes and full of violent ways.

chinese: 神觀看世界，見是敗壞了；凡有血氣的人在地上.都敗壞了行為。
english: And God, looking on the earth, saw that it was evil: for the way of all flesh had become evil on the earth.

chinese: 神就對挪亞說：凡有血氣的人，他的盡頭已經來到我面前；因為地上滿了他們的強暴，我要把他們和地一併毀滅。
english: And God said to Noah, The end of all flesh has come; the earth is full of their violent doings, and now I will put an end to them with the earth.

chinese: 你要用歌斐木造一隻方舟，分一間一間地造，裡外抹上松香。
english: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood with rooms in it, and make it safe from the water inside and out.

chinese: 方舟的造法乃是這樣：要長三百肘，寬五十肘，高三十肘。
english: And this is the way you are to make it: it is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.

chinese: 方舟上邊要留透光處，高一肘。方舟的門要開在旁邊。方舟要分上、中、下三層。
english: You are to put a window in the ark, a cubit from the roof, and a door in the side of it, and you are to make it with a lower and second and third floors.

chinese: 看哪，我要使洪水氾濫在地上，毀滅天下；凡地上有血肉、有氣息的活物，無一不死。
english: For truly, I will send a great flow of waters over the earth, for the destruction from under the heaven of all flesh in which is the breath of life; everything on the earth will come to an end.

chinese: 我卻要與你立約；你同你的妻，與兒子兒婦，都要進入方舟。
english: But with you I will make an agreement; and you will come into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and your sons' wives with you.

chinese: 凡有血肉的活物，每樣兩個，一公一母，你要帶進方舟，好在你那裡保全生命。
english: And you will take with you into the ark two of every sort of living thing, and keep them safe with you; they will be male and female.

chinese: 飛鳥各從其類，牲畜各從其類，地上的昆蟲各從其類，每樣兩個，要到你那裡，好保全生命。
english: Two of every sort of bird and cattle and of every sort of living thing which goes on the earth will you take with you to keep them from destruction.

chinese: 你要拿各樣食物積蓄起來，好作你和他們的食物。
english: And make a store of every sort of food for yourself and them.

chinese: 挪亞就這樣行。凡神所吩咐的，他都照樣行了。
english: And all these things Noah did; as God said, so he did.

chinese: 耶和華對挪亞說：你和你的全家都要進入方舟；因為在這世代中，我見你在我面前是義人。
english: And the Lord said to Noah, Take all your family and go into the ark, for you only in this generation have I seen to be upright.

chinese: 凡潔淨的畜類，你要帶七公七母；不潔淨的畜類，你要帶一公一母；
english: Of every clean beast you will take seven males and seven females, and of the beasts which are not clean, two, the male and his female;

chinese: 空中的飛鳥也要帶七公七母，可以留種，活在全地上；
english: And of the birds of the air, seven males and seven females, so that their seed may still be living on the face of the earth.

chinese: 因為再過七天，我要降雨在地上四十晝夜，把我所造的各種活物都從地上除滅。
english: For after seven days I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, for the destruction of every living thing which I have made on the face of the earth.

chinese: 挪亞就遵著耶和華所吩咐的行了。
english: And Noah did everything which the Lord said he was to do.

chinese: 當洪水氾濫在地上的時候，挪亞整六百歲。
english: And Noah was six hundred years old when the waters came flowing over all the earth.

chinese: 挪亞就同他的妻和兒子兒婦都進入方舟，躲避洪水。
english: And Noah, with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives, went into the ark because of the flowing of the waters.

chinese: 潔淨的畜類和不潔淨的畜類，飛鳥並地上一切的昆蟲，
english: Of clean beasts, and of beasts which are not clean, and of birds, and of everything which goes on the earth,

chinese: 都是一對一對的，有公有母，到挪亞那裡進入方舟，正如神所吩咐挪亞的。
english: In twos, male and female, they went into the ark with Noah, as God had said.

chinese: 過了那七天，洪水氾濫在地上。
english: And after the seven days, the waters came over all the earth.

chinese: 當挪亞六百歲，二月十七日那一天，大淵的泉源都裂開了，天上的窗戶也敞開了
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, all the fountains of the great deep came bursting through, and the windows of heaven were open;

chinese: 四十晝夜降大雨在地上。
english: And rain came down on the earth for forty days and forty nights.

chinese: 正當那日，挪亞和他三個兒子閃、含、雅弗，並挪亞的妻子和三個兒婦，都進入方舟。
english: On the same day Noah, with Shem, Ham, and Japheth, his sons, and his wife and his sons' wives, went into the ark;

chinese: 他們和百獸，各從其類，一切牲畜，各從其類，爬在地上的昆蟲，各從其類，一切禽鳥，各從其類，都進入方舟。
english: And with them, every sort of beast and cattle, and every sort of thing which goes on the earth, and every sort of bird.

chinese: 凡有血肉、有氣息的活物，都一對一對地到挪亞那裡，進入方舟。
english: They went with Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh in which is the breath of life.

chinese: 凡有血肉進入方舟的，都是有公有母，正如神所吩咐挪亞的。耶和華就把他關在方舟裡頭。
english: Male and female of all flesh went in, as God had said, and the ark was shut by the Lord.

chinese: 洪水氾濫在地上四十天，水往上長，把方舟從地上漂起。
english: And for forty days the waters were over all the earth; and the waters were increased so that the ark was lifted up high over the earth.

chinese: 水勢浩大，在地上大大地往上長，方舟在水面上漂來漂去。
english: And the waters overcame everything and were increased greatly on the earth, and the ark was resting on the face of the waters.

chinese: 水勢在地上極其浩大，天下的高山都淹沒了。
english: And the waters overcame everything on the earth; and all the mountains under heaven were covered.

chinese: 水勢比山高過十五肘，山嶺都淹沒了。
english: The waters went fifteen cubits higher, till all the mountains were covered.

chinese: 凡在地上有血肉的動物，就是飛鳥、牲畜、走獸，和爬在地上的昆蟲，以及所有的人，都死了。
english: And destruction came on every living thing moving on the earth, birds and cattle and beasts and everything which went on the earth, and every man.

chinese: 凡在旱地上、鼻孔有氣息的生靈都死了。
english: Everything on the dry land, in which was the breath of life, came to its end.

chinese: 凡地上各類的活物，連人帶牲畜、昆蟲，以及空中的飛鳥，都從地上除滅了，只留下挪亞和那些與他同在方舟裡的。
english: Every living thing on the face of all the earth, man and cattle and things moving on the face of the earth, and birds of the air, came to destruction: only Noah and those who were with him in the ark, were kept from death.

chinese: 水勢浩大，在地上共一百五十天。
english: And the waters were over the earth a hundred and fifty days.

chinese: 神記念挪亞和挪亞方舟裡的一切走獸牲畜。神叫風吹地，水勢漸落。
english: And God kept Noah in mind, and all the living things and the cattle which were with him in the ark: and God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters went down.

chinese: 淵源和天上的窗戶都閉塞了，天上的大雨也止住了。
english: And the fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were shut, and the rain from heaven was stopped.

chinese: 水從地上漸退。過了一百五十天，水就漸消。
english: And the waters went slowly back from the earth, and at the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters were lower.

chinese: 七月十七日，方舟停在亞拉臘山上。
english: And on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

chinese: 水又漸消，到十月初一日，山頂都現出來了。
english: And still the waters went on falling, till on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains were seen.

chinese: 過了四十天，挪亞開了方舟的窗戶，
english: Then, after forty days, through the open window of the ark which he had made,

chinese: 放出一隻烏鴉去；那烏鴉飛來飛去，直到地上的水都乾了。
english: Noah sent out a raven, which went this way and that till the waters were gone from the earth.

chinese: 他又放出一隻鴿子去，要看看水從地上退了沒有。
english: And he sent out a dove, to see if the waters had gone from the face of the earth;

chinese: 但遍地上都是水，鴿子找不著落腳之地，就回到方舟挪亞那裡，挪亞伸手把鴿子接進方舟來。
english: But the dove saw no resting-place for her foot, and came back to the ark, for the waters were still over all the earth; and he put out his hand, and took her into the ark.

chinese: 他又等了七天，再把鴿子從方舟放出去。
english: And after waiting another seven days, he sent the dove out again;

chinese: 到了晚上，鴿子回到他那裡，嘴裡叼著一個新擰下來的橄欖葉子，挪亞就知道地上的水退了。
english: And the dove came back at evening, and in her mouth was an olive-leaf broken off: so Noah was certain that the waters had gone down on the earth.

chinese: 他又等了七天，放出鴿子去，鴿子就不再回來了。
english: And after seven days more, he sent the dove out again, but she did not come back to him.

chinese: 到挪亞六百零一歲，正月初一日，地上的水都乾了。挪亞撤去方舟的蓋觀看，便見地面上乾了。
english: And in the six hundred and first year, on the first day of the first month, the waters were dry on the earth: and Noah took the cover off the ark and saw that the face of the earth was dry.

chinese: 到了二月二十七日，地就都乾了。
english: And on the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was dry.

chinese: 神對挪亞說：
english: And God said to Noah,

chinese: 你和你的妻子、兒子、兒婦都可以出方舟。
english: Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons' wives.

chinese: 在你那裡凡有血肉的活物，就是飛鳥、牲畜，和一切爬在地上的昆蟲，都要帶出來，叫他在地上多多滋生，大大興旺。
english: Take out with you every living thing which is with you, birds and cattle and everything which goes on the earth, so that they may have offspring and be fertile and be increased on the earth.

chinese: 於是挪亞和他的妻子、兒子、兒婦都出來了。
english: And Noah went out with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives;

chinese: 一切走獸、昆蟲、飛鳥，和地上所有的動物，各從其類，也都出了方舟。
english: And every beast and bird and every living thing of every sort which goes on the earth, went out of the ark.

chinese: 挪亞為耶和華築了一座壇，拿各類潔淨的牲畜、飛鳥獻在壇上為燔祭。
english: And Noah made an altar to the Lord, and from every clean beast and bird he made burned offerings on the altar.

chinese: 耶和華聞那馨香之氣，就心裡說：我不再因人的緣故咒詛地（人從小時心裡懷著惡念），也不再按著我才行的滅各種的活物了。
english: And when the sweet smell came up to the Lord, he said in his heart, I will not again put a curse on the earth because of man, for the thoughts of man's heart are evil from his earliest days; never again will I send destruction on all living things as I have done.

chinese: 地還存留的時候，稼穡、寒暑、冬夏、晝夜就永不停息了。
english: While the earth goes on, seed time and the getting in of the grain, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night, will not come to an end.

chinese: 神賜福給挪亞和他的兒子，對他們說：你們要生養眾多，遍滿了地。
english: And God gave his blessing to Noah and his sons, and said, Be fertile, and have increase, and make the earth full.

chinese: 凡地上的走獸和空中的飛鳥都必驚恐，懼怕你們，連地上一切的昆蟲並海裡一切的魚都交付你們的手。
english: And the fear of you will be strong in every beast of the earth and every bird of the air; everything which goes on the land, and all the fishes of the sea, are given into your hands.

chinese: 凡活著的動物都可以作你們的食物。這一切我都賜給你們，如同菜蔬一樣。
english: Every living and moving thing will be food for you; I give them all to you as before I gave you all green things.

chinese: 惟獨肉帶著血，那就是他的生命，你們不可吃。
english: But flesh with the life-blood in it you may not take for food.

chinese: 流你們血、害你們命的，無論是獸是人，我必討他的罪，就是向各人的弟兄也是如此。
english: And for your blood, which is your life, will I take payment; from every beast I will take it, and from every man will I take payment for the blood of his brother-man.

chinese: 凡流人血的，他的血也必被人所流，因為神造人是照自己的形像造的。
english: Whoever takes a man's life, by man will his life be taken; because God made man in his image.

chinese: 你們要生養眾多，在地上昌盛繁茂。
english: And now, be fertile and have increase; have offspring on the earth and become great in number.

chinese: 神曉諭挪亞和他的兒子說：
english: And God said to Noah and to his sons,

chinese: 我與你們和你們的後裔立約，
english: Truly, I will make my agreement with you and with your seed after you,

chinese: 並與你們這裡的一切活物─就是飛鳥、牲畜、走獸，凡從方舟裡出來的活物─立約。
english: And with every living thing with you, all birds and cattle and every beast of the earth which comes out of the ark with you.

chinese: 我與你們立約，凡有血肉的，不再被洪水滅絕，也不再有洪水毀壞地了。
english: And I will make my agreement with you; never again will all flesh be cut off by the waters; never again will the waters come over all the earth for its destruction.

chinese: 神說：我與你們並你們這裡的各樣活物所立的永約是有記號的。
english: And God said, This is the sign of the agreement which I make between me and you and every living thing with you, for all future generations:

chinese: 我把虹放在雲彩中，這就可作我與地立約的記號了。
english: I will put my bow in the cloud and it will be for a sign of the agreement between me and the earth.

chinese: 我使雲彩蓋地的時候，必有虹現在雲彩中，
english: And whenever I make a cloud come over the earth, the bow will be seen in the cloud,

chinese: 我便記念我與你們和各樣有血肉的活物所立的約，水就再不氾濫、毀壞一切有血肉的物了。
english: And I will keep in mind the agreement between me and you and every living thing; and never again will there be a great flow of waters causing destruction to all flesh.

chinese: 虹必現在雲彩中，我看見，就要記念我與地上各樣有血肉的活物所立的永約。
english: And the bow will be in the cloud, and looking on it, I will keep in mind the eternal agreement between God and every living thing on the earth.

chinese: 神對挪亞說：這就是我與地上一切有血肉之物立約的記號了。
english: And God said to Noah, This is the sign of the agreement which I have made between me and all flesh on the earth.

chinese: 出方舟挪亞的兒子就是閃、含、雅弗。含是迦南的父親。
english: And the sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and Ham is the father of Canaan.

chinese: 這是挪亞的三個兒子，他們的後裔分散在全地。
english: These three were the sons of Noah and from them all the earth was peopled.

chinese: 挪亞作起農夫來，栽了一個葡萄園。
english: In those days Noah became a farmer, and he made a vine-garden.

chinese: 他喝了園中的酒便醉了，在帳棚裡赤著身子。
english: And he took of the wine of it and was overcome by drink; and he was uncovered in his tent.

chinese: 迦南的父親含看見他父親赤身，就到外邊告訴他兩個弟兄。
english: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father unclothed, and gave news of it to his two brothers outside.

chinese: 於是閃和雅弗拿件衣服搭在肩上，倒退著進去，給他父親蓋上；他們背著臉就看不見父親的赤身。
english: And Shem and Japheth took a robe, and putting it on their backs went in with their faces turned away, and put it over their father so that they might not see him unclothed.

chinese: 挪亞醒了酒，知道小兒子向他所作的事，
english: And, awaking from his wine, Noah saw what his youngest son had done to him, and he said,

chinese: 就說：迦南當受咒詛，必給他弟兄作奴僕的奴僕；
english: Cursed be Canaan; let him be a servant of servants to his brothers.

chinese: 又說：耶和華─閃的神是應當稱頌的！願迦南作閃的奴僕。
english: And he said, Praise to the Lord, the God of Shem; let Canaan be his servant.

chinese: 願神使雅弗擴張，使他住在閃的帳棚裡；又願迦南作他的奴僕。
english: May God make Japheth great, and let his living-place be in the tents of Shem, and let Canaan be his servant.

chinese: 洪水以後，挪亞又活了三百五十年。
english: And Noah went on living three hundred and fifty years after the great flow of waters;

chinese: 挪亞共活了九百五十歲就死了。
english: all the years of his life were nine hundred and fifty: and he came to his end.

chinese: 挪亞的兒子閃、含、雅弗的後代記在下面。洪水以後，他們都生了兒子。
english: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: these are the sons which they had after the great flow of waters

chinese: 雅弗的兒子是歌篾、瑪各、瑪代、雅完、土巴、米設、提拉。
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

chinese: 歌篾的兒子是亞實基拿、利法、陀迦瑪。
english: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah.

chinese: 雅完的兒子是以利沙、他施、基提、多單。
english: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, the Kittim and the Dodanim.

chinese: 這些人的後裔將各國的地土、海島分開居住，各隨各的方言、宗族立國。
english: From these came the nations of the sea-lands, with their different families and languages.

chinese: 含的兒子是古實、麥西、弗、迦南。
english: And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim and Put and Canaan.

chinese: 古實的兒子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉瑪、撒弗提迦。拉瑪的兒子是示巴、底但。
english: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabtah and Raamah and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

chinese: 古實又生寧錄，他為世上英雄之首。
english: And Cush was the father of Nimrod, who was the first of the great men of the earth.

chinese: 他在耶和華面前是個英勇的獵戶，所以俗語說：像寧錄在耶和華面前是個英勇的獵戶。
english: He was a very great bowman, so that there is a saying, Like Nimrod, a very great bowman.

chinese: 他國的起頭是巴別、以力、亞甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。
english: And at the first, his kingdom was Babel and Erech and Accad and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

chinese: 他從那地出來往亞述去，建造尼尼微、利河伯、迦拉，
english: From that land he went out into Assyria, building Nineveh with its wide streets and Calah,

chinese: 和尼尼微、迦拉中間的利鮮，這就是那大城。
english: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah, which is a very great town.

chinese: 麥西生路低人、亞拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
english: And Mizraim was the father of the Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and Naphtuhim;

chinese: 帕斯魯細人、迦斯路希人、迦斐託人；從迦斐託出來的有非利士人。
english: And Pathrusim and Casluhim and Caphtorim, from whom came the Philistines.

chinese: 迦南生長子西頓，又生赫
english: And Canaan was the father of Zidon, who was his oldest son, and Heth,

chinese: 和耶布斯人、亞摩利人、革迦撒人、
english: And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,

chinese: 希未人、亞基人、西尼人、
english: And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,

chinese: 亞瓦底人、洗瑪利人、哈馬人，後來迦南的諸族分散了。
english: And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite; after that the families of the Canaanites went far and wide in all directions;

chinese: 迦南的境界是從西頓向基拉耳的路上，直到迦薩，又向所多瑪、蛾摩拉、押瑪、洗扁的路上，直到拉沙。
english: Their country stretching from Zidon to Gaza, in the direction of Gerar; and to Lasha, in the direction of Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim.

chinese: 這就是含的後裔，各隨他們的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦國。
english: All these, with their different families, languages, lands, and nations, are the offspring of Ham.

chinese: 雅弗的哥哥閃，是希伯子孫之祖，他也生了兒子。
english: And Shem, the older brother of Japheth, the father of the children of Eber, had other sons in addition.

chinese: 閃的兒子是以攔、亞述、亞法撒、路德、亞蘭。
english: These are the sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram.

chinese: 亞蘭的兒子是烏斯、戶勒、基帖、瑪施。
english: And the sons of Aram: Uz and Hul and Gether and Mash.

chinese: 亞法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
english: And Arpachshad became the father of Shelah; and Shelah became the father of Eber.

chinese: 希伯生了兩個兒子，一個名叫法勒(法勒就是分的意思)，因為那時人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫約坍。
english: And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his time the peoples of the earth became separate; and his brother's name was Joktan.

chinese: 約坍生亞摩答、沙列、哈薩瑪非、耶拉、
english: And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah

chinese: 哈多蘭、烏薩、德拉、
english: And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah

chinese: 俄巴路、亞比瑪利、示巴、
english: And Obal and Abimael and Sheba

chinese: 阿斐、哈腓拉、約巴，這都是約坍的兒子。
english: And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.

chinese: 他們所住的地方是從米沙直到西發東邊的山。
english: And their country was from Mesha, in the direction of Sephar, the mountain of the east.

chinese: 這就是閃的子孫，各隨他們的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦國。
english: These, with their families and their languages and their lands and their nations, are the offspring of Shem.

chinese: 這些都是挪亞三個兒子的宗族，各隨他們的支派立國。洪水以後，他們在地上分為邦國。
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, in the order of their generations and their nations: from these came all the nations of the earth after the great flow of waters.

chinese: 那時，天下人的口音、言語都是一樣。
english: And all the earth had one language and one tongue.

chinese: 他們往東邊遷移的時候，在示拿地遇見一片平原，就住在那裡。
english: And it came about that in their wandering from the east, they came to a stretch of flat country in the land of Shinar, and there they made their living-place.

chinese: 他們彼此商量說：來罷！我們要作磚，把磚燒透了。他們就拿磚當石頭，又拿石漆當灰泥。
english: And they said one to another, Come, let us make bricks, burning them well. And they had bricks for stone, putting them together with sticky earth.

chinese: 他們說：來罷！我們要建造一座城和一座塔，塔頂通天，為要傳揚我們的名，免得我們分散在全地上。
english: And they said, Come, let us make a town, and a tower whose top will go up as high as heaven; and let us make a great name for ourselves, so that we may not be wanderers over the face of the earth.

chinese: 耶和華降臨，要看看世人所建造的城和塔。
english: And the Lord came down to see the town and the tower which the children of men were building.

chinese: 耶和華說：看哪，他們成為一樣的人民，都是一樣的言語，如今既作起這事來，以後他們所要作的事就沒有不成就的了。
english: And the Lord said, See, they are all one people and have all one language; and this is only the start of what they may do: and now it will not be possible to keep them from any purpose of theirs.

chinese: 我們下去，在那裡變亂他們的口音，使他們的言語彼此不通。
english: Come, let us go down and take away the sense of their language, so that they will not be able to make themselves clear to one another.

chinese: 於是耶和華使他們從那裡分散在全地上；他們就停工，不造那城了。
english: So the Lord God sent them away into every part of the earth: and they gave up building their town.

chinese: 因為耶和華在那裡變亂天下人的言語，使眾人分散在全地上，所以那城名叫巴別(就是變亂的意思)。
english: So it was named Babel, because there the Lord took away the sense of all languages and from there the Lord sent them away over all the face of the earth.

chinese: 閃的後代記在下面。洪水以後二年，閃一百歲生了亞法撒。
english: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad, two years after the great flow of waters;

chinese: 閃生亞法撒之後又活了五百年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Arpachshad, Shem went on living for five hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 亞法撒活到三十五歲，生了沙拉。
english: And Arpachshad was thirty-five years old when he became the father of Shelah:

chinese: 亞法撒生沙拉之後又活了四百零三年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Shelah, Arpachshad went on living for four hundred and three years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 沙拉活到三十歲，生了希伯。
english: And Shelah was thirty years old when he became the father of Eber:

chinese: 沙拉生希伯之後又活了四百零三年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Eber, Shelah went on living for four hundred and three years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 希伯活到三十四歲，生了法勒。
english: And Eber was thirty-four years old when he became the father of Peleg:

chinese: 希伯生法勒之後又活了四百三十年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Peleg, Eber went on living for four hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 法勒活到三十歲，生了拉吳。
english: And Peleg was thirty years old when he became the father of Reu:

chinese: 法勒生拉吳之後又活了二百零九年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Reu, Peleg went on living for two hundred and nine years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 拉吳活到三十二歲，生了西鹿。
english: And Reu was thirty-two years old when he became the father of Serug:

chinese: 拉吳生西鹿之後又活了二百零七年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Serug, Reu went on living for two hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 西鹿活到三十歲，生了拿鶴。
english: And Serug was thirty years old when he became the father of Nahor:

chinese: 西鹿生拿鶴之後又活了二百年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Nahor, Serug went on living for two hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 拿鶴活到二十九歲，生了他拉。
english: And Nahor was twenty-nine years old when he became the father of Terah:

chinese: 拿鶴生他拉之後又活了一百一十九年，並且生兒養女。
english: And after the birth of Terah, Nahor went on living for a hundred and nineteen years, and had sons and daughters:

chinese: 他拉活到七十歲，生了亞伯蘭、拿鶴、哈蘭。
english: And Terah was seventy years old when he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

chinese: 他拉的後代記在下面。他拉生亞伯蘭、拿鶴、哈蘭；哈蘭生羅得。
english: These are the generations of Terah: Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran was the father of Lot.

chinese: 哈蘭死在他的本地迦勒底的吾珥，在他父親他拉之先。
english: And death came to Haran when he was with his father Terah in the land of his birth, Ur of the Chaldees.

chinese: 亞伯蘭、拿鶴各娶了妻：亞伯蘭的妻子名叫撒萊；拿鶴的妻子名叫密迦，是哈蘭的女兒；哈蘭是密迦和亦迦的父親。
english: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah and Iscah.

chinese: 撒萊不生育，沒有孩子。
english: And Sarai had no child.

chinese: 他拉帶著他兒子亞伯蘭和他孫子哈蘭的兒子羅得，並他兒婦亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊，出了迦勒底的吾珥，要往迦南地去；他們走到哈蘭，就住在那裡。
english: And Terah took Abram, his son, and Lot, the son of Haran, and Sarai, his daughter-in-law, the wife of his son Abram and they went out from Ur of the Chaldees, to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran, and were there for some time.

chinese: 他拉共活了二百零五歲，就死在哈蘭。
english: And all the years of Terah's life were two hundred and five: and Terah came to his end in Haran.

chinese: 耶和華對亞伯蘭說：你要離開本地、本族、父家，往我所要指示你的地去。
english: Now the Lord said to Abram, Go out from your country and from your family and from your father's house, into the land to which I will be your guide:

chinese: 我必叫你成為大國。我必賜福給你，叫你的名為大；你也要叫別人得福。
english: And I will make of you a great nation, blessing you and making your name great; and you will be a blessing:

chinese: 為你祝福的，我必賜福與他；那咒詛你的，我必咒詛他。地上的萬族都要因你得福。
english: To them who are good to you will I give blessing, and on him who does you wrong will I put my curse: and you will become a name of blessing to all the families of the earth.

chinese: 亞伯蘭就照著耶和華的吩咐去了；羅得也和他同去。亞伯蘭出哈蘭的時候年七十五歲。
english: So Abram went as the Lord had said to him, and Lot went with him: Abram was seventy-five years old when he went away from Haran.

chinese: 亞伯蘭將他妻子撒萊和姪兒羅得，連他們在哈蘭所積蓄的財物、所得的人口，都帶往迦南地去。他們就到了迦南地。
english: And Abram took Sarai, his wife, and Lot, his brother's son, and all their goods and the servants which they had got in Haran, and they went out to go to the land of Canaan.

chinese: 亞伯蘭經過那地，到了示劍地方、摩利橡樹那裡。那時迦南人住在那地。
english: And Abram went through the land till he came to Shechem, to the holy tree of Moreh. At that time, the Canaanites were still living in the land.

chinese: 耶和華向亞伯蘭顯現，說：我要把這地賜給你的後裔。亞伯蘭就在那裡為向他顯現的耶和華築了一座壇。
english: And the Lord came to Abram, and said, I will give all this land to your seed; then Abram made an altar there to the Lord who had let himself be seen by him.

chinese: 從那裡他又遷到伯特利東邊的山，支搭帳棚；西邊是伯特利，東邊是艾。他在那裡又為耶和華築了一座壇，求告耶和華的名。
english: And moving on from there to the mountain on the east of Beth-el, he put up his tent, having Beth-el on the west and Ai on the east: and there he made an altar and gave worship to the name of the Lord.

chinese: 後來亞伯蘭又漸漸遷往南地去。
english: And he went on, journeying still to the South.

chinese: 那地遭遇饑荒。因饑荒甚大，亞伯蘭就下埃及去，要在那裡暫居。
english: And because there was little food to be had in that land, he went down into Egypt.

chinese: 將近埃及，就對他妻子撒萊說：我知道你是容貌俊美的婦人。
english: Now when he came near to Egypt, he said to Sarai, his wife, Truly, you are a fair woman and beautiful to the eye;

chinese: 埃及人看見你必說：這是他的妻子，他們就要殺我，卻叫你存活。
english: And I am certain that when the men of Egypt see you, they will say, This is his wife: and they will put me to death and keep you.

chinese: 求你說，你是我的妹子，使我因你得平安，我的命也因你存活。
english: Say, then, that you are my sister, and so it will be well with me because of you, and my life will be kept safe on your account.

chinese: 及至亞伯蘭到了埃及，埃及人看見那婦人極其美貌。
english: And so it was that when Abram came into Egypt, the men of Egypt, looking on the woman, saw that she was fair.

chinese: 法老的臣宰看見了他，就在法老面前誇獎他。那婦人就被帶進法老的宮去。
english: And Pharaoh's great men, having seen her, said words in praise of her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into Pharaoh's house.

chinese: 法老因這婦人就厚待亞伯蘭，亞伯蘭得了許多牛、羊、駱駝、公驢、母驢、僕婢。
english: And because of her, he was good to Abram, and he had sheep and oxen and asses, and men-servants and women-servants, and camels.

chinese: 耶和華因亞伯蘭妻子撒萊的緣故，降大災與法老和他的全家。
english: And the Lord sent great troubles on Pharaoh's house because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

chinese: 法老就召了亞伯蘭來，說：你這向我作的是甚麼事呢？為甚麼沒有告訴我他是你的妻子？
english: Then Pharaoh sent for Abram, and said, What have you done to me? why did you not say that she was your wife?

chinese: 為甚麼說他是你的妹子，以致我把他取來要作我的妻子？現在你的妻子在這裡，可以帶他走罷。
english: Why did you say that she was your sister? so that I took her for my wife: now, take your wife and go on your way.

chinese: 於是法老吩咐人將亞伯蘭和他妻子，並他所有的都送走了。
english: And Pharaoh gave orders to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and all he had.

chinese: 亞伯蘭帶著他的妻子與羅得，並一切所有的，都從埃及上南地去。
english: And Abram went up out of Egypt with his wife and all he had, and Lot with him, and they came in to the South.

chinese: 亞伯蘭的金、銀、牲畜極多。
english: Now Abram had great wealth of cattle and silver and gold.

chinese: 他從南地漸漸往伯特利去，到了伯特利和艾的中間，就是從前支搭帳棚的地方，
english: And travelling on from the South, he came to Beth-el, to the place where his tent had been before, between Beth-el and Ai;

chinese: 也是他起先築壇的地方；他又在那裡求告耶和華的名。
english: To the place where he had made his first altar, and there Abram gave worship to the name of the Lord.

chinese: 與亞伯蘭同行的羅得也有牛群、羊群、帳棚。
english: And Lot, who went with him, had flocks and herds and tents;

chinese: 那地容不下他們；因為他們的財物甚多，使他們不能同居。
english: So that the land was not wide enough for the two of them: their property was so great that there was not room for them together.

chinese: 當時，迦南人與比利洗人在那地居住。亞伯蘭的牧人和羅得的牧人相爭。
english: And there was an argument between the keepers of Abram's cattle and the keepers of Lot's cattle: at that time the Canaanites and Perizzites were still living in the land.

chinese: 亞伯蘭就對羅得說：你我不可相爭，你的牧人和我的牧人也不可相爭，因為我們是骨肉(原文作弟兄)。
english: Then Abram said to Lot, Let there be no argument between me and you, and between my herdmen and your herdmen, for we are brothers.

chinese: 遍地不都在你眼前麼？請你離開我：你向左，我就向右；你向右，我就向左。
english: Is not all the land before you? then let us go our separate ways: if you go to the left, I will go to the right; or if you take the right, I will go to the left.

chinese: 羅得舉目看見約但河的全平原，直到瑣珥，都是滋潤的，那地在耶和華未滅所多瑪、蛾摩拉以先如同耶和華的園子，也像埃及地。
english: And Lot, lifting up his eyes and looking an the valley of Jordan, saw that it was well watered everywhere, before the Lord had sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah; it was like the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, on the way to Zoar.

chinese: 於是羅得選擇約但河的全平原，往東遷移；他們就彼此分離了。
english: So Lot took for himself all the valley of Jordan, and went to the east, and they were parted from one another.

chinese: 亞伯蘭住在迦南地，羅得住在平原的城邑，漸漸挪移帳棚，直到所多瑪。
english: Abram went on living in the land of Canaan, and Lot went to the lowland towns, moving his tent as far as Sodom.

chinese: 所多瑪人在耶和華面前罪大惡極。
english: Now the men of Sodom were evil, and great sinners before the Lord.

chinese: 羅得離別亞伯蘭以後，耶和華對亞伯蘭說：從你所在的地方，你舉目向東西南北觀看；
english: And the Lord had said to Abram, after Lot was parted from him, From this place where you are take a look to the north and to the south, to the east and to the west:

chinese: 凡你所看見的一切地，我都要賜給你和你的後裔，直到永遠。
english: For all the land which you see I will give to you and to your seed for ever.

chinese: 我也要使你的後裔如同地上的塵沙那樣多，人若能數算地上的塵沙才能數算你的後裔。
english: And I will make your children like the dust of the earth, so that if the dust of the earth may be numbered, then will your children be numbered.

chinese: 你起來，縱橫走遍這地，因為我必把這地賜給你。
english: Come, go through all the land from one end to the other for I will give it to you.

chinese: 亞伯蘭就搬了帳棚，來到希伯崙幔利的橡樹那裡居住，在那裡為耶和華築了一座壇。
english: And Abram, moving his tent, came and made his living-place by the holy tree of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and made an altar there to the Lord.

chinese: 當暗拉非作示拿王，亞略作以拉撒王，基大老瑪作以攔王，提達作戈印王的時候，
english: Now in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,

chinese: 他們都攻打所多瑪王比拉、蛾摩拉王比沙、押瑪王示納、洗扁王善以別，和比拉王；比拉就是瑣珥。
english: They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (which is Zoar).

chinese: 這五王都在西訂谷會合；西訂谷就是鹽海。
english: All these came together in the valley of Siddim (which is the Salt Sea).

chinese: 他們已經事奉基大老瑪十二年，到十三年就背叛了。
english: For twelve years they were under the rule of Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they put off his control.

chinese: 十四年，基大老瑪和同盟的王都來在亞特律加寧，殺敗了利乏音人，在哈麥殺敗了蘇西人，在沙微基列亭殺敗了以米人，
english: And in the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings who were on his side, overcame the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,

chinese: 在何利人的西珥山殺敗了何利人，一直殺到靠近曠野的伊勒巴蘭。
english: And the Horites in their mountain Seir, driving them as far as El-paran, which is near the waste land.

chinese: 他們回到安密巴，就是加低斯，殺敗了亞瑪力全地的人，以及住在哈洗遜他瑪的亞摩利人。
english: Then they came back to En-mishpat (which is Kadesh), making waste all the country of the Amalekites and of the Amorites living in Hazazon-tamar.

chinese: 於是所多瑪王、蛾摩拉王、押瑪王、洗扁王，和比拉王（比拉就是瑣珥）都出來，在西訂谷擺陣，與他們交戰，
english: And the king of Sodom with the king of Gomorrah and the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela (that is Zoar), went out, and put their forces in position in the valley of Siddim,

chinese: 就是與以攔王基大老瑪、戈印王提達、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亞略交戰；乃是四王與五王交戰。
english: Against Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Ellasar: four kings against the five.

chinese: 西訂谷有許多石漆坑。所多瑪王和蛾摩拉王逃跑，有掉在坑裡的，其餘的人都往山上逃跑。
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of holes of sticky earth; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah were put to flight and came to their end there, but the rest got away to the mountain.

chinese: 四王就把所多瑪和蛾摩拉所有的財物，並一切的糧食都擄掠去了；
english: And the four kings took all the goods and food from Sodom and Gomorrah and went on their way.

chinese: 又把亞伯蘭的姪兒羅得和羅得的財物擄掠去了。當時羅得正住在所多瑪。
english: And in addition they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who was living in Sodom, and all his goods.

chinese: 有一個逃出來的人告訴希伯來人亞伯蘭；亞伯蘭正住在亞摩利人幔利的橡樹那裡。幔利和以實各並亞乃都是弟兄，曾與亞伯蘭聯盟。
english: And one who had got away from the fight came and gave word of it to Abram the Hebrew, who was living by the holy tree of Mamre, the Amorite, the brother of Eshcol and Aner, who were friends of Abram.

chinese: 亞伯蘭聽見他姪兒(原文作弟兄)被擄去，就率領他家裡生養的精練壯丁三百一十八人，直追到但，
english: And Abram, hearing that his brother's son had been made a prisoner, took a band of his trained men, three hundred and eighteen of them, sons of his house, and went after them as far as Dan.

chinese: 便在夜間，自己同僕人分隊殺敗敵人，又追到大馬色左邊的何把，
english: And separating his forces by night, he overcame them, putting them to flight and going after them as far as Hobah, which is on the north side of Damascus.

chinese: 將被擄掠的一切財物奪回來，連他姪兒羅得和他的財物，以及婦女、人民也都奪回來。
english: And he got back all the goods, and Lot, his brother's son, with his goods and the women and the people.

chinese: 亞伯蘭殺敗基大老瑪和與他同盟的王回來的時候，所多瑪王出來，在沙微谷迎接他；沙微谷就是王谷。
english: And when he was coming back after putting to flight Chedorlaomer and the other kings, he had a meeting with the king of Sodom in the valley of Shaveh, that is, the King's Valley.

chinese: 又有撒冷王麥基洗德帶著餅和酒出來迎接；他是至高神的祭司。
english: And Melchizedek, king of Salem, the priest of the Most High God, took bread and wine,

chinese: 他為亞伯蘭祝福，說：願天地的主、至高的神賜福與亞伯蘭！
english: And blessing him, said, May the blessing of the Most High God, maker of heaven and earth, be on Abram:

chinese: 至高的神把敵人交在你手裡，是應當稱頌的！亞伯蘭就把所得的拿出十分之一來，給麥基洗德。
english: And let the Most High God be praised, who has given into your hands those who were against you. Then Abram gave him a tenth of all the goods he had taken.

chinese: 所多瑪王對亞伯蘭說：你把人口給我，財物你自己拿去罷！
english: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the prisoners and take the goods for yourself.

chinese: 亞伯蘭對所多瑪王說：我已經向天地的主─至高的神耶和華起誓：
english: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have taken an oath to the Lord, the Most High God, maker of heaven and earth,

chinese: 凡是你的東西，就是一根線、一根鞋帶，我都不拿，免得你說：我使亞伯蘭富足！
english: That I will not take so much as a thread or the cord of a shoe of yours; so that you may not say, I have given wealth to Abram:

chinese: 只有僕人所吃的，並與我同行的亞乃、以實各、幔利所應得的分，可以任憑他們拿去。
english: Give me nothing but the food which the fighting-men who went with me have had; but let Aner and Eshcol and Mamre have their part of the goods.

chinese: 這事以後，耶和華在異象中有話對亞伯蘭說：亞伯蘭，你不要懼怕！我是你的盾牌，必大大的賞賜你。
english: After these things, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Have no fear, Abram: I will keep you safe, and great will be your reward.

chinese: 亞伯蘭說：主耶和華阿，我既無子，你還賜我甚麼呢？並且要承受我家業的是大馬色人以利以謝。
english: And Abram said, What will you give me? for I have no child and this Eliezer of Damascus will have all my wealth after me.

chinese: 亞伯蘭又說：你沒有給我兒子；那生在我家中的人就是我的後嗣。
english: And Abram said, You have given me no child, and a servant in my house will get the heritage.

chinese: 耶和華又有話對他說：這人必不成為你的後嗣；你本身所生的才成為你的後嗣。
english: Then said the Lord, This man will not get the heritage, but a son of your body will have your property after you.

chinese: 於是領他走到外邊，說：你向天觀看，數算眾星，能數得過來麼？又對他說：你的後裔將要如此。
english: And he took him out into the open air, and said to him, Let your eyes be lifted to heaven, and see if the stars may be numbered; even so will your seed be.

chinese: 亞伯蘭信耶和華，耶和華就以此為他的義。
english: And he had faith in the Lord, and it was put to his account as righteousness.

chinese: 耶和華又對他說：我是耶和華，曾領你出了迦勒底的吾珥，為要將這地賜你為業。
english: And he said to him, I am the Lord, who took you from Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land for your heritage.

chinese: 亞伯蘭說：主耶和華阿，我怎能知道必得這地為業呢？
english: And he said, O Lord God, how may I be certain that it will be mine?

chinese: 他說：你為我取一隻三年的母牛，一隻三年的母山羊，一隻三年的公綿羊，一隻斑鳩，一隻雛鴿。
english: And he said, Take a young cow of three years old, and a she-goat of three years old, and a sheep of three years old, and a dove and a young pigeon.

chinese: 亞伯蘭就取了這些來，每樣劈開，分成兩半，一半對著一半地擺列，只有鳥沒有劈開。
english: All these he took, cutting them in two and putting one half opposite the other, but not cutting the birds in two.

chinese: 有鷙鳥下來，落在那死畜的肉上，亞伯蘭就把他嚇飛了。
english: And evil birds came down on the bodies, but Abram sent them away.

chinese: 日頭正落的時候，亞伯蘭沉沉地睡了；忽然有驚人的大黑暗落在他身上。
english: Now when the sun was going down, a deep sleep came on Abram, and a dark cloud of fear.

chinese: 耶和華對亞伯蘭說：你要的確知道，你的後裔必寄居別人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他們四百年。
english: And he said to Abram, Truly, your seed will be living in a land which is not theirs, as servants to a people who will be cruel to them for four hundred years;

chinese: 並且他們所要服事的那國，我要懲罰，後來他們必帶著許多財物從那裡出來。
english: But I will be the judge of that nation whose servants they are, and they will come out from among them with great wealth.

chinese: 但你要享大壽數，平平安安地歸到你列祖那裡，被人埋葬。
english: As for you, you will go to your fathers in peace; at the end of a long life you will be put in your last resting-place.

chinese: 到了第四代，他們必回到此地，因為亞摩利人的罪孽還沒有滿盈。
english: And in the fourth generation they will come back here; for at present the sin of the Amorite is not full.

chinese: 日落天黑，不料有冒煙的爐並燒著的火把從那些肉塊中經過。
english: Then when the sun went down and it was dark, he saw a smoking fire and a flaming light which went between the parts of the bodies.

chinese: 當那日，耶和華與亞伯蘭立約，說：我已賜給你的後裔，從埃及河直到伯拉大河之地，
english: In that day the Lord made an agreement with Abram, and said, To your seed have I given this land from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

chinese: 就是基尼人、基尼洗人、甲摩尼人、
english: The Kenite, the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,

chinese: 赫人、比利洗人、利乏音人、
english: And the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,

chinese: 亞摩利人、迦南人、革迦撒人、耶布斯人之地。
english: And the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.

chinese: 亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊不給他生兒女。撒萊有一個使女，名叫夏甲，是埃及人。
english: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, had given him no children; and she had a servant, a woman of Egypt whose name was Hagar.

chinese: 撒萊對亞伯蘭說：耶和華使我不能生育。求你和我的使女同房，或者我可以因他得孩子(原文作被建立)。亞伯蘭聽從了撒萊的話。
english: And Sarai said to Abram, See, the Lord has not let me have children; go in to my servant, for I may get a family through her. And Abram did as Sarai said.

chinese: 於是亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊將使女埃及人夏甲給了丈夫為妾；那時亞伯蘭在迦南已經住了十年。
english: So after Abram had been living for ten years in the land of Canaan, Sarai took Hagar, her Egyptian servant, and gave her to Abram for his wife.

chinese: 亞伯蘭與夏甲同房，夏甲就懷了孕；他見自己有孕，就小看他的主母。
english: And he went in to Hagar and she became with child, and when she saw that she was with child, she no longer had any respect for her master's wife.

chinese: 撒萊對亞伯蘭說：我因你受屈。我將我的使女放在你懷中，他見自己有了孕，就小看我。願耶和華在你我中間判斷。
english: And Sarai said to Abram, May my wrong be on you: I gave you my servant for your wife and when she saw that she was with child, she no longer had any respect for me: may the Lord be judge between you and me.

chinese: 亞伯蘭對撒萊說：使女在你手下，你可以隨意待他。撒萊苦待他，他就從撒萊面前逃走了。
english: And Abram said, The woman is in your power; do with her whatever seems good to you. And Sarai was cruel to her, so that she went running away from her.

chinese: 耶和華的使者在曠野書珥路上的水泉旁遇見他，
english: And an angel of the Lord came to her by a fountain of water in the waste land, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

chinese: 對他說：撒萊的使女夏甲，你從那裡來？要往那裡去？夏甲說：我從我的主母撒萊面前逃出來。
english: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's servant, where have you come from and where are you going? And she said, I am running away from Sarai, my master's wife.

chinese: 耶和華的使者對他說：你回到你主母那裡，服在他手下；
english: And the angel said to her, Go back, and put yourself under her authority.

chinese: 又說：我必使你的後裔極其繁多，甚至不可勝數；
english: And the angel of the Lord said, Your seed will be greatly increased so that it may not be numbered.

chinese: 並說：你如今懷孕要生一個兒子，可以給他起名叫以實瑪利，因為耶和華聽見了你的苦情。(以實瑪利就是神聽見的意思)
english: And the angel of the Lord said, See, you are with child and will give birth to a son, to whom you will give the name Ishmael, because the ears of the Lord were open to your sorrow.

chinese: 他為人必像野驢。他的手要攻打人，人的手也要攻打他；他必住在眾弟兄的東邊。
english: And he will be like a mountain ass among men; his hand will be against every man and every man's hand against him, and he will keep his place against all his brothers.

chinese: 夏甲就稱那對他說話的耶和華為看顧人的神。因而說：在這裡我也看見那看顧我的麼？
english: And to the Lord who was talking with her she gave this name, You are a God who is seen; for she said, Have I not even here in the waste land had a vision of God and am still living?

chinese: 所以這井名叫庇耳拉海萊。這井正在加低斯和巴列中間。
english: So that fountain was named, Fountain of Life and Vision: it is between Kadesh and Bered.

chinese: 後來夏甲給亞伯蘭生了一個兒子；亞伯蘭給他起名叫以實瑪利。
english: And Hagar gave birth to a child, the son of Abram, to whom Abram gave the name of Ishmael.

chinese: 夏甲給亞伯蘭生以實瑪利的時候，亞伯蘭年八十六歲。
english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar gave birth to Ishmael.

chinese: 亞伯蘭年九十九歲的時候，耶和華向他顯現，對他說：我是全能的神。你當在我面前作完全人，
english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord came to him, and said, I am God, Ruler of all; go in my ways and be upright in all things,

chinese: 我就與你立約，使你的後裔極其繁多。
english: And I will make an agreement between you and me, and your offspring will be greatly increased.

chinese: 亞伯蘭俯伏在地；神又對他說：
english: And Abram went down on his face on the earth, and the Lord God went on talking with him, and said,

chinese: 我與你立約：你要作多國的父。
english: As for me, my agreement is made with you, and you will be the father of nations without end.

chinese: 從此以後，你的名不再叫亞伯蘭，要叫亞伯拉罕，因為我已立你作多國的父。
english: No longer will your name be Abram, but Abraham, for I have made you the father of a number of nations.

chinese: 我必使你的後裔極其繁多；國度從你而立，君王從你而出。
english: I will make you very fertile, so that nations will come from you and kings will be your offspring.

chinese: 我要與你並你世世代代的後裔堅立我的約，作永遠的約，是要作你和你後裔的神。
english: And I will make between me and you and your seed after you through all generations, an eternal agreement to be a God to you and to your seed after you.

chinese: 我要將你現在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，賜給你和你的後裔永遠為業，我也必作他們的神。
english: And to you and to your seed after you, I will give the land in which you are living, all the land of Canaan for an eternal heritage; and I will be their God.

chinese: 神又對亞伯拉罕說：你和你的後裔必世世代代遵守我的約。
english: And God said to Abraham, On your side, you are to keep the agreement, you and your seed after you through all generations.

chinese: 你們所有的男子都要受割禮；這就是我與你並你的後裔所立的約，是你們所當遵守的。
english: And this is the agreement which you are to keep with me, you and your seed after you: every male among you is to undergo circumcision.

chinese: 你們都要受割禮(原文作割陽皮；14，23，24，25節同)；這是我與你們立約的證據。
english: In the flesh of your private parts you are to undergo it, as a mark of the agreement between me and you.

chinese: 你們世世代代的男子，無論是家裡生的，是在你後裔之外用銀子從外人買的，生下來第八日，都要受割禮。
english: Every male among you, from one generation to another, is to undergo circumcision when he is eight days old, with every servant whose birth takes place in your house, or for whom you gave money to someone of another country, and not of your seed.

chinese: 你家裡生的和你用銀子買的，都必須受割禮。這樣，我的約就立在你們肉體上作永遠的約。
english: He who comes to birth in your house and he who is made yours for a price, all are to undergo circumcision; so that my agreement may be marked in your flesh, an agreement for all time.

chinese: 但不受割禮的男子必從民中剪除，因他背了我的約。
english: And any male who does not undergo circumcision will be cut off from his people: my agreement has been broken by him.

chinese: 神又對亞伯拉罕說：你的妻子撒萊不可再叫撒萊，他的名要叫撒拉。
english: And God said, As for Sarai, your wife, from now her name will be not Sarai, but Sarah.

chinese: 我必賜福給他，也要使你從他得一個兒子。我要賜福給他，他也要作多國之母；必有百姓的君王從他而出。
english: And I will give her a blessing so that you will have a son by her: truly my blessing will be on her, and she will be the mother of nations: kings of peoples will be her offspring.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕就俯伏在地喜笑，心裡說：一百歲的人還能得孩子麼？撒拉已經九十歲了，還能生養麼？
english: Then Abraham went down on his face, and laughing, said in his heart, May a man a hundred years old have a child? will Sarah, at ninety years old, give birth?

chinese: 亞伯拉罕對神說：但願以實瑪利活在你面前。
english: And Abraham said to God, If only Ishmael's life might be your care!

chinese: 神說：不然，你妻子撒拉要給你生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫以撒。我要與他堅定所立的約，作他後裔永遠的約。
english: And God said, Not so; but Sarah, your wife, will have a son, and you will give him the name Isaac, and I will make my agreement with him for ever and with his seed after him.

chinese: 至於以實瑪利，我也應允你：我必賜福給他，使他昌盛，極其繁多。他必生十二個族長；我也要使他成為大國。
english: As for Ishmael, I have given ear to your prayer: truly I have given him my blessing and I will make him fertile and give him great increase; he will be the father of twelve chiefs, and I will make him a great nation.

chinese: 到明年這時節，撒拉必給你生以撒，我要與他堅定所立的約。
english: But my agreement will be with Isaac, to whom Sarah will give birth a year from this time.

chinese: 神和亞伯拉罕說完了話，就離開他上升去了。
english: And having said these words, God went up from Abraham.

chinese: 正當那日，亞伯拉罕遵著神的命，給他的兒子以實瑪利和家裡的一切男子，無論是在家裡生的，是用銀子買的，都行了割禮。
english: And Abraham took Ishmael, his son, and all whose birth had taken place in his house, and all his servants whom he had made his for a price, every male of his house, and on that very day he gave them circumcision in the flesh of their private parts as God had said to him.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕受割禮的時候年九十九歲。
english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he underwent circumcision.

chinese: 他兒子以實瑪利受割禮的時候年十三歲。
english: And Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he underwent circumcision.

chinese: 正當那日，亞伯拉罕和他兒子以實瑪利一同受了割禮。
english: Abraham and Ishmael, his son, underwent circumcision on that very day.

chinese: 家裡所有的人，無論是在家裡生的，是用銀子從外人買的，也都一同受了割禮。
english: And all the men of his house, those whose birth had taken place in the house and those whom he had got for money from men of other lands, underwent circumcision with him.

chinese: 耶和華在幔利橡樹那裡向亞伯拉罕顯現出來。那時正熱，亞伯拉罕坐在帳棚門口，
english: Now the Lord came to him by the holy tree of Mamre, when he was seated in the doorway of his tent in the middle of the day;

chinese: 舉目觀看，見有三個人在對面站著。他一見，就從帳棚門口跑去迎接他們，俯伏在地，
english: And lifting up his eyes, he saw three men before him; and seeing them, he went quickly to them from the door of the tent, and went down on his face to the earth;

chinese: 說：我主，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你不要離開僕人往前去。
english: And said, My Lord, if now I have grace in your eyes, do not go away from your servant:

chinese: 容我拿點水來，你們洗洗腳，在樹下歇息歇息。
english: Let me get water for washing your feet, and take your rest under the tree:

chinese: 我再拿一點餅來，你們可以加添心力，然後往前去。你們既到僕人這裡來，理當如此。他們說：就照你說的行罷。
english: And let me get a bit of bread to keep up your strength, and after that you may go on your way: for this is why you have come to your servant. And they said, Let it be so.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕急忙進帳棚見撒拉，說：你速速拿三細亞細麵調和作餅。
english: Then Abraham went quickly into the tent, and said to Sarah, Get three measures of meal straight away and make cakes.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕又跑到牛群裡，牽了一隻又嫩又好的牛犢來，交給僕人，僕人急忙預備好了。
english: And running to the herd, he took a young ox, soft and fat, and gave it to the servant and he quickly made it ready;

chinese: 亞伯拉罕又取了奶油和奶，並預備好的牛犢來，擺在他們面前，自己在樹下站在旁邊，他們就吃了。
english: And he took butter and milk and the young ox which he had made ready and put it before them, waiting by them under the tree while they took food.

chinese: 他們問亞伯拉罕說：你妻子撒拉在那裡？他說：在帳棚裡。
english: And they said to him, Where is Sarah your wife? And he said, She is in the tent.

chinese: 三人中有一位說：到明年這時候，我必要回到你這裡；你的妻子撒拉必生一個兒子。撒拉在那人後邊的帳棚門口也聽見了這話。
english: And he said, I will certainly come back to you in the spring, and Sarah your wife will have a son. And his words came to the ears of Sarah who was at the back of the tent-door.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕和撒拉年紀老邁，撒拉的月經已斷絕了。
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were very old, and Sarah was past the time for giving birth.

chinese: 撒拉心裡暗笑，說：我既已衰敗，我主也老邁，豈能有這喜事呢？
english: And Sarah, laughing to herself, said, Now that I am used up am I still to have pleasure, my husband himself being old?

chinese: 耶和華對亞伯拉罕說：撒拉為甚麼暗笑，說：我既已年老，果真能生養麼？
english: And the Lord said, Why was Sarah laughing and saying, Is it possible for me, being old, to give birth to a child?

chinese: 耶和華豈有難成的事麼？到了日期，明年這時候，我必回到你這裡，撒拉必生一個兒子。
english: Is there any wonder which the Lord is not able to do? At the time I said, in the spring, I will come back to you, and Sarah will have a child.

chinese: 撒拉就害怕，不承認，說：我沒有笑。那位說：不然，你實在笑了。
english: Then Sarah said, I was not laughing; for she was full of fear. And he said, No, but you were laughing.

chinese: 三人就從那裡起行，向所多瑪觀看，亞伯拉罕也與他們同行，要送他們一程。
english: And the men went on from there in the direction of Sodom; and Abraham went with them on their way.

chinese: 耶和華說：我所要作的事豈可瞞著亞伯拉罕呢？
english: And the Lord said, Am I to keep back from Abraham the knowledge of what I do;

chinese: 亞伯拉罕必要成為強大的國；地上的萬國都必因他得福。
english: Seeing that Abraham will certainly become a great and strong nation, and his name will be used by all the nations of the earth as a blessing?

chinese: 我眷顧他，為要叫他吩咐他的眾子和他的眷屬遵守我的道，秉公行義，使我所應許亞伯拉罕的話都成就了。
english: For I have made him mine so that he may give orders to his children and those of his line after him, to keep the ways of the Lord, to do what is good and right: so that the Lord may do to Abraham as he has said.

chinese: 耶和華說：所多瑪和蛾摩拉的罪惡甚重，聲聞於我。
english: And the Lord said, Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is very great, and their sin is very evil,

chinese: 我現在要下去，察看他們所行的，果然盡像那達到我耳中的聲音一樣麼？若是不然，我也必知道。
english: I will go down now, and see if their acts are as bad as they seem from the outcry which has come to me; and if they are not, I will see.

chinese: 二人轉身離開那裡，向所多瑪去；但亞伯拉罕仍舊站在耶和華面前。
english: And the men, turning from that place, went on to Sodom: but Abraham was still waiting before the Lord.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕近前來，說：無論善惡，你都要剿滅麼？
english: And Abraham came near, and said, Will you let destruction come on the upright with the sinners?

chinese: 假若那城裡有五十個義人，你還剿滅那地方麼？不為城裡這五十個義人饒恕其中的人麼？
english: If by chance there are fifty upright men in the town, will you give the place to destruction and not have mercy on it because of the fifty upright men?

chinese: 將義人與惡人同殺，將義人與惡人一樣看待，這斷不是你所行的。審判全地的主豈不行公義麼？
english: Let such a thing be far from you, to put the upright to death with the sinner: will not the judge of all the earth do right?

chinese: 耶和華說：我若在所多瑪城裡見有五十個義人，我就為他們的緣故饒恕那地方的眾人。
english: And the Lord said, If there are fifty upright men in the town, I will have mercy on it because of them.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：我雖然是灰塵，還敢對主說話。
english: And Abraham answering said, Truly, I who am only dust, have undertaken to put my thoughts before the Lord:

chinese: 假若這五十個義人短了五個，你就因為短了五個毀滅全城麼？他說：我在那裡若見有四十五個，也不毀滅那城。
english: If by chance there are five less than fifty upright men, will you give up all the town to destruction because of these five? And he said, I will not give it to destruction if there are forty-five.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕又對他說：假若在那裡見有四十個怎麼樣呢？他說：為這四十個的緣故，我也不作這事。
english: And again he said to him, By chance there may be forty there. And he said, I will not do it if there are forty.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：求主不要動怒，容我說，假若在那裡見有三十個怎麼樣呢？他說：我在那裡若見有三十個，我也不作這事。
english: And he said, Let not the Lord be angry with me if I say, What if there are thirty there? And he said, I will not do it if there are thirty.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：我還敢對主說話，假若在那裡見有二十個怎麼樣呢？他說：為這二十個的緣故，我也不毀滅那城。
english: And he said, See now, I have undertaken to put my thoughts before the Lord: what if there are twenty there? And he said, I will have mercy because of the twenty.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：求主不要動怒，我再說這一次，假若在那裡見有十個呢？他說：為這十個的緣故，我也不毀滅那城。
english: And he said, O let not the Lord be angry and I will say only one word more: by chance there may be ten there. And he said, I will have mercy because of the ten.

chinese: 耶和華與亞伯拉罕說完了話就走了；亞伯拉罕也回到自己的地方去了。
english: And the Lord went on his way when his talk with Abraham was ended, and Abraham went back to his place.

chinese: 那兩個天使晚上到了所多瑪；羅得正坐在所多瑪城門口，看見他們，就起來迎接，臉伏於地下拜，
english: And at nightfall the two angels came to Sodom; and Lot was seated at the way into the town: and when he saw them he got up and came before them, falling down on his face to the earth.

chinese: 說：我主阿，請你們到僕人家裡洗洗腳，住一夜，清早起來再走。他們說：不！我們要在街上過夜。
english: And he said, My masters, come now into your servant's house and take your rest there for the night, and let your feet be washed; and early in the morning you may go on your way. And they said, Not so, but we will take our night's rest in the street.

chinese: 羅得切切的請他們，他們這才進去，到他屋裡。羅得為他們預備筵席，烤無酵餅，他們就吃了。
english: But he made his request more strongly, so they went with him into his house; and he got food ready for them, and made unleavened bread, of which they took.

chinese: 他們還沒有躺下，所多瑪城裡各處的人，連老帶少，都來圍住那房子，
english: But before they had gone to bed, the men of the town, all the men of Sodom, came round the house, young and old, from every part of the town;

chinese: 呼叫羅得說：今日晚上到你這裡來的人在那裡呢？把他們帶出來，任我們所為。
english: And crying out to Lot, they said, Where are the men who came to your house this night? Send them out to us, so that we may take our pleasure with them.

chinese: 羅得出來，把門關上，到眾人那裡，
english: And Lot went out to them in the doorway, shutting the door after him.

chinese: 說：眾弟兄，請你們不要作這惡事。
english: And he said, My brothers, do not this evil.

chinese: 我有兩個女兒，還是處女，容我領出來，任憑你們的心願而行；只是這兩個人既然到我舍下，不要向他們作甚麼。
english: See now, I have two unmarried daughters; I will send them out to you so that you may do to them whatever seems good to you: only do nothing to these men, for this is why they have come under the shade of my roof.

chinese: 眾人說：退去罷！又說：這個人來寄居，還想要作官哪！現在我們要害你比害他們更甚。眾人就向前擁擠羅得，要攻破房門。
english: And they said, Give way there. This one man, they said, came here from a strange country, and will he now be our judge? now we will do worse to you than to them; and pushing violently against Lot, they came near to get the door broken in.

chinese: 只是那二人伸出手來，將羅得拉進屋去，把門關上，
english: But the men put out their hands and took Lot into the house to them, shutting the door again.

chinese: 並且使門外的人，無論老少，眼都昏迷；他們摸來摸去，總尋不著房門。
english: But the men who were outside the door they made blind, all of them, small and great, so that they were tired out with looking for the door.

chinese: 二人對羅得說：你這裡還有甚麼人麼？無論是女婿是兒女，和這城中一切屬你的人，你都要將他們從這地方帶出去。
english: Then the men said to Lot, Are there any others of your family here? sons-in-law or sons or daughters, take them all out of this place;

chinese: 我們要毀滅這地方；因為城內罪惡的聲音在耶和華面前甚大，耶和華差我們來，要毀滅這地方。
english: For we are about to send destruction on this place, because a great outcry against them has come to the ears of the Lord; and the Lord has sent us to put an end to the town.

chinese: 羅得就出去，告訴娶了(或作將要娶)他女兒的女婿們說：你們起來離開這地方，因為耶和華要毀滅這城。他女婿們卻以為他說的是戲言。
