english: And Lot went out and said to his sons-in-law, who were married to his daughters, Come, let us go out of this place, for the Lord is about to send destruction on the town. But his sons-in-law did not take him seriously.

chinese: 天明了，天使催逼羅得說：起來！帶著你的妻子和你在這裡的兩個女兒出去，免得你因這城裡的罪惡同被剿滅。
english: And when morning came, the angels did all in their power to make Lot go, saying, Get up quickly and take your wife and your two daughters who are here, and go, for fear that you come to destruction in the punishment of the town.

chinese: 但羅得遲延不走。二人因為耶和華憐恤羅得，就拉著他的手和他妻子的手，並他兩個女兒的手，把他們領出來，安置在城外；
english: But while he was waiting, the men took him and his wife and his daughters by the hand, for the Lord had mercy on them, and put them outside the town.

chinese: 領他們出來以後，就說：逃命罷！不可回頭看，也不可在平原站住。要往山上逃跑，免得你被剿滅。
english: And when they had put them out, he said, Go for your life, without looking back or waiting in the lowland; go quickly to the mountain or you will come to destruction.

chinese: 羅得對他們說：我主阿，不要如此！
english: And Lot said to them, Not so, O my Lord;

chinese: 你僕人已經在你眼前蒙恩；你又向我顯出莫大的慈愛，救我的性命。我不能逃到山上去，恐怕這災禍臨到我，我便死了。
english: See now, your servant has had grace in your eyes and great is your mercy in keeping my life from destruction, but I am not able to get as far as the mountain before evil overtakes me and death;

chinese: 看哪，這座城又小又近，容易逃到，這不是一個小的麼？求你容我逃到那裡，我的性命就得存活。
english: This town, now, is near, and it is a little one: O, let me go there (is it not a little one?) so that my life may be safe.

chinese: 天使對他說：這事我也應允你；我不傾覆你所說的這城。
english: And he said, See, I have given you your request in this one thing more: I will not send destruction on this town.

chinese: 你要速速地逃到那城；因為你還沒有到那裡，我不能作甚麼。因此那城名叫瑣珥(就是小的意思)。
english: Go there quickly, for I am not able to do anything till you have come there. For this reason, the town was named Zoar.

chinese: 羅得到了瑣珥，日頭已經出來了。
english: The sun was up when Lot came to Zoar.

chinese: 當時，耶和華將硫磺與火從天上耶和華那裡降與所多瑪和蛾摩拉，
english: Then the Lord sent fire and flaming smoke raining down from heaven on Sodom and Gomorrah.

chinese: 把那些城和全平原，並城裡所有的居民，連地上生長的，都毀滅了。
english: And he sent destruction on those towns, with all the lowland and all the people of those towns and every green thing in the land.

chinese: 羅得的妻子在後邊回頭一看，就變成了一根鹽柱。
english: But Lot's wife, looking back, became a pillar of salt.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，到了他從前站在耶和華面前的地方，
english: And Abraham got up early in the morning and went to the place where he had been talking with the Lord:

chinese: 向所多瑪和蛾摩拉與平原的全地觀看，不料，那地方煙氣上騰，如同燒窯一般。
english: And looking in the direction of Sodom and Gomorrah and the lowland, he saw the smoke of the land going up like the smoke of an oven.

chinese: 當神毀滅平原諸城的時候，他記念亞伯拉罕，正在傾覆羅得所住之城的時候，就打發羅得從傾覆之中出來。
english: So it came about that when God sent destruction on the towns of the lowland, he kept his word to Abraham, and sent Lot safely away when he put an end to the towns where he was living.

chinese: 羅得因為怕住在瑣珥，就同他兩個女兒從瑣珥上去，住在山裡；他和兩個女兒住在一個洞裡。
english: Then Lot went up out of Zoar to the mountain, and was living there with his two daughters, for fear kept him from living in Zoar: and he and his daughters made their living-place in a hole in the rock.

chinese: 大女兒對小女兒說：我們的父親老了，地上又無人按著世上的常規進到我們這裡。
english: And the older daughter said to her sister, Our father is old, and there is no man to be a husband to us in the natural way:

chinese: 來！我們可以叫父親喝酒，與他同寢。這樣，我們好從他存留後裔。
english: Come, let us give our father much wine, and we will go into his bed, so that we may have offspring by our father,

chinese: 於是，那夜他們叫父親喝酒，大女兒就進去和他父親同寢；他幾時躺下，幾時起來，父親都不知道。
english: And that night they made their father take much wine; and the older daughter went into his bed; and he had no knowledge of when she went in or when she went away.

chinese: 第二天，大女兒對小女兒說：我昨夜與父親同寢。今夜我們再叫他喝酒，你可以進去與他同寢。這樣，我們好從父親存留後裔。
english: And on the day after, the older daughter said to the younger, Last night I was with my father; let us make him take much wine this night again, and do you go to him, so that we may have offspring by our father.

chinese: 於是，那夜他們又叫父親喝酒，小女兒起來與他父親同寢；他幾時躺下，幾時起來，父親都不知道。
english: And that night again they made their father take much wine; and the younger daughter went into his bed; and he had no knowledge of when she went in or when she went away.

chinese: 這樣，羅得的兩個女兒都從他父親懷了孕。
english: And so the two daughters of Lot were with child by their father.

chinese: 大女兒生了兒子，給他起名叫摩押，就是現今摩押人的始祖。
english: And the older daughter had a son, and she gave him the name Moab: he is the father of the Moabites to this day.

chinese: 小女兒也生了兒子，給他起名叫便亞米，就是現今亞捫人的始祖。
english: And the younger had a son and gave him the name Ben-ammi: from him come the children of Ammon to this day.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕從那裡向南地遷去，寄居在加低斯和書珥中間的基拉耳。
english: And Abraham went on his way from there to the land of the South, and was living between Kadesh and Shur, in Gerar.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕稱他的妻撒拉為妹子，基拉耳王亞比米勒差人把撒拉取了去。
english: And Abraham said of Sarah, his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech, king of Gerar, sent and took Sarah.

chinese: 但夜間，神來，在夢中對亞比米勒說：你是個死人哪！因為你取了那女人來；他原是別人的妻子。
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream in the night, and said to him, Truly you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man's wife.

chinese: 亞比米勒卻還沒有親近撒拉；他說：主阿，連有義的國，你也要毀滅麼？
english: Now Abimelech had not come near her; and he said, Lord, will you put to death an upright nation?

chinese: 那人豈不是自己對我說他是我的妹子麼？就是女人也自己說：他是我的哥哥。我作這事是心正手潔的。
english: Did he not say to me himself, She is my sister? and she herself said, He is my brother: with an upright heart and clean hands have I done this.

chinese: 神在夢中對他說：我知道你作這事是心中正直；我也攔阻了你，免得你得罪我，所以我不容你沾著他。
english: And God said to him in the dream, I see that you have done this with an upright heart, and I have kept you from sinning against me: for this reason I did not let you come near her.

chinese: 現在你把這人的妻子歸還他；因為他是先知，他要為你禱告，使你存活。你若不歸還他，你當知道，你和你所有的人都必要死。
english: So now, give the man back his wife, for he is a prophet, and let him say a prayer for you, so your life may be safe: but if you do not give her back, be certain that death will come to you and all your house.

chinese: 亞比米勒清早起來，召了眾臣僕來，將這些事都說給他們聽，他們都甚懼怕。
english: So Abimelech got up early in the morning and sent for all his servants and gave them word of these things, and they were full of fear.

chinese: 亞比米勒召了亞伯拉罕來，對他說：你怎麼向我這樣行呢？我在甚麼事上得罪了你，你竟使我和我國裡的人陷在大罪裡？你向我行不當行的事了！
english: Then Abimelech sent for Abraham, and said, What have you done to us? what wrong have I done you that you have put on me and on my kingdom so great a sin? You have done to me things which are not to be done.

chinese: 亞比米勒又對亞伯拉罕說：你見了甚麼才做這事呢？
english: And Abimelech said to Abraham, Why did you do this thing?

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：我以為這地方的人總不懼怕神，必為我妻子的緣故殺我。
english: And Abraham said, Because it seemed to me that there was no fear of God in this place, and that they might put me to death because of my wife.

chinese: 況且他也實在是我的妹子；他與我是同父異母，後來作了我的妻子。
english: And, in fact, she is my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife:

chinese: 當神叫我離開父家、飄流在外的時候，我對他說：我們無論走到甚麼地方，你可以對人說：他是我的哥哥；這就是你待我的恩典了。
english: And when God sent me wandering from my father's house, I said to her, Let this be the sign of your love for me; wherever we go, say of me, He is my brother.

chinese: 亞比米勒把牛、羊、僕婢賜給亞伯拉罕，又把他的妻子撒拉歸還他。
english: Then Abimelech gave to Abraham sheep and oxen and men-servants and women-servants, and gave him back his wife Sarah.

chinese: 亞比米勒又說：看哪，我的地都在你面前，你可以隨意居住；
english: And Abimelech said, See, all my land is before you; take whatever place seems good to you.

chinese: 又對撒拉說：我給你哥哥一千銀子，作為你在閤家人面前遮羞(原文作眼)的，你就在眾人面前沒有不是了。
english: And he said to Sarah, See, I have given to your brother a thousand bits of silver so that your wrong may be put right; now your honour is clear in the eyes of all.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕禱告神，　神就醫好了亞比米勒和他的妻子，並他的眾女僕，他們便能生育。
english: Then Abraham made prayer to God, and God made Abimelech well again, and his wife and his women-servants, so that they had children.

chinese: 因耶和華為亞伯拉罕的妻子撒拉的緣故，已經使亞比米勒家中的婦人不能生育。
english: For the Lord had kept all the women of the house of Abimelech from having children, because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.

chinese: 耶和華按著先前的話眷顧撒拉，便照他所說的給撒拉成就。
english: And the Lord came to Sarah as he had said and did to her as he had undertaken.

chinese: 當亞伯拉罕年老的時候，撒拉懷了孕；到神所說的日期，就給亞伯拉罕生了一個兒子。
english: And Sarah became with child, and gave Abraham a son when he was old, at the time named by God.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕給撒拉所生的兒子起名叫以撒。
english: And Abraham gave to his son, to whom Sarah had given birth, the name Isaac.

chinese: 以撒生下來第八日，亞伯拉罕照著神所吩咐的，給以撒行了割禮。
english: And when his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham made him undergo circumcision, as God had said to him.

chinese: 他兒子以撒生的時候，亞伯拉罕年一百歲。
english: Now Abraham was a hundred years old when the birth of Isaac took place.

chinese: 撒拉說：神使我喜笑，凡聽見的必與我一同喜笑；
english: And Sarah said, God has given me cause for laughing, and everyone who has news of it will be laughing with me.

chinese: 又說：誰能預先對亞伯拉罕說撒拉要乳養嬰孩呢？因為在他年老的時候，我給他生了一個兒子。
english: And she said, Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would have a child at her breast? for see, I have given him a son now when he is old.

chinese: 孩子漸長，就斷了奶。以撒斷奶的日子，亞伯拉罕設擺豐盛的筵席。
english: And when the child was old enough to be taken from the breast, Abraham made a great feast.

chinese: 當時，撒拉看見埃及人夏甲給亞伯拉罕所生的兒子戲笑，
english: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian playing with Isaac.

chinese: 就對亞伯拉罕說：你把這使女和他兒子趕出去！因為這使女的兒子不可與我的兒子以撒一同承受產業。
english: So she said to Abraham, Send away that woman and her son: for the son of that woman is not to have a part in the heritage with my son Isaac.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕因他兒子的緣故很憂愁。
english: And this was a great grief to Abraham because of his son.

chinese: 神對亞伯拉罕說：你不必為這童子和你的使女憂愁。凡撒拉對你說的話，你都該聽從；因為從以撒生的，才要稱為你的後裔。
english: But God said, Let it not be a grief to you because of the boy and Hagar his mother; give ear to whatever Sarah says to you, because it is from Isaac that your seed will take its name.

chinese: 至於使女的兒子，我也必使他的後裔成立一國，因為他是你所生的。
english: And I will make a nation of the son of your servant-woman, because he is your seed.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，拿餅和一皮袋水，給了夏甲，搭在他的肩上，又把孩子交給他，打發他走。夏甲就走了，在別是巴的曠野走迷了路。
english: And early in the morning Abraham got up, and gave Hagar some bread and a water-skin, and put the boy on her back, and sent her away: and she went, wandering in the waste land of Beer-sheba.

chinese: 皮袋的水用盡了，夏甲就把孩子撇在小樹底下，
english: And when all the water in the skin was used up, she put the child down under a tree.

chinese: 自己走開約有一箭之遠，相對而坐，說：我不忍見孩子死，就相對而坐，放聲大哭。
english: And she went some distance away, about an arrow flight, and seating herself on the earth, she gave way to bitter weeping, saying, Let me not see the death of my child.

chinese: 神聽見童子的聲音；神的使者從天上呼叫夏甲說：夏甲，你為何這樣呢？不要害怕，　神已經聽見童子的聲音了。
english: And the boy's cry came to the ears of God; and the angel of God said to Hagar from heaven, Hagar, why are you weeping? have no fear, for the child's cry has come to the ears of God.

chinese: 起來！把童子抱在懷(原文作手)中，我必使他的後裔成為大國。
english: Come, take your child in your arms, for I will make of him a great nation.

chinese: 神使夏甲的眼睛明亮，他就看見一口水井，便去將皮袋盛滿了水，給童子喝。
english: Then God made her eyes open, and she saw a water-spring, and she got water in the skin and gave the boy a drink.

chinese: 神保佑童子，他就漸長，住在曠野，成了弓箭手。
english: And God was with the boy, and he became tall and strong, and he became a bowman, living in the waste land.

chinese: 他住在巴蘭的曠野；他母親從埃及地給他娶了一個妻子。
english: And while he was in the waste land of Paran, his mother got him a wife from the land of Egypt.

chinese: 當那時候，亞比米勒同他軍長非各對亞伯拉罕說：凡你所行的事都有神的保佑。
english: Now at that time, Abimelech and Phicol, the captain of his army, said to Abraham, I see that God is with you in all you do.

chinese: 我願你如今在這裡指著神對我起誓，不要欺負我與我的兒子，並我的子孫。我怎樣厚待了你，你也要照樣厚待我與你所寄居這地的民。
english: Now, then, give me your oath, in the name of God, that you will not be false to me or to my sons after me, but that as I have been good to you, so you will be to me and to this land where you have been living.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：我情願起誓。
english: And Abraham said, I will give you my oath.

chinese: 從前，亞比米勒的僕人霸佔了一口水井，亞伯拉罕為這事指責亞比米勒。
english: But Abraham made a protest to Abimelech because of a water-hole which Abimelech's servants had taken by force.

chinese: 亞比米勒說：誰做這事，我不知道，你也沒有告訴我，今日我才聽見了。
english: But Abimelech said, I have no idea who has done this thing; you never gave me word of it, and I had no knowledge of it till this day.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕把羊和牛給了亞比米勒，二人就彼此立約。
english: And Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them made an agreement together.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕把七隻母羊羔另放在一處。
english: And Abraham put seven young lambs of the flock on one side by themselves.

chinese: 亞比米勒問亞伯拉罕說：你把這七隻母羊羔另放在一處，是甚麼意思呢？
english: Then Abimelech said, What are these seven lambs which you have put on one side?

chinese: 他說：你要從我手裡受這七隻母羊羔，作我挖這口井的證據。
english: And he said, Take these seven lambs from me as a witness that I have made this water-hole.

chinese: 所以他給那地方起名叫別是巴，因為他們二人在那裡起了誓。(別是巴就是盟誓的井的意思)
english: So he gave that place the name Beer-sheba, because there the two of them had given their oaths.

chinese: 他們在別是巴立了約，亞比米勒就同他軍長非各起身回非利士地去了。
english: So they made an agreement at Beer-sheba, and Abimelech and Phicol, the captain of his army, went back to the land of the Philistines.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕在別是巴栽上一棵垂絲柳樹，又在那裡求告耶和華─永生神的名。
english: And Abraham, after planting a holy tree in Beer-sheba, gave worship to the name of the Lord, the Eternal God.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕在非利士人的地寄居了多日。
english: And Abraham went on living in the land of the Philistines as in a strange country.

chinese: 這些事以後，神要試驗亞伯拉罕，就呼叫他說：亞伯拉罕！他說：我在這裡。
english: Now after these things, God put Abraham to the test, and said to him, Abraham; and he said, Here am I.

chinese: 神說：你帶著你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，你所愛的以撒，往摩利亞地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他獻為燔祭。
english: And he said to him, Take your son, your dearly loved only son Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah and give him as a burned offering on one of the mountains of which I will give you knowledge.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，備上驢，帶著兩個僕人和他兒子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往神所指示他的地方去了。
english: And Abraham got up early in the morning, and made ready his ass, and took with him two of his young men and Isaac, his son, and after the wood for the burned offering had been cut, he went on his way to the place of which God had given him word.

chinese: 到了第三日，亞伯拉罕舉目遠遠的看見那地方。
english: And on the third day, Abraham, lifting up his eyes, saw the place a long way off.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕對他的僕人說：你們和驢在此等候，我與童子往那裡去拜一拜，就回到你們這裡來。
english: Then he said to his young men, Keep here with the ass; and I and the boy will go on and give worship and come back again to you.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他兒子以撒身上，自己手裡拿著火與刀；於是二人同行。
english: And Abraham put the wood for the burned offering on his son's back, and he himself took the fire and the knife in his hand, and the two of them went on together.

chinese: 以撒對他父親亞伯拉罕說：父親哪！亞伯拉罕說：我兒，我在這裡。以撒說：請看，火與柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在那裡呢？
english: Then Isaac said to Abraham, My father; and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, We have wood and fire here, but where is the lamb for the burned offering?

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：我兒，神必自己預備作燔祭的羊羔。於是二人同行。
english: And Abraham said, God himself will give the lamb for the burned offering: so they went on together.

chinese: 他們到了神所指示的地方，亞伯拉罕在那裡築壇，把柴擺好，捆綁他的兒子以撒，放在壇的柴上。
english: And they came to the place of which God had given him knowledge; and there Abraham made the altar and put the wood in place on it, and having made tight the bands round Isaac his son, he put him on the wood on the altar.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕就伸手拿刀，要殺他的兒子。
english: And stretching out his hand, Abraham took the knife to put his son to death.

chinese: 耶和華的使者從天上呼叫他說：亞伯拉罕！亞伯拉罕！他說：我在這裡。
english: But the voice of the angel of the Lord came from heaven, saying, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

chinese: 天使說：你不可在這童子身上下手。一點不可害他！現在我知道你是敬畏神的了；因為你沒有將你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，留下不給我。
english: And he said, Let not your hand be stretched out against the boy to do anything to him; for now I am certain that the fear of God is in your heart, because you have not kept back your son, your only son, from me.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕舉目觀看，不料，有一隻公羊，兩角扣在稠密的小樹中，亞伯拉罕就取了那隻公羊來，獻為燔祭，代替他的兒子。
english: And lifting up his eyes, Abraham saw a sheep fixed by its horns in the brushwood: and Abraham took the sheep and made a burned offering of it in place of his son.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕給那地方起名叫耶和華以勒(意思就是耶和華必預備的意思)，直到今日人還說：在耶和華的山上必有預備。
english: And Abraham gave that place the name Yahweh-yireh: as it is said to this day, In the mountain the Lord is seen.

chinese: 耶和華的使者第二次從天上呼叫亞伯拉罕說：
english: And the voice of the angel of the Lord came to Abraham a second time from heaven,

chinese: 耶和華說：你既行了這事，不留下你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，我便指著自己起誓說：
english: Saying, I have taken an oath by my name, says the Lord, because you have done this and have not kept back from me your dearly loved only son,

chinese: 論福，我必賜大福給你；論子孫，我必叫你的子孫多起來，如同天上的星，海邊的沙。你子孫必得著仇敵的城門，
english: That I will certainly give you my blessing, and your seed will be increased like the stars of heaven and the sand by the seaside; your seed will take the land of those who are against them;

chinese: 並且地上萬國都必因你的後裔得福，因為你聽從了我的話。
english: And your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth, because you have done what I gave you orders to do.

chinese: 於是亞伯拉罕回到他僕人那裡，他們一同起身往別是巴去，亞伯拉罕就住在別是巴。
english: Then Abraham went back to his young men and they went together to Beer-sheba, the place where Abraham was living.

chinese: 這事以後，有人告訴亞伯拉罕說：密迦給你兄弟拿鶴生了幾個兒子，
english: After these things, Abraham had news that Milcah, the wife of his brother Nahor, had given birth to children;

chinese: 長子是烏斯，他的兄弟是布斯和亞蘭的父親基母利，
english: Uz the oldest, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel, the father of Aram,

chinese: 並基薛、哈瑣、必達、益拉、彼土利（彼土利生利百加）。
english: And Chesed and Hazo and Pildash and Jidlaph and Bethuel.

chinese: 這八個人都是密迦給亞伯拉罕的兄弟拿鶴生的。
english: Bethuel was the father of Rebekah: these eight were the children of Milcah and Nahor, Abraham's brother.

chinese: 拿鶴的妾名叫流瑪，生了提八、迦含、他轄，和瑪迦。
english: And his servant Reumah gave birth to Tebah and Gaham and Tahash and Maacah.

chinese: 撒拉享壽一百二十七歲，這是撒拉一生的歲數。
english: Now the years of Sarah's life were a hundred and twenty-seven.

chinese: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列亞巴，就是希伯崙。亞伯拉罕為他哀慟哭號。
english: And Sarah's death took place in Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron, in the land of Canaan: and Abraham went into his house, weeping and sorrowing for Sarah.

chinese: 後來亞伯拉罕從死人面前起來，對赫人說：
english: And Abraham came from his dead and said to the children of Heth,

chinese: 我在你們中間是外人，是寄居的。求你們在這裡給我一塊地，我好埋葬我的死人，使他不在我眼前。
english: I am living among you as one from a strange country: give me some land here as my property, so that I may put my dead to rest.

chinese: 赫人回答亞伯拉罕說：
english: And in answer the children of Heth said to Abraham,

chinese: 我主請聽。你在我們中間是一位尊大的王子，只管在我們最好的墳地裡埋葬你的死人；我們沒有一人不容你在他的墳地裡埋葬你的死人。
english: My lord, truly you are a great chief among us; take the best of our resting-places for your dead; not one of us will keep back from you a place where you may put your dead to rest.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕就起來，向那地的赫人下拜，
english: And Abraham got up and gave honour to the children of Heth, the people of that land.

chinese: 對他們說：你們若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使他不在我眼前，就請聽我的話，為我求瑣轄的兒子以弗崙，
english: And he said to them, If you will let me put my dead to rest here, make a request for me to Ephron, the son of Zohar,

chinese: 把田頭上那麥比拉洞給我；他可以按著足價賣給我，作我在你們中間的墳地。
english: That he will give me the hollow in the rock named Machpelah, which is his property at the end of his field; let him give it to me for its full price as a resting-place for my dead among you.

chinese: 當時以弗崙正坐在赫人中間。於是，赫人以弗崙在城門出入的赫人面前對亞伯拉罕說：
english: Now Ephron was seated among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite gave Abraham his answer in the hearing of the children of Heth, and of all those who came into his town, saying,

chinese: 不然，我主請聽。我送給你這塊田，連田間的洞也送給你，在我同族的人面前都給你，可以埋葬你的死人。
english: No, my lord, I will give you the field with the hollow in the rock; before all the children of my people will I give it to you for a resting-place for your dead.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，
english: And Abraham went down on his face before the people of the land.

chinese: 在他們面前對以弗崙說：你若應允，請聽我的話。我要把田價給你，求你收下，我就在那裡埋葬我的死人。
english: And Abraham said to Ephron, in the hearing of the people of the land, If only you will give ear to me, I will give you the price of the field; take it, and let me put my dead to rest there.

chinese: 以弗崙回答亞伯拉罕說：
english: So Ephron said to Abraham,

chinese: 我主請聽。值四百舍客勒銀子的一塊田，在你我中間還算甚麼呢？只管埋葬你的死人罷！
english: My lord, give ear to me: the value of the land is four hundred shekels; what is that between me and you? so put your dead to rest there.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕聽從了以弗崙，照著他在赫人面前所說的話，把買賣通用的銀子平了四百舍客勒給以弗崙。
english: And Abraham took note of the price fixed by Ephron in the hearing of the children of Heth, and gave him four hundred shekels in current money.

chinese: 於是，麥比拉、幔利前、以弗崙的那塊田和其中的洞，並田間四圍的樹木，
english: So Ephron's field at Machpelah near Mamre, with the hollow in the rock and all the trees in the field and round it,

chinese: 都定準歸與亞伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前並城門出入的人面前買妥的。
english: Became the property of Abraham before the eyes of the children of Heth and of all who came into the town.

chinese: 此後，亞伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麥比拉田間的洞裡。〈幔利就是希伯崙〉。
english: Then Abraham put Sarah his wife to rest in the hollow rock in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, that is, Hebron in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 從此，那塊田和田間的洞就藉著赫人定準歸與亞伯拉罕作墳地。
english: And the field and the hollow rock were handed over to Abraham as his property by the children of Heth.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕年紀老邁，向來在一切事上耶和華都賜福給他。
english: Now Abraham was old and far on in years: and the Lord had given him everything in full measure.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕對管理他全業最老的僕人說：請你把手放在我大腿底下。
english: And Abraham said to his chief servant, the manager of all his property, Come now, put your hand under my leg:

chinese: 我要叫你指著耶和華─天地的主起誓，不要為我兒子娶這迦南地中的女子為妻。
english: And take an oath by the Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you will not get a wife for my son Isaac from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am living;

chinese: 你要往我本地本族去，為我的兒子以撒娶一個妻子。
english: But that you will go into my country and to my relations and get a wife there for my son Isaac.

chinese: 僕人對他說：倘若女子不肯跟我到這地方來，我必須將你的兒子帶回你原出之地麼？
english: And the servant said, If by chance the woman will not come with me into this land, am I to take your son back again to the land from which you came?

chinese: 亞伯拉罕對他說：你要謹慎，不要帶我的兒子回那裡去。
english: And Abraham said, Take care that you do not let my son go back to that land.

chinese: 耶和華─天上的主曾帶領我離開父家和本族的地，對我說話，向我起誓說：我要將這地賜給你的後裔。他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以從那裡為我兒子娶一個妻子。
english: The Lord God of heaven, who took me from my father's house and from the land of my birth, and made an oath to me, saying, To your seed I will give this land: he will send his angel before you and give you a wife for my son in that land.

chinese: 倘若女子不肯跟你來，我使你起的誓就與你無干了，只是不可帶我的兒子回那裡去。
english: And if the woman will not come with you, then you are free from this oath; only do not take my son back there.

chinese: 僕人就把手放在他主人亞伯拉罕的大腿底下，為這事向他起誓。
english: And the servant put his hand under Abraham's leg, and gave him his oath about this thing.

chinese: 那僕人從他主人的駱駝裡取了十匹駱駝，並帶些他主人各樣的財物，起身往米所波大米去，到了拿鶴的城。
english: And the servant took ten of his master's camels, and all sorts of good things of his master's, and went to Mesopotamia, to the town of Nahor.

chinese: 天將晚，眾女子出來打水的時候，他便叫駱駝跪在城外的水井那裡。
english: And he made the camels take their rest outside the town by the water-spring in the evening, at the time when the women came to get water.

chinese: 他說：耶和華─我主人亞伯拉罕的神阿，求你施恩給我主人亞伯拉罕，使我今日遇見好機會。
english: And he said, O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, let me do well in what I have undertaken this day, and give your mercy to my master Abraham.

chinese: 我現今站在井旁，城內居民的女子們正出來打水。
english: See, I am waiting here by the water-spring; and the daughters of the town are coming out to get water:

chinese: 我向那一個女子說：請你拿下水瓶來，給我水喝，他若說：請喝！我也給你的駱駝喝，願那女子就作你所預定給你僕人以撒的妻。這樣，我便知道你施恩給我主人了。
english: Now, may the girl to whom I say, Let down your vessel and give me a drink, and who says in answer, Here is a drink for you and let me give water to your camels: may she be the one marked out by you for your servant Isaac: so may I be certain that you have been good to my master Abraham.

chinese: 話還沒有說完，不料，利百加肩頭上扛著水瓶出來。利百加是彼土利所生的；彼土利是亞伯拉罕兄弟拿鶴妻子密迦的兒子。
english: And even before his words were ended, Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, who was the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, came out with her water-vessel on her arm.

chinese: 那女子容貌極其俊美，還是處女，也未曾有人親近他。他下到井旁，打滿了瓶，又上來。
english: She was a very beautiful girl, a virgin, who had never been touched by a man: and she went down to the spring to get water in her vessel.

chinese: 僕人跑上前去迎著他，說：求你將瓶裡的水給我一點喝。
english: And the servant came running to her and said, Give me a little water from your vessel.

chinese: 女子說：我主請喝！就急忙拿下瓶來，托在手上給他喝。
english: And she said, Take a drink, my lord: and quickly letting down her vessel onto her hand, she gave him a drink.

chinese: 女子給他喝了，就說：我再為你的駱駝打水，叫駱駝也喝足。
english: And having done so, she said, I will get water for your camels till they have had enough.

chinese: 他就急忙把瓶裡的水倒在槽裡，又跑到井旁打水，就為所有的駱駝打上水來。
english: And after putting the water from her vessel into the animals' drinking-place, she went quickly back to the spring and got water for all the camels.

chinese: 那人定睛看他，一句話也不說，要曉得耶和華賜他通達的道路沒有。
english: And the man, looking at her, said nothing, waiting to see if the Lord had given his journey a good outcome.

chinese: 駱駝喝足了，那人就拿一個金環，重半舍客勒，兩個金鐲，重十舍客勒，給了那女子，
english: And when the camels had had enough, the man took a gold nose-ring, half a shekel in weight, and two ornaments for her arms of ten shekels weight of gold;

chinese: 說：請告訴我，你是誰的女兒？你父親家裡有我們住宿的地方沒有？
english: And said to her, Whose daughter are you? is there room in your father's house for us?

chinese: 女子說：我是密迦與拿鶴之子彼土利的女兒；
english: And she said to him, I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, Nahor's wife.

chinese: 又說：我們家裡足有糧草，也有住宿的地方。
english: And she said, We have a great store of dry grass and cattle-food, and there is room for you.

chinese: 那人就低頭向耶和華下拜，
english: And with bent head the man gave worship to the Lord;

chinese: 說：耶和華─我主人亞伯拉罕的神是應當稱頌的，因他不斷地以慈愛誠實待我主人。至於我，耶和華在路上引領我，直走到我主人的兄弟家裡。
english: And said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who has given a sign that he is good and true to my master, by guiding me straight to the house of my master's family.

chinese: 女子跑回去，照著這些話告訴他母親和他家裡的人。
english: So the girl went running and took the news of these things to her mother's house

chinese: 利百加有一個哥哥，名叫拉班，看見金環，又看見金鐲在他妹子的手上，並聽見他妹子利百加的話，說那人對我如此如此說。拉班就跑出來往井旁去，到那人跟前，見他仍站在駱駝旁邊的井旁那裡，
english: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he came out quickly to the man at the water-spring.

And when he saw the nose-ring and the ornaments on his sister's hands, and when she gave him word of what the man had said to her, then he went out to the man who was waiting with the camels by the water-spring.

chinese: 便對他說：你這蒙耶和華賜福的，請進來，為甚麼站在外邊？我已經收拾了房屋，也為駱駝預備了地方。
english: And he said to him, Come in, you on whom is the blessing of the Lord; why are you waiting outside? for I have made the house ready for you, and a place for the camels.

chinese: 那人就進了拉班的家。拉班卸了駱駝，用草料餵上，拿水給那人和跟隨的人洗腳，
english: Then the man came into the house, and Laban took their cords off the camels and gave them dry grass and food, and he gave to him and the men who were with him water for washing their feet.

chinese: 把飯擺在他面前，叫他吃，他卻說：我不吃，等我說明白我的事情再吃。拉班說：請說。
english: And meat was put before him, but he said, I will not take food till I have made my business clear to you. And they said, Do so.

chinese: 他說：我是亞伯拉罕的僕人。
english: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

chinese: 耶和華大大地賜福給我主人，使他昌大，又賜給他羊群、牛群、金銀、僕婢、駱駝，和驢。
english: The Lord has given my master every blessing, and he has become great: he has given him flocks and herds and silver and gold, and men-servants and women-servants and camels and asses.

chinese: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的時候給我主人生了一個兒子；我主人也將一切所有的都給了這個兒子。
english: And when Sarah, my master's wife, was old, she gave birth to a son, to whom he has given all he has.

chinese: 我主人叫我起誓說：你不要為我兒子娶迦南地的女子為妻。
english: And my master made me take an oath, saying, Do not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am living;

chinese: 你要往我父家、我本族那裡去，為我的兒子娶一個妻子。
english: But go to my father's house and to my relations for a wife for my son.

chinese: 我對我主人說：恐怕女子不肯跟我來。
english: And I said to my master, What if the woman will not come with me?

chinese: 他就說：我所事奉的耶和華必要差遣他的使者與你同去，叫你的道路通達，你就得以在我父家、我本族那裡，給我的兒子娶一個妻子。
english: And he said, The Lord, whom I have ever kept before me, will send his angel with you, who will make it possible for you to get a wife for my son from my relations and my father's house;

chinese: 只要你到了我本族那裡，我使你起的誓就與你無干。他們若不把女子交給你，我使你起的誓也與你無干。
english: And you will be free from your oath to me when you come to my people; and if they will not give her to you, you will be free from your oath.

chinese: 我今日到了井旁，便說：耶和華─我主人亞伯拉罕的神阿，願你叫我所行的道路通達。
english: And I came today to the water-spring, and I said, O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, if it is your purpose to give a good outcome to my journey,

chinese: 我如今站在井旁，對那一個出來打水的女子說：請你把你瓶裡的水給我一點喝；
english: Let it come about that, while I am waiting here by the water-spring, if a girl comes to get water and I say to her, Give me a little water from your vessel, and she says,

chinese: 他若說：你只管喝，我也為你的駱駝打水；願那女子就作耶和華給我主人兒子所預定的妻。
english: Take a drink, and I will get water for your camels; let her be the woman marked out by the Lord for my master's son.

chinese: 我心裡的話還沒有說完，利百加就出來，肩頭上扛著水瓶，下到井旁打水。我便對他說：請你給我水喝。
english: And even while I was saying this to myself, Rebekah came out with her vessel on her arm; and she went down to the spring to get water; and I said to her, Give me a drink.

chinese: 他就急忙從肩頭上拿下瓶來，說：請喝！我也給你的駱駝喝。我便喝了；他又給我的駱駝喝了。
english: And straight away she took down her vessel from her arm, and said, Take a drink, and I will get water for your camels.

chinese: 我問他說：你是誰的女兒？他說：我是密迦與拿鶴之子彼土利的女兒。我就把環子戴在他鼻子上，把鐲子戴在他兩手上。
english: And questioning her, I said, Whose daughter are you? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, the son of Nahor, and Milcah his wife. Then I put the ring on her nose and the ornaments on her hands.

chinese: 隨後我低頭向耶和華下拜，稱頌耶和華─我主人亞伯拉罕的神；因為他引導我走合式的道路，使我得著我主人兄弟的孫女，給我主人的兒子為妻。
english: And with bent head I gave worship and praise to the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, by whom I had been guided in the right way, to get the daughter of my master's brother for his son.

chinese: 現在你們若願以慈愛誠實待我主人，就告訴我；若不然，也告訴我，使我可以或向左，或向右。
english: And now, say if you will do what is good and right for my master or not, in order that it may be clear to me what I have to do.

chinese: 拉班和彼土利回答說：這事乃出於耶和華，我們不能向你說好說歹。
english: Then Laban and Bethuel said in answer, This is the Lord's doing: it is not for us to say Yes or No to you.

chinese: 看哪，利百加在你面前，可以將他帶去，照著耶和華所說的，給你主人的兒子為妻。
english: See, here is Rebekah: take her and go, and let her be your master's son's wife, as the Lord has said.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕的僕人聽見他們這話，就向耶和華俯伏在地。
english: And at these words, Abraham's servant went down on his face and gave praise to the Lord.

chinese: 當下僕人拿出金器、銀器，和衣服送給利百加，又將寶物送給他哥哥和他母親。
english: Then he took jewels of silver and jewels of gold and fair robes and gave them to Rebekah: and he gave things of value to her mother and her brother.

chinese: 僕人和跟從他的人吃了喝了，住了一夜。早晨起來，僕人就說：請打發我回我主人那裡去罷。
english: Then he and the men who were with him had food and drink, and took their rest there that night; and in the morning he got up, and said, Let me now go back to my master.

chinese: 利百加的哥哥和他母親說：讓女子同我們再住幾天，至少十天，然後他可以去。
english: But her brother and her mother said, Let the girl be with us a week or ten days, and then she may go.

chinese: 僕人說：耶和華既賜給我通達的道路，你們不要耽誤我，請打發我走，回我主人那裡去罷。
english: And he said, Do not keep me; the Lord has given a good outcome to my journey; let me now go back to my master.

chinese: 他們說：我們把女子叫來問問他，
english: And they said, We will send for the girl, and let her make the decision.

chinese: 就叫了利百加來，問他說：你和這人同去麼？利百加說：我去。
english: And they sent for Rebekah and said to her, Are you ready to go with this man? And she said, I am ready.

chinese: 於是他們打發妹子利百加和他的乳母，同亞伯拉罕的僕人，並跟從僕人的，都走了。
english: So they sent their sister Rebekah and her servant with Abraham's servant and his men.

chinese: 他們就給利百加祝福說：我們的妹子阿，願你作千萬人的母！願你的後裔得著仇敵的城門！
english: And they gave Rebekah their blessing, saying, O sister, may you be the mother of thousands and ten thousands; and may your seed overcome all those who make war against them.

chinese: 利百加和他的使女們起來，騎上駱駝，跟著那僕人，僕人就帶著利百加走了。
english: So Rebekah and her servant-women went with the man, seated on the camels; and so the servant took Rebekah and went on his way.

chinese: 那時，以撒住在南地，剛從庇耳•拉海•萊回來。
english: Now Isaac had come through the waste land to Beer-lahai-roi; for he was living in the South.

chinese: 天將晚，以撒出來在田間默想，舉目一看，見來了些駱駝。
english: And when the evening was near, he went wandering out into the fields, and lifting up his eyes he saw camels coming.

chinese: 利百加舉目看見以撒，就急忙下了駱駝，
english: And when Rebekah, looking up, saw Isaac, she got down from her camel,

chinese: 問那僕人說：這田間走來迎接我們的是誰？僕人說：是我的主人。利百加就拿帕子蒙上臉。
english: And said to the servant, Who is that man coming to us through the field? And the servant said, It is my master: then she took her veil, covering her face with it.

chinese: 僕人就將所辦的一切事都告訴以撒。
english: Then the servant gave Isaac the story of all he had done.

chinese: 以撒便領利百加進了他母親撒拉的帳棚，娶了他為妻，並且愛他。以撒自從他母親不在了，這才得了安慰。
english: And Isaac took Rebekah into his tent and she became his wife; and in his love for her, Isaac was comforted after his father's death.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。
english: And Abraham took another wife named Keturah.

chinese: 基土拉給他生了心蘭、約珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴，和書亞。
english: She became the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah.

chinese: 約珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孫是亞書利族、利都是族，和利烏米族。
english: And Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan. And from Dedan came the Asshurim and Letushim and Leummim.

chinese: 米甸的兒子是以法、以弗、哈諾、亞比大，和以勒大。這都是基土拉的子孫。
english: And from Midian came Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the offspring of Keturah.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕將一切所有的都給了以撒。
english: Now Abraham gave all his property to Isaac;

chinese: 亞伯拉罕把財物分給他庶出的眾子，趁著自己還在世的時候打發他們離開他的兒子以撒，往東方去。
english: But to the sons of his other women he gave offerings, and sent them away, while he was still living, into the east country.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五歲。
english: Now the years of Abraham's life were a hundred and seventy-five.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕壽高年邁，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖(原文作本民)那裡。
english: And Abraham came to his death, an old man, full of years; and he was put to rest with his people.

chinese: 他兩個兒子以撒、以實瑪利把他埋葬在麥比拉洞裡。這洞在幔利前、赫人瑣轄的兒子以弗崙的田中，
english: And Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, put him to rest in the hollow rock of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, near Mamre;

chinese: 就是亞伯拉罕向赫人買的那塊田。亞伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那裡。
english: The same field which Abraham got from the children of Heth: there Abraham was put to rest with Sarah, his wife.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕死了以後，神賜福給他的兒子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳拉海萊居住。
english: Now after the death of Abraham, the blessing of God was with Isaac, his son.

chinese: 撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲給亞伯拉罕所生的兒子是以實瑪利。
english: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, the son of Abraham, whose mother was Hagar the Egyptian, the servant of Sarah:

chinese: 以實瑪利兒子們的名字，按著他們的家譜記在下面。以實瑪利的長子是尼拜約，又有基達、亞德別、米比衫、
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael by their generations: Ishmael's first son was Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam

chinese: 米施瑪、度瑪、瑪撒、
english: And Mishma and Dumah and Massa,

chinese: 哈大、提瑪、伊突、拿非施、基底瑪。
english: Hadad and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

chinese: 這是以實瑪利眾子的名字，照著他們的村莊、營寨，作了十二族的族長。
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names in their towns and their tent-circles; twelve chiefs with their peoples.

chinese: 以實瑪利享壽一百三十七歲，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖(原文作本民)那裡。
english: And the years of Ishmael's life were a hundred and thirty-seven: and he came to his end, and was put to rest with his people.

chinese: 他子孫的住處在他眾弟兄東邊，從哈腓拉直到埃及前的書珥，正在亞述的道上。
english: And their country was from Havilah to Shur which is east of Egypt: they took their place to the east of all their brothers.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕的兒子以撒的後代記在下面。亞伯拉罕生以撒。
english: Now these are the generations of Abraham's son Isaac:

chinese: 以撒娶利百加為妻的時候正四十歲。利百加是巴旦亞蘭地的亞蘭人彼土利的女兒，是亞蘭人拉班的妹子。
english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramaean of Paddan-aram, and the sister of Laban the Aramaean, to be his wife.

chinese: 以撒因他妻子不生育，就為他祈求耶和華；耶和華應允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就懷了孕。
english: Isaac made prayer to the Lord for his wife because she had no children; and the Lord gave ear to his prayer, and Rebekah became with child.

chinese: 孩子們在他腹中彼此相爭，他就說：若是這樣，我為甚麼活著呢(或作我為甚麼如此呢)？他就去求問耶和華。
english: And the children were fighting together inside her, and she said, If it is to be so, why am I like this? So she went to put her question to the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華對他說：兩國在你腹內；兩族要從你身上出來。這族必強於那族；將來大的要服事小的。
english: And the Lord said to her, Two nations are in your body, and two peoples will come to birth from you: the one will be stronger than the other, and the older will be the servant of the younger.

chinese: 生產的日子到了，腹中果然是雙子。
english: And when the time came for her to give birth, there were two children in her body.

chinese: 先產的身體發紅，渾身有毛，如同皮衣，他們就給他起名叫以掃(就是有毛的意思)。
english: And the first came out red from head to foot like a robe of hair, and they gave him the name of Esau.

chinese: 隨後又生了以掃的兄弟，手抓住以掃的腳跟，因此給他起名叫雅各(就是抓住的意思)。利百加生下兩個兒子的時候，以撒年正六十歲。
english: And after him, his brother came out, gripping Esau's foot; and he was named Jacob: Isaac was sixty years old when she gave birth to them.

chinese: 兩個孩子漸漸長大，以掃善於打獵，常在田野；雅各為人安靜，常住在帳棚裡。
english: And the boys came to full growth; and Esau became a man of the open country, an expert bowman; but Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

chinese: 以撒愛以掃，因為常吃他的野味；利百加卻愛雅各。
english: Now Isaac's love was for Esau, because Esau's meat was greatly to his taste: but Rebekah had more love for Jacob.

chinese: 有一天，雅各熬湯，以掃從田野回來累昏了。
english: And one day Jacob was cooking some soup when Esau came in from the fields in great need of food;

chinese: 以掃對雅各說：我累昏了，求你把這紅湯給我喝。因此以掃又叫以東(就是紅的意思)。
english: And Esau said to Jacob, Give me a full meal of that red soup, for I am overcome with need for food: for this reason he was named Edom.

chinese: 雅各說：你今日把長子的名分賣給我罷。
english: And Jacob said, First of all give me your birthright.

chinese: 以掃說：我將要死，這長子的名分於我有甚麼益處呢？
english: And Esau said, Truly, I am at the point of death: what profit is the birthright to me?

chinese: 雅各說：你今日對我起誓罷。以掃就對他起了誓，把長子的名分賣給雅各。
english: And Jacob said, First of all give me your oath; and he gave him his oath, handing over his birthright to Jacob.

chinese: 於是雅各將餅和紅豆湯給了以掃，以掃吃了喝了，便起來走了。這就是以掃輕看了他長子的名分。
english: Then Jacob gave him bread and soup; and he took food and drink and went away, caring little for his birthright.

chinese: 在亞伯拉罕的日子，那地有一次饑荒；這時又有饑荒，以撒就往基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亞比米勒那裡。
english: Then came a time of great need in the land, like that which had been before in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, at Gerar.

chinese: 耶和華向以撒顯現，說：你不要下去，要住在我所指示你的地。
english: And the Lord came to him in a vision and said, Do not go down to Egypt; keep in the land of which I will give you knowledge:

chinese: 你寄居在這地，我必與你同在，賜福給你，因為我要將這些地都賜給你和你的後裔。我必堅定我向你父亞伯拉罕所起的誓。
english: Keep in this land, and I will be with you and give you my blessing; for to you and to your seed will I give all these lands, giving effect to the oath which I made to your father Abraham;

chinese: 我要加增你的後裔，像天上的星那樣多，又要將這些地都賜給你的後裔。並且地上萬國必因你的後裔得福─
english: I will make your seed like the stars of heaven in number, and will give them all these lands, and your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth;

chinese: 都因亞伯拉罕聽從我的話，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令、律例、法度。
english: Because Abraham gave ear to my voice and kept my words, my rules, my orders, and my laws.

chinese: 以撒就住在基拉耳。
english: So Isaac went on living in Gerar;

chinese: 那地方的人問到他的妻子，他便說：那是我的妹子。原來他怕說：是我的妻子；他心裡想：恐怕這地方的人為利百加的緣故殺我，因為他容貌俊美。
english: And when he was questioned by the men of the place about his wife, he said, She is my sister; fearing to say, She is my wife; for, he said, the men of the place may put me to death on account of Rebekah; because she is very beautiful.

chinese: 他在那裡住了許久。有一天，非利士人的王亞比米勒從窗戶裡往外觀看，見以撒和他的妻子利百加戲玩。
english: And when he had been there for some time, Abimelech, king of the Philistines, looking through a window, saw Isaac playing with Rebekah his wife.

chinese: 亞比米勒召了以撒來，對他說：他實在是你的妻子，你怎麼說他是你的妹子？以撒說：我心裡想，恐怕我因他而死。
english: And he said to Isaac, It is clear that she is your wife: why then did you say, She is my sister? And Isaac said, For fear that I might be put to death because of her.

chinese: 亞比米勒說：你向我們做的是甚麼事呢？民中險些有人和你的妻同寢，把我們陷在罪裡。
english: Then Abimelech said, What have you done to us? one of the people might well have had connection with your wife, and the sin would have been ours.

chinese: 於是亞比米勒曉諭眾民說：凡沾著這個人，或是他妻子的，定要把他治死。
english: And Abimelech gave orders to his people that anyone touching Isaac or his wife was to be put to death.

chinese: 以撒在那地耕種，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和華賜福給他，
english: Now Isaac, planting seed in that land, got in the same year fruit a hundred times as much, for the blessing of the Lord was on him.

chinese: 他就昌大，日增月盛，成了大富戶。
english: And his wealth became very great, increasing more and more;

chinese: 他有羊群牛群，又有許多僕人，非利士人就嫉妒他。
english: For he had great wealth of flocks and herds and great numbers of servants; so that the Philistines were full of envy.

chinese: 當他父親亞伯拉罕在世的日子，他父親的僕人所挖的井，非利士人全都塞住，填滿了土。
english: Now all the water-holes, which his father's servants had made in the days of Abraham, had been stopped up with earth by the Philistines.

chinese: 亞比米勒對以撒說：你離開我們去罷。因為你比我們強盛得多。
english: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go away from us, for you are stronger than we are.

chinese: 以撒就離開那裡，在基拉耳谷支搭帳棚，住在那裡。
english: So Isaac went away from there, and put up his tents in the valley of Gerar, making his living-place there.

chinese: 當他父親亞伯拉罕在世之日所挖的水井因非利士人在亞伯拉罕死後塞住了，以撒就重新挖出來，仍照他父親所叫的叫那些井的名字。
english: And he made again the water-holes which had been made in the days of Abraham his father, and which had been stopped up by the Philistines; and he gave them the names which his father had given them.

chinese: 以撒的僕人在谷中挖井，便得了一口活水井。
english: Now Isaac's servants made holes in the valley, and came to a spring of flowing water.

chinese: 基拉耳的牧人與以撒的牧人爭競，說：這水是我們的。以撒就給那井起名叫埃色(就是相爭的意思)，因為他們和他相爭。
english: But the herdmen of Gerar had a fight with Isaac's herdmen, for they said, The spring is ours: so he gave the spring the name of Esek, because there was a fight about it.

chinese: 以撒的僕人又挖了一口井，他們又為這井爭競，因此以撒給這井起名叫西提拿(就是為敵的意思)。
english: Then they made another water-hole, and there was a fight about that, so he gave it the name of Sitnah.

chinese: 以撒離開那裡，又挖了一口井，他們不為這井爭競了，他就給那井起名叫利河伯(就是寬闊的意思)。他說：耶和華現在給我們寬闊之地，我們必在這地昌盛。
english: Then he went away from there, and made another water-hole, about which there was no fighting: so he gave it the name of Rehoboth, for he said, Now the Lord has made room for us, and we will have fruit in this land.

chinese: 以撒從那裡上別是巴去。
english: And from there he went on to Beer-sheba.

chinese: 當夜耶和華向他顯現，說：我是你父親亞伯拉罕的神，不要懼怕！因為我與你同在，要賜福給你，並要為我僕人亞伯拉罕的緣故，使你的後裔繁多。
english: That night the Lord came to him in a vision, and said, I am the God of your father Abraham: have no fear for I am with you, blessing you, and your seed will be increased because of my servant Abraham.

chinese: 以撒就在那裡築了一座壇，求告耶和華的名，並且支搭帳棚；他的僕人便在那裡挖了一口井。
english: Then he made an altar there, and gave worship to the name of the Lord, and he put up his tents there, and there his servants made a water-hole.

chinese: 亞比米勒，同他的朋友亞戶撒和他的軍長非各，從基拉耳來見以撒。
english: And Abimelech had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his friend and Phicol, the captain of his army.

chinese: 以撒對他們說：你們既然恨我，打發我走了，為甚麼到我這裡來呢？
english: And Isaac said to them, Why have you come to me, seeing that in your hate for me you sent me away from you?

chinese: 他們說：我們明明的看見耶和華與你同在，便說，不如我們兩下彼此起誓，彼此立約，
english: And they said, We saw clearly that the Lord was with you: so we said, Let there be an oath between us and you, and let us make an agreement with you;

chinese: 使你不害我們，正如我們未曾害你，一味的厚待你，並且打發你平平安安的走。你是蒙耶和華賜福的了。
english: That you will do us no damage, even as we put no hand on you, and did you nothing but good, and sent you away in peace: and now the blessing of the Lord is on you.

chinese: 以撒就為他們設擺筵席，他們便吃了喝了。
english: Then he made a feast for them, and they all had food and drink.

chinese: 他們清早起來彼此起誓。以撒打發他們走，他們就平平安安的離開他走了。
english: And early in the morning they took an oath one to the other: then Isaac sent them away and they went on their way in peace.

chinese: 那一天，以撒的僕人來，將挖井的事告訴他說：我們得了水了。
english: And that day Isaac's servants came to him and gave him word of the water-hole which they had made, and said to him, We have come to water.

chinese: 他就給那井起名叫示巴；因此那城叫做別是巴，直到今日。
english: And he gave it the name of Shibah: so the name of that town is Beer-sheba to this day.

chinese: 以掃四十歲的時候娶了赫人比利的女兒猶滴，與赫人以倫的女兒巴實抹為妻。
english: And when Esau was forty years old, he took as his wives Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

chinese: 他們常使以撒和利百加心裡愁煩。
english: And Isaac and Rebekah had grief of mind because of them.

chinese: 以撒年老，眼睛昏花，不能看見，就叫了他大兒子以掃來，說：我兒。以掃說：我在這裡。
english: Now when Isaac was old and his eyes had become clouded so that he was not able to see, he sent for Esau, his first son, and said to him, My son: and he said, Here am I.

chinese: 他說：我如今老了，不知道那一天死。
english: And he said, See now, I am old, and my death may take place at any time:

chinese: 現在拿你的器械，就是箭囊和弓，往田野去為我打獵，
english: So take your arrows and your bow and go out to the field and get meat for me;

chinese: 照我所愛的做成美味，拿來給我吃，使我在未死之先給你祝福。
english: And make me food, good to the taste, such as is pleasing to me, and put it before me, so that I may have a meal and give you my blessing before death comes to me.

chinese: 以撒對他兒子以掃說話，利百加也聽見了。以掃往田野去打獵，要得野味帶來。
english: Now Isaac's words to his son were said in Rebekah's hearing. Then Esau went out to get the meat.

chinese: 利百加就對他兒子雅各說：我聽見你父親對你哥哥以掃說：
english: And Rebekah said to Jacob, her son, Your father said to your brother Esau in my hearing,

chinese: 你去把野獸帶來，做成美味給我吃，我好在未死之先，在耶和華面前給你祝福。
english: Go and get some roe's meat and make me a good meal, so that I may be full, and give you my blessing before the Lord before my death.

chinese: 現在，我兒，你要照著我所吩咐你的，聽從我的話。
english: Now, my son, do what I say.

chinese: 你到羊群裡去，給我拿兩隻肥山羊羔來，我便照你父親所愛的給他做成美味。
english: Go to the flock and get me two fat young goats; and I will make of them a meal to your father's taste:

chinese: 你拿到你父親那裡給他吃，使他在未死之先給你祝福。
english: And you will take it to him, so that he may have a good meal and give you his blessing before his death.

chinese: 雅各對他母親利百加說：我哥哥以掃渾身是有毛的，我身上是光滑的；
english: And Jacob said to Rebekah, his mother, But Esau my brother is covered with hair, while I am smooth:

chinese: 倘若我父親摸著我，必以我為欺哄人的，我就招咒詛，不得祝福。
english: If by chance my father puts his hand on me, it will seem to him that I am tricking him, and he will put a curse on me in place of a blessing.

chinese: 他母親對他說：我兒，你招的咒詛歸到我身上；你只管聽我的話，去把羊羔給我拿來。
english: And his mother said, Let the curse be on me, my son: only do as I say, and go and get them for me.

chinese: 他便去拿來，交給他母親；他母親就照他父親所愛的做成美味。
english: So he went and got them and took them to his mother: and she made a meal to his father's taste.

chinese: 利百加又把家裡所存大兒子以掃上好的衣服給他小兒子雅各穿上，
english: And Rebekah took the fair robes of her oldest son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son:

chinese: 又用山羊羔皮包在雅各的手上和頸項的光滑處，
english: And she put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck:

chinese: 就把所做的美味和餅交在他兒子雅各的手裡。
english: And she gave into the hand of Jacob, her son, the meat and the bread which she had made ready.

chinese: 雅各到他父親那裡說：我父親！他說：我在這裡。我兒，你是誰？
english: And he came to his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I: who are you, my son?

chinese: 雅各對他父親說：我是你的長子以掃；我已照你所吩咐我的行了。請起來坐著，吃我的野味，好給我祝福。
english: And Jacob said, I am Esau, your oldest son; I have done as you said: come now, be seated and take of my meat, so that you may give me a blessing.

chinese: 以撒對他兒子說：我兒，你如何找得這麼快呢？他說：因為耶和華─你的神使我遇見好機會得著的。
english: And Isaac said, How is it that you have got it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord your God made it come my way.

chinese: 以撒對雅各說：我兒，你近前來，我摸摸你，知道你真是我的兒子以掃不是？
english: And Isaac said, Come near so that I may put my hand on you, my son, and see if you are truly my son Esau or not.

chinese: 雅各就挨近他父親以撒。以撒摸著他，說：聲音是雅各的聲音，手卻是以掃的手。
english: And Jacob went near his father Isaac: and he put his hands on him; and he said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

chinese: 以撒就辨不出他來；因為他手上有毛，像他哥哥以掃的手一樣，就給他祝福；
english: And he did not make out who he was, because his hands were covered with hair like his brother Esau's hands: so he gave him a blessing.

chinese: 又說：你真是我兒子以掃麼？他說：我是。
english: And he said, Are you truly my son Esau? And he said, I am.

chinese: 以撒說：你遞給我，我好吃我兒子的野味，給你祝福。雅各就遞給他，他便吃了，又拿酒給他，他也喝了。
english: And he said, Put it before me and I will take of my son's meat, so that I may give you a blessing. And he put it before him and he took it; and he gave him wine, and he had a drink.

chinese: 他父親以撒對他說：我兒，你上前來與我親嘴。
english: And his father Isaac said to him, Come near now, my son, and give me a kiss.

chinese: 他就上前與父親親嘴。他父親一聞他衣服上的香氣，就給他祝福，說：我兒的香氣如同耶和華賜福之田地的香氣一樣。
english: And he came near and gave him a kiss; and smelling the smell of his clothing, he gave him a blessing, and said, See, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field on which the blessing of the Lord has come:

chinese: 願神賜你天上的甘露，地上的肥土，並許多五穀新酒。
english: May God give you the dew of heaven, and the good things of the earth, and grain and wine in full measure:

chinese: 願多民事奉你，多國跪拜你。願你作你弟兄的主；你母親的兒子向你跪拜。凡咒詛你的，願他受咒詛；為你祝福的，願他蒙福。
english: Let peoples be your servants, and nations go down before you: be lord over your brothers, and let your mother's sons go down before you: a curse be on everyone by whom you are cursed, and a blessing on those who give you a blessing.

chinese: 以撒為雅各祝福已畢，雅各從他父親那裡才出來，他哥哥以掃正打獵回來，
english: And when Isaac had come to the end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob had not long gone away from Isaac his father, Esau came in from the field.

chinese: 也做了美味，拿來給他父親，說：請父親起來，吃你兒子的野味，好給我祝福。
english: And he made ready a meal, good to the taste, and took it to his father, and said to him, Let my father get up and take of his son's meat, so that you may give me a blessing.

chinese: 他父親以撒對他說：你是誰？他說：我是你的長子以掃。
english: And Isaac his father said to him, Who are you? And he said, I am your oldest son, Esau.

chinese: 以撒就大大地戰兢，說：你未來之先，是誰得了野味拿來給我呢？我已經吃了，為他祝福；他將來也必蒙福。
english: And in great fear Isaac said, Who then is he who got meat and put it before me, and I took it all before you came, and gave him a blessing, and his it will be?

chinese: 以掃聽了他父親的話，就放聲痛哭，說：我父阿，求你也為我祝福！
english: And hearing the words of his father, Esau gave a great and bitter cry, and said to his father, Give a blessing to me, even to me, O my father!

chinese: 以撒說：你兄弟已經用詭計來將你的福分奪去了。
english: And he said, Your brother came with deceit, and took away your blessing.

chinese: 以掃說：他名雅各，豈不是正對麼？因為他欺騙了我兩次：他從前奪了我長子的名分，你看，他現在又奪了我的福分。以掃又說：你沒有留下為我可祝的福麼？
english: And he said, Is it because he is named Jacob that he has twice taken my place? for he took away my birthright, and now he has taken away my blessing. And he said, Have you not kept a blessing for me?

chinese: 以撒回答以掃說：我已立他為你的主，使他的弟兄都給他作僕人，並賜他五穀新酒可以養生。我兒，現在我還能為你做甚麼呢？
english: And Isaac answering said, But I have made him your master, and have given him all his brothers for servants; I have made him strong with grain and wine: what then am I to do for you, my son?

chinese: 以掃對他父親說：父阿，你只有一樣可祝的福麼？我父阿，求你也為我祝福！以掃就放聲而哭。
english: And Esau said to his father, Is that the only blessing you have, my father? give a blessing to me, even me! And Esau was overcome with weeping.

chinese: 他父親以撒說：地上的肥土必為你所住；天上的甘露必為你所得。
english: Then Isaac his father made answer and said to him, Far from the fertile places of the earth, and far from the dew of heaven on high will your living-place be:

chinese: 你必倚靠刀劍度日，又必事奉你的兄弟；到你強盛的時候，必從你頸項上掙開他的軛。
english: By your sword will you get your living and you will be your brother's servant; but when your power is increased his yoke will be broken from off your neck.

chinese: 以掃因他父親給雅各祝的福，就怨恨雅各，心裡說：為我父親居喪的日子近了，到那時候，我要殺我的兄弟雅各。
english: So Esau was full of hate for Jacob because of his father's blessing; and he said in his heart, The days of weeping for my father are near; then I will put my brother Jacob to death.

chinese: 有人把利百加大兒子以掃的話告訴利百加，他就打發人去，叫了他小兒子雅各來，對他說：你哥哥以掃想要殺你，報仇雪恨。
english: Then Rebekah, hearing what Esau had said, sent for Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, It seems that your brother Esau is purposing to put you to death.

chinese: 現在，我兒，你要聽我的話：起來，逃往哈蘭、我哥哥拉班那裡去，
english: So now, my son, do what I say: go quickly to Haran, to my brother Laban;

chinese: 同他住些日子，直等你哥哥的怒氣消了。
english: And be there with him for a little time, till your brother's wrath is turned away;

chinese: 你哥哥向你消了怒氣，忘了你向他所做的事，我便打發人去把你從那裡帶回來。為甚麼一日喪你們二人呢？
english: Till the memory of what you have done to him is past and he is no longer angry: then I will send word for you to come back; are the two of you to be taken from me in one day?

chinese: 利百加對以撒說：我因這赫人的女子連性命都厭煩了；倘若雅各也娶赫人的女子為妻，像這些一樣，我活著還有甚麼益處呢？
english: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, My life is a weariness to me because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob takes a wife from among the daughters of Heth, such as these, the women of this land, of what use will my life be to me?

chinese: 以撒叫了雅各來，給他祝福，並囑咐他說：你不要娶迦南的女子為妻。
english: Then Isaac sent for Jacob, and blessing him, said, Do not take a wife from among the women of Canaan;

chinese: 你起身往巴旦亞蘭去，到你外祖彼土利家裡，在你母舅拉班的女兒中娶一女為妻。
english: But go to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel, your mother's father, and there get yourself a wife from the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother.

chinese: 願全能的神賜福給你，使你生養眾多，成為多族，
english: And may God, the Ruler of all, give you his blessing, giving you fruit and increase, so that you may become an army of peoples.

chinese: 將應許亞伯拉罕的福賜給你和你的後裔，使你承受你所寄居的地為業，就是神賜給亞伯拉罕的地。
english: And may God give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your seed, so that the land of your wanderings, which God gave to Abraham, may be your heritage.

chinese: 以撒打發雅各走了，他就往巴旦亞蘭去，到亞蘭人彼土利的兒子拉班那裡。拉班是雅各、以掃的母舅。
english: So Isaac sent Jacob away: and he went to Paddan-aram, to Laban, son of Bethuel the Aramaean, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.

chinese: 以掃見以撒已經給雅各祝福，而且打發他往巴旦亞蘭去，在那裡娶妻，並見祝福的時候囑咐他說：不要娶迦南的女子為妻，
english: So when Esau saw that Isaac had given Jacob his blessing, and sent him away to Paddan-aram to get a wife for himself there, blessing him and saying to him, Do not take a wife from among the women of Canaan;

chinese: 又見雅各聽從父母的話往巴旦亞蘭去了，
english: And that Jacob had done as his father and mother said and had gone to Paddan-aram;

chinese: 以掃就曉得他父親以撒看不中迦南的女子，
english: It was clear to Esau that his father had no love for the women of Canaan,

chinese: 便往以實瑪利那裡去，在他二妻之外又娶了瑪哈拉為妻。他是亞伯拉罕兒子以實瑪利的女兒，尼拜約的妹子。
english: So Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, the daughter of Abraham's son Ishmael, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife in addition to the wives he had.

chinese: 雅各出了別是巴，向哈蘭走去；
english: So Jacob went out from Beer-sheba to go to Haran.

chinese: 到了一個地方，因為太陽落了，就在那裡住宿，便拾起那地方的一塊石頭枕在頭下，在那裡躺臥睡了，
english: And coming to a certain place, he made it his resting-place for the night, for the sun had gone down; and he took one of the stones which were there, and putting it under his head he went to sleep in that place.

chinese: 夢見一個梯子立在地上，梯子的頭頂著天，有神的使者在梯子上，上去下來。
english: And he had a dream, and in his dream he saw steps stretching from earth to heaven, and the angels of God were going up and down on them.

chinese: 耶和華站在梯子以上(或作站在他旁邊)，說：我是耶和華─你祖亞伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的　神；我要將你現在所躺臥之地賜給你和你的後裔。
english: And he saw the Lord by his side, saying, I am the Lord, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac: I will give to you and to your seed this land on which you are sleeping.

chinese: 你的後裔必像地上的塵沙那樣多，必向東西南北開展；地上萬族必因你和你的後裔得福。
english: Your seed will be like the dust of the earth, covering all the land to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south: you and your seed will be a name of blessing to all the families of the earth.

chinese: 我也與你同在。你無論往那裡去，我必保佑你，領你歸回這地，總不離棄你，直到我成全了向你所應許的。
english: And truly, I will be with you, and will keep you wherever you go, guiding you back again to this land; and I will not give you up till I have done what I have said to you.

chinese: 雅各睡醒了，說：耶和華真在這裡，我竟不知道！
english: And Jacob, awaking from his sleep, said, Truly, the Lord is in this place and I was not conscious of it.

chinese: 就懼怕，說：這地方何等可畏！這不是別的，乃是神的殿，也是天的門。
english: And fear came on him, and he said, This is a holy place; this is nothing less than the house of God and the doorway of heaven.

chinese: 雅各清早起來，把所枕的石頭立作柱子，澆油在上面。
english: And early in the morning Jacob took the stone which had been under his head, and put it up as a pillar and put oil on it.

chinese: 他就給那地方起名叫伯特利(就是神殿的意思)；但那地方起先名叫路斯。
english: And he gave that place the name of Beth-el, but before that time the town was named Luz.

chinese: 雅各許願說：神若與我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又給我食物吃，衣服穿，
english: Then Jacob took an oath, and said, If God will be with me, and keep me safe on my journey, and give me food and clothing to put on,

chinese: 使我平平安安地回到我父親的家，我就必以耶和華為我的神。
english: So that I come again to my father's house in peace, then I will take the Lord to be my God,

chinese: 我所立為柱子的石頭也必作神的殿，凡你所賜給我的，我必將十分之一獻給你。
english: And this stone which I have put up for a pillar will be God's house: and of all you give me, I will give a tenth part to you.

chinese: 雅各起行，到了東方人之地，
english: Then Jacob went on his journey till he came to the land of the children of the East.

chinese: 看見田間有一口井，有三群羊臥在井旁；因為人飲羊群都是用那井裡的水。井口上的石頭是大的。
english: And there he saw a water-hole in a field, and by the side of it three flocks of sheep, for there they got water for the sheep: and on the mouth of the water-hole there was a great stone.

chinese: 常有羊群在那裡聚集，牧人把石頭轉離井口飲羊，隨後又把石頭放在井口的原處。
english: And all the flocks would come together there, and when the stone had been rolled away, they would give the sheep water, and put the stone back again in its place on the mouth of the water-hole.

chinese: 雅各對牧人說：弟兄們，你們是那裡來的？他們說：我們是哈蘭來的。
english: Then Jacob said to the herdmen, My brothers, where do you come from? And they said, From Haran.

chinese: 他問他們說：拿鶴的孫子拉班，你們認識麼？他們說：我們認識。
english: And he said to them, Have you any knowledge of Laban, the son of Nahor? And they said, We have.

chinese: 雅各說：他平安麼？他們說：平安。看哪，他女兒拉結領著羊來了。
english: And he said to them, Is he well? And they said, He is well, and here is Rachel his daughter coming with the sheep.

chinese: 雅各說：日頭還高，不是羊群聚集的時候，你們不如飲羊，再去放一放。
english: Then Jacob said, The sun is still high and it is not time to get the cattle together: get water for the sheep and go and give them their food.

chinese: 他們說：我們不能，必等羊群聚齊，人把石頭轉離井口才可飲羊。
english: And they said, We are not able to do so till all the flocks have come together and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the water-hole; then we will get water for the sheep.

chinese: 雅各正和他們說話的時候，拉結領著他父親的羊來了，因為那些羊是他牧放的。
english: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep, for she took care of them.

chinese: 雅各看見母舅拉班的女兒拉結和母舅拉班的羊群，就上前把石頭轉離井口，飲他母舅拉班的羊群。
english: Then when Jacob saw Rachel, the daughter of Laban, his mother's brother, coming with Laban's sheep, he came near, and rolling the stone away from the mouth of the hole, he got water for Laban's flock.

chinese: 雅各與拉結親嘴，就放聲而哭。
english: And weeping for joy, Jacob gave Rachel a kiss.

chinese: 雅各告訴拉結，自己是他父親的外甥，是利百加的兒子，拉結就跑去告訴他父親。
english: And Rachel, hearing from Jacob that he was her father's relation and that he was the son of Rebekah, went running to give her father news of it.

chinese: 拉班聽見外甥雅各的信息，就跑去迎接，抱著他，與他親嘴，領他到自己的家。雅各將一切的情由告訴拉班。
english: And Laban, hearing news of Jacob, his sister's son, came running, and took Jacob in his arms, and kissing him, made him come into his house. And Jacob gave him news of everything.

chinese: 拉班對他說：你實在是我的骨肉。雅各就和他同住了一個月。
english: And Laban said to him, Truly, you are my bone and my flesh. And he kept Jacob with him for the space of a month.

chinese: 拉班對雅各說：你雖是我的骨肉(原文作弟兄)，豈可白白地服事我？請告訴我，你要甚麼為工價？
english: Then Laban said to Jacob, Because you are my brother are you to be my servant for nothing? say now, what is your payment to be?

chinese: 拉班有兩個女兒，大的名叫利亞，小的名叫拉結。
english: Now Laban had two daughters: the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

chinese: 利亞的眼睛沒有神氣，拉結卻生得美貌俊秀。
english: And Leah's eyes were clouded, but Rachel was fair in face and form.

chinese: 雅各愛拉結，就說：我願為你小女兒拉結服事你七年。
english: And Jacob was in love with Rachel; and he said, I will be your servant seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.

chinese: 拉班說：我把他給你，勝似給別人，你與我同住罷！
english: And Laban said, It is better for you to have her than another man: go on living here with me.

chinese: 雅各就為拉結服事了七年；他因為深愛拉結，就看這七年如同幾天。
english: And Jacob did seven years' work for Rachel; and because of his love for her it seemed to him only a very little time.

chinese: 雅各對拉班說：日期已經滿了，求你把我的妻子給我，我好與他同房。
english: Then Jacob said to Laban, Give me my wife so that I may have her, for the days are ended.

chinese: 拉班就擺設筵席，請齊了那地方的眾人。
english: And Laban got together all the men of the place and gave a feast.

chinese: 到晚上，拉班將女兒利亞送來給雅各，雅各就與他同房。
english: And in the evening he took Leah, his daughter, and gave her to him, and he went in to her.

chinese: 拉班又將婢女悉帕給女兒利亞作使女。
english: And Laban gave Zilpah, his servant-girl, to Leah, to be her waiting-woman.

chinese: 到了早晨，雅各一看是利亞，就對拉班說：你向我做的是甚麼事呢？我服事你，不是為拉結麼？你為甚麼欺哄我呢？
english: And in the morning Jacob saw that it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What have you done to me? was I not working for you so that I might have Rachel? why have you been false to me?

chinese: 拉班說：大女兒還沒有給人，先把小女兒給人，在我們這地方沒有這規矩。
english: And Laban said, In our country we do not let the younger daughter be married before the older.

chinese: 你為這個滿了七日，我就把那個也給你，你再為他服事我七年。
english: Let the week of the bride-feast come to its end and then we will give you the other in addition, if you will be my servant for another seven years.

chinese: 雅各就如此行。滿了利亞的七日，拉班便將女兒拉結給雅各為妻。
english: And Jacob did so; and when the week was ended, Laban gave him his daughter Rachel for his wife.

chinese: 拉班又將婢女辟拉給女兒拉結作使女。
english: And Laban gave Rachel his servant-girl Bilhah to be her waiting-woman.

chinese: 雅各也與拉結同房，並且愛拉結勝似愛利亞，於是又服事了拉班七年。
english: Then Jacob took Rachel as his wife, and his love for her was greater than his love for Leah; and he went on working for Laban for another seven years.

chinese: 耶和華見利亞失寵(原文作被恨；下同)，就使他生育，拉結卻不生育。
english: Now the Lord, seeing that Leah was not loved, gave her a child; while Rachel had no children.

chinese: 利亞懷孕生子，就給他起名叫流便(就是有兒子的意思)，因而說：耶和華看見我的苦情，如今我的丈夫必愛我。
english: And Leah was with child, and gave birth to a son to whom she gave the name Reuben: for she said, The Lord has seen my sorrow; now my husband will have love for me.

chinese: 他又懷孕生子，就說：耶和華因為聽見我失寵，所以又賜給我這個兒子，於是給他起名叫西緬(就是聽見的意思)。
english: Then she became with child again, and gave birth to a son; and said, Because it has come to the Lord's ears that I am not loved, he has given me this son in addition: and she gave him the name Simeon.

chinese: 他又懷孕生子，起名叫利未(就是聯合的意思)，說：我給丈夫生了三個兒子，他必與我聯合。
english: And she was with child again, and gave birth to a son; and said, Now at last my husband will be united to me, because I have given him three sons: so he was named Levi.

chinese: 他又懷孕生子，說：這回我要讚美耶和華，因此給他起名叫猶大(就是讚美的意思)。這才停了生育。
english: And she was with child again, and gave birth to a son: and she said, This time I will give praise to the Lord: so he was named Judah; after this she had no more children for a time.

chinese: 拉結見自己不給雅各生子，就嫉妒他姊姊，對雅各說：你給我孩子，不然我就死了。
english: Now Rachel, because she had no children, was full of envy of her sister; and she said to Jacob, If you do not give me children I will not go on living.

chinese: 雅各向拉結生氣，說：叫你不生育的是神，我豈能代替他作主呢？
english: But Jacob was angry with Rachel, and said, Am I in the place of God, who has kept your body from having fruit?

chinese: 拉結說：有我的使女辟拉在這裡，你可以與他同房，使他生子在我膝下，我便因他也得孩子(原文作被建立)。
english: Then she said, Here is my servant Bilhah, go in to her, so that she may have a child on my knees, and I may have a family by her.

chinese: 拉結就把他的使女辟拉給丈夫為妾；雅各便與他同房，
english: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife, and Jacob went in to her.

chinese: 辟拉就懷孕，給雅各生了一個兒子。
english: And Bilhah became with child, and gave birth to a son.

chinese: 拉結說：神伸了我的冤，也聽了我的聲音，賜我一個兒子，因此給他起名叫但(就是伸冤的意思)。
english: Then Rachel said, God has been my judge, and has given ear to my voice, and has given me a son; so he was named Dan.

chinese: 拉結的使女辟拉又懷孕，給雅各生了第二個兒子。
english: And again Bilhah, Rachel's servant, was with child, and gave birth to a second son.

chinese: 拉結說：我與我姊姊大大相爭，並且得勝，於是給他起名叫拿弗他利(就是相爭的意思)。
english: And Rachel said, I have had a great fight with my sister, and I have overcome her: and she gave the child the name Naphtali.

chinese: 利亞見自己停了生育，就把使女悉帕給雅各為妾。
english: When it was clear to Leah that she would have no more children for a time, she gave Zilpah, her servant, to Jacob as a wife.

chinese: 利亞的使女悉帕給雅各生了一個兒子。
english: And Zilpah, Leah's servant, gave birth to a son.

chinese: 利亞說：萬幸！於是給他起名叫迦得(就是萬幸的意思)。
english: And Leah said, It has gone well for me: and she gave him the name Gad.

chinese: 利亞的使女悉帕又給雅各生了第二個兒子。
english: And Zilpah, Leah's servant, gave birth to a second son.

chinese: 利亞說：我有福阿，眾女子都要稱我是有福的，於是給他起名叫亞設(就是有福的意思)。
english: And Leah said, Happy am I! and all women will give witness to my joy: and she gave him the name Asher.

chinese: 割麥子的時候，流便往田裡去，尋見風茄，拿來給他母親利亞。拉結對利亞說：請你把你兒子的風茄給我些。
english: Now at the time of the grain-cutting, Reuben saw some love-fruits in the field, and took them to his mother Leah. And Rachel said to her, Let me have some of your son's love-fruits.

chinese: 利亞說：你奪了我的丈夫還算小事麼？你又要奪我兒子的風茄麼？拉結說：為你兒子的風茄，今夜他可以與你同寢。
english: But Leah said to her, Is it a small thing that you have taken my husband from me? and now would you take my son's love-fruits? Then Rachel said, You may have him tonight in exchange for your son's love-fruits.

chinese: 到了晚上，雅各從田裡回來，利亞出來迎接他，說：你要與我同寢，因為我實在用我兒子的風茄把你雇下了。那一夜，雅各就與他同寢。
english: In the evening, when Jacob came in from the field, Leah went out to him and said, Tonight you are to come to me, for I have given my son's love-fruits as a price for you. And he went in to her that night.

chinese: 神應允了利亞，他就懷孕，給雅各生了第五個兒子。
english: And God gave ear to her and she became with child, and gave Jacob a fifth son.

chinese: 利亞說：神給了我價值，因為我把使女給了我丈夫，於是給他起名叫以薩迦(就是價值的意思)。
english: Then Leah said, God has made payment to me for giving my servant-girl to my husband: so she gave her son the name Issachar.

chinese: 利亞又懷孕，給雅各生了第六個兒子。
english: And again Leah became with child, and she gave Jacob a sixth son.

chinese: 利亞說：神賜我厚賞；我丈夫必與我同住，因我給他生了六個兒子，於是給他起名西布倫(就是同住的意思)。
english: And she said, God has given me a good bride-price; now at last will I have my husband living with me, for I have given him six sons: and she gave him the name Zebulun.

chinese: 後來又生了一個女兒，給他起名叫底拿。
english: After that she had a daughter, to whom she gave the name Dinah.

chinese: 神顧念拉結，應允了他，使他能生育。
english: Then God gave thought to Rachel, and hearing her prayer he made her fertile.

chinese: 拉結懷孕生子，說：神除去了我的羞恥，
english: And she was with child, and gave birth to a son: and she said, God has taken away my shame.

chinese: 就給他起名叫約瑟(就是增添的意思)，意思說：願耶和華再增添我一個兒子。
english: And she gave him the name Joseph, saying, May the Lord give me another son.

chinese: 拉結生約瑟之後，雅各對拉班說：請打發我走，叫我回到我本鄉本土去。
english: Now after the birth of Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Let me go away to my place and my country.

chinese: 請你把我服事你所得的妻子和兒女給我，讓我走；我怎樣服事你，你都知道。
english: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have been your servant, and let me go: for you have knowledge of all the work I have done for you.

chinese: 拉班對他說：我若在你眼前蒙恩，請你仍與我同住，因為我已算定，耶和華賜福與我是為你的緣故；
english: And Laban said, If you will let me say so, do not go away; for I have seen by the signs that the Lord has been good to me because of you.

chinese: 又說：請你定你的工價，我就給你。
english: Say then what your payment is to be and I will give it.

chinese: 雅各對他說：我怎樣服事你，你的牲畜在我手裡怎樣，是你知道的。
english: Then Jacob said, You have seen what I have done for you, and how your cattle have done well under my care.

chinese: 我未來之先，你所有的很少，現今卻發大眾多，耶和華隨我的腳步賜福與你。如今，我甚麼時候才為自己興家立業呢？
english: For before I came you had little, and it has been greatly increased; and the Lord has given you a blessing in everything I have done; but when am I to do something for my family?

chinese: 拉班說：我當給你甚麼呢？雅各說：甚麼你也不必給我，只有一件事，你若應承，我便仍舊牧放你的羊群。
english: And Laban said, What am I to give you? And Jacob said, Do not give me anything; but I will again take up the care of your flock if you will only do this for me:

chinese: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，把綿羊中凡有點的、有斑的，和黑色的，並山羊中凡有斑的、有點的，都挑出來；將來這一等的就算我的工價。
english: Let me go through all your flock today, taking out from among them all the sheep which are marked or coloured or black, and all the marked or coloured goats: these will be my payment.

chinese: 以後你來查看我的工價，凡在我手裡的山羊不是有點有斑的，綿羊不是黑色的，那就算是我偷的；這樣便可證出我的公義來。
english: And so you will be able to put my honour to the test in time to come; if you see among my flocks any goats which are not marked or coloured, or any sheep which is not black, you may take me for a thief.

chinese: 拉班說：好阿！我情願照著你的話行。
english: And Laban said, Let it be as you say.

chinese: 當日，拉班把有紋的、有斑的公山羊，有點的、有斑的、有雜白紋的母山羊，並黑色的綿羊，都挑出來，交在他兒子們的手下，
english: So that day he took all the he-goats which were banded or coloured, and all the she-goats which were marked or coloured or had white marks, and all the black sheep, and gave them into the care of his sons;

chinese: 又使自己和雅各相離三天的路程。雅各就牧養拉班其餘的羊。
english: And sent them three days' journey away: and Jacob took care of the rest of Laban's flock.

chinese: 雅各拿楊樹、杏樹、楓樹的嫩枝，將皮剝成白紋，使枝子露出白的來，
english: Then Jacob took young branches of trees, cutting off the skin so that the white wood was seen in bands.

chinese: 將剝了皮的枝子，對著羊群，插在飲羊的水溝裡和水槽裡，羊來喝的時候，牝牡配合。
english: And he put the banded sticks in the drinking-places where the flock came to get water; and they became with young when they came to the water.

chinese: 羊對著枝子配合，就生下有紋的、有點的、有斑的來。
english: And because of this, the flock gave birth to young which were marked with bands of colour.

chinese: 雅各把羊羔分出來，使拉班的羊與這有紋和黑色的羊相對，把自己的羊另放一處，不叫他和拉班的羊混雜。
english: These lambs Jacob kept separate; and he put his flock in a place by themselves and not with Laban's flock.

chinese: 到羊群肥壯配合的時候，雅各就把枝子插在水溝裡，使羊對著枝子配合。
english: And whenever the stronger ones of the flock became with young, Jacob put the sticks in front of them in the drinking-places, so that they might become with young when they saw the sticks.

chinese: 只是到羊瘦弱配合的時候就不插枝子。這樣，瘦弱的就歸拉班，肥壯的就歸雅各。
english: But when the flocks were feeble, he did not put the sticks before them; so that the feebler flocks were Laban's and the stronger were Jacob's.

chinese: 於是雅各極其發大，得了許多的羊群、僕婢、駱駝，和驢。
english: So Jacob's wealth was greatly increased; he had great flocks and women-servants and men-servants and camels and asses.

chinese: 雅各聽見拉班的兒子們有話說：雅各把我們父親所有的都奪了去，並藉著我們父親的，得了這一切的榮耀(或作財)。
english: Now it came to the ears of Jacob that Laban's sons were saying, Jacob has taken away all our father's property, and in this way he has got all this wealth.

chinese: 雅各見拉班的氣色向他不如從前了。
english: And Jacob saw that Laban's feeling for him was no longer what it had been before.

chinese: 耶和華對雅各說：你要回你祖、你父之地，到你親族那裡去，我必與你同在。
english: Then the Lord said to Jacob, Go back to the land of your fathers, and to your relations, and I will be with you.

chinese: 雅各就打發人，叫拉結和利亞到田野羊群那裡來，
english: And Jacob sent for Rachel and Leah to come to him in the field among his flock.

chinese: 對他們說：我看你們父親的氣色向我不如從前了；但我父親的神向來與我同在。
english: And he said to them, It is clear to me that your father's feeling is no longer what it was to me; but the God of my father has been with me

chinese: 你們也知道，我盡了我的力量服事你們的父親。
english: And you have seen how I have done all in my power for your father,

chinese: 你們的父親欺哄我，十次改了我的工價；然而神不容他害我。
english: But your father has not kept faith with me, and ten times he has made changes in my payment; but God has kept him from doing me damage.

chinese: 他若說：有點的歸你作工價，羊群所生的都有點；他若說：有紋的歸你作工價，羊群所生的都有紋。
english: If he said, All those in the flock which have marks are to be yours, then all the flock gave birth to marked young; and if he said, All the banded ones are to be yours, then all the flock had banded young.

chinese: 這樣，神把你們父親的牲畜奪來賜給我了。
english: So God has taken away your father's cattle and has given them to me.

chinese: 羊配合的時候，我夢中舉目一看，見跳母羊的公羊都是有紋的、有點的、有花斑的。
english: And at the time when the flock were with young, I saw in a dream that all the he-goats which were joined with the she-goats were banded and marked and coloured.

chinese: 神的使者在那夢中呼叫我說：雅各。我說：我在這裡。
english: And in my dream the angel of the Lord said to me, Jacob: and I said, Here am I.

chinese: 他說：你舉目觀看，跳母羊的公羊都是有紋的、有點的、有花斑的；凡拉班向你所做的，我都看見了。
english: And he said, See how all the he-goats are banded and marked and coloured: for I have seen what Laban has done to you.

chinese: 我是伯特利的神；你在那裡用油澆過柱子，向我許過願。現今你起來，離開這地，回你本地去罷！
english: I am the God of Beth-el, where you put oil on the pillar and took an oath to me: now then, come out of this land and go back to the country of your birth.

chinese: 拉結和利亞回答雅各說：在我們父親的家裡還有我們可得的分麼？還有我們的產業麼？
english: Then Rachel and Leah said to him in answer, What part or heritage is there for us in our father's house?

chinese: 我們不是被他當作外人麼？因為他賣了我們，吞了我們的價值。
english: Are we not as people from a strange country to him? for he took a price for us and now it is all used up.

chinese: 神從我們父親所奪出來的一切財物，那就是我們和我們孩子們的。現今凡神所吩咐你的，你只管去行罷！
english: For the wealth which God has taken from him is ours and our children's; so now, whatever God has said to you, do.

chinese: 雅各起來，使他的兒子和妻子都騎上駱駝，
english: Then Jacob put his wives and his sons on camels;

chinese: 又帶著他在巴旦亞蘭所得的一切牲畜和財物，往迦南地、他父親以撒那裡去了。
english: And sending on before him all his cattle and his property which he had got together in Paddan-aram, he made ready to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 當時拉班剪羊毛去了，拉結偷了他父親家中的神像。
english: Now Laban had gone to see to the cutting of the wool of his sheep; so Rachel secretly took the images of the gods of her father's house.

chinese: 雅各背著亞蘭人拉班偷走了，並不告訴他，
english: And Jacob went away secretly, without giving news of his flight to Laban the Aramaean.

chinese: 就帶著所有的逃跑。他起身過大河，面向基列山行去。
english: So he went away with all he had, and went across the River in the direction of the hill-country of Gilead.

chinese: 到第三日，有人告訴拉班，雅各逃跑了。
english: And on the third day Laban had news of Jacob's flight.

chinese: 拉班帶領他的眾弟兄去追趕，追了七日，在基列山就追上了。
english: And taking the men of his family with him, he went after him for seven days and overtook him in the hill-country of Gilead.

chinese: 夜間，神到亞蘭人拉班那裡，在夢中對他說：你要小心，不可與雅各說好說歹。
english: Then God came to Laban in a dream by night, and said to him, Take care that you say nothing good or bad to Jacob.

chinese: 拉班追上雅各。雅各在山上支搭帳棚；拉班和他的眾弟兄也在基列山上支搭帳棚。
english: Now when Laban overtook him, Jacob had put up his tent in the hill-country; and Laban and his brothers put up their tents in the hill-country of Gilead.

chinese: 拉班對雅各說：你做的是甚麼事呢？你背著我偷走了，又把我的女兒們帶了去，如同用刀劍擄去的一般。
english: And Laban said to Jacob, Why did you go away secretly, taking my daughters away like prisoners of war?

chinese: 你為甚麼暗暗地逃跑，偷著走，並不告訴我，叫我可以歡樂、唱歌、擊鼓、彈琴的送你回去？
english: Why did you make a secret of your flight, not giving me word of it, so that I might have sent you away with joy and songs, with melody and music?

chinese: 又不容我與外孫和女兒親嘴？你所行的真是愚昧！
english: You did not even let me give a kiss to my sons and my daughters. This was a foolish thing to do.

chinese: 我手中原有能力害你，只是你父親的神昨夜對我說：你要小心，不可與雅各說好說歹。
english: It is in my power to do you damage: but the God of your father came to me this night, saying, Take care that you say nothing good or bad to Jacob.

chinese: 現在你雖然想你父家，不得不去，為甚麼又偷了我的神像呢？
english: And now, it seems, you are going because your heart's desire is for your father's house; but why have you taken my gods?

chinese: 雅各回答拉班說：恐怕你把你的女兒從我奪去，所以我逃跑。
english: And Jacob, in answer, said to Laban, My fear was that you might take your daughters from me by force.

chinese: 至於你的神像，你在誰那裡搜出來，就不容誰存活。當著我們的眾弟兄，你認一認，在我這裡有甚麼東西是你的，就拿去。原來雅各不知道拉結偷了那些神像。
english: As for your gods, if anyone of us has them, let him be put to death: make search before us all for what is yours, and take it. For Jacob had no knowledge that Rachel had taken them.

chinese: 拉班進了雅各、利亞，並兩個使女的帳棚，都沒有搜出來，就從利亞的帳棚出來，進了拉結的帳棚。
english: So Laban went into Jacob's tent and into Leah's tent, and into the tents of the two servant-women, but they were not there; and he came out of Leah's tent and went into Rachel's.

chinese: 拉結已經把神像藏在駱駝的馱簍裡，便坐在上頭。拉班摸遍了那帳棚，並沒有摸著。
english: Now Rachel had taken the images, and had put them in the camels' basket, and was seated on them. And Laban, searching through all the tent, did not come across them.

chinese: 拉結對他父親說：現在我身上不便，不能在你面前起來，求我主不要生氣。這樣，拉班搜尋神像，竟沒有搜出來。
english: And she said to her father, Let not my lord be angry because I do not get up before you, for I am in the common condition of women. And with all his searching, he did not come across the images.

chinese: 雅各就發怒斥責拉班說：我有甚麼過犯，有甚麼罪惡，你竟這樣火速的追我？
english: Then Jacob was angry with Laban, and said, What crime or sin have I done that you have come after me with such passion?

chinese: 你摸遍了我一切的家具，你搜出甚麼來呢？可以放在你我弟兄面前，叫他們在你我中間辨別辨別。
english: Now that you have made search through all my goods, what have you seen which is yours? Make it clear now before my people and your people, so that they may be judges between us.

chinese: 我在你家這二十年，你的母綿羊、母山羊沒有掉過胎。你群中的公羊，我沒有吃過；
english: These twenty years I have been with you; your sheep and your goats have had young without loss, not one of your he-goats have I taken for food.

chinese: 被野獸撕裂的，我沒有帶來給你，是我自己賠上。無論是白日，是黑夜，被偷去的，你都向我索要。
english: Anything which was wounded by beasts I did not take to you, but myself made up for the loss of it; you made me responsible for whatever was taken by thieves, by day or by night.

chinese: 我白日受盡乾熱，黑夜受盡寒霜，不得合眼睡著，我常是這樣。
english: This was my condition, wasted by heat in the day and by the bitter cold at night; and sleep went from my eyes.

chinese: 我這二十年在你家裡，為你的兩個女兒服事你十四年，為你的羊群服事你六年，你又十次改了我的工價。
english: These twenty years I have been in your house; I was your servant for fourteen years because of your daughters, and for six years I kept your flock, and ten times was my payment changed.

chinese: 若不是我父親以撒所敬畏的神，就是亞伯拉罕的　神與我同在，你如今必定打發我空手而去。　神看見我的苦情和我的勞碌，就在昨夜責備你。
english: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, you would have sent me away with nothing in my hands. But God has seen my troubles and the work of my hands, and this night he kept you back.

chinese: 拉班回答雅各說：這女兒是我的女兒，這些孩子是我的孩子，這些羊群也是我的羊群；凡在你眼前的都是我的。我的女兒並他們所生的孩子，我今日能向他們做甚麼呢？
english: Then Laban, answering, said, These women are my daughters and these children my children, the flocks and all you see are mine: what now may I do for my daughters and for their children?

chinese: 來罷！你我二人可以立約，作你我中間的證據。
