english: Come, let us make an agreement, you and I; and let it be for a witness between us.

chinese: 雅各就拿一塊石頭立作柱子，
english: Then Jacob took a stone and put it up as a pillar.

chinese: 又對眾弟兄說：你們堆聚石頭。他們就拿石頭來堆成一堆，大家便在旁邊吃喝。
english: And Jacob said to his people, Get stones together; and they did so; and they had a meal there by the stones.

chinese: 拉班稱那石堆為伊迦爾撒哈杜他，雅各卻稱那石堆為迦累得(都是以石堆為證的意思)。
english: And the name Laban gave it was Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob gave it the name of Galeed.

chinese: 拉班說：今日這石堆作你我中間的證據。因此這地方名叫迦累得，
english: And Laban said, These stones are a witness between you and me today. For this reason its name was Galeed,

chinese: 又叫米斯巴，意思說：我們彼此離別以後，願耶和華在你我中間鑒察。
english: And Mizpah, for he said, May the Lord keep watch on us when we are unable to see one another's doings.

chinese: 你若苦待我的女兒，又在我的女兒以外另娶妻，雖沒有人知道，卻有神在你我中間作見證。
english: If you are cruel to my daughters, or if you take other wives in addition to my daughters, then though no man is there to see, God will be the witness between us.

chinese: 拉班又說：你看我在你我中間所立的這石堆和柱子。
english: And Laban said, See these stones and this pillar which I have put between you and me;

chinese: 這石堆作證據，這柱子也作證據。我必不過這石堆去害你；你也不可過這石堆和柱子來害我。
english: They will be witness that I will not go over these stones to you, and you will not go over these stones or this pillar to me, for any evil purpose.

chinese: 但願亞伯拉罕的神和拿鶴的　神，就是他們父親的　神，在你我中間判斷。雅各就指著他父親以撒所敬畏的神起誓，
english: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, be our judge. Then Jacob took an oath by the Fear of his father Isaac.

chinese: 又在山上獻祭，請眾弟兄來吃飯。他們吃了飯，便在山上住宿。
english: And Jacob made an offering on the mountain, and gave orders to his people to take food: so they had a meal and took their rest that night on the mountain.

chinese: 拉班清早起來，與他外孫和女兒親嘴，給他們祝福，回往自己的地方去了。
english: And early in the morning Laban, after kissing and blessing his daughters, went on his way back to his country.

chinese: 雅各仍舊行路，神的使者遇見他。
english: And on his way Jacob came face to face with the angels of God.

chinese: 雅各看見他們就說：這是神的軍兵，於是給那地方起名叫瑪哈念(就是二軍兵的意思)。
english: And when he saw them he said, This is the army of God: so he gave that place the name of Mahanaim.

chinese: 雅各打發人先往西珥地去，就是以東地，見他哥哥以掃，
english: Now Jacob sent servants before him to Esau, his brother, in the land of Seir, the country of Edom;

chinese: 吩咐他們說：你們對我主以掃說：你的僕人雅各這樣說：我在拉班那裡寄居，直到如今。
english: And he gave them orders to say these words to Esau: Your servant Jacob says, Till now I have been living with Laban:

chinese: 我有牛、驢、羊群、僕婢，現在打發人來報告我主，為要在你眼前蒙恩。
english: And I have oxen and asses and flocks and men-servants and women-servants: and I have sent to give my lord news of these things so that I may have grace in his eyes.

chinese: 所打發的人回到雅各那裡，說：我們到了你哥哥以掃那裡，他帶著四百人，正迎著你來。
english: When the servants came back they said, We have seen your brother Esau and he is coming out to you, and four hundred men with him.

chinese: 雅各就甚懼怕，而且愁煩，便把那與他同在的人口和羊群、牛群、駱駝分做兩隊，
english: Then Jacob was in great fear and trouble of mind: and he put all the people and the flocks and the herds and the camels into two groups;

chinese: 說：以掃若來擊殺這一隊，剩下的那一隊還可以逃避。
english: And said, If Esau, meeting one group, makes an attack on them, the others will get away safely.

chinese: 雅各說：耶和華─我祖亞伯拉罕的神，我父親以撒的　神阿，你曾對我說：回你本地本族去，我要厚待你。
english: Then Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, the God of my father Isaac, the Lord who said to me, Go back to your country and your family and I will be good to you:

chinese: 你向僕人所施的一切慈愛和誠實，我一點也不配得；我先前只拿著我的杖過這約但河，如今我卻成了兩隊了。
english: I am less than nothing in comparison with all your mercies and your faith to me your servant; for with only my stick in my hand I went across Jordan, and now I have become two armies.

chinese: 求你救我脫離我哥哥以掃的手；因為我怕他來殺我，連妻子帶兒女一同殺了。
english: Be my saviour from the hand of Esau, my brother: for my fear is that he will make an attack on me, putting to death mother and child.

chinese: 你曾說：我必定厚待你，使你的後裔如同海邊的沙，多得不可勝數。
english: And you said, Truly, I will be good to you, and make your seed like the sand of the sea which may not be numbered.

chinese: 當夜，雅各在那裡住宿，就從他所有的物中拿禮物要送給他哥哥以掃：
english: Then he put up his tent there for the night; and from among his goods he took, as an offering for his brother Esau,

chinese: 母山羊二百隻，公山羊二十隻，母綿羊二百隻，公綿羊二十隻，
english: Two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred females and twenty males from the sheep,

chinese: 奶崽子的駱駝三十隻─各帶著崽子，母牛四十隻，公牛十隻，母驢二十匹，驢駒十匹；
english: Thirty camels with their young ones, forty cows, ten oxen, twenty asses, and ten young asses.

chinese: 每樣各分一群，交在僕人手下，就對僕人說：你們要在我前頭過去，使群群相離，有空閒的地方；
english: These he gave to his servants, every herd by itself, and he said to his servants, Go on before me, and let there be a space between one herd and another.

chinese: 又吩咐儘先走的說：我哥哥以掃遇見你的時候，問你說：你是那家的人？要往那裡去？你前頭？這些是誰的？
english: And he gave orders to the first, saying, When my brother Esau comes to you and says, Whose servant are you, and where are you going, and whose are these herds?

chinese: 你就說：是你僕人雅各的，是送給我主以掃的禮物；他自己也在我們後邊？。
english: Then say to him, These are your servant Jacob's; they are an offering for my lord, for Esau; and he himself is coming after us.

chinese: 又吩咐第二、第三，和一切趕群畜的人說：你們遇見以掃的時候也要這樣對他說；
english: And he gave the same orders to the second and the third and to all those who were with the herds, saying, This is what you are to say to Esau when you see him;

chinese: 並且你們要說：你僕人雅各在我們後邊。因雅各心裡說：我藉著在我前頭去的禮物解他的恨，然後再見他的面，或者他容納我。
english: And you are to say further, Jacob, your servant, is coming after us. For he said to himself, I will take away his wrath by the offering which I have sent on, and then I will come before him: it may be that I will have grace in his eyes.

chinese: 於是禮物先過去了；那夜，雅各在隊中住宿。
english: So the servants with the offerings went on in front, and he himself took his rest that night in the tents with his people.

chinese: 他夜間起來，帶著兩個妻子，兩個使女，並十一個兒子，都過了雅博渡口，
english: And in the night he got up, and taking with him his two wives and the two servant-women and his eleven children, he went over the river Jabbok.

chinese: 先打發他們過河，又打發所有的都過去，
english: He took them and sent them over the stream with all he had.

chinese: 只剩下雅各一人。有一個人來和他摔跤，直到黎明。
english: Then Jacob was by himself; and a man was fighting with him till dawn.

chinese: 那人見自己勝不過他，就將他的大腿窩摸了一把，雅各的大腿窩正在摔跤的時候就扭了。
english: But when the man saw that he was not able to overcome Jacob, he gave him a blow in the hollow part of his leg, so that his leg was damaged.

chinese: 那人說：天黎明了，容我去罷！雅各說：你不給我祝福，我就不容你去。
english: And he said to him, Let me go now, for the dawn is near. But Jacob said, I will not let you go till you have given me your blessing.

chinese: 那人說：你名叫甚麼？他說：我名叫雅各。
english: Then he said, What is your name? And he said, Jacob.

chinese: 那人說：你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因為你與神與人較力，都得了勝。
english: And he said, Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel: for in your fight with God and with men you have overcome.

chinese: 雅各問他說：請將你的名告訴我。那人說：何必問我的名？於是在那裡給雅各祝福。
english: Then Jacob said, What is your name? And he said, What is my name to you? Then he gave him a blessing.

chinese: 雅各便給那地方起名叫毘努伊勒(就是神之面的意思)，意思說：我面對面見了神，我的性命仍得保全。
english: And Jacob gave that place the name of Peniel, saying, I have seen God face to face, and still I am living.

chinese: 日頭剛出來的時候，雅各經過毘努伊勒，他的大腿就瘸了。
english: And while he was going past Peniel, the sun came up. And he went with unequal steps because of his damaged leg.

chinese: 故此，以色列人不吃大腿窩的筋，直到今日，因為那人摸了雅各大腿窩的筋。
english: For this reason the children of Israel, even today, never take that muscle in the hollow of the leg as food, because the hollow of Jacob's leg was touched.

chinese: 雅各舉目觀看，見以掃來了，後頭跟著四百人，他就把孩子們分開交給利亞、拉結，和兩個使女，
english: Then Jacob, lifting up his eyes, saw Esau coming with his four hundred men. So he made a division of the children between Leah and Rachel and the two women-servants.

chinese: 並且叫兩個使女和他們的孩子在前頭，利亞和他的孩子在後頭，拉結和約瑟在儘後頭。
english: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after them, and Rachel and Joseph at the back.

chinese: 他自己在他們前頭過去，一連七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。
english: And he himself, going before them, went down on his face to the earth seven times till he came near his brother.

chinese: 以掃跑來迎接他，將他抱住，又摟著他的頸項，與他親嘴，兩個人就哭了。
english: Then Esau came running up to him, and folding him in his arms, gave him a kiss: and the two of them were overcome with weeping.

chinese: 以掃舉目看見婦人孩子，就說：這些？和你同行的是誰呢？雅各說：這些孩子是神施恩給你的僕人的。
english: Then Esau, lifting up his eyes, saw the women and the children, and said, Who are these with you? And he said, The children whom God in his mercy has given to your servant.

chinese: 於是兩個使女和他們的孩子前來下拜；
english: Then the servants and their children came near, and went down on their faces.

chinese: 利亞和他的孩子也前來下拜；隨後約瑟和拉結也前來下拜。
english: And Leah came near with her children, and then Joseph and Rachel, and they did the same.

chinese: 以掃說：我所遇見的這些群畜是甚麼意思呢？雅各說：是要在我主面前蒙恩的。
english: And he said, What were all those herds which I saw on the way? And Jacob said, They were an offering so that I might have grace in my lord's eyes.

chinese: 以掃說：兄弟阿，我的已經夠了，你的仍歸你罷！
english: But Esau said, I have enough; keep what is yours, my brother, for yourself.

chinese: 雅各說：不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你從我手裡收下這禮物；因為我見了你的面，如同見了神的面，並且你容納了我。
english: And Jacob said, Not so; but if I have grace in your eyes, take them as a sign of my love, for I have seen your face as one may see the face of God, and you have been pleased with me.

chinese: 求你收下我帶來給你的禮物；因為神恩待我，使我充足。雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。
english: Take my offering then, with my blessing; for God has been very good to me and I have enough: so at his strong request, he took it.

chinese: 以掃說：我們可以起身前往，我在你前頭走。
english: And he said, Let us go on our journey together, and I will go in front.

chinese: 雅各對他說：我主知道孩子們年幼嬌嫩，牛羊也正在乳養的時候，若是催趕一天，群畜都必死了。
english: But Jacob said, My lord may see that the children are only small, and there are young ones in my flocks and herds: one day's over-driving will be the destruction of all the flock.

chinese: 求我主在僕人前頭走，我要量著在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那裡。
english: Do you, my lord, go on before your servant; I will come on slowly, at the rate at which the cattle and the children are able to go, till I come to my lord at Seir.

chinese: 以掃說：容我把跟隨我的人留幾個在你這裡。雅各說：何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。
english: And Esau said, Then keep some of my men with you. And he said, What need is there for that, if my lord is pleased with me?

chinese: 於是，以掃當日起行，回往西珥去了。
english: So Esau, turning back that day, went on his way to Seir.

chinese: 雅各就往疏割去，在那裡為自己蓋造房屋，又為牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫疏割(就是棚的意思)。
english: And Jacob went on to Succoth, where he made a house for himself and put up tents for his cattle: for this reason the place was named Succoth.

chinese: 雅各從巴旦亞蘭回來的時候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示劍城，在城東支搭帳棚，
english: So Jacob came safely from Paddan-aram to the town of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and put up his tents near the town.

chinese: 就用一百塊銀子向示劍的父親、哈抹的子孫買了支帳棚的那塊地，
english: And for a hundred bits of money he got from the children of Hamor, the builder of Shechem, the field in which he had put up his tents.

chinese: 在那裡築了一座壇，起名叫伊利伊羅伊以色列(就是神、以色列神的意思)。
english: And there he put up an altar, naming it El, the God of Israel.

chinese: 利亞給雅各所生的女兒底拿出去，要見那地的女子們。
english: Now Dinah, the daughter whom Leah had by Jacob, went out to see the women of that country.

chinese: 那地的主─希未人、哈抹的兒子示劍看見他，就拉住他，與他行淫，玷辱他。
english: And when Shechem, the son of Hamor the Hivite who was the chief of that land, saw her, he took her by force and had connection with her.

chinese: 示劍的心繫戀雅各的女兒底拿，喜愛這女子，甜言蜜語地安慰他。
english: Then his heart went out in love to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he said comforting words to her.

chinese: 示劍對他父親哈抹說：求你為我聘這女子為妻。
english: And Shechem said to Hamor, his father, Get me this girl for my wife.

chinese: 雅各聽見示劍玷污了他的女兒底拿。那時他的兒子們正和群畜在田野，雅各就閉口不言，等他們回來。
english: Now Jacob had word of what Shechem had done to his daughter; but his sons were in the fields with the cattle, and Jacob said nothing till they came.

chinese: 示劍的父親哈抹出來見雅各，要和他商議。
english: Then Hamor, the father of Shechem, came out to have a talk with Jacob.

chinese: 雅各的兒子們聽見這事，就從田野回來，人人忿恨，十分惱怒；因示劍在以色列家作了醜事，與雅各的女兒行淫，這本是不該做的事。
english: Now the sons of Jacob came in from the fields when they had news of it, and they were wounded and very angry because of the shame he had done in Israel by having connection with Jacob's daughter; and they said, Such a thing is not to be done.

chinese: 哈抹和他們商議說：我兒子示劍的心戀慕這女子，求你們將他給我的兒子為妻。
english: But Hamor said to them, Shechem, my son, is full of desire for your daughter: will you then give her to him for a wife?

chinese: 你們與我們彼此結親；你們可以把女兒給我們，也可以娶我們的女兒。
english: And let our two peoples be joined together; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

chinese: 你們與我們同住罷！這地都在你們面前，只管在此居住，做買賣，置產業。
english: Go on living with us, and the country will be open to you; do trade and get property there.

chinese: 示劍對女兒的父親和弟兄們說：但願我在你們眼前蒙恩，你們向我要甚麼，我必給你們。
english: And Shechem said to her father and her brothers, If you will give ear to my request, whatever you say I will give to you.

chinese: 任憑向我要多重的聘金和禮物，我必照你們所說的給你們；只要把女子給我為妻。
english: However great you make the bride-price and payment, I will give it; only let me have the girl for my wife.

chinese: 雅各的兒子們因為示劍玷污了他們的妹子底拿，就用詭詐的話回答示劍和他父親哈抹，
english: But the sons of Jacob gave a false answer to Shechem and Hamor his father, because of what had been done to Dinah their sister.

chinese: 對他們說：我們不能把我們的妹子給沒有受割禮的人為妻，因為那是我們的羞辱。
english: And they said, It is not possible for us to give our sister to one who is without circumcision, for that would be a cause of shame to us:

chinese: 惟有一件才可以應允：若你們所有的男丁都受割禮，和我們一樣，
english: But on this condition only will we come to an agreement with you: if every male among you becomes like us and undergoes circumcision;

chinese: 我們就把女兒給你們，也娶你們的女兒；我們便與你們同住，兩下成為一樣的人民。
english: Then we will give our daughters to you and take your daughters to us and go on living with you as one people.

chinese: 倘若你們不聽從我們受割禮，我們就帶著妹子走了。
english: But if you will not undergo circumcision as we say, then we will take our daughter and go.

chinese: 哈抹和他的兒子示劍喜歡這話。
english: And their words were pleasing to Hamor and his son Shechem.

chinese: 那少年人做這事並不遲延，因為他喜愛雅各的女兒；他在他父親家中也是人最尊重的。
english: And without loss of time the young man did as they said, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter, and he was the noblest of his father's house.

chinese: 哈抹和他兒子示劍到本城的門口，對本城的人說：
english: Then Hamor and Shechem, his son, went to the meeting-place of their town, and said to the men of the town,

chinese: 這些人與我們和睦，不如許他們在這地居住，做買賣；這地也寬闊，足可容下他們。我們可以娶他們的女兒為妻，也可以把我們的女兒嫁給他們。
english: It is the desire of these men to be at peace with us; let them then go on living in this country and doing trade here, for the country is wide open before them; let us take their daughters as wives and let us give them our daughters.

chinese: 惟有一件事我們必須做，他們才肯應允和我們同住，成為一樣的人民：就是我們中間所有的男丁都要受割禮，和他們一樣。
english: But these men will make an agreement with us to go on living with us and to become one people, only on the condition that every male among us undergoes circumcision as they have done.

chinese: 他們的群畜、貨財，和一切的牲口豈不都歸我們麼？只要依從他們，他們就與我們同住。
english: Then will not their cattle and their goods and all their beasts be ours? so let us come to an agreement with them so that they may go on living with us.

chinese: 凡從城門出入的人就都聽從哈抹和他兒子示劍的話；於是凡從城門出入的男丁都受了割禮。
english: Then all the men of the town gave ear to the words of Hamor and Shechem his son; and every male in the town underwent circumcision.

chinese: 到第三天，眾人正在疼痛的時候，雅各的兩個兒子，就是底拿的哥哥西緬和利未，各拿刀劍，趁著眾人想不到的時候來到城中，把一切男丁都殺了，
english: But on the third day after, before the wounds were well, two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, took their swords and came into the town by surprise and put all the males to death.

chinese: 又用刀殺了哈抹和他兒子示劍，把底拿從示劍家裡帶出來就走了。
english: And Hamor and his son they put to death with the sword, and they took Dinah from Shechem's house and went away.

chinese: 雅各的兒子們因為他們的妹子受了玷污，就來到被殺的人那裡，擄掠那城，
english: And the sons of Jacob came on them when they were wounded and made waste the town because of what had been done to their sister;

chinese: 奪了他們的羊群、牛群，和驢，並城裡田間所有的；
english: They took their flocks and their herds and their asses and everything in their town and in their fields,

chinese: 又把他們一切貨財、孩子、婦女，並各房中所有的，都擄掠去了。
english: And all their wealth and all their little ones and their wives; everything in their houses they took and made them waste.

chinese: 雅各對西緬和利未說：你們連累我，使我在這地的居民中，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中，有了臭名。我的人丁既然稀少，他們必聚集來擊殺我，我和全家的人都必滅絕。
english: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, You have made trouble for me and given me a bad name among the people of this country, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and because we are small in number they will come together against me and make war on me; and it will be the end of me and all my people.

chinese: 他們說：他豈可待我們的妹子如同妓女麼？
english: But they said, Were we to let him make use of our sister as a loose woman?

chinese: 神對雅各說：起來！上伯特利去，住在那裡；要在那裡築一座壇給神，就是你逃避你哥哥以掃的時候向你顯現的那位。
english: And God said to Jacob, Go up now to Beth-el and make your living-place there: and put up an altar there to the God who came to you when you were in flight from your brother Esau.

chinese: 雅各就對他家中的人並一切與他同在的人說：你們要除掉你們中間的外邦神，也要自潔，更換衣裳。
english: Then Jacob said to all his people, Put away the strange gods which are among you, and make yourselves clean, and put on a change of clothing:

chinese: 我們要起來，上伯特利去，在那裡我要築一座壇給神，就是在我遭難的日子應允我的禱告、在我行的路上保佑我的那位。
english: And let us go up to Beth-el: and there I will make an altar to God, who gave me an answer in the day of my trouble, and was with me wherever I went.

chinese: 他們就把外邦人的神像和他們耳朵上的環子交給雅各；雅各都藏在示劍那裡的橡樹底下。
english: Then they gave to Jacob all the strange gods which they had, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob put them away under the holy tree at Shechem.

chinese: 他們便起行前往。神使那周圍城邑的人都甚驚懼，就不追趕雅各的眾子了。
english: So they went on their journey: and the fear of God was on the towns round about, so that they made no attack on the sons of Jacob.

chinese: 於是雅各和一切與他同在的人到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
english: And Jacob came to Luz in the land of Canaan (which is the same as Beth-el), he and all his people.

chinese: 他在那裡築了一座壇，就給那地方起名叫伊勒伯特利(就是伯特利之神的意思)；因為他逃避他哥哥的時候，神在那裡向他顯現。
english: And there he made an altar, naming the place El-beth-el: because it was there he had the vision of God when he was in flight from his brother.

chinese: 利百加的奶母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下邊橡樹底下；那棵樹名叫亞倫巴古。
english: And Deborah, the servant who had taken care of Rebekah from her birth, came to her end, and was put to rest near Beth-el, under the holy tree: and they gave it the name of Allon-bacuth.

chinese: 雅各從巴旦亞蘭回來，神又向他顯現，賜福與他，
english: Now when Jacob was on his way from Paddan-aram, God came to him again and, blessing him, said,

chinese: 且對他說：你的名原是雅各，從今以後不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。這樣，他就改名叫以色列。
english: Jacob is your name, but it will be so no longer; from now your name will be Israel; so he was named Israel.

chinese: 神又對他說：我是全能的神；你要生養眾多，將來有一族和多國的民從你而生，又有君王從你而出。
english: And God said to him, I am God, the Ruler of all: be fertile, and have increase; a nation, truly a group of nations, will come from you, and kings will be your offspring;

chinese: 我所賜給亞伯拉罕和以撒的地，我要賜給你與你的後裔。
english: And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give to you; and to your seed after you I will give the land.

chinese: 神就從那與雅各說話的地方升上去了。
english: Then God went up from him in the place where he had been talking with him.

chinese: 雅各便在那裡立了一根石柱，在柱子上奠酒，澆油。
english: And Jacob put up a pillar in the place where he had been talking with God, and put a drink offering on it, and oil.

chinese: 雅各就給那地方起名叫伯特利。
english: And he gave to the place where God had been talking with him, the name of Beth-el.

chinese: 他們從伯特利起行，離以法他還有一段路程，拉結臨產甚是艱難。
english: So they went on from Beth-el; and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, the pains of birth came on Rachel and she had a hard time.

chinese: 正在艱難的時候，收生婆對他說：不要怕，你又要得一個兒子了。
english: And when her pain was very great, the woman who was helping her said, Have no fear; for now you will have another son.

chinese: 他將近於死，靈魂要走的時候，就給他兒子起名叫便俄尼；他父親卻給他起名叫便雅憫。
english: And in the hour when her life went from her (for death came to her), she gave the child the name Ben-oni: but his father gave him the name of Benjamin.

chinese: 拉結死了，葬在以法他的路旁；以法他就是伯利恆。
english: So Rachel came to her end and was put to rest on the road to Ephrath (which is Beth-lehem).

chinese: 雅各在他的墳上立了一統碑，就是拉結的墓碑，到今日還在。
english: And Jacob put up a pillar on her resting-place; which is named, The Pillar of the resting-place of Rachel, to this day.

chinese: 以色列起行前往，在以得臺那邊支搭帳棚。
english: And Israel went journeying on and put up his tents on the other side of the tower of the flock.

chinese: 以色列住在那地的時候，流便去與他父親的妾辟拉同寢，以色列也聽見了。雅各共有十二個兒子。
english: Now while they were living in that country, Reuben had connection with Bilhah, his father's servant-woman: and Israel had news of it.

chinese: 利亞所生的是雅各的長子流便，還有西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、西布倫。
english: Now Jacob had twelve sons: the sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's first son, and Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Zebulun;

chinese: 拉結所生的是約瑟、便雅憫。
english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;

chinese: 拉結的使女辟拉所生的是但、拿弗他利。
english: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel's servant: Dan and Naphtali;

chinese: 利亞的使女悉帕所生的是迦得、亞設。這是雅各在巴旦亞蘭所生的兒子。
english: The sons of Zilpah, Leah's servant: Gad and Asher; these are the sons whom Jacob had in Paddan-aram.

chinese: 雅各來到他父親以撒那裡，到了基列亞巴的幔利，乃是亞伯拉罕和以撒寄居的地方；基列亞巴就是希伯崙。
english: And Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, at Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac had been living.

chinese: 以撒共活了一百八十歲。
english: And Isaac was a hundred and eighty years old.

chinese: 以撒年紀老邁，日子滿足，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖(原文作本民)那裡。他兩個兒子以掃、雅各把他埋葬了。
english: Then Isaac came to his end and was put to rest with his father's people, an old man after a long life: and Jacob and Esau, his sons, put him in his last resting-place.

chinese: 以掃就是以東，他的後代記在下面。
english: Now these are the generations of Esau, that is to say, Edom.

chinese: 以掃娶迦南的女子為妻，就是赫人以倫的女兒亞大和希未人祭便的孫女、亞拿的女兒阿何利巴瑪，
english: Esau's wives were women of Canaan: Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

chinese: 又娶了以實瑪利的女兒、尼拜約的妹子巴實抹。
english: And Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.

chinese: 亞大給以掃生了以利法；巴實抹生了流珥；
english: Adah had a son Eliphaz; and Basemath was the mother of Reuel;

chinese: 阿何利巴瑪生了耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。這都是以掃的兒子，是在迦南地生的。
english: Oholibamah was the mother of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah; these are the sons of Esau, whose birth took place in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 以掃帶著他的妻子、兒女，與家中一切的人口，並他的牛羊、牲畜，和一切貨財，就是他在迦南地所得的，往別處去，離了他兄弟雅各。
english: Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters, and all the people of his house, and his beasts and his cattle and all his goods which he had got together in the land of Canaan, and went into the land of Seir, away from his brother Jacob.

chinese: 因為二人的財物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他們，所以不能同居。
english: For their wealth was so great that the land was not wide enough for the two of them and all their cattle.

chinese: 於是以掃住在西珥山裡；以掃就是以東。
english: So Esau made his living-place in the hill-country of Seir (Esau is Edom).

chinese: 以掃是西珥山裡以東人的始祖，他的後代記在下面。
english: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of the Edomites in the hill-country of Seir:

chinese: 以掃眾子的名字如下。以掃的妻子亞大生以利法；以掃的妻子巴實抹生流珥。
english: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau's wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau's wife Basemath.

chinese: 以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯。
english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

chinese: 亭納是以掃兒子以利法的妾；他給以利法生了亞瑪力。這是以掃的妻子亞大的子孫。
english: And Eliphaz, the son of Esau, had connection with a woman named Timna, who gave birth to Amalek: all these were the children of Esau's wife Adah.

chinese: 流珥的兒子是拿哈、謝拉、沙瑪、米撒。這是以掃妻子巴實抹的子孫。
english: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: they were the children of Esau's wife Basemath.

chinese: 以掃的妻子阿何利巴瑪是祭便的孫女，亞拿的女兒；他給以掃生了耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。
english: And these are the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon: she was the mother of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

chinese: 以掃子孫中作族長的記在下面。以掃的長子以利法的子孫中，有提幔族長、阿抹族長、洗玻族長，基納斯族長、
english: These were the chiefs among the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz, Esau's first son: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

chinese: 可拉族長、迦坦族長、亞瑪力族長。這是在以東地從以利法所出的族長，都是亞大的子孫。
english: Korah, Gatam, Amalek: all these were chiefs in the land of Edom, the offspring of Eliphaz, the seed of Adah.

chinese: 以掃的兒子流珥的子孫中，有拿哈族長、謝拉族長、沙瑪族長、米撒族長。這是在以東地從流珥所出的族長，都是以掃妻子巴實抹的子孫。
english: And these are the sons of Esau's son Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, Mizzah: these were the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom, the children of Esau's wife Basemath.

chinese: 以掃的妻子阿何利巴瑪的子孫中，有耶烏施族長、雅蘭族長、可拉族長。這是從以掃妻子，亞拿的女兒，阿何利巴瑪子孫中所出的族長。
english: And these are the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah: these were the chiefs who came from Esau's wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah.

chinese: 以上的族長都是以掃的子孫；以掃就是以東。
english: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.

chinese: 那地原有的居民─何利人西珥的子孫記在下面：就是羅坍、朔巴、祭便、亞拿、
english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite who were living in that country; Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

chinese: 底順、以察、底珊。這是從以東地的何利人西珥子孫中所出的族長。
english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan: these are the chiefs of the Horites, offspring of Seir in the land of Edom.

chinese: 羅坍的兒子是何利、希幔；羅坍的妹子是亭納。
english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; Lotan's sister was Timna.

chinese: 朔巴的兒子是亞勒文、瑪拿轄、以巴錄、示玻、阿南。
english: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

chinese: 祭便的兒子是亞雅、亞拿〈當時在曠野放他父親祭便的驢，遇著溫泉的，就是這亞拿〉。
english: And these are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; that same Anah who made the discovery of the water-springs in the waste land, when he was looking after the asses of his father Zibeon.

chinese: 亞拿的兒子是底順；亞拿的女兒是阿何利巴瑪。
english: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah his daughter.

chinese: 底順的兒子是欣但、伊是班、益蘭、基蘭。
english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.

chinese: 以察的兒子是辟罕、撒番、亞干。
english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

chinese: 底珊的兒子是烏斯、亞蘭。
english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

chinese: 從何利人所出的族長記在下面：就是羅坍族長、朔巴族長、祭便族長、亞拿族長、
english: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

chinese: 底順族長、以察族長、底珊族長。這是從何利人所出的族長，都在西珥地，按著宗族作族長。
english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. Such were the Horite chiefs in their order in the land of Seir.

chinese: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以東地作王的記在下面。
english: And these are the kings who were ruling in the land of Edom before there was any king over the children of Israel.

chinese: 比珥的兒子比拉在以東作王，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
english: Bela, son of Beor, was king in Edom, and the name of his chief town was Dinhabah.

chinese: 比拉死了，波斯拉人謝拉的兒子約巴接續他作王。
english: At his death, Jobab, son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.

chinese: 約巴死了，提幔地的人戶珊接續他作王。
english: And at the death of Jobab, Husham, from the country of the Temanites, became king in his place.

chinese: 戶珊死了，比達的兒子哈達接續他作王；這哈達就是在摩押地殺敗米甸人的，他的京城名叫亞未得。
english: And at the death of Husham, Hadad, son of Bedad, who overcame the Midianites in the field of Moab, became king; his chief town was named Avith.

chinese: 哈達死了，瑪士利加人桑拉接續他作王。
english: And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king.

chinese: 桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接續他作王。
english: And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the River became king in his place.

chinese: 掃羅死了，亞革波的兒子巴勒哈南接續他作王。
english: And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, son of Achbor, became king.

chinese: 亞革波的兒子巴勒哈南死了，哈達接續他作王，他的京城名叫巴烏；他的妻子名叫米希他別，是米薩合的孫女，瑪特列的女兒。
english: And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadar became king in his place; his chief town was named Pau, and his wife's name was Mehetabel; she was the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

chinese: 從以掃所出的族長，按著他們的宗族、住處、名字記在下面：就是亭納族長、亞勒瓦族長、耶帖族長、
english: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau in the order of their families and their places: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

chinese: 阿何利巴瑪族長、以拉族長、比嫩族長、
english: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

chinese: 基納斯族長、提幔族長、米比薩族長、
english: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

chinese: 瑪基疊族長、以蘭族長。這是以東人在所得為業的地上，按著他們的住處。〈所有的族長都是以東人的始祖以掃的後代。〉
english: Magdiel, Iram; these are the Edomite chiefs, in their places in their heritage; this is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

chinese: 雅各住在迦南地，就是他父親寄居的地。
english: Now Jacob was living in the land where his father had made a place for himself, in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 雅各的記略如下。約瑟十七歲與他哥哥們一同牧羊。他是個童子，與他父親的妾辟拉、悉帕的兒子們常在一處。約瑟將他哥哥們的惡行報給他們的父親。
english: These are the generations of Jacob: Joseph, a boy seventeen years old, was looking after the flock, together with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father's wives; and Joseph gave their father a bad account of them.

chinese: 以色列原來愛約瑟過於愛他的眾子，因為約瑟是他年老生的；他給約瑟做了一件彩衣。
english: Now the love which Israel had for Joseph was greater than his love for all his other children, because he got him when he was an old man: and he had a long coat made for him.

chinese: 約瑟的哥哥們見父親愛約瑟過於愛他們，就恨約瑟，不與他說和睦的話。
english: And because his brothers saw that Joseph was dearer to his father than all the others, they were full of hate for him, and would not say a kind word to him.

chinese: 約瑟做了一夢，告訴他哥哥們，他們就越發恨他。
english: Now Joseph had a dream, and he gave his brothers an account of it, which made their hate greater than ever.

chinese: 約瑟對他們說：請聽我所做的夢：
english: And he said to them, Let me give you the story of my dream.

chinese: 我們在田裡捆禾稼，我的捆起來站著，你們的捆來圍著我的捆下拜。
english: We were in the field, getting the grain stems together, and my grain kept upright, and yours came round and went down on the earth before mine.

chinese: 他的哥哥們回答說：難道你真要作我們的王麼？難道你真要管轄我們麼？他們就因為他的夢和他的話越發恨他。
english: And his brothers said to him, Are you to be our king? will you have authority over us? And because of his dream and his words, their hate for him became greater than ever.

chinese: 後來他又做了一夢，也告訴他的哥哥們說：看哪，我又做了一夢，夢見太陽、月亮，與十一個星向我下拜。
english: Then he had another dream, and gave his brothers an account of it, saying, I have had another dream: the sun and the moon and eleven stars gave honour to me.

chinese: 約瑟將這夢告訴他父親和他哥哥們，他父親就責備他說：你做的這是甚麼夢！難道我和你母親、你弟兄果然要來俯伏在地，向你下拜麼？
english: And he gave word of it to his father and his brothers; but his father protesting said, What sort of a dream is this? am I and your mother and your brothers to go down on our faces to the earth before you?

chinese: 他哥哥們都嫉妒他，他父親卻把這話存在心裡。
english: And his brothers were full of envy; but his father kept his words in mind.

chinese: 約瑟的哥哥們往示劍去放他們父親的羊。
english: Now his brothers went to keep watch over their father's flock in Shechem.

chinese: 以色列對約瑟說：你哥哥們不是在示劍放羊麼？你來，我要打發你往他們那裡去。約瑟說：我在這裡。
english: And Israel said to Joseph, Are not your brothers with the flock in Shechem? come, I will send you to them. And he said to him, Here am I.

chinese: 以色列說：你去看看你哥哥們平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回來報信給我；於是打發他出希伯崙谷，他就往示劍去了。
english: And he said to him, Go now, and see if your brothers are well and how the flock is; then come back and give me word. So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

chinese: 有人遇見他在田野走迷了路，就問他說：你找甚麼？
english: And a man saw him wandering in the country, and said to him, What are you looking for?

chinese: 他說：我找我的哥哥們，求你告訴我，他們在何處放羊。
english: And he said, I am looking for my brothers; please give me word of where they are keeping their flock.

chinese: 那人說：他們已經走了，我聽見他們說要往多坍去。約瑟就去追趕他哥哥們，遇見他們在多坍。
english: And the man said, They have gone away from here, for they said in my hearing, Let us go to Dothan. So Joseph went after them and came up with them at Dothan.

chinese: 他們遠遠地看見他，趁他還沒有走到跟前，大家就同謀要害死他，
english: But they saw him when he was a long way off, and before he came near them they made a secret design against him to put him to death;

chinese: 彼此說：你看！那做夢的來了。
english: Saying to one another, See, here comes this dreamer.

chinese: 來罷！我們將他殺了，丟在一個坑裡，就說有惡獸把他吃了。我們且看他的夢將來怎麼樣。
english: Let us now put him to death and put his body into one of these holes, and we will say, An evil beast has put him to death: then we will see what becomes of his dreams.

chinese: 流便聽見了，要救他脫離他們的手，說：我們不可害他的性命；
english: But Reuben, hearing these words, got him out of their hands, saying, Let us not take his life.

chinese: 又說：不可流他的血，可以把他丟在這野地的坑裡，不可下手害他。流便的意思是要救他脫離他們的手，把他歸還他的父親。
english: Do not put him to a violent death, but let him be placed in one of the holes; this he said to keep him safe from their hands, with the purpose of taking him back to his father again.

chinese: 約瑟到了他哥哥們那裡，他們就剝了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，
english: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they took off his long coat which he had on;

chinese: 把他丟在坑裡；那坑是空的，裡頭沒有水。
english: And they took him and put him in the hole: now the hole had no water in it.

chinese: 他們坐下吃飯，舉目觀看，見有一夥米甸的以實瑪利人從基列來，用駱駝馱著香料、乳香、沒藥，要帶下埃及去。
english: Then seating themselves, they took their meal: and looking up, they saw a travelling band of Ishmaelites, coming from Gilead on their way to Egypt, with spices and perfumes on their camels.

chinese: 猶大對眾弟兄說：我們殺我們的兄弟，藏了他的血有甚麼益處呢？
english: And Judah said to his brothers, What profit is there in putting our brother to death and covering up his blood?

chinese: 我們不如將他賣給以實瑪利人，不可下手害他；因為他是我們的兄弟，我們的骨肉。眾弟兄就聽從了他。
english: Let us give him to these Ishmaelites for a price, and let us not put violent hands on him, for he is our brother, our flesh. And his brothers gave ear to him.

chinese: 有些米甸的商人從那裡經過，哥哥們就把約瑟從坑裡拉上來，講定二十舍客勒銀子，把約瑟賣給以實瑪利人。他們就把約瑟帶到埃及去了。
english: And some traders from Midian went by; so pulling Joseph up out of the hole, they gave him to the Ishmaelites for twenty bits of silver, and they took him to Egypt.

chinese: 流便回到坑邊，見約瑟不在坑裡，就撕裂衣服，
english: Now when Reuben came back to the hole, Joseph was not there; and giving signs of grief,

chinese: 回到兄弟們那裡，說：童子沒有了。我往那裡去才好呢？
english: He went back to his brothers, and said, The child is gone; what am I to do?

chinese: 他們宰了一隻公山羊，把約瑟的那件彩衣染了血，
english: Then they took Joseph's coat, and put on it some of the blood from a young goat which they had put to death,

chinese: 打發人送到他們的父親那裡，說：我們撿了這個；請認一認是你兒子的外衣不是？
english: And they took the coat to their father, and said, We came across this; is it your son's coat or not?

chinese: 他認得，就說：這是我兒子的外衣。有惡獸把他吃了，約瑟被撕碎了！撕碎了！
english: And he saw that it was, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast has put him to death; without doubt Joseph has come to a cruel end.

chinese: 雅各便撕裂衣服，腰間圍上麻布，為他兒子悲哀了多日。
english: Then Jacob, giving signs of grief, put on haircloth, and went on weeping for his son day after day.

chinese: 他的兒女都起來安慰他，他卻不肯受安慰，說：我必悲哀著下陰間，到我兒子那裡。約瑟的父親就為他哀哭。
english: And all his sons and all his daughters came to give him comfort, but he would not be comforted, saying with weeping, I will go down to the underworld to my son. So great was his father's sorrow for him.

chinese: 米甸人帶約瑟到埃及，把他賣給法老的內臣─護衛長波提乏。
english: And in Egypt the men of Midian gave him for a price to Potiphar, a captain of high position in Pharaoh's house.

chinese: 那時，猶大離開他弟兄下去，到一個亞杜蘭人名叫希拉的家裡去。
english: Now at that time, Judah went away from his brothers and became the friend of a man of Adullam named Hirah.

chinese: 猶大在那裡看見一個迦南人名叫書亞的女兒，就娶他為妻，與他同房，
english: And there he saw the daughter of a certain man of Canaan named Shua, and took her as his wife.

chinese: 他就懷孕生了兒子，猶大給他起名叫珥。
english: And she gave birth to a son, and he gave him the name Er.

chinese: 他又懷孕生了兒子，母親給他起名叫俄南。
english: And again she gave birth to a son, and he gave him the name Onan.

chinese: 他復又生了兒子，給他起名叫示拉。他生示拉的時候，猶大正在基悉。
english: Then she had another son, to whom she gave the name Shelah; she was at Chezib when the birth took place.

chinese: 猶大為長子珥娶妻，名叫他瑪。
english: And Judah took a wife for his first son Er, and her name was Tamar.

chinese: 猶大的長子珥在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華就叫他死了。
english: Now Er, Judah's first son, did evil in the eyes of the Lord, so that he put him to death.

chinese: 猶大對俄南說：你當與你哥哥的妻子同房，向他盡你為弟的本分，為你哥哥生子立後。
english: Then Judah said to Onan, Go in to your brother's wife and do what it is right for a husband's brother to do; make her your wife and get offspring for your brother.

chinese: 俄南知道生子不歸自己，所以同房的時候便遺在地，免得給他哥哥留後。
english: But Onan, seeing that the offspring would not be his, went in to his brother's wife, but let his seed go on to the earth, so that he might not get offspring for his brother.

chinese: 俄南所做的在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華也就叫他死了。
english: And what he did was evil in the eyes of the Lord, so that he put him to death, like his brother.

chinese: 猶大心裡說：恐怕示拉也死，像他兩個哥哥一樣，就對他兒婦他瑪說：你去，在你父親家裡守寡，等我兒子示拉長大。他瑪就回去，住在他父親家裡。
english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, Go back to your father's house and keep yourself as a widow till my son Shelah becomes a man: for he had in his mind the thought that death might come to him as it had come to his brothers. So Tamar went back to her father's house.

chinese: 過了許久，猶大的妻子書亞的女兒死了。猶大得了安慰，就和他朋友亞杜蘭人希拉上亭拿去，到他剪羊毛的人那裡。
english: And after a time, Bath-shua, Judah's wife, came to her end; and after Judah was comforted for her loss, he went to Timnah, where they were cutting the wool of his sheep, and his friend Hirah of Adullam went with him.

chinese: 有人告訴他瑪說：你的公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。
english: And when Tamar had news that her father-in-law was going up to Timnah to the wool-cutting,

chinese: 他瑪見示拉已經長大，還沒有娶他為妻，就脫了他作寡婦的衣裳，用帕子蒙著臉，又遮住身體，坐在亭拿路上的伊拿印城門口。
english: She took off her widow's clothing, and covering herself with her veil, she took her seat near Enaim on the road to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was now a man, but she had not been made his wife.

chinese: 猶大看見他，以為是妓女，因為他蒙著臉。
english: When Judah saw her he took her to be a loose woman of the town, because her face was covered.

chinese: 猶大就轉到他那裡去，說：來罷！讓我與你同寢。他原不知道是他的兒婦。他瑪說：你要與我同寢，把甚麼給我呢？
english: And turning to her by the roadside, he said to her, Let me come in to you; for he had no idea that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, What will you give me as my price?

chinese: 猶大說：我從羊群裡取一隻山羊羔，打發人送來給你。他瑪說：在未送以先，你願意給我一個當頭麼？
english: And he said, I will give you a young goat from the flock. And she said, What will you give me as a sign till you send it?

chinese: 他說：我給你甚麼當頭呢？他瑪說：你的印、你的帶子，和你手裡的杖。猶大就給了他，與他同寢，他就從猶大懷了孕。
english: And he said, What would you have? And she said, Your ring and its cord and the stick in your hand. So he gave them to her and went in to her, and she became with child by him.

chinese: 他瑪起來走了，除去帕子，仍舊穿上作寡婦的衣裳。
english: Then she got up and went away and took off her veil and put on her widow's clothing.

chinese: 猶大託他朋友亞杜蘭人送一隻山羊羔去，要從那女人手裡取回當頭來，卻找不著他，
english: Then Judah sent his friend Hirah with the young goat, to get back the things which he had given as a sign to the woman: but she was not there.

chinese: 就問那地方的人說：伊拿印路旁的妓女在那裡？他們說：這裡並沒有妓女。
english: And he put questions to the men of the place, saying, Where is the loose woman who was in Enaim by the wayside? And they said, There was no such woman there.

chinese: 他回去見猶大說：我沒有找著他，並且那地方的人說：這裡沒有妓女。
english: So he went back to Judah, and said, I have not seen her, and the men of the place say that there is no such woman there.

chinese: 猶大說：我把這山羊羔送去了，你竟找不著他。任憑他拿去罷，免得我們被羞辱。
english: And Judah said, Let her keep the things, so that we may not be shamed; I sent the young goat, but you did not see the woman.

chinese: 約過了三個月，有人告訴猶大說：你的兒婦他瑪作了妓女，且因行淫有了身孕。猶大說：拉出他來，把他燒了！
english: Now about three months after this, word came to Judah that Tamar, his daughter-in-law, had been acting like a loose woman and was with child. And Judah said, Take her out and let her be burned.

chinese: 他瑪被拉出來的時候便打發人去見他公公，對他說：這些東西是誰的，我就是從誰懷的孕。請你認一認，這印和帶子並杖都是誰的？
english: And while she was being taken out, she sent word to her father-in-law, saying, The man whose property these things are, is the father of my child: say then, whose are this ring and this cord and this stick?

chinese: 猶大承認說：他比我更有義，因為我沒有將他給我的兒子示拉。從此猶大不再與他同寢了。
english: Then Judah said openly that they were his, and said, She is more upright than I am, for I did not give her to Shelah my son. And he had no more connection with her.

chinese: 他瑪將要生產，不料他腹裡是一對雙生。
english: And when the time came for her to give birth, it was clear that there were two children in her body.

chinese: 到生產的時候，一個孩子伸出一隻手來；收生婆拿紅線拴在他手上，說：這是頭生的。
english: And while she was in the act of giving birth, one of them put out his hand; and the woman who was with her put a red thread round his hand, saying, This one came out first.

chinese: 隨後這孩子把手收回去，他哥哥生出來了；收生婆說：你為甚麼搶著來呢？因此給他起名叫法勒斯。
english: But then he took his hand back again, and his brother came first to birth: and the woman said, What an opening you have made for yourself! So he was named Perez.

chinese: 後來，他兄弟那手上有紅線的也生出來，就給他起名叫謝拉。
english: And then his brother came out, with the red thread round his hand, and he was named Zerah.

chinese: 約瑟被帶下埃及去。有一個埃及人，是法老的內臣─護衛長波提乏，從那些帶下他來的以實瑪利人手下買了他去。
english: Now Joseph was taken down to Egypt; and Potiphar the Egyptian, a captain of high position in Pharaoh's house, got him for a price from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.

chinese: 約瑟住在他主人埃及人的家中，耶和華與他同在，他就百事順利。
english: And the Lord was with Joseph, and he did well; and he was living in the house of his master the Egyptian.

chinese: 他主人見耶和華與他同在，又見耶和華使他手裡所辦的盡都順利，
english: And his master saw that the Lord was with him, making everything he did go well.

chinese: 約瑟就在主人眼前蒙恩，伺候他主人，並且主人派他管理家務，把一切所有的都交在他手裡。
english: And having a high opinion of Joseph as his servant, he made him the overseer of his house and gave him control over all he had.

chinese: 自從主人派約瑟管理家務和他一切所有的，耶和華就因約瑟的緣故賜福與那埃及人的家；凡家裡和田間一切所有的都蒙耶和華賜福。
english: And from the time when he made him overseer and gave him control of all his property, the blessing of the Lord was with the Egyptian, because of Joseph; the blessing of the Lord was on all he had, in the house and in the field.

chinese: 波提乏將一切所有的都交在約瑟的手中，除了自己所吃的飯，別的事一概不知。約瑟原來秀雅俊美。
english: And he gave Joseph control of all his property, keeping no account of anything, but only the food which was put before him. Now Joseph was very beautiful in form and face.

chinese: 這事以後，約瑟主人的妻以目送情給約瑟，說：你與我同寢罷！
english: And after a time, his master's wife, looking on Joseph with desire, said to him, Be my lover.

chinese: 約瑟不從，對他主人的妻說：看哪，一切家務，我主人都不知道；他把所有的都交在我手裡。
english: But he would not, and said to her, You see that my master keeps no account of what I do in his house, and has put all his property in my control;

chinese: 在這家裡沒有比我大的；並且他沒有留下一樣不交給我，只留下了你，因為你是他的妻子。我怎能作這大惡，得罪神呢？
english: So that no one has more authority in this house than I have; he has kept nothing back from me but you, because you are his wife; how then may I do this great wrong, sinning against God?

chinese: 後來他天天和約瑟說，約瑟卻不聽從他，不與他同寢，也不和他在一處。
english: And day after day she went on requesting Joseph to come to her and be her lover, but he would not give ear to her.

chinese: 有一天，約瑟進屋裡去辦事，家中人沒有一個在那屋裡，
english: Now one day he went into the house to do his work; and not one of the men of the house was inside.

chinese: 婦人就拉住他的衣裳，說：你與我同寢罷！約瑟把衣裳丟在婦人手裡，跑到外邊去了。
english: And pulling at his coat, she said, Come to my bed; but slipping out of his coat, he went running away.

chinese: 婦人看見約瑟把衣裳丟在他手裡跑出去了，
english: And when she saw that he had got away, letting her keep his coat,

chinese: 就叫了家裡的人來，對他們說：你們看！他帶了一個希伯來人進入我們家裡，要戲弄我們。他到我這裡來，要與我同寢，我就大聲喊叫。
english: She sent for the men of her house and said to them, See, he has let a Hebrew come here and make sport of us; he came to my bed, and I gave a loud cry;

chinese: 他聽見我放聲喊起來，就把衣裳丟在我這裡，跑到外邊去了。
english: And hearing it he went running out without his coat.

chinese: 婦人把約瑟的衣裳放在自己那裡，等著他主人回家，
english: And she kept his coat by her, till his master came back.

chinese: 就對他如此如此說：你所帶到我們這裡的那希伯來僕人進來要戲弄我，
english: Then she gave him the same story, saying, The Hebrew servant whom you have taken into our house came in to make sport of me;

chinese: 我放聲喊起來，他就把衣裳丟在我這裡，跑出去了。
english: And when I gave a loud cry he went running out without his coat.

chinese: 約瑟的主人聽見他妻子對他所說的話，說：你的僕人如此如此待我，他就生氣，
english: And hearing his wife's account of what his servant had done, he became very angry.

chinese: 把約瑟下在監裡，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。於是約瑟在那裡坐監。
english: And Joseph's master took him and put him in prison, in the place where the king's prisoners were kept in chains, and he was there in the prison-house.

chinese: 但耶和華與約瑟同在，向他施恩，使他在司獄的眼前蒙恩。
english: But the Lord was with Joseph, and was good to him, and made the keeper of the prison his friend.

chinese: 司獄就把監裡所有的囚犯都交在約瑟手下；他們在那裡所辦的事都是經他的手。
english: And the keeper of the prison put all the prisoners under Joseph's control, and he was responsible for whatever was done there.

chinese: 凡在約瑟手下的事，司獄一概不察，因為耶和華與約瑟同在；耶和華使他所做的盡都順利。
english: And the keeper of the prison gave no attention to anything which was under his care, because the Lord was with him; and the Lord made everything he did go well.

chinese: 這事以後，埃及王的酒政和膳長得罪了他們的主─埃及王，
english: Now after these things the chief servant who had the care of the wine, and the chief bread-maker in Pharaoh's house, did something against Pharaoh's orders;

chinese: 法老就惱怒酒政和膳長這二臣，
english: And Pharaoh was angry with his two servants, with the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker;

chinese: 把他們下在護衛長府內的監裡，就是約瑟被囚的地方。
english: And he put them in prison under the care of the captain of the army, in the same prison where Joseph himself was shut up.

chinese: 護衛長把他們交給約瑟，約瑟便伺候他們；他們有些日子在監裡。
english: And the captain put them in Joseph's care, and he did what was needed for them; and they were kept in prison for some time.

chinese: 被囚在監之埃及王的酒政和膳長二人同夜各做一夢，各夢都有講解。
english: And these two had a dream on the same night; the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker of the king of Egypt, who were in prison, the two of them had dreams with a special sense.

chinese: 到了早晨，約瑟進到他們那裡，見他們有愁悶的樣子。
english: And in the morning when Joseph came to them he saw that they were looking sad.

chinese: 他便問法老的二臣，就是與他同囚在他主人府裡的，說：他們今日為甚麼面帶愁容呢？
english: And he said to the servants of Pharaoh who were in prison with him, Why are you looking so sad?

chinese: 他們對他說：我們各人做了一夢，沒有人能解。約瑟說：解夢不是出於神麼？請你們將夢告訴我。
english: Then they said to him, We have had a dream, and no one is able to give us the sense. And Joseph said, Does not the sense of dreams come from God? what was your dream?

chinese: 酒政便將他的夢告訴約瑟說：我夢見在我面前有一棵葡萄樹，
english: Then the chief wine-servant gave Joseph an account of his dream, and said, In my dream I saw a vine before me;

chinese: 樹上有三根枝子，好像發了芽，開了花，上頭的葡萄都成熟了。
english: And on the vine were three branches; and it seemed as if it put out buds and flowers, and from them came grapes ready for cutting.

chinese: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄擠在法老的杯裡，將杯遞在他手中。
english: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes and crushing them into Pharaoh's cup, gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

chinese: 約瑟對他說：他所做的夢是這樣解：三根枝子就是三天；
english: Then Joseph said, This is the sense of your dream: the three branches are three days;

chinese: 三天之內，法老必提你出監，叫你官復原職，你仍要遞杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一樣。
english: After three days Pharaoh will give you honour, and put you back into your place, and you will give him his cup as you did before, when you were his wine-servant.

chinese: 但你得好處的時候，求你記念我，施恩與我，在法老面前題說我，救我出這監牢。
english: But keep me in mind when things go well for you, and be good to me and say a good word for me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison:

chinese: 我實在是從希伯來人之地被拐來的；我在這裡也沒有做過甚麼，叫他們把我下在監裡。
english: For truly I was taken by force from the land of the Hebrews; and I have done nothing for which I might be put in prison.

chinese: 膳長見夢解得好，就對約瑟說：我在夢中見我頭上頂著三筐白餅；
english: Now when the chief bread-maker saw that the first dream had a good sense, he said to Joseph, I had a dream; and in my dream there were three baskets of white bread on my head;

chinese: 極上的筐子裡有為法老烤的各樣食物，有飛鳥來吃我頭上筐子裡的食物。
english: And in the top basket were all sorts of cooked meats for Pharaoh; and the birds were taking them out of the baskets on my head.

chinese: 約瑟說：你的夢是這樣解：三個筐子就是三天；
english: Then Joseph said, This is the sense of your dream: the three baskets are three days;

chinese: 三天之內，法老必斬斷你的頭，把你掛在木頭上，必有飛鳥來吃你身上的肉。
english: After three days Pharaoh will take you out of prison, hanging you on a tree, so that your flesh will be food for birds.

chinese: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他為眾臣僕設擺筵席，把酒政和膳長提出監來，
english: Now the third day was Pharaoh's birthday, and he gave a feast for all his servants; and he gave honour to the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker among the others.

chinese: 使酒政官復原職，他仍舊遞杯在法老手中；
english: And he put the chief wine-servant back in his old place; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

chinese: 但把膳長掛起來，正如約瑟向他們所解的話。
english: But the chief bread-maker was put to death by hanging, as Joseph had said.

chinese: 酒政卻不記念約瑟，竟忘了他。
english: But the wine-servant did not keep Joseph in mind or give a thought to him.

chinese: 過了兩年，法老做夢，夢見自己站在河邊，
english: Now after two years had gone by, Pharaoh had a dream; and in his dream he was by the side of the Nile;

chinese: 有七隻母牛從河裡上來，又美好又肥壯，在蘆荻中吃草。
english: And out of the Nile came seven cows, good-looking and fat, and their food was the river-grass.

chinese: 隨後又有七隻母牛從河裡上來，又醜陋又乾瘦，與那七隻母牛一同站在河邊。
english: And after them seven other cows came out of the Nile, poor-looking and thin; and they were by the side of the other cows.

chinese: 這又醜陋又乾瘦的七隻母牛吃盡了那又美好又肥壯的七隻母牛。法老就醒了。
english: And the seven thin cows made a meal of the seven fat cows. Then Pharaoh came out of his sleep.

chinese: 他又睡著，第二回做夢，夢見一棵麥子長了七個穗子，又肥大又佳美，
english: But he went to sleep again and had a second dream, in which he saw seven heads of grain, full and good, all on one stem.

chinese: 隨後又長了七個穗子，又細弱又被東風吹焦了。
english: And after them came up seven other heads, thin and wasted by the east wind.

chinese: 這細弱的穗子吞了那七個又肥大又飽滿的穗子。法老醒了，不料是個夢。
english: And the seven thin heads made a meal of the good heads. And when Pharaoh was awake he saw it was a dream.

chinese: 到了早晨，法老心裡不安，就差人召了埃及所有的術士和博士來；法老就把所做的夢告訴他們，卻沒有人能給法老圓解。
english: And in the morning his spirit was troubled; and he sent for all the wise men of Egypt and all the holy men, and put his dream before them, but no one was able to give him the sense of it.

chinese: 那時酒政對法老說：我今日想起我的罪來。
english: Then the chief wine-servant said to Pharaoh, The memory of my sin comes back to me now;

chinese: 從前法老惱怒臣僕，把我和膳長下在護衛長府內的監裡。
english: Pharaoh had been angry with his servants, and had put me in prison in the house of the captain of the army, together with the chief bread-maker;

chinese: 我們二人同夜各做一夢，各夢都有講解。
english: And we had a dream on the same night, the two of us, and the dreams had a special sense.

chinese: 在那裡同著我們有一個希伯來的少年人，是護衛長的僕人，我們告訴他，他就把我們的夢圓解，是按著各人的夢圓解的。
english: And there was with us a young Hebrew, the captain's servant, and when we put our dreams before him, he gave us the sense of them.

chinese: 後來正如他給我們圓解的成就了；我官復原職，膳長被掛起來了。
english: And it came about as he said: I was put back in my place, and the bread-maker was put to death by hanging.

chinese: 法老遂即差人去召約瑟，他們便急忙帶他出監，他就剃頭，刮臉，換衣裳，進到法老面前。
english: Then Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and they took him quickly out of prison; and when his hair had been cut and his dress changed, he came before Pharaoh.

chinese: 法老對約瑟說：我做了一夢，沒有人能解；我聽見人說，你聽了夢就能解。
english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I have had a dream, and no one is able to give me the sense of it; now it has come to my ears that you are able to give the sense of a dream when it is put before you.

chinese: 約瑟回答法老說：這不在乎我，神必將平安的話回答法老。
english: Then Joseph said, Without God there will be no answer of peace for Pharaoh.

chinese: 法老對約瑟說：我夢見我站在河邊，
english: Then Pharaoh said, In my dream I was by the side of the Nile:

chinese: 有七隻母牛從河裡上來，又肥壯又美好，在蘆荻中吃草。
english: And out of the Nile came seven cows, fat and good-looking, and their food was the river-grass;

chinese: 隨後又有七隻母牛上來，又軟弱又醜陋又乾瘦，在埃及遍地，我沒有見過這樣不好的。
english: Then after them came seven other cows, very thin and poor-looking, worse than any I ever saw in the land of Egypt;

chinese: 這又乾瘦又醜陋的母牛吃盡了那以先的七隻肥母牛，
english: And the thin cows made a meal of the seven fat cows who came up first;

chinese: 吃了以後卻看不出是吃了，那醜陋的樣子仍舊和先前一樣。我就醒了。
english: And even with the fat cows inside them they seemed as bad as before. And so I came out of my sleep.

chinese: 我又夢見一棵麥子，長了七個穗子，又飽滿又佳美，
english: And again in a dream I saw seven heads of grain, full and good, coming up on one stem:

chinese: 隨後又長了七個穗子，枯槁細弱，被東風吹焦了。
english: And then I saw seven other heads, dry, thin, and wasted by the east wind, coming up after them:

chinese: 這些細弱的穗子吞了那七個佳美的穗子。我將這夢告訴了術士，卻沒有人能給我解說。
english: And the seven thin heads made a meal of the seven good heads; and I put this dream before the wise men, but not one of them was able to give me the sense of it.

chinese: 約瑟對法老說：法老的夢乃是一個。神已將所要做的事指示法老了。
english: Then Joseph said, These two dreams have the same sense: God has made clear to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

chinese: 七隻好母牛是七年，七個好穗子也是七年；這夢乃是一個。
english: The seven fat cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years: the two have the same sense.

chinese: 那隨後上來的七隻又乾瘦又醜陋的母牛是七年，那七個虛空、被東風吹焦的穗子也是七年，都是七個荒年。
english: The seven thin and poor-looking cows who came up after them are seven years; and the seven heads of grain, dry and wasted by the east wind, are seven years when there will be no food.

chinese: 這就是我對法老所說，神已將所要做的事顯明給法老了。
english: As I said to Pharaoh before, God has made clear to him what he is about to do.

chinese: 埃及遍地必來七個大豐年，
english: Seven years are coming in which there will be great wealth of grain in Egypt;

chinese: 隨後又要來七個荒年，甚至埃及地都忘了先前的豐收，全地必被饑荒所滅。
english: And after that will come seven years when there will not be enough food; and the memory of the good years will go from men's minds; and the land will be made waste by the bad years;

chinese: 因那以後的饑荒甚大，便不覺得先前的豐收了。
english: And men will have no memory of the good time because of the need which will come after, for it will be very bitter.

chinese: 至於法老兩回做夢，是因神命定這事，而且必速速成就。
english: And this dream came to Pharaoh twice, because this thing is certain, and God will quickly make it come about.

chinese: 所以，法老當揀選一個有聰明有智慧的人，派他治理埃及地。
english: And now let Pharaoh make search for a man of wisdom and good sense, and put him in authority over the land of Egypt.

chinese: 法老當這樣行，又派官員管理這地。當七個豐年的時候，征收埃及地的五分之一，
english: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him put overseers over the land of Egypt to put in store a fifth part of the produce of the land in the good years.

chinese: 叫他們把將來豐年一切的糧食聚斂起來，積蓄五穀，收存在各城裡做食物，歸於法老的手下。
english: And let them get together all the food in those good years and make a store of grain under Pharaoh's control for the use of the towns, and let them keep it.

chinese: 所積蓄的糧食可以防備埃及地將來的七個荒年，免得這地被饑荒所滅。
english: And let that food be kept in store for the land till the seven bad years which are to come in Egypt; so that the land may not come to destruction through need of food.

chinese: 法老和他一切臣僕都以這事為妙。
english: And this seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his servants.

chinese: 法老對臣僕說：像這樣的人，有神的靈在他裡頭，我們豈能找得著呢？
english: Then Pharaoh said to his servants, Where may we get such a man as this, a man in whom is the spirit of God?

chinese: 法老對約瑟說：神既將這事都指示你，可見沒有人像你這樣有聰明有智慧。
english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Seeing that God has made all this clear to you, there is no other man of such wisdom and good sense as you:

chinese: 你可以掌管我的家；我的民都必聽從你的話。惟獨在寶座上我比你大。
english: You, then, are to be over my house, and all my people will be ruled by your word: only as king will I be greater than you.

chinese: 法老又對約瑟說：我派你治理埃及全地。
english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, See, I have put you over all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 法老就摘下手上打印的戒指，戴在約瑟的手上，給他穿上細麻衣，把金鍊戴在他的頸項上，
english: Then Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on Joseph's hand, and he had him clothed with the best linen, and put a chain of gold round his neck;

chinese: 又叫約瑟坐他的副車，喝道的在前呼叫說：跪下。這樣、法老派他治理埃及全地。
english: And he made him take his seat in the second of his carriages; and they went before him crying, Make way! So he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 法老對約瑟說：我是法老，在埃及全地，若沒有你的命令，不許人擅自辦事(原文作動手動腳)。
english: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh; and without your order no man may do anything in all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 法老賜名給約瑟，叫撒發那忒巴內亞，又將安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給他為妻。約瑟就出去巡行埃及地。
english: And Pharaoh gave Joseph the name of Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, the priest of On, to be his wife. So Joseph went through all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 約瑟見埃及王法老的時候年三十歲。他從法老面前出去，遍行埃及全地。
english: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he came before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from before the face of Pharaoh and went through all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 七個豐年之內，地的出產極豐極盛(原文作一把一把的)，
english: Now in the seven good years the earth gave fruit in masses.

chinese: 約瑟聚歛埃及地七個豐年一切的糧食，把糧食積存在各城裡；各城周圍田地的糧食都積存在本城裡。
english: And Joseph got together all the food of those seven years, and made a store of food in the towns: the produce of the fields round every town was stored up in the town.

chinese: 約瑟積蓄五穀甚多，如同海邊的沙，無法計算，因為穀不可勝數。
english: So he got together a store of grain like the sand of the sea; so great a store that after a time he gave up measuring it, for it might not be measured.

chinese: 荒年未到以前，安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給約瑟生了兩個兒子。
english: And before the time of need, Joseph had two sons, to whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On, gave birth.

chinese: 約瑟給長子起名叫瑪拿西(就是使之忘了的意思)，因為他說：神使我忘了一切的困苦和我父的全家。
english: And to the first he gave the name Manasseh, for he said, God has taken away from me all memory of my hard life and of my father's house.

chinese: 他給次子起名叫以法蓮(就是使之昌盛的意思)，因為他說：神使我在受苦的地方昌盛。
english: And to the second he gave the name Ephraim, for he said, God has given me fruit in the land of my sorrow.

chinese: 埃及地的七個豐年一完，
english: And so the seven good years in Egypt came to an end.

chinese: 七個荒年就來了。正如約瑟所說的，各地都有饑荒；惟獨埃及全地有糧食。
english: Then came the first of the seven years of need as Joseph had said: and in every other land they were short of food; but in the land of Egypt there was bread.

chinese: 及至埃及全地有了饑荒，眾民向法老哀求糧食，法老對他們說：你們往約瑟那裡去，凡他所說的，你們都要做。
english: And when all the land of Egypt was in need of food, the people came crying to Pharaoh for bread; and Pharaoh said to the people, Go to Joseph, and whatever he says to you, do it.

chinese: 當時饑荒遍滿天下，約瑟開了各處的倉，糶糧給埃及人；在埃及地饑荒甚大。
english: And everywhere on the earth they were short of food; then Joseph, opening all his store-houses, gave the people of Egypt grain for money; so great was the need of food in the land of Egypt.

chinese: 各地的人都往埃及去，到約瑟那裡糴糧，因為天下的饑荒甚大。
english: And all lands sent to Egypt, to Joseph, to get grain, for the need was great over all the earth.

chinese: 雅各見埃及有糧，就對兒子們說：你們為甚麼彼此觀望呢？
english: Now Jacob, hearing that there was grain in Egypt, said to his sons, Why are you looking at one another?

chinese: 我聽見埃及有糧，你們可以下去，從那裡為我們糴些來，使我們可以存活，不至於死。
english: And he said, I have had news that there is grain in Egypt: go down there and get grain for us, so that life and not death may be ours.

chinese: 於是，約瑟的十個哥哥都下埃及糴糧去了。
english: So Joseph's ten brothers went down to get grain from Egypt.

chinese: 但約瑟的兄弟便雅憫，雅各沒有打發他和哥哥們同去，因為雅各說：恐怕他遭害。
english: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, with them, for fear, as he said, that some evil might come to him.

chinese: 來糴糧的人中有以色列的兒子們，因為迦南地也有饑荒。
english: And the sons of Israel came with all the others to get grain: for they were very short of food in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 當時治理埃及地的是約瑟；糶糧給那地眾民的就是他。約瑟的哥哥們來了，臉伏於地，向他下拜。
english: Now Joseph was ruler over all the land, and it was he who gave out the grain to all the people of the land; and Joseph's brothers came before him and went down on their faces to the earth.

chinese: 約瑟看見他哥哥們，就認得他們，卻裝作生人，向他們說些嚴厲話，問他們說：你們從那裡來？他們說：我們從迦南地來糴糧。
english: And when Joseph saw his brothers, it was clear to him who they were, but he made himself strange to them, and talking roughly to them, said, Where do you come from? And they said, From the land of Canaan, to get food.

chinese: 約瑟認得他哥哥們，他們卻不認得他。
english: Now though Joseph saw that these were his brothers, they had no idea who he was.

chinese: 約瑟想起從前所做的那兩個夢，就對他們說：你們是奸細，來窺探這地的虛實。
english: Then the memory of his dreams about them came back to Joseph, and he said to them, You have come secretly to see how poor the land is.

chinese: 他們對他說：我主阿，不是的。僕人們是糴糧來的。
english: And they said to him, Not so, my lord: your servants have come with money to get food.

chinese: 我們都是一個人的兒子，是誠實人；僕人們並不是奸細。
english: We are all one man's sons, we are true men; we have not come with any secret purpose.

chinese: 約瑟說：不然，你們必是窺探這地的虛實來的。
english: And he said to them, No, but you have come to see how poor the land is.

chinese: 他們說：僕人們本是弟兄十二人，是迦南地一個人的兒子，頂小的現今在我們的父親那裡，有一個沒有了。
english: Then they said, We your servants are twelve brothers, sons of one man in the land of Canaan; the youngest of us is now with our father, and one is dead.

chinese: 約瑟說：我才說你們是奸細，這話實在不錯。
english: And Joseph said, It is as I said; you have come with some secret purpose;

chinese: 我指著法老的性命起誓，若是你們的小兄弟不到這裡，你們就不得出這地方，從此就可以把你們證驗出來了。
english: But in this way will you be put to the test: by the life of Pharaoh, you will not go away from this place till your youngest brother comes here.

chinese: 須要打發你們中間一個人去，把你們的兄弟帶來。至於你們，都要囚在這裡，好證驗你們的話真不真，若不真，我指著法老的性命起誓，你們一定是奸細。
english: Send one of your number to get your brother, and the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are true; if not, by the life of Pharaoh, your purpose is certainly secret.

chinese: 於是約瑟把他們都下在監裡三天。
english: So he put them in prison for three days.

chinese: 到了第三天，約瑟對他們說：我是敬畏神的；你們照我的話行就可以存活。
english: And on the third day Joseph said to them, Do this, if you would keep your lives: for I am a god-fearing man:

chinese: 你們如果是誠實人，可以留你們中間的一個人囚在監裡，但你們可以帶著糧食回去，救你們家裡的饑荒。
english: If you are true men, let one of you be kept in prison, while you go and take grain for the needs of your families;

chinese: 把你們的小兄弟帶到我這裡來，如此，你們的話便有證據，你們也不至於死。他們就照樣而行。
english: And come back to me with your youngest brother, so that your words may be seen to be true, and you will not be put to death. This is what you are to do.

chinese: 他們彼此說：我們在兄弟身上實在有罪。他哀求我們的時候，我們見他心裡的愁苦，卻不肯聽，所以這場苦難臨到我們身上。
english: And they said to one another, Truly, we did wrong to our brother, for we saw his grief of mind, and we did not give ear to his prayers; that is why this trouble has come on us.

chinese: 流便說：我豈不是對你們說過，不可傷害那孩子麼？只是你們不肯聽，所以流他血的罪向我們追討。
english: And Reuben said to them, Did I not say to you, Do the child no wrong? but you gave no attention; so now, punishment has come on us for his blood.

chinese: 他們不知道約瑟聽得出來，因為在他們中間用通事傳話。
english: They were not conscious that the sense of their words was clear to Joseph, for he had been talking to them through one who had knowledge of their language.

chinese: 約瑟轉身退去，哭了一場，又回來對他們說話，就從他們中間挑出西緬來，在他們眼前把他捆綁。
english: And turning away from them, he was overcome with weeping; then he went on talking to them again and took Simeon and put chains on him before their eyes.

chinese: 約瑟吩咐人把糧食裝滿他們的器具，把各人的銀子歸還在各人的口袋裡，又給他們路上用的食物，人就照他的話辦了。
english: Then Joseph gave orders for their bags to be made full of grain, and for every man's money to be put back into his bag, and for food to be given them for the journey: which was done.

chinese: 他們就把糧食馱在驢上，離開那裡去了。
english: Then they put the bags of grain on their asses and went away.

chinese: 到了住宿的地方，他們中間有一個人打開口袋，要拿料餵驢，才看見自己的銀子仍在口袋裡，
english: Now at their night's resting-place one of them, opening his bag to give his ass some food, saw his money in the mouth of the bag.

chinese: 就對弟兄們說：我的銀子歸還了，看哪，仍在我口袋裡！他們就提心吊膽，戰戰兢兢的彼此說：這是神向我們做甚麼呢？
english: And he said to his brothers, My money has been given back: it is in my bag; then their hearts became full of fear, and turning to one another they said, What is this which God has done to us?

chinese: 他們來到迦南地、他們的父親雅各那裡，將所遭遇的事都告訴他，說：
english: So when they came to Jacob their father, in the land of Canaan, they gave him an account of all their experiences, saying,

chinese: 那地的主對我們說嚴厲的話，把我們當作窺探那地的奸細。
english: The man who is the ruler of the country was rough with us and put us in prison, saying that we had come with a secret evil purpose.

chinese: 我們對他說：我們是誠實人，並不是奸細。
english: And we said to him, We are true men, we have no evil designs;

chinese: 我們本是弟兄十二人，都是一個父親的兒子，有一個沒有了，頂小的如今同我們的父親在迦南地。
english: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is dead, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 那地的主對我們說：若要我知道你們是誠實人，可以留下你們中間的一個人在我這裡，你們可以帶著糧食回去，救你們家裡的饑荒。
english: And the ruler of the land said, In this way I may be certain that you are true men; let one of you be kept here with me, while you go and take grain for the needs of your families;

chinese: 把你們的小兄弟帶到我這裡來，我便知道你們不是奸細，乃是誠實人。這樣，我就把你們的弟兄交給你們，你們也可以在這地做買賣。
english: And come back to me with your youngest brother: then I will be certain that you are true men, and I will give your brother back to you and let you do trade in the land.

chinese: 後來他們倒口袋，不料，各人的銀包都在口袋裡；他們和父親看見銀包就都害怕。
english: And when they took the grain out of their bags, it was seen that every man's parcel of money was in his bag; and when they and their father saw the money, they were full of fear.

chinese: 他們的父親雅各對他們說：你們使我喪失我的兒子：約瑟沒有了，西緬也沒有了，你們又要將便雅憫帶去；這些事都歸到我身上了。
english: And Jacob their father said to them, You have taken my children from me: Joseph is gone and Simeon is gone, and now you would take Benjamin away; all these things have come on me.

chinese: 流便對他父親說：我若不帶他回來交給你，你可以殺我的兩個兒子。只管把他交在我手裡，我必帶他回來交給你。
english: And Reuben said, Put my two sons to death if I do not come back to you with him; let him be in my care and I will give him safely back to you.

chinese: 雅各說：我的兒子不可與你們一同下去；他哥哥死了，只剩下他，他若在你們所行的路上遭害，那便是你們使我白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘的下陰間去了。
english: And he said, I will not let my son go down with you; for his brother is dead and he is all I have: if evil overtakes him on the journey, then through you will my grey head go down to the underworld in sorrow.

chinese: 那地的饑荒甚大。
english: Now the land was in bitter need of food.

chinese: 他們從埃及帶來的糧食吃盡了，他們的父親就對他們說：『你們再去給我糴些糧來。』
english: And when the grain which they had got in Egypt was all used up, their father said to them, Go again and get us a little food.

chinese: 猶大對他說：『那人諄諄地告誡我們說：「你們的兄弟若不與你們同來，你們就不得見我的面。」
english: And Judah said to him, The man said to us with an oath, You are not to come before me again without your brother.

chinese: 你若打發我們的兄弟與我們同去，我們就下去給你糴糧；
english: If you will let our brother go with us, we will go down and get food:

chinese: 你若不打發他去，我們就不下去，因為那人對我們說：「你們的兄弟若不與你們同來，你們就不得見我的面。」』
english: But if you will not send him, we will not go down: for the man said to us, You are not to come before me if your brother is not with you.

chinese: 以色列說：『你們為什麼這樣害我，告訴那人你們還有兄弟呢？』
english: And Israel said, Why were you so cruel to me as to say to him that you had a brother?

chinese: 他們回答說：『那人詳細問到我們和我們的親屬，說：「你們的父親還在嗎？你們還有兄弟嗎？」我們就按著他所問的告訴他，焉能知道他要說「必須把你們的兄弟帶下來」呢？』
english: And they said, The man put a number of questions to us about ourselves and our family, saying, Is your father still living? have you another brother? And we had to give him answers; how were we to have any idea that he would say, Come back with your brother?

chinese: 猶大又對他父親以色列說：『你打發童子與我同去，我們就起身下去，好叫我們和你，並我們的婦人孩子，都得存活，不至於死。
english: Then Judah said to Israel, his father, Send the boy with me, and let us be up and going, so that we and you and our little ones may not come to destruction.

chinese: 我為他作保；你可以從我手中追討，我若不帶他回來交在你面前，我情願永遠擔罪。
english: Put him into my care and make me responsible for him: if I do not give him safely back to you, let mine be the sin for ever.

chinese: 我們若沒有耽擱，如今第二次都回來了。』
english: Truly, if we had not let the time go by, we might have come back again by now.

chinese: 他們的父親以色列說：『若必須如此，你們就當這樣行：可以將這地土產中最好的乳香、蜂蜜、香料、沒藥、榧子、杏仁都取一點，收在器具裡，帶下去送給那人作禮物，
english: Then their father Israel said to them, If it has to be so, then do this: take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels to give the man, perfumes and honey and spices and nuts:

chinese: 又要手裡加倍地帶銀子，並將歸還在你們口袋內的銀子仍帶在手裡；那或者是錯了。
english: And take twice as much money with you; that is to say, take back the money which was put in your bags, for it may have been an error;

chinese: 也帶著你們的兄弟，起身去見那人。
english: And take your brother and go back to the man:

chinese: 但願全能的神使你們在那人面前蒙憐憫，釋放你們的那弟兄和便雅憫回來。我若喪了兒子，就喪了吧!』
english: And may God, the Ruler of all, give you mercy before the man, so that he may give you back your other brother and Benjamin. If my children are to be taken from me; there is no help for it.

chinese: 於是，他們拿著那禮物，又手裡加倍地帶銀子，並且帶著便雅憫，起身下到埃及，站在約瑟面前。
english: So they took what their father said for the man, and twice as much money in their hands, and Benjamin, and went on their journey to Egypt, and came before Joseph.

chinese: 約瑟見便雅憫和他們同來，就對家宰說：『將這些人領到屋裡。要宰殺牲畜，預備筵席，因為晌午這些人同我吃飯。』
english: And when Joseph saw Benjamin, he said to his chief servant, Take these men into my house, and make ready a meal, for they will take food with me in the middle of the day.

chinese: 家宰就遵著約瑟的命去行，領他們進約瑟的屋裡。
english: And the servant did as Joseph said, and took the men into Joseph's house.

chinese: 他們因為被領到約瑟的屋裡，就害怕，說：『領我們到這裡來，必是因為頭次歸還在我們口袋裡的銀子，找我們的錯縫，下手害我們，強取我們為奴僕，搶奪我們的驢。』
english: Now the men were full of fear because they had been taken into Joseph's house and they said, It is because of the money which was put back in our bags the first time; he is looking for something against us, so that he may come down on us and take us and our asses for his use.

chinese: 他們就挨近約瑟的家宰，在屋門口和他說話，
english: So they went up to Joseph's chief servant at the door of the house,

chinese: 說：『我主啊，我們頭次下來實在是要糴糧。
english: And said, O my lord, we only came down the first time to get food;

chinese: 後來到了住宿的地方，我們打開口袋，不料，各人的銀子，分量足數，仍在各人的口袋內，現在我們手裡又帶回來了。
english: And when we came to our night's resting-place, on opening our bags we saw that every man's money was in the mouth of his bag, all our money in full weight: and we have it with us to give it back;

chinese: 另外又帶下銀子來糴糧。不知道先前誰把銀子放在我們的口袋裡。』
english: As well as more money, with which to get food: we have no idea who put our money in our bags.

chinese: 家宰說：『你們可以放心，不要害怕，是你們的神和你們父親的　神賜給你們財寶在你們的口袋裡；你們的銀子，我早已收了。』他就把西緬帶出來，交給他們。
english: Then the servant said, Peace be with you: have no fear: your God, even the God of your father, has put wealth in your bags for you: I had your money. Then he let Simeon come out to them.

chinese: 家宰就領他們進約瑟的屋裡，給他們水洗腳，又給他們草料餵驢。
english: And the servant took them into Joseph's house, and gave them water for washing their feet; and he gave their asses food.

chinese: 他們就預備那禮物，等候約瑟晌午來，因為他們聽見要在那裡吃飯。
english: And they got ready the things for Joseph before he came in the middle of the day: for word was given to them that they were to have a meal there.

chinese: 約瑟來到家裡，他們就把手中的禮物拿進屋去給他，又俯伏在地，向他下拜。
english: And when Joseph came in, they gave him the things which they had for him, and went down to the earth before him.

chinese: 約瑟問他們好，又問：『你們的父親─就是你們所說的那老人家平安嗎？他還在嗎？』
english: And he said, How are you? is your father well, the old man of whom you were talking to me? is he still living?

chinese: 他們回答說：『你僕人─我們的父親平安；他還在。』於是他們低頭下拜。
english: And they said, Your servant, our father, is well, he is still living. And they went down on their faces before him.

chinese: 約瑟舉目看見他同母的兄弟便雅憫，就說：『你們向我所說那頂小的兄弟就是這位嗎？』又說：『小兒啊，願神賜恩給你!』
english: Then, lifting up his eyes, he saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother's son, and he said, Is this your youngest brother of whom you gave me word? And he said, God be good to you, my son.

chinese: 約瑟愛弟之情發動，就急忙尋找可哭之地，進入自己的屋裡，哭了一場。
english: Then Joseph's heart went out to his brother, and he went quickly into his room, for he was overcome with weeping.

chinese: 他洗了臉出來，勉強隱忍，吩咐人擺飯。
english: Then, after washing his face, he came out, and controlling his feelings said, Put food before us.

chinese: 他們就為約瑟單擺了一席，為那些人又擺了一席，也為和約瑟同吃飯的埃及人另擺了一席，因為埃及人不可和希伯來人一同吃飯；那原是埃及人所厭惡的。
english: And they put a meal ready for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians who were with him by themselves; because the Egyptians may not take food with the Hebrews, for that would make them unclean.

chinese: 約瑟使眾弟兄在他面前排列坐席，都按著長幼的次序，眾弟兄就彼此詫異。
english: And they were all given their seats before him in order of birth, from the oldest to the youngest: so that they were looking at one another in wonder.

chinese: 約瑟把他面前的食物分出來，送給他們；但便雅憫所得的比別人多五倍。他們就飲酒，和約瑟一同宴樂。
english: And Joseph sent food to them from his table, but he sent five times as much to Benjamin as to any of the others. And they took wine freely with him.

chinese: 約瑟吩咐家宰說：『把糧食裝滿這些人的口袋，儘著他們的驢所能馱的，又把各人的銀子放在各人的口袋裡，
english: Then he gave orders to the servant who was over his house, saying, Put as much food into the men's bags as will go into them, and put every man's money in the mouth of his bag;

chinese: 並將我的銀杯和那少年人糴糧的銀子一同裝在他的口袋裡。』家宰就照約瑟所說的話行了；
english: And put my cup, my silver cup, in the youngest one's bag, with his money. So he did as Joseph said.

chinese: 天一亮就打發那些人帶著驢走了。
english: And at dawn the men, with their asses, were sent away.

chinese: 他們出城走了不遠，約瑟對家宰說：『起來，追那些人去，追上了就對他們說：「你們為甚麼以惡報善呢？
english: And when they had gone only a little way out of the town, Joseph said to the servant who was over his house, Go after them; and when you overtake them, say to them, Why have you done evil in reward for good?

chinese: 這不是我主人飲酒的杯嗎？豈不是他占卜用的嗎？你們這樣行是作惡了。」』
english: Is not this the cup from which my lord takes wine and by which he gets knowledge of the future? Truly, you have done evil.

chinese: 家宰追上他們，將這些話對他們說了。
english: So he overtook them and said these words to them.

chinese: 他們回答說：『我主為甚麼說這樣的話呢？你僕人斷不能作這樣的事。
english: And they said to him, Why does my lord say such words as these? far be it from your servants to do such a thing:

chinese: 你看，我們從前在口袋裡所見的銀子，尚且從迦南地帶來還你，我們怎能從你主人家裡偷竊金銀呢？
english: See, the money which was in the mouth of our bags we gave back to you when we came again from Canaan: how then might we take silver or gold from your lord's house?

chinese: 你僕人中無論在誰那裡搜出來，就叫他死，我們也作我主的奴僕。』
english: If it comes to light that any of your servants has done this, let him be put to death, and we will be your lord's servants.

chinese: 家宰說：『現在就照你們的話行吧!在誰那裡搜出來，誰就作我的奴僕；其餘的都沒有罪。』
english: And he said, Let it be as you say: he in whose bag it is seen will become my servant; and you will not be responsible.

chinese: 於是他們各人急忙把口袋卸在地下，各人打開口袋。
english: Then every man quickly got his bag down and undid it.

chinese: 家宰就搜查，從年長的起到年幼的為止，那杯竟在便雅憫的口袋裡搜出來。
english: And he made a search, starting with the oldest and ending with the youngest; and the cup was in Benjamin's bag.

chinese: 他們就撕裂衣服，各人把馱子抬在驢上，回城去了。
english: Then in bitter grief they put the bags on the asses again and went back to the town.

chinese: 猶大和他弟兄們來到約瑟的屋中，約瑟還在那裡，他們就在他面前俯伏於地。
english: So Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house; and he was still there: and they went down on their faces before him.

chinese: 約瑟對他們說：『你們作的是甚麼事呢？你們豈不知像我這樣的人必能占卜嗎？』
english: And Joseph said, What is this thing which you have done? had you no thought that such a man as I would have power to see what is secret?

chinese: 猶大說：『我們對我主說甚麼呢？還有甚麼話可說呢？我們怎能自己表白出來呢？神已經查出僕人的罪孽了。我們與那在他手中搜出杯來的都是我主的奴僕。
english: And Judah said, What are we to say to my lord? how may we put ourselves right in his eyes? God has made clear the sin of your servants: now we are in your hands, we and the man in whose bag your cup was seen.

chinese: 約瑟說：『我斷不能這樣行!在誰的手中搜出杯來，誰就作我的奴僕；至於你們，可以平平安安地上你們父親那裡去。』
english: Then he said, Far be it from me to do so: but the man who had my cup will be my servant; and you may go back to your father in peace.

chinese: 猶大挨近他，說：『我主啊，求你容僕人說一句話給我主聽，不要向僕人發烈怒，因為你如同法老一樣。
english: Then Judah came near him, and said, Let your servant say a word in my lord's ears, and let not your wrath be burning against your servant: for you are in the place of Pharaoh to us.

chinese: 我主曾問僕人們說：「你們有父親有兄弟沒有？」
english: My lord said to his servants, Have you a father or a brother?

chinese: 我們對我主說：「我們有父親，已經年老，還有他老年所生的一個小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母親只撇下他一人，他父親疼愛他。」
english: And we said to my lord, We have an old father and a young child, whom he had when he was old; his brother is dead and he is the only son of his mother, and is very dear to his father.

chinese: 你對僕人說：「把他帶到我這裡來，叫我親眼看看他。」
english: And you said to your servants, Let him come down to me with you, so that I may see him.

chinese: 我們對我主說：童子不能離開他父親，若是離開，他父親必死。
english: And we said to my lord, His father will not let him go; for if he went away his father would come to his death.

chinese: 你對僕人說：你們的小兄弟若不與你們一同下來，你們就不得再見我的面。
english: But you said to your servants, If your youngest brother does not come with you, you will not see my face again.

chinese: 我們上到你僕人─我們父親那裡，就把我主的話告訴了他。
english: And when we went back to your servant, our father, we gave him an account of my lord's words.

chinese: 我們的父親說：你們再去給我糴些糧來。
english: And our father said, Go again and get us a little food.

chinese: 我們就說：我們不能下去。我們的小兄弟若和我們同往，我們就可以下去。因為，小兄弟若不與我們同往，我們必不得見那人的面。
english: And we said, Only if our youngest brother goes with us will we go down; for we may not see the man's face again if our youngest brother is not with us.

chinese: 你僕人─我父親對我們說：你們知道我的妻子給我生了兩個兒子。
english: And our father said to us, You have knowledge that my wife gave me two sons;

chinese: 一個離開我出去了；我說他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也沒有見他。
english: The one went away from me, and I said, Truly he has come to a violent death; and from that time I have not seen him,

chinese: 現在你們又要把這個帶去離開我，倘若他遭害，那便是你們使我白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。
english: If now you take this one from me, and some evil comes to him, you will make my grey head go down in sorrow to the underworld.

chinese: 我父親的命與這童子的命相連。如今我回到你僕人─我父親那裡，若沒有童子與我們同在，
english: If then I go back to your servant, my father, without the boy, because his life and the boy's life are one,

chinese: 我們的父親見沒有童子，他就必死。這便是我們使你僕人─我們的父親白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。
english: When he sees that the boy is not with us, he will come to his death, and our father's grey head will go down in sorrow to the underworld.

chinese: 因為僕人曾向我父親為這童子作保，說：我若不帶他回來交給父親，我便在父親面前永遠擔罪。
english: For I made myself responsible for the boy to my father, saying, If I do not give him safely back to you, let mine be the sin for ever.

chinese: 現在求你容僕人住下，替這童子作我主的奴僕，叫童子和他哥哥們一同上去。
english: So now let me be my lord's servant here in place of the boy, and let him go back with his brothers.

chinese: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去見我父親呢？恐怕我看見災禍臨到我父親身上。
english: For how may I go back to my father without the boy, and see the evil which will come on my father?

chinese: 約瑟在左右站著的人面前情不自禁，吩咐一聲說：人都要離開我出去！約瑟和弟兄相認的時候並沒有一人站在他面前。
english: Then Joseph, unable to keep back his feelings before those who were with him, gave orders for everyone to be sent away, and no one was present when he made clear to his brothers who he was.

chinese: 他就放聲大哭，埃及人和法老家中的人都聽見了。
english: And so loud was his weeping, that it came to the ears of the Egyptians and all Pharaoh's house.

chinese: 約瑟對他弟兄們說：我是約瑟。我的父親還在麼？他弟兄不能回答，因為在他面前都驚惶。
english: And Joseph said to his brothers, I am Joseph: is my father still living? But his brothers were not able to give him an answer for they were troubled before him.

chinese: 約瑟又對他弟兄們說：請你們近前來。他們就近前來。他說：我是你們的兄弟約瑟，就是你們所賣到埃及的。
english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, Come near to me. And they came near, And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sent into Egypt.

chinese: 現在，不要因為把我賣到這裡自憂自恨。這是神差我在你們以先來，為要保全生命。
english: Now do not be troubled or angry with yourselves for sending me away, because God sent me before you to be the saviour of your lives.

chinese: 現在這地的饑荒已經二年了，還有五年不能耕種，不能收成。
english: For these two years have been years of need, and there are still five more years to come in which there will be no ploughing or cutting of grain.

chinese: 神差我在你們以先來，為要給你們存留餘種在世上，又要大施拯救，保全你們的生命。
english: God sent me before you to keep you and yours living on earth so that you might become a great nation.

chinese: 這樣看來，差我到這裡來的不是你們，乃是神。他又使我如法老的父，作他全家的主，並埃及全地的宰相。
