english: So now it was not you who sent me here, but God: and he has made me as a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 你們要趕緊上到我父親那裡。對他說：你兒子約瑟這樣說：神使我作全埃及的主，請你下到我這裡來，不要耽延。
english: Now go quickly to my father, and say to him, Your son Joseph says, God has made me ruler over all the land of Egypt: come down to me straight away:

chinese: 你和你我兒子孫子，連牛群羊群，並一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，與我相近。
english: The land of Goshen will be your living-place, and you will be near me; you and your children and your children's children, and your flocks and herds and all you have:

chinese: 我要在那裡奉養你；因為還有五年的饑荒，免得你和你的眷屬，並一切所有的，都敗落了。
english: And there I will take care of you, so that you and your family may not be in need, for there are still five bad years to come.

chinese: 況且你們的眼和我兄弟便雅憫的眼都看見是我親口對你們說話。
english: Now truly, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see, that it is my mouth which says these things to you.

chinese: 你們也要將我在埃及一切的榮耀和你們所看見的事都告訴我父親，又要趕緊的將我父親搬到我這裡來。
english: Give my father word of all my glory in Egypt and of all you have seen; and come back quickly with my father.

chinese: 於是約瑟伏在他兄弟便雅憫的頸項上哭，便雅憫也在他的頸項上哭。
english: Then, weeping, he took Benjamin in his arms, and Benjamin himself was weeping on Joseph's neck.

chinese: 他又與眾弟兄親嘴，抱著他們哭，隨後他弟兄就和他說話。
english: Then he gave a kiss to all his brothers, weeping over them; and after that his brothers had no fear of talking to him.

chinese: 這風聲傳到法老的宮裡，說：約瑟的弟兄們來了。法老和他的臣僕都很喜歡。
english: And news of these things went through Pharaoh's house, and it was said that Joseph's brothers were come; and it seemed good to Pharaoh and his servants.

chinese: 法老對約瑟說：你吩咐你的弟兄們說：你們要這樣行：把馱子抬在牲口上，起身往迦南地去。
english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to your brothers, Put your goods on your beasts and go back to the land of Canaan;

chinese: 將你們的父親和你們的眷屬都搬到我這裡來，我要把埃及地的美物賜給你們，你們也要吃這地肥美的出產。
english: And get your father and your families and come back to me: and I will give you all the good things of Egypt, and the fat of the land will be your food.

chinese: 現在我吩咐你們要這樣行：從埃及地帶著車輛去，把你們的孩子和妻子，並你們的父親都搬來。
english: And say to them, This you are to do: take carts from the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and get your father and come back.

chinese: 你們眼中不要愛惜你們的家具，因為埃及全地的美物都是你們的。
english: And take no thought for your goods, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.

chinese: 以色列的兒子們就如此行。約瑟照著法老的吩咐給他們車輛和路上用的食物，
english: And the children of Israel did as he said; and Joseph gave them carts as had been ordered by Pharaoh, and food for their journey.

chinese: 又給他們各人一套衣服，惟獨給便雅憫三百銀子，五套衣服；
english: To every one of them he gave three changes of clothing; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred bits of silver and five changes of clothing.

chinese: 送給他父親公驢十匹，馱著埃及的美物，母驢十匹，馱著糧食與餅和菜，為他父親路上用。
english: And to his father he sent ten asses with good things from Egypt on their backs, and ten she-asses with grain and bread and food for his father on the journey.

chinese: 於是約瑟打發他弟兄們回去，又對他們說：你們不要在路上相爭。
english: And he sent his brothers on their way, and said to them, See that you have no argument on the road.

chinese: 他們從埃及上去，來到迦南地、他們的父親雅各那裡，
english: So they went up from Egypt and came to the land of Canaan, to their father Jacob.

chinese: 告訴他說：約瑟還在，並且作埃及全地的宰相。雅各心裡冰涼，因為不信他們。
english: And they said to him, Joseph is living, and is ruler over all the land of Egypt. And at this word Jacob was quite overcome, for he had no faith in it.

chinese: 他們便將約瑟對他們說的一切話都告訴了他。他們父親雅各又看見約瑟打發來接他的車輛，心就甦醒了。
english: And they gave him an account of everything Joseph had said to them; and when he saw the carts which Joseph had sent for them, his spirit came back to him:

chinese: 以色列說：罷了！罷了！我的兒子約瑟還在，趁我未死以先，我要去見他一面。
english: And Israel said, It is enough: Joseph my son is still living; I will go and see him before my death.

chinese: 以色列帶著一切所有的，起身來到別是巴，就獻祭給他父親以撒的神。
english: And Israel went on his journey with all he had, and came to Beer-sheba, where he made offerings to the God of his father Isaac.

chinese: 夜間，神在異象中對以色列說：雅各！雅各！他說：我在這裡。
english: And God said to Israel in a night-vision, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

chinese: 神說：我是神，就是你父親的神。你下埃及去不要害怕，因為我必使你在那裡成為大族。
english: And he said, I am God, the God of your father: go down to Egypt without fear, for I will make a great nation of you there:

chinese: 我要和你同下埃及去，也必定帶你上來；約瑟必給你送終(原文作將手按在你的眼睛上)。
english: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will see that you come back again, and at your death Joseph will put his hands on your eyes.

chinese: 雅各就從別是巴起行。以色列的兒子們使他們的父親雅各和他們的妻子、兒女都坐在法老為雅各送來的車上。
english: Then Jacob went on from Beer-sheba; and the sons of Jacob took their father and their little ones and their wives in the carts which Pharaoh had sent for them.

chinese: 他們又帶著迦南地所得的牲畜、貨財來到埃及。雅各和他的一切子孫都一同來了，
english: And they took their cattle and all the goods which they had got in the land of Canaan, and came to Egypt, even Jacob and all his seed:

chinese: 雅各把他的兒子、孫子、女兒、孫女，並他的子子孫孫，一同帶到埃及。
english: His sons and his sons' sons, his daughters and his daughters' sons and all his family he took with him into Egypt.

chinese: 來到埃及的以色列人名字記在下面。雅各和他的兒孫：雅各的長子是流便。
english: And these are the names of the children of Israel who came into Egypt, even Jacob and all his sons: Reuben, Jacob's oldest son;

chinese: 流便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯倫、迦米。
english: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch and Pallu and Hezron and Carmi;

chinese: 西緬的兒子是耶母利、雅憫、阿轄、雅斤、瑣轄，還有迦南女子所生的掃羅。
english: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and Jachin and Zohar and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan;

chinese: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
english: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari;

chinese: 猶大的兒子是珥、俄南、示拉、法勒斯、謝拉；惟有珥與俄南死在迦南地。法勒斯的兒子是希斯倫、哈母勒。
english: And the sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah and Perez and Zerah: but Er and Onan had come to their death in the land of Canaan; and the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

chinese: 以薩迦的兒子是陀拉、普瓦、約伯、伸崙。
english: And the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah and Job and Shimron;

chinese: 西布倫的兒子是西烈、以倫、雅利。
english: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered and Elon and Jahleel;

chinese: 這是利亞在巴旦亞蘭給雅各所生的兒子，還在女兒底拿。兒孫共三十三人。
english: All these, together with his daughter Dinah, were the children of Leah, whom Jacob had by her in Paddan-aram; they were thirty-three in number.

chinese: 迦得的兒子是洗非芸、哈基、書尼、以斯本、以利、亞羅底、亞列利。
english: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion and Haggi, Shuni and Ezbon, Eri and Arodi and Areli;

chinese: 亞設的兒子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韋、比利亞，還有他們的妹子西拉。比利亞的兒子是希別、瑪結。
english: And the sons of Asher: Jimnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah, and Sarah, their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

chinese: 這是拉班給他女兒利亞的婢女悉帕從雅各所生的兒孫，共有十六人。
english: These are the children of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah, and Jacob had these sixteen children by her.

chinese: 雅各之妻拉結的兒子是約瑟和便雅憫。
english: The sons of Jacob's wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

chinese: 約瑟在埃及地生了瑪拿西和以法蓮，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給約瑟生的。
english: And Joseph had Manasseh and Ephraim in the land of Egypt, by Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On.

chinese: 便雅憫的兒子是比拉、比結、亞實別、基拉、乃幔、以希、羅實、母平、戶平、亞勒。
english: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah and Becher and Ashbel, Gera and Naaman, Ehi and Rosh, Muppim and Huppim and Ard.

chinese: 這是拉結給雅各所生的兒孫，共有十四人。
english: All these were the children of Rachel whom Jacob had by her, fourteen persons.

chinese: 但的兒子是戶伸。
english: And the son of Dan was Hushim.

chinese: 拿弗他利的兒子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、示冷。
english: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel and Guni and Jezer and Shillem.

chinese: 這是拉班給他女兒拉結的婢女辟拉從雅各所生的兒孫，共有七人。
english: These were the children of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel, seven persons.

chinese: 那與雅各同到埃及的，除了他兒婦之外，凡從他所生的，共有六十六人。
english: All the persons who came with Jacob into Egypt, the offspring of his body, were sixty-six, without taking into account the wives of Jacob's sons.

chinese: 還有約瑟在埃及所生的兩個兒子。雅各家來到埃及的共有七十人。
english: And the sons of Joseph whom he had in Egypt were two. Seventy persons of the family of Jacob came into Egypt.

chinese: 雅各打發猶大先去見約瑟，請派人引路往歌珊去；於是他們來到歌珊地。
english: Now he had sent Judah before him to Goshen, to get word from Joseph; and so they came to the land of Goshen.

chinese: 約瑟套車往歌珊去，迎接他父親以色列，及至見了面，就伏在父親的頸項，哭了許久。
english: And Joseph got his carriage ready and went to Goshen for the meeting with his father; and when he came before him, he put his arms round his neck, weeping.

chinese: 以色列對約瑟說：我既得見你的面，知道你還在，就是死我也甘心。
english: And Israel said to Joseph, Now that I have seen you living again, I am ready for death.

chinese: 約瑟對他的弟兄和他父的全家說：我要上去告訴法老，對他說：我的弟兄和我父的全家從前在迦南地，現今都到我這裡來了。
english: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's people, I will go and give the news to Pharaoh, and say to him, My brothers and my father's people, from the land of Canaan, have come to me;

chinese: 他們本是牧羊的人，以養牲畜為業；他們把羊群牛群和一切所有的都帶來了。
english: And these men are keepers of sheep and owners of cattle, and have with them their flocks and their herds and all they have.

chinese: 等法老召你們的時候，問你們說：你們以何事為業？
english: Now when Pharaoh sends for you and says, What is your business?

chinese: 你們要說：你的僕人，從幼年直到如今，都以養牲畜為業，連我們的祖宗也都以此為業。這樣，你們可以住在歌珊地，因為凡牧羊的都被埃及人所厭惡。
english: You are to say, Your servants have been keepers of cattle from our early days up to now, like our fathers; in this way you will be able to have the land of Goshen for yourselves; because keepers of sheep are unclean in the eyes of the Egyptians.

chinese: 約瑟進去告訴法老說：我的父親和我的弟兄帶著羊群牛群，並一切所有的，從迦南地來了，如今在歌珊地。
english: Then Joseph went to Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brothers with their flocks and their herds and all they have, are come from Canaan, and are now in the land of Goshen.

chinese: 約瑟從他弟兄中挑出五個人來，引他們去見法老。
english: And he took five of his brothers to Pharaoh.

chinese: 法老問約瑟的弟兄說：你們以可事為業？他們對法老說：你僕人是牧羊的，連我們的祖宗也是牧羊的。
english: And Pharaoh said to them, What is your business? And they said, Your servants are keepers of sheep, as our fathers were before us.

chinese: 他們又對法老說：迦南地的饑荒甚大，僕人的羊群沒有草吃，所以我們來到這地寄居。現在求你容僕人住在歌珊地。
english: And they said to Pharaoh, We have come to make a living in this land, because we have no grass for our flocks in the land of Canaan; so now let your servants make a place for themselves in the land of Goshen.

chinese: 法老對約瑟說：你父親和你弟兄到你這裡來了，
english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Let them have the land of Goshen; and if there are any able men among them, put them over my cattle.

chinese: 埃及地都在你面前，只管叫你父親和你弟兄住在國中最好的地；他們可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他們中間有甚麼能人，就派他們看管我的牲畜。
english: And Jacob and his sons came to Joseph in Egypt, and when word of it came to the ears of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, he said to Joseph, Your father and brothers have come to you; all the land of Egypt is before you; let your father and your brothers have the best of the land for their resting-place.

chinese: 約瑟領他父親雅各進到法老面前，雅各就給法老祝福。
english: Then Joseph made his father Jacob come before Pharaoh, and Jacob gave him his blessing.

chinese: 法老問雅各說：你平生的年日是多少呢？
english: And Pharaoh said to him, How old are you?

chinese: 雅各對法老說：我寄居在世的年日是一百三十歲，我平生的年日又少又苦，不及我列祖早在世寄居的年日。
english: And Jacob said, The years of my wanderings have been a hundred and thirty; small in number and full of sorrow have been the years of my life, and less than the years of the wanderings of my fathers.

chinese: 雅各又給法老祝福，就從法老面前出去了。
english: And Jacob gave Pharaoh his blessing, and went out from before him.

chinese: 約瑟遵著法老的命，把埃及國最好的地，就是蘭塞境內的地，給他父親和弟兄居住，作為產業。
english: And Joseph made a place for his father and his brothers, and gave them a heritage in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had given orders.

chinese: 約瑟用糧食奉養他父親和他弟兄，並他父親全家的眷屬，都是照各家的人口奉養他們。
english: And Joseph took care of his father and his brothers and all his father's people, giving them food for the needs of their families.

chinese: 饑荒甚大，全地都絕了糧，甚至埃及地和迦南地的人因那饑荒的緣故都餓昏了。
english: Now there was no food to be had in all the land, so that all Egypt and Canaan were wasted from need of food.

chinese: 約瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所有的銀子，就是眾人糴糧的銀子，約瑟就把那銀子帶到法老的宮裡。
english: And all the money in Egypt and in the land of Canaan which had been given for grain, came into the hands of Joseph: and he put it in Pharaoh's house.

chinese: 埃及地和迦南地的銀子都花盡了，埃及眾人都來見約瑟，說：我們的銀子都用盡了，求你給我們糧食，我們為甚麼死在你面前呢？
english: And when all the money in Egypt and Canaan was gone, the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, Give us bread; would you have us come to destruction before your eyes? for we have no more money.

chinese: 約瑟說：若是銀子用盡了，可以把你們的牲畜給我，我就為你們的牲畜給你們糧食。
english: And Joseph said, Give me your cattle; I will give you grain in exchange for your cattle if your money is all gone.

chinese: 於是他們把牲畜趕到約瑟那裡，約瑟就拿糧食換了他們的牛、羊、驢、馬；那一年因換他們一切的牲畜，就用糧食養活他們。
english: So they took their cattle to Joseph and he gave them bread in exchange for their horses and flocks and herds and asses, so all that year he gave them food in exchange for their cattle.

chinese: 那一年過去，第二年他們又來見約瑟，說：我們不瞞我主，我們的銀子都花盡了，牲畜也都歸了我主。我們在我主眼前，除了我們的身體和田地之外，一無所剩。
english: And when that year was ended, they came to him in the second year, and said, We may not keep it from our lord's knowledge that all our money is gone, and all the herds of cattle are my lord's; there is nothing more to give my lord but our bodies and our land;

chinese: 你何忍見我們人死地荒呢？求你用糧食買我們的我們的地，我們和我們的地就要給法老效力。又求你給我們種子，使我們得以存活，不至死亡，地土也不至荒涼。
english: Are we to come to destruction before your eyes, we and our land? take us and our land and give us bread; and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh; and give us seed so that we may have life and the land may not become waste.

chinese: 於是，約瑟為法老買了埃及所有的地，埃及人因被饑荒所迫，各都賣了自己的田地；那地就都歸了法老。
english: So Joseph got all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh; for every Egyptian gave up his land in exchange for food, because of their great need; so all the land became Pharaoh's.

chinese: 至於百姓，約瑟叫他們，從埃及這邊直到埃及那邊，都各歸各城。
english: And as for the people, he made servants of them, town by town, from one end of Egypt to the other.

chinese: 惟有祭司的地，約瑟沒有買，因為祭司有從法老所得的常俸。他們吃法老所給的常俸，所以他們不賣自己的地。
english: Only he did not take the land of the priests, for the priests had their food given them by Pharaoh, and having what Pharaoh gave them, they had no need to give up their land.

chinese: 約瑟對百姓說：我今日為法老買了你們和你們的地，看哪，這裡有種子給你們，你們可以種地。
english: Then Joseph said to the people, I have made you and your land this day the property of Pharaoh; here is seed for you to put in your fields.

chinese: 後來打糧食的時候，你們要把五分之一納給法老，四分可以歸你們做地裡的種子，也做你們和你們家口孩童的食物。
english: And when the grain is cut, you are to give a fifth part to Pharaoh, and four parts will be yours for seed and food, and for your families and your little ones.

chinese: 他們說：你救了我們的性命。但願我們在我主眼前蒙恩，我們就作法老的僕人。
english: And they said to him, Truly you have kept us from death; may we have grace in your eyes, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

chinese: 於是約瑟為埃及地定下常例，直到今日：法老必得五分之一，惟獨祭司的地不歸法老。
english: Then Joseph made a law which is in force to this day, that Pharaoh was to have the fifth part; only the land of the priests did not become his.

chinese: 以色列人住在埃及的歌珊地。他們在那裡置了產業，並且生育甚多。
english: And so Israel was living among the Egyptians in the land of Goshen; and they got property there, and became very great in numbers and in wealth.

chinese: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七歲。
english: And Jacob was living in the land of Goshen for seventeen years; so the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.

chinese: 以色列的死期臨近了，他就叫了他兒子約瑟來，說：我若在你眼前蒙恩，請你把手放在我大腿底下，用慈愛和誠實待我，請你不要將我葬在埃及。
english: And the time of his death came near, and he sent for his son Joseph and said to him, If now I am dear to you, put your hand under my leg and take an oath that you will not put me to rest in Egypt;

chinese: 我與我祖我父同睡的時候，你要將我帶出埃及，葬在他們所葬的地方。約瑟說：我必遵著你的命而行。
english: But when I go to my fathers, you are to take me out of Egypt and put me to rest in their last resting-place. And he said, I will do so.

chinese: 雅各說：你要向我起誓。約瑟就向他起了誓，於是以色列在床頭上(或作扶著杖頭)敬拜神。
english: And he said, Take an oath to me; and he took an oath to him: and Israel gave worship on the bed's head.

chinese: 這事以後，有人告訴約瑟說：你的父親病了。他就帶著兩個兒子瑪拿西和以法蓮同去。
english: Now after these things, word came to Joseph that his father was ill: and he took with him his sons Manasseh and Ephraim.

chinese: 有人告訴雅各說：請看，你兒子約瑟到你這裡來了。以色列就勉強在床上坐起來。
english: And when they said to Jacob, Your son Joseph is coming to see you: then Israel, getting all his strength together, had himself lifted up in his bed.

chinese: 雅各對約瑟說：全能的神曾在迦南地的路斯向我顯現，賜福與我，
english: And Jacob said to Joseph, God, the Ruler of all, came to me in a vision at Luz in the land of Canaan, and gave me his blessing,

chinese: 對我說：我必使你生養眾多，成為多民，又要把這地賜給你的後裔，永遠為業。
english: And said to me, Truly, I will make you fertile and give you increase and will make of you a great family of nations: and I will give this land to your seed after you to be their heritage for ever.

chinese: 未到埃及見你之先，你在埃及地所生的以法蓮和瑪拿西這兩個兒子是我的，正如流便和西緬是我的一樣。
english: And now your two sons who came to birth in Egypt before I came to you here, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh will be mine, in the same way as Reuben and Simeon are.

chinese: 你在他們以後所生的就是你的，他們可以歸於他們弟兄的名下得產業。
english: And any other offspring which you have after them, will be yours, and will be named after their brothers in their heritage.

chinese: 至於我，我從巴旦來的時候，拉結死在我眼前，在迦南地的路上，離以法他還有一段路程，我就把他葬在以法他的路上〈以法他就是伯利恆〉。
english: And as for me, when I came from Paddan, death overtook Rachel on the way, when we were still some distance from Ephrath; and I put her to rest there on the road to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.

chinese: 以色列看見約瑟的兩個兒子，就說：這是誰？
english: Then Israel, looking at Joseph's sons, said, Who are these?

chinese: 約瑟對他父親說：這是神在這裡賜給我的兒子。以色列說：請你領他們到我跟前，我要給他們祝福。
english: And Joseph said to his father, They are my sons, whom God has given me in this land. And he said, Let them come near me, and I will give them a blessing.

chinese: 以色列年紀老邁，眼睛昏花，不能看見。約瑟領他們到他跟前，他就和他們親嘴，抱著他們。
english: Now because Israel was old, his eyes were no longer clear, and he was not able to see. So he made them come near to him, and he gave them a kiss, folding them in his arms.

chinese: 以色列對約瑟說：我想不到得見你的面，不料，神又使我得見你的兒子。
english: And Israel said to Joseph, I had no hope of seeing your face again, but God in his mercy has let me see you and your children.

chinese: 約瑟把兩個兒子從以色列兩膝中領出來，自己就臉伏於地下拜。
english: Then Joseph took them from between his knees, and went down on his face to the earth.

chinese: 隨後，約瑟又拉著他們兩個，以法蓮在他的右手裡，對著以色列的左手，瑪拿西在他的左手裡，對著以色列的右手，領他們到以色列的跟前。
english: Then taking Ephraim with his right hand, Joseph put him at Israel's left side, and with his left hand he put Manasseh at Israel's right side, placing them near him.

chinese: 以色列伸出右手來，按在以法蓮的頭上〈以法蓮乃是次子〉，又剪搭過左手來，按在瑪拿西的頭上〈瑪拿西原是長子〉。
english: And Israel, stretching out his right hand, put it on the head of Ephraim, the younger, and his left hand on the head of Manasseh, crossing his hands on purpose, for Manasseh was the older.

chinese: 他就給約瑟祝福說：願我祖亞伯拉罕和我父以撒所事奉的神，就是一生牧養我直到今日的　神，
english: And he gave Joseph a blessing, saying, May the God to whom my fathers, Abraham and Isaac, gave worship, the God who has taken care of me all my life till this day,

chinese: 救贖我脫離一切患難的那使者，賜福與這兩個童子。願他們歸在我的名下和我祖亞伯拉罕、我父以撒的名下。又願他們在世界中生養眾多。
english: The angel who has been my saviour from all evil, send his blessing on these children: and let my name and the name of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac, be given to them; and let them become a great nation in the earth.

chinese: 約瑟見他父親把右手按在以法蓮的頭上，就不喜悅，便提起他父親的手，要從以法蓮的頭上挪到瑪拿西的頭上。
english: Now when Joseph saw that his father had put his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it did not seem right to him; and lifting his father's hand he would have put it on the head of Manasseh.

chinese: 約瑟對他父親說：我父，不是這樣。這本是長子，求你把右手按在他的頭上。
english: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, my father, for this is the older; put your right hand on his head.

chinese: 他父親不從，說：我知道，我兒，我知道。他也必成為一族，也必昌大。只是他的兄弟將來比他還大；他兄弟的後裔要成為多族。
english: But his father would not, saying, I am doing it on purpose, my son; he will certainly become a nation and a great one; but his younger brother will be greater than he, and his seed will become a great family of nations.

chinese: 當日就給他們祝福說：以色列人要指著你們祝福說：願神使你如以法蓮、瑪拿西一樣。於是立以法蓮在瑪拿西以上。
english: So he gave them his blessing that day, saying, You will be the sign of blessing in Israel, for they will say, May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh; and he put Ephraim before Manasseh.

chinese: 以色列又對約瑟說：我要死了，但神必與你們同在，領你們回到你們列祖之地。
english: Then Israel said to Joseph, Now my death is near; but God will be with you, guiding you back to the land of your fathers.

chinese: 並且我從前用弓用刀從亞摩利人手下奪的那塊地，我都賜給你，使你比眾弟兄多得一分。
english: And I have given you more than your brothers, even Shechem as your heritage, which I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow.

chinese: 雅各叫了他的兒子們來，說：你們都來聚集，我好把你們日後必遇的事告訴你們。
english: And Jacob sent for his sons, and said, Come together, all of you, so that I may give you news of your fate in future times.

chinese: 雅各的兒子們，你們要聚集而聽，要聽你們父親以色列的話。
english: Come near, O sons of Jacob, and give ear to the words of Israel your father.

chinese: 流便哪，你是我的長子，是我力量強壯的時候生的，本當大有尊榮，權力超眾。
english: Reuben, you are my oldest son, the first-fruit of my strength, first in pride and first in power:

chinese: 但你放縱情慾，滾沸如水，必不得居首位；因為你上了你父親的床，污穢了我的榻。
english: But because you were uncontrolled, the first place will not be yours; for you went up to your father's bed, even his bride-bed, and made it unclean.

chinese: 西緬和利未是弟兄；他們的刀劍是殘忍的器具。
english: Simeon and Levi are brothers; deceit and force are their secret designs.

chinese: 我的靈阿，不要與他們同謀；我的心哪，不要與他們聯絡；因為他們趁怒殺害人命，任意砍斷牛腿大筋。
english: Take no part in their secrets, O my soul; keep far away, O my heart, from their meetings; for in their wrath they put men to death, and for their pleasure even oxen were wounded.

chinese: 他們的怒氣暴烈可咒；他們的忿恨殘忍可詛。我要使他們分居在雅各家裡，散住在以色列地中。
english: A curse on their passion for it was bitter; and on their wrath for it was cruel. I will let their heritage in Jacob be broken up, driving them from their places in Israel.

chinese: 猶大阿，你弟兄們必讚美你；你手必掐住仇敵的頸項；你父親的兒子們必向你下拜。
english: To you, Judah, will your brothers give praise: your hand will be on the neck of your haters; your father's sons will go down to the earth before you.

chinese: 猶大是個小獅子；我兒阿，你抓了食便上去。你屈下身去，臥如公獅，蹲如母獅，誰敢惹你？
english: Judah is a young lion; like a lion full of meat you have become great, my son; now he takes his rest like a lion stretched out and like an old lion; by whom will his sleep be broken?

chinese: 圭必不離猶大，杖必不離他兩腳之間，直等細羅(就是賜平安者)來到，萬民都必歸順。
english: The rod of authority will not be taken from Judah, and he will not be without a law-giver, till he comes who has the right to it, and the peoples will put themselves under his rule.

chinese: 猶大把小驢拴在葡萄樹上，把驢駒拴在美好的葡萄樹上。他在葡萄酒中洗了衣服，在葡萄汁中洗了袍褂。
english: Knotting his ass's cord to the vine, and his young ass to the best vine; washing his robe in wine, and his clothing in the blood of grapes:

chinese: 他的眼睛必因酒紅潤；他的牙齒必因奶白亮。
english: His eyes will be dark with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

chinese: 西布倫必住在海口，必成為停船的海口；他的境界必延到西頓。
english: The resting-place of Zebulun will be by the sea, and he will be a harbour for ships; the edge of his land will be by Zidon.

chinese: 以薩迦是個強壯的驢，臥在羊圈之中。
english: Issachar is a strong ass stretched out among the flocks:

chinese: 他以安靜為佳，以肥地為美，便低肩背重，成為服苦的僕人。
english: And he saw that rest was good and the land was pleasing; so he let them put weights on his back and became a servant.

chinese: 但必判斷他的民，作以色列支派之一。
english: Dan will be the judge of his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

chinese: 但必作道上的蛇，路中的虺，咬傷馬蹄，使騎馬的墜落於後。
english: May Dan be a snake in the way, a horned snake by the road, biting the horse's foot so that the horseman has a fall.

chinese: 耶和華阿，我向來等候你的救恩。
english: I have been waiting for your salvation, O Lord.

chinese: 迦得必被敵軍追逼，他卻要追逼他們的腳跟。
english: Gad, an army will come against him, but he will come down on them in their flight.

chinese: 亞設之地必出肥美的糧食，且出君王的美味。
english: Asher's bread is fat; he gives delicate food for kings.

chinese: 拿弗他利是被釋放的母鹿；他出嘉美的言語。
english: Naphtali is a roe let loose, giving fair young ones.

chinese: 約瑟是多結果子的樹枝，是泉旁多結果的枝子；他的枝條探出牆外。
english: Joseph is a young ox, whose steps are turned to the fountain;

chinese: 弓箭手將他苦害，向他射箭，逼迫他。
english: He was troubled by the archers; they sent out their arrows against him, cruelly wounding him:

chinese: 但他的弓仍舊堅硬；他的手健壯敏捷。這是因以色列的牧者，以色列的磐石─就是雅各的大能者。
english: But their bows were broken by a strong one, and the cords of their arms were cut by the Strength of Jacob, by the name of the Stone of Israel:

chinese: 你父親的神必幫助你；那全能者必將天上所有的福，地裡所藏的福，以及生產乳養的福，都賜給你。
english: Even by the God of your father, who will be your help, and by the Ruler of all, who will make you full with blessings from heaven on high, blessings of the deep stretched out under the earth, blessings of the breasts and of the fertile body:

chinese: 你父親所祝的福，勝過我祖先所祝的福，如永世的山嶺，至極的邊界；這些福必降在約瑟的頭上，臨到那與弟兄迥別之人的頂上。
english: Blessings of sons, old and young, to the father: blessings of the oldest mountains and the fruit of the eternal hills: let them come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of him who was separate from his brothers.

chinese: 便雅憫是個撕掠的狼，早晨要吃他所抓的，晚上要分他所奪的。
english: Benjamin is a wolf, searching for meat: in the morning he takes his food, and in the evening he makes division of what he has taken.

chinese: 這一切是以色列的十二支派；這也是他們的父親對他們所說的話，為他們所祝的福，都是按著各人的福分為他們祝福。
english: These are the twelve tribes of Israel: and these are the words their father said to them, blessing them; to every one he gave his blessing.

chinese: 他又囑咐他們說：我將要歸到我列祖(原文作本民)那裡，你們要將我葬在赫人以弗崙田間的洞裡，與我祖我父在一處，
english: And he gave orders to them, saying, Put me to rest with my people and with my fathers, in the hollow of the rock in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

chinese: 就是在迦南地幔利前、麥比拉田間的洞；那洞和田是亞伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙買來為業，作墳地的。
english: In the rock in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in the land of Canaan, which Abraham got from Ephron the Hittite, to be his resting-place.

chinese: 他們在那裡葬了亞伯拉罕和他妻撒拉，又在那裡葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那裡葬了利亞。
english: There Abraham and Sarah his wife were put to rest, and there they put Isaac and Rebekah his wife, and there I put Leah to rest.

chinese: 那塊田和田間的洞原是向赫人買的。
english: In the rock in the field which was got for a price from the people of Heth.

chinese: 雅各囑咐眾子已畢，就把腳收在床上，氣絕而死，歸到列祖(原文作本民)那裡去了。
english: And when Jacob had come to the end of these words to his sons, stretching himself on his bed, he gave up his spirit, and went the way of his people.

chinese: 約瑟伏在他父親的面上哀哭，與他親嘴。
english: And Joseph put his head down on his father's face, weeping and kissing him.

chinese: 約瑟吩咐伺候他的醫生用香料薰他父親，醫生就用香料薰了以色列。
english: And Joseph gave orders to his servants who had the necessary knowledge, to make his father's body ready, folding it in linen with spices, and they did so.

chinese: 薰屍的常例是四十天；那四十天滿了，埃及人為他哀哭了七十天。
english: And the forty days needed for making the body ready went by: and there was weeping for him among the Egyptians for seventy days.

chinese: 為他哀哭的日子過了，約瑟對法老家中的人說：我若在你們眼前蒙恩，請你們報告法老說：
english: And when the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph said to the servants of Pharaoh, If now you have love for me, say these words to Pharaoh:

chinese: 我父親要死的時候叫我起誓說：你要將我葬在迦南地，在我為自己所掘的墳墓裡。現在求你讓我上去葬我父親，以後我必回來。
english: My father made me take an oath, saying, When I am dead, put me to rest in the place I have made ready for myself in the land of Canaan. So now let me go and put my father in his last resting-place, and I will come back again.

chinese: 法老說：你可以上去，照著你父親叫你起的誓，將他葬埋。
english: And Pharaoh said, Go up and put your father to rest, as you gave your oath to him.

chinese: 於是約瑟上去葬他父親。與他一同上去的，有法老的臣僕和法老家中的長老，並埃及國的長老，
english: So Joseph went up to put his father in his last resting-place; and with him went all the servants of Pharaoh, and the chief men of his house and all the chiefs of the land of Egypt,

chinese: 還有約瑟的全家和他的弟兄們，並他父親的眷屬；只有他們的婦人孩子，和羊群牛群，都留在歌珊地。
english: And all the family of Joseph, and his brothers and his father's people: only their little ones and their flocks and herds they did not take with them from the land of Goshen.

chinese: 又有車輛馬兵，和他一同上去；那一幫人甚多。
english: And carriages went up with him and horsemen, a great army.

chinese: 他們到了約但河外、亞達的禾場，就在那裡大大地號咷痛哭。約瑟為他父親哀哭了七天。
english: And they came to the grain-floor of Atad on the other side of Jordan, and there they gave the last honours to Jacob, with great and bitter sorrow, weeping for their father for seven days.

chinese: 迦南的居民見亞達禾場上的哀哭，就說：這是埃及人一場大的哀哭。因此那地方名叫亞伯麥西，是在約但河東。
english: And when the people of the land, the people of Canaan, at the grain-floor of Atad, saw their grief, they said, Great is the grief of the Egyptians: so the place was named Abel-mizraim, on the other side of Jordan.

chinese: 雅各的兒子們就遵著他父親所吩咐的辦了，
english: So his sons did as he had given them orders to do:

chinese: 把他搬到迦南地，葬在幔利前、麥比拉田間的洞裡；那洞和田是亞伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙買來為業，作墳地的。
english: For they took him into the land of Canaan and put him to rest in the hollow rock in the field of Machpelah, which Abraham got with the field, for a resting-place, from Ephron the Hittite at Mamre.

chinese: 約瑟葬了他父親以後，就和眾弟兄，並一切同他上去葬他父親的人，都回埃及去了。
english: And when his father had been put to rest, Joseph and his brothers and all who had gone with him, went back to Egypt.

chinese: 約瑟的哥哥們見父親死了，就說：或者約瑟懷恨我們，照著我們從前待他一切的惡足足的報復我們。
english: Now after the death of their father, Joseph's brothers said to themselves, It may be that Joseph's heart will be turned against us, and he will give us punishment for all the evil which we did to him.

chinese: 他們就打發人去見約瑟，說：你父親未死以先吩咐說：
english: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, Your father, before his death, gave us orders, saying,

chinese: 你們要對約瑟這樣說：從前你哥哥們惡待你，求你饒恕他們的過犯和罪惡。如今求你饒恕你父親神之僕人的過犯。他們對約瑟說這話，約瑟就哭了。
english: You are to say to Joseph, Let the wrongdoing of your brothers be overlooked, and the evil they did to you: now, if it is your pleasure, let the sin of the servants of your father's God have forgiveness. And at these words, Joseph was overcome with weeping.

chinese: 他的哥哥們又來俯伏在他面前，說：我們是你的僕人。
english: Then his brothers went, and falling at his feet, said, Truly, we are your servants.

chinese: 約瑟對他們說：不要害怕，我豈能代替神呢？
english: And Joseph said, Have no fear: am I in the place of God?

chinese: 從前你們的意思是要害我，但神的意思原是好的，要保全許多人的性命，成就今日的光景。
english: As for you, it was in your mind to do me evil, but God has given a happy outcome, the salvation of numbers of people, as you see today.

chinese: 現在你們不要害怕，我必養活你們和你們的婦人孩子。於是約瑟用親愛的話安慰他們。
english: So now, have no fear: for I will take care of you and your little ones. So he gave them comfort with kind words.

chinese: 約瑟和他父親的眷屬都住在埃及。約瑟活了一百一十歲。
english: Now Joseph and all his father's family went on living in Egypt: and the years of Joseph's life were a hundred and ten.

chinese: 約瑟得見以法蓮第三代的子孫。瑪拿西的孫子、瑪吉的兒子也養在約瑟的膝上。
english: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: and the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, came to birth on Joseph's knees.

chinese: 約瑟對他弟兄們說：我要死了，但神必定看顧你們，領你們從這地上去，到他起誓所應許給亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各之地。
english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, The time of my death has come; but God will keep you in mind and take you out of this land into the land which he gave by his oath to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob.

chinese: 約瑟叫以色列的子孫起誓說：神必定看顧你們；你們要把我的骸骨從這裡搬上去。
english: Then Joseph made the children of Israel take an oath, saying, God will certainly give effect to his word, and you are to take my bones away from here.

chinese: 約瑟死了，正一百一十歲。人用香料將他薰了，把他收殮在棺材裡，停在埃及。
english: So Joseph came to his death, being a hundred and ten years old: and they made his body ready, and he was put in a chest in Egypt.

chinese: 以色列的眾子，各帶家眷，和雅各一同來到埃及。他們的名字記在下面。
english: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt; every man and his family came with Jacob.

chinese: 有流便、西緬、利未、猶大、
english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;

chinese: 以薩迦、西布倫、便雅憫、
english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;

chinese: 但、拿弗他利、迦得、亞設。
english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

chinese: 凡從雅各而生的，共有七十人。約瑟已經在埃及。
english: All the offspring of Jacob were seventy persons: and Joseph had come to Egypt before them.

chinese: 約瑟和他的弟兄，並那一代的人，都死了。
english: Then Joseph came to his end, and all his brothers, and all that generation.

chinese: 以色列人生養眾多，並且繁茂，極其強盛，滿了那地。
english: And the children of Israel were fertile, increasing very greatly in numbers and in power; and the land was full of them.

chinese: 有不認識約瑟的新王起來，治理埃及，
english: Now a new king came to power in Egypt, who had no knowledge of Joseph.

chinese: 對他的百姓說：看哪，這以色列民比我們還多，又比我們強盛。
english: And he said to his people, See, the people of Israel are greater in number and in power than we are:

chinese: 來罷，我們不如用巧計待他們，恐怕他們多起來，日後若遇甚麼爭戰的事，就連合我們的仇敵攻擊我們，離開這地去了。
english: Let us take care for fear that their numbers may become even greater, and if there is a war, they may be joined with those who are against us, and make an attack on us, and go up out of the land.

chinese: 於是埃及人派督工的轄制他們，加重擔苦害他們。他們為法老建造兩座積貨城，就是比東和蘭塞。
english: So they put overseers of forced work over them, in order to make their strength less by the weight of their work. And they made store-towns for Pharaoh, Pithom and Raamses.

chinese: 只是越發苦害他們，他們越發多起來，越發蔓延；埃及人就因以色列人愁煩。
english: But the more cruel they were to them, the more their number increased, till all the land was full of them. And the children of Israel were hated by the Egyptians.

chinese: 埃及人嚴嚴的使以色列人做工，
english: And they gave the children of Israel even harder work to do:

chinese: 使他們因做苦工覺得命苦；無論是和泥，是作磚，是作田間各樣的工，在一切的工上都嚴嚴的待他們。
english: And made their lives bitter with hard work, making building-material and bricks, and doing all sorts of work in the fields under the hardest conditions.

chinese: 有希伯來的兩個收生婆，一名施弗拉，一名普阿；埃及王對他們說：
english: And the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew women who gave help at the time of childbirth (the name of the one was Shiphrah and the name of the other Puah),

chinese: 你們為希伯來婦人收生，看他們臨盆的時候，若是男孩，就把他殺了；若是女孩，就留他存活。
english: When you are looking after the Hebrew women in childbirth, if it is a son you are to put him to death; but if it is a daughter, she may go on living.

chinese: 但是收生婆敬畏神，不照埃及王的吩咐行，竟存留男孩的性命。
english: But the women had the fear of God, and did not do as the king of Egypt said, but let the male children go on living.

chinese: 埃及王召了收生婆來，說：你們為甚麼做這事，存留男孩的性命呢？
english: And the king of Egypt sent for the women, and said to them, Why have you done this, and let the male children go on living?

chinese: 收生婆對法老說：因為希伯來婦人與埃及婦人不同；希伯來婦人本是健壯的（原文作活潑的），收生婆還沒有到，他們已經生產了。
english: And they said to Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are strong, and the birth takes place before we come to them.

chinese: 神厚待收生婆。以色列人多起來，極其強盛。
english: And the blessing of God was on these women: and the people were increased in number and became very strong.

chinese: 收生婆因為敬畏神，神便叫他們成立家室。
english: And because the women who took care of the Hebrew mothers had the fear of God, he gave them families.

chinese: 法老吩咐他的眾民說：以色列人所生的男孩，你們都要丟在河裡；一切的女孩，你們要存留他的性命。
english: And Pharaoh gave orders to all his people, saying, Every son who comes to birth is to be put into the river, but every daughter may go on living.

chinese: 有一個利未家的人娶了一個利未女子為妻。
english: Now a man of the house of Levi took as his wife a daughter of Levi.

chinese: 那女人懷孕，生一個兒子，見他俊美，就藏了他三個月，
english: And she became with child and gave birth to a Son; and when she saw that he was a beautiful child, she kept him secretly for three months.

chinese: 後來不能再藏，就取了一個蒲草箱，抹上石漆和石油，將孩子放在裡頭，把箱子擱在河邊的蘆荻中。
english: And when she was no longer able to keep him secret, she made him a basket out of the stems of water-plants, pasting sticky earth over it to keep the water out; and placing the baby in it she put it among the plants by the edge of the Nile.

chinese: 孩子的姊姊遠遠站著，要知道他究竟怎麼樣。
english: And his sister took her place at a distance to see what would become of him.

chinese: 法老的女兒來到河邊洗澡，他的使女們在河邊行走。他看見箱子在蘆荻中，就打發一個婢女拿來。
english: Now Pharaoh's daughter came down to the Nile to take a bath, while her women were walking by the riverside; and she saw the basket among the river-plants, and sent her servant-girl to get it.

chinese: 他打開箱子，看見那孩子。孩子哭了，他就可憐他，說：「這是希伯來人的一個孩子。」
english: And opening it, she saw the child, and he was crying. And she had pity on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.

chinese: 孩子的姊姊對法老的女兒說：「我去在希伯來婦人中叫一個奶媽來，為你奶這孩子，可以不可以？」
english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter, May I go and get you one of the Hebrew women to give him the breast?

chinese: 法老的女兒說：「可以。」童女就去叫了孩子的母親來。
english: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the girl went and got the child's mother.

chinese: 法老的女兒對他說：「你把這孩子抱去，為我奶他，我必給你工價。」婦人就抱了孩子去奶他。
english: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Take the child away and give it milk for me, and I will give you payment. And the woman took the child and gave it milk at her breast.

chinese: 孩子漸長，婦人把他帶到法老的女兒那裡，就作了他的兒子。他給孩子起名叫摩西，意思說：因我把他從水裡拉出來。
english: And when the child was older, she took him to Pharaoh's daughter and he became her son, and she gave him the name Moses, Because, she said, I took him out of the water.

chinese: 後來，摩西長大，他出去到他弟兄那裡，看他們的重擔，見一個埃及人打希伯來人的一個弟兄。
english: Now when Moses had become a man, one day he went out to his people and saw how hard their work was; and he saw an Egyptian giving blows to a Hebrew, one of his people.

chinese: 他左右觀看，見沒有人，就把埃及人打死了，藏在沙土裡。
english: And turning this way and that, and seeing no one, he put the Egyptian to death, covering his body with sand.

chinese: 第二天他出去，見有兩個希伯來人爭鬥，就對那欺負人的說：「你為甚麼打你同族的人呢？」
english: And he went out the day after and saw two of the Hebrews fighting: and he said to him who was in the wrong, Why are you fighting your brother?

chinese: 那人說：「誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？難道你要殺我，像殺那埃及人麼？」摩西便懼怕，說：「這事必是被人知道了。」
english: And he said, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us? are you going to put me to death as you did the Egyptian? And Moses was in fear, and said, It is clear that the thing has come to light.

chinese: 法老聽見這事，就想殺摩西，但摩西躲避法老，逃往米甸地居住。
english: Now when Pharaoh had news of this, he would have put Moses to death. But Moses went in flight from Pharaoh into the land of Midian: and he took his seat by a water-spring.

chinese: 一日，他在井旁坐下。米甸的祭司有七個女兒；他們來打水，打滿了槽，要飲父親的群羊。
english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came to get water for their father's flock.

chinese: 有牧羊的人來，把他們趕走了，摩西卻起來幫助他們，又飲了他們的群羊。
english: And the keepers of the sheep came up and were driving them away; but Moses got up and came to their help, watering their flock for them.

chinese: 他們來到父親流珥那裡；他說：「今日你們為何來得這麼快呢？」
english: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that you have come back so quickly today?

chinese: 他們說：「有一個埃及人救我們脫離牧羊人的手，並且為我們打水飲了群羊。」
english: And they said, An Egyptian came to our help against the keepers of sheep and got water for us and gave it to the flock.

chinese: 他對女兒們說：「那個人在那裡？你們為甚麼撇下他呢？你們去請他來吃飯。」
english: And he said to his daughters, Where is he? why have you let the man go? make him come in and give him a meal.

chinese: 摩西甘心和那人同住；那人把他的女兒西坡拉給摩西為妻。
english: And Moses was happy to go on living with the man; and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses.

chinese: 西坡拉生了一個兒子，摩西給他起名叫革舜，意思說：「因我在外邦作了寄居的。」
english: And she gave birth to a son, to whom he gave the name Gershom: for he said, I have been living in a strange land.

chinese: 過了多年，埃及王死了。以色列人因做苦工，就歎息哀求，他們的哀聲達於神。
english: Now after a long time the king of Egypt came to his end: and the children of Israel were crying in their grief under the weight of their work, and their cry for help came to the ears of God.

chinese: 神聽見他們的哀聲，就記念他與亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的約。
english: And at the sound of their weeping the agreement which God had made with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob came to his mind.

chinese: 神看顧以色列人，也知道他們的苦情。
english: And God's eyes were turned to the children of Israel and he gave them the knowledge of himself.

chinese: 摩西牧養他岳父米甸祭司葉忒羅的羊群；一日領羊群往野外去，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
english: Now Moses was looking after the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian: and he took the flock to the back of the waste land and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.

chinese: 耶和華的使者從荊棘裡火燄中向摩西顯現。摩西觀看，不料，荊棘被火燒著，卻沒有燒燬。
english: And the angel of the Lord was seen by him in a flame of fire coming out of a thorn-tree: and he saw that the tree was on fire, but it was not burned up.

chinese: 摩西說：我要過去看這大異象，這荊棘為何沒有燒壞呢？
english: And Moses said, I will go and see this strange thing, why the tree is not burned up,

chinese: 耶和華神見他過去要看，就從荊棘裡呼叫說：摩西！摩西！他說：我在這裡。
english: And when the Lord saw him turning to one side to see, God said his name out of the tree, crying, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

chinese: 神說：不要近前來。當把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站之地是聖地；
english: And he said, Do not come near: take off your shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy.

chinese: 又說：我是你父親的神，是亞伯拉罕的　神，以撒的　神，雅各的　神。摩西蒙上臉，因為怕看　神。
english: And he said, I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses kept his face covered for fear of looking on God.

chinese: 耶和華說：我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我實在看見了；他們因受督工的轄制所發的哀聲，我也聽見了。我原知道他們的痛苦，
english: And God said, Truly, I have seen the grief of my people in Egypt, and their cry because of their cruel masters has come to my ears; for I have knowledge of their sorrows;

chinese: 我下來是要救他們脫離埃及人的手，領他們出了那地，到美好、寬闊、流奶與蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地。
english: And I have come down to take them out of the hands of the Egyptians, guiding them out of that land into a good land and wide, into a land flowing with milk and honey; into the place of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.

chinese: 現在以色列人的哀聲達到我耳中，我也看見埃及人怎樣欺壓他們。
english: For now, truly, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me, and I have seen the cruel behaviour of the Egyptians to them.

chinese: 故此，我要打發你去見法老，使你可以將我的百姓以色列人從埃及領出來。
english: Come, then, and I will send you to Pharaoh, so that you may take my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.

chinese: 摩西對神說：我是甚麼人，竟能去見法老，將以色列人從埃及領出來呢？
english: And Moses said to God, Who am I to go to Pharaoh and take the children of Israel out of Egypt?

chinese: 神說：我必與你同在。你將百姓從埃及領出來之後，你們必在這山上事奉我；這就是我打發你去的證據。
english: And he said, Truly I will be with you; and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you: when you have taken the children of Israel out of Egypt, you will give worship to God on this mountain.

chinese: 摩西對神說：我到以色列人那裡，對他們說：你們祖宗的　神打發我到你們這裡來。他們若問我說：他叫甚麼名字？我要對他們說甚麼呢？
english: And Moses said to God, When I come to the children of Israel and say to them, The God of your fathers has sent me to you: and they say to me, What is his name? what am I to say to them?

chinese: 神對摩西說：我是自有永有的；又說：你要對以色列人這樣說：那自有的打發我到你們這裡來。
english: And God said to him, I AM WHAT I AM: and he said, Say to the children of Israel, I AM has sent me to you.

chinese: 神又對摩西說：你要對以色列人這樣說：耶和華─你們祖宗的神，就是亞伯拉罕的　神，以撒的　神，雅各的　神，打發我到你們這裡來。耶和華是我的名，直到永遠；這也是我的紀念，直到萬代。
english: And God went on to say to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has sent me to you: this is my name for ever, and this is my sign to all generations.

chinese: 你去招聚以色列的長老，對他們說：耶和華你們祖宗的神，就是亞伯拉罕的　神，以撒的　神，雅各的　神，向我顯現，說：我實在眷顧了你們，我也看見埃及人怎樣待你們。
english: Go and get together the chiefs of the children of Israel, and say to them, The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has been seen by me, and has said, Truly I have taken up your cause, because of what is done to you in Egypt;

chinese: 我也說：要將你們從埃及的困苦中領出來，往迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地去，就是到流奶與蜜之地。
english: And I have said, I will take you up out of the sorrows of Egypt into the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, into a land flowing with milk and honey.

chinese: 他們必聽你的話。你和以色列的長老要去見埃及王，對他說：耶和華希伯來人的神遇見了我們，現在求你容我們往曠野去，走三天的路程，為要祭祀耶和華我們的　神。
english: And they will give ear to your voice: and you, with the chiefs of Israel, will go to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and say to him, The Lord, the God of the Hebrews, has come to us: let us then go three days' journey into the waste land to make an offering to the Lord our God.

chinese: 我知道雖用大能的手，埃及王也不容你們去。
english: And I am certain that the king of Egypt will not let you go without being forced.

chinese: 我必伸手在埃及中間施行我一切的奇事，攻擊那地，然後他才容你們去。
english: But I will put out my hand and overcome Egypt with all the wonders which I will do among them: and after that he will let you go.

chinese: 我必叫你們在埃及人眼前蒙恩，你們去的時候就不至於空手而去。
english: And I will give this people grace in the eyes of the Egyptians, so that when you go out you will go out with your hands full.

chinese: 但各婦女必向他的鄰舍，並居住在他家裡的女人，要金器銀器和衣裳，好給你們的兒女穿戴。這樣你們就把埃及人的財物奪去了。
english: For every woman will get from her neighbour and from the woman living in her house, ornaments of silver and gold, and clothing; and you will put them on your sons and your daughters; you will take the best of their goods from the Egyptians.

chinese: 摩西回答說：他們必不信我，也不聽我的話，必說：耶和華並沒有向你顯現。
english: And Moses, answering, said, It is certain that they will not have faith in me or give ear to my voice; for they will say, You have not seen the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你手裡是甚麼？他說：是杖。
english: And the Lord said to him, What is that in your hand? And he said, A rod.

chinese: 耶和華說：丟在地上。他一丟下去，就變作蛇；摩西便跑開。
english: And he said, Put it down on the earth. And he put it down on the earth and it became a snake; and Moses went running from it.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：伸出手來，拿住他的尾巴，他必在你手中仍變為杖；
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Put out your hand and take it by the tail: (and he put out his hand and took a grip of it and it became a rod in his hand:)

chinese: 如此好叫他們信耶和華─他們祖宗的神，就是亞伯拉罕的　神，以撒的　神，雅各的　神，是向你顯現了。
english: So that they may be certain that the Lord, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has been seen by you.

chinese: 耶和華又對他說：把手放在懷裡。他就把手放在懷裡，及至抽出來，不料，手長了大痲瘋，有雪那樣白。
english: Then the Lord said to him again, Put your hand inside your clothing. And he put his hand inside his robe: and when he took it out it was like the hand of a leper, as white as snow.

chinese: 耶和華說：再把手放在懷裡。他就再把手放在懷裡，及至從懷裡抽出來，不料，手已經復原，與周身的肉一樣；
english: And he said, Put your hand inside your robe again. (And he put his hand into his robe again, and when he took it out he saw that it had become like his other flesh.)

chinese: 又說：倘或他們不聽你的話，也不信頭一個神蹟，他們必信第二個神蹟。
english: And if they do not have faith in you or give ear to the voice of the first sign, they will have faith in the second sign.

chinese: 這兩個神蹟若都不信，也不聽你的話，你就從河裡取些水，倒在旱地上，你從河裡取的水必在旱地上變作血。
english: And if they have no faith even in these two signs and will not give ear to your voice, then you are to take the water of the Nile and put it on the dry land: and the water you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.

chinese: 摩西對耶和華說：主阿，我素日不是能言的人，就是從你對僕人說話以後，也是這樣。我本是拙口笨舌的。
english: And Moses said to the Lord, O Lord, I am not a man of words; I have never been so, and am not now, even after what you have said to your servant: for talking is hard for me, and I am slow of tongue.

chinese: 耶和華對他說：誰造人的口呢？誰使人口啞、耳聾、目明、眼瞎呢？豈不是我─耶和華麼？
english: And the Lord said to him, Who has made man's mouth? who takes away a man's voice or hearing, or makes him seeing or blind? Is it not I, the Lord?

chinese: 現在去罷，我必賜你口才，指教你所當說的話。
english: So go now, and I will be with your mouth, teaching you what to say.

chinese: 摩西說：主阿，你願意打發誰，就打發誰去罷！
english: And he said, O Lord, send, if you will, by the hand of anyone whom it seems good to you to send.

chinese: 耶和華向摩西發怒說：不是有你的哥哥利未人亞倫麼？我知道他是能言的；現在他出來迎接你，他一見你，心裡就歡喜。
english: And the Lord was angry with Moses, and said, Is there not Aaron, your brother, the Levite? To my knowledge he is good at talking. And now he is coming out to you: and when he sees you he will be glad in his heart.

chinese: 你要將當說的話傳給他；我也要賜你和他口才，又要指教你們所當行的事。
english: Let him give ear to your voice, and you will put my words in his mouth; and I will be with your mouth and with his, teaching you what you have to do.

chinese: 他要替你對百姓說話；你要以他當作口，他要以你當作神。
english: And he will do the talking for you to the people: he will be to you as a mouth and you will be to him as God.

chinese: 你手裡要拿這杖，好行神蹟。
english: And take in your hand this rod with which you will do the signs.

chinese: 於是，摩西回到他岳父葉忒羅那裡，對他說：求你容我回去見我在埃及的弟兄，看他們還在不在。葉忒羅對摩西說：你可以平平安安地去罷！
english: And Moses went back to Jethro, his father-in-law, and said to him, Let me go back now to my relations in Egypt and see if they are still living. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

chinese: 耶和華在米甸對摩西說：你要回埃及去，因為尋索你命的人都死了。
english: And the Lord said to Moses in Midian, Go back to Egypt, for all the men are dead who were attempting to take your life.

chinese: 摩西就帶著妻子和兩個兒子，叫他們騎上驢，回埃及地去。摩西手裡拿著神的杖。
english: And Moses took his wife and his sons and put them on an ass and went back to the land of Egypt: and he took the rod of God in his hand.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你回到埃及的時候，要留意將我指示你的一切奇事行在法老面前。但我要使（或作：任憑；下同）他的心剛硬，他必不容百姓去。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, When you go back to Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have given you power to do: but I will make his heart hard and he will not let the people go.

chinese: 你要對法老說：耶和華這樣說：以色列是我的兒子，我的長子。
english: And you are to say to Pharaoh, The Lord says, Israel is the first of my sons:

chinese: 我對你說過：容我的兒子去，好事奉我。你還是不肯容他去。看哪，我要殺你的長子。
english: And I said to you, Let my son go, so that he may give me worship; and you did not let him go: so now I will put the first of your sons to death.

chinese: 摩西在路上住宿的地方，耶和華遇見他，想要殺他。
english: Now on the journey, at the night's resting-place, the Lord came in his way and would have put him to death.

chinese: 西坡拉就拿一塊火石，割下他兒子的陽皮，丟在摩西腳前，說：你真是我的血郎了。
english: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cutting off the skin of her son's private parts, and touching his feet with it, she said, Truly you are a husband of blood to me.

chinese: 這樣，耶和華才放了他。西坡拉說：你因割禮就是血郎了。
english: So he let him go. Then she said, You are a husband of blood because of the circumcision.

chinese: 耶和華對亞倫說：你往曠野去迎接摩西。他就去，在神的山遇見摩西，和他親嘴。
english: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the waste land and you will see Moses. So he went and came across Moses at the mountain of God, and gave him a kiss.

chinese: 摩西將耶和華打發他所說的言語和囑咐他所行的神蹟都告訴了亞倫。
english: And Moses gave Aaron an account of all the words of the Lord which he had sent him to say, and of all the signs which he had given him orders to do.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫就去招聚以色列的眾長老。
english: Then Moses and Aaron went and got together all the chiefs of the children of Israel:

chinese: 亞倫將耶和華對摩西所說的一切話述說了一遍，又在百姓眼前行了那些神蹟，
english: And Aaron said to them all the words the Lord had said to Moses, and did the signs before all the people.

chinese: 百姓就信了。以色列人聽見耶和華眷顧他們，鑒察他們的困苦，就低頭下拜。
english: And the people had faith in them; and hearing that the Lord had taken up the cause of the children of Israel and had seen their troubles, with bent heads they gave him worship.

chinese: 後來摩西、亞倫去對法老說：耶和華─以色列的神這樣說：容我的百姓去，在曠野向我守節。
english: And after that, Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh, and said, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, Let my people go so that they may keep a feast to me in the waste land.

chinese: 法老說：耶和華是誰，使我聽他的話，容以色列人去呢？我不認識耶和華，也不容以色列人去！
english: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, to whose voice I am to give ear and let Israel go? I have no knowledge of the Lord and I will not let Israel go.

chinese: 他們說：希伯來人的神遇見了我們。求你容我們往曠野去，走三天的路程，祭祀耶和華─我們的　神，免得他用瘟疫、刀兵攻擊我們。
english: And they said, The God of the Hebrews has come to us: let us then go three days' journey into the waste land to make an offering to the Lord our God, so that he may not send death on us by disease or the sword.

chinese: 埃及王對他們說：摩西、亞倫！你們為甚麼叫百姓曠工呢？你們去擔你們的擔子罷！
english: And the king of Egypt said to them, Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people away from their work? get back to your work.

chinese: 又說：看哪，這地的以色列人如今眾多，你們竟叫他們歇下擔子！
english: And Pharaoh said, Truly, the people of the land are increasing in number, and you are keeping them back from their work.

chinese: 當天，法老吩咐督工的和官長說：
english: The same day Pharaoh gave orders to the overseers and those who were responsible for the work, saying,

chinese: 你們不可照常把草給百姓做磚，叫他們自己去撿草。
english: Give these men no more dry stems for their brick-making as you have been doing; let them go and get the material for themselves.

chinese: 他們素常做磚的數目，你們仍舊向他們要，一點不可減少；因為他們是懶惰的，所以呼求說：容我們去祭祀我們的神。
english: But see that they make the same number of bricks as before, and no less: for they have no love for work; and so they are crying out and saying, Let us go and make an offering to our God.

chinese: 你們要把更重的工夫加在這些人身上，叫他們勞碌，不聽虛謊的言語。
english: Give the men harder work, and see that they do it; let them not give attention to false words.

chinese: 督工的和官長出來對百姓說：法老這樣說：我不給你們草。
english: And the overseers of the people and their responsible men went out and said to the people, Pharaoh says, I will give you no more dry stems.

chinese: 你們自己在那裡能找草，就往那裡去找罷！但你們的工一點不可減少。
english: Go yourselves and get dry stems wherever you are able; for your work is not to be any less.

chinese: 於是百姓散在埃及遍地，撿碎秸當作草。
english: So the people were sent in all directions through the land of Egypt to get dry grass for stems.

chinese: 督工的催著說：你們一天當完一天的工，與先前有草一樣。
english: And the overseers went on driving them and saying, Do your full day's work as before when there were dry stems for you.

chinese: 法老督工的，責打他所派以色列人的官長，說：你們昨天今天為甚麼沒有照向來的數目做磚、完你們的工作呢？
english: And the responsible men of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh's overseers had put over them, were given blows, and they said to them, Why have you not done your regular work, in making bricks as before?

chinese: 以色列人的官長就來哀求法老說：為甚麼這樣待你的僕人？
english: Then the responsible men of the children of Israel came to Pharaoh, protesting and saying, Why are you acting in this way to your servants?

chinese: 督工的不把草給僕人，並且對我們說：做磚罷！看哪，你僕人挨了打，其實是你百姓的錯。
english: They give us no dry stems and they say to us, Make bricks: and they give your servants blows; but it is your people who are in the wrong.

chinese: 但法老說：你們是懶惰的！你們是懶惰的！所以說：容我們去祭祀耶和華。
english: But he said, You have no love for work: that is why you say, Let us go and make an offering to the Lord.

chinese: 現在你們去做工罷！草是不給你們的，磚卻要如數交納。
english: Go now, get back to your work; no dry stems will be given to you, but you are to make the full number of bricks.

chinese: 以色列人的官長聽說你們每天做磚的工作一點不可減少，就知道是遭遇禍患了。
english: Then the responsible men of the children of Israel saw that they were purposing evil when they said, The number of bricks which you have to make every day will be no less than before.

chinese: 他們離了法老出來，正遇見摩西、亞倫站在對面，
english: And they came face to face with Moses and Aaron, who were in their way when they came out from Pharaoh:

chinese: 就向他們說：願耶和華鑒察你們，施行判斷；因你們使我們在法老和他臣僕面前有了臭名，把刀遞在他們手中殺我們。
english: And they said to them, May the Lord take note of you and be your judge; for you have given Pharaoh and his servants a bad opinion of us, putting a sword in their hands for our destruction.

chinese: 摩西回到耶和華那裡，說：主阿，你為甚麼苦待這百姓呢？為甚麼打發我去呢？
english: And Moses went back to the Lord and said, Lord, why have you done evil to this people? why have you sent me?

chinese: 自從我去見法老，奉你的名說話，他就苦待這百姓，你一點也沒有拯救他們。
english: For from the time when I came to Pharaoh to put your words before him, he has done evil to this people, and you have given them no help.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：現在你必看見我向法老所行的事，使他因我大能的手容以色列人去，且把他們趕出他的地。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Now you will see what I am about to do to Pharaoh; for by a strong hand he will be forced to let them go, driving them out of his land because of my outstretched arm.

chinese: 神曉諭摩西說：我是耶和華。
english: And God said to Moses, I am Yahweh:

chinese: 我從前向亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各顯現為全能的神；至於我名耶和華，他們未曾知道。
english: I let myself be seen by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, as God, the Ruler of all; but they had no knowledge of my name Yahweh.

chinese: 我與他們堅定所立的約，要把他們寄居的迦南地賜給他們。
english: And I made an agreement with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their wanderings.

chinese: 我也聽見以色列人被埃及人苦待的哀聲，我也記念我的約。
english: And truly my ears are open to the cry of the children of Israel whom the Egyptians keep under their yoke; and I have kept in mind my agreement.

chinese: 所以你要對以色列人說：我是耶和華；我要用伸出來的膀臂重重的刑罰埃及人，救贖你們脫離他們的重擔，不做他們的苦工。
english: Say then to the children of Israel, I am Yahweh, and I will take you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians, and make you safe from their power, and will make you free by the strength of my arm after great punishments.

chinese: 我要以你們為我的百姓，我也要作你們的神。你們要知道我是耶和華─你們的　神，是救你們脫離埃及人之重擔的。
english: And I will take you to be my people and I will be your God; and you will be certain that I am the Lord your God, who takes you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.

chinese: 我起誓應許給亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的那地，我要把你們領進去，將那地賜給你們為業。我是耶和華。
english: And I will be your guide into the land which I made an oath to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for your heritage: I am Yahweh.

chinese: 摩西將這話告訴以色列人，只是他們因苦工愁煩，不肯聽他的話。
english: And Moses said these words to the children of Israel, but they gave no attention to him, because of the grief of their spirit and the cruel weight of their work.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你進去對埃及王法老說，要容以色列人出他的地。
english: Go in and say to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, that he is to let the children of Israel go out of his land.

chinese: 摩西在耶和華面前說：以色列人尚且不聽我的話，法老怎肯聽我這拙口笨舌的人呢？
english: And Moses, answering the Lord, said, See, the children of Israel will not give ear to me; how then will Pharaoh give ear to me, whose lips are unclean?

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西、亞倫往以色列人和埃及王法老那裡去，把以色列人從埃及地領出來。
english: And the word of the Lord came to Moses and Aaron, with orders for the children of Israel and for Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to take the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 以色列人家長的名字記在下面。以色列長子流便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯崙、迦米；這是流便的各家。
english: These are the heads of their fathers' families: the sons of Reuben the oldest son of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi: these are the families of Reuben.

chinese: 西緬的兒子是耶母利、雅憫、阿轄、雅斤、瑣轄，和迦南女子的兒子掃羅；這是西緬的各家。
english: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and Jachin and Zohar and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan: these are the families of Simeon.

chinese: 利未眾子的名字按著他們的後代記在下面：就是革順、哥轄、米拉利。利未一生的歲數是一百三十七歲。
english: And these are the names of the sons of Levi in the order of their generations: Gershon and Kohath and Merari: and the years of Levi's life were a hundred and thirty-seven.

chinese: 革順的兒子按著家室是立尼、示每。
english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, in the order of their families.

chinese: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。哥轄一生的歲數是一百三十三歲。
english: And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel: and the years of Kohath's life were a hundred and thirty-three.

chinese: 米拉利的兒子是抹利和母示；這是利未的家，都按著他們的後代。
english: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi: these are the families of the Levites, in the order of their generations.

chinese: 暗蘭娶了他父親的妹妹約基別為妻，他給他生了亞倫和摩西。暗蘭一生的歲數是一百三十七歲。
english: And Amram took Jochebed, his father's sister, as wife; and she gave birth to Aaron and Moses: and the years of Amram's life were a hundred and thirty-seven.

chinese: 以斯哈的兒子是可拉、尼斐、細基利。
english: And the sons of Izhar: Korah and Nepheg and Zichri.

chinese: 烏薛的兒子是米沙利、以利撒反、西提利。
english: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri.

chinese: 亞倫娶了亞米拿達的女兒，拿順的妹妹，以利沙巴為妻，他給他生了拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
english: And Aaron took as his wife Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon; and she gave birth to Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

chinese: 可拉的兒子是亞惜、以利加拿、亞比亞撒；這是可拉的各家。
english: And the sons of Korah: Assir and Elkanah and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korahites.

chinese: 亞倫的兒子以利亞撒娶了普鐵的一個女兒為妻，他給他生了非尼哈。這是利未人的家長，都按著他們的家。
english: And Eleazar, Aaron's son, took as his wife one of the daughters of Putiel; and she gave birth to Phinehas. These are the heads of the families of the Levites, in the order of their families.

chinese: 耶和華說：將以色列人按著他們的軍隊從埃及地領出來。這是對那亞倫、摩西說的。
english: These are the same Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, Take the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt in their armies.

chinese: 對埃及王法老說要將以色列人從埃及領出來的，就是這摩西、亞倫。
english: These are the men who gave orders to Pharaoh to let the children of Israel go out of Egypt: these are the same Moses and Aaron.

chinese: 當耶和華在埃及地對摩西說話的日子，
english: And on the day when the word of the Lord came to Moses in the land of Egypt,

chinese: 他向摩西說：我是耶和華；我對你說的一切話，你都要告訴埃及王法老。
english: The Lord said to Moses, I am the Lord: say to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, everything I am saying to you.

chinese: 摩西在耶和華面前說：看哪，我是拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯聽我呢？
english: And Moses said to the Lord, My lips are unclean; how is it possible that Pharaoh will give me a hearing?

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：我使你在法老面前代替神，你的哥哥亞倫是替你說話的。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, See I have made you a god to Pharaoh, and Aaron your brother will be your prophet.

chinese: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要說。你的哥哥亞倫要對法老說，容以色列人出他的地。
english: Say whatever I give you orders to say: and Aaron your brother will give word to Pharaoh to let the children of Israel go out of his land.

chinese: 我要使法老的心剛硬，也要在埃及地多行神蹟奇事。
english: And I will make Pharaoh's heart hard, and my signs and wonders will be increased in the land of Egypt.

chinese: 但法老必不聽你們；我要伸手重重的刑罰埃及，將我的軍隊以色列民從埃及地領出來。
english: But Pharaoh will not give ear to you, and I will put my hand on Egypt, and take my armies, my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt, after great punishments.

chinese: 我伸手攻擊埃及，將以色列人從他們中間領出來的時候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和華。
english: And the Egyptians will see that I am the Lord, when my hand is stretched out over Egypt, and I take the children of Israel out from among them.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫這樣行；耶和華怎樣吩咐他們，他們就照樣行了。
english: And Moses and Aaron did so: as the Lord gave them orders, so they did.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫與法老說話的時候，摩西八十歲，亞倫八十三歲。
english: And Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they gave the Lord's word to Pharaoh.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 法老若對你們說：你們行件奇事罷！你就吩咐亞倫說：把杖丟在法老面前，使杖變作蛇。
english: If Pharaoh says to you, Let me see a wonder: then say to Aaron, Take your rod and put it down on the earth before Pharaoh so that it may become a snake.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫進去見法老，就照耶和華所吩咐的行。亞倫把杖丟在法老和臣僕面前，杖就變作蛇。
english: Then Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh and they did as the Lord had said: and Aaron put his rod down on the earth before Pharaoh and his servants, and it became a snake.

chinese: 於是法老召了博士和術士來；他們是埃及行法術的，也用邪術照樣而行。
english: Then Pharaoh sent for the wise men and the wonder-workers, and they, the wonder-workers of Egypt, did the same with their secret arts.

chinese: 他們各人丟下自己的杖，杖就變作蛇；但亞倫的杖吞了他們的杖。
english: For every one of them put down his rod on the earth, and they became snakes: but Aaron's rod made a meal of their rods.

chinese: 法老心裡剛硬，不肯聽從摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
english: But Pharaoh's heart was made hard, and he did not give ear to them, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：法老心裡固執，不肯容百姓去。
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Pharaoh's heart is unchanged; he will not let the people go.

chinese: 明日早晨，他出來往水邊去，你要往河邊迎接他，手裡要拿著那變過蛇的杖，
english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning; when he goes out to the water, you will be waiting for him by the edge of the Nile, with the rod which was turned into a snake in your hand;

chinese: 對他說：耶和華─希伯來人的神打發我來見你，說：容我的百姓去，好在曠野事奉我。到如今你還是不聽。
english: And say to him, The Lord, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, Let my people go so that they may give me worship in the waste land; but up to now you have not given ear to his words.

chinese: 耶和華這樣說：我要用我手裡的杖擊打河中的水，水就變作血；因此，你必知道我是耶和華。
english: So the Lord says, By this you may be certain that I am the Lord; see, by the touch of this rod in my hand the waters of the Nile will be turned to blood;

chinese: 河裡的魚必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厭惡吃這河裡的水。
english: And the fish in the Nile will come to destruction, and the river will send up a bad smell, and the Egyptians will not be able, for disgust, to make use of the water of the Nile for drinking.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：你對亞倫說：把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他們的江、河、池、塘以上，叫水都變作血。在埃及遍地，無論在木器中，石器中，都必有血。
english: And the Lord said, Say to Aaron, Let the rod in your hand be stretched out over the waters of Egypt, and over the rivers and the streams and the pools, and over every stretch of water, so that they may be turned to blood; and there will be blood through all the land of Egypt, in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫就照耶和華所吩咐的行。亞倫在法老和臣僕眼前舉杖擊打河裡的水，河裡的水都變作血了。
english: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord had said; and when his rod had been lifted up and stretched out over the waters of the Nile before the eyes of Pharaoh and his servants, all the water in the Nile was turned to blood;

chinese: 河裡的魚死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃這河裡的水；埃及遍地都有了血。
english: And the fish in the Nile came to destruction, and a bad smell went up from the river, and the Egyptians were not able to make use of the water of the Nile for drinking; and there was blood through all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 埃及行法術的，也用邪術照樣而行。法老心裡剛硬，不肯聽摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
english: And the wonder-workers of Egypt did the same with their secret arts: but Pharaoh's heart was made hard, and he would not give ear to them, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 法老轉身進宮，也不把這事放在心上。
english: Then Pharaoh went into his house, and did not take even this to heart.

chinese: 埃及人都在河的兩邊挖地，要得水喝，因為他們不能喝這河裡的水。
english: And all the Egyptians made holes round about the Nile to get drinking-water, for they were not able to make use of the Nile water.

chinese: 耶和華擊打河以後滿了七天。
english: And seven days went past, after the Lord had put his hand on the Nile.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：你進去見法老，對他說：耶和華這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
english: And this is what the Lord said to Moses: Go to Pharaoh and say to him, The Lord says, Let my people go so that they may give me worship.

chinese: 你若不肯容他們去，我必使青蛙蹧蹋你的四境。
english: And if you will not let them go, see, I will send frogs into every part of your land:

chinese: 河裡要滋生青蛙；這青蛙要上來進你的宮殿和你的臥房，上你的床榻，進你臣僕的房屋，上你百姓的身上，進你的爐灶和你的摶麵盆，
english: The Nile will be full of frogs, and they will come up into your house and into your bedrooms and on your bed, and into the houses of your servants and your people, and into your ovens and into your bread-basins.

chinese: 又要上你和你百姓並你眾臣僕的身上。
english: The frogs will come up over you and your people and all your servants.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：你對亞倫說：把你的杖伸在江、河、池以上，使青蛙到埃及地上來。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to Aaron, Let the rod in your hand be stretched out over the streams and the waterways and the pools, causing frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.

chinese: 亞倫便伸杖在埃及的諸水以上，青蛙就上來，遮滿了埃及地。
english: And when Aaron put out his hand over the waters of Egypt, the frogs came up and all the land of Egypt was covered with them.

chinese: 行法術的也用他們的邪術照樣而行，叫青蛙上了埃及地。
english: And the wonder-workers did the same with their secret arts, making frogs come up over the land of Egypt.

chinese: 法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：請你們求耶和華使這青蛙離開我和我的民，我就容百姓去祭祀耶和華。
english: Then Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron and said, Make prayer to the Lord that he will take away these frogs from me and my people; and I will let the people go and make their offering to the Lord.

chinese: 摩西對法老說：任憑你罷，我要何時為你和你的臣僕並你的百姓祈求，除滅青蛙離開你和你的宮殿只留在河裡呢？
english: And Moses said, I will let you have the honour of saying when I am to make prayer for you and your servants and your people, that the frogs may be sent away from you and your houses, and be only in the Nile.

chinese: 他說：明天。摩西說：可以照你的話罷，好叫你知道沒有像耶和華─我們神的。
english: And he said, By tomorrow. And he said, Let it be as you say: so that you may see that there is no other like the Lord our God.

chinese: 青蛙要離開你和你的宮殿，並你的臣僕與你的百姓，只留在河裡。
english: And the frogs will be gone from you and from your houses and from your servants and from your people and will be only in the Nile.

chinese: 於是摩西、亞倫離開法老出去。摩西為擾害法老的青蛙呼求耶和華。
english: Then Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh; and Moses made prayer to the Lord about the frogs which he had sent on Pharaoh.

chinese: 耶和華就照摩西的話行。凡在房裡、院中、田間的青蛙都死了。
english: And the Lord did as Moses said; and there was an end of all the frogs in the houses and in the open spaces and in the fields.

chinese: 眾人把青蛙聚攏成堆，遍地就都腥臭。
english: And they put them together in masses, and a bad smell went up from the land.

chinese: 但法老見災禍鬆緩，就硬著心，不肯聽他們，正如耶和華所說的。
english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was peace for a time, he made his heart hard and did not give ear to them, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：你對亞倫說：伸出你的杖擊打地上的塵土，使塵土在埃及遍地變作虱子（或譯：虼蚤；下同）。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to Aaron, Let your rod be stretched out over the dust of the earth so that it may become insects through all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 他們就這樣行。亞倫伸杖擊打地上的塵土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子；埃及遍地的塵土都變成虱子了。
english: And they did so; and Aaron, stretching out the rod in his hand, gave a touch to the dust of the earth, and insects came on man and on beast; all the dust of the earth was changed into insects through all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 行法術的也用邪術要生出虱子來，卻是不能。於是在人身上和牲畜身上都有了虱子。
english: And the wonder-workers with their secret arts, attempting to make insects, were unable to do so: and there were insects on man and on beast.

chinese: 行法術的就對法老說：這是神的手段。法老心裡剛硬，不肯聽摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
english: Then the wonder-workers said to Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: but Pharaoh's heart was hard, and he did not give ear to them, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你清早起來，法老來到水邊，你站在他面前，對他說：耶和華這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Get up early in the morning and take your place before Pharaoh when he comes out to the water; and say to him, This is what the Lord says: Let my people go to give me worship.

chinese: 你若不容我的百姓去，我要叫成群的蒼蠅到你和你臣僕並你百姓的身上，進你的房屋，並且埃及人的房屋和他們所住的地都要滿了成群的蒼蠅。
english: For if you do not let my people go, see, I will send clouds of flies on you and on your servants and on your people and into their houses; and the houses of the Egyptians and the land where they are will be full of flies.

chinese: 當那日，我必分別我百姓所住的歌珊地，使那裡沒有成群的蒼蠅，好叫你知道我是天下的耶和華。
english: And at that time I will make a division between your land and the land of Goshen where my people are, and no flies will be there; so that you may see that I am the Lord over all the earth.

chinese: 我要將我的百姓和你的百姓分別出來。明天必有這神蹟。
english: And I will put a division between my people and your people; tomorrow this sign will be seen.

chinese: 耶和華就這樣行。蒼蠅成了大群，進入法老的宮殿，和他臣僕的房屋；埃及遍地就因這成群的蒼蠅敗壞了。
english: And the Lord did so; and great clouds of flies came into the house of Pharaoh and into his servants' houses, and all the land of Egypt was made waste because of the flies.

chinese: 法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：你們去，在這地祭祀你們的神罷！
english: And Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron and said, Go and make your offering to your God here in the land.

chinese: 摩西說：這樣行本不相宜，因為我們要把埃及人所厭惡的祭祀耶和華─我們的神；若把埃及人所厭惡的在他們眼前獻為祭，他們豈不拿石頭打死我們麼？
english: And Moses said, It is not right to do so; for we make our offerings of that to which the Egyptians give worship; and if we do so before their eyes, certainly we will be stoned.

chinese: 我們要往曠野去，走三天的路程，照著耶和華─我們神所要吩咐我們的祭祀他。
english: But we will go three days' journey into the waste land and make an offering to the Lord our God as he may give us orders.

chinese: 法老說：我容你們去，在曠野祭祀耶和華─你們的神；只是不要走得很遠。求你們為我祈禱。
english: Then Pharaoh said, I will let you go to make an offering to the Lord your God in the waste land; but do not go very far away, and make prayer for me.

chinese: 摩西說：我要出去求耶和華，使成群的蒼蠅明天離開法老和法老的臣僕並法老的百姓；法老卻不可再行詭詐，不容百姓去祭祀耶和華。
english: And Moses said, When I go out from you I will make prayer to the Lord that the cloud of flies may go away from Pharaoh and from his people and from his servants tomorrow: only let Pharaoh no longer by deceit keep back the people from making their offering to the Lord.

chinese: 於是摩西離開法老去求耶和華。
english: Then Moses went out from Pharaoh and made prayer to the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華就照摩西的話行，叫成群的蒼蠅離開法老和他的臣僕並他的百姓，一個也沒有留下。
english: And the Lord did as Moses said, and took away the cloud of flies from Pharaoh and from his servants and from his people; not one was to be seen.

chinese: 這一次法老又硬著心，不容百姓去。
english: But again Pharaoh made his heart hard and did not let the people go.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：你進去見法老，對他說：耶和華─希伯來人的神這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
english: Then the Lord said to Moses, Go in to Pharaoh and say to him, This is what the Lord, the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go so that they may give me worship.

chinese: 你若不肯容他們去，仍舊強留他們，
english: For if you will not let them go, but still keep them in your power,

chinese: 耶和華的手加在你田間的牲畜上，就是在馬、驢、駱駝、牛群、羊群上，必有重重的瘟疫。
english: Then the hand of the Lord will put on your cattle in the field, on the horses and the asses and the camels, on the herds and the flocks, a very evil disease.

chinese: 耶和華要分別以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜，凡屬以色列人的，一樣都不死。
english: And the Lord will make a division between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt; there will be no loss of any of the cattle of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華就定了時候，說：明天耶和華必在此地行這事。
english: And the time was fixed by the Lord, and he said, Tomorrow the Lord will do this thing in the land.

chinese: 第二天，耶和華就行這事。埃及的牲畜幾乎都死了，只是以色列人的牲畜，一個都沒有死。
english: And on the day after, the Lord did as he had said, causing the death of all the cattle of Egypt, but there was no loss of any of the cattle of Israel.

chinese: 法老打發人去看，誰知以色列人的牲畜連一個都沒有死。法老的心卻是固執，不容百姓去。
english: And Pharaoh sent and got word that there was no loss of any of the cattle of Israel. But the heart of Pharaoh was hard and he did not let the people go.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西、亞倫說：你們取幾捧爐灰，摩西要在法老面前向天揚起來。
english: And the Lord said to Moses and to Aaron, Take in your hand a little dust from the fire and let Moses send it in a shower up to heaven before the eyes of Pharaoh.

chinese: 這灰要在埃及全地變作塵土，在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的瘡。
english: And it will become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and will be a skin-disease bursting out in wounds on man and beast through all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫取了爐灰，站在法老面前。摩西向天揚起來，就在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的瘡。
english: So they took some dust from the fire, and placing themselves before Pharaoh, Moses sent it out in a shower up to heaven; and it became a skin-disease bursting out on man and on beast.

chinese: 行法術的在摩西面前站立不住，因為在他們身上和一切埃及人身上都有這瘡。
english: And the wonder-workers were not able to take their places before Moses, because of the disease; for the disease was on the wonder-workers and on all the Egyptians.

chinese: 耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不聽他們，正如耶和華對摩西所說的。
english: And the Lord made Pharaoh's heart hard, and he would not give ear to them, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你清早起來，站在法老面前，對他說：耶和華─希伯來人的神這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Get up early in the morning and take your place before Pharaoh, and say to him, This is what the Lord, the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go so that they may give me worship.

chinese: 因為這一次我要叫一切的災殃臨到你和你臣僕並你百姓的身上，叫你知道在普天下沒有像我的。
english: For this time I will send all my punishments on yourself and on your servants and on your people; so that you may see that there is no other like me in all the earth.

chinese: 我若伸手用瘟疫攻擊你和你的百姓，你早就從地上除滅了。
english: For if I had put the full weight of my hand on you and your people, you would have been cut off from the earth:

chinese: 其實，我叫你存立，是特要向你顯我的大能，並要使我的名傳遍天下。
english: But, for this very reason, I have kept you from destruction, to make clear to you my power, and so that my name may be honoured through all the earth.

chinese: 你還向我的百姓自高，不容他們去麼？
english: Are you still uplifted in pride against my people so that you will not let them go?

chinese: 到明天約在這時候，我必叫重大的冰雹降下，自從埃及開國以來，沒有這樣的冰雹。
english: Truly, tomorrow about this time I will send down an ice-storm, such as never was in Egypt from its earliest days till now.

chinese: 現在你要打發人把你的牲畜和你田間一切所有的催進來；凡在田間不收回家的，無論是人是牲畜，冰雹必降在他們身上，他們就必死。
english: Then send quickly and get in your cattle and all you have from the fields; for if any man or beast in the field has not been put under cover, the ice-storm will come down on them with destruction.

chinese: 法老的臣僕中，懼怕耶和華這話的，便叫他的奴僕和牲畜跑進家來。
english: Then everyone among the servants of Pharaoh who had the fear of the Lord, made his servants and his cattle come quickly into the house:

chinese: 但那不把耶和華這話放在心上的，就將他的奴僕和牲畜留在田裡。
english: And he who gave no attention to the word of the Lord, kept his servants and his cattle in the field.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你向天伸杖，使埃及遍地的人身上和牲畜身上，並田間各樣菜蔬上，都有冰雹。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Now let your hand be stretched out to heaven so that there may be an ice-storm on all the land of Egypt, on man and on beast and on every plant of the field through all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 摩西向天伸杖，耶和華就打雷下雹，有火閃到地上；耶和華下雹在埃及地上。
english: And Moses put out his rod to heaven: and the Lord sent thunder, and an ice-storm, and fire running down on the earth; the Lord sent an ice-storm on the land of Egypt.

chinese: 那時，雹與火攙雜，甚是利害，自從埃及成國以來，遍地沒有這樣的。
english: So there was an ice-storm with fire running through it, coming down with great force, such as never was in all the land of Egypt from the time when it became a nation.

chinese: 在埃及遍地，雹擊打了田間所有的人和牲畜，並一切的菜蔬，又打壞田間一切的樹木。
english: And through all the land of Egypt the ice-storm came down on everything which was in the fields, on man and on beast; and every green plant was crushed and every tree of the field broken.

chinese: 惟獨以色列人所住的歌珊地沒有冰雹。
english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no ice-storm.

chinese: 法老打發人召摩西、亞倫來，對他們說：這一次我犯了罪了。耶和華是公義的；我和我的百姓是邪惡的。
english: Then Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, I have done evil this time: the Lord is upright, and I and my people are sinners.

chinese: 這雷轟和冰雹已經夠了。請你們求耶和華，我就容你們去，不再留住你們。
english: Make prayer to the Lord; for there has been enough of these thunderings of God and this ice-storm; and I will let you go and will keep you no longer.

chinese: 摩西對他說：我一出城，就要向耶和華舉手禱告；雷必止住，也不再有冰雹，叫你知道全地都是屬耶和華的。
english: And Moses said, When I am gone outside the town, my hands will be stretched out to the Lord; the thunders and the ice-storm will come to an end, so that you may see that the earth is the Lord's.

chinese: 至於你和你的臣僕，我知道你們還是不懼怕耶和華神。
english: But as for you and your servants, I am certain that even now the fear of the Lord God will not be in your hearts.

chinese: 那時，麻和大麥被雹擊打；因為大麥已經吐穗，麻也開了花。
english: And the flax and the barley were damaged, for the barley was almost ready to be cut and the flax was in flower.

chinese: 只是小麥和粗麥沒有被擊打，因為還沒有長成。）
english: But the rest of the grain-plants were undamaged, for they had not come up.

chinese: 摩西離了法老出城，向耶和華舉手禱告；雷和雹就止住，雨也不再澆在地上了。
english: So Moses went out of the town, and stretching out his hands made prayer to God: and the thunders and the ice-storm came to an end; and the fall of rain was stopped.

chinese: 法老見雨和雹與雷止住，就越發犯罪；他和他的臣僕都硬著心。
english: But when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the ice-storm and the thunders were ended, he went on sinning, and made his heart hard, he and his servants.

chinese: 法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人去，正如耶和華藉著摩西所說的。
english: And the heart of Pharaoh was hard, and he did not let the people go, as the Lord had said by the mouth of Moses.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你進去見法老。我使他和他臣僕的心剛硬，為要在他們中間顯我這些神蹟，
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go in to Pharaoh: for I have made his heart and the hearts of his servants hard, so that I may let my signs be seen among them:

chinese: 並要叫你將我向埃及人所做的事，和在他們中間所行的神蹟，傳於你兒子和你孫子的耳中，好叫你們知道我是耶和華。
english: And so that you may be able to give to your son and to your son's son the story of my wonders in Egypt, and the signs which I have done among them; so that you may see that I am the Lord.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫就進去見法老，對他說：耶和華─希伯來人的神這樣說：你在我面前不肯自卑要到幾時呢？容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
english: Then Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, This is what the Lord, the God of the Hebrews, says: How long will you be lifted up in your pride before me? let my people go so that they may give me worship.

chinese: 你若不肯容我的百姓去，明天我要使蝗蟲進入你的境內，
english: For if you will not let my people go, tomorrow I will send locusts into your land:

chinese: 遮滿地面，甚至看不見地，並且吃那冰雹所剩的和田間所長的一切樹木。
