english: And the face of the earth will be covered with them, so that you will not be able to see the earth: and they will be the destruction of everything which up to now has not been damaged, everything which was not crushed by the ice-storm, and every tree still living in your fields.

chinese: 你的宮殿和你眾臣僕的房屋，並一切埃及人的房屋，都要被蝗蟲佔滿了；自從你祖宗和你祖宗的祖宗在世以來，直到今日，沒有見過這樣的災。摩西就轉身離開法老出去。
english: And your houses will be full of them, and the houses of your servants and of all the Egyptians; it will be worse than anything your fathers have seen or their fathers, from the day when they were living on the earth till this day. And so he went out from Pharaoh.

chinese: 法老的臣僕對法老說：這人為我們的網羅要到幾時呢？容這些人去事奉耶和華─他們的神罷！埃及已經敗壞了，你還不知道麼？
english: And Pharaoh's servants said to him, How long is this man to be the cause of evil to us? let the men go so that they may give worship to the Lord their God: are you not awake to Egypt's danger?

chinese: 於是摩西、亞倫被召回來見法老；法老對他們說：你們去事奉耶和華─你們的神；但那要去的是誰呢？
english: Then Moses and Aaron came in again before Pharaoh: and he said to them, Go and give worship to the Lord your God: but which of you are going?

chinese: 摩西說：我們要和我們老的少的、兒子女兒同去，且把羊群牛群一同帶去，因為我們務要向耶和華守節。
english: And Moses said, We will go with our young and our old, with our sons and our daughters, with our flocks and our herds; for we are to keep a feast to the Lord.

chinese: 法老對他們說：我容你們和你們婦人孩子去的時候，耶和華與你們同在罷！你們要謹慎；因為有禍在你們眼前（或作：你們存著惡意），
english: And he said to them, May the Lord be with you, if I will let you and your little ones go! take care, for your purpose clearly is evil.

chinese: 不可都去！你們這壯年人去事奉耶和華罷，因為這是你們所求的。於是把他們從法老面前攆出去。
english: Not so; but let your males go and give worship to the Lord, as your desire is. This he said, driving them out from before him.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你向埃及地伸杖，使蝗蟲到埃及地上來，吃地上一切的菜蔬，就是冰雹所剩的。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Let your hand be stretched out over the land of Egypt so that the locusts may come up on the land for the destruction of every green plant in the land, even everything untouched by the ice-storm.

chinese: 摩西就向埃及地伸杖，那一晝一夜，耶和華使東風颳在埃及地上；到了早晨，東風把蝗蟲颳了來。
english: And Moses' rod was stretched out over the land of Egypt, and the Lord sent an east wind over the land all that day and all the night; and in the morning the locusts came up with the east wind.

chinese: 蝗蟲上來，落在埃及的四境，甚是厲害；以前沒有這樣的，以後也必沒有。
english: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, resting on every part of the land, in very great numbers; such an army of locusts had never been seen before, and never will be again.

chinese: 因為這蝗蟲遮滿地面，甚至地都黑暗了，又吃地上一切的菜蔬和冰雹所剩樹上的果子。埃及遍地，無論是樹木，是田間的菜蔬，連一點青的也沒有留下。
english: For all the face of the earth was covered with them, so that the land was black; and every green plant and all the fruit of the trees which was untouched by the ice-storm they took for food: not one green thing, no plant or tree, was to be seen in all the land of Egypt.

chinese: 於是法老急忙召了摩西、亞倫來，說：我得罪耶和華─你們的神，又得罪了你們。
english: Then Pharaoh quickly sent for Moses and Aaron, and said, I have done evil against the Lord your God and against you.

chinese: 現在求你，只這一次，饒恕我的罪，求耶和華─你們的神使我脫離這一次的死亡。
english: Let me now have forgiveness for my sin this time only, and make prayer to the Lord your God that he will take away from me this death only.

chinese: 摩西就離開法老去求耶和華。
english: So he went out from Pharaoh and made prayer to the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華轉了極大的西風，把蝗蟲颳起，吹入紅海；在埃及的四境連一個也沒有留下。
english: And the Lord sent a very strong west wind, which took up the locusts, driving them into the Red Sea; not one locust was to be seen in any part of Egypt.

chinese: 但耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人去。
english: But the Lord made Pharaoh's heart hard, and he did not let the children of Israel go.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你向天伸杖，使埃及地黑暗；這黑暗似乎摸得著。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Let your hand be stretched out to heaven, and all the land of Egypt will be dark, so that men will be feeling their way about in the dark.

chinese: 摩西向天伸杖，埃及遍地就烏黑了三天。
english: And when Moses' hand was stretched out, dark night came over all the land of Egypt for three days;

chinese: 三天之久，人不能相見，誰也不敢起來離開本處；惟有以色列人家中都有亮光。
english: They were not able to see one another, and no one got up from his place for three days: but where the children of Israel were living it was light.

chinese: 法老就召摩西來，說：你們去事奉耶和華；只是你們的羊群牛群要留下；你們的婦人孩子可以和你們同去。
english: Then Pharaoh sent for Moses, and said, Go and give worship to the Lord; only let your flocks and your herds be kept here: your little ones may go with you.

chinese: 摩西說：你總要把祭物和燔祭牲交給我們，使我們可以祭祀耶和華─我們的神。
english: But Moses said, You will have to let us take burned offerings to put before the Lord our God.

chinese: 我們的牲畜也要帶去，連一蹄也不留下；因為我們要從其中取出來，事奉耶和華─我們的神。我們未到那裡，還不知道用甚麼事奉耶和華。
english: So our cattle will have to go with us, not one may be kept back; for they are needed for the worship of the Lord our God; we have no knowledge what offering we have to give till we come to the place.

chinese: 但耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不肯容他們去。
english: But the Lord made Pharaoh's heart hard, and he would not let them go.

chinese: 法老對摩西說：你離開我去罷，你要小心，不要再見我的面！因為你見我面的那日你就必死！
english: And Pharaoh said to him, Go away from me, take care that you come not again before me; for the day when you see my face again will be your last.

chinese: 摩西說：你說得好！我必不再見你的面了。
english: And Moses said, You say truly; I will not see your face again.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：我再使一樣的災殃臨到法老和埃及，然後他必容你們離開這地。他容你們去的時候，總要催逼你們都從這地出去。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, I will send one more punishment on Pharaoh and on Egypt; after that he will let you go; and when he does let you go, he will not keep one of you back, but will send you out by force.

chinese: 你要傳於百姓的耳中，叫他們男女各人向鄰舍要金器銀器。
english: So go now and give orders to the people that every man and every woman is to get from his or her neighbour ornaments of silver and of gold.

chinese: 耶和華叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，並且摩西在埃及地、法老臣僕，和百姓的眼中看為極大。
english: And the Lord gave the people grace in the eyes of the Egyptians. For the man Moses was highly honoured in the land of Egypt, by Pharaoh's servants and the people.

chinese: 摩西說：耶和華這樣說：約到半夜，我必出去巡行埃及遍地。
english: And Moses said, This is what the Lord says: About the middle of the night I will go out through Egypt:

chinese: 凡在埃及地，從坐寶座的法老直到磨子後的婢女所有的長子，以及一切頭生的牲畜，都必死。
english: And death will come to every mother's first male child in all the land of Egypt, from the child of Pharaoh on his seat of power, to the child of the servant-girl crushing the grain; and the first births of all the cattle.

chinese: 埃及遍地必有大哀號；從前沒有這樣的，後來也必沒有。
english: And there will be a great cry through all the land of Egypt, such as never has been or will be again.

chinese: 至於以色列中，無論是人是牲畜，連狗也不敢向他們搖舌，好叫你們知道耶和華是將埃及人和以色列人分別出來。
english: But against the children of Israel, man or beast, not so much as the tongue of a dog will be moved: so that you may see how the Lord makes a division between Israel and the Egyptians.

chinese: 你這一切臣僕都要俯伏來見我，說：求你和跟從你的百姓都出去，然後我要出去。於是，摩西氣忿忿的離開法老，出去了。
english: And all these your servants will come to me, going down on their faces before me and saying, Go out, and all your people with you: and after that I will go out. And he went away from Pharaoh burning with wrath.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：法老必不聽你們，使我的奇事在埃及地多起來。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Pharaoh will not give ear to you, so that my wonders may be increased in the land of Egypt.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫在法老面前行了這一切奇事；耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人出離他的地。
english: All these wonders Moses and Aaron did before Pharaoh: but the Lord made Pharaoh's heart hard, and he did not let the children of Israel go out of his land.

chinese: 耶和華在埃及地曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt,

chinese: 你們要以本月為正月，為一年之首。
english: Let this month be to you the first of months, the first month of the year.

chinese: 你們吩咐以色列全會眾說：本月初十日，各人要按著父家取羊羔，一家一隻。
english: Say to all the children of Israel when they are come together, In the tenth day of this month every man is to take a lamb, by the number of their fathers' families, a lamb for every family:

chinese: 若是一家的人太少，吃不了一隻羊羔，本人就要和他隔壁的鄰舍共取一隻。你們預備羊羔，要按著人數和飯量計算。
english: And if the lamb is more than enough for the family, let that family and its nearest neighbour have a lamb between them, taking into account the number of persons and how much food is needed for every man.

chinese: 要無殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，你們或從綿羊裡取，或從山羊裡取，都可以。
english: Let your lamb be without a mark, a male in its first year: you may take it from among the sheep or the goats:

chinese: 要留到本月十四日，在黃昏的時候，以色列全會眾把羊羔宰了。
english: Keep it till the fourteenth day of the same month, when everyone who is of the children of Israel is to put it to death between sundown and dark.

chinese: 各家要取點血，塗在吃羊羔的房屋左右的門框上和門楣上。
english: Then take some of the blood and put it on the two sides of the door and over the door of the house where the meal is to be taken.

chinese: 當夜要吃羊羔的肉；用火烤了，與無酵餅和苦菜同吃。
english: And let your food that night be the flesh of the lamb, cooked with fire in the oven, together with unleavened bread and bitter-tasting plants.

chinese: 不可吃生的，斷不可吃水煮的，要帶著頭、腿、五臟，用火烤了吃。
english: Do not take it uncooked or cooked with boiling water, but let it be cooked in the oven; its head with its legs and its inside parts.

chinese: 不可剩下一點留到早晨；若留到早晨，要用火燒了。
english: Do not keep any of it till the morning; anything which is not used is to be burned with fire.

chinese: 你們吃羊羔當腰間束帶，腳上穿鞋，手中拿杖，趕緊的吃；這是耶和華的逾越節。
english: And take your meal dressed as if for a journey, with your shoes on your feet and your sticks in your hands: take it quickly: it is the Lord's Passover.

chinese: 因為那夜我要巡行埃及地，把埃及地一切頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都擊殺了，又要敗壞埃及一切的神。我是耶和華。
english: For on that night I will go through the land of Egypt, sending death on every first male child, of man and of beast, and judging all the gods of Egypt: I am the Lord.

chinese: 這血要在你們所住的房屋上作記號；我一見這血，就越過你們去。我擊殺埃及地頭生的時候，災殃必不臨到你們身上滅你們。
english: And the blood will be a sign on the houses where you are: when I see the blood I will go over you, and no evil will come on you for your destruction, when my hand is on the land of Egypt.

chinese: 你們要記念這日，守為耶和華的節，作為你們世世代代永遠的定例。
english: And this day is to be kept in your memories: you are to keep it as a feast to the Lord through all your generations, as an order for ever.

chinese: 你們要吃無酵餅七日。頭一日要把酵從你們各家中除去；因為從頭一日起，到第七日為止，凡吃有酵之餅的，必從以色列中剪除。
english: For seven days let your food be unleavened bread; from the first day no leaven is to be seen in your houses: whoever takes bread with leaven in it, from the first till the seventh day, will be cut off from Israel.

chinese: 頭一日你們當有聖會，第七日也當有聖會。這兩日之內，除了預備各人所要吃的以外，無論何工都不可做。
english: And on the first day there is to be a holy meeting and on the seventh day a holy meeting; no sort of work may be done on those days but only to make ready what is necessary for everyone's food.

chinese: 你們要守無酵節，因為我正當這日把你們的軍隊從埃及地領出來。所以，你們要守這日，作為世世代代永遠的定例。
english: So keep the feast of unleavened bread; for on this very day I have taken your armies out of the land of Egypt: this day, then, is to be kept through all your generations by an order for ever.

chinese: 從正月十四日晚上，直到二十一日晚上，你們要吃無酵餅。
english: In the first month, from the evening of the fourteenth day, let your food be unleavened bread till the evening of the twenty-first day of the month.

chinese: 在你們各家中，七日之內不可有酵；因為凡吃有酵之物的，無論是寄居的，是本地的，必從以色列的會中剪除。
english: For seven days no leaven is to be seen in your houses: for whoever takes bread which is leavened will be cut off from the people of Israel, if he is from another country or if he is an Israelite by birth.

chinese: 有酵的物，你們都不可吃；在你們一切住處要吃無酵餅。
english: Take nothing which has leaven in it; wherever you are living let your food be unleavened cakes.

chinese: 於是，摩西召了以色列的眾長老來，對他們說：你們要按著家口取出羊羔，把這逾越節的羊羔宰了。
english: Then Moses sent for the chiefs of Israel, and said to them, See that lambs are marked out for yourselves and your families, and let the Passover lamb be put to death.

chinese: 拿一把牛膝草，蘸盆裡的血，打在門楣上和左右的門框上。你們誰也不可出自己的房門，直到早晨。
english: And take some hyssop and put it in the blood in the basin, touching the two sides and the top of the doorway with the blood from the basin; and let not one of you go out of his house till the morning.

chinese: 因為耶和華要巡行擊殺埃及人，他看見血在門楣上和左右的門框上，就必越過那門，不容滅命的進你們的房屋，擊殺你們。
english: For the Lord will go through the land, sending death on the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the two sides and the top of the door, the Lord will go over your door and will not let death come in for your destruction.

chinese: 這例，你們要守著，作為你們和你們子孫永遠的定例。
english: And you are to keep this as an order to you and to your sons for ever.

chinese: 日後，你們到了耶和華按著所應許賜給你們的那地，就要守這禮。
english: And when you come into the land which the Lord will make yours, as he gave his word, you are to keep this act of worship.

chinese: 你們的兒女問你們說：行這禮是甚麼意思？
english: And when your children say to you, What is the reason of this act of worship?

chinese: 你們就說：這是獻給耶和華逾越節的祭。當以色列人在埃及的時候，他擊殺埃及人，越過以色列人的房屋，救了我們各家。於是百姓低頭下拜。
english: Then you will say, This is the offering of the Lord's Passover; for he went over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he sent death on the Egyptians, and kept our families safe. And the people gave worship with bent heads.

chinese: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西、亞倫，以色列人就怎樣行。
english: And the children of Israel went and did so; as the Lord had given orders to Moses and Aaron, so they did.

chinese: 到了半夜，耶和華把埃及地所有的長子，就是從坐寶座的法老，直到被擄囚在監裡之人的長子，以及一切頭生的牲畜，盡都殺了。
english: And in the middle of the night the Lord sent death on every first male child in the land of Egypt, from the child of Pharaoh on his seat of power to the child of the prisoner in the prison; and the first births of all the cattle.

chinese: 法老和一切臣僕，並埃及眾人，夜間都起來了。在埃及有大哀號，無一家不死一個人的。
english: Then Pharaoh got up in the night, he and all his servants and all the Egyptians; and a great cry went up from Egypt; for there was not a house where someone was not dead.

chinese: 夜間，法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：起來！連你們帶以色列人，從我民中出去，依你們所說的，去事奉耶和華罷！
english: And he sent for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Get up and go out from among my people, you and the children of Israel; go and give worship to the Lord as you have said.

chinese: 也依你們所說的，連羊群牛群帶著走罷！並要為我祝福。
english: And take your flocks and your herds as you have said, and be gone; and give me your blessing.

chinese: 埃及人催促百姓，打發他們快快出離那地，因為埃及人說：我們都要死了。
english: And the Egyptians were forcing the people on, to get them out of the land quickly; for they said, We are all dead men.

chinese: 百姓就拿著沒有酵的生麵，把摶麵盆包在衣服中，扛在肩頭上。
english: And the people took their bread-paste before it was leavened, putting their basins in their clothing on their backs.

chinese: 以色列人照著摩西的話行，向埃及人要金器、銀器，和衣裳。
english: And the children of Israel had done as Moses had said; and they got from the Egyptians ornaments of silver and of gold, and clothing:

chinese: 耶和華叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，以致埃及人給他們所要的。他們就把埃及人的財物奪去了。
english: And the Lord had given the people grace in the eyes of the Egyptians so that they gave them whatever was requested. So they took away all their goods from the Egyptians.

chinese: 以色列人從蘭塞起行，往疏割去；除了婦人孩子，步行的男人約有六十萬。
english: And the children of Israel made the journey from Rameses to Succoth; there were about six hundred thousand men on foot, as well as children.

chinese: 又有許多閒雜人，並有羊群牛群，和他們一同上去。
english: And a mixed band of people went with them; and flocks and herds in great numbers.

chinese: 他們用埃及帶出來的生麵烤成無酵餅。這生麵原沒有發起；因為他們被催逼離開埃及，不能耽延，也沒有為自己預備甚麼食物。
english: And they made unleavened cakes from the paste which they had taken out of Egypt; it was not leavened, for they had been sent out of Egypt so quickly, that they had no time to make any food ready.

chinese: 以色列人住在埃及共有四百三十年。
english: Now the children of Israel had been living in Egypt for four hundred and thirty years.

chinese: 正滿了四百三十年的那一天，耶和華的軍隊都從埃及地出來了。
english: And at the end of four hundred and thirty years, to the very day, all the armies of the Lord went out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 這夜是耶和華的夜；因耶和華領他們出了埃及地，所以當向耶和華謹守，是以色列眾人世世代代該謹守的。
english: It is a watch-night before the Lord who took them out of the land of Egypt: this same night is a watch-night to the Lord for all the children of Israel, through all their generations.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：逾越節的例是這樣：外邦人都不可吃這羊羔。
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, This is the law of the Passover: no man who is not an Israelite is to take of it:

chinese: 但各人用銀子買的奴僕，既受了割禮就可以吃。
english: But every man's servant, whom he has got for money, may take of it, when he has had circumcision.

chinese: 寄居的和雇工人都不可吃。
english: A man from a strange country living among you, and a servant working for payment, may not take part in it.

chinese: 應當在一個房子裡吃；不可把一點肉從房子裡帶到外頭去。羊羔的骨頭一根也不可折斷。
english: It is to be taken in one house; not a bit of the flesh is to be taken out of the house, and no bone of it may be broken.

chinese: 以色列全會眾都要守這禮。
english: All Israel is to keep the feast.

chinese: 若有外人寄居在你們中間，願向耶和華守逾越節，他所有的男子務要受割禮，然後才容他前來遵守，他也就像本地人一樣；但未受割禮的，都不可吃這羊羔。
english: And if a man from another country is living with you, and has a desire to keep the Passover to the Lord, let all the males of his family undergo circumcision, and then let him come near and keep it; for he will then be as one of your people; but no one without circumcision may keep it.

chinese: 本地人和寄居在你們中間的外人同歸一例。
english: The law is the same for him who is an Israelite by birth and for the man from a strange country who is living with you.

chinese: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西、亞倫，以色列眾人就怎樣行了。
english: So the children of Israel did as the Lord gave orders to Moses and Aaron.

chinese: 正當那日，耶和華將以色列人按著他們的軍隊，從埃及地領出來。
english: And on that very day the Lord took the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 以色列中凡頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都是我的，要分別為聖歸我。
english: Let the first male child of every mother among the children of Israel be kept holy for me, even the first male birth among man or beast; for it is mine.

chinese: 摩西對百姓說：你們要記念從埃及為奴之家出來的這日，因為耶和華用大能的手將你們從這地方領出來。有酵的餅都不可吃。
english: And Moses said to the people, Let this day, on which you came out of Egypt, out of your prison-house, be kept for ever in memory; for by the strength of his hand the Lord has taken you out from this place; let no leavened bread be used.

chinese: 亞筆月間的這日是你們出來的日子。
english: On this day, in the month Abib, you are going out.

chinese: 將來耶和華領你進迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、希未人、耶布斯人之地，就是他向你的祖宗起誓應許給你那流奶與蜜之地，那時你要在這月間守這禮。
english: And it will be that, when the Lord takes you into the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, the land which he made an oath to your fathers that he would give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, you will do this act of worship in this month.

chinese: 你要吃無酵餅七日，到第七日要向耶和華守節。
english: For seven days let your food be unleavened cakes; and on the seventh day there is to be a feast to the Lord.

chinese: 這七日之久，要吃無酵餅；在你四境之內不可見有酵的餅，也不可見發酵的物。
english: Unleavened cakes are to be your food through all the seven days; let no leavened bread be seen among you, or any leaven, in any part of your land.

chinese: 當那日，你要告訴你的兒子說：這是因耶和華在我出埃及的時候為我所行的事。
english: And you will say to your son in that day, It is because of what the Lord did for me when I came out of Egypt.

chinese: 這要在你手上作記號，在你額上作紀念，使耶和華的律法常在你口中，因為耶和華曾用大能的手將你從埃及領出來。
english: And this will be for a sign to you on your hand and for a mark on your brow, so that the law of the Lord may be in your mouth: for with a strong hand the Lord took you out of Egypt.

chinese: 所以你每年要按著日期守這例。
english: So let this order be kept, at the right time, from year to year.

chinese: 將來，耶和華照他向你和你祖宗所起的誓將你領進迦南人之地，把這地賜給你，
english: And when the Lord takes you into the land of Canaan, as he made his oath to you and to your fathers, and gives it to you,

chinese: 那時你要將一切頭生的，並牲畜中頭生的，歸給耶和華；公的都要屬耶和華。
english: You are to put on one side for the Lord every mother's first male child, the first-fruit of her body, and the first young one of every beast; every male is holy to the Lord.

chinese: 凡頭生的驢，你要用羊羔代贖；若不代贖，就要打折他的頸項。凡你兒子中頭生的都要贖出來。
english: And for the young of an ass you may give a lamb in payment, or if you will not make payment for it, its neck is to be broken; but for all the first sons among your children, let payment be made.

chinese: 日後，你的兒子問你說：這是甚麼意思？你就說：耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及為奴之家領出來。
english: And when your son says to you in time to come, What is the reason for this? say to him, By the strength of his hand the Lord took us out of Egypt, out of the prison-house:

chinese: 那時法老幾乎不容我們去，耶和華就把埃及地所有頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都殺了。因此，我把一切頭生的公牲畜獻給耶和華為祭，但將頭生的兒子都贖出來。
english: And when Pharaoh made his heart hard and would not let us go, the Lord sent death on all the first sons in Egypt, of man and of beast: and so every first male who comes to birth is offered to the Lord; but for all the first of my sons I give a price.

chinese: 這要在你手上作記號，在你額上作經文，因為耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及領出來。
english: And this will be for a sign on your hand and for a mark on your brow: for by the strength of his hand the Lord took us out of Egypt.

chinese: 法老容百姓去的時候，非利士地的道路雖近，神卻不領他們從那裡走；因為　神說：恐怕百姓遇見打仗後悔，就回埃及去。
english: Now after Pharaoh had let the people go, God did not take them through the land of the Philistines, though that was near: for God said, If the people see war, they may have a change of heart and go back to Egypt.

chinese: 所以神領百姓繞道而行，走紅海曠野的路。以色列人出埃及地，都帶著兵器上去。
english: But God took the people round by the waste land near the Red Sea: and the children of Israel went up in fighting order out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 摩西把約瑟的骸骨一同帶去；因為約瑟曾叫以色列人嚴嚴地起誓，對他們說：神必眷顧你們，你們要把我的骸骨從這裡一同帶上去。
english: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for Joseph had made the children of Israel take an oath, saying, God will certainly keep you in mind; and you are to take my bones away with you.

chinese: 他們從疏割起行，在曠野邊的以倘安營。
english: Then they went on their journey from Succoth, and put up their tents in Etham at the edge of the waste land.

chinese: 日間，耶和華在雲柱中領他們的路；夜間，在火柱中光照他們，使他們日夜都可以行走。
english: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, guiding them on their way; and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light: so that they were able to go on day and night:

chinese: 日間雲柱，夜間火柱，總不離開百姓的面前。
english: The pillar of cloud went ever before them by day, and the pillar of fire by night.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐以色列人轉回，安營在比哈希錄前，密奪和海的中間，對著巴力洗分，靠近海邊安營。
english: Give orders to the children of Israel to go back and put up their tents before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, in front of Baal-zephon, opposite to which you are to put up your tents by the sea.

chinese: 法老必說：以色列人在地中繞迷了，曠野把他們困住了。
english: And Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are wandering without direction, they are shut in by the waste land.

chinese: 我要使法老的心剛硬，他要追趕他們，我便在法老和他全軍身上得榮耀；埃及人就知道我是耶和華。於是以色列人這樣行了。
english: And I will make Pharaoh's heart hard, and he will come after them and I will be honoured over Pharaoh and all his army, so that the Egyptians may see that I am the Lord. And they did so.

chinese: 有人告訴埃及王說：百姓逃跑。法老和他的臣僕就向百姓變心，說：我們容以色列人去，不再服事我們，這做的是甚麼事呢？
english: And word came to Pharaoh of the flight of the people: and the feeling of Pharaoh and of his servants about the people was changed, and they said, Why have we let Israel go, so that they will do no more work for us?

chinese: 法老就預備他的車輛，帶領軍兵同去，
english: So he had his war-carriage made ready and took his people with him:

chinese: 並帶著六百輛特選的車和埃及所有的車，每輛都有車兵長。
english: And he took six hundred carriages, all the carriages of Egypt, and captains over all of them.

chinese: 耶和華使埃及王法老的心剛硬，他就追趕以色列人，因為以色列人是昂然無懼地出埃及。
english: And the Lord made the heart of Pharaoh hard, and he went after the children of Israel: for the children of Israel had gone out without fear.

chinese: 埃及人追趕他們，法老一切的馬匹、車輛、馬兵，與軍兵就在海邊上，靠近比哈希錄，對著巴力洗分，在他們安營的地方追上了。
english: But the Egyptians went after them, all the horses and carriages of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them in their tents by the sea, by Pihahiroth, before Baal-zephon.

chinese: 法老臨近的時候，以色列人舉目看見埃及人趕來，就甚懼怕，向耶和華哀求。
english: And when Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel, lifting up their eyes, saw the Egyptians coming after them, and were full of fear; and their cry went up to God.

chinese: 他們對摩西說：難道在埃及沒有墳地，你把我們帶來死在曠野麼？你為甚麼這樣待我們，將我們從埃及領出來呢？
english: And they said to Moses, Was there no resting-place for the dead in Egypt, that you have taken us away to come to our death in the waste land? why have you taken us out of Egypt?

chinese: 我們在埃及豈沒有對你說過，不要攪擾我們，容我們服事埃及人麼？因為服事埃及人比死在曠野還好。
english: Did we not say to you in Egypt, Let us be as we are, working for the Egyptians? for it is better to be the servants of the Egyptians than to come to our death in the waste land.

chinese: 摩西對百姓說：不要懼怕，只管站住！看耶和華今天向你們所要施行的救恩。因為，你們今天所看見的埃及人必永遠不再看見了。
english: But Moses said, Keep where you are and have no fear; now you will see the salvation of the Lord which he will give you today; for the Egyptians whom you see today you will never see again.

chinese: 耶和華必為你們爭戰；你們只管靜默，不要作聲。
english: The Lord will make war for you, you have only to keep quiet.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你為甚麼向我哀求呢？你吩咐以色列人往前走。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Why are you crying out to me? give the children of Israel the order to go forward.

chinese: 你舉手向海伸杖，把水分開。以色列人要下海中走乾地。
english: And let your rod be lifted up and your hand stretched out over the sea, and it will be parted in two; and the children of Israel will go through on dry land.

chinese: 我要使埃及人的心剛硬，他們就跟著下去。我要在法老和他的全軍、車輛、馬兵上得榮耀。
english: And I will make the heart of the Egyptians hard, and they will go in after them: and I will be honoured over Pharaoh and over his army, his war-carriages, and his horsemen.

chinese: 我在法老和他的車輛、馬兵上得榮耀的時候，埃及人就知道我是耶和華了。
english: And the Egyptians will see that I am the Lord, when I get honour over Pharaoh and his war-carriages and his horsemen.

chinese: 在以色列營前行走神的使者，轉到他們後邊去；雲柱也從他們前邊轉到他們後邊立住。
english: Then the angel of God, who had been before the tents of Israel, took his place at their back; and the pillar of cloud, moving from before them, came to rest at their back:

chinese: 在埃及營和以色列營中間有雲柱，一邊黑暗，一邊發光，終夜兩下不得相近。
english: And it came between the army of Egypt and the army of Israel; and there was a dark cloud between them, and they went on through the night; but the one army came no nearer to the other all the night.

chinese: 摩西向海伸杖，耶和華便用大東風，使海水一夜退去，水便分開，海就成了乾地。
english: And when Moses' hand was stretched out over the sea, the Lord with a strong east wind made the sea go back all night, and the waters were parted in two and the sea became dry land.

chinese: 以色列人下海中走乾地，水在他們的左右作了牆垣。
english: And the children of Israel went through the sea on dry land: and the waters were a wall on their right side and on their left.

chinese: 埃及人追趕他們，法老一切的馬匹、車輛，和馬兵都跟著下到海中。
english: Then the Egyptians went after them into the middle of the sea, all Pharaoh's horses and his war-carriages and his horsemen.

chinese: 到了晨更的時候，耶和華從雲火柱中向埃及的軍兵觀看，使埃及的軍兵混亂了；
english: And in the morning watch, the Lord, looking out on the armies of the Egyptians from the pillar of fire and cloud, sent trouble on the army of the Egyptians;

chinese: 又使他們的車輪脫落難以行走，以致埃及人說：我們從以色列人面前逃跑罷！因耶和華為他們攻擊我們了
english: And made the wheels of their war-carriages stiff, so that they had hard work driving them: so the Egyptians said, Let us go in flight from before the face of Israel, for the Lord is fighting for them against the Egyptians.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你向海伸杖，叫水仍合在埃及人並他們的車輛、馬兵身上。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Let your hand be stretched out over the sea, and the waters will come back again on the Egyptians, and on their war-carriages and on their horsemen.

chinese: 摩西就向海伸杖，到了天一亮，海水仍舊復原。埃及人避水逃跑的時候，耶和華把他們推翻在海中，
english: And when Moses' hand was stretched out over the sea, at dawn the sea came flowing back, meeting the Egyptians in their flight, and the Lord sent destruction on the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

chinese: 水就回流，淹沒了車輛和馬兵。那些跟著以色列人下海法老的全軍，連一個也沒有剩下。
english: And the waters came back, covering the war-carriages and the horsemen and all the army of Pharaoh which went after them into the middle of the sea; not one of them was to be seen.

chinese: 以色列人卻在海中走乾地；水在他們的左右作了牆垣。
english: But the children of Israel went through the sea walking on dry land, and the waters were a wall on their right side and on their left.

chinese: 當日，耶和華這樣拯救以色列人脫離埃及人的手，以色列人看見埃及人的死屍都在海邊了。
english: So that day the Lord gave Israel salvation from the hands of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the sea's edge.

chinese: 以色列人看見耶和華向埃及人所行的大事，就敬畏耶和華，又信服他和他的僕人摩西。
english: And Israel saw the great work which the Lord had done against the Egyptians, and the fear of the Lord came on the people and they had faith in the Lord and in his servant Moses.

chinese: 那時，摩西和以色列人向耶和華唱歌說：我要向耶和華歌唱，因他大大戰勝，將馬和騎馬的投在海中。
english: Then Moses and the children of Israel made this song to the Lord, and said, I will make a song to the Lord, for he is lifted up in glory: the horse and the horseman he has sent down into the sea.

chinese: 耶和華是我的力量，我的詩歌，也成了我的拯救。這是我的神，我要讚美他，是我父親的　神，我要尊崇他。
english: The Lord is my strength and my strong helper, he has become my salvation: he is my God and I will give him praise; my father's God and I will give him glory.

chinese: 耶和華是戰士；他的名是耶和華。
english: The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name.

chinese: 法老的車輛、軍兵，耶和華已拋在海中；他特選的軍長都沉於紅海。
english: Pharaoh's war-carriages and his army he has sent down into the sea: the best of his captains have gone down into the Red Sea.

chinese: 深水淹沒他們；他們如同石頭墜到深處。
english: They were covered by the deep waters: like a stone they went down under the waves.

chinese: 耶和華阿，你的右手施展能力，顯出榮耀；耶和華阿，你的右手摔碎仇敵。
english: Full of glory, O Lord, is the power of your right hand; by your right hand those who came against you are broken.

chinese: 你大發威嚴，推翻那些起來攻擊你的；你發出烈怒如火，燒滅他們像燒碎一樣。
english: When you are lifted up in power, all those who come against you are crushed: when you send out your wrath, they are burned up like dry grass.

chinese: 你發鼻中的氣，水便聚起成堆，大水直立如壘，海中的深水凝結。
english: By your breath the waves were massed together, the flowing waters were lifted up like a pillar; the deep waters became solid in the heart of the sea.

chinese: 仇敵說：我要追趕，我要追上；我要分擄物，我要在他們身上稱我的心願。我要拔出刀來，親手殺滅他們。
english: Egypt said, I will go after them, I will overtake, I will make division of their goods: my desire will have its way with them; my sword will be uncovered, my hand will send destruction on them.

chinese: 你叫風一吹，海就把他們淹沒；他們如鉛沉在大水之中。
english: You sent your wind and the sea came over them: they went down like lead into the great waters.

chinese: 耶和華阿，眾神之中，誰能像你？誰能像你─至聖至榮，可頌可畏，施行奇事？
english: Who is like you, O Lord, among the gods? who is like you, in holy glory, to be praised with fear, doing wonders?

chinese: 你伸出右手，地便吞滅他們。
english: When your right hand was stretched out, the mouth of the earth was open for them.

chinese: 你憑慈愛領了你所贖的百姓；你憑能力引他們到了你的聖所。
english: In your mercy you went before the people whom you have made yours; guiding them in your strength to your holy place.

chinese: 外邦人聽見就發顫；疼痛抓住非利士的居民。
english: Hearing of you the peoples were shaking in fear: the people of Philistia were gripped with pain.

chinese: 那時，以東的族長驚惶，摩押的英雄被戰兢抓住，迦南的居民心都消化了。
english: The chiefs of Edom were troubled in heart; the strong men of Moab were in the grip of fear: all the people of Canaan became like water.

chinese: 驚駭恐懼臨到他們。耶和華阿，因你膀臂的大能，他們如石頭寂然不動，等候你的百姓過去，等候你所贖的百姓過去。
english: Fear and grief came on them; by the strength of your arm they were turned to stone; till your people went over, O Lord, till the people went over whom you have made yours.

chinese: 你要將他們領進去，栽於你產業的山上─耶和華阿，就是你為自己所造的住處；主阿，就是你手所建立的聖所。
english: You will take them in, planting them in the mountain of your heritage, the place, O Lord, where you have made your house, the holy place, O Lord, the building of your hands.

chinese: 耶和華必作王，直到永永遠遠！
english: The Lord is King for ever and ever.

chinese: 法老的馬匹、車輛，和馬兵下到海中，耶和華使海水回流，淹沒他們；惟有以色列人在海中走乾地。
english: For the horses of Pharaoh, with his war-carriages and his horsemen, went into the sea, and the Lord sent the waters of the sea back over them; but the children of Israel went through the sea on dry land.

chinese: 亞倫的姊姊，女先知米利暗，手裡拿著鼓；眾婦女也跟他出去拿鼓跳舞。
english: And Miriam, the woman prophet, the sister of Aaron, took an instrument of music in her hand; and all the women went after her with music and dances.

chinese: 米利暗應聲說：你們要歌頌耶和華，因他大大戰勝，將馬和騎馬的投在海中。
english: And Miriam, answering, said, Make a song to the Lord, for he is lifted up in glory; the horse and the horseman he has sent into the sea.

chinese: 摩西領以色列人從紅海往前行，到了書珥的曠野，在曠野走了三天，找不著水。
english: Then Moses took Israel forward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the waste land of Shur; and for three days they were in the waste land where there was no water.

chinese: 到了瑪拉，不能喝那裡的水；因為水苦，所以那地名叫瑪拉。
english: And when they came to Marah, the water was no good for drinking, for the waters of Marah were bitter, which is why it was named Marah.

chinese: 百姓就向摩西發怨言，說：我們喝甚麼呢？
english: And the people, crying out against Moses, said, What are we to have for drink?

chinese: 摩西呼求耶和華，耶和華指示他一棵樹。他把樹丟在水裡，水就變甜了。耶和華在那裡為他們定了律例、典章，在那裡試驗他們；
english: And in answer to his prayer, the Lord made him see a tree, and when he put it into the water, the water was made sweet. There he gave them a law and an order, testing them;

chinese: 又說：你若留意聽耶和華─你神的話，又行我眼中看為正的事，留心聽我的誡命，守我一切的律例，我就不將所加與埃及人的疾病加在你身上，因為我─耶和華是醫治你的。
english: And he said, If with all your heart you will give attention to the voice of the Lord your God, and do what is right in his eyes, giving ear to his orders and keeping his laws, I will not put on you any of the diseases which I put on the Egyptians: for I am the Lord your life-giver.

chinese: 他們到了以琳，在那裡有十二股水泉，七十棵棕樹；他們就在那裡的水邊安營。
english: And they came to Elim where there were twelve water-springs and seventy palm-trees: and they put up their tents there by the waters.

chinese: 以色列全會眾從以琳起行，在出埃及後第二個月十五日到了以琳和西乃中間、汛的曠野。
english: And they went on their way from Elim, and all the children of Israel came into the waste land of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they went out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 以色列全會眾在曠野向摩西、亞倫發怨言，
english: And all the children of Israel were crying out against Moses and Aaron in the waste land:

chinese: 說：巴不得我們早死在埃及地、耶和華的手下；那時我們坐在肉鍋旁邊，吃得飽足。你們將我們領出來，到這曠野，是要叫這全會眾都餓死阿！
english: And the children of Israel said to them, It would have been better for the Lord to have put us to death in the land of Egypt, where we were seated by the flesh-pots and had bread enough for our needs; for you have taken us out to this waste of sand, to put all this people to death through need of food.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：我要將糧食從天降給你們。百姓可以出去，每天收每天的分，我好試驗他們遵不遵我的法度。
english: Then the Lord said to Moses, See, I will send down bread from heaven for you; and the people will go out every day and get enough for the day's needs; so that I may put them to the test to see if they will keep my laws or not.

chinese: 到第六天，他們要把所收進來的預備好了，比每天所收的多一倍。
english: And on the sixth day they are to make ready what they get in, and it will be twice as much as they get on the other days.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫對以色列眾人說：到了晚上，你們要知道是耶和華將你們從埃及地領出來的。
english: And Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, This evening it will be clear to you that it is the Lord who has taken you out of the land of Egypt:

chinese: 早晨，你們要看見耶和華的榮耀，因為耶和華聽見你們向他所發的怨言了。我們算甚麼，你們竟向我們發怨言呢？
english: And in the morning you will see the glory of the Lord; for your angry words against the Lord have come to his ears: and what are we that you are crying out against us?

chinese: 摩西又說：耶和華晚上必給你們肉吃，早晨必給你們食物得飽；因為你們向耶和華發的怨言，他都聽見了。我們算甚麼，你們的怨言不是向我們發的，乃是向耶和華發的。
english: And Moses said, The Lord will give you meat for your food at evening, and in the morning bread in full measure; for your outcry against the Lord has come to his ears: for what are we? your outcry is not against us but against the Lord.

chinese: 摩西對亞倫說：你告訴以色列全會眾說：你們就近耶和華面前，因為他已經聽見你們的怨言了。
english: And Moses said to Aaron, Say to all the people of Israel, Come near before the Lord for he has given ear to your outcry.

chinese: 亞倫正對以色列全會眾說話的時候，他們向曠野觀看，不料，耶和華的榮光在雲中顯現。
english: And while Aaron was talking to the children of Israel, their eyes were turned in the direction of the waste land, and they saw the glory of the Lord shining in the cloud.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 我已經聽見以色列人的怨言。你告訴他們說：到黃昏的時候，你們要吃肉，早晨必有食物得飽，你們就知道我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: The outcry of the children of Israel has come to my ears: say to them now, At nightfall you will have meat for your food, and in the morning bread in full measure; and you will see that I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 到了晚上，有鵪鶉飛來，遮滿了營；早晨在營四圍的地上有露水。
english: And it came about that in the evening little birds came up and the place was covered with them: and in the morning there was dew all round about the tents.

chinese: 露水上升之後，不料，野地面上有如白霜的小圓物。
english: And when the dew was gone, on the face of the earth was a small round thing, like small drops of ice on the earth.

chinese: 以色列人看見，不知道是甚麼，就彼此對問說：這是甚麼呢？摩西對他們說：這就是耶和華給你們吃的食物。
english: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, What is it? for they had no idea what it was. And Moses said to them, It is the bread which the Lord has given you for your food.

chinese: 耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：你們要按著各人的飯量，為帳棚裡的人，按著人數收起來，各拿一俄梅珥。
english: This is what the Lord has said, Let every man take up as much as he has need of; at the rate of one omer for every person, let every man take as much as is needed for his family.

chinese: 以色列人就這樣行；有多收的，有少收的。
english: And the children of Israel did so, and some took more and some less.

chinese: 及至用俄梅珥量一量，多收的也沒有餘，少收的也沒有缺；各人按著自己的飯量收取。
english: And when it was measured, he who had taken up much had nothing over, and he who had little had enough; every man had taken what he was able to make use of.

chinese: 摩西對他們說：所收的，不許甚麼人留到早晨。
english: And Moses said to them, Let nothing be kept till the morning.

chinese: 然而他們不聽摩西的話，內中有留到早晨的，就生蟲變臭了；摩西便向他們發怒。
english: But they gave no attention to Moses, and some of them kept it till the morning and there were worms in it and it had an evil smell: and Moses was angry with them.

chinese: 他們每日早晨，按著各人的飯量收取，日頭一發熱，就消化了。
english: And they took it up morning by morning, every man as he had need: and when the sun was high it was gone.

chinese: 到第六天，他們收了雙倍的食物，每人兩俄梅珥。會眾的官長來告訴摩西；
english: And on the sixth day they took up twice as much of the bread, two omers for every person: and all the rulers of the people gave Moses word of it.

chinese: 摩西對他們說：耶和華這樣說：明天是聖安息日，是向耶和華守的聖安息日。你們要烤的就烤了，要煮的就煮了，所剩下的都留到早晨。
english: And he said, This is what the Lord has said, Tomorrow is a day of rest, a holy Sabbath to the Lord: what has to be cooked may be cooked; and what is over, put on one side to be kept till the morning.

chinese: 他們就照摩西的吩咐留到早晨，也不臭，裡頭也沒有蟲子。
english: And they kept it till the morning as Moses had said: and no smell came from it, and it had no worms.

chinese: 摩西說：你們今天吃這個罷！因為今天是向耶和華守的安息日；你們在田野必找不著了。
english: And Moses said, Make your meal today of what you have, for this day is a Sabbath to the Lord: today you will not get any in the fields.

chinese: 六天可以收取，第七天乃是安息日，那一天必沒有了。
english: For six days you will get it, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will not be any.

chinese: 第七天，百姓中有人出去收，甚麼也找不著。
english: But still on the seventh day some of the people went out to get it, and there was not any.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你們不肯守我的誡命和律法，要到幾時呢？
english: And the Lord said to Moses, How long will you go against my orders and my laws?

chinese: 你們看！耶和華既將安息日賜給你們，所以第六天他賜給你們兩天的食物，第七天各人要住在自己的地方，不許甚麼人出去。
english: See, because the Lord has given you the Sabbath, he gives you on the sixth day bread enough for two days; let every man keep where he is; let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

chinese: 於是百姓第七天安息了。
english: So the people took their rest on the seventh day.

chinese: 這食物，以色列家叫嗎哪；樣子像芫荽子，顏色是白的，滋味如同攙蜜的薄餅。
english: And this bread was named manna by Israel: it was white, like a grain seed, and its taste was like cakes made with honey.

chinese: 摩西說：耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：要將一滿俄梅珥俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一）嗎哪留到世世代代，使後人可以看見我當日將你們領出埃及地，在曠野所給你們吃的食物。
english: And Moses said, This is the order which the Lord has given: Let one omer of it be kept for future generations, so that they may see the bread which I gave you for your food in the waste land, when I took you out from the land of Egypt.

chinese: 摩西對亞倫說：你拿一個罐子，盛一滿俄梅珥嗎哪，存在耶和華面前，要留到世世代代。
english: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a pot and put one omer of manna in it, and put it away before the Lord, to be kept for future generations.

chinese: 耶和華怎麼吩咐摩西，亞倫就怎麼行，把嗎哪放在法櫃前存留。
english: So Aaron put it away in front of the holy chest to be kept, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 以色列人吃嗎哪共四十年，直到進了有人居住之地，就是迦南的境界。
english: And the children of Israel had manna for their food for forty years, till they came to a land with people in it, till they came to the edge of the land of Canaan.

chinese: 俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一。
english: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

chinese: 以色列全會眾都遵耶和華的吩咐，按著站口從汛的曠野往前行，在利非訂安營。百姓沒有水喝，
english: And the children of Israel went on from the waste land of Sin, by stages as the Lord gave them orders, and put up their tents in Rephidim: and there was no drinking-water for the people.

chinese: 所以與摩西爭鬧，說：給我們水喝罷！摩西對他們說：你們為甚麼與我爭鬧？為甚麼試探耶和華呢？
english: So the people were angry with Moses, and said, Give us water for drinking. And Moses said, Why are you angry with me? and why do you put God to the test?

chinese: 百姓在那裡甚渴，要喝水，就向摩西發怨言，說：你為甚麼將我們從埃及領出來，使我們和我們的兒女並牲畜都渴死呢？
english: And the people were in great need of water; and they made an outcry against Moses, and said, Why have you taken us out of Egypt to send death on us and our children and our cattle through need of water?

chinese: 摩西就呼求耶和華說：我向這百姓怎樣行呢？他們幾乎要拿石頭打死我。
english: And Moses, crying out to the Lord, said, What am I to do to this people? they are almost ready to put me to death by stoning.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你手裡拿著你先前擊打河水的杖，帶領以色列的幾個長老，從百姓面前走過去。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go on before the people, and take some of the chiefs of Israel with you, and take in your hand the rod which was stretched out over the Nile, and go.

chinese: 我必在何烈的磐石那裡，站在你面前。你要擊打磐石，從磐石裡必有水流出來，使百姓可以喝。摩西就在以色列的長老眼前這樣行了。
english: See, I will take my place before you on the rock in Horeb; and when you give the rock a blow, water will come out of it, and the people will have drink. And Moses did so before the eyes of the chiefs of Israel.

chinese: 他給那地方起名叫瑪撒（就是試探的意思），又叫米利巴（就是爭鬧的意思）；因以色列人爭鬧，又因他們試探耶和華，說：耶和華是在我們中間不是？
english: And he gave that place the name Massah and Meribah, because the children of Israel were angry, and because they put the Lord to the test, saying, Is the Lord with us or not?

chinese: 那時，亞瑪力人來在利非訂，和以色列人爭戰。
english: Then Amalek came and made war on Israel in Rephidim.

chinese: 摩西對約書亞說：你為我們選出人來，出去和亞瑪力人爭戰。明天我手裡要拿著神的杖，站在山頂上。
english: And Moses said to Joshua, Get together a band of men for us and go out, make war on Amalek: tomorrow I will take my place on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.

chinese: 於是約書亞照著摩西對他所說的話行，和亞瑪力人爭戰。摩西、亞倫，與戶珥都上了山頂。
english: So Joshua did as Moses said to him, and went to war with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

chinese: 摩西何時舉手，以色列人就得勝，何時垂手，亞瑪力人就得勝。
english: Now while Moses' hand was lifted up, Israel was the stronger: but when he let his hand go down, Amalek became the stronger.

chinese: 但摩西的手發沉，他們就搬石頭來，放在他以下，他就坐在上面。亞倫與戶珥扶著他的手，一個在這邊，一個在那邊，他的手就穩住，直到日落的時候。
english: But Moses' hands became tired; so they put a stone under him and he took his seat on it, Aaron and Hur supporting his hands, one on one side and one on the other; so his hands were kept up without falling till the sun went down.

chinese: 約書亞用刀殺了亞瑪力王和他的百姓。
english: And Joshua overcame Amalek and his people with the sword.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：我要將亞瑪力的名號從天下全然塗抹了；你要將這話寫在書上作紀念，又念給約書亞聽。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Make a record of this in a book, so that it may be kept in memory, and say it again in the ears of Joshua: that all memory of Amalek is to be completely uprooted from the earth.

chinese: 摩西築了一座壇，起名叫耶和華尼西（就是耶和華是我旌旗的意思），
english: Then Moses put up an altar and gave it the name of Yahweh-nissi:

chinese: 又說：耶和華已經起了誓，必世世代代和亞瑪力人爭戰。
english: For he said, The Lord has taken his oath that there will be war with Amalek from generation to generation.

chinese: 摩西的岳父，米甸祭司葉忒羅，聽見神為摩西和神的百姓以色列所行的一切事，就是耶和華將以色列從埃及領出來的事，
english: Now news came to Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father-in-law, of all God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, and how the Lord had taken Israel out of Egypt.

chinese: 便帶著摩西的妻子西坡拉，就是摩西從前打發回去的，
english: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her away,

chinese: 又帶著西坡拉的兩個兒子，一個名叫革舜，因為摩西說：我在外邦作了寄居的；
english: And her two sons, one of whom was named Gershom, for he said, I have been living in a strange land:

chinese: 一個名叫以利以謝因為他說：我父親的神幫助了我，救我脫離法老的刀。
english: And the name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, The God of my father was my help, and kept me safe from the sword of Pharaoh:

chinese: 摩西的岳父葉忒羅帶著摩西的妻子和兩個兒子來到神的山，就是摩西在曠野安營的地方。
english: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to where Moses had put up his tent in the waste land, by the mountain of God.

chinese: 他對摩西說：我是你岳父葉忒羅，帶著你的妻子和兩個兒子來到你這裡。
english: And he said to Moses, I, your father-in-law, have come to you, with your wife and your two sons.

chinese: 摩西迎接他的岳父，向他下拜，與他親嘴，彼此問安，都進了帳棚。
english: And Moses went out to his father-in-law, and went down on his face before him and gave him a kiss; and they said to one another, Are you well? and they came into the tent.

chinese: 摩西將耶和華為以色列的緣故向法老和埃及人所行的一切事，以及路上所遭遇的一切艱難，並耶和華怎樣搭救他們，都述說與他岳父聽。
english: And Moses gave his father-in-law an account of all the Lord had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians because of Israel, and of all the troubles which had come on them by the way, and how the Lord had given them salvation.

chinese: 葉忒羅因耶和華待以色列的一切好處，就是拯救他們脫離埃及人的手，便甚歡喜。
english: And Jethro was glad because the Lord had been good to Israel, freeing them from the power of the Egyptians.

chinese: 葉忒羅說：耶和華是應當稱頌的；他救了你們脫離埃及人和法老的手，將這百姓從埃及人的手下救出來。
english: And Jethro said, Praise be to the Lord, who has taken you out of the hand of Pharaoh and out of the hand of the Egyptians; freeing the people from the yoke of the Egyptians.

chinese: 我現今在埃及人向這百姓發狂傲的事上得知，耶和華比萬神都大。
english: Now I am certain that the Lord is greater than all gods, for he has overcome them in their pride.

chinese: 摩西的岳父葉忒羅把燔祭和平安祭獻給神。亞倫和以色列的眾長老都來了，與摩西的岳父在　神面前吃飯。
english: Then Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, made a burned offering to God: and Aaron came, with the chiefs of Israel, and had a meal with Moses' father-in-law, before God.

chinese: 第二天，摩西坐著審判百姓，百姓從早到晚都站在摩西的左右。
english: Now on the day after, Moses took his seat to give decisions for the people: and the people were waiting before Moses from morning till evening.

chinese: 摩西的岳父看見他向百姓所做的一切事，就說：你向百姓做的是甚麼事呢？你為甚麼獨自坐著，眾百姓從早到晚都站在你的左右呢？
english: And when Moses' father-in-law saw all he was doing, he said, What is this you are doing for the people? why are you seated here by yourself, with all the people waiting before you from morning till evening?

chinese: 摩西對岳父說：這是因百姓到我這裡來求問神。
english: And Moses said to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to get directions from God:

chinese: 他們有事的時候就到我這裡來，我便在兩造之間施行審判；我又叫他們知道神的律例和法度。
english: And if they have any question between themselves, they come to me, and I am judge between a man and his neighbour, and I give them the orders and laws of God.

chinese: 摩西的岳父說：你這做的不好。
english: And Moses' father-in-law said to him, What you are doing is not good.

chinese: 你和這些百姓必都疲憊；因為這事太重，你獨自一人辦理不了。
english: Your strength and that of the people will be completely used up: this work is more than you are able to do by yourself.

chinese: 現在你要聽我的話。我為你出個主意，願神與你同在。你要替百姓到神面前，將案件奏告　神；
english: Give ear now to my suggestion, and may God be with you: you are to be the people's representative before God, taking their causes to him:

chinese: 又要將律例和法度教訓他們，指示他們當行的道，當做的事；
english: Teaching them his rules and his laws, guiding them in the way they have to go, and making clear to them the work they have to do.

chinese: 並要從百姓中揀選有才能的人，就是敬畏神、誠實無妄、恨不義之財的人，派他們作千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長，管理百姓，
english: But for the rest, take from among the people able men, such as have the fear of God, true men hating profits wrongly made; and put such men over them, to be captains of thousands, captains of hundreds and of fifties and of tens;

chinese: 叫他們隨時審判百姓，大事都要呈到你這裡，小事他們自己可以審判。這樣，你就輕省些，他們也可以同當此任。
english: And let them be judges in the causes of the people at all times: and let them put before you all important questions, but in small things let them give decisions themselves: in this way, it will be less hard for you, and they will take the weight off you.

chinese: 你若這樣行，神也這樣吩咐你，你就能受得住，這百姓也都平平安安歸回他們的住處。
english: If you do this, and God gives approval, then you will be able to go on without weariness, and all this people will go to their tents in peace.

chinese: 於是，摩西聽從他岳父的話，按著他所說的去行。
english: So Moses took note of the words of his father-in-law, and did as he had said.

chinese: 摩西從以色列人中揀選了有才能的人，立他們為百姓的首領，作千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長。
english: And he made selection of able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds and of fifties and of tens.

chinese: 他們隨時審判百姓，有難斷的案件就呈到摩西那裡，但各樣小事他們自己審判。
english: And they were judges in the causes of the people at all times: the hard questions they put before Moses; but on every small point they gave decisions themselves.

chinese: 此後，摩西讓他的岳父去，他就往本地去了。
english: And Moses let his father-in-law go away, and he went back to his land.

chinese: 以色列人出埃及地以後，滿了三個月的那一天，就來到西乃的曠野。
english: In the third month after the children of Israel went out from Egypt, on the same day, they came into the waste land of Sinai.

chinese: 他們離了利非訂，來到西乃的曠野，就在那裡的山下安營。
english: And when they had gone away from Rephidim and had come into the waste land of Sinai, they put up their tents in the waste land before the mountain: there Israel put up its tents.

chinese: 摩西到神那裡，耶和華從山上呼喚他說：你要這樣告訴雅各家，曉諭以色列人說：
english: And Moses went up to God, and the voice of the Lord came to him from the mountain, saying, Say to the family of Jacob, and give word to the children of Israel:

chinese: 我向埃及人所行的事，你們都看見了，且看見我如鷹將你們背在翅膀上，帶來歸我。
english: You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I took you, as on eagles' wings, guiding you to myself.

chinese: 如今你們若實在聽從我的話，遵守我的約，就要在萬民中作屬我的子民，因為全地都是我的。
english: If now you will truly give ear to my voice and keep my agreement, you will be my special property out of all the peoples: for all the earth is mine:

chinese: 你們要歸我作祭司的國度，為聖潔的國民。這些話你要告訴以色列人。
english: And you will be a kingdom of priests to me, and a holy nation. These are the words which you are to say to the children of Israel.

chinese: 摩西去召了民間的長老來，將耶和華所吩咐他的話都在他們面前陳明。
english: And Moses came and sent for the chiefs of the people and put before them all these words which the Lord had given him orders to say.

chinese: 百姓都同聲回答說：凡耶和華所說的，我們都要遵行。摩西就將百姓的話回覆耶和華。
english: And all the people, answering together, said, Whatever the Lord has said we will do. And Moses took back to the Lord the words of the people.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：我要在密雲中臨到你那裡，叫百姓在我與你說話的時候可以聽見，也可以永遠信你了。於是，摩西將百姓的話奏告耶和華。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, See, I will come to you in a thick cloud, so that what I say to you may come to the ears of the people and they may have belief in you for ever. And Moses gave the Lord word of what the people had said.

chinese: 耶和華又對摩西說：你往百姓那裡去，叫他們今天明天自潔，又叫他們洗衣服。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go to the people and make them holy today and tomorrow, and let their clothing be washed.

chinese: 到第三天要預備好了，因為第三天耶和華要在眾百姓眼前降臨在西乃山上。
english: And by the third day let them be ready: for on the third day the Lord will come down on Mount Sinai, before the eyes of all the people.

chinese: 你要在山的四圍給百姓定界限，說：你們當謹慎，不可上山去，也不可摸山的邊界；凡摸這山的，必要治死他。
english: And let limits be marked out for the people round the mountain, and say to them, Take care not to go up the mountain or near the sides of it: whoever puts his foot on the mountain will certainly come to his death:

chinese: 不可用手摸他，必用石頭打死，或用箭射透；無論是人是牲畜，都不得活。到角聲拖長的時候，他們才可到山根來。
english: He is not to be touched by a hand, but is to be stoned or have an arrow put through him; man or beast, he is to be put to death: at the long sounding of a horn they may come up to the mountain.

chinese: 摩西下山往百姓那裡去，叫他們自潔，他們就洗衣服。
english: Then Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and made the people holy; and their clothing was washed.

chinese: 他對百姓說：到第三天要預備好了。不可親近女人。
english: And he said to the people, Be ready by the third day: do not come near a woman.

chinese: 到了第三天早晨，在山上有雷轟、閃電，和密雲，並且角聲甚大，營中的百姓盡都發顫。
english: And when morning came on the third day, there were thunders and flames and a thick cloud on the mountain, and a horn sounding very loud; and all the people in the tents were shaking with fear.

chinese: 摩西率領百姓出營迎接神，都站在山下。
english: And Moses made the people come out of their tents and take their places before God; and they came to the foot of the mountain,

chinese: 西乃全山冒煙，因為耶和華在火中降於山上。山的煙氣上騰，如燒窯一般，遍山大大的震動。
english: And all the mountain of Sinai was smoking, for the Lord had come down on it in fire: and the smoke of it went up like the smoke of a great burning; and all the mountain was shaking.

chinese: 角聲漸漸的高而又高，摩西就說話，神有聲音答應他。
english: And when the sound of the horn became louder and louder, Moses' words were answered by the voice of God.

chinese: 耶和華降臨在西乃山頂上，耶和華召摩西上山頂，摩西就上去。
english: Then the Lord came down on to Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain, and the Lord sent for Moses to come up to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你下去囑咐百姓，不可闖過來到我面前觀看，恐怕他們有多人死亡；
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go down and give the people orders to keep back, for fear that a great number of them, forcing their way through to see the Lord, may come to destruction.

chinese: 又叫親近我的祭司自潔，恐怕我忽然出來擊殺他們。
english: And let the priests who come near to the Lord make themselves holy, for fear that the Lord may come on them suddenly.

chinese: 摩西對耶和華說：百姓不能上西乃山，因為你已經囑咐我們說：要在山的四圍定界限，叫山成聖。
english: And Moses said to the Lord, The people will not be able to come up the mountain, for you gave us orders to put limits round the mountain, marking it out and making it holy.

chinese: 耶和華對他說：下去罷，你要和亞倫一同上來；只是祭司和百姓不可闖過來上到我面前，恐怕我忽然出來擊殺他們。
english: And the Lord said to him, Go down, and you and Aaron may come up; but let not the priests and the people make their way through to the Lord, or he will come on them suddenly.

chinese: 於是摩西下到百姓那裡告訴他們。
english: So Moses went down to the people and said this to them.

chinese: 神吩咐這一切的話說：
english: And God said all these words:

chinese: 我是耶和華─你的神，曾將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來。
english: I am the Lord your God who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.

chinese: 除了我以外，你不可有別的神。
english: You are to have no other gods but me.

chinese: 不可為自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚麼形像彷彿上天、下地，和地底下、水中的百物。
english: You are not to make an image or picture of anything in heaven or on the earth or in the waters under the earth:

chinese: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉他，因為我耶和華─你的神是忌邪的　神。恨我的，我必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代；
english: You may not go down on your faces before them or give them worship: for I, the Lord your God, am a God who will not give his honour to another; and I will send punishment on the children for the wrongdoing of their fathers, to the third and fourth generation of my haters;

chinese: 愛我、守我誡命的，我必向他們發慈愛，直到千代。
english: And I will have mercy through a thousand generations on those who have love for me and keep my laws.

chinese: 不可妄稱耶和華─你神的名；因為妄稱耶和華名的，耶和華必不以他為無罪。
english: You are not to make use of the name of the Lord your God for an evil purpose; whoever takes the Lord's name on his lips for an evil purpose will be judged a sinner by the Lord

chinese: 當記念安息日，守為聖日。
english: Keep in memory the Sabbath and let it be a holy day.

chinese: 六日要勞碌做你一切的工，
english: On six days do all your work:

chinese: 但第七日是向耶和華─你神當守的安息日。這一日你和你的兒女、僕婢、牲畜，並你城裡寄居的客旅，無論何工都不可做；
english: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God; on that day you are to do no work, you or your son or your daughter, your man-servant or your woman-servant, your cattle or the man from a strange country who is living among you:

chinese: 因為六日之內，耶和華造天、地、海，和其中的萬物，第七日便安息，所以耶和華賜福與安息日，定為聖日。
english: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and the sea, and everything in them, and he took his rest on the seventh day: for this reason the Lord has given his blessing to the seventh day and made it holy.

chinese: 當孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和華─你神所賜你的地上得以長久。
english: Give honour to your father and to your mother, so that your life may be long in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

chinese: 不可殺人。
english: Do not put anyone to death without cause.

chinese: 不可姦淫。
english: Do not be false to the married relation.

chinese: 不可偷盜。
english: Do not take the property of another.

chinese: 不可作假見證陷害人。
english: Do not give false witness against your neighbour.

chinese: 不可貪戀人的房屋；也不可貪戀人的妻子、僕婢、牛驢，並他一切所有的。
english: Let not your desire be turned to your neighbour's house, or his wife or his man-servant or his woman-servant or his ox or his ass or anything which is his.

chinese: 眾百姓見雷轟、閃電、角聲、山上冒煙，就都發顫，遠遠的站立，
english: And all the people were watching the thunderings and the flames and the sound of the horn and the mountain smoking; and when they saw it, they kept far off, shaking with fear.

chinese: 對摩西說：求你和我們說話，我們必聽；不要神和我們說話，恐怕我們死亡。
english: And they said to Moses, To your words we will give ear, but let not the voice of God come to our ears, for fear death may come on us.

chinese: 摩西對百姓說：不要懼怕；因為神降臨是要試驗你們，叫你們時常敬畏他，不致犯罪。
english: And Moses said to the people, Have no fear: for God has come to put you to the test, so that fearing him you may be kept from sin.

chinese: 於是百姓遠遠地站立；摩西就挨近神所在的幽暗之中。
english: And the people kept their places far off, but Moses went near to the dark cloud where God was.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你要向以色列人這樣說：你們自己看見我從天上和你們說話了。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You yourselves have seen that my voice has come to you from heaven

chinese: 你們不可做甚麼神像與我相配，不可為自己做金銀的　神像。
english: Gods of silver and gods of gold you are not to make for yourselves.

chinese: 你要為我築土壇，在上面以牛羊獻為燔祭和平安祭。凡記下我名的地方，我必到那裡賜福給你。
english: Make for me an altar of earth, offering on it your burned offerings and your peace-offerings, your sheep and your oxen: in every place where I have put the memory of my name, I will come to you and give you my blessing.

chinese: 你若為我築一座石壇，不可用鑿成的石頭，因你在上頭一動家具，就把壇污穢了。
english: And if you make me an altar of stone do not make it of cut stones: for the touch of an instrument will make it unclean.

chinese: 你上我的壇，不可用臺階，免得露出你的下體來。
english: And do not go up by steps to my altar, for fear that your bodies may be seen uncovered.

chinese: 你在百姓面前所要立的典章是這樣：
english: Now these are the laws which you are to put before them.

chinese: 你若買希伯來人作奴僕，他必服事你六年；第七年他可以自由，白白的出去。
english: If you get a Hebrew servant for money, he is to be your servant for six years, and in the seventh year you are to let him go free without payment.

chinese: 他若孤身來就可以孤身去；他若有妻，他的妻就可以同他出去。
english: If he comes to you by himself, let him go away by himself: if he is married, let his wife go away with him.

chinese: 他主人若給他妻子，妻子給他生了兒子或女兒，妻子和兒女要歸主人，他要獨自出去。
english: If his master gives him a wife, and he gets sons or daughters by her, the wife and her children will be the property of the master, and the servant is to go away by himself.

chinese: 倘或奴僕明說：我愛我的主人和我的妻子兒女，不願意自由出去。
english: But if the servant says clearly, My master and my wife and children are dear to me; I have no desire to be free:

chinese: 他的主人就要帶他到審判官（審判官或作：神；下同）那裡，又要帶他到門前，靠近門框，用錐子穿他的耳朵，他就永遠服事主人。
english: Then his master is to take him to the gods of the house, and at the door, or at its framework, he is to make a hole in his ear with a sharp-pointed instrument; and he will be his servant for ever.

chinese: 人若賣女兒作婢女，婢女不可像男僕那樣出去。
english: And if a man gives his daughter for a price to be a servant, she is not to go away free as the men-servants do.

chinese: 主人選定他歸自己，若不喜歡他，就要許他贖身；主人既然用詭詐待他，就沒有權柄賣給外邦人。
english: If she is not pleasing to her master who has taken her for himself, let a payment be made for her so that she may go free; her master has no power to get a price for her and send her to a strange land, because he has been false to her.

chinese: 主人若選定他給自己的兒子，就當待他如同女兒。
english: And if he gives her to his son, he is to do everything for her as if she was his daughter.

chinese: 若另娶一個，那女子的吃食、衣服，並好合的事，仍不可減少。
english: And if he takes another woman, her food and clothing and her married rights are not to be less.

chinese: 若不向他行這三樣，他就可以不用錢贖，白白的出去。
english: And if he does not do these three things for her, she has the right to go free without payment.

chinese: 打人以致打死的，必要把他治死。
english: He who gives a man a death-blow is himself to be put to death.

chinese: 人若不是埋伏著殺人，乃是神交在他手中，我就設下一個地方，他可以往那裡逃跑。
english: But if he had no evil purpose against him, and God gave him into his hand, I will give you a place to which he may go in flight.

chinese: 人若任意用詭計殺了他的鄰舍，就是逃到我的壇那裡，也當捉去把他治死。
english: But if a man makes an attack on his neighbour on purpose, to put him to death by deceit, you are to take him from my altar and put him to death.

chinese: 打父母的，必要把他治死。
english: Any man who gives a blow to his father or his mother is certainly to be put to death.

chinese: 拐帶人口，或是把人賣了，或是留在他手下，必要把他治死。
english: Any man who gets another into his power in order to get a price for him is to be put to death, if you take him in the act.

chinese: 咒罵父母的，必要把他治死。
english: Any man cursing his father or his mother is to be put to death.

chinese: 人若彼此相爭，這個用石頭或是拳頭打那個，尚且不至於死，不過躺臥在床，
english: If, in a fight, one man gives another a blow with a stone, or with the shut hand, not causing his death, but making him keep in bed;

chinese: 若再能起來扶杖而出，那打他的可算無罪；但要將他耽誤的工夫用錢賠補，並要將他全然醫好。
english: If he is able to get up again and go about with a stick, the other will be let off; only he will have to give him payment for the loss of his time, and see that he is cared for till he is well.

chinese: 人若用棍子打奴僕或婢女，立時死在他的手下，他必要受刑。
english: If a man gives his man-servant or his woman-servant blows with a rod, causing death, he is certainly to undergo punishment.

chinese: 若過一兩天才死，就可以不受刑，因為是用錢買的。
english: But, at the same time, if the servant goes on living for a day or two, the master is not to get punishment, for the servant is his property.

chinese: 人若彼此爭鬥，傷害有孕的婦人，甚至墜胎，隨後卻無別害，那傷害他的，總要按婦人的丈夫所要的，照審判官所斷的，受罰。
english: If men, while fighting, do damage to a woman with child, causing the loss of the child, but no other evil comes to her, the man will have to make payment up to the amount fixed by her husband, in agreement with the decision of the judges.

chinese: 若有別害，就要以命償命，
english: But if damage comes to her, let life be given in payment for life,

chinese: 以眼還眼，以牙還牙，以手還手，以腳還腳，
english: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

chinese: 以烙還烙，以傷還傷，以打還打。
english: Burning for burning, wound for wound, blow for blow.

chinese: 人若打壞了他奴僕或是婢女的一隻眼，就要因他的眼放他去得以自由。
english: If a man gives his man-servant or his woman-servant a blow in the eye, causing its destruction, he is to let him go free on account of the damage to his eye.

chinese: 若打掉了他奴僕或是婢女的一個牙，就要因他的牙放他去得以自由。
english: Or if the loss of a tooth is caused by his blow, he will let him go free on account of his tooth.

chinese: 牛若觸死男人或是女人，總要用石頭打死那牛，卻不可吃他的肉；牛的主人可算無罪。
english: If an ox comes to be the cause of death to a man or a woman, the ox is to be stoned, and its flesh may not be used for food; but the owner will not be judged responsible.

chinese: 倘若那牛素來是觸人的，有人報告了牛主，他竟不把牛拴著，以致把男人或是女人觸死，就要用石頭打死那牛，牛主也必治死。
english: But if the ox has frequently done such damage in the past, and the owner has had word of it and has not kept it under control, so that it has been the cause of the death of a man or woman, not only is the ox to be stoned, but its owner is to be put to death.

chinese: 若罰他贖命的價銀，他必照所罰的贖他的命。
english: If a price is put on his life, let him make payment of whatever price is fixed.

chinese: 牛無論觸了人的兒子或是女兒，必照這例辦理。
english: If the death of a son or of a daughter has been caused, the punishment is to be in agreement with this rule.

chinese: 牛若觸了奴僕或是婢女，必將銀子三十舍客勒給他們的主人，也要用石頭把牛打死。
english: If the death of a man-servant or of a woman-servant is caused by the ox, the owner is to give their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox is to be stoned.

chinese: 人若敞著井口，或挖井不遮蓋，有牛或驢掉在裡頭，
english: If a man makes a hole in the earth without covering it up, and an ox or an ass dropping into it comes to its death;

chinese: 井主要拿錢賠還本主人，死牲畜要歸自己。
english: The owner of the hole is responsible; he will have to make payment to their owner, but the dead beast will be his.

chinese: 這人的牛若傷了那人的牛，以至於死，他們要賣了活牛，平分價值，也要平分死牛。
english: And if one man's ox does damage to another man's ox, causing its death, then the living ox is to be exchanged for money, and division made of the price of it, and of the price of the dead one.

chinese: 人若知道這牛素來是觸人的，主人竟不把牛拴著，他必要以牛還牛，死牛要歸自己。
english: But if it is common knowledge that the ox has frequently done such damage in the past, and its owner has not kept it under control, he will have to give ox for ox; and the dead beast will be his.

chinese: 人若偷牛或羊，無論是宰了，是賣了，他就要以五牛賠一牛，四羊賠一羊。
english: If a man takes without right another man's ox or his sheep, and puts it to death or gets a price for it, he is to give five oxen for an ox, or four sheep for a sheep, in payment: the thief will have to make payment for what he has taken; if he has no money, he himself will have to be exchanged for money, so that payment may be made.

chinese: 人若遇見賊挖窟窿，把賊打了，以至於死，就不能為他有流血的罪。
english: If a thief is taken in the act of forcing his way into a house, and his death is caused by a blow, the owner of the house is not responsible for his blood.

chinese: 若太陽已經出來，就為他有流血的罪。賊若被拿，總要賠還。若他一無所有，就要被賣，頂他所偷的物。
english: But if it is after dawn, he will be responsible.

chinese: 若他所偷的，或牛，或驢，或羊，仍在他手下存活，他就要加倍賠還。
english: If he still has what he had taken, whatever it is, ox or ass or sheep, he is to give twice its value.

chinese: 人若在田間或在葡萄園裡放牲畜，任憑牲畜上別人的田裡去吃，就必拿自己田間上好的和葡萄園上好的賠還。
english: If a man makes a fire in a field or a vine-garden, and lets the fire do damage to another man's field, he is to give of the best produce of his field or his vine-garden to make up for it.

chinese: 若點火焚燒荊棘，以致將別人堆積的禾捆，站著的禾稼，或是田園，都燒盡了，那點火的必要賠還。
english: If there is a fire and the flames get to the thorns at the edge of the field, causing destruction of the cut grain or of the living grain, or of the field, he who made the fire will have to make up for the damage.

chinese: 人若將銀錢或家具交付鄰舍看守，這物從那人的家被偷去，若把賊找到了，賊要加倍賠還；
english: If a man puts money or goods in the care of his neighbour to keep for him, and it is taken from the man's house, if they get the thief, he will have to make payment of twice the value.

chinese: 若找不到賊，那家主必就近審判官，要看看他拿了原主的物件沒有。
english: If they do not get the thief, let the master of the house come before the judges and take an oath that he has not put his hand on his neighbour's goods.

chinese: 兩個人的案件，無論是為甚麼過犯，或是為牛，為驢，為羊，為衣裳，或是為甚麼失掉之物，有一人說：這是我的，兩造就要將案件稟告審判官，審判官定誰有罪，誰就要加倍賠還。
english: In any question about an ox or an ass or a sheep or clothing, or about the loss of any property which anyone says is his, let the two sides put their cause before God; and he who is judged to be in the wrong is to make payment to his neighbour of twice the value.

chinese: 人若將驢，或牛，或羊，或別的牲畜，交付鄰舍看守，牲畜或死，或受傷，或被趕去，無人看見，
english: If a man puts an ass or an ox or a sheep or any beast into the keeping of his neighbour, and it comes to death or is damaged or is taken away, without any person seeing it:

chinese: 那看守的人要憑著耶和華起誓，手裡未曾拿鄰舍的物，本主就要罷休，看守的人不必賠還。
english: If he takes his oath before the Lord that he has not put his hand to his neighbour's goods, the owner is to take his word for it and he will not have to make payment for it.

chinese: 牲畜若從看守的那裡被偷去，他就要賠還本主；
english: But if it is taken from him by a thief, he is to make up for the loss of it to its owner.

chinese: 若被野獸撕碎，看守的要帶來當作證據，所撕的不必賠還。
english: But if it has been damaged by a beast, and he is able to make this clear, he will not have to make payment for what was damaged.

chinese: 人若向鄰舍借甚麼，所借的或受傷，或死，本主沒有同在一處，借的人總要賠還；
english: If a man gets from his neighbour the use of one of his beasts, and it is damaged or put to death when the owner is not with it, he will certainly have to make payment for the loss.

chinese: 若本主同在一處，他就不必賠還；若是雇的，也不必賠還，本是為雇價來的。
english: If the owner is with it, he will not have to make payment: if he gave money for the use of it, the loss is covered by the payment.

chinese: 人若引誘沒有受聘的處女，與他行淫，他總要交出聘禮，娶他為妻。
english: If a man takes a virgin, who has not given her word to another man, and has connection with her, he will have to give a bride-price for her to be his wife.

chinese: 若女子的父親決不肯將女子給他，他就要按處女的聘禮，交出錢來。
english: If her father will not give her to him on any account, he will have to give the regular payment for virgins.

chinese: 行邪術的女人，不可容他存活。
english: Any woman using unnatural powers or secret arts is to be put to death.

chinese: 凡與獸淫合的，總要把他治死。
english: Any man who has sex connection with a beast is to be put to death.

chinese: 祭祀別神，不單單祭祀耶和華的，那人必要滅絕。
english: Complete destruction will come on any man who makes offerings to any other god but the Lord.

chinese: 不可虧負寄居的，也不可欺壓他，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。
english: Do no wrong to a man from a strange country, and do not be hard on him; for you yourselves were living in a strange country, in the land of Egypt.

chinese: 不可苦待寡婦和孤兒；
english: Do no wrong to a widow, or to a child whose father is dead.

chinese: 若是苦待他們一點，他們向我一哀求，我總要聽他們的哀聲，
english: If you are cruel to them in any way, and their cry comes up to me, I will certainly give ear;

chinese: 並要發烈怒，用刀殺你們，使你們的妻子為寡婦，兒女為孤兒。
english: And in the heat of my wrath I will put you to death with the sword, so that your wives will be widows and your children without fathers.

chinese: 我民中有貧窮人與你同住，你若借錢給他，不可如放債的向他取利。
english: If you let any of the poor among my people have the use of your money, do not be a hard creditor to him, and do not take interest.

chinese: 你即或拿鄰舍的衣服作當頭，必在日落以先歸還他；
english: If ever you take your neighbour's clothing in exchange for the use of your money, let him have it back before the sun goes down:

chinese: 因他只有這一件當蓋頭，是他蓋身的衣服，若是沒有，他拿甚麼睡覺呢？他哀求我，我就應允，因為我是有恩惠的。
english: For it is the only thing he has for covering his skin; what is he to go to sleep in? and when his cry comes up to me, I will give ear, for my mercy is great.

chinese: 不可毀謗神；也不可毀謗你百姓的官長。
english: You may not say evil of the judges, or put a curse on the ruler of your people.

chinese: 你要從你莊稼中的穀和酒醡中滴出來的酒拿來獻上，不可遲延。你要將頭生的兒子歸給我。
english: Do not keep back your offerings from the wealth of your grain and your vines. The first of your sons you are to give to me.

chinese: 你牛羊頭生的，也要這樣；七天當跟著母，第八天要歸給我。
english: In the same way with your oxen and your sheep: for seven days let the young one be with its mother; on the eighth day give it to me.

chinese: 你要在我面前為聖潔的人。因此，田間被野獸撕裂牲畜的肉，你們不可吃，要丟給狗吃。
english: You are to be holy men to me: the flesh of no animal whose death has been caused by the beasts of the field may be used for your food; it is to be given to the dogs.

chinese: 不可隨夥佈散謠言；不可與惡人連手妄作見證。
english: Do not let a false statement go further; do not make an agreement with evil-doers to be a false witness.

chinese: 不可隨眾行惡；不可在爭訟的事上隨眾偏行，作見證屈枉正直；
english: Do not be moved to do wrong by the general opinion, or give the support of your words to a wrong decision:

chinese: 也不可在爭訟的事上偏護窮人。
english: But, on the other hand, do not be turned from what is right in order to give support to a poor man's cause.

chinese: 若遇見你仇敵的牛或驢失迷了路，總要牽回來交給他。
english: If you come across the ox or the ass of one who is no friend to you wandering from its way, you are to take it back to him.

chinese: 若看見恨你人的驢壓臥在重馱之下，不可走開，務要和驢主一同抬開重馱。
english: If you see the ass of one who has no love for you bent down to the earth under the weight which is put on it, you are to come to its help, even against your desire.

chinese: 不可在窮人爭訟的事上屈枉正直。
english: Let no wrong decisions be given in the poor man's cause.

chinese: 當遠離虛假的事。不可殺無辜和有義的人，因我必不以惡人為義。
english: Keep yourselves far from any false business; never let the upright or him who has done no wrong be put to death: for I will make the evil-doer responsible for his sin.

chinese: 不可受賄賂；因為賄賂能叫明眼人變瞎了，又能顛倒義人的話。
english: Take no rewards in a cause: for rewards make blind those who have eyes to see, and make the decisions of the upright false.

chinese: 不可欺壓寄居的；因為你們在埃及地作過寄居的，知道寄居的心。
english: Do not be hard on the man from a strange country who is living among you; for you have had experience of the feelings of one who is far from the land of his birth, because you yourselves were living in Egypt, in a strange land.

chinese: 六年你要耕種田地，收藏土產，
english: For six years put seed into your fields and get in the increase;

chinese: 只是第七年要叫地歇息，不耕不種，使你民中的窮人有吃的；他們所剩下的，野獸可以吃。你的葡萄園和橄欖園也要照樣辦理。
english: But in the seventh year let the land have a rest and be unplanted; so that the poor may have food from it: and let the beasts of the field take the rest. Do the same with your vine-gardens and your olive-trees.

chinese: 六日你要做工，第七日要安息，使牛、驢可以歇息，並使你婢女的兒子和寄居的都可以舒暢。
english: For six days do your work, and on the seventh day keep the Sabbath; so that your ox and your ass may have rest, together with the son of your servant and the man from a strange land living among you.

chinese: 凡我對你們說的話，你們要謹守。別神的名，你不可題，也不可從你口中傳說。
english: Take note of all these things which I have said to you, and let not the names of other gods come into your minds or from your lips.

chinese: 一年三次，你要向我守節。
english: Three times in the year you are to keep a feast to me.

chinese: 你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期，吃無酵餅七天。誰也不可空手朝見我，因為你是這月出了埃及。
english: You are to keep the feast of unleavened bread; for seven days let your bread be without leaven, as I gave you orders, at the regular time in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt); and let no one come before me without an offering:

chinese: 又要守收割節，所收的是你田間所種、勞碌得來初熟之物。並在年底收藏，要守收藏節。
english: And the feast of the grain-cutting, the first-fruits of your planted fields: and the feast at the start of the year, when you have got in all the fruit from your fields.

chinese: 一切的男丁要一年三次朝見主耶和華。
english: Three times in the year let all your males come before the Lord God.

chinese: 不可將我祭牲的血和有酵的餅一同獻上；也不可將我節上祭牲的脂油留到早晨。
english: Do not give the blood of my offering with leavened bread; and do not let the fat of my feast be kept all night till the morning.

chinese: 地裡首先初熟之物要送到耶和華─你神的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
english: The best of the first-fruits of your land are to be taken into the house of the Lord your God. The young goat is not to be cooked in its mother's milk.

chinese: 看哪，我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保護你，領你到我所預備的地方去。
english: See, I am sending an angel before you, to keep you on your way and to be your guide into the place which I have made ready for you.

chinese: 他是奉我名來的；你們要在他面前謹慎，聽從他的話，不可惹（惹或作：違背）他，因為他必不赦免你們的過犯。
english: Give attention to him and give ear to his voice; do not go against him; for your wrongdoing will not be overlooked by him, because my name is in him.

chinese: 你若實在聽從他的話，照著我一切所說的去行，我就向你的仇敵作仇敵，向你的敵人作敵人。
english: But if you truly give ear to his voice, and do whatever I say, then I will be against those who are against you, fighting those who are fighting you.

chinese: 我的使者要在你前面行，領你到亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、迦南人、希未人、耶布斯人那裡去，我必將他們剪除。
english: And my angel will go before you, guiding you into the land of the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Canaanite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, and they will be cut off by my hand.

chinese: 你不可跪拜他們的神，不可事奉他，也不可效法他們的行為，卻要把神像盡行拆毀，打碎他們的柱像。
english: Do not go down on your faces and give worship to their gods, or do as they do; but overcome them completely, and let their pillars be broken down.

chinese: 你們要事奉耶和華─你們的神，他必賜福與你的糧與你的水，也必從你們中間除去疾病。
english: And give worship to the Lord your God, who will send his blessing on your bread and on your water; and I will take all disease away from among you.

chinese: 你境內必沒有墜胎的，不生產的。我要使你滿了你年日的數目。
english: All your animals will give birth without loss, not one will be without young in all your land; I will give you a full measure of life.

chinese: 凡你所到的地方，我要使那裡的眾民在你面前驚駭，擾亂，又要使你一切仇敵轉背逃跑。
english: I will send my fear before you, putting to flight all the people to whom you come; all those who are against you will go in flight, turning their backs before you.

chinese: 我要打發黃蜂飛在你前面，把希未人、迦南人、赫人攆出去。
english: I will send hornets before you, driving out the Hivite and the Canaanite and the Hittite before your face.

chinese: 我不在一年之內將他們從你面前攆出去，恐怕地成為荒涼，野地的獸多起來害你。
english: I will not send them all out in one year, for fear that their land may become waste, and the beasts of the field be increased overmuch against you.

chinese: 我要漸漸地將他們從你面前攆出去，等到你的人數加多，承受那地為業。
english: Little by little I will send them away before you, till your numbers are increased and you take up your heritage in the land.

chinese: 我要定你的境界，從紅海直到非利士海，又從曠野直到大河。我要將那地的居民交在你手中，你要將他們從你面前攆出去。
english: I will let the limits of your land be from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the waste land to the river Euphrates: for I will give the people of those lands into your power; and you will send them out before you.

chinese: 不可和他們並他們的神立約。
english: Make no agreement with them or with their gods.

chinese: 他們不可住在你的地上，恐怕他們使你得罪我。你若事奉他們的神，這必成為你的網羅。
english: Let them not go on living in your land, or they will make you do evil against me: for if you give worship to their gods, it will certainly be a cause of sin to you.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你和亞倫、拿答、亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都要上到我這裡來，遠遠的下拜。
english: And he said to Moses, Come up to the Lord, you and Aaron, and Nadab and Abihu and seventy of the chiefs of Israel; and give me worship from a distance.

chinese: 惟獨你可以親近耶和華；他們卻不可親近；百姓也不可和你一同上來。
english: And Moses only may come near to the Lord; but the others are not to come near, and the people may not come up with them.

chinese: 摩西下山，將耶和華的命令典章都述說與百姓聽。眾百姓齊聲說：耶和華所吩咐的，我們都必遵行。
english: Then Moses came and put before the people all the words of the Lord and his laws: and all the people, answering with one voice, said, Whatever the Lord has said we will do.

chinese: 摩西將耶和華的命令都寫上。清早起來，在山下築一座壇，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，
english: Then Moses put down in writing all the words of the Lord, and he got up early in the morning and made an altar at the foot of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

chinese: 又打發以色列人中的少年人去獻燔祭，又向耶和華獻牛為平安祭。
english: And he sent some of the young men of the children of Israel to make burned offerings and peace-offerings of oxen to the Lord.

chinese: 摩西將血一半盛在盆中，一半灑在壇上；
english: And Moses took half the blood and put it in basins; draining out half of the blood over the altar.

chinese: 又將約書念給百姓聽。他們說：耶和華所吩咐的，我們都必遵行。
english: And he took the book of the agreement, reading it in the hearing of the people: and they said, Everything which the Lord has said we will do, and we will keep his laws.

chinese: 摩西將血灑在百姓身上，說：你看！這是立約的血，是耶和華按這一切話與你們立約的憑據。
english: Then Moses took the blood and let it come on the people, and said, This blood is the sign of the agreement which the Lord has made with you in these words.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫、拿答、亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都上了山。
english: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the chiefs of Israel went up:

chinese: 他們看見以色列的神，他腳下彷彿有平鋪的藍寶石，如同天色明淨。
english: And they saw the God of Israel; and under his feet there was, as it seemed, a jewelled floor, clear as the heavens.

chinese: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他們觀看神；他們又吃又喝。
english: And he put not his hand on the chiefs of the children of Israel: they saw God, and took food and drink.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你上山到我這裡來，住在這裡，我要將石版並我所寫的律法和誡命賜給你，使你可以教訓百姓。
