english: And the Lord said to Moses, Come up to me on the mountain, and take your place there: and I will give you the stones on which I have put in writing the law and the orders, so that you may give the people knowledge of them.

chinese: 摩西和他的幫手約書亞起來，上了神的山。
english: Then Moses and Joshua his servant got up; and Moses went up into the mountain of God.

chinese: 摩西對長老說：你們在這裡等著，等到我們再回來，有亞倫、戶珥與你們同在。凡有爭訟的，都可以就近他們去。
english: And he said to the chiefs, Keep your places here till we come back to you: Aaron and Hur are with you; if anyone has any cause let him go to them.

chinese: 摩西上山，有雲彩把山遮蓋。
english: And Moses went up into the mountain, and it was covered by the cloud.

chinese: 耶和華的榮耀停於西乃山；雲彩遮蓋山六天，第七天他從雲中召摩西。
english: And the glory of the Lord was resting on Mount Sinai, and the cloud was over it for six days; and on the seventh day he said Moses' name out of the cloud.

chinese: 耶和華的榮耀在山頂上，在以色列人眼前，形狀如烈火。
english: And the glory of the Lord was like a flame on the top of the mountain before the eyes of the children of Israel.

chinese: 摩西進入雲中上山，在山上四十晝夜。
english: And Moses went up the mountain, into the cloud, and was there for forty days and forty nights.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你告訴以色列人當為我送禮物來；凡甘心樂意的，你們就可以收下歸我。
english: Say to the children of Israel that they are to make me an offering; from every man who has the impulse in his heart take an offering for me.

chinese: 所要收的禮物：就是金、銀、銅，
english: And this is the offering you are to take from them: gold and silver and brass;

chinese: 藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，細麻，山羊毛，
english: And blue and purple and red, and the best linen, and goats' hair;

chinese: 染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂莢木，
english: And sheepskins coloured red, and leather, and hard wood;

chinese: 點燈的油並做膏油和香的香料，
english: Oil for the light, spices for the sweet-smelling oil, sweet perfumes for burning;

chinese: 紅瑪瑙與別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。
english: Beryls and stones of value to be put on the ephod and on the priest's bag.

chinese: 又當為我造聖所，使我可以住在他們中間。
english: And let them make me a holy place, so that I may be ever present among them.

chinese: 製造帳幕和其中的一切器具都要照我所指示你的樣式。
english: Make the House and everything in it from the designs which I will give you.

chinese: 要用皂莢木做一櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半。
english: And they are to make an ark of hard wood; two and a half cubits long, and a cubit and a half wide and high.

chinese: 要裡外包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
english: It is to be plated inside and out with the best gold, with an edge of gold all round it

chinese: 也要鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上；這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
english: And make four rings of gold for it, to be fixed on its four feet, two rings on one side of it and two on the other.

chinese: 要用皂莢木做兩根杠，用金包裹。
english: And make rods of the same wood, plating them with gold.

chinese: 要把杠穿在櫃旁的環內，以便抬櫃。
english: And put the rods through the rings at the sides of the ark, for lifting it.

chinese: 這杠要常在櫃的環內，不可抽出來。
english: The rods are to be kept in the rings, and never taken out.

chinese: 必將我所要賜給你的法版放在櫃裡。
english: Inside the ark you are to put the record which I will give you.

chinese: 要用精金做施恩座（施恩：或作蔽罪；下同），長二肘半，寬一肘半。
english: And you are to make a cover of the best gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

chinese: 要用金子錘出兩個基路伯來，安在施恩座的兩頭。
english: And at the two ends of the cover you are to make two winged ones of hammered gold,

chinese: 這頭做一個基路伯，那頭做一個基路伯，二基路伯要接連一塊，在施恩座的兩頭。
english: One at one end and one at the other; the winged ones are to be part of the cover.

chinese: 二基路伯要高張翅膀，遮掩施恩座。基路伯要臉對臉，朝著施恩座。
english: And their wings are to be outstretched over the cover, and the winged ones are to be opposite one another, facing the cover.

chinese: 要將施恩座安在櫃的上邊，又將我所要賜給你的法版放在櫃裡。
english: And put the cover over the ark, and in the ark the record which I will give you.

chinese: 我要在那裡與你相會，又要從法櫃施恩座上二基路伯中間，和你說我所要吩咐你傳給以色列人的一切事。
english: And there, between the two winged ones on the cover of the ark, I will come to you, face to face, and make clear to you all the orders I have to give you for the children of Israel.

chinese: 要用皂莢木做一張桌子，長二肘，寬一肘，高一肘半。
english: And you are to make a table of the same wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high,

chinese: 要包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
english: Plated with the best gold, with a gold edge all round it;

chinese: 桌子的四圍各做一掌寬的橫梁，橫梁上鑲著金牙邊。
english: And make a frame all round it, as wide as a man's hand, with a gold edge to the frame.

chinese: 要做四個金環，安在桌子的四角上，就是桌子四腳上的四角。
english: And make four gold rings and put them at the four angles, on the four feet of the table;

chinese: 安環子的地方要挨近橫梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。
english: The rings are to be fixed under the frame to take the rods with which the table is to be lifted.

chinese: 要用皂莢木做兩根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
english: Make rods of the same wood, plated with gold, for lifting the table.

chinese: 要做桌子上的盤子、調羹，並奠酒的爵和瓶；這都要用精金製作。
english: And make the table-vessels, the spoons and the cups and the basins for liquids, all of the best gold.

chinese: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常擺陳設餅。
english: And on the table at all times you are to keep my holy bread.

chinese: 要用精金做一個燈臺。燈臺的座和榦與杯、球、花，都要接連一塊錘出來。
english: And you are to make a support for lights, of the best gold; its base and its pillar are to be of hammered gold; its cups, its buds, and its flowers are to be made of the same metal.

chinese: 燈臺兩旁要杈出六個枝子：這旁三個，那旁三個。
english: It is to have six branches coming out from its sides; three branches from one side and three from the other.

chinese: 這旁每枝上有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花；那旁每枝上也有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花。從燈臺杈出來的六個枝子都是如此。
english: Every branch having three cups made like almond flowers, every cup with a bud and a flower, on all the branches.

chinese: 燈臺上有四個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花。
english: And on the pillar, four cups like almond flowers, every one with its bud and its flower:

chinese: 燈臺每兩個枝子以下有球與枝子接連一塊。燈臺出的六個枝子都是如此。
english: And under every two branches a bud, made with the branch, for all the six branches of it.

chinese: 球和枝子要接連一塊，都是一塊精金錘出來的。
english: The buds and the branches are to be made of the same metal; all together one complete work of hammered gold.

chinese: 要做燈臺的七個燈盞。祭司要點這燈，使燈光對照。
english: Then you are to make its seven vessels for the lights, putting them in their place so that they give light in front of it.

chinese: 燈臺的蠟剪和蠟花盤也是要精金的。
english: And the instruments and trays for use with it are all to be of the best gold.

chinese: 做燈臺和這一切的器具要用精金一他連得。
english: A talent of gold will be needed for it, with all these vessels.

chinese: 要謹慎做這些物件，都要照著在山上指示你的樣式。
english: And see that you make them from the design which you saw on the mountain.

chinese: 你要用十幅幔子做帳幕。這些幔子要用撚的細麻和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線製造，並用巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
english: And you are to make a House for me, with ten curtains of the best linen, blue and purple and red, worked with designs of winged ones by a good workman.

chinese: 每幅幔子要長二十八肘，寬四肘，幔子都要一樣的尺寸。
english: Every curtain is to be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

chinese: 這五幅幔子要幅幅相連；那五幅幔子也要幅幅相連。
english: Five curtains are to be joined together, and the other five are to be joined together.

chinese: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上要做藍色的鈕扣；在那相連的幔子末幅邊上也要照樣做。
english: And you are to put twists of blue cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group of five, and on the edge of the outside curtain of the second group of five;

chinese: 要在這相連的幔子上做五十個鈕扣；在那相連的幔子上也做五十個鈕扣，都要兩兩相對。
english: Fifty twists on one curtain and fifty on the other, the twists to be opposite one another.

chinese: 又要做五十個金鉤，用鉤使幔子相連，這才成了一個帳幕。
english: Then make fifty gold hooks, joining the curtains together by the hooks, and in this way the House will be made.

chinese: 你要用山羊毛織十一幅幔子，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
english: And you are to make curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the House, eleven curtains.

chinese: 每幅幔子要長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幔子都要一樣的尺寸。
english: Every curtain is to be thirty cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

chinese: 要把五幅幔子連成一幅，又把六幅幔子連成一幅，這第六幅幔子要在罩棚的前面摺上去。
english: Five of these curtains are to be joined together, and the other six are to be joined together, the sixth being folded over to make a hanging in front of the tent.

chinese: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上要做五十個鈕扣；在那相連的幔子末幅邊上也做五十個鈕扣。
english: And you are to put fifty twists of cord on the edge of the outside curtain of one group, and fifty twists on the edge of the outside curtain of the other group.

chinese: 又要做五十個銅鉤，鉤在鈕扣中，使罩棚連成一個。
english: Then make fifty brass hooks and put the hooks into the twists, joining the tent together to make it one.

chinese: 罩棚的幔子所餘那垂下來的半幅幔子，要垂在帳幕的後頭。
english: And the folded part which is over of the curtains of the tent, the half-curtain which is folded back, will be hanging down over the back of the House.

chinese: 罩棚的幔子所餘長的，這邊一肘，那邊一肘，要垂在帳幕的兩旁，遮蓋帳幕。
english: And the cubit which is over of the ten curtains at the sides will be hanging over the two sides of the House as a cover.

chinese: 又要用染紅的公羊皮做罩棚的蓋；再用海狗皮做一層罩棚上的頂蓋。
english: And then you are to make a cover for the tent, of sheepskins coloured red, and a cover of leather over that.

chinese: 你要用皂莢木做帳幕的豎板。
english: And you are to make upright boards of hard wood for the House.

chinese: 每塊要長十肘，寬一肘半；
english: Every board is to be ten cubits high and a cubit and a half wide.

chinese: 每塊必有兩榫相對。帳幕一切的板都要這樣做。
english: Every board is to be joined to the one nearest to it by two tongues, and so for every board in the House.

chinese: 帳幕的南面要做板二十塊。
english: These are the boards needed for the house; twenty boards for the south side,

chinese: 在這二十塊板底下要做四十個帶卯的銀座，兩卯接這塊板上的兩榫，兩卯接那塊板上的兩榫。
english: With forty silver bases under the twenty boards, two bases under every board to take its tongues.

chinese: 帳幕第二面，就是北面，也要做板二十塊
english: And twenty boards for the second side of the house on the north,

chinese: 和帶卯的銀座四十個；這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
english: With their forty silver bases, two under every board.

chinese: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，要做板六塊。
english: And six boards for the back of the House on the west,

chinese: 帳幕後面的拐角要做板兩塊。
english: With two boards for the angles of the House at the back.

chinese: 板的下半截要雙的，上半截要整的，直頂到第一個環子；兩塊都要這樣做兩個拐角。
english: The two are to be joined together at the base and at the top to one ring, forming the two angles.

chinese: 必有八塊板和十六個帶卯的銀座；這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
english: So there are to be eight boards, with their sixteen silver bases, two bases under every board.

chinese: 你要用皂莢木做閂：為帳幕這面的板做五閂，
english: And make rods of the same wood, five for the boards on the one side,

chinese: 為帳幕那面的板做五閂，又為帳幕後面的板做五閂。
english: And five for the boards on the other side of the House, and five for the west side of the House at the back.

chinese: 板腰間的中閂要從這一頭通到那一頭。
english: And the middle rod is to go through the rings of all the boards from end to end.

chinese: 板要用金子包裹，又要做板上的金環套閂；閂也要用金子包裹。
english: And the boards are to be plated with gold, having gold rings for the rods to go through: and the rods are to be plated with gold.

chinese: 要照著在山上指示你的樣式立起帳幕。
english: And you are to make the House from the design which you saw on the mountain.

chinese: 你要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
english: And you are to make a veil of the best linen, blue and purple and red, worked with designs of winged ones by a good workman:

chinese: 要把幔子掛在四根包金的皂莢木柱子上，柱子上當有金鉤，柱子安在四個帶卯的銀座上。
english: Hanging it by gold hooks from four pillars of wood, plated with gold and fixed in silver bases.

chinese: 要使幔子垂在鉤子下，把法櫃抬進幔子內；這幔子要將聖所和至聖所隔開。
english: And you are to put up the veil under the hooks, and put inside it the ark of the law: the veil is to be a division between the holy place and the most holy.

chinese: 又要把施恩座安在至聖所內的法櫃上，
english: You are to put the cover on the ark of the law, inside the most holy place.

chinese: 把桌子安在幔子外帳幕的北面；把燈臺安在帳幕的南面，彼此相對。
english: And outside the veil you are to put the table, and the support for the lights opposite the table on the south side of the House; and the table is to be on the north side.

chinese: 你要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾。
english: And you are to make a curtain for the doorway of the Tent, of the best linen with needlework of blue and purple and red.

chinese: 要用皂莢木為簾子做五根柱子，用金子包裹。柱子上當有金鉤；又要為柱子用銅鑄造五個帶卯的座。
english: And make five pillars for the curtain, of hard wood plated with gold; their hooks are to be of gold and their bases of brass

chinese: 你要用皂莢木做壇。這壇要四方的，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘。
english: And make an altar of hard wood, a square altar, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high.

chinese: 要在壇的四拐角上做四個角，與壇接連一塊，用銅把壇包裹。
english: Put horns at the four angles of it, made of the same, plating it all with brass.

chinese: 要做盆，收去壇上的灰，又做鏟子、盤子、肉鍤子、火鼎；壇上一切的器具都用銅做。
english: And make all its vessels, the baskets for taking away the dust of the fire, the spades and basins and meat-hooks and fire-trays, of brass.

chinese: 要為壇做一個銅網，在網的四角上做四個銅環，
english: And make a network of brass, with four brass rings at its four angles.

chinese: 把網安在壇四面的圍腰板以下，使網從下達到壇的半腰。
english: And put the network under the shelf round the altar so that the net comes half-way up the altar.

chinese: 又要用皂莢木為壇做杠，用銅包裹。
english: And make rods for the altar, of hard wood, plated with brass.

chinese: 這杠要穿在壇兩旁的環子內，用以抬壇。
english: And put the rods through the rings at the two opposite sides of the altar, for lifting it.

chinese: 要用板做壇，壇是空的，都照著在山上指示你的樣式作。
english: The altar is to be hollow, boarded in with wood; make it from the design which you saw on the mountain.

chinese: 你要做帳幕的院子。院子的南面要用撚的細麻做帷子，長一百肘。
english: And let there be an open space round the House, with hangings for its south side of the best linen, a hundred cubits long.

chinese: 帷子的柱子要二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個。柱子上的鉤子和杆子都要用銀子做。
english: Their twenty pillars and their twenty bases are to be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their bands are to be of silver.

chinese: 北面也當有帷子，長一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個。柱子上的鉤子和杆子都要用銀子做。
english: And on the north side in the same way, hangings a hundred cubits long, with twenty pillars of brass on bases of brass; their hooks and their bands are to be of silver.

chinese: 院子的西面當有帷子，寬五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，帶卯的座十個。
english: And for the open space on the west side, the hangings are to be fifty cubits wide, with ten pillars and ten bases;

chinese: 院子的東面要寬五十肘。
english: And on the east side the space is to be fifty cubits wide.

chinese: 門這邊的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
english: On the one side of the doorway will be hangings fifteen cubits long, with three pillars and three bases;

chinese: 門那邊的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
english: And on the other side, hangings fifteen cubits long, with three pillars and three bases.

chinese: 院子的門當有簾子，長二十肘，要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織成，柱子四根，帶卯的座四個。
english: And across the doorway, a veil of twenty cubits of the best linen, made of needlework of blue and purple and red, with four pillars and four bases.

chinese: 院子四圍一切的柱子都要用銀杆連絡，柱子上的鉤子要用銀做，帶卯的座要用銅做。
english: All the pillars round the open space are to have silver bands, with hooks of silver and bases of brass.

chinese: 院子要長一百肘，寬五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用撚的細麻做，帶卯的座要用銅做。
english: The open space is to be a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, with sides five cubits high, curtained with the best linen, with bases of brass.

chinese: 帳幕各樣用處的器具，並帳幕一切的橛子，和院子裡一切的橛子，都要用銅做。
english: All the instruments for the work of the House, and all its nails, and the nails of the open space are to be of brass.

chinese: 你要吩咐以色列人，把那為點燈搗成的清橄欖油拿來給你，使燈常常點著。
english: Give orders to the children of Israel to give you clear olive oil for the lights, so that a light may be burning there at all times.

chinese: 在會幕中法櫃前的幔外，亞倫和他的兒子，從晚上到早晨，要在耶和華面前經理這燈。這要作以色列人世世代代永遠的定例。
english: Let Aaron and his sons put this in order, evening and morning, before the Lord, inside the Tent of meeting, outside the veil which is before the ark; this is to be an order for ever, from generation to generation, to be kept by the children of Israel.

chinese: 你要從以色列人中，使你的哥哥亞倫和他的兒子拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪一同就近你，給我供祭司的職分。
english: Now let Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, come near from among the children of Israel, so that they may be my priests, even Aaron, and Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, his sons.

chinese: 你要給你哥哥亞倫做聖衣為榮耀，為華美。
english: And make holy robes for Aaron your brother, so that he may be clothed with glory and honour.

chinese: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫做衣服，使他分別為聖，可以給我供祭司的職分。
english: Give orders to all the wise-hearted workmen, whom I have made full of the spirit of wisdom, to make robes for Aaron, so that he may be made holy as my priest.

chinese: 所要做的就是胸牌、以弗得、外袍、雜色的內袍、冠冕、腰帶，使你哥哥亞倫和他兒子穿這聖服，可以給我供祭司的職分。
english: This is what they are to make: a priest's bag, an ephod, and a robe, and a coat of coloured needlework, a head-dress, and a linen band; they are to make holy robes for Aaron your brother and for his sons, so that they may do the work of priests for me.

chinese: 要用金線和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並細麻去做。
english: They are to take the gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen,

chinese: 他們要拿金線和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻，用巧匠的手工做以弗得。
english: And make the ephod of gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen, the work of a designer.

chinese: 以弗得當有兩條肩帶，接上兩頭，使他相連。
english: It is to have two bands stitched to it at the top of the arms, joining it together.

chinese: 其上巧工織的帶子，要和以弗得一樣的做法，用以束上，與以弗得接連一塊，要用金線和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做成。
english: And the beautifully worked band, which goes on it, is to be of the same work and the same material, of gold and blue and purple and red and twisted linen-work.

chinese: 要取兩塊紅瑪瑙，在上面刻以色列兒子的名字：
english: You are to take two beryl stones, on which the names of the children of Israel are to be cut:

chinese: 六個名字在這塊寶石上，六個名字在那塊寶石上，都照他們生來的次序。
english: Six names on the one stone and six on the other, in the order of their birth.

chinese: 要用刻寶石的手工，彷彿刻圖書，按著以色列兒子的名字，刻這兩塊寶石，要鑲在金槽上。
english: With the work of a jeweller, like the cutting of a stamp, the names of the children of Israel are to be cut on them, and they are to be fixed in twisted frames of gold.

chinese: 要將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人做紀念石。亞倫要在兩肩上擔他們的名字，在耶和華面前作為紀念。
english: And the two stones are to be placed on the ephod, over the arm-holes, to be stones of memory for the children of Israel: Aaron will have their names on his arms when he goes in before the Lord, to keep the Lord in mind of them.

chinese: 要用金子做二槽，
english: And you are to make twisted frames of gold;

chinese: 又拿精金，用擰工彷彿擰繩子，做兩條鍊子，把這擰成的鍊子搭在二槽上。
english: And two chains of the best gold, twisted like cords; and have the chains fixed on to the frames.

chinese: 你要用巧匠的手工做一個決斷的胸牌。要和以弗得一樣的做法：用金線和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做成。
english: And make a priest's bag for giving decisions, designed like the ephod, made of gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen.

chinese: 這胸牌要四方的，疊為兩層，長一虎口，寬一虎口。
english: It is to be square, folded in two, a hand-stretch long and a hand-stretch wide.

chinese: 要在上面鑲寶石四行：第一行是紅寶石、紅璧璽、紅玉；
english: And on it you are to put four lines of jewels; the first line is to be a cornelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;

chinese: 第二行是綠寶石、藍寶石、金鋼石；
english: The second, a ruby, a sapphire, and an onyx;

chinese: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶；
english: The third, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

chinese: 第四行是水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉。這都要鑲在金槽中。
english: The fourth, a topaz, a beryl, and a jasper; they are to be fixed in twisted frames of gold.

chinese: 這些寶石都要按著以色列十二個兒子的名字，彷彿刻圖書，刻十二個支派的名字。
english: The jewels are to be twelve in number, for the names of the children of Israel; every jewel having the name of one of the twelve tribes cut on it as on a stamp.

chinese: 要在胸牌上用精金擰成如繩的鍊子。
english: And you are to make two chains of gold, twisted like cords, to be fixed to the priest's bag.

chinese: 在胸牌上也要做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭。
english: And put two gold rings on the two ends of the bag.

chinese: 要把那兩條擰成的金鍊子，穿過胸牌兩頭的環子。
english: Put the two gold chains on the two rings at the ends of the bag;

chinese: 又要把鍊子的那兩頭接在兩槽上，安在以弗得前面肩帶上。
english: Joining the other ends of the chains to the gold frames and putting them on the front of the ephod, at the top of the arms.

chinese: 要做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭，在以弗得裡面的邊上。
english: Then make two gold rings and put them on the lower ends of the bag, at the edge of it on the inner side nearest to the ephod.

chinese: 又要做兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，挨近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
english: And make two more gold rings and put them on the front of the ephod at the top of the arms, at the join, over the worked band:

chinese: 要用藍細帶子把胸牌的環子與以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不可與以弗得離縫。
english: So that the rings on the bag may be fixed to the rings of the ephod by a blue cord and on to the band of the ephod, so that the bag may not come loose from the ephod.

chinese: 亞倫進聖所的時候，要將決斷胸牌，就是刻著以色列兒子名字的，帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常作紀念。
english: And so Aaron will have the names of the children of Israel on the priest's bag over his heart whenever he goes into the holy place, to keep the memory of them before the Lord.

chinese: 又要將烏陵和土明放在決斷的胸牌裡；亞倫進到耶和華面前的時候，要帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常將以色列人的決斷牌帶在胸前。
english: And in the bag you are to put the Urim and Thummim, so that they may be on Aaron's heart whenever he goes in before the Lord; and Aaron may have the power of making decisions for the children of Israel before the Lord at all times.

chinese: 你要做以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
english: The robe which goes with the ephod is to be made all of blue;

chinese: 袍上要為頭留一領口，口的周圍織出領邊來，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
english: With a hole at the top, in the middle of it; the hole is to be edged with a band to make it strong like the hole in the coat of a fighting-man, so that it may not be broken open.

chinese: 袍子周圍底邊上要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線做石榴。在袍子周圍的石榴中間要有金鈴鐺：
english: And round the skirts of it put fruits in blue and purple and red, with bells of gold between;

chinese: 一個金鈴鐺一個石榴，一個金鈴鐺一個石榴，在袍子周圍的底邊上。
english: A gold bell and a fruit in turn all round the skirts of the robe.

chinese: 亞倫供職的時候要穿這袍子。他進聖所到耶和華面前，以及出來的時候，袍上的響聲必被聽見，使他不至於死亡。
english: Aaron is to put it on for his holy work; and the sound of it will be clear, when he goes into the holy place before the Lord, and when he comes out, keeping him safe from death.

chinese: 你要用精金做一面牌，在上面按刻圖書之法刻著歸耶和華為聖。
english: You are to make a plate of the best gold, cutting on it, as on a stamp, these words: HOLY TO THE LORD.

chinese: 要用一條藍細帶子將牌繫在冠冕的前面。
english: Put a blue cord on it and put it on the front of the twisted head-dress:

chinese: 這牌必在亞倫的額上，亞倫要擔當干犯聖物條例的罪孽；這聖物是以色列人在一切的聖禮物上所分別為聖的。這牌要常在他的額上，使他們可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
english: And it will be over Aaron's brow, so that Aaron will be responsible for any error in all the holy offerings made by the children of Israel; it will be on his brow at all times, so that their offerings may be pleasing to the Lord.

chinese: 要用雜色細麻線織內袍，用細麻布做冠冕，又用繡花的手工做腰帶。
english: The coat is to be made of the best linen, worked in squares; and you are to make a head-dress of linen, and a linen band worked in needlework.

chinese: 你要為亞倫的兒子做內袍、腰帶、裹頭巾，為榮耀，為華美。
english: And for Aaron's sons you are to make coats, and bands, and head-dresses, so that they may be clothed with glory and honour.

chinese: 要把這些給你的哥哥亞倫和他的兒子穿戴，又要膏他們，將他們分別為聖，好給我供祭司的職分。
english: These you are to put on Aaron, your brother, and on his sons, putting oil on them, separating them and making them holy, to do the work of priests to me.

chinese: 要給他們做細麻布褲子，遮掩下體；褲子當從腰達到大腿。
english: And you are to make them linen trousers, covering their bodies from the middle to the knee;

chinese: 亞倫和他兒子進入會幕，或就近壇，在聖所供職的時候必穿上，免得擔罪而死。這要為亞倫和他的後裔作永遠的定例。
english: Aaron and his sons are to put these on whenever they go into the Tent of meeting or come near the altar, when they are doing the work of the holy place, so that they may be free from any sin causing death: this is to be an order for him and his seed after him for ever.

chinese: 你使亞倫和他兒子成聖，給我供祭司的職分，要如此行：取一隻公牛犢，兩隻無殘疾的公綿羊，
english: This is what you are to do to make them holy, to do the work of priests to me: Take one young ox and two male sheep, without any mark on them,

chinese: 無酵餅和調油的無酵餅，與抹油的無酵薄餅；這都要用細麥麵做成。
english: And unleavened bread, and unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and thin unleavened cakes on which oil has been put, made of the best bread-meal;

chinese: 這餅要裝在一個筐子裡，連筐子帶來，又把公牛和兩隻公綿羊牽來。
english: Put these in a basket and take them, with the ox and the two sheep.

chinese: 要使亞倫和他兒子到會幕門口來，用水洗身。
english: And let Aaron and his sons come to the door of the Tent of meeting, and there let them be washed with water.

chinese: 要給亞倫穿上內袍和以弗得的外袍，並以弗得，又帶上胸牌，束上以弗得巧工織的帶子。
english: Take the robes, and put the coat and the dress and the ephod and the priest's bag on Aaron; put the band of needlework round him,

chinese: 把冠冕戴在他頭上，將聖冠加在冠冕上，
english: And let the head-dress be placed on his head and the holy crown on the head-dress.

chinese: 就把膏油倒在他頭上膏他。
english: Then take the oil and put it on his head.

chinese: 要叫他的兒子來，給他們穿上內袍。
english: And take his sons and put their robes on them;

chinese: 給亞倫和他兒子束上腰帶，包上裹頭巾，他們就憑永遠的定例得了祭司的職任。又要將亞倫和他兒子分別為聖。
english: And put the linen bands round Aaron and his sons, and the head-dresses on them, to make them priests by my order for ever: so you are to make Aaron and his sons holy to me.

chinese: 你要把公牛帶到會幕前，亞倫和他兒子要按手在公牛的頭上。
english: Then let the ox be taken in front of the Tent of meeting: and let Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

chinese: 你要在耶和華面前，在會幕門口，宰這公牛。
english: And you are to put the ox to death before the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 要取些公牛的血，用指頭抹在壇的四角上，把血都倒在壇腳那裡。
english: Then take some of the blood of the ox, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, draining out all the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

chinese: 要把一切蓋臟的脂油與肝上的網子，並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上。
english: And take all the fat covering the inside of the ox, and the fat joining the liver and the two kidneys with the fat round them, and let them be burned on the altar;

chinese: 只是公牛的皮、肉、糞都要用火燒在營外。這牛是贖罪祭。
english: But the flesh of the ox and its skin and its waste parts are to be burned outside the circle of the tents, for it is a sin-offering.

chinese: 你要牽一隻公綿羊來，亞倫和他兒子要按手在這羊的頭上。
english: Then take one of the sheep, and let Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

chinese: 要宰這羊，把血灑在壇的周圍。
english: Then let it be put to death, so that the sides of the altar are marked with its blood.

chinese: 要把羊切成塊子，洗淨五臟和腿，連塊子帶頭，都放在一處。
english: Then the sheep is to be cut up into its parts, and after washing its legs and its inside parts, you are to put them with the parts and the head,

chinese: 要把全羊燒在壇上，是給耶和華獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: And let them all be burned on the altar as a burned offering to the Lord: a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 你要將那一隻公綿羊牽來，亞倫和他兒子要按手在羊的頭上。
english: Then take the other sheep; and after Aaron and his sons have put their hands on its head,

chinese: 你要宰這羊，取點血抹在亞倫的右耳垂上和他兒子的右耳垂上，又抹在他們右手的大拇指上和右腳的大拇指上；並要把血灑在壇的四圍。
english: You are to put the sheep to death, and take some of its blood and put it on the point of Aaron's right ear, and of the right ears of his sons, and on the thumbs of their right hands and the great toes of their right feet, dropping the rest of the blood on the sides of the altar.

chinese: 你要取點膏油和壇上的血，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子和他兒子的衣服上，他們和他們的衣服就一同成聖。
english: Then take some of the blood on the altar, and the oil, and put it on Aaron and his robes and on his sons and on their robes, so that he and his robes and his sons and their robes may be made holy.

chinese: 你要取這羊的脂油和肥尾巴，並蓋臟的脂油與肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油並右腿（這是承接聖職所獻的羊）。
english: Then take the fat of the sheep, the fat tail, the fat covering the insides, and the fat joining the liver and the two kidneys with the fat round them, and the right leg; for by the offering of this sheep they are to be marked out as priests:

chinese: 再從耶和華面前裝無酵餅的筐子中取一個餅，一個調油的餅和一個薄餅，
english: And take one bit of bread and one cake of oiled bread and one thin cake out of the basket of unleavened bread which is before the Lord:

chinese: 都放在亞倫的手上和他兒子的手上，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
english: And put them all on the hands of Aaron and of his sons, to be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.

chinese: 要從他們手中接過來，燒在耶和華面前壇上的燔祭上，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: Then take them from their hands, and let them be burned on the burned offering on the altar, a sweet smell before the Lord, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 你要取亞倫承接聖職所獻公羊的胸，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，這就可以作你的分。
english: Then take the breast of Aaron's sheep, waving it before the Lord; and it is to be your part of the offering.

chinese: 那搖祭的胸和舉祭的腿，就是承接聖職所搖的、所舉的，是歸亞倫和他兒子的。這些你都要成為聖，
english: So you are to make holy the breast of the sheep which is waved and the leg which is lifted up on high, that is, of the sheep which is offered for Aaron and his sons;

chinese: 作亞倫和他子孫從以色列人中永遠所得的分，因為是舉祭。這要從以色列人的平安祭中，作為獻給耶和華的舉祭。
english: And it will be their part as a right for ever from the children of Israel, it is a special offering from the children of Israel, made from their peace-offerings, a special offering lifted up to the Lord.

chinese: 亞倫的聖衣要留給他的子孫，可以穿著受膏，又穿著承接聖職。
english: And Aaron's holy robes will be used by his sons after him; they will put them on when they are made priests.

chinese: 他的子孫接續他當祭司的，每逢進會幕在聖所供職的時候，要穿七天。
english: For seven days the son who becomes priest in his place will put them on when he comes into the Tent of meeting to do the work of the holy place.

chinese: 你要將承接聖職所獻公羊的肉煮在聖處。
english: Then take the sheep of the wave offering and let its flesh be cooked in water in a holy place.

chinese: 亞倫和他兒子要在會幕門口吃這羊的肉和筐內的餅。
english: And let Aaron and his sons make a meal of it, with the bread in the basket, at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 他們吃那些贖罪之物，好承接聖職，使他們成聖；只是外人不可吃，因為這是聖物。
english: All those things which were used as offerings to take away sin, and to make them holy to be priests, they may have for food: but no one who is not a priest may have them, for they are holy food.

chinese: 那承接聖職所獻的肉或餅，若有一點留到早晨，就要用火燒了，不可吃這物，因為是聖物。
english: And if any of the flesh of the offering or of the bread is over till the morning, let it be burned with fire; it is not to be used for food, for it is holy.

chinese: 你要這樣照我一切所吩咐的，向亞倫和他兒子行承接聖職的禮七天。
english: All these things you are to do to Aaron and his sons as I have given you orders: for seven days the work of making them priests is to go on.

chinese: 每天要獻公牛一隻為贖罪祭。你潔淨壇的時候，壇就潔淨了；且要用膏抹壇，使壇成聖。
english: Every day an ox is to be offered as a sin-offering, to take away sins: and by this offering on it, you will make the altar clean from sin; and you are to put oil on it and make it holy.

chinese: 要潔淨壇七天，使壇成聖，壇就成為至聖。凡挨著壇的都成為聖。
english: For seven days you are to make offerings for the altar and make it holy, so that it may become completely holy, and anything touching it will become holy.

chinese: 你每天所要獻在壇上的就是兩隻一歲的羊羔；
english: Now this is the offering which you are to make on the altar: two lambs in their first year, every day regularly.

chinese: 早晨要獻這一隻，黃昏的時候要獻那一隻。
english: One lamb is to be offered in the morning and the other in the evening:

chinese: 和這一隻羊羔同獻的，要用細麵伊法十分之一與搗成的油一欣四分之一調和，又用酒一欣四分之一作為奠祭。
english: And with the one lamb, a tenth part of an ephah of the best meal, mixed with a fourth part of a hin of clear oil; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

chinese: 那一隻羊羔要在黃昏的時候獻上，照著早晨的素祭和奠祭的禮辦理，作為獻給耶和華馨香的火祭。
english: And the other lamb is to be offered in the evening, and with it the same meal offering and drink offering, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 這要在耶和華面前、會幕門口，作你們世世代代常獻的燔祭。我要在那裡與你們相會，和你們說話。
english: This is to be a regular burned offering made from generation to generation, at the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord, where I will come face to face with you and have talk with you.

chinese: 我要在那裡與以色列人相會，會幕就要因我的榮耀成為聖。
english: There I will come face to face with the children of Israel, and the Tent will be made holy by my glory

chinese: 我要使會幕和壇成聖，也要使亞倫和他的兒子成聖，給我供祭司的職分。
english: I will make holy the Tent of meeting and the altar: and Aaron and his sons I will make holy, to be my priests

chinese: 我要住在以色列人中間，作他們的神。
english: Among the children of Israel I will make my living-place, and I will be their God.

chinese: 他們必知道我是耶和華─他們的神，是將他們從埃及地領出來的，為要住在他們中間。我是耶和華─他們的　神。
english: And they will see that I am the Lord their God, who took them out of the land of Egypt, so that I might be ever with them: I am the Lord their God.

chinese: 你要用皂莢木做一座燒香的壇。
english: And you are to make an altar for the burning of perfume; of hard wood let it be made.

chinese: 這壇要四方的，長一肘，寬一肘，高二肘；壇的四角要與壇接連一塊。
english: The altar is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high, and its horns are to be made of the same.

chinese: 要用精金把壇的上面與壇的四圍，並壇的四角，包裹；又要在壇的四圍鑲上金牙邊。
english: It is to be plated with the best gold, the top of it and the sides and the horns, with an edging of gold all round it.

chinese: 要做兩個金環安在牙子邊以下，在壇的兩旁，兩根橫撐上，作為穿杠的用處，以便抬壇。
english: Under the edge on the two opposite sides, you are to make two gold rings, to take the rods for lifting it.

chinese: 要用皂莢木做杠，用金包裹。
english: And make these rods of the same wood, plating them with gold.

chinese: 要把壇放在法櫃前的幔子外，對著法櫃上的施恩座，就是我要與你相會的地方。
english: And let it be placed in front of the veil before the ark of the law, before the cover which is over the law, where I will come face to face with you.

chinese: 亞倫在壇上要燒馨香料做的香；每早晨他收拾燈的時候，要燒這香。
english: And on this altar sweet spices are to be burned by Aaron every morning when he sees to the lights.

chinese: 黃昏點燈的時候，他要在耶和華面前燒這香，作為世世代代常燒的香。
english: And every evening, when he puts the lights up in their places, the spices are to be burned, a sweet-smelling smoke going up before the Lord from generation to generation for ever.

chinese: 在這壇上不可奉上異樣的香，不可獻燔祭、素祭，也不可澆上奠祭。
english: No strange perfume, no burned offering or meal offering, and no drink offering is to be offered on it.

chinese: 亞倫一年一次要在壇的角上行贖罪之禮。他一年一次要用贖罪祭牲的血在壇上行贖罪之禮，作為世世代代的定例。這壇在耶和華面前為至聖。
english: And once every year Aaron is to make its horns clean: with the blood of the sin-offering he is to make it clean once every year from generation to generation: it is most holy to the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要按以色列人被數的，計算總數，你數的時候，他們各人要為自己的生命把贖價奉給耶和華，免得數的時候在他們中間有災殃。
english: When you are taking the number of the children of Israel, let every man who is numbered give to the Lord a price for his life, so that no disease may come on them when they are numbered.

chinese: 凡過去歸那些被數之人的，每人要按聖所的平，拿銀子半舍客勒；這半舍客勒是奉給耶和華的禮物（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
english: And this is what they are to give; let every man who is numbered give half a shekel, by the scale of the holy place: (the shekel being valued at twenty gerahs:) this money is an offering to the Lord.

chinese: 凡過去歸那些被數的人，從二十歲以外的，要將這禮物奉給耶和華。
english: Everyone who is numbered, from twenty years old and over, is to give an offering to the Lord.

chinese: 他們為贖生命將禮物奉給耶和華，富足的不可多出，貧窮的也不可少出，各人要出半舍客勒。
english: The man of wealth is to give no more and the poor man no less than the half-shekel of silver, when the offering is made to the Lord as the price for your lives.

chinese: 你要從以色列人收這贖罪銀，作為會幕的使用，可以在耶和華面前為以色列人作紀念，贖生命。
english: And you are to take this money from the children of Israel to be used for the work of the Tent of meeting, to keep the memory of the children of Israel before the Lord and to be the price of your lives.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要用銅做洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要將盆放在會幕和壇的中間，在盆裡盛水。
english: You are to make a brass washing-vessel, with a brass base; and put it between the Tent of meeting and the altar, with water in it;

chinese: 亞倫和他的兒子要在這盆裡洗手洗腳。
english: That it may be used by Aaron and his sons for washing their hands and feet;

chinese: 他們進會幕，或是就近壇前供職給耶和華獻火祭的時候，必用水洗濯，免得死亡。
english: Whenever they go into the Tent of meeting they are to be washed with water, to keep them from death; and whenever they come near to do the work of the altar, or to make an offering by fire to the Lord,

chinese: 他們洗手洗腳就免得死亡。這要作亞倫和他後裔世世代代永遠的定例。
english: Their hands and feet are to be washed. so that they may be safe from death: this is an order to them for ever; to him and his seed from generation to generation.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要取上品的香料，就是流質的沒藥五百舍客勒，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，
english: Take the best spices, five hundred shekels' weight of liquid myrrh, and of sweet cinnamon half as much, that is, two hundred and fifty shekels, and two hundred and fifty shekels of sweet calamus,

chinese: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按著聖所的平，又取橄欖油一欣，
english: And of cassia, five hundred shekels' weight measured by the scale of the holy place, and of olive oil a hin:

chinese: 按做香之法調和做成聖膏油。
english: And make these into a holy oil, a perfume made by the art of the perfume-maker; it is to be a holy oil.

chinese: 要用這膏油抹會幕和法櫃，
english: This oil is to be put on the Tent of meeting, and on the ark of the law,

chinese: 桌子與桌子的一切器具，燈臺和燈臺的器具，並香壇、
english: And on the table and all its vessels, and on the support for the lights, with its vessels, and on the altar for burning spices,

chinese: 燔祭壇，和壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座。
english: And on the altar of burned offerings with its vessels, and on the washing-vessel and its base.

chinese: 要使這些物成為聖，好成為至聖；凡挨著的都成為聖。
english: And you are to make them most holy; anything touching them will become holy.

chinese: 要膏亞倫和他的兒子，使他們成為聖，可以給我供祭司的職分。
english: And put the oil on Aaron and his sons, making them holy to do the work of priests to me.

chinese: 你要對以色列人說：這油，我要世世代代以為聖膏油。
english: And say to the children of Israel, This is to be the Lord's holy oil, from generation to generation.

chinese: 不可倒在別人的身上，也不可按這調和之法做與此相似的。這膏油是聖的，你們也要以為聖。
english: It is not to be used for man's flesh, and no other is to be made like it: holy it is, and you are to keep it holy.

chinese: 凡調和與此相似的，或將這膏膏在別人身上的，這人要從民中剪除。
english: Whoever makes any like it, or puts it on one who is not a priest, will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：你要取馨香的香料，就是拿他弗、施喜列、喜利比拿；這馨香的香料和淨乳香各樣要一般大的分量。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Take sweet spices, stacte and onycha and galbanum, with the best frankincense, in equal weights;

chinese: 你要用這些加上鹽，按做香之法做成清淨聖潔的香。
english: And make from them a perfume, such as is made by the art of the perfume-maker, mixed with salt, and clean and holy.

chinese: 這香要取點搗得極細，放在會幕內、法櫃前，我要在那裡與你相會。你們要以這香為至聖。
english: And put some of it, crushed very small, in front of the ark in the Tent of meeting, where I will come face to face with you; it is to be most holy.

chinese: 你們不可按這調和之法為自己做香；要以這香為聖，歸耶和華。
english: You are not to make any perfume like it for yourselves: it is to be kept holy to the Lord.

chinese: 凡做香和這香一樣，為要聞香味的，這人要從民中剪除。
english: Whoever makes any like it, for its sweet smell, will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 看哪，猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列，我已經題他的名召他。
english: I have made selection of Bezalel, the son of Uri, by name, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

chinese: 我也以我的靈充滿了他，使他有智慧，有聰明，有知識，能做各樣的工，
english: And I have given him the spirit of God and made him wise and full of knowledge and expert in every sort of handwork,

chinese: 能想出巧工，用金、銀、銅製造各物，
english: To do all sorts of delicate work in gold and silver and brass;

chinese: 又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕刻木頭，能做各樣的工。
english: In cutting stones for framing, and to do every form of woodwork.

chinese: 我分派但支派中、亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯與他同工。凡心裡有智慧的，我更使他們有智慧，能做我一切所吩咐的，
english: And I have made selection of Oholiab with him, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the hearts of all who are wise I have put the knowledge to make whatever I have given you orders to have made;

chinese: 就是會幕和法櫃，並其上的施恩座，與會幕中一切的器具，
english: The Tent of meeting, and the ark of the law, and the cover which is on it, and all the things for the tent,

chinese: 桌子和桌子的器具，精金的燈臺和燈臺的一切器具並香壇，
english: And the table with its vessels, and the holy light-support with all its vessels, and the altar for the burning of spices,

chinese: 燔祭壇和壇的一切器具，並洗濯盆與盆座，
english: And the altar of burned offerings with all its vessels, and the washing-vessel with its base,

chinese: 精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子用以供祭司職分的聖衣，
english: And the robes of needlework, the holy robes for Aaron and for his sons, for their use when acting as priests,

chinese: 膏油和為聖所用馨香的香料。他們都要照我一切所吩咐的去做。
english: And the holy oil, and the perfume of sweet spices for the holy place; they will do whatever I have given you orders to have done.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要吩咐以色列人說：你們務要守我的安息日；因為這是你我之間世世代代的證據，使你們知道我─耶和華是叫你們成為聖的。
english: Say to the children of Israel that they are to keep my Sabbaths; for the Sabbath day is a sign between me and you through all your generations; so that you may see that I am the Lord who makes you holy.

chinese: 所以你們要守安息日，以為聖日。凡干犯這日的，必要把他治死；凡在這日做工的，必從民中剪除。
english: So you are to keep the Sabbath as a holy day; and anyone not honouring it will certainly be put to death: whoever does any work on that day will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 六日要做工，但第七日是安息聖日，是向耶和華守為聖的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。
english: Six days may work be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the Lord; whoever does any work on the Sabbath day is to be put to death.

chinese: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日為永遠的約。
english: And the children of Israel are to keep the Sabbath holy, from generation to generation, by an eternal agreement.

chinese: 這是我和以色列人永遠的證據；因為六日之內耶和華造天地，第七日便安息舒暢。
english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever; because in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he took his rest and had pleasure in it.

chinese: 耶和華在西乃山和摩西說完了話，就把兩塊法版交給他，是神用指頭寫的石版。
english: And when his talk with Moses on Mount Sinai was ended, he gave him the two stones of the law, two stones on which was the writing made by the finger of God.

chinese: 百姓見摩西遲延不下山，就大家聚集到亞倫那裡，對他說：起來！為我們做神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。
english: And when the people saw that Moses was a long time coming down from the mountain, they all came to Aaron and said to him, Come, make us a god to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us up out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has become of him.

chinese: 亞倫對他們說：你們去摘下你們妻子、兒女耳上的金環，拿來給我。
english: Then Aaron said to them, Take off the gold rings which are in the ears of your wives and your sons and your daughters, and give them to me.

chinese: 百姓就都摘下他們耳上的金環，拿來給亞倫。
english: And all the people took the gold rings from their ears and gave them to Aaron.

chinese: 亞倫從他們手裡接過來，鑄了一隻牛犢，用雕刻的器具做成。他們就說：以色列阿，這是領你出埃及地的神。
english: And he took the gold from them and, hammering it with an instrument, he made it into the metal image of a young ox: and they said, This is your god, O Israel, who took you out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 亞倫看見，就在牛犢面前築壇，且宣告說：明日要向耶和華守節。
english: And when Aaron saw this, he made an altar before it, and made a public statement, saying, Tomorrow there will be a feast to the Lord.

chinese: 次日清早，百姓起來獻燔祭和平安祭，就坐下吃喝，起來玩耍。
english: So early on the day after they got up and made burned offerings and peace-offerings; and took their seats at the feast, and then gave themselves to pleasure.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：下去罷，因為你的百姓，就是你從埃及地領出來的，已經敗壞了。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go down quickly; for your people, whom you took out of the land of Egypt, are turned to evil ways;

chinese: 他們快快偏離了我所吩咐的道，為自己鑄了一隻牛犢，向他下拜獻祭，說：以色列阿，這就是領你出埃及地的神。
english: Even now they are turned away from the rule I gave them, and have made themselves a metal ox and given worship to it and offerings, saying, This is your god, O Israel, who took you up out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：我看這百姓真是硬著頸項的百姓。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, I have been watching this people, and I see that they are a stiff-necked people.

chinese: 你且由著我，我要向他們發烈怒，將他們滅絕，使你的後裔成為大國。
english: Now do not get in my way, for my wrath is burning against them; I will send destruction on them, but of you I will make a great nation.

chinese: 摩西便懇求耶和華─他的神說：耶和華阿，你為甚麼向你的百姓發烈怒呢？這百姓是你用大力和大能的手從埃及地領出來的。
english: But Moses made prayer to God, saying, Lord, why is your wrath burning against your people whom you took out of the land of Egypt, with great power and with the strength of your hand?

chinese: 為甚麼使埃及人議論說他領他們出去，是要降禍與他們，把他們殺在山中，將他們從地上除滅？求你轉意，不發你的烈怒，後悔，不降禍與你的百姓。
english: Why let the Egyptians say, He took them out to an evil fate, to put them to death on the mountains, cutting them off from the earth? Let your wrath be turned away from them, and send not this evil on your people.

chinese: 求你記念你的僕人亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列。你曾指著自己起誓說：我必使你們的後裔像天上的星那樣多，並且我所應許的這全地，必給你們的後裔，他們要永遠承受為業。
english: Have in mind Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you gave your oath, saying, I will make your seed like the stars of heaven in number, and all this land will I give to your seed, as I said, to be their heritage for ever.

chinese: 於是耶和華後悔，不把所說的禍降與他的百姓。
english: So the Lord let himself be turned from his purpose of sending punishment on his people.

chinese: 摩西轉身下山，手裡拿著兩塊法版。這版是兩面寫的，這面那面都有字，
english: Then Moses came down the mountain with the two stones of the law in his hand; the stones had writing on their two sides, on the front and on the back.

chinese: 是神的工作，字是　神寫的，刻在版上。
english: The stones were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, cut on the stones.

chinese: 約書亞一聽見百姓呼喊的聲音，就對摩西說：在營裡有爭戰的聲音。
english: Now when the noise and the voices of the people came to the ears of Joshua, he said to Moses, There is a noise of war in the tents.

chinese: 摩西說：這不是人打勝仗的聲音，也不是人打敗仗的聲音，我所聽見的乃是人歌唱的聲音。
english: And Moses said, It is not the voice of men who are overcoming in the fight, or the cry of those who have been overcome; it is the sound of songs which comes to my ear.

chinese: 摩西挨近營前就看見牛犢，又看見人跳舞，便發烈怒，把兩塊版扔在山下摔碎了，
english: And when he came near the tents he saw the image of the ox, and the people dancing; and in his wrath Moses let the stones go from his hands, and they were broken at the foot of the mountain.

chinese: 又將他們所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。
english: And he took the ox which they had made, burning it in the fire and crushing it to powder, and he put it in the water and made the children of Israel take a drink of it.

chinese: 摩西對亞倫說：這百姓向你做了甚麼？你竟使他們陷在大罪裡！
english: And Moses said to Aaron, What did the people do to you that you let this great sin come on them?

chinese: 亞倫說：求我主不要發烈怒。這百姓專於作惡，是你知道的。
english: And Aaron said, Let not my lord be angry; you have seen how the purposes of this people are evil.

chinese: 他們對我說：你為我們做神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。
english: For they said to me, Make us a god to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us up out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has come to him.

chinese: 我對他們說：凡有金環的可以摘下來，他們就給了我。我把金環扔在火中，這牛犢便出來了。
english: Then I said to them, Whoever has any gold, let him take it off; so they gave it to me, and I put it in the fire, and this image of an ox came out.

chinese: 摩西見百姓放肆（亞倫縱容他們，使他們在仇敵中間被譏刺），
english: And Moses saw that the people were out of control, for Aaron had let them loose to their shame before their haters:

chinese: 就站在營門中，說：凡屬耶和華的，都要到我這裡來！於是利未的子孫都到他那裡聚集。
english: Then Moses took his place at the way into the tents, and said, Whoever is on the Lord's side, let him come to me. And all the sons of Levi came together to him.

chinese: 他對他們說：耶和華─以色列的神這樣說：你們各人把刀跨在腰間，在營中往來，從這門到那門，各人殺他的弟兄與同伴並鄰舍。
english: And he said to them, This is the word of the Lord, the God of Israel: Let every man take his sword at his side, and go from one end of the tents to the other, putting to death his brother and his friend and his neighbour.

chinese: 利未的子孫照摩西的話行了。那一天百姓中被殺的約有三千。
english: And the sons of Levi did as Moses said; and about three thousand of the people were put to death that day.

chinese: 摩西說：今天你們要自潔，歸耶和華為聖，各人攻擊他的兒子和弟兄，使耶和華賜福與你們。
english: And Moses said, You have made yourselves priests to the Lord this day; for every one of you has made the offering of his son and his brother; the blessing of the Lord is on you this day.

chinese: 到了第二天，摩西對百姓說：你們犯了大罪。我如今要上耶和華那裡去，或者可以為你們贖罪。
english: And on the day after, Moses said to the people, Great has been your sin: but I will go up to the Lord, and see if I may get forgiveness for your sin.

chinese: 摩西回到耶和華那裡，說：唉！這百姓犯了大罪，為自己做了金像。
english: Then Moses went back to the Lord and said, This people has done a great sin, making themselves a god of gold;

chinese: 倘或你肯赦免他們的罪……不然，求你從你所寫的冊上塗抹我的名。
english: But now, if you will give them forgiveness--but if not, let my name be taken out of your book.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：誰得罪我，我就從我的冊上塗抹誰的名。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Whoever has done evil against me will be taken out of my book.

chinese: 現在你去領這百姓，往我所告訴你的地方去，我的使者必在你前面引路；只是到我追討的日子，我必追討他們的罪。
english: But now, go, take the people into that place of which I have given you word; see, my angel will go before you: but when the time of my judging has come, I will send punishment on them for their sin.

chinese: 耶和華殺百姓的緣故是因他們同亞倫做了牛犢。
english: And the Lord sent punishment on the people because they gave worship to the ox which Aaron made.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：我曾起誓應許亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各說：要將迦南地賜給你的後裔。現在你和你從埃及地所領出來的百姓，要從這裡往那地去。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go forward from this place, you and the people whom you have taken up out of the land of Egypt, to that land about which I made an oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed will I give it.

chinese: 我要差遣使者在你前面，攆出迦南人、亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
english: And I will send an angel before you, driving out the Canaanite and the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite:

chinese: 領你到那流奶與蜜之地。我自己不同你們上去；因為你們是硬著頸項的百姓，恐怕我在路上把你們滅絕。
english: Go up to that land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, for fear that I send destruction on you while you are on the way.

chinese: 百姓聽見這凶信就悲哀，也沒有人佩戴妝飾。
english: Hearing this bad news the people were full of grief, and no one put on his ornaments.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你告訴以色列人說：耶和華說：你們是硬著頸項的百姓，我若一霎時臨到你們中間，必滅絕你們。現在你們要把身上的妝飾摘下來，使我可以知道怎樣待你們
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You are a stiff-necked people: if I come among you, even for a minute, I will send destruction on you; so take off all your ornaments, so that I may see what to do with you.

chinese: 以色列人從住何烈山以後，就把身上的妝飾摘得乾淨。
english: So the children of Israel took off their ornaments at Mount Horeb, and did not put them on again.

chinese: 摩西素常將帳棚支搭在營外，離營卻遠，他稱這帳棚為會幕。凡求問耶和華的，就到營外的會幕那裡去。
english: Now it was Moses' way to put up the Tent of meeting outside the tent-circle, at some distance away; giving it the name of The Tent of meeting. And everyone desiring to make his prayer to the Lord went to the Tent of meeting outside the tent-circle.

chinese: 當摩西出營到會幕去的時候，百姓就都起來，各人站在自己帳棚的門口，望著摩西，直等到他進了會幕。
english: And whenever Moses went out to the Tent of meeting, all the people got up and everyone went to the door of his tent, looking after Moses till he went inside the Tent.

chinese: 摩西進會幕的時候，雲柱降下來，立在會幕的門前，耶和華便與摩西說話。
english: And whenever Moses went into the Tent, the pillar of cloud came down, and took its place by the door of the Tent, as long as the Lord was talking with Moses.

chinese: 眾百姓看見雲柱立在會幕門前，就都起來，各人在自己帳棚的門口下拜。
english: And all the people saw the cloud at the door of the Tent, and they went down on their faces, everyone at the door of his tent.

chinese: 耶和華與摩西面對面說話，好像人與朋友說話一般。摩西轉到營裡去，惟有他的幫手─一個少年人嫩的兒子約書亞不離開會幕。
english: And the Lord had talk with Moses face to face, as a man may have talk with his friend. And when Moses came back to the tents, his servant, the young man Joshua, the son of Nun, did not come away from the Tent.

chinese: 摩西對耶和華說：你吩咐我說：將這百姓領上去，卻沒有叫我知道你要打發誰與我同去，只說：我按你的名認識你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。
english: And Moses said to the Lord, See, you say to me, Be this people's guide on their journey, but you have not made clear to me whom you will send with me. But you have said, I have knowledge of you by name, and you have grace in my eyes.

chinese: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你將你的道指示我，使我可以認識你，好在你眼前蒙恩。求你想到這民是你的民。
english: If then I have grace in your eyes, let me see your ways, so that I may have knowledge of you and be certain of your grace; and my prayer is that you will keep in mind that this nation is your people.

chinese: 耶和華說：我必親自和你同去，使你得安息。
english: And he said, I myself will go with you and give you rest.

chinese: 摩西說：你若不親自和我同去，就不要把我們從這裡領上去。
english: And Moses said, If you yourself are not going with us, do not send us on from here.

chinese: 人在何事上得以知道我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩呢？豈不是因你與我們同去、使我和你的百姓與地上的萬民有分別麼？
english: For is not the fact of your going with us the sign that I and this people have grace in your eyes, so that we, that is, I and your people, are separate from all other people on the face of the earth?

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你這所求的我也要行；因為你在我眼前蒙了恩，並且我按你的名認識你。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, I will do as you say: for you have grace in my eyes, and I have knowledge of you by your name.

chinese: 摩西說：求你顯出你的榮耀給我看。
english: And Moses said, O Lord, let me see your glory.

chinese: 耶和華說：我要顯我一切的恩慈，在你面前經過，宣告我的名。我要恩待誰就恩待誰；要憐憫誰就憐憫誰；
english: And he said, I will make all the light of my being come before you, and will make clear to you what I am; I will be kind to those to whom I will be kind, and have mercy on those on whom I will have mercy.

chinese: 又說：你不能看見我的面，因為人見我的面不能存活。
english: But it is not possible for you to see my face, for no man may see me and still go on living.

chinese: 耶和華說：看哪，在我這裡有地方，你要站在磐石上。
english: And the Lord said, See, there is a place near me, and you may take your place on the rock:

chinese: 我的榮耀經過的時候，我必將你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，等我過去，
english: And when my glory goes by, I will put you in a hole in the rock, covering you with my hand till I have gone past:

chinese: 然後我要將我的手收回，你就得見我的背，卻不得見我的面。
english: Then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back: but my face is not to be seen.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：你要鑿出兩塊石版，和先前你摔碎的那版一樣；其上的字我要寫在這版上。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Make two other stones like the first two; and I will put on them the words which were on the first stones, which were broken by you.

chinese: 明日早晨，你要預備好了，上西乃山，在山頂上站在我面前。
english: And be ready by the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai, and come before me there in the morning, on the top of the mountain.

chinese: 誰也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山根也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。
english: No one is to come up with you, and let no man be seen anywhere on the mountain; let no flocks or herds come near to get their food at its foot.

chinese: 摩西就鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣。清晨起來，照耶和華所吩咐的上西乃山去，手裡拿著兩塊石版。
english: So Moses got two stones cut like the first; and early in the morning he went up Mount Sinai, as the Lord had said, with the two stones in his hand.

chinese: 耶和華在雲中降臨，和摩西一同站在那裡，宣告耶和華的名。
english: And the Lord came down in the cloud and took his place by the side of Moses, and Moses gave worship to the name of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華在他面前宣告說：耶和華，耶和華，是有憐憫有恩典的神，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和誠實，
english: And the Lord went past before his eyes, saying, The Lord, the Lord, a God full of pity and grace, slow to wrath and great in mercy and faith;

chinese: 為千萬人存留慈愛，赦免罪孽、過犯，和罪惡，萬不以有罪的為無罪，必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。
english: Having mercy on thousands, overlooking evil and wrongdoing and sin; he will not let wrongdoers go free, but will send punishment on children for the sins of their fathers, and on their children's children to the third and fourth generation.

chinese: 摩西急忙伏地下拜，
english: Then Moses quickly went down on his face in worship.

chinese: 說：主阿，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在我們中間同行，因為這是硬著頸項的百姓。又求你赦免我們的罪孽和罪惡，以我們為你的產業。
english: And he said, If now I have grace in your eyes, let the Lord go among us, for this is a stiff-necked people, and give us forgiveness for our wrongdoing and our sin, and take us for your heritage.

chinese: 耶和華說：我要立約，要在百姓面前行奇妙的事，是在遍地萬國中所未曾行的。在你四圍的外邦人就要看見耶和華的作為，因我向你所行的是可畏懼的事。
english: And the Lord said, See, this is what I will undertake: before the eyes of your people I will do wonders, such as have not been done in all the earth or in any nation: and all your people will see the work of the Lord, for what I am about to do for you is greatly to be feared.

chinese: 我今天所吩咐你的，你要謹守。我要從你面前攆出亞摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
english: Take care to do the orders which I give you today; I will send out from before you the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.

chinese: 你要謹慎，不可與你所去那地的居民立約，恐怕成為你們中間的網羅；
english: But take care, and do not make any agreement with the people of the land where you are going, for it will be a cause of sin to you.

chinese: 卻要拆毀他們的祭壇，打碎他們的柱像，砍下他們的木偶。
english: But their altars are to be overturned and their pillars broken and their images cut down:

chinese: 不可敬拜別神；因為耶和華是忌邪的神，名為忌邪者。
english: For you are to be worshippers of no other god: for the Lord is a God who will not give his honour to another.

chinese: 只怕你與那地的居民立約，百姓隨從他們的神，就行邪淫，祭祀他們的　神，有人叫你，你便吃他的祭物，
english: So see that you make no agreement with the people of the land, and do not go after their gods, or take part in their offerings, or be guests at their feasts,

chinese: 又為你的兒子娶他們的女兒為妻，他們的女兒隨從他們的神，就行邪淫，使你的兒子也隨從他們的　神行邪淫。
english: Or take their daughters for your sons; for when their daughters give worship before their gods, they will make your sons take part with them.

chinese: 不可為自己鑄造神像。
english: Make for yourselves no gods of metal.

chinese: 你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期吃無酵餅七天，因為你是這亞筆月內出了埃及。
english: Keep the feast of unleavened bread; for seven days your food is to be bread without leaven, as I gave you orders, at the regular time in the month Abib; for in that month you came out of Egypt.

chinese: 凡頭生的都是我的；一切牲畜頭生的，無論是牛是羊，公的都是我的。
english: Every first male child is mine; the first male birth of your cattle, the first male of every ox and sheep.

chinese: 頭生的驢要用羊羔代贖，若不代贖就要打折他的頸項。凡頭生的兒子都要贖出來。誰也不可空手朝見我。
english: A lamb may be given in payment for the young of an ass, but if you will not make payment for it, its neck will have to be broken. For all the first of your sons you are to make payment. No one is to come before me without an offering.

chinese: 你六日要做工，第七日要安息，雖在耕種收割的時候也要安息。
english: Six days let work be done, but on the seventh day take your rest: at ploughing time and at the grain-cutting you are to have a day for rest.

chinese: 在收割初熟麥子的時候要守七七節；又在年底要守收藏節。
english: And you are to keep the feast of weeks when you get in the first-fruits of the grain, and the feast at the turn of the year when you take in the produce of your fields.

chinese: 你們一切男丁要一年三次朝見主耶和華─以色列的神。
english: Three times in the year let all your males come before the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 我要從你面前趕出外邦人，擴張你的境界。你一年三次上去朝見耶和華─你神的時候，必沒有人貪慕你的地土。
english: For I will send out the nations before you and make wide the limits of your land; and no man will make an attempt to take your land while you go up to give worship to the Lord, three times in the year.

chinese: 你不可將我祭物的血和有酵的餅一同獻上。逾越節的祭物也不可留到早晨。
english: No leaven is to be offered with the blood of my offering, and the offering of the Passover feast may not be kept till the morning.

chinese: 地裡首先初熟之物要送到耶和華─你神的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
english: Take the first-fruits of your land as an offering to the house of the Lord your God. Let not the young goat be cooked in its mother's milk

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：你要將這些話寫上，因為我是按這話與你和以色列人立約。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Put all these words in writing; for on them is based the agreement which I will make with you.

chinese: 摩西在耶和華那裡四十晝夜，也不吃飯也不喝水。耶和華將這約的話，就是十條誡，寫在兩塊版上。
english: And for forty days and forty nights Moses was there with the Lord, and in that time he had no food or drink. And he put in writing on the stones the words of the agreement, the ten rules of the law.

chinese: 摩西手裡拿著兩塊法版下西乃山的時候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和華和他說話就發了光。
english: Now when Moses came down from Mount Sinai, with the two stones in his hand, he was not conscious that his face was shining because of his talk with God.

chinese: 亞倫和以色列眾人看見摩西的面皮發光就怕挨近他。
english: But when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, and the shining of his face, they would not come near him for fear.

chinese: 摩西叫他們來；於是亞倫和會眾的官長都到他那裡去，摩西就與他們說話。
english: Then Moses sent for them; and Aaron, with the chiefs of the people, came to him; and Moses had talk with them.

chinese: 隨後以色列眾人都近前來，他就把耶和華在西乃山與他所說的一切話都吩咐他們。
english: And later, all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the orders which the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.

chinese: 摩西與他們說完了話就用帕子蒙上臉。
english: And at the end of his talk with them, Moses put a veil over his face.

chinese: 但摩西進到耶和華面前與他說話就揭去帕子，及至出來的時候便將耶和華所吩咐的告訴以色列人。
english: But whenever Moses went in before the Lord to have talk with him, he took off the veil till he came out. And whenever he came out he said to the children of Israel what he had been ordered to say;

chinese: 以色列人看見摩西的面皮發光。摩西又用帕子蒙上臉，等到他進去與耶和華說話就揭去帕子。
english: And the children of Israel saw that the face of Moses was shining: so Moses put the veil over his face again till he went to the Lord.

chinese: 摩西招聚以色列全會眾，對他們說：這是耶和華所吩咐的話，叫你們照著行：
english: And Moses sent for all the children of Israel to come together, and said to them, This is what the Lord has said and these are his orders.

chinese: 六日要做工，第七日乃為聖日，當向耶和華守為安息聖日。凡這日之內做工的，必把他治死。
english: Six days let work be done, but the seventh day is to be a holy day to you, a Sabbath of rest to the Lord; whoever does any work on that day is to be put to death.

chinese: 當安息日，不可在你們一切的住處生火。
english: No fire is to be lighted in any of your houses on the Sabbath day.

chinese: 摩西對以色列全會眾說：耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：
english: And Moses said to all the meeting of the children of Israel, This is the order which the Lord has given:

chinese: 你們中間要拿禮物獻給耶和華，凡樂意獻的可以拿耶和華的禮物來，就是金、銀、銅，
english: Take from among you an offering to the Lord; everyone who has the impulse in his heart, let him give his offering to the Lord; gold and silver and brass;

chinese: 藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，細麻，山羊毛，
english: And blue and purple and red and the best linen and goats' hair,

chinese: 染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂莢木，
english: And sheepskins coloured red, and leather, and hard wood,

chinese: 點燈的油，並做膏油和香的香料，
english: And oil for the lights, and spices for the holy oil and for the sweet perfumes for burning.

chinese: 紅瑪瑙與別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得和胸牌上
english: And beryls and jewels to be cut for the ephod and for the priest's bag.

chinese: 你們中間凡心裡有智慧的都要來做耶和華一切所吩咐的：
english: And let every wise-hearted man among you come and make whatever has been ordered by the Lord;

chinese: 就是帳幕和帳幕的罩棚，並帳幕的蓋、鉤子、板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，
english: The House and its tent and its cover, its hooks and its boards, its rods and its pillars and its bases;

chinese: 櫃和櫃的杠，施恩座和遮掩櫃的幔子，
english: The ark with its cover and its rods and the veil hanging before it;

chinese: 桌子和桌子的杠與桌子的一切器具，並陳設餅，
english: The table and its rods and all its vessels, and the holy bread;

chinese: 燈臺和燈臺的器具，燈盞並點燈的油，
english: And the support for the lights, with its vessels and its lights and the oil for the light;

chinese: 香壇和壇的杠，膏油和馨香的香料，並帳幕門口的簾子，
english: And the altar for burning spices, with its rods, and the holy oil and the sweet perfume, and the curtain for the door, at the door of the House;

chinese: 燔祭壇和壇的銅網，壇的杠並壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
english: The altar of burned offerings, with its network of brass, its rods, and all its vessels, the washing-vessel and its base;

chinese: 院子的帷子和帷子的柱子，帶卯的座和院子的門簾，
english: The hangings for the open space, its pillars and their bases, and the curtain for the doorway;

chinese: 帳幕的橛子並院子的橛子，和這兩處的繩子，
english: The nails for the House, and the nails for the open space and their cords;

chinese: 精工做的禮服和祭司亞倫並他兒子在聖所用以供祭司職分的聖衣。
english: The robes of needlework for the work of the holy place, the holy robes for Aaron the priest, and the robes for his sons when acting as priests.

chinese: 以色列全會眾從摩西面前退去。
english: And all the children of Israel went away from Moses.

chinese: 凡心裡受感和甘心樂意的都拿耶和華的禮物來，用以做會幕和其中一切的使用，又用以做聖衣。
english: And everyone whose heart was moved, everyone who was guided by the impulse of his spirit, came with his offering for the Lord, for whatever was needed for the Tent of meeting and its work and for the holy robes.

chinese: 凡心裡樂意獻禮物的，連男帶女，各將金器，就是胸前鍼、耳環（或作：鼻環）、打印的戒指，和手釧帶來獻給耶和華。
english: They came, men and women, all who were ready to give, and gave pins and nose-rings and finger-rings and neck-ornaments, all of gold; everyone gave an offering of gold to the Lord.

chinese: 凡有藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，細麻，山羊毛，染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都拿了來；
english: And everyone who had blue and purple and red and the best linen and goats' hair and sheepskins coloured red and leather, gave them.

chinese: 凡獻銀子和銅給耶和華為禮物的都拿了來；凡有皂莢木可做甚麼使用的也拿了來。
english: Everyone who had silver and brass gave an offering of them to the Lord; and everyone who had hard wood, such as was needed for the work, gave it.

chinese: 凡心中有智慧的婦女親手紡線，把所紡的藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和細麻都拿了來。
english: And all the women who were expert with their hands, made cloth, and gave the work of their hands, blue and purple and red and the best linen.

chinese: 凡有智慧、心裡受感的婦女就紡山羊毛。
english: And those women who had the knowledge, made the goats' hair into cloth.

chinese: 眾官長把紅瑪瑙和別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得與胸牌上的，都拿了來；
english: And the rulers gave the beryls and the cut jewels for the ephod and the priest's bag;

chinese: 又拿香料做香，拿油點燈，做膏油。
english: And the spice and the oil for the light, and the holy oil and the sweet perfumes.

chinese: 以色列人，無論男女，凡甘心樂意獻禮物給耶和華的，都將禮物拿來，做耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的一切工。
english: The children of Israel, every man and woman, from the impulse of their hearts, gave their offerings freely to the Lord for the work which the Lord had given Moses orders to have done.

chinese: 摩西對以色列人說：猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列，耶和華已經題他的名召他，
english: And Moses said to the children of Israel, See, the Lord has made selection of Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

chinese: 又以神的靈充滿了他，使他有智慧、聰明、知識，能做各樣的工，
english: And he has made him full of the spirit of God, in all wisdom and knowledge and art of every sort;

chinese: 能想出巧工，用金、銀、銅製造各物，
english: As an expert designer of beautiful things, working in gold and silver and brass;

chinese: 又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕刻木頭，能做各樣的巧工。
english: Trained in the cutting of stones and the ornamenting of wood and in every sort of handwork.

chinese: 耶和華又使他，和但支派中亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯，心裡靈明，能教導人。
english: And he has given to him, and to Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the power of training others.

chinese: 耶和華使他們的心滿有智慧，能做各樣的工，無論是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和細麻、繡花的工，並機匠的工，他們都能做，也能想出奇巧的工。
english: To them he has given knowledge of all the arts of the handworker, of the designer, and the expert workman; of the maker of needlework in blue and purple and red and the best linen, and of the maker of cloth; in all the arts of the designer and the trained workman they are expert.

chinese: 比撒列和亞何利亞伯，並一切心裡有智慧的，就是蒙耶和華賜智慧聰明、叫他知道做聖所各樣使用之工的，都要照耶和華所吩咐的做工。
english: So let Bezalel and Oholiab get to work, with every wise-hearted man to whom the Lord has given wisdom and knowledge, to do whatever is necessary for the ordering of the holy place, as the Lord has given orders.

chinese: 凡耶和華賜他心裡有智慧、而且受感前來做這工的，摩西把他們和比撒列並亞何利亞伯一同召來。
english: Then Moses sent for Bezalel and Oholiab, and for all the wise-hearted men to whom the Lord had given wisdom, even everyone who was moved by the impulse of his heart to come and take part in the work:

chinese: 這些人就從摩西收了以色列人為做聖所並聖所使用之工所拿來的禮物。百姓每早晨還把甘心獻的禮物拿來。
english: And they took from Moses all the offerings which the children of Israel had given for the building of the holy place. And still they went on giving him more free offerings every morning.

chinese: 凡做聖所一切工的智慧人各都離開他所作的工，
english: Then the wise men, who were doing all the work of the holy place, came from their work;

chinese: 來對摩西說：百姓為耶和華吩咐使用之工所拿來的，富富有餘。
english: And said to Moses, The people are giving much more than is needed for the work which the Lord has given us orders to do.

chinese: 摩西傳命，他們就在全營中宣告說：無論男女，不必再為聖所拿甚麼禮物來。這樣才攔住百姓不再拿禮物來。
english: So Moses made an order and had it given out through all the tents, saying, Let no man or woman make any more offerings for the holy place. So the people were kept from giving more.

chinese: 因為他們所有的材料夠做一切當做的物，而且有餘。
english: For the material they had was enough and more than enough for all the work which had to be done.

chinese: 他們中間，凡心裡有智慧做工的，用十幅幔子做帳幕。這幔子是比撒列用撚的細麻和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線製造的，並用巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
english: Then all the expert workmen among them made the House with its ten curtains; of the best linen, blue and purple and red, they made them, with winged ones worked by expert designers.

chinese: 每幅幔子長二十八肘，寬四肘，都是一樣的尺寸。
english: Every curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

chinese: 他使這五幅幔子幅幅相連，又使那五幅幔子幅幅相連；
english: And five curtains were joined together, and the other five curtains were joined together.

chinese: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上做藍色的鈕扣，在那相連的幔子末幅邊上也照樣做；
english: And they put twists of blue cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group, and in the same way on the outside curtain of the second group.

chinese: 在這相連的幔子上做五十個鈕扣，在那相連的幔子上也做五十個鈕扣，都是兩兩相對；
english: Fifty twists on the one curtain and fifty on the edge of the curtain of the other group; the twists being opposite to one another.

chinese: 又做五十個金鉤，使幔子相連。這才成了一個帳幕。
english: And they made fifty hooks of gold, joining the curtains one to another with the hooks; and so the House was made.

chinese: 他用山羊毛織十一幅幔子，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
english: And they made curtains of goats' hair for the tent; eleven curtains were made.

chinese: 每幅幔子長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幔子都是一樣的尺寸。
english: Every curtain was thirty cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

chinese: 他把五幅幔子連成一幅，又把六幅幔子連成一幅；
english: Five curtains were joined together to make one group, and six curtains were joined together to make the other group.

chinese: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上做五十個鈕扣，在那相連的幔子末幅邊上也做五十個鈕扣；
english: And they put fifty twists of cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group, and fifty twists on the edge of the outside curtain of the second group,

chinese: 又做五十個銅鉤，使罩棚連成一個；
english: And fifty hooks of brass for joining them together to make the tent.

chinese: 並用染紅的公羊皮做罩棚的蓋，再用海狗皮做一層罩棚上的頂蓋。
english: And they made a cover of sheepskins coloured red, to go over the tent, and a cover of leather over that.

chinese: 他用皂莢木做帳幕的豎板。
english: And for the uprights of the House they made boards of hard wood.

chinese: 每塊長十肘，寬一肘半；
english: The boards were ten cubits long and one cubit and a half wide.

chinese: 每塊有兩榫相對。帳幕一切的板都是這樣做。
english: Every board had two tongues fixed into it; all the boards were made in this way.

chinese: 帳幕的南面做板二十塊。
english: They made twenty boards for the south side of the House:

chinese: 在這二十塊板底下又做四十個帶卯的銀座：兩卯接這塊板上的兩榫，兩卯接那塊板上的兩榫。
english: And for these twenty boards, forty silver bases, two bases under every board, to take its tongues.

chinese: 帳幕的第二面，就是北面，也做板二十塊
english: And for the second side of the House, on the north, they made twenty boards,

chinese: 和帶卯的銀座四十個：這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
english: With their forty silver bases, two bases for every board.

chinese: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，做板六塊。
english: And for the west side of the House, at the back, they made six boards,

chinese: 帳幕後面的拐角做板兩塊。
english: And two boards for the angles at the back.

chinese: 板的下半截是雙的，上半截是整的，直到第一個環子；在帳幕的兩個拐角上都是這樣做。
english: These were joined together at the base and at the top to one ring, so forming the two angles.

chinese: 有八塊板和十六個帶卯的銀座，每塊板底下有兩卯。
english: So there were eight boards with sixteen bases of silver, two bases under every board.

chinese: 他用皂莢木做閂：為帳幕這面的板做五閂，
english: And they made rods of hard wood; five for the boards on one side of the House,

chinese: 為帳幕那面的板做五閂，又為帳幕後面的板做五閂，
english: And five for the boards on the other side of the House, and five for the boards at the back, on the west.

chinese: 使板腰間的中閂從這一頭通到那一頭。
english: The middle rod was made to go right through the rings of all the boards from one end to the other.

chinese: 用金子將板包裹，又做板上的金環套閂；閂也用金子包裹。
english: All the boards were plated with gold, and the rings through which the rods went were of gold, and the rods were plated with gold.

chinese: 他用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
english: And he made the veil of the best linen, blue and purple and red, worked with winged ones designed by expert workmen.

chinese: 為幔子做四根皂莢木柱子，用金包裹，柱子上有金鉤，又為柱子鑄了四個帶卯的銀座。
english: And they made four pillars for it of hard wood plated with gold: they had hooks of gold and four silver bases.

chinese: 拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾；
english: And they made a curtain for the door of the tent, of the best linen with needlework of blue and purple and red;

chinese: 又為簾子做五根柱子和柱子上的鉤子，用金子把柱頂和柱子上的杆子包裹。柱子有五個帶卯的座，是銅的。
english: And five pillars for the curtain, with their hooks; the heads of the pillars were of gold and they were circled with bands of gold; and their five bases were of brass.

chinese: 比撒列用皂莢木做櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半。
english: And Bezalel made the ark of hard wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit and a half high;

chinese: 裡外包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊，
english: Plating it inside and out with the best gold, and putting an edge of gold all round it.

chinese: 又鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上：這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
english: And he made four gold rings for its four angles, two on one side and two on the other,

chinese: 用皂莢木做兩根杠，用金包裹。
english: And rods of the same wood plated with gold.

chinese: 把杠穿在櫃旁的環內，以便抬櫃。
english: These rods he put in the rings at the sides of the ark, for lifting it.

chinese: 用精金做施恩座，長二肘半，寬一肘半。
english: And he made the cover all of gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

chinese: 用金子錘出兩個基路伯來，安在施恩座的兩頭，
english: And he made two winged ones, hammered out of one bit of gold, for the two ends of the cover;

chinese: 這頭做一個基路伯，那頭做一個基路伯，二基路伯接連一塊，在施恩座的兩頭。
english: Placing one at one end and one at the other; the winged ones were part of the cover.

chinese: 二基路伯高張翅膀，遮掩施恩座；基路伯是臉對臉，朝著施恩座。
english: And their wings were stretched out over the cover; the faces of the winged ones were opposite one another and facing the cover.

chinese: 他用皂莢木做一張桌子，長二肘，寬一肘，高一肘半，
english: And he made the table of hard wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high;

chinese: 又包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
english: Plating it with the best gold and putting a gold edge all round it.

chinese: 桌子的四圍各做一掌寬的橫梁，橫梁上鑲著金牙邊，
english: And he made a frame all round it about as wide as a man's hand, edged with gold all round.

chinese: 又鑄了四個金環，安在桌子四腳的四角上。
english: And he made four gold rings, and put the rings at the angles of its four feet.

chinese: 安環子的地方是挨近橫梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。
english: The rings were fixed under the frame to take the rods with which the table was to be lifted.

chinese: 他用皂莢木做兩根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子；
english: The rods for lifting the table he made of hard wood plated with gold.

chinese: 又用精金做桌子上的器皿，就是盤子、調羹，並奠酒的瓶和爵。
english: And all the table-vessels, the plates and spoons and basins and the cups for liquids, he made of the best gold.

chinese: 他用精金做一個燈臺；這燈臺的座和榦，與杯、球、花，都是接連一塊錘出來的。
english: Then he made the support for the lights, all of the best gold; its base and its pillar were of hammered gold; its cups and buds and flowers were all made out of the same metal:

chinese: 燈臺兩旁杈出六個枝子：這旁三個，那旁三個。
english: It had six branches coming out from its sides, three from one side and three from the other;

chinese: 這旁每枝上有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花；那旁每枝上也有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花。從燈臺杈出來的六個枝子都是如此。
english: Every branch having three cups made like almond flowers, every cup with a bud and a flower on all the branches;

chinese: 燈臺上有四個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花。
english: And on its pillar, four cups like almond flowers, every one with its bud and its flower;

chinese: 燈臺每兩個枝子以下有球，與枝子接連一塊；燈臺杈出的六個枝子都是如此。
english: And under every two branches a bud, made with the branch, for all six branches of it.

chinese: 球和枝子是接連一塊，都是一塊精金錘出來的。
english: The buds and the branches were made of the same metal, all together one complete work of the best hammered gold.

chinese: 用精金做燈臺的七個燈盞，並燈臺的蠟剪和蠟花盤。
english: And he made the seven vessels for the lights, and all the necessary instruments for it, of gold.

chinese: 他用精金一他連得做燈臺和燈臺的一切器具。
english: A talent of the best gold was used for the making of it and its vessels.

chinese: 他用皂莢木做香壇，是四方的，長一肘，寬一肘，高二肘，壇的四角與壇接連一塊；
english: And he made the altar for the burning of spices, using the same hard wood; it was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide and two cubits high; the horns made of the same.

chinese: 又用精金把壇的上面與壇的四面並壇的四角包裹，又在壇的四圍鑲上金牙邊。
english: The top and the sides and the horns were all plated with the best gold; and he put an edge of gold all round it.

chinese: 做兩個金環，安在牙子邊以下，在壇的兩旁、兩根橫撐上，作為穿杠的用處，以便抬壇。
english: And he made two gold rings, placing them on the two opposite sides under the edge, to take the rods for lifting it.

chinese: 用皂莢木做杠，用金包裹。
english: The rods he made of the same hard wood, plating them with gold.

chinese: 又按做香之法做聖膏油和馨香料的淨香。
english: And he made the holy oil and the perfume of sweet spices for burning, after the art of the perfume-maker.

chinese: 他用皂莢木做燔祭壇，是四方的，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘，
english: The altar of burned offerings he made of hard wood; a square altar, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high,

chinese: 在壇的四拐角上做四個角，與壇接連一塊，用銅把壇包裹。
english: And he put horns at its four angles made of the same, plating it all with brass;

chinese: 他做壇上的盆、鏟子、盤子、肉鍤子、火鼎；這一切器具都是用銅做的。
english: And brass was used for all the vessels of the altar, the baskets and the spades, the basins and the meat-hooks and the fire-trays; all the vessels he made of brass

chinese: 又為壇做一個銅網，安在壇四面的圍腰板以下，從下達到壇的半腰。
english: And he made a network of brass for the altar, under the frame round it, stretching half-way up;

chinese: 為銅網的四角鑄四個環子，作為穿杠的用處。
english: And four rings for the four angles of this network, to take the rods.

chinese: 用皂莢木做杠，用銅包裹，
english: The rods he made of hard wood plated with brass.

chinese: 把杠穿在壇兩旁的環子內，用以抬壇，並用板做壇；壇是空的。
english: He put the rods through the rings at the opposite sides of the altar for lifting it; he made the altar hollow, boarded in with wood.

chinese: 他用銅做洗濯盆和盆座，是用會幕門前伺候的婦人之鏡子作的。
english: And he made the washing-vessel of brass on a brass base, using the polished brass looking-glasses given by the women who did work at the doors of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 他做帳幕的院子。院子的南面用撚的細麻做帷子，寬一百肘。
english: To make the open space, he put hangings on the south side, of the best linen, a hundred cubits long:

chinese: 帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
english: Their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were brass; and the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.

chinese: 北面也有帷子，寬一百肘。帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
english: And for the north side. hangings a hundred cubits long, on twenty brass pillars in brass bases, with silver hooks and bands.

chinese: 院子的西面有帷子，寬五十肘。帷子的柱子十根，帶卯的座十個；柱子的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
english: And on the west side, hangings fifty cubits long, on ten pillars in ten bases, with silver bands.

chinese: 院子的東面，寬五十肘。
english: And on the east side, the open space was fifty cubits long.

chinese: 門這邊的帷子十五肘，那邊也是一樣。帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。在門的左右各有帷子十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
english: The hangings on one side of the doorway were fifteen cubits long, on three pillars with their three bases;
And the same on the other side of the doorway; on this side and on that the hangings were fifteen cubits long, on three pillars with their three bases.

chinese: 院子四面的帷子都是用撚的細麻做的。
english: All the hangings were of the best linen.

chinese: 柱子帶卯的座是銅的，柱子上的鉤子和杆子是銀的，柱頂是用銀子包的。院子一切的柱子都是用銀杆連絡的。
english: And the bases of the pillars were of brass; their hooks and the bands round the tops of them were of silver; all the pillars were ringed with silver.

chinese: 院子的門簾是以繡花的手工，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻織的，寬二十肘，高五肘，與院子的帷子相配。
english: And the curtain for the doorway of the open space was of the best linen, with designs of blue and purple and red in needlework; it was twenty cubits long and five cubits high, to go with the hangings round the sides.

chinese: 帷子的柱子四根，帶卯的銅座四個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子是銀的；柱頂是用銀子包的。
english: There were four pillars with their bases, all of brass, the hooks being of silver, and their tops and their bands being covered with silver.

chinese: 帳幕一切的橛子和院子四圍的橛子都是銅的。
english: All the nails used for the House and the open space round it were of brass.

chinese: 這是法櫃的帳幕中利未人所用物件的總數，是照摩西的吩咐，經祭司亞倫的兒子以他瑪的手數點的。
english: This is the price of the making of the House, even the House of witness, as it was valued by the word of Moses, for the work of the Levites under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

chinese: 凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的都是猶大支派戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列做的。
