english: Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 與他同工的有但支派中亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯；他是雕刻匠，又是巧匠，又能用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和細麻繡花。
english: And with him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; a designer and a trained workman, expert in needlework of blue and purple and red and the best linen.

chinese: 為聖所一切工作使用所獻的金子，按聖所的平，有二十九他連得並七百三十舍客勒。
english: The gold used for all the different work done for the holy place, the gold which was given, was twenty-nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels in weight, by the scale of the holy place.

chinese: 會中被數的人所出的銀子，按聖所的平，有一百他連得並一千七百七十五舍客勒。
english: And the silver given by those who were numbered of the people was a hundred talents, and a thousand, seven hundred and seventy-five shekels in weight, by the scale of the holy place.

chinese: 凡過去歸那些被數之人的，從二十歲以外，有六十萬零三千五百五十人。按聖所的平，每人出銀半舍客勒，就是一比加。
english: A beka, that is, half a shekel by the holy scale, for everyone who was numbered; there were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty men of twenty years old and over.

chinese: 用那一百他連得銀子鑄造聖所帶卯的座和幔子柱子帶卯的座；一百他連得共一百帶卯的座，每帶卯的座用一他連得。
english: Of this silver, a hundred talents was used for making the bases of the pillars of the holy place and of the veil; a talent for every base.

chinese: 用那一千七百七十五舍客勒銀子做柱子上的鉤子，包裹柱頂並柱子上的杆子。
english: And a thousand, seven hundred and seventy-five shekels of silver was used to make the hooks for the pillars, and for plating the tops of the pillars and for making their bands.

chinese: 所獻的銅有七十他連得並二千四百舍客勒。
english: The brass which was given was seventy talents, two thousand four hundred shekels;

chinese: 用這銅做會幕門帶卯的座和銅壇，並壇上的銅網和壇的一切器具，
english: From it he made the bases of the doorway of the Tent of meeting and the brass altar and the network for it and all the vessels for the altar,

chinese: 並院子四圍帶卯的座和院門帶卯的座，與帳幕一切的橛子和院子四圍所有的橛子。
english: And the bases for the open space all round and for its doorway, and all the nails for the House and for the open space.

chinese: 比撒列用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線做精緻的衣服，在聖所用以供職，又為亞倫做聖衣，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And from the needlework of blue and purple and red they made the robes used for the work of the holy place, and the holy robes for Aaron, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 他用金線和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做以弗得；
english: The ephod he made of gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen;

chinese: 把金子錘成薄片，剪出線來，與藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，用巧匠的手工一同繡上。
english: Hammering the gold into thin plates and cutting it into wires to be worked into the blue and the purple and the red and the linen by the designer.

chinese: 又為以弗得做兩條相連的肩帶，接連在以弗得的兩頭。
english: And they made two bands for joining its edges together at the top of the arms.

chinese: 其上巧工織的帶子和以弗得一樣的做法，用以束上，與以弗得接連一塊，是用金線和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做的，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And the beautifully worked band which went on it was of the same design and the same material, worked in gold and blue and purple and red and twisted linen-work, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 又琢出兩塊紅瑪瑙，鑲在金槽上，彷彿刻圖書，按著以色列兒子的名字雕刻；
english: Then they made the beryl stones, fixed in twisted frames of gold and cut like the cutting of a stamp, with the names of the children of Israel.

chinese: 將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人做紀念石，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: These he put on the ephod, over the arm-holes, to be stones of memory for the children of Israel, as the Lord had said to Moses.

chinese: 他用巧匠的手工做胸牌，和以弗得一樣的做法，用金線與藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做的。
english: The priest's bag was designed like the ephod, of the best linen worked with gold and blue and purple and red.

chinese: 胸牌是四方的，疊為兩層；這兩層長一虎口，寬一虎口，
english: It was square and folded in two, as long and as wide as the stretch of a man's hand;

chinese: 上面鑲著寶石四行：第一行是紅寶石、紅璧璽、紅玉；
english: And on it they put four lines of stones: in the first line was a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;

chinese: 第二行是綠寶石、藍寶石、金鋼石；
english: In the second, a ruby, a sapphire, and an onyx;

chinese: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶；
english: In the third, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

chinese: 第四行是水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉。這都鑲在金槽中。
english: In the fourth, a topaz, a beryl, and a jasper; they were fixed in twisted frames of gold.

chinese: 這些寶石都是按著以色列十二個兒子的名字，彷彿刻圖書，刻十二個支派的名字。
english: There were twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel; on every one the name of one of the tribes of Israel was cut, like the cutting of a stamp.

chinese: 在胸牌上，用精金擰成如繩子的鍊子。
english: And on the bag they put gold chains, twisted like cords.

chinese: 又做兩個金槽和兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭。
english: And they made two gold frames and two gold rings, the rings being fixed to the ends of the priest's bag;

chinese: 把那兩條擰成的金鍊子穿過胸牌兩頭的環子，
english: And they put the two twisted chains on the two rings at the ends of the priest's bag;

chinese: 又把鍊子的那兩頭接在兩槽上，安在以弗得前面肩帶上。
english: And the other two ends of the chains were joined to the two frames and fixed to the front of the ephod over the arm-holes.

chinese: 做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭，在以弗得裡面的邊上，
english: And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two lower ends of the bag, on the inner side nearest to the ephod.

chinese: 又做兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，挨近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
english: And two other gold rings were put on the front of the ephod, over the arm-holes, at the join, and over the worked band.

chinese: 用一條藍細帶子把胸牌的環子和以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不可與以弗得離縫，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And the rings on the bag were fixed to the rings of the ephod by a blue cord, keeping it in place over the band, so that the bag might not get loose, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 他用織工做以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
english: The robe which went with the ephod was made all of blue;

chinese: 袍上留一領口，口的周圍織出領邊來，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
english: With a hole at the top in the middle, like the hole in the coat of a fighting-man, edged with a band to make it strong.

chinese: 在袍子底邊上，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做石榴，
english: The skirts of the robe were worked all round with fruits in blue and purple and red made of twisted linen.

chinese: 又用精金做鈴鐺，把鈴鐺釘在袍子周圍底邊上的石榴中間：
english: And between the fruits all round the skirt they put gold bells, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 一個鈴鐺一個石榴，一個鈴鐺一個石榴，在袍子周圍底邊上用以供職，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: All round the skirt of the robe were bells and fruits in turn.

chinese: 他用織成的細麻布為亞倫和他的兒子做內袍，
english: The coats for Aaron and his sons they made of the best linen;

chinese: 並用細麻布做冠冕和華美的裹頭巾，用撚的細麻布做褲子，
english: And the twisted head-dress for Aaron, and beautiful head-dresses of linen, and linen trousers,

chinese: 又用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻，以繡花的手工做腰帶，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And a linen band worked with a design of blue and purple and red, as the Lord had said to Moses.

chinese: 他用精金做聖冠上的牌，在上面按刻圖書之法，刻著歸耶和華為聖。
english: The plate for the holy crown was made of the best gold, and on it were cut these words, HOLY TO THE LORD.

chinese: 又用一條藍細帶子將牌繫在冠冕上，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: It was fixed to the head-dress by a blue cord, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 帳幕，就是會幕，一切的工就這樣做完了。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照樣作了。
english: So all the work on the House of the Tent of meeting was done; as the Lord had given orders to Moses, so the children of Israel did it.

chinese: 他們送到摩西那裡。帳幕和帳幕的一切器具，就是鉤子、板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，
english: Then they took the House to Moses, the tent with all the things for it; its hooks, its boards, its rods, its pillars, and its bases;

chinese: 染紅公羊皮的蓋、海狗皮的頂蓋，和遮掩櫃的幔子，
english: The outer cover of sheepskins coloured red, and the cover of leather, and the veil for the doorway;

chinese: 法櫃和櫃的杠並施恩座，
english: The ark of the law, with its rods and its cover;

chinese: 桌子和桌子的一切器具並陳設餅，
english: The table, with all its vessels and the holy bread;

chinese: 精金的燈臺和擺列的燈盞，與燈臺的一切器具，並點燈的油，
english: The support for the lights, with the vessels for the lights to be put in their places on it, and all its vessels, and the oil for the lights;

chinese: 金壇、膏油、馨香的香料、會幕的門簾，
english: And the gold altar, and the holy oil, and the sweet perfume for burning, and the curtain for the doorway of the tent;

chinese: 銅壇和壇上的銅網，壇的杠並壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
english: And the brass altar, with its network of brass, and its rods and all its vessels, and the washing-vessel and its base;

chinese: 院子的帷子和柱子，並帶卯的座，院子的門簾、繩子、橛子，並帳幕和會幕中一切使用的器具，
english: The hangings for the open space, with the pillars and their bases, and the curtain for the doorway, and the cords and nails, and all the instruments necessary for the work of the House of the Tent of meeting;

chinese: 精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子在聖所用以供祭司職分的聖衣。
english: The robes for use in the holy place, and the holy robes for Aaron and his sons when acting as priests.

chinese: 這一切工作都是以色列人照耶和華所吩咐摩西做的。
english: The children of Israel did everything as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 耶和華怎樣吩咐的，他們就怎樣做了。摩西看見一切的工都做成了，就給他們祝福。
english: Then Moses, when he saw all their work and saw that they had done everything as the Lord had said, gave them his blessing.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 正月初一日，你要立起帳幕，
english: On the first day of the first month you are to put up the House of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 把法櫃安放在裡面，用幔子將櫃遮掩。
english: And inside it put the ark of the law, hanging the veil before it.

chinese: 把桌子搬進去，擺設上面的物。把燈臺搬進去，點其上的燈。
english: And put the table inside, placing all the things on it in order; and put in the support for the lights, and let its lights be burning.

chinese: 把燒香的金壇安在法櫃前，掛上帳幕的門簾。
english: And put the gold altar for burning perfumes in front of the ark of the law, hanging the curtain over the doorway of the House.

chinese: 把燔祭壇安在帳幕門前。
english: And put the altar of burned offerings before the doorway of the House of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 把洗濯盆安在會幕和壇的中間，在盆裡盛水。
english: And let the washing-vessel, with water in it, be put between the Tent of meeting and the altar.

chinese: 又在四圍立院帷，把院子的門簾掛上。
english: And put up the hangings forming the open space all round it, with the curtain over its doorway.

chinese: 用膏油把帳幕和其中所有的都抹上，使帳幕和一切器具成聖，就都成聖。
english: And take the holy oil and put it on the House and everything in it, and make it and everything in it holy:

chinese: 又要抹燔祭壇和一切器具，使壇成聖，就都成為至聖。
english: And put oil on the altar of burned offering, and make it and all its vessels holy; this altar is to be most holy.

chinese: 要抹洗濯盆和盆座，使盆成聖。
english: And put oil on the washing-vessel and its base, and make them holy.

chinese: 要使亞倫和他兒子到會幕門口來，用水洗身。
english: Then let Aaron and his sons come to the door of the Tent of meeting; and after washing them with water,

chinese: 要給亞倫穿上聖衣，又膏他，使他成聖，可以給我供祭司的職分；
english: You are to put on Aaron the holy robes; and you are to put oil on him, and make him holy, so that he may be my priest.

chinese: 又要使他兒子來，給他們穿上內袍。
english: And take his sons with him and put coats on them;

chinese: 怎樣膏他們的父親，也要照樣膏他們，使他們給我供祭司的職分。他們世世代代凡受膏的，就永遠當祭司的職任。
english: And put oil on them as you did on their father, so that they may be my priests: the putting on of oil will make them priests for ever, from generation to generation.

chinese: 摩西這樣行，都是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
english: And Moses did this; as the Lord gave him orders, so he did.

chinese: 第二年正月初一日，帳幕就立起來。
english: So on the first day of the first month in the second year the House was put up.

chinese: 摩西立起帳幕，安上帶卯的座，立上板，穿上閂，立起柱子。
english: Moses put up the House; placing its bases in position and lifting up its uprights, putting in the rods and planting the pillars in their places;

chinese: 在帳幕以上搭罩棚，把罩棚的頂蓋蓋在其上，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
english: Stretching the outer tent over it, and covering it, as the Lord had given him orders.

chinese: 又把法版放在櫃裡，把杠穿在櫃的兩旁，把施恩座安在櫃上。
english: And he took the law and put it inside the ark, and put the rods at its side and the cover over it;

chinese: 把櫃抬進帳幕，掛上遮掩櫃的幔子，把法櫃遮掩了，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
english: And he took the ark into the House, hanging up the veil before it as the Lord had given him orders.

chinese: 又把桌子安在會幕內，在帳幕北邊，在幔子外。
english: And he put the table in the Tent of meeting, on the north side outside the veil.

chinese: 在桌子上將餅陳設在耶和華面前，是照耶和華所吩咐他的
english: And he put the bread on it in order before the Lord, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 又把燈臺安在會幕內，在帳幕南邊，與桌子相對，
english: The support for the lights he put in the Tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the south side:

chinese: 在耶和華面前點燈，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
english: Lighting the lights before the Lord, as the Lord had given him orders.

chinese: 把金壇安在會幕內的幔子前，
english: And he put the gold altar in the Tent of meeting, in front of the veil:

chinese: 在壇上燒了馨香料做的香，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
english: Burning sweet perfumes on it, as the Lord had given him orders.

chinese: 又掛上帳幕的門簾。
english: And he put up the curtain at the doorway of the House.

chinese: 在會幕的帳幕門前，安設燔祭壇，把燔祭和素祭獻在其上，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
english: And at the door of the House of the Tent of meeting, he put the altar of burned offerings, offering on it the burned offering and the meal offering, as the Lord had given him orders.

chinese: 把洗濯盆安在會幕和壇的中間，盆中盛水，以便洗濯。
english: And between the altar and the Tent of meeting he put the vessel with water in it for washing.

chinese: 摩西和亞倫並亞倫的兒子在這盆裡洗手洗腳。
english: In it the hands and feet of Moses and Aaron and his sons were washed,

chinese: 他們進會幕或就近壇的時候，便都洗濯，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
english: Whenever they went into the Tent of meeting, and when they came near the altar, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 在帳幕和壇的四圍立了院帷，把院子的門簾掛上。這樣，摩西就完了工。
english: And he put up the hangings forming the open space round the House and the altar, and put the curtain over the doorway. So Moses made the work complete.

chinese: 當時，雲彩遮蓋會幕，耶和華的榮光就充滿了帳幕。
english: Then the cloud came down covering the Tent of meeting, and the House was full of the glory of the Lord;

chinese: 摩西不能進會幕；因為雲彩停在其上，並且耶和華的榮光充滿了帳幕。
english: So that Moses was not able to go into the Tent of meeting, because the cloud was resting on it, and the House was full of the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 每逢雲彩從帳幕收上去，以色列人就起程前往；
english: And whenever the cloud was taken up from the House, the children of Israel went forward on their journey:

chinese: 雲彩若不收上去，他們就不起程，直等到雲彩收上去。
english: But while the cloud was there, they made no move till it was taken up.

chinese: 日間，耶和華的雲彩是在帳幕以上；夜間，雲中有火，在以色列全家的眼前。在他們所行的路上都是這樣。
english: For the cloud of the Lord was resting on the House by day, and at night there was fire in the cloud, before the eyes of all the people of Israel, and so it was through all their journeys.

chinese: 耶和華從會幕中呼叫摩西，對他說：
english: And the voice of the Lord came to Moses out of the Tent of meeting, saying,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：你們中間若有人獻供物給耶和華，要從牛群羊群中獻牲畜為供物。
english: Give these orders to the children of Israel: When anyone of you makes an offering to the Lord, you are to take it from the cattle, from the herd or from the flock.

chinese: 他的供物若以牛為燔祭，就要在會幕門口獻一隻沒有殘疾的公牛，可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
english: If the offering is a burned offering of the herd, let him give a male without a mark: he is to give it at the door of the Tent of meeting so that he may be pleasing to the Lord.

chinese: 他要按手在燔祭牲的頭上，燔祭便蒙悅納，為他贖罪。
english: And he is to put his hand on the head of the burned offering and it will be taken for him, to take away his sin.

chinese: 他要在耶和華面前宰公牛；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要奉上血，把血灑在會幕門口、壇的周圍。
english: And the ox is to be put to death before the Lord: then Aaron's sons, the priests, are to take the blood and put some of it on and round the altar which is at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 那人要剝去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成塊子。
english: And the burned offering is to be skinned and cut up into its parts.

chinese: 祭司亞倫的子孫要把火放在壇上，把柴擺在火上。
english: And Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put fire on the altar and put the wood in order on the fire:

chinese: 亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把肉塊和頭並脂油擺在壇上火的柴上。
english: And Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put the parts, the head and the fat, in order on the wood which is on the fire on the altar:

chinese: 但燔祭的臟腑與腿要用水洗。祭司就要把一切全燒在壇上，當作燔祭，獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: But its inside parts and its legs are to be washed with water, and it will all be burned on the altar by the priest for a burned offering, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 人的供物若以綿羊或山羊為燔祭，就要獻上沒有殘疾的公羊。
english: And if his offering is of the flock, a burned offering of sheep or goats, let him give a male without a mark.

chinese: 要把羊宰於壇的北邊，在耶和華面前；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把羊血灑在壇的周圍。
english: And he is to put it to death on the north side of the altar before the Lord: and Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put some of the blood on and round the altar.

chinese: 要把燔祭牲切成塊子，連頭和脂油，祭司就要擺在壇上火的柴上；
english: And the offering is to be cut into its parts, with its head and its fat; and the priest is to put them in order on the wood which is on the fire on the altar:

chinese: 但臟腑與腿要用水洗，祭司就要全然奉獻，燒在壇上。這是燔祭，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: But the inside parts and the legs are to be washed with water; and the priest will make an offering of all of it, burning it on the altar: it is a burned offering, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 人奉給耶和華的供物，若以鳥為燔祭，就要獻斑鳩或是雛鴿為供物。
english: And if his offering to the Lord is a burned offering of birds, then he is to make his offering of doves or of young pigeons.

chinese: 祭司要把鳥拿到壇前，揪下頭來，把鳥燒在壇上；鳥的血要流在壇的旁邊；
english: And the priest is to take it to the altar, and after its head has been twisted off, it is to be burned on the altar, and its blood drained out on the side of the altar:

chinese: 又要把鳥的嗉子和髒物除掉，（髒物：或作翎毛）丟在壇的東邊倒灰的地方。
english: And he is to take away its stomach, with its feathers, and put it down by the east side of the altar, where the burned waste is put:

chinese: 要拿著鳥的兩個翅膀，把鳥撕開，只是不可撕斷；祭司要在壇上、在火的柴上焚燒。這是燔祭，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: And let it be broken open at the wings, but not cut in two; and let it be burned on the altar by the priest on the wood which is on the fire; it is a burned offering; an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 若有人獻素祭為供物給耶和華，要用細麵澆上油，加上乳香，
english: And when anyone makes a meal offering to the Lord, let his offering be of the best meal, with oil on it and perfume:

chinese: 帶到亞倫子孫作祭司的那裡；祭司就要從細麵中取出一把來，並取些油和所有的乳香，然後要把所取的這些作為紀念，燒在壇上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: And let him take it to Aaron's sons, the priests; and having taken in his hand some of the meal and of the oil, with all the perfume, let him give it to the priest to be burned on the altar, as a sign, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫；這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
english: And the rest of the meal offering will be for Aaron and his sons; it is most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.

chinese: 若用爐中烤的物為素祭，就要用調油的無酵細麵餅，或是抹油的無酵薄餅。
english: And when you give a meal offering cooked in the oven, let it be of unleavened cakes of the best meal mixed with oil, or thin unleavened cakes covered with oil.

chinese: 若用鐵鏊上做的物為素祭，就要用調油的無酵細麵，
english: And if you give a meal offering cooked on a flat plate, let it be of the best meal, unleavened and mixed with oil.

chinese: 分成塊子，澆上油；這是素祭。
english: Let it be broken into bits, and put oil on it; it is a meal offering.

chinese: 若用煎盤做的物為素祭，就要用油與細麵作成。
english: And if your offering is of meal cooked in fat over the fire, let it be made of the best meal mixed with oil.

chinese: 要把這些東西做的素祭帶到耶和華面前，並奉給祭司，帶到壇前。
english: And you are to give the meal offering made of these things to the Lord, and let the priest take it to the altar.

chinese: 祭司要從素祭中取出作為紀念的，燒在壇上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: And he is to take from the meal offering a part, for a sign, burning it on the altar; an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫。這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
english: And the rest of the meal offering will be for Aaron and his sons; it is most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.

chinese: 凡獻給耶和華的素祭都不可有酵；因為你們不可燒一點酵、一點蜜當作火祭獻給耶和華。
english: No meal offering which you give to the Lord is to be made with leaven; no leaven or honey is to be burned as an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 這些物要獻給耶和華作為初熟的供物，只是不可在壇上獻為馨香的祭。
english: You may give them as an offering of first-fruits to the Lord, but they are not to go up as a sweet smell on the altar.

chinese: 凡獻為素祭的供物都要用鹽調和，在素祭上不可缺了你神立約的鹽。一切的供物都要配鹽而獻。
english: And every meal offering is to be salted with salt; your meal offering is not to be without the salt of the agreement of your God: with all your offerings give salt.

chinese: 若向耶和華獻初熟之物為素祭，要獻上烘了的禾穗子，就是軋了的新穗子，當作初熟之物的素祭。
english: And if you give a meal offering of first-fruits to the Lord, give, as your offering of first-fruits, new grain, made dry with fire, crushed new grain.

chinese: 並要抹上油，加上乳香；這是素祭。
english: And put oil on it and perfume: it is a meal offering.

chinese: 祭司要把其中作為紀念的，就是一些軋了的禾穗子和一些油，並所有的乳香，都焚燒，是向耶和華獻的火祭。
english: And part of the meal of the offering and part of the oil and all the perfume is to be burned for a sign by the priest: it is an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 人獻供物為平安祭（平安：或作酬恩；下同），若是從牛群中獻，無論是公的是母的，必用沒有殘疾的獻在耶和華面前。
english: And if his offering is given for a peace-offering; if he gives of the herd, male or female, let him give it without any mark on it, before the Lord.

chinese: 他要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕門口。亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把血灑在壇的周圍。
english: And he is to put his hand on the head of his offering and put it to death at the door of the Tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put some of the blood on and round the altar.

chinese: 從平安祭中，將火祭獻給耶和華，也要把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
english: And he is to give of the peace-offering, as an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,

chinese: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
english: And the two kidneys, and the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away;

chinese: 亞倫的子孫要把這些燒在壇的燔祭上，就是在火的柴上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: That it may be burned by Aaron's sons on the altar, on the burned offering which is on the wood on the fire: it is an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 人向耶和華獻供物為平安祭，若是從羊群中獻，無論是公的是母的，必用沒有殘疾的。
english: And if what he gives for a peace-offering to the Lord is of the flock, let him give a male or female, without any mark on it.

chinese: 若獻一隻羊羔為供物，必在耶和華面前獻上，
english: If his offering is a lamb, then let it be placed before the Lord:

chinese: 並要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕前。亞倫的子孫要把血灑在壇的周圍。
english: And he is to put his hand on the head of his offering and put it to death before the Tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons are to put some of its blood on and round the altar.

chinese: 從平安祭中，將火祭獻給耶和華，其中的脂油和整肥尾巴都要在靠近脊骨處取下，並要把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
english: And of the peace-offering, let him give an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat of it, all the fat tail, he is to take away near the backbone; and the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,

chinese: 兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
english: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away;

chinese: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，是獻給耶和華為食物的火祭。
english: That it may be burned by the priest on the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 人的供物若是山羊，必在耶和華面前獻上。
english: And if his offering is a goat, then let it be placed before the Lord,

chinese: 要按手在山羊頭上，宰於會幕前。亞倫的子孫要把血灑在壇的周圍，
english: And let him put his hand on the head of it and put it to death before the Tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron are to put some of its blood on and round the altar.

chinese: 又把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下，獻給耶和華為火祭。
english: And of it let him make his offering, an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,
And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, let him take away;

chinese: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，作為馨香火祭的食物。脂油都是耶和華的。
english: That it may be burned by the priest on the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet smell: all the fat is the Lord's.

chinese: 在你們一切的住處，脂油和血都不可吃；這要成為你們世世代代永遠的定例。
english: Let it be an order for ever, through all your generations, in all your houses, that you are not to take fat or blood for food.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：若有人在耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事上誤犯了一件，
english: Say to the children of Israel: These are the offerings of anyone who does wrong through error, doing any of the things which by the Lord's order are not to be done:

chinese: 或是受膏的祭司犯罪，使百姓陷在罪裡，就當為他所犯的罪把沒有殘疾的公牛犢獻給耶和華為贖罪祭。
english: If the chief priest by doing wrong becomes a cause of sin to the people, then let him give to the Lord for the sin which he has done, an ox, without any mark, for a sin-offering.

chinese: 他要牽公牛到會幕門口，在耶和華面前按手在牛的頭上，把牛宰於耶和華面前。
english: And he is to take the ox to the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord; and put his hand on its head and put it to death before the Lord.

chinese: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血帶到會幕，
english: And the chief priest is to take some of its blood and take it to the Tent of meeting;

chinese: 把指頭蘸於血中，在耶和華面前對著聖所的幔子彈血七次，
english: And the priest is to put his finger in the blood, shaking drops of it before the Lord seven times, in front of the veil of the holy place.

chinese: 又要把些血抹在會幕內、耶和華面前香壇的四角上，再把公牛所有的血倒在會幕門口、燔祭壇的腳那裡。
english: And the priest is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar on which perfume is burned before the Lord in the Tent of meeting, draining out all the rest of the blood of the ox at the base of the altar of burned offering which is at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 要把贖罪祭公牛所有的脂油，乃是蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
english: And he is to take away all the fat of the ox of the sin-offering; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat of the inside parts,

chinese: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下，
english: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away,

chinese: 與平安祭公牛上所取的一樣；祭司要把這些燒在燔祭的壇上。
english: As it is taken from the ox of the peace-offering; and it is to be burned by the priest on the altar of burned offerings.

chinese: 公牛的皮和所有的肉，並頭、腿、臟、腑、糞，
english: And the skin of the ox and all its flesh, with its head and its legs and its inside parts and its waste,

chinese: 就是全公牛，要搬到營外潔淨之地、倒灰之所，用火燒在柴上。
english: All the ox, he is to take away outside the circle of the tents into a clean place where the burned waste is put, and there it is to be burned on wood with fire.

chinese: 以色列全會眾若行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，是隱而未現，會眾看不出來的，
english: And if all the people of Israel do wrong, without anyone's knowledge; if they have done any of the things which by the Lord's order are not to be done, causing sin to come on them;

chinese: 會眾一知道所犯的罪就要獻一隻公牛犢為贖罪祭，牽到會幕前。
english: When the sin which they have done comes to light, then let all the people give an ox for a sin-offering, and take it before the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 會中的長老就要在耶和華面前按手在牛的頭上，將牛在耶和華面前宰了。
english: And let the chiefs of the people put their hands on its head before the Lord, and put the ox to death before the Lord.

chinese: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血帶到會幕，
english: And the priest is to take some of its blood to the Tent of meeting;

chinese: 把指頭蘸於血中，在耶和華面前對著幔子彈血七次，
english: And put his finger in the blood, shaking drops of the blood seven times before the Lord in front of the veil.

chinese: 又要把些血抹在會幕內、耶和華面前壇的四角上，再把所有的血倒在會幕門口、燔祭壇的腳那裡。
english: And he is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the Lord in the Tent of meeting; and all the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar of burned offering at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 把牛所有的脂油都取下，燒在壇上；
english: And he is to take off all its fat, burning it on the altar.

chinese: 收拾這牛，與那贖罪祭的牛一樣。祭司要為他們贖罪，他們必蒙赦免。
english: Let him do with the ox as he did with the ox of the sin-offering; and the priest will take away their sin and they will have forgiveness.

chinese: 他要把牛搬到營外燒了，像燒頭一個牛一樣；這是會眾的贖罪祭。
english: Then let the ox be taken away outside the tent-circle, that it may be burned as the other ox was burned; it is the sin-offering for all the people.

chinese: 官長若行了耶和華─他神所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，
english: If a ruler does wrong, and in error does any of the things which, by the order of the Lord his God, are not to be done, causing sin to come on him;

chinese: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要牽一隻沒有殘疾的公山羊為供物，
english: When the sin which he has done is made clear to him, let him give for his offering a goat, a male without any mark.

chinese: 按手在羊的頭上，宰於耶和華面前、宰燔祭牲的地方；這是贖罪祭。
english: And he is to put his hand on the head of the goat and put it to death in the place where they put to death the burned offering before the Lord: it is a sin-offering.

chinese: 祭司要用指頭蘸些贖罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，把血倒在燔祭壇的腳那裡。
english: And the priest is to take some of the blood of the offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, draining out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burned offering.

chinese: 所有的脂油，祭司都要燒在壇上，正如平安祭的脂油一樣。至於他的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。
english: And all the fat of it is to be burned on the altar like the fat of the peace-offering; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.

chinese: 民中若有人行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，
english: And if any one of the common people does wrong in error, doing any of the things which the Lord has given orders are not to be done, causing sin to come on him;

chinese: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要為所犯的罪牽一隻沒有殘疾的母山羊為供物，
english: When the sin which he has done is made clear to him, then he is to give for his offering a goat, a female without any mark, for the sin which he has done.

chinese: 按手在贖罪祭牲的頭上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了。
english: And he is to put his hand on the head of the sin-offering and put it to death in the place where they put to death the burned offering.

chinese: 祭司要用指頭蘸些羊的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，所有的血都要倒在壇的腳那裡，
english: And the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, and all the rest of its blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar.

chinese: 又要把羊所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭牲的脂油一樣。祭司要在壇上焚燒，在耶和華面前作為馨香的祭，為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
english: And let all its fat be taken away, as the fat is taken away from the peace-offerings, and let it be burned on the altar by the priest for a sweet smell to the Lord; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.

chinese: 人若牽一隻綿羊羔為贖罪祭的供物，必要牽一隻沒有殘疾的母羊，
english: And if he gives a lamb as his sin-offering, let it be a female without any mark;

chinese: 按手在贖罪祭牲的頭上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了作贖罪祭。
english: And he is to put his hand on the head of the offering and put it to death for a sin-offering in the place where they put to death the burned offering.

chinese: 祭司要用指頭蘸些贖罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，所有的血都要倒在壇的腳那裡，
english: And the priest is to take some of the blood of the offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, and all the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar;

chinese: 又要把所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭羊羔的脂油一樣。祭司要按獻給耶和華火祭的條例，燒在壇上。至於所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。
english: And let him take away all its fat, as the fat is taken away from the lamb of the peace-offerings; and let it be burned by the priest on the altar among the offerings made by fire to the Lord: and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.

chinese: 若有人聽見發誓的聲音（或作：若有人聽見叫人發誓的聲音），他本是見證，卻不把所看見的、所知道的說出來，這就是罪；他要擔當他的罪孽。
english: And if anyone does wrong by saying nothing when he is put under oath as a witness of something he has seen or had knowledge of, then he will be responsible:

chinese: 或是有人摸了不潔的物，無論是不潔的死獸，是不潔的死畜，是不潔的死蟲，他卻不知道，因此成了不潔，就有了罪。
english: If anyone becomes unclean through touching unconsciously some unclean thing, such as the dead body of an unclean beast or of unclean cattle or of any unclean animal which goes flat on the earth, he will be responsible:

chinese: 或是他摸了別人的污穢，無論是染了甚麼污穢，他卻不知道，一知道了就有了罪。
english: Or if he becomes unclean through touching unconsciously any unclean thing of man, whatever it may be, when it is made clear to him he will be responsible:

chinese: 或是有人嘴裡冒失發誓，要行惡，要行善，無論人在甚麼事上冒失發誓，他卻不知道，一知道了就要在這其中的一件上有了罪。
english: Or if anyone, without thought, takes an oath to do evil or to do good, whatever he says without thought, with an oath, having no knowledge of what he is doing; when it becomes clear to him, he will be responsible for any of these things.

chinese: 他有了罪的時候，就要承認所犯的罪，
english: And whoever is responsible for any such sin, let him make a statement openly of his wrongdoing;

chinese: 並要因所犯的罪，把他的贖愆祭牲─就是羊群中的母羊，或是一隻羊羔，或是一隻山羊─牽到耶和華面前為贖罪祭。至於他的罪，祭司要為他贖了。
english: And take to the Lord the offering for the wrong which he has done, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin-offering, and the priest will take away his sin.

chinese: 他的力量若不夠獻一隻羊羔，就要因所犯的罪，把兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿帶到耶和華面前為贖愆祭：一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭。
english: And if he has not money enough for a lamb, then let him give, for his offering to the Lord, two doves or two young pigeons; one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering.

chinese: 把這些帶到祭司那裡，祭司就要先把那贖罪祭獻上，從鳥的頸項上揪下頭來，只是不可把鳥撕斷，
english: And let him take them to the priest, who will first give the sin-offering, twisting off its head from its neck, but not cutting it in two;

chinese: 也把些贖罪祭牲的血彈在壇的旁邊，剩下的血要流在壇的腳那裡；這是贖罪祭。
english: And he is to put drops of the blood of the offering on the side of the altar, and the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin-offering.

chinese: 他要照例獻第二隻為燔祭。至於他所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。
english: And the second is for a burned offering, in agreement with the law; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.

chinese: 他的力量若不夠獻兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，就要因所犯的罪帶供物來，就是細麵伊法十分之一為贖罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因為是贖罪祭。
english: But if he has not enough money for two doves or two young pigeons, then let him give, for the sin he has done, the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal, for a sin-offering; let him put no oil on it, and no perfume, for it is a sin-offering.

chinese: 他要把供物帶到祭司那裡，祭司要取出自己的一把來作為紀念，按獻給耶和華火祭的條例燒在壇上；這是贖罪祭。
english: And let him come to the priest with it, and the priest will take some of it in his hand, to be burned on the altar as a sign, among the offerings of the Lord made by fire: it is a sin-offering.

chinese: 至於他在這幾件事中所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。剩下的麵都歸與祭司，和素祭一樣。
english: And the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness: and the rest of the offering will be the priest's, in the same way as the meal offering.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 人若在耶和華的聖物上誤犯了罪，有了過犯，就要照你所估的，按聖所的舍客勒拿銀子，將贖愆祭牲─就是羊群中一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊─牽到耶和華面前為贖愆祭；
english: If anyone is untrue, sinning in error in connection with the holy things of the Lord, let him take his offering to the Lord, a male sheep from the flock, without any mark, of the value fixed by you in silver by shekels, by the scale of the holy place.

chinese: 並且他因在聖物上的差錯要償還，另外加五分之一，都給祭司。祭司要用贖愆祭的公綿羊為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
english: And he is to make payment to the priest for what he has done wrong in relation to the holy thing, together with a fifth part of its value in addition; and the priest will take away his sin by the sheep of his offering, and he will have forgiveness.

chinese: 若有人犯罪，行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，他雖然不知道，還是有了罪，就要擔當他的罪孽；
english: And if anyone does wrong, and does any of the things which the Lord has given orders are not to be done, though he has no knowledge of it, still he is in the wrong and he is responsible.

chinese: 也要照你所估定的價，從羊群中牽一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊來，給祭司作贖愆祭。至於他誤行的那錯事，祭司要為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
english: Let him come to the priest with a sheep, a male without any mark out of the flock, of the value fixed by you, as an offering for his error; and the priest will take away the sin which he did in error, and he will have forgiveness.

chinese: 這是贖愆祭，因他在耶和華面前實在有了罪。
english: It is an offering for his error: he is certainly responsible before the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 若有人犯罪，干犯耶和華，在鄰舍交付他的物上，或是在交易上行了詭詐，或是搶奪人的財物，或是欺壓鄰舍，
english: If anyone does wrong, and is untrue to the Lord, acting falsely to his neighbour in connection with something put in his care, or something given for a debt, or has taken away anything by force, or has been cruel to his neighbour,

chinese: 或是在撿了遺失的物上行了詭詐，說謊起誓，在這一切的事上犯了甚麼罪；
english: Or has taken a false oath about the loss of something which he has come across by chance; if a man has done any of these evil things,

chinese: 他既犯了罪，有了過犯，就要歸還他所搶奪的，或是因欺壓所得的，或是人交付他的，或是人遺失他所撿的物，
english: Causing sin to come on him, then he will have to give back the thing he took by force or got by cruel acts, or the goods which were put in his care or the thing he came on by chance,

chinese: 或是他因甚麼物起了假誓，就要如數歸還，另外加上五分之一，在查出他有罪的日子要交還本主。
english: Or anything about which he took a false oath; he will have to give it all back, with the addition of a fifth of its value, to him whose property it is, when he has been judged to be in the wrong.

chinese: 也要照你所估定的價，把贖愆祭牲─就是羊群中一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊─牽到耶和華面前，給祭司為贖愆祭。
english: Then let him take to the Lord the offering for his wrongdoing; giving to the priest for his offering, a male sheep from the flock, without any mark, of the value fixed by you:

chinese: 祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪；他無論行了甚麼事，使他有了罪，都必蒙赦免。
english: And the priest will take away his sin from before the Lord, and he will have forgiveness for whatever crime he has done

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要吩咐亞倫和他的子孫說，燔祭的條例乃是這樣：燔祭要放在壇的柴上，從晚上到天亮，壇上的火要常常燒著。
english: Give orders to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law for the burned offering: the offering is to be on the fire-wood on the altar all night till the morning; and the fire of the altar is to be kept burning.

chinese: 祭司要穿上細麻布衣服，又要把細麻布褲子穿在身上，把壇上所燒的燔祭灰收起來，倒在壇的旁邊；
english: And the priest is to put on his linen robes and his linen trousers, and take up what is over of the offering after it has been burned on the altar, and put it by the side of the altar.

chinese: 隨後要脫去這衣服，穿上別的衣服，把灰拿到營外潔淨之處。
english: Then having taken off his linen robes and put on other clothing, he is to take it away into a clean place, outside the tent-circle.

chinese: 壇上的火要在其上常常燒著，不可熄滅。祭司要每日早晨在上面燒柴，並要把燔祭擺在壇上，在其上燒平安祭牲的脂油。
english: The fire on the altar is to be kept burning; it is never to go out; every morning the priest is to put wood on it, placing the burned offering in order on it, and there the fat of the peace-offering is to be burned.

chinese: 在壇上必有常常燒著的火，不可熄滅。
english: Let the fire be kept burning on the altar at all times; it is never to go out.

chinese: 素祭的條例乃是這樣：亞倫的子孫要在壇前把這祭獻在耶和華面前。
english: And this is the law for the meal offering: it is to be offered to the Lord before the altar by the sons of Aaron.

chinese: 祭司要從其中─就是從素祭的細麵中─取出自己的一把，又要取些油和素祭上所有的乳香，燒在壇上，奉給耶和華為馨香素祭的紀念。
english: The priest is to take in his hand some of the meal of the meal offering and of the oil of it, and all the perfume on it, burning it on the altar as a sign, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 所剩下的，亞倫和他子孫要吃，必在聖處不帶酵而吃，要在會幕的院子裡吃。
english: And whatever is over Aaron and his sons may have for their food, taking it without leaven in a holy place; in the open space of the Tent of meeting they may take a meal of it.

chinese: 烤的時候不可攙酵。這是從所獻給我的火祭中賜給他們的分，是至聖的，和贖罪祭並贖愆祭一樣。
english: It is not to be cooked with leaven. I have given it to them as their part of the offerings made by fire to me; it is most holy, as are the sin-offerings and the offerings for error.

chinese: 凡獻給耶和華的火祭，亞倫子孫中的男丁都要吃這一分，直到萬代，作他們永得的分。摸這些祭物的，都要成為聖。
english: Every male among the children of Aaron may have it for food; it is their right for ever through all your generations, from the offerings made by fire to the Lord: anyone touching them will be holy.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 當亞倫受膏的日子，他和他子孫所要獻給耶和華的供物，就是細麵伊法十分之一，為常獻的素祭：早晨一半，晚上一半。
english: This is the offering which Aaron and his sons are to make to the Lord on the day when he is made a priest: the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal for a meal offering for ever; half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

chinese: 要在鐵鏊上用油調和做成，調勻了，你就拿進來；烤好了分成塊子，獻給耶和華為馨香的素祭。
english: Let it be made with oil on a flat plate; when it is well mixed and cooked, let it be broken and taken in as a meal offering, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 亞倫的子孫中，接續他為受膏的祭司，要把這素祭獻上，要全燒給耶和華。這是永遠的定例。
english: And the same offering is to be given by that one of his sons who takes his place as priest; by an order for ever, all of it is to be burned before the Lord.

chinese: 祭司的素祭都要燒了，卻不可吃。
english: Every meal offering offered for the priest is to be completely burned: nothing of it is to be taken for food.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你對亞倫和他的子孫說，贖罪祭的條例乃是這樣：要在耶和華面前、宰燔祭牲的地方宰贖罪祭牲；這是至聖的。
english: Say to Aaron and his sons, This is the law for the sin-offering: the sin-offering is to be put to death before the Lord in the same place as the burned offering; it is most holy.

chinese: 為贖罪獻這祭的祭司要吃，要在聖處，就是在會幕的院子裡吃。
english: The priest by whom it is offered for sin, is to take it for his food in a holy place, in the open space of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 凡摸這祭肉的要成為聖；這祭牲的血若彈在甚麼衣服上，所彈的那一件要在聖處洗淨。
english: Anyone touching the flesh of it will be holy: and if any of the blood is dropped on any clothing, the thing on which the blood has been dropped is to be washed in a holy place.

chinese: 惟有煮祭物的瓦器要打碎；若是煮在銅器裡，這銅器要擦磨，在水中涮淨。
english: But the vessel of earth in which the flesh was cooked is to be broken; or if a brass vessel was used, it is to be rubbed clean and washed out with water.

chinese: 凡祭司中的男丁都可以吃；這是至聖的。
english: Every male among the priests may take it for his food: it is most holy.

chinese: 凡贖罪祭，若將血帶進會幕在聖所贖罪，那肉都不可吃，必用火焚燒。
english: No sin-offering, the blood of which is taken into the Tent of meeting, to take away sin in the holy place, may be used for food: it is to be burned with fire.

chinese: 贖愆祭的條例乃是如此：這祭是至聖的。
english: And this is the law of the offering for wrongdoing: it is most holy.

chinese: 人在那裡宰燔祭牲，也要在那裡宰贖愆祭牲；其血，祭司要灑在壇的周圍。
english: They are to put to death the offering for wrongdoing in the same place as the burned offering; and the priest is to put the blood on and round the altar.

chinese: 又要將肥尾巴和蓋臟的脂油，
english: And all the fat of it, the fat tail and the fat covering the inside parts, is to be given as an offering.

chinese: 兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
english: And the two kidneys, and the fat on them, which is by the top of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away:

chinese: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，為獻給耶和華的火祭，是贖愆祭。
english: They are to be burned by the priest on the altar for an offering made by fire to the Lord: it is an offering for wrongdoing.

chinese: 祭司中的男丁都可以吃這祭物；要在聖處吃，是至聖的。
english: Every male among the priests may have it as food in a holy place: it is most holy.

chinese: 贖罪祭怎樣，贖愆祭也是怎樣，兩個祭是一個條例。獻贖愆祭贖罪的祭司要得這祭物。
english: As is the sin-offering, so is the offering for wrongdoing; there is one law for them: the priest who makes the offering to take away sin, he is to have it.

chinese: 獻燔祭的祭司，無論為誰奉獻，要親自得他所獻那燔祭牲的皮。
english: And the priest offering any man's burned offering for him, may have the skin of the burned offering which is offered by him.

chinese: 凡在爐中烤的素祭和煎盤中做的，並鐵鏊上做的，都要歸那獻祭的祭司。
english: And every meal offering which is cooked in the oven and everything made in a cooking pot or on a flat plate, is for the priest by whom it is offered.

chinese: 凡素祭，無論是油調和的是乾的，都要歸亞倫的子孫，大家均分。
english: And every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, is for all the sons of Aaron in equal measure.

chinese: 人獻與耶和華平安祭的條例乃是這樣：
english: And this is the law for the peace-offerings offered to the Lord.

chinese: 他若為感謝獻上，就要用調油的無酵餅和抹油的無酵薄餅，並用油調勻細麵做的餅，與感謝祭一同獻上。
english: If any man gives his offering as a praise-offering, then let him give with the offering, unleavened cakes mixed with oil and thin unleavened cakes covered with oil and cakes of the best meal well mixed with oil.

chinese: 要用有酵的餅和為感謝獻的平安祭，與供物一同獻上。
english: With his peace-offering let him give cakes of leavened bread, as a praise-offering.

chinese: 從各樣的供物中，他要把一個餅獻給耶和華為舉祭，是要歸給灑平安祭牲血的祭司。
english: And let him give one out of every offering to be lifted up before the Lord; that it may be for the priest who puts the blood of the peace-offering on the altar.

chinese: 為感謝獻平安祭牲的肉，要在獻的日子吃，一點不可留到早晨。
english: And the flesh of the praise-offering is to be taken as food on the day when it is offered; no part of it may be kept till the morning.

chinese: 若所獻的是為還願，或是甘心獻的，必在獻祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
english: But if his offering is made because of an oath or given freely, it may be taken as food on the day when it is offered; and the rest may be used up on the day after:

chinese: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚燒；
english: But if any of the flesh of the offering is still unused on the third day, it is to be burned with fire.

chinese: 第三天若吃了平安祭的肉，這祭必不蒙悅納，人所獻的也不算為祭，反為可憎嫌的，吃這祭肉的，就必擔當他的罪孽。
english: And if any of the flesh of the peace-offering is taken as food on the third day, it will not be pleasing to God and will not be put to the account of him who gives it; it will be unclean and a cause of sin to him who takes it as food.

chinese: 挨了污穢物的肉就不可吃，要用火焚燒。至於平安祭的肉，凡潔淨的人都要吃；
english: And flesh touched by any unclean thing may not be taken for food: it is to be burned with fire; and as for the flesh of the peace-offerings, everyone who is clean may take it as food:

chinese: 只是獻與耶和華平安祭的肉，人若不潔淨而吃了，這人必從民中剪除。
english: But he who is unclean when he takes as food the flesh of the peace-offerings, which are the Lord's, will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 有人摸了甚麼不潔淨的物，或是人的不潔淨，或是不潔淨的牲畜，或是不潔可憎之物，吃了獻與耶和華平安祭的肉，這人必從民中剪除。
english: And anyone who, after touching any unclean thing of man or an unclean beast or any unclean and disgusting thing, takes as food the flesh of the peace-offerings, which are the Lord's, will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：牛的脂油、綿羊的脂油、山羊的脂油，你們都不可吃。
english: Say to the children of Israel: You are not to take any fat, of ox or sheep or goat, for food.

chinese: 自死的和被野獸撕裂的，那脂油可以做別的使用，只是你們萬不可吃。
english: And the fat of that which comes to a natural death, and the fat of that which is attacked by beasts, may be used for other purposes, but not in any way for food.

chinese: 無論何人吃了獻給耶和華當火祭牲畜的脂油，那人必從民中剪除。
english: For anyone who takes as food the fat of any beast of which men make an offering by fire to the Lord, will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 在你們一切的住處，無論是雀鳥的血是野獸的血，你們都不可吃。
english: And you are not to take for food any blood, of bird or of beast, in any of your houses.

chinese: 無論是誰吃血，那人必從民中剪除。
english: Whoever takes any blood for food will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：獻平安祭給耶和華的，要從平安祭中取些來奉給耶和華。
english: Say to the children of Israel: He who makes a peace-offering to the Lord, is to give an offering to the Lord out of his peace-offering:

chinese: 他親手獻給耶和華的火祭，就是脂油和胸，要帶來，好把胸在耶和華面前作搖祭，搖一搖。
english: He himself is to take to the Lord the offering made by fire, even the fat with the breast, so that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.

chinese: 祭司要把脂油在壇上焚燒，但胸要歸亞倫和他的子孫。
english: And the fat is to be burned by the priest on the altar, but the breast is for Aaron and his sons.

chinese: 你們要從平安祭中把右腿作舉祭，奉給祭司。
english: And the right leg you are to give to the priest for an offering to be lifted up out of what is given for your peace-offerings.

chinese: 亞倫子孫中，獻平安祭牲血和脂油的，要得這右腿為分；
english: That man, among the sons of Aaron, by whom the blood of the peace-offering and the fat are offered, is to have the right leg for his part.

chinese: 因為我從以色列人的平安祭中，取了這搖的胸和舉的腿給祭司亞倫和他子孫，作他們從以色列人中所永得的分。
english: For the breast which is waved and the right leg which is lifted up on high I have taken from the children of Israel, from their peace-offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their right for ever from the children of Israel.

chinese: 這是從耶和華火祭中，作亞倫受膏的分和他子孫受膏的分，正在摩西（原文是他）叫他們前來給耶和華供祭司職分的日子，
english: This is the holy part given to Aaron and to his sons, out of the offerings made to the Lord by fire, on the day when they were made priests before the Lord;

chinese: 就是在摩西（原文是他）膏他們的日子，耶和華吩咐以色列人給他們的。這是他們世世代代永得的分。
english: Which the Lord said the children of Israel were to give them, on the day when he made them his priests. It is their right for ever from generation to generation.

chinese: 這就是燔祭、素祭、贖罪祭、贖愆祭，和平安祭的條例，並承接聖職的禮，
english: These are the laws for the burned offering, the meal offering, and the offering for wrongdoing; and for the making of priests, and for the giving of peace-offerings;

chinese: 都是耶和華在西乃山所吩咐摩西的，就是他在西乃曠野吩咐以色列人獻供物給耶和華之日所說的。
english: As they were given by the Lord to Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day when the Lord gave orders to the children of Israel to make their offerings to the Lord, in the waste land of Sinai.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你將亞倫和他兒子一同帶來，並將聖衣、膏油，與贖罪祭的一隻公牛、兩隻公綿羊、一筐無酵餅都帶來，
english: Take Aaron, and his sons with him, and the robes and the holy oil and the ox of the sin-offering and the two male sheep and the basket of unleavened bread;

chinese: 又招聚會眾到會幕門口。
english: And let all the people come together at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的行了；於是會眾聚集在會幕門口。
english: And Moses did as the Lord said, and all the people came together at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 摩西告訴會眾說：這就是耶和華所吩咐當行的事。
english: And Moses said to the people, This is what the Lord has given orders to be done.

chinese: 摩西帶了亞倫和他兒子來，用水洗了他們。
english: Then Moses took Aaron and his sons; and after washing them with water,

chinese: 給亞倫穿上內袍，束上腰帶，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用其上巧工織的帶子把以弗得繫在他身上，
english: He put the coat on him, making it tight with its band, and then the robe, and over it the ephod, with its band of needlework to keep it in place.

chinese: 又給他戴上胸牌，把烏陵和土明放在胸牌內，
english: And he put the priest's bag on him, and in the bag he put the Urim and Thummim.

chinese: 把冠冕戴在他頭上，在冠冕的前面釘上金牌，就是聖冠，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And on his head he put the head-dress, and in front of the head-dress the plate of gold, the holy crown, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 摩西用膏油抹帳幕和其中所有的，使他成聖；
english: And Moses took the holy oil and put it on the House and on all the things in it, to make them holy.

chinese: 又用膏油在壇上彈了七次，又抹了壇和壇的一切器皿，並洗濯盆和盆座，使他成聖；
english: Seven times he put oil on the altar and on all its vessels, and on the washing-basin and its base, to make them holy.

chinese: 又把膏油倒在亞倫的頭上膏他，使他成聖。
english: And some of the oil he put on Aaron's head, to make him holy.

chinese: 摩西帶了亞倫的兒子來，給他們穿上內袍，束上腰帶，包上裹頭巾，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: Then he took Aaron's sons, clothing them with the coats, and putting the bands round them, and the head-dresses on their heads, as the Lord had given him orders.

chinese: 他牽了贖罪祭的公牛來，亞倫和他兒子按手在贖罪祭公牛的頭上，
english: And he took the ox of the sin-offering: and Aaron and his sons put their hands on the head of the ox,

chinese: 就宰了公牛。摩西用指頭蘸血，抹在壇上四角的周圍，使壇潔淨，把血倒在壇的腳那裡，使壇成聖，壇就潔淨了；
english: And he put it to death; and Moses took the blood and put it on the horns of the altar and round it with his finger, and made the altar clean, draining out the blood at the base of the altar; so he made it holy, taking away what was unclean.

chinese: 又取臟上所有的脂油和肝上的網子，並兩個腰子與腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上；
english: And he took all the fat on the inside parts, and the fat on the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, to be burned on the altar;

chinese: 惟有公牛，連皮帶肉並糞，用火燒在營外，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: But the ox, with its skin and its flesh and its waste, was burned with fire outside the tent-circle, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 他奉上燔祭的公綿羊；亞倫和他兒子按手在羊的頭上，
english: And he put the male sheep of the burned offering before the Lord, and Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head,

chinese: 就宰了公羊。摩西把血灑在壇的周圍，
english: And he put it to death; and Moses put some of the blood on and round the altar.

chinese: 把羊切成塊子，把頭和肉塊並脂油都燒了。
english: And when the sheep had been cut into parts, the head and the parts and the fat were burned by Moses.

chinese: 用水洗了臟腑和腿，就把全羊燒在壇上為馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And the inside parts and the legs were washed with water and all the sheep was burned by Moses on the altar; it was a burned offering for a sweet smell: it was an offering made by fire to the Lord, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 他又奉上第二隻公綿羊，就是承接聖職之禮的羊；亞倫和他兒子按手在羊的頭上，
english: And he put the other sheep before the Lord, the sheep with which they were made priests; and Aaron and his sons put their hands on the head of the sheep,

chinese: 就宰了羊。摩西把些血抹在亞倫的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，
english: And he put it to death; and Moses took some of the blood and put it on the point of Aaron's right ear and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot.

chinese: 又帶了亞倫的兒子來，把些血抹在他們的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，又把血灑在壇的周圍。
english: Then he took Aaron's sons, and Moses put some of the blood on the point of their right ears and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the great toes of their right feet: and Moses put the blood on and round the altar.

chinese: 取脂油和肥尾巴，並臟上一切的脂油與肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，並右腿，
english: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and the fat on the inside parts, and the fat on the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right leg;

chinese: 再從耶和華面前、盛無酵餅的筐子裡取出一個無酵餅，一個油餅，一個薄餅，都放在脂油和右腿上，
english: And out of the basket of unleavened bread which was before the Lord he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of bread with oil on it, and one thin cake, and put them on the fat and on the right leg:

chinese: 把這一切放在亞倫的手上和他兒子的手上作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
english: And he put them all on the hands of Aaron and on the hands of his sons, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord.

chinese: 摩西從他們的手上拿下來，燒在壇上的燔祭上，都是為承接聖職獻給耶和華馨香的火祭。
english: And Moses took them from their hands, and they were burned on the altar on the burned offering, as a priest's offering for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 摩西拿羊的胸作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，是承接聖職之禮，歸摩西的分，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And Moses took the breast, waving it for a wave offering before the Lord; it was Moses' part of the sheep of the priest's offering, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 摩西取點膏油和壇上的血，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子和他兒子的衣服上，使他和他們的衣服一同成聖。
english: And Moses took some of the holy oil and of the blood which was on the altar and put it on Aaron and on his robes, and on his sons and on his sons' robes; and made Aaron holy, and his robes and his sons and his sons' robes with him.

chinese: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子說：把肉煮在會幕門口，在那裡吃，又吃承接聖職筐子裡的餅，按我所吩咐的說（或作：按所吩咐我的說）：這是亞倫和他兒子要吃的。
english: And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, The flesh is to be cooked in water at the door of the Tent of meeting, and there you are to take it as food, together with the bread in the basket, as I have given orders, saying, It is the food of Aaron and his sons.

chinese: 剩下的肉和餅，你們要用火焚燒。
english: And that which is over of the flesh and of the bread is to be burned with fire.

chinese: 你們七天不可出會幕的門，等到你們承接聖職的日子滿了，因為主叫你們七天承接聖職。
english: And you are not to go out from the door of the Tent of meeting for seven days, till the days for making you priest are ended; for this will be the work of seven days.

chinese: 像今天所行的都是耶和華吩咐行的，為你們贖罪。
english: What has been done this day, has been ordered by the Lord to take away your sin.

chinese: 七天你們要晝夜住在會幕門口，遵守耶和華的吩咐，免得你們死亡，因為所吩咐我的就是這樣。
english: And you are to keep watch for the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting day and night for seven days, so that death may not come to you: for so he has given me orders.

chinese: 於是亞倫和他兒子行了耶和華藉著摩西所吩咐的一切事。
english: And Aaron and his sons did all the things about which the Lord had given orders through Moses.

chinese: 到了第八天，摩西召了亞倫和他兒子，並以色列的眾長老來，
english: And on the eighth day Moses sent for Aaron and his sons and the responsible men of Israel;

chinese: 對亞倫說：你當取牛群中的一隻公牛犢作贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊作燔祭，都要沒有殘疾的，獻在耶和華面前。
english: And he said to Aaron, Take a young ox for a sin-offering and a male sheep for a burned offering, without a mark, and make an offering of them before the Lord.

chinese: 你也要對以色列人說：你們當取一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，又取一隻牛犢和一隻綿羊羔，都要一歲、沒有殘疾的，作燔祭，
english: And say to the children of Israel: Take a he-goat for a sin-offering, and a young ox and a lamb, in their first year, without any mark on them, for a burned offering;

chinese: 又取一隻公牛，一隻公綿羊作平安祭，獻在耶和華面前，並取調油的素祭，因為今天耶和華要向你們顯現。
english: And an ox and a male sheep for peace-offerings, to be put to death before the Lord; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for this day you are to see the Lord.

chinese: 於是他們把摩西所吩咐的，帶到會幕前；全會眾都近前來，站在耶和華面前。
english: And they took the things ordered by Moses, before the Tent of meeting, and all the people came near, waiting before the Lord.

chinese: 摩西說：這是耶和華吩咐你們所當行的；耶和華的榮光就要向你們顯現。
english: And Moses said, This is what the Lord has said you are to do; and you will see the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 摩西對亞倫說：你就近壇前，獻你的贖罪祭和燔祭，為自己與百姓贖罪，又獻上百姓的供物，為他們贖罪，都照耶和華所吩咐的。
english: And Moses said to Aaron, Come near to the altar and make your sin-offering and your burned offering to take away your sin and the sin of the people, and make the people's offering to take away their sin; as the Lord has given orders.

chinese: 於是，亞倫就近壇前，宰了為自己作贖罪祭的牛犢。
english: So Aaron came near to the altar and put to death the ox for the sin-offering for himself;

chinese: 亞倫的兒子把血奉給他，他就把指頭蘸在血中，抹在壇的四角上，又把血倒在壇腳那裡。
english: And the sons of Aaron gave him the blood and he put his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar, draining out the blood at the base of the altar;

chinese: 惟有贖罪祭的脂油和腰子，並肝上取的網子，都燒在壇上，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的；
english: But the fat and the kidneys and the fat on the liver of the sin-offering were burned by him on the altar as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 又用火將肉和皮燒在營外。
english: And the flesh and the skin were burned with fire outside the tent-circle;

chinese: 亞倫宰了燔祭牲，他兒子把血遞給他，他就灑在壇的周圍，
english: And he put to death the burned offering; and Aaron's sons gave him the blood and he put some of it on and round the altar;

chinese: 又把燔祭一塊一塊的、連頭遞給他，他都燒在壇上；
english: And they gave him the parts of the burned offering, in their order, and the head, to be burned on the altar.

chinese: 又洗了臟腑和腿，燒在壇上的燔祭上。
english: And the inside parts and the legs, when they had been washed with water, were burned on the burned offering on the altar.

chinese: 他奉上百姓的供物，把那給百姓作贖罪祭的公山羊宰了，為罪獻上，和先獻的一樣；
english: And he made an offering for the people and took the goat of the sin-offering for the people and put it to death, offering it for sin, in the same way as the first.

chinese: 也奉上燔祭，照例而獻。
english: And he took the burned offering, offering it in the ordered way;

chinese: 他又奉上素祭，從其中取一滿把，燒在壇上；這是在早晨的燔祭以外。
english: And he put the meal offering before the Lord, and taking some of it in his hand he had it burned on the altar, separately from the burned offering of the morning.

chinese: 亞倫宰了那給百姓作平安祭的公牛和公綿羊。他兒子把血遞給他，他就灑在壇的周圍；
english: And he put to death the ox and the sheep, which were the peace-offerings for the people; and Aaron's sons gave him the blood and he put some of it on and round the altar;

chinese: 又把公牛和公綿羊的脂油、肥尾巴，並蓋臟的脂油與腰子，和肝上的網子，都遞給他；
english: And as for the fat of the ox and the fat tail of the sheep and the fat covering the inside parts and the kidneys and the fat on the liver;

chinese: 把脂油放在胸上，他就把脂油燒在壇上。
english: They put the fat on the breasts, and the fat was burned on the altar.

chinese: 胸和右腿，亞倫當作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，都是照摩西所吩咐的。
english: And Aaron took the breasts and the right leg, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord, as Moses gave orders.

chinese: 亞倫向百姓舉手，為他們祝福。他獻了贖罪祭、燔祭、平安祭就下來了。
english: And Aaron, lifting up his hands to the people, gave them a blessing; and he came down from offering the sin-offering, and the burned offering, and the peace-offerings.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫進入會幕，又出來為百姓祝福，耶和華的榮光就向眾民顯現。
english: And Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of meeting, and came out and gave the people a blessing, and the glory of the Lord was seen by all the people.

chinese: 有火從耶和華面前出來，在壇上燒盡燔祭和脂油；眾民一見，就都歡呼，俯伏在地。
english: And fire came out from before the Lord, burning up the offering on the altar and the fat: and when all the people saw it, they gave a loud cry, falling down on their faces.

chinese: 亞倫的兒子拿答、亞比戶各拿自己的香爐，盛上火，加上香，在耶和華面前獻上凡火，是耶和華沒有吩咐他們的，
english: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took their vessels and put fire in them and perfume, burning strange fire before the Lord, which he had not given them orders to do.

chinese: 就有火從耶和華面前出來，把他們燒滅，他們就死在耶和華面前。
english: And fire came out from before the Lord, burning them up and causing their destruction before the Lord.

chinese: 於是摩西對亞倫說：這就是耶和華所說：我在親近我的人中要顯為聖；在眾民面前，我要得榮耀。亞倫就默默不言。
english: Then Moses said to Aaron, This is what the Lord said, I will be holy in the eyes of all those who come near to me, and I will be honoured before all the people. And Aaron said nothing.

chinese: 摩西召了亞倫叔父烏薛的兒子米沙利、以利撒反來，對他們說：上前來，把你們的親屬從聖所前抬到營外。
english: And Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel, the brother of Aaron's father, and said to them, Come near and take your brothers away from before the holy place, outside the tent-circle.

chinese: 於是二人上前來，把他們穿著袍子抬到營外，是照摩西所吩咐的。
english: So they came and took them, in their coats, outside the tent-circle, as Moses had said.

chinese: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說：不可蓬頭散髮，也不可撕裂衣裳，免得你們死亡，又免得耶和華向會眾發怒；只要你們的弟兄以色列全家為耶和華所發的火哀哭。
english: And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons, Do not let your hair be loose, and give no signs of grief; so that death may not overtake you, and his wrath come on all the people; but let there be weeping among your brothers and all the house of Israel for this burning of the Lord's fire.

chinese: 你們也不可出會幕的門，恐怕你們死亡，因為耶和華的膏油在你們的身上。他們就照摩西的話行了。
english: And do not go out from the door of the Tent of meeting, or death will come to you; for the holy oil of the Lord is on you. And they did as Moses said.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Aaron:

chinese: 你和你兒子進會幕的時候，清酒、濃酒都不可喝，免得你們死亡；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
english: Take no wine, or strong drink, you or your sons with you, when you go into the Tent of meeting, that it may not be the cause of death to you; this is an order for ever through all your generations.

chinese: 使你們可以將聖的、俗的，潔淨的、不潔淨的，分別出來；
english: And make a division between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean;

chinese: 又使你們可以將耶和華藉摩西曉諭以色列人的一切律例教訓他們。
english: Teaching the children of Israel all the laws which the Lord has given them by the hand of Moses.

chinese: 摩西對亞倫和他剩下的兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說：你們獻給耶和華火祭中所剩的素祭，要在壇旁不帶酵而吃，因為是至聖的。
english: And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons who were still living, Take the rest of the meal offering from the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and take it for your food, without leaven, at the side of the altar, for it is most holy.

chinese: 你們要在聖處吃；因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中，這是你的分和你兒子的分；所吩咐我的本是這樣。
english: It is to be for your food in a holy place, because it is your right and your sons' right, from the offerings of the Lord made by fire: for so am I ordered.

chinese: 所搖的胸，所舉的腿，你們要在潔淨地方吃。你和你的兒女都要同吃；因為這些是從以色列人平安祭中給你，當你的分和你兒子的分。
english: And the breast which is waved and the leg which is lifted up on high, you are to take as your food in a clean place; you and your sons and your daughters with you: for they are given to you as your right and your sons' right, from the peace-offerings of the children of Israel.

chinese: 所舉的腿，所搖的胸，他們要與火祭的脂油一同帶來當搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這要歸你和你兒子，當作永得的分，都是照耶和華所吩咐的。
english: Let them take the breast which is waved and the leg which is lifted up on high, with the fat of the burned offering, to be waved for a wave offering before the Lord; and this will be for you and for your sons with you, for a right for ever, as the Lord has given orders.

chinese: 當下摩西急切的尋找作贖罪祭的公山羊，誰知已經焚燒了，便向亞倫剩下的兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪發怒，說：
english: And Moses was looking for the goat of the sin-offering, but it was burned; and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron, who were still living, saying,

chinese: 這贖罪祭既是至聖的，主又給了你們，為要你們擔當會眾的罪孽，在耶和華面前為他們贖罪，你們為何沒有在聖所吃呢？
english: Why did you not make a meal of the sin-offering in the holy place? For it is most holy and he has given it to you, so that the sin of the people may be put on it, to take away their sin before the Lord.

chinese: 看哪，這祭牲的血並沒有拿到聖所裡去，你們本當照我所吩咐的，在聖所裡吃這祭肉。
english: See, its blood was not taken into the holy place: certainly it was right for you to have taken it as food in the holy place, as I gave orders.

chinese: 亞倫對摩西說：今天他們在耶和華面前獻上贖罪祭和燔祭，我又遇見這樣的災，若今天吃了贖罪祭，耶和華豈能看為美呢？
english: And Aaron said to Moses, You have seen that today they have made their sin-offering and their burned offering before the Lord, and such things as these have come on me. If I had taken the sin-offering as food today, would it have been pleasing to the Lord?

chinese: 摩西聽見這話，便以為美。
english: And after hearing this, Moses was no longer angry.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 你們曉諭以色列人說，在地上一切走獸中可吃的乃是這些：
english: Say to the children of Israel: These are the living things which you may have for food among all the beasts on the earth.

chinese: 凡蹄分兩瓣、倒嚼的走獸，你們都可以吃。
english: You may have as food any beast which has a division in the horn of its foot, and whose food comes back into its mouth to be crushed again.

chinese: 但那倒嚼或分蹄之中不可吃的乃是：駱駝─因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
english: But, at the same time, of those beasts, you may not take for food the camel, because its food comes back but the horn of its foot is not parted in two; it is unclean to you.

chinese: 沙番─因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
english: And the rock-badger, for the same reason, is unclean to you.

chinese: 兔子─因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
english: And the hare, because the horn of its foot is not parted in two, is unclean to you.

chinese: 豬─因為蹄分兩瓣，卻不倒嚼，就與你們不潔淨。
english: And the pig is unclean to you, because though the horn of its foot is parted, its food does not come back.

chinese: 這些獸的肉，你們不可吃；死的，你們不可摸，都與你們不潔淨。
english: Their flesh may not be used for food, and their dead bodies may not even be touched; they are unclean to you.

chinese: 水中可吃的乃是這些：凡在水裡、海裡、河裡、有翅有鱗的，都可以吃。
english: These you may have for food of all things living in the water: anything living in the water, in the seas or rivers, which has special parts for swimming and skin formed of thin plates, may be used for food.

chinese: 凡在海裡、河裡，並一切水裡游動的活物，無翅無鱗的，你們都當以為可憎。
english: All other things living and moving in the water, in the sea or in the rivers, are a disgusting thing to you;

chinese: 這些無翅無鱗、以為可憎的，你們不可吃他的肉；死的也當以為可憎。
english: They may not be used for food, and their dead bodies are disgusting to you.

chinese: 凡水裡無翅無鱗的，你們都當以為可憎。
english: Anything in the water which has no special parts for swimming and no thin plates on its skin is disgusting to you.

chinese: 雀鳥中你們當以為可憎、不可吃的乃是：鵰、狗頭鵰、紅頭鵰、
english: And among birds these are to be disgusting to you, and not to be used for food: the eagle and the gier-eagle and the ospray;

chinese: 鷂鷹、小鷹與其類；
english: And the kite and the falcon, and birds of that sort;

chinese: 烏鴉與其類；
english: Every raven, and birds of that sort;

chinese: 鴕鳥、夜鷹、魚鷹、鷹與其類；
english: And the ostrich and the night-hawk and the sea-hawk, and birds of that sort;

chinese: 鴞鳥、鸕鶿、貓頭鷹、
english: And the little owl and the cormorant and the great owl;

chinese: 角鴟、鵜鶘、禿鵰、
english: And the water-hen and the pelican and the vulture;

chinese: 鸛、鷺鷥與其類；戴鵀與蝙蝠。
english: The stork and the heron, and birds of that sort, and the hoopoe and the bat.

chinese: 凡有翅膀用四足爬行的物，你們都當以為可憎。
english: Every winged four-footed thing which goes on the earth is disgusting to you;

chinese: 只是有翅膀用四足爬行的物中，有足有腿，在地上蹦跳的，你們還可以吃。
english: But of the winged four-footed things, those which have long legs for jumping on the earth you may have for food;

chinese: 其中有蝗蟲、螞蚱、蟋蟀與其類；蚱蜢與其類；這些你們都可以吃。
english: Such as all the different sorts of locust.

chinese: 但是有翅膀有四足的爬物，你們都當以為可憎。
english: But all other winged four-footed things which go on the earth are disgusting to you.

chinese: 這些都能使你們不潔淨。凡摸了死的，必不潔淨到晚上。
english: By these you will be made unclean; anyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean till evening:

chinese: 凡拿了死的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。
english: Whoever takes away the dead body of one of them is to have his clothing washed, and will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 凡走獸分蹄不成兩瓣、也不倒嚼的，是與你們不潔淨；凡摸了的就不潔淨。
english: Every beast, in the horn of whose foot there is not a complete division, and whose food does not come back, is unclean to you: anyone touching one of these will be unclean.

chinese: 凡四足的走獸，用掌行走的，是與你們不潔淨；摸其屍的，必不潔淨到晚上。
english: Any four-footed beast which goes on the ball of its foot, is unclean to you: anyone touching the dead body of one of these will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 拿其屍的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。這些是與你們不潔淨的。
english: Anyone who takes away the dead body of one of these is to have his clothing washed and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 地上爬物與你們不潔淨的乃是這些：鼬鼠、鼫鼠、蜥蜴與其類；
english: And these are unclean to you among things which go low down on the earth; the weasel and the mouse and the great lizard, and animals of that sort;

chinese: 壁虎、龍子、守宮、蛇醫、蝘蜓。
english: And the ferret and the land crocodile and the lizard and the sand-lizard and the chameleon.

chinese: 這些爬物都是與你們不潔淨的。在他死了以後，凡摸了的，必不潔淨到晚上。
english: All these are unclean to you: anyone touching them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 其中死了的，掉在甚麼東西上，這東西就不潔淨，無論是木器、衣服、皮子、口袋，不拘是做甚麼工用的器皿，須要放在水中，必不潔淨到晚上，到晚上才潔淨了。
english: The dead body of any of these, falling on anything, will make that thing unclean; if it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or bag, whatever it is, if it is used for any purpose, it will have to be put into water, and will be unclean till evening; after that it will be clean.

chinese: 若有死了掉在瓦器裡的，其中不拘有甚麼，就不潔淨，你們要把這瓦器打破了。
english: And if one of them gets into any vessel of earth, whatever is in the vessel will be unclean and the vessel will have to be broken.

chinese: 其中一切可吃的食物，沾水的就不潔淨，並且那樣器皿中一切可喝的，也必不潔淨。
english: Any food in it, and anything on which water from it comes, will be unclean: any drink taken from such a vessel will be unclean.

chinese: 其中已死的，若有一點掉在甚麼物件上，那物件就不潔淨，不拘是爐子，是鍋臺，就要打碎，都不潔淨，也必與你們不潔淨。
english: Any part of the dead body of one of these, falling on anything, will make it unclean; if it is an oven or a cooking-pot it will have to be broken: they are unclean and will be unclean to you.

chinese: 但是泉源或是聚水的池子仍是潔淨；惟挨了那死的，就不潔淨。
english: But at the same time a fountain or a place where water is stored for use will be clean; but anyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean.

chinese: 若是死的，有一點掉在要種的子粒上，子粒仍是潔淨；
english: If any part of the dead body of one of these gets on to any seed for planting, it is clean;

chinese: 若水已經澆在子粒上，那死的有一點掉在上頭，這子粒就與你們不潔淨。
english: But if water is put on the seed, and any part of the dead body gets on to it, it will be unclean to you.

chinese: 你們可吃的走獸若是死了，有人摸他，必不潔淨到晚上；
english: And if any beast which may be used for food comes to a natural death, anyone touching its dead body will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 有人吃那死了的走獸，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服；拿了死走獸的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。
english: And he who makes use of any part of its body for food is to have his clothing washed and be unclean till evening; and anyone taking away its body is to have his clothing washed and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 凡地上的爬物是可憎的，都不可吃。
english: Everything which goes flat on its body on the earth is disgusting, and is not to be used for food.

chinese: 凡用肚子行走的和用四足行走的，或是有許多足的，就是一切爬在地上的，你們都不可吃，因為是可憎的。
english: Whatever goes on its stomach or on four feet or has a great number of feet, even all those going flat on the earth, may not be used for food, for they are disgusting.

chinese: 你們不可因甚麼爬物使自己成為可憎的，也不可因這些使自己不潔淨，以致染了污穢。
english: You are not to make yourselves disgusting with anything which goes about flat on the earth; you may not make yourselves unclean with them, in such a way that you are not holy to me.

chinese: 我是耶和華─你們的神；所以你們要成為聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。你們也不可在地上的爬物污穢自己。
english: For I am the Lord your God: for this reason, make and keep yourselves holy, for I am holy; you are not to make yourselves unclean with any sort of thing which goes about flat on the earth.

chinese: 我是把你們從埃及地領出來的耶和華，要作你們的神；所以你們要聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。
english: For I am the Lord, who took you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God; so be you holy, for I am holy.

chinese: 這是走獸、飛鳥，和水中游動的活物，並地上爬物的條例。
english: This is the law about beasts and birds and every living thing moving in the waters, and every living thing which goes flat on the earth:

chinese: 要把潔淨的和不潔淨的，可吃的與不可吃的活物，都分別出來。
english: Marking out the unclean from the clean, and the living thing which may be used for food from that which may not.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：若有婦人懷孕生男孩，他就不潔淨七天，像在月經污穢的日子不潔淨一樣。
english: Say to the children of Israel, If a woman is with child and gives birth to a male child, she will be unclean for seven days, as when she is unwell.

chinese: 第八天，要給嬰孩行割禮。
english: And on the eighth day let him be given circumcision.

chinese: 婦人在產血不潔之中，要家居三十三天。他潔淨的日子未滿，不可摸聖物，也不可進入聖所。
english: And she will be unclean for thirty-three days till the flow of her blood is stopped; no holy thing may be touched by her, and she may not come into the holy place, till the days for making her clean are ended.

chinese: 他若生女孩，就不潔淨兩個七天，像污穢的時候一樣，要在產血不潔之中，家居六十六天。
english: But if she gives birth to a female child, then she will be unclean for two weeks, as when she is unwell; and she will not be completely clean for sixty-six days.

chinese: 滿了潔淨的日子，無論是為男孩是為女孩，他要把一歲的羊羔為燔祭，一隻雛鴿或是一隻斑鳩為贖罪祭，帶到會幕門口交給祭司。
english: And when the days are ended for making her clean for a son or a daughter, let her take to the priest at the door of the Tent of meeting, a lamb of the first year for a burned offering and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin-offering:

chinese: 祭司要獻在耶和華面前，為他贖罪，他的血源就潔淨了。這條例是為生育的婦人，無論是生男生女。
english: And the priest is to make an offering of it before the Lord and take away her sin, and she will be made clean from the flow of her blood. This is the law for a woman who gives birth to a male or a female.

chinese: 他的力量不夠獻一隻羊羔，他就要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，一隻為燔祭，一隻為贖罪祭。祭司要為他贖罪，他就潔淨了。
english: And if she has not money enough for a lamb, then let her take two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burned offering and the other for a sin-offering, and the priest will take away her sin and she will be clean,

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 人的肉皮上若長了癤子，或長了癬，或長了火斑，在他肉皮上成了大痲瘋的災病，就要將他帶到祭司亞倫或亞倫作祭司的一個子孫面前。
english: If a man has on his skin a growth or a mark or a white place, and it becomes the disease of a leper, let him be taken to Aaron the priest, or to one of the priests, his sons;

chinese: 祭司要察看肉皮上的災病，若災病處的毛已經變白，災病的現象深於肉上的皮，這便是大痲瘋的災病。祭司要察看他，定他為不潔淨。
english: And if, when the priest sees the mark on his skin, the hair on the place is turned white and the mark seems to go deeper than the skin, it is the mark of a leper: and the priest, after looking at him, will say that he is unclean.

chinese: 若火斑在他肉皮上是白的，現象不深於皮，其上的毛也沒有變白，祭司就要將有災病的人關鎖七天。
english: But if the mark on his skin is white, and does not seem to go deeper than the skin, and the hair on it is not turned white, then the priest will keep him shut up for seven days;

chinese: 第七天，祭司要察看他，若看災病止住了，沒有在皮上發散，祭司還要將他關鎖七天。
english: And the priest is to see him on the seventh day; and if, in his opinion, the place on his skin has not become worse and is not increased in size, then the priest will keep him shut up for seven days more:

chinese: 第七天，祭司要再察看他，若災病發暗，而且沒有在皮上發散，祭司要定他為潔淨，原來是癬；那人就要洗衣服，得為潔淨。
english: And the priest is to see him again on the seventh day; and if the mark is less bright and is not increased on his skin, then let the priest say that he is clean: it is only a skin-mark, and after his clothing has been washed he will be clean.

chinese: 但他為得潔淨，將身體給祭司察看以後，癬若在皮上發散開了，他要再將身體給祭司察看。
english: But if the size of the mark on his skin is increased after he has been seen by the priest, let him go to the priest again:

chinese: 祭司要察看，癬若在皮上發散，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋。
english: And if, after looking at him, he sees that the mark is increased in his skin, let the priest say that he is unclean; he is a leper.

chinese: 人有了大痲瘋的災病，就要將他帶到祭司面前。
english: When the disease of a leper is seen on a man, let him be taken to the priest;

chinese: 祭司要察看，皮上若長了白癤，使毛變白，在長白癤之處有了紅瘀肉，
english: And if the priest sees that there is a white growth on the skin, and the hair is turned white, and there is diseased flesh in the growth,

chinese: 這是肉皮上的舊大痲瘋，祭司要定他為不潔淨，不用將他關鎖，因為他是不潔淨了。
english: It is an old disease in the skin of his flesh, and the priest will say that he is unclean; he will not have to be shut up, for he is clearly unclean.

chinese: 大痲瘋若在皮上四外發散，長滿了患災病人的皮，據祭司察看，從頭到腳無處不有，
english: And if the disease comes out all over his skin, from his head to his feet, as far as the priest is able to see,

chinese: 祭司就要察看，全身的肉若長滿了大痲瘋，就要定那患災病的為潔淨；全身都變為白，他乃潔淨了。
english: And if the priest sees that all his flesh is covered with the leper's disease, the priest will say that he is clean: it is all turned white, he is clean.

chinese: 但紅肉幾時顯在他的身上就幾時不潔淨。
english: But whenever diseased flesh is seen on him, he will be unclean.

chinese: 祭司一看那紅肉就定他為不潔淨。紅肉本是不潔淨，是大痲瘋。
english: And when the priest sees the diseased flesh he will say that he is unclean; the diseased flesh is unclean, he is a leper.

chinese: 紅肉若復原，又變白了，他就要來見祭司。
english: Or if the diseased flesh is turned again and changed to white then he is to come to the priest,

chinese: 祭司要察看，災病處若變白了，祭司就要定那患災病的為潔淨，他乃潔淨了。
english: And the priest will see him: and if the place is turned white, then the priest will say that he is free from the disease.

chinese: 人若在皮肉上長瘡，卻治好了，
english: And if a bad place has come out on the skin and is well again,

chinese: 在長瘡之處又起了白癤，或是白中帶紅的火斑，就要給祭司察看。
english: And on the same place there is a white growth of a bright mark, red and white, then let the priest see it;

chinese: 祭司要察看，若現象窪於皮，其上的毛也變白了，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病發在瘡中。
english: And after looking at it, if it seems to go deeper than the skin, and the hair on it is turned white, then the priest will say that the man is unclean: it is the leper's disease, it has come out in the bad place.

chinese: 祭司若察看，其上沒有白毛，也沒有窪於皮，乃是發暗，就要將他關鎖七天。
english: But if, after looking at it, he sees that there are no white hairs on it, and it is not deeper than the skin, and it is not very bright, then let the priest keep him shut up for seven days:

chinese: 若在皮上發散開了，祭司就要定他為不潔淨，是災病。
english: And if it is increasing on the skin, the priest will say that he is unclean: it is a disease.

chinese: 火斑若在原處止住，沒有發散，便是瘡的痕跡，祭司就要定他為潔淨。
english: But if the bright mark keeps in the same place and gets no greater, it is the mark of the old wound, and the priest will say that he is clean.

chinese: 人的皮肉上若起了火毒，火毒的瘀肉成了火斑，或是白中帶紅的，或是全白的，
english: Or if there is a burn on the skin of the flesh, and if the diseased flesh in the burn becomes a bright place, red and white or white,

chinese: 祭司就要察看，火斑中的毛若變白了，現象又深於皮，是大痲瘋在火毒中發出，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病。
english: The priest is to see it: and if the hair on the bright place is turned white and it seems to go deeper than the skin, he is a leper: it has come out in the burn, and the priest will say that he is unclean: it is the leper's disease.

chinese: 但是祭司察看，在火斑中若沒有白毛，也沒有窪於皮，乃是發暗，就要將他關鎖七天。
english: But if, after looking at it, the priest sees that there is no white hair on the bright place, and it is not deeper than the skin, and is not very bright, then let the priest keep him shut up for seven days:

chinese: 到第七天，祭司要察看他，火斑若在皮上發散開了，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病。
english: And the priest is to see him again on the seventh day; if it is increased in the skin, then the priest will say that he is unclean: it is the leper's disease.

chinese: 火斑若在原處止住，沒有在皮上發散，乃是發暗，是起的火毒，祭司要定他為潔淨，不過是火毒的痕跡。
english: And if the bright place keeps the same size and gets no greater on the skin, but is less bright, it is the effect of the burn, and the priest will say that he is clean: it is the mark of the burn.

chinese: 無論男女，若在頭上有災病，或是男人鬍鬚上有災病，
english: And when a man or a woman has a disease on the head, or in the hair of the chin,

chinese: 祭司就要察看；這災病現象若深於皮，其間有細黃毛，就要定他為不潔淨，這是頭疥，是頭上或是鬍鬚上的大痲瘋。
