english: Then the priest is to see the diseased place: and if it seems to go deeper than the skin, and if there is thin yellow hair in it, then the priest will say that he is unclean: he has the mark of the leper's disease on his head or in the hair of his chin.

chinese: 祭司若察看頭疥的災病，現象不深於皮，其間也沒有黑毛，就要將長頭疥災病的關鎖七天。
english: And after looking at the diseased place, if it does not seem to go deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest will have him shut up for seven days:

chinese: 第七天，祭司要察看災病，若頭疥沒有發散，其間也沒有黃毛，頭疥的現象不深於皮，
english: And on the seventh day the priest will see the place: and if it is not increased, and there is no yellow hair in it, and it does not seem to go deeper than the skin,

chinese: 那人就要剃去鬚髮，但他不可剃頭疥之處。祭司要將那長頭疥的，再關鎖七天。
english: Then his hair is to be cut off, but not on the diseased place, and he is to be shut up for seven days more:

chinese: 第七天，祭司要察看頭疥，頭疥若沒有在皮上發散，現象也不深於皮，就要定他為潔淨，他要洗衣服，便成為潔淨。
english: And on the seventh day the priest will see the place: and if it is not increased, and does not seem to go deeper than the skin, the priest will say that he is clean: and after his clothing has been washed he will be clean.

chinese: 但他得潔淨以後，頭疥若在皮上發散開了，
english: But if the disease in his skin becomes worse after he has been made clean,

chinese: 祭司就要察看他。頭疥若在皮上發散，就不必找那黃毛，他是不潔淨了。
english: Then the priest is to see him: and if the mark is increased, the priest, without looking for the yellow hair, will say that he is unclean.

chinese: 祭司若看頭疥已經止住，其間也長了黑毛，頭疥已然痊愈，那人是潔淨了，就要定他為潔淨。
english: But if, in his opinion, the growth is stopped, and black hair has come up on it, the disease has gone; he is clean and the priest will say that he is clean.

chinese: 無論男女，皮肉上若起了火斑，就是白火斑，
english: And if a man or a woman has bright marks on the skin of their flesh, that is, bright white marks,

chinese: 祭司就要察看，他們肉皮上的火斑若白中帶黑，這是皮上發出的白癬，那人是潔淨了。
english: Then the priest is to see them: and if the white marks on their skin are not very bright, it is a skin disease which has come out on the skin; he is clean.

chinese: 人頭上的髮若掉了，他不過是頭禿，還是潔淨。
english: And if a man's hair has come out and he has no hair, still he is clean.

chinese: 他頂前若掉了頭髮，他不過是頂門禿，還是潔淨。
english: And if the hair has gone from the front part of his head, so that he has no hair there, still he is clean.

chinese: 頭禿處或是頂門禿處若有白中帶紅的災病，這就是大痲瘋發在他頭禿處或是頂門禿處，
english: But if, on his head or on his brow, where he has no hair, there is a red and white place, it is the disease of the leper coming out on his head or on his brow.

chinese: 祭司就要察看，他起的那災病若在頭禿處或是頂門禿處有白中帶紅的，像肉皮上大痲瘋的現象，
english: Then if the priest sees that the growth of the disease has become red and white on his head or on his brow where there is no hair, like the mark in the skin of a leper;

chinese: 那人就是長大痲瘋，不潔淨的，祭司總要定他為不潔淨，他的災病是在頭上。
english: He is a leper and unclean; the priest is to say that he is most certainly unclean: the disease is in his head.

chinese: 身上有長大痲瘋災病的，他的衣服要撕裂，也要蓬頭散髮，蒙著上唇，喊叫說：不潔淨了！不潔淨了！
english: And the leper who has the disease on him is to go about with signs of grief, with his hair loose and his mouth covered, crying, Unclean, unclean.

chinese: 災病在他身上的日子，他便是不潔淨；他既是不潔淨，就要獨居營外。
english: While the disease is on him, he will be unclean. He is unclean: let him keep by himself, living outside the tent-circle.

chinese: 染了大痲瘋災病的衣服，無論是羊毛衣服、是麻布衣服，
english: And any clothing of wool or of linen in which is the mark of the disease;

chinese: 無論是在經上、在緯上，是麻布的、是羊毛的，是在皮子上，或在皮子做的甚麼物件上，
english: If it is in the threads of the linen or of the wool, or in leather, or in anything made of skin;

chinese: 或在衣服上、皮子上，經上、緯上，或在皮子做的甚麼物件上，這災病若是發綠，或是發紅，是大痲瘋的災病，要給祭司察看。
english: If there are red or green marks on the clothing, or on the leather, or in the threads of the cloth, or in anything made of skin, it is the leper's disease: let the priest see it.

chinese: 祭司就要察看那災病，把染了災病的物件關鎖七天。
english: And after it has been seen by the priest, the thing which is so marked is to be shut up for seven days:

chinese: 第七天，他要察看那災病，災病或在衣服上，經上、緯上，皮子上，若發散，這皮子無論當作何用，這災病是蠶食的大痲瘋，都是不潔淨了。
english: And he is to see the mark on the seventh day; if the mark is increased in the clothing, or in the threads of the material, or in the leather, whatever the leather is used for, it is the disease biting into it: it is unclean.

chinese: 那染了災病的衣服，或是經上、緯上，羊毛上，麻衣上，或是皮子做的甚麼物件上，他都要焚燒；因為這是蠶食的大痲瘋，必在火中焚燒。
english: And the clothing, or the wool or linen material, or anything of leather in which is the disease, is to be burned: for the disease is biting into it; let it be burned in the fire.

chinese: 祭司要察看，若災病在衣服上，經上、緯上，或是皮子做的甚麼物件上，沒有發散，
english: And if the priest sees that the mark is not increased in the clothing or in any part of the material or in the leather,

chinese: 祭司就要吩咐他們，把染了災病的物件洗了，再關鎖七天。
english: Then the priest will give orders for the thing on which the mark is, to be washed, and to be shut up for seven days more:

chinese: 洗過以後，祭司要察看，那物件若沒有變色，災病也沒有消散，那物件就不潔淨，是透重的災病，無論正面反面，都要在火中焚燒。
english: And if, after the mark has been washed, the priest sees that the colour of it is not changed and it is not increased, it is to be burned in the fire: the disease is working in it, though the damage may be inside or outside.

chinese: 洗過以後，祭司要察看，若見那災病發暗，他就要把那災病從衣服上、皮子上、經上、緯上，都撕去。
english: And if the priest sees that the mark is less bright after the washing, then let him have it cut out of the clothing or the leather or from the threads of the material:

chinese: 若仍現在衣服上，或是經上、緯上、皮子做的甚麼物件上，這就是災病又發了、必用火焚燒那染災病的物件。
english: And if the mark is still seen in the clothing or in the threads of the material or in the leather, it is the disease coming out: the thing in which the disease is will have to be burned with fire.

chinese: 所洗的衣服，或是經，或是緯，或是皮子做的甚麼物件，若災病離開了，要再洗，就潔淨了。
english: And the material of the clothing, or anything of skin, which has been washed, if the mark has gone out of it, let it be washed a second time and it will be clean.

chinese: 這就是大痲瘋災病的條例，無論是在羊毛衣服上，麻布衣服上，經上、緯上，和皮子做的甚麼物件上，可以定為潔淨或是不潔淨。
english: This is the law about the leper's disease in the thread of wool or linen material, in clothing or in anything of skin, saying how it is to be judged clean or unclean.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 長大痲瘋得潔淨的日子，其例乃是這樣：要帶他去見祭司；
english: This is the law of the leper on the day when he is made clean: he is to be taken to the priest;

chinese: 祭司要出到營外察看，若見他的大痲瘋痊愈了
english: And the priest is to go outside the tent-circle; and if, after looking, the priest sees that the mark of the disease has gone from him,

chinese: 就要吩咐人為那求潔淨的拿兩隻潔淨的活鳥和香柏木、朱紅色線，並牛膝草來。
english: Then the priest is to give orders to take, for him who is to be made clean, two living clean birds and some cedar wood and red thread and hyssop.

chinese: 祭司要吩咐用瓦器盛活水，把一隻鳥宰在上面。
english: And the priest will give orders for one of the birds to be put to death in a vessel made of earth, over flowing water.

chinese: 至於那隻活鳥，祭司要把他和香柏木、朱紅色線並牛膝草一同蘸於宰在活水上的鳥血中，
english: And he will take the living bird and the wood and the red thread and the hyssop and put them in the blood of the bird which was put to death over flowing water.

chinese: 用以在那長大痲瘋求潔淨的人身上灑七次，就定他為潔淨，又把活鳥放在田野裡。
english: And shaking it seven times over the man who is to be made clean, he will say that he is clean and will let the living bird go free into the open country.

chinese: 求潔淨的人當洗衣服，剃去毛髮，用水洗澡，就潔淨了；然後可以進營，只是要在自己的帳棚外居住七天。
english: And he who is to be made clean will have his clothing washed and his hair cut and have a bath, and he will be clean. And after that he will come back to the tent-circle; but he is to keep outside his tent for seven days.

chinese: 第七天，再把頭上所有的頭髮與鬍鬚、眉毛，並全身的毛，都剃了；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就潔淨了。
english: And on the seventh day he is to have all the hair cut off his head and his chin and over his eyes--all his hair is to be cut off--and he will have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and he will be clean.

chinese: 第八天，他要取兩隻沒有殘疾的公羊羔和一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的母羊羔，又要把調油的細麵伊法十分之三為素祭，並油一羅革，一同取來。
english: And on the eighth day let him take two male lambs, without any marks on them, and one female lamb of the first year, without a mark, and three tenth parts of an ephah of the best meal, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

chinese: 行潔淨之禮的祭司要將那求潔淨的人和這些東西安置在會幕門口、耶和華面前。
english: And the priest who is making him clean will put the man who is being made clean, together with these things, before the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 祭司要取一隻公羊羔獻為贖愆祭，和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；
english: And the priest is to take one of the male lambs and give it as an offering for wrongdoing, and the log of oil, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord;

chinese: 把公羊羔宰於聖地，就是宰贖罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地。贖愆祭要歸祭司，與贖罪祭一樣，是至聖的。
english: And he is to put the male lamb to death in the place where they put to death the sin-offering and the burned offering, in the holy place; for as the sin-offering is the property of the priest, so is the offering for wrongdoing: it is most holy.

chinese: 祭司要取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
english: And let the priest take some of the blood of the offering for wrongdoing and put it on the point of the right ear of him who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot;

chinese: 祭司要從那一羅革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌裡，
english: And take some of the oil and put it in the hollow of his left hand;

chinese: 把右手的一個指頭蘸在左手的油裡，在耶和華面前用指頭彈七次。
english: And let the priest put his right finger in the oil which is in his left hand, shaking it out with his finger seven times before the Lord;

chinese: 將手裡所剩的油抹在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹在贖愆祭牲的血上。
english: And of the rest of the oil which is in his hand, the priest will put some on the point of the right ear of the man who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot, over the blood of the offering for wrongdoing;

chinese: 祭司手裡所剩的油要抹在那求潔淨人的頭上，在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
english: And the rest of the oil in the priest's hand he will put on the head of him who is to be made clean; and so the priest will make him free from sin before the Lord.

chinese: 祭司要獻贖罪祭，為那本不潔淨、求潔淨的人贖罪；然後要宰燔祭牲，
english: And the priest will give the sin-offering, and take away the sin of him who is to be made clean from his unclean condition; and after that he will put the burned offering to death.

chinese: 把燔祭和素祭獻在壇上，為他贖罪，他就潔淨了。
english: And the priest is to have the burned offering and the meal offering burned on the altar; and the priest will take away his sin and he will be clean.

chinese: 他若貧窮不能預備夠數，就要取一隻公羊羔作贖愆祭，可以搖一搖，為他贖罪；也要把調油的細麵伊法十分之一為素祭，和油一羅革一同取來；
english: And if he is poor and not able to get so much, then he may take one male lamb as an offering for wrongdoing, to be waved to take away his sin, and one tenth part of an ephah of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

chinese: 又照他的力量取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭。
english: And two doves or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and one will be for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering.

chinese: 第八天，要為潔淨，把這些帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司。
english: And on the eighth day he will take them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord, so that he may be made clean.

chinese: 祭司要把贖愆祭的羊羔和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
english: And the priest will take the lamb of the offering for wrongdoing and the oil, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord;

chinese: 要宰了贖愆祭的羊羔，取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
english: And he will put to death the lamb of the offering for wrongdoing and the priest will take some of the blood of the offering for wrongdoing and put it on the point of the right ear of him who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot;

chinese: 祭司要把些油倒在自己的左手掌裡，
english: And the priest will put out some of the oil in the hollow of his left hand,

chinese: 把左手裡的油，在耶和華面前，用右手的一個指頭彈七次，
english: Shaking out drops of oil with his right finger before the Lord seven times:

chinese: 又把手裡的油抹些在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹贖愆祭之血的原處。
english: And the priest will put some of the oil which is in his hand on the point of the ear of the man who is to be made clean and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot, on the place where the blood of the offering for wrongdoing was put;

chinese: 祭司手裡所剩的油要抹在那求潔淨人的頭上，在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
english: And the rest of the oil which is in the priest's hand he will put on the head of him who is to be made clean, to take away his sin before the Lord.

chinese: 那人又要照他的力量獻上一隻斑鳩或是一隻雛鴿，
english: And he will make an offering of one of the doves or the young pigeons, such as he is able to get;

chinese: 就是他所能辦的，一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭，與素祭一同獻上；祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
english: And of these, he will give one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, with the meal offering; and the priest will take away the sin of him who is to be made clean before the Lord.

chinese: 這是那有大痲瘋災病的人、不能將關乎得潔淨之物預備夠數的條例。
english: This is the law for the man who has the disease of the leper on him, and who is not able to get that which is necessary for making himself clean.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 你們到了我賜給你們為業的迦南地，我若使你們所得為業之地的房屋中有大痲瘋的災病，
english: When you have come into the land of Canaan which I will give you for your heritage, if I put the leper's disease on a house in the land of your heritage,

chinese: 房主就要去告訴祭司說：據我看，房屋中似乎有災病。
english: Then let the owner of the house come and say to the priest, It seems to me that there is a sort of leper's disease in the house.

chinese: 祭司還沒有進去察看災病以前，就要吩咐人把房子騰空，免得房子裡所有的都成了不潔淨；然後祭司要進去察看房子。
english: And the priest will give orders for everything to be taken out of the house, before he goes in to see the disease, so that the things in the house may not become unclean; and then the priest is to go in to see the house;

chinese: 他要察看那災病，災病若在房子的牆上有發綠或發紅的凹斑紋，現象窪於牆，
english: And if he sees that the walls of the house are marked with hollows of green and red, and if it seems to go deeper than the face of the wall;

chinese: 祭司就要出到房門外，把房子封鎖七天。
english: Then the priest will go out of the door of the house, and keep the house shut up for seven days:

chinese: 第七天，祭司要再去察看，災病若在房子的牆上發散，
english: And the priest is to come again on the seventh day and have a look and see if the marks on the walls of the house are increased in size;

chinese: 就要吩咐人把那有災病的石頭挖出來，扔在城外不潔淨之處；
english: Then the priest will give orders to them to take out the stones in which the disease is seen, and put them out into an unclean place outside the town:

chinese: 也要叫人刮房內的四圍，所刮掉的灰泥要倒在城外不潔淨之處；
english: And he will have the house rubbed all over inside, and the paste which is rubbed off will be put out into an unclean place outside the town:

chinese: 又要用別的石頭代替那挖出來的石頭，要另用灰泥墁房子。
english: And they will take other stones and put them in place of those stones, and he will take other paste and put it on the walls of the house.

chinese: 他挖出石頭，刮了房子，墁了以後，災病若在房子裡又發現，
english: And if the disease comes out again in the house after he has taken out the stones and after the walls have been rubbed and the new paste put on,

chinese: 祭司就要進去察看，災病若在房子裡發散，這就是房內蠶食的大痲瘋，是不潔淨。
english: Then the priest will come and see it; and if the disease in the house is increased in size, it is the leper's disease working out in the house: it is unclean.

chinese: 他就要拆毀房子，把石頭、木頭、灰泥都搬到城外不潔淨之處。
english: And the house will have to be pulled down, the stones of it and the wood and the paste; and everything is to be taken out to an unclean place outside the town.

chinese: 在房子封鎖的時候，進去的人必不潔淨到晚上；
english: And, in addition, anyone who goes into the house at any time, while it is shut up, will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 在房子裡躺著的必洗衣服；在房子裡吃飯的也必洗衣服。
english: And anyone who has been sleeping in the house will have to have his clothing washed; and anyone who takes food in that house will have to have his clothing washed.

chinese: 房子墁了以後，祭司若進去察看，見災病在房內沒有發散，就要定房子為潔淨，因為災病已經消除。
english: And if the priest comes in, and sees that the disease is not increased after the new paste has been put on the house, then the priest will say that the house is clean, because the disease is gone.

chinese: 要為潔淨房子取兩隻鳥和香柏木、朱紅色線並牛膝草，
english: And in order to make the house clean, let him take two birds and cedar-wood and red thread and hyssop;

chinese: 用瓦器盛活水，把一隻鳥宰在上面，
english: And put one of the birds to death in a vessel of earth over flowing water;

chinese: 把香柏木、牛膝草、朱紅色線，並那活鳥，都蘸在被宰的鳥血中與活水中，用以灑房子七次。
english: And take the cedar-wood and the hyssop and the red thread and the living bird and put them in the blood of the dead bird and in the flowing water, shaking it over the house seven times.

chinese: 要用鳥血、活水、活鳥、香柏木、牛膝草，並朱紅色線，潔淨那房子。
english: And he will make the house clean with the blood of the bird and the flowing water and with the living bird and with the cedar-wood and the hyssop and the red thread.

chinese: 但要把活鳥放在城外田野裡。這樣潔淨房子（原文是為房子贖罪），房子就潔淨了。
english: But he will let the living bird go out of the town into the open country; so he will take away sin from the house and it will be clean.

chinese: 這是為各類大痲瘋的災病和頭疥，
english: This is the law for all signs of the leper's disease and for skin diseases;

chinese: 並衣服與房子的大痲瘋，
english: And for signs of disease in clothing, or in a house;

chinese: 以及癤子、癬、火斑所立的條例，
english: And for a growth or a bad place or a bright mark on the skin;

chinese: 指明何時為潔淨，何時為不潔淨。這是大痲瘋的條例。
english: To make clear when it is unclean and when it is clean: this is the law about the disease of the leper.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and to Aaron,

chinese: 你們曉諭以色列人說：人若身患漏症，他因這漏症就不潔淨了。
english: Say to the children of Israel: If a man has an unclean flow from his flesh, it will make him unclean.

chinese: 他患漏症，無論是下流的，是止住的，都是不潔淨。
english: If the flow goes on or if the part is stopped up, to keep back the flow, he is still unclean.

chinese: 他所躺的床都為不潔淨，所坐的物也為不潔淨。
english: Every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean, and everything on which he has been seated will be unclean.

chinese: 凡摸那床的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And anyone touching his bed is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 那坐患漏症人所坐之物的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And he who has been seated on anything on which the unclean man has been seated is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 那摸患漏症人身體的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And anyone touching the flesh of the unclean man is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 若患漏症人吐在潔淨的人身上，那人必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And if liquid from the mouth of the unclean man comes on to him who is clean, then he is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 患漏症人所騎的鞍子也為不潔淨。
english: And any leather seat on a horse on which the unclean man has been seated will be unclean.

chinese: 凡摸了他身下之物的，必不潔淨到晚上；拿了那物的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And anyone touching anything which was under him will be unclean till the evening; anyone taking up any of these things is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 患漏症的人沒有用水涮手，無論摸了誰，誰必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And anyone on whom the unclean man puts his hands, without washing them in water, is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 患漏症人所摸的瓦器就必打破；所摸的一切木器也必用水涮洗。
english: And any vessel of earth which has been touched by the unclean man will have to be broken and any vessel of wood washed.

chinese: 患漏症的人痊愈了，就要為潔淨自己計算七天，也必洗衣服，用活水洗身，就潔淨了。
english: And when a man who has a flow from his body is made clean from it, he is to take seven days to make himself clean, washing his clothing and bathing his body in flowing water, and then he will be clean.

chinese: 第八天，要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，來到會幕門口、耶和華面前，把鳥交給祭司。
english: And on the eighth day he is to take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the door of the Tent of meeting and give them to the priest:

chinese: 祭司要獻上一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭；因那人患的漏症，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
english: And they are to be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, and the priest will take away his sin before the Lord on account of his flow.

chinese: 人若夢遺，他必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗全身。
english: And if a man's seed goes out from him, then all his body will have to be bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 無論是衣服是皮子，被精所染，必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗。
english: And any clothing or skin on which the seed comes is to be washed with water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 若男女交合，兩個人必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗澡。
english: And if a man has sex relations with a woman and his seed goes out from him, the two of them will have to be bathed in water and will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 女人行經，必污穢七天；凡摸他的，必不潔淨到晚上。
english: And if a woman has a flow of blood from her body, she will have to be kept separate for seven days, and anyone touching her will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 女人在污穢之中，凡他所躺的物件都為不潔淨，所坐的物件也都不潔淨。
english: And everything on which she has been resting, while she is kept separate, will be unclean, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean.

chinese: 凡摸他床的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And anyone touching her bed will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 凡摸他所坐甚麼物件的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And anyone touching anything on which she has been seated will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 在女人的床上，或在他坐的物上，若有別的物件，人一摸了，必不潔淨到晚上。
english: Anyone touching anything on the bed or on the thing on which she has been seated, will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 男人若與那女人同房，染了他的污穢，就要七天不潔淨；所躺的床也為不潔淨。
english: And if any man has sex relations with her so that her blood comes on him, he will be unclean for seven days and every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean.

chinese: 女人若在經期以外患多日的血漏，或是經期過長，有了漏症，他就因這漏症不潔淨，與他在經期不潔淨一樣。
english: And if a woman has a flow of blood for a long time, not at the time when she generally has it, or if the flow goes on longer than the normal time, she will be unclean while the flow of blood goes on, as she is at other normal times.

chinese: 他在患漏症的日子所躺的床、所坐的物都要看為不潔淨，與他月經的時候一樣。
english: Every bed on which she has been resting will be unclean, as at the times when she normally has a flow of blood, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean, in the same way.

chinese: 凡摸這些物件的，就為不潔淨，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
english: And anyone touching these things will be unclean, and his clothing will have to be washed and his body bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 女人的漏症若好了，就要計算七天，然後才為潔淨。
english: But when her flow of blood is stopped, after seven days she will be clean.

chinese: 第八天，要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，帶到會幕門口給祭司。
english: And on the eighth day let her get two doves or two young pigeons and take them to the priest to the door of the Tent of meeting,

chinese: 祭司要獻一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭；因那人血漏不潔，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
english: To be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering; and the priest will take away her sin before the Lord on account of her unclean condition.

chinese: 你們要這樣使以色列人與他們的污穢隔絕，免得他們玷污我的帳幕，就因自己的污穢死亡。
english: In this way may the children of Israel be made free from all sorts of unclean conditions, so that death may not overtake them when they are unclean and when they make unclean my holy place which is among them.

chinese: 這是患漏症和夢遺而不潔淨的，
english: This is the law for the man who has a flow from his body, or whose seed goes from him so that he is unclean;

chinese: 並有月經病的和患漏症的，無論男女，並人與不潔淨女人同房的條例。
english: And for her who has a flow of blood, and for any man or woman who has an unclean flow, and for him who has sex relations with a woman when she is unclean.

chinese: 亞倫的兩個兒子近到耶和華面前死了。死了之後，耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron when they took in strange fire before the Lord and death overtook them;

chinese: 要告訴你哥哥亞倫，不可隨時進聖所的幔子內、到櫃上的施恩座前，免得他死亡，因為我要從雲中顯現在施恩座上。
english: The Lord said to Moses, Say to Aaron, your brother, that he may not come at all times into the holy place inside the veil, before the cover which is on the ark, for fear that death may overtake him; for I will be seen in the cloud on the cover of the ark.

chinese: 亞倫進聖所，要帶一隻公牛犢為贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊為燔祭。
english: Let Aaron come into the holy place in this way: with an ox for a sin-offering and a male sheep for a burned offering.

chinese: 要穿上細麻布聖內袍，把細麻布褲子穿在身上，腰束細麻布帶子，頭戴細麻布冠冕；這都是聖服。他要用水洗身，然後穿戴。
english: Let him put on the holy linen coat, and the linen trousers on his body, and the linen band round him, and the linen head-dress on his head; for this is holy clothing, and before he puts them on his body is to be washed with water.

chinese: 要從以色列會眾取兩隻公山羊為贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊為燔祭。
english: And let him take from the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering and one male sheep for a burned offering.

chinese: 亞倫要把贖罪祭的公牛奉上，為自己和本家贖罪；
english: And Aaron is to give the ox of the sin-offering for himself, to make himself and his house free from sin.

chinese: 也要把兩隻公山羊安置在會幕門口、耶和華面前，
english: And he is to take the two goats and put them before the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 為那兩隻羊拈鬮，一鬮歸與耶和華，一鬮歸與阿撒瀉勒。
english: And Aaron will make selection from the two goats by the decision of the Lord, one goat for the Lord and one for Azazel.

chinese: 亞倫要把那拈鬮歸與耶和華的羊獻為贖罪祭，
english: And the goat which is marked out for the Lord, let Aaron give for a sin-offering.

chinese: 但那拈鬮歸與阿撒瀉勒的羊要活著安置在耶和華面前，用以贖罪，打發人送到曠野去，歸與阿撒瀉勒。
english: But the goat for Azazel is to be placed living before the Lord, for the taking away of sin, that it may be sent away for Azazel into the waste land.

chinese: 亞倫要把贖罪祭的公牛帶來宰了，為自己和本家贖罪；
english: And Aaron is to give the ox of the sin-offering for himself and take away sin from himself and his house, and put to death the ox of the sin-offering which is for himself.

chinese: 拿香爐，從耶和華面前的壇上盛滿火炭，又拿一捧搗細的香料，都帶入幔子內，
english: And he is to take a vessel full of burning coal from the altar before the Lord and in his hand some sweet perfume crushed small, and take it inside the veil;

chinese: 在耶和華面前，把香放在火上，使香的煙雲遮掩法櫃上的施恩座，免得他死亡；
english: And let him put the perfume on the fire before the Lord so that the ark may be covered with a cloud of the smoke of the perfume, in order that death may not overtake him.

chinese: 也要取些公牛的血，用指頭彈在施恩座的東面，又在施恩座的前面彈血七次。
english: And let him take some of the blood of the ox, shaking drops of it from his finger on the cover of the ark on the east side, and before it, seven times.

chinese: 隨後他要宰那為百姓作贖罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血帶入幔子內，彈在施恩座的上面和前面，好像彈公牛的血一樣。
english: Then let him put to death the goat of the sin-offering for the people, and take its blood inside the veil and do with it as he did with the blood of the ox, shaking drops of it on and before the cover of the ark.

chinese: 他因以色列人諸般的污穢、過犯，就是他們一切的罪愆，當這樣在聖所行贖罪之禮，並因會幕在他們污穢之中，也要照樣而行。
english: And let him make the holy place free from whatever is unclean among the children of Israel and from their wrongdoing in all their sins; and let him do the same for the Tent of meeting, which has its place among an unclean people.

chinese: 他進聖所贖罪的時候，會幕裡不可有人，直等到他為自己和本家並以色列全會眾贖了罪出來。
english: And no man may be in the Tent of meeting from the time when Aaron goes in to take away sin in the holy place till he comes out, having made himself and his house and all the people of Israel free from sin.

chinese: 他出來，要到耶和華面前的壇那裡，在壇上行贖罪之禮，又要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在壇上四角的周圍；
english: And he is to go out to the altar which is before the Lord and make it free from sin; and he is to take some of the blood of the ox and the blood of the goat and put it on the horns of the altar and round it;

chinese: 也要用指頭把血彈在壇上七次，潔淨了壇，從壇上除掉以色列人諸般的污穢，使壇成聖。
english: Shaking drops of the blood from his finger on it seven times to make it holy and clean from whatever is unclean among the children of Israel.

chinese: 亞倫為聖所和會幕並壇獻完了贖罪祭，就要把那隻活著的公山羊奉上。
english: And when he has done whatever is necessary to make the holy place and the Tent of meeting and the altar free from sin, let him put the living goat before the Lord;

chinese: 兩手按在羊頭上，承認以色列人諸般的罪孽過犯，就是他們一切的罪愆，把這罪都歸在羊的頭上，藉著所派之人的手，送到曠野去。
english: And Aaron, placing his two hands on the head of the living goat, will make a public statement over him of all the evil doings of the children of Israel and all their wrongdoing, in all their sins; and he will put them on the head of the goat and send him away, in the care of a man who will be waiting there, into the waste land.

chinese: 要把這羊放在曠野，這羊要擔當他們一切的罪孽，帶到無人之地。
english: And the goat will take all their sins into a land cut off from men, and he will send the goat away into the waste land.

chinese: 亞倫要進會幕，把他進聖所時所穿的細麻布衣服脫下，放在那裡，
english: Then let Aaron come into the Tent of meeting and take off the linen clothing which he put on when he went into the holy place, and put them down there;

chinese: 又要在聖處用水洗身，穿上衣服，出來，把自己的燔祭和百姓的燔祭獻上，為自己和百姓贖罪。
english: And after bathing his body in water in a holy place, he is to put on his clothing and come out and give his burned offering and the burned offering of the people, to take away his sin and the sin of the people.

chinese: 贖罪祭牲的脂油要在壇上焚燒。
english: And the fat of the sin-offering is to be burned by him on the altar.

chinese: 那放羊歸與阿撒瀉勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。
english: And the man who takes away the goat for Azazel is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and then he may come back to the tent-circle.

chinese: 作贖罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既帶入聖所贖罪，這牛羊就要搬到營外，將皮、肉、糞用火焚燒。
english: And the ox of the sin-offering and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was taken in to make the holy place free from sin, are to be taken away outside the tent-circle and their skins and their flesh and their waste are to be burned with fire.

chinese: 焚燒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。
english: And the man by whom they are burned is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water, and then he may come back to the tent-circle.

chinese: 每逢七月初十日，你們要刻苦己心，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，甚麼工都不可做；這要作你們永遠的定例。
english: And let this be an order to you for ever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day, you are to keep yourselves from pleasure and do no sort of work, those who are Israelites by birth and those from other lands who are living among you:

chinese: 因在這日要為你們贖罪，使你們潔淨。你們要在耶和華面前得以潔淨，脫盡一切的罪愆。
english: For on this day your sin will be taken away and you will be clean: you will be made free from all your sins before the Lord.

chinese: 這日你們要守為聖安息日，要刻苦己心；這為永遠的定例。
english: It is a special Sabbath for you, and you are to keep yourselves from pleasure; it is an order for ever.

chinese: 那受膏、接續他父親承接聖職的祭司要穿上細麻布的聖衣，行贖罪之禮。
english: And the man on whose head the holy oil has been put, and who has been marked out to be a priest in his father's place, will do what is necessary to take away sin, and will put on the linen clothing, even the holy robes:

chinese: 他要在至聖所和會幕與壇行贖罪之禮，並要為眾祭司和會眾的百姓贖罪。
english: And he will make the holy place and the Tent of meeting and the altar free from sin; he will take away sin from the priests and from all the people.

chinese: 這要作你們永遠的定例─就是因以色列人一切的罪，要一年一次為他們贖罪。於是，亞倫照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
english: And let this be an order for ever for you, so that the sin of the children of Israel may be taken away once every year. And he did as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭亞倫和他兒子並以色列眾人說，耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：
english: Say to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel: This is the order which the Lord has given.

chinese: 凡以色列家中的人宰公牛，或是綿羊羔，或是山羊，不拘宰於營內營外，
english: If any man of Israel puts to death an ox or a lamb or a goat, in or outside the tent-circle;

chinese: 若未曾牽到會幕門口、耶和華的帳幕前獻給耶和華為供物，流血的罪必歸到那人身上。他流了血，要從民中剪除。
english: And has not taken it to the door of the Tent of meeting, to make an offering to the Lord, before the Lord's House, its blood will be on him, for he has taken life, and he will be cut off from among his people:

chinese: 這是為要使以色列人把他們在田野裡所獻的祭帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司，獻與耶和華為平安祭。
english: So that the children of Israel may take to the Lord, to the door of the Tent of meeting and to the priest, the offerings which they have put to death in the open country, and that they may make their peace-offerings to the Lord.

chinese: 祭司要把血灑在會幕門口、耶和華的壇上，把脂油焚燒，獻給耶和華為馨香的祭。
english: And the priest will put blood on the altar of the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting, burning the fat for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 他們不可再獻祭給他們行邪淫所隨從的鬼魔（原文作公山羊）；這要作他們世世代代永遠的定例。
english: And let them make no more offerings to evil spirits, after which they have gone, turning away from the Lord. Let this be a law to them for ever, through all their generations.

chinese: 你要曉諭他們說：凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，獻燔祭或是平安祭，
english: And say to them, If any man of Israel, or any other living among them, makes a burned offering or other offering,

chinese: 若不帶到會幕門口獻給耶和華，那人必從民中剪除。
english: And does not take it to the door of the Tent of meeting to make an offering to the Lord, that man will be cut off from among his people.

chinese: 凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若吃甚麼血，我必向那吃血的人變臉，把他從民中剪除。
english: And if any man of Israel, or any other living among them, takes any sort of blood for food, my wrath will be turned against that man and he will be cut off from among his people.

chinese: 因為活物的生命是在血中。我把這血賜給你們，可以在壇上為你們的生命贖罪；因血裡有生命，所以能贖罪。
english: For the life of the flesh is in its blood; and I have given it to you on the altar to take away your sin: for it is the blood which makes free from sin because of the life in it.

chinese: 因此，我對以色列人說：你們都不可吃血；寄居在你們中間的外人也不可吃血。
english: For this reason I have said to the children of Israel, No man among you, or any others living with you, may take blood as food.

chinese: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若打獵得了可吃的禽獸，必放出他的血來，用土掩蓋。
english: And any man of Israel, or any other living among them, who gets with his bow any beast or bird used for food, is to see that its blood is covered with earth.

chinese: 論到一切活物的生命，就在血中。所以我對以色列人說：無論甚麼活物的血，你們都不可吃，因為一切活物的血就是他的生命。凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
english: For the blood is the life of all flesh: and so I have said to the children of Israel, You may not take any sort of blood as food, and any man who does so will be cut of.

chinese: 凡吃自死的，或是被野獸撕裂的，無論是本地人，是寄居的，必不潔淨到晚上，都要洗衣服，用水洗身，到了晚上才為潔淨。
english: And anyone who takes as food anything which has come to a natural end, or anything which has been put to death by beasts, if he is one of you by birth, or of another nation, will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening, and then he will be clean.

chinese: 但他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必擔當他的罪孽。
english: But if his clothing is not washed and his body bathed, his sin will be on him.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: Say to the children of Israel, I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們從前住的埃及地，那裡人的行為，你們不可效法，我要領你們到的迦南地，那裡人的行為也不可效法，也不可照他們的惡俗行。
english: You may not do those things which were done in the land of Egypt where you were living; and you may not do those things which are done in the land of Canaan where I am taking you, or be guided in your behaviour by their rules.

chinese: 你們要遵我的典章，守我的律例，按此而行。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: But you are to be guided by my decisions and keep my rules, and be guided by them: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 所以，你們要守我的律例典章；人若遵行，就必因此活著。我是耶和華。
english: So keep my rules and my decisions, which, if a man does them, will be life to him: I am the Lord.

chinese: 你們都不可露骨肉之親的下體，親近他們。我是耶和華。
english: You may not have sex connection with anyone who is a near relation: I am the Lord.

chinese: 不可露你母親的下體，羞辱了你父親。他是你的母親，不可露他的下體。
english: You may not have sex relations with your father or your mother: she is your mother, you may not take her.

chinese: 不可露你繼母的下體；這本是你父親的下體。
english: And you may not have sex relations with your father's wife: she is your father's.

chinese: 你的姊妹，不拘是異母同父的，是異父同母的，無論是生在家生在外的，都不可露他們的下體。
english: You may not take your sister, the daughter of your father or of your mother, wherever her birth took place, among you or in another country.

chinese: 不可露你孫女或是外孫女的下體，露了他們的下體就是露了自己的下體。
english: You may not have sex relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter, for they are part of yourself;

chinese: 你繼母從你父親生的女兒本是你的妹妹，不可露他的下體。
english: Or your father's wife's daughter, the child of your father, for she is your sister.

chinese: 不可露你姑母的下體；他是你父親的骨肉之親。
english: You may not have sex connection with your father's sister, for she is your father's near relation.

chinese: 不可露你姨母的下體；他是你母親的骨肉之親。
english: You may not have sex connection with your mother's sister, for she is your mother's near relation.

chinese: 不可親近你伯叔之妻，羞辱了你伯叔；他是你的伯叔母。
english: You may not have sex relations with the wife of your father's brother, for she is of your family;

chinese: 不可露你兒婦的下體；他是你兒子的妻，不可露他的下體。
english: Or with your daughter-in-law, for she is your son's wife, and you may not take her.

chinese: 不可露你弟兄妻子的下體；這本是你弟兄的下體。
english: You may not have sex relations with your brother's wife, for she is your brother's.

chinese: 不可露了婦人的下體，又露他女兒的下體，也不可娶他孫女或是外孫女，露他們的下體；他們是骨肉之親，這本是大惡。
english: You may not take as wife a woman and her daughter, or her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter, for they are of one family: it is an act of shame.

chinese: 你妻還在的時候，不可另娶他的姊妹作對頭，露他的下體。
english: And you may not take as wife a woman and at the same time her sister, to be in competition with her in her life-time.

chinese: 女人行經不潔淨的時候，不可露他的下體，與他親近。
english: And you may not go near a woman or have sex relations with her when she is unclean, at her regular time.

chinese: 不可與鄰舍的妻行淫，玷污自己。
english: And you may not have sex relations with your neighbour's wife, making yourself unclean with her.

chinese: 不可使你的兒女經火歸與摩洛，也不可褻瀆你神的名。我是耶和華。
english: And you may not make any of your children go through the fire as an offering to Molech, and you may not put shame on the name of your God: I am the Lord.

chinese: 不可與男人苟合，像與女人一樣；這本是可憎惡的。
english: You may not have sex relations with men, as you do with women: it is a disgusting thing.

chinese: 不可與獸淫合，玷污自己。女人也不可站在獸前，與他淫合；這本是逆性的事。
english: And you may not have sex relations with a beast, making yourself unclean with it; and a woman may not give herself to a beast: it is an unnatural act.

chinese: 在這一切的事上，你們都不可玷污自己；因為我在你們面前所逐出的列邦，在這一切的事上玷污了自己；
english: Do not make yourself unclean in any of these ways; for so have those nations whom I am driving out from before you made themselves unclean:

chinese: 連地也玷污了，所以我追討那地的罪孽，那地也吐出他的居民。
english: And the land itself has become unclean; so that I have sent on it the reward of its wrongdoing, and the land itself puts out those who are living in it.

chinese: 故此，你們要守我的律例典章。這一切可憎惡的事，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，都不可行，
english: So then keep my rules and my decisions, and do not do any of these disgusting things, those of you who are Israelites by birth, or any others who are living with you:

chinese: 在你們以先居住那地的人行了這一切可憎惡的事，地就玷污了，
english: (For all these disgusting things were done by the men of this country who were there before you, and the land has been made unclean by them;)

chinese: 免得你們玷污那地的時候，地就把你們吐出，像吐出在你們以先的國民一樣。
english: So that the land may not put you out from it, when you make it unclean, as it put out the nations which were there before you.

chinese: 無論甚麼人，行了其中可憎的一件事，必從民中剪除。
english: For all those who do any of these disgusting things will be cut off from among their people.

chinese: 所以，你們要守我所吩咐的，免得你們隨從那些可憎的惡俗，就是在你們以先的人所常行的，以致玷污了自己。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: So then, keep my orders, so that you may not do any of these disgusting things which were done before you, or make yourselves unclean through them: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列全會眾說：你們要聖潔，因為我耶和華─你們的神是聖潔的。
english: Say to all the people of Israel, You are to be holy, for I, the Lord your God, am holy.

chinese: 你們各人都當孝敬父母，也要守我的安息日。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: Let every man give honour to his mother and to his father and keep my Sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們不可偏向虛無的神，也不可為自己鑄造神像。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: Do not go after false gods, and do not make metal images of gods for yourselves: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們獻平安祭給耶和華的時候，要獻得可蒙悅納。
english: And when you give a peace offering to the Lord, do it in the way which is pleasing to the Lord.

chinese: 這祭物要在獻的那一天和第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就必用火焚燒。
english: Let it be used for food on the same day on which it is offered, or on the day after; and whatever is over on the third day is to be burned with fire.

chinese: 第三天若再吃，這就為可憎惡的，必不蒙悅納。
english: If any of it is used for food on the third day, it is a disgusting thing and will not be pleasing to the Lord.

chinese: 凡吃的人必擔當他的罪孽；因為他褻瀆了耶和華的聖物，那人必從民中剪除。
english: And as for anyone who takes it for food, his sin will be on him, for he has put shame on the holy thing of the Lord: he will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 在你們的地收割莊稼，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取所遺落的。
english: And when you get in the grain from your land, do not let all the grain be cut from the edges of the field, or take up what has been dropped on the earth after the getting in of the grain.

chinese: 不可摘盡葡萄園的果子，也不可拾取葡萄園所掉的果子；要留給窮人和寄居的。我是耶和華你─們的神。
english: And do not take all the grapes from your vine-garden, or the fruit dropped on the earth; let the poor man, and the man from another country, have these: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們不可偷盜，不可欺騙，也不可彼此說謊。
english: Do not take anyone's property or be false in act or word to another.

chinese: 不可指著我的名起假誓，褻瀆你神的名。我是耶和華。
english: And do not take an oath in my name falsely, putting shame on the name of your God: I am the Lord.

chinese: 不可欺壓你的鄰舍，也不可搶奪他的物。雇工人的工價，不可在你那裡過夜，留到早晨。
english: Do not be cruel to your neighbour or take what is his; do not keep back a servant's payment from him all night till the morning.

chinese: 不可咒罵聾子，也不可將絆腳石放在瞎子面前，只要敬畏你的神。我是耶和華。
english: Do not put a curse on those who have no hearing, or put a cause of falling in the way of the blind, but keep the fear of your God before you: I am the Lord.

chinese: 你們施行審判，不可行不義；不可偏護窮人，也不可重看有勢力的人，只要按著公義審判你的鄰舍。
english: Do no wrong in your judging: do not give thought to the position of the poor, or honour to the position of the great; but be a judge to your neighbour in righteousness.

chinese: 不可在民中往來搬弄是非，也不可與鄰舍為敵，置之於死（原文作流他的血）。我是耶和華。
english: Do not go about saying untrue things among your people, or take away the life of your neighbour by false witness: I am the Lord.

chinese: 不可心裡恨你的弟兄；總要指摘你的鄰舍，免得因他擔罪。
english: Let there be no hate in your heart for your brother; but you may make a protest to your neighbour, so that he may be stopped from doing evil.

chinese: 不可報仇，也不可埋怨你本國的子民，卻要愛人如己。我是耶和華。
english: Do not make attempts to get equal with one who has done you wrong, or keep hard feelings against the children of your people, but have love for your neighbour as for yourself: I am the Lord.

chinese: 你們要守我的律例。不可叫你的牲畜與異類配合；不可用兩樣攙雜的種種你的地，也不可用兩樣攙雜的料做衣服穿在身上。
english: Keep my laws. Do not let your cattle have offspring by those of a different sort; do not put mixed seed into your field; do not put on a robe made of two sorts of cloth.

chinese: 婢女許配了丈夫，還沒有被贖、得釋放，人若與他行淫，二人要受刑罰，卻不把他們治死，因為婢女還沒有得自由。
english: If any man has sex relations with a servant-woman who has given her word to be married to a man, and has not been made free for a price or in any other way, the thing will be looked into; but they will not be put to death because she was not a free woman.

chinese: 那人要把贖愆祭，就是一隻公綿羊牽到會幕門口、耶和華面前。
english: Let him take his offering for wrongdoing to the Lord, to the door of the Tent of meeting; let him give a male sheep as an offering for wrongdoing.

chinese: 祭司要用贖愆祭的羊在耶和華面前贖他所犯的罪，他的罪就必蒙赦免。
english: And the priest will take away his sin before the Lord with the sheep which is offered for his wrongdoing, and he will have forgiveness for the sin which he has done.

chinese: 你們到了迦南地，栽種各樣結果子的樹木，就要以所結的果子如未受割禮的一樣。三年之久，你們要以這些果子，如未受割禮的，是不可吃的。
english: And when you have come into the land, and have put in all sorts of fruit-trees, their fruit will be as if they had not had circumcision, and for three years their fruit may not be used for food.

chinese: 但第四年所結的果子全要成為聖，用以讚美耶和華。
english: And in the fourth year all the fruit will be holy as a praise-offering to the Lord.

chinese: 第五年，你們要吃那樹上的果子，好叫樹給你們結果子更多。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: But in the fifth year you may take the fruit and the increase of it for your food: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們不可吃帶血的物；不可用法術，也不可觀兆。
english: Nothing may be used for food with its blood in it; you may not make use of strange arts, or go in search of signs and wonders.

chinese: 頭的周圍不可剃，（周圍或作：兩鬢）鬍鬚的周圍也不可損壞。
english: The ends of the hair round your face and on your chin may not be cut off.

chinese: 不可為死人用刀劃身，也不可在身上刺花紋。我是耶和華。
english: You may not make cuts in your flesh in respect for the dead, or have marks printed on your bodies: I am the Lord.

chinese: 不可辱沒你的女兒，使他為娼妓，恐怕地上的人專向淫亂，地就滿了大惡。
english: Do not make your daughter common by letting her become a loose woman, for fear that the land may become full of shame.

chinese: 你們要守我的安息日，敬我的聖所。我是耶和華。
english: Keep my Sabbaths and have respect for my holy place: I am the Lord.

chinese: 不可偏向那些交鬼的和行巫術的；不可求問他們，以致被他們玷污了。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: Do not go after those who make use of spirits, or wonder-workers; do not go in their ways or become unclean through them: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 在白髮的人面前，你要站起來；也要尊敬老人，又要敬畏你的神。我是耶和華。
english: Get up from your seats before the white-haired, and give honour to the old, and let the fear of your God be before you: I am the Lord.

chinese: 若有外人在你們國中和你同居，就不可欺負他。
english: And if a man from another country is living in your land with you, do not make life hard for him;

chinese: 和你們同居的外人，你們要看他如本地人一樣，並要愛他如己，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: Let him be to you as one of your countrymen and have love for him as for yourself; for you were living in a strange land, in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們施行審判，不可行不義；在尺、秤、升、斗上也是如此。
english: Do not make false decisions in questions of yard-sticks and weights and measures.

chinese: 要用公道天平、公道法碼、公道升斗、公道秤。我是耶和華─你們的神，曾把你們從埃及地領出來的。
english: Have true scales, true weights and measures for all things: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt;

chinese: 你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例典章。我是耶和華。
english: You are to keep all my rules and my decisions and do them: I am the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你還要曉諭以色列人說：凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的兒女獻給摩洛的，總要治死他；本地人要用石頭把他打死。
english: Again, say to the children of Israel, If any man of the children of Israel, or any other man living in Israel, gives his offspring to Molech, he is certainly to be put to death: he is to be stoned by the people of the land;

chinese: 我也要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除；因為他把兒女獻給摩洛，玷污我的聖所，褻瀆我的聖名。
english: And my face will be turned against that man, and he will be cut off from his people; because he has given his offspring to Molech, making my holy place unclean, and making my holy name common.

chinese: 那人把兒女獻給摩洛，本地人若佯為不見，不把他治死，
english: And if the people of the land do not take note of that man when he gives his offspring to Molech, and do not put him to death,

chinese: 我就要向這人和他的家變臉，把他和一切隨他與摩洛行邪淫的人都從民中剪除。
english: Then my face will be turned against him and his family, and he and all those who do evil with him will be cut off from among their people.

chinese: 人偏向交鬼的和行巫術的，隨他們行邪淫，我要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除。
english: And whoever goes after those who make use of spirits and wonder-workers, doing evil with them, against him will my face be turned, and he will be cut off from among his people.

chinese: 所以你們要自潔成聖，因為我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: So make and keep yourselves holy, for I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們要謹守遵行我的律例；我是叫你們成聖的耶和華。
english: And keep my rules and do them: I am the Lord, who make you holy.

chinese: 凡咒罵父母的，總要治死他；他咒罵了父母，他的罪要歸到他身上。（罪原文作血；本章同）
english: Every man cursing his father or his mother is certainly to be put to death; because of his curse on his father or his mother, his blood will be on him.

chinese: 與鄰舍之妻行淫的，姦夫淫婦都必治死。
english: And if a man has sex relations with another man's wife, even the wife of his neighbour, he and she are certainly to be put to death.

chinese: 與繼母行淫的，就是羞辱了他父親，總要把他們二人治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
english: And the man who has sex relations with his father's wife has put shame on his father: the two of them are to be put to death; their blood will be on them.

chinese: 與兒婦同房的，總要把他們二人治死；他們行了逆倫的事，罪要歸到他們身上。
english: And if a man has sex relations with his son's wife, the two of them are to be put to death: it is unnatural; their blood will be on them.

chinese: 人若與男人苟合，像與女人一樣，他們二人行了可憎的事，總要把他們治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
english: And if a man has sex relations with a man, the two of them have done a disgusting thing: let them be put to death; their blood will be on them.

chinese: 人若娶妻，並娶其母，便是大惡，要把這三人用火焚燒，使你們中間免去大惡。
english: And if a man takes as wife a woman and her mother, it is an act of shame; let them be burned with fire, all three of them, so that there may be no shame among you.

chinese: 人若與獸淫合，總要治死他，也要殺那獸。
english: And if a man has sex relations with a beast, let him be put to death, and let the beast be put to destruction.

chinese: 女人若與獸親近，與他淫合，你要殺那女人和那獸，總要把他們治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
english: And if a woman goes near a beast and has sex relations with it, you will put an end to the woman and the beast: their blood will be on them.

chinese: 人若娶他的姊妹，無論是異母同父的，是異父同母的，彼此見了下體，這是可恥的事；他們必在本民的眼前被剪除。他露了姊妹的下體，必擔當自己的罪孽。
english: And if a man takes his sister, daughter of his father or his mother, and has sex relations with her and she with him, it is an act of shame: they are to be cut off before the children of their people; he has had sex relations with his sister, and his sin will be on him.

chinese: 婦人有月經，若與他同房，露了他的下體，就是露了婦人的血源，婦人也露了自己的血源，二人必從民中剪除。
english: And if a man has sex relations with a woman at the time when she is unwell, he has seen her fountain and she has let the fountain of her blood be uncovered, and the two of them are to be cut off from among their people.

chinese: 不可露姨母或是姑母的下體，這是露了骨肉之親的下體；二人必擔當自己的罪孽。
english: And you may not have sex connection with your mother's sister or your father's sister, for they are his near relations: their sin will be on them.

chinese: 人若與伯叔之妻同房，就羞辱了他的伯叔；二人要擔當自己的罪，必無子女而死。
english: And if a man has sex relations with the wife of his father's brother, he has put shame on his father's brother: their sin will be on them; till the day of their death they will have no children.

chinese: 人若娶弟兄之妻，這本是污穢的事，羞辱了他的弟兄；二人必無子女。
english: And if a man takes his brother's wife, it is an unclean act; he has put shame on his brother; they will have no children.

chinese: 所以，你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例典章，免得我領你們去住的那地把你們吐出。
english: So then, keep my rules and my decisions and do them, so that the land which I am giving you as your resting-place may not violently send you out again.

chinese: 我在你們面前所逐出的國民，你們不可隨從他們的風俗；因為他們行了這一切的事，所以我厭惡他們。
english: And do not keep the rules of the nations which I am driving out before you; for they did all these things, and for that reason my soul was turned against them.

chinese: 但我對你們說過，你們要承受他們的地，就是我要賜給你們為業、流奶與蜜之地。我是耶和華─你們的神，使你們與萬民有分別的。
english: But I have said to you, You will take their land and I will give it to you for your heritage, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God who have made you separate from all other peoples.

chinese: 所以，你們要把潔淨和不潔淨的禽獸分別出來；不可因我給你們分為不潔淨的禽獸，或是滋生在地上的活物，使自己成為可憎惡的。
english: So then, make division between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the clean bird and the unclean: do not make yourselves disgusting by any beast or bird or anything which goes flat on the earth, which has been marked by me as unclean for you.

chinese: 你們要歸我為聖，因為我─耶和華是聖的，並叫你們與萬民有分別，使你們作我的民。
english: And you are to be holy to me; for I the Lord am holy and have made you separate from the nations, so that you may be my people.

chinese: 無論男女，是交鬼的或行巫術的，總要治死他們。人必用石頭把他們打死，罪要歸到他們身上。
english: Any man or woman who makes use of spirits, or who is a wonder-worker, is to be put to death: they are to be stoned with stones: their blood will be on them.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你告訴亞倫子孫作祭司的說：祭司不可為民中的死人沾染自己，
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to the priests, the sons of Aaron, Let no man make himself unclean for the dead among his people;

chinese: 除非為他骨肉之親的父母、兒女、弟兄，
english: But only for his near relations, for his mother or his father, his son or his daughter, and his brother;

chinese: 和未曾出嫁、作處女的姊妹，才可以沾染自己。
english: And for his sister, a virgin, for she is his near relation and has had no husband, he may make himself unclean.

chinese: 祭司既在民中為首，就不可從俗沾染自己。
english: But let him, being a chief among his people, not make himself unclean in such a way as to put shame on himself.

chinese: 不可使頭光禿；不可剃除鬍鬚的周圍，也不可用刀劃身。
english: They are not to have their hair cut off for the dead, or the hair on their chins cut short, or make cuts in their flesh.

chinese: 要歸神為聖，不可褻瀆　神的名；因為耶和華的火祭，就是　神的食物，是他們獻的，所以他們要成為聖。
english: Let them be holy to their God and not make the name of their God common; for the fire offerings of the Lord and the bread of their God are offered by them, and they are to be holy.

chinese: 不可娶妓女或被污的女人為妻，也不可娶被休的婦人為妻，因為祭司是歸神為聖。
english: They may not take as wife a loose or common woman, or one who has been put away by her husband: for the priest is holy to his God.

chinese: 所以你要使他成聖，因為他奉獻你神的食物；你要以他為聖，因為我─使你們成聖的耶和華─是聖的。
english: And he is to be holy in your eyes, for by him the bread of your God is offered; he is to be holy in your eyes, for I the Lord, who make you holy, am holy.

chinese: 祭司的女兒若行淫辱沒自己，就辱沒了父親，必用火將他焚燒。
english: And if the daughter of a priest makes herself common and by her loose behaviour puts shame on her father, let her be burned with fire.

chinese: 在弟兄中作大祭司、頭上倒了膏油、又承接聖職，穿了聖衣的，不可蓬頭散髮，也不可撕裂衣服。
english: And he who is the chief priest among his brothers, on whose head the holy oil has been put, who is marked out to put on the holy robes, may not let his hair go loose or have his clothing out of order as a sign of sorrow.

chinese: 不可挨近死屍，也不可為父母沾染自己。
english: He may not go near any dead body or make himself unclean for his father or his mother;

chinese: 不可出聖所，也不可褻瀆神的聖所，因為　神膏油的冠冕在他頭上。我是耶和華。
english: He may not go out of the holy place or make the holy place of his God common; for the crown of the holy oil of his God is on him: I am the Lord.

chinese: 他要娶處女為妻。
english: And let him take as his wife one who has not had relations with a man.

chinese: 寡婦或是被休的婦人，或是被污為妓的女人，都不可娶；只可娶本民中的處女為妻。
english: A widow, or one whose husband has put her away, or a common woman of loose behaviour, may not be the wife of a priest; but let him take a virgin from among his people.

chinese: 不可在民中辱沒他的兒女，因為我是叫他成聖的耶和華。
english: And he may not make his seed unclean among his people, for I the Lord have made him holy.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你告訴亞倫說：你世世代代的後裔，凡有殘疾的，都不可近前來獻他神的食物。
english: Say to Aaron, If a man of your family, in any generation, is damaged in body, let him not come near to make the offering of the bread of his God.

chinese: 因為凡有殘疾的，無論是瞎眼的、瘸腿的、塌鼻子的、肢體有餘的、
english: For any man whose body is damaged may not come near: one who is blind, or has not the use of his legs, or one who has a broken nose or any unnatural growth,

chinese: 折腳折手的、
english: Or a man with broken feet or hands,

chinese: 駝背的、矮矬的、眼睛有毛病的、長癬的、長疥的，或是損壞腎子的，都不可近前來。
english: Or one whose back is bent, or one who is unnaturally small, or one who has a damaged eye, or whose skin is diseased, or whose sex parts are damaged;

chinese: 祭司亞倫的後裔，凡有殘疾的，都不可近前來，將火祭獻給耶和華。他有殘疾，不可近前來獻神的食物。
english: No man of the offspring of Aaron whose body is damaged in any way may come near to give the fire offerings of the Lord: he is damaged, he may not come near to make the offerings.

chinese: 神的食物，無論是聖的，至聖的，他都可以吃。
english: He may take of the bread of God, the holy and the most holy;

chinese: 但不可進到幔子前，也不可就近壇前；因為他有殘疾，免得褻瀆我的聖所。我是叫他成聖的耶和華。
english: But he may not go inside the veil or come near the altar, because he is damaged; and he may not make my holy places common; for I the Lord have made them holy.

chinese: 於是，摩西曉諭亞倫和亞倫的子孫，並以色列眾人。
english: These are the words which Moses said to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐亞倫和他子孫說：要遠離以色列人所分別為聖、歸給我的聖物，免得褻瀆我的聖名。我是耶和華。
english: Give orders to Aaron and to his sons to keep themselves separate from the holy things of the children of Israel which they give to me, and not to make my holy name common: I am the Lord,

chinese: 你要對他們說：你們世世代代的後裔，凡身上有污穢、親近以色列人所分別為聖、歸耶和華聖物的，那人必在我面前剪除。我是耶和華。
english: Say to them, If any man of all your seed through all your generations, being unclean, comes near the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the Lord, he will be cut off from before me: I am the Lord.

chinese: 亞倫的後裔，凡長大痲瘋的，或是有漏症的，不可吃聖物，直等他潔淨了。無論誰摸那因死屍不潔淨的物（物或作：人），或是遺精的人，
english: No man of the seed of Aaron who is a leper, or who has a flow from his body, may take of the holy food till he is clean. And any man touching anything which is unclean because of the dead, or any man whose seed goes from him;

chinese: 或是摸甚麼使他不潔淨的爬物，或是摸那使他不潔淨的人（不拘那人有甚麼不潔淨），
english: Or anyone touching any unclean thing which goes flat on the earth, or someone by whom he may be made unclean in any way whatever;

chinese: 摸了這些人、物的，必不潔淨到晚上；若不用水洗身，就不可吃聖物。
english: Any person touching any such unclean thing will be unclean till evening, and may not take of the holy food till his flesh has been bathed in water;

chinese: 日落的時候，他就潔淨了，然後可以吃聖物，因為這是他的食物。
english: And when the sun has gone down he will be clean; and after that he may take part in the holy food, because it is his bread.

chinese: 自死的或是被野獸撕裂的，他不可吃，因此污穢自己。我是耶和華。
english: That which comes to a natural death, or is attacked by beasts, he may not take as food, for it will make him unclean: I am the Lord.

chinese: 所以他們要守我所吩咐的，免得輕忽了，因此擔罪而死。我是叫他們成聖的耶和華。
english: So then, let them keep what I have put into their care, for fear that sin may come on them because of it, so causing their death because they have made it common: I am the Lord, who make them holy.

chinese: 凡外人不可吃聖物；寄居在祭司家的，或是雇工人，都不可吃聖物；
english: No outside person may take of the holy food, or one living as a guest in the priest's house, or a servant working for payment.

chinese: 倘若祭司買人，是他的錢買的，那人就可以吃聖物；生在他家的人也可以吃。
english: But any person for whom the priest has given money, to make him his, may take of it with him; and those who come to birth in his house may take of his bread.

chinese: 祭司的女兒若嫁外人，就不可吃舉祭的聖物。
english: And if the daughter of a priest is married to an outside person she may not take of the holy things which are lifted up as offerings.

chinese: 但祭司的女兒若是寡婦，或是被休的，沒有孩子，又歸回父家，與他青年一樣，就可以吃他父親的食物；只是外人不可吃。
english: But if a priest's daughter is a widow, or parted from her husband, and has no child, and has come back to her father's house as when she was a girl, she may take of her father's bread; but no outside person may do so.

chinese: 若有人誤吃了聖物，要照聖物的原數加上五分之一交給祭司。
english: And if a man takes the holy food in error, he will have to give the holy thing back to the priest, with the addition of a fifth part.

chinese: 祭司不可褻瀆以色列人所獻給耶和華的聖物，
english: And they may not make common the holy things which the children of Israel give to the Lord,

chinese: 免得他們在吃聖物上自取罪孽，因為我是叫他們成聖的耶和華。
english: So causing sin to come on them when they take their holy things for food: I am the Lord who make them holy.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭亞倫和他子孫，並以色列眾人說：以色列家中的人，或在以色列中寄居的，凡獻供物，無論是所許的願，是甘心獻的，就是獻給耶和華作燔祭的，
english: Say to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel, If any man of the children of Israel, or of another nation living in Israel, makes an offering, given because of an oath or freely given to the Lord for a burned offering;

chinese: 要將沒有殘疾的公牛，或是綿羊，或是山羊獻上，如此方蒙悅納。
english: So that it may be pleasing to the Lord, let him give a male, without any mark, from among the oxen or the sheep or the goats.

chinese: 凡有殘疾的，你們不可獻上，因為這不蒙悅納。
english: But anything which has a mark you may not give; it will not make you pleasing to the Lord.

chinese: 凡從牛群或是羊群中，將平安祭獻給耶和華，為要還特許的願，或是作甘心獻的，所獻的必純全無殘疾的才蒙悅納。
english: And whoever makes a peace-offering to the Lord, in payment of an oath or as a free offering, from the herd or the flock, if it is to be pleasing to the Lord, let it be free from any mark or damage.

chinese: 瞎眼的、折傷的、殘廢的、有瘤子的、長癬的、長疥的都不可獻給耶和華，也不可在壇上作為火祭獻給耶和華。
english: Anything blind or broken or damaged or having any disease or any mark on it may not be offered to the Lord; you may not make an offering of it by fire on the altar to the Lord.

chinese: 無論是公牛是綿羊羔，若肢體有餘的，或是缺少的，只可作甘心祭獻上；用以還願，卻不蒙悅納。
english: An ox or a lamb which has more or less than its natural parts, may be given as a free offering; but it will not be taken in payment of an oath.

chinese: 腎子損傷的，或是壓碎的，或是破裂的，或是騸了的，不可獻給耶和華，在你們的地上也不可這樣行。
english: An animal which has its sex parts damaged or crushed or broken or cut, may not be offered to the Lord; such a thing may not be done anywhere in your land.

chinese: 這類的物，你們從外人的手，一樣也不可接受作你們神的食物獻上；因為這些都有損壞，有殘疾，不蒙悅納。
english: And from one who is not an Israelite you may not take any of these for an offering to the Lord; for they are unclean, there is a mark on them, and the Lord will not be pleased with them.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 才生的公牛，或是綿羊或是山羊，七天當跟著母；從第八天以後，可以當供物蒙悅納，作為耶和華的火祭。
english: When an ox or a sheep or a goat is given birth, let it be with its mother for seven days; and after the eighth day it may be taken as an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 無論是母牛是母羊，不可同日宰母和子。
english: A cow or a sheep may not be put to death with its young on the same day.

chinese: 你們獻感謝祭給耶和華，要獻得可蒙悅納。
english: And when you make an offering of praise to the Lord, make it in a way which is pleasing to him.

chinese: 要當天吃，一點不可留到早晨。我是耶和華。
english: Let it be used for food on the same day; do not keep any part of it till the morning: I am the Lord.

chinese: 你們要謹守遵行我的誡命。我是耶和華。
english: So then, keep my orders and do them: I am the Lord.

chinese: 你們不可褻瀆我的聖名；我在以色列人中，卻要被尊為聖。我是叫你們成聖的耶和華，
english: And do not make my holy name common; so that it may be kept holy by the children of Israel: I am the Lord who make you holy,

chinese: 把你們從埃及地領出來，作你們的神。我是耶和華。
english: Who took you out of the land of Egypt that I might be your God: I am the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：耶和華的節期，你們要宣告為聖會的節期。
english: Say to the children of Israel, These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, which you will keep for holy meetings: these are my feasts.

chinese: 六日要做工，第七日是聖安息日，當有聖會；你們甚麼工都不可做。這是在你們一切的住處向耶和華守的安息日。
english: On six days work may be done; but the seventh day is a special day of rest, a time for worship; you may do no sort of work: it is a Sabbath to the Lord wherever you may be living.

chinese: 耶和華的節期，就是你們到了日期要宣告為聖會的，乃是這些。
english: These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, the holy days of worship which you will keep at their regular times.

chinese: 正月十四日，黃昏的時候，是耶和華的逾越節。
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at nightfall, is the Lord's Passover;

chinese: 這月十五日是向耶和華守的無酵節；你們要吃無酵餅七日。
english: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread; for seven days let your food be unleavened bread.

chinese: 第一日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；
english: On the first day you will have a holy meeting; you may do no sort of field-work.

chinese: 要將火祭獻給耶和華七日。第七日是聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
english: And every day for seven days you will give a burned offering to the Lord; and on the seventh day there will be a holy meeting; you may do no field-work.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我賜給你們的地，收割莊稼的時候，要將初熟的莊稼一捆帶給祭司。
english: Say to the children of Israel, When you have come to the land which I will give you, and have got in the grain from its fields, take some of the first-fruits of the grain to the priest;

chinese: 他要把這一捆在耶和華面前搖一搖，使你們得蒙悅納。祭司要在安息日的次日把這捆搖一搖。
english: And let the grain be waved before the Lord, so that you may be pleasing to him; on the day after the Sabbath let it be waved by the priest.

chinese: 搖這捆的日子，你們要把一歲、沒有殘疾的公綿羊羔獻給耶和華為燔祭。
english: And on the day of the waving of the grain, you are to give a male lamb of the first year, without any mark, for a burned offering to the Lord.

chinese: 同獻的素祭，就是調油的細麵伊法十分之二，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。同獻的奠祭，要酒一欣四分之一。
english: And let the meal offering with it be two tenth parts of an ephah of the best meal mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the Lord for a sweet smell; and the drink offering with it is to be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

chinese: 無論是餅，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你們都不可吃，直等到把你們獻給神的供物帶來的那一天才可以吃。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。
english: And you may take no bread or dry grain or new grain for food till the very day on which you have given the offering for your God: this is a rule for ever through all your generations wherever you are living.

chinese: 你們要從安息日的次日，獻禾捆為搖祭的那日算起，要滿了七個安息日。
english: And let seven full weeks be numbered from the day after the Sabbath, the day when you give the grain for the wave offering;

chinese: 到第七個安息日的次日，共計五十天，又要將新素祭獻給耶和華。
english: Let fifty days be numbered, to the day after the seventh Sabbath; then you are to give a new meal offering to the Lord.

chinese: 要從你們的住處取出細麵伊法十分之二，加酵，烤成兩個搖祭的餅，當作初熟之物獻給耶和華。
english: Take from your houses two cakes of bread, made of a fifth part of an ephah of the best meal, cooked with leaven, to be waved for first-fruits to the Lord.

chinese: 又要將一歲、沒有殘疾的羊羔七隻、公牛犢一隻、公綿羊兩隻，和餅一同奉上。這些與同獻的素祭和奠祭要作為燔祭獻給耶和華，就是作馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。
english: And with the bread, take seven lambs of the first year, without any marks, and one ox and two male sheep, to be a burned offering to the Lord, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, an offering of a sweet smell made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 你們要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，兩隻一歲的公綿羊羔為平安祭。
english: And you are to give one male goat for a sin-offering and two male lambs of the first year for peace-offerings.

chinese: 祭司要把這些和初熟麥子做的餅一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這是獻與耶和華為聖物歸給祭司的。
english: And these will be waved by the priest, with the bread of the first-fruits, for a wave offering to the Lord, with the two lambs: they will be holy to the Lord for the priest.

chinese: 當這日，你們要宣告聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。
english: And on the same day, let it be given out that there will be a holy meeting for you: you may do no field-work on that day: it is a rule for ever through all your generations wherever you are living.

chinese: 在你們的地收割莊稼，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取所遺落的；要留給窮人和寄居的。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: And when you get in the grain from your land, do not let all the grain at the edges of the field be cut, and do not take up the grain which has been dropped in the field; let that be for the poor, and for the man from another country: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：七月初一，你們要守為聖安息日，要吹角作紀念，當有聖會。
english: Say to the children of Israel, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, let there be a special day of rest for you, a day of memory, marked by the blowing of horns, a meeting for worship.

chinese: 甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；要將火祭獻給耶和華。
english: Do no field-work and give to the Lord an offering made by fire.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 七月初十是贖罪日；你們要守為聖會，並要刻苦己心，也要將火祭獻給耶和華。
english: The tenth day of this seventh month is the day for the taking away of sin; let it be a holy day of worship; you are to keep from pleasure, and give to the Lord an offering made by fire.

chinese: 當這日，甚麼工都不可做；因為是贖罪日，要在耶和華─你們的神面前贖罪。
english: And on that day you may do no sort of work, for it is a day of taking away sin, to make you clean before the Lord your God.

chinese: 當這日，凡不刻苦己心的，必從民中剪除。
english: For any person, whoever he may be, who takes his pleasure on that day will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 凡這日做甚麼工的，我必將他從民中除滅。
english: And if any person, whoever he may be, on that day does any sort of work, I will send destruction on him from among his people.

chinese: 你們甚麼工都不可做。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。
english: You may not do any sort of work: this is an order for ever through all your generations wherever you may be living.

chinese: 你們要守這日為聖安息日，並要刻苦己心。從這月初九日晚上到次日晚上，要守為安息日。
english: Let this be a Sabbath of special rest to you, and keep yourselves from all pleasure; on the ninth day of the month at nightfall from evening to evening, let this Sabbath be kept.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：這七月十五日是住棚節，要在耶和華面前守這節七日。
english: Say to the children of Israel, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month let the feast of tents be kept to the Lord for seven days.

chinese: 第一日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
english: On the first day there will be a holy meeting: do no field-work.

chinese: 七日內要將火祭獻給耶和華。第八日當守聖會，要將火祭獻給耶和華。這是嚴肅會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
english: Every day for seven days give an offering made by fire to the Lord; and on the eighth day there is to be a holy meeting, when you are to give an offering made by fire to the Lord; this is a special holy day: you may do no field-work on that day.

chinese: 這是耶和華的節期，就是你們要宣告為聖會的節期；要將火祭、燔祭、素祭、祭物，並奠祭，各歸各日，獻給耶和華。
english: These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, to be kept by you as holy days of worship, for making an offering by fire to the Lord; a burned offering, a meal offering, an offering of beasts, and drink offerings; every one on its special day;

chinese: 這是在耶和華的安息日以外，又在你們的供物和所許的願，並甘心獻給耶和華的以外。
english: In addition to the Sabbaths of the Lord, and in addition to the things you give and the oaths you make and the free offerings to the Lord.

chinese: 你們收藏了地的出產，就從七月十五日起，要守耶和華的節七日。第一日為聖安息；第八日也為聖安息。
english: But on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have got in all the fruits of the land, you will keep the feast of the Lord for seven days: the first day will be a Sabbath, and the eighth day the same.

chinese: 第一日要拿美好樹上的果子和棕樹上的枝子，與茂密樹的枝條並河旁的柳枝，在耶和華─你們的神面前歡樂七日。
english: On the first day, take the fruit of fair trees, branches of palm-trees, and branches of thick trees and trees from the riverside, and be glad before the Lord for seven days.

chinese: 每年七月間，要向耶和華守這節七日。這為你們世世代代永遠的定例。
english: And let this feast be kept before the Lord for seven days in the year: it is a rule for ever from generation to generation; in the seventh month let it be kept.

chinese: 你們要住在棚裡七日；凡以色列家的人都要住在棚裡，
english: For seven days you will be living in tents; all those who are Israelites by birth are to make tents their living-places:

chinese: 好叫你們世世代代知道，我領以色列人出埃及地的時候曾使他們住在棚裡。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: So that future generations may keep in mind how I gave the children of Israel tents as their living-places when I took them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 於是，摩西將耶和華的節期傳給以色列人。
english: And Moses made clear to the children of Israel the orders about the fixed feasts of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 要吩咐以色列人，把那為點燈搗成的清橄欖油拿來給你，使燈常常點著。
english: Give orders to the children of Israel to give you clean olive oil for the light, so that a light may be burning at all times,

chinese: 在會幕中法櫃的幔子外，亞倫從晚上到早晨必在耶和華面前經理這燈。這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
english: Outside the veil of the ark in the Tent of meeting; let Aaron see that it is burning from evening till morning at all times before the Lord: it is a rule for ever through all your generations.

chinese: 他要在耶和華面前常收拾精金燈臺上的燈。
english: Let Aaron put the lights in order on the support before the Lord at all times.

chinese: 你要取細麵，烤成十二個餅，每餅用麵伊法十分之二。
english: And take the best meal and make twelve cakes of it, a fifth part of an ephah in every cake.

chinese: 要把餅擺列兩行（或作：摞；下同），每行六個，在耶和華面前精金的桌子上；
english: And put them in two lines, six in a line, on the holy table before the Lord.

chinese: 又要把淨乳香放在每行餅上，作為紀念，就是作為火祭獻給耶和華。
english: And on the lines of cakes put clean sweet-smelling spices, for a sign on the bread, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 每安息日要常擺在耶和華面前；這為以色列人作永遠的約。
english: Every Sabbath day regularly, the priest is to put it in order before the Lord: it is offered for the children of Israel, an agreement made for ever.

chinese: 這餅是要給亞倫和他子孫的；他們要在聖處吃，為永遠的定例，因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中是至聖的。
english: And it will be for Aaron and his sons; they are to take it for food in a holy place: it is the most holy of all the offerings made by fire to the Lord, a rule for ever.

chinese: 有一個以色列婦人的兒子，他父親是埃及人，一日閒遊在以色列人中。這以色列婦人的兒子和一個以色列人在營裡爭鬥。
english: And a son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel and had a fight with a man of Israel by the tents;

chinese: 這以色列婦人的兒子褻瀆了聖名，並且咒詛，就有人把他送到摩西那裡。（他母親名叫示羅密，是但支派底伯利的女兒。）
english: And the son of the Israelite woman said evil against the holy Name, with curses; and they took him to Moses. His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

chinese: 他們把那人收在監裡，要得耶和華所指示的話。
english: And they kept him shut up, till a decision might be given by the mouth of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 把那咒詛聖名的人帶到營外。叫聽見的人都放手在他頭上；全會眾就要用石頭打死他。
english: Take the curser outside the tent-circle; and let all in whose hearing the words were said put their hands on his head, and let him be stoned by all the people.

chinese: 你要曉諭以色列人說：凡咒詛神的，必擔當他的罪。
english: And say to the children of Israel, As for any man cursing God, his sin will be on his head.

chinese: 那褻瀆耶和華名的，必被治死；全會眾總要用石頭打死他。不管是寄居的是本地人，他褻瀆耶和華名的時候，必被治死。
english: And he who says evil against the name of the Lord will certainly be put to death; he will be stoned by all the people; the man who is not of your nation and one who is an Israelite by birth, whoever says evil against the holy Name is to be put to death.

chinese: 打死人的，必被治死；
english: And anyone who takes another's life is certainly to be put to death.

chinese: 打死牲畜的，必賠上牲畜，以命償命。
english: And anyone wounding a beast and causing its death, will have to make payment for it: a life for a life.

chinese: 人若使他鄰舍的身體有殘疾，他怎樣行，也要照樣向他行：
english: And if a man does damage to his neighbour, as he has done, so let it be done to him;

chinese: 以傷還傷，以眼還眼，以牙還牙。他怎樣叫人的身體有殘疾，也要照樣向他行。
english: Wound for wound, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; whatever damage he has done, so let it be done to him.

chinese: 打死牲畜的，必賠上牲畜；打死人的，必被治死。
english: He who puts a beast to death will have to make payment for it; he who puts a man to death will himself be put to death.

chinese: 不管是寄居的是本地人，同歸一例。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: You are to have the same law for a man of another nation living among you as for an Israelite; for I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 於是，摩西曉諭以色列人，他們就把那咒詛聖名的人帶到營外，用石頭打死。以色列人就照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
english: And Moses said these words to the children of Israel, and they took the man who had been cursing outside the tent-circle and had him stoned. The children of Israel did as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 耶和華在西乃山對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所賜你們那地的時候，地就要向耶和華守安息。
english: Say to the children of Israel, When you come into the land which I will give you, let the land keep a Sabbath to the Lord.

chinese: 六年要耕種田地，也要修理葡萄園，收藏地的出產。
english: For six years put seed into your land, and for six years give care to your vines and get in the produce of them;

chinese: 第七年，地要守聖安息，就是向耶和華守的安息，不可耕種田地，也不可修理葡萄園。
english: But let the seventh year be a Sabbath of rest for the land, a Sabbath to the Lord; do not put seed into your land or have your vines cut.

chinese: 遺落自長的莊稼不可收割；沒有修理的葡萄樹也不可摘取葡萄。這年，地要守聖安息。
english: That which comes to growth of itself may not be cut, and the grapes of your uncared-for vines may not be taken off; let it be a year of rest for the land.

chinese: 地在安息年所出的，要給你和你的僕人、婢女、雇工人，並寄居的外人當食物。
english: And the Sabbath of the land will give food for you and your man-servant and your woman-servant and those working for payment, and for those of another country who are living among you;

chinese: 這年的土產也要給你的牲畜和你地上的走獸當食物。
english: And for your cattle and the beasts on the land; all the natural increase of the land will be for food.

chinese: 你要計算七個安息年，就是七七年。這便為你成了七個安息年，共是四十九年。
english: And let seven Sabbaths of years be numbered to you, seven times seven years; even the days of seven Sabbaths of years, that is forty-nine years;

chinese: 當年七月初十日，你要大發角聲；這日就是贖罪日，要在遍地發出角聲。
english: Then let the loud horn be sounded far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the day of taking away sin let the horn be sounded through all your land.

chinese: 第五十年，你們要當作聖年，在遍地給一切的居民宣告自由。這年必為你們的禧年，各人要歸自己的產業，各歸本家。
english: And let this fiftieth year be kept holy, and say publicly that everyone in the land is free from debt: it is the Jubilee, and every man may go back to his heritage and to his family.

chinese: 第五十年要作為你們的禧年。這年不可耕種；地中自長的，不可收割；沒有修理的葡萄樹也不可摘取葡萄。
english: Let this fiftieth year be the Jubilee: no seed may be planted, and that which comes to growth of itself may not be cut, and the grapes may not be taken from the uncared-for vines.

chinese: 因為這是禧年，你們要當作聖年，吃地中自出的土產。
english: For it is the Jubilee, and it is holy to you; your food will be the natural increase of the field.

chinese: 這禧年，你們各人要歸自己的地業。
english: In this year of Jubilee, let every man go back to his heritage.

chinese: 你若賣甚麼給鄰舍，或是從鄰舍的手中買甚麼，彼此不可虧負。
english: And in the business of trading goods for money, do no wrong to one another.

chinese: 你要按禧年以後的年數向鄰舍買；他也要按年數的收成賣給你。
english: Let your exchange of goods with your neighbours have relation to the number of years after the year of Jubilee, and the number of times the earth has given her produce.

chinese: 年歲若多，要照數加添價值；年歲若少，要照數減去價值，因為他照收成的數目賣給你。
english: If the number of years is great, the price will be increased, and if the number of years is small, the price will be less, for it is the produce of a certain number of years which the man is giving you.

chinese: 你們彼此不可虧負，只要敬畏你們的神，因為我是耶和華─你們的　神。
english: And do no wrong, one to another, but let the fear of your God be before you; for I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 我的律例，你們要遵行，我的典章，你們要謹守，就可以在那地上安然居住。
english: So keep my rules and my decisions and do them, and you will be safe in your land.

chinese: 地必出土產，你們就要吃飽，在那地上安然居住。
english: And the land will give her fruit, and you will have food in full measure and be safe in the land.

chinese: 你們若說：這第七年我們不耕種，也不收藏土產，吃甚麼呢？
english: And if you say, Where will our food come from in the seventh year, when we may not put in seed, or get in the increase

chinese: 我必在第六年將我所命的福賜給你們，地便生三年的土產。
english: Then I will send my blessing on you in the sixth year, and the land will give fruit enough for three years.

chinese: 第八年，你們要耕種，也要吃陳糧，等到第九年出產收來的時候，你們還吃陳糧。
english: And in the eighth year you will put in your seed, and get your food from the old stores, till the fruit of the ninth year is ready.

chinese: 地不可永賣，因為地是我的；你們在我面前是客旅，是寄居的。
english: No exchange of land may be for ever, for the land is mine, and you are as my guests, living with me for a time.

chinese: 在你們所得為業的全地，也要准人將地贖回。
english: Wherever there is property in land, the owner is to have the right of getting it back.

chinese: 你的弟兄（弟兄是指本國人說；下同）若漸漸窮乏，賣了幾分地業，他至近的親屬就要來把弟兄所賣的贖回。
english: If your brother becomes poor, and has to give up some of his land for money, his nearest relation may come and get back that which his brother has given up.

chinese: 若沒有能給他贖回的，他自己漸漸富足，能夠贖回，
english: And if he has no one to get it back for him, and later he himself gets wealth and has enough money to get it back;

chinese: 就要算出賣地的年數，把餘剩年數的價值還那買主，自己便歸回自己的地業。
english: Then let him take into account the years from the time when he gave it up, and make up the loss for the rest of the years to him who took it, and so get back his property.

chinese: 倘若不能為自己得回所賣的，仍要存在買主的手裡直到禧年；到了禧年，地業要出買主的手，自己便歸回自己的地業。
