english: But if he is not able to get it back for himself, then it will be kept by him who gave a price for it, till the year of Jubilee; and in that year it will go back to its first owner and he will have his property again.

chinese: 人若賣城內的住宅，賣了以後，一年之內可以贖回；在一整年，必有贖回的權柄。
english: And if a man gives his house in a walled town for money, he has the right to get it back for the space of a full year after he has given it up.

chinese: 若在一整年之內不贖回，這城內的房屋就定準永歸買主，世世代代為業；在禧年也不得出買主的手。
english: And if he does not get it back by the end of the year, then the house in the town will become the property of him who gave the money for it, and of his children for ever; it will not go from him in the year of Jubilee.

chinese: 但房屋在無城牆的村莊裡，要看如鄉下的田地一樣，可以贖回；到了禧年，都要出買主的手。
english: But houses in small unwalled towns will be the same as property in the country; they may be got back, and they will go back to their owners in the year of Jubilee.

chinese: 然而利未人所得為業的城邑，其中的房屋，利未人可以隨時贖回。
english: But the houses in the towns of the Levites may be got back by the Levites at any time.

chinese: 若是一個利未人不將所賣的房屋贖回，是在所得為業的城內，到了禧年就要出買主的手，因為利未人城邑的房屋是他們在以色列人中的產業。
english: And if a Levite does not give money to get back his property, his house in the town which was exchanged for money will come back to him in the year of Jubilee. For the houses of the towns of the Levites are their property among the children of Israel.

chinese: 只是他們各城郊野之地不可賣，因為是他們永遠的產業。
english: But the land on the outskirts of their towns may not be exchanged for money, for it is their property for ever.

chinese: 你的弟兄在你那裡若漸漸貧窮，手中缺乏，你就要幫補他，使他與你同住，像外人和寄居的一樣。
english: And if your brother becomes poor and is not able to make a living, then you are to keep him with you, helping him as you would a man from another country who is living among you.

chinese: 不可向他取利，也不可向他多要；只要敬畏你的神，使你的弟兄與你同住。
english: Take no interest from him, in money or in goods, but have the fear of your God before you, and let your brother make a living among you.

chinese: 你借錢給他，不可向他取利；借糧給他，也不可向他多要。
english: Do not take interest on the money which you let him have or on the food which you give him.

chinese: 我是耶和華─你們的神，曾領你們從埃及地出來，為要把迦南地賜給你們，要作你們的　神。
english: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, that I might be your God.

chinese: 你的弟兄若在你那裡漸漸窮乏，將自己賣給你，不可叫他像奴僕服事你。
english: And if your brother becomes poor and gives himself to you for money, do not make use of him like a servant who is your property;

chinese: 他要在你那裡像雇工人和寄居的一樣，要服事你直到禧年。
english: But let him be with you as a servant working for payment, till the year of Jubilee;

chinese: 到了禧年，他和他兒女要離開你，一同出去歸回本家，到他祖宗的地業那裡去。
english: Then he will go out from you, he and his children with him, and go back to his family and to the property of his fathers.

chinese: 因為他們是我的僕人，是我從埃及地領出來的，不可賣為奴僕。
english: For they are my servants whom I took out from the land of Egypt; they may not become the property of another.

chinese: 不可嚴嚴的轄管他，只要敬畏你的神。
english: Do not be a hard master to him, but have the fear of God before you.

chinese: 至於你的奴僕、婢女，可以從你四圍的國中買。
english: But you may get servants as property from among the nations round about; from them you may take men-servants and women-servants.

chinese: 並且那寄居在你們中間的外人和他們的家屬，在你們地上所生的，你們也可以從其中買人；他們要作你們的產業。
english: And in addition, you may get, for money, servants from among the children of other nations who are living with you, and from their families which have come to birth in your land; and these will be your property.

chinese: 你們要將他們遺留給你們的子孫為產業，要永遠從他們中間揀出奴僕；只是你們的弟兄以色列人，你們不可嚴嚴的轄管。
english: And they will be your children's heritage after you, to keep as their property; they will be your servants for ever; but you may not be hard masters to your countrymen, the children of Israel.

chinese: 住在你那裡的外人，或是寄居的，若漸漸富足，你的弟兄卻漸漸窮乏，將自己賣給那外人，或是寄居的，或是外人的宗族，
english: And if one from another nation living among you gets wealth, and your countryman, at his side, becomes poor and gives himself for money to the man from another nation or to one of his family;

chinese: 賣了以後，可以將他贖回。無論是他的弟兄，
english: After he has given himself he has the right to be made free, for a price, by one of his brothers,

chinese: 或伯叔、伯叔的兒子，本家的近支，都可以贖他。他自己若漸漸富足，也可以自贖。
english: Or his father's brother, or the son of his father's brother, or any near relation; or if he gets money, he may make himself free.

chinese: 他要和買主計算，從賣自己的那年起，算到禧年；所賣的價值照著年數多少，好像工人每年的工價。
english: And let the years be numbered from the time when he gave himself to his owner till the year of Jubilee, and the price given for him will be in relation to the number of years, on the scale of the payment of a servant.

chinese: 若缺少的年數多，就要按著年數從買價中償還他的贖價
english: If there is still a long time, he will give back, on account of it, a part of the price which was given for him.

chinese: 若到禧年只缺少幾年，就要按著年數和買主計算，償還他的贖價。
english: And if there is only a short time, he will take account of it with his master, and in relation to the number of years he will give back the price of making him free.

chinese: 他和買主同住，要像每年雇的工人，買主不可嚴嚴的轄管他。
english: And he will be with him as a servant working for payment year by year; his master is not to be cruel to him before your eyes.

chinese: 他若不這樣被贖，到了禧年，要和他的兒女一同出去。
english: And if he is not made free in this way, he will go out in the year of Jubilee, he and his children with him.

chinese: 因為以色列人都是我的僕人，是我從埃及地領出來的。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: For the children of Israel are servants to me; they are my servants whom I took out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們不可做甚麼虛無的神像，不可立雕刻的偶像或是柱像，也不可在你們的地上安甚麼鏨成的石像，向他跪拜，因為我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: Do not make images of false gods, or put up an image cut in stone or a pillar or any pictured stone in your land, to give worship to it; for I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們要守我的安息日，敬我的聖所。我是耶和華。
english: Keep my Sabbaths and give honour to my holy place: I am the Lord.

chinese: 你們若遵行我的律例，謹守我的誡命，
english: If you are guided by my rules, and keep my laws and do them,

chinese: 我就給你們降下時雨，叫地生出土產，田野的樹木結果子。
english: Then I will give you rain at the right time, and the land will give her increase and the trees of the field will give their fruit;

chinese: 你們打糧食要打到摘葡萄的時候，摘葡萄要摘到撒種的時候；並且要吃得飽足，在你們的地上安然居住。
english: And the crushing of the grain will overtake the cutting of the grapes, and the cutting of the grapes will overtake the planting of the seed, and there will be bread in full measure, and you will be living in your land safely.

chinese: 我要賜平安在你們的地上；你們躺臥，無人驚嚇。我要叫惡獸從你們的地上息滅；刀劍也必不經過你們的地。
english: And I will give you peace in the land, and you will take your rest and no one will give you cause for fear; and I will put an end to all evil beasts in the land, and no sword of war will go through your land.

chinese: 你們要追趕仇敵，他們必倒在你們刀下。
english: And you will put to flight those who are against you, and they will be put to death by your swords.

chinese: 你們五個人要追趕一百人，一百人要追趕一萬人；仇敵必倒在你們刀下。
english: Then five of you will put to flight a hundred, and a hundred of you will put to flight ten thousand, and all who are against you will be put to death by your swords.

chinese: 我要眷顧你們，使你們生養眾多，也要與你們堅定所立的約。
english: And I will have pleasure in you and make you fertile and greater in number; and I will keep my agreement with you.

chinese: 你們要吃陳糧，又因新糧挪開陳糧。
english: And old stores long kept will be your food, and you will take out the old because of the new;

chinese: 我要在你們中間立我的帳幕；我的心也不厭惡你們。
english: And I will put my holy House among you, and my soul will not be turned away from you in disgust.

chinese: 我要在你們中間行走；我要作你們的神，你們要作我的子民。
english: And I will be present among you and will be your God and you will be my people.

chinese: 我是耶和華─你們的神，曾將你們從埃及地領出來，使你們不作埃及人的奴僕；我也折斷你們所負的軛，叫你們挺身而走。
english: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt so that you might not be servants to them; by me the cords of your yoke were broken and I made you go upright.

chinese: 你們若不聽從我，不遵行我的誡命，
english: But if you do not give ear to me, and do not keep all these my laws;

chinese: 厭棄我的律例，厭惡我的典章，不遵行我一切的誡命，背棄我的約，
english: And if you go against my rules and if you have hate in your souls for my decisions and you do not do all my orders, but go against my agreement;

chinese: 我待你們就要這樣：我必命定驚惶，叫眼目乾癟、精神消耗的癆病熱病轄制你們。你們也要白白的撒種，因為仇敵要吃你們所種的。
english: This will I do to you: I will put fear in your hearts, even wasting disease and burning pain, drying up the eyes and making the soul feeble, and you will get no profit from your seed, for your haters will take it for food.

chinese: 我要向你們變臉，你們就要敗在仇敵面前。恨惡你們的，必轄管你們；無人追趕，你們卻要逃跑。
english: And my face will be turned from you, and you will be broken before those who are against you, and your haters will become your rulers, and you will go in flight when no man comes after you.

chinese: 你們因這些事若還不聽從我，我就要為你們的罪加七倍懲罰你們。
english: And if, even after these things, you will not give ear to me, then I will send you punishment seven times more for your sins.

chinese: 我必斷絕你們因勢力而有的驕傲，又要使覆你們的天如鐵，載你們的地如銅。
english: And the pride of your strength will be broken, and I will make your heaven as iron and your earth as brass;

chinese: 你們要白白的勞力；因為你們的地不出土產，其上的樹木也不結果子。
english: And your strength will be used up without profit; for your land will not give her increase and the trees of the field will not give their fruit.

chinese: 你們行事若與我反對，不肯聽從我，我就要按你們的罪加七倍降災與你們。
english: And if you still go against me and will not give ear to me, I will put seven times more punishments on you because of your sins.

chinese: 我也要打發野地的走獸到你們中間，搶吃你們的兒女，吞滅你們的牲畜，使你們的人數減少，道路荒涼。
english: I will let loose the beasts of the field among you, and they will take away your children and send destruction on your cattle, so that your numbers will become small and your roads become waste.

chinese: 你們因這些事若仍不改正歸我，行事與我反對，
english: And if by these things you will not be turned to me, but still go against me;

chinese: 我就要行事與你們反對，因你們的罪擊打你們七次。
english: Then I will go against you, and I will give you punishment, I myself, seven times for all your sins.

chinese: 我又要使刀劍臨到你們，報復你們背約的仇；聚集你們在各城內，降瘟疫在你們中間，也必將你們交在仇敵的手中。
english: And I will send a sword on you to give effect to the punishment of my agreement; and when you come together into your towns I will send disease among you and you will be given up into the hands of your haters.

chinese: 我要折斷你們的杖，就是斷絕你們的糧。那時，必有十個女人在一個爐子給你們烤餅，按分量秤給你們；你們要吃，也吃不飽。
english: When I take away your bread of life, ten women will be cooking bread in one oven, and your bread will be measured out by weight; you will have food but never enough.

chinese: 你們因這一切的事若不聽從我，卻行事與我反對，
english: And if, after all this, you do not give ear to me, but go against me still,

chinese: 我就要發烈怒，行事與你們反對，又因你們的罪懲罰你們七次。
english: Then my wrath will be burning against you, and I will give you punishment, I myself, seven times for your sins.

chinese: 並且你們要吃兒子的肉，也要吃女兒的肉。
english: Then you will take the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters for food;

chinese: 我又要毀壞你們的邱壇，砍下你們的日像，把你們的屍首扔在你們偶像的身上；我的心也必厭惡你們。
english: And I will send destruction on your high places, overturning your perfume altars, and will put your dead bodies on your broken images, and my soul will be turned from you in disgust.

chinese: 我要使你們的城邑變為荒涼，使你們的眾聖所成為荒場；我也不聞你們馨香的香氣。
english: And I will make your towns waste and send destruction on your holy places; I will take no pleasure in the smell of your sweet perfumes;

chinese: 我要使地成為荒場，住在其上的仇敵就因此詫異。
english: And I will make your land a waste, a wonder to your haters living in it.

chinese: 我要把你們散在列邦中；我也要拔刀追趕你們。你們的地要成為荒場；你們的城邑要變為荒涼。
english: And I will send you out in all directions among the nations, and my sword will be uncovered against you, and your land will be without any living thing, and your towns will be made waste.

chinese: 你們在仇敵之地居住的時候，你們的地荒涼，要享受眾安息；正在那時候，地要歇息，享受安息。
english: Then will the land take pleasure in its Sabbaths while it is waste and you are living in the land of your haters; then will the land have rest.

chinese: 地多時為荒場，就要多時歇息；地這樣歇息，是你們住在其上的安息年所不能得的。
english: All the days while it is waste will the land have rest, such rest as it never had in your Sabbaths, when you were living in it.

chinese: 至於你們剩下的人，我要使他們在仇敵之地心驚膽怯。葉子被風吹的響聲，要追趕他們；他們要逃避，像人逃避刀劍，無人追趕，卻要跌倒。
english: And as for the rest of you, I will make their hearts feeble in the land of their haters, and the sound of a leaf moved by the wind will send them in flight, and they will go in flight as from the sword, falling down when no one comes after them;

chinese: 無人追趕，他們要彼此撞跌，像在刀劍之前。你們在仇敵面前也必站立不住。
english: Falling on one another, as before the sword, when no one comes after them; you will give way before your haters.

chinese: 你們要在列邦中滅亡；仇敵之地要吞吃你們。
english: And death will overtake you among strange nations, and the land of your haters will be your destruction.

chinese: 你們剩下的人必因自己的罪孽和祖宗的罪孽在仇敵之地消滅。
english: And those of you who are still living will be wasting away in their sins in the land of your haters; in the sins of their fathers they will be wasting away.

chinese: 他們要承認自己的罪和他們祖宗的罪，就是干犯我的那罪，並且承認自己行事與我反對，
english: And they will have grief for their sins and for the sins of their fathers, when their hearts were untrue to me, and they went against me;

chinese: 我所以行事與他們反對，把他們帶到仇敵之地。那時，他們未受割禮的心若謙卑了，他們也服了罪孽的刑罰，
english: So that I went against them and sent them away into the land of their haters: if then the pride of their hearts is broken and they take the punishment of their sins,

chinese: 我就要記念我與雅各所立的約，與以撒所立的約，與亞伯拉罕所立的約，並要記念這地。
english: Then I will keep in mind the agreement which I made with Jacob and with Isaac and with Abraham, and I will keep in mind the land.

chinese: 他們離開這地，地在荒廢無人的時候就要享受安息。並且他們要服罪孽的刑罰；因為他們厭棄了我的典章，心中厭惡了我的律例。
english: And the land, while she is without them, will keep her Sabbaths; and they will undergo the punishment of their sins, because they were turned away from my decisions and in their souls was hate for my laws.

chinese: 雖是這樣，他們在仇敵之地，我卻不厭棄他們，也不厭惡他們，將他們盡行滅絕，也不背棄我與他們所立的約，因為我是耶和華─他們的神。
english: But for all that, when they are in the land of their haters I will not let them go, or be turned away from them, or give them up completely; my agreement with them will not be broken, for I am the Lord their God.

chinese: 我卻要為他們的緣故記念我與他們先祖所立的約。他們的先祖是我在列邦人眼前、從埃及地領出來的，為要作他們的神。我是耶和華。
english: And because of them I will keep in mind the agreement which I made with their fathers, whom I took out of the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations, to be their God: I am the Lord.

chinese: 這些律例、典章，和法度是耶和華與以色列人在西乃山藉著摩西立的。
english: These are the rules, decisions, and laws, which the Lord made between himself and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai, by the hand of Moses.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：人還特許的願，被許的人要按你所估的價值歸給耶和華。
english: Say to the children of Israel, If a man makes a special oath, you will give your decision as to the value of the persons for the Lord.

chinese: 你估定的，從二十歲到六十歲的男人，要按聖所的平，估定價銀五十舍客勒。
english: And you will put the value of a male from twenty years to sixty years old at fifty shekels of silver, by the scale of the holy place.

chinese: 若是女人，你要估定三十舍客勒。
english: And if it is a female, the value will be thirty shekels.

chinese: 若是從五歲到二十歲，男子你要估定二十舍客勒，女子估定十舍客勒。
english: And if the person is from five to twenty years old, the value will be twenty shekels for a male, and ten for a female.

chinese: 若是從一月到五歲，男子你要估定五舍客勒，女子估定三舍客勒。
english: And if the person is from one month to five years old, then the value for a male will be five shekels of silver, and for a female three shekels.

chinese: 若是從六十歲以上，男人你要估定十五舍客勒，女人估定十舍客勒。
english: And for sixty years old and over, for a male the value will be fifteen shekels, and for a female, ten.

chinese: 他若貧窮，不能照你所估定的價，就要把他帶到祭司面前，祭司要按許願人的力量估定他的價。
english: But if he is poorer than the value which you have put on him, then let him be taken to the priest, and the priest will put a value on him, such as it is possible for him to give.

chinese: 所許的若是牲畜，就是人獻給耶和華為供物的，凡這一類獻給耶和華的，都要成為聖。
english: And if it is a beast of which men make offerings to the Lord, whatever any man gives of such to the Lord will be holy.

chinese: 人不可改換，也不可更換，或是好的換壞的，或是壞的換好的。若以牲畜更換牲畜，所許的與所換的都要成為聖。
english: It may not be changed in any way, a good given for a bad, or a bad for a good; if one beast is changed for another, the two will be holy.

chinese: 若牲畜不潔淨，是不可獻給耶和華為供物的，就要把牲畜安置在祭司面前。
english: And if it is any unclean beast, of which offerings are not made to the Lord, then let him take the beast before the priest;

chinese: 祭司就要估定價值；牲畜是好是壞，祭司怎樣估定，就要以怎樣為是。
english: And let the priest put a value on it, if it is good or bad; whatever value the priest puts on it, so will it be.

chinese: 他若一定要贖回，就要在你所估定的價值以外加上五分之一。
english: But if he has a desire to get it back for himself, let him give a fifth more than your value.

chinese: 人將房屋分別為聖，歸給耶和華，祭司就要估定價值。房屋是好是壞，祭司怎樣估定，就要以怎樣為定。
english: And if a man has given his house as holy to the Lord, then the priest will put a value on it, if it is good or bad; as the priest gives decision so will the value be fixed.

chinese: 將房屋分別為聖的人，若要贖回房屋，就必在你所估定的價值以外加上五分之一，房屋仍舊歸他。
english: And if the owner has a desire to get back his house, let him give a fifth more than your value, and it will be his.

chinese: 人若將承受為業的幾分地分別為聖，歸給耶和華，你要按這地撒種多少估定價值，若撒大麥一賀梅珥，要估價五十舍客勒。
english: And if a man gives to the Lord part of the field which is his property, then let your value be in relation to the seed which is planted in it; a measure of barley grain will be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

chinese: 他若從禧年將地分別為聖，就要以你所估定的價為定。
english: If he gives his field from the year of Jubilee, the value will be fixed by your decision.

chinese: 倘若他在禧年以後將地分別為聖，祭司就要按著未到禧年所剩的年數推算價值，也要從你所估的減去價值。
english: But if he gives his field after the year of Jubilee, the amount of the money will be worked out by the priest in relation to the number of years till the coming year of Jubilee, and the necessary amount will be taken off your value.

chinese: 將地分別為聖的人若定要把地贖回，他便要在你所估的價值以外加上五分之一，地就准定歸他。
english: And if the man who has given the field has a desire to get it back, let him give a fifth more than the price at which it was valued and it will be his.

chinese: 他若不贖回那地，或是將地賣給別人，就再不能贖了。
english: But if he has no desire to get it back, or if he has given it for a price to another man, it may not be got back again.

chinese: 但到了禧年，那地從買主手下出來的時候，就要歸耶和華為聖，和永獻的地一樣，要歸祭司為業。
english: But the field, when it becomes free at the year of Jubilee, will be holy to the Lord, as a field given under oath: it will be the property of the priest.

chinese: 他若將所買的一塊地，不是承受為業的，分別為聖歸給耶和華，
english: And if a man gives to the Lord a field which he has got for money from another, which is not part of his heritage;

chinese: 祭司就要將你所估的價值給他推算到禧年。當日，他要以你所估的價銀為聖，歸給耶和華。
english: Then the value fixed by you up to the year of Jubilee will be worked out for him by the priest, and in that day he will give the amount of your value as holy to the Lord.

chinese: 到了禧年，那地要歸賣主，就是那承受為業的原主。
english: In the year of Jubilee the field will go back to him from whom he got it, that is, to him whose heritage it was.

chinese: 凡你所估定的價銀都要按著聖所的平：二十季拉為一舍客勒。
english: And let all your values be based on the shekel of the holy place, that is, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

chinese: 惟獨牲畜中頭生的，無論是牛是羊，既歸耶和華，誰也不可再分別為聖，因為這是耶和華的。
english: But a man may not give by oath to the Lord the first-fruits of cattle which are offered to the Lord: if it is an ox or a sheep it is the Lord's.

chinese: 若是不潔淨的牲畜生的，就要按你所估定的價值加上五分之一贖回；若不贖回，就要按你所估定的價值賣了。
english: And if it is an unclean beast, then the owner of it may give money to get it back, in agreement with the value fixed by you, by giving a fifth more; or if it is not taken back, let it be given for money in agreement with your valuing.

chinese: 但一切永獻的，就是人從他所有永獻給耶和華的，無論是人，是牲畜，是他承受為業的地，都不可賣，也不可贖。凡永獻的是歸給耶和華為至聖。
english: But nothing which a man has given completely to the Lord, out of all his property, of man or beast, or of the land which is his heritage, may be given away or got back in exchange for money; anything completely given is most holy to the Lord.

chinese: 凡從人中當滅的都不可贖，必被治死。
english: Any man given completely to the Lord may not be got back: he is certainly to be put to death.

chinese: 地上所有的，無論是地上的種子是樹上的果子，十分之一是耶和華的，是歸給耶和華為聖的。
english: And every tenth part of the land, of the seed planted, or of the fruit of trees, is holy to the Lord.

chinese: 人若要贖這十分之一的甚麼物，就要加上五分之一。
english: And if a man has a desire to get back any of the tenth part which he has given, let him give a fifth more.

chinese: 凡牛群羊群中，一切從杖下經過的，每第十隻要歸給耶和華為聖。
english: And a tenth part of the herd and of the flock, whatever goes under the rod of the valuer, will be holy to the Lord.

chinese: 不可問是好是壞，也不可更換；若定要更換，所更換的與本來的牲畜都要成為聖，不可贖回。
english: He may not make search to see if it is good or bad, or make any changes in it; and if he makes exchange of it for another, the two will be holy; he will not get them back again.

chinese: 這就是耶和華在西乃山為以色列人所吩咐摩西的命令。
english: These are the orders which the Lord gave to Moses for the children of Israel in Mount Sinai.

chinese: 以色列人出埃及地後，第二年二月初一日，耶和華在西乃的曠野、會幕中曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses in the waste land of Sinai, in the Tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt,

chinese: 你要按以色列全會眾的家室、宗族、人名的數目計算所有的男丁。
english: Take the full number of the children of Israel, by their families, and by their fathers' houses, every male by name;

chinese: 凡以色列中，從二十歲以外，能出去打仗的，你和亞倫要照他們的軍隊數點。
english: All those of twenty years old and over, who are able to go to war in Israel, are to be numbered by you and Aaron.

chinese: 每支派中必有一人作本支派的族長，幫助你們。
english: And to give you help, take one man from every tribe, the head of his father's house.

chinese: 他們的名字：屬流便的，有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿；
english: These are the names of those who are to be your helpers: from Reuben, Elizur, the son of Shedeur;

chinese: 屬西緬的，有蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑；
english: From Simeon, Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai;

chinese: 屬猶大的，有亞米拿達的兒子拿順；
english: From Judah, Nahshon, the son of Amminadab;

chinese: 屬以薩迦的，有蘇押的兒子拿坦業；
english: From Issachar, Nethanel, the son of Zuar;

chinese: 屬西布倫的，有希倫的兒子以利押；
english: From Zebulun, Eliab, the son of Helon;

chinese: 約瑟子孫、屬以法蓮的，有亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪；屬瑪拿西的，有比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列；
english: Of the children of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama, the son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur,

chinese: 屬便雅憫的，有基多尼的兒子亞比但；
english: From Benjamin, Abidan, the son of Gideoni;

chinese: 屬但的，有亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝；
english: From Dan, Ahiezer, the son of Ammi-shaddai;

chinese: 屬亞設的，有俄蘭的兒子帕結；
english: From Asher, Pagiel, the son of Ochran;

chinese: 屬迦得的，有丟珥的兒子以利雅薩；
english: From Gad, Eliasaph, the son of Reuel;

chinese: 屬拿弗他利的，有以南的兒子亞希拉。
english: From Naphtali, Ahira, the son of Enan.

chinese: 這都是從會中選召的，各作本支派的首領，都是以色列軍中的統領。
english: These are the men named out of all the people, chiefs of their fathers' houses, heads of the tribes of Israel.

chinese: 於是，摩西、亞倫帶著這些按名指定的人，
english: And Moses and Aaron took these men, marked out by name;

chinese: 當二月初一日招聚全會眾。會眾就照他們的家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外的，都述說自己的家譜。
english: And they got together all the people on the first day of the second month; and everyone made clear his family and his father's house, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and over.

chinese: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，他就怎樣在西乃的曠野數點他們。
english: As the Lord had given orders to Moses, so they were numbered by him in the waste place of Sinai.

chinese: 以色列的長子，流便子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的男丁，共有四萬六千五百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over, who was able to go to war;
Forty-six thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Reuben were numbered.

chinese: 西緬子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的男丁，共有五萬九千三百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Simeon were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over, who was able to go to war;
Fifty-nine thousand, three hundred of the tribe of Simeon were numbered.

chinese: 迦得子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名。
english: The generations of the sons of Gad were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty of the tribe of Gad were numbered.

chinese: 猶大子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Judah were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Seventy-four thousand, six hundred of the tribe of Judah were numbered.

chinese: 以薩迦子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Issachar were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Fifty-four thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Issachar were numbered.

chinese: 西布倫子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Zebulun were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Fifty-seven thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Zebulun were numbered.

chinese: 約瑟子孫屬以法蓮子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Joseph were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Forty thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Ephraim were numbered.

chinese: 瑪拿西子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Manasseh were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Thirty-two thousand, two hundred of the tribe of Manasseh were numbered.

chinese: 便雅憫子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Benjamin were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Thirty-five thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Benjamin were numbered.

chinese: 但子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗，被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Dan were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years and over who was able to go to war;
Sixty-two thousand, seven hundred of the tribe of Dan were numbered.

chinese: 亞設子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Asher were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Forty-one thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Asher were numbered.

chinese: 拿弗他利子孫的後代，照著家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
english: The generations of the sons of Naphtali were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
Fifty-three thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Naphtali were numbered.

chinese: 這些就是被數點的，是摩西、亞倫，和以色列中十二個首領所數點的；這十二個人各作各宗族的代表。
english: These are they who were numbered by Moses and Aaron and by the twelve chiefs of Israel, one from every tribe.

chinese: 這樣，凡以色列人中被數的，照著宗族，從二十歲以外，能出去打仗、被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。
english: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel, by their families, all those of twenty years old and over who were able to go to war,
Were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

chinese: 利未人卻沒有按著支派數在其中，
english: But the Levites, of the tribe of their fathers, were not numbered among them.

chinese: 因為耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: For the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 惟獨利未支派你不可數點，也不可在以色列人中計算他們的總數。
english: Only the tribe of Levi is not to be numbered among the children of Israel,

chinese: 只要派利未人管法櫃的帳幕和其中的器具，並屬乎帳幕的；他們要抬帳幕和其中的器具，（抬或作：搬運）並要辦理帳幕的事，在帳幕的四圍安營。
english: But to them you are to give the care of the Tent of meeting with its vessels and everything in it: they are to take up the Tent, and be responsible for everything to do with it, and put up their tents round it.

chinese: 帳幕將往前行的時候，利未人要拆卸；將支搭的時候，利未人要豎起。近前來的外人必被治死。
english: And when the Tent of meeting goes forward, the Levites are to take it down; and when it is to be put up, they are to do it: any strange person who comes near it is to be put to death.

chinese: 以色列人支搭帳棚，要照他們的軍隊，各歸本營，各歸本纛。
english: The children of Israel are to put up their tents, every man in his tent-circle round his flag.

chinese: 但利未人要在法櫃帳幕的四圍安營，免得忿怒臨到以色列會眾；利未人並要謹守法櫃的帳幕。
english: But the tents of the Levites are to be round the Tent of meeting, so that wrath may not come on the children of Israel: the Tent of meeting is to be in the care of the Levites.

chinese: 以色列人就這樣行。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，他們就照樣行了。
english: So the children of Israel did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 以色列人要各歸自己的纛下，在本族的旗號那裡，對著會幕的四圍安營。
english: The children of Israel are to put up their tents in the order of their families, by the flags of their fathers' houses, facing the Tent of meeting on every side.

chinese: 在東邊，向日出之地，照著軍隊安營的是猶大營的纛。有亞米拿達的兒子拿順作猶大人的首領。
english: Those whose tents are on the east side, looking to the dawn, will be round the flag of the children of Judah, with Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。
english: The number of his army was seventy-four thousand, six hundred.

chinese: 挨著他安營的是以薩迦支派。有蘇押的兒子拿坦業作以薩迦人的首領。
english: And nearest to him will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel, the son of Zuar, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。
english: The number of his army was fifty-four thousand, four hundred.

chinese: 又有西布倫支派。希倫的兒子以利押作西布倫人的首領。
english: After him, the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab, the son of Helon, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。
english: The number of his army was fifty-seven thousand, four hundred.

chinese: 凡屬猶大營、按著軍隊被數的，共有十八萬六千四百名，要作第一隊往前行。
english: The number of all the armies of Judah was a hundred and eighty-six thousand, four hundred. They go forward first.

chinese: 在南邊，按著軍隊是流便營的纛。有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿作流便人的首領。
english: On the south side is the flag of the children of Reuben, in the order of their armies, with Elizur, the son of Shedeur, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬六千五百名。
english: The number of his army was forty-six thousand, five hundred.

chinese: 挨著他安營的是西緬支派。蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑作西緬人的首領。
english: And nearest to him, the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬九千三百名。
english: The number of his army was fifty-nine thousand, three hundred.

chinese: 又有迦得支派。丟珥的兒子以利雅薩作迦得人的首領。
english: Then the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph, son of Reuel, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名，
english: The number of his army was forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty.

chinese: 凡屬流便營、按著軍隊被數的，共有十五萬一千四百五十名，要作第二隊往前行。
english: The number of all the armies of Reuben together came to a hundred and fifty-one thousand, four hundred and fifty. They go forward second.

chinese: 隨後，會幕要往前行，有利未營在諸營中間。他們怎樣安營就怎樣往前行，各按本位，各歸本纛。
english: Then the Tent of meeting is to go forward, with the tents of the Levites, in the middle of the armies; in the same order as their tents are placed, they are to go forward, every man under his flag.

chinese: 在西邊，按著軍隊是以法蓮營的纛。亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪作以法蓮人的首領。
english: On the west side will be the flag of the children of Ephraim, with Elishama, the son of Ammihud, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
english: The number of his army was forty thousand, five hundred.

chinese: 挨著他的是瑪拿西支派。比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列作瑪拿西人的首領。
english: And by him the tribe of Manasseh with Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。
english: The number of his army was thirty-two thousand, two hundred.

chinese: 又有便雅憫支派。基多尼的兒子亞比但作便雅憫人的首領。
english: Then the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan, the son of Gideoni, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。
english: The number of his army was thirty-five thousand, four hundred.

chinese: 凡屬以法蓮營、按著軍隊被數的，共有十萬零八千一百名，要作第三隊往前行。
english: The number of all the armies of Ephraim was a hundred and eight thousand, one hundred. They go forward third.

chinese: 在北邊，按著軍隊是但營的纛。亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝作但人的首領。
english: On the north side will be the flag of the children of Dan, with Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。
english: The number of his army was sixty-two thousand, seven hundred.

chinese: 挨著他安營的是亞設支派。俄蘭的兒子帕結作亞設人的首領。
english: Nearest to him will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel, the son of Ochran, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。
english: The number of his army was forty-one thousand, five hundred;

chinese: 又有拿弗他利支派。以南的兒子亞希拉作拿弗他利人的首領。
english: Then the tribe of Naphtali, with Ahira, the son of Enan, as their chief.

chinese: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
english: The number of his army was fifty-three thousand, four hundred.

chinese: 凡但營被數的，共有十五萬七千六百名，要歸本纛作末隊往前行。
english: The number of all the armies in the tents of Dan was a hundred and fifty-seven thousand, six hundred. They will go forward last, by their flags.

chinese: 這些以色列人，照他們的宗族，按他們的軍隊，在諸營中被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。
english: These are all who were numbered of the children of Israel, in the order of their fathers' families: all the armies in their tents together came to six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

chinese: 惟獨利未人沒有數在以色列人中，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, as the Lord said to Moses.

chinese: 以色列人就這樣行，各人照他們的家室、宗族歸於本纛，安營起行，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: So the children of Israel did as the Lord said to Moses, so they put up their tents by their flags, and they went forward in the same order, by their families, and by their fathers' houses.

chinese: 耶和華在西乃山曉諭摩西的日子，亞倫和摩西的後代如下：
english: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses, in the day when the word of the Lord came to Moses on Mount Sinai.

chinese: 亞倫的兒子，長子名叫拿答，還有亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the oldest, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

chinese: 這是亞倫兒子的名字，都是受膏的祭司，是摩西叫他們承接聖職供祭司職分的。
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests, on whom the holy oil was put, who were marked out as priests.

chinese: 拿答、亞比戶在西乃的曠野向耶和華獻凡火的時候就死在耶和華面前了。他們也沒有兒子。以利亞撒、以他瑪在他們的父親亞倫面前供祭司的職分。
english: And Nadab and Abihu were put to death before the Lord when they made an offering of strange fire before the Lord, in the waste land of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar did the work of priests before Aaron their father.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你使利未支派近前來，站在祭司亞倫面前好服事他，
english: Make the tribe of Levi come near, and put them before Aaron the priest, to be his helpers,

chinese: 替他和會眾在會幕前守所吩咐的，辦理帳幕的事。
english: In order that they may be responsible to him and to all Israel for the care of the Tent of meeting, and to do the work of the House;

chinese: 又要看守會幕的器具，並守所吩咐以色列人的，辦理帳幕的事。
english: And they will have the care of all the vessels of the Tent of meeting, and will do for the children of Israel all the necessary work of the House.

chinese: 你要將利未人給亞倫和他的兒子，因為他們是從以色列人中選出來給他的。
english: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; so that they may be his without question from among the children of Israel.

chinese: 你要囑咐亞倫和他的兒子謹守自己祭司的職任。近前來的外人必被治死。
english: And give orders that Aaron and his sons are to keep their place as priests; any strange person who comes near is to be put to death.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 我從以色列人中揀選了利未人，代替以色列人一切頭生的；利未人要歸我。
english: See, I have taken the Levites out of the children of Israel to be mine in place of the first sons of the children of Israel;

chinese: 因為凡頭生的是我的；我在埃及地擊殺一切頭生的那日就把以色列中一切頭生的，連人帶牲畜都分別為聖歸我；他們定要屬我。我是耶和華。
english: For all the first sons are mine; on the day when I put to death all the first sons in the land of Egypt, I took for myself every first male birth of man and beast. They are mine; I am the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華在西乃的曠野曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses in the waste land of Sinai,

chinese: 你要照利未人的宗族、家室數點他們。凡一個月以外的男子都要數點。
english: Let all the children of Levi be numbered by their families and their fathers' houses; let every male of a month old and over be numbered.

chinese: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的數點他們。
english: So Moses did as the Lord said, numbering them as he had been ordered.

chinese: 利未眾子的名字是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
english: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon and Kohath and Merari.

chinese: 革順的兒子，按著家室，是立尼、示每。
english: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon, by their families: Libni and Shimei.

chinese: 哥轄的兒子，按著家室，是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
english: And the sons of Kohath, by their families: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel.

chinese: 米拉利的兒子，按著家室，是抹利、母示。這些按著宗族是利未人的家室。
english: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites in the order of their fathers' houses.

chinese: 屬革順的，有立尼族、示每族。這是革順的二族。
english: From Gershon come the Libnites and the Shimeites; these are the families of the Gershonites.

chinese: 其中被數、從一個月以外所有的男子共有七千五百名。
english: Those who were numbered of them, the males from one month old and over, were seven thousand, five hundred.

chinese: 這革順的二族要在帳幕後西邊安營。
english: The tents of the Gershonites are to be placed at the back of the House, to the west.

chinese: 拉伊勒的兒子以利雅薩作革順人宗族的首領。
english: The chief of the Gershonites is Eliasaph, the son of Lael.

chinese: 革順的子孫在會幕中所要看守的，就是帳幕和罩棚，並罩棚的蓋與會幕的門簾，
english: In the Tent of meeting, the Gershonites are to have the care of the House, and the Tent with its cover, and the veil for the door of the Tent of meeting,

chinese: 院子的帷子和門簾（院子是圍帳幕和壇的），並一切使用的繩子。
english: And the hangings for the open space round the House and the altar, and the curtain for its doorway, and all the cords needed for its use.

chinese: 屬哥轄的，有暗蘭族、以斯哈族、希伯倫族、烏薛族。這是哥轄的諸族。
english: From Kohath come the Amramites and the Izharites and the Hebronites and the Uzzielites; these are the families of the Kohathites.

chinese: 按所有男子的數目，從一個月以外看守聖所的，共有八千六百名。
english: Those who were numbered of them, the males from one month old and over, were eight thousand, six hundred, who were responsible for the care of the holy place.

chinese: 哥轄兒子的諸族要在帳幕的南邊安營。
english: The tents of the Kohathites are to be placed on the south side of the House.

chinese: 烏薛的兒子以利撒反作哥轄宗族家室的首領。
english: Their chief is Elizaphan, the son of Uzziel.

chinese: 他們所要看守的是約櫃、桌子、燈臺、兩座壇與聖所內使用的器皿，並簾子和一切使用之物。
english: In their care are the ark, and the table, and the lights, and the altars, and all the vessels used in the holy place, and the veil, and all they are used for.

chinese: 祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒作利未人眾首領的領袖，要監察那些看守聖所的人。
english: Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, will be head over all the Levites and overseer of those responsible for the care of the holy place.

chinese: 屬米拉利的，有抹利族、母示族。這是米拉利的二族。
english: From Merari come the Mahlites and the Mushites; these are the families of Merari.

chinese: 他們被數的，按所有男子的數目，從一個月以外的，共有六千二百名。
english: Those who were numbered of them, the males of a month old and over, were six thousand, two hundred.

chinese: 亞比亥的兒子蘇列作米拉利二宗族的首領。他們要在帳幕的北邊安營。
english: The chief of the families of Merari was Zuriel, the son of Abihail: their tents are to be placed on the north side of the House.

chinese: 米拉利子孫的職分是看守帳幕的板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，和帳幕一切所使用的器具，
english: And in their care are to be all the boards of the Tent, with their rods and pillars and bases, and all the instruments, and all they are used for,

chinese: 院子四圍的柱子、帶卯的座、橛子，和繩子。
english: And the pillars of the open space round it, with their bases and nails and cords.

chinese: 在帳幕前東邊，向日出之地安營的是摩西、亞倫，和亞倫的兒子。他們看守聖所，替以色列人守耶和華所吩咐的。近前來的外人必被治死。
english: And those whose tents are to be placed on the east side of the House in front of the Tent of meeting, looking to the dawn, are Moses and Aaron and his sons, who will do the work of the holy place for the children of Israel; and any strange person who comes near will be put to death.

chinese: 凡被數的利未人，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華吩咐所數的，按著家室，從一個月以外的男子，共有二萬二千名。
english: All the Levites numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord, all the males of one month old and over numbered in the order of their families, were twenty-two thousand.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你要從以色列人中數點一個月以外、凡頭生的男子，把他們的名字記下。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Let all the first male children be numbered, and take the number of their names.

chinese: 我是耶和華。你要揀選利未人歸我，代替以色列人所有頭生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列所有頭生的牲畜。
english: And give to me the Levites (I am the Lord) in place of the first sons of the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites in place of the first births among the cattle of the children of Israel.

chinese: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的把以色列人頭生的都數點了。
english: So Moses had all the first sons among the children of Israel numbered, as the Lord said to him.

chinese: 按人名的數目，從一個月以外、凡頭生的男子，共有二萬二千二百七十三名。
english: Every first son from a month old and over was numbered by name, and the number came to twenty-two thousand, two hundred and seventy-three.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你揀選利未人代替以色列人所有頭生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列人的牲畜。利未人要歸我；我是耶和華。
english: Take the Levites in place of all the first sons of the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites in place of their cattle; the Levites are to be mine; I am the Lord.

chinese: 以色列人中頭生的男子比利未人多二百七十三個，必當將他們贖出來。
english: And the price you have to give for the two hundred and seventy-three first sons of the children of Israel which are in addition to the number of the Levites,

chinese: 你要按人丁，照聖所的平，每人取贖銀五舍客勒（一舍客勒是二十季拉），
english: Will be five shekels for every one, by the scale of the holy place (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

chinese: 把那多餘之人的贖銀交給亞倫和他的兒子。
english: And this money, the price of those over the number of the Levites, is to be given to Aaron and his sons.

chinese: 於是摩西從那被利未人所贖以外的人取了贖銀。
english: So Moses took the money, the price of those whose place had not been taken by the Levites;

chinese: 從以色列人頭生的所取之銀，按聖所的平，有一千三百六十五舍客勒。
english: From the first sons of Israel he took it, a thousand, three hundred and sixty-five shekels, by the scale of the holy place;

chinese: 摩西照耶和華的話把這贖銀給亞倫和他的兒子，正如耶和華所吩咐的。
english: And he gave the money to Aaron and his sons, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 你從利未人中，將哥轄子孫的總數，照他們的家室、宗族，
english: Let the sons of Kohath, from among the sons of Levi, be numbered by their families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

chinese: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裡辦事的，全都計算。
english: All those from thirty to fifty years old who are able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 哥轄子孫在會幕搬運至聖之物，所辦的事乃是這樣：
english: And this is to be the work of the sons of Kohath in connection with the most holy things.

chinese: 起營的時候，亞倫和他兒子要進去摘下遮掩櫃的幔子，用以蒙蓋法櫃，
english: When all the people go forward, Aaron is to go in with his sons, and take down the veil of the curtain, covering the ark of witness with it;

chinese: 又用海狗皮蓋在上頭，再蒙上純藍色的毯子，把杠穿上。
english: And putting over it the leather cover and over that a blue cloth; and putting its rods in place.

chinese: 又用藍色毯子鋪在陳設餅的桌子上，將盤子、調羹、奠酒的爵，和杯擺在上頭。桌子上也必有常設的餅。
english: And on the table of the holy bread they are to put a blue cloth, and on it all the vessels, the spoons and the basins and the cups; and the holy bread with them;

chinese: 在其上又要蒙朱紅色的毯子，再蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
english: And over them they are to put a red cloth, covering it with a leather cover, and putting its rods in their places.

chinese: 要拿藍色毯子，把燈臺和燈臺上所用的燈盞、剪子、蠟花盤，並一切盛油的器皿，全都遮蓋。
english: And they are to take a blue cloth, covering with it the light-support with its lights and its instruments and its trays and all the oil vessels which are used for it:

chinese: 又要把燈臺和燈臺的一切器具包在海狗皮裡，放在抬架上。
english: All these they are to put in a leather cover, and put it on the frame.

chinese: 在金壇上要鋪藍色毯子，蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
english: On the gold altar they are to put a blue cloth, covering it with a leather cover; and they are to put its rods in their places.

chinese: 又要把聖所用的一切器具包在藍色毯子裡，用海狗皮蒙上，放在抬架上。
english: All the vessels which are used in the holy place they are to put in a blue cloth, covering them with a leather cover, and put them on the frame.

chinese: 要收去壇上的灰，把紫色毯子鋪在壇上；
english: And they are to take away the burned waste from the altar, and put a purple cloth on it;

chinese: 又要把所用的一切器具，就是火鼎、肉鍤子、鏟子、盤子，一切屬壇的器具都擺在壇上，又蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
english: Placing on the cloth all its vessels, the fire-baskets, the meat-hooks, the spades, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; they are to put a leather cover over all these, and put its rods in their places.

chinese: 將要起營的時候，亞倫和他兒子把聖所和聖所的一切器具遮蓋完了，哥轄的子孫就要來抬，只是不可摸聖物，免得他們死亡。會幕裡這些物件是哥轄子孫所當抬的。
english: And after the holy place and all its vessels have been covered up by Aaron and his sons, when the tents of the people go forward, the sons of Kohath are to come and take it up; but the holy things may not be touched by them for fear of death.

chinese: 祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒所要看守的是點燈的油與香料，並當獻的素祭和膏油，也要看守全帳幕與其中所有的，並聖所和聖所的器具。
english: And Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, is to be responsible for the oil for the light, and the sweet perfumes for burning, and the regular meal offering, and the holy oil; the House and the holy place and everything in it will be in his care.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 你們不可將哥轄人的支派從利未人中剪除。
english: Do not let the family of the Kohathites be cut off from among the Levites;

chinese: 他們挨近至聖物的時候，亞倫和他兒子要進去派他們各人所當辦的，所當抬的。這樣待他們，好使他們活著，不至死亡。
english: But do this to them, so that life and not death may be theirs when they come near the most holy things; let Aaron and his sons go in and give to every one his work and that which he is to take up;

chinese: 只是他們連片時不可進去觀看聖所，免得他們死亡。
english: But they themselves are not to go in to see the holy place, even for a minute, for fear of death.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要將革順子孫的總數，照著宗族、家室，
english: Let the sons of Gershon be numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

chinese: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裡辦事的，全都數點。
english: All those from thirty to fifty years old who are able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 革順人各族所辦的事、所抬的物乃是這樣：
english: This is to be the work of the Gershonites, the things they are to do and take up.

chinese: 他們要抬帳幕的幔子和會幕，並會幕的蓋與其上的海狗皮，和會幕的門簾，
english: They are to take up the curtains of the House, and the Tent of meeting with its cover and the leather cover over it, and the hangings for the door of the Tent of meeting;

chinese: 院子的帷子和門簾（院子是圍帳幕和壇的）、繩子，並所用的器具，不論是做甚麼用的，他們都要經理。
english: And the hangings for the open space round the House and the altar, and the curtain for its doorway, with the cords and all the things used for them; whatever is necessary for these, they are to do.

chinese: 革順的子孫在一切抬物辦事之上都要憑亞倫和他兒子的吩咐；他們所當抬的，要派他們看守。
english: From the mouth of Aaron and his sons the Gershonites will have word about all the things they are to do and take up; you are to give them their orders.

chinese: 這是革順子孫的各族在會幕裡所辦的事；他們所看守的，必在祭司亞倫兒子以他瑪的手下。
english: This is the work of the family of the Gershonites in the Tent of meeting, and they will be under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

chinese: 至於米拉利的子孫，你要照著家室、宗族把他們數點。
english: The sons of Merari are to be numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

chinese: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裡辦事的，你都要數點。
english: Every one from thirty to fifty years old who is able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 他們辦理會幕的事，就是抬帳幕的板、閂、柱子，和帶卯的座，
english: And this is their part in the work of the Tent of meeting: the transport of the boards and the rods of the Tent, with the pillars and their bases;

chinese: 院子四圍的柱子和其上帶卯的座、橛子、繩子，並一切使用的器具。他們所抬的器具，你們要按名指定。
english: And the pillars of the open space outside it, with their bases and their nails and cords and all the instruments used, and everything which has to be done there; all the instruments for which they are responsible are to be numbered by name.

chinese: 這是米拉利子孫各族在會幕裡所辦的事，都在祭司亞倫兒子以他瑪的手下。
english: This is the work which the sons of Merari are to do in connection with the Tent of meeting, under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫與會眾的諸首領將哥轄的子孫，照著家室、宗族，
english: So Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the people took in hand the numbering of the sons of the Kohathites, by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

chinese: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裡辦事的，都數點了。
english: Numbering all those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work in the Tent of meeting;

chinese: 被數的共有二千七百五十名。
english: And the number of all these was two thousand, seven hundred and fifty.

chinese: 這是哥轄各族中被數的，是在會幕裡辦事的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
english: This is the number of those of the Kohathites who did the work in the Tent of meeting, as they were numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

chinese: 革順子孫被數的，照著家室、宗族，
english: And those of the sons of Gershon who were numbered by families,

chinese: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裡辦事的，共有二千六百三十名。
english: All those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work in the Tent of meeting,
Who were numbered by families in the order of their fathers' houses, were two thousand, six hundred and thirty.

chinese: 這是革順子孫各族中被數的，是在會幕裡辦事的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
english: This is the number of the sons of Gershon who did the work in the Tent of meeting, as they were numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

chinese: 米拉利子孫中各族被數的，照著家室、宗族，
english: And those of the sons of Merari who were numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses,

chinese: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裡辦事的，共有三千二百名。
english: All those from thirty to fifty years old who did the work in the Tent of meeting,
Who were numbered by families, were three thousand, two hundred.

chinese: 這是米拉利子孫各族中被數的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
english: This is the number of the sons of Merari, numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

chinese: 凡被數的利未人，就是摩西、亞倫並以色列眾首領，照著家室、宗族所數點的，
english: And all the Levites who were numbered by Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the people, by families, in the order of their fathers' houses,

chinese: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裡做抬物之工的，共有八千五百八十名。
english: Those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work of the Tent of meeting and of its transport,
Came to eight thousand, five hundred and eighty.

chinese: 摩西按他們所辦的事、所抬的物，憑耶和華的吩咐數點他們；他們這樣被摩西數點，正如耶和華所吩咐他的。
english: At the order of the Lord they were numbered by Moses, every one in relation to his work and to his part in the transport; so they were numbered by Moses at the order of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐以色列人，使一切長大痲瘋的，患漏症的，並因死屍不潔淨的，都出營外去。
english: Give orders to the children of Israel to put outside the tent-circle every leper, and anyone who has any sort of flow from his body, and anyone who is unclean from the touch of the dead;

chinese: 無論男女都要使他們出到營外，免得污穢他們的營；這營是我所住的。
english: Male or female they are to be put outside the tent-circle, so that they may not make unclean my resting-place among them.

chinese: 以色列人就這樣行，使他們出到營外。耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎樣行了。
english: So the children of Israel did as the Lord had said to Moses, and put them outside the tent-circle.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：無論男女，若犯了人所常犯的罪，以至干犯耶和華，那人就有了罪。
english: Say to the children of Israel, If a man or a woman does any of the sins of men, going against the word of the Lord, and is in the wrong;

chinese: 他要承認所犯的罪，將所虧負人的，如數賠還，另外加上五分之一，也歸與所虧負的人。
english: Let them say openly what they have done; and make payment for the wrong done, with the addition of a fifth part, and give it to him to whom the wrong was done.

chinese: 那人若沒有親屬可受所賠還的，那所賠還的就要歸與服事耶和華的祭司；至於那為他贖罪的公羊是在外。
english: But if the man has no relation to whom the payment may be made, then the payment for sin made to the Lord will be the priest's, in addition to the sheep offered to take away his sin.

chinese: 以色列人一切的聖物中，所奉給祭司的舉祭都要歸與祭司。
english: And every offering lifted up of all the holy things which the children of Israel give to the priest, will be his.

chinese: 各人所分別為聖的物，無論是甚麼，都要歸給祭司。
english: And every man's holy things will be his: whatever a man gives to the priest will be his.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：人的妻若有邪行，得罪他丈夫，
english: Say to the children of Israel, If any man's wife does wrong, sinning against him

chinese: 有人與他行淫，事情嚴密，瞞過他丈夫，而且他被玷污，沒有作見證的人，當他行淫的時候也沒有被捉住，
english: By taking as her lover another man, and keeps it secret so that her husband has no knowledge of it, and there is no witness against her, and she is not taken in the act;

chinese: 他丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨他，他是被玷污，或是他丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨他，他並沒有被玷污，
english: If the spirit of doubt comes into her husband's heart, and he has doubts of his wife, with good cause; or if he has doubts of her without cause:

chinese: 這人就要將妻送到祭司那裡，又為他帶著大麥麵伊法十分之一作供物，不可澆上油，也不可加上乳香；因為這是疑恨的素祭，是思念的素祭，使人思念罪孽。
english: Then let him take her to the priest, offering for her the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal, without oil or perfume; for it is a meal offering of a bitter spirit, a meal offering keeping wrongdoing in mind.

chinese: 祭司要使那婦人近前來，站在耶和華面前。
english: And the priest will make her come near and put her before the Lord;

chinese: 祭司要把聖水盛在瓦器裡，又從帳幕的地上取點塵土，放在水中。
english: And the priest will take holy water in a pot and put in it dust from the floor of the House;

chinese: 祭司要叫那婦人蓬頭散髮，站在耶和華面前，把思念的素祭，就是疑恨的素祭，放在他手中。祭司手裡拿著致咒詛的苦水，
english: And he will make the woman come before the Lord with her hair loose, and will put the meal offering, the offering of a bitter spirit, in her hands; and the priest will take in his hand the bitter water causing the curse;

chinese: 要叫婦人起誓，對他說：若沒有人與你行淫，也未曾背著丈夫做污穢的事，你就免受這致咒詛苦水的災。
english: And he will make her take an oath, and say to her, If no man has been your lover and you have not been with another in place of your husband, you are free from this bitter water causing the curse;

chinese: 你若背著丈夫行了污穢的事，在你丈夫以外有人與你行淫，
english: But if you have been with another in place of your husband and have made yourself unclean with a lover:

chinese: （祭司叫婦人發咒起誓），願耶和華叫你大腿消瘦，肚腹發脹，使你在你民中被人咒詛，成了誓語；
english: Then the priest will put the oath of the curse on the woman, and say to her, May the Lord make you a curse and an oath among your people, sending on you wasting of the legs and disease of the stomach;

chinese: 並且這致咒詛的水入你的腸中，要叫你的肚腹發脹，大腿消瘦。婦人要回答說：阿們，阿們。
english: And this water of the curse will go into your body, causing disease of your stomach and wasting of your legs: and the woman will say, So be it.

chinese: 祭司要寫這咒詛的話，將所寫的字抹在苦水裡，
english: And the priest will put these curses in a book, washing out the writing with the bitter water;

chinese: 又叫婦人喝這致咒詛的苦水；這水要進入他裡面變苦了。
english: And he will give to the woman the bitter water for drink; and the bitter water causing the curse will go into her.

chinese: 祭司要從婦人的手中取那疑恨的素祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，拿到壇前；
english: And the priest will take from her hand the meal offering of doubt, waving it before the Lord, and will take it to the altar;

chinese: 又要從素祭中取出一把，作為這事的紀念，燒在壇上，然後叫婦人喝這水。
english: And he will take some of it in his hand, burning it on the altar as a sign, and then he will give the woman the bitter water.

chinese: 叫他喝了以後，他若被玷污，得罪了丈夫，這致咒詛的水必進入他裡面變苦了，他的肚腹就要發脹，大腿就要消瘦，那婦人便要在他民中被人咒詛。
english: And it will be that if the woman has become unclean, sinning against her husband, when she has taken the bitter water it will go into her body, causing disease of the stomach and wasting of the legs, and she will be a curse among her people.

chinese: 若婦人沒有被玷污，卻是清潔的，就要免受這災，且要懷孕。
english: But if she is clean she will be free and will have offspring.

chinese: 妻子背著丈夫行了污穢的事，
english: This is the law for testing a wife who goes with another in place of her husband and becomes unclean;

chinese: 或是人生了疑恨的心，疑恨他的妻，就有這疑恨的條例。那時他要叫婦人站在耶和華面前，祭司要在他身上照這條例而行。
english: Or for a husband who, in a bitter spirit, has doubts in his heart about his wife; let him take her to the priest, who will put in force this law.

chinese: 男人就為無罪，婦人必擔當自己的罪孽。
english: Then the man will be free from all wrong, and the woman's sin will be on her.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：無論男女許了特別的願，就是拿細耳人的願（拿細耳就是歸主的意思；下同），要離俗歸耶和華。
english: Say to the children of Israel, If a man or a woman takes an oath to keep himself separate and give himself to the Lord;

chinese: 他就要遠離清酒濃酒，也不可喝甚麼清酒濃酒做的醋；不可喝甚麼葡萄汁，也不可吃鮮葡萄和乾葡萄。
english: He is to keep himself from wine and strong drink, and take no mixed wine or strong drink or any drink made from grapes, or any grapes, green or dry.

chinese: 在一切離俗的日子，凡葡萄樹上結的，自核至皮所做的物，都不可吃。
english: All the time he is separate he may take nothing made from the grape-vine, from its seeds to its skin.

chinese: 在他一切許願離俗的日子，不可用剃頭刀剃頭，要由髮綹長長了。他要聖潔，直到離俗歸耶和華的日子滿了。
english: All the time he is under his oath let no blade come near his head; till the days while he is separate are ended he is holy and his hair may not be cut.

chinese: 在他離俗歸耶和華的一切日子，不可挨近死屍。
english: All the time he is separate he may not come near any dead body.

chinese: 他的父母或是弟兄姊妹死了的時候，他不可因他們使自己不潔淨，因為那離俗歸神的憑據是在他頭上。
english: He may not make himself unclean for his father or his mother, his sister or his brother, if death comes to them; because he is under an oath to keep himself separate for God.

chinese: 在他一切離俗的日子是歸耶和華為聖。
english: All the time he is separate he is holy to the Lord.

chinese: 若在他旁邊忽然有人死了，以至沾染了他離俗的頭，他要在第七日，得潔淨的時候，剃頭。
english: If death comes suddenly to a man at his side, so that he becomes unclean, let his hair be cut off on the day when he is made clean, on the seventh day.

chinese: 第八日，他要把兩隻斑鳩或兩隻雛鴿帶到會幕門口，交給祭司。
english: And on the eighth day let him take to the priest, at the door of the Tent of meeting, two doves or two young pigeons;

chinese: 祭司要獻一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭，為他贖那因死屍而有的罪，並要當日使他的頭成為聖潔。
english: And the priest will give one for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering to take away the sin which came on him on account of the dead, and he will make his head holy that same day.

chinese: 他要另選離俗歸耶和華的日子，又要牽一隻一歲的公羊羔來作贖愆祭；但先前的日子要歸徒然，因為他在離俗之間被玷污了。
english: And he will give to the Lord his days of being separate, offering a he-lamb of the first year as an offering for error: but the earlier days will be a loss, because he became unclean.

chinese: 拿細耳人滿了離俗的日子乃有這條例：人要領他到會幕門口，
english: And this is the law for him who is separate, when the necessary days are ended: he is to come to the door of the Tent of meeting,

chinese: 他要將供物奉給耶和華，就是一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔作燔祭，一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的母羊羔作贖罪祭，和一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊作平安祭，
english: And make his offering to the Lord; one he-lamb of the first year, without a mark, for a burned offering, and one female lamb of the first year, without a mark, for a sin-offering, and one male sheep, without a mark, for peace-offerings,

chinese: 並一筐子無酵調油的細麵餅，與抹油的無酵薄餅，並同獻的素祭和奠祭。
english: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of the best meal mixed with oil, and thin unleavened cakes covered with oil, with their meal offering and drink offerings.

chinese: 祭司要在耶和華面前獻那人的贖罪祭和燔祭；
english: And the priest will take them before the Lord, and make his sin-offering and his burned offering;

chinese: 也要把那隻公羊和那筐無酵餅獻給耶和華作平安祭，又要將同獻的素祭和奠祭獻上。
english: Giving the sheep of the peace-offerings, with the basket of unleavened bread; and at the same time, the priest will make his meal offering and his drink offering.

chinese: 拿細耳人要在會幕門口剃離俗的頭，把離俗頭上的髮放在平安祭下的火上。
english: Then let his long hair, the sign of his oath, be cut off at the door of the Tent of meeting, and let him put it on the fire on which the peace-offerings are burning.

chinese: 他剃了以後，祭司就要取那已煮的公羊一條前腿，又從筐子裡取一個無酵餅和一個無酵薄餅，都放在他手上。
english: And the priest will take the cooked leg of the sheep and one unleavened cake and one thin cake out of the basket, and put them on the hands of the separate one after his hair has been cut,

chinese: 祭司要拿這些作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這與所搖的胸、所舉的腿同為聖物，歸給祭司。然後拿細耳人可以喝酒。
english: Waving them for a wave offering before the Lord; this is holy for the priest, together with the waved breast and the leg which is lifted up; after that, the man may take wine.

chinese: 許願的拿細耳人為離俗所獻的供物，和他以外所能得的獻給耶和華，就有這條例。他怎樣許願就當照離俗的條例行。
english: This is the law for him who takes an oath to keep himself separate, and for his offering to the Lord on that account, in addition to what he may be able to get; this is the law of his oath, which he will have to keep.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你告訴亞倫和他兒子說：你們要這樣為以色列人祝福，說：
english: Say to Aaron and his sons, These are the words of blessing which are to be used by you in blessing the children of Israel; say to them,

chinese: 願耶和華賜福給你，保護你。
english: May the Lord send his blessing on you and keep you:

chinese: 願耶和華使他的臉光照你，賜恩給你。
english: May the light of the Lord's face be shining on you in grace:

chinese: 願耶和華向你仰臉，賜你平安。
english: May the Lord's approval be resting on you and may he give you peace.

chinese: 他們要如此奉我的名為以色列人祝福；我也要賜福給他們。
english: So they will put my name on the children of Israel, and I will give them my blessing.

chinese: 摩西立完了帳幕，就把帳幕用膏抹了，使他成聖，又把其中的器具和壇，並壇上的器具，都抹了，使他成聖。
english: And when Moses had put up the House completely, and had put oil on it and made it holy, with all the things in it, and had made the altar and all its vessels holy with oil;

chinese: 當天，以色列的眾首領，就是各族的族長，都來奉獻。他們是各支派的首領，管理那些被數的人。
english: Then the chiefs of Israel, the heads of their fathers' houses, made offerings; these were the chiefs of the tribes, who were over those who were numbered.

chinese: 他們把自己的供物送到耶和華面前，就是六輛篷子車和十二隻公牛。每兩個首領奉獻一輛車，每首領奉獻一隻牛。他們把這些都奉到帳幕前。
english: And they came with their offerings before the Lord, six covered carts and twelve oxen; a cart for every two of the chiefs, and for every one an ox.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要收下這些，好作會幕的使用，都要照利未人所辦的事交給他們。
english: Take the things from them, to be used for the work of the Tent of meeting; and give them to the Levites, to every man what is needed for his work.

chinese: 於是摩西收了車和牛，交給利未人，
english: So Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.

chinese: 把兩輛車，四隻牛，照革順子孫所辦的事交給他們，
english: Two carts and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon for their work;

chinese: 又把四輛車，八隻牛，照米拉利子孫所辦的事交給他們；他們都在祭司亞倫的兒子以他瑪手下。
english: And four carts and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari for their work, under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

chinese: 但車與牛都沒有交給哥轄子孫；因為他們辦的是聖所的事，在肩頭上抬聖物。
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave nothing; because they had the care of the holy place, taking it about on their backs.

chinese: 用膏抹壇的日子，首領都來行奉獻壇的禮，眾首領就在壇前獻供物。
english: And the chiefs gave an offering for the altar on the day when the holy oil was put on it; they made their offering before the altar.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：眾首領為行奉獻壇的禮，要每天一個首領來獻供物。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Let every chief on his day give his offering to make the altar holy.

chinese: 頭一日獻供物的是猶大支派的亞米拿達的兒子拿順。

english: And for the peace-offerings, two oxen, five male sheep, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.

chinese: 用膏抹壇的日子，以色列的眾首領為行獻壇之禮所獻的是：銀盤子十二個，銀碗十二個，金盂十二個；
english: These were the offerings given for the altar by the chiefs of Israel, when the holy oil was put on it: twelve silver plates, twelve silver basins, twelve gold spoons;

chinese: 每盤子重一百三十舍客勒，每碗重七十舍客勒。一切器皿的銀子，按聖所的平，共有二千四百舍客勒。
english: The weight of every silver plate was a hundred and thirty shekels, and of every basin seventy; the weight of all the silver of the vessels was two thousand and four hundred shekels, by the scale of the holy place;

chinese: 十二個金盂盛滿了香，按聖所的平，每盂重十舍客勒，所有的金子共一百二十舍客勒。
english: The weight of the twelve gold spoons of spice for burning was ten shekels for every one, by the scale of the holy place; all the gold of the spoons was a hundred and twenty shekels;

chinese: 作燔祭的，共有公牛十二隻，公羊十二隻，一歲的公羊羔十二隻，並同獻的素祭作贖罪祭的公山羊十二隻；
english: All the oxen, for the burned offering were twelve, the male sheep twelve, the he-lambs of the first year twelve, with their meal offering; and the males of the goats for sin-offering twelve;

chinese: 作平安祭的，共有公牛二十四隻，公綿羊六十隻，公山羊六十隻，一歲的公羊羔六十隻。這就是用膏抹壇之後，為行奉獻壇之禮所獻的。
english: And all the oxen for the peace-offerings, twenty-four oxen, the male sheep sixty, and the he-goats sixty, the he-lambs of the first year sixty. This was given for the altar after the holy oil was put on it.

chinese: 摩西進會幕要與耶和華說話的時候，聽見法櫃的施恩座以上、二基路伯中間有與他說話的聲音，就是耶和華與他說話。
english: And when Moses went into the Tent of meeting to have talk with him, then the Voice came to his ears from over the cover which was on the ark of witness, from between the two winged ones. And he had talk with him.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你告訴亞倫說：點燈的時候，七盞燈都要向燈臺前面發光。
english: Say to Aaron, When you put the lights in their places, the seven lights will give light in front of the support.

chinese: 亞倫便這樣行。他點燈臺上的燈，使燈向前發光，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And Aaron did so; he put the lights in their places so that they gave light in front of the support, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 這燈臺的作法是用金子錘出來的，連座帶花都是錘出來的。摩西製造燈臺，是照耶和華所指示的樣式。
english: The support for the lights was of hammered gold work, from its base to its flowers it was of hammered work; from the design which the Lord had given to Moses, he made the support for the lights.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你從以色列人中選出利未人來，潔淨他們。
english: Take the Levites out from among the children of Israel and make them clean.

chinese: 潔淨他們當這樣行：用除罪水彈在他們身上，又叫他們用剃頭刀刮全身，洗衣服，潔淨自己。
english: And this is how you are to make them clean: let the holy water which takes away sin be put on them, and let the hair all over their bodies be cut off with a sharp blade, and let their clothing be washed and their bodies made clean.

chinese: 然後叫他們取一隻公牛犢，並同獻的素祭，就是調油的細麵；你要另取一隻公牛犢作贖罪祭。
english: Then let them take a young ox and its meal offering, crushed grain mixed with oil, and take another ox for a sin-offering.

chinese: 將利未人奉到會幕前，招聚以色列全會眾。
english: And make the Levites come forward in front of the Tent of meeting, and let all the children of Israel come together:

chinese: 將利未人奉到耶和華面前，以色列人要按手在他們頭上。
english: And you are to take the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel are to put their hands on them:

chinese: 亞倫也將他們奉到耶和華面前，為以色列人當作搖祭，使他們好辦耶和華的事。
english: And Aaron is to give the Levites to the Lord as a wave offering from the children of Israel, so that they may do the Lord's work.

chinese: 利未人要按手在那兩隻牛的頭上；你要將一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭，獻給耶和華，為利未人贖罪。
english: And the Levites are to put their hands on the heads of the oxen, and one of the oxen is to be offered for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering to the Lord to take away the sin of the Levites.

chinese: 你也要使利未人站在亞倫和他兒子面前，將他們當作搖祭奉給耶和華。
english: Then the Levites are to be put before Aaron and his sons, to be offered as a wave offering to the Lord.

chinese: 這樣，你從以色列人中將利未人分別出來，利未人便要歸我。
english: So you are to make the Levites separate from the children of Israel, and the Levites will be mine.

chinese: 此後利未人要進去辦會幕的事，你要潔淨他們，將他們當作搖祭奉上；
english: After that, the Levites will go in to do whatever has to be done in the Tent of meeting; you are to make them clean and give them as a wave offering.

chinese: 因為他們是從以色列人中全然給我的，我揀選他們歸我，是代替以色列人中一切頭生的。
english: For they have been given to me from among the children of Israel; in place of every mother's first son, the first to come to birth in Israel, I have taken them for myself.

chinese: 以色列人中一切頭生的，連人帶牲畜，都是我的。我在埃及地擊殺一切頭生的那天，將他們分別為聖歸我。
english: For every mother's first son among the children of Israel is mine, the first male birth of man or beast: on the day when I sent death on all the first sons in the land of Egypt, I made them mine.

chinese: 我揀選利未人代替以色列人中一切頭生的。
english: And in place of the first sons among the children of Israel, I have taken the Levites.

chinese: 我從以色列人中將利未人當作賞賜給亞倫和他的兒子，在會幕中辦以色列人的事，又為以色列人贖罪，免得他們挨近聖所，有災殃臨到他們中間。
english: And I have given them to Aaron and to his sons, from among the children of Israel, to undertake for them all the work of the Tent of meeting, and to take away sin from the children of Israel so that no evil may come on them when they come near the holy place.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫，並以色列全會眾便向利未人如此行。凡耶和華指著利未人所吩咐摩西的，以色列人就向他們這樣行。
english: All these things Moses and Aaron and the children of Israel did to the Levites; as the Lord gave orders to Moses about the Levites, so the children of Israel did.

chinese: 於是利未人潔淨自己，除了罪，洗了衣服；亞倫將他們當作搖祭奉到耶和華面前，又為他們贖罪，潔淨他們。
english: And the Levites were made clean from sin, and their clothing was washed, and Aaron gave them for a wave offering before the Lord; and Aaron took away their sin and made them clean.

chinese: 然後利未人進去，在亞倫和他兒子面前，在會幕中辦事。耶和華指著利未人怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎樣向他們行了。
english: And then the Levites went in to do their work in the Tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons: all the orders which the Lord had given Moses about the Levites were put into effect.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 利未人是這樣：從二十五歲以外，他們要前來任職，辦會幕的事。
english: This is the rule for the Levites: those of twenty-five years old and over are to go in and do the work of the Tent of meeting;

chinese: 到了五十歲要停工退任，不再辦事，
english: But after they are fifty years old, they are to give up their work and do no more;

chinese: 只要在會幕裡，和他們的弟兄一同伺候，謹守所吩咐的，不再辦事了。至於所吩咐利未人的，你要這樣向他們行。
english: But be with their brothers in the Tent of meeting, taking care of it but doing no work. This is what you are to do in connection with the Levites and their work.

chinese: 以色列人出埃及地以後，第二年正月，耶和華在西乃的曠野吩咐摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses, in the waste land of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt,

chinese: 以色列人應當在所定的日期守逾越節，
english: Let the children of Israel keep the Passover at its regular time.

chinese: 就是本月十四日黃昏的時候，你們要在所定的日期守這節，要按這節的律例典章而守。
english: In the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you are to keep it at the regular time, and in the way ordered in the law.

chinese: 於是摩西吩咐以色列人守逾越節。
english: And Moses gave orders to the children of Israel to keep the Passover.

chinese: 他們就在西乃的曠野，正月十四日黃昏的時候，守逾越節。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照樣行了。
english: So they kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at evening, in the waste land of Sinai: as the Lord gave orders to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

chinese: 有幾個人因死屍而不潔淨，不能在那日守逾越節。當日他們到摩西、亞倫面前，
english: And there were certain men who were unclean because of a dead body, so that they were not able to keep the Passover on that day; and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

chinese: 說：我們雖因死屍而不潔淨，為何被阻止、不得同以色列人在所定的日期獻耶和華的供物呢？
english: And these men said to him, We have been made unclean by the dead body of a man; why may we not make the offering of the Lord at the regular time among the children of Israel?

chinese: 摩西對他們說：你們暫且等候，我可以去聽耶和華指著你們是怎樣吩咐的。
english: And Moses said to them, Do nothing till the Lord gives me directions about you.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：你們和你們後代中，若有人因死屍而不潔淨，或在遠方行路，還要向耶和華守逾越節。
english: Say to the children of Israel, If any one of you or of your families is unclean because of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, still he is to keep the Passover to the Lord:

chinese: 他們要在二月十四日黃昏的時候，守逾越節。要用無酵餅與苦菜，和逾越節的羊羔同吃。
english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day, in the evening, they are to keep it, taking it with unleavened bread and bitter-tasting plants;

chinese: 一點不可留到早晨；羊羔的骨頭一根也不可折斷。他們要照逾越節的一切律例而守。
english: Nothing of it is to be kept till the morning, and no bone of it is to be broken: they are to keep it by the rules of the Passover.

chinese: 那潔淨而不行路的人若推辭不守逾越節，那人要從民中剪除；因為他在所定的日期不獻耶和華的供物，應該擔當他的罪。
english: But the man who, not being unclean or on a journey, does not keep the Passover, will be cut off from his people: because he did not make the offering of the Lord at the regular time, his sin will be on him.

chinese: 若有外人寄居在你們中間，願意向耶和華守逾越節，他要照逾越節的律例典章行，不管是寄居的是本地人，同歸一例。
english: And if a man from another country is among you and has a desire to keep the Passover to the Lord, let him do as is ordered in the law of the Passover: there is to be the same rule for the man from another nation and for him who had his birth in the land.

chinese: 立起帳幕的那日，有雲彩遮蓋帳幕，就是法櫃的帳幕；從晚上到早晨，雲彩在其上，形狀如火。
english: And on the day when the House was put up, the cloud came down on it, on the Tent of witness; and in the evening there was a light like fire over the House till the morning.

chinese: 常是這樣，雲彩遮蓋帳幕，夜間形狀如火。
english: And so it was at all times: it was covered by the cloud, and by a light as of fire by night.

chinese: 雲彩幾時從帳幕收上去，以色列人就幾時起行；雲彩在那裡停住，以色列人就在那裡安營。
english: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the House, then the children of Israel went journeying on; and in the place where the cloud came to rest, there the children of Israel put up their tents.

chinese: 以色列人遵耶和華的吩咐起行，也遵耶和華的吩咐安營。雲彩在帳幕上停住幾時，他們就住營幾時。
english: At the order of the Lord the children of Israel went forward, and at the order of the Lord they put up their tents: as long as the cloud was resting on the House, they did not go away from that place.

chinese: 雲彩在帳幕上停留許多日子，以色列人就守耶和華所吩咐的不起行。
english: When the cloud was resting on the House for a long time the children of Israel, waiting for the order of the Lord, did not go on.

chinese: 有時雲彩在帳幕上幾天，他們就照耶和華的吩咐住營，也照耶和華的吩咐起行。
english: Sometimes the cloud was resting on the House for two or three days; then, by the order of the Lord, they kept their tents in that place, and when the Lord gave the order they went on.

chinese: 有時從晚上到早晨，有這雲彩在帳幕上；早晨雲彩收上去，他們就起行。有時晝夜雲彩停在帳幕上，收上去的時候，他們就起行。
english: And sometimes the cloud was there only from evening to morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning they went on their journey again: or if it was resting there by day and by night, whenever the cloud was taken up they went forward.

chinese: 雲彩停留在帳幕上，無論是兩天，是一月，是一年，以色列人就住營不起行；但雲彩收上去，他們就起行。
english: Or if the cloud came to rest on the House for two days or a month or a year without moving, the children of Israel went on waiting there and did not go on; but whenever it was taken up they went forward on their journey.

chinese: 他們遵耶和華的吩咐安營，也遵耶和華的吩咐起行。他們守耶和華所吩咐的，都是憑耶和華吩咐摩西的。
english: At the word of the Lord they put up their tents, and at the word of the Lord they went forward on their journey: they kept the orders of the Lord as he gave them by Moses.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要用銀子做兩枝號，都要錘出來的，用以招聚會眾，並叫眾營起行。
english: Make two silver horns of hammered work, to be used for getting the people together and to give the sign for the moving of the tents.

chinese: 吹這號的時候，全會眾要到你那裡，聚集在會幕門口。
english: When they are sounded, all the people are to come together to you at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 若單吹一枝，眾首領，就是以色列軍中的統領，要聚集到你那裡。
english: If only one of them is sounded, then the chiefs, the heads of the thousands of Israel, are to come to you.

chinese: 吹出大聲的時候，東邊安的營都要起行。
english: When a loud note is sounded, the tents placed on the east side are to go forward.

chinese: 二次吹出大聲的時候，南邊安的營都要起行。他們將起行，必吹出大聲。
english: At the sound of a second loud note, the tents on the south side are to go forward: the loud note will be the sign to go forward.

chinese: 但招聚會眾的時候，你們要吹號，卻不要吹出大聲。
english: But when all the people are to come together, the horn is to be sounded but not loudly.

chinese: 亞倫子孫作祭司的要吹這號；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
english: The horns are to be sounded by the sons of Aaron, the priests; this is to be a law for you for ever, from generation to generation.

chinese: 你們在自己的地，與欺壓你們的敵人打仗，就要用號吹出大聲，便在耶和華─你們的神面前得蒙紀念，也蒙拯救脫離仇敵。
english: And if you go to war in your land against any who do you wrong, then let the loud note of the horn be sounded; and the Lord your God will keep you in mind and give you salvation from those who are against you.

chinese: 在你們快樂的日子和節期，並月朔，獻燔祭和平安祭，也要吹號，這都要在你們的神面前作為紀念。我是耶和華─你們的　神。
english: And on days of joy and on your regular feasts and on the first day of every month, let the horns be sounded over your burned offerings and your peace-offerings; and they will put the Lord in mind of you: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 第二年二月二十日，雲彩從法櫃的帳幕收上去。
english: Now in the second year, on the twentieth day of the second month, the cloud was taken up from over the Tent of witness.

chinese: 以色列人就按站往前行，離開西乃的曠野，雲彩停住在巴蘭的曠野。
english: And the children of Israel went on their journey out of the waste land of Sinai; and the cloud came to rest in the waste land of Paran.

chinese: 這是他們照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的，初次往前行。
english: They went forward for the first time on their journey as the Lord had given orders by the hand of Moses.

chinese: 按著軍隊首先往前行的是猶大營的纛。統領軍隊的是亞米拿達的兒子拿順。
english: First the flag of the children of Judah went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.

chinese: 統領以薩迦支派軍隊的是蘇押的兒子拿坦業。
english: And at the head of the army of the children of Issachar was Nethanel, the son of Zuar.

chinese: 統領西布倫支派軍隊的是希倫的兒子以利押。
english: And at the head of the army of the children of Zebulun was Eliab, the son of Helon.

chinese: 帳幕拆卸，革順的子孫和米拉利的子孫就抬著帳幕先往前行。
english: Then the House was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who were responsible for moving the House, went forward.

chinese: 按著軍隊往前行的是流便營的纛。統領軍隊的是示丟珥的兒子以利蓿。
english: Then the flag of the children of Reuben went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Elizur, the son of Shedeur.

chinese: 統領西緬支派軍隊的是蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑。
english: And at the head of the army of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.

chinese: 統領迦得支派軍隊的是丟珥的兒子以利雅薩。
english: At the head of the army of the children of Gad was Eliasaph, the son of Reuel.

chinese: 哥轄人抬著聖物先往前行。他們未到以前，抬帳幕的已經把帳幕支好。
english: Then the Kohathites went forward with the holy place; the others put up the House ready for their coming.

chinese: 按著軍隊往前行的是以法蓮營的纛，統領軍隊的是亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪。
english: Then the flag of the children of Ephraim went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Elishama, the son of Ammihud.

chinese: 統領瑪拿西支派軍隊的是比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列。
english: At the head of the army of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur.

chinese: 統領便雅憫支派軍隊的是基多尼的兒子亞比但。
english: At the head of the army of the children of Benjamin was Abidan, the son of Gideoni.

chinese: 在諸營末後的是但營的纛，按著軍隊往前行。統領軍隊的是亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝。
english: And the flag of the children of Dan, whose tents were moved last of all, went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai.

chinese: 統領亞設支派軍隊的是俄蘭的兒子帕結。
english: At the head of the army of the children of Asher was Pagiel, the son of Ochran.

chinese: 統領拿弗他利支派軍隊的是以南的兒子亞希拉。
english: And at the head of the army of the children of Naphtali was Ahira, the son of Enan.

chinese: 以色列人按著軍隊往前行，就是這樣。
english: This was the order in which the children of Israel were journeying by armies; so they went forward.

chinese: 摩西對他岳父（或作：內兄）─米甸人流珥的兒子何巴─說：我們要行路，往耶和華所應許之地去；他曾說：我要將這地賜給你們。現在求你和我們同去，我們必厚待你，因為耶和華指著以色列人已經應許給好處。
english: Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of his father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, We are journeying to that place of which the Lord has said, I will give it to you: so come with us, and it will be for your profit: for the Lord has good things in store for Israel.

chinese: 何巴回答說：我不去；我要回本地本族那裡去。
english: But he said, I will not go with you, I will go back to the land of my birth and to my relations.

chinese: 摩西說：求你不要離開我們；因為你知道我們要在曠野安營，你可以當作我們的眼目。
english: And he said, Do not go from us; for you will be eyes for us, guiding us to the right places in the waste land to put up our tents.

chinese: 你若和我們同去，將來耶和華有甚麼好處待我們，我們也必以甚麼好處待你。
english: And if you come with us, we will give you a part in whatever good the Lord does for us.

chinese: 以色列人離開耶和華的山，往前行了三天的路程；耶和華的約櫃在前頭行了三天的路程，為他們尋找安歇的地方。
