english: So they went forward three days' journey from the mountain of the Lord; and the ark of the Lord's agreement went three days' journey before them, looking for a resting-place for them;

chinese: 他們拔營往前行，日間有耶和華的雲彩在他們以上。
english: And by day the cloud of the Lord went over them, when they went forward from the place where they had put up their tents.

chinese: 約櫃往前行的時候，摩西就說：耶和華阿，求你興起！願你的仇敵四散！願恨你的人從你面前逃跑！
english: And when the ark went forward Moses said, Come up, O Lord, and let the armies of those who are against you be broken, and let your haters go in flight before you.

chinese: 約櫃停住的時候，他就說：耶和華阿，求你回到以色列的千萬人中！
english: And when it came to rest, he said, Take rest, O Lord, and give a blessing to the families of Israel.

chinese: 眾百姓發怨言，他們的惡語達到耶和華的耳中。耶和華聽見了就怒氣發作，使火在他們中間焚燒，直燒到營的邊界。
english: Now the people were saying evil against the Lord; and the Lord, hearing it, was angry and sent fire on them, burning the outer parts of the tent-circle.

chinese: 百姓向摩西哀求，摩西祈求耶和華，火就熄了。
english: And the people made an outcry to Moses, and Moses made prayer to the Lord, and the fire was stopped.

chinese: 那地方便叫做他備拉，因為耶和華的火燒在他們中間。
english: So that place was named Taberah, because of the fire of the Lord which had been burning among them.

chinese: 他們中間的閒雜人大起貪慾的心；以色列人又哭號說：誰給我們肉吃呢？
english: And the mixed band of people who went with them were overcome by desire: and the children of Israel, weeping again, said, Who will give us flesh for our food?

chinese: 我們記得，在埃及的時候不花錢就吃魚，也記得有黃瓜、西瓜、韭菜、蔥、蒜。
english: Sweet is the memory of the fish we had in Egypt for nothing, and the fruit and green plants of every sort, sharp and pleasing to the taste:

chinese: 現在我們的心血枯竭了，除這嗎哪以外，在我們眼前並沒有別的東西。
english: But now our soul is wasted away; there is nothing at all: we have nothing but this manna before our eyes.

chinese: 這嗎哪彷彿芫荽子，又好像珍珠。
english: Now the manna was like a seed of grain, like small clear drops.

chinese: 百姓周圍行走，把嗎哪收起來，或用磨推，或用臼搗，煮在鍋中，又做成餅，滋味好像新油。
english: The people went about taking it up from the earth, crushing it between stones or hammering it to powder, and boiling it in pots, and they made cakes of it: its taste was like the taste of cakes cooked with oil.

chinese: 夜間露水降在營中，嗎哪也隨著降下。
english: When the dew came down on the tents at night, the manna came down with it.

chinese: 摩西聽見百姓，各在各家的帳棚門口哭號。耶和華的怒氣便大發作，摩西就不喜悅。
english: And at the sound of the people weeping, every man at his tent-door, the wrath of the Lord was great, and Moses was very angry.

chinese: 摩西對耶和華說：你為何苦待僕人？我為何不在你眼前蒙恩，竟把這管理百姓的重任加在我身上呢？
english: And Moses said to the Lord, Why have you done me this evil? and why have I not grace in your eyes, that you have put on me the care of all this people?

chinese: 這百姓豈是我懷的胎，豈是我生下來的呢？你竟對我說：把他們抱在懷裡，如養育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓應許給他們祖宗的地去。
english: Am I the father of all this people? have I given them birth, that you say to me, Take them in your arms, like a child at the breast, to the land which you gave by an oath to their fathers?

chinese: 我從那裡得肉給這百姓吃呢？他們都向我哭號說：你給我們肉吃罷！
english: Where am I to get flesh to give to all this people? For they are weeping to me and saying, Give us flesh for our food.

chinese: 管理這百姓的責任太重了，我獨自擔當不起。
english: I am not able by myself to take the weight of all this people, for it is more than my strength.

chinese: 你這樣待我，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你立時將我殺了，不叫我見自己的苦情。
english: If this is to be my fate, put me to death now in answer to my prayer, if I have grace in your eyes; and let me not see my shame.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你從以色列的長老中招聚七十個人，就是你所知道作百姓的長老和官長的，到我這裡來，領他們到會幕前，使他們和你一同站立。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Send for seventy of the responsible men of Israel, who are in your opinion men of weight and authority over the people; make them come to the Tent of meeting and be there with you.

chinese: 我要在那裡降臨，與你說話，也要把降於你身上的靈分賜他們，他們就和你同當這管百姓的重任，免得你獨自擔當。
english: And I will come down and have talk with you there: and I will take some of the spirit which is on you and put it on them, and they will take part of the weight of the people off you, so that you do not have to take it by yourself.

chinese: 又要對百姓說：你們應當自潔，預備明天吃肉，因為你們哭號說：誰給我們肉吃！我們在埃及很好。這聲音達到了耶和華的耳中，所以他必給你們肉吃。
english: And say to the people, Make yourselves clean before tomorrow and you will have flesh for your food: for in the ears of the Lord you have been weeping and saying, Who will give us flesh for food? for we were well off in Egypt: and so the Lord will give you flesh, and it will be your food;

chinese: 你們不止吃一天、兩天、五天、十天、二十天，
english: Not for one day only, or even for five or ten or twenty days;

chinese: 要吃一個整月，甚至肉從你們鼻孔裡噴出來，使你們厭惡了，因為你們厭棄住在你們中間的耶和華，在他面前哭號說：我們為何出了埃及呢？
english: But every day for a month, till you are tired of it, turning from it in disgust: because you have gone against the Lord who is with you, and have been weeping before him saying, Why did we come out of Egypt?

chinese: 摩西對耶和華說：這與我同住的百姓、步行的男人有六十萬，你還說：我要把肉給他們，使他們可以吃一個整月。
english: Then Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, I will give them flesh to be their food for a month.

chinese: 難道給他們宰了羊群牛群，或是把海中所有的魚都聚了來，就夠他們吃麼？
english: Are flocks and herds to be put to death for them? or are all the fish in the sea to be got together so that they may be full?

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：耶和華的膀臂豈是縮短了麼？現在要看我的話向你應驗不應驗。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Has the Lord's hand become short? Now you will see if my word comes true for you or not.

chinese: 摩西出去，將耶和華的話告訴百姓，又招聚百姓的長老中七十個人來，使他們站在會幕的四圍。
english: And Moses went out and gave the people the words of the Lord: and he took seventy of the responsible men of the people, placing them round the Tent.

chinese: 耶和華在雲中降臨，對摩西說話，把降與他身上的靈分賜那七十個長老。靈停在他們身上的時候，他們就受感說話，以後卻沒有再說。
english: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and had talk with him, and put on the seventy men some of the spirit which was on him: now when the spirit came to rest on them, they were like prophets, but only at that time.

chinese: 但有兩個人仍在營裡，一個名叫伊利達，一個名叫米達。他們本是在那些被錄的人中，卻沒有到會幕那裡去。靈停在他們身上，他們就在營裡說預言。
english: But two men were still in the tent-circle one of them named Eldad and the other Medad: and the spirit came to rest on them; they were among those who had been sent for, but they had not gone out to the Tent: and the prophet's power came on them in the tent-circle.

chinese: 有個少年人跑來告訴摩西說：伊利達、米達在營裡說預言。
english: And a young man went running to Moses and said, Eldad and Medad are acting as prophets in the tent-circle.

chinese: 摩西的幫手，嫩的兒子約書亞，就是摩西所揀選的一個人，說：請我主摩西禁止他們。
english: Then Joshua, the son of Nun, who had been Moses' servant from the time when he was a child, said, My lord Moses, let them be stopped.

chinese: 摩西對他說：你為我的緣故嫉妒人麼？惟願耶和華的百姓都受感說話！願耶和華把他的靈降在他們身上！
english: And Moses said to him, Are you moved by envy on my account? If only all the Lord's people were prophets, and the Lord might put his spirit on them!

chinese: 於是，摩西和以色列的長老都回到營裡去了。
english: Then Moses, with the responsible men of Israel, went back to the tent-circle.

chinese: 有風從耶和華那裡颳起，把鵪鶉由海面颳來，飛散在營邊和營的四圍；這邊約有一天的路程，那邊約有一天的路程，離地面約有二肘。
english: Then the Lord sent a wind, driving little birds from the sea, so that they came down on the tents, and all round the tent-circle, about a day's journey on this side and on that, in masses about two cubits high over the face of the earth.

chinese: 百姓起來，終日終夜，並次日一整天，捕取鵪鶉；至少的也取了十賀梅珥，為自己擺列在營的四圍。
english: And all that day and all night and the day after, the people were taking up the birds; the smallest amount which anyone got was ten homers: and they put them out all round the tents.

chinese: 肉在他們牙齒之間尚未嚼爛，耶和華的怒氣就向他們發作，用最重的災殃擊殺了他們。
english: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was tasted, the wrath of the Lord was moved against the people and he sent a great outburst of disease on them.

chinese: 那地方便叫做基博羅哈他瓦（就是貪慾之人的墳墓），因為他們在那裡葬埋那起貪慾之心的人。
english: So that place was named Kibroth-hattaavah; because there they put in the earth the bodies of the people who had given way to their desires.

chinese: 百姓從基博羅哈他瓦走到哈洗錄，就住在哈洗錄。
english: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people went on to Hazeroth; and there they put up their tents.

chinese: 摩西娶了古實女子為妻。米利暗和亞倫因他所娶的古實女子，就毀謗他，說：
english: Now Miriam and Aaron said evil against Moses, because of the Cushite woman to whom he was married, for he had taken a Cushite woman as his wife.

chinese: 難道耶和華單與摩西說話，不也與我們說話麼？這話耶和華聽見了。
english: And they said, Have the words of the Lord been given to Moses only? have they not come to us? And the Lord took note of it.

chinese: 摩西為人極其謙和，勝過世上的眾人。
english: Now the man Moses was more gentle than any other man on earth.

chinese: 耶和華忽然對摩西、亞倫、米利暗說：你們三個人都出來，到會幕這裡。他們三個人就出來了。
english: And suddenly the Lord said to Moses and Aaron and Miriam, Come out, you three, to the Tent of meeting. And the three of them went out.

chinese: 耶和華在雲柱中降臨，站在會幕門口，召亞倫和米利暗，二人就出來了。
english: And the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud, taking his place at the door of the Tent, and made Aaron and Miriam come before him.

chinese: 耶和華說：你們且聽我的話：你們中間若有先知，我─耶和華必在異象中向他顯現，在夢中與他說話。
english: And he said, Now give ear to my words: if there is a prophet among you I will give him knowledge of myself in a vision and will let my words come to him in a dream.

chinese: 我的僕人摩西不是這樣；他是在我全家盡忠的。
english: My servant Moses is not so; he is true to me in all my house:

chinese: 我要與他面對面說話，乃是明說，不用謎語，並且他必見我的形像。你們毀謗我的僕人摩西，為何不懼怕呢？
english: With him I will have talk mouth to mouth, openly and not in dark sayings; and with his eyes he will see the form of the Lord: why then had you no fear of saying evil against my servant Moses?

chinese: 耶和華就向他們二人發怒而去。
english: And burning with wrath against them, the Lord went away.

chinese: 雲彩從會幕上挪開了，不料，米利暗長了大痲瘋，有雪那樣白，亞倫一看米利暗長了大痲瘋，
english: And the cloud was moved from over the Tent; and straight away Miriam became a leper, as white as snow: and Aaron, looking at Miriam, saw that she was a leper.

chinese: 就對摩西說：我主阿，求你不要因我們愚昧犯罪，便將這罪加在我們身上。
english: Then Aaron said to Moses, O my lord, let not our sin be on our heads, for we have done foolishly and are sinners.

chinese: 求你不要使他像那出母腹、肉已半爛的死胎。
english: Let her not be as one dead, whose flesh is half wasted when he comes out from the body of his mother.

chinese: 於是摩西哀求耶和華說：神阿，求你醫治他！
english: And Moses, crying to the Lord, said, Let my prayer come before you, O God, and make her well.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：他父親若吐唾沫在他臉上，他豈不蒙羞七天麼？現在要把他在營外關鎖七天，然後才可以領他進來。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, If her father had put a mark of shame on her, would she not be shamed for seven days? Let her be shut up outside the tent-circle for seven days, and after that she may come in again.

chinese: 於是米利暗關鎖在營外七天。百姓沒有行路，直等到把米利暗領進來。
english: So Miriam was shut up outside the tent-circle for seven days: and the people did not go forward on their journey till Miriam had come in again.

chinese: 以後百姓從哈洗錄起行，在巴蘭的曠野安營。
english: After that, the people went on from Hazeroth and put up their tents in the waste land of Paran.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你打發人去窺探我所賜給以色列人的迦南地，他們每支派中要打發一個人，都要作首領的。
english: Send men to get knowledge about the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel; from every tribe of their fathers you are to send a man, every one a chief among them.

chinese: 摩西就照耶和華的吩咐，從巴蘭的曠野打發他們去；他們都是以色列人的族長。
english: And Moses sent them from the waste land of Paran as the Lord gave orders, all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.

chinese: 他們的名字：屬流便支派的有撒刻的兒子沙母亞。
english: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua, the son of Zaccur.

chinese: 屬西緬支派的有何利的兒子的沙法。
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat, the son of Hori.

chinese: 屬猶大支派的有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

chinese: 屬以薩迦支派的有約色的兒子以迦。
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal, the son of Joseph.

chinese: 屬以法蓮支派的有嫩的兒子何西阿。
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea, the son of Nun.

chinese: 屬便雅憫支派的有拉孚的兒子帕提。
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti, the son of Raphu.

chinese: 屬西布倫支派的有梭底的兒子迦疊。
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel, the son of Sodi.

chinese: 約瑟的子孫屬瑪拿西支派的有穌西的兒子迦底。
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, that is of the family of Manasseh, Gaddi, the son of Susi.

chinese: 屬但支派的有基瑪利的兒子亞米利。
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel, the son of Gemalli.

chinese: 屬亞設支派的有米迦勒的兒子西帖。
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur, the son of Michael

chinese: 屬拿弗他利支派的有縛西的兒子拿比。
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi, the son of Vophsi.

chinese: 屬迦得支派的有瑪基的兒子臼利。
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Gevel, the son of Machi.

chinese: 這就是摩西所打發窺探那地之人的名字。摩西就稱嫩的兒子何西阿為約書亞。
english: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to get knowledge about the land. And Moses gave to Hoshea, the son of Nun, the name of Joshua.

chinese: 摩西打發他們去窺探迦南地，說：你們從南地上山地去，
english: So Moses sent them to have a look at the land of Canaan, and said to them, Go up into the South and into the hill-country;

chinese: 看那地如何，其中所住的民是強是弱，是多是少，
english: And see what the land is like; and if the people living in it are strong or feeble, small or great in number;

chinese: 所住之地是好是歹，所住之處是營盤是堅城。
english: And what sort of land they are living in, if it is good or bad; and what their living-places are, tent-circles or walled towns;

chinese: 又看那地土是肥美是瘠薄，其中有樹木沒有。你們要放開膽量，把那地的果子帶些來。那時正是葡萄初熟的時候。
english: And if the land is fertile or poor, and if there is wood in it or not. And be of good heart, and come back with some of the produce of the land. Now it was the time when the first grapes were ready.

chinese: 他們上去窺探那地，從尋的曠野到利合，直到哈馬口。
english: So they went up and got a view of the land, from the waste land of Zin to Rehob, on the way to Hamath.

chinese: 他們從南地上去，到了希伯崙；在那裡有亞衲族人亞希幔、示篩、撻買。原來希伯崙城被建造比埃及的鎖安城早七年。
english: They went up into the South and came to Hebron; and Ahiman and Sheshai and Talmai, the children of Anak, were living there. (Now the building of Hebron took place seven years before that of Zoan in Egypt.)

chinese: 他們到了以實各谷，從那裡砍了葡萄樹的一枝，上頭有一掛葡萄，兩個人用杠抬著，又帶了些石榴和無花果來。
english: And they came to the valley of Eshcol, and cutting down a vine-branch with its grapes, two of them took it on a rod between them; and they took some pomegranates and figs.

chinese: 因為以色列人從那裡砍來的那掛葡萄，所以那地方叫做以實各谷。
english: That place was named the valley of Eshcol because of the grapes which the children of Israel took from there.

chinese: 過了四十天，他們窺探那地才回來，
english: At the end of forty days they came back from viewing the land.

chinese: 到了巴蘭曠野的加低斯，見摩西、亞倫，並以色列的全會眾，回報摩西、亞倫，並全會眾，又把那地的果子給他們看；
english: And they came back to Moses and Aaron and all the children of Israel, to Kadesh in the waste land of Paran; and gave an account to them and to all the people and let them see the produce of the land.

chinese: 又告訴摩西說：我們到了你所打發我們去的那地，果然是流奶與蜜之地；這就是那地的果子。
english: And they said, We came to the land where you sent us, and truly it is flowing with milk and honey: and here is some of the produce of it.

chinese: 然而住那地的民強壯，城邑也堅固寬大，並且我們在那裡看見了亞衲族的人。
english: But the people living in the land are strong, and the towns are walled and very great; further, we saw the children of Anak there.

chinese: 亞瑪力人住在南地；赫人、耶布斯人、亞摩利人、住在山地；迦南人住在海邊並約但河旁。
english: And the Amalekites are in the South; and the Hittites and the Jebusites and the Amorites are living in the hill-country; and the Canaanites by the sea and by the side of Jordan.

chinese: 迦勒在摩西面前安撫百姓，說：我們立刻上去得那地罷！我們足能得勝。
english: Then Caleb made signs to the people to keep quiet, and said to Moses, Let us go up straight away and take this land; for we are well able to overcome it.

chinese: 但那些和他同去的人說：我們不能上去攻擊那民，因為他們比我們強壯。
english: But the men who had gone up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we.

chinese: 探子中有人論到所窺探之地，向以色列人報惡信，說：我們所窺探、經過之地是吞吃居民之地，我們在那裡所看見的人民都身量高大。
english: And they gave the children of Israel a bad account of the land they had been to see, saying, This land through which we went is a land causing destruction to those living in it; and all the people we saw there are men of more than common size.

chinese: 我們在那裡看見亞衲族人，就是偉人；他們是偉人的後裔。據我們看，自己就如蚱蜢一樣；據他們看，我們也是如此。
english: There we saw those great men, the sons of Anak, offspring of the Nephilim: and we seemed to ourselves no more than insects, and so we seemed to them.

chinese: 當下，全會眾大聲喧嚷；那夜百姓都哭號。
english: Then all the people gave load cries of grief, and all that night they gave themselves up to weeping.

chinese: 以色列眾人向摩西、亞倫發怨言；全會眾對他們說：巴不得我們早死在埃及地，或是死在這曠野。
english: And all the children of Israel, crying out against Moses and Aaron, said, If only we had come to our death in the land of Egypt, or even in this waste land!

chinese: 耶和華為甚麼把我們領到那地，使我們倒在刀下呢？我們的妻子和孩子必被擄掠。我們回埃及去豈不好麼？
english: Why is the Lord taking us into this land to come to our death by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will get into strange hands: would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?

chinese: 眾人彼此說：我們不如立一個首領回埃及去罷！
english: And they said to one another, Let us make a captain over us, and go back to Egypt.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫就俯伏在以色列全會眾面前。
english: Then Moses and Aaron went down on their faces before the meeting of the people.

chinese: 窺探地的人中，嫩的兒子約書亞和耶孚尼的兒子迦勒撕裂衣服，
english: And Joshua, the son of Nun, and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, two of those who had been to see the land, giving signs of grief,

chinese: 對以色列全會眾說：我們所窺探、經過之地是極美之地。
english: Said to all the children of Israel, This land which we went through to see is a very good land.

chinese: 耶和華若喜悅我們，就必將我們領進那地，把地賜給我們；那地原是流奶與蜜之地。
english: And if the Lord has delight in us, he will take us into this land and give it to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

chinese: 但你們不可背叛耶和華，也不要怕那地的居民；因為他們是我們的食物，並且蔭庇他們的已經離開他們。有耶和華與我們同在，不要怕他們！
english: Only, do not go against the Lord or go in fear of the people of the land, for they will be our food; their strength has been taken from them and the Lord is with us: have no fear of them.

chinese: 但全會眾說：拿石頭打死他們二人。忽然，耶和華的榮光在會幕中向以色列眾人顯現。
english: But all the people said they were to be stoned. Then the glory of the Lord was seen in the Tent of meeting, before the eyes of all the children of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：這百姓藐視我要到幾時呢？我在他們中間行了這一切神蹟，他們還不信我要到幾時呢？
english: And the Lord said to Moses, How long will this people have no respect for me? how long will they be without faith, in the face of all the signs I have done among them?

chinese: 我要用瘟疫擊殺他們，使他們不得承受那地，叫你的後裔成為大國，比他們強勝。
english: I will send disease on them for their destruction, and take away their heritage, and I will make of you a nation greater and stronger than they.

chinese: 摩西對耶和華說：埃及人必聽見這事；因為你曾施展大能，將這百姓從他們中間領上來。
english: And Moses said to the Lord, Then it will come to the ears of the Egyptians; for by your power you took this people out from among them;

chinese: 埃及人要將這事傳給迦南地的居民；那民已經聽見你─耶和華是在這百姓中間；因為你面對面被人看見，有你的雲彩停在他們以上。你日間在雲柱中，夜間在火柱中，在他們前面行。
english: And they will give the news to the people of this land: they have had word that you, Lord, are present with this people, letting yourself be seen face to face, and that your cloud is resting over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.

chinese: 如今你若把這百姓殺了，如殺一人，那些聽見你名聲的列邦必議論說：
english: Now if you put to death all this people as one man, then the nations who have had word of your glory will say,

chinese: 耶和華因為不能把這百姓領進他向他們起誓應許之地，所以在曠野把他們殺了。
english: Because the Lord was not able to take this people into the land which he made an oath to give them, he sent destruction on them in the waste land.

chinese: 現在求主大顯能力，照你所說過的話說：
english: So now, may my prayer come before you, and let the power of the Lord be great, as you said:

chinese: 耶和華不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛，赦免罪孽和過犯；萬不以有罪的為無罪，必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。
english: The Lord is slow to wrath and great in mercy, overlooking wrongdoing and evil, and will not let wrongdoers go free; sending punishment on children for the sins of their fathers, to the third and fourth generation.

chinese: 求你照你的大慈愛赦免這百姓的罪孽，好像你從埃及到如今常赦免他們一樣。
english: May the sin of this people have forgiveness, in the measure of your great mercy, as you have had mercy on them from Egypt up till now.

chinese: 耶和華說：我照著你的話赦免了他們。
english: And the Lord said, I have had mercy, as you say:

chinese: 然我指著我的永生起誓，遍地要被我的榮耀充滿。
english: But truly, as I am living, and as all the earth will be full of the glory of the Lord;

chinese: 這些人雖看見我的榮耀和我在埃及與曠野所行的神蹟，仍然試探我這十次，不聽從我的話，
english: Because all these men, having seen my glory and the signs which I have done in Egypt and in the waste land, still have put me to the test ten times, and have not given ear to my voice;

chinese: 他們斷不得看見我向他們的祖宗所起誓應許之地。凡藐視我的，一個也不得看見；
english: They will not see the land about which I made an oath to their fathers; not one of these by whom I have not been honoured will see it.

chinese: 惟獨我的僕人迦勒，因他另有一個心志，專一跟從我，我就把他領進他所去過的那地；他的後裔也必得那地為業。
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had a different spirit in him, and has been true to me with all his heart, him I will take into that land into which he went, and his seed will have it for their heritage.

chinese: 亞瑪力人和迦南人住在谷中，明天你們要轉回，從紅海的路往曠野去。
english: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites are in the valley; tomorrow, turning round, go into the waste land by the way to the Red Sea.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
english: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 這惡會眾向我發怨言，我忍耐他們要到幾時呢？以色列人向我所發的怨言，我都聽見了。
english: How long am I to put up with this evil people and their outcries against me? The words which they say against me have come to my ears.

chinese: 你們告訴他們，耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，我必要照你們達到我耳中的話待你們。
english: Say to them, By my life, says the Lord, as certainly as your words have come to my ears, so certainly will I do this to you:

chinese: 你們的屍首必倒在這曠野，並且你們中間凡被數點、從二十歲以外、向我發怨言的，
english: Your dead bodies will be stretched out in this waste land; and of all your number, all those of twenty years old and over who have been crying out against me,

chinese: 必不得進我起誓應許叫你們住的那地；惟有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞才能進去。
english: Not one will come into the land which I gave my word you would have for your resting-place, but only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua, the son of Nun.

chinese: 但你們的婦人孩子，就是你們所說、要被擄掠的，我必把他們領進去，他們就得知你們所厭棄的那地。
english: And your little ones, whom you said would come into strange hands, I will take in, and they will see the land which you would not have.

chinese: 至於你們，你們的屍首必倒在這曠野；
english: But as for you, your dead bodies will be stretched in this waste land.

chinese: 你們的兒女必在曠野飄流四十年，擔當你們淫行的罪，直到你們的屍首在曠野消滅。
english: And your children will be wanderers in the waste land for forty years, undergoing punishment for your false ways, till your bodies become dust in the waste land.

chinese: 按你們窺探那地的四十日，一年頂一日，你們要擔當罪孽四十年，就知道我與你們疏遠了，
english: And as you went through the land viewing it for forty days, so for forty years, a year for every day, you will undergo punishment for your wrongdoing, and you will see that I am against you.

chinese: 我─耶和華說過，我總要這樣待這一切聚集敵我的惡會眾；他們必在這曠野消滅，在這裡死亡。
english: I the Lord have said it, and this I will certainly do to all this evil people who have come together against me: in this waste land destruction will come on them, and death will be their fate.

chinese: 摩西所打發、窺探那地的人回來，報那地的惡信，叫全會眾向摩西發怨言，
english: And the men whom Moses sent to see the land, and who, by the bad account they gave of the land, were the cause of the outcry the people made against Moses,

chinese: 這些報惡信的人都遭瘟疫，死在耶和華面前。
english: Those same men who said evil of the land, came to their death by disease before the Lord.

chinese: 其中惟有嫩的兒子約書亞和耶孚尼的兒子迦勒仍然存活。
english: But Joshua, the son of Nun, and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, of those who went to see the land, were not touched by disease.

chinese: 摩西將這些話告訴以色列眾人，他們就甚悲哀。
english: And when Moses put these words before the children of Israel, the people were full of grief.

chinese: 清早起來，上山頂去，說：我們在這裡，我們有罪了；情願上耶和華所應許的地方去。
english: And early in the morning they got up and went to the top of the mountain, saying, We are here and we will go up to the place which the Lord said he would give us: for we have done wrong.

chinese: 摩西說：你們為何違背耶和華的命令呢？這事不能順利了。
english: And Moses said, Why are you now acting against the Lord's order, seeing that no good will come of it?

chinese: 不要上去；因為耶和華不在你們中間，恐怕你們被仇敵殺敗了。
english: Go not up, for the Lord is not with you, and you will be overcome by those who are fighting against you.

chinese: 亞瑪力人和迦南人都在你們面前，你們必倒在刀下；因你們退回不跟從耶和華，所以他必不與你們同在。
english: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you will be put to death by their swords: because you have gone back from the way of the Lord, the Lord will not be with you.

chinese: 他們卻擅敢上山頂去，然而耶和華的約櫃和摩西沒有出營。
english: But they gave no attention to his words and went to the top of the mountain, though Moses and the ark of the Lord's agreement did not go out of the tent-circle.

chinese: 於是亞瑪力人和住在那山上的迦南人都下來擊打他們，把他們殺退了，直到何珥瑪。
english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who were living in the hill-country, and overcame them completely, driving them back as far as Hormah.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所賜給你們居住的地，
english: Say to the children of Israel, When you have come into the land which I am giving to you for your resting-place,

chinese: 若願意從牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，獻給耶和華，無論是燔祭是平安祭，為要還特許的願，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你們節期獻的，都要奉給耶和華為馨香之祭。
english: And are going to make an offering by fire to the Lord, a burned offering or an offering in connection with an oath, or an offering freely given, or at your regular feasts, an offering for a sweet smell to the Lord, from the herd or the flock:

chinese: 那獻供物的就要將細麵伊法十分之一，並油一欣四分之一，調和作素祭，獻給耶和華。
english: Then let him who is making his offering, give to the Lord a meal offering of a tenth part of a measure of the best meal mixed with a fourth part of a hin of oil:

chinese: 無論是燔祭是平安祭，你要為每隻綿羊羔，一同預備奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。
english: And for the drink offering, you are to give with the burned offering or other offering, the fourth part of a hin of wine for every lamb.

chinese: 為公綿羊預備細麵伊法十分之二，並油一欣三分之一，調和作素祭，
english: Or for a male sheep, give as a meal offering two tenth parts of a measure of the best meal mixed with a third part of a hin of oil:

chinese: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，獻給耶和華為馨香之祭。
english: And for the drink offering give a third part of a hin of wine, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 你預備公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，為要還特許的願，或是作平安祭，獻給耶和華，
english: And when you make ready a young ox for a burned or other offering, or for the effecting of an oath, or for peace-offerings to the Lord:

chinese: 就要把細麵伊法十分之三，並油半欣，調和作素祭，和公牛一同獻上，
english: Then with the ox give a meal offering of three tenth parts of a measure of the best meal mixed with half a hin of oil.

chinese: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: And for the drink offering: give half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 獻公牛、公綿羊、綿羊羔、山羊羔，每隻都要這樣辦理。
english: This is to be done for every young ox and for every male sheep or he-lamb or young goat.

chinese: 照你們所預備的數目，按著隻數都要這樣辦理。
english: Whatever number you make ready, so you are to do for every one.

chinese: 凡本地人將馨香的火祭獻給耶和華，都要這樣辦理。
english: All those who are Israelites by birth are to do these things in this way, when giving an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 若有外人和你們同居，或有人世世代代住在你們中間，願意將馨香的火祭獻給耶和華，你們怎樣辦理，他也要照樣辦理。
english: And if a man from another country or any other person living among you, through all your generations, has the desire to give an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord, let him do as you do.

chinese: 至於會眾，你們和同居的外人都歸一例，作為你們世世代代永遠的定例，在耶和華面前，你們怎樣，寄居的也要怎樣。
english: There is to be one law for you and for the man of another country living with you, one law for ever from generation to generation; as you are, so is he to be before the Lord.

chinese: 你們並與你們同居的外人當有一樣的條例，一樣的典章。
english: The law and the rule are to be the same for you and for those from other lands living with you.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所領你們進去的那地，
english: Say to the children of Israel, When you come into the land where I am guiding you,

chinese: 吃那地的糧食，就要把舉祭獻給耶和華。
english: Then, when you take for your food the produce of the land, you are to give an offering lifted up before the Lord.

chinese: 你們要用初熟的麥子磨麵，做餅當舉祭奉獻；你們舉上，好像舉禾場的舉祭一樣，
english: Of the first of your rough meal you are to give a cake for a lifted offering, lifting it up before the Lord as the offering of the grain-floor is lifted up.

chinese: 你們世世代代要用初熟的麥子磨麵，當舉祭獻給耶和華。
english: From generation to generation you are to give to the Lord a lifted offering from the first of your rough meal.

chinese: 你們有錯誤的時候，不守耶和華所曉諭摩西的這一切命令，
english: And if in error you go against any of these laws which the Lord has given to Moses,

chinese: 就是耶和華藉摩西一切所吩咐你們的，自那日以至你們的世世代代，
english: All the laws which the Lord has given you by the hand of Moses, from the day when the Lord gave them, and ever after from generation to generation;

chinese: 若有誤行，是會眾所不知道的，後來全會眾就要將一隻公牛犢作燔祭，並照典章把素祭和奠祭一同獻給耶和華為馨香之祭，又獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭。
english: Then, if the wrong is done in error, without the knowledge of the meeting of the people, let all the meeting give a young ox as a burned offering, a sweet smell to the Lord, with its meal offering and its drink offering, as is ordered in the law, together with a he-goat for a sin-offering.

chinese: 祭司要為以色列全會眾贖罪，他們就必蒙赦免，因為這是錯誤。他們又因自己的錯誤，把供物，就是向耶和華獻的火祭和贖罪祭，一並奉到耶和華面前。
english: So the priest will make the people free from sin, and they will have forgiveness; for it was an error, and they have given their offering made by fire to the Lord, and their sin-offering before the Lord, on account of their error:

chinese: 以色列全會眾和寄居在他們中間的外人就必蒙赦免，因為這罪是百姓誤犯的。
english: And all the meeting of the children of Israel, as well as those from other lands living among them, will have forgiveness; for it was an error on the part of the people.

chinese: 若有一個人誤犯了罪，他就要獻一歲的母山羊作贖罪祭。
english: And if one person does wrong, without being conscious of it, then let him give a she-goat of the first year for a sin-offering.

chinese: 那誤行的人犯罪的時候，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪，他就必蒙赦免。
english: And the priest will take away the sin of the person who has done wrong, if the wrong was done unconsciously, and he will have forgiveness.

chinese: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他們中間的外人，若誤行了甚麼事，必歸一樣的條例，
english: The law in connection with wrong done unconsciously is to be the same for him who is an Israelite by birth and for the man from another country who is living among them.

chinese: 但那擅敢行事的，無論是本地人是寄居的，他褻瀆了耶和華，必從民中剪除。
english: But the person who does wrong in the pride of his heart, if he is one of you or of another nation by birth, is acting without respect for the Lord, and will be cut off from his people.

chinese: 因他藐視耶和華的言語，違背耶和華的命令，那人總要剪除；他的罪孽要歸到他身上。
english: Because he had no respect for the word of the Lord, and did not keep his law, that man will be cut off without mercy and his sin will be on him.

chinese: 以色列人在曠野的時候，遇見一個人在安息日撿柴。
english: Now while the children of Israel were in the waste land, they saw a man who was getting sticks on the Sabbath day.

chinese: 遇見他撿柴的人，就把他帶到摩西、亞倫並全會眾那裡，
english: And those who saw him getting sticks took him before Moses and Aaron and all the people.

chinese: 將他收在監內；因為當怎樣辦他，還沒有指明。
english: And they had him shut up, because they had no directions about what was to be done with him.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：總要把那人治死；全會眾要在營外用石頭把他打死。
english: Then the Lord said to Moses, Certainly the man is to be put to death: let him be stoned by all the people outside the tent-circle.

chinese: 於是全會眾將他帶到營外，用石頭打死他，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: So all the people took him outside the tent-circle and he was stoned to death there, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐以色列人，叫他們世世代代在衣服邊上做繸子，又在底邊的繸子上釘一根藍細帶子。
english: Say to the children of Israel that through all their generations they are to put on the edges of their robes an ornament of twisted threads, and in every ornament a blue cord;

chinese: 你們佩帶這繸子，好叫你們看見就記念遵行耶和華一切的命令，不隨從自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你們素常一樣；
english: So that, looking on these ornaments, you may keep in mind the orders of the Lord and do them; and not be guided by the desires of your hearts and eyes, through which you have been untrue to me:

chinese: 使你們記念遵行我一切的命令，成為聖潔，歸與你們的神。
english: And that you may keep in mind all my orders and do them and be holy to your God.

chinese: 我是耶和華─你們的神，曾把你們從埃及地領出來，要作你們的　神。我是耶和華─你們的　神。
english: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, so that I might be your God: I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 利未的曾孫、哥轄的孫子、以斯哈的兒子可拉，和流便子孫中以利押的兒子大坍、亞比蘭，與比勒的兒子安，
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Pallu, the son of Reuben, made themselves ready,

chinese: 並以色列會中的二百五十個首領，就是有名望選入會中的人，在摩西面前一同起來，
english: And came before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty chiefs of the people, men of good name who had a place in the meeting of the people.

chinese: 聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫，說：你們擅自專權！全會眾個個既是聖潔，耶和華也在他們中間，你們為甚麼自高，超過耶和華的會眾呢？
english: They came together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, You take overmuch on yourselves, seeing that all the people are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them; why then have you put yourselves in authority over the people of the Lord?

chinese: 摩西聽見這話就俯伏在地，
english: And Moses, hearing this, went down on his face;

chinese: 對可拉和他一黨的人說：到了早晨，耶和華必指示誰是屬他的，誰是聖潔的，就叫誰親近他；他所揀選的是誰，必叫誰親近他。
english: And he said to Korah and his band, In the morning the Lord will make clear who are his, and who is holy, and who may come near him: the man of his selection will be caused to come near him.

chinese: 可拉阿，你們要這樣行，你和你的一黨要拿香爐來。
english: So do this: let Korah and all his band take vessels for burning perfumes;

chinese: 明日，在耶和華面前，把火盛在爐中，把香放在其上。耶和華揀選誰，誰就為聖潔。你們這利未的子孫擅自專權了！
english: And put spices on the fire in them before the Lord tomorrow; then the man marked out by the Lord will be holy: you take overmuch on yourselves, you sons of Levi.

chinese: 摩西又對可拉說：利未的子孫哪，你們聽我說！
english: And Moses said to Korah, Give ear now, you sons of Levi:

chinese: 以色列的神從以色列會中將你們分別出來，使你們親近他，辦耶和華帳幕的事，並站在會眾面前替他們當差。
english: Does it seem only a small thing to you that the God of Israel has made you separate from the rest of Israel, letting you come near himself to do the work of the House of the Lord, and to take your place before the people to do what has to be done for them;

chinese: 耶和華又使你和你一切弟兄─利未的子孫─一同親近他，這豈為小事？你們還要求祭司的職任麼？
english: Letting you, and all your brothers the sons of Levi, come near to him? and would you now be priests?

chinese: 你和你一黨的人聚集是要攻擊耶和華。亞倫算甚麼，你們竟向他發怨言呢？
english: So you and all your band have come together against the Lord; and Aaron, who is he, that you are crying out against him?

chinese: 摩西打發人去召以利押的兒子大坍、亞比蘭。他們說：我們不上去！
english: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: and they said, We will not come up:

chinese: 你將我們從流奶與蜜之地領上來，要在曠野殺我們，這豈為小事？你還要自立為王轄管我們麼？
english: Is it not enough that you have taken us from a land flowing with milk and honey, to put us to death in the waste land, but now you are desiring to make yourself a chief over us?

chinese: 並且你沒有將我們領到流奶與蜜之地，也沒有把田地和葡萄園給我們為業。難道你要剜這些人的眼睛麼？我們不上去！
english: And more than this, you have not taken us into a land flowing with milk and honey, or given us a heritage of fields and vine-gardens: will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up.

chinese: 摩西就甚發怒，對耶和華說：求你不要享受他們的供物。我並沒有奪過他們一匹驢，也沒有害過他們一個人。
english: Then Moses was very angry, and said to the Lord, Give no attention to their offering: not one of their asses have I taken, or done wrong to any of them.

chinese: 摩西對可拉說：明天，你和你一黨的人，並亞倫，都要站在耶和華面前；
english: And Moses said to Korah, You and all your band are to come before the Lord tomorrow, you and they and Aaron:

chinese: 各人要拿一個香爐，共二百五十個，把香放在上面，到耶和華面前。你和亞倫也各拿自己的香爐。
english: And let every man take a vessel for burning perfumes, and put sweet spices in them; let every man take his vessel before the Lord, two hundred and fifty vessels; you and Aaron and everyone with his vessel.

chinese: 於是他們各人拿一個香爐，盛上火，加上香，同摩西、亞倫站在會幕門前。
english: So every man took his vessel and they put fire in them, with spices, and came to the door of the Tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.

chinese: 可拉招聚全會眾到會幕門前，要攻擊摩西、亞倫；耶和華的榮光就向全會眾顯現。
english: And Korah made all the people come together against them to the door of the Tent of meeting: and the glory of the Lord was seen by all the people.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 你們離開這會眾，我好在轉眼之間把他們滅絕。
english: Come out from among this people, so that I may send sudden destruction on them.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫就俯伏在地，說：神，萬人之靈的神阿，一人犯罪，你就要向全會眾發怒麼？
english: Then falling down on their faces they said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, because of one man's sin will your wrath be moved against all the people?

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐會眾說：你們離開可拉、大坍、亞比蘭帳棚的四圍。
english: Say to the people, Come away from the tent of Korah Dathan, and Abiram.

chinese: 摩西起來，往大坍、亞比蘭那裡去；以色列的長老也隨著他去。
english: So Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the responsible men of Israel went with him.

chinese: 他吩咐會眾說：你們離開這惡人的帳棚罷，他們的物件，甚麼都不可摸，恐怕你們陷在他們的罪中，與他們一同消滅。
english: And he said to the people, Come away now from the tents of these evil men, without touching anything of theirs, or you may be taken in the punishment of their sins.

chinese: 於是眾人離開可拉、大坍、亞比蘭帳棚的四圍。大坍、亞比蘭帶著妻子、兒女、小孩子，都出來，站在自己的帳棚門口。
english: So on every side they went away from the tent of Korah Dathan, and Abiram: and Dathan and Abiram came out to the door of their tents, with their wives and their sons and their little ones.

chinese: 摩西說：我行的這一切事本不是憑我自己心意行的，乃是耶和華打發我行的，必有證據使你們知道。
english: And Moses said, Now you will see that the Lord has sent me to do all these works, and I have not done them of myself.

chinese: 這些人死若與世人無異，或是他們所遭的與世人相同，就不是耶和華打發我來的。
english: If these men have the common death of men, or if the natural fate of all men overtakes them, then the Lord has not sent me.

chinese: 倘若耶和華創作一件新事，使地開口，把他們和一切屬他們的都吞下去，叫他們活活的墜落陰間，你們就明白這些人是藐視耶和華了。
english: But if the Lord does something new, opening the earth to take them in, with everything which is theirs, and they go down living into the underworld, then it will be clear to you that the Lord has not been honoured by these men.

chinese: 摩西剛說完了這一切話，他們腳下的地就開了口，
english: And while these words were on his lips, the earth under them was parted in two;

chinese: 把他們和他們的家眷，並一切屬可拉的人丁、財物，都吞下去。
english: And the earth, opening her mouth, took them in, with their families, and all the men who were joined to Korah, and their goods.

chinese: 這樣，他們和一切屬他們的，都活活的墜落陰間；地口在他們上頭照舊合閉，他們就從會中滅亡。
english: So they and all theirs went down living into the underworld, and the earth was shut over them, and they were cut off from among the meeting of the people.

chinese: 在他們四圍的以色列眾人聽他們呼號，就都逃跑，說：恐怕地也把我們吞下去。
english: And all Israel round about them went in flight at their cry, For fear, said they, that we go down into the heart of the earth.

chinese: 又有火從耶和華那裡出來，燒滅了那獻香的二百五十個人。
english: Then fire came out from the Lord, burning up the two hundred and fifty men who were offering the perfume.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒從火中撿起那些香爐來，把火撒在別處，因為那些香爐是聖的。
english: Say to Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, that he is to take out of the flames the vessels with the perfumes in them, turning the fire out of them, for they are holy;

chinese: 把那些犯罪、自害己命之人的香爐，叫人錘成片子，用以包壇。那些香爐本是他們在耶和華面前獻過的，所以是聖的，並且可以給以色列人作記號。
english: And let the vessels of those men, who with their lives have made payment for their sin, be hammered out into plates as a cover for the altar; for they have been offered before the Lord and are holy; so that they may be a sign to the children of Israel.

chinese: 於是祭司以利亞撒將被燒之人所獻的銅香爐拿來，人就錘出來，用以包壇，
english: So Eleazar the priest took the brass vessels which had been offered by those who were burned up, and they were hammered out to make a cover for the altar:

chinese: 給以色列人作紀念，使亞倫後裔之外的人不得近前來在耶和華面前燒香，免得他遭可拉和他一黨所遭的。這乃是照耶和華藉著摩西所吩咐的。
english: To be a sign, kept in memory for ever by the children of Israel, that no man who is not of the seed of Aaron has the right of burning spices before the Lord, so that he may not be like Korah and his band: as the Lord said to him by the mouth of Moses.

chinese: 第二天，以色列全會眾都向摩西、亞倫發怨言說：你們殺了耶和華的百姓了。
english: But on the day after, all the children of Israel made an outcry against Moses and against Aaron, saying, You have put to death the Lord's people.

chinese: 會眾聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫的時候，向會幕觀看，不料，有雲彩遮蓋了，耶和華的榮光顯現。
english: Now when the people had come together against Moses and Aaron, looking in the direction of the Tent of meeting, they saw the cloud covering it, and the glory of the Lord came before their eyes.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫就來到會幕前。
english: Then Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你們離開這會眾，我好在轉眼之間把他們滅絕。他們二人就俯伏於地。
english: Come out from among this people, so that I may send sudden destruction on them. And they went down on their faces.

chinese: 摩西對亞倫說：拿你的香爐，把壇上的火盛在其中，又加上香，快快帶到會眾那裡，為他們贖罪；因為有忿怒從耶和華那裡出來，瘟疫已經發作了。
english: And Moses said to Aaron, Take your vessel and put in it fire from the altar, and sweet spices, and take it quickly into the meeting of the people, and make them free from sin: for wrath has gone out from the Lord, and the disease is starting.

chinese: 亞倫照著摩西所說的拿來，跑到會中，不料，瘟疫在百姓中已經發作了。他就加上香，為百姓贖罪。
english: And at the words of Moses, Aaron took his vessel, and went running among the people; and even then the disease had made a start among them; and he put spices in his vessel to take away the sin of the people.

chinese: 他站在活人死人中間，瘟疫就止住了。
english: And he took his place between the dead and the living: and the disease was stopped.

chinese: 除了因可拉事情死的以外，遭瘟疫死的，共有一萬四千七百人。
english: Now fourteen thousand, seven hundred deaths were caused by that disease, in addition to those who came to their end because of what Korah had done.

chinese: 亞倫回到會幕門口，到摩西那裡，瘟疫已經止住了。
english: Then Aaron went back to Moses to the door of the Tent of meeting: and the disease came to a stop.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭以色列人，從他們手下取杖，每支派一根；從他們所有的首領，按著支派，共取十二根。你要將各人的名字寫在各人的杖上，
english: Say to the children of Israel that they are to give you rods, one for every family, for every chief, the head of his father's house, making twelve rods; let every man's name be placed on his rod.

chinese: 並要將亞倫的名字寫在利未的杖上，因為各族長必有一根杖。
english: And let Aaron's name be placed on the rod of Levi: for there is to be one rod for the head of every family.

chinese: 你要把這些杖存在會幕內法櫃前，就是我與你們相會之處。
english: And let them be stored up in the Tent of meeting, in front of the ark of witness where I come to you.

chinese: 後來我所揀選的那人，他的杖必發芽。這樣，我必使以色列人向你們所發的怨言止息，不再達到我耳中。
english: And the rod of that man who is marked out by me for myself will have buds on it; so I will put a stop to the outcries which the children of Israel make to me against you.

chinese: 於是摩西曉諭以色列人，他們的首領就把杖交給他，按著支派，每首領一根，共有十二根；亞倫的杖也在其中。
english: So Moses gave these orders to the children of Israel, and all their chiefs gave him rods, one for the head of every family, making twelve rods: and Aaron's rod was among them.

chinese: 摩西就把杖存在法櫃的帳幕內，在耶和華面前。
english: And Moses put the rods before the Lord in the Tent of witness.

chinese: 第二天，摩西進法櫃的帳幕去。誰知利未族亞倫的杖已經發了芽，生了花苞，開了花，結了熟杏。
english: Now on the day after, Moses went into the Tent of witness; and he saw that Aaron's rod, the rod of the house of Levi, had put out buds, and was covered with buds and flowers and fruit.

chinese: 摩西就把所有的杖從耶和華面前拿出來，給以色列眾人看；他們看見了，各首領就把自己的杖拿去。
english: Then Moses took out all the rods from before the Lord, and gave them back to the children of Israel: and they saw them, and every man took his rod.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：把亞倫的杖還放在法櫃前，給這些背叛之子留作記號。這樣，你就使他們向我發的怨言止息，免得他們死亡。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Put Aaron's rod back in front of the ark of witness, to be kept for a sign against this false-hearted people, so that you may put a stop to their outcries against me, and death may not overtake them.

chinese: 摩西就這樣行。耶和華怎樣吩咐他，他就怎樣行了。
english: This Moses did: as the Lord gave orders, so he did.

chinese: 以色列人對摩西說：我們死喇！我們滅亡喇！都滅亡喇！
english: And the children of Israel said to Moses, Truly, destruction has come on us; an evil fate has overtaken us all.

chinese: 凡挨近耶和華帳幕的是必死的。我們都要死亡麼？
english: Death will overtake everyone who comes near, who comes near the House of the Lord: are we all to come to destruction?

chinese: 耶和華對亞倫說：你和你的兒子，並你本族的人，要一同擔當干犯聖所的罪孽。你和你的兒子也要一同擔當干犯祭司職任的罪孽。
english: And the Lord said to Aaron, You and your sons and your father's family are to be responsible for all wrongdoing in relation to the holy place: and you and your sons are to be responsible for the errors which come about in your work as priests.

chinese: 你要帶你弟兄利未人，就是你祖宗支派的人前來，使他們與你聯合，服事你，只是你和你的兒子，要一同在法櫃的帳幕前供職。
english: Let your brothers, the family of Levi, come near with you, so that they may be joined with you and be your servants: but you and your sons with you are to go in before the ark of witness.

chinese: 他們要守所吩咐你的，並守全帳幕，只是不可挨近聖所的器具和壇，免得他們和你們都死亡。
english: They are to do your orders and be responsible for the work of the Tent; but they may not come near the vessels of the holy place or the altar, so that death may not overtake them or you.

chinese: 他們要與你聯合，也要看守會幕，辦理帳幕一切的事，只是外人不可挨近你們。
english: They are to be joined with you in the care of the Tent of meeting, doing whatever is needed for the Tent: and no one of any other family may come near you.

chinese: 你們要看守聖所和壇，免得忿怒再臨到以色列人。
english: You are to be responsible for the holy place and the altar, so that wrath may never again come on the children of Israel.

chinese: 我已將你們的弟兄利未人從以色列人中揀選出來歸耶和華，是給你們為賞賜的，為要辦理會幕的事。
english: Now, see, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel: they are given to you and to the Lord, to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 你和你的兒子要為一切屬壇和幔子內的事一同守祭司的職任。你們要這樣供職；我將祭司的職任給你們當作賞賜事奉我。凡挨近的外人必被治死。
english: And you and your sons with you are to be responsible as priests for the altar and everything on it, and everything inside the veil; you are to do the work of priests; I have given you your position as priests; and any other man who comes near will be put to death.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭亞倫說：我已將歸我的舉祭，就是以色列人一切分別為聖的物，交給你經管；因你受過膏，把這些都賜給你和你的子孫，當作永得的分。
english: And the Lord said to Aaron, See, I have given into your care my lifted offerings; even all the holy things of the children of Israel I have given to you and to your sons as your right for ever, because you have been marked with the holy oil.

chinese: 以色列人歸給我至聖的供物，就是一切的素祭、贖罪祭、贖愆祭，其中所有存留不經火的，都為至聖之物，要歸給你和你的子孫。
english: This is to be yours of the most holy things, out of the fire offerings; every offering of theirs, every meal offering and sin-offering, and every offering which they make on account of error, is to be most holy for you and your sons.

chinese: 你要拿這些當至聖物吃；凡男丁都可以吃。你當以此物為聖。
english: As most holy things they are to be your food: let every male have them for food; it is to be holy to you.

chinese: 以色列人所獻的舉祭並搖祭都是你的；我已賜給你和你的兒女，當作永得的分；凡在你家中的潔淨人都可以吃。
english: And this is yours: the lifted offering which they give and all the wave offerings of the children of Israel I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters as your right for ever: everyone in your house who is clean may have them for food.

chinese: 凡油中、新酒中、五穀中至好的，就是以色列人所獻給耶和華初熟之物，我都賜給你。
english: All the best of the oil and the wine and the grain, the first-fruits of them which they give to the Lord, to you have I given them.

chinese: 凡從他們地上所帶來給耶和華初熟之物也都要歸與你。你家中的潔淨人都可以吃。
english: The earliest produce from their land which they take to the Lord is to be yours; everyone in your house who is clean may have it for his food.

chinese: 以色列中一切永獻的都必歸與你。
english: Everything given by oath to the Lord in Israel is to be yours.

chinese: 他們所有奉給耶和華的，連人帶牲畜，凡頭生的，都要歸給你；只是人頭生的，總要贖出來；不潔淨牲畜頭生的，也要贖出來。
english: The first birth of every living thing which is offered to the Lord, of man or beast, is to be yours; but for the first sons of man payment is to be made, and for the first young of unclean beasts.

chinese: 其中在一月之外所當贖的，要照你所估定的價，按聖所的平，用銀子五舍客勒贖出來（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
english: Payment is to be made for these when they are a month old, at the value fixed by you, a price of five shekels by the scale of the holy place, that is, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

chinese: 只是頭生的牛，或是頭生的綿羊和山羊，必不可贖，都是聖的，要把他的血灑在壇上，把他的脂油焚燒，當作馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。
english: But no such payment may be made for the first birth of an ox or a sheep or a goat; these are holy: their blood is to be dropped on the altar, and their fat burned for an offering made by fire, a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 他的肉必歸你，像被搖的胸、被舉的右腿歸你一樣。
english: Their flesh is to be yours; like the breast of the wave offering and the right leg, it is to be yours.

chinese: 凡以色列人所獻給耶和華聖物中的舉祭，我都賜給你和你的兒女，當作永得的分。這是給你和你的後裔、在耶和華面前作為永遠的鹽約（鹽即不廢壞的意思）。
english: All the lifted offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel give to the Lord, I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters as a right for ever. This is an agreement made with salt before the Lord, to you and to your seed for ever.

chinese: 耶和華對亞倫說：你在以色列人的境內不可有產業，在他們中間也不可有分。我就是你的分，是你的產業。
english: And the Lord said to Aaron, You will have no heritage in their land, or any part among them; I am your part and your heritage among the children of Israel.

chinese: 凡以色列中出產的十分之一，我已賜給利未的子孫為業；因他們所辦的是會幕的事，所以賜給他們為酬他們的勞。
english: And to the children of Levi I have given as their heritage all the tenths offered in Israel, as payment for the work they do, the work of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 從今以後，以色列人不可挨近會幕，免得他們擔罪而死。
english: In future the children of Israel are not to come near the Tent of meeting, so that death may not come to them because of sin.

chinese: 惟獨利未人要辦會幕的事，擔當罪孽；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。他們在以色列人中不可有產業；
english: But the Levites are to do the work of the Tent of meeting, and be responsible for errors in connection with it: this is a law for ever through all your generations; and among the children of Israel they will have no heritage.

chinese: 因為以色列人中出產的十分之一，就是獻給耶和華為舉祭的，我已賜給利未人為業。所以我對他們說：在以色列人中不可有產業。
english: For the tenths which the children of Israel give as a lifted offering to the Lord I have given to the Levites as their heritage. and so I have said to them, Among the children of Israel they will have no heritage.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你曉諭利未人說：你們從以色列人中所取的十分之一，就是我給你們為業的，要再從那十分之一中取十分之一作為舉祭獻給耶和華，
english: Say to the Levites, When you take from the children of Israel the tenth which I have given to you from them as your heritage, a tenth part of that tenth is to be offered as an offering lifted up before the Lord.

chinese: 這舉祭要算為你們場上的穀，又如滿酒醡的酒。
english: And this lifted offering is to be put to your credit as if it was grain from the grain-floor and wine from the vines.

chinese: 這樣，你們從以色列人中所得十分之一也要作舉祭獻給耶和華，從這十分之一中，將所獻給耶和華的舉祭歸給祭司亞倫。
english: So you are to make an offering lifted up to the Lord from all the tenths which you get from the children of Israel, giving out of it the Lord's lifted offering to Aaron the priest.

chinese: 奉給你們的一切禮物，要從其中將至好的，就是分別為聖的，獻給耶和華為舉祭。
english: From everything given to you, let the best of it, the holy part of it, be offered as a lifted offering to the Lord.

chinese: 所以你要對利未人說：你們從其中將至好的舉起，這就算為你們場上的糧，又如酒醡的酒。
english: Say to them, then, When the best of it is lifted up on high, it is to be put to the account of the Levites as the increase of the grain-floor and of the place where the grapes are crushed.

chinese: 你們和你們家屬隨處可以吃；這原是你們的賞賜，是酬你們在會幕裡辦事的勞。
english: It is to be your food, for you and your families in every place: it is your reward for your work in the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 你們從其中將至好的舉起，就不至因這物擔罪。你們不可褻瀆以色列人的聖物，免得死亡。
english: And no sin will be yours on account of it, when the best of it has been lifted up on high; you are not to make a wrong use of the holy things of the children of Israel, so that death may not overtake you.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 耶和華命定律法中的一條律例乃是這樣說：你要吩咐以色列人，把一隻沒有殘疾、未曾負軛、純紅的母牛牽到你這裡來，
english: This is the rule of the law which the Lord has made, saying, Give orders to the children of Israel to give you a red cow without any mark on her, and on which the yoke has never been put:

chinese: 交給祭司以利亞撒；他必牽到營外，人就把牛宰在他面前。
english: Give her to Eleazar the priest and let him take her outside the tent-circle and have her put to death before him.

chinese: 祭司以利亞撒要用指頭蘸這牛的血，向會幕前面彈七次。
english: Then let Eleazar the priest take some of her blood on his finger, shaking the blood seven times in the direction of the front of the Tent of meeting:

chinese: 人要在他眼前把這母牛焚燒；牛的皮、肉、血、糞都要焚燒。
english: And the cow is to be burned before him, her skin and her flesh and her blood and her waste are to be burned:

chinese: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱紅色線都丟在燒牛的火中。
english: Then let the priest take cedar-wood and hyssop and red thread, and put them into the fire where the cow is burning.

chinese: 祭司必不潔淨到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後可以進營。
english: And the priest, after washing his clothing and bathing his body in water, may come back to the tent-circle, and will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 燒牛的人必不潔淨到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。
english: And he who does the burning is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

chinese: 必有一個潔淨的人收起母牛的灰，存在營外潔淨的地方，為以色列會眾調做除污穢的水。這本是除罪的。
english: Then let a man who is clean take the dust of the burned cow and put it outside the tent-circle in a clean place, where it is to be kept for the children of Israel and used in making the water which takes away what is unclean: it is a sin-offering.

chinese: 收起母牛灰的人必不潔淨到晚上，要洗衣服。這要給以色列人和寄居在他們中間的外人作為永遠的定例。
english: And he who takes up the dust of the burned cow is to have his clothing washed with water and be unclean till evening: this is to be a law for ever, for the children of Israel as well as for the man from another country who is living among them.

chinese: 摸了人死屍的，就必七天不潔淨。
english: Anyone touching a dead body will be unclean for seven days:

chinese: 那人到第三天要用這除污穢的水潔淨自己，第七天就潔淨了。他若在第三天不潔淨自己，第七天就不潔淨了。
english: On the third day and on the seventh day he is to make himself clean with the water, and so he will be clean: but if he does not do this on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.

chinese: 凡摸了人死屍、不潔淨自己的，就玷污了耶和華的帳幕，這人必從以色列中剪除；因為那除污穢的水沒有灑在他身上，他就為不潔淨，污穢還在他身上。
english: Anyone touching the body of a dead man without making himself clean in this way, makes the House of the Lord unclean; and that man will be cut off from Israel: because the water was not put on him, he will be unclean; his unclean condition is unchanged.

chinese: 人死在帳棚裡的條例乃是這樣：凡進那帳棚的，和一切在帳棚裡的，都必七天不潔淨。
english: This is the law when death comes to a man in his tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, will be unclean for seven days.

chinese: 凡敞口的器皿，就是沒有紮上蓋的，也是不潔淨。
english: And every open vessel without a cover fixed on it will be unclean.

chinese: 無論何人在田野裡摸了被刀殺的，或是屍首，或是人的骨頭，或是墳墓，就要七天不潔淨。
english: And anyone touching one who has been put to death with the sword in the open country, or the body of one who has come to his end by a natural death, or a man's bone, or the resting-place of a dead body, will be unclean for seven days.

chinese: 要為這不潔淨的人拿些燒成的除罪灰放在器皿裡，倒上活水。
english: And for the unclean, they are to take the dust of the burning of the sin-offering, and put flowing water on it in a vessel:

chinese: 必當有一個潔淨的人拿牛膝草蘸在這水中，把水灑在帳棚上，和一切器皿並帳棚內的眾人身上，又灑在摸了骨頭，或摸了被殺的，或摸了自死的，或摸了墳墓的那人身上。
english: And a clean person is to take hyssop and put it in the water, shaking it over the tent, and all the vessels, and the people who were there, and over him by whom the bone, or the body of one who has been put to death with the sword, or the body of one who has come to his end by a natural death, or the resting-place was touched.

chinese: 第三天和第七天，潔淨的人要灑水在不潔淨的人身上，第七天就使他成為潔淨。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就潔淨了。
english: Let the clean person do this to the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he is to make him clean; and after washing his clothing and bathing himself in water, he will be clean in the evening.

chinese: 但那污穢而不潔淨自己的，要將他從會中剪除，因為他玷污了耶和華的聖所。除污穢的水沒有灑在他身上，他是不潔淨的。
english: But the man who, being unclean, does not make himself clean in this way, will be cut off from the meeting of the people, because he has made the holy place of the Lord unclean: the water has not been put on him, he is unclean.

chinese: 這要給你們作為永遠的定例。並且那灑除污穢水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污穢水的，必不潔淨到晚上。
english: This is to be a law for them for ever: he who puts the water on the unclean person is to have his clothing washed; and anyone touching the water will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 不潔淨人所摸的一切物就不潔淨；摸了這物的人必不潔淨到晚上。
english: Anything touched by the unclean person will be unclean; and any person touching it will be unclean till evening.

chinese: 正月間，以色列全會眾到了尋的曠野，就住在加低斯。米利暗死在那裡，就葬在那裡。
english: In the first month all the children of Israel came into the waste land of Zin, and put up their tents in Kadesh; there death came to Miriam, and they put her body to rest in the earth.

chinese: 會眾沒有水喝，就聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫。
english: And there was no water for the people: and they came together against Moses and against Aaron.

chinese: 百姓向摩西爭鬧說：我們的弟兄曾死在耶和華面前，我們恨不得與他們同死。
english: And the people were angry with Moses and said, If only death had overtaken us when our brothers came to their death before the Lord!

chinese: 你們為何把耶和華的會眾領到這曠野、使我們和牲畜都死在這裡呢？
english: Why have you taken the Lord's people into this waste, for death to come to us and to our cattle there?

chinese: 你們為何逼著我們出埃及、領我們到這壞地方呢？這地方不好撒種，也沒有無花果樹、葡萄樹、石榴樹，又沒有水喝。
english: Why have you made us come out of Egypt into this evil place? This is no place of seed or figs or vines or other fruits, and there is no water for drinking.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫離開會眾，到會幕門口，俯伏在地；耶和華的榮光向他們顯現。
english: Then Moses and Aaron went away from the people to the door of the Tent of meeting; and, falling on their faces there, they saw the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你拿著杖去，和你的哥哥亞倫招聚會眾，在他們眼前吩咐磐石發出水來，水就從磐石流出，給會眾和他們的牲畜喝。
english: Take the rod, you and Aaron, your brother, and make all the people come together, and before their eyes give orders to the rock to give out its water; and so make water come out of the rock for them, and give the people and their cattle drink.

chinese: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的，從耶和華面前取了杖去。
english: And Moses took the rod from before the Lord as he gave him orders.

chinese: 摩西、亞倫就招聚會眾到磐石前。摩西說：你們這些背叛的人聽我說：我為你們使水從這磐石中流出來麼？
english: Then Moses and Aaron made the people come together in front of the rock, and he said to them, Give ear now, you people whose hearts are turned from the Lord; are we to get water for you out of the rock?

chinese: 摩西舉手，用杖擊打磐石兩下，就有許多水流出來，會眾和他們的牲畜都喝了。
english: And lifting up his hand, Moses gave the rock two blows with his rod: and water came streaming out, and the people and their cattle had drink enough.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：因為你們不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我為聖，所以你們必不得領這會眾進我所賜給他們的地去。
english: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Because you had not enough faith in me to keep my name holy before the children of Israel, you will not take this people into the land which I have given them.

chinese: 這水名叫米利巴水，是因以色列人向耶和華爭鬧，耶和華就在他們面前顯為聖。（米利巴就是爭鬧的意思）
english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel went against the Lord, and they saw that he was holy among them.

chinese: 摩西從加低斯差遣使者去見以東王，說：你的弟兄以色列人這樣說：我們所遭遇的一切艱難，
english: Then Moses sent men from Kadesh to the king of Edom to say to him, Your brother Israel says, You have knowledge of all the things we have been through;

chinese: 就是我們的列祖下到埃及，我們在埃及久住；埃及人惡待我們的列祖和我們，
english: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we were living in Egypt for a long time; and the Egyptians were cruel to us and to our fathers:

chinese: 我們哀求耶和華的時候，他聽了我們的聲音，差遣使者把我們從埃及領出來。這事你都知道。如今，我們在你邊界上的城加低斯。
english: And the Lord gave ear to the voice of our cry, and sent an angel and took us out of Egypt: and now we are in Kadesh, a town on the edge of your land;

chinese: 求你容我們從你的地經過。我們不走田間和葡萄園，也不喝井裡的水，只走大道（原文作王道），不偏左右，直到過了你的境界。
english: Let us now go through your land: we will not go into field or vine-garden, or take the water of the springs; we will go by the highway, not turning to the right or to the left, till we have gone past the limits of your land.

chinese: 以東王說：你不可從我的地經過，免得我帶刀出去攻擊你。
english: And Edom said, You are not to go through my land, for if you do I will come out against you with the sword.

chinese: 以色列人說：我們要走大道上去；我們和牲畜若喝你的水，必給你價值。不求別的，只求你容我們步行過去。
english: And the children of Israel said to him, We will go up by the highway: and if we or our cattle take of your water, we will give you a price for it: only let us go through on our feet, nothing more.

chinese: 以東王說：你們不可經過！就率領許多人出來，要用強硬的手攻擊以色列人。
english: But he said, You are not to go through. And Edom came out against them in his strength, with a great army.

chinese: 這樣，以東王不肯容以色列人從他的境界過去。於是他們轉去，離開他。
english: So Edom would not let Israel go through his land; and Israel went in another direction.

chinese: 以色列全會眾從加低斯起行，到了何珥山。
english: And they went on from Kadesh, and came, with all their people, to Mount Hor.

chinese: 耶和華在附近以東邊界的何珥山上曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
english: And at Mount Hor, at the edge of the land of Edom, the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

chinese: 亞倫要歸到他列祖（原文作本民）那裡。他必不得入我所賜給以色列人的地；因為在米利巴水，你們違背了我的命。
english: Aaron will be put to rest with his people; he will not go into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you went against my word at the waters of Meribah.

chinese: 你帶亞倫和他的兒子以利亞撒上何珥山，
english: So take Aaron and Eleazar, his son, up into Mount Hor;

chinese: 把亞倫的聖衣脫下來，給他的兒子以利亞撒穿上；亞倫必死在那裡，歸他列祖。
english: And take Aaron's robes off him and put them on Eleazar, his son: and death will come to Aaron there, and he will be put to rest with his people.

chinese: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的行。三人當著會眾的眼前上了何珥山。
english: So Moses did as the Lord had said, and before the eyes of all the people they went up Mount Hor.

chinese: 摩西把亞倫的聖衣脫下來，給他的兒子以利亞撒穿上，亞倫就死在山頂那裡。於是摩西和以利亞撒下了山。
english: And Moses took off Aaron's robes, and put them on Eleazar, his son; and there on the top of the mountain death came to Aaron: then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

chinese: 全會眾，就是以色列全家，見亞倫已經死了，便都為亞倫哀哭了三十天。
english: And when the people saw that Aaron was dead, all the children of Israel gave themselves up to weeping for him for thirty days.

chinese: 住南地的迦南人亞拉得王，聽說以色列人從亞他林路來，就和以色列人爭戰，擄了他們幾個人。
english: And it came to the ears of the Canaanite, the king of Arad, living in the South, that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim, and he came out against them and took some of them prisoners.

chinese: 以色列人向耶和華發願說：你若將這民交付我手，我就把他們的城邑盡行毀滅。
english: Then Israel made an oath to the Lord, and said, If you will give up this people into my hands, then I will send complete destruction on all their towns.

chinese: 耶和華應允了以色列人，把迦南人交付他們，他們就把迦南人和迦南人的城邑盡行毀滅。那地方的名便叫何珥瑪（何珥瑪就是毀滅的意思）。
english: And the Lord, in answer to the voice of Israel, gave the Canaanites up to them; and they put them and their towns completely to destruction: and that place was named Hormah.

chinese: 他們從何珥山起行，往紅海那條路走，要繞過以東地。百姓因這路難行，心中甚是煩躁，
english: Then they went on from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, going round the land of Edom: and the spirit of the people was overcome with weariness on the way.

chinese: 就怨讟神和摩西說：你們為甚麼把我們從埃及領出來、使我們死在曠野呢？這裡沒有糧，沒有水，我們的心厭惡這淡薄的食物。
english: And crying out against God and against Moses, they said, Why have you taken us out of Egypt to come to our death in the waste land? For there is no bread and no water, and this poor bread is disgusting to us.

chinese: 於是耶和華使火蛇進入百姓中間，蛇就咬他們。以色列人中死了許多。
english: Then the Lord sent poison-snakes among the people; and their bites were a cause of death to numbers of the people of Israel.

chinese: 百姓到摩西那裡，說：我們怨讟耶和華和你，有罪了。求你禱告耶和華，叫這些蛇離開我們。於是摩西為百姓禱告。
english: Then the people came to Moses and said, We have done wrong in crying out against the Lord and against you: make prayer to the Lord to take away the snakes from us. So Moses made prayer for the people.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你製造一條火蛇，掛在杆子上；凡被咬的，一望這蛇，就必得活。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Make an image of a snake and put it on a rod, and anyone who has been wounded by the snakes, looking on it will be made well.

chinese: 摩西便製造一條銅蛇，掛在杆子上；凡被蛇咬的，一望這銅蛇就活了。
english: So Moses made a snake of brass and put it on a rod; and anyone who had a snakebite, after looking on the snake of brass, was made well.

chinese: 以色列人起行，安營在阿伯。
english: Then the children of Israel went on and put up their tents in Oboth.

chinese: 又從阿伯起行，安營在以耶亞巴琳，與摩押相對的曠野，向日出之地。
english: And journeying on again from Oboth, they put up their tents in Iye-abarim, in the waste land before Moab looking east.

chinese: 從那裡起行，安營在撒烈谷。
english: And moving on from there, they put up their tents in the valley of Zered.

chinese: 從那裡起行，安營在亞嫩河那邊。這亞嫩河是在曠野，從亞摩利的境界流出來的；原來亞嫩河是摩押的邊界，在摩押和亞摩利人搭界的地方。
english: From there they went on and put up their tents on the other side of the Arnon, which is on the waste land at the edge of the land of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the line of division between Moab and the Amorites:

chinese: 所以耶和華的戰記上說：蘇法的哇哈伯與亞嫩河的谷，
english: As it says in the book of the Wars of the Lord, Vaheb in Suphah, and the valley of the Amon;

chinese: 並向亞珥城眾谷的下坡，是靠近摩押的境界。
english: The slope of the valleys going down to the tents of Ar and touching the edge of Moab.

chinese: 以色列人從那裡起行，到了比珥（比珥就是井的意思）。從前耶和華吩咐摩西說：招聚百姓，我好給他們水喝，說的就是這井。
english: From there they went on to Beer, the water-spring of which the Lord said to Moses, Make the people come together and I will give them water.

chinese: 當時，以色列人唱歌說：井阿，湧上水來！你們要向這井歌唱。
english: Then Israel gave voice to this song: Come up, O water-spring, let us make a song to it:

chinese: 這井是首領和民中的尊貴人用圭用杖所挖所掘的。以色列人從曠野往瑪他拿去，
english: The fountain made by the chiefs, made deep by the great ones of the people, with the law-givers' rod, and with their sticks. Then from the waste land they went on to Mattanah:

chinese: 從瑪他拿到拿哈列，從拿哈列到巴末，
english: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

chinese: 從巴末到了摩押地的谷，又到那下望曠野之毘斯迦的山頂。
english: And from Bamoth to the valley in the open country of Moab, and to the top of Pisgah looking over Jeshimon.

chinese: 以色列人差遣使者去見亞摩利人的王西宏，說：
english: And Israel sent men to Sihon, king of the Amorites, saying,

chinese: 求你容我們從你的地經過；我們不偏入田間和葡萄園，也不喝井裡的水，只走大道（原文作王道），直到過了你的境界。
english: Let me go through your land: we will not go into field or vine-garden, or take the water of the springs; we will go by the highway till we have gone past the limits of your land.

chinese: 西宏不容以色列人從他的境界經過，就招聚他的眾民出到曠野，要攻擊以色列人，到了雅雜與以色列人爭戰。
english: And Sihon would not let Israel go through his land; but got all his people together and went out against Israel into the waste land, as far as Jahaz, to make war on Israel.

chinese: 以色列人用刀殺了他，得了他的地，從亞嫩河到雅博河，直到亞捫人的境界，因為亞捫人的境界多有堅壘。
english: But Israel overcame him, and took all his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the country of the children of Ammon, for the country of the children of Ammon was strongly armed.

chinese: 以色列人奪取這一切的城邑，也住亞摩利人的城邑，就是希實本與希實本的一切鄉村。
english: And Israel took all their towns, living in Heshbon and all the towns and small places of the Amorites.

chinese: 這希實本是亞摩利王西宏的京城；西宏曾與摩押的先王爭戰，從他手中奪取了全地，直到亞嫩河。
english: For Heshbon was the town of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who had made war against an earlier king of Moab and taken from him all his land as far as the Arnon.

chinese: 所以那些作詩歌的說：你們來到希實本；願西宏的城被修造，被建立。
english: So the makers of wise sayings say, Come to Heshbon, building up the town of Sihon and making it strong:

chinese: 因為有火從希實本發出，有火燄出於西宏的城，燒盡摩押的亞珥和亞嫩河邱壇的祭司（祭司原文作主）。
english: For a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the town of Sihon: for the destruction of Ar in Moab, and the lords of the high places of the Arnon.

chinese: 摩押阿，你有禍了！基抹的民哪，你們滅亡了！基抹的男子逃奔，女子被擄，交付亞摩利的王西宏。
english: Sorrow is yours, O Moab! Destruction is your fate, O people of Chemosh: his sons have gone in flight, and his daughters are prisoners, in the hands of Sihon, king of the Amorites.

chinese: 我們射了他們；希實本直到底本盡皆毀滅。我們使地變成荒場，直到挪法；這挪法直延到米底巴。
english: They are wounded with our arrows; destruction has come on Heshbon, even to Dibon; and we have made the land waste as far as Nophah, stretching out to Medeba.

chinese: 這樣，以色列人就住在亞摩利人之地。
english: So Israel put up their tents in the land of the Amorites.

chinese: 摩西打發人去窺探雅謝，以色列人就佔了雅謝的鎮市，趕出那裡的亞摩利人。
english: And Moses sent men secretly to Jazer, and they took its towns, driving out the Amorites who were living there.

chinese: 以色列人轉回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的眾民都出來，在以得來與他們交戰。
english: Then turning they went up by the way of Bashan; and Og, king of Bashan, went out against them with all his people, to the fight at Edrei.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：不要怕他！因我已將他和他的眾民，並他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像從前待住希實本的亞摩利王西宏一般。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Have no fear of him: for I have given him up into your hands, with all his people and his land; do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the Amorites, at Heshbon.

chinese: 於是他們殺了他和他的眾子，並他的眾民，沒有留下一個，就得了他的地。
english: So they overcame him and his sons and his people, driving them all out: and they took his land for their heritage.

chinese: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原、約但河東，對著耶利哥安營。
english: Then the children of Israel, journeying on, put up their tents in the lowlands of Moab, on the other side of Jordan at Jericho.

chinese: 以色列人向亞摩利人所行的一切事，西撥的兒子巴勒都看見了。
english: Now Balak, the son of Zippor, saw what Israel had done to the Amorites.

chinese: 摩押人因以色列民甚多，就大大懼怕，心內憂急，
english: And in Moab there was great fear of the people, because their numbers were so great: and the feeling of Moab was bitter against the children of Israel.

chinese: 對米甸的長老說：現在這眾人要把我們四圍所有的一概餂盡，就如牛餂盡田間的草一般。那時西撥的兒子巴勒作摩押王。
english: Then Moab said to the responsible men of Midian, It is clear that this great people will be the destruction of everything round us, making a meal of us as the ox does of the grass of the field. At that time Balak, the son of Zippor, was king of Moab.

chinese: 他差遣使者往大河邊的毘奪去，到比珥的兒子巴蘭本鄉那裡，召巴蘭來，說：有一宗民從埃及出來，遮滿地面，與我對居。
english: So he sent men to Balaam, son of Beor, at Pethor by the River in the land of the children of his people, saying to him, See, a people has come out of Egypt, covering all the face of the earth, and they have put up their tents opposite to me:

chinese: 這民比我強盛，現在求你來為我咒詛他們，或者我能得勝，攻打他們，趕出此地。因為我知道，你為誰祝福，誰就得福；你咒詛誰，誰就受咒詛。
english: Come now, in answer to my prayer, and put a curse on this people, for they are greater than I: and then I may be strong enough to overcome them and send them out of the land: for it is clear that good comes to him who has your blessing, but he on whom you put your curse is cursed.

chinese: 摩押的長老和米甸的長老手裡拿著卦金，到了巴蘭那裡，將巴勒的話都告訴了他。
english: So the responsible men of Moab and Midian went away, taking in their hands rewards for the prophet; and they came to Balaam and said to him what Balak had given them orders to say.

chinese: 巴蘭說：你們今夜在這裡住宿，我必照耶和華所曉諭我的回報你們。摩押的使臣就在巴蘭那裡住下了。
english: And he said to them, Take your rest here tonight, and I will give you an answer after hearing what the Lord says; so the chiefs of Moab kept there with Balaam that night.

chinese: 神臨到巴蘭那裡，說：在你這裡的人都是誰？
english: And God came to Balaam and said, Who are these men with you?

chinese: 巴蘭回答說：是摩押王西撥的兒子巴勒打發人到我這裡來，說：
english: And Balaam said to God, Balak, the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent them to me, saying,

chinese: 從埃及出來的民遮滿地面，你來為我咒詛他們，或者我能與他們爭戰，把他們趕出去。
english: See, the people who have come out of Egypt are covering all the earth: now, put a curse on this people for me, so that I may be able to make war on them, driving them out of the land.

chinese: 神對巴蘭說：你不可同他們去，也不可咒詛那民，因為那民是蒙福的。
english: And God said to Balaam, You are not to go with them, or put a curse on this people, for they have my blessing.

chinese: 巴蘭早晨起來，對巴勒的使臣說：你們回本地去罷，因為耶和華不容我和你們同去。
english: In the morning Balaam got up and said to the chiefs of Balak, Go back to your land, for the Lord will not let me go with you.

chinese: 摩押的使臣就起來，回巴勒那裡去，說：巴蘭不肯和我們同來。
english: So the chiefs of Moab went back to Balak and said, Balaam will not come with us.

chinese: 巴勒又差遣使臣，比先前的又多又尊貴。
english: So Balak sent more chiefs, greater in number and of higher position than the others.

chinese: 他們到了巴蘭那裡，對他說：西撥的兒子巴勒這樣說：求你不容甚麼事攔阻你不到我這裡來，
english: And they came to Balaam and said, Balak, son of Zippor, says, Let nothing keep you from coming to me:

chinese: 因為我必使你得極大的尊榮。你向我要甚麼，我就給你甚麼；只求你來為我咒詛這民。
english: For I will give you a place of very great honour, and whatever you say to me I will do; so come, in answer to my prayer, and put a curse on this people.

chinese: 巴蘭回答巴勒的臣僕說：巴勒就是將他滿屋的金銀給我，我行大事小事也不得越過耶和華─我神的命。
english: But Balaam, in answer; said to the servants of Balak, Even if Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, it would not be possible for me to do anything more or less than the orders of the Lord my God.

chinese: 現在我請你們今夜在這裡住宿，等我得知耶和華還要對我說甚麼。
english: So take your rest here this night, till I have knowledge what more the Lord has to say to me.

chinese: 當夜，神臨到巴蘭那裡，說：這些人若來召你，你就起來同他們去，你只要遵行我對你所說的話。
english: And that night God came to Balaam and said to him, If these men have come for you, go with them: but do only what I say to you.

chinese: 巴蘭早晨起來，備上驢，和摩押的使臣一同去了。
english: So in the morning Balaam got up and, making his ass ready, went with the chiefs of Moab.

chinese: 神因他去就發了怒；耶和華的使者站在路上敵擋他。他騎著驢，有兩個僕人跟隨他。
english: But God was moved to wrath because he went: and the angel of the Lord took up a position in the road to keep him from his purpose. Now he was seated on his ass, and his two servants were with him.

chinese: 驢看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裡有拔出來的刀，就從路上跨進田間，巴蘭便打驢，要叫他回轉上路。
english: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord waiting in the road with his sword in his hand; and turning from the road, the ass went into the field; and Balaam gave the ass blows, to get her back on to the road.

chinese: 耶和華的使者就站在葡萄園的窄路上；這邊有牆，那邊也有牆。
english: Then the angel of the Lord took up his position in a narrow road through the vine-gardens, with a wall on this side and on that.

chinese: 驢看見耶和華的使者，就貼靠牆，將巴蘭的腳擠傷了；巴蘭又打驢。
english: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord, and went near the wall, crushing Balaam's foot against the wall; and he gave her more blows.

chinese: 耶和華的使者又往前去，站在狹窄之處，左右都沒有轉折的地方。
english: Then the angel of the Lord went further, stopping in a narrow place where there was no room for turning to the right or to the left.

chinese: 驢看見耶和華的使者，就臥在巴蘭底下，巴蘭發怒，用杖打驢。
english: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord and went down on the earth under Balaam; and full of wrath, Balaam gave her hard blows with his stick.

chinese: 耶和華叫驢開口，對巴蘭說：我向你行了甚麼，你竟打我這三次呢？
english: Then the Lord gave the ass the power of talking, and opening her mouth she said to Balaam, What have I done to you that you have given me blows these three times?

chinese: 巴蘭對驢說：因為你戲弄我，我恨不能手中有刀，把你殺了。
english: And Balaam said to the ass, You have made me seem foolish: if only I had a sword in my hand I would put you to death.

chinese: 驢對巴蘭說：我不是你從小時直到今日所騎的驢麼？我素常向你這樣行過麼？巴蘭說：沒有。
english: And the ass said to Balaam, Am I not your ass upon which you have gone all your life till this day? and have I ever done this to you before? And he said, No.

chinese: 當時，耶和華使巴蘭的眼目明亮，他就看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裡有拔出來的刀，巴蘭便低頭俯伏在地。
english: Then the Lord made Balaam's eyes open, and he saw the angel of the Lord in the way with his sword in his hand: and he went down on his face to the earth.

chinese: 耶和華的使者對他說：你為何這三次打你的驢呢？我出來敵擋你，因你所行的，在我面前偏僻。
english: And the angel of the Lord said to him, Why have you given your ass blows these three times? See, I have come out against you to keep you back, because your purpose is not pleasing to me.

chinese: 驢看見我就三次從我面前偏過去；驢若沒有偏過去，我早把你殺了，留他存活。
english: And the ass saw me, turning to one side from me three times: if she had not gone to one side, I would certainly have put you to death and kept her safe.

chinese: 巴蘭對耶和華的使者說：我有罪了。我不知道你站在路上阻擋我；你若不喜歡我去，我就轉回。
english: And Balaam said to the angel of the Lord, I have done wrong, for I did not see that you were in the way against me: but now, if it is evil in your eyes, I will go back again.

chinese: 耶和華的使者對巴蘭說：你同這些人去罷！你只要說我對你說的話。於是巴蘭同著巴勒的使臣去了。
english: And the angel of the Lord said to Balaam, Go with the men; but say only what I give you to say. Then Balaam went on with the chiefs of Balak.

chinese: 巴勒聽見巴蘭來了，就往摩押京城去迎接他；這城是在邊界上，在亞嫩河旁。
english: Now Balak, hearing that Balaam had come, went to the chief town of Moab, on the edge of the Arnon, in the farthest part of the land, for the purpose of meeting him.

chinese: 巴勒對巴蘭說：我不是急急的打發人到你那裡去召你麼？你為何不到我這裡來呢？我豈不能使你得尊榮麼？
english: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not send to you, requesting you with all my heart to come to me? why did you not come? am I not able to give you a place of honour?

chinese: 巴蘭說：我已經到你這裡來了！現在我豈能擅自說甚麼呢？神將甚麼話傳給我，我就說甚麼。
english: Then Balaam said to Balak, Now I have come to you; but have I power to say anything? Only what God puts into my mouth may I say.

chinese: 巴蘭和巴勒同行，來到基列胡瑣。
english: And Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath-huzoth.

chinese: 巴勒宰了（原文作獻）牛羊，送給巴蘭和陪伴的使臣。
english: And Balak made offerings of oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam and the chiefs who were with him.

chinese: 到了早晨，巴勒領巴蘭到巴力的高處；巴蘭從那裡觀看以色列營的邊界。
english: And in the morning Balak took Balaam up to the high places of Baal, and from there he was able to see the outer limits of the people.

chinese: 巴蘭對巴勒說：你在這裡給我築七座壇，為我豫備七隻公牛，七隻公羊。
english: And Balaam said to Balak, Make me here seven altars and get ready seven oxen and seven male sheep.

chinese: 巴勒照巴蘭的話行了。巴勒和巴蘭在每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
english: And Balak did as Balaam had said; and Balak and Balaam made an offering on every altar of an ox and a male sheep.

chinese: 巴蘭對巴勒說：你站在你的燔祭旁邊，我且往前去，或者耶和華來迎見我。他指示我甚麼，我必告訴你。於是巴蘭上一淨光的高處。
english: Then Balaam said to Balak, Take your place by your burned offering, and I will go and see if the Lord comes to me: and I will give you word of whatever he says to me. And he went to an open place on a hill.

chinese: 神迎見巴蘭；巴蘭說：我豫備了七座壇，在每座壇上獻了一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
english: And God came to Balaam, and Balaam said to him, I have made ready seven altars, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.

chinese: 耶和華將話傳給巴蘭，又說：你回到巴勒那裡，要如此如此說。
english: And the Lord put words in Balaam's mouth, and said, Go back to Balak, and this is what you are to say.

chinese: 他就回到巴勒那裡，見他同摩押的使臣都站在燔祭旁邊。
english: So he went back to him where he was waiting by his burned offering with all the chiefs of Moab.

chinese: 巴蘭便題起詩歌說：巴勒引我出亞蘭，摩押王引我出東山，說：來阿，為我咒詛雅各；來阿，怒罵以色列。
english: And in the words which the Lord had given him he said, From Aram Balak has sent for me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East: come, put curses on Jacob for me and be angry with Israel.

chinese: 神沒有咒詛的，我焉能咒詛？耶和華沒有怒罵的，我焉能怒罵？
english: How may I put curses on him who is not cursed by God? how may I be angry with him with whom the Lord is not angry?

chinese: 我從高峰看他，從小山望他；這是獨居的民，不列在萬民中。
english: From the top of the rocks I see him, looking down on him from the hills: it is a people made separate, not to be numbered among the nations.

chinese: 誰能數點雅各的塵土？誰能計算以色列的四分之一？我願如義人之死而死；我願如義人之終而終。
english: Who is able to take the measure of the dust of Jacob or the number of the thousands of Israel? May my death be the death of the upright and my last end like his!

chinese: 巴勒對巴蘭說：你向我做的是甚麼事呢？我領你來咒詛我的仇敵，不料，你竟為他們祝福。
english: Then Balak said to Balaam, What have you done to me? I sent for you so that my haters might be cursed, and see, you have given them a blessing.

chinese: 他回答說：耶和華傳給我的話，我能不謹慎傳說麼？
english: And in answer he said, Am I not ordered to say only what the Lord puts into my mouth?

chinese: 巴勒說：求你同我往別處去，在那裡可以看見他們；你不能全看見，只能看見他們邊界上的人。在那裡要為我咒詛他們。
english: And Balak said to him, Come with me now into another place from which you will not be able to see them all, but only the outskirts of them; and you will send curses on them from there.
