chinese: 於是領巴蘭到了瑣腓田，上了毘斯迦山頂，築了七座壇；每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
english: So he took him into the country of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and there they made seven altars, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.

chinese: 巴蘭對巴勒說：你站在這燔祭旁邊，等我往那邊去迎見耶和華。
english: Then he said to Balak, Take your place here by your burned offering, while I go over there to the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華臨到巴蘭那裡，將話傳給他；又說：你回到巴勒那裡，要如此如此說。
english: And the Lord came to Balaam, and put words in his mouth, and said, Go back to Balak, and this is what you are to say.

chinese: 他就回到巴勒那裡，見他站在燔祭旁邊；摩押的使臣也和他在一處。巴勒問他說：耶和華說了甚麼話呢？
english: So he came to him where he was waiting by his burned offering with the chiefs of Moab by his side. And Balak said to him, What has the Lord said?

chinese: 巴蘭就題詩歌說：巴勒，你起來聽；西撥的兒子，你聽我言。
english: And in the words which the Lord had given him he said, Up! Balak, and give ear; give attention to me, O son of Zippor:

chinese: 神非人，必不致說謊，也非人子，必不致後悔。他說話豈不照著行呢？他發言豈不要成就呢？
english: God is not a man, to say what is false; or the son of man, that his purpose may be changed: what he has said, will he not do? and will he not give effect to the words of his mouth?

chinese: 我奉命祝福；神也曾賜福，此事我不能翻轉。
english: See, I have had orders to give blessing: and he has given a blessing which I have no power to take away.

chinese: 他未見雅各中有罪孽，也未見以色列中有奸惡。耶和華─他的神和他同在；有歡呼王的聲音在他們中間。
english: He has seen no evil in Jacob or wrongdoing in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the glad cry of a king is among them.

chinese: 神領他們出埃及；他們似乎有野牛之力。
english: It is God who has taken them out of Egypt; his horns are like those of the mountain ox.

chinese: 斷沒有法術可以害雅各，也沒有占卜可以害以色列。現在必有人論及雅各，就是論及以色列說：神為他行了何等的大事！
english: No evil power has effect against Jacob, no secret arts against Israel; at the right time it will be said of Jacob and of Israel, See what God has done!

chinese: 這民起來，彷彿母獅，挺身，好像公獅，未曾喫野食，未曾喝被傷者之血，決不躺臥。
english: See, Israel comes up like a she-lion, lifting himself up like a lion: he will take no rest till he has made a meal of those he has overcome, drinking the blood of those he has put to death.

chinese: 巴勒對巴蘭說：你一點不要咒詛他們，也不要為他們祝福。
english: Then Balak said to Balaam, If you will not put a curse on them, at all events do not give them a blessing.

chinese: 巴蘭回答巴勒說：我豈不是告訴你說凡耶和華所說的，我必須遵行麼？
english: But Balaam in answer said to Balak, Did I not say to you, I may only do what the Lord says?

chinese: 巴勒對巴蘭說：來罷，我領你往別處去，或者神喜歡你在那裡為我咒詛他們。
english: Then Balak said to Balaam, Come now, I will take you to another place; it may be that God will let you put a curse on them from there.

chinese: 巴勒就領巴蘭到那下望曠野的毘珥山頂上。
english: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, looking down over the waste land.

chinese: 巴蘭對巴勒說：你在這裡為我築七座壇，又在這裡為我豫備七隻公牛，七隻公羊。
english: And Balaam said to Balak, Make me seven altars here and get seven oxen and seven male sheep ready for me.

chinese: 巴勒就照巴蘭的話行，在每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
english: And Balak did as Balaam said, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.

chinese: 巴蘭見耶和華喜歡賜福與以色列，就不像前兩次去求法術，卻面向曠野。
english: Now when Balaam saw that it was the Lord's pleasure to give his blessing to Israel, he did not, as at other times, make use of secret arts, but turning his face to the waste land,

chinese: 巴蘭舉目，看見以色列人照著支派居住。神的靈就臨到他身上，
english: And lifting up his eyes, he saw Israel there, with their tents in the order of their tribes: and the spirit of God came on him.

chinese: 他便題起詩歌說：比珥的兒子巴蘭說，眼目閉住的人說，（閉住或作：睜開）
english: And moved by the spirit, he said, These are the words of Balaam, son of Beor, the words of the man whose eyes are open:

chinese: 得聽神的言語，得見全能者的異象，眼目睜開而仆倒的人說：
english: He says, whose ears are open to the words of God, who has seen the vision of the Ruler of all, falling down, but having his eyes open:

chinese: 雅各阿，你的帳棚何等華美！以色列阿，你的帳幕何其華麗！
english: How fair are your tents, O Jacob, your houses, O Israel!

chinese: 如接連的山谷，如河旁的園子，如耶和華所栽的沉香樹，如水邊的香柏木。
english: They are stretched out like valleys, like gardens by the riverside, like flowering trees planted by the Lord, like cedar-trees by the waters.

chinese: 水要從他的桶裡流出；種子要撒在多水之處。他的王必超過亞甲；他的國必要振興。
english: Peoples will be in fear before his strength, his arm will be on great nations: his king will be higher than Agag, and his kingdom made great in honour.

chinese: 神領他出埃及；他似乎有野牛之力。他要吞喫敵國，折斷他們的骨頭，用箭射透他們。
english: It is God who has taken him out of Egypt; his horns are like those of the mountain ox; the nations warring against him will be his food, their bones will be broken, they will be wounded with his arrows.

chinese: 他蹲如公獅，臥如母獅，誰敢惹他？凡給你祝福的，願他蒙福；凡咒詛你的，願他受咒詛。
english: He took his sleep stretched out like a lion, and like a she-lion: by whom will his rest be broken? May a blessing be on everyone who gives you blessing, and a curse on everyone by whom you are cursed.

chinese: 巴勒向巴蘭生氣，就拍起手來，對巴蘭說：我召你來為我咒詛仇敵，不料，你這三次竟為他們祝福。
english: Then Balak was full of wrath against Balaam, and angrily waving his hands he said to Balaam, I sent for you so that those who are against me might be cursed, but now, see, three times you have given them a blessing.

chinese: 如今你快回本地去罷！我想使你得大尊榮，耶和華卻阻止你不得尊榮。
english: Go back quickly to the place you came from: it was my purpose to give you a place of honour, but now the Lord has kept you back from honour.

chinese: 巴蘭對巴勒說：我豈不是對你所差遣到我那裡的使者說：
english: Then Balaam said to Balak, Did I not say to the men you sent to me,

chinese: 巴勒就是將他滿屋的金銀給我，我也不得越過耶和華的命，憑自己的心意行好行歹。耶和華說甚麼，我就要說甚麼？
english: Even if Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, it would not be possible for me to go outside the orders of the Lord, doing good or evil at the impulse of my mind; whatever the Lord says I will say?

chinese: 現在我要回本族去。你來，我告訴你這民日後要怎樣待你的民。
english: So now I will go back to my people: but first let me make clear to you what this people will do to your people in days to come.

chinese: 他就題起詩歌說：比珥的兒子巴蘭說：眼目閉住的人說，（閉住或作：睜開）
english: Then he went on with his story and said, These are the words of Balaam, the son of Beor, the words of him whose eyes are open:

chinese: 得聽神的言語，明白至高者的意旨，看見全能者的異象，眼目睜開而仆倒的人說：
english: He says, whose ear is open to the words of God, who has knowledge of the Most High, who has seen the vision of the Ruler of all, falling down and having his eyes open:

chinese: 我看他卻不在現時；我望他卻不在近日。有星要出於雅各，有杖要興於以色列，必打破摩押的四角，毀壞擾亂.之子。
english: I see him, but not now: looking on him, but not near: a star will come out of Jacob, and a rod of authority out of Israel, sending destruction to the farthest limits of Moab and on the head of all the sons of Sheth.

chinese: 他必得以東為基業，又得仇敵之地西珥為產業；以色列必行事勇敢。
english: Edom will be his heritage, and he will put an end to the last of the people of Seir.

chinese: 有一位出於雅各的，必掌大權；他要除滅城中的餘民。
english: And Israel will go on in strength, and Jacob will have rule over his haters.

chinese: 巴蘭觀看亞瑪力，就題起詩歌說：亞瑪力原為諸國之首，但他終必沉淪。
english: Then, turning his eyes to Amalek, he went on with his story and said, Amalek was the first of the nations, but his part will be destruction for ever.

chinese: 巴蘭觀看基尼人，就題起詩歌說：你的住處本是堅固；你的窩巢做在巖穴中。
english: And looking on the Kenites he went on with his story and said, Strong is your living-place, and your secret place is safe in the rock.

chinese: 然而基尼必至衰微，直到亞述把你擄去。
english: But still the Kenites will be wasted, till Asshur takes you away prisoner.

chinese: 巴蘭又題起詩歌說：哀哉！神行這事，誰能得活？
english: Then he went on with his story and said, But who may keep his life when God does this?

chinese: 必有人乘船從基提界而來，苦害亞述，苦害希伯；他也必至沉淪。
english: But ships will come from the direction of Kittim, troubling Asshur and troubling Eber, and like the others their fate will be destruction.

chinese: 於是巴蘭起來，回他本地去；巴勒也回去了。
english: Then Balaam got up and went back to his place: and Balak went away.

chinese: 以色列人住在什亭，百姓與摩押女子行起淫亂。
english: Now when Israel was living in Shittim the people became false to the Lord, doing evil with the daughters of Moab:

chinese: 因為這女子叫百姓來，一同給他們的神獻祭，百姓就吃他們的祭物，跪拜他們的　神。
english: For they sent for the people to be present at the offerings made to their gods; and the people took part in their feasts and gave honour to their gods.

chinese: 以色列人與巴力毘珥連合，耶和華的怒氣就向以色列人發作。
english: So Israel had relations with the women of Moab in honour of the Baal of Peor: and the Lord was moved to wrath against Israel.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：將百姓中所有的族長在我面前對著日頭懸掛，使我向以色列人所發的怒氣可以消了。
english: Then the Lord said to Moses, Take all the chiefs of the people, hanging them up in the sun before the Lord, so that the wrath of the Lord may be turned from Israel.

chinese: 於是摩西吩咐以色列的審判官說：凡屬你們的人，有與巴力毘珥連合的，你們各人要把他們殺了。
english: So Moses said to the judges of Israel, Let everyone put to death those of his men who have had relations with the women of Moab in honour of the Baal of Peor.

chinese: 摩西和以色列全會眾正在會幕門前哭泣的時候，誰知，有以色列中的一個人，當他們眼前，帶著一個米甸女人到他弟兄那裡去。
english: Then one of the children of Israel came to his brothers, taking with him a woman of Midian, before the eyes of Moses and all the meeting of the people, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 祭司亞倫的孫子，以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈看見了，就從會中起來，手裡拿著槍，
english: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, seeing it, got up from among the people and took a spear in his hand,

chinese: 跟隨那以色列人進亭子裡去，便將以色列人和那女人由腹中刺透。這樣，在以色列人中瘟疫就止息了。
english: And went after the man of Israel into the tent, driving the spear through the two of them, through the man of Israel and through the stomach of the woman. So the disease was stopped among the children of Israel.

chinese: 那時遭瘟疫死的，有二萬四千人。
english: But twenty-four thousand of them had come to their death by the disease.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 祭司亞倫的孫子，以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈，使我向以色列人所發的怒消了；因他在他們中間，以我的忌邪為心，使我不在忌邪中把他們除滅。
english: Through Phinehas, and because of his passion for my honour, my wrath has been turned away from the children of Israel, so that I have not sent destruction on them all in my wrath.

chinese: 因此，你要說：我將我平安的約賜給他。
english: So say to them that I will make with him an agreement of peace:

chinese: 這約要給他和他的後裔，作為永遠當祭司職任的約；因他為神有忌邪的心，為以色列人贖罪。
english: And by this agreement, he and his sons after him have the right to be priests for ever; because, by his care for the honour of his God, he took away the sin of the children of Israel.

chinese: 那與米甸女人一同被殺的以色列人，名叫心利，是撒路的兒子，是西緬一個宗族的首領。
english: Now the man of Israel who was put to death with the woman of Midian was Zimri, the son of Salu, a chief of one of the families of the Simeonites.

chinese: 那被殺的米甸女人，名叫哥斯比，是蘇珥的女兒；這蘇珥是米甸.一個宗族的首領。
english: And the woman of Midian who was put to death was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was the head of a family in Midian.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: Then the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要擾害米甸人，擊殺他們；
english: Take up arms against the Midianites and overcome them;

chinese: 因為他們用詭計擾害你們，在毘珥的事上和他們的姊妹、米甸首領的女兒哥斯比的事上，用這詭計誘惑了你們；這哥斯比，當瘟疫流行的日子，因毘珥的事被殺了。
english: For they are a danger to you with their false ways, causing sin to come on you in the question of Peor, and because of Cozbi, their sister, the daughter of the chief of Midian, who was put to death at the time of the disease which came on you because of Peor.

chinese: 瘟疫之後，耶和華曉諭摩西和祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒說：
english: Now after the disease was over, the Lord said to Moses and Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest,

chinese: 你們要將以色列全會眾，按他們的宗族，凡以色列中從二十歲以外、能出去打仗的，計算總數。
english: Let all the children of Israel be numbered, by the names of their fathers' families, all those of twenty years old and over who are able to go to war in Israel.

chinese: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒在摩押平原與耶利哥相對的約但河邊向以色列人說：
english: So Moses and Eleazar the priest gave them the order in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, saying,

chinese: 將你們中間從二十歲以外的計算總數；是照耶和華吩咐出埃及地的摩西和以色列人的話。
english: Let all the people of twenty years old and over be numbered, as the Lord has given orders to Moses and the children of Israel who have come out of Egypt.

chinese: 以色列的長子是流便。流便的眾子：屬哈諾的，有哈諾族；屬法路的，有法路族；
english: Reuben, the first son of Israel: the sons of Reuben by their families: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

chinese: 屬希斯倫的，有希斯倫族；屬迦米的，有迦米族；
english: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

chinese: 這就是流便的各族；其中被數的，共有四萬三千七百三十名。
english: These are the families of the Reubenites: their number was forty-three thousand, seven hundred and thirty.

chinese: 法路的兒子是以利押。
english: And the sons of Pallu, Eliab

chinese: 以利押的眾子是尼母利、大坍、亞比蘭。這大坍、亞比蘭，就是從會中選召的，與可拉一黨同向耶和華爭鬧的時候也向摩西、亞倫爭鬧；
english: And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram who had a place in the meeting of the people, who together with Korah made an outcry against Moses and Aaron and against the Lord:

chinese: 地便開口吞了他們，和可拉、可拉的黨類一同死亡。那時火燒滅了二百五十個人；他們就作了警戒。
english: And they went down into the open mouth of the earth, together with Korah, when death overtook him and all his band; at the time when two hundred and fifty men were burned in the fire, and they became a sign.

chinese: 然而可拉的眾子沒有死亡。
english: But death did not overtake the sons of Korah.

chinese: 按著家族，西緬的眾子：屬尼母利的，有尼母利族；屬雅憫的，有雅憫族；屬雅斤的，有雅斤族；
english: The sons of Simeon by their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

chinese: 屬謝拉的，有謝拉族；屬掃羅的，有掃羅族。
english: Of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

chinese: 這就是西緬的各族，共有二萬二千二百名。
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand, two hundred.

chinese: 按著家族，迦得的眾子：屬洗分的，有洗分族；屬哈基的，有哈基族；屬書尼的，有書尼族；
english: The sons of Gad by their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

chinese: 屬阿斯尼的，有阿斯尼族；屬以利的，有以利族；
english: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

chinese: 屬亞律的，有亞律族；屬亞列利的，有亞列利族。
english: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

chinese: 這就是迦得子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad as they were numbered, forty thousand, five hundred.

chinese: 猶大的兒子是珥和俄南。這珥和俄南死在迦南地。
english: The sons of Judah, Er and Onan: and Er and Onan had come to their death in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 按著家族，猶大其餘的眾子：屬示拉的，有示拉族；屬法勒斯的，有法勒斯族；屬謝拉的，有謝拉族。
english: And the sons of Judah by their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelahites: of Perez, the family of the Perezites: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

chinese: 法勒斯的兒子：屬希斯倫的，有希斯倫族；屬哈母勒的，有哈母勒族。
english: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

chinese: 這就是猶大的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有七萬六千五百名。
english: These are the families of Judah as they were numbered, seventy-six thousand, five hundred.

chinese: 按著家族，以薩迦的眾子：屬陀拉的，有陀拉族；屬普瓦的，有普瓦族；
english: The sons of Issachar by their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Puvah, the family of the Punites:

chinese: 屬雅述的，有雅述族；屬伸崙的，有伸崙族。
english: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

chinese: 這就是以薩迦的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有六萬四千三百名。
english: These are the families of Issachar, as they were numbered, sixty-four thousand, three hundred.

chinese: 按著家族，西布倫的眾子：屬西烈的，有西烈族；屬以倫的，有以倫族；屬雅利的，有雅利族。
english: The sons of Zebulun by their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

chinese: 這就是西布倫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有六萬零五百名。
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites as they were numbered, sixty thousand, five hundred.

chinese: 按著家族，約瑟的兒子有瑪拿西、以法蓮。
english: The sons of Joseph by their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

chinese: 瑪拿西的眾子：屬瑪吉的，有瑪吉族；瑪吉生基列；屬基列的，有基列族。
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir was the father of Gilead: of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

chinese: 基列的眾子：屬伊以謝的，有伊以謝族；屬希勒的，有希勒族；
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

chinese: 屬亞斯烈的，有亞斯烈族；屬示劍的，有示劍族；
english: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

chinese: 屬示米大的，有示米大族；屬希弗的，有希弗族；。
english: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

chinese: 希弗的兒子西羅非哈沒兒子，只有女兒。西羅非哈女兒的名字就是瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
english: And Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, had no sons, but only daughters, and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

chinese: 這就是瑪拿西的各族；他們中間被數的，共有五萬二千七百名。
english: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand, seven hundred.

chinese: 按著家族，以法蓮的眾子：屬書提拉的，有書提拉族；屬比結的，有比結族；屬他罕的，有他罕族。
english: These are the sons of Ephraim by their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites: of Becher, the family of the Becherites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

chinese: 書提拉的眾子：屬以蘭的，有以蘭族。
english: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites:

chinese: 這就是以法蓮子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有三萬二千五百名。按著家族，這都是約瑟的子孫。
english: These are the families of Ephraim as they were numbered, thirty-two thousand, five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph by their families.

chinese: 按著家族，便雅憫眾子，屬比拉的，有比拉族；屬亞實別的，有亞實別族；屬亞希蘭的，有亞希蘭族；
english: The sons of Benjamin by their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

chinese: 屬書反的，有書反族；屬戶反的，有戶反族。
english: Of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites: and of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

chinese: 比拉的眾子是亞勒、乃幔。屬亞勒的，有亞勒族；屬乃幔的，有乃幔族。
english: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

chinese: 按著家族，這就是便雅憫的子孫，其中被數的，共有四萬五千六百名。
english: These are the sons of Benjamin by their families: and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand, six hundred.

chinese: 按著家族，但的眾子：屬書含的，有書含族。按著家族，這就是但的各族。
english: These are the sons of Dan by their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan by their families.

chinese: 照其中被數的，書含所有的各族，共有六萬四千四百名。
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, as they were numbered, were sixty-four thousand, four hundred.

chinese: 按著家族，亞設的眾子：屬音拿的，有音拿族；屬亦施韋的，有亦施韋族；屬比利亞的，有比利亞族。
english: The sons of Asher by their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites: of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

chinese: 比利亞的眾子：屬希別的，有希別族；屬瑪結的，有瑪結族。
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites:

chinese: 亞設的女兒名叫西拉。
english: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

chinese: 這就是亞設子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher as they were numbered, fifty-three thousand, four hundred.

chinese: 按著家族，拿弗他利的眾子：屬雅薛的，有雅薛族；屬沽尼的，有沽尼族；
english: The sons of Naphtali by their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

chinese: 屬耶色的，有耶色族；屬示冷的，有示冷族。
english: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

chinese: 按著家族，這就是拿弗他利的各族；他們中間被數的，共有四萬五千四百名。
english: These are the families of Naphtali by their families: and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand, four hundred.

chinese: 以色列人中被數的，共有六十萬零一千七百三十名。
english: Those who were numbered of the children of Israel were six hundred and one thousand, seven hundred and thirty.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要按著人名的數目將地分給這些人為業。
english: Let there be a division of the land among these, for their heritage, in relation to the number of names.

chinese: 人多的，你要把產業多分給他們；人少的，你要把產業少分給他們；要照被數的人數，把產業分給各人。
english: To those families who are more in number, give a greater heritage; to those who are less in number, a smaller part: to every one let the heritage be given in relation to the number in his family.

chinese: 雖是這樣，還要拈鬮分地。他們要按著祖宗各支派的名字承受為業。
english: But let the distribution of the land be made by the decision of the Lord: by the names of the tribes of their fathers let their heritage be given them.

chinese: 要按著所拈的鬮，看人數多，人數少，把產業分給他們。
english: As it is ordered by the decision of the Lord, let distribution be made between those who are more in number and those who are less.

chinese: 利未人，按著他們的各族被數的：屬革順的，有革順族；屬哥轄的，有哥轄族；屬米拉利的，有米拉利族。
english: These were those of the Levites who were numbered by their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

chinese: 利未的各族有立尼族、希伯倫族、瑪利族、母示族、可拉族。哥轄生暗蘭。
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. And Kohath was the father of Amram.

chinese: 暗蘭的妻名叫約基別，是利未女子，生在埃及。他給暗蘭生了亞倫、摩西，並他們的姊姊米利暗。
english: Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom he had in Egypt: by Amram she had Moses and Aaron and their sister Miriam.

chinese: 亞倫生拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
english: Aaron's sons were Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

chinese: 拿答、亞比戶在耶和華面前獻凡火的時候就死了。
english: Death overtook Nadab and Abihu when they made an offering of strange fire before the Lord.

chinese: 利未人中，凡一個月以外、被數的男丁，共有二萬三千。他們本來沒有數在以色列人中；因為在以色列人中，沒有分給他們產業。
english: Of these, twenty-three thousand males, from one month old and over, were numbered: they were not numbered with the rest of the children of Israel, for they had no heritage among the children of Israel.

chinese: 這些就是被摩西和祭司以利亞撒所數的；他們在摩押平原與耶利哥相對的約但河邊數點以色列人。
english: All these were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when the children of Israel were numbered in the lowlands of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

chinese: 但被數的人中，沒有一個是摩西和祭司亞倫從前在西乃的曠野所數的以色列人，
english: But among all these was not one of those numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when the children of Israel were numbered in the waste land of Sinai.

chinese: 因為耶和華論到他們說：他們必要死在曠野。所以，除了耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞以外，連一個人也沒有存留。
english: For the Lord had said of them, Death will certainly overtake them in the waste land. And of them all, only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua, the son of Nun, were still living.

chinese: 屬約瑟的兒子瑪拿西的各族，有瑪拿西的玄孫，瑪吉的曾孫，基列的孫子，希弗的兒子西羅非哈的女兒，名叫瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。他們前來，
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, came forward: their names are Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

chinese: 站在會幕門口，在摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並眾首領與全會眾面前，說：
english: They came before Moses and Eleazar the priest and the chiefs and all the people at the door of the Tent of meeting, and said,

chinese: 我們的父親死在曠野。他不與可拉同黨聚集攻擊耶和華，是在自己罪中死的；他也沒有兒子。
english: Death overtook our father in the waste land; he was not among those who were banded together with Korah against the Lord; but death came to him in his sin; and he had no sons.

chinese: 為甚麼因我們的父親沒有兒子就把他的名從他族中除掉呢？求你們在我們父親的弟兄中分給我們產業。
english: Why is the name of our father to be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give us a heritage among our father's brothers.

chinese: 於是，摩西將他們的案件呈到耶和華面前。
english: So Moses put their cause before the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 西羅非哈的女兒說得有理。你定要在他們父親的弟兄中，把地分給他們為業；要將他們父親的產業歸給他們。
english: What the daughters of Zelophehad say is right: certainly you are to give them a heritage among their father's brothers: and let the property which would have been their father's go to them.

chinese: 你也要曉諭以色列人說：人若死了沒有兒子，就要把他的產業歸給他的女兒。
english: And say to the children of Israel, If a man has no son at the time of his death, let his heritage go to his daughter.

chinese: 他若沒有女兒，就要把他的產業給他的弟兄。
english: And if he has no daughter, then give his heritage to his brothers.

chinese: 他若沒有弟兄，就要把他的產業給他父親的弟兄。
english: And if he has no brothers, then give his heritage to his father's brothers.

chinese: 他父親若沒有弟兄，就要把他的產業給他族中最近的親屬，他便要得為業。這要作以色列人的律例典章，是照耶和華吩咐摩西的。
english: And if his father has no brothers, then give it to his nearest relation in the family, as his heritage: this is to be a decision made by law for the children of Israel, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你上這亞巴琳山，觀看我所賜給以色列人的地。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go up into this mountain of Abarim so that you may see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

chinese: 看了以後，你也必歸到你列祖（原文作本民）那裡，像你哥哥亞倫一樣。
english: And when you have seen it, you will be put to rest with your people, as your brother Aaron was:

chinese: 因為你們在尋的曠野，當會眾爭鬧的時候，違背了我的命，沒有在湧水之地、會眾眼前尊我為聖。（這水就是尋的曠野加低斯米利巴水。）
english: Because in the waste land of Zin, when the people were angry, you and he went against my word and did not keep my name holy before their eyes, at the waters. (These are the waters of Meribah in Kadesh in the waste land of Zin.)

chinese: 摩西對耶和華說：
english: Then Moses said to the Lord,

chinese: 願耶和華萬人之靈的神，立一個人治理會眾，
english: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, put a man at the head of this people,

chinese: 可以在他們面前出入，也可以引導他們，免得耶和華的會眾如同沒有牧人的羊群一般。
english: To go out and come in before them and be their guide; so that the people of the Lord may not be like sheep without a keeper.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：嫩的兒子約書亞是心中有聖靈的；你將他領來，按手在他頭上，
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Take Joshua, the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and put your hand on him;

chinese: 使他站在祭司以利亞撒和全會眾面前，囑咐他，
english: And take him before Eleazar the priest and all the meeting of the people, and give him his orders before their eyes.

chinese: 又將你的尊榮給他幾分，使以色列全會眾都聽從他。
english: And put your honour on him, so that all the children of Israel may be under his authority.

chinese: 他要站在祭司以利亞撒面前；以利亞撒要憑烏陵的判斷，在耶和華面前為他求問。他和以色列全會眾都要遵以利亞撒的命出入。
english: He will take his place before Eleazar the priest, so that he may get directions from the Lord for him, with the Urim: at his word they will go out, and at his word they will come in, he and all the children of Israel.

chinese: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的將約書亞領來，使他站在祭司以利亞撒和全會眾面前。
english: So Moses did as the Lord said: he took Joshua and put him before Eleazar the priest and the meeting of the people:

chinese: 按手在他頭上，囑咐他，是照耶和華藉摩西所說的話。
english: And he put his hands on him and gave him his orders, as the Lord had said by Moses.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要吩咐以色列人說：獻給我的供物，就是獻給我作馨香火祭的食物，你們要按日期獻給我；
english: Give orders to the children of Israel and say to them, Let it be your care to give me my offerings at their regular times, the food of the offerings made by fire to me for a sweet smell.

chinese: 又要對他們說：你們要獻給耶和華的火祭，就是沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，每日兩隻，作為常獻的燔祭。
english: Say to them, This is the offering made by fire which you are to give to the Lord; he-lambs of the first year without any mark, two every day as a regular burned offering.

chinese: 早晨要獻一隻，黃昏的時候要獻一隻；
english: Let one be offered in the morning, and the other at evening;

chinese: 又用細麵伊法十分之一，並搗成的油一欣四分之一，調和作為素祭。
english: And the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with the fourth part of a hin of clear oil.

chinese: 這是西乃山所命定為常獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
english: It is a regular burned offering, as it was ordered in Mount Sinai, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 為這一隻羊羔，要同獻奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在聖所中，你要將醇酒奉給耶和華為奠祭。
english: And for its drink offering take the fourth part of a hin for one lamb: in the holy place let the wine be drained out for a drink offering for the Lord.

chinese: 晚上，你要獻那一隻羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同獻的奠祭獻上，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。
english: Let the other lamb be offered at evening; like the meal offering of the morning and its drink offering, let it be offered as an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

chinese: 當安息日，要獻兩隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，並用調油的細麵伊法十分之二為素祭，又將同獻的奠祭獻上。
english: And on the Sabbath day, two he-lambs of the first year, without any mark, and two tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

chinese: 這是每安息日獻的燔祭；那常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭在外。
english: This is the burned offering for every Sabbath day, in addition to the regular burned offering, and its drink offering.

chinese: 每月朔，你們要將兩隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，七隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，獻給耶和華為燔祭。
english: And on the first day of every month you are to give a burned offering to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark;

chinese: 每隻公牛要用調油的細麵伊法十分之三作為素祭；那隻公羊也用調油的細麵伊法十分之二作為素祭；
english: And three tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, for every ox; and two tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one sheep;

chinese: 每隻羊羔要用調油的細麵伊法十分之一作為素祭和馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭。
english: And a separate tenth part of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering for every lamb; for a burned offering of a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 一隻公牛要奠酒半欣，一隻公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一隻羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。這是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。
english: And their drink offerings are to be half a hin of wine for an ox, and the third part of a hin for a male sheep, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burned offering for every month through all the months of the year.

chinese: 又要將一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，獻給耶和華；要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering to the Lord; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burned offering and its drink offering.

chinese: 正月十四日是耶和華的逾越節。
english: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Lord's Passover.

chinese: 這月十五日是節期，要吃無酵餅七日。
english: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a feast; for seven days let your food be unleavened cakes.

chinese: 第一日當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
english: On the first day there is to be a holy meeting: you may do no sort of field-work:

chinese: 當將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為燔祭。
english: And you are to give an offering made by fire, a burned offering to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

chinese: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為一隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二；
english: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil: let three tenth parts of an ephah be offered for an ox and two tenth parts for a male sheep;

chinese: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。
english: And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;

chinese: 並獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering to take away your sin.

chinese: 你們獻這些，要在早晨常獻的燔祭以外。
english: These are to be offered in addition to the morning burned offering, which is a regular burned offering at all times.

chinese: 一連七日，每日要照這例把馨香火祭的食物獻給耶和華，是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。
english: In this way, every day for seven days, give the food of the offering made by fire, a sweet smell to the Lord: it is to be offered in addition to the regular burned offering, and its drink offering.

chinese: 第七日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
english: Then on the seventh day there will be a holy meeting; you may do no field-work.

chinese: 七七節莊稼初熟，你們獻新素祭給耶和華的日子，當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
english: And at the time of the first-fruits, when you give an offering of new meal to the Lord at your feast of weeks, there is to be a holy meeting: you may do no field-work:

chinese: 只要將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
english: And give a burned offering for a sweet smell to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year;

chinese: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為每隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二；
english: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for an ox, two tenth parts for a male sheep,

chinese: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。
english: And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;

chinese: 並獻一隻公山羊為你們贖罪。
english: And one he-goat to take away your sin.

chinese: 這些，你們要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外，都要沒有殘疾的。
english: These are in addition to the regular burned offering and its meal offering; take care that they are without any mark, and let them be offered with their drink offerings.

chinese: 七月初一日，你們當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做，是你們當守為吹角的日子。
english: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, let there be a holy meeting; on it you may do no field-work; let the day be marked by the blowing of horns;

chinese: 你們要將公牛犢一隻，公綿羊一隻，沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔七隻，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
english: And give to the Lord a burned offering for a sweet smell; one ox, one male sheep, seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark on them:

chinese: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為一隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二；
english: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for an ox, two tenth parts for a male sheep,

chinese: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。
english: And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;

chinese: 又獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering, to take away your sin:

chinese: 這些是在月朔的燔祭和同獻的素祭，並常獻的燔祭與同獻的素祭，以及照例同獻的奠祭以外，都作為馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。
english: In addition to the burned offering of the new moon, and its meal offering, and the regular burned offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, as they are ordered, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

chinese: 七月初十日，你們當有聖會；要刻苦己心，甚麼工都不可做。
english: And on the tenth day of this seventh month there will be a holy meeting; keep yourselves from pleasure, and do no sort of work;

chinese: 只要將公牛犢一隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
english: And give to the Lord a burned offering for a sweet smell; one ox, one male sheep, seven he-lambs of the first year: only those without any mark on them may be used:

chinese: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵：為一隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二；
english: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for an ox, two tenth parts for a male sheep,

chinese: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。
english: A separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;

chinese: 又獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在贖罪祭和常獻的燔祭，與同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: One he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the offering for taking away your sin, and the regular burned offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

chinese: 七月十五日，你們當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做，要向耶和華守節七日。
english: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month let there be a holy meeting; do no field-work, and keep a feast to the Lord for seven days;

chinese: 又要將公牛犢十三隻，公綿羊兩隻，一歲的公羊羔十四隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為馨香的燔祭。
english: And give a burned offering, an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord, thirteen oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, all without any mark on them;

chinese: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為那十三隻公牛，每隻要獻伊法十分之三；為那兩隻公羊，每隻要獻伊法十分之二；
english: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for every one of the thirteen oxen, two tenth parts for every male sheep,

chinese: 為那十四隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。
english: And a separate tenth part for every one of the fourteen lambs;

chinese: 並獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

chinese: 第二日要獻公牛犢十二隻，公綿羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
english: On the second day of the feast give an offering of twelve oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark on them;

chinese: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
english: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen and the sheep and the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

chinese: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

chinese: 第三日要獻公牛十一隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
english: And on the third day eleven oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark;

chinese: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
english: And their meal offering and drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

chinese: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

chinese: 第四日要獻公牛十隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
english: And on the fourth day ten oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

chinese: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
english: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered.

chinese: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

chinese: 第五日要獻公牛九隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
english: And on the fifth day nine oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

chinese: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
english: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

chinese: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

chinese: 第六日要獻公牛八隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
english: And on the sixth day eight oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

chinese: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
english: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

chinese: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, its meal offering, and its drink offerings.

chinese: 第七日要獻公牛七隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
english: And on the seventh day seven oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

chinese: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
english: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

chinese: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

chinese: 第八日你們當有嚴肅會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；
english: On the eighth day let there be a holy meeting: you may do no field-work;

chinese: 只要將公牛一隻，公羊一隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔七隻作火祭，獻給耶和華為馨香的燔祭；
english: And give a burned offering, an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord: one ox, one male sheep, seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

chinese: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
english: With the meal offering and the drink offerings for the ox, the male sheep, and the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

chinese: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

chinese: 這些祭要在你們的節期獻給耶和華，都在所許的願並甘心所獻的以外，作為你們的燔祭、素祭、奠祭，和平安祭。
english: These are the offerings which you are to give to the Lord at your regular feasts, in addition to the offerings for an oath, and the free offerings you give, for your burned offerings and your drink offerings and your peace-offerings.

chinese: 於是，摩西照耶和華所吩咐他的一切話告訴以色列人。
english: So Moses gave the children of Israel all these directions as the Lord had given him orders.

chinese: 摩西曉諭以色列各支派的首領說：耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：
english: And Moses said to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, This is the order of the Lord.

chinese: 人若向耶和華許願或起誓，要約束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切話行。
english: When a man takes an oath to the Lord, or gives an undertaking having the force of an oath, let him not go back from his word, but let him do whatever he has said he will do.

chinese: 女子年幼、還在父家的時候，若向耶和華許願，要約束自己，
english: If a woman, being young and under the authority of her father, takes an oath to the Lord or gives an undertaking;

chinese: 他父親也聽見他所許的願並約束自己的話，卻向他默默不言，他所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定.。
english: If her father, hearing of her oath or the undertaking she has given, says nothing to her, then all her oaths and every undertaking she has given will have force.

chinese: 但他父親聽見的日子若不應承他所許的願和約束自己的話，就都不得為定；耶和華也必赦免他，因為他父親不應承。
english: But if her father, hearing of it, makes her take back her word, then the oaths or the undertakings she has given will have no force; and she will have forgiveness from the Lord, because her oath was broken by her father.

chinese: 他若出了嫁，有願在身，或是口中出了約束自己的冒失話，
english: And if she is married to a husband at the time when she is under an oath or an undertaking given without thought;

chinese: 他丈夫聽見的日子，卻向他默默不言，他所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。
english: If her husband, hearing of it, says nothing to her at the time, then the oaths she made and the undertakings she gave will have force.

chinese: 但他丈夫聽見的日子，若不應承，就算廢了他所許的願和他出口約束自己的冒失話；耶和華也必赦免他。
english: But if her husband, hearing of it, makes her take it back, then the oath she made and the undertaking she gave without thought will have no force or effect, and she will have the Lord's forgiveness.

chinese: 寡婦或是被休的婦人所許的願，就是他約束自己的話，都要為定。
english: But an oath made by a widow or one who is no longer married to her husband, and every undertaking she has given, will have force.

chinese: 他若在丈夫家裡許了願或起了誓，約束自己，
english: If she made an oath while she was under the authority of her husband,

chinese: 丈夫聽見，卻向他默默不言，也沒有不應承，他所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。
english: And her husband, hearing of it, said nothing to her and did not put a stop to it, then all her oaths and every undertaking she gave will have force.

chinese: 丈夫聽見的日子，若把這兩樣全廢了，婦人口中所許的願或是約束自己的話就都不得為定，因他丈夫已經把這兩樣廢了；耶和華也必赦免他。
english: But if her husband, on hearing of it, made them without force or effect, then whatever she has said about her oaths or her undertaking has no force: her husband has made them without effect, and she will have the Lord's forgiveness.

chinese: 凡他所許的願和刻苦約束自己所起的誓，他丈夫可以堅定，也可以廢去。
english: Every oath, and every undertaking which she gives, to keep herself from pleasure, may be supported or broken by her husband.

chinese: 倘若他丈夫天天向他默默不言，就算是堅定他所許的願和約束自己的話；因丈夫聽見的日子向他默默不言，就使這兩樣堅定。
english: But if the days go on, and her husband says nothing whatever to her, then he is giving the support of his authority to her oaths and undertakings, because at the time of hearing them he said nothing to her.

chinese: 但他丈夫聽見以後，若使這兩樣全廢了，就要擔當婦人的罪孽。
english: But if at some time after hearing of them, he makes them without force, then he is responsible for her wrongdoing.

chinese: 這是丈夫待妻子，父親待女兒，女兒年幼、還在父家，耶和華所吩咐摩西的律例。
english: These are the laws which the Lord gave Moses in relation to a man and his wife, or a father and a young daughter who is under his authority.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
english: Then the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你要在米甸人身上報以色列人的仇，後來要歸到你列祖（原文作本民）那裡。
english: Give the Midianites punishment for the wrong they did to the children of Israel: and after that you will go to rest with your people.

chinese: 摩西吩咐百姓說：要從你們中間叫人帶兵器出去攻擊米甸，好在米甸人身上為耶和華報仇。
english: So Moses said to the people, Let men from among you be armed for war to put into effect against Midian the Lord's punishment on them.

chinese: 從以色列眾支派中，每支派要打發一千人去打仗。
english: From every tribe of Israel send a thousand to the war.

chinese: 於是從以色列千萬人中，每支派交出一千人，共一萬二千人，帶著兵器預備打仗。
english: So from the thousands of Israel a thousand were taken from every tribe, twelve thousand men armed for war.

chinese: 摩西就打發每支派的一千人去打仗，並打發祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈同去；非尼哈手裡拿著聖所的器皿和吹大聲的號筒。
english: And Moses sent them out to war, a thousand from every tribe, and with them Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, taking in his hands the vessels of the holy place and the horns for sounding the note of war.

chinese: 他們就照耶和華所吩咐摩西的，與米甸人打仗，殺了所有的男丁。
english: And they made war on Midian, as the Lord gave orders to Moses; and they put to death every male.

chinese: 在所殺的人中，殺了米甸的五王，就是以未、利金、蘇珥、戶珥、利巴，又用刀殺了比珥的兒子巴蘭。
english: They put the kings of Midian to death with the rest, Evi and Reken and Zur and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian: and Balaam, the son of Beor, they put to death with the sword.

chinese: 以色列人擄了米甸人的婦女孩子，並將他們的牲畜、羊群，和所有的財物都奪了來，當作擄物，
english: The women of Midian with their little ones the children of Israel took prisoner; and all their cattle and flocks and all their goods they took for themselves;

chinese: 又用火焚燒他們所住的城邑和所有的營寨，
english: And after burning all their towns and all their tent-circles,

chinese: 把一切所奪的、所擄的，連人帶牲畜都帶了去，
english: They went away with the goods they had taken, man and beast.

chinese: 將所擄的人，所奪的牲畜、財物，都帶到摩押平原，在約但河邊與耶利哥相對的營盤，交給摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並以色列的會眾。
english: And the prisoners and the goods and everything they had taken, they took to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the people of Israel, to the tent-circle in the lowlands of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

chinese: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾一切的首領，都出到營外迎接他們。
english: Then Moses and Eleazar the priest and the chiefs of the people went out to them before they had come into the tent-circle.

chinese: 摩西向打仗回來的軍長，就是千夫長、百夫長，發怒，
english: And Moses was angry with the chiefs of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds who had come back from the war.

chinese: 對他們說：你們要存留這一切婦女的活命麼？
english: And Moses said to them, Why have you kept all the women safe?

chinese: 這些婦女因巴蘭的計謀，叫以色列人在毘珥的事上得罪耶和華，以致耶和華的會眾遭遇瘟疫。
english: It was these who, moved by Balaam, were the cause of Israel's sin against the Lord in the question of Peor, because of which disease came on the people of the Lord.

chinese: 所以，你們要把一切的男孩和所有已嫁的女子都殺了。
english: So now put every male child to death, and every woman who has had sex relations with a man.

chinese: 但女孩子中，凡沒有出嫁的，你們都可以存留他的活命。
english: But all the female children who have had no sex relations with men, you may keep for yourselves.

chinese: 你們要在營外駐紮七日；凡殺了人的，和一切摸了被殺的，並你們所擄來的人口，第三日，第七日，都要潔淨自己，
english: You yourselves will have to keep outside the tent-circle for seven days, anyone of you who has put any person to death or come near a dead body; and on the third day and on the seventh day make yourselves and your prisoners clean.

chinese: 也要因一切的衣服、皮物、山羊毛織的物，和各樣的木器，潔淨自己。
english: And every bit of clothing, and anything made of leather or goats' hair or wood, you are to make clean.

chinese: 祭司以利亞撒對打仗回來的兵丁說：耶和華所吩咐摩西律法中的條例乃是這樣：
english: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had been to the fight, This is the rule of the law which the Lord has given to Moses:

chinese: 金、銀、銅、鐵、錫、鉛，
english: But gold and silver and brass and iron and tin and lead,

chinese: 凡能見火的，你們要叫他經火就為潔淨，然而還要用除污穢的水潔淨他；凡不能見火的，你們要叫他過水。
english: And anything which may be heated, is to go through the fire and be made clean; but in addition it is to be put in the water of cleaning: and anything which may not go through the fire is to be put in the water.

chinese: 第七日，你們要洗衣服，就為潔淨，然後可以進營。
english: And on the seventh day, after washing your clothing, you will be clean, and then you may come into the tent-circle.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾的各族長，要計算所擄來的人口和牲畜的總數。
english: Get an account of everything which was taken in the war, of man and of beast, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of families of the people:

chinese: 把所擄來的分作兩半：一半歸與出去打仗的精兵，一半歸與全會眾。
english: And let division be made of it into two parts, one for the men of war who went out to the fight, and one for all the people:

chinese: 又要從出去打仗所得的人口、牛、驢、羊群中，每五百取一，作為貢物奉給耶和華。
english: And from the men of war who went out let there be offered to the Lord one out of every five hundred, from the persons, and from the oxen and asses and sheep:

chinese: 從他們一半之中，要取出來交給祭司以利亞撒，作為耶和華的舉祭。
english: Take this from their part and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to be lifted up to the Lord.

chinese: 從以色列人的一半之中，就是從人口、牛、驢、羊群、各樣牲畜中，每五十取一，交給看守耶和華帳幕的利未人。
english: And from the part given to the children of Israel, take one out of every fifty, from the persons, and from the oxen and asses and sheep, and give it to the Levites who have the care of the House of the Lord.

chinese: 於是摩西和祭司以利亞撒照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
english: So Eleazar and Moses did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 除了兵丁所奪的財物以外，所擄來的：羊六十七萬五千隻；
english: Now the beasts taken, in addition to what the fighting-men took for themselves, were six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,

chinese: 牛七萬二千隻；
english: And seventy-two thousand oxen,

chinese: 驢六萬一千匹；
english: And sixty-one thousand asses;

chinese: 女人共三萬二千口，都是沒有出嫁的。
english: And thirty-two thousand persons, that is, women who had never had sex relations with a man.

chinese: 出去打仗之人的分，就是他們所得的那一半，共計羊三十三萬七千五百隻，
english: And the half given as their part to the men who went to the war, was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,

chinese: 從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有六百七十五隻；
english: Of which the Lord's part was six hundred and seventy-five.

chinese: 牛三萬六千隻，從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有七十二隻；
english: The number of oxen was thirty-six thousand, of which the Lord's part was seventy-two;

chinese: 驢三萬零五百匹，從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有六十一匹；
english: The number of asses was thirty thousand, five hundred, of which the Lord's part was sixty-one.

chinese: 人一萬六千口，從其中歸耶和華的，有三十二口。
english: And the number of persons was sixteen thousand, of which the Lord's part was thirty-two persons.

chinese: 摩西把貢物，就是歸與耶和華的舉祭，交給祭司以利亞撒，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: And Moses gave the Lord's part, lifted up as an offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 以色列人所得的那一半，就是摩西從打仗的人取來分給他們的。
english: And from the half given to the children of Israel, which Moses had kept separate from that given to the fighting-men,

chinese: （會眾的那一半有：羊三十三萬七千五百隻；
english: (Now the people's half was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,

chinese: 牛三萬六千隻；
english: And thirty-six thousand oxen,

chinese: 驢三萬零五百匹；
english: And thirty thousand, five hundred asses,

chinese: 人一萬六千口。）
english: And sixteen thousand persons;)

chinese: 無論是人口是牲畜，摩西每五十取一，交給看守耶和華帳幕的利未人，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: Even from the children of Israel's half, Moses took one out of every fifty, men and beasts, and gave them to the Levites who had the care of the House of the Lord; as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

chinese: 帶領千軍的各軍長，就是千夫長、百夫長，都近前來見摩西，
english: Then the men in authority over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, came to Moses,

chinese: 對他說：僕人權下的兵已經計算總數，並不短少一人。
english: And said to him, Your servants have taken note of the number of all the fighting-men under our orders, and every one is present;

chinese: 如今我們將各人所得的金器，就是腳鍊子、鐲子、打印的戒指、耳環、手釧，都送來為耶和華的供物，好在耶和華面前為我們的生命贖罪。
english: And we have here an offering for the Lord from what every man took in the war, ornaments of gold, leg-chains and arm-rings, finger-rings, ear-rings, and neck-ornaments, to make our souls free from sin before the Lord.

chinese: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒就收了他們的金子，都是打成的器皿。
english: So Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, even all the worked ornaments.

chinese: 千夫長、百夫長所獻給耶和華為舉祭的金子共有一萬六千七百五十舍客勒。
english: And the gold which the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds gave, as an offering to be lifted up before the Lord, came to sixteen thousand, seven hundred and fifty shekels.

chinese: 各兵丁都為自己奪了財物。
english: (For every man of the army had taken goods for himself in the war.)

chinese: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒收了千夫長、百夫長的金子，就帶進會幕，在耶和華面前作為以色列人的紀念。
english: Then Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold given by the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and took it into the Tent of meeting, to be a sign in memory of the children of Israel before the Lord.

chinese: 流便子孫和迦得子孫的牲畜極其眾多；他們看見雅謝地和基列地是可牧放牲畜之地，
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a great number of cattle: and when they saw that the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead was a good place for cattle;

chinese: 就來見摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾的首領，說：
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the chiefs of the meeting,

chinese: 亞大錄、底本、雅謝、寧拉、希實本、以利亞利、示班、尼波、比穩，
english: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

chinese: 就是耶和華在以色列會眾前面所攻取之地，是可牧放牲畜之地，你僕人也有牲畜；
english: The land which the Lord gave into the hands of the children of Israel, is a land for cattle, and your servants have cattle.

chinese: 又說：我們若在你眼前蒙恩，求你把這地給我們為業，不要領我們過約但河。
english: And they said, With your approval, let this land be given to your servants as their heritage: do not take us over Jordan.

chinese: 摩西對迦得子孫和流便子孫說：難道你們的弟兄去打仗，你們竟坐在這裡麼？
english: And Moses said to the children of Gad and the children of Reuben, Are your brothers to go to the war, while you take your rest here?

chinese: 你們為何使以色列人灰心喪膽、不過去進入耶和華所賜給他們的那地呢？
english: Why would you take from the children of Israel the desire to go over into the land which the Lord has given them?

chinese: 我先前從加低斯巴尼亞打發你們先祖去窺探那地，他們也是這樣行。
english: So did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

chinese: 他們上以實各谷，去窺探那地回來的時候，使以色列人灰心喪膽，不進入耶和華所賜給他們的地。
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they took from the children of Israel the desire to go into the land which the Lord had given them.

chinese: 當日，耶和華的怒氣發作，就起誓說：
english: And at that time the Lord was moved to wrath, and made an oath, saying,

chinese: 凡從埃及上來、二十歲以外的人斷不得看見我對亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許之地，因為他們沒有專心跟從我。
english: Truly, not one of the men of twenty years old and over who came out of Egypt will see the land which I gave by oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; because they have not been true to me with all their heart;

chinese: 惟有基尼洗族耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞可以看見，因為他們專心跟從我。
english: But only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua, the son of Nun: because they have been true to the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，使他們在曠野飄流四十年，等到在耶和華眼前行惡的那一代人都消滅了。
english: Then the Lord was angry with Israel, and he made them wanderers in the waste land for forty years? till all that generation who had done evil in the eyes of the Lord was dead.

chinese: 誰知，你們起來接續先祖，增添罪人的數目，使耶和華向以色列大發烈怒。
english: And now you have come to take the place of your fathers, another generation of sinners, increasing the wrath of the Lord against Israel.

chinese: 你們若退後不跟從他，他還要把以色列人撇在曠野，便是你們使這眾民滅亡。
english: For if you are turned away from him, he will send them wandering again in the waste land; and you will be the cause of the destruction of all this people.

chinese: 兩支派的人挨近摩西，說：我們要在這裡為牲畜壘圈，為婦人孩子造城。
english: Then they came to him, and said, We will make safe places for our cattle here, and towns for our little ones;

chinese: 我們自己要帶兵器行在以色列人的前頭，好把他們領到他們的地方；但我們的婦人孩子，因這地居民的緣故，要住在堅固的城內。
english: But we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel till we have taken them to their place: but our little ones will be safe in the walled towns against the people of the land.

chinese: 我們不回家，直等到以色列人各承受自己的產業。
english: We will not come back to our houses till every one of the children of Israel has come into his heritage.

chinese: 我們不和他們在約但河那邊一帶之地同受產業，因為我們的產業是坐落在約但河東邊這裡。
english: For we will not have our heritage with them on the other side of Jordan and forward; because our heritage has come to us on this side of Jordan to the east.

chinese: 摩西對他們說：你們若這樣行，在耶和華面前帶著兵器出去打仗，
english: Then Moses said to them, If you will do this, arming yourselves to go before the Lord to the war,

chinese: 所有帶兵器的人都要在耶和華面前過約但河，等他趕出他的仇敵，
english: Every armed man of you going across Jordan before the Lord till he has overcome and sent in flight all who are against him,

chinese: 那地被耶和華制伏了，然後你們可以回來，向耶和華和以色列才為無罪，這地也必在耶和華面前歸你們為業。
english: And the land is under the rule of the Lord: then after that you may come back, having done no wrong to the Lord and to Israel; and this land will be yours for your heritage before the Lord.

chinese: 倘若你們不這樣行，就得罪耶和華，要知道你們的罪必追上你們。
english: But if you do not do this, then you are sinners against the Lord; and you may be certain that your sin will have its reward.

chinese: 如今你們口中所出的，只管去行，為你們的婦人孩子造城，為你們的羊群壘圈。
english: So get to work building your towns for your little ones, and safe places for your sheep; and do as you have said.

chinese: 迦得子孫和流便子孫對摩西說：僕人要照我主所吩咐的去行。
english: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said to Moses, Your servants will do as my lord says.

chinese: 我們的妻子、孩子、羊群，和所有的牲畜都要留在基列的各城。
english: Our little ones, our wives, and our flocks, and all our cattle, will be there in the towns of Gilead;

chinese: 但你的僕人，凡帶兵器的，都要照我主所說的話，在耶和華面前過去打仗。
english: But your servants will go over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to the fight, as my lord says.

chinese: 於是，摩西為他們囑咐祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列眾支派的族長，說：
english: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua, the son of Nun, and to the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel.

chinese: 迦得子孫和流便子孫，凡帶兵器在耶和華面前去打仗的，若與你們一同過約但河，那地被你們制伏了，你們就要把基列地給他們為業。
english: And Moses said to them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben go with you over Jordan, every man armed for the fight before the Lord, and all the land is given into your hands, then let them have the land of Gilead for a heritage:

chinese: 倘若他們不帶兵器和你們一同過去，就要在迦南地你們中間得產業。
english: But if they do not go over with you armed, they will have to take their heritage with you in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 迦得子孫和流便子孫回答說：耶和華怎樣吩咐僕人，僕人就怎樣行。
english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said, As the Lord has said to your servants, so will we do.

chinese: 我們要帶兵器，在耶和華面前過去，進入迦南地，只是約但河這邊、我們所得為業之地仍歸我們。
english: We will go over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, and you will give us our heritage on this side of Jordan.

chinese: 摩西將亞摩利王西宏的國和巴珊王噩的國，連那地和周圍的城邑，都給了迦得子孫和流便子孫，並約瑟的兒子瑪拿西半個支派。
english: So Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad and the children of Reuben and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites and Og, king of Bashan, all the land with its towns and the country round them.

chinese: 迦得子孫建造底本、亞他錄、亞羅珥、
english: And the children of Gad were the builders of Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer;

chinese: 亞他錄朔反、雅謝、約比哈、
english: And Atroth-shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah;

chinese: 伯寧拉、伯哈蘭，都是堅固城。他們又壘羊圈。
english: And Beth-nimrah and Beth-haran: walled towns and shut-in places for sheep.

chinese: 流便子孫建造希實本、以利亞利、基列亭、
english: And the children of Reuben were the builders of Heshbon and Elealeh and Kiriathaim;

chinese: 尼波、巴力免、西比瑪（尼波、巴力免，名字是改了的），又給他們所建造的城另起別名。
english: And Nebo and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Sibmah: and they gave other names to the towns they made.

chinese: 瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉，他的子孫往基列去，佔了那地，趕出那裡的亞摩利人。
english: And the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, went to Gilead and took it, driving out the Amorites who were living there.

chinese: 摩西將基列賜給瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉，他子孫就住在那裡。
english: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir, the son of Manasseh; and he made it his living-place.

chinese: 瑪拿西的子孫睚珥去佔了基列的村莊，就稱這些村莊為哈倭特睚珥。
english: And Jair, the son of Manasseh, went and took the towns of Gilead, naming them Havvoth-Jair.

chinese: 挪巴去佔了基納和基納的鄉村，就按自己的名稱基納為挪巴。
english: And Nobah went and took Kenath and its small towns, naming it Nobah, after himself.

chinese: 以色列人按著軍隊，在摩西、亞倫的手下出埃及地所行的路程（或作：站口；下同）記在下面。
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt in their armies, under the direction of Moses and Aaron.

chinese: 摩西遵著耶和華的吩咐記載他們所行的路程，其路程乃是這樣：
english: And the stages of their journey on their way out were put down in writing by Moses at the order of the Lord: these are the stages of their journey and the way they went.

chinese: 正月十五日，就是逾越節的次日，以色列人從蘭塞起行，在一切埃及人眼前昂然無懼的出去。
english: On the fifteenth day of the first month they went out from Rameses; on the day after the Passover the children of Israel went out by the power of the Lord before the eyes of all the Egyptians,

chinese: 那時，埃及人正葬埋他們的長子，就是耶和華在他們中間所擊殺的；耶和華也敗壞他們的神。
english: While the Egyptians were placing in the earth the bodies of their sons on whom the Lord had sent destruction: and their gods had been judged by him.

chinese: 以色列人從蘭塞起行，安營在疏割。
english: So the children of Israel went from Rameses and put up their tents in Succoth.

chinese: 從疏割起行，安營在曠野邊的以倘。
english: And they went on from Succoth and put up their tents in Etham on the edge of the waste land.

chinese: 從以倘起行，轉到比哈希錄，是在巴力洗分對面，就在密奪安營。
english: And from Etham, turning back to Pi-hahiroth which is before Baal-zephon, they put up their tents before Migdol.

chinese: 從比哈希錄對面起行，經過海中到了書珥曠野，又在伊坦的曠野走了三天的路程，就安營在瑪拉。
english: And journeying on from before Hahiroth, they went through the sea into the waste land: they went three days' journey through the waste land of Etham and put up their tents in Marah.

chinese: 從瑪拉起行，來到以琳（以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕樹），就在那裡安營。
english: And from Marah they went on to Elim: and in Elim there were twelve water-springs and seventy palm-trees; and they put up their tents there.

chinese: 從以琳起行，安營在紅海邊。
english: And they went on from Elim and put up their tents by the Red Sea.

chinese: 從紅海邊起行，安營在汛的曠野。
english: Then from the Red Sea they went on and put up their tents in the waste land of Sin.

chinese: 從汛的曠野起行，安營在脫加。
english: And they went on from the waste land of Sin, and put up their tents in Dophkah.

chinese: 從脫加起行，安營在亞錄。
english: And they went on from Dophkah, and put up their tents in Alush.

chinese: 從亞錄起行，安營在利非訂；在那裡，百姓沒有水喝。
english: And they went on from Alush, and put up their tents in Rephidim, where there was no drinking-water for the people.

chinese: 從利非訂起行，安營在西乃的曠野。
english: And they went on from Rephidim, and put up their tents in the waste land of Sinai.

chinese: 從西乃的曠野起行，安營在基博羅哈他瓦。
english: And they went on from the waste land of Sinai and put up their tents in Kibroth-hattaavah.

chinese: 從基博羅哈他瓦起行，安營在哈洗錄。
english: And they went on from Kibroth-hattaavah, and put up their tents in Hazeroth.

chinese: 從哈洗錄起行，安營在利提瑪。
english: And they went on from Hazeroth, and put up their tents in Rithmah.

chinese: 從利提瑪起行，安營在臨門帕烈。
english: And they went on from Rithmah, and put up their tents in Rimmon-perez.

chinese: 從臨門帕烈起行，安營在立拿。
english: And they went on from Rimmon-perez, and put up their tents in Libnah.

chinese: 從立拿起行，安營在勒撒。
english: And they went on from Libnah, and put up their tents in Rissah.

chinese: 從勒撒起行，安營在基希拉他。
english: And they went on from Rissah, and put up their tents in Kehelathah.

chinese: 從基希拉他起行，安營在沙斐山。
english: And they went on from Kehelathah, and put up their tents in Mount Shepher.

chinese: 從沙斐山起行，安營在哈拉大。
english: And they went on from Mount Shepher, and put up their tents in Haradah.

chinese: 從哈拉大起行，安營在瑪吉希錄。
english: And they went on from Haradah, and put up their tents in Makheloth.

chinese: 從瑪吉希錄起行，安營在他哈。
english: And they went on from Makheloth, and put up their tents in Tahath.

chinese: 從他哈起行，安營在他拉。
english: And they went on from Tahath, and put up their tents in Terah.

chinese: 從他拉起行，安營在密加。
english: And they went on from Terah, and put up their tents in Mithkah.

chinese: 從密加起行，安營在哈摩拿。
english: And they went on from Mithkah, and put up their tents in Hashmonah.

chinese: 從哈摩拿起行，安營在摩西錄。
english: And they went on from Hashmonah, and put up their tents in Moseroth.

chinese: 從摩西錄起行，安營在比尼亞干。
english: And they went on from Moseroth, and put up their tents in Bene-jaakan.

chinese: 從比尼亞干起行，安營在曷哈及甲。
english: And they went on from Bene-jaakan, and put up their tents in Hor-haggidgad.

chinese: 從曷哈及甲起行，安營在約巴他。
english: And they went on from Hor-haggidgad, and put up their tents in Jotbathah.

chinese: 從約巴他起行，安營在阿博拿。
english: And they went on from Jotbathah, and put up their tents in Abronah.

chinese: 從阿博拿起行，安營在以旬迦別。
english: And they went on from Abronah, and put up their tents in Ezion-geber.

chinese: 從以旬迦別起行，安營在尋的曠野，就是加低斯。
english: And they went on from Ezion-geber, and put up their tents in the waste land of Zin (which is Kadesh).

chinese: 從加低斯起行，安營在何珥山，以東地的邊界。
english: And they went on from Kadesh, and put up their tents in Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.

chinese: 以色列人出了埃及地後四十年，五月初一日，祭司亞倫遵著耶和華的吩咐上何珥山，就死在那裡。
english: And Aaron the priest went up into the mountain at the order of the Lord, and came to his death there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

chinese: 亞倫死在何珥山的時候年一百二十三歲。
english: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old at the time of his death in Mount Hor.

chinese: 住在迦南南地的迦南人亞拉得王聽說以色列人來了。
english: And news of the coming of the children of Israel came to the king of Arad, the Canaanite, who was living in the South in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 以色列人從何珥山起行，安營在撒摩拿。
english: And from Mount Hor they went on, and put up their tents in Zalmonah.

chinese: 從撒摩拿起行，安營在普嫩。
english: And they went on from Zalmonah, and put up their tents in Punon.

chinese: 從普嫩起行，安營在阿伯。
english: And they went on from Punon, and put up their tents in Oboth.

chinese: 從阿伯起行，安營在以耶亞巴琳，摩押的邊界。
english: And they went on from Oboth, and put up their tents in Iye-abarim at the edge of Moab.

chinese: 從以耶亞巴琳起行，安營在底本迦得。
english: And they went on from Iyim, and put up their tents in Dibon-gad.

chinese: 從底本迦得起行，安營在亞門低比拉太音。
english: And from Dibon-gad they went on, and put up their tents in Almon-diblathaim.

chinese: 從亞門低比拉太音起行，安營在尼波對面的亞巴琳山裡。
english: And from Almon-diblathaim they went on, and put up their tents in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

chinese: 從亞巴琳山起行，安營在摩押平原─約但河邊、耶利哥對面。
english: And they went on from the mountains of Abarim, and put up their tents in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho;

chinese: 他們在摩押平原沿約但河邊安營，從伯耶施末直到亞伯什亭。
english: Planting their tents by the side of Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the lowlands of Moab.

chinese: 耶和華在摩押平原─約但河邊、耶利哥對面曉諭摩西說：
english: And in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐以色列人說：你們過約但河進迦南地的時候，
english: Say to the children of Israel, When you go over Jordan into the land of Canaan,

chinese: 就要從你們面前趕出那裡所有的居民，毀滅他們一切鏨成的石像和他們一切鑄成的偶像，又拆毀他們一切的邱壇。
english: See that all the people of the land are forced out from before you, and put to destruction all their pictured stones, and all their metal images, and all their high places:

chinese: 你們要奪那地，住在其中，因我把那地賜給你們為業。
english: And take the land for yourselves, for your resting-place: for to you I have given the land as your heritage.

chinese: 你們要按家室拈鬮，承受那地；人多的，要把產業多分給他們；人少的，要把產業少分給他們。拈出何地給何人，就要歸何人。你們要按宗族的支派承受。
english: And you will take up your heritage in the land by the decision of the Lord, to every family its part; the greater the family the greater its heritage, and the smaller the family the smaller will be its heritage; wherever the decision of the Lord gives to any man his part, that will be his; distribution will be made to you by your fathers' tribes.

chinese: 倘若你們不趕出那地的居民，所容留的居民就必作你們眼中的刺，肋下的荊棘，也必在你們所住的地上擾害你們。
english: But if you are slow in driving out the people of the land, then those of them who are still there will be like pin-points in your eyes and like thorns in your sides, troubling you in the land where you are living.

chinese: 而且我素常有意怎樣待他們，也必照樣待你們。
english: And it will come about that as it was my purpose to do to them, so I will do to you.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐以色列人說：你們到了迦南地，就是歸你們為業的迦南四境之地，
english: Give orders to the children of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land which is to be your heritage, the land of Canaan inside these limits,)

chinese: 南角要從尋的曠野，貼著以東的邊界；南界要從鹽海東頭起，
english: Then your south quarter will be from the waste land of Zin by the side of Edom, and your limit on the south will be from the east end of the Salt Sea,

chinese: 繞到亞克拉濱坡的南邊，接連到尋，直通到加低斯巴尼亞的南邊，又通到哈薩亞達，接連到押們，
english: And round to the south of the slope of Akrabbim, and on to Zin: and its direction will be south of Kadesh-barnea, and it will go as far as Hazar-addar and on to Azmon:

chinese: 從押們轉到埃及小河，直通到海為止。
english: And from Azmon it will go round to the stream of Egypt as far as the sea.

chinese: 西邊要以大海為界；這就是你們的西界。
english: And for your limit on the west you will have the Great Sea and its edge: this will be your limit on the west.

chinese: 北界要從大海起，畫到何珥山，
english: And your limit on the north will be the line from the Great Sea to Mount Hor:

chinese: 從何珥山劃到哈馬口，通到西達達，
english: And from Mount Hor the line will go in the direction of Hamath; the farthest point of it will be at Zedad:

chinese: 又通到西斐崙，直到哈薩以難。這要作你們的北界。
english: And the limit will go on to Ziphron, with its farthest point at Hazar-enan: this will be your limit on the north.

chinese: 你們要從哈薩以難劃到示番為東界。
english: And on the east, your limit will be marked out from Hazar-enan to Shepham,

chinese: 這界要從示番下到亞延東邊的利比拉，又要達到基尼烈湖的東邊。
english: Going down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain, and on as far as the east side of the sea of Chinnereth:

chinese: 這界要下到約但河，通到鹽海為止。這四圍的邊界以內，要作你們的地。
english: And so down to Jordan, stretching to the Salt Sea: all the land inside these limits will be yours.

chinese: 摩西吩咐以色列人說：這地就是耶和華吩咐拈鬮給九個半支派承受為業的；
english: And Moses gave orders to the children of Israel saying, This is the land which is to be your heritage, by the decision of the Lord, which by the Lord's order is to be given to the nine tribes and the half-tribe:

chinese: 因為流便支派和迦得支派按著宗族受了產業，瑪拿西半個支派也受了產業。
english: For the tribe of the children of Reuben, by their fathers' families, and the tribe of the children of Gad, by their fathers' families, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, have been given their heritage:

chinese: 這兩個半支派已經在耶利哥對面、約但河東、向日出之地受了產業。
english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have been given their heritage on the other side of Jordan at Jericho, on the east looking to the dawn.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 要給你們分地為業之人的名字是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞。
english: These are the names of the men who are to make the distribution of the land among you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun.

chinese: 又要從每支派中選一個首領幫助他們。
english: And you are to take one chief from every tribe to make the distribution of the land.

chinese: 這些人的名字：猶大支派有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。
english: And these are the names of the men: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

chinese: 西緬支派有亞米忽的兒子示母利。
english: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel, the son of Ammihud.

chinese: 便雅憫支派有基斯倫的兒子以利達。
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad, the son of Chislon.

chinese: 但支派有一個首領，約利的兒子布基。
english: And of the tribe of the children of Dan, a chief, Bukki, the son of Jogli.

chinese: 約瑟的子孫瑪拿西支派有一個首領，以弗的兒子漢聶。
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh, a chief, Hanniel, the son of Ephod:

chinese: 以法蓮支派有一個首領，拾弗但的兒子基母利。
english: And of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a chief, Kemuel, the son of Shiphtan.

chinese: 西布倫支派有一個首領，帕納的兒子以利撒番。
english: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a chief, Elizaphan, the son of Parnach.

chinese: 以薩迦支派有一個首領，阿散的兒子帕鐵。
english: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar, a chief, Paltiel, the son of Azzan.

chinese: 亞設支派有一個首領，示羅米的兒子亞希忽。
english: And of the tribe of the children of Asher, a chief, Ahihud, the son of Shelomi.

chinese: 拿弗他利支派有一個首領，亞米忽的兒子比大黑。
english: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a chief, Pedahel, the son of Ammihud.

chinese: 這些人就是耶和華所吩咐、在迦南地把產業分給以色列人的。
english: These are they to whom the Lord gave orders to make the distribution of the heritage among the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 耶和華在摩押平原─約但河邊、耶利哥對面曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho,

chinese: 你吩咐以色列人，要從所得為業的地中把些城給利未人居住，也要把這城四圍的郊野給利未人。
english: Give orders to the children of Israel to give to the Levites, from the heritage which is theirs, towns for themselves, with land on the outskirts of the towns.

chinese: 這城邑要歸他們居住，城邑的郊野可以牧養他們的牛羊和各樣的牲畜，又可以安置他們的財物。
english: These towns are to be their living-places, with land round them for their cattle and their food and all their beasts,

chinese: 你們給利未人的郊野，要從城根起，四圍往外量一千肘。
english: Stretching from the wall of the towns a distance of a thousand cubits all round.

chinese: 另外東量二千肘，南量二千肘，西量二千肘，北量二千肘，為邊界，城在當中；這要歸他們作城邑的郊野。
english: The measure of this space of land is to be two thousand cubits outside the town on the east, and two thousand cubits on the south and on the west and on the north, the town being in the middle. This space will be the outskirts of their towns.

chinese: 你們給利未人的城邑，其中當有六座逃城，使誤殺人的可以逃到那裡。此外還要給他們四十二座城。
english: And the towns which you give the Levites are to be the six safe places to which the taker of life may go in flight; and in addition you are to give them forty-two towns.

chinese: 你們要給利未人的城，共有四十八座，連城帶郊野都要給他們。
english: Forty-eight towns are to be given to the Levites, all with land round them.

chinese: 以色列人所得的地業從中要把些城邑給利未人；人多的就多給，人少的就少給；各支派要按所承受為業之地把城邑給利未人。
english: And these towns are to be given out of the heritage of the children of Israel, taking the greater number from those who have much, and a smaller number from those who have little: everyone, in the measure of his heritage, is to give of his property to the Levites.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
english: And the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你吩咐以色列人說：你們過約但河，進了迦南地，
english: Say to the children of Israel, when you have gone over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

chinese: 就要分出幾座城，為你們作逃城，使誤殺人的可以逃到那裡。
english: Then let certain towns be marked out as safe places to which anyone who takes the life of another in error may go in flight.

chinese: 這些城可以作逃避報仇人的城，使誤殺人的不至於死，等他站在會眾面前聽審判。
english: In these towns you may be safe from him who has the right of punishment; so that death may not overtake the taker of life till he has been judged by the meeting of the people.

chinese: 你們所分出來的城，要作六座逃城。
english: Six of the towns which you give will be such safe places;

chinese: 在約但河東要分出三座城，在迦南地也要分出三座城，都作逃城。
english: Three on the other side of Jordan and three in the land of Canaan, to be safe places for flight.

chinese: 這六座城要給以色列人和他們中間的外人，並寄居的，作為逃城，使誤殺人的都可以逃到那裡。
english: For the children of Israel and for the man from another country who is living among them, these six towns are to be safe places, where anyone causing the death of another through error may go in flight.

chinese: 倘若人用鐵器打人，以致打死，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
english: But if a man gives another man a blow with an iron instrument, causing his death, he is a taker of life and is certainly to be put to death.

chinese: 若用可以打死人的石頭打死了人，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
english: Or if he gives him a blow with a stone in his hand, causing his death, he is a taker of life and is certainly to be put to death.

chinese: 若用可以打死人的木器打死了人，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
english: Or if he gave him blows with a wood instrument in his hands, causing his death, he is a taker of life and is certainly to be put to death.

chinese: 報血仇的必親自殺那故殺人的，一遇見就殺他。
english: He whose right it is to give punishment for blood, may himself put to death the taker of life when he comes face to face with him.

chinese: 人若因怨恨把人推倒，或是埋伏往人身上扔物，以致於死，
english: If in his hate he put a sword through him, or waiting secretly for him sent a spear or stone at him, causing his death;

chinese: 或是因仇恨用手打人，以致於死，那打人的必被治死。他是故殺人的；報血仇的一遇見就殺他。
english: Or in hate gave him blows with his hand, causing death; he who gave the death-blow is to be put to death; he is a taker of life: he whose right it is to give punishment for blood may put to death the taker of life when he comes face to face with him.

chinese: 倘若人沒有仇恨，忽然將人推倒，或是沒有埋伏把物扔在人身上，
english: But if a man has given a wound to another suddenly and not in hate, or without design has sent something against him,

chinese: 或是沒有看見的時候用可以打死人的石頭扔在人身上，以致於死，本來與他無仇，也無意害他。
english: Or has given him a blow with a stone, without seeing him, so causing his death, though he had nothing against him and no desire to do him evil:

chinese: 會眾就要照典章，在打死人的和報血仇的中間審判。
english: Then let the meeting of the people be judge between the man responsible for the death and him who has the right of punishment for blood, acting by these rules:

chinese: 會眾要救這誤殺人的脫離報血仇人的手，也要使他歸入逃城。他要住在其中，直等到受聖膏的大祭司死了。
english: And let the people keep the man responsible for the death safe from the hands of him who has the right of punishment for blood, and send him back to his safe town where he had gone in flight: there let him be till the death of the high priest who was marked with the holy oil.

chinese: 但誤殺人的，無論甚麼時候，若出了逃城的境外，
english: But if ever he goes outside the walls of the safe town where he had gone in flight,

chinese: 報血仇的在逃城境外遇見他，將他殺了，報血仇的就沒有流血之罪。
english: And the giver of punishment, meeting him outside the walls of the town, puts him to death, he will not be responsible for his blood:

chinese: 因為誤殺人的該住在逃城裡，等到大祭司死了。大祭司死了以後，誤殺人的才可以回到他所得為業之地。
english: Because he had been ordered to keep inside the safe town till the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the taker of life may come back to the place of his heritage.

chinese: 這在你們一切的住處，要作你們世世代代的律例典章。
english: These rules are to be your guide in judging through all your generations wherever you may be living.

chinese: 無論誰故殺人，要憑幾個見證人的口把那故殺人的殺了，只是不可憑一個見證的口叫人死。
english: Anyone causing the death of another is himself to be put to death on the word of witnesses: but the word of one witness is not enough.

chinese: 故殺人、犯死罪的，你們不可收贖價代替他的命；他必被治死。
english: Further, no price may be given for the life of one who has taken life and whose right reward is death: he is certainly to be put to death.

chinese: 那逃到逃城的人，你們不可為他收贖價，使他在大祭司未死以先再來住在本地。
english: And no price may be offered for one who has gone in flight to a safe town, for the purpose of letting him come back to his place before the death of the high priest.

chinese: 這樣，你們就不污穢所住之地，因為血是污穢地的；若有在地上流人血的，非流那殺人者的血，那地就不得潔淨（潔淨原文作贖）。
english: So do not make the land where you are living unholy: for blood makes the land unholy: and there is no way of making the land free from the blood which has come on it, but only by the death of him who was the cause of it.

chinese: 你們不可玷污所住之地，就是我住在其中之地，因為我─耶和華住在以色列人中間。
english: Do not make unclean the land where you are living and in which is my House: for I the Lord am present among the children of Israel.

chinese: 約瑟的後裔，瑪拿西的孫子，瑪吉的兒子基列，他子孫中的諸族長來到摩西和作首領的以色列人族長面前，說：
english: Now the heads of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came to Moses, the chiefs and the heads of families of the children of Israel being present,

chinese: 耶和華曾吩咐我主拈鬮分地給以色列人為業，我主也受了耶和華的吩咐將我們兄弟西羅非哈的產業分給他的眾女兒。
english: And said, The Lord gave orders to my lord to make distribution of the land as their heritage to the children of Israel: and my lord was ordered by the Lord to give the heritage of Zelophehad, our brother, to his daughters.

chinese: 他們若嫁以色列別支派的人，就必將我們祖宗所遺留的產業加在他們丈夫支派的產業中。這樣，我們拈鬮所得的產業就要減少了。
english: Now if they get married to any of the sons of other tribes of the children of Israel, then their property will be taken away from the heritage of our fathers, and become part of the heritage of the tribe into which they get married: and their heritage will be taken away from the heritage of our tribe.

chinese: 到了以色列人的禧年，這女兒的產業就必加在他們丈夫支派的產業上。這樣，我們祖宗支派的產業就減少了。
english: And at the time of the Jubilee of the children of Israel, their property will be joined to the heritage of the tribe of which they are part and will be taken away from the heritage of the tribe of our fathers.

chinese: 摩西照耶和華的話吩咐以色列人說：約瑟支派的人說得有理。
english: So by the direction of the Lord, Moses gave orders to the children of Israel, saying, What the tribe of the sons of Joseph have said is right.

chinese: 論到西羅非哈的眾女兒，耶和華這樣吩咐說：他們可以隨意嫁人，只是要嫁同宗支派的人。
english: This is the order of the Lord about the daughters of Zelophehad: The Lord says, Let them take as their husbands whoever is most pleasing to them, but only among the family of their father's tribe.

chinese: 這樣，以色列人的產業就不從這支派歸到那支派，因為以色列人要各守各祖宗支派的產業。
english: And so no property will be handed from tribe to tribe among the children of Israel; but every one of the children of Israel will keep the heritage of his father's tribe.

chinese: 凡在以色列支派中得了產業的女子必作同宗支派人的妻，好叫以色列人各自承受他祖宗的產業。
