english: And every daughter owning property in any tribe of the children of Israel is to be married to one of the family of her father's tribe, so that every man of the children of Israel may keep the heritage of his fathers.

chinese: 這樣，他們的產業就不從這支派歸到那支派，因為以色列支派的人要各守各的產業。
english: And no property will be handed from one tribe to another, but every tribe of the children of Israel will keep its heritage.

chinese: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，西羅非哈的眾女兒就怎樣行。
english: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the Lord gave orders to Moses:

chinese: 西羅非哈的女兒瑪拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿都嫁了他們伯叔的兒子。
english: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, took as their husbands the sons of their father's brothers:

chinese: 他們嫁入約瑟兒子、瑪拿西子孫的族中；他們的產業仍留在同宗支派中。
english: And were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, and their property was kept in the tribe of their father's family

chinese: 這是耶和華在摩押平原─約但河邊、耶利哥對面─藉著摩西所吩咐以色列人的命令典章。
english: These are the laws and the orders which the Lord gave to the children of Israel by Moses, in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho.

chinese: 以下所記的是摩西在約但河東的曠野、疏弗對面的亞拉巴─就是巴蘭、陀弗、拉班、哈洗錄、底撒哈中間─向以色列眾人所說的話。
english: These are the words which Moses said to all Israel on the far side of Jordan, in the waste land in the Arabah opposite Suph, between Paran on the one side, and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab on the other.

chinese: 從何烈山經過西珥山到加低斯巴尼亞有十一天的路程。）
english: It is eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.

chinese: 出埃及第四十年十一月初一日，摩西照耶和華藉著他所吩咐以色列人的話都曉諭他們。
english: Now in the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses gave to the children of Israel all the orders which the Lord had given him for them;

chinese: 那時，他已經擊殺了住希實本的亞摩利王西宏和住以得來、亞斯他錄的巴珊王噩。
english: After he had overcome Sihon, king of the Amorites, ruling in Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, ruling in Ashtaroth, at Edrei:

chinese: 摩西在約但河東的摩押地講律法說：
english: On the far side of Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses gave the people this law, saying,

chinese: 耶和華─我們的神在何烈山曉諭我們說：你們在這山上住的日子夠了；
english: The Lord our God said to us in Horeb, You have been long enough in this mountain:

chinese: 要起行轉到亞摩利人的山地和靠近這山地的各處，就是亞拉巴、山地、高原、南地，沿海一帶迦南人的地，並利巴嫩山又到伯拉大河。
english: Make a move now, and go on your way into the hill-country of the Amorites and the places near it, in the Arabah and the hill-country and in the lowlands and in the South and by the seaside, all the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

chinese: 如今我將這地擺在你們面前；你們要進去得這地，就是耶和華向你們列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許賜給他們和他們後裔為業之地。
english: See, all the land is before you: go in and take for yourselves the land which the Lord gave by an oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their seed after them.

chinese: 那時，我對你們說：管理你們的重任，我獨自擔當不起。
english: At that time I said to you, I am not able to undertake the care of you by myself;

chinese: 耶和華─你們的神使你們多起來。看哪，你們今日像天上的星那樣多。
english: The Lord your God has given you increase, and now you are like the stars of heaven in number.

chinese: 惟願耶和華─你們列祖的神使你們比如今更多千倍，照他所應許你們的話賜福與你們。
english: May the Lord, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times greater in number than you are, and give you his blessing as he has said!

chinese: 但你們的麻煩，和管理你們的重任，並你們的爭訟，我獨自一人怎能擔當得起呢？
english: How is it possible for me by myself to be responsible for you, and undertake the weight of all your troubles and your arguments?

chinese: 你們要按著各支派選舉有智慧、有見識、為眾人所認識的，我立他們為你們的首領。
english: Take for yourselves men who are wise, far-seeing, and respected among you, from your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

chinese: 你們回答我說：照你所說的行了為妙。
english: And you made answer and said to me, It is good for us to do as you say.

chinese: 我便將你們各支派的首領，有智慧、為眾人所認識的，照你們的支派，立他們為官長、千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長，管理你們。
english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men and respected, and made them rulers over you, captains of thousands and captains of hundreds and captains of fifties and captains of tens, and overseers of your tribes.

chinese: 當時，我囑咐你們的審判官說：你們聽訟，無論是弟兄彼此爭訟，是與同居的外人爭訟，都要按公義判斷。
english: And at that time I gave orders to your judges, saying, Let all questions between your brothers come before you for hearing, and give decisions uprightly between a man and his brother or one from another nation who is with him.

chinese: 審判的時候，不可看人的外貌；聽訟不可分貴賤，不可懼怕人，因為審判是屬乎神的。若有難斷的案件，可以呈到我這裡，我就判斷。
english: In judging, do not let a man's position have any weight with you; give hearing equally to small and great; have no fear of any man, for it is God who is judge: and any cause in which you are not able to give a decision, you are to put before me and I will give it a hearing.

chinese: 那時，我將你們所當行的事都吩咐你們了。
english: And at that time I gave you all the orders which you were to do.

chinese: 我們照著耶和華─我們神所吩咐的從何烈山起行，經過你們所看見那大而可怕的曠野，往亞摩利人的山地去，到了加低斯巴尼亞。
english: Then we went on from Horeb, through all that great and cruel waste which you saw, on our way to the hill-country of the Amorites, as the Lord gave us orders; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

chinese: 我對你們說：你們已經到了耶和華─我們神所賜給我們的亞摩利人之山地。
english: And I said to you, You have come to the hill-country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.

chinese: 看哪，耶和華─你的神已將那地擺在你面前，你要照耶和華─你列祖的　神所說的上去得那地為業；不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。
english: See now, the Lord your God has put the land into your hands: go up and take it, as the Lord, the God of your fathers, has said to you; have no fear and do not be troubled.

chinese: 你們都就近我來說：我們要先打發人去，為我們窺探那地，將我們上去該走何道，必進何城，都回報我們。
english: And you came near to me, every one of you, and said, Let us send men before us to go through the land with care and give us an account of the way we are to go and the towns to which we will come.

chinese: 這話我以為美，就從你們中間選了十二個人，每支派一人。
english: And what you said seemed good to me, and I took twelve men from among you, one from every tribe;

chinese: 於是他們起身上山地去，到以實各谷，窺探那地。
english: And they went up into the hill-country and came to the valley of Eshcol, and saw what was there.

chinese: 他們手裡拿著那地的果子下來，到我們那裡，回報說：耶和華─我們的神所賜給我們的是美地。
english: And taking in their hands some of the fruit of the land, they came down again to us, and gave us their account, saying, It is a good land which the Lord our God is giving us.

chinese: 你們卻不肯上去，竟違背了耶和華─你們神的命令，
english: But going against the order of the Lord your God, you would not go up:

chinese: 在帳棚內發怨言說：耶和華因為恨我們，所以將我們從埃及地領出來，要交在亞摩利人手中，除滅我們。
english: And you made an angry outcry in your tents, and said, In his hate for us the Lord has taken us out of the land of Egypt, to give us up into the hands of the Amorites for our destruction.

chinese: 我們上那裡去呢？我們的弟兄使我們的心消化，說那地的民比我們又大又高，城邑又廣大又堅固，高得頂天，並且我們在那裡看見亞衲族的人。
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our hearts feeble with fear by saying, The people are greater and taller than we are, and the towns are great and walled up to heaven; and more than this, we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.

chinese: 我就對你們說：不要驚恐，也不要怕他們。
english: Then I said to you, Have no fear of them.

chinese: 在你們前面行的耶和華─你們的神必為你們爭戰，正如他在埃及和曠野，在你們眼前所行的一樣。
english: The Lord your God who goes before you will be fighting for you, and will do such wonders as he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

chinese: 你們在曠野所行的路上，也曾見耶和華─你們的神撫養你們，如同人撫養兒子一般，直等你們來到這地方。
english: And in the waste land, where you have seen how the Lord was supporting you, as a man does his son, in all your journeying till you came to this place.

chinese: 你們在這事上卻不信耶和華─你們的神。
english: But for all this, you had no faith in the Lord your God,

chinese: 他在路上，在你們前面行，為你們找安營的地方；夜間在火柱裡，日間在雲柱裡，指示你們所當行的路。
english: Who goes before you on your way, looking for a place where you may put up your tents, in fire by night, lighting up the way you are to go, and in a cloud by day.

chinese: 耶和華聽見你們這話，就發怒，起誓說：
english: And the Lord, hearing your words, was angry, and said with an oath,

chinese: 這惡世代的人，連一個也不得見我起誓應許賜給你們列祖的美地；
english: Truly, not one of this evil generation will see that good land which I said I would give to your fathers,

chinese: 惟有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒必得看見，並且我要將他所踏過的地{賜給他和他的子孫，因為他專心跟從我。
english: But only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, he will see it; and to him and to his children I will give the land over which his feet have gone, because he has been true to the Lord with all his heart.

chinese: 耶和華為你們的緣故也向我發怒，說：你必不得進入那地。
english: And, in addition, the Lord was angry with me because of you, saying, You yourself will not go into it:

chinese: 伺候你、嫩的兒子約書亞，他必得進入那地；你要勉勵他，因為他要使以色列人承受那地為業。
english: Joshua, the son of Nun, your servant, he will go into the land: say to him that he is to be strong, for he will be Israel's guide into their heritage.

chinese: 並且你們的婦人孩子，就是你們所說、必被擄掠的，和今日不知善惡的兒女，必進入那地。我要將那地賜給他們，他們必得為業。
english: And your little ones, who, you said, would come into strange hands, your children, who now have no knowledge of good or evil, they will go into that land, and to them I will give it and it will be theirs.

chinese: 至於你們，要轉回，從紅海的路往曠野去。
english: But as for you, go back, journeying into the waste land by the way of the Red Sea.

chinese: 那時，你們回答我說：我們得罪了耶和華，情願照耶和華─我們神一切所吩咐的上去爭戰。於是你們各人帶著兵器，爭先上山地去了。
english: Then you said to me, We have done evil against the Lord, we will go up to the attack, as the Lord our God has given us orders. And arming yourselves every one, you made ready to go up without care into the hill-country.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐我說：你對他們說：不要上去，也不要爭戰；因我不在你們中間，恐怕你們被仇敵殺敗了。
english: And the Lord said to me, Say to them, Do not go up to the attack; for I am not among you, and you will be overcome by those who are against you.

chinese: 我就告訴了你們，你們卻不聽從，竟違背耶和華的命令，擅自上山地去了。
english: This I said to you, but you gave no attention and went against the orders of the Lord, and in your pride went up into the hill-country.

chinese: 住那山地的亞摩利人就出來攻擊你們，追趕你們，如蜂擁一般，在西珥殺退你們，直到何珥瑪。
english: And the Amorites who were in the hill-country came out against you and put you to flight, rushing after you like bees, and overcame you in Seir, driving you even as far as Hormah.

chinese: 你們便回來，在耶和華面前哭號；耶和華卻不聽你們的聲音，也不向你們側耳。
english: And you came back, weeping before the Lord; but the Lord gave no attention to your cries and did not give ear to you.

chinese: 於是你們在加低斯住了許多日子。
english: So you were kept waiting in Kadesh for a long time.

chinese: 此後，我們轉回，從紅海的路往曠野去，是照耶和華所吩咐我的。我們在西珥山繞行了許多日子。
english: Then we went back, journeying into the waste land by the way to the Red Sea, as the Lord had said to me: and we were a long time going round Mount Seir.

chinese: 耶和華對我說：
english: And the Lord said to me,

chinese: 你們繞行這山的日子夠了，要轉向北去。
english: You have been journeying round this mountain long enough: now go to the north;

chinese: 你吩咐百姓說：你們弟兄以掃的子孫住在西珥，你們要經過他們的境界。他們必懼怕你們，所以你們要分外謹慎。
english: And give the people orders, saying, You are about to go through the land of your brothers, the children of Esau, who are living in Seir; and they will have fear of you; so take care what you do:

chinese: 不可與他們爭戰；他們的地，連腳掌可踏之處，我都不給你們，因我已將西珥山賜給以掃為業。
english: Make no attack on them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even space enough for a man's foot: because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for his heritage.

chinese: 你們要用錢向他們買糧吃，也要用錢向他們買水喝。
english: You may get food for your needs from them for a price, and water for drinking.

chinese: 因為耶和華─你的神在你手裡所辦的一切事上已賜福與你。你走這大曠野，他都知道了。這四十年，耶和華─你的　神常與你同在，故此你一無所缺。
english: For the blessing of the Lord your God has been on you in all the work of your hands: he has knowledge of your wanderings through this great waste: these forty years the Lord your God has been with you, and you have been short of nothing.

chinese: 於是，我們離了我們弟兄以掃子孫所住的西珥，從亞拉巴的路，經過以拉他、以旬迦別，轉向摩押曠野的路去。
english: So we went on past our brothers, the children of Esau, living in Seir, by the road through the Arabah, from Elath and Ezion-geber. And turning, we went by the road through the waste land of Moab.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐我說：不可擾害摩押人，也不可與他們爭戰。他們的地，我不賜給你為業，因我已將亞珥賜給羅得的子孫為業。
english: And the Lord said to me, Make no attack on Moab and do not go to war with them, for I will not give you any of his land: because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for their heritage.

chinese: （先前，有以米人住在那裡，民數眾多，身體高大，像亞衲人一樣。
english: (In the past the Emim were living there; a great people, equal in numbers to the Anakim and as tall;

chinese: 這以米人像亞衲人；也算為利乏音人；摩押人稱他們為以米人。
english: They are numbered among the Rephaim, like the Anakim; but are named Emim by the Moabites.

chinese: 先前，何利人也住在西珥，但以掃的子孫將他們除滅，得了他們的地，接著居住，就如以色列在耶和華賜給他為業之地所行的一樣。）
english: And the Horites in earlier times were living in Seir, but the children of Esau took their place; they sent destruction on them and took their land for themselves, as Israel did to the land of his heritage which the Lord gave them.)

chinese: 現在，起來過撒烈溪！於是我們過了撒烈溪。
english: Get up now, and go over the stream Zered. So we went over the stream Zered.

chinese: 自從離開加低斯巴尼亞，到過了撒烈溪的時候，共有三十八年，等那世代的兵丁都從營中滅盡，正如耶和華向他們所起的誓。
english: Thirty-eight years had gone by from the time when we came away from Kadesh-barnea till we went over the stream Zered; by that time all the generation of the men of war among us were dead, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 耶和華的手也攻擊他們，將他們從營中除滅，直到滅盡。
english: For the hand of the Lord was against them, working their destruction, till all were dead.

chinese: 兵丁從民中都滅盡死亡以後，
english: So when death had overtaken all the men of war among the people,

chinese: 耶和華吩咐我說：
english: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 你今天要從摩押的境界亞珥經過，
english: You are about to go by Ar, the limit of the country of Moab;

chinese: 走近亞捫人之地，不可擾害他們，也不可與他們爭戰。亞捫人的地，我不賜給你們為業，因我已將那地賜給羅得的子孫為業。
english: And when you come near the land of the children of Ammon, give them no cause of trouble and do not make war on them, for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for your heritage: because I have given it to the children of Lot.

chinese: （那地也算為利乏音人之地，先前利乏音人住在那裡，亞捫人稱他們為散送冥。
english: (That land is said to have been a land of the Rephaim, for Rephaim had been living there in earlier times, but they were named Zamzummim by the Ammonites;

chinese: 那民眾多，身體高大，像亞衲人一樣，但耶和華從亞捫人面前除滅他們，亞捫人就得了他們的地，接著居住。
english: They were a great people, tall as the Anakim, and equal to them in number; but the Lord sent destruction on them and the children of Ammon took their place, living in their land;

chinese: 正如耶和華從前為住西珥的以掃子孫將何利人從他們面前除滅、他們得了何利人的地、接著居住一樣，直到今日。
english: As he did for the children of Esau living in Seir, when he sent destruction on the Horites before them, and they took their land where they are living to this day:

chinese: 從迦斐託出來的迦斐託人將先前住在鄉村直到迦薩的亞衛人除滅，接著居住。）
english: And the Avvim, living in the small towns as far as Gaza, came to destruction by the hands of the Caphtorim who came out from Caphtor and took their land.)

chinese: 你們起來前往，過亞嫩谷；我已將亞摩利人希實本王西宏和他的地交在你手中，你要與他爭戰，得他的地為業。
english: Get up now, and go on your journey, crossing over the valley of the Arnon: see, I have given into your hands Sihon, the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and all his land: go forward to make it yours, and make war on him,

chinese: 從今日起，我要使天下萬民聽見你的名聲都驚恐懼怕，且因你發顫傷慟。
english: From now on I will put the fear of you in all peoples under heaven, who, hearing of you, will be shaking with fear and grief of heart because of you.

chinese: 我從基底莫的曠野差遣使者去見希實本王西宏，用和睦的話說：
english: Then from the waste land of Kedemoth I sent representatives to Sihon, king of Heshbon, with words of peace, saying,

chinese: 求你容我從你的地經過，只走大道，不偏左右。
english: Let me go through your land: I will keep to the highway, not turning to the right or to the left;

chinese: 你可以賣糧給我吃，也可以賣水給我喝，只要容我步行過去，
english: Let me have food, at a price, for my needs, and water for drinking: only let me go through on foot;

chinese: 就如住西珥的以掃子孫和住亞珥的摩押人待我一樣，等我過了約但河，好進入耶和華─我們神所賜給我們的地。
english: As the children of Esau did for me in Seir and the Moabites in Ar; till I have gone over Jordan into the land which the Lord our God is giving us.

chinese: 但希實本王西宏不容我們從他那裡經過；因為耶和華─你的神使他心中剛硬，性情頑梗，為要將他交在你手中，像今日一樣。
english: But Sihon, king of Heshbon, would not let us go through; for the Lord your God made his spirit hard and his heart strong, so that he might give him up into your hands as at this day.

chinese: 耶和華對我說：從此起首，我要將西宏和他的地交給你；你要得他的地為業。
english: And the Lord said to me, See, from now on I have given Sihon and his land into your hands: go forward now to take his land and make it yours.

chinese: 那時，西宏和他的眾民出來攻擊我們，在雅雜與我們交戰。
english: Then Sihon came out against us with all his people, to make an attack on us at Jahaz.

chinese: 耶和華─我們的神將他交給我們，我們就把他和他的兒子，並他的眾民，都擊殺了。
english: And the Lord our God gave him into our hands; and we overcame him and his sons and all his people.

chinese: 我們奪了他的一切城邑，將有人煙的各城，連女人帶孩子，盡都毀滅，沒有留下一個。
english: At that time we took all his towns, and gave them over to complete destruction, together with men, women, and children; we had no mercy on any:

chinese: 惟有牲畜和所奪的各城，並其中的財物，都取為自己的掠物。
english: Only the cattle we took for ourselves, with the goods from the towns we had taken.

chinese: 從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和華─我們的神都交給我們了，沒有一座城高得使我們不能攻取的。
english: From Aroer on the edge of the valley of the Arnon and from the town in the valley as far as Gilead, no town was strong enough to keep us out; the Lord our God gave them all into our hands:

chinese: 惟有亞捫人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，並山地的城邑，與耶和華─我們神所禁止我們去的地方，都沒有挨近。
english: But you did not go near the land of the children of Ammon, that is, all the side of the river Jabbok or the towns of the hill-country, wherever the Lord our God had said we were not to go.

chinese: 以後，我們轉回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的眾民都出來，在以得來與我們交戰。
english: Then turning we took the road to Bashan: and Og, king of Bashan, came out against us with all his people, and made an attack on us at Edrei.

chinese: 耶和華對我說：不要怕他！因我已將他和他的眾民，並他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像從前待住希實本的亞摩利王西宏一樣。
english: And the Lord said to me, Have no fear of him: for I have given him and all his people and his land into your hands; do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon.

chinese: 於是耶和華─我們的神也將巴珊王噩和他的眾民都交在我們手中；我們殺了他們，沒有留下一個。
english: So the Lord our God gave up Og, king of Bashan, and all his people into our hands; and we overcame him so completely that all his people came to their end in the fight.

chinese: 那時，我們奪了他所有的城，共有六十座，沒有一座城不被我們所奪。這為亞珥歌伯的全境，就是巴珊地噩王的國。
english: At that time we took all his towns; there was not one town of the sixty towns, all the country of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which we did not take.

chinese: 這些城都有堅固的高牆，有門有閂。此外還有許多無城牆的鄉村。
english: All these towns had high walls round them with doors and locks; and in addition we took a great number of unwalled towns.

chinese: 我們將這些都毀滅了，像從前待希實本王西宏一樣，把有人煙的各城，連女人帶孩子，盡都毀滅；
english: And we put them to the curse, every town together with men, women, and children.

chinese: 惟有一切牲畜和城中的財物都取為自己的掠物。
english: But we took for ourselves all the cattle and the stored wealth of the towns.

chinese: 那時，我們從約但河東兩個亞摩利王的手將亞嫩谷直到黑門山之地奪過來
english: At that time we took their land from the two kings of the Amorites on the far side of Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon;

chinese: （這黑門山，西頓人稱為西連，亞摩利人稱為示尼珥），
english: (By the Sidonians, Hermon is named Sirion, and by the Amorites Shenir;)

chinese: 就是奪了平原的各城、基列全地、巴珊全地，直到撒迦和以得來，都是巴珊王噩國內的城邑。
english: All the towns of the table-land and all Gilead and Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, towns of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

chinese: （利乏音人所剩下的只有巴珊王噩。他的床是鐵的，長九肘，寬四肘，都是以人肘為度。現今豈不是在亞捫人的拉巴麼？）
english: (For Og, king of Bashan, was the last of all the Rephaim; his bed was made of iron; is it not in Rabbah, in the land of the children of Ammon? It was nine cubits long and four cubits wide, measured by the common cubit.)

chinese: 那時，我們得了這地。從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥起，我將基列山地的一半，並其中的城邑，都給了流便人和迦得人。
english: And this land which we took at that time, from Aroer by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill-country of Gilead with its towns, I gave to the Reubenites and the Gadites.

chinese: 其餘的基列地和巴珊全地，就是噩王的國，我給了瑪拿西半支派。亞珥歌伯全地乃是巴珊全地；這叫做利乏音人之地。
english: The rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, all the land of Argob, together with Bashan, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh. (This land is named the land of the Rephaim.

chinese: 瑪拿西的子孫睚珥佔了亞珥歌伯全境，直到基述人和瑪迦人的交界，就按自己的名稱這巴珊地為哈倭特睚珥，直到今日。
english: Jair, the son of Manasseh, took all the land of Argob, as far as the country of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, naming it, Bashan, Havvoth-Jair after himself, as it is to this day.)

chinese: 我又將基列給了瑪吉。
english: And Gilead I gave to Machir.

chinese: 從基列到亞嫩谷，以谷中為界，直到亞捫人交界的雅博河，我給了流便人和迦得人，
english: And the land from Gilead to the valley of the Arnon, with the middle of the valley as a limit, as far as the river Jabbok which is the limit of the country of the children of Ammon, I gave to the Reubenites and the Gadites;

chinese: 又將亞拉巴和靠近約但河之地，從基尼烈直到亞拉巴海，就是鹽海，並毘斯迦山根東邊之地，都給了他們。
english: As well as the Arabah, with the river Jordan as their limit, from Chinnereth to the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah to the east.

chinese: 那時，我吩咐你們說：耶和華─你們的神已將這地賜給你們為業；你們所有的勇士都要帶著兵器，在你們的弟兄以色列人前面過去。
english: At that time I gave you orders, saying, The Lord has given you this land for your heritage: all the men of war are to go over armed before your brothers the children of Israel.

chinese: 但你們的妻子、孩子、牲畜（我知道你們有許多的牲畜）可以住在我所賜給你們的各城裡。
english: But your wives and your little ones and your cattle (for it is clear that you have much cattle) may go on living in the towns I have given you;

chinese: 等到你們弟兄在約但河那邊，也得耶和華─你們神所賜給他們的地，又使他們得享平安，與你們一樣，你們才可以回到我所賜給你們為業之地。
english: Till the Lord has given rest to your brothers as to you, and till they have taken for themselves the land which the Lord your God is giving them on the other side of Jordan: then you may go back, every man of you, to the heritage which I have given you.

chinese: 那時我吩咐約書亞說：你親眼看見了耶和華─你神向這二王所行的；耶和華也必向你所要去的各國照樣行。
english: And I gave orders to Joshua at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen what the Lord your God has done to these two kings: so will the Lord do to all the kingdoms into which you come.

chinese: 你不要怕他們，因那為你爭戰的是耶和華─你的神。
english: Have no fear of them, for the Lord your God will be fighting for you.

chinese: 那時，我懇求耶和華說：
english: And at that time I made request to the Lord, saying,

chinese: 主耶和華阿，你已將你的大力大能顯給僕人看。在天上，在地下，有甚麼神能像你行事、像你有大能的作為呢？
english: O Lord God, you have now for the first time let your servant see your great power and the strength of your hand; for what god is there in heaven or on earth able to do such great works and such acts of power?

chinese: 求你容我過去，看約但河那邊的美地，就是那佳美的山地和利巴嫩。
english: Let me go over, O Lord, and see the good land on the other side of Jordan, and that fair mountain country, even Lebanon.

chinese: 但耶和華因你們的緣故向我發怒，不應允我，對我說：罷了！你不要向我再題這事。
english: But the Lord was angry with me because of you and would not give ear to my prayer; and the Lord said to me, Let it be enough, say no more about this thing.

chinese: 你且上毘斯迦山頂去，向東、西、南、北舉目觀望，因為你必不能過這約但河。
english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and turning your eyes to the west and the north, to the south and the east, see the land with your eyes: for you are not to go over Jordan.

chinese: 你卻要囑咐約書亞，勉勵他，使他膽壯；因為他必在這百姓前面過去，使他們承受你所要觀看之地。
english: But give my orders to Joshua, comforting him and making him strong; for he is to go over Jordan at the head of this people, and he will give them this land which you will see for their heritage.

chinese: 於是我們住在伯毘珥對面的谷中。
english: So we were waiting in the valley facing Beth-peor.

chinese: 以色列人哪，現在我所教訓你們的律例典章，你們要聽從遵行，好叫你們存活，得以進入耶和華─你們列祖之神所賜給你們的地，承受為業。
english: And now give ear, O Israel, to the laws and the decisions which I am teaching you, and do them; so that life may be yours, and you may go in and take for yourselves the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, is giving you.

chinese: 所吩咐你們的話，你們不可加添，也不可刪減，好叫你們遵守我所吩咐的，就是耶和華─你們神的命令。
english: Make no addition to the orders which I give you, and take nothing from them, but keep the orders of the Lord your God which I give you.

chinese: 耶和華因巴力毘珥的事所行的，你們親眼看見了。凡隨從巴力毘珥的人，耶和華─你們的神都從你們中間除滅了。
english: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baal-peor: for destruction came from the Lord on all those among you who went after Baal-peor.

chinese: 惟有你們專靠耶和華─你們神的人，今日全都存活。
english: But you who kept faith with the Lord are living, every one of you, today.

chinese: 我照著耶和華─我神所吩咐的將律例典章教訓你們，使你們在所要進去得為業的地上遵行。
english: I have been teaching you laws and decisions, as I was ordered to do by the Lord my God, so that you might keep them in the land to which you are going to take it for your heritage.

chinese: 所以你們要謹守遵行；這就是你們在萬民眼前的智慧、聰明。他們聽見這一切律例，必說：這大國的人真是有智慧，有聰明！
english: So keep these laws and do them; for so will your wisdom and good sense be clear in the eyes of the peoples, who hearing all these laws will say, Truly, this great nation is a wise and far-seeing people.

chinese: 那一大國的人有神與他們相近，像耶和華─我們的　神、在我們求告他的時候與我們相近呢？
english: For what great nation has a god so near to them as the Lord our God is, whenever we are turned to him in prayer?

chinese: 又那一大國有這樣公義的律例典章、像我今日在你們面前所陳明的這一切律法呢？
english: And what great nation has laws and decisions so right as all this law which I put before you today?

chinese: 你只要謹慎，殷勤保守你的心靈，免得忘記你親眼所看見的事，又免得你一生這事離開你的心；總要傳給你的子子孫孫。
english: Only take care, and keep watch on your soul, for fear that the things which your eyes have seen go from your memory and from your heart all the days of your life; but let the knowledge of them be given to your children and to your children's children;

chinese: 你在何烈山站在耶和華─你神面前的那日，耶和華對我說：你為我招聚百姓，我要叫他們聽見我的話，使他們存活在世的日子，可以學習敬畏我，又可以教訓兒女這樣行。
english: That day when you were waiting before the Lord your God in Horeb, and the Lord said to me, Make all the people come together, so that hearing my words they may go in fear of me all the days of their life on earth and give this teaching to their children.

chinese: 那時你們近前來，站在山下；山上有火焰沖天，並有昏黑、密雲、幽暗。
english: And you came near, waiting at the foot of the mountain; and flames of fire went up from the mountain to the heart of heaven, with dark clouds, and all was black as night.

chinese: 耶和華從火焰中對你們說話，你們只聽見聲音，卻沒有看見形像。
english: And the voice of the Lord came to you out of the fire: the sound of his words came to your ears but you saw no form; there was nothing but a voice.

chinese: 他將所吩咐你們當守的約指示你們，就是十條誡，並將這誡寫在兩塊石版上。
english: And he gave you his agreement with you, the ten rules which you were to keep, which he put in writing on the two stones of the law.

chinese: 那時耶和華又吩咐我將律例典章教訓你們，使你們在所要過去得為業的地上遵行。
english: And the Lord gave me orders at that time to make clear to you these laws and decisions, so that you might do them in the land to which you are going, and which is to be your heritage.

chinese: 所以，你們要分外謹慎；因為耶和華在何烈山、從火中對你們說話的那日，你們沒有看見甚麼形像。
english: So keep watch on yourselves with care; for you saw no form of any sort on the day when the voice of the Lord came to you in Horeb out of the heart of the fire:

chinese: 惟恐你們敗壞自己，雕刻偶像，彷彿甚麼男像女像，
english: So that you may not be turned to evil ways and make for yourselves an image in the form of any living thing, male or female,

chinese: 或地上走獸的像，或空中飛鳥的像，
english: Or any beast of the earth, or winged bird of the air,

chinese: 或地上爬物的像，或地底下水中魚的像。
english: Or of anything which goes flat on the earth, or any fish in the water under the earth.

chinese: 又恐怕你向天舉目觀看，見耶和華─你的神為天下萬民所擺列的日月星，就是天上的萬象，自己便被勾引敬拜事奉他。
english: And when your eyes are lifted up to heaven, and you see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the army of heaven, do not let yourselves be moved to give them worship, or become the servants of what the Lord has given equally to all peoples under heaven.

chinese: 耶和華將你們從埃及領出來，脫離鐵爐，要特作自己產業的子民，像今日一樣。
english: But the Lord has taken you out of the flaming fire, out of Egypt, to be to him the people of his heritage, as you are today.

chinese: 耶和華又因你們的緣故向我發怒，起誓必不容我過約但河，也不容我進入耶和華─你神所賜你為業的那美地。
english: And the Lord was angry with me because of you, and made an oath that I was not to go over Jordan into the good land which the Lord is giving you for your heritage:

chinese: 我只得死在這地，不能過約但河；但你們必過去得那美地。
english: But death is to come to me in this land, I may not go over Jordan: but you will go over and take that good land for your heritage.

chinese: 你們要謹慎，免得忘記耶和華─你們神與你們所立的約，為自己雕刻偶像，就是耶和華─你　神所禁止你做的偶像；
english: Take care that you do not let the agreement of the Lord your God, which he has made with you, go out of your mind, or make for yourselves images of any sort, against the orders which the Lord your God has given you.

chinese: 因為耶和華─你的神乃是烈火，是忌邪的　神。
english: For the Lord your God is an all-burning fire, and he will not let the honour which is his be given to any other.

chinese: 你們在那地住久了，生子生孫，就雕刻偶像，彷彿甚麼形像，敗壞自己，行耶和華─你神眼中看為惡的事，惹他發怒。
english: If, when you have had children and children's children, and have been living a long time in the land, you are turned to evil ways, and make an image of any sort, and do evil in the eyes of the Lord your God, moving him to wrath:

chinese: 我今日呼天喚地向你們作見證，你們必在過約但河得為業的地上速速滅盡！你們不能在那地上長久，必盡行除滅。
english: May heaven and earth be my witnesses against you today, that destruction will quickly overtake you, cutting you off from that land which you are going over Jordan to take; your days will not be long in that land, but you will come to a complete end.

chinese: 耶和華必使你們分散在萬民中；在他所領你們到的萬國裡，你們剩下的人數稀少。
english: And the Lord will send you wandering among the peoples; only a small band of you will be kept from death among the nations where the Lord will send you.

chinese: 在那裡，你們必事奉人手所造的神，就是用木石造成、不能看、不能聽、不能吃、不能聞的　神。
english: There you will be the servants of gods, made by men's hands, of wood and stone, having no power of seeing or hearing or taking food or smelling.

chinese: 但你們在那裡必尋求耶和華─你的神。你盡心盡性尋求他的時候，就必尋見。
english: But if in those lands you are turned again to the Lord your God, searching for him with all your heart and soul, he will not keep himself from you.

chinese: 日後你遭遇一切患難的時候，你必歸回耶和華─你的神，聽從他的話。
english: When you are in trouble and all these things have come on you, if, in the future, you are turned again to the Lord your God, and give ear to his voice:

chinese: 耶和華─你神原是有憐憫的　神；他總不撇下你，不滅絕你，也不忘記他起誓與你列祖所立的約。
english: Because the Lord your God is a God of mercy, he will not take away his help from you or let destruction overtake you, or be false to the agreement which he made by an oath with your fathers.

chinese: 你且考察在你以前的世代，自神造人在世以來，從天這邊到天那邊，曾有何民聽見　神在火中說話的聲音，像你聽見還能存活呢？
english: Give thought now to the days which are past, before your time, from the day when God first gave life to man on the earth, and searching from one end of heaven to the other, see if such a great thing as this has ever been, or if anything like it has been talked of in story.

chinese: 這樣的大事何曾有、何曾聽見呢？
english: Has any people ever gone on living after hearing the voice of God out of the heart of the fire as you did?

chinese: 神何曾從別的國中將一國的人民領出來，用試驗、神蹟、奇事、爭戰、大能的手，和伸出來的膀臂，並大可畏的事，像耶和華─你們的神在埃及，在你們眼前為你們所行的一切事呢？
english: Has God ever before taken a nation for himself from out of another nation, by punishments and signs and wonders, by war and by a strong hand and a stretched-out arm and great acts of wonder and fear, as the Lord your God did for you in Egypt, before your very eyes?

chinese: 這是顯給你看，要使你知道，惟有耶和華─他是神，除他以外，再無別神。
english: All this he let you see, so that you might be certain that the Lord is God and there is no other.

chinese: 他從天上使你聽見他的聲音，為要教訓你，又在地上使你看見他的烈火，並且聽見他從火中所說的話。
english: Out of heaven itself his voice came to you, teaching you; and on earth he let you see his great fire; and his words came to your ears out of the heart of the fire.

chinese: 因他愛你的列祖，所以揀選他們的後裔，用大能親自領你出了埃及，
english: And because of his love for your fathers, he took their seed and made it his, and he himself, present among you, took you out of Egypt by his great power;

chinese: 要將比你強大的國民從你面前趕出，領你進去，將他們的地賜你為業，像今日一樣。
english: Driving out before you nations greater and stronger than you, to take you into their land and give it to you for your heritage, as at this day.

chinese: 所以，今日你要知道，也要記在心上，天上地下惟有耶和華他是神，除他以外，再無別神。
english: So today be certain, and keep the knowledge deep in your hearts, that the Lord is God, in heaven on high and here on earth; there is no other God.

chinese: 我今日將他的律例誡命曉諭你，你要遵守，使你和你的子孫可以得福，並使你的日子在耶和華─你神所賜的地上得以長久。
english: Then keep his laws and his orders which I give you today, so that it may be well for you and for your children after you, and that your lives may be long in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for ever.

chinese: 那時，摩西在約但河東，向日出之地，分定三座城，
english: Then Moses had three towns marked out on the far side of Jordan looking to the east;

chinese: 使那素無仇恨、無心殺了人的，可以逃到這三城之中的一座城，就得存活：
english: To which anyone causing the death of his neighbour in error and not through hate, might go in flight; so that in one of these towns he might be kept from death:

chinese: 為流便人分定曠野平原的比悉；為迦得人分定基列的拉末；為瑪拿西人分定巴珊的哥蘭。
english: The names of the towns were Bezer in the waste land, in the table-land, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for Manasseh.

chinese: 摩西在以色列人面前所陳明的律法─
english: This is the law which Moses put before the children of Israel:

chinese: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及後所傳給他們的法度、律例、典章；
english: These are the rules and the laws and the decisions which Moses gave to the children of Israel after they came out of Egypt;

chinese: 在約但河東伯毘珥對面的谷中，在住希實本、亞摩利王西宏之地；這西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及後所擊殺的。
english: On the far side of Jordan, in the valley facing Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel overcame after they had come out of Egypt:

chinese: 他們得了他的地，又得了巴珊王噩的地，就是兩個亞摩利王，在約但河東向日出之地。
english: And they took his land for a heritage, and the land of Og, king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, whose lands were on the other side of Jordan to the east;

chinese: 從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥，直到西雲山，就是黑門山。
english: From Aroer on the edge of the valley of the Arnon as far as Mount Sion, which is Hermon,

chinese: 還有約但河東的全亞拉巴，直到亞拉巴海，靠近毘斯迦山根。
english: And all the Arabah on the far side of Jordan to the east, as far as the sea of the Arabah under the slopes of Pisgah.

chinese: 摩西將以色列眾人召了來，對他們說：以色列人哪，我今日曉諭你們的律例典章，你們要聽，可以學習，謹守遵行。
english: And Moses sent for all Israel, and said to them, Give ear, O Israel, to the laws and the decisions which I give you today, and give attention to them so that you may keep and do them.

chinese: 耶和華─我們的神在何烈山與我們立約。
english: The Lord our God made an agreement with us in Horeb.

chinese: 這約不是與我們列祖立的，乃是與我們今日在這裡存活之人立的。
english: The Lord did not make this agreement with our fathers but with us, who are all living and present here today.

chinese: 耶和華在山上，從火中，面對面與你們說話─
english: The word of the Lord came to you face to face on the mountain, out of the heart of the fire,

chinese: 那時我站在耶和華和你們中間，要將耶和華的話傳給你們；因為你們懼怕那火，沒有上山─說：
english: (I was between the Lord and you at that time, to make clear to you the word of the Lord: because, through fear of the fire, you did not go up the mountain;) saying,

chinese: 我是耶和華─你的神，曾將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來。
english: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.

chinese: 除了我以外，你不可有別的神。
english: You are to have no other gods but me.

chinese: 不可為自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚麼形像，彷彿上天、下地和地底下、水中的百物。
english: You may not make for yourselves an image in the form of anything in heaven or on earth or in the waters under the earth:

chinese: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉他，因為我耶和華─你的神是忌邪的　神。恨我的，我必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代；
english: You may not go down on your faces before them or give them worship: for I, the Lord your God, am a God who will not give his honour to another; and I will send punishment on the children for the wrongdoing of their fathers, to the third and fourth generation of my haters;

chinese: 愛我、守我誡命的，我必向他們發慈愛，直到千代。
english: And I will have mercy through a thousand generations on those who have love for me and keep my laws.

chinese: 不可妄稱耶和華─你神的名；因為妄稱耶和華名的，耶和華必不以他為無罪。
english: You are not to make use of the name of the Lord your God for an evil purpose; whoever takes the Lord's name on his lips for an evil purpose will be judged as a sinner by the Lord.

chinese: 當照耶和華─你神所吩咐的守安息日為聖日。
english: Keep the Sabbath day as a holy day, as you have been ordered by the Lord your God.

chinese: 六日要勞碌做你一切的工，
english: On six days do all your work:

chinese: 但第七日是向耶和華─你神當守的安息日。這一日，你和你的兒女、僕婢、牛、驢、牲畜，並在你城裡寄居的客旅，無論何工都不可做，使你的僕婢可以和你一樣安息。
english: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God; on that day do no work, you or your son or your daughter, or your man-servant or your woman-servant, or your ox or your ass or any of your cattle, or the man from a strange country who is living among you; so that your man-servant and your woman-servant may have rest as well as you.

chinese: 你也要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕；耶和華─你神用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂將你從那裡領出來。因此，耶和華─你的　神吩咐你守安息日。
english: And keep in mind that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord your God took you out of that land by his strong hand and his stretched-out arm: for this reason the Lord has given you orders to keep the Sabbath day.

chinese: 當照耶和華─你神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，並使你的日子在耶和華─你　神所賜你的地上得以長久。
english: Give honour to your father and your mother, as you have been ordered by the Lord your God; so that your life may be long and all may be well for you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

chinese: 不可殺人。
english: Do not put anyone to death without cause.

chinese: 不可姦淫。
english: Do not be false to the married relation.

chinese: 不可偷盜。
english: Do not take the property of another.

chinese: 不可作假見證陷害人。
english: Do not give false witness against your neighbour;

chinese: 不可貪戀人的妻子；也不可貪圖人的房屋、田地、僕婢、牛、驢，並他一切所有的。
english: Or let your desire be turned to your neighbour's wife, or his house or his field or his man-servant or his woman-servant or his ox or his ass or anything which is your neighbour's.

chinese: 這些話是耶和華在山上，從火中、雲中、幽暗中，大聲曉諭你們全會眾的；此外並沒有添別的話。他就把這話寫在兩塊石版上，交給我了。
english: These words the Lord said to all of you together on the mountain, out of the heart of the fire, out of the cloud and the dark, with a great voice: and he said no more; he put them in writing on the two stones of the law and gave them to me.

chinese: 那時，火焰燒山，你們聽見從黑暗中出來的聲音；你們支派中所有的首領和長老都來就近我，
english: And after hearing the voice which came out of the dark while the mountain was burning with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your chiefs came to me,

chinese: 說：看哪，耶和華─我們神將他的榮光和他的大能顯給我們看，我們又聽見他的聲音從火中出來。今日我們得見　神與人說話，人還存活。
english: And said, The Lord has let us see his glory and his power, and his voice has come to us out of the fire: today we have seen that a man may go on living even after hearing the voice of God.

chinese: 現在這大火將要燒滅我們，我們何必冒死呢？若再聽見耶和華─我們神的聲音就必死亡。
english: Why then is death to be our fate? For if the voice of the Lord our God comes to us any more, death will overtake us, and we will be burned up in this great fire.

chinese: 凡屬血氣的，曾有何人聽見永生神的聲音從火中出來，像我們聽見還能存活呢？
english: For what man is there in all the earth, who, hearing the voice of the living God as we have, out of the heart of the fire, has been kept from death?

chinese: 求你近前去，聽耶和華─我們神所要說的一切話，將他對你說的話都傳給我們，我們就聽從遵行。
english: Do you go near: and after hearing everything which the Lord our God has to say, give us an account of all he has said to you, and we will give ear, and do it.

chinese: 你們對我說的話，耶和華都聽見了。耶和華對我說：這百姓的話，我聽見了；他們所說的都是。
english: Then the Lord, hearing your words to me, said to me, The words which this people have said to you have come to my ears: what they have said is well said.

chinese: 惟願他們存這樣的心敬畏我，常遵守我的一切誡命，使他們和他們的子孫永遠得福。
english: If only they had such a heart in them at all times, so that they might go in fear of me and keep my orders and that it might be well for them and for their children for ever!

chinese: 你去對他們說：你們回帳棚去罷！
english: Now say to them, Go back to your tents.

chinese: 至於你，可以站在我這裡，我要將一切誡命、律例、典章傳給你；你要教訓他們，使他們在我賜他們為業的地上遵行。
english: But as for you, keep your place here by me, and I will give you all the orders and the laws and the decisions which you are to make clear to them, so that they may do them in the land which I am giving them for their heritage.

chinese: 所以，你們要照耶和華─你們神所吩咐的謹守遵行，不可偏離左右。
english: Take care, then, to do whatever the Lord your God has given you orders to do; let there be no turning away to the right hand or to the left.

chinese: 耶和華─你們神所吩咐你們行的，你們都要去行，使你們可以存活得福，並使你們的日子在所要承受的地上得以長久。
english: Go on walking in the way ordered for you by the Lord your God, so that life may be yours and it may be well for you, and your days may be long in the land of your heritage.

chinese: 這是耶和華─你們神所吩咐教訓你們的誡命、律例、典章，使你們在所要過去得為業的地上遵行，
english: Now these are the orders and the laws and the decisions which the Lord your God gave me for your teaching, so that you might do them in the land of your heritage to which you are going:

chinese: 好叫你和你子子孫孫一生敬畏耶和華─你的神，謹守他的一切律例誡命，就是我所吩咐你的，使你的日子得以長久。
english: So that living in the fear of the Lord your God, you may keep all his laws and his orders, which I give you: you and your son and your son's son, all the days of your life; and so that your life may be long.

chinese: 以色列阿，你要聽，要謹守遵行，使你可以在那流奶與蜜之地得以享福，人數極其增多，正如耶和華─你列祖的神所應許你的。
english: So give ear, O Israel, and take care to do this; so that it may be well for you, and you may be greatly increased, as the Lord the God of your fathers has given you his word, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

chinese: 以色列阿，你要聽！耶和華─我們神是獨一的主。
english: Give ear, O Israel: the Lord our God is one Lord:

chinese: 你要盡心、盡性、盡力愛耶和華─你的神。
english: And the Lord your God is to be loved with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

chinese: 我今日所吩咐你的話都要記在心上，
english: Keep these words, which I say to you this day, deep in your hearts;

chinese: 也要殷勤教訓你的兒女。無論你坐在家裡，行在路上，躺下，起來，都要談論。
english: Teaching them to your children with all care, talking of them when you are at rest in your house or walking by the way, when you go to sleep and when you get up.

chinese: 也要繫在手上為記號，戴在額上為經文；
english: Let them be fixed as a sign on your hand, and marked on your brow;

chinese: 又要寫在你房屋的門框上，並你的城門上。
english: Have them lettered on the pillars of your houses and over the doors of your towns.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神領你進他向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許給你的地。那裡有城邑，又大又美，非你所建造的；
english: And when the Lord your God has taken you into the land which he gave his oath to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, that he would give you; with great and fair towns which were not of your building;

chinese: 有房屋，裝滿各樣美物，非你所裝滿的；有鑿成的水井，非你所鑿成的；還有葡萄園、橄欖園，非你所栽種的；你吃了而且飽足。
english: And houses full of good things not stored up by you, and places for storing water which you did not make, and vine-gardens and olive-trees not of your planting; and you have taken food and are full;

chinese: 那時你要謹慎，免得你忘記將你從埃及地、為奴之家領出來的耶和華。
english: Then take care that you keep your hearts true to the Lord, who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.

chinese: 你要敬畏耶和華─你的神，事奉他，指著他的名起誓。
english: Let the fear of the Lord your God be in your hearts, and be his servants, taking your oaths by his name.

chinese: 不可隨從別神，就是你們四圍國民的　神；
english: Do not go after other gods, the gods of the peoples round about you;

chinese: 因為在你們中間的耶和華─你神是忌邪的　神，惟恐耶和華─你　神的怒氣向你發作，就把你從地上除滅。
english: For the Lord your God who is with you is a God who will not let his honour be given to another; or the wrath of the Lord will be burning against you, causing your destruction from the face of the earth.

chinese: 你們不可試探耶和華─你們的神，像你們在瑪撒那樣試探他。
english: Do not put the Lord your God to the test as you did in Massah.

chinese: 要留意遵守耶和華─你們神所吩咐的誡命、法度、律例。
english: Keep with care the orders of the Lord your God, and his rules and his laws which he has given you;

chinese: 耶和華眼中看為正、看為善的，你都要遵行，使你可以享福，並可以進去得耶和華向你列祖起誓應許的那美地，
english: And do what is upright and good in the eyes of the Lord your God, so that it may be well for you and you may go in and take for your heritage that good land from which the Lord undertook by an oath to your fathers,

chinese: 照耶和華所說的，從你面前攆出你的一切仇敵。
english: To send out from before you all those who are against you.

chinese: 日後，你的兒子問你說：耶和華─我們神吩咐你們的這些法度、律例、典章是甚麼意思呢？
english: And when your son says to you in time to come, What is the reason for these rules and laws and decisions which the Lord our God has given you?

chinese: 你就告訴你的兒子說：我們在埃及作過法老的奴僕；耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及領出來，
english: Then you will say to your son, We were servants under Pharaoh's yoke in Egypt; and the Lord took us out of Egypt with a strong hand:

chinese: 在我們眼前，將重大可怕的神蹟奇事施行在埃及地和法老並他全家的身上，
english: And the Lord did great signs and wonders against Egypt, and against Pharaoh and all his house, before our eyes:

chinese: 將我們從那裡領出來，要領我們進入他向我們列祖起誓應許之地，把這地賜給我們。
english: And he took us out from that place, guiding us here to give us this land, as he said in his oath to our fathers.

chinese: 耶和華又吩咐我們遵行這一切律例，要敬畏耶和華─我們的神，使我們常得好處，蒙他保全我們的生命，像今日一樣。
english: And the Lord gave us orders to keep all these laws, in the fear of the Lord our God, so that it might be well for us for ever, and that he might keep us from death, as he has done to this day.

chinese: 我們若照耶和華─我們神所吩咐的一切誡命謹守遵行，這就是我們的義了。
english: And it will be our righteousness if we take care to keep all this order before the Lord our God as he has given it to us.

chinese: 耶和華─你神領你進入要得為業之地，從你面前趕出許多國民，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七國的民，都比你強大。
english: When the Lord your God takes you into the land where you are going, which is to be your heritage, and has sent out the nations before you, the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and stronger than you;

chinese: 耶和華─你神將他們交給你擊殺，那時你要把他們滅絕淨盡，不可與他們立約，也不可憐恤他們。
english: And when the Lord has given them up into your hands and you have overcome them, give them up to complete destruction: make no agreement with them, and have no mercy on them:

chinese: 不可與他們結親。不可將你的女兒嫁他們的兒子，也不可叫你的兒子娶他們的女兒；
english: Do not take wives or husbands from among them; do not give your daughters to their sons, or take their daughters for your sons.

chinese: 因為他必使你兒子轉離不跟從主，去事奉別神，以致耶和華的怒氣向你們發作，就速速地將你們滅絕。
english: For through them your sons will be turned from me to the worship of other gods: and the Lord will be moved to wrath against you and send destruction on you quickly.

chinese: 你們卻要這樣待他們：拆毀他們的祭壇，打碎他們的柱像，砍下他們的木偶，用火焚燒他們雕刻的偶像。
english: But this is what you are to do to them: their altars are to be pulled down and their pillars broken, and their holy trees cut down and their images burned with fire.

chinese: 因為你歸耶和華─你神為聖潔的民；耶和華─你　神從地上的萬民中揀選你，特作自己的子民。
english: For you are a holy people to the Lord your God: marked out by the Lord your God to be his special people out of all the nations on the face of the earth.

chinese: 耶和華專愛你們，揀選你們，並非因你們的人數多於別民，原來你們的人數在萬民中是最少的。
english: The Lord did not give you his love or take you for himself because you were more in number than any other people; for you were the smallest of the nations:

chinese: 只因耶和華愛你們，又因要守他向你們列祖所起的誓，就用大能的手領你們出來，從為奴之家救贖你們脫離埃及王法老的手。
english: But because of his love for you, and in order to keep his oath to your fathers, the Lord took you out with the strength of his hand, making you free from the prison-house and from the hand of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.

chinese: 所以，你要知道耶和華─你的神，他是　神，是信實的　神；向愛他、守他誡命的人守約，施慈愛，直到千代；
english: Be certain, then, that the Lord your God is God; whose faith and mercy are unchanging, who keeps his word through a thousand generations to those who have love for him and keep his laws;

chinese: 向恨他的人當面報應他們，將他們滅絕。凡恨他的人必報應他們，決不遲延。
english: Rewarding his haters to their face with destruction; he will have no mercy on his hater, but will give him open punishment.

chinese: 所以，你要謹守遵行我今日所吩咐你的誡命、律例、典章。
english: So keep the orders and the laws and the decisions which I give you today and do them.

chinese: 你們果然聽從這些典章，謹守遵行，耶和華─你神就必照他向你列祖所起的誓守約，施慈愛。
english: And it will be, that if you give attention to these decisions and keep and do them, then the Lord will keep his agreement with you and his mercy, as he said in his oath to your fathers.

chinese: 他必愛你，賜福與你，使你人數增多，也必在他向你列祖起誓應許給你的地上賜福與你身所生的，地所產的，並你的五穀、新酒，和油，以及牛犢、羊羔。
english: And he will give you his love, blessing you and increasing you: he will send his blessing on the offspring of your body and the fruit of your land, your grain and your wine and your oil, the increase of your cattle and the young of your flock, in the land which by his oath to your fathers he undertook to give you.

chinese: 你必蒙福勝過萬民；你們的男女沒有不能生養的，牲畜也沒有不能生育的。
english: You will have greater blessings than any other people: no male or female among you or among your cattle will be without offspring.

chinese: 耶和華必使一切的病症離開你；你所知道埃及各樣的惡疾，他不加在你身上，只加在一切恨你的人身上。
english: And the Lord will take away from you all disease, and will not put on you any of the evil diseases of Egypt which you have seen, but will put them on your haters.

chinese: 耶和華─你神所要交給你的一切人民，你要將他們除滅；你眼不可顧惜他們。你也不可事奉他們的　神，因這必成為你的網羅。
english: And you are to send destruction on all the peoples which the Lord your God gives into your hands; have no pity on them, and do not give worship to their gods; for that will be a cause of sin to you.

chinese: 你若心裡說，這些國的民比我更多，我怎能趕出他們呢？
english: If you say in your hearts, These nations are greater in number than we are: how are we to take their land from them?

chinese: 你不要懼怕他們，要牢牢記念耶和華─你神向法老和埃及全地所行的事，
english: Have no fear of them, but keep well in mind what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt;

chinese: 就是你親眼所看見的大試驗、神蹟、奇事，和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂，都是耶和華─你神領你出來所用的。耶和華─你　神必照樣待你所懼怕的一切人民。
english: The great punishments which your eyes saw, and the signs and the wonders and the strong hand and the stretched-out arm, by which the Lord your God took you out: so will the Lord your God do to all the peoples who are the cause of your fears.

chinese: 並且耶和華─你神必打發黃蜂飛到他們中間，直到那剩下而藏躲的人從你面前滅亡。
english: And the Lord will send a hornet among them, till all the rest who have kept themselves safe from you in secret places have been cut off.

chinese: 你不要因他們驚恐，因為耶和華─你神在你們中間是大而可畏的　神。
english: Have no fear of them: for the Lord your God is with you, a great God greatly to be feared.

chinese: 耶和華─你神必將這些國的民從你面前漸漸趕出；你不可把他們速速滅盡，恐怕野地的獸多起來害你。
english: The Lord your God will send out the nations before you little by little; they are not to be rooted out quickly, for fear that the beasts of the field may be increased overmuch against you.

chinese: 耶和華─你神必將他們交給你，大大的擾亂他們，直到他們滅絕了；
english: But the Lord your God will give them up into your hands, overpowering them till their destruction is complete.

chinese: 又要將他們的君王交在你手中，你就使他們的名從天下消滅。必無一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你將他們滅絕了。
english: He will give their kings into your hands, and you will put their names out of existence under heaven; there is not one of them who will not give way before you, till their destruction is complete.

chinese: 他們雕刻的神像，你們要用火焚燒；其上的金銀，你不可貪圖，也不可收取，免得你因此陷入網羅；這原是耶和華─你　神所憎惡的。
english: The images of their gods are to be burned with fire: have no desire for the gold and silver on them, and do not take it for yourselves, for it will be a danger to you: it is a thing disgusting to the Lord your God:

chinese: 可憎的物，你不可帶進家去；不然，你就成了當毀滅的，與那物一樣。你要十分厭惡，十分憎嫌，因為這是當毀滅的物。
english: And you may not take a disgusting thing into your house, and so become cursed with its curse: but keep yourselves from it, turning from it with fear and hate, for it is a cursed thing.

chinese: 我今日所吩咐的一切誡命，你們要謹守遵行，好叫你們存活，人數增多，且進去得耶和華向你們列祖起誓應許的那地。
english: Take care to keep all the orders which I give you today, so that you may have life and be increased and go in and take as a heritage the land which the Lord, by his oath to your fathers, undertook to give you.

chinese: 你也要記念耶和華─你的神在曠野引導你這四十年，是要苦煉你，試驗你，要知道你心內如何，肯守他的誡命不肯。
english: And keep in mind the way by which the Lord your God has taken you through the waste land these forty years, so that he might make low your pride and put you to the test, to see what was in your heart and if you would keep his orders or not.

chinese: 他苦煉你，任你飢餓，將你和你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，使你知道，人活著不是單靠食物，乃是靠耶和華口裡所出的一切話。
english: And he made low your pride and let you be without food and gave you manna for your food, a thing new to you, which your fathers never saw; so that he might make it clear to you that bread is not man's only need, but his life is in every word which comes out of the mouth of the Lord.

chinese: 這四十年，你的衣服沒有穿破，你的腳也沒有腫。
english: Through all these forty years your clothing did not get old or your feet become tired.

chinese: 你當心裡思想，耶和華─你神管教你，好像人管教兒子一樣。
english: Keep in mind this thought, that as a son is trained by his father, so you have been trained by the Lord your God.

chinese: 你要謹守耶和華─你神的誡命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。
english: Then keep the orders of the Lord your God, fearing him and walking in his ways.

chinese: 因為耶和華─你神領你進入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，從山谷中流出水來。
english: For the Lord your God is guiding you into a good land, a land of water-springs, of fountains, and deep streams flowing out from the valleys and the hills;

chinese: 那地有小麥、大麥、葡萄樹、無花果樹、石榴樹、橄欖樹，和蜜。
english: A land of grain and vines and fig-trees and fair fruits; a land of oil-giving olive-trees and honey;

chinese: 你在那地不缺食物，一無所缺。那地的石頭是鐵，山內可以挖銅。
english: Where there will be bread for you in full measure and you will be in need of nothing; a land where the very stones are iron and from whose hills you may get copper.

chinese: 你吃得飽足，就要稱頌耶和華─你的神，因他將那美地賜給你了。
english: And you will have food enough and be full, praising the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.

chinese: 你要謹慎，免得忘記耶和華─你的神，不守他的誡命、典章、律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；
english: Then take care that you are not turned away from the Lord your God and from keeping his orders and decisions and laws which I give you this day:

chinese: 恐怕你吃得飽足，建造美好的房屋居住，
english: And when you have taken food and are full, and have made fair houses for yourselves and are living in them;

chinese: 你的牛羊加多，你的金銀增添，並你所有的全都加增，
english: And when your herds and your flocks are increased, and your stores of silver and gold, and you have wealth of every sort;

chinese: 你就心高氣傲，忘記耶和華─你的神，就是將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來的，
english: Take care that your hearts are not lifted up in pride, giving no thought to the Lord your God who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house;

chinese: 引你經過那大而可怕的曠野，那裡有火蛇、蠍子、乾旱無水之地。他曾為你使水從堅硬的磐石中流出來，
english: Who was your guide through that great and cruel waste, where there were poison-snakes and scorpions and a dry land without water; who made water come out of the hard rock for you;

chinese: 又在曠野將你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，是要苦煉你，試驗你，叫你終久享福；
english: Who gave you manna for your food in the waste land, a food which your fathers had never seen; so that your pride might be broken and your hearts tested for your good in the end;

chinese: 恐怕你心裡說：這貨財是我力量、我能力得來的。
english: Say not then, in your hearts, My power and the strength of my hands have got me this wealth.

chinese: 你要記念耶和華─你的神，因為得貨財的力量是他給你的，為要堅定他向你列祖起誓所立的約，像今日一樣。
english: But keep in mind the Lord your God: for it is he who gives you the power to get wealth, so that he may give effect to the agreement which he made by his oath with your fathers, as at this day.

chinese: 你若忘記耶和華─你的神，隨從別　神，事奉敬拜，你們必定滅亡；這是我今日警戒你們的。
english: And it is certain that if at any time you are turned away from the Lord your God, and go after other gods, to be their servants and to give them worship, destruction will overtake you.

chinese: 耶和華在你們面前怎樣使列國的民滅亡，你們也必照樣滅亡，因為你們不聽從耶和華─你們神的話。
english: Like the nations which the Lord is cutting off before you, so you will be cut off; because you would not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God.

chinese: 以色列阿，你當聽！你今日要過約但河，進去趕出比你強大的國民，得著廣大堅固、高得頂天的城邑。
english: Give ear, O Israel: today you are to go over Jordan, to take the heritage of nations greater and stronger than yourselves, and towns of great size with walls as high as heaven;

chinese: 那民是亞衲族的人，又大又高，是你所知道的；也曾聽見有人指著他們說：誰能在亞衲族人面前站立得住呢？
english: A people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, of whom you have knowledge and of whom it has been said, All are forced to give way before the sons of Anak.

chinese: 你今日當知道，耶和華─你的神在你前面過去，如同烈火，要滅絕他們，將他們制伏在你面前。這樣，你就要照耶和華所說的趕出他們，使他們速速滅亡。
english: Be certain then today that it is the Lord your God who goes over before you like an all-burning fire; he will send destruction on them, crushing them before you; and you will send them in flight, putting an end to them quickly, as the Lord has said.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神將這些國民從你面前攆出以後，你心裡不可說：耶和華將我領進來得這地是因我的義。其實，耶和華將他們從你面前趕出去是因他們的惡。
english: And after the Lord has sent them in flight from before you, say not in your heart, Because of my righteousness the Lord has given me this land; when it is because of their evil-doing that the Lord is driving these nations out before you.

chinese: 你進去得他們的地，並不是因你的義，也不是因你心裡正直，乃是因這些國民的惡，耶和華─你的神將他們從你面前趕出去，又因耶和華要堅定他向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓所應許的話。
english: Not for your righteousness or because your hearts are upright are you going in to take their land; but because of the evil-doing of these nations the Lord your God is driving them out from before you, and to give effect to his oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

chinese: 你當知道，耶和華─你神將這美地賜你為業，並不是因你的義；你本是硬著頸項的百姓。
english: Be certain then that the Lord your God is not giving you this good land as a reward for your righteousness; for you are a stiff-necked people.

chinese: 你當記念不忘，你在曠野怎樣惹耶和華─你神發怒。自從你出了埃及地的那日，直到你們來到這地方，你們時常悖逆耶和華。
english: Keep well in mind how you made the Lord your God angry in the waste land; from the day when you went out of Egypt till you came to this place, you have gone against the orders of the Lord.

chinese: 你們在何烈山又惹耶和華發怒；他惱怒你們，要滅絕你們。
english: Again in Horeb you made the Lord angry, and in his wrath he would have put an end to you.

chinese: 我上了山，要領受兩塊石版，就是耶和華與你們立約的版。那時我在山上住了四十晝夜，沒有吃飯，也沒有喝水。
english: When I had gone up into the mountain to be given the stones on which was recorded the agreement which the Lord made with you, I was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights without taking food or drinking water.

chinese: 耶和華把那兩塊石版交給我，是神用指頭寫的。版上所寫的是照耶和華在大會的日子、在山上、從火中對你們所說的一切話。
english: And the Lord gave me the two stones with writing on them done by the finger of God: on them were recorded all the words which the Lord said to you on the mountain out of the heart of the fire, on the day of the great meeting.

chinese: 過了四十晝夜，耶和華把那兩塊石版，就是約版，交給我。
english: Then at the end of forty days and forty nights the Lord gave me those stones, the stones of the agreement.

chinese: 對我說：你起來，趕快下去！因為你從埃及領出來的百姓已經敗壞了自己；他們快快的偏離了我所吩咐的道，為自己鑄成了偶像。
english: And the Lord said to me, Get up now, and go down quickly from this place; for the people you have taken out of Egypt have given themselves over to evil; they have quickly been turned from the way in which I gave them orders to go; they have made themselves a metal image.

chinese: 耶和華又對我說：我看這百姓是硬著頸項的百姓。
english: And then the Lord said to me, I have seen that this people is stiff-necked:

chinese: 你且由著我，我要滅絕他們，將他們的名從天下塗抹，使你的後裔比他們成為更大更強的國。
english: Let me send destruction on them till their very name is cut off; and I will make of you a nation greater and stronger than they.

chinese: 於是我轉身下山，山被火燒著，兩塊約版在我兩手之中。
english: So turning round I came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire; and the two stones of the agreement were in my hands.

chinese: 我一看見你們得罪了耶和華─你們的神，鑄成了牛犢，快快的偏離了耶和華所吩咐你們的道，
english: And I saw that you had done evil against the Lord, and had made for yourselves a metal image of a young ox: you had quickly been turned from the way in which the Lord had given you orders to go.

chinese: 我就把那兩塊版從我手中扔下去，在你們眼前摔碎了。
english: And I let the stones go from my hands, and they were broken before your eyes.

chinese: 因你們所犯的一切罪，行了耶和華眼中看為惡的事，惹他發怒，我就像從前俯伏在耶和華面前四十晝夜，沒有吃飯，也沒有喝水。
english: And I went down on my face before the Lord, as at the first, for forty days and forty nights, without taking food or drinking water, because of all your sin, in doing evil in the eyes of the Lord and moving him to wrath.

chinese: 我因耶和華向你們大發烈怒，要滅絕你們，就甚害怕；但那次耶和華又應允了我。
english: For I was full of fear because of the wrath of the Lord which was burning against you, with your destruction in view. But again the Lord's ear was open to my prayer.

chinese: 耶和華也向亞倫甚是發怒，要滅絕他；那時我又為亞倫祈禱。
english: And the Lord, in his wrath, would have put Aaron to death: and I made prayer for Aaron at the same time.

chinese: 我把那叫你們犯罪所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，又搗碎磨得很細，以至細如灰塵，我就把這灰塵撒在從山上流下來的溪水中。
english: And I took your sin, the image which you had made, and put it in the fire and had it hammered and crushed very small till it was only dust: and the dust I put in the stream flowing down from the mountain.

chinese: 你們在他備拉、瑪撒、基博羅哈他瓦又惹耶和華發怒。
english: Again at Taberah and at Massah and at Kibroth-hattaavah you made the Lord angry.

chinese: 耶和華打發你們離開加低斯巴尼亞，說：你們上去得我所賜給你們的地。那時你們違背了耶和華─你們神的命令，不信服他，不聽從他的話。
english: And when the Lord sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and take the land which I have given you; you went against the orders of the Lord your God, and had no faith in him, and would not give ear to his voice.

chinese: 自從我認識你們以來，你們常常悖逆耶和華。
english: From the day when I first had knowledge of you, you have gone against the word of the Lord.

chinese: 我因耶和華說要滅絕你們，就在耶和華面前照舊俯伏四十晝夜。
english: So I went down on my face in prayer before the Lord for forty days and forty nights as I did at first; because the Lord had said that he would put an end to you.

chinese: 我祈禱耶和華說：主耶和華阿，求你不要滅絕你的百姓。他們是你的產業，是你用大力救贖的，用大能從埃及領出來的。
english: And I made prayer to the Lord and said, O Lord God, do not send destruction on your people and your heritage, to whom, by your great power, you have given salvation, whom you have taken out of Egypt by the strength of your hand.

chinese: 求你記念你的僕人亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，不要想念這百姓的頑梗、邪惡、罪過，
english: Keep in mind your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, not looking at the hard heart of this people, or their evil-doing and their sin:

chinese: 免得你領我們出來的那地之人說，耶和華因為不能將這百姓領進他所應許之地，又因恨他們，所以領他們出去，要在曠野殺他們。
english: Or it may be said in the land from which you have taken them, Because the Lord was not able to take them into the land which he said he would give them, and because of his hate for them, he has taken them out to put them to death in the waste land.

chinese: 其實他們是你的百姓，你的產業，是你用大能和伸出來的膀臂領出來的。
english: But still they are your people and your heritage, whom you took out by your great power and by your stretched-out arm.

chinese: 那時，耶和華吩咐我說：你要鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣，上山到我這裡來，又要做一木櫃。
english: At that time the Lord said to me, Make two other stones, cut like the first two, and come up to me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

chinese: 你先前摔碎的那版，其上的字我要寫在這版上；你要將這版放在櫃中。
english: And I will put on the stones the words which were on the first stones which were broken by you, and you are to put them into the ark.

chinese: 於是我用皂莢木做了一櫃，又鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣，手裡拿這兩塊版上山去了。
english: So I made an ark of hard wood, and had two stones cut like the others, and went up the mountain with the stones in my hands.

chinese: 耶和華將那大會之日、在山上從火中所傳與你們的十條誡，照先前所寫的，寫在這版上，將版交給我了。
english: And he put on the stones, as in the first writing, the ten rules which the Lord gave you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the great meeting: and the Lord gave the stones to me.

chinese: 我轉身下山，將這版放在我所做的櫃中，現今還在那裡，正如耶和華所吩咐我的。
english: And turning round I came down from the mountain and put the stones in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the Lord gave me orders.

chinese: （以色列人從比羅比尼亞干（或作：亞干井）起行，到了摩西拉。亞倫死在那裡，就葬在那裡。他兒子以利亞撒接續他供祭司的職分。
english: (And the children of Israel went on from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah: there death came to Aaron and he was put to rest in the earth; and Eleazar, his son, took his place as priest.

chinese: 他們從那裡起行，到了谷歌大，又從谷歌大到了有溪水之地的約巴他。
english: From there they went on to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.

chinese: 那時，耶和華將利未支派分別出來，抬耶和華的約櫃，又侍立在耶和華面前事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到今日。
english: At that time the Lord had the tribe of Levi marked out to take up the ark of the Lord's agreement, to be before the Lord and to do his work and to give blessings in his name, to this day.

chinese: 所以利未人在他弟兄中無分無業，耶和華是他的產業，正如耶和華─你神所應許他的。）
english: For this reason Levi has no part or heritage for himself among his brothers: the Lord is his heritage, as the Lord your God said to him.)

chinese: 我又像從前在山上住了四十晝夜。那次耶和華也應允我，不忍將你滅絕。
english: And I was in the mountain, as at the first time, for forty days and forty nights; and again the ears of the Lord were open to my prayer, and he did not send destruction on you.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐我說：你起來引導這百姓，使他們進去得我向他們列祖起誓應許所賜之地。
english: Then the Lord said to me, Get up and go on your journey before the people, so that they may go in and take the land which I said in my oath to their fathers that I would give them.

chinese: 以色列阿，現在耶和華─你神向你所要的是甚麼呢？只要你敬畏耶和華─你的　神，遵行他的道，愛他，盡心盡性事奉他，
english: And now, Israel, what would the Lord your God have you do, but to go in the fear of the Lord your God, walking in all his ways and loving him and doing his pleasure with all your heart and all your soul,

chinese: 遵守他的誡命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，為要叫你得福。
english: Doing the orders of the Lord and keeping his laws which I give you this day for your good?

chinese: 看哪，天和天上的天，地和地上所有的，都屬耶和華─你的神。
english: The Lord your God is ruler of heaven, of the heaven of heavens, and of the earth with everything in it.

chinese: 耶和華但喜悅你的列祖，愛他們，從萬民中揀選他們的後裔，就是你們，像今日一樣。
english: But the Lord had delight in your fathers and love for them, marking out for himself their seed after them, even you, from all peoples, as at this day.

chinese: 所以你們要將心裡的污穢除掉，不可再硬著頸項。
english: Let your circumcision be of the heart, and put away your pride.

chinese: 因為耶和華─你們的神─他是萬　神之　神，萬主之主，至大的　神，大有能力，大而可畏，不以貌取人，也不受賄賂。
english: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, strong in power and greatly to be feared, who has no respect for any man's position and takes no rewards:

chinese: 他為孤兒寡婦伸冤，又憐愛寄居的，賜給他衣食。
english: Judging uprightly in the cause of the widow and of the child who has no father, and giving food and clothing in his mercy to the man from a strange country.

chinese: 所以你們要憐愛寄居的，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。
english: So be kind to the man from a strange country who is living among you, for you yourselves were living in a strange country in the land of Egypt.

chinese: 你要敬畏耶和華─你的神，事奉他，專靠他，也要指著他的名起誓。
english: Let the fear of the Lord your God be before you, give him worship and be true to him at all times, taking your oaths in his name.

chinese: 他是你所讚美的，是你的神，為你做了那大而可畏的事，是你親眼所看見的。
english: He is your God, the God of your praise, your God who has done for you all these works of power which your eyes have seen.

chinese: 你的列祖七十人下埃及；現在耶和華─你的神使你如同天上的星那樣多。
english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the Lord your God has made you like the stars of heaven in number.

chinese: 你要愛耶和華─你的神，常守他的吩咐、律例、典章、誡命。
english: So have love for the Lord your God, and give him worship, and keep his laws and his decisions and his orders at all times.

chinese: 你們今日當知道，我本不是和你們的兒女說話；因為他們不知道，也沒有看見耶和華─你們神的管教、威嚴、大能的手，和伸出來的膀臂，
english: And be certain in your minds this day; for these words are not said to your children, who have had no experience of the training of the Lord your God, and who have not seen his great power or his strong hand and his stretched-out arm,

chinese: 並他在埃及中向埃及王法老和其全地所行的神蹟奇事；
english: Or his signs and wonders which he did in Egypt, to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and all his land;

chinese: 也沒有看見他怎樣待埃及的軍兵、車馬，他們追趕你們的時候，耶和華怎樣使紅海的水淹沒他們，將他們滅絕，直到今日，
english: And what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses and their war-carriages; how he made the waters of the Red Sea come up over them when they went after you, and how the Lord put an end to them even to this day;

chinese: 並他在曠野怎樣待你們，以至你們來到這地方；
english: And what he did for you in the waste land, till you came to this place;

chinese: 也沒有看見他怎樣待流便子孫以利押的兒子大坍、亞比蘭，地怎樣在以色列人中間開口，吞了他們和他們的家眷，並帳棚與跟他們的一切活物。
english: And what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben; when they went down into the open mouth of the earth, with their families and their tents and every living thing which was theirs, before the eyes of all Israel:

chinese: 惟有你們親眼看見耶和華所做的一切大事。
english: But your eyes have seen all the great works of the Lord which he has done.

chinese: 所以，你們要守我今日所吩咐的一切誡命，使你們膽壯，能以進去，得你們所要得的那地，
english: So keep all the orders which I give you today, so that you may be strong, and go in and take the land which is to be your heritage;

chinese: 並使你們的日子在耶和華向你們列祖起誓、應許給他們和他們後裔的地上得以長久；那是流奶與蜜之地。
english: And that your days may be long in the land which the Lord gave by an oath to your fathers and to their seed after them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

chinese: 你要進去得為業的那地，本不像你出來的埃及地。你在那裡撒種，用腳澆灌，像澆灌菜園一樣。
english: For the land where you are going is not like the land of Egypt from which you have come, where you put in your seeds, watering them with your foot, like a planted garden:

chinese: 你們要過去得為業的那地乃是有山有谷、雨水滋潤之地，
english: But the land where you are going is a land of hills and valleys, drinking in the rain of heaven:

chinese: 是耶和華─你神所眷顧的；從歲首到年終，耶和華─你　神的眼目時常看顧那地。
english: A land cared for by the Lord your God: the eyes of the Lord your God are on it at all times from one end of the year to the other.

chinese: 你們若留意聽從我今日所吩咐的誡命，愛耶和華─你們的神，盡心盡性事奉他，
english: And it will be that if you truly give ear to the orders which I put before you this day, loving the Lord your God and worshipping him with all your heart and all your soul,

chinese: 他（原文是我）必按時降秋雨春雨在你們的地上，使你們可以收藏五穀、新酒和油，
english: Then I will send rain on your land at the right time, the early rains and the late rains, so that you may get in your grain and your wine and your oil.

chinese: 也必使你吃得飽足，並使田野為你的牲畜長草。
english: And I will give grass in your fields for your cattle, so that you may have food in full measure.

chinese: 你們要謹慎，免得心中受迷惑，就偏離正路，去事奉敬拜別神。
english: But take care that your hearts are not turned to false ways so that you become servants and worshippers of other gods;

chinese: 耶和華的怒氣向你們發作，就使天閉塞不下雨，地也不出產，使你們在耶和華所賜給你們的美地上速速滅亡。
english: For if you do so, the wrath of the Lord will be burning against you, and the heaven will be shut up so that there is no rain and the land will give no fruit; and in a very little time you will be cut off from the good land which the Lord is giving you.

chinese: 你們要將我這話存在心內，留在意中，繫在手上為記號，戴在額上為經文；
english: So keep these words deep in your heart and in your soul, and have them fixed on your hand for a sign and marked on your brow;

chinese: 也要教訓你們的兒女，無論坐在家裡，行在路上，躺下，起來，都要談論；
english: Teaching them to your children, and talking of them when you are at rest in your house or walking by the way, when you go to sleep and when you get up:

chinese: 又要寫在房屋的門框上，並城門上，
english: Writing them on the pillars of your houses and over the doors of your towns:

chinese: 使你們和你們子孫的日子在耶和華向你們列祖起誓、應許給他們的地上得以增多，如天覆地的日子那樣多。
english: So that your days, and the days of your children, may be long in the land which the Lord by his oath to your fathers said he would give them, like the days of the eternal heavens.

chinese: 你們若留意謹守遵行我所吩咐這一切的誡命，愛耶和華─你們的神，行他的道，專靠他，
english: For if you take care to keep all the orders which I give you, and to do them; loving the Lord your God and walking in all his ways and being true to him:

chinese: 他必從你們面前趕出這一切國民，就是比你們更大更強的國民，你們也要得他們的地。
english: Then the Lord will send these nations in flight before you, and you will take the lands of nations greater and stronger than yourselves.

chinese: 凡你們腳掌所踏之地都必歸你們；從曠野和利巴嫩，並伯拉大河，直到西海，都要作你們的境界。
english: Every place where you put your foot will be yours: from the waste land and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates as far as the Great Sea, will be the limits of your land.

chinese: 必無一人能在你們面前站立得住；耶和華─你們的神必照他所說的，使懼怕驚恐臨到你們所踏之地的居民。
english: All people will give way before you: for the Lord your God will put the fear of you on all the land through which you go, as he has said.

chinese: 看哪，我今日將祝福與咒詛的話都陳明在你們面前。
english: Today I put before you a blessing and a curse:

chinese: 你們若聽從耶和華─你們神的誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你們的，就必蒙福。
english: The blessing if you give ear to the orders of the Lord your God, which I give you this day:

chinese: 你們若不聽從耶和華─你們神的誡命，偏離我今日所吩咐你們的道，去事奉你們素來所不認識的別　神，就必受禍。
english: And the curse if you do not give ear to the orders of the Lord your God, but let yourselves be turned from the way which I have put before you this day, and go after other gods which are not yours.

chinese: 及至耶和華─你的神領你進入要去得為業的那地，你就要將祝福的話陳明在基利心山上，將咒詛的話陳明在以巴路山上。
english: And when the Lord your God has taken you into the land of your heritage, you are to put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

chinese: 這二山豈不是在約但河那邊，日落之處，在住亞拉巴的迦南人之地與吉甲相對，靠近摩利橡樹麼？
english: Are they not on the other side of Jordan, looking west, in the land of the Canaanites living in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, by the holy tree of Moreh?

chinese: 你們要過約但河，進去得耶和華─你們神所賜你們為業之地，在那地居住。
english: For you are about to go over Jordan to take the heritage which the Lord your God is giving you, and it will be your resting-place.

chinese: 你們要謹守遵行我今日在你們面前所陳明的一切律例典章。
english: And you are to take care to keep all the laws and the decisions which I put before you today.

chinese: 你們存活於世的日子，在耶和華─你們列祖的神所賜你們為業的地上，要謹守遵行的律例典章乃是這些：
english: These are the laws and the decisions which you are to keep with care in the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, has given you to be your heritage all the days of your life on earth.

chinese: 你們要將所趕出的國民事奉神的各地方，無論是在高山，在小山，在各青翠樹下，都毀壞了；
english: You are to give up to the curse all those places where the nations, whom you are driving out, gave worship to their gods, on the high mountains and the hills and under every green tree:

chinese: 也要拆毀他們的祭壇，打碎他們的柱像，用火焚燒他們的木偶，砍下他們雕刻的神像，並將其名從那地方除滅。
english: Their altars and their pillars are to be broken down, and their holy trees burned with fire, and the images of their gods cut down; you are to take away their names out of that place.

chinese: 你們不可照他們那樣事奉耶和華─你們的神。
english: Do not so to the Lord your God.

chinese: 但耶和華─你們的神從你們各支派中選擇何處為立他名的居所，你們就當往那裡去求問，
english: But let your hearts be turned to the place which will be marked out by the Lord your God, among your tribes, to put his name there;

chinese: 將你們的燔祭、平安祭、十分取一之物，和手中的舉祭，並還願祭、甘心祭，以及牛群羊群中頭生的，都奉到那裡。
english: And there you are to take your burned offerings and other offerings, and the tenth part of your goods, and the offerings to be lifted up to the Lord, and the offerings of your oaths, and those which you give freely from the impulse of your hearts, and the first births among your herds and your flocks;

chinese: 在那裡，耶和華─你們神的面前，你們和你們的家屬都可以吃，並且因你手所辦的一切事蒙耶和華─你的　神賜福，就都歡樂。
english: There you and all your families are to make a feast before the Lord your God, with joy in everything to which you put your hand, because the Lord has given you his blessing.

chinese: 我們今日在這裡所行的是各人行自己眼中看為正的事，你們將來不可這樣行；
english: You are not to do things then in the way in which we now do them here, every man as it seems right to him:

chinese: 因為你們還沒有到耶和華─你神所賜你的安息地，所給你的產業。
english: For you have not come to the rest and the heritage which the Lord your God is giving you.

chinese: 但你們過了約但河，得以住在耶和華─你們神使你們承受為業之地，又使你們太平，不被四圍的一切仇敵擾亂，安然居住。
english: But when you have gone over Jordan and are living in the land which the Lord your God is giving you as your heritage, and when he has given you rest from all those on every side who are fighting against you, and you are living there safely;

chinese: 那時要將我所吩咐你們的燔祭、平安祭、十分取一之物，和手中的舉祭，並向耶和華許願獻的一切美祭，都奉到耶和華─你們神所選擇要立為他名的居所。
english: Then there will be a place marked out by the Lord your God as the resting-place for his name, and there you will take all the things which I give you orders to take: your burned offerings and other offerings, and the tenth part of your goods, and the offerings to be lifted up, and the offerings of your oaths which you make to the Lord;

chinese: 你們和兒女、僕婢，並住在你們城裡無分無業的利未人，都要在耶和華─你們的神面前歡樂。
english: And you will be glad before the Lord your God, you and your sons and your daughters, and your men-servants and your women-servants, and the Levite who is with you in your house, because he has no part or heritage among you.

chinese: 你要謹慎，不可在你所看中的各處獻燔祭。
english: Take care that you do not make your burned offerings in any place you see:

chinese: 惟獨耶和華從你那一支派中所選擇的地方，你就要在那裡獻燔祭，行我一切所吩咐你的。
english: But in the place marked out by the Lord in one of your tribes, there let your burned offerings be offered, and there do what I have given you orders to do.

chinese: 然而，在你各城裡都可以照耶和華─你神所賜你的福分，隨心所欲宰牲吃肉；無論潔淨人不潔淨人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊與鹿一般。
english: Only you may put to death animals, such as the gazelle or the roe, for your food in any of your towns, at the desire of your soul, in keeping with the blessing of the Lord your God which he has given you: the unclean and the clean may take of it.

chinese: 只是不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一樣。
english: But you may not take the blood for food, it is to be drained out on the earth like water.

chinese: 你的五穀、新酒，和油的十分之一，或是牛群羊群中頭生的，或是你許願獻的，甘心獻的，或是手中的舉祭，都不可在你城裡吃。
english: In your towns you are not to take as food the tenth part of your grain, or of your wine or your oil, or the first births of your herds or of your flocks, or anything offered under an oath, or freely offered to the Lord, or given as a lifted offering;

chinese: 但要在耶和華─你的神面前吃，在耶和華─你　神所要選擇的地方，你和兒女、僕婢，並住在你城裡的利未人，都可以吃；也要因你手所辦的，在耶和華─你　神面前歡樂。
english: But they will be your food before the Lord your God in the place of his selection, where you may make a feast of them, with your son and your daughter, and your man-servant and your woman-servant, and the Levite who is living with you: and you will have joy before the Lord your God in everything to which you put your hand.

chinese: 你要謹慎，在你所住的地方永不可丟棄利未人。
english: See that you do not give up caring for the Levite as long as you are living in your land.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神照他所應許擴張你境界的時候，你心裡想要吃肉，說：我要吃肉，就可以隨心所欲地吃肉。
english: When the Lord your God makes wide the limit of your land, as he has said, and you say, I will take flesh for my food, because you have a desire for it; then you may take whatever flesh you have a desire for.

chinese: 耶和華─你神所選擇要立他名的地方若離你太遠，就可以照我所吩咐的，將耶和華賜給你的牛羊取些宰了，可以隨心所欲在你城裡吃。
english: If the place marked out by the Lord your God as the resting-place for his name is far away from you, then take from your herds and from your flocks which the Lord has given you, as I have said, and have a meal of it in the towns where you may be living.

chinese: 你吃那肉，要像吃羚羊與鹿一般；無論潔淨人不潔淨人都可以吃。
english: It will be your food, like the gazelle and the roe; the unclean and the clean may take of it.

chinese: 只是你要心意堅定，不可吃血，因為血是生命；不可將血（原文作生命）與肉同吃。
english: But see that you do not take the blood for food; for the blood is the life; and you may not make use of the life as food with the flesh.

chinese: 不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一樣。
english: Do not take it for food but let it be drained out on the earth like water.

chinese: 不可吃血。這樣，你行耶和華眼中看為正的事，你和你的子孫就可以得福。
english: Do not take it for food; so that it may be well for you and for your children after you, while you do what is right in the eyes of the Lord.

chinese: 只是你分別為聖的物和你的還願祭要奉到耶和華所選擇的地方去。
english: But the holy things which you have, and the offerings of your oaths, you are to take to the place which will be marked out by the Lord:

chinese: 你的燔祭，連肉帶血，都要獻在耶和華─你神的壇上。平安祭的血要倒在耶和華─你　神的壇上；平安祭的肉，你自己可以吃。
english: Offering the flesh and the blood of your burned offerings on the altar of the Lord your God; and the blood of your offerings is to be drained out on the altar of the Lord your God, and the flesh will be your food.

chinese: 你要謹守聽從我所吩咐的一切話，行耶和華─你神眼中看為善，看為正的事。這樣，你和你的子孫就可以永遠享福。
english: Take note of all these orders I am giving you and give attention to them, so that it may be well for you and for your children after you for ever, while you do what is good and right in the eyes of the Lord your God.

chinese: 耶和華─你神將你要去趕出的國民從你面前剪除，你得了他們的地居住，
english: When the people of the land where you are going have been cut off before you by the Lord your God, and you have taken their land and are living in it;

chinese: 那時就要謹慎，不可在他們除滅之後隨從他們的惡俗，陷入網羅，也不可訪問他們的神說：這些國民怎樣事奉他們的　神，我也要照樣行。
