english: After their destruction take care that you do not go in their ways, and that you do not give thought to their gods, saying, How did these nations give worship to their gods? I will do as they did.

chinese: 你不可向耶和華─你的神這樣行，因為他們向他們的　神行了耶和華所憎嫌所恨惡的一切事，甚至將自己的兒女用火焚燒，獻與他們的　神。
english: Do not so to the Lord your God: for everything which is disgusting to the Lord and hated by him they have done in honour of their gods: even burning their sons and daughters in the fire to their gods.

chinese: 凡我所吩咐的，你們都要謹守遵行，不可加添，也不可刪減。
english: You are to keep with care all the words I give you, making no addition to them and taking nothing from them.

chinese: 你們中間若有先知或是做夢的起來，向你顯個神蹟奇事，
english: If ever you have among you a prophet or a dreamer of dreams and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

chinese: 對你說：我們去隨從你素來所不認識的別神，事奉他罷。他所顯的神蹟奇事雖有應驗，
english: And the sign or the wonder takes place, and he says to you, Let us go after other gods, which are strange to you, and give them worship;

chinese: 你也不可聽那先知或是那做夢之人的話；因為這是耶和華─你們的神試驗你們，要知道你們是盡心盡性愛耶和華─你們的　神不是。
english: Then give no attention to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams: for the Lord your God is testing you, to see if all the love of your heart and soul is given to him.

chinese: 你們要順從耶和華─你們的神，敬畏他，謹守他的誡命，聽從他的話，事奉他，專靠他。
english: But keep on in the ways of the Lord your God, fearing him and keeping his orders and hearing his voice, worshipping him and being true to him.

chinese: 那先知或是那做夢的既用言語叛逆那領你們出埃及地、救贖你脫離為奴之家的耶和華─你們的神，要勾引你離開耶和華─你　神所吩咐你行的道，你便要將他治死。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
english: And that prophet or that dreamer of dreams is to be put to death; for his words were said with the purpose of turning you away from the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt and made you free from the prison-house; and of forcing you out of the way in which the Lord your God has given you orders to go. So you are to put away the evil from among you.

chinese: 你的同胞弟兄，或是你的兒女，或是你懷中的妻，或是如同你性命的朋友，若暗中引誘你，說：我們不如去事奉你和你列祖素來所不認識的別神─
english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter or the wife of your heart, or the friend who is as dear to you as your life, working on you secretly says to you, Let us go and give worship to other gods, strange to you and to your fathers;

chinese: 是你四圍列國的神。無論是離你近，離你遠，從地這邊到地那邊的神，
english: Gods of the peoples round about you, near or far, from one end of the earth to the other;

chinese: 你不可依從他，也不可聽從他，眼不可顧惜他。你不可憐恤他，也不可遮庇他，
english: Do not be guided by him or give attention to him; have no pity on him or mercy, and give him no cover;

chinese: 總要殺他；你先下手，然後眾民也下手，將他治死。
english: But put him to death without question; let your hand be the first stretched out against him to put him to death, and then the hands of all the people.

chinese: 要用石頭打死他，因為他想要勾引你離開那領你出埃及地為奴之家的耶和華─你的神。
english: Let him be stoned with stones till he is dead; because it was his purpose to make you false to the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.

chinese: 以色列眾人都要聽見害怕，就不敢在你們中間再行這樣的惡了。
english: And all Israel, hearing of it, will be full of fear, and no one will again do such evil as this among you.

chinese: 在耶和華─你神所賜你居住的各城中，你若聽人說，有些匪類從你們中間的一座城出來勾引本城的居民，說：我們不如去事奉你們素來所不認識的別　神；
english: And if word comes to you, in one of the towns which the Lord your God is giving you for your resting-place,
That good-for-nothing persons have gone out from among you, turning the people of their town from the right way and saying, Let us go and give worship to other gods, of whom you have no knowledge;

chinese: 你就要探聽，查究，細細地訪問，果然是真，準有這可憎惡的事行在你們中間，
english: Then let a full search be made, and let questions be put with care; and if it is true and certain that such a disgusting thing has been done among you;

chinese: 你必要用刀殺那城裡的居民，把城裡所有的，連牲畜，都用刀殺盡。
english: Then take up arms against the people of that town and give it up to the curse, with all its cattle and everything in it.

chinese: 你從那城裡所奪的財物都要堆積在街市上，用火將城和其內所奪的財物都在耶和華─你神面前燒盡；那城就永為荒堆，不可再建造。
english: And take all the goods into the middle of its open space, burning the town and all its property with fire as an offering to the Lord your God; it is to be a waste for ever; there is to be no more building there.

chinese: 那當毀滅的物連一點都不可粘你的手。你要聽從耶和華─你神的話，遵守我今日所吩咐你的一切誡命，行耶和華─你　神眼中看為正的事，耶和華就必轉意，不發烈怒，恩待你，憐恤你，照他向你列祖所起的誓使你人數增多。
english: Keep not a thing of what is cursed for yourselves: so the Lord may be turned away from the heat of his wrath, and have mercy on you, and give you increase as he said in his oath to your fathers:
So long as you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and keep all his orders which I give you today, and do what is right in the eyes of the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們是耶和華─你們神的兒女。不可為死人用刀劃身，也不可將額上剃光。
english: You are the children of the Lord your God: you are not to make cuts on your bodies or take off the hair on your brows in honour of the dead;

chinese: 因為你歸耶和華─你神為聖潔的民，耶和華從地上的萬民中揀選你特作自己的子民。
english: For you are a holy people to the Lord your God, and the Lord has taken you to be his special people out of all the nations on the face of the earth.

chinese: 凡可憎的物都不可吃。
english: No disgusting thing may be your food.

chinese: 可吃的牲畜就是牛、綿羊、山羊、
english: These are the beasts which you may have for food: the ox, the sheep, and the goat;

chinese: 鹿、羚羊、麃子、野山羊、麋鹿、黃羊、青羊。
english: The hart, the gazelle, and the roe, the mountain goat and the pygarg and the antelope and the mountain sheep.

chinese: 凡分蹄成為兩瓣又倒嚼的走獸，你們都可以吃。
english: Any beast which has a division in the horn of its foot and whose food comes back into its mouth to be crushed again, may be used for food.

chinese: 但那些倒嚼或是分蹄之中不可吃的乃是駱駝、兔子、沙番─因為是倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
english: But even among these, there are some which may not be used for food: such as the camel, the hare, and the coney, which are unclean to you, because, though their food comes back, the horn of their feet is not parted in two.

chinese: 豬─因為是分蹄卻不倒嚼，就與你們不潔淨。這些獸的肉，你們不可吃，死的也不可摸。
english: And the pig is unclean to you, because though it has a division in the horn of its foot, its food does not come back; their flesh may not be used for food or their dead bodies touched by you.

chinese: 水中可吃的乃是這些：凡有翅有鱗的都可以吃；
english: And of the things living in the waters, you may take all those who have wings for swimming with and skins formed of thin plates.

chinese: 凡無翅無鱗的都不可吃，是與你們不潔淨。
english: But any which have no skin-plates or wings for swimming, you may not take; they are unclean for you.

chinese: 凡潔淨的鳥，你們都可以吃。
english: All clean birds may be used for food.

chinese: 不可吃的乃是鵰、狗頭鵰、紅頭鵰、
english: But these birds you may not take: the eagle and the gier-eagle and the ospray;

chinese: 鸇、小鷹、鷂鷹與其類，
english: The falcon and the kite, and birds of that sort;

chinese: 烏鴉與其類，
english: Every raven, and all birds of that sort;

chinese: 鴕鳥、夜鷹、魚鷹、鷹與其類，
english: And the ostrich and the night-hawk and the sea-hawk and birds of that sort;

chinese: 鴞鳥、貓頭鷹、角鴟、
english: The little owl and the great owl and the water-hen;

chinese: 鵜鶘、禿鵰、鸕鶿、
english: And the pelican and the vulture and the cormorant;

chinese: 鸛、鷺鷥與其類，戴鵀與蝙蝠。
english: The stork and the heron and birds of that sort, and the hoopoe and the bat.

chinese: 凡有翅膀爬行的物是與你們不潔淨，都不可吃。
english: Every winged thing which goes flat on the earth is unclean to you and may not be used as food.

chinese: 凡潔淨的鳥，你們都可以吃。
english: But all clean birds you may take.

chinese: 凡自死的，你們都不可吃，可以給你城裡寄居的吃，或賣與外人吃，因為你是歸耶和華─你神為聖潔的民。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
english: You may not have as food anything which has come to a natural death; the man from another country who is living with you may take it for food, or you may get a price for it from one of another nation; for you are a holy people to the Lord your God. The young goat is not to be cooked in its mother's milk.

chinese: 你要把你撒種所產的，就是你田地每年所出的，十分取一分；
english: Put on one side a tenth of all the increase of your seed, produced year by year.

chinese: 又要把你的五穀、新酒、和油的十分之一，並牛群羊群中頭生的，吃在耶和華─你神面前，就是他所選擇要立為他名的居所。這樣，你可以學習時常敬畏耶和華─你的　神。
english: And make a feast before the Lord your God, in the place which is to be marked out, where his name will be for ever, of the tenth part of your grain and your wine and your oil, and the first births of your herds and your flocks; so that you may have the fear of the Lord your God in your hearts at all times.

chinese: 當耶和華─你神賜福與你的時候，耶和華─你　神所選擇要立為他名的地方若離你太遠，那路也太長，使你不能把這物帶到那裡去，
english: And if the way is so long that you are not able to take these things to the place marked out by the Lord your God for his name, when he has given you his blessing, because it is far away from you;

chinese: 你就可以換成銀子，將銀子包起來，拿在手中，往耶和華─你神所要選擇的地方去。
english: Then let these things be exchanged for money, and, taking the money in your hand, go to the place marked out by the Lord your God for himself;

chinese: 你用這銀子，隨心所欲，或買牛羊，或買清酒濃酒，凡你心所想的都可以買；你和你的家屬在耶和華─你神的面前吃喝快樂。
english: And with the money get whatever you have a desire for, oxen or sheep or wine or strong drink, whatever your soul's desire may be: and make a feast there before the Lord your God, and be glad, you and all your house;

chinese: 住在你城裡的利未人，你不可丟棄他，因為他在你們中間無分無業。
english: And give a thought to the Levite who is living among you, for he has no part or heritage in the land.

chinese: 每逢三年的末一年，你要將本年的土產十分之一都取出來，積存在你的城中。
english: At the end of every three years take a tenth part of all your increase for that year, and put it in store inside your walls:

chinese: 在你城裡無分無業的利未人，和你城裡寄居的，並孤兒寡婦，都可以來，吃得飽足。這樣，耶和華─你的神必在你手裡所辦的一切事上賜福與你。
english: And the Levite, because he has no part or heritage in the land, and the man from a strange country, and the child who has no father, and the widow, who are living among you, will come and take food and have enough; and so the blessing of the Lord your God will be on you in everything you do.

chinese: 每逢七年末一年，你要施行豁免。
english: At the end of every seven years there is to be a general forgiveness of debt.

chinese: 豁免的定例乃是這樣：凡債主要把所借給鄰舍的豁免了；不可向鄰舍和弟兄追討，因為耶和華的豁免年已經宣告了。
english: This is how it is to be done: every creditor is to give up his right to whatever he has let his neighbour have; he is not to make his neighbour, his countryman, give it back; because a general forgiveness has been ordered by the Lord.

chinese: 若借給外邦人，你可以向他追討；但借給你弟兄，無論是甚麼，你要鬆手豁免了。
english: A man of another nation may be forced to make payment of his debt, but if your brother has anything of yours, let it go;

chinese: 你若留意聽從耶和華─你神的話，謹守遵行我今日所吩咐你這一切的命令，就必在你們中間沒有窮人了（在耶和華─你　神所賜你為業的地上，耶和華必大大賜福與你。）
english: But there will be no poor among you; for the Lord will certainly give you his blessing in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage;
If only you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and take care to keep all these orders which I give you today.

chinese: 因為耶和華─你的神必照他所應許你的賜福與你。你必借給許多國民，卻不至向他們借貸；你必管轄許多國民，他們卻不能管轄你。
english: For the Lord your God will give you his blessing as he has said: you will let other nations have the use of your money, but you will not make use of theirs; you will be rulers over a number of nations, but they will not be your rulers.

chinese: 在耶和華─你神所賜你的地上，無論那一座城裡，你弟兄中若有一個窮人，你不可忍著心、揝著手不幫補你窮乏的弟兄。
english: If in any of your towns in the land which the Lord your God is giving you, there is a poor man, one of your countrymen, do not let your heart be hard or your hand shut to him;

chinese: 總要向他鬆開手，照他所缺乏的借給他，補他的不足。
english: But let your hand be open to give him the use of whatever he is in need of.

chinese: 你要謹慎，不可心裡起惡念，說：第七年的豁免年快到了，你便惡眼看你窮乏的弟兄，甚麼都不給他，以致他因你求告耶和華，罪便歸於你了。
english: And see that there is no evil thought in your heart, moving you to say to yourself, The seventh year, the year of forgiveness is near; and so looking coldly on your poor countryman you give him nothing; and he will make an outcry to the Lord against you, and it will be judged as sin in you.

chinese: 你總要給他，給他的時候心裡不可愁煩；因耶和華─你的神必在你這一切所行的，並你手裡所辦的事上，賜福與你。
english: But it is right for you to give to him, without grief of heart: for because of this, the blessing of the Lord your God will be on all your work and on everything to which you put your hand.

chinese: 原來那地上的窮人永不斷絕；所以我吩咐你說：總要向你地上困苦窮乏的弟兄鬆開手。
english: For there will never be a time when there are no poor in the land; and so I give orders to you, Let your hand be open to your countrymen, to those who are poor and in need in your land.

chinese: 你弟兄中，若有一個希伯來男人或希伯來女人被賣給你，服事你六年，到第七年就要任他自由出去。
english: If one of your countrymen, a Hebrew man or woman, becomes your servant for a price and does work for you six years, in the seventh year let him go free.

chinese: 你任他自由的時候，不可使他空手而去，
english: And when you make him free, do not let him go away with nothing in his hands:

chinese: 要從你羊群、禾場、酒醡之中多多的給他；耶和華─你的神怎樣賜福與你，你也要照樣給他。
english: But give him freely from your flock and from your grain and your wine: in the measure of the wealth which the Lord your God has given you, you are to give to him.

chinese: 要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕，耶和華─你的神將你救贖；因此，我今日吩咐你這件事。
english: And keep in mind that you yourself were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God made you free: so I give you this order today.

chinese: 他若對你說：我不願意離開你，是因他愛你和你的家，且因在你那裡很好，
english: But if he says to you, I have no desire to go away from you; because you and your family are dear to him and he is happy with you;

chinese: 你就要拿錐子將他的耳朵在門上刺透，他便永為你的奴僕了。你待婢女也要這樣。
english: Then take a sharp-pointed instrument, driving it through his ear into the door, and he will be your servant for ever. And you may do the same for your servant-girl.

chinese: 你任他自由的時候，不可以為難事，因他服事你六年，較比雇工的工價多加一倍了。耶和華─你的神就必在你所做的一切事上賜福與你。
english: Let it not seem hard to you that you have to send him away free; for he has been working for you for six years, which is twice the regular time for a servant: and the blessing of the Lord your God will be on you in everything you do.

chinese: 你牛群羊群中頭生的，凡是公的，都要分別為聖，歸耶和華─你的神。牛群中頭生的，不可用他耕地；羊群中頭生的，不可剪毛。
english: All the first males to come to birth in your herd and your flock are to be holy to the Lord your God: the first birth of your ox is not to be used for work, the wool of your first lamb is not to be cut.

chinese: 這頭生的，你和你的家屬，每年要在耶和華所選擇的地方，在耶和華─你神面前吃。
english: But year by year you and all your house are to take a meal of it before the Lord, in the place of his selection.

chinese: 這頭生的若有甚麼殘疾，就如瘸腿的、瞎眼的，無論有甚麼惡殘疾，都不可獻給耶和華─你的神；
english: But if it has any mark on it, if it is blind or has damaged legs, or if there is anything wrong with it, it may not be offered to the Lord your God.

chinese: 可以在你城裡吃；潔淨人與不潔淨人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊與鹿一般。
english: It may be used for food in your houses: the unclean and the clean may take of it, as of the gazelle and the roe.

chinese: 只是不可吃他的血；要倒在地上，如同倒水一樣。
english: Only do not take its blood for food, but let it be drained out on the earth like water.

chinese: 你要注意亞筆月，向耶和華─你的神守逾越節，因為耶和華─你的　神在亞筆月夜間領你出埃及。
english: Take note of the month of Abib and keep the Passover to the Lord your God: for in the month of Abib the Lord your God took you out of Egypt by night.

chinese: 你當在耶和華所選擇要立為他名的居所，從牛群羊群中，將逾越節的祭牲獻給耶和華─你的神。
english: The Passover offering, from your flock or your herd, is to be given to the Lord your God in the place marked out by him as the resting-place of his name.

chinese: 你吃這祭牲，不可吃有酵的餅；七日之內要吃無酵餅，就是困苦餅─你本是急忙出了埃及地─要叫你一生一世記念你從埃及地出來的日子。
english: Take no leavened bread with it; for seven days let your food be unleavened bread, that is, the bread of sorrow; for you came out of the land of Egypt quickly: so the memory of that day, when you came out of the land of Egypt, will be with you all your life.

chinese: 在你四境之內，七日不可見麵酵，頭一日晚上所獻的肉，一點不可留到早晨。
english: For seven days let no leaven be used through all your land; and nothing of the flesh which is put to death in the evening of the first day is to be kept through the night till morning.

chinese: 在耶和華─你神所賜的各城中，你不可獻逾越節的祭；
english: The Passover offering is not to be put to death in any of the towns which the Lord your God gives you:

chinese: 只當在耶和華─你神所選擇要立為他名的居所，晚上日落的時候，乃是你出埃及的時候，獻逾越節的祭。
english: But in the place marked out by the Lord your God as the resting-place of his name, there you are to put the Passover to death in the evening, at sundown, at that time of the year when you came out of Egypt.

chinese: 當在耶和華─你神所選擇的地方把肉烤了吃（烤：或作煮），次日早晨就回到你的帳棚去。
english: It is to be cooked and taken as food in the place marked out by the Lord: and in the morning you are to go back to your tents.

chinese: 你要吃無酵餅六日，第七日要向耶和華─你的神守嚴肅會，不可做工。
english: For six days let your food be unleavened bread; and on the seventh day there is to be a holy meeting to the Lord your God; no work is to be done.

chinese: 你要計算七七日：從你開鐮收割禾稼時算起，共計七七日。
english: Let seven weeks be numbered from the first day when the grain is cut.

chinese: 你要照耶和華─你神所賜你的福，手裡拿著甘心祭，獻在耶和華─你的　神面前，守七七節。
english: Then keep the feast of weeks to the Lord your God, with an offering freely given to him from the wealth he has given you:

chinese: 你和你兒女、僕婢，並住在你城裡的利未人，以及在你們中間寄居的與孤兒寡婦，都要在耶和華─你神所選擇立為他名的居所，在耶和華─你的　神面前歡樂。
english: Then you are to be glad before the Lord your God, you and your son and your daughter, your man-servant and your woman-servant, and the Levite who is with you, and the man from a strange country, and the child without a father, and the widow, who are living among you, in the place marked out by the Lord your God as a resting-place for his name.

chinese: 你也要記念你在埃及作過奴僕。你要謹守遵行這些律例。
english: And you will keep in mind that you were a servant in the land of Egypt: and you will take care to keep all these laws.

chinese: 你把禾場的穀、酒醡的酒收藏以後，就要守住棚節七日。
english: You are to keep the feast of tents for seven days after you have got in all your grain and made your wine:

chinese: 守節的時候，你和你兒女、僕婢，並住在你城裡的利未人，以及寄居的與孤兒寡婦，都要歡樂。
english: You are to keep the feast with joy, you and your son and your daughter, your man-servant and your woman-servant, and the Levite, and the man from a strange country, and the child without a father, and the widow, who are living among you.

chinese: 在耶和華所選擇的地方，你當向耶和華─你的神守節七日；因為耶和華─你　神在你一切的土產上和你手裡所辦的事上要賜福與你，你就非常的歡樂。
english: Keep the feast to the Lord your God for seven days, in the place marked out by the Lord: because the blessing of the Lord your God will be on all the produce of your land and all the work of your hands, and you will have nothing but joy.

chinese: 你一切的男丁要在除酵節、七七節、住棚節，一年三次，在耶和華─你神所選擇的地方朝見他，卻不可空手朝見。
english: Three times in the year let all your males come before the Lord your God in the place named by him; at the feast of unleavened bread, the feast of weeks, and the feast of tents: and they are not to come before the Lord with nothing in their hands;

chinese: 各人要按自己的力量，照耶和華─你神所賜的福分，奉獻禮物。
english: Every man is to give as he is able, in the measure of the blessing which the Lord your God has given you.

chinese: 你要在耶和華─你神所賜的各城裡，按著各支派設立審判官和官長。他們必按公義的審判判斷百姓。
english: You are to make judges and overseers in all your towns which the Lord your God gives you, for every tribe: and they are to be upright men, judging the people in righteousness.

chinese: 不可屈枉正直；不可看人的外貌。也不可受賄賂；因為賄賂能叫智慧人的眼變瞎了，又能顛倒義人的話。
english: You are not to be moved in your judging by a man's position, you are not to take rewards; for rewards make the eyes of the wise man blind, and the decisions of the upright false.

chinese: 你要追求至公至義，好叫你存活，承受耶和華─你神所賜你的地。
english: Let righteousness be your guide, so that you may have life, and take for your heritage the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

chinese: 你為耶和華─你的神築壇，不可在壇旁栽甚麼樹木作為木偶。
english: Let no holy tree of any sort be planted by the altar of the Lord your God which you will make.

chinese: 也不可為自己設立柱像；這是耶和華─你神所恨惡的。
english: You are not to put up stone pillars, for they are hated by the Lord your God.

chinese: 凡有殘疾，或有甚麼惡病的牛羊，你都不可獻給耶和華─你的神，因為這是耶和華─你　神所憎惡的。
english: No ox or sheep which has a mark on it or is damaged in any way may be offered to the Lord your God: for that is disgusting to the Lord your God.

chinese: 在你們中間，在耶和華─你神所賜你的諸城中，無論那座城裡，若有人，或男或女，行耶和華─你　神眼中看為惡的事，違背了他的約，
english: If there is any man or woman among you, in any of the towns which the Lord your God gives you, who does evil in the eyes of the Lord your God, sinning against his agreement,

chinese: 去事奉敬拜別神，或拜日頭，或拜月亮，或拜天象，是主不曾吩咐的；
english: By becoming a servant of other gods and worshipping them or the sun or the moon or all the stars of heaven, against my orders;

chinese: 有人告訴你，你也聽見了，就要細細的探聽，果然是真，準有這可憎惡的事行在以色列中，
english: If word of this comes to your ears, then let this thing be looked into with care, and if there is no doubt that it is true, and such evil has been done in Israel;

chinese: 你就要將行這惡事的男人或女人拉到城門外，用石頭將他打死。
english: Then you are to take the man or woman who has done the evil to the public place of your town, and they are to be stoned with stones till they are dead.

chinese: 要憑兩三個人的口作見證將那當死的人治死；不可憑一個人的口作見證將他治死。
english: On the word of two or three witnesses, a man may be given the punishment of death; but he is not to be put to death on the word of one witness.

chinese: 見證人要先下手，然後眾民也下手將他治死。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
english: The hands of the witnesses will be the first to put him to death, and after them the hands of all the people. So you are to put away the evil from among you.

chinese: 你城中若起了爭訟的事，或因流血，或因爭競，或因毆打，是你難斷的案件，你就當起來，往耶和華─你神所選擇的地方
english: If you are not able to give a decision as to who is responsible for a death, or who is right in a cause, or who gave the first blow in a fight, and there is a division of opinion about it in your town: then go to the place marked out by the Lord your God;

chinese: 去見祭司利未人，並當時的審判官，求問他們，他們必將判語指示你。
english: And come before the priests, the Levites, or before him who is judge at the time: and they will go into the question and give you a decision:

chinese: 他們在耶和華所選擇的地方指示你的判語，你必照著他們所指教你的一切話謹守遵行。
english: And you are to be guided by the decision they give in the place named by the Lord, and do whatever they say:

chinese: 要按他們所指教你的律法，照他們所斷定的去行；他們所指示你的判語，你不可偏離左右。
english: Acting in agreement with their teaching and the decision they give: not turning to one side or the other from the word they have given you.

chinese: 若有人擅敢不聽從那侍立在耶和華─你神面前的祭司，或不聽從審判官，那人就必治死；這樣，便將那惡從以色列中除掉。
english: And any man who, in his pride, will not give ear to the priest whose place is there before the Lord your God, or to the judge, is to be put to death: you are to put away the evil from Israel.

chinese: 眾百姓都要聽見害怕，不再擅敢行事。
english: And all the people, hearing of it, will be full of fear and put away their pride.

chinese: 到了耶和華─你神所賜你的地，得了那地居住的時候，若說：我要立王治理我，像四圍的國一樣。
english: When you have come into the land which the Lord your God is giving you, and have taken it for a heritage and are living in it, if it is your desire to have a king over you, like the other nations round about you;

chinese: 你總要立耶和華─你神所揀選的人為王。必從你弟兄中立一人；不可立你弟兄以外的人為王。
english: Then see that you take as your king the man named by the Lord your God: let your king be one of your countrymen, not a man of another nation who is not one of yourselves.

chinese: 只是王不可為自己加添馬匹，也不可使百姓回埃及去，為要加添他的馬匹，因耶和華曾吩咐你們說：不可再回那條路去。
english: And he is not to get together a great army of horses for himself, or make the people go back to Egypt to get horses for him: because the Lord has said, You will never again go back that way.

chinese: 他也不可為自己多立妃嬪，恐怕他的心偏邪；也不可為自己多積金銀。
english: And he is not to have a great number of wives, for fear that his heart may be turned away; or great wealth of silver and gold.

chinese: 他登了國位，就要將祭司利未人面前的這律法書，為自己抄錄一本，
english: And when he has taken his place on the seat of his kingdom, he is to make in a book a copy of this law, from that which the priests, the Levites, have in their care:

chinese: 存在他那裡，要平生誦讀，好學習敬畏耶和華─他的神，謹守遵行這律法書上的一切言語和這些律例，
english: And it is to be with him for his reading all the days of his life, so that he may be trained in the fear of the Lord his God to keep and do all the words of this teaching and these laws:

chinese: 免得他向弟兄心高氣傲，偏左偏右，離了這誡命。這樣，他和他的子孫便可在以色列中，在國位上年長日久。
english: So that his heart may not be lifted up over his countrymen, and he may not be turned away from the orders, to one side or the other: but that his life and the lives of his children may be long in his kingdom in Israel.

chinese: 祭司利未人和利未全支派必在以色列中無分無業；他們所吃用的就是獻給耶和華的火祭和一切所捐的。
english: The priests, the Levites, that is, all the tribe of Levi, will have no part or heritage with Israel: their food and their heritage will be the offerings of the Lord made by fire.

chinese: 他們在弟兄中必沒有產業；耶和華是他們的產業，正如耶和華所應許他們的。
english: And they will have no heritage among their countrymen: the Lord is their heritage, as he has said to them.

chinese: 祭司從百姓所當得的分乃是這樣：凡獻牛或羊為祭的，要把前腿和兩腮並脾胃給祭司。
english: And this is to be the priests' right: those who make an offering of a sheep or an ox are to give to the priest the top part of the leg and the two sides of the head and the stomach.

chinese: 初收的五穀、新酒和油，並初剪的羊毛，也要給他；
english: And in addition you are to give him the first of your grain and wine and oil, and the first wool cut from your sheep.

chinese: 因為耶和華─你的神從你各支派中將他揀選出來，使他和他子孫永遠奉耶和華的名侍立，事奉。
english: For he, and his sons after him for ever, have been marked out by the Lord your God from all your tribes, to do the work of priests in the name of the Lord.

chinese: 利未人無論寄居在以色列中的那一座城，若從那裡出來，一心願意到耶和華所選擇的地方，
english: And if a Levite, moved by a strong desire, comes from any town in all Israel where he is living to the place marked out by the Lord;

chinese: 就要奉耶和華─他神的名事奉，像他眾弟兄利未人侍立在耶和華面前事奉一樣。
english: Then he will do the work of a priest in the name of the Lord his God, with all his brothers the Levites who are there before the Lord.

chinese: 除了他賣祖父產業所得的以外，還要得一分祭物與他們同吃。
english: His food will be the same as theirs, in addition to what has come to him as the price of his property.

chinese: 你到了耶和華─你神所賜之地，那些國民所行可憎惡的事，你不可學著行。
english: When you have come into the land which the Lord your God is giving you, do not take as your example the disgusting ways of those nations.

chinese: 你們中間不可有人使兒女經火，也不可有占卜的、觀兆的、用法術的、行邪術的、
english: Let there not be seen among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter go through the fire, or anyone using secret arts, or a maker of strange sounds, or a reader of signs, or any wonder-worker,

chinese: 用迷術的、交鬼的、行巫術的、過陰的。
english: Or anyone using secret force on people, or putting questions to a spirit, or having secret knowledge, or going to the dead for directions.

chinese: 凡行這些事的都為耶和華所憎惡；因那些國民行這可憎惡的事，所以耶和華─你的神將他們從你面前趕出。
english: For all who do such things are disgusting to the Lord; and because of these disgusting things the Lord your God is driving them out before you.

chinese: 你要在耶和華─你的神面前作完全人。
english: You are to be upright in heart before the Lord your God.

chinese: 因你所要趕出的那些國民都聽信觀兆的和占卜的，至於你，耶和華─你的神從來不許你這樣行。
english: For these nations, whose land you are taking, give attention to readers of signs and to those using secret arts: but the Lord your God will not let you do so.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神要從你們弟兄中間給你興起一位先知，像我，你們要聽從他。
english: The Lord your God will give you a prophet from among your people, like me; you will give ear to him;

chinese: 正如你在何烈山大會的日子求耶和華─你神一切的話，說：求你不再叫我聽見耶和華─我　神的聲音，也不再叫我看見這大火，免得我死亡。
english: In answer to the request you made to the Lord your God in Horeb on the day of the great meeting, when you said, Let not the voice of the Lord my God come to my ears again, and let me not see this great fire any more, or death will overtake me.

chinese: 耶和華就對我說：他們所說的是。
english: Then the Lord said to me, What they have said is well said.

chinese: 我必在他們弟兄中間給他們興起一位先知，像你。我要將當說的話傳給他；他要將我一切所吩咐的都傳給他們。
english: I will give them a prophet from among themselves, like you, and I will put my words in his mouth, and he will say to them whatever I give him orders to say.

chinese: 誰不聽他奉我名所說的話，我必討誰的罪。
english: And whoever does not give ear to my words which he will say in my name, will be responsible to me.

chinese: 若有先知擅敢託我的名說我所未曾吩咐他說的話，或是奉別神的名說話，那先知就必治死。
english: But the prophet who takes it on himself to say words in my name which I have not given him orders to say, or who says anything in the name of other gods, will come to his death.

chinese: 你心裡若說：耶和華所未曾吩咐的話，我們怎能知道呢？
english: And if you say in your hearts, How are we to be certain that the word does not come from the Lord?

chinese: 先知託耶和華的名說話，所說的若不成就，也無效驗，這就是耶和華所未曾吩咐的，是那先知擅自說的，你不要怕他。
english: When a prophet makes a statement in the name of the Lord, if what he says does not take place and his words do not come true, then his word is not the word of the Lord: the words of the prophet were said in the pride of his heart, and you are to have no fear of him.

chinese: 耶和華─你神將列國之民剪除的時候，耶和華─你　神也將他們的地賜給你，你接著住他們的城邑並他們的房屋，
english: When the nations, whose land the Lord your God is giving you, have been cut off by him, and you have taken their place and are living in their towns and in their houses;

chinese: 就要在耶和華─你神所賜你為業的地上分定三座城。
english: You are to have three towns marked out in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage.

chinese: 要將耶和華─你神使你承受為業的地分為三段；又要預備道路，使誤殺人的，都可以逃到那裡去。
english: You are to make ready a way, and see that the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, is marked out into three parts, to which any taker of life may go in flight.

chinese: 誤殺人的逃到那裡可以存活，定例乃是這樣：凡素無仇恨，無心殺了人的，
english: This is to be the rule for anyone who goes in flight there, after causing the death of his neighbour in error and not through hate;

chinese: 就如人與鄰舍同入樹林砍伐樹木，手拿斧子一砍，本想砍下樹木，不料，斧頭脫了把，飛落在鄰舍身上，以致於死，這人逃到那些城的一座城，就可以存活，
english: For example, if a man goes into the woods with his neighbour for the purpose of cutting down trees, and when he takes his axe to give a blow to the tree, the head of the axe comes off, and falling on to his neighbour gives him a wound causing his death; then the man may go in flight to one of these towns and be safe:

chinese: 免得報血仇的，心中火熱追趕他，因路遠就追上，將他殺死；其實他不該死，因為他與被殺的素無仇恨。
english: For if not, he who has the right of punishment may go running after the taker of life in the heat of his wrath, and overtake him because the way is long, and give him a death-blow; though it is not right for him to be put to death because he was not moved by hate.

chinese: 所以我吩咐你說，要分定三座城。
english: And so I am ordering you to see that three towns are marked out for this purpose.

chinese: 耶和華─你神若照他向你列祖所起的誓擴張你的境界，將所應許賜你列祖的地全然給你，
english: And if the Lord your God makes wide the limits of your land, as he said in his oath to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he undertook to give to your fathers;

chinese: 你若謹守遵行我今日所吩咐的這一切誡命，愛耶和華─你的神，常常遵行他的道，就要在這三座城之外，再添三座城，
english: If you keep and do all these orders which I give you today, loving the Lord your God and walking ever in his ways; then let three more towns, in addition to these three, be marked out for you:

chinese: 免得無辜之人的血流在耶和華─你神所賜你為業的地上，流血的罪就歸於你。
english: So that in all your land, which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, no man may be wrongly put to death, for which you will be responsible.

chinese: 若有人恨他的鄰舍，埋伏著起來擊殺他，以致於死，便逃到這些城的一座城，
english: But if any man has hate for his neighbour, and waiting for him secretly makes an attack on him and gives him a blow causing his death, and then goes in flight to one of these towns;

chinese: 本城的長老就要打發人去，從那裡帶出他來，交在報血仇的手中，將他治死。
english: The responsible men of his town are to send and take him, and give him up to the one who has the right of punishment to be put to death.

chinese: 你眼不可顧惜他，卻要從以色列中除掉流無辜血的罪，使你可以得福。
english: Have no pity on him, so that Israel may be clear from the crime of putting a man to death without cause, and it will be well for you.

chinese: 在耶和華─你神所賜你承受為業之地，不可挪移你鄰舍的地界，那是先人所定的。
english: Your neighbour's landmark, which was put in its place by the men of old times, is not to be moved or taken away in the land of your heritage which the Lord your God is giving you.

chinese: 人無論犯甚麼罪，作甚麼惡，不可憑一個人的口作見證，總要憑兩三個人的口作見證才可定案。
english: One witness may not make a statement against a man in relation to any sin or wrongdoing which he has done: on the word of two or three witnesses a question is to be judged.

chinese: 若有凶惡的見證人起來，見證某人作惡，
english: If a false witness makes a statement against a man, saying that he has done wrong,

chinese: 這兩個爭訟的人就要站在耶和華面前，和當時的祭司，並審判官面前，
english: Then the two men, between whom the argument has taken place, are to come before the Lord, before the priests and judges who are then in power;

chinese: 審判官要細細的查究，若見證人果然是作假見證的，以假見證陷害弟兄，
english: And the judges will have the question looked into with care: and if the witness is seen to be false and to have made a false statement against his brother,

chinese: 你們就要待他如同他想要待的弟兄。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
english: Then do to him what it was his purpose to do to his brother: and so put away the evil from among you.

chinese: 別人聽見都要害怕，就不敢在你們中間再行這樣的惡了。
english: And the rest of the people, hearing of it, will be full of fear, and never again do such evil among you.

chinese: 你眼不可顧惜，要以命償命，以眼還眼，以牙還牙，以手還手，以腳還腳。
english: Have no pity; let life be given for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

chinese: 你出去與仇敵爭戰的時候，看見馬匹、車輛，並有比你多的人民，不要怕他們，因為領你出埃及地的耶和華─你神與你同在。
english: When you go out to war against other nations, and come face to face with horses and war-carriages and armies greater in number than yourselves, have no fear of them: for the Lord your God is with you, who took you up out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 你們將要上陣的時候，祭司要到百姓面前宣告
english: And when you are on the point of attacking, let the priest come forward and say to the people,

chinese: 說：以色列人哪，你們當聽，你們今日將要與仇敵爭戰，不要膽怯，不要懼怕戰兢，也不要因他們驚恐；
english: Give ear, O Israel: today you are going forward to the fight; let your heart be strong; do not let uncontrolled fear overcome you because of those who are against you;

chinese: 因為耶和華─你們的神與你們同去，要為你們與仇敵爭戰，拯救你們。
english: For the Lord your God goes with you, fighting for you to give you salvation from those who are against you.

chinese: 官長也要對百姓宣告說：誰建造房屋，尚未奉獻，他可以回家去，恐怕他陣亡，別人去奉獻。
english: And let the overseers say to the people, If there is any man who has made for himself a new house and has not gone into it, let him go back to his house, so that in the event of his death in the fight, another may not take his house for himself.

chinese: 誰種葡萄園，尚未用所結的果子，他可以回家去，恐怕他陣亡，別人去用。
english: Or if any man has made a vine-garden without taking the first-fruits of it, let him go back to his house, so that in the event of his death in the fight, another may not be the first to make use of the fruit.

chinese: 誰聘定了妻，尚未迎娶，他可以回家去，恐怕他陣亡，別人去娶。
english: Or if any man is newly married and has had no sex relations with his wife, let him go back to his house, so that in the event of his death in the fight, another man may not take her.

chinese: 官長又要對百姓宣告說：誰懼怕膽怯，他可以回家去，恐怕他弟兄的心消化，和他一樣。
english: And let the overseers go on to say to the people, If there is any man whose heart is feeble with fear, let him go back to his house before he makes the hearts of his countrymen feeble.

chinese: 官長對百姓宣告完了，就當派軍長率領他們。
english: Then, after saying these words to the people, let the overseers put captains over the army.

chinese: 你臨近一座城、要攻打的時候，先要對城裡的民宣告和睦的話。
english: When you come to a town, before attacking it, make an offer of peace.

chinese: 他們若以和睦的話回答你，給你開了城，城裡所有的人都要給你效勞，服事你；
english: And if it gives you back an answer of peace, opening its doors to you, then all the people in it may be put to forced work as your servants.

chinese: 若不肯與你和好，反要與你打仗，你就要圍困那城。
english: If however it will not make peace with you, but war, then let it be shut in on all sides:

chinese: 耶和華─你的神把城交付你手，你就要用刀殺盡這城的男丁。
english: And when the Lord your God has given it into your hands, let every male in it be put to death without mercy.

chinese: 惟有婦女、孩子、牲畜，和城內一切的財物，你可以取為自己的掠物。耶和華─你神把你仇敵的財物賜給你，你可以吃用。
english: But the women and the children and the cattle and everything in the town and all its wealth, you may take for yourselves: the wealth of your haters, which the Lord your God has given you, will be your food.

chinese: 離你甚遠的各城，不是這些國民的城，你都要這樣待他。
english: So you are to do to all the towns far away, which are not the towns of these nations.

chinese: 但這些國民的城，耶和華─你神既賜你為業，其中凡有氣息的，一個不可存留；
english: But in the towns of these peoples whose land the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, let no living thing be kept from death:

chinese: 只要照耶和華─你神所吩咐的將這赫人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人都滅絕淨盡，
english: Give them up to the curse; the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as the Lord your God has given you orders:

chinese: 免得他們教導你們學習一切可憎惡的事，就是他們向自己神所行的，以致你們得罪耶和華─你們的　神。
english: So that you may not take them as your example and do all the disgusting things which they do in the worship of their gods, so sinning against the Lord your God.

chinese: 你若許久圍困、攻打所要取的一座城，就不可舉斧子砍壞樹木；因為你可以吃那樹上的果子，不可砍伐。田間的樹木豈是人，叫你蹧蹋麼？
english: If in war a town is shut in by your armies for a long time, do not let its trees be cut down and made waste; for their fruit will be your food; are the trees of the countryside men for you to take up arms against them?

chinese: 惟獨你所知道不是結果毀壞、砍伐，用以修築營壘，攻擊那與你打仗的城，直到攻塌了。
english: Only those trees which you are certain are not used for food may be cut down and put to destruction: and you are to make walls of attack against the town till it is taken.

chinese: 在耶和華─你神所賜你為業的地上，若遇見被殺的人倒在田野，不知道是誰殺的，
english: If, in the land which the Lord your God is giving you, you come across the dead body of a man in the open country, and you have no idea who has put him to death:

chinese: 長老和審判官就要出去，從被殺的人那裡量起，直量到四圍的城邑，
english: Then your responsible men and your judges are to come out, and give orders for the distance from the dead body to the towns round about it to be measured;

chinese: 看哪城離被殺的人最近，那城的長老就要從牛群中取一隻未曾耕地、未曾負軛的母牛犢，
english: And whichever town is nearest to the body, the responsible men of that town are to take from the herd a young cow which has never been used for work or put under the yoke;

chinese: 把母牛犢牽到流水、未曾耕種的山谷去，在谷中打折母牛犢的頸項。
english: And they are to take the cow into a valley where there is flowing water, and which is not ploughed or planted, and there the neck of the cow is to be broken:

chinese: 祭司利未的子孫要近前來；因為耶和華─你的神揀選了他們事奉他，奉耶和華的名祝福，所有爭訟毆打的事都要憑他們判斷。
english: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, are to come near; for they have been marked out by the Lord your God to be his servants and to give blessings in the name of the Lord; and by their decision every argument and every blow is to be judged:

chinese: 那城的眾長老，就是離被殺的人最近的，要在那山谷中，在所打折頸項的母牛犢以上洗手，
english: And all the responsible men of that town which is nearest to the dead man, washing their hands over the cow whose neck was broken in the valley,

chinese: 禱告（原文作回答）說：我們的手未曾流這人的血；我們的眼也未曾看見這事。
english: Will say, This death is not the work of our hands and our eyes have not seen it.

chinese: 耶和華阿，求你赦免你所救贖的以色列民，不要使流無辜血的罪歸在你的百姓以色列中間。這樣，流血的罪必得赦免。
english: Have mercy, O Lord, on your people Israel whom you have made free, and take away from your people the crime of a death without cause. Then they will no longer be responsible for the man's death.

chinese: 你行耶和華眼中看為正的事，就可以從你們中間除掉流無辜血的罪。
english: So you will take away the crime of a death without cause from among you, when you do what is right in the eyes of the Lord.

chinese: 你出去與仇敵爭戰的時候，耶和華─你的神將他們交在你手中，你就擄了他們去。
english: When you go out to war against other nations, and the Lord your God gives them up into your hands and you take them as prisoners;

chinese: 若在被擄的人中見有美貌的女子，戀慕他，要娶他為妻，
english: If among the prisoners you see a beautiful woman and it is your desire to make her your wife;

chinese: 就可以領他到你家裡去；他便要剃頭髮，修指甲，
english: Then take her back to your house; and let her hair and her nails be cut;

chinese: 脫去被擄時所穿的衣服，住在你家裡哀哭父母一個整月，然後可以與他同房。你作他的丈夫，他作你的妻子。
english: And let her take off the dress in which she was made prisoner and go on living in your house and weeping for her father and mother for a full month: and after that you may go in to her and be her husband and she will be your wife.

chinese: 後來你若不喜悅他，就要由他隨意出去，決不可為錢賣他，也不可當婢女待他，因為你玷污了他。
english: But if you have no delight in her, you are to let her go wherever she will; you may not take a price for her as if she was your property, for you have made use of her for your pleasure.

chinese: 人若有二妻，一為所愛，一為所惡，所愛的、所惡的都給他生了兒子，但長子是所惡之妻生的。
english: If a man has two wives, one greatly loved and the other hated, and the two of them have had children by him; and if the first son is the child of the hated wife:

chinese: 到了把產業分給兒子承受的時候，不可將所愛之妻生的兒子立為長子，在所惡之妻生的兒子以上，
english: Then when he gives his property to his sons for their heritage, he is not to put the son of his loved one in the place of the first son, the son of the hated wife:

chinese: 卻要認所惡之妻生的兒子為長子，將產業多加一分給他；因這兒子是他力量強壯的時候生的，長子的名分本當歸他。
english: But he is to give his first son his birthright, and twice as great a part of his property: for he is the first-fruits of his strength and the right of the first son is his.

chinese: 人若有頑梗悖逆的兒子，不聽從父母的話，他們雖懲治他，他仍不聽從，
english: If a man has a son who is hard-hearted and uncontrolled, who gives no attention to the voice of his father and mother, and will not be ruled by them, though they give him punishment:

chinese: 父母就要抓住他，將他帶到本地的城門、本城的長老那裡，
english: Then let his father and mother take him to the responsible men of the town, to the public place;

chinese: 對長老說：我們這兒子頑梗悖逆，不聽從我們的話，是貪食好酒的人。
english: And say to them, This son of ours is hard-hearted and uncontrolled, he will not give attention to us; he gives himself up to pleasure and strong drink.

chinese: 本城的眾人就要用石頭將他打死。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉，以色列眾人都要聽見害怕。
english: Then he is to be stoned to death by all the men of the town: so you are to put away the evil from among you; and all Israel, hearing of it, will be full of fear.

chinese: 人若犯該死的罪，被治死了，你將他挂在木頭上，
english: If a man does a crime for which the punishment is death, and he is put to death by hanging him on a tree;

chinese: 他的屍首不可留在木頭上過夜，必要當日將他葬埋，免得玷污了耶和華─你神所賜你為業之地。因為被挂的人是在　神面前受咒詛的。
english: Do not let his body be on the tree all night, but put it to rest in the earth the same day; for the man who undergoes hanging is cursed by God; so do not make unclean the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage.

chinese: 你若看見弟兄的牛或羊失迷了路，不可佯為不見，總要把他牽回來交給你的弟兄。
english: If you see your brother's ox or his sheep wandering, do not go by without helping, but take them back to your brother.

chinese: 你弟兄若離你遠，或是你不認識他，就要牽到你家去，留在你那裡，等你弟兄來尋找就還給他。
english: If their owner is not near, or if you are not certain who he is, then take the beast to your house and keep it till its owner comes in search of it, and then you are to give it back to him.

chinese: 你的弟兄無論失落甚麼，或是驢，或是衣服，你若遇見，都要這樣行，不可佯為不見。
english: Do the same with his ass or his robe or anything which has gone from your brother's keeping and which you have come across: do not keep it to yourself.

chinese: 你若看見弟兄的牛或驢跌倒在路上，不可佯為不見，總要幫助他拉起來。
english: If you see your brother's ox or his ass falling down on the road, do not go by without giving him help in lifting it up again.

chinese: 婦女不可穿戴男子所穿戴的，男子也不可穿婦女的衣服，因為這樣行都是耶和華─你神所憎惡的。
english: It is not right for a woman to be dressed in man's clothing, or for a man to put on a woman's robe: whoever does such things is disgusting to the Lord your God.

chinese: 你若路上遇見鳥窩，或在樹上或在地上，裡頭有雛或有蛋，母鳥伏在雛上或在蛋上，你不可連母帶雛一併取去。
english: If by chance you see a place which a bird has made for itself in a tree or on the earth, with young ones or eggs, and the mother bird seated on the young ones or on the eggs, do not take the mother bird with the young:

chinese: 總要放母，只可取雛，這樣你就可以享福，日子得以長久。
english: See that you let the mother bird go, but the young ones you may take; so it will be well for you and your life will be long.

chinese: 你若建造房屋，要在房上的四圍安欄杆，免得有人從房上掉下來，流血的罪就歸於你家。
english: If you are building a house, make a railing for the roof, so that the blood of any man falling from it will not come on your house.

chinese: 不可把兩樣種子種在你的葡萄園裡，免得你撒種所結的和葡萄園的果子都要充公。
english: Do not have your vine-garden planted with two sorts of seed: or all of it may become a loss, the seed you have put in as well as the increase.

chinese: 不可並用牛、驢耕地。
english: Do not do your ploughing with an ox and an ass yoked together.

chinese: 不可穿羊毛、細麻兩樣攙雜料做的衣服。
english: Do not have clothing made of two sorts of thread, wool and linen together.

chinese: 你要在所披的外衣上四圍做繸子。
english: On the four edges of your robe, with which your body is covered, put ornaments of twisted threads.

chinese: 人若娶妻，與他同房之後恨惡他，
english: If any man takes a wife, and having had connection with her, has no delight in her,

chinese: 信口說他，將醜名加在他身上，說：我娶了這女子，與他同房，見他沒有貞潔的憑據；
english: And says evil things about her and gives her a bad name, saying, I took this woman, and when I had connection with her it was clear to me that she was not a virgin:

chinese: 女子的父母就要把女子貞潔的憑據拿出來，帶到本城門長老那裡。
english: Then let the girl's father and mother put before the responsible men of the town, in the public place, signs that the girl was a virgin:

chinese: 女子的父親要對長老說：我將我的女兒給這人為妻，他恨惡他，
english: And let the girl's father say to the responsible men, I gave my daughter to this man for his wife, but he has no love for her;

chinese: 信口說他，說：我見你的女兒沒有貞潔的憑據；其實這就是我女兒貞潔的憑據。父母就把那布鋪在本城的長老面前。
english: And now he has put shame on her, saying that she is not a virgin; but here is the sign that she is a virgin. Then they are to put her clothing before the responsible men of the town.

chinese: 本城的長老要拿住那人，懲治他，
english: Then the responsible men of the town are to give the man his punishment;

chinese: 並要罰他一百舍客勒銀子，給女子的父親，因為他將醜名加在以色列的一個處女身上。女子仍作他的妻，終身不可休他。
english: They will take from him a hundred shekels of silver, which are to be given to the father of the girl, because he has given an evil name to a virgin of Israel: she will go on being his wife, he may never put her away all his life.

chinese: 但這事若是真的，女子沒有貞潔的憑據，
english: But if what he has said is true, and she is seen to be not a virgin,

chinese: 就要將女子帶到他父家的門口，本城的人要用石頭將他打死；因為他在父家行了淫亂，在以色列中做了醜事。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
english: Then they are to make the girl come to the door of her father's house and she will be stoned to death by the men of the town, because she has done evil and put shame on Israel, by acting as a loose woman in her father's house: so you are to put away evil from among you.

chinese: 若遇見人與有丈夫的婦人行淫，就要將姦夫淫婦一併治死。這樣，就把那惡從以色列中除掉。
english: If a man is taken in the act of going in to a married woman, the two of them, the man as well as the woman, are to be put to death: so you are to put away the evil from Israel.

chinese: 若有處女已經許配丈夫，有人在城裡遇見他，與他行淫，
english: If a young virgin has given her word to be married to a man, and another man meeting her in the town, has connection with her;

chinese: 你們就要把這二人帶到本城門，用石頭打死─女子是因為雖在城裡卻沒有喊叫；男子是因為玷污別人的妻。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。
english: Then you are to take the two of them to the doorway of the town, and have them stoned to death; the young virgin, because she gave no cry for help, though it was in the town, and the man, because he has put shame on his neighbour's wife: so you are to put away evil from among you.

chinese: 若有男子在田野遇見已經許配人的女子，強與他行淫，只要將那男子治死。
english: But if the man, meeting such a virgin in the open country, takes her by force, then only the man is to be put to death;

chinese: 但不可辦女子；他本沒有該死的罪，這事就類乎人起來攻擊鄰舍，將他殺了一樣。
english: Nothing is to be done to the virgin, because there is no cause of death in her: it is the same as if a man made an attack on his neighbour and put him to death:

chinese: 因為男子是在田野遇見那已經許配人的女子，女子喊叫，並無人救他。
english: For he came across her in the open country, and there was no one to come to the help of the virgin in answer to her cry.

chinese: 若有男子遇見沒有許配人的處女，抓住他，與他行淫，被人看見，
english: If a man sees a young virgin, who has not given her word to be married to anyone, and he takes her by force and has connection with her, and discovery is made of it;

chinese: 這男子就要拿五十舍客勒銀子給女子的父親；因他玷污了這女子，就要娶他為妻，終身不可休他。
english: Then the man will have to give the virgin's father fifty shekels of silver and make her his wife, because he has put shame on her; he may never put her away all his life.

chinese: 人不可娶繼母為妻；不可掀開他父親的衣襟。
english: A man may not take his father's wife or have sex relations with a woman who is his father's.

chinese: 凡外腎受傷的，或被閹割的，不可入耶和華的會。
english: No man whose private parts have been wounded or cut off may come into the meeting of the Lord's people.

chinese: 私生子不可入耶和華的會；他的子孫，直到十代，也不可入耶和華的會。
english: One whose father and mother are not married may not come into the meeting of the Lord's people, or any of his family to the tenth generation.

chinese: 亞捫人或是摩押人不可入耶和華的會；他們的子孫，雖過十代，也永不可入耶和華的會。
english: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their people to the tenth generation may come into the meeting of the Lord's people:

chinese: 因為你們出埃及的時候，他們沒有拿食物和水在路上迎接你們，又因他們雇了米所波大米的毘奪人比珥的兒子巴蘭來咒詛你們。
english: Because they gave you no bread or water on your way, when you came out of Egypt: and they got Balaam, the son of Peor, from Pethor in Aram-naharaim to put curses on you.

chinese: 然而耶和華─你的神不肯聽從巴蘭，咒詛的言語變為祝福的話，因為耶和華─你的　神愛你。
english: But the Lord your God would not give ear to Balaam, but let the curse be changed into a blessing to you, because of his love for you.

chinese: 你一生一世永不可求他們的平安和他們的利益。
english: Do nothing for their peace or well-being for ever.

chinese: 不可憎惡以東人，因為他是你的弟兄。不可憎惡埃及人，因為你在他的地上作過寄居的。
english: But have no hate for an Edomite, because he is your brother, or for an Egyptian, for you were living in his land.

chinese: 他們第三代子孫入耶和華的會。
english: Their children in the third generation may come into the meeting of the Lord's people.

chinese: 你出兵攻打仇敵，就要遠避諸惡。
english: When you go out to war and put your tents in position, keep from every evil thing.

chinese: 你們中間，若有人夜間偶然夢遺，不潔淨，就要出到營外，不可入營；
english: If any man among you becomes unclean through anything which has taken place in the night, he is to go out from the tent-circle and keep outside it:

chinese: 到傍晚的時候，他要用水洗澡，及至日落了才可以入營。
english: But when evening comes near, let him take a bath: and after sundown he may come back to the tents.

chinese: 你在營外也該定出一個地方作為便所。
english: Let there be a place outside the tent-circle to which you may go;

chinese: 在你器械之中當預備一把鍬，你出營外便溺以後，用以鏟土，轉身掩蓋。
english: And have among your arms a spade; and when you have been to that place, let that which comes from you be covered up with earth:

chinese: 因為耶和華─你的神常在你營中行走，要救護你，將仇敵交給你，所以你的營理當聖潔，免得他見你那裡有污穢，就離開你。
english: For the Lord your God is walking among your tents, to keep you safe and to give up into your hands those who are fighting against you; then let your tents be holy, so that he may see no unclean thing among you, and be turned away from you.

chinese: 若有奴僕脫了主人的手，逃到你那裡，你不可將他交付他的主人。
english: Do not give back to his master a servant who has gone in flight from his master and come to you:

chinese: 他必在你那裡與你同住，在你的城邑中，要由他選擇一個所喜悅的地方居住；你不可欺負他。
english: Let him go on living among you in whatever place is most pleasing to him: do not be hard on him.

chinese: 以色列的女子中不可有妓女；以色列的男子中不可有孌童。
english: No daughter of Israel is to let herself be used as a loose woman for a strange god, and no son of Israel is to give himself to a man.

chinese: 娼妓所得的錢，或孌童（原文作狗）所得的價，你不可帶入耶和華─你神的殿還願，因為這兩樣都是耶和華─你　神所憎惡的。
english: Do not take into the house of the Lord your God, as an offering for an oath, the price of a loose woman or the money given to one used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods: for these two things are disgusting to the Lord your God.

chinese: 你借給你弟兄的，或是錢財或是糧食，無論甚麼可生利的物，都不可取利。
english: Do not take interest from an Israelite on anything, money or food or any other goods, which you let him have:

chinese: 借給外邦人可以取利，只是借給你弟兄不可取利。這樣，耶和華─你神必在你所去得為業的地上和你手裡所辦的一切事上賜福與你。
english: From men of other nations you may take interest, but not from an Israelite: so that the blessing of the Lord your God may be on everything to which you put your hand, in the land which you are about to take as your heritage.

chinese: 你向耶和華─你的神許願，償還不可遲延；因為耶和華─你的　神必定向你追討，你不償還就有罪。
english: When you take an oath to the Lord, do not be slow to give effect to it: for without doubt the Lord your God will make you responsible, and will put it to your account as sin.

chinese: 你若不許願，倒無罪。
english: But if you take no oath, there will be no sin.

chinese: 你嘴裡所出的，就是你口中應許甘心所獻的，要照你向耶和華─你神所許的願謹守遵行。
english: Whatever your lips have said, see that you do it; for you gave your word freely to the Lord your God.

chinese: 你進了鄰舍的葡萄園，可以隨意吃飽了葡萄，只是不可裝在器皿中。
english: When you go into your neighbour's vine-garden, you may take of his grapes at your pleasure, but you may not take them away in your vessel.

chinese: 你進了鄰舍站著的禾稼，可以用手摘穗子，只是不可用鐮刀割取禾稼。
english: When you go into your neighbour's field, you may take the heads of grain with your hand; but you may not put your blade to his grain.

chinese: 人若娶妻以後，見他有甚麼不合理的事，不喜悅他，就可以寫休書交在他手中，打發他離開夫家。
english: If a man takes a wife, and after they are married she is unpleasing to him because of some bad quality in her, let him give her a statement in writing and send her away from his house.

chinese: 婦人離開夫家以後，可以去嫁別人。
english: And when she has gone away from him, she may become another man's wife.

chinese: 後夫若恨惡他，寫休書交在他手中，打發他離開夫家，或是娶他為妻的後夫死了，
english: And if the second husband has no love for her and, giving her a statement in writing, sends her away; or if death comes to the second husband to whom she was married;

chinese: 打發他去的前夫不可在婦人玷污之後再娶他為妻，因為這是耶和華所憎惡的；不可使耶和華─你神所賜為業之地被玷污了。
english: Her first husband, who had sent her away, may not take her back after she has been wife to another; for that is disgusting to the Lord: and you are not to be a cause of sin in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage.

chinese: 新娶妻之人不可從軍出征，也不可託他辦理甚麼公事，可以在家清閒一年，使他所娶的妻快活。
english: A newly married man will not have to go out with the army or undertake any business, but may be free for one year, living in his house for the comfort of his wife.

chinese: 不可拿人的全盤磨石或是上磨石作當頭，因為這是拿人的命作當頭。
english: No one is to take, on account of a debt, the stones with which grain is crushed: for in doing so he takes a man's living.

chinese: 若遇見人拐帶以色列中的一個弟兄，當奴才待他，或是賣了他，那拐帶人的就必治死。這樣，便將那惡從你們中間除掉。
english: If a man takes by force one of his countrymen, the children of Israel, using him as his property or getting a price for him, that thief is to be put to death: so you are to put away evil from among you.

chinese: 在大痲瘋的災病上，你們要謹慎，照祭司利未人一切所指教你們的留意遵行。我怎樣吩咐他們，你們要怎樣遵行。
english: In connection with the leper's disease, take care to keep and do every detail of the teaching of the priests, the Levites: as I gave them orders, so you are to do.

chinese: 當記念出埃及後，在路上，耶和華─你神向米利暗所行的事。
english: Keep in mind what the Lord your God did to Miriam on the way, when you came out of Egypt.

chinese: 你借給鄰舍，不拘是甚麼，不可進他家拿他的當頭。
english: If you let your brother have the use of anything which is yours, do not go into his house and take anything of his as a sign of his debt;

chinese: 要站在外面，等那向你借貸的人把當頭拿出來交給你。
english: But keep outside till he comes out and gives it to you.

chinese: 他若是窮人，你不可留他的當頭過夜。
english: If he is a poor man, do not keep his property all night;

chinese: 日落的時候，總要把當頭還他，使他用那件衣服蓋著睡覺，他就為你祝福；這在耶和華─你神面前就是你的義了。
english: But be certain to give it back to him when the sun goes down, so that he may have his clothing for sleeping in, and will give you his blessing: and this will be put to your account as righteousness before the Lord your God.

chinese: 困苦窮乏的雇工，無論是你的弟兄或是在你城裡寄居的，你不可欺負他。
english: Do not be hard on a servant who is poor and in need, if he is one of your countrymen or a man from another nation living with you in your land.

chinese: 要當日給他工價，不可等到日落─因為他窮苦，把心放在工價上─恐怕他因你求告耶和華，罪便歸你了。
english: Give him his payment day by day, not keeping it back over night; for he is poor and his living is dependent on it; and if his cry against you comes to the ears of the Lord, it will be judged as sin in you.

chinese: 不可因子殺父，也不可因父殺子；凡被殺的都為本身的罪。
english: Fathers are not to be put to death for their children or children for their fathers: every man is to be put to death for the sin which he himself has done.

chinese: 你不可向寄居的和孤兒屈枉正直，也不可拿寡婦的衣裳作當頭。
english: Be upright in judging the cause of the man from a strange country and of him who has no father; do not take a widow's clothing on account of a debt:

chinese: 要記念你在埃及作過奴僕。耶和華─你的神從那裡將你救贖，所以我吩咐你這樣行。
english: But keep in mind that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God made you free: for this is why I give you orders to do this.

chinese: 你在田間收割莊稼，若忘下一捆，不可回去再取，要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。這樣，耶和華─你神必在你手裡所辦的一切事上賜福與你。
english: When you get in the grain from your field, if some of the grain has been dropped by chance in the field, do not go back and get it, but let it be for the man from a strange land, the child without a father, and the widow: so that the blessing of the Lord your God may be on all the work of your hands.

chinese: 你打橄欖樹，枝上剩下的，不可再打；要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。
english: When you are shaking the fruit from your olive-trees, do not go over the branches a second time: let some be for the man from a strange land, the child without a father, and the widow.

chinese: 你摘葡萄園的葡萄，所剩下的，不可再摘；要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。
english: When you are pulling the grapes from your vines, do not take up those which have been dropped; let them be for the man from a strange land, the child without a father, and the widow.

chinese: 你也要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕，所以我吩咐你這樣行。
english: Keep in mind that you were a servant in the land of Egypt: for this is why I give you orders to do this.

chinese: 人若有爭訟，來聽審判，審判官就要定義人有理，定惡人有罪。
english: If there is an argument between men and they go to law with one another, let the judges give their decision for the upright, and against the wrongdoer.

chinese: 惡人若該受責打，審判官就要叫他當面伏在地上，按著他的罪照數責打。
english: And if the wrongdoer is to undergo punishment by whipping, the judge will give orders for him to go down on his face and be whipped before him, the number of the blows being in relation to his crime.

chinese: 只可打他四十下，不可過數；若過數，便是輕賤你的弟兄了。
english: He may be given forty blows, not more; for if more are given, your brother may be shamed before you.

chinese: 牛在場上踹穀的時候，不可籠住他的嘴。
english: Do not keep the ox from taking the grain when he is crushing it.

chinese: 弟兄同居，若死了一個，沒有兒子，死人的妻不可出嫁外人，他丈夫的兄弟當盡弟兄的本分，娶他為妻，與他同房。
english: If brothers are living together and one of them, at his death, has no son, the wife of the dead man is not to be married outside the family to another man: let her husband's brother go in to her and make her his wife, doing as it is right for a brother-in-law to do.

chinese: 婦人生的長子必歸死兄的名下，免得他的名在以色列中塗抹了。
english: Then the first male child she has will take the rights of the brother who is dead, so that his name may not come to an end in Israel.

chinese: 那人若不願意娶他哥哥的妻，他哥哥的妻就要到城門長老那裡，說：我丈夫的兄弟不肯在以色列中興起他哥哥的名字，不給我盡弟兄的本分。
english: But if the man says he will not take his brother's wife, then let the wife go to the responsible men of the town, and say, My husband's brother will not keep his brother's name living in Israel; he will not do what it is right for a husband's brother to do.

chinese: 本城的長老就要召那人來問他，他若執意說：我不願意娶他，
english: Then the responsible men of the town will send for the man, and have talk with him: and if he still says, I will not take her;

chinese: 他哥哥的妻就要當著長老到那人的跟前，脫了他的鞋，吐唾沫在他臉上，說：凡不為哥哥建立家室的都要這樣待他。
english: Then his brother's wife is to come to him, before the responsible men of the town, and take his shoe off his foot, and put shame on him, and say, So let it be done to the man who will not take care of his brother's name.

chinese: 在以色列中，他的名必稱為脫鞋之家。
english: And his family will be named in Israel, The house of him whose shoe has been taken off.

chinese: 若有二人爭鬥，這人的妻近前來，要救他丈夫脫離那打他丈夫之人的手，抓住那人的下體，
english: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one of them, coming to the help of her husband, takes the other by the private parts;

chinese: 就要砍斷婦人的手，眼不可顧惜他。
english: Her hand is to be cut off; have no pity on her.

chinese: 你囊中不可有一大一小兩樣的法碼。
english: Do not have in your bag different weights, a great and a small;

chinese: 你家裡不可有一大一小兩樣的升斗。
english: Or in your house different measures, a great and a small.

chinese: 當用對準公平的法碼，公平的升斗。這樣，在耶和華─你神所賜你的地上，你的日子就可以長久。
english: But have a true weight and a true measure: so that your life may be long in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

chinese: 因為行非義之事的人都是耶和華─你神所憎惡的。
english: For all who do such things, and all whose ways are not upright, are disgusting to the Lord your God.

chinese: 你要記念你們出埃及的時候，亞瑪力人在路上怎樣待你。
english: Keep in mind what Amalek did to you on your way from Egypt;

chinese: 他們在路上遇見你，趁你疲乏困倦擊殺你儘後邊軟弱的人，並不敬畏神。
english: How, meeting you on the way, he made an attack on you when you were tired and without strength, cutting off all the feeble ones at the end of your line; and the fear of God was not in him.

chinese: 所以耶和華─你神使你不被四圍一切的仇敵擾亂，在耶和華─你　神賜你為業的地上得享平安。那時，你要將亞瑪力的名號從天下塗抹了，不可忘記。
english: So when the Lord your God has given you rest from all who are against you on every side, in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, see to it that the memory of Amalek is cut off from the earth; keep this in mind.

chinese: 你進去得了耶和華─你神所賜你為業之地居住，
english: Now when you have come into the land which the Lord is giving you for your heritage, and you have made it yours and are living in it;

chinese: 就要從耶和華─你神賜你的地上將所收的各種初熟的土產取些來，盛在筐子裡，往耶和華─你　神所選擇要立為他名的居所去，
english: You are to take a part of the first-fruits of the earth, which you get from the land which the Lord your God is giving you, and put it in a basket, and go to the place marked out by the Lord your God, as the resting-place of his name.

chinese: 見當時作祭司的，對他說：我今日向耶和華─你神明認，我已來到耶和華向我們列祖起誓應許賜給我們的地。
english: And you are to come to him who is priest at that time, and say to him, I give witness today before the Lord your God, that I have come into the land which the Lord made an oath to our fathers to give us.

chinese: 祭司就從你手裡取過筐子來，放在耶和華─你神的壇前。
english: Then the priest will take the basket from your hand and put it down in front of the altar of the Lord your God.

chinese: 你要在耶和華─你神面前說：我祖原是一個將亡的亞蘭人，下到埃及寄居。他人口稀少，在那裡卻成了又大又強、人數很多的國民。
english: And these are the words which you will say before the Lord your God: My father was a wandering Aramaean, and he went down with a small number of people into Egypt; there he became a great and strong nation:

chinese: 埃及人惡待我們，苦害我們，將苦工加在我們身上。
english: And the Egyptians were cruel to us, crushing us under a hard yoke:

chinese: 於是我們哀求耶和華─我們列祖的神，耶和華聽見我們的聲音，看見我們所受的困苦、勞碌、欺壓，
english: And our cry went up to the Lord, the God of our fathers, and the Lord's ear was open to the voice of our cry, and his eyes took note of our grief and the crushing weight of our work:

chinese: 他就用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，並大可畏的事與神蹟奇事，領我們出了埃及，
english: And the Lord took us out of Egypt with a strong hand and a stretched-out arm, with works of power and signs and wonders:

chinese: 將我們領進這地方，把這流奶與蜜之地賜給我們。
english: And he has been our guide to this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

chinese: 耶和華阿，現在我把你所賜給我地上初熟的土產奉了來。隨後你要把筐子放在耶和華─你神面前，向耶和華─你的　神下拜。
english: So now, I have come here with the first of the fruits of the earth which you, O Lord, have given me. Then you will put it down before the Lord your God and give him worship:

chinese: 你和利未人，並在你們中間寄居的，要因耶和華─你神所賜你和你家的一切福分歡樂。
english: And you will have joy in every good thing which the Lord your God has given to you and to your family; and the Levite, and the man from a strange land who is with you, will take part in your joy.

chinese: 每逢三年，就是十分取一之年，你取完了一切土產的十分之一，要分給利未人和寄居的，與孤兒寡婦，使他們在你城中可以吃得飽足。
english: When you have taken out a tenth from the tenth of all your produce in the third year, which is the year when this has to be done, give it to the Levite, and the man from a strange land, and the child without a father, and the widow, so that they may have food in your towns and be full;

chinese: 你又要在耶和華─你神面前說：我已將聖物從我家裡拿出來，給了利未人和寄居的，與孤兒寡婦，是照你所吩咐我的一切命令。你的命令我都沒有違背，也沒有忘記。
english: And say before the Lord your God, I have taken all the holy things out of my house and have given them to the Levite, and the man from a strange land, and him who has no father, and the widow, as you have given me orders: I have kept in mind all your orders, in nothing have I gone against them:

chinese: 我守喪的時候，沒有吃這聖物；不潔淨的時候，也沒有拿出來，又沒有為死人送去。我聽從了耶和華─我神的話，都照你所吩咐的行了。
english: No part of these things has been used for food in a time of weeping, or put away when I was unclean, or given for the dead: I have given ear to the voice of the Lord my God, and have done all you have given me orders to do.

chinese: 求你從天上、你的聖所垂看，賜福給你的百姓以色列與你所賜給我們的地，就是你向我們列祖起誓賜我們流奶與蜜之地。
english: So, looking down from your holy place in heaven, send your blessing on your people Israel and on the land which you have given us, as you said in your oath to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神今日吩咐你行這些律例典章，所以你要盡心盡性謹守遵行。
english: Today the Lord your God gives you orders to keep all these laws and decisions: so then keep and do them with all your heart and all your soul.

chinese: 你今日認耶和華為你的神，應許遵行他的道，謹守他的律例、誡命、典章，聽從他的話。
english: Today you have given witness that the Lord is your God, and that you will go in his ways and keep his laws and his orders and his decisions and give ear to his voice:

chinese: 耶和華今日照他所應許你的，也認你為他的子民，使你謹守他的一切誡命，
english: And the Lord has made it clear this day that you are a special people to him, as he gave you his word; and that you are to keep all his orders;

chinese: 又使你得稱讚、美名、尊榮，超乎他所造的萬民之上，並照他所應許的使你歸耶和華─你神為聖潔的民。
english: And that he will make you high over all the nations he has made, in praise, in name, and in honour, and that you are to be a holy people to the Lord your God as he has said.

chinese: 摩西和以色列的眾長老吩咐百姓說：你們要遵守我今日所吩咐的一切誡命。
english: Then Moses and the responsible men of Israel gave the people these orders: Keep all the orders which I have given you this day;

chinese: 你們過約但河，到了耶和華─你神所賜給你的地，當天要立起幾塊大石頭，墁上石灰，
english: And on the day when you go over Jordan into the land which the Lord your God is giving you, put up great stones, coating them with building-paste,

chinese: 把這律法的一切話寫在石頭上。你過了河，可以進入耶和華─你神所賜你流奶與蜜之地，正如耶和華─你列祖之　神所應許你的。
english: And writing on them all the words of this law, after you have gone over; so that you may take the heritage which the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the Lord, the God of your fathers, has said.

chinese: 你們過了約但河，就要在以巴路山上照我今日所吩咐的，將這些石頭立起來，墁上石灰。
english: And when you have gone over Jordan, you are to put up these stones, as I have said to you today, in Mount Ebal, and have them coated with building-paste.

chinese: 在那裡要為耶和華─你的神築一座石壇；在石頭上不可動鐵器。
english: There you are to make an altar to the Lord your God, of stones on which no iron instrument has been used.

chinese: 要用沒有鑿過的石頭築耶和華─你神的壇，在壇上要將燔祭獻給耶和華─你的　神。
english: You are to make the altar of the Lord your God of uncut stones; offering on it burned offerings to the Lord your God:

chinese: 又要獻平安祭，且在那裡吃，在耶和華─你的神面前歡樂。
english: And you are to make your peace-offerings, feasting there with joy before the Lord your God.

chinese: 你要將這律法的一切話明明的寫在石頭上。
english: And put on the stones all the words of this law, writing them very clearly.

chinese: 摩西和祭司利未人曉諭以色列眾人說：以色列阿，要默默靜聽。你今日成為耶和華─你神的百姓了。
english: Then Moses and the priests, the Levites, said to all Israel, Be quiet and give ear, O Israel; today you have become the people of the Lord your God.

chinese: 所以要聽從耶和華─你神的話，遵行他的誡命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的。
english: For this cause you are to give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and do his orders and his laws which I give you this day.

chinese: 當日，摩西囑咐百姓說：
english: That same day Moses said to the people,

chinese: 你們過了約但河，西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、約瑟、便雅憫六個支派的人都要站在基利心山上為百姓祝福。
english: These are to take their places on Mount Gerizim for blessing the people when you have gone over Jordan: Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Joseph and Benjamin;

chinese: 流便、迦得、亞設、西布倫、但、拿弗他利六個支派的人都要站在以巴路山上宣布咒詛。
english: And these are to be on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

chinese: 利未人要向以色列眾人高聲說：
english: Then the Levites are to say in a loud voice to all the men of Israel,

chinese: 有人製造耶和華所憎惡的偶像，或雕刻，或鑄造，就是工匠手所做的，在暗中設立，那人必受咒詛！百姓都要答應說：阿們！
english: Cursed is the man who makes any image of wood or stone or metal, disgusting to the Lord, the work of man's hands, and puts it up in secret. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 輕慢父母的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who does not give honour to his father or mother. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 挪移鄰舍地界的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who takes his neighbour's landmark from its place. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 使瞎子走差路的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he by whom the blind are turned out of the way. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 向寄居的和孤兒寡婦屈枉正直的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who gives a wrong decision in the cause of a man from a strange land, or of one without a father, or of a widow. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 與繼母行淫的，必受咒詛！因為掀開他父親的衣襟。百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who has sex relations with his father's wife, for he has put shame on his father. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 與獸淫合的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who has sex relations with any sort of beast. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 與異母同父，或異父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who has sex relations with his sister, the daughter of his father or of his mother. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 與岳母行淫的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who has sex relations with his mother-in-law. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 暗中殺人的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who takes his neighbour's life secretly. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 受賄賂害死無辜之人的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who for a reward puts to death one who has done no wrong. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 不堅守遵行這律法言語的，必受咒詛！百姓都要說：阿們！
english: Cursed is he who does not take this law to heart to do it. And let all the people say, So be it.

chinese: 你若留意聽從耶和華─你神的話，謹守遵行他的一切誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下萬民之上。
english: Now if you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and keep with care all these orders which I have given you today, then the Lord your God will put you high over all the nations of the earth:

chinese: 你若聽從耶和華─你神的話，這以下的福必追隨你，臨到你身上：
english: And all these blessings will come on you and overtake you, if your ears are open to the voice of the Lord your God.

chinese: 你在城裡必蒙福，在田間也必蒙福。
english: A blessing will be on you in the town, and a blessing in the field.

chinese: 你身所生的，地所產的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犢、羊羔，都必蒙福。
english: A blessing will be on the fruit of your body, and on the fruit of your land, on the fruit of your cattle, the increase of your herd, and the young of your flock.

chinese: 你的筐子和你的摶麵盆都必蒙福。
english: A blessing will be on your basket and on your bread-basin.

chinese: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。
english: A blessing will be on your coming in and on your going out.

chinese: 仇敵起來攻擊你，耶和華必使他們在你面前被你殺敗；他們從一條路來攻擊你，必從七條路逃跑。
english: By the power of the Lord, those who take arms against you will be overcome before you: they will come out against you one way, and will go in flight from you seven ways.

chinese: 在你倉房裡，並你手所辦的一切事上，耶和華所命的福必臨到你。耶和華─你神也要在所給你的地上賜福與你。
english: The Lord will send his blessing on your store-houses and on everything to which you put your hand: his blessing will be on you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

chinese: 你若謹守耶和華─你神的誡命，遵行他的道，他必照著向你所起的誓立你作為自己的聖民。
english: The Lord will keep you as a people holy to himself, as he has said to you in his oath, if you keep the orders of the Lord your God and go on walking in his ways.

chinese: 天下萬民見你歸在耶和華的名下，就要懼怕你。
english: And all the peoples of the earth will see that the name of the Lord is on you, and they will go in fear of you.

chinese: 你在耶和華向你列祖起誓應許賜你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所產的，都綽綽有餘。
english: And the Lord will make you fertile in every good thing, in the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your fields, in the land which the Lord, by his oath to your fathers, said he would give you.

chinese: 耶和華必為你開天上的府庫，按時降雨在你的地上。在你手裡所辦的一切事上賜福與你。你必借給許多國民，卻不至向他們借貸。
english: Opening his store-house in heaven, the Lord will send rain on your land at the right time, blessing all the work of your hands: other nations will make use of your wealth, and you will have no need of theirs.

chinese: 你若聽從耶和華─你神的誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，謹守遵行，不偏左右，也不隨從事奉別神，耶和華就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。
english: The Lord will make you the head and not the tail; and you will ever have the highest place, if you give ear to the orders of the Lord your God which I give you today, to keep and to do them;
Not turning away from any of the orders which I give you today, to the right hand or to the left, or going after any other gods to give them worship.

chinese: 你若不聽從耶和華─你神的話，不謹守遵行他的一切誡命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，這以下的咒詛都必追隨你，臨到你身上：
english: But if you do not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and take care to do all his orders and his laws which I give you today, then all these curses will come on you and overtake you:

chinese: 你在城裡必受咒詛，在田間也必受咒詛。
english: You will be cursed in the town and cursed in the field.

chinese: 你的筐子和你的摶麵盆都必受咒詛。
english: A curse will be on your basket and on your bread-basin.

chinese: 你身所生的，地所產的，以及牛犢、羊羔，都必受咒詛。
english: A curse will be on the fruit of your body, and on the fruit of your land, on the increase of your cattle, and the young of your flock.

chinese: 你出也受咒詛，入也受咒詛。
english: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.

chinese: 耶和華因你行惡離棄他，必在你手裡所辦的一切事上，使咒詛、擾亂、責罰臨到你，直到你被毀滅，速速的滅亡。
english: The Lord will send on you cursing and trouble and punishment in everything to which you put your hand, till sudden destruction overtakes you; because of your evil ways in which you have been false to me.

chinese: 耶和華必使瘟疫貼在你身上，直到他將你從所進去得為業的地上滅絕。
english: The Lord will send disease after disease on you, till you have been cut off by death from the land to which you are going.

chinese: 耶和華要用癆病、熱病、火症、瘧疾、刀劍、旱風（或作：乾旱）、霉爛攻擊你。這都要追趕你，直到你滅亡。
english: The Lord will send wasting disease, and burning pain, and flaming heat against you, keeping back the rain till your land is waste and dead; so will it be till your destruction is complete.

chinese: 你頭上的天要變為銅，腳下的地要變為鐵。
english: And the heaven over your heads will be brass, and the earth under you hard as iron.

chinese: 耶和華要使那降在你地上的雨變為塵沙，從天臨在你身上，直到你滅亡
english: The Lord will make the rain of your land powder and dust, sending it down on you from heaven till your destruction is complete.

chinese: 耶和華必使你敗在仇敵面前，你從一條路去攻擊他們，必從七條路逃跑。你必在天下萬國中拋來拋去。
english: The Lord will let you be overcome by your haters: you will go out against them one way, and you will go in flight before them seven ways: you will be the cause of fear among all the kingdoms of the earth.

chinese: 你的屍首必給空中的飛鳥和地上的走獸作食物，並無人鬨趕。
english: Your bodies will be meat for all the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth; there will be no one to send them away.

chinese: 耶和華必用埃及人的瘡並痔瘡、牛皮癬與疥攻擊你，使你不能醫治。
english: The Lord will send on you the disease of Egypt, and other sorts of skin diseases which nothing will make well.

chinese: 耶和華必用癲狂、眼瞎、心驚攻擊你。
english: He will make your minds diseased, and your eyes blind, and your hearts wasted with fear:

chinese: 你必在午間摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一樣。你所行的必不亨通，時常遭遇欺壓、搶奪，無人搭救。
english: You will go feeling your way when the sun is high, like a blind man for whom all is dark, and nothing will go well for you: you will be crushed and made poor for ever, and you will have no saviour.

chinese: 你聘定了妻，別人必與他同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其內；你栽種葡萄園，也不得用其中的果子。
english: You will take a wife, but another man will have the use of her: the house which your hands have made will never be your resting-place: you will make a vine-garden, and never take the fruit of it.

chinese: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃他的肉；你的驢在你眼前被搶奪，不得歸還；你的羊歸了仇敵，無人搭救。
english: Your ox will be put to death before your eyes, but its flesh will not be your food: your ass will be violently taken away before your face, and will not be given back to you: your sheep will be given to your haters, and there will be no saviour for you.

chinese: 你的兒女必歸與別國的民；你的眼目終日切望，甚至失明，你手中無力拯救。
english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people, and your eyes will be wasted away with looking and weeping for them all the day: and you will have no power to do anything.

chinese: 你的土產和你勞碌得來的，必被你所不認識的國民吃盡。你時常被欺負，受壓制，
english: The fruit of your land and all the work of your hands will be food for a nation which is strange to you and to your fathers; you will only be crushed down and kept under for ever:

chinese: 甚至你因眼中所看見的，必致瘋狂。
english: So that the things which your eyes have to see will send you out of your minds.

chinese: 耶和華必攻擊你，使你膝上腿上，從腳掌到頭頂，長毒瘡無法醫治。
english: The Lord will send a skin disease, attacking your knees and your legs, bursting out from your feet to the top of your head, so that nothing will make you well.

chinese: 耶和華必將你和你所立的王領到你和你列祖素不認識的國去；在那裡你必事奉木頭石頭的神。
english: And you, and the king whom you have put over you, will the Lord take away to a nation strange to you and to your fathers; there you will be servants to other gods of wood and stone.

chinese: 你在耶和華領你到的各國中，要令人驚駭、笑談、譏誚。
english: And you will become a wonder and a name of shame among all the nations where the Lord will take you.

chinese: 你帶到田間的種子雖多，收進來的卻少，因為被蝗蟲吃了。
english: You will take much seed out into the field, and get little in; for the locust will get it.

chinese: 你栽種、修理葡萄園，卻不得收葡萄，也不得喝葡萄酒，因為被蟲子吃了。
english: You will put in vines and take care of them, but you will get no wine or grapes from them; for they will be food for worms.

chinese: 你全境有橄欖樹，卻不得其油抹身，因為樹上的橄欖不熟自落了。
english: Your land will be full of olive-trees, but there will be no oil for the comfort of your body; for your olive-tree will give no fruit.

chinese: 你生兒養女，卻不算是你的，因為必被擄去。
english: You will have sons and daughters, but they will not be yours; for they will go away prisoners into a strange land.

chinese: 你所有的樹木和你地裡的出產必被蝗蟲所吃。
english: All your trees and the fruit of your land will be the locust's.

chinese: 在你中間寄居的，必漸漸上升，比你高而又高；你必漸漸下降，低而又低。
english: The man from a strange land who is living among you will be lifted up higher and higher over you, while you go down lower and lower.

chinese: 他必借給你，你卻不能借給他；他必作首，你必作尾。
english: He will let you have his wealth at interest, and will have no need of yours: he will be the head and you the tail.

chinese: 這一切咒詛必追隨你，趕上你，直到你滅亡；因為你不聽從耶和華─你神的話，不遵守他所吩咐的誡命律例。
english: And all these curses will come after you and overtake you, till your destruction is complete; because you did not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, or keep his laws and his orders which he gave you:

chinese: 這些咒詛必在你和你後裔的身上成為異蹟奇事，直到永遠！
english: These things will come on you and on your seed, to be a sign and a wonder for ever;

chinese: 因為你富有的時候，不歡心樂意的事奉耶和華─你的神，
english: Because you did not give honour to the Lord your God, worshipping him gladly, with joy in your hearts on account of all your wealth of good things;

chinese: 所以你必在飢餓、乾渴、赤露、缺乏之中事奉耶和華所打發來攻擊你的仇敵。他必把鐵軛加在你的頸項上，直到將你滅絕。
english: For this cause you will become servants to those whom the Lord your God will send against you, without food and drink and clothing, and in need of all things: and he will put a yoke of iron on your neck till he has put an end to you.

chinese: 耶和華要從遠方、地極帶一國的民，如鷹飛來攻擊你。這民的言語，你不懂得。
english: The Lord will send a nation against you from the farthest ends of the earth, coming with the flight of an eagle; a nation whose language is strange to you;

chinese: 這民的面貌凶惡，不顧恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。
english: A hard-faced nation, who will have no respect for the old or mercy for the young:

chinese: 他們必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所產的，直到你滅亡。你的五穀、新酒，和油，以及牛犢、羊羔，都不給你留下，直到將你滅絕。
english: He will take the fruit of your cattle and of your land till death puts an end to you: he will let you have nothing of your grain or wine or oil or any of the increase of your cattle or the young of your flock, till he has made your destruction complete.

chinese: 他們必將你困在你各}城裡，直到你所倚靠、高大堅固的城牆都被攻塌。他們必將你困在耶和華─你神所賜你遍地的各城裡。
