english: Your towns will be shut in by his armies, till your high walls, in which you put your faith, have come down: his armies will be round your towns, through all your land which the Lord your God has given you.

chinese: 你在仇敵圍困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和華─你神所賜給你的兒女之肉。
english: And your food will be the fruit of your body, the flesh of the sons and daughters which the Lord your God has given you; because of your bitter need and the cruel grip of your haters.

chinese: 你們中間，柔弱嬌嫩的人必惡眼看他弟兄和他懷中的妻，並他餘剩的兒女；
english: That man among you who is soft and used to comfort will be hard and cruel to his brother, and to his dear wife, and to of those his children who are still living;

chinese: 甚至在你受仇敵圍困窘迫的城中，他要吃兒女的肉，不肯分一點給他的親人，因為他一無所剩。
english: And will not give to any of them the flesh of his children which will be his food because he has no other; in the cruel grip of your haters on all your towns.

chinese: 你們中間，柔弱嬌嫩的婦人，是因嬌嫩柔弱不肯把腳踏地的，必惡眼看他懷中的丈夫和他的兒女。
english: The most soft and delicate of your women, who would not so much as put her foot on the earth, so delicate is she, will be hard-hearted to her husband and to her son and to her daughter;

chinese: 他兩腿中間出來的嬰孩與他所要生的兒女，他因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敵圍困窘迫的城中將他們暗暗地吃了。
english: And to her baby newly come to birth, and to the children of her body; for having no other food, she will make a meal of them secretly, because of her bitter need and the cruel grip of your haters on all your towns.

chinese: 這書上所寫律法的一切話是叫你敬畏耶和華─你神可榮可畏的名。你若不謹守遵行，耶和華就必將奇災，就是至大至長的災，至重至久的病，加在你和你後裔的身上，
english: If you will not take care to do all the words of this law, recorded in this book, honouring that name of glory and of fear, THE LORD YOUR GOD;
Then the Lord your God will make your punishment, and the punishment of your seed, a thing to be wondered at; great punishments and cruel diseases stretching on through long years.

chinese: 也必使你所懼怕、埃及人的病都臨到你，貼在你身上，
english: He will send on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which were a cause of fear to you, and they will take you in their grip.

chinese: 又必將沒有寫在這律法書上的各樣疾病、災殃降在你身上，直到你滅亡。
english: And all the diseases and the pains not recorded in the book of this law will the Lord send on you till your destruction is complete.

chinese: 你們先前雖然像天上的星那樣多，卻因不聽從耶和華─你神的話，所剩的人數就稀少了。
english: And you will become a very small band, though your numbers were like the stars of heaven; because you did not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God.

chinese: 先前耶和華怎樣喜悅善待你們，使你們眾多，也要照樣喜悅毀滅你們，使你們滅亡；並且你們從所要進去得的地上必被拔除。
english: And as the Lord took delight in doing you good and increasing you, so the Lord will take pleasure in cutting you off and causing your destruction, and you will be uprooted from the land which you are about to take as your heritage.

chinese: 耶和華必使你們分散在萬民中，從地這邊到地那邊，你必在那裡事奉你和你列祖素不認識、木頭石頭的神。
english: And the Lord will send you wandering among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other: there you will be servants to other gods, of wood and stone, gods of which you and your fathers had no knowledge.

chinese: 在那些國中，你必不得安逸，也不得落腳之地；耶和華卻使你在那裡心中跳動，眼目失明，精神消耗。
english: And even among these nations there will be no peace for you, and no rest for your feet: but the Lord will give you there a shaking heart and wasting eyes and weariness of soul:

chinese: 你的性命必懸懸無定；你晝夜恐懼，自料性命難保。
english: Your very life will be hanging in doubt before you, and day and night will be dark with fears, and nothing in life will be certain:

chinese: 你因心裡所恐懼的，眼中所看見的，早晨必說，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必說，巴不得到早晨才好。
english: In the morning you will say, If only it was evening! And at evening you will say, If only morning would come! Because of the fear in your hearts and the things which your eyes will see.

chinese: 耶和華必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告訴你不得再見的路；在那裡你必賣己身與仇敵作奴婢，卻無人買。
english: And the Lord will take you back to Egypt again in ships, by the way of which I said to you, You will never see it again: there you will be offering yourselves as men-servants and women-servants to your haters for a price, and no man will take you.

chinese: 這是耶和華在摩押地吩咐摩西與以色列人立約的話，是在他和他們於何烈山所立的約之外。
english: These are the words of the agreement which Moses was ordered by the Lord to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the agreement which he made with them in Horeb.

chinese: 摩西召了以色列眾人來，對他們說：耶和華在埃及地，在你們眼前向法老和他眾臣僕，並他全地所行的一切事，你們都看見了，
english: And Moses said in the hearing of all Israel, You have seen all the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants and all his land;

chinese: 就是你親眼看見的大試驗和神蹟，並那些大奇事。
english: The great tests which your eyes saw, and the signs and wonders:

chinese: 但耶和華到今日沒有使你們心能明白，眼能看見，耳能聽見。
english: But even to this day the Lord has not given you a mind open to knowledge, or seeing eyes or hearing ears.

chinese: 我領你們在曠野四十年，你們身上的衣服並沒有穿破，腳上的鞋也沒有穿壞。
english: For forty years I have been your guide through the waste land: your clothing has not become old on your backs, or your shoes on your feet.

chinese: 你們沒有吃餅，也沒有喝清酒濃酒。這要使你們知道，耶和華是你們的神。
english: You have had no bread, or wine, or strong drink: so that you might see that I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們來到這地方，希實本王西宏、巴珊王噩都出來與我們交戰，我們就擊殺了他們，
english: When you came to this place, Sihon, king of Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, came out to make war against us and we overcame them:

chinese: 取了他們的地給流便支派、迦得支派，和瑪拿西半支派為業。
english: And we took their land and gave it to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, for their heritage.

chinese: 所以你們要謹守遵行這約的話，好叫你們在一切所行的事上亨通。
english: So keep the words of this agreement and do them, so that it may be well for you in everything you do.

chinese: 今日，你們的首領、族長（原文作支派）、長老、官長、以色列的男丁，你們的妻子兒女，和營中寄居的，以及為你們劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和華─你們的神面前，
english: You have come here today, all of you, before the Lord your God; the heads of your tribes, the overseers, and those who are in authority over you, with all the men of Israel,
And your little ones, your wives, and the men of other lands who are with you in your tents, down to the wood-cutter and the servant who gets water for you:

chinese: 為要你順從耶和華─你神今日與你所立的約，向你所起的誓。
english: With the purpose of taking part in the agreement of the Lord your God, and his oath which he makes with you today:

chinese: 這樣，他要照他向你所應許的話，又向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的神。這樣，他要照他向你所應許的話，又向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的　神。
english: And so that he may make you his people today, and be your God, as he has said to you, and as he made an oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

chinese: 我不但與你們立這約，起這誓，
english: And not with you only do I make this agreement and this oath;

chinese: 凡與我們一同站在耶和華─我們神面前的，並今日不在我們這裡的人，我也與他們立這約，起這誓。
english: But with everyone who is here with us today before the Lord our God, as well as with those who are not here:

chinese: 我們曾住過埃及地，也從列國經過；這是你們知道的。
english: (For you have in mind how we were living in the land of Egypt; and how we came through all the nations which were on your way;

chinese: 你們也看見他們中間可憎之物，並他們木、石、金、銀的偶像。
english: And you have seen their disgusting doings, and the images of wood and stone and silver and gold which were among them:)

chinese: 惟恐你們中間，或男或女，或族長或支派長，今日心裡偏離耶和華─我們的神，去事奉那些國的　神；又怕你們中間有惡根生出苦菜和茵蔯來，
english: So that there may not be among you any man or woman or family or tribe whose heart is turned away from the Lord our God today, to go after other gods and give them worship; or any root among you whose fruit is poison and bitter sorrow;

chinese: 聽見這咒詛的話，心裡仍是自誇說：我雖然行事心裡頑梗，連累眾人，卻還是平安。
english: If such a man, hearing the words of this oath, takes comfort in the thought that he will have peace even if he goes on in the pride of his heart, taking whatever chance may give him:

chinese: 耶和華必不饒恕他；耶和華的怒氣與憤恨要向他發作，如煙冒出，將這書上所寫的一切咒詛都加在他身上。耶和華又要從天下塗抹他的名，
english: The Lord will have no mercy on him, but the wrath of the Lord will be burning against that man, and all the curses recorded in this book will be waiting for him, and the Lord will take away his name completely from the earth.

chinese: 也必照著寫在律法書上、約中的一切咒詛將他從以色列眾支派中分別出來，使他受禍。
english: He will be marked out by the Lord, from all the tribes of Israel, for an evil fate, in keeping with all the curses of the agreement recorded in this book of the law.

chinese: 你們的後代，就是以後興起來的子孫，和遠方來的外人，看見這地的災殃，並耶和華所降與這地的疾病，
english: And future generations, your children coming after you, and travellers from far countries, will say, when they see the punishments of that land and the diseases which the Lord has sent on it;

chinese: 又看見遍地有硫磺，有鹽鹵，有火跡，沒有耕種，沒有出產，連草都不生長─好像耶和華在忿怒中所傾覆的所多瑪、蛾摩拉、押瑪、洗扁一樣─
english: And that all the land is a salt and smoking waste, not planted or giving fruit or clothed with grass, but wasted like Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, on which the Lord sent destruction in the heat of his wrath:

chinese: 所看見的人，連萬國人，都必問說：耶和華為何向此地這樣行呢？這樣大發烈怒是甚麼意思呢？
english: Truly all the nations will say, Why has the Lord done so to this land? what is the reason for this great and burning wrath?

chinese: 人必回答說：是因這地的人離棄了耶和華─他們列祖的神，領他們出埃及地的時候與他們所立的約，
english: Then men will say, Because they gave up the agreement of the Lord, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he took them out of the land of Egypt:

chinese: 去事奉敬拜素不認識的別神，是耶和華所未曾給他們安排的。
english: And they went after other gods and gave them worship, gods who were strange to them, and whom he had not given them:

chinese: 所以耶和華的怒氣向這地發作，將這書上所寫的一切咒詛都降在這地上。
english: And so the wrath of the Lord was moved against this land, to send on it all the curse recorded in this book:

chinese: 耶和華在怒氣、忿怒、大惱恨中將他們從本地拔出來，扔在別的地上，像今日一樣。
english: Rooting them out of their land, in the heat of his wrath and passion, and driving them out into another land, as at this day.

chinese: 隱祕的事是屬耶和華─我們神的；惟有明顯的事是永遠屬我們和我們子孫的，好叫我們遵行這律法上的一切話。
english: The secret things are the Lord our God's: but the things which have been made clear are ours and our children's for ever, so that we may do all the words of this law.

chinese: 我所陳明在你面前的這一切咒詛都臨到你身上；你在耶和華─你神追趕你到的萬國中必心裡追念祝福的話；
english: Now when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse which I have put before you, if the thought of them comes back to your minds, when you are living among the nations where the Lord your God has sent you,

chinese: 你和你的子孫若盡心盡性歸向耶和華─你的神，照著我今日一切所吩咐的聽從他的話；
english: And your hearts are turned again to the Lord your God, and you give ear to his word which I give you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul:

chinese: 那時，耶和華─你的神必憐恤你，救回你這被擄的子民；耶和華─你的　神要回轉過來，從分散你到的萬民中將你招聚回來。
english: Then the Lord will have pity on you, changing your fate, and taking you back again from among all the nations where you have been forced to go.

chinese: 你被趕散的人，就是在天涯的，耶和華─你的神也必從那裡將你招聚回來。
english: Even if those who have been forced out are living in the farthest part of heaven, the Lord your God will go in search of you, and take you back;

chinese: 耶和華─你的神必領你進入你列祖所得的地，使你可以得著；又必善待你，使你的人數比你列祖眾多。
english: Placing you again in the land of your fathers as your heritage; and he will do you good, increasing you till you are more in number than your fathers were.

chinese: 耶和華─你神必將你心裡和你後裔心裡的污穢除掉，好叫你盡心盡性愛耶和華─你的　神，使你可以存活。
english: And the Lord your God will give to you and to your seed a circumcision of the heart, so that, loving him with all your heart and all your soul, you may have life.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神必將這一切咒詛加在你仇敵和恨惡你、逼迫你的人身上。
english: And the Lord your God will put all these curses on those who are against you, and on your haters who put a cruel yoke on you.

chinese: 你必歸回，聽從耶和華的話，遵行他的一切誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的。
english: And you will again give ear to the voice of the Lord, and do all his orders which I have given you today.

chinese: 你若聽從耶和華─你神的話，謹守這律法書上所寫的誡命律例，又盡心盡性歸向耶和華─你的　神，他必使你手裡所辦的一切事，並你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地土所產的，都綽綽有餘；因為耶和華必再喜悅你，降福與你，像從前喜悅你列祖一樣。
english: And the Lord your God will make you fertile in all good things, blessing the work of your hands, and the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your land: for the Lord will have joy in you, as he had in your fathers:

If you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, keeping his orders and his laws which are recorded in this book of the law, and turning to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

chinese: 我今日所吩咐你的誡命不是你難行的，也不是離你遠的；
english: For these orders which I have given you today are not strange and secret, and are not far away.

chinese: 不是在天上，使你說：誰替我們上天取下來，使我們聽見可以遵行呢？
english: They are not in heaven, for you to say, Who will go up to heaven for us and give us knowledge of them so that we may do them?

chinese: 也不是在海外，使你說：誰替我們過海取了來，使我們聽見可以遵行呢？
english: And they are not across the sea, for you to say, Who will go over the sea for us and give us news of them so that we may do them?

chinese: 這話卻離你甚近，就在你口中，在你心裡，使你可以遵行。
english: But the word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may do it.

chinese: 看哪，我今日將生與福，死與禍，陳明在你面前。
english: See, I have put before you today, life and good, and death and evil;

chinese: 吩咐你愛耶和華─你的神，遵行他的道，謹守他的誡命、律例、典章，使你可以存活，人數增多，耶和華─你　神就必在你所要進去得為業的地上賜福與你。
english: In giving you orders today to have love for the Lord your God, to go in his ways and keep his laws and his orders and his decisions, so that you may have life and be increased, and that the blessing of the Lord your God may be with you in the land where you are going, the land of your heritage.

chinese: 倘若你心裡偏離，不肯聽從，卻被勾引去敬拜事奉別神，
english: But if your heart is turned away and your ear is shut, and you go after those who would make you servants and worshippers of other gods:

chinese: 我今日明明告訴你們，你們必要滅亡；在你過約但河、進去得為業的地上，你的日子必不長久。
english: I give witness against you this day that destruction will certainly be your fate, and your days will be cut short in the land where you are going, the land of your heritage on the other side of Jordan.

chinese: 我今日呼天喚地向你作見證；我將生死禍福陳明在你面前，所以你要揀選生命，使你和你的後裔都得存活；
english: Let heaven and earth be my witnesses against you this day that I have put before you life and death, a blessing and a curse: so take life for yourselves and for your seed:

chinese: 且且愛耶和華─你的神，聽從他的話，專靠他；因為他是你的生命，你的日子長久也在乎他。這樣，你就可以在耶和華向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許所賜的地上居住。
english: In loving the Lord your God, hearing his voice and being true to him: for he is your life and by him will your days be long: so that you may go on living in the land which the Lord gave by an oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

chinese: 摩西去告訴以色列眾人
english: So Moses said all these things to Israel.

chinese: 說：我現在一百二十歲了，不能照常出入；耶和華也曾對我說：你必不得過這約但河。
english: Then he said to them, I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to go out and come in: and the Lord has said to me, You are not to go over Jordan.

chinese: 耶和華─你們的神必引導你們過去，將這些國民在你們面前滅絕，你們就得他們的地。約書亞必引導你們過去，正如耶和華所說的。
english: The Lord your God, he will go over before you; he will send destruction on all those nations, and you will take their land as your heritage: and Joshua will go over at your head as the Lord has said.

chinese: 耶和華必待他們，如同從前待他所滅絕的亞摩利二王西宏與噩以及他們的國一樣。
english: The Lord will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, whom he put to destruction.

chinese: 耶和華必將他們交給你們；你們要照我所吩咐的一切命令待他們。
english: The Lord will give them up into your hands, and you are to do to them as I have given you orders.

chinese: 你們當剛強壯膽，不要害怕，也不要畏懼他們，因為耶和華─你的神和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。
english: Be strong and take heart, and have no fear of them: for it is the Lord your God who is going with you; he will not take away his help from you.

chinese: 摩西召了約書亞來，在以色列眾人眼前對他說：你當剛強壯膽！因為，你要和這百姓一同進入耶和華向他們列祖起誓應許所賜之地；你也要使他們承受那地為業。
english: Then Moses sent for Joshua, and before the eyes of all Israel said to him, Be strong and take heart: for you are to go with this people into the land which the Lord, by his oath to their fathers, has given them; by your help they will take it for their heritage.

chinese: 耶和華必在你前面行；他必與你同在，必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。
english: It is the Lord who goes before you; he will be with you, he will not take away his help from you or give you up: so have no fear.

chinese: 摩西將這律法寫出來，交給抬耶和華約櫃的祭司利未子孫和以色列的眾長老。
english: Then Moses put all this law in writing, and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who take up the ark of the Lord's agreement, and to all the responsible men of Israel.

chinese: 摩西吩咐他們說：每逢七年的末一年，就在豁免年的定期住棚節的時候，
english: And Moses said to them, At the end of every seven years, at the time fixed for the ending of debts, at the feast of tents,

chinese: 以色列眾人來到耶和華─你神所選擇的地方朝見他。那時，你要在以色列眾人面前將這律法念給他們聽。
english: When all Israel has come before the Lord your God in the place named by him, let a reading be given of this law in the hearing of all Israel.

chinese: 要招聚他們男、女、孩子，並城裡寄居的，使他們聽，使他們學習，好敬畏耶和華─你們的神，謹守、遵行這律法的一切話，
english: Make all the people come together, men and women and children, and anyone from another country who is with you, so that hearing they may become wise in the fear of the Lord your God, and take care to do all the words of this law;

chinese: 也使他們未曾曉得這律法的兒女得以聽見，學習敬畏耶和華─你們的神，在你們過約但河要得為業之地，存活的日子，常常這樣行。
english: And so that your children, to whom it is new, may give ear and be trained in the fear of the Lord your God, while you are living in the land which you are going over Jordan to take for your heritage.

chinese: 耶和華對摩西說：你的死期臨近了；要召約書亞來，你們二人站在會幕裡，我好囑咐他。於是摩西和約書亞去站在會幕裡。
english: At that time the Lord said to Moses, The day of your death is near: send for Joshua, and come to the Tent of meeting so that I may give him his orders. So Moses and Joshua went to the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 耶和華在會幕裡雲柱中顯現，雲柱停在會幕門以上。
english: And the Lord was seen in the Tent in a pillar of cloud resting by the door of the Tent.

chinese: 耶和華又對摩西說：你必和你列祖同睡。這百姓要起來，在他們所要去的地上，在那地的人中，隨從外邦神行邪淫，離棄我，違背我與他們所立的約。
english: And the Lord said to Moses, Now you are going to rest with your fathers; and this people will be false to me, uniting themselves to the strange gods of the land where they are going; they will be turned away from me and will not keep the agreement I have made with them.

chinese: 那時，我的怒氣必向他們發作；我也必離棄他們，掩面不顧他們，以致他們被吞滅，並有許多的禍患災難臨到他們。那日他們必說：這些禍患臨到我們，豈不是因我們的神不在我們中間麼？
english: In that day my wrath will be moved against them, and I will be turned away from them, veiling my face from them, and destruction will overtake them, and unnumbered evils and troubles will come on them; so that in that day they will say, Have not these evils come on us because our God is not with us?

chinese: 那時，因他們偏向別神所行的一切惡，我必定掩面不顧他們。
english: Truly, my face will be turned away from them in that day, because of all the evil they have done in going after other gods.

chinese: 現在你要寫一篇歌，教導以色列人，傳給他們，使這歌見證他們的不是；
english: Make then this song for yourselves, teaching it to the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, so that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

chinese: 因為我將他們領進我向他們列祖起誓應許那流奶與蜜之地，他們在那裡吃得飽足，身體肥胖，就必偏向別神，事奉他們，藐視我，背棄我的約。
english: For when I have taken them into the land named in my oath to their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, and they have made themselves full of food and are fat, then they will be turned to other gods and will give them worship, no longer honouring me or keeping my agreement.

chinese: 那時，有許多禍患災難臨到他們，這歌必在他們面前作見證，他們後裔的口中必念誦不忘。我未領他們到我所起誓應許之地以先，他們所懷的意念我都知道了。
english: Then when evils and troubles without number have overtaken them, this song will be a witness to them, for the words of it will be clear in the memories of their children: for I see the thoughts which are moving in their hearts even now, before I have taken them into the land of my oath.

chinese: 當日摩西就寫了一篇歌，教導以色列人。
english: So that same day Moses made this song, teaching it to the children of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華囑咐嫩的兒子約書亞說：你當剛強壯膽，因為你必領以色列人進我所起誓應許他們的地；我必與你同在。
english: Then he gave orders to Joshua, the son of Nun, saying to him, Be strong and take heart: for you are to go at the head of the children of Israel into the land which I made an oath to give them; and I will be with you.

chinese: 摩西將這律法的話寫在書上，及至寫完了，
english: Now after writing all the words of this law in a book till the record of them was complete,

chinese: 就吩咐抬耶和華約櫃的利未人說：
english: Moses said to the Levites who were responsible for taking up the ark of the Lord's agreement,

chinese: 將這律法書放在耶和華─你們神的約櫃旁，可以在那裡見證以色列人的不是；
english: Take this book of the law and put it by the ark of the Lord's agreement, so that it may be a witness against you.

chinese: 因為我知道你們是悖逆的，是硬著頸項的。我今日還活著與你們同在，你們尚且悖逆耶和華，何況我死後呢？
english: For I have knowledge of your hard and uncontrolled hearts: even now, while I am still living, you will not be ruled by the Lord; how much less after my death?

chinese: 你們要將你們支派的眾長老和官長都招聚了來，我好將這些話說與他們聽，並呼天喚地見證他們的不是。
english: Get together before me all those who are in authority in your tribes, and your overseers, so that I may say these things in their hearing, and make heaven and earth my witnesses against them.

chinese: 我知道我死後，你們必全然敗壞，偏離我所吩咐你們的道，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，以手所做的惹他發怒；日後必有禍患臨到你們。
english: For I am certain that after my death you will give yourselves up to sin, wandering from the way which I have given you; and evil will overtake you in the end, because you will do evil in the eyes of the Lord, moving him to wrath by the work of your hands.

chinese: 摩西將這一篇歌的話都說與以色列全會眾聽。
english: Then in the hearing of all the meeting of Israel, Moses said the words of this song, to the end.

chinese: 諸天哪，側耳，我要說話；願地也聽我口中的言語。
english: Give ear, O heavens, to my voice; let the earth take note of the words of my mouth:

chinese: 我的教訓要淋漓如雨；我的言語要滴落如露，如細雨降在嫩草上，如甘霖降在菜蔬中。
english: My teaching is dropping like rain, coming down like dew on the fields; like rain on the young grass and showers on the garden plants:

chinese: 我要宣告耶和華的名；你們要將大德歸與我們的神。
english: For I will give honour to the name of the Lord: let our God be named great.

chinese: 他是磐石，他的作為完全；他所行的無不公平，是誠實無偽的神，又公義，又正直。
english: He is the Rock, complete is his work; for all his ways are righteousness: a God without evil who keeps faith, true and upright is he.

chinese: 這乖僻彎曲的世代向他行事邪僻；有這弊病就不是他的兒女。
english: They have become false, they are not his children, the mark of sin is on them; they are an evil and hard-hearted generation.

chinese: 愚昧無知的民哪，你們這樣報答耶和華麼？他豈不是你的父、將你買來的麼？他是製造你、建立你的。
english: Is this your answer to the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? Is he not your father who has given you life? He has made you and given you your place.

chinese: 你當追想上古之日，思念歷代之年；問你的父親，他必指示你；問你的長者，他必告訴你。
english: Keep in mind the days of the past, give thought to the years of generations gone by: go to your father and he will make it clear to you, to the old men and they will give you the story.

chinese: 至高者將地業賜給列邦，將世人分開，就照以色列人的數目立定萬民的疆界。
english: When the Most High gave the nations their heritage, separating into groups the children of men, he had the limits of the peoples marked out, keeping in mind the number of the children of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華的分本是他的百姓；他的產業本是雅各。
english: For the Lord's wealth is his people; Jacob is the land of his heritage.

chinese: 耶和華遇見他在曠野─荒涼野獸吼叫之地，就環繞他，看顧他，保護他，如同保護眼中的瞳人。
english: He came to him in the waste land, in the unpeopled waste of sand: putting his arms round him and caring for him, he kept him as the light of his eye.

chinese: 又如鷹攪動巢窩，在雛鷹以上兩翅搧展，接取雛鷹，背在兩翼之上。
english: As an eagle, teaching her young to make their flight, with her wings outstretched over them, takes them up on her strong feathers:

chinese: 這樣，耶和華獨自引導他，並無外邦神與他同在。
english: So the Lord only was his guide, no other god was with him.

chinese: 耶和華使他乘駕地的高處，得吃田間的土產；又使他從磐石中咂蜜，從堅石中吸油；
english: He put him on the high places of the earth, his food was the increase of the field; honey he gave him out of the rock and oil out of the hard rock;

chinese: 也吃牛的奶油，羊的奶，羊羔的脂油，巴珊所出的公綿羊和山羊，與上好的麥子，也喝葡萄汁釀的酒。
english: Butter from his cows and milk from his sheep, with fat of lambs and sheep of Bashan, and goats, and the heart of the grain; and for your drink, wine from the blood of the grape.

chinese: 但耶書崙漸漸肥胖，粗壯，光潤，踢跳，奔跑，便離棄造他的神，輕看救他的磐石；
english: But Jeshurun became fat and would not be controlled: you have become fat, you are thick and full of food: then he was untrue to the God who made him, giving no honour to the Rock of his salvation.

chinese: 敬拜別神，觸動神的憤恨，行可憎惡的事，惹了他的怒氣。
english: The honour which was his they gave to strange gods; by their disgusting ways he was moved to wrath.

chinese: 所祭祀的鬼魔並非真神，乃是素不認識的神，是近來新興的，是你列祖所不畏懼的。
english: They made offerings to evil spirits which were not God, to gods who were strange to them, which had newly come up, not feared by your fathers.

chinese: 你輕忽生你的磐石，忘記產你的神。
english: You have no thought for the Rock, your father, you have no memory of the God who gave you birth.

chinese: 耶和華看見他的兒女惹動他，就厭惡他們，說：
english: And the Lord saw with disgust the evil-doing of his sons and daughters.

chinese: 我要向他們掩面，看他們的結局如何。他們本是極乖僻的族類，心中無誠實的兒女。
english: And he said, My face will be veiled from them, I will see what their end will be: for they are an uncontrolled generation, children in whom is no faith.

chinese: 他們以那不算為神的觸動我的憤恨，以虛無的神惹了我的怒氣。我也要以那不成子民的觸動他們的憤恨，以愚昧的國民惹了他們的怒氣。
english: They have given my honour to that which is not God, moving me to wrath with their false worship: I will give their honour to those who are not a people, moving them to wrath by a foolish nation,

chinese: 因為在我怒中有火燒起，直燒到極深的陰間，把地和地的出產盡都焚燒，山的根基也燒著了。
english: For my wrath is a flaming fire, burning to the deep parts of the underworld, burning up the earth with her increase, and firing the deep roots of the mountains.

chinese: 我要將禍患堆在他們身上，把我的箭向他們射盡。
english: I will send a rain of troubles on them, my arrows will be showered on them.

chinese: 他們必因飢餓消瘦，被炎熱苦毒吞滅。我要打發野獸用牙齒咬他們，並土中腹行的，用毒氣害他們。
english: They will be wasted from need of food, and overcome by burning heat and bitter destruction; and the teeth of beasts I will send on them, with the poison of the worms of the dust.

chinese: 外頭有刀劍，內室有驚恐，使人喪亡，使少男、童女、吃奶的、白髮的，盡都滅絕。
english: Outside they will be cut off by the sword, and in the inner rooms by fear; death will take the young man and the virgin, the baby at the breast and the grey-haired man.

chinese: 我說，我必將他們分散遠方，使他們的名號從人間除滅。
english: I said I would send them wandering far away, I would make all memory of them go from the minds of men:

chinese: 惟恐仇敵惹動我，只怕敵人錯看，說：是我們手的能力，並非耶和華所行的。
english: But for the fear that their haters, uplifted in their pride, might say, Our hand is strong, the Lord has not done all this.

chinese: 因為以色列民毫無計謀，心中沒有聰明。
english: For they are a nation without wisdom; there is no sense in them.

chinese: 惟願他們有智慧，能明白這事，肯思念他們的結局。
english: If only they were wise, if only this was clear to them, and they would give thought to their future!

chinese: 若不是他們的磐石賣了他們，若不是耶和華交出他們，一人焉能追趕他們千人？二人焉能使萬人逃跑呢？
english: How would it be possible for one to overcome a thousand, and two to send ten thousand in flight, if their rock had not let them go, if the Lord had not given them up?

chinese: 據我們的仇敵自己斷定，他們的磐石不如我們的磐石。
english: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our haters themselves being judges.

chinese: 他們的葡萄樹是所多瑪的葡萄樹，蛾摩拉田園所生的；他們的葡萄是毒葡萄，全挂都是苦的。
english: For their vine is the vine of Sodom, from the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are the grapes of evil, and the berries are bitter:

chinese: 他們的酒是大蛇的毒氣，是虺蛇殘害的惡毒。
english: Their wine is the poison of dragons, the cruel poison of snakes.

chinese: 這不都是積蓄在我這裡，封鎖在我府庫中麼？
english: Is not this among my secrets, kept safe in my store-house?

chinese: 他們失腳的時候，伸冤報應在我；因他們遭災的日子近了；那要臨在他們身上的必速速來到。
english: Punishment is mine and reward, at the time of the slipping of their feet: for the day of their downfall is near, sudden will be their fate.

chinese: 耶和華見他百姓毫無能力，無論困住的、自由的都沒有剩下，就必為他們伸冤，為他的僕人後悔。
english: For the Lord will be judge of his people, he will have pity for his servants; when he sees that their power is gone, there is no one, shut up or free.

chinese: 他必說：他們的神，他們所投靠的磐石，
english: And he will say, Where are their gods, the rock in which they put their faith?

chinese: 就是向來吃他們祭牲的脂油，喝他們奠祭之酒的，在那裡呢？他可以興起幫助你們，護衛你們。
english: Who took the fat of their offerings, and the wine of their drink offering? Let them now come to your help, let them be your salvation.

chinese: 你們如今要知道：我，惟有我是神；在我以外並無別神。我使人死，我使人活；我損傷，我也醫治，並無人能從我手中救出來。
english: See now, I myself am he; there is no other god but me: giver of death and life, wounding and making well: and no one has power to make you free from my hand.

chinese: 我向天舉手說：我憑我的永生起誓：
english: For lifting up my hand to heaven I say, By my unending life,

chinese: 我若磨我閃亮的刀，手掌審判之權，就必報復我的敵人，報應恨我的人。
english: If I make sharp my shining sword, and my hand is outstretched for judging, I will give punishment to those who are against me, and their right reward to my haters.

chinese: 我要使我的箭飲血飲醉，就是被殺被擄之人的血。我的刀要吃肉，乃是仇敵中首領之頭的肉。
english: I will make my arrows red with blood, my sword will be feasting on flesh, with the blood of the dead and the prisoners, of the long-haired heads of my haters.

chinese: 你們外邦人當與主的百姓一同歡呼；因他要伸他僕人流血的冤，報應他的敵人，潔淨他的地，救贖他的百姓。
english: Be glad, O you his people, over the nations; for he will take payment for the blood of his servants, and will give punishment to his haters, and take away the sin of his land, for his people.

chinese: 摩西和嫩的兒子約書亞去將這歌的一切話說給百姓聽。
english: So Moses said all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Hoshea, the son of Nun.

chinese: 摩西向以色列眾人說完了這一切的話，
english: And after saying all this to the people,

chinese: 又說：我今日所警教你們的，你們都要放在心上；要吩咐你們的子孫謹守遵行這律法上的話。
english: Moses said to them, Let the words which I have said to you today go deep into your hearts, and give orders to your children to do every word of this law.

chinese: 因為這不是虛空、與你們無關的事，乃是你們的生命；在你們過約但河要得為業的地上必因這事日子得以長久。
english: And this is no small thing for you, but it is your life, and through this you may make your days long in the land which you are going over Jordan to take for your heritage.

chinese: 當日，耶和華吩咐摩西說：
english: That same day the Lord said to Moses,

chinese: 你上這亞巴琳山中的尼波山去，在摩押地與耶利哥相對，觀看我所要賜給以色列人為業的迦南地。
english: Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo in the land of Moab opposite Jericho; there you may see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel for their heritage:

chinese: 你必死在你所登的山上，歸你列祖（原文作本民）去，像你哥哥亞倫死在何珥山上，歸他的列祖一樣。
english: And let death come to you on the mountain where you are going, and be put to rest with your people; as death came to Aaron, your brother, on Mount Hor, where he was put to rest with his people:

chinese: 因為你們在尋的曠野，加低斯的米利巴水，在以色列人中沒有尊我為聖，得罪了我。
english: Because of your sin against me before the children of Israel at the waters of Meribath Kadesh in the waste land of Zin; because you did not keep my name holy among the children of Israel.

chinese: 我所賜給以色列人的地，你可以遠遠地觀看，卻不得進去。
english: So you will see the land before you, but you will not go into the land which I am giving to the children of Israel.

chinese: 以下是神人摩西在未死之先為以色列人所祝的福：
english: Now this is the blessing which Moses, the man of God, gave to the children of Israel before his death.

chinese: 他說：耶和華從西乃而來，從西珥向他們顯現，從巴蘭山發出光輝，從萬萬聖者中來臨，從他右手為百姓傳出烈火的律法。
english: He said, The Lord came from Sinai, dawning on them from Seir; shining out from Mount Paran, coming from Meribath Kadesh: from his right hand went flames of fire: his wrath made waste the peoples.

chinese: 他疼愛百姓；眾聖徒都在他手中。他們坐在他的腳下，領受他的言語。
english: All his holy ones are at his hand; they go at his feet; they are lifted up on his wings.

chinese: 摩西將律法傳給我們，作為雅各會眾的產業。
english: Moses gave us a law, a heritage for the people of Jacob.

chinese: 百姓的眾首領，以色列的各支派，一同聚會的時候，耶和華（原文作他）在耶書崙中為王。
english: And there was a king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel came together.

chinese: 願流便存活，不至死亡；願他人數不致稀少。
english: Let life not death be Reuben's, let not the number of his men be small.

chinese: 為猶大祝福說：求耶和華俯聽猶大的聲音，引導他歸於本族；他曾用手為自己爭戰，你必幫助他攻擊敵人。
english: And this is the blessing of Judah: he said, Give ear, O Lord, to the voice of Judah and make him one with his people: let your hands take up his cause, and be his help against his attackers.

chinese: 論利未說：耶和華阿，你的土明和烏陵都在你的虔誠人那裡。你在瑪撒曾試驗他，在米利巴水與他爭論。
english: And of Levi he said, Give your Thummim to Levi and let the Urim be with your loved one, whom you put to the test at Massah, with whom you were angry at the waters of Meribah;

chinese: 他論自己的父母說：我未曾看見；他也不承認弟兄，也不認識自己的兒女。這是因利未人遵行你的話，謹守你的約。
english: Who said of his father, Who is he? and of his mother, I have not seen her; he kept himself separate from his brothers and had no knowledge of his children: for they have given ear to your word and kept your agreement.

chinese: 他們要將你的典章教訓雅各，將你的律法教訓以色列。他們要把香焚在你面前，把全牲的燔祭獻在你的壇上。
english: They will be the teachers of your decisions to Jacob and of your law to Israel: the burning of perfumes before you will be their right, and the ordering of burned offerings on your altar.

chinese: 求耶和華降福在他的財物上，悅納他手裡所辦的事。那些起來攻擊他和恨惡他的人，願你刺透他們的腰，使他們不得再起來。
english: Let your blessing, O Lord, be on his substance, may the work of his hands be pleasing to you: may those who take up arms against him and all who have hate for him, be wounded through the heart, never to be lifted up again.

chinese: 論便雅憫說：耶和華所親愛的必同耶和華安然居住；耶和華終日遮蔽他，也住在他兩肩之中。
english: And of Benjamin he said, Benjamin is the loved one of the Lord, he will be kept safe at all times; he will be covered by the Most High, resting between his arms.

chinese: 論約瑟說：願他的地蒙耶和華賜福，得天上的寶物、甘露，以及地裡所藏的泉水；
english: And of Joseph he said, Let the blessing of the Lord be on his land; for the good things of heaven on high, and the deep waters flowing under the earth,

chinese: 得太陽所曬熟的美果，月亮所養成的寶物；
english: And the good things of the fruits of the sun, and the good things of the growth of the moons,

chinese: 得上古之山的至寶，永世之嶺的寶物；
english: And the chief things of the oldest mountains, and the good things of the eternal hills,

chinese: 得地和其中所充滿的寶物，並住荊棘中上主的喜悅。願這些福都歸於約瑟的頭上，歸於那與弟兄迥別之人的頂上。
english: The good things of the earth and all its wealth, the good pleasure of him who was seen in the burning tree: may they come on the head of Joseph, on the head of him who was prince among his brothers.

chinese: 他為牛群中頭生的，有威嚴；他的角是野牛的角，用以牴觸萬邦，直到地極。這角是以法蓮的萬萬，瑪拿西的千千。
english: He is a young ox, glory is his; his horns are the horns of the mountain ox, with which all peoples will be wounded, even to the ends of the earth: they are the ten thousands of Ephraim and the thousands of Manasseh.

chinese: 論西布倫說：西布倫哪，你出外可以歡喜。以薩迦阿，在你帳棚裡可以快樂。
english: And of Zebulun he said, Be glad, Zebulun, in your going out; and, Issachar, in your tents.

chinese: 他們要將列邦召到山上，在那裡獻公義的祭；因為他們要吸取海裡的豐富，並沙中所藏的珍寶。
english: They will send out the word for the people to come to the mountain, taking there the offerings of righteousness: for the store of the seas will be theirs, and the secret wealth of the sand.

chinese: 論迦得說：使迦得擴張的應當稱頌！迦得住如母獅；他撕裂膀臂，連頭頂也撕裂。
english: Of Gad he said, A blessing be on him who makes wide the limits of Gad: he takes his rest like a she-lion, taking for himself the arm and the crown of the head.

chinese: 他為自己選擇頭一段地，因在那裡有設立律法者的分存留。他與百姓的首領同來；他施行耶和華的公義和耶和華與以色列所立的典章。
english: He kept for himself the first part, for his was the ruler's right: he put in force the righteousness of the Lord, and his decisions for Israel.

chinese: 論但說：但為小獅子，從巴珊跳出來。
english: And of Dan he said, Dan is a young lion, springing out from Bashan.

chinese: 論拿弗他利說：拿弗他利阿，你足沾恩惠，滿得耶和華的福，可以得西方和南方為業。
english: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, made glad with grace and full of the blessing of the Lord: the sea and its fishes will be his.

chinese: 論亞設說：願亞設享受多子的福樂，得他弟兄的喜悅，可以把腳蘸在油中。
english: And of Asher he said, Let Asher have the blessing of children; may he be pleasing to his brothers, and let his foot be wet with oil.

chinese: 你的門閂（門閂或作：鞋）是銅的，鐵的。你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。
english: Your shoes will be iron and brass; and as your days, so may your work be.

chinese: 耶書崙哪，沒有能比神的。他為幫助你，乘在天空，顯其威榮，駕行穹蒼。
english: No other is like the God of Jeshurun, coming on the heavens to your help, and letting his glory be seen in the skies.

chinese: 永生的神是你的居所；他永久的膀臂在你以下。他在你前面攆出仇敵，說：毀滅罷。
english: The God of your fathers is your safe resting-place, and under you are his eternal arms: driving out the forces of your haters from before you, he said, Let destruction overtake them.

chinese: 以色列安然居住；雅各的本源獨居五穀新酒之地。他的天也滴甘露。
english: And Israel is living in peace, the fountain of Jacob by himself, in a land of grain and wine, with dew dropping from the heavens.

chinese: 以色列阿，你是有福的！誰像你這蒙耶和華所拯救的百姓呢？他是你的盾牌，幫助你，是你威榮的刀劍。你的仇敵必投降你；你必踏在他們的高處。
english: Happy are you, O Israel: who is like you, a people whose saviour is the Lord, whose help is your cover, whose sword is your strength! All those who are against you will put themselves under your rule, and your feet will be planted on their high places.

chinese: 摩西從摩押平原登尼波山，上了那與耶利哥相對的毘斯迦山頂。耶和華把基列全地直到但，
english: And Moses went up from the table-lands of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah which is facing Jericho. And the Lord let him see all the land, the land of Gilead as far as Dan;

chinese: 拿弗他利全地，以法蓮、瑪拿西的地，猶大全地直到西海，
english: And all Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, as far as the Great Sea of the west;

chinese: 南地和棕樹城耶利哥的平原，直到瑣珥，都指給他看。
english: And the South, and the circle of the valley of Jericho, the town of palm-trees, as far as Zoar.

chinese: 耶和華對他說：這就是我向亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許之地，說：我必將這地賜給你的後裔。現在我使你眼睛看見了，你卻不得過到那裡去。
english: And the Lord said to him, This is the land about which I made an oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, I will give it to your seed: now I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not go in there.

chinese: 於是，耶和華的僕人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和華所說的。
english: So death came to Moses, the servant of the Lord, there in the land of Moab, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 耶和華將他埋葬在摩押地、伯毘珥對面的谷中，只是到今日沒有人知道他的墳墓。
english: And the Lord put him to rest in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth-peor: but no man has knowledge of his resting-place to this day.

chinese: 摩西死的時候年一百二十歲；眼目沒有昏花，精神沒有衰敗。
english: And Moses at his death was a hundred and twenty years old: his eye had not become clouded, or his natural force become feeble.

chinese: 以色列人在摩押平原為摩西哀哭了三十日，為摩西居喪哀哭的日子就滿了。
english: For thirty days the children of Israel were weeping for Moses in the table-lands of Moab, till the days of weeping and sorrow for Moses were ended.

chinese: 嫩的兒子約書亞；因為摩西曾按手在他頭上，就被智慧的靈充滿，以色列人便聽從他，照著耶和華吩咐摩西的行了。
english: And Joshua, the son of Nun, was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had put his hands on him: and the children of Israel gave ear to him, and did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 以後以色列中再沒有興起先知像摩西的。他是耶和華面對面所認識的。
english: There has never been another prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord had knowledge of face to face;

chinese: 耶和華打發他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣僕，並他的全地，行各樣神蹟奇事，
english: In all the signs and wonders which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to all his servants and all his land;

chinese: 又在以色列.眾人眼前顯大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。
english: And in all the acts of power and fear which Moses did before the eyes of all Israel.

chinese: 耶和華的僕人摩西死了以後，耶和華曉諭摩西的幫手，嫩的兒子約書亞，說：
english: Now after the death of Moses, the servant of the Lord, the word of the Lord came to Joshua, the son of Nun, Moses' helper, saying,

chinese: 我的僕人摩西死了。現在你要起來，和眾百姓過這約但河，往我所要賜給以色列人的地去。
english: Moses my servant is dead; so now get up! Go over Jordan, you and all this people, into the land which I am giving to them, to the children of Israel.

chinese: 凡你們腳掌所踏之地，我都照著我所應許摩西的話賜給你們了。
english: Every place on which you put your foot I have given to you, as I said to Moses.

chinese: 從曠野和這利巴嫩，直到伯拉大河，赫人的全地，又到大海日落之處，都要作你們的境界。
english: From the waste land and this mountain Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, and all the land of the Hittites to the Great Sea, in the west, will be your country.

chinese: 你平生的日子，必無一人能在你面前站立得住。我怎樣與摩西同在，也必照樣與你同在；我必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。
english: While you are living, all will give way before you: as I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will not take away my help from you or give you up.

chinese: 你當剛強壯膽！因為你必使這百姓承受那地為業，就是我向他們列祖起誓應許賜給他們的地。
english: Take heart and be strong; for you will give to this people for their heritage the land which I gave by an oath to their fathers.

chinese: 只要剛強，大大壯膽，謹守遵行我僕人摩西所吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏離左右，使你無論往那裡去，都可以順利。
english: Only take heart and be very strong; take care to do all the law which Moses my servant gave you, not turning from it to the right hand or to the left, so that you may do well in all your undertakings.

chinese: 這律法書不可離開你的口，總要晝夜思想，好使你謹守遵行這書上所寫的一切話。如此，你的道路就可以亨通，凡事順利。
english: Let this book of the law be ever on your lips and in your thoughts day and night, so that you may keep with care everything in it; then a blessing will be on all your way, and you will do well.

chinese: 我豈沒有吩咐你麼？你當剛強壯膽！不要懼怕，也不要驚惶；因為你無論往那裡去，耶和華─你的神必與你同在。
english: Have I not given you your orders? Take heart and be strong; have no fear and do not be troubled; for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go,

chinese: 於是，約書亞吩咐百姓的官長說：
english: Then Joshua gave their orders to those who were in authority over the people, saying,

chinese: 你們要走遍營中，吩咐百姓說：當預備食物；因為三日之內你們要過這約但河，進去得耶和華─你們神賜你們為業之地。
english: Go through the tents and give orders to the people, saying, Get ready a store of food; for in three days you are to go over this river Jordan and take for your heritage the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

chinese: 約書亞對流便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人說：
english: And to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,

chinese: 你們要追念耶和華的僕人摩西所吩咐你們的話說：耶和華─你們的神使你們得享平安，也必將這地賜給你們。
english: Keep in mind what Moses, the servant of the Lord, said to you, The Lord your God is sending you rest and will give you this land.

chinese: 你們的妻子、孩子，和牲畜都可以留在約但河東、摩西所給你們的地；但你們中間一切大能的勇士都要帶著兵器在你們的弟兄前面過去，幫助他們，
english: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle will be kept here in the land which Moses gave you on this side of Jordan; but you, the fighting-men, are to go over before your brothers, armed, to give them help;

chinese: 等到耶和華使你們的弟兄像你們一樣得享平安，並且得著耶和華─你們神所賜他們為業之地，那時才可以回你們所得之地，承受為業，就是耶和華的僕人摩西在約但河東、向日出之地所給你們的。
english: Till the Lord has given your brothers rest, as he has given it to you, and they have taken their heritage in the land which the Lord your God is giving them: then you will go back to the land of your heritage which Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave you on the east side of Jordan.

chinese: 他們回答約書亞說：你所吩咐我們行的，我們都必行；你所差遣我們去的，我們都必去。
english: Then they said to Joshua in answer, Whatever you say to us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

chinese: 我們從前在一切事上怎樣聽從摩西，現在也必照樣聽從你；惟願耶和華─你的神與你同在，像與摩西同在一樣。
english: As we gave attention to Moses in all things, so we will give attention to you: and may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.

chinese: 無論甚麼人違背你的命令，不聽從你所吩咐他的一切話，就必治死他。你只要剛強壯膽！
english: Whoever goes against your orders, and does not give attention to all your words, will be put to death: only take heart and be strong.

chinese: 當下，嫩的兒子約書亞從什亭暗暗打發兩個人作探子，吩咐說：你們去窺探那地和耶利哥。於是二人去了，來到一個妓女名叫喇合的家裡，就在那裡躺臥。
english: Then Joshua, the son of Nun, sent two men from Shittim secretly, with the purpose of searching out the land, and Jericho. So they went and came to the house of a loose woman of the town, named Rahab, where they took their rest for the night.

chinese: 有人告訴耶利哥王說：今夜有以色列人來到這裡窺探此地。
english: And it was said to the king of Jericho, See, some men have come here tonight from the children of Israel with the purpose of searching out the land.

chinese: 耶利哥王打發人去見喇合說：那來到你這裡、進了你家的人要交出來，因為他們來窺探全地。
english: Then the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, Send out the men who have come to you and are in your house; for they have come with the purpose of searching out all the land.

chinese: 女人將二人隱藏，就回答說：那人果然到我這裡來；他們是那裡來的我卻不知道。
english: And the woman took the two men and put them in a secret place; then she said, Yes, the men came to me, but I had no idea where they came from;

chinese: 天黑、要關城門的時候，他們出去了，往那裡去我卻不知道。你們快快的去追趕，就必追上。
english: And when it was the time for shutting the doors at dark, they went out; I have no idea where the men went: but if you go after them quickly, you will overtake them.

chinese: （先是女人領二人上了房頂，將他們藏在那裡所擺的麻中。）
english: But she had taken them up to the roof, covering them with the stems of flax which she had put out in order there.

chinese: 那些人就往約但河的渡口追趕他們去了。追趕他們的人一出去，城門就關了。
english: So the men went after them on the road to Jordan as far as the river-crossing: and when they had gone out after them, the door into the town was shut.

chinese: 二人還沒有躺臥，女人就上房頂，到他們那裡，
english: And before the men went to rest, she came up to them on the roof,

chinese: 對他們說：我知道耶和華已經把這地賜給你們，並且因你們的緣故我們都驚慌了。這地的一切居民在你們面前心都消化了；
english: And said to them, It is clear to me that the Lord has given you the land, and that the fear of you has come on us;

chinese: 因為我們聽見你們出埃及的時候，耶和華怎樣在你們前面使紅海的水乾了，並且你們怎樣待約但河東的兩個亞摩利王西宏和噩，將他們盡行毀滅。
english: For we have had news of how the Lord made the Red Sea dry before you when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, on the other side of Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you gave up to the curse.

chinese: 我們一聽見這些事，心就消化了。因你們的緣故，並無一人有膽氣。耶和華─你們的神本是上天下地的　神。
english: And because of this news, our hearts became like water, and there was no more spirit in any of us because of you; for the Lord your God is God in heaven on high and here on earth.

chinese: 現在我既是恩待你們，求你們指著耶和華向我起誓，也要恩待我父家，並給我一個實在的證據，
english: So now, will you give me your oath by the Lord, that, because I have been kind to you, you will be kind to my father's house,

chinese: 要救活我的父母、弟兄、姊妹，和一切屬他們的，拯救我們性命不死。
english: And that you will keep safe my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and all they have, so that death may not come on us?

chinese: 二人對他說：你若不洩漏我們這件事，我們情願替你們死。耶和華將這地賜給我們的時候，我們必以慈愛誠實待你。
english: And the men said to her, Our life for yours if you keep our business secret; and when the Lord has given us the land, we will keep faith and be kind to you.

chinese: 於是女人用繩子將二人從窗戶裡縋下去；因他的房子是在城牆邊上，他也住在城牆上。
english: Then she let them down from the window by a cord, for the house where she was living was on the town wall.

chinese: 他對他們說：你們且往山上去，恐怕追趕的人碰見你們；要在那裡隱藏三天，等追趕的人回來，然後才可以走你們的路。
english: And she said to them, Get away into the hill-country, or the men who have gone after you will overtake you; keep yourselves safe there for three days, till the searchers have come back, and then go on your way.

chinese: 二人對他說：你要這樣行。不然，你叫我們所起的誓就與我們無干了。
english: And the men said to her, We will only be responsible for this oath which you have made us take,

chinese: 我們來到這地的時候，你要把這條朱紅線繩繫在縋我們下去的窗戶上，並要使你的父母、弟兄，和你父的全家都聚集在你家中。
english: If, when we come into the land, you put this cord of bright red thread in the window from which you let us down; and get your father and mother and your brothers and all your family into the house;

chinese: 凡出了你家門往街上去的，他的罪（原文是血）必歸到自己的頭上，與我們無干了。凡在你家裡的，若有人下手害他，流他血的罪就歸到我們的頭上。
english: Then if anyone goes out of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, we will not be responsible; but if any damage comes to anyone in the house, his blood will be on our heads.

chinese: 你若洩漏我們這件事，你叫我們所起的誓就與我們無干了。
english: But if you say anything about our business here, then we will be free from the oath you have made us take.

chinese: 女人說：照你們的話行罷！於是打發他們去了，又把朱紅線繩繫在窗戶上。
english: And she said, Let it be as you say. Then she sent them away, and they went; and she put the bright red cord in the window.

chinese: 二人到山上，在那裡住了三天，等著追趕的人回去了。追趕的人一路找他們，卻找不著。
english: And they went into the hill-country and were there three days, till the men who had gone after them had come back; and those who went after them were searching for them everywhere without coming across them.

chinese: 二人就下山回來，過了河，到嫩的兒子約書亞那裡，向他述說所遭遇的一切事；
english: Then the two men came down from the hill-country and went over and came back to Joshua, the son of Nun; and they gave him a complete account of what had taken place.

chinese: 又對約書亞說：耶和華果然將那全地交在我們手中；那地的一切居民在我們面前心都消化了。
english: And they said to Joshua, Truly, the Lord has given all the land into our hands; and all the people of the land have become like water because of us.

chinese: 約書亞清早起來，和以色列眾人都離開什亭，來到約但河，就住在那裡，等候過河。
english: Then Joshua got up early in the morning, and, moving on from Shittim, he and all the children of Israel came to Jordan and were there for the night before going over.

chinese: 過了三天，官長走遍營中，
english: And at the end of three days, the men in authority over the people went through the tents,

chinese: 吩咐百姓說：你們看見耶和華─你們神的約櫃，又見祭司利未人抬著，就要離開所住的地方，跟著約櫃去。
english: Giving the people their orders, and saying, When you see the ark of the agreement of the Lord your God lifted up by the priests, the Levites, then get up from your places and go after it;

chinese: 只是你們和約櫃相離要量二千肘，不可與約櫃相近，使你們知道所當走的路，因為這條路你們向來沒有走過。
english: But let there be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits: come no nearer to it, so that you may see the way you have to go, for you have not been over this way before.

chinese: 約書亞吩咐百姓說：你們要自潔，因為明天耶和華必在你們中間行奇事。
english: And Joshua said to the people, Make yourselves holy, for tomorrow the Lord will do works of wonder among you.

chinese: 約書亞又吩咐祭司說：你們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭過去。於是他們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭走。
english: Then Joshua said to the priests, Take up the ark of the agreement and go over in front of the people. So they took up the ark of the agreement and went in front of the people.

chinese: 耶和華對約書亞說：從今日起，我必使你在以色列眾人眼前尊大，使他們知道我怎樣與摩西同在，也必照樣與你同在。
english: And the Lord said to Joshua, From now on I will give you glory in the eyes of all Israel, so that they may see that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

chinese: 你要吩咐抬約櫃的祭司說：你們到了約但河的水邊上，就要在約但河水裡站住。
english: And you are to give orders to the priests who take up the ark of the agreement, and say, When you come to the edge of the waters of Jordan, go no further.

chinese: 約書亞對以色列人說：你們近前來，聽耶和華─你們神的話。
english: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, Come to me here: and give ear to the words of the Lord your God.

chinese: 約書亞說：看哪，普天下主的約櫃必在你們前頭過去，到約但河裡，因此你們就知道在你們中間有永生神；並且他必在你們面前趕出迦南人、赫人、希未人、比利洗人、革迦撒人、亞摩利人、耶布斯人。
english: And Joshua said, By this you will see that the living God is among you, and that he will certainly send out from before you the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Hivite and the Perizzite and the Girgashite and the Amorite and the Jebusite.
See, the ark of the agreement of the Lord of all the earth is going over before you into Jordan.

chinese: 你們現在要從以色列支派中揀選十二個人，每支派一人，
english: So take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, a man from every tribe.

chinese: 等到抬普天下主耶和華約櫃的祭司把腳站在約但河水裡，約但河的水，就是從上往下流的水，必然斷絕，立起成壘。
english: And when the feet of the priests who take up the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, come to rest in the waters of Jordan, the waters of Jordan will be cut off, all the waters flowing down from higher up, and will come together in a mass.

chinese: 百姓離開帳棚要過約但河的時候，抬約櫃的祭司乃在百姓的前頭。
english: So when the people went out from their tents to go over Jordan, the priests who took up the ark of the agreement were in front of the people;

chinese: 他們到了約但河，腳一入水（原來約但河水在收割的日子漲過兩岸），
english: And when those who took up the ark came to Jordan, and the feet of the priests who took up the ark were touching the edge of the water (for the waters of Jordan are overflowing all through the time of the grain-cutting),

chinese: 那從上往下流的水便在極遠之地、撒拉但旁的亞當城那裡停住，立起成壘；那往亞拉巴的海，就是鹽海，下流的水全然斷絕。於是百姓在耶利哥的對面過去了。
english: Then the waters flowing down from higher up were stopped and came together in a mass a long way back at Adam, a town near Zarethan; and the waters flowing down to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, were cut off: and the people went across opposite Jericho.

chinese: 抬耶和華約櫃的祭司在約但河中的乾地上站定，以色列眾人都從乾地上過去，直到國民盡都過了約但河。
english: And the priests who took up the ark of the agreement of the Lord kept their places, with their feet on dry land in the middle of Jordan, while all Israel went over on dry land, till all the nation had gone over Jordan.

chinese: 國民盡都過了約但河，耶和華就對約書亞說：
english: Now when all the nation had come to the other side of Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua,

chinese: 你從民中要揀選十二個人，每支派一人，
english: Take twelve men from the people, a man for every tribe,

chinese: 吩咐他們說：你們從這裡，從約但河中、祭司腳站定的地方，取十二塊石頭帶過去，放在你們今夜要住宿的地方。
english: And say to them, Take up from the middle of Jordan, from the place where the feet of the priests were resting, twelve stones, and take them over with you and put them down in the place where you take your rest tonight.

chinese: 於是，約書亞將他從以色列人中所預備的那十二個人，每支派一人，都召了來。
english: So Joshua sent for the twelve men, whom he had ready, one man out of every tribe of the children of Israel,

chinese: 對他們說：你們下約但河中，過到耶和華─你們神的約櫃前頭，按著以色列人十二支派的數目，每人取一塊石頭扛在肩上。
english: And he said to them, Go over before the ark of the Lord your God into the middle of Jordan, and let every one of you take up a stone on his back, one for every tribe of the children of Israel:

chinese: 這些石頭在你們中間可以作為證據。日後，你們的子孫問你們說：這些石頭是甚麼意思？
english: So that this may be a sign among you; when your children say to you in time to come, What is the reason for these stones?

chinese: 你們就對他們說：這是因為約但河的水在耶和華的約櫃前斷絕；約櫃過約但河的時候，約但河的水就斷絕了。這些石頭要作以色列人永遠的紀念。
english: Then you will say to them, Because the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the Lord's agreement; when it went over Jordan the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones will be a sign for the children of Israel, keeping it in their memory for ever.

chinese: 以色列人就照約書亞所吩咐的，按著以色列人支派的數目，從約但河中取了十二塊石頭，都遵耶和華所吩咐約書亞的行了。他們把石頭帶過去，到他們所住宿的地方，就放在那裡。
english: So the children of Israel did as Joshua gave them orders, and took twelve stones from the middle of Jordan, as the Lord had said to Joshua, one for every tribe of the children of Israel; these they took across with them to their night's resting-place and put them down there.

chinese: 約書亞另把十二塊石頭立在約但河中，在抬約櫃的祭司腳站立的地方；直到今日，那石頭還在那裡。
english: And Joshua put up twelve stones in the middle of Jordan, where the feet of the priests who took up the ark of the agreement had been placed: and there they are to this day.

chinese: 抬約櫃的祭司站在約但河中，等到耶和華曉諭約書亞吩咐百姓的事辦完了，是照摩西所吩咐約書亞的一切話。於是百姓急速過去了。
english: For the priests who took up the ark kept there in the middle of Jordan till all the orders given to Joshua by Moses from the Lord had been done: then the people went over quickly.

chinese: 眾百姓盡都過了河，耶和華的約櫃和祭司就在百姓面前過去。
english: And when all the people had come to the other side, the ark of the Lord went over, and the priests, before the eyes of the people.

chinese: 流便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人都照摩西所吩咐他們的，帶著兵器在以色列人前頭過去。
english: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh went over armed before the children of Israel as Moses had said to them:

chinese: 約有四萬人都準備打仗，在耶和華面前過去，到耶利哥的平原，等候上陣。
english: About forty thousand armed for war went over before the Lord to the fight, to the lowlands of Jericho.

chinese: 當那日，耶和華使約書亞在以色列眾人眼前尊大。在他平生的日子，百姓敬畏他，像從前敬畏摩西一樣。
english: That day the Lord made Joshua great in the eyes of all Israel; and all the days of his life they went in fear of him, as they had gone in fear of Moses.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭約書亞說：
english: Then the Lord said to Joshua,

chinese: 你吩咐抬法櫃的祭司從約但河裡上來。
english: Give orders to the priests who take up the ark of witness, to come up out of Jordan.

chinese: 約書亞就吩咐祭司說：你們從約但河裡上來。
english: So Joshua gave orders to the priests, saying, Come up now out of Jordan.

chinese: 抬耶和華約櫃的祭司從約但河裡上來，腳掌剛落旱地，約但河的水就流到原處，仍舊漲過兩岸。
english: And when the priests who took up the ark of the Lord's agreement came up out of Jordan and their feet came out on to dry land, the waters of Jordan went back to their place, overflowing its edges as before.

chinese: 正月初十日，百姓從約但河裡上來，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的東邊安營。
english: So on the tenth day of the first month the people came up out of Jordan, and put up their tents in Gilgal, on the east side of Jericho.

chinese: 他們從約但河中取來的那十二塊石頭，約書亞就立在吉甲，
english: And the twelve stones which they took out of Jordan, Joshua put up in Gilgal.

chinese: 對以色列人說：日後你們的子孫問他們的父親說：這些石頭是甚麼意思？
english: And he said to the children of Israel, When your children say to their fathers in time to come, What is the reason for these stones?

chinese: 你們就告訴他們說：以色列人曾走乾地過這約但河；
english: Then give your children the story, and say, Israel came over this river Jordan on dry land.

chinese: 因為耶和華─你們的神在你們前面使約但河的水乾了，等著你們過來，就如耶和華─你們的　神從前在我們前面使紅海乾了，等著我們過來一樣，
english: For the Lord your God made the waters of Jordan dry before you till you had gone across, as he did to the Red Sea, drying it up before us till we had gone across:

chinese: 要使地上萬民都知道，耶和華的手大有能力，也要使你們永遠敬畏耶和華─你們的神。
english: So that all the peoples of the earth may see that the hand of the Lord is strong; and that they may go in fear of the Lord your God for ever.

chinese: 約但河西亞摩利人的諸王和靠海迦南人的諸王，聽見耶和華在以色列人前面使約但河的水乾了，等到我們過去，他們的心因以色列人的緣故就消化了，不再有膽氣。
english: Now when the news came to all the kings of the Amorites on the west side of Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites living by the sea, how the Lord had made the waters of Jordan dry before the children of Israel, till they had gone across, their hearts became like water, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

chinese: 那時，耶和華吩咐約書亞說：你製造火石刀，第二次給以色列人行割禮。
english: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, Make yourself stone knives and give the children of Israel circumcision a second time.

chinese: 約書亞就製造了火石刀，在除皮山那裡給以色列人行割禮。
english: So Joshua made stone knives and gave the children of Israel circumcision at Gibeath-ha-araloth.

chinese: 約書亞行割禮的緣故，是因為從埃及出來的眾民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以後，都死在曠野的路上。
english: And this is the reason why Joshua did so: all the males of the people who came out of Egypt, all the fighting-men, had been overtaken by death in the waste land on the way, after they came out of Egypt.

chinese: 因為出來的眾民都受過割禮；惟獨出埃及以後、在曠野的路上所生的眾民都沒有受過割禮。
english: All the people who came out had undergone circumcision; but all the people whose birth had taken place in the waste land on their journey from Egypt had not.

chinese: 以色列人在曠野走了四十年，等到國民，就是出埃及的兵丁，都消滅了，因為他們沒有聽從耶和華的話。耶和華曾向他們起誓，必不容他們看見耶和華向他們列祖起誓、應許賜給我們的地，就是流奶與蜜之地。
english: For the children of Israel were wandering in the waste land for forty years, till all the nation, that is, all the fighting-men, who had come out of Egypt, were dead, because they did not give ear to the voice of the Lord: to whom the Lord said, with an oath, that he would not let them see the land which the Lord had given his word to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

chinese: 他們的子孫，就是耶和華所興起來接續他們的，都沒有受過割禮；因為在路上沒有給他們行割禮，約書亞這才給他們行了。
english: And their children, who came up in their place, now underwent circumcision by the hands of Joshua, not having had it before: for there had been no circumcision on the journey.

chinese: 國民都受完了割禮，就住在營中自己的地方，等到痊愈了。
english: So when all the nation had undergone circumcision, they kept in their tents till they were well again.

chinese: 耶和華對約書亞說：我今日將埃及的羞辱從你們身上輥去了。因此，那地方名叫吉甲（吉甲就是輥的意思），直到今日。
english: And the Lord said to Joshua, Today the shame of Egypt has been rolled away from you. So that place was named Gilgal, to this day.

chinese: 以色列人在吉甲安營。正月十四日晚上，在耶利哥的平原守逾越節。
english: So the children of Israel put up their tents in Gilgal; and they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month, in the evening, in the lowlands of Jericho.

chinese: 逾越節的次日，他們就吃了那地的出產；正當那日吃無酵餅和烘的穀。
english: And on the day after the Passover, they had for their food the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and dry grain on the same day.

chinese: 他們吃了那地的出產，第二日嗎哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有嗎哪了。那一年，他們卻吃迦南地的出產。
english: And there was no more manna from the day after they had for their food the produce of the land; the children of Israel had manna no longer, but that year the produce of the land of Canaan was their food.

chinese: 約書亞靠近耶利哥的時候，舉目觀看，不料，有一個人手裡有拔出來的刀，對面站立。約書亞到他那裡，問他說：你是幫助我們呢，是幫助我們敵人呢？
english: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, lifting up his eyes he saw a man in front of him, with his sword uncovered in his hand: and Joshua went up to him and said, Are you for us or against us?

chinese: 他回答說：不是的，我來是要作耶和華軍隊的元帥。約書亞就俯伏在地下拜，說：我主有甚麼話吩咐僕人。
english: And he said, No; but I have come as captain of the armies of the Lord. Then Joshua, falling down with his face to the earth in worship, said, What has my lord to say to his servant?

chinese: 耶和華軍隊的元帥對約書亞說：把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站的地方是聖的。約書亞就照著行了。
english: And the captain of the Lord's army said to Joshua, Take off your shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy. And Joshua did so.

chinese: 耶利哥的城門因以色列人就關得嚴緊，無人出入。
english: (Now Jericho was all shut up because of the children of Israel: there was no going out or coming in.)

chinese: 耶和華曉諭約書亞說：看哪，我已經把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，並大能的勇士，都交在你手中。
english: And the Lord said to Joshua, See, I have given into your hands Jericho with its king and all its men of war.

chinese: 你們的一切兵丁要圍繞這城，一日圍繞一次，六日都要這樣行。
english: Now let all your fighting-men make a circle round the town, going all round it once. Do this for six days.

chinese: 七個祭司要拿七個羊角走在約櫃前。到第七日，你們要繞城七次，祭司也要吹角。
english: And let seven priests go before the ark with seven loud-sounding horns in their hands: on the seventh day you are to go round the town seven times, the priests blowing their horns.

chinese: 他們吹的角聲拖長，你們聽見角聲，眾百姓要大聲呼喊，城牆就必塌陷，各人都要往前直上。
english: And at the sound of a long note on the horns, let all the people give a loud cry; and the wall of the town will come down flat, and all the people are to go straight forward.

chinese: 嫩的兒子約書亞召了祭司來，吩咐他們說：你們抬起約櫃來，要有七個祭司拿七個羊角走在耶和華的約櫃前；
english: Then Joshua, the son of Nun, sent for the priests and said to them, Take up the ark of the agreement, and let seven priests take seven horns in their hands and go before the ark of the Lord.

chinese: 又對百姓說：你們前去繞城，帶兵器的要走在耶和華的約櫃前。
english: And he said to the people, Go forward, circling the town, and let the armed men go before the ark of the Lord.

chinese: 約書亞對百姓說完了話，七個祭司拿七個羊角走在耶和華面前吹角；耶和華的約櫃在他們後面跟隨。
english: So after Joshua had said this to the people, the seven priests with their seven horns went forward before the Lord, blowing on their horns: and the ark of the Lord's agreement went after them.

chinese: 帶兵器的走在吹角的祭司前面，後隊隨著約櫃行。祭司一面走一面吹。
english: And the armed men went before the priests who were blowing the horns, and the mass of the people went after the ark, blowing their horns.

chinese: 約書亞吩咐百姓說：你們不可呼喊，不可出聲，連一句話也不可出你們的口，等到我吩咐你們呼喊的日子，那時才可以呼喊。
english: And to the people Joshua gave an order, saying, You will give no cry, and make no sound, and let no word go out of your mouth till the day when I say, Give a loud cry; then give a loud cry.

chinese: 這樣，他使耶和華的約櫃繞城，把城繞了一次；眾人回到營裡，就在營裡住宿。
english: So he made the ark of the Lord go all round the town once: then they went back to the tents for the night.

chinese: 約書亞清早起來，祭司又抬起耶和華的約櫃。
english: And early in the morning Joshua got up, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.

chinese: 七個祭司拿七個羊角在耶和華的約櫃前，時常行走吹角；帶兵器的在他們前面走，後隊隨著耶和華的約櫃行。祭司一面走一面吹。
english: And the seven priests with their seven horns went on before the ark of the Lord, blowing their horns: the armed men went before them, and the mass of the people went after the ark of the Lord, blowing their horns.

chinese: 第二日，眾人把城繞了一次，就回營裡去。六日都是這樣行。
english: The second day they went all round the town once, and then went back to their tents: and so they did for six days.

chinese: 第七日清早，黎明的時候，他們起來，照樣繞城七次；惟獨這日把城繞了七次。
english: Then on the seventh day they got up early, at the dawn of the day, and went round the town in the same way, but that day they went round it seven times.

chinese: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的時候，約書亞吩咐百姓說：呼喊罷，因為耶和華已經把城交給你們了！
english: And the seventh time, at the sound of the priests' horns, Joshua said to the people, Now give a loud cry; for the Lord has given you the town.

chinese: 這城和其中所有的都要在耶和華面前毀滅；只有妓女喇合與他家中所有的可以存活，因為他隱藏了我們所打發的使者。
english: And the town will be put to the curse, and everything in it will be given to the Lord: only Rahab, the loose woman, and all who are in the house with her, will be kept safe, because she kept secret the men we sent.

chinese: 至於你們，務要謹慎，不可取那當滅的物，恐怕你們取了那當滅的物就連累以色列的全營，使全營受咒詛。
english: And as for you, keep yourselves from the cursed thing, for fear that you may get a desire for it and take some of it for yourselves, and so be the cause of a curse and great trouble on the tents of Israel.

chinese: 惟有金子、銀子，和銅鐵的器皿都要歸耶和華為聖，必入耶和華的庫中。
english: But all the silver and gold and the vessels of brass and iron are holy to the Lord: they are to come into the store-house of the Lord.

chinese: 於是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹角。百姓聽見角聲，便大聲呼喊，城牆就塌陷，百姓便上去進城，各人往前直上，將城奪取。
english: So the people gave a loud cry, and the horns were sounded; and on hearing the horns the people gave a loud cry, and the wall came down flat, so that the people went up into the town, every man going straight before him, and they took the town.

chinese: 又將城中所有的，不拘男女老少，牛羊和驢，都用刀殺盡。
english: And they put everything in the town to the curse; men and women, young and old, ox and sheep and ass, they put to death without mercy.

chinese: 約書亞吩咐窺探地的兩個人說：你們進那妓女的家，照著你們向他所起的誓，將那女人和他所有的都從那裡帶出來。
english: Then Joshua said to the two men who had been sent to make a search through the land, Go into the house of the loose woman, and get her out, and all who are with her, as you gave her your oath.

chinese: 當探子的兩個少年人就進去，將喇合與他的父母、弟兄，和他所有的，並他一切的親眷，都帶出來，安置在以色列的營外。
english: So the searchers went in and got out Rahab and her father and mother and her brothers and all she had, and they got out all her family; and they took them outside the tents of Israel.

chinese: 眾人就用火將城和其中所有的焚燒了；惟有金子、銀子，和銅鐵的器皿都放在耶和華殿的庫中。
english: Then, after burning up the town and everything in it, they put the silver and gold and the vessels of brass and iron into the store-house of the Lord's house.

chinese: 約書亞卻把妓女喇合與他父家，並他所有的，都救活了；因為他隱藏了約書亞所打發窺探耶利哥的使者，他就住在以色列中，直到今日。
english: But Joshua kept Rahab, the loose woman, and her father's family and all she had, from death, and so she got a living-place among the children of Israel to this day; because she kept safe the men whom Joshua had sent to make a search through the land.

chinese: 當時，約書亞叫眾人起誓說：有興起重修這耶利哥城的人，當在耶和華面前受咒詛。他立根基的時候，必喪長子，安門的時候，必喪幼子。
english: Then Joshua gave the people orders with an oath, saying, Let that man be cursed before the Lord who puts his hand to the building up of this town: with the loss of his first son will he put the first stone of it in place, and with the loss of his youngest son he will put up its doors.

chinese: 耶和華與約書亞同在，約書亞的聲名傳揚遍地。
english: So the Lord was with Joshua; and news of him went through all the land.

chinese: 以色列人在當滅的物上犯了罪；因為猶大支派中，謝拉的曾孫，撒底的孫子，迦米的兒子亞干取了當滅的物；耶和華的怒氣就向以色列人發作。
english: But the children of Israel did wrong about the cursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the family of Judah, took of the cursed thing, moving the Lord to wrath against the children of Israel.

chinese: 當下，約書亞從耶利哥打發人往伯特利東邊、靠近伯亞文的艾城去，吩咐他們說：你們上去窺探那地。他們就上去窺探艾城。
english: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is by the side of Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and said to them, Go up and make a search through the land. And the men went up and saw how Ai was placed.

chinese: 他們回到約書亞那裡，對他說：眾民不必都上去，只要二三千人上去就能攻取艾城；不必勞累眾民都去，因為那裡的人少。
english: Then they came back to Joshua and said to him, Do not send all the people up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and make an attack on Ai; there is no need for all the people to be tired with the journey there, for it is only a small town.

chinese: 於是民中約有三千人上那裡去，竟在艾城人面前逃跑了。
english: So about three thousand of the people went up, and were sent in flight by the men of Ai.

chinese: 艾城的人擊殺了他們三十六人，從城門前追趕他們，直到示巴琳，在下坡殺敗他們；眾民的心就消化如水。
english: The men of Ai put to death about thirty-six of them, driving them from before the town as far as the stoneworks, and overcoming them on the way down: and the hearts of the people became like water.

chinese: 約書亞便撕裂衣服；他和以色列的長老把灰撒在頭上，在耶和華的約櫃前俯伏在地，直到晚上。
english: Then Joshua, in great grief, went down on the earth before the ark of the Lord till the evening, and all the chiefs of Israel with him, and they put dust on their heads.

chinese: 約書亞說：哀哉！主耶和華阿，你為甚麼竟領這百姓過約但河，將我們交在亞摩利人的手中，使我們滅亡呢？我們不如住在約但河那邊倒好。
english: And Joshua said, O Lord God, why have you taken us over Jordan only to give us up into the hands of the Amorites for our destruction? If only it had been enough for us to keep on the other side of Jordan!

chinese: 主阿，以色列人既在仇敵面前轉背逃跑，我還有甚麼可說的呢？
english: O Lord, what am I to say now that Israel have given way before their attackers?

chinese: 迦南人和這地一切的居民聽見了就必圍困我們，將我們的名從地上除滅。那時你為你的大名要怎樣行呢？
english: For when the news comes to the Canaanites and all the people of the land, they will come up, shutting us in and cutting off our name from the earth: and what will you do for the honour of your great name?

chinese: 耶和華吩咐約書亞說：起來！你為何這樣俯伏在地呢？
english: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Get up; what are you doing with your face to the earth?

chinese: 以色列人犯了罪，違背了我所吩咐他們的約，取了當滅的物；又偷竊，又行詭詐，又把那當滅的放在他們的家具裡。
english: Israel has done wrong, sinning against the agreement which I made with them: they have even taken of the cursed thing; acting falsely like thieves they have put it among their goods.

chinese: 因此，以色列人在仇敵面前站立不住。他們在仇敵面前轉背逃跑，是因成了被咒詛的；你們若不把當滅的物從你們中間除掉，我就不再與你們同在了。
english: For this reason the children of Israel have given way, turning their backs in flight before their attackers, because they are cursed: I will no longer be with you, if you do not put the cursed thing away from among you.

chinese: 你起來，叫百姓自潔，對他們說：你們要自潔，預備明天，因為耶和華─以色列的神這樣說：以色列阿，你們中間有當滅的物，你們若不除掉，在仇敵面前必站立不住！
english: Up! make the people holy; say to them, Make yourselves holy before tomorrow, for the Lord, the God of Israel, has said, There is a cursed thing among you, O Israel, and you will give way before your attackers in the fight till the cursed thing has been taken away from among you.

chinese: 到了早晨，你們要按著支派近前來；耶和華所取的支派，要按著宗族近前來；耶和華所取的宗族，要按著家室近前來；耶和華所取的家室，要按著人丁，一個一個的近前來。
english: So in the morning you are to come near, tribe by tribe; and the tribe marked out by the Lord is to come near, family by family; and the family marked out by the Lord is to come near, house by house; and the house marked out by the Lord is to come near, man by man.

chinese: 被取的人有當滅的物在他那裡，他和他所有的必被火焚燒；因他違背了耶和華的約，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。
english: Then the man who is taken with the cursed thing is to be burned, with everything which is his; because he has gone against the agreement of the Lord and has done an act of shame in Israel.

chinese: 於是，約書亞清早起來，使以色列人按著支派近前來，取出來的是猶大支派；
english: So Joshua got up early in the morning, and made Israel come before him by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken;

chinese: 使猶大支派（原文是宗族）近前來，就取了謝拉的宗族；使謝拉的宗族，按著家室人丁，一個一個的近前來，取出來的是撒底；
english: Then he made Judah come forward, and the family of the Zerahites was taken; and he made the family of the Zerahites come forward man by man; and Zabdi was taken;

chinese: 使撒底的家室，按著人丁，一個一個的近前來，就取出猶大支派的人謝拉的曾孫，撒底的孫子，迦米的兒子亞干。
english: Then the house of Zabdi came forward man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

chinese: 約書亞對亞干說：我兒，我勸你將榮耀歸給耶和華─以色列的神，在他面前認罪，將你所做的事告訴我，不要向我隱瞞。
english: And Joshua said to Achan, My son, give glory and praise to the Lord, the God of Israel; give me word now of what you have done, and keep nothing back from me.

chinese: 亞干回答約書亞說：我實在得罪了耶和華─以色列的神。我所做的事如此如此：
english: And Achan, answering, said to Joshua, Truly I have done wrong against the Lord, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done:

chinese: 我在所奪的財物中看見一件美好的示拿衣服，二百舍客勒銀子，一條金子重五十舍客勒，我就貪愛這些物件，便拿去了。現今藏在我帳棚內的地裡，銀子在衣服底下。
english: When I saw among their goods a fair robe of Babylon and two hundred shekels of silver, and a mass of gold, fifty shekels in weight, I was overcome by desire and took them; and they are put away in the earth in my tent, and the silver is under it.

chinese: 約書亞就打發人跑到亞干的帳棚裡。那件衣服果然藏在他帳棚內，銀子在底下。
english: So Joshua sent men quickly, and looking in his tent, they saw where the robe had been put away secretly with the silver under it.

chinese: 他們就從帳棚裡取出來，拿到約書亞和以色列眾人那裡，放在耶和華面前。
english: And they took them from the tent and came back with them to Joshua and the children of Israel, and put them before the Lord.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人把謝拉的曾孫亞干和那銀子、那件衣服、那條金子，並亞干的兒女、牛、驢、羊、帳棚，以及他所有的，都帶到亞割谷去。
english: Then Joshua and all Israel took Achan, the son of Zerah, and the silver and the robe and the mass of gold, and his sons and his daughters and his oxen and his asses and his sheep and his tent and everything he had; and they took them up into the valley of Achor.

chinese: 約書亞說：你為甚麼連累我們呢？今日耶和華必叫你受連累。於是以色列眾人用石頭打死他，將石頭扔在其上，又用火焚燒他所有的（他所有的原文作他們）。
english: And Joshua said, Why have you been a cause of trouble to us? Today the Lord will send trouble on you. And all Israel took part in stoning him; they had him stoned to death and then burned with fire.

chinese: 眾人在亞干身上堆成一大堆石頭，直存到今日。於是耶和華轉意，不發他的烈怒。因此那地方名叫亞割谷（亞割就是連累的意思），直到今日。
english: And over him they put a great mass of stones, which is there to this day; then the heat of the Lord's wrath was turned away. So that place was named, The Valley of Achor, to this day.

chinese: 耶和華對約書亞說：不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。你起來，率領一切兵丁上艾城去，我已經把艾城的王和他的民、他的城，並他的地，都交在你手裡。
english: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Have no fear and do not be troubled: take with you all the fighting-men and go up against Ai: for I have given into your hands the king of Ai and his people and his town and his land:

chinese: 你怎樣待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也當照樣待艾城和艾城的王。只是城內所奪的財物和牲畜，你們可以取為自己的掠物。你要在城後設下伏兵。
english: And you are to do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king: but their goods and their cattle you may take for yourselves: let a secret force be stationed to make a surprise attack on the town from the back.

chinese: 於是，約書亞和一切兵丁都起來，要上艾城去。約書亞選了三萬大能的勇士，夜間打發他們前往，
english: So Joshua and the fighting-men got ready to go up against Ai; and Joshua took thirty thousand men of war, and sent them out by night.

chinese: 吩咐他們說：你們要在城後埋伏，不可離城太遠，都要各自準備。
english: And he gave them their orders, saying, Go and take up your position secretly at the back of the town: do not go very far away, and let all of you be ready:

chinese: 我與我所帶領的眾民要向城前往。城裡的人像初次出來攻擊我們的時候，我們就在他們面前逃跑，
english: And I and all the people with me will come near the town, and when they come out against us as they did before, we will go in flight from them;

chinese: 他們必出來追趕我們，直到我們引誘他們離開城；因為他們必說：這些人像初次在我們面前逃跑。所以我們要在他們面前逃跑，
english: And they will come out after us, till we have got them away from the town; for they will say, They have gone in flight from us as before; so we will go in flight before them;

chinese: 你們就從埋伏的地方起來，奪取那城，因為耶和華─你們的神必把城交在你們手裡。
english: Then you will get up from your secret position and take the town, for the Lord your God will give it up into your hands.

chinese: 你們奪了城以後，就放火燒城，要照耶和華的話行。這是我吩咐你們的。
english: And when you have taken the town, put fire to it, as the Lord has said: see, I have given you your orders.

chinese: 約書亞打發他們前往，他們就上埋伏的地方去，住在伯特利和艾城的中間，就是在艾城的西邊。這夜約書亞卻在民中住宿。
english: So Joshua sent them out: and they took up a secret position between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua kept with the people that night.

chinese: 約書亞清早起來，點齊百姓，他和以色列的長老在百姓前面上艾城去。
english: And early in the morning Joshua got up, and put the people in order, and he and the chiefs of Israel went up before the people to Ai.

chinese: 眾民，就是他所帶領的兵丁，都上去，向前直往，來到城前，在艾城北邊安營。在約書亞和艾城中間有一山谷。
english: And all the fighting-men who were with him went up and came near the town, and took up a position on the north side of Ai facing the town, with a valley between him and the town.

chinese: 他挑了約有五千人，使他們埋伏在伯特利和艾城的中間，就是在艾城的西邊，
english: And taking about five thousand men, he put them in position for a surprise attack on the west side of Ai, between Beth-el and Ai.

chinese: 於是安置了百姓，就是城北的全軍和城西的伏兵。這夜約書亞進入山谷之中。
english: So all the people were in their places, the army on the north side of the town and the secret force on the west; and that night Joshua went down into the valley.

chinese: 艾城的王看見這景況，就和全城的人，清早急忙起來，按所定的時候，出到亞拉巴前，要與以色列人交戰；王卻不知道在城後有伏兵。
english: Now when the king of Ai saw it, he got up quickly and went out to war against Israel, he and all his people, to the slope going down to the valley; but he had no idea that a secret force was waiting at the back of the town.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人在他們面前裝敗，往那通曠野的路逃跑。
english: Then Joshua and all Israel, acting as if they were overcome before them, went in flight by way of the waste land.

chinese: 城內的眾民都被招聚，追趕他們；艾城人追趕的時候，就被引誘離開城。
english: And all the people in Ai came together to go after them; and they went after Joshua, moving away from the town.

chinese: 艾城和伯特利城沒有一人不出來追趕以色列人的，撇了敞開的城門，去追趕以色列人。
english: There was not a man in Ai and Beth-el who did not go out after Israel; and the town was open and unwatched while they went after Israel.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐約書亞說：你向艾城伸出手裡的短鎗，因為我要將城交在你手裡。約書亞就向城伸出手裡的短鎗。
english: And the Lord said to Joshua, Let your spear be stretched out against Ai; for I will give it into your hands. So Joshua took up his spear, stretching it out in the direction of the town.

chinese: 他一伸手，伏兵就從埋伏的地方急忙起來，奪了城，跑進城去，放火焚燒。
english: Then the secret force came quickly from their place, and running forward when they saw his hand stretched out, went into the town and took it, and put fire to it straight away.

chinese: 艾城的人回頭一看，不料，城中煙氣沖天，他們就無力向左向右逃跑。那往曠野逃跑的百姓便轉身攻擊追趕他們的人。
english: Then the men of Ai, looking back, saw the smoke of the town going up to heaven, and were unable to go this way or that: and the people who had gone in flight to the waste land were turned back on those who were coming after them.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人見伏兵已經奪了城，城中煙氣飛騰，就轉身回去，擊殺艾城的人。
english: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the town had been taken by the surprise attack, and that the smoke of the town had gone up, turning round they overcame the men of Ai.

chinese: 伏兵也出城迎擊艾城人，艾城人就困在以色列人中間，前後都是以色列人。於是以色列人擊殺他們，沒有留下一個，也沒有一個逃脫的，
english: Then the other force came out of the town against them, so that they were being attacked on this side and on that: and Israel overcame them and let not one of them get away with his life.

chinese: 生擒了艾城的王，將他解到約書亞那裡。
english: But the king of Ai they made prisoner, and took him to Joshua.

chinese: 以色列人在田間和曠野殺盡所追趕一切艾城的居民。艾城人倒在刀下，直到滅盡；以色列眾人就回到艾城，用刀殺了城中的人。
english: Then, after the destruction of all the people of Ai in the field and in the waste land where they went after them, and when all the people had been put to death without mercy, all Israel went back to Ai, and put to death all who were in it without mercy.

chinese: 當日殺斃的人，連男帶女共有一萬二千，就是艾城所有的人。
english: On that day twelve thousand were put to death, men and women, all the people of Ai.

chinese: 約書亞沒有收回手裡所伸出來的短鎗，直到把艾城的一切居民盡行殺滅。
english: For Joshua did not take back his hand with the outstretched spear till the destruction of the people of Ai was complete.

chinese: 惟獨城中的牲畜和財物，以色列人都取為自己的掠物，是照耶和華所吩咐約書亞的話。
english: But the cattle and the goods from that town, Israel took for themselves, as the Lord had given orders to Joshua.

chinese: 約書亞將艾城焚燒，使城永為高堆、荒場，直到今日；
english: So Joshua gave Ai to the flames, and made it a waste mass of stones for ever, as it is to this day.

chinese: 又將艾城王掛在樹上，直到晚上。日落的時候，約書亞吩咐人把屍首從樹上取下來，丟在城門口，在屍首上堆成一大堆石頭，直存到今日。
english: And he put the king of Ai to death, hanging him on a tree till evening: and when the sun went down, Joshua gave them orders to take his body down from the tree, and put it in the public place of the town, covering it with a great mass of stones, which is there to this day.

chinese: 那時，約書亞在以巴路山上為耶和華─以色列的神築一座壇，
english: Then Joshua put up an altar to the Lord, the God of Israel, in Mount Ebal,

chinese: 是用沒有動過鐵器的整石頭築的，照著耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐以色列人的話，正如摩西律法書上所寫的。眾人在這壇上給耶和華奉獻燔祭和平安祭。
english: In the way ordered by Moses, the servant of the Lord, as it is recorded in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of uncut stones, untouched by any iron instrument: and on it they made burned offerings and peace-offerings to the Lord.

chinese: 約書亞在那裡，當著以色列人面前，將摩西所寫的律法抄寫在石頭上。
english: And he made there on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, writing it before the eyes of the children of Israel.
