chinese: 以色列眾人，無論是本地人、是寄居的，和長老、官長，並審判官，都站在約櫃兩旁，在抬耶和華約櫃的祭司利未人面前，一半對著基利心山，一半對著以巴路山，為以色列民祝福，正如耶和華僕人摩西先前所吩咐的。
english: And all Israel, those who were Israelites by birth, as well as the men from other lands living with them, and their responsible men and their overseers and judges, took their places round the ark, in front of the priests, the Levites, whose work it was to take up the ark of the Lord's agreement; half of them were stationed in front of Mount Gerizim and half in front of Mount Ebal, in agreement with the orders for the blessing of the children of Israel which Moses, the servant of the Lord, had given.

chinese: 隨後，約書亞將律法上祝福、咒詛的話，照著律法書上一切所寫的，都宣讀了一遍。
english: And after, he gave them all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, as it is all recorded in the book of the law;

chinese: 摩西所吩咐的一切話，約書亞在以色列全會眾和婦女、孩子，並他們中間寄居的外人面前，沒有一句不宣讀的。
english: Reading to all the meeting of Israel, with the women and the children and the men from other lands who were living among them, every word of the orders which Moses had given.

chinese: 約但河西，住山地、高原，並對著利巴嫩山沿大海一帶的諸王，就是赫人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的諸王，聽見這事，
english: Now on hearing the news of these things, all the kings on the west side of Jordan, in the hill-country and the lowlands and by the Great Sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittites and the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites,

chinese: 就都聚集，同心合意的要與約書亞和以色列人爭戰。
english: Came together with one purpose, to make war against Joshua and Israel.

chinese: 基遍的居民聽見約書亞向耶利哥和艾城所行的事，
english: And the men of Gibeon, hearing what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,

chinese: 就設詭計，假充使者，拿舊口袋和破裂縫補的舊皮酒袋馱在驢上，
english: Acting with deceit, got food together as if for a long journey; and took old food-bags for their asses, and old and cracked wine-skins kept together with cord;

chinese: 將補過的舊鞋穿在腳上，把舊衣服穿在身上；他們所帶的餅都是乾的，長了霉了。
english: And put old stitched-up shoes on their feet, and old clothing on their backs; and all the food they had with them was dry and broken up.

chinese: 他們到吉甲營中見約書亞，對他和以色列人說：我們是從遠方來的，現在求你與我們立約。
english: And they came to Joshua to the tent-circle at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, We have come from a far country: so now make an agreement with us.

chinese: 以色列人對這些希未人說：只怕你們是住在我們中間的；若是這樣，怎能和你們立約呢？
english: And the men of Israel said to the Hivites, It may be that you are living among us; how then may we make an agreement with you?

chinese: 他們對約書亞說：我們是你的僕人。約書亞問他們說：你們是甚麼人？是從那裡來的？
english: And they said to Joshua, We are your servants. Then Joshua said to them, Who are you and where do you come from?

chinese: 他們回答說：僕人從極遠之地而來，是因聽見耶和華─你神的名聲和他在埃及所行的一切事，
english: And they said to him, Your servants have come from a very far country, because of the name of the Lord your God: for the story of his great name, and of all he did in Egypt has come to our ears,

chinese: 並他向約但河東的兩個亞摩利王，就是希實本王西宏和在亞斯他錄的巴珊王噩一切所行的事。
english: And what he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of Jordan, to Sihon, king of Heshbon, and to Og, king of Bashan, at Ashtaroth.

chinese: 我們的長老和我們那地的一切居民對我們說：你們手裡要帶著路上用的食物去迎接以色列人，對他們說：我們是你們的僕人；現在求你們與我們立約。
english: So the responsible men and all the people of our country said to us, Take food with you for the journey and go to them, and say to them, We are your servants: so now make an agreement with us.

chinese: 我們出來要往你們這裡來的日子，從家裡帶出來的這餅還是熱的；看哪，現在都乾了，長了霉了。
english: This bread which we have with us for our food, we took warm and new from our houses when starting on our journey to you; but now see, it has become dry and broken up.

chinese: 這皮酒袋，我們盛酒的時候還是新的；看哪，現在已經破裂。我們這衣服和鞋，因為道路甚遠，也都穿舊了。
english: And these wine-skins were new when we put the wine in them, and now they are cracked as you see; and our clothing and our shoes have become old because of our very long journey here.

chinese: 以色列人受了他們些食物，並沒有求問耶和華。
english: And the men took some of their food, without requesting directions from the Lord.

chinese: 於是約書亞與他們講和，與他們立約，容他們活著；會眾的首領也向他們起誓。
english: So Joshua made peace with them, and made an agreement with them that they were not to be put to death: and the chiefs of the people took an oath to them.

chinese: 以色列人與他們立約之後，過了三天才聽見他們是近鄰，住在以色列人中間的。
english: Now three days after, when they had made this agreement with them, they had word that these men were their neighbours, living near them.

chinese: 以色列人起行，第三天到了他們的城邑，就是基遍、基非拉、比錄、基列耶琳。
english: And the children of Israel went forward on their journey, and on the third day came to their towns. Now their towns were Gibeon and Chephirah and Beeroth and Kiriath-jearim.

chinese: 因為會眾的首領已經指著耶和華─以色列的神向他們起誓，所以以色列人不擊殺他們；全會眾就向首領發怨言。
english: And the children of Israel did not put them to death, because the chiefs of the people had taken an oath to them by the Lord, the God of Israel. And all the people made an outcry against the chiefs.

chinese: 眾首領對全會眾說：我們已經指著耶和華─以色列的神向他們起誓，現在我們不能害他們。
english: But all the chiefs said to the people, We have taken an oath to them by the Lord, the God of Israel, and so we may not put our hands on them.

chinese: 我們要如此待他們，容他們活著，免得有忿怒因我們所起的誓臨到我們身上。
english: This is what we will do to them: we will not put them to death, for fear that wrath may come on us because of our oath to them.

chinese: 首領又對會眾說：要容他們活著。於是他們為全會眾作了劈柴挑水的人，正如首領對他們所說的話。
english: Keep them living, and let them be servants, cutting wood and getting water for all the people. And all the people did as the chiefs had said to them.

chinese: 約書亞召了他們來，對他們說：為甚麼欺哄我們說我們離你們甚遠呢？其實你們是住在我們中間。
english: Then Joshua sent for them, and said to them, Why have you been false to us, saying, We are very far from you, when you are living among us?

chinese: 現在你們是被咒詛的！你們中間的人必斷不了作奴僕，為我神的殿作劈柴挑水的人。
english: Now because of this you are cursed, and you will for ever be our servants, cutting wood and getting water for the house of my God.

chinese: 他們回答約書亞說：因為有人實在告訴你的僕人，耶和華─你的神曾吩咐他的僕人摩西，把這全地賜給你們，並在你們面前滅絕這地的一切居民，所以我們為你們的緣故甚怕喪命，就行了這事。
english: And, answering Joshua, they said, Because it came to the ears of your servants that the Lord your God had given orders to his servant Moses to give you all this land, and to send destruction on all the people living in it, because of you; so, fearing greatly for our lives because of you, we have done this.

chinese: 現在我們在你手中，你以怎樣待我們為善為正，就怎樣做罷！
english: And now we are in your hands: do to us whatever seems good and right to you.

chinese: 於是約書亞這樣待他們，救他們脫離以色列人的手，以色列人就沒有殺他們。
english: So he kept them safe from the children of Israel, and did not let them be put to death.

chinese: 當日約書亞使他們在耶和華所要選擇的地方，為會眾和耶和華的壇作劈柴挑水的人，直到今日。
english: And that day Joshua made them servants, cutting wood and getting water for the people and for the altar of the Lord, in the place marked out by him, to this day.

chinese: 耶路撒冷王亞多尼洗德聽見約書亞奪了艾城，盡行毀滅，怎樣待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也照樣待艾城和艾城的王，又聽見基遍的居民與以色列人立了和約，住在他們中間，
english: Now when it came to the ears of Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, that Joshua had taken Ai, and had given it up to the curse (for as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king); and that the people of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were living among them;

chinese: 就甚懼怕；因為基遍是一座大城，如都城一般，比艾城更大，並且城內的人都是勇士。
english: He was in great fear, because Gibeon was a great town, like one of the king's towns, greater than Ai, and all the men in it were men of war.

chinese: 所以耶路撒冷王亞多尼洗德打發人去見希伯崙王何咸、耶末王毘蘭、拉吉王雅非亞，和伊磯倫王底璧，說：
english: So Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, sent to Hoham, king of Hebron, and to Piram, king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia, king of Lachish, and to Debir, king of Eglon, saying,

chinese: 求你們上來幫助我，我們好攻打基遍，因為他們與約書亞和以色列人立了和約。
english: Come up to me and give me help, and let us make an attack on Gibeon: for they have made peace with Joshua and the children of Israel.

chinese: 於是五個亞摩利王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯崙王、耶末王、拉吉王、伊磯倫王，大家聚集，率領他們的眾軍上去，對著基遍安營，攻打基遍。
english: So the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, were banded together, and went up with all their armies and took up their position before Gibeon and made war against it.

chinese: 基遍人就打發人往吉甲的營中去見約書亞，說：你不要袖手不顧你的僕人，求你速速上來拯救我們，幫助我們，因為住山地亞摩利人的諸王都聚集攻擊我們。
english: And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua to the tent-circle at Gilgal, saying, Be not slow to send help to your servants; come up quickly to our support and keep us safe: for all the kings of the Amorites from the hill-country have come together against us.

chinese: 於是約書亞和他一切兵丁，並大能的勇士，都從吉甲上去。
english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal with all his army and all his men of war.

chinese: 耶和華對約書亞說：不要怕他們；因為我已將他們交在你手裡，他們無一人能在你面前站立得住。
english: And the Lord said to Joshua, Have no fear of them, for I have given them into your hands; they will all give way before you.

chinese: 約書亞就終夜從吉甲上去，猛然臨到他們那裡。
english: So Joshua, having come up from Gilgal all night, made a sudden attack on them.

chinese: 耶和華使他們在以色列人面前潰亂。約書亞在基遍大大的殺敗他們，追趕他們，在伯和崙的上坡路擊殺他們，直到亞西加和瑪基大。
english: And the Lord made them full of fear before Israel, and they put great numbers of them to death at Gibeon, and went after them by the way going up to Beth-horon, driving them back to Azekah and Makkedah

chinese: 他們在以色列人面前逃跑，正在伯和崙下坡的時候，耶和華從天上降大冰雹在他們身上，（冰雹原文作石頭）直降到亞西加，打死他們。被冰雹打死的，比以色列人用刀殺死的還多。
english: And in their flight before Israel, on the way down from Beth-horon, the Lord sent down great stones from heaven on them all the way to Azekah, causing their death: those whose death was caused by the stones were more than those whom the children of Israel put to death with the sword.

chinese: 當耶和華將亞摩利人交付以色列人的日子，約書亞就禱告耶和華，在以色列人眼前說：日頭阿，你要停在基遍；月亮阿，你要止在亞雅崙谷。
english: It was on the day when the Lord gave up the Amorites into the hands of the children of Israel that Joshua said to the Lord, before the eyes of Israel, Sun, be at rest over Gibeon; and you, O moon, in the valley of Aijalon.

chinese: 於是日頭停留，月亮止住，直等國民向敵人報仇。這事豈不是寫在雅煞珥書上麼？日頭在天當中停住，不急速下落，約有一日之久。
english: And the sun was at rest and the moon kept its place till the nation had given punishment to their attackers. (Is it not recorded in the book of Jashar?) So the sun kept its place in the middle of the heavens, and was waiting, and did not go down, for the space of a day.

chinese: 在這日以前，這日以後，耶和華聽人的禱告，沒有像這日的，是因耶和華為以色列爭戰。
english: And there was no day like that, before it or after it, when the Lord gave ear to the voice of a man; for the Lord was fighting for Israel.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人回到吉甲的營中。
english: And Joshua, with all Israel, went back to the tent-circle at Gilgal.

chinese: 那五王逃跑，藏在瑪基大洞裡。
english: But these five kings went in flight secretly to a hole in the rock at Makkedah.

chinese: 有人告訴約書亞說：那五王已經找到了，都藏在瑪基大洞裡。
english: And word was given to Joshua that the five kings had been taken in a hole in the rock at Makkedah.

chinese: 約書亞說：你們把幾塊大石頭輥到洞口，派人看守，
english: And Joshua said, Let great stones be rolled against the mouth of the hole, and let men keep watch by it:

chinese: 你們卻不可耽延，要追趕你們的仇敵，擊殺他們儘後邊的人，不容他們進自己的城邑，因為耶和華─你們的神已經把他們交在你們手裡。
english: But do you, without waiting, go after their army, attacking them from the back; do not let them get into their towns, for the Lord your God has given them into your hands.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列人大大殺敗他們，直到將他們滅盡；其中剩下的人都進了堅固的城。
english: Now when Joshua and the children of Israel had come to the end of their war of complete destruction, and had put to death all but a small band who had got safely into the walled towns,

chinese: 眾百姓就安然回瑪基大營中，到約書亞那裡。沒有一人敢向以色列人饒舌。
english: All the people went back to Joshua to the tent-circle at Makkedah in peace: and no one said a word against the children of Israel.

chinese: 約書亞說：打開洞口，將那五王從洞裡帶出來，領到我面前。
english: Then Joshua said, Take away the stones from the mouth of the hole in the rock, and make those five kings come out to me.

chinese: 眾人就這樣行，將那五王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯崙王、耶末王、拉吉王、伊磯倫王，從洞裡帶出來，領到約書亞面前。
english: And they did so, and made those five kings come out of the hole to him, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

chinese: 帶出那五王到約書亞面前的時候，約書亞就召了以色列眾人來，對那些和他同去的軍長說：你們近前來，把腳踏在這些王的頸項上。他們就近前來，把腳踏在這些王的頸項上。
english: And when they had made those kings come out to Joshua, Joshua sent for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who had gone with him, Come near and put your feet on the necks of these kings. So they came near and put their feet on their necks.

chinese: 約書亞對他們說：你們不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。應當剛強壯膽，因為耶和華必這樣待你們所要攻打的一切仇敵。
english: And Joshua said to them, Have no fear and do not be troubled; be strong and take heart: for so will the Lord do to all against whom you make war.

chinese: 隨後約書亞將這五王殺死，掛在五棵樹上。他們就在樹上直掛到晚上。
english: Then Joshua had them put to death, hanging them on five trees, where they were till evening.

chinese: 日頭要落的時候，約書亞一吩咐，人就把屍首從樹上取下來，丟在他們藏過的洞裡，把幾塊大石頭放在洞口，直存到今日。
english: And when the sun went down, they were taken down from the trees, by Joshua's orders, and put into the hole where they had gone to be safe; and great stones were placed at the mouth of the hole, where they are to this day.

chinese: 當日，約書亞奪了瑪基大，用刀擊殺城中的人和王；將其中一切人口盡行殺滅，沒有留下一個。他待瑪基大王，像從前待耶利哥王一樣。
english: That day Joshua took Makkedah, and put it and its king to the sword; every soul in it he gave up to the curse without mercy: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人從瑪基大往立拿去，攻打立拿。
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went on from Makkedah and came to Libnah, and made an attack on it;

chinese: 耶和華將立拿和立拿的王也交在以色列人手裡。約書亞攻打這城，用刀擊殺了城中的一切人口，沒有留下一個。他待立拿王，像從前待耶利哥王一樣。
english: And again the Lord gave it and its king into the hands of Israel; and he put it and every person in it to the sword, till their destruction was complete; and he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人從立拿往拉吉去，對著拉吉安營，攻打這城。
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went on from Libnah to Lachish, and took up their position against it and made an attack on it,

chinese: 耶和華將拉吉交在以色列人的手裡。第二天約書亞就奪了拉吉，用刀擊殺了城中的一切人口，是照他向立拿一切所行的。
english: And the Lord gave Lachish into the hands of Israel, and on the second day he took it, putting it and every person in it to the sword without mercy, as he had done to Libnah.

chinese: 那時基色王荷蘭上來幫助拉吉，約書亞就把他和他的民都擊殺了，沒有留下一個。
english: Then Horam, king of Gezer, came up to the help of Lachish; and Joshua overcame him and his people, putting all of them to death.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人從拉吉往伊磯倫去，對著伊磯倫安營，攻打這城。
english: And Joshua and all Israel with him went on from Lachish to Eglon: and they took up their position against it and made an attack on it;

chinese: 當日就奪了城，用刀擊殺了城中的人。那日，約書亞將城中的一切人口盡行殺滅，是照他向拉吉一切所行的。
english: And that day they took it, putting it and every person in it to the sword, as he had done to Lachish.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人從伊磯倫上希伯崙去，攻打這城，
english: And Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron, and made an attack on it;

chinese: 就奪了希伯崙和屬希伯崙的諸城邑，用刀將城中的人與王，並那些城邑中的人口，都擊殺了，沒有留下一個，是照他向伊磯倫所行的，把城中的一切人口盡行殺滅。
english: And took it, overcoming it and putting it and its king and its towns and every person in it to the sword: as he had done to Eglon, he put them all to death, and gave it up to the curse with every person in it.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列眾人回到底璧，攻打這城，
english: And Joshua and all Israel with him went on to make an attack on Debir;

chinese: 就奪了底璧和屬底璧的城邑，又擒獲底璧的王，用刀將這些城中的人口盡行殺滅，沒有留下一個。他待底璧和底璧王，像從前待希伯崙和立拿與立拿王一樣。
english: And he took it, with its king and all its towns: and he put them to the sword, giving every person in it to the curse; all were put to death: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir and its king.

chinese: 這樣，約書亞擊殺全地的人，就是山地、南地、高原、山坡的人，和那些地的諸王，沒有留下一個。將凡有氣息的盡行殺滅，正如耶和華─以色列的神所吩咐的。
english: So Joshua overcame all the land, the hill-country and the South and the lowland and the mountain slopes, and all their kings; all were put to death: and every living thing he gave up to the curse, as the Lord, the God of Israel, had given him orders.

chinese: 約書亞從加低斯巴尼亞攻擊到迦薩，又攻擊歌珊全地，直到基遍。
english: Joshua overcame them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and all the land of Goshen as far as Gibeon.

chinese: 約書亞一時殺敗了這些王，並奪了他們的地，因為耶和華─以色列的神為以色列爭戰。
english: And all these kings and their land Joshua took at the same time, because the Lord, the God of Israel, was fighting for Israel.

chinese: 於是約書亞和以色列眾人回到吉甲的營中。
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went back to their tents at Gilgal.

chinese: 夏瑣王耶賓聽見這事，就打發人去見瑪頓王約巴、伸崙王、押煞王，
english: Now Jabin, king of Hazor, hearing of these things, sent to Jobab, king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

chinese: 與北方山地、基尼烈南邊的亞拉巴高原，並西邊多珥山岡的諸王；
english: And to the kings on the north in the hill-country, and in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, and in the lowland, and in the highlands of Dor on the west,

chinese: 又去見東方和西方的迦南人，與山地的亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人，並黑門山根米斯巴地的希未人。
english: And to the Canaanites on the east and on the west, and to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites in the hill-country, and the Hivites under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

chinese: 這些王和他們的眾軍都出來，人數多如海邊的沙，並有許多馬匹車輛。
english: And they went out, they and all their armies with them, a great people, in number like the sand on the seaside, with horses and war-carriages in great number.

chinese: 這諸王會合，來到米倫水邊，一同安營，要與以色列人爭戰。
english: And all these kings came together, and put their forces in position at the waters of Merom, to make war on Israel.

chinese: 耶和華對約書亞說：你不要因他們懼怕。明日這時，我必將他們交付以色列人全然殺了。你要砍斷他們馬的蹄筋，用火焚燒他們的車輛。
english: And the Lord said to Joshua, Have no fear of them: for tomorrow at this time I will give them all up dead before Israel; you are to have the leg-muscles of their horses cut and their war-carriages burned with fire.

chinese: 於是約書亞率領一切兵丁，在米倫水邊突然向前攻打他們。
english: So Joshua and all the men of war with him came against them suddenly at the waters of Merom, and made an attack on them.

chinese: 耶和華將他們交在以色列人手裡，以色列人就擊殺他們，追趕他們到西頓大城，到米斯利弗瑪音，直到東邊米斯巴的平原，將他們擊殺，沒有留下一個。
english: And the Lord gave them up into the hands of Israel, and they overcame them driving them back to great Zidon and to Misrephoth-maim and into the valley of Mizpeh to the east; and they put them all to death, no man got away safely.

chinese: 約書亞就照耶和華所吩咐他的去行，砍斷他們馬的蹄筋，用火焚燒他們的車輛。
english: And Joshua did to them as the Lord had said to him; he had the leg-muscles of their horses cut and their war-carriages burned with fire.

chinese: 當時，約書亞轉回奪了夏瑣，用刀擊殺夏瑣王。（素來夏瑣在這諸國中是為首的。）
english: At that time, Joshua went on to take Hazor and put its king to the sword: for in earlier times Hazor was the chief of all those kingdoms.

chinese: 以色列人用刀擊殺城中的人口，將他們盡行殺滅；凡有氣息的沒有留下一個。約書亞又用火焚燒夏瑣。
english: And they put every person in it to death without mercy, giving every living thing up to the curse, and burning Hazor.

chinese: 約書亞奪了這些王的一切城邑，擒獲其中的諸王，用刀擊殺他們，將他們盡行殺滅，正如耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐的。
english: And all the towns of these kings, and all the kings, Joshua took, and put them to the sword: he gave them up to the curse, as Moses, the servant of the Lord, had said.

chinese: 至於造在山岡上的城，除了夏瑣以外，以色列人都沒有焚燒。約書亞只將夏瑣焚燒了。
english: As for the towns made on hills of earth, not one was burned by Israel but Hazor, which was burned by Joshua.

chinese: 那些城邑所有的財物和牲畜，以色列人都取為自己的掠物；惟有一切人口都用刀擊殺，直到殺盡；凡有氣息的沒有留下一個。
english: And all the goods taken from these towns, and their cattle, the children of Israel kept for themselves; but every man they put to death without mercy, till their destruction was complete, and there was no one living.

chinese: 耶和華怎樣吩咐他僕人摩西，摩西就照樣吩咐約書亞，約書亞也照樣行。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，約書亞沒有一件懈怠不行的。
english: As the Lord had given orders to Moses his servant, so Moses gave orders to Joshua, and so Joshua did; every order which the Lord had given to Moses was done.

chinese: 約書亞奪了那全地，就是山地、一帶南地、歌珊全地、高原、亞拉巴、以色列的山地，和山下的高原。
english: So Joshua took all that land, the hill-country and all the South, and all the land of Goshen, and the lowland and the Arabah, the hill-country of Israel and its lowland;

chinese: 從上西珥的哈拉山，直到黑門山下利巴嫩平原的巴力迦得，並且擒獲那些地的諸王，將他們殺死。
english: From Mount Halak, which goes up to Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon: and all their kings he overcame and put to death.

chinese: 約書亞和這諸王爭戰了許多年日。
english: For a long time Joshua made war on all those kings.

chinese: 除了基遍的希未人之外，沒有一城與以色列人講和的，都是以色列人爭戰奪來的。
english: Not one town made peace with the children of Israel, but only the Hivites of Gibeon: they took them all in war.

chinese: 因為耶和華的意思是要使他們心裡剛硬，來與以色列人爭戰，好叫他們盡被殺滅，不蒙憐憫，正如耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
english: For the Lord made them strong in heart to go to war against Israel, so that he might give them up to the curse without mercy, and that destruction might come on them, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

chinese: 當時約書亞來到，將住山地、希伯崙、底璧、亞拿伯、猶大山地、以色列山地所有的亞衲族人剪除了。約書亞將他們和他們的城邑盡都毀滅。
english: And Joshua came at that time and put an end to the Anakim in the hill-country, in Hebron, in Debir, in Anab, and in all the hill-country of Judah and Israel: Joshua gave them and their towns to the curse.

chinese: 在以色列人的地沒有留下一個亞衲族人，只在迦薩、迦特，和亞實突有留下的。
english: Not one of the Anakim was to be seen in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, some were still living.

chinese: 這樣，約書亞照著耶和華所吩咐摩西的一切話奪了那全地，就按著以色列支派的宗族將地分給他們為業。於是國中太平，沒有爭戰了。
english: So Joshua took all the land, as the Lord had said to Moses; and Joshua gave it to the children of Israel as their heritage, making division of it among them by their tribes. And the land had rest from war.

chinese: 以色列人在約但河外向日出之地擊殺二王，得他們的地，就是從亞嫩谷直到黑門山，並東邊的全亞拉巴之地。
english: Now these are the kings of the land whom the children of Israel overcame, taking as their heritage their land on the east side of Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah to the east:

chinese: 這二王，有住希實本、亞摩利人的王西宏。他所管之地是從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的城，並基列一半，直到亞捫人的境界，雅博河
english: Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was living in Heshbon, ruling from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, as far as the river Jabbok, the limits of the children of Ammon;

chinese: 與約但河東邊的亞拉巴，直到基尼烈海，又到亞拉巴的海，就是鹽海，通伯耶西末的路，以及南方，直到毘斯迦的山根。
english: And the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, to the east, and to the sea of the Arabah, that is the Salt Sea, to the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

chinese: 又有巴珊王噩。他是利乏音人所剩下的，住在亞斯他錄和以得來。
english: And the land of Og, king of Bashan, of the rest of the Rephaim, who was living at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

chinese: 他所管之地是黑門山、撒迦、巴珊全地，直到基述人和瑪迦人的境界，並基列一半，直到希實本王西宏的境界。
english: Ruling in the mountain of Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, as far as the limits of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, to the land of Sihon, king of Heshbon.

chinese: 這二王是耶和華僕人摩西和以色列人所擊殺的；耶和華僕人摩西將他們的地賜給流便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人為業。
english: Moses, the servant of the Lord, and the children of Israel overcame them; and Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave their land for a heritage to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

chinese: 約書亞和以色列人在約但河西擊殺了諸王。他們的地是從利巴嫩平原的巴力迦得，直到上西珥的哈拉山。約書亞就將那地按著以色列支派的宗族分給他們為業，
english: And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel overcame on the west side of Jordan, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which goes up to Seir; and Joshua gave the land to the tribes of Israel for a heritage, in keeping with their divisions;

chinese: 就是赫人、亞摩利人，迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的山地、高原亞拉巴、山坡、曠野，和南地。
english: In the hill-country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and on the mountain slopes, and in the waste land, and in the South; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

chinese: 他們的王：一個是耶利哥王，一個是靠近伯特利的艾城王，
english: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Beth-el, one;

chinese: 一個是耶路撒冷王，一個是希伯崙王，
english: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

chinese: 一個是耶末王，一個是拉吉王，
english: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

chinese: 一個是伊磯倫王，一個是基色王，
english: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

chinese: 一個是底璧王，一個是基德王，
english: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

chinese: 一個是何珥瑪王，一個是亞拉得王，
english: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

chinese: 一個是立拿王，一個是亞杜蘭王，
english: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

chinese: 一個是瑪基大王，一個是伯特利王，
english: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;

chinese: 一個是他普亞王，一個是希弗王，
english: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

chinese: 一個是亞弗王，一個是拉沙崙王，
english: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

chinese: 一個是瑪頓王，一個是夏瑣王，
english: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

chinese: 一個是伸崙米崙王，一個是押煞王，
english: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

chinese: 一個是他納王，一個是米吉多王，
english: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

chinese: 一個是基低斯王，一個是靠近迦密的約念王，
english: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

chinese: 一個是多珥山岡的多珥王，一個是吉甲的戈印王，
english: The king of Dor on the hill of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

chinese: 一個是得撒王；共計三十一個王。
english: The king of Tirzah, one; all the kings together were thirty-one.

chinese: 約書亞年紀老邁，耶和華對他說：你年紀老邁了，還有許多未得之地，
english: Now Joshua was old and full of years; and the Lord said to him, You are old and full of years, and there is still very much land to be taken.

chinese: 就是非利士人的全境和基述人的全地。
english: This is the land which is still to be taken: all the country of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

chinese: 從埃及前的西曷河往北，直到以革倫的境界，就算屬迦南人之地。有非利士人五個首領所管的迦薩人、亞實突人、亞實基倫人、迦特人、以革倫人之地，並有南方亞衛人之地。
english: From the Shihor, which is before Egypt, to the edge of Ekron to the north, which is taken to be Canaanite property: the five chiefs of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites, as well as the Avvim;

chinese: 又有迦南人的全地，並屬西頓人的米亞拉到亞弗，直到亞摩利人的境界。
english: On the south: all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah which is the property of the Zidonians, to Aphek, as far as the limit of the Amorites:

chinese: 還有迦巴勒人之地，並向日出的全利巴嫩，就是從黑門山根的巴力迦得，直到哈馬口。
english: And the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, looking east, from Baal-gad under Mount Hermon as far as Hamath:

chinese: 山地的一切居民，從利巴嫩直到米斯利弗瑪音，就是所有的西頓人，我必在以色列人面前趕出他們去。你只管照我所吩咐的，將這地拈鬮分給以色列人為業。
english: All the people of the hill-country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, all the Zidonians; them will I send out from before the children of Israel: only make division of it to Israel for a heritage, as I have given you orders to do.

chinese: 現在你要把這地分給九個支派和瑪拿西半個支派為業。
english: So now make division of this land for a heritage to the nine tribes, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

chinese: 瑪拿西那半支派和流便、迦得二支派已經受了產業，就是耶和華的僕人摩西在約但河東所賜給他們的：
english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites have been given their heritage, which Moses gave them, on the east side of Jordan, as Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave them;

chinese: 是從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的城，並米底巴的全平原，直到底本，
english: From Aroer, on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and all the table-land from Medeba to Dibon;

chinese: 和在希實本作王亞摩利王西宏的諸城，直到亞捫人的境界；
english: And all the towns of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, to the limits of the children of Ammon;

chinese: 又有基列地、基述人、瑪迦人的地界，並黑門全山、巴珊全地，直到撒迦；
english: And Gilead, and the land of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

chinese: 又有巴珊王噩的全國─他在亞斯他錄和以得來作王（利乏音人所存留的只剩下他）。這些地的人都是摩西所擊殺、所趕逐的。
english: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who was ruling in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (he was one of the last of the Rephaim); these did Moses overcome, driving them out of their country.

chinese: 以色列人卻沒有趕逐基述人、瑪迦人；這些人仍住在以色列中，直到今日。
english: However, the people of Israel did not send out the Geshurites, or the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath are living among Israel to this day.

chinese: 只是利未支派，摩西（原文作他）沒有把產業分給他們。他們的產業乃是獻與耶和華─以色列神的火祭，正如耶和華所應許他們的。
english: Only to the tribe of Levi he gave no heritage; the offerings of the Lord, the God of Israel, made by fire are his heritage, as he said to him.

chinese: 摩西按著流便支派的宗族分給他們產業。
english: And Moses gave their heritage to the tribe of Reuben by their families.

chinese: 他們的境界是亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的城，靠近米底巴的全平原；
english: Their limit was from Aroer, on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and all the table-land by Medeba;

chinese: 希實本並屬希實本平原的各城，底本、巴末巴力、伯巴力勉、
english: Heshbon and all her towns in the table-land; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon;

chinese: 雅雜、基底莫、米法押、
english: And Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath;

chinese: 基列亭、西比瑪、谷中山的細列哈沙轄、
english: And Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the mountain of the valley;

chinese: 伯毘珥、毘斯迦山坡、伯耶西末；
english: And Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth;

chinese: 平原的各城，並亞摩利王西宏的全國。這西宏曾在希實本作王，摩西把他和米甸的族長以未、利金、蘇珥、戶珥、利巴擊殺了；這都是住那地屬西宏為首領的。
english: And all the towns of the table-land, and all the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, whom Moses overcame, together with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the chiefs of Sihon, who were living in the land.

chinese: 那時以色列人在所殺的人中，也用刀殺了比珥的兒子術士巴蘭。
english: And Balaam, the son of Beor, the prophet, the children of Israel put to death with the sword.

chinese: 流便人的境界就是約但河與靠近約但河的地。以上是流便人按著宗族所得為業的諸城，並屬城的村莊。
english: And the limit of the children of Reuben was the edge of Jordan. This was the heritage of the children of Reuben by their families, with its towns and its unwalled places.

chinese: 摩西按著迦得支派的宗族分給他們產業。
english: And Moses gave their heritage to the tribe of Gad by their families.

chinese: 他們的境界是雅謝和基列的各城，並亞捫人的一半地，直到拉巴前的亞羅珥；
english: And their limit was Jazer, and all the towns of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer before Rabbah;

chinese: 從希實本到拉抹米斯巴和比多寧，又從瑪哈念到底璧的境界，
english: And from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the edge of Debir;

chinese: 並谷中的伯亞蘭、伯寧拉、疏割、撒分，就是希實本王西宏國中的餘地，以及約但河與靠近約但河的地，直到基尼烈海的極邊，都在約但河東。
english: And in the valley, Beth-haram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon, king of Heshbon, having Jordan for its limit, to the end of the sea of Chinnereth on the east side of Jordan.

chinese: 以上是迦得人按著宗族所得為業的諸城，並屬城的村莊。
english: This is the heritage of the children of Gad by their families, with its towns and its unwalled places

chinese: 摩西把產業分給瑪拿西半支派，是按著瑪拿西半支派的宗族所分的。
english: And Moses gave their heritage to the half-tribe of Manasseh by their families.

chinese: 他們的境界是從瑪哈念起，包括巴珊全地，就是巴珊王噩的全國，並在巴珊、睚珥的一切城邑，共六十個。
english: And their limit was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, and all Havvoth-Jair, in Bashan, sixty towns;

chinese: 基列的一半，並亞斯他錄、以得來，就是屬巴珊王噩國的二城，是按著宗族給瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉的一半子孫。
english: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, towns of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, for half of the children of Machir by their families.

chinese: 以上是摩西在約但河東對著耶利哥的摩押平原所分給他們的產業。
english: These are the heritages of which Moses made distribution in the lowlands of Moab, on the other side of Jordan in Jericho, to the east.

chinese: 只是利未支派，摩西沒有把產業分給他們。耶和華─以色列的神是他們的產業，正如耶和華所應許他們的。
english: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no heritage: the Lord, the God of Israel, is their heritage, as he said to them.

chinese: 以色列人在迦南地所得的產業，就是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列各支派的族長所分給他們的，都記在下面，
english: And these are the heritages which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar, the priest, and Joshua, the son of Nun, and the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, gave out to them;

chinese: 是照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的，把產業拈鬮分給九個半支派。
english: Their heritage by the Lord's decision, as he gave orders by Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.

chinese: 原來，摩西在約但河東已經把產業分給那兩個半支派，只是在他們中間沒有把產業分給利未人。
english: For Moses had given their heritage to the two tribes and the half-tribe on the other side of Jordan, but to the Levites he gave no heritage among them.

chinese: 因為約瑟的子孫是兩個支派，就是瑪拿西和以法蓮，所以沒有把地分給利未人，但給他們城邑居住，並城邑的郊野，可以牧養他們的牲畜，安置他們的財物。
english: Because the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim; and they gave the Levites no part in the land, only towns for their living-places, with the grass-lands for their cattle and for their property.

chinese: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就照樣行，把地分了。
english: As the Lord had given orders to Moses, so the people of Israel did, and they made division of the land.

chinese: 那時，猶大人來到吉甲見約書亞，有基尼洗族耶孚尼的兒子迦勒對約書亞說：耶和華在加低斯巴尼亞指著我與你對神人摩西所說的話，你都知道了。
english: Then the children of Judah went to Joshua in Gilgal; and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, said to him, You have knowledge of what the Lord said to Moses, the man of God, about me and about you in Kadesh-barnea.

chinese: 耶和華的僕人摩西從加低斯巴尼亞打發我窺探這地，那時我正四十歲；我按著心意回報他。
english: I was forty years old when Moses, the servant of the Lord, sent me from Kadesh-barnea to make a search through the land; and the account which I gave him was in keeping with his desire.

chinese: 然而，同我上去的眾弟兄使百姓的心消化；但我專心跟從耶和華─我的神。
english: My brothers, however, who went up with me, made the heart of the people like water: but I was true to the Lord with all my heart.

chinese: 當日摩西起誓說：你腳所踏之地定要歸你和你的子孫永遠為業，因為你專心跟從耶和華─我的神。
english: And on that day Moses took an oath, saying, Truly the land where your feet have been placed will become a heritage for you and your children for ever, because you have been true to the Lord your God with all your heart.

chinese: 自從耶和華對摩西說這話的時候，耶和華照他所應許的使我存活這四十五年；其間以色列人在曠野行走。看哪，現今我八十五歲了，
english: And now, as you see, the Lord has kept me safe these forty-five years, from the time when the Lord said this to Moses, while Israel was wandering in the waste land: and now I am eighty-five years old.

chinese: 我還是強壯，像摩西打發我去的那天一樣；無論是爭戰，是出入，我的力量那時如何，現在還是如何。
english: And still, I am as strong today as I was when Moses sent me out: as my strength was then, so is it now, for war and for all the business of life.

chinese: 求你將耶和華那日應許我的這山地給我；那裡有亞衲族人，並寬大堅固的城，你也曾聽見了。或者耶和華照他所應許的與我同在，我就把他們趕出去。
english: So now, give me this hill-country named by the Lord at that time; for you had an account of it then, how the Anakim were there, and great walled towns: it may be that the Lord will be with me, and I will be able to take their land, as the Lord said.

chinese: 於是約書亞為耶孚尼的兒子迦勒祝福，將希伯崙給他為業。
english: And Joshua gave him his blessing; and he gave Hebron to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, for his heritage.

chinese: 所以希伯崙作了基尼洗族耶孚尼的兒子迦勒的產業，直到今日，因為他專心跟從耶和華─以色列的神。
english: So Hebron became the heritage of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, to this day, because with all his heart he was true to the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 希伯崙從前名叫基列亞巴；亞巴是亞衲族中最尊大的人。於是國中太平，沒有爭戰了。
english: In earlier times the name of Hebron had been Kiriath-arba, named after Arba, the greatest of the Anakim. And the land had rest from war.

chinese: 猶大支派按著宗族拈鬮所得之地是在儘南邊，到以東的交界，向南直到尋的曠野。
english: Now the part of the land marked out for the children of Judah by families, went up to the edge of Edom, as far as the waste land of Zin to the south, to the farthest point of it on the south.

chinese: 他們的南界是從鹽海的儘邊，就是從朝南的海汊起，
english: Their south limit was from the farthest part of the Salt Sea, from the inlet looking to the south:

chinese: 通到亞克拉濱坡的南邊，接連到尋，上到加低斯巴尼亞的南邊，又過希斯崙，上到亞達珥，繞到甲加，
english: From there it goes south of the slope up to Akrabbim, and on to Zin, then south past Kadesh-barnea, and on by Hezron and up to Addar, turning in the direction of Karka:

chinese: 接連到押們，通到埃及小河，直通到海為止。這就是他們的南界。
english: Then on to Azmon, ending at the stream of Egypt: and the end of the limit is at the sea; this will be your limit on the south.

chinese: 東界是從鹽海南邊到約但河口。北界是從約但河口的海汊起，
english: And the east limit is the Salt Sea as far as the end of Jordan. And the limit of the north part of the land is from the inlet of the sea at the end of Jordan:

chinese: 上到伯曷拉，過伯亞拉巴的北邊，上到流便之子波罕的磐石；
english: Then the line goes up to Beth-hoglah, past the north of Beth-arabah, and up to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben;

chinese: 從亞割谷往北，上到底璧，直向河南亞都冥坡對面的吉甲；又接連到隱示麥泉，直通到隱羅結，
english: Then the line goes up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so to the north, in the direction of Gilgal, which is opposite the slope up to Adummim, on the south side of the river: and the line goes on to the waters of En-shemesh, ending at En-rogel:

chinese: 上到欣嫩子谷，貼近耶布斯的南界（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）；又上到欣嫩谷西邊的山頂，就是在利乏音谷極北的邊界；
english: Then the line goes up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the south side of the Jebusite (which is Jerusalem): then up to the top of the mountain in front of the valley of Hinnom to the west, which is at the farthest point of the valley of Rephaim on the north:

chinese: 又從山頂延到尼弗多亞的水源，通到以弗崙山的城邑，又延到巴拉（巴拉就是基列耶琳）；
english: And the limit is marked out from the top of the mountain to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah, and out to the towns of Mount Ephron, as far as Baalah (which is Kiriath-jearim):

chinese: 又從巴拉往西繞到西珥山，接連到耶琳山的北邊（耶琳就是基撒崙）；又下到伯示麥過亭納，
english: Then turning west, the line goes from Baalah to Mount Seir, and on to the side of Mount Jearim (which is Chesalon) on the north, then down to Beth-shemesh, and on past Timnah:

chinese: 通到以革倫北邊，延到施基崙，接連到巴拉山；又通到雅比聶，直通到海為止。
english: And out to the side of Ekron to the north: then it is marked out to Shikkeron and on to Mount Baalah, ending at Jabneel; the end of the line is at the sea.

chinese: 西界就是大海和靠近大海之地。這是猶大人按著宗族所得之地四圍的交界。
english: And the limit on the west is the edge of the Great Sea. This is the line going round the land marked out for the children of Judah, by their families.

chinese: 約書亞照耶和華所吩咐的，將猶大人中的一段地，就是基列亞巴，分給耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。亞巴是亞衲族的始祖（基列亞巴就是希伯崙）。
english: And to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, he gave a part among the children of Judah, as the Lord had given orders to Joshua, that is, Kiriath-arba, named after Arba, the father of Anak which is Hebron.

chinese: 迦勒就從那裡趕出亞衲族的三個族長，就是示篩、亞希幔、撻買；
english: And the three sons of Anak, Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai, the children of Anak, were forced out from there by Caleb.

chinese: 又從那裡上去，攻擊底璧的居民。（這底璧從前名叫基列西弗。）
english: From there he went up against the people of Debir: (now the name of Debir before that was Kiriath-sepher.)

chinese: 迦勒說：誰能攻打基列西弗將城奪取，我就把我女兒押撒給他為妻。
english: And Caleb said, I will give Achsah, my daughter, as wife to the man who overcomes Kiriath-sepher and takes it.

chinese: 迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶奪取了那城，迦勒就把女兒押撒給他為妻。
english: And Othniel, the son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, took it: so he gave him his daughter Achsah for his wife.

chinese: 押撒過門的時候，勸丈夫向他父親求一塊田，押撒一下驢，迦勒問他說：你要甚麼？
english: Now when she came to him, he put into her mind the idea of requesting a field from her father: and she got down from her ass; and Caleb said to her, What is it?

chinese: 他說：求你賜福給我，你既將我安置在南地，求你也給我水泉。他父親就把上泉下泉賜給他。
english: And she said, Give me a blessing; because you have put me in dry south-land, now give me springs of water. So he gave her the higher spring and the lower spring.

chinese: 以下是猶大支派按著宗族所得的產業。
english: This is the heritage of the tribe of Judah, by their families.

chinese: 猶大支派儘南邊的城邑，與以東交界相近的，就是甲薛、以得、雅姑珥、
english: The farthest towns of the tribe of Judah in the direction of the limits of Edom to the south, were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur;

chinese: 基拿、底摩拿、亞大達、
english: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah;

chinese: 基低斯、夏瑣、以提楠、
english: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan;

chinese: 西弗、提鍊、比亞綠、
english: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth;

chinese: 夏瑣哈大他、加略希斯崙（加略希斯崙就是夏瑣）、
english: And Hazor-hadattah, and Kerioth-hezron (which is Hazor);

chinese: 亞曼、示瑪、摩拉大、
english: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah;

chinese: 哈薩迦大、黑實門、伯帕列、
english: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-pelet;

chinese: 哈薩書亞、別是巴、比斯約他、
english: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Biziothiah;

chinese: 巴拉、以因、以森、
english: Baalah, and Iim, and Ezem;

chinese: 伊勒多臘、基失、何珥瑪、
english: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah;

chinese: 洗革拉、麥瑪拿、三撒拿、
english: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah;

chinese: 利巴勿、實忻、亞因、臨門，共二十九座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon; all the towns are twenty-nine, with their unwalled places.

chinese: 在高原有以實陶、瑣拉、亞實拿、
english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, and Zorah, and Ashnah;

chinese: 撒挪亞、隱干寧、他普亞、以楠、
english: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam;

chinese: 耶末、亞杜蘭、梭哥、亞西加、
english: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah;

chinese: 沙拉音、亞底他音、基底拉、基底羅他音，共十四座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 又有洗楠、哈大沙、麥大迦得、
english: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad;

chinese: 底連、米斯巴、約帖、
english: And Dilan, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel;

chinese: 拉吉、波斯加、伊磯倫、
english: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon;

chinese: 迦本、拉幔、基提利、
english: And Cabbon, and Lahmas, and Chithlish;

chinese: 基低羅、伯大袞、拿瑪、瑪基大，共十六座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 又有立拿、以帖、亞珊、
english: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan;

chinese: 益弗他、亞實拿、尼悉、
english: And Iphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib;

chinese: 基伊拉、亞革悉、瑪利沙，共九座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 又有以革倫和屬以革倫的鎮市村莊；
english: Ekron, with her daughter-towns and her unwalled places;

chinese: 從以革倫直到海，一切靠近亞實突之地，並屬其地的村莊。
english: From Ekron to the sea, all the towns by the side of Ashdod, with their unwalled places.

chinese: 亞實突和屬亞實突的鎮市村莊；迦薩和屬迦薩的鎮市村莊；直到埃及小河，並大海和靠近大海之地。
english: Ashdod, with her daughter-towns and her unwalled places; Gaza, with her daughter-towns and her unwalled places, to the stream of Egypt, with the Great Sea as a limit.

chinese: 在山地有沙密、雅提珥、梭哥、
english: And in the hill-country, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh;

chinese: 大拿、基列薩拿（基列薩拿就是底璧）、
english: And Dannah, and Kiriath-sannah (which is Debir);

chinese: 亞拿伯、以實提莫、亞念、
english: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim;

chinese: 歌珊、何倫、基羅，共十一座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 又有亞拉、度瑪、以珊、
english: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshan;

chinese: 雅農、伯他普亞、亞非加、
english: And Janim, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah;

chinese: 宏他、基列亞巴（基列亞巴就是希伯崙）、洗珥，共九座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Humtah, and Kiriath-arba (which is Hebron), and Zior; nine towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 又有瑪雲、迦密、西弗、淤他、
english: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Jutah;

chinese: 耶斯列、約甸、撒挪亞、
english: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah;

chinese: 該隱、基比亞、亭納，共十座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 又有哈忽、伯夙、基突、
english: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor;

chinese: 瑪臘、伯亞諾、伊勒提君，共六座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 又有基列巴力（基列巴力就是基列耶琳）、拉巴，共兩座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: Kiriath-baal (which is Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah; two towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 在曠野有伯亞拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、
english: In the waste land, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah;

chinese: 匿珊、鹽城、隱基底，共六座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Nibshan, and the Town of Salt, and En-gedi; six towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 至於住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，猶大人不能把他們趕出去，耶布斯人卻在耶路撒冷與猶大人同住，直到今日。
english: And as for the Jebusites living in Jerusalem, the children of Judah were unable to make them go out; but the Jebusites are living with the children of Judah at Jerusalem, to this day.

chinese: 約瑟的子孫拈鬮所得之地是從靠近耶利哥的約但河起，以耶利哥東邊的水為界：從耶利哥上去，通過山地的曠野，到伯特利；
english: And the limit of the land marked out for the children of Joseph went out from Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, in the waste land, going up from Jericho through the hill-country to Beth-el;

chinese: 又從伯特利到路斯，接連到亞基人的境界，至亞他綠；
english: And it goes out from Beth-el to Luz, and on as far as the limit of the Archites to Ataroth;

chinese: 又往西下到押利提人的境界，到下伯和崙的境界，直到基色，通到海為止。
english: And it goes down to the west to the limit of the Japhletites, to the limit of Beth-horon the lower, as far as Gezer; ending at the sea.

chinese: 約瑟的兒子瑪拿西、以法蓮就得了他們的地業。
english: And the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their heritage.

chinese: 以法蓮子孫的境界，按著宗族所得的，記在下面：他們地業的東界是亞他綠亞達到上伯和崙；
english: And the limit of the land of the children of Ephraim by their families was marked out in this way: the limit of their heritage to the east was Ataroth-addar, to Beth-horon the higher;

chinese: 往西通到北邊的密米他，又向東繞到他納示羅，又接連到雅挪哈的東邊；
english: The line goes out to the west at Michmethath on the north; then turning to the east to Taanath-shiloh, going past it on the east of Janoah;

chinese: 從雅挪哈下到亞他綠，又到拿拉，達到耶利哥，通到約但河為止；
english: And from Janoah down to Ataroth, and to Naarah, and touching Jericho, it goes on to Jordan.

chinese: 從他普亞往西，到加拿河，直通到海為止。這就是以法蓮支派按著宗族所得的地業。
english: From Tappuah the line goes on to the west to the river of Kanah; ending at the sea. This is the heritage of the children of Ephraim by their families;

chinese: 另外在瑪拿西人地業中得了些城邑和屬城的村莊。這都是分給以法蓮子孫的。
english: Together with the towns marked out for the children of Ephraim in the heritage of Manasseh, all the towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 他們沒有趕出住基色的迦南人；迦南人卻住在以法蓮人中間，成為作苦工的僕人，直到今日。
english: And the Canaanites who were living in Gezer were not forced out; but the Canaanites have been living among Ephraim, to this day, as servants, doing forced work.

chinese: 瑪拿西是約瑟的長子，他的支派拈鬮所得之地記在下面。至於瑪拿西的長子基列之父（父或作：主）瑪吉，因為是勇士就得了基列和巴珊。
english: And this was the part marked out for the tribe of Manasseh, because he was the oldest son of Joseph. As for Machir, the oldest son of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war he had Gilead and Bashan.

chinese: 瑪拿西其餘的子孫，按著宗族拈鬮分地，就是亞比以謝子孫，希勒子孫，亞斯列子孫，示劍子孫，希弗子孫，示米大子孫；這些按著宗族，都是約瑟兒子瑪拿西子孫的男丁。
english: And as for the rest of the children of Manasseh, their heritage was given to them by families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, by their families.

chinese: 瑪拿西的元孫，瑪吉的曾孫，基列的孫子，希弗的兒子西羅非哈沒有兒子，只有女兒。他的女兒名叫瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒；
english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

chinese: 他們來到祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞並眾首領面前，說：耶和華曾吩咐摩西在我們弟兄中分給我們產業。於是約書亞照耶和華所吩咐的，在他們伯叔中，把產業分給他們。
english: And they came before Eleazar the priest, and Joshua, the son of Nun, and before the chiefs, saying, The Lord gave orders to Moses to give us a heritage among our brothers: so in agreement with the orders of the Lord he gave them a heritage among their father's brothers.

chinese: 除了約但河東的基列和巴珊地之外，還有十分地歸瑪拿西，
english: And ten parts were given to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is on the other side of Jordan;

chinese: 因為瑪拿西的孫女們在瑪拿西的孫子中得了產業。基列地是屬瑪拿西其餘的子孫。
english: Because the daughters of Manasseh had a heritage among his sons, and the land of Gilead was the property of the other sons of Manasseh.

chinese: 瑪拿西的境界：從亞設起，到示劍前的密米他，往北到隱他普亞居民之地。
english: And the limit of Manasseh's land was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem; the line goes on to the right hand, to the people of En-tappuah.

chinese: 他普亞地歸瑪拿西，只是瑪拿西境界上的他普亞城歸以法蓮子孫。
english: The land of Tappuah was the property of Manasseh; but Tappuah on the edge of Manasseh was the property of the children of Ephraim.

chinese: 其界下到加拿河的南邊。在瑪拿西城邑中的這些城邑都歸以法蓮。瑪拿西的地界是在河北直通到海為止；
english: And the limit goes down to the stream Kanah, to the south of the stream: these towns were Ephraim's among the towns of Manasseh; Manasseh's limit was on the north side of the stream, ending at the sea:

chinese: 南歸以法蓮，北歸瑪拿西，以海為界；北邊到亞設，東邊到以薩迦。
english: To the south it is Ephraim's, and to the north it is Manasseh's, and the sea is his limit; and they are touching Asher on the north, and Issachar on the east.

chinese: 瑪拿西在以薩迦和亞設境內，有伯善和屬伯善的鎮市，以伯蓮和屬以伯蓮的鎮市，多珥的居民和屬多珥的鎮市；又有三處山岡，就是隱多珥和屬隱多珥的鎮市；他納的居民和屬他納的鎮市，米吉多的居民和屬米吉多的鎮市。
english: In Issachar and Asher, Manasseh had Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, and Ibleam and its daughter-towns, and the people of Dor and its daughter-towns, and the people of En-dor and its daughter-towns, and the people of Taanach and its daughter-towns, and the people of Megiddo and its daughter-towns, that is, the three hills.

chinese: 只是瑪拿西子孫不能趕出這些城的居民，迦南人偏要住在那地。
english: But the children of Manasseh were not able to make the people of those towns go out; but the Canaanites would go on living in that land.

chinese: 及至以色列人強盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，沒有把他們全然趕出。
english: And when the children of Israel had become strong, they put the Canaanites to forced work, in place of driving them out.

chinese: 約瑟的子孫對約書亞說：耶和華到如今既然賜福與我們，我們也族大人多，你為甚麼僅將一鬮一段之地分給我們為業呢？
english: Then the children of Joseph said to Joshua, Why have you given me only one part and one stretch of land for my heritage? For through the blessing given to me by the Lord up to now, I am a great people.

chinese: 約書亞說：你們如果族大人多，嫌以法蓮山地窄小，就可以上比利洗人、利乏音人之地，在樹林中砍伐樹木。
english: Then Joshua said to them, If you are such a great people, go up into the woodlands, clearing a place there for yourselves in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, if the hill-country of Ephraim is not wide enough for you.

chinese: 約瑟的子孫說：那山地容不下我們，並且住平原的迦南人，就是住伯善和屬伯善的鎮市，並住耶斯列平原的人，都有鐵車。
english: And the children of Joseph said, The hill-country is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites living in the valley have iron war-carriages, those in Beth-shean and its towns as well as those in the valley of Jezreel.

chinese: 約書亞對約瑟家，就是以法蓮和瑪拿西人，說：你是族大人多，並且強盛，不可僅有一鬮之地，
english: Then Joshua said to the children of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, You are a great people, and have great power: you are not to have one property only,

chinese: 山地也要歸你，雖是樹林，你也可以砍伐；靠近之地必歸你。迦南人雖有鐵車，雖是強盛，你也能把他們趕出去。
english: For the hill-country of Gilead will be yours ... the woodland and cut down ... its outskirts will be yours ... get the Canaanites out, for they have iron war-carriages ... strong.

chinese: 以色列的全會眾都聚集在示羅，把會幕設立在那裡，那地已經被他們制伏了。
english: And all the meeting of the children of Israel came together at Shiloh and put up the Tent of meeting there: and the land was crushed before them.

chinese: 以色列人中其餘的七個支派還沒有分給他們地業。
english: But there were still seven tribes among the children of Israel who had not taken up their heritage.

chinese: 約書亞對以色列人說：耶和華─你們列祖的神所賜給你們的地，你們耽延不去得，要到幾時呢？
english: Then Joshua said to the children of Israel, Why are you so slow to go in and take up your heritage in the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, has given you?

chinese: 你們每支派當選舉三個人，我要打發他們去，他們就要起身走遍那地，按著各支派應得的地業寫明（或作：畫圖），就回到我這裡來。
english: Take from among you three men from every tribe; and I will send them to go through the land and make a record of it for distribution as their heritage; then let them come back to me.

chinese: 他們要將地分做七分；猶大仍在南方，住在他的境內。約瑟家仍在北方，住在他的境內。
english: And let them make division of it into seven parts: let Judah keep inside his limit on the south, and let the children of Joseph keep inside their limit on the north.

chinese: 你們要將地分做七分，寫明了拿到我這裡來。我要在耶和華─我們神面前，為你們拈鬮。
english: And you are to have the land marked out in seven parts, and come back to me with the record; and I will make the distribution for you here by the decision of the Lord our God.

chinese: 利未人在你們中間沒有分，因為供耶和華祭司的職任就是他們的產業。迦得支派、流便支派，和瑪拿西半支派已經在約但河東得了地業，就是耶和華僕人摩西所給他們的。
english: For the Levites have no part among you; to be the Lord's priests is their heritage; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have had their heritage on the east side of Jordan, given to them by Moses, the servant of the Lord.

chinese: 劃地勢的人起身去的時候，約書亞囑咐他們說：你們去走遍那地，劃明地勢，就回到我這裡來。我要在示羅這裡，耶和華面前，為你們拈鬮。
english: So the men got up and went; and Joshua gave orders to those who went, to make a record of the land, saying, Go up and down through the land, and make a record of it and come back here to me, and I will make the distribution for you here by the decision of the Lord in Shiloh.

chinese: 他們就去了，走遍那地，按著城邑分做七分，寫在冊子上，回到示羅營中見約書亞。
english: So the men went, travelling through the land, and made a record of it by towns in seven parts in a book, and came back to Joshua to the tent-circle at Shiloh.

chinese: 約書亞就在示羅，耶和華面前，為他們拈鬮。約書亞在那裡，按著以色列人的支派，將地分給他們。
english: And Joshua made the distribution for them in Shiloh by the decision of the Lord, marking out the land for the children of Israel by their divisions.

chinese: 便雅憫支派，按著宗族拈鬮所得之地，是在猶大、約瑟子孫中間。
english: And the first heritage came out for the tribe of Benjamin by their families: and the limit of their heritage went between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

chinese: 他們的北界是從約但河起，往上貼近耶利哥的北邊；又往西通過山地，直到伯亞文的曠野；
english: And their limit on the north was from the Jordan, and the line goes up to the side of Jericho on the north and through the hill-country to the west, ending at the waste land of Beth-aven.

chinese: 從那裡往南接連到路斯，貼近路斯（路斯就是伯特利），又下到亞他綠亞達，靠近下伯和崙南邊的山；
english: And from there the line goes south to Luz, to the side of Luz (which is Beth-el), then down to Ataroth-addar, by the mountain to the south of Beth-horon the lower.

chinese: 從那裡往西，又轉向南，從伯和崙南對面的山，直達到猶大人的城基列巴力（基列巴力就是基列耶琳）；這是西界。
english: And the limit is marked as coming round to the south on the west side from the mountain which is south of Beth-horon, and ending at Kiriath-baal (which is Kiriath-jearim), a town of the children of Judah: this is the west part.

chinese: 南界是從基列耶琳的儘邊起，往西達到尼弗多亞的水源；
english: And the south part is from the farthest point of Kiriath-jearim, and the line goes out to the west to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah:

chinese: 又下到欣嫩子谷對面山的儘邊，就是利乏音谷北邊的山；又下到欣嫩谷，貼近耶布斯的南邊；又下到隱羅結；
english: And the line goes down to the farthest part of the mountain facing the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is on the north of the valley of Rephaim: from there it goes down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite on the south as far as En-rogel;

chinese: 又往北通到隱示麥，達到亞都冥坡對面的基利綠；又下到流便之子波罕的磐石；
english: And it goes to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth, opposite the way up to Adummim, and it goes down to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben;

chinese: 又接連到亞拉巴對面，往北下到亞拉巴；
english: And it goes on to the side facing the Arabah to the north, and down to the Arabah;

chinese: 又接連到伯曷拉的北邊，直通到鹽海的北汊，就是約但河的南頭；這是南界。
english: And on to the north side of Beth-hoglah, ending at the north inlet of the Salt Sea at the south end of Jordan; this is their limit on the south.

chinese: 東界是約但河。這是便雅憫人按著宗族，照他們四圍的交界所得的地業。
english: And the limit of the east part is the Jordan. This is the heritage of the children of Benjamin, marked out for their families by these limits on all sides.

chinese: 便雅憫支派按著宗族所得的城邑就是：耶利哥、伯曷拉、伊麥基悉、
english: And the towns of the children of Benjamin, given to them in the order of their families, are Jericho and Beth-hoglah and Emek-kezziz

chinese: 伯亞拉巴、洗瑪臉、伯特利、
english: And Beth-arabah and Zemaraim and Beth-el

chinese: 亞文、巴拉、俄弗拉、
english: And Avvim and Parah and Ophrah

chinese: 基法阿摩尼、俄弗尼、迦巴，共十二座城，還有屬城的村莊；
english: And Chephar-Ammoni and Ophni and Geba; twelve towns with their unwalled places;

chinese: 又有基遍、拉瑪、比錄、
english: Gibeon and Ramah and Beeroth

chinese: 米斯巴、基非拉、摩撒、
english: And Mizpeh and Chephirah and Mozah

chinese: 利堅、伊利毘勒、他拉拉、
english: And Rekem and Irpeel and Taralah

chinese: 洗拉、以利弗、耶布斯（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）、基比亞、基列，共十四座城，還有屬城的村莊。這是便雅憫人按著宗族所得的地業。
english: And Zela, Eleph and the Jebusite (which is Jerusalem), Gibeath and Kiriath; fourteen towns with their unwalled places. This is the heritage of the children of Benjamin by their families.

chinese: 為西緬支派的人，按著宗族，拈出第二鬮。他們所得的地業是在猶大人地業中間。
english: And the second heritage came out for the tribe of Simeon by their families; and their heritage was in the middle of the heritage of the children of Judah.

chinese: 他們所得為業之地就是：別是巴（或名示巴）、摩拉大、
english: And they had for their heritage Beer-sheba and Shema and Moladah

chinese: 哈薩書亞、巴拉、以森、
english: And Hazar-shual and Balah and Ezem

chinese: 伊利多拉、比土力、何珥瑪、
english: And Eltolad and Bethul and Hormah

chinese: 洗革拉、伯瑪加博、哈薩蘇撒、
english: And Ziklag and Beth-marcaboth and Hazar-susah

chinese: 伯利巴勿、沙魯險，共十三座城，還有屬城的村莊；
english: And Beth-lebaoth and Sharuhen; thirteen towns with their unwalled places;

chinese: 又有亞因、利門、以帖、亞珊，共四座城，還有屬城的村莊；
english: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether and Ashan; four towns with their unwalled places;

chinese: 並有這些城邑四圍一切的村莊，直到巴拉比珥，就是南地的拉瑪。這是西緬支派按著宗族所得的地業。
english: And all the unwalled places round about these towns as far as Baalath-beer-ramah to the south. This is the heritage of the tribe of Simeon by their families.

chinese: 西緬人的地業是從猶大人地業中得來的；因為猶大人的分過多，所以西緬人在他們的地業中得了地業。
english: The heritage of Simeon was taken out of Judah's stretch of land, for Judah's part was more than they had need of, so the heritage of the children of Simeon was inside their heritage.

chinese: 為西布倫人，按著宗族，拈出第三鬮。他們地業的境界是到撒立；
english: And the third heritage came out for Zebulun by their families; the limit of their heritage was as far as Sarid;

chinese: 往西上到瑪拉拉，達到大巴設，又達到約念前的河；
english: And their limit goes up to the west to Maralah, stretching to Dabbesheth, and to the stream in front of Jokneam;

chinese: 又從撒立往東轉向日出之地，到吉斯綠他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亞；
english: Then turning east from Sarid to the limit of Chisloth-tabor, it goes out to Daberath, and up to Japhia;

chinese: 從那裡往東，接連到迦特希弗，至以特加汛，通到臨門，臨門延到尼亞；
english: And from there it goes on east to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin; ending at Rimmon which goes as far as Neah;

chinese: 又繞過尼亞的北邊，轉到哈拿頓，通到伊弗他伊勒谷。
english: And the line goes round it on the north to Hannathon, ending at the valley of Iphtah-el;

chinese: 還有加他、拿哈拉、伸崙、以大拉、伯利恆，共十二座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Kattath and Nahalal and Shimron and Idalah and Beth-lehem; twelve towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是西布倫人按著宗族所得的地業。
english: This is the heritage of the children of Zebulun by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 為以薩迦人，按著宗族，拈出第四鬮。
english: For Issachar the fourth heritage came out, for the children of Issachar by their families;

chinese: 他們的境界是到耶斯列、基蘇律、書念、
english: And their limit was to Jezreel and Chesulloth and Shunem

chinese: 哈弗連、示按、亞拿哈拉、
english: And Hapharaim and Shion and Anaharath

chinese: 拉璧、基善、亞別、
english: And Rabbith and Kishion and Ebez

chinese: 利篾、隱干寧、隱哈大、伯帕薛；
english: And Remeth and En-gannim and En-haddah and Beth-pazzez;

chinese: 又達到他泊、沙哈洗瑪、伯示麥，直通到約但河為止，共十六座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And their limit goes as far as Tabor and Shahazimah and Beth-shemesh, ending at Jordan; sixteen towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是以薩迦支派按著宗族所得的地業。
english: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Issachar by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 為亞設支派，按著宗族，拈出第五鬮。
english: And the fifth heritage came out for the tribe of Asher by their families.

chinese: 他們的境界是黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、
english: And their limit was Helkath and Hali and Beten and Achshaph

chinese: 亞拉米勒、亞末、米沙勒；往西達到迦密，又到希曷立納，
english: And Alammelech and Amad and Mishal, stretching to Carmel on the west and Shihor-libnath;

chinese: 轉向日出之地，到伯大袞，達到細步綸往北到伊弗他伊勒谷，到伯以墨和尼業，也通到迦步勒的左邊；
english: Turning to the east to Beth-dagon and stretching to Zebulun and the valley of Iphtah-el as far as Beth-emek and Neiel to the north; on the left it goes as far as Cabul

chinese: 又到義伯崙、利合、哈們、加拿，直到西頓大城；
english: And Ebron and Rehob and Hammon and Kanah, to great Zidon;

chinese: 轉到拉瑪和堅固城推羅；又轉到何薩，靠近亞革悉一帶地方，直通到海；
english: And the limit goes round to Ramah and the walled town of Tyre and Hosah, ending at the sea by Heleb and Achzib;

chinese: 又有烏瑪、亞弗、利合，共二十二座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Ummah and Aphek and Rehob; twenty-two towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是亞設支派按著宗族所得的地業。
english: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Asher by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 為拿弗他利人，按著宗族，拈出第六鬮。
english: For the children of Naphtali the sixth heritage came out, for the children of Naphtali by their families;

chinese: 他們的境界是從希利弗從撒拿音的橡樹，從亞大米尼吉和雅比聶，直到拉共，通到約但河；
english: And their limit was from Heleph, from the oak-tree in Zaanannim, and Adami-hannekeb and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum, ending at Jordan;

chinese: 又轉向西到亞斯納他泊，從那裡通到戶割，南邊到西布倫，西邊到亞設，又向日出之地，達到約但河那裡的猶大。
english: And turning west to Aznoth-tabor, the limit goes out from there to Hukkok, stretching to Zebulun on the south, and Asher on the west, and Judah at Jordan on the east.

chinese: 堅固的城就是：西丁、側耳、哈末、拉甲、基尼烈、
english: And the walled towns are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth

chinese: 亞大瑪、拉瑪、夏瑣、
english: And Adamah and Ramah and Hazor

chinese: 基低斯、以得來、隱夏瑣、
english: And Kedesh and Edrei and En-Hazor

chinese: 以利穩、密大伊勒、和璉、伯亞納、伯示麥，共十九座城，還有屬城的村莊。
english: And Iron and Migdal-el, Horem and Beth-anath and Beth-shemesh; nineteen towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是拿弗他利支派按著宗族所得的地業。
english: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Naphtali by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 為但支派，按著宗族，拈出第七鬮。
english: For the tribe of Dan by their families the seventh heritage came out;

chinese: 他們地業的境界是瑣拉、以實陶、伊珥示麥、
english: And the limit of their heritage was Zorah and Eshtaol and Ir-shemesh

chinese: 沙拉賓、亞雅崙、伊提拉、
english: And Shaalabbin and Aijalon and Ithlah

chinese: 以倫、亭拿他、以革倫、
english: And Elon and Timnah and Ekron

chinese: 伊利提基、基比頓、巴拉、
english: And Eltekeh and Gibbethon and Baalath

chinese: 伊胡得、比尼比拉、迦特臨門、
english: And Jehud and Bene-berak and Gath-rimmon;

chinese: 美耶昆、拉昆，並約帕對面的地界。
english: And on the west was ... opposite Joppa.

chinese: 但人的地界越過原得的地界；因為但人上去攻取利善，用刀擊殺城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他們先祖但的名將利善改名為但。
english: (But the limit of the children of Dan was not wide enough for them; so the children of Dan went up and made war on Leshem and took it, putting it to the sword without mercy, and they took it for their heritage and made a place for themselves there, giving it the name of Leshem-dan, after the name of their father, Dan.)

chinese: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是但支派按著宗族所得的地業。
english: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Dan by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

chinese: 以色列人按著境界分完了地業，就在他們中間將地給嫩的兒子約書亞為業，
english: So the distribution of the land and its limits was complete; and the children of Israel gave Joshua, the son of Nun, a heritage among them;

chinese: 是照耶和華的吩咐，將約書亞所求的城，就是以法蓮山地的亭拿西拉城，給了他。他就修那城，住在其中。
english: By the orders of the Lord they gave him the town for which he made request, Timnath-serah in the hill-country of Ephraim: there, after building the town, he made his living-place.

chinese: 這就是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列各支派的族長，在示羅會幕門口，耶和華面前，拈鬮所分的地業。這樣，他們把地分完了。
english: These are the heritages which Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun, and the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel gave out at Shiloh, by the decision of the Lord, at the door of the Tent of meeting. So the distribution of the land was complete.

chinese: 耶和華曉諭約書亞說：
english: And the Lord said to Joshua,

chinese: 你吩咐以色列人說：你們要照著我藉摩西所曉諭你們的，為自己設立逃城，
english: Say to the children of Israel, Let certain towns be marked out as safe places, as I said to you by the mouth of Moses,

chinese: 使那無心而誤殺人的，可以逃到那裡。這些城可以作你們逃避報血仇人的地方。
english: So that any man who in error and without design has taken the life of another, may go in flight to them: and they will be safe places for you from him who has the right of punishment for blood.

chinese: 那殺人的要逃到這些城中的一座城，站在城門口，將他的事情說給城內的長老們聽。他們就把他收進城裡，給他地方，使他住在他們中間。
english: And if anyone goes in flight to one of those towns, and comes into the public place of the town, and puts his cause before the responsible men of the town, they will take him into the town and give him a place among them where he may be safe.

chinese: 若是報血仇的追了他來，長老不可將他交在報血仇的手裡；因為他是素無仇恨，無心殺了人的。
english: And if the one who has the right of punishment comes after him, they are not to give the taker of life up to him; because he was the cause of his neighbour's death without designing it and not in hate.

chinese: 他要住在那城裡，站在會眾面前聽審判，等到那時的大祭司死了，殺人的才可以回到本城本家，就是他所逃出來的那城。
english: And he is to go on living in that town till he has to come before the meeting of the people to be judged; (till the death of him who is high priest at that time:) then the taker of life may come back to his town and to his house, to the town from which he had gone in flight.

chinese: 於是，以色列人在拿弗他利山地分定加利利的基低斯；在以法蓮山地分定示劍；在猶大山地分定基列亞巴（基列亞巴就是希伯崙）；
english: So they made selection of Kedesh in Galilee in the hill-country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (which is Hebron) in the hill-country of Judah.

chinese: 又在約但河外耶利哥東，從流便支派中，在曠野的平原，設立比悉；從迦得支派中設立基列的拉末；從瑪拿西支派中設立巴珊的哥蘭。
english: And on the east side of Jordan at Jericho, they made selection of Bezer in the waste land, in the table-land, out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

chinese: 這都是為以色列眾人和在他們中間寄居的外人所分定的地邑，使誤殺人的都可以逃到那裡，不死在報血仇人的手中，等他站在會眾面前聽審判。
english: These were the towns marked out for all the children of Israel and for the man from a strange country living among them, so that anyone causing the death of another in error, might go in flight there, and not be put to death by him who has the right of punishment for blood till he had come before the meeting of the people.

chinese: 那時，利未人的眾族長來到祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列各支派的族長面前，
english: Then the heads of the families of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun, and to the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel;

chinese: 在迦南地的示羅對他們說：從前耶和華藉著摩西吩咐給我們城邑居住，並城邑的郊野可以牧養我們的牲畜。
english: And said to them in Shiloh in the land of Canaan, The Lord gave orders by Moses that we were to have towns for living in, with their grass-lands for our cattle.

chinese: 於是以色列人照耶和華所吩咐的，從自己的地業中，將以下所記的城邑和城邑的郊野給了利未人。
english: And the children of Israel out of their heritage gave to the Levites these towns with their grass-lands, by the order of the Lord.

chinese: 為哥轄族拈鬮：利未人的祭司、亞倫的子孫，從猶大支派、西緬支派、便雅憫支派的地業中，按鬮得了十三座城。
english: And the heritage came out for the families of the Kohathites: the children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, were given thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

chinese: 哥轄其餘的子孫，從以法蓮支派、但支派、瑪拿西半支派的地業中，按鬮得了十座城。
english: The rest of the children of Kohath by their families were given ten towns from the tribes of Ephraim and Dan and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

chinese: 革順的子孫，從以薩迦支派、亞設支派、拿弗他利支派、住巴珊的瑪拿西半支派的地業中，按鬮得了十三座城。
english: The children of Gershon by their families were given thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar and Asher and Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh which was in Bashan.

chinese: 米拉利的子孫，按著宗族，從流便支派、迦得支派、西布倫支派的地業中，按鬮得了十二座城。
english: The children of Merari by their families were given twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben and Gad and Zebulun.

chinese: 以色列人照著耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的，將這些城邑和城邑的郊野，按鬮分給利未人。
english: All these towns with their grass-lands the children of Israel gave by the decision of the Lord to the Levites, as the Lord had given orders by Moses.

chinese: 從猶大支派、西緬支派的地業中，將以下所記的城給了利未支派哥轄宗族亞倫的子孫；因為給他們拈出頭一鬮，
english: From the tribes of the children of Judah and the children of Simeon they gave these towns, listed here by name:
These were for the children of Aaron among the families of the Kohathites, of the children of Levi: for they came first in the distribution.

chinese: 將猶大山地的基列亞巴和四圍的郊野給了他們。亞巴是亞衲族的始祖。（基列亞巴就是希伯崙）。
english: They gave them Kiriath-arba, the town of Arba, the father of Anak, (which is Hebron) in the hill-country of Judah, with its grass-lands.

chinese: 惟將屬城的田地和村莊給了耶孚尼的兒子迦勒為業。
english: But the open country round the town, and its unwalled places, they gave to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, as his property.

chinese: 以色列人將希伯崙，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了祭司亞倫的子孫；又給他們立拿和屬城的郊野，
english: And to the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Libnah with its grass-lands;

chinese: 雅提珥和屬城的郊野，以實提莫和屬城的郊野，
english: And Jattir with its grass-lands, and Eshtemoa with its grass-lands;

chinese: 何崙和屬城的郊野，底璧和屬城的郊野，
english: And Holon with its grass-lands, and Debir with its grass-lands;

chinese: 亞因和屬城的郊野，淤他和屬城的郊野，伯示麥和屬城的郊野，共九座城，都是從這二支派中分出來的。
english: And Ain, and Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, with their grass-lands; nine towns from those two tribes.

chinese: 又從便雅憫支派的地業中給了他們基遍和屬城的郊野，迦巴和屬城的郊野，
english: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave Gibeon and Geba with their grass-lands;

chinese: 亞拿突和屬城的郊野，亞勒們和屬城的郊野，共四座城。
english: Anathoth and Almon with their grass-lands, four towns.

chinese: 亞倫子孫作祭司的共有十三座城，還有屬城的郊野。
english: Thirteen towns with their grass-lands were given to the children of Aaron, the priests.

chinese: 利未支派中哥轄的宗族，就是哥轄其餘的子孫，拈鬮所得的城有從以法蓮支派中分出來的。
english: The rest of the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, were given towns from the tribe of Ephraim.

chinese: 以色列人將以法蓮山地的示劍，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們基色和屬城的郊野，
english: And they gave them Shechem with its grass-lands in the hill-country of Ephraim, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Gezer with its grass-lands;

chinese: 基伯先和屬城的郊野，伯和崙和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
english: And Kibzaim and Beth-horon with their grass-lands, four towns.

chinese: 又從但支派的地業中給了他們伊利提基和屬城的郊野，基比頓和屬城的郊野，
english: And from the tribe of Dan, Elteke and Gibbethon with their grass-lands;

chinese: 亞雅崙和屬城的郊野，迦特臨門和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
english: Aijalon and Gath-rimmon with their grass-lands, four towns.

chinese: 又從瑪拿西半支派的地業中給了他們他納和屬城的郊野，迦特臨門和屬城的郊野，共兩座城。
english: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach and Gath-rimmon with their grass-lands, two towns.

chinese: 哥轄其餘的子孫共有十座城，還有屬城的郊野。
english: All the towns of the rest of the families of the children of Kohath were ten with their grass-lands.

chinese: 以色列人又從瑪拿西半支派的地業中將巴珊的哥蘭，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了利未支派革順的子孫；又給他們比施提拉和屬城的郊野，共兩座城；
english: And to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, they gave from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Ashtaroth with its grass-lands, two towns.

chinese: 又從以薩迦支派的地業中給了他們基善和屬城的郊野，大比拉和屬城的郊野，
english: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kishion and Daberath with their grass-lands;

chinese: 耶末和屬城的郊野，隱干寧和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
english: Jarmuth and En-gannim with their grass-lands, four towns.

chinese: 又從亞設支派的地業中給了他們米沙勒和屬城的郊野，押頓和屬城的郊野，
english: And from the tribe of Asher, Mishal and Abdon, with their grass-lands:

chinese: 黑甲和屬城的郊野，利合和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
english: Helkath and Rehob with their grass-lands, four towns.

chinese: 又從拿弗他利支派的地業中將加利利的基低斯，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們哈末多珥和屬城的郊野，加珥坦和屬城的郊野，共三座城。
english: And from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Hammoth-dor and Kartan with their grass-lands, three towns.

chinese: 革順人按著宗族所得的城，共十三座，還有屬城的郊野。
english: All the towns of the Gershonites with their families were thirteen with their grass-lands.

chinese: 其餘利未支派米拉利子孫，從西布倫支派的地業中所得的，就是約念和屬城的郊野，加珥他和屬城的郊野，
english: And to the rest of the Levites, that is, the families of the children of Merari, they gave from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam and Kartah with their grass-lands;

chinese: 丁拿和屬城的郊野，拿哈拉和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
english: Dimnah and Nahalal with their grass-lands, four towns.

chinese: 又從流便支派的地業中給了他們比悉和屬城的郊野，雅雜和屬城的郊野，
english: And from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer and Jahaz with their grass-lands;

chinese: 基底莫和屬城的郊野，米法押和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
english: Kedemoth and Mephaath with their grass-lands, four towns.

chinese: 又從迦得支派的地業中，將基列的拉末，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們瑪哈念和屬城的郊野，
english: And from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Mahanaim with their grass-lands;

chinese: 希實本和屬城的郊野，雅謝和屬城的郊野，共四座城。
english: Heshbon and Jazer with their grass-lands, four towns.

chinese: 其餘利未支派的人，就是米拉利的子孫，按著宗族拈鬮所得的，共十二座城。
english: All these towns were given to the children of Merari by their families, that is, the rest of the families of the Levites; and their heritage was twelve towns.

chinese: 利未人在以色列人的地業中所得的城，共四十八座，並有屬城的郊野。
english: All the towns of the Levites, among the heritage of the children of Israel, were forty-eight towns with their grass-lands.

chinese: 這些城四圍都有屬城的郊野，城城都是如此。
english: Every one of these towns had grass-lands round it.

chinese: 這樣，耶和華將從前向他們列祖起誓所應許的全地賜給以色列人，他們就得了為業，住在其中。
english: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land which he gave by oath to their fathers; so it became their heritage and their living-place.

chinese: 耶和華照著向他們列祖起誓所應許的一切話，使他們四境平安；他們一切仇敵中，沒有一人在他們面前站立得住。耶和華把一切仇敵都交在他們手中。
english: And the Lord gave them peace on every side, as he had said to their fathers: all those who were against them gave way before them, for the Lord gave them all up into their hands.

chinese: 耶和華應許賜福給以色列家的話一句也沒有落空，都應驗了。
english: The Lord kept faith with the house of Israel about all the good which he said he would do for them, and all his words came true.

chinese: 當時，約書亞召了流便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人來，
english: Then Joshua sent for the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

chinese: 對他們說：耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐你們的，你們都遵守了；我所吩咐你們的，你們也都聽從了。
english: And said to them, You have kept all the orders of Moses, the Lord's servant, and have done everything I gave you orders to do:

chinese: 你們這許多日子，總沒有撇離你們的弟兄，直到今日，並守了耶和華─你們神所吩咐你們當守的。
english: You have now been with your brothers for a long time; till this day you have been doing the orders of the Lord your God.

chinese: 如今耶和華─你們神照著他所應許的，使你們弟兄得享平安，現在可以轉回你們的帳棚，到耶和華的僕人摩西在約但河東所賜你們為業之地。
english: And now the Lord your God has given your brothers rest, as he said: so now you may go back to your tents, to the land of your heritage, which Moses, the Lord's servant, gave to you on the other side of Jordan.

chinese: 只要切切的謹慎遵行耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐你們的誡命律法，愛耶和華─你們的神，行他一切的道，守他的誡命，專靠他，盡心盡性事奉他。
english: Only take great care to do the orders and the law which Moses, the Lord's servant, gave you; to have love for the Lord your God and to go in all his ways; and to keep his laws and to be true to him and to be his servants with all your heart and with all your soul.

chinese: 於是約書亞為他們祝福，打發他們去，他們就回自己的帳棚去了。
english: Then Joshua gave them his blessing and sent them away: and they went back to their tents.

chinese: 瑪拿西那半支派，摩西早已在巴珊分給他們地業。這半支派，約書亞在約但河西，在他們弟兄中，分給他們地業。約書亞打發他們回帳棚的時候為他們祝福，
english: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh, Moses had given a heritage in Bashan; but to the other half, Joshua gave a heritage among their brothers on the west side of Jordan. Now when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he gave them his blessing,

chinese: 對他們說：你們帶許多財物，許多牲畜和金、銀、銅、鐵，並許多衣服，回你們的帳棚去，要將你們從仇敵奪來的物，與你們眾弟兄同分。
english: And said to them, Go back with much wealth to your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver and gold and brass and iron, and with a very great store of clothing; give your brothers a part of the goods taken in the war.

chinese: 於是流便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人從迦南地的示羅起行，離開以色列人，回往他們得為業的基列地，就是照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的得了為業之地。
english: So Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh went back, parting from the children of Israel at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their heritage which had been given to them by the Lord's order to Moses.

chinese: 流便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人到了靠近約但河的一帶迦南地，就在約但河那裡築了一座壇；那壇看著高大。
english: Now when they came to the country by Jordan in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh put up there, by Jordan, a great altar, seen from far.

chinese: 以色列人聽說流便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人靠近約但河邊，在迦南地屬以色列人的那邊築了一座壇。
english: And news came to the children of Israel, See, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have put up an altar opposite the land of Canaan, in the country by Jordan on the side which is Israel's.

chinese: 全會眾一聽見，就聚集在示羅，要上去攻打他們。
english: Then all the meeting of the children of Israel, hearing this, came together at Shiloh to go up against them to war.

chinese: 以色列人打發祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈，往基列地去見流便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人；
english: And the children of Israel sent Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, to the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead,

chinese: 又打發十個首領與非尼哈同去，就是以色列每支派的一個首領，都是以色列軍中的統領。
english: And with him they sent ten chiefs, one for every tribe of the children of Israel, every one of them the head of his house among the families of Israel.

chinese: 他們到了基列地，見流便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人，對他們說：
english: And they came to the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and said to them,

chinese: 耶和華全會眾這樣說，你們今日轉去不跟從耶和華，干犯以色列的神，為自己築一座壇，悖逆了耶和華，這犯的是甚麼罪呢？
english: This is what all the meeting of the people of the Lord has said, What is this wrong which you have done against the God of Israel, turning back this day from the Lord and building an altar for yourselves, and being false to the Lord?

chinese: 從前拜毘珥的罪孽還算小麼？雖然瘟疫臨到耶和華的會眾，到今日我們還沒有洗淨這罪。
english: Was not the sin of Baal-peor great enough, from which we are not clear even to this day, though punishment came on the people of the Lord,

chinese: 你們今日竟轉去不跟從耶和華麼？你們今日既悖逆耶和華，明日他必向以色列全會眾發怒。
english: That now you are turned back from the Lord? and, because you are false to him today, tomorrow his wrath will be let loose on all the people of Israel.

chinese: 你們所得為業之地，若嫌不潔淨，就可以過到耶和華之地，就是耶和華的帳幕所住之地，在我們中間得地業。只是不可悖逆耶和華，也不可得罪我們，在耶和華─我們神的壇以外為自己築壇。
english: But if the land you now have is unclean, come over into the Lord's land where his House is, and take up your heritage among us: but do not be false to the Lord and to us by building yourselves an altar in addition to the altar of the Lord our God.

chinese: 從前謝拉的曾孫亞干豈不是在那當滅的物上犯了罪，就有忿怒臨到以色列全會眾麼？那人在所犯的罪中不獨一人死亡。
english: Did not Achan, the son of Zerah, do wrong about the cursed thing, causing wrath to come on all the people of Israel? And not on him only came the punishment of death.

chinese: 於是流便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人回答以色列軍中的統領說：
english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh said in answer to the heads of the families of Israel,

chinese: 大能者神耶和華！大能者神耶和華！他是知道的！以色列人也必知道！我們若有悖逆的意思，或是干犯耶和華（願你今日不保佑我們），
english: God, even God the Lord, God, even God the Lord, he sees, and Israel will see--if it is in pride or in sin against the Lord,

chinese: 為自己築壇，要轉去不跟從耶和華，或是要將燔祭、素祭、平安祭獻在壇上，願耶和華親自討我們的罪。
english: That we have made ourselves an altar, being false to the Lord, keep us not safe from death this day; and if for the purpose of offering burned offerings on it and meal offerings, or peace-offerings, let the Lord himself send punishment for it;

chinese: 我們行這事並非無故，是特意做的，說：恐怕日後你們的子孫對我們的子孫說：你們與耶和華─以色列的神有何關涉呢？
english: And if we have not, in fact, done this designedly and with purpose, having in our minds the fear that in time to come your children might say to our children, What have you to do with the Lord, the God of Israel?

chinese: 因為耶和華把約但河定為我們和你們這流便人、迦得人的交界，你們與耶和華無分了。這樣，你們的子孫就使我們的子孫不再敬畏耶和華了。
english: For the Lord has made Jordan a line of division between us and you, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad; you have no part in the Lord: so your children will make our children give up fearing the Lord.

chinese: 因此我們說：不如為自己築一座壇，不是為獻燔祭，也不是為獻別的祭，
english: So we said, Let us now make an altar for ourselves, not for burned offerings or for the offerings of beasts:

chinese: 乃是為你我中間和你我後人中間作證據，好叫我們也在耶和華面前獻燔祭、平安祭，和別的祭事奉他，免得你們的子孫日後對我們的子孫說，你們與耶和華無分了。
english: But to be a witness between us and you, and between the future generations, that we have the right of worshipping the Lord with our burned offerings and our offerings of beasts and our peace-offerings; so that your children will not be able to say to our children in time to come, You have no part in the Lord.

chinese: 所以我們說：日後你們對我們，或對我們的後人這樣說，我們就可以回答說，你們看我們列祖所築的壇是耶和華壇的樣式；這並不是為獻燔祭，也不是為獻別的祭，乃是為作你我中間的證據。
english: For we said to ourselves, If they say this to us or to future generations, then we will say, See this copy of the Lord's altar which our fathers made, not for burned offerings or offerings of beasts, but for a witness between us and you.

chinese: 我們在耶和華─我們神帳幕前的壇以外，另築一座壇，為獻燔祭、素祭，和別的祭，悖逆耶和華，今日轉去不跟從他，我們斷沒有這個意思。
