english: Never let it be said that we were false to the Lord, turning back this day from him and building an altar for burned offerings and meal offerings and offerings of beasts, in addition to the altar of the Lord our God which is before his House.

chinese: 祭司非尼哈與會中的首領，就是與他同來以色列軍中的統領，聽見流便人、迦得人、瑪拿西人所說的話，就都以為美。
english: Then Phinehas the priest and the chiefs of the meeting and the heads of the families of Israel who were with him, hearing what the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh said, were pleased.

chinese: 祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈對流便人、迦得人、瑪拿西人說：今日我們知道耶和華在我們中間，因為你們沒有向他犯了這罪。現在你們救以色列人脫離耶和華的手了。
english: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, said to the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh, Now we are certain that the Lord is among us, because you have not done this wrong against the Lord: and you have kept us from falling into the hands of the Lord.

chinese: 祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈與眾首領離了流便人、迦得人，從基列地回往迦南地，到了以色列人那裡，便將這事回報他們。
english: Then Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, and the chiefs went back from the land of Gilead, from the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and came to the children of Israel in Canaan and gave them the news.

chinese: 以色列人以這事為美，就稱頌神，不再提上去攻打流便人、迦得人、毀壞他們所住的地了。
english: And the children of Israel were pleased about this; and they gave praise to God, and had no more thought of going to war against the children of Reuben and the children of Gad for the destruction of their land.

chinese: 流便人、迦得人給壇起名叫證壇，意思說：這壇在我們中間證明耶和華是神。
english: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad gave to that altar the name of Ed. For, they said, It is a witness between us that the Lord is God.

chinese: 耶和華使以色列人安靜，不與四圍的一切仇敵爭戰，已經多日。約書亞年紀老邁，
english: Now after a long time, when the Lord had given Israel rest from wars on every side, and Joshua was old and full of years,

chinese: 就把以色列眾人的長老、族長、審判官，並官長都召了來，對他們說：我年紀已經老邁。
english: Joshua sent for all Israel, for their responsible men and their chiefs and their judges and their overseers, and said to them, I am old, and full of years:

chinese: 耶和華─你們的神因你們的緣故向那些國所行的一切事，你們親眼看見了，因那為你們爭戰的是耶和華─你們的　神。
english: You have seen everything the Lord your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is the Lord your God who has been fighting for you.

chinese: 我所剪除和所剩下的各國，從約但河起到日落之處的大海，我已經拈鬮分給你們各支派為業。
english: Now I have given to you, as the heritage of your tribes, all these nations which are still in the land, together with those cut off by me, from Jordan as far as the Great Sea on the west.

chinese: 耶和華─你們的神必將他們從你們面前趕出去，使他們離開你們，你們就必得他們的地為業，正如耶和華─你們的　神所應許的。
english: The Lord your God will send them away by force, driving them out before you; and you are to take their land for your heritage, as the Lord your God said to you.

chinese: 所以，你們要大大壯膽，謹守遵行寫在摩西律法書上的一切話，不可偏離左右。
english: So be very strong to keep and do whatever is recorded in the book of the law of Moses, not turning away from it to the right or to the left;

chinese: 不可與你們中間所剩下的這些國民攙雜。他們的神，你們不可提他的名，不可指著他起誓，也不可事奉、叩拜；
english: Have nothing to do with these nations who still are living among you; let not their gods be named by you or used in your oaths; do not be their servants or give them worship:

chinese: 只要照著你們到今日所行的，專靠耶和華─你們的神。
english: But be true to the Lord your God as you have been till this day.

chinese: 因為耶和華已經把又大又強的國民從你們面前趕出；直到今日，沒有一人在你們面前站立得住。
english: For the Lord has sent out from before you nations great and strong: and they have all given way before you till this day.

chinese: 你們一人必追趕千人，因耶和華─你們的神照他所應許的，為你們爭戰。
english: One man of you is able to put to flight a thousand; for it is the Lord your God who is fighting for you, as he has said to you.

chinese: 你們要分外謹慎，愛耶和華─你們的神。
english: So keep watch on yourselves, and see that you have love for the Lord your God.

chinese: 你們若稍微轉去，與你們中間所剩下的這些國民聯絡，彼此結親，互相往來，
english: For if you go back, joining yourselves to the rest of these nations who are still among you, getting married to them and living with them and they with you:

chinese: 你們要確實知道，耶和華─你們的神必不再將他們從你們眼前趕出；他們卻要成為你們的網羅、機檻、肋上的鞭、眼中的刺，直到你們在耶和華─你們　神所賜的這美地上滅亡。
english: Then you may be certain that the Lord your God will not go on driving these nations out from before you; but they will become a danger and a cause of sin to you, a whip for your sides and thorns in your eyes, till you are cut off from this good land which the Lord your God has given you.

chinese: 我現在要走世人必走的路。你們是一心一意的知道，耶和華─你們神所應許賜福與你們的話沒有一句落空，都應驗在你們身上了。
english: Now I am about to go the way of all the earth: and you have seen and are certain, all of you, in your hearts and souls, that in all the good things which the Lord said about you, he has kept faith with you; everything has come true for you.

chinese: 耶和華─你們神所應許的一切福氣怎樣臨到你們身上，耶和華也必照樣使各樣禍患臨到你們身上，直到把你們從耶和華─你們　神所賜的這美地上除滅。
english: And you will see that, as all the good things which the Lord your God undertook to do for you, have come to you, so the Lord will send down on you all the evil things till he has made your destruction complete, and you are cut off from the good land which the Lord your God has given you.

chinese: 你們若違背耶和華─你們神吩咐你們所守的約，去事奉別　神，叩拜他，耶和華的怒氣必向你們發作，使你們在他所賜的美地上速速滅亡。
english: If the agreement of the Lord your God, which was given to you by his orders, is broken, and you become the servants of other gods and give them worship, then the wrath of the Lord will be burning against you, and you will quickly be cut off from the good land which he has given you.

chinese: 約書亞將以色列的眾支派聚集在示劍，召了以色列的長老、族長、審判官，並官長來，他們就站在神面前。
english: Then Joshua got all the tribes of Israel together at Shechem; and he sent for the responsible men of Israel and their chiefs and their judges and their overseers; and they took their place before God.

chinese: 約書亞對眾民說：耶和華─以色列的神如此說：古時你們的列祖，就是亞伯拉罕和拿鶴的父親他拉，住在大河那邊事奉別　神，
english: And Joshua said to all the people, These are the words of the Lord, the God of Israel: In the past your fathers, Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor, were living on the other side of the River: and they were worshipping other gods.

chinese: 我將你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕從大河那邊帶來，領他走遍迦南全地，又使他的子孫眾多，把以撒賜給他；
english: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the River, guiding him through all the land of Canaan; I made his offspring great in number, and gave him Isaac.

chinese: 又把雅各和以掃賜給以撒，將西珥山賜給以掃為業；後來雅各和他的子孫下到埃及去了。
english: And to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau: to Esau I gave Mount Seir, as his heritage; but Jacob and his children went down to Egypt.

chinese: 我差遣摩西、亞倫，並照我在埃及中所行的降災與埃及，然後把你們領出來。
english: And I sent Moses and Aaron, troubling Egypt by all the signs I did among them: and after that I took you out.

chinese: 我領你們列祖出埃及，他們就到了紅海；埃及人帶領車輛馬兵追趕你們列祖到紅海。
english: I took your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the Red Sea; and the Egyptians came after your fathers to the Red Sea, with their war-carriages and their horsemen.

chinese: 你們列祖哀求耶和華，他就使你們和埃及人中間黑暗了，又使海水淹沒埃及人。我在埃及所行的事，你們親眼見過。你們在曠野也住了許多年日。
english: And at their cry, the Lord made it dark between you and the Egyptians, and made the sea go over them, covering them with its waters; your eyes have seen what I did in Egypt: then for a long time you were living in the waste land.

chinese: 我領你們到約但河東亞摩利人所住之地。他們與你們爭戰，我將他們交在你們手中，你們便得了他們的地為業；我也在你們面前將他們滅絕。
english: And I took you into the lands of the Amorites on the other side of Jordan; and they made war on you, and I gave them into your hands and you took their land; and I sent destruction on them before you.

chinese: 那時，摩押王西撥的兒子巴勒起來攻擊以色列人，打發人召了比珥的兒子巴蘭來咒詛你們。
english: Then Balak, the son of Zippor, king of Moab, went up to war against Israel; and he sent for Balaam, the son of Beor, to put a curse on you:

chinese: 我不肯聽巴蘭的話，所以他倒為你們連連祝福。這樣，我便救你們脫離巴勒的手。
english: But I did not give ear to Balaam; and so he went on blessing you; and I kept you safe from him.

chinese: 你們過了約但河，到了耶利哥；耶利哥人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、迦南人、赫人、革迦撒人、希未人、耶布斯人都與你們爭戰；我把他們交在你們手裡。
english: Then you went over Jordan and came to Jericho: and the men of Jericho made war on you, the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Hivites and the Jebusites: and I gave them up into your hands.

chinese: 我打發黃蜂飛在你們前面，將亞摩利人的二王從你們面前攆出，並不是用你的刀，也不是用你的弓。
english: And I sent the hornet before you, driving out the two kings of the Amorites before you, not with your sword and your bow.

chinese: 我賜給你們地土，非你們所修治的；我賜給你們城邑，非你們所建造的。你們就住在其中，又得吃非你們所栽種的葡萄園、橄欖園的果子。
english: And I gave you a land on which you had done no work, and towns not of your building, and you are now living in them; and your food comes from vine-gardens and olive-gardens not of your planting.

chinese: 現在你們要敬畏耶和華，誠心實意的事奉他，將你們列祖在大河那邊和在埃及所事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和華。
english: So now, go in fear of the Lord, and be his servants with true hearts: put away the gods worshipped by your fathers across the River and in Egypt, and be servants of the Lord.

chinese: 若是你們以事奉耶和華為不好，今日就可以選擇所要事奉的：是你們列祖在大河那邊所事奉的神呢？是你們所住這地的亞摩利人的　神呢？至於我和我家，我們必定事奉耶和華。
english: And if it seems evil to you to be the servants of the Lord, make the decision this day whose servants you will be: of the gods whose servants your fathers were across the River, or of the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living: but I and my house will be the servants of the Lord.

chinese: 百姓回答說：我們斷不敢離棄耶和華去事奉別神；
english: Then the people in answer said, Never will we give up the Lord to be the servants of other gods;

chinese: 因耶和華─我們的神曾將我們和我們列祖從埃及地的為奴之家領出來，在我們眼前行了那些大神蹟，在我們所行的道上，所經過的諸國，都保護了我們。
english: For it is the Lord our God who has taken us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house, and who did all those great signs before our eyes, and kept us safe on all our journeys, and among all the peoples through whom we went:

chinese: 耶和華又把住此地的亞摩利人都從我們面前趕出去。所以，我們必事奉耶和華，因為他是我們的神。
english: And the Lord sent out from before us all the peoples, the Amorites living in the land: so we will be the servants of the Lord, for he is our God.

chinese: 約書亞對百姓說：你們不能事奉耶和華；因為他是聖潔的神，是忌邪的　神，必不赦免你們的過犯罪惡。
english: And Joshua said to the people, You are not able to be the servants of the Lord, for he is a holy God, a God who will not let his honour be given to another: he will have no mercy on your wrongdoing or your sins.

chinese: 你們若離棄耶和華去事奉外邦神，耶和華在降福之後，必轉而降禍與你們，把你們滅絕。
english: If you are turned away from the Lord and become the servants of strange gods, then turning against you he will do you evil, cutting you off, after he has done you good.

chinese: 百姓回答約書亞說：不然，我們定要事奉耶和華。
english: And the people said to Joshua, No! But we will be the servants of the Lord.

chinese: 約書亞對百姓說：你們選定耶和華，要事奉他，你們自己作見證罷！他們說：我們願意作見證。
english: And Joshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have made the decision to be the servants of the Lord. And they said, We are witnesses.

chinese: 約書亞說：你們現在要除掉你們中間的外邦神，專心歸向耶和華─以色列的　神。
english: Then, he said, put away the strange gods among you, turning your hearts to the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 百姓回答約書亞說：我們必事奉耶和華─我們的神，聽從他的話。
english: And the people said to Joshua, We will be the servants of the Lord our God, and we will give ear to his voice.

chinese: 當日，約書亞就與百姓立約，在示劍為他們立定律例典章。
english: So Joshua made an agreement with the people that day, and gave them a rule and a law in Shechem.

chinese: 約書亞將這些話都寫在神的律法書上，又將一塊大石頭立在橡樹下耶和華的聖所旁邊。
english: And Joshua put these words on record, writing them in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and put it up there under the oak-tree which was in the holy place of the Lord.

chinese: 約書亞對百姓說：看哪，這石頭可以向我們作見證；因為是聽見了耶和華所吩咐我們的一切話，倘或你們背棄你們的神，這石頭就可以向你們作見證（倘或云云：或作所以要向你們作見證，免得你們背棄耶和華─你們的　神）。
english: And Joshua said to all the people, See now, this stone is to be a witness against us; for all the words of the Lord have been said to us in its hearing: so it will be a witness against you if you are false to the Lord your God.

chinese: 於是約書亞打發百姓各歸自己的地業去了。
english: Then Joshua let the people go away, every man to his heritage.

chinese: 這些事以後，耶和華的僕人嫩的兒子約書亞，正一百一十歲，就死了。
english: Now after these things, the death of Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, took place, he being then a hundred and ten years old.

chinese: 以色列人將他葬在他地業的境內，就是在以法蓮山地的亭拿西拉，在迦實山的北邊。
english: And they put his body in the earth in the land of his heritage in Timnath-serah, in the hill-country of Ephraim, to the north of Mount Gaash.

chinese: 約書亞在世和約書亞死後，那些知道耶和華為以色列人所行諸事的長老還在的時候，以色列人事奉耶和華。
english: And Israel was true to the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the older men who were still living after Joshua's death, and had seen what the Lord had done for Israel.

chinese: 以色列人從埃及所帶來約瑟的骸骨，葬埋在示劍，就是在雅各從前用一百塊銀子向示劍的父親、哈抹的子孫所買的那塊地裡；這就作了約瑟子孫的產業。
english: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel had taken up from Egypt, they put in the earth in Shechem, in the property which Jacob had got from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for a hundred shekels: and they became the heritage of the children of Joseph.

chinese: 亞倫的兒子以利亞撒也死了，就把他葬在他兒子非尼哈所得、以法蓮山地的小山上。
english: Then the death of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, took place; and his body was put in the earth in the hill of Phinehas his son, which had been given to him in the hill-country of Ephraim.

chinese: 約書亞死後，以色列人求問耶和華說：我們中間誰當首先上去攻擊迦南人，與他們爭戰？
english: Now after the death of Joshua, the children of Israel made request to the Lord, saying, Who is to go up first to make war for us against the Canaanites?

chinese: 耶和華說：猶大當先上去，我已將那地交在他手中。
english: And the Lord said, Judah is to go up: see, I have given the land into his hands.

chinese: 猶大對他哥哥西緬說：請你同我到拈鬮所得之地去，好與迦南人爭戰；以後我也同你到你拈鬮所得之地去。於是西緬與他同去。
english: Then Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my heritage, so that we may make war against the Canaanites; and I will then go with you into your heritage. So Simeon went with him.

chinese: 猶大就上去；耶和華將迦南人和比利洗人交在他們手中。他們在比色擊殺了一萬人，
english: And Judah went up; and the Lord gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hands; and they overcame ten thousand of them in Bezek.

chinese: 又在那裡遇見亞多尼比色，與他爭戰，殺敗迦南人和比利洗人。
english: And they came across Adoni-zedek, and made war on him; and they overcame the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

chinese: 亞多尼比色逃跑；他們追趕，拿住他，砍斷他手腳的大姆指。
english: But Adoni-zedek went in flight; and they went after him and overtook him, and had his thumbs and his great toes cut off.

chinese: 亞多尼比色說：從前有七十個王，手腳的大姆指都被我砍斷，在我桌子底下拾取零碎食物。現在神按著我所行的報應我了。於是他們將亞多尼比色帶到耶路撒冷，他就死在那裡。
english: And Adoni-zedek said, Seventy kings, whose thumbs and great toes had been cut off, got broken meat under my table: as I have done, so has God done to me in full. And they took him to Jerusalem, and he came to his end there.

chinese: 猶大人攻打耶路撒冷，將城攻取，用刀殺了城內的人，並且放火燒城。
english: Then the children of Judah made an attack on Jerusalem, and took it, burning down the town after they had put its people to the sword without mercy.

chinese: 後來猶大人下去，與住山地、南地，和高原的迦南人爭戰。
english: After that the children of Judah went down to make war on the Canaanites living in the hill-country and in the south and in the lowlands.

chinese: 猶大人去攻擊住希伯崙的迦南人，殺了示篩、亞希幔、撻買。希伯崙從前名叫基列亞巴。
english: And Caleb went against the Canaanites of Hebron: (now in earlier times Hebron was named Kiriath-arba:) and he put Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai to the sword.

chinese: 他們從那裡去攻擊底壁的居民；底壁從前名叫基列西弗。
english: And from there he went up against the people of Debir. (Now the name of Debir in earlier times was Kiriath-sepher.)

chinese: 迦勒說：誰能攻打基列西弗，將城奪取，我就把我女兒押撒給他為妻。
english: And Caleb said, I will give Achsah, my daughter, as wife to the man who overcomes Kiriath-sepher and takes it.

chinese: 迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶奪取了那城，迦勒就把女兒押撒給他為妻。
english: And Othniel, the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it; so he gave him his daughter Achsah for his wife.

chinese: 押撒過門的時候，勸丈夫向他父親求一塊田。押撒一下驢，迦勒問他說：你要甚麼？
english: Now when she came to him, he put into her mind the idea of requesting a field from her father: and she got down from her ass; and Caleb said to her, What is it?

chinese: 他說：求你賜福給我，你既將我安置在南地，求你也給我水泉。迦勒就把上泉下泉賜給他。
english: And she said to him, Give me a blessing; because you have put me in a dry south-land, now give me springs of water. So Caleb gave her the higher spring and the lower spring.

chinese: 摩西的內兄（或譯：岳父）是基尼人，他的子孫與猶大人一同離了棕樹城，往亞拉得以南的猶大曠野去，就住在民中。
english: Now Hobab the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, had come up out of the town of palm-trees, with the children of Judah, into the waste land of Arad; and he went and was living among the Amalekites;

chinese: 猶大和他哥哥西緬同去，擊殺了住洗法的迦南人，將城盡行毀滅，那城的名便叫何珥瑪。
english: And Judah went with Simeon, his brother, and overcame the Canaanites living in Zephath, and put it under the curse; and he gave the town the name of Hormah.

chinese: 猶大又取了迦薩和迦薩的四境，亞實基倫和亞實基倫的四境，以革倫和以革倫的四境。
english: Then Judah took Gaza and its limit, and Ashkelon and its limit, and Ekron and its limit.

chinese: 耶和華與猶大同在，猶大就趕出山地的居民，只是不能趕出平原的居民，因為他們有鐵車。
english: And the Lord was with Judah; and he took the hill-country for his heritage; but he was unable to make the people of the valley go out, for they had war-carriages of iron.

chinese: 以色列人照摩西所說的，將希伯崙給了迦勒；迦勒就從那裡趕出亞衲族的三個族長。
english: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said; and he took the land of the three sons of Anak, driving them out from there.

chinese: 便雅憫人沒有趕出住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人。耶布斯人仍在耶路撒冷與便雅憫人同住，直到今日。
english: And the children of Judah did not make the Jebusites who were living in Jerusalem go out; the Jebusites are still living with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem.

chinese: 約瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；耶和華與他們同在。
english: And the family of Joseph went up against Beth-el, and the Lord was with them.

chinese: 約瑟家打發人去窺探伯特利（那城起先名叫路斯）。
english: So they sent men to make a search round Beth-el. (Now the name of the town in earlier times was Luz.)

chinese: 窺探的人看見一個人從城裡出來，就對他說：求你將進城的路指示我們，我們必恩待你。
english: And the watchers saw a man coming out of the town, and said to him, If you will make clear to us the way into the town, we will be kind to you.

chinese: 那人將進城的路指示他們，他們就用刀擊殺了城中的居民，但將那人和他全家放去。
english: So he made clear to them the way into the town, and they put it to the sword; but they let the man and all his family get away safe.

chinese: 那人往赫人之地去，築了一座城，起名叫路斯。那城到如今還叫這名。
english: And he went into the land of the Hittites, building a town there and naming it Luz: which is its name to this day.

chinese: 瑪拿西沒有趕出伯善和屬伯善鄉村的居民，他納和屬他納鄉村的居民，多珥和屬多珥鄉村的居民，以伯蓮和屬以伯蓮鄉村的居民，米吉多和屬米吉多鄉村的居民；迦南人卻執意住在那些地方。
english: And Manasseh did not take away the land of the people of Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, or of Taanach and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Dor and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Ibleam and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Megiddo and its daughter-towns, driving them out; but the Canaanites would go on living in that land.

chinese: 及至以色列強盛了，就使迦南人作苦工，沒有把他們全然趕出。
english: And whenever Israel became strong, they put the Canaanites to forced work, without driving them out completely.

chinese: 以法蓮沒有趕出住基色的迦南人。於是迦南人仍住在基色，在以法蓮中間。
english: And Ephraim did not make the Canaanites who were living in Gezer go out; but the Canaanites went on living in Gezer among them.

chinese: 西布倫沒有趕出基倫的居民和拿哈拉的居民。於是迦南人仍住在西布倫中間，成了服苦的人。
english: Zebulun did not make the people of Kitron or the people of Nahalol go out; but the Canaanites went on living among them and were put to forced work.

chinese: 亞設沒有趕出亞柯和西頓的居民，亞黑拉和亞革悉的居民，黑巴、亞弗革與利合的居民。
english: And Asher did not take the land of the people of Acco, or Zidon, or Ahlab, or Achzib, or Helbah, or Aphik, or Rehob, driving them out;

chinese: 於是，亞設因為沒有趕出那地的迦南人，就住在他們中間。
english: But the Asherites went on living among the Canaanites, the people of the land, without driving them out.

chinese: 拿弗他利沒有趕出伯示麥和伯亞納的居民，於是拿弗他利就住在那地的迦南人中間；然而伯示麥和伯亞納的居民成了服苦的人。
english: Naphtali did not take the land of the people of Beth-shemesh or of Beth-anath, driving them out; but he was living among the Canaanites in the land; however, the people of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath were put to forced work.

chinese: 亞摩利人強逼但人住在山地，不容他們下到平原；
english: And the children of Dan were forced into the hill-country by the Amorites, who would not let them come down into the valley;

chinese: 亞摩利人卻執意住在希烈山和亞雅倫並沙賓。然而約瑟家勝了他們，使他們成了服苦的人。
english: For the Amorites would go on living in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim; but the children of Joseph became stronger than they, and put them to forced work.

chinese: 亞摩利人的境界，是從亞克拉濱坡，從西拉而上。
english: And the limit of the Edomites went from the slope of Akrabbim from Sela and up.

chinese: 耶和華的使者從吉甲上到波金，對以色列人說：我使你們從埃及上來，領你們到我向你們列祖起誓應許之地。我又說：我永不廢棄與你們所立的約。
english: Now the angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim. And he said, *** I took you out of Egypt, guiding you into the land which I gave by an oath to your fathers; and I said, My agreement with you will never be broken by me:

chinese: 你們也不可與這地的居民立約，要拆毀他們的祭壇。你們竟沒有聽從我的話！為何這樣行呢？
english: And you are to make no agreement with the people of this land; you are to see that their altars are broken down: but you have not given ear to my voice: what have you done?

chinese: 因此我又說：我必不將他們從你們面前趕出；他們必作你們肋下的荊棘。他們的神必作你們的網羅。
english: And so I have said, I will not send them out from before you; but they will be a danger to you, and their gods will be a cause of falling to you.

chinese: 耶和華的使者向以色列眾人說這話的時候，百姓就放聲而哭。
english: Now on hearing these words which the angel of the Lord said to all the children of Israel, the people gave themselves up to loud crying and weeping.

chinese: 於是給那地方起名叫波金（就是哭的意思）。眾人在那裡向耶和華獻祭。
english: And they gave that place the name of Bochim, and made offerings there to the Lord.

chinese: 從前約書亞打發以色列百姓去的時候，他們各歸自己的地業，佔據地土。
english: And Joshua let the people go away, and the children of Israel went, every man to his heritage, to take the land for themselves.

chinese: 約書亞在世和約書亞死後，那些見耶和華為以色列人所行大事的長老還在的時候，百姓都事奉耶和華。
english: And the people were true to the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the responsible men who were still living after the death of Joshua, and had seen all the great work of the Lord which he had done for Israel.

chinese: 耶和華的僕人、嫩的兒子約書亞，正一百一十歲就死了。
english: And death came to Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, he being a hundred and ten years old.

chinese: 以色列人將他葬在他地業的境內，就是在以法蓮山地的亭拿希烈，在迦實山的北邊。
english: And they put his body in the earth in the land of his heritage in Timnath-heres, in the hill-country of Ephraim to the north of Mount Gaash.

chinese: 那世代的人也都歸了自己的列祖。後來有別的世代興起，不知道耶和華，也不知道耶和華為以色列人所行的事。
english: And in time death overtook all that generation; and another generation came after them, having no knowledge of the Lord or of the things which he had done for Israel.

chinese: 以色列人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，去事奉諸巴力，
english: And the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord and became servants to the Baals;

chinese: 離棄了領他們出埃及地的耶和華─他們列祖的神，去叩拜別　神，就是四圍列國的　神，惹耶和華發怒；
english: And they gave up the Lord, the God of their fathers, who had taken them out of the land of Egypt, and went after other gods, the gods of the peoples round about them, worshipping them and moving the Lord to wrath.

chinese: 並離棄耶和華，去事奉巴力和亞斯他錄。
english: And they gave up the Lord, and became the servants of Baal and the Astartes.

chinese: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在搶奪他們的人手中，又將他們付與四圍仇敵的手中，甚至他們在仇敵面前再不能站立得住。
english: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of those who violently took their property, and into the hands of their haters all round them, so that they were forced to give way before them.

chinese: 他們無論往何處去，耶和華都以災禍攻擊他們，正如耶和華所說的話，又如耶和華向他們所起的誓；他們便極其困苦。
english: Wherever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord had taken his oath it would be; and things became very hard for them.

chinese: 耶和華興起士師，士師就拯救他們脫離搶奪他們人的手。
english: Then the Lord gave them judges, as their saviours from the hands of those who were cruel to them.

chinese: 他們卻不聽從士師，竟隨從叩拜別神，行了邪淫，速速地偏離他們列祖所行的道，不如他們列祖順從耶和華的命令。
english: But still they would not give ear to their judges, but went after other gods and gave them worship; quickly turning from the way in which their fathers had gone, keeping the orders of the Lord; but they did not do so.

chinese: 耶和華為他們興起士師，就與那士師同在。士師在世的一切日子，耶和華拯救他們脫離仇敵的手。他們因受欺壓擾害，就哀聲歎氣，所以耶和華後悔了。
english: And whenever the Lord gave them judges, then the Lord was with the judge, and was their saviour from the hands of their haters all the days of the judge; for the Lord was moved by their cries of grief because of those who were cruel to them.

chinese: 及至士師死後，他們就轉去行惡，比他們列祖更甚，去事奉叩拜別神，總不斷絕頑梗的惡行。
english: But whenever the judge was dead, they went back and did more evil than their fathers, going after other gods, to be their servants and their worshippers; giving up nothing of their sins and their hard-hearted ways.

chinese: 於是耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作。他說：因這民違背我吩咐他們列祖所守的約，不聽從我的話，
english: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he said, Because this nation has not been true to my agreement which I made with their fathers, and has not given ear to my voice;

chinese: 所以約書亞死的時候所剩下的各族，我必不再從他們面前趕出，
english: From now on I will not go on driving out from before them any of the nations which at the death of Joshua were still living in this land;

chinese: 為要藉此試驗以色列人，看他們肯照他們列祖謹守遵行我的道不肯。
english: In order to put Israel to the test, and see if they will keep the way of the Lord, walking in it as their fathers did, or not.

chinese: 這樣耶和華留下各族，不將他們速速趕出，也沒有交付約書亞的手。
english: So the Lord let those nations go on living in the land, not driving them out quickly, and did not give them up into the hands of Joshua.

chinese: 耶和華留下這幾族，為要試驗那不曾知道與迦南爭戰之事的以色列人，
english: Now these are the nations which the Lord kept in the land for the purpose of testing Israel by them, all those who had had no experience of all the wars of Canaan;

chinese: 好叫以色列的後代又知道又學習未曾曉得的戰事。
english: Only because of the generations of the children of Israel, for the purpose of teaching them war--only those who up till then had no experience of it;

chinese: 所留下的就是非利士的五個首領和一切迦南人、西頓人，並住利巴嫩山的希未人，從巴力黑們山直到哈馬口。
english: The five chiefs of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites and the Zidonians and the Hivites living in Mount Lebanon, from the mountain Baal-hermon as far as Hamath:

chinese: 留下這幾族，為要試驗以色列人，知道他們肯聽從耶和華藉摩西吩咐他們列祖的誡命不肯。
english: For the purpose of testing Israel by them, to see if they would give ear to the orders of the Lord, which he had given to their fathers by the hand of Moses.

chinese: 以色列人竟住在迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中間，
english: Now the children of Israel were living among the Canaanites, the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

chinese: 娶他們的女兒為妻，將自己的女兒嫁給他們的兒子，並事奉他們的神。
english: And they took as wives the daughters of these nations and gave their daughters to their sons, and became servants to their gods.

chinese: 以色列人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，忘記耶和華─他們的神，去事奉諸巴力和亞舍拉，
english: And the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord, and put out of their minds the Lord their God, and became servants to the Baals and the Astartes.

chinese: 所以耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在米所波大米王古珊利薩田的手中。以色列人服事古珊利薩田八年。
english: So the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of Cushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel were his servants for eight years.

chinese: 以色列人呼求耶和華的時候，耶和華就為他們興起一位拯救者救他們，就是迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶。
english: And when the children of Israel made prayer to the Lord, he gave them a saviour, Othniel, the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

chinese: 耶和華的靈降在他身上，他就作了以色列的士師，出去爭戰。耶和華將米所波大米王古珊利薩田交在他手中，他便勝了古珊利薩田。
english: And the spirit of the Lord came on him and he became judge of Israel, and went out to war, and the Lord gave up Cushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, into his hands and he overcame him.

chinese: 於是國中太平四十年。基納斯的兒子俄陀聶死了。
english: Then for forty years the land had peace, till the death of Othniel, the son of Kenaz.

chinese: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，耶和華就使摩押王伊磯倫強盛，攻擊以色列人。
english: Then the children of Israel again did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and the Lord made Eglon, king of Moab, strong against Israel, because they had done evil in the Lord's eyes.

chinese: 伊磯倫招聚亞捫人和亞瑪力人，去攻打以色列人，佔據棕樹城。
english: And Eglon got together the people of Ammon and Amalek, and they went and overcame Israel and took the town of palm-trees.

chinese: 於是以色列人服事摩押王伊磯倫十八年。
english: And the children of Israel were servants to Eglon, king of Moab, for eighteen years.

chinese: 以色列人呼求耶和華的時候，耶和華就為他們興起一位拯救者，就是便雅憫人基拉的兒子以笏；他是左手便利的。以色列人託他送禮物給摩押王伊磯倫。
english: Then when the children of Israel made prayer to the Lord, he gave them a saviour, Ehud, the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man; and the children of Israel sent an offering by him to Eglon, king of Moab.

chinese: 以笏打了一把兩刃的劍，長一肘，帶在右腿衣服裡面。
english: So Ehud made himself a two-edged sword, a cubit long, which he put on at his right side under his robe.

chinese: 他將禮物獻給摩押王伊磯倫（原來伊磯倫極其肥胖）；
english: And he took the offering to Eglon, king of Moab, who was a very fat man.

chinese: 以笏獻完禮物，便將抬禮物的人打發走了，
english: And after giving the offering, he sent away the people who had come with the offering.

chinese: 自己卻從靠近吉甲鑿石之地回來，說：王啊，我有一件機密事奏告你。王說：迴避罷！於是左右侍立的人都退去了。
english: But he himself, turning back from the stone images at Gilgal, said, I have something to say to you in secret, O king. And he said, Let there be quiet. Then all those who were waiting before him went out.

chinese: 以笏來到王面前；王獨自一人坐在涼樓上。以笏說：我奉神的命報告你一件事。王就從座位上站起來。
english: Then Ehud came in to him while he was seated by himself in his summer-house. And Ehud said, I have a word from God for you. And he got up from his seat.

chinese: 以笏便伸左手，從右腿上拔出劍來，刺入王的肚腹，
english: And Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right side, and sent it into his stomach;

chinese: 連劍把都刺進去了。劍被肥肉夾住，他沒有從王的肚腹拔出來，且穿通了後身。
english: And the hand-part went in after the blade, and the fat was joined up over the blade; for he did not take the sword out of his stomach. And he went out into the ...

chinese: 以笏就出到遊廊，將樓門盡都關鎖。
english: Then Ehud went out into the covered way, shutting the doors of the summer-house on him and locking them.

chinese: 以笏出來之後，王的僕人到了，看見樓門關鎖，就說：他必是在樓上大解。
english: Now when he had gone, the king's servants came, and saw that the doors of the summer-house were locked; and they said, It may be that he is in his summer-house for a private purpose.

chinese: 他們等煩了，見仍不開樓門，就拿鑰匙開了，不料，他們的主人已死，倒在地上。
english: And they went on waiting till they were shamed, but the doors were still shut; so they took the key, and, opening them, saw their lord stretched out dead on the floor.

chinese: 他們耽延的時候，以笏就逃跑了，經過鑿石之地，逃到西伊拉；
english: But Ehud had got away while they were waiting and had gone past the stone images and got away to Seirah.

chinese: 到了，就在以法蓮山地吹角。以色列人隨著他下了山地，他在前頭引路，
english: And when he came there, he had a horn sounded in the hill-country of Ephraim, and all the children of Israel went down with him from the hill-country, and he at their head.

chinese: 對他們說：你們隨我來，因為耶和華已經把你們的仇敵摩押人交在你們手中。於是他們跟著他下去，把守約但河的渡口，不容摩押一人過去。
english: And he said to them, Come after me; for the Lord has given the Moabites, your haters, into your hands. So they went down after him and took the crossing-places of Jordan against Moab, and let no one go across.

chinese: 那時擊殺了摩押人約有一萬，都是強壯的勇士，沒有一人逃脫。
english: At that time they put about ten thousand men of Moab to the sword, every strong man and every man of war; not a man got away.

chinese: 這樣，摩押就被以色列人制伏了。國中太平八十年。
english: So Moab was broken that day under the hand of Israel. And for eighty years the land had peace.

chinese: 以笏之後，有亞拿的兒子珊迦，他用趕牛的棍子打死六百非利士人。他也救了以色列人。
english: And after him came Shamgar, the son of Anath, who put to death six hundred Philistines with an ox-stick; and he was another saviour of Israel.

chinese: 以笏死後，以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，
english: And the children of Israel again did evil in the eyes of the Lord when Ehud was dead.

chinese: 耶和華就把他們付與在夏瑣作王的迦南王耶賓手中；他的將軍是西西拉，住在外邦人的夏羅設。
english: And the Lord gave them up into the hands of Jabin, king of Canaan, who was ruling in Hazor; the captain of his army was Sisera, who was living in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

chinese: 耶賓王有鐵車九百輛。他大大欺壓以色列人二十年，以色列人就呼求耶和華。
english: Then the children of Israel made prayer to the Lord; for he had nine hundred iron war-carriages, and for twenty years he was very cruel to the children of Israel.

chinese: 有一位女先知名叫底波拉，是拉比多的妻，當時作以色列的士師。
english: Now Deborah, a woman prophet, the wife of Lapidoth, was judge of Israel at that time.

chinese: 他住在以法蓮山地拉瑪和伯特利中間，在底波拉的棕樹下。以色列人都上他那裡去聽判斷。
english: (And she had her seat under the palm-tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in the hill-country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her to be judged.)

chinese: 他打發人從拿弗他利的基低斯將亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉召了來，對他說：耶和華─以色列的神吩咐你說：你率領一萬拿弗他利和西布倫人上他泊山去。
english: And she sent for Barak, the son of Abinoam, from Kedesh-naphtali, and said to him, Has not the Lord, the God of Israel, given orders saying, Go and get your force into line in Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

chinese: 我必使耶賓的將軍西西拉率領他的車輛和全軍往基順河，到你那裡去；我必將他交在你手中。
english: And I will make Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his war-carriages and his forces, come against you at the river Kishon, where I will give him into your hands.

chinese: 巴拉說：你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。
english: And Barak said to her, If you will go with me then I will go; but if you will not go with me I will not go.

chinese: 底波拉說：我必與你同去，只是你在所行的路上得不著榮耀，因為耶和華要將西西拉交在一個婦人手裡。於是底波拉起來，與巴拉一同往基低斯去了。
english: And she said, I will certainly go with you: though you will get no honour in your undertaking, for the Lord will give Sisera into the hands of a woman. So Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh.

chinese: 巴拉就招聚西布倫人和拿弗他利人到基低斯，跟他上去的有一萬人。底波拉也同他上去。
english: Then Barak sent for Zebulun and Naphtali to come to Kedesh; and ten thousand men went up after him, and Deborah went up with him.

chinese: 摩西岳父（或譯：內兄）何巴的後裔，基尼人希百曾離開基尼族，到靠近基低斯撒拿音的橡樹旁支搭帳棚。
english: Now Heber the Kenite, separating himself from the rest of the Kenites, from the children of Hobab, the brother-in-law of Moses, had put up his tent as far away as the oak-tree in Zaanannim, by Kedesh.

chinese: 有人告訴西西拉說：亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉已經上他泊山了。
english: And word was given to Sisera that Barak, the son of Abinoam, had gone up to Mount Tabor.

chinese: 西西拉就聚集所有的鐵車九百輛，和跟隨他的全軍，從外邦人的夏羅設出來，到了基順河。
english: So Sisera got together all his war-carriages, nine hundred war-carriages of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles as far as the river Kishon.

chinese: 底波拉對巴拉說：你起來，今日就是耶和華將西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和華豈不在你前頭行麼？於是巴拉下了他泊山，跟隨他有一萬人。
english: Then Deborah said to Barak, Up! for today the Lord has given Sisera into your hands: has not the Lord gone out before you? So Barak went down from Mount Tabor and ten thousand men after him.

chinese: 耶和華使西西拉和他一切車輛全軍潰亂，在巴拉面前被刀殺敗；西西拉下車步行逃跑。
english: And the Lord sent fear on Sisera and all his war-carriages and all his army before Barak; and Sisera got down from his war-carriage and went in flight on foot.

chinese: 巴拉追趕車輛、軍隊，直到外邦人的夏羅設。西西拉的全軍都倒在刀下，沒有留下一人。
english: But Barak went after the war-carriages and the army as far as Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all Sisera's army was put to the sword; not a man got away.

chinese: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希百之妻雅億的帳棚，因為夏瑣王耶賓與基尼人希百家和好。
english: But Sisera went in flight on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin, king of Hazor, and the family of Heber the Kenite.

chinese: 雅億出來迎接西西拉，對他說：請我主進來，不要懼怕；西西拉就進了他的帳棚。雅憶用被將他遮蓋。
english: And Jael went out to Sisera, and said to him, Come in, my lord, come in to me without fear. So he went into her tent, and she put a cover over him.

chinese: 西西拉對雅億說：我渴了，求你給我一點水喝。雅億就打開皮袋，給他奶子喝，仍舊把他遮蓋。
english: Then he said to her, Give me now a little water, for I have need of a drink. And opening a skin of milk, she gave him drink, and put the cover over him again.

chinese: 西西拉又對雅億說：請你站在帳棚門口，若有人來問你說：有人在這裡沒有？你就說：沒有。
english: And he said to her, Take your place at the door of the tent, and if anyone comes and says to you, Is there any man here, say, No.

chinese: 西西拉疲乏沉睡。希百的妻雅億取了帳棚的橛子，手裡拿著錘子，輕悄悄地到他旁邊，將橛子從他鬢邊釘進去，釘入地裡。西西拉就死了。
english: Then Jael, Heber's wife, took a tent-pin and a hammer and went up to him quietly, driving the pin into his head, and it went through his head into the earth, for he was in a deep sleep from weariness; and so he came to his end.

chinese: 巴拉追趕西西拉的時候，雅億出來迎接他說：來罷，我將你所尋找的人給你看。他就進入帳棚，看見西西拉已經死了，倒在地上，橛子還在他鬢中。
english: Then Jael went out, and meeting Barak going after Sisera, said to him, Come, and I will let you see the man you are searching for. So he came into her tent and saw, and there was Sisera stretched out dead with the tent-pin in his head.

chinese: 這樣，神使迦南王耶賓被以色列人制伏了。
english: So that day God overcame Jabin, king of Canaan, before the children of Israel.

chinese: 從此以色列人的手越發有力，勝了迦南王耶賓，直到將他滅絕了。
english: And the power of the children of Israel went on increasing against Jabin, king of Canaan, till he was cut off.

chinese: 那時，底波拉和亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉作歌，說：
english: At that time Deborah and Barak, the son of Abinoam, made this song, saying:

chinese: 因為以色列中有軍長率領，百姓也甘心犧牲自己，你們應當頌讚耶和華！
english: Because of the flowing hair of the fighters in Israel, because the people gave themselves freely, give praise to the Lord.

chinese: 君王啊，要聽！王子啊，要側耳而聽！我要向耶和華歌唱；我要歌頌耶和華─以色列的神。
english: Give attention, O kings; give ear, O rulers; I, even I, will make a song to the Lord; I will make melody to the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你從西珥出來，由以東地行走。那時地震天漏，雲也落雨。
english: Lord, when you went out from Seir, moving like an army from the field of Edom, the earth was shaking and the heavens were troubled, and the clouds were dropping water.

chinese: 山見耶和華的面就震動，西乃山見耶和華─以色列神的面也是如此。
english: The mountains were shaking before the Lord, before the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 在亞拿之子珊迦的時候，又在雅億的日子，大道無人行走，都是繞道而行。
english: In the days of Shamgar, the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were not used, and travellers went by side roads.

chinese: 以色列中的官長停職，直到我底波拉興起，等我興起作以色列的母。
english: Country towns were no more in Israel, *** were no more, till you, Deborah, came up, till you came up as a mother in Israel.

chinese: 以色列人選擇新神，爭戰的事就臨到城門。那時，以色列四萬人中豈能見盾牌槍矛呢？
english: They had no one to make arms, there were no more armed men in the towns; was there a body-cover or a spear to be seen among forty thousand in Israel?

chinese: 我心傾向以色列的首領，他們在民中甘心犧牲自己。你們應當頌讚耶和華！
english: Come, you rulers of Israel, you who gave yourselves freely among the people: give praise to the Lord.

chinese: 騎白驢的、坐繡花毯子的、行路的，你們都當傳揚！
english: Let them give thought to it, who go on white asses, and those who are walking on the road.

chinese: 在遠離弓箭響聲打水之處，人必述說耶和華公義的作為，就是他治理以色列公義的作為。那時耶和華的民下到城門。
english: Give ear to the women laughing by the water-springs; there they will give again the story of the upright acts of the Lord, all the upright acts of his arm in Israel.

chinese: 底波拉啊，興起！興起！你當興起，興起，唱歌。亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉啊，你當奮興，擄掠你的敵人。
english: Awake! awake! Deborah: awake! awake! give a song: Up! Barak, and take prisoner those who took you prisoner, O son of Abinoam.

chinese: 那時有餘剩的貴冑和百姓一同下來；耶和華降臨，為我攻擊勇士。
english: Then the chiefs went down to the doors; the Lord's people went down among the strong ones.

chinese: 有根本在亞瑪力人的地，從以法蓮下來的；便雅憫在民中跟隨。有掌權的從瑪吉下來；有持杖檢點民數的從西布倫下來；
english: Out of Ephraim they came down into the valley; after you, Benjamin, among your tribesmen; from Machir came down the captains, and from Zebulun those in whose hand is the ruler's rod.

chinese: 以薩迦的首領與底波拉同來；以薩迦怎樣，巴拉也怎樣。眾人都跟隨巴拉衝下平原；在流便的溪水旁有心中定大志的。
english: Your chiefs, Issachar, were with Deborah; and Naphtali was true to Barak; into the valley they went rushing out at his feet. In Reuben there were divisions, and great searchings of heart.

chinese: 你為何坐在羊圈內聽群中吹笛的聲音呢？在流便的溪水旁有心中設大謀的。
english: Why did you keep quiet among the sheep, hearing nothing but the watchers piping to the flocks?

chinese: 基列人安居在約但河外。但人為何等在船上？亞設人在海口靜坐，在港口安居。
english: Gilead was living over Jordan; and Dan was waiting in his ships; Asher kept in his place by the sea's edge, living by his inlets.

chinese: 西布倫人是拚命敢死的；拿弗他利人在田野的高處也是如此。
english: It was the people of Zebulun who put their lives in danger, even to death, with Naphtali on the high places of the field.

chinese: 君王都來爭戰。那時迦南諸王在米吉多水旁的他納爭戰，卻未得擄掠銀錢。
english: The kings came on to the fight, the kings of Canaan were warring; in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo: they took no profit in money.

chinese: 星宿從天上爭戰，從其軌道攻擊西西拉。
english: The stars from heaven were fighting; from their highways they were fighting against Sisera.

chinese: 基順古河把敵人沖沒；我的靈啊，應當努力前行。
english: The river Kishon took them violently away, stopping their flight, the river Kishon. Give praise, O my soul, to the strength of the Lord!

chinese: 那時壯馬馳驅，踢跳，奔騰。
english: Then loudly the feet of the horses were sounding with the stamping, the stamping of their war-horses.

chinese: 耶和華的使者說：應當咒詛米羅斯，大大咒詛其中的居民；因為他們不來幫助耶和華，不來幫助耶和華攻擊勇士。
english: A curse, a curse on Meroz! said the angel of the Lord. A bitter curse on her townspeople! Because they came not to the help of the Lord, to the help of the Lord among the strong ones.

chinese: 願基尼人希百的妻雅億比眾婦人多得福氣，比住帳棚的婦人更蒙福祉。
english: Blessings be on Jael, more than on all women! Blessings greater than on any in the tents!

chinese: 西西拉求水，雅億給他奶子，用寶貴的盤子給他奶油。
english: His request was for water, she gave him milk; she put butter before him on a fair plate.

chinese: 雅億左手拿著帳棚的橛子，右手拿著匠人的錘子，擊打西西拉，打傷他的頭，把他的鬢角打破穿通。
english: She put out her hand to the tent-pin, and her right hand to the workman's hammer; and she gave Sisera a blow, crushing his head, wounding and driving through his brow.

chinese: 西西拉在他腳前曲身仆倒，在他腳前曲身倒臥；在那裡曲身，就在那裡死亡。
english: Bent at her feet he went down, he was stretched out; bent at her feet he went down; where he was bent down, there he went down in death.

chinese: 西西拉的母親從窗戶裡往外觀看，從窗櫺中呼叫說：他的戰車為何耽延不來呢？他的車輪為何行得慢呢？
english: Looking out from the window she gave a cry, the mother of Sisera was crying out through the window, Why is his carriage so long in coming? When will the noise of his wheels be sounding?

chinese: 聰明的宮女安慰他（原文是回答他），他也自言自語地說：
english: Her wise women gave answer to her, yes, she made answer again to herself,

chinese: 他們莫非得財而分？每人得了一兩個女子？西西拉得了彩衣為擄物，得繡花的彩衣為掠物。這彩衣兩面繡花，乃是披在被擄之人頸項上的。
english: Are they not getting, are they not parting the goods among them: a young girl or two to every man; and to Sisera robes of coloured needlework, worked in fair colours on this side and on that, for the neck of the queen?

chinese: 耶和華啊，願你的仇敵都這樣滅亡！願愛你的人如日頭出現，光輝烈烈！這樣，國中太平四十年。
english: So may destruction come on all your haters, O Lord; but let your lovers be like the sun going out in his strength. And for forty years the land had peace.

chinese: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，耶和華就把他們交在米甸人手裡七年。
english: And the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and the Lord gave them up into the hand of Midian for seven years.

chinese: 米甸人壓制以色列人；以色列人因為米甸人，就在山中挖穴、挖洞、建造營寨。
english: And Midian was stronger than Israel; and because of the Midianites, the children of Israel made holes for themselves in the mountains, and hollows in the rocks, and strong places.

chinese: 以色列人每逢撒種之後，米甸人、亞瑪力人，和東方人都上來攻打他們，
english: And whenever Israel's grain was planted, the Midianites and the Amalekites and the people of the east came up against them;

chinese: 對著他們安營，毀壞土產，直到迦薩，沒有給以色列人留下食物，牛、羊、驢也沒有留下；
english: And put their army in position against them; and they took all the produce of the earth as far as Gaza, till there was no food in Israel, or any sheep or oxen or asses.

chinese: 因為那些人帶著牲畜帳棚來，像蝗蟲那樣多，人和駱駝無數，都進入國內，毀壞全地。
english: For they came up regularly with their oxen and their tents; they came like the locusts in number; they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land for its destruction.

chinese: 以色列人因米甸人的緣故，極其窮乏，就呼求耶和華。
english: And Israel was in great need because of Midian; and the cry of the children of Israel went up to the Lord.

chinese: 以色列人因米甸人的緣故，呼求耶和華，
english: And when the cry of the children of Israel, because of Midian, came before the Lord,

chinese: 耶和華就差遣先知到以色列人那裡，對他們說：耶和華─以色列的神如此說：我曾領你們從埃及上來，出了為奴之家，
english: The Lord sent a prophet to the children of Israel, who said to them, The Lord the God of Israel, has said, I took you up from Egypt, out of the prison-house;

chinese: 救你們脫離埃及人的手，並脫離一切欺壓你們之人的手，把他們從你們面前趕出，將他們的地賜給你們；
english: And I took you out of the hands of the Egyptians and out of the hands of all who were cruel to you, and I sent them out by force from before you and gave you their land;

chinese: 又對你們說：我是耶和華─你們的神。你們住在亞摩利人的地，不可敬畏他們的　神。你們竟不聽從我的話。
english: And I said to you, I am the Lord your God; you are not to give worship to the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living, but you did not give ear to my voice.

chinese: 耶和華的使者到了俄弗拉，坐在亞比以謝族人約阿施的橡樹下。約阿施的兒子基甸正在酒醡那裡打麥子，為要防備米甸人。
english: Now the angel of the Lord came and took his seat under the oak-tree in Ophrah, in the field of Joash the Abiezrite; and his son Gideon was crushing grain in the place where the grapes were crushed, so that the Midianites might not see it.

chinese: 耶和華的使者向基甸顯現，對他說：大能的勇士啊，耶和華與你同在！
english: And the angel of the Lord came before his eyes, and said to him, The Lord is with you, O man of war.

chinese: 基甸說：主啊，耶和華若與我們同在，我們何至遭遇這一切事呢？我們的列祖不是向我們說耶和華領我們從埃及上來麼？他那樣奇妙的作為在哪裡呢？現在他卻丟棄我們，將我們交在米甸人手裡。
english: Then Gideon said to him, O my lord, if the Lord is with us why has all this come on us? And where are all his works of power, of which our fathers have given us word, saying, Did not the Lord take us out of Egypt? But now he has given us up, handing us over to the power of Midian.

chinese: 耶和華觀看基甸，說：你靠著你這能力去從米甸人手裡拯救以色列人，不是我差遣你去的麼？
english: And the Lord, turning to him, said, Go in the strength you have and be Israel's saviour from Midian: have I not sent you?

chinese: 基甸說：主啊，我有何能拯救以色列人呢？我家在瑪拿西支派中是至貧窮的。我在我父家是至微小的。
english: And he said to him, O Lord, how may I be the saviour of Israel? See, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

chinese: 耶和華對他說：我與你同在，你就必擊打米甸人，如擊打一人一樣。
english: Then the Lord said to him, Truly, I will be with you, and you will overcome the Midianites as if they were one man.

chinese: 基甸說：我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你給我一個證據，使我知道與我說話的就是主。
english: So he said to him, If now I have grace in your eyes, then give me a sign that it is you who are talking to me.

chinese: 求你不要離開這裡，等我歸回將禮物帶來供在你面前。主說：我必等你回來。
english: Do not go away till I come with my offering and put it before you. And he said, I will not go away before you come back.

chinese: 基甸去預備了一隻山羊羔，用一伊法細麵做了無酵餅，將肉放在筐內，把湯盛在壺中，帶到橡樹下，獻在使者面前。
english: Then Gideon went in and made ready a young goat, and with an ephah of meal he made unleavened cakes: he put the meat in a basket and the soup in which it had been cooked he put in a pot, and he took it out to him under the oak-tree and gave it to him there.

chinese: 神的使者吩咐基甸說：將肉和無酵餅放在這磐石上，把湯倒出來。他就這樣行了。
english: And the angel of God said to him, Take the meat and the unleavened cakes and put them down on the rock over there, draining out the soup over them. And he did so.

chinese: 耶和華的使者伸出手內的杖，杖頭挨了肉和無酵餅，就有火從磐石中出來，燒盡了肉和無酵餅。耶和華的使者也就不見了。
english: Then the angel of the Lord put out the stick which was in his hand, touching the meat and the cakes with the end of it; and a flame came up out of the rock, burning up the meat and the cakes: and the angel of the Lord was seen no longer.

chinese: 基甸見他是耶和華的使者，就說：哀哉！主耶和華啊，我不好了，因為我覿面看見耶和華的使者。
english: Then Gideon was certain that he was the angel of the Lord; and Gideon said, I am in fear, O Lord God! for I have seen the angel of the Lord face to face.

chinese: 耶和華對他說：你放心，不要懼怕，你必不至死。
english: But the Lord said to him, Peace be with you; have no fear: you are in no danger of death.

chinese: 於是基甸在那裡為耶和華築了一座壇，起名叫耶和華沙龍（就是耶和華賜平安的意思）。（這壇在亞比以謝族的俄弗拉直到如今。）
english: Then Gideon made an altar there to the Lord, and gave it the name Yahweh-shalom; to this day it is in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

chinese: 當那夜，耶和華吩咐基甸說：你取你父親的牛來，就是（或譯：和）那七歲的第二隻牛，並拆毀你父親為巴力所築的壇，砍下壇旁的木偶，
english: The same night the Lord said to him, Take ten men of your servants and an ox seven years old, and after pulling down the altar of Baal which is your father's, and cutting down the holy tree by its side,

chinese: 在這磐石（原文是保障）上整整齊齊地為耶和華─你的神築一座壇，將第二隻牛獻為燔祭，用你所砍下的木偶作柴。
english: Make an altar to the Lord your God on the top of this rock, in the ordered way and take the ox and make a burned offering with the wood of the holy tree which has been cut down.

chinese: 基甸就從他僕人中挑了十個人，照著耶和華吩咐他的行了。他因怕父家和本城的人，不敢在白晝行這事，就在夜間行了。
english: Then Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the Lord had said to him; but fearing to do it by day, because of his father's people and the men of the town, he did it by night.

chinese: 城裡的人清早起來，見巴力的壇拆毀，壇旁的木偶砍下，第二隻牛獻在新築的壇上，
english: And the men of the town got up early in the morning, and they saw the altar of Baal broken down, and the holy tree which was by it cut down, and the ox offered on the altar which had been put up there.

chinese: 就彼此說：這事是誰做的呢？他們訪查之後，就說：這是約阿施的兒子基甸做的。
english: And they said to one another, Who has done this thing? And after searching with care, they said, Gideon, the son of Joash, has done this thing.

chinese: 城裡的人對約阿施說：將你兒子交出來，好治死他；因為他拆毀了巴力的壇，砍下壇旁的木偶。
english: Then the men of the town said to Joash, Make your son come out to be put to death, for pulling down the altar of Baal and cutting down the holy tree which was by it.

chinese: 約阿施回答站著攻擊他的眾人說：你們是為巴力爭論麼？你們要救他麼？誰為他爭論，趁早將誰治死！巴力若果是神，有人拆毀他的壇，讓他為自己爭論罷！
english: But Joash said to all those who were attacking him, Will you take up the cause of Baal? will you be his saviour? Let anyone who will take up his cause be put to death while it is still morning: if he is a god, let him take up his cause himself because of the pulling down of his altar.

chinese: 所以當日人稱基甸為耶路巴力，意思說：他拆毀巴力的壇，讓巴力與他爭論。
english: So that day he gave him the name of Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal take up his cause against him because his altar has been broken down.

chinese: 那時，米甸人、亞瑪力人，和東方人都聚集過河，在耶斯列平原安營。
english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the people of the east, banding themselves together, went over and put up their tents in the valley of Jezreel.

chinese: 耶和華的靈降在基甸身上，他就吹角；亞比以謝族都聚集跟隨他。
english: But the spirit of the Lord came on Gideon; and at the sound of his horn all Abiezer came together after him.

chinese: 他打發人走遍瑪拿西地，瑪拿西人也聚集跟隨他；又打發人去見亞設人、西布倫人、拿弗他利人，他們也都出來與他們會合。
english: And he sent through all Manasseh, and they came after him; and he sent to Asher and Zebulun and Naphtali, and they came up and were joined to the others.

chinese: 基甸對神說：你若果照著所說的話，藉我手拯救以色列人，
english: Then Gideon said to God, If you are going to give Israel salvation by my hand, as you have said,

chinese: 我就把一團羊毛放在禾場上：若單是羊毛上有露水，別的地方都是乾的，我就知道你必照著所說的話，藉我手拯救以色列人。
english: See, I will put the wool of a sheep on the grain-floor; if there is dew on the wool only, while all the earth is dry, then I will be certain that it is your purpose to give Israel salvation by my hand as you have said.

chinese: 次日早晨基甸起來，見果然是這樣；將羊毛擠一擠，從羊毛中擰出滿盆的露水來。
english: And it was so: for he got up early on the morning after, and twisting the wool in his hands, he got a basin full of water from the dew on the wool.

chinese: 基甸又對神說：求你不要向我發怒，我再說這一次：讓我將羊毛再試一次。但願羊毛是乾的，別的地方都有露水。
english: Then Gideon said to God, Do not be moved to wrath against me if I say only this: let me make one more test with the wool; let the wool now be dry, while the earth is covered with dew.

chinese: 這夜神也如此行：獨羊毛上是乾的，別的地方都有露水。
english: And that night God did so; for the wool was dry, and there was dew on all the earth round it.

chinese: 耶路巴力就是基甸，他和一切跟隨的人早晨起來，在哈律泉旁安營。米甸營在他們北邊的平原，靠近摩利岡。
english: Then Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, and all the people with him, got up early and put up their tents by the side of the water-spring of Harod; the tents of Midian were on the north side of him, under the hill of Moreh in the valley.

chinese: 耶和華對基甸說：跟隨你的人過多，我不能將米甸人交在他們手中，免得以色列人向我誇大，說：是我們自己的手救了我們。
english: And the Lord said to Gideon, So great is the number of your people, that if I give the Midianites into their hands they will be uplifted in pride over me and will say, I myself have been my saviour.

chinese: 現在你要向這些人宣告說：凡懼怕膽怯的，可以離開基列山回去。於是有二萬二千人回去，只剩下一萬。
english: So now, let it be given out to the people that anyone who is shaking with fear is to go back from Mount Galud. So twenty-two thousand of the people went back, but there were still ten thousand.

chinese: 耶和華對基甸說：人還是過多；你要帶他們下到水旁，我好在那裡為你試試他們。我指點誰說：這人可以同你去，他就可以同你去；我指點誰說：這人不可同你去，他就不可同你去。
english: Then the Lord said to Gideon, There are still more people than is necessary; take them down to the water so that I may put them to the test for you there; then whoever I say is to go with you will go, and whoever I say is not to go will not go.

chinese: 基甸就帶他們下到水旁。耶和華對基甸說：凡用舌頭舔水，像狗舔的，要使他單站在一處；凡跪下喝水的，也要使他單站在一處。
english: So he took the people down to the water; and the Lord said to Gideon, Put on one side by themselves all those drinking up the water with their tongues like a dog; and in the same way, all those who go down on their knees to the water while drinking.

chinese: 於是用手捧著舔水的有三百人，其餘的都跪下喝水。
english: Now the number of those who took up the water with their tongues was three hundred; all the rest of the people went down on their knees to the water.

chinese: 耶和華對基甸說：我要用這舔水的三百人拯救你們，將米甸人交在你手中；其餘的人都可以各歸各處去。
english: And the Lord said to Gideon, By those three hundred who were drinking with their tongues I will give you salvation and give the Midianites into your hands; let the rest of the people go away, every man to his place.

chinese: 這三百人就帶著食物和角；其餘的以色列人，基甸都打發他們各歸各的帳棚，只留下這三百人。米甸營在他下邊的平原裡。
english: So they took the vessels of the people, and their horns from their hands, and he sent them away, every man to his tent, keeping only the three hundred; and the tents of Midian were lower down in the valley.

chinese: 當那夜，耶和華吩咐基甸說：起來，下到米甸營裡去，因我已將他們交在你手中。
english: The same night the Lord said to him, Up! go down now against their army, for I have given them into your hands.

chinese: 倘若你怕下去，就帶你的僕人普拉下到那營裡去。
english: But if you have fear of going down, take your servant Purah with you and go down to the tents;

chinese: 你必聽見他們所說的，然後你就有膽量下去攻營。於是基甸帶著僕人普拉下到營旁。
english: And after hearing what they are saying, you will get strength to go down against the army. So he went down with his servant Purah to the outer line of the tents of the armed men.

chinese: 米甸人、亞瑪力人，和一切東方人都布散在平原，如同蝗蟲那樣多。他們的駱駝無數，多如海邊的沙。
english: Now the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the people of the east were covering the valley like locusts; and their camels were like the sand by the seaside, without number.

chinese: 基甸到了，就聽見一人將夢告訴同伴說：我做了一夢，夢見一個大麥餅滾入米甸營中，到了帳幕，將帳幕撞倒，帳幕就翻轉傾覆了。
english: When Gideon came there, a man was giving his friend an account of his dream, saying, See, I had a dream about a cake of barley bread which, falling into the tents of Midian, came on to the tent, overturning it so that it was stretched out flat on the earth.

chinese: 那同伴說：這不是別的，乃是以色列人約阿施的兒子基甸的刀；神已將米甸和全軍都交在他的手中。
english: And his friend in answer said, This is certainly the sword of Gideon, the son of Joash, the men of Israel: into their hands God has given up all the army of Midian.

chinese: 基甸聽見這夢和夢的講解，就敬拜神，回到以色列營中，說：起來罷！耶和華已將米甸的軍隊交在你們手中了。
english: Then Gideon, hearing the story of the dream and the sense in which they took it, gave worship; then he went back to the tents of Israel, and said, Up! for the Lord has given the army of Midian into your hands.

chinese: 於是基甸將三百人分作三隊，把角和空瓶交在各人手裡（瓶內都藏著火把），
english: Then separating the three hundred men into three bands, he gave every man a horn, and a vessel in which was a flaming branch.

chinese: 吩咐他們說：你們要看我行事：我到了營的旁邊怎樣行，你們也要怎樣行。
english: And he said to them, Keep your eyes on me, and do what I do; when I come to the outer line of tents, whatever I do, you are to do the same.

chinese: 我和一切跟隨我的人吹角的時候，你們也要在營的四圍吹角，喊叫說：耶和華和基甸的刀！
english: At the sound of my horn, and the horns of those who are with me, let your horns be sounded all round the tents, and say, For the Lord and for Gideon.

chinese: 基甸和跟隨他的一百人，在三更之初才換更的時候，來到營旁，就吹角，打破手中的瓶。
english: So Gideon and the three hundred men who were with him came to the outer line of tents, at the start of the middle watch, when the watchmen had only then taken their stations; and the horns were sounded and the vessels broken.

chinese: 三隊的人就都吹角，打破瓶子，左手拿著火把，右手拿著角，喊叫說：耶和華和基甸的刀！
english: So the three bands all gave a loud note on their horns, and when the vessels had been broken, they took the flaming branches in their left hands, and the horns in their right hands ready for blowing, crying out, For the Lord and for Gideon.

chinese: 他們在營的四圍各站各的地方；全營的人都亂竄。三百人吶喊，使他們逃跑。
english: Then they made a line round the tents, every man in his place; and all the army, awaking from sleep, came running out, and with loud cries went in flight.

chinese: 三百人就吹角，耶和華使全營的人用刀互相擊殺，逃到西利拉的伯哈示他，直逃到靠近他巴的亞伯米何拉。
english: And the three hundred gave a loud note on their horns, and every man's sword was turned by the Lord against his brother all through the army; and the army went in flight as far as Beth-shittah in the direction of Zeredah, to the edge of Abel-meholah by Tabbath.

chinese: 以色列人就從拿弗他利、亞設，和瑪拿西全地聚集來追趕米甸人。
english: And the men of Israel came together from Naphtali and from Asher and all Manasseh, and went after Midian.

chinese: 基甸打發人走遍以法蓮山地，說：你們下來攻擊米甸人，爭先把守約但河的渡口，直到伯巴拉。於是以法蓮的眾人聚集，把守約但河的渡口，直到伯巴拉，
english: Then Gideon sent through all the hill-country of Ephraim saying, Come down against Midian, and keep the ways across Jordan before they come. So all the men of Ephraim, massing themselves together, kept the ways across Jordan.

chinese: 捉住了米甸人的兩個首領：一名俄立，一名西伊伯；將俄立殺在俄立磐石上，將西伊伯殺在西伊伯酒醡那裡；又追趕米甸人，將俄立和西伊伯的首級帶過約但河，到基甸那裡。
english: And they took the two chiefs of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; and they put Oreb to death at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb they put to death at the place of the grape-crushing in Zeeb, and they went after Midian; but the heads of Oreb and Zeeb they took across Jordan to Gideon.

chinese: 以法蓮人對基甸說：你去與米甸人爭戰，沒有招我們同去，為甚麼這樣待我們呢？他們就與基甸大大地爭吵。
english: And the men of Ephraim came and said to him, Why did you not send for us when you went to war against Midian? And they said sharp and angry words to him.

chinese: 基甸對他們說：我所行的豈能比你們所行的呢？以法蓮拾取剩下的葡萄不強過亞比以謝所摘的葡萄麼？
english: And he said to them, What have I done in comparison with you? Is not that which Ephraim took up after the grape-cutting better than all the grapes which Abiezer got in from the grape-cutting?

chinese: 神已將米甸人的兩個首領俄立和西伊伯交在你們手中；我所行的豈能比你們所行的呢？基甸說了這話，以法蓮人的怒氣就消了。
english: God has given into your hands the chiefs of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; what have I been able to do in comparison with you? And when he said this, their feeling about him became kinder.

chinese: 基甸和跟隨他的三百人到約但河過渡，雖然疲乏，還是追趕。
english: Then Gideon came to Jordan and went over it with his three hundred, overcome with weariness and in need of food.

chinese: 基甸對疏割人說：求你們拿餅來給跟隨我的人吃，因為他們疲乏了；我們追趕米甸人的兩個王西巴和撒慕拿。
english: And he said to the men of Succoth, Give bread cakes to my people, for they are overcome with weariness, and I am going on after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.

chinese: 疏割人的首領回答說：西巴和撒慕拿已經在你手裡，你使我們將餅給你的軍兵麼？
english: But the chiefs of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna even now in your hand that we are to give bread to your army?

chinese: 基甸說：耶和華將西巴和撒慕拿交在我手之後，我就用野地的荊條和枳棘打傷你們。
english: Then Gideon said, Because of this, when the Lord has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hands, I will have you stretched on a bed of thorns of the waste land and on sharp stems, and have you crushed as grain is crushed on a grain-floor.

chinese: 基甸從那裡上到毗努伊勒，對那裡的人也是這樣說；毗努伊勒人也與疏割人回答他的話一樣。
english: So he went up from there to Penuel and made the same request to the men of Penuel; but they gave him the same answer as the men of Succoth had given.

chinese: 他向毗努伊勒人說：我平平安安回來的時候，我必拆毀這樓。
english: So he said to the men of Penuel, When I come back in peace, I will have this tower broken down.

chinese: 那時西巴和撒慕拿，並跟隨他們的軍隊都在加各，約有一萬五千人，就是東方人全軍所剩下的；已經被殺約有十二萬拿刀的。
english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, those of all the army of the children of the east who were still living; for a hundred and twenty thousand of their swordsmen had been put to death.

chinese: 基甸就由挪巴和約比哈東邊，從住帳棚人的路上去，殺敗了米甸人的軍兵，因為他們坦然無懼。
english: And Gideon went up by the way used by the people living in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and made an attack on the army when they had no thought of danger.

chinese: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑；基甸追趕他們，捉住米甸的二王西巴和撒慕拿，驚散全軍。
english: And Zebah and Zalmunna went in flight; and he went after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and put all the army to the curse.

chinese: 約阿施的兒子基甸由希列斯坡從陣上回來，
english: Then Gideon, the son of Joash, went back from the fight:

chinese: 捉住疏割的一個少年人，問他：疏割的首領長老是誰？他就將首領長老七十七個人的名字寫出來。
english: And taking prisoner a young man of the people of Succoth, he got from him, in answer to his questions, a list of the chiefs of Succoth and the responsible men, seventy-seven men.

chinese: 基甸到了疏割，對那裡的人說：你們從前譏誚我說：西巴和撒慕拿已經在你手裡，你使我們將餅給跟隨你的疲乏人麼？ㄤ萑在西巴和撒慕拿在這裡。
english: So he came to the men of Succoth and said, Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, on account of whom you made sport of me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna even now in your hand, that we are to give bread to your army who are overcome with weariness?

chinese: 於是捉住那城內的長老，用野地的荊條和枳棘責打（原文是指教）疏割人；
english: Then he took the responsible men of the town and had them crushed on a bed of thorns and sharp stems.

chinese: 又拆了毗努伊勒的樓，殺了那城裡的人。
english: And he had the tower of Penuel broken down and the men of the town put to death.

chinese: 基甸問西巴和撒慕拿說：你們在他泊山所殺的人是甚麼樣式？回答說：他們好像你，各人都有王子的樣式。
english: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, Where are the men whom you put to death at Tabor? And they gave answer, As you are, so were they; every one of them was like a king's son.

chinese: 基甸說：他們是我同母的弟兄，我指著永生的耶和華起誓，你們從前若存留他們的性命，我如今就不殺你們了。
english: And he said, They were my brothers, my mother's sons: by the life of the Lord, if you had kept them safe, I would not put you to death.

chinese: 於是對他的長子益帖說：你起來殺他們。但益帖因為是童子，害怕，不敢拔刀。
english: Then he said to Jether, his oldest son, Up! Put them to death. But the boy did not take out his sword, fearing because he was still a boy.

chinese: 西巴和撒慕拿說：你自己起來殺我們罷！因為人如何，力量也是如何。基甸就起來，殺了西巴和撒慕拿，奪獲他們駱駝項上戴的月牙圈。
english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Up! Put an end to us yourself: for you have a man's strength. Then Gideon got up and put Zebah and Zalmunna to death and took the ornaments which were on their camels' necks.

chinese: 以色列人對基甸說：你既救我們脫離米甸人的手，願你和你的兒孫管理我們。
english: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, Be our ruler, you and your son and your son's son after him; for you have been our saviour from the hands of Midian.

chinese: 基甸說：我不管理你們，我的兒子也不管理你們，惟有耶和華管理你們。
english: But Gideon said to them, I will not be a ruler over you, and my son will not be a ruler over you: it is the Lord who will be ruler over you.

chinese: 基甸又對他們說：我有一件事求你們：請你們各人將所奪的耳環給我。原來仇敵是以實瑪利人，都是戴金耳環的。）
english: Then Gideon said to them, I have a request to make to you; let every man give me the ear-rings he has taken. (For they had gold ear-rings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

chinese: 他們說：我們情願給你。就鋪開一件外衣，各人將所奪的耳環丟在其上。
english: And they gave answer, We will gladly give them. So they put down a robe, every man dropping into it the ear-rings he had taken.

chinese: 基甸所要出來的金耳環重一千七百舍客勒金子。此外還有米甸王所戴的月環、耳墜，和所穿的紫色衣服，並駱駝項上的金鍊子。
english: The weight of the gold ear-rings which he got from them was one thousand, seven hundred shekels of gold; in addition to the moon-ornaments and jewels and the purple robes which were on the kings of Midian, and the chains on their camels' necks.

chinese: 基甸以此製造了一個以弗得，設立在本城俄弗拉。後來以色列人拜那以弗得行了邪淫；這就作了基甸和他全家的網羅。
english: And Gideon made an ephod from them and put it up in his town Ophrah; and all Israel went after it there and were false to the Lord; and it became a cause of sin to Gideon and his house.

chinese: 這樣，米甸人被以色列人制伏了，不敢再抬頭。基甸還在的日子，國中太平四十年。
english: So Midian was broken before the children of Israel and the Midianites never got back their strength. And the land had peace for forty years, in the days of Gideon.

chinese: 約阿施的兒子耶路巴力回去，住在自己家裡。
english: And Jerubbaal, the son of Joash, went back to his house and was living there.

chinese: 基甸有七十個親生的兒子，因為他有許多的妻。
english: Gideon had seventy sons, the offspring of his body; for he had a number of wives.

chinese: 他的妾住在示劍，也給他生了一個兒子。基甸與他起名叫亞比米勒。
english: And the servant-wife he had in Shechem had a son by him, to whom he gave the name Abimelech.

chinese: 約阿施的兒子基甸，年紀老邁而死，葬在亞比以謝族的俄弗拉，在他父親約阿施的墳墓裡。
english: And Gideon, the son of Joash, came to his end when he was very old, and his body was put in the resting-place of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

chinese: 基甸死後，以色列人又去隨從諸巴力行邪淫，以巴力比利土為他們的神。
english: And after the death of Gideon, the children of Israel again went after the gods of Canaan and were false to the Lord, and made Baal-berith their god.

chinese: 以色列人不記念耶和華─他們的神，就是拯救他們脫離四圍仇敵之手的，
english: And the children of Israel did not keep in their minds the Lord their God, who had been their saviour from all their haters on every side;

chinese: 也不照著耶路巴力，就是基甸向他們所施的恩惠厚待他的家。
english: And they were not kind to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, in reward for all the good he had done to Israel.

chinese: 耶路巴力的兒子亞比米勒到了示劍見他的眾母舅，對他們和他外祖全家的人說：
english: Now Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, went to Shechem to his mother's family, and said to them and to all the family of his mother's father,

chinese: 請你們問示劍的眾人說，是耶路巴力的眾子七十人都管理你們好呢？還是一人管理你們好呢？你們又要記念我是你們的骨肉。
english: Say now in the ears of all the townsmen of Shechem, Is it better for you to be ruled by all the seventy sons of Jerubbaal or by one man only? And keep in mind that I am your bone and your flesh.

chinese: 他的眾母舅便將這一切話為他說給示劍人聽，示劍人的心就歸向亞比米勒。他們說：他原是我們的弟兄；
english: So his mother's family said all this about him in the ears of all the townsmen of Shechem: and their hearts were turned to Abimelech, for they said, He is our brother.

chinese: 就從巴力比利土的廟中取了七十舍客勒銀子給亞比米勒；亞比米勒用以雇了些匪徒跟隨他。
english: And they gave him seventy shekels of silver from the house of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech got the support of a number of uncontrolled and good-for-nothing persons.

chinese: 他往俄弗拉到他父親的家，將他弟兄、耶路巴力的眾子七十人都殺在一塊磐石上；只剩下耶路巴力的小兒子約坦，因為他躲藏了。
english: Then he went to his father's house at Ophrah, and put his brothers, the seventy sons of Jerubbaal, to death on the same stone; however, Jotham, the youngest, kept himself safe by going away to a secret place.

chinese: 示劍人和米羅人都一同聚集，往示劍橡樹旁的柱子那裡，立亞比米勒為王。
english: And all the townsmen of Shechem and all Beth-millo came together and went and made Abimelech their king, by the oak of the pillar in Shechem.

chinese: 有人將這事告訴約坦，他就去站在基利心山頂上，向眾人大聲喊叫說：示劍人哪，你們要聽我的話，神也就聽你們的話。
english: Now Jotham, on hearing of it, went to the top of Mount Gerizim, and crying out with a loud voice said to them, Give ear to me, you townsmen of Shechem, so that God may give ear to you.

chinese: 有一時樹木要膏一樹為王，管理他們，就去對橄欖樹說：請你作我們的王。
english: One day the trees went out to make a king for themselves; and they said to the olive-tree, Be king over us.

chinese: 橄欖樹回答說：我豈肯止住供奉神和尊重人的油，飄颻在眾樹之上呢？
english: But the olive-tree said to them, Am I to give up my wealth of oil, by which men give honour to God, and go waving over the trees?

chinese: 樹木對無花果樹說：請你來作我們的王。
english: Then the trees said to the fig-tree, You come and be king over us.

chinese: 無花果樹回答說：我豈肯止住所結甜美的果子，飄颻在眾樹之上呢？
english: But the fig-tree said to them, Am I to give up my sweet taste and my good fruit and go waving over the trees?

chinese: 樹木對葡萄樹說：請你來作我們的王。
english: Then the trees said to the vine, You come and be king over us.

chinese: 葡萄樹回答說：我豈肯止住使神和人喜樂的新酒，飄颻在眾樹之上呢。
english: But the vine said to them, Am I to give up my wine, which makes glad God and men, to go waving over the trees?

chinese: 眾樹對荊棘說：請你來作我們的王。
english: Then all the trees said to the thorn, You come and be king over us.

chinese: 荊棘回答說：你們若誠誠實實地膏我為王，就要投在我的蔭下；不然，願火從荊棘裡出來，燒滅利巴嫩的香柏樹。
english: And the thorn said to the trees, If it is truly your desire to make me your king, then come and put your faith in my shade; and if not, may fire come out of the thorn, burning up the cedars of Lebanon.

chinese: 現在你們立亞比米勒為王，若按誠實正直善待耶路巴力和他的全家，這就是酬他的勞。
english: So now, if you have done truly and uprightly in making Abimelech king, and if you have done well to Jerubbaal and his house in reward for the work of his hands;

chinese: 從前我父冒死為你們爭戰，救了你們脫離米甸人的手。
english: (For my father made war for you, and put his life in danger, and made you free from the hands of Midian;

chinese: 你們如今起來攻擊我的父家，將他眾子七十人殺在一塊磐石上，又立他婢女所生的兒子亞比米勒為示劍人的王；他原是你們的弟兄。
english: And you have gone against my father's family this day, and have put to death his sons, even seventy men on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his servant-wife, king over the townsmen of Shechem because he is your brother;)

chinese: 你們如今若按誠實正直待耶路巴力和他的家，就可因亞比米勒得歡樂，他也可因你們得歡樂；
english: If then you have done what is true and upright to Jerubbaal and his family this day, may you have joy in Abimelech, and may he have joy in you;

chinese: 不然，願火從亞比米勒發出，燒滅示劍人和米羅眾人，又願火從示劍人和米羅人中出來，燒滅亞比米勒。
english: But if not, may fire come out from Abimelech, burning up the townsmen of Shechem and Beth-millo; and may fire come out from the townsmen of Shechem and Beth-millo, for the destruction of Abimelech.

chinese: 約坦因怕他弟兄亞比米勒，就逃跑，來到比珥，住在那裡。
english: Then Jotham straight away went in flight to Beer, and was living there for fear of his brother Abimelech.

chinese: 亞比米勒管理以色列人三年。
english: So Abimelech was chief over Israel for three years.

chinese: 神使惡魔降在亞比米勒和示劍人中間，示劍人就以詭詐待亞比米勒。
english: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the townsmen of Shechem; and the townsmen of Shechem were false to Abimelech;

chinese: 這是要叫耶路巴力七十個兒子所受的殘害歸與他們的哥哥亞比米勒，又叫那流他們血的罪歸與幫助他殺弟兄的示劍人。
english: So that punishment for the violent attack made on the seventy sons of Jerubbaal, and for their blood, might come on Abimelech, their brother, who put them to death, and on the townsmen of Shechem who gave him their help in putting his brothers to death.

chinese: 示劍人在山頂上設埋伏，等候亞比米勒。凡從他們那裡經過的人，他們就搶奪。有人將這事告訴亞比米勒。
english: And the townsmen of Shechem put secret watchers on the tops of the mountains, and they made attacks on all who went by on the road and took their goods; and word of this came to Abimelech.

chinese: 以別的兒子迦勒和他的弟兄來到示劍，示劍人都信靠他。
english: Then Gaal, the son of Ebed, came with his brothers, and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their faith in him.

chinese: 示劍人出城到田間去，摘下葡萄，踹酒，設擺筵宴，進他們神的廟中吃喝，咒詛亞比米勒。
english: And they went out into their fields and got in the fruit of their vines, and when the grapes had been crushed, they made a holy feast and went into the house of their god, and over their food and drink they were cursing Abimelech.

chinese: 以別的兒子迦勒說：亞比米勒是誰？示劍是誰？使我們服事他呢？他不是耶路巴力的兒子麼？他的幫手不是西布勒麼？你們可以服事示劍的父親哈抹的後裔。我們為何服事亞比米勒呢？
english: And Gaal, the son of Ebed, said, Who is Abimelech and who is Shechem, that we are to be his servants? Is it not right for the son of Jerubbaal and Zebul his captain to be servants to the men of Hamor, the father of Shechem? But why are we to be his servants?

chinese: 惟願這民歸我的手下，我就除掉亞比米勒。迦勒又對亞比米勒說：增添你的軍兵出來罷。
english: If only I had authority over this people! I would put Abimelech out of the way, and I would say to Abimelech, Make your army strong, and come out.

chinese: 邑宰西布勒聽見以別的兒子迦勒的話，就發怒，
english: Now Zebul, the ruler of the town, hearing what Gaal, the son of Ebed, had said, was moved to wrath.

chinese: 悄悄地打發人去見亞比米勒，說：以別的兒子迦勒和他的弟兄到了示劍，煽惑城中的民攻擊你。
english: And he sent to Abimelech at Arumah, saying, See, Gaal, the son of Ebed, and his brothers have come to Shechem, and they are working up the town against you.

chinese: 現在你和跟隨你的人今夜起來，在田間埋伏。
english: So now, get up by night, you and your people, and keep watch in the field secretly;

chinese: 到早晨太陽一出，你就起來闖城。迦勒和跟隨他的人出來攻擊你的時候，你便向他們見機而做。
english: And in the morning, when the sun is up, get up early and make a rush on the town; and when he and his people come out against you, do to them whatever you have a chance to do.

chinese: 於是，亞比米勒和跟隨他的眾人夜間起來，分作四隊，埋伏等候示劍人。
english: So Abimelech and the people with him got up by night, in four bands, to make a surprise attack on Shechem.

chinese: 以別的兒子迦勒出去，站在城門口。亞比米勒和跟隨他的人從埋伏之處起來。
english: And Gaal, the son of Ebed, went out, and took his place at the doorway into the town; then Abimelech and his people got up from the place where they had been waiting.

chinese: 迦勒看見那些人，就對西布勒說：看哪，有人從山頂上下來了。西布勒說：你看見山的影子，以為是人。
english: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, See! people are coming down from the tops of the mountains. And Zebul said to him, You see the shade of the mountains like men.

chinese: 迦勒又說：看哪，有人從高處下來，又有一隊從米惡尼尼橡樹的路上而來。
english: And Gaal said again, See! people are coming down from the middle of the land, and one band is coming by way of the oak-tree of the Seers.

chinese: 西布勒對他說：你曾說，亞比米勒是誰，叫我們服事他？你所誇的口在哪裡呢？這不是你所藐視的民麼？你現在出去，與他們交戰罷！
english: Then Zebul said to him, Now where is your loud talk when you said, Who is Abimelech that we are to be his servants? Is this not the people whom you were rating so low? Go out now, and make war on them.

chinese: 於是迦勒率領示劍人出去，與亞比米勒交戰。
english: So Gaal went out at the head of the townsmen of Shechem and made war on Abimelech.

chinese: 亞比米勒追趕迦勒；迦勒在他面前逃跑，有許多受傷仆倒的，直到城門。
english: And Abimelech went after him and he went in flight before him; and a great number were falling by the sword all the way up to the town.

chinese: 亞比米勒住在亞魯瑪。西布勒趕出迦勒和他弟兄，不准他們住在示劍。
english: Then Abimelech went back to Arumah; and Zebul sent Gaal and his brothers away and would not let them go on living in Shechem.

chinese: 次日，民出到田間，有人告訴亞比米勒；
english: Now the day after, the people went out into the fields; and news of it came to Abimelech.

chinese: 他就把他的人分作三隊，埋伏在田間，看見示劍人從城裡出來，就起來擊殺他們。
english: And he took his people, separating them into three bands, and was waiting secretly in the field; and when he saw the people coming out of the town, he went up and made an attack on them.

chinese: 亞比米勒和跟隨他的一隊向前闖去，站在城門口；那兩隊直闖到田間，擊殺了眾人。
english: And Abimelech with his band made a rush, and took up their position at the doorway into the town; and the other two bands made a rush on all those who were in the fields, and overcame them.

chinese: 亞比米勒整天攻打城，將城奪取，殺了其中的居民，將城拆毀，撒上了鹽。
english: And all that day Abimelech was fighting against the town; and he took it, and put to death the people who were in it, and had the town pulled down and covered with salt.

chinese: 示劍樓的人聽見了，就躲入巴力比利土廟的衛所。
english: Then all the townsmen of the tower of Shechem, hearing of it, went into the inner room of the house of El-berith.

chinese: 有人告訴亞比米勒說：示劍樓的人都聚在一處。
english: And word was given to Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were there together.

chinese: 亞比米勒和跟隨他的人就都上撒們山。亞比米勒手拿斧子，砍下一根樹枝，扛在肩上，對跟隨他的人說：你們看我所行的，也當趕緊照樣行。
english: Then Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, with all his people; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand and, cutting down branches of trees, took them and put them on his back. And he said to the people who were with him, Be quick and do as you have seen me do.

chinese: 眾人就各砍一枝，跟隨亞比米勒，把樹枝堆在衛所的四圍，放火燒了衛所，以致示劍樓的人都死了，男女約有一千。
english: So all the people got branches, every man cutting down a branch, and they went with Abimelech at their head and, massing the branches against the inner room, put fire to the room over them; so all those who were in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women, were burned to death with it.

chinese: 亞比米勒到提備斯，向提備斯安營，就攻取了那城。
english: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, and put his army in position against Thebez and took it.

chinese: 城中有一座堅固的樓；城裡的眾人，無論男女，都逃進樓去，關上門，上了樓頂。
english: But in the middle of the town there was a strong tower, to which all the men and women of the town went in flight and, shutting themselves in, went up to the roof of the tower.

chinese: 亞比米勒到了樓前攻打，挨近樓門，要用火焚燒。
english: And Abimelech came to the tower and made an attack on it, and got near to the door of the tower for the purpose of firing it.

chinese: 有一個婦人把一塊上磨石拋在亞比米勒的頭上，打破了他的腦骨。
english: But a certain woman sent a great stone, such as is used for crushing grain, on to the head of Abimelech, cracking the bone.

chinese: 他就急忙喊叫拿他兵器的少年人，對他說：拔出你的刀來，殺了我罷！免得人議論我說，他為一個婦人所殺。於是少年人把他刺透，他就死了。
english: Then quickly crying out to his body-servant, he said to him, Take out your sword and put an end to me straight away, so that men may not say of me, His death was the work of a woman. So the young man put his sword through him, causing his death.

chinese: 以色列人見亞比米勒死了，便各回自己的地方去了。
english: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they went away, every man to his place.

chinese: 這樣，神報應亞比米勒向他父親所行的惡，就是殺了弟兄七十個人的惡。
english: In this way Abimelech was rewarded by God for the evil he had done to his father in putting his seventy brothers to death;

chinese: 示劍人的一切惡，神也都報應在他們頭上；耶路巴力的兒子約坦的咒詛歸到們身上了。
english: And God sent back on to the heads of the men of Shechem all the evil they had done, and the curse of Jotham, the son of Jerubbaal, came on them.

chinese: 亞比米勒以後，有以薩迦人朵多的孫子、普瓦的兒子陀拉興起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法蓮山地的沙密。
english: Now after Abimelech, Tola, the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, became the saviour of Israel; he was living in Shamir in the hill-country of Ephraim.

chinese: 陀拉作以色列的士師二十三年，就死了，葬在沙密。
english: He was judge over Israel for twenty-three years; and at his death his body was put to rest in the earth in Shamir.

chinese: 在他以後有基列人睚珥興起，作以色列的士師二十二年。
english: And after him came Jair the Gileadite, who was judge over Israel for twenty-two years.

chinese: 他有三十個兒子，騎著三十匹驢駒。他們有三十座城邑，叫作哈倭特睚珥，直到如今，都是在基列地。
english: And he had thirty sons, who went on thirty young asses; and they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which are named Havvoth-Jair to this day.

chinese: 睚珥死了，就葬在加們。
english: And at the death of Jair his body was put to rest in the earth in Kamon.

chinese: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，去事奉諸巴力和亞斯他錄，並亞蘭的神、西頓的　神、摩押的　神、亞捫人的　神、非利士人的　神，離棄耶和華，不事奉他。
english: And again the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord, worshipping the Baals and Astartes, and the gods of Aram and the gods of Zidon and the gods of Moab and the gods of the children of Ammon and the gods of the Philistines; they gave up the Lord and were servants to him no longer.

chinese: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在非利士人和亞捫人的手中。
english: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

chinese: 從那年起，他們擾害欺壓約但河那邊、住亞摩利人之基列地的以色列人，共有十八年。
english: And that year the children of Israel were crushed under their yoke; for eighteen years all the children of Israel on the other side of Jordan, in the land of the Amorites which is in Gilead, were cruelly crushed down.

chinese: 亞捫人又渡過約但河去攻打猶大和便雅憫，並以法蓮族。以色列人就甚覺窘迫。
english: And the children of Ammon went over Jordan, to make war against Judah and Benjamin and the house of Ephraim; and Israel was in great trouble.

chinese: 以色列人哀求耶和華說：我們得罪了你；因為離棄了我們神，去事奉諸巴力。
english: Then the children of Israel, crying out to the Lord, said, Great is our sin against you, for we have given up our God and have been servants to the Baals.

chinese: 耶和華對以色列人說：我豈沒有救過你們脫離埃及人、亞摩利人、亞捫人，和非利士人麼？
english: And the Lord said to the children of Israel, Were not the Egyptians and the Amorites and the children of Ammon and the Philistines

chinese: 西頓人、亞瑪力人、馬雲人也都欺壓你們；你們哀求我，我也拯救你們脫離他們的手。
english: And the Zidonians and Amalek and Midian crushing you down, and in answer to your cry did I not give you salvation from their hands?

chinese: 你們竟離棄我，事奉別神！所以我不再救你們了。
english: But, for all this, you have given me up and have been servants to other gods: so I will be your saviour no longer.

chinese: 你們去哀求所選擇的神；你們遭遇急難的時候，讓他救你們罷！
english: Go, send up your cry for help to the gods of your selection; let them be your saviours in the time of your trouble.
