chinese: 以色列人對耶和華說：我們犯罪了，任憑你隨意待我們罷！只求你今日拯救我們。
english: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, We are sinners; do to us whatever seems good to you: only give us salvation this day.

chinese: 以色列人就除掉他們中間的外邦神，事奉耶和華。耶和華因以色列人受的苦難，就心中擔憂。
english: So they put away the strange gods from among them, and became the Lord's servants; and his soul was angry because of the sorrows of Israel.

chinese: 當時亞捫人聚集，安營在基列。以色列人也聚集，安營在米斯巴。
english: Then the children of Ammon came together and put their army in position in Gilead. And the children of Israel came together and put their army in position in Mizpah.

chinese: 基列的民和眾首領彼此商議說：誰能先去攻打亞捫人，誰必作基列一切居民的領袖。
english: And the people of Israel said to one another, Who will be the first to make an attack on the children of Ammon? We will make him head over all Gilead.

chinese: 基列人耶弗他是個大能的勇士，是妓女的兒子。耶弗他是基列所生的。
english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a great man of war; he was the son of a loose woman, and Gilead was his father.

chinese: 基列的妻也生了幾個兒子：他妻所生的兒子長大了，就趕逐耶弗他，說：你不可在我們父家承受產業，因為你是妓女的兒子。
english: And Gilead's wife gave birth to sons, and when her sons became men, they sent Jephthah away, saying, You have no part in the heritage of our father's house, for you are the son of another woman.

chinese: 耶弗他就逃避他的弟兄，去住在陀伯地，有些匪徒到他那裡聚集，與他一同出入。
english: So Jephthah went in flight from his brothers and was living in the land of Tob, where a number of good-for-nothing men, joining Jephthah, went out with him on his undertakings.

chinese: 過了些日子，亞捫人攻打以色列。
english: Now after a time the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

chinese: 亞捫人攻打以色列的時候，基列的長老到陀伯地去，要叫耶弗他回來；
english: And when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the responsible men of Gilead went to get Jephthah back from the land of Tob;

chinese: 對耶弗他說：請你來作我們的元帥，我們好與亞捫人爭戰。
english: And they said to Jephthah, Come and be our chief so that we may make war against the children of Ammon.

chinese: 耶弗他回答基列的長老說：從前你們不是恨我、趕逐我出離父家麼？現在你們遭遇急難為何到我這裡來呢？
english: But Jephthah said to the responsible men of Gilead, Did you not, in your hate for me, send me away from my father's house? Why do you come to me now when you are in trouble?

chinese: 基列的長老回答耶弗他說：現在我們到你這裡來，是要你同我們去，與亞捫人爭戰；你可以作基列一切居民的領袖。
english: And the responsible men of Gilead said to Jephthah, That is the reason we have come back to you; so go with us and make war against the children of Ammon, and we will make you our head over all the people of Gilead.

chinese: 耶弗他對基列的長老說：你們叫我回去，與亞捫人爭戰，耶和華把他交給我，我可以作你們的領袖麼？
english: Then Jephthah said to the responsible men of Gilead, If you take me back to make war against the children of Ammon, and if with the help of the Lord I overcome them, will you make me your head?

chinese: 基列的長老回答耶弗他說：有耶和華在你我中間作見證，我們必定照你的話行。
english: And the responsible men of Gilead said to Jephthah, May the Lord be our witness: we will certainly do as you say.

chinese: 於是耶弗他同基列的長老回去，百姓就立耶弗他作領袖、作元帥。耶弗他在米斯巴將自己的一切話陳明在耶和華面前。
english: So Jephthah went with the responsible men of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them; and Jephthah said all these things before the Lord in Mizpah.

chinese: 耶弗他打發使者去見亞捫人的王，說：你與我有甚麼相干，竟來到我國中攻打我呢？
english: Then Jephthah sent men to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What have you against me that you have come to make war against my land?

chinese: 亞捫人的王回答耶弗他的使者說：因為以色列從埃及上來的時候佔據我的地，從亞嫩河到雅博河，直到約但河。現在你要好好地將這地歸還罷！
english: And the king of the children of Ammon said to the men sent by Jephthah, Because Israel, when he came up out of Egypt, took away my land, from the Arnon as far as the Jabbok and as far as Jordan: so now, give me back those lands quietly.

chinese: 耶弗他又打發使者去見亞捫人的王，
english: And Jephthah sent again to the king of the children of Ammon,

chinese: 對他說：耶弗他如此說，以色列人並沒有佔據摩押地和亞捫人的地。
english: And said to him, This is the word of Jephthah: Israel did not take away the land of Moab or the land of the children of Ammon;

chinese: 以色列人從埃及上來乃是經過曠野到紅海，來到加低斯，
english: But when they came up from Egypt, Israel went through the waste land to the Red Sea and came to Kadesh;

chinese: 就打發使者去見以東王，說：求你容我從你的地經過。以東王卻不應允。又照樣打發使者去見摩押王，他也不允准。以色列人就住在加低斯。
english: Then Israel sent men to the king of Edom saying, Let me now go through your land; but the king of Edom did not give ear to them. And in the same way he sent to the king of Moab, but he would not; so Israel went on living in Kadesh.

chinese: 他們又經過曠野，繞著以東和摩押地，從摩押地的東邊過來，在亞嫩河邊安營，並沒有入摩押的境內，因為亞嫩河是摩押的邊界。
english: Then he went on through the waste land and round the land of Edom and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and put up their tents on the other side of the Arnon; they did not come inside the limit of Moab, for the Arnon was the limit of Moab.

chinese: 以色列人打發使者去見亞摩利王西宏，就是希實本的王，對他說：求你容我們從你的地經過，往我們自己的地方去。
english: And Israel sent men to Sihon, king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, Let me now go through your land to my place.

chinese: 西宏卻不信服以色列人，不容他們經過他的境界，乃招聚他的眾民在雅雜安營，與以色列人爭戰。
english: But Sihon would not give way and let Israel go through his land; and Sihon got together all his people, and put his army in position in Jahaz, and made war on Israel.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神將西宏和他的眾民都交在以色列人手中，以色列人就擊殺他們，得了亞摩利人的全地：
english: And the Lord, the God of Israel, gave Sihon and all his people into the hands of Israel, and they overcame them; so all the land of the Amorites, the people of that land, became Israel's.

chinese: 從亞嫩河到雅博河，從曠野直到約但河。
english: All the limit of the Amorites was theirs, from the Arnon as far as the Jabbok and from the waste land even to Jordan.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神在他百姓以色列面前趕出亞摩利人，你竟要得他們的地麼？
english: So now the Lord, the God of Israel, has taken away their land from the Amorites and given it to his people Israel; are you then to have it?

chinese: 你的神基抹所賜你的地你不是得為業麼？耶和華─我們的　神在我們面前所趕出的人，我們就得他的地。
english: Do you not keep the lands of those whom Chemosh your god sends out from before you? So we will keep all the lands of those whom the Lord our God sends out from before us.

chinese: 難道你比摩押王西撥的兒子巴勒還強麼？他曾與以色列人爭競，或是與他們爭戰麼？
english: What! are you any better than Balak, the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever take up a cause against Israel or make war against them?

chinese: 以色列人住希實本和屬希實本的鄉村，亞羅珥和屬亞羅珥的鄉村，並沿亞嫩河的一切城邑，已經有三百年了；在這三百年之內，你們為甚麼沒有取回這些地方呢？
english: While Israel was living in Heshbon and its daughter-towns and in Aroer and its daughter-towns and in all the towns which are by the side of the Arnon, for three hundred years, why did you not get them back at that time?

chinese: 原來我沒有得罪你，你卻攻打我，惡待我。願審判人的耶和華今日在以色列人和亞捫人中間判斷是非。
english: So I have done no wrong against you, but you are doing wrong to me in fighting against me: may the Lord, who is Judge this day, be judge between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

chinese: 但亞捫人的王不肯聽耶弗他打發人說的話。
english: The king of the children of Ammon, however, did not give ear to the words which Jephthah sent to him.

chinese: 耶和華的靈降在耶弗他身上，他就經過基列和瑪拿西，來到基列的米斯巴，又從米斯巴來到亞捫人那裡。
english: Then the spirit of the Lord came on Jephthah, and he went through Gilead and Manasseh, and came to Mizpeh of Gilead; and from Mizpeh of Gilead he went over to the children of Ammon.

chinese: 耶弗他就向耶和華許願，說：你若將亞捫人交在我手中，
english: And Jephthah took an oath to the Lord, and said, If you will give the children of Ammon into my hands,

chinese: 我從亞捫人那裡平平安安回來的時候，無論甚麼人，先從我家門出來迎接我，就必歸你，我也必將他獻上為燔祭。
english: Then whoever comes out from the door of my house, meeting me when I come back in peace from the children of Ammon, will be the Lord's and I will give him as a burned offering.

chinese: 於是耶弗他往亞捫人那裡去，與他們爭戰；耶和華將他們交在他手中，
english: So Jephthah went over to the children of Ammon to make war on them; and the Lord gave them into his hands.

chinese: 他就大大殺敗他們，從亞羅珥到米匿，直到亞備勒基拉明，攻取了二十座城。這樣亞捫人就被以色列人制伏了。
english: And he made an attack on them from Aroer all the way to Minnith, overrunning twenty towns, as far as Abel-cheramim, and put great numbers to the sword. So the children of Ammon were crushed before the children of Israel.

chinese: 耶弗他回米斯巴到了自己的家，不料，他女兒拿著鼓跳舞出來迎接他，是他獨生的，此外無兒無女。
english: Then Jephthah came back to his house in Mizpah, and his daughter came out, meeting him on his way with music and with dances; she was his only child; he had no other sons or daughters.

chinese: 耶弗他看見他，就撕裂衣服，說：哀哉！我的女兒啊，你使我甚是愁苦，叫我作難了；因為我已經向耶和華開口許願，不能挽回。
english: And when he saw her he was overcome with grief, and said, Ah! my daughter! I am crushed with sorrow, and it is you who are the chief cause of my trouble; for I have made an oath to the Lord and I may not take it back.

chinese: 他女兒回答說：父啊，你既向耶和華開口，就當照你口中所說的向我行，因耶和華已經在仇敵亞捫人身上為你報仇；
english: And she said to him, My father, you have made an oath to the Lord; do then to me whatever you have said; for the Lord has sent a full reward on your haters, on the children of Ammon.

chinese: 又對父親說：有一件事求你允准：容我去兩個月，與同伴在山上，好哀哭我終為處女。
english: Then she said to her father, Only do this for me: let me have two months to go away into the mountains with my friends, weeping for my sad fate.

chinese: 耶弗他說：你去罷！就容他去兩個月。他便和同伴去了，在山上為他終為處女哀哭。
english: And he said, Go then. So he sent her away for two months; and she went with her friends to the mountains, weeping for her sad fate.

chinese: 兩月已滿，他回到父親那裡，父親就照所許的願向他行了。女兒終身沒有親近男子。
english: And at the end of two months she went back to her father, who did with her as he had said in his oath: and she had never been touched by a man. So it became a rule in Israel,

chinese: 此後以色列中有個規矩，每年以色列的女子去為基列人耶弗他的女兒哀哭四天。
english: For the women to go year by year sorrowing for the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite, four days in every year.

chinese: 以法蓮人聚集，到了北方，對耶弗他說：你去與亞捫人爭戰，為甚麼沒有招我們同去呢？我們必用火燒你和你的房屋。
english: Now the men of Ephraim came together and took up arms and went over to Zaphon; and they said to Jephthah, Why did you go over to make war against the children of Ammon without sending for us to go with you? Now we will put your house on fire over you.

chinese: 耶弗他對他們說：我和我的民與亞捫；人大大爭戰；我招你們來，你們竟沒有來救我脫離他們的手。
english: And Jephthah said to them, I and my people were in danger, and the children of Ammon were very cruel to us, and when I sent for you, you gave me no help against them.

chinese: 我見你們不來救我，我就拚命前去攻擊亞捫人，耶和華將他們交在我手中。你們今日為甚麼上我這裡來攻打我呢？
english: So when I saw that there was no help to be had from you, I put my life in my hand and went over against the children of Ammon, and the Lord gave them into my hands: why then have you come up to me this day to make war on me?

chinese: 於是耶弗他招聚基列人，與以法蓮人爭戰。基列人擊殺以法蓮，是因他們說：你們基列人在以法蓮、瑪拿西中間，不過是以法蓮逃亡的人。
english: Then Jephthah got together all the men of Gilead and made war on Ephraim; and the men of Gilead overcame Ephraim.

chinese: 基列人把守約但河的渡口，不容以法蓮人過去。以法蓮逃走的人若說：容我過去。基列人就問他說：你是以法蓮人不是？他若說：不是，
english: And the Gileadites took the crossing-places of Jordan against the Ephraimites; and when any of the men of Ephraim who had gone in flight said, let me go over; the men of Gilead said to him, Are you an Ephraimite? And if he said, No;

chinese: 就對他說：你說示播列；以法蓮人因為咬不真字音，便說西播列。基列人就將他拿住，殺在約但河的渡口。那時以法蓮人被殺的有四萬二千人。
english: Then they said to him, Now say Shibboleth; and he said Sibboleth, and was not able to say it in the right way; then they took him and put him to death at the crossing-places of Jordan; and at that time forty-two thousand Ephraimites were put to death.

chinese: 耶弗他作以色列的士師年。基列人耶弗他死了，葬在基列的一座城裡。
english: Now Jephthah was judge of Israel for six years. And Jephthah the Gileadite came to his death, and his body was put to rest in his town, Mizpeh of Gilead.

chinese: 耶弗他以後，有伯利恆人以比讚作以色列士師。
english: And after him, Ibzan of Beth-lehem was judge of Israel.

chinese: 他有三十個兒子，三十女兒；女兒都嫁出去了。他給眾子從外鄉娶了三十媳婦。他作以色列的士師七年。
english: He had thirty sons, and thirty daughters whom he sent to other places, and he got thirty wives from other places for his sons. And he was judge of Israel for seven years.

chinese: 以比讚死了，葬在伯利恆。
english: And Ibzan came to his death and his body was put to rest at Beth-lehem.

chinese: 以比讚之後，有西布倫人以倫，作以色列的士師十年。
english: And after him, Elon the Zebulonite was judge of Israel; and he was judge of Israel for ten years.

chinese: 西布倫人以倫死了，葬在西布倫地的亞雅崙。
english: And Elon the Zebulonite came to his death, and his body was put to rest in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

chinese: 以倫之後，有比拉頓人希列的兒子押頓作以色的士師。
english: And after him, Abdon, the son of Hillel, the Pirathonite, was judge of Israel.

chinese: 他有四十個兒子，三十個孫子，騎著七十匹驢駒。押頓作以色列的士師八年。
english: He had forty sons and thirty sons' sons who went on seventy young asses; and he was judge of Israel for eight years.

chinese: 比拉頓人希列的兒子押頓死了，葬在以法蓮地的比拉頓，在亞瑪力人的山地。
english: And Abdon, the son of Hillel, came to his death, and his body was put to rest in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill-country of the Amalekites.

chinese: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，耶和華將他們交在非利士人手中四十年。
english: And the children of Israel again did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and the Lord gave them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.

chinese: 那時，有一個瑣拉人，是屬但族的，名叫瑪挪亞。他的妻不懷孕，不生育。
english: Now there was a certain man of Zorah of the family of the Danites, and his name was Manoah; and his wife had never given birth to a child.

chinese: 耶和華的使者向那婦人顯現，對他說：向來你不懷孕，不生育，如今你必懷孕生一個兒子。
english: And the angel of the Lord came to the woman, and said to her, See now! though you have never given birth to children, you will be with child and give birth to a son.

chinese: 所以你當謹慎，清酒濃酒都不可喝，一切不潔之物也不可吃。
english: Now then take care to have no wine or strong drink and to take no unclean thing for food;

chinese: 你必懷孕生一個兒子，不可用剃頭刀剃他的頭，因為這孩子一出胎就歸神作拿細耳人。他必起首拯救以色列人脫離非利士人的手。
english: For you are with child and will give birth to a son; his hair is never to be cut, for the child is to be separate to God from his birth; and he will take up the work of freeing Israel from the hands of the Philistines.

chinese: 婦人就回去對丈夫說：有一個神人到我面前來，他的相貌如　神使者的相貌，甚是可畏。我沒有問他從哪裡來，他也沒有將他的名告訴我，
english: Then the woman came in, and said to her husband, A man came to me, and his form was like the form of a god, causing great fear; I put no question to him about where he came from, and he did not give me his name;

chinese: 卻對我說：你要懷孕生一個兒子，所以清酒濃酒都不可喝，一切不潔之物也不可吃；因為這孩子從出胎一直到死，必歸□神作拿細耳人。
english: But he said to me, You are with child and will give birth to a son; and now do not take any wine or strong drink or let anything unclean be your food; for the child will be separate to God from his birth to the day of his death.

chinese: 瑪挪亞就祈求耶和華說：主啊，求你再差遣那神人到我們這裡來，好指教我們怎樣待這將要生的孩子。
english: Then Manoah made prayer to the Lord, and said, O Lord, let the man of God whom you sent come to us again and make clear to us what we are to do for the child who is to come.

chinese: 神應允瑪挪亞的話；婦人正坐在田間的時候，神的使者又到他那裡，他丈夫瑪挪亞卻沒有同他在一處。
english: And God gave ear to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came to the woman again when she was seated in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.

chinese: 婦人急忙跑去告訴丈夫說：那日到我面前來的人，又向我顯現。
english: So the woman, running quickly, gave her husband the news, saying, I have seen the man who came to me the other day.

chinese: 瑪挪亞起來跟隨他的妻來到那人面前，對他說：與這婦人說話的就是你麼？他說：是我。
english: And Manoah got up and went after his wife, and came up to the man and said to him, Are you the man who was talking to this woman? And he said, I am.

chinese: 瑪挪亞說：願你的話應驗！我們當怎樣待這孩子，他後來當怎樣呢？
english: And Manoah said, Now when your words come true, what is to be the rule for the child and what will be his work?

chinese: 耶和華的使者對瑪挪亞說：我告訴婦人的一切事，他都當謹慎。
english: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Let the woman take note of what I have said to her.

chinese: 葡萄樹所結的都不可吃，清酒濃酒都不可喝，一切不潔之物也不可吃。凡我所吩咐的，他都當遵守。
english: She is to have nothing which comes from the vine for her food, and let her take no wine or strong drink or anything which is unclean; let her take care to do all I have given her orders to do.

chinese: 瑪挪亞對耶和華的使者說：求你容我們款留你，好為你預備一隻山羊羔。
english: And Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, Now let us keep you while we make ready a young goat for you.

chinese: 耶和華的使者對瑪挪亞說：你雖然款留我，我卻不吃你的食物，你若預備燔祭就當獻與耶和華。原來瑪挪亞不知道他是耶和華的使者。
english: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Though you keep me I will not take of your food; but if you will make a burned offering, let it be offered to the Lord. For it had not come into Manoah's mind that he was the angel of the Lord.

chinese: 瑪挪亞對耶和華的使者說：請將你的名告訴我，到你話應驗的時候，我們好尊敬你。
english: Then Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, What is your name, so that when your words come true we may give you honour?

chinese: 耶和華的使者對他說：你何必問我的名，我名是奇妙的。
english: But the angel of the Lord said to him, Why are you questioning me about my name, seeing that it is a wonder?

chinese: 瑪挪亞將一隻山羊羔和素祭在磐石上獻與耶和華，使者行奇妙的事；瑪挪亞和他的妻觀看，
english: So Manoah took the young goat with its meal offering, offering it on the rock to the Lord, who did strange things.

chinese: 見火燄從壇上往上升，耶和華的使者在壇上的火燄中也升上去了。瑪挪亞和他的妻看見，就俯伏於地。
english: And when the flame went up to heaven from the altar, the angel of the Lord went up in the flame of the altar, while Manoah and his wife were looking on; and they went down on their faces to the earth.

chinese: 耶和華的使者不再向瑪挪亞和他的妻顯現，瑪挪亞才知道他是耶和華的使者。
english: But the angel of the Lord was seen no more by Manoah and his wife. Then it was clear to Manoah that he was the angel of the Lord.

chinese: 瑪挪亞對他的妻說：我們必要死，因為看見了神。
english: And Manoah said to his wife, Death will certainly be our fate, for it is a god whom we have seen.

chinese: 他的妻卻對他說：耶和華若要殺我們，必不從我們手裡收納燔祭和素祭，並不將這一切事指示我們，今日也不將這些話告訴我們。
english: But his wife said to him, If the Lord was purposing our death, he would not have taken our burned offering and our meal offering, or have given us such orders about the child.

chinese: 後來婦人生了一個兒子，給他起名叫參孫。孩子長大，耶和華賜福與他。
english: So the woman gave birth to a son, and gave him the name Samson; and he became a man and the blessing of the Lord was on him.

chinese: 在瑪哈尼但，就是瑣拉和以實陶中間，耶和華的靈才感動他。
english: And the spirit of the Lord first came on him in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

chinese: 參孫下到亭拿，在那裡看見一個女子，是非利士人的女兒。
english: Now Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah, of the daughters of the Philistines;

chinese: 參孫上來稟告他父母說：我在亭拿看見一個女子，是非利士人的女兒，願你們給我娶來為妻。
english: And when he came back he said to his father and mother, I have seen a woman in Timnah, of the daughters of the Philistines: get her now for me for my wife.

chinese: 他父母說：在你弟兄的女兒中，或在本國的民中，豈沒有一個女子，何至你去在未受割禮的非利士人中娶妻呢？參孫對他父親說：願你給我娶那女子，因我喜悅他。
english: Then his father and mother said to him, Is there no woman among the daughters of your relations or among all my people, that you have to go for your wife to the Philistines, who are without circumcision? But Samson said to his father, Get her for me, for she is pleasing to me.

chinese: 他的父母卻不知道這事是出於耶和華，因為他找機會攻擊非利士人。那時，非利士人轄制以色列人。
english: Now his father and mother had no knowledge that this was the purpose of the Lord, who had the destruction of the Philistines in mind. Now the Philistines at that time were ruling over Israel.

chinese: 參孫跟他父母下亭拿去，到了亭拿的葡萄園，見有一隻少壯獅子向他吼叫。
english: Then Samson went down to Timnah (and his father and his mother,) and came to the vine-gardens of Timnah; and a young lion came rushing out at him.

chinese: 耶和華的靈大大感動參孫，他雖然手無器械，卻將獅子撕裂，如同撕裂山羊羔一樣。他行這事並沒有告訴父母。
english: And the spirit of the Lord came on him with power, and, unarmed as he was, pulling the lion in two as one might do to a young goat, he put him to death; (but he said nothing to his father and mother of what he had done.)

chinese: 參孫下去與女子說話，就喜悅他；
english: So he went down and had talk with the woman; and she was pleasing to Samson.

chinese: 過了些日子，再下去要娶那女子，轉向道旁要看死獅，見有一群蜂子和蜜在死獅之內，
english: Then after a time he went back to take her; and turning from the road to see the dead body of the lion, he saw a mass of bees in the body of the lion, and honey there.

chinese: 就用手取蜜，且吃且走；到了父母那裡，給他父母，他們也吃了；只是沒有告訴這蜜是從死獅之內取來的。
english: And he took the honey in his hand, and went on, tasting it on the way; and when he came to his father and mother he gave some to them; but did not say that he had taken the honey from the body of the lion.

chinese: 他父親下去見女子。參孫在那裡設擺筵宴，因為向來少年人都有這個規矩。
english: Then Samson went down to the woman, and made a feast there, as was the way among young men.

chinese: 眾人看見參孫，就請了三十個人陪伴他。
english: And he took thirty friends, and they were with him.

chinese: 參孫對他們說：我給你們出一個謎語，你們在七日筵宴之內，若能猜出意思告訴我，我就給你們三十件裡衣，三十套衣裳；
english: And Samson said, Now I have a hard question for you: if you are able to give me the answer before the seven days of the feast are over, I will give you thirty linen robes and thirty changes of clothing;

chinese: 你們若不能猜出意思告訴我，你們就給我三十件裡衣，三十套衣裳。他們說：請將謎語說給我們聽。
english: But if you are not able to give me the answer, then you will have to give me thirty linen robes and thirty changes of clothing. And they said to him, Put your hard question and let us see what it is.

chinese: 參孫對他們說：吃的從吃者出來；甜的從強者出來。他們三日不能猜出謎語的意思。
english: And he said, Out of the taker of food came food, and out of the strong came the sweet. And at the end of three days they were still not able to give the answer.

chinese: 到第七天，他們對參孫的妻說：你誆哄你丈夫，探出謎語的意思告訴我們，免得我們用火燒你和你父家。你們請了我們來，是要奪我們所有的麼？
english: So on the fourth day they said to Samson's wife, Get from your husband the answer to his question by some trick or other, or we will have you and your father's house burned with fire; did you get us here to take all we have?

chinese: 參孫的妻在丈夫面前啼哭說：你是恨我，不是愛我，你給我本國的人出謎語，卻沒有將意思告訴我。參孫回答說：連我父母我都沒有告訴，豈可告訴你呢？
english: Then Samson's wife, weeping over him, said, Truly you have no love for me but only hate; you have put a hard question to the children of my people and have not given me the answer. And he said to her, See, I have not given the answer even to my father or my mother; am I to give it to you?

chinese: 七日筵宴之內，他在丈夫面前啼哭，到第七天逼著他，他才將謎語的意思告訴他妻，他妻就告訴本國的人。
english: And all the seven days of the feast she went on weeping over him; and on the seventh day he gave her the answer, because she gave him no peace; and she sent word of it to the children of her people.

chinese: 到第七天，日頭未落以前，那城裡的人對參孫說：有甚麼比蜜還甜呢？有甚麼比獅子還強呢？參孫對他們說：你們若非用我的母牛犢耕地，就猜不出我謎語的意思來。
english: Then on the seventh day, before he went into the bride's room, the men of the town said to him, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? And he said to them, If you had not been ploughing with my cow you would not have got the answer to my question.

chinese: 耶和華的靈大大感動參孫，他就下到亞實基倫，擊殺了三十個人，奪了他們的衣裳，將衣裳給了猜出謎語的人。參孫發怒，就上父家去了。
english: And the spirit of the Lord came rushing on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and, attacking thirty men there, took their clothing from them, and gave it to the men who had given the answer to his hard question. Then, full of wrath, he went back to his father's house.

chinese: 參孫的妻便歸了參孫的陪伴，就是作過他朋友的。
english: But Samson's wife was given to the friend who had been his best man.

chinese: 過了些日子，到割麥子的時候，參孫帶著一隻山羊羔去看他的妻，說：我要進內室見我的妻。他岳父不容他進去，
english: Now a short time after, at the time of the grain-cutting, Samson, taking with him a young goat, went to see his wife; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the bride's room. But her father would not let him go in.

chinese: 說：我估定你是極其恨他，因此我將他給了你的陪伴。他的妹子不是比他還美麗麼？你可以娶來代替他罷！
english: And her father said, It seemed to me that you had only hate for her; so I gave her to your friend: but is not her younger sister fairer than she? so please take her in place of the other.

chinese: 參孫說：這回我加害於非利士人不算有罪。
english: Then Samson said to them, This time I will give payment in full to the Philistines, for I am going to do them great evil.

chinese: 於是參孫去捉了三百隻狐狸（或譯：野狗），將狐狸尾巴一對一對地捆上，將火把捆在兩條尾巴中間，
english: So Samson went and got three hundred foxes and some sticks of fire-wood; and he put the foxes tail to tail with a stick between every two tails;

chinese: 點著火把，就放狐狸進入非利士人站著的禾稼，將堆集的禾捆和未割的禾稼，並橄欖園盡都燒了。
english: Then firing the sticks, he let the foxes loose among the uncut grain of the Philistines, and all the corded stems as well as the living grain and the vine-gardens and the olives went up in flames.

chinese: 非利士人說：這事是誰做的呢？有人說：是亭拿人的女婿參孫，因為他岳父將他的妻給了他的陪伴。於是非利士人上去，用火燒了婦人和他的父親。
english: Then the Philistines said, Who has done this? And they said, Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he took his wife and gave her to his friend. So the Philistines came up and had her and her father's house burned.

chinese: 參孫對非利士人說：你們既然這樣行，我必向你們報仇才肯罷休。
english: And Samson said to them, If you go on like this, truly I will take my full payment from you; and that will be the end of it.

chinese: 參孫就大大擊殺他們，連腿帶腰都砍斷了。他便下去，住在以坦磐的穴內。
english: And he made an attack on them, driving them in uncontrolled flight, and causing great destruction; then he went away to his safe place in the crack of the rock at Etam.

chinese: 非利士人上去安營在猶大，布散在利希。
english: Then the Philistines went and put up their tents in Judah, all round Lehi.

chinese: 猶大人說：你們為何上來攻擊我們呢？他們說：我們上來是要捆綁參孫；他向我們怎樣行，我們也要向他怎樣行。
english: And the men of Judah said, Why have you come up against us? And they said, We have come up to take Samson, and to do to him as he has done to us.

chinese: 於是有三千猶大人下到以坦磐的穴內，對參孫說：非利士人轄制我們，你不知道麼？你向我們行的是甚麼事呢？他回答說：他們向我怎樣行，我也要向他們怎樣行。
english: Then three thousand of the men of Judah went down to the crack of the rock of Etam, and said to Samson, Is it not clear to you that the Philistines are our rulers? What is this you have done to us? And he said to them, I only did to them as they did to me.

chinese: 猶大人對他說：我們下來是要捆綁你，將你交在非利士人手中。參孫說：你們要向我起誓，應承你們自己不害死我。
english: Then they said to him, We have come down to take you and give you up into the hands of the Philistines. And Samson said to them, Give me your oath that you will not make an attack on me yourselves.

chinese: 他們說：我們斷不殺你，只要將你捆綁交在非利士人手中。於是用兩條新繩捆綁參孫，將他從以坦磐帶上去。
english: And they said, No; we will take you and give you up into their hands, but truly we will not put you to death. So knotting two new cords round him they took him up from the rock.

chinese: 參孫到了利希，非利士人都迎著喧嚷。耶和華的靈大大感動參孫，他臂上的繩就像火燒的麻一樣，他的綁繩都從他手上脫落下來。
english: And when he came to Lehi, the Philistines came out, meeting him with loud cries; then the spirit of the Lord came rushing on him, and the cords on his arms became like grass which has been burned with fire, and the bands came falling off his hands.

chinese: 他見一塊未乾的驢腮骨，就伸手拾起來，用以擊殺一千人。
english: And taking up the mouth-bone of an ass newly dead, which he saw by chance on the earth, he put to death a thousand men with it.

chinese: 參孫說：我用驢恉骨殺人成堆，用驢腮骨殺了一千人。
english: And Samson said, With a red ass's mouth-bone I have made them red with blood, with a red ass's mouth-bone I have sent destruction on a thousand men.

chinese: 說完這話，就把那恉骨從手裡拋出去了。那地便叫拉末利希。
english: And having said these words, he let the mouth-bone go out of his hand; so that place was named Ramath-lehi.

chinese: 參孫甚覺口渴，就求告耶和華說：你既藉僕人的手施行這麼大的拯救，豈可任我渴死、落在未受割禮的人手中呢？
english: After this, he was in great need of water, and crying out to the Lord, he said, You have given this great salvation by the hand of your servant, and now need of water will be my death; and I will be given into the hands of this people who are without circumcision.

chinese: 神就使利希的窪處裂開，有水從其中湧出來。參孫喝了，精神復原；因此那泉名叫隱哈歌利，那泉直到今日還在利希。
english: Then God made a crack in the hollow rock in Lehi and water came out of it; and after drinking, his spirit came back to him and he was strong again; so that place was named En-hakkore; it is in Lehi to this day.

chinese: 當非利士人轄制以色列人的時候，參孫作以色列的士師二十年。
english: And he was judge of Israel in the days of the Philistines for twenty years.

chinese: 參孫到了迦薩，在那裡看見一個妓女，就與他親近。
english: Now Samson went to Gaza, and there he saw a loose woman and went in to her.

chinese: 有人告訴迦薩人說：參孫到這裡來了！他們就把他團團圍住，終夜在城門悄悄埋伏，說：等到天亮我們便殺他。
english: And it was said to the Gazites, Samson is here. So they went round, watching for him all day at the doorway of the town, but at night they kept quiet, saying, When daylight comes we will put him to death.

chinese: 參孫睡到半夜，起來，將城門的門扇、門框、門閂，一齊拆下來，扛在肩上，扛到希伯崙前的山頂上。
english: And Samson was there till the middle of the night; then he got up, and took a grip on the doors of the town, pulling them up, together with their two supports and their locks, and put them on his back and took them up to the top of the hill in front of Hebron.

chinese: 後來，參孫在梭烈谷喜愛一個婦人，名叫大利拉。
english: Now after this, he was in love with a woman in the valley of Sorek, named Delilah.

chinese: 非利士人的首領上去見那婦人，對他說：求你誆哄參孫，探探他因何有這麼大的力氣，我們用何法能勝他，捆綁剋制他。我們就每人給你一千一百舍客勒銀子。
english: And the chiefs of the Philistines came up to her, and said to her, Make use of your power over him and see what is the secret of his great strength, and how we may get the better of him, and put bands on him, so that we may make him feeble; and every one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver.

chinese: 大利拉對參孫說：求你告訴我，你因何有這麼大的力氣，當用何法捆綁剋制你。
english: So Delilah said to Samson, Make clear to me now what is the secret of your great strength, and how you may be put in bands and made feeble.

chinese: 參孫回答說：人若用七條未乾的青繩子捆綁我，我就軟弱像別人一樣。
english: And Samson said to her, If seven new bow-cords which have never been made dry are knotted round me, I will become feeble and will be like any other man.

chinese: 於是非利士人的首領拿了七條未乾的青繩子來，交給婦人，他就用繩子捆綁參孫。
english: So the chiefs of the Philistines gave her seven new bow-cords which had never been made dry, and she had them tightly knotted round him.

chinese: 有人預先埋伏在婦人的內室裡。婦人說：參孫哪，非利士人拿你來了！參孫就掙斷繩子，如掙斷經火的麻線一般。這樣，他力氣的根由人還是不知道。
english: Now she had men waiting secretly in the inner room; and she said to him, The Philistines are on you, Samson. And the cords were broken by him as a twist of thread is broken when touched by a flame. So the secret of his strength did not come to light.

chinese: 大利拉對參孫說：你欺哄我，向我說謊言。現在求你告訴我當用何法捆綁你。
english: Then Delilah said to Samson, See, you have been making sport of me with false words; now, say truly how may you be put in bands?

chinese: 參孫回答說：人若用沒有使過的新繩捆綁我，我就軟弱像別人一樣。
english: And he said to her, If they only put round me new thick cords which have never been used, then I will become feeble and will be like any other man.

chinese: 大利拉就用新繩捆綁他，對他說：參孫哪，非利士人拿你來了！有人預先埋伏在內室裡。參孫將臂上的繩掙斷了，如掙斷一條線一樣。
english: So Delilah took new thick cords, knotting them tightly round him, and said to him, The Philistines are on you, Samson. And men were waiting secretly in the inner room. And the cords were broken off his arms like threads.

chinese: 大利拉對參孫說：你到如今還是欺哄我，向我說謊言。求你告訴我，當用何法捆綁你。參孫回答說：你若將我頭上的七條髮綹，與緯線同織就可以了。
english: Then Delilah said to Samson, Up to now you have made sport of me with false words; now say truly, how may you be put in bands? And he said to her, If you get the seven twists of my hair worked into the cloth you are making and fixed with the pin, I will become feeble and will be like any other man.

chinese: 於是大利拉將他的髮綹與緯線同織，用橛子釘住，對他說：參孫哪，非利士人拿你來了！參孫從睡中醒來，將機上的橛子和緯線一齊都拔出來了。
english: So while he was sleeping she got the seven twists of his hair worked into her cloth and fixed with the pin, and said to him, The Philistines are on you, Samson. Then awaking from his sleep, he got up quickly, pulling up cloth and machine together.

chinese: 大利拉對參孫說：你既不與我同心，怎麼說你愛我呢？你這三次欺哄我，沒有告訴我，你因何有這麼大的力氣。
english: And she said to him, Why do you say you are my lover when your heart is not mine? Three times you have made sport of me, and have not made clear to me the secret of your great strength.

chinese: 大利拉天天用話催逼他，甚至他心裡煩悶要死。
english: So day after day she gave him no peace, for ever questioning him till his soul was troubled to death.

chinese: 參孫就把心中所藏的都告訴了他，對他說：向來人沒有用剃頭刀剃我的頭，因為我自出母胎就歸神作拿細耳人；若剃了我的頭髮，我的力氣就離開我，我便軟弱像別人一樣。
english: And opening all his heart to her, he said to her, My head has never been touched by a blade, for I have been separate to God from the day of my birth: if my hair is cut off, then my strength will go from me and I will become feeble, and will be like any other man.

chinese: 大利拉見他把心中所藏的都告訴了他，就打發人到非利士人的首領那裡，對他們說：他已經把心中所藏的都告訴了我，請你們再上來一次。於是非利士人的首領手裡拿著銀子，上到婦人那裡。
english: And when Delilah saw that he had let her see into his heart, she sent word to the chiefs of the Philistines saying, Come up this time, for he has let out all his heart to me. Then the chiefs of the Philistines came to her, with the money in their hands.

chinese: 大利拉使參孫枕著他的膝睡覺，叫了一個人來剃除他頭上的七條髮綹。於是大利拉剋制他，他的力氣就離開他了。
english: And she made him go to sleep on her knees; and she sent for a man and had his seven twists of hair cut off; and while it was being done he became feeble and his strength went from him.

chinese: 大利拉說：參孫哪，非利士人拿你來了！參孫從睡中醒來，心裡說：我要像前幾次出去活動身體；他卻不知道耶和華已經離開他了。
english: Then she said, The Philistines are on you, Samson. And awaking from his sleep, he said, I will go out as at other times, shaking myself free. But he was not conscious that the Lord had gone from him.

chinese: 非利士人將他拿住，剜了他的眼睛，帶他下到迦薩，用銅鍊拘索他；他就在監裡推磨。
english: So the Philistines took him and put out his eyes; then they took him down to Gaza, and, chaining him with bands of brass, put him to work crushing grain in the prison-house.

chinese: 然而他的頭髮被剃之後，又漸漸長起來了。
english: But the growth of his hair was starting again after it had been cut off.

chinese: 非利士人的首領聚集，要給他們的神大袞獻大祭，並且歡樂，因為他們說：我們的神將我們的仇敵參孫交在我們手中了。
english: And the chiefs of the Philistines came together to make a great offering to Dagon their god, and to be glad; for they said, Our god has given into our hands Samson our hater.

chinese: 眾人看見參孫，就讚美他們的神說：我們的　神將毀壞我們地、殺害我們許多人的仇敵交在我們手中了。
english: And when the people saw him, they gave praise to their god; for they said, Our god has given into our hands the one who was fighting against us, who made our country waste, and who put great numbers of us to death.

chinese: 他們正宴樂的時候，就說：叫參孫來，在我們面前戲耍戲耍。於是將參孫從監裡提出來，他就在眾人面前戲耍。他們使他站在兩柱中間。
english: Now when their hearts were full of joy, they said, Send for Samson to make sport for us. And they sent for Samson out of the prison-house, and he made sport before them; and they put him between the pillars.

chinese: 參孫向拉他手的童子說：求你讓我摸著托房的柱子，我要靠一靠。
english: And Samson said to the boy who took him by the hand, Let me put my hand on the pillars supporting the house, so that I may put my back against them.

chinese: 那時房內充滿男女，非利士人的眾首領也都在那裡。房的平頂上約有三千男女觀看參孫戲耍。
english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and about three thousand men and women were on the roof, looking on while Samson made sport.

chinese: 參孫求告耶和華說：主耶和華啊，求你眷念我。神啊，求你賜我這一次的力量，使我在非利士人身上報那剜我雙眼的仇。
english: And Samson, crying out to the Lord, said, O Lord God, do have me now in mind, and do make me strong only this once, O God, so that I may take one last payment from the Philistines for my two eyes.

chinese: 參孫就抱住托房的那兩根柱子：左手抱一根，右手抱一根，
english: Then Samson put his arms round the two middle pillars supporting the house, putting his weight on them, on one with his right hand and on the other with his left.

chinese: 說：我情願與非利士人同死！就盡力屈身，房子倒塌，壓住首領和房內的眾人。這樣，參孫死時所殺的人比活著所殺的還多。
english: And Samson said, Let death overtake me with the Philistines. And he put out all his strength, and the house came down on the chiefs and on all the people who were in it. So the dead whom he sent to destruction by his death were more than all those on whom he had sent destruction in his life.

chinese: 參孫的弟兄和他父的全家都下去取他的屍首，抬上來葬在瑣拉和以實陶中間，在他父瑪挪亞的墳墓裡。參孫作以色列的士師二十年。
english: Then his brothers and his father's people came down and took him up and put his body to rest in the earth between Zorah and Eshtaol in the resting-place of Manoah his father. And he had been judge of Israel for twenty years.

chinese: 以法蓮山地有一個人名叫米迦。
english: Now there was a man of the hill-country of Ephraim named Micah.

chinese: 他對母親說：你那一千一百舍客勒銀子被人拿去，你因此咒詛，並且告訴了我。看哪，這銀子在我這裡，是我拿去了。他母親說：我兒啊，願耶和華賜福與你！
english: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver which were taken from you, about which you took an oath and said in my hearing, I have given this silver to the Lord from my hand for myself, to make a pictured image and a metal image: see, I have the silver, for I took it: so now I will give it back to you. And his mother said, May the blessing of the Lord be on my son.

chinese: 米迦就把這一千一百舍客勒銀子還他母親。他母親說：我分出這銀子來為你獻給耶和華，好雕刻一個像，鑄成一個像。現在我還是交給你。
english: And he gave back the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, and his mother said, I have made the silver holy to the Lord from me for my son, to make a pictured image and a metal image.

chinese: 米迦將銀子還他母親，他母親將二百舍客勒銀子交給銀匠，雕刻一個像，鑄成一個像，安置在米迦的屋內。
english: So he gave the silver back to his mother. Then his mother took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a metal-worker who made a pictured image and a metal image from them: and it was in the house of Micah.

chinese: 這米迦有了神堂，又製造以弗得和家中的神像，分派他一個兒子作祭司。
english: And the man Micah had a house of gods; and he made an ephod and family gods and put one of his sons in the position of priest.

chinese: 那時以色列中沒有王，各人任意而行。
english: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did as seemed right to him.

chinese: 猶大的伯利恆有一個少年人，是猶大族的利未人，他在那裡寄居。
english: Now there was a young man living in Beth-lehem-judah, of the family of Judah and a Levite, who was not a townsman of the place.

chinese: 這人離開猶大的伯利恆城，要找一個可住的地方。行路的時候，到了以法蓮山地，走到米迦的家。
english: And he went away from the town of Beth-lehem-judah, looking for somewhere to make his living-place; and on his journey he came to the hill-country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah.

chinese: 米迦問他說：你從哪裡來？他回答說：從猶大的伯利恆來。我是利未人，要找一個可住的地方。
english: And Micah said to him, Where do you come from? And he said to him, I am a Levite from Beth-lehem-judah, and I am looking for a living-place.

chinese: 米迦說：你可以住在我這裡，我以你為父、為祭司。我每年給你十舍客勒銀子，一套衣服和度日的食物。利未人就進了他的家。
english: Then Micah said to him, Make your living-place with me, and be a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten shekels of silver a year and your clothing and food.

chinese: 利未人情願與那人同住；那人看這少年人如自己的兒子一樣。
english: And the Levite said he would make his living-place with the man, and he became to him as one of his sons.

chinese: 米迦分派這少年的利未人作祭司，他就住在米迦的家裡。
english: And Micah gave the position to the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

chinese: 米迦說：現在我知道耶和華必賜福與我，因我有一個利未人作祭司。
english: Then Micah said, Now I am certain that the Lord will do me good, seeing that the Levite has become my priest.

chinese: 那時，以色列中沒有王。但支派的人仍是尋地居住；因為到那日子，他們還沒有在以色列支派中得地為業。
english: In those days there was no king in Israel, and in those days the Danites were looking for a heritage for themselves, to be their living-place; for up to that time no distribution of land had been made to them among the tribes of Israel.

chinese: 但人從瑣拉和以實陶打發本族中的五個勇士，去仔細窺探那地，吩咐他們說：你們去窺探那地。他們來到以法蓮山地，進了米迦的住宅，就在那裡住宿。
english: So the children of Dan sent five men from among their number, strong men, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to take a look at the land and make a search through it; and they said to them, Go and make a search through the land; and they came to the hill-country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, where they made a stop for the night.

chinese: 他們臨近米迦的住宅，聽出那少年利未人的口音來，就進去問他說：誰領你到這裡來？你在這裡做甚麼？你在這裡得甚麼？
english: When they were near the house of Micah, hearing a voice which was not strange to them, that of the young Levite, they went out of their road to his place, and said to him, How did you come here? and what are you doing in this place? and why are you here?

chinese: 他回答說：米迦待我如此如此，請我作祭司。
english: And he said to them, This is what Micah did for me, and he gave me payment and I became his priest.

chinese: 他們對他說：請你求問神，使我們知道所行的道路通達不通達。
english: Then they said, Do get directions from God for us, to see if the journey on which we are going will have a good outcome.

chinese: 祭司對他們說：你們可以平平安安地去，你們所行的道路是在耶和華面前的。
english: And the priest said to them, Go in peace: your way is guided by the Lord.

chinese: 五人就走了，來到拉億，見那裡的民安居無慮，如同西頓人安居一樣。在那地沒有人掌權擾亂他們；他們離西頓人也遠，與別人沒有來往。
english: Then the five men went on their way and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, living without thought of danger, like the Zidonians, quiet and safe; for they had everything on earth for their needs, and they were far from the Zidonians and had no business with Aram.

chinese: 五人回到瑣拉和以實陶，見他們的弟兄；弟兄問他們說：你們有甚麼話？
english: So they came back to their brothers in Zorah and Eshtaol, and their brothers said to them, What news have you?

chinese: 他們回答說：起來，我們上去攻擊他們罷！我們已經窺探那地，見那地甚好。你們為何靜坐不動呢？要急速前往得那地為業，不可遲延。
english: And they said, Up! and let us go against Laish; for we have seen the land, and it is very good: why are you doing nothing? Do not be slow to go in and take the land for your heritage.

chinese: 你們到了那裡，必看見安居無慮的民，地也寬闊。□神已將那地交在你們手中；那地百物俱全，一無所缺。
english: When you come there you will come to a people living without thought of danger; and the land is wide, and God has given it into your hands: a place where there is everything on earth for man's needs.

chinese: 於是但族中的六百人，各帶兵器，從瑣拉和以實陶前往，
english: So six hundred men of the Danites from Zorah and Eshtaol went out armed with instruments of war.

chinese: 上到猶大的基列耶琳，在基列耶琳後邊安營。因此那地方名叫瑪哈尼但，直到今日。
english: And they went up and put up their tents in Kiriath-jearim in Judah: so that place is named Mahaneh-dan to this day. It is to the west of Kiriath-jearim.

chinese: 他們從那裡往以法蓮山地去，來到米迦的住宅。
english: From there they went on to the hill-country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah.

chinese: 從前窺探拉億地的五個人對他們的弟兄說：這宅子裡有以弗得和家中的神像，並雕刻的像與鑄成的像，你們知道麼？現在你們要想一想當怎樣行。
english: Then the five men who had gone to make a search through the country of Laish, said to their brothers, Have you knowledge that in these houses there is an ephod and family gods and a pictured image and a metal image? So now you see what to do.

chinese: 五人就進入米迦的住宅，到了那少年利未人的房內問他好。
english: And turning from their road they came to the house of the young Levite, the house of Micah, and said to him, Is it well with you?

chinese: 那六百但人各帶兵器，站在門口。
english: And the six hundred armed men of the Danites took their places by the doorway.

chinese: 窺探地的五個人走進去，將雕刻的像、以弗得、家中的神像，並鑄成的像，都拿了去。祭司和帶兵器的六百人，一同站在門口。
english: Then the five men who had gone to make a search through the land, went in and took the pictured image and the ephod and the family gods and the metal image; and the priest was by the doorway with the six hundred armed men.

chinese: 那五個人進入米迦的住宅，拿出雕刻的像、以弗得、家中的神像，並鑄成的像，祭司就問他們說：你們做甚麼呢？
english: And when they went into Micah's house and took out the pictured image and the ephod and the family gods and the metal image, the priest said to them, What are you doing?

chinese: 他們回答說：不要作聲，用手摀口，跟我們去罷！我們必以你為父、為祭司。你作一家的祭司好呢？還是作以色列一族一支派的祭司好呢？
english: And they said to him, Be quiet; say nothing, and come with us and be our father and priest; is it better for you to be priest to one man's house or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?

chinese: 祭司心裡喜悅，便拿著以弗得和家中的神像，並雕刻的像，進入他們中間。
english: Then the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod and the family gods and the pictured image and went with the people.

chinese: 他們就轉身離開那裡，妻子、兒女、牲畜、財物都在前頭。
english: So they went on their way again, putting the little ones and the oxen and the goods in front of them.

chinese: 離米迦的住宅已遠，米迦的近鄰都聚集來，追趕但人，
english: When they had gone some way from the house of Micah, the men from the houses near Micah's house came together and overtook the children of Dan,

chinese: 呼叫但人。但人回頭問米迦說：你聚集這許多人來做甚麼呢？
english: Crying out to them. And the Danites, turning round, said to Micah, What is your trouble, that you have taken up arms?

chinese: 米迦說：你們將我所做的神像和祭司都帶了去，我還有所剩的麼？怎麼還問我說做甚麼呢？
english: And he said, You have taken my gods which I made, and my priest, and have gone away; what is there for me now? Why then do you say to me, What is your trouble?

chinese: 但人對米迦說：你不要使我們聽見你的聲音，恐怕有性暴的人攻擊你，以致你和你的全家盡都喪命。
english: And the children of Dan said to him, Say no more, or men of bitter spirit may make an attack on you, causing loss of your life and the lives of your people.

chinese: 但人還是走他們的路。米迦見他們的勢力比自己強盛，就轉身回家去了。
english: Then the children of Dan went on their way; and when Micah saw that they were stronger than he, he went back to his house.

chinese: 但人將米迦所做的神像和他的祭司都帶到拉億，見安居無慮的民，就用刀殺了那民，又放火燒了那城，
english: And they took that which Micah had made, and his priest, and came to Laish, to a people living quietly and without thought of danger, and they put them to the sword without mercy, burning down their town.

chinese: 並無人搭救；因為離西頓遠，他們又與別人沒有來往。城在平原，那平原靠近伯利合。但人又在那裡修城居住，
english: And they had no saviour, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with Aram; and it was in the valley which is the property of Beth-rehob. And building up the town again they took it for their living-place.

chinese: 照著他們始祖以色列之子但的名字，給那城起名叫但；原先那城名叫拉億。
english: And they gave the town the name of Dan, after Dan their father, who was the son of Israel: though the town had been named Laish at first.

chinese: 但人就為自己設立那雕刻的像。摩西的孫子、革舜的兒子約拿單，和他的子孫作但支派的祭司，直到那地遭擄掠的日子。
english: (And the children of Dan put up the pictured image for themselves; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of the Danites till the day when the ark was taken prisoner.)

chinese: 神的殿在示羅多少日子，但人為自己設立米迦所雕刻的像也在但多少日子。
english: And they put up for themselves the image which Micah had made, and it was there all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

chinese: 當以色列中沒有王的時候，有住以法蓮山地那邊的一個利未人，娶了一個猶大伯利恆的女子為妾。
english: Now in those days, when there was no king in Israel, a certain Levite was living in the inmost parts of the hill-country of Ephraim, and he got for himself a servant-wife from Beth-lehem-judah.

chinese: 妾行淫離開丈夫，回猶大的伯利恆，到了父家，在那裡住了四個月。
english: And his servant-wife was angry with him, and went away from him to her father's house at Beth-lehem-judah, and was there for four months.

chinese: 他丈夫起來，帶著一個僕人、兩匹驢去見他，用好話勸他回來。女子就引丈夫進入父家。他父見了那人，便歡歡喜喜地迎接。
english: Then her husband got up and went after her, with the purpose of talking kindly to her, and taking her back with him; he had with him his young man and two asses: and she took him into her father's house, and her father, when he saw him, came forward to him with joy.

chinese: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父親，將那人留下住了三天。於是二人一同吃喝、住宿。
english: And his father-in-law, the girl's father, kept him there for three days; and they had food and drink and took their rest there.

chinese: 到第四天，利未人清早起來要走，女子的父親對女婿說：請你吃點飯，加添心力，然後可以行路。
english: Now on the fourth day they got up early in the morning and he made ready to go away; but the girl's father said to his son-in-law, Take a little food to keep up your strength, and then go on your way.

chinese: 於是二人坐下一同吃喝。女子的父親對那人說：請你再住一夜，暢快你的心。
english: So seating themselves they had food and drink, the two of them together; and the girl's father said to the man, If it is your pleasure, take your rest here tonight, and let your heart be glad.

chinese: 那人起來要走，他岳父強留他，他又住了一宿。
english: And the man got up to go away, but his father-in-law would not let him go, so he took his rest there again for the night.

chinese: 到第五天，他清早起來要走，女子的父親說：請你吃點飯，加添心力，等到日頭偏西再走。於是二人一同吃飯。
english: Then early on the morning of the fifth day he got up to go away; but the girl's father said, Keep up your strength; so the two of them had a meal, and the man and his woman and his servant did not go till after the middle of the day.

chinese: 那人同他的妾和僕人起來要走，他岳父，就是女子的父親，對他說：看哪，日頭偏西了，請你再住一夜；天快晚了，可以在這裡住宿，暢快你的心。明天早早起行回家去。
english: And when they got up to go away, his father-in-law, the girl's father, said to him, Now evening is coming on, so do not go tonight; see, the day is almost gone; take your rest here and let your heart be glad, and tomorrow early, go on your way back to your house.

chinese: 那人不願再住一夜，就備上那兩匹驢，帶著妾起身走了，來到耶布斯的對面（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。）
english: But the man would not be kept there that night, and he got up and went away and came opposite to Jebus (which is Jerusalem); and he had with him the two asses, ready for travelling, and his woman.

chinese: 臨近耶布斯的時候，日頭快要落了，僕人對主人說：我們不如進這耶布斯人的城裡住宿。
english: When they got near Jebus the day was far gone; and the servant said to his master, Now let us go from our road into this town of the Jebusites and take our night's rest there.

chinese: 主人回答說：我們不可進不是以色列人住的外邦城，不如過到基比亞去；
english: But his master said to him, We will not go out of our way into a strange town, whose people are not of the children of Israel; but we will go on to Gibeah.

chinese: 又對僕人說：我們可以到一個地方，或住在基比亞，或住在拉瑪。
english: And he said to his servant, Come, let us go on to one of these places, stopping for the night in Gibeah or Ramah.

chinese: 他們就往前走。將到便雅憫的基比亞，日頭已經落了；
english: So they went on their way; and the sun went down when they were near Gibeah in the land of Benjamin.

chinese: 他們進入基比亞要在那裡住宿，就坐在城裡的街上，因為無人接他們進家住宿。
english: And they went off the road there with the purpose of stopping for the night in Gibeah: and he went in, seating himself in the street of the town, for no one took them into his house for the night.

chinese: 晚上，有一個老年人從田間做工回來。他原是以法蓮山地的人，住在基比亞；那地方的人卻是便雅憫人。
english: Now when it was evening they saw an old man coming back from his work in the fields; he was from the hill-country of Ephraim and was living in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.

chinese: 老年人舉目看見客人坐在城裡的街上，就問他說：你從哪裡來？要往哪裡去？
english: And when he saw the traveller in the street of the town, the old man said, Where are you going? and where do you come from?

chinese: 他回答說：我們從猶大的伯利恆來，要往以法蓮山地那邊去。我原是那裡的人，到過猶大的伯利恆，現在我往耶和華的殿去，在這裡無人接我進他的家。
english: And he said to him, We are on our way from Beth-lehem-judah to the inmost parts of the hill-country of Ephraim: I came from there and went to Beth-lehem-judah: now I am on my way back to my house, but no man will take me into his house.

chinese: 其實我有糧草可以餵驢，我與我的妾，並我的僕人，有餅有酒，並不缺少甚麼。
english: But we have dry grass and food for our asses, as well as bread and wine for me, and for the woman, and for the young man with us: we have no need of anything.

chinese: 老年人說：願你平安！你所需用的我都給你，只是不可在街上過夜。
english: And the old man said, Peace be with you; let all your needs be my care; only do not take your rest in the street.

chinese: 於是領他們到家裡，餵上驢，他們就洗腳吃喝。
english: So he took them into his house and gave the asses food; and after washing their feet they took food and drink.

chinese: 他們心裡正歡暢的時候，城中的匪徒圍住房子，連連叩門，對房主老人說：你把那進你家的人帶出來，我們要與他交合。
english: While they were taking their pleasure at the meal, the good-for-nothing men of the town came round the house, giving blows on the door; and they said to the old man, the master of the house, Send out that man who came to your house, so that we may take our pleasure with him.

chinese: 那房主出來對他們說：弟兄們哪，不要這樣作惡；這人既然進了我的家，你們就不要行這醜事。
english: So the man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said, No, my brothers, do not this evil thing; this man has come into my house, and you are not to do him this wrong.

chinese: 我有個女兒，還是處女，並有這人的妾，我將他們領出來任憑你們玷辱他們，只是向這人不可行這樣的醜事。
english: See, here is my daughter, a virgin, and his servant-wife: I will send them out for you to take them and do with them whatever you will. But do no such thing of shame to this man.

chinese: 那些人卻不聽從他的話。那人就把他的妾拉出去交給他們，他們便與他交合，終夜凌辱他，直到天色快亮才放他去。
english: But the men would not give ear to him: so the man took his woman and sent her out to them; and they took her by force, using her for their pleasure all night till the morning; and when dawn came they let her go.

chinese: 天快亮的時候，婦人回到他主人住宿的房門前，就仆倒在地，直到天亮。
english: Then at the dawn of day the woman came, and, falling down at the door of the man's house where her master was, was stretched there till it was light.

chinese: 早晨，他的主人起來開了房門，出去要行路，不料那婦人仆倒在房門前，兩手搭在門檻上；
english: In the morning her master got up, and opening the door of the house went out to go on his way; and he saw his servant-wife stretched on the earth at the door of the house with her hands on the step.

chinese: 就對婦人說：起來，我們走罷！婦人卻不回答。那人便將他馱在驢上，起身回本處去了。
english: And he said to her, Get up and let us be going; but there was no answer; so he took her up and put her on the ass, and went on his way and came to his house.

chinese: 到了家裡，用刀將妾的屍身切成十二塊，使人拿著傳送以色列的四境。
english: And when he had come to his house, he got his knife, and took the woman, cutting her up bone by bone into twelve parts, which he sent through all Israel.

chinese: 凡看見的人都說：從以色列人出埃及地，直到今日，這樣的事沒有行過，也沒有見過。現在應當思想，大家商議當怎樣辦理。
english: And he gave orders to the men whom he sent, saying, This is what you are to say to all the men of Israel, Has ever an act like this been done from the day when the children of Israel came out of Egypt to this day? Give thought to it, turning it over in your minds, and give your opinion of it.

chinese: 於是以色列從但到別是巴，以及住基列地的眾人都出來，如同一人，聚集在米斯巴耶和華面前。
english: Then all the children of Israel took up arms, and the people came together like one man, from Dan to Beer-sheba, and the land of Gilead, before the Lord at Mizpah.

chinese: 以色列民的首領，就是各支派的軍長，都站在神百姓的會中；拿刀的步兵共有四十萬。
english: And the chiefs of the people, out of all the tribes of Israel, took their places in the meeting of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen armed with swords.

chinese: 以色列人上到米斯巴，便雅憫人都聽見了。以色列人說：請你將這件惡事的情由對我們說明。
english: (Now the children of Benjamin had word that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) And the children of Israel said, Make clear how this evil thing took place.

chinese: 那利未人，就是被害之婦人的丈夫，回答說：我和我的妾到了便雅憫的基比亞住宿。
english: Then the Levite, the husband of the dead woman, said in answer, I came to Gibeah in the land of Benjamin, I and my servant-wife, for the purpose of stopping there for the night.

chinese: 基比亞人夜間起來，圍了我住的房子，想要殺我，又將我的妾強姦致死。
english: And the townsmen of Gibeah came together against me, going round the house on all sides by night; it was their purpose to put me to death, and my servant-wife was violently used by them and is dead.

chinese: 我就把我妾的屍身切成塊子，使人拿著傳送以色列得為業的全地，因為基比亞人在以色列中行了扔菏醜惡的事。
english: So I took her, cutting her into parts which I sent through all the country of the heritage of Israel: for they have done an act of shame in Israel.

chinese: 你們以色列人都當籌劃商議。
english: Here you all are, you children of Israel; give now your suggestions about what is to be done.

chinese: 眾民都起來如同一人，說：我們連一人都不回自己帳棚、自己房屋去。
english: Then all the people got up as one man and said, Not one of us will go to his tent or go back to his house:

chinese: 我們向基比亞人必這樣行，照所掣的籤去攻擊他們。
english: But this is what we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by the decision of the Lord;

chinese: 我們要在以色列各支派中，一百人挑取十人，一千人挑取百人，一萬人挑取千人，為民運糧，等大眾到了便雅憫的基比亞，就照基比亞人在以色列中所行的醜事征伐他們。
english: And we will take ten men out of every hundred, through all the tribes of Israel, a hundred out of every thousand, a thousand out of every ten thousand, to get food for the people, so that they may give to Gibeah of Benjamin the right punishment for the act of shame they have done in Israel.

chinese: 於是以色列眾人彼此連合如同一人，聚集攻擊那城
english: So all the men of Israel were banded together against the town, united like one man.

chinese: 以色列眾支派打發人去，問便雅憫支派的各家說：你們中間怎麼做了這樣的惡事呢？
english: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin saying, What is this evil which has been done among you?

chinese: 現在你們要將基比亞的那些匪徒交出來，我們好治死他們，從以色列中除掉這惡。便雅憫人卻不肯聽從他們弟兄以色列人的話。
english: Now give up those good-for-nothing persons in Gibeah so that we may put them to death, clearing away the evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not give ear to the voice of their brothers, the children of Israel.

chinese: 便雅憫人從他們的各城裡出來，聚集到了基比亞，要與以色列人打仗。
english: And the children of Benjamin came together from all their towns to Gibeah, to go to war with the children of Israel.

chinese: 那時便雅憫人從各城裡點出拿刀的，共有二萬六千；另外還有基比亞人點出七百精兵。
english: And the children of Benjamin who came that day from the towns were twenty-six thousand men armed with swords, in addition to the people of Gibeah, numbering seven hundred of the best fighting-men,

chinese: 在眾軍之中有揀選的七百精兵，都是左手便利的，能用機弦甩石打人，毫髮不差。
english: Who were left-handed, able to send a stone at a hair without error.

chinese: 便雅憫人之外，點出以色列人拿刀的，共有四十萬，都是戰士。
english: And the men of Israel, other than Benjamin, were four hundred thousand in number, all armed with swords; they were all men of war.

chinese: 以色列人就起來，到伯特利去求問神說：我們中間誰當首先上去與便雅憫人爭戰呢？耶和華說：猶大當先上去。
english: And they got up and went up to Beth-el to get directions from God, and the children of Israel said, Who is to be the first to go up to the fight against the children of Benjamin? And the Lord said, Judah is to go up first.

chinese: 以色列人早晨起來，對著基比亞安營。
english: So the children of Israel got up in the morning and put themselves in position against Gibeah.

chinese: 以色列人出來，要與便雅憫人打仗，就在基比亞前擺陣。
english: And the men of Israel went out to war against Benjamin (and the men of Israel put their forces in fighting order against them at Gibeah).

chinese: 便雅憫人就從基比亞出來，當日殺死以色列人二萬二千。
english: Then the children of Benjamin came out from Gibeah, cutting down twenty-two thousand of the Israelites that day.

chinese: 以色列人彼此奮勇，仍在頭一日擺陣的地方又擺陣。
english: But the people, the men of Israel, taking heart again, put their forces in order and took up the same position as on the first day.

chinese: 未擺陣之先，以色列人上去，在耶和華面前哭號，直到晚上，求問耶和華說：我們再去與我們弟兄便雅憫人打仗可以不可以？耶和華說：可以上去攻擊他們。
english: Now the children of Israel went up, weeping before the Lord till evening, requesting the Lord and saying, Am I to go forward again to the fight against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the Lord said, Go up against him.

chinese: 第二日，以色列人就上前攻擊便雅憫人。
english: So the children of Israel went forward against the children of Benjamin the second day.

chinese: 便雅憫人也在這日從基比亞出來，與以色列人接戰，又殺死他們一萬八千，都是拿刀的。
english: And the second day Benjamin went out against them from Gibeah, cutting down eighteen thousand men of the children of Israel, all swordsmen.

chinese: 以色列眾人就上到伯特利，坐在耶和華面前哭號，當日禁食直到晚上；又在耶和華面前獻燔祭和平安祭。
english: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up to Beth-el, weeping and waiting there before the Lord, going without food all day till evening, and offering burned offerings and peace-offerings before the Lord.

chinese: 那時，神的約櫃在那裡；亞倫的孫子、以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈侍立在約櫃前。以色列人問耶和華說：我們當再出去與我們弟兄便雅憫人打仗呢？還是罷兵呢？耶和華說：你們當上去，因為明日我必將他們交在你們手中。
english: And the children of Israel made request to the Lord, (for the ark of the agreement of the Lord was there in those days,

And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, was in his place before it,) and said, Am I still to go on with the fight against the children of Benjamin my brother, or am I to give it up? And the Lord said, Go on; for tomorrow I will give him into your hands.

chinese: 以色列人在基比亞的四圍設下伏兵。
english: So Israel put men secretly all round Gibeah to make a surprise attack on it.

chinese: 第三日，以色列人又上去攻擊便雅憫人，在基比亞前擺陣，與前兩次一樣。
english: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in fighting order against Gibeah as before.

chinese: 便雅憫人也出來迎敵，就被引誘離城；在田間兩條路上，一通伯特利，一通基比亞，像前兩次，動手殺死以色列人約有三十個。
english: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, moving away from the town; and as before, at their first attack, they put to death about thirty men of Israel on the highways, of which one goes up to Beth-el and the other to Gibeah, and in the open country.

chinese: 便雅憫人說：他們仍舊敗在我們面前。但以色列人說：我們不如逃跑，引誘他們離開城到路上來。
english: And the children of Benjamin said, They are giving way before us as at first. But the children of Israel said, Let us go in flight and get them away from the town, into the highways.

chinese: 以色列眾人都起來，在巴力他瑪擺陣，以色列的伏兵從馬利迦巴埋伏的地方衝上前去。
english: So all the men of Israel got up and put themselves in fighting order at Baal-tamar: and those who had been waiting secretly to make a surprise attack came rushing out of their place on the west of Geba.

chinese: 有以色列人中的一萬精兵，來到基比亞前接戰，勢派甚是凶猛；便雅憫人卻不知道災禍臨近了。
english: And they came in front of Gibeah, ten thousand of the best men in all Israel, and the fighting became more violent; but the children of Benjamin were not conscious that evil was coming on them.

chinese: 耶和華使以色列人殺敗便雅憫人。那日，以色列人殺死便雅憫人二萬五千一百，都是拿刀的。
english: Then the Lord sent sudden fear on Benjamin before Israel; and that day the children of Israel put to death twenty-five thousand, one hundred men of Benjamin, all of them swordsmen.

chinese: 於是便雅憫人知道自己敗了。先是以色列人；因為靠著在基比亞前所設的伏兵，就在便雅憫人面前詐敗。
english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were overcome: and the men of Israel had given way before Benjamin, putting their faith in the watchers who were to make the surprise attack on Gibeah.

chinese: 伏兵急忙闖進基比亞，用刀殺死全城的人。
english: And the watchers, rushing on Gibeah and overrunning it, put all the town to the sword without mercy.

chinese: 以色列人預先同伏兵約定在城內放火，以煙氣上騰為號。
english: Now the sign fixed between the men of Israel and those making the surprise attack was that when they made a pillar of smoke go up from the town,

chinese: 以色列人臨退陣的時候，便雅憫人動手殺死以色列人，約有三十個，就說：他們仍像前次被我們殺敗了。
english: The men of Israel were to make a turn about in the fight. And Benjamin had overcome and put to death about thirty of the men of Israel, and were saying, Certainly they are falling back before us as in the first fight.

chinese: 當煙氣如柱從城中上騰的時候，便雅憫人回頭觀看，見全城的煙氣沖天。
english: Then the sign went up out of the town in the pillar of smoke, and the Benjamites, turning back, saw all the town going up in smoke to heaven.

chinese: 以色列人又轉身回來，便雅憫人就甚驚惶，因為看見災禍臨到自己了。
english: And the men of Israel had made a turn about, and the men of Benjamin were overcome with fear, for they saw that evil had overtaken them.

chinese: 他們在以色列人面前轉身往曠野逃跑；以色列人在後面追殺。那從各城裡出來的，也都夾攻殺滅他們。
english: So turning their backs on the men of Israel, they went in the direction of the waste land; but the fight overtook them; and those who came out of the town were heading them off and putting them to the sword.

chinese: 以色列人圍繞便雅憫人，追趕他們，在他們歇腳之處、對著日出之地的基比亞踐踏他們。
english: And crushing Benjamin down, they went after them, driving them from Nohah as far as the east side of Gibeah.

chinese: 便雅憫人死了的有一萬八千，都是勇士。
english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin came to their death, all strong men of war.

chinese: 其餘的人轉身向曠野逃跑，往臨門磐去。以色列人在道路上殺了他們五千人，如拾取遺穗一樣，追到基頓又殺了他們二千人。
english: And turning, they went in flight to the rock of Rimmon in the waste land: and on the highways five thousand of them were cut off by the men of Israel, who, pushing on hard after them to Geba, put to death two thousand more.

chinese: 那日便雅憫死了的共有二萬五千人，都是拿刀的勇士。
english: So twenty-five thousand of the swordsmen of Benjamin came to their end that day, all strong men of war.

chinese: 只剩下六百人，轉身向曠野逃跑，到了臨門磐，就在那裡住了四個月。
english: But six hundred men, turning back, went in flight to the rock of Rimmon in the waste land, and were living on the rock of Rimmon for four months.

chinese: 以色列人又轉到便雅憫地，將各城的人和牲畜，並一切所遇見的，都用刀殺盡，又放火燒了一切城邑。
english: And the men of Israel, turning again against the children of Benjamin, put to the sword without mercy all the towns and the cattle and everything there was, burning every town which came into their hands.

chinese: 以色列人在米斯巴曾起誓說：我們都不將女兒給便雅憫人為妻。
english: Now the men of Israel had taken an oath in Mizpah, saying, Not one of us will give his daughter as a wife to Benjamin.

chinese: 以色列人來到伯特利，坐在神面前直到晚上，放聲痛哭，
english: And the people came to Beth-el, waiting there till evening before God, and gave themselves up to bitter weeping.

chinese: 說：耶和華─以色列的神啊，為何以色列中有這樣缺了一支派的事呢？
english: And they said, O Lord, the God of Israel, why has this fate come on Israel, that today one tribe has been cut off from Israel?

chinese: 次日清早，百姓起來，在那裡築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭。
english: Then on the day after, the people got up early and made an altar there, offering burned offerings and peace-offerings.

chinese: 以色列人彼此問說：以色列各支派中，誰沒有同會眾上到耶和華面前來呢？先是以色列人起過大誓說，凡不上米斯巴到耶和華面前來的，必將他治死。
english: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel, who did not come up to the Lord at the meeting of all Israel? For they had taken a great oath that whoever did not come up to Mizpah to the Lord was to be put to death.

chinese: 以色列人為他們的弟兄便雅憫後悔，說：如今以色列中絕了一個支派了。
english: And the children of Israel were moved with pity for Benjamin their brother, saying, Today one tribe has been cut off from Israel.

chinese: 我們既在耶和華面前起誓說，必不將我們的女兒給便雅憫人為妻，現在我們當怎樣辦理、使他們剩下的人有妻呢？
english: What are we to do about wives for those who are still living? For we have taken an oath by the Lord that we will not give them our daughters for wives.

chinese: 又彼此問說：以色列支派中誰沒有上米斯巴到耶和華面前來呢？他們就查出基列雅比沒有一人進營到會眾那裡；
english: And they said, Which one of the tribes of Israel did not come up to Mizpah to the Lord? And it was seen that no one had come from Jabesh-gilead to the meeting.

chinese: 因為百姓被數的時候，沒有一個基列雅比人在那裡。
english: For when the people were numbered, not one man of the people of Jabesh-gilead was present.

chinese: 會眾就打發一萬二千大勇士，吩咐他們說：你們去用刀將基列雅比人連婦女帶孩子都擊殺了。
english: So they (the meeting) sent twelve thousand of the best fighting-men, and gave them orders, saying, Go and put the people of Jabesh-gilead to the sword without mercy, with their women and their little ones.

chinese: 所當行的就是這樣：要將一切男子和已嫁的女子盡行殺戮。
english: And this is what you are to do: every male, and every woman who has had sex relations with a man, you are to put to the curse, but you are to keep safe the virgins. And they did so.

chinese: 他們在基列雅比人中，遇見了四百個未嫁的處女，就帶到迦南地的示羅營裡。
english: Now there were among the people of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins who had never had sex relations with a man; these they took to their tents in Shiloh in the land of Canaan.

chinese: 全會眾打發人到臨門磐的便雅憫人那裡，向他們說和睦的話。
english: And all the meeting sent to the men of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, offering them peace.

chinese: 當時便雅憫人回來了，以色列人就把所存活基列雅比的女子給他們為妻，還是不夠。
english: Then Benjamin came back; and they gave them the women whom they had kept from death among the women of Jabesh-gilead: but still there were not enough for them.

chinese: 百姓為便雅憫人後悔，因為耶和華使以色列人缺了一個支派（原文是使以色列中有了破口）。
english: And the people were moved with pity for Benjamin, because the Lord had let his wrath loose on the tribes of Israel.

chinese: 會中的長老說：便雅憫中的女子既然除滅了，我們當怎樣辦理、使那餘剩的人有妻呢？
english: Then the responsible men of the meeting said, What are we to do about wives for the rest of them, seeing that the women of Benjamin are dead?

chinese: 又說：便雅憫逃脫的人當有地業，免得以色列中塗抹了一個支派。
english: And they said, How is the rest of Benjamin to be given offspring so that one tribe of Israel may not be put out of existence,

chinese: 只是我們不能將自己的女兒給他們為妻；因為以色列人曾起誓說，有將女兒給便雅憫人為妻的，必受咒詛。
english: Seeing that we may not give them our daughters as wives? For the children of Israel had taken an oath, saying, Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.

chinese: 他們又說：在利波拿以南，伯特利以北，在示劍大路以東的示羅，年年有耶和華的節期；
english: And they said, See, every year there is a feast of the Lord in Shiloh, which is to the north of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway which goes up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

chinese: 就吩咐便雅憫人說：你們去，在葡萄園中埋伏。
english: And they said to the men of Benjamin, Go into the vine-gardens, waiting there secretly,

chinese: 若看見示羅的女子出來跳舞，就從葡萄園出來，在示羅的女子中各搶一個為妻，回便雅憫地去。
english: And watching; and if the daughters of Shiloh come out to take part in the dances, then come from the vine-gardens and take a wife for every one of you from among the daughters of Shiloh, and go back to the land of Benjamin.

chinese: 他們的父親或是弟兄若來與我們爭競，我們就說：求你們看我們的情面，施恩給這些人，因我們在爭戰的時候沒有給他們留下女子為妻。這也不是你們將子女給他們的；若是你們給的，就算有罪。
english: And when their fathers or their brothers come and make trouble, you are to say to them, Give them to us as an act of grace; for we did not take them as wives for ourselves in war; and if you yourselves had given them to us you would have been responsible for the broken oath.

chinese: 於是便雅憫人照樣而行，按著他們的數目從跳舞的女子中搶去為妻，就回自己的地業去，又重修城邑居住。
english: So the men of Benjamin did this, and got wives for themselves for every one of their number, taking them away by force from the dance; then they went back to their heritage, building up their towns and living in them.

chinese: 當時以色列人離開那裡，各歸本支派、本宗族、本地業去了。
english: Then the children of Israel went away from there, every man to his tribe and his family, every man went back to his heritage.

chinese: 那時，以色列中沒有王，各人任意而行。
english: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did what seemed right to him.

chinese: 當士師秉政的時候，國中遭遇饑荒。在猶大、伯利恆，有一個人帶著妻子和兩個兒子往摩押地去寄居。
english: Now there came a time, in the days of the judges, when there was no food in the land. And a certain man went from Beth-lehem-judah, he and his wife and his two sons, to make a living-place in the country of Moab.

chinese: 這人名叫以利米勒，他的妻名叫拿俄米；他兩個兒子，一個名叫瑪倫，一個名叫基連，都是猶大的伯利恆的以法他人。他們到了摩押地，就住在那裡。
english: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and were there for some time.

chinese: 後來拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒死了，剩下婦人和他兩個兒子。
english: And Elimelech, Naomi's husband, came to his end; and only her two sons were with her.

chinese: 這兩個兒子娶了摩押女子為妻，一個名叫俄珥巴，一個名叫路得，在那裡住了約有十年。
english: And they took two women of Moab as their wives: the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth; and they went on living there for about ten years.

chinese: 瑪倫和基連二人也死了，剩下拿俄米，沒有丈夫，也沒有兒子。
english: And Mahlon and Chilion came to their end; and the woman was without her two sons and her husband.

chinese: 他就與兩個兒婦起身，要從摩押地歸回；因為他在摩押地聽見耶和華眷顧自己的百姓，賜糧食與他們。
english: So she and her daughters-in-law got ready to go back from the country of Moab, for news had come to her in the country of Moab that the Lord, in mercy for his people, had given them food.

chinese: 於是他和兩個兒婦起行離開所住的地方，要回猶大地去。
english: And she went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on their way to go back to the land of Judah.

chinese: 拿俄米對兩個兒婦說：你們各人回娘家去罷。願耶和華恩待你們，像你們恩待已死的人與我一樣！
english: And Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, Go back to your mothers' houses: may the Lord be good to you as you have been good to the dead and to me:

chinese: 願耶和華使你們各在新夫家中得平安！於是拿俄米與他們親嘴。他們就放聲而哭，
english: May the Lord give you rest in the houses of your husbands. Then she gave them a kiss; and they were weeping bitterly.

chinese: 說：不然，我們必與你一同回你本國去。
english: And they said to her, No, but we will go back with you to your people.

chinese: 拿俄米說：我女兒們哪，回去罷！為何要跟我去呢？我還能生子作你們的丈夫麼？
english: But Naomi said, Go back, my daughters; why will you come with me? Have I more sons in my body, to become your husbands?

chinese: 我女兒們哪，回去罷！我年紀老邁，不能再有丈夫；即或說，我還有指望，今夜有丈夫可以生子，
english: Go back, my daughters, and go on your way; I am so old now that I may not have another husband. If I said, I have hopes, if I had a husband tonight, and might have sons,

chinese: 你們豈能等著他們長大呢？你們豈能等著他們不嫁別人呢？我女兒們哪，不要這樣。我為你們的緣故甚是愁苦，因為耶和華伸手攻擊我。
english: Would you keep yourselves till they were old enough? would you keep from having husbands for them? No, my daughters; but I am very sad for you that the hand of the Lord is against me.

chinese: 兩個兒婦又放聲而哭，俄珥巴與婆婆親嘴而別，只是路得捨不得拿俄米。
english: Then again they were weeping; and Orpah gave her mother-in-law a kiss, but Ruth would not be parted from her.

chinese: 拿俄米說：看哪，你嫂子已經回他本國和他所拜的神那裡去了，你也跟著你嫂子回去罷！
english: And Naomi said, See, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods: go back after your sister-in-law.

chinese: 路得說：不要催我回去不跟隨你。你往哪裡去，我也往那裡去；你在哪裡住宿，我也在那裡住宿；你的國就是我的國，你的神就是我的　神。
english: But Ruth said, Give up requesting me to go away from you, or to go back without you: for where you go I will go; and where you take your rest I will take my rest; your people will be my people, and your God my God.

chinese: 你在哪裡死，我也在那裡死，也葬在那裡。除非死能使你我相離！不然，願耶和華重重地降罰與我。
english: Wherever death comes to you, death will come to me, and there will be my last resting-place; the Lord do so to me and more if we are parted by anything but death.

chinese: 拿俄米見路得定意要跟隨自己去，就不再勸他了。
english: And when she saw that Ruth was strong in her purpose to go with her she said no more.

chinese: 於是二人同行，來到伯利恆。他們到了伯利恆，合城的人就都驚訝。婦女們說：這是拿俄米麼？
english: So the two of them went on till they came to Beth-lehem. And when they came to Beth-lehem all the town was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?

chinese: 拿俄米對他們說：不要叫我拿俄米（就是甜的意思），要叫我瑪拉（就是苦的意思），因為全能者使我受了大苦。
english: And she said to them, Do not let my name be Naomi, but Mara, for the Ruler of all has given me a bitter fate.

chinese: 我滿滿地出去，耶和華使我空空地回來。耶和華降禍與我，全能者使我受苦。既是這樣，你們為何還叫我拿俄米呢？
english: I went out full, and the Lord has sent me back again with nothing; why do you give me the name Naomi, seeing that the Lord has given witness against me, and the Ruler of all has sent sorrow on me?

chinese: 拿俄米和他兒婦摩押女子路得，從摩押地回來到伯利恆，正是動手割大麥的時候。
english: So Naomi came back out of the country of Moab, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her; and they came to Beth-lehem in the first days of the grain-cutting.

chinese: 拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒的親族中，有一個人名叫波阿斯，是個大財主。
english: And Naomi had a relation of her husband, a man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.

chinese: 摩押女子路得對拿俄米說：容我往田間去，我蒙誰的恩，就在誰的身後拾取麥穗。拿俄米說：女兒啊，你只管去。
english: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, Now let me go into the field and take up the heads of grain after him in whose eyes I may have grace. And she said to her, Go, my daughter.

chinese: 路得就去了，來到田間，在收割的人身後拾取麥穗。他恰巧到了以利米勒本族的人波阿斯那塊田裡。
english: And she went, and came and took up the heads of grain in the field after the cutters; and by chance she went into that part of the field which was the property of Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.

chinese: 波阿斯正從伯利恆來，對收割的人說：願耶和華與你們同在！他們回答說：願耶和華賜福與你！
english: And Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said to the grain-cutters, The Lord be with you. And they made answer, The Lord give you his blessing.

chinese: 波阿斯問監管收割的僕人說：那是誰家的女子？
english: Then Boaz said to his servant who was in authority over the cutters, Whose girl is this?

chinese: 監管收割的僕人回答說：是那摩押女子，跟隨拿俄米從摩押地回來的。
english: And the servant who was in authority over the cutters said, It is a Moabite girl who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab;

chinese: 他說：請你容我跟著收割的人拾取打捆剩下的麥穗。他從早晨直到如今，除了在屋子裡坐一會兒，常在這裡。
english: And she said to me, Let me come into the grain-field and take up the grain after the cutters. So she came, and has been here from morning till now, without resting even for a minute.

chinese: 波阿斯對路得說：女兒啊，聽我說，不要往別人田裡拾取麥穗，也不要離開這裡，要常與我使女們在一處。
english: Then said Boaz to Ruth, Give ear to me, my daughter: do not go to take up the grain in another field, or go away from here, but keep here by my young women:

chinese: 我的僕人在那塊田收割，你就跟著他們去。我已經吩咐僕人不可欺負你；你若渴了，就可以到器皿那裡喝僕人打來的水。
english: Keep your eyes on the field they are cutting, and go after them; have I not given orders to the young men not to put a hand on you? And when you are in need of drink go to the vessels and take of what the young men have put there.

chinese: 路得就俯伏在地叩拜，對他說：我既是外邦人，怎麼蒙你的恩，這樣顧恤我呢？
english: Then she went down on her face to the earth, and said to him, Why have I grace in your eyes, that you give attention to me, seeing I am from a strange people?

chinese: 波阿斯回答說：自從你丈夫死後，凡你向婆婆所行的，並你離開父母和本地，到素不認識的民中，這些事人全都告訴我了。
english: And Boaz answering said to her, I have had news of everything you have done for your mother-in-law after the death of your husband; how you went away from your father and mother and the land of your birth, and came to a people who are strange to you.

chinese: 願耶和華照你所行的賞賜你。你來投靠耶和華─以色列神的翅膀下，願你滿得他的賞賜。
english: The Lord give you a reward for what you have done, and may a full reward be given to you by the Lord, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take cover.

chinese: 路得說：我主啊，願在你眼前蒙恩。我雖然不及你的一個使女，你還用慈愛的話安慰我的心。
english: Then she said, May I have grace in your eyes, my lord, for you have given me comfort, and you have said kind words to your servant, though I am not like one of your servants.

chinese: 到了吃飯的時候，波阿斯對路得說：你到這裡來吃餅，將餅蘸在醋裡。路得就在收割的人旁邊坐下；他們把烘了的穗子遞給他。他吃飽了，還有餘剩的。
english: And at meal-time Boaz said to her, Come here, and take some of the bread, and put your bit into the wine. And she took her seat among the grain-cutters: and he gave her dry grain, and she took it, and there was more than enough for her meal.

chinese: 他起來又拾取麥穗，波阿斯吩咐僕人說：他就是在捆中拾取麥穗，也可以容他，不可羞辱他；
english: And when she got ready to take up the grain, Boaz gave his young men orders, saying, Let her take it even from among the cut grain, and say nothing to her.

chinese: 並要從捆裡抽出些來，留在地下任他拾取，不可叱嚇他。
english: And let some heads of grain be pulled out of what has been corded up, and dropped for her to take, and let no sharp word be said to her.

chinese: 這樣，路得在田間拾取麥穗，直到晚上，將所拾取的打了，約有一伊法大麥。
english: So she went on getting together the heads of grain till evening; and after crushing out the seed it came to about an ephah of grain.

chinese: 他就把所拾取的帶進城去給婆婆看，又把他吃飽了所剩的給了婆婆。
english: And she took it up and went into the town; and she let her mother-in-law see what she had got, and after taking enough for herself she gave her the rest.

chinese: 婆婆問他說：你今日在哪裡拾取麥穗，在哪裡做工呢？願那顧恤你的得福。路得就告訴婆婆說：我今日在一個名叫波阿斯的人那裡做工。
english: And her mother-in-law said to her, Where did you take up the grain today, and where were you working? May a blessing be on him who gave such attention to you. And she gave her mother-in-law an account of where she had been working, and said, The name of the man with whom I was working today is Boaz.

chinese: 拿俄米對兒婦說：願那人蒙耶和華賜福，因為他不斷地恩待活人死人。拿俄米又說：那是我們本族的人，是一個至近的親屬。
english: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, May the blessing of the Lord, who has at all times been kind to the living and to the dead, be on him. And Naomi said to her, The man is of our family, one of our near relations.

chinese: 摩押女子路得說：他對我說：你要緊隨我的僕人拾取麥穗，直等他們收完了我的莊稼。
english: And Ruth the Moabitess said, Truly, he said to me, Keep near my young men till all my grain is cut.

chinese: 拿俄米對兒婦路得說：女兒啊，你跟著他的使女出去，不叫人遇見你在別人田間，這才為好。
english: And Naomi said to Ruth, her daughter-in-law, It is better, my daughter, for you to go out with his servant-girls, so that no danger may come to you in another field.

chinese: 於是路得與波阿斯的使女常在一處拾取麥穗，直到收完了大麥和小麥。路得仍與婆婆同住。
english: So she kept near the servant-girls of Boaz to take up the grain till the cutting of the early grain and the cutting of the late grain were ended; and she went on living with her mother-in-law.

chinese: 路得的婆婆拿俄米對他說：女兒啊，我不當為你找個安身之處，使你享福麼？
english: And Naomi, her mother-in-law, said to her, My daughter, am I not to get you a resting-place where you may be in comfort?

chinese: 你與波阿斯的使女常在一處，波阿斯不是我們的親族麼？他今夜在場上簸大麥；
english: And now, is there not Boaz, our relation, with whose young women you were? See, tonight he is separating the grain from the waste in his grain-floor.

chinese: 你要沐浴抹膏，換上衣服，下到場上，卻不要使那人認出你來。你等他吃喝完了，
english: So take a bath, and, after rubbing your body with sweet oil, put on your best robe, and go down to the grain-floor; but do not let him see you till he has come to the end of his meal.

chinese: 到他睡的時候，你看準他睡的地方，就進去掀開他腳上的被，躺臥在那裡，他必告訴你所當做的事。
english: But see to it, when he goes to rest, that you take note of the place where he is sleeping, and go in there, and, uncovering his feet, take your place by him; and he will say what you are to do.

chinese: 路得說：凡你所吩咐的，我必遵行。
english: And she said, I will do all you say.

chinese: 路得就下到場上，照他婆婆所吩咐他的而行。
english: So she went down to the grain-floor and did all her mother-in-law had said to her.

chinese: 波阿斯吃喝完了，心裡歡暢，就去睡在麥堆旁邊。路得便悄悄地來掀開他腳上的被，躺臥在那裡。
english: Now when Boaz had taken meat and drink, and his heart was glad, he went to take his rest at the end of the mass of grain; then she came softly and, uncovering his feet, went to rest.

chinese: 到了夜半，那人忽然驚醒，翻過身來，不料有女子躺在他的腳下。
english: Now in the middle of the night, the man awaking from his sleep in fear, and lifting himself up, saw a woman stretched at his feet.

chinese: 他就說：你是誰？回答說：我是你的婢女路得。求你用你的衣襟遮蓋我，因為你是我一個至近的親屬。
english: And he said, Who are you? And she answering said, I am your servant Ruth: take your servant as wife, for you are a near relation.

chinese: 波阿斯說：女兒啊，願你蒙耶和華賜福。你末後的恩比先前更大；因為少年人無論貧富，你都沒有跟從。
english: And he said, May the Lord give you his blessing, my daughter: even better than what you did at the first is this last kind act you have done, in not going after young men, with or without wealth.

chinese: 女兒啊，現在不要懼怕，凡你所說的，我必照著行；我本城的人都知道你是個賢德的女子。
