english: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, attacking them till the morning, till there is not a man of them living. And they said, Do whatever seems right to you. Then the priest said, Let us come near to God.

chinese: 掃羅求問神說：我下去追趕非利士人可以不可以？你將他們交在以色列人手裡不交？這日　神沒有回答他。
english: And Saul, desiring directions from God, said, Am I to go down after the Philistines? will you give them up into the hands of Israel? But he gave him no answer that day.

chinese: 掃羅說：你們百姓中的長老都上這裡來，查明今日是誰犯了罪。
english: And Saul said, Come near, all you chiefs of the people, and let us get word from God and see in whom is this sin today.

chinese: 我指著救以色列─永生的耶和華起誓，就是我兒子約拿單犯了罪，他也必死。但百姓中無一人回答他。
english: For, by the living Lord, the saviour of Israel, even if the sinner is Jonathan, my son, death will certainly be his fate. But not a man among all the people gave him any answer.

chinese: 掃羅就對以色列眾人說：你們站在一邊，我與我兒子約拿單也站在一邊。百姓對掃羅說：你看怎樣好就去行罷！
english: Then he said to all Israel, You be on one side, and I with Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said to Saul, Do whatever seems good to you.

chinese: 掃羅禱告耶和華─以色列的神說：求你指示實情。於是掣籤掣出掃羅和約拿單來；百姓盡都無事。
english: Then Saul said to the Lord, the God of Israel, Why have you not given me an answer today? If the sin is in me or in Jonathan my son, O Lord God of Israel, give Urim, and if it is in your people Israel, give Thummim. And by the decision of the Lord, Saul and Jonathan were marked out, and the people went free.

chinese: 掃羅說：你們再掣籤，看是我，是我兒子約拿單，就掣出約拿單來。
english: And Saul said, Give your decision between my son Jonathan and me. And Jonathan was taken.

chinese: 掃羅對約拿單說：你告訴我，你做了甚麼事？約拿單說：我實在以手裡的杖，用杖頭蘸了一點蜜嘗了一嘗。這樣我就死麼（或譯：罷））？
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Give me an account of what you have done. And Jonathan gave him the story and said, Certainly I took a little honey on the end of my rod; and now death is to be my fate.

chinese: 掃羅說：約拿單哪，你定要死！若不然，願神重重地降罰與我。
english: And Saul said, May God's punishment be on me if death is not your fate, Jonathan.

chinese: 百姓對掃羅說：約拿單在以色列人中這樣大行拯救，豈可使他死呢？斷乎不可！我們指著永生的耶和華起誓，連他的一根頭髮也不可落地，因為他今日與神一同做事。於是百姓救約拿單免了死亡。
english: And the people said to Saul, Is death to come to Jonathan, the worker of this great salvation for Israel? Let it not be so: by the living Lord, not one hair of his head is to be touched, for he has been working with God today. So the people kept Jonathan from death.

chinese: 掃羅回去，不追趕非利士人；非利士人也回本地去了。
english: Then Saul, turning back, went after the Philistines no longer: and the Philistines went back to their place.

chinese: 掃羅執掌以色列的國權，常常攻擊他四圍的一切仇敵，就是摩押人、亞捫人、以東人，和瑣巴諸王，並非利士人。他無論往何處去，都打敗仇敵。
english: Now when Saul had taken his place as ruler of Israel, he made war on those who were against him on every side, Moab and the Ammonites and Edom and the kings of Zobah and the Philistines: and whichever way he went, he overcame them.

chinese: 掃羅奮勇攻擊亞瑪力人，救了以色列人脫離搶掠他們之人的手。
english: And he did great things, and overcame the Amalekites, and made Israel safe from the hands of their attackers.

chinese: 掃羅的兒子是約拿單、亦施韋、麥基舒亞。他的兩個女兒：長女名米拉，次女名米甲。
english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan and Ishvi and Malchi-shua; and these are the names of his daughters: the older was named Merab and the younger Michal;

chinese: 掃羅的妻名叫亞希暖，是亞希瑪斯的女兒。掃羅的元帥名叫押尼珥，是尼珥的兒子；尼珥是掃羅的叔叔。
english: The name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz; the captain of his army was Abner, the son of Ner, brother of Saul's father.

chinese: 掃羅的父親基士，押尼珥的父親尼珥，都是亞別的兒子。
english: Kish, the father of Saul, and Ner, the father of Abner, were sons of Abiel.

chinese: 掃羅平生常與非利士人大大爭戰。掃羅遇見有能力的人或勇士，都招募了來跟隨他。
english: All through the life of Saul there was bitter war against the Philistines; and whenever Saul saw any strong man or any good fighting man, he kept him near himself.

chinese: 撒母耳對掃羅說：耶和華差遣我膏你為王，治理他的百姓以色列；所以你當聽從耶和華的話。
english: And Samuel said to Saul, The Lord sent me to put the holy oil on you and to make you king over his people, over Israel: so give ear now to the words of the Lord.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：以色列人出埃及的時候，在路上亞瑪力人怎樣待他們，怎樣抵擋他們，我都沒忘。
english: The Lord of armies says, I will give punishment to Amalek for what he did to Israel, fighting against him on the way when Israel came out of Egypt.

chinese: 現在你要去擊打亞瑪力人，滅盡他們所有的，不可憐惜他們，將男女、孩童、吃奶的，並牛、羊、駱駝，和驢盡行殺死。
english: Go now and put Amalek to the sword, putting to the curse all they have, without mercy: put to death every man and woman, every child and baby at the breast, every ox and sheep, camel and ass.

chinese: 於是掃羅招聚百姓在提拉因，數點他們，共有步兵二十萬，另有猶大人一萬。
english: And Saul sent for the people and had them numbered in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

chinese: 掃羅到了亞瑪力的京城，在谷中設下埋伏。
english: And Saul came to the town of Amalek, and took up his position in the valley secretly.

chinese: 掃羅對基尼人說：你們離開亞瑪力人下去罷，恐怕我將你們和亞瑪力人一同殺滅；因為以色列人出埃及的時候，你們曾恩待他們。於是基尼人離開亞瑪力人去了。
english: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go away, take yourselves out from among the Amalekites, or destruction will overtake you with them: for you were kind to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt. So the Kenites went away from among the Amalekites.

chinese: 掃羅擊打亞瑪力人，從哈腓拉直到埃及前的書珥，
english: And Saul made an attack on the Amalekites from Havilah on the road to Shur, which is before Egypt.

chinese: 生擒了亞瑪力王亞甲，用刀殺盡亞瑪力的眾民。
english: He took Agag, king of the Amalekites, prisoner, and put all the people to the sword without mercy.

chinese: 掃羅和百姓卻憐惜亞甲，也愛惜上好的牛、羊、牛犢、羊羔，並一切美物，不肯滅絕。凡下賤瘦弱的，盡都殺了。
english: But Saul and the people did not put Agag to death, and they kept the best of the sheep and the oxen and the fat beasts and the lambs, and whatever was good, not desiring to put them to the curse: but everything which was bad and of no use they put to the curse.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到撒母耳說：
english: Then the Lord said to Samuel,

chinese: 我立掃羅為王，我後悔了；因為他轉去不跟從我，不遵守我的命令。撒母耳便甚憂愁，終夜哀求耶和華。
english: It is no longer my pleasure for Saul to be king; for he is turned back from going in my ways, and has not done my orders. And Samuel was very sad, crying to the Lord in prayer all night.

chinese: 撒母耳清早起來，迎接掃羅。有人告訴撒母耳說：掃羅到了迦密，在那裡立了記紀念碑，又轉身下到吉甲。
english: And early in the morning he got up and went to Saul; and word was given to Samuel that Saul had come to Carmel and put up a pillar, and had gone from there down to Gilgal.

chinese: 撒母耳到了掃羅那裡，掃羅對他說：願耶和華賜福與你，耶和華的命令我已遵守了。
english: And Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, May the blessing of the Lord be with you: I have done what was ordered by the Lord.

chinese: 撒母耳說：我耳中聽見有羊叫、牛鳴，是從哪裡來的呢？
english: And Samuel said, What then is this sound of the crying of sheep and the noise of oxen which comes to my ears?

chinese: 掃羅說：這是百姓從亞瑪力人那裡帶來的；因為他們愛惜上好的牛羊，要獻與耶和華─你的神；其餘的，我們都滅盡了。
english: And Saul said, They have taken them from the Amalekites: for the people have kept the best of the sheep and of the oxen as an offering to the Lord your God; all the rest we have given up to destruction.

chinese: 撒母耳對掃羅說：你住口罷！等我將耶和華昨夜向我所說的話告訴你。掃羅說：請講。
english: Then Samuel said to Saul, Say no more! Let me give you word of what the Lord has said to me this night. And he said to him, Say on.

chinese: 撒母耳對掃羅說：從前你雖然以自己為小，豈不是被立為以色列支派的元首麼？耶和華膏你作以色列的王。
english: And Samuel said, Though you may seem little to yourself, are you not head of the tribes of Israel? for the Lord with the holy oil made you king over Israel,

chinese: 耶和華差遣你，吩咐你說，你去擊打那些犯罪的亞瑪力人，將他們滅絕淨盡。
english: And the Lord sent you on a journey and said, Go and put to the curse those sinners, the Amalekites, fighting against them till every one is dead.

chinese: 你為何沒有聽從耶和華的命令，急忙擄掠財物，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事呢？
english: Why then did you not do the orders of the Lord, but by violently taking their goods did evil in the eyes of the Lord?

chinese: 掃羅對撒母耳說：我實在聽從了耶和華的命令，行了耶和華所差遣我行的路，擒了亞瑪力王亞甲來，滅盡了亞瑪力人。
english: And Saul said, Truly, I have done the orders of the Lord and have gone the way the Lord sent me; I have taken Agag, the king of Amalek, and have given the Amalekites up to destruction.

chinese: 百姓卻在所當滅的物中取了最好的牛羊，要在吉甲獻與耶和華─你的神。
english: But the people took some of their goods, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which were put to the curse, to make an offering of them to the Lord your God in Gilgal.

chinese: 撒母耳說：耶和華喜悅燔祭和平安祭，豈如喜悅人聽從他的話呢？聽命勝於獻祭；順從勝於公羊的脂油。
english: And Samuel said, Has the Lord as much delight in offerings and burned offerings as in the doing of his orders? Truly, to do his pleasure is better than to make offerings, and to give ear to him than the fat of sheep.

chinese: 悖逆的罪與行邪術的罪相等；頑梗的罪與拜虛神和偶像的罪相同。你既厭棄耶和華的命令，耶和華也厭棄你作王。
english: For to go against his orders is like the sin of those who make use of secret arts, and pride is like giving worship to images. Because you have put away from you the word of the Lord, he has put you from your place as king.

chinese: 掃羅對撒母耳說：我有罪了，我因懼怕百姓，聽從他們的話，就違背了耶和華的命令和你的言語。
english: And Saul said to Samuel, Great is my sin: for I have gone against the orders of the Lord and against your words: because, fearing the people, I did what they said.

chinese: 現在求你赦免我的罪，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和華。
english: So now, let my sin have forgiveness, and go back with me to give worship to the Lord.

chinese: 撒母耳對掃羅說：我不同你回去；因為你厭棄耶和華的命令，耶和華也厭棄你作以色列的王。
english: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not go back with you: for you have put away from you the word of the Lord, and the Lord has put you from your place as king over Israel.

chinese: 撒母耳轉身要走，掃羅就扯住他外袍的衣襟，衣襟就撕斷了。
english: And when Samuel was turning round to go away, Saul took the skirt of his robe in his hand, and the cloth came away.

chinese: 撒母耳對他說：如此，今日耶和華使以色列國與你斷絕，將這國賜與比你更好的人。
english: And Samuel said to him, The Lord has taken away the kingdom of Israel from you this day by force, and has given it to a neighbour of yours who is better than you.

chinese: 以色列的大能者必不致說謊，也不致後悔；因為他迥非世人，決不後悔。
english: And further, the Glory of Israel will not say what is false, and his purpose may not be changed: for he is not a man, whose purpose may be changed.

chinese: 掃羅說：我有罪了，雖然如此，求你在我百姓的長老和以色列人面前抬舉我，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和華─你的神。
english: Then he said, Great is my sin: but still, give me honour now before the heads of my people and before Israel, and come back with me so that I may give worship to the Lord your God.

chinese: 於是撒母耳轉身跟隨掃羅回去，掃羅就敬拜耶和華。
english: So Samuel went back after Saul, and Saul gave worship to the Lord.

chinese: 撒母耳說：要把亞瑪力王亞甲帶到我這裡來。亞甲就歡歡喜喜地來到他面前，心裡說，死亡的苦難必定過去了。
english: Then Samuel said, Make Agag, the king of the Amalekites, come here to me. And Agag came to him shaking with fear. And Agag said, Truly the pain of death is past.

chinese: 撒母耳說：你既用刀使婦人喪子，這樣，你母親在婦人中也必喪子。於是，撒母耳在吉甲耶和華面前將亞甲殺死。
english: And Samuel said, As your sword has made women without children, so now your mother will be without children among women. And Agag was cut up by Samuel, bone from bone, before the Lord in Gilgal.

chinese: 撒母耳回了拉瑪。掃羅上他所住的基比亞，回自己的家去了。
english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house in Gibeah, in the land of Saul.

chinese: 撒母耳直到死的日子，再沒有見掃羅；但撒母耳為掃羅悲傷，是因耶和華後悔立他為以色列的王。
english: And Samuel never saw Saul again till the day of his death; but Samuel was sorrowing for Saul: and it was no longer the Lord's pleasure for Saul to be king over Israel.

chinese: 耶和華對撒母耳說：我既厭棄掃羅作以色列的王，你為他悲傷要到幾時呢？你將膏油盛滿了角，我差遣你往伯利恆人耶西那裡去；因為我在他眾子之內，預定一個作王的。
english: And the Lord said to Samuel, How long will you go on sorrowing for Saul, seeing that I have put him from his place as king over Israel? Take oil in your vessel and go; I will send you to Jesse, the Beth-lehemite: for I have got a king for myself among his sons.

chinese: 撒母耳說：我怎能去呢？掃羅若聽見，必要殺我。耶和華說：你可以帶一隻牛犢去，就說：我來是要向耶和華獻祭。
english: And Samuel said, How is it possible for me to go? If Saul gets news of it he will put me to death. And the Lord said, Take a young cow with you and say, I have come to make an offering to the Lord.

chinese: 你要請耶西來吃祭肉，我就指示你所當行的事。我所指給你的人，你要膏他。
english: And send for Jesse to be present at the offering, and I will make clear to you what you are to do: and you are to put the holy oil on him whose name I give you.

chinese: 撒母耳就照耶和華的話去行。到了伯利恆，那城裡的長老都戰戰兢兢地出來迎接他，問他說：你是為平安來的麼？
english: And Samuel did as the Lord said and came to Beth-lehem. And the responsible men of the town came out to him in fear and said, Do you come in peace?

chinese: 他說：為平安來的，我是給耶和華獻祭。你們當自潔，來與我同吃祭肉。撒母耳就使耶西和他眾子自潔，請他們來吃祭肉。
english: And he said, In peace: I have come to make an offering to the Lord: make yourselves clean and come with me to make the offering. And he made Jesse and his sons clean, and sent for them to be present at the offering.

chinese: 他們來的時候，撒母耳看見以利押，就心裡說，耶和華的受膏者必定在他面前。
english: Now when they came, looking at Eliab, he said, Clearly the man of the Lord's selection is before him.

chinese: 耶和華卻對撒母耳說：不要看他的外貌和他身材高大，我不揀選他。因為，耶和華不像人看人：人是看外貌；耶和華是看內心。
english: But the Lord said to Samuel, Do not take note of his face or how tall he is, because I will not have him: for the Lord's view is not man's; man takes note of the outer form, but the Lord sees the heart.

chinese: 耶西叫亞比拿達從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：耶和華也不揀選他。
english: Then Jesse sent for Abinadab and made him come before Samuel. And he said, The Lord has not taken this one.

chinese: 耶西又叫沙瑪從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：耶和華也不揀選他。
english: Then Jesse made Shammah come before him. And he said, The Lord has not taken this one.

chinese: 耶西叫他七個兒子都從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：這都不是耶和華所揀選的。
english: And Jesse made his seven sons come before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, The Lord has not taken any of these.

chinese: 撒母耳對耶西說：你的兒子都在這裡麼？他回答說：還有個小的，現在放羊。撒母耳對耶西說：你打發人去叫他來；他若不來，我們必不坐席。
english: Then Samuel said to Jesse, Are all your children here? And he said, There is still the youngest, and he is looking after the sheep. And Samuel said to Jesse, Send and make him come here: for we will not take our seats till he is here.

chinese: 耶西就打發人去叫了他來。他面色光紅，雙目清秀，容貌俊美。耶和華說：這就是他，你起來膏他。
english: So he sent and made him come in. Now he had red hair and beautiful eyes and pleasing looks. And the Lord said, Come, put the oil on him, for this is he.

chinese: 撒母耳就用角裡的膏油，在他諸兄中膏了他。從這日起，耶和華的靈就大大感動大衛。撒母耳起身回拉瑪去了。
english: Then Samuel took the bottle of oil, and put the oil on him there among his brothers: and from that day the spirit of the Lord came on David with power. So Samuel went back to Ramah.

chinese: 耶和華的靈離開掃羅，有惡魔從耶和華那裡來擾亂他。
english: Now the spirit of the Lord had gone from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord was troubling him.

chinese: 掃羅的臣僕對他說：現在有惡魔從神那裡來擾亂你。
english: And Saul's servants said to him, See now, an evil spirit from God is troubling you.

chinese: 我們的主可以吩咐面前的臣僕，找一個善於彈琴的來，等神那裡來的惡魔臨到你身上的時候，使他用手彈琴，你就好了。
english: Now give orders to your servants who are here before you to go in search of a man who is an expert player on a corded instrument: and it will be that when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will make music for you on his instrument, and you will get well.

chinese: 掃羅對臣僕說：你們可以為我找一個善於彈琴的，帶到我這裡來。
english: And Saul said to his servants, Then get me a man who is an expert player, and make him come to me.

chinese: 其中有一個少年人說：我曾見伯利恆人耶西的一個兒子善於彈琴，是大有勇敢的戰士，說話合宜，容貌俊美，耶和華也與他同在。
english: Then one of the servants in answer said, I have seen a son of Jesse, the Beth-lehemite, who is expert at playing, and a strong man and a man of war; and he is wise in his words, and pleasing in looks, and the Lord is with him.

chinese: 於是掃羅差遣使者去見耶西，說：請你打發你放羊的兒子大衛到我這裡來。
english: So Saul sent his servants to Jesse and said, Send me your son David who is with the sheep.

chinese: 耶西就把幾個餅和一皮袋酒，並一隻山羊羔，都馱在驢上，交給他兒子大衛，送與掃羅。
english: And Jesse took five cakes of bread and a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them to Saul by David.

chinese: 大衛到了掃羅那裡，就侍立在掃羅面前。掃羅甚喜愛他，他就作了掃羅拿兵器的人。
english: And David came to Saul, waiting before him: and he became very dear to Saul, who made him his servant, giving him the care of his arms.

chinese: 掃羅差遣人去見耶西，說：求你容大衛侍立在我面前，因為他在我眼前蒙了恩。
english: And Saul sent to Jesse saying, Let David be with me, for he is pleasing to me.

chinese: 從神那裡來的惡魔臨到掃羅身上的時候，大衛就拿琴，用手而彈，掃羅便舒暢爽快，惡魔離了他。
english: And whenever the evil spirit from God came on Saul, David took his instrument and made music: so new life came to Saul, and he got well, and the evil spirit went away from him.

chinese: 非利士人招聚他們的軍旅，要來爭戰；聚集在屬猶大的梭哥，安營在梭哥和亞西加中間的以弗大憫。
english: Now the Philistines got their armies together for war, and came together at Socoh in the land of Judah, and took up their position between Socoh and Azekah in Ephes-dammim.

chinese: 掃羅和以色列人也聚集，在以拉谷安營，擺列隊伍，要與非利士人打仗。
english: And Saul and the men of Israel came together and took up their position in the valley of Elah, and put their forces in order against the Philistines.

chinese: 非利士人站在這邊山上，以色列人站在那邊山上，當中有谷。
english: The Philistines were stationed on the mountain on one side and Israel on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

chinese: 從非利士營中出來一個討戰的人，名叫歌利亞，是迦特人，身高六肘零一虎口；
english: And a fighter came out from the tents of the Philistines, named Goliath of Gath; he was more than six cubits tall.

chinese: 頭戴銅盔，身穿鎧甲，甲重五千舍客勒；
english: And he had a head-dress of brass on his head, and he was dressed in a coat of metal, the weight of which was five thousand shekels of brass.

chinese: 腿上有銅護膝，兩肩之中背負銅戟；
english: His legs were covered with plates of brass and hanging on his back was a javelin of brass.

chinese: 槍桿粗如織布的機軸，鐵槍頭重六百舍客勒。有一個拿盾牌的人在他前面走。
english: The stem of his spear was as long as a cloth-worker's rod, and its head was made of six hundred shekels' weight of iron: and one went before him with his body-cover.

chinese: 歌利亞對著以色列的軍隊站立，呼叫說：你們出來擺列隊伍做甚麼呢？我不是非利士人麼？你們不是掃羅的僕人麼？可以從你們中間揀選一人，使他下到我這裡來。
english: He took up his position and in a loud voice said to the armies of Israel, Why have you come out to make war? Am I not a Philistine and you servants of Saul? Send out a man for yourselves and let him come down to me.

chinese: 他若能與我戰鬥，將我殺死，我們就作你們的僕人；我若勝了他，將他殺死，你們就作我們的僕人，服事我們。
english: If he is able to have a fight with me and overcome me, then we will be your servants: but if I am able to overcome him, then you will be our servants and do work for us.

chinese: 那非利士人又說：我今日向以色列人的軍隊罵陣。你們叫一個人出來，與我戰鬥。
english: And the Philistine said, I have put to shame the armies of Israel this day; give me a man so that we may have a fight together.

chinese: 掃羅和以色列眾人聽見非利士人的這些話，就驚惶，極其害怕。
english: And Saul and all Israel, hearing those words of the Philistine, were troubled and full of fear.

chinese: 大衛是猶大、伯利恆的以法他人耶西的兒子。耶西有八個兒子。當掃羅的時候，耶西已經老邁。
english: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah named Jesse, who had eight sons; and he was an old man in Saul's day, and far on in years.

chinese: 耶西的三個大兒子跟隨掃羅出征。這出征的三個兒子：長子名叫以利押，次子名叫亞比拿達，三子名叫沙瑪。
english: And the three oldest sons of Jesse had gone with Saul to the fight: the names of the three who went to the fight were Eliab, the oldest, and Abinadab the second, and Shammah the third.

chinese: 大衛是最小的；那三個大兒子跟隨掃羅。
english: And David was the youngest: and the three oldest were with Saul's army.

chinese: 大衛有時離開掃羅，回伯利恆放他父親的羊。
english: Now David went to and from Saul, looking after his father's sheep at Beth-lehem.

chinese: 那非利士人早晚都出來站著，如此四十日。
english: And the Philistine came near every morning and evening for forty days.

chinese: 一日，耶西對他兒子大衛說：你拿一伊法烘了的穗子和十個餅，速速地送到營裡去，交給你哥哥們；
english: And Jesse said to his son David, Take now for your brothers an ephah of this dry grain and these ten cakes of bread, and go quickly with them to the tents to your brothers;

chinese: 再拿這十塊奶餅，送給他們的千夫長，且問你哥哥們好，向他們要一封信來。
english: And take these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand, and see how your brothers are and come back with a sign to say how they are.

chinese: 掃羅與大衛的三個哥哥和以色列眾人，在以拉谷與非利士人打仗。
english: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

chinese: 大衛早晨起來，將羊交託一個看守的人，照著他父親所吩咐的話，帶著食物去了。到了輜重營，軍兵剛出到戰場，吶喊要戰。
english: And David got up early in the morning, and, giving the sheep into the care of a keeper, took the things and went as Jesse had said; and he came to the lines where the carts were, when the army was going out to the fight giving their war-cry.

chinese: 以色列人和非利士人都擺列隊伍，彼此相對。
english: And Israel and the Philistines had put their forces in position, army against army.

chinese: 大衛把他帶來的食物留在看守物件人的手下，跑到戰場，問他哥哥們安。
english: And David gave his parcels into the hands of the keeper of the army stores, and went running to the army and came to his brothers to get knowledge about them.

chinese: 與他們說話的時候，那討戰的，就是屬迦特的非利士人歌利亞，從非利士隊中出來，說從前所說的話；大衛都聽見了。
english: And while he was talking to them, the fighter, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came out from the Philistines' lines and said the same words, in David's hearing.

chinese: 以色列眾人看見那人，就逃跑，極其害怕。
english: And all the men of Israel, when they saw him, went in flight, overcome with fear.

chinese: 以色列人彼此說：這上來的人你看見了麼？他上來是要向以色列人罵陣。若有能殺他的，王必賞賜他大財，將自己的女兒給他為妻，並在以色列人中免他父家納糧當差。
english: And the men of Israel said, Have you seen this man? Clearly he has come out to put shame on Israel: and it is certain that if any man overcomes him, the king will give that man great wealth, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's family free in Israel.

chinese: 大衛問站在旁邊的人說：有人殺這非利士人，除掉以色列人的恥辱，怎樣待他呢？這未受割禮的非利士人是誰呢？竟敢向永生神的軍隊罵陣麼？
english: And David said to the men near him, What will be done to the man who overcomes this Philistine and takes away the shame from Israel? for who is this Philistine, a man without circumcision, that he has put shame on the armies of the living God?

chinese: 百姓照先前的話回答他說：有人能殺這非利士人，必如此如此待他。
english: And the people gave him this answer, So it will be done to the man who overcomes him.

chinese: 大衛的長兄以利押聽見大衛與他們所說的話，就向他發怒，說：你下來做甚麼呢？在曠野的那幾隻羊，你交託了誰呢？我知道你的驕傲和你心裡的惡意，你下來特為要看爭戰！
english: And Eliab, his oldest brother, hearing what David said to the men, was moved to wrath against David, and said, Why have you come here? Into whose care have you given that little flock of sheep in the waste land? I have knowledge of your pride and the evil of your heart, you have come down to see the fight.

chinese: 大衛說：我做了甚麼呢？我來豈沒有緣故麼？
english: And David said, What have I done now? was it not only a word?

chinese: 大衛就離開他轉向別人，照先前的話而問；百姓仍照先前的話回答他。
english: And turning away from him to one of the other men, he said the same words: and the people gave him the same answer.

chinese: 有人聽見大衛所說的話，就告訴了掃羅；掃羅便打發人叫他來。
english: And, hearing what David said, they gave Saul word of it: and he sent for him.

chinese: 大衛對掃羅說：人都不必因那非利士人膽怯。你的僕人要去與那非利士人戰鬥。
english: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart become feeble because of him; I, your servant, will go out and have a fight with this Philistine.

chinese: 掃羅對大衛說：你不能去與那非利士人戰鬥；因為你年紀太輕，他自幼就作戰士。
english: And Saul said to David, You are not able to go out against this Philistine and have a fight with him: for you are only a boy, and he has been a man of war from his earliest days.

chinese: 大衛對掃羅說：你僕人為父親放羊，有時來了獅子，有時來了熊，從群中啣一隻羊羔去。
english: And David said to Saul, Your servant has been keeper of his father's sheep; and if a lion or a bear came and took a lamb from the flock,

chinese: 我就追趕他，擊打他，將羊羔從他口中救出來。他起來要害我，我就揪著他的鬍子，將他打死。
english: I went out after him, and overcame him, and took it out of his mouth: and if, turning on me, he came at me, I took him by the hair and overcame him and put him to death.

chinese: 你僕人曾打死獅子和熊，這未受割禮的非利士人向永生神的軍隊罵陣，也必像獅子和熊一般。
english: Your servant has overcome lion and bear: and the fate of this Philistine, who is without circumcision, will be like theirs, seeing that he has put shame on the armies of the living God.

chinese: 大衛又說：耶和華救我脫離獅子和熊的爪，也必救我脫離這非利士人的手。掃羅對大衛說：你可以去罷！耶和華必與你同在。
english: And David said, The Lord, who kept me safe from the grip of the lion and the bear, will be my saviour from the hands of this Philistine. And Saul said to David, Go! and may the Lord be with you.

chinese: 掃羅就把自己的戰衣給大衛穿上，將銅盔給他戴上，又給他穿上鎧甲。
english: Then Saul gave David his clothing of war, and put a head-dress of brass on his head and had him clothed with a coat of metal.

chinese: 大衛把刀跨在戰衣外，試試能走不能走；因為素來沒有穿慣，就對掃羅說：我穿戴這些不能走，因為素來沒有穿慣。於是摘脫了。
english: And David took Saul's sword and put the band round him over the metal coat, and was unable to go forward; for he was not used to them. Then David said to Saul, It is not possible for me to go out with these, for I am not used to them. So David took them off.

chinese: 他手中拿杖，又在溪中挑選了五塊光滑石子，放在袋裡，就是牧人帶的囊裡；手中拿著甩石的機弦，就去迎那非利士人。
english: Then he took his stick in his hand, and got five smooth stones from the bed of the stream and put them in a bag such as is used by sheep-keepers; and in his hand was a leather band used for sending stones: and so he went in the direction of the Philistine.

chinese: 非利士人也漸漸地迎著大衛來，拿盾牌的走在前頭。
english: And the Philistine came nearer to David; and the man who had his body-cover went before him.

chinese: 非利士人觀看，見了大衛，就藐視他；因為他年輕，面色光紅，容貌俊美。
english: And when the Philistine, taking note, saw David, he had a poor opinion of him: for he was only a boy, red-haired and good-looking.

chinese: 非利士人對大衛說：你拿杖到我這裡來，我豈是狗呢？非利士人就指著自己的神咒詛大衛。
english: And the Philistine said to David, Am I a dog, that you come out to me with sticks? And the Philistine put curses on David by all his gods.

chinese: 非利士人又對大衛說：來罷！我將你的肉給空中的飛鳥、田野的走獸吃。
english: And the Philistine said to David, Come here to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field.

chinese: 大衛對非利士人說：你來攻擊我，是靠著刀槍和銅戟；我來攻擊你，是靠著萬軍之耶和華的名，就是你所怒罵帶領以色列軍隊的神。
english: Then David said to the Philistine, You come to me with a sword and a spear and a javelin: but I come to you in the name of the Lord of armies, the God of the armies of Israel on which you have put shame.

chinese: 今日耶和華必將你交在我手裡。我必殺你，斬你的頭，又將非利士軍兵的屍首給空中的飛鳥、地上的野獸吃，使普天下的人都知道以色列中有神；
english: This day the Lord will give you up into my hands, and I will overcome you, and take your head off you; and I will give the bodies of the Philistine army to the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth today, so that all the earth may see that Israel has a God;

chinese: 又使這眾人知道耶和華使人得勝，不是用刀用槍，因為爭戰的勝敗全在乎耶和華。他必將你們交在我們手裡。
english: And all these people who are here today may see that the Lord does not give salvation by sword and spear: for the fight is the Lord's, and he will give you up into our hands.

chinese: 非利士人起身，迎著大衛前來。大衛急忙迎著非利士人，往戰場跑去。
english: Now when the Philistine made a move and came near to David, David quickly went at a run in the direction of the army, meeting the Philistine face to face.

chinese: 大衛用手從囊中掏出一塊石子來，用機弦甩去，打中非利士人的額，石子進入額內，他就仆倒，面伏於地。
english: And David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone and sent it from his leather band straight at the Philistine, and the stone went deep into his brow, and he went down to the earth, falling on his face.

chinese: 這樣，大衛用機弦甩石，勝了那非利士人，打死他；大衛手中卻沒有刀。
english: So David overcame the Philistine with his leather band and a stone, wounding the Philistine and causing his death: but David had no sword in his hand.

chinese: 大衛跑去，站在非利士人身旁，將他的刀從鞘中拔出來，殺死他，割了他的頭。非利士眾人看見他們討戰的勇士死了，就都逃跑。
english: So running up to the Philistine and putting his foot on him, David took his sword out of its cover, and put him to death, cutting off his head with it. And when the Philistines saw that their fighter was dead, they went in flight.

chinese: 以色列人和猶大人便起身吶喊，追趕非利士人，直到迦特（或譯：該）和以革倫的城門。被殺的非利士人倒在沙拉音的路上，直到迦特和以革倫。
english: And the men of Israel and of Judah got up, and gave a cry, and went after the Philistines as far as Gath and the town doors of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines were falling down by the road from Shaaraim all the way to Gath and Ekron.

chinese: 以色列人追趕非利士人回來，就奪了他們的營盤。
english: Then the children of Israel came back from going after the Philistines, and took their goods from the tents.

chinese: 大衛將那非利士人的頭拿到耶路撒冷，卻將他軍裝放在自己的帳棚裡。
english: And David took the head of the Philistine to Jerusalem, but the metal war-dress and the arms he put in his tent.

chinese: 掃羅看見大衛去攻擊非利士人，就問元帥押尼珥說：押尼珥啊，那少年人是誰的兒子？押尼珥說：我敢在王面前起誓，我不知道。
english: And when Saul saw David going out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, Abner, whose son is this young man? And Abner said, On your life, O king, I have no idea.

chinese: 王說：你可以問問那幼年人是誰的兒子。
english: And the king said, Make search and see whose son this young man is.

chinese: 大衛打死非利士人回來，押尼珥領他到掃羅面前，他手中拿著非利士人的頭。
english: And when David was coming back after the destruction of the Philistine, Abner took him to Saul, with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

chinese: 掃羅問他說：少年人哪，你是誰的兒子？大衛說：我是你僕人伯利恆人耶西的兒子。
english: And Saul said to him, Young man, whose son are you? And David in answer said, I am the son of your servant Jesse of Beth-lehem.

chinese: 大衛對掃羅說完了話，約拿單的心與大衛的心深相契合。約拿單愛大衛，如同愛自己的性命。
english: Now after David's talk with Saul was ended, the soul of Jonathan was joined with the soul of David, and David became as dear to him as his very life.

chinese: 那日掃羅留住大衛，不容他再回父家。
english: And that day Saul took David and would not let him go back to his father's house.

chinese: 約拿單愛大衛如同愛自己的性命，就與他結盟。
english: Then Jonathan and David made an agreement together, because of Jonathan's love for David.

chinese: 約拿單從身上脫下外袍，給了大衛，又將戰衣、刀、弓、腰帶都給了他。
english: And Jonathan took off the robe he had on and gave it to David, with all his military dress, even to his sword and his bow and the band round his body.

chinese: 掃羅無論差遣大衛往何處去，他都做事精明。掃羅就立他作戰士長，眾百姓和掃羅的臣僕無不喜悅。
english: And David went wherever Saul sent him, and did wisely: and Saul put him at the head of his men of war, and this was pleasing to all the people as well as to Saul's servants.

chinese: 大衛打死了那非利士人，同眾人回來的時候，婦女們從以色列各城裡出來，歡歡喜喜，打鼓擊磬，歌唱跳舞，迎接掃羅王。
english: Now on their way, when David came back after the destruction of the Philistine, the women came out of all the towns of Israel, with songs and dances, meeting David with melody and joy and instruments of music.

chinese: 眾婦女舞蹈唱和，說：掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬。
english: And the women, answering one another in their song, said, Saul has put to death his thousands and David his tens of thousands.

chinese: 掃羅甚發怒，不喜悅這話，就說：將萬萬歸大衛，千千歸我，只剩下王位沒有給他了。
english: And Saul was very angry and this saying was unpleasing to him; and he said, They have given David credit for tens of thousands, and to me for only thousands: what more is there for him but the kingdom?

chinese: 從這日起，掃羅就怒視大衛。
english: And from that day Saul was looking with envy on David.

chinese: 次日，從神那裡來的惡魔大大降在掃羅身上，他就在家中胡言亂語。大衛照常彈琴，掃羅手裡拿著槍。
english: Now on the day after, an evil spirit from God came on Saul with great force and he was acting like a prophet among the men of his house, while David was making music for him, as he did day by day: and Saul had his spear in his hand.

chinese: 掃羅把槍一掄，心裡說，我要將大衛刺透，釘在牆上。大衛躲避他兩次。
english: And Saul, balancing the spear in his hand, said, I will give David a blow, pinning him to the wall. And David got away from him twice.

chinese: 掃羅懼怕大衛；因為耶和華離開自己，與大衛同在。
english: And Saul went in fear of David, because the Lord was with David and had gone away from Saul.

chinese: 所以掃羅使大衛離開自己，立他為千夫長，他就領兵出入。
english: So Saul sent him away, and made him a captain over a thousand; and he went about his business before the people.

chinese: 大衛做事無不精明，耶和華也與他同在。
english: And in all his undertakings David did wisely; and the Lord was with him.

chinese: 掃羅見大衛做事精明，就甚怕他。
english: And when Saul saw how wisely he did, he was in fear of him.

chinese: 但以色列和猶大眾人都愛大衛，因為他領他們出入。
english: But David was loved by all Israel and Judah, for he went out and came in before them.

chinese: 掃羅對大衛說：我將大女兒米拉給你為妻，只要你為我奮勇，為耶和華爭戰。掃羅心裡說：我不好親手害他，要藉非利士人的手害他。
english: And Saul said to David, Here is my oldest daughter Merab, whom I will give you for your wife: only be strong for me, fighting in the Lord's wars. For Saul said, Let it not be through me that his fate comes to him, but through the Philistines.

chinese: 大衛對掃羅說：我是誰，我是甚麼出身，我父家在以色列中是何等的家，豈敢作王的女婿呢？
english: And David said to Saul, Who am I, and what is my father's family in Israel, that I am to be son-in-law to the king?

chinese: 掃羅的女兒米拉到了當給大衛的時候，掃羅卻給了米何拉人亞得列為妻。
english: But when the time came to give Merab, Saul's daughter, to David, she was given to Adriel of Meholath.

chinese: 掃羅的次女米甲愛大衛。有人告訴掃羅，掃羅就喜悅。
english: And Saul's daughter Michal was in love with David: and Saul had word of it and was pleased.

chinese: 掃羅心裡說：我將這女兒給大衛，作他的網羅，好藉非利士人的手害他。所以掃羅對大衛說：你今日可以第二次作我的女婿。
english: And Saul said, I will give her to him, so that she may be a cause of danger to him, and so that the hands of the Philistines may be against him. So Saul said to David, Today you are to become my son-in-law for the second time.

chinese: 掃羅吩咐臣僕說：你們暗中對大衛說：王喜悅你，王的臣僕也都喜愛你，所以你當作王的女婿。
english: And Saul gave his servants orders saying, Have talk with David secretly and say to him, See how the king has delight in you, and how you are loved by all his servants: then be the king's son-in-law.

chinese: 掃羅的臣僕就照這話說給大衛聽。大衛說：你們以為作王的女婿是一件小事麼？我是貧窮卑微的人。
english: And Saul's servants said these things to David. And David said, Does it seem to you a small thing to be the king's son-in-law, seeing that I am a poor man, of no great name?

chinese: 掃羅的臣僕回奏說，大衛所說的如此如此。
english: And the servants of Saul gave him an account of what David had said.

chinese: 掃羅說：你們要對大衛這樣說：王不要甚麼聘禮，只要一百非利士人的陽皮，好在王的仇敵身上報仇。掃羅的意思要使大衛喪在非利士人的手裡。
english: And Saul said, Then say to David, The king has no desire for any bride-price, but only for the private parts of a hundred Philistines so that the king may get the better of his haters. But it was in Saul's mind that David might come to his end by the hands of the Philistines.

chinese: 掃羅的臣僕將這話告訴大衛，大衛就歡喜作王的女婿。日期還沒有到，
english: And when his servants said these words to David, he was well pleased to be the son-in-law of the king. And the days were still not past.

chinese: 大衛和跟隨他的人起身前往，殺了二百非利士人，將陽皮滿數交給王，為要作王的女婿。於是掃羅將女兒米甲給大衛為妻。
english: So David and his men got up and went, and put to death two hundred of the Philistines; and David took their private parts and gave the full number of them to the king, so that he might be the king's son-in-law. And Saul gave him his daughter Michal for his wife.

chinese: 掃羅見耶和華與大衛同在，又知道女兒米甲愛大衛，
english: And it was clear to Saul that the Lord was with David; and he was loved by all Israel.

chinese: 就更怕大衛，常作大衛的仇敵。
english: And Saul's fear of David became all the greater, and he went on hating him, day by day.

chinese: 每逢非利士軍長出來打仗，大衛比掃羅的臣僕做事精明，因此他的名被人尊重。
english: Then the rulers of the Philistines went out to war: and whenever they went out, David did more wisely than all the other servants of Saul, so that his name became greatly honoured.

chinese: 掃羅對他兒子約拿單和眾臣僕說，要殺大衛；掃羅的兒子約拿單卻甚喜愛大衛。
english: And Saul gave orders to his son Jonathan and to all his servants to put David to death. But Saul's son Jonathan had great delight in David.

chinese: 約拿單告訴大衛說：我父掃羅想要殺你，所以明日早晨你要小心，到一個僻靜地方藏身。
english: And Jonathan said to David, Saul, my father, is purposing your death: so now, take care in the morning, and keep yourself safe in a secret place:

chinese: 我就出到你所藏的田裡，站在我父親旁邊與他談論。我看他情形怎樣，我必告訴你。
english: And I will go out and take my place by my father's side in the field near where you are; and I will get into talk with my father about you, and when I see how things are, I will give you word.

chinese: 約拿單向他父親掃羅替大衛說好話，說：王不可得罪王的僕人大衛；因為他未曾得罪你，他所行的都與你大有益處。
english: And Jonathan gave his father Saul a good account of David, and said to him, Let not the king do wrong against his servant, against David; because he has done you no wrong, and all his acts have had a good outcome for you:

chinese: 他拚命殺那非利士人，耶和華為以色列眾人大行拯救；那時你看見，甚是歡喜，現在為何無故要殺大衛，流無辜人的血，自己取罪呢？
english: For he put his life in danger and overcame the Philistine, and the Lord gave all Israel salvation: you saw it and were glad: why then are you sinning against him who has done no wrong, desiring the death of David without cause?

chinese: 掃羅聽了約拿單的話，就指著永生的耶和華起誓說：我必不殺他。
english: And Saul gave ear to the voice of Jonathan, and said with an oath, By the living Lord, he is not to be put to death.

chinese: 約拿單叫大衛來，把這一切事告訴他，帶他去見掃羅。他就仍然侍立在掃羅面前。
english: Then Jonathan sent for David and gave him word of all these things. And Jonathan took David to Saul, who kept him by his side as in the past.

chinese: 此後又有爭戰的事。大衛出去與非利士人打仗，大大殺敗他們，他們就在他面前逃跑。
english: And there was war again: and David went out fighting the Philistines, causing great destruction among them; and they went in flight before him.

chinese: 從耶和華那裡來的惡魔又降在掃羅身上（掃羅手裡拿槍坐在屋裡），大衛就用手彈琴。
english: And an evil spirit from the Lord came on Saul, when he was seated in his house with his spear in his hand; and David made music for him.

chinese: 掃羅用槍想要刺透大衛，釘在牆上；他卻躲開，掃羅的槍刺入牆內。當夜大衛逃走，躲避了。
english: And Saul would have sent his spear through him, pinning him to the wall, but he got away and the spear went into the wall: and that night David went in flight and got away.

chinese: 掃羅打發人到大衛的房屋那裡窺探他，要等到天亮殺他。大衛的妻米甲對他說：你今夜若不逃命，明日你要被殺。
english: Then in that night Saul sent men to David's house to keep watch on him so as to put him to death in the morning: and David's wife Michal said to him, If you do not go away to a safe place tonight you will be put to death in the morning.

chinese: 於是米甲將大衛從窗戶裡縋下去；大衛就逃走，躲避了。
english: So Michal let David down through the window, and he went in flight and got away.

chinese: 米甲把家中的神像放在床上，頭枕在山羊毛裝的枕頭上，用被遮蓋。
english: Then Michal took the image and put it in the bed, with a cushion of goat's hair at its head, and she put clothing over it.

chinese: 掃羅打發人去捉拿大衛，米甲說：他病了。
english: And when Saul sent men to take David, she said, He is ill.

chinese: 掃羅又打發人去看大衛，說：當連床將他抬來，我好殺他。
english: And Saul sent his men to see David, saying, Do not come back without him, take him in his bed, so that I may put him to death.

chinese: 使者進去，看見床上有神像，頭枕在山羊毛裝的枕頭上。
english: And when the men came in, there was the image in the bed, with the cushion of goat's hair at its head

chinese: 掃羅對米甲說：你為甚麼這樣欺哄我，放我仇敵逃走呢？米甲回答說：他對我說：你放我走，不然我要殺你。
english: And Saul said to Michal, why have you been false to me, letting my hater go and get safely away? And in answer Michal said to Saul, He said to me, Let me go, or I will put you to death.

chinese: 大衛逃避，來到拉瑪見撒母耳，將掃羅向他所行的事述說了一遍。他和撒母耳就往拿約去居住。
english: So David went in flight and got away and came to Ramah, to Samuel, and gave him an account of all Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and were living in Naioth.

chinese: 有人告訴掃羅，說大衛在拉瑪的拿約。
english: And word was given to Saul that David was at Naioth in Ramah.

chinese: 掃羅打發人去捉拿大衛。去的人見有一班先知都受感說話，撒母耳站在其中監管他們；打發去的人也受神的靈感動說話。
english: And Saul sent men to take David; and when they saw the band of prophets at work, with Samuel in his place at their head, the spirit of God came on Saul's men, and they became like prophets.

chinese: 有人將這事告訴掃羅，他又打發人去，他們也受感說話。掃羅第三次打發人去，他們也受感說話。
english: And Saul, having news of this, sent other men, who in the same way became like prophets. And a third time Saul sent men, and they like the others became like prophets.

chinese: 然後掃羅自己往拉瑪去，到了西沽的大井，問人說：撒母耳和大衛在哪裡呢？有人說：在拉瑪的拿約。
english: Then he himself went to Ramah, and came to the great water-spring in Secu; and questioning the people he said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, They are at Naioth in Ramah.

chinese: 他就往拉瑪的拿約去。神的靈也感動他，一面走一面說話，直到拉瑪的拿約。
english: And he went on from there to Naioth in Ramah: and the spirit of God came on him, and he went on, acting like a prophet, till he came to Naioth in Ramah.

chinese: 他就脫了衣服，在撒母耳面前受感說話，一晝一夜露體躺臥。因此有句俗語說：掃羅也列在先知中麼？
english: And he took off his clothing, acting like a prophet before Samuel, and falling down he was stretched out, without his clothing, all that day and all that night. This is the reason for the saying, Is even Saul among the prophets?

chinese: 大衛從拉瑪的拿約逃跑，來到約拿單那裡，對他說：我做了甚麼？有甚麼罪孽呢？在你父親面前犯了甚麼罪，他竟尋索我的性命呢？
english: And David went in flight from Naioth in Ramah and came to Jonathan and said, What have I done? What is my crime and my sin against your father that he is attempting to take my life?

chinese: 約拿單回答說：斷然不是！你必不致死。我父作事，無論大小，沒有不叫我知道的。怎麼獨有這事隱瞞我呢？決不如此。
english: And he said to him, Far be the thought: you will not be put to death: see, my father does nothing, great or small, without giving me word of it: would he keep this secret from me? It is not so.

chinese: 大衛又起誓說：你父親準知我在你眼前蒙恩。他心裡說，不如不叫約拿單知道，恐怕他愁煩。我指著永生的耶和華，又敢在你面前起誓，我離死不過一步。
english: But David took his oath again and said, Your father sees that I am dear to you; so he says to himself, Let Jonathan have no idea of this, for it will be a grief to him; but as the Lord is living, and as your soul is living, there is only a step between me and death.

chinese: 約拿單對大衛說：你心裡所求的，我必為你成就。
english: Then Jonathan said to David, Whatever your desire is, I will do it for you.

chinese: 大衛對約拿單說：明日是初一，我當與王同席，求你容我去藏在田野，直到第三日晚上。
english: And David said to Jonathan, Tomorrow is the new moon, and I will not be seated with the king at his table: but let me go to a safe place in the country till the evening.

chinese: 你父親若見我不在席上，你就說：大衛切求我許他回本城伯利恆去，因為他全家在那裡獻年祭。
english: And if your father takes note of the fact that I am away, say, David made a request to me for himself that he might go to Beth-lehem, to his town: for it is the time when his family make their offering year by year.

chinese: 你父親若說好，僕人就平安了；他若發怒，你就知道他決意要害我。
english: If he says, It is well, your servant will be at peace: but if he is angry, then it will be clear to you that he has an evil purpose in mind against me.

chinese: 求你施恩與僕人，因你在耶和華面前曾與僕人結盟。我若有罪，不如你自己殺我，何必將我交給你父親呢？
english: So, then, be kind to your servant; for you have been united with your servant in an agreement made before the Lord: but if there is any wrongdoing in me, put me to death yourself; why take me to your father?

chinese: 約拿單說：斷無此事！我若知道我父親決意害你，我豈不告訴你呢？
english: And Jonathan said, Do not have such a thought: for if I saw that my father was designing evil against you, would I not give you word of it?

chinese: 大衛對約拿單說：你父親若用厲言回答你，誰來告訴我呢？
english: Then David said to Jonathan, Who will give me word if your father gives you a rough answer?

chinese: 約拿單對大衛說：你我且往田野去。二人就往田野去了。
english: And Jonathan said to David, Come, let us go out into the country. And the two of them went out together into the open country.

chinese: 約拿單對大衛說：願耶和華─以色列的神為證。明日約在這時候，或第三日，我探我父親的意思，若向你有好意，我豈不打發人告訴你麼？
english: And Jonathan said to David, May the Lord, the God of Israel, be witness; when I have had a chance of talking to my father, about this time tomorrow, if his feelings to David are good, will I not send and give you the news?

chinese: 我父親若有意害你，我不告訴你使你平平安安地走，願耶和華重重地降罰與我。願耶和華與你同在，如同從前與我父親同在一樣。
english: May the Lord's punishment be on Jonathan, if it is my father's pleasure to do you evil and I do not give you word of it and send you away so that you may go in peace: and may the Lord be with you, as he has been with my father.

chinese: 你要照耶和華的慈愛恩待我，不但我活著的時候免我死亡，
english: And may you, while I am still living, O may you be kind to me, as the Lord is kind, and keep me from death!

chinese: 就是我死後，耶和華從地上剪除你仇敵的時候，你也永不可向我家絕了恩惠。
english: And let not your mercy ever be cut off from my family, even when the Lord has sent destruction on all David's haters, cutting them off from the face of the earth.

chinese: 於是約拿單與大衛家結盟，說：願耶和華藉大衛的仇敵追討背約的罪。
english: And if it comes about that the name of Jonathan is cut off from the family of David, the Lord will make David responsible.

chinese: 約拿單因愛大衛如同愛自己的性命，就使他再起誓。
english: And Jonathan again took an oath to David, because of his love for him: for David was as dear to him as his very soul.

chinese: 約拿單對他說：明日是初一，你的座位空設，人必理會你不在那裡。
english: Then Jonathan said to him, Tomorrow is the new moon: and it will be seen that you are not present, for there will be no one in your seat.

chinese: 你等三日，就要速速下去，到你從前遇事所藏的地方，在以色磐石那裡等候。
english: And on the third day it will be specially noted, and you will go to the place where you took cover when the other business was in hand, waiting by the hill over there.

chinese: 我要向磐石旁邊射三箭，如同射箭靶一樣。
english: And on the third day I will send arrows from my bow against its side as if at a mark.

chinese: 我要打發童子，說：去把箭找來。我若對童子說：箭在後頭，把箭拿來，你就可以回來；我指著永生的耶和華起誓，你必平安無事。
english: And I will send my boy to have a look for the arrow. And if I say to him, See, the arrow is on this side of you; take it up! then you may come; for there is peace for you and no evil, by the living Lord.

chinese: 我若對童子說：箭在前頭，你就要去，因為是耶和華打發你去的。
english: But if I say to the boy, See, the arrow has gone past you: then go on your way, for the Lord has sent you away.

chinese: 至於你我今日所說的話，有耶和華在你我中間為證，直到永遠。
english: As for what you and I were talking of, the Lord is between you and me for ever.

chinese: 大衛就去藏在田野。到了初一日，王坐席要吃飯。
english: So David went to a secret place in the country: and when the new moon came, the king took his place at the feast.

chinese: 王照常坐在靠牆的位上，約拿單侍立，押尼珥坐在掃羅旁邊，大衛的座位空設。
english: And the king took his seat, as at other times, by the wall: and Jonathan was in front, and Abner was seated by Saul's side, but there was no one in David's seat.

chinese: 然而這日掃羅沒有說甚麼，他想大衛遇事，偶染不潔，他必定是不潔。
english: But Saul said nothing that day, for his thought was, Something has taken place making him unclean; it is clear that he is not clean.

chinese: 初二日大衛的座位還空設。掃羅問他兒子約拿單說：耶西的兒子為何昨日、今日沒有來吃飯呢？
english: And on the day after the new moon, that is, the second day, there was still no one in David's seat: and Saul said to his son Jonathan, Why has the son of Jesse not come to the feast yesterday or today?

chinese: 約拿單回答掃羅說：大衛切求我容他往伯利恆去。
english: And answering Saul, Jonathan said, He made a request to me that he might go to Beth-lehem,

chinese: 他說：求你容我去，因為我家在城裡有獻祭的事；我長兄吩咐我去。如今我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你容我去見我的弟兄；所以大衛沒有赴王的席。
english: Saying, Our family is making an offering in the town, and my brothers have given me orders to be there: so now, if I have grace in your eyes, let me go away and see my brothers. This is why he has not come to the king's table.

chinese: 掃羅向約拿單發怒，對他說：你這頑梗背逆之婦人所生的，我豈不知道你喜悅耶西的兒子，自取羞辱，以致你母親露體蒙羞麼？
english: Then Saul was moved to wrath against Jonathan, and he said to him, You son of an evil and uncontrolled woman, have I not seen how you have given your love to the son of Jesse, to your shame and the shame of your mother?

chinese: 耶西的兒子若在世間活著，你和你的國位必站立不住。現在你要打發人去，將他捉拿交給我；他是該死的。
english: For while the son of Jesse is living on the earth, your position is unsafe and your kingdom is in danger. So make him come here to me, for it is certainly right for him to be put to death.

chinese: 約拿單對父親掃羅說：他為甚麼該死呢？他做了甚麼呢？
english: And Jonathan, answering his father Saul, said to him, Why is he to be put to death? What has he done?

chinese: 掃羅向約拿單掄槍要刺他，約拿單就知道他父親決意要殺大衛。
english: And Saul, pointing his spear at him, made an attempt to give him a wound: from which it was clear to Jonathan that his father's purpose was to put David to death.

chinese: 於是約拿單氣忿忿地從席上起來，在這初二日沒有吃飯。他因見父親羞辱大衛，就為大衛愁煩。
english: So Jonathan got up from the table, burning with wrath, and took no part in the feast the second day of the month, being full of grief for David because his father had put shame on him.

chinese: 次日早晨，約拿單按著與大衛約會的時候出到田野，有一個童子跟隨。
english: Now in the morning, Jonathan went out into the fields at the time he had said to David, and he had a little boy with him.

chinese: 約拿單對童子說：你跑去，把我所射的箭找來。童子跑去，約拿單就把箭射在童子前頭。
english: And he said to the boy, Go and get the arrow I let loose from my bow. And while the boy was running, he sent an arrow past him.

chinese: 童子到了約拿單落箭之地，約拿單呼叫童子說：箭不是在你前頭麼？
english: And when the boy came to the place where the arrow was, Jonathan, crying out after the boy, said, Has it not gone past you?

chinese: 約拿單又呼叫童子說：速速地去，不要遲延！童子就拾起箭來，回到主人那裡。
english: And Jonathan went on crying out after the boy, Be quick, do not keep waiting about, go quickly. And Jonathan's boy got the arrow and came back to his master.

chinese: 童子卻不知道這是甚麼意思，只有約拿單和大衛知道。
english: But the boy had no idea what was going on; only Jonathan and David had knowledge of it.

chinese: 約拿單將弓箭交給童子，吩咐說：你拿到城裡去。
english: And Jonathan gave his bow and arrows to the boy, and said to him, Take these and go back to the town.

chinese: 童子一去，大衛就從磐石的南邊出來，俯伏在地，拜了三拜；二人親嘴，彼此哭泣，大衛哭得更慟。
english: And when the boy had gone, David came from his secret place by the hill, and falling to the earth went down on his face three times: and they gave one another a kiss, weeping together, till David's grief was the greater.

chinese: 約拿單對大衛說：我們二人曾指著耶和華的名起誓說：願耶和華在你我中間，並你我後裔中間為證，直到永遠。如今你平平安安地去罷！大衛就起身走了；約拿單也回城裡去了。
english: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, for we two have taken an oath, in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord will be between me and you, and between my seed and your seed for ever. Then David went away, and Jonathan went into the town.

chinese: 大衛到了挪伯祭司亞希米勒那裡，亞希米勒戰戰兢兢地出來迎接他，問他說：你為甚麼獨自來，沒有人跟隨呢？
english: Then David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was full of fear at meeting David, and said to him, Why are you by yourself, having no man with you?

chinese: 大衛回答祭司亞希米勒說：王吩咐我一件事說：我差遣你委託你的這件事，不要使人知道。故此我已派定少年人在某處等候我。
english: And David said to Ahimelech the priest, The king has given me orders and has said to me, Say nothing to anyone about the business on which I am sending you and the orders I have given you: and a certain place has been fixed to which the young men are to go.

chinese: 現在你手下有甚麼？求你給我五個餅或是別樣的食物。
english: So now, if you have here five cakes of bread, give them into my hand, or whatever you have.

chinese: 祭司對大衛說：我手下沒有尋常的餅，只有聖餅；若少年人沒有親近婦人才可以給。
english: And the priest, answering David, said, I have no common bread here but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.

chinese: 大衛對祭司說：實在約有三日我們沒有親近婦人；我出來的時候，雖是尋常行路，少年人的器皿還是潔淨的；何況今日不更是潔淨麼？
english: And David in answer said to the priest, Certainly women have been kept from us; and as has been done before when I have gone out the arms of the young men were made holy, even though it was a common journey; how much more today will their arms be made holy.

chinese: 祭司就拿聖餅給他；因為在那裡沒有別樣餅，只有更換新餅，從耶和華面前撤下來的陳設餅。
english: So the priest gave him the holy bread: there was no other, only the holy bread which had been taken from before the Lord, so that new bread might be put in its place on the day when it was taken away.

chinese: （當日有掃羅的一個臣子留在耶和華面前。他名叫多益，是以東人，作掃羅的司牧長。）
english: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, kept back before the Lord; his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the strongest of Saul's runners.

chinese: 大衛問亞希米勒說：你手下有槍有刀沒有？因為王的事甚急，連刀劍器械我都沒有帶。
english: And David said to Ahimelech, Have you no sword or spear with you here? for I have come without my sword and other arms, because the king's business had to be done quickly.

chinese: 祭司說：你在以拉谷殺非利士人歌利亞的那刀在這裡，裹在布中，放在以弗得後邊，你要就可以拿去；除此以外，再沒有別的。大衛說：這刀沒有可比的！求你給我。
english: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you put to death in the valley of Elah, is here folded in a cloth at the back of the ephod: take that, if you will, for there is no other sword here. And David said, there is no other sword like that; give it to me.

chinese: 那日大衛起來，躲避掃羅，逃到迦特王亞吉那裡。
english: Then David got up and went in flight that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish, the king of Gath.

chinese: 亞吉的臣僕對亞吉說：這不是以色列國王大衛麼？那裡的婦女跳舞唱和，不是指著他說掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬麼？
english: And the servants of Achish said to him, Is not this David, the king of the land? did they not make songs about him in their dances, saying, Saul has put to death thousands, and David tens of thousands?

chinese: 大衛將這話放在心裡，甚懼怕迦特王亞吉，
english: And David took these words to heart, fearing Achish, the king of Gath.

chinese: 就在眾人面前改變了尋常的舉動，在他們手下假裝瘋癲，在城門的門扇上胡寫亂畫，使唾沫流在鬍子上。
english: So changing his behaviour before them, he made it seem as if he was off his head, hammering on the doors of the town, and letting the water from his mouth go down his chin.

chinese: 亞吉對臣僕說：你們看，這人是瘋子。為甚麼帶他到我這裡來呢？
english: Then Achish said to his servants, Look! the man is clearly off his head; why have you let him come before me?

chinese: 我豈缺少瘋子，你們帶這人來在我面前瘋癲麼？這人豈可進我的家呢？
english: Are there not enough unbalanced men about me, that you have let this person come and do such tricks before me? is such a man to come into my house?

chinese: 大衛就離開那裡，逃到亞杜蘭洞。他的弟兄和他父親的全家聽見了，就都下到他那裡。
english: So David went away from there and took cover in a strong place at Adullam; and his brothers and all his father's people, hearing of it, went down to him there.

chinese: 凡受窘迫的、欠債的、心裡苦惱的都聚集到大衛那裡；大衛就作他們的頭目，跟隨他的約有四百人。
english: And everyone who was in trouble, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was bitter in soul, came together to him, and he became captain over them: about four hundred men were joined to him.

chinese: 大衛從那裡往摩押的米斯巴去，對摩押王說：求你容我父母搬來，住在你們這裡，等我知道神要為我怎樣行。
english: And from there David went to Mizpeh in the land of Moab: and he said to the king of Moab, Let my father and mother come and make their living-place with you till it is clear to me what God will do for me.

chinese: 大衛領他父母到摩押王面前。大衛住山寨多少日子，他父母也住摩押王那裡多少日子。
english: And he took them to the king of Moab and they went on living with him while David was in his safe place.

chinese: 先知迦得對大衛說：你不要住在山寨，要往猶大地去。大衛就離開那裡，進入哈列的樹林。
english: And the prophet Gad said to David, Do not go on living in this place but go into the land of Judah. Then David went away and came to the woodland of Hereth.

chinese: 掃羅在基比亞的拉瑪，坐在垂絲柳樹下，手裡拿著槍，眾臣僕侍立在左右。掃羅聽見大衛和跟隨他的人在何處，
english: And news was given to Saul that David had been seen, and the men who were with him: now Saul was in Gibeah, seated under the tree in the high place, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were in their places before him.

chinese: 就對左右侍立的臣僕說：便雅憫人哪，你們要聽我的話！耶西的兒子能將田地和葡萄園賜給你們各人麼？能立你們各人作千夫長百夫長麼？
english: Then Saul said to his servants who were there about him, Give ear now, you Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give to every one of you fields and vine-gardens, will he make you all captains of hundreds and captains of thousands;

chinese: 你們竟都結黨害我！我的兒子與耶西的兒子結盟的時候，無人告訴我；我的兒子挑唆我的臣子謀害我，就如今日的光景，也無人告訴我，為我憂慮。
english: That all of you have made designs against me, and not one of you gave me word when my son made an agreement with the son of Jesse, and not one of you has pity for me or has made my eyes open to the fact that my servant has been moved by my son against me, as at this day?

chinese: 那時以東人多益站在掃羅的臣僕中，對他說：我曾看見耶西的兒子到了挪伯，亞希突的兒子亞希米勒那裡。
english: Then Doeg, the Edomite, who was by the side of the servants of Saul, in answer said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub.

chinese: 亞希米勒為他求問耶和華，又給他食物，並給他殺非利士人歌利亞的刀。
english: And he got directions from the Lord for him, and gave him food, and put in his hand the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

chinese: 王就打發人將祭司亞希突的兒子亞希米勒和他父親的全家，就是住挪伯的祭司都召了來；他們就來見王。
english: Then the king sent for Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and for all the men of his father's family who were priests in Nob: and they all came to the king.

chinese: 掃羅說：亞希突的兒子，要聽我的話！他回答說：主啊，我在這裡。
english: And Saul said, Give ear now, O son of Ahitub. And answering he said, Here I am, my lord.

chinese: 掃羅對他說：你為甚麼與耶西的兒子結黨害我，將食物和刀給他，又為他求問神，使他起來謀害我，就如今日的光景？
english: And Saul said to him, Why have you made designs against me with the son of Jesse, giving him food and a sword and getting directions from the Lord for him, and helping him to take up arms against me, and to be on the watch to make a secret attack on me as he is doing now?

chinese: 亞希米勒回答王說：王的臣僕中有誰比大衛忠心呢？他是王的女婿，又是王的參謀，並且在王家中是尊貴的。
english: Then Ahimelech answering said to the king, Who among all your servants is so true to you as David, who is the king's son-in-law, and is a captain of your armed men, and has a place of honour in your house?

chinese: 我豈是從今日才為他求問神呢？斷不是這樣！王不要將罪歸我和我父的全家；因為這事，無論大小，僕人都不知道。
english: Is this the first time I have got directions from God for him? Far be the thought! let the king make no such statement against his servant or my father's family, for your servant has no knowledge, great or small, of this thing.

chinese: 王說：亞希米勒啊，你和你父的全家都是該死的！
english: And the king said, You will certainly be put to death, Ahimelech, you and all your father's family.

chinese: 王就吩咐左右的侍衛說：你們去殺耶和華的祭司；因為他們幫助大衛，又知道大衛逃跑，竟沒有告訴我。掃羅的臣子卻不肯伸手殺耶和華的祭司。
english: Then the king said to the runners who were waiting near him, Put the priests of the Lord to death; because they are on David's side, and having knowledge of his flight, did not give me word of it. But the king's servants would not put out their hands to make an attack on the Lord's priests.

chinese: 王吩咐多益說：你去殺祭司罷！以東人多益就去殺祭司，那日殺了穿細麻布以弗得的八十五人；
english: Then the king said to Doeg, You are to put the priests to death. And Doeg the Edomite, turning on the priests and attacking them, put to death that day eighty-five men who took up the ephod.

chinese: 又用刀將祭司城挪伯中的男女、孩童、吃奶的，和牛、羊、驢盡都殺滅。
english: And Nob, the town of the priests, he put to the sword, all the men and women, children and babies at the breast, and oxen and asses and sheep.

chinese: 亞希突的兒子亞希米勒有一個兒子，名叫亞比亞他，逃到大衛那裡。
english: And Abiathar, one of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, got away and went in flight after David;

chinese: 亞比亞他將掃羅殺耶和華祭司的事告訴大衛。
english: And gave him the news of how Saul had put to death the Lord's priests.

chinese: 大衛對亞比亞他說：那日我見以東人多益在那裡，就知道他必告訴掃羅。你父的全家喪命，都是因我的緣故。
english: And David said to Abiathar, I was certain that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would take the news to Saul: I am responsible for the lives of all your father's family.

chinese: 你可以住在我這裡，不要懼怕。因為尋索你命的就是尋索我的命；你在我這裡可得保全。
english: Keep here with me and have no fear; for he who has designs on my life has designs on yours: but with me you will be safe.

chinese: 有人告訴大衛說：非利士人攻擊基伊拉，搶奪禾場。
english: And they sent word to David, saying, The Philistines are fighting against Keilah and taking the grain from the grain-floors.

chinese: 所以大衛求問耶和華說：我去攻打那些非利士人可以不可以？耶和華對大衛說：你可以去攻打非利士人，拯救基伊拉。
english: So David, questioning the Lord, said, Am I to go and make an attack on these Philistines? And the Lord said to David, Go and make an attack on the Philistines so that Keilah may be kept from falling into their hands.

chinese: 跟隨大衛的人對他說：我們在猶大地這裡尚且懼怕，何況往基伊拉去攻打非利士人的軍旅呢？
english: And David's men said to him, Even here in Judah we are full of fear: how much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

chinese: 大衛又求問耶和華。耶和華回答說：你起身下基伊拉去，我必將非利士人交在你手裡。
english: Then David put the question to the Lord again, and the Lord answering said, Up! go down to Keilah; for I will give the Philistines into your hands.

chinese: 大衛和跟隨他的人往基伊拉去，與非利士人打仗，大大殺敗他們，又奪獲他們的牲畜。這樣，大衛救了基伊拉的居民。
english: So David and his men went to Keilah, and had a fight with the Philistines, and took away their cattle, and put them to the sword with great destruction. So David was the saviour of the people of Keilah.

chinese: 亞希米勒的兒子亞比亞他逃到基伊拉見大衛的時候，手裡拿著以弗得。
english: Now when Abiathar, the son of Ahimelech, went in flight to David, he came down to Keilah with the ephod in his hand.

chinese: 有人告訴掃羅說：大衛到了基伊拉。掃羅說：他進了有門有閂的城，困閉在裡頭；這是神將他交在我手裡了。
english: And news was given to Saul that David had come to Keilah. And Saul said, Now God has given him into my hands; for by going into a walled town with locked doors, he has let himself be shut in.

chinese: 於是掃羅招聚眾民，要下去攻打基伊拉城，圍困大衛和跟隨他的人。
english: And Saul sent for all the people to come to the fight, and go down to Keilah to make an attack on David and his men.

chinese: 大衛知道掃羅設計謀害他，就對祭司亞比亞他說：將以弗得拿過來。
english: And it was clear to David that Saul had evil designs against him, and he said to Abiathar the priest, Come here with the ephod.

chinese: 大衛禱告說：耶和華─以色列的神啊，你僕人聽真了掃羅要往基伊拉來，為我的緣故滅城。
english: Then David said, O Lord, the God of Israel, news has been given to your servant that it is Saul's purpose to come to Keilah and send destruction on the town because of me.

chinese: 基伊拉人將我交在掃羅手裡不交？掃羅照著你僕人所聽的話下來不下來？耶和華─以色列的神啊，求你指示僕人！耶和華說：掃羅必下來。
english: And now, is it true, as they have said to me, that Saul is coming? O Lord, the God of Israel, give ear to your servant, and say if these things are so. And the Lord said, He is coming down.

chinese: 大衛又說：基伊拉人將我和跟隨我的人交在掃羅手裡不交？耶和華說：必交出來。
english: Then David said, Will the men of Keilah give me and my men up to Saul? and the Lord said, They will give you up.

chinese: 大衛和跟隨他的約有六百人，就起身出了基伊拉，往他們所能往的地方去。有人告訴掃羅，大衛離開基伊拉逃走；於是掃羅不出來了。
english: Then David and his men, about six hundred of them, went out of Keilah, and got away wherever they were able to go. And Saul, hearing that David had got away from Keilah, did not go there.

chinese: 大衛住在曠野的山寨裡，常在西弗曠野的山地。掃羅天天尋索大衛，神卻不將大衛交在他手裡。
english: And David kept in the waste land, in safe places, waiting in the hill-country in the waste land of Ziph. And Saul was searching for him every day, but God did not give him up into his hands.

chinese: 大衛知道掃羅出來尋索他的命。那時，他住在西弗曠野的樹林裡；
english: And David was full of fear, in the knowledge that Saul had come out to take his life; and David was in the waste land of Ziph, in Horesh.

chinese: 掃羅的兒子約拿單起身，往那樹林裡去見大衛，使他倚靠神得以堅固，
english: And Saul's son Jonathan went to David in Horesh, and made his hands strong in God;

chinese: 對他說：不要懼怕！我父掃羅的手必不加害於你；你必作以色列的王，我也作你的宰相。這事我父掃羅知道了。
english: And said to him, Have no fear, for Saul my father will not get you into his power; and you will be king of Israel, and I will be by your side, and my father Saul is certain of this.

chinese: 於是二人在耶和華面前立約。大衛仍住在樹林裡，約拿單回家去了。
english: And the two of them made an agreement before the Lord: and David went on living in Horesh, and Jonathan went back to his house.

chinese: 西弗人上到基比亞見掃羅，說：大衛不是在我們那裡的樹林裡山寨中、曠野南邊的哈基拉山藏著麼？
english: Then the Ziphites came up to Gibeah to see Saul, and said, Is not David living secretly among us in the strong places in Horesh, in the hill of Hachilah to the south of the waste land?

chinese: 王啊，請你隨你的心願下來，我們必親自將他交在王的手裡。
english: So now, O king, have your soul's desire and come down, and we, for our part, will give him up into the king's hands.

chinese: 掃羅說：願耶和華賜福與你們，因你們顧恤我。
english: And Saul said, The Lord's blessing will be yours, for you have had pity on me.

chinese: 請你們回去，再確實查明他的住處和行蹤，是誰看見他在那裡，因為我聽見人說他甚狡猾。
english: Go now, and take more steps, and see where he is living: for they say that he is expert in deceit.

chinese: 所以要看準他藏匿的地方，回來據實地告訴我，我就與你們同去。他若在猶大的境內，我必從千門萬戶中搜出他來。
english: So take care to get knowledge of all the secret places where he is taking cover, and be certain to come back to me, and I will go with you: and without doubt, if he is anywhere in the land, I will get him, among all the families of Judah.

chinese: 西弗人就起身，在掃羅以先往西弗去。大衛和跟隨他的人卻在瑪雲曠野南邊的亞拉巴。
english: And they went back and came to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the waste land of Maon, in the dry land south of the waste land.

chinese: 掃羅和跟隨他的人去尋找大衛；有人告訴大衛，他就下到磐石，住在瑪雲的曠野。掃羅聽見，便在瑪雲的曠野追趕大衛。
english: And Saul and his men went in search of him. And David had word of it, so he came down to the rock in the waste land of Maon. And Saul, hearing of this, went after David into the waste land of Maon.

chinese: 掃羅在山這邊走，大衛和跟隨他的人在山那邊走。大衛急忙躲避掃羅；因為掃羅和跟隨他的人，四面圍住大衛和跟隨他的人，要拿獲他們。
english: And Saul and his men went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men went on the other: and David's purpose was to get away as quickly as possible, for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men were making a circle round David and his men in order to take them.

chinese: 忽有使者來報告掃羅說：非利士人犯境搶掠，請王快快回去！
english: But a man came to Saul saying, Be quick and come; for the Philistines have made an attack on the land.

chinese: 於是掃羅不追趕大衛，回去攻打非利士人。因此那地方名叫西拉哈瑪希羅結。
english: So turning back from going after David, Saul went against the Philistines: so that place was named Sela-hammah-lekoth.

chinese: 大衛從那裡上去，住在隱基底的山寨裡。
english: And from there, David went up and took cover in the safe place of En-gedi.

chinese: 掃羅追趕非利士人回來，有人告訴他說：大衛在隱基底的曠野。
english: Now when Saul came back from fighting the Philistines, news was given him that David was in the waste land of En-gedi.

chinese: 掃羅就從以色列人中挑選三千精兵，率領他們往野羊的磐石去，尋索大衛和跟隨他的人。
english: Then Saul took three thousand of the best men out of all Israel, and went in search of David and his men on the rocks of the mountain goats.

chinese: 到了路旁的羊圈，在那裡有洞，掃羅進去大解。大衛和跟隨他的人正藏在洞裡的深處。
english: And on the way he came to a place where sheep were kept, where there was a hollow in the rock; and Saul went in for a private purpose. Now David and his men were in the deepest part of the hollow.

chinese: 跟隨的人對大衛說：耶和華曾應許你說：我要將你的仇敵交在你手裡，你可以任意待他。如今時候到了！大衛就起來，悄悄地割下掃羅外袍的衣襟。
english: And David's men said to him, Now is the time when the Lord says to you, I will give up your hater into your hands to do with him whatever seems good to you. Then David, getting up, took the skirt of Saul's robe in his hand, cutting off the end of it without his knowledge.

chinese: 隨後大衛心中自責，因為割下掃羅的衣襟；
english: And later, David was full of regret for cutting off Saul's skirt.

chinese: 對跟隨他的人說：我的主乃是耶和華的受膏者，我在耶和華面前萬不敢伸手害他，因他是耶和華的受膏者。
english: And David said to his men, Before the Lord, never let it be said that my hand was lifted up against my lord, the man of the Lord's selection, for the Lord's holy oil has been put on him.

chinese: 大衛用這話攔住跟隨他的人，不容他們起來害掃羅。掃羅起來，從洞裡出去行路。
english: So with these words David kept his servants back, and did not let them make an attack on Saul. And Saul got up and went on his way.

chinese: 隨後大衛也起來，從洞裡出去，呼叫掃羅說：我主，我王！掃羅回頭觀看，大衛就屈身、臉伏於地下拜。
english: And after that David came out of the hollow rock, and crying after Saul said, My lord the king. And when Saul gave a look back, David went down on his face and gave him honour.

chinese: 大衛對掃羅說：你為何聽信人的讒言，說大衛想要害你呢？
english: And David said to Saul, Why do you give any attention to those who say that it is my desire to do you wrong?

chinese: 今日你親眼看見在洞中，耶和華將你交在我手裡；有人叫我殺你，我卻愛惜你，說：我不敢伸手害我的主，因為他是耶和華的受膏者。
english: Look! you have seen today how the Lord gave you up into my hands even now in the hollow of the rocks: and some would have had me put you to death, but I had pity on you: for I said, Never will my hand be lifted up against my lord, who has been marked with the holy oil.

chinese: 我父啊，看看你外袍的衣襟在我手中。我割下你的衣襟，沒有殺你；你由此可以知道我沒有惡意叛逆你。你雖然獵取我的命，我卻沒有得罪你。
english: And see, my father, see the skirt of your robe in my hand: for the fact that I took off the skirt of your robe and did not put you to death is witness that I have no evil purpose, and I have done you no wrong, though you are waiting for my life to take it.

chinese: 願耶和華在你我中間判斷是非，在你身上為我伸冤，我卻不親手加害於你。
english: May the Lord be judge between me and you, and may the Lord give me my rights against you, but my hand will never be lifted up against you.

chinese: 古人有句俗語說：惡事出於惡人。我卻不親手加害於你。
english: There is an old saying, From the evil-doer comes evil: but my hand will never be lifted up against you.

chinese: 以色列王出來要尋找誰呢？追趕誰呢？不過追趕一條死狗，一個虼蚤就是了。
english: After whom has the king of Israel come out? for whom are you searching? for a dead dog, an insect.

chinese: 願耶和華在你我中間施行審判，斷定是非，並且鑒察，為我伸冤，救我脫離你的手。
english: So let the Lord be judge, and give a decision between me and you, and see and give support to my cause, and keep me from falling into your hands.

chinese: 大衛向掃羅說完這話，掃羅說：我兒大衛，這是你的聲音麼？就放聲大哭，
english: Now when David had said these words to Saul, Saul said, Is this your voice, David, my son? And Saul was overcome with weeping.

chinese: 對大衛說：你比我公義；因為你以善待我，我卻以惡待你。
english: And he said to David, You are right and I am wrong: for you have given me back good, but I have given you evil.

chinese: 你今日顯明是以善待我；因為耶和華將我交在你手裡，你卻沒有殺我。
english: And you have made clear to me how good you have been to me today: because, when the Lord gave me up into your hands, you did not put me to death.

chinese: 人若遇見仇敵，豈肯放他平安無事地去呢？願耶和華因你今日向我所行的，以善報你。
english: If a man comes across his hater, will he let him get away safe? so may you be rewarded by the Lord for what you have done for me today.

chinese: 我也知道你必要作王，以色列的國必堅立在你手裡。
english: And now I am certain that you will be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be made strong under your authority.

chinese: 現在你要指著耶和華向我起誓，不剪除我的後裔，在我父家不滅沒我的名。
english: So give me your oath by the Lord, that you will not put an end to my seed after me or let my name be cut off from my father's family.

chinese: 於是大衛向掃羅起誓，掃羅就回家去；大衛和跟隨他的人上山寨去了。
english: And David gave Saul his oath. And Saul went back to his house; but David and his men went up to their safe place.

chinese: 撒母耳死了，以色列眾人聚集，為他哀哭，將他葬在拉瑪─他自己的墳墓（原文是房屋）裡。大衛起身，下到巴蘭的曠野。
english: And death came to Samuel; and all Israel came together, weeping for him, and put his body in its resting-place in his house at Ramah. Then David went down to the waste land of Maon.

chinese: 在瑪雲有一個人，他的產業在迦密，是一個大富戶，有三千綿羊，一千山羊；他正在迦密剪羊毛。
english: Now there was a man in Maon whose business was in Carmel; he was a great man and had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats: and he was cutting the wool of his sheep in Carmel.

chinese: 那人名叫拿八，是迦勒族的人；他的妻名叫亞比該，是聰明俊美的婦人。拿八為人剛愎凶惡。
english: Now this man was named Nabal, and his wife's name was Abigail: she was a woman of good sense and pleasing looks: but the man was cruel and evil in his ways; he was of the family of Caleb.

chinese: 大衛在曠野聽見說拿八剪羊毛，
english: And David had word in the waste land that Nabal was cutting the wool of his sheep.

chinese: 大衛就打發十個僕人，吩咐他們說：你們上迦密去見拿八，提我的名問他安。
english: And David sent ten young men, and said to them, Go up to Carmel and go to Nabal, and say kind words to him in my name;

chinese: 要對那富戶如此說：願你平安，願你家平安，願你一切所有的都平安。
english: And say this to my brother, May all be well for you: peace be to you and your house and all you have.

chinese: 現在我聽說有人為你剪羊毛，你的牧人在迦密的時候和我們在一處，我們沒有欺負他們，他們也未曾失落甚麼。
english: I have had word that you have wool-cutters: now the keepers of your sheep have been with us, and we have done them no evil, and taken nothing of theirs while they were in Carmel.

chinese: 可以問你的僕人，他們必告訴你。所以願我的僕人在你眼前蒙恩，因為是在好日子來的。求你隨手取點賜與僕人和你兒子大衛。
english: If your young men are questioned they will say the same thing. So now, let my young men have grace in your eyes, for we are come at a good time; please give anything you may have by you to your servants and to your son David.

chinese: 大衛的僕人到了，將這話提大衛的名都告訴了拿八，就住了口。
english: And when David's young men came, they said all this to Nabal, in David's name, and said nothing more.

chinese: 拿八回答大衛的僕人說：大衛是誰？耶西的兒子是誰？近來悖逆主人奔逃的僕人甚多，
english: And Nabal gave them his answer and said, Who is David? who is the son of Jesse? there are a number of servants in these days running away from their masters.

chinese: 我豈可將飲食和為我剪羊毛人所宰的肉給我不知道從哪裡來的人呢？
english: Am I to take my bread and my wine and the meat I have got ready for my wool-cutters and give it to men coming from I have no idea where?

chinese: 大衛的僕人就轉身從原路回去，照這話告訴大衛。
english: So David's young men, turning away, went back and gave him an account of everything he had said.

chinese: 大衛向跟隨他的人說：你們各人都要帶上刀！眾人就都帶上刀，大衛也帶上刀。跟隨大衛上去的約有四百人，留下二百人看守器具。
english: And David said to his men, Put on your swords, every one of you. And every man put on his sword; and David did the same; and about four hundred men went up with David, and two hundred kept watch over their goods.

chinese: 有拿八的一個僕人告訴拿八的妻亞比該說：大衛從曠野打發使者來問我主人的安，主人卻辱罵他們。
english: But one of the young men said to Nabal's wife Abigail, David sent men from the waste land to say kind words to our master, and he gave them a rough answer.

chinese: 但是那些人待我們甚好；我們在田野與他們來往的時候，沒有受他們的欺負，也未曾失落甚麼。
english: But these men have been very good to us; they did us no wrong and nothing of ours was touched while we were with them in the fields:

chinese: 我們在他們那裡牧羊的時候，他們晝夜作我們的保障。
english: But day and night they were like a wall round us while we were with them, looking after the sheep.

chinese: 所以你當籌劃，看怎樣行才好；不然，禍患定要臨到我主人和他全家。他性情凶暴，無人敢與他說話。
english: So now, give thought to what you are going to do; for evil is in store for our master and all his house: for he is such a good-for-nothing person that it is not possible to say anything to him.

chinese: 亞比該急忙將二百餅，兩皮袋酒，五隻收拾好了的羊，五細亞烘好了的穗子，一百葡萄餅，二百無花果餅，都馱在驢上，
english: Then Abigail quickly took two hundred cakes of bread and two skins full of wine and five sheep ready for cooking and five measures of dry grain and a hundred parcels of dry grapes and two hundred cakes of figs, and put them on asses.

chinese: 對僕人說：你們前頭走，我隨著你們去。這事他卻沒有告訴丈夫拿八。
english: And she said to her young men, Go on in front of me and I will come after you. But she said nothing to her husband Nabal.

chinese: 亞比該騎著驢，正下山坡，見大衛和跟隨他的人從對面下來，亞比該就迎接他們。
english: Now while she was going down under cover of the mountain on her ass, David and his men came down against her, and suddenly she came face to face with them.

chinese: 大衛曾說：我在曠野為那人看守所有的，以致他一樣不失落，實在是徒然了！他向我以惡報善。
english: Now David had said, What was the use of my taking care of this man's goods in the waste land, so that there was no loss of anything which was his? he has only given me back evil for good.

chinese: 凡屬拿八的男丁，我若留一個到明日早晨，願神重重降罰與我！
english: May God's punishment be on David, if when morning comes there is so much as one male of his people still living.

chinese: 亞比該見大衛，便急忙下驢，在大衛面前臉伏於地叩拜，
english: And when Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her ass, falling down on her face before him.

chinese: 俯伏在大衛的腳前，說：我主啊，願這罪歸我！求你容婢女向你進言，更求你聽婢女的話。
english: And falling at his feet she said, May the wrong be on me, my lord, on me: let your servant say a word to you, and give ear to the words of your servant.

chinese: 我主不要理這壞人拿八，他的性情與他的名相稱；他名叫拿八（就是愚頑的意思），他為人果然愚頑。但我主所打發的僕人，婢女並沒有看見。
english: Let my lord give no attention to Nabal, that good-for-nothing: for as his name is, so is he, a man without sense: but I, your servant, did not see the young men whom my lord sent.

chinese: 我主啊，耶和華既然阻止你親手報仇，取流血的罪，所以我指著永生的耶和華，又敢在你面前起誓說：願你的仇敵和謀害你的人都像拿八一樣。
english: So now, my lord, by the living God and by your living soul, seeing that the Lord has kept you from the crime of blood and from taking into your hands the punishment for your wrongs, may all your haters, and those who would do evil to my lord, be like Nabal.

chinese: 如今求你將婢女送來的禮物給跟隨你的僕人。
english: And let this offering, which your servant gives to my lord, be given to the young men who are with my lord.

chinese: 求你饒恕婢女的罪過。耶和華必為我主建立堅固的家，因我主為耶和華爭戰；並且在你平生的日子查不出有甚麼過來。
english: And may the sin of your servant have forgiveness: for the Lord will certainly make your family strong, because my lord is fighting in the Lord's war; and no evil will be seen in you all your days.

chinese: 雖有人起來追逼你，尋索你的性命，你的性命卻在耶和華─你的神那裡蒙保護，如包裹寶器一樣；你仇敵的性命，耶和華必拋去，如用機弦甩石一樣。
english: And though a man has taken up arms against you, putting your life in danger, still the soul of my lord will be kept safe among the band of the living with the Lord your God; and the souls of those who are against you he will send violently away from him, like stones from a bag.

chinese: 我主現在若不親手報仇流無辜人的血，到了耶和華照所應許你的話賜福與你，立你作以色列的王，那時我主必不至心裡不安，覺得良心有虧。耶和華賜福與我主的時候，求你記念婢女。
english: And when the Lord has done for my lord all those good things which he has said he will do for you, and has made you a ruler over Israel;

Then you will have no cause for grief, and my lord's heart will not be troubled because you have taken life without cause and have yourself given punishment for your wrongs: and when the Lord has been good to you, then give a thought to your servant.

chinese: 大衛對亞比該說：耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的，因為他今日使你來迎接我。
english: And David said to Abigail, May the Lord, the God of Israel, be praised, who sent you to me today:

chinese: 你和你的見識也當稱讚；因為你今日攔阻我親手報仇、流人的血。
english: A blessing on your good sense and on you, who have kept me today from the crime of blood and from taking into my hands the punishment for my wrongs.

chinese: 我指著阻止我加害於你的耶和華─以色列永生的神起誓，你若不速速地來迎接我，到明日早晨，凡屬拿八的男丁必定不留一個。
english: For truly, by the living Lord, the God of Israel, who has kept me from doing you evil, if you had not been so quick in coming to me and meeting me, by dawn there would not have been in Nabal's house so much as one male living.

chinese: 大衛受了亞比該送來的禮物，就對他說：我聽了你的話，准了你的情面，你可以平平安安地回家罷！
english: Then David took from her hands her offering: and he said to her, Go back to your house in peace; see, I have given ear to your voice, and taken your offering with respect.

chinese: 亞比該到拿八那裡，見他在家裡設擺筵席，如同王的筵席；拿八快樂大醉。亞比該無論大小事都沒有告訴他，就等到次日早晨。
english: And Abigail went back to Nabal; and he was feasting in his house like a king; and Nabal's heart was full of joy, for he had taken much wine; so she said nothing to him till dawn came.

chinese: 到了早晨，拿八醒了酒，他的妻將這些事都告訴他，他就魂不附體，身僵如石頭一般。
english: And in the morning, when the effect of the wine was gone, Nabal's wife gave him an account of all these things, and all the heart went out of him, and he became like stone.

chinese: 過了十天，耶和華擊打拿八，他就死了。
english: And about ten days after, the Lord sent disease on Nabal and death came to him.

chinese: 大衛聽見拿八死了，就說：應當稱頌耶和華，因他伸了拿八羞辱我的冤，又阻止僕人行惡；也使拿八的惡歸到拿八的頭上。於是大衛打發人去，與亞比該說，要娶他為妻。
english: And David, hearing that Nabal was dead, said, May the Lord be praised, who has taken up my cause against Nabal for the shame which he put on me, and has kept back his servant from evil, and has sent on Nabal's head the reward of his evil-doing. And David sent word to Abigail, desiring to take her as his wife.

chinese: 大衛的僕人到了迦密見亞比該，對他說：大衛打發我們來見你，想要娶你為妻。
english: And when David's servants came to Carmel, to Abigail, they said to her, David has sent us to you to take you to him as his wife.

chinese: 亞比該就起來，俯伏在地，說：我情願作婢女，洗我主僕人的腳。
english: And she got up, and going down on her face to the earth, said, See, I am ready to be a servant-girl, washing the feet of the servants of my lord.

chinese: 亞比該立刻起身，騎上驢，帶著五個使女，跟從大衛的使者去了，就作了大衛的妻。
english: Then Abigail got up quickly and went on her ass, with five of her young women, after the men whom David had sent; and she became David's wife.

chinese: 大衛先娶了耶斯列人亞希暖，他們二人都作了他的妻。
english: And David had taken Ahinoam of Jezreel, to be his wife; these two were his wives.

chinese: 掃羅已將他的女兒米甲，就是大衛的妻，給了迦琳人拉億的兒子帕提為妻。
english: Now Saul had given his daughter Michal, David's wife, to Palti the son of Laish of Gallim.

chinese: 西弗人到基比亞見掃羅，說：大衛不是在曠野前的哈基拉山藏著麼？
english: And the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, and said, Is not David waiting secretly near us in the hill of Hachilah, before the waste land?

chinese: 掃羅就起身，帶領以色列人中挑選的三千精兵下到西弗的曠野，要在那裡尋索大衛。
english: Then Saul went down to the waste land of Ziph, taking with him three thousand of the best men of Israel, to make search for David in the waste land of Ziph.

chinese: 掃羅在曠野前的哈基拉山，在道路上安營。大衛住在曠野，聽說掃羅到曠野來追尋他，
english: And Saul put up his tents on the hill of Hachilah, which is in front of the waste land on the road. But David was in the waste land, and he saw that Saul was coming after him.

chinese: 就打發人去探聽，便知道掃羅果然來到。
english: And so David sent out watchers, and got word from them that Saul was certainly coming.

chinese: 大衛起來，到掃羅安營的地方，看見掃羅和他的元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥睡臥之處；掃羅睡在輜重營裡，百姓安營在他周圍。
english: And David got up and came to the place where Saul's tents were: and David had a view of the place where Saul was sleeping with Abner, the son of Ner, the captain of his army: and Saul was sleeping inside the ring of carts, and the tents of the people were all round him.

chinese: 大衛對赫人亞希米勒和洗魯雅的兒子約押的兄弟亞比篩說：誰同我下到掃羅營裡去？亞比篩說：我同你下去。
english: Then David said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, Who will go down with me to the tents of Saul? And Abishai said, I will go down with you.

chinese: 於是大衛和亞比篩夜間到了百姓那裡，見掃羅睡在輜重營裡；他的槍在頭旁，插在地上。押尼珥和百姓睡在他周圍。
english: So David and Abishai came down to the army by night: and Saul was sleeping inside the ring of carts with his spear planted in the earth by his head: and Abner and the people were sleeping round him.

chinese: 亞比篩對大衛說：現在神將你的仇敵交在你手裡，求你容我拿槍將他刺透在地，一刺就成，不用再刺。
english: Then Abishai said to David, God has given up your hater into your hands today; now let me give him one blow through to the earth with his spear, and there will be no need to give him a second.

chinese: 大衛對亞比篩說：不可害死他。有誰伸手害耶和華的受膏者而無罪呢？
english: And David said to Abishai Do not put him to death; for who, without sin, may put out his hand against the man on whom the Lord has put the holy oil?

chinese: 大衛又說：我指著永生的耶和華起誓，他或被耶和華擊打，或是死期到了，或是出戰陣亡；
english: And David said, By the living Lord, the Lord will send destruction on him; the natural day of his death will come, or he will go into the fight and come to his end.
