chinese: 我在耶和華面前，萬不敢伸手害耶和華的受膏者。現在你可以將他頭旁的槍和水瓶拿來，我們就走。
english: Never will my hand be stretched out against the man marked with the holy oil; but take the spear which is by his head and the vessel of water, and let us go.

chinese: 大衛從掃羅的頭旁拿了槍和水瓶，二人就走了，沒有人看見，沒有人知道，也沒有人醒起，都睡著了，因為耶和華使他們沉沉地睡了。
english: So David took the spear and the vessel of water from Saul's head; and they got away without any man seeing them, or being conscious of their coming, or awaking; for they were all sleeping because a deep sleep from the Lord had come on them.

chinese: 大衛過到那邊去，遠遠地站在山頂上，與他們相離甚遠。
english: Then David went over to the other side, and took his place on the top of a mountain some distance away, with a great space between them;

chinese: 大衛呼叫百姓和尼珥的兒子押尼珥說：押尼珥啊，你為何不答應呢？押尼珥說：你是誰？竟敢呼叫王呢？
english: And crying out to the people and to Abner, the son of Ner, David said, Have you no answer to give, Abner? Then Abner said, Who is that crying out to the king?

chinese: 大衛對押尼珥說：你不是個勇士麼？以色列中誰能比你呢？民中有人進來要害死王─你的主，你為何沒有保護王─你的主呢？
english: And David said to Abner, Are you not a man of war? is there any other like you in Israel? why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? for one of the people came in to put the king your lord to death.

chinese: 你這樣是不好的！我指著永生的耶和華起誓，你們都是該死的；因為沒有保護你們的主，就是耶和華的受膏者。現在你看看王頭旁的槍和水瓶在哪裡。
english: What you have done is not good. By the living Lord, death is the right fate for you, because you have not kept watch over your lord, the man on whom the Lord has put the holy oil. Now see, where is the king's spear, and the vessel of water which was by his head?

chinese: 掃羅聽出是大衛的聲音，就說：我兒大衛，這是你的聲音麼？大衛說：主─我的王啊，是我的聲音；
english: And Saul, conscious that the voice was David's, said, Is that your voice, David, my son? And David said, It is my voice, O my lord king.

chinese: 又說：我做了甚麼？我手裡有甚麼惡事？我主竟追趕僕人呢？
english: And he said, Why does my lord go armed against his servant? what have I done? or what evil is there in me?

chinese: 求我主我王聽僕人的話：若是耶和華激發你攻擊我，願耶和華收納祭物；若是人激發你，願他在耶和華面前受咒詛；因為他現今趕逐我，不容我在耶和華的產業上有分，說：你去事奉別神罷！
english: Let my lord the king give ear now to the words of his servant. If it is the Lord who is moving you against me, let him take an offering: but if it is the children of men, may they be cursed before the Lord, for driving me out today and keeping me from my place in the heritage of the Lord, saying, Go, be the servant of other gods.

chinese: 現在求王不要使我的血流在離耶和華遠的地方。以色列王出來是尋找一個虼蚤，如同人在山上獵取一個鷓鴣一般。
english: Then do not let my blood be drained out on the earth away from the face of the Lord: for the king of Israel has come out to take my life, like one going after birds in the mountains.

chinese: 掃羅說：我有罪了！我兒大衛，你可以回來，因你今日看我的性命為寶貴；我必不再加害於你。我是糊塗人，大大錯了。
english: Then Saul said, I have done wrong: come back to me, David my son: I will do you no more wrong, because my life was dear to you today truly, I have been foolish and my error is very great.

chinese: 大衛說：王的槍在這裡，可以吩咐一個僕人過來拿去。
english: Then David said, Here is the king's spear! let one of the young men come over and get it.

chinese: 今日耶和華將王交在我手裡，我卻不肯伸手害耶和華的受膏者。耶和華必照各人的公義誠實報應他。
english: And the Lord will give to every man the reward of his righteousness and his faith: because the Lord gave you into my hands today, and I would not put out my hand against the man who has been marked with the holy oil.

chinese: 我今日重看你的性命，願耶和華也重看我的性命，並且拯救我脫離一切患難。
english: And so, as your life was dear to me today, may my life be dear to the Lord, and may he make me free from all my troubles.

chinese: 掃羅對大衛說：我兒大衛，願你得福！你必做大事，也必得勝。於是大衛起行，掃羅回他的本處去了。
english: Then Saul said to David, May a blessing be on you, David, my son; you will do great things and without doubt you will overcome. Then David went on his way, and Saul went back to his place.

chinese: 大衛心裡說：必有一日我死在掃羅手裡，不如逃奔非利士地去。掃羅見我不在以色列的境內，就必絕望，不再尋索我；這樣我可以脫離他的手。
english: And David said to himself, Some day death will come to me by the hand of Saul: the only thing for me to do is to get away into the land of the Philistines; then Saul will give up hope of taking me in any part of the land of Israel: and so I may be able to get away from him.

chinese: 於是大衛起身，和跟隨他的六百人投奔迦特王─瑪俄的兒子亞吉去了。
english: So David and the six hundred men who were with him went over to Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

chinese: 大衛和他的兩個妻，就是耶斯列人亞希暖和作過拿八妻的迦密人亞比該，並跟隨他的人，連各人的眷屬，都住在迦特的亞吉那裡。
english: And David and his men were living with Achish at Gath; every man had his family with him, and David had his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail of Carmel, who had been the wife of Nabal.

chinese: 有人告訴掃羅說：大衛逃到迦特。掃羅就不再尋索他了。
english: And Saul, hearing that David had gone to Gath, went after him no longer.

chinese: 大衛對亞吉說：我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在京外的城邑中賜我一個地方居住。僕人何必與王同住京都呢？
english: Then David said to Achish, If now I have grace in your eyes, let me have a place in one of the smaller towns of your land, to be my living-place; for it is not right for your servant to be living with you in the king's town.

chinese: 當日亞吉將洗革拉賜給他，因此洗革拉屬猶大王，直到今日。
english: So Achish straight away gave him Ziklag: and for that reason Ziklag has been the property of the kings of Judah to this day.

chinese: 大衛在非利士地住了一年零四個月。
english: And David was living in the land of the Philistines for the space of a year and four months.

chinese: 大衛和跟隨他的人上去，侵奪基述人、基色人、亞瑪力人之地。這幾族歷來住在那地，從書珥直到埃及。
english: And David and his men went up and made attacks on the Geshurites and the Girzites and the Amalekites; for these were the people who were living in the land from Telam on the way to Shur, as far as Egypt.

chinese: 大衛擊殺那地的人，無論男女都沒有留下一個，又奪獲牛、羊、駱駝、驢，並衣服，回來見亞吉。
english: And David again and again made attacks on the land till not a man or a woman was still living; and he took away the sheep and the oxen and the asses and the camels and the clothing; and he came back to Achish.

chinese: 亞吉說：你們今日侵奪了甚麼地方呢？大衛說：侵奪了猶大的南方、耶拉篾的南方、基尼的南方。
english: And every time Achish said, Where have you been fighting today? David said, Against the South of Judah and the South of the Jerahmeelites and the South of the Kenites.

chinese: 無論男女，大衛沒有留下一個帶到迦特來。他說：恐怕他們將我們的事告訴人，說大衛住在非利士地的時候常常這樣行。
english: Not one living man or woman did David ever take back with him to Gath, fearing that they might give an account of what had taken place, and say, This is what David did, and so has he been doing all the time while he has been living in the land of the Philistines.

chinese: 亞吉信了大衛，心裡說：大衛使本族以色列人憎惡他，所以他必永遠作我的僕人了。
english: And Achish had belief in what David said, saying, He has made himself hated by all his people Israel, and so he will be my servant for ever.

chinese: 那時，非利士人聚集軍旅，要與以色列人打仗。亞吉對大衛說：你當知道，你和跟隨你的人都要隨我出戰。
english: Now in those days the Philistines got their forces together to make war on Israel. And Achish said to David, Certainly you and your men are to go out with me to the fight.

chinese: 大衛對亞吉說：僕人所能做的事，王必知道。亞吉對大衛說：這樣，我立你永遠作我的護衛長。
english: And David said to Achish, You will see now what your servant will do. And Achish said to David, Then I will make you keeper of my head for ever.

chinese: 那時撒母耳已經死了，以色列眾人為他哀哭，葬他在拉瑪，就是在他本城裡。掃羅曾在國內不容有交鬼的和行巫術的人。
english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel, after weeping for him, had put his body in its last resting-place in Ramah, his town. And Saul had put away from the land all those who had control of spirits and who made use of secret arts.

chinese: 非利士人聚集，來到書念安營；掃羅聚集以色列眾人在基利波安營。
english: And the Philistines came together and put their forces in position in Shunem; and Saul got all Israel together and they took up their positions in Gilboa.

chinese: 掃羅看見非利士的軍旅就懼怕，心中發顫。
english: And when Saul saw the Philistine army he was troubled, and his heart was moved with fear.

chinese: 掃羅求問耶和華，耶和華卻不藉夢，或烏陵，或先知回答他。
english: And when Saul went for directions to the Lord, the Lord gave him no answer, by a dream or by the Urim or by the prophets.

chinese: 掃羅吩咐臣僕說：當為我找一個交鬼的婦人，我好去問他。臣僕說：在隱多珥有一個交鬼的婦人。
english: Then Saul said to his servants, Get me a woman who has control of a spirit so that I may go to her and get directions. And his servants said to him, There is such a woman at En-dor.

chinese: 於是掃羅改了裝，穿上別的衣服，帶著兩個人，夜裡去見那婦人。掃羅說：求你用交鬼的法術，將我所告訴你的死人，為我招上來。
english: So Saul, putting on other clothing, so that he might not be seen to be the king, took two men with him and went to the woman by night; and he said, Now, with the help of the spirit which you have, make the person whose name I will give you come up.

chinese: 婦人對他說：你知道掃羅從國中剪除交鬼的和行巫術的。你為何陷害我的性命，使我死呢？
english: And the woman said to him, But you have knowledge of what Saul has done, how he has put away out of the land those who have control of spirits and the users of secret arts: why would you, by a trick, put me in danger of death?

chinese: 掃羅向婦人指著耶和華起誓說：我指著永生的耶和華起誓，你必不因這事受刑。
english: And Saul made an oath to her by the Lord, saying, By the living Lord, no punishment will come to you for this.

chinese: 婦人說：我為你招誰上來呢？回答說：為我招撒母耳上來。
english: Then the woman said, Who am I to let you see? And he said, Make Samuel come up for me.

chinese: 婦人看見撒母耳，就大聲呼叫，對掃羅說：你是掃羅，為甚麼欺哄我呢？
english: And the woman saw that it was Saul, and she gave a loud cry, and said to Saul, Why have you made use of deceit? for you are Saul.

chinese: 王對婦人說：不要懼怕，你看見了甚麼呢？婦人對掃羅說：我看見有神從地裡上來。
english: And the king said to her, Have no fear: what do you see? And the woman said to Saul, I see a god coming up out of the earth.

chinese: 掃羅說：他是怎樣的形狀？婦人說：有一個老人上來，身穿長衣。掃羅知道是撒母耳，就屈身，臉伏於地下拜。
english: And he said to her, What is his form? And she said, It is an old man coming up covered with a robe. And Saul saw that it was Samuel, and with his face bent down to the earth he gave him honour.

chinese: 撒母耳對掃羅說：你為甚麼攪擾我，招我上來呢？掃羅回答說：我甚窘急；因為非利士人攻擊我，神也離開我，不再藉先知或夢回答我。因此請你上來，好指示我應當怎樣行。
english: And Samuel said to Saul, Why have you made me come up, troubling my rest? And Saul in answer said, I am in great danger; for the Philistines are making war on me, and God has gone away from me and will no longer give me any answer, by the prophets or by dreams: so I have sent for you to make clear to me what I am to do.

chinese: 撒母耳說：耶和華已經離開你，且與你為敵，你何必問我呢？
english: And Samuel said, Why do you put your questions to me, seeing that God has gone away from you and is on the side of him who is against you?

chinese: 耶和華照他藉我說的話，已經從你手裡奪去國權，賜與別人，就是大衛。
english: And the Lord himself has done what I said: the Lord has taken the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbour David;

chinese: 因你沒有聽從耶和華的命令；他惱怒亞瑪力人，你沒有滅絕他們，所以今日耶和華向你這樣行，
english: Because you did not do what the Lord said, and did not give effect to his burning wrath against Amalek. So the Lord has done this thing to you today.

chinese: 並且耶和華必將你和以色列人交在非利士人的手裡。明日你和你眾子必與我在一處了；耶和華必將以色列的軍兵交在非利士人手裡。
english: And more than this, the Lord will give Israel up with you into the hands of the Philistines: and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me: and the Lord will give up the army of Israel into the hands of the Philistines.

chinese: 掃羅猛然仆倒，挺身在地，因撒母耳的話甚是懼怕；那一晝一夜沒有吃甚麼，就毫無氣力。
english: Then Saul went down flat on the earth, and was full of fear because of Samuel's words: and there was no strength in him, for he had taken no food all that day or all that night.

chinese: 婦人到掃羅面前，見他極其驚恐，對他說：婢女聽從你的話，不顧惜自己的性命，遵從你所吩咐的。
english: And the woman came to Saul and saw that he was in great trouble, and said to him, See now, your servant has given ear to your words, and I have put my life in danger by doing what you said.

chinese: 現在求你聽婢女的話，容我在你面前擺上一點食物，你吃了，可以有氣力行路。
english: So now, give ear to the voice of your servant, and let me give you a little bread; and take some food to give you strength when you go on your way.

chinese: 掃羅不肯，說：我不吃。但他的僕人和婦人再三勸他，他才聽了他們的話，從地上起來，坐在床上。
english: But he would not, saying, I have no desire for food. But his servants, together with the woman, made him take food, and he gave way to them. So he got up from the earth, and took his seat on the bed.

chinese: 婦人急忙將家裡的一隻肥牛犢宰了，又拿麵摶成無酵餅烤了，
english: And the woman had in the house a young cow, made fat for food; and she put it to death straight away; and she took meal and got it mixed and made unleavened bread;

chinese: 擺在掃羅和他僕人面前。他們吃完，當夜就起身走了。
english: And she put it before Saul and his servants, and they had a meal. Then they got up and went away the same night.

chinese: 非利士人將他們的軍旅聚到亞弗；以色列人在耶斯列的泉旁安營。
english: Now the Philistines got all their army together at Aphek: and the Israelites put their forces in position by the fountain in Jezreel.

chinese: 非利士人的首領各率軍隊，或百或千，挨次前進；大衛和跟隨他的人同著亞吉跟在後邊。
english: And the lords of the Philistines went on with their hundreds and their thousands, and David and his men came after with Achish.

chinese: 非利士人的首領說：這些希伯來人在這裡做甚麼呢？亞吉對他們說：這不是以色列王掃羅的臣子大衛麼？他在我這裡有些年日了。自從他投降我直到今日，我未曾見他有過錯。
english: Then the rulers of the Philistines said, What are these Hebrews doing here? And Achish said to the rulers of the Philistines, Is this not David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me for a year or two, and I have never seen any wrong in him from the time when he came to me till now?

chinese: 非利士人的首領向亞吉發怒，對他說：你要叫這人回你所安置他的地方，不可叫他同我們出戰，恐怕他在陣上反為我們的敵人。他用甚麼與他主人復和呢？豈不是用我們這些人的首級麼？
english: But the rulers of the Philistines were angry with him, and said to him, Make the man go back to the place you have given him; do not let him go down with us to the fight, or he may be turned against us and be false to us: for how will this man make peace with his lord? will it not be with the heads of these men?

chinese: 從前以色列的婦女跳舞唱和說：掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬，所說的不是這個大衛麼？
english: Is this not David, who was named in their songs, when in the dance they said to one another, Saul has put to death thousands, and David tens of thousands?

chinese: 亞吉叫大衛來，對他說：我指著永生的耶和華起誓，你是正直人。你隨我在軍中出入，我看你甚好。自從你投奔我到如今，我未曾見你有甚麼過失；只是眾首領不喜悅你。
english: Then Achish sent for David and said to him, By the living Lord, you are upright, and everything you have done with me in the army has been pleasing to me: I have seen no evil in you from the day when you came to me till now: but still, the lords are not pleased with you.

chinese: 現在你可以平平安安地回去，免得非利士人的首領不歡喜你。
english: So now go back, and go in peace, so that you do not make the lords of the Philistines angry.

chinese: 大衛對亞吉說：我做了甚麼呢？自從僕人到你面前，直到今日，你查出我有甚麼過錯，使我不去攻擊主─我王的仇敵呢？
english: And David said to Achish, But what have I done? what have you seen in your servant while I have been with you till this day, that I may not go and take up arms against those who are now making war on my lord the king?

chinese: 亞吉說：我知道你在我眼前是好人，如同神的使者一般；只是非利士人的首領說：這人不可同我們出戰。
english: And Achish in answer said, It is true that in my eyes you are good, like an angel of God: but still, the rulers of the Philistines have said, He is not to go up with us to the fight.

chinese: 故此你和跟隨你的人，就是你本主的僕人，要明日早晨起來，等到天亮回去罷！
english: So get up early in the morning, with the servants of your lord who are with you, and go to the place I have given you, and have no evil design in your heart, for you are good in my eyes; but when there is light enough in the morning, go away.

chinese: 於是大衛和跟隨他的人早晨起來，回往非利士地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。
english: So David and his men got up early in the morning to go back to the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

chinese: 第三日，大衛和跟隨他的人到了洗革拉。亞瑪力人已經侵奪南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚燒，
english: Now when David and his men came to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made an attack on the South and on Ziklag, and had overcome Ziklag and put it on fire;

chinese: 擄了城內的婦女和其中的大小人口，卻沒有殺一個，都帶著走了。
english: And had made the women and all who were there, small and great, prisoners: they had not put any of them to death, but had taken them all away.

chinese: 大衛和跟隨他的人到了那城，不料，城已燒燬，他們的妻子兒女都被擄去了。
english: And when David and his men came to the town, they saw that it had been burned down, and their wives and their sons and daughters had been made prisoners.

chinese: 大衛和跟隨他的人就放聲大哭，直哭得沒有氣力。
english: Then David and the people who were with him gave themselves up to weeping till they were able to go on weeping no longer.

chinese: 大衛的兩個妻─耶斯列人亞希暖和作過拿八妻的迦密人亞比該，也被擄去了。
english: And David's two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the wife of Nabal of Carmel, had been made prisoners.

chinese: 大衛甚是焦急，因眾人為自己的兒女苦惱，說：要用石頭打死他。大衛卻倚靠耶和華─他的神，心裡堅固。
english: And David was greatly troubled; for the people were talking of stoning him, because their hearts were bitter, every man sorrowing for his sons and his daughters: but David made himself strong in the Lord his God.

chinese: 大衛對亞希米勒的兒子祭司亞比亞他說：請你將以弗得拿過來。亞比亞他就將以弗得拿到大衛面前。
english: And David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, Come here to me with the ephod. And Abiathar took the ephod to David.

chinese: 大衛求問耶和華說：我追趕敵軍，追得上追不上呢？耶和華說：你可以追，必追得上，都救得回來。
english: Then David, questioning the Lord, said, Am I to go after this band? will I be able to overtake them? And in answer he said, Go after them, for you will certainly overtake them, and get back everything.

chinese: 於是，大衛和跟隨他的六百人來到比梭溪；有不能前去的就留在那裡。
english: So David went, and his six hundred men went with him, and they came to the stream Besor.

chinese: 大衛卻帶著四百人往前追趕，有二百人疲乏，不能過比梭溪，所以留在那裡。
english: And David, with four hundred men, went on: but two hundred of them were overcome with weariness, and not able to go across the stream.

chinese: 這四百人在田野遇見一個埃及人，就帶他到大衛面前，給他餅吃，給他水喝，
english: And in the fields they saw an Egyptian whom they took to David, and they gave him bread, and he had a meal, and they gave him water for drink;

chinese: 又給他一塊無花果餅，兩個葡萄餅。他吃了，就精神復原；因為他三日三夜沒有吃餅，沒有喝水。
english: And they gave him part of a cake of figs and some dry grapes; and after the food, his spirit came back to him, for he had had no food or drink for three days and nights.

chinese: 大衛問他說：你是屬誰的？你是哪裡的人？他回答說：我是埃及的少年人，是亞瑪力人的奴僕；因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇棄了。
english: And David said to him, Whose man are you and where do you come from? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master went on without me because three days back I became ill.

chinese: 我們侵奪了基利提的南方和屬猶大的地，並迦勒地的南方，又用火燒了洗革拉。
english: We made an attack on the south part of the country of the Cherethites, and on the land which is Judah's, and on the south of Caleb; and we put Ziklag on fire.

chinese: 大衛問他說：你肯領我們到敵軍那裡不肯？他回答說：你要向我指著神起誓，不殺我，也不將我交在我主人手裡，我就領你下到敵軍那裡。
english: And David said to him, Will you take me down to this band? And he said, If you give me your oath that you will not put me to death or give me up to my master, I will take you to them.

chinese: 那人領大衛下去，見他們散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因為從非利士地和猶大地所擄來的財物甚多。
english: And when he had taken him down, they saw them all, seated about on all sides, feasting and drinking among all the mass of goods which they had taken from the land of the Philistines and the land of Judah.

chinese: 大衛從黎明直到次日晚上，擊殺他們，除了四百騎駱駝的少年人之外，沒有一個逃脫的。
english: And David went on fighting them from evening till the evening of the day after; and not one of them got away but only four hundred young men who went in flight on camels.

chinese: 亞瑪力人所擄去的財物，大衛全都奪回，並救回他的兩個妻來。
english: And David got back everything the Amalekites had taken; and he got back his two wives.

chinese: 凡亞瑪力人所擄去的，無論大小、兒女、財物，大衛都奪回來，沒有失落一個。
english: There was no loss of anything, small or great, sons or daughters or goods or anything which they had taken away: David got it all back.

chinese: 大衛所奪來的牛群羊群，跟隨他的人趕在原有的群畜前邊，說：這是大衛的掠物。
english: And they took all the flocks and herds, and driving them in front of him, said, These are David's.

chinese: 大衛到了那疲乏不能跟隨、留在比梭溪的二百人那裡。他們出來迎接大衛並跟隨的人。大衛前來問他們安。
english: And David came to the two hundred men, who because of weariness had not gone with him, but were waiting at the stream Besor: and they went out, meeting David and the people who were with him; and when they came near them, they said, How are you?

chinese: 跟隨大衛人中的惡人和匪類說：這些人既然沒有和我們同去，我們所奪的財物就不分給他們，只將他們各人的妻子兒女給他們，使他們帶去就是了。
english: Then the bad and good-for-nothing men among those who went with David said, Because they did not go with us, we will give them nothing of the goods which we have got back, but only to every man his wife and children, so that he may take them and go.

chinese: 大衛說：弟兄們，耶和華所賜給我們的，不可不分給他們；因為他保佑我們，將那攻擊我們的敵軍交在我們手裡。
english: Then David said, You are not to do this, my brothers, after what the Lord has given us, who has kept us safe and given up the band which came against us into our hands.

chinese: 這事誰肯依從你們呢？上陣的得多少，看守器具的也得多少；應當大家平分。
english: Who is going to give any attention to you in this question? for an equal part will be given to him who went to the fight and to him who was waiting by the goods: they are all to have the same.

chinese: 大衛定此為以色列的律例典章，從那日直到今日。
english: And so he made it a rule and an order for Israel from that day till now.

chinese: 大衛到了洗革拉，從掠物中取些送給他朋友猶大的長老，說：這是從耶和華仇敵那裡奪來的，送你們為禮物。
english: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the goods to the responsible men of Judah, and to his friends, saying, Here is an offering for you from the goods of those who were fighting against the Lord;

chinese: 他送禮物給住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的；
english: He sent to those who were in Beth-el, and in Ramah of the South, and in Jattir;

chinese: 住亞羅珥的，息末的，以實提莫的；
english: And to those in Arara and Eshtemoa

chinese: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的；
english: and Carmel and in the towns of the Jerahmeelites, and in the towns of the Kenites;

chinese: 住何珥瑪的，歌拉珊的，亞撻的；
english: And to those who were in Hormah and in Bor-ashan and in Athach;

chinese: 住希伯崙的，並大衛和跟隨他的人素來所到之處的人。
english: And in Hebron, and to all the places where David and his men had been living.

chinese: 非利士人與以色列人爭戰。以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波有被殺仆倒的。
english: Now the Philistines were fighting against Israel: and the men of Israel went in flight before the Philistines, falling down wounded in Mount Gilboa.

chinese: 非利士人緊追掃羅和他兒子們，就殺了掃羅的兒子約拿單、亞比拿達、麥基舒亞。
english: And the Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and they put to death Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

chinese: 勢派甚大，掃羅被弓箭手追上，射傷甚重，
english: And the fight was going badly for Saul, and the archers came across him, and he was wounded by the archers.

chinese: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人說：你拔出刀來，將我刺死，免得那些未受割禮的人來刺我，凌辱我。但拿兵器的人甚懼怕，不肯刺他；掃羅就自己伏在刀上死了。
english: Then Saul said to the servant who had the care of his arms, Take out your sword and put it through me, before these men without circumcision come and make sport of me. But his servant, full of fear, would not do so. Then Saul took out his sword, and falling on it, put an end to himself.

chinese: 拿兵器的人見掃羅已死，也伏在刀上死了。
english: And when his servant saw that Saul was dead, he did the same, and was united with him in death.

chinese: 這樣，掃羅和他三個兒子，與拿他兵器的人，以及跟隨他的人，都一同死亡。
english: So death overtook Saul and his three sons and his servant on the same day.

chinese: 住平原那邊並約但河西的以色列人，見以色列軍兵逃跑，掃羅和他兒子都死了，也就棄城逃跑。非利士人便來住在其中。
english: And when the men of Israel across the valley and on the other side of Jordan saw that the army of Israel was in flight and that Saul and his sons were dead, they came out of their towns and went in flight; and the Philistines came and took them for themselves.

chinese: 次日，非利士人來剝那被殺之人的衣服，看見掃羅和他三個兒子仆倒在基利波山，
english: Now on the day after, when the Philistines came to take their goods from the dead, they saw Saul and his three sons dead on the earth in Mount Gilboa.

chinese: 就割下他的首級，剝了他的軍裝，打發人到（或譯：送到）非利士地的四境，報信與他們廟裡的偶像和眾民；
english: And cutting off his head and taking away his war-dress, they sent word into the land of the Philistines round about, to take the news to their gods and to the people.

chinese: 又將掃羅的軍裝放在亞斯他錄廟裡，將他的屍身釘在伯珊的城牆上。
english: His war-dress they put in the house of Astarte; and his body was fixed on the wall of Beth-shan.

chinese: 基列雅比的居民聽見非利士人向掃羅所行的事，
english: And when the people of Jabesh-gilead had news of what the Philistines had done to Saul,

chinese: 他們中間所有的勇士就起身，走了一夜，將掃羅和他兒子的屍身從伯珊城牆上取下來，送到雅比那裡，用火燒了；
english: All the fighting men got up and, travelling all night, took Saul's body and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan; and they came to Jabesh and had them burned there.

chinese: 將他們骸骨葬在雅比的垂絲柳樹下，就禁食七日。
english: And their bones they put in the earth under a tree in Jabesh; and for seven days they took no food.

chinese: 掃羅死後，大衛擊殺亞瑪力人回來，在洗革拉住了兩天。
english: Now after the death of Saul, when David, having come back from the destruction of the Amalekites, had been in Ziklag for two days;

chinese: 第三天，有一人從掃羅的營裡出來，衣服撕裂，頭蒙灰塵，到大衛面前伏地叩拜。
english: On the third day a man came from Saul's tents, with his clothing out of order and earth on his head: and when he came to David, he went down on the earth and gave him honour.

chinese: 大衛問他說：你從哪裡來？他說：我從以色列的營裡逃來。
english: And David said to him, Where have you come from? And he said, I have come in flight from the tents of Israel.

chinese: 大衛又問他說：事情怎樣？請你告訴我。他回答說：百姓從陣上逃跑，也有許多人仆倒死亡；掃羅和他兒子約拿單也死了。
english: And David said to him, How did things go? Give me the news. And in answer he said, The people have gone in flight from the fight, and a great number of them are dead; and Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.

chinese: 大衛問報信的少年人說：你怎麼知道掃羅和他兒子約拿單死了呢？
english: And David said to the young man who gave him the news, Why are you certain that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?

chinese: 報信的少年人說：我偶然到基利波山，看見掃羅伏在自己槍上，有戰車、馬兵緊緊地追他。
english: And the young man said, I came by chance to Mount Gilboa, and I saw Saul supporting himself on his spear; and the war-carriages and horsemen overtook him.

chinese: 他回頭看見我，就呼叫我。我說：我在這裡。
english: And looking back, he saw me and gave a cry to me. And answering him I said, Here am I.

chinese: 他問我說：你是甚麼人？我說：我是亞瑪力人。
english: And he said to me, Who are you? And I said, I am an Amalekite.

chinese: 他說：請你來，將我殺死；因為痛苦抓住我，我的生命尚存。
english: Then he said to me, Come here to my side, and put me to death, for the pain of death has me in its grip but my life is still strong in me.

chinese: 我準知他仆倒必不能活，就去將他殺死，把他頭上的冠冕、臂上的鐲子拿到我主這裡。
english: So I put my foot on him and gave him his death-blow, because I was certain that he would not go on living after his fall: and I took the crown from his head and the band from his arm, and I have them here for my lord.

chinese: 大衛就撕裂衣服，跟隨他的人也是如此，
english: Then David gave way to bitter grief, and so did all the men who were with him:

chinese: 而且悲哀哭號，禁食到晚上，是因掃羅和他兒子約拿單，並耶和華的民以色列家的人，倒在刀下。
english: And till evening they gave themselves to sorrow and weeping, and took no food, weeping for Saul and for Jonathan, his son, and for the people of the Lord and for the men of Israel; because they had come to their end by the sword.

chinese: 大衛問報信的少年人說：你是哪裡的人？他說：我是亞瑪力客人的兒子。
english: And David said to the young man who had given him the news, Where do you come from? And he said, I am the son of a man from a strange land; I am an Amalekite.

chinese: 大衛說：你伸手殺害耶和華的受膏者，怎麼不畏懼呢？
english: And David said to him, Had you no fear of stretching out your hand to put to death the one marked with the holy oil?

chinese: 大衛叫了一個少年人來，說：你去殺他罷！
english: And David sent for one of his young men and said, Go near and put an end to him. And he put him to death.

chinese: 大衛對他說：你流人血的罪歸到自己的頭上，因為你親口作見證說：我殺了耶和華的受膏者。少年人就把他殺了。
english: And David said to him, May your blood be on your head; for your mouth has given witness against you, saying, I have put to death the man marked with the holy oil.

chinese: 大衛作哀歌，弔掃羅和他兒子約拿單，
english: Then David made this song of grief for Saul and Jonathan, his son:

chinese: 且吩咐將這歌教導猶大人。這歌名叫弓歌，寫在雅煞珥書上。
english: (It is recorded in the book of Jashar for teaching to the sons of Judah) and he said:

chinese: 歌中說：以色列啊，你尊榮者在山上被殺！大英雄何竟死亡！
english: The glory, O Israel, is dead on your high places! How have the great ones been made low!

chinese: 不要在迦特報告；不要在亞實基倫街上傳揚；免得非利士的女子歡樂；免得未受割禮之人的女子矜誇。
english: Give no news of it in Gath, let it not be said in the streets of Ashkelon; or the daughters of the Philistines will be glad, the daughters of men without circumcision will be uplifted in joy.

chinese: 基利波山哪，願你那裡沒有雨露！願你田地無土產可作供物！因為英雄的盾牌在那裡被污丟棄；掃羅的盾牌彷彿未曾抹油。
english: O mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, you fields of death: for there the arms of the strong have been shamed, the arms of Saul, as if he had not been marked with the holy oil.

chinese: 約拿單的弓箭非流敵人的血不退縮；掃羅的刀劍非剖勇士的油不收回。
english: From the blood of the dead, from the fat of the strong, the bow of Jonathan was not turned back, the sword of Saul did not come back unused.

chinese: 掃羅和約拿單─活時相悅相愛，死時也不分離─他們比鷹更快，比獅子還強。
english: Saul and Jonathan were loved and pleasing; in their lives and in their death they were not parted; they went more quickly than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

chinese: 以色列的女子啊，當為掃羅哭號！他曾使你們穿朱紅色的美衣，使你們衣服有黃金的妝飾。
english: O daughters of Israel, have sorrow for Saul, by whom you were delicately clothed in robes of red, with ornaments of gold on your dresses.

chinese: 英雄何竟在陣上仆倒！約拿單何竟在山上被殺！
english: How have the great ones been made low in the fight! Jonathan is dead on your high places.

chinese: 我兄約拿單哪，我為你悲傷！我甚喜悅你！你向我發的愛情奇妙非常，過於婦女的愛情。
english: I am full of grief for you, my brother Jonathan: very dear have you been to me: your love for me was a wonder, greater than the love of women.

chinese: 英雄何竟仆倒！戰具何竟滅沒！
english: How have the great ones been made low, and the arms of war broken!

chinese: 此後，大衛問耶和華說：我上猶大的一個城去可以麼？耶和華說：可以。大衛說：我上哪一個城去呢？耶和華說：上希伯崙去。
english: Now after this, David, questioning the Lord, said, Am I to go up into any of the towns of Judah? And the Lord said to him, Go up. And David said, Where am I to go? And he said, To Hebron.

chinese: 於是大衛和他的兩個妻─一個是耶斯列人亞希暖，一個是作過迦密人拿八妻的亞比該─都上那裡去了。
english: So David went there, taking with him his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail, the wife of Nabal of Carmel.

chinese: 大衛也將跟隨他的人和他們各人的眷屬一同帶上去，住在希伯崙的城邑中。
english: And David took all his men with him, every man with his family: and they were living in the towns round Hebron.

chinese: 猶大人來到希伯崙，在那裡膏大衛作猶大家的王。有人告訴大衛說：葬埋掃羅的是基列雅比人。
english: And the men of Judah came there, and with the holy oil made David king over the people of Judah. And word came to David that it was the men of Jabesh-gilead who put Saul's body in its last resting-place.

chinese: 大衛就差人去見基列雅比人，對他們說：你們厚待你們的主─掃羅，將他葬埋。願耶和華賜福與你們！
english: And David sent to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to them, May the Lord give you his blessing, because you have done this kind act to Saul your lord, and have put his body to rest!

chinese: 你們既行了這事，願耶和華以慈愛誠實待你們，我也要為此厚待你們。
english: May the Lord be good and true to you: and I myself will see that your kind act is rewarded, because you have done this thing.

chinese: 現在你們的主─掃羅死了，猶大家已經膏我作他們的王，所以你們要剛強奮勇。
english: Then let your hands be strong, and have no fear: though Saul your lord is dead, the people of Judah have made me their king.

chinese: 掃羅的元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥，曾將掃羅的兒子伊施波設帶過河，到瑪哈念，
english: Now Abner, the son of Ner, captain of Saul's army, had taken Saul's son Ish-bosheth over to Mahanaim,

chinese: 立他作王，治理基列、亞書利、耶斯列、以法蓮、便雅憫，和以色列眾人。
english: And made him king over Gilead and the Asherites and over Jezreel and Ephraim and Benjamin, that is, over all Israel.

chinese: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設登基的時候年四十歲，作以色列王二年；惟獨猶大家歸從大衛。
english: (Saul's son Ish-bosheth was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he was ruler for two years.) But Judah was on the side of David.

chinese: 大衛在希伯崙作猶大家的王，共七年零六個月。
english: And the time when David was king in Hebron over the people of Judah was seven years and six months.

chinese: 尼珥的兒子押尼珥和掃羅的兒子伊施波設的僕人從瑪哈念出來，往基遍去。
english: And Abner, the son of Ner, with the servants of Saul's son Ish-bosheth, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

chinese: 洗魯雅的兒子約押和大衛的僕人也出來，在基遍池旁與他們相遇；一班坐在池這邊，一班坐在池那邊。
english: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out and came face to face with them by the pool of Gibeon; and they took up their position, facing one another on opposite sides of the pool.

chinese: 押尼珥對約押說：讓少年人起來，在我們面前戲耍罷！約押說：可以。
english: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men give a test of their strength before us. And Joab said, Let them do so.

chinese: 就按著定數起來：屬掃羅兒子伊施波設的便雅憫人過去十二名，大衛的僕人也過去十二名，
english: So they got up and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth and twelve of the servants of David.

chinese: 彼此揪頭，用刀刺肋，一同仆倒。所以，那地叫作希利甲哈素林，就在基遍。
english: And every one got the other by the head, driving his sword into the other's side, so they all went down together: and that place was named the Field of Sides, and it is in Gibeon.

chinese: 那日的戰事凶猛，押尼珥和以色列人敗在大衛的僕人面前。
english: And there was hard fighting that day; and Abner and the men of Israel gave way before the servants of David.

chinese: 在那裡有洗魯雅的三個兒子：約押、亞比篩、亞撒黑。亞撒黑腳快如野鹿一般；
english: There were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab and Abishai and Asahel: and Asahel was as quick-footed as a roe of the fields.

chinese: 亞撒黑追趕押尼珥，直追趕他不偏左右。
english: Asahel went running after Abner, not turning to the right or to the left.

chinese: 押尼珥回頭說：你是亞撒黑麼？回答說：是。
english: Then Abner, looking back, said, Is it you, Asahel? And he said, It is I.

chinese: 押尼珥對他說：你或轉向左轉向右，拿住一個少年人，剝去他的戰衣。亞撒黑卻不肯轉開不追趕他。
english: And Abner said, Then go to the right or to the left and put your hands on one of the fighting-men and take his arms. But Asahel would not be turned away from going after Abner.

chinese: 押尼珥又對亞撒黑說：你轉開不追趕我罷！我何必殺你呢？若殺你，有甚麼臉見你哥哥約押呢？
english: Then again Abner said to Asahel, Go to one side, do not keep on coming after me: why will you make me put an end to you? for then I will be shamed before your brother Joab.

chinese: 亞撒黑仍不肯轉開。故此，押尼珥就用槍鐏刺入他的肚腹，甚至槍從背後透出，亞撒黑就在那裡仆倒而死。眾人趕到亞撒黑仆倒而死的地方，就都站住。
english: But still he did not go to one side: so Abner gave him a back blow in the stomach with his spear, so that the spear came out at his back; and he went down on the earth, wounded to death: and all those who came to the place where Asahel went down dead, came to a stop.

chinese: 約押和亞比篩追趕押尼珥，日落的時候，到了通基遍曠野的路旁，基亞對面的亞瑪山。
english: But Joab and Abishai went after Abner: and the sun went down when they came to the hill of Ammah, which is to the east of the road through the waste land of Geba.

chinese: 便雅憫人聚集，跟隨押尼珥站在一個山頂上。
english: And the men of Benjamin came together after Abner in one band, and took their places on the top of a hill.

chinese: 押尼珥呼叫約押說：刀劍豈可永遠殺人麼？你豈不知終久必有苦楚麼？你要等何時才叫百姓回去、不追趕弟兄呢？
english: Then crying out to Joab, Abner said, Are fighting and destruction to go on for ever? do you not see that the end will only be bitter? how long will it be before you send the people back and make them give up attacking their countrymen?

chinese: 約押說：我指著永生的神起誓：你若不說戲耍的那句話，今日早晨百姓就回去，不追趕弟兄了。
english: And Joab said, By the living God, if you had not given the word, the people would have gone on attacking their countrymen till the morning.

chinese: 於是約押吹角，眾民就站住，不再追趕以色列人，也不再打仗了。
english: So Joab had a horn sounded, and all the people came to a stop, and gave up going after Israel and fighting them.

chinese: 押尼珥和跟隨他的人整夜經過亞拉巴，過約但河，走過畢倫，到了瑪哈念。
english: And all that night Abner and his men went through the Arabah; they went over Jordan and through all Bithron and came to Mahanaim.

chinese: 約押追趕押尼珥回來，聚集眾民，見大衛的僕人中缺少了十九個人和亞撒黑。
english: And Joab came back from fighting Abner: and when he had got all his men together, it was seen that nineteen of David's men, in addition to Asahel, were not with them.

chinese: 但大衛的僕人殺了便雅憫人和跟隨押尼珥的人，共三百六十名。
english: But David's men had put to death three hundred and sixty of the men of Benjamin and of Abner's men

chinese: 眾人將亞撒黑送到伯利恆，葬在他父親的墳墓裡。約押和跟隨他的人走了一夜，天亮的時候到了希伯崙。
english: And they took Asahel's body and put it in the last resting-place of his father in Beth-lehem. And Joab and his men, travelling all night, came to Hebron at dawn.

chinese: 掃羅家和大衛家爭戰許久。大衛家日見強盛；掃羅家日見衰弱。
english: Now there was a long war between Saul's people and David's people; and David became stronger and stronger, but those on Saul's side became more and more feeble.

chinese: 大衛在希伯崙得了幾個兒子：長子暗嫩是耶斯列人亞希暖所生的；
english: While David was in Hebron he became the father of sons: the oldest was Amnon, son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;

chinese: 次子基利押（在歷代上三章一節作但以利）是作過迦密人拿八的妻亞比該所生的；三子押沙龍是基述王達買的女兒瑪迦所生的；
english: And the second, Chileab, whose mother was Abigail, the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom, son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur;

chinese: 四子亞多尼雅是哈及所生的；五子示法提雅是亞比他所生的；
english: And the fourth, Adonijah, the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah, the son of Abital;

chinese: 六子以特念是大衛的妻以格拉所生的。大衛這六個兒子都是在希伯崙生的。
english: And the sixth, Ithream, whose mother was David's wife Eglah. These were the sons of David, whose birth took place in Hebron.

chinese: 掃羅家和大衛家爭戰的時候，押尼珥在掃羅家大有權勢。
english: Now while there was war between Saul's people and David's people, Abner was making himself strong among the supporters of Saul.

chinese: 掃羅有一妃嬪，名叫利斯巴，是愛亞的女兒。一日，伊施波設對押尼珥說：你為甚麼與我父的妃嬪同房呢？
english: Now Saul had among his wives a woman named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Why have you taken my father's wife?

chinese: 押尼珥因伊施波設的話就甚發怒，說：我豈是猶大的狗頭呢？我恩待你父掃羅的家和他的弟兄、朋友，不將你交在大衛手裡，今日你竟為這婦人責備我麼？
english: And Abner was very angry at the words of Ish-bosheth, and he said, Am I a dog's head of Judah? I am this day doing all in my power for the cause of your father Saul and for his brothers and his friends, and have not given you up into the hands of David, and now you say I have done wrong with a woman.

chinese: 我若不照著耶和華起誓應許大衛的話行，廢去掃羅的位，建立大衛的位，使他治理以色列和猶大，從但直到別是巴，願神重重地降罰與我！
english: May God's punishment be on Abner, if I do not for David as the Lord in his oath has said,
And if I do not take away the kingdom from the family of Saul and make David ruler over Israel and Judah from Dan as far as Beer-sheba!

chinese: 伊施波設懼怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。
english: And so great was Ish-bosheth's fear of Abner that he was not able to say a word in answer.

chinese: 押尼珥打發人去見大衛，替他說：這國歸誰呢？又說：你與我立約，我必幫助你，使以色列人都歸服你。
english: And Abner sent men to David at Hebron, saying, Make an agreement with me, and I will give you my support in getting all Israel on your side.

chinese: 大衛說：好！我與你立約。但有一件，你來見我面的時候，若不將掃羅的女兒米甲帶來，必不得見我的面。
english: And he said, It is well; I will make an agreement with you, but on one condition, which is, that when you come before me, Saul's daughter Michal is to come with you; till she comes you will not see my face.

chinese: 大衛就打發人去見掃羅的兒子伊施波設，說：你要將我的妻米甲歸還我；他是我從前用一百非利士人的陽皮所聘定的。
english: And David sent men to Saul's son Ish-bosheth, saying, Give me back Michal, my wife, whom I made mine for the price of the private parts of a hundred Philistines.

chinese: 伊施波設就打發人去，將米甲從拉億的兒子、他丈夫帕鐵那裡接回來。
english: So Ish-bosheth sent and took her from her husband Paltiel, the son of Laish.

chinese: 米甲的丈夫跟著他，一面走一面哭，直跟到巴戶琳。押尼珥說：你回去罷！帕鐵就回去了。
english: And her husband went with her as far as Bahurim, weeping while he went. Then Abner said to him, Go back. And he went back.

chinese: 押尼珥對以色列長老說：從前你們願意大衛作王治理你們，
english: Then Abner had a talk with the chief men of Israel, saying, In the past it was your desire to make David your king: so now, do it:

chinese: 現在你們可以照心願而行。因為耶和華曾論到大衛說：我必藉我僕人大衛的手，救我民以色列脫離非利士人和眾仇敵的手。
english: For the Lord has said of David, By the hand of my servant David I will make my people Israel safe from the Philistines, and from all who are against them.

chinese: 押尼珥也用這話說給便雅憫人聽，又到希伯崙，將以色列人和便雅憫全家一切所喜悅的事說給大衛聽。
english: And Abner said the same things to Benjamin: and he went to David in Hebron to make clear to him what seemed good to Israel and to all the people of Benjamin.

chinese: 押尼珥帶著二十個人來到希伯崙見大衛，大衛就為押尼珥和他帶來的人設擺筵席。
english: So Abner, with twenty men, came to Hebron, to David. And David made a feast for Abner and the men who were with him.

chinese: 押尼珥對大衛說：我要起身去招聚以色列眾人來見我主我王，與你立約，你就可以照著心願作王。於是大衛送押尼珥去，押尼珥就平平安安地去了。
english: And Abner said to David, Now I will go, and make all Israel come to my lord the king, so that they may make an agreement with you, and your kingdom may be as wide as your heart's desire. Then David sent Abner away and he went in peace.

chinese: 約押和大衛的僕人攻擊敵軍，帶回許多的掠物。那時押尼珥不在希伯崙大衛那裡，因大衛已經送他去，他也平平安安地去了。
english: Now the servants of David and Joab had been out attacking a band of armed men, and they came back with a great store of goods taken in the fight: but Abner was no longer in Hebron with David, for he had sent him away and he had gone in peace.

chinese: 約押和跟隨他的全軍到了，就有人告訴約押說：尼珥的兒子押尼珥來見王，王送他去，他也平平安安地去了。
english: When Joab and his men came, news was given them that Abner, the son of Ner, had come to the king, who had let him go away again in peace.

chinese: 約押去見王說：你這是做甚麼呢？押尼珥來見你，你為何送他去，他就蹤影不見了呢？
english: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What have you done? when Abner came to you why did you send him away and let him go?

chinese: 你當曉得，尼珥的兒子押尼珥來是要誆哄你，要知道你的出入和你一切所行的事。
english: Is it not clear to you that Abner, the son of Ner, came with deceit to get knowledge of your going out and your coming in and of all you are doing?

chinese: 約押從大衛那裡出來，就打發人去追趕押尼珥，在西拉井追上他，將他帶回來，大衛卻不知道。
english: And when Joab had come out from David, he sent men after Abner, and they overtook him at the water-spring of Sirah, and made him come back with them: but David had no knowledge of it.

chinese: 押尼珥回到希伯崙，約押領他到城門的甕洞，假作要與他說機密話，就在那裡刺透他的肚腹，他便死了。這是報殺他兄弟亞撒黑的仇。
english: And when Abner was back in Hebron, Joab took him on one side by the doorway of the town to have a word with him quietly, and there he gave him a wound in the stomach, causing his death in payment for the death of his brother Asahel.

chinese: 大衛聽見了，就說：流尼珥的兒子押尼珥的血，這罪在耶和華面前必永不歸我和我的國。
english: And when David had word of it he said, May I and my kingdom be clear for ever in the eyes of the Lord from the blood of Abner, the son of Ner:

chinese: 願流他血的罪歸到約押頭上和他父的全家；又願約押家不斷有患漏症的，長大痲瘋的，架柺而行的，被刀殺死的，缺乏飲食的。
english: May it come on the head of Joab and all his father's family: among the men of Joab's family may there ever be some who are diseased or lepers, or who do the work of women, or are put to the sword, or are wasted from need of food!

chinese: 約押和他兄弟亞比篩殺了押尼珥，是因押尼珥在基遍爭戰的時候殺了他們的兄弟亞撒黑。
english: So Joab and Abishai his brother put Abner to death, because he had put to death their brother Asahel in the fight at Gibeon.

chinese: 大衛吩咐約押和跟隨他的眾人說：你們當撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥棺前哀哭。大衛王也跟在棺後。
english: And David said to Joab and all the people who were with him, Go in grief and put haircloth about you, in sorrow for Abner. And King David went after the dead body.

chinese: 他們將押尼珥葬在希伯崙。王在押尼珥的墓旁放聲而哭，眾民也都哭了。
english: And they put Abner's body to rest in Hebron; and the king and all the people were weeping loudly by the resting-place of Abner's body.

chinese: 王為押尼珥舉哀，說：押尼珥何竟像愚頑人死呢？
english: And the king made a song of grief for Abner and said, Was the death of Abner to be like the death of a foolish man?

chinese: 你手未曾捆綁，腳未曾鎖住。你死，如人死在罪孽之輩手下一樣。於是眾民又為押尼珥哀哭。
english: Your hands were free, your feet were not chained: like the downfall of a man before evil men, so was your fall. And the weeping of the people over him went on again.

chinese: 日頭未落的時候，眾民來勸大衛吃飯，但大衛起誓說：我若在日頭未落以前吃飯，或吃別物，願神重重地降罰與我！
english: And the people came to make David take food, while it was still day, but David with an oath said, May God's punishment be on me if I take a taste of bread or any other thing till the sun has gone down!

chinese: 眾民知道了就都喜悅。凡王所行的，眾民無不喜悅。
english: And all the people took note of it and were pleased: like everything the king did, it was pleasing to the people.

chinese: 那日，以色列眾民才知道殺尼珥的兒子押尼珥並非出於王意。
english: So it was clear to Israel and to all the people on that day that the king was not responsible for the death of Abner, the son of Ner.

chinese: 王對臣僕說：你們豈不知今日以色列人中死了一個作元帥的大丈夫麼？
english: And the king said to his servants, Do you not see that a chief and a great man has come to his end today in Israel?

chinese: 我雖然受膏為王，今日還是軟弱；這洗魯雅的兩個兒子比我剛強。願耶和華照著惡人所行的惡報應他。
english: While I, though I am crowned king, have little strength, and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are out of my control: may the Lord give to the evil-doer the reward of his evil-doing!

chinese: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設聽見押尼珥死在希伯崙，手就發軟；以色列眾人也都驚惶
english: And when Saul's son Ish-bosheth had news that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

chinese: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設有兩個軍長，一名巴拿，一名利甲，是便雅憫支派、比錄人臨門的兒子。比錄也屬便雅憫。
english: And Saul's son had two men, captains of bands, one named Baanah and the other Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the tribe of Benjamin; (for Beeroth was at one time taken to be part of Benjamin:

chinese: 比錄人早先逃到基他音，在那裡寄居，直到今日。
english: But the people of Beeroth had gone in flight to Gittaim, where they have been living to this day.)

chinese: 掃羅的兒子約拿單有一個兒子名叫米非波設，是瘸腿的。掃羅和約拿單死亡的消息從耶斯列傳到的時候，他才五歲。他乳母抱著他逃跑；因為跑得太急，孩子掉在地上，腿就瘸了。
english: Now Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son whose feet were damaged. He was five years old when news of the death of Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel, and the woman who took care of him took him up and went in flight: and while she was getting him away as quickly as she was able, he had a fall and his feet were damaged. His name was Mephibosheth.

chinese: 一日，比錄人臨門的兩個兒子利甲和巴拿出去，約在午熱的時候到了伊施波設的家；伊施波設正睡午覺。
english: And Rechab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, went out and came to the house of Ish-bosheth in the heat of the day, when he was resting in the middle of the day. Now the woman who kept the door was cleaning grain, and sleep overcame her.

chinese: 他們進了房子，假作要取麥子，就刺透伊施波設的肚腹，逃跑了。
english: And Rechab and his brother Baanah got in without being seen.

chinese: 他們進房子的時候，伊施波設正在臥房裡躺在床上，他們將他殺死，割了他的首級，拿著首級在亞拉巴走了一夜，
english: And when they came into the house, Ish-bosheth was stretched on his bed in his bedroom; and they made an attack on him and put him to death, and, cutting off his head, they took it with them and went by the road through the Arabah all night.

chinese: 將伊施波設的首級拿到希伯崙見大衛王，說：王的仇敵掃羅曾尋索王的性命。看哪，這是他兒子伊施波設的首級；耶和華今日為我主我王在掃羅和他後裔的身上報了仇。
english: And they took the head of Ish-bosheth to David in Hebron, and said to the king, Here is the head of Ish-bosheth, the son of Saul your hater, who would have taken your life; the Lord has taken payment for the wrongs of my lord the king from Saul and his seed today.

chinese: 大衛對比錄人臨門的兒子利甲和他兄弟巴拿說：我指著救我性命脫離一切苦難、永生的耶和華起誓：
english: And David made answer to Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, By the living Lord, who has kept me safe from all my trouble,

chinese: 從前有人報告我說，掃羅死了，他自以為報好消息；我就拿住他，將他殺在洗革拉，這就作了他報消息的賞賜。
english: When one came to me with the news of Saul's death, in the belief that it would be good news, I took him and put him to death in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news:

chinese: 何況惡人將義人殺在他的床上，我豈不向你們討流他血的罪、從世上除滅你們呢？
english: How much more, when evil men have put an upright person to death, in his house, sleeping on his bed, will I take payment from you for his blood, and have you cut off from the earth?

chinese: 於是大衛吩咐少年人將他們殺了，砍斷他們的手腳，掛在希伯崙的池旁，卻將伊施波設的首級葬在希伯崙押尼珥的墳墓裡。
english: And David gave orders to his young men and they put them to death, cutting off their hands and their feet and hanging them up by the side of the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth and put it in its last resting-place with Abner's body in Hebron.

chinese: 以色列眾支派來到希伯崙見大衛，說：我們原是你的骨肉。
english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David in Hebron and said, Truly, we are your bone and your flesh.

chinese: 從前掃羅作我們王的時候，率領以色列人出入的是你；耶和華也曾應許你說：你必牧養我的民以色列，作以色列的君。
english: In the past when Saul was king over us, it was you who went at the head of Israel when they went out or came in: and the Lord said to you, You are to be the keeper of my people Israel and their ruler.

chinese: 於是以色列的長老都來到希伯崙見大衛王，大衛在希伯崙耶和華面前與他們立約，他們就膏大衛作以色列的王。
english: So all the responsible men of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and King David made an agreement with them in Hebron before the Lord: and they put the holy oil on David and made him king over Israel.

chinese: 大衛登基的時候年三十歲，在位四十年；
english: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he was king for forty years,

chinese: 在希伯崙作猶大王七年零六個月，在耶路撒冷作以色列和猶大王三十三年。
english: Ruling over Judah in Hebron for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem, over all Israel and Judah, for thirty-three years.

chinese: 大衛和跟隨他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住那地方的耶布斯人。耶布斯人對大衛說：你若不趕出瞎子、瘸子，必不能進這地方；心裡想大衛決不能進去。
english: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the people of the land: and they said to David, You will not come in here, but the blind and the feeble-footed will keep you out; for they said, David will not be able to come in here.

chinese: 然而大衛攻取錫安的保障，就是大衛的城。
english: But David took the strong place of Zion, which is the town of David.

chinese: 當日，大衛說：誰攻打耶布斯人，當上水溝攻打我心裡所恨惡的瘸子、瞎子。從此有俗語說：在那裡有瞎子、瘸子，他不能進屋去。
english: And that day David said, Whoever makes an attack on the Jebusites, let him go up by the water-pipe, and put to death all the blind and feeble-footed who are hated by David. And this is why they say, The blind and feeble-footed may not come into the house.

chinese: 大衛住在保障裡，給保障起名叫大衛城。大衛又從米羅以裡，周圍築牆。
english: So David took the strong tower for his living-place, naming it the town of David. And David took in hand the building of the town all round, starting from the Millo.

chinese: 大衛日見強盛，因為耶和華─萬軍之神與他同在。
english: And David became greater and greater; for the Lord, the God of armies, was with him.

chinese: 推羅王希蘭將香柏木運到大衛那裡，又差遣使者和木匠、石匠給大衛建造宮殿。
english: And Hiram, king of Tyre, sent men to David, with cedar-trees and woodworkers and stoneworkers: and they made David a house.

chinese: 大衛就知道耶和華堅立他作以色列王，又為自己的民以色列使他的國興旺。
english: And David saw that the Lord had made his position safe as king over Israel, and that he had made his kingdom great because of his people Israel.

chinese: 大衛離開希伯崙之後，在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生兒女。
english: And David took more women and wives in Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron: and he had more sons and daughters.

chinese: 在耶路撒冷所生的兒子是沙母亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門、
english: These are the names of those whose birth took place in Jerusalem: Shammua and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon

chinese: 益轄、以利書亞、尼斐、雅非亞、
english: And Ibhar and Elishua and Nepheg and Japhia

chinese: 以利沙瑪、以利雅大、以利法列。
english: And Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet.

chinese: 非利士人聽見人膏大衛作以色列王，非利士人就上來尋索大衛；大衛聽見，就下到保障。
english: And when the Philistines had news that David had been made king over Israel, they all went up in search of David; and David, hearing of it, went down to the strong place.

chinese: 非利士人來了，布散在利乏音谷。
english: And when the Philistines came, they went in every direction in the valley of Rephaim.

chinese: 大衛求問耶和華說：我可以上去攻打非利士人麼？你將他們交在我手裡麼？耶和華說：你可以上去，我必將非利士人交在你手裡。
english: And David, desiring directions from the Lord, said, Am I to go up against the Philistines? will you give them up into my hands? And the Lord said, Go up, for I will certainly give up the Philistines into your hands.

chinese: 大衛來到巴力毗拉心，在那裡擊殺非利士人，說：耶和華在我面前沖破敵人，如同水沖去一般。因此稱那地方為巴力毗拉心。
english: And David went to Baal-perazim, and overcame them there; and he said, The Lord has let the forces fighting against me be broken before me as a wall is broken by rushing waters. So that place was named Baal-perazim.

chinese: 非利士人將偶像撇在那裡，大衛和跟隨他的人拿去了。
english: And the Philistines, when they went in flight, did not take their images with them, and David and his men took them away.

chinese: 非利士人又上來，布散在利乏音谷。
english: And the Philistines came up again, and went in every direction in the valley of Rephaim.

chinese: 大衛求問耶和華；耶和華說：不要一直地上去，要轉到他們後頭，從桑林對面攻打他們。
english: And when David went for directions to the Lord, he said, You are not to go up against them in front; but make a circle round them from the back and come on them opposite the spice-trees.

chinese: 你聽見桑樹梢上有腳步的聲音，就要急速前去，因為那時耶和華已經在你前頭去攻打非利士人的軍隊。
english: Then at the sound of footsteps in the tops of the trees, go forward quickly, for the Lord has gone out before you to overcome the army of the Philistines.

chinese: 大衛就遵著耶和華所吩咐的去行，攻打非利士人，從迦巴直到基色。
english: And David did as the Lord had said; and he overcame the Philistines, attacking them from Gibeon to near Gezer.

chinese: 大衛又聚集以色列中所有挑選的人三萬。
english: And David got together all the fighting-men of Israel to the number of thirty thousand;

chinese: 大衛起身，率領跟隨他的眾人前往，要從巴拉猶大將神的約櫃運來；這約櫃就是坐在二基路伯上萬軍之耶和華留名的約櫃。
english: And David, and all the people who were with him, went to Baal of Judah to get the ark of God, over which the holy name is named, the name of the Lord of armies, whose place is between the winged ones.

chinese: 他們將神的約櫃從岡上亞比拿達的家裡抬出來，放在新車上；亞比拿達的兩個兒子烏撒和亞希約趕這新車。
english: And they put the ark of God on a new cart and took it out of the house of Abinadab which was on the hill: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were the drivers of the cart.

chinese: 他們將神的約櫃從岡上亞比拿達家裡抬出來的時候，亞希約在櫃前行走。
english: And Uzzah went by the side of the ark, while Ahio went before it.

chinese: 大衛和以色列的全家在耶和華面前，用松木製造的各樣樂器和琴、瑟、鼓、鈸、鑼，作樂跳舞。
english: And David and all the men of Israel made melody before the Lord with all their power, with songs and with corded instruments and instruments of brass.

chinese: 到了拿艮的禾場，因為牛失前蹄（或譯：驚跳），烏撒就伸手扶住神的約櫃。
english: And when they came to Nacon's grain-floor, Uzzah put his hand on the ark of God to keep it safe in its place, for the oxen were out of control.

chinese: 神耶和華向烏撒發怒，因這錯誤擊殺他，他就死在神的約櫃旁。
english: And the wrath of the Lord, burning against Uzzah, sent destruction on him because he had put his hand on the ark, and death came to him there by the ark of God.

chinese: 大衛因耶和華擊殺（原文是闖殺）烏撒，心裡愁煩，就稱那地方為毗列斯烏撒，直到今日。
english: And David was angry because of the Lord's outburst of wrath against Uzzah: and he gave that place the name Perez-uzzah, which is its name to this day.

chinese: 那日，大衛懼怕耶和華，說：耶和華的約櫃怎可運到我這裡來？
english: And such was David's fear of the Lord that day, that he said, How may I let the ark of God come to me?

chinese: 於是大衛不肯將耶和華的約櫃運進大衛的城，卻運到迦特人俄別以東的家中。
english: So David did not let the ark of the Lord come back to him to the town of David: but had it turned away and put into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

chinese: 耶和華的約櫃在迦特人俄別以東家中三個月；耶和華賜福給俄別以東和他的全家。
english: And the ark of the Lord was in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months: and the Lord sent a blessing on Obed-edom and all his family.

chinese: 有人告訴大衛王說：耶和華因為約櫃賜福給俄別以東的家和一切屬他的。大衛就去，歡歡喜喜地將神的約櫃從俄別以東家中抬到大衛的城裡。
english: And they said to King David, The blessing of the Lord is on the family of Obed-edom and on all he has, because of the ark of God. And David went and took the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the town of David with joy.

chinese: 抬耶和華約櫃的人走了六步，大衛就獻牛與肥羊為祭。
english: And when those who were lifting the ark of the Lord had gone six steps, he made an offering of an ox and a fat young beast.

chinese: 大衛穿著細麻布的以弗得，在耶和華面前極力跳舞。
english: And David, clothed in a linen ephod, was dancing before the Lord with all his strength.

chinese: 這樣，大衛和以色列的全家歡呼吹角，將耶和華的約櫃抬上來。
english: So David and all the men of Israel took up the ark of the Lord with cries of joy and sounding of horns.

chinese: 耶和華的約櫃進了大衛城的時候，掃羅的女兒米甲從窗戶裡觀看，見大衛王在耶和華面前踴躍跳舞，心裡就輕視他。
english: And when the ark of the Lord came into the town of David, Michal, Saul's daughter, looking out of the window, saw King David dancing and jumping before the Lord; and to her mind he seemed foolish.

chinese: 眾人將耶和華的約櫃請進去，安放在所預備的地方，就是在大衛所搭的帳幕裡。大衛在耶和華面前獻燔祭和平安祭。
english: And they took in the ark of the Lord, and put it in its place inside the tent which David had put up for it: and David made burned offerings and peace-offerings to the Lord.

chinese: 大衛獻完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉萬軍之耶和華的名給民祝福，
english: And after David had made the burned offerings and the peace-offerings, he gave the people a blessing in the name of the Lord of armies.

chinese: 並且分給以色列眾人，無論男女，每人一個餅，一塊肉，一個葡萄餅；眾人就各回各家去了。
english: And he gave to every man and woman among all the people, among all the masses of Israel, a cake of bread and a measure of wine and a cake of dry grapes. Then all the people went away, every man to his house.

chinese: 大衛回家要給眷屬祝福；掃羅的女兒米甲出來迎接他，說：以色列王今日在臣僕的婢女眼前露體，如同一個輕賤人無恥露體一樣，有好大的榮耀啊！
english: Then David came back to give a blessing to his family. And Michal, Saul's daughter, came out to him and said, How full of glory was the king of Israel today, who let himself be seen uncovered by his servant-girls like a foolish person uncovering himself without shame!

chinese: 大衛對米甲說：這是在耶和華面前；耶和華已揀選我，廢了你父和你父的全家，立我作耶和華民以色列的君，所以我必在耶和華面前跳舞。
english: And David said to Michal, I was dancing before the Lord, who put me over your father and all his sons, to make me a ruler over the people of the Lord, over his people Israel: and I will go on playing before the Lord;

chinese: 我也必更加卑微，自己看為輕賤。你所說的那些婢女，他們倒要尊敬我。
english: And I will do even worse than this, and make myself even lower in your eyes: but the servant-girls of whom you were talking will give me honour.

chinese: 掃羅的女兒米甲，直到死日，沒有生養兒女。
english: And Michal, Saul's daughter, had no child till the day of her death.

chinese: 王住在自己宮中，耶和華使他安靖，不被四圍的仇敵擾亂。
english: Now when the king was living in his house, and the Lord had given him rest from war on every side;

chinese: 那時，王對先知拿單說：看哪，我住在香柏木的宮中，神的約櫃反在幔子裡。
english: The king said to Nathan the prophet, See now, I am living in a house of cedar, but the ark of God is housed inside the curtains of a tent.

chinese: 拿單對王說：你可以照你的心意而行，因為耶和華與你同在。
english: And Nathan said to the king, Go and do whatever is in your heart; for the Lord is with you.

chinese: 當夜，耶和華的話臨到拿單說：
english: Now that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,

chinese: 你去告訴我僕人大衛，說耶和華如此說：你豈可建造殿宇給我居住呢？
english: Go and say to my servant David, The Lord says, Are you to be the builder of a house, a living-place for me?

chinese: 自從我領以色列人出埃及直到今日，我未曾住過殿宇，常在會幕和帳幕中行走。
english: For from the day when I took the children of Israel up out of Egypt till this day, I have had no house, but have gone from place to place in a tent.

chinese: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列一支派的士師，就是我吩咐牧養我民以色列的說：你們為何不給我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？
english: In all the places where I went with all the children of Israel, did I ever say to any of the judges of Israel, to whom I gave the care of my people Israel, Why have you not made me a house of cedar?

chinese: 現在，你要告訴我僕人大衛，說萬軍之耶和華如此說：我從羊圈中將你召來，叫你不再跟從羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
english: Then say these words to my servant David, The Lord of armies says, I took you from the fields, from keeping the sheep, so that you might be a ruler over my people, over my people Israel:

chinese: 你無論往哪裡去，我常與你同在，剪除你的一切仇敵。我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一樣。
english: And I have been with you wherever you went, cutting off before you all those who were against you; and I will make your name great, like the name of the greatest ones of the earth.

chinese: 我必為我民以色列選定一個地方，栽培他們，使他們住自己的地方，不再遷移；凶惡之子也不像從前擾害他們，
english: And I will make a resting-place for my people Israel, planting them there, so that they may be living in the place which is theirs, and never again be moved; and never again will they be troubled by evil men as they were at the first,

chinese: 並不像我命士師治理我民以色列的時候一樣。我必使你安靖，不被一切仇敵擾亂，並且我─耶和華應許你，必為你建立家室。
english: From the time when I put judges over my people Israel; and I will give you peace from all who are against you. And the Lord says to you that he will make you the head of a line of kings.

chinese: 你壽數滿足、與你列祖同睡的時候，我必使你的後裔接續你的位；我也必堅定他的國。
english: And when the time comes for you to go to rest with your fathers, I will put in your place your seed after you, the offspring of your body, and I will make his kingdom strong.

chinese: 他必為我的名建造殿宇；我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。
english: He will be the builder of a house for my name, and I will make the seat of his authority certain for ever.

chinese: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖責打他，用人的鞭責罰他。
english: I will be to him a father and he will be to me a son: if he does wrong, I will give him punishment with the rod of men and with the blows of the children of men;

chinese: 但我的慈愛仍不離開他，像離開在你面前所廢棄的掃羅一樣。
english: But my mercy will not be taken away from him, as I took it from him who was before you.

chinese: 你的家和你的國必在我（原文是你）面前永遠堅立。你的國位也必堅定，直到永遠。
english: And your family and your kingdom will keep their place before me for ever: the seat of your authority will never be overturned.

chinese: 拿單就按這一切話，照這默示，告訴大衛。
english: So Nathan gave David an account of all these words and this vision.

chinese: 於是大衛王進去，坐在耶和華面前，說：主耶和華啊，我是誰？我的家算甚麼？你竟使我到這地步呢？
english: Then David the king went in and took his seat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have been my guide till now?

chinese: 主耶和華啊，這在你眼中還看為小，又應許你僕人的家至於久遠。主耶和華啊，這豈是人所常遇的事麼？
english: And this was only a small thing to you, O Lord God; but your words have even been about the far-off future of your servant's family, O Lord God!

chinese: 主耶和華啊，我還有何言可以對你說呢？因為你知道你的僕人。
english: What more may David say to you? for you have knowledge of your servant, O Lord God.

chinese: 你行這大事使僕人知道，是因你所應許的話，也是照你的心意。
english: Because of your word and from your heart, you have done all this great work, and let your servant see it.

chinese: 主耶和華啊，你本為大，照我們耳中聽見，沒有可比你的；除你以外再無神。
english: Truly you are great, O Lord God: there is no one like you and no other God but you, as is clear from everything which has come to our ears.

chinese: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你從埃及救贖他們作自己的子民，又在你贖出來的民面前行大而可畏的事，驅逐列邦人和他們的神，顯出你的大名。
english: And what other nation in the earth, like your people Israel, did a god go out to take for himself, to be his people, and to make a name for himself, and to do great and strange things for them, driving out a nation and its gods from before his people?

chinese: 你曾堅立你的民以色列作你的子民，直到永遠；你─耶和華也作了他們的神。
english: But you took and made strong for yourself your people Israel, to be your people for ever; and you, Lord, became their God.

chinese: 耶和華神啊，你所應許僕人和僕人家的話，求你堅定，直到永遠；照你所說的而行。
english: And now, O Lord God, may the word which you have said about your servant and about his family, be made certain for ever, and may you do as you have said!

chinese: 願人永遠尊你的名為大，說：萬軍之耶和華是治理以色列的神。這樣，你僕人大衛的家必在你面前堅立。
english: And let your name be made great for ever, and let men say, The Lord of armies is God over Israel: and let the family of David your servant be made strong before you!

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神啊，因你啟示你的僕人說：我必為你建立家室，所以僕人大膽向你如此祈禱。
english: For you, O Lord of armies, the God of Israel, have clearly said to your servant, I will make you the head of a family of kings: and so it has come into your servant's heart to make this prayer to you.

chinese: 主耶和華啊，惟有你是神。你的話是真實的；你也應許將這福氣賜給僕人。
english: And now, O Lord God, you are God and your words are true and you have said you will give your servant this good thing;

chinese: 現在求你賜福與僕人的家，可以永存在你面前。主耶和華啊，這是你所應許的。願你永遠賜福與僕人的家！
english: So may it be your pleasure to give your blessing to the family of your servant, so that it may go on for ever before you: (for you, O Lord God, have said it,) and may your blessing be on your servant's family line for ever!

chinese: 此後，大衛攻打非利士人，把他們治服，從他們手下奪取了京城的權柄（原文是母城的嚼環）；
english: And it came about after this that David made an attack on the Philistines and overcame them; and David took the authority of the mother-town from the hands of the Philistines.

chinese: 又攻打摩押人，使他們躺臥在地上，用繩量一量：量二繩的殺了，量一繩的存留。摩押人就歸服大衛，給他進貢。
english: And he overcame the Moabites, and he had them measured with a line when they were stretched out on the earth; marking out two lines for death and one full line for life. So the Moabites became servants to David and gave him offerings.

chinese: 瑣巴王利合的兒子哈大底謝往大河去，要奪回他的國權。大衛就攻打他，
english: And David overcame Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to make his power seen by the River.

chinese: 擒拿了他的馬兵一千七百，步兵二萬，將拉戰車的馬砍斷蹄筋，但留下一百輛車.的馬。
english: And David took from him one thousand, seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen: and David had the leg-muscles of the horses cut, only keeping enough of them for a hundred war-carriages.

chinese: 大馬色的亞蘭人來幫助瑣巴王哈大底謝，大衛就殺了亞蘭人二萬二千。
english: And when the Aramaeans of Damascus came to the help of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, David put to the sword twenty-two thousand of the Aramaeans.

chinese: 於是大衛在大馬色的亞蘭地設立防營，亞蘭人就歸服他，給他進貢。大衛無論往哪裡去，耶和華都使他得勝。
english: And David put armed forces in Aram of Damascus: and the Aramaeans became servants to David and gave him offerings. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.

chinese: 他奪了哈大底謝臣僕所拿的金盾牌，帶到耶路撒冷。
english: And David took their gold body-covers from the servants of Hadadezer and took them to Jerusalem.

chinese: 大衛王又從屬哈大底謝的比他和比羅他城中奪取了許多的銅。
english: And from Tebah and Berothai, towns of Hadadezer, King David took a great store of brass.

chinese: 哈馬王陀以聽見大衛殺敗哈大底謝的全軍，
english: And when Tou, king of Hamath, had news that David had overcome all the army of Hadadezer,

chinese: 就打發他兒子約蘭去見大衛王，問他的安，為他祝福，因為他殺敗了哈大底謝（原來陀以與哈大底謝常常爭戰）。約蘭帶了金銀銅的器皿來，
english: He sent his son Hadoram to David, with words of peace and blessing, because he had overcome Hadadezer in the fight, for Hadadezer had wars with Tou; and Hadoram took with him vessels of silver and gold and brass:

chinese: 大衛王將這些器皿和他治服各國所得來的金銀都分別為聖，獻給耶和華，
english: These King David made holy to the Lord, together with the silver and gold which he had taken from the nations he had overcome--

chinese: 就是從亞蘭、摩押、亞捫、非利士、亞瑪力人所得來的，以及從瑣巴王利合的兒子哈大底謝所掠之物。
english: The nations of Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon and the Philistines and the Amalekites and the goods he had taken from Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

chinese: 大衛在鹽谷擊殺了亞蘭（或譯：以東，見詩篇六十篇詩題）一萬八千人回來，就得了大名；
english: And David got great honour for himself, when he came back, by the destruction of Edom in the valley of Salt, to the number of eighteen thousand men.

chinese: 又在以東全地設立防營，以東人就都歸服大衛。大衛無論往哪裡去，耶和華都使他得勝。
english: And he put armed forces in Edom; all through Edom he had armed forces stationed, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.

chinese: 大衛作以色列眾人的王，又向眾民秉公行義。
english: And David was king over all Israel, judging and giving right decisions for all his people.

chinese: 洗魯雅的兒子約押作元帥；亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官；
english: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the army; and Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was keeper of the records;

chinese: 亞希突的兒子撒督和亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒作祭司長；西萊雅作書記；
english: And Zadok and Abiathar, the son of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, were priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

chinese: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅統轄基利提人和比利提人。大衛的眾子都作領袖。
english: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were priests.

chinese: 大衛問說：掃羅家還有剩下的人沒有？我要因約拿單的緣故向他施恩。
english: And David said, Is there still anyone of Saul's family living, so that I may be a friend to him, because of Jonathan?

chinese: 掃羅家有一個僕人，名叫洗巴，有人叫他來見大衛，王問他說：你是洗巴麼。回答說：僕人是。
english: Now there was of Saul's people a servant named Ziba, and they sent him to David; and the king said to him, Are you Ziba? And he said, I am.

chinese: 王說：掃羅家還有人沒有？我要照神的慈愛恩待他。洗巴對王說：還有約拿單的一個兒子，是瘸腿的。
english: And the king said, Is there anyone of Saul's family still living, to whom I may be a friend in God's name? And Ziba said, There is a son of Jonathan, whose feet are damaged.

chinese: 王說：他在哪裡？洗巴對王說：他在羅底巴，亞米利的兒子瑪吉家裡。
english: And the king said to him, Where is he? And Ziba said to the king, He is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.

chinese: 於是大衛王打發人去，從羅底巴亞米利的兒子瑪吉家裡召了他來。
english: Then King David sent, and had him taken from Lo-debar, from the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel.

chinese: 掃羅的孫子、約拿單的兒子米非波設來見大衛，伏地叩拜。大衛說：米非波設！米非波設說：僕人在此。
english: And Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, came to David, and falling down on his face, gave him honour. And David said, Mephibosheth. And answering he said, Your servant is here.

chinese: 大衛說：你不要懼怕，我必因你父親約拿單的緣故施恩與你，將你祖父掃羅的一切田地都歸還你；你也可以常與我同席吃飯。
english: And David said to him, Have no fear: for truly I will be good to you, because of your father Jonathan, and I will give back to you all the land which was Saul's; and you will have a place at my table at all times.

chinese: 米非波設又叩拜，說：僕人算甚麼，不過如死狗一般，竟蒙王這樣眷顧！
english: And he went down on his face before the king, and said, What is your servant, for you to take note of a dead dog such as I am?

chinese: 王召了掃羅的僕人洗巴來，對他說：我已將屬掃羅和他的一切家產都賜給你主人的兒子了。
english: Then the king sent for Ziba, Saul's servant, and said to him, All the property of Saul and of his family I have given to your master's son.

chinese: 你和你的眾子、僕人要為你主人的兒子米非波設耕種田地，把所產的拿來供他食用；他卻要常與我同席吃飯。洗巴有十五個兒子，二十個僕人。
english: And you and your sons and your servants are to take care of the land for him, and get in the fruit of it, so that your master's son may have food: but Mephibosheth, your master's son, will have a place at my table at all times. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

chinese: 洗巴對王說：凡我主我王吩咐僕人的，僕人都必遵行。王又說：米非波設必與我同席吃飯，如王的兒子一樣。
english: Then Ziba said to the king, Every order which you have given to your servant will be done. As for Mephibosheth, he had a place at David's table, like one of the king's sons.

chinese: 米非波設有一個小兒子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家裡的人都作了米非波設的僕人。
english: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica. And all the people living in the house of Ziba were servants to Mephibosheth.

chinese: 於是米非波設住在耶路撒冷，常與王同席吃飯。他兩腿都是瘸的。
english: So Mephibosheth went on living in Jerusalem; for he took all his meals at the king's table; and he had not the use of his feet.

chinese: 此後，亞捫人的王死了，他兒子哈嫩接續他作王。
english: Now after this, death came to the king of the children of Ammon, and Hanun, his son, became king in his place.

chinese: 大衛說：我要照哈嫩的父親拿轄厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。於是大衛差遣臣僕，為他喪父安慰他。大衛的臣僕到了亞捫人的境內。
english: And David said, I will be a friend to Hanun, the son of Nahash, as his father was a friend to me. So David sent his servants, to give him words of comfort on account of his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

chinese: 但亞捫人的首領對他們的主哈嫩說：大衛差人來安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父親麼？他差臣僕來不是詳察窺探、要傾覆這城麼？
english: But the chiefs of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, Does it seem to you that David is honouring your father by sending comforters to you? has he not sent his servants to go through the town and make secret observation of it, and overcome it?

chinese: 哈嫩便將大衛臣僕的鬍鬚剃去一半，又割斷他們下半截的衣服，使他們露出下體，打發他們回去。
english: So Hanun took David's servants, and after cutting off half the hair on their chins, and cutting off the skirts of their robes up to the middle, he sent them away.

chinese: 有人告訴大衛，他就差人去迎接他們，（因為他們甚覺羞恥），告訴他們說：可以住在耶利哥，等到鬍鬚長起再回來。
english: When David had news of it, he sent men out with the purpose of meeting them on their way, for the men were greatly shamed: and the king said, Go to Jericho till your hair is long again, and then come back.

chinese: 亞捫人知道大衛憎惡他們，就打發人去，招募伯利合的亞蘭人和瑣巴的亞蘭人，步兵二萬，與瑪迦王的人一千、陀伯人一萬二千。
english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves hated by David, they sent to the Aramaeans of Beth-rehob and Zobah, and got for payment twenty thousand footmen, and they got from the king of Maacah a thousand men, and from Tob twelve thousand.

chinese: 大衛聽見了，就差派約押統帶勇猛的全軍出去。
english: And hearing of this, David sent Joab and all the army and the best fighting-men.

chinese: 亞捫人出來，在城門前擺陣；瑣巴與利合的亞蘭人、陀伯人，並瑪迦人，另在郊野擺陣。
english: And the children of Ammon came out and put their forces in position at the way into the town: and the Aramaeans of Zobah and of Rehob, with the men of Tob and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

chinese: 約押看見敵人在他前後擺陣，就從以色列軍中挑選精兵，使他們對著亞蘭人擺陣。
english: Now when Joab saw that their forces were in position against him in front and at his back, he took the best of the men of Israel and put them in line against the Aramaeans;

chinese: 其餘的兵交與他兄弟亞比篩，對著亞捫人擺陣。
english: And the rest of the people he put in position against the children of Ammon, with Abishai, his brother, at their head.

chinese: 約押對亞比篩說：亞蘭人若強過我，你就來幫助我；亞捫人若強過你，我就去幫助你。
english: And he said, If the Aramaeans are stronger and get the better of me, then you are to come to my help; but if the children of Ammon get the better of you, I will come to your help.

chinese: 我們都當剛強，為本國的民和神的城邑作大丈夫。願耶和華憑他的意旨而行！
english: Take heart, and let us be strong for our people and for the towns of our God, and may the Lord do what seems good to him.

chinese: 於是，約押和跟隨他的人前進攻打亞蘭人；亞蘭人在約押面前逃跑。
english: Then Joab and the people with him went forward to the fight against the Aramaeans, and they went in flight before him.

chinese: 亞捫人見亞蘭人逃跑，他們也在亞比篩面前逃跑進城。約押就離開亞捫人那裡，回耶路撒冷去了。
english: And when the children of Ammon saw the flight of the Aramaeans, they themselves went in flight from Abishai, and came into the town. So Joab went back from fighting the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.

chinese: 亞蘭人見自己被以色列人打敗，就又聚集。
english: And when the Aramaeans saw that Israel had overcome them, they got themselves together.

chinese: 哈大底謝差遣人，將大河那邊的亞蘭人調來；他們到了希蘭，哈大底謝的將軍朔法率領他們。
english: And Hadadezer sent for the Aramaeans who were on the other side of the River: and they came to Helam, with Shobach, the captain of Hadadezer's army, at their head.

chinese: 有人告訴大衛，他就聚集以色列眾人，過約但河，來到希蘭。亞蘭人迎著大衛擺陣，與他打仗。
english: And word of this was given to David: and he got all Israel together and went over Jordan and came to Helam. And the Aramaeans put their forces in position against David, and made an attack on him.

chinese: 亞蘭人在以色列人面前逃跑；大衛殺了亞蘭七百輛戰車的人，四萬馬兵，又殺了亞蘭的將軍朔法。
english: And the Aramaeans went in flight before Israel; and David put to the sword the men of seven hundred Aramaean war-carriages and forty thousand footmen, and Shobach, the captain of the army, was wounded, and came to his death there.

chinese: 屬哈大底謝的諸王見自己被以色列人打敗，就與以色列人和好，歸服他們。於是亞蘭人不敢再幫助亞捫人了。
english: And when all the kings who were servants of Hadadezer saw that they were overcome by Israel, they made peace with Israel and became their servants. So the Aramaeans, in fear, gave no more help to the children of Ammon.

chinese: 過了一年，到列王出戰的時候，大衛又差派約押，率領臣僕和以色列眾人出戰。他們就打敗亞捫人，圍攻拉巴。大衛仍住在耶路撒冷。
english: Now in the spring, at the time when kings go out to war, David sent Joab and his servants and all Israel with him; and they made waste the land of the children of Ammon, and took up their position before Rabbah, shutting it in. But David was still at Jerusalem.

chinese: 一日，太陽平西，大衛從床上起來，在王宮的平頂上遊行，看見一個婦人沐浴，容貌甚美，
english: Now one evening, David got up from his bed, and while he was walking on the roof of the king's house, he saw from there a woman bathing; and the woman was very beautiful.

chinese: 大衛就差人打聽那婦人是誰。有人說：他是以連的女兒，赫人烏利亞的妻拔示巴。
english: And David sent to get knowledge who the woman was. And one said, Is this not Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah the Hittite?

chinese: 大衛差人去，將婦人接來；那時他的月經才得潔淨。他來了，大衛與他同房，他就回家去了。
english: And David sent and took her; and she came to him, and he took her to his bed: (for she had been made clean;) then she went back to her house.

chinese: 於是他懷了孕，打發人去告訴大衛說：我懷了孕。
english: And the woman became with child; and she sent word to David that she was with child.

chinese: 大衛差人到約押那裡，說：你打發赫人烏利亞到我這裡來。約押就打發烏利亞去見大衛。
english: And David sent to Joab saying, Send Uriah the Hittite to me. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

chinese: 烏利亞來了，大衛問約押好，也問兵好，又問爭戰的事怎樣。
english: And when Uriah came to him, David put questions to him about how Joab and the people were, and how the war was going.

chinese: 大衛對烏利亞說：你回家去，洗洗腳罷！烏利亞出了王宮，隨後王送他一分食物。
english: And David said to Uriah, Go down to your house and let your feet be washed. And Uriah went away from the king's house, and an offering from the king was sent after him.

chinese: 烏利亞卻和他主人的僕人一同睡在宮門外，沒有回家去。
english: But Uriah took his rest at the door of the king's house, with all the servants of his lord, and did not go down to his house.

chinese: 有人告訴大衛說：烏利亞沒有回家去。大衛就問烏利亞說：你從遠路上來，為甚麼不回家去呢？
english: And when word was given to David that Uriah had not gone down to his house, David said to Uriah, Have you not come from a journey? why did you not go down to your house?

chinese: 烏利亞對大衛說：約櫃和以色列與猶大兵都住在棚裡，我主約押和我主（或譯：王）的僕人都在田野安營，我豈可回家吃喝、與妻子同寢呢？我敢在王面前起誓（原文是我指著王和王的性命起誓）：我決不行這事！
english: And Uriah said to David, Israel and Judah with the ark are living in tents, and my lord Joab and the other servants of my lord are sleeping in the open field; and am I to go to my house and take food and drink, and go to bed with my wife? By the living Lord, and by the life of your soul, I will not do such a thing.

chinese: 大衛吩咐烏利亞說：你今日仍住在這裡，明日我打發你去。於是烏利亞那日和次日住在耶路撒冷。
english: And David said to Uriah, Be here today, and after that I will let you go. So Uriah was in Jerusalem that day and the day after.

chinese: 大衛召了烏利亞來，叫他在自己面前吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，烏利亞出去與他主的僕人一同住宿，還沒有回到家裡去。
english: And when David sent for him, he took meat and drink with him, and David made him the worse for drink: and when evening came, he went to rest on his bed with the servants of his lord, but he did not go down to his house.

chinese: 次日早晨，大衛寫信與約押，交烏利亞隨手帶去。
english: Now in the morning, David gave Uriah a letter to take to Joab.

chinese: 信內寫著說：要派烏利亞前進，到陣勢極險之處，你們便退後，使他被殺。
english: And in the letter he said, Take care to put Uriah in the very front of the line, where the fighting is most violent, and go back from him, so that he may be overcome and put to death.

chinese: 約押圍城的時候，知道敵人那裡有勇士，便將烏利亞派在那裡。
english: So while Joab was watching the town, he put Uriah in the place where it was clear to him the best fighters were.

chinese: 城裡的人出來和約押打仗；大衛的僕人中有幾個被殺的，赫人烏利亞也死了。
english: And the men of the town went out and had a fight with Joab: and a number of David's men came to their death in the fight, and with them Uriah the Hittite.

chinese: 於是，約押差人去將爭戰的一切事告訴大衛，
english: Then Joab sent David news of everything which had taken place in the war:

chinese: 又囑咐使者說：你把爭戰的一切事對王說完了，
english: And he gave orders to the man who took the news, saying, After you have given the king all the news about the war,

chinese: 王若發怒，問你說：你們打仗為甚麼挨近城牆呢？豈不知敵人必從城上射箭麼？
english: If the king is angry and says, Why did you go so near the town for the fight? was it not certain that their archers would be on the wall?

chinese: 從前打死耶路比設（就是耶路巴力，見士師記九章一節）兒子亞比米勒的是誰呢？豈不是一個婦人從城上拋下一塊上磨石來，打在他身上，他就死在提備斯麼？你們為甚麼挨近城牆呢？你就說：王的僕人─赫人烏利亞也死了。
english: Who put Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, to death? did not a woman send a great stone down on him from the wall, putting him to death at Thebez? why did you go so near the wall? Then say to him, Your servant Uriah the Hittite is among the dead.

chinese: 使者起身，來見大衛，照著約押所吩咐他的話奏告大衛。
english: So the man went, and came to David, and gave him all the news which Joab had sent him to give; then David was angry with Joab and said, Why did you go so near the town for the fight? was it not certain that their archers would be on the wall? who put Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, to death? did not a woman send a great stone down on him from the wall, putting him to death at Thebez? why did you go so near the wall?

chinese: 使者對大衛說：敵人強過我們，出到郊野與我們打仗，我們追殺他們，直到城門口。
english: And the man said to David, Truly the men got the better of us, and came out against us into the open country, but we sent them back to the very doors of the town.

chinese: 射箭的從城上射王的僕人，射死幾個，赫人烏利亞也死了。
english: And the archers sent their arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king's servants are dead, and among them is your servant Uriah the Hittite.

chinese: 王向使者說：你告訴約押說：不要因這事愁悶，刀劍或吞滅這人或吞滅那人，沒有一定的；你只管竭力攻城，將城傾覆。可以用這話勉勵約押。
english: Then David said to the man, Go and say to Joab, Do not let this be a grief to you; for one man may come to his death by the sword like another: put up an even stronger fight against the town, and take it: and do you put heart into him.

chinese: 烏利亞的妻聽見丈夫烏利亞死了，就為他哀哭。
english: And when the wife of Uriah had news that her husband was dead, she gave herself up to weeping for him.

chinese: 哀哭的日子過了，大衛差人將他接到宮裡，他就作了大衛的妻，給大衛生了一個兒子。但大衛所行的這事，耶和華甚不喜悅。
english: And when the days of weeping were past, David sent for her, and took her into his house, and she became his wife and gave him a son. But the Lord was not pleased with the thing David had done.

chinese: 耶和華差遣拿單去見大衛。拿單到了大衛那裡，對他說：在一座城裡有兩個人：一個是富戶，一個是窮人。
english: And the Lord sent Nathan to David. And Nathan came to him and said, There were two men in the same town: one a man of great wealth, and the other a poor man.

chinese: 富戶有許多牛群羊群；
english: The man of wealth had great numbers of flocks and herds;

chinese: 窮人除了所買來養活的一隻小母羊羔之外，別無所有。羊羔在他家裡和他兒女一同長大，吃他所吃的，喝他所喝的，睡在他懷中，在他看來如同女兒一樣。
