chinese: 但匪類都必像荊棘被丟棄；人不敢用手拿他；
english: But the evil-doers, all of them, will be like thorns to be pushed away, because they may not be gripped in the hand:

chinese: 拿他的人必帶鐵器和槍桿，終久他必被火焚燒。
english: But anyone touching them has to be armed with iron and the rod of a spear; and they will be burned with fire, every one of them.

chinese: 大衛勇士的名字記在下面：他革捫人約設巴設，又稱伊斯尼人亞底挪，他是軍長的統領，一時擊殺了八百人。
english: These are the names of David's men of war: Ishbaal the Hachmonite, chief of the three; his axe was lifted up against eight hundred put to death at one time.

chinese: 其次是亞合人朵多的兒子以利亞撒。從前非利士人聚集要打仗，以色列人迎著上去，有跟隨大衛的三個勇士向非利士人罵陣，其中有以利亞撒。
english: After him was Eleazar, the son of Dodai the Ahohite, one of the three great fighters, who was with David in Pas-dammim when the Philistines came together there for the fight; and when the men of Israel had gone in flight,

chinese: 他起來擊殺非利士人，直到手臂疲乏，手黏住刀把。那日耶和華使以色列人大獲全勝；眾民在以利亞撒後頭專奪財物。
english: He was with David and went on fighting the Philistines till his hand became tired and stiff from gripping his sword: and that day the Lord gave a great salvation, and the people came back after him only to take the goods of the Philistines.

chinese: 其次是哈拉人亞基的兒子沙瑪。一日，非利士人聚集成群，在一塊長滿紅豆的田裡，眾民就在非利士人面前逃跑。
english: After him was Shammah, the son of Ela the Hararite. And the Philistines came together in Lehi, where there was a bit of land full of seed; and the people went in flight from the Philistines.

chinese: 沙瑪卻站在那田間擊殺非利士人，救護了那田。耶和華使以色列人大獲全勝。
english: But he kept his place in the middle of the bit of land, and kept back their attack and overcame the Philistines: and the Lord gave a great salvation.

chinese: 收割的時候，有三十個勇士中的三個人下到亞杜蘭洞見大衛。非利士的軍兵在利乏音谷安營。
english: And three of the thirty went down at the start of the grain-cutting, and they came to David at the strong place of Adullam; and the band of Philistines had taken up their position in the valley of Rephaim.

chinese: 那時大衛在山寨，非利士人的防營在伯利恆。
english: And at that time David had taken cover in the strong place, and an armed force of the Philistines was in Beth-lehem.

chinese: 大衛渴想，說：甚願有人將伯利恆城門旁、井裡的水打來給我喝。
english: And David, moved by a strong desire, said, If only someone would give me a drink of water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town!

chinese: 這三個勇士就闖過非利士人的營盤，從伯利恆城門旁的井裡打水，拿來奉給大衛。他卻不肯喝，將水奠在耶和華面前，
english: And the three men, forcing their way through the Philistine army, got water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town, and took it back to David: but he would not take it, but, draining it out, made an offering of it to the Lord.

chinese: 說：耶和華啊，這三個人冒死去打水；這水好像他們的血一般，我斷不敢喝。如此，大衛不肯喝。這是三個勇士所做的事。
english: And he said, Far be it from me, O Lord, to do this; how may I take as my drink the life-blood of men who have put their lives in danger? So he would not take it. These things did the three great men of war.

chinese: 洗魯雅的兒子、約押的兄弟亞比篩是這三個勇士的首領；他舉槍殺了三百人，就在三個勇士裡得了名。
english: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the thirty. He put to death three hundred with his spear, and he got for himself a name among the thirty.

chinese: 他在這三個勇士裡是最尊貴的，所以作他們的首領，只是不及前三個勇士。
english: Was he not the noblest of the thirty? so he was made their captain: but he was not equal to the first three.

chinese: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅行過大能的事；他殺了摩押人亞利伊勒的兩個兒子，又在下雪的時候下坑裡去，殺了一個獅子，
english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a fighting man of Kabzeel, had done great acts; he put to death the two sons of Ariel of Moab: he went down into a hole and put a lion to death in time of snow:

chinese: 又殺了一個強壯的埃及人；埃及人手裡拿著槍，比拿雅只拿著棍子下去，從埃及人手裡奪過槍來，用那槍將他殺死。
english: And he made an attack on an Egyptian, a tall man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a stick, and pulling the spear out of the hands of the Egyptian, put him to death with that same spear.

chinese: 這是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅所行的事，就在三個勇士裡得了名。
english: These were the acts of Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, who had a great name among the thirty men of war.

chinese: 他比那三十個勇士都尊貴，只是不及前三個勇士。大衛立他作護衛長。
english: He was honoured over the rest of the thirty, but he was not equal to the first three. And David put him over the fighting men who kept him safe.

chinese: 三十個勇士裡有約押的兄弟亞撒黑，伯利恆人朵多的兒子伊勒哈難，
english: Asahel, the brother of Joab, was one of the thirty; and Elhanan, the son of Dodai, of Beth-lehem,

chinese: 哈律人沙瑪，哈律人以利加，
english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

chinese: 帕勒提人希利斯，提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉，
english: Helez the Paltite, Ira, the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

chinese: 亞拿突人亞比以謝，戶沙人米本乃，
english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Sibbecai the Hushathite,

chinese: 亞合人撒們，尼陀法人瑪哈萊，
english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

chinese: 尼陀法人巴拿的兒子希立，便雅憫族、基比亞人利拜的兒子以太，
english: Heldai, the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai, the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

chinese: 比拉頓人比拿雅，迦實溪人希太，
english: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the valleys of Gaash,

chinese: 伯亞拉巴人亞比亞本，巴魯米人押斯瑪弗，
english: Abiel the Arbathite, Azmaveth of Bahurim,

chinese: 沙本人以利雅哈巴，雅善兒子中的約拿單，
english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, Jashen the Gunite,

chinese: 哈拉人沙瑪，哈拉人沙拉的兒子亞希暗，
english: Jonathan, the son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam, the son of Sharar the Hararite,

chinese: 瑪迦人亞哈拜的兒子以利法列，基羅人亞希多弗的兒子以連，
english: Eliphelet, the son of Ahasbai the Maacathite, Eliam, the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

chinese: 迦密人希斯萊，亞巴人帕萊，
english: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Archite,

chinese: 瑣巴人拿單的兒子以甲，迦得人巴尼，
english: Igal, the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

chinese: 亞捫人洗勒，比錄人拿哈萊（是給洗魯雅的兒子約押拿兵器的），
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, who had the care of the arms of Joab, son of Zeruiah,

chinese: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

chinese: 赫人烏利亞，共有三十七人。
english: Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in number.

chinese: 耶和華又向以色列人發怒，就激動大衛，使他吩咐人去數點以色列人和猶大人。
english: Again the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and moving David against them, he said, Go, take the number of Israel and Judah.

chinese: 大衛就吩咐跟隨他的元帥約押說：你去走遍以色列眾支派，從但直到別是巴，數點百姓，我好知道他們的數目。
english: And the king said to Joab and the captains of the army, who were with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan as far as Beer-sheba, and have all the people numbered, so that I may be certain of the number of the people.

chinese: 約押對王說：無論百姓多少，願耶和華─你的神再加增百倍，使我主我王親眼得見。我主我王何必喜悅行這事呢？
english: And Joab said to the king, Whatever the number of the people, may the Lord make it a hundred times as much, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it: but why does my lord the king take pleasure in doing this thing?

chinese: 但王的命令勝過約押和眾軍長。約押和眾軍長就從王面前出去，數點以色列的百姓。
english: But the king's order was stronger than Joab and the captains of the army. And Joab and the captains of the army went out from the king, to take the number of the children of Israel.

chinese: 他們過了約但河，在迦得谷中、城的右邊亞羅珥安營，與雅謝相對，
english: And they went over Jordan, and starting from Aroer, from the town which is in the middle of the valley, they went in the direction of the Gadites, and on to Jazer;

chinese: 又到了基列和他停合示地，又到了但雅安，繞到西頓，
english: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of the Hittites under Hermon; and they came to Dan, and from Dan they came round to Zidon,

chinese: 來到推羅的保障，並希未人和迦南人的各城，又到猶大南方的別是巴。
english: And to the walled town of Tyre, and to all the towns of the Hivites and the Canaanites: and they went out to the South of Judah at Beer-sheba.

chinese: 他們走遍全地，過了九個月零二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。
english: So after going through all the land in every direction, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

chinese: 約押將百姓的總數奏告於王：以色列拿刀的勇士有八十萬；猶大有五十萬。
english: And Joab gave the king the number of all the people: there were in Israel eight hundred thousand fighting men able to take up arms; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand.

chinese: 大衛數點百姓以後，就心中自責，禱告耶和華說：我行這事大有罪了。耶和華啊，求你除掉僕人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。
english: And after the people had been numbered, David's heart was troubled. And David said to the Lord, Great has been my sin in doing this; but now, O Lord, be pleased to take away the sin of your servant, for I have done very foolishly

chinese: 大衛早晨起來，耶和華的話臨到先知迦得，就是大衛的先見，說：
english: And David got up in the morning; now the word of the Lord had come to the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

chinese: 你去告訴大衛，說耶和華如此說：我有三樣災，隨你選擇一樣，我好降與你。
english: Go and say to David, The Lord says, Three things are offered to you: say which of them you will have, and I will do it to you.

chinese: 於是迦得來見大衛，對他說：你願意國中有七年的饑荒呢？是在你敵人面前逃跑，被追趕三個月呢？是在你國中有三日的瘟疫呢？現在你要揣摩思想，我好回覆那差我來的。
english: So Gad came to David, and gave him word of this and said to him, Are there to be three years when there is not enough food in your land? or will you go in flight from your haters for three months, while they go after you? or will you have three days of violent disease in your land? take thought and say what answer I am to give to him who sent me.

chinese: 大衛對迦得說：我甚為難！我願落在耶和華的手裡，因為他有豐盛的憐憫。我不願落在人的手裡。
english: And David said to Gad, This is a hard decision for me to make: let us come into the hands of the Lord, for great are his mercies: let me not come into the hands of men.

chinese: 於是，耶和華降瘟疫與以色列人，自早晨到所定的時候；從但直到別是巴，民間死了七萬人。
english: So David made selection of the disease; and the time was the days of the grain-cutting, when the disease came among the people, causing the death of seventy thousand men from Dan as far as Beer-sheba.

chinese: 天使向耶路撒冷伸手要滅城的時候，耶和華後悔，就不降這災了，吩咐滅民的天使說：夠了！住手罷！那時耶和華的使者在耶布斯人亞勞拿的禾場那裡。
english: And when the hand of the angel was stretched out in the direction of Jerusalem, for its destruction, the Lord had regret for the evil, and said to the angel who was sending destruction on the people, It is enough; do no more. And the angel of the Lord was by the grain-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

chinese: 大衛看見滅民的天使，就禱告耶和華說：我犯了罪，行了惡；但這群羊做了甚麼呢？願你的手攻擊我和我的父家。
english: And when David saw the angel who was causing the destruction of the people, he said to the Lord, Truly, the sin is mine; I have done wrong: but these are only sheep; what have they done? let your hand be against me and against my family.

chinese: 當日，迦得來見大衛，對他說：你上去，在耶布斯人亞勞拿的禾場上為耶和華築一座壇。
english: And that day Gad came to David and said to him, Go up, and put up an altar to the Lord on the grain-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

chinese: 大衛就照著迦得奉耶和華名所說的話上去了。
english: So David went up, as Gad had said and as the Lord had given orders.

chinese: 亞勞拿觀看，見王和他臣僕前來，就迎接出去，臉伏於地，向王下拜，
english: And Araunah, looking out, saw the king and his servants coming to him: and Araunah went out, and went down on his face to the earth before the king.

chinese: 說：我主我王為何來到僕人這裡呢？大衛說：我要買你這禾場，為耶和華築一座壇，使民間的瘟疫止住。
english: And Araunah said, Why has my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To give you a price for your grain-floor, so that I may put up an altar to the Lord, and the disease may be stopped among the people.

chinese: 亞勞拿對大衛說：我主我王，你喜悅用甚麼，就拿去獻祭。看哪，這裡有牛可以作燔祭，有打糧的器具和套牛的軛可以當柴燒。
english: And Araunah said to David, Let my lord the king take whatever seems right to him, and make an offering of it: see, here are the oxen for the burned offering, and the grain-cleaning instruments and the ox-yokes for wood:

chinese: 王啊，這一切，我亞勞拿都奉給你；又對王說：願耶和華─你的神悅納你。
english: All this does the servant of my lord the king give to the king. And Araunah said, May the Lord your God be pleased with your offering!

chinese: 王對亞勞拿說：不然。我必要按著價值向你買；我不肯用白得之物作燔祭獻給耶和華─我的神。大衛就用五十舍客勒銀子買了那禾場與牛。
english: And the king said to Araunah, No, but I will give you a price for it; I will not give to the Lord my God burned offerings for which I have given nothing. So David got the grain-floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

chinese: 大衛在那裡為耶和華築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭。如此，耶和華垂聽國民所求的，瘟疫在以色列人中就止住了。
english: And there David put up an altar to the Lord, making burned offerings and peace-offerings. So the Lord gave ear to his prayer for the land, and the disease came to an end in Israel.

chinese: 大衛王年紀老邁，雖用被遮蓋，仍不覺暖。
english: Now King David was old and far on in years; and though they put covers over him, his body was cold.

chinese: 所以臣僕對他說：不如為我主我王尋找一個處女，使他伺候王，奉養王，睡在王的懷中，好叫我主我王得暖。
english: So his servants said to him, Let search be made for a young virgin for my lord the king, to take care of him and be waiting on him; and you may take her in your arms, and so my lord the king will be warm.

chinese: 於是在以色列全境尋找美貌的童女，尋得書念的一個童女亞比煞，就帶到王那裡。
english: So after searching through all the land of Israel for a fair young girl, they saw Abishag the Shunammite, and took her to the king.

chinese: 這童女極其美貌，他奉養王，伺候王，王卻沒有與他親近。
english: Now she was very beautiful; and she took care of the king, waiting on him at all times; but the king had no connection with her.

chinese: 那時，哈及的兒子亞多尼雅自尊，說：我必作王，就為自己預備車輛、馬兵，又派五十人在他前頭奔走。
english: Then Adonijah, the son of Haggith, lifting himself up in pride, said, I will become king; and he made ready his carriages of war and his horsemen, with fifty runners to go before him.

chinese: 他父親素來沒有使他憂悶，說：你是做甚麼呢？他甚俊美，生在押沙龍之後。
english: Now all his life his father had never gone against him or said to him, Why have you done so? and he was a very good-looking man, and younger than Absalom.

chinese: 亞多尼雅與洗魯雅的兒子約押，和祭司亞比亞他商議；二人就順從他，幫助他。
english: And he had talk with Joab, the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they were on his side and gave him their support.

chinese: 但祭司撒督、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅、先知拿單、示每、利以，並大衛的勇士都不順從亞多尼雅。
english: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet and Shimei and Rei, and David's men of war did not take the side of Adonijah.

chinese: 一日，亞多尼雅在隱羅結旁、瑣希列磐石那裡宰了牛羊、肥犢，請他的諸弟兄，就是王的眾子，並所有作王臣僕的猶大人；
english: Then Adonijah put to death sheep and oxen and fat beasts by the stone of Zoheleth, by En-rogel; and he sent for all his brothers, the king's sons, and all the men of Judah, the king's servants, to come to him:

chinese: 惟獨先知拿單和比拿雅並勇士，與他的兄弟所羅門，他都沒有請。
english: But he did not send for Nathan the prophet and Benaiah and the other men of war and Solomon his brother.

chinese: 拿單對所羅門的母親拔示巴說：哈及的兒子亞多尼雅作王了，你沒有聽見麼？我們的主大衛卻不知道。
english: Then Nathan said to Bath-sheba, the mother of Solomon, Has it not come to your ears that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has made himself king without the knowledge of David our lord?

chinese: 現在我可以給你出個主意，好保全你和你兒子所羅門的性命。
english: So now, let me make a suggestion, so that you may keep your life safe and the life of your son Solomon.

chinese: 你進去見大衛王，對他說：我主我王啊，你不曾向婢女起誓說：你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上麼？現在亞多尼雅怎麼作了王呢？
english: Come now, go to King David and say to him, Did you not, O my lord, take an oath to me, your servant, saying, Truly Solomon your son will be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom? why then is Adonijah acting as king?

chinese: 你還與王說話的時候，我也隨後進去，證實你的話。
english: And while you are still talking there with the king, see, I will come in after you and say that your story is true.

chinese: 拔示巴進入內室見王，王甚老邁，書念的童女亞比煞正伺候王。
english: Then Bath-sheba went into the king's room; now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was waiting on him.

chinese: 拔示巴向王屈身下拜；王說：你要甚麼？
english: And Bath-sheba went down on her face on the earth before the king giving him honour. And he said, What is your desire?

chinese: 他說：我主啊，你曾向婢女指著耶和華─你的神起誓說：你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上。
english: And she said to him, My lord, you took an oath by the Lord your God and gave your word to your servant, saying, Truly, Solomon your son will be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom.

chinese: 現在亞多尼雅作王了，我主我王卻不知道。
english: And now, see, Adonijah has made himself king without my lord's knowledge;

chinese: 他宰了許多牛羊、肥犢，請了王的眾子和祭司亞比亞他，並元帥約押；惟獨王的僕人所羅門，他沒有請。
english: And has put to death oxen and fat beasts and sheep in great numbers, and has sent for all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab, the captain of the army; but he has not sent for Solomon your servant.

chinese: 我主我王啊，以色列眾人的眼目都仰望你，等你曉諭他們，在我主我王之後誰坐你的位。
english: And now, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, waiting for you to say who is to take the place of my lord the king after him.

chinese: 若不然，到我主我王與列祖同睡以後，我和我兒子所羅門必算為罪人了。
english: For as things are, it will come about, when my lord the king is sleeping with his fathers, that I and Solomon my son will be made outlaws.

chinese: 拔示巴還與王說話的時候，先知拿單也進來了。
english: And while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

chinese: 有人奏告王說：先知拿單來了。拿單進到王前，臉伏於地。
english: And they said to the king, Here is Nathan the prophet. And when he came in before the king, he went down on his face on the earth.

chinese: 拿單說：我主我王果然應許亞多尼雅說你必接續我作王，坐在我的位上麼？
english: And Nathan said, O my lord king, have you said, Adonijah is to be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom?

chinese: 他今日下去，宰了許多牛羊、肥犢，請了王的眾子和軍長，並祭司亞比亞他；他們正在亞多尼雅面前吃喝，說：願亞多尼雅王萬歲！
english: Because today he has gone down and has put to death oxen and fat beasts and sheep in great numbers, and has sent for all the king's sons to come to him, with the captains of the army and Abiathar the priest; and they are feasting before him and crying, Long life to King Adonijah!

chinese: 惟獨我，就是你的僕人和祭司撒督，耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，並王的僕人所羅門，他都沒有請。
english: But me, your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon, he has not sent for.

chinese: 這事果然出乎我主我王麼？王卻沒有告訴僕人們，在我主我王之後誰坐你的位。
english: Has this thing been done by my lord the king, without giving word to your servants who was to be placed on my lord the king's seat after him?

chinese: 大衛王吩咐說：叫拔示巴來。拔示巴就進來，站在王面前。
english: Then King David in answer said, Send for Bath-sheba to come to me. And she came in and took her place before the king.

chinese: 王起誓說：我指著救我性命脫離一切苦難、永生的耶和華起誓。
english: And the king took an oath, and said, By the living Lord, who has been my saviour from all my troubles,

chinese: 我既然指著耶和華─以色列的神向你起誓說：你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上。我今日就必照這話而行。
english: As I took an oath to you by the Lord, the God of Israel, saying, Certainly Solomon your son will become king after me, seated on my seat in my place; so will I do this day.

chinese: 於是，拔示巴臉伏於地，向王下拜，說：願我主大衛王萬歲！
english: Then Bath-sheba went down on her face on the earth before the king giving him honour, and said, May my lord King David go on living for ever.

chinese: 大衛王又吩咐說：將祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅召來！他們就都來到王面前。
english: And King David said, Send for Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

chinese: 王對他們說：要帶領你們主的僕人，使我兒子所羅門騎我的騾子，送他下到基訓；
english: And the king said to them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and put Solomon my son on my beast, yes, mine, and take him down to Gihon;

chinese: 在那裡，祭司撒督和先知拿單要膏他作以色列的王；你們也要吹角，說：願所羅門王萬歲！
english: And there let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet put the holy oil on him to make him king over Israel; and sounding the horn say, Long life to King Solomon!

chinese: 然後要跟隨他上來，使他坐在我的位上，接續我作王。我已立他作以色列和猶大的君。
english: Then come up after him and he will come in and take his place on the seat of my kingdom; for he is to be king in my place, and I have given orders that he is to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

chinese: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅對王說：阿們！願耶和華─我主我王的神也這樣命定。
english: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, answering the king, said, So be it: and may the Lord, the God of my lord the king, say so.

chinese: 耶和華怎樣與我主我王同在，願他照樣與所羅門同在，使他的國位比我主大衛王的國位更大。
english: As the Lord has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon and make the seat of his authority greater than that of my lord King David.

chinese: 於是，祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都下去使所羅門騎大衛王的騾子，將他送到基訓。
english: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, went down and put Solomon on King David's beast and took him to Gihon.

chinese: 祭司撒督就從帳幕中取了盛膏油的角來，用膏膏所羅門。人就吹角，眾民都說：願所羅門王萬歲！
english: And Zadok the priest took the vessel of oil out of the Tent, and put the holy oil on Solomon. And when the horn was sounded, all the people said, Long life to King Solomon!

chinese: 眾民跟隨他上來，且吹笛，大大歡呼，聲音震地。
english: And all the people came up after him, piping with pipes, and they were glad with great joy, so that the earth was shaking with the sound.

chinese: 亞多尼雅和所請的眾客筵宴方畢，聽見這聲音；約押聽見角聲就說：城中為何有這響呢？
english: And it came to the ears of Adonijah and all the guests who were with him, when their meal was ended. And Joab, hearing the sound of the horn, said, What is the reason of this noise as if the town was worked up?

chinese: 他正說話的時候，祭司亞比亞他的兒子約拿單來了。亞多尼雅對他說：進來罷！你是個忠義的人，必是報好信息。
english: And while the words were on his lips, Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest, came; and Adonijah said, Come in; for you are a man of good faith and the news which you have for us will be good.

chinese: 約拿單對亞多尼雅說：我們的主大衛王誠然立所羅門為王了。
english: And Jonathan, answering, said to Adonijah, Not so, but our lord King David has made Solomon king:

chinese: 王差遣祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都去使所羅門騎王的騾子。
english: And he sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they put him on the king's beast:

chinese: 祭司撒督和先知拿單在基訓已經膏他作王。眾人都從那裡歡呼著上來，聲音使城震動，這就是你們所聽見的聲音；
english: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet put the holy oil on him and made him king in Gihon; and they came back from there with joy, and the town was all worked up. This is the noise which has come to your ears.

chinese: 並且所羅門登了國位。
english: And now Solomon is seated on the seat of the kingdom.

chinese: 王的臣僕也來為我們的主大衛王祝福，說：願王的神使所羅門的名比王的名更尊榮；使他的國位比王的國位更大。王就在床上屈身下拜。
english: And the king's servants came to our lord King David, blessing him and saying, May God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and the seat of his authority greater than your seat; and the king was bent low in worship on his bed.

chinese: 王又說：耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的；因他賜我一人今日坐在我的位上，我也親眼看見了。
english: Then the king said, May the God of Israel be praised, who has given one of my seed to be king in my place this day and has let my eyes see it.

chinese: 亞多尼雅的眾客聽見這話就都驚懼，起來四散。
english: And all the guests of Adonijah got up in fear and went away, every man to his place.

chinese: 亞多尼雅懼怕所羅門，就起來，去抓住祭壇的角。
english: And Adonijah himself was full of fear because of Solomon; and he got up and went to the altar, and put his hands on its horns.

chinese: 有人告訴所羅門說：亞多尼雅懼怕所羅門王，現在抓住祭壇的角，說：願所羅門王今日向我起誓，必不用刀殺僕人。
english: And they gave Solomon word of it, saying, See, Adonijah goes in such fear of King Solomon, that he has put his hands on the horns of the altar, saying, Let King Solomon first give me his oath that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.

chinese: 所羅門說：他若作忠義的人，連一根頭髮也不致落在地上；他若行惡，必要死亡。
english: And Solomon said, If he is seen to be a man of good faith, not a hair of him will be touched; but if any wrongdoing is seen in him, he is to be put to death.

chinese: 於是所羅門王差遣人，使亞多尼雅從壇上下來，他就來，向所羅門王下拜；所羅門對他說：你回家去罷！
english: So King Solomon sent, and they took him down from the altar. And he came and gave honour to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, Go to your house.

chinese: 大衛的死期臨近了，就囑吩他兒子所羅門說：
english: Now the time of David's death came near; and he gave orders to Solomon his son, saying,

chinese: 我現在要走世人必走的路。所以，你當剛強，作大丈夫，
english: I am going the way of all the earth: so be strong and be a man;

chinese: 遵守耶和華─你神所吩咐的，照著摩西律法上所寫的行主的道，謹守他的律例、誡命、典章、法度。這樣，你無論做甚麼事，不拘往何處去，盡都亨通。
english: And keep the orders of the Lord your God, walking in his ways, keeping his laws and his orders and his rules and his words, as they are recorded in the law of Moses; so that you may do well in all you do and wherever you go,

chinese: 耶和華必成就向我所應許的話說：你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，盡心盡意誠誠實實地行在我面前，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。
english: So that the Lord may give effect to what he said of me, If your children give attention to their ways, living uprightly before me with all their heart and their soul, you will never be without a man to be king in Israel.

chinese: 你知道洗魯雅的兒子約押向我所行的，就是殺了以色列的兩個元帥：尼珥的兒子押尼珥和益帖兒子亞瑪撒。他在太平之時流這二人的血，如在爭戰之時一樣，將這血染了腰間束的帶和腳上穿的鞋。
english: Now you have knowledge of what Joab, the son of Zeruiah, did to me, and to the two captains of the army of Israel, Abner, the son of Ner, and Amasa, the son of Jether, whom he put to death, taking payment for the blood of war in time of peace, and making the band of my clothing and the shoes on my feet red with the blood of one put to death without cause.

chinese: 所以你要照你的智慧行，不容他白頭安然下陰間。
english: So be guided by your wisdom, and let not his white head go down to the underworld in peace.

chinese: 你當恩待基列人巴西萊的眾子，使他們常與你同席吃飯；因為我躲避你哥哥押沙龍的時候，他們拿食物來迎接我。
english: But be good to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be guests at your table; for so they came to me when I went in flight from Absalom your brother.

chinese: 在你這裡有巴戶琳的便雅憫人，基拉的兒子示每；我往瑪哈念去的那日，他用狠毒的言語咒罵我，後來卻下約但河迎接我，我就指著耶和華向他起誓說：我必不用刀殺你。
english: Now you have with you Shimei, the son of Gera the Benjamite of Bahurim, who put a bitter curse on me on the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to see me at Jordan, and I gave him my oath by the Lord, saying, I will not put you to death by the sword.

chinese: 現在你不要以他為無罪。你是聰明人，必知道怎樣待他，使他白頭見殺，流血下到陰間。
english: But do not let him be free from punishment, for you are a wise man; and it will be clear to you what you have to do with him; see that his white head goes down to the underworld in blood.

chinese: 大衛與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城。
english: Then David went to rest with his fathers, and his body was put into the earth in the town of David.

chinese: 大衛作以色列王四十年：在希伯崙作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
english: David was king over Israel for forty years: for seven years he was king in Hebron and for thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

chinese: 所羅門坐他父親大衛的位，他的國甚是堅固。
english: And Solomon took his place on the seat of David his father, and his kingdom was made safe and strong.

chinese: 哈及的兒子亞多尼雅去見所羅門的母親拔示巴，拔示巴問他說：你來是為平安麼？回答說：是為平安；
english: Then Adonijah, the son of Haggith, came to Bath-sheba, the mother of Solomon. And she said, Come you in peace? And he said, Yes, in peace.

chinese: 又說：我有話對你說。拔示巴說：你說罷。
english: Then he said, I have something to say to you. And she said, Say on.

chinese: 亞多尼雅說：你知道國原是歸我的，以色列眾人也都仰望我作王，不料，國反歸了我兄弟，因他得國是出乎耶和華。
english: And he said, You saw how the kingdom was mine, and all Israel had the idea that I would be their king; but now the kingdom is turned about, and has become my brother's, for it was given to him by the Lord.

chinese: 現在我有一件事求你，望你不要推辭。拔示巴說：你說罷。
english: Now I have one request to make to you, and do not say, No, to me. And she said to him, Say on.

chinese: 他說：求你請所羅門王將書念的女子亞比煞賜我為妻，因他必不推辭你。
english: Then he said, Will you go to Solomon the king (for he will not say, No, to you) and put before him my request that he will give me Abishag the Shunammite for a wife?

chinese: 拔示巴說：好，我必為你對王提說。
english: And Bath-sheba said, Good! I will make your request to the king.

chinese: 於是，拔示巴去見所羅門王，要為亞多尼雅提說；王起來迎接，向他下拜，就坐在位上，吩咐人為王母設一座位，他便坐在王的右邊。
english: So Bath-sheba went to King Solomon to have talk with him on Adonijah's account. And the king got up to come to her, and went down low to the earth before her; then he took his place on the king's seat and had a seat made ready for the king's mother and she took her place at his right hand.

chinese: 拔示巴說：我有一件小事求你，望你不要推辭。王說：請母親說，我必不推辭。
english: Then she said, I have one small request to make to you; do not say, No, to me. And the king said, Say on, my mother, for I will not say, No, to you.

chinese: 拔示巴說：求你將書念的女子亞比煞賜給你哥哥亞多尼雅為妻。
english: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother for a wife.

chinese: 所羅門王對他母親說：為何單替他求書念的女子亞比煞呢？也可以為他求國罷！他是我的哥哥，他有祭司亞比亞他和洗魯雅的兒子約押為輔佐。
english: Then King Solomon made answer and said to his mother, Why are you requesting me to give Abishag the Shunammite to Adonijah? Take the kingdom for him in addition, for he is my older brother, and Abiathar the priest and Joab, the son of Zeruiah, are on his side.

chinese: 所羅門王就指著耶和華起誓說：亞多尼雅這話是自己送命，不然，願神重重地降罰與我。
english: Then King Solomon took an oath by the Lord, saying, May God's punishment be on me if Adonijah does not give payment for these words with his life.

chinese: 耶和華堅立我，使我坐在父親大衛的位上，照著所應許的話為我建立家室；現在我指著永生的耶和華起誓，亞多尼雅今日必被治死。
english: Now by the living Lord, who has given me my place on the seat of David my father, and made me one of a line of kings, as he gave me his word, truly Adonijah will be put to death this day.

chinese: 於是所羅門王差遣耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，將亞多尼雅殺死。
english: And King Solomon sent Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and he made an attack on him and put him to death.

chinese: 王對祭司亞比亞他說：你回亞拿突歸自己的田地去罷！你本是該死的，但因你在我父親大衛面前抬過主耶和華的約櫃，又與我父親同受一切苦難，所以我今日不將你殺死。
english: And to Abiathar the priest the king said, Go to Anathoth, to your fields; for death would be your right reward; but I will not put you to death now, because you took up the ark of the Lord God before David my father, and you were with him in all his troubles.

chinese: 所羅門就革除亞比亞他，不許他作耶和華的祭司。這樣，便應驗耶和華在示羅論以利家所說的話。
english: So Solomon let Abiathar be priest no longer, so that he might make the word of the Lord come true which he said about the sons of Eli in Shiloh.

chinese: 約押雖然沒有歸從押沙龍，卻歸從了亞多尼雅。他聽見這風聲，就逃到耶和華的帳幕，抓住祭壇的角。
english: And news of this came to Joab; for Joab had been one of Adonijah's supporters, though he had not been on Absalom's side. Then Joab went in flight to the Tent of the Lord, and put his hands on the horns of the altar.

chinese: 有人告訴所羅門王說：約押逃到耶和華的帳幕，現今在祭壇的旁邊。所羅門就差遣耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，說你去將他殺死。
english: And they said to King Solomon, Joab has gone in flight to the Tent of the Lord and is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, make an attack on him.

chinese: 比拿雅來到耶和華的帳幕，對約押說：王吩咐說，你出來罷！他說：我不出去，我要死在這裡。比拿雅就去回覆王，說約押如此如此回答我。
english: And Benaiah came to the Tent of the Lord and said to him, The king says, Come out. And he said, No; but let death come to me here. And Benaiah went back to the king and gave him word of the answer which Joab had given.

chinese: 王說：你可以照著他的話行，殺死他，將他葬埋，好叫約押流無辜人血的罪不歸我和我的父家了。
english: And the king said, Do as he has said and make an attack on him there, and put his body into the earth; so that you may take away from me and from my family the blood of one put to death by Joab without cause.

chinese: 耶和華必使約押流人血的罪歸到他自己的頭上；因為他用刀殺了兩個比他又義又好的人，就是以色列元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥和猶大元帥益帖的兒子亞瑪撒，我父親大衛卻不知道。
english: And the Lord will send back his blood on his head, because of the attack he made on two men more upright and better than himself, putting them to the sword without my father's knowledge; even Abner, the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa, the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.

chinese: 故此，流這二人血的罪必歸到約押和他後裔的頭上，直到永遠；惟有大衛和他的後裔，並他的家與國，必從耶和華那裡得平安，直到永遠。
english: So their blood will be on the head of Joab, and on the head of his seed for ever; but for David and his seed and his family and the seat of his kingdom, there will be peace for ever from the Lord.

chinese: 於是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅上去，將約押殺死，葬在曠野約押自己的墳墓(原文作房屋)裡。
english: So Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, went up, and falling on him, put him to death; and his body was put to rest in his house in the waste land.

chinese: 王就立耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅作元帥，代替約押，又使祭司撒督代替亞比亞他。
english: And the king put Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, in his place over the army; and Zadok the priest he put in the place of Abiathar.

chinese: 王差遣人將示每召來，對他說：你要在耶路撒冷建造房屋居住，不可出來往別處去。
english: Then the king sent for Shimei, and said to him, Make a house for yourself in Jerusalem and keep there and go to no other place.

chinese: 你當確實地知道，你何日出來過汲淪溪，何日必死！你的罪(原文作血)必歸到自己的頭上。
english: For be certain that on the day when you go out and go over the stream Kidron, death will overtake you: and your blood will be on your head.

chinese: 示每對王說：這話甚好！我主我王怎樣說，僕人必怎樣行。於是示每多日住在耶路撒冷。
english: And Shimei said to the king, Very well! as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do. And for a long time Shimei went on living in Jerusalem.

chinese: 過了三年，示每的兩個僕人逃到迦特王瑪迦的兒子亞吉那裡去。有人告訴示每說：你的僕人在迦特。
english: But after three years, two of the servants of Shimei went in flight to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. And word was given to Shimei that his servants had gone to Gath.

chinese: 示每起來，備上驢，往迦特到亞吉那裡去找他的僕人，就從迦特帶他僕人回來。
english: Then Shimei got up, and making ready his ass, he went to Gath, to Achish, in search of his servants; and he sent and got them from Gath.

chinese: 有人告訴所羅門說：示每出耶路撒冷往迦特去，回來了。
english: And news was given to Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had come back again.

chinese: 王就差遣人將示每召了來，對他說：我豈不是叫你指著耶和華起誓，並且警戒你說你當確實地知道，你哪日出來往別處去，那日必死麼？你也對我說：這話甚好，我必聽從。
english: Then the king sent for Shimei, and said to him, Did I not make you take an oath by the Lord, protesting to you and saying, Be certain that on the day when you go out from here, wherever you go, death will overtake you? and you said to me, Very well!

chinese: 現在你為何不遵守你指著耶和華起的誓和我所吩咐你的命令呢？
english: Why then have you not kept the oath of the Lord and the order which I gave you?

chinese: 王又對示每說：你向我父親大衛所行的一切惡事，你自己心裡也知道，所以耶和華必使你的罪惡歸到自己的頭上；
english: And the king said to Shimei, You have knowledge of all the evil which you did to David my father; and now the Lord has sent back your evil on yourself.

chinese: 惟有所羅門王必得福，並且大衛的國位必在耶和華面前堅定，直到永遠。
english: But a blessing will be on King Solomon, and the kingdom of David will keep its place before the Lord for ever.

chinese: 於是王吩咐耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，他就去殺死示每。這樣，便堅定了所羅門的國位。
english: So the king gave orders to Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada; and he went out and, falling on him, put him to death. And Solomon's authority over the kingdom was complete.

chinese: 所羅門與埃及王法老結親，娶了法老的女兒為妻，接他進入大衛城，直等到造完了自己的宮和耶和華的殿，並耶路撒冷周圍的城牆。
english: Solomon became the son-in-law of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter as his wife, keeping her in the town of David, till the house he was building for himself, and the house of the Lord and the wall round Jerusalem, were complete.

chinese: 當那些日子，百姓仍在邱壇獻祭，因為還沒有為耶和華的名建殿。
english: But all this time the people were making their offerings in the high places, because no house had been put up to the name of the Lord till those days.

chinese: 所羅門愛耶和華，遵行他父親大衛的律例，只是還在邱壇獻祭燒香。
english: And Solomon, in his love for the Lord, kept the laws of David his father; but he made offerings and let them go up in smoke on the high places.

chinese: 所羅門王上基遍去獻祭；因為在那裡有極大(或作出名)的邱壇，他在那壇上獻一千犧牲作燔祭。
english: And the king went to Gibeon to make an offering there, because that was the chief high place: it was Solomon's way to make a thousand burned offerings on that altar.

chinese: 在基遍，夜間夢中，耶和華向所羅門顯現，對他說：你願我賜你甚麼？你可以求。
english: In Gibeon, Solomon had a vision of the Lord in a dream by night; and God said to him, Say what I am to give you.

chinese: 所羅門說：你僕人─我父親大衛用誠實、公義、正直的心行在你面前，你就向他大施恩典，又為他存留大恩，賜他一個兒子坐在他的位上，正如今日一樣。
english: And Solomon said, Great was your mercy to David my father, as his life before you was true and upright and his heart was true to you; and you have kept for him this greatest mercy, a son to take his place this day.

chinese: 耶和華─我的神啊，如今你使僕人接續我父親大衛作王；但我是幼童，不知道應當怎樣出入。
english: And now, O Lord my God, you have made your servant king in the place of David my father; and I am only a young boy, with no knowledge of how to go out or come in.

chinese: 僕人住在你所揀選的民中，這民多得不可勝數。
english: And your servant has round him the people of your selection, a people so great that they may not be numbered, and no account of them may be given.

chinese: 所以求你賜我智慧，可以判斷你的民，能辨別是非。不然，誰能判斷這眾多的民呢？
english: Give your servant, then, a wise heart for judging your people, able to see what is good and what evil; for who is able to be the judge of this great people?

chinese: 所羅門因為求這事，就蒙主喜悅。
english: Now these words and Solomon's request were pleasing to the Lord.

chinese: 神對他說：你既然求這事，不為自己求壽、求富，也不求滅絕你仇敵的性命，單求智慧可以聽訟，
english: And God said to him, Because your request is for this thing, and not for long life for yourself or for wealth or for the destruction of your haters, but for wisdom to be a judge of causes;

chinese: 我就應允你所求的，賜你聰明智慧，甚至在你以前沒有像你的，在你以後也沒有像你的。
english: I have done as you said: I have given you a wise and far-seeing heart, so that there has never been your equal in the past, and never will there be any like you in the future.

chinese: 你所沒有求的，我也賜給你，就是富足、尊榮，使你在世的日子，列王中沒有一個能比你的。
english: And with this I have given you what you made no request for: wealth and honour, so that no king was ever your equal.

chinese: 你若效法你父親大衛，遵行我的道，謹守我的律例、誡命，我必使你長壽。
english: And if you go on in my ways, keeping my laws and my orders as your father David did, I will give you a long life.

chinese: 所羅門醒了，不料是個夢。他就回到耶路撒冷，站在耶和華的約櫃前，獻燔祭和平安祭，又為他眾臣僕設擺筵席。
english: And Solomon, awakening, saw that it was a dream; then he came to Jerusalem, where he went before the ark of the agreement of the Lord, offering burned offerings and peace-offerings; and he made a feast for all his servants.

chinese: 一日，有兩個妓女來，站在王面前。
english: Then two loose women of the town came and took their places before the king;

chinese: 一個說：我主啊，我和這婦人同住一房；他在房中的時候，我生了一個男孩。
english: And one of them said, O my lord, I and this woman are living in the same house; and I gave birth to a child by her side in the house.

chinese: 我生孩子後第三日，這婦人也生了孩子。我們是同住的，除了我們二人之外，房中再沒有別人。
english: And three days after the birth of my child, this woman had a child: we were together, no other-person was with us in the house but we two only.

chinese: 夜間，這婦人睡著的時候，壓死了他的孩子。
english: In the night, this woman, sleeping on her child, was the cause of its death.

chinese: 他半夜起來，趁我睡著，從我旁邊把我的孩子抱去，放在他懷裡，將他的死孩子放在我懷裡。
english: And she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while your servant was sleeping; and she took it in her arms and put her dead child in my arms.

chinese: 天要亮的時候，我起來要給我的孩子吃奶，不料，孩子死了；及至天亮，我細細地察看，不是我所生的孩子。
english: And when I got up to give my child the breast, I saw that it was dead; but in the morning, looking at it with care, I saw that it was not my son.

chinese: 那婦人說：不然，活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的。這婦人說：不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的。他們在王面前如此爭論。
english: And the other woman said, No; but the living child is my son and the dead one yours. But the first said, No; the dead child is your son and the living one mine. So they kept on talking before the king.

chinese: 王說：這婦人說活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的，那婦人說不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的，
english: Then the king said, One says, The living child is my son, and yours is the dead: and the other says, Not so; but your son is the dead one and mine is the living.

chinese: 就吩咐說：拿刀來！人就拿刀來。
english: Then he said, Get me a sword. So they went and put a sword before the king.

chinese: 王說：將活孩子劈成兩半，一半給那婦人，一半給這婦人。
english: And the king said, Let the living child be cut in two and one half given to one woman and one to the other.

chinese: 活孩子的母親為自己的孩子心裡急痛，就說：求我主將活孩子給那婦人罷，萬不可殺他！那婦人說：這孩子也不歸我，也不歸你，把他劈了罷！
english: Then the mother of the living child came forward, for her heart went out to her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the child; do not on any account put it to death. But the other woman said, It will not be mine or yours; let it be cut in two.

chinese: 王說：將活孩子給這婦人，萬不可殺他；這婦人實在是他的母親。
english: Then the king made answer and said, Give her the child, and do not put it to death; she is the mother of it.

chinese: 以色列眾人聽見王這樣判斷，就都敬畏他；因為見他心裡有神的智慧，能以斷案。
english: And news of this decision which the king had made went through all Israel; and they had fear of the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to give decisions.

chinese: 所羅門作以色列眾人的王。
english: Now Solomon was king over all Israel.

chinese: 他的臣子記在下面：撒督的兒子亞撒利雅作祭司，
english: And these were his chief men: Azariah, the son of Zadok, was the priest;

chinese: 示沙的兩個兒子以利何烈、亞希亞作書記，亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官，
english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, were scribes; Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was the recorder;

chinese: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅作元帥，撒督和亞比亞他作祭司長，
english: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was head of the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

chinese: 拿單的兒子亞撒利雅作眾吏長，王的朋友拿單的兒子撒布得作領袖，
english: Azariah, the son of Nathan, was over those in authority in the different divisions of the country; Zabud, the son of Nathan, was priest and the king's friend;

chinese: 亞希煞作家宰，亞比大的兒子亞多尼蘭掌管服苦的人。
english: Ahishar was controller of the king's house; Adoniram, the son of Abda, was overseer of the forced work.

chinese: 所羅門在以色列全地立了十二個官吏，使他們供給王和王家的食物，每年各人供給一月。
english: And Solomon put twelve overseers over all Israel, to be responsible for the stores needed for the king and those of his house; every man was responsible for one month in the year.

chinese: 他們的名字記在下面：在以法蓮山地有便戶珥；
english: And these are their names: ... the son of Hur in the hill country of Ephraim;

chinese: 在瑪迦斯、沙賓、伯示麥、以倫伯哈南有便底甲；
english: ... the son of Deker in Makaz and Shaalbim and Beth-shemesh and Elonbeth-hanan;

chinese: 在亞魯泊有便希悉，他管理梭哥和希弗全地；
english: ... the son of Hesed in Arubboth; Socoh and all the land of Hepher were under his control;

chinese: 在多珥山岡(或作全境)有便亞比拿達，他娶了所羅門的女兒他法為妻；
english: ... the son of Abinadab in all Naphath-dor; his wife was Taphath, the daughter of Solomon.

chinese: 在他納和米吉多，並靠近撒拉他拿、耶斯列下邊的伯善全地，從伯善到亞伯米何拉直到約念之外，有亞希律的兒子巴拿；
english: Baana, the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is by the side of Zarethan, under Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as the far side of Jokmeam;

chinese: 在基列的拉末有便基別，他管理在基列的瑪拿西子孫睚珥的城邑，巴珊的亞珥歌伯地的大城六十座，都有城牆和銅閂；
english: ... the son of Geber in Ramoth-gilead; he had the towns of Jair, the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, and the country of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great towns with walls and locks of brass.

chinese: 在瑪哈念有易多的兒子亞希拿達；
english: Ahinadab, the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

chinese: 在拿弗他利有亞希瑪斯，他也娶了所羅門的一個女兒巴實抹為妻；
english: Ahimaaz in Naphtali; he took Basemath, the daughter of Solomon, as his wife;

chinese: 在亞設和亞祿有戶篩的兒子巴拿；
english: Baana, the son of Hushai, in Asher and Aloth;

chinese: 在以薩迦有帕路亞的兒子約沙法；
english: Jehoshaphat, the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

chinese: 在便雅憫有以拉的兒子示每；
english: Shimei, the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

chinese: 在基列地，就是從前屬亞摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地，有烏利的兒子基別一人管理。
english: Geber, the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan; and one overseer had authority over all the overseers who were in the land.

chinese: 猶大人和以色列人如同海邊的沙那樣多，都吃喝快樂。
english: Judah and Israel were as great in number as the sand by the seaside, and they took their food and drink with joy in their hearts.

chinese: 所羅門統管諸國，從大河到非利士地，直到埃及的邊界。所羅門在世的日子，這些國都進貢服事他。
english: And Solomon was ruler over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and as far as the edge of Egypt; men gave him offerings and were his servants all the days of his life.

chinese: 所羅門每日所用的食物：細麵三十歌珥，粗麵六十歌珥，
english: And the amount of Solomon's food for one day was thirty measures of crushed grain and sixty measures of meal;

chinese: 肥牛十隻，草場的牛二十隻，羊一百隻，還有鹿、羚羊、麃子，並肥禽。
english: Ten fat oxen and twenty oxen from the fields, and a hundred sheep, in addition to harts and gazelles and roes and fat fowls.

chinese: 所羅門管理大河西邊的諸王，以及從提弗薩直到迦薩的全地，四境盡都平安。
english: For he had authority over all the country on this side of the River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace round him on every side.

chinese: 所羅門在世的日子，從但到別是巴的猶大人和以色列人都在自己的葡萄樹下和無花果樹下安然居住。
english: So Judah and Israel were living safely, every man under his vine and his fig-tree, from Dan as far as Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.

chinese: 所羅門有套車的馬四萬，還有馬兵一萬二千。
english: And Solomon had four thousand boxed-off spaces for horses for his carriages, and twelve thousand horsemen.

chinese: 那十二個官吏各按各月供給所羅門王，並一切與他同席之人的食物，一無所缺。
english: And those overseers, every man in his month, saw that food was produced for Solomon and all his guests, they took care that nothing was overlooked.

chinese: 眾人各按各分，將養馬與快馬的大麥和乾草送到官吏那裡。
english: And they took grain and dry grass for the horses and the carriage-horses, to the right place, every man as he was ordered.

chinese: 神賜給所羅門極大的智慧聰明和廣大的心，如同海沙不可測量。
english: And God gave Solomon a great store of wisdom and good sense, and a mind of wide range, as wide as the sand by the seaside.

chinese: 所羅門的智慧超過東方人和埃及人的一切智慧。
english: And Solomon's wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the people of the East and all the wisdom of Egypt.

chinese: 他的智慧勝過萬人，勝過以斯拉人以探，並瑪曷的兒子希幔、甲各、達大的智慧。他的名聲傳揚在四圍的列國。
english: For he was wiser than all men, even than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman and Calcol and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and he had a great name among all the nations round about.

chinese: 他作箴言三千句，詩歌一千零五首。
english: He was the maker of three thousand wise sayings, and of songs to the number of a thousand and five.

chinese: 他講論草木，自利巴嫩的香柏樹直到牆上長的牛膝草，又講論飛禽走獸、昆蟲水族。
english: He made sayings about all plants, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop hanging on the wall; and about all beasts and birds and fishes and the small things of the earth.

chinese: 天下列王聽見所羅門的智慧，就都差人來聽他的智慧話。
english: People came from every nation to give ear to the wisdom of Solomon, from all the kings of the earth who had word of his wisdom.

chinese: 推羅王希蘭，平素愛大衛；他聽見以色列人膏所羅門，接續他父親作王，就差遣臣僕來見他。
english: Now Hiram, king of Tyre, hearing that Solomon had been made king in place of his father, sent his servants to him; for Hiram had ever been a friend to David.

chinese: 所羅門也差遣人去見希蘭，說：
english: And Solomon sent back word to Hiram, saying,

chinese: 你知道我父親大衛因四圍的爭戰，不能為耶和華─他神的名建殿，直等到耶和華使仇敵都服在他腳下。
english: You have knowledge that David my father was not able to make a house for the name of the Lord his God, because of the wars which were round him on every side, till the Lord put all those who were against him under his feet.

chinese: 現在耶和華─我的神使我四圍平安，沒有仇敵，沒有災禍。
english: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side; no one is making trouble, and no evil is taking place.

chinese: 我定意要為耶和華─我神的名建殿，是照耶和華應許我父親大衛的話說：我必使你兒子接續你坐你的位，他必為我的名建殿。
english: And so it is my purpose to make a house for the name of the Lord my God, as he said to David my father, Your son, whom I will make king in your place, will be the builder of a house for my name.

chinese: 所以求你吩咐你的僕人在利巴嫩為我砍伐香柏木，我的僕人也必幫助他們，我必照你所定的，給你僕人的工價；因為你知道，在我們中間沒有人像西頓人善於砍伐樹木。
english: So now, will you have cedar-trees from Lebanon cut down for me, and my servants will be with your servants; and I will give you payment for your servants at whatever rate you say; for it is common knowledge that we have no such wood-cutters among us as the men of Zidon.

chinese: 希蘭聽見所羅門的話，就甚喜悅，說：今日應當稱頌耶和華；因他賜給大衛一個有智慧的兒子，治理這眾多的民。
english: And these words of Solomon made Hiram glad, and he said, Now may the Lord be praised who has given to David a wise son to be king over this great people.

chinese: 希蘭打發人去見所羅門，說：你差遣人向我所提的那事，我都聽見了；論到香柏木和松木，我必照你的心願而行。
english: Then Hiram sent to Solomon, saying; The words you sent have been given to me: I will do all your desire in the question of cedar-wood and cypress-wood.

chinese: 我的僕人必將這木料從利巴嫩運到海裡，紮成筏子，浮海運到你所指定我的地方，在那裡拆開，你就可以收取；你也要成全我的心願，將食物給我的家。
english: My men will take them down from Lebanon to the sea, where I will have them corded together to go by sea to whatever place you say, and I will have them cut up there so that you may take them away; as for payment, it will be enough if you give me food for my people.

chinese: 於是希蘭照著所羅門所要的，給他香柏木和松木；
english: So Hiram gave Solomon all the cedar-wood and cypress-wood he had need of;

chinese: 所羅門給希蘭麥子二萬歌珥，清油二十歌珥，作他家的食物。所羅門每年都是這樣給希蘭。
english: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of grain, as food for his people, and twenty measures of clear oil; this he did every year.

chinese: 耶和華照著所應許的賜智慧給所羅門。希蘭與所羅門和好，彼此立約。
english: Now the Lord had given Solomon wisdom, as he had said to him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and they made an agreement together.

chinese: 所羅門王從以色列人中挑取服苦的人共有三萬，
english: Then King Solomon got together men for the forced work through all Israel, thirty thousand men in number;

chinese: 派他們輪流每月一萬人上利巴嫩去；一個月在利巴嫩，兩個月在家裡。亞多尼蘭掌管他們。
english: And sent them to Lebanon in bands of ten thousand every month: for a month they were working in Lebanon and for two months in their country, and Adoniram was in control of them.

chinese: 所羅門用七萬扛抬的，八萬在山上鑿石頭的。
english: Then he had seventy thousand for the work of transport, and eighty thousand stone-cutters in the mountains;

chinese: 此外，所羅門用三千三百督工的，監管工人。
english: In addition to the chiefs of the responsible men put by Solomon to oversee the work, three thousand and three hundred in authority over the workmen.

chinese: 王下令，人就鑿出又大又寶貴的石頭來，用以立殿的根基。
english: By the king's orders great stones, stones of high price, were cut out, so that the base of the house might be made of squared stone.

chinese: 所羅門的匠人和希蘭的匠人，並迦巴勒人，都將石頭鑿好，預備木料和石頭建殿。
english: Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did the work of cutting them, and put edges on them, and got the wood and the stone ready for the building of the house.

chinese: 以色列人出埃及地後四百八十年，所羅門作以色列王第四年西弗月，就是二月，開工建造耶和華的殿。
english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year that Solomon was king of Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, the building of the Lord's house was started.

chinese: 所羅門王為耶和華所建的殿，長六十肘，寬二十肘，高三十肘。
english: The house which Solomon made for the Lord was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.

chinese: 殿前的廊子長二十肘，與殿的寬窄一樣，闊十肘；
english: The covered way before the Temple of the house was twenty cubits long, as wide as the house, and ten cubits wide in front of the house.

chinese: 又為殿做了嚴緊的窗櫺。
english: And for the house he made windows, with network across.

chinese: 靠著殿牆，圍著外殿內殿，造了三層旁屋；
english: And against the walls all round, and against the walls of the Temple and of the inmost room, he put up wings, with side rooms all round:

chinese: 下層寬五肘，中層寬六肘，上層寬七肘。殿外旁屋的梁木擱在殿牆坎上，免得插入殿牆。
english: The lowest line of them being five cubits wide, the middle six cubits wide and the third seven cubits; for there was a space all round the outside walls of the house so that the boards supporting the rooms did not have to be fixed in the walls of the house.

chinese: 建殿是用山中鑿成的石頭。建殿的時候，鎚子、斧子，和別樣鐵器的響聲都沒有聽見。
english: (And the stones used in the building of the house were squared at the place where they were cut out; there was no sound of hammer or axe or any iron instrument while they were building the house.)

chinese: 在殿右邊當中的旁屋有門，門內有旋螺的樓梯，可以上到第二層，從第二層可以上到第三層。
english: The door to the lowest side rooms was in the right side of the house; and they went up by twisting steps into the middle rooms, and from the middle into the third.

chinese: 所羅門建殿，安置香柏木的棟梁，又用香柏木板遮蓋。
english: So he put up the house and made it complete, roofing it with boards of cedar-wood.

chinese: 靠著殿所造的旁屋，每層高五肘，香柏木的棟梁擱在殿牆坎上。
english: And he put up the line of side rooms against the walls of the house, fifteen cubits high, resting against the house on boards of cedar-wood.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到所羅門說：
english: (And the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,

chinese: 論到你所建的這殿，你若遵行我的律例，謹守我的典章，遵從我的一切誡命，我必向你應驗我所應許你父親大衛的話。
english: About this house which you are building: if you will keep my laws and give effect to my decisions and be guided by my rules, I will give effect to my word which I gave to David your father.

chinese: 我必住在以色列人中間，並不丟棄我民以色列。
english: And I will be ever among the children of Israel, and will not go away from my people.

chinese: 所羅門建造殿宇。
english: So Solomon made the building of the house complete.)

chinese: 殿裡面用香柏木板貼牆，從地到棚頂都用木板遮蔽，又用松木板鋪地。
english: The walls of the house were covered inside with cedar-wood boards; from the floor to the roof of the house they were covered inside with wood; and the floor was covered with boards of cypress-wood.

chinese: 內殿，就是至聖所，長二十肘，從地到棚頂用香柏木板遮蔽(或作隔斷)。
english: And at the back of the house a further space of twenty cubits was shut in with boards of cedar-wood, for the inmost room.

chinese: 內殿前的外殿，長四十肘。
english: And the house, that is, the Temple, in front of the holy place was forty cubits long.

chinese: 殿裡一點石頭都不顯露，一概用香柏木遮蔽；上面刻著野瓜和初開的花。
english: (All the inside of the house was cedar-wood, ornamented with designs of buds and flowers; no stonework was to be seen inside.)

chinese: 殿裡預備了內殿，好安放耶和華的約櫃。
english: And he made ready an inmost room in the middle of the house, in which to put the ark of the agreement of the Lord.

chinese: 內殿長二十肘，寬二十肘，高二十肘，牆面都貼上精金；又用香柏木做壇，包上精金。
english: And the inmost room was twenty cubits square and twenty cubits high, plated over with clear gold, and he made an altar of cedar-wood, plating it with gold.

chinese: 所羅門用精金貼了殿內的牆，又用金鍊子掛在內殿前門扇，用金包裹。
english: Solomon had all the inside of the house covered with gold, and he put chains of gold across in front of the inmost room, which itself was covered with gold.

chinese: 全殿都貼上金子，直到貼完；內殿前的壇，也都用金包裹。
english: Plates of gold were put all through the house till it was covered completely (and the altar in the inmost room was all covered with gold).

chinese: 他用橄欖木做兩個基路伯，各高十肘，安在內殿。
english: In the inmost room he made two winged beings of olive-wood, ten cubits high;

chinese: 這一個基路伯有兩個翅膀，各長五肘，從這翅膀尖到那翅膀尖共有十肘；
english: With outstretched wings five cubits wide; the distance from the edge of one wing to the edge of the other was ten cubits.

chinese: 那一個基路伯的兩個翅膀也是十肘，兩個基路伯的尺寸、形像都是一樣。
english: The two winged ones were ten cubits high, of the same size and form.

chinese: 這基路伯高十肘，那基路伯也是如此。
english: The two of them were ten cubits high.

chinese: 他將兩個基路伯安在內殿裡；基路伯的翅膀是張開的，這基路伯的一個翅膀挨著這邊的牆，那基路伯的一個翅膀挨著那邊的牆，裡邊的兩個翅膀在殿中間彼此相接；
english: These were placed inside the inner house, their outstretched wings touching the walls of the house, one touching one wall and one the other, while their other wings were touching in the middle.

chinese: 又用金子包裹二基路伯。
english: These winged ones were plated over with gold.

chinese: 內殿、外殿周圍的牆上都刻著基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花。
english: And all the walls of the house inside and out were ornamented with forms of winged ones and palm-trees and open flowers.

chinese: 內殿、外殿的地板都貼上金子。
english: And the floor of the house was covered with gold, inside and out.

chinese: 又用橄欖木製造內殿的門扇、門楣、門框；門口有牆的五分之一。
english: For the way into the inmost room he made doors of olive-wood, the arch and the door supports forming a five-sided opening.

chinese: 在橄欖木做的兩門扇上刻著基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花，都貼上金子。
english: On the olive-wood doors were cut designs of winged ones and palm-trees and open flowers, all of them, with the doors, plated with gold.

chinese: 又用橄欖木製造外殿的門框，門口有牆的四分之一。
english: Then he made pillars of olive-wood for the way into the Temple; the pillars were square:

chinese: 用松木做門兩扇。這扇分兩扇，是摺疊的；那扇分兩扇；也是摺疊的。
english: And two folding doors of cypress-wood, with two leaves.

chinese: 上面刻著基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花，都用金子貼了。
english: These were ornamented with designs of winged ones and palm-trees and open flowers, plated over with gold.

chinese: 他又用鑿成的石頭三層、香柏木一層建築內院。
english: And the inner space was walled with three lines of squared stones and a line of cedar-wood boards.

chinese: 所羅門在位第四年西弗月，立了耶和華殿的根基。
english: In the fourth year the base of the house was put in its place, in the month Ziv.

chinese: 到十一年布勒月，就是八月，殿和一切屬殿的都按著樣式造成。他建殿的工夫共有七年。
english: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the building of the house was complete in every detail, as it had been designed. So he was seven years building it.

chinese: 所羅門為自己建造宮室，十三年方才造成；
english: Solomon was thirteen years building a house for himself till it was complete.

chinese: 又建造利巴嫩林宮，長一百肘，寬五十肘，高三十肘，有香柏木柱三(原文作四)行，柱上有香柏木柁梁。
english: And he made the house of the Woods of Lebanon, which was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high, resting on four lines of cedar-wood pillars with cedar-wood supports on the pillars.

chinese: 其上以香柏木為蓋，每行柱子十五根，共有四十五根。
english: And it was covered with cedar over the forty-five supports which were on the pillars, fifteen in a line.

chinese: 有窗戶三層，窗與窗相對。
english: There were three lines of window-frames, window facing window in every line.

chinese: 所有的門框都是厚木見方的，有窗戶三層，窗與窗相對。
english: And all the doors and windows had square frames, with the windows facing one another in three lines.

chinese: 並建造有柱子的廊子，長五十肘，寬三十肘；在這廊前又有廊子，廊外有柱子和臺階。
english: And he made a covered room of pillars, fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide, and ... with steps before it.

chinese: 又建造一廊，其中設立審判的座位，這廊從地到頂都用香柏木遮蔽。
english: Then he made a covered room for his high seat when he gave decisions; this was the covered room of judging; it was covered with cedar-wood from floor to roof.

chinese: 廊後院內有所羅門住的宮室；工作與這工作相同。所羅門又為所娶法老的女兒建造一宮，做法與這廊子一樣。
english: And the house for his living-place, the other open square in the covered room, was made in the same way. And then he made a house like it for Pharaoh's daughter, whom Solomon had taken as his wife.

chinese: 建造這一切所用的石頭都是寶貴的，是按著尺寸鑿成的，是用鋸裡外鋸齊的；從根基直到檐石，從外頭直到大院，都是如此。
english: All these buildings were made, inside and out, from base to crowning stone, and outside to the great walled square, of highly priced stone, cut to different sizes with cutting-instruments.

chinese: 根基是寶貴的大石頭，有長十肘的，有長八肘的；
english: And the base was of great masses of highly priced stone, some ten cubits and some eight cubits square.

chinese: 上面有香柏木和按著尺寸鑿成寶貴的石頭。
english: Overhead were highly priced stones cut to measure, and cedar-wood.

chinese: 大院周圍有鑿成的石頭三層、香柏木一層，都照耶和華殿的內院和殿廊的樣式。
english: The great outer square all round was walled with three lines of squared stones and a line of cedar-wood boards, round about the open square inside the house of the Lord and the covered room of the king's house.

chinese: 所羅門王差遣人往推羅去，將戶蘭召了來。
english: Then King Solomon sent and got Hiram from Tyre.

chinese: 他是拿弗他利支派中一個寡婦的兒子，他父親是推羅人，作銅匠的。戶蘭滿有智慧、聰明、技能，善於各樣銅作。他來到所羅門王那裡，做王一切所要做的。
english: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass; he was full of wisdom and knowledge and an expert worker in brass. He came to King Solomon and did all his work for him.

chinese: 他製造兩根銅柱，每根高十八肘，圍十二肘。
english: He it was who made the two brass pillars; the first pillar was eighteen cubits high, and a line of twelve cubits went round it; and the second was the same.

chinese: 又用銅鑄了兩個柱頂安在柱上，各高五肘。
english: And he made the two crowns to be put on the tops of the pillars, of brass made soft in the fire; the crowns were five cubits high.

chinese: 柱頂上有裝修的網子和擰成的鍊索，每頂七個。
english: There were nets of open-work for the crowns on the tops of the pillars, a net of open-work for one and a net of open-work for the other.

chinese: 網子周圍有兩行石榴遮蓋柱頂，兩個柱頂都是如此。
english: And he made ornaments of apples; and two lines of apples all round over the network, covering the crowns of the pillars, the two crowns in the same way.

chinese: 廊子的柱頂徑四肘，刻著百合花。
english: The crowns on the tops of the pillars were ornamented with a design of flowers, and were four cubits across.

chinese: 兩柱頂的鼓肚上挨著網子，各有兩行石榴環繞，兩行共有二百。
english: And there were crowns on the two pillars near the round part by the network, and there were two hundred apples in lines round every crown.

chinese: 他將兩根柱子立在殿廊前頭：右邊立一根，起名叫雅斤；左邊立一根，起名叫波阿斯。
english: He put up the pillars at the doorway of the Temple, naming the one on the right Jachin, and that on the left Boaz.

chinese: 在柱頂上刻著百合花。這樣，造柱子的工就完畢了。
english: The tops of the pillars had a design of flowers; and the work of making the pillars was complete.

chinese: 他又鑄一個銅海，樣式是圓的，高五肘，徑十肘，圍三十肘。
english: And he made a great metal water-vessel ten cubits across from edge to edge, five cubits high and thirty cubits round.

chinese: 在海邊之下，周圍有野瓜的樣式；每肘十瓜，共有兩行，是鑄海的時候鑄上的。
english: And under the edge of it, circling it all round for ten cubits, were two lines of flower buds, made together with it from liquid metal.

chinese: 有十二隻銅牛馱海：三隻向北，三隻向西，三隻向南，三隻向東；海在牛上，牛尾都向內。
english: It was supported on twelve oxen, with their back parts turned to the middle of it, three of them facing to the north, three to the west, three to the south, and three to the east; the vessel was resting on top of them.

chinese: 海厚一掌，邊如杯邊，又如百合花，可容二千罷特。
english: It was as thick as a man's open hand, and was curved like the edge of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it would take two thousand baths.

chinese: 他用銅製造十個盆座，每座長四肘，寬四肘，高三肘。
english: And he made ten wheeled bases of brass; every one four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.

chinese: 座的造法是這樣：四面都有心子，心子在邊子當中，
english: And the bases were made in this way; their sides were square, fixed in a framework;

chinese: 心子上有獅子和牛，並基路伯；邊上有小座，獅子和牛以下有垂下的瓔珞。
english: And on the square sides between the frames were lions, oxen, and winged ones; and the same on the frame; and over and under the lions and the oxen and the winged ones were steps.

chinese: 每盆座有四個銅輪和銅軸。小座的四角上在盆以下，有鑄成的盆架，其旁都有瓔珞。
english: Every base had four wheels of brass, turning on brass rods, and their four angles had angle-plates under them; the angle-plates under the base were of metal, and there were ornaments at the side of every one.

chinese: 小座高一肘，口是圓的，彷彿座的樣式，徑一肘半，在口上有雕工，心子是方的，不是圓的。
english: The mouth of it inside the angle-plate was one cubit across; it was round like a pillar, a cubit and a half across; it had designs cut on it; the sides were square, not round.

chinese: 四個輪子在心子以下，輪軸與座相連，每輪高一肘半。
english: The four wheels were under the frames, and the rods on which the wheels were fixed were in the base; the wheels were a cubit and a half high.

chinese: 輪的樣式如同車輪；軸、輞、輻、轂都是鑄的。
english: The wheels were made like carriage-wheels, the rods on which they were fixed, the parts forming their edges, their rods and the middle points of them, were all formed out of liquid metal.

chinese: 每座四角上都有盆架，是與座一同鑄成的。
english: And there were four angle-plates at the four angles of every base, forming part of the structure of the base.

chinese: 座上有圓架，高半肘；座上有撐子和心子，是與座一同鑄的。
english: And at the top of the base there was a round vessel, half a cubit high;

chinese: 在撐子和心子上刻著基路伯、獅子，和棕樹，周圍有瓔珞。
english: In the spaces of the flat sides and on the frames of them, he made designs of winged ones, lions, and palm-trees, with ornamented edges all round.

chinese: 十個盆座都是這樣，鑄法、尺寸、樣式相同。
english: All the ten bases were made in this way, after the same design, of the same size and form.

chinese: 又用銅製造十個盆，每盆可容四十罷特。盆徑四肘，在那十座上，每座安設一盆。
english: And he made ten brass washing-vessels, everyone taking forty baths, and measuring four cubits; one vessel was placed on every one of the ten bases.

chinese: 五個安在殿門的右邊，五個放在殿門的左邊；又將海放在殿門的右旁，就是南邊。
english: And he put the bases by the house, five on the right side and five on the left; and he put the great water-vessel on the right side of the house, to the east, facing south.

chinese: 戶蘭又造了盆、鏟子，和盤子。這樣，他為所羅門王做完了耶和華殿的一切工。
english: And Hiram made the pots and spades and the basins. So Hiram came to the end of all the work he did for King Solomon in the house of the Lord:

chinese: 所造的就是：兩根柱子和柱上兩個如球的頂；並兩個蓋柱頂的網子；
english: The two pillars and the two cups of the crowns which were on the tops of the two pillars; and the network covering the two cups of the crowns on the tops of the pillars,

chinese: 和四百石榴，安在兩個網子上，每網兩行，蓋著兩個柱上如球的頂；
english: And the four hundred apples for the network, two lines of apples for every network, covering the two cups of the crowns on the pillars;

chinese: 十個座和其上的十個盆；
english: And the ten bases, with the ten washing-vessels on them;

chinese: 海和海下的十二隻牛；
english: And the great water-vessel, with the twelve oxen under it;

chinese: 盆、鏟子、盤子。這一切都是戶蘭給所羅門王用光亮的銅為耶和華的殿造成的，
english: And the pots and the spades and the basins; all the vessels which Hiram made for King Solomon, for the house of the Lord, were of polished brass.

chinese: 是遵王命在約但平原、疏割和撒拉但中間藉膠泥鑄成的。
english: He made them of liquid metal in the lowland of Jordan, at the way across the river, at Adama, between Succoth and Zarethan.

chinese: 這一切所羅門都沒有過秤；因為甚多，銅的輕重也無法可查。
english: The weight of all these vessels was not measured, because there was such a number of them; it was not possible to get the weight of the brass.

chinese: 所羅門又造耶和華殿裡的金壇和陳設餅的金桌子；
english: And Solomon had all the vessels made for use in the house of the Lord: the altar of gold and the gold table on which the holy bread was placed;

chinese: 內殿前的精金燈臺：右邊五個，左邊五個，並其上的金花、燈盞、蠟剪，
english: And the supports for the lights, five on the right side and five on the left before the inmost room, of clear gold; and the flowers and the lights and all the instruments of gold;

chinese: 與精金的杯、盤、鑷子、調羹、火鼎，以及至聖所、內殿的門樞，和外殿的門樞。
english: And the cups and the scissors and the basins and the spoons and the fire-trays, all of gold; and the pins on which the doors were turned, the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and the doors of the Temple, all of gold.

chinese: 所羅門王做完了耶和華殿的一切工，就把他父大衛分別為聖的金銀和器皿都帶來放在耶和華殿的府庫裡。
english: So all the work King Solomon had done in the house of the Lord was complete. Then Solomon took the holy things which David his father had given, the silver and the gold and all the vessels, and put them in the store-houses of the house of the Lord.

chinese: 那時，所羅門將以色列的長老和各支派的首領，並以色列的族長，招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和華的約櫃從大衛城─就是錫安─運上來。
english: Then Solomon sent for all the responsible men of Israel, and all the chiefs of the tribes, and the heads of families of the children of Israel, to come to him in Jerusalem to take the ark of the Lord's agreement up out of the town of David, which is Zion.

chinese: 以他念月，就是七月，在節前，以色列人都聚集到所羅門王那裡。
english: And all the men of Israel came together to King Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, the seventh month.

chinese: 以色列長老來到，祭司便抬起約櫃，
english: And all the responsible men of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

chinese: 祭司和利未人將耶和華的約櫃運上來，又將會幕和會幕的一切聖器具都帶上來。
english: They took up the ark of the Lord, and the Tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels which were in the Tent; all these the priests and the Levites took up.

chinese: 所羅門王和聚集到他那裡的以色列全會眾，一同在約櫃前獻牛羊為祭，多得不可勝數。
english: And King Solomon and all the men of Israel who had come together there, were with him before the ark, making offerings of sheep and oxen more than might be numbered.

chinese: 祭司將耶和華的約櫃抬進內殿，就是至聖所，放在兩個基路伯的翅膀底下。
english: And the priests took the ark of the agreement of the Lord and put it in its place in the inner room of the house, in the most holy place, under the wings of the winged ones.

chinese: 基路伯張著翅膀在約櫃之上，遮掩約櫃和抬櫃的杠。
english: For their wings were outstretched over the place where the ark was, covering the ark and its rods.

chinese: 這杠甚長，杠頭在內殿前的聖所可以看見，在殿外卻不能看見，直到如今還在那裡。
english: The rods were so long that their ends were seen from the holy place, in front of the inmost room; but they were not seen from outside: and there they are to this day.

chinese: 約櫃裡惟有兩塊石版，就是以色列人出埃及地後，耶和華與他們立約的時候摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，並無別物。
english: There was nothing in the ark but the two flat stones which Moses put there at Horeb, where the Lord made an agreement with the children of Israel when they came out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 祭司從聖所出來的時候，有雲充滿耶和華的殿；
english: Now when the priests had come out of the holy place, the house of the Lord was full of the cloud,

chinese: 甚至祭司不能站立供職，因為耶和華的榮光充滿了殿。
english: So that the priests were not able to keep their places to do their work because of the cloud, for the house of the Lord was full of the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 那時所羅門說：耶和華曾說，他必住在幽暗之處。
english: Then Solomon said, O Lord, to the sun you have given the heaven for a living-place, but your living-place was not seen by men;

chinese: 我已經建造殿宇作你的居所，為你永遠的住處。
english: So I have made for you a living-place, a house in which you may be for ever present.

chinese: 王轉臉為以色列會眾祝福，以色列會眾就都站立。
english: Then, turning his face about, the king gave a blessing to all the men of Israel; and they were all on their feet together.

chinese: 所羅門說：耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的！因他親口向我父大衛所應許的，也親手成就了。
english: And he said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, who himself gave his word to David my father, and with his strong hand has made his word come true, saying,

chinese: 他說：自從我領我民以色列出埃及以來，我未曾在以色列各支派中選擇一城建造殿宇─為我名的居所，但揀選大衛治理我民以色列。
english: From the day when I took my people Israel out of Egypt, no town in all the tribes of Israel has been marked out by me for the building of a house for the resting-place of my name; but I made selection of David to be king over my people Israel.

chinese: 所羅門說：我父大衛曾立意，要為耶和華─以色列神的名建殿。
english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to put up a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華卻對我父大衛說：你立意為我的名建殿，這意思甚好。
english: But the Lord said to David my father, You did well to have in your heart the desire to make a house for my name;

chinese: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的兒子必為我名建殿。
english: But you yourself will not be the builder of my house; but your son, the offspring of your body, he it is who will put up a house for my name.

chinese: 現在耶和華成就了他所應許的話，使我接續我父大衛坐以色列的國位，又為耶和華─以色列神的名建造了殿。
english: And the Lord has made his word come true; for I have taken my father David's place on the seat of the kingdom of Israel, as the Lord gave his word; and I have made a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 我也在其中為約櫃預備一處。約櫃內有耶和華的約，就是他領我們列祖出埃及地的時候，與他們所立的約。
english: In it I have made a place for the ark, in which is the agreement which the Lord made with our fathers, when he took them out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 所羅門當著以色列會眾，站在耶和華的壇前，向天舉手說：
english: Then Solomon took his place before the altar of the Lord, all the men of Israel being present, and stretching out his hands to heaven,

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神啊，天上地下沒有　神可比你的！你向那盡心行在你面前的僕人守約施慈愛；
english: Said, O Lord, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on the earth; keeping faith and mercy unchanging for your servants, while they go in your ways with all their hearts.

chinese: 向你僕人─我父大衛所應許的話現在應驗了。你親口應許，親手成就，正如今日一樣。
english: And you have kept the word which you gave to your servant David, my father; with your mouth you said it and with your hand you have made it come true this day.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神啊，你所應許你僕人─我父大衛的話說：你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，在我面前行事像你所行的一樣，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。現在求你應驗這話。
english: So now, O Lord, the God of Israel, let your word to your servant David, my father, come true, when you said, You will never be without a man to take his place on the seat of the kingdom of Israel before me, if only your children give attention to their ways, walking before me as you have done.

chinese: 以色列的神啊，求你成就向你僕人─我父大衛所應許的話。
english: So now, O God of Israel, it is my prayer that you will make your word come true which you said to your servant David, my father.

chinese: 神果真住在地上麼？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何況我所建的這殿呢？
english: But is it truly possible that God may be housed on earth? see, heaven and the heaven of heavens are not wide enough to be your resting-place; how much less this house which I have made!

chinese: 惟求耶和華─我的神垂顧僕人的禱告祈求，俯聽僕人今日在你面前的祈禱呼籲。
english: Still, let your heart be turned to the prayer of your servant, O Lord God, and to his prayer for grace; give ear to the cry and the prayer which your servant sends up to you this day;

chinese: 願你晝夜看顧這殿，就是你應許立為你名的居所；求你垂聽僕人向此處禱告的話。
english: That your eyes may be open to this house night and day, to this place of which you have said, My name will be there; hearing the prayer which your servant may make, turning to this place.

chinese: 你僕人和你民以色列向此處祈禱的時候，求你在天上你的居所垂聽，垂聽而赦免。
english: Give ear to the prayers of your servant, and the prayers of your people Israel, when they make their prayers, turning to this place; give ear in heaven your living-place, and hearing, have mercy.

chinese: 人若得罪鄰舍，有人叫他起誓，他來到這殿在你的壇前起誓，
english: If a man does wrong to his neighbour, and has to take an oath, and comes before your altar to take his oath in this house:

chinese: 求你在天上垂聽，判斷你的僕人：定惡人有罪，照他所行的報應在他頭上；定義人有理，照他的義賞賜他。
english: Then let your ear be open in heaven, and be the judge of your servants, giving your decision against the wrongdoer, so that punishment for his sins may come on his head; and, by your decision, keeping from evil him who has done no wrong.

chinese: 你的民以色列若得罪你，敗在仇敵面前，又歸向你，承認你的名，在這殿裡祈求禱告，
english: When your people Israel are overcome in war, because of their sin against you; if they are turned to you again, honouring your name, making prayers to you and requesting your grace in this house:

chinese: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他們歸回你賜給他們列祖之地。
english: Then give ear in heaven, and let the sin of your people Israel have forgiveness, and take them back again into the land which you gave to their fathers.

chinese: 你的民因得罪你，你懲罰他們，使天閉塞不下雨；他們若向此處禱告，承認你的名，離開他們的罪，
english: When heaven is shut up and there is no rain, because of their sin against you; if they make prayers with their faces turned to this place, honouring your name and turning away from their sin when you send trouble on them:

chinese: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你僕人以色列民的罪，將當行的善道指教他們，且降雨在你的地，就是你賜給你民為業之地。
english: Then give ear in heaven, so that the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, may have forgiveness, when you make clear to them the good way in which they are to go; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for their heritage.

chinese: 國中若有饑荒、瘟疫、旱風、霉爛、蝗蟲、螞蚱，或有仇敵犯境圍困城邑，無論遭遇甚麼災禍疾病，
english: If there is no food in the land, or if there is disease, or if the fruits of the earth are damaged through heat or water, locust or worm; if their towns are shut in by their attackers; whatever trouble, whatever disease there may be:

chinese: 你的民以色列，或是眾人，或是一人，自覺有罪(原文作災)，向這殿舉手，無論祈求甚麼，禱告甚麼，
english: Whatever prayer or request for your grace is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, whatever his trouble may be, whose hands are stretched out to this house:

chinese: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他們（惟有你知道世人的心），
english: Give ear in heaven your living-place, acting in mercy; and give to every man whose secret heart is open to you, the reward of all his ways; for you, and you only, have knowledge of the hearts of all the children of men:

chinese: 使他們在你賜給我們列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你。
english: So that they may give you worship all the days of their life in the land which you gave to our fathers.

chinese: 論到不屬你民以色列的外邦人，為你名從遠方而來，
english: And as for the man from a strange land, who is not of your people Israel; when he comes from a far country because of the glory of your name:

chinese: （他們聽人論說你的大名和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂）向這殿禱告，
english: (For they will have news of your great name and your strong hand and your out-stretched arm;) when he comes to make his prayer, turning to this house:

chinese: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽，照著外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下萬民都認識你的名，敬畏你像你的民以色列一樣；又使他們知道我建造的這殿是稱為你名下的。
english: Give ear in heaven your living-place, and give him his desire, whatever it may be; so that all the peoples of the earth may have knowledge of your name, worshipping you as do your people Israel, and that they may see that this house which I have put up is truly named by your name.

chinese: 你的民若奉你的差遣，無論往何處去與仇敵爭戰，向耶和華所選擇的城與我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
english: If your people go out to war against their attackers, by whatever way you may send them, if they make their prayer to the Lord, turning their faces to this town of yours and to this house which I have made for your name:

chinese: 求你在天上垂聽他們的禱告祈求，使他們得勝。
english: Give ear in heaven to their prayer and their cry for grace, and see right done to them.

chinese: 你的民若得罪你（世上沒有不犯罪的人），你向他們發怒，將他們交給仇敵擄到仇敵之地，或遠或近，
english: If they do wrong against you, (for no man is without sin,) and you are angry with them and give them up into the power of those who are fighting against them, so that they take them away as prisoners into a strange land, far off or near;

chinese: 他們若在擄到之地想起罪來，回心轉意，懇求你說：我們有罪了，我們悖逆了，我們作惡了；
english: And if they take thought, in the land where they are prisoners, and are turned again to you, crying out in prayer to you in that land, and saying, We are sinners, we have done wrong, we have done evil;

chinese: 他們若在擄到之地盡心盡性歸服你，又向自己的地，就是你賜給他們列祖之地和你所選擇的城，並我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
english: And with all their heart and soul are turned again to you, in the land of those who took them prisoners, and make their prayer to you, turning their eyes to this land which you gave to their fathers, and to the town which you took for yourself, and the house which I made for your name:

chinese: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽他們的禱告祈求，為他們伸冤；
english: Then give ear to their prayer and to their cry in heaven your living-place, and see right done to them;

chinese: 饒恕得罪你的民，赦免他們的一切過犯，使他們在擄他們的人面前蒙憐恤。
english: Answering with forgiveness the people who have done wrong against you, and overlooking the evil which they have done against you; let those who made them prisoners be moved with pity for them, and have pity on them;

chinese: 因為他們是你的子民，你的產業，是你從埃及領出來脫離鐵爐的。
english: For they are your people and your heritage, which you took out of Egypt, out of the iron fireplace;

chinese: 願你的眼目看顧僕人，聽你民以色列的祈求，無論何時向你祈求，願你垂聽。
english: Let your eyes be open to your servant's prayer for grace and to the prayer of your people Israel, hearing them when their cry comes to you.

chinese: 主耶和華啊，你將他們從地上的萬民中分別出來作你的產業，是照你領我們列祖出埃及的時候，藉你僕人摩西所應許的話。
english: For you made them separate from all the peoples of the earth, to be your heritage, as you said by Moses your servant, when you took our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord God.

chinese: 所羅門在耶和華的壇前屈膝跪著，向天舉手，在耶和華面前禱告祈求已畢，就起來，
english: Then Solomon, after making all these prayers and requests for grace to the Lord, got up from his knees before the altar of the Lord, where his hands had been stretched out in prayer to heaven;

chinese: 站著，大聲為以色列全會眾祝福，說：
english: And, getting on his feet, he gave a blessing to all the men of Israel, saying with a loud voice,

chinese: 耶和華是應當稱頌的！因為他照著一切所應許的賜平安給他的民以色列人，凡藉他僕人摩西應許賜福的話，一句都沒有落空。
english: Praise be to the Lord who has given rest to his people Israel, as he gave them his word to do; every word of all his oath, which he gave by the hand of Moses his servant, has come true.

chinese: 願耶和華─我們的神與我們同在，像與我們列祖同在一樣，不撇下我們，不丟棄我們，
english: Now may the Lord our God be with us as he was with our fathers; let him never go away from us or give us up;

chinese: 使我們的心歸向他，遵行他的道，謹守他吩咐我們列祖的誡命、律例、典章。
english: Turning our hearts to himself, guiding us to go in all his ways, to keep his orders and his laws and his decisions, which he gave to our fathers.

chinese: 我在耶和華面前祈求的這些話，願耶和華─我們的神晝夜垂念，每日為他僕人與他民以色列伸冤，
english: And may these my words, the words of my prayer to the Lord, be before the Lord our God day and night, so that he may see right done to his servant and to his people Israel, day by day as we have need.

chinese: 使地上的萬民都知道惟獨耶和華是神，並無別神。
english: So that all the peoples of the earth may see that the Lord is God, and there is no other.

chinese: 所以你們當向耶和華─我們的神存誠實的心，遵行他的律例，謹守他的誡命，至終如今日一樣。
english: Then let your hearts be without sin before the Lord our God, walking in his laws and keeping his orders as at this day.

chinese: 王和以色列眾民一同在耶和華面前獻祭。
english: Now the king, and all Israel with him, were making offerings before the Lord.

chinese: 所羅門向耶和華獻平安祭，用牛二萬二千，羊十二萬。這樣，王和以色列眾民為耶和華的殿行奉獻之禮。
english: And Solomon gave to the Lord for peace-offerings, twenty-two thousand oxen and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel kept the feast of the opening of the Lord's house.

chinese: 當日，王因耶和華殿前的銅壇太小，容不下燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便將耶和華殿前院子當中分別為聖，在那裡獻燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。
english: The same day the king made holy the middle of the open square in front of the house of the Lord, offering there the burned offering and the meal offering and the fat of the peace-offerings; for there was not room on the brass altar of the Lord for the burned offerings and the meal offerings and the fat of the peace-offerings.

chinese: 那時，所羅門和以色列眾人，就是從哈馬口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成為大會，在耶和華─我們的神面前守節七日又七日，共十四日。
english: So Solomon and all Israel with him, a very great meeting, (for the people had come together from the way into Hamath to the river of Egypt,) kept the feast at that time before the Lord our God, for two weeks, even fourteen days.

chinese: 第八日，王遣散眾民；他們都為王祝福。因見耶和華向他僕人大衛和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜樂，各歸各家去了。
english: And on the eighth day he sent the people away, and, blessing the king, they went to their tents full of joy and glad in their hearts, because of all the good which the Lord had done to David his servant and to Israel his people.

chinese: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，並一切所願意建造的都完畢了，
english: Now when Solomon came to the end of building the house of the Lord and the king's house, and all Solomon's desires, which he had in mind were effected;
