chinese: 耶和華就二次向所羅門顯現，如先前在基遍向他顯現一樣，
english: The Lord came to him again in a vision, as he had done at Gibeon;

chinese: 對他說：你向我所禱告祈求的，我都應允了。我已將你所建的這殿分別為聖，使我的名永遠在其中；我的眼、我的心也必常在那裡。
english: And the Lord said to him, Your prayers and your requests for grace have come to my ears: I have made holy this house which you have made, and I have put my name there for ever; my eyes and my heart will be there at all times.

chinese: 你若效法你父大衛，存誠實正直的心行在我面前，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，謹守我的律例典章，
english: As for you, if you will go on your way before me, as David your father did, uprightly and with a true heart, doing what I have given you orders to do, keeping my laws and my decisions;

chinese: 我就必堅固你的國位在以色列中，直到永遠，正如我應許你父大衛說：你的子孫必不斷人坐以色列的國位。
english: Then I will make the seat of your rule over Israel certain for ever, as I gave my word to David your father, saying, You will never be without a man to be king in Israel.

chinese: 倘若你們和你們的子孫轉去不跟從我，不守我指示你們的誡命律例，去事奉敬拜別神，
english: But if you are turned from my ways, you or your children, and do not keep my orders and my laws which I have put before you, but go and make yourselves servants to other gods and give them worship:

chinese: 我就必將以色列人從我賜給他們的地上剪除，並且我為己名所分別為聖的殿也必捨棄不顧，使以色列人在萬民中作笑談，被譏誚。
english: Then I will have Israel cut off from the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for myself, I will put away from before my eyes; and Israel will be a public example, and a word of shame among all peoples.

chinese: 這殿雖然甚高，將來經過的人必驚訝、嗤笑，說：耶和華為何向這地和這殿如此行呢？
english: And this house will become a mass of broken walls, and everyone who goes by will be overcome with wonder at it and make whistling sounds; and they will say, Why has the Lord done so to this land and to this house?

chinese: 人必回答說：是因此地的人離棄領他們列祖出埃及地之耶和華─他們的神，去親近別　神，事奉敬拜他，所以耶和華使這一切災禍臨到他們。
english: And their answer will be, Because they were turned away from the Lord their God, who took their fathers out of the land of Egypt; they took for themselves other gods and gave them worship and became their servants: that is why the Lord has sent all this evil on them.

chinese: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，這兩所二十年才完畢了。
english: Now at the end of twenty years, in which time Solomon had put up the two houses, the house of the Lord and the king's house,

chinese: 推羅王希蘭曾照所羅門所要的，資助他香柏木、松木，和金子；所羅門王就把加利利地的二十座城給了希蘭。
english: (Hiram, king of Tyre, had given Solomon cedar-trees and cypress-trees and gold, as much as he had need of,) King Solomon gave Hiram twenty towns in the land of Galilee.

chinese: 希蘭從推羅出來，察看所羅門給他的城邑，就不喜悅，
english: But when Hiram came from Tyre to see the towns which Solomon had given him, he was not pleased with them.

chinese: 說：我兄啊，你給我的是甚麼城邑呢？他就給這城邑之地起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。
english: And he said, What sort of towns are these which you have given me, my brother? So they were named the land of Cabul, to this day.

chinese: 希蘭給所羅門一百二十他連得金子。
english: And Hiram sent the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold.

chinese: 所羅門王挑取服苦的人，是為建造耶和華的殿、自己的宮、米羅、耶路撒冷的城牆、夏瑣、米吉多，並基色。
english: Now, this was the way of Solomon's system of forced work for the building of the Lord's house and of the king's house, and the Millo and the wall of Jerusalem and Megiddo and Gezer. ...

chinese: 先前埃及王法老上來攻取基色，用火焚燒，殺了城內居住的迦南人，將城賜給他女兒所羅門的妻作妝奩。
english: Pharaoh, king of Egypt, came and took Gezer, burning it down and putting to death the Canaanites living in the town, and he gave it for a bride-offering to his daughter, Solomon's wife. ...

chinese: 所羅門建造基色、下伯和崙、
english: ... and Solomon was the builder of Gezer and Beth-horon the lower,

chinese: 巴拉，並國中曠野裡的達莫，
english: And Baalath and Tamar in the waste land, in that land;

chinese: 又建造所有的積貨城，並屯車和馬兵的城，與耶路撒冷、利巴嫩，以及自己治理的全國中所願建造的。
english: And all the store-towns and the towns which Solomon had for his war-carriages and for his horsemen, and everything which it was his pleasure to put up in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all the land under his rule.

chinese: 至於國中所剩下不屬以色列人的亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
english: As for the rest of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not children of Israel;

chinese: 就是以色列人不能滅盡的，所羅門挑取他們的後裔作服苦的奴僕，直到今日。
english: Their children who were still in the land, and whom the children of Israel had not been able to put to complete destruction, them did Solomon put to forced work, to this day.

chinese: 惟有以色列人，所羅門不使他們作奴僕，乃是作他的戰士、臣僕、統領、軍長、車兵長、馬兵長。
english: But Solomon did not put the children of Israel to forced work; they were the men of war, his servants, his captains, and his chiefs, captains of his war-carriages and of his horsemen.

chinese: 所羅門有五百五十督工的，監管工人。
english: These were the chiefs of the overseers of Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, in authority over the people who did the work.

chinese: 法老的女兒從大衛城搬到所羅門為他建造的宮裡。那時，所羅門才建造米羅。
english: At that time Solomon made Pharaoh's daughter come up from the town of David to the house which he had made for her: then he made the Millo.

chinese: 所羅門每年三次在他為耶和華所築的壇上獻燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和華面前的壇上燒香。這樣，他建造殿的工程完畢了。
english: Three times in the year it was Solomon's way to give burned offerings and peace-offerings on the altar he had made to the Lord, causing his fire-offering to go up on the altar before the Lord.

chinese: 所羅門王在以東地紅海邊，靠近以祿的以旬迦別製造船隻。
english: And King Solomon made a sea-force of ships in Ezion-geber, by Eloth, on the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

chinese: 希蘭差遣他的僕人，就是熟悉泛海的船家，與所羅門的僕人一同坐船航海。
english: Hiram sent his servants, who were experienced seamen, in the sea-force with Solomon's men.

chinese: 他們到了俄斐，從那裡得了四百二十他連得金子，運到所羅門王那裡。
english: And they came to Ophir, where they got four hundred and twenty talents of gold, and took it back to King Solomon.

chinese: 示巴女王聽見所羅門因耶和華之名所得的名聲，就來要用難解的話試問所羅門。
english: Now the queen of Sheba, hearing great things of Solomon, came to put his wisdom to the test with hard questions.

chinese: 跟隨他到耶路撒冷的人甚多，又有駱駝馱著香料、寶石，和許多金子。他來見了所羅門王，就把心裡所有的對所羅門都說出來。
english: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels weighted down with spices, and stores of gold and jewels: and when she came to Solomon she had talk with him of everything in her mind.

chinese: 所羅門王將他所問的都答上了，沒有一句不明白、不能答的。
english: And Solomon gave her answers to all her questions; there was no secret which the king did not make clear to her.

chinese: 示巴女王見所羅門大有智慧，和他所建造的宮室，
english: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he had made,

chinese: 席上的珍饈美味，群臣分列而坐，僕人兩旁侍立，以及他們的衣服裝飾和酒政的衣服裝飾，又見他上耶和華殿的臺階(或作他在耶和華殿裡所獻的燔祭)，就詫異得神不守舍；
english: And the food at his table, and all his servants seated there, and those who were waiting on him in their places, and their robes, and his wine-servants, and the burned offerings which he made in the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.

chinese: 對王說：我在本國裡所聽見論到你的事和你的智慧實在是真的！
english: And she said to the king, The account which was given to me in my country of your acts and your wisdom was true.

chinese: 我先不信那些話，及至我來親眼見了才知道人所告訴我的還不到一半。你的智慧和你的福分越過我所聽見的風聲。
english: But I had no faith in what was said about you, till I came and saw for myself; and now I see that it was not half the story; your wisdom and your wealth are much greater than they said.

chinese: 你的臣子、你的僕人常侍立在你面前聽你智慧的話是有福的！
english: Happy are your wives, happy are these your servants whose place is ever before you, hearing your words of wisdom.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神是應當稱頌的！他喜悅你，使你坐以色列的國位；因為他永遠愛以色列，所以立你作王，使你秉公行義。
english: May the Lord your God be praised, whose pleasure it was to put you on the seat of the kingdom of Israel; because the Lord's love for Israel is eternal, he has made you king, to be their judge in righteousness.

chinese: 於是，示巴女王將一百二十他連得金子和寶石，與極多的香料，送給所羅門王。他送給王的香料，以後奉來的不再有這樣多。
english: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and a great store of spices and jewels: never again was such a wealth of spices seen as that which the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon.

chinese: 〈希蘭的船隻從俄斐運了金子來，又從俄斐運了許多檀香木(或作烏木；下同)和寶石來。
english: And the sea-force of Hiram, in addition to gold from Ophir, came back with much sandal-wood and jewels.

chinese: 王用檀香木為耶和華殿和王宮做欄杆，又為歌唱的人做琴瑟。以後再沒有這樣的檀香木進國來，也沒有人看見過，直到如今。〉
english: And from the sandal-wood the king made pillars for the house of the Lord, and for the king's house, and instruments of music for the makers of melody: never has such sandal-wood been seen to this day.

chinese: 示巴女王一切所要所求的，所羅門王都送給他，另外照自己的厚意餽送他。於是女王和他臣僕轉回本國去了。
english: And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she made request for, in addition to what he gave her freely from the impulse of his heart. So she went back to her country, she and her servants.

chinese: 所羅門每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他連得。
english: Now the weight of gold which came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents;

chinese: 另外還有商人和雜族(歷代下九章14節作亞拉伯)的諸王，與國中的省長所進的金子。
english: In addition to what came to him from the business of the traders, and from all the kings of the Arabians, and from the rulers of the country.

chinese: 所羅門王用錘出來的金子打成擋牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；
english: And Solomon made two hundred body-covers of hammered gold, every one having six hundred shekels of gold in it.

chinese: 又用錘出來的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三彌那，都放在利巴嫩林宮裡。
english: And he made three hundred smaller body-covers of hammered gold, with three pounds of gold in every cover: and the king put them in the house of the Woods of Lebanon.

chinese: 王用象牙製造一個寶座，用精金包裹。
english: Then the king made a great ivory seat, plated with the best gold.

chinese: 寶座有六層臺階，座的後背是圓的，兩旁有扶手，靠近扶手有兩個獅子站立。
english: There were six steps going up to it, and the top of it was round at the back, there were arms on the two sides of the seat, and two lions by the side of the arms;

chinese: 六層臺階上有十二個獅子站立，每層有兩個：左邊一個，右邊一個；在列國中沒有這樣做的。
english: And twelve lions were placed on the one side and on the other side on the six steps: there was nothing like it in any kingdom.

chinese: 所羅門王一切的飲器都是金子的。利巴嫩林宮裡的一切器皿都是精金的。所羅門年間，銀子算不了甚麼。
english: And all King Solomon's drinking-vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the Woods of Lebanon were of the best gold; not one was of silver, for no one gave a thought to silver in the days of King Solomon.

chinese: 因為王有他施船隻與希蘭的船隻一同航海，三年一次，裝載金銀、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回來。
english: For the king had Tarshish-ships at sea with the ships of Hiram; once every three years the Tarshish-ships came with gold and silver and ivory and monkeys and peacocks.

chinese: 所羅門王的財寶與智慧勝過天下的列王。
english: And King Solomon was greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and in wisdom.

chinese: 普天下的王都求見所羅門，要聽神賜給他智慧的話。
english: And from all over the earth they came to see Solomon and to give ear to his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

chinese: 他們各帶貢物，就是金器、銀器、衣服、軍械、香料、騾馬，每年有一定之例。
english: And everyone took with him an offering, vessels of silver and vessels of gold, and robes, and coats of metal, and spices, and horses, and beasts of transport, regularly year by year.

chinese: 所羅門聚集戰車馬兵，有戰車一千四百輛，馬兵一萬二千名，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裡。
english: And Solomon got together war-carriages and horsemen; he had one thousand, four hundred carriages and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he kept, some in the carriage-towns and some with the king at Jerusalem.

chinese: 王在耶路撒冷使銀子多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
english: And the king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem and cedars like the sycamore-trees of the lowlands in number.

chinese: 所羅門的馬是從埃及帶來的，是王的商人一群一群按著定價買來的。
english: And Solomon's horses came from Egypt and from Kue; the king's traders got them at a price from Kue.

chinese: 從埃及買來的車，每輛價銀六百舍客勒，馬每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人諸王和亞蘭諸王所買的車馬，也是按這價值經他們手買來的。
english: A war-carriage might be got from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty; they got them at the same rate for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.

chinese: 所羅門王在法老的女兒之外，又寵愛許多外邦女子，就是摩押女子、亞捫女子、以東女子、西頓女子、赫人女子。
english: Now a number of strange women were loved by Solomon, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites:

chinese: 論到這些國的人，耶和華曾曉諭以色列人說：你們不可與他們往來相通，因為他們必誘惑你們的心去隨從他們的神。所羅門卻戀愛這些女子。
english: The nations of which the Lord had said to the children of Israel, You are not to take wives from them and they are not to take wives from you; or they will certainly make you go after their gods: to these Solomon was united in love.

chinese: 所羅門有妃七百，都是公主；還有嬪三百。這些妃嬪誘惑他的心。
english: He had seven hundred wives, daughters of kings, and three hundred other wives; and through his wives his heart was turned away.

chinese: 所羅門年老的時候，他的妃嬪誘惑他的心去隨從別神，不效法他父親大衛誠誠實實地順服耶和華─他的　神。
english: For it came about that when Solomon was old, his heart was turned away to other gods by his wives; and his heart was no longer true to the Lord his God as the heart of his father David had been.

chinese: 因為所羅門隨從西頓人的女神亞斯他錄和亞捫人可憎的神米勒公。
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Zidonians, and Milcom, the disgusting god of the Ammonites.

chinese: 所羅門行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，不效法他父親大衛專心順從耶和華。
english: And Solomon did evil in the eyes of the Lord, not walking in the Lord's ways with all his heart as David his father did.

chinese: 所羅門為摩押可憎的神基抹和亞捫人可憎的神摩洛，在耶路撒冷對面的山上建築邱壇。
english: Then Solomon put up a high place for Chemosh, the disgusting god of Moab, in the mountain before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the disgusting god worshipped by the children of Ammon.

chinese: 他為那些向自己的神燒香獻祭的外邦女子，就是他娶來的妃嬪也是這樣行。
english: And so he did for all his strange wives, who made offerings with burning of perfumes to their gods.

chinese: 耶和華向所羅門發怒，因為他的心偏離向他兩次顯現的耶和華─以色列的神。
english: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the Lord, the God of Israel, who had twice come to him in a vision;

chinese: 耶和華曾吩咐他不可隨從別神，他卻沒有遵守耶和華所吩咐的。
english: And had given him orders about this very thing, that he was not to go after other gods; but he did not keep the orders of the Lord.

chinese: 所以耶和華對他說：你既行了這事，不遵守我所吩咐你守的約和律例，我必將你的國奪回，賜給你的臣子。
english: So the Lord said to Solomon, Because you have done this, and have not kept my agreement and my laws, which I gave you, I will take the kingdom away from you by force and will give it to your servant.

chinese: 然而，因你父親大衛的緣故，我不在你活著的日子行這事，必從你兒子的手中將國奪回。
english: I will not do it in your life-time, because of your father David, but I will take it from your son.

chinese: 只是我不將全國奪回，要因我僕人大衛和我所選擇的耶路撒冷，還留一支派給你的兒子。
english: Still I will not take all the kingdom from him; but I will give one tribe to your son, because of my servant David, and because of Jerusalem, the town of my selection.

chinese: 耶和華使以東人哈達興起，作所羅門的敵人；他是以東王的後裔。
english: So the Lord sent Hadad the Edomite to make trouble for Solomon: he was of the king's seed in Edom.

chinese: 先前大衛攻擊以東，元帥約押上去葬埋陣亡的人，將以東的男丁都殺了。
english: And when David had sent destruction on Edom, and Joab, the captain of the army, had gone to put the dead into the earth, and had put to death every male in Edom;

chinese: 約押和以色列眾人在以東住了六個月，直到將以東的男丁盡都剪除。
english: (For Joab and all Israel were there six months till every male in Edom had been cut off;)

chinese: 那時哈達還是幼童；他和他父親的臣僕，幾個以東人逃往埃及。
english: Hadad, being still a young boy, went in flight to Egypt, with certain Edomites, servants of his father;

chinese: 他們從米甸起行，到了巴蘭；從巴蘭帶著幾個人來到埃及見埃及王法老；法老為他派定糧食，又給他房屋田地。
english: And they went on from Midian and came to Paran; and, taking men from Paran with them, they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who gave him a house and gave orders for his food and gave him land.

chinese: 哈達在法老面前大蒙恩惠，以致法老將王后答比匿的妹子賜他為妻。
english: Now Hadad was very pleasing to Pharaoh, so that he gave him the sister of his wife, Tahpenes the queen, for his wife.

chinese: 答比匿的妹子給哈達生了一個兒子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使基努拔在法老的宮裡斷奶，基努拔就與法老的眾子一同住在法老的宮裡。
english: And the sister of Tahpenes had a son by him, Genubath, whom Tahpenes took care of in Pharaoh's house; and Genubath was living in Pharaoh's house among Pharaoh's sons.

chinese: 哈達在埃及聽見大衛與他列祖同睡，元帥約押也死了，就對法老說：求王容我回本國去。
english: Now when Hadad had news in Egypt that David had been put to rest with his fathers, and that Joab, the captain of the army, was dead, he said to Pharaoh, Send me back to my country.

chinese: 法老對他說：你在我這裡有甚麼缺乏，你竟要回你本國去呢？他回答說：我沒有缺乏甚麼，只是求王容我回去。
english: But Pharaoh said to him, What have you been short of while you have been with me, that you are desiring to go back to your country? And he said, Nothing; but even so, send me back.

chinese: 神又使以利亞大的兒子利遜興起，作所羅門的敵人。他先前逃避主人瑣巴王哈大底謝。
english: And God sent another trouble-maker, Rezon, the son of Eliada, who had gone in flight from his lord, Hadadezer, king of Zobah:

chinese: 大衛擊殺瑣巴人的時候，利遜招聚了一群人，自己作他們的頭目，往大馬色居住，在那裡作王。
english: He got some men together and made himself captain of a band of outlaws; and went to Damascus and became king there.

chinese: 所羅門活著的時候，哈達為患之外，利遜也作以色列的敵人。他恨惡以色列人，且作了亞蘭人的王。
english: He was a trouble to Israel all through the days of Solomon. And this is the damage Hadad did: he was cruel to Israel while he was ruler over Edom.

chinese: 所羅門的臣僕、尼八的兒子耶羅波安也舉手攻擊王。他是以法蓮支派的洗利達人，他母親是寡婦，名叫洗魯阿。
english: And there was Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother was Zeruah, a widow; and his hand was lifted up against the king.

chinese: 他舉手攻擊王的緣故，乃由先前所羅門建造米羅，修補他父親大衛城的破口。
english: The way in which his hand came to be lifted up against the king was this: Solomon was building the Millo and making good the damaged parts of the town of his father David;

chinese: 耶羅波安是大有才能的人。所羅門見這少年人殷勤，就派他監管約瑟家的一切工程。
english: And Jeroboam was an able and responsible man; and Solomon saw that he was a good worker and made him overseer of all the work given to the sons of Joseph.

chinese: 一日，耶羅波安出了耶路撒冷，示羅人先知亞希雅在路上遇見他；亞希雅身上穿著一件新衣。他們二人在田野，以外並無別人。
english: Now at that time, when Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite came across him on the road; now Ahijah had put on a new robe; and the two of them were by themselves in the open country.

chinese: 亞希雅將自己穿的那件新衣撕成十二片，
english: And Ahijah took his new robe in his hands, parting it violently into twelve.

chinese: 對耶羅波安說：你可以拿十片。耶和華─以色列的神如此說：我必將國從所羅門手裡奪回，將十個支派賜給你。
english: And he said to Jeroboam, Take ten of the parts, for this is what the Lord has said: See, I will take the kingdom away from Solomon by force, and will give ten tribes to you;

chinese: （我因僕人大衛和我在以色列眾支派中所選擇的耶路撒冷城的緣故，仍給所羅門留一個支派。）
english: (But one tribe will be his, because of my servant David, and because of Jerusalem, the town which, out of all the tribes of Israel, I have made mine,)

chinese: 因為他離棄我，敬拜西頓人的女神亞斯他錄、摩押的　神基抹，和亞捫人的　神米勒公，沒有遵從我的道，行我眼中看為正的事，守我的律例典章，像他父親大衛一樣。
english: Because they are turned away from me to the worship of Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Zidonians, and Chemosh, the god of Moab, and Milcom, the god of the Ammonites; they have not been walking in my ways or doing what is right in my eyes or keeping my laws and my decisions as his father David did.

chinese: 但我不從他手裡將全國奪回；使他終身為君，是因我所揀選的僕人大衛謹守我的誡命律例。
english: But I will not take the kingdom from him; I will let him be king all the days of his life, because of David my servant, in whom I took delight because he kept my orders and my laws.

chinese: 我必從他兒子的手裡將國奪回，以十個支派賜給你，
english: But I will take the kingdom from his son, and give it to you.

chinese: 還留一個支派給他的兒子，使我僕人大衛在我所選擇立我名的耶路撒冷城裡，在我面前長有燈光。
english: And one tribe I will give to his son, so that David my servant may have a light for ever burning before me in Jerusalem, the town which I have made mine to put my name there.

chinese: 我必揀選你，使你照心裡一切所願的，作王治理以色列。
english: And you I will take, and you will be king over Israel, ruling over whatever is the desire of your soul.

chinese: 你若聽從我一切所吩咐你的，遵行我的道，行我眼中看為正的事，謹守我的律例誡命，像我僕人大衛所行的，我就與你同在，為你立堅固的家，像我為大衛所立的一樣，將以色列人賜給你。
english: And if you give attention to the orders I give you, walking in my ways and doing what is right in my eyes and keeping my laws and my orders as David my servant did; then I will be with you, building up for you a safe house, as I did for David, and I will give Israel to you.

chinese: 我必因所羅門所行的使大衛後裔受患難，但不至於永遠。
english: (So that I may send trouble for this on the seed of David, but not for ever.)

chinese: 所羅門因此想要殺耶羅波安。耶羅波安卻起身逃往埃及；到了埃及王示撒那裡，就住在埃及，直到所羅門死了。
english: And Solomon was looking for a chance to put Jeroboam to death; but he went in flight to Egypt, to Shishak, king of Egypt, and was in Egypt till the death of Solomon.

chinese: 所羅門其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的智慧都寫在所羅門記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all he did, and his wisdom, are they not recorded in the book of the acts of Solomon?

chinese: 所羅門在耶路撒冷作以色列眾人的王共四十年。
english: And the time Solomon was king in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

chinese: 所羅門與他列祖同睡，葬在他父親大衛的城裡。他兒子羅波安接續他作王。
english: And Solomon went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the town of David his father: and Solomon went to rest with his fathers and Rehoboam his son became king in his place.

chinese: 羅波安往示劍去；因為以色列人都到了示劍要立他作王。
english: And Rehoboam went to Shechem, where all Israel had come together to make him king,

chinese: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安先前躲避所羅門王，逃往埃及，住在那裡（他聽見這事。）
english: And, hearing of it, Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who was still in Egypt, where he had gone in flight from Solomon, and was living there, came back to his town Zeredah, in the hill-country of Ephraim;

chinese: 以色列人打發人去請他來，他就和以色列會眾都來見羅波安，對他說：
english: And all the men of Israel came to Rehoboam and said,

chinese: 你父親使我們負重軛，做苦工，現在求你使我們做的苦工、負的重軛輕鬆些，我們就事奉你。
english: Your father put a hard yoke on us: if you will make the conditions under which your father kept us down less cruel, and the weight of the yoke he put on us less hard, then we will be your servants.

chinese: 羅波安對他們說：你們暫且去，第三日再來見我。民就去了。
english: And he said to them, Go away for three days and then come back to me again. So the people went away.

chinese: 羅波安之父所羅門在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，羅波安王和他們商議，說：你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆這民。
english: Then King Rehoboam took the opinion of the old men who had been with Solomon his father when he was living, and said, In your opinion, what answer am I to give to this people?

chinese: 老年人對他說：現在王若服事這民如僕人，用好話回答他們，他們就永遠作王的僕人。
english: And they said to him, If you will be a servant to this people today, caring for them and giving them a gentle answer, then they will be your servants for ever.

chinese: 王卻不用老年人給他出的主意，就和那些與他一同長大、在他面前侍立的少年人商議，
english: But he gave no attention to the opinion of the old men, and went to the young men of his generation who were waiting before him:

chinese: 說：這民對我說：你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些。你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆他們。
english: And said to them, What is your opinion? What answer are we to give to this people who have said to me, Make less the weight of the yoke which your father put on us?

chinese: 那同他長大的少年人說：這民對王說：你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些。王要對他們如此說：我的小拇指頭比我父親的腰還粗。
english: And the young men of his generation said to him, This is the answer to give to the people who came to you saying, Your father put a hard yoke on us; will you make it less? say to them, My little finger is thicker than my father's body;

chinese: 我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛！我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子鞭責打你們！
english: If my father put a hard yoke on you, I will make it harder: my father gave you punishment with whips, but I will give you blows with snakes.

chinese: 耶羅波安和眾百姓遵著羅波安王所說你們第三日再來見我的那話，第三日他們果然來了。
english: So all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had given orders, saying, Come back to me the third day.

chinese: 王用嚴厲的話回答百姓，不用老年人給他所出的主意，
english: And the king gave them a rough answer, giving no attention to the suggestion of the old men;

chinese: 照著少年人所出的主意對民說：我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛！我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子鞭責打你們！
english: But giving them the answer put forward by the young men, saying, My father made your yoke hard, but I will make it harder; my father gave you punishment with whips, but I will give it with snakes.

chinese: 王不肯依從百姓，這事乃出於耶和華，為要應驗他藉示羅人亞希雅對尼八的兒子耶羅波安所說的話。
english: So the king did not give ear to the people; and this came about by the purpose of the Lord, so that what he had said by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam, son of Nebat, might be effected.

chinese: 以色列眾民見王不依從他們，就對王說：我們與大衛有甚麼分兒呢？與耶西的兒子並沒有關涉。以色列人哪，各回各家去罷！大衛家啊，自己顧自己罷！於是，以色列人都回自己家裡去了，
english: And when all Israel saw that the king would give no attention to them, the people in answer said to the king, What part have we in David? what is our heritage in the son of Jesse? to your tents, O Israel; now see to your people, David. So Israel went away to their tents.

chinese: 惟獨住猶大城邑的以色列人，羅波安仍作他們的王。
english: (But Rehoboam was still king over those of the children of Israel who were living in the towns of Judah.)

chinese: 羅波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的亞多蘭往以色列人那裡去，以色列人就用石頭打死他。羅波安王急忙上車，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoniram, the overseer of the forced work; and he was stoned to death by all Israel. And King Rehoboam went quickly and got into his carriage to go in flight to Jerusalem.

chinese: 這樣，以色列人背叛大衛家，直到今日。
english: So Israel was turned away from the family of David to this day.

chinese: 以色列眾人聽見耶羅波安回來了，就打發人去請他到會眾面前，立他作以色列眾人的王。除了猶大支派以外，沒有順從大衛家的。
english: Now when all Israel had news that Jeroboam had come back, they sent for him to come before the meeting of the people, and made him king over Israel: not one of them was joined to the family of David but only the tribe of Judah.

chinese: 羅波安來到耶路撒冷，招聚猶大全家和便雅憫支派的人共十八萬，都是挑選的戰士，要與以色列家爭戰，好將國奪回，再歸所羅門的兒子羅波安。
english: When Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he got together all the men of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand of his best fighting-men, to make war against Israel and get the kingdom back for Rehoboam, the son of Solomon.

chinese: 但神的話臨到　神人示瑪雅，說：
english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah, the man of God, saying,

chinese: 你去告訴所羅門的兒子猶大王羅波安和猶大、便雅憫全家，並其餘的民說：
english: Say to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the men of Judah and Benjamin and the rest of the people:

chinese: 耶和華如此說：你們不可上去與你們的弟兄以色列人爭戰。各歸各家去罷！因為這事出於我。眾人就聽從耶和華的話，遵著耶和華的命回去了。
english: The Lord has said, You are not to go to war against your brothers, the children of Israel; go back, every man to his house, because this thing is my purpose. So they gave ear to the word of the Lord, and went back, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 耶羅波安在以法蓮山地建築示劍，就住在其中；又從示劍出去，建築毗努伊勒。
english: Then Jeroboam made the town of Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim a strong place, and was living there; and from there he went out and did the same to Penuel.

chinese: 耶羅波安心裡說：恐怕這國仍歸大衛家；
english: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now the kingdom will go back to the family of David:

chinese: 這民若上耶路撒冷去，在耶和華的殿裡獻祭，他們的心必歸向他們的主─猶大王羅波安，就把我殺了，仍歸猶大王羅波安。
english: If the people go up to make offerings in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, their heart will be turned again to their lord, to Rehoboam, king of Judah; and they will put me to death and go back to Rehoboam, king of Judah.

chinese: 耶羅波安王就籌劃定妥，鑄造了兩個金牛犢，對眾民說：以色列人哪，你們上耶路撒冷去實在是難；這就是領你們出埃及地的神。
english: So after taking thought the king made two oxen of gold; and he said to the people, You have been going up to Jerusalem long enough; see! these are your gods, O Israel, who took you out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 他就把牛犢一隻安在伯特利，一隻安在但。
english: And he put one in Beth-el and the other in Dan.

chinese: 這事叫百姓陷在罪裡，因為他們往但去拜那牛犢。
english: And this became a sin in Israel; for the people went to give worship to the one at Beth-el, and to the other at Dan.

chinese: 耶羅波安在邱壇那裡建殿，將那不屬利未人的凡民立為祭司。
english: And he made places for worship at the high places, and made priests, who were not Levites, from among all the people.

chinese: 耶羅波安定八月十五日為節期，像在猶大的節期一樣，自己上壇獻祭。他在伯特利也這樣向他所鑄的牛犢獻祭，又將立為邱壇的祭司安置在伯特利。
english: And Jeroboam gave orders for a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast which is kept in Judah, and he went up to the altar. And in the same way, in Beth-el, he gave offerings to the oxen which he had made, placing in Beth-el the priests of the high places he had made.

chinese: 他在八月十五日，就是他私自所定的月日，為以色列人立作節期的日子，在伯特利上壇燒香。
english: He went up to the altar he had made in Beth-el on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, the month fixed by him at his pleasure; and he gave orders for a feast for the people of Israel, and went up to the altar, and there he made the smoke of his offerings go up.

chinese: 那時，有一個神人奉耶和華的命從猶大來到伯特利。耶羅波安正站在壇旁要燒香；
english: Then a man of God came from Judah by the order of the Lord to Beth-el, where Jeroboam was by the altar, burning offerings.

chinese: 神人奉耶和華的命向壇呼叫，說：壇哪，壇哪！耶和華如此說：大衛家裡必生一個兒子，名叫約西亞，他必將邱壇的祭司，就是在你上面燒香的，殺在你上面，人的骨頭也必燒在你上面。
english: And by the order of the Lord he made an outcry against the altar, saying, O altar, altar, the Lord has said, From the seed of David will come a child, named Josiah, and on you he will put to death the priests of the high places, who are burning offerings on you, and men's bones will be burned on you.

chinese: 當日，神人設個預兆，說：這壇必破裂，壇上的灰必傾撒，這是耶和華說的預兆。
english: The same day he gave them a sign, saying, This is the sign which the Lord has given: See, the altar will be broken and the burned waste on it overturned.

chinese: 耶羅波安王聽見神人向伯特利的壇所呼叫的話，就從壇上伸手，說：拿住他罷！王向神人所伸的手就枯乾了，不能彎回；
english: Then the king, hearing the man of God crying out against the altar at Beth-el, put out his hand from the altar, saying, Take him prisoner. And his hand, stretched out against him, became dead, and he had no power of pulling it back.

chinese: 壇也破裂了，壇上的灰傾撒了，正如神人奉耶和華的命所設的預兆。
english: And the altar was broken and the burned waste on it overturned; this was the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.

chinese: 王對神人說：請你為我禱告，求耶和華─你　神的恩典使我的手復原。於是　神人祈禱耶和華，王的手就復了原，仍如尋常一樣。
english: Then the king made answer and said to the man of God, Make a prayer now for the grace of the Lord your God, and for me, that my hand may be made well. And in answer to the prayer of the man of God, the king's hand was made well again, as it was before.

chinese: 王對神人說：請你同我回去吃飯，加添心力，我也必給你賞賜。
english: And the king said to the man of God, Come with me to my house for food and rest, and I will give you a reward.

chinese: 神人對王說：你就是把你的宮一半給我，我也不同你進去，也不在這地方吃飯喝水；
english: But the man of God said to the king, Even if you gave me half of all you have, I would not go in with you, and I would not take food or a drink of water in this place;

chinese: 因為有耶和華的話囑咐我，說不可在伯特利吃飯喝水，也不可從你去的原路回來。
english: For so I was ordered by the word of the Lord, who said, You are not to take food or a drink of water, and you are not to go back the way you came.

chinese: 於是神人從別的路回去，不從伯特利來的原路回去。
english: So he went another way, and not by the way he came to Beth-el.

chinese: 有一個老先知住在伯特利，他兒子們來，將神人當日在伯特利所行的一切事和向王所說的話都告訴了父親。
english: Now there was an old prophet living in Beth-el; and one of his sons came and gave him word of all the man of God had done that day in Beth-el, and they gave their father an account of the words he had said to the king.

chinese: 父親問他們說：神人從哪條路去了呢？兒子們就告訴他；原來他們看見那從猶大來的神人所去的路。
english: Then their father said to them, Which way did he go? Now his sons had seen which way the man of God who came from Judah had gone.

chinese: 老先知就吩咐他兒子們說：你們為我備驢。他們備好了驢，他就騎上，
english: So the prophet said to his sons, Make ready an ass for me. So they made an ass ready, and he got on it,

chinese: 去追趕神人，遇見他坐在橡樹底下，就問他說：你是從猶大來的　神人不是？他說：是。
english: And went after the man of God, and came up with him while he was seated under an oak-tree. And he said to him, Are you the man of God who came from Judah? And he said, I am.

chinese: 老先知對他說：請你同我回家吃飯。
english: Then he said to him, Come back to the house with me and have a meal.

chinese: 神人說：我不可同你回去進你的家，也不可在這裡同你吃飯喝水；
english: But he said, I may not go back with you or go into your house; and I will not take food or a drink of water with you in this place;

chinese: 因為有耶和華的話囑咐我說：你在那裡不可吃飯喝水，也不可從你去的原路回來。
english: For the Lord said to me, You are not to take food or water there, or go back again by the way you came.

chinese: 老先知對他說：我也是先知，和你一樣。有天使奉耶和華的命對我說：你去把他帶回你的家，叫他吃飯喝水。這都是老先知誆哄他。
english: Then he said to him, I am a prophet like you; and an angel said to me by the word of the Lord, Take him back with you and give him food and water. But he said false words to him.

chinese: 於是神人同老先知回去，在他家裡吃飯喝水。
english: So he went back with him, and had a meal in his house and a drink of water.

chinese: 二人坐席的時候，耶和華的話臨到那帶神人回來的先知，
english: But while they were seated at the table, the word of the Lord came to the prophet who had taken him back;

chinese: 他就對那從猶大來的神人說：耶和華如此說：你既違背耶和華的話，不遵守耶和華─你　神的命令，
english: And crying out to the man of God who came from Judah, he said, The Lord says, Because you have gone against the voice of the Lord, and have not done as you were ordered by the Lord,

chinese: 反倒回來，在耶和華禁止你吃飯喝水的地方吃了喝了，因此你的屍身不得入你列祖的墳墓。
english: But have come back, and have taken food and water in this place where he said you were to take no food or water; your dead body will not be put to rest with your fathers.

chinese: 吃喝完了，老先知為所帶回來的先知備驢。
english: Now after the meal he made ready the ass for him, for the prophet whom he had taken back.

chinese: 他就去了，在路上有個獅子遇見他，將他咬死，屍身倒在路上，驢站在屍身旁邊，獅子也站在屍身旁邊。
english: And he went on his way; but on the road a lion came rushing at him and put him to death; and his dead body was stretched in the road with the ass by its side, and the lion was there by the body.

chinese: 有人從那裡經過，看見屍身倒在路上，獅子站在屍身旁邊，就來到老先知所住的城裡述說這事。
english: And some men, going by, saw the body stretched out in the road with the lion by its side; and they came and gave news of it in the town where the old prophet was living.

chinese: 那帶神人回來的先知聽見這事，就說：這是那違背了耶和華命令的神人，所以耶和華把他交給獅子；獅子抓傷他，咬死他，是應驗耶和華對他說的話。
english: Then the prophet who had made him come back, hearing it, said, It is the man of God, who went against the word of the Lord; that is why the Lord has given him to the lion to be wounded to death, as the Lord said.

chinese: 老先知就吩咐他兒子們說：你們為我備驢。他們就備了驢。
english: And he said to his sons, Make ready the ass for me. And they did so.

chinese: 他去了，看見神人的屍身倒在路上，驢和獅子站在屍身旁邊，獅子卻沒有吃屍身，也沒有抓傷驢。
english: And he went and saw the dead body stretched out in the road with the ass and the lion by its side: the lion had not taken the body for its food or done any damage to the ass.

chinese: 老先知就把神人的屍身馱在驢上，帶回自己的城裡，要哀哭他，葬埋他；
english: Then the prophet took up the body of the man of God and put it on the ass and took it back; and he came to the town to put the body to rest with weeping.

chinese: 就把他的屍身葬在自己的墳墓裡，哀哭他，說：哀哉！我兄啊。
english: And he put the body in the resting-place made ready for himself, weeping and sorrowing over it, saying, O my brother!

chinese: 安葬之後，老先知對他兒子們說：我死了，你們要葬我在神人的墳墓裡，使我的屍骨靠近他的屍骨，
english: And when he had put it to rest, he said to his sons, When I am dead, then you are to put my body into the earth with the body of this man of God, and put me by his bones so that my bones may be kept safe with his bones.

chinese: 因為他奉耶和華的命指著伯特利的壇和撒瑪利亞各城有邱壇之殿所說的話必定應驗。
english: For the outcry he made by the word of the Lord against the altar in Beth-el and against all the houses of the high places in the towns of Samaria, will certainly come about.

chinese: 這事以後，耶羅波安仍不離開他的惡道，將凡民立為邱壇的祭司；凡願意的，他都分別為聖，立為邱壇的祭司。
english: After this Jeroboam, not turning back from his evil ways, still made priests for his altars from among all the people; he made a priest of anyone desiring it, so that there might be priests of the high places.

chinese: 這事叫耶羅波安的家陷在罪裡，甚至他的家從地上除滅了。
english: And this became a sin in the family of Jeroboam, causing it to be cut off and sent to destruction from the face of the earth.

chinese: 那時，耶羅波安的兒子亞比雅病了。
english: At that time Abijah, the son of Jeroboam, became ill.

chinese: 耶羅波安對他的妻說：你可以起來改裝，使人不知道你是耶羅波安的妻，往示羅去，在那裡有先知亞希雅。他曾告訴我說，你必作這民的王。
english: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Now come, put on different clothing so that you may not seem to be the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh; see, Ahijah is there, the prophet who said I would be king over this people.

chinese: 現在你要帶十個餅，與幾個薄餅，和一瓶蜜去見他，他必告訴你兒子將要怎樣。
english: And take with you ten cakes of bread and dry cakes and a pot of honey, and go to him: he will give you word of what is to become of the child.

chinese: 耶羅波安的妻就這樣行，起身往示羅去，到了亞希雅的家。亞希雅因年紀老邁，眼目發直，不能看見。
english: So Jeroboam's wife did so, and got up and went to Shiloh and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah was unable to see, because he was very old.

chinese: 耶和華先曉諭亞希雅說：耶羅波安的妻要來問你，因他兒子病了，你當此此如此告訴他。他進來的時候必裝作別的婦人。
english: And the Lord had said to Ahijah, The wife of Jeroboam is coming to get news from you about her son, who is ill; give her such and such an answer; for she will make herself seem to be another woman.

chinese: 他剛進門，亞希雅聽見他腳步的響聲，就說：耶羅波安的妻，進來罷！你為何裝作別的婦人呢？我奉差遣將凶事告訴你。
english: Then Ahijah, hearing the sound of her footsteps coming in at the door, said, Come in, O wife of Jeroboam; why do you make yourself seem like another? for I am sent to you with bitter news.

chinese: 你回去告訴耶羅波安說：耶和華─以色列的神如此說：我從民中將你高舉，立你作我民以色列的君，
english: Go, say to Jeroboam, These are the words of the Lord, the God of Israel: Though I took you from among the people, lifting you up to be a ruler over my people Israel,

chinese: 將國從大衛家奪回賜給你；你卻不效法我僕人大衛，遵守我的誡命，一心順從我，行我眼中看為正的事。
english: And took the kingdom away by force from the seed of David and gave it to you, you have not been like my servant David, who kept my orders, and was true to me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.

chinese: 你竟行惡，比那在你以先的更甚，為自己立了別神，鑄了偶像，惹我發怒，將我丟在背後。
english: But you have done evil more than any before you, and have made for yourself other gods, and images of metal, moving me to wrath, and turning your back on me.

chinese: 因此，我必使災禍臨到耶羅波安的家，將屬耶羅波安的男丁，無論困住的、自由的都從以色列中剪除，必除盡耶羅波安的家，如人除盡糞土一般。
english: So I will send evil on the line of Jeroboam, cutting off from his family every male child, those who are shut up and those who go free in Israel; the family of Jeroboam will be brushed away like a man brushing away waste till it is all gone.

chinese: 凡屬耶羅波安的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鳥吃。這是耶和華說的。
english: Those of the family of Jeroboam who come to death in the town, will become food for the dogs; and those on whom death comes in the open country, will be food for the birds of the air; for the Lord has said it.

chinese: 所以你起身回家去罷！你的腳一進城，你兒子就必死了。
english: Up, then! go back to your house; and in the hour when your feet go into the town, the death of the child will take place.

chinese: 以色列眾人必為他哀哭，將他葬埋。凡屬耶羅波安的人，惟有他得入墳墓；因為在耶羅波安的家中，只有他向耶和華─以色列的神顯出善行。
english: And all Israel will put his body to rest, weeping over him, because he only of the family of Jeroboam will be put into his resting-place in the earth; for of all the family of Jeroboam, in him only has the Lord, the God of Israel, seen some good.

chinese: 耶和華必另立一王治理以色列。到了日期，他必剪除耶羅波安的家；那日期已經到了。
english: And the Lord will put up a king over Israel who will send destruction on the family of Jeroboam in that day;

chinese: 耶和華必擊打以色列人，使他們搖動，像水中的蘆葦一般；又將他們從耶和華賜給他們列祖的美地上拔出來，分散在大河那邊；因為他們做木偶，惹耶和華發怒。
english: And even now the hand of the Lord has come down on Israel, shaking it like a river-grass in the water; and, uprooting Israel from this good land, which he gave to their fathers, he will send them this way and that on the other side of the River; because they have made for themselves images, moving the Lord to wrath.

chinese: 因耶羅波安所犯的罪，又使以色列人陷在罪裡，耶和華必將以色列人交給仇敵。
english: And he will give Israel up because of the sins which Jeroboam has done and made Israel do.

chinese: 耶羅波安的妻起身回去，到了得撒，剛到門檻，兒子就死了。
english: Then Jeroboam's wife got up and went away and came to Tirzah; and when she came to the doorway of the house, death came to the child.

chinese: 以色列眾人將他葬埋，為他哀哭，正如耶和華藉他僕人先知亞希雅所說的話。
english: And all Israel put his body to rest, weeping over him, as the Lord had said by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

chinese: 耶羅波安其餘的事，他怎樣爭戰，怎樣作王，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he made war and how he became king, are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.

chinese: 耶羅波安作王二十二年，就與他列祖同睡。他兒子拿答接續他作王。
english: And Jeroboam was king for twenty-two years, and was put to rest with his fathers, and Nadab his son became king in his place.

chinese: 所羅門的兒子羅波安作猶大王。他登基的時候年四十一歲，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和華從以色列眾支派中所選擇立他名的城，作王十七年。羅波安的母親名叫拿瑪，是亞捫人。
english: And Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, was king in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he was king for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the town which the Lord had made his out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there; his mother's name was Naamah, an Ammonite woman.

chinese: 猶大人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，犯罪觸動他的憤恨，比他們列祖更甚。
english: And Judah did evil in the eyes of the Lord, and made him more angry than their fathers had done by their sins.

chinese: 因為他們在各高岡上，各青翠樹下築壇，立柱像和木偶。
english: For they made high places and upright stones and wood pillars on every high hill and under every green tree;

chinese: 國中也有孌童。猶大人效法耶和華在以色列人面前所趕出的外邦人，行一切可憎惡的事。
english: And more than this, there were those in the land who were used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods, doing the same disgusting crimes as the nations which the Lord had sent out before the children of Israel.

chinese: 羅波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上來攻取耶路撒冷，
english: Now in the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak, king of Egypt, came up against Jerusalem;

chinese: 奪了耶和華殿和王宮裡的寶物，盡都帶走，又奪去所羅門製造的金盾牌。
english: And took away all the stored wealth from the house of the Lord, and from the king's house, and all the gold body-covers which Solomon had made.

chinese: 羅波安王製造銅盾牌代替那金盾牌，交給守王宮門的護衛長看守。
english: So in their place King Rehoboam had other body-covers made of brass, and gave them into the care of the captains of the armed men who were stationed at the door of the king's house.

chinese: 王每逢進耶和華的殿，護衛兵就拿這盾牌，隨後仍將盾牌送回，放在護衛房。
english: And whenever the king went into the house of the Lord, the armed men went with him taking the body-covers, and then took them back to their room.

chinese: 羅波安其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在猶大列王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

chinese: 羅波安與耶羅波安時常爭戰。
english: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

chinese: 羅波安與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裡。他母親名叫拿瑪，是亞捫人。他兒子亞比央(又名亞比雅)接續他作王。
english: And Rehoboam went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth with his fathers in the town of David; his mother's name was Naamah, an Ammonite woman. And Abijam his son became king in his place.

chinese: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安王十八年，亞比央登基作猶大王，
english: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.

chinese: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母親名叫瑪迦，是押沙龍的女兒。
english: For three years he was king in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.

chinese: 亞比央行他父親在他以前所行的一切惡，他的心不像他祖大衛的心，誠誠實實地順服耶和華─他的神。
english: And he did the same sins which his father had done before him: his heart was not completely true to the Lord his God, like the heart of David his father.

chinese: 然而耶和華─他的神因大衛的緣故，仍使他在耶路撒冷有燈光，叫他兒子接續他作王，堅立耶路撒冷。
english: But because of David, the Lord gave him a light in Jerusalem, making his sons king after him, so that Jerusalem might be safe;

chinese: 因為大衛除了赫人烏利亞那件事，都是行耶和華眼中看為正的事，一生沒有違背耶和華一切所吩咐的。
english: Because David did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, and never in all his life went against his orders, but only in the question of Uriah the Hittite.

chinese: 羅波安在世的日子常與耶羅波安爭戰。
亞比央其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在猶大列王記上。亞比央常與耶羅波安爭戰。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

chinese: 亞比央與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛的城裡。他兒子亞撒接續他作王。
english: Then Abijam went to rest with his fathers, and they put him into the earth in the town of David: and Asa his son became king in his place.

chinese: 以色列王耶羅波安二十年，亞撒登基作猶大王，
english: In the twentieth year that Jeroboam was king of Israel, Asa became king over Judah.

chinese: 在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他祖母名叫瑪迦，是押沙龍的女兒。
english: And he was king for forty-one years in Jerusalem; his mother's name was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.

chinese: 亞撒效法他祖大衛行耶和華眼中看為正的事，
english: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as David his father did.

chinese: 從國中除去孌童，又除掉他列祖所造的一切偶像；
english: Those used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods he sent out of the country, and he took away all the images which his fathers had made.

chinese: 並且貶了他祖母瑪迦太后的位，因他造了可憎的偶像亞舍拉。亞撒砍下他的偶像，燒在汲淪溪邊，
english: And he would not let Maacah his mother be queen, because she had made a disgusting image for Asherah; and Asa had the image cut down and burned by the stream Kidron.

chinese: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去。亞撒一生卻向耶和華存誠實的心。
english: The high places, however, were not taken away: but still the heart of Asa was true to the Lord all his life.

chinese: 亞撒將他父親所分別為聖與自己所分別為聖的金銀和器皿都奉到耶和華的殿裡。
english: He took into the house of the Lord all the things which his father had made holy, and those which he himself had made holy, silver and gold and vessels.

chinese: 亞撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常爭戰。
english: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha, king of Israel, all their days.

chinese: 以色列王巴沙上來要攻擊猶大，修築拉瑪，不許人從猶大王亞撒那裡出入。
english: And Baasha, king of Israel, went up against Judah, building Ramah, so that no one was able to go out or in to Asa, king of Judah.

chinese: 於是亞撒將耶和華殿和王宮府庫裡所剩下的金銀都交在他臣僕手中，打發他們往住大馬色的亞蘭王─希旬的孫子、他伯利們的兒子便哈達那裡去，
english: Then Asa took all the silver and gold which was still stored in the Lord's house, and in the king's house, and sent them, in the care of his servants, to Ben-hadad, son of Tabrimmon, son of Rezon, king of Aram, at Damascus, saying,

chinese: 說：你父曾與我父立約，我與你也要立約。現在我將金銀送你為禮物，求你廢掉你與以色列王巴沙所立的約，使他離開我。
english: Let there be an agreement between me and you as there was between my father and your father: see, I have sent you an offering of silver and gold; go and put an end to your agreement with Baasha, king of Israel, so that he may give up attacking me.

chinese: 便哈達聽從亞撒王的話，派軍長去攻擊以色列的城邑；他們就攻破以雲、但、亞伯伯瑪迦、基尼烈全境、拿弗他利全境。
english: So Ben-hadad did as King Asa said, and sent the captains of his armies against the towns of Israel, attacking Ijon and Dan and Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth as far as all the land of Naphtali.

chinese: 巴沙聽見，就停工不修築拉瑪了，仍住在得撒。
english: And Baasha, hearing of it, put a stop to the building of Ramah, and was living in Tirzah.

chinese: 於是亞撒王宣告猶大眾人，不准一個推辭，吩咐他們將巴沙修築拉瑪所用的石頭、木頭都運去，用以修築便雅憫的迦巴和米斯巴。
english: Then King Asa got all Judah together, making every man come; and they took away the stones and the wood with which Baasha was building Ramah, and King Asa made use of them for building Geba in the land of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

chinese: 亞撒其餘的事，凡他所行的，並他的勇力與他所建築的城邑，都寫在猶大列王記上。亞撒年老的時候，腳上有病。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Asa, and his power, and all he did, and the towns of which he was the builder, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah? But when he was old he had a disease of the feet.

chinese: 亞撒與他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大衛城他列祖的墳地裡。他兒子約沙法接續他作王。
english: So Asa went to rest with his fathers and was put into the earth in the town of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son became king in his place.

chinese: 猶大王亞撒第二年，耶羅波安的兒子拿答登基作以色列王共二年，
english: Nadab, the son of Jeroboam, became king over Israel in the second year that Asa was king of Judah; and he was king of Israel for two years.

chinese: 拿答行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行他父親所行的，犯他父親使以色列人陷在罪裡的那罪。
english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the evil ways of his father, and the sin which he did and made Israel do.

chinese: 以薩迦人亞希雅的兒子巴沙背叛拿答，在非利士的基比頓殺了他。那時拿答和以色列眾人正圍困基比頓。
english: And Baasha, the son of Ahijah, of the family of Issachar, made a secret design against him, attacking him at Gibbethon, a town of the Philistines; for Nadab and the armies of Israel were making war on Gibbethon.

chinese: 在猶大王亞撒第三年巴沙殺了他，篡了他的位。
english: In the third year of the rule of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha put him to death, and became king in his place.

chinese: 巴沙一作王就殺了耶羅波安的全家，凡有氣息的沒有留下一個，都滅盡了，正應驗耶和華藉他僕人示羅人亞希雅所說的話。
english: And straight away when he became king, he sent destruction on all the offspring of Jeroboam; there was not one living person of all the family of Jeroboam whom he did not put to death, so the word of the Lord, which he said by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite, came about;

chinese: 這是因為耶羅波安所犯的罪使以色列人陷在罪裡，惹動耶和華─以色列神的怒氣。
english: Because of the sins which Jeroboam did and made Israel do, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath.

chinese: 拿答其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

chinese: 亞撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常爭戰。
english: And there was war between Asa and Baasha, king of Israel, all their days.

chinese: 猶大王亞撒第三年，亞希雅的兒子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列眾人的王共廿四年。
english: In the third year of the rule of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha, the son of Ahijah, became king over all Israel in Tirzah, and was king for twenty-four years.

chinese: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行耶羅波安所行的道，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裡的那罪。
english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the evil ways of Jeroboam and the sin which he made Israel do.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到哈拿尼的兒子耶戶，責備巴沙說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to Jehu, son of Hanani, protesting against Baasha and saying,

chinese: 我既從塵埃中提拔你，立你作我民以色列的君，你竟行耶羅波安所行的道，使我民以色列陷在罪裡，惹我發怒，
english: Because I took you up out of the dust, and made you ruler over my people Israel; and you have gone in the ways of Jeroboam, and made my people Israel do evil, moving me to wrath by their sins;

chinese: 我必除盡你和你的家，使你的家像尼八的兒子耶羅波安的家一樣。
english: Truly, I will see that Baasha and all his family are completely brushed away; I will make your family like the family of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat.

chinese: 凡屬巴沙的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鳥吃。
english: Anyone of the family of Baasha who comes to death in the town, will become food for the dogs; and he to whom death comes in the open country, will be food for the birds of the air.

chinese: 巴沙其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his power, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

chinese: 巴沙與他列祖同睡，葬在得撒。他兒子以拉接續他作王。
english: And Baasha went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth at Tirzah; and Elah his son became king in his place.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到哈拿尼的兒子先知耶戶，責備巴沙和他的家，因他行耶和華眼中看為惡的一切事，以他手所做的惹耶和華發怒，像耶羅波安的家一樣，又因他殺了耶羅波安的全家。
english: And the Lord sent his word against Baasha and his family by the mouth of the prophet Jehu, the son of Hanani, because of all the evil he did in the eyes of the Lord, moving him to wrath by the work of his hands, because he was like the family of Jeroboam, and because he put it to death.

chinese: 猶大王亞撒二十六年，巴沙的兒子以拉在得撒登基作以色列王共二年。
english: In the twenty-sixth year that Asa was king of Judah, Elah, the son of Baasha, became king of Israel in Tirzah, and he was king for two years.

chinese: 有管理他一半戰車的臣子心利背叛他。當他在得撒家宰亞雜家裡喝醉的時候，
english: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his war-carriages, made secret designs against him: now he was in Tirzah, drinking hard in the house of Arza, controller of the king's house in Tirzah.

chinese: 心利就進去殺了他，篡了他的位。這是猶大王亞撒二十七年的事。
english: And Zimri went in and made an attack on him and put him to death, in the twenty-seventh year that Asa was king of Judah, and made himself king in his place.

chinese: 心利一坐王位就殺了巴沙的全家，連他的親屬、朋友也沒有留下一個男丁。
english: And straight away when he became king and took his place on the seat of the kingdom, he put to death all the family of Baasha: not one male child of his relations or his friends kept his life.

chinese: 心利這樣滅絕巴沙的全家，正如耶和華藉先知耶戶責備巴沙的話。
english: So Zimri put to death all the family of Baasha, so that the word which the Lord said against him by the mouth of Jehu the prophet came about;

chinese: 這是因巴沙和他兒子以拉的一切罪，就是他們使以色列人陷在罪裡的那罪，以虛無的神惹耶和華─以色列神的怒氣。
english: Because of all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they did and made Israel do, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath by their foolish acts.

chinese: 以拉其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

chinese: 猶大王亞撒二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那時民正安營圍攻非利士的基比頓。
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa, king of Judah, Zimri was king for seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were attacking Gibbethon in the land of the Philistines.

chinese: 民在營中聽說心利背叛，又殺了王，故此以色列眾人當日在營中立元帥暗利作以色列王。
english: And news came to the people in the tents that Zimri had made a secret design and had put the king to death: so all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king that day in the tents.

chinese: 暗利率領以色列眾人，從基比頓上去，圍困得撒。
english: Then Omri went up from Gibbethon, with all the army of Israel, and they made an attack on Tirzah, shutting in the town on every side.

chinese: 心利見城破失，就進了王宮的衛所，放火焚燒宮殿，自焚而死。
english: And when Zimri saw that the town was taken, he went into the inner room of the king's house, and burning the house over his head, came to his end,

chinese: 這是因他犯罪，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行耶羅波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裡的那罪。
english: Because of his sin in doing evil in the eyes of the Lord, in going in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin which he made Israel do.

chinese: 心利其餘的事和他背叛的情形都寫在以色列諸王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and the secret design he made, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

chinese: 那時，以色列民分為兩半：一半隨從基納的兒子提比尼，要立他作王；一半隨從暗利。
english: Then there was a division among the people of Israel; half the people were for making Tibni, son of Ginath, king, and half were supporting Omri.

chinese: 但隨從暗利的民勝過隨從基納的兒子提比尼的民。提比尼死了，暗利就作了王。
english: But the supporters of Omri overcame those who were on the side of Tibni, the son of Ginath; and death came to Tibni and to his brother Joram at that time: and Omri became king in the place of Tibni.

chinese: 猶大王亞撒三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年；在得撒作王六年。
english: In the thirty-first year of Asa, king of Judah, Omri became king over Israel, and he was king for twelve years; for six years he was ruling in Tirzah.

chinese: 暗利用二他連得銀子向撒瑪買了撒瑪利亞山，在山上造城，就按著山的原主撒瑪的名，給所造的城起名叫撒瑪利亞。
english: He got the hill Samaria from Shemer for the price of two talents of silver, and he made a town there, building it on the hill and naming it Samaria, after Shemer the owner of the hill.

chinese: 暗利行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，比他以前的列王作惡更甚。
english: And Omri did evil in the eyes of the Lord, even worse than all those before him,

chinese: 因他行了尼八的兒子耶羅波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裡的那罪，以虛無的神惹耶和華─以色列神的怒氣。
english: Copying all the evil ways of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, and all the sins he did and made Israel do, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath by their foolish ways.

chinese: 暗利其餘的事和他所顯出的勇力都寫在以色列諸王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts which Omri did, and his great power, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

chinese: 暗利與他列祖同睡，葬在撒瑪利亞。他兒子亞哈接續他作王。
english: So Omri went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in Samaria; and Ahab his son became king in his place.

chinese: 猶大王亞撒三十八年，暗利的兒子亞哈登基作了以色列王。暗利的兒子亞哈在撒瑪利亞作以色列王二十二年。
english: In the thirty-eighth year that Asa was king of Judah, Ahab, the son of Omri, became king over Israel; and Ahab was king in Samaria for twenty-two years.

chinese: 暗利的兒子亞哈行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，比他以前的列王更甚，
english: And Ahab, the son of Omri, did evil in the eyes of the Lord, even worse than all who went before him.

chinese: 犯了尼八的兒子耶羅波安所犯的罪；他還以為輕，又娶了西頓王謁巴力的女兒耶洗別為妻，去事奉敬拜巴力，
english: And as if copying the evil ways of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, was a small thing for him, he took as his wife Jezebel, daughter of Ethbaal, king of Zidon, and became a servant and worshipper of Baal.

chinese: 在撒瑪利亞建造巴力的廟，在廟裡為巴力築壇。
english: And he put up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal which he had made in Samaria.

chinese: 亞哈又做亞舍拉，他所行的惹耶和華─以色列神的怒氣，比他以前的以色列諸王更甚。
english: And Ahab made an image of Asherah and did more than all the kings of Israel before him to make the Lord, the God of Israel, angry.

chinese: 亞哈在位的時候，有伯特利人希伊勒重修耶利哥城；立根基的時候，喪了長子亞比蘭；安門的時候，喪了幼子西割，正如耶和華藉嫩的兒子約書亞所說的話。
english: In his days Hiel made Jericho; he put its base in position at the price of Abiram, his oldest son, and he put its doors in place at the price of his youngest son Segub; even as the Lord had said by Joshua, the son of Nun.

chinese: 基列寄居的提斯比人以利亞對亞哈說：我指著所事奉永生耶和華─以色列的神起誓，這幾年我若不禱告，必不降露，不下雨。
english: And Elijah the Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, By the living Lord, the God of Israel, whose servant I am, there will be no dew or rain in these years, but only at my word.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到以利亞說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,

chinese: 你離開這裡往東去，藏在約但河東邊的基立溪旁。
english: Go from here in the direction of the east, and keep yourself in a secret place by the stream Cherith, east of Jordan.

chinese: 你要喝那溪裡的水，我已吩咐烏鴉在那裡供養你。
english: The water of the stream will be your drink, and by my orders the ravens will give you food there.

chinese: 於是以利亞照著耶和華的話，去住在約但河東的基立溪旁。
english: So he went and did as the Lord said, living by the stream Cherith, east of Jordan.

chinese: 烏鴉早晚給他叼餅和肉來，他也喝那溪裡的水。
english: And the ravens took him bread in the morning and meat in the evening; and the water of the stream was his drink.

chinese: 過了些日子，溪水就乾了，因為雨沒有下在地上。
english: Now after a time the stream became dry, because there was no rain in the land.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到他說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,

chinese: 你起身往西頓的撒勒法(撒勒法與路四26同)去，住在那裡；我已吩咐那裡的一個寡婦供養你。
english: Up! go now to Zarephath, in Zidon, and make your living-place there; I have given orders to a widow woman there to see that you have food.

chinese: 以利亞就起身往撒勒法去。到了城門，見有一個寡婦在那裡撿柴，以利亞呼叫他說：求你用器皿取點水來給我喝。
english: So he got up and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the door of the town, he saw a widow woman getting sticks together; and crying out to her he said, Will you give me a little water in a vessel for my drink?

chinese: 他去取水的時候，以利亞又呼叫他說：也求你拿點餅來給我！
english: And when she was going to get it, he said to her, And get me with it a small bit of bread.

chinese: 他說：我指著永生耶和華─你的神起誓，我沒有餅，罈內只有一把麵，瓶裡只有一點油；我現在找兩根柴，回家要為我和我兒子做餅；我們吃了，死就死罷！
english: Then she said, By the life of the Lord your God, I have nothing but a little meal in my store, and a drop of oil in the bottle; and now I am getting two sticks together so that I may go in and make it ready for me and my son, so that we may have a meal before our death.

chinese: 以利亞對他說：不要懼怕！可以照你所說的去做罷！只要先為我做一個小餅拿來給我，然後為你和你的兒子做餅。
english: And Elijah said to her, Have no fear; go and do as you have said, but first make me a little cake of it and come and give it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.

chinese: 因為耶和華─以色列的神如此說：罈內的麵必不減少，瓶裡的油必不缺短，直到耶和華使雨降在地上的日子。
english: For this is the word of the Lord, the God of Israel: The store of meal will not come to an end, and the bottle will never be without oil, till the day when the Lord sends rain on the earth.

chinese: 婦人就照以利亞的話去行。他和他家中的人，並以利亞，吃了許多日子。
english: So she went and did as Elijah said; and she and he and her family had food for a long time.

chinese: 罈內的麵果不減少，瓶裡的油也不缺短，正如耶和華藉以利亞所說的話。
english: The store of meal did not come to an end, and the bottle was never without oil, as the Lord had said by the mouth of Elijah.

chinese: 這事以後，作那家主母的婦人，他兒子病了；病得甚重，以致身無氣息。
english: Now after this, the son of the woman of the house became ill, so ill that there was no breath in him.

chinese: 婦人對以利亞說：神人哪，我與你何干？你竟到我這裡來，使神想念我的罪，以致我的兒子死呢？
english: And she said to Elijah, What have I to do with you, O man of God? have you come to put God in mind of my sin, and to put my son to death?

chinese: 以利亞對他說：把你兒子交給我。以利亞就從婦人懷中將孩子接過來，抱到他所住的樓中，放在自己的床上，
english: And he said to her, Give your son to me. And lifting him out of her arms, he took him up to his room and put him down on his bed.

chinese: 就求告耶和華說：耶和華─我的神啊，我寄居在這寡婦的家裡，你就降禍與他，使他的兒子死了麼？
english: And crying to the Lord he said, O Lord my God, have you sent evil even on the widow whose guest I am, by causing her son's death?

chinese: 以利亞三次伏在孩子的身上，求告耶和華說：耶和華─我的神啊，求你使這孩子的靈魂仍入他的身體！
english: And stretching herself out on the child three times, he made his prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord my God, be pleased to let this child's life come back to him again.

chinese: 耶和華應允以利亞的話，孩子的靈魂仍入他的身體，他就活了。
english: And the Lord gave ear to the voice of Elijah, and the child's spirit came into him again, and he came back to life.

chinese: 以利亞將孩子從樓上抱下來，進屋子交給他母親，說：看哪，你的兒子活了！
english: And Elijah took the child down from his room into the house and gave him to his mother and said to her, See, your son is living.

chinese: 婦人對以利亞說：現在我知道你是神人，耶和華藉你口所說的話是真的。
english: Then the woman said to Elijah, Now I am certain that you are a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is true.

chinese: 過了許久，到第三年，耶和華的話臨到以利亞說：你去，使亞哈得見你；我要降雨在地上。
english: Now after a long time, the word of the Lord came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, Go and let Ahab see you, so that I may send rain on the earth.

chinese: 以利亞就去，要使亞哈得見他。那時，撒瑪利亞有大饑荒；
english: So Elijah went to let Ahab see him. Now there was no food to be had in Samaria.

chinese: 亞哈將他的家宰俄巴底召了來。〈俄巴底甚是敬畏耶和華，
english: And Ahab sent for Obadiah, the controller of the king's house. (Now Obadiah had the fear of the Lord before him greatly;

chinese: 耶洗別殺耶和華眾先知的時候，俄巴底將一百個先知藏了，每五十人藏在一個洞裡，拿餅和水供養他們。〉
english: For when Jezebel was cutting off the prophets of the Lord, Obadiah took a hundred of them, and kept them secretly in a hole in the rock, fifty at a time, and gave them bread and water.)

chinese: 亞哈對俄巴底說：我們走遍這地，到一切水泉旁和一切溪邊，或者找得著青草，可以救活騾馬，免得絕了牲畜。
english: And Ahab said to Obadiah, Come, let us go through all the country, to all the fountains of water and all the rivers, and see if there is any grass to be had for the horses and the transport beasts, so that we may be able to keep some of the beasts from destruction.

chinese: 於是二人分地遊行，亞哈獨走一路，俄巴底獨走一路。
english: So they went through all the country, covering it between them; Ahab went in one direction by himself, and Obadiah went in another by himself.

chinese: 俄巴底在路上恰與以利亞相遇，俄巴底認出他來，就俯伏在地，說：你是我主以利亞不是？
english: And while Obadiah was on his way, he came face to face with Elijah; and seeing who it was, he went down on his face and said, Is it you, my lord Elijah?

chinese: 回答說：是。你去告訴你主人說，以利亞在這裡。
english: And Elijah in answer said, It is I; now go and say to your lord, Elijah is here.

chinese: 俄巴底說：僕人有甚麼罪，你竟要將我交在亞哈手裡，使他殺我呢？
english: And he said, What sin have I done, that you would give up your servant into the hand of Ahab, and be the cause of my death?

chinese: 我指著永生耶和華─你的神起誓，無論哪一邦哪一國，我主都打發人去找你。若說你沒有在那裡，就必使那邦那國的人起誓說，實在是找不著你。
english: By the life of the Lord your God, there is not a nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent in search of you; and when they said, He is not here; he made them take an oath that they had not seen you.

chinese: 現在你說，要去告訴你主人說，以利亞在這裡；
english: And now you say, Go, say to your lord, Elijah is here.

chinese: 恐怕我一離開你，耶和華的靈就提你到我所不知道的地方去。這樣，我去告訴亞哈，他若找不著你，就必殺我；僕人卻是自幼敬畏耶和華的。
english: And straight away, when I have gone from you, the spirit of the Lord will take you away, I have no idea where, so that when I come and give word to Ahab, and he sees you not, he will put me to death: though I, your servant, have been a worshipper of the Lord from my earliest years.

chinese: 耶洗別殺耶和華眾先知的時候，我將耶和華的一百個先知藏了，每五十人藏在一個洞裡，拿餅和水供養他們，豈沒有人將這事告訴我主麼？
english: Has my lord not had word of what I did when Jezebel was putting the Lord's prophets to death? how I kept a hundred of them in a secret hole in the rock, fifty at a time, and gave them bread and water?

chinese: 現在你說，要去告訴你主人說，以利亞在這裡，他必殺我。
english: And now you say, Go and say to your Lord, Elijah is here; and he will put me to death.

chinese: 以利亞說：我指著所事奉永生的萬軍之耶和華起誓，我今日必使亞哈得見我。
english: And Elijah said, By the life of the Lord of armies, whose servant I am, I will certainly let him see me today.

chinese: 於是俄巴底去迎著亞哈，告訴他；亞哈就去迎著以利亞。
english: So Obadiah went to Ahab and gave him the news; and Ahab went to see Elijah.

chinese: 亞哈見了以利亞，便說：使以色列遭災的就是你麼？
english: And when he saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, Is it you, you troubler of Israel?

chinese: 以利亞說：使以色列遭災的不是我，乃是你和你父家；因為你們離棄耶和華的誡命，去隨從巴力。
english: Then he said in answer, I have not been troubling Israel, but you and your family; because, turning away from the orders of the Lord, you have gone after the Baals.

chinese: 現在你當差遣人，招聚以色列眾人和事奉巴力的那四百五十個先知，並耶洗別所供養事奉亞舍拉的那四百個先知，使他們都上迦密山去見我。
english: Now send, and get Israel together before me at Mount Carmel, with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal who get their food at Jezebel's table.

chinese: 亞哈就差遣人招聚以色列眾人和先知都上迦密山。
english: So Ahab sent for all the children of Israel, and got the prophets together at Mount Carmel.

chinese: 以利亞前來對眾民說：你們心持兩意要到幾時呢？若耶和華是神，就當順從耶和華；若巴力是神，就當順從巴力。眾民一言不答。
english: And Elijah came near to all the people and said, How long will you go on balancing between two opinions? if the Lord is God, then give worship to him; but if Baal, give worship to him. And the people said not a word in answer.

chinese: 以利亞對眾民說：作耶和華先知的只剩下我一個人；巴力的先知卻有四百五十個人。
english: Then Elijah said to the people, I, even I, am the only living prophet of the Lord; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

chinese: 當給我們兩隻牛犢，巴力的先知可以挑選一隻，切成塊子，放在柴上，不要點火；我也預備一隻牛犢放在柴上，也不點火。
english: Now, let them give us two oxen; and let them take one for themselves, and have it cut up, and put it on the wood, but put no fire under it; I will get the other ox ready, and put it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

chinese: 你們求告你們神的名，我也求告耶和華的名。那降火顯應的　神，就是　神。眾民回答說：這話甚好。
english: And do you make prayers to your god, and I will make a prayer to the Lord: and it will be clear that the one who gives an answer by fire is God. And all the people in answer said, It is well said.

chinese: 以利亞對巴力的先知說：你們既是人多，當先挑選一隻牛犢，預備好了，就求告你們神的名，卻不要點火。
english: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Take one ox for yourselves and get it ready first, for there are more of you; and make your prayers to your god, but put no fire under.

chinese: 他們將所得的牛犢預備好了，從早晨到午間，求告巴力的名說：巴力啊，求你應允我們！卻沒有聲音，沒有應允的。他們在所築的壇四圍踊跳。
english: So they took the ox which was given them, and made it ready, crying out to Baal from morning till the middle of the day, and saying, O Baal, give ear to us. But there was no voice and no answer. And they were jumping up and down before the altar they had made.

chinese: 到了正午，以利亞嬉笑他們，說：大聲求告罷！因為他是神，他或默想，或走到一邊，或行路，或睡覺，你們當叫醒他。
english: And in the middle of the day, Elijah made sport of them, saying, Give louder cries, for he is a god; he may be deep in thought, or he may have gone away for some purpose, or he may be on a journey, or by chance he is sleeping and has to be made awake.

chinese: 他們大聲求告，按著他們的規矩，用刀槍自割、自刺，直到身體流血。
english: So they gave loud cries, cutting themselves with knives and swords, as was their way, till the blood came streaming out all over them.

chinese: 從午後直到獻晚祭的時候，他們狂呼亂叫，卻沒有聲音，沒有應允的，也沒有理會的。
english: And from the middle of the day they went on with their prayers till the time of the offering; but there was no voice, or any answer, or any who gave attention to them.

chinese: 以利亞對眾民說：你們到我這裡來。眾民就到他那裡。他便重修已經毀壞耶和華的壇。
english: Then Elijah said to all the people, Come near to me; and all the people came near. And he put up again the altar of the Lord which had been broken down.

chinese: 以利亞照雅各子孫支派的數目，取了十二塊石頭（耶和華的話曾臨到雅各說：你的名要叫以色列），
english: And Elijah took twelve stones, the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the Lord had said, Israel will be your name:

chinese: 用這些石頭為耶和華的名築一座壇，在壇的四圍挖溝，可容穀種二細亞，
english: And with the stones he made an altar to the name of the Lord; and he made a deep drain all round the altar, great enough to take two measures of seed.

chinese: 又在壇上擺好了柴，把牛犢切成塊子放在柴上，對眾人說：你們用四個桶盛滿水，倒在燔祭和柴上；
english: And he put the wood in order, and, cutting up the ox, put it on the wood. Then he said, Get four vessels full of water and put it on the burned offering and on the wood. And he said, Do it a second time, and they did it a second time;

chinese: 又說：倒第二次。他們就倒第二次；又說：倒第三次。他們就倒第三次。
english: And he said, Do it a third time, and they did it a third time.

chinese: 水流在壇的四圍，溝裡也滿了水。
english: And the water went all round the altar, till the drain was full.

chinese: 到了獻晚祭的時候，先知以利亞近前來，說：亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神，耶和華啊，求你今日使人知道你是以色列的　神，也知道我是你的僕人，又是奉你的命行這一切事。
english: Then at the time of the offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, O Lord, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be seen this day that you are God in Israel, and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things by your order.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你應允我，應允我！使這民知道你─耶和華是神，又知道是你叫這民的心回轉。
english: Give me an answer, O Lord, give me an answer, so that this people may see that you are God, and that you have made their hearts come back again.

chinese: 於是，耶和華降下火來，燒盡燔祭、木柴、石頭、塵土，又燒乾溝裡的水。
english: Then the fire of the Lord came down, burning up the offering and the wood and the stones and the dust, and drinking up the water in the drain.

chinese: 眾民看見了，就俯伏在地，說：耶和華是神！耶和華是　神！
english: And when the people saw it, they all went down on their faces, and said, The Lord, he is God, the Lord, he is God.

chinese: 以利亞對他們說：拿住巴力的先知，不容一人逃脫！眾人就拿住他們。以利亞帶他們到基順河邊，在那裡殺了他們。
english: And Elijah said to them, Take the prophets of Baal, let not one of them get away. So they took them, and Elijah made them go down to the stream Kishon, and put them to death there.

chinese: 以利亞對亞哈說：你現在可以上去吃喝，因為有多雨的響聲了。
english: Then Elijah said to Ahab, Up! take food and drink, for there is a sound of much rain.

chinese: 亞哈就上去吃喝。以利亞上了迦密山頂，屈身在地，將臉伏在兩膝之中；
english: So Ahab went up to have food and drink, while Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he went down on the earth, putting his face between his knees.

chinese: 對僕人說：你上去，向海觀看。僕人就上去觀看，說：沒有甚麼。他說：你再去觀看。如此七次。
english: And he said to his servant, Go now, and take a look in the direction of the sea. And he went up, and after looking said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times; and he went seven times.

chinese: 第七次僕人說：我看見有一小片雲從海裡上來，不過如人手那樣大。以利亞說：你上去告訴亞哈，當套車下去，免得被雨阻擋。
english: And the seventh time he said, I see a cloud coming up out of the sea, as small as a man's hand. Then he said, Go up and say to Ahab, Get your carriage ready and go down or the rain will keep you back.

chinese: 霎時間，天因風雲黑暗，降下大雨。亞哈就坐車往耶斯列去了。
english: And after a very little time, the heaven became black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab went in his carriage to Jezreel.

chinese: 耶和華的靈(原文是手)降在以利亞身上，他就束上腰，奔在亞哈前頭，直到耶斯列的城門。
english: And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah; and he made himself strong, and went running before Ahab till they came to Jezreel.

chinese: 亞哈將以利亞一切所行的和他用刀殺眾先知的事都告訴耶洗別。
english: Ahab gave Jezebel news of all Elijah had done, and how he had put all the prophets to death with the sword.

chinese: 耶洗別就差遣人去見以利亞，告訴他說：明日約在這時候，我若不使你的性命像那些人的性命一樣，願神明重重地降罰與我。
english: Then Jezebel sent a servant to Elijah, saying, May the gods' punishment be on me if I do not make your life like the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time.

chinese: 以利亞見這光景就起來逃命，到了猶大的別是巴，將僕人留在那裡，
english: And he got up, fearing for his life, and went in flight, and came to Beer-sheba in Judah, parting there from his servant;

chinese: 自己在曠野走了一日的路程，來到一棵羅騰(小樹名，松類；下同)樹下，就坐在那裡求死，說：耶和華啊，罷了！求你取我的性命，因為我不勝於我的列祖。
english: While he himself went a day's journey into the waste land, and took a seat under a broom-plant, desiring for himself only death; for he said, It is enough: now, O Lord, take away my life, for I am no better than my fathers.

chinese: 他就躺在羅騰樹下，睡著了。有一個天使拍他，說：起來吃罷！
english: And stretching himself on the earth, he went to sleep under the broom-plant; but an angel, touching him, said to him, Get up and have some food.

chinese: 他觀看，見頭旁有一瓶水與炭火燒的餅，他就吃了喝了，仍然躺下。
english: And looking up, he saw by his head a cake cooked on the stones and a bottle of water. So he took food and drink and went to sleep again.

chinese: 耶和華的使者第二次來拍他，說：起來吃罷！因為你當走的路甚遠。
english: And the angel of the Lord came again a second time, and touching him said, Get up and have some food, or the journey will be overmuch for your strength.

chinese: 他就起來吃了喝了，仗著這飲食的力，走了四十晝夜，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
english: So he got up and took food and drink, and in the strength of that food he went on for forty days and nights, to Horeb, the mountain of God.

chinese: 他在那裡進了一個洞，就住在洞中。耶和華的話臨到他說：以利亞啊，你在這裡做甚麼？
english: And there he went into a hole in the rock for the night; then the word of the Lord came to him, saying, What are you doing here, Elijah?

chinese: 他說：我為耶和華─萬軍之神大發熱心；因為以色列人背棄了你的約，毀壞了你的壇，用刀殺了你的先知，只剩下我一個人，他們還要尋索我的命。
english: And he said, I have been burning for the honour of the Lord, the God of armies; for the children of Israel have not kept your agreement; they have made destruction of your altars, and have put your prophets to death with the sword: till I, even I, am the only one living; and now they are attempting to take away my life.

chinese: 耶和華說：你出來站在山上，在我面前。那時耶和華從那裡經過，在他面前有烈風大作，崩山碎石，耶和華卻不在風中；風後地震，耶和華卻不在其中；
english: Then he said, Go out and take your place on the mountain before the Lord. Then the Lord went by, and mountains were parted by the force of a great wind, and rocks were broken before the Lord; but the Lord was not in the wind. And after the wind there was an earth-shock, but the Lord was not in the earth-shock.

chinese: 地震後有火，耶和華也不在火中；火後有微小的聲音。
english: And after the earth-shock a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire, the sound of a soft breath.

chinese: 以利亞聽見，就用外衣蒙上臉，出來站在洞口。有聲音向他說：以利亞啊，你在這裡做甚麼？
english: And Elijah, hearing it, went out, covering his face with his robe, and took his place in the opening of the hole. And there a voice came to him saying, What are you doing here, Elijah?

chinese: 他說：我為耶和華─萬軍之神大發熱心；因為以色列人背棄了你的約，毀壞了你的壇，用刀殺了你的先知，只剩下我一個人，他們還要尋索我的命。
english: And he said, I have been burning for the honour of the Lord, the God of armies; for the children of Israel have not kept your agreement; they have had your altars broken down, and have put your prophets to death with the sword: till I, even I, am the only one living; and now they are attempting to take away my life.

chinese: 耶和華對他說：你回去，從曠野往大馬色去。到了那裡，就要膏哈薛作亞蘭王，
english: And the Lord said to him, Go back on your way through the waste land to Damascus; and when you come there, put the holy oil on Hazael to make him king over Aram;

chinese: 又膏寧示的孫子耶戶作以色列王，並膏亞伯米何拉人沙法的兒子以利沙作先知接續你。
english: And on Jehu, son of Nimshi, making him king over Israel; and on Elisha, the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah, to be prophet in your place.

chinese: 將來躲避哈薛之刀的，必被耶戶所殺；躲避耶戶之刀的，必被以利沙所殺。
english: And it will come about that the man who gets away safe from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will put to death; and whoever gets away safe from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will put to death.

chinese: 但我在以色列人中為自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的，未曾與巴力親嘴的。
english: But I will keep safe seven thousand in Israel, all those whose knees have not been bent to Baal, and whose mouths have given him no kisses.

chinese: 於是，以利亞離開那裡走了，遇見沙法的兒子以利沙耕地；在他前頭有十二對牛，自己趕著第十二對。以利亞到他那裡去，將自己的外衣搭在他身上。
english: So he went away from there and came across Elisha, the son of Shaphat, ploughing with twelve yoke of oxen, he himself walking with the twelfth; and Elijah went up to him and put his robe on him.

chinese: 以利沙就離開牛，跑到以利亞那裡，說：求你容我先與父母親嘴，然後我便跟隨你。以利亞對他說：你回去罷，我向你做了甚麼呢？
english: And letting the oxen be where they were, he came running after Elijah, and said, Only let me give a kiss to my father and mother, and then I will come after you. But he said to him, Go back again; for what have I done to you?

chinese: 以利沙就離開他回去，宰了一對牛，用套牛的器具煮肉給民吃，隨後就起身跟隨以利亞，服事他。
english: And he went back, and took the oxen and put them to death, and cooking their flesh with the yokes of the oxen, he gave the people a feast. Then he got up and went after Elijah and became his servant.

chinese: 亞蘭王便哈達聚集他的全軍，率領三十二個王，帶著車馬上來圍攻撒瑪利亞；
english: Now Ben-hadad, king of Aram, got all his army together, and thirty-two kings with him, and horses and carriages of war; he went up and made war on Samaria, shutting it in.

chinese: 又差遣使者進城見以色列王亞哈，對他說：便哈達如此說：
english: And he sent representatives into the town to Ahab, king of Israel;

chinese: 你的金銀都要歸我，你妻子兒女中最美的也要歸我。
english: And they said to him, Ben-hadad says, Your silver and your gold are mine; and your wives and children are mine.

chinese: 以色列王回答說：我主我王啊，可以依著你的話，我與我所有的都歸你。
english: And the king of Israel sent him an answer saying, As you say, my lord king, I am yours with all I have.

chinese: 使者又來說：便哈達如此說：我已差遣人去見你，要你將你的金銀、妻子、兒女都給我。
english: Then the representatives came back again, and said, These are the words of Ben-hadad: I sent to you saying, Give up to me your silver and your gold, your wives and your children;

chinese: 但明日約在這時候，我還要差遣臣僕到你那裡，搜查你的家和你僕人的家，將你眼中一切所喜愛的都拿了去。
english: But I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, to make a search through your house and the houses of your people, and everything which is pleasing in your eyes they will take away in their hands.

chinese: 以色列王召了國中的長老來，對他們說：請你們看看，這人是怎樣地謀害我，他先差遣人到我這裡來，要我的妻子、兒女，和金銀，我並沒有推辭他。
english: Then the king of Israel sent for all the responsible men of the land, and said, Now will you take note and see the evil purpose of this man: he sent for my wives and my children, my silver and my gold, and I did not keep them back.

chinese: 長老和百姓對王說：不要聽從他，也不要應允他。
english: And all the responsible men and the people said to him, Do not give attention to him or do what he says.

chinese: 故此，以色列王對便哈達的使者說：你們告訴我主我王說：王頭一次差遣人向僕人所要的，僕人都依從；但這次所要的，我不能依從。使者就去回覆便哈達。
english: So he said to the representatives of Ben-hadad, Say to my lord the king, All the orders you sent the first time I will do; but this thing I may not do. And the representatives went back with this answer.

chinese: 便哈達又差遣人去見亞哈說：撒瑪利亞的塵土若夠跟從我的人每人捧一捧的，願神明重重地降罰與我！
english: Then Ben-hadad sent to him, saying, May the gods' punishment be on me if there is enough of the dust of Samaria for all the people at my feet to take some in their hands.

chinese: 以色列王說：你告訴他說，才頂盔貫甲的，休要像摘盔卸甲的誇口。
english: And the king of Israel said in answer, Say to him, The time for loud talk is not when a man is putting on his arms, but when he is taking them off.

chinese: 便哈達和諸王正在帳幕裡喝酒，聽見這話，就對他臣僕說：擺隊罷！他們就擺隊攻城。
english: Now when this answer was given to Ben-hadad, he was drinking with the kings in the tents, and he said to his men, Take up your positions. So they put themselves in position for attacking the town.

chinese: 有一個先知來見以色列王亞哈，說：耶和華如此說：這一大群人你看見了麼？今日我必將他們交在你手裡，你就知道我是耶和華。
english: Then a prophet came up to Ahab, king of Israel, and said, The Lord says, Have you seen all this great army? See, I will give it into your hands today, and you will see that I am the Lord.

chinese: 亞哈說：藉著誰呢？他回答說：耶和華說，藉著跟從省長的少年人。亞哈說：要誰率領呢？他說：要你親自率領。
english: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, The Lord says, By the servants of the chiefs who are over the divisions of the land. Then he said, By whom is the fighting to be started? And he made answer, By you.

chinese: 於是亞哈數點跟從省長的少年人，共有二百三十二名，後又數點以色列的眾兵，共有七千名。
english: Then he got together the servants of all the chiefs who were over the divisions of the land, two hundred and thirty-two of them; and after them, he got together all the people, all the children of Israel, seven thousand.

chinese: 午間，他們就出城；便哈達和幫助他的三十二個王正在帳幕裡痛飲。
english: And in the middle of the day they went out. But Ben-hadad was drinking in the tents with the thirty-two kings who were helping him.

chinese: 跟從省長的少年人先出城；便哈達差遣人去探望，他們回報說：有人從撒瑪利亞出來了。
english: And the servants of the chiefs who were over the divisions of the land went forward first; and when Ben-hadad sent out, they gave him the news, saying, Men have come out from Samaria.

chinese: 他說：他們若為講和出來，要活捉他們；若為打仗出來，也要活捉他們。
english: And he said, If they have come out for peace, take them living, and if they have come out for war, take them living.

chinese: 跟從省長的少年人出城，軍兵跟隨他們；
english: So the servants of the chiefs of the divisions of the land went out of the town, with the army coming after them.

chinese: 各人遇見敵人就殺。亞蘭人逃跑，以色列人追趕他們；亞蘭王便哈達騎著馬和馬兵一同逃跑。
english: And every one of them put his man to death, and the Aramaeans went in flight with Israel after them; and Ben-hadad, king of Aram, got away safely on a horse with his horsemen.

chinese: 以色列王出城攻打車馬，大大擊殺亞蘭人。
