english: But the people of the land put to death all those who had taken part in the design against the king, and made Josiah his son king in his place.

chinese: 亞們其餘所行的事都寫在猶大列王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts which Amon did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

chinese: 亞們葬在烏撒的園內自己的墳墓裡。他兒子約西亞接續他作王。
english: He was put in his last resting-place in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son became king in his place.

chinese: 約西亞登基的時候年八歲，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。他母親名叫耶底大，是波斯加人亞大雅的女兒。
english: Josiah was eight years old when he became king; and he was ruling in Jerusalem for thirty-one years; his mother's name was Jedidah, daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

chinese: 約西亞行耶和華眼中看為正的事，行他祖大衛一切所行的，不偏左右。
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, walking in the ways of David his father, without turning to the right hand or to the left.

chinese: 約西亞王十八年，王差遣米書蘭的孫子、亞薩利的兒子─書記沙番上耶和華殿去，吩咐他說：
english: Now in the eighteenth year after he became king, Josiah sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying to him,

chinese: 你去見大祭司希勒家，使他將奉到耶和華殿的銀子，就是守門的從民中收聚的銀子，數算數算，
english: Go up to Hilkiah, the chief priest, and let him give out the money which is taken into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the door have got together from the people;

chinese: 交給耶和華殿裡辦事的人，使他們轉交耶和華殿裡做工的人，好修理殿的破壞之處，
english: And let it be given to the overseers of the work of the Lord's house, to give to the workmen who are making good what was damaged in the house of the Lord;

chinese: 就是轉交木匠和工人，並瓦匠，又買木料和鑿成的石頭修理殿宇，
english: To the woodworkers and the builders and the stone-cutters; and for getting wood and cut stones for the building up of the house.

chinese: 將銀子交在辦事的人手裡，不與他們算帳，因為他們辦事誠實。
english: They did not have to give any account of the money which was handed to them, for they made use of it with good faith.

chinese: 大祭司希勒家對書記沙番說：我在耶和華殿裡得了律法書。希勒家將書遞給沙番，沙番就看了。
english: Then Hilkiah, the chief priest, said to Shaphan the scribe, I have made discovery of the book of the law in the house of the Lord. So Hilkiah gave it to Shaphan;

chinese: 書記沙番到王那裡，回覆王說：你的僕人已將殿裡的銀子倒出數算，交給耶和華殿裡辦事的人了。
english: Then, after reading it, Shaphan the scribe went in to the king and gave him an account of what had been done, saying, Your servants have given out the money which was in the house, and have given it to the overseers of the work of the house of the Lord.

chinese: 書記沙番又對王說：祭司希勒家遞給我一卷書。沙番就在王面前讀那書。
english: Then Shaphan the scribe said to the king, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book; and he was reading it before the king.

chinese: 王聽見律法書上的話，便撕裂衣服，
english: And the king, hearing the words of the book of the law, took his robe in his hands, violently parting it as a sign of his grief;

chinese: 吩咐祭司希勒家與沙番的兒子亞希甘、米該亞的兒子亞革波、書記沙番和王的臣僕亞撒雅，說：
english: And he gave orders to Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, and Achbor, the son of Micaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king's servant, saying,

chinese: 你們去為我、為民、為猶大眾人，以這書上的話求問耶和華；因為我們列祖沒有聽從這書上的言語，沒有遵著書上所吩咐我們的去行，耶和華就向我們大發烈怒。
english: Go and get directions from the Lord for me and for the people and for all Judah, about the words of this book which has come to light; for great is the wrath of the Lord which is burning against us, because our fathers have not given ear to the words of this book, to do all the things which are recorded in it.

chinese: 於是，祭司希勒家和亞希甘、亞革波、沙番、亞撒雅都去見女先知戶勒大。戶勒大是掌管禮服沙龍的妻；沙龍是哈珥哈斯的孫子、特瓦的兒子。戶勒大住在耶路撒冷第二區。他們請問於他。
english: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam and Achbor and Shaphan and Asaiah, went to Huldah the woman prophet, the wife of Shallum, the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the robes, (now she was living in Jerusalem, in the second part of the town;) and they had talk with her.

chinese: 他對他們說：耶和華─以色列的神如此說：你們可以回覆那差遣你們來見我的人說，
english: And she said to them, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, Say to the man who sent you to me,

chinese: 耶和華如此說：我必照著猶大王所讀那書上的一切話，降禍與這地和其上的居民。
english: These are the words of the Lord: See, I will send evil on this place and on its people, even everything which the king of Judah has been reading in the book;

chinese: 因為他們離棄我，向別神燒香，用他們手所做的惹我發怒，所以我的忿怒必向這地發作，總不止息。
english: Because they have given me up, burning offerings to other gods and moving me to wrath by all the work of their hands; so my wrath will be on fire against this place, and will not be put out.

chinese: 然而，差遣你們來求問耶和華的猶大王，你們要這樣回覆他說：耶和華─以色列的神如此說：至於你所聽見的話，
english: But to the king of Judah who sent you to get directions from the Lord, say, This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said: As to the words which have come to your ears,

chinese: 就是聽見我指著這地和其上的居民所說、要使這地變為荒場、民受咒詛的話，你便心裡敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我應允了你。這是我─耶和華說的。
english: Because your heart was soft, and you made yourself low before me, when you had word of what I said against this place and its people, that they would become a waste and a curse, and you gave signs of grief, weeping before me: truly, I have given ear to you, says the Lord.

chinese: 我必使你平平安安地歸到墳墓到你列祖那裡；我要降與這地的一切災禍，你也不至親眼看見。他們就回覆王去了。
english: For this cause I will let you go to your fathers and be put in your last resting-place in peace, and your eyes will not see all the evil which I will send on this place. So they took this news back to the king.

chinese: 王差遣人招聚猶大和耶路撒冷的眾長老來。
english: Then the king sent and got together all the responsible men of Judah and of Jerusalem.

chinese: 王和猶大眾人與耶路撒冷的居民，並祭司、先知，和所有的百姓，無論大小，都一同上到耶和華的殿；王就把耶和華殿裡所得的約書念給他們聽。
english: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, with all the men of Judah and all the people of Jerusalem, and the priests and the prophets and all the people, small and great; and they were present at his reading of the book of the law which had come to light in the house of the Lord.

chinese: 王站在柱旁，在耶和華面前立約，要盡心盡性地順從耶和華，遵守他的誡命、法度、律例，成就這書上所記的約言。眾民都服從這約。
english: And the king took his place by the pillar, and made an agreement before the Lord, to go in the way of the Lord, and keep his orders and his decisions and his rules with all his heart and all his soul, and to keep the words of the agreement recorded in the book; and all the people gave their word to keep the agreement.

chinese: 王吩咐大祭司希勒家和副祭司，並把門的，將那為巴力和亞舍拉，並天上萬象所造的器皿，都從耶和華殿裡搬出來，在耶路撒冷外汲淪溪旁的田間燒了，把灰拿到伯特利去。
english: Then the king gave orders to Hilkiah, the chief priest, and to the priests of the second order, and to the keepers of the door, to take out of the house of the Lord all the vessels made for Baal and for the Asherah and for all the stars of heaven; and he had them burned outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and took the dust of them to Beth-el.

chinese: 從前猶大列王所立拜偶像的祭司，在猶大城邑的邱壇和耶路撒冷的周圍燒香，現在王都廢去，又廢去向巴力和日、月、行星(或作十二宮)，並天上萬象燒香的人；
english: And he put an end to the false priests, who had been put in their positions by the kings of Judah to see to the burning of offerings in the high places in the towns of Judah and the outskirts of Jerusalem, and all those who made offerings to Baal and to the sun and the moon and the twelve signs and all the stars of heaven.

chinese: 又從耶和華殿裡將亞舍拉搬到耶路撒冷外汲淪溪邊焚燒，打碎成灰，將灰撒在平民的墳上；
english: And he took the Asherah from the house of the Lord, outside Jerusalem to the stream Kidron, burning it by the stream and crushing it to dust, and he put the dust on the place where the bodies of the common people were put to rest.

chinese: 又拆毀耶和華殿裡孌童的屋子，就是婦女為亞舍拉織帳子的屋子，
english: And he had the houses pulled down of those who were used for sex purposes in the house of the Lord, where women were making robes for the Asherah.

chinese: 並且從猶大的城邑帶眾祭司來，污穢祭司燒香的邱壇，從迦巴直到別是巴，又拆毀城門旁的邱壇，這邱壇在邑宰約書亞門前，進城門的左邊。
english: And he made all the priests from the towns of Judah come into Jerusalem, and he made unclean the high places where the priests had been burning offerings, from Geba to Beer-sheba; and he had the high places of the evil spirits pulled down which were by the doorway of Joshua, the ruler of the town, on the left side of the way into the town.

chinese: 但是邱壇的祭司不登耶路撒冷耶和華的壇，只在他們弟兄中間吃無酵餅。
english: Still the priests of the high places never came up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem; but they took their food of unleavened bread among their brothers.

chinese: 又污穢欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不許人在那裡使兒女經火獻給摩洛；
english: And Topheth, in the valley of the sons of Hinnom, he made unclean, so that no man might make his son or his daughter go through the fire to Molech.

chinese: 又將猶大列王在耶和華殿門旁、太監拿單米勒靠近遊廊的屋子、向日頭所獻的馬廢去，且用火焚燒日車。
english: And he took away the horses which the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the way into the house of the Lord, by the room of Nathan-melech, the unsexed servant, which was in the outer part of the building, and the carriages of the sun he put on fire.

chinese: 猶大列王在亞哈斯樓頂上所築的壇和瑪拿西在耶和華殿兩院中所築的壇，王都拆毀打碎了，就把灰倒在汲淪溪中。
english: And the altars on the roof of the high room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two outer squares of the house of the Lord, were pulled down and crushed to bits, and the dust of them was put into the stream Kidron.

chinese: 從前以色列王所羅門在耶路撒冷前、邪僻山右邊為西頓人可憎的神亞斯他錄、摩押人可憎的神基抹、亞捫人可憎的神米勒公所築的邱壇，王都污穢了，
english: And the high places before Jerusalem, on the south side of the mountain of destruction, which Solomon, king of Israel, had made for Ashtoreth, the disgusting god of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh, the disgusting god of Moab, and for Milcom, the disgusting god of the children of Ammon, the king made unclean.

chinese: 又打碎柱像，砍下木偶，將人的骨頭充滿了那地方。
english: The stone pillars were broken to bits and the wood pillars cut down, and the places where they had been were made full of the bones of the dead.

chinese: 他將伯特利的壇，就是叫以色列人陷在罪裡、尼八的兒子耶羅波安所築的那壇，都拆毀焚燒，打碎成灰，並焚燒了亞舍拉。
english: And the altar at Beth-el, and the high place put up by Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who made Israel do evil, that altar and that high place were pulled down; and the high place was burned and crushed to dust and the Asherah was burned.

chinese: 約西亞回頭，看見山上的墳墓，就打發人將墳墓裡的骸骨取出來，燒在壇上，污穢了壇，正如從前神人宣傳耶和華的話。
english: Then Josiah, turning round, saw on the mountain the places of the dead, and he sent and had the bones taken out of their places and burned on the altar, so making it unclean, as the Lord had said by the man of God when Jeroboam was in his place by the altar on that feast-day. And he, turning his eyes to the resting-place of the man of God who had given word of these things, said:

chinese: 約西亞問說：我所看見的是甚麼碑？那城裡的人回答說：先前有神人從猶大來，預先說王現在向伯特利壇所行的事，這就是他的墓碑。
english: What is that headstone I see over there? And the men of the town said to him, It is the resting-place of the man of God who came from Judah and gave word of all these things which you have done to the altar of Beth-el.

chinese: 約西亞說：由他罷！不要挪移他的骸骨。他們就不動他的骸骨，也不動從撒瑪利亞來那先知的骸骨。
english: So he said, Let him be; let not his bones be moved. So they let his bones be with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.

chinese: 從前以色列諸王在撒瑪利亞的城邑建築邱壇的殿，惹動耶和華的怒氣，現在約西亞都廢去了，就如他在伯特利所行的一般；
english: Then Josiah took away all the houses of the high places in the towns of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had put up, moving the Lord to wrath, and he did with them as he had done in Beth-el.

chinese: 又將邱壇的祭司都殺在壇上，並在壇上燒人的骨頭，就回耶路撒冷去了。
english: And all the priests of the high places there he put to death on the altars, burning the bones of the dead on them; and then he went back to Jerusalem.

chinese: 王吩咐眾民說：你們當照這約書上所寫的，向耶和華─你們的神守逾越節。
english: And the king gave orders to all the people, saying, Keep the Passover to the Lord your God, as it says in this book of the law.

chinese: 自從士師治理以色列人和以色列王、猶大王的時候，直到如今，實在沒有守過這樣的逾越節；
english: Truly, such a Passover had not been kept in all the days of the judges of Israel or of the kings of Israel or the kings of Judah;

chinese: 只有約西亞王十八年在耶路撒冷向耶和華守這逾越節。
english: In the eighteenth year of the rule of King Josiah this Passover was kept to the Lord in Jerusalem.

chinese: 凡猶大國和耶路撒冷所有交鬼的、行巫術的，與家中的神像和偶像，並一切可憎之物，約西亞盡都除掉，成就了祭司希勒家在耶和華殿裡所得律法書上所寫的話。
english: And all those who had control of spirits, and the wonder-workers, and the images, and the false gods, and all the disgusting things which were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, Josiah put away, so that he might give effect to the words of the agreement recorded in the book which Hilkiah the priest made discovery of in the house of the Lord.

chinese: 在約西亞以前沒有王像他盡心、盡性、盡力地歸向耶和華，遵行摩西的一切律法；在他以後也沒有興起一個王像他。
english: Never before had there been a king like him, turning to the Lord with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his power, as the law of Moses says; and after him there was no king like him.

chinese: 然而，耶和華向猶大所發猛烈的怒氣仍不止息，是因瑪拿西諸事惹動他。
english: But still the heat of the Lord's wrath was not turned back from Judah, because of all Manasseh had done in moving him to wrath.

chinese: 耶和華說：我必將猶大人從我面前趕出，如同趕出以色列人一般；我必棄掉我從前所選擇的這城─耶路撒冷和我所說立我名的殿。
english: And the Lord said, I will send Judah away from before my face, as I have sent Israel; I will have nothing more to do with this town, which I had made mine, even Jerusalem, and the holy house of which I said, My name will be there.

chinese: 約西亞其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

chinese: 約西亞年間，埃及王法老尼哥上到伯拉河攻擊亞述王；約西亞王去抵擋他。埃及王遇見約西亞在米吉多，就殺了他。
english: In his days, Pharaoh-necoh, king of Egypt, sent his armies against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went out against him; and he put him to death at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

chinese: 他的臣僕用車將他的屍首從米吉多送到耶路撒冷，葬在他自己的墳墓裡。國民膏約西亞的兒子約哈斯接續他父親作王。
english: And his servants took his body in a carriage from Megiddo to Jerusalem, and put him into the earth there. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz, the son of Josiah, and put the holy oil on him and made him king in place of his father.

chinese: 約哈斯登基的時候年二十三歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月。他母親名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, ruling in Jerusalem for three months; his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

chinese: 約哈斯行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his fathers had done.

chinese: 法老尼哥將約哈斯鎖禁在哈馬地的利比拉，不許他在耶路撒冷作王，又罰猶大國銀子一百他連得，金子一他連得。
english: And Pharaoh-necoh put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath, so that he might not be king in Jerusalem; and took from the land a tax of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

chinese: 法老尼哥立約西亞的兒子以利亞敬接續他父親約西亞作王，給他改名叫約雅敬，卻將約哈斯帶到埃及，他就死在那裡。
english: Then Pharaoh-necoh made Eliakim, the son of Josiah, king in place of Josiah his father, changing his name to Jehoiakim; but Jehoahaz he took away to Egypt, where he was till his death.

chinese: 約雅敬將金銀給法老，遵著法老的命向國民徵取金銀，按著各人的力量派定，索要金銀，好給法老尼哥。
english: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and gold to Pharaoh, taxing the land by his orders to get the money; the people of the land had to give silver and gold, everyone as he was taxed, to make the payment to Pharaoh-necoh.

chinese: 約雅敬登基的時候年二十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫西布大，是魯瑪人毗大雅的女兒。
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for eleven years; his mother's name was Zebidah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

chinese: 約雅敬行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord as his fathers had done.

chinese: 約雅敬年間，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒上到猶大；約雅敬服事他三年，然後背叛他。
english: In his days, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came up and Jehoiakim was his servant for three years; then he took up arms against him.

chinese: 耶和華使迦勒底軍、亞蘭軍、摩押軍，和亞捫人的軍來攻擊約雅敬，毀滅猶大，正如耶和華藉他僕人眾先知所說的。
english: And the Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldaeans and of the Edomites and of the Moabites and of the children of Ammon; sending them against Judah for its destruction, as he had said by his servants the prophets.

chinese: 這禍臨到猶大人，誠然是耶和華所命的，要將他們從自己面前趕出，是因瑪拿西所犯的一切罪；
english: Only by the word of the Lord did this fate come on Judah, to take them away from before his face; because of the sins of Manasseh and all the evil he did;

chinese: 又因他流無辜人的血，充滿了耶路撒冷；耶和華決不肯赦免。
english: And because of the death of those who had done no wrong, for he made Jerusalem full of the blood of the upright; and the Lord had no forgiveness for it.

chinese: 約雅敬其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

chinese: 約雅敬與他列祖同睡。他兒子約雅斤接續他作王。
english: So Jehoiakim went to rest with his fathers; and Jehoiachin his son became king in his place.

chinese: 埃及王不再從他國中出來；因為巴比倫王將埃及王所管之地，從埃及小河直到伯拉河都奪去了。
english: And the king of Egypt did not come out of his land again, for the king of Babylon had taken all his country, from the stream of Egypt to the river Euphrates.

chinese: 約雅斤登基的時候年十八歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月。他母親名叫尼護施他，是耶路撒冷人以利拿單的女兒。
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, he was ruling in Jerusalem for three months, and his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

chinese: 約雅斤行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他父親一切所行的。
english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his father had done.

chinese: 那時，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的軍兵上到耶路撒冷，圍困城。
english: At that time the armies of Nebuchadnezzar came up to Jerusalem and the town was shut in on every side.

chinese: 當他軍兵圍困城的時候，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒就親自來了。
english: And Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came there, while his servants were shutting in the town;

chinese: 猶大王約雅斤和他母親、臣僕、首領、太監一同出城，投降巴比倫王；巴比倫王便拿住他。那時是巴比倫王第八年。
english: Then Jehoiachin, king of Judah, went out to the king of Babylon, with his mother and his servants and his chiefs and his unsexed servants; and in the eighth year of his rule the king of Babylon took him.

chinese: 巴比倫王將耶和華殿和王宮裡的寶物都拿去了，將以色列王所羅門所造耶和華殿裡的金器都毀壞了，正如耶和華所說的；
english: And he took away all the stored wealth of the Lord's house, and the goods from the king's store-house, cutting up all the gold vessels which Solomon, king of Israel, had made in the house of the Lord, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 又將耶路撒冷的眾民和眾首領，並所有大能的勇士，共一萬人，連一切木匠、鐵匠都擄了去；除了國中極貧窮的人以外，沒有剩下的；
english: And he took away all the people of Jerusalem and all the chiefs and all the men of war, ten thousand prisoners; and all the expert workmen and the metal-workers; only the poorest sort of the people of the land were not taken away.

chinese: 並將約雅斤和王母、后妃、太監，與國中的大官，都從耶路撒冷擄到巴比倫去了；
english: He took Jehoiachin a prisoner to Babylon, with his mother and his wives and his unsexed servants and the great men of the land; he took them all as prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylon.

chinese: 又將一切勇士七千人和木匠、鐵匠一千人，都是能上陣的勇士，全擄到巴比倫去了。
english: And all the men of war, seven thousand of them, and a thousand expert workmen and metal-workers, all of them strong and able to take up arms, the king of Babylon took away as prisoners into Babylon.

chinese: 巴比倫王立約雅斤的叔叔瑪探雅代替他作王，給瑪探雅改名叫西底家。
english: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, his father's brother, king in place of Jehoiachin, changing his name to Zedekiah.

chinese: 西底家登基的時候年二十一歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he was king in Jerusalem for eleven years; his mother's name was Hamutal, daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

chinese: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。
english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Jehoiakim had done.

chinese: 因此耶和華的怒氣在耶路撒冷和猶大發作，以致將人民從自己面前趕出。
english: And because of the wrath of the Lord, this came about in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had sent them all away from before him: and Zedekiah took up arms against the king of Babylon.

chinese: 西底家背叛巴比倫王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。
english: Now in the ninth year of his rule, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came against Jerusalem with all his army and took up his position before it, building earthworks all round the town.

chinese: 於是城被圍困，直到西底家王十一年。
english: And the town was shut in by their forces till the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

chinese: 四月初九日，城裡有大饑荒，甚至百姓都沒有糧食。
english: Now on the ninth day of the fourth month, the store of food in the town was almost gone, so that there was no food for the people of the land.

chinese: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜間從靠近王園兩城中間的門逃跑。迦勒底人正在四圍攻城，王就向亞拉巴逃走。
english: So an opening was made in the wall of the town, and all the men of war went in flight by night through the doorway between the two walls which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldaeans were stationed round the town:) and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

chinese: 迦勒底的軍隊追趕王，在耶利哥的平原追上他；他的全軍都離開他四散了。
english: But the Chaldaean army went after the king, and overtook him in the lowlands of Jericho, and all his army went in flight from him in every direction.

chinese: 迦勒底人就拿住王，帶他到在利比拉的巴比倫王那裡審判他。
english: And they made the king a prisoner and took him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah to be judged.

chinese: 在西底家眼前殺了他的眾子，並且剜了西底家的眼睛，用銅鍊鎖著他，帶到巴比倫去。
english: And they put the sons of Zedekiah to death before his eyes, and then they put out his eyes, and chaining him with iron bands, took him to Babylon.

chinese: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比倫王的臣僕、護衛長尼布撒拉旦來到耶路撒冷，
english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem;

chinese: 用火焚燒耶和華的殿和王宮，又焚燒耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大戶家的房屋。
english: And he had the house of the Lord and the king's house and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burned with fire;

chinese: 跟從護衛長迦勒底的全軍就拆毀耶路撒冷四圍的城牆。
english: And the walls round Jerusalem were broken down by the Chaldaean army which was with the captain.

chinese: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦將城裡所剩下的百姓，並已經投降巴比倫王的人，以及大眾所剩下的人，都擄去了。
english: And the rest of the people who were still in the town, and all those who had given themselves up to the king of Babylon, and all the rest of the workmen, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took away as prisoners;

chinese: 但護衛長留下些民中最窮的，使他們修理葡萄園，耕種田地。
english: But he let the poorest of the land go on living there, to take care of the vines and the fields.

chinese: 耶和華殿的銅柱，並耶和華殿的盆座和銅海，迦勒底人都打碎了，將那銅運到巴比倫去了，
english: And the brass pillars in the house of the Lord, and the wheeled bases, and the great brass water-vessel in the house of the Lord, were broken up by the Chaldaeans, who took the brass to Babylon.

chinese: 又帶去鍋、鏟子、蠟剪、調羹，並所用的一切銅器，
english: And the pots and the spades and the scissors for the lights and the spoons, and all the brass vessels used in the Lord's house, they took away.

chinese: 火鼎、碗，無論金的銀的，護衛長也都帶去了。
english: And the fire-trays and the basins; the gold of the gold vessels and the silver of the silver vessels, were all taken away by the captain of the armed men.

chinese: 所羅門為耶和華殿所造的兩根銅柱、一個銅海，和幾個盆座，這一切的銅，多得無法可稱。
english: The two pillars, the great water-vessel and the wheeled bases, which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

chinese: 這一根柱子高十八肘，柱上有銅頂，高三肘；銅頂的周圍有網子和石榴，都是銅的。那一根柱子，照此一樣，也有網子。
english: One of the pillars was eighteen cubits high, with a crown of brass on it; the crown was three cubits high, circled with a network and apples all of brass; and the second pillar had the same.

chinese: 護衛長拿住大祭司西萊雅、副祭司西番亞，和三個把門的，
english: And the captain of the armed men took Seraiah, the chief priest, and Zephaniah, the second priest, and the three door-keepers;

chinese: 又從城中拿住一個管理兵丁的官(或作太監)，並在城裡所遇常見王面的五個人和檢點國民軍長的書記，以及城裡遇見的國民六十個人。
english: And from the town he took the unsexed servant who was over the men of war, and five of the king's near friends who were in the town, and the scribe of the captain of the army, who was responsible for getting the people of the land together in military order, and sixty men of the people of the land who were in the town.

chinese: 護衛長尼布撒拉旦將這些人帶到在利比拉的巴比倫王那裡。
english: These Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took with him to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

chinese: 巴比倫王就把他們擊殺在哈馬地的利比拉。這樣，猶大人被擄去離開本地。
english: And the king of Babylon put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was taken away prisoner from his land.

chinese: 至於猶大國剩下的民，就是巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒所剩下的，巴比倫王立了沙番的孫子、亞希甘的兒子基大利作他們的省長。
english: As for the people who were still living in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, did not take away, he made Gedaliah, the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler over them.

chinese: 眾軍長和屬他們的人聽見巴比倫王立了基大利作省長，於是軍長尼探雅的兒子以實瑪利、加利亞的兒子約哈難、尼陀法人單戶蔑的兒子西萊雅、瑪迦人的兒子雅撒尼亞，和屬他們的人都到米斯巴見基大利。
english: Now the captains of the armed forces, hearing that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah ruler, came with their men to Gedaliah at Mizpah; Ishmael, the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan, the son of Kareah, and Seraiah, the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah, the son of the Maacathite, came with all their men.

chinese: 基大利向他們和屬他們的人起誓說：你們不必懼怕迦勒底臣僕，只管住在這地服事巴比倫王，就可以得福。
english: Then Gedaliah gave his oath to them and their men, saying, Have no fear because of the servants of the Chaldaeans; go on living in the land under the rule of the king of Babylon, and all will be well.

chinese: 七月間，宗室以利沙瑪的孫子、尼探雅的兒子以實瑪利帶著十個人來，殺了基大利和同他在米斯巴的猶大人與迦勒底人。
english: But in the seventh month, Ishmael, the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the king's seed, came with ten men and made an attack on Gedaliah, causing his death and the death of the Jews and the Chaldaeans who were with him at Mizpah.

chinese: 於是眾民，無論大小，連眾軍長；因為懼怕迦勒底人，都起身往埃及去了。
english: Then all the people, small and great, and the captains of the forces, got up and went away to Egypt, for fear of the Chaldaeans.

chinese: 猶大王約雅斤被擄後三十七年，巴比倫王以未米羅達元年十二月二十七日，使猶大王約雅斤抬頭，提他出監；
english: And in the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiachin, king of Judah, had been taken prisoner, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evil-merodach, king of Babylon, in the first year of his rule, took Jehoiachin, king of Judah, out of prison;

chinese: 又對他說恩言，使他的位高過與他一同在巴比倫眾王的位，
english: And said kind words to him, and put his seat higher than the seats of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

chinese: 給他脫了囚服。他終身常在巴比倫王面前吃飯。
english: And his prison clothing was changed, and he was a guest at the king's table every day for the rest of his life.

chinese: 王賜他所需用的食物，日日賜他一分，終身都是這樣。
english: And for his food, the king gave him a regular amount every day for the rest of his life.

chinese: 亞當生塞特；塞特生以挪士；
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh;

chinese: 以挪士生該南；該南生瑪勒列；瑪勒列生雅列；
english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

chinese: 雅列生以諾；以諾生瑪土撒拉；瑪土撒拉生拉麥；
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;

chinese: 拉麥生挪亞；挪亞生閃、含、雅弗。
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

chinese: 雅弗的兒子是歌篾、瑪各、瑪代、雅完、土巴、米設、提拉。
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

chinese: 歌篾的兒子是亞實基拿、低法(創十章三節作利法)、陀迦瑪。
english: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Diphath and Togarmah.

chinese: 雅完的兒子是以利沙、他施、基提、多單(有作羅單的)。
english: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim and Rodanim.

chinese: 含的兒子是古實、麥西、弗、迦南。
english: The sons of Ham: Cush and Egypt, Put and Canaan.

chinese: 古實的兒子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉瑪、撒弗提迦。拉瑪的兒子是示巴、底但。
english: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabta and Raama and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

chinese: 古實生寧錄；他為世上英雄之首。
english: And Cush was the father of Nimrod: he was the first to be a great man in the earth.

chinese: 麥西生路低人、亞拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
english: And Egypt was the father of the Ludim and the Anamim and the Lehabim and the Naphtuhim

chinese: 帕斯魯細人、迦斯路希人、迦斐託人；從迦斐託出來的有非利士人。
english: And the Pathrusim and the Casluhim and the Caphtorim (from whom came the Philistines).

chinese: 迦南生長子西頓，又生赫
english: And Canaan was the father of Zidon, his oldest son, and Heth,

chinese: 和耶布斯人、亞摩利人、革迦撒人、
english: And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,

chinese: 希未人、亞基人、西尼人、
english: And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,

chinese: 亞瓦底人、洗瑪利人，並哈馬人。
english: And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite.

chinese: 閃的兒子是以攔、亞述、亞法撒、路德、亞蘭、烏斯、戶勒、基帖、米設(創十23作瑪施)。
english: The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram and Uz and Hul and Gether and Meshech.

chinese: 亞法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
english: And Arpachshad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.

chinese: 希伯生了兩個兒子：一個名叫法勒(就是分的意思)，因為那時人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫約坍。
english: And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days a division was made of the earth; and his brother's name was Joktan.

chinese: 約坍生亞摩答、沙列、哈薩瑪非、耶拉、
english: And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah

chinese: 哈多蘭、烏薩、德拉、
english: And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah

chinese: 以巴錄、亞比瑪利、示巴、
english: And Ebal and Abimael and Sheba

chinese: 阿斐、哈腓拉、約巴。這都是約坍的兒子。
english: And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

chinese: 閃生亞法撒；亞法撒生沙拉；
english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

chinese: 沙拉生希伯；希伯生法勒；法勒生拉吳；
english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

chinese: 拉吳生西鹿；西鹿生拿鶴；拿鶴生他拉；
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

chinese: 他拉生亞伯蘭，亞伯蘭就是亞伯拉罕。
english: Abram (that is Abraham).

chinese: 亞伯拉罕的兒子是以撒、以實瑪利。
english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

chinese: 以實瑪利的兒子記在下面：以實瑪利的長子是尼拜約，其次是基達、押德別、米比衫、
english: These are their generations: the oldest son of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam,

chinese: 米施瑪、度瑪、瑪撒、哈達、提瑪、
english: Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad and Tema,

chinese: 伊突、拿非施、基底瑪。這都是以實瑪利的兒子。
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的兒子，就是心蘭、約珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、書亞。約珊的兒子是示巴、底但。
english: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's servant-wife: she was the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

chinese: 米甸的兒子是以法、以弗、哈諾、亞比大、以勒大。這都是基土拉的子孫。
english: And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒的兒子是以掃和以色列。
english: And Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

chinese: 以掃的兒子是以利法、流珥、耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel and Jeush and Jalam and Korah.

chinese: 以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯、亭納、亞瑪力。
english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zephi and Gatam, Kenaz and Timna and Amalek.

chinese: 流珥的兒子是拿哈、謝拉、沙瑪、米撒。
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.

chinese: 西珥的兒子是羅坍、朔巴、祭便、亞拿、底順、以察、底珊。
english: And the sons of Seir: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan.

chinese: 羅坍的兒子是何利、荷幔；羅坍的妹子是亭納。
english: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan's sister.

chinese: 朔巴的兒子是亞勒文、瑪拿轄、以巴錄、示非、阿南。祭便的兒子是亞雅、亞拿。
english: The sons of Shobal: Alian and Manahath and Ebal, Shephi and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

chinese: 亞拿的兒子是底順。底順的兒子是哈默蘭、伊是班、益蘭、基蘭。
english: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.

chinese: 以察的兒子是辟罕、撒番、亞干。底珊的兒子是烏斯、亞蘭。
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

chinese: 以色列人未有君王治理之先，在以東地作王的記在下面：有比珥的兒子比拉，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
english: Now these are the kings who were ruling in the land of Edom, before there was any king over Israel: Bela, the son of Beor; his town was named Dinhabah.

chinese: 比拉死了，波斯拉人謝拉的兒子約巴接續他作王。
english: At his death, Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.

chinese: 約巴死了，提幔地的人戶珊接續他作王。
english: At the death of Jobab, Husham, from the land of the Temanites, became king in his place.

chinese: 戶珊死了，比達的兒子哈達接續他作王。這哈達就是在摩押地殺敗米甸人的，他的京城名叫亞未得。
english: And at the death of Husham, Hadad, the son of Bedad, who overcame Midian in the field of Moab, became king; his town was named Avith.

chinese: 哈達死了，瑪士利加人桑拉接續他作王。
english: And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.

chinese: 桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接續他作王。
english: And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river became king in his place,

chinese: 掃羅死了，亞革波的兒子巴勒哈南接續他作王。
english: And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, became king in his place.

chinese: 巴勒哈南死了，哈達接續他作王。他的京城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希他別，是米薩合的孫女，瑪特列的女兒。
english: And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadad became king in his place; his town was named Pai, and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

chinese: 哈達死了，以東人的族長有亭納族長、亞勒瓦族長、耶帖族長、
english: And Hadad came to his end. Now the chiefs of Edom were: the chief of Timna, the chief of Aliah, the chief of Jetheth,

chinese: 亞何利巴瑪族長、以拉族長、比嫩族長、
english: The chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon,

chinese: 基納斯族長、提幔族長、米比薩族長、
english: The chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar,

chinese: 瑪基疊族長、以蘭族長。這都是以東人的族長。
english: The chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

chinese: 以色列的兒子是流便、西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、西布倫、
english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun;

chinese: 但、約瑟、便雅憫、拿弗他利、迦得、亞設。
english: Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

chinese: 猶大的兒子是珥、俄南、示拉，這三人是迦南人書亞女兒所生的。猶大的長子珥在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華就使他死了。
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah; these three were his sons by Bathshua, the Canaanite woman. And Er, Judah's oldest son, did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and he put him to death.

chinese: 猶大的兒婦他瑪給猶大生法勒斯和謝拉。猶大共有五個兒子。
english: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, had Perez and Zerah by him. All the sons of Judah were five.

chinese: 法勒斯的兒子是希斯崙、哈母勒。
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

chinese: 謝拉的兒子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各、大拉(即達大)，共五人。
english: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri and Ethan and Heman and Calcol and Dara; five of them.

chinese: 迦米的兒子是亞干，這亞干在當滅的物上犯了罪，連累了以色列人。
english: And the sons of Carmi: Achan, the troubler of Israel, who did wrong about the cursed thing.

chinese: 以探的兒子是亞撒利雅.。
english: And the son of Ethan: Azariah.

chinese: 希斯崙所生的兒子是耶拉篾、蘭、基路拜。
english: And the sons of Hezron, the offspring of his body: Jerahmeel and Ram and Chelubai.

chinese: 蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順。拿順作猶大人的首領。
english: And Ram was the father of Amminadab; and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, chief of the children of Judah;

chinese: 拿順生撒門；撒門生波阿斯；
english: And Nahshon was the father of Salma, and Salma was the father of Boaz,

chinese: 波阿斯生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；
english: And Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse,

chinese: 耶西生長子以利押，次子亞比拿達，三子示米亞(即沙瑪，見撒上十六章九節)，
english: And Jesse was the father of Eliab, his oldest son, and Abinadab, the second, and Shimea, the third,

chinese: 四子拿坦業，五子拉代，
english: Nethanel, the fourth, Raddai, the fifth,

chinese: 六子阿鮮，七子大衛。
english: Ozem, the sixth, David, the seventh;

chinese: 他們的姊妹是洗魯雅和亞比該。洗魯雅的兒子是亞比篩、約押、亞撒黑，共三人。
english: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And Zeruiah had three sons: Abishai and Joab and Asahel.

chinese: 亞比該生亞瑪撒；亞瑪撒的父親是以實瑪利人益帖。
english: And Abigail was the mother of Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

chinese: 希斯崙的兒子迦勒娶阿蘇巴和耶略為妻，阿蘇巴的兒子是耶設、朔罷、押墩。
english: And Caleb, the son of Hezron, had children by Azubah his wife, the daughter of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher and Shobab and Ardon.

chinese: 阿蘇巴死了，迦勒又娶以法他，生了戶珥。
english: And after the death of Azubah, Caleb took as his wife Ephrath, who was the mother of Hur.

chinese: 戶珥生烏利；烏利生比撒列。
english: And Hur was the father of Uri; and Uri was the father of Bezalel.

chinese: 希斯崙正六十歲娶了基列父親瑪吉的女兒，與他同房；瑪吉的女兒生了西割；
english: And after that, Hezron had connection with the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, whom he took as his wife when he was sixty years old; and she had Segub by him.

chinese: 西割生睚珥。睚珥在基列地有二十三個城邑。
english: And Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.

chinese: 後來基述人和亞蘭人奪了睚珥的城邑，並基納和其鄉村，共六十個。這都是基列父親瑪吉之子的。
english: And Geshur and Aram took the tent-towns of Jair from them, with Kenath and the small places round it, even sixty towns. All these were the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.

chinese: 希斯崙在迦勒以法他死後，他的妻亞比雅給他生了亞施戶；亞施戶是提哥亞的父親。
english: And after the death of Hezron, Caleb had connection with Ephrath, his father Hezron's wife, and she gave birth to his son Asshur, the father of Tekoa.

chinese: 希斯崙的長子耶拉篾生長子蘭，又生布拿、阿連、阿鮮、亞希雅。
english: And the sons of Jerahmeel, the oldest son of Hezron, were Ram, the oldest, and Bunah and Oren and Ozem and Ahijah.

chinese: 耶拉篾又娶一妻名叫亞他拉，是阿南的母親。
english: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah: she was the mother of Onam.

chinese: 耶拉篾長子蘭的兒子是瑪斯、雅憫、以結。
english: And the sons of Ram, the oldest son of Jerahmeel, were Maaz and Jamin and Eker.

chinese: 阿南的兒子是沙買、雅大。沙買的兒子是拿答、亞比述。
english: And the sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada; and the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

chinese: 亞比述的妻名叫亞比孩，亞比孩給他生了亞辦和摩利。
english: And the name of Abishur's wife was Abihail; and she had Ahban and Molid by him.

chinese: 拿答的兒子是西列、亞遍；西列死了沒有兒子。
english: And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled came to his end without sons.

chinese: 亞遍的兒子是以示；以示的兒子是示珊；示珊的兒子是亞來。
english: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.

chinese: 沙買兄弟雅大的兒子是益帖、約拿單；益帖死了沒有兒子。
english: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether came to his end without sons.

chinese: 約拿單的兒子是比勒、撒薩。這都是耶拉篾的子孫。
english: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

chinese: 示珊沒有兒子，只有女兒。示珊有一個僕人名叫耶哈，是埃及人。
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, whose name was Jarha.

chinese: 示珊將女兒給了僕人耶哈為妻，給他生了亞太。
english: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha, his servant, as a wife; and she had Attai by him.

chinese: 亞太生拿單；拿單生撒拔；
english: And Attai was the father of Nathan, and Nathan was the father of Zabad,

chinese: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄備得；
english: And Zabad was the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal was the father of Obed,

chinese: 俄備得生耶戶；耶戶生亞撒利雅；
english: And Obed was the father of Jehu, and Jehu was the father of Azariah,

chinese: 亞撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亞薩；
english: And Azariah was the father of Helez, and Helez was the father of Eleasah,

chinese: 以利亞薩生西斯買；西斯買生沙龍；
english: And Eleasah was the father of Sismai, and Sismai was the father of Shallum,

chinese: 沙龍生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙瑪。
english: And Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.

chinese: 耶拉篾兄弟迦勒的長子米沙，是西弗之祖瑪利沙的兒子，是希伯崙之祖。
english: And the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, were Mareshah, his oldest son, who was the father of Ziph and Hebron.

chinese: 希伯崙的兒子是可拉、他普亞、利肯、示瑪。
english: And the sons of Hebron: Korah and Tappuah and Rekem and Shema.

chinese: 示瑪生拉含，是約干之祖。利肯生沙買。
english: And Shema was the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.

chinese: 沙買的兒子是瑪雲；瑪雲是伯夙之祖。
english: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

chinese: 迦勒的妾以法生哈蘭、摩撒、迦謝；哈蘭生迦卸。
english: And Ephah, Caleb's servant-wife, had Haran and Moza and Gazez; and Haran was the father of Gazez.

chinese: 〈雅代的兒子是利健、約坦、基珊、毗力、以法、沙亞弗。〉
english: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph.

chinese: 迦勒的妾瑪迦生示別、特哈拿，
english: Maacah, Caleb's servant-wife, was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah,

chinese: 又生麥瑪拿之祖沙亞弗、抹比拿和基比亞之祖示法。迦勒的女兒是押撒。
english: And Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, Sheva, the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and Caleb's daughter was Achsah. These were the sons of Caleb.

chinese: 迦勒的子孫就是以法他的長子、戶珥的兒子，記在下面：基列耶琳之祖朔巴，
english: The sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah; Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim,

chinese: 伯利恆之祖薩瑪，伯迦得之祖哈勒。
english: Salma, the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph, the father of Beth-gader.

chinese: 基列耶琳之祖朔巴的子孫是哈羅以和一半米努哈人(即瑪拿哈人)。
english: And Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites.

chinese: 基列耶琳的諸族是以帖人、布特人、舒瑪人、密來人，又從這些族中生出瑣拉人和以實陶人來。
english: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites and the Puthites and the Shumathites and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

chinese: 薩瑪的子孫是伯利恆人、尼陀法人、亞他綠伯約押人、一半瑪拿哈人、瑣利人，
english: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-Joab and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

chinese: 和住雅比斯眾文士家的特拉人、示米押人、蘇甲人。這都是基尼人利甲家之祖哈末所生的。
english: And the families of scribes who were living at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites, the offspring of Hammath, the father of the family of Rechab.

chinese: 大衛在希伯崙所生的兒子記在下面：長子暗嫩是耶斯列人亞希暖生的。次子但以利是迦密人亞比該生的。
english: Now these were David's sons, whose birth took place in Hebron: the oldest Amnon, by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite woman;

chinese: 三子押沙龍是基述王達買的女兒瑪迦生的。四子亞多尼雅是哈及生的。
english: The third Absalom, the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, the son of Haggith;

chinese: 五子示法提雅是亞比他生的。六子以特念是大衛的妻以格拉生的。
english: The fifth Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth Ithream, by Eglah his wife.

chinese: 這六人都是大衛在希伯崙生的。大衛在希伯崙作王七年零六個月，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
english: He had six sons in Hebron; he was ruling there for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.

chinese: 大衛在耶路撒冷所生的兒子是示米亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門。這四人是亞米利的女兒拔書亞生的。
english: And in Jerusalem he had four sons, Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon, by Bath-shua, the daughter of Ammiel;

chinese: 還有益轄、以利沙瑪、以利法列、
english: And Ibhar and Elishama and Eliphelet

chinese: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亞、
english: And Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia

chinese: 以利沙瑪、以利雅大、以利法列，共九人。
english: And Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet, nine.

chinese: 這都是大衛的兒子，還有他們的妹子他瑪，妃嬪的兒子不在其內。
english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of his servant-wives; and Tamar was their sister.

chinese: 所羅門的兒子是羅波安；羅波安的兒子是亞比雅；亞比雅的兒子是亞撒；亞撒的兒子是約沙法；
english: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

chinese: 約沙法的兒子是約蘭；約蘭的兒子是亞哈謝；亞哈謝的兒子是約阿施；
english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

chinese: 約阿施的兒子是亞瑪謝；亞瑪謝的兒子是亞撒利雅；亞撒利雅的兒子是約坦；
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

chinese: 約坦的兒子是亞哈斯；亞哈斯的兒子是希西家；希西家的兒子是瑪拿西；
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

chinese: 瑪拿西的兒子是亞們；亞們的兒子是約西亞；
english: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

chinese: 約西亞的長子是約哈難，次子是約雅敬，三子是西底家，四子是沙龍。
english: And the sons of Josiah: the oldest Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

chinese: 約雅敬的兒子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。
english: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

chinese: 耶哥尼雅被擄。他的兒子是撒拉鐵、
english: And the sons of Jeconiah, who was taken prisoner: Shealtiel his son,

chinese: 瑪基蘭、毗大雅、示拿薩、耶加米、何沙瑪、尼大比雅。
english: And Malchiram and Pedaiah and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.

chinese: 毗大雅的兒子是所羅巴伯、示每。所羅巴伯的兒子是米書蘭、哈拿尼雅，他們的妹子名叫示羅密。
english: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

chinese: 米書蘭的兒子是哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙希悉，共五人。
english: And Hashubah and Ohel and Berechiah and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

chinese: 哈拿尼雅的兒子是毗拉提、耶篩亞。還有利法雅的眾子，亞珥難的眾子，俄巴底亞的眾子，示迦尼的眾子。
english: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

chinese: 示迦尼的兒子是示瑪雅；示瑪雅的兒子是哈突、以甲、巴利亞、尼利雅、沙法，共六人。
english: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush and Igal and Bariah and Neariah and Shaphat, six.

chinese: 尼利雅的兒子是以利約乃、希西家、亞斯利干，共三人。
english: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai and Hizkiah and Azrikam, three.

chinese: 以利約乃的兒子是何大雅、以利亞實、毗萊雅、阿谷、約哈難、第萊雅、阿拿尼，共七人。
english: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah and Eliashib and Pelaiah and Akkub and Johanan and Delaiah and Anani, seven.

chinese: 猶大的兒子是法勒斯、希斯崙、迦米、戶珥、朔巴。
english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron and Carmi and Hur and Shobal.

chinese: 朔巴的兒子利亞雅生雅哈；雅哈生亞戶買和拉哈。這是瑣拉人的諸族。
english: And Reaiah, the son of Shobal, was the father of Jahath; and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

chinese: 以坦之祖的兒子是耶斯列、伊施瑪、伊得巴；他們的妹子名叫哈悉勒玻尼。
english: And these were the sons of Hur, the father of Etam: Jezreel and Ishma and Idbash, and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;

chinese: 基多之祖是毗努伊勒。戶沙之祖是以謝珥。這都是伯利恆之祖以法他的長子戶珥所生的。
english: And Penuel, the father of Gedor, and Ezer, the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.

chinese: 提哥亞之祖亞施戶有兩個妻子：一名希拉，一名拿拉。
english: And Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

chinese: 拿拉給亞施戶生亞戶撒、希弗、提米尼、哈轄斯他利。這都是拿拉的兒子。
english: And Naarah had Ahuzzam by him, and Hepher and Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

chinese: 希拉的兒子是洗列、瑣轄、伊提南。
english: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar and Ethnan.

chinese: 哥斯生亞諾、瑣比巴，並哈崙兒子亞哈黑的諸族。
english: And Koz was the father of Anub and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

chinese: 雅比斯比他眾弟兄更尊貴，他母親給他起名叫雅比斯，意思說：我生他甚是痛苦。
english: And Jabez was honoured more than his brothers; but his mother had given him the name Jabez, saying, Because I gave birth to him with sorrow.

chinese: 雅比斯求告以色列的神說：甚願你賜福與我，擴張我的境界，常與我同在，保佑我不遭患難，不受艱苦。　神就應允他所求的。
english: And Jabez made a prayer to the God of Israel, saying, If only you would truly give me a blessing, and make wider the limits of my land, and let your hand be with me, and keep me from evil, so that I may not be troubled by it! And God gave him his desire.

chinese: 書哈的弟兄基綠生米黑，米黑是伊施屯之祖。
english: And Chelub, the brother of Shuhah, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

chinese: 伊施屯生伯拉巴、巴西亞，並珥拿轄之祖提欣拿，這都是利迦人。
english: And Eshton was the father of Bethrapha and Paseah and Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.

chinese: 基納斯的兒子是俄陀聶、西萊雅。俄陀聶的兒子是哈塔。
english: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.

chinese: 憫挪太生俄弗拉；西萊雅生革夏納欣人之祖約押。他們都是匠人。
english: And Meonothai was the father of Ophrah; and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge-harashim; they were expert workmen.

chinese: 耶孚尼的兒子是迦勒；迦勒的兒子是以路、以拉、拿安。以拉的兒子是基納斯。
english: And the sons of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the son of Elah: Kenaz.

chinese: 耶哈利勒的兒子是西弗、西法、提利、亞撒列。
english: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.

chinese: 以斯拉的兒子是益帖、米列、以弗、雅倫。米列娶法老女兒比提雅為妻，生米利暗、沙買，和以實提摩之祖益巴。米列又娶猶大女子為妻，生基多之祖雅列，梭哥之祖希伯，和撒挪亞之祖耶古鐵。
english: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether and Mered and Epher and Jalon; and these are the sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, the wife of Mered. And she became the mother of Miriam and Shammai and Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa.
And his wife, a woman of the tribe of Judah, became the mother of Jered, the father of Gedor, and Heber, the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel, the father of Zanoah.

chinese: 荷第雅的妻是拿含的妹子，他所生的兒子是迦米人基伊拉和瑪迦人以實提摩之祖。
english: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

chinese: 示門的兒子是暗嫩、林拿、便哈南、提倫。以示的兒子是梭黑與便梭黑。
english: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon and Rinnah, Ben-hanan and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth; and the son of Zoheth. ...

chinese: 猶大的兒子是示拉；示拉的兒子是利迦之祖珥，瑪利沙之祖拉大，和屬亞實比族織細麻布的各家。
english: The sons of Shelah, the son of Judah: Er, the father of Lecah, and Laadah, the father of Mareshah, and the families of those who made delicate linen, of the family of Ashbea;

chinese: 還有約敬、哥西巴人、約阿施、薩拉，就是在摩押地掌權的，又有雅叔比利恆。這都是古時所記載的。
english: And Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who were rulers in Moab, and went back to Beth-lehem. And the records are very old.

chinese: 這些人都是窯匠，是尼他應和基低拉的居民；與王同處，為王做工。
english: These were the potters, and the people living among planted fields with walls round them; they were there to do the king's work.

chinese: 西緬的兒子是尼母利、雅憫、雅立、謝拉、掃羅。
english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

chinese: 掃羅的兒子是沙龍；沙龍的兒子是米比衫；米比衫的兒子是米施瑪；
english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

chinese: 米施瑪的兒子是哈母利；哈母利的兒子是撒刻；撒刻的兒子是示每。
english: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

chinese: 示每有十六個兒子，六個女兒，他弟兄的兒女不多，他們各家不如猶大族的人丁增多。
english: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers had only a small number of children, and their family was not as fertile as the children of Judah.

chinese: 西緬人住在別是巴、摩拉大、哈薩書亞、
english: And they were living at Beer-sheba and Moladah and Hazar-shual,

chinese: 辟拉、以森、陀臘、
english: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

chinese: 彼土利、何珥瑪、洗革拉、
english: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

chinese: 伯瑪嘉博、哈薩蘇撒、伯比利、沙拉音，這些城邑直到大衛作王的時候都是屬西緬人的。
english: And at Beth-marcaboth, and at Hazarsusim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their towns till David became king.

chinese: 他們的五個城邑是以坦、亞因、臨門、陀健、亞珊；
english: And their small towns were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen and Ashan, five towns;

chinese: 還有屬城的鄉村，直到巴力。這是他們的住處，他們都有家譜。
english: And all the small places round these towns, as far as Baalath-beer, the high place of the South. These were their living-places, and they have lists of their generations.

chinese: 還有米所巴、雅米勒、亞瑪謝的兒子約沙、
english: And Meshobab and Jamlech and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,

chinese: 約珥、約示比的兒子耶戶；約示比是西萊雅的兒子；西萊雅是亞薛的兒子。
english: And Joel and Jehu, the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

chinese: 還有以利約乃、雅哥巴、約朔海、亞帥雅、亞底業、耶西篾、比拿雅、
english: And Elioenai and Jaakobah and Jeshohaiah and Asaiah and Adiel and Jesimiel and Benaiah,

chinese: 示非的兒子細撒。示非是亞龍的兒子；亞龍是耶大雅的兒子；耶大雅是申利的兒子；申利是示瑪雅的兒子。
english: And Ziza, the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

chinese: 以上所記的人名都是作族長的，他們宗族的人數增多。
english: These, whose names are given, were chiefs in their families, and their families became very great in number.

chinese: 他們往平原東邊基多口去，尋找牧放羊群的草場，
english: And they went to the opening into Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, in search of grass-land for their flocks.

chinese: 尋得肥美的草場地，又寬闊又平靜。從前住那裡的是含族的人。
english: And they came to some good fertile grass-land, in a wide quiet country of peace-loving people; for the people who were living there before were of the offspring of Ham.

chinese: 以上錄名的人，在猶大王希西家年間，來攻擊含族人的帳棚和那裡所有的米烏尼人，將他們滅盡，就住在他們的地方，直到今日，因為那裡有草場可以牧放羊群。
english: And these whose names are given came in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and made an attack on the Meunim who were living there, and put an end to them to this day, and took their place, because there was grass there for their flocks.

chinese: 這西緬人中，有五百人上西珥山，率領他們的是以示的兒子毗拉提、尼利雅、利法雅，和烏薛，
english: And some of them, five hundred of the sons of Simeon, went to the hill-country of Seir, with Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, at their head.

chinese: 殺了逃脫剩下的亞瑪力人，就住在那裡直到今日。
english: And they put to death the rest of the Amalekites who had got away safely, and made it their living-place to this day.

chinese: 以色列的長子原是流便；因他污穢了父親的床，他長子的名分就歸了約瑟。只是按家譜他不算長子。
english: And the sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, (for he was the oldest son, but, because he made his father's bride-bed unclean, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel; but he is not to be given the place of the oldest.

chinese: 猶大勝過一切弟兄，君王也是從他而出；長子的名分卻歸約瑟。
english: Though Judah became stronger than his brothers, and from him came the ruler, the birthright was Joseph's:)

chinese: 以色列長子流便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯倫、迦米。
english: The sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.

chinese: 約珥的兒子是示瑪雅；示瑪雅的兒子是歌革；歌革的兒子是示每；
english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

chinese: 示每的兒子是米迦；米迦的兒子是利亞雅；利亞雅的兒子是巴力；
english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

chinese: 巴力的兒子是備拉。這備拉作流便支派的首領，被亞述王提革拉毗尼色擄去。
english: Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, took away as a prisoner: he was chief of the Reubenites.

chinese: 他的弟兄照著宗族，按著家譜作族長的是耶利、撒迦利雅、比拉。
english: And his brothers by their families, when the list of their generations was made up: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

chinese: 比拉是亞撒的兒子；亞撒是示瑪的兒子；示瑪是約珥的兒子；約珥所住的地方是從亞羅珥直到尼波和巴力免，
english: And Bela, the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who was living in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon;

chinese: 又向東延到伯拉河這邊的曠野，因為他們在基列地牲畜增多。
english: And to the east his limits went as far as the starting point of the waste land, ending at the river Euphrates, because their cattle were increased in number in the land of Gilead.

chinese: 掃羅年間，他們與夏甲人爭戰，夏甲人倒在他們手下，他們就在基列東邊的全地，住在夏甲人的帳棚裡。
english: And in the days of Saul they made war on the Hagarites, and overcame them; and they put up their tents through all the land east of Gilead.

chinese: 迦得的子孫在流便對面，住在巴珊地，延到撒迦。
english: And the sons of Gad were living opposite to them, in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah:

chinese: 他們中間有作族長的約珥，有作副族長的沙番，還有雅乃和住在巴珊的沙法。
english: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan;

chinese: 他們族弟兄是米迦勒、米書蘭、示巴、約賴、雅干、細亞、希伯，共七人。
english: And their brothers, the men of their family: Michael and Meshullam and Sheba and Jorai and Jacan and Zia and Eber, seven of them.

chinese: 這都是亞比孩的兒子。亞比孩是戶利的兒子；戶利是耶羅亞的兒子；耶羅亞是基列的兒子；基列是米迦勒的兒子；米迦勒是耶示篩的兒子；耶示篩是耶哈多的兒子；耶哈多是布斯的兒子。
english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

chinese: 還有古尼的孫子、押比疊的兒子亞希。這都是作族長的。
english: Ahi, the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, head of their families.

chinese: 他們住在基列與巴珊和巴珊的鄉村，並沙崙的郊野，直到四圍的交界。
english: And they were living in Gilead in Bashan, in its small towns and in all the grass-land of Sirion as far as its limits.

chinese: 這些人在猶大王約坦並在以色列王耶羅波安年間，都載入家譜。
english: All these were listed under the names of their families, in the time of Jotham, king of Judah, and in the time of Jeroboam, king of Israel.

chinese: 流便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人，能拿盾牌和刀劍、拉弓射箭、出征善戰的勇士共有四萬四千七百六十名。
english: There were forty-four thousand, seven hundred and sixty of the sons of Reuben and of the Gadites and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, all strong men, expert in the use of the body-cover, the sword, and the bow, and in the art of war, all able to take up arms.

chinese: 他們與夏甲人、伊突人、拿非施人、挪答人爭戰。
english: And they went to war against the Hagarites, with Jetur and Naphish and Nodab.

chinese: 他們得了神的幫助，夏甲人和跟隨夏甲的人都交在他們手中；因為他們在陣上呼求神，倚賴神，神就應允他們。
english: And they were helped against them, so that the Hagarites, and those with them, were given into their power. For they sent up prayers to God in the fight, and he gave ear to them, because they put their faith in him.

chinese: 他們擄掠了夏甲人的牲畜，有駱駝五萬，羊二十五萬，驢二千；又有人十萬。
english: And they took away their cattle: fifty thousand camels, two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, and two thousand asses, and a hundred thousand men.

chinese: 敵人被殺仆倒的甚多，因為這爭戰是出乎神。他們就住在敵人的地上，直到被擄的時候。
english: And a very great number went to their death, because the war was God's purpose. And they went on living in their place till they were taken away as prisoners.

chinese: 瑪拿西半支派的人住在那地。從巴珊延到巴力黑們、示尼珥與黑門山。
english: And the men of the half-tribe of Manasseh were living in the land: and their numbers were increased till all the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir and the mountain Hermon was theirs.

chinese: 他們的族長是以弗、以示、以列、亞斯列、耶利米、何達威雅、雅疊，都是大能的勇士，是有名的人，也是作族長的。
english: And these were the heads of their families: Epher and Ishi and Eliel and Azriel and Jeremiah and Hodaviah and Jahdiel, men of war, of great name, heads of families.

chinese: 他們得罪了他們列祖的神，隨從那地之民的　神行邪淫；這民就是　神在他們面前所除滅的。
english: And they did evil against the God of their fathers, worshipping the gods of the people of the land, whom God had put to destruction before them.

chinese: 故此，以色列的神激動亞述王普勒和亞述王提革拉毗尼色的心，他們就把流便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人擄到哈臘、哈博、哈拉與歌散河邊，直到今日還在那裡。
english: And the God of Israel put an impulse into the heart of Pul, king of Assyria, and of Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, who took them away as prisoners, all the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to Halah and Habor and Hara and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

chinese: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

chinese: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
english: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

chinese: 暗蘭的兒子是亞倫、摩西，還有女兒米利暗。亞倫的兒子是拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
english: And the sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

chinese: 以利亞撒生非尼哈；非尼哈生亞比書；
english: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas; Phinehas was the father of Abishua;

chinese: 亞比書生布基；布基生烏西；
english: And Abishua was the father of Bukki, and Bukki was the father of Uzzi,

chinese: 烏西生西拉希雅；西拉希雅生米拉約；
english: And Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, and Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth;

chinese: 米拉約生亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅生亞希突；
english: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, and Amariah was the father of Ahitub,

chinese: 亞希突生撒督；撒督生亞希瑪斯；
english: And Ahitub was the father of Zadok, and Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,

chinese: 亞希瑪斯生亞撒利雅；亞撒利雅生約哈難；
english: And Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, and Azariah was the father of Johanan,

chinese: 約哈難生亞撒利雅（這亞撒利雅在所羅門於耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的職分）；
english: And Johanan was the father of Azariah, (he was priest in the house which Solomon put up in Jerusalem:)

chinese: 亞撒利雅生亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅生亞希突；
english: And Azariah was the father of Amariah, and Amariah was the father of Ahitub,

chinese: 亞希突生撒督；撒督生沙龍；
english: And Ahitub was the father of Zadok, and Zadok was the father of Shallum,

chinese: 沙龍生希勒家；希勒家生亞撒利雅；
english: And Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, and Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,

chinese: 亞撒利雅生西萊雅；西萊雅生約薩答。
english: And Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak;

chinese: 當耶和華藉尼布甲尼撒的手擄掠猶大和耶路撒冷人的時候，這約薩答也被擄去。
english: And Jehozadak went as a prisoner when the Lord took away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

chinese: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
english: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

chinese: 革順的兒子名叫立尼、示每。
english: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

chinese: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
english: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

chinese: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示。這是按著利未人宗族分的各家。
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites listed by the names of their fathers.

chinese: 革順的兒子是立尼；立尼的兒子是雅哈；雅哈的兒子是薪瑪；
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

chinese: 薪瑪的兒子是約亞；約亞的兒子是易多；易多的兒子是謝拉；謝拉的兒子是耶特賴。
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.

chinese: 哥轄的兒子是亞米拿達；亞米拿達的兒子是可拉；可拉的兒子是亞惜；
english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

chinese: 亞惜的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是以比雅撒；以比雅撒的兒子是亞惜；
english: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

chinese: 亞惜的兒子是他哈；他哈的兒子是烏列；烏列的兒子是烏西雅；烏西雅的兒子是少羅。
english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

chinese: 以利加拿的兒子是亞瑪賽和亞希摩。
english: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

chinese: 亞希摩的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是瑣菲；瑣菲的兒子是拿哈；
english: Elkanah his son: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

chinese: 拿哈的兒子是以利押；以利押的兒子是耶羅罕；耶羅罕的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是撒母耳。
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son, Samuel his son.

chinese: 撒母耳的長子是約珥，次子是亞比亞。
english: And the sons of Samuel: the oldest Joel, and the second Abiah.

chinese: 米拉利的兒子是抹利；抹利的兒子是立尼；立尼的兒子是示每；示每的兒子是烏撒；
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

chinese: 烏撒的兒子是示米亞；示米亞的兒子是哈基雅；哈基雅的兒子是亞帥雅。
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

chinese: 約櫃安設之後，大衛派人在耶和華殿中管理歌唱的事。
english: And these are those whom David made responsible for the music in the house of the Lord, after the ark had rest.

chinese: 他們就在會幕前當歌唱的差，及至所羅門在耶路撒冷建造了耶和華的殿，他們便按著班次供職。
english: They gave worship with songs before the House of the Tent of meeting, till Solomon put up the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they took their places for their work in their regular order.

chinese: 供職的人和他們的子孫記在下面：哥轄的子孫中有歌唱的希幔。希幔是約珥的兒子；約珥是撒母耳的兒子；
english: And these are those who did this work, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman, who made melody, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

chinese: 撒母耳是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是耶羅罕的兒子；耶羅罕是以列的兒子；以列是陀亞的兒子；
english: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

chinese: 陀亞是蘇弗的兒子；蘇弗是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是瑪哈的兒子；瑪哈是亞瑪賽的兒子；
english: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

chinese: 亞瑪賽是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是約珥的兒子；約珥是亞撒利雅的兒子；亞撒利雅是西番雅的兒子；
english: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

chinese: 西番雅是他哈的兒子；他哈是亞惜的兒子；亞惜是以比雅撒的兒子；以比雅撒是可拉的兒子；
english: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

chinese: 可拉是以斯哈的兒子；以斯哈是哥轄的兒子；哥轄是利未的兒子；利未是以色列的兒子。
english: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

chinese: 希幔的族兄亞薩是比利家的兒子，亞薩在希幔右邊供職。比利家是示米亞的兒子；
english: And his brother Asaph, whose place was at his right hand, Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

chinese: 示米亞是米迦勒的兒子；米迦勒是巴西雅的兒子；巴西雅是瑪基雅的兒子；
english: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

chinese: 瑪基雅是伊特尼的兒子；伊特尼是謝拉的兒子；謝拉是亞大雅的兒子；
english: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

chinese: 亞大雅是以探的兒子；以探是薪瑪的兒子；薪瑪是示每的兒子；
english: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

chinese: 示每是雅哈的兒子；雅哈是革順的兒子。革順是利未的兒子。
english: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

chinese: 他們的族弟兄米拉利的子孫，在他們左邊供職的有以探。以探是基示的兒子；基示是亞伯底的兒子；亞伯底是瑪鹿的兒子；
english: And on the left their brothers, the sons of Merari: Ethan, the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

chinese: 瑪鹿是哈沙比雅的兒子；哈沙比雅是亞瑪謝的兒子；亞瑪謝是希勒家的兒子；
english: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

chinese: 希勒家是暗西的兒子；暗西是巴尼的兒子；巴尼是沙麥的兒子；
english: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

chinese: 沙麥是末力的兒子；末力是母示的兒子；母示是米拉利的兒子；米拉利是利未的兒子。
english: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

chinese: 他們的族弟兄利未人也被派辦神殿中的一切事。
english: And their brothers the Levites were responsible for all the work of the Tent of the house of God.

chinese: 亞倫和他的子孫在燔祭壇和香壇上獻祭燒香，又在至聖所辦理一切的事，為以色列人贖罪，是照神僕人摩西所吩咐的。
english: But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burned offering, and on the altar of perfume, for all the work of the most holy place, and to take away the sin of Israel, doing everything ordered by Moses, the servant of God.

chinese: 亞倫的兒子是以利亞撒；以利亞撒的兒子是非尼哈；非尼哈的兒子是亞比書；
english: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

chinese: 亞比書的兒子是布基；布基的兒子是烏西；烏西的兒子是西拉希雅；
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

chinese: 西拉希雅的兒子是米拉約；米拉約的兒子是亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅的兒子是亞希突；
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

chinese: 亞希突的兒子是撒督；撒督的兒子是亞希瑪斯。
english: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

chinese: 他們的住處按著境內的營寨，記在下面：哥轄族亞倫的子孫先拈鬮得地，
english: Now these are their living-places, the limits inside which they were to put up their tents: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, because they had the first selection,

chinese: 在猶大地中得了希伯崙和四圍的郊野；
english: To them they gave Hebron and its outskirts in the land of Judah;

chinese: 只是屬城的田地和村莊都為耶孚尼的兒子迦勒所得。
english: But the open country of the town, and the small places round it, they gave to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

chinese: 亞倫的子孫得了逃城希伯崙，又得了立拿與其郊野，雅提珥、以實提莫與其郊野；
english: And to the sons of Aaron they gave Hebron, the town to which men might go in flight and be safe, and Libnah with its outskirts, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its outskirts,

chinese: 希崙與其郊野，底璧與其郊野，
english: And Hilen with its outskirts, Debir with its outskirts,

chinese: 亞珊與其郊野，伯示麥與其郊野。
english: And Ashan with its outskirts, and Beth-shemesh with its outskirts;

chinese: 在便雅憫支派的地中，得了迦巴與其郊野，阿勒篾與其郊野，亞拿突與其郊野。他們諸家所得的城共十三座。
english: And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its outskirts, and Alemeth with its outskirts, and Anathoth with its outskirts. All their towns among their families were thirteen towns.

chinese: 哥轄族其餘的人又拈鬮，在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了十座城。
english: And to the rest of the sons of Kohath there were given by the Lord's decision ten towns out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim and out of the tribe of Dan and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

chinese: 革順族按著宗族，在以薩迦支派的地中，亞設支派的地中，拿弗他利支派的地中，巴珊內瑪拿西支派的地中，得了十三座城。
english: And to the sons of Gershom, by their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen towns.

chinese: 米拉利族按著宗族拈鬮，在流便支派的地中，迦得支派的地中，西布倫支派的地中，得了十二座城。
english: And to the sons of Merari, by their families, twelve towns were given by the Lord's decision, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

chinese: 以色列人將這些城與其郊野給了利未人。
english: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the towns with their outskirts.

chinese: 這以上錄名的城，在猶大、西緬、便雅憫三支派的地中，以色列人拈鬮給了他們。
english: And they gave by the Lord's decision out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these towns whose names are given.

chinese: 哥轄族中有幾家在以法蓮支派的地中也得了城邑，
english: And to the families of the sons of Kohath were given towns by the Lord's decision out of the tribe of Ephraim.

chinese: 在以法蓮山地得了逃城示劍與其郊野，又得了基色與其郊野，
english: And they gave them the town to which men might go in flight and be safe, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim with its outskirts, and Gezer with its outskirts,

chinese: 約緬與其郊野，伯和崙與其郊野，
english: And Jokmeam with its outskirts, and Beth-horon with its outskirts,

chinese: 亞雅崙與其郊野，迦特臨門與其郊野。
english: And Aijalon with its outskirts, and Gath-rimmon with its outskirts;

chinese: 哥轄族其餘的人在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了亞乃與其郊野，比連與其郊野。
english: And out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its outskirts, and Bileam with its outskirts, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

chinese: 革順族在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了巴珊的哥蘭與其郊野，亞斯他錄與其郊野；
english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its outskirts, and Ashtaroth with its outskirts;

chinese: 又在以薩迦支派的地中得了基低斯與其郊野，大比拉與其郊野，
english: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its outskirts, and Daberath with its outskirts,

chinese: 拉末與其郊野，亞年與其郊野；
english: And Ramoth with its outskirts, and Anem with its outskirts;

chinese: 在亞設支派的地中得了瑪沙與其郊野，押頓與其郊野，
english: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its outskirts, and Abdon with its outskirts,

chinese: 戶割與其郊野，利合與其郊野；
english: And Hukok with its outskirts, and Rehob with its outskirts;

chinese: 在拿弗他利支派的地中得了加利利的基低斯與其郊野，哈們與其郊野，基列亭與其郊野。
english: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its outskirts, and Hammon with its outskirts, and Kiriathaim with its outskirts.

chinese: 還有米拉利族的人在西布倫支派的地中得了臨摩挪與其郊野，他泊與其郊野；
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its outskirts, Tabor with its outskirts;

chinese: 又在耶利哥的約但河東，在流便支派的地中得了曠野的比悉與其郊野，雅哈撒與其郊野，
english: And on the other side of Jordan, at Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the waste land with its outskirts, and Jahzah with its outskirts,

chinese: 基底莫與其郊野，米法押與其郊野；
english: And Kedemoth with its outskirts, and Mephaath with its outskirts;

chinese: 又在迦得支派的地中得了基列的拉末與其郊野，瑪哈念與其郊野，
english: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its outskirts, and Mahanaim with its outskirts,

chinese: 希實本與其郊野，雅謝與其郊野。
english: And Heshbon with its outskirts, and Jazer with its outskirts.

chinese: 以薩迦的兒子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述(創四六13是約伯)、伸崙，共四人。
english: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah, Jashub and Shimron, four.

chinese: 陀拉的兒子是烏西、利法雅、耶勒、雅買、易伯散、示母利，都是陀拉的族長，是大能的勇士。到大衛年間，他們的人數共有二萬二千六百名。
english: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah and Jeriel and Jahmai and Ibsam and Shemuel, heads of their families; they were men of war; in the record of their generations their number in the time of David was twenty-two thousand, six hundred.

chinese: 烏西的兒子是伊斯拉希；伊斯拉希的兒子是米迦勒、俄巴底亞、約珥、伊示雅，共五人，都是族長。
english: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah; and the sons of Izrahiah: Michael and Obadiah and Joel and Isshiah, five; all of them chiefs.

chinese: 他們所率領的，按著宗族出戰的軍隊，共有三萬六千人，因為他們的妻和子眾多。
english: And with them, recorded in generations by their families, were bands of fighting-men, thirty-six thousand of them, for they had a great number of wives and sons.

chinese: 他們的族弟兄在以薩迦各族中都是大能的勇士，按著家譜計算共有八萬七千人。
english: And there were recorded among all the families of Issachar, great men of war, eighty-seven thousand.

chinese: 便雅憫的兒子是比拉、比結、耶疊，共三人。
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela and Becher and Jediael, three.

chinese: 比拉的兒子是以斯本、烏西、烏薛、耶利摩、以利，共五人，都是族長，是大能的勇士。按著家譜計算，他們的子孫共有二萬二千零三十四人。
english: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon and Uzzi and Uzziel and Jerimoth and Iri, five; heads of their families, great men of war; there were twenty-two thousand and thirty-four of them recorded by their families.

chinese: 比結的兒子是細米拉、約阿施、以利以謝、以利約乃、暗利、耶利摩、亞比雅、亞拿突、亞拉篾。這都是比結的兒子。
english: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah and Joash and Eliezer and Elioenai and Omri and Jerimoth and Abijah and Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

chinese: 他們都是族長，是大能的勇士。按著家譜計算，他們的子孫共有二萬零二百人。
english: And they were recorded by their generations, heads of their families, great men of war, twenty thousand, two hundred.

chinese: 耶疊的兒子是比勒罕；比勒罕的兒子是耶烏施、便雅憫、以忽、基拿拿、細坦、他施、亞希沙哈。
english: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan: Jeush and Benjamin and Ehud and Chenaanah and Zethan and Tarshish and Ahishahar.

chinese: 這都是耶疊的兒子，都是族長，是大能的勇士；他們的子孫能上陣打仗的，共有一萬七千二百人。
english: All these were the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their families, seventeen thousand, two hundred men of war, able to go out with the army for war.

chinese: 還有以珥的兒子書品、戶品，並亞黑的兒子戶伸。
english: And Shuppim and Huppim. The sons of Dan, Hushim his son, one.

chinese: 拿弗他利的兒子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、沙龍。這都是辟拉的子孫。
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel and Guni and Jezer and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

chinese: 瑪拿西的兒子亞斯列是他妾亞蘭人所生的，又生了基列之父瑪吉。
english: The sons of Manasseh by his servant-wife, the Aramaean woman: she gave birth to Machir, the father of Gilead;

chinese: 瑪吉娶的妻是戶品、書品的妹子，名叫瑪迦。瑪拿西的次子名叫西羅非哈；西羅非哈但有幾個女兒。
english: (And Gilead took a wife, whose name was Maacah, and his sister's name was Hammoleketh;) and the name of his brother was Zelophehad, who was the father of daughters.

chinese: 瑪吉的妻瑪迦生了一個兒子，起名叫毗利施。毗利施的兄弟名叫示利施；示利施的兒子是烏蘭和利金。
english: And Maacah, the wife of Gilead, gave birth to a son to whom she gave the name Peresh; and his brother was named Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

chinese: 烏蘭的兒子是比但。這都是基列的子孫。基列是瑪吉的兒子，瑪吉是瑪拿西的兒子。
english: And the son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir the son of Manasseh.

chinese: 基列的妹子哈摩利吉生了伊施荷、亞比以謝、瑪拉。
english: And his sister Hammoleketh was the mother of Ishhod and Abiezer and Mahlah.

chinese: 〈示米大的兒子是亞現、示劍、利克希、阿尼安。〉
english: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian and Shechem and Likhi and Aniam.

chinese: 以法蓮的兒子是書提拉；書提拉的兒子是比列；比列的兒子是他哈；他哈的兒子是以拉大；以拉大的兒子是他哈；
english: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,

chinese: 他哈的兒子是撒拔；撒拔的兒子是書提拉。以法蓮又生以謝、以列；這二人因為下去奪取迦特人的牲畜，被本地的迦特人殺了。
english: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead, whom the men of Gath, who had been living in the land from their birth, put to death, because they came down to take away their cattle.

chinese: 他們的父親以法蓮為他們悲哀了多日，他的弟兄都來安慰他。
english: And for a long time Ephraim their father went on weeping for them, and his brothers came to give him comfort.

chinese: 以法蓮與妻同房，他妻就懷孕生了一子，以法蓮因為家裡遭禍，就給這兒子起名叫比利亞。
english: After that, he had connection with his wife, and she became with child and gave birth to a son, to whom his father gave the name of Beriah, because trouble had come on his family.

chinese: 他的女兒名叫舍伊拉，就是建築上伯和崙、下伯和崙與烏羨舍伊拉的。
english: And his daughter was Sheerah, the builder of Beth-horon the lower and the higher, and Uzzen-sheerah.

chinese: 比利阿的兒子是利法和利悉。利悉的兒子是他拉；他拉的兒子是他罕；
english: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph; his son was Telah, and his son was Tahan;

chinese: 他罕的兒子是拉但；拉但的兒子是亞米忽；亞米忽的兒子是以利沙瑪；
english: Ladan was his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

chinese: 以利沙瑪的兒子是嫩；嫩的兒子是約書亞。
english: Nun his son, Joshua his son.

chinese: 以法蓮人的地業和住處是伯特利與其村莊；東邊拿蘭，西邊基色與其村莊；示劍與其村莊，直到迦薩與其村莊；
english: Their heritage and their living-places were Beth-el and its daughter-towns, and Naaran to the east, and Gezer to the west, with its daughter-towns, as well as Shechem and its daughter-towns as far as Azzah and its daughter-towns;

chinese: 還有靠近瑪拿西人的境界，伯善與其村莊；他納與其村莊；米吉多與其村莊；多珥與其村莊。以色列兒子約瑟的子孫住在這些地方。
english: And by the limits of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, with their daughter-towns. In these the children of Joseph, the son of Israel, were living.

chinese: 亞設的兒子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韋、比利亞，還有他們的妹子西拉。
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah and Serah, their sister.

chinese: 比利亞的兒子是希別、瑪結；瑪結是比撒威的父親。
english: And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

chinese: 希別生雅弗勒、朔默、何坦，和他們的妹子書雅。
english: And Heber was the father of Japhlet and Shomer and Hotham and Shua, their sister.

chinese: 雅弗勒的兒子是巴薩、賓哈、亞施法。這都是雅弗勒的兒子。
english: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach and Bimhal and Ashvath. These are the sons of Japhlet.

chinese: 朔默的兒子是亞希、羅迦、耶戶巴、亞蘭。
english: And the sons of Shomer: Ahi and Rohgah, Jehubbah and Aram.

chinese: 朔默兄弟希連的兒子是瑣法、音那、示利斯、亞抹。
english: And the sons of Hotham, his brother: Zophah and Imna and Shelesh and Amal.

chinese: 瑣法的兒子是書亞、哈尼弗、書阿勒、比利、音拉、
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah and Harnepher and Shual and Beri and Imrah,

chinese: 比悉、河得、珊瑪、施沙、益蘭、比拉。
english: Bezer and Hod and Shamma and Shilshah and Ithran and Beera.

chinese: 益帖的兒子是耶孚尼、毗斯巴、亞拉。
english: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh and Pispah and Ara.

chinese: 烏拉的兒子是亞拉、漢尼業、利寫。
english: And the sons of Ulla: Arah and Hanniel and Rizia.

chinese: 這都是亞設的子孫，都是族長，是精壯大能的勇士，也是首領中的頭目，按著家譜計算，他們的子孫能出戰的共有二萬六千人。
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their families, specially strong men of war, chiefs of the rulers. They were recorded in the army for war, twenty-six thousand men in number.

chinese: 便雅憫的長子比拉，次子亞實別，三子亞哈拉，
english: And Benjamin was the father of Bela his oldest son, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

chinese: 四子挪哈，五子拉法。
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

chinese: 比拉的兒子是亞大、基拉、亞比忽、
english: And Bela had sons, Addar and Gera, the father of Ehud,

chinese: 亞比書、乃幔、亞何亞、
english: And Abishua and Naaman and Ahoah

chinese: 基拉、示孚汛、戶蘭。
english: And Gera and Shephuphan and Huram.

chinese: 以忽的兒子作迦巴居民的族長，被擄到瑪拿轄；
english: And these are the sons of Ehud, heads of families of those living in Geba: Iglaam and Alemeth

chinese: 以忽的兒子乃幔、亞希亞、基拉也被擄去。基拉生烏撒、亞希忽。
english: And Naaman and Ahijah and Gera; and Iglaam was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

chinese: 沙哈連休他二妻戶伸和巴拉之後，在摩押地生了兒子。
english: And Shaharaim became the father of children in the country of the Moabites after driving out Hushim and Beerah his wives;

chinese: 他與妻賀得同房，生了約巴、洗比雅、米沙、瑪拉干、
english: And by Hodesh his wife he became the father of Jobab and Zibia and Mesha and Malcam.

chinese: 耶烏斯、沙迦、米瑪。他這些兒子都是族長。
english: And Jeuz and Shachia and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.

chinese: 他的妻戶伸給他生的兒子有亞比突、以利巴力。
english: And Hushim became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

chinese: 以利巴力的兒子是希伯、米珊、沙麥。沙麥建立阿挪和羅德二城與其村莊。
english: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber and Misham and Shemed (he was the builder of Ono and Lod and their daughter-towns);

chinese: 又有比利亞和示瑪是亞雅崙居民的族長，是驅逐迦特人的。
english: And Beriah and Shema, who were heads of the families of those who were living in Aijalon, who put to flight the people living in Gath;

chinese: 亞希約、沙煞、耶利末、
english: And their brothers Shashak and Jeremoth.

chinese: 西巴第雅、亞拉得、亞得、
english: And Zebadiah and Arad and Eder

chinese: 米迦勒、伊施巴、約哈都是比利亞的兒子。
english: And Michael and Ishpah and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

chinese: 西巴第雅、米書蘭、希西基、希伯、
english: And Zebadiah and Meshullam and Hizki and Heber

chinese: 伊施米萊、伊斯利亞、約巴都是以利巴力的兒子。
english: And Ishmerai and Izliah and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

chinese: 雅金、細基利、撒底、
english: And Jakim and Zichri and Zabdi

chinese: 以利乃、洗勒太、以列、
english: And Elienai and Zillethai and Eliel

chinese: 亞大雅、比拉雅、申拉都是示每的兒子。
english: And Adaiah and Beraiah and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei;

chinese: 伊施班、希伯、以列、
english: And Ishpan and Eber and Eliel

chinese: 亞伯頓、細基利、哈難、
english: And Abdon and Zichri and Hanan

chinese: 哈拿尼雅、以攔、安陀提雅、
english: And Hananiah and Elam and Anathothijah

chinese: 伊弗底雅、毗努伊勒都是沙煞的兒子。
english: And Iphdeiah and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

chinese: 珊示萊、示哈利、亞他利雅、
english: And Shamsherai and Shehariah and Athaliah

chinese: 雅利西、以利亞、細基利都是耶羅罕的兒子。
english: And Jaareshiah and Elijah and Zichri, the sons of Jeremoth.

chinese: 這些人都是著名的族長，住在耶路撒冷。
english: These were heads of families in their generations; chief men: these were living in Jerusalem.

chinese: 在基遍住的有基遍的父親耶利。他的妻名叫瑪迦；
english: And in Gibeon was living the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife's name was Maacah;

chinese: 他長子是亞伯頓。他又生蘇珥、基士、巴力、拿答、
english: And his oldest son Abdon, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab

chinese: 基多、亞希約、撒迦、米基羅。
english: And Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth.

chinese: 米基羅生示米暗。這些人和他們的弟兄在耶路撒冷對面居住。
english: And Mikloth was the father of Shimeah. And they were living with their brothers in Jerusalem opposite their brothers.

chinese: 尼珥生基士；基士生掃羅；掃羅生約拿單、麥基舒亞、亞比拿達、伊施巴力。
english: And Ner was the father of Abner, and Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan and Malchi-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.

chinese: 約拿單的兒子是米力巴力(撒下四章四節作米非波設)；米力巴力生米迦。
english: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.

chinese: 米迦的兒子是毗敦、米勒、他利亞、亞哈斯；
english: And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tarea and Ahaz.

chinese: 亞哈斯生耶何阿達；耶何阿達生亞拉篾、亞斯瑪威、心利；心利生摩撒；
english: And Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza;

chinese: 摩撒生比尼亞；比尼亞的兒子是拉法；拉法的兒子是以利亞薩；以利亞薩的兒子是亞悉。
english: And Moza was the father of Binea: Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son;

chinese: 亞悉有六個兒子，他們的名字是亞斯利干、波基路、以實瑪利、示亞利雅、俄巴底雅、哈難。這都是亞悉的兒子。
english: And Azel had five sons, whose names are: Azrikam, his oldest, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

chinese: 亞悉兄弟以設的長子是烏蘭，次子耶烏施，三子是以利法列。
english: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his oldest son, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

chinese: 烏蘭的兒子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他們有許多的子孫，共一百五十名，都是便雅憫人。
english: And the sons of Ulam were men of war, bowmen, and had a great number of sons and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were the sons of Benjamin.

chinese: 以色列人都按家譜計算，寫在以色列諸王記上。猶大人因犯罪就被擄到巴比倫。
english: So all Israel was listed by their families; and, truly, they are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was taken away as prisoners to Babylon because of their sin.

chinese: 先從巴比倫回來，住在自己地業城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提寧的首領。
english: Now the first to take up their heritage in their towns were: Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.

chinese: 住在耶路撒冷的有猶大人、便雅憫人、以法蓮人、瑪拿西人。
english: And in Jerusalem there were living some of the sons of Judah, and of Benjamin, and of Ephraim and Manasseh;

chinese: 猶大兒子法勒斯的子孫中有烏太。烏太是亞米忽的兒子；亞米忽是暗利的兒子；暗利是音利的兒子；音利是巴尼的兒子。
english: Uthai, the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the sons of Perez, the son of Judah.

chinese: 示羅的子孫中有長子亞帥雅和他的眾子。
english: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the oldest, and his sons.

chinese: 謝拉的子孫中有耶烏利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。
english: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.

chinese: 便雅憫人中有哈西努的曾孫、何達威雅的孫子、米書蘭的兒子撒路，
english: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, Judah, the son of Hassenuah,

chinese: 又有耶羅罕的兒子伊比尼雅，米基立的孫子、烏西的兒子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孫、流珥的孫子、示法提雅的兒子米書蘭，
english: And Ibneiah, the son of Jeroham, and Elah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

chinese: 和他們的族弟兄，按著家譜計算共有九百五十六名。這些人都是他們的族長。
english: And their brothers, in the list of their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were heads of families, listed by the names of their fathers.
