chinese: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，
english: And of the priests: Jedaiah and Jehoiarib and Jachin

chinese: 還有管理神殿希勒家的兒子亞薩利雅。希勒家是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是撒督的兒子；撒督是米拉約的兒子；米拉約是亞希突的兒子。
english: And Azariah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

chinese: 有瑪基雅的曾孫、巴施戶珥的孫子、耶羅罕的兒子亞大雅，又有亞第業的兒子瑪賽；亞第業是雅希細拉的兒子；雅希細拉是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是米實利密的兒子；米實利密是音麥的兒子。
english: And Adaiah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai, the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

chinese: 他們和眾弟兄都是族長，共有一千七百六十人，是善於做神殿使用之工的。
english: And their brothers, heads of their families, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty: able men, doing the work of the house of God.

chinese: 利未人米拉利的子孫中，有哈沙比雅的曾孫、押利甘的孫子、哈述的兒子示瑪雅。
english: And of the Levites: Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

chinese: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，並亞薩的曾孫、細基利的孫子、米迦的兒子瑪探雅，
english: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah, the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

chinese: 又有耶杜頓的曾孫、迦拉的孫子、示瑪雅的兒子俄巴底，還有以利加拿的孫子、亞撒的兒子比利家。他們都住在尼陀法人的村莊。
english: And Obadiah, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah, the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who were living in the small towns of the Netophathites.

chinese: 守門的是沙龍、亞谷、達們、亞希幔，和他們的弟兄；沙龍為長。
english: And the door-keepers: Shallum and Akkub and Talmon and Ahiman and their brothers: Shallum was the chief.

chinese: 從前這些人看守朝東的王門，如今是利未營中守門的。
english: Up till then they had been at the king's door to the east. They were door-keepers for the tents of the sons of Levi.

chinese: 可拉的曾孫、以比雅撒的孫子、可利的兒子沙龍，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，並守會幕的門。他們的祖宗曾管理耶和華的營盤，又把守營門。
english: And Shallum, the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his family, the Korahites, were responsible for everything which had to be done in connection with the order of worship, keepers of the doors of the Tent; their fathers had had the care of the tents of the Lord, being keepers of the doorway.

chinese: 從前以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈管理他們，耶和華也與他同在。
english: In the past Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, had been ruler over them; may the Lord be with him!

chinese: 米施利米雅的兒子撒迦利雅是看守會幕之門的。
english: Zechariah, the son of Meshelemiah, was keeper of the door of the Tent of meeting.

chinese: 被選守門的人共有二百一十二名。他們在自己的村莊，按著家譜計算，是大衛和先見撒母耳所派當這緊要職任的。
english: There were two hundred and twelve whose business it was to keep the doorway. These were listed by families in the country places where they were living, whom David and Samuel the seer put in their responsible positions.

chinese: 他們和他們的子孫按著班次看守耶和華殿的門，就是會幕的門。
english: So they and their sons had the care of the doors of the house of the Lord, the house of the Tent, as watchers.

chinese: 在東西南北，四方都有守門的。
english: There were keepers of the doors on the four sides, to the east, west, north, and south.

chinese: 他們的族弟兄住在村莊，每七日來與他們換班。
english: And their brothers, in the country places where they were living, were to come in every seven days to be with them from time to time.

chinese: 這四個門領都是利未人，各有緊要的職任，看守神殿的倉庫。
english: For the four chief door-keepers, who were Levites, had a special position, looking after the rooms and the store-houses of the house of God.

chinese: 他們住在神殿的四圍，是因委託他們守殿，要每日早晨開門。
english: Their sleeping-rooms were round the house of God, for they had the care of it, and were responsible for opening it morning by morning.

chinese: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按著數目拿出拿入；
english: Certain of them had the care of the vessels used in worship, to keep an account of them when they came in and when they were taken out again.

chinese: 又有人管理器具和聖所的器皿，並細麵、酒、油、乳香、香料。
english: And some of them were responsible for the holy things and for the vessels of the holy place, and the meal and the wine and the oil and the perfume and the spices.

chinese: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。
english: And some of the sons of the priests were responsible for crushing the spices.

chinese: 利未人瑪他提雅是可拉族沙龍的長子，他緊要的職任是管理盤中烤的物。
english: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, the oldest son of Shallum the Korahite, was responsible for cooking the flat cakes.

chinese: 他們族弟兄哥轄子孫中，有管理陳設餅的，每安息日預備擺列。
english: And some of their brothers, sons of the Kohathites, were responsible for the holy bread which was put in order before the Lord, to get it ready every Sabbath.

chinese: 歌唱的有利未人的族長，住在屬殿的房屋，晝夜供職，不做別樣的工。
english: And these were those who had the ordering of the music and songs, heads of families of the Levites, who were living in the rooms, and were free from other work, for their work went on day and night.

chinese: 以上都是利未人著名的族長，住在耶路撒冷。
english: These were heads of families of the Levites in their generations, chief men; they were living at Jerusalem.

chinese: 在基遍住的有基遍的父親耶利。他的妻名叫瑪迦；
english: And in Gibeon was living the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife's name was Maacah;

chinese: 他長子是亞伯頓。他又生蘇珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、
english: And Abdon his oldest son, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab

chinese: 基多、亞希約、撒迦利雅、米基羅。
english: And Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth

chinese: 米基羅生示米暗。這些人和他們的弟兄在耶路撒冷對面居住。
english: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They were living with their brothers in Jerusalem opposite their brothers.

chinese: 尼珥生基士；基士生掃羅；掃羅生約拿單、麥基舒亞、亞比拿達、伊施巴力。
english: And Ner was the father of Kish; and Kish was the father of Saul; and Saul was the father of Jonathan and Malchi-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.

chinese: 約拿單的兒子是米力巴力(即米非波設)；米力巴力生米迦。
english: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.

chinese: 米迦的兒子是毗敦、米勒、他利亞、亞哈斯。
english: And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tahrea and Ahaz.

chinese: 亞哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亞拉篾、亞斯瑪威、心利；心利生摩撒；
english: And Ahaz was the father of Jarah; and Jarah was the father of Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza.

chinese: 摩撒生比尼亞；比尼亞生利法雅；利法雅的兒子是以利亞薩；以利亞薩的兒子是亞悉。
english: And Moza was the father of Binea; and Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

chinese: 亞悉有六個兒子，他們的名字是亞斯利干、波基路、以實瑪利、示亞利雅、俄巴底雅、哈難。這都是亞悉的兒子。
english: And Azel had five sons, whose names are: Azrikam, his oldest son, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

chinese: 非利士人與以色列人爭戰，以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山有被殺仆倒的。
english: Now the Philistines were fighting against Israel; and the men of Israel went in flight before the Philistines, falling down wounded in Mount Gilboa.

chinese: 非利士人緊追掃羅和他兒子們，就殺了掃羅的兒子約拿單、亞比拿達、麥基舒亞。
english: And the Philistines went hard after Saul and his sons, and put to death Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

chinese: 勢派甚大，掃羅被弓箭手追上，射傷甚重，
english: And the fight was going against Saul, and the archers came across him, and he was wounded by the archers.

chinese: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人說：你拔出刀來，將我刺死，免得那些未受割禮的人來凌辱我。但拿兵器的人甚懼怕，不肯刺他；
english: Then Saul said to the servant who had the care of his arms, Take your sword and put it through me, before these men without circumcision come and make sport of me. But his servant, full of fear, would not do so. Then Saul took out his sword, falling on it himself.

chinese: 掃羅就自己伏在刀上死了。拿兵器的人見掃羅已死，也伏在刀上死了。
english: And when his servant saw that Saul was dead, he did the same, and came to his death.

chinese: 這樣，掃羅和他三個兒子，並他的全家都一同死亡。
english: So death overtook Saul and his three sons; all his family came to an end together.

chinese: 住平原的以色列眾人見以色列軍兵逃跑，掃羅和他兒子都死了，也就棄城逃跑，非利士人便來住在其中。
english: And when all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that the men of Israel had gone in flight and that Saul and his sons were dead, they went in flight away from their towns; and the Philistines came and took them for themselves.

chinese: 次日，非利士人來剝那被殺之人的衣服，看見掃羅和他兒子仆倒在基利波山，
english: Now the day after, when the Philistines came to take their goods from the dead, they saw Saul and his sons dead in Mount Gilboa.

chinese: 就剝了他的軍裝，割下他的首級，打發人到(或作送到)非利士地的四境報信與他們的偶像和眾民，
english: And they took everything off him, and took his head and his war-dress, and sent word into the land of the Philistines round about to give the news to their gods and to the people.

chinese: 又將掃羅的軍裝放在他們神的廟裡，將他的首級釘在大袞廟中。
english: And they put his war-dress in the house of their gods, and put up his head in the house of Dagon.

chinese: 基列雅比人聽見非利士人向掃羅所行的一切事，
english: And when the news came to Jabesh-gilead of what the Philistines had done to Saul,

chinese: 他們中間所有的勇士就起身前去，將掃羅和他兒子的屍身送到雅比，將他們的屍骨葬在雅比的橡樹下，就禁食七日。
english: All the fighting-men came up and took away Saul's body and the bodies of his sons, and took them to Jabesh, and put their bones to rest under the oak-tree in Jabesh, and took no food for seven days.

chinese: 這樣，掃羅死了。因為他干犯耶和華，沒有遵守耶和華的命；又因他求問交鬼的婦人，
english: So death came to Saul because of the sin which he did against the Lord, that is, because of the word of the Lord which he kept not; and because he went for directions to one who had an evil spirit,

chinese: 沒有求問耶和華，所以耶和華使他被殺，把國歸於耶西的兒子大衛。
english: And not to the Lord: for this reason, he put him to death and gave the kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.

chinese: 以色列眾人聚集到希伯崙見大衛，說：我們原是你的骨肉。
english: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron, and said, Truly, we are your bone and your flesh.

chinese: 從前掃羅作王的時候，率領以色列人出入的是你；耶和華─你的神也曾應許你說：你必牧養我的民以色列，作以色列的君。
english: In the past, when Saul was king, it was you who went at the head of Israel when they went out or came in; and the Lord your God said to you, You are to be the keeper of my people Israel, and their ruler.

chinese: 於是以色列的長老都來到希伯崙見大衛王。大衛在希伯崙耶和華面前與他們立約，他們就膏大衛作以色列的王，是照耶和華藉撒母耳所說的話。
english: So all the responsible men of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and David made an agreement with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they put the holy oil on David and made him king over Israel, as the Lord had said by Samuel.

chinese: 大衛和以色列眾人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯；那時耶布斯人住在那裡。
english: Then David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (which is Jebus); and the Jebusites, the people of the land, were there.

chinese: 耶布斯人對大衛說：你決不能進這地方。然而大衛攻取錫安的保障，就是大衛的城。
english: And the people of Jebus said to David, You will not come in here. But still, David took the strong place of Zion, which is the town of David.

chinese: 大衛說：誰先攻打耶布斯人，必作首領元帥。洗魯雅的兒子約押先上去，就作了元帥。
english: And David said, The first to overcome the Jebusites will be chief and captain. And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, went up first, and became chief.

chinese: 大衛住在保障裡，所以那保障叫作大衛城。
english: And David took the strong tower for his living-place, so it was named the town of David.

chinese: 大衛又從米羅起，四圍建築城牆，其餘的是約押修理。
english: And he took in hand the building of the town all round, starting from the Millo; and Joab put the rest of the town in order.

chinese: 大衛日見強盛，因為萬軍之耶和華與他同在。
english: And David became greater and greater in power, because the Lord of armies was with him.

chinese: 以下記錄跟隨大衛勇士的首領，就是奮勇幫助他得國、照著耶和華吩咐以色列人的話、與以色列人一同立他作王的。
english: Now these are the chief of David's men of war who were his strong supporters in the kingdom, and, with all Israel, made him king, as the Lord had said about Israel.

chinese: 大衛勇士的數目記在下面：哈革摩尼的兒子雅朔班，他是軍長的統領，一時舉槍殺了三百人。
english: This is the list of David's men of war: Ishbaal, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the three: he put to death three hundred at one time with his spear.

chinese: 其次是亞合人犰多的兒子以利亞撒，他是三個勇士裡的一個。
english: And after him was Eleazar, the son of Dodo the Ahohite, who was one of the three great fighters.

chinese: 他從前與大衛在巴斯達閔，非利士人聚集要打仗。那裡有一塊長滿大麥的田，眾民就在非利士人面前逃跑；
english: He was with David at Pas-dammim, where the Philistines had come together for the fight, near a bit of land full of barley; and the people went in flight before the Philistines.

chinese: 這勇士便站在那田間擊殺非利士人，救護了那田。耶和華使以色列人大獲全勝。
english: And he took up his position in the middle of the bit of land, and kept back their attack, and overcame the Philistines; and the Lord gave a great salvation.

chinese: 三十個勇士中的三個人下到磐石那裡，進了亞杜蘭洞見大衛；非利士的軍隊在利乏音谷安營。
english: And three of the thirty went down to David, to the rock, into the strong place of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines had taken up their position in the valley of Rephaim.

chinese: 那時大衛在山寨，非利士人的防營在伯利恆。
english: At that time David had taken cover in the strong place, and an armed force of the Philistines was in Beth-lehem.

chinese: 大衛渴想，說：甚願有人將伯利恆城門旁井裡的水打來給我喝！
english: And David, moved by a strong desire, said, If only someone would give me a drink of the water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem by the doorway into the town!

chinese: 這三個勇士就闖過非利士人的營盤，從伯利恆城門旁的井裡打水，拿來奉給大衛。他卻不肯喝，將水奠在耶和華面前，
english: So the three, forcing a way through the Philistine army, got water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town, and took it back to David; but David would not take it, but made an offering of it, draining it out to the Lord,

chinese: 說：我的神啊，這三個人冒死去打水，這水好像他們的血一般，我斷不敢喝！如此，大衛不肯喝。這是三個勇士所做的事。
english: Saying, By my God, far be it from me to do this! How may I take as drink the life-blood of these men who have put their lives in danger? so he did not take it. These things did the three great men of war.

chinese: 約押的兄弟亞比篩是這三個勇士的首領；他舉槍殺了三百人，就在三個勇士裡得了名。
english: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the thirty, for he put to death three hundred with his spear, but he had not a name among the three.

chinese: 他在這三個勇士裡是最尊貴的，所以作他們的首領；只是不及前三個勇士。
english: Of the thirty, he was the noblest, and was made their captain, but he was not equal to the first three.

chinese: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅行過大能的事：他殺了摩押人亞利伊勒的兩個兒子，又在下雪的時候下坑裡去殺了一個獅子，
english: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, a fighting-man of Kabzeel, had done great acts; he put to death two young lions going into their secret place; and he went down into a hole and put a lion to death in time of snow.

chinese: 又殺了一個埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手裡拿著槍，槍桿粗如織布的機軸；比拿雅只拿著棍子下去，從埃及人手裡奪過槍來，用那槍將他刺死。
english: And he made an attack on an Egyptian, a very tall man about five cubits high, armed with a spear like a cloth-worker's rod; he went down to him with a stick, and pulling his spear out of the hand of the Egyptian, put him to death with that same spear.

chinese: 這是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅所行的事，就在三個勇士裡得了名。
english: These were the acts of Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, who had a great name among the thirty men of war.

chinese: 他比那三十個勇士都尊貴，只是不及前三個勇士。大衛立他作護衛長。
english: He was honoured over the thirty, but he was not equal to the first three: and David put him over his servants.

chinese: 軍中的勇士有約押的兄弟亞撒黑，伯利恆人朵多的兒子伊勒哈難，
english: And these were the great men of war: Asahel, the brother of Joab, Elhanan, the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

chinese: 哈律人沙瑪，比倫人希利斯，
english: Shammoth the Harodite, Helez the Pelonite,

chinese: 提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉，亞拿突人亞比以謝，
english: Ira, the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

chinese: 戶沙人西比該，亞合人以來，
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

chinese: 尼陀法人瑪哈萊，尼陀法人巴拿的兒子希立，
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled, the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

chinese: 便雅憫族基比亞人利拜的兒子以太，比拉頓人比拿雅，
english: Ithai, the son of Ribai of Gibeah, of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

chinese: 迦實溪人戶萊，亞拉巴人亞比，
english: Hurai of Nahale-gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

chinese: 巴路米人押斯瑪弗，沙本人以利雅哈巴，
english: Azmaveth of Bahurim, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

chinese: 基孫人哈深的眾子，哈拉人沙基的兒子約拿單，
english: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan, the son of Shage the Hararite,

chinese: 哈拉人沙甲的兒子亞希暗，吾珥的兒子以利法勒，
english: Ahiam, the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal, the son of Ur,

chinese: 米基拉人希弗，比倫人亞希雅，
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

chinese: 迦密人希斯羅，伊斯拜的兒子拿萊，
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai, the son of Ezbai,

chinese: 拿單的兄弟約珥，哈基利的兒子彌伯哈，
english: Joel, the brother of Nathan, Mibhar, the son of Hagri,

chinese: 亞捫人洗勒，比錄人拿哈萊〈拿哈萊是給洗魯雅的兒子約押拿兵器的〉，
english: Zelek the Ammonite, and Naharai the Berothite, the servant who had the care of the arms of Joab, the son of Zeruiah;

chinese: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

chinese: 赫人烏利亞，亞萊的兒子撒拔，
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad, the son of Ahlai,

chinese: 流便人示撒的兒子亞第拿〈他是流便支派中的一個族長，率領三十人〉，
english: Adina, the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him;

chinese: 瑪迦的兒子哈難，彌特尼人約沙法，
english: Hanan, the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

chinese: 亞施他拉人烏西亞，亞羅珥人何坦的兒子沙瑪、耶利，
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel, the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

chinese: 提洗人申利的兒子耶疊和他的兄弟約哈，
english: Jediael, the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

chinese: 瑪哈未人以利業，伊利拿安的兒子耶利拜、約沙未雅，摩押人伊特瑪、
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

chinese: 以利業、俄備得，並米瑣八人雅西業。
english: Eliel and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

chinese: 大衛因怕基士的兒子掃羅，躲在洗革拉的時候，有勇士到他那裡幫助他打仗。
english: Now these are the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still shut up, because of Saul, the son of Kish; they were among the strong men, his helpers in war.

chinese: 他們善於拉弓，能用左右兩手甩石射箭，都是便雅憫人掃羅的族弟兄。
english: They were armed with bows, and were able to send stones, and arrows from the bow, with right hand or left: they were Saul's brothers, of Benjamin.

chinese: 為首的是亞希以謝，其次是約阿施，都是基比亞人示瑪的兒子。還有亞斯瑪威的兒子耶薛和毗力，又有比拉迦，並亞拿突人耶戶，
english: Ahiezer was their chief, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Beracah and Jehu the Anathothite;

chinese: 基遍人以實買雅〈他在三十人中是勇士，管理他們〉，且有耶利米、雅哈悉、約哈難，和基得拉人約撒拔、
english: And Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a great man among the thirty, and their chief; and Jeremiah and Jehaziel and Johanan and Jozabad the Gederathite;

chinese: 伊利烏賽、耶利摩、比亞利雅、示瑪利雅，哈律弗人示法提雅，
english: Eluzai and Jerimoth and Bealiah and Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;

chinese: 可拉人以利加拿、耶西亞、亞薩列、約以謝、雅朔班，
english: Elkanah and Isshiah and Azarel and Joezer and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

chinese: 基多人耶羅罕的兒子猶拉和西巴第雅。
english: And Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

chinese: 迦得支派中有人到曠野的山寨投奔大衛，都是大能的勇士，能拿盾牌和槍的戰士。他們的面貌好像獅子，快跑如同山上的鹿。
english: And some of the Gadites, siding with David, went to his strong place in the waste land, great and strong men, trained for war, expert in the use of arms, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were quick-footed like roes on the mountains;

chinese: 第一以薛，第二俄巴底雅，第三以利押，
english: Ezer their chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

chinese: 第四彌施瑪拿，第五耶利米，
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

chinese: 第六亞太，第七以利業，
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

chinese: 第八約哈難，第九以利薩巴，
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

chinese: 第十耶利米，第十一末巴奈。
english: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.

chinese: 這都是迦得人中的軍長，至小的能抵一百人，至大的能抵一千人。
english: These Gadites were captains of the army; the least of them was captain over a hundred men, and the greatest over a thousand.

chinese: 正月，約但河水漲過兩岸的時候，他們過河，使一切住平原的人東奔西逃。
english: It was they who went over Jordan in the first month, when the river was overflowing, and put to flight all the people of the valleys, to the east and to the west.

chinese: 又有便雅憫和猶大人到山寨大衛那裡。
english: And some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to David in his strong place.

chinese: 大衛出去迎接他們，對他們說：你們若是和和平平地來幫助我，我心就與你們相契；你們若是將我這無罪的人賣在敵人手裡，願我們列祖的神察看責罰。
english: And David went out to them, and said to them, If you have come in peace to give me help, my heart will be united with yours; but if you have come to give me up to those who would take my life, though my hands are clean from wrongdoing, then may the God of our fathers see it and give you punishment.

chinese: 那時神的靈感動那三十個勇士的首領亞瑪撒，他就說：大衛啊，我們是歸於你的！耶西的兒子啊，我們是幫助你的！願你平平安安，願幫助你的也都平安！因為你的神幫助你。大衛就收留他們，立他們作軍長。
english: Then the spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, We are yours, David, we are on your side, O son of Jesse: may peace be with you and peace be with your helpers; for God is your helper. Then David took them into his army and made them captains of the band.

chinese: 大衛從前與非利士人同去，要與掃羅爭戰，有些瑪拿西人來投奔大衛，他們卻沒有幫助非利士人；因為非利士人的首領商議，打發他們回去，說：恐怕大衛拿我們的首級，歸降他的主人掃羅。
english: And some of the men of Manasseh came over to David, when he went with the Philistines to the war against Saul, but he gave them no help: for the lords of the Philistines, after discussion, sent him away, saying, He will go back to his master Saul, at the price of our lives.

chinese: 大衛往洗革拉去的時候，有瑪拿西人的千夫長押拿、約撒拔、耶疊、米迦勒、約撒拔、以利戶、洗勒太都來投奔他。
english: Then when he went back to Ziklag, there came over to him, of the men of Manasseh, Adnah and Jozabad and Jediael and Michael and Jozabad and Elihu and Zillethai, captains of thousands from the armies of Manasseh.

chinese: 這些人幫助大衛攻擊群賊；他們都是大能的勇士，且作軍長。
english: And they gave David help against the armed bands, for they were all great men of war, and captains in the army.

chinese: 那時天天有人來幫助大衛，以致成了大軍，如神的軍一樣。
english: And from day to day more supporters came to David, till he had a great army like the army of God.

chinese: 預備打仗的兵來到希伯崙見大衛，要照著耶和華的話將掃羅的國位歸與大衛。他們的數目如下：
english: These are the numbers of the chiefs of the armed men, ready for war, who came to David at Hebron, to give the kingdom of Saul into his hands, as the Lord had said.

chinese: 猶大支派，拿盾牌和槍預備打仗的有六千八百人。
english: There were six thousand, eight hundred spearmen of the children of Judah, armed for war;

chinese: 西緬支派，能上陣大能的勇士有七千一百人。
english: Seven thousand, one hundred of the children of Simeon, great men of war;

chinese: 利未支派有四千六百人。
english: Of the children of Levi, four thousand, six hundred.

chinese: 耶何耶大是亞倫家的首領，跟從他的有三千七百人。
english: And Jehoiada, chief of the family of Aaron, and with him three thousand, seven hundred men;

chinese: 還有少年大能的勇士撒督，同著他的有族長二十二人。
english: And Zadok, a young man, great and strong in war, with twenty-two captains from his father's people.

chinese: 便雅憫支派，掃羅的族弟兄也有三千人，他們向來大半歸順掃羅家。
english: And of the children of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul, three thousand; for up to that time the greater part of them had been true to Saul.

chinese: 以法蓮支派大能的勇士，在本族著名的有二萬零八百人。
english: And of the children of Ephraim, twenty thousand, eight hundred great men of war, men of great name in their families.

chinese: 瑪拿西半支派，冊上有名的共一萬八千人，都來立大衛作王。
english: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh, eighteen thousand, listed by name, came to make David king.

chinese: 以薩迦支派，有二百族長都通達時務，知道以色列人所當行的；他們族弟兄都聽從他們的命令。
english: And of the children of Issachar, there were two hundred chiefs, men who had expert knowledge of the times and what it was best for Israel to do, and all their brothers were under their orders.

chinese: 西布倫支派，能上陣用各樣兵器打仗、行伍整齊、不生二心的有五萬人。
english: Of Zebulun, there were fifty thousand men, who went out with the army, expert in ordering the fight, to give help with all sorts of arms; true-hearted men.

chinese: 拿弗他利支派，有一千軍長；跟從他們、拿盾牌和槍的有三萬七千人。
english: And of Naphtali, a thousand captains with thirty-seven thousand spearmen.

chinese: 但支派，能擺陣的有二萬八千六百人。
english: And of the Danites, twenty-eight thousand, six hundred, expert in ordering the fight.

chinese: 亞設支派，能上陣打仗的有四萬人。
english: And of Asher, forty thousand who went out with the army, expert in ordering the fight.

chinese: 約但河東的流便支派、迦得支派、瑪拿西半支派，拿著各樣兵器打仗的有十二萬人。
english: From the other side of Jordan, there were a hundred and twenty thousand of the Reubenites and the Gadites and the men of the half-tribe of Manasseh, armed with every sort of instrument of war.

chinese: 以上都是能守行伍的戰士，他們都誠心來到希伯崙，要立大衛作以色列的王。以色列其餘的人也都一心要立大衛作王。
english: All these men of war, expert in ordering the fight, came to Hebron with the full purpose of making David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel were united in their desire to make David king.

chinese: 他們在那裡三日，與大衛一同吃喝，因為他們的族弟兄給他們預備了。
english: For three days they were there with David, feasting at his table, for their brothers had made ready food for them.

chinese: 靠近他們的人以及以薩迦、西布倫、拿弗他利人將許多麵餅、無花果餅、乾葡萄、酒、油，用驢、駱駝、騾子、牛馱來，又帶了許多的牛和羊來，因為以色列人甚是歡樂。
english: And those who were near, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, came with food on asses and camels and mules and oxen, with meal for food and cakes of figs and masses of grapes, and wine and oil and oxen and sheep in great numbers, for there was joy in Israel.

chinese: 大衛與千夫長、百夫長，就是一切首領商議。
english: Then David had discussions with the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds and with every chief.

chinese: 大衛對以色列全會眾說：你們若以為美，見這事是出於耶和華─我們的神，我們就差遣人走遍以色列地，見我們未來的弟兄，又見住在有郊野之城的祭司利未人，使他們都到這裡來聚集。
english: And David said to all the men of Israel who had come together there, If it seems good to you and if it is the purpose of the Lord our God, let us send to all the rest of our brothers, everywhere in the land of Israel, and to the priests and the Levites in their towns and the country round them, and get them to come together here to us;

chinese: 我們要把神的約櫃運到我們這裡來；因為在掃羅年間，我們沒有在約櫃前求問　神。
english: And let us get back for ourselves the ark of our God: for in the days of Saul we did not go to it for directions.

chinese: 全會眾都說可以如此行；這事在眾民眼中都看為好。
english: And all the people said they would do so, for it seemed right to them.

chinese: 於是，大衛將以色列人從埃及的西曷河直到哈馬口都招聚了來，要從基列耶琳將神的約櫃運來。
english: So David sent for all Israel to come together, from Shihor, the river of Egypt, as far as the way into Hamath, to get the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

chinese: 大衛率領以色列眾人上到巴拉，就是屬猶大的基列耶琳，要從那裡將約櫃運來。這約櫃就是坐在二基路伯上耶和華神留名的約櫃。
english: And David went up, with all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim in Judah, to get up from there the ark of God, over which the holy Name is named, the name of the Lord whose place is between the winged ones.

chinese: 他們將神的約櫃從亞比拿達的家裡抬出來，放在新車上。烏撒和亞希約趕車。
english: And they put the ark of God on a new cart, and took it out of the house of Abinadab; and Uzza and Ahio were the drivers of the cart.

chinese: 大衛和以色列眾人在神前用琴、瑟、鑼、鼓、號作樂，極力跳舞歌唱。
english: Then David and all Israel made melody before God with all their strength, with songs and corded instruments of music, and with brass instruments and horns.

chinese: 到了基頓(撒下六章六節作拿艮)的禾場；因為牛失前蹄(或作驚跳)，烏撒就伸手扶住約櫃。
english: And when they came to the grain-floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to keep the ark in its place, for the oxen were slipping.

chinese: 耶和華向他發怒，因他伸手扶住約櫃擊殺他，他就死在神面前。
english: And the wrath of the Lord, burning against Uzza, sent destruction on him because he had put his hand on the ark, and death came to him there before God.

chinese: 大衛因耶和華擊殺(原文作闖殺)烏撒，心裡愁煩，就稱那地方為毗列斯烏撒，直到今日。
english: And David was angry because of the Lord's outburst of wrath against Uzza, and he gave that place the name Perez-uzza, to this day.

chinese: 那日，大衛懼怕神，說：　神的約櫃怎可運到我這裡來？
english: And so great was David's fear of God that day, that he said, How may I let the ark of God come to me?

chinese: 於是大衛不將約櫃運進大衛的城，卻運到迦特人俄別以東的家中。
english: So David did not let the ark come back to him to the town of David, but had it turned away and put into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

chinese: 神的約櫃在俄別以東家中三個月，耶和華賜福給俄別以東的家和他一切所有的。
english: And the ark of God was in the house of Obed-edom for three months; and the Lord sent a blessing on the house of Obed-edom and on all he had.

chinese: 推羅王希蘭將香柏木運到大衛那裡，又差遣使者和石匠、木匠給大衛建造宮殿。
english: And Hiram, king of Tyre, sent men to David with cedar-trees, and stoneworkers and woodworkers for the building of his house.

chinese: 大衛就知道耶和華堅立他作以色列王，又為自己的民以色列，使他的國興旺。
english: And David saw that the Lord had made his position safe as king over Israel, lifting up his kingdom on high because of his people Israel.

chinese: 大衛在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生兒女。
english: And while he was living in Jerusalem, David took more wives and became the father of more sons and daughters.

chinese: 在耶路撒冷所生的眾子是沙母亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門、
english: These are the names of the children he had in Jerusalem: Shammua and Shobab, Nathan and Solomon

chinese: 益轄、以利書亞、以法列、
english: And Ibhar and Elishua and Elpelet

chinese: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亞、
english: And Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia

chinese: 以利沙瑪、比利雅大、以利法列。
english: And Elishama and Beeliada and Eliphelet.

chinese: 非利士人聽見大衛受膏作以色列眾人的王，非利士眾人就上來尋索大衛。大衛聽見，就出去迎敵。
english: And when the Philistines had news that David had been made king over all Israel, they went up in search of David, and David, hearing of it, went out against them.

chinese: 非利士人來了，布散在利乏音谷。
english: Now the Philistines had come, and had gone out in every direction in the valley of Rephaim.

chinese: 大衛求問神，說：我可以上去攻打非利士人麼？你將他們交在我手裡麼？耶和華說：你可以上去，我必將他們交在你手裡。
english: And David, desiring directions from God, said, Am I to go up against the Philistines? and will you give them into my hands? And the Lord said, Go up; for I will give them into your hands.

chinese: 非利士人來到巴力毗拉心，大衛在那裡殺敗他們。大衛說：神藉我的手沖破敵人，如同水沖去一般；因此稱那地方為巴力毗拉心。
english: So they went up to Baal-perazim, and David overcame them there, and David said, God has let the forces fighting against me be broken by my hand, as a wall is broken down by rushing water; so they gave that place the name of Baal-perazim.

chinese: 非利士人將神像撇在那裡，大衛吩咐人用火焚燒了。
english: And the Philistines did not take their images with them in their flight; and at David's orders they were burned with fire.

chinese: 非利士人又布散在利乏音谷。
english: Then the Philistines again went out in every direction in the valley.

chinese: 大衛又求問神。　神說：不要一直地上去，要轉到他們後頭，從桑林對面攻打他們。
english: And David went for directions to God; and God said to him, You are not to go up after them; but, turning away from them, come face to face with them opposite the spice-trees.

chinese: 你聽見桑樹梢上有腳步的聲音，就要出戰，因為神已經在你前頭去攻打非利士人的軍隊。
english: And at the sound of footsteps in the tops of the trees, go out to the fight, for God has gone out before you to overcome the army of the Philistines.

chinese: 大衛就遵著神所吩咐的，攻打非利士人的軍隊，從基遍直到基色。
english: And David did as the Lord had said; and they overcame the army of the Philistines, attacking them from Gibeon as far as Gezer.

chinese: 於是大衛的名傳揚到列國，耶和華使列國都懼怕他。
english: And David's name was honoured in all lands; and the Lord put the fear of him on all nations.

chinese: 大衛在大衛城為自己建造宮殿，又為神的約櫃預備地方，支搭帳幕。
english: And David made houses for himself in the town of David; and he got ready a place for the ark of God, and put up a tent for it.

chinese: 那時大衛說：除了利未人之外，無人可抬神的約櫃；因為耶和華揀選他們抬　神的約櫃，且永遠事奉他。
english: Then David said, The ark of God may not be moved by any but the Levites, for they have been marked out by God to take the ark of God, and to do his work for ever.

chinese: 大衛招聚以色列眾人眾人到耶路撒冷，要將耶和華的約櫃抬到他所預備的地方。
english: And David made all Israel come together at Jerusalem, to take the ark of the Lord to its place, which he had got ready for it.

chinese: 大衛又聚集亞倫的子孫和利未人。
english: And David got together the sons of Aaron, and the Levites;

chinese: 哥轄子孫中有族長烏列和他的弟兄一百二十人。
english: Of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and twenty;

chinese: 米拉利子孫中有族長亞帥雅和他的弟兄二百二十人。
english: Of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, and his brothers, two hundred and twenty;

chinese: 革順子孫中有族長約珥和他的弟兄一百三十人。
english: Of the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and thirty;

chinese: 以利撒反子孫中有族長示瑪雅和他的弟兄二百人。
english: Of the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers, two hundred;

chinese: 希伯崙子孫中有族長以列和他的弟兄八十人。
english: Of the sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief, and his brothers, eighty;

chinese: 烏薛子孫中有族長亞米拿達和他的弟兄一百一十二人。
english: Of the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and twelve.

chinese: 大衛將祭司撒督和亞比亞他，並利未人烏列、亞帥雅、約珥、示瑪雅、以列、亞米拿達召來，
english: And David sent for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, Uriel, Asaiah and Joel, Shemaiah and Eliel and Amminadab,

chinese: 對他們說：你們是利未人的族長，你們和你們的弟兄應當自潔，好將耶和華─以色列神的約櫃抬到我所預備的地方。
english: And said to them, You are the heads of the families of the Levites: make yourselves holy, you and your brothers, so that you may take the ark of the Lord, the God of Israel, to the place which I have made ready for it.

chinese: 因你們先前沒有抬這約櫃，按定例求問耶和華─我們的神，所以他刑罰(原文作闖殺)我們。
english: For because you did not take it at the first, the Lord our God sent punishment on us, because we did not get directions from him in the right way.

chinese: 於是祭司利未人自潔，好將耶和華─以色列神的約櫃抬上來。
english: So the priests and the Levites made themselves holy to take up the ark of the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 利未子孫就用杠，肩抬神的約櫃，是照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的。
english: And the sons of the Levites took up the ark of God, lifting it by its rods, as the Lord had said to Moses.

chinese: 大衛吩咐利未人的族長，派他們歌唱的弟兄用琴瑟和鈸作樂，歡歡喜喜地大聲歌頌。
english: And David gave orders to the chief of the Levites to put their brothers the music-makers in position, with instruments of music, corded instruments and brass, with glad voices making sounds of joy.

chinese: 於是利未人派約珥的兒子希幔和他弟兄中比利家的兒子亞薩，並他們族弟兄米拉利子孫裡古沙雅的兒子以探。
english: So Heman, the son of Joel, and, of his brothers, Asaph, the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan, the son of Kushaiah, were put in position by the Levites;

chinese: 其次還有他們的弟兄撒迦利雅、便雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、烏尼、以利押、比拿雅、瑪西雅、瑪他提雅、以利斐利戶、彌克尼雅，並守門的俄別以東和耶利。
english: And with them their brothers of the second order, Zechariah, Bani and Jaaziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni, Eliab and Benaiah and Maaseiah and Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom and Jeiel, the door-keepers.

chinese: 這樣，派歌唱的希幔、亞薩、以探敲銅鈸，大發響聲；
english: So those who made melody, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were put in position, with brass instruments, sounding loudly;

chinese: 派撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、烏尼、以利押、瑪西雅、比拿雅鼓瑟，調用女音；
english: And Zechariah and Aziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel, Unni and Eliab and Maaseiah and Benaiah, with corded instruments put to Alamoth.

chinese: 又派瑪他提雅、以利斐利戶、彌克尼雅、俄別以東、耶利、亞撒西雅領首彈琴，調用第八。
english: And Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed-edom and Jeiel and Azaziah, with corded instruments on the octave, to give the first note of the song.

chinese: 利未人的族長基拿尼雅是歌唱人的首領，又教訓人歌唱，因為他精通此事。
english: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was master of the music: he gave directions about the song, because he was expert.

chinese: 比利家、以利加拿是約櫃前守門的。
english: And Berechiah and Elkanah were door-keepers for the ark.

chinese: 祭司示巴尼、約沙法、拿坦業、亞瑪賽、撒迦利雅、比拿亞、以利以謝在神的約櫃前吹號。俄別以東和耶希亞也是約櫃前守門的。
english: And Shebaniah and Joshaphat and Nethanel and Amasai and Zechariah and Benaiah and Eliezer, the priests, made music on the horns before the ark of God; and Obed-edom and Jehiah were door-keepers for the ark.

chinese: 於是，大衛和以色列的長老，並千夫長都去從俄別以東的家歡歡喜喜地將耶和華的約櫃抬上來。
english: So David, and the responsible men of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went with joy to get the ark of the agreement of the Lord out of the house of Obed-edom.

chinese: 神賜恩與抬耶和華約櫃的利未人，他們就獻上七隻公牛，七隻公羊。
english: And when God gave help to the Levites who were lifting up the ark of the agreement of the Lord, they made an offering of seven oxen and seven sheep.

chinese: 大衛和抬約櫃的利未人，並歌唱人的首領基拿尼雅，以及歌唱的人，都穿著細麻布的外袍；大衛另外穿著細麻布的以弗得。
english: And David was clothed with a robe of fair linen, as were all the Levites who took up the ark, and those who made melody, and Chenaniah the master of those who made melody; and David had on a linen ephod;

chinese: 這樣，以色列眾人歡呼吹角、吹號、敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，大發響聲，將耶和華的約櫃抬上來。
english: So all Israel took up the ark of the agreement of the Lord, with loud cries and with horns and brass and corded instruments sounding loudly.

chinese: 耶和華的約櫃進了大衛城的時候，掃羅的女兒米甲從窗戶裡觀看，見大衛王踴躍跳舞，心裡就輕視他。
english: And when the ark of the agreement of the Lord came into the town of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, looking out of the window, saw King David dancing and playing; and to her mind he seemed foolish.

chinese: 眾人將神的約櫃請進去，安放在大衛所搭的帳幕裡，就在　神面前獻燔祭和平安祭。
english: Then they took in the ark of God and put it inside the tent which David had put up for it; and they made offerings, burned offerings and peace-offerings before God.

chinese: 大衛獻完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉耶和華的名給民祝福，
english: And when David had come to an end of making the burned offerings and peace-offerings, he gave the people a blessing in the name of the Lord.

chinese: 並且分給以色列人，無論男女，每人一個餅，一塊肉，一個葡萄餅。
english: And he gave to everyone, every man and woman of Israel, a cake of bread, some meat, and a cake of dry grapes.

chinese: 大衛派幾個利未人在耶和華的約櫃前事奉，頌揚，稱謝，讚美耶和華─以色列的神：
english: And he put some of the Levites before the ark of the Lord as servants, to keep the acts of the Lord in memory, and to give worship and praise to the Lord, the God of Israel:

chinese: 為首的是亞薩，其次是撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、瑪他提雅、以利押、比拿雅、俄別以東、耶利，鼓瑟彈琴；惟有亞薩敲鈸，大發響聲；
english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Uzziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Mattithiah and Eliab and Benaiah and Obed-edom and Jeiel, with corded instruments of music; and Asaph, with brass instruments sounding loudly;

chinese: 祭司比拿雅和雅哈悉常在神的約櫃前吹號。
english: And Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests, blowing horns all the time before the ark of the agreement of God.

chinese: 那日，大衛初次藉亞薩和他的弟兄以詩歌稱頌耶和華，說：
english: Then on that day David first made the giving of praise to the Lord the work of Asaph and his brothers.

chinese: 你們要稱謝耶和華，求告他的名，在萬民中傳揚他的作為！
english: O give praise to the Lord; give honour to his name, talking of his doings among the peoples.

chinese: 要向他唱詩、歌頌，談論他一切奇妙的作為。
english: Let your voice be sounded in songs and melody; let all your thoughts be of the wonder of his works.

chinese: 要以他的聖名誇耀；尋求耶和華的人，心中應當歡喜。
english: Have glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who are searching after the Lord be glad.

chinese: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力，時常尋求他的面。
english: Let your search be for the Lord and for his strength; let your hearts ever be turned to him.

chinese: 他僕人以色列的後裔，他所揀選雅各的子孫哪，你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事，並他口中的判語。
english: Keep in mind the great works which he has done; his wonders, and the decisions of his mouth;
O you seed of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his loved ones.

chinese: 他是耶和華─我們的神，全地都有他的判斷。
english: He is the Lord our God: he is judge of all the earth.

chinese: 你們要記念他的約，直到永遠；他所吩咐的話，直到千代，
english: He has kept his agreement in mind for ever, the word which he gave for a thousand generations;

chinese: 就是與亞伯拉罕所立的約，向以撒所起的誓。
english: The agreement which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;

chinese: 他又將這約向雅各定為律例，向以色列定為永遠的約，
english: And he gave it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an eternal agreement;

chinese: 說：我必將迦南地賜給你，作你產業的分。
english: Saying, To you will I give the land of Canaan, the measured line of your heritage:

chinese: 當時你們人丁有限，數目稀少，並且在那地為寄居的；
english: When you were still small in number, and strange in the land;

chinese: 他們從這邦游到那邦，從這國行到那國。
english: When they went about from one nation to another, and from one kingdom to another people;

chinese: 耶和華不容甚麼人欺負他們，為他們的緣故責備君王，
english: He would not let anyone do them wrong; he even kept back kings because of them,

chinese: 說：不可難為我受膏的人，也不可惡待我的先知！
english: Saying, Put not your hand on those who have been marked with my holy oil, and do my prophets no wrong.

chinese: 全地都要向耶和華歌唱！天天傳揚他的救恩，
english: Make songs to the Lord, all the earth; give the good news of his salvation day by day.

chinese: 在列邦中述說他的榮耀，在萬民中述說他的奇事。
english: Make clear his glory to the nations, and his wonders to all the peoples.

chinese: 因耶和華為大，當受極大的讚美；他在萬神之上，當受敬畏。
english: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised; and he is more to be feared than all other gods.

chinese: 外邦的神都屬虛無，惟獨耶和華創造諸天。
english: For all the gods of the nations are false gods; but the Lord made the heavens.

chinese: 有尊榮和威嚴在他面前，有能力和喜樂在他聖所。
english: Honour and glory are before him: strength and joy are in his holy place.

chinese: 民中的萬族啊，你們要將榮耀能力歸給耶和華，都歸給耶和華！
english: Give to the Lord, O you families of the peoples, give to the Lord glory and strength.

chinese: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他，拿供物來奉到他面前；當以聖潔的(的或作為)妝飾敬拜耶和華。
english: Give to the Lord the glory of his name; take with you an offering and come before him; give worship to the Lord in holy robes.

chinese: 全地要在他面前戰抖，世界也堅定不得動搖。
english: Be in fear before him, all the earth: the world is ordered so that it may not be moved.

chinese: 願天歡喜，願地快樂；願人在列邦中說：耶和華作王了
english: Let the heavens have joy and let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, The Lord is King.

chinese: 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃；願田和其中所有的都歡樂。
english: Let the sea be thundering with all its waters; let the field be glad, and everything which is in it;

chinese: 那時，林中的樹木都要在耶和華面前歡呼，因為他來要審判全地。
english: Then let all the trees of the wood be sounding with joy before the Lord, for he is come to be the judge of the earth.

chinese: 應當稱謝耶和華；因他本為善，他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 要說：拯救我們的神啊，求你救我們，聚集我們，使我們脫離外邦，我們好稱讚你的聖名，以讚美你為誇勝。
english: And say, Be our saviour, O God of our salvation, and let us come back, and give us salvation from the nations, so that we may give honour to your holy name and have glory in your praise.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神，從亙古直到永遠，是應當稱頌的！眾民都說：阿們！並且讚美耶和華。
english: Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, for ever and for ever. And all the people said, So be it; and gave praise to the Lord.

chinese: 大衛派亞薩和他的弟兄在約櫃前常常事奉耶和華，一日盡一日的職分；
english: So he made Asaph and his brothers keep their places there before the ark of the agreement of the Lord, to do whatever had to be done before the ark at all times day by day:

chinese: 又派俄別以東和他的弟兄六十八人，與耶杜頓的兒子俄別以東，並何薩作守門的；
english: And Obed-edom, the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah, with their brothers, sixty-eight of them, to be door-keepers:

chinese: 且派祭司撒督和他弟兄眾祭司在基遍的邱壇、耶和華的帳幕前燔祭壇上，每日早晚，照著耶和華律法書上所吩咐以色列人的，常給耶和華獻燔祭。
english: And Zadok the priest, with his brothers the priests, before the House of the Lord in the high place at Gibeon;
To give burned offerings to the Lord on the altar of burned offerings morning and evening, every day, as it is ordered in the law of the Lord which he gave to Israel;

chinese: 與他們一同被派的有希幔、耶杜頓，和其餘被選名字錄在冊上的，稱謝耶和華，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were marked out by name to give praise to the Lord, for his mercy is unchanging for ever;

chinese: 希幔、耶杜頓同著他們吹號、敲鈸，大發響聲，並用別的樂器隨著歌頌神。耶杜頓的子孫作守門的。
english: And Heman and Jeduthun had horns and brass instruments sounding loudly, and instruments of music for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun were to be at the door.

chinese: 於是眾民各歸各家；大衛也回去為家眷祝福。
english: And all the people went away, every man to his house; and David went back to give a blessing to his family.

chinese: 大衛住在自己宮中，對先知拿單說：看哪，我住在香柏木的宮中，耶和華的約櫃反在幔子裡。
english: Now when David was living in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet, See, I am living in a house of cedar-wood, but the ark of the Lord's agreement is under the curtains of a tent.

chinese: 拿單對大衛說：你可以照你的心意而行，因為神與你同在。
english: And Nathan said to David, Do whatever is in your heart, for God is with you.

chinese: 當夜，神的話臨到拿單，說：
english: But that same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

chinese: 你去告訴我僕人大衛，說耶和華如此說：你不可建造殿宇給我居住。
english: Go and say to David my servant, The Lord says, You are not to make me a house for my living-place:

chinese: 自從我領以色列人出埃及，直到今日，我未曾住過殿宇，乃從這會幕到那會幕，從這帳幕到那帳幕。
english: For from the day when I took Israel up, till this day, I have had no house, but have gone from tent to tent, and from living-place to living-place.

chinese: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列的一個士師，就是我吩咐牧養我民的說：你為何不給我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？
english: In all the places where I have gone with all Israel, did I ever say to any of the judges of Israel, whom I made the keepers of my people, Why have you not made for me a house of cedar?

chinese: 現在你要告訴我僕人大衛，說萬軍之耶和華如此說：我從羊圈中將你召來，叫你不再跟從羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
english: So now, say to my servant David, The Lord of armies says, I took you from the fields, from keeping sheep, so that you might be a ruler over my people Israel;

chinese: 你無論往哪裡去，我常與你同在，剪除你的一切仇敵；我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一樣。
english: And I have been with you wherever you went, cutting off before you all those who were against you; and I will make your name like the name of the greatest ones of the earth.

chinese: 我必為我民以色列選定一個地方，栽培他們，使他們住自己的地方，不再遷移；凶惡之子也不像從前擾害他們，
english: And I will make a resting-place for my people Israel, planting them there, so that they may be in the place which is theirs and never again be moved; and never again will they be made waste by evil men, as they were at first,

chinese: 並不像我命士師治理我民以色列的時候一樣。我必治服你的一切仇敵，並且我─耶和華應許你，必為你建立家室。
english: From the time when I put judges over my people Israel; and I will overcome all those who are against you; and I will make you great and the head of a line of kings.

chinese: 你壽數滿足歸你列祖的時候，我必使你的後裔接續你的位，我也必堅定他的國。
english: And when the time comes for you to go to your fathers, I will put in your place your seed after you, one of your sons, and I will make his kingdom strong.

chinese: 他必為我建造殿宇；我必堅定他的國位直到永遠。
english: He will be the builder of my house, and I will make the seat of his authority certain for ever.

chinese: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；並不使我的慈愛離開他，像離開在你以前的掃羅一樣。
english: I will be to him a father and he will be to me a son; and I will not take my mercy away from him as I took it from him who was before you;

chinese: 我卻要將他永遠堅立在我家裡和我國裡；他的國位也必堅定，直到永遠。
english: But I will make his place in my house and in my kingdom certain for ever; and the seat of his authority will never be overturned.

chinese: 拿單就按這一切話，照這默示告訴大衛。
english: So Nathan gave David an account of all these words and this vision.

chinese: 於是大衛王進去，坐在耶和華面前，說：耶和華神啊，我是誰，我的家算甚麼，你竟使我到這地步呢？
english: Then David the king went in and took his seat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have been my guide till now?

chinese: 神啊，這在你眼中還看為小，又應許你僕人的家至於久遠。耶和華神啊，你看顧我好像看顧高貴的人。
english: And this was only a small thing to you, O God; but your words have even been about the far-off future of your servant's family, looking on me as on one of high position, O Lord God.

chinese: 你加於僕人的尊榮，我還有何言可說呢？因為你知道你的僕人。
english: What more may David say to you? for you have knowledge of your servant.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你行了這大事，並且顯明出來，是因你僕人的緣故，也是照你的心意。
english: O Lord, because of your servant, and from your heart, you have done all these great things and let them be seen.

chinese: 耶和華啊，照我們耳中聽見，沒有可比你的，除你以外再無神。
english: O Lord, there is no one like you, and no other God but you, as is clear from everything which has come to our ears.

chinese: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你神從埃及救贖他們作自己的子民，又在你贖出來的民面前行大而可畏的事，驅逐列邦人，顯出你的大名。
english: And what other nation in the earth, like your people Israel, did a god go out to take for himself, to be his people, making his name great and to be feared, driving out the nations from before your people whom you made free and took out of Egypt?

chinese: 你使以色列人作你的子民，直到永遠；你─耶和華也作他們的神。
english: For your people Israel you made yours for ever; and you, Lord, became their God.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你所應許僕人和僕人家的話，求你堅定，直到永遠，照你所說的而行。
english: And now, Lord, let your words about your servant and about his family be made certain for ever, and do as you have said.

chinese: 願你的名永遠堅立，被尊為大，說：萬軍之耶和華是以色列的神，是治理以色列的　神。這樣，你僕人大衛的家必在你面前堅立。
english: So let your words be made certain and your name be made great, when men say, The Lord of armies is the God of Israel; and when the family of David your servant is made strong before you.

chinese: 我的神啊，因你啟示僕人說，我必為你建立家室，所以僕人大膽在你面前祈禱。
english: For you, O my God, have let your servant see that you will make him head of a line of kings; and so it has come into your servant's heart to make his prayer to you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，惟有你是神，你也應許將這福氣賜給僕人。
english: And now, O Lord, you are God, and you have said you will give this good thing to your servant:

chinese: 現在你喜悅賜福與僕人的家，可以永存在你面前。耶和華啊，你已經賜福，還要賜福到永遠。
english: And now you have been pleased to give your blessing to the family of your servant, so that it may go on for ever before you; you, O Lord, have given your blessing, and a blessing will be on it for ever.

chinese: 此後，大衛攻打非利士人，把他們治服，從他們手下奪取了迦特和屬迦特的村莊；
english: And it came about after this that David made an attack on the Philistines and overcame them, and took Gath with its daughter-towns out of the hands of the Philistines.

chinese: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就歸服大衛，給他進貢。
english: And he overcame Moab, and the Moabites became his servants and gave him offerings.

chinese: 瑣巴王哈大利謝(撒下八章三節作哈大底謝)往伯拉河去，要堅定自己的國權，大衛就攻打他，直到哈馬，
english: Then David overcame Hadadezer, king of Zobah, near Hamath, when he was going to make his power seen by the river Euphrates.

chinese: 奪了他的戰車一千，馬兵七千，步兵二萬，將拉戰車的馬砍斷蹄筋，但留下一百輛車的馬。
english: And David took from him a thousand war-carriages and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand footmen: and he had the leg-muscles of all the horses cut, keeping only enough of them for a hundred war-carriages.

chinese: 大馬色的亞蘭人來幫助瑣巴王哈大利謝，大衛就殺了亞蘭人二萬二千。
english: And when the Aramaeans of Damascus came to the help of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, David put to the sword twenty-two thousand Aramaeans.

chinese: 於是大衛在大馬色的亞蘭地設立防營，亞蘭人就歸服他，給他進貢。大衛無論往哪裡去，耶和華都使他得勝。
english: Then David put armed forces in Damascus, and the Aramaeans became his servants and gave him offerings. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.

chinese: 他奪了哈大利謝臣僕所拿的金盾牌帶到耶路撒冷。
english: And the gold body-covers of the servants of Hadadezer, David took to Jerusalem.

chinese: 大衛又從屬哈大利謝的提巴(或作比他)和均二城中奪取了許多的銅。後來所羅門用此製造銅海、銅柱，和一切的銅器。
english: And from Tibhath and from Cun, towns of Hadadezer, David took a great store of brass, of which Solomon made the great brass water-vessel and the brass pillars and vessels.

chinese: 哈馬王陀烏聽見大衛殺敗瑣巴王哈大利謝的全軍，
english: Now when Tou, king of Hamath, had news that David had overcome all the army of Hadadezer, king of Zobah,

chinese: 就打發他兒子哈多蘭去見大衛王，問他的安，為他祝福，因為他殺敗了哈大利謝〈原來陀烏與哈大利謝常常爭戰〉。哈多蘭帶了金銀銅的各樣器皿來。
english: He sent his son Hadoram to King David, to give him words of peace and blessing, because he had overcome Hadadezer in the fight, for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou; and he gave him all sorts of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

chinese: 大衛王將這些器皿，並從各國奪來的金銀，就是從以東、摩押、亞捫、非利士、亞瑪力人所奪來的，都分別為聖獻給耶和華。
english: These King David made holy to the Lord, together with the silver and gold he had taken from all nations; from Edom and Moab and from the children of Ammon and from the Philistines and from Amalek.

chinese: 洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩在鹽谷擊殺了以東一萬八千人。
english: And when he came back from putting to the sword eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt,

chinese: 大衛在以東地設立防營，以東人就都歸服他。大衛無論往哪裡去，耶和華都使他得勝。
english: David put armed forces in all the towns of Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The Lord made David overcome wherever he went.

chinese: 大衛作以色列眾人的王，又向眾民秉公行義。
english: So David was king over all Israel, judging and giving right decisions for all his people.

chinese: 洗魯雅的兒子約押作元帥；亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官；
english: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the army; and Jehoshaphat, son of Ahilud, was keeper of the records.

chinese: 亞希突的兒子撒督和亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒作祭司長；沙威沙作書記；
english: And Zadok, the son of Ahitub; and Ahimelech, the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was the scribe;

chinese: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅統轄基利提人和比利提人。大衛的眾子都在王的左右作領袖。
english: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief of those whose places were at the king's side.

chinese: 此後，亞捫人的王拿轄死了，他兒子接續他作王。
english: Now it came about after this that death came to Nahash, the king of the children of Ammon, and his son became king in his place.

chinese: 大衛說：我要照哈嫩的父親拿轄厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。於是大衛差遣使者為他喪父安慰他。大衛的臣僕到了亞捫人的境內見哈嫩，要安慰他，
english: And David said, I will be a friend to Hanun, the son of Nahash, because his father was a friend to me. So David sent men to him, to give him words of comfort on account of his father. And the servants of David came to Hanun, to the land of the children of Ammon, offering him comfort.

chinese: 但亞捫人的首領對哈嫩說：大衛差人來安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父親麼？他的臣僕來見你不是為詳察窺探、傾覆這地麼？
english: But the chiefs of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Does it seem to you that David is honouring your father, by sending comforters to you? is it not clear that these men have only come to go through the land and to make secret observation of it so that they may overcome it?

chinese: 哈嫩便將大衛臣僕的鬍鬚剃去一半，又割斷他們下半截的衣服，使他們露出下體，打發他們回去。
english: So Hanun took David's servants, and cutting off their hair and the skirts of their robes up to the middle, sent them away.

chinese: 有人將臣僕所遇的事告訴大衛，他就差人去迎接他們，因為他們甚覺羞恥；告訴他們說：可以住在耶利哥，等到鬍鬚長起再回來。
english: Then certain men went and gave David word of what had been done to them. And he sent out with the purpose of meeting them; for the men were greatly shamed. And the king said, Keep where you are at Jericho till your hair is long again, and then come back.

chinese: 亞捫人知道大衛憎惡他們，哈嫩和亞捫人就打發人拿一千他連得銀子，從米所波大米、亞蘭、瑪迦、瑣巴雇戰車和馬兵，
english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves hated by David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver as payment for war-carriages and horsemen from Mesopotamia and Aram-maacah and Zobah.

chinese: 於是雇了三萬二千輛戰車和瑪迦王並他的軍兵；他們來安營在米底巴前。亞捫人也從他們的城裡出來，聚集交戰。
english: So with this money they got thirty-two thousand war-carriages, and the help of the king of Maacah and his people, who came and took up their position in front of Medeba. And the children of Ammon came together from their towns for the fight.

chinese: 大衛聽見了，就差派約押統帶勇猛的全軍出去。
english: And David, hearing of it, sent Joab with all the army of fighting-men.

chinese: 亞捫人出來在城門前擺陣，所來的諸王另在郊野擺陣。
english: So the children of Ammon came out and put their forces in position on the way into the town; and the kings who had come were stationed by themselves in the field.

chinese: 約押看見敵人在他前後擺陣，就從以色列軍中挑選精兵，使他們對著亞蘭人擺陣；
english: Now when Joab saw that their forces were in position against him in front and at his back, he took all the best men of Israel, and put them in line against the Aramaeans;

chinese: 其餘的兵交與他兄弟亞比篩，對著亞捫人擺陣。
english: And the rest of the people he put in position against the children of Ammon with Abishai, his brother, at their head.

chinese: 約押對亞比篩說：亞蘭人若強過我，你就來幫助我；亞捫人若強過你，我就去幫助你。
english: And he said, If the Aramaeans are stronger and get the better of me, then come to my help; and if the children of Ammon get the better of you, I will come to your help.

chinese: 我們都當剛強，為本國的民和神的城邑作大丈夫，願耶和華憑他的意旨而行。
english: Take heart, and let us be strong for our people and for the towns of our God; and may the Lord do what seems good to him.

chinese: 於是約押和跟隨他的人前進攻打亞蘭人；亞蘭人在約押面前逃跑。
english: So Joab and the people who were with him went forward into the fight against the Aramaeans, and they went in flight before him.

chinese: 亞捫人見亞蘭人逃跑，他們也在約押的兄弟亞比篩面前逃跑進城。約押就回耶路撒冷去了。
english: And when the children of Ammon saw the flight of the Aramaeans, they themselves went in flight from Abishai, his brother, and came into the town. Then Joab came back to Jerusalem.

chinese: 亞蘭人見自己被以色列人打敗，就打發使者將大河那邊的亞蘭人調來，哈大利謝的將軍朔法率領他們。
english: And when the Aramaeans saw that Israel had overcome them, they sent men to get the Aramaeans who were on the other side of the River, with Shophach, the captain of Hadadezer's army, at their head.

chinese: 有人告訴大衛，他就聚集以色列眾人過約但河，來到亞蘭人那裡，迎著他們擺陣。大衛既擺陣攻擊亞蘭人，亞蘭人就與他打仗。
english: And word of this was given to David; and he got all Israel together and went over Jordan and came to Helam and put his forces in position against them. And when David's forces were in position against the Aramaeans, the fight was started.

chinese: 亞蘭人在以色列人面前逃跑。大衛殺了亞蘭七千輛戰車的人，四萬步兵，又殺了亞蘭的將軍朔法。
english: And the Aramaeans went in flight before Israel; and David put to the sword the men of seven thousand Aramaean war-carriages and forty thousand footmen, and put to death Shophach, the captain of the army.

chinese: 屬哈大利謝的諸王見自己被以色列人打敗，就與大衛和好，歸服他。於是亞蘭人不敢再幫助亞捫人了。
english: And when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were overcome by Israel, they made peace with David and became his servants: and the Aramaeans would give no more help to the children of Ammon.

chinese: 過了一年，到列王出戰的時候，約押率領軍兵毀壞亞捫人的地，圍攻拉巴；大衛仍住在耶路撒冷。約押攻打拉巴，將城傾覆。
english: Now in the spring, at the time when kings go out to war, Joab went out at the head of the armed forces and made waste all the land of the Ammonites and put his men in position before Rabbah, shutting it in. But David was still at Jerusalem. And Joab took Rabbah and made it waste.

chinese: 大衛奪了亞捫人之王(王或作瑪勒堪。瑪勒堪即米勒公，是亞捫族之神名)所戴的金冠冕，其上的金子重一他連得，又嵌著寶石；人將這冠冕戴在大衛頭上。大衛從城裡奪了許多財物，
english: And David took the crown of Milcom from off his head; its weight was a talent of gold and it had stones of great price in it; and it was put on David's head, and he took a great store of goods from the town.

chinese: 將城裡的人拉出來，放在鋸下，或鐵耙下，或鐵斧下(或作強他們用鋸，或用打糧食的鐵器，或用鐵斧作工)，大衛待亞捫各城的居民都是如此。其後大衛和眾軍都回耶路撒冷去了。
english: And he took the people out of the town and put them to work with wood-cutting instruments, and iron grain-crushers, and axes. And this he did to all the towns of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people went back to Jerusalem.

chinese: 後來，以色列人在基色與非利士人打仗。戶沙人西比該殺了偉人的一個兒子細派，非利士人就被制伏了。
english: Now after this there was war with the Philistines at Gezer; then Sibbecai the Hushathite put to death Sippai, one of the offspring of the Rephaim; and they were overcome.

chinese: 又與非利士人打仗。睚珥的兒子伊勒哈難殺了迦特人歌利亞的兄弟拉哈米；這人的槍桿粗如織布的機軸。
english: And again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan, the son of Jair, put to death Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the stem of whose spear was like a cloth-worker's rod.

chinese: 又在迦特打仗。那裡有一個身量高大的人，手腳都是六指，共有二十四個指頭，他也是偉人的兒子。
english: And again there was war at Gath, where there was a very tall man, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six fingers on his hands and six toes on his feet; he was one of the offspring of the Rephaim.

chinese: 這人向以色列人罵陣，大衛的哥哥示米亞的兒子約拿單就殺了他。
english: And when he put shame on Israel, Jonathan, the son of Shimea, David's brother, put him to death.

chinese: 這三個人是迦特偉人的兒子，都死在大衛和他僕人的手下。
english: These were of the offspring of the Rephaim in Gath; they came to their death by the hands of David and his servants.

chinese: 撒但起來攻擊以色列人，激動大衛數點他們。
english: Now Satan, designing evil against Israel, put into David's mind the impulse to take the number of Israel.

chinese: 大衛就吩咐約押和民中的首領說：你們去數點以色列人，從別是巴直到但，回來告訴我，我好知道他們的數目。
english: And David said to Joab and the captains of the people, Now let all Israel, from Beer-sheba to Dan, be numbered; and give me word so that I may be certain of their number.

chinese: 約押說：願耶和華使他的百姓比現在加增百倍。我主我王啊，他們不都是你的僕人麼？我主為何吩咐行這事，為何使以色列人陷在罪裡呢？
english: And Joab said, May the Lord make his people a hundred times more in number than they are; but, my lord king, are they not all my lord's servants? why would my lord have this done? why will he become a cause of sin to Israel?

chinese: 但王的命令勝過約押。約押就出去，走遍以色列地，回到耶路撒冷，
english: But the king's word was stronger than Joab's. So Joab went out and went through all Israel and came to Jerusalem.

chinese: 將百姓的總數奏告大衛：以色列人拿刀的有一百一十萬；猶大人拿刀的有四十七萬。
english: And Joab gave David the number of all the people; all the men of Israel, able to take up arms, were one million, one hundred thousand men; and those of Judah were four hundred and seventy thousand men, able to take up arms.

chinese: 惟有利未人和便雅憫人沒有數在其中，因為約押厭惡王的這命令。
english: But Levi and Benjamin were not numbered among them, for Joab was disgusted with the king's order.

chinese: 神不喜悅這數點百姓的事，便降災給以色列人。
english: And God was not pleased with this thing; so he sent punishment on Israel.

chinese: 大衛禱告神說：我行這事大有罪了！現在求你除掉僕人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。
english: Then David said to God, Great has been my sin in doing this; but now, be pleased to take away the sin of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐大衛的先見迦得說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to Gad, David's seer, saying,

chinese: 你去告訴大衛說，耶和華如此說：我有三樣災，隨你選擇一樣，我好降與你。
english: Go and say to David, The Lord says, Three things are offered to you: say which of them you will have, so that I may do it to you.

chinese: 於是，迦得來見大衛，對他說：耶和華如此說：你可以隨意選擇：
english: So Gad came to David and said to him, The Lord says, Take whichever you will:

chinese: 或三年的饑荒；或敗在你敵人面前，被敵人的刀追殺三個月；或在你國中有耶和華的刀，就是三日的瘟疫，耶和華的使者在以色列的四境施行毀滅。現在你要想一想，我好回覆那差我來的。
english: Three years when there will not be enough food; or three months of war, when you will go in flight before your haters, being in great danger of the sword; or three days of the sword of the Lord, disease in the land, and the angel of the Lord taking destruction through all the land of Israel. Now give thought to the answer I am to take back to him who sent me.

chinese: 大衛對迦得說：我甚為難。我願落在耶和華的手裡，因為他有豐盛的憐憫；我不願落在人的手裡。
english: And David said to Gad, This is a hard decision for me to make: let me come into the hands of the Lord, for great are his mercies: let me not come into the hands of men.

chinese: 於是，耶和華降瘟疫與以色列人，以色列人就死了七萬。
english: So the Lord sent disease on Israel, causing the death of seventy thousand men.

chinese: 神差遣使者去滅耶路撒冷，剛要滅的時候，耶和華看見後悔，就不降這災了，吩咐滅城的天使說：夠了，住手罷！那時，耶和華的使者站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場那裡。
english: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem for its destruction: and when he was about to do so, the Lord saw, and had regret for the evil, and said to the angel of destruction, It is enough; do no more. Now the angel of the Lord was by the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

chinese: 大衛舉目，看見耶和華的使者站在天地間，手裡有拔出來的刀，伸在耶路撒冷以上。大衛和長老都身穿麻衣，面伏於地。
english: And David, lifting up his eyes, saw the angel of the Lord there between earth and heaven, with an uncovered sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the responsible men, clothed in haircloth, went down on their faces.

chinese: 大衛禱告神說：吩咐數點百姓的不是我麼？我犯了罪，行了惡，但這群羊做了甚麼呢？願耶和華─我　神的手攻擊我和我的父家，不要攻擊你的民，降瘟疫與他們。
english: And David said to God, Was it not I who gave the order for the people to be numbered? It is I who have done the sin and the great wrong; but these are only sheep; what have they done? let your hand, O Lord God, be lifted up against me and against my family, but not against your people to send disease on them.

chinese: 耶和華的使者吩咐迦得去告訴大衛，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場上為耶和華築一座壇；
english: Then the angel of the Lord gave orders to Gad to say to David that he was to go and put up an altar to the Lord on the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

chinese: 大衛就照著迦得奉耶和華名所說的話上去了。
english: And David went up, as Gad had said in the name of the Lord.

chinese: 那時阿珥楠正打麥子，回頭看見天使，就和他四個兒子都藏起來了。
english: And Ornan, turning back, saw the angel, and his four sons who were with him went to a secret place. Now Ornan was crushing his grain.

chinese: 大衛到了阿珥楠那裡，阿珥楠看見大衛，就從禾場上出去，臉伏於地，向他下拜。
english: And when David came, Ornan, looking, saw him, and came out from the grain-floor and went down on his face to the earth before him.

chinese: 大衛對阿珥楠說：你將這禾場與相連之地賣給我，我必給你足價，我好在其上為耶和華築一座壇，使民間的瘟疫止住。
english: Then David said to Ornan, Give me the place where this grain-floor is, so that I may put up an altar here to the Lord: let me have it for its full price; so that this disease may be stopped among the people.

chinese: 阿珥楠對大衛說：你可以用這禾場，願我主我王照你所喜悅的去行。我也將牛給你作燔祭，把打糧的器具當柴燒，拿麥子作素祭。這些我都送給你。
english: And Ornan said to David, Take it, and let my lord the king do what seems right to him. See, I give you the oxen for burned offerings and the grain-cleaning instruments for fire-wood, and the grain for the meal offering; I give it all.

chinese: 大衛王對阿珥楠說：不然！我必要用足價向你買。我不用你的物獻給耶和華，也不用白得之物獻為燔祭。
english: And King David said to Ornan, No; I will certainly give you the full price for it, because I will not take for the Lord what is yours, or give a burned offering without payment.

chinese: 於是大衛為那塊地平了六百舍客勒金子給阿珥楠。
english: So David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

chinese: 大衛在那裡為耶和華築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭，求告耶和華。耶和華就應允他，使火從天降在燔祭壇上。
english: And David put up an altar there to the Lord, offering burned offerings and peace-offerings with prayers to the Lord; and he gave him an answer from heaven, sending fire on the altar of burned offering.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。
english: Then the Lord gave orders to the angel, and he put back his sword into its cover.

chinese: 那時，大衛見耶和華在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場上應允了他，就在那裡獻祭。
english: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had given him an answer on the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he made an offering there.

chinese: 摩西在曠野所造之耶和華的帳幕和燔祭壇都在基遍的高處；
english: For the House of the Lord, which Moses had made in the waste land, and the altar of burned offerings, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

chinese: 只是大衛不敢前去求問神，因為懼怕耶和華使者的刀。
english: But David was not able to go before it to get directions from the Lord, so great was his fear of the sword of the angel of the Lord.

chinese: 大衛說：這就是耶和華神的殿，為以色列人獻燔祭的壇。
english: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar for Israel's burned offerings.

chinese: 大衛吩咐聚集住以色列地的外邦人，從其中派石匠鑿石頭，要建造神的殿。
english: And David gave orders to get together all the men from strange lands who were in the land of Israel; and he put stone-cutters to work, cutting stones for building the house of God.

chinese: 大衛預備許多鐵做門上的釘子和鉤子，又預備許多銅，多得無法可稱；
english: And he got together a great store of iron, for the nails for the doors and for the joins; and brass, more in weight than might be measured;

chinese: 又預備無數的香柏木，因為西頓人和推羅人給大衛運了許多香柏木來。
english: And cedar-trees without number, for the Zidonians and the men of Tyre came with a great amount of cedar-trees for David.

chinese: 大衛說：我兒子所羅門還年幼嬌嫩，要為耶和華建造的殿宇必須高大輝煌，使名譽榮耀傳遍萬國；所以我要為殿預備材料。於是，大衛在未死之先預備的材料甚多。
english: And David said, Solomon my son is young and untested, and the house which is to be put up for the Lord is to be very great, a thing of wonder and glory through all countries; so I will make ready what is needed for it. So David got ready a great store of material before his death.

chinese: 大衛召了他兒子所羅門來，囑咐他給耶和華─以色列的神建造殿宇，
english: Then he sent for his son Solomon, and gave him orders for the building of a house for the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 對所羅門說：我兒啊，我心裡本想為耶和華─我神的名建造殿宇，
english: And David said to Solomon, My son, it was my desire to put up a house for the name of the Lord my God.

chinese: 只是耶和華的話臨到我說：你流了多人的血，打了多次大仗，你不可為我的名建造殿宇，因為你在我眼前使多人的血流在地上。
english: But the word of the Lord came to me saying, You have taken lives without number and made great wars; I will not let you be the builder of a house for my name, because of the lives you have taken on the earth before my eyes.

chinese: 你要生一個兒子，他必作太平的人；我必使他安靜，不被四圍的仇敵擾亂。他的名要叫所羅門(即太平之意)。他在位的日子，我必使以色列人平安康泰。
english: But you will have a son who will be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from wars on every side. His name will be Solomon, and in his time I will give Israel peace and quiet;

chinese: 他必為我的名建造殿宇。他要作我的子；我要作他的父。他作以色列王；我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。
english: He will be the builder of a house for my name; he will be to me a son, and I will be to him a father; and I will make the seat of his rule over Israel certain for ever.

chinese: 我兒啊，現今願耶和華與你同在，使你亨通，照他指著你說的話，建造耶和華─你神的殿。
english: Now, my son, may the Lord be with you; and may you do well, and put up the house of the Lord your God, as he has said of you.

chinese: 但願耶和華賜你聰明智慧，好治理以色列國，遵行耶和華─你神的律法。
english: Only may the Lord give you wisdom, and knowledge of his orders for Israel, so that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.

chinese: 你若謹守遵行耶和華藉摩西吩咐以色列的律例典章，就得亨通。你當剛強壯膽，不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。
english: And all will go well for you, if you take care to keep the laws and the rules which the Lord gave to Moses for Israel: be strong and take heart; have no fear and do not be troubled.

chinese: 我在困難之中為耶和華的殿預備了金子十萬他連得，銀子一百萬他連得，銅和鐵多得無法可稱；我也預備了木頭、石頭，你還可以增添。
english: Now see, poor though I am, I have got ready for the house of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold and a million talents of silver; and a weight of brass and iron greater than may be measured; and wood and stone have I made ready, and you may put more to it.

chinese: 你有許多匠人，就是石匠、木匠，和一切能做各樣工的巧匠，
english: And you have a great number of workmen, cutters and workers of stone and wood, and experts in every sort of work,

chinese: 並有無數的金銀銅鐵。你當起來辦事，願耶和華與你同在。
english: In gold and silver and brass and iron more than may be numbered. Up! then, and to work; and may the Lord be with you.

chinese: 大衛又吩咐以色列的眾首領幫助他兒子所羅門，說：
english: Then David gave orders to all the chiefs of Israel to give their help to Solomon his son, saying,

chinese: 耶和華─你們的神不是與你們同在麼？不是叫你們四圍都平安麼？因他已將這地的居民交在我手中，這地就在耶和華與他百姓面前制伏了。
english: Is not the Lord your God with you? and has he not given you rest on every side? for the Lord has given the people of the land into my hands, and the land is overcome before the Lord and before his people.

chinese: 現在你們應當立定心意，尋求耶和華─你們的神；也當起來建造耶和華　神的聖所，好將耶和華的約櫃和供奉　神的聖器皿都搬進為耶和華名建造的殿裡。
english: Now give your heart and soul to the worship of the Lord your God; and get to work on the building of the holy place of the Lord God, so that you may put the ark of the Lord's agreement and the holy vessels of God in the house which is to be made for the name of the Lord.

chinese: 大衛年紀老邁，日子滿足，就立他兒子所羅門作以色列的王。
english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

chinese: 大衛招聚以色列的眾首領和祭司利未人。
english: And he got together all the chiefs of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

chinese: 利未人從三十歲以外的都被數點，他們男丁的數目共有三萬八千；
english: And the Levites, all those of thirty years old and over, were numbered; and the number of them, by heads, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

chinese: 其中有二萬四千人管理耶和華殿的事，有六千人作官長和士師，
english: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to be overseers of the work of the house of the Lord, and six thousand were judges and men of authority;

chinese: 有四千人作守門的，又有四千人用大衛所做的樂器頌讚耶和華。
english: Four thousand were door-keepers; and four thousand gave praise to the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, for giving praise.

chinese: 大衛將利未人革順、哥轄、米拉利的子孫分了班次。
english: And David put them into divisions under the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

chinese: 革順的子孫有拉但和示每。
english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

chinese: 拉但的長子是耶歇，還有細坦和約珥，共三人。
english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham and Joel, three.

chinese: 示每的兒子是示羅密、哈薛、哈蘭三人。這是拉但族的族長。
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth and Haziel and Haran, three; these were the heads of the families of Ladan.

chinese: 示每的兒子是雅哈、細拿、耶烏施、比利亞共四人。
english: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zizah and Jeush and Beriah; these four were the sons of Shimei.

chinese: 雅哈是長子，細撒是次子。但耶烏施和比利亞的子孫不多，所以算為一族。
english: Jahath was the chief and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah had only a small number of sons, so they were grouped together as one family.

chinese: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛共四人。
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

chinese: 暗蘭的兒子是亞倫、摩西。亞倫和他的子孫分出來，好分別至聖的物，在耶和華面前燒香、事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永遠。
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was made separate and holy, he and his sons for ever, for the care of the most holy things and the burning of offerings before the Lord, to do his work and give blessings in his name for ever.

chinese: 至於神人摩西，他的子孫名字記在利未支派的冊上。
english: And the sons of Moses, the man of God, were put into the list of the tribe of Levi.

chinese: 摩西的兒子是革舜和以利以謝。
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

chinese: 革舜的長子是細布業；
english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the first.

chinese: 以利以謝的兒子是利哈比雅。以利以謝沒有別的兒子，但利哈比雅的子孫甚多。
english: And the sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the first; and Eliezer had no other sons, but Rehabiah had a great number.

chinese: 以斯哈的長子是示羅密。
english: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the first.

chinese: 希伯倫的長子是耶利雅，次子是亞瑪利亞，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

chinese: 烏薛的長子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first, and Isshiah the second.

chinese: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示。抹利的兒子是以利亞撒、基士。
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

chinese: 以利亞撒死了，沒有兒子，只有女兒，他們本族基士的兒子娶了他們為妻。
english: And at his death Eleazar had no sons, but only daughters, and their relations, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

chinese: 母示的兒子是末力、以得、耶利摩共三人。
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli and Eder and Jeremoth, three.

chinese: 以上利未子孫作族長的，照著男丁的數目，從二十歲以外，都辦耶和華殿的事務。
english: These were the sons of Levi, grouped by families, the heads of the families of those who were numbered by name, by heads, all those of twenty years old and over who did the work of the house of the Lord.

chinese: 大衛說：耶和華─以色列的神已經使他的百姓平安，他永遠住在耶路撒冷。
english: For David said, The Lord, the God of Israel, has given his people rest, and he has made his resting-place in Jerusalem for ever;

chinese: 利未人不必再抬帳幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。
english: And from now, there will be no need for the House of the Lord, and the vessels used in it, to be moved about by the Levites.

chinese: 照著大衛臨終所吩咐的，利未人從二十歲以外的都被數點。
english: So among the last acts of David was the numbering of the sons of Levi, from twenty years old and over.

chinese: 他們的職任是服事亞倫的子孫，在耶和華的殿和院子，並屋中辦事，潔淨一切聖物，就是辦神殿的事務，
english: Their place was by the side of the sons of Aaron in all the work of the house of the Lord, in the open spaces and in the rooms, in the making clean of all the holy things, in doing all the work of the house of the Lord,

chinese: 並管理陳設餅，素祭的細麵，或無酵薄餅，或用盤烤，或用油調和的物，又管理各樣的升斗尺度；
english: The holy bread was in their care, and the crushed grain for the meal offering, of unleavened cakes or meal cooked over the fire or in water; they had control of all sorts of weights and measures;

chinese: 每日早晚，站立稱謝讚美耶和華，
english: They had to take their places every morning to give praise and make melody to the Lord, and in the same way at evening;

chinese: 又在安息日、月朔，並節期，按數照例，將燔祭常常獻給耶和華；
english: At every offering of burned offerings to the Lord, on Sabbaths, and at the new moons, and on the regular feasts, in the number ordered by the law, at all times before the Lord;

chinese: 又看守會幕和聖所，並守耶和華吩咐他們弟兄亞倫子孫的，辦耶和華殿的事。
english: And they had the care of the Tent of meeting and the holy place, under the direction of the sons of Aaron their brothers, for the work of the house of the Lord.

chinese: 亞倫子孫的班次記在下面：亞倫的兒子是拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
english: Now the divisions into which the sons of Aaron were grouped were these: the sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

chinese: 拿答、亞比戶死在他們父親之先，沒有留下兒子；故此，以利亞撒、以他瑪供祭司的職分。
english: But Nadab and Abihu came to their end before their father, and had no children; so Eleazar and Ithamar did the work of priests.

chinese: 以利亞撒的子孫撒督和以他瑪的子孫亞希米勒，同著大衛將他們的族弟兄分成班次。
english: And David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, made distribution of them into their positions for their work.

chinese: 以利亞撒子孫中為首的比以他瑪子孫中為首的更多，分班如下：以利亞撒的子孫中有十六個族長，以他瑪的子孫中有八個族長；
english: And there were more chiefs among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar; and this is how they were grouped: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, all heads of families; and of the sons of Ithamar, heads of families, there were eight.

chinese: 都掣籤分立，彼此一樣。在聖所和神面前作首領的有以利亞撒的子孫，也有以他瑪的子孫。
english: So they were put into groups, by the Lord's decision, one with another; for there were rulers of the holy place and rulers of the house of God among the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar.

chinese: 作書記的利未人拿坦業的兒子示瑪雅在王和首領，與祭司撒督、亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒，並祭司利未人的族長面前記錄他們的名字。在以利亞撒的子孫中取一族，在以他瑪的子孫中取一族。
english: And Shemaiah, the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was a Levite, put down their names in writing, the king being present with the rulers, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech, the son of Abiathar, and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites; one family being taken for Eleazar and then one for Ithamar, and so on.

chinese: 掣籤的時候，第一掣出來的是耶何雅立，第二是耶大雅，
english: Now the first name to come out was that of Jehoiarib; the second Jedaiah,

chinese: 第三是哈琳，第四是梭琳，
english: The third Harim, the fourth Seorim,

chinese: 第五是瑪基雅，第六是米雅民，
english: The fifth Malchijah, the sixth Mijamin,

chinese: 第七是哈歌斯，第八是亞比雅，
english: The seventh Hakkoz, the eighth Abijah,

chinese: 第九是耶書亞，第十是示迦尼，
english: The ninth Jeshua, the tenth Shecaniah,

chinese: 第十一是以利亞實，第十二是雅金，
english: The eleventh Eliashib, the twelfth Jakim,

chinese: 第十三是胡巴，第十四是耶是比押，
english: The thirteenth Huppah, the fourteenth Jeshebeab,

chinese: 第十五是璧迦，第十六是音麥，
english: The fifteenth Bilgah, the sixteenth Immer,

chinese: 第十七是希悉，第十八是哈闢悉，
english: The seventeenth Hezir, the eighteenth Happizzez,

chinese: 第十九是毗他希雅，第二十是以西結，
english: The nineteenth Pethahiah, the twentieth Jehezkel,

chinese: 第二十一是雅斤，第二十二是迦末，
english: The twenty-first Jachin, the twenty-second Gamul,

chinese: 第二十三是第來雅，第二十四是瑪西亞。
english: The twenty-third Delaiah, the twenty-fourth Maaziah.

chinese: 這就是他們的班次，要照耶和華─以色列的神藉他們祖宗亞倫所吩咐的條例進入耶和華的殿辦理事務。
english: So they were put into their different groups, to take their places in the house of the Lord, in agreement with the rules made by Aaron their father, as the Lord, the God of Israel, had given him orders.

chinese: 利未其餘的子孫如下：暗蘭的子孫裡有書巴業；書巴業的子孫裡有耶希底亞。
english: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

chinese: 利哈比雅的子孫裡有長子伊示雅。
english: Of Rehabiah; of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

chinese: 以斯哈的子孫裡有示羅摩；示羅摩的子孫裡有雅哈。
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

chinese: 希伯倫的子孫裡有長子耶利雅，次子亞瑪利亞，三子雅哈悉，四子耶加面。
english: And the sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

chinese: 烏薛的子孫裡有米迦；米迦的子孫裡有沙密。
english: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

chinese: 米迦的兄弟是伊示雅；伊示雅的子孫裡有撒迦利雅。
english: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

chinese: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示、雅西雅；雅西雅的兒子有比挪；
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah.

chinese: 米拉利的子孫裡有雅西雅的兒子比挪、朔含、撒刻、伊比利。
english: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Shoham and Zaccur and Ibri.

chinese: 抹利的兒子是以利亞撒；以利亞撒沒有兒子。
english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

chinese: 基士的子孫裡有耶拉篾。
english: Of Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.

chinese: 母示的兒子是末力、以得、耶利摩。按著宗族這都是利未的子孫。
english: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli and Eder and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites by their families.

chinese: 他們在大衛王和撒督，並亞希米勒與祭司利未人的族長面前掣籤，正如他們弟兄亞倫的子孫一般。各族的長者與兄弟沒有分別。
english: Selection was made of these in the same way as of their brothers the sons of Aaron, David the king being present, with Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites; the families of the chief in the same way as those of his younger brother.

chinese: 大衛和眾首領分派亞薩、希幔，並耶杜頓的子孫彈琴、鼓瑟、敲鈸、唱歌(原文作說預言；本章同)。他們供職的人數記在下面：
english: Further, David and the chiefs of the servants of the holy place made selection of certain of the sons of Asaph and of Heman and of Jeduthun for the work of prophets, to make melody with corded instruments and brass; and the number of the men for the work they had to do was:

chinese: 亞薩的兒子撒刻、約瑟、尼探雅、亞薩利拉都歸亞薩指教，遵王的旨意唱歌。
english: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur and Joseph and Nethaniah and Asharelah, sons of Asaph; under the direction of Asaph, acting as a prophet under the orders of the king;

chinese: 耶杜頓的兒子基大利、西利、耶篩亞、哈沙比雅、瑪他提雅、示每共六人，都歸他們父親耶杜頓指教，彈琴，唱歌，稱謝，頌讚耶和華。
english: Of Jeduthun: the six sons of Jeduthun, Gedaliah and Zeri and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah and Mattithiah; under the direction of their father Jeduthun who, acting as a prophet, with corded instruments gave praise and glory to the Lord.

chinese: 希幔的兒子布基雅、瑪探雅、烏薛、細布業、耶利摩、哈拿尼雅、哈拿尼、以利亞他、基大利提、羅幔提•以謝、約施比加沙、瑪羅提、何提、瑪哈秀；
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth;

chinese: 這都是希幔的兒子，吹角頌讚。希幔奉神之命作王的先見。　神賜給希幔十四個兒子，三個女兒，
english: All these were sons of Heman, the king's seer in the words of God. And to make great his power God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

chinese: 都歸他們父親指教，在耶和華的殿唱歌、敲鈸、彈琴、鼓瑟，辦神殿的事務。亞薩、耶杜頓、希幔都是王所命定的。
english: All these, under the direction of their father, made music in the house of the Lord, with brass and corded instruments, for the worship of the house of God; Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the orders of the king.

chinese: 他們和他們的弟兄學習頌讚耶和華；善於歌唱的共有二百八十八人。
english: And the number of them, with their brothers who were trained and expert in making melody to the Lord, was two hundred and eighty-eight.

chinese: 這些人無論大小，為師的、為徒的，都一同掣籤分了班次。
english: And selection was made of them for their special work, all having equal chances, small as well as great, the teacher as the learner.

chinese: 掣籤的時候，第一掣出來的是亞薩的兒子約瑟。第二是基大利；他和他弟兄並兒子共十二人。
english: Now of the group of Asaph, the first name to come out was Joseph; the second Gedaliah; he and his brothers and sons were twelve?

chinese: 第三是撒刻；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The third Zaccur, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第四是伊洗利；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
