english: The fourth Izri, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第五是尼探雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The fifth Nethaniah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第六是布基雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The sixth Bukkiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第七是耶薩利拉；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The seventh Jesharelah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第八是耶篩亞；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The eighth Jeshaiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第九是瑪探雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The ninth Mattaniah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十是示每；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The tenth Shimei, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十一是亞薩烈；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The eleventh Azarel, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十二是哈沙比雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The twelfth Hashabiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十三是書巴業；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The thirteenth Shubael, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十四是瑪他提雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The fourteenth Mattithiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十五是耶利摩；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The fifteenth Jeremoth, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十六是哈拿尼雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The sixteenth Hananiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十七是約施比加沙；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The seventeenth Joshbekashah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十八是哈拿尼；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The eighteenth Hanani, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第十九是瑪羅提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The nineteenth Mallothi, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第二十是以利亞他；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The twentieth Eliathah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第二十一是何提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The twenty-first Hothir, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第二十二是基大利提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The twenty-second Giddalti, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第二十三是瑪哈秀；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The twenty-third Mahazioth, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

chinese: 第二十四是羅幔提•以謝；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
english: The twenty-fourth Romamti-ezer, with his sons and his brothers, twelve.

chinese: 守門的班次記在下面：可拉族亞薩的子孫中，有可利的兒子米施利米雅。
english: For the divisions of the door-keepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah, the son of Kore, of the sons of Ebiasaph.

chinese: 米施利米雅的長子是撒迦利亞，次子是耶疊，三子是西巴第雅，四子是耶提聶，
english: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the oldest, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

chinese: 五子是以攔，六子是約哈難，七子是以利約乃。
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.

chinese: 俄別以東的長子是示瑪雅，次子是約薩拔，三子是約亞，四子是沙甲，五子是拿坦業，
english: And Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the oldest, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth,

chinese: 六子是亞米利，七子是以薩迦，八子是毗烏利太，因為神賜福與俄別以東。
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for the blessing of God was on him.

chinese: 他的兒子示瑪雅有幾個兒子，都是大能的壯士，掌管父親的家。
english: And Shemaiah his son had sons, rulers over the family of their father, for they were able men.

chinese: 示瑪雅的兒子是俄得尼、利法益、俄備得、以利薩巴。以利薩巴的弟兄是壯士，還有以利戶和西瑪迦。
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni and Rephael and Obed, Elzabad, whose brothers were great men of war, Elihu and Semachiah.

chinese: 這都是俄別以東的子孫，他們和他們的兒子並弟兄，都是善於辦事的壯士。俄別以東的子孫共六十二人。
english: All these were sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brothers, able men and strong for the work; sixty-two sons of Obed-edom.

chinese: 米施利米雅的兒子和弟兄都是壯士，共十八人。
english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen able men.

chinese: 米拉利子孫何薩有幾個兒子：長子是申利，他原不是長子，是他父親立他作長子。
english: And Hosah, a son of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the oldest, his father made him chief);

chinese: 次子是希勒家，三子是底巴利雅，四子是撒迦利亞。何薩的兒子並弟兄共十三人。
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: Hosah had thirteen sons and brothers.

chinese: 這些人都是守門的班長，與他們的弟兄一同在耶和華殿裡按班供職。
english: Of these were the divisions of the door-keepers, men of authority, having responsible positions like their brothers to be servants in the house of the Lord.

chinese: 他們無論大小，都按著宗族掣籤分守各門。
english: And the families were taken by the decision of the Lord for every door; the small family had the same chance as the great.

chinese: 掣籤守東門的是示利米雅；他的兒子撒迦利亞是精明的謀士，掣籤守北門。
english: And the care of the door on the east came out for Shelemiah. Then the name of Zechariah his son, a man wise in discussion, came out, and the door on the north was given to him.

chinese: 俄別以東守南門，他的兒子守庫房。
english: To Obed-edom, that on the south; and to his sons, the store-house.

chinese: 書聘與何薩守西門，在靠近沙利基門、通著往上去的街道上，班與班相對。
english: To Hosah, the door on the west, by the door of Shallecheth, at the footway which goes up, watch by watch.

chinese: 每日東門有六個利未人，北門有四個，南門有四個，庫房有兩個，又有兩個輪班替換。
english: On the east were six Levites a day, and on the north and the south four a day, and for the store-house two and two.

chinese: 在西面街道上有四個，在遊廊上有兩個。
english: For the pillared way, on the west, four at the footway and two at the pillared way itself.

chinese: 以上是可拉子孫和米拉利子孫守門的班次。
english: These were the divisions of door-keepers, of the sons of the Korahites and of the sons of Merari.

chinese: 利未子孫中有亞希雅掌管神殿的府庫和聖物的府庫。
english: And the Levites their brothers were responsible for the stores of the house of God and the holy things.

chinese: 革順族、拉但子孫裡，作族長的是革順族拉但的子孫耶希伊利。
english: The sons of Ladan: sons of the Gershonites of the family of Ladan, heads of families of Ladan the Gershonite, Jehieli.

chinese: 耶希伊利的兒子西坦和他兄弟約珥掌管耶和華殿裡的府庫。
english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham and Joel, his brother, had the care of the stores of the house of the Lord.

chinese: 暗蘭族、以斯哈族、希伯倫族、烏泄族也有職分。
english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

chinese: 摩西的孫子、革舜的兒子細布業掌管府庫。
english: And Shebuel, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was controller of the stores.

chinese: 還有他的弟兄以利以謝。以利以謝的兒子是利哈比雅；利哈比雅的兒子是耶篩亞；耶篩亞的兒子是約蘭；約蘭的兒子是細基利；細基利的兒子是示羅密。
english: And his brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

chinese: 這示羅密和他的弟兄掌管府庫的聖物，就是大衛王和眾族長、千夫長、百夫長，並軍長所分別為聖的物。
english: Shelomoth and his brothers were responsible for all the store of holy things which David the king and the heads of families, the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and the captains of the army, had given to the Lord.

chinese: 他們將爭戰時所奪的財物分別為聖，以備修造耶和華的殿。
english: From the goods taken in war, they gave, as a holy offering, materials for the building of the house of the Lord.

chinese: 先見撒母耳、基士的兒子掃羅、尼珥的兒子押尼珥、洗魯雅的兒子約押所分別為聖的物都歸示羅密和他的弟兄掌管。
english: And everything Samuel the prophet and Saul, the son of Kish, and Abner, the son of Ner, and Joab, the son of Zeruiah, had made holy; whatever anyone had given, it was under the care of Shelomoth and his brothers.

chinese: 以斯哈族有基拿尼雅和他眾子作官長和士師，管理以色列的外事。
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons had to do all the public business of Israel, in relation to judges and men in authority.

chinese: 希伯倫族有哈沙比雅和他弟兄一千七百人，都是壯士，在約但河西、以色列地辦理耶和華與王的事。
english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, seventeen hundred able men, were overseers of Israel on the other side of the Jordan, to the west, being responsible for all the work of the Lord's house and for the work done by the king's servants.

chinese: 希伯倫族中有耶利雅作族長。大衛作王第四十年，在基列的雅謝，從這族中尋得大能的勇士。
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of all the Hebronites, in their generations by families. In the fortieth year of the rule of David a search was made, and able men were seen among them at Jazer of Gilead.

chinese: 耶利雅的弟兄有二千七百人，都是壯士，且作族長；大衛王派他們在流便支派、迦得支派、瑪拿西半支派中辦理神和王的事。
english: And his brothers were two thousand, seven hundred able men, heads of families, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, in everything to do with God, and for the king's business.

chinese: 以色列人的族長、千夫長、百夫長，和官長都分定班次，每班是二萬四千人，週年按月輪流，替換出入服事王。
english: Now the number of the children of Israel, that is, the heads of families, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and the men in authority who were servants of the king in anything to do with the divisions which came in and went out month by month through all the months of the year, in every division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 正月第一班的班長是撒巴第業的兒子雅朔班；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: Over the first division for the first month was Ishbaal, the son of Zabdiel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 他是法勒斯的子孫，統管正月班的一切軍長。
english: He was of the sons of Perez, and the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

chinese: 二月的班長是亞哈希人朵代，還有副官密基羅；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: And over the division for the second month was Eleazar, the son of Dodai the Ahohite, the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 三月第三班的班長(原文作軍長；下同)是祭司耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the priest; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 這比拿雅是那三十人中的勇士，管理那三十人；他班內又有他兒子暗米薩拔。
english: This is the same Benaiah who was the great man of the thirty, chief of the thirty; and in his division was Ammizabad his son.

chinese: 四月第四班的班長是約押的兄弟亞撒黑。接續他的是他兒子西巴第雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel, the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 五月第五班的班長是伊斯拉人珊合；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 六月第六班的班長是提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira, the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 七月第七班的班長是以法蓮族比倫人希利斯；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the sons of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 八月第八班的班長是謝拉族戶沙人西比該；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 九月第九班的班長是便雅憫族亞拿突人亞比以謝；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 十月第十班的班長是謝拉族尼陀法人瑪哈萊；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 十一月第十一班的班長是以法蓮族比拉頓人比拿雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the sons of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 十二月第十二班的班長是俄陀聶族尼陀法人黑玳；他班內有二萬四千人。
english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

chinese: 管理以色列眾支派的記在下面：管流便人的是細基利的兒子以利以謝；管西緬人的是瑪迦的兒子示法提雅；
english: And over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer, the son of Zichri; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah, the son of Maacah;

chinese: 管利未人的是基母利的兒子哈沙比雅；管亞倫子孫的是撒督；
english: Of Levi, Hashabiah, the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

chinese: 管猶大人的是大衛的一個哥哥以利戶，管以薩迦人的是米迦勒的兒子暗利；
english: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri, the son of Michael;

chinese: 管西布倫人的是俄巴第雅的兒子伊施瑪雅；管拿弗他利人的是亞斯列的兒子耶利摩；
english: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah, the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jerimoth, the son of Azriel;

chinese: 管以法蓮人的是阿撒細雅的兒子何細亞；管瑪拿西半支派的是毗大雅的兒子約珥；
english: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea, the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel, the son of Pedaiah;

chinese: 管基列地瑪拿西那半支派的是撒迦利亞的兒子易多；管便雅憫人的是押尼珥的兒子雅西業；
english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo, the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel, the son of Abner;

chinese: 管但人的是耶羅罕的兒子亞薩列。以上是以色列眾支派的首領。
english: Of Dan, Azarel, the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

chinese: 以色列人二十歲以內的，大衛沒有記其數目；因耶和華曾應許說，必加增以色列人如天上的星那樣多。
english: But David did not take the number of those who were under twenty years old, for the Lord had said that he would make Israel like the stars of heaven in number.

chinese: 洗魯雅的兒子約押動手數點，當時耶和華的烈怒臨到以色列人；因此，沒有點完，數目也沒有寫在大衛王記上。
english: The numbering was started by Joab, the son of Zeruiah, but he did not go on to the end; and because of it, wrath came on Israel and the number was not recorded in the history of King David.

chinese: 掌管王府庫的是亞疊的兒子押斯馬威。掌管田野城邑村莊保障之倉庫的是烏西雅的兒子約拿單。
english: And Azmaveth, the son of Adiel, was controller of the king's property; Jonathan, the son of Uzziah, had control of all store-houses in country places and in the towns and little towns and strong places;

chinese: 掌管耕田種地的是基綠的兒子以斯利。
english: Ezri, the son of Chelub, had authority over the field-workers and farmers;

chinese: 掌管葡萄園的是拉瑪人示每。掌管葡萄園酒窖的是實弗米人撒巴底。
english: Shimei the Ramathite was responsible for the vine-gardens; Zabdi the Shiphmite was responsible for the produce of the vine-gardens and for all the stores of wine;

chinese: 掌管高原橄欖樹和桑樹的是基第利人巴勒哈南。掌管油庫的是約阿施。
english: Baal-hanan the Gederite was responsible for the olive-trees and the sycamore-trees in the lowlands; and Joash for the stores of oil;

chinese: 掌管沙崙牧放牛群的是沙崙人施提賚。掌管山谷牧養牛群的是亞第賚的兒子沙法。
english: And Shitrai the Sharonite was responsible for the herds in the grass-lands of Sharon, and Shaphat, the son of Adlai, for those in the valleys;

chinese: 掌管駝群的是以實瑪利人阿比勒。掌管驢群的是米崙人耶希底亞。掌管羊群的是夏甲人雅悉。
english: Obil the Ishmaelite had control of the camels and Jehdeiah the Meronothite of the she-asses;

chinese: 這都是給大衛王掌管產業的。
english: The flocks were in the care of Jaziz the Hagarite. All these were the controllers of King David's property.

chinese: 大衛的叔叔約拿單作謀士；這人有智慧，又作書記。哈摩尼的兒子耶歇作王眾子的師傅。
english: Now Jonathan, David's father's brother, expert in discussion, and a man of good sense, was a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni, had the care of the king's sons;

chinese: 亞希多弗也作王的謀士。亞基人戶篩作王的陪伴。
english: And Ahithophel was the king's expert in discussion and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.

chinese: 亞希多弗之後，有比拿雅的兒子耶何耶大和亞比亞他接續他作謀士。約押作王的元帥。
english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada, the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar; and the captain of the king's army was Joab.

chinese: 大衛招聚以色列各支派的首領和輪班服事王的軍長，與千夫長、百夫長，掌管王和王子產業牲畜的，並太監，以及大能的勇士，都到耶路撒冷來。
english: And David got together at Jerusalem all the rulers of Israel, the chiefs of the tribes and the captains of the divisions waiting on the king in turn, and the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds and the controllers of all the goods and property of the king and his sons, with the unsexed servants and the great men of war.

chinese: 大衛王就站起來，說：我的弟兄，我的百姓啊，你們當聽我言，我心裡本想建造殿宇，安放耶和華的約櫃，作為我神的腳凳；我已經預備建造的材料。
english: Then David the king got up and said, Give ear to me, my brothers and my people; it was my desire to put up a house, a resting-place for the ark of the Lord's agreement, and for the foot-rest of our God; and I had got material ready for the building of it.

chinese: 只是神對我說：你不可為我的名建造殿宇；因你是戰士，流了人的血。
english: But God said to me, You are not to be the builder of a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have taken life;

chinese: 然而，耶和華─以色列的神在我父的全家揀選我作以色列的王，直到永遠。因他揀選猶大為首領；在猶大支派中揀選我父家，在我父的眾子裡喜悅我，立我作以色列眾人的王。
english: Though the Lord, the God of Israel, took me out of all my father's family, to be king over Israel for ever, marking out Judah to be chief, and, of the people of Judah, my father's family; and among the sons of my father he was pleased to make me king over all Israel;

chinese: 耶和華賜我許多兒子，在我兒子中揀選所羅門坐耶和華的國位，治理以色列人。
english: And of all my sons (for the Lord has given me a great number of sons) he has made selection of Solomon to take his place on the seat of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

chinese: 耶和華對我說：你兒子所羅門必建造我的殿和院宇；因為我揀選他作我的子，我也必作他的父。
english: And he said to me, Solomon your son will be the builder of my house and the open spaces round it; for I have taken him to be my son, and I will be his father.

chinese: 他若恆久遵行我的誡命典章如今日一樣，我就必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。
english: I will keep his kingdom in its place for ever, if he is strong at all times to do my orders and keep my rules, as at this day.

chinese: 現今在耶和華的會中，以色列眾人眼前所說的，我們的神也聽見了。你們應當尋求耶和華─你們　神的一切誡命，謹守遵行，如此你們可以承受這美地，遺留給你們的子孫，永遠為業。
english: So now, before the eyes of all Israel, the people of the Lord, and in the hearing of our God, keep and be true to the orders of the Lord your God; so that you may have this good land for yourselves and give it for a heritage to your children after you for ever.

chinese: 我兒所羅門哪，你當認識耶和華─你父的神，誠心樂意地事奉他；因為他鑒察眾人的心，知道一切心思意念。你若尋求他，他必使你尋見；你若離棄他，他必永遠丟棄你。
english: And you, Solomon my son, get knowledge of the God of your father, and be his servant with a true heart and with a strong desire, for the Lord is the searcher of all hearts, and has knowledge of all the designs of men's thoughts; if you make search for him, he will be near you; but if you are turned away from him, he will give you up for ever.

chinese: 你當謹慎，因耶和華揀選你建造殿宇作為聖所。你當剛強去行。
english: Now then, take note; for the Lord has made selection of you to be the builder of a house for the holy place. Be strong and do it.

chinese: 大衛將殿的遊廊、旁屋、府庫、樓房、內殿，和施恩所的樣式指示他兒子所羅門，
english: Then David gave to his son Solomon the design of the doorway of the house of God and of its houses and its store-houses, and the higher rooms and the inner rooms and the place for the mercy-seat;

chinese: 又將被靈感動所得的樣式，就是耶和華神殿的院子、周圍的房屋、殿的府庫，和聖物府庫的一切樣式都指示他；
english: And the design of all he had in his heart for the outer squares of the house of the Lord, and for the rooms all round it, and for the store-houses of the house of the Lord, and for the store-houses for the holy things;

chinese: 又指示他祭司和利未人的班次與耶和華殿裡各樣的工作，並耶和華殿裡一切器皿的樣式，
english: And for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work in connection with the worship of the house of the Lord, and all the vessels used in the house of the Lord;

chinese: 以及各樣應用金器的分兩和各樣應用銀器的分兩，
english: Of gold, by weight, for the vessels of gold, for all the vessels of different uses; and silver for all the vessels of silver by weight, for vessels of different uses;

chinese: 金燈臺和金燈的分兩，銀燈臺和銀燈的分兩，輕重各都合宜；
english: And gold by weight for the light-supports and the vessels for the lights, the weight of gold needed for every support and every vessel for lights; and for the silver light-supports, the weight of silver needed for every support and for the different vessels as every one was to be used;

chinese: 陳設餅金桌子的分兩，銀桌子的分兩，
english: And gold by weight for the tables for the holy bread for every table, and silver for the silver tables;

chinese: 精金的肉叉子、盤子，和爵的分兩，各金碗與各銀碗的分兩，
english: Clear gold for the meat-hooks and the basins and the cups; for the gold basins, gold enough by weight for every basin; and silver by weight for every silver basin;

chinese: 精金香壇的分兩，並用金子做基路伯(原文作用金子做車式的基路伯)；基路伯張開翅膀，遮掩耶和華的約櫃。
english: And the best gold for the altar of perfumes; and gold for the design of the carriage, for the winged ones whose wings were outstretched covering the ark of the Lord's agreement.

chinese: 大衛說：這一切工作的樣式都是耶和華用手劃出來使我明白的。
english: All this, said David, the design for all these things, has been made dear to me in writing by the hand of the Lord.

chinese: 大衛又對他兒子所羅門說：你當剛強壯膽去行！不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。因為耶和華神就是我的　神，與你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丟棄你，直到耶和華殿的工作都完畢了。
english: And David said to his son Solomon, Be strong and of a good heart and do your work; have no fear and do not be troubled, for the Lord God, my God, is with you; he will not give you up, and his face will not be turned away from you, till all the work necessary for the house of the Lord is complete.

chinese: 有祭司和利未人的各班，為要辦理神殿各樣的事，又有靈巧的人在各樣的工作上樂意幫助你；並有眾首領和眾民一心聽從你的命令。
english: And see, there are the divisions of the priests and Levites for all the work of the house of God; and every trained and expert workman will be ready to do for you whatever is needed; and the captains and the people will be under your orders in everything.

chinese: 大衛王對會眾說：我兒子所羅門是神特選的，還年幼嬌嫩；這工程甚大，因這殿不是為人，乃是為耶和華　神建造的。
english: And David the king said to all the people, Solomon my son, the only one who has been marked out by God, is still young and untested, and the work is great, for this great house is not for man, but for the Lord God.

chinese: 我為我神的殿已經盡力，預備金子做金器，銀子做銀器，銅做銅器，鐵做鐵器，木做木器，還有紅瑪瑙可鑲嵌的寶石，彩石和一切的寶石，並許多漢白玉。
english: Now as far as I am able, I have made ready what is needed for the house of my God; the gold for the things of gold, and the silver for the silver things, and the brass for the brass things, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood; beryls and jewels to be framed, and stones of different colours for ornament; all sorts of stones of great price, and polished building-stone, as much as is needed and more.

chinese: 且因我心中愛慕我神的殿，就在預備建造聖殿的材料之外，又將我自己積蓄的金銀獻上，建造我　神的殿，
english: And because this house of God is dear to me, I give my private store of gold and silver to the house of my God, in addition to all I have got ready for the holy house;

chinese: 就是俄斐金三千他連得、精鍊的銀子七千他連得，以貼殿牆。
english: Even three thousand talents of gold of Ophir and seven thousand talents of the best silver, for plating the walls of the house:

chinese: 金子做金器，銀子做銀器，並藉匠人的手製造一切。今日有誰樂意將自己獻給耶和華呢？
english: Gold for the gold things, and silver for the silver things, and for every sort of work to be done by the expert workmen. Who then will come forward, offering himself this day for the Lord's work?

chinese: 於是，眾族長和以色列各支派的首領、千夫長、百夫長，並監管王工的官長，都樂意獻上。
english: Then the heads of families and the chiefs of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the controllers of the king's business, freely gave themselves;

chinese: 他們為神殿的使用獻上金子五千他連得零一萬達利克，銀子一萬他連得，銅一萬八千他連得，鐵十萬他連得。
english: And they gave for the use of the house of the Lord, five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of brass, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.

chinese: 凡有寶石的都交給革順人耶歇，送入耶和華殿的府庫。
english: And those who had stones of great price gave them to the store of the house of the Lord, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.

chinese: 因這些人誠心樂意獻給耶和華，百姓就歡喜，大衛王也大大歡喜。
english: Then the people were glad because their offerings were freely given, for with a true heart they freely gave what they had to the Lord; and David the king was full of joy.

chinese: 所以，大衛在會眾面前稱頌耶和華說：耶和華─我們的父，以色列的神是應當稱頌，直到永永遠遠的！
english: So David gave praise to the Lord before all the people; and David said, Praise be to you, O Lord the God of Israel, our father for ever and ever.

chinese: 耶和華啊，尊大、能力、榮耀、強勝、威嚴都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；國度也是你的，並且你為至高，為萬有之首。
english: Yours, O Lord, is the strength and the power and the glory, and the authority and the honour: for everything in heaven and on earth is yours; yours is the kingdom, O Lord, and you are lifted up as head over all.

chinese: 豐富尊榮都從你而來，你也治理萬物。在你手裡有大能大力，使人尊大強盛都出於你。
english: Wealth and honour come from you, and you are ruler over all, and in your hand is power and strength; it is in your power to make great, and to give strength to all.

chinese: 我們的神啊，現在我們稱謝你，讚美你榮耀之名！
english: So now, our God, we give you praise, honouring the glory of your name.

chinese: 我算甚麼，我的民算甚麼，竟能如此樂意奉獻？因為萬物都從你而來，我們把從你而得的獻給你。
english: But who am I and what is my people, that we have power to give so freely in this way? for all things come from you, and what we have given you is yours.

chinese: 我們在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，與我們列祖一樣。我們在世的日子如影兒，不能長存(或作沒有長存的指望)。
english: For we, as all our fathers were, are like men from a strange country before you, who have got a place for a time in the land; our days on the earth are like a shade, and there is no hope of going on.

chinese: 耶和華─我們的神啊，我們預備這許多材料，要為你的聖名建造殿宇，都是從你而來，都是屬你的。
english: O Lord our God, all this store, which we have made ready for the building of a house for your holy name, comes from your hand and is yours.

chinese: 我的神啊，我知道你察驗人心，喜悅正直；我以正直的心樂意獻上這一切物。現在我喜歡見你的民在這裡都樂意奉獻與你。
english: And I am conscious, my God, that you are the searcher of hearts, taking pleasure in righteousness. As for me, with an upright heart I have freely given all these things; and I have seen with joy your people who are here to make their offerings freely to you.

chinese: 耶和華─我們列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神啊，求你使你的民常存這樣的心思意念，堅定他們的心歸向你，
english: O Lord, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the deepest thoughts of your people, and let their hearts be fixed and true to you;

chinese: 又求你賜我兒子所羅門誠實的心，遵守你的命令、法度、律例，成就這一切的事，用我所預備的建造殿宇。
english: And give to Solomon my son a true heart, to keep your orders, your rules, and your laws, and to do all these things, and to put up this great house for which I have made ready.

chinese: 大衛對全會眾說：你們應當稱頌耶和華─你們的神。於是會眾稱頌耶和華─他們列祖的　神，低頭拜耶和華與王。
english: And David said to all the people, Now give praise to the Lord your God. And all the people gave praise to the Lord, the God of their fathers, with bent heads worshipping the Lord and the king.

chinese: 次日，他們向耶和華獻平安祭和燔祭，就是獻公牛一千隻，公綿羊一千隻，羊羔一千隻，並同獻的奠祭；又為以色列眾人獻許多的祭。那日，他們在耶和華面前吃喝，大大歡樂。
english: And they made offerings to the Lord, and gave burned offerings to the Lord, on the day after, a thousand oxen, a thousand sheep, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and a great wealth of offerings for all Israel.

chinese: 他們奉耶和華的命再膏大衛的兒子所羅門作王，又膏撒督作祭司。
english: And with great joy they made a feast before the Lord that day. And they made Solomon, the son of David, king a second time, putting the holy oil on him to make him holy to the Lord as ruler, and on Zadok as priest.

chinese: 於是所羅門坐在耶和華所賜的位上，接續他父親大衛作王，萬事亨通；以色列眾人也都聽從他。
english: So Solomon was put on the seat of the Lord as king in place of his father David, and everything went well for him; and all Israel was under his authority.

chinese: 眾首領和勇士，並大衛王的眾子，都順服所羅門王。
english: And all the chiefs and the men of war and all the sons of King David put themselves under the authority of Solomon the king.

chinese: 耶和華使所羅門在以色列眾人眼前甚為尊大，極其威嚴，勝過在他以前的以色列王。
english: And the Lord made Solomon great in the eyes of all Israel, clothing him with glory and honour such as no other king in Israel had had before him.

chinese: 耶西的兒子大衛作以色列眾人的王，
english: Now David, the son of Jesse, was king over all Israel.

chinese: 作王共四十年：在希伯崙作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
english: For forty years he was ruling as king over Israel, seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

chinese: 他年紀老邁，日子滿足，享受豐富、尊榮，就死了。他兒子所羅門接續他作王。
english: And he came to his end after a long life, full of days and great wealth and honour; and Solomon his son became king in his place.

chinese: 大衛王始終的事都寫在先見撒母耳的書上和先知拿單並先見迦得的書上。
english: Now all the acts of David, first and last, are recorded in the words of Samuel the seer, and the words of Nathan the prophet, and the words of Gad the seer;

chinese: 他的國事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列並列國所經過的事都寫在這書上。
english: Together with all his rule and his power, and the events which took place in his time, in Israel and in all the kingdoms of other lands.

chinese: 大衛的兒子所羅門國位堅固；耶和華─他的神與他同在，使他甚為尊大。
english: And Solomon, the son of David, made himself strong in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and made him very great.

chinese: 所羅門吩咐以色列眾人，就是千夫長、百夫長、審判官、首領與族長都來。
english: And Solomon sent word to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds and to the judges and to every chief in all Israel, heads of their families.

chinese: 所羅門和會眾都往基遍的邱壇去，因那裡有神的會幕，就是耶和華僕人摩西在曠野所製造的。
english: Then Solomon, and all the men of Israel with him, went to the high place at Gibeon, because the Tent of meeting of God, which Moses, the servant of the Lord, had made in the waste land, was there.

chinese: 只是神的約櫃，大衛已經從基列耶琳搬到他所預備的地方，因他曾在耶路撒冷為約櫃支搭了帳幕，
english: But the ark of God had been moved by David from Kiriath-jearim to the place which he had made ready for it, for he had put up a tent for it at Jerusalem.

chinese: 並且戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列所造的銅壇也在基遍耶和華的會幕前。所羅門和會眾都就近壇前。
english: And the altar of brass which Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, was there before the Tent of the Lord; and Solomon and all the people went to give worship there.

chinese: 所羅門上到耶和華面前會幕的銅壇那裡，獻一千犧牲為燔祭。
english: And Solomon went up there to the brass altar before the Lord at the Tent of meeting, offering on it a thousand burned offerings.

chinese: 當夜，神向所羅門顯現，對他說：你願我賜你甚麼，你可以求。
english: In that night God came to Solomon in a vision, and said to him, Say what I am to give you.

chinese: 所羅門對神說：你曾向我父大衛大施慈愛，使我接續他作王。
english: And Solomon said to God, Great was your mercy to David my father, and you have made me king in his place.

chinese: 耶和華神啊，現在求你成就向我父大衛所應許的話；因你立我作這民的王，他們如同地上塵沙那樣多。
english: Now, O Lord God, let your word to David my father come true; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in number.

chinese: 求你賜我智慧聰明，我好在這民前出入；不然，誰能判斷這眾多的民呢？
english: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, so that I may go out and come in before this people: for who is able to be the judge of this great people of yours?

chinese: 神對所羅門說：我已立你作我民的王。你既有這心意，並不求資財、豐富、尊榮，也不求滅絕那恨你之人的性命，又不求大壽數，只求智慧聰明好判斷我的民；
english: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in your heart, and you did not make request for money, property, or honour, or for the destruction of your haters, or for long life; but you have made request for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, so that you may be the judge of my people over whom I have made you king:

chinese: 我必賜你智慧聰明，也必賜你資財、豐富、尊榮。在你以前的列王都沒有這樣，在你以後也必沒有這樣的。
english: Wisdom and knowledge are given to you; and I will give you wealth and honour, such as no king has had before you or ever will have after you.

chinese: 於是，所羅門從基遍邱壇會幕前回到耶路撒冷，治理以色列人。
english: So Solomon went back from the high place at Gibeon, from before the Tent of meeting, to Jerusalem; and he was king over Israel.

chinese: 所羅門聚集戰車馬兵，有戰車一千四百輛，馬兵一萬二千名，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裡。
english: And Solomon got together war-carriages and horsemen; he had one thousand, four hundred carriages and twelve thousand horsemen, which he kept, some in the carriage-towns and some with the king at Jerusalem.

chinese: 王在耶路撒冷使金銀多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
english: And the king made silver and gold as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedar like the sycamore-trees of the lowland in number.

chinese: 所羅門的馬是從埃及帶來的，是王的商人一群一群按著定價買來的。
english: And Solomon's horses came out of Egypt; the king's traders got them from Kue at a price.

chinese: 他們從埃及買來的車，每輛價銀六百舍客勒，馬每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人諸王和亞蘭諸王所買的車馬，也是按這價值經他們手買來的。
english: A war-carriage might be got from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty: they got them at the same rate for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.

chinese: 所羅門定意要為耶和華的名建造殿宇，又為自己的國建造宮室。
english: Now it was Solomon's purpose to put up a house for the name of the Lord and a house for himself as king.

chinese: 所羅門就挑選七萬扛抬的，八萬在山上鑿石頭的，三千六百督工的。
english: And Solomon had seventy thousand men numbered for transport, and eighty thousand for cutting stone in the mountains, and three thousand, six hundred as overseers.

chinese: 所羅門差人去見推羅王希蘭，說：你曾運香柏木與我父大衛建宮居住，求你也這樣待我。
english: And Solomon sent to Huram, king of Tyre, saying, As you did for my father David, sending him cedar-trees for the building of his house,

chinese: 我要為耶和華─我神的名建造殿宇，分別為聖獻給他，在他面前焚燒美香，常擺陳設餅，每早晚、安息日、月朔，並耶和華─我們　神所定的節期獻燔祭。這是以色列人永遠的定例。
english: See! I am building a house for the name of the Lord my God, to be made holy to him, where perfumes of sweet spices will be burned before him, and the holy bread will be placed at all times, and burned offerings will be offered morning and evening, on the Sabbaths and at the new moons, and on the regular feasts of the Lord our God. This is a law for ever to Israel.

chinese: 我所要建造的殿宇甚大；因為我們的神至大，超乎諸　神。
english: And the house which I am building is to be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

chinese: 天和天上的天，尚且不足他居住的，誰能為他建造殿宇呢？我是誰？能為他建造殿宇嗎？不過在他面前燒香而已。
english: But who may have strength enough to make a house for him, seeing that the heaven and the heaven of heavens are not wide enough to be his resting-place? who am I then to make a house for him? But I am building it only for the burning of perfume before him.

chinese: 現在求你差一個巧匠來，就是善用金、銀、銅、鐵，和紫色、朱紅色、藍色線，並精於雕刻之工的巧匠，與我父大衛在猶大和耶路撒冷所預備的巧匠一同做工；
english: So now send me an expert worker in gold and silver and brass and iron? in purple and red and blue, and in the cutting of all sorts of ornament, to be with the expert workmen who are here in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom my father David got together.

chinese: 又求你從利巴嫩運些香柏木、松木、檀香木到我這裡來，因我知道你的僕人善於砍伐利巴嫩的樹木。我的僕人也必與你的僕人同工。
english: And send me cedar-trees, cypress-trees and sandal-wood from Lebanon, for, to my knowledge, your servants are expert wood-cutters in Lebanon; and my servants will be with yours,

chinese: 這樣，可以給我預備許多的木料，因我要建造的殿宇高大出奇。
english: To get trees for me in great numbers, for the house which I am building is to be great and a wonder.

chinese: 你的僕人砍伐樹木，我必給他們打好了的小麥二萬歌珥，大麥二萬歌珥，酒二萬罷特，油二萬罷特。
english: And I will give as food to your servants, the wood-cutters, twenty thousand measures of grain, and twenty thousand measures of barley and twenty thousand measures of wine and twenty thousand measures of oil.

chinese: 推羅王希蘭寫信回答所羅門說：耶和華因為愛他的子民，所以立你作他們的王；
english: Then Huram, king of Tyre, sent Solomon an answer in writing, saying, Because of his love for his people the Lord has made you king over them.

chinese: 又說：創造天地的耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的！他賜給大衛王一個有智慧的兒子，使他有謀略聰明，可以為耶和華建造殿宇，又為自己的國建造宮室。
english: And Huram said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, maker of heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, full of wisdom and good sense, to be the builder of a house for the Lord and a house for himself as king.

chinese: 現在我打發一個精巧有聰明的人去，他是我父親希蘭所用的，
english: And now I am sending you a wise and expert man, Huram who is as my father,

chinese: 是但支派一個婦人的兒子。他父親是推羅人，他善用金、銀、銅、鐵、石、木，和紫色、藍色、朱紅色線與細麻製造各物，並精於雕刻，又能想出各樣的巧工。請你派定這人，與你的巧匠和你父─我主大衛的巧匠一同做工。
english: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, whose father was a man of Tyre, an expert worker in gold and silver and brass and iron, in stone and wood, in purple and blue and fair linen and red, trained in the cutting of every sort of ornament and the invention of every sort of design; let him be given a place among your expert workmen and those of my lord, your father David.

chinese: 我主所說的小麥、大麥、酒、油，願我主運來給眾僕人。
english: So now let my lord send to his servants the grain and the oil and the wine as my lord has said;

chinese: 我們必照你所需用的，從利巴嫩砍伐樹木，紮成筏子，浮海運到約帕；你可以從那裡運到耶路撒冷。
english: And we will have wood cut from Lebanon, as much as you have need of, and will send it to you on flat boats by sea to Joppa, and from there you may take it up to Jerusalem.

chinese: 所羅門仿照他父大衛數點住在以色列地所有寄居的外邦人，共有十五萬三千六百名；
english: Then Solomon took the number of all the men from strange lands who were living in Israel, as his father David had done; there were a hundred and fifty-three thousand, six hundred.

chinese: 使七萬人扛抬材料，八萬人在山上鑿石頭，三千六百人督理工作。
english: Seventy thousand he put to the work of transport, eighty thousand to cutting stone in the mountains, and three thousand, six hundred as overseers to put the people to work.

chinese: 所羅門就在耶路撒冷、耶和華向他父大衛顯現的摩利亞山上，就是耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場上、大衛所指定的地方預備好了，開工建造耶和華的殿。
english: Then Solomon made a start at building the house of the Lord on Mount Moriah in Jerusalem, where the Lord had been seen by his father David, in the place which David had made ready in the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

chinese: 所羅門作王第四年二月初二日開工建造。
english: The building was started in the second month in the fourth year of his rule.

chinese: 所羅門建築神殿的根基，乃是這樣：長六十肘，寬二十肘，都按著古時的尺寸。
english: And Solomon put the base of the house of God in position; by the older measure it was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.

chinese: 殿前的廊子長二十肘，與殿的寬窄一樣，高一百二十肘；裡面貼上精金。
english: And the covered way in front of the house was twenty cubits long, as wide as the house, and a hundred and twenty cubits high, all plated inside with the best gold.

chinese: 大殿的牆都用松木板遮蔽，又貼了精金，上面雕刻棕樹和鍊子；
english: And the greater house was roofed with cypress-wood, plated with the best gold and ornamented with designs of palm-trees and chains.

chinese: 又用寶石裝飾殿牆，使殿華美；所用的金子都是巴瓦音的金子。
english: And the house was made beautiful with stones of great value, and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

chinese: 又用金子貼殿和殿的棟梁、門檻、牆壁、門扇；牆上雕刻基路伯。
english: All the house was plated with gold, the supports, the steps, the walls and the doors; and the walls were ornamented with designs of winged ones.

chinese: 又建造至聖所，長二十肘，與殿的寬窄一樣，寬也是二十肘；貼上精金，共用金子六百他連得。
english: And he made the most holy place; it was twenty cubits long, and twenty cubits wide, like the greater house, and was plated all over with the best gold; six hundred talents were used for it.

chinese: 金釘重五十舍客勒。樓房都貼上金子。
english: And fifty shekels weight of gold was used for the nails. He had all the higher rooms plated with gold.

chinese: 在至聖所按造像的法子造兩個基路伯，用金子包裹。
english: And in the most holy place he made images of two winged beings, covering them with gold.

chinese: 兩個基路伯的翅膀共長二十肘。這基路伯的一個翅膀長五肘，挨著殿這邊的牆；那一個翅膀也長五肘，與那基路伯翅膀相接。
english: Their outstretched wings were twenty cubits across; one wing, five cubits long, touching the wall of the house, and the other, of the same size, meeting the wing of the other winged one.

chinese: 那基路伯的一個翅膀長五肘，挨著殿那邊的牆；那一個翅膀也長五肘，與這基路伯的翅膀相接。
english: And in the same way, the wings of the other, five cubits long, were stretched out, one touching the wall and the other meeting the wing of the first winged one.

chinese: 兩個基路伯張開翅膀，共長二十肘，面向外殿而立。
english: Their outstretched wings were twenty cubits across; they were placed upright on their feet, facing the inner part of the house.

chinese: 又用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線和細麻織幔子，在其上繡出基路伯來。
english: And he made the veil of blue and purple and red, of the best linen, worked with winged ones.

chinese: 在殿前造了兩根柱子，高三十五肘；每柱頂高五肘。
english: And in front of the house he made two pillars, thirty-five cubits high, with crowns on the tops of them, five cubits high.

chinese: 又照聖所內鍊子的樣式做鍊子，安在柱頂上；又做一百石榴，安在鍊子上。
english: And he made chains, like neck ornaments, and put them on the tops of the pillars, and a hundred apples on the chains.

chinese: 將兩根柱子立在殿前，一根在右邊，一根在左邊；右邊的起名叫雅斤，左邊的起名叫波阿斯。
english: He put up the pillars in front of the Temple, one on the right side and one on the left, naming the one on the right Jachin and that on the left Boaz.

chinese: 他又製造一座銅壇，長二十肘，寬二十肘，高十肘；
english: Then he made a brass altar, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.

chinese: 又鑄一個銅海，樣式是圓的，高五肘，徑十肘，圍三十肘；
english: And he made the great water-vessel of metal, round in form, measuring ten cubits across from edge to edge; it was five cubits high and thirty cubits round.

chinese: 海周圍有野瓜(原文作牛)的樣式，每肘十瓜，共有兩行，是鑄海的時候鑄上的；
english: And under it was a design of flowers all round it, ten to a cubit, circling the water-vessel in two lines; they were made from liquid metal at the same time as the water-vessel.

chinese: 有十二隻銅牛馱海：三隻向北，三隻向西，三隻向南，三隻向東；海在牛上，牛尾向內；
english: It was supported on twelve oxen, three facing to the north, three to the west, three to the south, and three to the east, the water-vessel resting on top of them; their back parts were all turned to the middle of it.

chinese: 海厚一掌，邊如杯邊，又如百合花，可容三千罷特；
english: It was as thick as a man's open hand, and the edge of it was curved like the edge of a cup, like a lily flower; it would take three thousand baths.

chinese: 又製造十個盆：五個放在右邊，五個放在左邊，獻燔祭所用之物都洗在其內；但海是為祭司沐浴的。
english: And he made ten washing-vessels, putting five on the right side and five on the left; such things as were used in making the burned offering were washed in them; but the great water-vessel was to be used by the priests for washing themselves.

chinese: 他又照所定的樣式造十個金燈臺放在殿裡：五個在右邊，五個在左邊；
english: And he made the ten gold supports for the lights, as directions had been given for them, and he put them in the Temple, five on the right side and five on the left.

chinese: 又造十張桌子放在殿裡：五張在右邊，五張在左邊；又造一百個金碗；
english: He made ten tables, and put them in the Temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made a hundred gold basins.

chinese: 又建立祭司院和大院，並院門，用銅包裹門扇；
english: Then he made the open space for the priests, and the great open space and its doors, plating the doors with brass.

chinese: 將海安在殿門的右邊，就是南邊。
english: He put the great water-vessel on the right side of the house to the east, facing south.

chinese: 戶蘭又造了盆、鏟、碗。這樣，他為所羅門王做完了神殿的工。
english: And Huram made all the pots and the spades and the basins. So he came to the end of all the work he did for King Solomon in the house of God:

chinese: 所造的就是：兩根柱子和柱上兩個如球的頂，並兩個蓋柱頂的網子
english: The two pillars, and the two crowns on the tops of the pillars, and the network covering the two cups of the crowns on the tops of the pillars;

chinese: 和四百石榴，安在兩個網子上〈每網兩行蓋著兩個柱上如球的頂〉。
english: And the four hundred apples for the network, two lines of apples for the network covering the two cups of the crowns on the pillars.

chinese: 盆座和其上的盆，
english: And he made the ten bases and the ten washing-vessels which were on the bases;

chinese: 海和海下的十二隻牛，
english: The great water-vessel with the twelve oxen under it.

chinese: 盆、鏟子、肉鍤子，與耶和華殿裡的一切器皿，都是巧匠戶蘭用光亮的銅為所羅門王造成的，
english: All the pots and the spades and the meat-hooks and their vessels, which Huram, who was as his father, made for King Solomon for the house of the Lord, were of polished brass.

chinese: 是在約但平原疏割和撒利但中間藉膠泥鑄成的。
english: The king made them of liquid metal in the lowland of Jordan, in the soft earth between Succoth and Zeredah.

chinese: 所羅門製造的這一切甚多，銅的輕重無法可查。
english: So Solomon made all these vessels, a very great store of them, and the weight of the brass used was not measured.

chinese: 所羅門又造神殿裡的金壇和陳設餅的桌子，
english: And Solomon made all the vessels used in the house of God, the gold altar and the tables on which the holy bread was placed,

chinese: 並精金的燈臺和燈盞，可以照例點在內殿前。
english: And the supports for the lights with their lights, to be burning in the regular way in front of the inmost room, of the best gold;

chinese: 燈臺上的花和燈盞，並蠟剪都是金的，且是純金的；
english: The flowers and the vessels for the lights and the instruments used for them, were all of gold; it was the best gold.

chinese: 又用精金製造鑷子、盤子、調羹、火鼎。至於殿門和至聖所的門扇，並殿的門扇，都是金子妝飾的。
english: The scissors and the basins and the spoons and the fire-trays, of the best gold; and the inner doors of the house, opening into the most holy place, and the doors of the Temple, were all of gold.

chinese: 所羅門做完了耶和華殿的一切工，就把他父大衛分別為聖的金銀和器皿都帶來，放在神殿的府庫裡。
english: So all the work which Solomon did for the house of the Lord was complete. And Solomon took the holy things which David his father had given, the silver and the gold and all the vessels, and put them in the store-houses of the house of God.

chinese: 那時，所羅門將以色列的長老、各支派的首領，並以色列的族長招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和華的約櫃從大衛城─就是錫安─運上來。
english: Then Solomon sent for all the responsible men of Israel, all the chiefs of the tribes and the heads of families of the children of Israel, to come to Jerusalem and take the ark of the Lord's agreement up out of the town of David, which is Zion.

chinese: 於是以色列眾人在七月節前都聚集到王那裡。
english: And all the men of Israel came together to the king at the feast in the seventh month.

chinese: 以色列眾長老來到，利未人便抬起約櫃。
english: All the responsible men of Israel came, and the Levites took up the ark.

chinese: 祭司利未人將約櫃運上來，又將會幕和會幕的一切聖器具都帶上來。
english: They took up the ark and the Tent of meeting and all the holy vessels which were in the Tent; all these the priests, the Levites, took up.

chinese: 所羅門王和聚集到他那裡的以色列全會眾都在約櫃前獻牛羊為祭，多得不可勝數。
english: And King Solomon and all the men of Israel who had come together there with him, were before the ark, making offerings of sheep and oxen more than might be numbered.

chinese: 祭司將耶和華的約櫃抬進內殿，就是至聖所，放在兩個基路伯的翅膀底下。
english: And the priests took the ark of the Lord's agreement and put it in its place, in the inner room of the house, in the most holy place, under the wings of the winged ones.

chinese: 基路伯張著翅膀在約櫃之上，遮掩約櫃和抬櫃的杠。
english: For their wings were outstretched over the place where the ark was, covering the ark and its rods.

chinese: 這杠甚長，杠頭在內殿前可以看見，在殿外卻不能看見，直到如今還在那裡。
english: The rods were so long that their ends were seen from the holy place before the inmost room; but they were not seen from outside; and there they are to this day.

chinese: 約櫃裡惟有兩塊石版，就是以色列人出埃及後，耶和華與他們立約的時候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，並無別物。
english: Nothing was in the ark but the two flat stones which Moses put there at Horeb, where the Lord made an agreement with the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt.

chinese: 當時，在那裡所有的祭司都已自潔，並不分班供職。
english: Now when the priests had come out of the holy place, (for all the priests who were present had made themselves holy, not keeping to their divisions;

chinese: 他們出聖所的時候，歌唱的利未人亞薩、希幔、耶杜頓，和他們的眾子眾弟兄都穿細麻布衣服，站在壇的東邊，敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，同著他們有一百二十個祭司吹號。
english: And the Levites who made the music, all of them, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and brothers, robed in fair linen, were in their places with their brass and corded instruments at the east side of the altar, and with them a hundred and twenty priests blowing horns;)

chinese: 吹號的、歌唱的都一齊發聲，聲合為一，讚美感謝耶和華。吹號、敲鈸，用各種樂器，揚聲讚美耶和華說：耶和華本為善，他的慈愛永遠長存！那時，耶和華的殿有雲充滿，
english: And when the players on horns, and those who made melody in song, with one voice were sounding the praise and glory of the Lord; with loud voices and with wind instruments, and brass and corded instruments of music, praising the Lord and saying, He is good; his mercy is unchanging for ever: then the house was full of the cloud of the glory of the Lord,

chinese: 甚至祭司不能站立供職，因為耶和華的榮光充滿了神的殿。
english: So that the priests were not able to keep their places to do their work because of the cloud; for the house of God was full of the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 那時，所羅門說：耶和華曾說他必住在幽暗之處。
english: Then Solomon said, O Lord, to the sun you have given the heaven for a living-place, but your living-place was not seen by men,

chinese: 但我已經建造殿宇作你的居所，為你永遠的住處。
english: So I have made for you a living-place, a house in which you may be for ever present.

chinese: 王轉臉為以色列會眾祝福，以色列會眾就都站立。
english: Then, turning his face about, the king gave a blessing to all the men of Israel; and they were all on their feet together.

chinese: 所羅門說：耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的！因他親口向我父大衛所應許的，也親手成就了。
english: And he said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, who himself gave his word to my father David, and with his strong hand has made his word come true, saying,

chinese: 他說：自從我領我民出埃及地以來，我未曾在以色列眾支派中選擇一城建造殿宇為我名的居所，也未曾揀選一人作我民以色列的君；
english: From the day when I took my people out of the land of Egypt, no town in all the tribes of Israel has been marked out by me for the building of a house for the resting-place of my name; and I took no man to be a ruler over my people Israel;

chinese: 但選擇耶路撒冷為我名的居所，又揀選大衛治理我民以色列。
english: But now I have made selection of Jerusalem, that my name might be there, and of David, to be over my people Israel.

chinese: 所羅門說：我父大衛曾立意要為耶和華─以色列神的名建殿，
english: Now it was in the heart of my father David to put up a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華卻對我父大衛說：你立意要為我的名建殿，這意思甚好；
english: But the Lord said to David my father, You did well to have in your heart the desire to make a house for my name:

chinese: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的兒子必為我名建殿。
english: But you yourself will not be the builder of the house; but your son, the offspring of your body, he it is who will put up a house for my name.

chinese: 現在耶和華成就了他所應許的話，使我接續我父大衛坐以色列的國位，是照耶和華所說的，又為耶和華─以色列神的名建造了殿。
english: And the Lord has kept his word; for I have taken my father David's place on the seat of the kingdom of Israel, as the Lord gave his word; and I have made the house for the name of the Lord the God of Israel.

chinese: 我將約櫃安置在其中，櫃內有耶和華的約，就是他與以色列人所立的約。
english: And there I have put the ark, in which is the agreement of the Lord, which he made with the people of Israel.

chinese: 所羅門當著以色列會眾，站在耶和華的壇前，舉起手來，
english: Then he took his place in front of the altar of the Lord, all the men of Israel being present,

chinese: 〈所羅門曾造一個銅臺，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘，放在院中〉就站在臺上，當著以色列的會眾跪下，向天舉手，
english: (For Solomon had made a brass stage, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had put it in the middle of the open space; on this he took his place and went down on his knees before all the meeting of Israel, stretching out his hands to heaven.)

chinese: 說：耶和華─以色列的神啊，天上地下沒有　神可比你的！你向那盡心行在你面前的僕人守約施慈愛；
english: And he said, O Lord, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth; keeping faith and mercy unchanging for your servants, while they go in your ways with all their hearts;

chinese: 向你僕人─我父大衛所應許的話現在應驗了。你親口應許，親手成就，正如今日一樣。
english: For you have kept the word which you gave to your servant David, my father; with your mouth you said it and with your hand you have made it come true this day.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神啊，你所應許你僕人─我父大衛的話說：你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一樣，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。現在求你應驗這話。
english: So now, O Lord, the God of Israel, let your word to your servant David, my father, come true, when you said, You will never be without a man to take his place before me on the seat of the kingdom of Israel; if only your children give attention to their ways, walking in my law, as you have done before me.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神啊，求你成就向你僕人大衛所應許的話。
english: So now, O Lord, the God of Israel, make your word come true which you said to your servant David.

chinese: 神果真與世人同住在地上麼？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何況我所建的這殿呢？
english: But is it truly possible that God may be housed with men on earth? see, heaven and the heaven of heavens are not wide enough to be your resting-place: how much less this house which I have made:

chinese: 惟求耶和華─我的神垂顧僕人的禱告祈求，俯聽僕人在你面前的祈禱呼籲。
english: Still, let your heart be turned to the prayer of your servant and to his prayer for grace, O Lord my God, and give ear to the cry and the prayer which your servant makes before you;

chinese: 願你晝夜看顧這殿，就是你應許立為你名的居所；求你垂聽僕人向此處禱告的話。
english: That your eyes may be open to this house day and night, to this place of which you have said that you would put your name there; to give ear to the prayer which your servant may make, turning to this place.

chinese: 你僕人和你民以色列向此處祈禱的時候，求你從天上你的居所垂聽，垂聽而赦免。
english: And give ear to the prayers of your servant and of your people Israel, when they make their prayers, turning to this place; give ear from heaven your living-place; and hearing have mercy.

chinese: 人若得罪鄰舍，有人叫他起誓，他來到這殿，在你的壇前起誓，
english: If a man does wrong to his neighbour and has to take an oath, and comes before your altar to take his oath in this house:

chinese: 求你從天上垂聽，判斷你的僕人，定惡人有罪，照他所行的報應在他頭上；定義人有理，照他的義賞賜他。
english: Then let your ear be open in heaven, and be the judge of your servants, giving punishment to the wrongdoer, so that his sin may come on his head; and, by your decision, keeping from evil him who has done no wrong.

chinese: 你的民以色列若得罪你，敗在仇敵面前，又回心轉意承認你的名，在這殿裡向你祈求禱告，
english: And if your people Israel are overcome in war, because of their sin against you; if they are turned to you again, honouring your name, making prayers and requesting your grace in this house:

chinese: 求你從天上垂聽，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他們歸回你賜給他們和他們列祖之地。
english: Then give ear from heaven, and let the sin of your people Israel have forgiveness, and take them back again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

chinese: 你的民因得罪你，你懲罰他們，使天閉塞不下雨，他們若向此處禱告，承認你的名，離開他們的罪，
english: When heaven is shut up and there is no rain, because of their sin against you: if they make prayers with their faces turned to this place, honouring your name and turning away from their sin when you send trouble on them:

chinese: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你僕人和你民以色列的罪，將當行的善道指教他們，且降雨在你的地，就是你賜給你民為業之地。
english: Then give ear from heaven, so that the sin of your servants and the sin of your people Israel may have forgiveness, when you make clear to them the good way in which they are to go; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for their heritage.

chinese: 國中若有饑荒、瘟疫、旱風、霉爛、蝗蟲、螞蚱，或有仇敵犯境，圍困城邑，無論遭遇甚麼災禍疾病，
english: If there is no food in the land, if there is disease, if the fruits of the earth are damaged by heat or water, locust or worm; if their towns are shut in by their attackers: whatever trouble or whatever disease there may be:

chinese: 你的民以色列，或是眾人，或是一人，自覺災禍甚苦，向這殿舉手，無論祈求甚麼，禱告甚麼，
english: Whatever prayer or request for your grace is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, whatever his trouble may be, whose hands are stretched out to this house:

chinese: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他們（惟有你知道世人的心），
english: Then give ear from heaven your living-place, answering with forgiveness, and give to every man, whose secret heart is open to you, the reward of all his ways; (for you, and you only, have knowledge of the hearts of the children of men;)

chinese: 使他們在你賜給我們列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道。
english: So that they may give you worship, walking in your ways, as long as they are living in the land which you gave to our fathers.

chinese: 論到不屬你民以色列的外邦人，為你的大名和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂，從遠方而來，向這殿禱告，
english: And as for the man from a strange land, who is not of your people Israel but comes from a far country because of the glory of your name and your strong hand and your outstretched arm; when he comes to make his prayer, turning to this house:

chinese: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽，照著外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下萬民都認識你的名，敬畏你，像你的民以色列一樣，又使他們知道我建造的這殿是稱為你名下的。
english: Then give ear from heaven your living-place, and give him his desire, whatever it may be; so that all the peoples of the earth may have knowledge of your name, worshipping you as do your people Israel, and may see that this house which I have made is truly named by your name.

chinese: 你的民若奉你的差遣，無論往何處去與仇敵爭戰，向你所選擇的城與我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
english: If your people go out to war against their attackers, by whatever way you may send them, if they make their prayers to you turning their faces to this town of yours and to this house which I have put up for your name:

chinese: 求你從天上垂聽他們的禱告祈求，使他們得勝。
english: Then give ear from heaven to their prayer and their cry for grace, and see right done to them.

chinese: 你的民若得罪你（世上沒有不犯罪的人），你向他們發怒，將他們交給仇敵擄到或遠或近之地；
english: If they do wrong against you, (for no man is without sin,) and you are angry with them, and give them up into the power of those who are fighting against them, so that they take them away prisoners to a land far off or near;

chinese: 他們若在擄到之地想起罪來，回心轉意，懇求你說：我們有罪了，我們悖逆了，我們作惡了；
english: And if they take thought, in the land where they are prisoners, turning again to you, crying out in prayer to you in that land, and saying, We are sinners, we have done wrong, we have done evil;

chinese: 他們若在擄到之地盡心盡性歸服你，又向自己的地，就是你賜給他們列祖之地和你所選擇的城，並我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
english: If with all their heart and soul they are turned again to you, in the land where they are prisoners, the land where they have been taken, and make their prayers, turning their eyes to their land which you gave to their fathers, and to the town which you took for yourself, and the house which I have made for your name:

chinese: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽你民的禱告祈求，為他們伸冤，赦免他們的過犯。
english: Then give ear from heaven your living-place to their prayer and their cry, and see right done to them, answering with forgiveness your people who have done wrong against you.

chinese: 我的神啊，現在求你睜眼看，側耳聽在此處所獻的禱告。
english: Now, O my God, may your eyes be open and your ears awake to the prayers made in this place.

chinese: 耶和華神啊，求你起來，和你有能力的約櫃同入安息之所。耶和華　神啊，願你的祭司披上救恩；願你的聖民蒙福歡樂。
english: Up! now, O Lord God, come back to your resting-place, you and the ark of your strength: let your priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints be glad in what is good.

chinese: 耶和華神啊，求你不要厭棄你的受膏者，要記念向你僕人大衛所施的慈愛。
english: O Lord God, let him whom you have taken for yourself never be given up by you: keep in mind your mercies to David your servant.

chinese: 所羅門祈禱已畢，就有火從天上降下來，燒盡燔祭和別的祭。耶和華的榮光充滿了殿；
english: Now when Solomon's prayers were ended, fire came down from heaven, burning up all the offerings; and the house was full of the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 因耶和華的榮光充滿了耶和華殿，所以祭司不能進殿。
english: And the priests were not able to go into the house of the Lord, for the Lord's house was full of the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 那火降下、耶和華的榮光在殿上的時候，以色列眾人看見，就在鋪石地俯伏叩拜，稱謝耶和華說：耶和華本為善，他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: And all the children of Israel were looking on when the fire came down, and the glory of the Lord was on the house; and they went down on their knees, with their faces to the earth, worshipping and praising the Lord, and saying, He is good; for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 王和眾民在耶和華面前獻祭。
english: Then the king and all the people made offerings before the Lord.

chinese: 所羅門王用牛二萬二千，羊十二萬獻祭。這樣，王和眾民為神的殿行奉獻之禮。
english: King Solomon made an offering of twenty-two thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people kept the feast of the opening of the house of God.

chinese: 祭司侍立，各供其職；利未人也拿著耶和華的樂器，就是大衛王造出來、藉利未人頌讚耶和華的。（他的慈愛永遠長存！）祭司在眾人面前吹號，以色列人都站立。
english: And the priests were in their places, and the Levites with their instruments of music for the Lord's song, which David the king had made for the praise of the Lord whose mercy is unchanging for ever, when David gave praise by their hand; and the priests were sounding horns before them; and all Israel were on their feet.

chinese: 所羅門因他所造的銅壇容不下燔祭、素祭，和脂油，便將耶和華殿前院子當中分別為聖，在那裡獻燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油。
english: Then Solomon made holy the middle of the open square in front of the house of the Lord, offering the burned offerings there, and the fat of the peace-offerings; for there was not room on the brass altar which Solomon had made for all the burned offerings and the meal offerings and the fat.

chinese: 那時所羅門和以色列眾人，就是從哈馬口直到埃及小河，所有的以色列人都聚集成為大會，守節七日。
english: So Solomon kept the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great meeting, for the people had come together from the way into Hamath and from as far as the river of Egypt.

chinese: 第八日設立嚴肅會，行奉獻壇的禮七日，守節七日。
english: And on the eighth day they had a holy meeting; the offerings for making the altar holy went on for seven days, and the feast for seven days.

chinese: 七月二十三日，王遣散眾民；他們因見耶和華向大衛和所羅門與他民以色列所施的恩惠，就都心中喜樂，各歸各家去了。
english: And on the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, full of joy and glad in their hearts, because of all the good which the Lord had done to David and to Solomon and to Israel his people.

chinese: 所羅門造成了耶和華殿和王宮；在耶和華殿和王宮凡他心中所要做的，都順順利利地做成了。
english: So Solomon came to the end of building the house of the Lord and the king's house; and everything which it was in his mind to make in the house of the Lord and for himself had been well done.

chinese: 夜間耶和華向所羅門顯現，對他說：我已聽了你的禱告，也選擇這地方作為祭祀我的殿宇。
english: Now the Lord came to Solomon in a vision by night, and said to him, I have given ear to your prayer, and have taken this place for myself as a house where offerings are to be made.

chinese: 我若使天閉塞不下雨，或使蝗蟲吃這地的出產，或使瘟疫流行在我民中，
english: If, at my word, heaven is shut up, so that there is no rain, or if I send locusts on the land for its destruction, or if I send disease on my people;

chinese: 這稱為我名下的子民，若是自卑、禱告，尋求我的面，轉離他們的惡行，我必從天上垂聽，赦免他們的罪，醫治他們的地。
english: If my people, on whom my name is named, make themselves low and come to me in prayer, searching for me and turning from their evil ways; then I will give ear from heaven, overlooking their sin, and will give life again to their land.

chinese: 我必睜眼看、側耳聽在此處所獻的禱告。
english: Now my eyes will be open and my ears awake to the prayers made in this place.

chinese: 現在我已選擇這殿，分別為聖，使我的名永在其中，我的眼、我的心也必常在那裡。
english: For I have taken this house for myself and made it holy, so that my name may be there for ever; and my eyes and my heart will be there at all times.

chinese: 你若在我面前效法你父大衛所行的，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，謹守我的律例典章，
english: And as for you, if you will go on your way before me as David your father did, doing whatever I have given you orders to do and keeping my laws and my decisions:

chinese: 我就必堅固你的國位，正如我與你父大衛所立的約，說：你的子孫必不斷人作以色列的王。
english: Then I will make strong the seat of your kingdom, as I gave my word to David your father, saying, You will never be without a man to be ruler in Israel.

chinese: 倘若你們轉去丟棄我指示你們的律例誡命，去事奉敬拜別神，
english: But if you are turned away from me, and do not keep my orders and my laws which I have put before you, but go and make yourselves servants to other gods, giving them worship:

chinese: 我就必將以色列人從我賜給他們的地上拔出根來，並且我為己名所分別為聖的殿也必捨棄不顧，使他在萬民中作笑談，被譏誚。
english: Then I will have this people uprooted out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will put away from before my eyes, and make it an example and a word of shame among all peoples.

chinese: 這殿雖然甚高，將來經過的人必驚訝說：耶和華為何向這地和這殿如此行呢？
english: And this house will become a mass of broken walls, and everyone who goes by will be overcome with wonder, and will say, Why has the Lord done so to this land and to this house?

chinese: 人必回答說：是因此地的人離棄耶和華─他們列祖的神，就是領他們出埃及地的　神，去親近別　神，敬拜事奉他，所以耶和華使這一切災禍臨到他們。
english: And their answer will be, Because they were turned away from the Lord, the God of their fathers, who took them out of the land of Egypt, and took for themselves other gods and gave them worship and became their servants: that is why he has sent all this evil on them.

chinese: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，二十年才完畢了。
english: Now at the end of twenty years, in which time Solomon had put up the house of the Lord and a house for himself,

chinese: 以後所羅門重新修築希蘭送給他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那裡。
english: He took in hand the building up of the towns which Huram had given him, causing the children of Israel to make living-places for themselves there.

chinese: 所羅門往哈馬瑣巴去，攻取了那地方。
english: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and overcame it.

chinese: 所羅門建造曠野裡的達莫，又建造哈馬所有的積貨城，
english: And he put up the buildings of Tadmor in the waste land, and of all the store-towns in Hamath;

chinese: 又建造上伯和崙、下伯和崙作為保障，都有牆，有門，有閂；
english: And of Beth-horon the higher and the lower, walled towns with walls and doorways and locks;

chinese: 又建造巴拉和所有的積貨城，並屯車輛馬兵的城，與耶路撒冷、利巴嫩，以及自己治理的全國中所願意建造的。
english: And of Baalath, and all the store-towns which Solomon had, and the towns where he kept his war-carriages and his horse men, and everything which it was his pleasure to put up in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all the land under his rule.

chinese: 至於國中所剩下不屬以色列人的赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
english: As for all the rest of the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel:

chinese: 就是以色列人未曾滅絕的，所羅門挑取他們的後裔作服苦的奴僕，直到今日。
english: Their men who were still living in the land, and whom the children of Israel had not put an end to, these Solomon put to forced work, as is done to this day;

chinese: 惟有以色列人，所羅門不使他們當奴僕做工，乃是作他的戰士、軍長的統領、車兵長、馬兵長。
english: But Solomon did not make use of the children of Israel as servants for his work; they were men of war, his chiefs and his captains, and captains of his war-carriages and his horsemen.

chinese: 所羅門王有二百五十督工的，監管工人。
english: Now these were the chief men in authority whom King Solomon had: two hundred and fifty of them, in authority over the people.

chinese: 所羅門將法老的女兒帶出大衛城，上到為他建造的宮裡；因所羅門說：耶和華約櫃所到之處都為聖地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大衛的宮裡。
english: Then Solomon made Pharaoh's daughter come up from the town of David to the house which he had made for her; for he said, I will not have my wife living in the house of David, king of Israel, because those places where the ark of the Lord has come are holy.

chinese: 所羅門在耶和華的壇上，就是在廊子前他所築的壇上，與耶和華獻燔祭；
english: Then Solomon made burned offerings to the Lord on the altar of the Lord which he had put up in front of the covered way,

chinese: 又遵著摩西的吩咐在安息日、月朔，並一年三節，就是除酵節、七七節、住棚節，獻每日所當獻的祭。
english: Offering every day what had been ordered by Moses, on the Sabbaths and at the new moon and at the regular feasts three times a year, that is at the feast of unleavened bread, the feast of weeks, and the feast of tents.

chinese: 所羅門照著他父大衛所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他們各供己事，又使利未人各盡其職，讚美耶和華，在祭司面前做每日所當做的；又派守門的按著班次看守各門，因為神人大衛是這樣吩咐的。
english: And he gave the divisions of the priests their places for their work, as ordered by his father David, and to the Levites he gave their work of praise and waiting on the priests, to do what was needed day by day; and he gave the door-keepers their places in turn at every door; for so David, the man of God, had given orders.

chinese: 王所吩咐眾祭司和利未人的，無論是管府庫或辦別的事，他們都不違背。
english: All the orders given by the king to the priests and Levites, in connection with any business or stores, were done with care.

chinese: 所羅門建造耶和華的殿，從立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱備。這樣，耶和華的殿全然完畢。
english: And all the work of Solomon was complete, from the day when he put the base of the Lord's house in position, till Solomon had come to the end of building the Lord's house.

chinese: 那時，所羅門往以東地靠海的以旬迦別和以祿去。
english: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth by the sea in the land of Edom.

chinese: 希蘭差遣他的臣僕，將船隻和熟悉泛海的僕人送到所羅門那裡。他們同著所羅門的僕人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他連得金子，運到所羅門王那裡。
english: And Huram sent him, by his servants, ships and experienced seamen, who went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir and came back with four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they took to King Solomon.

chinese: 示巴女王聽見所羅門的名聲，就來到耶路撒冷，要用難解的話試問所羅門；跟隨他的人甚多，又有駱駝馱著香料、寶石，和許多金子。他來見了所羅門，就把心裡所有的對所羅門都說出來。
english: Now the queen of Sheba, hearing great things of Solomon, came to Jerusalem to put his wisdom to the test with hard questions; and with her came a very great train, and camels weighted down with spices, and great stores of gold and jewels: and when she came to Solomon she had talk with him of everything in her mind.

chinese: 所羅門將他所問的都答上了，沒有一句不明白、不能答的。
english: And Solomon gave her answers to all her questions; there was no secret which he did not make clear to her.

chinese: 示巴女王見所羅門的智慧和他所建造的宮室、
english: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he had made,

chinese: 席上的珍饈美味、群臣分列而坐、僕人兩旁侍立，以及他們的衣服裝飾、酒政，和酒政的衣服裝飾，又見他上耶和華殿的臺階，就詫異得神不守舍，
english: And the food at his table, and all his servants seated there, and those who were waiting on him in their places, and their robes, and his wine-servants and their robes, and the burned offerings which he made in the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.

chinese: 對王說：我在本國裡所聽見論到你的事和你的智慧實在是真的！
english: And she said to the king, The account which was given to me in my country of your acts and your wisdom was true.

chinese: 我先不信那些話，及至我來親眼見了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告訴我的，還不到一半；你的實跡越過我所聽見的名聲。
english: But I had no faith in what was said about you, till I came and saw for myself; and truly, word was not given me of half your great wisdom; you are much greater than they said.

chinese: 你的群臣、你的僕人常侍立在你面前聽你智慧的話是有福的。
english: Happy are your wives and happy these your servants whose place is ever before you, hearing your words of wisdom.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神是應當稱頌的！他喜悅你，使你坐他的國位，為耶和華─你的　神作王；因為你的　神愛以色列人，要永遠堅立他們，所以立你作他們的王，使你秉公行義。
english: Praise be to the Lord your God whose pleasure it was to put you on the seat of his kingdom to be king for the Lord your God: because, in his love for Israel, it was the purpose of your God to make them strong for ever, he made you king over them, to be their judge in righteousness.

chinese: 於是示巴女王將一百二十他連得金子和寶石，與極多的香料送給所羅門王；他送給王的香料，以後再沒有這樣的。
english: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and a great store of spices and jewels: never had such spices been seen as the queen of Sheba gave to Solomon.

chinese: 希蘭的僕人和所羅門的僕人從俄斐運了金子來，也運了檀香木(或作烏木；下同)和寶石來。
english: And the servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, in addition to gold from Ophir, came back with sandal-wood and jewels.

chinese: 王用檀香木為耶和華殿和王宮做臺，又為歌唱的人做琴瑟；猶大地從來沒有見過這樣的。
english: And with the sandal-wood the king made steps for the house of the Lord and for the king's house, and instruments of music for the makers of melody; never before had such been seen in the land of Judah.

chinese: 所羅門王按示巴女王所帶來的，還他禮物，另外照他一切所要所求的，都送給他。於是女王和他臣僕轉回本國去了。
english: And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she made request for, in addition to what she had taken to the king. So she went back to her country with her servants.

chinese: 所羅門每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他連得，
english: Now the weight of gold which came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents;

chinese: 另外還有商人所進的金子，並且亞拉伯諸王與屬國的省長都帶金銀給所羅門。
english: And in addition to what he got from traders of different sorts, all the kings of Arabia and the rulers of the country gave gold and silver to Solomon.

chinese: 所羅門王用錘出來的金子打成擋牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；
english: And King Solomon made two hundred body-covers of hammered gold, every one having six hundred shekels of gold in it.

chinese: 又用錘出來的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百舍客勒，都放在利巴嫩林宮裡。
english: And he made three hundred smaller body-covers of hammered gold, using three hundred shekels of gold for every cover, and the king put them in the house of the Woods of Lebanon.

chinese: 王用象牙製造一個大寶座，用精金包裹。
english: Then the king made a great ivory seat, plated with the best gold.

chinese: 寶座有六層臺階，又有金腳凳，與寶座相連。寶座兩旁有扶手，靠近扶手有兩個獅子站立。
english: There were six steps up to it, and a foot-rest of gold fixed to it, and arms on the two sides of the seat, with two lions at the side of the arms.

chinese: 六層臺階上有十二個獅子站立，每層有兩個：左邊一個，右邊一個；在列國中沒有這樣做的。
english: And twelve lions were placed on one side and on the other side on the six steps: there was nothing like it in any kingdom.

chinese: 所羅門王一切的飲器都是金的，利巴嫩林宮裡的一切器皿都是精金的。所羅門年間，銀子算不了甚麼。
english: All King Solomon's drinking-vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the Woods of Lebanon were of the best gold: no one gave a thought to silver in the days of Solomon.

chinese: 因為王的船隻與希蘭的僕人一同往他施去；他施船隻三年一次裝載金、銀、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回來。
english: For the king had Tarshish-ships sailing with the servants of Huram: once every three years the Tarshish-ships came back with gold and silver, ivory and monkeys and peacocks.

chinese: 所羅門王的財寶與智慧勝過天下的列王。
english: And King Solomon was greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and in wisdom.

chinese: 普天下的王都求見所羅門，要聽神賜給他智慧的話。
english: And all the kings of the earth came to see Solomon and to give ear to his wisdom, which God had put into his heart.

chinese: 他們各帶貢物，就是金器、銀器、衣服、軍械、香料、騾馬，每年有一定之例。
english: And everyone took with him an offering, vessels of silver and vessels of gold, and robes, and coats of metal, and spices, and horses and beasts for transport, regularly year by year.

chinese: 所羅門有套車的馬四千棚，有馬兵一萬二千，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裡。
english: Solomon had four thousand buildings for his horses and his war-carriages, and twelve thousand horsemen whom he kept, some in the carriage-towns and some with the king in Jerusalem.

chinese: 所羅門統管諸王，從大河到非利士地，直到埃及的邊界。
english: And he was ruler over all the kings from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the limit of Egypt.

chinese: 王在耶路撒冷使銀子多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem and cedars like the sycamore-trees of the lowlands in number.

chinese: 有人從埃及和各國為所羅門趕馬群來。
english: They got horses for Solomon from Egypt and from every land.

chinese: 所羅門其餘的事，自始至終，不都寫在先知拿單的書上和示羅人亞希雅的預言書上，並先見易多論尼八兒子耶羅波安的默示書上麼？
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not recorded in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the words of Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh, and in the visions of Iddo the seer about Jeroboam, the son of Nebat?

chinese: 所羅門在耶路撒冷作以色列眾人的王共四十年。
english: Solomon was king over Israel in Jerusalem for forty years.

chinese: 所羅門與他列祖同睡，葬在他父大衛城裡。他兒子羅波安接續他作王。
english: And Solomon went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the town of David his father; and Rehoboam his son became king in his place.

chinese: 羅波安往示劍去，因為以色列人都到了示劍，要立他作王。
english: And Rehoboam went to Shechem, where all Israel had come together to make him king.

chinese: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安先前躲避所羅門王，逃往埃及，住在那裡；他聽見這事，就從埃及回來。
english: And when Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, had news of it, (for he was in Egypt where he had gone in flight from King Solomon,) he came back from Egypt.

chinese: 以色列人打發人去請他，他就和以色列眾人來見羅波安，對他說：
english: And they sent for him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came to Rehoboam and said,

chinese: 你父親使我們負重軛做苦工，現在求你使我們做的苦工負的重軛輕鬆些，我們就事奉你。
english: Your father put a hard yoke on us: if you will make the conditions under which your father kept us down less cruel, and the weight of the yoke he put on us less hard, then we will be your servants.

chinese: 羅波安對他們說：第三日再來見我罷！民就去了。
english: And he said to them, Come to me again after three days. So the people went away.

chinese: 羅波安之父所羅門在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，羅波安王和他們商議，說：你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆這民。
english: Then King Rehoboam took the opinion of the old men who had been with Solomon his father when he was living, and said, In your opinion, what answer am I to give to this people?

chinese: 老年人對他說：王若恩待這民，使他們喜悅，用好話回覆他們，他們就永遠作王的僕人。
english: And they said to him, If you are kind to this people, pleasing them and saying good words to them, then they will be your servants for ever.

chinese: 王卻不用老年人給他出的主意，就和那些與他一同長大、在他面前侍立的少年人商議，
english: But he gave no attention to the opinion of the old men, but went to the young men of his generation who were waiting before him.

chinese: 說：這民對我說：你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些；你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆他們。
english: And he said to them, What is your opinion? What answer are we to give to this people who have said to me, Make less the weight of the yoke which your father put on us?

chinese: 那同他長大的少年人說：這民對王說：你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些；王要對他們如此說：我的小拇指比我父親的腰還粗；
english: And the young men of his generation said to him, This is the answer to give to the people who came to you saying, Your father put a hard yoke on us, but will you make it less; say to them, My little finger is thicker than my father's body;

chinese: 我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛；我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子鞭責打你們。
english: If my father put a hard yoke on you, I will make it harder: my father gave you punishment with whips, but I will give you blows with snakes.

chinese: 耶羅波安和眾百姓遵著羅波安王所說你們第三日再來見我的那話，第三日他們果然來了。
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had given orders, saying, Come to me again on the third day.

chinese: 羅波安王用嚴厲的話回覆他們，不用老年人所出的主意，
english: And the king gave them a rough answer. So King Rehoboam gave no attention to the suggestion of the old men,

chinese: 照著少年人所出的主意對他們說：我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛；我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子鞭責打你們。
english: But gave them the answer put forward by the young men, saying, My father made your yoke hard, but I will make it harder; my father gave you punishment with whips, but I will give it with snakes.

chinese: 王不肯依從百姓；這事乃出於神，為要應驗耶和華藉示羅人亞希雅對尼八兒子耶羅波安所說的話。
english: So the king did not give ear to the people; for this came about by the purpose of God, so that the Lord might give effect to his word which he had said by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam, the son of Nebat.

chinese: 以色列眾民見王不依從他們，就對王說：我們與大衛有甚麼分兒呢？與耶西的兒子並沒有關涉！以色列人哪，各回各家去罷！大衛家啊，自己顧自己罷！於是，以色列眾人都回自己家裡去了。
english: And when all Israel saw that the king would give no attention to them, the people in answer said to the king, What part have we in David? what is our heritage in the son of Jesse? every man to your tents, O Israel; now see to your house, David. So all Israel went to their tents.

chinese: 惟獨住在猶大城邑的以色列人，羅波安仍作他們的王。
english: But Rehoboam was still king over those of the children of Israel who were living in the towns of Judah.

chinese: 羅波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的哈多蘭往以色列人那裡去，以色列人就用石頭打死他。羅波安王急忙上車，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
english: Then Rehoboam sent Adoniram, the overseer of the forced work; and he was stoned to death by all Israel. And King Rehoboam went quickly and got into his carriage to go in flight to Jerusalem.

chinese: 這樣，以色列人背叛大衛家，直到今日。
english: So Israel was turned away from the family of David to this day.

chinese: 羅波安來到耶路撒冷，招聚猶大家和便雅憫家，共十八萬人，都是挑選的戰士，要與以色列人爭戰，好將國奪回再歸自己。
english: And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, and got together the men of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand of his best fighting-men, to make war against Israel and get the kingdom back for Rehoboam.

chinese: 但耶和華的話臨到神人示瑪雅說：
english: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, the man of God, saying,

chinese: 你去告訴所羅門的兒子猶大王羅波安和住猶大、便雅憫的以色列眾人說，
english: Say to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,

chinese: 耶和華如此說：你們不可上去與你們的弟兄爭戰，各歸各家去罷！因為這事出於我。眾人就聽從耶和華的話歸回，不去與耶羅波安爭戰。
english: The Lord has said, You are not to go to war against your brothers: let every man go back to his house, for this thing is my purpose. So they gave ear to the words of the Lord and were turned back from fighting against Jeroboam.

chinese: 羅波安住在耶路撒冷，在猶大地修築城邑，
english: Now Rehoboam kept in Jerusalem, building walled towns in Judah.

chinese: 為保障修築伯利恆、以坦、提哥亞、
english: He was the builder of Beth-lehem and Etam and Tekoa

chinese: 伯夙、梭哥、亞杜蘭、
english: And Beth-zur and Soco and Adullam

chinese: 迦特、瑪利沙、西弗、
english: And Gath and Mareshah and Ziph

chinese: 亞多萊音、拉吉、亞西加、
english: And Adoraim and Lachish and Azekah

chinese: 瑣拉、亞雅崙、希伯崙。這都是猶大和便雅憫的堅固城。
english: And Zorah and Aijalon and Hebron, walled towns in Judah and Benjamin.

chinese: 羅波安又堅固各處的保障，在其中安置軍長，又預備下糧食、油、酒。
english: And he made the walled towns strong, and he put captains in them and stores of food, oil, and wine.

chinese: 他在各城裡預備盾牌和槍，且使城極其堅固。猶大和便雅憫都歸了他。
english: And in every town he put stores of body-covers and spears, and made them very strong. And Judah and Benjamin were his.

chinese: 以色列全地的祭司和利未人都從四方來歸羅波安。
english: And the priests and Levites who were in all Israel came together to him from every part of their country.

chinese: 利未人撇下他們的郊野和產業，來到猶大與耶路撒冷，是因耶羅波安和他的兒子拒絕他們，不許他們供祭司職分事奉耶和華。
english: For the Levites gave up their living-places and their property, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons had sent them away, not letting them be priests to the Lord;

chinese: 耶羅波安為邱壇、為鬼魔(原文作公山羊)、為自己所鑄造的牛犢設立祭司。
english: And he himself made priests for the high places, and for the images of he-goats and oxen which he had made.

chinese: 以色列各支派中，凡立定心意尋求耶和華─以色列神的，都隨從利未人，來到耶路撒冷祭祀耶和華─他們列祖的　神。
english: And after them, from all the tribes of Israel, all those whose hearts were fixed and true to the Lord, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to make offerings to the Lord, the God of their fathers.

chinese: 這樣，就堅固猶大國，使所羅門的兒子羅波安強盛三年，因為他們三年遵行大衛和所羅門的道。
english: So they went on increasing the power of the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, strong for three years; and for three years they went in the ways of David and Solomon.

chinese: 羅波安娶大衛兒子耶利摩的女兒瑪哈拉為妻，又娶耶西兒子以利押的女兒亞比孩為妻。
english: And Rehoboam took as his wife Mahalath, the daughter of Jerimoth, the son of David and of Abihail, the daughter of Eliab, the son of Jesse;

chinese: 從他生了幾個兒子，就是耶烏施、示瑪利雅、撒罕。
english: And she had sons by him, Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

chinese: 後來又娶押沙龍的女兒瑪迦(十三章二節作烏列的女兒米該雅)，從他生了亞比雅、亞太、細撒、示羅密。
english: And after her he took Maacah, the daughter of Absalom; and she had Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomith by him.

chinese: 羅波安娶十八個妻，立六十個妾，生二十八個兒子，六十個女兒；他卻愛押沙龍的女兒瑪迦，比愛別的妻妾更甚。
english: Maacah, the daughter of Absalom, was dearer to Rehoboam than all his wives and his servant-wives: (for he had eighteen wives and sixty servant-wives, and was the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.)

chinese: 羅波安立瑪迦的兒子亞比雅作太子，在他弟兄中為首，因為想要立他接續作王。
english: Rehoboam made Abijah, the son of Maacah, chief and ruler among his brothers, for it was his purpose to make him king.

chinese: 羅波安辦事精明，使他眾子分散在猶大和便雅憫全地各堅固城裡，又賜他們許多糧食，為他們多尋妻子。
english: And in his wisdom he had his sons stationed in every walled town through all the lands of Judah and Benjamin; and he gave them a great store of food, and took wives for them.

chinese: 羅波安的國堅立，他強盛的時候就離棄耶和華的律法，以色列人也都隨從他。
english: Now when Rehoboam's position as king had been made certain, and he was strong, he gave up the law of the Lord, and all Israel with him.

chinese: 羅波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上來攻打耶路撒冷，因為王和民得罪了耶和華。
english: Now in the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak, king of Egypt, came up against Jerusalem, because of their sin against the Lord,

chinese: 示撒帶戰車一千二百輛，馬兵六萬，並且跟從他出埃及的路比人、蘇基人，和古實人，多得不可勝數。
