english: And he said to him, Go, take these vessels, and put them in the Temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be put up again in its place.

chinese: 於是這設巴薩來建立耶路撒冷神殿的根基。這殿從那時直到如今尚未造成。』
english: Then this same Sheshbazzar came and put the house of God in Jerusalem on its bases: and from that time till now the building has been going on, but it is still not complete.

chinese: 現在王若以為美，請察巴比倫王的府庫，看古列王降旨允准在耶路撒冷建造神的殿沒有，王的心意如何？請降旨曉諭我們。」
english: So now, if it seems good to the king, let search be made in the king's store-house at Babylon, to see if it is true that an order was given by Cyrus the king for the building of this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send us word of his pleasure in connection with this business.

chinese: 於是大利烏王降旨，要尋察典籍庫內，就是在巴比倫藏寶物之處；
english: Then Darius the king gave an order and a search was made in the house of the records, where the things of value were stored up in Babylon.

chinese: 在瑪代省亞馬他城的宮內尋得一卷，其中記著說：
english: And at Achmetha, in the great house of the king in the land of Media, they came across a roll, in which this statement was put on record:

chinese: 古列王元年，他降旨論到耶路撒冷神的殿，要建造這殿為獻祭之處，堅立殿的根基。殿高六十肘，寬六十肘，
english: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made an order: In connection with the house of God at Jerusalem, let the house be put up, the place where they make offerings, and let the earth for the bases be put in place; let it be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide;

chinese: 用三層大石頭，一層新木頭，經費要出於王庫；
english: With three lines of great stones and one line of new wood supports; and let the necessary money be given out of the king's store-house;

chinese: 並且神殿的金銀器皿，就是尼布甲尼撒從耶路撒冷的殿中掠到巴比倫的，要歸還帶到耶路撒冷的殿中，各按原處放在神的殿裡。
english: And let the gold and silver vessels from the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the Temple at Jerusalem to Babylon, be given back and taken again to the Temple at Jerusalem, every one in its place, and put them in the house of God.

chinese: 「現在河西的總督達乃和示他波斯乃，並你們的同黨，就是住河西的亞法薩迦人，你們當遠離他們。
english: So now, Tattenai, ruler of the land across the river, and Shethar-bozenai and your people the Apharsachites across the river, keep far from that place:

chinese: 不要攔阻神殿的工作，任憑猶大人的省長和猶大人的長老在原處建造神的這殿。
english: Let the work of this house of God go on; let the ruler of the Jews and their responsible men put up this house of God in its place.

chinese: 我又降旨，吩咐你們向猶大人的長老為建造神的殿當怎樣行，就是從河西的款項中，急速撥取貢銀作他們的經費，免得耽誤工作。
english: Further, I give orders as to what you are to do for the responsible men of the Jews in connection with the building of this house of God: that from the king's wealth, that is, from the taxes got together in the land over the river, the money needed is to be given to these men readily, so that their work may not be stopped.

chinese: 他們與天上的神獻燔祭所需用的公牛犢、公綿羊、綿羊羔，並所用的麥子、鹽、酒、油，都要照耶路撒冷祭司的話，每日供給他們，不得有誤；
english: And whatever they have need of, young oxen and sheep and lambs, for burned offerings to the God of heaven, grain, salt, wine, and oil, whatever the priests in Jerusalem say is necessary, is to be given to them day by day regularly:

chinese: 好叫他們獻馨香的祭給天上的神，又為王和王眾子的壽命祈禱。
english: So that they may make offerings of a sweet smell to the God of heaven, with prayers for the life of the king and of his sons.

chinese: 我再降旨，無論誰更改這命令，必從他房屋中拆出一根梁來，把他舉起，懸在其上，又使他的房屋成為糞堆。
english: And I have given orders that if anyone makes any change in this word, one of the supports is to be pulled out of his house, and he is to be lifted up and fixed to it; and his house is to be made waste for this;

chinese: 若有王和民伸手更改這命令，拆毀這殿，願那使耶路撒冷的殿作為他名居所的神將他們滅絕。我─大利烏降這旨意，當速速遵行。」
english: And may the God who has made it a resting-place for his name send destruction on all kings and peoples whose hands are outstretched to make any change in this or to do damage to this house of God at Jerusalem. I, Darius, have given this order, let it be done with all care.

chinese: 於是，河西總督達乃和示他•波斯乃，並他們的同黨，因大利烏王所發的命令，就急速遵行。
english: Then Tattenai, the ruler across the river, and Shethar-bozenai and their people, because of the order given by King Darius, did as he had said with all care.

chinese: 猶大長老因先知哈該和易多的孫子撒迦利亞所說勸勉的話就建造這殿，凡事亨通。他們遵著以色列神的命令和波斯王古列、大利烏、亞達薛西的旨意，建造完畢。
english: And the responsible men of the Jews went on with their building, and did well, helped by the teaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, the son of Iddo. They went on building till it was complete, in keeping with the word of the God of Israel, and the orders given by Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes, king of Persia.

chinese: 大利烏王第六年，亞達月初三日，這殿修成了。
english: And the building of this house was complete on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of the rule of Darius the king.

chinese: 以色列的祭司和利未人，並其餘被擄歸回的人都歡歡喜喜地行奉獻神殿的禮。
english: And the children of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of those who had come back, kept the feast of the opening of this house of God with joy.

chinese: 行奉獻神殿的禮就獻公牛一百隻，公綿羊二百隻，綿羊羔四百隻，又照以色列支派的數目獻公山羊十二隻，為以色列眾人作贖罪祭；
english: And they gave as offerings at the opening of this house of God a hundred oxen, two hundred sheep, four hundred lambs; and for a sin-offering for all Israel, twelve he-goats, being the number of the tribes of Israel.

chinese: 且派祭司和利未人按著班次在耶路撒冷事奉神，是照摩西律法書上所寫的。
english: And they put the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their order, for the worship of God at Jerusalem; as it is recorded in the book of Moses.

chinese: 正月十四日，被擄歸回的人守逾越節。
english: And the children of Israel who had come back kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

chinese: 原來，祭司和利未人一同自潔，無一人不潔淨。利未人為被擄歸回的眾人和他們的弟兄眾祭司，並為自己宰逾越節的羊羔。
english: For the priests and the Levites had made themselves clean together; they were all clean: and they put the Passover lamb to death for all those who had come back, and for their brothers the priests and for themselves.

chinese: 從擄到之地歸回的以色列人和一切除掉所染外邦人污穢、歸附他們、要尋求耶和華─以色列神的人都吃這羊羔，
english: And the children of Israel, who had come back, and all those who were joined to them, after separating themselves from the evil ways of the people of the land to become the servants of the Lord, the God of Israel, took food together,

chinese: 歡歡喜喜地守除酵節七日；因為耶和華使他們歡喜，又使亞述王的心轉向他們，堅固他們的手，作以色列神殿的工程。
english: And kept the feast of unleavened bread for seven days with joy: for the Lord had made them full of joy, by turning the heart of the king of Assyria to them to give them help in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

chinese: 這事以後，波斯王亞達薛西年間，有個以斯拉，他是西萊雅的兒子，西萊雅是亞撒利雅的兒子，亞撒利雅是希勒家的兒子，
english: Now after these things, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra, the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

chinese: 希勒家是沙龍的兒子，沙龍是撒督的兒子，撒督是亞希突的兒子，
english: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

chinese: 亞希突是亞瑪利雅的兒子，亞瑪利雅是亞撒利雅的兒子，亞撒利雅是米拉約的兒子，
english: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

chinese: 米拉約是西拉希雅的兒子，西拉希雅是烏西的兒子，烏西是布基的兒子，
english: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

chinese: 布基是亞比書的兒子，亞比書是非尼哈的兒子，非尼哈是以利亞撒的兒子，以利亞撒是大祭司亞倫的兒子。
english: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

chinese: 這以斯拉從巴比倫上來，他是敏捷的文士，通達耶和華─以色列神所賜摩西的律法書。王允准他一切所求的，是因耶和華─他　神的手幫助他。
english: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a scribe, expert in the law of Moses which the Lord, the God of Israel, had given: and the king, moved by the Lord his God, gave him whatever he made request for.

chinese: 亞達薛西王第七年，以色列人、祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守門的、尼提寧，有上耶路撒冷的。
english: And some of the children of Israel went up, with some of the priests and the Levites and the music-makers and the door-keepers and the Nethinim, to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

chinese: 王第七年五月，以斯拉到了耶路撒冷。
english: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, in the seventh year of the king's rule.

chinese: 正月初一日，他從巴比倫起程；因他神施恩的手幫助他，五月初一日就到了耶路撒冷。
english: For, starting his journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, he came to Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, by the good help of his God.

chinese: 以斯拉定志考究遵行耶和華的律法，又將律例典章教訓以色列人。
english: For Ezra had given his mind to learning the law of the Lord and doing it, and to teaching his rules and decisions in Israel.

chinese: 祭司以斯拉是通達耶和華誡命和賜以色列之律例的文士。亞達薛西王賜給他們諭旨，上面寫著說：
english: Now this is a copy of the letter which King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra, the priest and the scribe, who put into writing the words of the orders of the Lord, and of his rules for Israel:

chinese: 「諸王之王亞達薛西，達於祭司以斯拉通達天上神律法大德的文士，云云。
english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, scribe of the law of the God of heaven, all peace;

chinese: 住在我國中的以色列人、祭司、利未人，凡甘心上耶路撒冷去的，我降旨准他們與你同去。
english: And now it is my order that all those of the people of Israel, and their priests and Levites in my kingdom, who are ready and have a desire to go to Jerusalem, are to go with you.

chinese: 王與七個謀士既然差你去，照你手中神的律法書察問猶大和耶路撒冷的景況；
english: Because you are sent by the king and his seven wise men, to get knowledge about Judah and Jerusalem, as you are ordered by the law of your God which is in your hand;

chinese: 又帶金銀，就是王和謀士甘心獻給住耶路撒冷、以色列神的，
english: And to take with you the silver and gold freely offered by the king and his wise men to the God of Israel, whose Temple is in Jerusalem,

chinese: 並帶你在巴比倫全省所得的金銀，和百姓、祭司樂意獻給耶路撒冷─他們神殿的禮物。
english: As well as all the silver and gold which you get from the land of Babylon, together with the offering of the people and of the priests, freely given for the house of their God, which is in Jerusalem:

chinese: 所以你當用這金銀，急速買公牛、公綿羊、綿羊羔，和同獻的素祭奠祭之物，獻在耶路撒冷─你們神殿的壇上。
english: So with this money get with care oxen, sheep, and lambs, with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, to be offered on the altar of the house of your God, which is in Jerusalem.

chinese: 剩下的金銀，你和你的弟兄看著怎樣好，就怎樣用，總要遵著你們神的旨意。
english: And whatever seems right to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, that do, as may be pleasing to your God.

chinese: 所交給你神殿中使用的器皿，你要交在耶路撒冷神面前。
english: And the vessels which have been given to you for the uses of the house of your God, you are to give to the God of Jerusalem.

chinese: 你神殿裡若再有需用的經費，你可以從王的府庫裡支取。
english: And whatever more is needed for the house of your God, and which you may have to give, take it from the king's store-house.

chinese: 「我─亞達薛西王又降旨與河西的一切庫官，說：『通達天上神律法的文士祭司以斯拉，無論向你們要甚麼，你們要速速地備辦，
english: And I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, now give orders to all keepers of the king's money across the river, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, may have need of from you, is to be done with all care,

chinese: 就是銀子直到一百他連得，麥子一百柯珥，酒一百罷特，油一百罷特，鹽不計其數，也要給他。
english: Up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred measures of grain, a hundred measures of wine, and a hundred measures of oil, and salt without measure.

chinese: 凡天上之神所吩咐的，當為天上神的殿詳細辦理。為何使忿怒臨到王和王眾子的國呢？
english: Whatever is ordered by the God of heaven, let it be done completely for the house of the God of heaven; so that there may not be wrath against the kingdom of the king and his sons.

chinese: 我又曉諭你們，至於祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守門的，和尼提寧，並在神殿當差的人，不可叫他們進貢，交課，納稅。』
english: In addition, we make it clear to you, that it will be against the law to put any tax or payment in goods or forced payment on any of the priests or Levites, the music-makers, door-keepers, Nethinim, or any servants of this house of God.

chinese: 「以斯拉啊，要照著你神賜你的智慧，將所有明白你神律法的人立為士師、審判官，治理河西的百姓，使他們教訓一切不明白神律法的人。
english: And you, Ezra, by the wisdom of your God which is in you, are to put rulers and judges to have authority over all the people across the river who have knowledge of the laws of your God; and you are to give teaching to him who has no knowledge of them.

chinese: 凡不遵行你神律法和王命令的人就當速速定他的罪，或治死，或充軍，或抄家，或囚禁。」
english: And if anyone does not keep the law of your God and the law of the king, take care that punishment is given to him, by death or by driving him from his country or by taking away his goods or by putting him in prison.

chinese: 以斯拉說：耶和華─我們列祖的神是應當稱頌的！因他使王起這心意修飾耶路撒冷耶和華的殿，
english: Praise be to the Lord, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing into the heart of the king, to make fair the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem;

chinese: 又在王和謀士，並大能的軍長面前施恩於我。因耶和華─我神的手幫助我，我就得以堅強，從以色列中招聚首領，與我一同上來。
english: And has given mercy to me before the king and his government and before all the king's great captains. And I was made strong by the hand of the Lord my God which was on me, and I got together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

chinese: 當亞達薛西王年間，同我從巴比倫上來的人，他們的族長和他們的家譜記在下面：
english: Now these are the heads of families who were listed of those who went up with me from Babylon, when Artaxerxes was king.

chinese: 屬非尼哈的子孫有革順；屬以他瑪的子孫有但以理；屬大衛的子孫有哈突；
english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom; of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; of the sons of David, Hattush;

chinese: 屬巴錄的後裔，就是示迦尼的子孫有撒迦利亞，同著他，按家譜計算，男丁一百五十人；
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah; of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed a hundred and fifty males.

chinese: 屬巴哈•摩押的子孫有西拉希雅的兒子以利約乃，同著他有男丁二百；
english: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai, the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

chinese: 屬示迦尼的子孫有雅哈悉的兒子，同著他有男丁三百；
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

chinese: 屬亞丁的子孫有約拿單的兒子以別，同著他有男丁五十；
english: And of the sons of Adin, Ebed, the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

chinese: 屬以攔的子孫有亞他利雅的兒子耶篩亞，同著他有男丁七十；
english: And of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah; the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

chinese: 屬示法提雅的子孫有米迦勒的兒子西巴第雅，同著他有男丁八十；
english: And of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah, the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

chinese: 屬約押的子孫有耶歇的兒子俄巴底亞，同著他有男丁二百一十八；
english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah, the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

chinese: 屬示羅密的子孫有約細斐的兒子，同著他有男丁一百六十；
english: And of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him a hundred and sixty males.

chinese: 屬比拜的子孫有比拜的兒子撒迦利亞，同著他有男丁二十八；
english: And of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah, the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

chinese: 屬押甲的子孫有哈加坦的兒子約哈難，同著他有男丁一百一十；
english: And of the sons of Azgad, Johanan, the son of Hakkatan; and with him a hundred and ten males.

chinese: 屬亞多尼干的子孫，就是末尾的，他們的名字是以利法列、耶利、示瑪雅，同著他們有男丁六十；
english: And of the sons of Adonikam, the last, whose names were Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

chinese: 屬比革瓦伊的子孫有烏太和撒布，同著他們有男丁七十。
english: And of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

chinese: 我招聚這些人在流入亞哈瓦的河邊，我們在那裡住了三日。我查看百姓和祭司，見沒有利未人在那裡，
english: And I made them come together by the river flowing to Ahava; and we were there in tents for three days: and after viewing the people and the priests I saw that no sons of Levi were there.

chinese: 就召首領以利以謝、亞列、示瑪雅、以利拿單、雅立、以利拿單、拿單、撒迦利亞、米書蘭，又召教習約雅立和以利拿單。
english: Then I sent for Eliezer and Ariel and Shemaiah and Elnathan Jarib and Elnathan and Nathan and Zechariah and Meshullam, all responsible men; and for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were wise men.

chinese: 我打發他們往迦西斐雅地方去見那裡的首領易多，又告訴他們當向易多和他的弟兄尼提寧說甚麼話叫他們為我們神的殿帶使用的人來。
english: And I sent them to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and gave them orders what to say to Iddo and his brothers the Nethinim at the place Casiphia, so that they might come back to us with men to do the work of the house of our God.

chinese: 蒙我們神施恩的手幫助我們，他們在以色列的曾孫、利未的孫子、抹利的後裔中帶一個通達人來；還有示利比和他的眾子與弟兄共一十八人。
english: And by the help of our God they got for us Ish-sechel, one of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah with his sons and brothers, eighteen;

chinese: 又有哈沙比雅，同著他有米拉利的子孫耶篩亞，並他的眾子和弟兄共二十人。
english: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

chinese: 從前大衛和眾首領派尼提寧服事利未人，現在從這尼提寧中也帶了二百二十人來，都是按名指定的。
english: And of the Nethinim, to whom David and the captains had given the work of helping the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim, all of them specially named.

chinese: 那時，我在亞哈瓦河邊宣告禁食，為要在我們神面前克苦己心，求他使我們和婦人孩子，並一切所有的，都得平坦的道路。
english: Then I gave orders for a time of going without food, there by the river Ahava, so that we might make ourselves low before our God in prayer, requesting from him a straight way for us and for our little ones and for all our substance.

chinese: 我求王撥步兵馬兵幫助我們抵擋路上的仇敵，本以為羞恥；因我曾對王說：「我們神施恩的手必幫助一切尋求他的；但他的能力和忿怒必攻擊一切離棄他的。」
english: For I would not, for shame, make request to the king for a band of armed men and horsemen to give us help against those who might make attacks on us on the way: for we had said to the king, The hand of our God is on his servants for good, but his power and his wrath are against all those who are turned away from him.

chinese: 所以我們禁食祈求我們的神，他就應允了我們。
english: So we went without food, requesting our God for this: and his ear was open to our prayer.

chinese: 我分派祭司長十二人，就是示利比、哈沙比雅，和他們的弟兄十人，
english: So I put on one side twelve of the chiefs of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

chinese: 將王和謀士、軍長，並在那裡的以色列眾人為我們神殿所獻的金銀和器皿，都秤了交給他們。
english: And gave to them by weight the silver and the gold and the vessels, all the offering for the house of our God which the king and his wise men and his captains and all Israel there present had given:

chinese: 我秤了交在他們手中的銀子有六百五十他連得；銀器重一百他連得；金子一百他連得；
english: Measuring into their hands six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels, a hundred talents' weight, and a hundred talents of gold,

chinese: 金碗二十個，重一千達利克；上等光銅的器皿兩個，寶貴如金。
english: And twenty gold basins, of a thousand darics, and two vessels of the best bright brass, equal in value to gold.

chinese: 我對他們說：你們歸耶和華為聖，器皿也為聖；金銀是甘心獻給耶和華─你們列祖之神的。
english: And I said to them, You are holy to the Lord and the vessels are holy: and the silver and the gold are an offering freely given to the Lord, the God of your fathers.

chinese: 你們當警醒看守，直到你們在耶路撒冷耶和華殿的庫內，在祭司長和利未族長，並以色列的各族長面前過了秤。」
english: Take care of them and keep them, till you put them on the scales before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and the chiefs of the families of Israel, in Jerusalem, in the rooms of the house of the Lord.

chinese: 於是，祭司、利未人按著分量接受金銀和器皿，要帶到耶路撒冷我們神的殿裡。
english: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of silver and gold and the vessels, to take them to Jerusalem into the house of our God.

chinese: 正月十二日，我們從亞哈瓦河邊起行，要往耶路撒冷去。我們神的手保佑我們，救我們脫離仇敵和路上埋伏之人的手。
english: Then we went away from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was on us, and he gave us salvation from our haters and those who were waiting to make an attack on us by the way.

chinese: 我們到了耶路撒冷，在那裡住了三日。
english: And we came to Jerusalem and were there for three days.

chinese: 第四日，在我們神的殿裡把金銀和器皿都秤了，交在祭司烏利亞的兒子米利末的手中。同著他有非尼哈的兒子以利亞撒，還有利未人耶書亞的兒子約撒拔和賓內的兒子挪亞底。
english: And on the fourth day, the silver and the gold and the vessels were measured out by weight in the house of our God into the hands of Meremoth, the son of Uriah, the priest; and with him was Eleazar, the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad, the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah, the son of Binnui, the Levites;

chinese: 當時都點了數目，按著分量寫在冊上。
english: All was handed over by number and by weight: and the weight was put on record at that time.

chinese: 從擄到之地歸回的人向以色列的神獻燔祭，就是為以色列眾人獻公牛十二隻，公綿羊九十六隻，綿羊羔七十七隻，又獻公山羊十二隻作贖罪祭，這都是向耶和華焚獻的。
english: And those who had been prisoners, who had come back from a strange land, made burned offerings to the God of Israel, twelve oxen for all Israel, ninety-six male sheep, seventy-seven lambs, twelve he-goats for a sin-offering: all this was a burned offering to the Lord.

chinese: 他們將王的諭旨交給王所派的總督與河西的省長，他們就幫助百姓，又供給神殿裡所需用的。
english: And they gave the king's orders to the king's captains and the rulers across the river, and they gave the people and the house of God the help which was needed.

chinese: 這事做完了，眾首領來見我，說：「以色列民和祭司並利未人，沒有離絕迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、亞捫人、摩押人、埃及人、亞摩利人，仍效法這些國的民，行可憎的事。
english: Now after these things were done, the captains came to me and said, The people of Israel and the priests and Levites have not kept themselves separate from the people of the lands, but have taken part in the disgusting ways of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

chinese: 因他們為自己和兒子娶了這些外邦女子為妻，以致聖潔的種類和這些國的民混雜；而且首領和官長在這事上為罪魁。」
english: For they have taken their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy seed has been mixed with the peoples of the lands; and in fact the captains and rulers have been the first to do this evil.

chinese: 我一聽見這事，就撕裂衣服和外袍，拔了頭髮和鬍鬚，驚懼憂悶而坐。
english: And hearing this, with signs of grief and pulling out the hair of my head and my chin, I took my seat on the earth deeply troubled.

chinese: 凡為以色列神言語戰兢的，都因這被擄歸回之人所犯的罪聚集到我這裡來。我就驚懼憂悶而坐，直到獻晚祭的時候。
english: Then everyone who went in fear of the words of the God of Israel, because of the sin of those who had come back, came together to me; and I kept where I was, overcome with grief, till the evening offering.

chinese: 獻晚祭的時候我起來，心中愁苦，穿著撕裂的衣袍，雙膝跪下向耶和華─我的神舉手，
english: And at the evening offering, having made myself low before God, I got up, and with signs of grief, falling down on my knees, with my hands stretched out to the Lord my God,

chinese: 說：我的神啊，我抱愧蒙羞，不敢向我　神仰面；因為我們的罪孽滅頂，我們的罪惡滔天。
english: I said, O my God, shame keeps me from lifting up my face to you, my God: for our sins are increased higher than our heads and our evil-doing has come up to heaven.

chinese: 從我們列祖直到今日，我們的罪惡甚重；因我們的罪孽，我們和君王、祭司都交在外邦列王的手中，殺害、擄掠、搶奪、臉上蒙羞正如今日的光景。
english: From the days of our fathers till this day we have been great sinners; and for our sins, we and our kings and our priests have been given up into the hands of the kings of the lands, to the sword and to prison and to loss of goods and to shame of face, as it is this day.

chinese: 現在耶和華─我們的神暫且施恩與我們，給我們留些逃脫的人，使我們安穩如釘子釘在他的聖所，我們的　神好光照我們的眼目，使我們在受轄制之中稍微復興。
english: And now for a little time grace has come to us from the Lord our God, to let a small band of us get free and to give us a nail in his holy place, so that our God may give light to our eyes and a measure of new life in our prison chains.

chinese: 我們是奴僕，然而在受轄制之中，我們的神仍沒有丟棄我們，在波斯王眼前向我們施恩，叫我們復興，能重建我們　神的殿，修其毀壞之處，使我們在猶大和耶路撒冷有牆垣。
english: For we are servants; but our God has not been turned away from us in our prison, but has had mercy on us before the eyes of the kings of Persia, to give us new strength to put up again the house of our God and to make fair its waste places, and to give us a wall in Judah and Jerusalem.

chinese: 「我們的神啊，既是如此，我們還有甚麼話可說呢？因為我們已經離棄你的命令，
english: And now, O our God, what are we to say after this? for we have not kept your laws,

chinese: 就是你藉你僕人眾先知所吩咐的說：『你們要去得為業之地是污穢之地；因列國之民的污穢和可憎的事，叫全地從這邊直到那邊滿了污穢。
english: Which you gave to your servants the prophets, saying, The land into which you are going, to take it for a heritage, is an unclean land, because of the evil lives of the peoples of the land and their disgusting ways, which have made the land unclean from end to end.

chinese: 所以不可將你們的女兒嫁他們的兒子，也不可為你們的兒子娶他們的女兒，永不可求他們的平安和他們的利益，這樣你們就可以強盛，吃這地的美物，並遺留這地給你們的子孫永遠為業。』
english: So now do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons or do anything for their peace or well-being for ever; so that you may be strong, living on the good of the land, and handing it on to your children for a heritage for ever.

chinese: 神啊，我們因自己的惡行和大罪，遭遇了這一切的事，並且你刑罰我們輕於我們罪所當得的，又給我們留下這些人。
english: And after everything which has come on us because of our evil-doing and our great sin, and seeing that the punishment which you, O God, have given us, is less than the measure of our sins, and that you have kept from death those of us who are here;

chinese: 我們豈可再違背你的命令，與這行可憎之事的民結親呢？若這樣行，你豈不向我們發怒，將我們滅絕，以致沒有一個剩下逃脫的人嗎？
english: Are we again to go against your orders, taking wives from among the people who do these disgusting things? would you not be angry with us till our destruction was complete, till there was not one who got away safe?

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神啊，因你是公義的，我們這剩下的人才得逃脫，正如今日的光景。看哪，我們在你面前有罪惡，因此無人在你面前站立得住。」
english: O Lord God of Israel, righteousness is yours; we are only a small band which has been kept from death, as at this day: see, we are before you in our sin; for no one may keep his place before you because of this.

chinese: 以斯拉禱告，認罪，哭泣，俯伏在神殿前的時候，有以色列中的男女孩童聚集到以斯拉那裡，成了大會，眾民無不痛哭。
english: Now while Ezra was making his prayer and his statement of wrongdoing, weeping and falling down before the house of God, a very great number of men and women and children out of Israel came together round him: for the people were weeping bitterly.

chinese: 屬以攔的子孫、耶歇的兒子示迦尼對以斯拉說：我們在此地娶了外邦女子為妻，干犯了我們的神，然而以色列人還有指望。
english: And Shecaniah, the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answering, said to Ezra, We have done evil against our God, and have taken as our wives strange women of the peoples of the land: but still there is hope for Israel in this question.

chinese: 現在當與我們的神立約，休這一切的妻，離絕他們所生的，照著我主和那因　神命令戰兢之人所議定的，按律法而行。
english: Let us now make an agreement with our God to put away all the wives and all their children, if it seems right to my lord and to those who go in fear of the words of our God; and let it be done in keeping with the law.

chinese: 你起來，這是你當辦的事，我們必幫助你，你當奮勉而行。」
english: Up, now! for this is your business, and we are with you; take heart and do it.

chinese: 以斯拉便起來，使祭司長和利未人，並以色列眾人起誓說，必照這話去行；他們就起了誓。
english: Then Ezra got up, and made the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and all Israel take an oath that they would do this. So they took an oath.

chinese: 以斯拉從神殿前起來，進入以利亞實的兒子約哈難的屋裡，到了那裡不吃飯，也不喝水；因為被擄歸回之人所犯的罪，心裡悲傷。
english: Then Ezra got up from before the house of God and went into the room of Jehohanan, the son of Eliashib; but when he came there, he took no food or drink, for he was sorrowing for the sin of those who had come back.

chinese: 他們通告猶大和耶路撒冷被擄歸回的人，叫他們在耶路撒冷聚集。
english: And they made a public statement through all Judah and Jerusalem, to all those who had come back, that they were to come together to Jerusalem;

chinese: 凡不遵首領和長老所議定、三日之內不來的，就必抄他的家，使他離開被擄歸回之人的會。
english: And that if anyone did not come before three days were past, as ordered by the rulers and the responsible men, all his goods would be put under the curse, and he himself would be cut off from the meeting of the people who had come back.

chinese: 於是，猶大和便雅憫眾人，三日之內都聚集在耶路撒冷。那日正是九月二十日，眾人都坐在神殿前的寬闊處；因這事，又因下大雨，就都戰兢。
english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin came together to Jerusalem before three days were past; it was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people were seated in the wide square in front of the house of God, shaking with fear because of this business and because of the great rain.

chinese: 祭司以斯拉站起來，對他們說：你們有罪了；因你們娶了外邦的女子為妻，增添以色列人的罪惡。
english: And Ezra the priest got to his feet and said to them, You have done wrong and taken strange women for your wives, so increasing the sin of Israel.

chinese: 現在當向耶和華─你們列祖的神認罪，遵行他的旨意，離絕這些國的民和外邦的女子。」
english: So now, give praise to the Lord, the God of your fathers, and do his pleasure; and make yourselves separate from the peoples of the land and from the strange women.

chinese: 會眾都大聲回答說：我們必照著你的話行，
english: Then all the people, answering, said with a loud voice, As you have said, so it is right for us to do.

chinese: 只是百姓眾多，又逢大雨的時令，我們不能站在外頭，這也不是一兩天辦完的事，因我們在這事上犯了大罪；
english: But the number of people is great, and it is a time of much rain; it is not possible for us to go on waiting outside, and this is not a thing which may be done in one day or even two: for our sin in this business is great.

chinese: 不如為全會眾派首領辦理。凡我們城邑中娶外邦女子為妻的，當按所定的日期，同著本城的長老和士師而來，直到辦完這事，神的烈怒就轉離我們了。」
english: So now let our rulers be representatives for all the people, and let all those in our towns who are married to strange women come at fixed times, and with them the responsible men and the judges of every town, till the burning wrath of our God is turned away from us, and this has been done.

chinese: 惟有亞撒黑的兒子約拿單，特瓦的兒子雅哈謝阻擋（或譯：總辦）這事，並有米書蘭和利未人沙比太幫助他們。
english: Only Jonathan, the son of Asahel, and Jahzeiah, the son of Tikvah, were against this, Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supporting them.

chinese: 被擄歸回的人如此而行。祭司以斯拉和些族長按著宗族都指名見派；在十月初一日，一同在座查辦這事，
english: So those who had come back did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain heads of families, by their fathers' families, all of them by their names, were marked out; and on the first day of the tenth month they took their places to go into the question with care.

chinese: 到正月初一日，才查清娶外邦女子的人數。
english: And they got to the end of all the men who were married to strange women by the first day of the first month.

chinese: 在祭司中查出娶外邦女子為妻的，就是耶書亞的子孫約薩達的兒子，和他弟兄瑪西雅、以利以謝、雅立、基大利；
english: And among the sons of the priests who were married to strange women were these: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak and his brothers, Maaseiah and Eliezer and Jarib and Gedaliah.

chinese: 他們便應許必休他們的妻。他們因有罪，就獻群中的一隻公綿羊贖罪。
english: And they gave their word that they would put away their wives; and for their sin, they gave an offering of a male sheep of the flock.

chinese: 音麥的子孫中，有哈拿尼、西巴第雅。
english: And of the sons of Immer, Hanani and Zebadiah.

chinese: 哈琳的子孫中，有瑪西雅、以利雅、示瑪雅、耶歇、烏西雅。
english: And of the sons of Harim, Maaseiah and Elijah and Shemaiah and Jehiel and Uzziah.

chinese: 巴施戶珥的子孫中，有以利約乃、瑪西雅、以實瑪利、拿坦業、約撒拔、以利亞撒。
english: And of the sons of Pashhur, Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

chinese: 利未人中，有約撒拔、示每、基拉雅（基拉雅就是基利他），還有毗他希雅、猶大、以利以謝。
english: And of the Levites, Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah (that is Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

chinese: 歌唱的人中有以利亞實。守門的人中，有沙龍、提聯、烏利。
english: And of the music-makers, Eliashib; and of the door-keepers, Shallum and Telem and Uri.

chinese: 以色列人巴錄的子孫中，有拉米、耶西雅、瑪基雅、米雅民、以利亞撒、瑪基雅、比拿雅。
english: And of Israel, the sons of Parosh, Ramiah and Izziah and Malchijah and Mijamin and Eleazar and Malchijah and Benaiah.

chinese: 以攔的子孫中，有瑪他尼、撒迦利亞、耶歇、押底、耶利末、以利雅。
english: And of the sons of Elam, Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel and Abdi and Jeremoth and Elijah.

chinese: 薩土的子孫中，有以利約乃、以利亞實、瑪他尼、耶利末、撒拔、亞西撒。
english: And of the sons of Zattu, Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth and Zabad and Aziza.

chinese: 比拜的子孫中，有約哈難、哈拿尼雅、薩拜、亞勒。
english: And of the sons of Bebai, Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.

chinese: 巴尼的子孫中，有米書蘭、瑪鹿、亞大雅、雅述、示押、耶利末。
english: And of the sons of Bani, Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub and Sheal, Jeremoth.

chinese: 巴哈•摩押的子孫中，有阿底拿、基拉、比拿雅、瑪西雅、瑪他尼、比撒列、賓內、瑪拿西。
english: And of the sons of Pahath-moab, Adna and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel and Binnui and Manasseh.

chinese: 哈琳的子孫中，有以利以謝、伊示雅、瑪基雅、示瑪雅、西緬、
english: And of the sons of Harim, Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

chinese: 便雅憫、瑪鹿、示瑪利雅。
english: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.

chinese: 哈順的子孫中，有瑪特乃、瑪達他、撒拔、以利法列、耶利買、瑪拿西、示每。
english: Of the sons of Hashum, Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.

chinese: 巴尼的子孫中，有瑪玳、暗蘭、烏益、
english: Of the sons of Bani, Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

chinese: 比拿雅、比底雅、基祿、
english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

chinese: 瓦尼雅、米利末、以利亞實、
english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

chinese: 瑪他尼、瑪特乃、雅掃、
english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu,

chinese: 巴尼、賓內、示每、
english: And Bani and Binnui, Shimei;

chinese: 示利米雅、拿單、亞大雅、
english: And Shelemiah and Nathan and Adaiah,

chinese: 瑪拿底拜、沙賽、沙賴、
english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

chinese: 亞薩利、示利米雅、示瑪利雅、
english: Azarel and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

chinese: 沙龍、亞瑪利雅、約瑟。
english: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.

chinese: 尼波的子孫中，有耶利、瑪他提雅、撒拔、西比拿、雅玳、約珥、比拿雅。
english: Of the sons of Nebo, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, and Joel, Benaiah.

chinese: 這些人都娶了外邦女子為妻，其中也有生了兒女的。
english: All these had taken strange wives; and some of them had wives by whom they had offspring.

chinese: 哈迦利亞的兒子尼希米的言語如下：亞達薛西王二十年基斯流月，我在書珊城的宮中。
english: The history of Nehemiah, the son of Hacaliah. Now it came about, in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, when I was in Shushan, the king's town,

chinese: 那時，有我一個弟兄哈拿尼，同著幾個人從猶大來。我問他們那些被擄歸回、剩下逃脫的猶大人和耶路撒冷的光景。
english: That Hanani, one of my brothers, came with certain men from Judah; and in answer to my request for news of the Jews who had been prisoners and had got away, and of Jerusalem,

chinese: 他們對我說：那些被擄歸回剩下的人在猶大省遭大難，受凌辱；並且耶路撒冷的城牆拆毀，城門被火焚燒。
english: They said to me, The small band of Jews now living there in the land are in great trouble and shame: the wall of Jerusalem has been broken down, and its doorways burned with fire.

chinese: 我聽見這話，就坐下哭泣，悲哀幾日，在天上的神面前禁食祈禱，說：
english: Then, after hearing these words, for some days I gave myself up to weeping and sorrow, seated on the earth; and taking no food I made prayer to the God of heaven,

chinese: 耶和華─天上的神，大而可畏的神啊，你向愛你、守你誡命的人守約施慈愛。
english: And said, O Lord, the God of heaven, the great God, greatly to be feared, keeping faith and mercy with those who have love for him and are true to his laws:

chinese: 願你睜眼看，側耳聽，你僕人晝夜在你面前為你眾僕人以色列民的祈禱，承認我們以色列人向你所犯的罪；我與我父家都有罪了。
english: Let your ear now take note and let your eyes be open, so that you may give ear to the prayer of your servant, which I make before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel, your servants, while I put before you the sins of the children of Israel, which we have done against you: truly, I and my father's people are sinners.

chinese: 我們向你所行的甚是邪惡，沒有遵守你藉著僕人摩西所吩咐的誡命、律例、典章。
english: We have done great wrong against you, and have not kept the orders, the rules, and the decisions, which you gave to your servant Moses.

chinese: 求你記念所吩咐你僕人摩西的話，說：你們若犯罪，我就把你們分散在萬民中；
english: Keep in mind, O Lord, the order you gave your servant Moses, saying, If you do wrong I will send you wandering among the peoples:

chinese: 但你們若歸向我，謹守遵行我的誡命，你們被趕散的人雖在天涯，我也必從那裡將他們招聚回來，帶到我所選擇立為我名的居所。
english: But if you come back to me and keep my orders and do them, even if those of you who have been forced out are living in the farthest parts of heaven, I will get them from there, and take them back to the place marked out by me for the resting-place of my name.

chinese: 這都是你的僕人、你的百姓，就是你用大力和大能的手所救贖的。
english: Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have made yours by your great power and by your strong hand.

chinese: 主啊，求你側耳聽你僕人的祈禱，和喜愛敬畏你名眾僕人的祈禱，使你僕人現今亨通，在王面前蒙恩。我是作王酒政的。
english: O Lord, let your ear take note of the prayer of your servant, and of the prayers of your servants, who take delight in worshipping your name: give help, O Lord, to your servant this day, and let him have mercy in the eyes of this man. (Now I was the king's wine-servant.)

chinese: 亞達薛西王二十年尼散月，在王面前擺酒，我拿起酒來奉給王。我素來在王面前沒有愁容。
english: And it came about in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, that I took up the wine and gave it to the king. Now I had never before been sad when the king was present.

chinese: 王對我說：你既沒有病，為甚麼面帶愁容呢？這不是別的，必是你心中愁煩。於是我甚懼怕。
english: And the king said to me, Why is your face sad, seeing that you are not ill? this is nothing but sorrow of heart. Then I was full of fear;

chinese: 我對王說：願王萬歲！我列祖墳墓所在的那城荒涼，城門被火焚燒，我豈能面無愁容麼？
english: And said to the king, May the king be living for ever: is it not natural for my face to be sad, when the town, the place where the bodies of my fathers are at rest, has been made waste and its doorways burned with fire?

chinese: 王問我說：你要求甚麼？於是我默禱天上的神。
english: Then the king said to me, What is your desire? So I made prayer to the God of heaven.

chinese: 我對王說：僕人若在王眼前蒙恩，王若喜歡，求王差遣我往猶大，到我列祖墳墓所在的那城去，我好重新建造。
english: And I said to the king, If it is the king's pleasure, and if your servant has your approval, send me to Judah, to the town where the bodies of my fathers are at rest, so that I may take in hand the building of it.

chinese: 那時王后坐在王的旁邊。王問我說：你去要多少日子？幾時回來？我就定了日期。於是王喜歡差遣我去。
english: And the king said to me (the queen being seated by his side), How long will your journey take, and when will you come back? So the king was pleased to send me, and I gave him a fixed time.

chinese: 我又對王說：王若喜歡，求王賜我詔書，通知大河西的省長准我經過，直到猶大；
english: Further, I said to the king, If it is the king's pleasure, let letters be given to me for the rulers across the river, so that they may let me go through till I come to Judah;

chinese: 又賜詔書，通知管理王園林的亞薩，使他給我木料，做屬殿營樓之門的橫梁和城牆，與我自己房屋使用的。王就允准我，因我神施恩的手幫助我。
english: And a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the king's park, so that he may give me wood to make boards for the doors of the tower of the house, and for the wall of the town, and for the house which is to be mine. And the king gave me this, for the hand of my God was on me.

chinese: 王派了軍長和馬兵護送我。我到了河西的省長那裡，將王的詔書交給他們。
english: Then I came to the rulers of the lands across the river and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent with me captains of the army and horsemen.

chinese: 和倫人參巴拉，並為奴的亞捫人多比雅，聽見有人來為以色列人求好處，就甚惱怒。
english: And Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, hearing of it, were greatly troubled because a man had come to the help of the children of Israel.

chinese: 我到了耶路撒冷，在那裡住了三日。
english: So I came to Jerusalem and was there three days.

chinese: 我夜間起來，有幾個人也一同起來；但神使我心裡要為耶路撒冷做甚麼事，我並沒有告訴人。除了我騎的牲口以外，也沒有別的牲口在我那裡。
english: And in the night I got up, taking with me a small band of men; I said nothing to any man of what God had put into my heart to do for Jerusalem: and I had no beast with me but the one on which I was seated.

chinese: 當夜我出了谷門，往野狗井去（野狗：或譯龍），到了糞廠門，察看耶路撒冷的城牆，見城牆拆毀，城門被火焚燒。
english: And I went out by night, through the doorway of the valley, and past the dragon's water-spring as far as the place where waste material was put, viewing the walls of Jerusalem which were broken down, and the doorways which had been burned with fire.

chinese: 我又往前，到了泉門和王池，但所騎的牲口沒有地方過去。
english: Then I went on to the door of the fountain and to the king's pool: but there was no room for my beast to get through.

chinese: 於是夜間沿溪而上，察看城牆，又轉身進入谷門，就回來了。
english: Then in the night, I went up by the stream, viewing the wall; then turning back, I went in by the door in the valley, and so came back.

chinese: 我往哪裡去，我做甚麼事，官長都不知道。我還沒有告訴猶大平民、祭司、貴冑、官長，和其餘做工的人。
english: And the chiefs had no knowledge of where I had been or what I was doing; and I had not then said anything to the Jews or to the priests or the great ones or the chiefs or the rest of those who were doing the work.

chinese: 以後，我對他們說：我們所遭的難，耶路撒冷怎樣荒涼，城門被火焚燒，你們都看見了。來罷，我們重建耶路撒冷的城牆，免得再受凌辱！
english: Then I said to them, You see what a bad condition we are in; how Jerusalem is a waste, and its doorways burned with fire: come, let us get to work, building up the wall of Jerusalem, so that we may no longer be put to shame.

chinese: 我告訴他們我神施恩的手怎樣幫助我，並王對我所說的話。他們就說：我們起來建造罷！於是他們奮勇做這善工。
english: Then I gave them an account of how the hand of my God was on me, helping me; and of the king's words which he had said to me. And they said, Let us get to work on the building. So they made their hands strong for the good work.

chinese: 但和倫人參巴拉，並為奴的亞捫人多比雅和亞拉伯人基善聽見就嗤笑我們，藐視我們，說：你們做甚麼呢？要背叛王麼？
english: But Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, hearing of it, made sport of us, laughing at us and saying, What are you doing? will you go against the king?

chinese: 我回答他們說：天上的神必使我們亨通。我們作他僕人的，要起來建造；你們卻在耶路撒冷無分、無權、無紀念。
english: Then answering them I said, The God of heaven, he will be our help; so we his servants will go on with our building: but you have no part or right or any name in Jerusalem.

chinese: 那時，大祭司以利亞實和他的弟兄眾祭司起來建立羊門，分別為聖，安立門扇，又築城牆到哈米亞樓，直到哈楠業樓，分別為聖。
english: Then Eliashib, the chief priest, got up with his brothers the priests, and took in hand the building of the sheep doorway; they made it holy and put its doors in position; as far as the tower of Hammeah they made it holy, even to the tower of Hananel.

chinese: 其次是耶利哥人建造。其次是音利的兒子撒刻建造。
english: And by his side the men of Jericho were building. And after them, Zaccur, the son of Imri.

chinese: 哈西拿的子孫建立魚門，架橫梁、安門扇，和閂鎖。
english: The sons of Hassenaah were the builders of the fish doorway; they put its boards in place and put up its doors, with their locks and rods.

chinese: 其次是哈哥斯的孫子、烏利亞的兒子米利末修造。其次是米示薩別的孫子、比利迦的兒子米書蘭修造。其次是巴拿的兒子撒督修造。
english: By their side Meremoth, the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, was making good the walls. Then Meshullam, the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel; and by him, Zadok, the son of Baana.

chinese: 其次是提哥亞人修造；但是他們的貴冑不用肩（原文是頸項）擔他們主的工作。
english: Near them, the Tekoites were at work; but their chiefs did not put their necks to the work of their Lord.

chinese: 巴西亞的兒子耶何耶大與比所玳的兒子米書蘭修造古門，架橫梁，安門扇和閂鎖。
english: Joiada, the son of Paseah, and Meshullam, the son of Besodeiah, made good the old doorway; they put its boards in place and put up its doors, with their locks and rods.

chinese: 其次是基遍人米拉提，米倫人雅頓與基遍人，並屬河西總督所管的米斯巴人修造。
english: By their side were working Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah from the seat of the ruler across the river.

chinese: 其次是銀匠哈海雅的兒子烏薛修造。其次是做香的哈拿尼雅修造。這些人修堅耶路撒冷，直到寬牆。
english: Near them was working Uzziel, the son of Harhaiah, the gold-worker. And by him was Hananiah, one of the perfume-makers, building up Jerusalem as far as the wide wall.

chinese: 其次是管理耶路撒冷一半、戶珥的兒子利法雅修造。
english: Near them was working Rephaiah, the son of Hur, the ruler of half Jerusalem.

chinese: 其次是哈路抹的兒子耶大雅對著自己的房屋修造。其次是哈沙尼的兒子哈突修造。
english: By his side was Jedaiah, the son of Harumaph, opposite his house. And by him was Hattush, the son of Hashabneiah.

chinese: 哈琳的兒子瑪基雅和巴哈摩押的兒子哈述修造一段，並修造爐樓。
english: Malchijah, the son of Harim, and Hasshub, the son of Pahath-moab, were working on another part, and the tower of the ovens.

chinese: 其次是管理耶路撒冷那一半、哈羅黑的兒子沙龍和他的女兒們修造。
english: Near them was Shallum, the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half Jerusalem, with his daughters.

chinese: 哈嫩和撒挪亞的居民修造谷門，立門，安門扇和閂鎖，又建築城牆一千肘，直到糞廠門。
english: Hanun and the people of Zanoah were working on the doorway of the valley; they put it up and put up its doors, with their locks and rods, and a thousand cubits of wall as far as the doorway where the waste material was placed.

chinese: 管理伯哈基琳、利甲的兒子瑪基雅修造糞廠門，立門，安門扇和閂鎖。
english: And Malchijah, the son of Rechab, the ruler of the division of Beth-haccherem, made good the doorway of the waste, building it up and putting up its doors, with their locks and rods.

chinese: 管理米斯巴、各荷西的兒子沙崙修造泉門，立門，蓋門頂，安門扇和閂鎖，又修造靠近王園西羅亞池的牆垣，直到那從大衛城下來的臺階。
english: And Shallun, the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of the division of Mizpah, made good the doorway of the fountain, building it up and covering it and putting up its doors, with their locks and rods, with the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king's garden, as far as the steps which go down from the town of David.

chinese: 其次是管理伯夙一半、押卜的兒子尼希米修造，直到大衛墳地的對面，又到挖成的池子，並勇士的房屋。
english: By his side was working Nehemiah, the son of Azbuk, ruler of half the division of Beth-zur, as far as the place opposite the last resting-places of David's family, and the pool which was made and the house of the men of war.

chinese: 其次是利未人巴尼的兒子利宏修造。其次是管理基伊拉一半、哈沙比雅為他所管的本境修造。
english: Then came the Levites, Rehum, the son of Bani. By his side was working Hashabiah, ruler of half the division of Keilah, for his division.

chinese: 其次是利未人弟兄中管理基伊拉那一半、希拿達的兒子巴瓦伊修造。
english: After him were working their brothers, Bavvai, the son of Henadad, ruler of half the division of Keilah.

chinese: 其次是管理米斯巴、耶書亞的兒子以謝修造一段，對著武庫的上坡、城牆轉彎之處。
english: And by his side was working Ezer, the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, making good another part opposite the way up to the store of arms at the turning of the wall.

chinese: 其次是薩拜的兒子巴錄竭力修造一段，從城牆轉彎，直到大祭司以利亞實的府門。
english: After him Baruch, the son of Zabbai, was hard at work on another part, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib, the chief priest.

chinese: 其次是哈哥斯的孫子、烏利亞的兒子米利末修造一段，從以利亞實的府門，直到以利亞實府的盡頭。
english: After him Meremoth, the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, was working on another part, from the door of the house of Eliashib as far as the end of his house.

chinese: 其次是住平原的祭司修造。
english: After him were working the priests, the men of the lowland.

chinese: 其次是便雅憫與哈述對著自己的房屋修造。其次是亞難尼的孫子、瑪西雅的兒子亞撒利雅在靠近自己的房屋修造。
english: After them came Benjamin and Hasshub, opposite their house. After them Azariah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made good the wall by the house where he himself was living.

chinese: 其次是希拿達的兒子賓內修造一段，從亞撒利雅的房屋直到城牆轉彎，又到城角。
english: After him Binnui, the son of Henadad, was working on another part, from the house of Azariah as far as the turning of the wall and the angle.

chinese: 烏賽的兒子巴拉修造對著城牆的轉彎和王上宮凸出來的城樓，靠近護衛院的那一段。其次是巴錄的兒子毗大雅修造。
english: Palal, the son of Uzai, made good the wall opposite the angle and the tower which comes out from the higher part of the king's house, by the open space of the watch. After him was Pedaiah, the son of Parosh.

chinese: （尼提寧住在俄斐勒，直到朝東水門的對面和凸出來的城樓。）
english: (Now the Nethinim were living in the Ophel, as far as the place facing the water doorway to the east, and the tower which comes out.)

chinese: 其次是提哥亞人又修一段，對著那凸出來的大樓，直到俄斐勒的牆。
english: After him the Tekoites were making good another part, opposite the great tower which comes out, and up to the wall of the Ophel.

chinese: 從馬門往上，眾祭司各對自己的房屋修造。
english: Further on, past the horse doorway, the priests were at work, every one opposite his house.

chinese: 其次是音麥的兒子撒督對著自己的房屋修造。其次是守東門、示迦尼的兒子示瑪雅修造。
english: After them Zadok, the son of Immer, was working opposite his house. And after him Shemaiah, the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east door.

chinese: 其次是示利米雅的兒子哈拿尼雅和薩拉的第六子哈嫩又修一段。其次是比利迦的兒子米書蘭對著自己的房屋修造。
english: After him Hananiah, the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, were making good another part. After him Meshullam, the son of Berechiah, made good the wall opposite his room.

chinese: 其次是銀匠瑪基雅修造到尼提寧和商人的房屋，對著哈米弗甲門，直到城的角樓。
english: After him Malchijah, one of the gold-workers to the Nethinim and the traders, made good the wall opposite the doorway of Hammiphkad and as far as the way up to the angle.

chinese: 銀匠與商人在城的角樓和羊門中間修造。
english: And between the way up to the angle and the sheep door, the gold-workers and the traders made good the wall.

chinese: 參巴拉聽見我們修造城牆就發怒，大大惱恨，嗤笑猶大人，
english: Now, Sanballat, hearing that we were building the wall, was very angry, and in his wrath made sport of the Jews.

chinese: 對他弟兄和撒瑪利亞的軍兵說：這些軟弱的猶大人做甚麼呢？要保護自己麼？要獻祭麼？要一日成功麼？要從土堆裡拿出火燒的石頭再立牆麼？
english: And in the hearing of his countrymen and the army of Samaria he said, What are these feeble Jews doing? will they make themselves strong? will they make offerings? will they get the work done in a day? will they make the stones which have been burned come again out of the dust?

chinese: 亞捫人多比雅站在旁邊，說：他們所修造的石牆，就是狐狸上去也必跐倒。
english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Such is their building that if a fox goes up it, their stone wall will be broken down.

chinese: 我們的神啊，求你垂聽，因為我們被藐視。求你使他們的毀謗歸於他們的頭上，使他們在擄到之地作為掠物。
english: Give ear, O our God, for we are looked down on: let their words of shame be turned back on themselves, and let them be given up to wasting in a land where they are prisoners:

chinese: 不要遮掩他們的罪孽，不要使他們的罪惡從你面前塗抹，因為他們在修造的人眼前惹動你的怒氣。
english: Let not their wrongdoing be covered or their sin washed away from before you: for they have made you angry before the builders.

chinese: 這樣，我們修造城牆，城牆就都連絡，高至一半，因為百姓專心做工。
english: So we went on building the wall; and all the wall was joined together half-way up: for the people were working hard.

chinese: 參巴拉、多比雅、亞拉伯人、亞捫人、亞實突人聽見修造耶路撒冷城牆，著手進行堵塞破裂的地方，就甚發怒。
english: But when it came to the ears of Sanballat and Tobiah and the Arabians and the Ammonites and the Ashdodites, that the building of the walls of Jerusalem was going forward and the broken places were being made good, they were full of wrath;

chinese: 大家同謀要來攻擊耶路撒冷，使城內擾亂。
english: And they made designs, all of them together, to come and make an attack on Jerusalem, causing trouble there.

chinese: 然而，我們禱告我們的神，又因他們的緣故，就派人看守，晝夜防備。
english: But we made our prayer to God, and had men on watch against them day and night because of them.

chinese: 猶大人說：灰土尚多，扛抬的人力氣已經衰敗，所以我們不能建造城牆。
english: And Judah said, The strength of the workmen is giving way, and there is much waste material; it is impossible for us to put up the wall.

chinese: 我們的敵人且說：趁他們不知不見，我們進入他們中間，殺他們，使工作止住。
english: And those who were against us said, Without their knowledge and without their seeing us, we will come among them and put them to death, causing the work to come to a stop.

chinese: 那靠近敵人居住的猶大人十次從各處來見我們，說：你們必要回到我們那裡。
english: And it came about that when the Jews who were living near them came, they said to us ten times, From all directions they are coming against us.

chinese: 所以我使百姓各按宗族拿刀、拿槍、拿弓站在城牆後邊低窪的空處。
english: So in the lowest part of the space at the back of the walls, in the open places, I put the people by families, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

chinese: 我察看了，就起來對貴冑、官長，和其餘的人說：不要怕他們！當記念主是大而可畏的。你們要為弟兄、兒女、妻子、家產爭戰。
english: And after looking, I got up and said to the great ones and to the chiefs and to the rest of the people, Have no fear of them: keep in mind the Lord who is great and greatly to be feared, and take up arms for your brothers, your sons, and your daughters, your wives and your houses.

chinese: 仇敵聽見我們知道他們的心意，見神也破壞他們的計謀，就不來了。我們都回到城牆那裡，各做各的工。
english: And when it came to the ears of those who were against us, that we had knowledge of their designs and that God had made their purpose come to nothing, we all went back to the wall, everyone to his work

chinese: 從那日起，我的僕人一半做工，一半拿槍、拿盾牌、拿弓、穿（或譯：拿）鎧甲，官長都站在猶大眾人的後邊。
english: And from that time, half of my servants were doing their part of the work, and half kept the spears and body-covers and the bows and the metal war-dresses; and the chiefs were at the back of the men of Judah.

chinese: 修造城牆的，扛抬材料的，都一手做工一手拿兵器。
english: Those who were building the wall and those who were moving material did their part, everyone working with one hand, with his spear in the other;

chinese: 修造的人都腰間佩刀修造，吹角的人在我旁邊。
english: Every builder was working with his sword at his side. And by my side was a man for sounding the horn.

chinese: 我對貴冑、官長，和其餘的人說：這工程浩大，我們在城牆上相離甚遠；
english: And I said to the great ones and the chiefs and the rest of the people, The work is great and widely spaced and we are far away from one another on the wall:

chinese: 你們聽見角聲在哪裡，就聚集到我們那裡去。我們的神必為我們爭戰。
english: Wherever you may be when the horn is sounded, come here to us; our God will be fighting for us.

chinese: 於是，我們做工，一半拿兵器，從天亮直到星宿出現的時候。
english: So we went on with the work: and half of them had spears in their hands from the dawn of the morning till the stars were seen.

chinese: 那時，我又對百姓說：各人和他的僕人當在耶路撒冷住宿，好在夜間保守我們，白晝做工。
english: And at the same time I said to the people, Let everyone with his servant come inside Jerusalem for the night, so that at night they may keep watch for us, and go on working by day.

chinese: 這樣，我和弟兄僕人，並跟從我的護兵都不脫衣服，出去打水也帶兵器。
english: So not one of us, I or my brothers or my servants or the watchmen who were with me, took off his clothing, everyone went armed to the water.

chinese: 百姓和他們的妻大大呼號，埋怨他們的弟兄猶大人。
english: Then there was a great outcry from the people and their wives against their countrymen the Jews.

chinese: 有的說：我們和兒女人口眾多，要去得糧食度命；
english: For there were some who said, We, our sons and our daughters, are a great number: let us get grain, so that we may have food for our needs.

chinese: 有的說：我們典了田地、葡萄園、房屋，要得糧食充飢；
english: And there were some who said, We are giving our fields and our vine-gardens and our houses for debt: let us get grain because we are in need.

chinese: 有的說：我們已經指著田地、葡萄園，借了錢給王納稅。
english: And there were others who said, We have given up our fields and our vine-gardens to get money for the king's taxes.

chinese: 我們的身體與我們弟兄的身體一樣；我們的兒女與他們的兒女一般。現在我們將要使兒女作人的僕婢，我們的女兒已有為婢的；我們並無力拯救，因為我們的田地、葡萄園已經歸了別人。
english: But our flesh is the same as the flesh of our countrymen, and our children as their children: and now we are giving our sons and daughters into the hands of others, to be their servants, and some of our daughters are servants even now: and we have no power to put a stop to it; for other men have our fields and our vine-gardens.

chinese: 我聽見他們呼號說這些話，便甚發怒。
english: And on hearing their outcry and what they said I was very angry.

chinese: 我心裡籌劃，就斥責貴冑和官長說：你們各人向弟兄取利！於是我招聚大會攻擊他們。
english: And after turning it over in my mind, I made a protest to the chiefs and the rulers, and said to them, Every one of you is taking interest from his countryman. And I got together a great meeting of protest.

chinese: 我對他們說：我們盡力贖回我們弟兄，就是賣與外邦的猶大人；你們還要賣弟兄，使我們贖回來麼？他們就靜默不語，無話可答。
english: And I said to them, We have given whatever we were able to give, to make our brothers the Jews free, who were servants and prisoners of the nations: and would you now give up your brothers for a price, and are they to become our property? Then they said nothing, answering not a word.

chinese: 我又說：你們所行的不善！你們行事不當敬畏我們的神麼？不然，難免我們的仇敵外邦人毀謗我們。
english: And I said, What you are doing is not good: is it not the more necessary for you to go in the fear of our God, because of the shame which the nations may put on us?

chinese: 我和我的弟兄與僕人也將銀錢糧食借給百姓；我們大家都當免去利息。
english: Even I and my servants have been taking interest for the money and the grain we have let them have. So now, let us give up this thing.

chinese: 如今我勸你們將他們的田地、葡萄園、橄欖園、房屋，並向他們所取的銀錢、糧食、新酒，和油，百分之一的利息都歸還他們。
english: Give back to them this very day their fields, their vine-gardens, their olive-gardens, and their houses, as well as a hundredth part of the money and the grain and the wine and the oil which you have taken from them.

chinese: 眾人說：我們必歸還，不再向他們索要，必照你的話行。我就召了祭司來，叫眾人起誓，必照著所應許的而行。
english: Then they said, We will give them back, and take nothing for them; we will do as you say. Then I sent for the priests and made them take an oath that they would keep this agreement.

chinese: 我也抖著胸前的衣襟，說：凡不成就這應許的，願神照樣抖他離開家產和他勞碌得來的，直到抖空了。會眾都說：阿們！又讚美耶和華。百姓就照著所應許的去行。
english: And shaking out the folds of my robe, I said, So may God send out from his house and his work every man who does not keep this agreement; even so let him be sent out and made as nothing. And all the meeting of the people said, So be it, and gave praise to the Lord. And the people did as they had said.

chinese: 自從我奉派作猶大地的省長，就是從亞達薛西王二十年直到三十二年，共十二年之久，我與我弟兄都沒有吃省長的俸祿。
english: Now from the time when I was made ruler of the people in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year till the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, for twelve years, I and my servants have never taken the food which was the right of the ruler.

chinese: 在我以前的省長加重百姓的擔子，每日索要糧食和酒，並銀子四十舍客勒，就是他們的僕人也轄制百姓；但我因敬畏神不這樣行。
english: But earlier rulers who were before me made the people responsible for their upkeep, and took from them bread and wine at the rate of forty shekels of silver; and even their servants were lords over the people: but I did not do so, because of the fear of God.

chinese: 並且我恆心修造城牆，並沒有置買田地；我的僕人也都聚集在那裡做工。
english: And I kept on with the work of this wall, and we got no land for ourselves: and all my servants were helping with the work.

chinese: 除了從四圍外邦中來的猶大人以外，有猶大平民和官長一百五十人在我席上吃飯。
english: And more than this, a hundred and fifty of the Jews and the rulers were guests at my table, in addition to those who came to us from the nations round about us.

chinese: 每日預備一隻公牛，六隻肥羊，又預備些飛禽；每十日一次，多預備各樣的酒。雖然如此，我並不要省長的俸祿，因為百姓服役甚重。
english: Now the food made ready for one day was one ox and six fat sheep, as well as fowls; and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine: but all the same, I did not take the food to which the ruler had a right, because the people were crushed under a hard yoke.

chinese: 我的神啊，求你記念我為這百姓所行的一切事，施恩與我。
english: Keep in mind, O my God, for my good, all I have done for this people.

chinese: 參巴拉、多比雅、亞拉伯人基善和我們其餘的仇敵聽見我已經修完了城牆，其中沒有破裂之處（那時我還沒有安門扇），
english: Now when word was given to Sanballat and Tobiah and to Geshem the Arabian and to the rest of our haters, that I had done the building of the wall and that there were no more broken places in it (though even then I had not put up the doors in the doorways);

chinese: 參巴拉和基善就打發人來見我，說：請你來，我們在阿挪平原的一個村莊相會。他們卻想害我。
english: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me saying, Come, let us have a meeting in one of the little towns in the lowland of Ono. But their purpose was to do me evil.

chinese: 於是我差遣人去見他們，說：我現在辦理大工，不能下去。焉能停工下去見你們呢？
english: And I sent men to them saying, I am doing a great work, so that it is not possible for me to come down: is the work to be stopped while I go away from it and come down to you?

chinese: 他們這樣四次打發人來見我，我都如此回答他們。
english: And four times they sent to me in this way, and I sent them the same answer.

chinese: 參巴拉第五次打發僕人來見我，手裡拿著未封的信，
english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me a fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

chinese: 信上寫著說：外邦人中有風聲，迦施慕（就是基善，見二章十九節）也說，你和猶大人謀反，修造城牆，你要作他們的王；
english: And in it these words were recorded: It is said among the nations, and Geshem says so, that you and the Jews are hoping to make yourselves free from the king's authority; and that this is why you are building the wall: and they say that it is your purpose to be their king;

chinese: 你又派先知在耶路撒冷指著你宣講，說在猶大有王。現在這話必傳與王知；所以請你來，與我們彼此商議。
english: And that you have prophets preaching about you in Jerusalem, and saying, There is a king in Judah: now an account of these things will be sent to the king. So come now, and let us have a discussion.

chinese: 我就差遣人去見他，說：你所說的這事，一概沒有，是你心裡捏造的。
english: Then I sent to him, saying, No such things as you say are being done, they are only a fiction you have made up yourself.

chinese: 他們都要使我們懼怕，意思說，他們的手必軟弱，以致工作不能成就。神啊，求你堅固我的手。
english: For they were hoping to put fear in us, saying, Their hands will become feeble and give up the work so that it may not get done. But now, O God, make my hands strong.

chinese: 我到了米希大別的孫子、第來雅的兒子示瑪雅家裡；那時，他閉門不出。他說：我們不如在神的殿裡會面，將殿門關鎖；因為他們要來殺你，就是夜裡來殺你。
english: And I went to the house of Shemaiah, the son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us have a meeting in the house of God, inside the Temple, and let the doors be shut: for they will come to put you to death; truly, in the night they will come to put you to death.

chinese: 我說：像我這樣的人豈要逃跑呢？像我這樣的人豈能進入殿裡保全生命呢？我不進去！
english: And I said, Am I the sort of man to go in flight? what man, in my position, would go into the Temple to keep himself safe? I will not go in.

chinese: 我看明神沒有差遣他，是他自己說這話攻擊我，是多比雅和參巴拉賄買了他。
english: Then it became clear to me that God had not sent him: he had given this word of a prophet against me himself: and Tobiah and Sanballat had given him money to do so.

chinese: 賄買他的緣故，是要叫我懼怕，依從他犯罪，他們好傳揚惡言毀謗我。
english: For this reason they had given him money, in order that I might be overcome by fear and do what he said and do wrong, and so they would have reason to say evil about me and put shame on me.

chinese: 我的神啊，多比雅、參巴拉、女先知挪亞底，和其餘的先知要叫我懼怕，求你記念他們所行的這些事。
english: Keep in mind, O my God, Tobiah and Sanballat and what they did, and Noadiah, the woman prophet, and the rest of the prophets whose purpose was to put fear into me.

chinese: 以祿月二十五日，城牆修完了，共修了五十二天。
english: So the wall was complete on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.

chinese: 我們一切仇敵、四圍的外邦人聽見了便懼怕，愁眉不展；因為見這工作完成是出乎我們的神。
english: And when our haters had news of this, all the nations round about us were full of fear and were greatly shamed, for they saw that this work had been done by our God.

chinese: 在那些日子，猶大的貴冑屢次寄信與多比雅，多比雅也來信與他們。
english: And further, in those days the chiefs of Judah sent a number of letters to Tobiah, and his letters came to them.

chinese: 在猶大有許多人與多比雅結盟；因他是亞拉的兒子，示迦尼的女婿，並且他的兒子約哈難娶了比利迦兒子米書蘭的女兒為妻。
english: For in Judah there were a number of people who had made an agreement by oath with him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah, the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken as his wife the daughter of Meshullam, the son of Berechiah.

chinese: 他們常在我面前說多比雅的善行，也將我的話傳與他。多比雅又常寄信來，要叫我懼怕。
english: And they said much before me of the good he had done, and gave him accounts of my words. And Tobiah sent letters with the purpose of causing me fear.

chinese: 城牆修完，我安了門扇，守門的、歌唱的，和利未人都已派定。
english: Now when the building of the wall was complete and I had put up the doors, and the door-keepers and the music-makers and the Levites had been given their places,

chinese: 我就派我的弟兄哈拿尼和營樓的宰官哈拿尼雅管理耶路撒冷；因為哈拿尼雅是忠信的，又敬畏神過於眾人。
english: I made my brother Hanani, and Hananiah, the ruler of the tower, responsible for the government of Jerusalem: for he was a man of good faith, fearing God more than most.

chinese: 我吩咐他們說：等到太陽上升才可開耶路撒冷的城門；人尚看守的時候就要關門上閂；也當派耶路撒冷的居民各按班次看守自己房屋對面之處。
english: And I said to them, Do not let the doors of Jerusalem be open till the sun is high; and while the watchmen are in their places, let the doors be shut and locked: and let the people of Jerusalem be put on watch, every one in his watch, opposite his house.

chinese: 城是廣大，其中的民卻稀少，房屋還沒有建造。
english: Now the town was wide and great: but the people in it were only a small number, and the houses had not been put up.

chinese: 我的神感動我心，招聚貴冑、官長，和百姓，要照家譜計算。我找著第一次上來之人的家譜，其上寫著：
english: And my God put it into my heart to get together the rulers and the chiefs and the people so that they might be listed by families. And I came across a record of the names of those who came up at the first, and in it I saw these words:

chinese: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒從前擄去猶大省的人，現在他們的子孫從被擄到之地回耶路撒冷和猶大，各歸本城。
english: These are the people of the divisions of the kingdom, among those who had been made prisoners by Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, and taken away by him, who went back to Jerusalem and Judah, every one to his town;

chinese: 他們是同著所羅巴伯、耶書亞、尼希米、亞撒利雅、拉米、拿哈瑪尼、末底改、必珊、米斯毗列、比革瓦伊、尼宏、巴拿回來的。
english: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

chinese: 以色列人民的數目記在下面：巴錄的子孫二千一百七十二名；
english: The children of Parosh, two thousand, one hundred and seventy-two.

chinese: 示法提雅的子孫三百七十二名；
english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.

chinese: 亞拉的子孫六百五十二名；
english: The children of Arah, six hundred and fifty-two.

chinese: 巴哈摩押的後裔，就是耶書亞和約押的子孫二千八百一十八名；
english: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand, eight hundred and eighteen.

chinese: 以攔的子孫一千二百五十四名；
english: The children of Elam, a thousand, two hundred and fifty-four.

chinese: 薩土的子孫八百四十五名；
english: The children of Zattu, eight hundred and forty-five.

chinese: 薩改的子孫七百六十名；
english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

chinese: 賓內的子孫六百四十八名；
english: The children of Binnui, six hundred and forty-eight.

chinese: 比拜的子孫六百二十八名；
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-eight.

chinese: 押甲的子孫二千三百二十二名；
english: The children of Azgad, two thousand, three hundred and twenty-two.

chinese: 亞多尼干的子孫六百六十七名；
english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-seven.

chinese: 比革瓦伊的子孫二千零六十七名；
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand and sixty-seven.

chinese: 亞丁的子孫六百五十五名；
english: The children of Adin, six hundred and fifty-five.

chinese: 亞特的後裔，就是希西家的子孫九十八名；
english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

chinese: 哈順的子孫三百二十八名；
english: The children of Hashum, three hundred and twenty-eight.

chinese: 比賽的子孫三百二十四名；
english: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-four.

chinese: 哈拉的子孫一百一十二名；
english: The children of Hariph, a hundred and twelve.

chinese: 基遍人九十五名；
english: The children of Gibeon, ninety-five.

chinese: 伯利恆人和尼陀法人共一百八十八名；
english: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, a hundred and eighty-eight.

chinese: 亞拿突人一百二十八名；
english: The men of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.

chinese: 伯亞斯瑪弗人四十二名；
english: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty-two.

chinese: 基列耶琳人、基非拉人、比錄人共七百四十三名；
english: The men of Kiriath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three.

chinese: 拉瑪人和迦巴人共六百二十一名；
english: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.

chinese: 默瑪人一百二十二名；
english: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty-two.

chinese: 伯特利人和艾人共一百二十三名；
english: The men of Beth-el and Ai, a hundred and twenty-three.

chinese: 別的尼波人五十二名；
english: The men of the other Nebo, fifty-two.

chinese: 別的以攔子孫一千二百五十四名；
english: The children of the other Elam, a thousand, two hundred and fifty-four.

chinese: 哈琳的子孫三百二十名；
english: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

chinese: 耶利哥人三百四十五名；
english: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.

chinese: 羅德人、哈第人、阿挪人共七百二十一名；
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-one.

chinese: 西拿人三千九百三十名。
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand, nine hundred and thirty.

chinese: 祭司：耶書亞家，耶大雅的子孫九百七十三名；
english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the family of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.

chinese: 音麥的子孫一千零五十二名；
english: The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty-two.

chinese: 巴施戶珥的子孫一千二百四十七名；
english: The children of Pashhur, a thousand, two hundred and forty-seven.

chinese: 哈琳的子孫一千零一十七名。
english: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

chinese: 利未人：何達威的後裔，就是耶書亞和甲篾的子孫七十四名。
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah, seventy-four.

chinese: 歌唱的：亞薩的子孫一百四十八名。
english: The music-makers: the children of Asaph, a hundred and forty-eight.

chinese: 守門的：沙龍的子孫、亞特的子孫、達們的子孫、亞谷的子孫、哈底大的子孫、朔拜的子孫，共一百三十八名。
english: The door-keepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, a hundred and thirty-eight.

chinese: 尼提寧（就是殿役）：西哈的子孫、哈蘇巴的子孫、答巴俄的子孫、
english: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

chinese: 基綠的子孫、西亞的子孫、巴頓的子孫、
english: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

chinese: 利巴拿的子孫、哈迦巴的子孫、薩買的子孫、
english: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

chinese: 哈難的子孫、吉德的子孫、迦哈的子孫、
english: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

chinese: 利亞雅的子孫、利汛的子孫、尼哥大的子孫、
english: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

chinese: 迦散的子孫、烏撒的子孫、巴西亞的子孫、
english: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,

chinese: 比賽的子孫、米烏寧的子孫、尼普心的子孫、
english: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,

chinese: 巴卜的子孫、哈古巴的子孫、哈忽的子孫、
english: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

chinese: 巴洗律的子孫、米希大的子孫、哈沙的子孫、
english: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

chinese: 巴柯的子孫、西西拉的子孫、答瑪的子孫、
english: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

chinese: 尼細亞的子孫、哈提法的子孫。
english: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

chinese: 所羅門僕人的後裔，就是瑣太的子孫、瑣斐列的子孫、比路大的子孫、
english: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

chinese: 雅拉的子孫、達昆的子孫、吉德的子孫、
english: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

chinese: 示法提雅的子孫、哈替的子孫、玻黑列哈斯巴音的子孫、亞們的子孫。
english: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth-hazzebaim, the children of Amon.

chinese: 尼提寧和所羅門僕人的後裔共三百九十二名。
english: All the Nethinim and the children of Solomon's servants were three hundred and ninety-two.

chinese: 從特米拉、特哈薩、基綠、亞頓、音麥上來的，不能指明他們的宗族譜系是以色列人不是；
english: All these were the people who went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but because they had no knowledge of their fathers' families or offspring, it was not certain if they were Israelites:

chinese: 他們是第萊雅的子孫、多比雅的子孫、尼哥大的子孫，共六百四十二名。
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and forty-two.

chinese: 祭司中，哈巴雅的子孫、哈哥斯的子孫、巴西萊的子孫；因為他們的先祖娶了基列人巴西萊的女兒為妻，所以起名叫巴西萊。
english: And of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who was married to one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and took their name.

chinese: 這三家的人在族譜之中尋查自己的譜系，卻尋不著，因此算為不潔，不准供祭司的職任。
english: They made search for their record among the lists of families, but their names were nowhere to be seen, so they were looked on as unclean and no longer priests.

chinese: 省長對他們說：不可吃至聖的物，直到有用烏陵和土明決疑的祭司興起來。
english: And the Tirshatha said that they were not to have the most holy things for their food, till a priest came to give decision by the Urim and Thummim.

chinese: 會眾共有四萬二千三百六十名。
english: The number of all the people together was forty-two thousand, three hundred and sixty;

chinese: 此外，還有他們的僕婢七千三百三十七名，又有歌唱的男女二百四十五名。
english: As well as their men-servants and their women-servants, of whom there were seven thousand, three hundred and thirty-seven; and they had two hundred and forty-five men and women to make music.

chinese: 他們有馬七百三十六匹，騾子二百四十五匹，
english: They had seven hundred and thirty-six horses, two hundred and forty-five transport beasts;

chinese: 駱駝四百三十五隻，驢六千七百二十匹。
english: Four hundred and thirty-five camels, six thousand, seven hundred and twenty asses.

chinese: 有些族長為工程捐助。省長捐入庫中的金子一千達利克，碗五十個，祭司的禮服五百三十件。
english: And some of the heads of families gave money for the work. The Tirshatha gave into the store a thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, five hundred and thirty priests' robes.

chinese: 又有族長捐入工程庫的金子二萬達利克，銀子二千二百彌拿。
english: And some of the heads of families gave into the store for the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand, two hundred pounds of silver.

chinese: 其餘百姓所捐的金子二萬達利克，銀子二千彌拿，祭司的禮服六十七件。
english: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and sixty-seven priests' robes.

chinese: 於是祭司、利未人、守門的、歌唱的、民中的一些人、尼提寧，並以色列眾人，各住在自己的城裡。
english: So the priests and the Levites and the door-keepers and the music-makers and some of the people and the Nethinim, and all Israel, were living in their towns.

chinese: 到了七月，以色列人住在自己的城裡。那時，他們如同一人聚集在水門前的寬闊處，請文士以斯拉將耶和華藉摩西傳給以色列人的律法書帶來。
english: And when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their towns. And all the people came together like one man into the wide place in front of the water-doorway; and they made a request to Ezra the scribe that he would put before them the book of the law of Moses which the Lord had given to Israel.

chinese: 七月初一日，祭司以斯拉將律法書帶到聽了能明白的男女會眾面前。
english: And Ezra the priest put the law before the meeting of the people, before the men and women and all those who were able to take it in, on the first day of the seventh month.

chinese: 在水門前的寬闊處，從清早到晌午，在眾男女、一切聽了能明白的人面前讀這律法書。眾民側耳而聽。
english: He was reading it in the wide place in front of the water-doorway, from early morning till the middle of the day, in the hearing of all those men and women whose minds were able to take it in; and the ears of all the people were open to the book of the law.

chinese: 文士以斯拉站在為這事特備的木臺上。瑪他提雅、示瑪、亞奈雅、烏利亞、希勒家，和瑪西雅站在他的右邊；毗大雅、米沙利、瑪基雅、哈順、哈拔大拿、撒迦利亞，和米書蘭站在他的左邊。
english: And Ezra the scribe took his place on a tower of wood which they had made for the purpose; and by his side were placed Mattithiah and Shema and Anaiah and Uriah and Hilkiah and Maaseiah on the right; and on the left, Pedaiah and Mishael and Malchijah and Hashum and Hashbaddanah, Zechariah and Meshullam.

chinese: 以斯拉站在眾民以上，在眾民眼前展開這書。他一展開，眾民就都站起來。
english: And Ezra took the book, opening it before the eyes of all the people (for he was higher than the people); and when it was open, all the people got to their feet:

chinese: 以斯拉稱頌耶和華至大的神；眾民都舉手應聲說：阿們！阿們！就低頭，面伏於地，敬拜耶和華。
english: And Ezra gave praise to the Lord, the great God. And all the people in answer said, So be it, so be it; lifting up their hands; and with bent heads they gave worship to the Lord, going down on their faces to the earth.

chinese: 耶書亞、巴尼、示利比、雅憫、亞谷、沙比太、荷第雅、瑪西雅、基利他、亞撒利雅、約撒拔、哈難、毗萊雅，和利未人使百姓明白律法；百姓都站在自己的地方。
english: And Jeshua and Bani and Sherebiah and Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites made the law clear to the people: and the people kept in their places.

chinese: 他們清清楚楚地念神的律法書，講明意思，使百姓明白所念的。
english: And they gave out the words of the book the law of God, clearly, and gave the sense of it, so that their minds were able to take it in.

chinese: 省長尼希米和作祭司的文士以斯拉，並教訓百姓的利未人，對眾民說：今日是耶和華─你們神的聖日，不要悲哀哭泣。這是因為眾民聽見律法書上的話都哭了；
english: And Nehemiah, who was the Tirshatha, and Ezra, the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were the teachers of the people, said to all the people, This day is holy to the Lord your God; let there be no sorrow or weeping; for all the people were weeping on hearing the words of the law.

chinese: 又對他們說：你們去吃肥美的，喝甘甜的，有不能預備的就分給他，因為今日是我們主的聖日。你們不要憂愁，因靠耶和華而得的喜樂是你們的力量。
english: Then he said to them, Go away now, and take the fat for your food and the sweet for your drink, and send some to him for whom nothing is made ready: for this day is holy to our Lord: and let there be no grief in your hearts; for the joy of the Lord is your strong place.

chinese: 於是利未人使眾民靜默，說：今日是聖日；不要作聲，也不要憂愁。
english: So the Levites made all the people quiet, saying, Be quiet, for the day is holy; and do not give way to grief.

chinese: 眾民都去吃喝，也分給人，大大快樂，因為他們明白所教訓他們的話。
english: And all the people went away to take food and drink, and to send food to others, and to be glad, because the words which were said to them had been made clear.

chinese: 次日，眾民的族長、祭司，和利未人都聚集到文士以斯拉那裡，要留心聽律法上的話。
english: And on the second day the heads of families of all the people and the priests and the Levites came together to Ezra the scribe, to give attention to the words of the law.

chinese: 他們見律法上寫著，耶和華藉摩西吩咐以色列人要在七月節住棚，
english: And they saw that it was recorded in the law that the Lord had given orders by Moses, that the children of Israel were to have tents for their living-places in the feast of the seventh month:

chinese: 並要在各城和耶路撒冷宣傳報告說：你們當上山，將橄欖樹、野橄欖樹、番石榴樹、棕樹，和各樣茂密樹的枝子取來，照著所寫的搭棚。
english: And that they were to give out an order, and make it public in all their towns and in Jerusalem, saying, Go out to the mountain and get olive branches and branches of field olives and of myrtle, and palm branches and branches of thick trees, to make tents, as it says in the book.

chinese: 於是百姓出去，取了樹枝來，各人在自己的房頂上，或院內，或神殿的院內，或水門的寬闊處，或以法蓮門的寬闊處搭棚。
english: And the people went out and got them and made themselves tents, every one on the roof of his house, and in the open spaces and in the open squares of the house of God, and in the wide place of the water-doorway, and the wide place of the doorway of Ephraim.

chinese: 從擄到之地歸回的全會眾就搭棚，住在棚裡。從嫩的兒子約書亞的時候直到這日，以色列人沒有這樣行。於是眾人大大喜樂。
english: All the people who had been prisoners and had come back, made tents and were living in them: for from the time of Jeshua, the son of Nun, till that day, the children of Israel had not done so. And there was very great joy.

chinese: 從頭一天直到末一天，以斯拉每日念神的律法書。眾人守節七日，第八日照例有嚴肅會。
english: And day by day, from the first day till the last, he was reading from the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast for seven days: and on the eighth day there was a holy meeting, as it is ordered in the law.

chinese: 這月二十四日，以色列人聚集禁食，身穿麻衣，頭蒙灰塵。
english: Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel came together, taking no food and putting haircloth and dust on their bodies.

chinese: 以色列人（人：原文是種類）就與一切外邦人離絕，站著承認自己的罪惡和列祖的罪孽。
english: And the seed of Israel made themselves separate from all the men of other nations, publicly requesting forgiveness for their sins and the wrongdoing of their fathers.

chinese: 那日的四分之一站在自己的地方念耶和華─他們神的律法書，又四分之一認罪，敬拜耶和華─他們的　神。
english: And for a fourth part of the day, upright in their places, they were reading from the book of the law of their God; and for a fourth part of the day they were requesting forgiveness and worshipping the Lord their God.

chinese: 耶書亞、巴尼、甲篾、示巴尼、布尼、示利比、巴尼、基拿尼站在利未人的臺上，大聲哀求耶和華─他們的神。
english: Then Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani took their places on the steps of the Levites, crying in a loud voice to the Lord their God.

chinese: 利未人耶書亞、甲篾、巴尼、哈沙尼、示利比、荷第雅、示巴尼、毗他希雅說：你們要站起來稱頌耶和華─你們的神，永世無盡。耶和華啊，你榮耀之名是應當稱頌的！超乎一切稱頌和讚美。
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said, Get up and give praise to the Lord your God for ever and ever. Praise be to your great name which is lifted up high over all blessing and praise.

chinese: 你，惟獨你是耶和華！你造了天和天上的天，並天上的萬象，地和地上的萬物，海和海中所有的；這一切都是你所保存的。天軍也都敬拜你。
english: You are the Lord, even you only; you have made heaven, the heaven of heavens with all their armies, the earth and all things in it, the seas and everything in them; and you keep them from destruction: and the armies of heaven are your worshippers.

chinese: 你是耶和華神，曾揀選亞伯蘭，領他出迦勒底的吾珥，給他改名叫亞伯拉罕。
english: You are the Lord, the God, who took Abram and made him yours, guiding him from Ur of the Chaldees, and gave him the name of Abraham;

chinese: 你見他在你面前心裡誠實，就與他立約，應許把迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、革迦撒人之地賜給他的後裔，且應驗了你的話，因為你是公義的。
english: You saw that his heart was true to you, and made an agreement with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Jebusite and the Girgashite, even to give it to his seed, and you have done what you said; for righteousness is yours:

chinese: 你曾看見我們列祖在埃及所受的困苦，垂聽他們在紅海邊的哀求，
english: And you saw the trouble of our fathers in Egypt, and their cry came to your ears by the Red Sea;

chinese: 就施行神蹟奇事在法老和他一切臣僕，並他國中的眾民身上。你也得了名聲，正如今日一樣，因為你知道他們向我們列祖行事狂傲。
english: And you did signs and wonders on Pharaoh and all his servants and all the people of his land; for you saw how cruel they were to them. So you got yourself a name as it is today.

chinese: 你又在我們列祖面前把海分開，使他們在海中行走乾地，將追趕他們的人拋在深海，如石頭拋在大水中；
english: By you the sea was parted before them, so that they went through the sea on dry land; and those who went after them went down into the deep, like a stone into great waters.

chinese: 並且白晝用雲柱引導他們，黑夜用火柱照亮他們當行的路。
english: And you went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light on the way they were to go.

chinese: 你也降臨在西乃山，從天上與他們說話，賜給他們正直的典章、真實的律法、美好的條例與誡命，
english: And you came down on Mount Sinai, and your voice came to them from heaven, giving them right decisions and true laws, good rules and orders:

chinese: 又使他們知道你的安息聖日，並藉你僕人摩西傳給他們誡命、條例、律法。
english: And you gave them word of your holy Sabbath, and gave them orders and rules and a law, by the hand of Moses your servant:

chinese: 從天上賜下糧食充他們的飢，從磐石使水流出解他們的渴，又吩咐他們進去得你起誓應許賜給他們的地。
english: And you gave them bread from heaven when they were in need, and made water come out of the rock for their drink, and gave them orders to go in and take for their heritage the land which your hand had been lifted up to give them.

chinese: 但我們的列祖行事狂傲，硬著頸項不聽從你的誡命；
english: But they and our fathers, in their pride, made their necks stiff, and gave no attention to your orders,

chinese: 不肯順從，也不記念你在他們中間所行的奇事，竟硬著頸項，居心背逆，自立首領，要回他們為奴之地。但你是樂意饒恕人，有恩典，有憐憫，不輕易發怒，有豐盛慈愛的神，並不丟棄他們。
english: And would not do them, and gave no thought to the wonders you had done among them; but made their necks stiff, and turning away from you, made a captain over themselves to take them back to their prison in Egypt: but you are a God of forgiveness, full of grace and pity, slow to wrath and great in mercy, and you did not give them up.

chinese: 他們雖然鑄了一隻牛犢，彼此說這是領你出埃及的神，因而大大惹動你的怒氣；
english: Even when they had made for themselves an ox of metal, and said, This is your God who took you up out of Egypt, and had done so much to make you angry;

chinese: 你還是大施憐憫，在曠野不丟棄他們。白晝，雲柱不離開他們，仍引導他們行路；黑夜，火柱也不離開他們，仍照亮他們當行的路。
english: Even then, in your great mercy, you did not give them up in the waste land: the pillar of cloud still went before them by day, guiding them on their way, and the pillar of fire by night, to give them light, and make clear the way they were to go.

chinese: 你也賜下你良善的靈教訓他們；未嘗不賜嗎哪使他們糊口，並賜水解他們的渴。
