english: And Job's three friends had word of all this evil which had come on him. And they came every one from his place, Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite. So they came together to a meeting-place, in order that they might go and make clear to Job their grief for him, and give him comfort.

chinese: 他們遠遠地舉目觀看，認不出他來，就放聲大哭。各人撕裂外袍，把塵土向天揚起來，落在自己的頭上。
english: And lifting up their eyes when they were still far off, it did not seem that the man they saw was Job because of the change in him. And they gave way to bitter weeping, with signs of grief, and put dust on their heads.

chinese: 他們就同他七天七夜坐在地上，一個人也不向他說句話，因為他極其痛苦。
english: And they took their seats on the earth by his side for seven days and seven nights: but no one said a word to him, for they saw that his pain was very great.

chinese: 此後，約伯開口咒詛自己的生日，
english: Then, opening his mouth, and cursing the day of his birth,

chinese: 說：
english: Job made answer and said,

chinese: 願我生的那日和說懷了男胎的那夜都滅沒。
english: Let destruction take the day of my birth, and the night on which it was said, A man child has come into the world.

chinese: 願那日變為黑暗；願神不從上面尋找他；願亮光不照於其上。
english: That day--let it be dark; let not God take note of it from on high, and let not the light be shining on it;

chinese: 願黑暗和死蔭索取那日；願密雲停在其上；願日蝕恐嚇他。
english: Let the dark and the black night take it for themselves; let it be covered with a cloud; let the dark shades of day send fear on it.

chinese: 願那夜被幽暗奪取，不在年中的日子同樂，也不入月中的數目。
english: That night--let the thick dark take it; let it not have joy among the days of the year; let it not come into the number of the months.

chinese: 願那夜沒有生育，其間也沒有歡樂的聲音。
english: As for that night, let it have no fruit; let no voice of joy be sounded in it;

chinese: 願那咒詛日子且能惹動鱷魚的咒詛那夜。
english: Let it be cursed by those who put a curse on the day; who are ready to make Leviathan awake.

chinese: 願那夜黎明的星宿變為黑暗，盼亮卻不亮，也不見早晨的光線（原文是眼皮）；
english: Let its morning stars be dark; let it be looking for light, but may it not have any; let it not see the eyes of the dawn.

chinese: 因沒有把懷我胎的門關閉，也沒有將患難對我的眼隱藏。
english: Because it did not keep the doors of my mother's body shut, so that trouble might be veiled from my eyes.

chinese: 我為何不出母胎而死？為何不出母腹絕氣？
english: Why did death not take me when I came out of my mother's body, why did I not, when I came out, give up my last breath?

chinese: 為何有膝接收我？為何有奶哺養我？
english: Why did the knees take me, or why the breasts that they might give me milk?

chinese: 不然，我就早已躺臥安睡，
english: For then I might have gone to my rest in quiet, and in sleep have been in peace,

chinese: 和地上為自己重造荒邱的君王、謀士，
english: With kings and the wise ones of the earth, who put up great houses for themselves;

chinese: 或與有金子、將銀子裝滿了房屋的王子一同安息；
english: Or with rulers who had gold, and whose houses were full of silver;

chinese: 或像隱而未現、不到期而落的胎，歸於無有，如同未見光的嬰孩。
english: Or as a child dead at birth I might never have come into existence; like young children who have not seen the light.

chinese: 在那裡惡人止息攪擾，困乏人得享安息，
english: There the passions of the evil are over, and those whose strength has come to an end have rest.

chinese: 被囚的人同得安逸，不聽見督工的聲音。
english: There the prisoners are at peace together; the voice of the overseer comes not again to their ears.

chinese: 大小都在那裡；奴僕脫離主人的轄制。
english: The small and the great are there, and the servant is free from his master.

chinese: 受患難的人為何有光賜給他呢？心中愁苦的人為何有生命賜給他呢？
english: Why does he give light to him who is in trouble, and life to the bitter in soul;

chinese: 他們切望死，卻不得死；求死，勝於求隱藏的珍寶。
english: To those whose desire is for death, but it comes not; who are searching for it more than for secret wealth;

chinese: 他們尋見墳墓就快樂，極其歡喜。
english: Who are glad with great joy, and full of delight when they come to their last resting-place;

chinese: 人的道路既然遮隱，神又把他四面圍困，為何有光賜給他呢？
english: To a man whose way is veiled, and who is shut in by God?

chinese: 我未曾吃飯就發出歎息；我唉哼的聲音湧出如水。
english: In place of my food I have grief, and cries of sorrow come from me like water.

chinese: 因我所恐懼的臨到我身，我所懼怕的迎我而來。
english: For I have a fear and it comes on me, and my heart is greatly troubled.

chinese: 我不得安逸，不得平靜，也不得安息，卻有患難來到。
english: I have no peace, no quiet, and no rest; nothing but pain comes on me.

chinese: 提幔人以利法回答說：
english: And Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,

chinese: 人若想與你說話，你就厭煩麼？但誰能忍住不說呢？
english: If one says a word, will it be a weariness to you? but who is able to keep from saying what is in his mind?

chinese: 你素來教導許多的人，又堅固軟弱的手。
english: Truly, you have been a helper to others, and you have made feeble hands strong;

chinese: 你的言語曾扶助那將要跌倒的人；你又使軟弱的膝穩固。
english: He who was near to falling has been lifted up by your words, and you have given strength to bent knees.

chinese: 但現在禍患臨到你，你就昏迷，挨近你，你便驚惶。
english: But now it has come on you and it is a weariness to you; you are touched by it and your mind is troubled.

chinese: 你的倚靠不是在你敬畏神麼？你的盼望不是在你行事純正麼？
english: Is not your fear of God your support, and your upright way of life your hope?

chinese: 請你追想：無辜的人有誰滅亡？正直的人在何處剪除？
english: Have you ever seen destruction come to an upright man? or when were the god-fearing ever cut off?

chinese: 按我所見，耕罪孽、種毒害的人都照樣收割。
english: What I have seen is that those by whom trouble has been ploughed, and evil planted, get the same for themselves.

chinese: 神一出氣，他們就滅亡；神一發怒，他們就消沒。
english: By the breath of God destruction takes them, and by the wind of his wrath they are cut off.

chinese: 獅子的吼叫和猛獅的聲音盡都止息；少壯獅子的牙齒也都敲掉。
english: Though the noise of the lion and the sounding of his voice, may be loud, the teeth of the young lions are broken.

chinese: 老獅子因絕食而死；母獅之子也都離散。
english: The old lion comes to his end for need of food, and the young of the she-lion go wandering in all directions.

chinese: 我暗暗地得了默示；我耳朵也聽其細微的聲音。
english: A word was given to me secretly, and the low sound of it came to my ears.

chinese: 在思念夜中、異象之間，世人沉睡的時候，
english: In troubled thoughts from visions of the night, when deep sleep comes on men,

chinese: 恐懼、戰兢臨到我身，使我百骨打戰。
english: Fear came on me and shaking, and my bones were full of trouble;

chinese: 有靈從我面前經過，我身上的毫毛直立。
english: And a breath was moving over my face; the hair of my flesh became stiff:

chinese: 那靈停住，我卻不能辨其形狀；有影像在我眼前。我在靜默中聽見有聲音說：
english: Something was present before me, but I was not able to see it clearly; there was a form before my eyes: a quiet voice came to my ears, saying:

chinese: 必死的人豈能比神公義麼？人豈能比造他的主潔淨麼？
english: May a man be upright before God? or a man be clean before his Maker?

chinese: 主不信靠他的臣僕，並且指他的使者為愚昧；
english: Truly, he puts no faith in his servants, and he sees error in his angels;

chinese: 何況那住在土房、根基在塵土裡、被蠹蟲所毀壞的人呢？
english: How much more those living in houses of earth, whose bases are in the dust! They are crushed more quickly than an insect;

chinese: 早晚之間，就被毀滅，永歸無有，無人理會。
english: Between morning and evening they are completely broken; they come to an end for ever, and no one takes note.

chinese: 他帳棚的繩索豈不從中抽出來呢？他死，且是無智慧而死。
english: If their tent-cord is pulled up, do they not come to an end, and without wisdom?

chinese: 你且呼求，有誰答應你？諸聖者之中，你轉向哪一位呢？
english: Give now a cry for help; is there anyone who will give you an answer? and to which of the holy ones will you make your prayer?

chinese: 忿怒害死愚妄人；嫉妒殺死癡迷人。
english: For wrath is the cause of death to the foolish, and he who has no wisdom comes to his end through passion.

chinese: 我曾見愚妄人扎下根，但我忽然咒詛他的住處。
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly the curse came on his house.

chinese: 他的兒女遠離穩妥的地步，在城門口被壓，並無人搭救。
english: Now his children have no safe place, and they are crushed before the judges, for no one takes up their cause.

chinese: 他的莊稼有飢餓的人吃盡了，就是在荊棘裡的也搶去了；他的財寶有網羅張口吞滅了。
english: Their produce is taken by him who has no food, and their grain goes to the poor, and he who is in need of water gets it from their spring.

chinese: 禍患原不是從土中出來；患難也不是從地裡發生。
english: For evil does not come out of the dust, or trouble out of the earth;

chinese: 人生在世必遇患難，如同火星飛騰。
english: But trouble is man's fate from birth, as the flames go up from the fire.

chinese: 至於我，我必仰望神，把我的事情託付他。
english: But as for me, I would make my prayer to God, and I would put my cause before him:

chinese: 他行大事不可測度，行奇事不可勝數：
english: Who does great things outside our knowledge, wonders without number:

chinese: 降雨在地上，賜水於田裡；
english: Who gives rain on the earth, and sends water on the fields:

chinese: 將卑微的安置在高處，將哀痛的舉到穩妥之地；
english: Lifting up those who are low, and putting the sad in a safe place;

chinese: 破壞狡猾人的計謀，使他們所謀的不得成就。
english: Who makes the designs of the wise go wrong, so that they are unable to give effect to their purposes.

chinese: 他叫有智慧的中了自己的詭計，使狡詐人的計謀速速滅亡。
english: He takes the wise in their secret designs, and the purposes of the twisted are cut off suddenly.

chinese: 他們白晝遇見黑暗，午間摸索如在夜間。
english: In the daytime it becomes dark for them, and in the sunlight they go feeling about as if it was night.

chinese: 神拯救窮乏人脫離他們口中的刀和強暴人的手。
english: But he keeps safe from their sword those who have no father, and the poor from the power of the strong.

chinese: 這樣，貧寒的人有指望，罪孽之輩必塞口無言。
english: So the poor man has hope, and the mouth of the evil-doer is stopped.

chinese: 神所懲治的人是有福的！所以你不可輕看全能者的管教。
english: Truly, that man is happy who has training from the hand of God: so do not let your heart be shut to the teaching of the Ruler of all.

chinese: 因為他打破，又纏裹；他擊傷，用手醫治。
english: For after his punishment he gives comfort, and after wounding, his hands make you well.

chinese: 你六次遭難，他必救你；就是七次，災禍也無法害你。
english: He will keep you safe from six troubles, and in seven no evil will come near you.

chinese: 在饑荒中，他必救你脫離死亡；在爭戰中，他必救你脫離刀劍的權力。
english: When there is need of food he will keep you from death, and in war from the power of the sword.

chinese: 你必被隱藏，不受口舌之害；災殃臨到，你也不懼怕。
english: He will keep you safe from the evil tongue; and you will have no fear of wasting when it comes.

chinese: 你遇見災害饑饉，就必嬉笑；地上的野獸，你也不懼怕。
english: You will make sport of destruction and need, and will have no fear of the beasts of the earth.

chinese: 因為你必與田間的石頭立約；田裡的野獸也必與你和好。
english: For you will be in agreement with the stones of the earth, and the beasts of the field will be at peace with you.

chinese: 你必知道你帳棚平安，要查看你的羊圈，一無所失；
english: And you will be certain that your tent is at peace, and after looking over your property you will see that nothing is gone.

chinese: 也必知道你的後裔將來發達，你的子孫像地上的青草。
english: You will be certain that your seed will be great, and your offspring like the plants of the earth.

chinese: 你必壽高年邁才歸墳墓，好像禾捆到時收藏。
english: You will come to your last resting-place in full strength, as the grain is taken up to the crushing-floor in its time.

chinese: 這理，我們已經考察，本是如此。你須要聽，要知道是與自己有益。
english: See, we have made search with care, and it is so; it has come to our ears; see that you take note of it for yourself.

chinese: 約伯回答說：
english: And Job made answer and said,

chinese: 惟願我的煩惱稱一稱，我一切的災害放在天平裡；
english: If only my passion might be measured, and put into the scales against my trouble!

chinese: 現今都比海沙更重，所以我的言語急躁。
english: For then its weight would be more than the sand of the seas: because of this my words have been uncontrolled.

chinese: 因全能者的箭射入我身；其毒，我的靈喝盡了；神的驚嚇擺陣攻擊我。
english: For the arrows of the Ruler of all are present with me, and their poison goes deep into my spirit: his army of fears is put in order against me.

chinese: 野驢有草豈能叫喚？牛有料豈能吼叫？
english: Does the ass of the fields give out his voice when he has grass? or does the ox make sounds over his food?

chinese: 物淡而無鹽豈可吃麼？蛋青有甚麼滋味呢？
english: Will a man take food which has no taste without salt? or is there any taste in the soft substance of purslain?

chinese: 看為可厭的食物，我心不肯挨近。
english: My soul has no desire for such things, they are as disease in my food.

chinese: 惟願我得著所求的，願神賜我所切望的!
english: If only I might have an answer to my prayer, and God would give me my desire!

chinese: 就是願神把我壓碎，伸手將我剪除。
english: If only he would be pleased to put an end to me; and would let loose his hand, so that I might be cut off!

chinese: 我因沒有違棄那聖者的言語，就仍以此為安慰，在不止息的痛苦中還可踴躍。
english: So I would still have comfort, and I would have joy in the pains of death, for I have not been false to the words of the Holy One.

chinese: 我有甚麼氣力使我等候？我有甚麼結局使我忍耐？
english: Have I strength to go on waiting, or have I any end to be looking forward to?

chinese: 我的氣力豈是石頭的氣力？我的肉身豈是銅的呢？
english: Is my strength the strength of stones, or is my flesh brass?

chinese: 在我豈不是毫無幫助麼？智慧豈不是從我心中趕出淨盡麼？
english: I have no help in myself, and wisdom is completely gone from me.

chinese: 那將要灰心、離棄全能者、不敬畏神的人，他的朋友當以慈愛待他。
english: He whose heart is shut against his friend has given up the fear of the Ruler of all.

chinese: 我的弟兄詭詐，好像溪水，又像溪水流乾的河道。
english: My friends have been false like a stream, like streams in the valleys which come to an end:

chinese: 這河因結冰發黑，有雪藏在其中；
english: Which are dark because of the ice, and the snow falling into them;

chinese: 天氣漸暖就隨時消化，日頭炎熱便從原處乾涸。
english: Under the burning sun they are cut off, and come to nothing because of the heat.

chinese: 結伴的客旅離棄大道，順河偏行，到荒野之地死亡。
english: The camel-trains go out of their way; they go up into the waste and come to destruction.

chinese: 提瑪結伴的客旅瞻望；示巴同夥的人等候。
english: The camel-trains of Tema were searching with care, the bands of Sheba were waiting for them:

chinese: 他們因失了盼望就抱愧，來到那裡便蒙羞。
english: They were put to shame because of their hope; they came and their hope was gone.

chinese: 現在你們正是這樣，看見驚嚇的事便懼怕。
english: So have you now become to me; you see my sad condition and are in fear.

chinese: 我豈說：請你們供給我，從你們的財物中送禮物給我？
english: Did I say, Give me something? or, Make a payment for me out of your wealth?

chinese: 豈說：拯救我脫離敵人的手麼？救贖我脫離強暴人的手麼？
english: Or, Get me out of the power of my hater? or, Give money so that I may be free from the power of the cruel ones?

chinese: 請你們教導我，我便不作聲；使我明白在何事上有錯。
english: Give me teaching and I will be quiet; and make me see my error.

chinese: 正直的言語力量何其大！但你們責備是責備甚麼呢？
english: How pleasing are upright words! but what force is there in your arguments?

chinese: 絕望人的講論既然如風，你們還想要駁正言語麼？
english: My words may seem wrong to you, but the words of him who has no hope are for the wind.

chinese: 你們想為孤兒拈鬮，以朋友當貨物。
english: Truly, you are such as would give up the child of a dead man to his creditors, and would make a profit out of your friend.

chinese: 現在請你們看看我，我決不當面說謊。
english: Now then, let your eyes be turned to me, for truly I will not say what is false to your face.

chinese: 請你們轉意，不要不公；請再轉意，我的事有理。
english: Let your minds be changed, and do not have an evil opinion of me; yes, be changed, for my righteousness is still in me.

chinese: 我的舌上豈有不義麼？我的口裡豈不辨奸惡麼？
english: Is there evil in my tongue? is not the cause of my trouble clear to me?

chinese: 人在世上豈無爭戰麼？他的日子不像雇工人的日子麼？
english: Has not man his ordered time of trouble on the earth? and are not his days like the days of a servant working for payment?

chinese: 像奴僕切慕黑影，像雇工人盼望工價；
english: As a servant desiring the shades of evening, and a workman looking for his payment:

chinese: 我也照樣經過困苦的日月，夜間的疲乏為我而定。
english: So I have for my heritage months of pain to no purpose, and nights of weariness are given to me.

chinese: 我躺臥的時候便說：我何時起來，黑夜就過去呢？我盡是反來覆去，直到天亮。
english: When I go to my bed, I say, When will it be time to get up? but the night is long, and I am turning from side to side till morning light.

chinese: 我的肉體以蟲子和塵土為衣；我的皮膚才收了口又重新破裂。
english: My flesh is covered with worms and dust; my skin gets hard and then is cracked again.

chinese: 我的日子比梭更快，都消耗在無指望之中。
english: My days go quicker than the cloth-worker's thread, and come to an end without hope.

chinese: 求你想念，我的生命不過是一口氣；我的眼睛必不再見福樂。
english: O, keep in mind that my life is wind: my eye will never again see good.

chinese: 觀看我的人，他的眼必不再見我；你的眼目要看我，我卻不在了。
english: The eye of him who sees me will see me no longer: your eyes will be looking for me, but I will be gone.

chinese: 雲彩消散而過；照樣，人下陰間也不再上來。
english: A cloud comes to an end and is gone; so he who goes down into the underworld comes not up again.

chinese: 他不再回自己的家；故土也不再認識他。
english: He will not come back to his house, and his place will have no more knowledge of him.

chinese: 我不禁止我口；我靈愁苦，要發出言語；我心苦惱，要吐露哀情。
english: So I will not keep my mouth shut; I will let the words come from it in the pain of my spirit, my soul will make a bitter outcry.

chinese: 我對神說：我豈是洋海，豈是大魚，你竟防守我呢？
english: Am I a sea, or a sea-beast, that you put a watch over me?

chinese: 若說：我的床必安慰我，我的榻必解釋我的苦情，
english: When I say, In my bed I will have comfort, there I will get rest from my disease;

chinese: 你就用夢驚駭我，用異象恐嚇我，
english: Then you send dreams to me, and visions of fear;

chinese: 甚至我寧肯噎死，寧肯死亡，勝似留我這一身的骨頭。
english: So that a hard death seems better to my soul than my pains.

chinese: 我厭棄性命，不願永活。你任憑我罷，因我的日子都是虛空。
english: I have no desire for life, I would not be living for ever! Keep away from me, for my days are as a breath.

chinese: 人算甚麼，你竟看他為大，將他放在心上？
english: What is man, that you have made him great, and that your attention is fixed on him,

chinese: 每早鑒察他，時刻試驗他？
english: And that your hand is on him every morning, and that you are testing him every minute?

chinese: 你到何時才轉眼不看我，才任憑我咽下唾沫呢？
english: How long will it be before your eyes are turned away from me, so that I may have a minute's breathing-space?

chinese: 鑒察人的主啊，我若有罪，於你何妨？為何以我當你的箭靶子，使我厭棄自己的性命？
english: If I have done wrong, what have I done to you, O keeper of men? why have you made me a mark for your blows, so that I am a weariness to myself?

chinese: 為何不赦免我的過犯，除掉我的罪孽？我現今要躺臥在塵土中；你要殷勤地尋找我，我卻不在了。
english: And why do you not take away my sin, and let my wrongdoing be ended? for now I go down to the dust, and you will be searching for me with care, but I will be gone.

chinese: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

chinese: 這些話你要說到幾時？口中的言語如狂風要到幾時呢？
english: How long will you say these things, and how long will the words of your mouth be like a strong wind?

chinese: 神豈能偏離公平？全能者豈能偏離公義？
english: Does God give wrong decisions? or is the Ruler of all not upright in his judging?

chinese: 或者你的兒女得罪了他；他使他們受報應。
english: If your children have done evil against him, then their punishment is from his hand.

chinese: 你若殷勤地尋求神，向全能者懇求；
english: If you will make search for God with care, and put your request before the Ruler of all;

chinese: 你若清潔正直，他必定為你起來，使你公義的居所興旺。
english: If you are clean and upright; then he will certainly be moved to take up your cause, and will make clear your righteousness by building up your house again.

chinese: 你起初雖然微小，終久必甚發達。
english: And though your start was small, your end will be very great.

chinese: 請你考問前代，追念他們的列祖所查究的。
english: Put the question now to the past generations, and give attention to what has been searched out by their fathers:

chinese: 我們不過從昨日才有，一無所知；我們在世的日子好像影兒。
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and have no knowledge, because our days on earth are gone like a shade:)

chinese: 他們豈不指教你，告訴你，從心裡發出言語來呢？
english: Will they not give you teaching, and say words of wisdom to you?

chinese: 蒲草沒有泥豈能發長？蘆荻沒有水豈能生發？
english: Will the river-plant come up in its pride without wet earth? will the grass get tall without water?

chinese: 尚青的時候，還沒有割下，比百樣的草先枯槁。
english: When it is still green, without being cut down, it becomes dry and dead before any other plant.

chinese: 凡忘記神的人，景況也是這樣；不虔敬人的指望要滅沒。
english: So is the end of all who do not keep God in mind; and the hope of the evil-doer comes to nothing:

chinese: 他所仰賴的必折斷；他所倚靠的是蜘蛛網。
english: Whose support is cut off, and whose hope is no stronger than a spider's thread.

chinese: 他要倚靠房屋，房屋卻站立不住；他要抓住房屋，房屋卻不能存留。
english: He is looking to his family for support, but it is not there; he puts his hope in it, but it comes to nothing.

chinese: 他在日光之下發青，蔓子爬滿了園子；
english: He is full of strength before the sun, and his branches go out over his garden.

chinese: 他的根盤繞石堆，扎入石地。
english: His roots are twisted round the stones, forcing their way in between them.

chinese: 他若從本地被拔出，那地就不認識他，說：我沒有見過你。
english: If he is taken away from his place, then it will say, I have not seen you.

chinese: 看哪，這就是他道中之樂；以後必另有人從地而生。
english: Such is the joy of his way, and out of the dust another comes up to take his place.

chinese: 神必不丟棄完全人，也不扶助邪惡人。
english: Truly, God will not give up him who is without sin, and will not take evil-doers by the hand.

chinese: 他還要以喜笑充滿你的口，以歡呼充滿你的嘴。
english: The time will come when your mouth will be full of laughing, and cries of joy will come from your lips.

chinese: 恨惡你的要披戴慚愧；惡人的帳棚必歸於無有。
english: Your haters will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the sinner will not be seen again.

chinese: 約伯回答說：
english: And Job made answer and said,

chinese: 我真知道是這樣；但人在神面前怎能成為義呢？
english: Truly, I see that it is so: and how is it possible for a man to get his right before God?

chinese: 若願意與他爭辯，千中之一也不能回答。
english: If a man was desiring to go to law with him, he would not be able to give him an answer to one out of a thousand questions.

chinese: 他心裡有智慧，且大有能力。誰向神剛硬而得亨通呢？
english: He is wise in heart and great in strength: who ever made his face hard against him, and any good came of it?

chinese: 他發怒，把山翻倒挪移，山並不知覺。
english: It is he who takes away the mountains without their knowledge, overturning them in his wrath:

chinese: 他使地震動，離其本位，地的柱子就搖撼。
english: Who is moving the earth out of its place, so that its pillars are shaking:

chinese: 他吩咐日頭不出來，就不出來，又封閉眾星。
english: Who gives orders to the sun, and it does not give its light; and who keeps the stars from shining.

chinese: 他獨自鋪張蒼天，步行在海浪之上。
english: By whose hand the heavens were stretched out, and who is walking on the waves of the sea:

chinese: 他造北斗、參星、昴星，並南方的密宮；
english: Who made the Bear and Orion, and the Pleiades, and the store-houses of the south:

chinese: 他行大事，不可測度，行奇事，不可勝數。
english: Who does great things not to be searched out; yes, wonders without number.

chinese: 他從我旁邊經過，我卻不看見；他在我面前行走，我倒不知覺。
english: See, he goes past me and I see him not: he goes on before, but I have no knowledge of him.

chinese: 他奪取，誰能阻擋？誰敢問他：你做甚麼？
english: If he puts out his hand to take, by whom may it be turned back? who may say to him, What are you doing?

chinese: 神必不收回他的怒氣；扶助拉哈伯的，屈身在他以下。
english: God's wrath may not be turned back; the helpers of Rahab were bent down under him.

chinese: 既是這樣，我怎敢回答他，怎敢選擇言語與他辯論呢？
english: How much less may I give an answer to him, using the right words in argument with him?

chinese: 我雖有義，也不回答他，只要向那審判我的懇求。
english: Even if my cause was good, I would not be able to give an answer; I would make request for grace from him who was against me.

chinese: 我若呼籲，他應允我；我仍不信他真聽我的聲音。
english: If I had sent for him to be present, and he had come, I would have no faith that he would give ear to my voice.

chinese: 他用暴風折斷我，無故地加增我的損傷。
english: For I would be crushed by his storm, my wounds would be increased without cause.

chinese: 我就是喘一口氣，他都不容，倒使我滿心苦惱。
english: He would not let me take my breath, but I would be full of bitter grief.

chinese: 若論力量，他真有能力！若論審判，他說誰能將我傳來呢？
english: If it is a question of strength, he says, Here I am! and if it is a question of a cause at law, he says, Who will give me a fixed day?

chinese: 我雖有義，自己的口要定我為有罪；我雖完全，我口必顯我為彎曲。
english: Though I was in the right, he would say that I was in the wrong; I have done no evil; but he says that I am a sinner.

chinese: 我本完全，不顧自己；我厭惡我的性命。
english: I have done no wrong; I give no thought to what becomes of me; I have no desire for life.

chinese: 善惡無分，都是一樣；所以我說，完全人和惡人，他都滅絕。
english: It is all the same to me; so I say, He puts an end to the sinner and to him who has done no wrong together.

chinese: 若忽然遭殺害之禍，他必戲笑無辜的人遇難。
english: If death comes suddenly through disease, he makes sport of the fate of those who have done no wrong.

chinese: 世界交在惡人手中；蒙蔽世界審判官的臉，若不是他，是誰呢？
english: The land is given into the power of the evil-doer; the faces of its judges are covered; if not by him, then who has done it?

chinese: 我的日子比跑信的更快，急速過去，不見福樂。
english: My days go quicker than a post-runner: they go in flight, they see no good.

chinese: 我的日子過去如快船，如急落抓食的鷹。
english: They go rushing on like reed-boats, like an eagle dropping suddenly on its food.

chinese: 我若說：我要忘記我的哀情，除去我的愁容，心中暢快；
english: If I say, I will put my grief out of mind, I will let my face be sad no longer and I will be bright;

chinese: 我因愁苦而懼怕，知道你必不以我為無辜。
english: I go in fear of all my pains; I am certain that I will not be free from sin in your eyes.

chinese: 我必被你定為有罪，我何必徒然勞苦呢？
english: You will not let me be clear of sin! why then do I take trouble for nothing?

chinese: 我若用雪水洗身，用鹼潔淨我的手，
english: If I am washed with snow water, and make my hands clean with soap;

chinese: 你還要扔我在坑裡，我的衣服都憎惡我。
english: Then you will have me pushed into the dust, so that I will seem disgusting to my very clothing.

chinese: 他本不像我是人，使我可以回答他，又使我們可以同聽審判。
english: For he is not a man as I am, that I might give him an answer, that we might come together before a judge.

chinese: 我們中間沒有聽訟的人可以向我們兩造按手。
english: There is no one to give a decision between us, who might have control over us.

chinese: 願他把杖離開我，不使驚惶威嚇我。
english: Let him take away his rod from me and not send his fear on me:

chinese: 我就說話，也不懼怕他，現在我卻不是那樣。
english: Then I would say what is in my mind without fear of him; for there is no cause of fear in myself.

chinese: 我厭煩我的性命，必由著自己述說我的哀情；因心裡苦惱，我要說話，
english: My soul is tired of life; I will let my sad thoughts go free in words; my soul will make a bitter outcry.

chinese: 對神說：不要定我有罪，要指示我，你為何與我爭辯？
english: I will say to God, Do not put me down as a sinner; make clear to me what you have against me.

chinese: 你手所造的，你又欺壓，又藐視，卻光照惡人的計謀。這事你以為美麼？
english: What profit is it to you to be cruel, to give up the work of your hands, looking kindly on the design of evil-doers?

chinese: 你的眼豈是肉眼？你查看豈像人查看麼？
english: Have you eyes of flesh, or do you see as man sees?

chinese: 你的日子豈像人的日子，你的年歲豈像人的年歲，
english: Are your days as the days of man, or your years like his,

chinese: 就追問我的罪孽，尋察我的罪過麼？
english: That you take note of my sin, searching after my wrongdoing,

chinese: 其實，你知道我沒有罪惡，並沒有能救我脫離你手的。
english: Though you see that I am not an evil-doer; and there is no one who is able to take a man out of your hands?

chinese: 你的手創造我，造就我的四肢百體，你還要毀滅我。
english: Your hands made me, and I was formed by you, but then, changing your purpose, you gave me up to destruction.

chinese: 求你記念─製造我如摶泥一般，你還要使我歸於塵土麼？
english: O keep in mind that you made me out of earth; and will you send me back again to dust?

chinese: 你不是倒出我來好像奶，使我凝結如同奶餅麼？
english: Was I not drained out like milk, becoming hard like cheese?

chinese: 你以皮和肉為衣給我穿上，用骨與筋把我全體聯絡。
english: By you I was clothed with skin and flesh, and joined together with bones and muscles.

chinese: 你將生命和慈愛賜給我；你也眷顧保全我的心靈。
english: You have been kind to me, and your grace has been with me, and your care has kept my spirit safe.

chinese: 然而，你待我的這些事早已藏在你心裡；我知道你久有此意。
english: But you kept these things in the secret of your heart; I am certain this was in your thoughts:

chinese: 我若犯罪，你就察看我，並不赦免我的罪孽。
english: That, if I did wrong, you would take note of it, and would not make me clear from sin:

chinese: 我若行惡，便有了禍；我若為義，也不敢抬頭，正是滿心羞愧，眼見我的苦情。
english: That, if I was an evil-doer, the curse would come on me; and if I was upright, my head would not be lifted up, being full of shame and overcome with trouble.

chinese: 我若昂首自得，你就追捕我如獅子，又在我身上顯出奇能。
english: And that if there was cause for pride, you would go after me like a lion; and again put out your wonders against me:

chinese: 你重立見證攻擊我，向我加增惱怒，如軍兵更換著攻擊我。
english: That you would send new witnesses against me, increasing your wrath against me, and letting loose new armies on me.

chinese: 你為何使我出母胎呢？不如我當時氣絕，無人得見我；
english: Why then did you make me come out of my mother's body? It would have been better for me to have taken my last breath, and for no eye to have seen me,

chinese: 這樣，就如沒有我一般，一出母胎就被送入墳墓。
english: And for me to have been as if I had not been; to have been taken from my mother's body straight to my last resting-place.

chinese: 我的日子不是甚少麼？求你停手寬容我，叫我在往而不返之先─就是往黑暗和死蔭之地以先─可以稍得暢快。
english: Are not the days of my life small in number? Let your eyes be turned away from me, so that I may have a little pleasure,
Before I go to the place from which I will not come back, to the land where all is dark and black,

chinese: 那地甚是幽暗，是死蔭混沌之地；那裡的光好像幽暗。
english: A land of thick dark, without order, where the very light is dark.

chinese: 拿瑪人瑣法回答說：
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite made answer and said,

chinese: 這許多的言語豈不該回答麼？多嘴多舌的人豈可稱為義麼？
english: Are all these words to go unanswered? and is a man seen to be right because he is full of talk?

chinese: 你誇大的話豈能使人不作聲麼？你戲笑的時候豈沒有人叫你害羞麼？
english: Are your words of pride to make men keep quiet? and are you to make sport, with no one to put you to shame?

chinese: 你說：我的道理純全；我在你眼前潔淨。
english: You may say, My way is clean, and I am free from sin in your eyes.

chinese: 惟願神說話；願他開口攻擊你，
english: But if only God would take up the word, opening his lips in argument with you;

chinese: 並將智慧的奧祕指示你；他有諸般的智識。所以當知道神追討你比你罪孽該得的還少。
english: And would make clear to you the secrets of wisdom, and the wonders of his purpose!

chinese: 你考察就能測透神嗎？你豈能盡情測透全能者嗎？
english: Are you able to take God's measure, to make discovery of the limits of the Ruler of all?

chinese: 他的智慧高於天，你還能做甚麼？深於陰間，你還能知道甚麼？
english: They are higher than heaven; what is there for you to do? deeper than the underworld, and outside your knowledge;

chinese: 其量比地長，比海寬。
english: Longer in measure than the earth, and wider than the sea.

chinese: 他若經過，將人拘禁，招人受審，誰能阻擋他呢？
english: If he goes on his way, shutting a man up and putting him to death, who may make him go back from his purpose?

chinese: 他本知道虛妄的人；人的罪孽，他雖不留意，還是無所不見。
english: For in his eyes men are as nothing; he sees evil and takes note of it.

chinese: 空虛的人卻毫無知識；人生在世好像野驢的駒子。
english: And so a hollow-minded man will get wisdom, when a young ass of the field gets teaching.

chinese: 你若將心安正，又向主舉手；
english: But if you put your heart right, stretching out your hands to him;

chinese: 你手裡若有罪孽，就當遠遠地除掉，也不容非義住在你帳棚之中。
english: If you put far away the evil of your hands, and let no wrongdoing have a place in your tent;

chinese: 那時，你必仰起臉來毫無斑點；你也必堅固，無所懼怕。
english: Then truly your face will be lifted up, with no mark of sin, and you will be fixed in your place without fear:

chinese: 你必忘記你的苦楚，就是想起也如流過去的水一樣。
english: For your sorrow will go from your memory, like waters flowing away:

chinese: 你在世的日子要比正午更明，雖有黑暗仍像早晨。
english: And your life will be brighter than day; though it is dark, it will become like the morning.

chinese: 你因有指望就必穩固，也必四圍巡查，坦然安息。
english: And you will be safe because there is hope; after looking round, you will take your rest in quiet;

chinese: 你躺臥，無人驚嚇，且有許多人向你求恩。
english: Sleeping with no fear of danger; and men will be desiring to have grace in your eyes;

chinese: 但惡人的眼目必要失明。他們無路可逃；他們的指望就是氣絕。
english: But the eyes of the evil-doers will be wasting away; their way of flight is gone, and their only hope is the taking of their last breath.

chinese: 約伯回答說：
english: And Job made answer and said,

chinese: 你們真是子民哪，你們死亡，智慧也就滅沒了。
english: No doubt you have knowledge, and wisdom will come to an end with you.

chinese: 但我也有聰明，與你們一樣，並非不及你們。你們所說的，誰不知道呢？
english: But I have a mind as well as you; I am equal to you: yes, who has not knowledge of such things as these?

chinese: 我這求告神、蒙他應允的人竟成了朋友所譏笑的；公義完全人竟受了人的譏笑。
english: It seems that I am to be as one who is a cause of laughing to his neighbour, one who makes his prayer to God and is answered! the upright man who has done no wrong is to be made sport of!

chinese: 安逸的人心裡藐視災禍；這災禍常常等待滑腳的人。
english: In the thought of him who is in comfort there is no respect for one who is in trouble; such is the fate of those whose feet are slipping.

chinese: 強盜的帳棚興旺，惹神的人穩固，神多將財物送到他們手中。
english: There is wealth in the tents of those who make destruction, and those by whom God is moved to wrath are safe; even those whose god is their strength.

chinese: 你且問走獸，走獸必指教你；又問空中的飛鳥，飛鳥必告訴你；
english: But put now a question to the beasts, and get teaching from them; or to the birds of the heaven, and they will make it clear to you;

chinese: 或與地說話，地必指教你；海中的魚也必向你說明。
english: Or to the things which go flat on the earth, and they will give you wisdom; and the fishes of the sea will give you news of it.

chinese: 看這一切，誰不知道是耶和華的手做成的呢？
english: Who does not see by all these that the hand of the Lord has done this?

chinese: 凡活物的生命和人類的氣息都在他手中。
english: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all flesh of man.

chinese: 耳朵豈不試驗言語，正如上膛嘗食物麼？
english: Are not words tested by the ear, even as food is tasted by the mouth?

chinese: 年老的有智慧；壽高的有知識。
english: Old men have wisdom, and a long life gives knowledge.

chinese: 在神有智慧和能力；他有謀略和知識。
english: With him there is wisdom and strength; power and knowledge are his.

chinese: 他拆毀的，就不能再建造；他捆住人，便不得開釋。
english: Truly, there is no building up of what is pulled down by him; when a man is shut up by him, no one may let him loose.

chinese: 他把水留住，水便枯乾；他再發出水來，水就翻地。
english: Truly, he keeps back the waters and they are dry; he sends them out and the earth is overturned.

chinese: 在他有能力和智慧，被誘惑的與誘惑人的都是屬他。
english: With him are strength and wise designs; he who is guided into error, together with his guide, are in his hands;

chinese: 他把謀士剝衣擄去，又使審判官變成愚人。
english: He takes away the wisdom of the wise guides, and makes judges foolish;

chinese: 他放鬆君王的綁，又用帶子捆他們的腰。
english: He undoes the chains of kings, and puts his band on them;

chinese: 他把祭司剝衣擄去，又使有能的人傾敗。
english: He makes priests prisoners, overturning those in safe positions;

chinese: 他廢去忠信人的講論，又奪去老人的聰明。
english: He makes the words of responsible persons without effect, and takes away the good sense of the old;

chinese: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，放鬆有力之人的腰帶。
english: He puts shame on chiefs, and takes away the power of the strong;

chinese: 他將深奧的事從黑暗中彰顯，使死蔭顯為光明。
english: Uncovering deep things out of the dark, and making the deep shade bright;

chinese: 他使邦國興旺而又毀滅；他使邦國開廣而又擄去。
english: Increasing nations, and sending destruction on them; making wide the lands of peoples, and then giving them up.

chinese: 他將地上民中首領的聰明奪去，使他們在荒廢無路之地漂流；
english: He takes away the wisdom of the rulers of the earth, and sends them wandering in a waste where there is no way.

chinese: 他們無光，在黑暗中摸索，又使他們東倒西歪，像醉酒的人一樣。
english: They go feeling about in the dark without light, wandering without help like those overcome with wine.

chinese: 這一切，我眼都見過；我耳都聽過，而且明白。
english: Truly, my eye has seen all this, word of it has come to my ear, and I have knowledge of it.

chinese: 你們所知道的，我也知道，並非不及你們。
english: The same things are in my mind as in yours; I am equal to you.

chinese: 我真要對全能者說話；我願與神理論。
english: But I would have talk with the Ruler of all, and my desire is to have an argument with God.

chinese: 你們是編造謊言的，都是無用的醫生。
english: But you put a false face on things; all your attempts to put things right are of no value.

chinese: 惟願你們全然不作聲；這就算為你們的智慧！
english: If only you would keep quiet, it would be a sign of wisdom!

chinese: 請你們聽我的辯論，留心聽我口中的分訴。
english: Give ear to the argument of my mouth, and take note of the words of my lips.

chinese: 你們要為神說不義的話麼？為他說詭詐的言語麼？
english: Will you say in God's name what is not right, and put false words into his mouth?

chinese: 你們要為神徇情麼？要為他爭論麼？
english: Will you have respect for God's person in this cause, and put yourselves forward as his supporters?

chinese: 他查出你們來，這豈是好麼？人欺哄人，你們也要照樣欺哄他麼？
english: Will it be good for you to be searched out by him, or have you the thought that he may be guided into error like a man?

chinese: 你們若暗中徇情，他必要責備你們。
english: He will certainly put you right, if you have respect for persons in secret.

chinese: 他的尊榮豈不叫你們懼怕麼？他的驚嚇豈不臨到你們麼？
english: Will not his glory put you in fear, so that your hearts will be overcome before him?

chinese: 你們以為可記念的箴言是爐灰的箴言；你們以為可靠的堅壘是淤泥的堅壘。
english: Your wise sayings are only dust, and your strong places are only earth.

chinese: 你們不要作聲，任憑我罷！讓我說話，無論如何我都承當。
english: Keep quiet, and let me say what is in my mind, whatever may come to me.

chinese: 我何必把我的肉掛在牙上，將我的命放在手中。
english: I will take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand.

chinese: 他必殺我；我雖無指望，然而我在他面前還要辯明我所行的。
english: Truly, he will put an end to me; I have no hope; but I will not give way in argument before him;

chinese: 這要成為我的拯救，因為不虔誠的人不得到他面前。
english: And that will be my salvation, for an evil-doer would not come before him,

chinese: 你們要細聽我的言語，使我所辯論的入你們的耳中。
english: Give ear with care to my words, and keep what I say in your minds.

chinese: 我已陳明我的案，知道自己有義。
english: See now, I have put my cause in order, and I am certain that I will be seen to be right.

chinese: 有誰與我爭論，我就情願緘默不言，氣絕而亡。
english: Is any one able to take up the argument against me? If so, I would keep quiet and give up my breath.

chinese: 惟有兩件不要向我施行，我就不躲開你的面：
english: Only two things do not do to me, then I will come before your face:

chinese: 就是把你的手縮回，遠離我身；又不使你的驚惶威嚇我。
english: Take your hand far away from me; and let me not be overcome by fear of you.

chinese: 這樣，你呼叫，我就回答；或是讓我說話，你回答我。
english: Then at the sound of your voice I will give answer; or let me put forward my cause for you to give me an answer.

chinese: 我的罪孽和罪過有多少呢？求你叫我知道我的過犯與罪愆。
english: What is the number of my evil-doings and my sins? give me knowledge of them.

chinese: 你為何掩面、拿我當仇敵呢？
english: Why is your face veiled from me, as if I was numbered among your haters?

chinese: 你要驚動被風吹的葉子麼？要追趕枯乾的碎秸麼？
english: Will you be hard on a leaf in flight before the wind? will you make a dry stem go more quickly on its way?

chinese: 你按罪狀刑罰我，又使我擔當幼年的罪孽；
english: For you put bitter things on record against me, and send punishment on me for the sins of my early years;

chinese: 也把我的腳上了木狗，並窺察我一切的道路，為我的腳掌劃定界限。
english: And you put chains on my feet, watching all my ways, and making a limit for my steps;

chinese: 我已經像滅絕的爛物，像蟲蛀的衣裳。
english: Though a man comes to nothing like a bit of dead wood, or like a robe which has become food for the worm.

chinese: 人為婦人所生，日子短少，多有患難；
english: As for man, the son of woman, his days are short and full of trouble.

chinese: 出來如花，又被割下，飛去如影，不能存留。
english: He comes out like a flower, and is cut down: he goes in flight like a shade, and is never seen again.

chinese: 這樣的人你豈睜眼看他麼？又叫我來受審麼？
english: Is it on such a one as this that your eyes are fixed, with the purpose of judging him?

chinese: 誰能使潔淨之物出於污穢之中呢？無論誰也不能！
english: If only a clean thing might come out of an unclean! But it is not possible.

chinese: 人的日子既然限定，他的月數在你那裡，你也派定他的界限，使他不能越過，
english: If his days are ordered, and you have knowledge of the number of his months, having given him a fixed limit past which he may not go;

chinese: 便求你轉眼不看他，使他得歇息，直等他像雇工人完畢他的日子。
english: Let your eyes be turned away from him, and take your hand from him, so that he may have pleasure at the end of his day, like a servant working for payment.

chinese: 樹若被砍下，還可指望發芽，嫩枝生長不息；
english: For there is hope of a tree; if it is cut down, it will come to life again, and its branches will not come to an end.

chinese: 其根雖然衰老在地裡，幹也死在土中，
english: Though its root may be old in the earth, and its cut-off end may be dead in the dust;

chinese: 及至得了水氣，還要發芽，又長枝條，像新栽的樹一樣。
english: Still, at the smell of water, it will make buds, and put out branches like a young plant.

chinese: 但人死亡而消滅；他氣絕，竟在何處呢？
english: But man comes to his death and is gone: he gives up his spirit, and where is he?

chinese: 海中的水絕盡，江河消散乾涸。
english: The waters go from a pool, and a river becomes waste and dry;

chinese: 人也是如此，躺下不再起來，等到天沒有了，仍不得復醒，也不得從睡中喚醒。
english: So man goes down to his last resting-place and comes not again: till the heavens come to an end, they will not be awake or come out of their sleep.

chinese: 惟願你把我藏在陰間，存於隱密處，等你的忿怒過去；願你為我定了日期，記念我。
english: If only you would keep me safe in the underworld, putting me in a secret place till your wrath is past, giving me a fixed time when I might come to your memory again!

chinese: 人若死了豈能再活呢？我只要在我一切爭戰的日子，等我被釋放（或譯：改變）的時候來到。
english: If death takes a man, will he come to life again? All the days of my trouble I would be waiting, till the time came for me to be free.

chinese: 你呼叫，我便回答；你手所做的，你必羨慕。
english: At the sound of your voice I would give an answer, and you would have a desire for the work of your hands.

chinese: 但如今你數點我的腳步，豈不窺察我的罪過麼？
english: For now my steps are numbered by you, and my sin is not overlooked.

chinese: 我的過犯被你封在囊中，也縫嚴了我的罪孽。
english: My wrongdoing is corded up in a bag, and my sin is shut up safe.

chinese: 山崩變為無有；磐石挪開原處。
english: But truly a mountain falling comes to dust, and a rock is moved from its place;

chinese: 水流消磨石頭，所流溢的洗去地上的塵土；你也照樣滅絕人的指望。
english: The stones are crushed small by the force of the waters; the dust of the earth is washed away by their overflowing: and so you put an end to the hope of man.

chinese: 你攻擊人常常得勝，使他去世；你改變他的容貌，叫他往而不回。
english: You overcome him for ever, and he is gone; his face is changed in death, and you send him away.

chinese: 他兒子得尊榮，他也不知道，降為卑，他也不覺得。
english: His sons come to honour, and he has no knowledge of it; they are made low, but he is not conscious of it.

chinese: 但知身上疼痛，心中悲哀。
english: Only his flesh still has pain, and his soul is sad.

chinese: 提幔人以利法回答說：
english: And Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,

chinese: 智慧人豈可用虛空的知識回答，用東風充滿肚腹呢？
english: Will a wise man make answer with knowledge of no value, or will he give birth to the east wind?

chinese: 他豈可用無益的話和無濟於事的言語理論呢？
english: Will he make arguments with words in which is no profit, and with sayings which have no value?

chinese: 你是廢棄敬畏的意，在神面前阻止敬虔的心。
english: Truly, you make the fear of God without effect, so that the time of quiet worship before God is made less by your outcry.

chinese: 你的罪孽指教你的口；你選用詭詐人的舌頭。
english: For your mouth is guided by your sin, and you have taken the tongue of the false for yourself.

chinese: 你自己的口定你有罪，並非是我；你自己的嘴見證你的不是。
english: It is by your mouth, even yours, that you are judged to be in the wrong, and not by me; and your lips give witness against you.

chinese: 你豈是頭一個被生的人麼？你受造在諸山之先麼？
english: Were you the first man to come into the world? or did you come into being before the hills?

chinese: 你曾聽見神的密旨麼？你還將智慧獨自得盡麼？
english: Were you present at the secret meeting of God? and have you taken all wisdom for yourself?

chinese: 你知道甚麼是我們不知道的呢？你明白甚麼是我們不明白的呢？
english: What knowledge have you which we have not? is there anything in your mind which is not in ours?

chinese: 我們這裡有白髮的和年紀老邁的，比你父親還老。
english: With us are men who are grey-haired and full of years, much older than your father.

chinese: 神用溫和的話安慰你，你以為太小麼？
english: Are the comforts of God not enough for you, and the gentle word which was said to you?

chinese: 你的心為何將你逼去？你的眼為何冒出火星，
english: Why is your heart uncontrolled, and why are your eyes lifted up;

chinese: 使你的靈反對神，也任你的口發這言語？
english: So that you are turning your spirit against God, and letting such words go out of your mouth?

chinese: 人是甚麼，竟算為潔淨呢？婦人所生的是甚麼，竟算為義呢？
english: What is man, that he may be clean? and how may the son of woman be upright?

chinese: 神不信靠他的眾聖者；在他眼前，天也不潔淨，
english: Truly, he puts no faith in his holy ones, and the heavens are not clean in his eyes;

chinese: 何況那污穢可憎、喝罪孽如水的世人呢！
english: How much less one who is disgusting and unclean, a man who takes in evil like water!

chinese: 我指示你，你要聽；我要述說所看見的，
english: Take note and give ear to my words; and I will say what I have seen:

chinese: 就是智慧人從列祖所受，傳說而不隱瞞的。
english: (The things which wise men have got from their fathers, and have not kept secret from us;

chinese: （這地惟獨賜給他們，並沒有外人從他們中間經過。）
english: For only to them was the land given, and no strange people were among them:)

chinese: 惡人一生之日劬勞痛苦；強暴人一生的年數也是如此。
english: The evil man is in pain all his days, and the number of the years stored up for the cruel is small.

chinese: 驚嚇的聲音常在他耳中；在平安時，搶奪的必臨到他那裡。
english: A sound of fear is in his ears; in time of peace destruction will come on him:

chinese: 他不信自己能從黑暗中轉回；他被刀劍等候。
english: He has no hope of coming safe out of the dark, and his fate will be the sword;

chinese: 他漂流在外求食，說：哪裡有食物呢？他知道黑暗的日子在他手邊預備好了。
english: He is wandering about in search of bread, saying, Where is it? and he is certain that the day of trouble is ready for him:

chinese: 急難困苦叫他害怕，而且勝了他，好像君王預備上陣一樣。
english: He is greatly in fear of the dark day, trouble and pain overcome him:

chinese: 他伸手攻擊神，以驕傲攻擊全能者，
english: Because his hand is stretched out against God, and his heart is lifted up against the Ruler of all,

chinese: 挺著頸項，用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闖；
english: Running against him like a man of war, covered by his thick breastplate; even like a king ready for the fight,

chinese: 是因他的臉蒙上脂油，腰積成肥肉。
english: Because his face is covered with fat, and his body has become thick;

chinese: 他曾住在荒涼城邑，無人居住、將成亂堆的房屋。
english: And he has made his resting-place in the towns which have been pulled down, in houses where no man had a right to be, whose fate was to become masses of broken walls.

chinese: 他不得富足，財物不得常存，產業在地上也不加增。
english: He does not get wealth for himself, and is unable to keep what he has got; the heads of his grain are not bent down to the earth.

chinese: 他不得出離黑暗。火燄要將他的枝子燒乾；因神口中的氣，他要滅亡（原文是走去）。
english: He does not come out of the dark; his branches are burned by the flame, and the wind takes away his bud.

chinese: 他不用倚靠虛假欺哄自己，因虛假必成為他的報應。
english: Let him not put his hope in what is false, falling into error: for he will get deceit as his reward.

chinese: 他的日期未到之先，這事必成就；他的枝子不得青綠。
english: His branch is cut off before its time, and his leaf is no longer green.

chinese: 他必像葡萄樹的葡萄，未熟而落；又像橄欖樹的花，一開而謝。
english: He is like a vine whose grapes do not come to full growth, or an olive-tree dropping its flowers.

chinese: 原來不敬虔之輩必無生育；受賄賂之人的帳棚必被火燒。
english: For the band of the evil-doers gives no fruit, and the tents of those who give wrong decisions for reward are burned with fire.

chinese: 他們所懷的是毒害，所生的是罪孽；心裡所預備的是詭詐。
english: Evil has made them with child, and they give birth to trouble; and the fruit of their body is shame for themselves.

chinese: 約伯回答說：
english: And Job made answer and said,

chinese: 這樣的話我聽了許多；你們安慰人，反叫人愁煩。
english: Such things have frequently come to my ears: you are comforters who only give trouble.

chinese: 虛空的言語有窮盡麼？有甚麼話惹動你回答呢？
english: May words which are like the wind be stopped? or what is troubling you to make answer to them?

chinese: 我也能說你們那樣的話；你們若處在我的境遇，我也會聯絡言語攻擊你們，又能向你們搖頭。
english: It would not be hard for me to say such things if your souls were in my soul's place; joining words together against you, and shaking my head at you:

chinese: 但我必用口堅固你們，用嘴消解你們的憂愁。
english: I might give you strength with my mouth, and not keep back the comfort of my lips.

chinese: 我雖說話，憂愁仍不得消解；我雖停住不說，憂愁就離開我麼？
english: If I say what is in my mind, my pain becomes no less: and if I keep quiet, how much of it goes from me?

chinese: 但現在神使我困倦，使親友遠離我，
english: But now he has overcome me with weariness and fear, and I am in the grip of all my trouble.

chinese: 又抓住我，作見證攻擊我；我身體的枯瘦也當面見證我的不是。
english: It has come up as a witness against me, and the wasting of my flesh makes answer to my face.

chinese: 主發怒撕裂我，逼迫我，向我切齒；我的敵人怒目看我。
english: I am broken by his wrath, and his hate has gone after me; he has made his teeth sharp against me: my haters are looking on me with cruel eyes;

chinese: 他們向我開口，打我的臉羞辱我，聚會攻擊我。
english: Their mouths are open wide against me; the blows of his bitter words are falling on my face; all of them come together in a mass against me.

chinese: 神把我交給不敬虔的人，把我扔到惡人的手中。
english: God gives me over to the power of sinners, sending me violently into the hands of evil-doers.

chinese: 我素來安逸，他折斷我，掐住我的頸項，把我摔碎，又立我為他的箭靶子。
english: I was in comfort, but I have been broken up by his hands; he has taken me by the neck, shaking me to bits; he has put me up as a mark for his arrows.

chinese: 他的弓箭手四面圍繞我；他破裂我的肺腑，並不留情，把我的膽傾倒在地上，
english: His bowmen come round about me; their arrows go through my body without mercy; my life is drained out on the earth.

chinese: 將我破裂又破裂，如同勇士向我直闖。
english: I am broken with wound after wound; he comes rushing on me like a man of war.

chinese: 我縫麻布在我皮膚上，把我的角放在塵土中。
english: I have made haircloth the clothing of my skin, and my horn is rolled in the dust.

chinese: 我的臉因哭泣發紫，在我的眼皮上有死蔭。
english: My face is red with weeping, and my eyes are becoming dark;

chinese: 我的手中卻無強暴；我的祈禱也是清潔。
english: Though my hands have done no violent acts, and my prayer is clean.

chinese: 地啊，不要遮蓋我的血！不要阻擋我的哀求！
english: O earth, let not my blood be covered, and let my cry have no resting-place!

chinese: 現今，在天有我的見證，在上有我的中保。
english: Even now my witness is in heaven, and the supporter of my cause is on high.

chinese: 我的朋友譏誚我，我卻向神眼淚汪汪。
english: My friends make sport of me; to God my eyes are weeping,

chinese: 願人得與神辯白，如同人與朋友辯白一樣；
english: So that he may give decision for a man in his cause with God, and between a son of man and his neighbour.

chinese: 因為再過幾年，我必走那往而不返之路。
english: For in a short time I will take the journey from which I will not come back.

chinese: 我的心靈消耗，我的日子滅盡；墳墓為我預備好了。
english: My spirit is broken, my days are ended, the last resting-place is ready for me.

chinese: 真有戲笑我的在我這裡，我眼常見他們惹動我。
english: Truly, those who make sport of me are round about me, and my eyes become dark because of their bitter laughing.

chinese: 願主拿憑據給我，自己為我作保。在你以外誰肯與我擊掌呢？
english: Be pleased, now, to be responsible for me to yourself; for there is no other who will put his hand in mine.

chinese: 因你使他們心不明理，所以你必不高舉他們。
english: You have kept their hearts from wisdom: for this cause you will not give them honour.

chinese: 控告他的朋友、以朋友為可搶奪的，連他兒女的眼睛也要失明。
english: As for him who is false to his friend for a reward, light will be cut off from the eyes of his children.

chinese: 神使我作了民中的笑談；他們也吐唾沫在我臉上。
english: He has made me a word of shame to the peoples; I have become a mark for their sport.

chinese: 我的眼睛因憂愁昏花；我的百體好像影兒。
english: My eyes have become dark because of my pain, and all my body is wasted to a shade.

chinese: 正直人因此必驚奇；無辜的人要興起攻擊不敬虔之輩。
english: The upright are surprised at this, and he who has done no wrong is troubled because of the evil-doers.

chinese: 然而，義人要持守所行的道；手潔的人要力上加力。
english: Still the upright keeps on his way, and he who has clean hands gets new strength.

chinese: 至於你們眾人，可以再來辯論罷！你們中間，我找不著一個智慧人。
english: But come back, now, all of you, come; and I will not see a wise man among you.

chinese: 我的日子已經過了；我的謀算、我心所想望的已經斷絕。
english: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the desires of my heart.

chinese: 他們以黑夜為白晝，說：亮光近乎黑暗。
english: They are changing night into day; they say, The light is near the dark.

chinese: 我若盼望陰間為我的房屋，若下榻在黑暗中，
english: If I am waiting for the underworld as my house, if I have made my bed in the dark;

chinese: 若對朽壞說：你是我的父；對蟲說：你是我的母親姊妹；
english: If I say to the earth, You are my father; and to the worm, My mother and my sister;

chinese: 這樣，我的指望在哪裡呢？我所指望的誰能看見呢？
english: Where then is my hope? and who will see my desire?

chinese: 等到安息在塵土中，這指望必下到陰間的門閂那裡了。
english: Will they go down with me into the underworld? Will we go down together into the dust?

chinese: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

chinese: 你尋索言語要到幾時呢？你可以揣摩思想，然後我們就說話。
english: How long will it be before you have done talking? Get wisdom, and then we will say what is in our minds.

chinese: 我們為何算為畜生，在你眼中看作污穢呢？
english: Why do we seem as beasts in your eyes, and as completely without knowledge?

chinese: 你這惱怒將自己撕裂的，難道大地為你見棄、磐石挪開原處麼？
english: But come back, now, come: you who are wounding yourself in your passion, will the earth be given up because of you, or a rock be moved out of its place?

chinese: 惡人的亮光必要熄滅；他的火燄必不照耀。
english: For the light of the sinner is put out, and the flame of his fire is not shining.

chinese: 他帳棚中的亮光要變為黑暗；他以上的燈也必熄滅。
english: The light is dark in his tent, and the light shining over him is put out.

chinese: 他堅強的腳步必見狹窄；自己的計謀必將他絆倒。
english: The steps of his strength become short, and by his design destruction overtakes him.

chinese: 因為他被自己的腳陷入網中，走在纏人的網羅上。
english: His feet take him into the net, and he goes walking into the cords.

chinese: 圈套必抓住他的腳跟；機關必擒獲他。
english: His foot is taken in the net; he comes into its grip.

chinese: 活扣為他藏在土內；羈絆為他藏在路上。
english: The twisted cord is put secretly in the earth to take him, and the cord is placed in his way.

chinese: 四面的驚嚇要使他害怕，並且追趕他的腳跟。
english: He is overcome by fears on every side, they go after him at every step.

chinese: 他的力量必因飢餓衰敗；禍患要在他旁邊等候。
english: His strength is made feeble for need of food, and destruction is waiting for his falling footstep.

chinese: 他本身的肢體要被吞吃；死亡的長子要吞吃他的肢體。
english: His skin is wasted by disease, and his body is food for the worst of diseases.

chinese: 他要從所倚靠的帳棚被拔出來，帶到驚嚇的王那裡。
english: He is pulled out of his tent where he was safe, and he is taken away to the king of fears.

chinese: 不屬他的必住在他的帳棚裡；硫磺必撒在他所住之處。
english: In his tent will be seen that which is not his, burning stone is dropped on his house.

chinese: 下邊，他的根本要枯乾；上邊，他的枝子要剪除。
english: Under the earth his roots are dry, and over it his branch is cut off.

chinese: 他的記念在地上必然滅亡；他的名字在街上也不存留。
english: His memory is gone from the earth, and in the open country there is no knowledge of his name.

chinese: 他必從光明中被攆到黑暗裡，必被趕出世界。
english: He is sent away from the light into the dark; he is forced out of the world.

chinese: 在本民中必無子無孫；在寄居之地也無一人存留。
english: He has no offspring or family among his people, and in his living-place there is no one of his name.

chinese: 以後來的要驚奇他的日子，好像以前去的受了驚駭。
english: At his fate those of the west are shocked, and those of the east are overcome with fear.

chinese: 不義之人的住處總是這樣；此乃不認識神之人的地步。
english: Truly, these are the houses of the sinner, and this is the place of him who has no knowledge of God.

chinese: 約伯回答說：
english: And Job made answer and said,

chinese: 你們攪擾我的心，用言語壓碎我要到幾時呢？
english: How long will you make my life bitter, crushing me with words?

chinese: 你們這十次羞辱我；你們苦待我也不以為恥。
english: Ten times now you have made sport of me; it gives you no sense of shame to do me wrong.

chinese: 果真我有錯，這錯乃是在我。
english: And, truly, if I have been in error, the effect of my error is only on myself.

chinese: 你們果然要向我誇大，以我的羞辱為證指責我，
english: If you make yourselves great against me, using my punishment as an argument against me,

chinese: 就該知道是神傾覆我，用網羅圍繞我。
english: Be certain that it is God who has done me wrong, and has taken me in his net.

chinese: 我因委曲呼叫，卻不蒙應允；我呼求，卻不得公斷。
english: Truly, I make an outcry against the violent man, but there is no answer: I give a cry for help, but no one takes up my cause.

chinese: 神用籬笆攔住我的道路，使我不得經過；又使我的路徑黑暗。
english: My way is walled up by him so that I may not go by: he has made my roads dark.

chinese: 他剝去我的榮光，摘去我頭上的冠冕。
english: He has put off my glory from me, and taken the crown from my head.

chinese: 他在四圍攻擊我，我便歸於死亡，將我的指望如樹拔出來。
english: I am broken down by him on every side, and I am gone; my hope is uprooted like a tree.

chinese: 他的忿怒向我發作，以我為敵人。
english: His wrath is burning against me, and I am to him as one of his haters.

chinese: 他的軍旅一齊上來，修築戰路攻擊我，在我帳棚的四圍安營。
english: His armies come on together, they make their road high against me, and put up their tents round mine.

chinese: 他把我的弟兄隔在遠處，使我所認識的全然與我生疏。
english: He has taken my brothers far away from me; they have seen my fate and have become strange to me.

chinese: 我的親戚與我斷絕；我的密友都忘記我。
english: My relations and my near friends have given me up, and those living in my house have put me out of their minds.

chinese: 在我家寄居的，和我的使女都以我為外人；我在他們眼中看為外邦人。
english: I am strange to my women-servants, and seem to them as one from another country.

chinese: 我呼喚僕人，雖用口求他，他還是不回答。
english: At my cry my servant gives me no answer, and I have to make a prayer to him.

chinese: 我口的氣味，我妻子厭惡；我的懇求，我同胞也憎嫌。
english: My breath is strange to my wife, and I am disgusting to the offspring of my mother's body.

chinese: 連小孩子也藐視我；我若起來，他們都嘲笑我。
english: Even young children have no respect for me; when I get up their backs are turned on me.

chinese: 我的密友都憎惡我；我平日所愛的人向我翻臉。
english: All the men of my circle keep away from me; and those dear to me are turned against me.

chinese: 我的皮肉緊貼骨頭；我只剩牙皮逃脫了。
english: My bones are joined to my skin, and I have got away with my flesh in my teeth.

chinese: 我朋友啊，可憐我！可憐我！因為神的手攻擊我。
english: Have pity on me, have pity on me, O my friends! for the hand of God is on me.

chinese: 你們為甚麼彷彿神逼迫我，吃我的肉還以為不足呢？
english: Why are you cruel to me, like God, for ever saying evil against me?

chinese: 惟願我的言語現在寫上，都記錄在書上；
english: If only my words might be recorded! if they might be put in writing in a book!

chinese: 用鐵筆鐫刻，用鉛灌在磐石上，直存到永遠。
english: And with an iron pen and lead be cut into the rock for ever!

chinese: 我知道我的救贖主活著，末了必站立在地上。
english: But I am certain that he who will take up my cause is living, and that in time to come he will take his place on the dust;

chinese: 我這皮肉滅絕之後，我必在肉體之外得見神。
english: And ... without my flesh I will see God;

chinese: 我自己要見他，親眼要看他，並不像外人。我的心腸在我裡面消滅了！
english: Whom I will see on my side, and not as one strange to me. My heart is broken with desire.

chinese: 你們若說：我們逼迫他要何等地重呢？惹事的根乃在乎他；
english: If you say, How cruel we will be to him! because the root of sin is clearly in him:

chinese: 你們就當懼怕刀劍；因為忿怒惹動刀劍的刑罰，使你們知道有報應（原文是審判）。
english: Be in fear of the sword, for the sword is the punishment for such things, so that you may be certain that there is a judge.

chinese: 拿瑪人瑣法回答說：
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite made answer and said,

chinese: 我心中急躁，所以我的思念叫我回答。
english: For this cause my thoughts are troubling me and driving me on.

chinese: 我已聽見那羞辱我，責備我的話；我的悟性叫我回答。
english: I have to give ear to arguments which put me to shame, and your answers to me are wind without wisdom.

chinese: 你豈不知亙古以來，自從人生在地，
english: Have you knowledge of this from early times, when man was placed on the earth,

chinese: 惡人誇勝是暫時的，不敬虔人的喜樂不過轉眼之間麼？
english: That the pride of the sinner is short, and the joy of the evil-doer but for a minute?

chinese: 他的尊榮雖達到天上，頭雖頂到雲中，
english: Though he is lifted up to the heavens, and his head goes up to the clouds;

chinese: 他終必滅亡，像自己的糞一樣；素來見他的人要說：他在哪裡呢？
english: Like the waste from his body he comes to an end for ever: those who have seen him say, Where is he?

chinese: 他必飛去如夢，不再尋見，速被趕去，如夜間的異象。
english: He is gone like a dream, and is not seen again; he goes in flight like a vision of the night.

chinese: 親眼見過他的，必不再見他；他的本處也再見不著他。
english: The eye which saw him sees him no longer; and his place has no more knowledge of him.

chinese: 他的兒女要求窮人的恩；他的手要賠還不義之財。
english: His children are hoping that the poor will be kind to them, and his hands give back his wealth.

chinese: 他的骨頭雖然有青年之力，卻要和他一同躺臥在塵土中。
english: His bones are full of young strength, but it will go down with him into the dust.

chinese: 他口內雖以惡為甘甜，藏在舌頭底下，
english: Though evil-doing is sweet in his mouth, and he keeps it secretly under his tongue;

chinese: 愛戀不捨，含在口中；
english: Though he takes care of it, and does not let it go, but keeps it still in his mouth;

chinese: 他的食物在肚裡卻要化為酸，在他裡面成為虺蛇的惡毒。
english: His food becomes bitter in his stomach; the poison of snakes is inside him.

chinese: 他吞了財寶，還要吐出；神要從他腹中掏出來。
english: He takes down wealth as food, and sends it up again; it is forced out of his stomach by God.

chinese: 他必吸飲虺蛇的毒氣；蝮蛇的舌頭也必殺他。
english: He takes the poison of snakes into his mouth, the tongue of the snake is the cause of his death.

chinese: 流奶與蜜之河，他不得再見。
english: Let him not see the rivers of oil, the streams of honey and milk.

chinese: 他勞碌得來的要賠還，不得享用（原文是吞下）；不能照所得的財貨歡樂。
english: He is forced to give back the fruit of his work, and may not take it for food; he has no joy in the profit of his trading.

chinese: 他欺壓窮人，且又離棄；強取非自己所蓋的房屋（或譯：強取房屋不得再建造）。
english: Because he has been cruel to the poor, turning away from them in their trouble; because he has taken a house by force which he did not put up;

chinese: 他因貪而無厭，所喜悅的連一樣也不能保守。
english: There is no peace for him in his wealth, and no salvation for him in those things in which he took delight.

chinese: 其餘的沒有一樣他不吞滅，所以他的福樂不能長久。
english: He had never enough for his desire; for this cause his well-being will quickly come to an end.

chinese: 他在滿足有餘的時候，必到狹窄的地步；凡受苦楚的人都必加手在他身上。
english: Even when his wealth is great, he is full of care, for the hand of everyone who is in trouble is turned against him.

chinese: 他正要充滿肚腹的時候，神必將猛烈的忿怒降在他身上；正在他吃飯的時候，要將這忿怒像雨降在他身上。
english: God gives him his desire, and sends the heat of his wrath on him, making it come down on him like rain.

chinese: 他要躲避鐵器；銅弓的箭要將他射透。
english: He may go in flight from the iron spear, but the arrow from the bow of brass will go through him;

chinese: 他把箭一抽，就從他身上出來；發光的箭頭從他膽中出來，有驚惶臨在他身上。
english: He is pulling it out, and it comes out of his back; and its shining point comes out of his side; he is overcome by fears.

chinese: 他的財寶歸於黑暗；人所不吹的火要把他燒滅，要把他帳棚中所剩下的燒燬。
english: All his wealth is stored up for the dark: a fire not made by man sends destruction on him, and on everything in his tent.

chinese: 天要顯明他的罪孽；地要興起攻擊他。
english: The heavens make clear his sin, and the earth gives witness against him.

chinese: 他的家產必然過去；神發怒的日子，他的貨物都要消滅。
english: The produce of his house is taken away into another country, like things given into the hands of others in the day of wrath.

chinese: 這是惡人從神所得的分，是神為他所定的產業。
english: This is the reward of the evil man, and the heritage given to him by God.

chinese: 約伯回答說：
english: Then Job made answer and said,

chinese: 你們要細聽我的言語，就算是你們安慰我。
english: Give attention with care to my words; and let this be your comfort.

chinese: 請寬容我，我又要說話；說了以後，任憑你們嗤笑罷！
english: Let me say what is in my mind, and after that, go on making sport of me.

chinese: 我豈是向人訴冤？為何不焦急呢？
english: As for me, is my outcry against man? is it then to be wondered at if my spirit is troubled?

chinese: 你們要看著我而驚奇，用手摀口。
english: Take note of me and be full of wonder, put your hand on your mouth.

chinese: 我每逢思想，心就驚惶，渾身戰兢。
english: At the very thought of it my flesh is shaking with fear.

chinese: 惡人為何存活，享大壽數，勢力強盛呢？
english: Why is life given to the evil-doers? why do they become old and strong in power?

chinese: 他們眼見兒孫，和他們一同堅立。
english: Their children are ever with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

chinese: 他們的家宅平安無懼；神的杖也不加在他們身上。
english: Their houses are free from fear, and the rod of God does not come on them.

chinese: 他們的公牛孳生而不斷絕；母牛下犢而不掉胎。
english: Their ox is ready at all times to give seed; their cow gives birth, without dropping her young.

chinese: 他們打發小孩子出去，多如羊群；他們的兒女踴躍跳舞。
english: They send out their young ones like a flock, and their children have pleasure in the dance,

chinese: 他們隨著琴鼓歌唱，又因簫聲歡喜。
english: They make songs to the instruments of music, and are glad at the sound of the pipe.

chinese: 他們度日諸事亨通，轉眼下入陰間。
english: Their days come to an end without trouble, and suddenly they go down to the underworld.

chinese: 他們對神說：離開我們罷！我們不願曉得你的道。
english: Though they said to God, Go away from us, for we have no desire for the knowledge of your ways.

chinese: 全能者是誰，我們何必事奉他呢？求告他有甚麼益處呢？
english: What is the Ruler of all, that we may give him worship? and what profit is it to us to make prayer to him?

chinese: 看哪，他們亨通不在乎自己；惡人所謀定的離我好遠。
english: Truly, is not their well-being in their power? (The purpose of the evil-doers is far from me.)

chinese: 惡人的燈何嘗熄滅？患難何嘗臨到他們呢？神何嘗發怒，向他們分散災禍呢？
english: How frequently is the light of the evil-doers put out, or does trouble come on them? how frequently does his wrath take them with cords?

chinese: 他們何嘗像風前的碎秸，如暴風颳去的糠秕呢？
english: How frequently are they as dry stems before the wind, or as grass taken away by the storm-wind?

chinese: 你們說：神為惡人的兒女積蓄罪孽；我說：不如本人受報，好使他親自知道。
english: You say, God keeps punishment stored up for his children. Let him send it on the man himself, so that he may have the punishment of it!

chinese: 願他親眼看見自己敗亡，親自飲全能者的忿怒。
english: Let his eyes see his trouble, and let him be full of the wrath of the Ruler of all!

chinese: 他的歲月既盡，他還顧他本家麼？
english: For what interest has he in his house after him, when the number of his months is ended?

chinese: 神既審判那在高位的，誰能將知識教訓他呢？
english: Is anyone able to give teaching to God? for he is the judge of those who are on high.

chinese: 有人至死身體強壯，盡得平靖安逸；
english: One comes to his end in complete well-being, full of peace and quiet:

chinese: 他的奶桶充滿，他的骨髓滋潤。
english: His buckets are full of milk, and there is no loss of strength in his bones.

chinese: 有人至死心中痛苦，終身未嘗福樂的滋味；
english: And another comes to his end with a bitter soul, without ever tasting good.

chinese: 他們一樣躺臥在塵土中，都被蟲子遮蓋。
english: Together they go down to the dust, and are covered by the worm.

chinese: 我知道你們的意思，並誣害我的計謀。
english: See, I am conscious of your thoughts, and of your violent purposes against me;

chinese: 你們說：霸者的房屋在哪裡？惡人住過的帳棚在哪裡？
english: For you say, Where is the house of the ruler, and where is the tent of the evil-doer?

chinese: 你們豈沒有詢問過路的人麼？不知道他們所引的證據麼？
english: Have you not put the question to the travellers, and do you not take note of their experience?

chinese: 就是惡人在禍患的日子得存留，在發怒的日子得逃脫。
english: How the evil man goes free in the day of trouble, and has salvation in the day of wrath?

chinese: 他所行的，有誰當面給他說明；他所做的，有誰報應他呢？
english: Who will make his way clear to his face? and if he has done a thing, who gives him punishment for it?

chinese: 然而他要被抬到塋地；並有人看守墳墓。
english: He is taken to his last resting-place, and keeps watch over it.

chinese: 他要以谷中的土塊為甘甜；在他以先去的無數，在他以後去的更多。
english: The earth of the valley covering his bones is sweet to him, and all men come after him, as there were unnumbered before him.

chinese: 你們對答的話中既都錯謬，怎麼徒然安慰我呢？
english: Why then do you give me comfort with words in which there is no profit, when you see that there is nothing in your answers but deceit?

chinese: 提幔人以利法回答說：
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,

chinese: 人豈能使神有益呢？智慧人但能有益於己。
english: Is it possible for a man to be of profit to God? No, for a man's wisdom is only of profit to himself.

chinese: 你為人公義，豈叫全能者喜悅呢？你行為完全，豈能使他得利呢？
english: Is it of any interest to the Ruler of all that you are upright? or is it of use to him that your ways are without sin?

chinese: 豈是因你敬畏他就責備你、審判你麼？
english: Is it because you give him honour that he is sending punishment on you and is judging you?

chinese: 你的罪惡豈不是大麼？你的罪孽也沒有窮盡；
english: Is not your evil-doing great? and there is no end to your sins.

chinese: 因你無故強取弟兄的物為當頭，剝去貧寒人的衣服。
english: For you have taken your brother's goods when he was not in your debt, and have taken away the clothing of those who have need of it.

chinese: 困乏的人，你沒有給他水喝；飢餓的人，你沒有給他食物。
english: You do not give water to the tired traveller, and from him who has no food you keep back bread.

chinese: 有能力的人就得地土；尊貴的人也住在其中。
english: For it was the man with power who had the land, and the man with an honoured name who was living in it.

chinese: 你打發寡婦空手回去，折斷孤兒的膀臂。
english: You have sent widows away without hearing their cause, and you have taken away the support of the child who has no father.

chinese: 因此，有網羅環繞你，有恐懼忽然使你驚惶；
english: For this cause nets are round your feet, and you are overcome with sudden fear.

chinese: 或有黑暗蒙蔽你，並有洪水淹沒你。
english: Your light is made dark so that you are unable to see, and you are covered by a mass of waters.

chinese: 神豈不是在高天麼？你看星宿何其高呢！
english: Is not God as high as heaven? and see the stars, how high they are!

chinese: 你說：神知道甚麼？他豈能看透幽暗施行審判呢？
english: And you say, What knowledge has God? is he able to give decisions through the deep dark?

chinese: 密雲將他遮蓋，使他不能看見；他周遊穹蒼。
english: Thick clouds are covering him, so that he is unable to see; and he is walking on the arch of heaven.

chinese: 你要依從上古的道麼？這道是惡人所行的。
english: Will you keep the old way by which evil men went?

chinese: 他們未到死期，忽然除滅；根基毀壞，好像被江河沖去。
english: Who were violently taken away before their time, who were overcome by the rush of waters:

chinese: 他們向神說：離開我們罷！又說：全能者能把我們怎麼樣呢？
english: Who said to God, Go away from us; and, What is the Ruler of all able to do to us?

chinese: 哪知神以美物充滿他們的房屋；但惡人所謀定的離我好遠。
english: Though he made their houses full of good things: but the purpose of the evil-doers is far from me!

chinese: 義人看見他們的結局就歡喜；無辜的人嗤笑他們，
english: The upright saw it and were glad: and those who had done no wrong made sport of them,

chinese: 說：那起來攻擊我們的果然被剪除，其餘的都被火燒滅。
english: Saying, Truly, their substance is cut off, and their wealth is food for the fire.

chinese: 你要認識神，就得平安；福氣也必臨到你。
english: Put yourself now in a right relation with him and be at peace: so will you do well in your undertakings.

chinese: 你當領受他口中的教訓，將他的言語存在心裡。
english: Be pleased to take teaching from his mouth, and let his words be stored up in your heart.

chinese: 你若歸向全能者，從你帳棚中遠除不義，就必得建立。
english: If you come back to the Ruler of all, making yourself low before him; if you put evil far away from your tents;

chinese: 要將你的珍寶丟在塵土裡，將俄斐的黃金丟在溪河石頭之間；
english: And put your gold in the dust, even your gold of Ophir among the rocks of the valleys;

chinese: 全能者就必為你的珍寶，作你的寶銀。
english: Then the Ruler of all will be your gold, and his teaching will be your silver;

chinese: 你就要以全能者為喜樂，向神仰起臉來。
english: For then you will have delight in the Ruler of all, and your face will be lifted up to God.

chinese: 你要禱告他，他就聽你；你也要還你的願。
english: You will make your prayer to him, and be answered; and you will give effect to your oaths.

chinese: 你定意要做何事，必然給你成就；亮光也必照耀你的路。
english: Your purposes will come about, and light will be shining on your ways.

chinese: 人使你降卑，你仍可說：必得高升；謙卑的人，神必然拯救。
english: For God makes low those whose hearts are lifted up, but he is a saviour to the poor in spirit.

chinese: 人非無辜，神且要搭救他；他因你手中清潔，必蒙拯救。
english: He makes safe the man who is free from sin, and if your hands are clean, salvation will be yours.

chinese: 約伯回答說：
english: And Job made answer and said,

chinese: 如今我的哀告還算為悖逆；我的責罰比我的唉哼還重。
english: Even today my outcry is bitter; his hand is hard on my sorrow.

chinese: 惟願我能知道在哪裡可以尋見神，能到他的臺前，
english: If only I had knowledge of where he might be seen, so that I might come even to his seat!

chinese: 我就在他面前將我的案件陳明，滿口辯白。
english: I would put my cause in order before him, and my mouth would be full of arguments.

chinese: 我必知道他回答我的言語，明白他向我所說的話。
english: I would see what his answers would be, and have knowledge of what he would say to me.

chinese: 他豈用大能與我爭辯麼？必不這樣！他必理會我。
english: Would he make use of his great power to overcome me? No, but he would give attention to me.

chinese: 在他那裡正直人可以與他辯論；這樣，我必永遠脫離那審判我的。
english: There an upright man might put his cause before him; and I would be free for ever from my judge.

chinese: 只是，我往前行，他不在那裡，往後退，也不能見他。
english: See, I go forward, but he is not there; and back, but I do not see him;

chinese: 他在左邊行事，我卻不能看見，在右邊隱藏，我也不能見他。
english: I am looking for him on the left hand, but there is no sign of him; and turning to the right, I am not able to see him.

chinese: 然而他知道我所行的路；他試煉我之後，我必如精金。
english: For he has knowledge of the way I take; after I have been tested I will come out like gold.

chinese: 我腳追隨他的步履；我謹守他的道，並不偏離。
english: My feet have gone in his steps; I have kept in his way, without turning to one side or to the other.

chinese: 他嘴唇的命令，我未曾背棄；我看重他口中的言語，過於我需用的飲食。
english: I have never gone against the orders of his lips; the words of his mouth have been stored up in my heart.

chinese: 只是他心志已定，誰能使他轉意呢？他心裡所願的，就行出來。
english: But his purpose is fixed and there is no changing it; and he gives effect to the desire of his soul.

chinese: 他向我所定的，就必做成；這類的事他還有許多。
english: For what has been ordered for me by him will be gone through to the end: and his mind is full of such designs.

chinese: 所以我在他面前驚惶；我思念這事便懼怕他。
english: For this cause I am in fear before him, my thoughts of him overcome me.

chinese: 神使我喪膽；全能者使我驚惶。
english: For God has made my heart feeble, and my mind is troubled before the Ruler of all.

chinese: 我的恐懼不是因為黑暗，也不是因為幽暗蒙蔽我的臉。
english: For I am overcome by the dark, and by the black night which is covering my face.

chinese: 全能者既定期罰惡，為何不使認識他的人看見那日子呢？
english: Why are times not stored up by the Ruler of all, and why do those who have knowledge of him not see his days?

chinese: 有人挪移地界，搶奪群畜而牧養。
english: The landmarks are changed by evil men, they violently take away flocks, together with their keepers.

chinese: 他們拉去孤兒的驢，強取寡婦的牛為當頭。
english: They send away the ass of him who has no father, they take the widow's ox for debt.

chinese: 他們使窮人離開正道；世上的貧民盡都隱藏。
english: The crushed are turned out of the way; all the poor of the earth go into a secret place together.

chinese: 這些貧窮人如同野驢出到曠野，殷勤尋找食物；他們靠著野地給兒女糊口，
english: Like asses in the waste land they go out to their work, looking for food with care; from the waste land they get bread for their children.

chinese: 收割別人田間的禾稼，摘取惡人餘剩的葡萄，
english: They get mixed grain from the field, and they take away the late fruit from the vines of those who have wealth.

chinese: 終夜赤身無衣，天氣寒冷毫無遮蓋，
english: They take their rest at night without clothing, and have no cover in the cold.

chinese: 在山上被大雨淋濕，因沒有避身之處就挨近磐石。
english: They are wet with the rain of the mountains, and get into the cracks of the rock for cover.

chinese: 又有人從母懷中搶奪孤兒，強取窮人的衣服為當頭，
english: The child without a father is forced from its mother's breast, and they take the young children of the poor for debt.

chinese: 使人赤身無衣，到處流行，且因飢餓扛抬禾捆，
english: Others go about without clothing, and though they have no food, they get in the grain from the fields.

chinese: 在那些人的圍牆內造油，醡酒，自己還口渴。
english: Between the lines of olive-trees they make oil; though they have no drink, they are crushing out the grapes.

chinese: 在多民的城內有人唉哼，受傷的人哀號；神卻不理會那惡人的愚妄。
english: From the town come sounds of pain from those who are near death, and the soul of the wounded is crying out for help; but God does not take note of their prayer.

chinese: 又有人背棄光明，不認識光明的道，不住在光明的路上。
english: Then there are those who are haters of the light, who have no knowledge of its ways, and do not go in them.

chinese: 殺人的黎明起來，殺害困苦窮乏人，夜間又作盜賊。
english: He who is purposing death gets up before day, so that he may put to death the poor and those in need.

chinese: 姦夫等候黃昏，說：必無眼能見我，就把臉蒙蔽。
english: And the man whose desire is for the wife of another is waiting for the evening, saying, No eye will see me; and he puts a cover on his face. And in the night the thief goes about;

chinese: 盜賊黑夜挖窟窿；白日躲藏，並不認識光明。
english: In the dark he makes holes in the walls of houses: in the daytime they are shutting themselves up, they have no knowledge of the light.

chinese: 他們看早晨如幽暗，因為他們曉得幽暗的驚駭。
english: For the middle of the night is as morning to them, they are not troubled by the fear of the dark.

chinese: 這些惡人猶如浮萍快快飄去。他們所得的分在世上被咒詛；他們不得再走葡萄園的路。
english: They go quickly on the face of the waters; their heritage is cursed in the earth; the steps of the crusher of grapes are not turned to their vine-garden.

chinese: 乾旱炎熱消沒雪水；陰間也如此消沒犯罪之輩。
english: Snow waters become dry with the heat: so do sinners go down into the underworld.

chinese: 懷他的母（原文是胎）要忘記他；蟲子要吃他，覺得甘甜；他不再被人記念。不義的人必如樹折斷。
english: The public place of his town has no more knowledge of him, and his name has gone from the memory of men: he is rooted up like a dead tree.

chinese: 他惡待（或譯：他吞滅）不懷孕不生養的婦人，不善待寡婦。
english: He is not kind to the widow, and he has no pity for her child.

chinese: 然而神用能力保全有勢力的人；那性命難保的人仍然興起。
english: But God by his power gives long life to the strong; he gets up again, though he has no hope of life.

chinese: 神使他們安穩，他們就有所倚靠；神的眼目也看顧他們的道路。
english: He takes away his fear of danger and gives him support; and his eyes are on his ways.

chinese: 他們被高舉，不過片時就沒有了；他們降為卑，被除滅，與眾人一樣，又如穀穗被割。
english: For a short time they are lifted up; then they are gone; they are made low, they are pulled off like fruit, and like the heads of grain they are cut off.

chinese: 若不是這樣，誰能證實我是說謊的，將我的言語駁為虛空呢？
english: And if it is not so, now, who will make it clear that my words are false, and that what I say is of no value?

chinese: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

chinese: 神有治理之權，有威嚴可畏；他在高處施行和平。
english: Rule and power are his; he makes peace in his high places.

chinese: 他的諸軍豈能數算？他的光亮一發，誰不蒙照呢？
english: Is it possible for his armies to be numbered? and on whom is not his light shining?

chinese: 這樣在神面前，人怎能稱義？婦人所生的怎能潔淨？
english: How then is it possible for man to be upright before God? or how may he be clean who is a son of woman?

chinese: 在神眼前，月亮也無光亮，星宿也不清潔。
english: See, even the moon is not bright, and the stars are not clean in his eyes:

chinese: 何況如蟲的人，如蛆的世人呢！
english: How much less man who is an insect, and the son of man who is a worm!

chinese: 約伯回答說：
english: Then Job made answer and said,

chinese: 無能的人蒙你何等的幫助！膀臂無力的人蒙你何等的拯救！
english: How have you given help to him who has no power! how have you been the salvation of the arm which has no strength!

chinese: 無智慧的人蒙你何等的指教！你向他多顯大知識！
english: How have you given teaching to him who has no wisdom, and fully made clear true knowledge!

chinese: 你向誰發出言語來？誰的靈從你而出？
english: To whom have your words been said? and whose spirit came out from you?

chinese: 在大水和水族以下的陰魂戰兢。
english: The shades in the underworld are shaking; the waters and those living in them.

chinese: 在神面前，陰間顯露；滅亡也不得遮掩。
english: The underworld is uncovered before him, and Destruction has no veil.

chinese: 神將北極鋪在空中，將大地懸在虛空；
english: By his hand the north is stretched out in space, and the earth is hanging on nothing.

chinese: 將水包在密雲中，雲卻不破裂；
english: By him the waters are shut up in his thick clouds, and the cloud does not give way under them.

chinese: 遮蔽他的寶座，將雲鋪在其上；
english: By him the face of his high seat is veiled, and his cloud stretched out over it.

chinese: 在水面的周圍劃出界限，直到光明黑暗的交界。
english: By him a circle is marked out on the face of the waters, to the limits of the light and the dark.

chinese: 天的柱子因他的斥責震動驚奇。
english: The pillars of heaven are shaking, and are overcome by his sharp words.

chinese: 他以能力攪動（或譯：平靜）大海；他藉知識打傷拉哈伯，
english: By his power the sea was made quiet; and by his wisdom Rahab was wounded.

chinese: 藉他的靈使天有妝飾；他的手刺殺快蛇。
english: By his wind the heavens become bright: by his hand the quickly moving snake was cut through.

chinese: 看哪，這不過是神工作的些微；我們所聽於他的是何等細微的聲音！他大能的雷聲誰能明透呢？
english: See, these are only the outskirts of his ways; and how small is that which comes to our ears about him! But the thunder of his acts of power is outside all knowledge.

chinese: 約伯接著說：
english: And Job again took up the word and said,

chinese: 神奪去我的理，全能者使我心中愁苦。我指著永生的神起誓：
english: By the life of God, who has taken away my right; and of the Ruler of all, who has made my soul bitter;

chinese: 我的生命尚在我裡面；神所賜呼吸之氣仍在我的鼻孔內。
english: (For all my breath is still in me, and the spirit of God is my life;)

chinese: 我的嘴決不說非義之言；我的舌也不說詭詐之語。
english: Truly, there is no deceit in my lips, and my tongue does not say what is false.

chinese: 我斷不以你們為是；我至死必不以自己為不正！
english: Let it be far from me! I will certainly not say that you are right! I will come to death before I give up my righteousness.

chinese: 我持定我的義，必不放鬆；在世的日子，我心必不責備我。
english: I will keep it safe, and will not let it go: my heart has nothing to say against any part of my life.

chinese: 願我的仇敵如惡人一樣；願那起來攻擊我的，如不義之人一般。
english: Let my hater be like the evil man, and let him who comes against me be as the sinner.

chinese: 不敬虔的人雖然得利，神奪取其命的時候還有甚麼指望呢？
english: For what is the hope of the sinner when he is cut off, when God takes back his soul?

chinese: 患難臨到他，神豈能聽他的呼求？
english: Will his cry come to the ears of God when he is in trouble?

chinese: 他豈以全能者為樂，隨時求告神呢？
english: Will he take delight in the Ruler of all, and make his prayer to God at all times?

chinese: 神的作為，我要指教你們；全能者所行的，我也不隱瞞。
english: I will give you teaching about the hand of God; I will not keep secret from you what is in the mind of the Ruler of all.

chinese: 你們自己也都見過，為何全然變為虛妄呢？
english: Truly, you have all seen it yourselves; why then have you become completely foolish?

chinese: 神為惡人所定的分，強暴人從全能者所得的報（原文是產業）乃是這樣：
english: This is the punishment of the evil-doer from God, and the heritage given to the cruel by the Ruler of all.

chinese: 倘或他的兒女增多，還是被刀所殺；他的子孫必不得飽食。
english: If his children are increased, it is for the sword; and his offspring have not enough bread.
