chinese: 他所遺留的人必死而埋葬；他的寡婦也不哀哭。
english: When those of his house who are still living come to their end by disease, they are not put into the earth, and their widows are not weeping for them.

chinese: 他雖積蓄銀子如塵沙，預備衣服如泥土；
english: Though he may get silver together like dust, and make ready great stores of clothing;

chinese: 他只管預備，義人卻要穿上；他的銀子，無辜的人要分取。
english: He may get them ready, but the upright will put them on, and he who is free from sin will take the silver for a heritage.

chinese: 他建造房屋如蟲做窩，又如守望者所搭的棚。
english: His house has no more strength than a spider's thread, or a watchman's tent.

chinese: 他雖富足躺臥，卻不得收殮，轉眼之間就不在了。
english: He goes to rest full of wealth, but does so for the last time: on opening his eyes, he sees it there no longer.

chinese: 驚恐如波濤將他追上；暴風在夜間將他颳去。
english: Fears overtake him like rushing waters; in the night the storm-wind takes him away.

chinese: 東風把他飄去，又颳他離開本處。
english: The east wind takes him up and he is gone; he is forced violently out of his place.

chinese: 神要向他射箭，並不留情；他恨不得逃脫神的手。
english: God sends his arrows against him without mercy; he goes in flight before his hand.

chinese: 人要向他拍掌，並要發叱聲，使他離開本處。
english: Men make signs of joy because of him, driving him from his place with sounds of hissing.

chinese: 銀子有礦；煉金有方。
english: Truly there is a mine for silver, and a place where gold is washed out.

chinese: 鐵從地裡挖出；銅從石中鎔化。
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and stone is changed into brass by the fire.

chinese: 人為黑暗定界限，查究幽暗陰翳的石頭，直到極處，
english: Man puts an end to the dark, searching out to the farthest limit the stones of the deep places of the dark.

chinese: 在無人居住之處刨開礦穴，過路的人也想不到他們；又與人遠離，懸在空中搖來搖去。
english: He makes a deep mine far away from those living in the light of day; when they go about on the earth, they have no knowledge of those who are under them, who are hanging far from men, twisting from side to side on a cord.

chinese: 至於地，能出糧食，地內好像被火翻起來。
english: As for the earth, bread comes out of it; but under its face it is turned up as if by fire.

chinese: 地中的石頭有藍寶石，並有金沙。
english: Its stones are the place of sapphires, and it has dust of gold.

chinese: 礦中的路鷙鳥不得知道；鷹眼也未見過。
english: No bird has knowledge of it, and the hawk's eye has never seen it.

chinese: 狂傲的野獸未曾行過；猛烈的獅子也未曾經過。
english: The great beasts have not gone over it, and the cruel lion has not taken that way.

chinese: 人伸手鑿開堅石，傾倒山根，
english: Man puts out his hand on the hard rock, overturning mountains by the roots.

chinese: 在磐石中鑿出水道，親眼看見各樣寶物。
english: He makes deep ways, cut through the rock, and his eye sees everything of value.

chinese: 他封閉水不得滴流，使隱藏的物顯露出來。
english: He keeps back the streams from flowing, and makes the secret things come out into the light.

chinese: 然而，智慧有何處可尋？聰明之處在哪裡呢？
english: But where may wisdom be seen? and where is the resting-place of knowledge?

chinese: 智慧的價值無人能知，在活人之地也無處可尋。
english: Man has not seen the way to it, and it is not in the land of the living.

chinese: 深淵說：不在我內；滄海說：不在我中。
english: The deep waters say, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not with me.

chinese: 智慧非用黃金可得，也不能平白銀為他的價值。
english: Gold may not be given for it, or a weight of silver in payment for it.

chinese: 俄斐金和貴重的紅瑪瑙，並藍寶石，不足與較量；
english: It may not be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the onyx of great price, or the sapphire.

chinese: 黃金和玻璃不足與比較；精金的器皿不足與兌換。
english: Gold and glass are not equal to it in price, and it may not be exchanged for jewels of the best gold.

chinese: 珊瑚、水晶都不足論；智慧的價值勝過珍珠（或譯：紅寶石）。
english: There is no need to say anything about coral or crystal; and the value of wisdom is greater than that of pearls.

chinese: 古實的紅璧璽不足與比較；精金也不足與較量。
english: The topaz of Ethiopia is not equal to it, and it may not be valued with the best gold.

chinese: 智慧從何處來呢？聰明之處在哪裡呢？
english: From where then does wisdom come, and where is the resting-place of knowledge?

chinese: 是向一切有生命的眼目隱藏，向空中的飛鳥掩蔽。
english: For it is kept secret from the eyes of all living, unseen by the birds of the air.

chinese: 滅沒和死亡說：我們風聞其名。
english: Destruction and Death say, We have only had word of it with our ears.

chinese: 神明白智慧的道路，曉得智慧的所在。
english: God has knowledge of the way to it, and of its resting-place;

chinese: 因他鑒察直到地極，遍觀普天之下，
english: For his eyes go to the ends of the earth, and he sees everything under heaven.

chinese: 要為風定輕重，又度量諸水；
english: When he made a weight for the wind, measuring out the waters;

chinese: 他為雨露定命令，為雷電定道路。
english: When he made a law for the rain, and a way for the thunder-flames;

chinese: 那時他看見智慧，而且述說；他堅定，並且查究。
english: Then he saw it, and put it on record; he gave it its fixed form, searching it out completely.

chinese: 他對人說：敬畏主就是智慧；遠離惡便是聰明。
english: And he said to man, Truly the fear of the Lord is wisdom, and to keep from evil is the way to knowledge.

chinese: 約伯又接著說：
english: And Job again took up the word and said,

chinese: 惟願我的景況如從前的月份，如神保守我的日子。
english: If only I might again be as I was in the months which are past, in the days when God was watching over me!

chinese: 那時他的燈照在我頭上；我藉他的光行過黑暗。
english: When his light was shining over my head, and when I went through the dark by his light.

chinese: 我願如壯年的時候：那時我在帳棚中，神待我有密友之情；
english: As I was in my flowering years, when my tent was covered by the hand of God;

chinese: 全能者仍與我同在；我的兒女都環繞我。
english: While the Ruler of all was still with me, and my children were round me;

chinese: 奶多可洗我的腳；磐石為我出油成河。
english: When my steps were washed with milk, and rivers of oil were flowing out of the rock for me.

chinese: 我出到城門，在街上設立座位；
english: When I went out of my door to go up to the town, and took my seat in the public place,

chinese: 少年人見我而迴避，老年人也起身站立；
english: The young men saw me, and went away, and the old men got up from their seats;

chinese: 王子都停止說話，用手摀口；
english: The rulers kept quiet, and put their hands on their mouths;

chinese: 首領靜默無聲，舌頭貼住上膛。
english: The chiefs kept back their words, and their tongues were joined to the roofs of their mouths.

chinese: 耳朵聽我的，就稱我有福；眼睛看我的，便稱讚我；
english: For when it came to their ears, men said that I was truly happy; and when their eyes saw, they gave witness to me;

chinese: 因我拯救哀求的困苦人和無人幫助的孤兒。
english: For I was a saviour to the poor when he was crying for help, to the child with no father, and to him who had no supporter.

chinese: 將要滅亡的為我祝福；我也使寡婦心中歡樂。
english: The blessing of him who was near to destruction came on me, and I put a song of joy into the widow's heart.

chinese: 我以公義為衣服，以公平為外袍和冠冕。
english: I put on righteousness as my clothing, and was full of it; right decisions were to me a robe and a head-dress.

chinese: 我為瞎子的眼，瘸子的腳。
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to him who had no power of walking.

chinese: 我為窮乏人的父；素不認識的人，我查明他的案件。
english: I was a father to the poor, searching out the cause of him who was strange to me.

chinese: 我打破不義之人的牙床，從他牙齒中奪了所搶的。
english: By me the great teeth of the evil-doer were broken, and I made him give up what he had violently taken away.

chinese: 我便說：我必死在家中（原文是窩中），必增添我的日子，多如塵沙。
english: Then I said, I will come to my end with my children round me, my days will be as the sand in number;

chinese: 我的根長到水邊；露水終夜霑在我的枝上。
english: My root will be open to the waters, and the night mist will be on my branches,

chinese: 我的榮耀在身上增新；我的弓在手中日強。
english: My glory will be ever new, and my bow will be readily bent in my hand.

chinese: 人聽見我而仰望，靜默等候我的指教。
english: Men gave ear to me, waiting and keeping quiet for my suggestions.

chinese: 我說話之後，他們就不再說；我的言語像雨露滴在他們身上。
english: After I had said what was in my mind, they were quiet and let my words go deep into their hearts;

chinese: 他們仰望我如仰望雨，又張開口如切慕春雨。
english: They were waiting for me as for the rain, opening their mouths wide as for the spring rains.

chinese: 他們不敢自信，我就向他們含笑；他們不使我臉上的光改變。
english: I was laughing at them when they had no hope, and the light of my face was never clouded by their fear.

chinese: 我為他們選擇道路，又坐首位；我如君王在軍隊中居住，又如弔喪的安慰傷心的人。
english: I took my place as a chief, guiding them on their way, and I was as a king among his army. ...

chinese: 但如今，比我年少的人戲笑我；其人之父我曾藐視，不肯安在看守我羊群的狗中。
english: But now those who are younger than I make sport of me; those whose fathers I would not have put with the dogs of my flocks.

chinese: 他們壯年的氣力既已衰敗，其手之力與我何益呢？
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me? all force is gone from them.

chinese: 他們因窮乏飢餓，身體枯瘦，在荒廢淒涼的幽暗中，齦乾燥之地，
english: They are wasted for need of food, biting the dry earth; their only hope of life is in the waste land.

chinese: 在草叢之中採鹹草，羅騰（小樹名，松類）的根為他們的食物。
english: They are pulling off the salt leaves from the brushwood, and making a meal of roots.

chinese: 他們從人中被趕出；人追喊他們如賊一般，
english: They are sent out from among their townsmen, men are crying after them as thieves

chinese: 以致他們住在荒谷之間，在地洞和巖穴中；
english: They have to get a resting-place in the hollows of the valleys, in holes of the earth and rocks.

chinese: 在草叢中叫喚，在荊棘下聚集。
english: They make noises like asses among the brushwood; they get together under the thorns.

chinese: 這都是愚頑下賤人的兒女；他們被鞭打，趕出境外。
english: They are sons of shame, and of men without a name, who have been forced out of the land.

chinese: 現在這些人以我為歌曲，以我為笑談。
english: And now I have become their song, and I am a word of shame to them.

chinese: 他們厭惡我，躲在旁邊站著，不住地吐唾沫在我臉上。
english: I am disgusting to them; they keep away from me, and put marks of shame on me.

chinese: 鬆開他們的繩索苦待我，在我面前脫去轡頭。
english: For he has made loose the cord of my bow, and put me to shame; he has sent down my flag to the earth before me.

chinese: 這等下流人在我右邊起來，推開我的腳，築成戰路來攻擊我。
english: The lines of his men of war put themselves in order, and make high their ways of destruction against me:

chinese: 這些無人幫助的，毀壞我的道，加增我的災。
english: They have made waste my roads, with a view to my destruction; his bowmen come round about me;

chinese: 他們來如同闖進大破口，在毀壞之間滾在我身上。
english: As through a wide broken place in the wall they come on, I am overturned by the shock of their attack.

chinese: 驚恐臨到我，驅逐我的尊榮如風；我的福祿如雲過去。
english: Fears have come on me; my hope is gone like the wind, and my well-being like a cloud.

chinese: 現在我心極其悲傷；困苦的日子將我抓住。
english: But now my soul is turned to water in me, days of trouble overtake me:

chinese: 夜間，我裡面的骨頭刺我，疼痛不止，好像齦我。
english: The flesh is gone from my bones, and they give me no rest; there is no end to my pains.

chinese: 因神的大力，我的外衣污穢不堪，又如裡衣的領子將我纏住。
english: With great force he takes a grip of my clothing, pulling me by the neck of my coat.

chinese: 神把我扔在淤泥中，我就像塵土和爐灰一般。
english: Truly God has made me low, even to the earth, and I have become like dust.

chinese: 主啊，我呼求你，你不應允我；我站起來，你就定睛看我。
english: You give no answer to my cry, and take no note of my prayer.

chinese: 你向我變心，待我殘忍，又用大能追逼我，
english: You have become cruel to me; the strength of your hand is hard on me.

chinese: 把我提在風中，使我駕風而行，又使我消滅在烈風中。
english: Lifting me up, you make me go on the wings of the wind; I am broken up by the storm.

chinese: 我知道要使我臨到死地，到那為眾生所定的陰宅。
english: For I am certain that you will send me back to death, and to the meeting-place ordered for all living.

chinese: 然而，人仆倒豈不伸手？遇災難豈不求救呢？
english: Has not my hand been stretched out in help to the poor? have I not been a saviour to him in his trouble?

chinese: 人遭難，我豈不為他哭泣呢？人窮乏，我豈不為他憂愁呢？
english: Have I not been weeping for the crushed? and was not my soul sad for him who was in need?

chinese: 我仰望得好處，災禍就到了；我等待光明，黑暗便來了。
english: For I was looking for good, and evil came; I was waiting for light, and it became dark.

chinese: 我心裡煩擾不安，困苦的日子臨到我身。
english: My feelings are strongly moved, and give me no rest; days of trouble have overtaken me.

chinese: 我沒有日光就哀哭行去（或譯：我面發黑並非因日曬）；我在會中站著求救。
english: I go about in dark clothing, uncomforted; I get up in the public place, crying out for help.

chinese: 我與野狗為弟兄，與鴕鳥為同伴。
english: I have become a brother to the jackals, and go about in the company of ostriches.

chinese: 我的皮膚黑而脫落；我的骨頭因熱燒焦。
english: My skin is black and dropping off me; and my bones are burning with the heat of my disease.

chinese: 所以，我的琴音變為悲音；我的簫聲變為哭聲。
english: And my music has been turned to sorrow, and the sound of my pipe into the noise of weeping.

chinese: 我與眼睛立約，怎能戀戀瞻望處女呢？
english: I made an agreement with my eyes; how then might my eyes be looking on a virgin?

chinese: 從至上的神所得之分，從至高全能者所得之業是甚麼呢？
english: For what is God's reward from on high, or the heritage given by the Ruler of all from heaven?

chinese: 豈不是禍患臨到不義的，災害臨到作孽的呢？
english: Is it not trouble for the sinner, and destruction for the evil-doers?

chinese: 神豈不是察看我的道路，數點我的腳步呢？
english: Does he not see my ways, and are not my steps all numbered?

chinese: 我若與虛謊同行，腳若追隨詭詐；
english: If I have gone in false ways, or my foot has been quick in working deceit;

chinese: （我若被公道的天平稱度，使神可以知道我的純正；）
english: (Let me be measured in upright scales, and let God see my righteousness:)

chinese: 我的腳步若偏離正路，我的心若隨著我的眼目，若有玷污粘在我手上；
english: If my steps have been turned out of the way, or if my heart went after my eyes, or if the property of another is in my hands;

chinese: 就願我所種的有別人吃，我田所產的被拔出來。
english: Let me put seed in the earth for another to have the fruit of it, and let my produce be uprooted.

chinese: 我若受迷惑，向婦人起淫念，在鄰舍的門外蹲伏，
english: If my heart went after another man's wife, or if I was waiting secretly at my neighbour's door;

chinese: 就願我的妻子給別人推磨，別人也與他同室。
english: Then let my wife give pleasure to another man and let others make use of her body.

chinese: 因為這是大罪，是審判官當罰的罪孽。
english: For that would be a crime; it would be an act for which punishment would be measured out by the judges:

chinese: 這本是火焚燒，直到毀滅，必拔除我所有的家產。
english: It would be a fire burning even to destruction, and taking away all my produce.

chinese: 我的僕婢與我爭辯的時候，我若藐視不聽他們的情節；
english: If I did wrong in the cause of my man-servant, or my woman-servant, when they went to law with me;

chinese: 神興起，我怎樣行呢？他察問，我怎樣回答呢？
english: What then will I do when God comes as my judge? and what answer may I give to his questions?

chinese: 造我在腹中的，不也是造他麼？將他與我摶在腹中的豈不是一位麼？
english: Did not God make him as well as me? did he not give us life in our mothers' bodies?

chinese: 我若不容貧寒人得其所願，或叫寡婦眼中失望，
english: If I kept back the desire of the poor; if the widow's eye was looking for help to no purpose;

chinese: 或獨自吃我一點食物，孤兒沒有與我同吃；
english: If I kept my food for myself, and did not give some of it to the child with no father;

chinese: （從幼年時孤兒與我同長，好像父子一樣；我從出母腹就扶助寡婦。）
english: (For I was cared for by God as by a father from my earliest days; he was my guide from the body of my mother;)

chinese: 我若見人因無衣死亡，或見窮乏人身無遮蓋；
english: If I saw one near to death for need of clothing, and that the poor had nothing covering him;

chinese: 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖，為我祝福；
english: If his back did not give me a blessing, and the wool of my sheep did not make him warm;

chinese: 我若在城門口見有幫助我的，舉手攻擊孤兒；
english: If my hand had been lifted up against him who had done no wrong, when I saw that I was supported by the judges;

chinese: 情願我的肩頭從缺盆骨脫落，我的膀臂從羊矢骨折斷。
english: May my arm be pulled from my body, and be broken from its base.

chinese: 因神降的災禍使我恐懼；因他的威嚴，我不能妄為。
english: For the fear of God kept me back, and because of his power I might not do such things.

chinese: 我若以黃金為指望，對精金說：你是我的倚靠；
english: If I made gold my hope, or if I ever said to the best gold, I have put my faith in you;

chinese: 我若因財物豐裕，因我手多得資財而歡喜；
english: If I was glad because my wealth was great, and because my hand had got together a great store;

chinese: 我若見太陽發光，明月行在空中，
english: If, when I saw the sun shining, and the moon moving on its bright way,

chinese: 心就暗暗被引誘，口便親手；
english: A secret feeling of worship came into my heart, and my hand gave kisses from my mouth;

chinese: 這也是審判官當罰的罪孽，又是我背棄在上的神。
english: That would have been another sin to be rewarded with punishment by the judges; for I would have been false to God on high.

chinese: 我若見恨我的遭報就歡喜，見他遭災便高興；
english: If I was glad at the trouble of my hater, and gave cries of joy when evil overtook him;

chinese: （我沒有容口犯罪，咒詛他的生命；）
english: (For I did not let my mouth give way to sin, in putting a curse on his life;)

chinese: 若我帳棚的人未嘗說，誰不以主人的食物吃飽呢？
english: If the men of my tent did not say, Who has not had full measure of his meat?

chinese: （從來我沒有容客旅在街上住宿，卻開門迎接行路的人；）
english: The traveller did not take his night's rest in the street, and my doors were open to anyone on a journey;

chinese: 我若像亞當（或譯：別人）遮掩我的過犯，將罪孽藏在懷中；
english: If I kept my evil doings covered, and my sin in the secret of my breast,

chinese: 因懼怕大眾，又因宗族藐視我使我驚恐，以致閉口無言，杜門不出；
english: For fear of the great body of people, or for fear that families might make sport of me, so that I kept quiet, and did not go out of my door;

chinese: 惟願有一位肯聽我！（看哪，在這裡有我所劃的押，願全能者回答我！）
english: If only God would give ear to me, and the Ruler of all would give me an answer! or if what he has against me had been put in writing!

chinese: 願那敵我者所寫的狀詞在我這裡！我必帶在肩上，又綁在頭上為冠冕。
english: Truly I would take up the book in my hands; it would be to me as a crown;

chinese: 我必向他述說我腳步的數目，必如君王進到他面前。
english: I would make clear the number of my steps, I would put it before him like a prince! The words of Job are ended.

chinese: 我若奪取田地，這地向我喊冤，犁溝一同哭泣；
english: If my land has made an outcry against me, or the ploughed earth has been in sorrow;

chinese: 我若吃地的出產不給價值，或叫原主喪命；
english: If I have taken its produce without payment, causing the death of its owners;

chinese: 願這地長蒺藜代替麥子，長惡草代替大麥。約伯的話說完了。
english: Then in place of grain let thorns come up, and in place of barley evil-smelling plants.

chinese: 於是這三個人，因約伯自以為義就不再回答他。
english: So these three men gave no more answers to Job, because he seemed to himself to be right.

chinese: 那時有布西人蘭族巴拉迦的兒子以利戶向約伯發怒；因約伯自以為義，不以神為義。
english: And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was angry, burning with wrath against Job, because he seemed to himself more right than God;

chinese: 他又向約伯的三個朋友發怒；因為他們想不出回答的話來，仍以約伯為有罪。
english: And he was angry with his three friends, because they had been unable to give him an answer, and had not made Job's sin clear.

chinese: 以利戶要與約伯說話，就等候他們，因為他們比自己年老。
english: Now Elihu had kept quiet while Job was talking, because they were older than he;

chinese: 以利戶見這三個人口中無話回答，就怒氣發作。
english: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, he was very angry.

chinese: 布西人巴拉迦的兒子以利戶回答說：我年輕，你們老邁；因此我退讓，不敢向你們陳說我的意見。
english: And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, made answer and said, I am young, and you are very old, so I was in fear, and kept myself from putting my knowledge before you.

chinese: 我說，年老的當先說話；壽高的當以智慧.教訓人。
english: I said to myself, It is right for the old to say what is in their minds, and for those who are far on in years to give out wisdom.

chinese: 但在人裡面有靈；全能者的氣使人有聰明。
english: But truly it is the spirit in man, even the breath of the Ruler of all, which gives them knowledge.

chinese: 尊貴的不都有智慧；壽高的不都能明白公平。
english: It is not the old who are wise, and those who are full of years have not the knowledge of what is right.

chinese: 因此我說：你們要聽我言；我也要陳說我的意見。
english: So I say, Give ear to me, and I will put forward my knowledge.

chinese: 你們查究所要說的話；那時我等候你們的話，側耳聽你們的辯論，
english: I was waiting for your words, I was giving ear to your wise sayings; while you were searching out what to say,

chinese: 留心聽你們；誰知你們中間無一人折服約伯，駁倒他的話。
english: I was taking note; and truly not one of you was able to make clear Job's error, or to give an answer to his words.

chinese: 你們切不可說：我們尋得智慧；神能勝他，人卻不能。
english: Take care that you do not say, Wisdom is here; God may overcome him, but not man.

chinese: 約伯沒有向我爭辯；我也不用你們的話回答他。
english: I will not put forward words like these, or make use of your sayings in answer to him.

chinese: 他們驚奇不再回答，一言不發。
english: Fear has overcome them, they have no more answers to give; they have come to an end of words.

chinese: 我豈因他們不說話，站住不再回答，仍舊等候呢？
english: And am I to go on waiting while they have nothing to say? while they keep quiet and give no more answers?

chinese: 我也要回答我的一分話，陳說我的意見。
english: I will give my answer; I will put forward my knowledge:

chinese: 因為我的言語滿懷；我裡面的靈激動我。
english: For I am full of words, I am unable to keep in my breath any longer:

chinese: 我的胸懷如盛酒之囊沒有出氣之縫，又如新皮袋快要破裂。
english: My stomach is like wine which is unable to get out; like skins full of new wine, it is almost burst.

chinese: 我要說話，使我舒暢；我要開口回答。
english: Let me say what is in my mind, so that I may get comfort; let me give answer with open mouth.

chinese: 我必不看人的情面，也不奉承人。
english: Let me not give respect to any man, or give names of honour to any living.

chinese: 我不曉得奉承；若奉承，造我的主必快快除滅我。
english: For I am not able to give names of honour to any man; and if I did, my Maker would quickly take me away.

chinese: 約伯啊，請聽我的話，留心聽我一切的言語。
english: And now, O Job, give ear to my words, and take note of all I say.

chinese: 我現在開口，用舌發言。
english: See, now my mouth is open, my tongue gives out words.

chinese: 我的言語要發明心中所存的正直；我所知道的，我嘴唇要誠實地說出。
english: My heart is overflowing with knowledge, my lips say what is true.

chinese: 神的靈造我；全能者的氣使我得生。
english: The spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Ruler of all gives me life.

chinese: 你若回答我，就站起來，在我面前陳明。
english: If you are able, give me an answer; put your cause in order, and come forward.

chinese: 我在神面前與你一樣，也是用土造成。
english: See, I am the same as you are in the eyes of God; I was cut off from the same bit of wet earth.

chinese: 我不用威嚴驚嚇你，也不用勢力重壓你。
english: Fear of me will not overcome you, and my hand will not be hard on you.

chinese: 你所說的，我聽見了，也聽見你的言語，說：
english: But you said in my hearing, and your voice came to my ears:

chinese: 我是清潔無過的，我是無辜的；在我裡面也沒有罪孽。
english: I am clean, without sin; I am washed, and there is no evil in me:

chinese: 神找機會攻擊我，以我為仇敵，
english: See, he is looking for something against me; in his eyes I am as one of his haters;

chinese: 把我的腳上了木狗，窺察我一切的道路。
english: He puts chains on my feet; he is watching all my ways.

chinese: 我要回答你說：你這話無理，因神比世人更大。
english: Truly, in saying this you are wrong; for God is greater than man.

chinese: 你為何與他爭論呢？因他的事都不對人解說？
english: Why do you put forward your cause against him, saying, He gives no answer to any of my words?

chinese: 神說一次、兩次，世人卻不理會。
english: For God gives his word in one way, even in two, and man is not conscious of it:

chinese: 人躺在床上沉睡的時候，神就用夢和夜間的異象，
english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep comes on men, while they take their rest on their beds;

chinese: 開通他們的耳朵，將當受的教訓印在他們心上，
english: Then he makes his secrets clear to men, so that they are full of fear at what they see;

chinese: 好叫人不從自己的謀算，不行驕傲的事（原文是將驕傲向人隱藏），
english: In order that man may be turned from his evil works, and that pride may be taken away from him;

chinese: 攔阻人不陷於坑裡，不死在刀下。
english: To keep back his soul from the underworld, and his life from destruction.

chinese: 人在床上被懲治，骨頭中不住地疼痛，
english: Pain is sent on him as a punishment, while he is on his bed; there is no end to the trouble in his bones;

chinese: 以致他的口厭棄食物，心厭惡美味。
english: He has no desire for food, and his soul is turned away from delicate meat;

chinese: 他的肉消瘦，不得再見；先前不見的骨頭都凸出來。
english: His flesh is so wasted away, that it may not be seen, and his bones. ...

chinese: 他的靈魂臨近深坑；他的生命近於滅命的。
english: And his soul comes near to the underworld, and his life to the angels of death.

chinese: 一千天使中，若有一個作傳話的與神同在，指示人所當行的事，
english: If now there may be an angel sent to him, one of the thousands which there are to be between him and God, and to make clear to man what is right for him;

chinese: 神就給他開恩，說：救贖他免得下坑；我已經得了贖價。
english: And if he has mercy on him, and says, Let him not go down to the underworld, I have given the price for his life:

chinese: 他的肉要比孩童的肉更嫩；他就返老還童。
english: Then his flesh becomes young again, and he comes back to the days of his early strength;

chinese: 他禱告神，神就喜悅他，使他歡呼朝見神的面；神又看他為義。
english: He makes his prayer to God, and he has mercy on him; he sees God's face with cries of joy; he gives news of his righteousness to men;

chinese: 他在人前歌唱說：我犯了罪，顛倒是非，這竟與我無益。
english: He makes a song, saying, I did wrong, turning from the straight way, but he did not give me the reward of my sin.

chinese: 神救贖我的靈魂免入深坑；我的生命也必見光。
english: He kept my soul from the underworld, and my life sees the light in full measure.

chinese: 神兩次、三次向人行這一切的事，
english: Truly, God does all these things to man, twice and three times,

chinese: 為要從深坑救回人的靈魂，使他被光照耀，與活人一樣。
english: Keeping back his soul from the underworld, so that he may see the light of life.

chinese: 約伯啊，你當側耳聽我的話，不要作聲，等我講說。
english: Take note O Job, give ear to me; keep quiet, while I say what is in my mind.

chinese: 你若有話說，就可以回答我；你只管說，因我願以你為是。
english: If you have anything to say, give me an answer; for it is my desire that you may be judged free from sin.

chinese: 若不然，你就聽我說；你不要作聲，我便將智慧教訓你。
english: If not, give attention to me, and keep quiet, and I will give you wisdom.

chinese: 以利戶又說：
english: And Elihu made answer and said,

chinese: 你們智慧人要聽我的話；有知識的人要留心聽我說。
english: Give ear, you wise, to my words; and you who have knowledge, give attention to me;

chinese: 因為耳朵試驗話語，好像上膛嘗食物。
english: For words are tested by the ear, as food is tasted by the mouth.

chinese: 我們當選擇何為是，彼此知道何為善。
english: Let us make the decision for ourselves as to what is right; let us have the knowledge among ourselves of what is good.

chinese: 約伯曾說：我是公義，神奪去我的理；
english: For Job has said, I am upright, and it is God who has taken away my right;

chinese: 我雖有理，還算為說謊言的；我雖無過，受的傷還不能醫治。
english: Though I am right, still I am in pain; my wound may not be made well, though I have done no wrong.

chinese: 誰像約伯，喝譏誚如同喝水呢？
english: What man is like Job, a man who freely makes sport of God,

chinese: 他與作孽的結伴，和惡人同行。
english: And goes in the company of evil-doers, walking in the way of sinners?

chinese: 他說：人以神為樂，總是無益。
english: For he has said, It is no profit to a man to take delight in God.

chinese: 所以，你們明理的人要聽我的話。神斷不致行惡；全能者斷不致作孽。
english: Now then, you wise, take note; you men of knowledge, give ear to me. Let it be far from God to do evil, and from the Ruler of all to do wrong.

chinese: 他必按人所做的報應人，使各人照所行的得報。
english: For he gives to every man the reward of his work, and sees that he gets the fruit of his ways.

chinese: 神必不作惡；全能者也不偏離公平。
english: Truly, God does not do evil, and the Ruler of all is not a false judge.

chinese: 誰派他治理地，安定全世界呢？
english: Who put the earth into his care, or made him responsible for the world?

chinese: 他若專心為己，將靈和氣收歸自己，
english: If he made his spirit come back to him, taking his breath into himself again,

chinese: 凡有血氣的就必一同死亡；世人必仍歸塵土。
english: All flesh would come to an end together, and man would go back to the dust.

chinese: 你若明理，就當聽我的話，留心聽我言語的聲音。
english: If you are wise, take note of this; give ear to the voice of my words.

chinese: 難道恨惡公平的可以掌權麼？那有公義的、有大能的，豈可定他有罪麼？
english: How may a hater of right be a ruler? and will you say that the upright Ruler of all is evil?

chinese: 他對君王說：你是鄙陋的；對貴臣說：你是邪惡的。
english: He who says to a king, You are an evil-doer; and to rulers, You are sinners;

chinese: 他待王子不徇情面，也不看重富足的過於貧窮的，因為都是他手所造。
english: Who has no respect for rulers, and who gives no more attention to those who have wealth than to the poor, for they are all the work of his hands.

chinese: 在轉眼之間，半夜之中，他們就死亡。百姓被震動而去世；有權力的被奪去非借人手。
english: Suddenly they come to an end, even in the middle of the night: the blow comes on the men of wealth, and they are gone, and the strong are taken away without the hand of man.

chinese: 神注目觀看人的道路，看明人的腳步。
english: For his eyes are on the ways of a man, and he sees all his steps.

chinese: 沒有黑暗、陰翳能給作孽的藏身。
english: There is no dark place, and no thick cloud, in which the workers of evil may take cover.

chinese: 神審判人，不必使人到他面前再三鑒察。
english: For he does not give man a fixed time to come before him to be judged.

chinese: 他用難測之法打破有能力的人，設立別人代替他們。
english: He sends the strong to destruction without searching out their cause, and puts others in their place.

chinese: 他原知道他們的行為，使他們在夜間傾倒滅亡。
english: For he has knowledge of their works, overturning them in the night, so that they are crushed.

chinese: 他在眾人眼前擊打他們，如同擊打惡人一樣。
english: The evil-doers are broken by his wrath, he puts his hand on them with force before the eyes of all onlookers.

chinese: 因為他們偏行不跟從他，也不留心他的道，
english: Because they did not go after him, and took no note of his ways,

chinese: 甚至使貧窮人的哀聲達到他那裡；他也聽了困苦人的哀聲。
english: So that the cry of the poor might come up to him, and the prayer of those in need come to his ears.

chinese: 他使人安靜，誰能擾亂（或譯：定罪）呢？他掩面，誰能見他呢？無論待一國或一人都是如此─
使不虔敬的人不得作王，免得有人牢籠百姓。
有誰對神說：我受了責罰，不再犯罪；
我所看不明的，求你指教我；我若作了孽，必不再作？
他施行報應，豈要隨你的心願、叫你推辭不受麼？選定的是你，不是我。你所知道的只管說罷！
明理的人和聽我話的智慧人必對我說：
english: Men of knowledge, and all wise men, hearing me, will say,

chinese: 約伯說話沒有知識，言語中毫無智慧。
english: Job's words do not come from knowledge; they are not the fruit of wisdom.

chinese: 願約伯被試驗到底，因他回答像惡人一樣。
english: May Job be tested to the end, because his answers have been like those of evil men.

chinese: 他在罪上又加悖逆；在我們中間拍手，用許多言語輕慢神。
english: For in addition to his sin, he is uncontrolled in heart; before our eyes he makes sport of God, increasing his words against him.

chinese: 以利戶又說：
english: And Elihu made answer and said,

chinese: 你以為有理，或以為你的公義勝於神的公義，
english: Does it seem to you to be right, and righteousness before God, to say,

chinese: 才說這與我有甚麼益處？我不犯罪比犯罪有甚麼好處呢？
english: What profit is it to me, and how am I better off than if I had done wrong?

chinese: 我要回答你和在你這裡的朋友。
english: I will make answer to you and to your friends:

chinese: 你要向天觀看，瞻望那高於你的穹蒼。
english: Let your eyes be turned to the heavens, and lifted up to see the skies; they are higher than you.

chinese: 你若犯罪，能使神受何害呢？你的過犯加增，能使神受何損呢？
english: If you have done wrong, is he any the worse for it? and if your sins are great in number, what is it to him?

chinese: 你若是公義，還能加增他甚麼呢？他從你手裡還接受甚麼呢？
english: If you are upright, what do you give to him? or what does he take from your hand?

chinese: 你的過惡或能害你這類的人；你的公義或能叫世人得益處。
english: Your evil-doing may have an effect on a man like yourself, or your righteousness on a son of man.

chinese: 人因多受欺壓就哀求，因受能者的轄制（原文是膀臂）便求救，
english: Because the hand of the cruel is hard on them, men are making sounds of grief; they are crying out for help because of the arm of the strong.

chinese: 卻無人說：造我的神在哪裡？他使人夜間歌唱，
english: But no one has said, Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night;

chinese: 教訓我們勝於地上的走獸，使我們有聰明勝於空中的飛鳥。
english: Who gives us more knowledge than the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the heaven?

chinese: 他們在那裡，因惡人的驕傲呼求，卻無人答應。
english: There they are crying out because of the pride of the evil-doers, but he gives them no answer.

chinese: 虛妄的呼求，神必不垂聽；全能者也必不眷顧。
english: But God will not give ear to what is false, or the Ruler of all take note of it;

chinese: 何況你說，你不得見他；你的案件在他面前，你等候他罷。
english: How much less when you say that you do not see him; that the cause is before him, and you are waiting for him.

chinese: 但如今因他未曾發怒降罰，也不甚理會狂傲，
english: And now ... ;

chinese: 所以約伯開口說虛妄的話，多發無知識的言語。
english: And Job's mouth is open wide to give out what is of no profit, increasing words without knowledge.

chinese: 以利戶又接著說：
english: And Elihu went on to say,

chinese: 你再容我片時，我就指示你，因我還有話為神說。
english: Give me a little more time, and I will make it clear to you; for I have still something to say for God.

chinese: 我要將所知道的從遠處引來，將公義歸給造我的主。
english: I will get my knowledge from far, and I will give righteousness to my Maker.

chinese: 我的言語真不虛謊；有知識全備的與你同在。
english: For truly my words are not false; one who has all knowledge is talking with you.

chinese: 神有大能，並不藐視人；他的智慧甚廣。
english: Truly, God gives up the hard-hearted, and will not give life to the sinner.

chinese: 他不保護惡人的性命，卻為困苦人伸冤。
english: His eyes are ever on the upright, and he gives to the crushed their right;

chinese: 他時常看顧義人，使他們和君王同坐寶座，永遠要被高舉。
english: Lifting them up to the seat of kings, and making them safe for ever.

chinese: 他們若被鎖鍊捆住，被苦難的繩索纏住，
english: And if they have been prisoned in chains, and taken in cords of trouble,

chinese: 他就把他們的作為和過犯指示他們，叫他們知道有驕傲的行動。
english: Then he makes clear to them what they have done, even their evil works in which they have taken pride.

chinese: 他也開通他們的耳朵得受教訓，吩咐他們離開罪孽轉回。
english: Their ear is open to his teaching, and he gives them orders so that their hearts may be turned from evil.

chinese: 他們若聽從事奉他，就必度日亨通，歷年福樂；
english: If they give ear to his voice, and do his word, then he gives them long life, and years full of pleasure.

chinese: 若不聽從，就要被刀殺滅，無知無識而死。
english: But if not, they come to their end, and give up their breath without knowledge.

chinese: 那心中不敬虔的人積蓄怒氣；神捆綁他們，他們竟不求救；
english: Those who have no fear of God keep wrath stored up in their hearts; they give no cry for help when they are made prisoners.

chinese: 必在青年時死亡，與污穢人一樣喪命。
english: They come to their end while they are still young, their life is short like that of those who are used for sex purposes in the worship of their gods.

chinese: 神藉著困苦救拔困苦人，趁他們受欺壓開通他們的耳朵。
english: He makes the wrong done to the poor the way of their salvation, opening their ears by their trouble.

chinese: 神也必引你出離患難，進入寬闊不狹窄之地；擺在你席上的必滿有肥甘。
但你滿口有惡人批評的言語；判斷和刑罰抓住你。
不可容忿怒觸動你，使你不服責罰；也不可因贖價大就偏行。
你的呼求（或譯：資財），或是你一切的勢力，果有靈驗，叫你不受患難麼？
不要切慕黑夜，就是眾民在本處被除滅的時候。
你要謹慎，不可重看罪孽，因你選擇罪孽過於選擇苦難。
english: Take care not to be turned to sin, for you have taken evil for your part in place of sorrow.

chinese: 神行事有高大的能力；教訓人的有誰像他呢？
english: Truly God is lifted up in strength; who is a ruler like him?

chinese: 誰派定他的道路？誰能說：你所行的不義？
english: Who ever gave orders to him, or said to him, You have done wrong?

chinese: 你不可忘記稱讚他所行的為大，就是人所歌頌的。
english: See that you give praise to his work, about which men make songs.

chinese: 他所行的，萬人都看見；世人也從遠處觀看。
english: All people are looking on it; man sees it from far.

chinese: 神為大，我們不能全知；他的年數不能測度。
english: Truly, God is great, greater than all our knowledge; the number of his years may not be searched out.

chinese: 他吸取水點，這水點從雲霧中就變成雨；
english: For he takes up the drops from the sea; he sends them through his mist as rain,

chinese: 雲彩將雨落下，沛然降與世人。
english: Flowing down from the sky, and dropping on the peoples.

chinese: 誰能明白雲彩如何鋪張，和神行宮的雷聲呢？
english: And who has knowledge of how the clouds are stretched out, or of the thunders of his tent?

chinese: 他將亮光普照在自己的四圍；他又遮覆海底。
english: See, he is stretching out his mist, covering the tops of the mountains with it.

chinese: 他用這些審判眾民，且賜豐富的糧食。
english: For by these he gives food to the peoples, and bread in full measure.

chinese: 他以電光遮手，命閃電擊中敵人（或譯：中了靶子）。
english: He takes the light in his hands, sending it against the mark.

chinese: 所發的雷聲顯明他的作為，又向牲畜指明要起暴風。
english: The thunder makes clear his passion, and the storm gives news of his wrath.

chinese: 因此我心戰兢，從原處移動。
english: At this my heart is shaking; it is moved out of its place.

chinese: 聽啊，神轟轟的聲音是他口中所發的響聲。
english: Give ear to the rolling noise of his voice; to the hollow sound which goes out of his mouth.

chinese: 他發響聲震遍天下，發電光閃到地極。
english: He sends it out through all the heaven, and his thunder-flame to the ends of the earth.

chinese: 隨後人聽見有雷聲轟轟，大發威嚴，雷電接連不斷。
english: After it a voice is sounding, thundering out the word of his power; he does not keep back his thunder-flames; from his mouth his voice is sounding.

chinese: 神發出奇妙的雷聲；他行大事，我們不能測透。
english: He does wonders, more than may be searched out; great things of which we have no knowledge;

chinese: 他對雪說：要降在地上；對大雨和暴雨也是這樣說。
english: For he says to the snow, Make the earth wet; and to the rain-storm, Come down.

chinese: 他封住各人的手，叫所造的萬人都曉得他的作為。
english: He puts an end to the work of every man, so that all may see his work.

chinese: 百獸進入穴中，臥在洞內。
english: Then the beasts go into their holes, and take their rest.

chinese: 暴風出於南宮；寒冷出於北方。
english: Out of its place comes the storm-wind, and the cold out of its store-houses.

chinese: 神噓氣成冰；寬闊之水也都凝結。
english: By the breath of God ice is made, and the wide waters are shut in.

chinese: 他使密雲盛滿水氣，布散電光之雲；
english: The thick cloud is weighted with thunder-flame, and the cloud sends out its light;

chinese: 這雲是藉他的指引游行旋轉，得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，
english: And it goes this way and that, round about, turning itself by his guiding, to do whatever he gives orders to be done, on the face of his world of men,

chinese: 或為責罰，或為潤地，或為施行慈愛。
english: For a rod, or for a curse, or for mercy, causing it to come on the mark.

chinese: 約伯啊，你要留心聽，要站立思想神奇妙的作為。
english: Give ear to this, O Job, and keep quiet in your place; and take note of the wonders worked by God.

chinese: 神如何吩咐這些，如何使雲中的電光照耀，你知道麼？
english: Have you knowledge of God's ordering of his works, how he makes the light of his cloud to be seen?

chinese: 雲彩如何浮於空中，那知識全備者奇妙的作為，你知道麼？
english: Have you knowledge of the balancings of the clouds, the wonders of him who has all wisdom?

chinese: 南風使地寂靜，你的衣服就如火熱，你知道麼？
english: You, whose clothing is warm, when the earth is quiet because of the south wind,

chinese: 你豈能與神同鋪穹蒼麼？這穹蒼堅硬，如同鑄成的鏡子。
english: Will you, with him, make the skies smooth, and strong as a polished looking-glass?

chinese: 我們愚昧不能陳說；請你指教我們該對他說甚麼話。
english: Make clear to me what we are to say to him; we are unable to put our cause before him, because of the dark.

chinese: 人豈可說：我願與他說話？豈有人自願滅亡麼？
english: How may he have knowledge of my desire for talk with him? or did any man ever say, May destruction come on me?

chinese: 現在有雲遮蔽，人不得見穹蒼的光亮；但風吹過，天又發晴。
english: And now the light is not seen, for it is dark because of the clouds; but a wind comes, clearing them away.

chinese: 金光出於北方，在神那裡有可怕的威嚴。
english: A bright light comes out of the north; God's glory is greatly to be feared.

chinese: 論到全能者，我們不能測度；他大有能力，有公平和大義，必不苦待人。
english: There is no searching out of the Ruler of all: his strength and his judging are great; he is full of righteousness, doing no wrong.

chinese: 所以，人敬畏他；凡自以為心中有智慧的人，他都不顧念。
english: For this cause men go in fear of him; he has no respect for any who are wise in heart.

chinese: 那時，耶和華從旋風中回答約伯說：
english: And the Lord made answer to Job out of the storm-wind, and said,

chinese: 誰用無知的言語使我的旨意暗昧不明，
english: Who is this who makes the purpose of God dark by words without knowledge?

chinese: 你要如勇士束腰；我問你，你可以指示我。
english: Get your strength together like a man of war; I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

chinese: 我立大地根基的時候，你在哪裡呢？你若有聰明，只管說罷！
english: Where were you when I put the earth on its base? Say, if you have knowledge.

chinese: 你若曉得就說，是誰定地的尺度？是誰把準繩拉在其上？
english: By whom were its measures fixed? Say, if you have wisdom; or by whom was the line stretched out over it?

chinese: 地的根基安置在何處？地的角石是誰安放的？
english: On what were its pillars based, or who put down its angle-stone,

chinese: 那時，晨星一同歌唱；神的眾子也都歡呼。
english: When the morning stars made songs together, and all the sons of the gods gave cries of joy?

chinese: 海水衝出，如出胎胞，那時誰將他關閉呢？
english: Or where were you when the sea came to birth, pushing out from its secret place;

chinese: 是我用雲彩當海的衣服，用幽暗當包裹他的布，
english: When I made the cloud its robe, and put thick clouds as bands round it,

chinese: 為他定界限，又安門和閂，
english: Ordering a fixed limit for it, with locks and doors;

chinese: 說：你只可到這裡，不可越過；你狂傲的浪要到此止住。
english: And said, So far you may come, and no farther; and here the pride of your waves will be stopped?

chinese: 你自生以來，曾命定晨光，使清晨的日光知道本位，
english: Have you, from your earliest days, given orders to the morning, or made the dawn conscious of its place;

chinese: 叫這光普照地的四極，將惡人從其中驅逐出來麼？
english: So that it might take a grip of the skirts of the earth, shaking all the evil-doers out of it?

chinese: 因這光，地面改變如泥上印印，萬物出現如衣服一樣。
english: It is changed like wet earth under a stamp, and is coloured like a robe;

chinese: 亮光不照惡人；強橫的膀臂也必折斷。
english: And from the evil-doers their light is kept back, and the arm of pride is broken.

chinese: 你曾進到海源，或在深淵的隱密處行走麼？
english: Have you come into the springs of the sea, walking in the secret places of the deep?

chinese: 死亡的門曾向你顯露麼？死蔭的門你曾見過麼？
english: Have the doors of death been open to you, or have the door-keepers of the dark ever seen you?

chinese: 地的廣大你能明透麼？你若全知道，只管說罷！
english: Have you taken note of the wide limits of the earth? Say, if you have knowledge of it all.

chinese: 光明的居所從何而至？黑暗的本位在於何處？
english: Which is the way to the resting-place of the light, and where is the store-house of the dark;

chinese: 你能帶到本境，能看明其室之路麼？
english: So that you might take it to its limit, guiding it to its house?

chinese: 你總知道，因為你早已生在世上，你日子的數目也多。
english: No doubt you have knowledge of it, for then you had come to birth, and the number of your days is great.

chinese: 你曾進入雪庫，或見過雹倉麼？
english: Have you come into the secret place of snow, or have you seen the store-houses of the ice-drops,

chinese: 這雪雹乃是我為降災，並打仗和爭戰的日子所預備的。
english: Which I have kept for the time of trouble, for the day of war and fighting?

chinese: 光亮從何路分開？東風從何路分散遍地？
english: Which is the way to the place where the wind is measured out, and the east wind sent out over the earth?

chinese: 誰為雨水分道？誰為雷電開路？
english: By whom has the way been cut for the flowing of the rain, and the flaming of the thunder;

chinese: 使雨降在無人之地、無人居住的曠野？
english: Causing rain to come on a land where no man is living, on the waste land which has no people;

chinese: 使荒廢淒涼之地得以豐足，青草得以發生？
english: To give water to the land where there is waste and destruction, and to make the dry land green with young grass?

chinese: 雨有父麼？露水珠是誰生的呢？
english: Has the rain a father? or who gave birth to the drops of night mist?

chinese: 冰出於誰的胎？天上的霜是誰生的呢？
english: Out of whose body came the ice? and who gave birth to the cold mist of heaven?

chinese: 諸水堅硬（或譯：隱藏）如石頭；深淵之面凝結成冰。
english: The waters are joined together, hard as a stone, and the face of the deep is covered.

chinese: 你能繫住昴星的結麼？能解開參星的帶麼？
english: Are the bands of the Pleiades fixed by you, or are the cords of Orion made loose?

chinese: 你能按時領出十二宮麼？能引導北斗和隨他的眾星（星：原文是子）麼？
english: Do you make Mazzaroth come out in its right time, or are the Bear and its children guided by you?

chinese: 你知道天的定例麼？能使地歸在天的權下麼？
english: Have you knowledge of the laws of the heavens? did you give them rule over the earth?

chinese: 你能向雲彩揚起聲來，使傾盆的雨遮蓋你麼？
english: Is your voice sent up to the cloud, so that you may be covered by the weight of waters?

chinese: 你能發出閃電，叫他行去，使他對你說：我們在這裡？
english: Do you send out the thunder-flames, so that they may go, and say to you, Here we are?

chinese: 誰將智慧放在懷中？誰將聰明賜於心內？
english: Who has put wisdom in the high clouds, or given knowledge to the lights of the north?

chinese: 誰能用智慧數算雲彩呢？塵土聚集成團，土塊緊緊結連；那時，誰能傾倒天上的瓶呢？
english: By whose wisdom are the clouds numbered, or the water-skins of the heavens turned to the earth,
When the earth becomes hard as metal, and is joined together in masses?

chinese: 母獅子在洞中蹲伏，少壯獅子在隱密處埋伏；你能為他們抓取食物，使他們飽足麼？
english: Do you go after food for the she-lion, or get meat so that the young lions may have enough,
When they are stretched out in their holes, and are waiting in the brushwood?

chinese: 烏鴉之雛因無食物飛來飛去，哀告神；那時，誰為他預備食物呢？
english: Who gives in the evening the meat he is searching for, when his young ones are crying to God; when the young lions with loud noise go wandering after their food?

chinese: 山巖間的野山羊幾時生產，你知道麼？母鹿下犢之期，你能察定麼？
english: Have you knowledge of the rock-goats? or do you see the roes giving birth to their young?

chinese: 他們懷胎的月數，你能數算麼？他們幾時生產，你能曉得麼？
english: Is the number of their months fixed by you? or is the time when they give birth ordered by you?

chinese: 他們屈身，將子生下，就除掉疼痛。
english: They are bent down, they give birth to their young, they let loose the fruit of their body.

chinese: 這子漸漸肥壯，在荒野長大，去而不回。
english: Their young ones are strong, living in the open country; they go out and do not come back again.

chinese: 誰放野驢出去自由？誰解開快驢的繩索？
english: Who has let the ass of the fields go free? or made loose the bands of the loud-voiced beast?

chinese: 我使曠野作他的住處，使鹹地當他的居所。
english: To whom I have given the waste land for a heritage, and the salt land as a living-place.

chinese: 他嗤笑城內的喧嚷，不聽趕牲口的喝聲。
english: He makes sport of the noise of the town; the voice of the driver does not come to his ears;

chinese: 遍山是他的草場；他尋找各樣青綠之物。
english: He goes looking for his grass-lands in the mountains, searching out every green thing.

chinese: 野牛豈肯服事你？豈肯住在你的槽旁？
english: Will the ox of the mountains be your servant? or is his night's resting-place by your food-store?

chinese: 你豈能用套繩將野牛籠在犁溝之間？他豈肯隨你耙山谷之地？
english: Will he be pulling your plough with cords, turning up the valleys after you?

chinese: 豈可因他的力大就倚靠他？豈可把你的工交給他做麼？
english: Will you put your faith in him, because his strength is great? will you give the fruit of your work into his care?

chinese: 豈可信靠他把你的糧食運到家，又收聚你禾場上的穀麼？
english: Will you be looking for him to come back, and get in your seed to the crushing-floor?

chinese: 鴕鳥的翅膀歡然搧展，豈是顯慈愛的翎毛和羽毛麼？
english: Is the wing of the ostrich feeble, or is it because she has no feathers,

chinese: 因他把蛋留在地上，在塵土中使得溫暖；
english: That she puts her eggs on the earth, warming them in the dust,

chinese: 卻想不到被腳踹碎，或被野獸踐踏。
english: Without a thought that they may be crushed by the foot, and broken by the beasts of the field?

chinese: 他忍心待雛，似乎不是自己的；雖然徒受勞苦，也不為雛懼怕；
english: She is cruel to her young ones, as if they were not hers; her work is to no purpose; she has no fear.

chinese: 因為神使他沒有智慧，也未將悟性賜給他。
english: For God has taken wisdom from her mind, and given her no measure of knowledge.

chinese: 他幾時挺身展開翅膀，就嗤笑馬和騎馬的人。
english: When she is shaking her wings on high, she makes sport of the horse and of him who is seated on him.

chinese: 馬的大力是你所賜的麼？他頸項上挓挲的鬃是你給他披上的麼？
english: Do you give strength to the horse? is it by your hand that his neck is clothed with power?

chinese: 是你叫他跳躍像蝗蟲麼？他噴氣之威使人驚惶。
english: Is it through you that he is shaking like a locust, in the pride of his loud-sounding breath?

chinese: 他在谷中刨地，自喜其力；他出去迎接佩帶兵器的人。
english: He is stamping with joy in the valley; he makes sport of fear.

chinese: 他嗤笑可怕的事並不驚惶，也不因刀劍退回。
english: In his strength he goes out against the arms of war, turning not away from the sword.

chinese: 箭袋和發亮的槍，並短槍在他身上錚錚有聲。
english: The bow is sounding against him; he sees the shining point of spear and arrow.

chinese: 他發猛烈的怒氣將地吞下；一聽角聲就不耐站立。
english: Shaking with passion, he is biting the earth; he is not able to keep quiet at the sound of the horn;

chinese: 角每發聲，他說呵哈；他從遠處聞著戰氣，又聽見軍長大發雷聲和兵丁吶喊。
english: When it comes to his ears he says, Aha! He is smelling the fight from far off, and hearing the thunder of the captains, and the war-cries.

chinese: 鷹雀飛翔，展開翅膀一直向南，豈是藉你的智慧麼？
english: Is it through your knowledge that the hawk takes his flight, stretching out his wings to the south?

chinese: 大鷹上騰在高處搭窩，豈是聽你的吩咐麼？
english: Or is it by your orders that the eagle goes up, and makes his resting-place on high?

chinese: 他住在山巖，以山峰和堅固之所為家，
english: On the rock is his house, and on the mountain-top his strong place.

chinese: 從那裡窺看食物，眼睛遠遠觀望。
english: From there he is watching for food; his eye sees it far off.

chinese: 他的雛也咂血；被殺的人在哪裡，他也在那裡。
english: His young have blood for their drink, and where the dead bodies are, there is he to be seen.

chinese: 耶和華又對約伯說：
強辯的豈可與全能者爭論麼？與神辯駁的可以回答這些罷！
english: Will he who is protesting give teaching to the Ruler of all? Let him who has arguments to put forward against God give an answer.

chinese: 於是，約伯回答耶和華說：
english: And Job said in answer to the Lord,

chinese: 我是卑賤的！我用甚麼回答你呢？只好用手摀口。
english: Truly, I am of no value; what answer may I give to you? I will put my hand on my mouth.

chinese: 我說了一次，再不回答；說了兩次，就不再說。
english: I have said once, and even twice, what was in my mind, but I will not do so again.

chinese: 於是，耶和華從旋風中回答約伯說：
english: Then the Lord made answer to Job out of the storm-wind, and said,

chinese: 你要如勇士束腰；我問你，你可以指示我。
english: Get your strength together like a man of war: I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

chinese: 你豈可廢棄我所擬定的？豈可定我有罪，好顯自己為義麼？
english: Will you even make my right of no value? will you say that I am wrong in order to make clear that you are right?

chinese: 你有神那樣的膀臂麼？你能像他發雷聲麼？
english: Have you an arm like God? have you a voice of thunder like his?

chinese: 你要以榮耀莊嚴為妝飾，以尊榮威嚴為衣服；
english: Put on the ornaments of your pride; be clothed with glory and power:

chinese: 要發出你滿溢的怒氣，見一切驕傲的人，使他降卑；
english: Let your wrath be overflowing; let your eyes see all the sons of pride, and make them low.

chinese: 見一切驕傲的人，將他制伏，把惡人踐踏在本處；
english: Send destruction on all who are lifted up, pulling down the sinners from their places.

chinese: 將他們一同隱藏在塵土中，把他們的臉蒙蔽在隱密處；
english: Let them be covered together in the dust; let their faces be dark in the secret place of the underworld.

chinese: 我就認你右手能以救自己。
english: Then I will give praise to you, saying that your right hand is able to give you salvation.

chinese: 你且觀看河馬；我造你也造他。他吃草與牛一樣；
english: See now the Great Beast, whom I made, even as I made you; he takes grass for food, like the ox.

chinese: 他的氣力在腰間，能力在肚腹的筋上。
english: His strength is in his body, and his force in the muscles of his stomach.

chinese: 他搖動尾巴如香柏樹；他大腿的筋互相聯絡。
english: His tail is curving like a cedar; the muscles of his legs are joined together.

chinese: 他的骨頭好像銅管；他的肢體彷彿鐵棍。
english: His bones are pipes of brass, his legs are like rods of iron.

chinese: 他在神所造的物中為首；創造他的給他刀劍。
english: He is the chief of the ways of God, made by him for his pleasure.

chinese: 諸山給他出食物，也是百獸遊玩之處。
english: He takes the produce of the mountains, where all the beasts of the field are at play.

chinese: 他伏在蓮葉之下，臥在蘆葦隱密處和水窪子裡。
english: He takes his rest under the trees of the river, and in the pool, under the shade of the water-plants.

chinese: 蓮葉的陰涼遮蔽他；溪旁的柳樹環繞他。
english: He is covered by the branches of the trees; the grasses of the stream are round him.

chinese: 河水泛濫，他不發戰；就是約但河的水漲到他口邊，也是安然。
english: Truly, if the river is overflowing, it gives him no cause for fear; he has no sense of danger, even if Jordan is rushing against his mouth.

chinese: 在他防備的時候，誰能捉拿他？誰能牢籠他穿他的鼻子呢？
english: Will anyone take him when he is on the watch, or put metal teeth through his nose?

chinese: 你能用魚鉤釣上鱷魚麼？能用繩子壓下他的舌頭麼？
english: Is it possible for Leviathan to be pulled out with a fish-hook, or for a hook to be put through the bone of his mouth?

chinese: 你能用繩索穿他的鼻子麼？能用鉤穿他的腮骨麼？
english: Will you put a cord into his nose, or take him away with a cord round his tongue?

chinese: 他豈向你連連懇求，說柔和的話麼？
english: Will he make prayers to you, or say soft words to you?

chinese: 豈肯與你立約，使你拿他永遠作奴僕麼？
english: Will he make an agreement with you, so that you may take him as a servant for ever?

chinese: 你豈可拿他當雀鳥玩耍麼？豈可為你的幼女將他拴住麼？
english: Will you make sport with him, as with a bird? or put him in chains for your young women?

chinese: 搭夥的漁夫豈可拿他當貨物麼？能把他分給商人麼？
english: Will the fishermen make profit out of him? will they have him cut up for the traders?

chinese: 你能用倒鉤槍扎滿他的皮，能用魚叉叉滿他的頭麼？
english: Will you put sharp-pointed irons into his skin, or fish-spears into his head?

chinese: 你按手在他身上，想與他爭戰，就不再這樣行罷！
english: Only put your hand on him, and see what a fight you will have; you will not do it again!

chinese: 人指望捉拿他是徒然的；一見他，豈不喪膽麼？
english: Truly, the hope of his attacker is false; he is overcome even on seeing him!

chinese: 沒有那麼凶猛的人敢惹他。這樣，誰能在我面前站立得住呢？
english: He is so cruel that no one is ready to go against him. Who then is able to keep his place before me?

chinese: 誰先給我甚麼，使我償還呢？天下萬物都是我的。
english: Who ever went against me, and got the better of me? There is no one under heaven!

chinese: 論到鱷魚的肢體和其大力，並美好的骨骼，我不能緘默不言。
english: I will not keep quiet about the parts of his body, or about his power, and the strength of his frame.

chinese: 誰能剝他的外衣？誰能進他上下牙骨之間呢？
english: Who has ever taken off his outer skin? who may come inside his inner coat of iron?

chinese: 誰能開他的腮頰？他牙齒四圍是可畏的。
english: Who has made open the doors of his face? Fear is round about his teeth.

chinese: 他以堅固的鱗甲為可誇，緊緊合閉，封得嚴密。
english: His back is made of lines of plates, joined tight together, one against the other, like a stamp.

chinese: 這鱗甲一一相連，甚至氣不得透入其間，
english: One is so near to the other that no air may come between them.

chinese: 都是互相聯絡、膠結，不能分離。
english: They take a grip of one another; they are joined together, so that they may not be parted.

chinese: 他打噴嚏就發出光來；他眼睛好像早晨的光線（原文是眼皮）。
english: His sneezings give out flames, and his eyes are like the eyes of the dawn.

chinese: 從他口中發出燒著的火把，與飛迸的火星；
english: Out of his mouth go burning lights, and flames of fire are jumping up.

chinese: 從他鼻孔冒出煙來，如燒開的鍋和點著的蘆葦。
english: Smoke comes out of his nose, like a pot boiling on the fire.

chinese: 他的氣點著煤炭，有火燄從他口中發出。
english: His breath puts fire to coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.

chinese: 他頸項中存著勁力；在他面前的都恐嚇蹦跳。
english: Strength is in his neck, and fear goes dancing before him.

chinese: 他的肉塊互相聯絡，緊貼其身，不能搖動。
english: The plates of his flesh are joined together, fixed, and not to be moved.

chinese: 他的心結實如石頭，如下磨石那樣結實。
english: His heart is as strong as a stone, hard as the lower crushing-stone.

chinese: 他一起來，勇士都驚恐，心裡慌亂，便都昏迷。
english: When he gets ready for the fight, the strong are overcome with fear.

chinese: 人若用刀，用槍，用標槍，用尖槍扎他，都是無用。
english: The sword may come near him but is not able to go through him; the spear, or the arrow, or the sharp-pointed iron.

chinese: 他以鐵為乾草，以銅為爛木。
english: Iron is to him as dry grass, and brass as soft wood.

chinese: 箭不能恐嚇他使他逃避；彈石在他看為碎秸。
english: The arrow is not able to put him to flight: stones are no more to him than dry stems.

chinese: 棍棒算為禾秸；他嗤笑短槍颼的響聲。
english: A thick stick is no better than a leaf of grass, and he makes sport of the onrush of the spear.

chinese: 他肚腹下如尖瓦片；他如釘耙經過淤泥。
english: Under him are sharp edges of broken pots: as if he was pulling a grain-crushing instrument over the wet earth.

chinese: 他使深淵開滾如鍋，使洋海如鍋中的膏油。
english: The deep is boiling like a pot of spices, and the sea like a perfume-vessel.

chinese: 他行的路隨後發光，令人想深淵如同白髮。
english: After him his way is shining, so that the deep seems white.

chinese: 在地上沒有像他造的那樣，無所懼怕。
english: On earth there is not another like him, who is made without fear.

chinese: 凡高大的，他無不藐視；他在驕傲的水族上作王。
english: Everything which is high goes in fear of him; he is king over all the sons of pride.

chinese: 約伯回答耶和華說：
english: And Job said in answer to the Lord,

chinese: 我知道，你萬事都能做；你的旨意不能攔阻。
english: I see that you are able to do every thing, and to give effect to all your designs.

chinese: 誰用無知的言語使你的旨意隱藏呢？我所說的是我不明白的；這些事太奇妙，是我不知道的。
english: Who is this who makes dark the purpose of God by words without knowledge? For I have been talking without knowledge about wonders not to be searched out.

chinese: 求你聽我，我要說話；我問你，求你指示我。
english: Give ear to me, and I will say what is in my mind; I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

chinese: 我從前風聞有你，現在親眼看見你。
english: Word of you had come to my ears, but now my eye has seen you.

chinese: 因此我厭惡自己（或譯：我的言語），在塵土和爐灰中懊悔。
english: For this cause I give witness that what I said is false, and in sorrow I take my seat in the dust.

chinese: 耶和華對約伯說話以後，就對提幔人以利法說：我的怒氣向你和你兩個朋友發作，因為你們議論我不如我的僕人約伯說的是。
english: And it came about, after he had said these words to Job, that the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, I am very angry with you and your two friends, because you have not said what is right about me, as my servant Job has.

chinese: 現在你們要取七隻公牛，七隻公羊，到我僕人約伯那裡去，為自己獻上燔祭，我的僕人約伯就為你們祈禱。我因悅納他，就不按你們的愚妄辦你們。你們議論我，不如我的僕人約伯說的是。
english: And now, take seven oxen and seven sheep, and go to my servant Job, and give a burned offering for yourselves, and my servant Job will make prayer for you, that I may not send punishment on you; because you have not said what is right about me, as my servant Job has.

chinese: 於是提幔人以利法、書亞人比勒達、拿瑪人瑣法照著耶和華所吩咐的去行；耶和華就悅納約伯。
english: And Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, went and did as the Lord had said. And the Lord gave ear to Job.

chinese: 約伯為他的朋友祈禱。耶和華就使約伯從苦境（原文是擄掠）轉回，並且耶和華賜給他的比他從前所有的加倍。
english: And the Lord made up to Job for all his losses, after he had made prayer for his friends: and all Job had before was increased by the Lord twice as much.

chinese: 約伯的弟兄、姊妹，和以先所認識的人都來見他，在他家裡一同吃飯；又論到耶和華所降與他的一切災禍，都為他悲傷安慰他。每人也送他一塊銀子和一個金環。
english: And all his brothers and sisters, and his friends of earlier days, came and took food with him in his house; and made clear their grief for him, and gave him comfort for all the evil which the Lord had sent on him; and they all gave him a bit of money and a gold ring.

chinese: 這樣，耶和華後來賜福給約伯比先前更多。他有一萬四千羊，六千駱駝，一千對牛，一千母驢。
english: And the Lord's blessing was greater on the end of Job's life than on its start: and so he came to have fourteen thousand sheep and goats, and six thousand camels, and two thousand oxen, and a thousand she-asses.

chinese: 他也有七個兒子，三個女兒。
english: And he had seven sons and three daughters.

chinese: 他給長女起名叫耶米瑪，次女叫基洗亞，三女叫基連哈樸。
english: And he gave the first the name of Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch;

chinese: 在那全地的婦女中找不著像約伯的女兒那樣美貌。他們的父親使他們在弟兄中得產業。
english: And there were no women so beautiful as the daughters of Job in all the earth: and their father gave them a heritage among their brothers.

chinese: 此後，約伯又活了一百四十年，得見他的兒孫，直到四代。
english: And after this Job had a hundred and forty years of life, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

chinese: 這樣，約伯年紀老邁，日子滿足而死。
english: And Job came to his end, old and full of days.

chinese: 不從惡人的計謀，不站罪人的道路，不坐褻慢人的座位，
english: Happy is the man who does not go in the company of sinners, or take his place in the way of evil-doers, or in the seat of those who do not give honour to the Lord.

chinese: 惟喜愛耶和華的律法，晝夜思想，這人便為有福！
english: But whose delight is in the law of the Lord, and whose mind is on his law day and night.

chinese: 他要像一棵樹栽在溪水旁，按時候結果子，葉子也不枯乾。凡他所做的盡都順利。
english: He will be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, which gives its fruit at the right time, whose leaves will ever be green; and he will do well in all his undertakings.

chinese: 惡人並不是這樣，乃像糠秕被風吹散。
english: The evil-doers are not so; but are like the dust from the grain, which the wind takes away.

chinese: 因此，當審判的時候惡人必站立不住；罪人在義人的會中也是如此。
english: For this cause there will be no mercy for sinners when they are judged, and the evil-doers will have no place among the upright,

chinese: 因為耶和華知道義人的道路；惡人的道路卻必滅亡。
english: Because the Lord sees the way of the upright, but the end of the sinner is destruction.

chinese: 外邦為甚麼爭鬧？萬民為甚麼謀算虛妄的事？
english: Why are the nations so violently moved, and why are the thoughts of the people so foolish?

chinese: 世上的君王一齊起來，臣宰一同商議，要敵擋耶和華並他的受膏者，
english: The kings of the earth have taken their place, and the rulers are fixed in their purpose, against the Lord, and against the king of his selection, saying,

chinese: 說：我們要掙開他們的捆綁，脫去他們的繩索。
english: Let their chains be broken, and their cords taken from off us.

chinese: 那坐在天上的必發笑；主必嗤笑他們。
english: Then he whose seat is in the heavens will be laughing: the Lord will make sport of them.

chinese: 那時，他要在怒中責備他們，在烈怒中驚嚇他們，
english: Then will his angry words come to their ears, and by his wrath they will be troubled:

chinese: 說：我已經立我的君在錫安─我的聖山上了。
english: But I have put my king on my holy hill of Zion.

chinese: 受膏者說：我要傳聖旨。耶和華曾對我說：你是我的兒子，我今日生你。
english: I will make clear the Lord's decision: he has said to me, You are my son, this day have I given you being.

chinese: 你求我，我就將列國賜你為基業，將地極賜你為田產。
english: Make your request to me, and I will give you the nations for your heritage, and the farthest limits of the earth will be under your hand.

chinese: 你必用鐵杖打破他們；你必將他們如同窯匠的瓦器摔碎。
english: They will be ruled by you with a rod of iron; they will be broken like a potter's vessel.

chinese: 現在，你們君王應當省悟！你們世上的審判官該受管教！
english: So now be wise, you kings: take his teaching, you judges of the earth.

chinese: 當存畏懼事奉耶和華，又當存戰兢而快樂。
english: Give worship to the Lord with fear, kissing his feet and giving him honour,

chinese: 當以嘴親子，恐怕他發怒，你們便在道中滅亡，因為他的怒氣快要發作。凡投靠他的，都是有福的。
english: For fear that he may be angry, causing destruction to come on you, because he is quickly moved to wrath. Happy are all those who put their faith in him.

chinese: （大衛逃避他兒子押沙龍的時候作的詩。）耶和華啊，我的敵人何其加增；有許多人起來攻擊我。
english: - A Psalm. Of David. When he went in flight from Absalom his son. - Lord, how greatly are they increased who make attacks on me! in great numbers they come against me.

chinese: 有許多人議論我說：他得不著神的幫助。（細拉）
english: Unnumbered are those who say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. (Selah.)

chinese: 但你─耶和華是我四圍的盾牌，是我的榮耀，又是叫我抬起頭來的。
english: But your strength, O Lord, is round me, you are my glory and the lifter up of my head.

chinese: 我用我的聲音求告耶和華，他就從他的聖山上應允我。（細拉）
english: I send up a cry to the Lord with my voice, and he gives me an answer from his holy hill. (Selah.)

chinese: 我躺下睡覺，我醒著，耶和華都保佑我。
english: I took my rest in sleep, and then again I was awake; for the Lord was my support.

chinese: 雖有成萬的百姓來周圍攻擊我，我也不怕。
english: I will have no fear, though ten thousand have come round me, putting themselves against me.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你起來！我的神啊，求你救我！因為你打了我一切仇敵的腮骨，敲碎了惡人的牙齒。
english: Come to me, Lord; keep me safe, O my God; for you have given all my haters blows on their face-bones; the teeth of the evil-doers have been broken by you.

chinese: 救恩屬乎耶和華；願你賜福給你的百姓。（細拉）
english: Salvation comes from the Lord; your blessing is on your people. (Selah.)

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）顯我為義的神啊，我呼籲的時候，求你應允我！我在困苦中，你曾使我寬廣；現在求你憐恤我，聽我的禱告！
english: - To the chief music-maker on corded instruments. A Psalm. Of David. - Give answer to my cry, O God of my righteousness; make me free from my troubles; have mercy on me, and give ear to my prayer.

chinese: 你們這上流人哪，你們將我的尊榮變為羞辱要到幾時呢？你們喜愛虛妄，尋找虛假，要到幾時呢？（細拉）
english: O you sons of men, how long will you go on turning my glory into shame? how long will you give your love to foolish things, going after what is false? (Selah.)

chinese: 你們要知道，耶和華已經分別虔誠人歸他自己；我求告耶和華，他必聽我。
english: See how the Lord has made great his mercy for me; the Lord will give ear to my cry.

chinese: 你們應當畏懼，不可犯罪；在床上的時候，要心裡思想，並要肅靜。（細拉）
english: Let there be fear in your hearts, and do no sin; have bitter feelings on your bed, but make no sound. (Selah.)

chinese: 當獻上公義的祭，又當倚靠耶和華。
english: Give the offerings of righteousness, and put your faith in the Lord.

chinese: 有許多人說：誰能指示我們甚麼好處？耶和華啊，求你仰起臉來，光照我們。
english: There are numbers who say, Who will do us any good? the light of his face has gone from us.

chinese: 你使我心裡快樂，勝過那豐收五穀新酒的人。
english: Lord, you have put joy in my heart, more than they have when their grain and their wine are increased.

chinese: 我必安然躺下睡覺，因為獨有你─耶和華使我安然居住。
english: I will take my rest on my bed in peace, because you only, Lord, keep me safe.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。用吹的樂器。）耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的言語，顧念我的心思！
english: - To the chief music-maker on wind instruments. A Psalm. Of David. - Give ear to my words, O Lord; give thought to my heart-searchings.

chinese: 我的王我的神啊，求你垂聽我呼求的聲音！因為我向你祈禱。
english: Let the voice of my cry come to you, my King and my God; for to you will I make my prayer.

chinese: 耶和華啊，早晨你必聽我的聲音；早晨我必向你陳明我的心意，並要警醒！
english: My voice will come to you in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I send my prayer to you, and keep watch.

chinese: 因為你不是喜悅惡事的神，惡人不能與你同居。
english: For you are not a God who takes pleasure in wrongdoing; there is no evil with you.

chinese: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前；凡作孽的，都是你所恨惡的。
english: The sons of pride have no place before you; you are a hater of all workers of evil.

chinese: 說謊言的，你必滅絕；好流人血弄詭詐的，都為耶和華所憎惡。
english: You will send destruction on those whose words are false; the cruel man and the man of deceit are hated by the Lord.

chinese: 至於我，我必憑你豐盛的慈愛進入你的居所；我必存敬畏你的心向你的聖殿下拜。
english: But as for me, I will come into your house, in the full measure of your mercy; and in your fear I will give worship, turning my eyes to your holy Temple.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你因我的仇敵，憑你的公義引領我，使你的道路在我面前正直。
english: Be my guide, O Lord, in the ways of your righteousness, because of those who are against me; make your way straight before my face.

chinese: 因為，他們的口中沒有誠實；他們的心裡滿有邪惡；他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓；他們用舌頭諂媚人。
english: For no faith may be put in their words; their inner part is nothing but evil; their throat is like an open place for the dead; smooth are the words of their tongues.

chinese: 神啊，求你定他們的罪！願他們因自己的計謀跌倒；願你在他們許多的過犯中把他們逐出，因為他們背叛了你。
english: Send them to destruction, O Lord; let their evil designs be the cause of their fall; let them be forced out by all their sins; because they have gone against your authority.

chinese: 凡投靠你的，願他們喜樂，時常歡呼，因為你護庇他們；又願那愛你名的人都靠你歡欣。
english: But let all those who put their faith in you be glad with cries of joy at all times, and let all the lovers of your name be glad in you.

chinese: 因為你必賜福與義人；耶和華啊，你必用恩惠如同盾牌四面護衛他。
english: For you, Lord, will send a blessing on the upright man; your grace will be round him, and you will be his strength.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器，調用第八。）耶和華啊，求你不要在怒中責備我，也不要在烈怒中懲罰我！
english: - To the chief music-maker on corded instruments, on the Sheminith. A Psalm. Of David. - O Lord, do not be bitter with me in your wrath; do not send punishment on me in the heat of your passion.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你可憐我，因為我軟弱。耶和華啊，求你醫治我，因為我的骨頭發戰。
english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am wasted away: make me well, for even my bones are troubled.

chinese: 我心也大大地驚惶。耶和華啊，你要到幾時才救我呢？
english: My soul is in bitter trouble; and you, O Lord, how long?

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你轉回搭救我！因你的慈愛拯救我。
english: Come back, O Lord, make my soul free; O give me salvation because of your mercy.

chinese: 因為，在死地無人記念你，在陰間有誰稱謝你？
english: For in death there is no memory of you; in the underworld who will give you praise?

chinese: 我因唉哼而困乏；我每夜流淚，把床榻漂起，把褥子濕透。
english: The voice of my sorrow is a weariness to me; all the night I make my bed wet with weeping; it is watered by the drops flowing from my eyes.

chinese: 我因憂愁眼睛乾癟，又因我一切的敵人眼睛昏花。
english: My eyes are wasting away with trouble; they are becoming old because of all those who are against me.

chinese: 你們一切作孽的人，離開我罷！因為耶和華聽了我哀哭的聲音。
english: Go from me, all you workers of evil; for the Lord has given ear to the voice of my weeping.

chinese: 耶和華聽了我的懇求；耶和華必收納我的禱告。
english: The Lord has given ear to my request; the Lord has let my prayer come before him.

chinese: 我的一切仇敵都必羞愧，大大驚惶；他們必要退後，忽然羞愧。
english: Let all those who are against me be shamed and deeply troubled; let them be turned back and suddenly put to shame.

chinese: （大衛指著便雅憫人古實的話，向耶和華唱的流離歌。）耶和華─我的神啊，我投靠你！求你救我脫離一切追趕我的人，將我救拔出來！
english: - Shiggaion of David; a song which he made to the Lord, about the words of Cush the Benjamite. - O Lord my God, I put my faith in you; take me out of the hands of him who is cruel to me, and make me free;

chinese: 恐怕他們像獅子撕裂我，甚至撕碎，無人搭救。
english: So that he may not come rushing on my soul like a lion, wounding it, while there is no one to be my saviour.

chinese: 耶和華─我的神啊，我若行了這事，若有罪孽在我手裡，
english: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if my hands have done any wrong;

chinese: 我若以惡報那與我交好的人─連那無故與我為敵的，我也救了他，
english: If I have given back evil to him who did evil to me, or have taken anything from him who was against me without cause;

chinese: 就任憑仇敵追趕我，直到追上，將我的性命踏在地下，使我的榮耀歸於灰塵。（細拉）
english: Let my hater go after my soul and take it; let my life be crushed to the earth, and my honour into the dust. (Selah.)

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你在怒中起來，挺身而立，抵擋我敵人的暴怒！求你為我興起！你已經命定施行審判！
english: Come up, Lord, in your wrath; be lifted up against my haters; be awake, my God, give orders for the judging.

chinese: 願眾民的會環繞你！願你從其上歸於高位！
english: The meeting of the nations will be round you; take your seat, then, over them, on high.

chinese: 耶和華向眾民施行審判；耶和華啊，求你按我的公義和我心中的純正判斷我。
english: The Lord will be judge of the peoples; give a decision for me, O Lord, because of my righteousness, and let my virtue have its reward.

chinese: 願惡人的惡斷絕！願你堅立義人！因為公義的神察驗人的心腸肺腑。
english: O let the evil of the evil-doer come to an end, but give strength to the upright: for men's minds and hearts are tested by the God of righteousness.

chinese: 神是我的盾牌；他拯救心裡正直的人。
english: God, who is the saviour of the upright in heart, is my breastplate.

chinese: 神是公義的審判者，又是天天向惡人發怒的神。
english: God is the judge of the upright, and is angry with the evil-doers every day.

chinese: 若有人不回頭，他的刀必磨快，弓必上弦，預備妥當了。
english: If a man is not turned from his evil, he will make his sword sharp; his bow is bent and ready.

chinese: 他也預備了殺人的器械；他所射的是火箭。
english: He has made ready for him the instruments of death; he makes his arrows flames of fire.

chinese: 試看惡人因奸惡而劬勞，所懷的是毒害，所生的是虛假。
english: That man is a worker of evil; the seed of wrongdoing has given birth to deceit.

chinese: 他掘了坑，又挖深了，竟掉在自己所挖的阱裡。
english: He has made a hole deep in the earth, and is falling into the hole which he has made

chinese: 他的毒害必臨到他自己的頭上；他的強暴必落到他自己的腦袋上。
english: His wrongdoing will come back to him, and his violent behaviour will come down on his head.

chinese: 我要照著耶和華的公義稱謝他，歌頌耶和華至高者的名。
english: I will give praise to the Lord for his righteousness; I will make a song to the name of the Lord Most High.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。）耶和華─我們的主啊，你的名在全地何其美！你將你的榮耀彰顯於天。
english: - To the chief music-maker on the Gittith. A Psalm. Of David. - O Lord, our Lord, whose glory is higher than the heavens, how noble is your name in all the earth!

chinese: 你因敵人的緣故，從嬰孩和吃奶的口中，建立了能力，使仇敵和報仇的閉口無言。
english: You have made clear your strength even out of the mouths of babies at the breast, because of those who are against you; so that you may put to shame the cruel and violent man.

chinese: 我觀看你指頭所造的天，並你所陳設的月亮星宿，
english: When I see your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have put in their places;

chinese: 便說：人算甚麼，你竟顧念他？世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他？
english: What is man, that you keep him in mind? the son of man, that you take him into account?

chinese: 你叫他比天使（或譯：神）微小一點，並賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕。
english: For you have made him only a little lower than the gods, crowning him with glory and honour.

chinese: 你派他管理你手所造的，使萬物，就是一切的牛羊、田野的獸、空中的鳥、海裡的魚，凡經行海道的，都服在他的腳下。
english: You have made him ruler over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet;
All sheep and oxen, and all the beasts of the field;
The birds of the air and the fish of the sea, and whatever goes through the deep waters of the seas.

chinese: 耶和華─我們的主啊，你的名在全地何其美！
english: O Lord, our Lord, how noble is your name in all the earth!

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用慕拉便。）我要一心稱謝耶和華；我要傳揚你一切奇妙的作為。
english: - To the chief music-maker on Muthlabben. A Psalm. Of David. - I will give you praise, O Lord, with all my heart; I will make clear all the wonder of your works.

chinese: 我要因你歡喜快樂；至高者啊，我要歌頌你的名！
english: I will be glad and have delight in you: I will make a song of praise to your name, O Most High.

chinese: 我的仇敵轉身退去的時候，他們一見你的面就跌倒滅亡。
english: When my haters are turned back, they will be broken and overcome before you.

chinese: 因你已經為我伸冤，為我辨屈；你坐在寶座上，按公義審判。
english: For you gave approval to my right and my cause; you were seated in your high place judging in righteousness.

chinese: 你曾斥責外邦，你曾滅絕惡人；你曾塗抹他們的名，直到永永遠遠。
english: You have said sharp words to the nations, you have sent destruction on the sinners, you have put an end to their name for ever and ever.

chinese: 仇敵到了盡頭；他們被毀壞，直到永遠。你拆毀他們的城邑，連他們的名號都歸於無有。
english: You have given their towns to destruction; the memory of them has gone; they have become waste for ever.

chinese: 惟耶和華坐著為王，直到永遠；他已經為審判設擺他的寶座。
english: But the Lord is King for ever: he has made ready his high seat for judging.

chinese: 他要按公義審判世界，按正直判斷萬民。
english: And he will be the judge of the world in righteousness, giving true decisions for the peoples.

chinese: 耶和華又要給受欺壓的人作高臺，在患難的時候作高臺。
english: The Lord will be a high tower for those who are crushed down, a high tower in times of trouble;

chinese: 耶和華啊，認識你名的人要倚靠你，因你沒有離棄尋求你的人。
english: And those who have knowledge of your name will put their faith in you; because you, Lord, have ever given your help to those who were waiting for you.

chinese: 應當歌頌居錫安的耶和華，將他所行的傳揚在眾民中。
english: Make songs of praise to the Lord, whose house is in Zion: make his doings clear to the people.

chinese: 因為那追討流人血之罪的─他記念受屈的人，不忘記困苦人的哀求。
english: When he makes search for blood, he has them in his memory: he is not without thought for the cry of the poor.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你是從死門把我提拔起來的；求你憐恤我，看那恨我的人所加給我的苦難，
english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, and see how I am troubled by my haters; let me be lifted up from the doors of death;

chinese: 好叫我述說你一切的美德；我必在錫安城（原文是女子）的門因你的救恩歡樂。
english: So that I may make clear all your praise in the house of the daughter of Zion: I will be glad because of your salvation.

chinese: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中；他們的腳在自己暗設的網羅裡纏住了。
english: The nations have gone down into the hole which they made: in their secret net is their foot taken.

chinese: 耶和華已將自己顯明了，他已施行審判；惡人被自己手所做的纏住了（或譯：他叫惡人被自己手所做的累住了）。（細拉）
english: The Lord has given knowledge of himself through his judging: the evil-doer is taken in the net which his hands had made. (Higgaion. Selah.)

chinese: 惡人，就是忘記神的外邦人，都必歸到陰間。
english: The sinners and all the nations who have no memory of God will be turned into the underworld.

chinese: 窮乏人必不永久被忘；困苦人的指望必不永遠落空。
english: For the poor will not be without help; the hopes of those in need will not be crushed for ever.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你起來，不容人得勝！願外邦人在你面前受審判！
english: Up! O Lord; let not man overcome you: let the nations be judged before you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你使外邦人恐懼；願他們知道自己不過是人。（細拉）
english: Put them in fear, O Lord, so that the nations may see that they are only men. (Selah.)

chinese: 耶和華啊，你為甚麼站在遠處？在患難的時候為甚麼隱藏？
english: Why do you keep far away, O Lord? why are you not to be seen in times of trouble?

chinese: 惡人在驕橫中把困苦人追得火急；願他們陷在自己所設的計謀裡。
english: The evil-doer in his pride is cruel to the poor; let him be taken by the tricks of his invention.

chinese: 因為惡人以心願自誇；貪財的背棄耶和華，並且輕慢他（或譯：他祝福貪財的，卻輕慢耶和華）。
english: For the evil-doer is lifted up because of the purpose of his heart, and he whose mind is fixed on wealth is turned away from the Lord, saying evil against him.

chinese: 惡人面帶驕傲，說：耶和華必不追究；他一切所想的都以為沒有神。
english: The evil-doer in his pride says, God will not make a search. All his thoughts are, There is no God.

chinese: 凡他所做的，時常穩固；你的審判超過他的眼界。至於他一切的敵人，他都向他們噴氣。
english: His ways are ever fixed; your decisions are higher than he may see: as for his haters, they are as nothing to him.

chinese: 他心裡說：我必不動搖，世世代代不遭災難。
english: He has said in his heart, I will not be moved: through all generations I will never be in trouble.

chinese: 他滿口是咒罵、詭詐、欺壓，舌底是毒害、奸惡。
english: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and false words: under his tongue are evil purposes and dark thoughts.

chinese: 他在村莊埋伏等候；他在隱密處殺害無辜的人。他的眼睛窺探無倚無靠的人；
english: He is waiting in the dark places of the towns: in the secret places he puts to death those who have done no wrong: his eyes are secretly turned against the poor.

chinese: 他埋伏在暗地，如獅子蹲在洞中。他埋伏，要擄去困苦人；他拉網，就把困苦人擄去。
english: He keeps himself in a secret place like a lion in his hole, waiting to put his hands on the poor man, and pulling him into his net.

chinese: 他屈身蹲伏，無倚無靠的人就倒在他爪牙（爪牙：或譯強暴人）之下。
english: The upright are crushed and made low, and the feeble are overcome by his strong ones.

chinese: 他心裡說：神竟忘記了；他掩面永不觀看。
english: He says in his heart, God has no memory of me: his face is turned away; he will never see it.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你起來！神啊，求你舉手，不要忘記困苦人！
english: Up! O Lord; let your hand be lifted: give thought to the poor.

chinese: 惡人為何輕慢神，心裡說：你必不追究？
english: Why has the evil-doer a low opinion of God, saying in his heart, You will not make search for it?

chinese: 其實你已經觀看；因為奸惡毒害，你都看見了，為要以手施行報應。無倚無靠的人把自己交託你；你向來是幫助孤兒的。
english: You have seen it; for your eyes are on sorrow and grief, to take it into your hand: the poor man puts his faith in you; you have been the helper of the child who has no father.

chinese: 願你打斷惡人的膀臂；至於壞人，願你追究他的惡，直到淨盡。
english: Let the arm of the sinner and the evil-doer be broken; go on searching for his sin till there is no more.

chinese: 耶和華永永遠遠為王；外邦人從他的地已經滅絕了。
english: The Lord is King for ever and ever; the nations are gone from his land.

chinese: 耶和華啊，謙卑人的心願，你早已知道（原文是聽見）。你必預備他們的心，也必側耳聽他們的祈求，
english: Lord, you have given ear to the prayer of the poor: you will make strong their hearts, you will give them a hearing:

chinese: 為要給孤兒和受欺壓的人伸冤，使強橫的人不再威嚇他們。
english: To give decision for the child without a father and for the broken-hearted, so that the man of the earth may no longer be feared.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）我是投靠耶和華；你們怎麼對我說：你當像鳥飛往你的山去。
english: - For the chief music-maker. Of David. - In the Lord put I my faith; how will you say to my soul, Go in flight like a bird to the mountain?

chinese: 看哪，惡人彎弓，把箭搭在弦上，要在暗中射那心裡正直的人。
english: See, the bows of the evil-doers are bent, they make ready their arrows on the cord, so that they may send them secretly against the upright in heart.

chinese: 根基若毀壞，義人還能做甚麼呢？
english: If the bases are broken down, what is the upright man to do?

chinese: 耶和華在他的聖殿裡；耶和華的寶座在天上；他的慧眼察看世人。
english: The Lord is in his holy Temple, the Lord's seat is in heaven; his eyes are watching and testing the children of men.

chinese: 耶和華試驗義人；惟有惡人和喜愛強暴的人，他心裡恨惡。
english: The Lord puts the upright and the sinner to the test, but he has hate in his soul for the lover of violent acts.

chinese: 他要向惡人密布網羅；有烈火、硫磺、熱風，作他們杯中的分。
english: On the evil-doer he will send down fire and flames, and a burning wind; with these will their cup be full.

chinese: 因為耶和華是公義的，他喜愛公義；正直人必得見他的面。
english: For the Lord is upright; he is a lover of righteousness: the upright will see his face.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用第八。）耶和華啊，求你幫助，因虔誠人斷絕了；世人中間的忠信人沒有了。
english: - For the chief music-maker on the Sheminith. A Psalm. Of David. - Send help, Lord, for mercy has come to an end; there is no more faith among the children of men.

chinese: 人人向鄰舍說謊；他們說話，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。
english: Everyone says false words to his neighbour: their tongues are smooth in their talk, and their hearts are full of deceit.

chinese: 凡油滑的嘴唇和誇大的舌頭，耶和華必要剪除。
english: The smooth lips and the tongue of pride will be cut off by the Lord.

chinese: 他們曾說：我們必能以舌頭得勝；我們的嘴唇是我們自己的，誰能作我們的主呢？
english: They have said, With our tongues will we overcome; our lips are ours: who is lord over us?

chinese: 耶和華說：因為困苦人的冤屈和貧窮人的歎息，我現在要起來，把他安置在他所切慕的穩妥之地。
english: Because of the crushing of the poor and the weeping of those in need, now will I come to his help, says the Lord; I will give him the salvation which he is desiring.

chinese: 耶和華的言語是純淨的言語，如同銀子在泥爐中煉過七次。
english: The words of the Lord are true words: like silver tested by fire and burned clean seven times.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你必保護他們；你必保佑他們永遠脫離這世代的人。
english: You will keep them, O Lord, you will keep them safe from this generation for ever.

chinese: 下流人在世人中升高，就有惡人到處遊行。
english: The sinners are walking on every side, and evil is honoured among the children of men.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，你忘記我要到幾時呢？要到永遠麼？你掩面不顧我要到幾時呢？
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - Will you for ever put me out of your memory, O Lord? will your face for ever be turned away from me?

chinese: 我心裡籌算，終日愁苦，要到幾時呢？我的仇敵升高壓制我，要到幾時呢？
english: How long is my soul to be in doubt, with sorrow in my heart all the day? how long will he who is against me be given power over me?

chinese: 耶和華─我的神啊，求你看顧我，應允我！使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；
english: Let my voice come before you, and give me an answer, O Lord my God; let your light be shining on me, so that the sleep of death may not overtake me;

chinese: 免得我的仇敵說：我勝了他；免得我的敵人在我搖動的時候喜樂。
english: And he who is against me may not say, I have overcome him; and those who are troubling me may not be glad when I am moved.

chinese: 但我倚靠你的慈愛；我的心因你的救恩快樂。
english: But I have had faith in your mercy; my heart will be glad in your salvation.

chinese: 我要向耶和華歌唱，因他用厚恩待我。
english: I will make a song to the Lord, because he has given me my reward.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）愚頑人心裡說：沒有神。他們都是邪惡，行了可憎惡的事；沒有一個人行善。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of David. - The foolish man has said in his heart, God will not do anything. They are unclean, they have done evil works; there is not one who does good.

chinese: 耶和華從天上垂看世人，要看有明白的沒有，有尋求神的沒有。
english: The Lord was looking down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who had wisdom, searching after God.

chinese: 他們都偏離正路，一同變為污穢；並沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
