english: They have all gone out of the way together; they are unclean, there is not one who does good, no, not one.

chinese: 作孽的都沒有知識麼？他們吞吃我的百姓，如同吃飯一樣，並不求告耶和華。
english: Have all the workers of evil no knowledge? they take my people for food as they would take bread; they make no prayer to the Lord.

chinese: 他們在那裡大大地害怕，因為神在義人的族類中。
english: Then were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the upright.

chinese: 你們叫困苦人的謀算變為羞辱；然而耶和華是他的避難所。
english: You have put to shame the thoughts of the poor, but the Lord is his support.

chinese: 但願以色列的救恩從錫安而出。耶和華救回他被擄的子民那時，雅各要快樂，以色列要歡喜。
english: May the salvation of Israel come out of Zion! when the fate of his people is changed by the Lord, Jacob will have joy and Israel will be glad.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華啊，誰能寄居你的帳幕？誰能住在你的聖山？
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - Lord, who may have a resting-place in your tent, a living-place on your holy hill?

chinese: 就是行為正直、做事公義、心裡說實話的人。
english: He who goes on his way uprightly, doing righteousness, and saying what is true in his heart;

chinese: 他不以舌頭讒謗人，不惡待朋友，也不隨夥毀謗鄰里。
english: Whose tongue is not false, who does no evil to his friend, and does not take away the good name of his neighbour;

chinese: 他眼中藐視匪類，卻尊重那敬畏耶和華的人。他發了誓，雖然自己吃虧也不更改。
english: Who gives honour to those who have the fear of the Lord, turning away from him who has not the Lord's approval. He who takes an oath against himself, and makes no change.

chinese: 他不放債取利，不受賄賂以害無辜。行這些事的人必永不動搖。
english: He who does not put out his money at interest, or for payment give false decisions against men who have done no wrong. He who does these things will never be moved.

chinese: （大衛的金詩。）神啊，求你保佑我，因為我投靠你。
english: - Michtam. Of David. - Keep me safe, O God: for in you I have put my faith.

chinese: 我的心哪，你曾對耶和華說：你是我的主；我的好處不在你以外。
english: O my soul, you have said to the Lord, You are my Lord: I have no good but you.

chinese: 論到世上的聖民，他們又美又善，是我最喜悅的。
english: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the noble in whom is all my delight.

chinese: 以別神代替耶和華的（或譯：送禮物給別　神的），他們的愁苦必加增；他們所澆奠的血我不獻上；我嘴唇也不提別　神的名號。
english: Their sorrows will be increased who go after another god: I will not take drink offerings from their hands, or take their names on my lips.

chinese: 耶和華是我的產業，是我杯中的分；我所得的，你為我持守。
english: The Lord is my heritage and the wine of my cup; you are the supporter of my right.

chinese: 用繩量給我的地界，坐落在佳美之處；我的產業實在美好。
english: Fair are the places marked out for me; I have a noble heritage.

chinese: 我必稱頌那指教我的耶和華；我的心腸在夜間也警戒我。
english: I will give praise to the Lord who has been my guide; knowledge comes to me from my thoughts in the night.

chinese: 我將耶和華常擺在我面前，因他在我右邊，我便不致搖動。
english: I have put the Lord before me at all times; because he is at my right hand, I will not be moved.

chinese: 因此，我的心歡喜，我的靈（原文是榮耀）快樂；我的肉身也要安然居住。
english: Because of this my heart is glad, and my glory is full of joy: while my flesh takes its rest in hope.

chinese: 因為你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間，也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
english: For you will not let my soul be prisoned in the underworld; you will not let your loved one see the place of death.

chinese: 你必將生命的道路指示我。在你面前有滿足的喜樂；在你右手中有永遠的福樂。
english: You will make clear to me the way of life; where you are joy is complete; in your right hand there are pleasures for ever and ever.

chinese: （大衛的祈禱。）耶和華啊，求你聽聞公義，側耳聽我的呼籲！求你留心聽我這不出於詭詐嘴唇的祈禱！
english: - A Prayer. Of David. - Let my cause come to your ears, O Lord, give attention to my cry; give ear to my prayer which goes not out from false lips.

chinese: 願我的判語從你面前發出；願你的眼睛觀看公正。
english: Be my judge; for your eyes see what is right.

chinese: 你已經試驗我的心；你在夜間鑒察我；你熬煉我，卻找不著甚麼；我立志叫我口中沒有過失。
english: You have put my heart to the test, searching me in the night; you have put me to the test and seen no evil purpose in me; I will keep my mouth from sin.

chinese: 論到人的行為，我藉著你嘴唇的言語自己謹守，不行強暴人的道路。
english: As for the works of men, by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

chinese: 我的腳踏定了你的路徑；我的兩腳未曾滑跌。
english: I have kept my feet in your ways, my steps have not been turned away.

chinese: 神啊，我曾求告你，因為你必應允我；求你向我側耳，聽我的言語。
english: My cry has gone up to you, for you will give me an answer, O God: let your ear be turned to me, and give attention to my words.

chinese: 求你顯出你奇妙的慈愛來；你是那用右手拯救投靠你的脫離起來攻擊他們的人。
english: Make clear the wonder of your mercy, O saviour of those who put their faith in your right hand, from those who come out against them.

chinese: 求你保護我，如同保護眼中的瞳人；將我隱藏在你翅膀的蔭下，
english: Keep me as the light of your eyes, covering me with the shade of your wings,

chinese: 使我脫離那欺壓我的惡人，就是圍困我要害我命的仇敵。
english: From the evil-doers who are violent to me, and from those who are round me, desiring my death.

chinese: 他們的心被脂油包裹；他們用口說驕傲的話。
english: They are shut up in their fat: with their mouths they say words of pride.

chinese: 他們圍困了我們的腳步；他們瞪著眼，要把我們推倒在地。
english: They have made a circle round our steps: their eyes are fixed on us, forcing us down to the earth;

chinese: 他像獅子急要抓食，又像少壯獅子蹲伏在暗處。
english: Like a lion desiring its food, and like a young lion waiting in secret places.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你起來，前去迎敵，將他打倒！用你的刀救護我命脫離惡人。
english: Up! Lord, come out against him, make him low, with your sword be my saviour from the evil-doer.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你用手救我脫離世人，脫離那只在今生有福分的世人！你把你的財寶充滿他們的肚腹；他們因有兒女就心滿意足，將其餘的財物留給他們的嬰孩。
english: With your hand, O Lord, from men, even men of the world, whose heritage is in this life, and whom you make full with your secret wealth: they are full of children; after their death their offspring take the rest of their goods.

chinese: 至於我，我必在義中見你的面；我醒了的時候，得見（或譯：著）你的形像就心滿意足了。
english: As for me, I will see your face in righteousness: when I am awake it will be joy enough for me to see your form.

chinese: （耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。當耶和華救他脫離一切仇敵和掃羅之手的日子，他向耶和華念這詩的話。說：）耶和華，我的力量啊，我愛你！
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of the servant of the Lord, of David, who said the words of this song to the Lord on the day when the Lord made him free from the hand of all his haters, and from the hand of Saul; and he said, - I will give you my love, O Lord, my strength.

chinese: 耶和華是我的巖石，我的山寨，我的救主，我的神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角，是我的高臺。
english: The Lord is my Rock, my walled town, and my saviour; my God, my Rock, in him will I put my faith; my breastplate, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

chinese: 我要求告當讚美的耶和華；這樣我必從仇敵手中被救出來。
english: I will send up my cry to the Lord, who is to be praised; so will I be made safe from those who are against me.

chinese: 曾有死亡的繩索纏繞我，匪類的急流使我驚懼，
english: The cords of death were round me, and the seas of evil put me in fear.

chinese: 陰間的繩索纏繞我，死亡的網羅臨到我。
english: The cords of hell were round me: the nets of death came on me.

chinese: 我在急難中求告耶和華，向我的神呼求。他從殿中聽了我的聲音；我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。
english: In my trouble my voice went up to the Lord, and my cry to my God: my voice came to his hearing in his holy Temple, and my prayer came before him, even into his ears.

chinese: 那時，因他發怒，地就搖撼戰抖；山的根基也震動搖撼。
english: Then trouble and shock came on the earth; and the bases of the mountains were moved and shaking, because he was angry.

chinese: 從他鼻孔冒煙上騰；從他口中發火焚燒，連炭也著了。
english: There went up a smoke from his nose, and a fire of destruction from his mouth: flames were lighted by it.

chinese: 他又使天下垂，親自降臨，有黑雲在他腳下。
english: The heavens were bent, so that he might come down; and it was dark under his feet.

chinese: 他坐著基路伯飛行；他藉著風的翅膀快飛。
english: And he went in flight through the air, seated on a storm-cloud: going quickly on the wings of the wind.

chinese: 他以黑暗為藏身之處，以水的黑暗、天空的厚雲為他四圍的行宮。
english: He made the dark his secret place; his tent round him was the dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

chinese: 因他面前的光輝，他的厚雲行過便有冰雹火炭。
english: Before his shining light his dark clouds went past, raining ice and fire.

chinese: 耶和華也在天上打雷；至高者發出聲音便有冰雹火炭。
english: The Lord made thunder in the heavens, and the voice of the Highest was sounding out: a rain of ice and fire.

chinese: 他射出箭來，使仇敵四散；多多發出閃電，使他們擾亂。
english: He sent out his arrows, driving them in all directions; by his flames of fire they were troubled.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的斥責一發，你鼻孔的氣一出，海底就出現，大地的根基也顯露。
english: Then the deep beds of the waters were seen, and the bases of the world were uncovered, because of your words of wrath, O Lord, because of the breath from your mouth.

chinese: 他從高天伸手抓住我，把我從大水中拉上來。
english: He sent from on high, he took me, pulling me out of great waters.

chinese: 他救我脫離我的勁敵和那些恨我的人，因為他們比我強盛。
english: He made me free from my strong hater, and from those who were against me, because they were stronger than I.

chinese: 我遭遇災難的日子，他們來攻擊我；但耶和華是我的倚靠。
english: They came on me in the day of my trouble; but the Lord was my support.

chinese: 他又領我到寬闊之處；他救拔我，因他喜悅我。
english: He took me out into a wide place; he was my saviour because he had delight in me.

chinese: 耶和華按著我的公義報答我，按著我手中的清潔賞賜我。
english: The Lord gives me the reward of my righteousness, because my hands are clean before him.

chinese: 因為我遵守了耶和華的道，未曾作惡離開我的神。
english: For I have kept the ways of the Lord; I have not been turned away in sin from my God.

chinese: 他的一切典章常在我面前；他的律例我也未曾丟棄。
english: For all his decisions were before me, and I did not put away his laws from me.

chinese: 我在他面前作了完全人；我也保守自己遠離我的罪孽。
english: And I was upright before him, and I kept myself from sin.

chinese: 所以，耶和華按我的公義，按我在他眼前手中的清潔償還我。
english: Because of this the Lord has given me the reward of my righteousness, because my hands are clean in his eyes.

chinese: 慈愛的人，你以慈愛待他；完全的人，你以完全待他。
english: On him who has mercy you will have mercy; to the upright you will be upright;

chinese: 清潔的人，你以清潔待他；乖僻的人，你以彎曲待他。
english: He who is holy will see that you are holy; but to the man whose way is not straight you will be a hard judge.

chinese: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救；高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。
english: For you are the saviour of those who are in trouble; but eyes full of pride will be made low.

chinese: 你必點著我的燈；耶和華─我的神必照明我的黑暗。
english: You, O Lord, will be my light; by you, my God, the dark will be made bright for me.

chinese: 我藉著你衝入敵軍，藉著我的神跳過牆垣。
english: By your help I have made a way through the wall which was shutting me in; by the help of my God I have gone over a wall.

chinese: 至於神，他的道是完全的；耶和華的話是煉淨的。凡投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
english: As for God, his way is completely good; the word of the Lord is tested; he is a breastplate for all those who put their faith in him.

chinese: 除了耶和華，誰是神呢？除了我們的　神，誰是磐石呢？
english: For who is God but the Lord? or who is a Rock but our God?

chinese: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、使我行為完全的，他是神。
english: God puts a strong band about me, guiding me in a straight way.

chinese: 他使我的腳快如母鹿的蹄，又使我在高處安穩。
english: He makes my feet like roes' feet, and puts me on high places.

chinese: 他教導我的手能以爭戰，甚至我的膀臂能開銅弓。
english: He makes my hands expert in war, so that a bow of brass is bent by my arms.

chinese: 你把你的救恩給我作盾牌；你的右手扶持我；你的溫和使我為大。
english: You have given me the breastplate of your salvation: your right hand has been my support, and your mercy has made me great.

chinese: 你使我腳下的地步寬闊；我的腳未曾滑跌。
english: You have made my steps wide under me, so that my feet are kept from slipping.

chinese: 我要追趕我的仇敵，並要追上他們；不將他們滅絕，我總不歸回。
english: I go after my haters and overtake them; not turning back till they are all overcome.

chinese: 我要打傷他們，使他們不能起來；他們必倒在我的腳下。
english: I will give them wounds, so that they are not able to get up: they are stretched under my feet.

chinese: 因為你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能爭戰；你也使那起來攻擊我的都服在我以下。
english: For I have been armed by you with strength for the fight: you have made low under me those who come out against me.

chinese: 你又使我的仇敵在我面前轉背逃跑，叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
english: By you their backs are turned in flight, so that my haters are cut off.

chinese: 他們呼求，卻無人拯救；就是呼求耶和華，他也不應允。
english: They were crying out, but there was no one to come to their help: even to the Lord, but he gave them no answer.

chinese: 我搗碎他們，如同風前的灰塵，倒出他們，如同街上的泥土。
english: Then they were crushed as small as dust before the wind; they were drained out like the waste of the streets.

chinese: 你救我脫離百姓的爭競，立我作列國的元首；我素不認識的民必事奉我。
english: You have made me free from the fightings of the people; you have made me the head of the nations: a people of whom I had no knowledge will be my servants.

chinese: 他們一聽見我的名聲就必順從我；外邦人要投降我。
english: From the time when my name comes to their ears they will be ruled by me: men of other countries will, with false hearts, put themselves under my authority.

chinese: 外邦人要衰殘，戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。
english: They will be wasting away, they will come out of their secret places shaking with fear.

chinese: 耶和華是活神。願我的磐石被人稱頌；願救我的神被人尊崇。
english: The Lord is living; praise be to my Rock, and let the God of my salvation be honoured.

chinese: 這位神，就是那為我伸冤、使眾民服在我以下的。
english: It is God who sends punishment on my haters, and puts peoples under my rule.

chinese: 你救我脫離仇敵，又把我舉起，高過那些起來攻擊我的；你救我脫離強暴的人。
english: He makes me free from my haters; I am lifted up over those who come up against me: you have made me free from the violent man.

chinese: 耶和華啊，因此我要在外邦中稱謝你，歌頌你的名。
english: Because of this I will give you praise, O Lord, among the nations, and will make a song of praise to your name.

chinese: 耶和華賜極大的救恩給他所立的王，施慈愛給他的受膏者，就是給大衛和他的後裔，直到永遠。
english: Great salvation does he give to his king; he has mercy on the king of his selection, David, and on his seed for ever.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）諸天述說神的榮耀；穹蒼傳揚他的手段。
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - The heavens are sounding the glory of God; the arch of the sky makes clear the work of his hands.

chinese: 這日到那日發出言語；這夜到那夜傳出知識。
english: Day after day it sends out its word, and night after night it gives knowledge.

chinese: 無言無語，也無聲音可聽。
english: There are no words or language; their voice makes no sound.

chinese: 他的量帶通遍天下，他的言語傳到地極。神在其間為太陽安設帳幕；
english: Their line has gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them has he put a tent for the sun,

chinese: 太陽如同新郎出洞房，又如勇士歡然奔路。
english: Who is like a newly married man coming from his bride-tent, and is glad like a strong runner starting on his way.

chinese: 他從天這邊出來，繞到天那邊，沒有一物被隱藏不得他的熱氣。
english: His going out is from the end of the heaven, and his circle to the ends of it; there is nothing which is not open to his heat.

chinese: 耶和華的律法全備，能甦醒人心；耶和華的法度確定，能使愚人有智慧。
english: The law of the Lord is good, giving new life to the soul: the witness of the Lord is certain, giving wisdom to the foolish.

chinese: 耶和華的訓詞正直，能快活人的心；耶和華的命令清潔，能明亮人的眼目。
english: The orders of the Lord are right, making glad the heart: the rule of the Lord is holy, giving light to the eyes.

chinese: 耶和華的道理潔淨，存到永遠；耶和華的典章真實，全然公義─
english: The fear of the Lord is clean, and has no end; the decisions of the Lord are true and full of righteousness.

chinese: 都比金子可羨慕，且比極多的精金可羨慕；比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。
english: More to be desired are they than gold, even than much shining gold; sweeter than the dropping honey.

chinese: 況且你的僕人因此受警戒，守著這些便有大賞。
english: By them is your servant made conscious of danger, and in keeping them there is great reward.

chinese: 誰能知道自己的錯失呢？願你赦免我隱而未現的過錯。
english: Who has full knowledge of his errors? make me clean from secret evil.

chinese: 求你攔阻僕人不犯任意妄為的罪，不容這罪轄制我，我便完全，免犯大罪。
english: Keep your servant back from sins of pride; let them not have rule over me: then will I be upright and free from great sin.

chinese: 耶和華─我的磐石，我的救贖主啊，願我口中的言語、心裡的意念在你面前蒙悅納。
english: Let the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart be pleasing in your eyes, O Lord, my strength and my salvation.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）願耶和華在你遭難的日子應允你；願名為雅各神的高舉你。
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - May the Lord give ear to you in the day of trouble; may you be placed on high by the name of the God of Jacob;

chinese: 願他從聖所救助你，從錫安堅固你，
english: May he send you help from the holy place, and give you strength from Zion;

chinese: 記念你的一切供獻，悅納你的燔祭，（細拉）
english: May he keep all your offerings in mind, and be pleased with the fat of your burned offerings; (Selah.)

chinese: 將你心所願的賜給你，成就你的一切籌算。
english: May he give you your heart's desire, and put all your purposes into effect.

chinese: 我們要因你的救恩誇勝，要奉我們神的名豎立旌旗。願耶和華成就你一切所求的！
english: We will be glad in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will put up our flags: may the Lord give you all your requests.

chinese: 現在我知道耶和華救護他的受膏者，必從他的聖天上應允他，用右手的能力救護他。
english: Now am I certain that the Lord gives salvation to his king; he will give him an answer from his holy heaven with the strength of salvation in his right hand.

chinese: 有人靠車，有人靠馬，但我們要提到耶和華─我們神的名。
english: Some put their faith in carriages and some in horses; but we will be strong in the name of the Lord our God.

chinese: 他們都屈身仆倒，我們卻起來，立得正直。
english: They are bent down and made low; but we have been lifted up.

chinese: 求耶和華施行拯救；我們呼求的時候，願王應允我們！
english: Come to our help, Lord: let the king give ear to our cry.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，王必因你的能力歡喜；因你的救恩，他的快樂何其大！
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - The king will be glad in your strength, O Lord; how great will be his delight in your salvation!

chinese: 他心裡所願的，你已經賜給他；他嘴唇所求的，你未嘗不應允。（細拉）
english: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not kept back the request of his lips. (Selah.)

chinese: 你以美福迎接他，把精金的冠冕戴在他頭上。
english: For you go before him with the blessings of good things: you put a crown of fair gold on his head.

chinese: 他向你求壽，你便賜給他，就是日子長久，直到永遠。
english: He made request to you for life, and you gave it to him, long life for ever and ever.

chinese: 他因你的救恩大有榮耀；你又將尊榮威嚴加在他身上。
english: His glory is great in your salvation: honour and authority have you put on him.

chinese: 你使他有洪福，直到永遠，又使他在你面前歡喜快樂。
english: For you have made him a blessing for ever: you have given him joy in the light of your face.

chinese: 王倚靠耶和華，因至高者的慈愛必不搖動。
english: For the king has faith in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Most High he will not be moved.

chinese: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敵；你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。
english: Your hand will make a search for all your haters; your right hand will be hard on all those who are against you.

chinese: 你發怒的時候，要使他們如在炎熱的火爐中。耶和華要在他的震怒中吞滅他們；那火要把他們燒盡了。
english: You will make them like a flaming oven before you; the Lord in his wrath will put an end to them, and they will be burned up in the fire.

chinese: 你必從世上滅絕他們的子孫（原文是果子），從人間滅絕他們的後裔。
english: Their fruit will be cut off from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

chinese: 因為他們有意加害於你；他們想出計謀，卻不能做成。
english: For their thoughts were bitter against you: they had an evil design in their minds, which they were not able to put into effect.

chinese: 你必使他們轉背逃跑，向他們的臉搭箭在弦。
english: Their backs will be turned when you make ready the cords of your bow against their faces.

chinese: 耶和華啊，願你因自己的能力顯為至高！這樣，我們就唱詩，歌頌你的大能。
english: Be lifted up, O Lord, in your strength; so will we make songs in praise of your power.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用朝鹿。）我的神，我的神！為甚麼離棄我？為甚麼遠離不救我？不聽我唉哼的言語？
english: - To the chief music-maker on Aijeleth-hash-shahar. A Psalm. Of David. - My God, my God, why are you turned away from me? why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my crying?

chinese: 我的神啊，我白日呼求，你不應允，夜間呼求，並不住聲。
english: O my God, I make my cry in the day, and you give no answer; and in the night, and have no rest.

chinese: 但你是聖潔的，是用以色列的讚美為寶座（或譯：居所）的。
english: But you are holy, O you who are seated among the praises of Israel.

chinese: 我們的祖宗倚靠你；他們倚靠你，你便解救他們。
english: Our fathers had faith in you: they had faith and you were their saviour.

chinese: 他們哀求你，便蒙解救；他們倚靠你，就不羞愧。
english: They sent up their cry to you and were made free: they put their faith in you and were not put to shame.

chinese: 但我是蟲，不是人，被眾人羞辱，被百姓藐視。
english: But I am a worm and not a man; cursed by men, and looked down on by the people.

chinese: 凡看見我的都嗤笑我；他們撇嘴搖頭，說：
english: I am laughed at by all those who see me: pushing out their lips and shaking their heads they say,

chinese: 他把自己交託耶和華，耶和華可以救他罷！耶和華既喜悅他，可以搭救他罷！
english: He put his faith in the Lord; let the Lord be his saviour now: let the Lord be his saviour, because he had delight in him.

chinese: 但你是叫我出母腹的；我在母懷裡，你就使我有倚靠的心。
english: But it was you who took care of me from the day of my birth: you gave me faith even from my mother's breasts.

chinese: 我自出母胎就被交在你手裡；從我母親生我，你就是我的神。
english: I was in your hands even before my birth; you are my God from the time when I was in my mother's body.

chinese: 求你不要遠離我！因為急難臨近了，沒有人幫助我。
english: Be not far from me, for trouble is near; there is no one to give help.

chinese: 有許多公牛圍繞我，巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。
english: A great herd of oxen is round me: I am shut in by the strong oxen of Bashan.

chinese: 他們向我張口，好像抓撕吼叫的獅子。
english: I saw their mouths wide open, like lions crying after food.

chinese: 我如水被倒出來；我的骨頭都脫了節；我心在我裡面如蠟鎔化。
english: I am flowing away like water, and all my bones are out of place: my heart is like wax, it has become soft in my body.

chinese: 我的精力枯乾，如同瓦片；我的舌頭貼在我牙床上。你將我安置在死地的塵土中。
english: My throat is dry like a broken vessel; my tongue is fixed to the roof of my mouth, and the dust of death is on my lips.

chinese: 犬類圍著我，惡黨環繞我；他們扎了我的手，我的腳。
english: Dogs have come round me: I am shut in by the band of evil-doers; they made wounds in my hands and feet.

chinese: 我的骨頭，我都能數過；他們瞪著眼看我。
english: I am able to see all my bones; their looks are fixed on me:

chinese: 他們分我的外衣，為我的裡衣拈鬮。
english: They make a division of my robes among them, by the decision of chance they take my clothing.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你不要遠離我！我的救主啊，求你快來幫助我！
english: Do not be far from me, O Lord: O my strength, come quickly to my help.

chinese: 求你救我的靈魂脫離刀劍，救我的生命（生命：原文是獨一者）脫離犬類，
english: Make my soul safe from the sword, my life from the power of the dog.

chinese: 救我脫離獅子的口；你已經應允我，使我脫離野牛的角。
english: Be my saviour from the lion's mouth; let me go free from the horns of the cruel oxen.

chinese: 我要將你的名傳與我的弟兄，在會中我要讚美你。
english: I will give the knowledge of your name to my brothers: I will give you praise among the people.

chinese: 你們敬畏耶和華的人要讚美他！雅各的後裔都要榮耀他！以色列的後裔都要懼怕他！
english: You who have fear of the Lord, give him praise; all you seed of Jacob, give him glory; go in fear of him, all you seed of Israel.

chinese: 因為他沒有藐視憎惡受苦的人，也沒有向他掩面；那受苦之人呼籲的時候，他就垂聽。
english: For he has not been unmoved by the pain of him who is troubled; or kept his face covered from him; but he has given an answer to his cry.

chinese: 我在大會中讚美你的話是從你而來的；我要在敬畏耶和華的人面前還我的願。
english: My praise will be of you in the great meeting: I will make my offerings before his worshippers.

chinese: 謙卑的人必吃得飽足；尋求耶和華的人必讚美他。願你們的心永遠活著！
english: The poor will have a feast of good things: those who make search for the Lord will give him praise: your heart will have life for ever.

chinese: 地的四極都要想念耶和華，並且歸順他；列國的萬族都要在你面前敬拜。
english: All the ends of the earth will keep it in mind and be turned to the Lord: all the families of the nations will give him worship.

chinese: 因為國權是耶和華的；他是管理萬國的。
english: For the kingdom is the Lord's; he is the ruler among the nations.

chinese: 地上一切豐肥的人必吃喝而敬拜；凡下到塵土中─不能存活自己性命的人─都要在他面前下拜。
english: All the fat ones of the earth will give him worship; all those who go down to the dust will make themselves low before him, even he who has not enough for the life of his soul.

chinese: 他必有後裔事奉他；主所行的事必傳與後代。
english: A seed will be his servant; the doings of the Lord will be made clear to the generation which comes after.

chinese: 他們必來把他的公義傳給將要生的民，言明這事是他所行的。
english: They will come and make his righteousness clear to a people of the future because he has done this.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華是我的牧者，我必不致缺乏。
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - The Lord takes care of me as his sheep; I will not be without any good thing.

chinese: 他使我躺臥在青草地上，領我在可安歇的水邊。
english: He makes a resting-place for me in the green fields: he is my guide by the quiet waters.

chinese: 他使我的靈魂甦醒，為自己的名引導我走義路。
english: He gives new life to my soul: he is my guide in the ways of righteousness because of his name.

chinese: 我雖然行過死蔭的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因為你與我同在；你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
english: Yes, though I go through the valley of deep shade, I will have no fear of evil; for you are with me, your rod and your support are my comfort.

chinese: 在我敵人面前，你為我擺設筵席；你用油膏了我的頭，使我的福杯滿溢。
english: You make ready a table for me in front of my haters: you put oil on my head; my cup is overflowing.

chinese: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈愛隨著我；我且要住在耶和華的殿中，直到永遠。
english: Truly, blessing and mercy will be with me all the days of my life; and I will have a place in the house of the Lord all my days.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）地和其中所充滿的，世界和住在其間的，都屬耶和華。
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - The earth is the Lord's, with all its wealth; the world and all the people living in it.

chinese: 他把地建立在海上，安定在大水之上。
english: For by him it was based on the seas, and made strong on the deep rivers.

chinese: 誰能登耶和華的山？誰能站在他的聖所？
english: Who may go up into the hill of the Lord? and who may come into his holy place?

chinese: 就是手潔心清、不向虛妄、起誓不懷詭詐的人。
english: He who has clean hands and a true heart; whose desire has not gone out to foolish things, who has not taken a false oath.

chinese: 他必蒙耶和華賜福，又蒙救他的神使他成義。
english: He will have blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

chinese: 這是尋求耶和華的族類，是尋求你面的雅各。（細拉）
english: This is the generation of those whose hearts are turned to you, even to your face, O God of Jacob. (Selah.)

chinese: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！永久的門戶，你們要被舉起！那榮耀的王將要進來！
english: Let your heads be lifted up, O doors; be lifted up, O you eternal doors: that the King of glory may come in.

chinese: 榮耀的王是誰呢？就是有力有能的耶和華，在戰場上有能的耶和華！
english: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of strength and power, the Lord strong in war.

chinese: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！永久的門戶，你們要把頭抬起！那榮耀的王將要進來！
english: Let your heads be lifted up, O doors; let them be lifted up, O you eternal doors: that the King of glory may come in.

chinese: 榮耀的王是誰呢？萬軍之耶和華，他是榮耀的王！（細拉）
english: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of armies, he is the King of glory. (Selah.)

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華啊，我的心仰望你。
english: - Of David. - To you, O Lord, my soul is lifted up.

chinese: 我的神啊，我素來倚靠你；求你不要叫我羞愧，不要叫我的仇敵向我誇勝。
english: O my God, I have put my faith in you, let me not be shamed; let not my haters be glorying over me.

chinese: 凡等候你的必不羞愧；惟有那無故行奸詐的必要羞愧。
english: Let no servant of yours be put to shame; may those be shamed who are false without cause.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指示我，將你的路教訓我！
english: Make your steps clear to me, O Lord; give me knowledge of your ways.

chinese: 求你以你的真理引導我，教訓我，因為你是救我的神。我終日等候你。
english: Be my guide and teacher in the true way; for you are the God of my salvation; I am waiting for your word all the day.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你記念你的憐憫和慈愛，因為這是亙古以來所常有的。
english: O Lord, keep in mind your pity and your mercies; for they have been from the earliest times.

chinese: 求你不要記念我幼年的罪愆和我的過犯；耶和華啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈愛記念我。
english: Do not keep in mind my sins when I was young, or my wrongdoing: let your memory of me be full of mercy, O Lord, because of your righteousness.

chinese: 耶和華是良善正直的，所以他必指示罪人走正路。
english: Good and upright is the Lord: so he will be the teacher of sinners in the way.

chinese: 他必按公平引領謙卑人，將他的道教訓他們。
english: He will be an upright guide to the poor in spirit: he will make his way clear to them.

chinese: 凡遵守他的約和他法度的人，耶和華都以慈愛誠實待他。
english: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and good faith for those who keep his agreement and his witness.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪，因為我的罪重大。
english: Because of your name, O Lord, let me have forgiveness for my sin, which is very great.

chinese: 誰敬畏耶和華，耶和華必指示他當選擇的道路。
english: If a man has the fear of the Lord, the Lord will be his teacher in the way of his pleasure.

chinese: 他必安然居住；他的後裔必承受地土。
english: His soul will be full of good things, and his seed will have the earth for its heritage.

chinese: 耶和華與敬畏他的人親密；他必將自己的約指示他們。
english: The secret of the Lord is with those in whose hearts is the fear of him; he will make his agreement clear to them.

chinese: 我的眼目時常仰望耶和華，因為他必將我的腳從網裡拉出來。
english: My eyes are turned to the Lord at all times; for he will take my feet out of the net.

chinese: 求你轉向我，憐恤我，因為我是孤獨困苦。
english: Be turned to me, and have mercy on me; for I am troubled and have no helper.

chinese: 我心裡的愁苦甚多，求你救我脫離我的禍患。
english: The troubles of my heart are increased: O take me out of my sorrows.

chinese: 求你看顧我的困苦，我的艱難，赦免我一切的罪。
english: Give thought to my grief and my pain; and take away all my sins.

chinese: 求你察看我的仇敵，因為他們人多，並且痛痛地恨我。
english: See how those who are against me are increased, for bitter is their hate of me.

chinese: 求你保護我的性命，搭救我，使我不致羞愧，因為我投靠你。
english: O keep my soul, and take me out of danger: let me not be shamed, for I have put my faith in you.

chinese: 願純全、正直保守我，因為我等候你。
english: For my clean and upright ways keep me safe, because my hope is in you.

chinese: 神啊，求你救贖以色列脫離他一切的愁苦。
english: Give Israel salvation, O God, out of all his troubles.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華啊，求你為我伸冤，因我向來行事純全；我又倚靠耶和華，並不搖動。
english: - Of David. - O Lord, be my judge, for my behaviour has been upright: I have put my faith in the Lord, I am not in danger of slipping.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你察看我，試驗我，熬煉我的肺腑心腸。
english: Put me in the scales, O Lord, so that I may be tested; let the fire make clean my thoughts and my heart.

chinese: 因為你的慈愛常在我眼前，我也按你的真理而行。
english: For your mercy is before my eyes; and I have gone in the way of your good faith.

chinese: 我沒有和虛謊人同坐，也不與瞞哄人的同群。
english: I have not taken my seat with foolish persons, and I do not go with false men.

chinese: 我恨惡惡人的會，必不與惡人同坐。
english: I have been a hater of the band of wrongdoers, and I will not be seated among sinners.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我要洗手表明無辜，才環繞你的祭壇；
english: I will make my hands clean from sin; so will I go round your altar, O Lord;

chinese: 我好發稱謝的聲音，也要述說你一切奇妙的作為。
english: That I may give out the voice of praise, and make public all the wonders which you have done.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我喜愛你所住的殿和你顯榮耀的居所。
english: Lord, your house has been dear to me, and the resting-place of your glory.

chinese: 不要把我的靈魂和罪人一同除掉；不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。
english: Let not my soul be numbered among sinners, or my life among men of blood;

chinese: 他們的手中有奸惡，右手滿有賄賂。
english: In whose hands are evil designs, and whose right hands take money for judging falsely.

chinese: 至於我，卻要行事純全；求你救贖我，憐恤我！
english: But as for me, I will go on in my upright ways: be my saviour, and have mercy on me.

chinese: 我的腳站在平坦地方；在眾會中我要稱頌耶和華！
english: I have a safe resting-place for my feet; I will give praise to the Lord in the meetings of the people.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華是我的亮光，是我的拯救，我還怕誰呢？耶和華是我性命的保障（或譯：力量），我還懼誰呢？
english: - Of David. - The Lord is my light and my salvation; who is then a cause of fear to me? the Lord is the strength of my life; who is a danger to me?

chinese: 那作惡的就是我的仇敵，前來吃我肉的時候就絆跌仆倒。
english: When evil-doers, even my haters, came on me to put an end to me, they were broken and put to shame.

chinese: 雖有軍兵安營攻擊我，我的心也不害怕；雖然興起刀兵攻擊我，我必仍舊安穩。
english: Even if an army came against me with its tents, my heart would have no fear: if war was made on me, my faith would not be moved.

chinese: 有一件事，我曾求耶和華，我仍要尋求：就是一生一世住在耶和華的殿中，瞻仰他的榮美，在他的殿裡求問。
english: One prayer have I made to the Lord, and this is my heart's desire; that I may have a place in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, looking on his glory, and getting wisdom in his Temple.

chinese: 因為我遭遇患難，他必暗暗地保守我；在他亭子裡，把我藏在他帳幕的隱密處，將我高舉在磐石上。
english: For in the time of trouble he will keep me safe in his tent: in the secret place of his tent he will keep me from men's eyes; high on a rock he will put me.

chinese: 現在我得以昂首，高過四面的仇敵。我要在他的帳幕裡歡然獻祭；我要唱詩歌頌耶和華。
english: And now my head will be lifted up higher than my haters who are round me: because of this I will make offerings of joy in his tent; I will make a song, truly I will make a song of praise to the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我用聲音呼籲的時候，求你垂聽；並求你憐恤我，應允我。
english: O Lord, let the voice of my cry come to your ears: have mercy on me, and give me an answer.

chinese: 你說：你們當尋求我的面。那時我心向你說：耶和華啊，你的面我正要尋求。
english: When you said, Make search for my face, my heart said to you, For your face will I make my search.

chinese: 不要向我掩面。不要發怒趕逐僕人，你向來是幫助我的。救我的神啊，不要丟掉我，也不要離棄我。
english: Let not your face be covered from me; do not put away your servant in wrath; you have been my help: do not give me up or take your support from me, O God of my salvation.

chinese: 我父母離棄我，耶和華必收留我。
english: When my father and my mother are turned away from me, then the Lord will be my support.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我，因我仇敵的緣故引導我走平坦的路。
english: Make your way clear to me, O Lord, guiding me by the right way, because of my haters.

chinese: 求你不要把我交給敵人，遂其所願；因為妄作見證的和口吐凶言的，起來攻擊我。
english: Do not give me into their hands, because false witnesses have come out against me, and men breathing destruction.

chinese: 我若不信在活人之地得見耶和華的恩惠，就早已喪膽了。
english: I had almost given up my hope of seeing the blessing of the Lord in the land of the living.

chinese: 要等候耶和華！當壯膽，堅固你的心！我再說，要等候耶和華！
english: Let your hope be in the Lord: take heart and be strong; yes, let your hope be in the Lord.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華啊，我要求告你！我的磐石啊，不要向我緘默！倘若你向我閉口，我就如將死的人一樣。
english: - Of David. - My cry goes up to you, O Lord, my Rock; do not keep back your answer from me, so that I may not become like those who go down into the underworld.

chinese: 我呼求你，向你至聖所舉手的時候，求你垂聽我懇求的聲音！
english: Give ear to the voice of my prayer, when I am crying to you, when my hands are lifted up to your holy place.

chinese: 不要把我和惡人並作孽的一同除掉；他們與鄰舍說和平話，心裡卻是奸惡。
english: Do not take me away with the sinners and the workers of evil, who say words of peace to their neighbours, but evil is in their hearts.

chinese: 願你按著他們所做的，並他們所行的惡事待他們。願你照著他們手所做的待他們，將他們所應得的報應加給他們。
english: Give them the right reward of their acts, and of their evil doings: give them punishment for the works of their hands, let them have their full reward.

chinese: 他們既然不留心耶和華所行的和他手所做的，他就必毀壞他們，不建立他們。
english: Because they have no respect for the works of the Lord, or for the things which his hands have made, they will be broken down and not lifted up by him.

chinese: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，因為他聽了我懇求的聲音。
english: May the Lord be praised, because he has given ear to the voice of my prayer.

chinese: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的盾牌；我心裡倚靠他就得幫助。所以我心中歡樂，我必用詩歌頌讚他。
english: The Lord is my strength and my breastplate, my heart had faith in him and I am helped; for this cause my heart is full of rapture, and I will give him praise in my song.

chinese: 耶和華是他百姓的力量，又是他受膏者得救的保障。
english: The Lord is their strength, and a strong place of salvation for his king.

chinese: 求你拯救你的百姓，賜福給你的產業，牧養他們，扶持他們，直到永遠。
english: Be a saviour to your people, and send a blessing on your heritage: be their guide, and let them be lifted up for ever.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）神的眾子啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華，歸給耶和華！
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - Give to the Lord, you sons of the gods, give to the Lord glory and strength.

chinese: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他，以聖潔的（的：或譯為）妝飾敬拜耶和華。
english: Give to the Lord the full glory of his name; give him worship in holy robes.

chinese: 耶和華的聲音發在水上；榮耀的神打雷，耶和華打雷在大水之上。
english: The voice of the Lord is on the waters: the God of glory is thundering, the Lord is on the great waters.

chinese: 耶和華的聲音大有能力；耶和華的聲音滿有威嚴。
english: The voice of the Lord is full of power; the voice of the Lord has a noble sound.

chinese: 耶和華的聲音震破香柏樹；耶和華震碎利巴嫩的香柏樹。
english: By the voice of the Lord are the cedar-trees broken, even the cedars of Lebanon are broken by the Lord.

chinese: 他也使之跳躍如牛犢，使利巴嫩和西連跳躍如野牛犢。
english: He makes them go jumping about like a young ox; Lebanon and Sirion like a young mountain ox.

chinese: 耶和華的聲音使火燄分岔。
english: At the voice of the Lord flames of fire are seen.

chinese: 耶和華的聲音震動曠野；耶和華震動加低斯的曠野。
english: At the voice of the Lord there is a shaking in the waste land, even a shaking in the waste land of Kadesh.

chinese: 耶和華的聲音驚動母鹿落胎，樹木也脫落淨光。凡在他殿中的，都稱說他的榮耀。
english: At the voice of the Lord the roes give birth, the leaves are taken from the trees: in his Temple everything says, Glory.

chinese: 洪水泛濫之時，耶和華坐著為王；耶和華坐著為王，直到永遠。
english: The Lord had his seat as king when the waters came on the earth; the Lord is seated as king for ever.

chinese: 耶和華必賜力量給他的百姓；耶和華必賜平安的福給他的百姓。
english: The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will give his people the blessing of peace.

chinese: （大衛在獻殿的時候，作這詩歌。）耶和華啊，我要尊崇你，因為你曾提拔我，不叫仇敵向我誇耀。
english: - A Psalm. A Song at the blessing of the House. Of David. - I will give you praise and honour, O Lord, because through you I have been lifted up; you have not given my haters cause to be glad over me.

chinese: 耶和華─我的神啊，我曾呼求你，你醫治了我。
english: O Lord my God, I sent up my cry to you, and you have made me well.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你曾把我的靈魂從陰間救上來，使我存活，不至於下坑。
english: O Lord, you have made my soul come again from the underworld: you have given me life and kept me from going down among the dead.

chinese: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們要歌頌他，稱讚他可記念的聖名。
english: Make songs to the Lord, O you saints of his, and give praise to his holy name.

chinese: 因為，他的怒氣不過是轉眼之間；他的恩典乃是一生之久。一宿雖然有哭泣，早晨便必歡呼。
english: For his wrath is only for a minute; in his grace there is life; weeping may be for a night, but joy comes in the morning.

chinese: 至於我，我凡事平順便說：我永不動搖。
english: When things went well for me I said, I will never be moved.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你曾施恩，叫我的江山穩固；你掩了面，我就驚惶。
english: Lord, by your grace you have kept my mountain strong: when your face was turned from me I was troubled.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我曾求告你；我向耶和華懇求，說：
english: My voice went up to you, O Lord; I made my prayer to the Lord.

chinese: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有甚麼益處呢？塵土豈能稱讚你，傳說你的誠實麼？
english: What profit is there in my blood if I go down into the underworld? will the dust give you praise, or be a witness to your help?

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你應允我，憐恤我！耶和華啊，求你幫助我！
english: Give ear to me, O Lord, and have mercy on me: Lord, be my helper.

chinese: 你已將我的哀哭變為跳舞，將我的麻衣脫去，給我披上喜樂，
english: By you my sorrow is turned into dancing; you have taken away my clothing of grief, and given me robes of joy;

chinese: 好叫我的靈（原文是榮耀）歌頌你，並不住聲。耶和華─我的神啊，我要稱謝你，直到永遠！
english: So that my glory may make songs of praise to you and not be quiet. O Lord my God, I will give you praise for ever.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，我投靠你；求你使我永不羞愧；憑你的公義搭救我！
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - In you, O Lord, have I put my hope; let me never be shamed; keep me safe in your righteousness.

chinese: 求你側耳而聽，快快救我！作我堅固的磐石，拯救我的保障！
english: Let your ear be turned to me; take me quickly out of danger; be my strong Rock, my place of strength where I may be safe.

chinese: 因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨；所以，求你為你名的緣故引導我，指點我。
english: For you are my Rock and my strong tower; go in front of me and be my guide, because of your name.

chinese: 求你救我脫離人為我暗設的網羅，因為你是我的保障。
english: Take me out of the net which they have put ready for me secretly; for you are my strength.

chinese: 我將我的靈魂交在你手裡；耶和華誠實的神啊，你救贖了我。
english: Into your hands I give my spirit; you are my saviour, O Lord God for ever true.

chinese: 我恨惡那信奉虛無之神的人；我卻倚靠耶和華。
english: I am full of hate for those who go after false gods; but my hope is in the Lord.

chinese: 我要為你的慈愛高興歡喜；因為你見過我的困苦，知道我心中的艱難。
english: I will be glad and have delight in your mercy; because you have seen my trouble; you have had pity on my soul in its sorrows;

chinese: 你未曾把我交在仇敵手裡；你使我的腳站在寬闊之處。
english: And you have not given me into the hand of my hater; you have put my feet in a wide place.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，因為我在急難之中；我的眼睛因憂愁而乾癟，連我的身心也不安舒。
english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am in trouble; my eyes are wasted with grief, I am wasted in soul and body.

chinese: 我的生命為愁苦所消耗；我的年歲為歎息所曠廢。我的力量因我的罪孽衰敗；我的骨頭也枯乾。
english: My life goes on in sorrow, and my years in weeping; my strength is almost gone because of my sin, and my bones are wasted away.

chinese: 我因一切敵人成了羞辱，在我的鄰舍跟前更甚；那認識我的都懼怕我，在外頭看見我的都躲避我。
english: Because of all those who are against me, I have become a word of shame to my neighbours; a cause of shaking the head and a fear to my friends: those who saw me in the street went in flight from me.

chinese: 我被人忘記，如同死人，無人記念；我好像破碎的器皿。
english: I have gone from men's minds and memory like a dead man; I am like a broken vessel.

chinese: 我聽見了許多人的讒謗，四圍都是驚嚇；他們一同商議攻擊我的時候，就圖謀要害我的性命。
english: False statements against me have come to my ears; fear was on every side: they were talking together against me, designing to take away my life.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我仍舊倚靠你；我說：你是我的神。
english: But I had faith in you, O Lord; I said, You are my God.

chinese: 我終身的事在你手中；求你救我脫離仇敵的手和那些逼迫我的人。
english: The chances of my life are in your hand; take me out of the hands of my haters, and of those who go after me.

chinese: 求你使你的臉光照僕人，憑你的慈愛拯救我。
english: Let your servant see the light of your face; in your mercy be my saviour.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你叫我不致羞愧，因為我曾呼籲你；求你使惡人羞愧，使他們在陰間緘默無聲。
english: Let me not be shamed, O Lord, for I have made my prayer to you; let the sinners be shamed, and let their mouths be shut in the underworld.

chinese: 那撒謊的人逞驕傲輕慢，出狂妄的話攻擊義人；願他的嘴啞而無言。
english: Let the false lips be shut, which say evil against the upright, looking down on him in their pride.

chinese: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你為他們所積存的，在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！
english: O how great is your grace, which you have put in store for your worshippers, and which you have made clear to those who had faith in you, before the sons of men!

chinese: 你必把他們藏在你面前的隱密處，免得遇見人的計謀；你必暗暗地保守他們在亭子裡，免受口舌的爭鬧。
english: You will keep them safe in your house from the designs of man; in the secret of your tent will you keep them from angry tongues.

chinese: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，因為他在堅固城裡向我施展奇妙的慈愛。
english: May the Lord be praised, because he has made clear to me the wonder of his grace in a strong town.

chinese: 至於我，我曾急促地說：我從你眼前被隔絕。然而，我呼求你的時候，你仍聽我懇求的聲音。
english: And as for me, I said in my fear, I am cut off from before your eyes; but you gave ear to the voice of my prayer, when my cry went up to you.

chinese: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們都要愛他！耶和華保護誠實人，足足報應行事驕傲的人。
english: O have love for the Lord, all you his saints; for the Lord keeps safe from danger all those who are true to him, and gives the workers of pride their right reward.

chinese: 凡仰望耶和華的人，你們都要壯膽，堅固你們的心！
english: Put away fear and let your heart be strong, all you whose hope is in the Lord.

chinese: （大衛的訓誨詩。）得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的，這人是有福的！
english: - Of David. Maschil. - Happy is he who has forgiveness for his wrongdoing, and whose sin is covered.

chinese: 凡心裡沒有詭詐、耶和華不算為有罪的，這人是有福的！
english: Happy is the man in whom the Lord sees no evil, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.

chinese: 我閉口不認罪的時候，因終日唉哼而骨頭枯乾。
english: When I kept my mouth shut, my bones were wasted, because of my crying all through the day.

chinese: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重；我的精液耗盡，如同夏天的乾旱。（細拉）
english: For the weight of your hand was on me day and night; my body became dry like the earth in summer. (Selah.)

chinese: 我向你陳明我的罪，不隱瞞我的惡。我說：我要向耶和華承認我的過犯，你就赦免我的罪惡。（細拉）
english: I made my wrongdoing clear to you, and did not keep back my sin. I said, I will put it all before the Lord; and you took away my wrongdoing and my sin. (Selah.)

chinese: 為此，凡虔誠人都當趁你可尋找的時候禱告你；大水泛溢的時候，必不能到他那裡。
english: For this cause let every saint make his prayer to you at a time when you are near: then the overflowing of the great waters will not overtake him.

chinese: 你是我藏身之處；你必保佑我脫離苦難，以得救的樂歌四面環繞我。（細拉）
english: You are my safe and secret place; you will keep me from trouble; you will put songs of salvation on the lips of those who are round me. (Selah.)

chinese: 我要教導你，指示你當行的路；我要定睛在你身上勸戒你。
english: I will give you knowledge, teaching you the way to go; my eye will be your guide.

chinese: 你不可像那無知的騾馬，必用嚼環轡頭勒住他；不然，就不能馴服。
english: Do not be like the horse or the ass, without sense; ...

chinese: 惡人必多受苦楚；惟獨倚靠耶和華的必有慈愛四面環繞他。
english: The sinner will be full of trouble; but mercy will be round the man who has faith in the Lord.

chinese: 你們義人應當靠耶和華歡喜快樂；你們心裡正直的人都當歡呼。
english: Be glad in the Lord with joy, you upright men; give cries of joy, all you whose hearts are true.

chinese: 義人哪，你們應當靠耶和華歡樂；正直人的讚美是合宜的。
english: Be glad in the Lord, O doers of righteousness; for praise is beautiful for the upright.

chinese: 你們應當彈琴稱謝耶和華，用十弦瑟歌頌他。
english: Give praise to the Lord on the corded instrument; make melody to him with instruments of music.

chinese: 應當向他唱新歌，彈得巧妙，聲音洪亮。
english: Make a new song to him; playing expertly with a loud noise.

chinese: 因為耶和華的言語正直；凡他所做的盡都誠實。
english: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his works are certain.

chinese: 他喜愛仁義公平；遍地滿了耶和華的慈愛。
english: His delight is in righteousness and wisdom; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

chinese: 諸天藉耶和華的命而造；萬象藉他口中的氣而成。
english: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the army of heaven by the breath of his mouth.

chinese: 他聚集海水如壘，收藏深洋在庫房。
english: He makes the waters of the sea come together in a mass; he keeps the deep seas in store-houses.

chinese: 願全地都敬畏耶和華！願世上的居民都懼怕他！
english: Let the earth be full of the fear of the Lord; let all the people of the world be in holy fear of him.

chinese: 因為他說有，就有，命立，就立。
english: For he gave the word, and it was done; by his order it was fixed for ever.

chinese: 耶和華使列國的籌算歸於無有，使眾民的思念無有功效。
english: The Lord undoes the designs of the nations; he makes the thoughts of the peoples without effect.

chinese: 耶和華的籌算永遠立定；他心中的思念萬代常存。
english: The Lord's purpose is eternal, the designs of his heart go on through all the generations of man.

chinese: 以耶和華為神的，那國是有福的！他所揀選為自己產業的，那民是有福的！
english: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he has taken for his heritage.

chinese: 耶和華從天上觀看；他看見一切的世人。
english: The Lord is looking down from heaven; he sees all the sons of men;

chinese: 從他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民。
english: From his house he keeps watch on all who are living on the earth;

chinese: 他是那造成他們眾人心的，留意他們一切作為的。
english: He makes all their hearts; their works are clear to him.

chinese: 君王不能因兵多得勝；勇士不能因力大得救。
english: A king's salvation is not in the power of his army; a strong man does not get free by his great strength.

chinese: 靠馬得救是枉然的；馬也不能因力大救人。
english: A horse is a false hope; his great power will not make any man free from danger.

chinese: 耶和華的眼目看顧敬畏他的人和仰望他慈愛的人，
english: See, the eye of the Lord is on those in whose hearts is the fear of him, on those whose hope is in his mercy;

chinese: 要救他們的命脫離死亡，並使他們在饑荒中存活。
english: To keep their souls from death; and to keep them living in time of need.

chinese: 我們的心向來等候耶和華；他是我們的幫助，我們的盾牌。
english: Our souls are waiting for the Lord; he is our help and our salvation.

chinese: 我們的心必靠他歡喜，因為我們向來倚靠他的聖名。
english: For in him our hearts have joy; in his holy name is our hope.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你照著我們所仰望你的，向我們施行慈愛！
english: Let your mercy be on us, O Lord, as we are waiting for you.

chinese: （大衛在亞比米勒面前裝瘋，被他趕出去，就作這詩。）我要時時稱頌耶和華；讚美他的話必常在我口中。
english: - Of David. When he made a change in his behaviour before Abimelech, who sent him away, and he went. - I will be blessing the Lord at all times; his praise will be ever in my mouth.

chinese: 我的心必因耶和華誇耀；謙卑人聽見就要喜樂。
english: My soul will say great things of the Lord: the poor in spirit will have knowledge of it and be glad.

chinese: 你們和我當稱耶和華為大，一同高舉他的名。
english: O give praise to the Lord with me; let us be witnesses together of his great name.

chinese: 我曾尋求耶和華，他就應允我，救我脫離了一切的恐懼。
english: I was searching for the Lord, and he gave ear to my voice, and made me free from all my fears.

chinese: 凡仰望他的，便有光榮；他們的臉必不蒙羞。
english: Let your eyes be turned to him and you will have light, and your faces will not be shamed.

chinese: 我這困苦人呼求，耶和華便垂聽，救我脫離一切患難。
english: This poor man's cry came before the Lord, and he gave him salvation from all his troubles.

chinese: 耶和華的使者在敬畏他的人四圍安營，搭救他們。
english: The angel of the Lord is ever watching over those who have fear of him, to keep them safe.

chinese: 你們要嘗嘗主恩的滋味，便知道他是美善；投靠他的人有福了！
english: By experience you will see that the Lord is good; happy is the man who has faith in him.

chinese: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們當敬畏他，因敬畏他的一無所缺。
english: Keep yourselves in the fear of the Lord, all you his saints; for those who do so will have no need of anything.

chinese: 少壯獅子還缺食忍餓，但尋求耶和華的甚麼好處都不缺。
english: The young lions are in need and have no food; but those who are looking to the Lord will have every good thing.

chinese: 眾弟子啊，你們當來聽我的話！我要將敬畏耶和華的道教訓你們。
english: Come, children, give attention to me; I will be your teacher in the fear of the Lord.

chinese: 有何人喜好存活，愛慕長壽，得享美福，
english: What man has a love of life, and a desire that his days may be increased so that he may see good?

chinese: 就要禁止舌頭不出惡言，嘴唇不說詭詐的話。
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from words of deceit.

chinese: 要離惡行善，尋求和睦，一心追趕。
english: Be turned from evil, and do good; make a search for peace, desiring it with all your heart.

chinese: 耶和華的眼目看顧義人；他的耳朵聽他們的呼求。
english: The eyes of the Lord are on the upright, and his ears are open to their cry.

chinese: 耶和華向行惡的人變臉，要從世上除滅他們的名號。
english: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to take away the memory of them from the earth.

chinese: 義人呼求，耶和華聽見了，便救他們脫離一切患難。
english: The cry of the upright comes before the Lord, and he takes them out of all their troubles.

chinese: 耶和華靠近傷心的人，拯救靈性痛悔的人。
english: The Lord is near the broken-hearted; he is the saviour of those whose spirits are crushed down.

chinese: 義人多有苦難，但耶和華救他脫離這一切，
english: Great are the troubles of the upright: but the Lord takes him safely out of them all.

chinese: 又保全他一身的骨頭，連一根也不折斷。
english: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.

chinese: 惡必害死惡人；恨惡義人的，必被定罪。
english: Evil will put an end to the sinner, and those who are haters of righteousness will come to destruction.

chinese: 耶和華救贖他僕人的靈魂；凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
english: The Lord will be the saviour of the souls of his servants, and no one who has faith in him will be put to shame.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華啊，與我相爭的，求你與他們相爭！與我相戰的，求你與他們相戰！
english: - Of David. - O Lord, be on my side against those who are judging me; be at war with those who make war against me.

chinese: 拿著大小的盾牌，起來幫助我。
english: Be a breastplate to me, and give me your help.

chinese: 抽出槍來，擋住那追趕我的；求你對我的靈魂說：我是拯救你的。
english: Take up your spear and keep back my attackers; say to my soul, I am your salvation.

chinese: 願那尋索我命的，蒙羞受辱！願那謀害我的，退後羞愧！
english: Let them be overcome and put to shame who make attempts to take my soul; let those who would do me damage be turned back and made foolish.

chinese: 願他們像風前的糠，有耶和華的使者趕逐他們。
english: Let them be like dust from the grain before the wind; let the angel of the Lord send them in flight.

chinese: 願他們的道路又暗又滑，有耶和華的使者追趕他們。
english: Let their way be dark and full of danger; let them be troubled by the angel of the Lord.

chinese: 因他們無故地為我暗設網羅，無故地挖坑，要害我的性命。
english: For without cause they have put a net ready for me secretly, in which to take my soul.

chinese: 願災禍忽然臨到他身上！願他暗設的網纏住自己！願他落在其中遭災禍！
english: Let destruction come on them without their knowledge; let them be taken themselves in their secret nets, falling into the same destruction.

chinese: 我的心必靠耶和華快樂，靠他的救恩高興。
english: And my soul will have joy in the Lord; it will be glad in his salvation.

chinese: 我的骨頭都要說：耶和華啊，誰能像你救護困苦人脫離那比他強壯的，救護困苦窮乏人脫離那搶奪他的？
english: All my bones will say, Lord, who is like you? The saviour of the poor man from the hands of the strong, of him who is poor and in need from him who takes his goods.

chinese: 凶惡的見證人起來，盤問我所不知道的事。
english: False witnesses got up: they put questions to me about crimes of which I had no knowledge.

chinese: 他們向我以惡報善，使我的靈魂孤苦。
english: They gave me back evil for good, troubling my soul.

chinese: 至於我，當他們有病的時候，我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心；我所求的都歸到自己的懷中。
english: But as for me, when they were ill I put on the clothing of sorrow: I went without food and was sad, and my prayer came back again to my heart.

chinese: 我這樣行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄；我屈身悲哀，如同人為母親哀痛。
english: My behaviour was as if it had been my friend or my brother: I was bent low in grief like one whose mother is dead.

chinese: 我在患難中，他們卻歡喜，大家聚集。我所不認識的那些下流人聚集攻擊我；他們不住地把我撕裂。
english: But they took pleasure in my trouble, and came together, yes, low persons came together against me without my knowledge; they never came to an end of wounding me.

chinese: 他們如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。
english: Like men of deceit they put me to shame; the voice of their wrath was loud against me.

chinese: 主啊，你看著不理要到幾時呢？求你救我的靈魂脫離他們的殘害！救我的生命（生命：原文是獨一者）脫離少壯獅子！
english: Lord, how long will you be looking on? take my soul from their destruction, my life from the lions.

chinese: 我在大會中要稱謝你，在眾民中要讚美你。
english: I will give you praise in the great meeting; I will give you honour among a strong people.

chinese: 求你不容那無理與我為仇的向我誇耀！不容那無故恨我的向我擠眼！
english: Do not let my haters be glad over me falsely; let not those who are against me without cause make sport of me.

chinese: 因為他們不說和平話，倒想出詭詐的言語害地上的安靜人。
english: For they do not say words of peace; in their deceit they are designing evil things against the quiet ones in the land.

chinese: 他們大大張口攻擊我，說：阿哈，阿哈，我們的眼已經看見了！
english: Their mouths were open wide against me, and they said, Aha, aha, our eyes have seen it.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你已經看見了，求你不要閉口！主啊，求你不要遠離我！
english: You have seen this, O Lord; be not unmoved: O Lord, be not far from me.

chinese: 我的神我的主啊，求你奮興醒起，判清我的事，伸明我的冤！
english: Be awake, O Lord, be moved to take up my cause, my God and my Lord.

chinese: 耶和華─我的神啊，求你按你的公義判斷我，不容他們向我誇耀！
english: Be my judge, O Lord my God, in your righteousness; do not let them be glad over me.

chinese: 不容他們心裡說：阿哈，遂我們的心願了！不容他們說：我們已經把他吞了！
english: Let them not say in their hearts, So we will have it: let them not say, We have put an end to him.

chinese: 願那喜歡我遭難的一同抱愧蒙羞！願那向我妄自尊大的披慚愧，蒙羞辱！
english: Let all those who take pleasure in my troubles be shamed and come to nothing: let those who are lifted up against me be covered with shame and have no honour.

chinese: 願那喜悅我冤屈得伸的（冤屈得伸：原文是公義）歡呼快樂；願他們常說：當尊耶和華為大！耶和華喜悅他的僕人平安。
english: Let those who are on my side give cries of joy; let them ever say, The Lord be praised, for he has pleasure in the peace of his servant.

chinese: 我的舌頭要終日論說你的公義，時常讚美你。
english: And my tongue will be talking of your righteousness and of your praise all the day.

chinese: （耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。）惡人的罪過在他心裡說：我眼中不怕神！
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of the servant of the Lord. Of David. - The sin of the evil-doer says in his heart, There is no fear of the Lord before his eyes.

chinese: 他自誇自媚，以為他的罪孽終不顯露，不被恨惡。
english: For he takes comfort in the thought that his sin will not be uncovered and hated.

chinese: 他口中的言語盡是罪孽詭詐；他與智慧善行已經斷絕。
english: In the words of his mouth are evil and deceit; he has given up being wise and doing good.

chinese: 他在床上圖謀罪孽，定意行不善的道，不憎惡惡事。
english: He gives thought to evil on his bed; he takes a way which is not good; he is not a hater of evil.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛上及諸天；你的信實達到穹蒼。
english: Your mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens, and your strong purpose is as high as the clouds.

chinese: 你的公義好像高山；你的判斷如同深淵。耶和華啊，人民、牲畜，你都救護。
english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judging is like the great deep; O Lord, you give life to man and beast.

chinese: 神啊，你的慈愛何其寶貴！世人投靠在你翅膀的蔭下。
english: How good is your loving mercy, O God! the children of men take cover under the shade of your wings.

chinese: 他們必因你殿裡的肥甘得以飽足；你也必叫他們喝你樂河的水。
english: The delights of your house will be showered on them; you will give them drink from the river of your pleasures.

chinese: 因為，在你那裡有生命的源頭；在你的光中，我們必得見光。
english: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light we will see light.

chinese: 願你常施慈愛給認識你的人，常以公義待心裡正直的人。
english: O let there be no end to your loving mercy to those who have knowledge of you, or of your righteousness to the upright in heart.

chinese: 不容驕傲人的腳踐踏我；不容凶惡人的手趕逐我。
english: Let not the foot of pride come against me, or the hand of the evil-doers put me out of my place.

chinese: 在那裡，作孽的人已經仆倒；他們被推倒，不能再起來。
english: There the workers of evil have come down: they have been made low, and will not be lifted up.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）不要為作惡的心懷不平，也不要向那行不義的生出嫉妒。
english: - Of David. - Do not be angry because of the wrongdoers, or have envy of the workers of evil.

chinese: 因為他們如草快被割下，又如青菜快要枯乾。
english: For they will quickly be cut down like grass, and become dry like the green plants.

chinese: 你當倚靠耶和華而行善，住在地上，以他的信實為糧；
english: Have faith in the Lord, and do good; be at rest in the land, and go after righteousness.

chinese: 又要以耶和華為樂，他就將你心裡所求的賜給你。
english: So will your delight be in the Lord, and he will give you your heart's desires.

chinese: 當將你的事交託耶和華，並倚靠他，他就必成全。
english: Put your life in the hands of the Lord; have faith in him and he will do it.

chinese: 他要使你的公義如光發出，使你的公平明如正午。
english: And he will make your righteousness be seen like the light, and your cause like the shining of the sun.

chinese: 你當默然倚靠耶和華，耐性等候他；不要因那道路通達的和那惡謀成就的心懷不平。
english: Take your rest in the Lord, waiting quietly for him; do not be angry because of the man who does well in his evil ways, and gives effect to his bad designs.

chinese: 當止住怒氣，離棄忿怒；不要心懷不平，以致作惡。
english: Put an end to your wrath and be no longer bitter; do not give way to angry feeling which is a cause of sin.

chinese: 因為作惡的必被剪除；惟有等候耶和華的必承受地土。
english: For the evil-doers will be cut off: but those who have faith in the Lord will have the earth for their heritage.

chinese: 還有片時，惡人要歸於無有；你就是細察他的住處也要歸於無有。
english: For in a short time the evil-doer will be gone: you will go searching for his place, and it will not be there.

chinese: 但謙卑人必承受地土，以豐盛的平安為樂。
english: But the gentle will have the earth for their heritage; they will take their delight in peace without measure.

chinese: 惡人設謀害義人，又向他咬牙。
english: The sinner has evil designs against the upright, lifting up the voice of wrath against him.

chinese: 主要笑他，因見他受罰的日子將要來到。
english: He will be laughed at by the Lord, who sees that his day is coming.

chinese: 惡人已經弓上弦，刀出鞘，要打倒困苦窮乏的人，要殺害行動正直的人。
english: The evil-doers have taken out their swords, their bows are bent; for crushing the poor, and to put to death those who are upright in their ways.

chinese: 他們的刀必刺入自己的心；他們的弓必被折斷。
english: But their swords will be turned into their hearts, and their bows will be broken.

chinese: 一個義人所有的雖少，強過許多惡人的富餘。
english: The little which the good man has is better than the wealth of evil-doers.

chinese: 因為惡人的膀臂必被折斷；但耶和華是扶持義人。
english: For the arms of the evil-doers will be broken: but the Lord is the support of the good.

chinese: 耶和華知道完全人的日子；他們的產業要存到永遠。
english: The days of the upright are numbered by the Lord, and their heritage will be for ever.

chinese: 他們在急難的時候不致羞愧，在饑荒的日子必得飽足。
english: They will not be shamed in the evil time, and in the days when all are in need of food they will have enough.

chinese: 惡人卻要滅亡。耶和華的仇敵要像羊羔的脂油（或譯：像草地的華美）；他們要消滅，要如煙消滅。
english: But the wrongdoers will come to destruction, and the haters of the Lord will be like the fat of lambs, they will be burned up; they will go up in smoke, and never again be seen.

chinese: 惡人借貸而不償還；義人卻恩待人，並且施捨。
english: The sinner takes money and does not give it back; but the upright man has mercy, and gives to others.

chinese: 蒙耶和華賜福的必承受地土；被他咒詛的必被剪除。
english: Those who have his blessing will have the earth for their heritage; but those who are cursed by him will be cut off.

chinese: 義人的腳步被耶和華立定；他的道路，耶和華也喜愛。
english: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he takes delight in his way.

chinese: 他雖失腳也不至全身仆倒，因為耶和華用手攙扶他（或譯：攙扶他的手）。
english: Even if he has a fall he will not be without help: for the hand of the Lord is supporting him.

chinese: 我從前年幼，現在年老，卻未見過義人被棄，也未見過他的後裔討飯。
english: I have been young, and now am old, but I have not seen the good man without help, or his children looking for bread.

chinese: 他終日恩待人，借給人；他的後裔也蒙福！
english: All the day he is ready to have mercy and to give; his children are a blessing.

chinese: 你當離惡行善，就可永遠安居。
english: Be turned from evil, and do good; and your place will be for ever.

chinese: 因為，耶和華喜愛公平，不撇棄他的聖民；他們永蒙保佑，但惡人的後裔必被剪除。
english: For the Lord is a lover of righteousness, and takes care of his saints; they will be kept safe for ever; but the seed of the evil-doers will be cut off.

chinese: 義人必承受地土，永居其上。
english: The upright will have the earth for their heritage, and will go on living there for ever.

chinese: 義人的口談論智慧；他的舌頭講說公平。
english: The mouth of the good man says words of wisdom; the talk of his tongue is of righteousness.

chinese: 神的律法在他心裡；他的腳總不滑跌。
english: The law of his God is in his heart; he will never make a false step.

chinese: 惡人窺探義人，想要殺他。
english: The sinners are watching the upright man, desiring to put him to death.

chinese: 耶和華必不撇他在惡人手中；當審判的時候，也不定他的罪。
english: The Lord will not give him into their hands, or be against him when he is judged.

chinese: 你當等候耶和華，遵守他的道，他就抬舉你，使你承受地土；惡人被剪除的時候，你必看見。
english: Be waiting for the Lord, and keep his way; and you will be lifted up, and have the land for your heritage: when the evil-doers are cut off, you will see it.

chinese: 我見過惡人大有勢力，好像一根青翠樹在本土生發。
english: I have seen the evil-doer in great power, covering the earth like a great tree.

chinese: 有人從那裡經過，不料，他沒有了；我也尋找他，卻尋不著。
english: But he came to an end, and there was no sign of him; I made a search for him and he was not there.

chinese: 你要細察那完全人，觀看那正直人，因為和平人有好結局。
english: Give attention to the good man, and take note of the upright; because the end of that man is peace.

chinese: 至於犯法的人，必一同滅絕；惡人終必剪除。
english: But as for the sinners, they will be cut off together; the end of the wrongdoers is destruction.

chinese: 但義人得救是由於耶和華；他在患難時作他們的營寨。
english: But the Lord is the saviour of the upright: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

chinese: 耶和華幫助他們，解救他們；他解救他們脫離惡人，把他們救出來，因為他們投靠他。
english: And the Lord will be their help, and keep them safe: he will take them out of the hands of the evil-doers, and be their saviour, because they had faith in him.

chinese: （大衛的記念詩。）耶和華啊，求你不要在怒中責備我，不要在烈怒中懲罰我！
english: - A Psalm. Of David. To keep in memory. - O Lord, be not bitter with me in your wrath; let not your hand be on me in the heat of your passion.

chinese: 因為，你的箭射入我身；你的手壓住我。
english: For your arrows have gone into my flesh, and I am crushed under the weight of your hand.

chinese: 因你的惱怒，我的肉無一完全；因我的罪過，我的骨頭也不安寧。
english: My flesh is wasted because of your wrath; and there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.

chinese: 我的罪孽高過我的頭，如同重擔叫我擔當不起。
english: For my crimes have gone over my head; they are like a great weight which is more than my strength.

chinese: 因我的愚昧，我的傷發臭流膿。
english: My wounds are poisoned and evil-smelling, because of my foolish behaviour.

chinese: 我疼痛，大大拳曲，終日哀痛。
english: I am troubled, I am made low; I go weeping all the day.

chinese: 我滿腰是火；我的肉無一完全。
english: For my body is full of burning; all my flesh is unhealthy.

chinese: 我被壓傷，身體疲倦；因心裡不安，我就唉哼。
english: I am feeble and crushed down; I gave a cry like a lion because of the grief in my heart.

chinese: 主啊，我的心願都在你面前；我的歎息不向你隱瞞。
english: Lord, all my desire is before you; my sorrow is not kept secret from you.

chinese: 我心跳動，我力衰微，連我眼中的光也沒有了。
english: My heart goes out in pain, my strength is wasting away; as for the light of my eyes, it is gone from me.

chinese: 我的良朋密友因我的災病都躲在旁邊站著；我的親戚本家也遠遠地站立。
english: My lovers and my friends keep away from my disease; my relations keep far away.

chinese: 那尋索我命的設下網羅；那想要害我的口出惡言，終日思想詭計。
english: Those who have a desire to take my life put nets for me; those who are designing my destruction say evil things against me, all the day their minds are full of deceit.

chinese: 但我如聾子不聽，像啞巴不開口。
english: But I kept my ears shut like a man without hearing; like a man without a voice, never opening his mouth.

chinese: 我如不聽見的人，口中沒有回話。
english: So I was like a man whose ears are shut, and in whose mouth there are no sharp words.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我仰望你！主─我的神啊，你必應允我！
english: In you, O Lord, is my hope: you will give me an answer, O Lord, my God.

chinese: 我曾說：恐怕他們向我誇耀；我失腳的時候，他們向我誇大。
english: I said, Let them not be glad over me; when my foot is moved, let them not be lifted up with pride against me.

chinese: 我幾乎跌倒；我的痛苦常在我面前。
english: My feet are near to falling, and my sorrow is ever before me.

chinese: 我要承認我的罪孽；我要因我的罪憂愁。
english: I will make clear my wrongdoing, with sorrow in my heart for my sin.

chinese: 但我的仇敵又活潑又強壯，無理恨我的增多了。
english: But they are strong who have hate for me without cause: those who are against me falsely are increased in numbers.

chinese: 以惡報善的與我作對，因我是追求良善。
english: They give me back evil for good; they are my haters because I go after the thing which is right.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你不要撇棄我！我的神啊，求你不要遠離我！
english: Do not give me up, O Lord; O my God, be near to me.

chinese: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快幫助我！
english: Come quickly to give me help, O Lord, my salvation.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長耶杜頓。）我曾說：我要謹慎我的言行，免得我舌頭犯罪；惡人在我面前的時候，我要用嚼環勒住我的口。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of Jeduthun. A Psalm. Of David. - I said, I will give attention to my ways, so that my tongue may do no wrong; I will keep my mouth under control, while the sinner is before me.

chinese: 我默然無聲，連好話也不出口；我的愁苦就發動了，
english: I made no sound, I said no word, even of good; and I was moved with sorrow.

chinese: 我的心在我裡面發熱。我默想的時候，火就燒起，我便用舌頭說話。
english: My heart was burning in my breast; while I was deep in thought the fire was lighted; then I said with my tongue,

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你叫我曉得我身之終！我的壽數幾何？叫我知道我的生命不長！
english: Lord, give me knowledge of my end, and of the measure of my days, so that I may see how feeble I am.

chinese: 你使我的年日窄如手掌；我一生的年數，在你面前如同無有。各人最穩妥的時候，真是全然虛幻。（細拉）
english: You have made my days no longer than a hand's measure; and my years are nothing in your eyes; truly, every man is but a breath. (Selah.)

chinese: 世人行動實係幻影。他們忙亂，真是枉然；積蓄財寶，不知將來有誰收取。
english: Truly, every man goes on his way like an image; he is troubled for no purpose: he makes a great store of wealth, and has no knowledge of who will get it.

chinese: 主啊，如今我等甚麼呢？我的指望在乎你！
english: And now, Lord, what am I waiting for? my hope is in you.

chinese: 求你救我脫離一切的過犯，不要使我受愚頑人的羞辱。
english: Make me free from all my sins; do not let me be shamed by the man of evil behaviour.

chinese: 因我所遭遇的是出於你，我就默然不語。
english: I was quiet, and kept my mouth shut; because you had done it.

chinese: 求你把你的責罰從我身上免去；因你手的責打，我便消滅。
english: No longer let your hand be hard on me; I am wasted by the blows of your hand.

chinese: 你因人的罪惡懲罰他的時候，叫他的笑容（的笑容：或譯所喜愛的）消滅，如衣被蟲所咬。世人真是虛幻！（細拉）
english: By the weight of your wrath against man's sin, the glory of his form is wasted away; truly every man is but a breath. (Selah.)

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，留心聽我的呼求！我流淚，求你不要靜默無聲！因為我在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我列祖一般。
english: Let my prayer come to your ears, O Lord, and give attention to my cry, make an answer to my weeping: for my time here is short before you, and in a little time I will be gone, like all my fathers.

chinese: 求你寬容我，使我在去而不返之先可以力量復原。
english: Let your wrath be turned away from me, so that I may be comforted, before I go away from here, and become nothing.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）我曾耐性等候耶和華；他垂聽我的呼求。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of David. A Psalm. - When I was waiting quietly for the Lord, his heart was turned to me, and he gave ear to my cry.

chinese: 他從禍坑裡，從淤泥中，把我拉上來，使我的腳立在磐石上，使我腳步穩當。
english: He took me up out of a deep waste place, out of the soft and sticky earth; he put my feet on a rock, and made my steps certain.

chinese: 他使我口唱新歌，就是讚美我們神的話。許多人必看見而懼怕，並要倚靠耶和華。
english: And he put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God; numbers have seen it with fear, and put their faith in the Lord.

chinese: 那倚靠耶和華、不理會狂傲和偏向虛假之輩的，這人便為有福！
english: Happy is the man who has faith in the Lord, and does not give honour to the men of pride or to those who are turned away to deceit.

chinese: 耶和華─我的神啊，你所行的奇事，並你向我們所懷的意念甚多，不能向你陳明。若要陳明，其事不可勝數。
english: O Lord my God, great are the wonders which you have done in your thought for us; it is not possible to put them out in order before you; when I would give an account of them, their number is greater than I may say.

chinese: 祭物和禮物，你不喜悅；你已經開通我的耳朵。燔祭和贖罪祭非你所要。
english: You had no desire for offerings of beasts or fruits of the earth; ears you made for me: for burned offerings and sin offerings you made no request.

chinese: 那時我說：看哪，我來了！我的事在經卷上已經記載了。
english: Then I said, See, I come; it is recorded of me in the roll of the book,

chinese: 我的神啊，我樂意照你的旨意行；你的律法在我心裡。
english: My delight is to do your pleasure, O my God; truly, your law is in my heart.

chinese: 我在大會中宣傳公義的佳音；我必不止住我的嘴唇。耶和華啊，這是你所知道的。
english: I have given news of righteousness in the great meeting; O Lord, you have knowledge that I have not kept back my words.

chinese: 我未曾把你的公義藏在心裡；我已陳明你的信實和你的救恩；我在大會中未曾隱瞞你的慈愛和誠實。
english: Your righteousness has not been folded away in my heart; I have made clear your true word and your salvation; I have not kept secret your mercy or your faith from the great meeting.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！願你的慈愛和誠實常常保佑我！
english: Take not away your gentle mercies from me, O Lord; let your mercy and your faith keep me safe for ever.

chinese: 因有無數的禍患圍困我，我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首；這罪孽比我的頭髮還多，我就心寒膽戰。
english: For unnumbered evils are round about me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I am bent down with their weight; they are more than the hairs of my head, my strength is gone because of them.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你開恩搭救我！耶和華啊，求你速速幫助我！
english: Be pleased, O Lord, to take me out of danger; O Lord, come quickly and give me help.

chinese: 願那些尋找我、要滅我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！願那些喜悅我受害的，退後受辱！
english: Let those who go after my soul for its destruction have shame and trouble together; let them be turned back and made foolish who take pleasure in my trouble.

chinese: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的，因羞愧而敗亡！
english: Let those who say to me, Aha, aha! be surprised because of their shame.

chinese: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜！願那些喜愛你救恩的，常說：當尊耶和華為大！
english: Let all those who are looking for you be glad and have joy in you; let the lovers of your salvation ever say, May the Lord be great.

chinese: 但我是困苦窮乏的，主仍顧念我；你是幫助我的，搭救我的。神啊，求你不要耽延！
english: Though I am poor and in need, the Lord has me in mind; you are my help and my saviour; let there be no waiting, O my God.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）眷顧貧窮的有福了！他遭難的日子，耶和華必搭救他。
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - Happy is the man who gives thought to the poor; the Lord will be his saviour in the time of trouble.

chinese: 耶和華必保全他，使他存活；他必在地上享福。求你不要把他交給仇敵，遂其所願。
english: The Lord will keep him safe, and give him life; the Lord will let him be a blessing on the earth, and will not give him into the hand of his haters.

chinese: 他病重在榻，耶和華必扶持他；他在病中，你必給他鋪床。
english: The Lord will be his support on his bed of pain: by you will all his grief be turned to strength.

chinese: 我曾說：耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，醫治我！因為我得罪了你。
english: I said, Lord, have mercy on me; make my soul well, because my faith is in you.

chinese: 我的仇敵用惡言議論我說：他幾時死，他的名才滅亡呢？
english: My haters say evil against me, When will he be dead, and his name come to an end?

chinese: 他來看我就說假話；他心存奸惡，走到外邊才說出來。
english: If one comes to see me, deceit is in his heart; he keeps a store of evil, which he makes public in every place.

chinese: 一切恨我的，都交頭接耳地議論我；他們設計要害我。
english: All my haters are talking secretly together against me; they are designing my downfall.

chinese: 他們說：有怪病貼在他身上；他已躺臥，必不能再起來。
english: They say, He has an evil disease, which will not let him go: and now that he is down he will not get up again.

chinese: 連我知己的朋友，我所倚靠、吃過我飯的也用腳踢我。
english: Even my dearest friend, in whom I had faith, who took bread with me, is turned against me.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，使我起來，好報復他們！
english: But you, O Lord, have mercy on me, lifting me up, so that I may give them their punishment.

chinese: 因我的仇敵不得向我誇勝，我從此便知道你喜愛我。
english: By this I see that you have pleasure in me, because my hater does not overcome me.

chinese: 你因我純正就扶持我，使我永遠站在你的面前。
english: And as for me, you are my support in my righteousness, giving me a place before your face for ever.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的，從亙古直到永遠。阿們！阿們！
english: May the Lord God of Israel be praised, through eternal days and for ever. So be it. So be it.

chinese: （可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。）神啊，我的心切慕你，如鹿切慕溪水。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Maschil. Of the sons of Korah. - Like the desire of the roe for the water-streams, so is my soul's desire for you, O God.

chinese: 我的心渴想神，就是永生神；我幾時得朝見　神呢？
english: My soul is dry for need of God, the living God; when may I come and see the face of God?

chinese: 我晝夜以眼淚當飲食；人不住地對我說：你的神在哪裡呢？
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they keep saying to me, Where is your God?

chinese: 我從前與眾人同往，用歡呼稱讚的聲音領他們到神的殿裡，大家守節。我追想這些事，我的心極其悲傷。
english: Let my soul be overflowing with grief when these things come back to my mind, how I went in company to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with the song of those who were keeping the feast.

chinese: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？為何在我裡面煩躁？應當仰望神，因他笑臉幫助我；我還要稱讚他。
english: Why are you crushed down, O my soul? and why are you troubled in me? put your hope in God; for I will again give him praise who is my help and my God.

chinese: 我的神啊，我的心在我裡面憂悶，所以我從約但地，從黑門嶺，從米薩山記念你。
english: My soul is crushed down in me, so I will keep you in mind; from the land of Jordan and of the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.

chinese: 你的瀑布發聲，深淵就與深淵響應；你的波浪洪濤漫過我身。
english: Deep is sounding to deep at the noise of your waterfalls; all your waves have gone rolling over me.

chinese: 白晝，耶和華必向我施慈愛；黑夜，我要歌頌禱告賜我生命的神。
english: But the Lord will send his mercy in the daytime, and in the night his song will be with me, a prayer to the God of my life.

chinese: 我要對神─我的磐石說：你為何忘記我呢？我為何因仇敵的欺壓時常哀痛呢？
english: I will say to God my Rock, Why have you let me go from your memory? why do I go in sorrow because of the attacks of my haters?

chinese: 我的敵人辱罵我，好像打碎我的骨頭，不住地對我說：你的神在哪裡呢？
english: The cruel words of my haters are like a crushing of my bones; when they say to me every day, Where is your God?

chinese: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？為何在我裡面煩躁？應當仰望神，因我還要稱讚他。他是我臉上的光榮（原文是幫助），是我的　神。
english: Why are you crushed down, O my soul? and why are you troubled in me? put your hope in God; for I will again give him praise who is my help and my God.

chinese: 神啊，求你伸我的冤，向不虔誠的國為我辨屈；求你救我脫離詭詐不義的人。
english: Be my judge, O God, supporting my cause against a nation without religion; O keep me from the false and evil man.

chinese: 因為你是賜我力量的神，為何丟棄我呢？我為何因仇敵的欺壓時常哀痛呢？
english: You are the God of my strength; why have you put me from you? why do I go in sorrow because of the attacks of my haters?

chinese: 求你發出你的亮光和真實，好引導我，帶我到你的聖山，到你的居所！
english: O send out your light and your true word; let them be my guide: let them take me to your holy hill, and to your tents.

chinese: 我就走到神的祭壇，到我最喜樂的神那裡。神啊，我的　神，我要彈琴稱讚你！
english: Then I will go up to the altar of God, to the God of my joy; I will be glad and give praise to you on an instrument of music, O God, my God.

chinese: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？為何在我裡面煩躁？應當仰望神，因我還要稱讚他。他是我臉上的光榮（原文是幫助），是我的　神。
english: Why are you crushed down, O my soul? and why are you troubled in me? put your hope in God, for I will again give him praise who is my help and my God.

chinese: （可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。）神啊，你在古時，我們列祖的日子所行的事，我們親耳聽見了；我們的列祖也給我們述說過。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah Maschil. - It has come to our ears, O God, our fathers have given us the story, of the works which you did in their days, in the old times,

chinese: 你曾用手趕出外邦人，卻栽培了我們列祖；你苦待列邦，卻叫我們列祖發達。
english: Uprooting the nations with your hand, and planting our fathers in their place; cutting down the nations, but increasing the growth of your people.

chinese: 因為他們不是靠自己的刀劍得地土，也不是靠自己的膀臂得勝，乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂，和你臉上的亮光，因為你喜悅他們。
english: For they did not make the land theirs by their swords, and it was not their arms which kept them safe; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you had pleasure in them.

chinese: 神啊，你是我的王；求你出令使雅各得勝。
english: You are my King and my God; ordering salvation for Jacob.

chinese: 我們靠你要推倒我們的敵人，靠你的名要踐踏那起來攻擊我們的人。
english: Through you will we overcome our haters; by your name will they be crushed under our feet who are violent against us.

chinese: 因為，我必不靠我的弓；我的刀也不能使我得勝。
english: I will not put faith in my bow, my sword will not be my salvation.

chinese: 惟你救了我們脫離敵人，使恨我們的人羞愧。
english: But it is you who have been our saviour from those who were against us, and have put to shame those who had hate for us.

chinese: 我們終日因神誇耀，還要永遠稱謝你的名。（細拉）
english: Our pride is in God at all times, to his name we give praise for ever. (Selah.)

chinese: 但如今你丟棄了我們，使我們受辱，不和我們的軍兵同去。
english: But now you have sent us away from you, and put us to shame; you do not go out with our armies.

chinese: 你使我們向敵人轉身退後；那恨我們的人任意搶奪。
english: Because of this we are turned back by the attacker: those who have hate for us take our goods for themselves.

chinese: 你使我們當作快要被吃的羊，把我們分散在列邦中。
english: You have made us like sheep which are taken for meat; we are put to flight among the nations.

chinese: 你賣了你的子民也不賺利，所得的價值並不加添你的資財。
english: You let your people go for nothing; your wealth is not increased by their price.

chinese: 你使我們受鄰國的羞辱，被四圍的人嗤笑譏刺。
english: You have made us to be looked down on by our neighbours, we are laughed at and shamed by those who are round about us.

chinese: 你使我們在列邦中作了笑談，使眾民向我們搖頭。
english: Our name is a word of shame among the nations, a sign for the shaking of heads among the peoples.

chinese: 我的凌辱終日在我面前，我臉上的羞愧將我遮蔽，
english: My downfall is ever before me, and I am covered with the shame of my face;

chinese: 都因那辱罵毀謗人的聲音，又因仇敵和報仇人的緣故。
english: Because of the voice of him who says sharp and bitter words; because of the hater and him who is the instrument of punishment.

chinese: 這都臨到我們身上，我們卻沒有忘記你，也沒有違背你的約。
english: All this has come on us, but still we have kept you in our memory; and we have not been false to your word.

chinese: 我們的心沒有退後；我們的腳也沒有偏離你的路。
english: Our hearts have not gone back, and our steps have not been turned out of your way;

chinese: 你在野狗之處壓傷我們，用死蔭遮蔽我們。
english: Though you have let us be crushed in the place of jackals, though we are covered with darkest shade.

chinese: 倘若我們忘了神的名，或向別神舉手，
english: If the name of our God has gone out of our minds, or if our hands have been stretched out to a strange god,

chinese: 神豈不鑒察這事麼？因為他曉得人心裡的隱秘。
english: Will not God make search for it? for he sees the secrets of the heart.

chinese: 我們為你的緣故終日被殺；人看我們如將宰的羊。
english: Truly, because of you we are put to death every day; we are numbered like sheep for destruction.

chinese: 主啊，求你睡醒，為何儘睡呢？求你興起，不要永遠丟棄我們！
english: Why are you sleeping, O Lord? awake! and come to our help, do not give us up for ever.

chinese: 你為何掩面，不顧我們所遭的苦難和所受的欺壓？
english: Why is your face covered, and why do you give no thought to our trouble and our cruel fate?

chinese: 我們的性命伏於塵土；我們的肚腹緊貼地面。
english: For our souls are crushed down to the dust: our bodies are stretched out on the earth.

chinese: 求你起來幫助我們！憑你的慈愛救贖我們！
english: Up! and come to our help, and give us salvation because of your mercy.

chinese: （可拉後裔的訓誨詩，又是愛慕歌，交與伶長。調用百合花。）我心裡湧出美辭；我論到我為王做的事，我的舌頭是快手筆。
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Shoshannim. Of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves. - My heart is flowing over with good things; my words are of that which I have made for a king; my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

chinese: 你比世人更美；在你嘴裡滿有恩惠；所以神賜福給你，直到永遠。
english: You are fairer than the children of men; grace is flowing through your lips; for this cause the blessing of God is with you for ever.

chinese: 大能者啊，願你腰間佩刀，大有榮耀和威嚴！
english: Put on your sword, make it ready at your side, O strong chief, with your glory and power.

chinese: 為真理、謙卑、公義赫然坐車前往，無不得勝；你的右手必顯明可畏的事。
english: And go nobly on in your power, because you are good and true and without pride; and your right hand will be teaching you things of fear.

chinese: 你的箭鋒快，射中王敵之心；萬民仆倒在你以下。
english: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's haters; because of them the peoples are falling under you.

chinese: 神啊，你的寶座是永永遠遠的；你的國權是正直的。
english: Your seat of power, O God, is for ever and ever; the rod of your kingdom is a rod of honour.

chinese: 你喜愛公義，恨惡罪惡；所以神─就是你的　神─用喜樂油膏你，勝過膏你的同伴。
english: You have been a lover of righteousness and a hater of evil: and so God, your God, has put the oil of joy on your head, lifting you high over all other kings.

chinese: 你的衣服都有沒藥、沉香、肉桂的香氣；象牙宮中有絲弦樂器的聲音使你歡喜。
english: Your robes are full of the smell of all sorts of perfumes and spices; music from the king's ivory houses has made you glad.

chinese: 有君王的女兒在你尊貴婦女之中；王后佩戴俄斐金飾站在你右邊。
english: Kings' daughters are among your noble women: on your right is the queen in gold of Ophir.

chinese: 女子啊，你要聽，要想，要側耳而聽！不要記念你的民和你的父家，
english: O daughter, give thought and attention, and let your ear be open; no longer keep in mind your people, and your father's house;

chinese: 王就羨慕你的美貌；因為他是你的主，你當敬拜他。
