english: So will the king have a great desire for you, seeing how beautiful you are; because he is your lord, give him honour.

chinese: 推羅的民（原文是女子）必來送禮；民中的富足人也必向你求恩。
english: And the daughters of Tyre will be there with an offering; those who have wealth among the people will be looking for your approval.

chinese: 王女在宮裡極其榮華；他的衣服是用金線繡的。
english: In the great house the king's daughter is all shining: her clothing is worked with gold.

chinese: 他要穿錦繡的衣服，被引到王前；隨從他的陪伴童女也要被帶到你面前。
english: She will come before the king in robes of needlework; the virgins in her train will come before you.

chinese: 他們要歡喜快樂被引導；他們要進入王宮。
english: With joy and rapture will they come; they will go into the king's house.

chinese: 你的子孫要接續你的列祖；你要立他們在全地作王。
english: Your children will take the place of your fathers; so that you may make them rulers over all the earth.

chinese: 我必叫你的名被萬代記念，所以萬民要永永遠遠稱謝你。
english: I will keep the memory of your name living through all generations; and because of this the people will give you praise for ever.

chinese: （可拉後裔的詩歌，交與伶長。調用女音。）神是我們的避難所，是我們的力量，是我們在患難中隨時的幫助。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah; put to Alamoth. A Song. - God is our harbour and our strength, a very present help in trouble.

chinese: 所以，地雖改變，山雖搖動到海心，
english: For this cause we will have no fear, even though the earth is changed, and though the mountains are moved in the heart of the sea;

chinese: 其中的水雖匉訇翻騰，山雖因海漲而戰抖，我們也不害怕。（細拉）
english: Though its waters are sounding and troubled, and though the mountains are shaking with their violent motion. (Selah.)

chinese: 有一道河，這河的分使　神的城歡喜；這城就是至高者居住的聖所。
english: There is a river whose streams make glad the resting-place of God, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

chinese: 神在其中，城必不動搖；到天一亮，神必幫助這城。
english: God has taken his place in her; she will not be moved: he will come to her help at the dawn of morning.

chinese: 外邦喧嚷，列國動搖；神發聲，地便鎔化。
english: The nations were angry, the kingdoms were moved; at the sound of his voice the earth became like wax.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在；雅各的神是我們的避難所！（細拉）
english: The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)

chinese: 你們來看耶和華的作為，看他使地怎樣荒涼。
english: Come, see the works of the Lord, the destruction which he has made in the earth.

chinese: 他止息刀兵，直到地極；他折弓、斷槍，把戰車焚燒在火中。
english: He puts an end to wars over all the earth; by him the bow is broken, and the spear cut in two, and the carriage burned in the fire.

chinese: 你們要休息，要知道我是神！我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。
english: Be at peace in the knowledge that I am God: I will be lifted up among the nations, I will be honoured through all the earth.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在；雅各的神是我們的避難所！
english: The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)

chinese: （可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。）萬民哪，你們都要拍掌！要用誇勝的聲音向神呼喊！
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah. - O make a glad noise with your hands, all you peoples; letting your voices go up to God with joy.

chinese: 因為耶和華至高者是可畏的；他是治理全地的大君王。
english: For the Lord Most High is to be feared; he is a great King over all the earth.

chinese: 他叫萬民服在我們以下，又叫列邦服在我們腳下。
english: He will put down the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.

chinese: 他為我們選擇產業，就是他所愛之雅各的榮耀。（細拉）
english: He will give us our heritage, the glory of Jacob who is dear to him. (Selah.)

chinese: 神上升，有喊聲相送；耶和華上升，有角聲相送。
english: God has gone up with a glad cry, the Lord with the sound of the horn.

chinese: 你們要向神歌頌，歌頌！向我們王歌頌，歌頌！
english: Give praises to God, make songs of praise; give praises to our King, make songs of praise.

chinese: 因為神是全地的王；你們要用悟性歌頌。
english: For God is the King of all the earth; make songs of praise with knowledge.

chinese: 神作王治理萬國；神坐在他的聖寶座上。
english: God is the ruler over the nations; God is on the high seat of his holy rule.

chinese: 列邦的君王聚集要作亞伯拉罕之神的民。因為世界的盾牌是屬　神的；他為至高！
english: The rulers of the peoples have come together, with the people of the God of Abraham; because the powers of the earth are God's: he is lifted up on high.

chinese: （可拉後裔的詩歌。）耶和華本為大！在我們神的城中，在他的聖山上，該受大讚美。
english: - A Song. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah. - Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised, in the town of our God, in his holy mountain.

chinese: 錫安山─大君王的城，在北面居高華美，為全地所喜悅。
english: Beautiful in its high position, the joy of all the earth, is the mountain of Zion, the mountain of God, the town of the great King.

chinese: 神在其宮中，自顯為避難所。
english: In its buildings God is seen to be a high tower.

chinese: 看哪，眾王會合，一同經過。
english: For see! the kings came together by agreement, they were joined together.

chinese: 他們見了這城就驚奇喪膽，急忙逃跑。
english: They saw it, and so were full of wonder; they were troubled, and went quickly away in fear.

chinese: 他們在那裡被戰兢疼痛抓住，好像產難的婦人一樣。
english: Shaking came on them and pain, as on a woman in childbirth.

chinese: 神啊，你用東風打破他施的船隻。
english: By you the ships of Tarshish are broken as by an east wind.

chinese: 我們在萬軍之耶和華的城中─就是我們神的城中─所看見的，正如我們所聽見的。　神必堅立這城，直到永遠。（細拉）
english: As it came to our ears so have we seen it, in the town of the Lord of armies, in the town of our God; God will keep it fixed for ever. (Selah.)

chinese: 神啊，我們在你的殿中想念你的慈愛。
english: Our thoughts were of your mercy, O God, while we were in your Temple.

chinese: 神啊，你受的讚美正與你的名相稱，直到地極！你的右手滿了公義。
english: As your name is, O God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth; your right hand is full of righteousness.

chinese: 因你的判斷，錫安山應當歡喜，猶大的城邑（原文是女子）應當快樂。
english: Let there be joy in the mountain of Zion, and let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of your wise decisions.

chinese: 你們當周遊錫安，四圍旋繞，數點城樓，
english: Make your way about Zion, and go round it, numbering its towers.

chinese: 細看他的外郭，察看他的宮殿，為要傳說到後代。
english: Take note of its strong walls, looking well at its fair buildings; so that you may give word of it to the generation which comes after.

chinese: 因為這神永永遠遠為我們的　神；他必作我們引路的，直到死時。
english: Because this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide.

chinese: （可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。）萬民哪，你們都當聽這話！世上一切的居民，
english: - Alamoth. To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. - Give attention to this, all you peoples; let your ears be open, all you who are living in the world.

chinese: 無論上流下流，富足貧窮，都當留心聽！
english: High and low together, the poor, and those who have wealth.

chinese: 我口要說智慧的言語；我心要想通達的道理。
english: From my mouth will come words of wisdom; and in the thoughts of my heart will be knowledge.

chinese: 我要側耳聽比喻，用琴解謎語。
english: I will put my teaching into a story; I will make my dark sayings clear with music.

chinese: 在患難的日子，奸惡隨我腳跟，四面環繞我，我何必懼怕？
english: What cause have I for fear in the days of evil, when the evil-doing of those who are working for my downfall is round about me?

chinese: 那些倚仗財貨自誇錢財多的人，
english: Even of those whose faith is in their wealth, and whose hearts are lifted up because of their stores.

chinese: 一個也無法贖自己的弟兄，也不能替他將贖價給神，
english: Truly, no man may get back his soul for a price, or give to God the payment for himself;

chinese: 叫他長遠活著，不見朽壞；因為贖他生命的價值極貴，只可永遠罷休。
english: (Because it takes a great price to keep his soul from death, and man is not able to give it.)
So that he might have eternal life, and never see the underworld.

chinese: 他必見智慧人死，又見愚頑人和畜類人一同滅亡，將他們的財貨留給別人。
english: For he sees that wise men come to their end, and foolish persons of low behaviour come to destruction together, letting their wealth go to others.

chinese: 他們心裡思想：他們的家室必永存，住宅必留到萬代；他們以自己的名稱自己的地。
english: The place of the dead is their house for ever, and their resting-place through all generations; those who come after them give their names to their lands.

chinese: 但人居尊貴中不能長久，如同死亡的畜類一樣。
english: But man, like the animals, does not go on for ever; he comes to an end like the beasts.

chinese: 他們行的這道本為自己的愚昧；但他們以後的人還佩服他們的話語。（細拉）
english: This is the way of the foolish; their silver is for those who come after them, and their children get the pleasure of their gold. (Selah.)

chinese: 他們如同羊群派定下陰間；死亡必作他們的牧者。到了早晨，正直人必管轄他們；他們的美容必被陰間所滅，以致無處可存。
english: Death will give them their food like sheep; the underworld is their fate and they will go down into it; their flesh is food for worms; their form is wasted away; the underworld is their resting-place for ever.

chinese: 只是神必救贖我的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄，因他必收納我。（細拉）
english: But God will get back my soul; for he will take me from the power of death. (Selah.)

chinese: 見人發財、家室增榮的時候，你不要懼怕；
english: Have no fear when wealth comes to a man, and the glory of his house is increased;

chinese: 因為，他死的時候甚麼也不能帶去；他的榮耀不能隨他下去。
english: For at his death, he will take nothing away; his glory will not go down after him.

chinese: 他活著的時候，雖然自誇為有福（你若利己，人必誇獎你）；
english: Though he might have pride in his soul in his life-time, and men will give you praise if you do well for yourself,

chinese: 他仍必歸到他歷代的祖宗那裡，永不見光。
english: He will go to the generation of his fathers; he will not see the light again.

chinese: 人在尊貴中而不醒悟，就如死亡的畜類一樣。
english: Man, like the animals, does not go on for ever; he comes to an end like the beasts.

chinese: （亞薩的詩。）大能者神─耶和華已經發言招呼天下，從日出之地到日落之處。
english: - A Psalm. Of Asaph. - The God of gods, even the Lord, has sent out his voice, and the earth is full of fear; from the coming up of the sun to its going down.

chinese: 從全美的錫安中，神已經發光了。
english: From Zion, most beautiful of places, God has sent out his light.

chinese: 我們的神要來，決不閉口。有烈火在他面前吞滅；有暴風在他四圍大颳。
english: Our God will come, and will not keep quiet; with fire burning before him, and storm-winds round him.

chinese: 他招呼上天下地，為要審判他的民，
english: His voice will go out to the heavens and to the earth, for the judging of his people:

chinese: 說：招聚我的聖民到我這裡來，就是那些用祭物與我立約的人。
english: Let my saints come together to me; those who have made an agreement with me by offerings.

chinese: 諸天必表明他的公義，因為神是施行審判的。（細拉）
english: And let the heavens make clear his righteousness; for God himself is the judge. (Selah.)

chinese: 我的民哪，你們當聽我的話！以色列啊，我要勸戒你；我是神，是你的　神！
english: Give ear, O my people, to my words; O Israel, I will be a witness against you; I am God, even your God.

chinese: 我並不因你的祭物責備你；你的燔祭常在我面前。
english: I will not take up a cause against you because of your offerings, or because of your burned offerings, which are ever before me.

chinese: 我不從你家中取公牛，也不從你圈內取山羊；
english: I will take no ox out of your house, or he-goats from your flocks;

chinese: 因為，樹林中的百獸是我的，千山上的牲畜也是我的。
english: For every beast of the woodland is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.

chinese: 山中的飛鳥，我都知道；野地的走獸也都屬我。
english: I see all the birds of the mountains, and the beasts of the field are mine.

chinese: 我若是飢餓，我不用告訴你，因為世界和其中所充滿的都是我的。
english: If I had need of food, I would not give you word of it; for the earth is mine and all its wealth.

chinese: 我豈吃公牛的肉呢？我豈喝山羊的血呢？
english: Am I to take the flesh of the ox for my food, or the blood of goats for my drink?

chinese: 你們要以感謝為祭獻與神，又要向至高者還你的願，
english: Make an offering of praise to God; keep the agreements which you have made with the Most High;

chinese: 並要在患難之日求告我；我必搭救你，你也要榮耀我。
english: Let your voice come up to me in the day of trouble; I will be your saviour, so that you may give glory to me.

chinese: 但神對惡人說：你怎敢傳說我的律例，口中提到我的約呢？
english: But to the sinner, God says, What are you doing, talking of my laws, or taking the words of my agreement in your mouth?

chinese: 其實你恨惡管教，將我的言語丟在背後。
english: Seeing that you have no desire for my teaching, turning your back on my words.

chinese: 你見了盜賊就樂意與他同夥，又與行姦淫的人一同有分。
english: When you saw a thief, you were in agreement with him, and you were joined with those who took other men's wives.

chinese: 你口任說惡言；你舌編造詭詐。
english: You have given your mouth to evil, your tongue to words of deceit.

chinese: 你坐著毀謗你的兄弟，讒毀你親母的兒子。
english: You say evil of your brother; you make false statements against your mother's son.

chinese: 你行了這些事，我還閉口不言，你想我恰和你一樣；其實我要責備你，將這些事擺在你眼前。
english: These things have you done, and I said nothing; it seemed to you that I was such a one as yourself; but I will make a protest against you, and put them in order before your eyes.

chinese: 你們忘記神的，要思想這事，免得我把你們撕碎，無人搭救。
english: Now keep this in mind, you who have no memory of God, for fear that you may be crushed under my hand, with no one to give you help:

chinese: 凡以感謝獻上為祭的便是榮耀我；那按正路而行的，我必使他得著我的救恩。
english: Whoever makes an offering of praise gives glory to me; and to him who is upright in his ways I will make clear the salvation of God.

chinese: （大衛與拔示巴同室以後，先知拿單來見他；他作這詩，交與伶長。）神啊，求你按你的慈愛憐恤我！按你豐盛的慈悲塗抹我的過犯！
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba. - Have pity on me, O God, in your mercy; out of a full heart, take away my sin.

chinese: 求你將我的罪孽洗除淨盡，並潔除我的罪！
english: Let all my wrongdoing be washed away, and make me clean from evil.

chinese: 因為，我知道我的過犯；我的罪常在我面前。
english: For I am conscious of my error; my sin is ever before me.

chinese: 我向你犯罪，惟獨得罪了你；在你眼前行了這惡，以致你責備我的時候顯為公義，判斷我的時候顯為清正。
english: Against you, you only, have I done wrong, working that which is evil in your eyes; so that your words may be seen to be right, and you may be clear when you are judging.

chinese: 我是在罪孽裡生的，在我母親懷胎的時候就有了罪。
english: Truly, I was formed in evil, and in sin did my mother give me birth.

chinese: 你所喜愛的是內裡誠實；你在我隱密處，必使我得智慧。
english: Your desire is for what is true in the inner parts: in the secrets of my soul you will give me knowledge of wisdom.

chinese: 求你用牛膝草潔淨我，我就乾淨；求你洗滌我，我就比雪更白。
english: Make me free from sin with hyssop: let me be washed whiter than snow.

chinese: 求你使我得聽歡喜快樂的聲音，使你所壓傷的骨頭可以踴躍。
english: Make me full of joy and rapture; so that the bones which have been broken may be glad.

chinese: 求你掩面不看我的罪，塗抹我一切的罪孽。
english: Let your face be turned from my wrongdoing, and take away all my sins.

chinese: 神啊，求你為我造清潔的心，使我裡面重新有正直（或譯：堅定）的靈。
english: Make a clean heart in me, O God; give me a right spirit again.

chinese: 不要丟棄我，使我離開你的面；不要從我收回你的聖靈。
english: Do not put me away from before you, or take your holy spirit from me.

chinese: 求你使我仍得救恩之樂，賜我樂意的靈扶持我，
english: Give me back the joy of your salvation; let a free spirit be my support.

chinese: 我就把你的道指教有過犯的人，罪人必歸順你。
english: Then will I make your ways clear to wrongdoers; and sinners will be turned to you.

chinese: 神啊，你是拯救我的神；求你救我脫離流人血的罪！我的舌頭就高聲歌唱你的公義。
english: Be my saviour from violent death, O God, the God of my salvation; and my tongue will give praise to your righteousness.

chinese: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇張開，我的口便傳揚讚美你的話！
english: O Lord, let my lips be open, so that my mouth may make clear your praise.

chinese: 你本不喜愛祭物，若喜愛，我就獻上；燔祭，你也不喜悅。
english: You have no desire for an offering or I would give it; you have no delight in burned offerings.

chinese: 神所要的祭就是憂傷的靈；神啊，憂傷痛悔的心，你必不輕看。
english: The offerings of God are a broken spirit; a broken and sorrowing heart, O God, you will not put from you.

chinese: 求你隨你的美意善待錫安，建造耶路撒冷的城牆。
english: Do good to Zion in your good pleasure, building up the walls of Jerusalem.

chinese: 那時，你必喜愛公義的祭和燔祭並全牲的燔祭；那時，人必將公牛獻在你壇上。
english: Then you will have delight in the offerings of righteousness, in burned offerings and offerings of beasts; then they will make offerings of oxen on your altar.

chinese: （以東人多益來告訴掃羅說：大衛到了亞希米勒家。那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。）勇士啊，你為何以作惡自誇？神的慈愛是常存的。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Maschil. Of David. When Doeg the Edomite came to Saul saying, David has come to the house of Ahimelech. - Why do you take pride in wrongdoing, lifting yourself up against the upright man all the day?

chinese: 你的舌頭邪惡詭詐，好像剃頭刀，快利傷人。
english: Purposing destruction, using deceit; your tongue is like a sharp blade.

chinese: 你愛惡勝似愛善，又愛說謊，不愛說公義。（細拉）
english: You have more love for evil than for good, for deceit than for works of righteousness. (Selah.)

chinese: 詭詐的舌頭啊，你愛說一切毀滅的話！
english: Destruction is in all your words, O false tongue.

chinese: 神也要毀滅你，直到永遠；他要把你拿去，從你的帳棚中抽出，從活人之地將你拔出。（細拉）
english: But God will put an end to you for ever; driving you out from your tent, uprooting you from the land of the living. (Selah.)

chinese: 義人要看見而懼怕，並要笑他，
english: The upright will see it with fear, and will say, laughing at you:

chinese: 說：看哪，這就是那不以神為他力量的人，只倚仗他豐富的財物，在邪惡上堅立自己。
english: See, this is the man who did not make God his strength, but had faith in his goods and his property, and made himself strong in his wealth.

chinese: 至於我，就像神殿中的青橄欖樹；我永永遠遠倚靠　神的慈愛。
english: But I am like a branching olive-tree in the house of God; I have put my faith in his mercy for ever and ever.

chinese: 我要稱謝你，直到永遠，因為你行了這事。我也要在你聖民面前仰望你的名；這名本為美好。
english: I will give you praise without end for what you have done; I will give honour to your name before your saints, for it is good.

chinese: （大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉。）愚頑人心裡說：沒有神。他們都是邪惡，行了可憎惡的罪孽；沒有一個人行善。
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Mahalath. Maschil. Of David. - The foolish man has said in his heart, God will not do anything. They are unclean, they have done evil works; there is not one who does good.

chinese: 神從天上垂看世人，要看有明白的沒有？有尋求他的沒有？
english: God was looking down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who had wisdom, searching after God.

chinese: 他們各人都退後，一同變為污穢；並沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
english: Every one of them has gone back; they are unclean: there is not one who does good, no, not one.

chinese: 作孽的沒有知識麼？他們吞吃我的百姓如同吃飯一樣，並不求告神。
english: Have the workers of evil no knowledge? they take my people for food, as they would take bread; they make no prayer to God.

chinese: 他們在無可懼怕之處就大大害怕，因為神把那安營攻擊你之人的骨頭散開了。你使他們蒙羞，因為　神棄絕了他們。
english: They were in great fear, where there was no cause for fear: for the bones of those who make war on you have been broken by God; you have put them to shame, because God has no desire for them.

chinese: 但願以色列的救恩從錫安而出。神救回他被擄的子民那時，雅各要快樂，以色列要歡喜。
english: May the salvation of Israel come out of Zion! When the fate of his people is changed by God, Jacob will have joy, and Israel will be glad.

chinese: （西弗人來對掃羅說：大衛豈不是在我們那裡藏身麼？那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）神啊，求你以你的名救我，憑你的大能為我伸冤。
english: - To the chief music-maker; on Neginoth. Maschil. Of David. When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Is not David keeping himself secret among us? - Let your name be my salvation, O God; let my cause be judged by your strength.

chinese: 神啊，求你聽我的禱告，留心聽我口中的言語。
english: Let my prayer come before you, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

chinese: 因為，外人起來攻擊我，強暴人尋索我的命；他們眼中沒有神。（細拉）
english: For men who are going after me have come out against me, violent men are purposing to take my soul; they have not put God before their eyes. (Selah.)

chinese: 神是幫助我的，是扶持我命的。
english: See, God is my helper: the Lord is the great supporter of my soul.

chinese: 他要報應我仇敵所行的惡；求你憑你的誠實滅絕他們。
english: Let the evil works of my haters come back on them again; let them be cut off by your good faith.

chinese: 我要把甘心祭獻給你。耶和華啊，我要稱讚你的名；這名本為美好。
english: Freely will I make my offerings to you; I will give praise to your name, O Lord, for it is good.

chinese: 他從一切的急難中把我救出來；我的眼睛也看見了我仇敵遭報。
english: Because it has been my saviour from all my trouble; and my eyes have seen the punishment of my haters.

chinese: （大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）神啊，求你留心聽我的禱告，不要隱藏不聽我的懇求！
english: - To the chief music-maker, on Neginoth. Maschil. Of David. - Give hearing to my prayer, O God; and let not your ear be shut against my request.

chinese: 求你側耳聽我，應允我。我哀歎不安，發聲唉哼，
english: Give thought to me, and let my prayer be answered: I have been made low in sorrow;

chinese: 都因仇敵的聲音，惡人的欺壓；因為他們將罪孽加在我身上，發怒氣逼迫我。
english: I am troubled because of the voice of the cruel ones, because of the loud cry of the evil-doers; for they put a weight of evil on me, and they are cruel in their hate for me.

chinese: 我心在我裡面甚是疼痛；死的驚惶臨到我身。
english: My heart is deeply wounded, and the fear of death has come on me.

chinese: 恐懼戰兢歸到我身；驚恐漫過了我。
english: Fear and shaking have come over me, with deep fear I am covered.

chinese: 我說：但願我有翅膀像鴿子，我就飛去，得享安息。
english: And I said, If only I had wings like a dove! for then I would go in flight from here and be at rest.

chinese: 我必遠遊，宿在曠野。（細拉）
english: I would go wandering far away, living in the waste land. (Selah.)

chinese: 我必速速逃到避所，脫離狂風暴雨。
english: I would quickly take cover from the driving storm and from the violent wind.

chinese: 主啊，求你吞滅他們，變亂他們的舌頭！因為我在城中見了強暴爭競的事。
english: Send destruction on them, O Lord, make a division of tongues among them: for I have seen fighting and violent acts in the town.

chinese: 他們在城牆上晝夜繞行；在城內也有罪孽和奸惡。
english: By day and night they go round the town, on the walls; trouble and sorrow are in the heart of it.

chinese: 邪惡在其中；欺壓和詭詐不離街市。
english: Evil is there; cruel rule and deceit are ever in the streets.

chinese: 原來不是仇敵辱罵我，若是仇敵，還可忍耐；也不是恨我的人向我狂大，若是恨我的人就必躲避他。
english: For it was not my hater who said evil of me; that would have been no grief to me; it was not one outside the number of my friends who made himself strong against me, or I would have kept myself from him in a secret place;

chinese: 不料是你；你原與我平等，是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！
english: But it was you, my equal, my guide, my well-loved friend.

chinese: 我們素常彼此談論，以為甘甜；我們與群眾在神的殿中同行。
english: We had loving talk together, and went to the house of God in company.

chinese: 願死亡忽然臨到他們！願他們活活地下入陰間！因為他們的住處，他們的心中，都是邪惡。
english: Let the hand of death come on them suddenly, and let them go down living into the underworld; because evil is in their houses and in their hearts.

chinese: 至於我，我要求告神；耶和華必拯救我。
english: As for me, I will make my prayer to God, and he will be my saviour.

chinese: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀聲悲歎；他也必聽我的聲音。
english: In the evening and in the morning and in the middle of the day I will make my prayer with sounds of grief; and my voice will come to his ears.

chinese: 他救贖我命脫離攻擊我的人，使我得享平安，因為與我相爭的人甚多。
english: He has taken my soul away from the attack which was made against me, and given it peace; for great numbers were against me.

chinese: 那沒有更變、不敬畏神的人，從太古常存的　神必聽見而苦待他。
english: God will give thought to me; he who from early times is strong will send pain and trouble on them. (Selah.) Because they are unchanged, they have no fear of God.

chinese: 他背了約，伸手攻擊與他和好的人。
english: He has put out his hand against those who were at peace with him; he has not kept his agreement.

chinese: 他的口如奶油光滑，他的心卻懷著爭戰；他的話比油柔和，其實是拔出來的刀。
english: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart; his words were softer than oil, but they were sharp swords.

chinese: 你要把你的重擔卸給耶和華，他必撫養你；他永不叫義人動搖。
english: Put your cares on the Lord, and he will be your support; he will not let the upright man be moved.

chinese: 神啊，你必使惡人下入滅亡的坑；流人血、行詭詐的人必活不到半世，但我要倚靠你。
english: But you, O God, will send them down into the underworld; the cruel and the false will be cut off before half their days are ended; but I will have faith in you.

chinese: （非利士人在迦特拿住大衛。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用遠方無聲鴿。）神啊，求你憐憫我，因為人要把我吞了，終日攻擊欺壓我。
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Jonath elem rehokim. Of David. Michtam. When the Philistines took him in Gath. - Have mercy on me, O God, for man is attempting my destruction; every day he makes cruel attacks against me.

chinese: 我的仇敵終日要把我吞了，因逞驕傲攻擊我的人甚多。
english: My haters are ever ready to put an end to me; great numbers are lifting themselves up against me.

chinese: 我懼怕的時候要倚靠你。
english: In the time of my fear, I will have faith in you.

chinese: 我倚靠神，我要讚美他的話；我倚靠　神，必不懼怕。血氣之輩能把我怎麼樣呢？
english: In God will I give praise to his word; in God have I put my hope; I will have no fear of what flesh may do to me.

chinese: 他們終日顛倒我的話；他們一切的心思都是要害我。
english: Every day they make wrong use of my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.

chinese: 他們聚集，埋伏窺探我的腳蹤，等候要害我的命。
english: They come together, they are waiting in secret places, they take note of my steps, they are waiting for my soul.

chinese: 他們豈能因罪孽逃脫麼？神啊，求你在怒中使眾民墮落！
english: By evil-doing they will not get free from punishment. In wrath, O God, let the peoples be made low.

chinese: 我幾次流離，你都記數；求你把我眼淚裝在你的皮袋裡。這不都記在你冊子上麼？
english: You have seen my wanderings; put the drops from my eyes into your bottle; are they not in your record?

chinese: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敵都要轉身退後。神幫助我，這是我所知道的。
english: When I send up my cry to you, my haters will be turned back; I am certain of this, for God is with me.

chinese: 我倚靠神，我要讚美他的話我倚靠耶和華，我要讚美他的話。
english: In God will I give praise to his word; in the Lord will I give praise to his word.

chinese: 我倚靠神，必不懼怕。人能把我怎麼樣呢？
english: In God have I put my hope, I will have no fear of what man may do to me.

chinese: 神啊，我向你所許的願在我身上；我要將感謝祭獻給你。
english: I keep the memory of my debt to you, O God; I will give you the offerings of praise.

chinese: 因為你救我的命脫離死亡。你豈不是救護我的腳不跌倒、使我在生命光中行在神面前麼？
english: Because you have taken my soul from the power of death; and kept my feet from falling, so that I may be walking before God in the light of life.

chinese: （大衛逃避掃羅，藏在洞裡。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。）神啊，求你憐憫我，憐憫我！因為我的心投靠你。我要投靠在你翅膀的蔭下，等到災害過去。
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. Michtam. Of David. When he went in flight from Saul, in the hole of the rock. - Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me; for the hope of my soul is in you: I will keep myself safely under the shade of your wings, till these troubles are past.

chinese: 我要求告至高的神，就是為我成全諸事的　神。
english: I will send up my cry to the Most High God; to God who does all things for me.

chinese: 那要吞我的人辱罵我的時候，神從天上必施恩救我，也必向我發出慈愛和誠實。
english: He will send from heaven, and take me from the power of him whose desire is for my destruction. God will send out his mercy and his good faith.

chinese: 我的性命在獅子中間；我躺臥在性如烈火的世人當中。他們的牙齒是槍、箭；他們的舌頭是快刀。
english: My soul is among lions; I am stretched out among those who are on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and whose tongue is a sharp sword.

chinese: 神啊，願你崇高過於諸天！願你的榮耀高過全地！
english: O God, be lifted up higher than the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

chinese: 他們為我的腳設下網羅，壓制我的心；他們在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。（細拉）
english: They have made ready a net for my steps; my soul is bent down; they have made a great hole before me, and have gone down into it themselves. (Selah.)

chinese: 神啊，我心堅定，我心堅定；我要唱詩，我要歌頌！
english: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; I will make songs, and give praise.

chinese: 我的靈（原文是榮耀）啊，你當醒起！琴瑟啊，你們當醒起！我自己要極早醒起！
english: You are my glory; let the instruments of music be awake; I myself will be awake with the dawn.

chinese: 主啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你，在列邦中歌頌你！
english: I will give you praise, O Lord, among the peoples; I will make songs to you among the nations.

chinese: 因為，你的慈愛高及諸天；你的誠實達到穹蒼。
english: For your mercy is great, stretching up to the heavens, and your righteousness goes up to the clouds.

chinese: 神啊，願你崇高過於諸天！願你的榮耀高過全地！
english: Be lifted up, O God, higher than the heavens, let your glory be over all the earth.

chinese: （大衛的金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。）世人哪，你們默然不語，真合公義麼？施行審判，豈按正直麼？
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. Michtam. Of David. - Is there righteousness in your mouths, O you gods? are you upright judges, O you sons of men?

chinese: 不然！你們是心中作惡；你們在地上秤出你們手所行的強暴。
english: The purposes of your hearts are evil; your hands are full of cruel doings on the earth.

chinese: 惡人一出母胎就與神疏遠，一離母腹便走錯路，說謊話。
english: The evil-doers are strange from the first; from the hour of their birth they go out of the true way, saying false words.

chinese: 他們的毒氣好像蛇的毒氣；他們好像塞耳的聾虺，
english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; they are like the adder, whose ears are shut;

chinese: 不聽行法術的聲音，雖用極靈的咒語也是不聽。
english: Who will not be moved by the voice of the wonder-worker, however great are his powers.

chinese: 神啊，求你敲碎他們口中的牙；耶和華啊，求你敲掉少壯獅子的大牙！
english: O God, let their teeth be broken in their mouths; let the great teeth of the young lions be pulled out, O Lord.

chinese: 願他們消滅，如急流的水一般；他們瞅準射箭的時候，願箭頭彷彿砍斷。
english: Let them be turned to liquid like the ever-flowing waters; let them be cut off like the grass by the way.

chinese: 願他們像蝸牛消化過去，又像婦人墜落未見天日的胎。
english: Let them be like an after-birth which is turned to water and comes to an end; like the fruit of a woman who gives birth before her time, let them not see the sun.

chinese: 你們用荊棘燒火，鍋還未熱，他要用旋風把青的和燒著的一齊颳去。
english: Before they are conscious of it, let them be cut down like thorns; let a strong wind take them away like waste growth.

chinese: 義人見仇敵遭報就歡喜，要在惡人的血中洗腳。
english: The upright man will be glad when he sees their punishment; his feet will be washed in the blood of the evil-doer.

chinese: 因此，人必說：義人誠然有善報；在地上果有施行判斷的神！
english: So that men will say, Truly there is a reward for righteousness; truly there is a God who is judge on the earth.

chinese: （掃羅打發人窺探大衛的房屋，要殺他。那時，大衛用這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。）我的神啊，求你救我脫離仇敵，把我安置在高處，得脫那些起來攻擊我的人。
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to At-tashheth. Michtam. Of David. When Saul sent, and they were watching the house, to put him to death. - Take me out of the hands of the cruel ones, O my God; keep me safe from those who come up against me.

chinese: 求你救我脫離作孽的人和喜愛流人血的人！
english: Take me out of the power of the workers of evil, and keep me safe from the men of blood.

chinese: 因為，他們埋伏要害我的命；有能力的人聚集來攻擊我。耶和華啊，這不是為我的過犯，也不是為我的罪愆。
english: For see, they are watching in secret for my soul; the strong have come together against me? but not because of my sin, or my evil-doing, O Lord.

chinese: 我雖然無過，他們預備整齊，跑來攻擊我。求你興起鑒察，幫助我！
english: For no sin of mine they go quickly and get themselves ready; be awake and come to my help, and see.

chinese: 萬軍之神─耶和華以色列的　神啊！求你興起，懲治萬邦！不要憐憫行詭詐的惡人！（細拉）
english: You, O Lord God of armies, are the God of Israel; come now and give punishment to the nations; have no mercy on any workers of deceit. (Selah.)

chinese: 他們晚上轉回，叫號如狗，圍城繞行。
english: They come back in the evening; they make a noise like a dog, and go round the town.

chinese: 他們口中噴吐惡言，嘴裡有刀；他們說：有誰聽見？
english: See, hate is dropping from their lips; curses are on their tongues: they say, Who gives attention to it?

chinese: 但你─耶和華必笑話他們；你要嗤笑萬邦。
english: But you are laughing at them, O Lord; you will make sport of all the nations.

chinese: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你，因為神是我的高臺。
english: O my strength, I will put my hope in you; because God is my strong tower.

chinese: 我的神要以慈愛迎接我；　神要叫我看見我仇敵遭報。
english: The God of my mercy will go before me: God will let me see my desire effected on my haters.

chinese: 不要殺他們，恐怕我的民忘記。主啊，你是我們的盾牌；求你用你的能力使他們四散，且降為卑。
english: Put them not to death, for so my people will keep the memory of them: let them be sent in all directions by your power; make them low, O Lord our saviour.

chinese: 他們口中的罪和嘴裡的言語，並咒罵虛謊的話，願他們在驕傲之中被纏住了。
english: Because of the sin of their mouths and the word of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride; and for their curses and their deceit,

chinese: 求你發怒，使他們消滅，以致歸於無有，叫他們知道神在雅各中間掌權，直到地極。（細拉）
english: Put an end to them in your wrath, put an end to them, so that they may not be seen again; let them see that God is ruling in Jacob and to the ends of the earth. (Selah.)

chinese: 到了晚上，任憑他們轉回；任憑他們叫號如狗，圍城繞行。
english: And in the evening let them come back, and make a noise like a dog, and go round the town.

chinese: 他們必走來走去，尋找食物，若不得飽就終夜在外。
english: Let them go wandering up and down in search of food, and be there all night if they have not enough.

chinese: 但我要歌頌你的力量，早晨要高唱你的慈愛；因為你作過我的高臺，在我急難的日子作過我的避難所。
english: But I will make songs of your power; yes, I will give cries of joy for your mercy in the morning; because you have been my strength and my high tower in the day of my trouble.

chinese: 我的力量啊，我要歌頌你；因為神是我的高臺，是賜恩與我的　神。
english: To you, O my strength, will I make my song: because God is my high tower, even the God of my mercy.

chinese: （大衛與兩河間的亞蘭並瑣巴的亞蘭爭戰的時候，約押轉回，在鹽谷攻擊以東，殺了一萬二千人。那時，大衛作這金詩叫人學習，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。）神啊，你丟棄了我們，使我們破敗；你向我們發怒，求你使我們復興！
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Shushan-eduth. Michtam. Of David. For teaching. When he was fighting against Aram-naharaim and Aramzobah, when Joab came back, and put twelve thousand of the Edomites to death, in the Valley of Salt. - God, you have put us away from you, you have sent us in all directions, you have been angry; O be turned to us again.

chinese: 你使地震動，而且崩裂；求你將裂口醫好，因為地搖動。
english: By the power of your hand the earth is shaking and broken; make it strong again, for it is moved.

chinese: 你叫你的民遇見艱難；你叫我們喝那使人東倒西歪的酒。
english: You have made the people see hard times; you have given us the wine of shaking for our drink.

chinese: 你把旌旗賜給敬畏你的人，可以為真理揚起來。（細拉）
english: Give a safe place to those who have fear of you, where they may go in flight from before the bow. (Selah.)

chinese: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們，好叫你所親愛的人得救。
english: So that your loved ones may be made safe, let your right hand be my salvation, and give me an answer.

chinese: 神已經指著他的聖潔說（說：或譯應許我）：我要歡樂；我要分開示劍，丈量疏割谷。
english: God has said in his holy place, I will be glad: I will make a division of Shechem, and the valley of Succoth will be measured out.

chinese: 基列是我的，瑪拿西也是我的。以法蓮是護衛我頭的；猶大是我的杖。
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; and Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;

chinese: 摩押是我的沐浴盆；我要向以東拋鞋。非利士啊，你還能因我歡呼麼？
english: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I put out my shoe; over Philistia will a glad cry be sounded.

chinese: 誰能領我進堅固城？誰能引我到以東地？
english: Who will take me into the strong town? who will be my guide into Edom?

chinese: 神啊，你不是丟棄了我們麼？神啊，你不和我們的軍兵同去麼？
english: Have not you put us away, O God? and you have not gone out with our armies.

chinese: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人，因為人的幫助是枉然的。
english: Give us help in our trouble; for there is no help in man.

chinese: 我們倚靠神才得施展大能，因為踐踏我們敵人的就是他。
english: Through God we will do great things, for through him our haters will be crushed under our feet.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）神啊，求你聽我的呼求，側耳聽我的禱告！
english: - To the chief music-maker. On a corded instrument. Of David. - Let my cry come to you, O God; let your ears be open to my prayer.

chinese: 我心裡發昏的時候，我要從地極求告你。求你領我到那比我更高的磐石！
english: From the end of the earth will I send up my cry to you, when my heart is overcome: take me to the rock which is over-high for me.

chinese: 因為你作過我的避難所，作過我的堅固臺，脫離仇敵。
english: For you have been my secret place, and my high tower from those who made war on me.

chinese: 我要永遠住在你的帳幕裡！我要投靠在你翅膀下的隱密處！（細拉）
english: I will make your tent my resting-place for ever: I will keep myself under the cover of your wings. (Selah.)

chinese: 神啊，你原是聽了我所許的願；你將產業賜給敬畏你名的人。
english: For you, O God, have made answer to my prayers; you have given me the heritage of those who give honour to your name.

chinese: 你要加添王的壽數；他的年歲必存到世世。
english: You will give the king long life; and make his years go on through the generations.

chinese: 他必永遠坐在神面前；願你預備慈愛和誠實保佑他！
english: May the seat of his authority be before God for ever; may mercy and righteousness keep him safe.

chinese: 這樣，我要歌頌你的名，直到永遠，好天天還我所許的願。
english: So will I make songs in praise of your name for ever, giving to God that which is right day by day.

chinese: （大衛的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。）我的心默默無聲，專等候神；我的救恩是從他而來。
english: - To the chief music-maker. After Jeduthun. A Psalm. Of David. - My soul, put all your faith in God; for from him comes my salvation.

chinese: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救；他是我的高臺，我必不很動搖。
english: He only is my Rock and my salvation; he is my high tower; I will not be greatly moved.

chinese: 你們大家攻擊一人，把他毀壞，如同毀壞歪斜的牆、將倒的壁，要到幾時呢？
english: How long will you go on designing evil against a man? running against him as against a broken wall, which is on the point of falling?

chinese: 他們彼此商議，專要從他的尊位上把他推下；他們喜愛謊話，口雖祝福，心卻咒詛。（細拉）
english: Their only thought is to put him down from his place of honour; their delight is in deceit: blessing is in their mouths but cursing in their hearts. (Selah.)

chinese: 我的心哪，你當默默無聲，專等候神，因為我的盼望是從他而來。
english: My soul, put all your faith in God; for from him comes my hope.

chinese: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救；他是我的高臺，我必不動搖。
english: He only is my Rock and my salvation; he is my high tower; I will not be greatly moved.

chinese: 我的拯救、我的榮耀都在乎神；我力量的磐石、我的避難所都在乎　神。
english: In God is my salvation, and my glory; the Rock of my strength, and my safe place.

chinese: 你們眾民當時時倚靠他，在他面前傾心吐意；神是我們的避難所。（細拉）
english: Have faith in him at all times, you people; let your hearts go flowing out before him: God is our safe place. (Selah.)

chinese: 下流人真是虛空；上流人也是虛假；放在天平裡就必浮起；他們一共比空氣還輕。
english: Truly men of low birth are nothing, and men of high position are not what they seem; if they are put in the scales together they are less than a breath.

chinese: 不要仗勢欺人，也不要因搶奪而驕傲；若財寶加增，不要放在心上。
english: Have no faith in the rewards of evil-doing, or in profits wrongly made: if your wealth is increased, do not put your hopes on it.

chinese: 神說了一次、兩次，我都聽見：就是能力都屬乎神。
english: Once has God said, twice has it come to my ears, that power is God's:

chinese: 主啊，慈愛也是屬乎你，因為你照著各人所行的報應他。
english: And mercy, O Lord, is yours, for you give to every man the reward of his work.

chinese: （大衛在猶大曠野的時候，作了這詩。）神啊，你是我的神，我要切切地尋求你，在乾旱疲乏無水之地，我渴想你；我的心切慕你。
english: - A Psalm. Of David. When he was in the waste land of Judah. - O God, you are my God; early will I make my search for you: my soul is dry for need of you, my flesh is wasted with desire for you, as a dry and burning land where no water is;

chinese: 我在聖所中曾如此瞻仰你，為要見你的能力和你的榮耀。
english: To see your power and your glory, as I have seen you in the holy place.

chinese: 因你的慈愛比生命更好，我的嘴唇要頌讚你。
english: Because your mercy is better than life, my lips will give you praise.

chinese: 我還活的時候要這樣稱頌你；我要奉你的名舉手。
english: So will I go on blessing you all my life, lifting up my hands in your name.

chinese: 我在床上記念你，在夜更的時候思想你；我的心就像飽足了骨髓肥油，我也要以歡樂的嘴唇讚美你。
english: My soul will be comforted, as with good food; and my mouth will give you praise with songs of joy;

chinese: 合和譯本併入上一節
english: When the memory of you comes to me on my bed, and when I give thought to you in the night-time.

chinese: 因為你曾幫助我，我就在你翅膀的蔭下歡呼。
english: Because you have been my help, I will have joy in the shade of your wings.

chinese: 我心緊緊地跟隨你；你的右手扶持我。
english: My soul keeps ever near you: your right hand is my support.

chinese: 但那些尋索要滅我命的人必往地底下去；
english: But those whose desire is my soul's destruction will go down to the lower parts of the earth.

chinese: 他們必被刀劍所殺，被野狗所吃。
english: They will be cut off by the sword; they will be food for foxes.

chinese: 但是王必因神歡喜。凡指著他發誓的必要誇口，因為說謊之人的口必被塞住。
english: But the king will have joy in God; everyone who takes an oath by him will have cause for pride; but the false mouth will be stopped.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）神啊，我哀歎的時候，求你聽我的聲音！求你保護我的性命，不受仇敵的驚恐！
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - O God, let the voice of my grief come to your ear: keep my life from the fear of those who are against me.

chinese: 求你把我隱藏，使我脫離作惡之人的暗謀和作孽之人的擾亂。
english: Keep me safe from the secret purpose of wrongdoers; from the band of the workers of evil;

chinese: 他們磨舌如刀，發出苦毒的言語，好像比準了的箭，
english: Who make their tongues sharp like a sword, and whose arrows are pointed, even bitter words;

chinese: 要在暗地射完全人；他們忽然射他，並不懼怕。
english: So that in secret they may let loose their arrows at the upright, suddenly and unseen.

chinese: 他們彼此勉勵設下惡計；他們商量暗設網羅，說：誰能看見？
english: They make themselves strong in an evil purpose; they make holes for secret nets; they say, Who will see it,

chinese: 他們圖謀奸惡，說：我們是極力圖謀的。他們各人的意念心思是深的。
english: Or make discovery of our secret purpose? The design is framed with care; and the inner thought of a man, and his heart, is deep.

chinese: 但神要射他們；他們忽然被箭射傷。
english: But God sends out an arrow against them; suddenly they are wounded.

chinese: 他們必然絆跌，被自己的舌頭所害；凡看見他們的必都搖頭。
english: The evil of their tongues is the cause of their fall; all those who see them are shaking their heads at them.

chinese: 眾人都要害怕，要傳揚神的工作，並且明白他的作為。
english: And in fear men make public the works of God; and giving thought to his acts they get wisdom.

chinese: 義人必因耶和華歡喜，並要投靠他；凡心裡正直的人都要誇口。
english: The upright will be glad in the Lord and have hope in him; and all the lovers of righteousness will give him glory.

chinese: （大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。）神啊，錫安的人都等候讚美你；所許的願也要向你償還。
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. A Song. - It is right for you, O God, to have praise in Zion: to you let the offering be made.

chinese: 聽禱告的主啊，凡有血氣的都要來就你。
english: To you, O hearer of prayer, let the words of all flesh come.

chinese: 罪孽勝了我；至於我們的過犯，你都要赦免。
english: Evils have overcome us: but as for our sins, you will take them away.

chinese: 你所揀選、使他親近你、住在你院中的，這人便為有福！我們必因你居所、你聖殿的美福知足了。
english: Happy is the man of your selection, to whom you give a resting-place in your house; we will be full of the good things out of your holy place.

chinese: 拯救我們的神啊，你必以威嚴秉公義應允我們；你本是一切地極和海上遠處的人所倚靠的。
english: You will give us an answer in righteousness by great acts of power, O God of our salvation; you who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, and of the far-off lands of the sea;

chinese: 他既以大能束腰，就用力量安定諸山，
english: The God by whose strength the mountains are fixed; who is robed with power:

chinese: 使諸海的響聲和其中波浪的響聲，並萬民的喧嘩，都平靜了。
english: Who makes the loud voice of the sea quiet, and puts an end to the sound of its waves.

chinese: 住在地極的人因你的神蹟懼怕；你使日出日落之地都歡呼。
english: Those in the farthest parts of the earth have fear when they see your signs: the outgoings of the morning and evening are glad because of you.

chinese: 你眷顧地，降下透雨，使地大得肥美。神的河滿了水；你這樣澆灌了地，好為人預備五穀。
english: You have given your blessing to the earth, watering it and making it fertile; the river of God is full of water: and having made it ready, you give men grain.

chinese: 你澆透地的犁溝，潤平犁脊，降甘霖，使地軟和；其中發長的，蒙你賜福。
english: You make the ploughed lands full of water; you make smooth the slopes: you make the earth soft with showers, sending your blessing on its growth.

chinese: 你以恩典為年歲的冠冕；你的路徑都滴下脂油，
english: The year is crowned with the good you give; life-giving rain is dropping from your footsteps,

chinese: 滴在曠野的草場上。小山以歡樂束腰；
english: Falling on the grass of the waste land: and the little hills are glad on every side.

chinese: 草場以羊群為衣；谷中也長滿了五穀。這一切都歡呼歌唱。
english: The grass-land is thick with flocks; the valleys are full of grain; they give glad cries and songs of joy.

chinese: （一篇詩歌，交與伶長。）全地都當向神歡呼！
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Song. A Psalm. - Send up a glad cry to God, all the earth:

chinese: 歌頌他名的榮耀！用讚美的言語將他的榮耀發明！
english: Make a song in honour of his name: give praise and glory to him.

chinese: 當對神說：你的作為何等可畏！因你的大能，仇敵要投降你。
english: Say to God, How greatly to be feared are your works! because of your great power your haters are forced to put themselves under your feet.

chinese: 全地要敬拜你，歌頌你，要歌頌你的名。（細拉）
english: Let all the earth give you worship, and make songs to you; let them make songs to your name. (Selah.)

chinese: 你們來看神所行的，他向世人所做之事是可畏的。
english: Come and see the works of God: he is to be feared in all he does to the children of men.

chinese: 他將海變成乾地，眾民步行過河；我們在那裡因他歡喜。
english: The sea was turned into dry land: they went through the river on foot: there did we have joy in him.

chinese: 他用權能治理萬民，直到永遠。他的眼睛鑒察列邦；悖逆的人不可自高。（細拉）
english: He is ruling in power for ever; his eyes are watching the nations: may his haters have no strength against him. (Selah.)

chinese: 萬民哪，你們當稱頌我們的神，使人得聽讚美他的聲音。
english: Give blessings to our God, O you peoples, let the voice of his praise be loud;

chinese: 他使我們的性命存活，也不叫我們的腳搖動。
english: Because he gives us life, and has not let our feet be moved.

chinese: 神啊，你曾試驗我們，熬煉我們，如熬煉銀子一樣。
english: For you, O God, have put us to the test: testing us by fire like silver.

chinese: 你使我們進入網羅，把重擔放在我們的身上。
english: You let us be put in prison; chains were put on our legs.

chinese: 你使人坐車軋我們的頭；我們經過水火，你卻使我們到豐富之地。
english: You let men go driving over our heads; we went through fire and through water; but you took us out into a wide place.

chinese: 我要用燔祭進你的殿，向你還我的願，
english: I will come into your house with burned offerings, I will make payment of my debt to you,

chinese: 就是在急難時我嘴唇所發的、口中所許的。
english: Keeping the word which came from my lips, and which my mouth said, when I was in trouble.

chinese: 我要把肥牛作燔祭，將公羊的香祭獻給你，又把公牛和山羊獻上。（細拉）
english: I will give you burned offerings of fat beasts, and the smoke of sheep; I will make offerings of oxen and goats. (Selah.)

chinese: 凡敬畏神的人，你們都來聽！我要述說他為我所行的事。
english: Come, give ear to me, all you God-fearing men, so that I may make clear to you what he has done for my soul.

chinese: 我曾用口求告他；我的舌頭也稱他為高。
english: My voice went up to him, and I was lifted up from the underworld.

chinese: 我若心裡注重罪孽，主必不聽。
english: I said in my heart, The Lord will not give ear to me:

chinese: 但神實在聽見了；他側耳聽了我禱告的聲音。
english: But truly God's ear has been open; he has give attention to the voice of my prayer.

chinese: 神是應當稱頌的！他並沒有推卻我的禱告，也沒有叫他的慈愛離開我。
english: Praise be to God who has not taken away his good faith and his mercy from me.

chinese: （一篇詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）願神憐憫我們，賜福與我們，用臉光照我們，（細拉）
english: - To the chief music-maker. With corded instruments. A Psalm. A Song. - May God give us mercy and blessing, and let the light of his face be shining on us; (Selah.)

chinese: 好叫世界得知你的道路，萬國得知你的救恩。
english: So that men may see your way on the earth, and your salvation among all nations.

chinese: 神啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！
english: Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.

chinese: 願萬國都快樂歡呼；因為你必按公正審判萬民，引導世上的萬國。（細拉）
english: O let the nations be glad, and make song of joy; for you will be the judge of the peoples in righteousness, guiding the nations of the earth. (Selah.)

chinese: 神啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！
english: Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.

chinese: 地已經出了土產；神─就是我們的　神要賜福與我們。
english: The earth has given her increase; and God, even our God, will give us his blessing.

chinese: 神要賜福與我們；地的四極都要敬畏他！
english: God will give us his blessing; so let all the ends of the earth be in fear of him.

chinese: （大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。）願神興起，使他的仇敵四散，叫那恨他的人從他面前逃跑。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of David. A Psalm. A Song. - Let God be seen, and let his haters be put to flight; let those who are against him be turned back before him.

chinese: 他們被驅逐，如煙被風吹散；惡人見神之面而消滅，如蠟被火鎔化。
english: Let them be like smoke before the driving wind; as wax turning soft before the fire, so let them come to an end before the power of God.

chinese: 惟有義人必然歡喜，在神面前高興快樂。
english: But let the upright be glad; let them have delight before God; let them be full of joy.

chinese: 你們當向神唱詩，歌頌他的名；為那坐車行過曠野的修平大路。他的名是耶和華，要在他面前歡樂！
english: Make songs to God, make songs of praise to his name; make a way for him who comes through the waste lands; his name is Jah; be glad before him.

chinese: 神在他的聖所作孤兒的父，作寡婦的伸冤者。
english: A father to those who have no father, a judge of the widows, is God in his holy place.

chinese: 神叫孤獨的有家，使被囚的出來享福；惟有悖逆的住在乾燥之地。
english: Those who are without friends, God puts in families; he makes free those who are in chains; but those who are turned away from him are given a dry land.

chinese: 神啊，你曾在你百姓前頭出來，在曠野行走。（細拉）
english: O God, when you went out before your people, wandering through the waste land; (Selah.)

chinese: 那時，地見神的面而震動，天也落雨；西乃山見以色列　神的面也震動。
english: The earth was shaking and the heavens were streaming, because God was present; even Sinai itself was moved before God, the God of Israel.

chinese: 神啊，你降下大雨；你產業以色列疲乏的時候，你使他堅固。
english: You, O God, did freely send the rain, giving strength to the weariness of your heritage.

chinese: 你的會眾住在其中；神啊，你的恩惠是為困苦人預備的。
english: Those whose resting-place was there, even the poor, were comforted by your good things, O God.

chinese: 主發命令，傳好信息的婦女成了大群。
english: The Lord gives the word; great is the number of the women who make it public.

chinese: 統兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了；在家等候的婦女分受所奪的。
english: Kings of armies quickly go in flight: and the women in the houses make a division of their goods.

chinese: 你們安臥在羊圈的時候，好像鴿子的翅膀鍍白銀，翎毛鍍黃金一般。
english: Will you take your rest among the flocks? like the wings of a dove covered with silver, and its feathers with yellow gold.

chinese: 全能者在境內趕散列王的時候，勢如飄雪在撒們。
english: When the Most High put the kings to flight, it was as white as snow in Salmon.

chinese: 巴珊山是神的山；巴珊山是多峰多嶺的山。
english: A hill of God is the hill of Bashan; a hill with high tops is the hill of Bashan.

chinese: 你們多峰多嶺的山哪，為何斜看神所願居住的山？耶和華必住這山，直到永遠！
english: Why are you looking with envy, you high hills, on the hill desired by God as his resting-place? truly, God will make it his house for ever.

chinese: 神的車蔥詎萬盈千；主在其中，好像在西乃聖山一樣。
english: The war-carriage of God is among Israel's thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai to the holy place.

chinese: 你已經升上高天，擄掠仇敵；你在人間，就是在悖逆的人間，受了供獻，叫耶和華神可以與他們同住。
english: You have gone up on high, taking your prisoners with you; you have taken offerings from men; the Lord God has taken his place on the seat of his power.

chinese: 天天背負我們重擔的主，就是拯救我們的神，是應當稱頌的！（細拉）
english: Praise be to the Lord, who is our support day by day, even the God of our salvation. (Selah.)

chinese: 神是為我們施行諸般救恩的神；人能脫離死亡是在乎主耶和華。
english: Our God is for us a God of salvation; his are the ways out of death.

chinese: 但神要打破他仇敵的頭，就是那常犯罪之人的髮頂。
english: The heads of the haters of God will be crushed; even the head of him who still goes on in his evil ways.

chinese: 主說：我要使眾民從巴珊而歸，使他們從深海而回，
english: The Lord said, I will make them come back from Bashan, and from the deep parts of the sea;

chinese: 使你打碎仇敵，你的腳踹在血中，使你狗的舌頭從其中得分。
english: So that your foot may be red with blood, and the tongues of your dogs with the same.

chinese: 神啊，你是我的神，我的王；人已經看見你行走，進入聖所。
english: We see your going, O God: even the going of my God, my King, into the holy place.

chinese: 歌唱的行在前，作樂的隨在後，都在擊鼓的童女中間。
english: The makers of songs go before, the players of music come after, among the young girls playing on brass instruments.

chinese: 從以色列源頭而來的，當在各會中稱頌主神！
english: Give praise to God in the great meeting; even the Lord, you who come from the fountain of Israel.

chinese: 在那裡，有統管他們的小便雅憫，有猶大的首領和他們的群眾，有西布倫的首領，有拿弗他利的首領。
english: There is little Benjamin ruling them, the chiefs of Judah and their army, the rulers of Zebulun and the rulers of Naphtali.

chinese: 以色列的能力是神所賜的；　神啊，求你堅固你為我們所成全的事！
english: O God, send out your strength; the strength, O God, with which you have done great things for us,

chinese: 因你耶路撒冷的殿，列王必帶貢物獻給你。
english: Out of your Temple in Jerusalem.

chinese: 求你叱喝蘆葦中的野獸和群公牛，並列邦中的牛犢。把銀塊踹在腳下；神已經趕散好爭戰的列邦。
english: Say sharp words to the beast among the water-plants, the band of strong ones, with the lords of the peoples, put an end to the people whose delight is in war.

chinese: 埃及的公侯要出來朝見神；古實人要急忙舉手禱告。
english: Kings will give you offerings, they will come out of Egypt; from Pathros will come offerings of silver; Ethiopia will be stretching out her hands to God.

chinese: 世上的列國啊，你們要向神歌唱；願你們歌頌主！
english: Make songs to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O make songs of praise to the Lord; (Selah.)

chinese: 歌頌那自古駕行在諸天以上的主！他發出聲音，是極大的聲音。
english: To him who goes or the clouds of heaven, the heaven which was from earliest times; he sends out his voice of power.

chinese: 你們要將能力歸給神。他的威榮在以色列之上；他的能力是在穹蒼。
english: Make clear that strength is God's: he is lifted up over Israel, and his power is in the clouds.

chinese: 神啊，你從聖所顯為可畏；以色列的神是那將力量權能賜給他百姓的。神是應當稱頌的！
english: O God, you are to be feared in your holy place: the God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用百合花。）神啊，求你救我！因為眾水要淹沒我。
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Shoshannim. Of David. - Be my saviour, O God; because the waters have come in, even to my neck.

chinese: 我陷在深淤泥中，沒有立腳之地；我到了深水中，大水漫過我身。
english: My feet are deep in the soft earth, where there is no support; I have come into deep waters, the waves are flowing over me.

chinese: 我因呼求困乏，喉嚨發乾；我因等候神，眼睛失明。
english: I am tired with my crying; my throat is burning: my eyes are wasted with waiting for my God.

chinese: 無故恨我的，比我頭髮還多；無理與我為仇、要把我剪除的，甚為強盛。我沒有搶奪的，要叫我償還。
english: Those who have hate for me without cause are greater in number than the hairs of my head; those who are against me, falsely desiring my destruction, are very strong; I gave back what I had not taken away.

chinese: 神啊，我的愚昧，你原知道；我的罪愆不能隱瞞。
english: O God, you see how foolish I am; and my wrongdoing is clear to you.

chinese: 萬軍的主─耶和華啊，求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！以色列的神啊，求你叫那尋求你的，不要因我受辱！
english: Let not those who have hope in you be put to shame because of me, O Lord God of armies: let not those who are waiting for you be made low because of me, O God of Israel.

chinese: 因我為你的緣故受了辱罵，滿面羞愧。
english: I have been wounded with sharp words because of you; my face has been covered with shame.

chinese: 我的弟兄看我為外路人；我的同胞看我為外邦人。
english: I have become strange to my brothers, and like a man from a far country to my mother's children.

chinese: 因我為你的殿心裡焦急，如同火燒，並且辱罵你人的辱罵都落在我身上。
english: I am on fire with passion for your house; and the hard things which are said about you have come on me.

chinese: 我哭泣，以禁食刻苦我心；這倒算為我的羞辱。
english: My bitter weeping, and my going without food, were turned to my shame.

chinese: 我拿麻布當衣裳，就成了他們的笑談。
english: When I put on the clothing of grief, they said evil of me.

chinese: 坐在城門口的談論我；酒徒也以我為歌曲。
english: I am a cause of wonder to those in authority; a song to those who are given to strong drink.

chinese: 但我在悅納的時候向你─耶和華祈禱。神啊，求你按你豐盛的慈愛，憑你拯救的誠實應允我！
english: But as for me, let my prayer be made to you, O Lord, at a time when you are pleased; O God, give me an answer in your great mercy, for your salvation is certain.

chinese: 求你搭救我出離淤泥，不叫我陷在其中；求你使我脫離那些恨我的人，使我出離深水。
english: Take me from the grip of the sticky earth, so that I may not go down into it; let me be lifted up from the deep waters.

chinese: 求你不容大水漫過我，不容深淵吞滅我，不容坑坎在我以上合口。
english: Let me not be covered by the flowing waters; let not the deep waters go over my head, and let me not be shut up in the underworld.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你應允我！因為你的慈愛本為美好；求你按你豐盛的慈悲回轉眷顧我！
english: Give an answer to my words, O Lord; for your mercy is good: be turned to me, because of your great pity.

chinese: 不要掩面不顧你的僕人；我是在急難之中，求你速速地應允我！
english: Let not your face be covered from your servant, for I am in trouble; quickly give me an answer.

chinese: 求你親近我，救贖我！求你因我的仇敵把我贖回！
english: Come near to my soul, for its salvation: be my saviour, because of those who are against me.

chinese: 你知道我受的辱罵、欺凌、羞辱；我的敵人都在你面前。
english: You have seen my shame, how I was laughed at and made low; my haters are all before you.

chinese: 辱罵傷破了我的心，我又滿了憂愁。我指望有人體恤，卻沒有一個；我指望有人安慰，卻找不著一個。
english: My heart is broken by bitter words, I am full of grief; I made a search for some to have pity on me, but there was no one; I had no comforter.

chinese: 他們拿苦膽給我當食物；我渴了，他們拿醋給我喝。
english: They gave me poison for my food; and bitter wine for my drink.

chinese: 願他們的筵席在他們面前變為網羅，在他們平安的時候變為機檻。
english: Let their table before them be for their destruction; let their feasts become a net to take them.

chinese: 願他們的眼睛昏矇，不得看見；願你使他們的腰常常戰抖。
english: Let their eyes be blind so that they may not see; let their bodies for ever be shaking.

chinese: 求你將你的惱恨倒在他們身上，叫你的烈怒追上他們。
english: Let your curse come on them; let the heat of your wrath overtake them.

chinese: 願他們的住處變為荒場；願他們的帳棚無人居住。
english: Give their houses to destruction, and let there be no one in their tents.

chinese: 因為，你所擊打的，他們就逼迫；你所擊傷的，他們戲說他的愁苦。
english: Because they are cruel to him against whom your hand is turned; they make bitter the grief of him who is wounded by you.

chinese: 願你在他們的罪上加罪，不容他們在你面前稱義。
english: Let their punishment be increased; let them not come into your righteousness.

chinese: 願他們從生命冊上被塗抹，不得記錄在義人之中。
english: Let their names be taken from the book of the living, let them not be numbered with the upright.

chinese: 但我是困苦憂傷的；神啊，願你的救恩將我安置在高處。
english: But I am poor and full of sorrow; let me be lifted up by your salvation, O Lord.

chinese: 我要以詩歌讚美神的名，以感謝稱他為大！
english: I will give praise to the name of God with a song; I will give glory to him for what he has done.

chinese: 這便叫耶和華喜悅，勝似獻牛，或是獻有角有蹄的公牛。
english: This will be more pleasing to the Lord than an ox, or a young ox of full growth.

chinese: 謙卑的人看見了就喜樂；尋求神的人，願你們的心甦醒。
english: The poor will see it and be glad: you who are lovers of God, let your hearts have life.

chinese: 因為耶和華聽了窮乏人，不藐視被囚的人。
english: For the ears of the Lord are open to the poor, and he takes thought for his prisoners.

chinese: 願天和地、洋海和其中一切的動物都讚美他！
english: Let the heavens and the earth give praise to him, the seas, and everything moving in them.

chinese: 因為神要拯救錫安，建造猶大的城邑；他的民要在那裡居住，得以為業。
english: For God will be the saviour of Zion, and the builder of the towns of Judah; so that it may be their resting-place and heritage.

chinese: 他僕人的後裔要承受為業；愛他名的人也要住在其中。
english: The seed of his servants will have their part in it, and there the lovers of his name will have rest.

chinese: （大衛的記念詩，交與伶長。）神啊，求你快快搭救我！耶和華啊，求你速速幫助我！
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of David. To keep in memory. - Let your salvation come quickly, O God; come quickly to my help, O Lord.

chinese: 願那些尋索我命的，抱愧蒙羞；願那些喜悅我遭害的，退後受辱。
english: Let those who go after my soul have shame and trouble; let those who have evil designs against me be turned back and made foolish.

chinese: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的，因羞愧退後。
english: Let those who say Aha, aha! be turned back as a reward of their shame.

chinese: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜；願那些喜愛你救恩的，常說：當尊神為大！
english: Let all those who are looking for you be glad and have joy in you; let the lovers of your salvation ever say, May God be great.

chinese: 但我是困苦窮乏的；神啊，求你速速到我這裡來！你是幫助我的，搭救我的。耶和華啊，求你不要耽延！
english: But I am poor and in need; come to me quickly, O God; you are my help and my saviour; let there be no waiting, O Lord.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我投靠你；求你叫我永不羞愧！
english: In you, O Lord, have I put my hope; let me never be shamed.

chinese: 求你憑你的公義搭救我，救拔我；側耳聽我，拯救我！
english: Keep me safe in your righteousness, and come to my help; give ear to my voice, and be my saviour.

chinese: 求你作我常住的磐石；你已經命定要救我，因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨。
english: Be my strong Rock, the strong place of my salvation; for you are my Rock, and my safe place.

chinese: 我的神啊，求你救我脫離惡人的手，脫離不義和殘暴之人的手。
english: O my God, take me out of the hand of the sinner, out of the hand of the evil and cruel man.

chinese: 主─耶和華啊，你是我所盼望的；從我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。
english: For you are my hope, O Lord God; I have had faith in you from the time when I was young.

chinese: 我從出母胎被你扶持；使我出母腹的是你。我必常常讚美你！
english: You have been my support from the day of my birth; you took me out of my mother's body; my praise will be ever of you.

chinese: 許多人以我為怪，但你是我堅固的避難所。
english: I am a wonder to all; but you are my strong tower.

chinese: 你的讚美，你的榮耀終日必滿了我的口。
english: My mouth will be full of your praise and glory all the day.

chinese: 我年老的時候，求你不要丟棄我！我力氣衰弱的時候，求你不要離棄我！
english: Do not give me up when I am old; be my help even when my strength is gone.

chinese: 我的仇敵議論我；那些窺探要害我命的彼此商議，
english: For my haters are waiting secretly for me; and those who are watching for my soul are banded together in their evil designs,

chinese: 說：神已經離棄他；我們追趕他，捉拿他罷！因為沒有人搭救。
english: Saying, God has given him up; go after him and take him, for he has no helper.

chinese: 神啊，求你不要遠離我！我的神啊，求你速速幫助我！
english: O God, be not far from me; O my God, come quickly to my help.

chinese: 願那與我性命為敵的，羞愧被滅；願那謀害我的，受辱蒙羞。
english: Let those who say evil against my soul be overcome and put to shame; let my haters be made low and have no honour.

chinese: 我卻要常常盼望，並要越發讚美你。
english: But I will go on ever hoping, and increasing in all your praise.

chinese: 我的口終日要述說你的公義和你的救恩，因我不計其數。
english: My mouth will make clear your righteousness and your salvation all the day; for they are more than may be measured.

chinese: 我要來說主─耶和華大能的事；我單要提說你的公義。
english: I will give news of the great acts of the Lord God; my words will be of your righteousness, and of yours only.

chinese: 神啊，自我年幼時，你就教訓我；直到如今，我傳揚你奇妙的作為。
english: O God, you have been my teacher from the time when I was young; and I have been talking of your works of wonder even till now.

chinese: 神啊，我到年老髮白的時候，求你不要離棄我！等我將你的能力指示下代，將你的大能指示後世的人。
english: Now when I am old and grey-headed, O God, give me not up; till I have made clear your strength to this generation, and your power to all those to come.

chinese: 神啊，你的公義甚高；行過大事的神啊，誰能像你！
english: Your righteousness, O God, is very high; you have done great things; O God, who is like you?

chinese: 你是叫我們多經歷重大急難的，必使我們復活，從地的深處救上來。
english: You, who have sent great and bitter troubles on me, will give me life again, lifting me up from the deep waters of the underworld.

chinese: 求你使我越發昌大，又轉來安慰我。
english: You will make me greater than before, and give me comfort on every side.

chinese: 我的神啊，我要鼓瑟稱讚你，稱讚你的誠實！以色列的聖者啊，我要彈琴歌頌你！
english: I will give praise to you with instruments of music, O my God, for you are true; I will make songs to you with music, O Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 我歌頌你的時候，我的嘴唇和你所贖我的靈魂都必歡呼；
english: Joy will be on my lips when I make melody to you; and in my soul, to which you have given salvation.

chinese: 並且我的舌頭必終日講論你的公義，因為那些謀害我的人已經蒙羞受辱了。
english: My tongue will be talking of your righteousness all the day; for those whose purpose is to do me evil have been crushed and put to shame.

chinese: （所羅門的詩。）神啊，求你將判斷的權柄賜給王，將公義賜給王的兒子。
english: - Of Solomon. - Give the king your authority, O God, and your righteousness to the king's son.

chinese: 他要按公義審判你的民，按公平審判你的困苦人。
english: May he be a judge of your people in righteousness, and make true decisions for the poor.

chinese: 大山小山都要因公義使民得享平安。
english: May the mountains give peace to the people, and the hills righteousness.

chinese: 他必為民中的困苦人伸冤，拯救窮乏之輩，壓碎那欺壓人的。
english: May he be a judge of the poor among the people, may he give salvation to the children of those who are in need; by him let the violent be crushed.

chinese: 太陽還存，月亮還在，人要敬畏你，直到萬代！
english: May his life go on as long as the sun and moon, through all generations.

chinese: 他必降臨，像雨降在已割的草地上，如甘霖滋潤田地。
english: May he come down like rain on the cut grass; like showers watering the earth.

chinese: 在他的日子，義人要發旺，大有平安，好像月亮長存。
english: In his days may the upright do well, living in peace as long as there is a moon in heaven.

chinese: 他要執掌權柄，從這海直到那海，從大河直到地極。
english: Let his kingdom be from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

chinese: 住在曠野的，必在他面前下拜；他的仇敵必要舔土。
english: Let those who are against him go down before him; and let his haters be low in the dust.

chinese: 他施和海島的王要進貢；示巴和西巴的王要獻禮物。
english: Let the kings of Tarshish and of the islands come back with offerings; let the kings of Sheba and Seba give of their stores.

chinese: 諸王都要叩拜他；萬國都要事奉他。
english: Yes, let all kings go down before him; let all nations be his servants.

chinese: 因為，窮乏人呼求的時候，他要搭救；沒有人幫助的困苦人，他也要搭救。
english: For he will be a saviour to the poor in answer to his cry; and to him who is in need, without a helper.

chinese: 他要憐恤貧寒和窮乏的人，拯救窮苦人的性命。
english: He will have pity on the poor, and be the saviour of those who are in need.

chinese: 他要救贖他們脫離欺壓和強暴；他們的血在他眼中看為寶貴。
english: He will keep their souls free from evil designs and violent attacks; and their blood will be of value in his eyes.

chinese: 他們要存活。示巴的金子要奉給他；人要常常為他禱告，終日稱頌他。
english: May he have long life, and may gold from Sheba be given to him: may prayers be made for him at all times; may blessings be on him every day.

chinese: 在地的山頂上，五穀必然茂盛（或譯：有一把五穀）；所結的穀實要響動，如利巴嫩的樹林；城裡的人要發旺，如地上的草。
english: May there be wide-stretching fields of grain in the land, shaking on the top of the mountains, full of fruit like Lebanon: may its stems be unnumbered like the grass of the earth.

chinese: 他的名要存到永遠，要留傳如日之久。人要因他蒙福；萬國要稱他有福。
english: May his name go on for ever, as long as the sun: may men be blessing themselves by him; may all nations be blessing his name.

chinese: 獨行奇事的耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的！
english: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, the only doer of wonders.

chinese: 他榮耀的名也當稱頌，直到永遠。願他的榮耀充滿全地！阿們！阿們！
english: Praise to the glory of his noble name for ever; let all the earth be full of his glory. So be it, So be it.

chinese: 耶西的兒子─大衛的祈禱完畢。
english: The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are ended. - A Psalm. Of Asaph. -

chinese: （亞薩的詩。）神實在恩待以色列那些清心的人！
english: Truly, God is good to Israel, even to such as are clean in heart.

chinese: 至於我，我的腳幾乎失閃；我的腳險些滑跌。
english: But as for me, my feet had almost gone from under me; I was near to slipping;

chinese: 我見惡人和狂傲人享平安就心懷不平。
english: Because of my envy of the men of pride, when I saw the well-being of the wrongdoers.

chinese: 他們死的時候沒有疼痛；他們的力氣卻也壯實。
english: For they have no pain; their bodies are fat and strong.

chinese: 他們不像別人受苦，也不像別人遭災。
english: They are not in trouble as others are; they have no part in the unhappy fate of men.

chinese: 所以，驕傲如鏈子戴在他們的項上；強暴像衣裳遮住他們的身體。
english: For this reason pride is round them like a chain; they are clothed with violent behaviour as with a robe.

chinese: 他們的眼睛因體胖而凸出；他們所得的，過於心裡所想的。
english: Their eyes are bursting with fat; they have more than their heart's desire.

chinese: 他們譏笑人，憑惡意說欺壓人的話；他們說話自高。
english: Their thoughts are deep with evil designs; their talk from their seats of power is of cruel acts.

chinese: 他們的口褻瀆上天；他們的舌毀謗全地。
english: Their mouth goes up to heaven; their tongues go walking through the earth.

chinese: 所以神的民歸到這裡，喝盡了滿杯的苦水。
english: For this reason they are full of bread; and water is ever flowing for them.

chinese: 他們說：神怎能曉得？至高者豈有知識呢？
english: And they say, How will the Lord see this? is there knowledge in the Most High?

chinese: 看哪，這就是惡人；他們既是常享安逸，財寶便加增。
english: Truly, such are the sinners; they do well at all times, and their wealth is increased.

chinese: 我實在徒然潔淨了我的心，徒然洗手表明無辜。
english: As for me, I have made my heart clean to no purpose, washing my hands in righteousness;

chinese: 因為，我終日遭災難；每早晨受懲治。
english: For I have been troubled all the day; every morning have I undergone punishment.

chinese: 我若說，我要這樣講，這就是以奸詐待你的眾子。
english: If I would make clear what it is like, I would say, You are false to the generation of your children.

chinese: 我思索怎能明白這事，眼看實係為難，
english: When my thoughts were turned to see the reason of this, it was a weariness in my eyes;

chinese: 等我進了神的聖所，思想他們的結局。
english: Till I went into God's holy place, and saw the end of the evil-doers.

chinese: 你實在把他們安在滑地，使他們掉在沉淪之中。
english: You put their feet where there was danger of slipping, so that they go down into destruction.

chinese: 他們轉眼之間成了何等的荒涼！他們被驚恐滅盡了。
english: How suddenly are they wasted! fears are the cause of their destruction.

chinese: 人睡醒了，怎樣看夢；主啊，你醒了也必照樣輕看他們的影像。
english: As a dream when one is awake, they are ended; they are like an image gone out of mind when sleep is over.

chinese: 因而，我心裡發酸，肺腑被刺。
english: My heart was made bitter, and I was pained by the bite of grief:

chinese: 我這樣愚昧無知，在你面前如畜類一般。
english: As for me, I was foolish, and without knowledge; I was like a beast before you.

chinese: 然而，我常與你同在；你攙著我的右手。
english: But still I am ever with you; you have taken me by my right hand.

chinese: 你要以你的訓言引導我，以後必接我到榮耀裡。
english: Your wisdom will be my guide, and later you will put me in a place of honour.

chinese: 除你以外，在天上我有誰呢？除你以外，在地上我也沒有所愛慕的。
english: Whom have I in heaven but you? and having you I have no desire for anything on earth.

chinese: 我的肉體和我的心腸衰殘；但神是我心裡的力量，又是我的福分，直到永遠。
english: My flesh and my heart are wasting away: but God is the Rock of my heart and my eternal heritage.

chinese: 遠離你的，必要死亡；凡離棄你行邪淫的，你都滅絕了。
english: For those who are far away from you will come to destruction: you will put an end to all those who have not kept faith with you.

chinese: 但我親近神是與我有益；我以主耶和華為我的避難所，好叫我述說你一切的作為。
english: But it is good for me to come near to God: I have put my faith in the Lord God, so that I may make clear all his works.

chinese: （亞薩的訓誨詩。）神啊，你為何永遠丟棄我們呢？你為何向你草場的羊發怒，如煙冒出呢？
english: - Maschil. Of Asaph. - Of God, why have you put us away from you for ever? why is the fire of your wrath smoking against the sheep who are your care?

chinese: 求你記念你古時所得來的會眾，就是你所贖﹔作你產業支派的，並記念你向來所居住的錫安山。
english: Keep in mind your band of worshippers, for whom you gave payment in the days which are past, whom you took for yourself as the people of your heritage; even this mountain of Zion, which has been your resting-place.

chinese: 求你舉步去看那日久荒涼之地，仇敵在聖所中所行的一切惡事。
english: Go up and see the unending destruction; all the evil which your haters have done in the holy place;

chinese: 你的敵人在你會中吼叫；他們豎了自己的旗為記號。
english: Sending out their voices like lions among your worshippers; they have put up their signs to be seen.

chinese: 他們好像人揚起斧子，砍伐林中的樹。
english: They are cutting down, like a man whose blade is lifted up against the thick trees.

chinese: 聖所中一切雕刻的，他們現在用斧子錘子打壞了。
english: Your doors are broken down with hammers and iron blades.

chinese: 他們用火焚燒你的聖所，褻瀆你名的居所，拆毀到地。
english: They have put on fire your holy place; they have made the place of your name unclean, pulling it down to the earth.

chinese: 他們心裡說：我們要盡行毀滅；他們就在遍地把神的會所都燒燬了。
english: They have said in their hearts, Let us put an end to them all together; they have given over to the fire all God's places of worship in the land.

chinese: 我們不見我們的標幟，不再有先知；我們內中也沒有人知道這災禍要到幾時呢！
english: We do not see our signs: there is no longer any prophet, or anyone among us to say how long.

chinese: 神啊，敵人辱罵要到幾時呢？仇敵褻瀆你的名要到永遠麼？
english: O God, how long will those who are against us say cruel things? will the hater go on looking down on your name for ever?

chinese: 你為甚麼縮回你的右手？求你從懷中伸出來，毀滅他們。
english: Why are you keeping back your hand, and covering your right hand in your robe?

chinese: 神自古以來為我的王，在地上施行拯救。
english: For from the past God is my King, working salvation in the earth.

chinese: 你曾用能力將海分開，將水中大魚的頭打破。
english: The sea was parted in two by your strength; the heads of the great sea-beasts were broken.

chinese: 你曾砸碎鱷魚的頭，把他給曠野的禽獸（禽獸：原文是民）為食物。
english: The heads of the great snake were crushed by you; you gave them as food to the fishes of the sea.

chinese: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河；你使長流的江河乾了。
english: You made valleys for fountains and springs; you made the ever-flowing rivers dry.

chinese: 白晝屬你，黑夜也屬你；亮光和日頭是你所預備的。
english: The day is yours and the night is yours: you made the light and the sun.

chinese: 地的一切疆界是你所立的；夏天和冬天是你所定的。
english: By you all the limits of the earth were fixed; you have made summer and winter.

chinese: 耶和華啊，仇敵辱罵，愚頑民褻瀆了你的名，求你記念這事。
english: Keep this in mind, O Lord, that your haters have said cruel things, and that your name has been looked down on by a people of evil behaviour.

chinese: 不要將你斑鳩的性命交給野獸；不要永遠忘記你困苦人的性命。
english: O give not the soul of your dove to the hawk; let not the life of the poor go out of your memory for ever.

chinese: 求你顧念所立的約，因為地上黑暗之處都滿了強暴的居所。
english: Keep in mind your undertaking; for the dark places of the earth are full of pride and cruel acts.

chinese: 不要叫受欺壓的人蒙羞回去；要叫困苦窮乏的人讚美你的名。
english: O let not the crushed be turned back in shame; let the low man and the poor give praise to your name.

chinese: 神啊，求你起來為自己伸訴！要記念愚頑人怎樣終日辱罵你。
english: Up! O God, be the judge of your cause; keep in mind the bitter things which the man of evil behaviour says against you every day.

chinese: 不要忘記你敵人的聲音；那起來敵你之人的喧嘩時常上升。
english: Keep in mind the voice of your haters; the outcry of those who come against you goes up every day.

chinese: （亞薩的詩歌，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。）神啊，我們稱謝你，我們稱謝你！因為你的名相近，人都述說你奇妙的作為。
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. A Psalm. Of Asaph. A Song. - To you, O God, we give praise, to you we give praise: and those who give honour to your name make clear your works of power.

chinese: 我到了所定的日期，必按正直施行審判。
english: When the right time has come, I will be the judge in righteousness.

chinese: 地和其上的居民都消化了；我曾立了地的柱子。（細拉）
english: When the earth and all its people become feeble, I am the support of its pillars. (Selah.)

chinese: 我對狂傲人說：不要行事狂傲！對凶惡人說：不要舉角！
english: I say to the men of pride, Let your pride be gone: and to the sinners, Let not your horn be lifted up.

chinese: 不要把你們的角高舉；不要挺著頸項說話。
english: Let not your horn be lifted up: let no more words of pride come from your outstretched necks.

chinese: 因為高舉非從東，非從西，也非從南而來。
english: For honour does not come from the east, or from the west, or uplifting from the south;

chinese: 惟有神斷定；他使這人降卑，使那人升高。
english: But God is the judge, putting down one, and lifting up another.

chinese: 耶和華手裡有杯，其中的酒起沫，杯內滿了攙雜的酒；他倒出來，地上的惡人必都喝這酒的渣滓，而且喝盡。
english: For in the hand of the Lord is a cup, and the wine is red; it is well mixed, overflowing from his hand: he will make all the sinners of the earth take of it, even to the last drop.

chinese: 但我要宣揚，直到永遠！我要歌頌雅各的神！
english: But I will ever be full of joy, making songs of praise to the God of Jacob.

chinese: 惡人一切的角，我要砍斷；惟有義人的角必被高舉。
english: By him will all the horns of the sinners be cut off; but the horns of the upright will be lifted up.

chinese: （亞薩的詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）在猶大，神為人所認識；在以色列，他的名為大。
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Neginoth. A Psalm. Of Asaph. A Song. -

chinese: 在撒冷有他的帳幕；在錫安有他的居所。
english: In Judah is the knowledge of God; his name is great in Israel,

chinese: 他在那裡折斷弓上的火箭，並盾牌、刀劍，和爭戰的兵器。（細拉）
english: In Salem is his tent, his resting-place in Zion.

chinese: 你從有野食之山而來，有光華和榮美。
english: There were the arrows of the bow broken, there he put an end to body-cover, sword, and fight. (Selah.)

chinese: 心中勇敢的人都被搶奪；他們睡了長覺，沒有一個英雄能措手。
english: You are shining and full of glory, more than the eternal mountains.

chinese: 雅各的神啊，你的斥責一發，坐車的﹔騎馬的都沉睡了。
english: Gone is the wealth of the strong, their last sleep has overcome them; the men of war have become feeble.

chinese: 惟獨你是可畏的！你怒氣一發，誰能在你面前站得住呢？
english: At the voice of your wrath, O God of Jacob, deep sleep has overcome carriage and horse.

chinese: 你從天上使人聽判斷。神起來施行審判，要救地上一切謙卑的人；那時地就懼怕而靜默。（細拉）
english: You, you are to be feared; who may keep his place before you in the time of your wrath?
From heaven you gave your decision; the earth, in its fear, gave no sound,

chinese: 人的忿怒要成全你的榮美；人的餘怒，你要禁止。
english: When God took his place as judge, for the salvation of the poor on the earth. (Selah.)

chinese: 你們許願，當向耶和華─你們的神還願；在他四面的人都當拿貢物獻給那可畏的主。
english: The ... will give you praise; the rest of ...

chinese: 他要挫折王子的驕氣；他向地上的君王顯威可畏。
english: Give to the Lord your God what is his by right; let all who are round him give offerings to him who is to be feared.

chinese: （亞薩的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。）我要向神發聲呼求；我向　神發聲，他必留心聽我。
english: - To the chief music-maker. After Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A Psalm. - I was crying to God with my voice; even to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.

chinese: 我在患難之日尋求主；我在夜間不住地舉手禱告；我的心不肯受安慰。
english: In the day of my trouble, my heart was turned to the Lord: my hand was stretched out in the night without resting; my soul would not be comforted.

chinese: 我想念神，就煩燥不安；我沉吟悲傷，心便發昏。（細拉）
english: I will keep God in memory, with sounds of grief; my thoughts are troubled, and my spirit is overcome. (Selah.)

chinese: 你叫我不能閉眼；我煩亂不安，甚至不能說話。
english: You keep my eyes from sleep; I am so troubled that no words come.

chinese: 我追想古時之日，上古之年。
english: My thoughts go back to the days of the past, to the years which are gone.

chinese: 我想起我夜間的歌曲，捫心自問；我心裡也仔細省察。
english: The memory of my song comes back to me in the night; my thoughts are moving in my heart; my spirit is searching with care.

chinese: 難道主要永遠丟棄我，不再施恩麼？
english: Will the Lord put me away for ever? will he be kind no longer?

chinese: 難道他的慈愛永遠窮盡，他的應許世世廢棄麼？
english: Is his mercy quite gone for ever? has his word come to nothing?

chinese: 難道神忘記開恩，因發怒就止住他的慈悲麼？（細拉）
english: Has God put away the memory of his pity? are his mercies shut up by his wrath? (Selah.)

chinese: 我便說：這是我的懦弱，但我要追念至高者顯出右手之年代。
english: And I said, It is a weight on my spirit; but I will keep in mind the years of the right hand of the Most High.

chinese: 我要提說耶和華所行的；我要記念你古時的奇事。
english: I will keep in mind the works of Jah: I will keep the memory of your wonders in the past.

chinese: 我也要思想你的經營，默念你的作為。
english: I will give thought to all your work, while my mind goes over your acts of power.

chinese: 神啊，你的作為是潔淨的；有何神大如神呢？
english: Your way, O God, is holy: what god is so great as our God?

chinese: 你是行奇事的神；你曾在列邦中彰顯你的能力。
english: You are the God who does works of power: you have made your strength clear to the nations.

chinese: 你曾用你的膀臂贖了你的民，就是雅各和約瑟的子孫。（細拉）
english: With your arm you have made your people free, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. (Selah.)

chinese: 神啊，諸水見你，一見就都驚惶；深淵也都戰抖。
english: The waters saw you, O God; the waters saw you, they were in fear: even the deep was troubled.

chinese: 雲中倒出水來；天空發出響聲；你的箭也飛行四方。
english: The clouds sent out water; the skies gave out a sound; truly, your arrows went far and wide.

chinese: 你的雷聲在旋風中；電光照亮世界；大地戰抖震動。
english: The voice of your thunder went rolling on; the world was flaming with the light of the storm; the earth was shaking.

chinese: 你的道在海中；你的路在大水中；你的腳蹤無人知道。
english: Your way was in the sea, and your road in the great waters; there was no knowledge of your footsteps.

chinese: 你曾藉摩西和亞倫的手引導你的百姓，好像羊群一般。
english: You were guiding your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

chinese: （亞薩的訓誨詩。）我的民哪，你們要留心聽我的訓誨，側耳聽我口中的話。
english: - Maschil. Of Asaph. - Give ear, O my people, to my law; let your ears be bent down to the words of my mouth.

chinese: 我要開口說比喻；我要說出古時的謎語，
english: Opening my mouth I will give out a story, even the dark sayings of old times;

chinese: 是我們所聽見、所知道的，也是我們的祖宗告訴我們的。
english: Which have come to our hearing and our knowledge, as they were given to us by our fathers.

chinese: 我們不將這些事向他們的子孫隱瞞，要將耶和華的美德和他的能力，並他奇妙的作為，述說給後代聽。
english: We will not keep them secret from our children; we will make clear to the coming generation the praises of the Lord and his strength, and the great works of wonder which he has done.

chinese: 因為，他在雅各中立法度，在以色列中設律法；是他吩咐我們祖宗要傳給子孫的，
english: He put up a witness in Jacob, and made a law in Israel; which he gave to our fathers so that they might give knowledge of them to their children;

chinese: 使將要生的後代子孫可以曉得；他們也要起來告訴他們的子孫，
english: So that the generation to come might have knowledge of them, even the children of the future, who would give word of them to their children;

chinese: 好叫他們仰望神，不忘記神的作為，惟要守他的命令。
english: So that they might put their hope in God, and not let God's works go out of their minds, but keep his laws;

chinese: 不要像他們的祖宗，是頑梗悖逆、居心不正之輩，向著神，心不誠實。
english: And not be like their fathers, a stiff-necked and uncontrolled generation; a generation whose heart was hard, whose spirit was not true to God.

chinese: 以法蓮的子孫帶著兵器，拿著弓，臨陣之日轉身退後。
english: The children of Ephraim, armed with bows, were turned back on the day of the fight.

chinese: 他們不遵守神的約，不肯照他的律法行；
english: They were not ruled by God's word, and they would not go in the way of his law;

chinese: 又忘記他所行的和他顯給他們奇妙的作為。
english: They let his works go out of their memory, and the wonders which he had made them see.

chinese: 他在埃及地，在瑣安田，在他們祖宗的眼前施行奇事。
english: He did great works before the eyes of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the fields of Zoan.

chinese: 他將海分裂，使他們過去，又叫水立起如壘。
english: The sea was cut in two so that they might go through; the waters were massed together on this side and on that.

chinese: 他白日用雲彩，終夜用火光引導他們。
english: In the daytime he was guiding them in the cloud, and all through the night with a light of fire.

chinese: 他在曠野分裂磐石，多多地給他們水喝，如從深淵而出。
english: The rocks of the waste land were broken by his power, and he gave them drink as out of the deep waters.

chinese: 他使水從磐石湧出，叫水如江河下流。
english: He made streams come out of the rock; and waters came flowing down like rivers.

chinese: 他們卻仍舊得罪他，在乾燥之地悖逆至高者。
english: And they went on sinning against him even more, turning away from the Most High in the waste land;

chinese: 他們心中試探神，隨自己所欲的求食物，
english: Testing God in their hearts, requesting meat for their desire.

chinese: 並且妄論神說：神在曠野豈能擺設筵席麼？
english: They said bitter words against God, saying, Is God able to make ready a table in the waste land?

chinese: 他曾擊打磐石，使水湧出，成了江河；他還能賜糧食麼？還能為他的百姓預備肉麼？
english: See, the rock was cut open by his power, so that the water came rushing out, and overflowing streams; is he able to give us bread? is he able to get meat for his people?

chinese: 所以，耶和華聽見就發怒；有烈火向雅各燒起；有怒氣向以色列上騰；
english: So these things came to the Lord's ears, and he was angry; and a fire was lighted against Jacob, and wrath came up against Israel;

chinese: 因為他們不信服神，不倚賴他的救恩。
english: Because they had no faith in God, and no hope in his salvation.

chinese: 他卻吩咐天空，又敞開天上的門，
english: And he gave orders to the clouds on high, and the doors of heaven were open;

chinese: 降嗎哪，像雨給他們吃，將天上的糧食賜給他們。
english: And he sent down manna like rain for their food, and gave them the grain of heaven.
