chinese: 各人（或譯：人）吃大能者的食物；他賜下糧食，使他們飽足。
english: Man took part in the food of strong ones; he sent them meat in full measure.

chinese: 他領東風起在天空，又用能力引了南風來。
english: He sent an east wind from heaven, driving on the south wind by his power.

chinese: 他降肉，像雨在他們當中，多如塵土，又降飛鳥，多如海沙，
english: He sent down meat on them like dust, and feathered birds like the sand of the sea,

chinese: 落在他們的營中，在他們住處的四面。
english: And he let it come down into their resting-place, round about their tents.

chinese: 他們吃了，而且飽足；這樣就隨了他們所欲的。
english: So they had food and were full; for he gave them their desire;

chinese: 他們貪而無厭，食物還在他們口中的時候，
english: But they were not turned from their desires; and while the food was still in their mouths,

chinese: 神的怒氣就向他們上騰，殺了他們內中的肥壯人，打倒以色列的少年人。
english: The wrath of God came on them, and put to death the fattest of them, and put an end to the young men of Israel.

chinese: 雖是這樣，他們仍舊犯罪，不信他奇妙的作為。
english: For all this they went on sinning even more, and had no faith in his great wonders.

chinese: 因此，他叫他們的日子全歸虛空，叫他們的年歲盡屬驚恐。
english: So their days were wasted like a breath, and their years in trouble.

chinese: 他殺他們的時候，他們才求問他，回心轉意，切切地尋求神。
english: When he sent death on them, then they made search for him; turning to him and looking for him with care;

chinese: 他們也追念神是他們的磐石，至高的神是他們的救贖主。
english: In the memory that God was their Rock, and the Most High God their saviour.

chinese: 他們卻用口諂媚他，用舌向他說謊。
english: But their lips were false to him, and their tongues were untrue to him;

chinese: 因他們的心向他不正，在他的約上也不忠心。
english: And their hearts were not right with him, and they did not keep their agreement with him.

chinese: 但他有憐憫，赦免他們的罪孽，不滅絕他們，而且屢次消他的怒氣，不發盡他的忿怒。
english: But he, being full of pity, has forgiveness for sin, and does not put an end to man: frequently turning back his wrath, and not being violently angry.

chinese: 他想到他們不過是血氣，是一陣去而不返的風。
english: So he kept in mind that they were only flesh; a breath which is quickly gone, and will not come again.

chinese: 他們在曠野悖逆他，在荒地叫他擔憂，何其多呢！
english: How frequently did they go against him in the waste land, and give him cause for grief in the dry places!

chinese: 他們再三試探神，惹動以色列的聖者。
english: Again they put God to the test, and gave pain to the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 他們不追念他的能力（原文是手）和贖他們脫離敵人的日子；
english: They did not keep in mind the work of his hand, or the day when he took them from the power of their haters;

chinese: 他怎樣在埃及地顯神蹟，在瑣安田顯奇事，
english: How he had done his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan;

chinese: 把他們的江河並河的水都變為血，使他們不能喝。
english: So that their rivers were turned to blood, and they were not able to get drink from their streams.

chinese: 他叫蒼蠅成群落在他們當中，嘬盡他們，又叫青蛙滅了他們，
english: He sent different sorts of flies among them, poisoning their flesh; and frogs for their destruction.

chinese: 把他們的土產交給螞蚱，把他們辛苦得來的交給蝗蟲。
english: He gave the increase of their fields to worms, the fruits of their industry to the locusts.

chinese: 他降冰雹打壞他們的葡萄樹，下嚴霜打壞他們的桑樹，
english: He sent ice for the destruction of their vines; their trees were damaged by the bitter cold.

chinese: 又把他們的牲畜交給冰雹，把他們的群畜交給閃電。
english: Ice was rained down on their cattle; thunderstorms sent destruction among the flocks.

chinese: 他使猛烈的怒氣和忿怒、惱恨、苦難成了一群降災的使者，臨到他們。
english: He sent on them the heat of his wrath, his bitter disgust, letting loose evil angels among them.

chinese: 他為自己的怒氣修平了路，將他們交給瘟疫，使他們死亡，
english: He let his wrath have its way; he did not keep back their soul from death, but gave their life to disease.

chinese: 在埃及擊殺一切長子，在含的帳棚中擊殺他們強壯時頭生的。
english: He gave to destruction all the first sons of Egypt; the first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;

chinese: 他卻領出自己的民如羊，在曠野引他們如羊群。
english: But he took his people out like sheep, guiding them in the waste land like a flock.

chinese: 他領他們穩穩妥妥地，使他們不致害怕；海卻淹沒他們的仇敵。
english: He took them on safely so that they had no fear; but their haters were covered by the sea.

chinese: 他帶他們到自己聖地的邊界，到他右手所得的這山地。
english: And he was their guide to his holy land, even to the mountain, which his right hand had made his;

chinese: 他在他們面前趕出外邦人，用繩子將外邦的地量給他們為業，叫以色列支派的人住在他們的帳棚裡。
english: Driving out nations before them, marking out the line of their heritage, and giving the people of Israel their tents for a resting-place.

chinese: 他們仍舊試探、悖逆至高的神，不守他的法度，
english: But they were bitter against the Most High God, testing him, and not keeping his laws;

chinese: 反倒退後，行詭詐，像他們的祖宗一樣；他們改變，如同翻背的弓。
english: Their hearts were turned back and untrue like their fathers; they were turned to one side like a twisted bow.

chinese: 因他們的邱壇惹了他的怒氣；因他們雕刻的偶像觸動他的憤恨。
english: They made him angry with their high places; moving him to wrath with their images.

chinese: 神聽見就發怒，極其憎惡以色列人。
english: When this came to God's ears he was very angry, and gave up Israel completely;

chinese: 甚至他離棄示羅的帳幕，就是他在人間所搭的帳棚；
english: So that he went away from the holy place in Shiloh, the tent which he had put among men;

chinese: 又將他的約櫃（原文是能力）交與人擄去，將他的榮耀交在敵人手中；
english: And he let his strength be taken prisoner, and gave his glory into the hands of his hater.

chinese: 並將他的百姓交與刀劍，向他的產業發怒。
english: He gave his people up to the sword, and was angry with his heritage.

chinese: 少年人被火燒滅；處女也無喜歌。
english: Their young men were burned in the fire; and their virgins were not praised in the bride-song.

chinese: 祭司倒在刀下，寡婦卻不哀哭。
english: Their priests were put to death by the sword, and their widows made no weeping for them.

chinese: 那時，主像世人睡醒，像勇士飲酒呼喊。
english: Then was the Lord like one awaking from sleep, and like a strong man crying out because of wine.

chinese: 他就打退了他的敵人，叫他們永蒙羞辱；
english: His haters were turned back by his blows and shamed for ever.

chinese: 並且他棄掉約瑟的帳棚，不揀選以法蓮支派，
english: And he put the tent of Joseph on one side, and took not the tribe of Ephraim;

chinese: 卻揀選猶大支派─他所喜愛的錫安山；
english: But he took the tribe of Judah for himself, and the mountain of Zion, in which he had pleasure.

chinese: 蓋造他的聖所，好像高峰，又像他建立永存之地；
english: And he made his holy place like the high heaven, like the earth which is fixed by him for ever.

chinese: 又揀選他的僕人大衛，從羊圈中將他召來，
english: He took David to be his servant, taking him from the place of the flocks;

chinese: 叫他不再跟從那些帶奶的母羊，為要牧養自己的百姓雅各和自己的產業以色列。
english: From looking after the sheep which were giving milk, he took him to give food to Jacob his people, and to Israel his heritage.

chinese: 於是，他按心中的純正牧養他們，用手中的巧妙引導他們。
english: So he gave them food with an upright heart, guiding them by the wisdom of his hands.

chinese: （亞薩的詩。）神啊，外邦人進入你的產業，污穢你的聖殿，使耶路撒冷變成荒堆，
english: - A Psalm. Of Asaph. - O God, the nations have come into your heritage; they have made your holy Temple unclean; they have made Jerusalem a mass of broken walls.

chinese: 把你僕人的屍首交與天空的飛鳥為食，把你聖民的肉交與地上的野獸，
english: They have given the bodies of your servants as food to the birds of the air, and the flesh of your saints to the beasts of the earth.

chinese: 在耶路撒冷周圍流他們的血如水，無人葬埋。
english: Their blood has been flowing like water round about Jerusalem; there was no one to put them in their last resting-place.

chinese: 我們成為鄰國的羞辱，成為我們四圍人的嗤笑譏刺。
english: We are looked down on by our neighbours, we are laughed at and made sport of by those who are round us.

chinese: 耶和華啊，這到幾時呢？你要動怒到永遠麼？你的憤恨要如火焚燒麼？
english: How long, O Lord? will you be angry for ever? will your wrath go on burning like fire?

chinese: 願你將你的忿怒倒在那不認識你的外邦和那不求告你名的國度。
english: Let your wrath be on the nations who have no knowledge of you, and on the kingdoms who have not made prayer to your name.

chinese: 因為他們吞了雅各，把他的住處變為荒場。
english: For they have taken Jacob for their meat, and made waste his house.

chinese: 求你不要記念我們先祖的罪孽，向我們追討；願你的慈悲快迎著我們，因為我們落到極卑微的地步。
english: Do not keep in mind against us the sins of our fathers; let your mercy come to us quickly, for we have been made very low.

chinese: 拯救我們的神啊，求你因你名的榮耀幫助我們！為你名的緣故搭救我們，赦免我們的罪。
english: Give us help, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; take us out of danger and give us forgiveness for our sins, because of your name.

chinese: 為何容外邦人說他們的神在哪裡呢？願你使外邦人知道你在我們眼前伸你僕人流血的冤。
english: Why may the nations say, Where is their God? Let payment for the blood of your servants be made openly among the nations before our eyes.

chinese: 願被囚之人的歎息達到你面前；願你按你的大能力存留那些將要死的人。
english: Let the cry of the prisoner come before you; with your strong arm make free the children of death;

chinese: 主啊，願你將我們鄰邦所羞辱你的羞辱加七倍歸到他們身上。
english: And give punishment seven times over into the breast of our neighbours for the bitter words which they have said against you, O Lord.

chinese: 這樣，你的民，你草場的羊，要稱謝你，直到永遠；要述說讚美你的話，直到萬代。
english: So we your people, and the sheep of your flock, will give you glory for ever: we will go on praising you through all generations.

chinese: （亞薩的詩，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。）領約瑟如領羊群之以色列的牧者啊，求你留心聽！坐在二基路伯上的啊，求你發出光來！
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to Shoshannim-eduth. Of Asaph. A Psalm. - Give ear, O Keeper of Israel, guiding Joseph like a flock; you who have your seat on the winged ones, let your glory be seen.

chinese: 在以法蓮、便雅憫、瑪拿西前面施展你的大能，來救我們。
english: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, let your strength be awake from sleep, and come as our salvation.

chinese: 神啊，求你使我們回轉（或譯：復興），使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
english: Take us back again, O God; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.

chinese: 耶和華─萬軍之神啊，你向你百姓的禱告發怒，要到幾時呢？
english: O Lord God of armies, how long will your wrath be burning against the rest of your people?

chinese: 你以眼淚當食物給他們吃，又多量出眼淚給他們喝。
english: You have given them the bread of weeping for food; for their drink you have given them sorrow in great measure.

chinese: 你使鄰邦因我們紛爭；我們的仇敵彼此戲笑。
english: You make us a cause of war among our neighbours; our haters are laughing at us among themselves.

chinese: 萬軍之神啊，求你使我們回轉，使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
english: Take us back again, O God of armies; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.

chinese: 你從埃及挪出一棵葡萄樹，趕出外邦人，把這樹栽上。
english: You took a vine out of Egypt: driving out the nations, and planting it in their land.

chinese: 你在這樹根前預備了地方，他就深深扎根，爬滿了地。
english: You made ready a place for it, so that it might take deep root, and it sent out its branches over all the land.

chinese: 他的影子遮滿了山，枝子好像佳美的香柏樹。
english: The mountains were covered with its shade, and the great trees with its branches.

chinese: 他發出枝子，長到大海，發出蔓子，延到大河。
english: It sent out its arms to the Sea, and its branches to the River.

chinese: 你為何拆毀這樹的籬笆，任憑一切過路的人摘取？
english: Why are its walls broken down by your hands, so that all who go by may take its fruit?

chinese: 林中出來的野豬把他糟踏；野地的走獸拿他當食物。
english: It is uprooted by the pigs from the woods, the beasts of the field get their food from it.

chinese: 萬軍之神啊，求你回轉！從天上垂看，眷顧這葡萄樹，
english: Come back, O God of armies: from heaven let your eyes be turned to this vine, and give your mind to it,

chinese: 保護你右手所栽的和你為自已所堅固的枝子。
english: Even to the tree which was planted by your right hand, and to the branch which you made strong for yourself.

chinese: 這樹已經被火焚燒，被刀砍伐；他們因你臉上的怒容就滅亡了。
english: It is burned with fire; it is cut down: they are made waste by the wrath of your face.

chinese: 願你的手扶持你右邊的人，就是你為自已所堅固的人子。
english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

chinese: 這樣，我們便不退後離開你；求你救活我們，我們就要求告你的名。
english: So will we not be turned back from you; keep us in life, and we will give praise to your name.

chinese: 耶和華─萬軍之神啊，求你使我們回轉，使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
english: Take us back, O Lord God of armies; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.

chinese: （亞薩的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。）你們當向神─我們的力量大聲歡呼，向雅各的　神發聲歡樂！
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to the Gittith. Of Asaph. - Make a song to God our strength: make a glad cry to the God of Jacob.

chinese: 唱起詩歌，打手鼓，彈美琴與瑟。
english: Take up the melody, playing on an instrument of music, even on corded instruments.

chinese: 當在月朔並月望─我們過節的日期吹角，
english: Let the horn be sounded in the time of the new moon, at the full moon, on our holy feast-day:

chinese: 因這是為以色列定的律例，是雅各神的典章。
english: For this is a rule for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

chinese: 他去攻擊埃及地的時候，在約瑟中間立此為證。我在那裡聽見我所不明白的言語：
english: He gave it to Joseph as a witness, when he went out over the land of Egypt; then the words of a strange tongue were sounding in my ears.

chinese: 神說：我使你的肩得脫重擔，你的手放下筐子。
english: I took the weight from his back; his hands were made free from the baskets.

chinese: 你在急難中呼求，我就搭救你；我在雷的隱密處應允你，在米利巴水那裡試驗你。（細拉）
english: You gave a cry in your trouble, and I made you free; I gave you an answer in the secret place of the thunder; I put you to the test at the waters of Meribah. (Selah.)

chinese: 我的民哪，你當聽，我要勸戒你；以色列啊，甚願你肯聽從我。
english: Give ear, O my people, and I will give you my word, O Israel, if you will only do as I say!

chinese: 在你當中，不可有別的神；外邦的神，你也不可下拜。
english: There is to be no strange god among you; you are not to give worship to any other god.

chinese: 我是耶和華─你的神，曾把你從埃及地領上來；你要大大張口，我就給你充滿。
english: I am the Lord your God, who took you up from the land of Egypt: let your mouth be open wide, so that I may give you food.

chinese: 無奈，我的民不聽我的聲音；以色列全不理我。
english: But my people did not give ear to my voice; Israel would have nothing to do with me.

chinese: 我便任憑他們心裡剛硬，隨自己的計謀而行。
english: So I gave them up to the desires of their hearts; that they might go after their evil purposes.

chinese: 甚願我的民肯聽從我，以色列肯行我的道，
english: If only my people would give ear to me, walking in my ways!

chinese: 我便速速治服他們的仇敵，反手攻擊他們的敵人。
english: I would quickly overcome their haters: my hand would be turned against those who make war on them.

chinese: 恨耶和華的人必來投降，但他的百姓必永久長存。
english: The haters of the Lord would be broken, and their destruction would be eternal.

chinese: 他也必拿上好的麥子給他們吃，又拿從磐石出的蜂蜜叫他們飽足。
english: I would give them the best grain for food; you would be full of honey from the rock.

chinese: （亞薩的詩。）神站在有權力者的會中，在諸　神中行審判，
english: - A Psalm. Of Asaph. - God is in the meeting-place of God; he is judging among the gods.

chinese: 說：你們審判不秉公義，徇惡人的情面，要到幾時呢？（細拉）
english: How long will you go on judging falsely, having respect for the persons of evil-doers? (Selah.)

chinese: 你們當為貧寒的人和孤兒伸冤；當為困苦和窮乏的人施行公義。
english: Give ear to the cause of the poor and the children without fathers; let those who are troubled and in need have their rights.

chinese: 當保護貧寒和窮乏的人，救他們脫離惡人的手。
english: Be the saviour of the poor and those who have nothing: take them out of the hand of the evil-doers.

chinese: 你們仍不知道，也不明白，在黑暗中走來走去；地的根基都搖動了。
english: They have no knowledge or sense; they go about in the dark: all the bases of the earth are moved.

chinese: 我曾說：你們是神，都是至高者的兒子。
english: I said, You are gods; all of you are the sons of the Most High:

chinese: 然而，你們要死，與世人一樣，要仆倒，像王子中的一位。
english: But you will come to death like men, falling like one of the rulers of the earth.

chinese: 神啊，求你起來審判世界，因為你要得萬邦為業。
english: Up! O God, come as judge of the earth; for all the nations are your heritage.

chinese: （亞薩的詩歌。）神啊，求你不要靜默！神啊，求你不要閉口，也不要不作聲！
english: - A Song. A Psalm. Of Asaph. - O God, do not keep quiet: let your lips be open and take no rest, O God.

chinese: 因為你的仇敵喧嚷，恨你的抬起頭來。
english: For see! those who make war on you are out of control; your haters are lifting up their heads.

chinese: 他們同謀奸詐要害你的百姓，彼此商議要害你所隱藏的人。
english: They have made wise designs against your people, talking together against those whom you keep in a secret place.

chinese: 他們說：來罷，我們將他們剪滅，使他們不再成國！使以色列的名不再被人記念！
english: They have said, Come, let us put an end to them as a nation; so that the name of Israel may go out of man's memory.

chinese: 他們同心商議，彼此結盟，要抵擋你，
english: For they have all come to an agreement; they are all joined together against you:

chinese: 就是住帳棚的以東人和以實瑪利人，摩押和夏甲人，
english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagarites;

chinese: 迦巴勒、亞捫，和亞瑪力、非利士並推羅的居民。
english: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek; the Philistines and the people of Tyre;

chinese: 亞述也與他們連合；他們作羅得子孫的幫手。（細拉）
english: Assur is joined with them; they have become the support of the children of Lot. (Selah.)

chinese: 求你待他們，如待米甸，如在基順河待西西拉和耶賓一樣。
english: Do to them what you did to the Midianites; what you did to Sisera and Jabin, at the stream of Kishon:

chinese: 他們在隱多珥滅亡，成了地上的糞土。
english: Who came to destruction at En-dor; their bodies became dust and waste.

chinese: 求你叫他們的首領像俄立和西伊伯，叫他們的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。
english: Make their chiefs like Oreb and Zeeb; and all their rulers like Zebah and Zalmunna:

chinese: 他們說：我們要得神的住處，作為自己的產業。
english: Who have said, Let us take for our heritage the resting-place of God.

chinese: 我的神啊，求你叫他們像旋風的塵土，像風前的碎秸。
english: O my God, make them like the rolling dust; like dry stems before the wind.

chinese: 火怎樣焚燒樹林，火燄怎樣燒著山嶺，
english: As fire burning a wood, and as a flame causing fire on the mountains,

chinese: 求你也照樣用狂風追趕他們，用暴雨恐嚇他們。
english: So go after them with your strong wind, and let them be full of fear because of your storm.

chinese: 願你使他們滿面羞恥，好叫他們尋求你─耶和華的名！
english: Let their faces be full of shame; so that they may give honour to your name, O Lord.

chinese: 願他們永遠羞愧驚惶！願他們慚愧滅亡！
english: Let them be overcome and troubled for ever; let them be put to shame and come to destruction;

chinese: 使他們知道：惟獨你─名為耶和華的─是全地以上的至高者！
english: So that men may see that you only, whose name is Yahweh, are Most High over all the earth.

chinese: （可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。）萬軍之耶和華啊，你的居所何等可愛！
english: - To the chief music-maker; put to the Gittith A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah. - How dear are your tents, O Lord of armies!

chinese: 我羨慕渴想耶和華的院宇；我的心腸，我的肉體向永生神呼籲（或譯：歡呼）。
english: The passion of my soul's desire is for the house of the Lord; my heart and my flesh are crying out for the living God.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華─我的王，我的神啊，在你祭壇那裡，麻雀為自己找著房屋，燕子為自己找著菢雛之窩。
english: The little birds have places for themselves, where they may put their young, even your altars, O Lord of armies, my King and my God.

chinese: 如此住在你殿中的便為有福！他們仍要讚美你。（細拉）
english: Happy are they whose resting-place is in your house: they will still be praising you. (Selah.)

chinese: 靠你有力量、心中想往錫安大道的，這人便為有福！
english: Happy is the man whose strength is in you; in whose heart are the highways to Zion.

chinese: 他們經過流淚谷，叫這谷變為泉源之地；並有秋雨之福蓋滿了全谷。
english: Going through the valley of balsam-trees, they make it a place of springs; it is clothed with blessings by the early rain.

chinese: 他們行走，力上加力，各人到錫安朝見神。
english: They go from strength to strength; every one of them comes before God in Zion.

chinese: 耶和華─萬軍之神啊，求你聽我的禱告！雅各的　神啊，求你留心聽！（細拉）
english: O Lord God of armies, let my prayer come to you: give ear, O God of Jacob. (Selah.)

chinese: 神啊，你是我們的盾牌；求你垂顧觀看你受膏者的面！
english: O God, let your eyes be on him who is our safe cover, and let your heart be turned to your king.

chinese: 在你的院宇住一日，勝似在別處住千日；寧可在我神殿中看門，不願住在惡人的帳棚裡。
english: For a day in your house is better than a thousand. It is better to be a door-keeper in the house of my God, than to be living in the tents of sin.

chinese: 因為耶和華─神是日頭，是盾牌，要賜下恩惠和榮耀。他未嘗留下一樣好處不給那些行動正直的人。
english: The Lord God is our sun and our strength: the Lord will give grace and glory: he will not keep back any good thing from those whose ways are upright.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華啊，倚靠你的人便為有福！
english: O Lord of armies, happy is the man whose hope is in you.

chinese: （可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，你已經向你的地施恩，救回被擄的雅各。
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah. - Lord, you were good to your land: changing the fate of Jacob.

chinese: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽，遮蓋了他們一切的過犯。（細拉）
english: The wrongdoing of your people had forgiveness; all their sin had been covered. (Selah.)

chinese: 你收轉了所發的忿怒和你猛烈的怒氣。
english: You were no longer angry: you were turned from the heat of your wrath.

chinese: 拯救我們的神啊，求你使我們回轉，叫你的惱恨向我們止息。
english: Come back to us, O God of our salvation, and be angry with us no longer.

chinese: 你要向我們發怒到永遠麼？你要將你的怒氣延留到萬代麼？
english: Will you go on being angry with us for ever? will you keep your wrath against us through all the long generations?

chinese: 你不再將我們救活，使你的百姓靠你歡喜麼？
english: Will you not give us life again, so that your people may be glad in you?

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你使我們得見你的慈愛，又將你的救恩賜給我們。
english: Let us see your mercy, O Lord, and give us your salvation.

chinese: 我要聽神─耶和華所說的話；因為他必應許將平安賜給他的百姓─他的聖民；他們卻不可再轉去妄行。
english: I will give ear to the voice of the Lord; for he will say words of peace to his people and to his saints; but let them not go back to their foolish ways.

chinese: 他的救恩誠然與敬畏他的人相近，叫榮耀住在我們的地上。
english: Truly, his salvation is near to his worshippers; so that glory may be in our land.

chinese: 慈愛和誠實彼此相遇；公義和平安彼此相親。
english: Mercy and faith have come together; righteousness and peace have given one another a kiss.

chinese: 誠實從地而生；公義從天而現。
english: Faith comes up from the earth like a plant; righteousness is looking down from heaven.

chinese: 耶和華必將好處賜給我們；我們的地也要多出土產。
english: The Lord will give what is good; and our land will give its increase.

chinese: 公義要行在他面前，叫他的腳蹤成為可走的路。
english: Righteousness will go before him, making a way for his footsteps.

chinese: （大衛的祈禱。）耶和華啊，求你側耳應允我，因我是困苦窮乏的。
english: - A Prayer. Of David. - Let your ears be open to my voice, O Lord, and give me an answer; for I am poor and in need.

chinese: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔誠人。我的神啊，求你拯救這倚靠你的僕人！
english: Keep my soul, for I am true to you; O my God, give salvation to your servant, whose hope is in you.

chinese: 主啊，求你憐憫我，因我終日求告你。
english: Have mercy on me, O Lord; for my cry goes up to you all the day.

chinese: 主啊，求你使僕人心裡歡喜，因為我的心仰望你。
english: Make glad the soul of your servant; for it is lifted up to you, O Lord.

chinese: 主啊，你本為良善，樂意饒恕人，有豐盛的慈愛賜給凡求告你的人。
english: You are good, O Lord, and full of forgiveness; your mercy is great to all who make their cry to you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的禱告，垂聽我懇求的聲音。
english: O Lord, give ear to my prayer; and take note of the sound of my requests.

chinese: 我在患難之日要求告你，因為你必應允我。
english: In the day of my trouble I send up my cry to you; for you will give me an answer.

chinese: 主啊，諸神之中沒有可比你的；你的作為也無可比。
english: There is no god like you, O Lord; there are no works like your works.

chinese: 主啊，你所造的萬民都要來敬拜你；他們也要榮耀你的名。
english: Let all the nations whom you have made come and give worship to you, O Lord, giving glory to your name.

chinese: 因你為大，且行奇妙的事；惟獨你是神。
english: For you are great, and do great works of wonder; you only are God.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我；我要照你的真理行；求你使我專心敬畏你的名！
english: Make your way clear to me, O Lord; I will go on my way in your faith: let my heart be glad in the fear of your name.

chinese: 主─我的神啊，我要一心稱讚你；我要榮耀你的名，直到永遠。
english: I will give you praise, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will give glory to your name for ever.

chinese: 因為，你向我發的慈愛是大的；你救了我的靈魂免入極深的陰間。
english: For your mercy to me is great; you have taken my soul up from the deep places of the underworld.

chinese: 神啊，驕傲的人起來攻擊我，又有一黨強橫的人尋索我的命；他們沒有將你放在眼中。
english: O God, men of pride have come up against me, and the army of violent men would take my life; they have not put you before them.

chinese: 主啊，你是有憐憫有恩典的神，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和誠實。
english: But you, O Lord, are a God full of pity and forgiveness, slow to get angry, great in mercy and wisdom.

chinese: 求你向我轉臉，憐恤我，將你的力量賜給僕人，救你婢女的兒子。
english: O be turned to me and have mercy on me: give your strength to your servant, and your salvation to the son of her who is your servant.

chinese: 求你向我顯出恩待我的憑據，叫恨我的人看見便羞愧，因為你─耶和華幫助我，安慰我。
english: Give me a sign for good; so that my haters may see it and be shamed; because you, Lord, have been my help and comfort.

chinese: （可拉後裔的詩歌。）耶和華所立的根基在聖山上。
english: - Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. A Song. - This house is resting on the holy mountain.

chinese: 他愛錫安的門，勝於愛雅各一切的住處。
english: The Lord has more love for the doors of Zion than for all the tents of Jacob.

chinese: 神的城啊，有榮耀的事乃指著你說的。（細拉）
english: Noble things are said of you, O town of God. (Selah.)

chinese: 我要提起拉哈伯和巴比倫人，是在認識我之中的；看哪，非利士和推羅並古實人，個個生在那裡。
english: Rahab and Babylon will be named among those who have knowledge of me; see, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man had his birth there.

chinese: 論到錫安，必說：這一個、那一個都生在其中，而且至高者必親自堅立這城。
english: And of Zion it will be said, This or that man had his birth there; and the Most High will make her strong.

chinese: 當耶和華記錄萬民的時候，他要點出這一個生在那裡。（細拉）
english: The Lord will keep in mind, when he is writing the records of the people, that this man had his birth there. (Selah.)

chinese: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都要說：我的泉源都在你裡面。
english: The players on instruments will be there, and the dancers will say, All my springs are in you.

chinese: （可拉後裔的詩歌，就是以斯拉人希幔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉利暗俄。）耶和華─拯救我的神啊，我晝夜在你面前呼籲。
english: - A Song. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah. To the chief music-maker; put to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil. Of Heman the Ezrahite. - O Lord, God of my salvation, I have been crying to you for help by day and by night:

chinese: 願我的禱告達到你面前；求你側耳聽我的呼求！
english: Let my prayer come before you; give ear to my cry:

chinese: 因為我心裡滿了患難；我的性命臨近陰間。
english: For my soul is full of evils, and my life has come near to the underworld.

chinese: 我算和下坑的人同列，如同無力（或譯：沒有幫助）的人一樣。
english: I am numbered among those who go down into the earth; I have become like a man for whom there is no help:

chinese: 我被丟在死人中，好像被殺的人躺在墳墓裡。他們是你不再記念的，與你隔絕了。
english: My soul is among the dead, like those in the underworld, to whom you give no more thought; for they are cut off from your care.

chinese: 你把我放在極深的坑裡，在黑暗地方，在深處。
english: You have put me in the lowest deep, even in dark places.

chinese: 你的忿怒重壓我身；你用一切的波浪困住我。（細拉）
english: The weight of your wrath is crushing me, all your waves have overcome me. (Selah.)

chinese: 你把我所認識的隔在遠處，使我為他們所憎惡；我被拘困，不得出來。
english: You have sent my friends far away from me; you have made me a disgusting thing in their eyes: I am shut up, and not able to come out.

chinese: 我的眼睛因困苦而乾癟。耶和華啊，我天天求告你，向你舉手。
english: My eyes are wasting away because of my trouble: Lord, my cry has gone up to you every day, my hands are stretched out to you.

chinese: 你豈要行奇事給死人看麼？難道陰魂還能起來稱讚你麼？（細拉）
english: Will you do works of wonder for the dead? will the shades come back to give you praise? (Selah.)

chinese: 豈能在墳墓裡述說你的慈愛麼？豈能在滅亡中述說你的信實麼？
english: Will the story of your mercy be given in the house of the dead? will news of your faith come to the place of destruction?

chinese: 你的奇事豈能在幽暗裡被知道麼？你的公義豈能在忘記之地被知道麼？
english: May there be knowledge of your wonders in the dark? or of your righteousness where memory is dead?

chinese: 耶和華啊，我呼求你；我早晨的禱告要達到你面前。
english: But to you did I send up my cry, O Lord; in the morning my prayer came before you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你為何丟棄我？為何掩面不顧我？
english: Lord, why have you sent away my soul? why is your face covered from me?

chinese: 我自幼受苦，幾乎死亡；我受你的驚恐，甚至慌張。
english: I have been troubled and in fear of death from the time when I was young; your wrath is hard on me, and I have no strength.

chinese: 你的烈怒漫過我身；你的驚嚇把我剪除。
english: The heat of your wrath has gone over me; I am broken by your cruel punishments.

chinese: 這些終日如水環繞我，一齊都來圍困我。
english: They are round me all the day like water; they have made a circle about me.

chinese: 你把我的良朋密友隔在遠處，使我所認識的人進入黑暗裡。
english: You have sent my friends and lovers far from me; I am gone from the memory of those who are dear to me.

chinese: （以斯拉人以探的訓誨詩。）我要歌唱耶和華的慈愛，直到永遠；我要用口將你的信實傳與萬代。
english: - Maschil. Of Ethan the Ezrahite. - My song will be of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make his faith clear to all generations.

chinese: 因我曾說：你的慈悲必建立到永遠；你的信實必堅立在天上。
english: For you have said, Mercy will be made strong for ever; my faith will be unchanging in the heavens.

chinese: 我與我所揀選的人立了約，向我的僕人大衛起了誓：
english: I have made an agreement with the man of my selection, I have made an oath to David my servant;

chinese: 我要建立你的後裔，直到永遠；要建立你的寶座，直到萬代。（細拉）
english: I will make your seed go on for ever, your kingdom will be strong through all generations. (Selah.)

chinese: 耶和華啊，諸天要稱讚你的奇事；在聖者的會中，要稱讚你的信實。
english: In heaven let them give praise for your wonders, O Lord; and your unchanging faith among the saints.

chinese: 在天空誰能比耶和華呢？神的眾子中，誰能像耶和華呢？
english: For who is there in the heavens in comparison with the Lord? who is like the Lord among the sons of the gods?

chinese: 他在聖者的會中，是大有威嚴的神，比一切在他四圍的更可畏懼。
english: God is greatly to be feared among the saints, and to be honoured over all those who are about him.

chinese: 耶和華─萬軍之神啊，哪一個大能者像你耶和華？你的信實是在你的四圍。
english: O Lord God of armies, who is strong like you, O Jah? and your unchanging faith is round about you.

chinese: 你管轄海的狂傲；波浪翻騰，你就使他平靜了。
english: You have rule over the sea in storm; when its waves are troubled, you make them calm.

chinese: 你打碎了拉哈伯，似乎是已殺的人；你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敵。
english: Rahab was crushed by you like one wounded to death; with your strong arm you put to flight all your haters.

chinese: 天屬你，地也屬你；世界和其中所充滿的都為你所建立。
english: Yours are the heavens, and the earth is yours; you have made the world, and everything which is in it.

chinese: 南北為你所創造；他泊和黑門都因你的名歡呼。
english: You have made the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon are sounding with joy at your name.

chinese: 你有大能的膀臂；你的手有力，你的右手也高舉。
english: Yours is an arm of power; strong is your hand and high your right hand.

chinese: 公義和公平是你寶座的根基；慈愛和誠實行在你前面。
english: The seat of your kingdom is resting on righteousness and right judging: mercy and good faith come before your face.

chinese: 知道向你歡呼的，那民是有福的！耶和華啊，他們在你臉上的末毼行走。
english: Happy are the people who have knowledge of the holy cry: the light of your face, O Lord, will be shining on their way.

chinese: 他們因你的名終日歡樂，因你的公義得以高舉。
english: In your name will they have joy all the day: in your righteousness will they be lifted up.

chinese: 你是他們力量的榮耀；因為你喜悅我們，我們的角必被高舉。
english: For you are the glory of their strength; in your pleasure will our horn be lifted up.

chinese: 我們的盾牌屬耶和華；我們的王屬以色列的聖者。
english: For our breastplate is the Lord; and our king is the Holy One of Israel's.

chinese: 當時，你在異象中曉諭你的聖民，說：我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上；我高舉那從民中所揀選的。
english: Then your voice came to your holy one in a vision, saying, I have put the crown on a strong one, lifting up one taken from among the people.

chinese: 我尋得我的僕人大衛，用我的聖膏膏他。
english: I have made discovery of David my servant; I have put my holy oil on his head.

chinese: 我的手必使他堅立；我的膀臂也必堅固他。
english: My hand will be his support; my arm will give him strength.

chinese: 仇敵必不勒索他；凶惡之子也不苦害他。
english: The deceit of those who are against him will not overcome him; he will not be troubled by the sons of evil.

chinese: 我要在他面前打碎他的敵人，擊殺那恨他的人。
english: I will have those who are against him broken before his face, and his haters will be crushed under my blows.

chinese: 只是我的信實和我的慈愛要與他同在；因我的名，他的角必被高舉。
english: But my faith and my mercy will be with him; and in my name will his horn be lifted up.

chinese: 我要使他的左手伸到海上，右手伸到河上。
english: I will put his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

chinese: 他要稱呼我說：你是我的父，是我的神，是拯救我的磐石。
english: He will say to me, You are my father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.

chinese: 我也要立他為長子，為世上最高的君王。
english: And I will make him the first of my sons, most high over the kings of the earth.

chinese: 我要為他存留我的慈愛，直到永遠；我與他立的約必要堅定。
english: I will keep my mercy for him for ever; my agreement with him will not be changed.

chinese: 我也要使他的後裔存到永遠，使他的寶座如天之久。
english: His seed will keep their place for ever; his kingdom will be eternal, like the heavens.

chinese: 倘若他的子孫離棄我的律法，不照我的典章行，
english: If his children give up my law, and are not ruled by my decisions;

chinese: 背棄我的律例，不遵守我的誡命，
english: If my rules are broken, and my orders are not kept;

chinese: 我就要用杖責罰他們的過犯，用鞭責罰他們的罪孽。
english: Then I will send punishment on them for their sin; my rod will be the reward of their evil-doing.

chinese: 只是我必不將我的慈愛全然收回，也必不叫我的信實廢棄。
english: But I will not take away my mercy from him, and will not be false to my faith.

chinese: 我必不背棄我的約，也不改變我口中所出的。
english: I will be true to my agreement; the things which have gone out of my lips will not be changed.

chinese: 我一次指著自己的聖潔起誓：我決不向大衛說謊！
english: I have made an oath once by my holy name, that I will not be false to David.

chinese: 他的後裔要存到永遠；他的寶座在我面前如日之恆一般，
english: His seed will not come to an end for ever; the seat of his kingdom will be like the sun before me.

chinese: 又如月亮永遠堅立，如天上確實的見證。（細拉）
english: It will be fixed for ever like the moon; and the witness in heaven is true. (Selah.)

chinese: 但你惱怒你的受膏者，就丟掉棄絕他。
english: But you have put him away in disgust; you have been angry with the king of your selection.

chinese: 你厭惡了與僕人所立的約，將他的冠冕踐踏於地。
english: You have made your agreement with your servant of no effect: you have had no respect for his crown, it has come down even to the earth.

chinese: 你拆毀了他一切的籬笆，使他的保障變為荒場。
english: All his walls are broken down; you have given his strong towers to destruction.

chinese: 凡過路的人都搶奪他；他成為鄰邦的羞辱。
english: All those who come by take away his goods; he is laughed at by his neighbours.

chinese: 你高舉了他敵人的右手；你叫他一切的仇敵歡喜。
english: You have given power to the right hand of his haters; you have made glad all those who are against him.

chinese: 你叫他的刀劍捲刃，叫他在爭戰之中站立不住。
english: His sword is turned back; you have not been his support in the fight.

chinese: 你使他的光輝止息，將他的寶座推倒於地。
english: You have put an end to his glory: the seat of his kingdom has been levelled to the earth.

chinese: 你減少他青年的日子，又使他蒙羞。（細拉）
english: You have made him old before his time; he is covered with shame. (Selah.)

chinese: 耶和華啊，這要到幾時呢？你要將自己隱藏到永遠麼？你的忿怒如火焚燒要到幾時呢？
english: How long, O Lord, will you Keep yourself for ever from our eyes? how long will your wrath be burning like fire?

chinese: 求你想念我的時候是何等的短少；你創造世人，要使他們歸何等的虛空呢？
english: See how short my time is; why have you made all men for no purpose?

chinese: 誰能常活免死、救他的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄呢？（細拉）
english: What man now living will not see death? will he be able to keep back his soul from the underworld? (Selah.)

chinese: 主啊，你從前憑你的信實向大衛立誓要施行的慈愛在哪裡呢？
english: Lord, where are your earlier mercies? where is the oath which you made to David in unchanging faith?

chinese: 主啊，求你記念僕人們所受的羞辱，記念我怎樣將一切強盛民的羞辱存在我懷裡。
english: Keep in mind, O Lord, the shame of your servants, and how the bitter words of all the people have come into my heart;

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的仇敵用這羞辱羞辱了你的僕人，羞辱了你受膏者的腳蹤。
english: The bitter words of your haters, O Lord, shaming the footsteps of your king.

chinese: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，直到永遠。阿們！阿們！
english: Let the Lord be praised for ever. So be it, So be it.

chinese: （神人摩西的祈禱）主啊，你世世代代作我們的居所。
english: - A Prayer of Moses, the man of God. - Lord, you have been our resting-place in all generations.

chinese: 諸山未曾生出，地與世界你未曾造成，從亙古到永遠，你是神。
english: Before the mountains were made, before you had given birth to the earth and the world, before time was, and for ever, you are God.

chinese: 你使人歸於塵土，說：你們世人要歸回。
english: You send man back to his dust; and say, Go back, you children of men.

chinese: 在你看來，千年如已過的昨日，又如夜間的一更。
english: For to you a thousand years are no more than yesterday when it is past, and like a watch in the night.

chinese: 你叫他們如水沖去；他們如睡一覺。早晨，他們如生長的草，
早晨發芽生長，晚上割下枯乾。
english: In the morning it is green; in the evening it is cut down, and becomes dry.

chinese: 我們因你的怒氣而消滅，因你的忿怒而驚惶。
english: We are burned up by the heat of your passion, and troubled by your wrath.

chinese: 你將我們的罪孽擺在你面前，將我們的隱惡擺在你面光之中。
english: You have put our evil doings before you, our secret sins in the light of your face.

chinese: 我們經過的日子都在你震怒之下；我們度盡的年歲好像一聲歎息。
english: For all our days have gone by in your wrath; our years come to an end like a breath.

chinese: 我們一生的年日是七十歲，若是強壯可到八十歲；但其中所矜誇的不過是勞苦愁煩，轉眼成空，我們便如飛而去。
english: The measure of our life is seventy years; and if through strength it may be eighty years, its pride is only trouble and sorrow, for it comes to an end and we are quickly gone.

chinese: 誰曉得你怒氣的權勢？誰按著你該受的敬畏曉得你的忿怒呢？
english: Who has knowledge of the power of your wrath, or who takes note of the weight of your passion?

chinese: 求你指教我們怎樣數算自己的日子，好叫我們得著智慧的心。
english: So give us knowledge of the number of our days, that we may get a heart of wisdom.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我們要等到幾時呢？求你轉回，為你的僕人後悔。
english: Come back, O Lord; how long? let your purpose for your servants be changed.

chinese: 求你使我們早早飽得你的慈愛，好叫我們一生一世歡呼喜樂。
english: In the morning give us your mercy in full measure; so that we may have joy and delight all our days.

chinese: 求你照著你使我們受苦的日子，和我們遭難的年歲，叫我們喜樂。
english: Make us glad in reward for the days of our sorrow, and for the years in which we have seen evil.

chinese: 願你的作為向你僕人顯現；願你的榮耀向他們子孫顯明。
english: Make your work clear to your servants, and your glory to their children.

chinese: 願主─我們神的榮美歸於我們身上。願你堅立我們手所做的工；我們手所做的工，願你堅立。
english: Let the pleasure of the Lord our God be on us: O Lord, give strength to the work of our hands.

chinese: 住在至高者隱密處的，必住在全能者的蔭下。
english: Happy is he whose resting-place is in the secret of the Lord, and under the shade of the wings of the Most High;

chinese: 我要論到耶和華說：他是我的避難所，是我的山寨，是我的神，是我所倚靠的。
english: Who says of the Lord, He is my safe place and my tower of strength: he is my God, in whom is my hope.

chinese: 他必救你脫離捕鳥人的網羅和毒害的瘟疫。
english: He will take you out of the bird-net, and keep you safe from wasting disease.

chinese: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你；你要投靠在他的翅膀底下；他的誠實是大小的盾牌。
english: You will be covered by his feathers; under his wings you will be safe: his good faith will be your salvation.

chinese: 你必不怕黑夜的驚駭，或是白日飛的箭，
english: You will have no fear of the evil things of the night, or of the arrow in flight by day,

chinese: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫，或是午間滅人的毒病。
english: Or of the disease which takes men in the dark, or of the destruction which makes waste when the sun is high.

chinese: 雖有千人仆倒在你旁邊，萬人仆倒在你右邊，這災卻不得臨近你。
english: You will see a thousand falling by your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

chinese: 你惟親眼觀看，見惡人遭報。
english: Only with your eyes will you see the reward of the evil-doers.

chinese: 耶和華是我的避難所；你已將至高者當你的居所，
english: Because you have said, I am in the hands of the Lord, the Most High is my safe resting-place;

chinese: 禍患必不臨到你，災害也不挨近你的帳棚。
english: No evil will come on you, and no disease will come near your tent.

chinese: 因他要為你吩咐他的使者，在你行的一切道路上保護你。
english: For he will give you into the care of his angels to keep you wherever you go.

chinese: 他們要用手托著你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。
english: In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.

chinese: 你要踹在獅子和虺蛇的身上，踐踏少壯獅子和大蛇。
english: You will put your foot on the lion and the snake; the young lion and the great snake will be crushed under your feet.

chinese: 神說：因為他專心愛我，我就要搭救他；因為他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高處。
english: Because he has given me his love, I will take him out of danger: I will put him in a place of honour, because he has kept my name in his heart.

chinese: 他若求告我，我就應允他；他在急難中，我要與他同在；我要搭救他，使他尊貴。
english: When his cry comes up to me, I will give him an answer: I will be with him in trouble; I will make him free from danger and give him honour.

chinese: 我要使他足享長壽，將我的救恩顯明給他。
english: With long life will he be rewarded; and I will let him see my salvation.

chinese: （安息日的詩歌。）稱謝耶和華！歌頌你至高者的名！
english: - A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath. - It is a good thing to give praise to the Lord, and to make melody to your name, O Most High;

chinese: 用十弦的樂器和瑟，用琴彈幽雅的聲音，早晨傳揚你的慈愛；每夜傳揚你的信實。這本為美事。
english: To make clear your mercy in the morning, and your unchanging faith every night;
On a ten-corded instrument, and on an instrument of music with a quiet sound.

chinese: 因你─耶和華藉著你的作為叫我高興，我要因你手的工作歡呼。
english: For you, O Lord, have made me glad through your work; I will have joy in the works of your hands.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的工作何其大！你的心思極其深！
english: O Lord, how great are your works! and your thoughts are very deep.

chinese: 畜類人不曉得；愚頑人也不明白。
english: A man without sense has no knowledge of this; and a foolish man may not take it in.

chinese: 惡人茂盛如草，一切作孽之人發旺的時候，正是他們要滅亡，直到永遠。
english: When the sinners come up like the grass, and all the workers of evil do well for themselves, it is so that their end may be eternal destruction.

chinese: 惟你─耶和華是至高，直到永遠。
english: But you, O Lord, are on high for ever.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的仇敵都要滅亡；一切作孽的也要離散。
english: For see! your haters, O Lord, will be put to death; all the workers of evil will be put to flight;

chinese: 你卻高舉了我的角，如野牛的角；我是被新油膏了的。
english: But my horn is lifted up like the horn of the ox: the best oil is flowing on my head.

chinese: 我眼睛看見仇敵遭報；我耳朵聽見那些起來攻擊我的惡人受罰。
english: My eyes have seen trouble come on my haters; my ears have news of the fate of the evil-doers who have come up against me.

chinese: 義人要發旺如棕樹，生長如利巴嫩的香柏樹。
english: The good man will be like a tall tree in his strength; his growth will be as the wide-stretching trees of Lebanon.

chinese: 他們栽於耶和華的殿中，發旺在我們神的院裡。
english: Those who are planted in the house of the Lord will come up tall and strong in his gardens.

chinese: 他們年老的時候仍要結果子，要滿了汁漿而常發青，
english: They will give fruit even when they are old; they will be fertile and full of growth;

chinese: 好顯明耶和華是正直的。他是我的磐石，在他毫無不義。
english: For a sign that the Lord is upright; he is my Rock, there is no deceit in him.

chinese: 耶和華作王！他以威嚴為衣穿上；耶和華以能力為衣，以能力束腰，世界就堅定，不得動搖。
english: The Lord is King; he is clothed with glory; the Lord is clothed with strength; power is the cord of his robe; the world is fixed, so that it may not be moved.

chinese: 你的寶座從太初立定；你從亙古就有。
english: The seat of your power has been from the past; you are eternal.

chinese: 耶和華啊，大水揚起，大水發聲，波浪澎湃。
english: The rivers send up, O Lord, the rivers send up their voices; they send them up with a loud cry.

chinese: 耶和華在高處大有能力，勝過諸水的響聲，洋海的大浪。
english: The Lord in heaven is stronger than the noise of great waters, yes, he is stronger than the great waves of the sea.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的法度最的確；你的殿永稱為聖，是合宜的。
english: Your witness is most certain; it is right for your house to be holy, O Lord, for ever.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你是伸冤的神；伸冤的神啊，求你發出光來！
english: O God, in whose hands is punishment, O God of punishment, let your shining face be seen.

chinese: 審判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立，使驕傲人受應得的報應！
english: Be lifted up, O judge of the earth; let their reward come to the men of pride.

chinese: 耶和華啊，惡人誇勝要到幾時呢？要到幾時呢？
english: How long will sinners, O Lord, how long will sinners have joy over us?

chinese: 他們絮絮叨叨說傲慢的話；一切作孽的人都自己誇張。
english: Words of pride come from their lips; all the workers of evil say great things of themselves.

chinese: 耶和華啊，他們強壓你的百姓，苦害你的產業。
english: Your people are crushed by them, O Lord, your heritage is troubled,

chinese: 他們殺死寡婦和寄居的，又殺害孤兒。
english: They put to death the widow and the guest, they take the lives of children who have no father;

chinese: 他們說：耶和華必不看見；雅各的神必不思念。
english: And they say, Jah will not see it, the God of Jacob will not give thought to it.

chinese: 你們民間的畜類人當思想；你們愚頑人到幾時才有智慧呢？
english: Give your mind to my words, you who are without wisdom among the people; you foolish men, when will you be wise?

chinese: 造耳朵的，難道自己不聽見麼？造眼睛的，難道自己不看見麼？
english: Has he by whom your ears were planted no hearing? or is he blind by whom your eyes were formed?

chinese: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知識的，難道自己不懲治人麼？
english: He who is the judge of the nations, will he not give men the reward of their acts, even he who gives knowledge to man?

chinese: 耶和華知道人的意念是虛妄的。
english: The Lord has knowledge of the thoughts of man, for they are only a breath.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你所管教、用律法所教訓的人是有福的！
english: Happy is the man who is guided by you, O Jah, and to whom you give teaching out of your law;

chinese: 你使他在遭難的日子得享平安；惟有惡人陷在所挖的坑中。
english: So that you may give him rest from the days of evil, till a hole is made ready for the destruction of the sinners.

chinese: 因為耶和華必不丟棄他的百姓，也不離棄他的產業。
english: The Lord will not give up his people, or take away his support from his heritage;

chinese: 審判要轉向公義；心裡正直的，必都隨從。
english: But decisions will again be made in righteousness; and they will be kept by all whose hearts are true.

chinese: 誰肯為我起來攻擊作惡的？誰肯為我站起抵擋作孽的？
english: Who will give me help against the sinners? and who will be my support against the workers of evil?

chinese: 若不是耶和華幫助我，我就住在寂靜之中了。
english: If the Lord had not been my helper, my soul would quickly have gone down into death.

chinese: 我正說我失了腳，耶和華啊，那時你的慈愛扶助我。
english: If I say, My foot is slipping; your mercy, O Lord, is my support.

chinese: 我心裡多憂多疑，你安慰我，就使我歡樂。
english: Among all my troubled thoughts, your comforts are the delight of my soul.

chinese: 那藉著律例架弄殘害、在位上行奸惡的，豈能與你相交麼？
english: What part with you has the seat of sin, which makes evil into a law?

chinese: 他們大家聚集攻擊義人，將無辜的人定為死罪。
english: They are banded together against the soul of the upright, to give decisions against those who have done no wrong.

chinese: 但耶和華向來作了我的高臺；我的神作了我投靠的磐石。
english: But the Lord is my safe resting-place; my God is the Rock where I am safe.

chinese: 他叫他們的罪孽歸到他們身上。他們正在行惡之中，他要剪除他們；耶和華─我們的神要把他們剪除。
english: And he has made their evil designs come back on themselves, cutting them off in their sin; the Lord our God will put an end to them.

chinese: 來啊，我們要向耶和華歌唱，向拯救我們的磐石歡呼！
english: O come, let us make songs to the Lord; sending up glad voices to the Rock of our salvation.

chinese: 我們要來感謝他，用詩歌向他歡呼！
english: Let us come before his face with praises; and make melody with holy songs.

chinese: 因耶和華為大神，為大王，超乎萬神之上。
english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King over all gods.

chinese: 地的深處在他手中；山的高峰也屬他。
english: The deep places of the earth are in his hand; and the tops of the mountains are his.

chinese: 海洋屬他，是他造的；旱地也是他手造成的。
english: The sea is his, and he made it; and the dry land was formed by his hands.

chinese: 來啊，我們要屈身敬拜，在造我們的耶和華面前跪下。
english: O come, let us give worship, falling down on our knees before the Lord our Maker.

chinese: 因為他是我們的神；我們是他草場的羊，是他手下的民。惟願你們今天聽他的話：
english: For he is our God; and we are the people to whom he gives food, and the sheep of his flock. Today, if you would only give ear to his voice!

chinese: 你們不可硬著心，像當日在米利巴，就是在曠野的瑪撒。
english: Let not your hearts be hard, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the waste land;

chinese: 那時，你們的祖宗試我探我，並且觀看我的作為。
english: When your fathers put me to the test and saw my power and my work.

chinese: 四十年之久，我厭煩那世代，說：這是心裡迷糊的百姓，竟不曉得我的作為！
english: For forty years I was angry with this generation, and said, They are a people whose hearts are turned away from me, for they have no knowledge of my ways;

chinese: 所以，我在怒中起誓，說：他們斷不可進入我的安息！
english: And I made an oath in my wrath, that they might not come into my place of rest.

chinese: 你們要向耶和華唱新歌！全地都要向耶和華歌唱！
english: O make a new song to the Lord; let all the earth make melody to the Lord.

chinese: 要向耶和華歌唱，稱頌他的名！天天傳揚他的救恩！
english: Make songs to the Lord, blessing his name; give the good news of his salvation day by day.

chinese: 在列邦中述說他的榮耀！在萬民中述說他的奇事！
english: Make clear his glory to the nations, and his wonders to all the peoples.

chinese: 因耶和華為大，當受極大的讚美；他在萬神之上，當受敬畏。
english: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised; he is more to be feared than all other gods.

chinese: 外邦的神都屬虛無；惟獨耶和華創造諸天。
english: For all the gods of the nations are false gods; but the Lord made the heavens.

chinese: 有尊榮和威嚴在他面前；有能力與華美在他聖所。
english: Honour and glory are before him: strong and fair is his holy place.

chinese: 民中的萬族啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華，都歸給耶和華！
english: Give to the Lord, O you families of the peoples, give to the Lord glory and strength.

chinese: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他，拿供物來進入他的院宇。
english: Give to the Lord the glory of his name; take with you an offering and come into his house.

chinese: 當以聖潔的（的：或譯為）妝飾敬拜耶和華；全地要在他面前戰抖！
english: O give worship to the Lord in holy robes; be in fear before him, all the earth.

chinese: 人在列邦中要說：耶和華作王！世界就堅定，不得動搖；他要按公正審判眾民。
english: Say among the nations, The Lord is King; yes, the world is ordered so that it may not be moved; he will be an upright judge of the peoples.

chinese: 願天歡喜，願地快樂！願海和其中所充滿的澎湃！
english: Let the heavens have joy and the earth be glad; let the sea be thundering with all its waters;

chinese: 願田和其中所有的都歡樂！那時，林中的樹木都要在耶和華面前歡呼。
english: Let the field be glad, and everything which is in it; yes, let all the trees of the wood be sounding with joy,

chinese: 因為他來了，他來要審判全地。他要按公義審判世界，按他的信實審判萬民。
english: Before the Lord, for he is come; he is come to be the judge of the earth; the earth will be judged in righteousness, and the peoples with unchanging faith.

chinese: 耶和華作王！願地快樂！願眾海島歡喜！
english: The Lord is King, let the earth have joy; let all the sea-lands be glad.

chinese: 密雲和幽暗在他的四圍；公義和公平是他寶座的根基。
english: Dark clouds are round him; his kingdom is based on righteousness and right judging.

chinese: 有烈火在他前頭行，燒滅他四圍的敵人。
english: Fire goes before him, burning up all those who are against him round about.

chinese: 他的閃電光照世界，大地看見便震動。
english: His bright flames give light to the world; the earth saw it with fear.

chinese: 諸山見耶和華的面，就是全地之主的面，便消化如蠟。
english: The mountains became like wax at the coming of the Lord, at the coming of the Lord of all the earth.

chinese: 諸天表明他的公義；萬民看見他的榮耀。
english: The heavens gave out the news of his righteousness, and all the people saw his glory.

chinese: 願一切事奉雕刻的偶像、靠虛無之神自誇的，都蒙羞愧。萬神哪，你們都當拜他。
english: Shamed be all those who give worship to images, and take pride in false gods; give him worship, all you gods.

chinese: 耶和華啊，錫安聽見你的判斷就歡喜；猶大的城邑（原文是女子）也都快樂。
english: Zion gave ear and was glad; and the daughters of Judah were full of joy, because of your decisions, O Lord.

chinese: 因為你─耶和華至高，超乎全地；你被尊崇，遠超萬神之上。
english: For you, Lord, are most high over the earth; you are lifted up over all other gods.

chinese: 你們愛耶和華的，都當恨惡罪惡；他保護聖民的性命，搭救他們脫離惡人的手。
english: You who are lovers of the Lord, be haters of evil; he keeps the souls of his saints; he takes them out of the hand of sinners.

chinese: 散布亮光是為義人；預備喜樂是為正直人。
english: Light is shining on the lovers of righteousness, and for the upright in heart there is joy.

chinese: 你們義人當靠耶和華歡喜，稱謝他可記念的聖名。
english: Be glad in the Lord, you upright men; praising the memory of his holy name.

chinese: （一篇詩。）你們要向耶和華唱新歌！因為他行過奇妙的事；他的右手和聖臂施行救恩。
english: - A Psalm. - O make a new song to the Lord, because he has done works of wonder; with his right hand, and with his holy arm, he has overcome.

chinese: 耶和華發明了他的救恩，在列邦人眼前顯出公義；
english: The Lord has given to all the knowledge of his salvation; he has made clear his righteousness in the eyes of the nations.

chinese: 記念他向以色列家所發的慈愛，所憑的信實。地的四極都看見我們神的救恩。
english: He has kept in mind his mercy and his unchanging faith to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

chinese: 全地都要向耶和華歡樂；要發起大聲，歡呼歌頌！
english: Let all the earth send out a glad cry to the Lord; sounding with a loud voice, and praising him with songs of joy.

chinese: 要用琴歌頌耶和華，用琴和詩歌的聲音歌頌他！
english: Make melody to the Lord with instruments of music; with a corded instrument and the voice of song.

chinese: 用號和角聲，在大君王耶和華面前歡呼！
english: With wind instruments and the sound of the horn, make a glad cry before the Lord, the King.

chinese: 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃；世界和住在其間的也要發聲。
english: Let the sea be thundering, with all its waters; the world, and all who are living in it;

chinese: 願大水拍手；願諸山在耶和華面前一同歡呼；
english: Let the streams make sounds of joy with their hands; let the mountains be glad together,

chinese: 因為他來要審判遍地。他要按公義審判世界，按公正審判萬民。
english: Before the Lord, for he has come as judge of the earth; judging the world in righteousness, and giving true decisions for the peoples.

chinese: 耶和華作王；萬民當戰抖！他坐在二基路伯上，地當動搖。
english: The Lord is King; let the peoples be in fear: his seat is on the winged ones; let the earth be moved.

chinese: 耶和華在錫安為大；他超乎萬民之上。
english: The Lord is great in Zion; he is high over all the nations.

chinese: 他們當稱讚他大而可畏的名；他本為聖！
english: Let them give praise to your name, for it is great and to be feared; holy is he.

chinese: 王有能力，喜愛公平，堅立公正，在雅各中施行公平和公義。
english: The king's power is used for righteousness; you give true decisions, judging rightly in the land of Jacob.

chinese: 你們當尊崇耶和華─我們的神，在他腳凳前下拜。他本為聖！
english: Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping at his feet; holy is he.

chinese: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亞倫；在求告他名的人中有撒母耳。他們求告耶和華，他就應允他們。
english: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who gave honour to his name; they made prayers to the Lord, and he gave answers to them.

chinese: 他在雲柱中對他們說話；他們遵守他的法度和他所賜給他們的律例。
english: His voice came to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his witness, and the law which he gave them.

chinese: 耶和華─我們的神啊，你應允他們；你是赦免他們的　神，卻按他們所行的報應他們。
english: You gave them an answer, O Lord our God; you took away their sin, though you gave them punishment for their wrongdoing.

chinese: 你們要尊崇耶和華─我們的神，在他的聖山下拜，因為耶和華─我們的　神本為聖！
english: Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping with your faces turned to his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.

chinese: （稱謝詩。）普天下當向耶和華歡呼！
english: - A Psalm of Praise. - Make a glad sound to the Lord, all the earth.

chinese: 你們當樂意事奉耶和華，當來向他歌唱！
english: Give worship to the Lord with joy; come before him with a song.

chinese: 你們當曉得耶和華是神！我們是他造的，也是屬他的；我們是他的民，也是他草場的羊。
english: Be certain that the Lord is God; it is he who has made us, and we are his; we are his people, and the sheep to whom he gives food.

chinese: 當稱謝進入他的門；當讚美進入他的院。當感謝他，稱頌他的名！
english: Come into his doors with joy, and into his house with praise; give him honour, blessing his name.

chinese: 因為耶和華本為善。他的慈愛存到永遠；他的信實直到萬代。
english: For the Lord is good, and his mercy is never-ending; his faith is unchanging through all generations.

chinese: （大衛的詩）我要歌唱慈愛和公平；耶和華啊，我要向你歌頌！
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - I will make a song of mercy and righteousness; to you, O Lord, will I make melody.

chinese: 我要用智慧行完全的道。你幾時到我這裡來呢？我要存完全的心行在我家中。
english: I will do wisely in the way of righteousness: O when will you come to me? I will be walking in my house with a true heart.

chinese: 邪僻的事，我都不擺在我眼前；悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨惡，不容沾在我身上。
english: I will not put any evil thing before my eyes; I am against all turning to one side; I will not have it near me.

chinese: 彎曲的心思，我必遠離；一切的惡人（或譯：惡事），我不認識。
english: The false heart I will send away from me: I will not have an evil-doer for a friend.

chinese: 在暗中讒謗他鄰居的，我必將他滅絕；眼目高傲、心裡驕縱的，我必不容他。
english: I will put to death anyone who says evil of his neighbour secretly; the man with a high look and a heart of pride is disgusting to me.

chinese: 我眼要看國中的誠實人，叫他們與我同住；行為完全的，他要伺候我。
english: My eyes will be on those of good faith in the land, so that they may be living in my house; he who is walking in the right way will be my servant.

chinese: 行詭詐的，必不得住在我家裡；說謊話的，必不得立在我眼前。
english: The worker of deceit will not come into my house; the false man will have no place before my eyes.

chinese: 我每日早晨要滅絕國中所有的惡人，好把一切作孽的從耶和華的城裡剪除。
english: Morning by morning will I put to death all the sinners in the land, so that all evil-doers may be cut off from Jerusalem.

chinese: （困苦人發昏的時候，在耶和華面前吐露苦情的禱告。）耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，容我的呼求達到你面前！
english: - A Prayer of the man who is in trouble, when he is overcome, and puts his grief before the Lord. - Give ear to my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come to you.

chinese: 我在急難的日子，求你向我側耳；不要向我掩面！我呼求的日子，求你快快應允我！
english: Let not your face be veiled from me in the day of my trouble; give ear to me, and let my cry be answered quickly.

chinese: 因為，我的年日如煙雲消滅；我的骨頭如火把燒著。
english: My days are wasted like smoke, and my bones are burned up as in a fire.

chinese: 我的心被傷，如草枯乾，甚至我忘記吃飯。
english: My heart is broken; it has become dry and dead like grass, so that I give no thought to food.

chinese: 因我唉哼的聲音，我的肉緊貼骨頭。
english: Because of the voice of my sorrow, my flesh is wasted to the bone.

chinese: 我如同曠野的鵜鶘；我好像荒場的鴞鳥。
english: I am like a bird living by itself in the waste places; like the night-bird in a waste of sand.

chinese: 我警醒不睡；我像房頂上孤單的麻雀。
english: I keep watch like a bird by itself on the house-top.

chinese: 我的仇敵終日辱罵我；向我猖狂的人指著我賭咒。
english: My haters say evil of me all day; those who are violent against me make use of my name as a curse.

chinese: 我吃過爐灰，如同吃飯；我所喝的與眼淚攙雜。
english: I have had dust for bread and my drink has been mixed with weeping:

chinese: 這都因你的惱恨和忿怒；你把我拾起來，又把我摔下去。
english: Because of your passion and your wrath, for I have been lifted up and then made low by you.

chinese: 我的年日如日影偏斜；我也如草枯乾。
english: My days are like a shade which is stretched out; I am dry like the grass.

chinese: 惟你─耶和華必存到永遠；你可記念的名也存到萬代。
english: But you, O Lord, are eternal; and your name will never come to an end.

chinese: 你必起來憐恤錫安，因現在是可憐他的時候，日期已經到了。
english: You will again get up and have mercy on Zion: for the time has come for her to be comforted.

chinese: 你的僕人原來喜悅他的石頭，可憐他的塵土。
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, looking with love on her dust.

chinese: 列國要敬畏耶和華的名；世上諸王都敬畏你的榮耀。
english: So the nations will give honour to the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth will be in fear of his glory:

chinese: 因為耶和華建造了錫安，在他榮耀裡顯現。
english: When the Lord has put up the walls of Zion, and has been been in his glory;

chinese: 他垂聽窮人的禱告，並不藐視他們的祈求。
english: When he has given ear to the prayer of the poor, and has not put his request on one side.

chinese: 這必為後代的人記下，將來受造的民要讚美耶和華。
english: This will be put in writing for the coming generation, and the people of the future will give praise to the Lord.

chinese: 因為，他從至高的聖所垂看；耶和華從天向地觀察，
english: For from his holy place the Lord has seen, looking down on the earth from heaven;

chinese: 要垂聽被囚之人的歎息，要釋放將要死的人，
english: Hearing the cry of the prisoner, making free those for whom death is ordered;

chinese: 使人在錫安傳揚耶和華的名，在耶路撒冷傳揚讚美他的話，
english: So that they may give out the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

chinese: 就是在萬民和列國聚會事奉耶和華的時候。
english: When the peoples are come together, and the kingdoms, to give worship to the Lord.

chinese: 他使我的力量中道衰弱，使我的年日短少。
english: He has taken my strength from me in the way; he has made short my days.

chinese: 我說：我的神啊，不要使我中年去世。你的年數世世無窮！
english: I will say, O my God, take me not away before my time; your years go on through all generations:

chinese: 你起初立了地的根基；天也是你手所造的。
english: In the past you put the earth on its base, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

chinese: 天地都要滅沒，你卻要長存；天地都要如外衣漸漸舊了。你要將天地如裡衣更換，天地就改變了。
english: They will come to an end, but you will still go on; they all will become old like a coat, and like a robe they will be changed:

chinese: 惟有你永不改變；你的年數沒有窮盡。
english: But you are the unchanging One, and your years will have no end.

chinese: 你僕人的子孫要長存；他們的後裔要堅立在你面前。
english: The children of your servants will have a safe resting-place, and their seed will be ever before you.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！凡在我裡面的，也要稱頌他的聖名！
english: - Of David. - Give praise to the Lord, O my soul; let everything in me give praise to his holy name.

chinese: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！不可忘記他的一切恩惠！
english: Give praise to the Lord, O my soul; let not all his blessings go from your memory.

chinese: 他赦免你的一切罪孽，醫治你的一切疾病。
english: He has forgiveness for all your sins; he takes away all your diseases;

chinese: 他救贖你的命脫離死亡，以仁愛和慈悲為你的冠冕。
english: He keeps back your life from destruction, crowning you with mercy and grace.

chinese: 他用美物使你所願的得以知足，以致你如鷹返老還童。
english: He makes your mouth full of good things, so that your strength is made new again like the eagle's.

chinese: 耶和華施行公義，為一切受屈的人伸冤。
english: The Lord gives decisions in righteousness for all who are in trouble.

chinese: 他使摩西知道他的法則，叫以色列人曉得他的作為。
english: He gave knowledge of his way to Moses, and made his acts clear to the children of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華有憐憫，有恩典，不輕易發怒，且有豐盛的慈愛。
english: The Lord is kind and full of pity, not quickly made angry, but ever ready to have mercy.

chinese: 他不長久責備，也不永遠懷怒。
english: His feeling will no longer be bitter; he will not keep his wrath for ever.

chinese: 他沒有按我們的罪過待我們，也沒有照我們的罪孽報應我們。
english: He has not given us the punishment for our sins, or the reward of our wrongdoing.

chinese: 天離地何等的高，他的慈愛向敬畏他的人也是何等的大！
english: For as the heaven is high over the earth, so great is his mercy to his worshippers.

chinese: 東離西有多遠，他叫我們的過犯離我們也有多遠！
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he put our sins from us.

chinese: 父親怎樣憐恤他的兒女，耶和華也怎樣憐恤敬畏他的人！
english: As a father has pity on his children, so the Lord has pity on his worshippers.

chinese: 因為他知道我們的本體，思念我們不過是塵土。
english: For he has knowledge of our feeble frame; he sees that we are only dust.

chinese: 至於世人，他的年日如草一樣。他發旺如野地的花，
english: As for man, his days are as grass: his beautiful growth is like the flower of the field.

chinese: 經風一吹，便歸無有；他的原處也不再認識他。
english: The wind goes over it and it is gone; and its place sees it no longer.

chinese: 但耶和華的慈愛歸於敬畏他的人，從亙古到永遠；他的公義也歸於子子孫孫
english: But the mercy of the Lord is eternal for his worshippers, and their children's children will see his righteousness;

chinese: 就是那些遵守他的約、記念他的訓詞而遵行的人。
english: If they keep his agreement, and have his laws in mind to do them.

chinese: 耶和華在天上立定寶座；他的權柄（原文是國）統管萬有。
english: The Lord has made ready his high seat in the heavens; his kingdom is ruling over all.

chinese: 聽從他命令、成全他旨意、有大能的天使，都要稱頌耶和華！
english: Give praise to the Lord, you his angels, who are great in strength, doing his orders, and waiting for his voice.

chinese: 你們作他的諸軍，作他的僕役，行他所喜悅的，都要稱頌耶和華！
english: Give praise to the Lord, all you his armies; and you his servants who do his pleasure.

chinese: 你們一切被他造的，在他所治理的各處，都要稱頌耶和華！我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！
english: Give praise to the Lord, all his works, in all places under his rule: give praise to the Lord, O my soul.

chinese: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！耶和華─我的神啊，你為至大！你以尊榮威嚴為衣服，
english: Give praise to the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, you are very great; you are robed with honour and power.

chinese: 披上亮光，如披外袍，鋪張穹蒼，如鋪幔子，
english: You are clothed with light as with a robe; stretching out the heavens like a curtain:

chinese: 在水中立樓閣的棟梁，用雲彩為車輦，藉著風的翅膀而行，
english: The arch of your house is based on the waters; you make the clouds your carriage; you go on the wings of the wind:

chinese: 以風為使者，以火燄為僕役，
english: He makes winds his angels, and flames of fire his servants.

chinese: 將地立在根基上，使地永不動搖。
english: He has made the earth strong on its bases, so that it may not be moved for ever and ever;

chinese: 你用深水遮蓋地面，猶如衣裳；諸水高過山嶺。
english: Covering it with the sea as with a robe: the waters were high over the mountains;

chinese: 你的斥責一發，水便奔逃；你的雷聲一發，水便奔流。
english: At the voice of your word they went in flight; at the sound of your thunder they went away in fear;

chinese: 諸山升上，諸谷沉下（或譯：隨山上翻，隨谷下流），歸你為他所安定之地。
english: The mountains came up and the valleys went down into the place which you had made ready for them.

chinese: 你定了界限，使水不能過去，不再轉回遮蓋地面。
english: You made a limit over which they might not go, so that the earth would never again be covered by them.

chinese: 耶和華使泉源湧在山谷，流在山間，
english: You sent the springs into the valleys; they are flowing between the hills.

chinese: 使野地的走獸有水喝，野驢得解其渴。
english: They give drink to every beast of the field; the mountain asses come to them for water.

chinese: 天上的飛鳥在水旁住宿，在樹枝上啼叫。
english: The birds of the air have their resting-places by them, and make their song among the branches.

chinese: 他從樓閣中澆灌山嶺；因他作為的功效，地就豐足。
english: He sends down rain from his store-houses on the hills: the earth is full of the fruit of his works.

chinese: 他使草生長，給六畜吃，使菜蔬發長，供給人用，使人從地裡能得食物，
english: He makes the grass come up for the cattle, and plants for the use of man; so that bread may come out of the earth;

chinese: 又得酒能悅人心，得油能潤人面，得糧能養人心。
english: And wine to make glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face shining, and bread giving strength to his heart.

chinese: 佳美的樹木，就是利巴嫩的香柏樹，是耶和華所栽種的，都滿了汁漿。
english: The trees of the Lord are full of growth, the cedars of Lebanon of his planting;

chinese: 雀鳥在其上搭窩；至於鶴，松樹是他的房屋。
english: Where the birds have their resting-places; as for the stork, the tall trees are her house.

chinese: 高山為野山羊的住所；巖石為沙番的藏處。
english: The high hills are a safe place for the mountain goats, and the rocks for the small beasts.

chinese: 你安置月亮為定節令；日頭自知沉落。
english: He made the moon for a sign of the divisions of the year; teaching the sun the time of its going down.

chinese: 你造黑暗為夜，林中的百獸就都爬出來。
english: When you make it dark, it is night, when all the beasts of the woods come quietly out of their secret places.

chinese: 少壯獅子吼叫，要抓食，向神尋求食物。
english: The young lions go thundering after their food; searching for their meat from God.

chinese: 日頭一出，獸便躲避，臥在洞裡。
english: The sun comes up, and they come together, and go back to their secret places to take their rest.

chinese: 人出去做工，勞碌直到晚上。
english: Man goes out to his work, and to his business, till the evening.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地滿了你的豐富。
english: O Lord, how great is the number of your works! in wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of the things you have made.

chinese: 那裡有海，又大又廣；其中有無數的動物，大小活物都有。
english: There is the great, wide sea, where there are living things, great and small, more than may be numbered.

chinese: 那裡有船行走，有你所造的鱷魚游泳在其中。
english: There go the ships; there is that great beast, which you have made as a plaything.

chinese: 這都仰望你按時給他食物。
english: All of them are waiting for you, to give them their food in its time.

chinese: 你給他們，他們便拾起來；你張手，他們飽得美食。
english: They take what you give them; they are full of the good things which come from your open hand.

chinese: 你掩面，他們便驚惶；你收回他們的氣，他們就死亡，歸於塵土。
english: If your face is veiled, they are troubled; when you take away their breath, they come to an end, and go back to the dust.

chinese: 你發出你的靈，他們便受造；你使地面更換為新。
english: If you send out your spirit, they are given life; you make new the face of the earth.

chinese: 願耶和華的榮耀存到永遠！願耶和華喜悅自己所造的！
english: Let the glory of the Lord be for ever; let the Lord have joy in his works:

chinese: 他看地，地便震動；他摸山，山就冒煙。
english: At whose look the earth is shaking; at whose touch the mountains send out smoke.

chinese: 我要一生向耶和華唱詩！我還活的時候，要向我神歌頌！
english: I will make songs to the Lord all my life; I will make melody to my God while I have my being.

chinese: 願他以我的默念為甘甜！我要因耶和華歡喜！
english: Let my thoughts be sweet to him: I will be glad in the Lord.

chinese: 願罪人從世上消滅！願惡人歸於無有！我的心哪，要稱頌耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華（原文是哈利路亞；下同）！
english: Let sinners be cut off from the earth, and let all evil-doers come to an end. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul. Give praise to the Lord.

chinese: 你們要稱謝耶和華，求告他的名，在萬民中傳揚他的作為！
english: O give praise to the Lord; give honour to his name, talking of his doings among the peoples.

chinese: 要向他唱詩歌頌，談論他一切奇妙的作為！
english: Let your voice be sounding in songs and melody; let all your thoughts be of the wonder of his works.

chinese: 要以他的聖名誇耀！尋求耶和華的人，心中應當歡喜！
english: Have glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who are searching after the Lord be glad.

chinese: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力，時常尋求他的面。
english: Let your search be for the Lord and for his strength; let your hearts ever be turned to him.

chinese: 他僕人亞伯拉罕的後裔，他所揀選雅各的子孫哪，你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事，並他口中的判語。
english: Keep in mind the great works which he has done; his wonders, and the decisions of his mouth;
O you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his loved ones.

chinese: 他是耶和華─我們的神；全地都有他的判斷。
english: He is the Lord our God: he is judge of all the earth.

chinese: 他記念他的約，直到永遠；他所吩咐的話，直到千代─
english: He has kept his agreement in mind for ever, the word which he gave for a thousand generations;

chinese: 就是與亞伯拉罕所立的約，向以撒所起的誓。
english: The agreement which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;

chinese: 他又將這約向雅各定為律例，向以色列定為永遠的約，
english: And he gave it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an eternal agreement;

chinese: 說：我必將迦南地賜給你，作你產業的分。
english: Saying, To you will I give the land of Canaan, the measured line of your heritage:

chinese: 當時，他們人丁有限，數目稀少，並且在那地為寄居的。
english: When they were still small in number, and strange in the land;

chinese: 他們從這邦遊到那邦，從這國行到那國。
english: When they went about from one nation to another, and from one kingdom to another people.

chinese: 他不容甚麼人欺負他們，為他們的緣故責備君王，
english: He would not let anyone do them wrong; he even kept back kings because of them,

chinese: 說：不可難為我受膏的人，也不可惡待我的先知。
english: Saying, Put not your hand on those who have been marked with my holy oil, and do my prophets no wrong.

chinese: 他命饑荒降在那地上，將所倚靠的糧食全行斷絕，
english: And he took away all food from the land, so that the people were without bread.

chinese: 在他們以先打發一個人去─約瑟被賣為奴僕。
english: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was given as a servant for a price:

chinese: 人用腳鐐傷他的腳；他被鐵鍊捆拘。
english: His feet were fixed in chains; his neck was put in iron bands;

chinese: 耶和華的話試煉他，直等到他所說的應驗了。
english: Till the time when his word came true; he was tested by the word of the Lord.

chinese: 王打發人把他解開，就是治理眾民的，把他釋放，
english: The king sent men to take off his chains; even the ruler of the people, who let him go free.

chinese: 立他作王家之主，掌管他一切所有的，
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler over everything he had;

chinese: 使他隨意捆綁他的臣宰，將智慧教導他的長老。
english: To give his chiefs teaching at his pleasure, and so that his law-givers might get wisdom from him.

chinese: 以色列也到了埃及；雅各在含地寄居。
english: Then Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob was living in the land of Ham.

chinese: 耶和華使他的百姓生養眾多，使他們比敵人強盛，
english: And his people were greatly increased, and became stronger than those who were against them.

chinese: 使敵人的心轉去恨他的百姓，並用詭計待他的僕人。
english: Their hearts were turned to hate against his people, so that they made secret designs against them.

chinese: 他打發他的僕人摩西和他所揀選的亞倫，
english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, the man of his selection.

chinese: 在敵人中間顯他的神蹟，在含地顯他的奇事。
english: He let his signs be seen among the people, and his wonders in the land of Ham.

chinese: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗；沒有違背他話的。
english: He sent black night and made it dark; and they did not go against his word.

chinese: 他叫埃及的水變為血，叫他們的魚死了。
english: At his word their waters were turned to blood, and he sent death on all their fish.

chinese: 在他們的地上以及王宮的內室，青蛙多多滋生。
english: Their land was full of frogs, even in the rooms of the king.

chinese: 他說一聲，蒼蠅就成群而來，並有虱子進入他們四境。
english: He gave the word, and there came the dog-fly, and insects over all the land.

chinese: 他給他們降下冰雹為雨，在他們的地上降下火燄。
english: He gave them ice for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

chinese: 他也擊打他們的葡萄樹和無花果樹，毀壞他們境內的樹木。
english: He gave their vines and their fig-trees to destruction, and the trees of their land were broken down.

chinese: 他說一聲，就有蝗蟲螞蚱上來，不計其數，
english: At his word the locusts came, and young locusts more than might be numbered,

chinese: 吃盡了他們地上各樣的菜蔬和田地的出產。
english: And put an end to all the plants of their land, taking all the fruit of the earth for food.

chinese: 他又擊殺他們國內一切的長子，就是他們強壯時頭生的。
english: He put to death the first child of every family in the land, the first-fruits of their strength.

chinese: 他領自己的百姓帶銀子金子出來；他支派中沒有一個軟弱的。
english: He took his people out with silver and gold: there was not one feeble person among them.

chinese: 他們出來的時候，埃及人便歡喜；原來埃及人懼怕他們。
english: Egypt was glad when they went; for the fear of them had come down on them.

chinese: 他鋪張雲彩當遮蓋，夜間使火光照。
english: A cloud was stretched over them for a cover; and he sent fire to give light in the night.

chinese: 他們一求，他就使鵪鶉飛來，並用天上的糧食叫他們飽足。
english: At the people's request he sent birds, and gave them the bread of heaven for food.

chinese: 他打開磐石，水就湧出；在乾旱之處，水流成河。
english: His hand made the rock open, and the waters came streaming out; they went down through the dry places like a river.

chinese: 這都因他記念他的聖言和他的僕人亞伯拉罕。
english: For he kept in mind his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

chinese: 他帶領百姓歡樂而出，帶領選民歡呼前往。
english: And he took his people out with joy, the men of his selection with glad cries:

chinese: 他將列國的地賜給他們，他們便承巡蛦民勞碌得來的，
english: And gave them the lands of the nations; and they took the work of the peoples for a heritage;

chinese: 好使他們遵他的律例，守他的律法。你們要讚美耶和華！
english: So that they might keep his orders, and be true to his laws. Give praise to the Lord.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: Let the Lord be praised. O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 誰能傳說耶和華的大能？誰能表明他一切的美德？
english: Who is able to give an account of the great acts of the Lord, or to make clear all his praise?

chinese: 凡遵守公平﹔常行公義的，這人便為有福！
english: Happy are they whose decisions are upright, and he who does righteousness at all times.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓；求你也用這恩惠記念我，開你的救恩眷顧我，
english: Keep me in mind, O Lord, when you are good to your people; O let your salvation come to me;

chinese: 使我見你選民的福，樂你國民的樂，與你的產業一同誇耀。
english: So that I may see the well-being of the people of your selection, and have a part in the joy of your nation, and take pride in your heritage.

chinese: 我們與我們的祖宗一同犯罪；我們作了孽，行了惡。
english: We are sinners like our fathers, we have done wrong, our acts are evil.

chinese: 我們的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事，不記念你豐盛的慈愛，反倒在紅海行了悖逆。
english: Our fathers did not give thought to your wonders in Egypt; they did not keep in memory the great number of your mercies, but gave you cause for wrath at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

chinese: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他們，為要彰顯他的大能，
english: But he was their saviour because of his name, so that men might see his great power.

chinese: 並且斥責紅海，海便乾了；他帶領他們經過深處，如同經過曠野。
english: By his word the Red Sea was made dry: and he took them through the deep waters as through the waste land.

chinese: 他拯救他們脫離恨他們人的手，從仇敵手中救贖他們。
english: And he took them safely out of the hands of their haters, and kept them from the attacks of those who were against them.

chinese: 水淹沒他們的敵人，沒有一個存留。
english: And the waters went over their haters; all of them came to an end.

chinese: 那時，他們才信了他的話，歌唱讚美他。
english: Then they had faith in his words; they gave him songs of praise.

chinese: 等不多時，他們就忘了他的作為，不仰望他的指教，
english: But their memory of his works was short; not waiting to be guided by him,

chinese: 反倒在曠野大起慾心，在荒地試探神。
english: They gave way to their evil desires in the waste land, and put God to the test in the dry places.

chinese: 他將他們所求的賜給他們，卻使他們的心靈軟弱。
english: And he gave them their request, but sent a wasting disease into their souls.

chinese: 他們又在營中嫉妒摩西和耶和華的聖者亞倫。
english: They were full of envy against Moses among the tents, and against Aaron, the holy one of the Lord.

chinese: 地裂開，吞下大坍，掩蓋亞比蘭一黨的人。
english: The earth opening put an end to Dathan, covering up Abiram and his band.

chinese: 有火在他們的黨中發起；有火燄燒燬了惡人。
english: And a fire was lighted among their tents; the sinners were burned up by the flames.

chinese: 他們在何烈山造了牛犢，叩拜鑄成的像。
english: They made a young ox in Horeb, and gave worship to an image of gold.

chinese: 如此將他們榮耀的主換為吃草之牛的像，
english: And their glory was changed into the image of an ox, whose food is grass.

chinese: 忘了神─他們的救主；他曾在埃及行大事，
english: They had no memory of God their saviour, who had done great things in Egypt;

chinese: 在含地行奇事，在紅海行可畏的事。
english: Works of wonder in the land of Ham, and things of fear by the Red Sea.

chinese: 所以，他說要滅絕他們；若非有他所揀選的摩西站在當中（原文是破口），使他的忿怒轉消，恐怕他就滅絕他們。
english: And he was purposing to put an end to them if Moses, his special servant, had not gone up before him, between him and his people, turning back his wrath, to keep them from destruction.

chinese: 他們又藐視那美地，不信他的話，
english: They were disgusted with the good land; they had no belief in his word;

chinese: 在自己帳棚內發怨言，不聽耶和華的聲音。
english: Talking against him secretly in their tents, they did not give ear to the voice of the Lord.

chinese: 所以，他對他們起誓：必叫他們倒在曠野，
english: So he made an oath against them, to put an end to them in the waste land:

chinese: 叫他們的後裔倒在列國之中，分散在各地。
english: That their children might be mixed among the nations, and sent away into other lands.

chinese: 他們又與巴力•毗珥連合，且吃了祭死神（或譯：人）的物。
english: And they were joined to Baal-peor, and took part in the offerings to the dead.

chinese: 他們這樣行，惹耶和華發怒，便有瘟疫流行在他們中間。
english: So they made him angry by their behaviour; and he sent disease on them.

chinese: 那時，非尼哈站起，刑罰惡人，瘟疫這才止息。
english: Then Phinehas got up, and made prayer for them; and the disease went no farther.

chinese: 那就算為他的義，世世代代，直到永遠。
english: And all the generations coming after him kept the memory of his righteousness for ever.

chinese: 他們在米利巴水又叫耶和華發怒，甚至摩西也受了虧損，
english: They made God angry again at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled because of them;

chinese: 是因他們惹動他的靈，摩西（原文是他）用嘴說了急躁的話。
english: For they made his spirit bitter, and he said unwise things.

chinese: 他們不照耶和華所吩咐的滅絕外邦人，
english: They did not put an end to the peoples, as the Lord had said;

chinese: 反與他們混雜相合，學習他們的行為，
english: But they were joined to the nations, learning their works.

chinese: 事奉他們的偶像，這就成了自己的網羅，
english: And they gave worship to images; which were a danger to them:

chinese: 把自己的兒女祭祀鬼魔，
english: They even made offerings of their sons and their daughters to evil spirits,

chinese: 流無辜人的血，就是自己兒女的血，把他們祭祀迦南的偶像，那地就被血污穢了。
english: And gave the blood of their sons and their daughters who had done no wrong, offering them to the images of Canaan; and the land was made unclean with blood.

chinese: 這樣，他們被自己所做的污穢了，在行為上犯了邪淫。
english: So they became unclean through their works, going after their evil desires.

chinese: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作，憎惡他的產業，
english: Then the wrath of the Lord was burning against his people, and he was angry with his heritage.

chinese: 將他們交在外邦人的手裡；恨他們的人就轄制他們。
english: And he gave them into the hands of the nations; and they were ruled by their haters.

chinese: 他們的仇敵也欺壓他們，他們就伏在敵人手下。
english: By them they were crushed, and made low under their hands.

chinese: 他屢次搭救他們，他們卻設謀背逆，因自己的罪孽降為卑下。
english: Again and again he made them free; but their hearts were turned against his purpose, and they were overcome by their sins.

chinese: 然而，他聽見他們哀告的時候，就眷顧他們的急難，
english: But when their cry came to his ears, he had pity on their trouble:

chinese: 為他們記念他的約，照他豐盛的慈愛後悔。
english: And kept in mind his agreement with them, and in his great mercy gave them forgiveness.

chinese: 他也使他們在凡擄掠他們的人面前蒙憐恤。
english: He put pity into the hearts of those who made them prisoners.

chinese: 耶和華─我們的神啊，求你拯救我們，從外邦中招聚我們，我們好稱讚你的聖名，以讚美你為誇勝。
english: Be our saviour, O Lord our God, and let us come back together from among the nations, so that we may give honour to your holy name, and have glory in your praise.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的，從亙古直到永遠。願眾民都說：阿們！你們要讚美耶和華！
english: Praise be to the Lord God of Israel for ever and for ever; and let all the people say, So be it. Give praise to the Lord.

chinese: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 願耶和華的贖民說這話，就是他從敵人手中所救贖的，
english: Let those whose cause the Lord has taken up say so, his people whom he has taken out of the hands of their haters;

chinese: 從各地，從東從西，從南從北，所招聚來的。
english: Making them come together out of all the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

chinese: 他們在曠野荒地漂流，尋不見可住的城邑，
english: They were wandering in the waste places; they saw no way to a resting-place.

chinese: 又飢又渴，心裡發昏。
english: Their souls became feeble for need of food and drink.

chinese: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中搭救他們，
english: Then they sent up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gave them salvation out of all their troubles;

chinese: 又領他們行走直路，使他們往可居住的城邑。
english: Guiding them in the right way, so that they might come into the town of their resting-place.

chinese: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他；
english: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

chinese: 因他使心裡渴慕的人得以知足，使心裡飢餓的人得飽美物。
english: He gives its desire to the unresting soul, so that it is full of good things.

chinese: 那些坐在黑暗中、死蔭裡的人被困苦和鐵鍊捆鎖，
english: Those who were in the dark, in the black night, in chains of sorrow and iron;

chinese: 是因他們違背神的話語，藐視至高者的旨意。
english: Because they went against the words of God, and gave no thought to the laws of the Most High:

chinese: 所以，他用勞苦治服他們的心；他們仆倒，無人扶助。
english: So that he made their hearts weighted down with grief; they were falling, and had no helper.

chinese: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中拯救他們。
english: Then they sent up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gave them salvation out of all their troubles.

chinese: 他從黑暗中和死蔭裡領他們出來，折斷他們的綁索。
english: He took them out of the dark and the black night, and all their chains were broken.

chinese: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他；
english: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

chinese: 因為他打破了銅門，砍斷了鐵閂。
english: The doors of brass are broken by his arm, and the bands of iron are cut in two.

chinese: 愚妄人因自己的過犯和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。
