english: Foolish men, because of their sins, and because of their wrongdoing, are troubled;

chinese: 他們心裡厭惡各樣的食物，就臨近死門。
english: They are disgusted by all food, and they come near to the doors of death.

chinese: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；他從他們的禍患中拯救他們。
english: Then they send up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gives them salvation out of all their troubles.

chinese: 他發命醫治他們，救他們脫離死亡。
english: He sent his word and made them well, and kept them safe from the underworld.

chinese: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他。
english: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

chinese: 願他們以感謝為祭獻給他，歡呼述說他的作為！
english: Let them make offerings of praise, giving news of his works with cries of joy.

chinese: 在海上坐船，在大水中經理事務的，
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in the great waters;

chinese: 他們看見耶和華的作為，並他在深水中的奇事。
english: They see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

chinese: 因他一吩咐，狂風就起來，海中的波浪也揚起。
english: For at his word comes up the storm-wind, lifting high the waves.

chinese: 他們上到天空，下到海底；他們的心因患難便消化。
english: The sailors go up to heaven, and down into the deep; their souls are wasted because of their trouble.

chinese: 他們搖搖幌幌，東倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；他們的智慧無法可施。
english: They are turned here and there, rolling like a man who is full of wine; and all their wisdom comes to nothing.

chinese: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華，他從他們的禍患中領出他們來。
english: Then they send up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gives them salvation out of all their troubles.

chinese: 他使狂風止息，波浪就平靜。
english: He makes the storm into a calm, so that the waves are at peace.

chinese: 風息浪靜，他們便歡喜；他就引他們到所願去的海口。
english: Then they are glad, because the sea is quiet, and he takes them to the harbour of their desire.

chinese: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他。
english: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

chinese: 願他們在民的會中尊崇他，在長老的位上讚美他！
english: Let them give glory to him in the meeting of the people, and praise among the chiefs.

chinese: 他使江河變為曠野，叫水泉變為乾渴之地，
english: He makes rivers into waste places, and springs of water into a dry land;

chinese: 使肥地變為鹼地；這都因其間居民的罪惡。
english: He makes a fertile country into a salt waste, because of the sins of those who are living there.

chinese: 他使曠野變為水潭，叫旱地變為水泉。
english: He makes a waste land into a place of water, and a dry land into water-springs.

chinese: 他使飢餓的人住在那裡，好建造可住的城邑，
english: And there he gives the poor a resting-place, so that they may make themselves a town;

chinese: 又種田地，栽葡萄園，得享所出的土產。
english: And put seed in the fields and make vine-gardens, to give them fruit.

chinese: 他又賜福給他們，叫他們生養眾多，也不叫他們的牲畜減少。
english: He gives them his blessing so that they are increased greatly, and their cattle do not become less.

chinese: 他們又因暴虐、患難、愁苦，就減少且卑下。
english: And when they are made low, and crushed by trouble and sorrow,

chinese: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，使他們在荒廢無路之地漂流。
english: He puts an end to the pride of kings, and sends them wandering in the waste lands where there is no way.

chinese: 他卻將窮乏人安置在高處，脫離苦難，使他的家屬多如羊群。
english: But he puts the poor man on high from his troubles, and gives him families like a flock.

chinese: 正直人看見就歡喜；罪孽之輩必塞口無言。
english: The upright see it and are glad: the mouth of the sinner is stopped.

chinese: 凡有智慧的，必在這些事上留心，也必思想耶和華的慈愛。
english: Let the wise give thought to these things, and see the mercies of the Lord.

chinese: （大衛的詩歌。）神啊，我心堅定；我口（原文是榮耀）要唱詩歌頌！
english: - A Song. A Psalm. Of David. - O God, my heart is fixed; I will make songs and melody, even with my glory.

chinese: 琴瑟啊，你們當醒起！我自己要極早醒起！
english: Give out your sounds, O corded instruments: the dawn will be awaking with my song.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你，在列邦中歌頌你！
english: I will give you praise, O Lord, among the peoples; I will make melody to you among the nations.

chinese: 因為，你的慈愛大過諸天；你的誠實達到穹蒼。
english: For your mercy is higher than the heavens: and your unchanging faith than the clouds.

chinese: 神啊，願你崇高過於諸天！願你的榮耀高過全地！
english: Be lifted up, O God, higher than the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

chinese: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們，好叫你所親愛的人得救。
english: Let your right hand be stretched out for salvation, and give me an answer, so that your loved ones may be safe from danger.

chinese: 神已經指著他的聖潔說（說：或譯應許我）：我要歡樂；我要分開示劍，丈量疏割谷。
english: This is the word of the holy God: I will be glad; I will make Shechem a heritage, measuring out the valley of Succoth.

chinese: 基列是我的；瑪拿西是我的；以法蓮是護衛我頭的；猶大是我的杖；
english: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;

chinese: 摩押是我的沐浴盆；我要向以東拋鞋；我必因勝非利士呼喊。
english: Moab is my washpot; on Edom is the resting-place of my shoe; over Philistia will I send out a glad cry.

chinese: 誰能領我進堅固城？誰能引我到以東地？
english: Who will take me into the strong town? who will be my guide into Edom?

chinese: 神啊，你不是丟棄了我們麼？神啊，你不和我們的軍兵同去麼？
english: Have you not sent us away from you, O God? and you go not out with our armies.

chinese: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人，因為人的幫助是枉然的。
english: Give us help in our trouble; for there is no help in man.

chinese: 我們倚靠神才得施展大能，因為踐踏我們敵人的就是他。
english: With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）我所讚美的神啊，求你不要閉口不言。
english: - To the chief music-maker. Of David. A Psalm. - God of my praise, let my prayer be answered;

chinese: 因為惡人的嘴和詭詐人的口已經張開攻擊我；他們用撒謊的舌頭對我說話。
english: For the mouth of the sinner is open against me in deceit: his tongue has said false things against me.

chinese: 他們圍繞我，說怨恨的話，又無故地攻打我。
english: Words of hate are round about me; they have made war against me without cause.

chinese: 他們與我為敵以報我愛，但我專心祈禱。
english: For my love they give me back hate; but I have given myself to prayer.

chinese: 他們向我以惡報善，以恨報愛。
english: They have put on me evil for good; hate in exchange for my love.

chinese: 願你派一個惡人轄制他，派一個對頭站在他右邊！
english: Put an evil man over him; and let one be placed at his right hand to say evil of him.

chinese: 他受審判的時候，願他出來擔當罪名！願他的祈禱反成為罪！
english: When he is judged, let the decision go against him; and may his prayer become sin.

chinese: 願他的年日短少！願別人得他的職分！
english: Let his life be short; let another take his position of authority.

chinese: 願他的兒女為孤兒，他的妻子為寡婦！
english: Let his children have no father, and his wife be made a widow.

chinese: 願他的兒女漂流討飯，從他們荒涼之處出來求食！
english: Let his children be wanderers, looking to others for their food; let them be sent away from the company of their friends.

chinese: 願強暴的債主牢籠他一切所有的！願外人搶他勞碌得來的！
english: Let his creditor take all his goods; and let others have the profit of his work.

chinese: 願無人向他延綿施恩！願無人可憐他的孤兒！
english: Let no man have pity on him, or give help to his children when he is dead.

chinese: 願他的後人斷絕，名字被塗抹，不傳於下代！
english: Let his seed be cut off; in the coming generation let their name go out of memory.

chinese: 願他祖宗的罪孽被耶和華記念！願他母親的罪過不被塗抹！
english: Let the Lord keep in mind the wrongdoing of his fathers; and may the sin of his mother have no forgiveness.

chinese: 願這些罪常在耶和華面前，使他的名號斷絕於世！
english: Let them be ever before the eyes of the Lord, so that the memory of them may be cut off from the earth.

chinese: 因為他不想施恩，卻逼迫困苦窮乏的和傷心的人，要把他們治死。
english: Because he had no mercy, but was cruel to the low and the poor, designing the death of the broken-hearted.

chinese: 他愛咒罵，咒罵就臨到他；他不喜愛福樂，福樂就與他遠離！
english: As he took pleasure in cursing, so let it come on him; and as he had no delight in blessing, let it be far from him.

chinese: 他拿咒罵當衣服穿上；這咒罵就如水進他裡面，像油入他的骨頭。
english: He put on cursing like a robe, and it has come into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.

chinese: 願這咒罵當他遮身的衣服，當他常束的腰帶！
english: Let it be to him as a robe which he puts on, let it be like a band which is round him at all times.

chinese: 這就是我對頭和用惡言議論我的人從耶和華那裡所受的報應。
english: Let this be the reward given to my haters from the Lord, and to those who say evil of my soul.

chinese: 主─耶和華啊，求你為你的名恩待我；因你的慈愛美好，求你搭救我！
english: But, O Lord God, give me your help, because of your name; take me out of danger, because your mercy is good.

chinese: 因為我困苦窮乏，內心受傷。
english: For I am poor and in need, and my heart is wounded in me.

chinese: 我如日影漸漸偏斜而去；我如蝗蟲被抖出來。
english: I am gone like the shade when it is stretched out: I am forced out of my place like a locust.

chinese: 我因禁食，膝骨軟弱；我身上的肉也漸漸瘦了。
english: My knees are feeble for need of food; there is no fat on my bones.

chinese: 我受他們的羞辱，他們看見我便搖頭。
english: As for me, they make sport of me; shaking their heads when they see me.

chinese: 耶和華─我的神啊，求你幫助我，照你的慈愛拯救我，
english: Give me help, O Lord my God; in your mercy be my saviour;

chinese: 使他們知道這是你的手，是你─耶和華所行的事。
english: So that they may see that it is the work of your hand; that you, Lord, have done it.

chinese: 任憑他們咒罵，惟願你賜福；他們幾時起來就必蒙羞，你的僕人卻要歡喜。
english: They may give curses but you give blessing; when they come up against me, put them to shame; but let your servant be glad.

chinese: 願我的對頭披戴羞辱！願他們以自己的羞愧為外袍遮身！
english: Let my haters be clothed with shame, covering themselves with shame as with a robe.

chinese: 我要用口極力稱謝耶和華；我要在眾人中間讚美他；
english: I will give the Lord great praise with my mouth; yes, I will give praise to him among all the people.

chinese: 因為他必站在窮乏人的右邊，要救他脫離審判他靈魂的人。
english: For he is ever at the right hand of the poor, to take him out of the hands of those who go after his soul.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - The Lord said to my lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put all those who are against you under your feet.

chinese: 耶和華必使你從錫安伸出能力的杖來；你要在你仇敵中掌權。
english: The Lord will send out the rod of your strength from Zion; be king over your haters.

chinese: 當你掌權的日子（或譯：行軍的日子），你的民要以聖潔的妝飾為衣（或譯：以聖潔為妝飾），甘心犧牲自己；你的民多如清晨的甘露（或譯：你少年時光耀如清晨的甘露）。
english: Your people give themselves gladly in the day of your power; like the dew of the morning on the holy mountains is the army of your young men.

chinese: 耶和華起了誓，決不後悔，說：你是照著麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。
english: The Lord has made an oath, and will not take it back. You are a priest for ever, after the order of Melchizedek.

chinese: 在你右邊的主，當他發怒的日子，必打傷列王。
english: In the day of his wrath kings will be wounded by the Lord at your right hand.

chinese: 他要在列邦中刑罰惡人，屍首就遍滿各處；他要在許多國中打破仇敵的頭。
english: He will be judge among the nations, the valleys will be full of dead bodies; the head over a great country will be wounded by him.

chinese: 他要喝路旁的河水，因此必抬起頭來。
english: He will take of the stream by the way; so his head will be lifted up.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！我要在正直人的大會中，並公會中，一心稱謝耶和華。
english: Let the Lord be praised. I will give praise to the Lord with all my heart, among the upright, and in the meeting of the people.

chinese: 耶和華的作為本為大；凡喜愛的都必考察。
english: The works of the Lord are great, searched out by all those who have delight in them.

chinese: 他所行的是尊榮和威嚴；他的公義存到永遠。
english: His work is full of honour and glory; and his righteousness is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 他行了奇事，使人記念；耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫。
english: Certain for ever is the memory of his wonders: the Lord is full of pity and mercy.

chinese: 他賜糧食給敬畏他的人；他必永遠記念他的約。
english: He has given food to his worshippers; he will keep his agreement in mind for ever.

chinese: 他向百姓顯出大能的作為，把外邦的地賜給他們為業。
english: He has made clear to his people the power of his works, giving them the heritage of the nations.

chinese: 他手所行的是誠實公平；他的訓詞都是確實的，
english: The works of his hands are faith and righteousness; all his laws are unchanging.

chinese: 是永永遠遠堅定的，是按誠實正直設立的。
english: They are fixed for ever and ever, they are done in faith and righteousness.

chinese: 他向百姓施行救贖，命定他的約，直到永遠；他的名聖而可畏。
english: He has sent salvation to his people; he has given his word for ever: holy is his name and greatly to be feared.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端；凡遵行他命令的是聰明人。耶和華是永遠當讚美的！
english: The fear of the Lord is the best part of wisdom: all those who keep his laws are wise: his praise is eternal.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！敬畏耶和華，甚喜愛他命令的，這人便為有福！
english: Let the Lord be praised. Happy is the man who gives honour to the Lord, and has great delight in his laws.

chinese: 他的後裔在世必強盛；正直人的後代必要蒙福。
english: His seed will be strong on the earth; blessings will be on the generation of the upright.

chinese: 他家中有貨物，有錢財；他的公義存到永遠。
english: A store of wealth will be in his house, and his righteousness will be for ever.

chinese: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他發現；他有恩惠，有憐憫，有公義。
english: For the upright there is a light shining in the dark; he is full of grace and pity.

chinese: 施恩與人、借貸與人的，這人事情順利；他被審判的時候要訴明自己的冤。
english: All is well for the man who is kind and gives freely to others; he will make good his cause when he is judged.

chinese: 他永不動搖；義人被記念，直到永遠。
english: He will not ever be moved; the memory of the upright will be living for ever.

chinese: 他必不怕凶惡的信息；他心堅定，倚靠耶和華。
english: He will have no fear of evil news; his heart is fixed, for his hope is in the Lord.

chinese: 他心確定，總不懼怕，直到他看見敵人遭報。
english: His heart is resting safely, he will have no fear, till he sees trouble come on his haters.

chinese: 他施捨錢財，賙濟貧窮；他的仁義存到永遠。他的角必被高舉，大有榮耀。
english: He has given with open hands to the poor; his righteousness is for ever; his horn will be lifted up with honour.

chinese: 惡人看見便惱恨，必咬牙而消化；惡人的心願要歸滅絕。
english: The sinner will see it with grief; he will be wasted away with envy; the desire of the evil-doers will come to nothing.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！耶和華的僕人哪，你們要讚美，讚美耶和華的名！
english: Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的名是應當稱頌的，從今時直到永遠！
english: Let blessing be on the name of the Lord, from this time and for ever.

chinese: 從日出之地到日落之處，耶和華的名是應當讚美的！
english: From the coming up of the sun to its going down, the Lord's name is to be praised.

chinese: 耶和華超乎萬民之上；他的榮耀高過諸天。
english: The Lord is high over all nations, and his glory is higher than the heavens.

chinese: 誰像耶和華─我們的神呢？他坐在至高之處，
english: Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high,

chinese: 自己謙卑，觀看天上地下的事。
english: Looking down on the heavens, and on the earth?

chinese: 他從灰塵裡抬舉貧寒人，從糞堆中提拔窮乏人，
english: He takes the poor man out of the dust, lifting him up from his low position;

chinese: 使他們與王子同坐，就是與本國的王子同坐。
english: To give him a place among the rulers, even with the rulers of his people.

chinese: 他使不能生育的婦人安居家中，為多子的樂母。你們要讚美耶和華！
english: He gives the unfertile woman a family, making her a happy mother of children. Give praise to the Lord.

chinese: 以色列出了埃及，雅各家離開說異言之民；
english: When Israel came out of Egypt, the children of Jacob from a people whose language was strange to them;

chinese: 那時，猶大為主的聖所，以色列為他所治理的國度。
english: Judah became his holy place, and Israel his kingdom.

chinese: 滄海看見就奔逃；約但河也倒流。
english: The sea saw it, and went in flight; Jordan was turned back.

chinese: 大山踴躍，如公羊；小山跳舞，如羊羔。
english: The mountains were jumping like goats, and the little hills like lambs.

chinese: 滄海啊，你為何奔逃？約但哪，你為何倒流？
english: What was wrong with you, O sea, that you went in flight? O Jordan, that you were turned back?

chinese: 大山哪，你為何踴躍，如公羊？小山哪，你為何跳舞，如羊羔？
english: You mountains, why were you jumping like goats, and you little hills like lambs?

chinese: 大地啊，你因見主的面，就是雅各神的面，便要震動。
english: Be troubled, O earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob;

chinese: 他叫磐石變為水池，叫堅石變為泉源。
english: Who made the rock into a water-spring, and the hard stone into a fountain.

chinese: 耶和華啊，榮耀不要歸與我們，不要歸與我們；要因你的慈愛和誠實歸在你的名下！
english: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name let glory be given, because of your mercy and your unchanging faith.

chinese: 為何容外邦人說：他們的神在哪裡呢？
english: Why may the nations say, Where is now their God?

chinese: 然而，我們的神在天上，都隨自己的意旨行事。
english: But our God is in heaven: he has done whatever was pleasing to him.

chinese: 他們的偶像是金的，銀的，是人手所造的，
english: Their images are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

chinese: 有口卻不能言，有眼卻不能看，
english: They have mouths, but no voice; they have eyes, but they see not;

chinese: 有耳卻不能聽，有鼻卻不能聞，
english: They have ears, but no hearing; they have noses, but no sense of smell;

chinese: 有手卻不能摸，有腳卻不能走，有喉嚨也不能出聲。
english: They have hands without feeling, and feet without power of walking; and no sound comes from their throat.

chinese: 造他的要和他一樣；凡靠他的也要如此。
english: Those who make them are like them; and so is everyone who puts his faith in them.

chinese: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和華！他是你的幫助和你的盾牌。
english: O Israel, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

chinese: 亞倫家啊，你們要倚靠耶和華！他是你們的幫助和你們的盾牌。
english: O house of Aaron, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

chinese: 你們敬畏耶和華的，要倚靠耶和華！他是你們的幫助和你們的盾牌。
english: You worshippers of the Lord, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

chinese: 耶和華向來眷念我們；他還要賜福給我們：要賜福給以色列的家，賜福給亞倫的家。
english: The Lord has kept us in mind and will give us his blessing; he will send blessings on the house of Israel and on the house of Aaron.

chinese: 凡敬畏耶和華的，無論大小，主必賜福給他。
english: He will send blessings on the worshippers of the Lord, on the small and on the great.

chinese: 願耶和華叫你們和你們的子孫日見加增。
english: May the Lord give you and your children still greater increase.

chinese: 你們蒙了造天地之耶和華的福！
english: May you have the blessing of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

chinese: 天，是耶和華的天；地，他卻給了世人。
english: The heavens are the Lord's; but the earth he has given to the children of men.

chinese: 死人不能讚美耶和華；下到寂靜中的也都不能。
english: The dead do not give praise to the Lord; or those who go down to the underworld.

chinese: 但我們要稱頌耶和華，從今時直到永遠。你們要讚美耶和華！
english: But we will give praise to the Lord now and for ever. Praise be to the Lord.

chinese: 我愛耶和華，因為他聽了我的聲音和我的懇求。
english: I have given my love to the Lord, because he has given ear to the voice of my cry and my prayer.

chinese: 他既向我側耳，我一生要求告他。
english: He has let my request come before him, and I will make my prayer to him all my days.

chinese: 死亡的繩索纏繞我；陰間的痛苦抓住我；我遭遇患難愁苦。
english: The nets of death were round me, and the pains of the underworld had me in their grip; I was full of trouble and sorrow.

chinese: 那時，我便求告耶和華的名，說：耶和華啊，求你救我的靈魂！
english: Then I made my prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord, take my soul out of trouble.

chinese: 耶和華有恩惠，有公義；我們的神以憐憫為懷。
english: The Lord is full of grace and righteousness; truly, he is a God of mercy.

chinese: 耶和華保護愚人；我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。
english: The Lord keeps the simple; I was made low, and he was my saviour.

chinese: 我的心哪！你要仍歸安樂，因為耶和華用厚恩待你。
english: Come back to your rest, O my soul; for the Lord has given you your reward.

chinese: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡，救我的眼免了流淚，救我的腳免了跌倒。
english: You have taken my soul from the power of death, keeping my eyes from weeping, and my feet from falling.

chinese: 我要在耶和華面前行活人之路。
english: I will go before the Lord in the land of the living.

chinese: 我因信，所以如此說話；我受了極大的困苦。
english: I still had faith, though I said, I am in great trouble;

chinese: 我曾急促地說：人都是說謊的！
english: Though I said in my fear, All men are false.

chinese: 我拿甚麼報答耶和華向我所賜的一切厚恩？
english: What may I give to the Lord for all the good things which he has done for me?

chinese: 我要舉起救恩的杯，稱揚耶和華的名。
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and give praise to the name of the Lord.

chinese: 我要在他眾民面前向耶和華還我的願。
english: I will make the offering of my oath to the Lord, even before all his people.

chinese: 在耶和華眼中，看聖民之死極為寶貴。
english: Dear in the eyes of the Lord is the death of his saints.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我真是你的僕人；我是你的僕人，是你婢女的兒子。你已經解開我的綁索。
english: O Lord, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of her who is your servant; by you have my cords been broken.

chinese: 我要以感謝為祭獻給你，又要求告耶和華的名。
english: I will give an offering of praise to you, and make my prayer in the name of the Lord.

chinese: 我要在他眾民面前，在耶和華殿的院內，在耶路撒冷當中，向耶和華還我的願。你們要讚美耶和華！
english: I will make the offerings of my oath, even before all his people;
In the Lord's house, even in Jerusalem. Praise be to the Lord.

chinese: 萬國啊，你們都當讚美耶和華！萬民哪，你們都當頌讚他！
english: Let all the nations give praise to the Lord: let all the people give him praise.

chinese: 因為他向我們大施慈愛；耶和華的誠實存到永遠。你們要讚美耶和華！
english: For great is his mercy to us, and his faith is unchanging for ever. Praise be to the Lord.

chinese: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 願以色列說：他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: Let Israel now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 願亞倫的家說：他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 願敬畏耶和華的說：他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: Let all worshippers of the Lord now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 我在急難中求告耶和華，他就應允我，把我安置在寬闊之地。
english: I made my prayer to the Lord in my trouble: and the Lord gave me an answer, and put me in a wide place.

chinese: 有耶和華幫助我，我必不懼怕，人能把我怎麼樣呢？
english: The Lord is on my side; I will have no fear: what is man able to do to me?

chinese: 在那幫助我的人中，有耶和華幫助我，所以我要看見那恨我的人遭報。
english: The Lord is my great helper: I will see my desire against my haters.

chinese: 投靠耶和華，強似倚賴人；
english: It is better to have faith in the Lord than to put one's hope in man.

chinese: 投靠耶和華，強似倚賴王子。
english: It is better to have faith in the Lord than to put one's hope in rulers.

chinese: 萬民圍繞我，我靠耶和華的名必剿滅他們。
english: All the nations have come round me; but in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

chinese: 他們環繞我，圍困我，我靠耶和華的名必剿滅他們。
english: They are round me, yes, they are all about me; but in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

chinese: 他們如同蜂子圍繞我，好像燒荊棘的火，必被熄滅；我靠耶和華的名，必剿滅他們。
english: They are round me like bees; but they are put out like a fire among thorns; for in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

chinese: 你推我，要叫我跌倒，但耶和華幫助了我。
english: I have been hard pushed by you, so that I might have a fall: but the Lord was my helper.

chinese: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的詩歌；他也成了我的拯救。
english: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.

chinese: 在義人的帳棚裡，有歡呼拯救的聲音；耶和華的右手施展大能。
english: The sound of joy and salvation is in the tents of the upright; the right hand of the Lord does works of power.

chinese: 耶和華的右手高舉；耶和華的右手施展大能。
english: The right hand of the Lord is lifted up; the right hand of the Lord does works of power.

chinese: 我必不致死，仍要存活，並要傳揚耶和華的作為。
english: Life and not death will be my part, and I will give out the story of the works of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華雖嚴嚴地懲治我，卻未曾將我交於死亡。
english: The hand of Jah has been hard on me; but he has not given me up to death.

chinese: 給我敞開義門；我要進去稱謝耶和華！
english: Let the doors of righteousness be open to me; I will go in and give praise to the Lord.

chinese: 這是耶和華的門；義人要進去！
english: This is the door of the Lord's house; the workers of righteousness will go in through it.

chinese: 我要稱謝你，因為你已經應允我，又成了我的拯救！
english: I will give you praise, for you have given me an answer, and have become my salvation.

chinese: 匠人所棄的石頭已成了房角的頭塊石頭。
english: The stone which the builders put on one side has become the chief stone of the building.

chinese: 這是耶和華所做的，在我們眼中看為希奇。
english: This is the Lord's doing; it is a wonder in our eyes.

chinese: 這是耶和華所定的日子，我們在其中要高興歡喜！
english: This is the day which the Lord has made; we will be full of joy and delight in it.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你拯救！耶和華啊，求你使我們亨通！
english: Send salvation now, O Lord; Lord, send us your blessing.

chinese: 奉耶和華名來的是應當稱頌的！我們從耶和華的殿中為你們祝福！
english: A blessing be on him who comes in the name of the Lord; we give you blessing from the house of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華是神；他光照了我們。理當用繩索把祭牲拴住，牽到壇角那裡。
english: The Lord is God, and he has given us light; let the holy dance be ordered with branches, even up to the horns of the altar.

chinese: 你是我的神，我要稱謝你！你是我的神，我要尊崇你！
english: You are my God, and I will give you praise; my God, and I will give honour to your name.

chinese: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 行為完全、遵行耶和華律法的，這人便為有福！
english: #NAME?

chinese: 遵守他的法度、一心尋求他的，這人便為有福！
english: Happy are they who keep his unchanging word, searching after him with all their heart.

chinese: 這人不做非義的事，但遵行他的道。
english: They do no evil; they go in his ways.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你曾將你的訓詞吩咐我們，為要我們殷勤遵守。
english: You have put your orders into our hearts, so that we might keep them with care.

chinese: 但願我行事堅定，得以遵守你的律例。
english: If only my ways were ordered so that I might keep your rules!

chinese: 我看重你的一切命令，就不至於羞愧。
english: Then I would not be put to shame, as long as I have respect for all your teaching.

chinese: 我學了你公義的判語，就要以正直的心稱謝你。
english: I will give you praise with an upright heart in learning your right decisions.

chinese: 我必守你的律例；求你總不要丟棄我！
english: I will keep your rules: O give me not up completely.

chinese: 少年人用甚麼潔淨他的行為呢？是要遵行你的話！
english: #NAME?

chinese: 我一心尋求了你；求你不要叫我偏離你的命令。
english: I have made search for you with all my heart: O let me not go wandering far from your teaching.

chinese: 我將你的話藏在心裡，免得我得罪你。
english: I have kept your sayings secretly in my heart, so that I might do no sin against you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你是應當稱頌的！求你將你的律例教訓我！
english: Praise be to you, O Lord: give me knowledge of your rules.

chinese: 我用嘴唇傳揚你口中的一切典章。
english: With my lips have I made clear all the decisions of your mouth.

chinese: 我喜悅你的法度，如同喜悅一切的財物。
english: I have taken as much delight in the way of your unchanging word, as in all wealth.

chinese: 我要默想你的訓詞，看重你的道路。
english: I will give thought to your orders, and have respect for your ways.

chinese: 我要在你的律例中自樂；我不忘記你的話。
english: I will have delight in your rules; I will not let your word go out of my mind.

chinese: 求你用厚恩待你的僕人，使我存活，我就遵守你的話。
english: - GIMEL - Give me, your servant, the reward of life, so that I may keep your word;

chinese: 求你開我的眼睛，使我看出你律法中的奇妙。
english: Let my eyes be open to see the wonders of your law.

chinese: 我是在地上作寄居的；求你不要向我隱瞞你的命令！
english: I am living in a strange land: do not let your teachings be kept secret from me.

chinese: 我時常切慕你的典章，甚至心碎。
english: My soul is broken with desire for your decisions at all times.

chinese: 受咒詛、偏離你命令的驕傲人，你已經責備他們。
english: Your hand has been against the men of pride, a curse is on those who go wandering out of your way.

chinese: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐視，因我遵守你的法度。
english: Take away from me shame and bitter words; for I have kept your unchanging word in my heart.

chinese: 雖有首領坐著妄論我，你僕人卻思想你的律例。
english: Rulers make evil designs against me; but your servant gives thought to your rules.

chinese: 你的法度是我所喜樂的，是我的謀士。
english: Your unchanging word is my delight, and the guide of my footsteps.

chinese: 我的性命幾乎歸於塵土；求你照你的話將我救活！
english: #NAME?

chinese: 我述說我所行的，你應允了我；求你將你的律例教訓我！
english: I put the record of my ways before you, and you gave me an answer: O give me knowledge of your rules.

chinese: 求你使我明白你的訓詞，我就思想你的奇事。
english: Make the way of your orders clear to me; then my thoughts will be ever on your wonders.

chinese: 我的心因愁苦而消化；求你照你的話使我堅立！
english: My soul is wasted with sorrow; give me strength again in keeping with your word

chinese: 求你使我離開奸詐的道，開恩將你的律法賜給我！
english: Take from me every false way; and in mercy give me your law.

chinese: 我揀選了忠信的道，將你的典章擺在我面前。
english: I have taken the way of faith: I have kept your decisions before me.

chinese: 我持守你的法度；耶和華啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！
english: I have been true to your unchanging word; O Lord, do not put me to shame.

chinese: 你開廣我心的時候，我就往你命令的道上直奔。
english: I will go quickly in the way of your teaching, because you have given me a free heart.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你將你的律例指教我，我必遵守到底！
english: #NAME?

chinese: 求你賜我悟性，我便遵守你的律法，且要一心遵守。
english: Give me wisdom, so that I may keep your law; going after it with all my heart.

chinese: 求你叫我遵行你的命令，因為這是我所喜樂的。
english: Make me go in the way of your teachings; for they are my delight.

chinese: 求你使我的心趨向你的法度，不趨向非義之財。
english: Let my heart be turned to your unchanging word, and not to evil desire.

chinese: 求你叫我轉眼不看虛假，又叫我在你的道中生活。
english: Let my eyes be turned away from what is false; give me life in your ways.

chinese: 你向敬畏你的人所應許的話，求你向僕人堅定！
english: Give effect to your word to your servant, in whose heart is the fear of you.

chinese: 求你使我所怕的羞辱遠離我，因你的典章本為美。
english: Take away the shame which is my fear; for your decisions are good.

chinese: 我羨慕你的訓詞；求你使我在你的公義上生活！
english: See how great is my desire for your orders: give me life in your righteousness.

chinese: 耶和華啊，願你照你的話，使你的慈愛，就是你的救恩，臨到我身上，
english: #NAME?

chinese: 我就有話回答那羞辱我的，因我倚靠你的話。
english: So that I may have an answer for the man who would put me to shame; for I have faith in your word.

chinese: 求你叫真理的話總不離開我口，因我仰望你的典章。
english: Take not your true word quite out of my mouth; for I have put my hope in your decisions.

chinese: 我要常守你的律法，直到永永遠遠。
english: So that I may keep your law for ever and ever;

chinese: 我要自由而行（或譯：我要行在寬闊之地），因我素來考究你的訓詞。
english: So that my way may be in a wide place: because my search has been for your orders.

chinese: 我也要在君王面前論說你的法度，並不至於羞愧。
english: So that I may give knowledge of your unchanging word before kings, and not be put to shame.

chinese: 我要在你的命令中自樂；這命令素來是我所愛的。
english: And so that I may take delight in your teachings, to which I have given my love.

chinese: 我又要遵行（原文是舉手）你的命令，這命令素來是我所愛的；我也要思想你的律例。
english: And so that my hands may be stretched out to you; and I will give thought to your rules.

chinese: 求你記念向你僕人所應許的話，叫我有盼望。
english: #NAME?

chinese: 這話將我救活了；我在患難中，因此得安慰。
english: This is my comfort in my trouble; that your sayings have given me life.

chinese: 驕傲的人甚侮慢我，我卻未曾偏離你的律法。
english: The men of pride have made great sport of me; but I have not been turned from your law.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我記念你從古以來的典章，就得了安慰。
english: I have kept the memory of your decisions from times past, O Lord; and they have been my comfort.

chinese: 我見惡人離棄你的律法，就怒氣發作，猶如火燒。
english: I am burning with wrath, because of the sinners who have given up your law.

chinese: 我在世寄居，素來以你的律例為詩歌。
english: Your rules have been melodies to me, while I have been living in strange lands.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我夜間記念你的名，遵守你的律法。
english: I have given thought to your name in the night, O Lord, and have kept your law.

chinese: 我所以如此，是因我守你的訓詞。
english: This has been true of me, that I have kept your orders in my heart.

chinese: 耶和華是我的福分；我曾說，我要遵守你的言語。
english: #NAME?

chinese: 我一心求過你的恩；願你照你的話憐憫我！
english: I have given my mind to do your pleasure with all my heart; have mercy on me, as you have said.

chinese: 我思想我所行的道，就轉步歸向你的法度。
english: I gave thought to my steps, and my feet were turned into the way of your unchanging word.

chinese: 我急忙遵守你的命令，並不遲延。
english: I was quick to do your orders, and let no time be wasted.

chinese: 惡人的繩索纏繞我，我卻沒有忘記你的律法。
english: The cords of evil-doers are round me; but I have kept in mind your law.

chinese: 我因你公義的典章，半夜必起來稱謝你。
english: In the middle of the night I will get up to give you praise, because of all your right decisions.

chinese: 凡敬畏你、守你訓詞的人，我都與他作伴。
english: I keep company with all your worshippers, and those who have your orders in their memory.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛遍滿大地；求你將你的律例教訓我！
english: The earth, O Lord, is full of your mercy: give me knowledge of your rules.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你向來是照你的話善待僕人。
english: #NAME?

chinese: 求你將精明和知識賜給我，因我信了你的命令。
english: Give me knowledge and good sense; for I have put my faith in your teachings.

chinese: 我未受苦以先走迷了路，現在卻遵守你的話。
english: Before I was in trouble I went out of the way; but now I keep your word.

chinese: 你本為善，所行的也善；求你將你的律例教訓我！
english: You are good, and your works are good; give me knowledge of your rules.

chinese: 驕傲人編造謊言攻擊我，我卻要一心守你的訓詞。
english: The men of pride have said false things about me; but I will keep your orders in my heart.

chinese: 他們心蒙脂油，我卻喜愛你的律法。
english: Their hearts are shut up with fat; but my delight is in your law.

chinese: 我受苦是與我有益，為要使我學習你的律例。
english: It is good for me to have been through trouble; so that I might come to the knowledge of your rules.

chinese: 你口中的訓言（或譯：律法）與我有益，勝於千萬的金銀。
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

chinese: 你的手製造我，建立我；求你賜我悟性，可以學習你的命令！
english: #NAME?

chinese: 敬畏你的人見我就要歡喜，因我仰望你的話。
english: Your worshippers will see me and be glad; because my hope has been in your word.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我知道你的判語是公義的；你使我受苦是以誠實待我。
english: I have seen, O Lord, that your decisions are right, and that in unchanging faith you have sent trouble on me.

chinese: 求你照著應許僕人的話，以慈愛安慰我。
english: Let your mercy now be my comfort, as you have said to your servant.

chinese: 願你的慈悲臨到我，使我存活，因你的律法是我所喜愛的。
english: Let your gentle mercies come to me, so that I may have life; for your law is my delight.

chinese: 願驕傲人蒙羞，因為他們無理地傾覆我；但我要思想你的訓詞。
english: Let the men of pride be shamed; because they have falsely given decision against me; but I will give thought to your orders.

chinese: 願敬畏你的人歸向我，他們就知道你的法度。
english: Let your worshippers be turned to me, and those who have knowledge of your words.

chinese: 願我的心在你的律例上完全，使我不致蒙羞。
english: Let all my heart be given to your orders, so that I may not be put to shame.

chinese: 我心渴想你的救恩，仰望你的應許。
english: #NAME?

chinese: 我因盼望你的應許眼睛失明，說：你何時安慰我？
english: My eyes are full of weariness with searching for your word, saying, When will you give me comfort?

chinese: 我好像煙薰的皮袋，卻不忘記你的律例。
english: For I have become like a wine-skin black with smoke; but I still keep the memory of your rules.

chinese: 你僕人的年日有多少呢？你幾時向逼迫我的人施行審判呢？
english: How short is the life of your servant! when will you give your decision against those who are attacking me?

chinese: 不從你律法的驕傲人為我掘了坑。
english: The men of pride, who are turned away from your law, have put nets for me.

chinese: 你的命令盡都誠實；他們無理地逼迫我，求你幫助我！
english: All your teachings are certain; they go after me with evil design; give me your help.

chinese: 他們幾乎把我從世上滅絕，但我沒有離棄你的訓詞。
english: They had almost put an end to me on earth; but I did not give up your orders.

chinese: 求你照你的慈愛將我救活，我就遵守你口中的法度。
english: Give me life in your mercy; so that I may be ruled by the unchanging word of your mouth.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的話安定在天，直到永遠。
english: #NAME?

chinese: 你的誠實存到萬代；你堅定了地，地就長存。
english: Your faith is unchanging from generation to generation: you have put the earth in its place, and it is not moved.

chinese: 天地照你的安排存到今日；萬物都是你的僕役。
english: They are ruled this day by your decisions; for all things are your servants.

chinese: 我若不是喜愛你的律法，早就在苦難中滅絕了！
english: If your law had not been my delight, my troubles would have put an end to me.

chinese: 我永不忘記你的訓詞，因你用這訓詞將我救活了。
english: I will ever keep your orders in mind; for in them I have life.

chinese: 我是屬你的，求你救我，因我尋求了你的訓詞。
english: I am yours, O be my saviour; for my desire has been for your rules.

chinese: 惡人等待我，要滅絕我，我卻要揣摩你的法度。
english: The sinners have been waiting for me to give me up to destruction; but I will give all my mind to your unchanging ward.

chinese: 我看萬事盡都有限，惟有你的命令極其寬廣。
english: I have seen that nothing on earth is complete; but your teaching is very wide.

chinese: 我何等愛慕你的律法，終日不住地思想。
english: #NAME?

chinese: 你的命令常存在我心裡，使我比仇敵有智慧。
english: Your teaching has made me wiser than my haters: for it is mine for ever.

chinese: 我比我的師傅更通達，因我思想你的法度。
english: I have more knowledge than all my teachers, because I give thought to your unchanging word.

chinese: 我比年老的更明白，因我守了你的訓詞。
english: I have more wisdom than the old, because I have kept your orders.

chinese: 我禁止我腳走一切的邪路，為要遵守你的話。
english: I have kept back my feet from all evil ways, so that I might be true to your word.

chinese: 我沒有偏離你的典章，因為你教訓了我。
english: My heart has not been turned away from your decisions; for you have been my teacher.

chinese: 你的言語在我上膛何等甘美，在我口中比蜜更甜！
english: How sweet are your sayings to my taste! truly, they are sweeter than honey in my mouth!

chinese: 我藉著你的訓詞得以明白，所以我恨一切的假道。
english: Through your orders I get wisdom; for this reason I am a hater of every false way.

chinese: 你的話是我腳前的燈，是我路上的光。
english: #NAME?

chinese: 你公義的典章，我曾起誓遵守，我必按誓而行。
english: I have made an oath and kept it, to be guided by your upright decisions.

chinese: 我甚是受苦；耶和華啊，求你照你的話將我救活！
english: I am greatly troubled, O Lord, give me life in keeping with your word.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你悅納我口中的讚美為供物，又將你的典章教訓我！
english: Take, O Lord, the free offerings of my mouth, and give me knowledge of your decisions.

chinese: 我的性命常在危險之中，我卻不忘記你的律法。
english: My soul is ever in danger; but I still keep the memory of your law.

chinese: 惡人為我設下網羅，我卻沒有偏離你的訓詞。
english: Sinners have put a net to take me; but I was true to your orders.

chinese: 我以你的法度為永遠的產業，因這是我心中所喜愛的。
english: I have taken your unchanging word as an eternal heritage; for it is the joy of my heart.

chinese: 我的心專向你的律例，永遠遵行，一直到底。
english: My heart is ever ready to keep your rules, even to the end.

chinese: 心懷二意的人為我所恨；但你的律法為我所愛。
english: - SAMECH - I am a hater of men of doubting mind; but I am a lover of your law.

chinese: 你是我藏身之處，又是我的盾牌；我甚仰望你的話語。
english: You are my secret place and my breastplate against danger; my hope is in your word.

chinese: 作惡的人哪，你們離開我罷！我好遵守我神的命令。
english: Go far from me, you evil-doers; so that I may keep the teachings of my God.

chinese: 求你照你的話扶持我，使我存活，也不叫我因失望而害羞。
english: Be my support as you have said, and give me life; let not my hope be turned to shame.

chinese: 求你扶持我，我便得救，時常看重你的律例。
english: Let me not be moved, and I will be safe, and ever take delight in your rules.

chinese: 凡偏離你律例的人，你都輕棄他們，因為他們的詭詐必歸虛空。
english: You have overcome all those who are wandering from your rules; for all their thoughts are false.

chinese: 凡地上的惡人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓；因此我愛你的法度。
english: All the sinners of the earth are like waste metal in your eyes; and for this cause I give my love to your unchanging word.

chinese: 我因懼怕你，肉就發抖；我也怕你的判語。
english: My flesh is moved for fear of you; I give honour to your decisions.

chinese: 我行過公平和公義，求你不要撇下我給欺壓我的人！
english: #NAME?

chinese: 求你為僕人作保，使我得好處，不容驕傲人欺壓我！
english: Take your servant's interests into your keeping; let me not be crushed by the men of pride.

chinese: 我因盼望你的救恩和你公義的話眼睛失明。
english: My eyes are wasted with desire for your salvation, and for the word of your righteousness.

chinese: 求你照你的慈愛待僕人，將你的律例教訓我。
english: Be good to your servant in your mercy, and give me teaching in your rules.

chinese: 我是你的僕人，求你賜我悟性，使我得知你的法度。
english: I am your servant; give me wisdom, so that I may have knowledge of your unchanging word.

chinese: 這是耶和華降罰的時候，因人廢了你的律法。
english: It is time, O Lord, for you to let your work be seen; for they have made your law without effect.

chinese: 所以，我愛你的命令勝於金子，更勝於精金。
english: For this reason I have greater love far your teachings than for gold, even for shining gold.

chinese: 你一切的訓詞，在萬事上我都以為正直；我卻恨惡一切假道。
english: Because of it I keep straight in all things by your orders; and I am a hater of every false way.

chinese: 你的法度奇妙，所以我一心謹守。
english: - PE - Your unchanging word is full of wonder; for this reason my soul keeps it.

chinese: 你的言語一解開就發出亮光，使愚人通達。
english: The opening of your words gives light; it gives good sense to the simple.

chinese: 我張口而氣喘，因我切慕你的命令。
english: My mouth was open wide, waiting with great desire for your teachings.

chinese: 求你轉向我，憐憫我，好像你素常待那些愛你名的人。
english: Let your eyes be turned to me, and have mercy on me, as it is right for you to do to those who are lovers of your name.

chinese: 求你用你的話使我腳步穩當，不許甚麼罪孽轄制我。
english: Let my steps be guided by your word; and let not sin have control over me.

chinese: 求你救我脫離人的欺壓，我要遵守你的訓詞。
english: Make me free from the cruel rule of man; then I will keep your orders.

chinese: 求你用臉光照僕人，又將你的律例教訓我。
english: Let your servant see the shining of your face; give me knowledge of your rules.

chinese: 我的眼淚下流成河，因為他們不守你的律法。
english: Rivers of water are flowing from my eyes, because men do not keep your law.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你是公義的；你的判語也是正直的！
english: #NAME?

chinese: 你所命定的法度是憑公義和至誠。
english: You have given your unchanging word in righteousness, and it is for ever.

chinese: 我心焦急，如同火燒，因我敵人忘記你的言語。
english: My passion has overcome me; because my haters are turned away from your words.

chinese: 你的話極其精煉，所以你的僕人喜愛。
english: Your word is of tested value; and it is dear to your servant.

chinese: 我微小，被人藐視，卻不忘記你的訓詞。
english: I am small and of no account; but I keep your orders in mind.

chinese: 你的公義永遠長存；你的律法盡都真實。
english: Your righteousness is an unchanging righteousness, and your law is certain.

chinese: 我遭遇患難愁苦，你的命令卻是我所喜愛的。
english: Pain and trouble have overcome me: but your teachings are my delight.

chinese: 你的法度永遠是公義的；求你賜我悟性，我就活了。
english: The righteousness of your unchanging word is eternal; give me wisdom so that I may have life.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我一心呼籲你；求你應允我，我必謹守你的律例！
english: - KOPH - I have made my prayer with all my heart; give answer to me, O Lord: I will keep your rules.

chinese: 我向你呼籲，求你救我！我要遵守你的法度。
english: My cry has gone up to you; take me out of trouble, and I will be guided by your unchanging word.

chinese: 我趁天未亮呼求；我仰望了你的言語。
english: Before the sun is up, my cry for help comes to your ear; my hope is in your words.

chinese: 我趁夜更未換將眼睜開，為要思想你的話語。
english: In the night watches I am awake, so that I may give thought to your saying.

chinese: 求你照你的慈愛聽我的聲音；耶和華啊，求你照你的典章將我救活！
english: Let my voice come to you, in your mercy; O Lord, by your decisions give me life.

chinese: 追求奸惡的人臨近了；他們遠離你的律法。
english: Those who have evil designs against me come near; they are far from your law.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你與我相近；你一切的命令盡都真實！
english: You are near, O Lord; and all your teachings are true.

chinese: 我因學你的法度，久已知道是你永遠立定的。
english: I have long had knowledge that your unchanging word is for ever.

chinese: 求你看顧我的苦難，搭救我，因我不忘記你的律法。
english: - RESH - O see my trouble, and be my saviour; for I keep your law in my mind,

chinese: 求你為我辨屈，救贖我，照你的話將我救活。
english: Undertake my cause, and come to my help, give me life, as you have said.

chinese: 救恩遠離惡人，因為他們不尋求你的律例。
english: Salvation is far from evil-doers; for they have made no search for your rules.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的慈悲本為大；求你照你的典章將我救活。
english: Great is the number of your mercies, O Lord; give me life in keeping with your decisions.

chinese: 逼迫我的，抵擋我的，很多，我卻沒有偏離你的法度。
english: Great is the number of those who are against me; but I have not been turned away from your unchanging word.

chinese: 我看見奸惡的人就甚憎惡，因為他們不遵守你的話。
english: I saw with hate those who were untrue to you; for they did not keep your saying.

chinese: 你看我怎樣愛你的訓詞！耶和華啊，求你照你的慈愛將我救活！
english: See how great is my love for your orders: give me life, O Lord, in keeping with your mercy.

chinese: 你話的總綱是真實；你一切公義的典章是永遠長存。
english: Your word is true from the first; and your upright decision is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 首領無故地逼迫我，但我的心畏懼你的言語。
english: - SHIN - Rulers have been cruel to me without cause; but I have the fear of your word in my heart.

chinese: 我喜愛你的話，好像人得了許多擄物。
english: I am delighted by your saying, like a man who makes discovery of great wealth.

chinese: 謊話是我所恨惡所憎嫌的；惟你的律法是我所愛的。
english: I am full of hate and disgust for false words; but I am a lover of your law.

chinese: 我因你公義的典章一天七次讚美你。
english: Seven times a day do I give you praise, because of your upright decisions.

chinese: 愛你律法的人有大平安，甚麼都不能使他們絆腳。
english: Great peace have lovers of your law; they have no cause for falling.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我仰望了你的救恩，遵行了你的命令。
english: Lord, my hope has been in your salvation; and I have kept your teachings.

chinese: 我心裡守了你的法度；這法度我甚喜愛。
english: My soul has kept your unchanging word; great is my love for it.

chinese: 我遵守了你的訓詞和法度，因我一切所行的都在你面前。
english: I have been ruled by your orders; for all my ways are before you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，願我的呼籲達到你面前，照你的話賜我悟性。
english: - TAU - Let my cry come before you, O Lord; give me wisdom in keeping with your word.

chinese: 願我的懇求達到你面前，照你的話搭救我。
english: Let my prayer come before you; take me out of trouble, as you have said.

chinese: 願我的嘴發出讚美的話，因為你將律例教訓我。
english: Let my lips be flowing with praise, because you have given me knowledge of your rules.

chinese: 願我的舌頭歌唱你的話，因你一切的命令盡都公義。
english: Let my tongue make songs in praise of your word; for all your teachings are righteousness.

chinese: 願你用手幫助我，因我揀選了你的訓詞。
english: Let your hand be near for my help; for I have given my heart to your orders.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我切慕你的救恩！你的律法也是我所喜愛的。
english: All my desire has been for your salvation, O Lord; and your law is my delight.

chinese: 願我的性命存活，得以讚美你！願你的典章幫助我！
english: Give life to my soul so that it may give you praise; and let your decisions be my support.

chinese: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你尋找僕人，因我不忘記你的命令。
english: I have gone out of the way like a wandering sheep; make search for your servant; for I keep your teachings ever in mind.

chinese: （上行（或作登階，下同）之詩。）我在急難中求告耶和華，他就應允我。
english: - A Song of the going up. - In my trouble my cry went up to the Lord, and he gave me an answer.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你救我脫離說謊的嘴唇和詭詐的舌頭！
english: O Lord, be the saviour of my soul from false lips, and from the tongue of deceit.

chinese: 詭詐的舌頭啊，要給你甚麼呢？要拿甚麼加給你呢？
english: What punishment will he give you? what more will he do to you, you false tongue?

chinese: 就是勇士的利箭和羅騰木（小樹名，松類）的炭火。
english: Sharp arrows of the strong, and burning fire.

chinese: 我寄居在米設，住在基達帳棚之中，有禍了！
english: Sorrow is mine because I am strange in Meshech, and living in the tents of Kedar.

chinese: 我與那恨惡和睦的人許久同住。
english: My soul has long been living with the haters of peace.

chinese: 我願和睦，但我發言，他們就要爭戰。
english: I am for peace: but when I say so, they are for war.

chinese: （上行之詩。）我要向山舉目；我的幫助從何而來？
english: - A Song of the going up. - My eyes are lifted up to the hills: O where will my help come from?

chinese: 我的幫助從造天地的耶和華而來。
english: Your help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

chinese: 他必不叫你的腳搖動；保護你的必不打盹！
english: May he not let your foot be moved: no need of sleep has he who keeps you.

chinese: 保護以色列的，也不打盹也不睡覺。
english: See, the eyes of Israel's keeper will not be shut in sleep.

chinese: 保護你的是耶和華；耶和華在你右邊蔭庇你。
english: The Lord is your keeper; the Lord is your shade on your right hand.

chinese: 白日，太陽必不傷你；夜間，月亮必不害你。
english: You will not be touched by the sun in the day, or by the moon at night.

chinese: 耶和華要保護你，免受一切的災害；他要保護你的性命。
english: The Lord will keep you safe from all evil; he will take care of your soul.

chinese: 你出你入，耶和華要保護你，從今時直到永遠。
english: The Lord will keep watch over your going out and your coming in, from this time and for ever.

chinese: （大衛上行之詩。）人對我說：我們往耶和華的殿去，我就歡喜。
english: - A Song of the going up. Of David. - I was glad because they said to me, We will go into the house of the Lord.

chinese: 耶路撒冷啊，我們的腳站在你的門內。
english: At last our feet were inside your doors, O Jerusalem.

chinese: 耶路撒冷被建造，如同連絡整齊的一座城。
english: O Jerusalem, you are like a town which is well joined together;

chinese: 眾支派，就是耶和華的支派，上那裡去，按以色列的常例（或譯：作以色列的證據）稱讚耶和華的名。
english: To which the tribes went up, even the tribes of the Lord, for a witness to Israel, to give praise to the name of the Lord.

chinese: 因為在那裡設立審判的寶座，就是大衛家的寶座。
english: For there seats for the judges were placed, even the rulers' seats of the line of David.

chinese: 你們要為耶路撒冷求平安！耶路撒冷啊，愛你的人必然興旺！
english: O make prayers for the peace of Jerusalem; may they whose love is given to you do well.

chinese: 願你城中平安！願你宮內興旺！
english: May peace be inside your walls, and wealth in your noble houses.

chinese: 因我弟兄和同伴的緣故，我要說：願平安在你中間！
english: Because of my brothers and friends, I will now say, Let peace be with you.

chinese: 因耶和華─我們神殿的緣故，我要為你求福！
english: Because of the house of the Lord our God, I will be working for your good.

chinese: （上行之詩。）坐在天上的主啊，我向你舉目。
english: - A Song of the going up. - To you my eyes are lifted up, even to you whose seat is in the heavens.

chinese: 看哪，僕人的眼睛怎樣望主人的手，使女的眼睛怎樣望主母的手，我們的眼睛也照樣望耶和華─我們的神，直到他憐憫我們。
english: See! as the eyes of servants are turned to the hands of their masters, and the eyes of a servant-girl to her owner, so our eyes are waiting for the Lord our God, till he has mercy on us.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你憐憫我們，憐憫我們！因為我們被藐視，已到極處。
english: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: for all men are looking down on us.

chinese: 我們被那些安逸人的譏誚和驕傲人的藐視，已到極處。
english: For long enough have men of pride made sport of our soul.

chinese: （大衛上行之詩。）以色列人要說：若不是耶和華幫助我們，
english: - A Song of the going up. Of David. - If it had not been the Lord who was on our side (let Israel now say);

chinese: 若不是耶和華幫助我們，當人起來攻擊我們、
english: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men came up against us;

chinese: 向我們發怒的時候，就把我們活活地吞了。
english: They would have made a meal of us while still living, in the heat of their wrath against us:

chinese: 那時，波濤必漫過我們，河水必淹沒我們，
english: We would have been covered by the waters; the streams would have gone over our soul;

chinese: 狂傲的水必淹沒我們。
english: Yes, the waters of pride would have gone over our soul.

chinese: 耶和華是應當稱頌的！他沒有把我們當野食交給他們吞吃（原文是牙齒）。
english: Praise be to the Lord, who has not let us be wounded by their teeth.

chinese: 我們好像雀鳥，從捕鳥人的網羅裡逃脫；網羅破裂，我們逃脫了。
english: Our soul has gone free like a bird out of the net of those who would take her: the net is broken, and we are free.

chinese: 我們得幫助，是在乎倚靠造天地之耶和華的名。
english: Our help is in the name of the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.

chinese: （上行之詩。）倚靠耶和華的人好像錫安山，永不動搖。
english: - A Song of the going up. - Those whose hope is in the Lord are like the mountain of Zion, which may not be moved, but keeps its place for ever.

chinese: 眾山怎樣圍繞耶路撒冷，耶和華也照樣圍繞他的百姓，從今時直到永遠。
english: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people, from this time and for ever.

chinese: 惡人的杖不常落在義人的分上，免得義人伸手作惡。
english: For the rod of sinners will not be resting on the heritage of the upright; so that the upright may not put out their hands to evil.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你善待那些為善和心裡正直的人。
english: Do good, O Lord, to those who are good, and to those who are upright in heart.

chinese: 至於那偏行彎曲道路的人，耶和華必使他和作惡的人一同出去受刑。願平安歸於以色列！
english: But as for such as are turned out of the straight way, the Lord will take them away with the workers of evil. Let peace be on Israel.

chinese: （上行之詩。）當耶和華將那些被擄的帶回錫安的時候，我們好像做夢的人。
english: - A Song of the going up. - When the Lord made a change in Zion's fate, we were like men in a dream.

chinese: 我們滿口喜笑、滿舌歡呼的時候，外邦中就有人說：耶和華為他們行了大事！
english: Then our mouths were full of laughing, and our tongues gave a glad cry; they said among the nations, The Lord has done great things for them.

chinese: 耶和華果然為我們行了大事，我們就歡喜。
english: The Lord has done great things for us; because of which we are glad.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你使我們被擄的人歸回，好像南地的河水復流。
english: Let our fate be changed, O Lord, like the streams in the South.

chinese: 流淚撒種的，必歡呼收割！
english: Those who put in seed with weeping will get in the grain with cries of joy.

chinese: 那帶種流淚出去的，必要歡歡樂樂地帶禾捆回來！
english: Though a man may go out weeping, taking his vessel of seed with him; he will come again in joy, with the corded stems of grain in his arms.

chinese: （所羅門上行之詩。）若不是耶和華建造房屋，建造的人就枉然勞力；若不是耶和華看守城池，看守的人就枉然警醒。
english: - A Song of the going up. Of Solomon. - If the Lord is not helping the builders, then the building of a house is to no purpose: if the Lord does not keep the town, the watchman keeps his watch for nothing.

chinese: 你們清晨早起，夜晚安歇，吃勞碌得來的飯，本是枉然；惟有耶和華所親愛的，必叫他安然睡覺。
english: It is of no use for you to get up early, and to go late to your rest, with the bread of sorrow for your food; for the Lord gives to his loved ones in sleep.

chinese: 兒女是耶和華所賜的產業；所懷的胎是他所給的賞賜。
english: See, sons are a heritage from the Lord; the fruit of the body is his reward.

chinese: 少年時所生的兒女好像勇士手中的箭。
english: Like arrows in the hand of a man of war, are the children of the young.

chinese: 箭袋充滿的人便為有福；他們在城門口和仇敵說話的時候，必不至於羞愧。
english: Happy is the man who has a good store of them; he will not be put to shame, but his cause will be supported by them against his haters.

chinese: （上行之詩。）凡敬畏耶和華、遵行他道的人便為有福！
english: - A Song of the going up. - Happy is the worshipper of the Lord, who is walking in his ways.

chinese: 你要吃勞碌得來的；你要享福，事情順利。
english: You will have the fruit of the work of your hands: happy will you be, and all will be well for you.

chinese: 你妻子在你的內室，好像多結果子的葡萄樹；你兒女圍繞你的桌子，好像橄欖栽子。
english: Your wife will be like a fertile vine in the inmost parts of your house: your children will be like olive plants round your table.

chinese: 看哪，敬畏耶和華的人必要這樣蒙福！
english: See! this is the blessing of the worshipper of the Lord.

chinese: 願耶和華從錫安賜福給你！願你一生一世看見耶路撒冷的好處！
english: May the Lord send you blessing out of Zion: may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

chinese: 願你看見你兒女的兒女！願平安歸於以色列！
english: May you see your children's children. Peace be on Israel.

chinese: （上行之詩。）以色列當說：從我幼年以來，敵人屢次苦害我，
english: - A Song of the going up. - Great have been my troubles from the time when I was young (let Israel now say);

chinese: 從我幼年以來，敵人屢次苦害我，卻沒有勝了我。
english: Great have been my troubles from the time when I was young, but my troubles have not overcome me.

chinese: 如同扶犁的在我背上扶犁而耕，耕的犁溝甚長。
english: The ploughmen were ploughing on my back; long were the wounds they made.

chinese: 耶和華是公義的；他砍斷了惡人的繩索。
english: The Lord is true: the cords of the evil-doers are broken in two.

chinese: 願恨惡錫安的都蒙羞退後！
english: Let all the haters of Zion be shamed and turned back.

chinese: 願他們像房頂上的草，未長成而枯乾，
english: Let them be like the grass on the house-tops, which is dry before it comes to full growth.

chinese: 收割的不夠一把，捆禾的也不滿懷。
english: He who gets in the grain has no use for it; and they do not make bands of it for the grain-stems.

chinese: 過路的也不說：願耶和華所賜的福歸與你們！我們奉耶和華的名給你們祝福！
english: And those who go by do not say, The blessing of the Lord be on you; we give you blessing in the name of the Lord.

chinese: （上行之詩。）耶和華啊，我從深處向你求告！
english: - A Song of the going up. - Out of the deep have I sent up my cry to you, O Lord.

chinese: 主啊，求你聽我的聲音！願你側耳聽我懇求的聲音！
english: Lord, let my voice come before you: let your ears be awake to the voice of my prayer.

chinese: 主─耶和華啊，你若究察罪孽，誰能站得住呢？
english: O Jah, if you took note of every sin, who would go free?

chinese: 但在你有赦免之恩，要叫人敬畏你。
english: But there is forgiveness with you, so that you may be feared.

chinese: 我等候耶和華，我的心等候；我也仰望他的話。
english: I am waiting for the Lord, my soul is waiting for him, and my hope is in his word.

chinese: 我的心等候主，勝於守夜的，等候天亮，勝於守夜的，等候天亮。
english: My soul is watching for the Lord more than those who are watching for the morning; yes, more than the watchers for the morning.

chinese: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華！因他有慈愛，有豐盛的救恩。
english: O Israel, have hope in the Lord; for with the Lord is mercy and full salvation.

chinese: 他必救贖以色列脫離一切的罪孽。
english: And he will make Israel free from all his sins.

chinese: （大衛上行之詩。）耶和華啊，我的心不狂傲，我的眼不高大；重大和測不透的事，我也不敢行。
english: - A Song of the going up. Of David. - Lord, there is no pride in my heart and my eyes are not lifted up; and I have not taken part in great undertakings, or in things over-hard for me.

chinese: 我的心平穩安靜，好像斷過奶的孩子在他母親的懷中；我的心在我裡面真像斷過奶的孩子。
english: See, I have made my soul calm and quiet, like a child on its mother's breast; my soul is like a child on its mother's breast.

chinese: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華，從今時直到永遠！
english: O Israel, have hope in the Lord, from this time and for ever.

chinese: （上行之詩。）耶和華啊，求你記念大衛所受的一切苦難！
english: - A Song of the going up. - Lord, give thought to David, and to all his troubles;

chinese: 他怎樣向耶和華起誓，向雅各的大能者許願，
english: How he made an oath to the Lord, and gave his word to the great God of Jacob, saying,

chinese: 說：我必不進我的帳幕，也不上我的床榻；
english: Truly, I will not come into my house, or go to my bed,

chinese: 我不容我的眼睛睡覺，也不容我的眼目打盹；
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or rest to my eyeballs,

chinese: 直等我為耶和華尋得所在，為雅各的大能者尋得居所。
english: Till I have got a place for the Lord, a resting-place for the great God of Jacob.

chinese: 我們聽說約櫃在以法他，我們在基列耶琳就尋見了。
english: We had news of it at Ephrathah: we came to it in the fields of the wood.

chinese: 我們要進他的居所，在他腳凳前下拜。
english: Let us go into his tent; let us give worship at his feet.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你興起，和你有能力的約櫃同入安息之所！
english: Come back, O Lord, to your resting-place; you and the ark of your strength.

chinese: 願你的祭司披上公義！願你的聖民歡呼！
english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; and let your saints give cries of joy.

chinese: 求你因你僕人大衛的緣故，不要厭棄你的受膏者！
english: Because of your servant David, do not give up your king.

chinese: 耶和華向大衛、憑誠實起了誓，必不反覆，說：我要使你所生的坐在你的寶座上。
english: The Lord gave a true oath to David, which he will not take back, saying, I will give your kingdom to the fruit of your body.

chinese: 你的眾子若守我的約和我所教訓他們的法度，他們的子孫必永遠坐在你的寶座上。
english: If your children keep my word, and the teachings which I will give them, their children will be rulers of your kingdom for ever.

chinese: 因為耶和華揀選了錫安，願意當作自己的居所，
english: For the Lord's heart is on Zion, desiring it for his resting-place.

chinese: 說：這是我永遠安息之所；我要住在這裡，因為是我所願意的。
english: This is my rest for ever: here will I ever be; for this is my desire.

chinese: 我要使其中的糧食豐滿，使其中的窮人飽足。
english: My blessing will be on her food; and her poor will be full of bread.

chinese: 我要使祭司披上救恩，聖民大聲歡呼！
english: Her priests will be clothed with salvation; and her saints will give cries of joy.

chinese: 我要叫大衛的角在那裡發生；我為我的受膏者預備明燈。
english: There I will make the horn of David fertile: I have made ready a light for my king.

chinese: 我要使他的仇敵披上羞恥；但他的冠冕要在頭上發光。
english: His haters will be clothed with shame; but I will make his crown shining.

chinese: （大衛上行之詩。）看哪，弟兄和睦同居是何等地善，何等地美！
english: - A Song of the going up. Of David. - See how good and how pleasing it is for brothers to be living together in harmony!

chinese: 這好比那貴重的油澆在亞倫的頭上，流到鬍鬚，又流到他的衣襟；
english: It is like oil of great price on the head, flowing down over the face, even Aaron's face: coming down to the edge of his robe;

chinese: 又好比黑門的甘露降在錫安山；因為在那裡有耶和華所命定的福，就是永遠的生命。
english: Like the dew of Hermon, which comes down on the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord gave orders for the blessing, even life for ever.

chinese: （上行之詩。）耶和華的僕人夜間站在耶和華殿中的，你們當稱頌耶和華！
english: - A Song of the going up. - Give praise to the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, who take your places in the house of the Lord by night.

chinese: 你們當向聖所舉手，稱頌耶和華！
english: Give praise to the Lord, lifting up your hands in his holy place.

chinese: 願造天地的耶和華，從錫安賜福給你們！
english: May the Lord, who made heaven and earth, send you blessing out of Zion,

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華的名！耶和華的僕人站在耶和華殿中；站在我們神殿院中的，你們要讚美他！
english: Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.
You who are in the house of the Lord, and in the open spaces of the house of our God,

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！耶和華本為善；要歌頌他的名，因為這是美好的。
english: Give praise to Jah, for he is good: make melody to his name, for it is pleasing.

chinese: 耶和華揀選雅各歸自己，揀選以色列特作自己的子民。
english: For the Lord has taken Jacob for himself, and Israel for his property.

chinese: 原來我知道耶和華為大，也知道我們的主超乎萬神之上。
english: I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is greater than all other gods.

chinese: 耶和華在天上，在地下，在海中，在一切的深處，都隨自己的意旨而行。
english: The Lord has done whatever was pleasing to him, in heaven, and on the earth, in the seas and in all the deep waters.

chinese: 他使雲霧從地極上騰，造電隨雨而閃，從府庫中帶出風來。
english: He makes the mists go up from the ends of the earth; he makes thunder-flames for the rain; he sends out the winds from his store-houses.

chinese: 他將埃及頭生的，連人帶牲畜都擊殺了。
english: He put to death the first-fruits of Egypt, of man and of beast.

chinese: 埃及啊，他施行神蹟奇事，在你當中，在法老和他一切臣僕身上。
english: He sent signs and wonders among you, O Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

chinese: 他擊殺許多的民，又殺戮大能的王，
english: He overcame great nations, and put strong kings to death;

chinese: 就是亞摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩，並迦南一切的國王，
english: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;

chinese: 將他們的地賞賜他的百姓以色列為業。
english: And gave their land for a heritage, even for a heritage to Israel his people.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的名存到永遠！耶和華啊，你可記念的名存到萬代！
english: O Lord, your name is eternal; and the memory of you will have no end.

chinese: 耶和華要為他的百姓伸冤，為他的僕人後悔。
english: For the Lord will be judge of his people's cause; his feelings will be changed to his servants.

chinese: 外邦的偶像是金的，銀的，是人手所造的；
english: The images of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

chinese: 有口卻不能言，有眼卻不能看，
english: They have mouths, but no voice, they have eyes, but they do not see;

chinese: 有耳卻不能聽，口中也沒有氣息。
english: They have ears, but no hearing; and there is no breath in their mouths.

chinese: 造他的要和他一樣，凡靠他的也要如此。
english: Those who make them are like them; and so is everyone who puts his hope in them.

chinese: 以色列家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！亞倫家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！
english: Give praise to the Lord, O children of Israel: give praise to the Lord, O sons of Aaron:

chinese: 利未家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！你們敬畏耶和華的，要稱頌耶和華！
english: Give praise to the Lord, O sons of Levi: let all the worshippers of the Lord give him praise.

chinese: 住在耶路撒冷的，耶和華該從錫安受稱頌。你們要讚美耶和華！
english: Praise be to the Lord out of Zion, even to the Lord whose house is in Jerusalem, Let the Lord be praised.

chinese: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 你們要稱謝萬神之神，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: O give praise to the God of gods: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 你們要稱謝萬主之主，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: O give praise to the Lord of lords: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 稱謝那獨行大奇事的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: To him who only does great wonders: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 稱謝那用智慧造天的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: To him who by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 稱謝那鋪地在水以上的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: To him by whom the earth was stretched out over the waters: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 稱謝那造成大光的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: To him who made great lights: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 他造日頭管白晝，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: The sun to have rule by day: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 他造月亮星宿管黑夜，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: The moon and the stars to have rule by night: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 稱謝那擊殺埃及人之長子的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: To him who put to death the first-fruits of Egypt: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

chinese: 他領以色列人從他們中間出來，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: And took out Israel from among them: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

chinese: 他施展大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: With a strong hand and an outstretched arm: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 稱謝那分裂紅海的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: To him who made a way through the Red Sea: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

chinese: 他領以色列從其中經過，因他的慈愛永遠長存；
english: And let Israel go through it: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

chinese: 卻把法老和他的軍兵推翻在紅海裡，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: By him Pharaoh and his army were overturned in the Red Sea: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 稱謝那引導自己的民行走曠野的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: To him who took his people through the waste land: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 稱謝那擊殺大君王的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: To him who overcame great kings: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

chinese: 他殺戮有名的君王，因他的慈愛永遠長存；
english: And put noble kings to death: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

chinese: 就是殺戮亞摩利王西宏，因他的慈愛永遠長存；
english: Sihon, king of the Amorites: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

chinese: 又殺巴珊王噩，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: And Og, king of Bashan: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

chinese: 他將他們的地賜他的百姓為業，因他的慈愛永遠長存；
english: And gave their land to his people for a heritage: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 就是賜他的僕人以色列為業，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: Even a heritage for his servant Israel: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 他顧念我們在卑微的地步，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: Who kept us in mind when we were in trouble: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 他救拔我們脫離敵人，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: And has taken us out of the hands of our haters: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 他賜糧食給凡有血氣的，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: Who gives food to all flesh: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 你們要稱謝天上的神，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
english: O give praise to the God of heaven: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

chinese: 我們曾在巴比倫的河邊坐下，一追想錫安就哭了。
english: By the rivers of Babylon we were seated, weeping at the memory of Zion,

chinese: 我們把琴掛在那裡的柳樹上；
english: Hanging our instruments of music on the trees by the waterside.

chinese: 因為在那裡，擄掠我們的要我們唱歌，搶奪我們的要我們作樂，說：給我們唱一首錫安歌罷！
english: For there those who had taken us prisoners made request for a song; and those who had taken away all we had gave us orders to be glad, saying, Give us one of the songs of Zion.

chinese: 我們怎能在外邦唱耶和華的歌呢？
english: How may we give the Lord's song in a strange land?

chinese: 耶路撒冷啊，我若忘記你，情願我的右手忘記技巧！
english: If I keep not your memory, O Jerusalem, let not my right hand keep the memory of its art.

chinese: 我若不記念你，若不看耶路撒冷過於我所最喜樂的，情願我的舌頭貼於上膛！
english: If I let you go out of my thoughts, and if I do not put Jerusalem before my greatest joy, let my tongue be fixed to the roof of my mouth.

chinese: 耶路撒冷遭難的日子，以東人說：拆毀！拆毀！直拆到根基！耶和華啊，求你記念這仇！
english: O Lord, keep in mind against the children of Edom the day of Jerusalem; how they said, Let it be uncovered, uncovered even to its base.

chinese: 將要被滅的巴比倫城啊（城：原文是女子），報復你像你待我們的，那人便為有福！
english: O daughter of Babylon, whose fate is destruction; happy is the man who does to you what you have done to us.

chinese: 拿你的嬰孩摔在磐石上的，那人便為有福！
english: Happy is the man who takes your little ones, crushing them against the rocks.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）我要一心稱謝你，在諸神面前歌頌你。
english: - Of David. - I will give you praise with all my heart: I will make melody to you before the gods.

chinese: 我要向你的聖殿下拜，為你的慈愛和誠實稱讚你的名；因你使你的話顯為大，過於你所應許的（或譯：超乎你的名聲）。
english: I will give worship before your holy Temple, praising your name for your mercy and for your unchanging faith: for you have made your word greater than all your name.

chinese: 我呼求的日子，你就應允我，鼓勵我，使我心裡有能力。
english: When my cry came to your ears you gave me an answer, and made me great with strength in my soul.

chinese: 耶和華啊，地上的君王都要稱謝你，因他們聽見了你口中的言語。
english: All the kings of the earth will give you praise, O Lord, when the words of your mouth come to their ears.

chinese: 他們要歌頌耶和華的作為，因耶和華大有榮耀。
english: They will make songs about the ways of the Lord; for great is the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華雖高，仍看顧低微的人；他卻從遠處看出驕傲的人。
english: Though the Lord is high, he sees those who are low; and he has knowledge from far off of those who are lifted up.

chinese: 我雖行在患難中，你必將我救活；我的仇敵發怒，你必伸手抵擋他們；你的右手也必救我。
english: Even when trouble is round me, you will give me life; your hand will be stretched out against the wrath of my haters, and your right hand will be my salvation.

chinese: 耶和華必成全關乎我的事；耶和華啊，你的慈愛永遠長存！求你不要離棄你手所造的。
english: The Lord will make all things complete for me: O Lord, your mercy is eternal; do not give up the works of your hands.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，你已經鑒察我，認識我。
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - O Lord, you have knowledge of me, searching out all my secrets.

chinese: 我坐下，我起來，你都曉得；你從遠處知道我的意念。
english: You have knowledge when I am seated and when I get up, you see my thoughts from far away.

chinese: 我行路，我躺臥，你都細察；你也深知我一切所行的。
english: You keep watch over my steps and my sleep, and have knowledge of all my ways.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我舌頭上的話，你沒有一句不知道的。
english: For there is not a word on my tongue which is not clear to you, O Lord.

chinese: 你在我前後環繞我，按手在我身上。
english: I am shut in by you on every side, and you have put your hand on me.

chinese: 這樣的知識奇妙，是我不能測的，至高，是我不能及的。
english: Such knowledge is a wonder greater than my powers; it is so high that I may not come near it.

chinese: 我往哪裡去躲避你的靈？我往哪裡逃、躲避你的面？
english: Where may I go from your spirit? how may I go in flight from you?

chinese: 我若升到天上，你在那裡；我若在陰間下榻，你也在那裡。
english: If I go up to heaven, you are there: or if I make my bed in the underworld, you are there.

chinese: 我若展開清晨的翅膀，飛到海極居住，
english: If I take the wings of the morning, and go to the farthest parts of the sea;

chinese: 就是在那裡，你的手必引導我；你的右手也必扶持我。
english: Even there will I be guided by your hand, and your right hand will keep me.

chinese: 我若說：黑暗必定遮蔽我，我周圍的亮光必成為黑夜；
english: If I say, Only let me be covered by the dark, and the light about me be night;

chinese: 黑暗也不能遮蔽我，使你不見，黑夜卻如白晝發亮。黑暗和光明，在你看都是一樣。
english: Even the dark is not dark to you; the night is as bright as the day: for dark and light are the same to you.

chinese: 我的肺腑是你所造的；我在母腹中，你已覆庇我。
english: My flesh was made by you, and my parts joined together in my mother's body.

chinese: 我要稱謝你，因我受造，奇妙可畏；你的作為奇妙，這是我心深知道的。
english: I will give you praise, for I am strangely and delicately formed; your works are great wonders, and of this my soul is fully conscious.

chinese: 我在暗中受造，在地的深處被聯絡；那時，我的形體並不向你隱藏。
english: My frame was not unseen by you when I was made secretly, and strangely formed in the lowest parts of the earth.

chinese: 我未成形的體質，你的眼早已看見了；你所定的日子，我尚未度一日（或譯：我被造的肢體尚未有其一），你都寫在你的冊上了。
english: Your eyes saw my unformed substance; in your book all my days were recorded, even those which were purposed before they had come into being.

chinese: 神啊，你的意念向我何等寶貴！其數何等眾多！
english: How dear are your thoughts to me, O God! how great is the number of them!

chinese: 我若數點，比海沙更多；我睡醒的時候，仍和你同在。
english: If I made up their number, it would be more than the grains of sand; when I am awake, I am still with you.

chinese: 神啊，你必要殺戮惡人；所以，你們好流人血的，離開我去罷！
english: If only you would put the sinners to death, O God; go far from me, you men of blood.

chinese: 因為他們說惡言頂撞你；你的仇敵也妄稱你的名。
english: For they go against you with evil designs, and your haters make sport of your name.

chinese: 耶和華啊，恨惡你的，我豈不恨惡他們麼？攻擊你的，我豈不憎嫌他們麼？
english: Are not your haters hated by me, O Lord? are not those who are lifted up against you a cause of grief to me?

chinese: 我切切地恨惡他們，以他們為仇敵。
english: My hate for them is complete; my thoughts of them are as if they were making war on me.

chinese: 神啊，求你鑒察我，知道我的心思，試煉我，知道我的意念，
english: O God, let the secrets of my heart be uncovered, and let my wandering thoughts be tested:

chinese: 看在我裡面有甚麼惡行沒有，引導我走永生的道路。
english: See if there is any way of sorrow in me, and be my guide in the eternal way.

chinese: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離凶惡的人，保護我脫離強暴的人！
english: - To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. - O Lord, take me out of the power of the evil man; keep me safe from the violent man:

chinese: 他們心中圖謀奸惡，常常聚集要爭戰。
english: For their hearts are full of evil designs; and they are ever making ready causes of war.

chinese: 他們使舌頭尖利如蛇，嘴裡有虺蛇的毒氣。（細拉）
english: Their tongues are sharp like the tongue of a snake; the poison of snakes is under their lips. (Selah.)

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離惡人的手，保護我脫離強暴的人！他們圖謀推我跌倒。
english: O Lord, take me out of the hands of sinners; keep me safe from the violent man: for they are designing my downfall.

chinese: 驕傲人為我暗設網羅和繩索；他們在路旁鋪下網，設下圈套。（細拉）
english: The men of pride have put secret cords for my feet; stretching nets in my way, so that they may take me with their tricks. (Selah.)

chinese: 我曾對耶和華說：你是我的神。耶和華啊，求你留心聽我懇求的聲音！
english: I have said to the Lord, You are my God: give ear, O Lord, to the voice of my prayer.

chinese: 主─耶和華、我救恩的力量啊，在爭戰的日子，你遮蔽了我的頭。
english: O Lord God, the strength of my salvation, you have been a cover over my head in the day of the fight.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你不要遂惡人的心願；不要成就他們的計謀，恐怕他們自高。（細拉）
english: O Lord, give not the wrongdoer his desire; give him no help in his evil designs, or he may be uplifted in pride. (Selah.)

chinese: 至於那些昂首圍困我的人，願他們嘴唇的奸惡陷害（原文是遮蔽自己）！
english: As for those who come round me, let their heads be covered by the evil of their lips.

chinese: 願火炭落在他們身上！願他們被丟在火中，拋在深坑裡，不能再起來。
english: Let burning flames come down on them: let them be put into the fire, and into deep waters, so that they may not get up again.

chinese: 說惡言的人在地上必堅立不住；禍患必獵取強暴的人，將他打倒。
english: Let not a man of evil tongue be safe on earth: let destruction overtake the violent man with blow on blow.

chinese: 我知道耶和華必為困苦人伸冤，必為窮乏人辨屈。
english: I am certain that the Lord will take care of the cause of the poor, and of the rights of those who are troubled.

chinese: 義人必要稱讚你的名；正直人必住在你面前。
english: Truly, the upright will give praise to your name: the holy will have a place in your house.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華啊，我曾求告你，求你快快臨到我這裡！我求告你的時候，願你留心聽我的聲音！
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - Lord, I have made my cry to you; come to me quickly; give ear to my voice, when it goes up to you.

chinese: 願我的禱告如香陳列在你面前！願我舉手祈求，如獻晚祭！
english: Let my prayer be ordered before you like a sweet smell; and let the lifting up of my hands be like the evening offering.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你禁止我的口，把守我的嘴！
english: O Lord, keep a watch over my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

chinese: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪惡，以致我和作孽的人同行惡事；也不叫我吃他們的美食。
english: Keep my heart from desiring any evil thing, or from taking part in the sins of the evil-doers with men who do wrong: and let me have no part in their good things.

chinese: 任憑義人擊打我，這算為仁慈；任憑他責備我，這算為頭上的膏油；我的頭不要躲閃。正在他們行惡的時候，我仍要祈禱。
english: Let the upright give me punishment; and let the god-fearing man put me in the right way; but I will not let the oil of sinners come on my head: when they do evil I will give myself to prayer.

chinese: 他們的審判官被扔在巖下；眾人要聽我的話，因為這話甘甜。
english: When destruction comes to their judges by the side of the rock, they will give ear to my words, for they are sweet.

chinese: 我們的骨頭散在墓旁，好像人耕田、刨地的土塊。
english: Our bones are broken up at the mouth of the underworld, as the earth is broken by the plough.

chinese: 主─耶和華啊，我的眼目仰望你；我投靠你，求你不要將我撇得孤苦！
english: But my eyes are turned to you, O Lord God: my hope is in you; let not my soul be given up to death.

chinese: 求你保護我脫離惡人為我設的網羅和作孽之人的圈套！
english: Keep me from the net which they have put down for me, and from the designs of the workers of evil.

chinese: 願惡人落在自己的網裡，我卻得以逃脫。
english: Let the sinners be taken in the nets which they themselves have put down, while I go free.

chinese: （大衛在洞裡作的訓誨詩，乃是祈禱。）我發聲哀告耶和華，發聲懇求耶和華。
english: - Maschil. Of David. A prayer when he was in the hole of the rock. - The sound of my cry went up to the Lord; with my voice I made my prayer for grace to the Lord.

chinese: 我在他面前吐露我的苦情，陳說我的患難。
english: I put all my sorrows before him; and made clear to him all my trouble.

chinese: 我的靈在我裡面發昏的時候，你知道我的道路。在我行的路上，敵人為我暗設網羅。
english: When my spirit is overcome, your eyes are on my goings; nets have been secretly placed in the way in which I go.

chinese: 求你向我右邊觀看，因為沒有人認識我；我無處避難，也沒有人眷顧我。
english: Looking to my right side, I saw no man who was my friend: I had no safe place; no one had any care for my soul.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我曾向你哀求。我說：你是我的避難所；在活人之地，你是我的福分。
english: I have made my cry to you, O Lord; I have said, You are my safe place, and my heritage in the land of the living.

chinese: 求你側耳聽我的呼求，因我落到極卑之地；求你救我脫離逼迫我的人，因為他們比我強盛。
english: Give ear to my cry, for I am made very low: take me out of the hands of my haters, for they are stronger than I.

chinese: 求你領我出離被囚之地，我好稱讚你的名。義人必環繞我，因為你是用厚恩待我。
english: Take my soul out of prison, so that I may give praise to your name: the upright will give praise because of me; for you have given me a full reward.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，留心聽我的懇求，憑你的信實和公義應允我。
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - Let my prayer come to you, O Lord; give ear to my requests for your grace; keep faith with me, and give me an answer in your righteousness;

chinese: 求你不要審問僕人；因為在你面前，凡活著的人沒有一個是義的。
english: Let not your servant come before you to be judged; for no man living is upright in your eyes.

chinese: 原來仇敵逼迫我，將我打倒在地，使我住在幽暗之處，像死了許久的人一樣。
english: The evil man has gone after my soul; my life is crushed down to the earth: he has put me in the dark, like those who have long been dead.

chinese: 所以，我的靈在我裡面發昏；我的心在我裡面悽慘。
english: Because of this my spirit is overcome; and my heart is full of fear.

chinese: 我追想古時之日，思想你的一切作為，默念你手的工作。
english: I keep in mind the early days of the past, giving thought to all your acts, even to the work of your hands.

chinese: 我向你舉手；我的心渴想你，如乾旱之地盼雨一樣。（細拉）
english: My hands are stretched out to you: my soul is turned to you, like a land in need of water. (Selah.)

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你速速應允我！我心神耗盡！不要向我掩面，免得我像那些下坑的人一樣。
english: Be quick in answering me, O Lord, for the strength of my spirit is gone: let me see your face, so that I may not be like those who go down into the underworld.

chinese: 求你使我清晨得聽你慈愛之言，因我倚靠你；求你使我知道當行的路，因我的心仰望你。
english: Let the story of your mercy come to me in the morning, for my hope is in you: give me knowledge of the way in which I am to go; for my soul is lifted up to you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你救我脫離我的仇敵！我往你那裡藏身。
english: O Lord, take me out of the hands of my haters; my soul is waiting for you.

chinese: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意，因你是我的神。你的靈本為善；求你引我到平坦之地。
english: Give me teaching so that I may do your pleasure; for you are my God: let your good Spirit be my guide into the land of righteousness.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你為你的名將我救活，憑你的公義，將我從患難中領出來，
english: Give me life, O Lord, because of your name; in your righteousness take my soul out of trouble.

chinese: 憑你的慈愛剪除我的仇敵，滅絕一切苦待我的人，因我是你的僕人。
english: And in your mercy put an end to my haters, and send destruction on all those who are against my soul; for I am your servant.

chinese: （大衛的詩。）耶和華─我的磐石是應當稱頌的！他教導我的手爭戰，教導我的指頭打仗。
english: - A Psalm. Of David. - Praise be to the God of my strength, teaching my hands the use of the sword, and my fingers the art of fighting:

chinese: 他是我慈愛的主，我的山寨，我的高臺，我的救主，我的盾牌，是我所投靠的；他使我的百姓服在我以下。
english: He is my strength, and my Rock; my high tower, and my saviour; my keeper and my hope: he gives me authority over my people.

chinese: 耶和華啊，人算甚麼，你竟認識他！世人算甚麼，你竟顧念他！
english: Lord, what is man, that you keep him in mind? or the son of man that you take him into account?

chinese: 人好像一口氣；他的年日如同影兒快快過去。
english: Man is like a breath: his life is like a shade which is quickly gone.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你使天下垂，親自降臨，摸山，山就冒煙。
english: Come down, O Lord, from your heavens: at your touch let the mountains give out smoke.

chinese: 求你發出閃電，使他們四散，射出你的箭，使他們擾亂。
english: With your storm-flames send them in flight: send out your arrows for their destruction.

chinese: 求你從上伸手救拔我，救我出離大水，救我脫離外邦人的手。
english: Put out your hand from on high; make me free, take me safely out of the great waters, and out of the hands of strange men;

chinese: 他們的口說謊話；他們的右手起假誓。
english: In whose mouths are false words, and whose right hand is a right hand of deceit.

chinese: 神啊，我要向你唱新歌，用十弦瑟向你歌頌。
english: I will make a new song to you, O God; I will make melody to you on an instrument of ten cords.

chinese: 你是那拯救君王的；你是那救僕人大衛脫離害命之刀的。
english: It is God who gives salvation to kings; and who kept his servant David from the wounding sword.

chinese: 求你救拔我，救我脫離外邦人的手。他們的口說謊話；他們的右手起假誓。
english: Make me free, and take me out of the hands of strange men, in whose mouths are false words, and whose right hand is a right hand of deceit.

chinese: 我們的兒子從幼年好像樹栽子長大；我們的女兒如同殿角石，是按建宮的樣式鑿成的。
english: Our sons are like tall young plants; and our daughters like the shining stones of a king's house;

chinese: 我們的倉盈滿，能出各樣的糧食；我們的羊在田間孳生千萬。
english: Our store-houses are full of all good things; and our sheep give birth to thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

chinese: 我們的牛馱著滿馱，沒有人闖進來搶奪，也沒有人出去爭戰；我們的街市上也沒有哭號的聲音。
english: Our oxen are well weighted down; our cows give birth safely; there is no going out, and there is no cry of sorrow in our open places.

chinese: 遇見這光景的百姓便為有福！有耶和華為他們的神，這百姓便為有福！
english: Happy is the nation whose ways are so ordered: yes, happy is the nation whose God is the Lord.

chinese: （大衛的讚美詩。）我的神我的王啊，我要尊崇你！我要永永遠遠稱頌你的名！
english: - A Song of praise. Of David. - Let me give glory to you, O God, my King; and blessing to your name for ever and ever.

chinese: 我要天天稱頌你，也要永永遠遠讚美你的名！
english: Every day will I give you blessing, praising your name for ever and ever.

chinese: 耶和華本為大，該受大讚美；其大無法測度。
english: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; his power may never be searched out.

chinese: 這代要對那代頌讚你的作為，也要傳揚你的大能。
english: One generation after another will give praise to your great acts, and make clear the operation of your strength.

chinese: 我要默念你威嚴的尊榮和你奇妙的作為。
english: My thoughts will be of the honour and glory of your rule, and of the wonder of your works.

chinese: 人要傳說你可畏之事的能力；我也要傳揚你的大德。
english: Men will be talking of the power and fear of your acts; I will give word of your glory.

chinese: 他們記念你的大恩就要傳出來，並要歌唱你的公義。
english: Their sayings will be full of the memory of all your mercy, and they will make songs of your righteousness.

chinese: 耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫，不輕易發怒，大有慈愛。
english: The Lord is full of grace and pity; not quickly angry, but great in mercy.

chinese: 耶和華善待萬民；他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。
english: The Lord is good to all men; and his mercies are over all his works.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你一切所造的都要稱謝你；你的聖民也要稱頌你，
english: All the works of your hands give praise to you, O Lord; and your saints give you blessing.
