chinese: 傳說你國的榮耀，談論你的大能，
english: Their words will be of the glory of your kingdom, and their talk of your strength;

chinese: 好叫世人知道你大能的作為，並你國度威嚴的榮耀。
english: So that the sons of men may have knowledge of his acts of power, and of the great glory of his kingdom.

chinese: 你的國是永遠的國！你執掌的權柄存到萬代！
english: Your kingdom is an eternal kingdom, and your rule is through all generations.

chinese: 凡跌倒的，耶和華將他們扶持；凡被壓下的，將他們扶起。
english: The Lord is the support of all who are crushed, and the lifter up of all who are bent down.

chinese: 萬民都舉目仰望你；你隨時給他們食物。
english: The eyes of all men are waiting for you; and you give them their food in its time.

chinese: 你張手，使有生氣的都隨願飽足。
english: By the opening of your hand, every living thing has its desire in full measure.

chinese: 耶和華在他一切所行的，無不公義；在他一切所做的都有慈愛。
english: The Lord is upright in all his ways, and kind in all his works.

chinese: 凡求告耶和華的，就是誠心求告他的，耶和華便與他們相近。
english: The Lord is near all those who give honour to his name; even to all who give honour to him with true hearts.

chinese: 敬畏他的，他必成就他們的心願，也必聽他們的呼求，拯救他們。
english: To his worshippers, he will give their desire; their cry comes to his ears, and he gives them salvation.

chinese: 耶和華保護一切愛他的人，卻要滅絕一切的惡人。
english: The Lord will keep all his worshippers from danger; but he will send destruction on all sinners.

chinese: 我的口要說出讚美耶和華的話；惟願凡有血氣的都永永遠遠稱頌他的聖名。
english: My mouth will give praise to the Lord; let all flesh be blessing his holy name for ever and ever.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！我的心哪，你要讚美耶和華！
english: Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul.

chinese: 我一生要讚美耶和華！我還活的時候要歌頌我的神！
english: While I have breath I will give praise to the Lord: I will make melody to my God while I have my being.

chinese: 你們不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人；他一點不能幫助。
english: Put not your faith in rulers, or in the son of man, in whom there is no salvation.

chinese: 他的氣一斷，就歸回塵土；他所打算的，當日就消滅了。
english: Man's breath goes out, he is turned back again to dust; in that day all his purposes come to an end.

chinese: 以雅各的神為幫助、仰望耶和華─他神的，這人便為有福！
english: Happy is the man who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:

chinese: 耶和華造天、地、海，和其中的萬物；他守誠實，直到永遠。
english: Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things in them; who keeps faith for ever:

chinese: 他為受屈的伸冤，賜食物與飢餓的。耶和華釋放被囚的；
english: Who gives their rights to those who are crushed down; and gives food to those who are in need of it: the Lord makes the prisoners free;

chinese: 耶和華開了瞎子的眼睛；耶和華扶起被壓下的人。耶和華喜愛義人。
english: The Lord makes open the eyes of the blind; the Lord is the lifter up of those who are bent down; the Lord is a lover of the upright;

chinese: 耶和華保護寄居的，扶持孤兒和寡婦，卻使惡人的道路彎曲。
english: The Lord takes care of those who are in a strange land; he gives help to the widow and to the child who has no father; but he sends destruction on the way of sinners.

chinese: 耶和華要作王，直到永遠！錫安哪，你的神要作王，直到萬代！你們要讚美耶和華！
english: The Lord will be King for ever; your God, O Zion, will be King through all generations. Praise be to the Lord.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！因歌頌我們的神為善為美；讚美的話是合宜的。
english: Give praise to the Lord; for it is good to make melody to our God; praise is pleasing and beautiful.

chinese: 耶和華建造耶路撒冷，聚集以色列中被趕散的人。
english: The Lord is building up Jerusalem; he makes all the outlaws of Israel come together.

chinese: 他醫好傷心的人，裹好他們的傷處。
english: He makes the broken-hearted well, and puts oil on their wounds.

chinese: 他數點星宿的數目，一一稱他的名。
english: He sees the number of the stars; he gives them all their names.

chinese: 我們的主為大，最有能力；他的智慧無法測度。
english: Great is our Lord, and great his power; there is no limit to his wisdom.

chinese: 耶和華扶持謙卑人，將惡人傾覆於地。
english: The Lord gives help to the poor in spirit; but he sends sinners down in shame.

chinese: 你們要以感謝向耶和華歌唱，用琴向我們的神歌頌。
english: Make songs of praise to the Lord; make melody to our God with instruments of music.

chinese: 他用雲遮天，為地降雨，使草生長在山上。
english: By his hand the heaven is covered with clouds and rain is stored up for the earth; he makes the grass tall on the mountains.

chinese: 他賜食給走獸和啼叫的小烏鴉。
english: He gives food to every beast, and to the young ravens in answer to their cry.

chinese: 他不喜悅馬的力大，不喜愛人的腿快。
english: He has no delight in the strength of a horse; he takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

chinese: 耶和華喜愛敬畏他和盼望他慈愛的人。
english: The Lord takes pleasure in his worshippers, and in those whose hope is in his mercy.

chinese: 耶路撒冷啊，你要頌讚耶和華！錫安哪，你要讚美你的神！
english: Give praise to the Lord, O Jerusalem; give praise to your God, O Zion.

chinese: 因為他堅固了你的門閂，賜福給你中間的兒女。
english: He has made strong the iron bands of your doors; he has sent blessings on your children inside your walls.

chinese: 他使你境內平安，用上好的麥子使你滿足。
english: He gives peace in all your land, making your stores full of fat grain.

chinese: 他發命在地；他的話頒行最快。
english: He sends out his orders to the earth; his word goes out quickly.

chinese: 他降雪如羊毛，撒霜如爐灰。
english: He gives snow like wool; he sends out ice-drops like dust.

chinese: 他擲下冰雹如碎渣；他發出寒冷，誰能當得起呢？
english: He sends down ice like raindrops: water is made hard by his cold.

chinese: 他一出令，這些就都消化；他使風颳起，水便流動。
english: At the outgoing of his word, the ice is turned to water; when he sends out his wind, there is a flowing of waters.

chinese: 他將他的道指示雅各，將他的律例典章指示以色列。
english: He makes his word clear to Jacob, teaching Israel his laws and his decisions.

chinese: 別國他都沒有這樣待過；至於他的典章，他們向來沒有知道。你們要讚美耶和華！
english: He has not done these things for any other nation: and as for his laws, they have no knowledge of them. Let the Lord be praised.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！從天上讚美耶和華，在高處讚美他！
english: Give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised from the heavens: give him praise in the skies.

chinese: 他的眾使者都要讚美他！他的諸軍都要讚美他！
english: Give praise to him, all you his angels: give praise to him, all his armies.

chinese: 日頭月亮，你們要讚美他！放光的星宿，你們都要讚美他！
english: Give praise to him, you sun and moon: give praise to him, all you stars of light.

chinese: 天上的天和天上的水，你們都要讚美他！
english: Give praise to him, you highest heavens, and you waters which are over the heavens.

chinese: 願這些都讚美耶和華的名！因他一吩咐便都造成。
english: Let them give praise to the name of the Lord: for he gave the order, and they were made.

chinese: 他將這些立定，直到永永遠遠；他定了命，不能廢去（或譯：越過）。
english: He has put them in their places for ever; he has given them their limits which may not be broken.

chinese: 所有在地上的，大魚和一切深洋，
english: Give praise to the Lord from the earth, you great sea-beasts, and deep places:

chinese: 火與冰雹，雪和霧氣，成就他命的狂風，
english: Fire and rain of ice, snow and mists; storm-wind, doing his word:

chinese: 大山和小山，結果的樹木和一切香柏樹，
english: Mountains and all hills; fruit-trees and all trees of the mountains:

chinese: 野獸和一切牲畜，昆蟲和飛鳥，
english: Beasts and all cattle; insects and winged birds:

chinese: 世上的君王和萬民，首領和世上一切審判官，
english: Kings of the earth, and all peoples; rulers and all judges of the earth:

chinese: 少年人和處女，老年人和孩童，都當讚美耶和華！
english: Young men and virgins; old men and children:

chinese: 願這些都讚美耶和華的名！因為獨有他的名被尊崇；他的榮耀在天地之上。
english: Let them give glory to the name of the Lord: for his name only is to be praised: his kingdom is over the earth and the heaven.

chinese: 他將他百姓的角高舉，因此他（或譯：他使）一切聖民以色列人，就是與他相近的百姓，都讚美他！你們要讚美耶和華！
english: He has put on high the horn of his people, for the praise of all his saints; even the children of Israel, a people which is near to him. Let the Lord be praised.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！向耶和華唱新歌，在聖民的會中讚美他！
english: Let the Lord be praised. Make a new song to the Lord, let his praise be in the meeting of his saints.

chinese: 願以色列因造他的主歡喜！願錫安的民因他們的王快樂！
english: Let Israel have joy in his maker; let the children of Zion be glad in their King.

chinese: 願他們跳舞讚美他的名，擊鼓彈琴歌頌他！
english: Let them give praise to his name in the dance: let them make melody to him with instruments of brass and corded instruments of music.

chinese: 因為耶和華喜愛他的百姓；他要用救恩當作謙卑人的妝飾。
english: For the Lord has pleasure in his people: he gives the poor in spirit a crown of salvation.

chinese: 願聖民因所得的榮耀高興！願他們在床上歡呼！
english: Let the saints have joy and glory: let them give cries of joy on their beds.

chinese: 願他們口中稱讚神為高，手裡有兩刃的刀，
english: Let the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hands;

chinese: 為要報復列邦，刑罰萬民。
english: To give the nations the reward of their sins, and the peoples their punishment;

chinese: 要用鍊子捆他們的君王，用鐵鐐鎖他們的大臣；
english: To put their kings in chains, and their rulers in bands of iron;

chinese: 要在他們身上施行所記錄的審判。他的聖民都有這榮耀。你們要讚美耶和華！
english: To give them the punishment which is in the holy writings: this honour is given to all his saints. Praise be to the Lord.

chinese: 你們要讚美耶和華！在神的聖所讚美他！在他顯能力的穹蒼讚美他！
english: Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to God in his holy place: give him praise in the heaven of his power.

chinese: 要因他大能的作為讚美他，按著他極美的大德讚美他！
english: Give him praise for his acts of power: give him praise in the measure of his great strength.

chinese: 要用角聲讚美他，鼓瑟彈琴讚美他！
english: Give him praise with the sound of the horn: give him praise with corded instruments of music.

chinese: 擊鼓跳舞讚美他！用絲弦的樂器和簫的聲音讚美他！
english: Give him praise with instruments of brass and in the dance: give him praise with horns and corded instruments.

chinese: 用大響的鈸讚美他！用高聲的鈸讚美他！
english: Give him praise with the loud brass: give him praise with the high-sounding brass.

chinese: 凡有氣息的都要讚美耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華！
english: Let everything which has breath give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised.

chinese: 以色列王大衛兒子所羅門的箴言：
english: The wise sayings of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel.

chinese: 要使人曉得智慧和訓誨，分辨通達的言語，
english: To have knowledge of wise teaching; to be clear about the words of reason:

chinese: 使人處事領受智慧、仁義、公平、正直的訓誨，
english: To be trained in the ways of wisdom, in righteousness and judging truly and straight behaviour:

chinese: 使愚人靈明，使少年人有知識和謀略，
english: To make the simple-minded sharp, and to give the young man knowledge, and serious purpose:

chinese: 使智慧人聽見，增長學問，使聰明人得著智謀
english: (The wise man, hearing, will get greater learning, and the acts of the man of good sense will be wisely guided:)

chinese: 使人明白箴言和譬喻，懂得智慧人的言詞和謎語。
english: To get the sense of wise sayings and secrets, and of the words of the wise and their dark sayings.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華是知識的開端；愚妄人藐視智慧和訓誨。
english: The fear of the Lord is the start of knowledge: but the foolish have no use for wisdom and teaching.

chinese: 我兒，要聽你父親的訓誨，不可離棄你母親的法則（或譯：指教）；
english: My son, give ear to the training of your father, and do not give up the teaching of your mother:

chinese: 因為這要作你頭上的華冠，你項上的金鍊。
english: For they will be a crown of grace for your head, and chain-ornaments about your neck.

chinese: 我兒，惡人若引誘你，你不可隨從。
english: My son, if sinners would take you out of the right way, do not go with them.

chinese: 他們若說：你與我們同去，我們要埋伏流人之血，要蹲伏害無罪之人；
english: If they say, Come with us; let us make designs against the good, waiting secretly for the upright, without cause;

chinese: 我們好像陰間，把他們活活吞下；他們如同下坑的人，被我們囫圇吞了；
english: Let us overcome them living, like the underworld, and in their strength, as those who go down to death;

chinese: 我們必得各樣寶物，將所擄來的，裝滿房屋；
english: Goods of great price will be ours, our houses will be full of wealth;

chinese: 你與我們大家同分，我們共用一個囊袋；
english: Take your chance with us, and we will all have one money-bag:

chinese: 我兒，不要與他們同行一道，禁止你腳走他們的路。
english: My son, do not go with them; keep your feet from their ways:

chinese: 因為，他們的腳奔跑行惡；他們急速流人的血，
english: For their feet are running after evil, and they are quick to take a man's life.

chinese: 好像飛鳥，網羅設在眼前仍不躲避。
english: Truly, to no purpose is the net stretched out before the eyes of the bird:

chinese: 這些人埋伏，是為自流己血；蹲伏，是為自害己命。
english: And they are secretly waiting for their blood and making ready destruction for themselves.

chinese: 凡貪戀財利的，所行之路都是如此；這貪戀之心乃奪去得財者之命。
english: Such is the fate of everyone who goes in search of profit; it takes away the life of its owners.

chinese: 智慧在街市上呼喊，在寬闊處發聲，
english: Wisdom is crying out in the street; her voice is loud in the open places;

chinese: 在熱鬧街頭喊叫，在城門口，在城中發出言語，
english: Her words are sounding in the meeting-places, and in the doorways of the town:

chinese: 說：你們愚昧人喜愛愚昧，褻慢人喜歡褻慢，愚頑人恨惡知識，要到幾時呢？
english: How long, you simple ones, will foolish things be dear to you? and pride a delight to the haters of authority? how long will the foolish go on hating knowledge?

chinese: 你們當因我的責備回轉；我要將我的靈澆灌你們，將我的話指示你們。
english: Be turned again by my sharp words: see, I will send the flow of my spirit on you, and make my words clear to you.

chinese: 我呼喚，你們不肯聽從；我伸手，無人理會；
english: Because your ears were shut to my voice; no one gave attention to my out-stretched hand;

chinese: 反輕棄我一切的勸戒，不肯受我的責備。
english: You were not controlled by my guiding, and would have nothing to do with my sharp words:

chinese: 你們遭災難，我就發笑；驚恐臨到你們，我必嗤笑。
english: So in the day of your trouble I will be laughing; I will make sport of your fear;

chinese: 驚恐臨到你們，好像狂風；災難來到，如同暴風；急難痛苦臨到你們身上。
english: When your fear comes on you like a storm, and your trouble like a rushing wind; when pain and sorrow come on you.

chinese: 那時，你們必呼求我，我卻不答應，懇切地尋找我，卻尋不見。
english: Then I will give no answer to their cries; searching for me early, they will not see me:

chinese: 因為，你們恨惡知識，不喜愛敬畏耶和華，
english: For they were haters of knowledge, and did not give their hearts to the fear of the Lord:

chinese: 不聽我的勸戒，藐視我一切的責備，
english: They had no desire for my teaching, and my words of protest were as nothing to them.

chinese: 所以必吃自結的果子，充滿自設的計謀.。
english: So the fruit of their way will be their food, and with the designs of their hearts they will be made full.

chinese: 愚昧人背道，必殺己身；愚頑人安逸，必害己命。
english: For the turning back of the simple from teaching will be the cause of their death, and the peace of the foolish will be their destruction.

chinese: 惟有聽從我的，必安然居住，得享安靜，不怕災禍。
english: But whoever gives ear to me will take his rest safely, living in peace without fear of evil.

chinese: 我兒，你若領受我的言語，存記我的命令，
english: My son, if you will take my words to your heart, storing up my laws in your mind;

chinese: 側耳聽智慧，專心求聰明，
english: So that your ear gives attention to wisdom, and your heart is turned to knowledge;

chinese: 呼求明哲，揚聲求聰明，
english: Truly, if you are crying out for good sense, and your request is for knowledge;

chinese: 尋找他，如尋找銀子，搜求他，如搜求隱藏的珍寶，
english: If you are looking for her as for silver, and searching for her as for stored-up wealth;

chinese: 你就明白敬畏耶和華，得以認識神。
english: Then the fear of the Lord will be clear to you, and knowledge of God will be yours.

chinese: 因為，耶和華賜人智慧；知識和聰明都由他口而出。
english: For the Lord gives wisdom; out of his mouth come knowledge and reason:

chinese: 他給正直人存留真智慧，給行為純正的人作盾牌，
english: He has salvation stored up for the upright, he is a breastplate to those in whom there is no evil;

chinese: 為要保守公平人的路，護庇虔敬人的道。
english: He keeps watch on the ways which are right, and takes care of those who have the fear of him.

chinese: 你也必明白仁義、公平、正直、一切的善道。
english: Then you will have knowledge of righteousness and right acting, and upright behaviour, even of every good way.

chinese: 智慧必入你心；你的靈要以知識為美。
english: For wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasing to your soul;

chinese: 謀略必護衛你；聰明必保守你，
english: Wise purposes will be watching over you, and knowledge will keep you;

chinese: 要救你脫離惡道（或譯：惡人的道），脫離說乖謬話的人。
english: Giving you salvation from the evil man, from those whose words are false;

chinese: 那等人捨棄正直的路，行走黑暗的道，
english: Who give up the way of righteousness, to go by dark roads;

chinese: 歡喜作惡，喜愛惡人的乖僻，
english: Who take pleasure in wrongdoing, and have joy in the evil designs of the sinner;

chinese: 在他們的道中彎曲，在他們的路上偏僻。
english: Whose ways are not straight, and whose footsteps are turned to evil:

chinese: 智慧要救你脫離淫婦，就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。
english: To take you out of the power of the strange woman, who says smooth words with her tongue;

chinese: 他離棄幼年的配偶，忘了神的盟約。
english: Who is false to the husband of her early years, and does not keep the agreement of her God in mind:

chinese: 他的家陷入死地；他的路偏向陰間。
english: For her house is on the way down to death; her footsteps go down to the shades:

chinese: 凡到他那裡去的，不得轉回，也得不著生命的路。
english: Those who go to her do not come back again; their feet do not keep in the ways of life:

chinese: 智慧必使你行善人的道，守義人的路。
english: So that you may go in the way of good men, and keep in the footsteps of the upright.

chinese: 正直人必在世上居住；完全人必在地上存留。
english: For the upright will be living in the land, and the good will have it for their heritage.

chinese: 惟有惡人必然剪除；奸詐的，必然拔出。
english: But sinners will be cut off from the land, and those whose acts are false will be uprooted.

chinese: 我兒，不要忘記我的法則（或譯：指教）；你心要謹守我的誡命；
english: My son, keep my teaching in your memory, and my rules in your heart:

chinese: 因為他必將長久的日子，生命的年數與平安，加給你。
english: For they will give you increase of days, years of life, and peace.

chinese: 不可使慈愛、誠實離開你，要繫在你頸項上，刻在你心版上。
english: Let not mercy and good faith go from you; let them be hanging round your neck, recorded on your heart;

chinese: 這樣，你必在神和世人眼前蒙恩寵，有聰明。
english: So you will have grace and a good name in the eyes of God and men.

chinese: 你要專心仰賴耶和華，不可倚靠自己的聰明，
english: Put all your hope in God, not looking to your reason for support.

chinese: 在你一切所行的事上都要認定他，他必指引你的路。
english: In all your ways give ear to him, and he will make straight your footsteps.

chinese: 不要自以為有智慧；要敬畏耶和華，遠離惡事。
english: Put no high value on your wisdom: let the fear of the Lord be before you, and keep yourself from evil:

chinese: 這便醫治你的肚臍，滋潤你的百骨。
english: This will give strength to your flesh, and new life to your bones.

chinese: 你要以財物和一切初熟的土產尊榮耶和華。
english: Give honour to the Lord with your wealth, and with the first-fruits of all your increase:

chinese: 這樣，你的倉房必充滿有餘；你的酒醡有新酒盈溢。
english: So your store-houses will be full of grain, and your vessels overflowing with new wine.

chinese: 我兒，你不可輕看耶和華的管教（或譯：懲治），也不可厭煩他的責備；
english: My son, do not make your heart hard against the Lord's teaching; do not be made angry by his training:

chinese: 因為耶和華所愛的，他必責備，正如父親責備所喜愛的兒子。
english: For to those who are dear to him the Lord says sharp words, and makes the son in whom he has delight undergo pain.

chinese: 得智慧，得聰明的，這人便為有福。
english: Happy is the man who makes discovery of wisdom, and he who gets knowledge.

chinese: 因為得智慧勝過得銀子，其利益強如精金，
english: For trading in it is better than trading in silver, and its profit greater than bright gold.

chinese: 比珍珠（或譯：紅寶石）寶貴；你一切所喜愛的，都不足與比較。
english: She is of more value than jewels, and nothing for which you may have a desire is fair in comparison with her.

chinese: 他右手有長壽，左手有富貴。
english: Long life is in her right hand, and in her left are wealth and honour.

chinese: 他的道是安樂；他的路全是平安。
english: Her ways are ways of delight, and all her goings are peace.

chinese: 他與持守他的作生命樹；持定他的，俱各有福。
english: She is a tree of life to all who take her in their hands, and happy is everyone who keeps her.

chinese: 耶和華以智慧立地，以聰明定天，
english: The Lord by wisdom put in position the bases of the earth; by reason he put the heavens in their place.

chinese: 以知識使深淵裂開，使天空滴下甘露。
english: By his knowledge the deep was parted, and dew came dropping from the skies.

chinese: 我兒，要謹守真智慧和謀略，不可使他離開你的眼目。
english: My son, keep good sense, and do not let wise purpose go from your eyes.

chinese: 這樣，他必作你的生命，頸項的美飾。
english: So they will be life for your soul, and grace for your neck.

chinese: 你就坦然行路，不致碰腳。
english: Then you will go safely on your way, and your feet will have no cause for slipping.

chinese: 你躺下，必不懼怕；你躺臥，睡得香甜。
english: When you take your rest you will have no fear, and on your bed sleep will be sweet to you.

chinese: 忽然來的驚恐，不要害怕；惡人遭毀滅，也不要恐懼。
english: Have no fear of sudden danger, or of the storm which will come on evil-doers:

chinese: 因為耶和華是你所倚靠的；他必保守你的腳不陷入網羅。
english: For the Lord will be your hope, and will keep your foot from being taken in the net.

chinese: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辭，就當向那應得的人施行。
english: Do not keep back good from those who have a right to it, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

chinese: 你那裡若有現成的，不可對鄰舍說：去罷，明天再來，我必給你。
english: Say not to your neighbour, Go, and come again, and tomorrow I will give; when you have it by you at the time.

chinese: 你的鄰舍既在你附近安居，你不可設計害他。
english: Do not make evil designs against your neighbour, when he is living with you without fear.

chinese: 人未曾加害與你，不可無故與他相爭。
english: Do not take up a cause at law against a man for nothing, if he has done you no wrong.

chinese: 不可嫉妒強暴的人，也不可選擇他所行的路。
english: Have no envy of the violent man, or take any of his ways as an example.

chinese: 因為，乖僻人為耶和華所憎惡；正直人為他所親密。
english: For the wrong-hearted man is hated by the Lord, but he is a friend to the upright.

chinese: 耶和華咒詛惡人的家庭，賜福與義人的居所。
english: The curse of the Lord is on the house of the evil-doer, but his blessing is on the tent of the upright.

chinese: 他譏誚那好譏誚的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
english: He makes sport of the men of pride, but he gives grace to the gentle-hearted.

chinese: 智慧人必承受尊榮；愚昧人高升也成為羞辱。
english: The wise will have glory for their heritage, but shame will be the reward of the foolish.

chinese: 眾子啊，要聽父親的教訓，留心得知聰明。
english: Give ear, my sons, to the teaching of a father; give attention so that you may have knowledge:

chinese: 因我所給你們的是好教訓；不可離棄我的法則（或譯：指教）。
english: For I give you good teaching; do not give up the knowledge you are getting from me.

chinese: 我在父親面前為孝子，在母親眼中為獨一的嬌兒。
english: For I was a son to my father, a gentle and an only one to my mother.

chinese: 父親教訓我說：你心要存記我的言語，遵守我的命令，便得存活。
english: And he gave me teaching, saying to me, Keep my words in your heart; keep my rules so that you may have life:

chinese: 要得智慧，要得聰明，不可忘記，也不可偏離我口中的言語。
english: Get wisdom, get true knowledge; keep it in memory, do not be turned away from the words of my mouth.

chinese: 不可離棄智慧，智慧就護衛你；要愛他，他就保守你。
english: Do not give her up, and she will keep you; give her your love, and she will make you safe.

chinese: 智慧為首；所以，要得智慧。在你一切所得之內必得聰明.（或譯：用你一切所得的去換聰明）。
english: The first sign of wisdom is to get wisdom; go, give all you have to get true knowledge.

chinese: 高舉智慧，他就使你高升；懷抱智慧，他就使你尊榮。
english: Put her in a high place, and you will be lifted up by her; she will give you honour, when you give her your love.

chinese: 他必將華冠加在你頭上，把榮冕交給你。
english: She will put a crown of grace on your head, giving you a head-dress of glory.

chinese: 我兒，你要聽受我的言語，就必延年益壽。
english: Give ear, O my son, and let your heart be open to my sayings; and long life will be yours.

chinese: 我已指教你走智慧的道，引導你行正直的路。
english: I have given you teaching in the way of wisdom, guiding your steps in the straight way.

chinese: 你行走，腳步必不致狹窄；你奔跑，也不致跌倒。
english: When you go, your way will not be narrow, and in running you will not have a fall.

chinese: 要持定訓誨，不可放鬆；必當謹守，因為他是你的生命。
english: Take learning in your hands, do not let her go: keep her, for she is your life.

chinese: 不可行惡人的路；不要走壞人的道。
english: Do not go in the road of sinners, or be walking in the way of evil men.

chinese: 要躲避，不可經過；要轉身而去。
english: Keep far from it, do not go near; be turned from it, and go on your way.

chinese: 這等人若不行惡，不得睡覺；不使人跌倒，睡臥不安；
english: For they take no rest till they have done evil; their sleep is taken away if they have not been the cause of someone's fall.

chinese: 因為他們以奸惡吃餅，以強暴喝酒。
english: The bread of evil-doing is their food, the wine of violent acts their drink.

chinese: 但義人的路好像黎明的光，越照越明，直到日午。
english: But the way of the upright is like the light of early morning, getting brighter and brighter till the full day.

chinese: 惡人的道好像幽暗，自己不知因甚麼跌倒。
english: The way of sinners is dark; they see not the cause of their fall.

chinese: 我兒，要留心聽我的言詞，側耳聽我的話語，
english: My son, give attention to my words; let your ear be turned to my sayings.

chinese: 都不可離你的眼目，要存記在你心中。
english: Let them not go from your eyes; keep them deep in your heart.

chinese: 因為得著他的，就得了生命，又得了醫全體的良藥。
english: For they are life to him who gets them, and strength to all his flesh.

chinese: 你要保守你心，勝過保守一切（或譯：你要切切保守你心），因為一生的果效是由心發出。
english: And keep watch over your heart with all care; so you will have life.

chinese: 你要除掉邪僻的口，棄絕乖謬的嘴。
english: Put away from you an evil tongue, and let false lips be far from you.

chinese: 你的眼目要向前正看；你的眼睛（原文是皮）當向前直觀。
english: Keep your eyes on what is in front of you, looking straight before you.

chinese: 要修平你腳下的路，堅定你一切的道。
english: Keep a watch on your behaviour; let all your ways be rightly ordered.

chinese: 不可偏向左右；要使你的腳離開邪惡。
english: Let there be no turning to the right or to the left, keep your feet from evil.

chinese: 我兒，要留心我智慧的話語，側耳聽我聰明的言詞，
english: My son, give attention to my wisdom; let your ear be turned to my teaching:

chinese: 為要使你謹守謀略，嘴唇保存知識。
english: So that you may be ruled by a wise purpose, and your lips may keep knowledge.

chinese: 因為淫婦的嘴滴下蜂蜜；他的口比油更滑，
english: For honey is dropping from the lips of the strange woman, and her mouth is smoother than oil;

chinese: 至終卻苦似茵蔯，快如兩刃的刀。
english: But her end is bitter as wormwood, and sharp as a two-edged sword;

chinese: 他的腳下入死地；他腳步踏住陰間，
english: Her feet go down to death, and her steps to the underworld;

chinese: 以致他找不著生命平坦的道。他的路變遷不定，自己還不知道。
english: She never keeps her mind on the road of life; her ways are uncertain, she has no knowledge.

chinese: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我；不可離棄我口中的話。
english: Give ear to me then, my sons, and do not put away my words from you.

chinese: 你所行的道要離他遠，不可就近他的房門，
english: Go far away from her, do not come near the door of her house;

chinese: 恐怕將你的尊榮給別人，將你的歲月給殘忍的人；
english: For fear that you may give your honour to others, and your wealth to strange men:

chinese: 恐怕外人滿得你的力量，你勞碌得來的，歸入外人的家；
english: And strange men may be full of your wealth, and the fruit of your work go to the house of others;

chinese: 終久，你皮肉和身體消毀，你就悲歎，
english: And you will be full of grief at the end of your life, when your flesh and your body are wasted;

chinese: 說：我怎麼恨惡訓誨，心中藐視責備，
english: And you will say, How was teaching hated by me, and my heart put no value on training;

chinese: 也不聽從我師傅的話，又不側耳聽那教訓我的人？
english: I did not give attention to the voice of my teachers, my ear was not turned to those who were guiding me!

chinese: 我在聖會裡，幾乎落在諸般惡中。
english: I was in almost all evil in the company of the people.

chinese: 你要喝自己池中的水，飲自己井裡的活水。
english: Let water from your store and not that of others be your drink, and running water from your fountain.

chinese: 你的泉源豈可漲溢在外？你的河水豈可流在街上？
english: Let not your springs be flowing in the streets, or your streams of water in the open places.

chinese: 惟獨歸你一人，不可與外人同用。
english: Let them be for yourself only, not for other men with you.

chinese: 要使你的泉源蒙福；要喜悅你幼年所娶的妻。
english: Let blessing be on your fountain; have joy in the wife of your early years.

chinese: 他如可愛的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿；願他的胸懷使你時時知足，他的愛情使你常常戀慕。
english: As a loving hind and a gentle doe, let her breasts ever give you rapture; let your passion at all times be moved by her love.

chinese: 我兒，你為何戀慕淫婦？為何抱外女的胸懷？
english: Why let yourself, my son, go out of the way with a strange woman, and take another woman in your arms?

chinese: 因為，人所行的道都在耶和華眼前；他也修平人一切的路。
english: For a man's ways are before the eyes of the Lord, and he puts all his goings in the scales.

chinese: 惡人必被自己的罪孽捉住；他必被自己的罪惡如繩索纏繞。
english: The evil-doer will be taken in the net of his crimes, and prisoned in the cords of his sin.

chinese: 他因不受訓誨就必死亡；又因愚昧過甚，必走差了路。
english: He will come to his end for need of teaching; he is so foolish that he will go wandering from the right way.

chinese: 我兒，你若為朋友作保，替外人擊掌，
english: My son, if you have made yourself responsible for your neighbour, or given your word for another,

chinese: 你就被口中的話語纏住，被嘴裡的言語捉住。
english: You are taken as in a net by the words of your mouth, the sayings of your lips have overcome you.

chinese: 我兒，你既落在朋友手中，就當這樣行才可救自己：你要自卑，去懇求你的朋友。
english: Do this, my son, and make yourself free, because you have come into the power of your neighbour; go without waiting, and make a strong request to your neighbour.

chinese: 不要容你的眼睛睡覺；不要容你的眼皮打盹。
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, or rest to them;

chinese: 要救自己，如鹿脫離獵戶的手，如鳥脫離捕鳥人的手。
english: Make yourself free, like the roe from the hand of the archer, and the bird from him who puts a net for her.

chinese: 懶惰人哪，你去察看螞蟻的動作就可得智慧。
english: Go to the ant, you hater of work; give thought to her ways and be wise:

chinese: 螞蟻沒有元帥，沒有官長，沒有君王，
english: Having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

chinese: 尚且在夏天預備食物，在收割時聚斂糧食。
english: She gets her meat in the summer, storing up food at the time of the grain-cutting.

chinese: 懶惰人哪，你要睡到幾時呢？你何時睡醒呢？
english: How long will you be sleeping, O hater of work? when will you get up from your sleep?

chinese: 再睡片時，打盹片時，抱著手躺臥片時，
english: A little sleep, a little rest, a little folding of the hands in sleep:

chinese: 你的貧窮就必如強盜速來，你的缺乏彷彿拿兵器的人來到。
english: Then loss will come on you like an outlaw, and your need like an armed man

chinese: 無賴的惡徒，行動就用乖僻的口，
english: A good-for-nothing man is an evil-doer; he goes on his way causing trouble with false words;

chinese: 用眼傳神，用腳示意，用指點劃，
english: Making signs with his eyes, rubbing with his feet, and giving news with his fingers;

chinese: 心中乖僻，常設惡謀，布散紛爭。
english: His mind is ever designing evil: he lets loose violent acts.

chinese: 所以，災難必忽然臨到他身；他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。
english: For this cause his downfall will be sudden; quickly he will be broken, and there will be no help for him.

chinese: 耶和華所恨惡的有六樣，連他心所憎惡的共有七樣：
english: Six things are hated by the Lord; seven things are disgusting to him:

chinese: 就是高傲的眼，撒謊的舌，流無辜人血的手，
english: Eyes of pride, a false tongue, hands which take life without cause;

chinese: 圖謀惡計的心，飛跑行惡的腳，
english: A heart full of evil designs, feet which are quick in running after sin;

chinese: 吐謊言的假見證，並弟兄中布散紛爭的人。
english: A false witness, breathing out untrue words, and one who lets loose violent acts among brothers.

chinese: 我兒，要謹守你父親的誡命；不可離棄你母親的法則（或譯：指教），
english: My son, keep the rule of your father, and have in memory the teaching of your mother:

chinese: 要常繫在你心上，掛在你項上。
english: Keep them ever folded in your heart, and have them hanging round your neck.

chinese: 你行走，他必引導你；你躺臥，他必保守你；你睡醒，他必與你談論。
english: In your walking, it will be your guide; when you are sleeping, it will keep watch over you; when you are awake, it will have talk with you.

chinese: 因為誡命是燈，法則（或譯：指教）是光，訓誨的責備是生命的道，
english: For the rule is a light, and the teaching a shining light; and the guiding words of training are the way of life.

chinese: 能保你遠離惡婦，遠離外女諂媚的舌頭。
english: They will keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the strange woman.

chinese: 你心中不要戀慕他的美色，也不要被他眼皮勾引。
english: Let not your heart's desire go after her fair body; let not her eyes take you prisoner.

chinese: 因為，妓女能使人只剩一塊餅；淫婦獵取人寶貴的生命。
english: For a loose woman is looking for a cake of bread, but another man's wife goes after one's very life.

chinese: 人若懷裡搋火，衣服豈能不燒呢？
english: May a man take fire to his breast without burning his clothing?

chinese: 人若在火炭上走，腳豈能不燙呢？
english: Or may one go on lighted coals, and his feet not be burned?

chinese: 親近鄰舍之妻的，也是如此；凡挨近他的，不免受罰。
english: So it is with him who goes in to his neighbour's wife; he who has anything to do with her will not go free from punishment.

chinese: 賊因飢餓偷竊充飢，人不藐視他，
english: Men do not have a low opinion of a thief who takes food when he is in need of it:

chinese: 若被找著，他必賠還七倍，必將家中所有的盡都償還。
english: But if he is taken in the act he will have to give back seven times as much, giving up all his property which is in his house.

chinese: 與婦人行淫的，便是無知；行這事的，必喪掉生命。
english: He who takes another man's wife is without all sense: he who does it is the cause of destruction to his soul.

chinese: 他必受傷損，必被凌辱；他的羞恥不得塗抹。
english: Wounds will be his and loss of honour, and his shame may not be washed away.

chinese: 因為人的嫉恨成了烈怒，報仇的時候決不留情。
english: For bitter is the wrath of an angry husband; in the day of punishment he will have no mercy.

chinese: 甚麼贖價，他都不顧；你雖送許多禮物，他也不肯干休。
english: He will not take any payment; and he will not make peace with you though your money offerings are increased.

chinese: 我兒，你要遵守我的言語，將我的命令存記在心。
english: My son, keep my sayings, and let my rules be stored up with you.

chinese: 遵守我的命令就得存活；保守我的法則（或譯：指教），好像保守眼中的瞳人，
english: Keep my rules and you will have life; let my teaching be to you as the light of your eyes;

chinese: 繫在你指頭上，刻在你心版上。
english: Let them be fixed to your fingers, and recorded in your heart.

chinese: 對智慧說：你是我的姊妹，稱呼聰明為你的親人，
english: Say to wisdom, You are my sister; let knowledge be named your special friend:

chinese: 他就保你遠離淫婦，遠離說諂媚話的外女。
english: So that they may keep you from the strange woman, even from her whose words are smooth.

chinese: 我曾在我房屋的窗戶內，從我窗櫺之間往外觀看：
english: Looking out from my house, and watching through the window,

chinese: 見愚蒙人內，少年人中，分明有一個無知的少年人，
english: I saw among the young men one without sense,

chinese: 從街上經過，走近淫婦的巷口，直往通他家的路去，
english: Walking in the street near the turn of her road, going on the way to her house,

chinese: 在黃昏，或晚上，或半夜，或黑暗之中。
english: At nightfall, in the evening of the day, in the black dark of the night.

chinese: 看哪，有一個婦人來迎接他，是妓女的打扮，有詭詐的心思。
english: And the woman came out to him, in the dress of a loose woman, with a designing heart;

chinese: 這婦人喧嚷，不守約束，在家裡停不住腳，
english: She is full of noise and uncontrolled; her feet keep not in her house.

chinese: 有時在街市上，有時在寬闊處，或在各巷口蹲伏，
english: Now she is in the street, now in the open spaces, waiting at every turning of the road.

chinese: 拉住那少年人，與他親嘴，臉無羞恥對他說：
english: So she took him by his hand, kissing him, and without a sign of shame she said to him:

chinese: 平安祭在我這裡，今日才還了我所許的願。
english: I have a feast of peace-offerings, for today my oaths have been effected.

chinese: 因此，我出來迎接你，懇切求見你的面，恰巧遇見了你。
english: So I came out in the hope of meeting you, looking for you with care, and now I have you.

chinese: 我已經用繡花毯子和埃及線織的花紋布鋪了我的床。
english: My bed is covered with cushions of needlework, with coloured cloths of the cotton thread of Egypt;

chinese: 我又用沒藥、沉香、桂皮薰了我的榻。
english: I have made my bed sweet with perfumes and spices.

chinese: 你來，我們可以飽享愛情，直到早晨；我們可以彼此親愛歡樂。
english: Come, let us take our pleasure in love till the morning, having joy in love's delights.

chinese: 因為我丈夫不在家，出門行遠路；
english: For the master of the house is away on a long journey:

chinese: 他手拿銀囊，必到月望才回家。
english: He has taken a bag of money with him; he is coming back at the full moon.

chinese: 淫婦用許多巧言誘他隨從，用諂媚的嘴逼他同行。
english: With her fair words she overcame him, forcing him with her smooth lips.

chinese: 少年人立刻跟隨他，好像牛往宰殺之地，又像愚昧人帶鎖鍊去受刑罰，
english: The simple man goes after her, like an ox going to its death, like a roe pulled by a cord;

chinese: 直等箭穿他的肝，如同雀鳥急入網羅，卻不知是自喪己命。
english: Like a bird falling into a net; with no thought that his life is in danger, till an arrow goes into his side.

chinese: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我，留心聽我口中的話。
english: So now, my sons, give ear to me; give attention to the sayings of my mouth;

chinese: 你的心不可偏向淫婦的道，不要入他的迷途。
english: Let not your heart be turned to her ways, do not go wandering in her footsteps.

chinese: 因為，被他傷害仆倒的不少；被他殺戮的而且甚多。
english: For those wounded and made low by her are great in number; and all those who have come to their death through her are a great army.

chinese: 他的家是在陰間之路，下到死亡之宮。
english: Her house is the way to the underworld, going down to the rooms of death.

chinese: 智慧豈不呼叫？聰明豈不發聲？
english: Is not wisdom crying out, and the voice of knowledge sounding?

chinese: 他在道旁高處的頂上，在十字路口站立，
english: At the top of the highways, at the meeting of the roads, she takes her place;

chinese: 在城門旁，在城門口，在城門洞，大聲說：
english: Where the roads go into the town her cry goes out, at the doorways her voice is loud:

chinese: 眾人哪，我呼叫你們，我向世人發聲。
english: I am crying out to you, O men; my voice comes to the sons of men.

chinese: 說：愚蒙人哪，你們要會悟靈明；愚昧人哪，你們當心裡明白。
english: Become expert in reason, O you simple ones; you foolish ones, take training to heart.

chinese: 你們當聽，因我要說極美的話；我張嘴要論正直的事。
english: Give ear, for my words are true, and my lips are open to give out what is upright.

chinese: 我的口要發出真理；我的嘴憎惡邪惡。
english: For good faith goes out of my mouth, and false lips are disgusting to me.

chinese: 我口中的言語都是公義，並無彎曲乖僻。
english: All the words of my mouth are righteousness; there is nothing false or twisted in them.

chinese: 有聰明的，以為明顯，得知識的，以為正直。
english: They are all true to him whose mind is awake, and straightforward to those who get knowledge.

chinese: 你們當受我的教訓，不受白銀；寧得知識，勝過黃金。
english: Take my teaching, and not silver; get knowledge in place of the best gold.

chinese: 因為智慧比珍珠（或譯：紅寶石）更美；一切可喜愛的都不足與比較。
english: For wisdom is better than jewels, and all things which may be desired are nothing in comparison with her.

chinese: 我─智慧以靈明為居所，又尋得知識和謀略。
english: I, wisdom, have made wise behaviour my near relation; I am seen to be the special friend of wise purposes.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華在乎恨惡邪惡；那驕傲、狂妄，並惡道，以及乖謬的口，都為我所恨惡。
english: The fear of the Lord is seen in hating evil: pride, a high opinion of oneself, the evil way, and the false tongue, are unpleasing to me.

chinese: 我有謀略和真知識；我乃聰明，我有能力。
english: Wise design and good sense are mine; reason and strength are mine.

chinese: 帝王藉我坐國位；君王藉我定公平。
english: Through me kings have their power, and rulers give right decisions.

chinese: 王子和首領，世上一切的審判官，都是藉我掌權。
english: Through me chiefs have authority, and the noble ones are judging in righteousness.

chinese: 愛我的，我也愛他；懇切尋求我的，必尋得見。
english: Those who have given me their love are loved by me, and those who make search for me with care will get me.

chinese: 豐富尊榮在我；恆久的財並公義也在我。
english: Wealth and honour are in my hands, even wealth without equal and righteousness.

chinese: 我的果實勝過黃金，強如精金；我的出產超乎高銀。
english: My fruit is better than gold, even than the best gold; and my increase is more to be desired than silver.

chinese: 我在公義的道上走，在公平的路中行，
english: I go in the road of righteousness, in the way of right judging:

chinese: 使愛我的，承受貨財，並充滿他們的府庫。
english: So that I may give my lovers wealth for their heritage, making their store-houses full.

chinese: 在耶和華造化的起頭，在太初創造萬物之先，就有了我。
english: The Lord made me as the start of his way, the first of his works in the past.

chinese: 從亙古，從太初，未有世界以前，我已被立。
english: From eternal days I was given my place, from the birth of time, before the earth was.

chinese: 沒有深淵，沒有大水的泉源，我已生出。
english: When there was no deep I was given birth, when there were no fountains flowing with water.

chinese: 大山未曾奠定，小山未有之先，我已生出。
english: Before the mountains were put in their places, before the hills was my birth:

chinese: 耶和華還沒有創造大地和田野，並世上的土質，我已生出。
english: When he had not made the earth or the fields or the dust of the world.

chinese: 他立高天，我在那裡；他在淵面的周圍，劃出圓圈。
english: When he made ready the heavens I was there: when he put an arch over the face of the deep:

chinese: 上使穹蒼堅硬，下使淵源穩固，
english: When he made strong the skies overhead: when the fountains of the deep were fixed:

chinese: 為滄海定出界限，使水不越過他的命令，立定大地的根基。
english: When he put a limit to the sea, so that the waters might not go against his word: when he put in position the bases of the earth:

chinese: 那時，我在他那裡為工師，日日為他所喜愛，常常在他面前踴躍，
english: Then I was by his side, as a master workman: and I was his delight from day to day, playing before him at all times;

chinese: 踴躍在他為人預備可住之地，也喜悅住在世人之間。
english: Playing in his earth; and my delight was with the sons of men.

chinese: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我，因為謹守我道的，便為有福。
english: Give ear to me then, my sons: for happy are those who keep my ways.

chinese: 要聽教訓就得智慧，不可棄絕。
english: Take my teaching and be wise; do not let it go.

chinese: 聽從我、日日在我門口仰望、在我門框旁邊等候的，那人便為有福。
english: Happy is the man who gives ear to me, watching at my doors day by day, keeping his place by the pillars of my house.

chinese: 因為尋得我的，就尋得生命，也必蒙耶和華的恩惠。
english: For whoever gets me gets life, and grace from the Lord will come to him.

chinese: 得罪我的，卻害了自己的性命；恨惡我的，都喜愛死亡。
english: But he who does evil to me, does wrong to his soul: all my haters are in love with death.

chinese: 智慧建造房屋，鑿成七根柱子，
english: Wisdom has made her house, putting up her seven pillars.

chinese: 宰殺牲畜，調和旨酒，設擺筵席；
english: She has put her fat beasts to death; her wine is mixed, her table is ready.

chinese: 打發使女出去，自己在城中至高處呼叫，
english: She has sent out her women-servants; her voice goes out to the highest places of the town, saying,

chinese: 說：誰是愚蒙人，可以轉到這裡來！又對那無知的人說：
english: Whoever is simple, let him come in here; and to him who has no sense, she says:

chinese: 你們來，吃我的餅，喝我調和的酒。
english: Come, take of my bread, and of my wine which is mixed.

chinese: 你們愚蒙人，要捨棄愚蒙，就得存活，並要走光明的道。
english: Give up the simple ones and have life, and go in the way of knowledge.

chinese: 指斥褻慢人的，必受辱罵；責備惡人的，必被玷污。
english: He who gives teaching to a man of pride gets shame for himself; he who says sharp words to a sinner gets a bad name.

chinese: 不要責備褻慢人，恐怕他恨你；要責備智慧人，他必愛你。
english: Do not say sharp words to a man of pride, or he will have hate for you; make them clear to a wise man, and you will be dear to him.

chinese: 教導智慧人，他就越發有智慧；指示義人，他就增長學問。
english: Give teaching to a wise man, and he will become wiser; give training to an upright man, and his learning will be increased.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端；認識至聖者便是聰明。
english: The fear of the Lord is the start of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One gives a wise mind

chinese: 你藉著我，日子必增多，年歲也必加添。
english: For by me your days will be increased, and the years of your life will be long.

chinese: 你若有智慧，是與自己有益；你若褻慢，就必獨自擔當。
english: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; if your heart is full of pride, you only will have the pain of it.

chinese: 愚昧的婦人喧嚷；他是愚蒙，一無所知。
english: The foolish woman is full of noise; she has no sense at all.

chinese: 他坐在自己的家門口，坐在城中高處的座位上，
english: Seated at the door of her house, in the high places of the town,

chinese: 呼叫過路的，就是直行其道的人，
english: Crying out to those who go by, going straight on their way, she says:

chinese: 說：誰是愚蒙人，可以轉到這裡來！又對那無知的人說：
english: Whoever is simple, let him come in here: and to him who is without sense, she says:

chinese: 偷來的水是甜的，暗吃的餅是好的。
english: Drink taken without right is sweet, and food in secret is pleasing.

chinese: 人卻不知有陰魂在他那裡；他的客在陰間的深處。
english: But he does not see that the dead are there, that her guests are in the deep places of the underworld.

chinese: 所羅門的箴言：智慧之子使父親歡樂；愚昧之子叫母親擔憂。
english: A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish son is a sorrow to his mother.

chinese: 不義之財毫無益處；惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。
english: Wealth which comes from sin is of no profit, but righteousness gives salvation from death.

chinese: 耶和華不使義人受飢餓；惡人所欲的，他必推開。
english: The Lord will not let the upright be in need of food, but he puts far from him the desire of the evil-doers.

chinese: 手懶的，要受貧窮；手勤的，卻要富足。
english: He who is slow in his work becomes poor, but the hand of the ready worker gets in wealth.

chinese: 夏天聚斂的，是智慧之子；收割時沉睡的，是貽羞之子。
english: He who in summer gets together his store is a son who does wisely; but he who takes his rest when the grain is being cut is a son causing shame.

chinese: 福祉臨到義人的頭；強暴蒙蔽惡人的口。
english: Blessings are on the head of the upright, but the face of sinners will be covered with sorrow.

chinese: 義人的紀念被稱讚；惡人的名字必朽爛。
english: The memory of the upright is a blessing, but the name of the evil-doer will be turned to dust.

chinese: 心中智慧的，必受命令；口裡愚妄的，必致傾倒。
english: The wise-hearted man will let himself be ruled, but the man whose talk is foolish will have a fall.

chinese: 行正直路的，步步安穩；走彎曲道的，必致敗露。
english: He whose ways are upright will go safely, but he whose ways are twisted will be made low.

chinese: 以眼傳神的，使人憂患；口裡愚妄的，必致傾倒。
english: He who makes signs with his eyes is a cause of trouble, but he who makes a man see his errors is a cause of peace.

chinese: 義人的口是生命的泉源；強暴蒙蔽惡人的口。
english: The mouth of the upright man is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the evil-doer is a bitter cup.

chinese: 恨能挑啟爭端；愛能遮掩一切過錯。
english: Hate is a cause of violent acts, but all errors are covered up by love.

chinese: 明哲人嘴裡有智慧；無知人背上受刑杖。
english: In the lips of him who has knowledge wisdom is seen; but a rod is ready for the back of him who is without sense.

chinese: 智慧人積存知識；愚妄人的口速致敗壞。
english: Knowledge is stored up by the wise, but the mouth of the foolish man is a destruction which is near.

chinese: 富戶的財物是他的堅城；窮人的貧乏是他的敗壞。
english: The property of the man of wealth is his strong town: the poor man's need is his destruction.

chinese: 義人的勤勞致生；惡人的進項致死（死：原文是罪）。
english: The work of the upright gives life: the increase of the evil-doer is a cause of sin.

chinese: 謹守訓誨的，乃在生命的道上；違棄責備的，便失迷了路。
english: He who takes note of teaching is a way of life, but he who gives up training is a cause of error.

chinese: 隱藏怨恨的，有說謊的嘴；口出讒謗的，是愚妄的人。
english: Hate is covered up by the lips of the upright man, but he who lets out evil about another is foolish.

chinese: 多言多語難免有過；禁止嘴唇是有智慧。
english: Where there is much talk there will be no end to sin, but he who keeps his mouth shut does wisely.

chinese: 義人的舌乃似高銀；惡人的心所值無幾。
english: The tongue of the upright man is like tested silver: the heart of the evil-doer is of little value.

chinese: 義人的口教養多人；愚昧人因無知而死亡。
english: The lips of the upright man give food to men, but the foolish come to death for need of sense.

chinese: 耶和華所賜的福使人富足，並不加上憂慮。
english: The blessing of the Lord gives wealth: hard work makes it no greater.

chinese: 愚妄人以行惡為戲耍；明哲人卻以智慧為樂。
english: It is sport to the foolish man to do evil, but the man of good sense takes delight in wisdom.

chinese: 惡人所怕的，必臨到他；義人所願的，必蒙應允。
english: The thing feared by the evil-doer will come to him, but the upright man will get his desire.

chinese: 暴風一過，惡人歸於無有；義人的根基卻是永久。
english: When the storm-wind is past, the sinner is seen no longer, but the upright man is safe for ever.

chinese: 懶惰人叫差他的人如醋倒牙，如煙薰目。
english: Like acid drink to the teeth and as smoke to the eyes, so is the hater of work to those who send him.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華使人日子加多；但惡人的年歲必被減少。
english: The fear of the Lord gives long life, but the years of the evil-doer will be cut short.

chinese: 義人的盼望必得喜樂；惡人的指望必致滅沒。
english: The hope of the upright man will give joy, but the waiting of the evil-doer will have its end in sorrow.

chinese: 耶和華的道是正直人的保障，卻成了作孽人的敗壞。
english: The way of the Lord is a strong tower for the upright man, but destruction to the workers of evil.

chinese: 義人永不挪移；惡人不得住在地上。
english: The upright man will never be moved, but evil-doers will not have a safe resting-place in the land.

chinese: 義人的口滋生智慧；乖謬的舌必被割斷。
english: The mouth of the upright man is budding with wisdom, but the twisted tongue will be cut off.

chinese: 義人的嘴能令人喜悅；惡人的口說乖謬的話。
english: The lips of the upright man have knowledge of what is pleasing, but twisted are the mouths of evil-doers.

chinese: 詭詐的天平為耶和華所憎惡；公平的法碼為他所喜悅。
english: Scales of deceit are hated by the Lord, but a true weight is his delight.

chinese: 驕傲來，羞恥也來；謙遜人卻有智慧。
english: When pride comes, there comes shame, but wisdom is with the quiet in spirit.

chinese: 正直人的純正必引導自己；奸詐人的乖僻必毀滅自己。
english: The righteousness of the upright will be their guide, but the twisted ways of the false will be their destruction.

chinese: 發怒的日子資財無益；惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。
english: Wealth is of no profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness keeps a man safe from death.

chinese: 完全人的義必指引他的路；但惡人必因自己的惡跌倒。
english: The righteousness of the good man will make his way straight, but the sin of the evil-doer will be the cause of his fall.

chinese: 正直人的義必拯救自己；奸詐人必陷在自己的罪孽中。
english: The righteousness of the upright will be their salvation, but the false will themselves be taken in their evil designs.

chinese: 惡人一死，他的指望必滅絕；罪人的盼望也必滅沒。
english: At the death of an upright man his hope does not come to an end, but the hope of the evil-doer comes to destruction.

chinese: 義人得脫離患難，有惡人來代替他。
english: The upright man is taken out of trouble, and in his place comes the sinner.

chinese: 不虔敬的人用口敗壞鄰舍；義人卻因知識得救。
english: With his mouth the evil man sends destruction on his neighbour; but through knowledge the upright are taken out of trouble.

chinese: 義人享福，合城喜樂；惡人滅亡，人都歡呼。
english: When things go well for the upright man, all the town is glad; at the death of sinners, there are cries of joy.

chinese: 城因正直人祝福便高舉，卻因邪惡人的口就傾覆。
english: By the blessing of the upright man the town is made great, but it is overturned by the mouth of the evil-doer.

chinese: 藐視鄰舍的，毫無智慧；明哲人卻靜默不言。
english: He who has a poor opinion of his neighbour has no sense, but a wise man keeps quiet.

chinese: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事；心中誠實的，遮隱事情。
english: He who goes about talking of others makes secrets public, but the true-hearted man keeps things covered.

chinese: 無智謀，民就敗落；謀士多，人便安居。
english: When there is no helping suggestion the people will have a fall, but with a number of wise guides they will be safe.

chinese: 為外人作保的，必受虧損；恨惡擊掌的，卻得安穩。
english: He who makes himself responsible for a strange man will undergo much loss; but the hater of such undertakings will be safe.

chinese: 恩德的婦女得尊榮；強暴的男子得資財。
english: A woman who is full of grace is honoured, but a woman hating righteousness is a seat of shame: those hating work will undergo loss, but the strong keep their wealth.

chinese: 仁慈的人善待自己；殘忍的人擾害己身。
english: The man who has mercy will be rewarded, but the cruel man is the cause of trouble to himself.

chinese: 惡人經營，得虛浮的工價；撒義種的，得實在的果效。
english: The sinner gets the payment of deceit; but his reward is certain who puts in the seed of righteousness.

chinese: 恆心為義的，必得生命；追求邪惡的，必致死亡。
english: So righteousness gives life; but he who goes after evil gets death for himself.

chinese: 心中乖僻的，為耶和華所憎惡；行事完全的，為他所喜悅。
english: The uncontrolled are hated by the Lord, but those whose ways are without error are his delight

chinese: 惡人雖然連手，必不免受罰；義人的後裔必得拯救。
english: Certainly the evil-doer will not go free from punishment, but the seed of the upright man will be safe.

chinese: 婦女美貌而無見識，如同金環帶在豬鼻上。
english: Like a ring of gold in the nose of a pig, is a beautiful woman who has no sense.

chinese: 義人的心願盡得好處；惡人的指望致干忿怒。
english: The desire of the upright man is only for good, but wrath is waiting for the evil-doer.

chinese: 有施散的，卻更增添；有吝惜過度的，反致窮乏。
english: A man may give freely, and still his wealth will be increased; and another may keep back more than is right, but only comes to be in need.

chinese: 好施捨的，必得豐裕；滋潤人的，必得滋潤。
english: He who gives blessing will be made fat, but the curser will himself be cursed.

chinese: 屯糧不賣的，民必咒詛他；情願出賣的，人必為他祝福。
english: He who keeps back grain will be cursed by the people; but a blessing will be on the head of him who lets them have it for a price.

chinese: 懇切求善的，就求得恩惠；惟獨求惡的，惡必臨到他身。
english: He who, with all his heart, goes after what is good is searching for grace; but he who is looking for trouble will get it.

chinese: 倚仗自己財物的，必跌倒；義人必發旺，如青葉。
english: He who puts his faith in wealth will come to nothing; but the upright man will be full of growth like the green leaf.

chinese: 擾害己家的，必承受清風；愚昧人必作慧心人的僕人。
english: The troubler of his house will have the wind for his heritage, and the foolish will be servant to the wise-hearted.

chinese: 義人所結的果子就是生命樹；有智慧的，必能得人。
english: The fruit of righteousness is a tree of life, but violent behaviour takes away souls.

chinese: 看哪，義人在世尚且受報，何況惡人和罪人呢？
english: If the upright man is rewarded on earth, how much more the evil-doer and the sinner!

chinese: 喜愛管教的，就是喜愛知識；恨惡責備的，卻是畜類。
english: A lover of training is a lover of knowledge; but a hater of teaching is like a beast.

chinese: 善人必蒙耶和華的恩惠；設詭計的人，耶和華必定他的罪。
english: A good man has grace in the eyes of the Lord; but the man of evil designs gets punishment from him.

chinese: 人靠惡行不能堅立；義人的根必不動搖。
english: No man will make himself safe through evil-doing; but the root of upright men will never be moved.

chinese: 才德的婦人是丈夫的冠冕；貽羞的婦人如同朽爛在他丈夫的骨中。
english: A woman of virtue is a crown to her husband; but she whose behaviour is a cause of shame is like a wasting disease in his bones.

chinese: 義人的思念是公平；惡人的計謀是詭詐。
english: The purposes of upright men are right, but the designs of evil-doers are deceit.

chinese: 惡人的言論是埋伏流人的血；正直人的口必拯救人。
english: The words of sinners are destruction for the upright; but the mouth of upright men is their salvation.

chinese: 惡人傾覆，歸於無有；義人的家必站得住。
english: Evil-doers are overturned and never seen again, but the house of upright men will keep its place.

chinese: 人必按自己的智慧被稱讚；心中乖謬的，必被藐視。
english: A man will be praised in the measure of his wisdom, but a wrong-minded man will be looked down on.

chinese: 被人輕賤，卻有僕人，強如自尊，缺少食物。
english: He who is of low position and has a servant, is better than one who has a high opinion of himself and is in need of bread.

chinese: 義人顧惜他牲畜的命；惡人的憐憫也是殘忍。
english: An upright man has thought for the life of his beast, but the hearts of evil-doers are cruel.

chinese: 耕種自己田地的，必得飽食；追隨虛浮的，卻是無知。
english: He who does work on his land will not be short of bread; but he who goes after foolish men is without sense.

chinese: 惡人想得壞人的網羅；義人的根得以結實。
english: The resting-place of the sinner will come to destruction, but the root of upright men is for ever.

chinese: 惡人嘴中的過錯是自己的網羅；但義人必脫離患難。
english: In the sin of the lips is a net which takes the sinner, but the upright man will come out of trouble.

chinese: 人因口所結的果子，必飽得美福；人手所做的，必為自己的報應。
english: From the fruit of his mouth will a man have good food in full measure, and the work of a man's hands will be rewarded.

chinese: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看為正直；惟智慧人肯聽人的勸教。
english: The way of the foolish man seems right to him? but the wise man gives ear to suggestions.

chinese: 愚妄人的惱怒立時顯露；通達人能忍辱藏羞。
english: A foolish man lets his trouble be openly seen, but a sharp man keeps shame secret.

chinese: 說出真話的，顯明公義；作假見證的，顯出詭詐。
english: The breathing out of true words gives knowledge of righteousness; but a false witness gives out deceit.

chinese: 說話浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌頭卻為醫人的良藥。
english: There are some whose uncontrolled talk is like the wounds of a sword, but the tongue of the wise makes one well again.

chinese: 口吐真言，永遠堅立；舌說謊話，只存片時。
english: True lips are certain for ever, but a false tongue is only for a minute.

chinese: 圖謀惡事的，心存詭詐；勸人和睦的，便得喜樂。
english: Deceit is in the heart of those whose designs are evil, but for those purposing peace there is joy.

chinese: 義人不遭災害；惡人滿受禍患。
english: No trouble will come to upright men, but sinners will be full of evil.

chinese: 說謊言的嘴為耶和華所憎惡；行事誠實的，為他所喜悅。
english: False lips are hated by the Lord, but those whose acts are true are his delight.

chinese: 通達人隱藏知識；愚昧人的心彰顯愚昧。
english: A sharp man keeps back his knowledge; but the heart of foolish men makes clear their foolish thoughts.

chinese: 殷勤人的手必掌權；懶惰的人必服苦。
english: The hand of the ready worker will have authority, but he who is slow in his work will be put to forced work.

chinese: 人心憂慮，屈而不伸；一句良言，使心歡樂。
english: Care in the heart of a man makes it weighted down, but a good word makes it glad.

chinese: 義人引導他的鄰舍；惡人的道叫人失迷。
english: The upright man is a guide to his neighbour, but the way of evil-doers is a cause of error to them.

chinese: 懶惰的人不烤打獵所得的；殷勤的人卻得寶貴的財物。
english: He who is slow in his work does not go in search of food; but the ready worker gets much wealth.

chinese: 在公義的道上有生命；其路之中並無死亡。
english: In the road of righteousness is life, but the way of the evil-doer goes to death.

chinese: 智慧子聽父親的教訓；褻慢人不聽責備。
english: A wise son is a lover of teaching, but the ears of the haters of authority are shut to sharp words.

chinese: 人因口所結的果子，必享美福；奸詐人必遭強暴。
english: A man will get good from the fruit of his lips, but the desire of the false is for violent acts.

chinese: 謹守口的，得保生命；大張嘴的，必致敗亡。
english: He who keeps a watch on his mouth keeps his life; but he whose lips are open wide will have destruction.

chinese: 懶惰人羨慕，卻無所得；殷勤人必得豐裕。
english: The hater of work does not get his desires, but the soul of the hard workers will be made fat.

chinese: 義人恨惡謊言；惡人有臭名，且致慚愧。
english: The upright man is a hater of false words: the evil-doer gets a bad name and is put to shame.

chinese: 行為正直的，有公義保守；犯罪的，被邪惡傾覆。
english: Righteousness keeps safe him whose way is without error, but evil-doers are overturned by sin.

chinese: 假作富足的，卻一無所有；裝作窮乏的，卻廣有財物。
english: A man may be acting as if he had wealth, but have nothing; another may seem poor, but have great wealth.

chinese: 人的資財是他生命的贖價；窮乏人卻聽不見威嚇的話。
english: A man will give his wealth in exchange for his life; but the poor will not give ear to sharp words.

chinese: 義人的光明亮（原文是歡喜）；惡人的燈要熄滅.。
english: There is a glad dawn for the upright man, but the light of the sinner will be put out.

chinese: 驕傲只啟爭競；聽勸言的，卻有智慧。
english: The only effect of pride is fighting; but wisdom is with the quiet in spirit.

chinese: 不勞而得之財必然消耗；勤勞積蓄的，必見加增。
english: Wealth quickly got will become less; but he who gets a store by the work of his hands will have it increased.

chinese: 所盼望的遲延未得，令人心憂；所願意的臨到，卻是生命樹。
english: Hope put off is a weariness to the heart; but when what is desired comes, it is a tree of life.

chinese: 藐視訓言的，自取滅亡；敬畏誡命的，必得善報。
english: He who makes sport of the word will come to destruction, but the respecter of the law will be rewarded.

chinese: 智慧人的法則（或譯：指教）是生命的泉源，可以使人離開死亡的網羅。
english: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning men away from the nets of death.

chinese: 美好的聰明使人蒙恩；奸詐人的道路崎嶇難行。
english: Wise behaviour gets approval, but the way of the false is their destruction.

chinese: 凡通達人都憑知識行事；愚昧人張揚自己的愚昧。
english: A sharp man does everything with knowledge, but a foolish man makes clear his foolish thoughts.

chinese: 奸惡的使者必陷在禍患裡；忠信的使臣乃醫人的良藥。
english: A man taking false news is a cause of trouble, but he who gives news rightly makes things well.

chinese: 棄絕管教的，必致貧受辱；領受責備的，必得尊榮。
english: Need and shame will be the fate of him who is uncontrolled by training; but he who takes note of teaching will be honoured.

chinese: 所欲的成就，心覺甘甜；遠離惡事，為愚昧人所憎惡。
english: To get one's desire is sweet to the soul, but to give up evil is disgusting to the foolish.

chinese: 與智慧人同行的，必得智慧；和愚昧人作伴的，必受虧損。
english: Go with wise men and be wise: but he who keeps company with the foolish will be broken.

chinese: 禍患追趕罪人；義人必得善報。
english: Evil will overtake sinners, but the upright will be rewarded with good.

chinese: 善人給子孫遺留產業；罪人為義人積存資財。
english: The heritage of the good man is handed down to his children's children; and the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the upright man.

chinese: 窮人耕種多得糧食，但因不義，有消滅的。
english: There is much food in the ploughed land of the poor; but it is taken away by wrongdoing.

chinese: 不忍用杖打兒子的，是恨惡他；疼愛兒子的，隨時管教。
english: He who keeps back his rod is unkind to his son: the loving father gives punishment with care.

chinese: 義人吃得飽足；惡人肚腹缺糧。
english: The upright man has food to the full measure of his desire, but there will be no food for the stomach of evil-doers.

chinese: 智慧婦人建立家室；愚妄婦人親手拆毀。
english: Wisdom is building her house, but the foolish woman is pulling it down with her hands.

chinese: 行動正直的，敬畏耶和華；行事乖僻的，卻藐視他。
english: He who goes on his way in righteousness has before him the fear of the Lord; but he whose ways are twisted gives him no honour.

chinese: 愚妄人口中驕傲，如杖責打己身；智慧人的嘴必保守自己。
english: In the mouth of the foolish man is a rod for his back, but the lips of the wise will keep them safe.

chinese: 家裡無牛，槽頭乾淨；土產加多乃憑牛力。
english: Where there are no oxen, their food-place is clean; but much increase comes through the strength of the ox.

chinese: 誠實見證人不說謊話；假見證人吐出謊言。
english: A true witness does not say what is false, but a false witness is breathing out deceit.

chinese: 褻慢人尋智慧，卻尋不著；聰明人易得知識。
english: The hater of authority, searching for wisdom, does not get it; but knowledge comes readily to the open-minded man.

chinese: 到愚昧人面前，不見他嘴中有知識。
english: Go away from the foolish man, for you will not see the lips of knowledge.

chinese: 通達人的智慧在乎明白己道；愚昧人的愚妄乃是詭詐（或譯：自歎）。
english: The wisdom of the man of good sense makes his way clear; but the unwise behaviour of the foolish is deceit.

chinese: 愚妄人犯罪，以為戲耍（或譯：贖愆祭愚弄愚妄人）；正直人互相喜悅。
english: In the tents of those hating authority there is error, but in the house of the upright man there is grace.

chinese: 心中的苦楚，自己知道；心裡的喜樂，外人無干。
english: No one has knowledge of a man's grief but himself; and a strange person has no part in his joy.

chinese: 奸惡人的房屋必傾倒；正直人的帳棚必興盛。
english: The house of the sinner will be overturned, but the tent of the upright man will do well.

chinese: 有一條路，人以為正，至終成為死亡之路。
english: There is a way which seems straight before a man, but its end is the ways of death.

chinese: 人在喜笑中，心也憂愁；快樂至極就生愁苦。
english: Even while laughing the heart may be sad; and after joy comes sorrow.

chinese: 心中背道的，必滿得自己的結果；善人必從自己的行為得以知足。
english: He whose heart is turned away will have the reward of his ways in full measure; but a good man will have the reward of his doings.

chinese: 愚蒙人是話都信；通達人步步謹慎。
english: The simple man has faith in every word, but the man of good sense gives thought to his footsteps.

chinese: 智慧人懼怕，就遠離惡事；愚妄人卻狂傲自恃。
english: The wise man, fearing, keeps himself from evil; but the foolish man goes on in his pride, with no thought of danger.

chinese: 輕易發怒的，行事愚妄；設立詭計的，被人恨惡。
english: He who is quickly angry will do what is foolish, but the man of good sense will have quiet.

chinese: 愚蒙人得愚昧為產業；通達人得知識為冠冕。
english: Foolish behaviour is the heritage of the simple, but men of good sense are crowned with knowledge.

chinese: 壞人俯伏在善人面前；惡人俯伏在義人門口。
english: The knees of the evil are bent before the good; and sinners go down in the dust at the doors of the upright.

chinese: 貧窮人連鄰舍也恨他；富足人朋友最多。
english: The poor man is hated even by his neighbour, but the man of wealth has numbers of friends.

chinese: 藐視鄰舍的，這人有罪；憐憫貧窮的，這人有福。
english: He who has no respect for his neighbour is a sinner, but he who has pity for the poor is happy.

chinese: 謀惡的，豈非走入迷途麼？謀善的，必得慈愛和誠實。
english: Will not the designers of evil come into error? But mercy and good faith are for the designers of good.

chinese: 諸般勤勞都有益處；嘴上多言乃致窮乏。
english: In all hard work there is profit, but talk only makes a man poor.

chinese: 智慧人的財為自己的冠冕；愚妄人的愚昧終是愚昧。
english: Their wisdom is a crown to the wise, but their foolish behaviour is round the head of the unwise.

chinese: 作真見證的，救人性命；吐出謊言的，施行詭詐。
english: A true witness is the saviour of lives; but he who says false things is a cause of deceit.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華的，大有倚靠；他的兒女也有避難所。
english: For him in whose heart is the fear of the Lord there is strong hope: and his children will have a safe place.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華就是生命的泉源，可以使人離開死亡的網羅。
english: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, by which one may be turned from the nets of death.

chinese: 帝王榮耀在乎民多；君王衰敗在乎民少。
english: A king's glory is in the number of his people: and for need of people a ruler may come to destruction.

chinese: 不輕易發怒的，大有聰明；性情暴躁的，大顯愚妄。
english: He who is slow to be angry has great good sense; but he whose spirit is over-quick gives support to what is foolish.

chinese: 心中安靜是肉體的生命；嫉妒是骨中的朽爛。
english: A quiet mind is the life of the body, but envy is a disease in the bones.

chinese: 欺壓貧寒的，是辱沒造他的主；憐憫窮乏的，乃是尊敬主。
english: He who is hard on the poor puts shame on his Maker; but he who has mercy on those who are in need gives him honour.

chinese: 惡人在所行的惡上必被推倒；義人臨死，有所投靠。
english: The sinner is overturned in his evil-doing, but the upright man has hope in his righteousness.

chinese: 智慧存在聰明人心中；愚昧人心裡所存的，顯而易見。
english: Wisdom has her resting-place in the mind of the wise, but she is not seen among the foolish.

chinese: 公義使邦國高舉；罪惡是人民的羞辱。
english: By righteousness a nation is lifted up, but sin is a cause of shame to the peoples.

chinese: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠；貽羞的僕人遭其震怒。
english: The king has pleasure in a servant who does wisely, but his wrath is against him who is a cause of shame.

chinese: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言語暴戾，觸動怒氣。
english: By a soft answer wrath is turned away, but a bitter word is a cause of angry feelings.

chinese: 智慧人的舌善發知識；愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。
english: Knowledge is dropping from the tongue of the wise; but from the mouth of the foolish comes a stream of foolish words.

chinese: 耶和華的眼目無處不在；惡人善人，他都鑒察。
english: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

chinese: 溫良的舌是生命樹；乖謬的嘴使人心碎。
english: A comforting tongue is a tree of life, but a twisted tongue is a crushing of the spirit.

chinese: 愚妄人藐視父親的管教；領受責備的，得著見識。
english: A foolish man puts no value on his father's training; but he who has respect for teaching has good sense.

chinese: 義人家中多有財寶；惡人得利反受擾害。
english: In the house of the upright man there is a great store of wealth; but in the profits of the sinner there is trouble.

chinese: 智慧人的嘴播揚知識；愚昧人的心並不如此。
english: The lips of the wise keep knowledge, but the heart of the foolish man is not right.

chinese: 惡人獻祭，為耶和華所憎惡；正直人祈禱，為他所喜悅。
english: The offering of the evil-doer is disgusting to the Lord, but the prayer of the upright man is his delight.

chinese: 惡人的道路，為耶和華所憎惡；追求公義的，為他所喜愛。
english: The way of the evil-doer is disgusting to the Lord, but he who goes after righteousness is dear to him.

chinese: 捨棄正路的，必受嚴刑；恨惡責備的，必致死亡。
english: There is bitter punishment for him who is turned from the way; and death will be the fate of the hater of teaching.

chinese: 陰間和滅亡尚在耶和華眼前，何況世人的心呢？
english: Before the Lord are the underworld and destruction: how much more, then, the hearts of the children of men!

chinese: 褻慢人不愛受責備；他也不就近智慧人。
english: The hater of authority has no love for teaching: he will not go to the wise.

chinese: 心中喜樂，面帶笑容；心裡憂愁，靈被損傷。
english: A glad heart makes a shining face, but by the sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

chinese: 聰明人心求知識；愚昧人口吃愚昧。
english: The heart of the man of good sense goes in search of knowledge, but foolish things are the food of the unwise.

chinese: 困苦人的日子都是愁苦；心中歡暢的，常享豐筵。
english: All the days of the troubled are evil; but he whose heart is glad has an unending feast.

chinese: 少有財寶，敬畏耶和華，強如多有財寶，煩亂不安。
english: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord, than great wealth together with trouble.

chinese: 吃素菜，彼此相愛，強如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。
english: Better is a simple meal where love is, than a fat ox and hate with it.

chinese: 暴怒的人挑啟爭端；忍怒的人止息紛爭。
english: An angry man makes men come to blows, but he who is slow to get angry puts an end to fighting.

chinese: 懶惰人的道像荊棘的籬笆；正直人的路是平坦的大道。
english: Thorns are round the way of the hater of work; but the road of the hard worker becomes a highway.

chinese: 智慧子使父親喜樂；愚昧人藐視母親。
english: A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish man has no respect for his mother.

chinese: 無知的人以愚妄為樂；聰明的人按正直而行。
english: Foolish behaviour is joy to the unwise; but a man of good sense makes his way straight.

chinese: 不先商議，所謀無效；謀士眾多，所謀乃成。
english: Where there are no wise suggestions, purposes come to nothing; but by a number of wise guides they are made certain.

chinese: 口善應對，自覺喜樂；話合其時，何等美好。
english: A man has joy in the answer of his mouth: and a word at the right time, how good it is!

chinese: 智慧人從生命的道上升，使他遠離在下的陰間。
english: Acting wisely is the way of life, guiding a man away from the underworld.

chinese: 耶和華必拆毀驕傲人的家，卻要立定寡婦的地界。
english: The house of the man of pride will be uprooted by the Lord, but he will make safe the heritage of the widow.

chinese: 惡謀為耶和華所憎惡；良言乃為純淨。
english: Evil designs are disgusting to the Lord, but the words of the clean-hearted are pleasing.

chinese: 貪戀財利的，擾害己家；恨惡賄賂的，必得存活。
english: He whose desires are fixed on profit is a cause of trouble to his family; but he who has no desire for offerings will have life.

chinese: 義人的心，思量如何回答；惡人的口吐出惡言。
english: The heart of the upright gives thought to his answer; but from the mouth of the evil-doer comes a stream of evil things.

chinese: 耶和華遠離惡人，卻聽義人的禱告。
english: The Lord is far from sinners, but his ear is open to the prayer of the upright.

chinese: 眼有光，使心喜樂；好信息，使骨滋潤。
english: The light of the eyes is a joy to the heart, and good news makes the bones fat.

chinese: 聽從生命責備的，必常在智慧人中。
english: The man whose ear is open to the teaching of life will have his place among the wise.

chinese: 棄絕管教的，輕看自己的生命；聽從責備的，卻得智慧。
english: He who will not be controlled by training has no respect for his soul, but he who gives ear to teaching will get wisdom.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的訓誨；尊榮以前，必有謙卑。
english: The fear of the Lord is the teaching of wisdom; and a low opinion of oneself goes before honour.

chinese: 心中的謀算在乎人；舌頭的應對由於耶和華。
english: The designs of the heart are man's, but the answer of the tongue comes from the Lord.

chinese: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看為清潔；惟有耶和華衡量人心。
english: All a man's ways are clean to himself; but the Lord puts men's spirits into his scales.

chinese: 你所做的，要交託耶和華，你所謀的，就必成立。
english: Put your works into the hands of the Lord, and your purposes will be made certain.

chinese: 耶和華所造的，各適其用；就是惡人也為禍患的日子所造。
english: The Lord has made everything for his purpose, even the sinner for the day of evil.

chinese: 凡心裡驕傲的，為耶和華所憎惡；雖然連手，他必不免受罰。
english: Everyone who has pride in his heart is disgusting to the Lord: he will certainly not go free from punishment.

chinese: 因憐憫誠實，罪孽得贖；敬畏耶和華的，遠離惡事。
english: By mercy and good faith evil-doing is taken away: and by the fear of the Lord men are turned away from evil.

chinese: 人所行的，若蒙耶和華喜悅，耶和華也使他的仇敵與他和好。
english: When a man's ways are pleasing to the Lord, he makes even his haters be at peace with him.

chinese: 多有財利，行事不義，不如少有財利，行事公義。
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great wealth with wrongdoing.

chinese: 人心籌算自己的道路；惟耶和華指引他的腳步。
english: A man may make designs for his way, but the Lord is the guide of his steps.

chinese: 王的嘴中有神語，審判之時，他的口必不差錯。
english: Decision is in the lips of the king: his mouth will not go wrong in judging.

chinese: 公道的天平和秤都屬耶和華；囊中一切法碼都為他所定。
english: True measures and scales are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work.

chinese: 作惡，為王所憎惡，因國位是靠公義堅立。
english: Evil-doing is disgusting to kings: for the seat of the ruler is based on righteousness.

chinese: 公義的嘴為王所喜悅；說正直話的，為王所喜愛。
english: Lips of righteousness are the delight of kings; and he who says what is upright is dear to him.

chinese: 王的震怒如殺人的使者；但智慧人能止息王怒。
english: The wrath of the king is like those who give news of death, but a wise man will put peace in place of it.

chinese: 王的臉光使人有生命；王的恩典好像春雲時雨。
english: In the light of the king's face there is life; and his approval is like a cloud of spring rain.

chinese: 得智慧勝似得金子；選聰明強如選銀子。
english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! and to get knowledge is more to be desired than silver.

chinese: 正直人的道是遠離惡事；謹守己路的，是保全性命。
english: The highway of the upright is to be turned away from evil: he who takes care of his way will keep his soul.

chinese: 驕傲在敗壞以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
english: Pride goes before destruction, and a stiff spirit before a fall.

chinese: 心裡謙卑與窮乏人來往，強如將擄物與驕傲人同分。
english: Better it is to have a gentle spirit with the poor, than to take part in the rewards of war with men of pride.

chinese: 謹守訓言的，必得好處；倚靠耶和華的，便為有福。
english: He who gives attention to the law of right will get good; and whoever puts his faith in the Lord is happy.

chinese: 心中有智慧，必稱為通達人；嘴中的甜言，加增人的學問。
english: The wise-hearted will be named men of good sense: and by pleasing words learning is increased.

chinese: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源；愚昧人必被愚昧懲治。
english: Wisdom is a fountain of life to him who has it; but the punishment of the foolish is their foolish behaviour.

chinese: 智慧人的心教訓他的口，又使他的嘴增長學問。
english: The heart of the wise man is the teacher of his mouth, and gives increased learning to his lips.

chinese: 良言如同蜂房，使心覺甘甜，使骨得醫治。
english: Pleasing words are like honey, sweet to the soul and new life to the bones.

chinese: 有一條路，人以為正，至終成為死亡之路。
english: There is a way which seems straight before a man, but its end is the ways of death.

chinese: 勞力人的胃口使他勞力，因為他的口腹催逼他。
english: The desire of the working man is working for him, for his need of food is driving him on.

chinese: 匪徒圖謀奸惡，嘴上彷彿有燒焦的火。
english: A good-for-nothing man is a designer of evil, and in his lips there is a burning fire.

chinese: 乖僻人播散紛爭；傳舌的，離間密友。
english: A man of twisted purposes is a cause of fighting everywhere: and he who says evil secretly makes trouble between friends.

chinese: 強暴人誘惑鄰舍，領他走不善之道。
english: A violent man puts desire of evil into his neighbour's mind, and makes him go in a way which is not good.

chinese: 眼目緊合的，圖謀乖僻；嘴唇緊閉的，成就邪惡。
english: He whose eyes are shut is a man of twisted purposes, and he who keeps his lips shut tight makes evil come about.

chinese: 白髮是榮耀的冠冕，在公義的道上必能得著。
english: The grey head is a crown of glory, if it is seen in the way of righteousness.

chinese: 不輕易發怒的，勝過勇士；治服己心的，強如取城。
english: He who is slow to be angry is better than a man of war, and he who has control over his spirit than he who takes a town.

chinese: 籤放在懷裡，定事由耶和華。
english: A thing may be put to the decision of chance, but it comes about through the Lord.

chinese: 設筵滿屋，大家相爭，不如有塊乾餅，大家相安。
english: Better a bit of dry bread in peace, than a house full of feasting and violent behaviour.

chinese: 僕人辦事聰明，必管轄貽羞之子，又在眾子中同分產業。
english: A servant who does wisely will have rule over a son causing shame, and will have his part in the heritage among brothers.

chinese: 鼎為煉銀，爐為煉金；惟有耶和華熬煉人心。
english: The heating-pot is for silver and the oven-fire for gold, but the Lord is the tester of hearts.

chinese: 行惡的，留心聽奸詐之言；說謊的，側耳聽邪惡之語。
english: A wrongdoer gives attention to evil lips, and a man of deceit gives ear to a damaging tongue.

chinese: 戲笑窮人的，是辱沒造他的主；幸災樂禍的，必不免受罰。
english: Whoever makes sport of the poor puts shame on his Maker; and he who is glad because of trouble will not go free from punishment.

chinese: 子孫為老人的冠冕；父親是兒女的榮耀。
english: Children's children are the crown of old men, and the glory of children is their fathers.

chinese: 愚頑人說美言本不相宜，何況君王說謊話呢？
english: Fair words are not to be looked for from a foolish man, much less are false lips in a ruler.

chinese: 賄賂在餽送的人眼中看為寶玉，隨處運動都得順利。
english: An offering of money is like a stone of great price in the eyes of him who has it: wherever he goes, he does well.

chinese: 遮掩人過的，尋求人愛；屢次挑錯的，離間密友。
english: He who keeps a sin covered is looking for love; but he who keeps on talking of a thing makes division between friends.

chinese: 一句責備話深入聰明人的心，強如責打愚昧人一百下。
english: A word of protest goes deeper into one who has sense than a hundred blows into a foolish man.

chinese: 惡人只尋背叛，所以必有嚴厲的使者奉差攻擊他。
english: An uncontrolled man is only looking for trouble, so a cruel servant will be sent against him.

chinese: 寧可遇見丟崽子的母熊，不可遇見正行愚妄的愚昧人。
english: It is better to come face to face with a bear whose young ones have been taken away than with a foolish man acting foolishly.

chinese: 以惡報善的，禍患必不離他的家。
english: If anyone gives back evil for good, evil will never go away from his house.

chinese: 紛爭的起頭如水放開，所以，在爭鬧之先必當止息爭競。
english: The start of fighting is like the letting out of water: so give up before it comes to blows.

chinese: 定惡人為義的，定義人為惡的，這都為耶和華所憎惡。
english: He who gives a decision for the evil-doer and he who gives a decision against the upright, are equally disgusting to the Lord.

chinese: 愚昧人既無聰明，為何手拿價銀買智慧呢？
english: How will money in the hand of the foolish get him wisdom, seeing that he has no sense?

chinese: 朋友乃時常親愛，弟兄為患難而生。
english: A friend is loving at all times, and becomes a brother in times of trouble.

chinese: 在鄰舍面前擊掌作保乃是無知的人。
english: A man without sense gives his hand in an agreement, and makes himself responsible before his neighbour.

chinese: 喜愛爭競的，是喜愛過犯；高立家門的，乃自取敗壞。
english: The lover of fighting is a lover of sin: he who makes high his doorway is looking for destruction.

chinese: 心存邪僻的，尋不著好處；舌弄是非的，陷在禍患中。
english: Nothing good comes to him whose heart is fixed on evil purposes: and he who has an evil tongue will come to trouble.

chinese: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦；愚頑人的父毫無喜樂。
english: He who has an unwise son gets sorrow for himself, and the father of a foolish son has no joy.

chinese: 喜樂的心乃是良藥；憂傷的靈使骨枯乾。
english: A glad heart makes a healthy body, but a crushed spirit makes the bones dry.

chinese: 惡人暗中受賄賂，為要顛倒判斷。
english: A sinner takes an offering out of his robe, to get a decision for himself in a cause.

chinese: 明哲人眼前有智慧；愚昧人眼望地極。
english: Wisdom is before the face of him who has sense; but the eyes of the foolish are on the ends of the earth.

chinese: 愚昧子使父親愁煩，使母親憂苦。
english: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitter pain to her who gave him birth.

chinese: 刑罰義人為不善；責打君子為不義。
english: To give punishment to the upright is not good, or to give blows to the noble for their righteousness.

chinese: 寡少言語的，有知識；性情溫良的，有聰明。
english: He who has knowledge says little: and he who has a calm spirit is a man of good sense.

chinese: 愚昧人若靜默不言也可算為智慧；閉口不說也可算為聰明。
english: Even the foolish man, when he keeps quiet, is taken to be wise: when his lips are shut he is credited with good sense.

chinese: 與眾寡合的，獨自尋求心願，並惱恨一切真智慧。
english: He who keeps himself separate for his private purpose goes against all good sense.

chinese: 愚昧人不喜愛明哲，只喜愛顯露心意。
english: A foolish man has no pleasure in good sense, but only to let what is in his heart come to light.

chinese: 惡人來，藐視隨來；羞恥到，辱罵同到。
english: When the evil-doer comes, a low opinion comes with him, and with the loss of honour comes shame.

chinese: 人口中的言語如同深水；智慧的泉源好像湧流的河水。
english: The words of a man's mouth are like deep waters: the fountain of wisdom is like a flowing stream.

chinese: 瞻徇惡人的情面，偏斷義人的案件，都為不善。
english: To have respect for the person of the evil-doer is not good, or to give a wrong decision against the upright.

chinese: 愚昧人張嘴啟爭端，開口招鞭打。
english: A foolish man's lips are a cause of fighting, and his mouth makes him open to blows.

chinese: 愚昧人的口自取敗壞；他的嘴是他生命的網羅。
english: The mouth of a foolish man is his destruction, and his lips are a net for his soul.

chinese: 傳舌人的言語如同美食，深入人的心腹。
english: The words of one who says evil of his neighbour secretly are like sweet food, and go down into the inner parts of the stomach.

chinese: 做工懈怠的，與浪費人為弟兄。
english: He who does not give his mind to his work is brother to him who makes destruction.

chinese: 耶和華的名是堅固臺；義人奔入便得安穩。
english: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the upright man running into it is safe.

chinese: 富足人的財物是他的堅城，在他心想，猶如高牆。
english: The property of a man of wealth is his strong town, and it is as a high wall in the thoughts of his heart.

chinese: 敗壞之先，人心驕傲；尊榮以前，必有謙卑。
english: Before destruction the heart of man is full of pride, and before honour goes a gentle spirit.

chinese: 未曾聽完先回答的，便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
english: To give an answer before hearing is a foolish thing and a cause of shame.

chinese: 人有疾病，心能忍耐；心靈憂傷，誰能承當呢？
english: The spirit of a man will be his support when he is ill; but how may a broken spirit be lifted up?

chinese: 聰明人的心得知識；智慧人的耳求知識。
english: The heart of the man of good sense gets knowledge; the ear of the wise is searching for knowledge.

chinese: 人的禮物為他開路，引他到高位的人面前。
english: A man's offering makes room for him, letting him come before great men.

chinese: 先訴情由的，似乎有理；但鄰舍來到，就察出實情。
english: The man who first puts his cause before the judge seems to be in the right; but then his neighbour comes and puts his cause in its true light.

chinese: 掣籤能止息爭競，也能解散強勝的人。
english: The decision of chance puts an end to argument, parting the strong.

chinese: 弟兄結怨，勸他和好，比取堅固城還難；這樣的爭競如同堅寨的門閂。
english: A brother wounded is like a strong town, and violent acts are like a locked tower.

chinese: 人口中所結的果子，必充滿肚腹；他嘴所出的，必使他飽足。
english: With the fruit of a man's mouth his stomach will be full; the produce of his lips will be his in full measure.

chinese: 生死在舌頭的權下，喜愛他的，必吃他所結的果子。
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; and those to whom it is dear will have its fruit for their food.

chinese: 得著賢妻的，是得著好處，也是蒙了耶和華的恩惠。
english: Whoever gets a wife gets a good thing, and has the approval of the Lord.

chinese: 貧窮人說哀求的話；富足人用威嚇的話回答。
english: The poor man makes requests for grace, but the man of wealth gives a rough answer.

chinese: 濫交朋友的，自取敗壞；但有一朋友比弟兄更親密。
english: There are friends who may be a man's destruction, but there is a lover who keeps nearer than a brother.

chinese: 行為純正的貧窮人勝過乖謬愚妄的富足人。
english: Better is the poor man whose ways are upright, than the man of wealth whose ways are twisted.

chinese: 心無知識的，乃為不善；腳步急快的，難免犯罪。
english: Further, without knowledge desire is not good; and he who is over-quick in acting goes out of the right way.

chinese: 人的愚昧傾敗他的道；他的心也抱怨耶和華。
english: By his foolish behaviour a man's ways are turned upside down, and his heart is bitter against the Lord.

chinese: 財物使朋友增多；但窮人朋友遠離。
english: Wealth makes a great number of friends; but the poor man is parted from his friend.

chinese: 作假見證的，必不免受罰；吐出謊言的，終不能逃脫。
