english: A false witness will not go without punishment, and the breather out of deceit will not go free.

chinese: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情；愛送禮的，人都為他的朋友。
english: Great numbers will make attempts to get the approval of a ruler: and every man is the special friend of him who has something to give.

chinese: 貧窮人，弟兄都恨他；何況他的朋友，更遠離他！他用言語追隨，他們卻走了。
english: All the brothers of the poor man are against him: how much more do his friends go far from him! ...

chinese: 得著智慧的，愛惜生命；保守聰明的，必得好處。
english: He who gets wisdom has love for his soul: he who keeps good sense will get what is truly good.

chinese: 作假見證的，不免受罰；吐出謊言的，也必滅亡。
english: A false witness will not go without punishment, and the breather out of deceit will be cut off.

chinese: 愚昧人宴樂度日是不合宜的；何況僕人管轄王子呢？
english: Material comfort is not good for the foolish; much less for a servant to be put over rulers.

chinese: 人有見識就不輕易發怒；寬恕人的過失便是自己的榮耀。
english: A man's good sense makes him slow to wrath, and the overlooking of wrongdoing is his glory.

chinese: 王的忿怒好像獅子吼叫；他的恩典卻如草上的甘露。
english: The king's wrath is like the loud cry of a lion, but his approval is like dew on the grass.

chinese: 愚昧的兒子是父親的禍患；妻子的爭吵如雨連連滴漏。
english: A foolish son is the destruction of his father; and the bitter arguments of a wife are like drops of rain falling without end.

chinese: 房屋錢財是祖宗所遺留的；惟有賢慧的妻是耶和華所賜的。
english: House and wealth are a heritage from fathers, but a wife with good sense is from the Lord.

chinese: 懶惰使人沉睡；懈怠的人必受飢餓。
english: Hate of work sends deep sleep on a man: and he who has no industry will go without food.

chinese: 謹守誡命的，保全生命；輕忽己路的，必致死亡。
english: He who keeps the law keeps his soul; but death will be the fate of him who takes no note of the word.

chinese: 憐憫貧窮的，就是借給耶和華；他的善行，耶和華必償還。
english: He who has pity on the poor gives to the Lord, and the Lord will give him his reward.

chinese: 趁有指望，管教你的兒子；你的心不可任他死亡。
english: Give your son training while there is hope; let not your heart be purposing his death.

chinese: 暴怒的人必受刑罰；你若救他，必須再救。
english: A man of great wrath will have to take his punishment: for if you get him out of trouble you will have to do it again.

chinese: 你要聽勸教，受訓誨，使你終久有智慧。
english: Let your ear be open to suggestion and take teaching, so that at the end you may be wise.

chinese: 人心多有計謀；惟有耶和華的籌算才能立定。
english: A man's heart may be full of designs, but the purpose of the Lord is unchanging.

chinese: 施行仁慈的，令人愛慕；窮人強如說謊言的。
english: The ornament of a man is his mercy, and a poor man is better than one who is false.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華的，得著生命；他必恆久知足，不遭禍患。
english: The fear of the Lord gives life: and he who has it will have need of nothing; no evil will come his way.

chinese: 懶惰人放手在盤子裡，就是向口撤回，他也不肯。
english: The hater of work puts his hand deep into the basin, and will not even take it to his mouth again.

chinese: 鞭打褻慢人，愚蒙人必長見識；責備明哲人，他就明白知識。
english: When blows overtake the man of pride, the simple will get sense; say sharp words to the wise, and knowledge will be made clear to him.

chinese: 虐待父親、攆出母親的，是貽羞致辱之子。
english: He who is violent to his father, driving away his mother, is a son causing shame and a bad name.

chinese: 我兒，不可聽了教訓而又偏離知識的言語。
english: A son who no longer gives attention to teaching is turned away from the words of knowledge.

chinese: 匪徒作見證戲笑公平；惡人的口吞下罪孽。
english: A good-for-nothing witness makes sport of the judge's decision: and the mouth of evil-doers sends out evil like a stream.

chinese: 刑罰是為褻慢人預備的；鞭打是為愚昧人的背預備的。
english: Rods are being made ready for the man of pride, and blows for the back of the foolish.

chinese: 酒能使人褻慢，濃酒使人喧嚷；凡因酒錯誤的，就無智慧。
english: Wine makes men foolish, and strong drink makes men come to blows; and whoever comes into error through these is not wise.

chinese: 王的威嚇如同獅子吼叫；惹動他怒的，是自害己命。
english: The wrath of a king is like the loud cry of a lion: he who makes him angry does wrong against himself.

chinese: 遠離紛爭是人的尊榮；愚妄人都愛爭鬧。
english: It is an honour for a man to keep from fighting, but the foolish are ever at war.

chinese: 懶惰人因冬寒不肯耕種，到收割的時候，他必討飯而無所得。
english: The hater of work will not do his ploughing because of the winter; so at the time of grain-cutting he will be requesting food and will get nothing.

chinese: 人心懷藏謀略，好像深水，惟明哲人才能汲引出來。
english: The purpose in the heart of a man is like deep water, but a man of good sense will get it out.

chinese: 人多述說自己的仁慈，但忠信人誰能遇著呢？
english: Most men make no secret of their kind acts: but where is a man of good faith to be seen?

chinese: 行為純正的義人，他的子孫是有福的！
english: An upright man goes on in his righteousness: happy are his children after him!

chinese: 王坐在審判的位上，以眼目驅散諸惡。
english: A king on the seat of judging puts to flight all evil with his eyes.

chinese: 誰能說，我潔淨了我的心，我脫淨了我的罪？
english: Who is able to say, I have made my heart clean, I am free from my sin?

chinese: 兩樣的法碼，兩樣的升斗，都為耶和華所憎惡。
english: Unequal weights and unequal measures, they are all disgusting to the Lord.

chinese: 孩童的動作是清潔，是正直，都顯明他的本性。
english: Even a child may be judged by his doings, if his work is free from sin and if it is right.

chinese: 能聽的耳，能看的眼，都是耶和華所造的。
english: The hearing ear and the seeing eye are equally the Lord's work.

chinese: 不要貪睡，免致貧窮；眼要睜開，你就吃飽。
english: Do not be a lover of sleep, or you will become poor: keep your eyes open, and you will have bread enough.

chinese: 買物的說：不好，不好；及至買去，他便自誇。
english: A poor thing, a poor thing, says he who is giving money for goods: but when he has gone on his way, then he makes clear his pride in what he has got.

chinese: 有金子和許多珍珠（或譯：紅寶石），惟有知識的嘴乃為貴重的珍寶。
english: There is gold and a store of corals: but the lips of knowledge are a jewel of great price.

chinese: 誰為生人作保，就拿誰的衣服；誰為外人作保，誰就要承當。
english: Take a man's clothing if he makes himself responsible for a strange man, and get an undertaking from him who gives his word for strange men.

chinese: 以虛謊而得的食物，人覺甘甜；但後來，他的口必充滿塵沙。
english: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but after, his mouth will be full of sand.

chinese: 計謀都憑籌算立定；打仗要憑智謀。
english: Every purpose is put into effect by wise help: and by wise guiding make war.

chinese: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事；大張嘴的，不可與他結交。
english: He who goes about talking of the business of others gives away secrets: so have nothing to do with him whose lips are open wide.

chinese: 咒罵父母的，他的燈必滅，變為漆黑的黑暗。
english: If anyone puts a curse on his father or his mother, his light will be put out in the blackest night.

chinese: 起初速得的產業，終久卻不為福。
english: A heritage may be got quickly at first, but the end of it will not be a blessing.

chinese: 你不要說，我要以惡報惡；要等候耶和華，他必拯救你。
english: Do not say, I will give punishment for evil: go on waiting for the Lord, and he will be your saviour.

chinese: 兩樣的法碼為耶和華所憎惡；詭詐的天平也為不善。
english: Unequal weights are disgusting to the Lord, and false scales are not good.

chinese: 人的腳步為耶和華所定；人豈能明白自己的路呢？
english: A man's steps are of the Lord; how then may a man have knowledge of his way?

chinese: 人冒失說，這是聖物，許願之後才查問，就是自陷網羅。
english: It is a danger to a man to say without thought, It is holy, and, after taking his oaths, to be questioning if it is necessary to keep them.

chinese: 智慧的王簸散惡人，用碌碡滾軋他們。
english: A wise king puts evil-doers to flight, and makes their evil-doing come back on them.

chinese: 人的靈是耶和華的燈，鑒察人的心腹。
english: The Lord keeps watch over the spirit of man, searching all the deepest parts of the body.

chinese: 王因仁慈和誠實得以保全他的國位，也因仁慈立穩。
english: Mercy and good faith keep the king safe, and the seat of his power is based on upright acts.

chinese: 強壯乃少年人的榮耀；白髮為老年人的尊榮。
english: The glory of young men is their strength, and the honour of old men is their grey hairs.

chinese: 鞭傷除淨人的罪惡；責打能入人的心腹。
english: By the wounds of the rod evil is taken away, and blows make clean the deepest parts of the body.

chinese: 王的心在耶和華手中，好像隴溝的水隨意流轉。
english: The king's heart in the hands of the Lord is like the water streams, and by him it is turned in any direction at his pleasure.

chinese: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看為正；惟有耶和華衡量人心。
english: Every way of a man seems right to himself, but the Lord is the tester of hearts.

chinese: 行仁義公平比獻祭更蒙耶和華悅納。
english: To do what is right and true is more pleasing to the Lord than an offering.

chinese: 惡人發達（發達：原文是燈），眼高心傲，這乃是罪。
english: A high look and a heart of pride, *** of the evil-doer is sin.

chinese: 殷勤籌劃的，足致豐裕；行事急躁的，都必缺乏。
english: The purposes of the man of industry have their outcome only in wealth; but one who is over-quick in acting will only come to be in need.

chinese: 用詭詐之舌求財的，就是自己取死；所得之財乃是吹來吹去的浮雲。
english: He who gets stores of wealth by a false tongue, is going after what is only breath, and searching for death.

chinese: 惡人的強暴必將自己掃除，因他們不肯按公平行事。
english: By their violent acts the evil-doers will be pulled away, because they have no desire to do what is right.

chinese: 負罪之人的路甚是彎曲；至於清潔的人，他所行的乃是正直。
english: Twisted is the way of him who is full of crime; but as for him whose heart is clean, his work is upright.

chinese: 寧可住在房頂的角上，不在寬闊的房屋與爭吵的婦人同住。
english: It is better to be living in an angle of the house-top, than with a bitter-tongued woman in a wide house.

chinese: 惡人的心樂人受禍；他眼並不憐恤鄰舍。
english: The desire of the evil-doer is fixed on evil: he has no kind feeling for his neighbour.

chinese: 褻慢的人受刑罰，愚蒙的人就得智慧；智慧人受訓誨，便得知識。
english: When the man of pride undergoes punishment, the simple man gets wisdom; and by watching the wise he gets knowledge.

chinese: 義人思想惡人的家，知道惡人傾倒，必致滅亡。
english: The Upright One, looking on the house of the evil-doer, lets sinners be overturned to their destruction.

chinese: 塞耳不聽窮人哀求的，他將來呼籲也不蒙應允。
english: He whose ears are stopped at the cry of the poor, will himself get no answer to his cry for help.

chinese: 暗中送的禮物挽回怒氣；懷中搋的賄賂止息暴怒。
english: By a secret offering wrath is turned away, and the heat of angry feelings by money in the folds of the robe.

chinese: 秉公行義使義人喜樂，使作孽的人敗壞。
english: It is a joy to the good man to do right, but it is destruction to the workers of evil.

chinese: 迷離通達道路的，必住在陰魂的會中。
english: The wanderer from the way of knowledge will have his resting-place among the shades.

chinese: 愛宴樂的，必致窮乏；好酒，愛膏油的，必不富足。
english: The lover of pleasure will be a poor man: the lover of wine and oil will not get wealth.

chinese: 惡人作了義人的贖價；奸詐人代替正直人。
english: The evil-doer will be given as a price for the life of the good man, and the worker of deceit in the place of the upright.

chinese: 寧可住在曠野，不與爭吵使氣的婦人同住。
english: It is better to be living in a waste land, than with a bitter-tongued and angry woman.

chinese: 智慧人家中積蓄寶物膏油；愚昧人隨得來隨吞下。
english: There is a store of great value in the house of the wise, but it is wasted by the foolish man.

chinese: 追求公義仁慈的，就尋得生命、公義，和尊榮。
english: He who goes after righteousness and mercy will get life, righteousness, and honour.

chinese: 智慧人爬上勇士的城牆，傾覆他所倚靠的堅壘。
english: A wise man goes up into the town of the strong ones, and overcomes its strength in which they put their faith.

chinese: 謹守口與舌的，就保守自己免受災難。
english: He who keeps watch over his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

chinese: 心驕氣傲的人名叫褻慢；他行事狂妄，都出於驕傲。
english: The man of pride, lifted up in soul, is named high-hearted; he is acting in an outburst of pride.

chinese: 懶惰人的心願將他殺害，因為他手不肯做工。
english: The desire of the hater of work is death to him, for his hands will do no work.

chinese: 有終日貪得無饜的；義人施捨而不吝惜。
english: All the day the sinner goes after his desire: but the upright man gives freely, keeping nothing back.

chinese: 惡人的祭物是可憎的；何況他存惡意來獻呢？
english: The offering of evil-doers is disgusting: how much more when they give it with an evil purpose!

chinese: 作假見證的必滅亡；惟有聽真情而言的，其言長存。
english: A false witness will be cut off, ...

chinese: 惡人臉無羞恥；正直人行事堅定。
english: The evil-doer makes his face hard, but as for the upright, he gives thought to his way.

chinese: 沒有人能以智慧、聰明、謀略敵擋耶和華。
english: Wisdom and knowledge and wise suggestions are of no use against the Lord.

chinese: 馬是為打仗之日預備的；得勝乃在乎耶和華。
english: The horse is made ready for the day of war, but power to overcome is from the Lord.

chinese: 美名勝過大財；恩寵強如金銀。
english: A good name is more to be desired than great wealth, and to be respected is better than silver and gold.

chinese: 富戶窮人在世相遇，都為耶和華所造。
english: The man of wealth and the poor man come face to face: the Lord is the maker of them all.

chinese: 通達人見禍藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。
english: The sharp man sees the evil and takes cover: the simple go straight on and get into trouble.

chinese: 敬畏耶和華心存謙卑，就得富有、尊榮、生命為賞賜。
english: The reward of a gentle spirit and the fear of the Lord is wealth and honour and life.

chinese: 乖僻人的路上有荊棘和網羅；保守自己生命的，必要遠離。
english: Thorns and nets are in the way of the twisted: he who keeps watch over his soul will be far from them.

chinese: 教養孩童，使他走當行的道，就是到老他也不偏離。
english: If a child is trained up in the right way, even when he is old he will not be turned away from it.

chinese: 富戶管轄窮人；欠債的是債主的僕人。
english: The man of wealth has rule over the poor, and he who gets into debt is a servant to his creditor.

chinese: 撒罪孽的，必收災禍；他逞怒的杖也必廢掉。
english: By planting the seed of evil a man will get in the grain of sorrow, and the rod of his wrath will be broken.

chinese: 眼目慈善的，就必蒙福，因他將食物分給窮人。
english: He who is kind will have a blessing, for he gives of his bread to the poor.

chinese: 趕出褻慢人，爭端就消除；紛爭和羞辱也必止息。
english: Send away the man of pride, and argument will go out; truly fighting and shame will come to an end.

chinese: 喜愛清心的人因他嘴上的恩言，王必與他為友。
english: He whose heart is clean is dear to the Lord; for the grace of his lips the king will be his friend.

chinese: 耶和華的眼目眷顧聰明人，卻傾敗奸詐人的言語。
english: The eyes of the Lord keep knowledge, but by him the acts of the false man will be overturned.

chinese: 懶惰人說：外頭有獅子；我在街上就必被殺。
english: The hater of work says, There is a lion outside: I will be put to death in the streets.

chinese: 淫婦的口為深坑；耶和華所憎惡的，必陷在其中。
english: The mouth of strange women is a deep hole: he with whom the Lord is angry will go down into it.

chinese: 愚蒙迷住孩童的心，用管教的杖可以遠遠趕除。
english: Foolish ways are deep-seated in the heart of a child, but the rod of punishment will send them far from him.

chinese: 欺壓貧窮為要利己的，並送禮與富戶的，都必缺乏。
english: He who is cruel to the poor for the purpose of increasing his profit, and he who gives to the man of wealth, will only come to be in need.

chinese: 你須側耳聽受智慧人的言語，留心領會我的知識。
english: Let your ear be bent down for hearing my words, and let your heart give thought to knowledge.

chinese: 你若心中存記，嘴上咬定，這便為美。
english: For it is a delight to keep them in your heart, to have them ready on your lips.

chinese: 我今日以此特特指教你，為要使你倚靠耶和華。
english: So that your faith may be in the Lord, I have made them clear to you this day, even to you.

chinese: 謀略和知識的美事，我豈沒有寫給你麼？
english: Have I not put in writing for you thirty sayings, with wise suggestions and knowledge,

chinese: 要使你知道真言的實理，你好將真言回覆那打發你來的人。
english: To make you see how certain are true words, so that you may give a true answer to those who put questions to you?

chinese: 貧窮人，你不可因他貧窮就搶奪他的物，也不可在城門口欺壓困苦人；
english: Do not take away the property of the poor man because he is poor, or be cruel to the crushed ones when they come before the judge:

chinese: 因耶和華必為他辨屈；搶奪他的，耶和華必奪取那人的命。
english: For the Lord will give support to their cause, and take the life of those who take their goods.

chinese: 好生氣的人，不可與他結交；暴怒的人，不可與他來往；
english: Do not be friends with a man who is given to wrath; do not go in the company of an angry man:

chinese: 恐怕你效法他的行為，自己就陷在網羅裡。
english: For fear of learning his ways and making a net ready for your soul.

chinese: 不要與人擊掌，不要為欠債的作保。
english: Be not one of those who give their hands in an agreement, or of those who make themselves responsible for debts:

chinese: 你若沒有甚麼償還，何必使人奪去你睡臥的床呢？
english: If you have nothing with which to make payment, he will take away your bed from under you.

chinese: 你先祖所立的地界，你不可挪移。
english: Let not the old landmark be moved which your fathers have put in place.

chinese: 你看見辦事殷勤的人麼？他必站在君王面前，必不站在下賤人面前。
english: Have you seen a man who is expert in his business? he will take his place before kings; his place will not be among low persons.

chinese: 你若與官長坐席，要留意在你面前的是誰。
english: When you take your seat at the feast with a ruler, give thought with care to what is before you;

chinese: 你若是貪食的，就當拿刀放在喉嚨上。
english: And put a knife to your throat, if you have a strong desire for food.

chinese: 不可貪戀他的美食，因為是哄人的食物。
english: Have no desire for his delicate food, for it is the bread of deceit.

chinese: 不要勞碌求富，休仗自己的聰明。
english: Take no care to get wealth; let there be an end to your desire for money.

chinese: 你豈要定睛在虛無的錢財上麼？因錢財必長翅膀，如鷹向天飛去。
english: Are your eyes lifted up to it? it is gone: for wealth takes to itself wings, like an eagle in flight up to heaven.

chinese: 不要吃惡眼人的飯，也不要貪他的美味；
english: Do not take the food of him who has an evil eye, or have any desire for his delicate meat:

chinese: 因為他心怎樣思量，他為人就是怎樣。他雖對你說，請吃，請喝，他的心卻與你相背。
english: For as the thoughts of his heart are, so is he: Take food and drink, he says to you; but his heart is not with you.

chinese: 你所吃的那點食物必吐出來；你所說的甘美言語也必落空。
english: The food which you have taken will come up again, and your pleasing words will be wasted.

chinese: 你不要說話給愚昧人聽，因他必藐視你智慧的言語。
english: Say nothing in the hearing of a foolish man, for he will put no value on the wisdom of your words.

chinese: 不可挪移古時的地界，也不可侵入孤兒的田地；
english: Do not let the landmark of the widow be moved, and do not go into the fields of those who have no father;

chinese: 因他們的救贖主大有能力，他必向你為他們辨屈。
english: For their saviour is strong, and he will take up their cause against you.

chinese: 你要留心領受訓誨，側耳聽從知識的言語。
english: Give your heart to teaching, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

chinese: 不可不管教孩童；你用杖打他，他必不至於死。
english: Do not keep back training from the child: for even if you give him blows with the rod, it will not be death to him.

chinese: 你要用杖打他，就可以救他的靈魂免下陰間。
english: Give him blows with the rod, and keep his soul safe from the underworld.

chinese: 我兒，你心若存智慧，我的心也甚歡喜。
english: My son, if your heart becomes wise, I, even I, will be glad in heart;

chinese: 你的嘴若說正直話，我的心腸也必快樂。
english: And my thoughts in me will be full of joy when your lips say right things.

chinese: 你心中不要嫉妒罪人，只要終日敬畏耶和華；
english: Have no envy of sinners in your heart, but keep in the fear of the Lord all through the day;

chinese: 因為至終必有善報，你的指望也不致斷絕。
english: For without doubt there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.

chinese: 我兒，你當聽，當存智慧，好在正道上引導你的心。
english: Give ear, my son, and be wise, guiding your heart in the right way.

chinese: 好飲酒的，好吃肉的，不要與他們來往；
english: Do not be among those who give themselves to wine-drinking, or among those who make themselves full with meat:

chinese: 因為好酒貪食的，必致貧窮；好睡覺的，必穿破爛衣服。
english: For those who take delight in drink and feasting will come to be in need; and through love of sleep a man will be poorly clothed.

chinese: 你要聽從生你的父親；你母親老了，也不可藐視他。
english: Give ear to your father whose child you are, and do not keep honour from your mother when she is old.

chinese: 你當買真理；就是智慧、訓誨，和聰明也都不可賣。
english: Get for yourself that which is true, and do not let it go for money; get wisdom and teaching and good sense.

chinese: 義人的父親必大得快樂；人生智慧的兒子，必因他歡喜。
english: The father of the upright man will be glad, and he who has a wise child will have joy because of him.

chinese: 你要使父母歡喜，使生你的快樂。
english: Let your father and your mother be glad, let her who gave you birth have joy.

chinese: 我兒，要將你的心歸我；你的眼目也要喜悅我的道路。
english: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes take delight in my ways.

chinese: 妓女是深坑；外女是窄阱。
english: For a loose woman is a deep hollow, and a strange woman is a narrow water-hole.

chinese: 他埋伏好像強盜；他使人中多有奸詐的。
english: Yes, she is waiting secretly like a beast for its food, and deceit by her is increased among men.

chinese: 誰有禍患？誰有憂愁？誰有爭鬥？誰有哀歎（或譯：怨言）？誰無故受傷？誰眼目紅赤？
english: Who says, Oh! who says, Ah! who has violent arguments, who has grief, who has wounds without cause, whose eyes are dark?

chinese: 就是那流連飲酒、常去尋找調和酒的人。
english: Those who are seated late over the wine: those who go looking for mixed wine.

chinese: 酒發紅，在杯中閃爍，你不可觀看，雖然下咽舒暢，終久是咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。
english: Keep your eyes from looking on the wine when it is red, when its colour is bright in the cup, when it goes smoothly down:
In the end, its bite is like that of a snake, its wound like the wound of a poison-snake.

chinese: 你眼必看見異怪的事（或譯：淫婦）；你心必發出乖謬的話。
english: Your eyes will see strange things, and you will say twisted things.

chinese: 你必像躺在海中，或像臥在桅杆上。
english: Yes, you will be like him who takes his rest on the sea, or on the top of a sail-support.

chinese: 你必說：人打我，我卻未受傷；人鞭打我，我竟不覺得。我幾時清醒，我仍去尋酒。
english: They have overcome me, you will say, and I have no pain; they gave me blows without my feeling them: when will I be awake from my wine? I will go after it again.

chinese: 你不要嫉妒惡人，也不要起意與他們相處；
english: Have no envy for evil men, or any desire to be with them:

chinese: 因為，他們的心圖謀強暴，他們的口談論奸惡。
english: For the purposes of their hearts are destruction, and their lips are talking of trouble.

chinese: 房屋因智慧建造，又因聰明立穩；
english: The building of a house is by wisdom, and by reason it is made strong:

chinese: 其中因知識充滿各樣美好寶貴的財物。
english: And by knowledge its rooms are full of all dear and pleasing things.

chinese: 智慧人大有能力；有知識的人力上加力。
english: A wise man is strong; and a man of knowledge makes strength greater.

chinese: 你去打仗，要憑智謀；謀士眾多，人便得勝。
english: For by wise guiding you will overcome in war: and in a number of wise guides there is salvation.

chinese: 智慧極高，非愚昧人所能及，所以在城門內不敢開口。
english: Wisdom is outside the power of the foolish: he keeps his mouth shut in the public place.

chinese: 設計作惡的，必稱為奸人。
english: He whose purposes are bad will be named a man of evil designs.

chinese: 愚妄人的思念乃是罪惡；褻慢者為人所憎惡。
english: The purpose of the foolish is sin: and the hater of authority is disgusting to others.

chinese: 你在患難之日若膽怯，你的力量就微小。
english: If you give way in the day of trouble, your strength is small.

chinese: 人被拉到死地，你要解救；人將被殺，你須攔阻。
english: Be the saviour of those who are given up to death, and do not keep back help from those who are slipping to destruction.

chinese: 你若說：這事我未曾知道，那衡量人心的豈不明白麼？保守你命的豈不知道麼？他豈不按各人所行的報應各人麼？
english: If you say, See, we had no knowledge of this: does not the tester of hearts give thought to it? and he who keeps your soul, has he no knowledge of it? and will he not give to every man the reward of his work?

chinese: 我兒，你要吃蜜，因為是好的；吃蜂房下滴的蜜便覺甘甜。
english: My son, take honey, for it is good; and the flowing honey, which is sweet to your taste:

chinese: 你心得了智慧，也必覺得如此。你若找著，至終必有善報；你的指望也不致斷絕。
english: So let your desire be for wisdom: if you have it, there will be a future, and your hope will not be cut off.

chinese: 你這惡人，不要埋伏攻擊義人的家；不要毀壞他安居之所。
english: Do not keep a secret watch, O evil-doer, against the fields of the upright man, or send destruction on his resting-place:

chinese: 因為，義人雖七次跌倒，仍必興起；惡人卻被禍患傾倒。
english: For an upright man, after falling seven times, will get up again: but trouble is the downfall of the evil.

chinese: 你仇敵跌倒，你不要歡喜；他傾倒，你心不要快樂；
english: Do not be glad at the fall of your hater, and let not your heart have joy at his downfall:

chinese: 恐怕耶和華看見就不喜悅，將怒氣從仇敵身上轉過來。
english: For fear that the Lord may see it, and it may be evil in his eyes, and his wrath may be turned away from him.

chinese: 不要為作惡的心懷不平，也不要嫉妒惡人；
english: Do not be troubled because of evil-doers, or have envy of sinners:

chinese: 因為，惡人終不得善報；惡人的燈也必熄滅。
english: For there will be no future for the evil man; the light of sinners will be put out.

chinese: 我兒，你要敬畏耶和華與君王，不要與反覆無常的人結交，
english: My son, go in fear of the Lord and the king: have nothing to do with those who are in high positions:

chinese: 因為他們的災難必忽然而起。耶和華與君王所施行的毀滅，誰能知道呢？
english: For their downfall will come suddenly; and who has knowledge of the destruction of those in high positions?

chinese: 以下也是智慧人的箴言：審判時看人情面是不好的。
english: These are more sayings of the wise: To have respect for a person's position when judging is not good.

chinese: 對惡人說：你是義人的，這人萬民必咒詛，列邦必憎惡。
english: He who says to the evil-doer, You are upright, will be cursed by peoples and hated by nations.

chinese: 責備惡人的，必得喜悅；美好的福也必臨到他。
english: But those who say sharp words to him will have delight, and a blessing of good will come on them.

chinese: 應對正直的，猶如與人親嘴。
english: He gives a kiss with his lips who gives a right answer.

chinese: 你要在外頭預備工料，在田間辦理整齊，然後建造房屋。
english: Put your work in order outside, and make it ready in the field; and after that, see to the building of your house.

chinese: 不可無故作見證陷害鄰舍，也不可用嘴欺騙人。
english: Do not be a violent witness against your neighbour, or let your lips say what is false.

chinese: 不可說：人怎樣待我，我也怎樣待他；我必照他所行的報復他。
english: Say not, I will do to him as he has done to me; I will give the man the reward of his work.

chinese: 我經過懶惰人的田地、無知人的葡萄園，
english: I went by the field of the hater of work, and by the vine-garden of the man without sense;

chinese: 荊棘長滿了地皮，刺草遮蓋了田面，石牆也坍塌了。
english: And it was all full of thorns, and covered with waste plants, and its stone wall was broken down.

chinese: 我看見就留心思想；我看著就領了訓誨。
english: Then looking at it, I gave thought: I saw, and I got teaching from it.

chinese: 再睡片時，打盹片時，抱著手躺臥片時，
english: A little sleep, a little rest, a little folding of the hands in sleep:

chinese: 你的貧窮就必如強盜速來，你的缺乏彷彿拿兵器的人來到。
english: So loss will come on you like an outlaw, and your need like an armed man.

chinese: 以下也是所羅門的箴言，是猶大王希西家的人所謄錄的。
english: These are more wise sayings of Solomon, copied out by the men of Hezekiah, king of Judah.

chinese: 將事隱祕乃神的榮耀；將事察清乃君王的榮耀。
english: It is the glory of God to keep a thing secret: but the glory of kings is to have it searched out.

chinese: 天之高，地之厚，君王之心也測不透。
english: The heaven is high and the earth is deep, and the hearts of kings may not be searched out.

chinese: 除去銀子的渣滓就有銀子出來，銀匠能以做器皿。
english: Take away the waste from silver, and a vessel will come out for the silver-worker.

chinese: 除去王面前的惡人，國位就靠公義堅立。
english: Take away evil-doers from before the king, and the seat of his power will be made strong in righteousness.

chinese: 不要在王面前妄自尊大；不要在大人的位上站立。
english: Do not take glory for yourself before the king, and do not put yourself in the place of the great:

chinese: 寧可有人說：請你上來，強如在你覲見的王子面前叫你退下。
english: For it is better to have it said to you, Come up here; than for you to be put down in a lower place before the ruler.

chinese: 不要冒失出去與人爭競，免得至終被他羞辱，你就不知道怎樣行了。
english: Do not be quick to go to law about what you have seen, for what will you do in the end, when your neighbour has put you to shame?

chinese: 你與鄰舍爭訟，要與他一人辯論，不可洩漏人的密事，
english: Have a talk with your neighbour himself about your cause, but do not give away the secret of another:

chinese: 恐怕聽見的人罵你，你的臭名就難以脫離。
english: Or your hearer may say evil of you, and your shame will not be turned away.

chinese: 一句話說得合宜，就如金蘋果在銀網子裡。
english: A word at the right time is like apples of gold in a network of silver.

chinese: 智慧人的勸戒，在順從的人耳中，好像金耳環和精金的妝飾。
english: Like a nose-ring of gold and an ornament of the best gold, is a wise man who says sharp words to an ear ready to give attention.

chinese: 忠信的使者叫差他的人心裡舒暢，就如在收割時有冰雪的涼氣。
english: As the cold of snow in the time of grain-cutting, so is a true servant to those who send him; for he gives new life to the soul of his master.

chinese: 空誇贈送禮物的，好像無雨的風雲。
english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is one who takes credit for an offering he has not given.

chinese: 恆常忍耐可以勸動君王；柔和的舌頭能折斷骨頭。
english: A judge is moved by one who for a long time undergoes wrongs without protest, and by a soft tongue even bone is broken.

chinese: 你得了蜜麼？只可吃夠而已，恐怕你過飽就嘔吐出來。
english: If you have honey, take only as much as is enough for you; for fear that, being full of it, you may not be able to keep it down.

chinese: 你的腳要少進鄰舍的家，恐怕他厭煩你，恨惡你。
english: Let not your foot be frequently in your neighbour's house, or he may get tired of you, and his feeling be turned to hate.

chinese: 作假見證陷害鄰舍的，就是大槌，是利刀，是快箭。
english: One who gives false witness against his neighbour is a hammer and a sword and a sharp arrow.

chinese: 患難時倚靠不忠誠的人，好像破壞的牙，錯骨縫的腳。
english: Putting one's faith in a false man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth and a shaking foot.

chinese: 對傷心的人唱歌，就如冷天脫衣服，又如鹼上倒醋。
english: Like one who takes off clothing in cold weather and like acid on a wound, is he who makes melody to a sad heart.

chinese: 你的仇敵若餓了，就給他飯吃；若渴了，就給他水喝；
english: If your hater is in need of food, give him bread; and if he is in need of drink, give him water:

chinese: 因為，你這樣行就是把炭火堆在他的頭上；耶和華也必賞賜你。
english: For so you will put coals of fire on his head, and the Lord will give you your reward.

chinese: 北風生雨，讒謗人的舌頭也生怒容。
english: As the north wind gives birth to rain, so is an angry face caused by a tongue saying evil secretly.

chinese: 寧可住在房頂的角上，不在寬闊的房屋與爭吵的婦人同住。
english: It is better to be living in an angle of the house-top, than with a bitter-tongued woman in a wide house.

chinese: 有好消息從遠方來，就如拿涼水給口渴的人喝。
english: As cold water to a tired soul, so is good news from a far country.

chinese: 義人在惡人面前退縮，好像逿渾之泉，弄濁之井。
english: Like a troubled fountain and a dirty spring, is an upright man who has to give way before evil-doers.

chinese: 吃蜜過多是不好的；考究自己的榮耀也是可厭的。
english: It is not good to take much honey: so he who is not looking for honour will be honoured.

chinese: 人不制伏自己的心，好像毀壞的城邑沒有牆垣。
english: He whose spirit is uncontrolled is like an unwalled town which has been broken into.

chinese: 夏天落雪，收割時下雨，都不相宜；愚昧人得尊榮也是如此。
english: Like snow in summer and rain when the grain is being cut, so honour is not natural for the foolish.

chinese: 麻雀往來，燕子翻飛；這樣，無故的咒詛也必不臨到。
english: As the sparrow in her wandering and the swallow in her flight, so the curse does not come without a cause.

chinese: 鞭子是為打馬，轡頭是為勒驢；刑杖是為打愚昧人的背。
english: A whip for the horse, a mouth-bit for the ass, and a rod for the back of the foolish.

chinese: 不要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他，恐怕你與他一樣。
english: Do not give to the foolish man a foolish answer, or you will be like him.

chinese: 要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他，免得他自以為有智慧。
english: Give a foolish man a foolish answer, or he will seem wise to himself.

chinese: 藉愚昧人手寄信的，是砍斷自己的腳，自受（原文是：喝）損害。
english: He who sends news by the hand of a foolish man is cutting off his feet and drinking in damage.

chinese: 瘸子的腳空存無用；箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。
english: The legs of one who has no power of walking are hanging loose; so is a wise saying in the mouth of the foolish.

chinese: 將尊榮給愚昧人的，好像人把石子包在機弦裡。
english: Giving honour to a foolish man is like attempting to keep a stone fixed in a cord.

chinese: 箴言在愚昧人的口中，好像荊棘刺入醉漢的手。
english: Like a thorn which goes up into the hand of a man overcome by drink, so is a wise saying in the mouth of a foolish man.

chinese: 雇愚昧人的，與雇過路人的，就像射傷眾人的弓箭手。
english: Like an archer wounding all who go by, is a foolish man overcome by drink.

chinese: 愚昧人行愚妄事，行了又行，就如狗轉過來吃他所吐的。
english: Like a dog going back to the food which he has not been able to keep down, is the foolish man doing his foolish acts over again.

chinese: 你見自以為有智慧的人麼？愚昧人比他更有指望。
english: Have you seen a man who seems to himself to be wise? There is more hope for the foolish than for him.

chinese: 懶惰人說：道上有猛獅，街上有壯獅。
english: The hater of work says, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.

chinese: 門在樞紐轉動，懶惰人在床上也是如此。
english: A door is turned on its pillar, and the hater of work on his bed.

chinese: 懶惰人放手在盤子裡，就是向口撤回也以為勞乏。
english: The hater of work puts his hand deep into the basin: lifting it again to his mouth is a weariness to him.

chinese: 懶惰人看自己比七個善於應對的人更有智慧。
english: The hater of work seems to himself wiser than seven men who are able to give an answer with good sense.

chinese: 過路被事激動，管理不干己的爭競，好像人揪住狗耳。
english: He who gets mixed up in a fight which is not his business, is like one who takes a dog by the ears while it is going by.

chinese: 人欺凌鄰舍，卻說：我豈不是戲耍麼？他就像瘋狂的人拋擲火把、利箭，與殺人的兵器（原文是死亡）。
english: As one who is off his head sends about flaming sticks and arrows of death,
So is the man who gets the better of his neighbour by deceit, and says, Am I not doing so in sport?

chinese: 火缺了柴就必熄滅；無人傳舌，爭競便止息。
english: Without wood, the fire goes out; and where there is no secret talk, argument is ended.

chinese: 好爭競的人煽惑爭端，就如餘火加炭，火上加柴一樣。
english: Like breath on coals and wood on fire, so a man given to argument gets a fight started.

chinese: 傳舌人的言語，如同美食，深入人的心腹。
english: The words of one who says evil of his neighbour secretly are like sweet food, they go down into the inner parts of the stomach.

chinese: 火熱的嘴，奸惡的心，好像銀渣包的瓦器。
english: Smooth lips and an evil heart are like a vessel of earth plated with silver waste.

chinese: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉飾，心裡卻藏著詭詐；
english: With his lips the hater makes things seem what they are not, but deceit is stored up inside him;

chinese: 他用甜言蜜語，你不可信他，因為他心中有七樣可憎惡的。
english: When he says fair words, have no belief in him; for in his heart are seven evils:

chinese: 他雖用詭詐遮掩自己的怨恨，他的邪惡必在會中顯露。
english: Though his hate is covered with deceit, his sin will be seen openly before the meeting of the people.

chinese: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中；滾石頭的，石頭必反滾在他身上。
english: He who makes a hole in the earth will himself go falling into it: and on him by whom a stone is rolled the stone will come back again.

chinese: 虛謊的舌恨他所壓傷的人；諂媚的口敗壞人的事。
english: A false tongue has hate for those who have clean hearts, and a smooth mouth is a cause of falling.

chinese: 不要為明日自誇，因為一日要生何事，你尚且不能知道。
english: Do not make a noise about tomorrow, for you are not certain what a day's outcome may be.

chinese: 要別人誇獎你，不可用口自誇；等外人稱讚你，不可用嘴自稱。
english: Let another man give you praise, and not your mouth; one who is strange to you, and not your lips.

chinese: 石頭重，沙土沉，愚妄人的惱怒比這兩樣更重。
english: A stone has great weight, and sand is crushing; but the wrath of the foolish is of greater weight than these.

chinese: 忿怒為殘忍，怒氣為狂瀾，惟有嫉妒，誰能敵得住呢？
english: Wrath is cruel, and angry feeling an overflowing stream; but who does not give way before envy?

chinese: 當面的責備強如背地的愛情。
english: Better is open protest than love kept secret.

chinese: 朋友加的傷痕出於忠誠；仇敵連連親嘴卻是多餘。
english: The wounds of a friend are given in good faith, but the kisses of a hater are false.

chinese: 人吃飽了，厭惡蜂房的蜜；人飢餓了，一切苦物都覺甘甜。
english: The full man has no use for honey, but to the man in need of food every bitter thing is sweet.

chinese: 人離本處飄流，好像雀鳥離窩遊飛。
english: Like a bird wandering from the place of her eggs is a man wandering from his station.

chinese: 膏油與香料使人心喜悅；朋友誠實的勸教也是如此甘美。
english: Oil and perfume make glad the heart, and the wise suggestion of a friend is sweet to the soul.

chinese: 你的朋友和父親的朋友，你都不可離棄。你遭難的日子，不要上弟兄的家去；相近的鄰舍強如遠方的弟兄。
english: Do not give up your friend and your father's friend; and do not go into your brother's house in the day of your trouble: better is a neighbour who is near than a brother far off.

chinese: 我兒，你要作智慧人，好叫我的心歡喜，使我可以回答那譏誚我的人。
english: My son, be wise and make my heart glad, so that I may give back an answer to him who puts me to shame.

chinese: 通達人見禍藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。
english: The sharp man sees the evil and takes cover: the simple go straight on and get into trouble.

chinese: 誰為生人作保，就拿誰的衣服；誰為外女作保，誰就承當。
english: Take a man's clothing if he makes himself responsible for a strange man, and get an undertaking from him who gives his word for strange men.

chinese: 清晨起來，大聲給朋友祝福的，就算是咒詛他。
english: He who gives a blessing to his friend with a loud voice, getting up early in the morning, will have it put to his account as a curse.

chinese: 大雨之日連連滴漏，和爭吵的婦人一樣；
english: Like an unending dropping on a day of rain is a bitter-tongued woman.

chinese: 想攔阻他的，便是攔阻風，也是右手抓油。
english: He who keeps secret the secret of his friend, will get himself a name for good faith.

chinese: 鐵磨鐵，磨出刃來；朋友相感（原文是磨朋友的臉）也是如此。
english: Iron makes iron sharp; so a man makes sharp his friend.

chinese: 看守無花果樹的，必吃樹上的果子；敬奉主人的，必得尊榮。
english: Whoever keeps a fig-tree will have its fruit; and the servant waiting on his master will be honoured.

chinese: 水中照臉，彼此相符；人與人，心也相對。
english: Like face looking at face in water, so are the hearts of men to one another.

chinese: 陰間和滅亡永不滿足；人的眼目也是如此。
english: The underworld and Abaddon are never full, and the eyes of man have never enough.

chinese: 鼎為煉銀，爐為煉金，人的稱讚也試煉人。
english: The heating-pot is for silver and the oven-fire for gold, and a man is measured by what he is praised for.

chinese: 你雖用杵將愚妄人與打碎的麥子一同搗在臼中，他的愚妄還是離不了他。
english: Even if a foolish man is crushed with a hammer in a vessel among crushed grain, still his foolish ways will not go from him.

chinese: 你要詳細知道你羊群的景況，留心料理你的牛群；
english: Take care to have knowledge about the condition of your flocks, looking well after your herds;

chinese: 因為資財不能永有，冠冕豈能存到萬代？
english: For wealth is not for ever, and money does not go on for all generations.

chinese: 乾草割去，嫩草發現，山上的菜蔬也被收斂。
english: The grass comes up and the young grass is seen, and the mountain plants are got in.

chinese: 羊羔之毛是為你作衣服；山羊是為作田地的價值，
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the he-goats make the value of a field:

chinese: 並有母山羊奶夠你吃，也夠你的家眷吃，且夠養你的婢女。
english: There will be goats' milk enough for your food, and for the support of your servant-girls.

chinese: 惡人雖無人追趕也逃跑；義人卻膽壯像獅子。
english: The evil man goes running away when no man is after him, but the upright are without fear, like the lion.

chinese: 邦國因有罪過，君王就多更換；因有聰明知識的人，國必長存。
english: Because of the sin of the land, its troubles are increased; but by a man of wisdom and knowledge they will be put out like a fire.

chinese: 窮人欺壓貧民，好像暴雨沖沒糧食。
english: A man of wealth who is cruel to the poor is like a violent rain causing destruction of food.

chinese: 違棄律法的，誇獎惡人；遵守律法的，卻與惡人相爭。
english: Those who have no respect for the law give praise to the evil-doer; but such as keep the law are against him.

chinese: 壞人不明白公義；惟有尋求耶和華的，無不明白。
english: Evil men have no knowledge of what is right; but those who go after the Lord have knowledge of all things.

chinese: 行為純正的窮乏人勝過行事乖僻的富足人。
english: Better is the poor man whose ways are upright, than the man of wealth whose ways are not straight.

chinese: 謹守律法的，是智慧之子；與貪食人作伴的，卻羞辱其父。
english: He who keeps the law is a wise son, but he who keeps company with feasters puts shame on his father.

chinese: 人以厚利加增財物，是給那憐憫窮人者積蓄的。
english: He who makes his wealth greater by taking interest, only gets it together for him who has pity on the poor.

chinese: 轉耳不聽律法的，他的祈禱也為可憎。
english: As for the man whose ear is turned away from hearing the law, even his prayer is disgusting.

chinese: 誘惑正直人行惡道的，必掉在自己的坑裡；惟有完全人必承受福分。
english: Anyone causing the upright to go wandering in an evil way, will himself go down into the hole he has made; but the upright will have good things for their heritage.

chinese: 富足人自以為有智慧，但聰明的貧窮人能將他查透。
english: The man of wealth seems to himself to be wise, but the poor man who has sense has a low opinion of him.

chinese: 義人得志，有大榮耀；惡人興起，人就躲藏。
english: When the upright do well, there is great glory; but when evil-doers are lifted up, men do not let themselves be seen.

chinese: 遮掩自己罪過的，必不亨通；承認離棄罪過的，必蒙憐恤。
english: He who keeps his sins secret will not do well; but one who is open about them, and gives them up, will get mercy.

chinese: 常存敬畏的，便為有福；心存剛硬的，必陷在禍患裡。
english: Happy is the man in whom is the fear of the Lord at all times; but he whose heart is hard will come into trouble.

chinese: 暴虐的君王轄制貧民，好像吼叫的獅子、覓食的熊。
english: Like a loud-voiced lion and a wandering bear, is an evil ruler over a poor people.

chinese: 無知的君多行暴虐；以貪財為可恨的，必年長日久。
english: The prince who has no sense is a cruel ruler; but he who has no desire to get profit for himself will have long life.

chinese: 背負流人血之罪的，必往坑裡奔跑，誰也不可攔阻他。
english: One who has been the cause of a man's death will go in flight to the underworld: let no man give him help.

chinese: 行動正直的，必蒙拯救；行事彎曲的，立時跌倒。
english: He whose ways are upright will be safe, but sudden will be the fall of him whose ways are twisted.

chinese: 耕種自己田地的，必得飽食；追隨虛浮的，足受窮乏。
english: By ploughing his land a man will have bread in full measure; but he who goes after good-for-nothing persons will be poor enough.

chinese: 誠實人必多得福；想要急速發財的，不免受罰。
english: A man of good faith will have great blessing, but one attempting to get wealth quickly will not go free from punishment.

chinese: 看人的情面乃為不好；人因一塊餅枉法也為不好。
english: It is not good to have respect for a man's position: for a man will do wrong for a bit of bread.

chinese: 人有惡眼想要急速發財，卻不知窮乏必臨到他身。
english: He who is ever desiring wealth goes running after money, and does not see that need will come on him.

chinese: 責備人的，後來蒙人喜悅，多於那用舌頭諂媚人的。
english: He who says words of protest to a man will later have more approval than one who says smooth words with his tongue.

chinese: 偷竊父母的，說：這不是罪，此人就是與強盜同類。
english: He who takes from his father or his mother what is theirs by right, and says, It is no sin; is the same as a taker of life.

chinese: 心中貪婪的，挑起爭端；倚靠耶和華的，必得豐裕。
english: He who is ever desiring profit is a cause of fighting; but he who puts his faith in the Lord will be made fat.

chinese: 心中自是的，便是愚昧人；憑智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。
english: He whose faith is in himself is foolish; but everyone walking wisely will be kept safe.

chinese: 賙濟貧窮的，不致缺乏；佯為不見的，必多受咒詛。
english: He who gives to the poor will never be in need, but great curses will be on him who gives no attention to them.

chinese: 惡人興起，人就躲藏；惡人敗亡，義人增多。
english: When evil-doers are lifted up, men take cover; but when destruction overtakes them, the upright are increased.

chinese: 人屢次受責罰，仍然硬著頸項；他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。
english: A man hating sharp words and making his heart hard, will suddenly be broken and will not be made well again.

chinese: 義人增多，民就喜樂；惡人掌權，民就歎息。
english: When the upright have power, the people are glad; when an evil man is ruler, grief comes on the people.

chinese: 愛慕智慧的，使父親喜樂；與妓女結交的，卻浪費錢財。
english: A man who is a lover of wisdom is a joy to his father: but he who goes in the company of loose women is a waster of wealth.

chinese: 王藉公平，使國堅定；索要賄賂，使國傾敗。
english: A king, by right rule, makes the land safe; but one full of desires makes it a waste.

chinese: 諂媚鄰舍的，就是設網羅絆他的腳。
english: A man who says smooth things to his neighbour is stretching out a net for his steps.

chinese: 惡人犯罪，自陷網羅；惟獨義人歡呼喜樂。
english: In the steps of an evil man there is a net for him, but the upright man gets away quickly and is glad.

chinese: 義人知道查明窮人的案；惡人沒有聰明，就不得而知。
english: The upright man gives attention to the cause of the poor: the evil-doer gives no thought to it.

chinese: 褻慢人煽惑通城；智慧人止息眾怒。
english: Men of pride are the cause of violent acts in a town, but by wise men wrath is turned away.

chinese: 智慧人與愚妄人相爭，或怒或笑，總不能使他止息。
english: If a wise man goes to law with a foolish man, he may be angry or laughing, but there will be no rest.

chinese: 好流人血的，恨惡完全人，索取正直人的性命。
english: Men of blood are haters of the good man, and evil-doers go after his soul.

chinese: 愚妄人怒氣全發；智慧人忍氣含怒。
english: A foolish man lets out all his wrath, but a wise man keeps it back quietly.

chinese: 君王若聽謊言，他一切臣僕都是奸惡。
english: If a ruler gives attention to false words, all his servants are evil-doers.

chinese: 貧窮人、強暴人在世相遇；他們的眼目都蒙耶和華光照。
english: The poor man and his creditor come face to face: the Lord gives light to their eyes equally.

chinese: 君王憑誠實判斷窮人；他的國位必永遠堅立。
english: The king who is a true judge in the cause of the poor, will be safe for ever on the seat of his power.

chinese: 杖打和責備能加增智慧；放縱的兒子使母親羞愧。
english: The rod and sharp words give wisdom: but a child who is not guided is a cause of shame to his mother.

chinese: 惡人加多，過犯也加多，義人必看見他們跌倒。
english: When evil men are in power, wrongdoing is increased; but the upright will have pleasure when they see their downfall.

chinese: 管教你的兒子，他就使你得安息，也必使你心裡喜樂。
english: Give your son training, and he will give you rest; he will give delight to your soul.

chinese: 沒有異象（或譯：默示），民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便為有福。
english: Where there is no vision, the people are uncontrolled; but he who keeps the law will be happy.

chinese: 只用言語，僕人不肯受管教；他雖然明白，也不留意。
english: A servant will not be trained by words; for though the sense of the words is clear to him, he will not give attention.

chinese: 你見言語急躁的人嗎？愚昧人比他更有指望。
english: Have you seen a man who is quick with his tongue? There is more hope for a foolish man than for him.

chinese: 人將僕人從小嬌養，這僕人終久必成了他的兒子。
english: If a servant is gently cared for from his early years, he will become a cause of sorrow in the end.

chinese: 好氣的人挑啟爭端；暴怒的人多多犯罪。
english: An angry man is the cause of fighting, and a man given to wrath does much wrong.

chinese: 人的高傲必使他卑下；心裡謙遜的，必得尊榮。
english: A man's pride will be the cause of his fall, but he who has a gentle spirit will get honour.

chinese: 人與盜賊分贓，是恨惡自己的性命；他聽見叫人發誓的聲音，卻不言語。
english: A man who takes part with a thief has hate for his soul; he is put under oath, but says nothing.

chinese: 懼怕人的，陷入網羅；惟有倚靠耶和華的，必得安穩。
english: The fear of man is a cause of danger: but whoever puts his faith in the Lord will have a safe place on high.

chinese: 求王恩的人多；定人事乃在耶和華。
english: The approval of a ruler is desired by great numbers: but the decision in a man's cause comes from the Lord.

chinese: 為非作歹的，被義人憎嫌；行事正直的，被惡人憎惡。
english: An evil man is disgusting to the upright, and he who is upright is disgusting to evil-doers.

chinese: 雅基的兒子亞古珥的言語就是真言。這人對以鐵和烏甲說：
english: The words of Agur, the son of Jakeh, from Massa. The man says: I am full of weariness, O God, I am full of weariness; O God, I have come to an end:

chinese: 我比眾人更蠢笨，也沒有人的聰明。
english: For I am more like a beast than any man, I have no power of reasoning like a man:

chinese: 我沒有學好智慧，也不認識至聖者。
english: I have not got wisdom by teaching, so that I might have the knowledge of the Holy One.

chinese: 誰升天又降下來？誰聚風在掌握中？誰包水在衣服裡？誰立定地的四極？他名叫甚麼？他兒子名叫甚麼？你知道嗎？
english: Who has gone up to heaven and come down? who has taken the winds in his hands, prisoning the waters in his robe? by whom have all the ends of the earth been fixed? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if you are able to say?

chinese: 神的言語句句都是煉淨的；投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
english: Every word of God is tested: he is a breastplate to those who put their faith in him.

chinese: 他的言語，你不可加添，恐怕他責備你，你就顯為說謊言的。
english: Make no addition to his words, or he will make clear your error, and you will be seen to be false.

chinese: 我求你兩件事，在我未死之先，不要不賜給我：
english: I have made request to you for two things; do not keep them from me before my death:

chinese: 求你使虛假和謊言遠離我；使我也不貧窮也不富足；賜給我需用的飲食，
english: Put far from me all false and foolish things: do not give me great wealth or let me be in need, but give me only enough food:

chinese: 恐怕我飽足不認你，說：耶和華是誰呢？又恐怕我貧窮就偷竊，以致褻瀆我神的名。
english: For fear that if I am full, I may be false to you and say, Who is the Lord? or if I am poor, I may become a thief, using the name of my God wrongly.

chinese: 你不要向主人讒謗僕人，恐怕他咒詛你，你便算為有罪。
english: Do not say evil of a servant to his master, or he will put a curse on you, and you will get into trouble.

chinese: 有一宗人（宗：原文是代；下同），咒詛父親，不給母親祝福。
english: There is a generation who put a curse on their father, and do not give a blessing to their mother.

chinese: 有一宗人，自以為清潔，卻沒有洗去自己的污穢。
english: There is a generation who seem to themselves to be free from sin, but are not washed from their unclean ways.

chinese: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲，眼皮也是高舉。
english: There is a generation, O how full of pride are their eyes! O how their brows are lifted up!

chinese: 有一宗人，牙如劍，齒如刀，要吞滅地上的困苦人和世間的窮乏人。
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, their strong teeth like knives, for the destruction of the poor from the earth, and of those who are in need from among men.

chinese: 螞蟥有兩個女兒，常說：給呀，給呀！有三樣不知足的，連不說夠的共有四樣：
english: The night-spirit has two daughters, Give, give. There are three things which are never full, even four which never say, Enough:

chinese: 就是陰間和石胎，浸水不足的地，並火。
english: The underworld, and the woman without a child; the earth which never has enough water, and the fire which never says, Enough.

chinese: 戲笑父親、藐視而不聽從母親的，他的眼睛必為谷中的烏鴉啄出來，為鷹雛所吃。
english: The eye which makes sport of a father, and sees no value in a mother when she is old will be rooted out by the ravens of the valley, and be food for the young eagles.

chinese: 我所測不透的奇妙有三樣，連我所不知道的共有四樣：
english: There are three things, the wonder of which overcomes me, even four things outside my knowledge:

chinese: 就是鷹在空中飛的道；蛇在磐石上爬的道；船在海中行的道；男與女交合的道。
english: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a snake on a rock; the way of a ship in the heart of the sea; and the way of a man with a girl.

chinese: 淫婦的道也是這樣：他吃了，把嘴一擦就說：我沒有行惡。
english: This is the way of a false wife; she takes food, and, cleaning her mouth, says, I have done no wrong.

chinese: 使地震動的有三樣，連地擔不起的共有四樣：
english: For three things the earth is moved, and there are four which it will not put up with:

chinese: 就是僕人作王；愚頑人吃飽；
english: A servant when he becomes a king; a man without sense when his wealth is increased;

chinese: 醜惡的女子出嫁；婢女接續主母。
english: A hated woman when she is married; and a servant-girl who takes the place of her master's wife.

chinese: 地上有四樣小物，卻甚聰明：
english: There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are very wise:

chinese: 螞蟻是無力之類，卻在夏天預備糧食。
english: The ants are a people not strong, but they put by a store of food in the summer;

chinese: 沙番是軟弱之類，卻在磐石中造房。
english: The conies are only a feeble people, but they make their houses in the rocks;

chinese: 蝗蟲沒有君王，卻分隊而出。
english: The locusts have no king, but they all go out in bands;

chinese: 守宮用爪抓牆，卻住在王宮。
english: You may take the lizard in your hands, but it is in kings' houses.

chinese: 步行威武的有三樣，連行走威武的共有四樣：
english: There are three things whose steps are good to see, even four whose goings are fair:

chinese: 就是獅子─乃百獸中最為猛烈、無所躲避的，
english: The lion, which is strongest among beasts, not turning from his way for any;

chinese: 獵狗，公山羊，和無人能敵的君王。
english: The war-horse, and the he-goat, and the king when his army is with him.

chinese: 你若行事愚頑，自高自傲，或是懷了惡念，就當用手摀口。
english: If you have done foolishly in lifting yourself up, or if you have had evil designs, put your hand over your mouth.

chinese: 搖牛奶必成奶油；扭鼻子必出血。照樣，激動怒氣必起爭端。
english: The shaking of milk makes butter, and the twisting of the nose makes blood come: so the forcing of wrath is a cause of fighting.

chinese: 利慕伊勒王的言語，是他母親教訓他的真言。
english: The words of Lemuel, king of Massa: the teaching which he had from his mother.

chinese: 我的兒啊，我腹中生的兒啊，我許願得的兒啊！我當怎樣教訓你呢？
english: What am I to say to you, O Lemuel, my oldest son? and what, O son of my body? and what, O son of my oaths?

chinese: 不要將你的精力給婦女；也不要有敗壞君王的行為。
english: Do not give your strength to women, or your ways to that which is the destruction of kings.

chinese: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜；王子說濃酒在那裡也不相宜；
english: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to take wine, or for rulers to say, Where is strong drink?

chinese: 恐怕喝了就忘記律例，顛倒一切困苦人的是非。
english: For fear that through drinking they may come to have no respect for the law, wrongly judging the cause of those who are in trouble.

chinese: 可以把濃酒給將亡的人喝，把清酒給苦心的人喝，
english: Give strong drink to him who is near to destruction, and wine to him whose soul is bitter:

chinese: 讓他喝了，就忘記他的貧窮，不再記念他的苦楚。
english: Let him have drink, and his need will go from his mind, and the memory of his trouble will be gone.

chinese: 你當為啞巴（或譯：不能自辯的）開口，為一切孤獨的伸冤。
english: Let your mouth be open for those who have no voice, in the cause of those who are ready for death.

chinese: 你當開口按公義判斷，為困苦和窮乏的辨屈。
english: Let your mouth be open, judging rightly, and give right decisions in the cause of the poor and those in need.

chinese: 才德的婦人誰能得著呢？他的價值遠勝過珍珠。
english: Who may make discovery of a woman of virtue? For her price is much higher than jewels.

chinese: 他丈夫心裡倚靠他，必不缺少利益.；
english: The heart of her husband has faith in her, and he will have profit in full measure.

chinese: 他一生使丈夫有益無損。
english: She does him good and not evil all the days of her life.

chinese: 他尋找羊羢和麻，甘心用手做工。
english: She gets wool and linen, working at the business of her hands.

chinese: 他好像商船從遠方運糧來，
english: She is like the trading-ships, getting food from far away.

chinese: 未到黎明他就起來，把食物分給家中的人，將當做的工分派婢女。
english: She gets up while it is still night, and gives meat to her family, and their food to her servant-girls.

chinese: 他想得田地就買來；用手所得之利栽種葡萄園。
english: After looking at a field with care, she gets it for a price, planting a vine-garden with the profit of her work.

chinese: 他以能力束腰，使膀臂有力。
english: She puts a band of strength round her, and makes her arms strong.

chinese: 他覺得所經營的有利；他的燈終夜不滅
english: She sees that her marketing is of profit to her: her light does not go out by night.

chinese: 他手拿撚線竿，手把紡線車。
english: She puts her hands to the cloth-working rod, and her fingers take the wheel.

chinese: 他張手賙濟困苦人，伸手幫補窮乏人。
english: Her hands are stretched out to the poor; yes, she is open-handed to those who are in need.

chinese: 他不因下雪為家裡的人擔心，因為全家都穿著朱紅衣服。
english: She has no fear of the snow for her family, for all those in her house are clothed in red.

chinese: 他為自己製作繡花毯子；他的衣服是細麻和紫色布作的。
english: She makes for herself cushions of needlework; her clothing is fair linen and purple.

chinese: 他丈夫在城門口與本地的長老同坐，為眾人所認識。
english: Her husband is a man of note in the public place, when he takes his seat among the responsible men of the land.

chinese: 他做細麻布衣裳出賣，又將腰帶賣與商家。
english: She makes linen robes and gets a price for them, and traders take her cloth bands for a price.

chinese: 能力和威儀是他的衣服；他想到日後的景況就喜笑。
english: Strength and self-respect are her clothing; she is facing the future with a smile.

chinese: 他開口就發智慧；他舌上有仁慈的法則。
english: Her mouth is open to give out wisdom, and the law of mercy is on her tongue.

chinese: 他觀察家務，並不吃閒飯。
english: She gives attention to the ways of her family, she does not take her food without working for it.

chinese: 他的兒女起來，稱他有福；他的丈夫也稱讚他，
english: Her children get up and give her honour, and her husband gives her praise, saying,

chinese: 說：才德的女子很多，惟獨你超過一切。
english: Unnumbered women have done well, but you are better than all of them.

chinese: 艷麗是虛假的，美容是虛浮的；惟敬畏耶和華的婦女必得稱讚。
english: Fair looks are a deceit, and a beautiful form is of no value; but a woman who has the fear of the Lord is to be praised.

chinese: 願他享受操作所得的；願他的工作在城門口榮耀他。
english: Give her credit for what her hands have made: let her be praised by her works in the public place.

chinese: 在耶路撒冷作王、大衛的兒子、傳道者的言語。
english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

chinese: 傳道者說：虛空的虛空，虛空的虛空，凡事都是虛空。
english: All is to no purpose, said the Preacher, all the ways of man are to no purpose.

chinese: 人一切的勞碌，就是他在日光之下的勞碌，有甚麼益處呢？
english: What is a man profited by all his work which he does under the sun?

chinese: 一代過去，一代又來，地卻永遠長存。
english: One generation goes and another comes; but the earth is for ever.

chinese: 日頭出來，日頭落下，急歸所出之地。
english: The sun comes up and the sun goes down, and goes quickly back to the place where he came up.

chinese: 風往南颳，又向北轉，不住地旋轉，而且返回轉行原道。
english: The wind goes to the south, turning back again to the north; circling round for ever.

chinese: 江河都往海裡流，海卻不滿；江河從何處流，仍歸還何處。
english: All the rivers go down to the sea, but the sea is not full; to the place where the rivers go, there they go again.

chinese: 萬事令人厭煩（或譯：萬物滿有困乏），人不能說盡。眼看，看不飽；耳聽，聽不足。
english: All things are full of weariness; man may not give their story: the eye has never enough of its seeing, or the ear of its hearing.

chinese: 已有的事後必再有；已行的事後必再行。日光之下並無新事。
english: That which has been, is that which is to be, and that which has been done, is that which will be done, and there is no new thing under the sun.

chinese: 豈有一件事人能指著說這是新的？哪知，在我們以前的世代早已有了。
english: Is there anything of which men say, See, this is new? It has been in the old time which was before us.

chinese: 已過的世代，無人記念；將來的世代，後來的人也不記念。
english: There is no memory of those who have gone before, and of those who come after there will be no memory for those who are still to come after them.

chinese: 我傳道者在耶路撒冷作過以色列的王。
english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

chinese: 我專心用智慧尋求、查究天下所做的一切事，乃知神叫世人所經練的是極重的勞苦。
english: And I gave my heart to searching out in wisdom all things which are done under heaven: it is a hard thing which God has put on the sons of men to do.

chinese: 我見日光之下所做的一切事，都是虛空，都是捕風。
english: I have seen all the works which are done under the sun; all is to no purpose, and desire for wind.

chinese: 彎曲的，不能變直；缺少的，不能足數。
english: That which is bent may not be made straight, and that which is not there may not be numbered.

chinese: 我心裡議論說：我得了大智慧，勝過我以前在耶路撒冷的眾人，而且我心中多經歷智慧和知識的事。
english: I said to my heart, See, I have become great and am increased in wisdom more than any who were before me in Jerusalem--yes, my heart has seen much wisdom and knowledge.

chinese: 我又專心察明智慧、狂妄，和愚昧，乃知這也是捕風。
english: And I gave my heart to getting knowledge of wisdom, and of the ways of the foolish. And I saw that this again was desire for wind.

chinese: 因為多有智慧，就多有愁煩；加增知識的，就加增憂傷。
english: Because in much wisdom is much grief, and increase of knowledge is increase of sorrow.

chinese: 我心裡說：來罷，我以喜樂試試你，你好享福！誰知，這也是虛空。
english: I said in my heart, I will give you joy for a test; so take your pleasure--but it was to no purpose.

chinese: 我指嬉笑說：這是狂妄。論喜樂說：有何功效呢？
english: Of laughing I said, It is foolish; and of joy--What use is it?

chinese: 我心裡察究，如何用酒使我肉體舒暢，我心卻仍以智慧引導我；又如何持住愚昧，等我看明世人，在天下一生當行何事為美。
english: I made a search with my heart to give pleasure to my flesh with wine, still guiding my heart with wisdom, and to go after foolish things, so that I might see what was good for the sons of men to do under the heavens all the days of their life.

chinese: 我為自己動大工程，建造房屋，栽種葡萄園，
english: I undertook great works, building myself houses and planting vine-gardens.

chinese: 修造園囿，在其中栽種各樣果木樹；
english: I made myself gardens and fruit gardens, planting in them fruit-trees of all sorts.

chinese: 挖造水池，用以澆灌嫩小的樹木。
english: I made pools to give water for the woods with their young trees.

chinese: 我買了僕婢，也有生在家中的僕婢；又有許多牛群羊群，勝過以前在耶路撒冷眾人所有的。
english: I got men-servants and women-servants, and they gave birth to sons and daughters in my house. I had great wealth of herds and flocks, more than all who were in Jerusalem before me.

chinese: 我又為自己積蓄金銀和君王的財寶，並各省的財寶；又得唱歌的男女和世人所喜愛的物，並許多的妃嬪。
english: I got together silver and gold and the wealth of kings and of countries. I got makers of song, male and female; and the delights of the sons of men--girls of all sorts to be my brides.

chinese: 這樣，我就日見昌盛，勝過以前在耶路撒冷的眾人。我的智慧仍然存留。
english: And I became great; increasing more than all who had been before me in Jerusalem, and my wisdom was still with me.

chinese: 凡我眼所求的，我沒有留下不給他的；我心所樂的，我沒有禁止不享受的；因我的心為我一切所勞碌的快樂，這就是我從勞碌中所得的分。
english: And nothing which was desired by my eyes did I keep from them; I did not keep any joy from my heart, because my heart took pleasure in all my work, and this was my reward.

chinese: 後來，我察看我手所經營的一切事和我勞碌所成的功。誰知都是虛空，都是捕風；在日光之下毫無益處。
english: Then I saw all the works which my hands had made, and everything I had been working to do; and I saw that all was to no purpose and desire for wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

chinese: 我轉念觀看智慧、狂妄，和愚昧。在王以後而來的人還能做甚麼呢？也不過行早先所行的就是了。
english: And I went again in search of wisdom and of foolish ways. What may the man do who comes after the king? The thing which he has done before.

chinese: 我便看出智慧勝過愚昧，如同光明勝過黑暗。
english: Then I saw that wisdom is better than foolish ways--as the light is better than the dark.

chinese: 智慧人的眼目光明（光明原文是在他頭上），愚昧人在黑暗裡行。我卻看明有一件事，這兩等人都必遇見。
english: The wise man's eyes are in his head, but the foolish man goes walking in the dark; but still I saw that the same event comes to them all.

chinese: 我就心裡說：愚昧人所遇見的，我也必遇見，我為何更有智慧呢？我心裡說，這也是虛空。
english: Then said I in my heart: As it comes to the foolish man, so will it come to me; so why have I been wise overmuch? Then I said in my heart: This again is to no purpose.

chinese: 智慧人和愚昧人一樣，永遠無人記念，因為日後都被忘記；可歎智慧人死亡，與愚昧人無異。
english: Of the wise man, as of the foolish man, there is no memory for ever, seeing that those who now are will have gone from memory in the days to come. See how death comes to the wise as to the foolish!

chinese: 我所以恨惡生命；因為在日光之下所行的事我都以為煩惱，都是虛空，都是捕風。
english: So I was hating life, because everything under the sun was evil to me: all is to no purpose and desire for wind.

chinese: 我恨惡一切的勞碌，就是我在日光之下的勞碌，因為我得來的必留給我以後的人。
english: Hate had I for all my work which I had done, because the man who comes after me will have its fruits.

chinese: 那人是智慧是愚昧，誰能知道？他竟要管理我勞碌所得的，就是我在日光之下用智慧所得的。這也是虛空。
english: And who is to say if that man will be wise or foolish? But he will have power over all my work which I have done and in which I have been wise under the sun. This again is to no purpose.

chinese: 故此，我轉想我在日光之下所勞碌的一切工作，心便絕望。
english: So my mind was turned to grief for all the trouble I had taken and all my wisdom under the sun.

chinese: 因為有人用智慧、知識、靈巧所勞碌得來的，卻要留給未曾勞碌的人為分.。這也是虛空，也是大患。
english: Because there is a man whose work has been done with wisdom, with knowledge, and with an expert hand; but one who has done nothing for it will have it for his heritage. This again is to no purpose and a great evil.

chinese: 人在日光之下勞碌累心，在他一切的勞碌上得著甚麼呢？
english: What does a man get for all his work, and for the weight of care with which he has done his work under the sun?

chinese: 因為他日日憂慮，他的勞苦成為愁煩，連夜間心也不安。這也是虛空。
english: All his days are sorrow, and his work is full of grief. Even in the night his heart has no rest. This again is to no purpose.

chinese: 人莫強如吃喝，且在勞碌中享福，我看這也是出於神的手。
english: There is nothing better for a man than taking meat and drink, and having delight in his work. This again I saw was from the hand of God.

chinese: 論到吃用、享福，誰能勝過我呢？
english: Who may take food or have pleasure without him?

chinese: 神喜悅誰，就給誰智慧、知識，和喜樂；惟有罪人，神使他勞苦，叫他將所收聚的、所堆積的歸給神所喜悅的人。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
english: To the man with whom he is pleased, God gives wisdom and knowledge and joy; but to the sinner he gives the work of getting goods together and storing up wealth, to give to him in whom God has pleasure. This again is to no purpose and desire for wind.

chinese: 凡事都有定期，天下萬務都有定時。
english: For everything there is a fixed time, and a time for every business under the sun.

chinese: 生有時，死有時；栽種有時，拔出所栽種的也有時；
english: A time for birth and a time for death; a time for planting and a time for uprooting;

chinese: 殺戮有時，醫治有時；拆毀有時，建造有時；
english: A time to put to death and a time to make well; a time for pulling down and a time for building up;

chinese: 哭有時，笑有時；哀慟有時，跳舞有時；
english: A time for weeping and a time for laughing; a time for sorrow and a time for dancing;

chinese: 拋擲石頭有時，堆聚石頭有時；懷抱有時，不懷抱有時；
english: A time to take stones away and a time to get stones together; a time for kissing and a time to keep from kissing;

chinese: 尋找有時，失落有時；保守有時，捨棄有時；
english: A time for search and a time for loss; a time to keep and a time to give away;

chinese: 撕裂有時，縫補有時；靜默有時，言語有時；
english: A time for undoing and a time for stitching; a time for keeping quiet and a time for talk;

chinese: 喜愛有時，恨惡有時；爭戰有時，和好有時。
english: A time for love and a time for hate; a time for war and a time for peace.

chinese: 這樣看來，做事的人在他的勞碌上有甚麼益處呢？
english: What profit has the worker in the work which he does?

chinese: 我見神叫世人勞苦，使他們在其中受經練。
english: I saw the work which God has put on the sons of man.

chinese: 神造萬物，各按其時成為美好，又將永生（原文是永遠）安置在世人心裡。然而神從始至終的作為，人不能參透。
english: He has made everything right in its time; but he has made their hearts without knowledge, so that man is unable to see the works of God, from the first to the last.

chinese: 我知道世人，莫強如終身喜樂行善；
english: I am certain that there is nothing better for a man than to be glad, and to do good while life is in him.

chinese: 並且人人吃喝，在他一切勞碌中享福，這也是神的恩賜。
english: And for every man to take food and drink, and have joy in all his work, is a reward from God.

chinese: 我知道神一切所做的都必永存；無所增添，無所減少。　神這樣行，是要人在他面前存敬畏的心。
english: I am certain that whatever God does will be for ever. No addition may be made to it, nothing may be taken from it; and God has done it so that man may be in fear before him.

chinese: 現今的事早先就有了，將來的事早已也有了，並且神使已過的事重新再來（或譯：並且　神再尋回已過的事）。
english: Whatever is has been before, and what is to be is now; because God makes search for the things which are past.

chinese: 我又見日光之下，在審判之處有奸惡，在公義之處也有奸惡。
english: And again, I saw under the sun, in the place of the judges, that evil was there; and in the place of righteousness, that evil was there.

chinese: 我心裡說，神必審判義人和惡人；因為在那裡，各樣事務，一切工作，都有定時。
english: I said in my heart, God will be judge of the good and of the bad; because a time for every purpose and for every work has been fixed by him.

chinese: 我心裡說，這乃為世人的緣故，是神要試驗他們，使他們覺得自己不過像獸一樣。
english: I said in my heart, It is because of the sons of men, so that God may put them to the test and that they may see themselves as beasts.

chinese: 因為世人遭遇的，獸也遭遇，所遭遇的都是一樣：這個怎樣死，那個也怎樣死，氣息都是一樣。人不能強於獸，都是虛空。
english: Because the fate of the sons of men and the fate of the beasts is the same. As is the death of one so is the death of the other, and all have one spirit. Man is not higher than the beasts; because all is to no purpose.

chinese: 都歸一處，都是出於塵土，也都歸於塵土。
english: All go to one place, all are of the dust, and all will be turned to dust again.

chinese: 誰知道人的靈是往上升，獸的魂是下入地呢？
english: Who is certain that the spirit of the sons of men goes up to heaven, or that the spirit of the beasts goes down to the earth?

chinese: 故此，我見人莫強如在他經營的事上喜樂，因為這是他的分。他身後的事誰能使他回來得見呢？
english: So I saw that there is nothing better than for a man to have joy in his work--because that is his reward. Who will make him see what will come after him?

chinese: 我又轉念，見日光之下所行的一切欺壓。看哪，受欺壓的流淚，且無人安慰；欺壓他們的有勢力，也無人安慰他們。
english: And again I saw all the cruel things which are done under the sun; there was the weeping of those who have evil done to them, and they had no comforter: and from the hands of the evil-doers there went out power, but they had no comforter.

chinese: 因此，我讚歎那早已死的死人，勝過那還活著的活人。
english: So my praise was for the dead who have gone to their death, more than for the living who still have life.

chinese: 並且我以為那未曾生的，就是未見過日光之下惡事的，比這兩等人更強。
english: Yes, happier than the dead or the living seemed he who has not ever been, who has not seen the evil which is done under the sun.

chinese: 我又見人為一切的勞碌和各樣靈巧的工作就被鄰舍嫉妒。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
english: And I saw that the cause of all the work and of everything which is done well was man's envy of his neighbour. This again is to no purpose and a desire for wind.

chinese: 愚昧人抱著手，吃自己的肉。
english: The foolish man, folding his hands, takes the flesh of his body for food.

chinese: 滿了一把，得享安靜，強如滿了兩把，勞碌捕風。
english: One hand full of rest is better than two hands full of trouble and desire for wind.

chinese: 我又轉念，見日光之下有一件虛空的事：
english: Then I came back, and I saw an example of what is to no purpose under the sun.

chinese: 有人孤單無二，無子無兄，竟勞碌不息，眼目也不以錢財為足。他說：我勞勞碌碌，刻苦自己，不享福樂，到底是為誰呢？這也是虛空，是極重的勞苦。
english: It is one who is by himself, without a second, and without son or brother; but there is no end to all his work, and he has never enough of wealth. For whom, then, am I working and keeping myself from pleasure? This again is to no purpose, and a bitter work.

chinese: 兩個人總比一個人好，因為二人勞碌同得美好的果效。
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their work.

chinese: 若是跌倒，這人可以扶起他的同伴；若是孤身跌倒，沒有別人扶起他來，這人就有禍了。
english: And if one has a fall, the other will give him a hand; but unhappy is the man who is by himself, because he has no helper.

chinese: 再者，二人同睡就都暖和，一人獨睡怎能暖和呢？
english: So again, if two are sleeping together they are warm, but how may one be warm by himself?

chinese: 有人攻勝孤身一人，若有二人便能敵擋他；三股合成的繩子不容易折斷。
english: And two attacked by one would be safe, and three cords twisted together are not quickly broken.

chinese: 貧窮而有智慧的少年人勝過年老不肯納諫的愚昧王。
english: A young man who is poor and wise is better than a king who is old and foolish and will not be guided by the wisdom of others.

chinese: 這人是從監牢中出來作王，在他國中，生來原是貧窮的。
english: Because out of a prison the young man comes to be king, though by birth he was only a poor man in the kingdom.

chinese: 我見日光之下一切行動的活人都隨從那第二位，就是起來代替老王的少年人。
english: I saw all the living under the sun round the young man who was to be ruler in place of the king.

chinese: 他所治理的眾人就是他的百姓，多得無數；在他後來的人尚且不喜悅他。這真是虛空，也是捕風。
english: There was no end of all the people, of all those whose head he was, but they who come later will have no delight in him. This again is to no purpose and desire for wind.

chinese: 你到神的殿要謹慎腳步；因為近前聽，勝過愚昧人獻祭（或譯：勝過獻愚昧人的祭），他們本不知道所做的是惡。
english: Put your feet down with care when you go to the house of God, for it is better to give ear than to make the burned offerings of the foolish, whose knowledge is only of doing evil.

chinese: 你在神面前不可冒失開口，也不可心急發言；因為　神在天上，你在地下，所以你的言語要寡少。
english: Be not unwise with your mouth, and let not your heart be quick to say anything before God, because God is in heaven and you are on the earth--so let not the number of your words be great.

chinese: 事務多，就令人做夢；言語多，就顯出愚昧。
english: As a dream comes from much business, so the voice of a foolish man comes with words in great number.

chinese: 你向神許願，償還不可遲延，因他不喜悅愚昧人，所以你許的願應當償還。
english: When you take an oath before God, put it quickly into effect, because he has no pleasure in the foolish; keep the oath you have taken.

chinese: 你許願不還，不如不許。
english: It is better not to take an oath than to take an oath and not keep it.

chinese: 不可任你的口使肉體犯罪，也不可在祭司（原文是使者）面前說是錯許了。為何使神因你的聲音發怒，敗壞你手所做的呢？
english: Let not your mouth make your flesh do evil. And say not before the angel, It was an error. So that God may not be angry with your words and put an end to the work of your hands.

chinese: 多夢和多言，其中多有虛幻，你只要敬畏神。
english: Because much talk comes from dreams and things of no purpose. But let the fear of God be in you.

chinese: 你若在一省之中見窮人受欺壓，並奪去公義公平的事，不要因此詫異；因有一位高過居高位的鑒察，在他們以上還有更高的。
english: If you see the poor under a cruel yoke, and law and right being violently overturned in a country, be not surprised, because one authority is keeping watch on another and there are higher than they.

chinese: 況且地的益處歸眾人，就是君王也受田地的供應。
english: It is good generally for a country where the land is worked to have a king.

chinese: 貪愛銀子的，不因得銀子知足；貪愛豐富的，也不因得利益知足。這也是虛空。
english: He who has a love for silver never has enough silver, or he who has love for wealth, enough profit. This again is to no purpose.

chinese: 貨物增添，吃的人也增添，物主得甚麼益處呢？不過眼看而已！
english: When goods are increased, the number of those who take of them is increased; and what profit has the owner but to see them?

chinese: 勞碌的人不拘吃多吃少，睡得香甜；富足人的豐滿卻不容他睡覺。
english: The sleep of a working man is sweet, if he has little food or much; but to him who is full, sleep will not come.

chinese: 我見日光之下有一宗大禍患，就是財主積存資財，反害自己。
english: There is a great evil which I have seen under the sun--wealth kept by the owner to be his downfall.

chinese: 因遭遇禍患，這些資財就消滅；那人若生了兒子，手裡也一無所有。
english: And I saw the destruction of his wealth by an evil chance; and when he became the father of a son he had nothing in his hand.

chinese: 他怎樣從母胎赤身而來，也必照樣赤身而去；他所勞碌得來的，手中分毫不能帶去。
english: As he came from his mother at birth, so does he go again; he gets from his work no reward which he may take away in his hand.

chinese: 他來的情形怎樣，他去的情形也怎樣。這也是一宗大禍患。他為風勞碌有甚麼益處呢？
english: And this again is a great evil, that in all points as he came so will he go; and what profit has he in working for the wind?

chinese: 並且他終身在黑暗中吃喝，多有煩惱，又有病患嘔氣。
english: All his days are in the dark, and he has much sorrow, pain, disease, and trouble.

chinese: 我所見為善為美的，就是人在神賜他一生的日子吃喝，享受日光之下勞碌得來的好處，因為這是他的分。
english: This is what I have seen: it is good and fair for a man to take meat and drink and to have joy in all his work under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; that is his reward.

chinese: 神賜人資財豐富，使他能以吃用，能取自己的分，在他勞碌中喜樂，這乃是神的恩賜。
english: Every man to whom God has given money and wealth and the power to have pleasure in it and to do his part and have joy in his work: this is given by God.

chinese: 他不多思念自己一生的年日，因為神應他的心使他喜樂。
english: He will not give much thought to the days of his life; because God lets him be taken up with the joy of his heart.

chinese: 我見日光之下有一宗禍患重壓在人身上，
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is hard on men;

chinese: 就是人蒙神賜他資財、豐富、尊榮，以致他心裡所願的一樣都不缺，只是　神使他不能吃用，反有外人來吃用。這是虛空，也是禍患。
english: A man to whom God gives money, wealth, and honour so that he has all his desires but God does not give him the power to have joy of it, and a strange man takes it. This is to no purpose and an evil disease.

chinese: 人若生一百個兒子，活許多歲數，以致他的年日甚多，心裡卻不得滿享福樂，又不得埋葬；據我說，那不到期而落的胎比他倒好。
english: If a man has a hundred children, and his life is long so that the days of his years are great in number, but his soul takes no pleasure in good, and he is not honoured at his death; I say that a birth before its time is better than he.

chinese: 因為虛虛而來，暗暗而去，名字被黑暗遮蔽，
english: In wind it came and to the dark it will go, and with the dark will its name be covered.

chinese: 並且沒有見過天日，也毫無知覺；這胎，比那人倒享安息。
english: Yes, it saw not the sun, and it had no knowledge; it is better with this than with the other.

chinese: 那人雖然活千年，再活千年，卻不享福，眾人豈不都歸一個地方去麼？
english: And though he goes on living a thousand years twice over and does not see good, are not the two going to the same place?

chinese: 人的勞碌都為口腹，心裡卻不知足。
english: All the work of man is for his mouth, and still he has a desire for food.

chinese: 這樣看來，智慧人比愚昧人有甚麼長處呢？窮人在眾人面前知道如何行，有甚麼長處呢？
english: What have the wise more than the foolish? and what has the poor man by walking wisely before the living?

chinese: 眼睛所看的比心裡妄想的倒好。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
english: What the eyes see is better than the wandering of desire. This is to no purpose and a desire for wind.

chinese: 先前所有的，早已起了名，並知道何為人，他也不能與那比自己力大的相爭。
english: That which is, has been named before, and of what man is there is knowledge. He has no power against one stronger than he.

chinese: 加增虛浮的事既多，這與人有甚麼益處呢？
english: There are words without number for increasing what is to no purpose, but what is man profited by them?

chinese: 人一生虛度的日子，就如影兒經過，誰知道甚麼與他有益呢？誰能告訴他身後在日光之下有甚麼事呢？
english: Who is able to say what is good for man in life all the days of his foolish life which he goes through like a shade? who will say what is to be after him under the sun?

chinese: 名譽強如美好的的膏油；人死的日子勝過人生的日子。
english: A good name is better than oil of great price, and the day of death than the day of birth.

chinese: 往遭喪的家去，強如往宴樂的家去；因為死是眾人的結局，活人也必將這事放在心上。
english: It is better to go to the house of weeping, than to go to the house of feasting; because that is the end of every man, and the living will take it to their hearts.

chinese: 憂愁強如喜笑；因為面帶愁容，終必使心喜樂。
english: Sorrow is better than joy; when the face is sad the mind gets better.

chinese: 智慧人的心在遭喪之家；愚昧人的心在快樂之家。
english: The hearts of the wise are in the house of weeping; but the hearts of the foolish are in the house of joy.

chinese: 聽智慧人的責備，強如聽愚昧人的歌唱。
english: It is better to take note of the protest of the wise, than for a man to give ear to the song of the foolish.

chinese: 愚昧人的笑聲，好像鍋下燒荊棘的爆聲；這也是虛空。
english: Like the cracking of thorns under a pot, so is the laugh of a foolish man; and this again is to no purpose.

chinese: 勒索使智慧人變為愚妄；賄賂能敗壞人的慧心。
english: The wise are troubled by the ways of the cruel, and the giving of money is the destruction of the heart.

chinese: 事情的終局強如事情的起頭；存心忍耐的，勝過居心驕傲的。
english: The end of a thing is better than its start, and a gentle spirit is better than pride.

chinese: 你不要心裡急躁惱怒，因為惱怒存在愚昧人的懷中。
english: Be not quick to let your spirit be angry; because wrath is in the heart of the foolish.

chinese: 不要說：先前的日子強過如今的日子，是甚麼緣故呢？你這樣問，不是出於智慧。
english: Say not, Why were the days which have gone by better than these? Such a question comes not from wisdom.

chinese: 智慧和產業並好，而且見天日的人得智慧更為有益。
english: Wisdom together with a heritage is good, and a profit to those who see the sun.

chinese: 因為智慧護庇人，好像銀錢護庇人一樣。惟獨智慧能保全智慧人的生命。這就是知識的益處。
english: Wisdom keeps a man from danger even as money does; but the value of knowledge is that wisdom gives life to its owner.

chinese: 你要察看神的作為；因　神使為曲的，誰能變為直呢？
english: Give thought to the work of God. Who will make straight what he has made bent?

chinese: 遇亨通的日子你當喜樂；遭患難的日子你當思想；因為神使這兩樣並列，為的是叫人查不出身後有甚麼事。
english: In the day of wealth have joy, but in the day of evil take thought: God has put the one against the other, so that man may not be certain what will be after him.

chinese: 有義人行義，反致滅亡；有惡人行惡，倒享長壽。這都是我在虛度之日中所見過的。
english: These two have I seen in my life which is to no purpose: a good man coming to his end in his righteousness, and an evil man whose days are long in his evil-doing.

chinese: 不要行義過分，也不要過於自逞智慧，何必自取敗亡呢？
english: Be not given overmuch to righteousness and be not over-wise. Why let destruction come on you?

chinese: 不要行惡過分，也不要為人愚昧，何必不到期而死呢？
english: Be not evil overmuch, and be not foolish. Why come to your end before your time?

chinese: 你持守這個為美，那個也不要鬆手；因為敬畏神的人，必從這兩樣出來。
english: It is good to take this in your hand and not to keep your hand from that; he who has the fear of God will be free of the two.

chinese: 智慧使有智慧的人比城中十個官長更有能力。
english: Wisdom makes a wise man stronger than ten rulers in a town.

chinese: 時常行善而不犯罪的義人，世上實在沒有。
english: There is no man on earth of such righteousness that he does good and is free from sin all his days.

chinese: 人所說的一切話，你不要放在心上，恐怕聽見你的僕人咒詛你。
english: Do not give ear to all the words which men say, for fear of hearing the curses of your servant.

chinese: 因為你心裡知道，自己也曾屢次咒詛別人。
english: Your heart has knowledge how frequently others have been cursed by you.

chinese: 我曾用智慧試驗這一切事；我說，要得智慧，智慧卻離我遠。
english: All this I have put to the test by wisdom; I said, I will be wise, but it was far from me.

chinese: 萬事之理，離我甚遠，而且最深，誰能測透呢？
english: Far off is true existence, and very deep; who may have knowledge of it?

chinese: 我轉念，一心要知道，要考察，要尋求智慧和萬事的理由；又要知道邪惡為愚昧，愚昧為狂妄。
english: I gave my mind to knowledge and to searching for wisdom and the reason of things, and to the discovery that sin is foolish, and that to be foolish is to be without one's senses.

chinese: 我得知有等婦人比死還苦：他的心是網羅，手是鎖鍊。凡蒙神喜悅的人必能躲避他；有罪的人卻被他纏住了。
english: And I saw a thing more bitter than death, even the woman whose heart is full of tricks and nets, and whose hands are as bands. He with whom God is pleased will get free from her, but the sinner will be taken by her.

chinese: 傳道者說：看哪，一千男子中，我找到一個正直人，但眾女子中，沒有找到一個。我將這事一一比較，要尋求其理，我心仍要尋找，卻未曾找到。
english: Look! this I have seen, said the Preacher, taking one thing after another to get the true account,
For which my soul is still searching, but I have it not; one man among a thousand have I seen; but a woman among all these I have not seen.

chinese: 我所找到的只有一件，就是神造人原是正直，但他們尋出許多巧計。
english: This only have I seen, that God made men upright, but they have been searching out all sorts of inventions.

chinese: 誰如智慧人呢？誰知道事情的解釋呢？人的智慧使他的臉發光，並使他臉上的暴氣改變。
english: Who is like the wise man? and to whom is the sense of anything clear? A man's wisdom makes his face shining, and his hard face will be changed.

chinese: 我勸你遵守王的命令；既指神起誓，理當如此。
english: I say to you, Keep the king's law, from respect for the oath of God.

chinese: 不要急躁離開王的面前，不要固執行惡，因為他凡事都隨自己的心意而行。
english: Be not quick to go from before him. Be not fixed in an evil design, because he does whatever is pleasing to him.

chinese: 王的話本有權力，誰敢問他說你做甚麼呢？
english: The word of a king has authority; and who may say to him, What is this you are doing?

chinese: 凡遵守命令的，必不經歷禍患；智慧人的心能辨明時候和定理（原文是審判；下節同）。
english: Whoever keeps the law will come to no evil: and a wise man's heart has knowledge of time and of decision.

chinese: 各樣事務成就都有時候和定理，因為人的苦難重壓在他身上。
english: For every purpose there is a time and a decision, because the sorrow of man is great in him.

chinese: 他不知道將來的事，因為將來如何，誰能告訴他呢？
english: No one is certain what is to be, and who is able to say to him when it will be?

chinese: 無人有權力掌管生命，將生命留住；也無人有權力掌管死期；這場爭戰，無人能免；邪惡也不能救那好行邪惡的人。
english: No man has authority over the wind, to keep the wind; or is ruler over the day of his death. In war no man's time is free, and evil will not keep the sinner safe.

chinese: 這一切我都見過，也專心查考日光之下所做的一切事。有時這人管轄那人，令人受害。
english: All this have I seen, and have given my heart to all the work which is done under the sun: there is a time when man has power over man for his destruction.

chinese: 我見惡人埋葬，歸入墳墓；又見行正直事的離開聖地，在城中被人忘記。這也是虛空。
