english: And then I saw evil men put to rest, taken even from the holy place; and they went about and were praised in the town because of what they had done. This again is to no purpose.

chinese: 因為斷定罪名不立刻施刑，所以世人滿心作惡。
english: Because punishment for an evil work comes not quickly, the minds of the sons of men are fully given to doing evil.

chinese: 罪人雖然作惡百次，倒享長久的年日；然而我準知道，敬畏神的，就是在他面前敬畏的人，終久必得福樂。
english: Though a sinner does evil a hundred times and his life is long, I am certain that it will be well for those who go in fear of God and are in fear before him.

chinese: 惡人卻不得福樂，也不得長久的年日；這年日好像影兒，因他不敬畏神。
english: But it will not be well for the evil-doer; he will not make his days long like a shade, because he has no fear before God.

chinese: 世上有一件虛空的事，就是義人所遭遇的，反照惡人所行的；又有惡人所遭遇的，反照義人所行的。我說，這也是虛空。
english: There is a thing which is to no purpose done on the earth: that there are good men to whom is given the same punishment as those who are evil, and there are evil men who get the reward of the good. I say that this again is to no purpose.

chinese: 我就稱讚快樂，原來人在日光之下，莫強如吃喝快樂；因為他在日光之下，神賜他一生的年日，要從勞碌中，時常享受所得的。
english: So I gave praise to joy, because there is nothing better for a man to do under the sun than to take meat and drink and be happy; for that will be with him in his work all the days of his life which God gives him under the sun.

chinese: 我專心求智慧，要看世上所做的事。（有晝夜不睡覺不合眼的。）
english: When I gave my mind to the knowledge of wisdom and to seeing the business which is done on the earth (and there are those whose eyes see not sleep by day or by night),

chinese: 我就看明神一切的作為，知道人查不出日光之下所做的事；任憑他費多少力尋查，都查不出來，就是智慧人雖想知道，也是查不出來。
english: Then I saw all the work of God, and that man may not get knowledge of the work which is done under the sun; because, if a man gives hard work to the search he will not get knowledge, and even if the wise man seems to be coming to the end of his search, still he will be without knowledge.

chinese: 我將這一切事放在心上，詳細考究，就知道義人和智慧人，並他們的作為都在神手中；或是愛，或是恨，都在他們的前面，人不能知道。
english: All this I took to heart, and my heart saw it all: that the upright and the wise and their works are in the hand of God; and men may not be certain if it will be love or hate; all is to no purpose before them.

chinese: 凡臨到眾人的事都是一樣：義人和惡人都遭遇一樣的事；好人，潔淨人和不潔淨人，獻祭的與不獻祭的，也是一樣。好人如何，罪人也如何；起誓的如何，怕起誓的也如何。
english: Because to all there is one event, to the upright man and to the evil, to the clean and to the unclean, to him who makes an offering and to him who makes no offering; as is the good so is the sinner; he who takes an oath is as he who has fear of it.

chinese: 在日光之下所行的一切事上有一件禍患，就是眾人所遭遇的都是一樣，並且世人的心充滿了惡；活著的時候心裡狂妄，後來就歸死人那裡去了。
english: This is evil in all things which are done under the sun: that there is one fate for all, and the hearts of the sons of men are full of evil; while they have life their hearts are foolish, and after that--to the dead.

chinese: 與一切活人相連的，那人還有指望，因為活著的狗比死了的獅子更強。
english: For him who is joined to all the living there is hope; a living dog is better than a dead lion.

chinese: 活著的人知道必死；死了的人毫無所知，也不再得賞賜；他們的名無人記念。
english: The living are conscious that death will come to them, but the dead are not conscious of anything, and they no longer have a reward, because there is no memory of them.

chinese: 他們的愛，他們的恨，他們的嫉妒，早都消滅了。在日光之下所行的一切事上，他們永不再有分了。
english: Their love and their hate and their envy are now ended; and they have no longer a part for ever in anything which is done under the sun.

chinese: 你只管去歡歡喜喜吃你的飯，心中快樂喝你的酒，因為神已經悅納你的作為。
english: Come, take your bread with joy, and your wine with a glad heart. God has taken pleasure in your works.

chinese: 你的衣服當時常潔白，你頭上也不要缺少膏油。
english: Let your clothing be white at all times, and let not your head be without oil.

chinese: 在你一生虛空的年日，就是神賜你在日光之下虛空的年日，當同你所愛的妻，快活度日，因為那是你生前在日光之下勞碌的事上所得的分。
english: Have joy with the woman of your love all the days of your foolish life which he gives you under the sun. Because that is your part in life and in your work which you do under the sun.

chinese: 凡你手所當做的事要盡力去做；因為在你所必去的陰間沒有工作，沒有謀算，沒有知識，也沒有智慧。
english: Whatever comes to your hand to do with all your power, do it because there is no work, or thought, or knowledge, or wisdom in the place of the dead to which you are going.

chinese: 我又轉念：見日光之下，快跑的未必能贏；力戰的未必得勝；智慧的未必得糧食；明哲的未必得資財；靈巧的未必得喜悅。所臨到眾人的是在乎當時的機會。
english: And again I saw under the sun that the reward goes not to him who is quick, or the fruits of war to the strong; and there is no bread for the wise, or wealth for men of learning, or respect for those who have knowledge; but time and chance come to all.

chinese: 原來人也不知道自己的定期。魚被惡網圈住，鳥被網羅捉住，禍患忽然臨到的時候，世人陷在其中也是如此。
english: Even man has no knowledge of his time; like fishes taken in an evil net, or like birds taken by deceit, are the sons of men taken in an evil time when it comes suddenly on them.

chinese: 我見日光之下有一樣智慧，據我看乃是廣大，
english: This again I have seen under the sun as wisdom and it seemed great to me.

chinese: 就是有一小城，其中的人數稀少，有大君王來攻擊，修築營壘，將城圍困。
english: There was a little town and the number of its men was small, and there came a great king against it and made an attack on it, building works of war round about it.

chinese: 城中有一個貧窮的智慧人，他用智慧救了那城，卻沒有人記念那窮人。
english: Now there was in the town a poor, wise man, and he, by his wisdom, kept the town safe. But no one had any memory of that same poor man.

chinese: 我就說，智慧勝過勇力；然而那貧窮人的智慧被人藐視，他的話也無人聽從。
english: Then I said, Wisdom is better than strength, but the poor man's wisdom is not respected, and his words are not given a hearing.

chinese: 寧可在安靜之中聽智慧人的言語，不聽掌管愚昧人的喊聲。
english: The words of the wise which come quietly to the ear are noted more than the cry of a ruler among the foolish.

chinese: 智慧勝過打仗的兵器；但一個罪人能敗壞許多善事。
english: Wisdom is better than instruments of war, but one sinner is the destruction of much good.

chinese: 死蒼蠅使做香的膏油發出臭氣；這樣，一點愚昧也能敗壞智慧和尊榮。
english: Dead flies make the oil of the perfumer give out an evil smell; more valued is a little wisdom than the great glory of the foolish.

chinese: 智慧人的心居右；愚昧人的心居左。
english: The heart of the wise man goes in the right direction; but the heart of a foolish man in the wrong.

chinese: 並且愚昧人行路顯出無知，對眾人說，他是愚昧人。
english: And when the foolish man is walking in the way, he has no sense and lets everyone see that he is foolish.

chinese: 掌權者的心若向你發怒，不要離開你的本位，因為柔和能免大過。
english: If the wrath of the ruler is against you, keep in your place; in him who keeps quiet even great sins may be overlooked.

chinese: 我見日光之下有一件禍患，似乎出於掌權的錯誤，
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, like an error which comes by chance from a ruler:

chinese: 就是愚昧人立在高位；富足人坐在低位。
english: The foolish are placed in high positions, but men of wealth are kept low.

chinese: 我見過僕人騎馬，王子像僕人在地上步行。
english: I have seen servants on horses, and rulers walking on the earth as servants.

chinese: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中；拆牆垣的，必為蛇所咬。
english: He who makes a hole for others will himself go into it, and for him who makes a hole through a wall the bite of a snake will be a punishment.

chinese: 鑿開（或譯：挪移）石頭的，必受損傷；劈開木頭的，必遭危險。
english: He who gets out stones from the earth will be damaged by them, and in the cutting of wood there is danger.

chinese: 鐵器鈍了，若不將刃磨快，就必多費氣力；但得智慧指教，便有益處。
english: If the iron has no edge, and he does not make it sharp, then he has to put out more strength; but wisdom makes things go well.

chinese: 未行法術以先，蛇若咬人，後行法術也是無益。
english: If a snake gives a bite before the word of power is said, then there is no longer any use in the word of power.

chinese: 智慧人的口說出恩言；愚昧人的嘴吞滅自己。
english: The words of a wise man's mouth are sweet to all, but the lips of a foolish man are his destruction.

chinese: 他口中的言語起頭是愚昧；他話的末尾是奸惡的狂妄。
english: The first words of his mouth are foolish, and the end of his talk is evil crime.

chinese: 愚昧人多有言語，人卻不知將來有甚麼事；他身後的事誰能告訴他呢？
english: The foolish are full of words; man has no knowledge of what will be; and who is able to say what will be after him?

chinese: 凡愚昧人，他的勞碌使自己困乏，因為連進城的路，他也不知道。
english: The work of the foolish will be a weariness to him, because he has no knowledge of the way to the town.

chinese: 邦國啊，你的王若是孩童，你的群臣早晨宴樂，你就有禍了！
english: Unhappy is the land whose king is a boy, and whose rulers are feasting in the morning.

chinese: 邦國啊，你的王若是貴冑之子，你的群臣按時吃喝，為要補力，不為酒醉，你就有福了！
english: Happy is the land whose ruler is of noble birth, and whose chiefs take food at the right time, for strength and not for feasting.

chinese: 因人懶惰，房頂塌下；因人手懶，房屋滴漏。
english: When no work is done the roof goes in, and when the hands do nothing water comes into the house.

chinese: 設擺筵席是為喜笑。酒能使人快活；錢能叫萬事應心。
english: A feast is for laughing, and wine makes glad the heart; but by the one and the other money is wasted.

chinese: 你不可咒詛君王，也不可心懷此念；在你臥房也不可咒詛富戶。因為空中的鳥必傳揚這聲音，有翅膀的也必述說這事。
english: Say not a curse against the king, even in your thoughts; and even secretly say not a curse against the man of wealth; because a bird of the air will take the voice, and that which has wings will give news of it.

chinese: 當將你的糧食撒在水面，因為日久必能得著。
english: Put out your bread on the face of the waters; for after a long time it will come back to you again.

chinese: 你要分給七人，或分給八人，因為你不知道將來有甚麼災禍臨到地上。
english: Give a part to seven or even to eight, because you have no knowledge of the evil which will be on the earth.

chinese: 雲若滿了雨，就必傾倒在地上。樹若向南倒，或向北倒，樹倒在何處，就存在何處。
english: If the clouds are full of rain, they send it down on the earth; and if a tree comes down to the south, or the north, in whatever place it comes down, there it will be.

chinese: 看風的，必不撒種；望雲的，必不收割。
english: He who is watching the wind will not get the seed planted, and he who is looking at the clouds will not get in the grain.

chinese: 風從何道來，骨頭在懷孕婦人的胎中如何長成，你尚且不得知道；這樣，行萬事之神的作為，你更不得知道。
english: As you have no knowledge of the way of the wind, or of the growth of the bones in the body of her who is with child, even so you have no knowledge of the works of God who has made all.

chinese: 早晨要撒你的種，晚上也不要歇你的手，因為你不知道哪一樣發旺；或是早撒的，或是晚撒的，或是兩樣都好。
english: In the morning put your seed into the earth, and till the evening let not your hand be at rest; because you are not certain which will do well, this or that--or if the two will be equally good.

chinese: 光本是佳美的，眼見日光也是可悅的。
english: Truly the light is sweet, and it is good for the eyes to see the sun.

chinese: 人活多年，就當快樂多年；然而也當想到黑暗的日子。因為這日子必多，所要來的都是虛空。
english: But even if a man's life is long and he has joy in all his years, let him keep in mind the dark days, because they will be great in number. Whatever may come is to no purpose.

chinese: 少年人哪，你在幼年時當快樂。在幼年的日子，使你的心歡暢，行你心所願行的，看你眼所愛看的；卻要知道，為這一切的事，神必審問你。
english: Have joy, O young man, while you are young; and let your heart be glad in the days of your strength, and go in the ways of your heart, and in the desire of your eyes; but be certain that for all these things God will be your judge.

chinese: 所以，你當從心中除掉愁煩，從肉體克去邪惡；因為一生的開端和幼年之時，都是虛空的。
english: So put away trouble from your heart, and sorrow from your flesh; because the early years and the best years are to no purpose.

chinese: 你趁著年幼、衰敗的日子尚未來到，就是你所說，我毫無喜樂的那些年日未曾臨近之先，當記念造你的主。
english: Let your mind be turned to your Maker in the days of your strength, while the evil days come not, and the years are far away when you will say, I have no pleasure in them;

chinese: 不要等到日頭、光明、月亮、星宿變為黑暗，雨後雲彩反回，
english: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, are not dark, and the clouds come not back after the rain;

chinese: 看守房屋的發顫，有力的屈身，推磨的稀少就止息，從窗戶往外看的都昏暗；
english: In the day when the keepers of the house are shaking for fear, and the strong men are bent down, and the women who were crushing the grain are at rest because their number is small, and those looking out of the windows are unable to see;

chinese: 街門關閉，推磨的響聲微小，雀鳥一叫，人就起來，唱歌的女子也都衰微。
english: When the doors are shut in the street, and the sound of the crushing is low, and the voice of the bird is soft, and the daughters of music will be made low;

chinese: 人怕高處，路上有驚慌，杏樹開花，蚱蜢成為重擔，人所願的也都廢掉；因為人歸他永遠的家，弔喪的在街上往來。
english: And he is in fear of that which is high, and danger is in the road, and the tree is white with flower, and the least thing is a weight, and desire is at an end, because man goes to his last resting-place, and those who are sorrowing are in the streets;

chinese: 銀鍊折斷，金罐破裂，瓶子在泉旁損壞，水輪在井口破爛，
english: Before ever the silver cord is cut, or the vessel of gold is broken, or the pot is broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the water-hole;

chinese: 塵土仍歸於地，靈仍歸於賜靈的神。
english: And the dust goes back to the earth as it was, and the spirit goes back to God who gave it.

chinese: 傳道者說：虛空的虛空，凡事都是虛空。
english: All things are to no purpose, says the Preacher, all is to no purpose.

chinese: 再者，傳道者因有智慧，仍將知識教訓眾人；又默想，又考查，又陳說許多箴言。
english: And because the Preacher was wise he still gave the people knowledge; searching out, testing, and putting in order a great number of wise sayings.

chinese: 傳道者專心尋求可喜悅的言語，是憑正直寫的誠實話。
english: The Preacher made search for words which were pleasing, but his writing was in words upright and true.

chinese: 智慧人的言語好像刺棍；會中之師的言語又像釘穩的釘子，都是一個牧者所賜的。
english: The words of the wise are pointed, and sayings grouped together are like nails fixed with a hammer; they are given by one guide.

chinese: 我兒，還有一層，你當受勸戒：著書多，沒有窮盡；讀書多，身體疲倦。
english: And further, my son, take note of this: of the making of books there is no end, and much learning is a weariness to the flesh.

chinese: 這些事都已聽見了，總意就是：敬畏神，謹守他的誡命，這是人所當盡的本分（或譯：這是眾人的本分）。
english: This is the last word. All has been said. Have fear of God and keep his laws; because this is right for every man.

chinese: 因為人所做的事，連一切隱藏的事，無論是善是惡，神都必審問。
english: God will be judge of every work, with every secret thing, good or evil.

chinese: 所羅門的歌，是歌中的雅歌。（新娘）
english: The song of Songs, which is Solomon's.

chinese: 願他用口與我親嘴；因你的愛情比酒更美。
english: Let him give me the kisses of his mouth: for his love is better than wine.

chinese: 你的膏油馨香；你的名如同倒出來的香膏，所以眾童女都愛你。
english: Sweet is the smell of your perfumes; your name is as perfume running out; so the young girls give you their love.

chinese: 願你吸引我，我們就快跑跟隨你。王帶我進了內室，我們必因你歡喜快樂。我們要稱讚你的愛情，勝似稱讚美酒。他們愛你是理所當然的。
english: Take me to you, and we will go after you: the king has taken me into his house. We will be glad and full of joy in you, we will give more thought to your love than to wine: rightly are they your lovers.

chinese: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我雖然黑，卻是秀美，如同基達的帳棚，好像所羅門的幔子。
english: I am dark, but fair of form, O daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

chinese: 不要因日頭把我曬黑了就輕看我。我同母的弟兄向我發怒，他們使我看守葡萄園；我自己的葡萄園卻沒有看守。
english: Let not your eyes be turned on me, because I am dark, because I was looked on by the sun; my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vine-gardens; but my vine-garden I have not kept.

chinese: 我心所愛的啊，求你告訴我，你在何處牧羊？晌午在何處使羊歇臥？我何必在你同伴的羊群旁邊好像蒙著臉的人呢？（新郎）
english: Say, O love of my soul, where you give food to your flock, and where you make them take their rest in the heat of the day; why have I to be as one wandering by the flocks of your friends?

chinese: 你這女子中極美麗的，你若不知道，只管跟隨羊群的腳蹤去，把你的山羊羔牧放在牧人帳棚的旁邊。
english: If you have not knowledge, O most beautiful among women, go on your way in the footsteps of the flock, and give your young goats food by the tents of the keepers.

chinese: 我的佳偶，我將你比法老車上套的駿馬。
english: I have made a comparison of you, O my love, to a horse in Pharaoh's carriages.

chinese: 你的兩腮因髮辮而秀美；你的頸項因珠串而華麗。
english: Your face is a delight with rings of hair, your neck with chains of jewels.

chinese: 我們要為你編上金辮，鑲上銀釘。（新娘）
english: We will make you chains of gold with ornaments of silver.

chinese: 王正坐席的時候，我的哪噠香膏發出香味。
english: While the king is seated at his table, my spices send out their perfume.

chinese: 我以我的良人為一袋沒藥，常在我懷中。
english: As a bag of myrrh is my well-loved one to me, when he is at rest all night between my breasts.

chinese: 我以我的良人為一棵鳳仙花，在隱基底葡萄園中。（新郎）
english: My love is to me as a branch of the cypress-tree in the vine-gardens of En-gedi.

chinese: 我的佳偶，你甚美麗！你甚美麗！你的眼好像鴿子眼。（新娘）
english: See, you are fair, my love, you are fair; you have the eyes of a dove.

chinese: 我的良人哪，你甚美麗可愛！我們以青草為床榻，
english: See, you are fair, my loved one, and a pleasure; our bed is green.

chinese: 以香柏樹為房屋的棟梁，以松樹為椽子。
english: Cedar-trees are the pillars of our house; and our boards are made of fir-trees.

chinese: 我是沙崙的玫瑰花（或譯：水仙花），是谷中的百合花。（新郎）
english: I am a rose of Sharon, a flower of the valleys.

chinese: 我的佳偶在女子中，好像百合花在荊棘內。（新娘）
english: As the lily-flower among the thorns of the waste, so is my love among the daughters.

chinese: 我的良人在男子中，如同蘋果樹在樹林中。我歡歡喜喜坐在他的蔭下，嘗他果子的滋味，覺得甘甜。
english: As the apple-tree among the trees of the wood, so is my loved one among the sons. I took my rest under his shade with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.

chinese: 他帶我入筵宴所，以愛為旗在我以上。
english: He took me to the house of wine, and his flag over me was love.

chinese: 求你們給我葡萄乾增補我力，給我蘋果暢快我心，因我思愛成病。
english: Make me strong with wine-cakes, let me be comforted with apples; I am overcome with love.

chinese: 他的左手在我頭下；他的右手將我抱住。
english: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand is round about me.

chinese: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我指著羚羊或田野的母鹿囑咐你們：不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的，等他自己情願（不要叫醒……情願：或譯不要激動愛情，等他自發）。
english: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes of the field, do not let love be moved till it is ready.

chinese: 聽啊！是我良人的聲音；看哪！他躥山越嶺而來。
english: The voice of my loved one! See, he comes dancing on the mountains, stepping quickly on the hills.

chinese: 我的良人好像羚羊，或像小鹿。他站在我們牆壁後，從窗戶往裡觀看，從窗櫺往裡窺探。
english: My loved one is like a roe; see, he is on the other side of our wall, he is looking in at the windows, letting himself be seen through the spaces.

chinese: 我良人對我說：（新郎）我的佳偶，我的美人，起來，與我同去！
english: My loved one said to me, Get up, my love, my fair one, and come away.

chinese: 因為冬天已往，雨水止住過去了。
english: For, see, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

chinese: 地上百花開放，百鳥鳴叫的時候（或譯：修理葡萄樹的時候）已經來到；斑鳩的聲音在我們境內也聽見了。
english: The flowers are come on the earth; the time of cutting the vines is come, and the voice of the dove is sounding in our land;

chinese: 無花果樹的果子漸漸成熟；葡萄樹開花放香。我的佳偶，我的美人，起來，與我同去！
english: The fig-tree puts out her green fruit and the vines with their young fruit give a good smell. Get up from your bed, my beautiful one, and come away.

chinese: 我的鴿子啊，你在磐石穴中，在陡巖的隱密處。求你容我得見你的面貌，得聽你的聲音；因為你的聲音柔和，你的面貌秀美。
english: O my dove, you are in the holes of the mountain sides, in the cracks of the high hills; let me see your face, let your voice come to my ears; for sweet is your voice, and your face is fair.

chinese: 要給我們擒拿狐狸，就是毀壞葡萄園的小狐狸，因為我們的葡萄正在開花。（新娘）
english: Take for us the foxes, the little foxes, which do damage to the vines; our vines have young grapes.

chinese: 良人屬我，我也屬他；他在百合花中牧放群羊。
english: My loved one is mine, and I am his: he takes his food among the flowers.

chinese: 我的良人哪，求你等到天起涼風、日影飛去的時候，你要轉回，好像羚羊，或像小鹿在比特山上。
english: Till the evening comes, and the sky slowly becomes dark, come, my loved one, and be like a roe on the mountains of Bether.

chinese: 我夜間躺臥在床上，尋找我心所愛的；我尋找他，卻尋不見。
english: By night on my bed I was looking for him who is the love of my soul: I was looking for him, but I did not see him.

chinese: 我說：我要起來，遊行城中，在街市上，在寬闊處，尋找我心所愛的。我尋找他，卻尋不見。
english: I will get up now and go about the town, in the streets and in the wide ways I will go after him who is the love of my soul: I went after him, but I did not see him.

chinese: 城中巡邏看守的人遇見我；我問他們：你們看見我心所愛的沒有？
english: The watchmen who go about the town came by me; to them I said, Have you seen him who is my heart's desire?

chinese: 我剛離開他們就遇見我心所愛的。我拉住他，不容他走，領他入我母家，到懷我者的內室。
english: I was but a little way from them, when I came face to face with him who is the love of my soul. I took him by the hands, and did not let him go, till I had taken him into my mother's house, and into the room of her who gave me birth.

chinese: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我指著羚羊或田野的母鹿囑咐你們：不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的，等他自己情願（不要叫醒……情願：或譯不要激動愛情，等他自發）。
english: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes of the field, let not love be moved till it is ready.

chinese: 那從曠野上來、形狀如煙柱、以沒藥和乳香並商人各樣香粉薰的是誰呢？
english: Who is this coming out of the waste places like pillars of smoke, perfumed with sweet spices, with all the spices of the trader?

chinese: 看哪，是所羅門的轎；四圍有六十個勇士，都是以色列中的勇士；
english: See, it is the bed of Solomon; sixty men of war are about it, of the army of Israel,

chinese: 手都持刀，善於爭戰，腰間佩刀，防備夜間有驚慌。
english: All of them armed with swords, trained in war; every man has his sword at his side, because of fear in the night.

chinese: 所羅門王用利巴嫩木為自己製造一乘華轎。
english: King Solomon made himself a bed of the wood of Lebanon.

chinese: 轎柱是用銀做的，轎底是用金做的；坐墊是紫色的，其中所鋪的乃耶路撒冷眾女子的愛情。
english: He made its pillars of silver, its base of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it of ebony.

chinese: 錫安的眾女子啊，你們出去觀看所羅門王！頭戴冠冕，就是在他婚筵的日子、心中喜樂的時候，他母親給他戴上的。
english: Go out, O daughters of Jerusalem, and see King Solomon, with the crown which his mother put on his head on the day when he was married, and on the day of the joy of his heart.

chinese: 我的佳偶，你甚美麗！你甚美麗！你的眼在帕子內好像鴿子眼。你的頭髮如同山羊群臥在基列山旁。
english: See, you are fair, my love, you are fair; you have the eyes of a dove; your hair is as a flock of goats, which take their rest on the side of Gilead.

chinese: 你的牙齒如新剪毛的一群母羊，洗淨上來，個個都有雙生，沒有一隻喪掉子的。
english: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep whose wool is newly cut, which come up from the washing; every one has two lambs, and there is not one without young.

chinese: 你的唇好像一條朱紅線；你的嘴也秀美。你的兩太陽在帕子內，如同一塊石榴。
english: Your red lips are like a bright thread, and your mouth is fair of form; the sides of your head are like pomegranate fruit under your veil.

chinese: 你的頸項好像大衛建造收藏軍器的高臺，其上懸掛一千盾牌，都是勇士的籐牌。
english: Your neck is like the tower of David made for a store-house of arms, in which a thousand breastplates are hanging, breastplates for fighting-men.

chinese: 你的兩乳好像百合花中吃草的一對小鹿，就是母鹿雙生的。
english: Your two breasts are like two young roes of the same birth, which take their food among the lilies.

chinese: 我要往沒藥山和乳香岡去，直等到天起涼風、日影飛去的時候回來。
english: Till the evening comes, and the sky slowly becomes dark, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.

chinese: 我的佳偶，你全然美麗，毫無瑕疵！
english: You are all fair, my love; there is no mark on you.

chinese: 我的新婦，求你與我一同離開利巴嫩，與我一同離開利巴嫩。從亞瑪拿頂，從示尼珥與黑門頂，從有獅子的洞，從有豹子的山往下觀看。
english: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon; see from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the places of the lions, from the mountains of the leopards.

chinese: 我妹子，我新婦，你奪了我的心。你用眼一看，用你項上的一條金鍊，奪了我的心！
english: You have taken away my heart, my sister, my bride; you have taken away my heart, with one look you have taken it, with one chain of your neck!

chinese: 我妹子，我新婦，你的愛情何其美！你的愛情比酒更美！你膏油的香氣勝過一切香品！
english: How fair is your love, my sister! How much better is your love than wine, and the smell of your oils than any perfume!

chinese: 我新婦，你的嘴唇滴蜜，好像蜂房滴蜜；你的舌下有蜜，有奶。你衣服的香氣如利巴嫩的香氣。
english: Your lips are dropping honey; honey and milk are under your tongue; and the smell of your clothing is like the smell of Lebanon.

chinese: 我妹子，我新婦，乃是關鎖的園，禁閉的井，封閉的泉源。
english: A garden walled-in is my sister, my bride; a garden shut up, a spring of water stopped.

chinese: 你園內所種的結了石榴，有佳美的果子，並鳳仙花與哪噠樹。
english: The produce of the garden is pomegranates; with all the best fruits, henna and spikenard,

chinese: 有哪噠和番紅花，菖蒲和桂樹，並各樣乳香木、沒藥、沉香，與一切上等的果品。
english: Spikenard and safron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices.

chinese: 你是園中的泉，活水的井，從利巴嫩流下來的溪水。（新娘）
english: You are a fountain of gardens, a spring of living waters, and flowing waters from Lebanon.

chinese: 北風啊，興起！南風啊，吹來！吹在我的園內，使其中的香氣發出來。願我的良人進入自己園裡，吃他佳美的果子。
english: Be awake, O north wind; and come, O south, blowing on my garden, so that its spices may come out. Let my loved one come into his garden, and take of his good fruits.

chinese: 我妹子，我新婦，我進了我的園中，採了我的沒藥和香料，吃了我的蜜房和蜂蜜，喝了我的酒和奶。（耶路撒冷的眾女子）我的朋友們，請吃！我所親愛的，請喝，且多多地喝！
english: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride; to take my myrrh with my spice; my wax with my honey; my wine with my milk. Take meat, O friends; take wine, yes, be overcome with love.

chinese: 我身睡臥，我心卻醒。這是我良人的聲音；他敲門說：（新郎）我的妹子，我的佳偶，我的鴿子，我的完全人，求你給我開門；因我的頭滿了露水，我的頭髮被夜露滴濕。（新娘）
english: I am sleeping, but my heart is awake; it is the sound of my loved one at the door, saying, Be open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my very beautiful one; my head is wet with dew, and my hair with the drops of the night.

chinese: 我回答說：我脫了衣裳，怎能再穿上呢？我洗了腳，怎能再玷污呢？
english: I have put off my coat; how may I put it on? My feet are washed; how may I make them unclean?

chinese: 我的良人從門孔裡伸進手來，我便因他動了心。
english: My loved one put his hand on the door, and my heart was moved for him.

chinese: 我起來，要給我良人開門。我的兩手滴下沒藥；我的指頭有沒藥汁滴在門閂上。
english: I got up to let my loved one in; and my hands were dropping with myrrh, and my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the lock of the door.

chinese: 我給我的良人開了門；我的良人卻已轉身走了。他說話的時候，我神不守舍；我尋找他，竟尋不見；我呼叫他，他卻不回答。
english: I made the door open to my loved one; but my loved one had taken himself away, and was gone, my soul was feeble when his back was turned on me; I went after him, but I did not come near him; I said his name, but he gave me no answer.

chinese: 城中巡邏看守的人遇見我，打了我，傷了我；看守城牆的人奪去我的披肩。
english: The keepers who go about the town overtook me; they gave me blows and wounds; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.

chinese: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我囑咐你們：若遇見我的良人，要告訴他，我因思愛成病。（耶路撒冷的眾女子）
english: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if you see my loved one, what will you say to him? That I am overcome with love.

chinese: 你這女子中極美麗的，你的良人比別人的良人有何強處？你的良人比別人的良人有何強處，你就這樣囑咐我們？（新娘）
english: What is your loved one more than another, O fairest among women? What is your loved one more than another, that you say this to us?

chinese: 我的良人白而且紅，超乎萬人之上。
english: My loved one is white and red, the chief among ten thousand.

chinese: 他的頭像至精的金子；他的頭髮厚密纍垂，黑如烏鴉。
english: His head is as the most delicate gold; his hair is thick, and black as a raven.

chinese: 他的眼如溪水旁的鴿子眼，用奶洗淨，安得合式。
english: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the water streams, washed with milk, and rightly placed.

chinese: 他的兩腮如香花畦，如香草臺；他的嘴唇像百合花，且滴下沒藥汁。
english: His face is as beds of spices, giving out perfumes of every sort; his lips like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.

chinese: 他的兩手好像金管，鑲嵌水蒼玉；他的身體如同雕刻的象牙，周圍鑲嵌藍寶石。
english: His hands are as rings of gold ornamented with beryl-stones; his body is as a smooth plate of ivory covered with sapphires.

chinese: 他的腿好像白玉石柱，安在精金座上；他的形狀如利巴嫩，且佳美如香柏樹。
english: His legs are as pillars of stone on a base of delicate gold; his looks are as Lebanon, beautiful as the cedar-tree.

chinese: 他的口極其甘甜；他全然可愛。耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，這是我的良人；這是我的朋友。
english: His mouth is most sweet; yes, he is all beautiful. This is my loved one, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.

chinese: 你這女子中極美麗的，你的良人往何處去了？你的良人轉向何處去了，我們好與你同去尋找他。（新娘）
english: Where is your loved one gone, O most fair among women? Where is your loved one turned away, that we may go looking for him with you?

chinese: 我的良人下入自己園中，到香花畦，在園內牧放群羊，採百合花。
english: My loved one is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to take food in the gardens, and to get lilies.

chinese: 我屬我的良人，我的良人也屬我；他在百合花中牧放群羊。
english: I am for my loved one, and my loved one is for me; he takes food among the lilies.

chinese: 我的佳偶啊，你美麗如得撒，秀美如耶路撒冷，威武如展開旌旗的軍隊。
english: You are beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, as fair as Jerusalem; you are to be feared like an army with flags.

chinese: 求你掉轉眼目不看我，因你的眼目使我驚亂。你的頭髮如同山羊群臥在基列山旁。
english: Let your eyes be turned away from me; see, they have overcome me; your hair is as a flock of goats which take their rest on the side of Gilead.

chinese: 你的牙齒如一群母羊洗淨上來，個個都有雙生，沒有一隻喪掉子的。
english: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep which come up from the washing; every one has two lambs, and there is not one without young.

chinese: 你的兩太陽在帕子內，如同一塊石榴。
english: Like pomegranate fruit are the sides of your head under your veil.

chinese: 有六十王后八十妃嬪，並有無數的童女。
english: There are sixty queens, and eighty servant-wives, and young girls without number.

chinese: 我的鴿子，我的完全人，只有這一個是他母親獨生的，是生養他者所寶愛的。眾女子見了就稱他有福；王后妃嬪見了也讚美他。
english: My dove, my very beautiful one, is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the dearest one of her who gave her birth. The daughters saw her, and gave her a blessing; yes, the queens and the servant-wives, and they gave her praises.

chinese: 那向外觀看、如晨光發現、美麗如月亮、皎潔如日頭、威武如展開旌旗軍隊的是誰呢？
english: Who is she, looking down as the morning light, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, who is to be feared like an army with flags?

chinese: 我下入核桃園，要看谷中青綠的植物，要看葡萄發芽沒有，石榴開花沒有。
english: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the green plants of the valley, and to see if the vine was in bud, and the pomegranate-trees were in flower.

chinese: 不知不覺，我的心將我安置在我尊長的車中。（耶路撒冷的眾女子）
english: Before I was conscious of it, ...

chinese: 回來，回來，書拉密女；你回來，你回來，使我們得觀看你。（新娘）你們為何要觀看書拉密女，像觀看瑪哈念跳舞的呢？
english: Come back, come back, O Shulammite; come back, come back, so that our eyes may see you. What will you see in the Shulammite? A sword-dance.

chinese: 王女啊，你的腳在鞋中何其美好！你的大腿圓潤，好像美玉，是巧匠的手做成的。
english: How beautiful are your feet in their shoes, O king's daughter! The curves of your legs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a good workman:

chinese: 你的肚臍如圓杯，不缺調和的酒；你的腰如一堆麥子，周圍有百合花。
english: Your stomach is a store of grain with lilies round it, and in the middle a round cup full of wine.

chinese: 你的兩乳好像一對小鹿，就是母鹿雙生的。
english: Your two breasts are like two young roes of the same birth.

chinese: 你的頸項如象牙臺；你的眼目像希實本、巴特拉併門旁的水池；你的鼻子彷彿朝大馬色的利巴嫩塔。
english: Your neck is as a tower of ivory; your eyes like the waters in Heshbon, by the doorway of Bath-rabbim; your nose is as the tower on Lebanon looking over Damascus:

chinese: 你的頭在你身上好像迦密山；你頭上的髮是紫黑色；王的心因這下垂的髮綹繫住了。
english: Your head is like Carmel, and the hair of your head is like purple, in whose net the king is prisoner.

chinese: 我所愛的，你何其美好！何其可悅，使人歡暢喜樂！
english: How beautiful and how sweet you are, O love, for delight.

chinese: 你的身量好像棕樹；你的兩乳如同其上的果子，纍纍下垂。
english: You are tall like a palm-tree, and your breasts are like the fruit of the vine.

chinese: 我說：我要上這棕樹，抓住枝子。願你的兩乳好像葡萄纍纍下垂，你鼻子的氣味香如蘋果；
english: I said, Let me go up the palm-tree, and let me take its branches in my hands: your breasts will be as the fruit of the vine, and the smell of your breath like apples;

chinese: 你的口如上好的酒。（新娘）女子說：為我的良人下咽舒暢，流入睡覺人的嘴中。
english: And the roof of your mouth like good wine flowing down smoothly for my loved one, moving gently over my lips and my teeth.

chinese: 我屬我的良人，他也戀慕我。
english: I am for my loved one, and his desire is for me.

chinese: 我的良人，來吧！你我可以往田間去；你我可以在村莊住宿。
english: Come, my loved one, let us go out into the field; let us take rest among the cypress-trees.

chinese: 我們早晨起來往葡萄園去，看看葡萄發芽開花沒有，石榴放蕊沒有；我在那裡要將我的愛情給你。
english: Let us go out early to the vine-gardens; let us see if the vine is in bud, if it has put out its young fruit, and the pomegranate is in flower. There I will give you my love.

chinese: 風茄放香，在我們的門內有各樣新陳佳美的果子；我的良人，這都是我為你存留的。
english: The mandrakes give out a sweet smell, and at our doors are all sorts of good fruits, new and old, which I have kept for my loved one.

chinese: 巴不得你像我的兄弟，像吃我母親奶的兄弟；我在外頭遇見你就與你親嘴，誰也不輕看我。
english: Oh that you were my brother, who took milk from my mother's breasts! When I came to you in the street, I would give you kisses; yes, I would not be looked down on.

chinese: 我必引導你，領你進我母親的家；我可以領受教訓，也就使你喝石榴汁釀的香酒。
english: I would take you by the hand into my mother's house, and she would be my teacher. I would give you drink of spiced wine, drink of the pomegranate.

chinese: 他的左手必在我頭下；他的右手必將我抱住。
english: His left hand would be under my head, and his right hand about me.

chinese: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我囑咐你們：不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的，等他自己情願（不要叫醒……情願：或譯不要激動愛情，等他自發）。
english: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, do not let love be moved till it is ready.

chinese: 那靠著良人從曠野上來是誰呢？（新娘）我在蘋果樹下叫醒你。你母親在的那裡為你劬勞；生養你的在那裡為你劬勞。
english: Who is this, who comes up from the waste places, resting on her loved one? It was I who made you awake under the apple-tree, where your mother gave you birth; there she was in pain at your birth.

chinese: 求你將我放在你心上如印記，帶在你臂上如戳記。因為愛情如死之堅強，嫉恨如陰間之殘忍；所發的電光是火焰的電光，是耶和華的烈焰。
english: Put me as a sign on your heart, as a sign on your arm; love is strong as death, and wrath bitter as the underworld: its coals are coals of fire; violent are its flames.

chinese: 愛情，眾水不能息滅，大水也不能淹沒。若有人拿家中所有的財寶要換愛情，就全被藐視。（新娘的兄弟）
english: Much water may not put out love, or the deep waters overcome it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would be judged a price not great enough.

chinese: 我們有一小妹；他的兩乳尚未長成，人來提親的日子，我們當為他怎樣辦理？
english: We have a young sister, and she has no breasts; what are we to do for our sister in the day when she is given to a man?

chinese: 他若是牆，我們要在其上建造銀塔；他若是門，我們要用香柏木板圍護他。（新娘）
english: If she is a wall, we will make on her a strong base of silver; and if she is a door, we will let her be shut up with cedar-wood.

chinese: 我是牆；我兩乳像其上的樓。那時，我在他眼中像得平安的人。（新郎）
english: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers; then was I in his eyes as one to whom good chance had come.

chinese: 所羅門在巴力哈們有一葡萄園；他將這葡萄園交給看守的人，為其中的果子必交一千舍客勒銀子。
english: Solomon had a vine-garden at Baal-hamon; he let out the vine-garden to keepers; every one had to give a thousand bits of silver for its fruit.

chinese: 我自己的葡萄園在我面前。所羅門哪，一千舍客勒歸你，二百舍客勒歸看守果子的人。
english: My vine-garden, which is mine, is before me: you, O Solomon, will have the thousand, and those who keep the fruit of them two hundred.

chinese: 你這住在園中的，同伴都要聽你的聲音，求你使我也得聽見。（新娘）
english: You who have your resting-place in the gardens, the friends give ear to your voice; make me give ear to it.

chinese: 我的良人哪，求你快來！如羚羊或小鹿在香草山上。
english: Come quickly, my loved one, and be like a roe on the mountains of spice.

chinese: 當烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家作猶大王的時候，亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論到猶大和耶路撒冷。
english: The vision of Isaiah, the son of Amoz, which he saw about Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

chinese: 天哪，要聽！地啊，側耳而聽！因為耶和華說：我養育兒女，將他們養大，他們竟悖逆我。
english: Give ear, O heavens, and you, O earth, to the word which the Lord has said: I have taken care of my children till they became men, but their hearts have been turned away from me.

chinese: 牛認識主人，驢認識主人的槽，以色列卻不認識；我的民卻不留意。
english: Even the ox has knowledge of its owner, and the ass of the place where its master puts its food: but Israel has no knowledge, my people give no thought to me.

chinese: 嗐！犯罪的國民，擔著罪孽的百姓；行惡的種類，敗壞的兒女！他們離棄耶和華，藐視以色列的聖者，與他生疏，往後退步。
english: O nation full of sin, a people weighted down with crime, a generation of evil-doers, false-hearted children: they have gone away from the Lord, they have no respect for the Holy One of Israel, their hearts are turned back from him.

chinese: 你們為甚麼屢次悖逆，還要受責打嗎？你們已經滿頭疼痛，全心發昏。
english: Why will you have more and more punishment? why keep on in your evil ways? Every head is tired and every heart is feeble.

chinese: 從腳掌到頭頂，沒有一處完全的，盡是傷口、青腫，與新打的傷痕，都沒有收口，沒有纏裹，也沒有用膏滋潤。
english: The body, from head to foot, is all diseased; it is a mass of open wounds, marks of blows, and broken flesh: the flow of blood has not been stopped, and no oil has been put on the wounds.

chinese: 你們的地土已經荒涼；你們的城邑被火焚燬。你們的田地在你們眼前為外邦人所侵吞，既被外邦人傾覆就成為荒涼。
english: Your country has become waste; your towns are burned with fire; as for your land, it is overturned before your eyes, made waste and overcome by men from strange lands.

chinese: 僅存錫安城（原文是女子），好像葡萄園的草棚，瓜田的茅屋，被圍困的城邑。
english: And the daughter of Zion has become like a tent in a vine-garden, like a watchman's house in a field of fruit, like a town shut in by armies.

chinese: 若不是萬軍之耶和華給我們稍留餘種，我們早已像所多瑪、蛾摩拉的樣子了。
english: If the Lord of armies had not kept some at least of us safe, we would have been like Sodom, and the fate of Gomorrah would have been ours.

chinese: 你們這所多瑪的官長啊，要聽耶和華的話！你們這蛾摩拉的百姓啊，要側耳聽我們神的訓誨！
english: Give ear to the word of the Lord, you rulers of Sodom; let your hearts be turned to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah.

chinese: 耶和華說：你們所獻的許多祭物與我何益呢？公綿羊的燔祭和肥畜的脂油，我已經夠了；公牛的血，羊羔的血，公山羊的血，我都不喜悅。
english: What use to me is the number of the offerings which you give me? says the Lord; your burned offerings of sheep, and the best parts of fat cattle, are a weariness to me; I take no pleasure in the blood of oxen, or of lambs, or of he-goats.

chinese: 你們來朝見我，誰向你們討這些，使你們踐踏我的院宇呢？
english: At whose request do you come before me, making my house unclean with your feet?

chinese: 你們不要再獻虛浮的供物。香品是我所憎惡的；月朔和安息日，並宣召的大會，也是我所憎惡的；作罪孽，又守嚴肅會，我也不能容忍。
english: Give me no more false offerings; the smoke of burning flesh is disgusting to me, so are your new moons and Sabbaths and your holy meetings.

chinese: 你們的月朔和節期，我心裡恨惡，我都以為麻煩；我擔當，便不耐煩。
english: Your new moons and your regular feasts are a grief to my soul: they are a weight in my spirit; I am crushed under them.

chinese: 你們舉手禱告，我必遮眼不看；就是你們多多地祈禱，我也不聽。你們的手都滿了殺人的血。
english: And when your hands are stretched out to me, my eyes will be turned away from you: even though you go on making prayers, I will not give ear: your hands are full of blood.

chinese: 你們要洗濯、自潔，從我眼前除掉你們的惡行，要止住作惡，
english: Be washed, make yourselves clean; put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes; let there be an end of sinning;

chinese: 學習行善，尋求公平，解救受欺壓的；給孤兒伸冤，為寡婦辨屈。
english: Take pleasure in well-doing; let your ways be upright, keep down the cruel, give a right decision for the child who has no father, see to the cause of the widow.

chinese: 耶和華說：你們來，我們彼此辯論。你們的罪雖像硃紅，必變成雪白；雖紅如丹顏，必白如羊毛。
english: Come now, and let us have an argument together, says the Lord: how may your sins which are red like blood be white as snow? how may their dark purple seem like wool?

chinese: 你們若甘心聽從，必吃地上的美物，
english: If you will give ear to my word and do it, the good things of the land will be yours;

chinese: 若不聽從，反倒悖逆，必被刀劍吞滅。這是耶和華親口說的。
english: But if your hearts are turned against me, I will send destruction on you by the sword; so the Lord has said.

chinese: 可歎，忠信的城變為妓女！從前充滿了公平，公義居在其中，現今卻有兇手居住。
english: The upright town has become untrue; there was a time when her judges gave right decisions, when righteousness had a resting-place in her, but now she is full of those who take men's lives.

chinese: 你的銀子變為渣滓；你的酒用水攙對。
english: Your silver is no longer true metal, your wine is mixed with water.

chinese: 你的官長居心悖逆，與盜賊作伴，各都喜愛賄賂，追求贓私。他們不為孤兒伸冤；寡婦的案件也不得呈到他們面前。
english: Your chiefs have gone against the Lord, they have become friends of thieves; every one of them is looking for profit and going after rewards; they do not give right decisions for the child who has no father, and they do not let the cause of the widow come before them.

chinese: 因此，主─萬軍之耶和華、以色列的大能者說：哎！我要向我的對頭雪恨，向我的敵人報仇。
english: For this reason the Lord, the Lord of armies, the Strong One of Israel, has said, I will put an end to my haters, and send punishment on those who are against me;

chinese: 我必反手加在你身上，煉盡你的渣滓，除淨你的雜質。
english: And my hand will again be on you, washing away what is unclean as with soap, and taking away all your false metal;

chinese: 我也必復還你的審判官，像起初一樣，復還你的謀士，像起先一般。然後，你必稱為公義之城，忠信之邑。
english: And I will give you judges again as at the first, and wise guides as in the past; then you will be named, The Town of Righteousness, the true town.

chinese: 錫安必因公平得蒙救贖；其中歸正的人必因公義得蒙救贖。
english: Upright acts will be the price of Zion's forgiveness, and by righteousness will men be living there.

chinese: 但悖逆的和犯罪的必一同敗亡；離棄耶和華的必致消滅。
english: But a common destruction will overtake sinners and evil-doers together, and those who have gone away from the Lord will be cut off.

chinese: 那等人必因你們所喜愛的橡樹抱愧；你們必因所選擇的園子蒙羞。
english: For you will be put to shame because of the trees of your desire, and because of the gardens of your pleasure.

chinese: 因為，你們必如葉子枯乾的橡樹，好像無水澆灌的園子。
english: For you will be like a tree whose leaves have become dry, and like a garden without water.

chinese: 有權勢的必如麻瓤；他的工作好像火星，都要一同焚燬，無人撲滅。
english: And the strong will be as food for the fire, and his work as a flame; and they will be burned together, with no one to put out the fire.

chinese: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論到猶大和耶路撒冷。
english: The word which Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saw about Judah and Jerusalem.

chinese: 末後的日子，耶和華殿的山必堅立，超乎諸山，高舉過於萬嶺；萬民都要流歸這山。
english: And it will come about in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord will be placed on the top of the mountains, and be lifted up over the hills; and all nations will come to it.

chinese: 必有許多國的民前往，說：來吧，我們登耶和華的山，奔雅各神的殿。主必將他的道教訓我們；我們也要行他的路。因為訓誨必出於錫安；耶和華的言語必出於耶路撒冷。
english: And the peoples will say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob: and he will give us knowledge of his ways, and we will be guided by his word; for out of Zion the law will go out, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

chinese: 他必在列國中施行審判，為許多國民斷定是非。他們要將刀打成犁頭，把槍打成鐮刀。這國不舉刀攻擊那國；他們也不再學習戰事。
english: And he will be the judge between the nations, and the peoples will be ruled by his decisions: and their swords will be turned into plough-blades, and their spears into vine-knives: no longer will the nations be turning their swords against one another, and the knowledge of war will be gone for ever.

chinese: 雅各家啊，來吧！我們在耶和華的光明中行走。
english: O family of Jacob, come, and let us go in the light of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華，你離棄了你百姓雅各家，是因他們充滿了東方的風俗，作觀兆的，像非利士人一樣，並與外邦人擊掌。
english: For you, O Lord, have given up your people, the family of Jacob, because they are full of the evil ways of the east, and make use of secret arts like the Philistines, and are friends with the children of strange countries.

chinese: 他們的國滿了金銀，財寶也無窮；他們的地滿了馬匹，車輛也無數。
english: And their land is full of silver and gold, and there is no end to their stores; their land is full of horses, and there is no end to their carriages.

chinese: 他們的地滿了偶像；他們跪拜自己手所造的，就是自己指頭所做的。
english: Their land is full of images; they give worship to the work of their hands, even to that which their fingers have made.

chinese: 卑賤人屈膝；尊貴人下跪；所以不可饒恕他們。
english: And the poor man's head is bent, and the great man goes down on his face: for this cause there will be no forgiveness for their sin.

chinese: 你當進入巖穴，藏在土中，躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
english: Go into a hole in the rock, covering yourselves with dust, in fear of the Lord, before the glory of his power.

chinese: 到那日，眼目高傲的必降為卑；性情狂傲的都必屈膝；惟獨耶和華被尊崇。
english: The high looks of man will be put to shame, and the pride of men will be made low, and only the Lord will be lifted up in that day.

chinese: 必有萬軍耶和華降罰的一個日子，要臨到驕傲狂妄的；一切自高的都必降為卑；
english: For the day of the Lord of armies is coming on all the pride of men, and on all who are high and lifted up;

chinese: 又臨到利巴嫩高大的香柏樹和巴珊的橡樹；
english: And on all the high trees of Lebanon, and on all the strong trees of Bashan;

chinese: 又臨到一切高山的峻嶺；
english: And on all the high mountains, and on all the hills which are lifted up;

chinese: 又臨到高臺和堅固城牆；
english: And on every high tower, and on every strong wall;

chinese: 又臨到他施的船隻並一切可愛的美物。
english: And on all the ships of Tarshish, and on all the fair boats.

chinese: 驕傲的必屈膝；狂妄的必降卑。在那日，惟獨耶和華被尊崇；
english: And the high looks of man will be put to shame, and the pride of men will be made low: and only the Lord will be lifted up in that day.

chinese: 偶像必全然廢棄。
english: And the images will never be seen again.

chinese: 耶和華興起，使地大震動的時候，人就進入石洞，進入土穴，躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
english: And men will go into cracks of the rocks, and into holes of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and before the glory of his power, when he comes out of his place, shaking the earth with his strength.

chinese: 到那日，人必將為拜而造的金偶像、銀偶像拋給田鼠和蝙蝠。
english: In that day men will put their images of silver and of gold, which they made for worship, in the keeping of the beasts of the dark places;

chinese: 到耶和華興起，使地大震動的時候，人好進入磐石洞中和巖石穴裡，躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
english: To take cover in the cracks of the rocks, and in the holes of the hills, for fear of the Lord, and before the glory of his power, when he comes out of his place, shaking the earth with his strength.

chinese: 你們休要倚靠世人。他鼻孔裡不過有氣息；他在一切事上可算甚麼呢？
english: Have no more to do with man, whose life is only a breath, for he is of no value.

chinese: 主─萬軍之耶和華從耶路撒冷和猶大，除掉眾人所倚靠的，所仗賴的，就是所倚靠的糧，所仗賴的水；
english: For the Lord, the Lord of armies, is about to take away from Jerusalem and from Judah all their support; their store of bread and of water;

chinese: 除掉勇士和戰士，審判官和先知，占卜的和長老，
english: The strong man and the man of war; the judge and the prophet; the man who has knowledge of secret arts, and the man who is wise because of his years;

chinese: 五十夫長和尊貴人，謀士和有巧藝的，以及妙行法術的。
english: The captain of fifty, and the man of high position, and the wise guide, and the wonder-worker, and he who makes use of secret powers.

chinese: 主說：我必使孩童作他們的首領，使嬰孩轄管他們。
english: And I will make children their chiefs, and foolish ones will have rule over them.

chinese: 百姓要彼此欺壓；各人受鄰舍的欺壓。少年人必侮慢老年人；卑賤人必侮慢尊貴人。
english: And the people will be crushed, every one by his neighbour; the young will be full of pride against the old, and those of low position will be lifted up against the noble.

chinese: 人在父家拉住弟兄，說：你有衣服，可以作我們的官長。這敗落的事歸在你手下吧！
english: When one man puts his hand on another in his father's house, and says, You have clothing, be our ruler and be responsible for us in our sad condition:

chinese: 那時，他必揚聲說：我不作醫治你們的人；因我家中沒有糧食，也沒有衣服，你們不可立我作百姓的官長。
english: Then he will say with an oath, I will not be a helper, for in my house there is no bread or clothing: I will not let you make me a ruler of the people.

chinese: 耶路撒冷敗落，猶大傾倒；因為他們的舌頭和行為與耶和華反對，惹了他榮光的眼目。
english: For Jerusalem has become feeble, and destruction has come on Judah, because their words and their acts are against the Lord, moving the eyes of his glory to wrath.

chinese: 他們的面色證明自己的不正；他們述說自己的罪惡，並不隱瞞，好像所多瑪一樣。他們有禍了！因為作惡自害。
english: Their respect for a man's position is a witness against them; and their sin is open to the view of all; like that of Sodom, it is not covered. A curse on their soul! for the measure of their sin is full.

chinese: 你們要論義人說：他必享福樂，因為要吃自己行為所結的果子。
english: Happy is the upright man! for he will have joy of the fruit of his ways.

chinese: 惡人有禍了！他必遭災難！因為要照自己手所行的受報應。
english: Unhappy is the sinner! for the reward of his evil doings will come on him.

chinese: 至於我的百姓，孩童欺壓他們，婦女轄管他們。我的百姓啊，引導你的使你走錯，並毀壞你所行的道路。
english: As for my people, their ruler is acting like a child, and those who have authority over them are women. O my people, your guides are the cause of your wandering, turning your footsteps out of the right way.

chinese: 耶和華起來辯論，站著審判眾民。
english: The Lord is ready to take up his cause against his people, and is about to come forward as their judge.

chinese: 耶和華必審問他民中的長老和首領，說：吃盡葡萄園果子的就是你們；向貧窮人所奪的都在你們家中。
english: The Lord comes to be the judge of their responsible men and of their rulers: it is you who have made waste the vine-garden, and in your houses is the property of the poor which you have taken by force.

chinese: 主─萬軍之耶和華說：你們為何壓制我的百姓，搓磨貧窮人的臉呢？
english: By what right are you crushing my people, and putting a bitter yoke on the necks of the poor? This is the word of the Lord, the Lord of armies.

chinese: 耶和華又說：因為錫安的女子狂傲，行走挺項，賣弄眼目，俏步徐行，腳下玎璫，
english: Again, the Lord has said, Because the daughters of Zion are full of pride, and go with outstretched necks and wandering eyes, with their foot-chains sounding when they go:

chinese: 所以，主必使錫安的女子頭長禿瘡；耶和華又使他們赤露下體。
english: The Lord will send disease on the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will let their secret parts be seen.

chinese: 到那日，主必除掉他們華美的腳釧、髮網、月牙圈、
english: In that day the Lord will take away the glory of their foot-rings, and their sun-jewels, and their moon-ornaments,

chinese: 耳環、手鐲、蒙臉的帕子、
english: The ear-rings, and the chains, and the delicate clothing,

chinese: 華冠、足鍊、華帶、香盒、符囊、
english: The head-bands, and the arm-chains, and the worked bands, and the perfume-boxes, and the jewels with secret powers,

chinese: 戒指、鼻環、
english: The rings, and the nose-jewels,

chinese: 吉服、外套、雲肩、荷包、
english: The feast-day dresses, and the robes, and the wide skirts, and the handbags,

chinese: 手鏡、細麻衣、裹頭巾、蒙身的帕子。
english: The looking-glasses, and the fair linen, and the high head-dresses, and the veils.

chinese: 必有臭爛代替馨香，繩子代替腰帶，光禿代替美髮，麻衣繫腰代替華服，烙傷代替美容。
english: And in the place of sweet spices will be an evil smell, and for a fair band a thick cord; for a well-dressed head there will be the cutting-off of the hair, and for a beautiful robe there will be the clothing of sorrow; the mark of the prisoner in place of the ornaments of the free.

chinese: 你的男丁必倒在刀下；你的勇士必死在陣上。
english: Your men will be put to the sword, and your men of war will come to destruction in the fight.

chinese: 錫安（原文是他）的城門必悲傷、哀號；他必荒涼坐在地上。
english: And in the public places of her towns will be sorrow and weeping; and she will be seated on the earth, waste and uncovered.

chinese: 在那日，七個女人必拉住一個男人，說：我們吃自己的食物，穿自己的衣服，但求你許我們歸你名下；求你除掉我們的羞恥。
english: And in that day seven women will put their hands on one man, saying, There will be no need for you to give us food or clothing, only let us go under your name, so that our shame may be taken away.

chinese: 到那日，耶和華發生的苗必華美尊榮，地的出產必為以色列逃脫的人顯為榮華茂盛。
english: In that day will the young growth of the Lord be beautiful in glory, and the fruit of the earth will be the pride of those who are still living in Israel.

chinese: 主以公義的靈和焚燒的靈，將錫安女子的污穢洗去，又將耶路撒冷中殺人的血除淨。那時，剩在錫安、留在耶路撒冷的，就是一切住耶路撒冷、在生命冊上記名的，必稱為聖。
english: And it will come about that the rest of the living in Zion, and of those who have been kept from destruction in Jerusalem, will be named holy, even everyone who has been recorded for life in Jerusalem:
When Zion has been washed from her sin by the Lord, and Jerusalem made clean from her blood by a judging and a burning wind.

chinese: 耶和華也必在錫安全山，並各會眾以上，使白日有煙雲，黑夜有火燄的光。因為在全榮耀之上必有遮蔽。
english: And over every living-place on Mount Zion, all over all her meetings, the Lord will make a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all, the glory of the Lord will be a cover and a tent;

chinese: 必有亭子，白日可以得蔭避暑，也可以作為藏身之處，躲避狂風暴雨。
english: And a shade in the daytime from the heat, and a safe cover from storm and from rain.

chinese: 我要為我所親愛的唱歌，是我所愛者的歌，論他葡萄園的事：我所親愛的有葡萄園在肥美的山岡上。
english: Let me make a song about my loved one, a song of love for his vine-garden. My loved one had a vine-garden on a fertile hill:

chinese: 他刨挖園子，撿去石頭，栽種上等的葡萄樹，在園中蓋了一座樓，又鑿出壓酒池；指望結好葡萄，反倒結了野葡萄。
english: And after working the earth of it with a spade, he took away its stones, and put in it a very special vine; and he put up a watchtower in the middle of it, hollowing out in the rock a place for the grape-crushing; and he was hoping that it would give the best grapes, but it gave common grapes.

chinese: 耶路撒冷的居民和猶大人哪，請你們現今在我與我的葡萄園中，斷定是非。
english: And now, you people of Jerusalem and you men of Judah, be the judges between me and my vine-garden.

chinese: 我為我葡萄園所做之外，還有甚麼可做的呢？我指望結好葡萄，怎麼倒結了野葡萄呢？
english: Is there anything which might have been done for my vine-garden which I have not done? why then, when I was hoping for the best grapes did it give me common grapes?

chinese: 現在我告訴你們，我要向我葡萄園怎樣行：我必撤去籬笆，使他被吞滅，拆毀牆垣，使他被踐踏。
english: And now, this is what I will do to my vine-garden: I will take away the circle of thorns round it, and it will be burned up; its wall will be broken down and the beasts of the field will go through it;

chinese: 我必使他荒廢，不再修理，不再鋤刨，荊棘蒺藜倒要生長。我也必命雲不降雨在其上。
english: And I will make it waste; its branches will not be touched with the knife, or the earth worked with the spade; but blackberries and thorns will come up in it: and I will give orders to the clouds not to send rain on it.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華的葡萄園就是以色列家；他所喜愛的樹就是猶大人。他指望的是公平，誰知倒有暴虐（或譯：倒流人血）；指望的是公義，誰知倒有冤聲。
english: For the vine-garden of the Lord of armies is the people of Israel, and the men of Judah are the plant of his delight: and he was looking for upright judging, and there was blood; for righteousness, and there was a cry for help.

chinese: 禍哉！那些以房接房，以地連地，以致不留餘地的，只顧自己獨居境內。
english: Cursed are those who are joining house to house, and putting field to field, till there is no more living-space for any but themselves in all the land!

chinese: 我耳聞萬軍之耶和華說：必有許多又大又美的房屋成為荒涼，無人居住。
english: The Lord of armies has said to me secretly, Truly, numbers of great and fair houses will be waste, with no one living in them.

chinese: 三十畝葡萄園只出一罷特酒；一賀梅珥穀種只結一伊法糧食。
english: For ten fields of vines will only give one measure of wine, and a great amount of seed will only give a small measure of grain.

chinese: 禍哉！那些清早起來追求濃酒，留連到夜深，甚至因酒發燒的人。
english: Cursed are those who get up early in the morning to give themselves up to strong drink; who keep on drinking far into the night till they are heated with wine!

chinese: 他們在筵席上彈琴，鼓瑟，擊鼓，吹笛，飲酒，卻不顧念耶和華的作為，也不留心他手所做的。
english: And corded instruments and wind-instruments and wine are in their feasts: but they give no thought to the work of the Lord, and they are not interested in what his hands are doing.

chinese: 所以，我的百姓因無知就被擄去；他們的尊貴人甚是飢餓，群眾極其乾渴。
english: For this cause my people are taken away as prisoners into strange countries for need of knowledge: and their rulers are wasted for need of food, and their loud-voiced feasters are dry for need of water.

chinese: 故此，陰間擴張其欲，開了無限量的口；他們的榮耀、群眾、繁華，並快樂的人都落在其中。
english: For this cause the underworld has made wide its throat, opening its mouth without limit: and her glory, and the noise of her masses, and her loud-voiced feasters, will go down into it.

chinese: 卑賤人被壓服；尊貴人降為卑；眼目高傲的人也降為卑。
english: And the poor man's head is bent, and the great man goes down on his face, and the eyes of pride are put to shame:

chinese: 惟有萬軍之耶和華因公平而崇高；聖者神因公義顯為聖。
english: But the Lord of armies is lifted up as judge, and the Holy God is seen to be holy in righteousness.

chinese: 那時，羊羔必來吃草，如同在自己的草場；豐肥人的荒場被遊行的人吃盡。
english: Then the lambs will get food as in their grass-lands, and the fat cattle will be feasting in the waste places.

chinese: 禍哉！那些以虛假之細繩牽罪孽的人！他們又像以套繩拉罪惡，
english: Cursed are those who make use of ox-cords for pulling the evil thing, and the bands of a young ox for their sin!

chinese: 說：任他急速行，趕快成就他的作為，使我們看看；任以色列聖者所謀劃的臨近成就，使我們知道。
english: Who say, Let him do his work quickly, let him make it sudden, so that we may see it: let the design of the Holy One of Israel come near, so that it may be clear to us.

chinese: 禍哉！那些稱惡為善，稱善為惡，以暗為光，以光為暗，以苦為甜，以甜為苦的人。
english: Cursed are those who give the name of good to evil, and of evil to what is good: who make light dark, and dark light: who make bitter sweet, and sweet bitter!

chinese: 禍哉！那些自以為有智慧，自看為通達的人。
english: Cursed are those who seem wise to themselves, and who take pride in their knowledge!

chinese: 禍哉！那些勇於飲酒，以能力調濃酒的人。
english: Cursed are those who are strong to take wine, and great in making mixed drinks!

chinese: 他們因受賄賂，就稱惡人為義，將義人的義奪去。
english: Who for a reward give support to the cause of the sinner, and who take away the righteousness of the upright from him.

chinese: 火苗怎樣吞滅碎秸，乾草怎樣落在火燄之中，照樣，他們的根必像朽物，他們的花必像灰塵飛騰；因為他們厭棄萬軍之耶和華的訓誨，藐視以色列聖者的言語。
english: For this cause, as the waste of the grain is burned up by tongues of fire, and as the dry grass goes down before the flame, so their root will be like the dry stems of grain, and their flower will go up in dust: because they have gone against the law of the Lord of armies, and have given no honour to the word of the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作。他的手伸出攻擊他們，山嶺就震動；他們的屍首在街市上好像糞土。雖然如此，他的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
english: For this reason the wrath of the Lord has been burning against his people, and his hand has been stretched out against them in punishment, and the hills were shaking, and their dead bodies were like waste in the open places of the town.

chinese: 他必豎立大旗，招遠方的國民，發嘶聲叫他們從地極而來；看哪，他們必急速奔來。
english: And he will let a flag be lifted up as a sign to a far-off nation, whistling to them from the ends of the earth: and they will come quickly and suddenly.

chinese: 其中沒有疲倦的，絆跌的；沒有打盹的，睡覺的；腰帶並不放鬆，鞋帶也不折斷。
english: There is no weariness among them, and no man is feeble-footed: they come without resting or sleeping, and the cord of their shoes is not broken.

chinese: 他們的箭快利，弓也上了弦。馬蹄算如堅石，車輪好像旋風。
english: Their arrows are sharp, and every bow is bent: the feet of their horses are like rock, and their wheels are like a rushing storm.

chinese: 他們要吼叫，像母獅子，咆哮，像少壯獅子；他們要咆哮抓食，坦然叼去，無人救回。
english: The sound of their armies will be like the voice of a lion, and their war-cry like the noise of young lions: with loud cries they will come down on their food and will take it away safely, and there will be no one to take it out of their hands.

chinese: 那日，他們要向以色列人吼叫，像海浪匉訇；人若望地，只見黑暗艱難，光明在雲中變為昏暗。
english: And his voice will be loud over him in that day like the sounding of the sea: and if a man's eyes are turned to the earth, it is all dark and full of trouble; and the light is made dark by thick clouds.

chinese: 當烏西雅王崩的那年，我見主坐在高高的寶座上。他的衣裳垂下，遮滿聖殿。
english: In the year of King Uzziah's death I saw the Lord seated in his place, high and lifted up, and the Temple was full of the wide skirts of his robe.

chinese: 其上有撒拉弗侍立，各有六個翅膀：用兩個翅膀遮臉，兩個翅膀遮腳，兩個翅膀飛翔；
english: Over him were the winged ones: every one had six wings; two for covering his face, two for covering his feed, and two for flight.

chinese: 彼此呼喊說：聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！萬軍之耶和華；他的榮光充滿全地！
english: And one said in a loud voice to another, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of armies: all the earth is full of his glory.

chinese: 因呼喊者的聲音，門檻的根基震動，殿充滿了煙雲。
english: And the bases of the door-pillars were shaking at the sound of his cry, and the house was full of smoke.

chinese: 那時我說：禍哉！我滅亡了！因為我是嘴唇不潔的人，又住在嘴唇不潔的民中，又因我眼見大君王─萬軍之耶和華。
english: Then I said, The curse is on me, and my fate is destruction; for I am a man of unclean lips, living among a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, the Lord of armies.

chinese: 有一撒拉弗飛到我跟前，手裡拿著紅炭，是用火剪從壇上取下來的，
english: Then a winged one came to me with a burning coal in his hand, which he had taken from off the altar with the fire-spoon.

chinese: 將炭沾我的口，說：看哪，這炭沾了你的嘴，你的罪孽便除掉，你的罪惡就赦免了。
english: And after touching my mouth with it, he said, See, your lips have been touched with this; and your evil is taken away, and you are made clean from sin.

chinese: 我又聽見主的聲音說：我可以差遣誰呢？誰肯為我們去呢？我說：我在這裡，請差遣我！
english: And the voice of the Lord came to my ears, saying, Whom am I to send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here am I, send me.

chinese: 他說：你去告訴這百姓說：你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白；看是要看見，卻不曉得。
english: And he said, Go, and say to this people, You will go on hearing, but learning nothing; you will go on seeing, but without getting wiser.

chinese: 要使這百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵發沉，眼睛昏迷；恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裡明白，回轉過來，便得醫治。
english: Make the hearts of this people fat, and let their ears be stopped, and their eyes shut; for fear that they may see with their eyes, and be hearing with their ears, and their heart may become wise, and they may be turned to me and made well.

chinese: 我就說：主啊，這到幾時為止呢？他說：直到城邑荒涼，無人居住，房屋空閒無人，地土極其荒涼。
english: Then I said, Lord, how long? And he said in answer, Till the towns are waste and unpeopled, and the houses have no men, and the land becomes completely waste,

chinese: 並且耶和華將人遷到遠方，在這境內撇下的地土很多。
english: And the Lord has taken men far away, and there are wide waste places in the land.

chinese: 境內剩下的人若還有十分之一，也必被吞滅，像栗樹、橡樹雖被砍伐，樹墩子卻仍存留。這聖潔的種類在國中也是如此。
english: And even if there is still a tenth part in it, it will again be burned, like a tree of the woods whose broken end is still in the earth after the tree has been cut down (the holy seed is the broken end).

chinese: 烏西雅的孫子、約坦的兒子、猶大王亞哈斯在位的時候，亞蘭王利汛和利瑪利的兒子、以色列王比加上來攻打耶路撒冷，卻不能攻取。
english: Now it came about in the days of Ahaz, the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin, the king of Aram, and Pekah, the son of Remaliah, the king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem to make war against it, but were not able to overcome it.

chinese: 有人告訴大衛家說：亞蘭與以法蓮已經同盟。王的心和百姓的心就都跳動，好像林中的樹被風吹動一樣。
english: And word came to the family of David that Aram had put up its tents in Ephraim. And the king's heart, and the hearts of his people, were moved, like the trees of the wood shaking in the wind.

chinese: 耶和華對以賽亞說：你和你的兒子施亞雅述出去，到上池的水溝頭，在漂布地的大路上，去迎接亞哈斯，
english: Then the Lord said to Isaiah, Go out now, you and Shear-jashub, your son, and you will come across Ahaz at the end of the stream flowing from the higher pool, in the highway of the washerman's field;

chinese: 對他說：你要謹慎安靜，不要因亞蘭王利汛和利瑪利的兒子這兩個冒煙的火把頭所發的烈怒害怕，也不要心裡膽怯。
english: And say to him, Take care and be quiet; have no fear, and do not let your heart be feeble, because of these two ends of smoking fire-wood, because of the bitter wrath of Rezin and Aram, and of the son of Remaliah.

chinese: 因為亞蘭和以法蓮，並利瑪利的兒子，設惡謀害你，
english: Because Aram has made evil designs against you, saying,

chinese: 說：我們可以上去攻擊猶大，擾亂他，攻破他，在其中立他比勒的兒子為王。
english: Let us go up against Judah, troubling her, and forcing our way into her, and let us put up a king in her, even the son of Tabeel:

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：這所謀的必立不住，也不得成就。
english: This is the word of the Lord God: This design will not come about or be effected.

chinese: 原來亞蘭的首城是大馬色；大馬色的首領是利汛。（六十五年之內，以法蓮必然破壞，不再成為國民。）
english: For the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin (and in sixty-five years from now Ephraim will be broken, and will no longer be a people):

chinese: 以法蓮的首城是撒瑪利亞；撒瑪利亞的首領是利瑪利的兒子。你們若是不信，定然不得立穩。
english: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If you will not have faith, your kingdom will be broken.

chinese: 耶和華又曉諭亞哈斯說：
english: And Isaiah said again to Ahaz,

chinese: 你向耶和華─你的神求一個兆頭：或求顯在深處，或求顯在高處。
english: Make a request to the Lord your God for a sign, a sign in the deep places of the underworld, or in the high heavens.

chinese: 亞哈斯說：我不求；我不試探耶和華。
english: But Ahaz said, I will not put the Lord to the test by making such a request.

chinese: 以賽亞說：大衛家啊，你們當聽！你們使人厭煩豈算小事，還要使我的神厭煩嗎？
english: And he said, Give ear now, O family of David: is it not enough that you are driving men to disgust? will you do the same to my God?

chinese: 因此，主自己要給你們一個兆頭，必有童女懷孕生子，給他起名叫以馬內利（就是神與我們同在的意思）。
english: For this cause the Lord himself will give you a sign; a young woman is now with child, and she will give birth to a son, and she will give him the name Immanuel.

chinese: 到他曉得棄惡擇善的時候，他必吃奶油與蜂蜜。
english: Butter and honey will be his food, when he is old enough to make a decision between evil and good.

chinese: 因為在這孩子還不曉得棄惡擇善之先，你所憎惡的那二王之地必致見棄。
english: For before the child is old enough to make a decision between evil and good, the land whose two kings you are now fearing will have become waste.

chinese: 耶和華必使亞述王攻擊你的日子臨到你和你的百姓，並你的父家，自從以法蓮離開猶大以來，未曾有這樣的日子。
english: The Lord is about to send on you, and on your people, and on your father's house, such a time of trouble as there has not been from the days of the separating of Ephraim from Judah; even the coming of the king of Assyria.

chinese: 那時，耶和華要發嘶聲，使埃及江河源頭的蒼蠅和亞述地的蜂子飛來；
english: And it will be in that day that the Lord will make a piping sound for the fly which is in the end of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee which is in the land of Assyria.

chinese: 都必飛來，落在荒涼的谷內、磐石的穴裡，和一切荊棘籬笆中，並一切的草場上。
english: And they will come, covering all the waste valleys, and the holes of the rocks, and the thorns, and all the watering-places.

chinese: 那時，主必用大河外賃的剃頭刀，就是亞述王，剃去頭髮和腳上的毛，並要剃淨鬍鬚。
english: In that day will the Lord take away the hair of the head and of the feet, as well as the hair of the face, with a blade got for a price from the other side of the River; even with the king of Assyria.

chinese: 那時，一個人要養活一隻母牛犢，兩隻母綿羊；
english: And it will be in that day that a man will give food to a young cow and two sheep;

chinese: 因為出的奶多，他就得吃奶油，在境內所剩的人都要吃奶油與蜂蜜。
english: And they will give so much milk that he will be able to have butter for his food: for butter and honey will be the food of all who are still living in the land.

chinese: 從前，凡種一千棵葡萄樹、值銀一千舍客勒的地方，到那時必長荊棘和蒺藜。
english: And it will be in that day that in every place where before there were a thousand vines valued at a thousand shekels of silver, there will be nothing but blackberries and thorns.

chinese: 人上那裡去，必帶弓箭，因為遍地滿了荊棘和蒺藜。
english: Men will come there with bows and arrows, because all the land will be full of blackberries and thorns.

chinese: 所有用鋤刨挖的山地，你因怕荊棘和蒺藜，不敢上那裡去；只可成了放牛之處，為羊踐踏之地。
english: And they will send out the oxen and the sheep on all the hills which before were worked with the spade, ... fear of blackberries and thorns.

chinese: 耶和華對我說：你取一個大牌，拿人所用的筆（或譯：人常用的字），寫上瑪黑珥沙拉勒哈施罷斯（就是擄掠速臨、搶奪快到的意思）。
english: And the Lord said to me, Take a great writing-board, and on it put down in common letters, Maher-shalal-hash-baz;

chinese: 我要用誠實的見證人，祭司烏利亞和耶比利家的兒子撒迦利亞記錄這事。
english: And take true witnesses to the writing, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah, the son of Jeberechiah.

chinese: 我─以賽亞與妻子（原文是女先知）同室；他懷孕生子，耶和華就對我說：給他起名叫瑪黑珥沙拉勒哈施罷斯；
english: And I went in to my wife, and she became with child, and gave birth to a son. Then the Lord said to me, Give him the name Maher-shalal-hash-baz,

chinese: 因為在這小孩子不曉得叫父叫母之先，大馬色的財寶和撒瑪利亞的擄物必在亞述王面前搬了去。
english: For before the child is able to say, Father, or, Mother, the wealth of Damascus and the goods of Samaria will be taken away by the king of Assyria.

chinese: 耶和華又曉諭我說：
english: And the Lord said again to me,

chinese: 這百姓既厭棄西羅亞緩流的水，喜悅利汛和利瑪利的兒子；
english: Because this people will have nothing to do with the softly-flowing waters of Shiloah, and have fear of Rezin and Remaliah's son;

chinese: 因此，主必使大河翻騰的水猛然沖來，就是亞述王和他所有的威勢，必漫過一切的水道，漲過兩岸；
english: For this cause the Lord is sending on them the waters of the River, deep and strong, even the king of Assyria and all his glory: and it will come up through all its streams, overflowing all its edges:

chinese: 必沖入猶大，漲溢氾濫，直到頸項。以馬內利啊，他展開翅膀，遍滿你的地。
english: And it will come on into Judah; rushing on and overflowing, till the waters are up to the neck; *** and his outstretched wings will be covering the land from side to side: for God is with us.

chinese: 列國的人民哪，任憑你們喧嚷，終必破壞；遠方的眾人哪，當側耳而聽！任憑你們束起腰來，終必破壞；你們束起腰來，終必破壞。
english: Have knowledge, O peoples, and be in fear; give ear, all you far-off parts of the earth:

chinese: 任憑你們同謀，終歸無有；任憑你們言定，終不成立；因為神與我們同在。
english: Let your designs be formed, and they will come to nothing; give your orders, and they will not be effected: for God is with us.

chinese: 耶和華以大能的手，指教我不可行這百姓所行的道，對我這樣說：
english: For the Lord, controlling me with a strong hand, gave me orders not to go in the way of this people, saying,

chinese: 這百姓說同謀背叛，你們不要說同謀背叛。他們所怕的，你們不要怕，也不要畏懼。
english: Do not say, It is holy, about everything of which this people says, It is holy; and do not be in fear of what they go in fear of.

chinese: 但要尊萬軍之耶和華為聖，以他為你們所當怕的，所當畏懼的。
english: But let the Lord of armies be holy to you, and go in fear of him, giving honour to him.

chinese: 他必作為聖所，卻向以色列兩家作絆腳的石頭，跌人的磐石；向耶路撒冷的居民作為圈套和網羅。
english: And he will be for a holy place: but for a stone of falling and a rock of trouble to the two houses of Israel, and to the men of Jerusalem, for a net in which they may be taken.

chinese: 許多人必在其上絆腳跌倒，而且跌碎，並陷入網羅，被纏住。
english: And numbers of them, falling on the stone, will be broken, and will be taken in the net.

chinese: 你要捲起律法書，在我門徒中間封住訓誨。
english: Let my teaching be kept secret: and my words be given to my disciples only.

chinese: 我要等候那掩面不顧雅各家的耶和華；我也要仰望他。
english: And I will be waiting for the Lord, whose face is veiled from the house of Jacob, and I will be looking for him.

chinese: 看哪，我與耶和華所給我的兒女，就是從住在錫安山萬軍之耶和華來的，在以色列中作為預兆和奇蹟。
english: See, I and the children whom the Lord has given me, are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of armies, whose resting-place is in Mount Zion.

chinese: 有人對你們說：當求問那些交鬼的和行巫術的，就是聲音綿蠻，言語微細的。你們便回答說：百姓不當求問自己的神嗎？豈可為活人求問死人呢？
english: And when they say to you, Make request for us to those who have control of spirits, and to those wise in secret arts, who make hollow bird-like sounds; is it not right for a people to make request to their gods, to make request for the living to the dead?

chinese: 人當以訓誨和法度為標準；他們所說的，若不與此相符，必不得見晨光。
english: Then say to them, Put your faith in the teaching and the witness. ... If they do not say such things. ... For him there is no dawn. ...

chinese: 他們必經過這地，受艱難，受飢餓；飢餓的時候，心中焦躁，咒罵自己的君王和自己的神。
english: And he will go through the land in bitter trouble and in need of food; and when he is unable to get food, he will become angry, cursing his king and his God, and his eyes will be turned to heaven on high;

chinese: 仰觀上天，俯察下地，不料，盡是艱難、黑暗，和幽暗的痛苦。他們必被趕入烏黑的黑暗中去。
english: And he will be looking down on the earth, and there will be trouble and dark clouds, black night where there is no seeing.

chinese: 但那受過痛苦的必不再見幽暗。從前神使西布倫地和拿弗他利地被藐視，末後卻使這沿海的路，約但河外，外邦人的加利利地得著榮耀。
english: In earlier times he made the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali of small value, but after that he gave it glory, by the way of the sea, on the other side of Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

chinese: 在黑暗中行走的百姓看見了大光，住在死蔭之地的人有光照耀他們。
english: The people who went in the dark have seen a great light, and for those who were living in the land of the deepest night, the light is shining.

chinese: 你使這國民繁多，加增他們的喜樂；他們在你面前歡喜，好像收割的歡喜，像人分擄物那樣的快樂。
english: You have made them very glad, increasing their joy. They are glad before you as men are glad in the time of getting in the grain, or when they make division of the goods taken in war.

chinese: 因為他們所負的重軛和肩頭上的杖，並欺壓他們人的棍，你都已經折斷，好像在米甸的日子一樣。
english: For by your hand the yoke on his neck and the rod on his back, even the rod of his cruel master, have been broken, as in the day of Midian.

chinese: 戰士在亂殺之間所穿戴的盔甲，並那滾在血中的衣服，都必作為可燒的，當作火柴。
english: For every boot of the man of war with his sounding step, and the clothing rolled in blood, will be for burning, food for the fire.

chinese: 因有一嬰孩為我們而生；有一子賜給我們。政權必擔在他的肩頭上；他名稱為奇妙策士、全能的神、永在的父、和平的君。
english: For to us a child has come, to us a son is given; and the government has been placed in his hands; and he has been named Wise Guide, Strong God, Father for ever, Prince of Peace.

chinese: 他的政權與平安必加增無窮。他必在大衛的寶座上治理他的國，以公平公義使國堅定穩固，從今直到永遠。萬軍之耶和華的熱心必成就這事。
english: Of the increase of his rule and of peace there will be no end, on the seat of David, and in his kingdom; to make it strong, supporting it with wise decision and righteousness, now and for ever. By the fixed purpose of the Lord of armies this will be done.

chinese: 主使一言入於雅各家，落於以色列家。
english: The Lord has sent a word to Jacob, and it has come on Israel;

chinese: 這眾百姓，就是以法蓮和撒瑪利亞的居民，都要知道；他們憑驕傲自大的心說：
english: And all the people will have experience of it, even Ephraim and the men of Samaria, who say in the pride of their uplifted hearts,

chinese: 磚牆塌了，我們卻要鑿石頭建築；桑樹砍了，我們卻要換香柏樹。
english: The bricks have come down, but we will put up buildings of cut stone in their place: the sycamores are cut down, but they will be changed to cedars.

chinese: 因此，耶和華要高舉利汛的敵人來攻擊以色列，並要激動以色列的仇敵。
english: For this cause the Lord has made strong the haters of Israel, driving them on to make war against him;

chinese: 東有亞蘭人，西有非利士人；他們張口要吞吃以色列。雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
english: Aram on the east, and the Philistines on the west, who have come against Israel with open mouths. For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

chinese: 這百姓還沒有歸向擊打他們的主，也沒有尋求萬軍之耶和華。
english: But the heart of the people was not turned to him who sent punishment on them, and they made no prayer to the Lord of armies.

chinese: 因此，耶和華一日之間必從以色列中剪除頭與尾，棕枝與蘆葦─
english: For this cause the Lord took away from Israel head and tail, high and low, in one day.

chinese: 長老和尊貴人就是頭，以謊言教人的先知就是尾。
english: The man who is honoured and responsible is the head, and the prophet who gives false teaching is the tail.

chinese: 因為，引導這百姓的使他們走錯了路；被引導的都必敗亡。
english: For the guides of this people are the cause of their wandering from the right way, and those who are guided by them come to destruction.

chinese: 所以，主必不喜悅他們的少年人，也不憐恤他們的孤兒寡婦；因為，各人是褻瀆的，是行惡的，並且各人的口都說愚妄的話。雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
english: For this cause the Lord will have no pleasure in their young men, and no pity on their widows and the children without fathers: for they are all haters of God and evil-doers, and foolish words come from every mouth. For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

chinese: 邪惡像火焚燒，燒滅荊棘和蒺藜，在稠密的樹林中著起來，就成為煙柱，旋轉上騰。
english: For evil was burning like a fire; the blackberries and thorns were burned up; the thick woods took fire, rolling up in dark clouds of smoke.

chinese: 因萬軍之耶和華的烈怒，地都燒遍；百姓成為火柴；無人憐愛弟兄。
english: The land was dark with the wrath of the Lord of armies: the people were like those who take men's flesh for food.

chinese: 有人右邊搶奪，仍受飢餓，左邊吞吃，仍不飽足；各人吃自己膀臂上的肉。
english: On the right a man was cutting off bits and was still in need; on the left a man took a meal but had not enough; no man had pity on his brother; every man was making a meal of the flesh of his neighbour.

chinese: 瑪拿西吞吃（或譯：攻擊；下同）以法蓮；以法蓮吞吃瑪拿西，又一同攻擊猶大。雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
english: Manasseh was making a meal of Ephraim, and Ephraim of Manasseh; and together they were attacking Judah. For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

chinese: 禍哉！那些設立不義之律例的和記錄奸詐之判語的，
english: Cursed are those who make evil decisions, and the writers who make the records of their cruel acts:

chinese: 為要屈枉窮乏人，奪去我民中困苦人的理，以寡婦當作擄物，以孤兒當作掠物。
english: Who do wrong to the poor in their cause, and take away the right of the crushed among my people, so that they may have the property of widows, and get under their power those who have no father.

chinese: 到降罰的日子，有災禍從遠方臨到，那時，你們怎樣行呢？你們向誰逃奔求救呢？你們的榮耀（或譯：財寶）存留何處呢？
english: And what will you do in the day of punishment, and in the destruction which is coming from far? to whom will you go for help, and what will become of your glory?

chinese: 他們只得屈身在被擄的人以下，仆倒在被殺的人以下。雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消；他的手仍伸不縮。
english: ... For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

chinese: 亞述是我怒氣的棍，手中拿我惱恨的杖。
english: Ho! Assyrian, the rod of my wrath, the instrument of my punishment!

chinese: 我要打發他攻擊褻瀆的國民，吩咐他攻擊我所惱怒的百姓，搶財為擄物，奪貨為掠物，將他們踐踏，像街上的泥土一樣。
english: I will send him against a nation of wrongdoers, and against the people of my wrath I will give him orders, to take their wealth in war, crushing them down like the dust in the streets.

chinese: 然而，他不是這樣的意思；他心也不這樣打算。他心裡倒想毀滅，剪除不少的國。
english: But this is not what is in his mind, and this is not his design; but his purpose is destruction, and the cutting off of more and more nations.

chinese: 他說：我的臣僕豈不都是王嗎？
english: For he says, Are not all my captains kings?

chinese: 迦勒挪豈不像迦基米施嗎？哈馬豈不像亞珥拔嗎？撒瑪利亞豈不像大馬色嗎？
english: Will not the fate of Calno be like that of Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?

chinese: 我手已經搆到有偶像的國；這些國雕刻的偶像過於耶路撒冷和撒瑪利亞的偶像。
english: As my hand has come on the kingdoms of the images, whose pictured images were more in number than those of Jerusalem and Samaria;

chinese: 我怎樣待撒瑪利亞和其中的偶像，豈不照樣待耶路撒冷和其中的偶像嗎？
english: So, as I have done to Samaria and her images, I will do to Jerusalem and her images.

chinese: 主在錫安山和耶路撒冷成就他一切工作的時候，主說：我必罰亞述王自大的心和他高傲眼目的榮耀。
english: For this cause it will be that, when the purpose of the Lord against Mount Zion and Jerusalem is complete, I will send punishment on the pride of the heart of the king of Assyria, and on the glory of his uplifted eyes.

chinese: 因為他說：我所成就的事是靠我手的能力和我的智慧，我本有聰明。我挪移列國的地界，搶奪他們所積蓄的財寶；並且我像勇士，使坐寶座的降為卑。
english: For he has said, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my knowledge, for I am wise: and I have taken away the limits of the peoples' lands, and the stores of their wealth have become mine; and I have made towns low in the dust, sending destruction on those living in them;

chinese: 我的手搆到列國的財寶，好像人搆到鳥窩；我也得了全地，好像人拾起所棄的雀蛋。沒有動翅膀的；沒有張嘴的，也沒有鳴叫的。
english: And I have put my hands on the wealth of the peoples, as on the place where a bird has put her eggs; and as a man may take the eggs from which a bird has gone, so I have taken all the earth for myself: and not a wing was moved, and not a mouth gave out a sound.

chinese: 斧豈可向用斧砍木的自誇呢？鋸豈可向用鋸的自大呢？好比棍掄起那舉棍的，好比杖舉起那非木的人。
english: Will the axe say high-sounding words against him who is using it, or the blade be full of pride against him who is cutting with it? As if a rod had the power of shaking him who is using it, or as if a stick might take up him who is not wood.

chinese: 因此，主─萬軍之耶和華必使亞述王的肥壯人變為瘦弱，在他的榮華之下必有火著起，如同焚燒一樣。
english: For this cause the Lord, the Lord of armies, will make his fat become wasted; and in his inner parts a fire will be lighted like a burning flame.

chinese: 以色列的光必如火；他的聖者必如火燄。在一日之間，將亞述王的荊棘和蒺藜焚燒淨盡；
english: And the light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: wasting and burning up his thorns in one day.

chinese: 又將他樹林和肥田的榮耀全然燒盡，好像拿軍旗的昏過去一樣。
english: And he will put an end to the glory of his woods and of his planted fields, soul and body together; and it will be as when a man is wasted by disease.

chinese: 他林中剩下的樹必稀少，就是孩子也能寫其數。
english: And the rest of the trees of his wood will be small in number, so that a child may put them down in writing.

chinese: 到那日，以色列所剩下的和雅各家所逃脫的，不再倚靠那擊打他們的，卻要誠實倚靠耶和華─以色列的聖者。
english: And it will be in that day that the rest of Israel, and those of Jacob who have come safely through these troubles, will no longer go for help to him whose rod was on their back, but their faith will be in the Lord, the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 所剩下的，就是雅各家所剩下的，必歸回全能的神。
english: The rest, even the rest of Jacob, will come back to the Strong God.

chinese: 以色列啊，你的百姓雖多如海沙，惟有剩下的歸回。原來滅絕的事已定，必有公義施行，如水漲溢。
english: For though your people, O Israel, are as the sand of the sea, only a small number will come back: for the destruction is fixed, overflowing in righteousness.

chinese: 因為主─萬軍之耶和華在全地之中必成就所定規的結局。
english: For the Lord, the Lord of armies, is about to make destruction complete in all the land.

chinese: 所以，主─萬軍之耶和華如此說：住錫安我的百姓啊，亞述王雖然用棍擊打你，又照埃及的樣子舉杖攻擊你，你卻不要怕他。
english: For this cause the Lord, the Lord of armies, says, O my people living in Zion, have no fear of the Assyrian, even if his rod comes on your back, and his stick is lifted up as in Egypt.

chinese: 因為還有一點點時候，向你們發的忿恨就要完畢，我的怒氣要向他發作，使他滅亡。
english: For in a very short time my passion will be over, and my wrath will be turned to their destruction.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華要興起鞭來攻擊他，好像在俄立磐石那裡殺戮米甸人一樣。耶和華的杖要向海伸出，把杖舉起，像在埃及一樣。
english: And the Lord of armies will be shaking a whip against him, as when he overcame Midian at the rock of Oreb: and his rod will be lifted up against them as it was against the Egyptians.

chinese: 到那日，亞述王的重擔必離開你的肩頭；他的軛必離開你的頸項；那軛也必因肥壯的緣故撐斷（或譯：因膏油的緣故毀壞）。
english: And in that day the weight which he put on your back will be taken away, and his yoke broken from off your neck.

chinese: 亞述王來到亞葉，經過米磯崙，在密抹安放輜重。
english: He has gone up from Pene-Rimmon, he has come to Aiath; he has gone past Migron, at Michmash he puts his forces in order.

chinese: 他們過了隘口，在迦巴住宿。拉瑪人戰兢；掃羅的基比亞人逃跑。
english: They have gone across the mountain; Geba will be our resting-place tonight, they say: Ramah is shaking with fear; Gibeah of Saul has gone in flight.

chinese: 迦琳的居民（原文是女子）哪，要高聲呼喊！萊煞人哪，須聽！哀哉！困苦的亞拿突啊。
english: Give a loud cry, daughter of Gallim; let Laishah give ear; let Anathoth give answer to her.

chinese: 瑪得米那人躲避；基柄的居民逃遁。
english: Madmenah has gone; the men of Gebim are putting their goods in a safe place.

chinese: 當那日，亞述王要在挪伯歇兵，向錫安女子的山─就是耶路撒冷的山─掄手攻他。
english: This very day he is stopping at Nob; he is shaking his hand against the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

chinese: 看哪，主─萬軍之耶和華以驚嚇削去樹枝；長高的必被砍下，高大的必被伐倒。
english: See, the Lord, the Lord of armies, is cutting off his branches with a great noise, and his strong ones are falling and his high ones are coming down.

chinese: 稠密的樹林，他要用鐵器砍下；利巴嫩的樹木必被大能者伐倒。
english: And he is cutting down the thick places of the wood with an axe, and Lebanon with its tall trees is coming down.

chinese: 從耶西的本（原文是墩）必發一條；從他根生的枝子必結果實。
