english: And there will come a rod out of the broken tree of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will give fruit.

chinese: 耶和華的靈必住在他身上，就是使他有智慧和聰明的靈，謀略和能力的靈，知識和敬畏耶和華的靈。
english: And the spirit of the Lord will be resting on him, the spirit of wisdom and good sense, the spirit of wise guiding and strength, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;

chinese: 他必以敬畏耶和華為樂；行審判不憑眼見，斷是非也不憑耳聞；
english: And he will not be guided in his judging by what he sees, or give decisions by the hearing of his ears:

chinese: 卻要以公義審判貧窮人，以正直判斷世上的謙卑人，以口中的杖擊打世界，以嘴裡的氣殺戮惡人。
english: But he will do right in the cause of the poor, and give wise decisions for those in the land who are in need; and the rod of his mouth will come down on the cruel, and with the breath of his lips he will put an end to the evil-doer.

chinese: 公義必當他的腰帶；信實必當他脅下的帶子。
english: And righteousness will be the cord of his robe, and good faith the band round his breast.

chinese: 豺狼必與綿羊羔同居，豹子與山羊羔同臥；少壯獅子與牛犢並肥畜同群；小孩子要牽引他們。
english: And the wolf will be living with the lamb, and the leopard will take his rest with the young goat; and the lion will take grass for food like the ox; and the young lion will go with the young ones of the herd; and a little child will be their guide.

chinese: 牛必與熊同食；牛犢必與小熊同臥；獅子必吃草，與牛一樣。
english: And the cow and the bear will be friends while their young ones are sleeping together.

chinese: 吃奶的孩子必玩耍在虺蛇的洞口；斷奶的嬰兒必按手在毒蛇的穴上。
english: And the child at the breast will be playing by the hole of the snake, and the older child will put his hand on the bright eye of the poison-snake.

chinese: 在我聖山的遍處，這一切都不傷人，不害物；因為認識耶和華的知識要充滿遍地，好像水充滿洋海一般。
english: There will be no cause of pain or destruction in all my holy mountain: for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the Lord as the sea is covered by the waters.

chinese: 到那日，耶西的根立作萬民的大旗；外邦人必尋求他，他安息之所大有榮耀。
english: And in that day, the eyes of the nations will be turned to the root of Jesse which will be lifted up as the flag of the peoples; and his resting-place will be glory.

chinese: 當那日，主必二次伸手救回自己百姓中所餘剩的，就是在亞述、埃及、巴忒羅、古實、以攔、示拿、哈馬，並眾海島所剩下的。
english: And in that day the hand of the Lord will be stretched out the second time to get back the rest of his people, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the sea-lands.

chinese: 他必向列國豎立大旗，招回以色列被趕散的人，又從地的四方聚集分散的猶大人。
english: And he will put up a flag as a sign to the nations, and he will get together those of Israel who had been sent away, and the wandering ones of Judah, from the four ends of the earth.

chinese: 以法蓮的嫉妒就必消散；擾害猶大的必被剪除。以法蓮必不嫉妒猶大，猶大也不擾害以法蓮。
english: And the envy of Ephraim will be gone, and those who make trouble for Judah will come to an end: Ephraim will have no more envy of Judah, and there will be an end of Judah's hate for Ephraim.

chinese: 他們要向西飛，撲在非利士人的肩頭上（肩頭上：或譯西界），一同擄掠東方人，伸手按住以東和摩押；亞捫人也必順服他們。
english: And they will be united in attacking the Philistines on the west, and together they will take the goods of the children of the east: their hand will be on Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon will be under their rule.

chinese: 耶和華必使埃及海汊枯乾，掄手用暴熱的風使大河分為七條，令人過去不致濕腳。
english: And the Lord will make the tongue of the Egyptian sea completely dry; and with his burning wind his hand will be stretched out over the River, and it will be parted into seven streams, so that men may go over it with dry feet.

chinese: 為主餘剩的百姓，就是從亞述剩下回來的，必有一條大道，如當日以色列從埃及地上來一樣。
english: And there will be a highway for the rest of his people from Assyria; as there was for Israel in the day when he came up out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 到那日，你必說：耶和華啊，我要稱謝你！因為你雖然向我發怒，你的怒氣卻已轉消；你又安慰了我。
english: And in that day you will say I will give praise to you, O Lord; for though you were angry with me, your wrath is turned away, and I am comforted.

chinese: 看哪！神是我的拯救；我要倚靠他，並不懼怕。因為主耶和華是我的力量，是我的詩歌，他也成了我的拯救。
english: See, God is my salvation; I will have faith in the Lord, without fear: for the Lord Jah is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.

chinese: 所以，你們必從救恩的泉源歡然取水。
english: So with joy will you get water out of the springs of salvation.

chinese: 在那日，你們要說：當稱謝耶和華，求告他的名；將他所行的傳揚在萬民中，提說他的名已被尊崇。
english: And in that day you will say, Give praise to the Lord, let his name be honoured, give word of his doings among the peoples, say that his name is lifted up.

chinese: 你們要向耶和華唱歌，因他所行的甚是美好；但願這事普傳天下。
english: Make a song to the Lord; for he has done noble things: give news of them through all the earth.

chinese: 錫安的居民哪，當揚聲歡呼，因為在你們中間的以色列聖者乃為至大。
english: Let your voice be sounding in a cry of joy, O daughter of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you.

chinese: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論巴比倫。
english: The word of the Lord about Babylon which Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saw.

chinese: 應當在淨光的山豎立大旗，向群眾揚聲招手，使他們進入貴冑的門。
english: Put up a flag on a clear mountain-top, make a loud outcry to them, give directions with the hand, so that they may go into the doors of the great ones.

chinese: 我吩咐我所挑出來的人；我招呼我的勇士─就是那矜誇高傲之輩，為要成就我怒中所定的。
english: I have given orders to my holy ones, I have sent out my men of war, those of mine who take pride in their power, to give effect to my wrath.

chinese: 山間有多人的聲音，好像是大國人民。有許多國的民聚集鬨嚷的聲音；這是萬軍之耶和華點齊軍隊，預備打仗。
english: The noise of great numbers in the mountains, like the noise of a strong people! The noise of the kingdoms of the nations meeting together! The Lord of armies is numbering his forces for war.

chinese: 他們從遠方來，從天邊來，就是耶和華並他惱恨的兵器要毀滅這全地。
english: They come from a far country, from the farthest part of heaven, even the Lord and the instruments of his wrath, with destruction for all the land.

chinese: 你們要哀號，因為耶和華的日子臨近了！這日來到，好像毀滅從全能者來到。
english: Send out a cry of grief; for the day of the Lord is near; it comes as destruction from the Most High.

chinese: 所以，人手都必軟弱；人心都必消化。
english: For this cause all hands will be feeble, and every heart of man be turned to water;

chinese: 他們必驚惶悲痛；愁苦必將他們抓住。他們疼痛，好像產難的婦人一樣，彼此驚奇相看，臉如火燄。
english: Their hearts will be full of fear; pains and sorrows will overcome them; they will be in pain like a woman in childbirth; they will be shocked at one another; their faces will be like flames.

chinese: 耶和華的日子臨到，必有殘忍、忿恨、烈怒，使這地荒涼，從其中除滅罪人。
english: See, the day of the Lord is coming, cruel, with wrath and burning passion: to make the land a waste, driving the sinners in it to destruction.

chinese: 天上的眾星群宿都不發光，日頭一出就變黑暗；月亮也不放光。
english: For the stars of heaven and its bright armies will not give their light: the sun will be made dark in his journey through the heaven, and the moon will keep back her light.

chinese: 我必因邪惡刑罰世界，因罪孽刑罰惡人，使驕傲人的狂妄止息，制伏強暴人的狂傲。
english: And I will send punishment on the world for its evil, and on the sinners for their wrongdoing; and I will put an end to all pride, and will make low the power of the cruel.

chinese: 我必使人比精金還少，使人比俄斐純金更少。
english: I will make men so small in number, that a man will be harder to get than gold, even the best gold of Ophir.

chinese: 我─萬軍之耶和華在忿恨中發烈怒的日子，必使天震動，使地搖撼，離其本位。
english: For this cause the heavens will be shaking, and the earth will be moved out of its place, in the wrath of the Lord of armies, and in the day of his burning passion.

chinese: 人必像被追趕的鹿，像無人收聚的羊，各歸回本族，各逃到本土。
english: And it will be that, like a roe in flight, and like wandering sheep, they will go every man to his people and to his land.

chinese: 凡被仇敵追上的必被刺死；凡被捉住的必被刀殺。
english: Everyone who is overtaken will have a spear put through him, and everyone who goes in flight will be put to the sword.

chinese: 他們的嬰孩必在他們眼前摔碎；他們的房屋必被搶奪；他們的妻子必被玷污。
english: Their young children will be broken up before their eyes; their goods will be taken away, and their wives made the property of others.

chinese: 我必激動瑪代人來攻擊他們。瑪代人不注重銀子，也不喜愛金子。
english: See, I am driving the Medes against them, who put no value on silver and have no pleasure in gold.

chinese: 他們必用弓擊碎少年人，不憐憫婦人所生的，眼也不顧惜孩子。
english: In their hands are bows and spears; they are cruel, violently putting the young men to death, and crushing the young women; they have no pity for children, and no mercy for the fruit of the body.

chinese: 巴比倫素來為列國的榮耀，為迦勒底人所矜誇的華美，必像神所傾覆的所多瑪、蛾摩拉一樣。
english: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beautiful town which is the pride of the Chaldaeans, will be like God's destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.

chinese: 其內必永無人煙，世世代代無人居住。亞拉伯人也不在那裡支搭帳棚；牧羊的人也不使羊群臥在那裡。
english: People will never be living in it again, and it will have no more men from generation to generation: the Arab will not put up his tent there; and those who keep sheep will not make it a resting-place for their flocks.

chinese: 只有曠野的走獸臥在那裡；咆哮的獸滿了房屋。鴕鳥住在那裡；野山羊在那裡跳舞。
english: But the beasts of the waste land will have their holes there; and the houses will be full of crying jackals, and ostriches will have their place there, and evil spirits will be dancing there.

chinese: 豺狼必在他宮中呼號；野狗必在他華美殿內吼叫。巴比倫受罰的時候臨近；他的日子必不長久。
english: And wolves will be answering one another in their towers, and jackals in their houses of pleasure: her time is near, and her days of power will quickly be ended.

chinese: 耶和華要憐恤雅各，必再揀選以色列，將他們安置在本地。寄居的必與他們聯合，緊貼雅各家。
english: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will again make Israel his special people, and will put them in their land; and the man from a strange country will take his place among them and be joined to the family of Jacob.

chinese: 外邦人必將他們帶回本土；以色列家必在耶和華的地上得外邦人為僕婢，也要擄掠先前擄掠他們的，轄制先前欺壓他們的。
english: And the people will take them with them to their place: and the children of Israel will give them a heritage in the Lord's land as men-servants and women-servants, making them prisoners whose prisoners they were; and they will be rulers over their masters.

chinese: 當耶和華使你脫離愁苦、煩惱，並人勉強你做的苦工，得享安息的日子，
english: And it will be, in the day when the Lord gives you rest from your sorrow, and from your trouble, and from the hard yoke which they had put on you,

chinese: 你必題這詩歌論巴比倫王說：欺壓人的何竟息滅？強暴的何竟止息？
english: That you will take up this bitter song against the king of Babylon, and say, How has the cruel overseer come to an end! He who was lifted up in pride is cut off;

chinese: 耶和華折斷了惡人的杖，轄制人的圭，
english: The stick of the evil-doers, the rod of the rulers, is broken by the Lord;

chinese: 就是在忿怒中連連攻擊眾民的，在怒氣中轄制列國，行逼迫無人阻止的。
english: He whose rod was on the peoples with an unending wrath, ruling the nations in passion, with an uncontrolled rule.

chinese: 現在全地得安息，享平靜；人皆發聲歡呼。
english: All the earth is at rest and is quiet: they are bursting into song.

chinese: 松樹和利巴嫩的香柏樹都因你歡樂，說：自從你仆倒，再無人上來砍伐我們。
english: Even the trees of the wood are glad over you, the trees of Lebanon, saying, From the time of your fall no wood-cutter has come up against us with an axe.

chinese: 你下到陰間，陰間就因你震動來迎接你，又因你驚動在世曾為首領的陰魂，並使那曾為列國君王的，都離位站起。
english: The underworld is moved at your coming: the shades of the dead are awake before you, even the strong ones of the earth; all the kings of the world have got up from their seats.

chinese: 他們都要發言對你說：你也變為軟弱像我們一樣嗎？你也成了我們的樣子嗎？
english: They all make answer and say to you, Have you become feeble like us? have you been made even as we are?

chinese: 你的威勢和你琴瑟的聲音都下到陰間。你下鋪的是蟲，上蓋的是蛆。
english: Your pride has gone down into the underworld, and the noise of your instruments of music; the worms are under you, and your body is covered with them.

chinese: 明亮之星，早晨之子啊，你何竟從天墜落？你這攻敗列國的何竟被砍倒在地上？
english: How great is your fall from heaven, O shining one, son of the morning! How are you cut down to the earth, low among the dead bodies!

chinese: 你心裡曾說：我要升到天上；我要高舉我的寶座在神眾星以上；我要坐在聚會的山上，在北方的極處。
english: For you said in your heart, I will go up to heaven, I will make my seat higher than the stars of God; I will take my place on the mountain of the meeting-place of the gods, in the inmost parts of the north.

chinese: 我要升到高雲之上；我要與至上者同等。
english: I will go higher than the clouds; I will be like the Most High.

chinese: 然而，你必墜落陰間，到坑中極深之處。
english: But you will come down to the underworld, even to its inmost parts.

chinese: 凡看見你的都要定睛看你，留意看你，說：使大地戰抖，使列國震動，
english: Those who see you will be looking on you with care, they will be in deep thought, saying, Is this the troubler of the earth, the shaker of kingdoms?

chinese: 使世界如同荒野，使城邑傾覆，不釋放被擄的人歸家，是這個人嗎？
english: Who made the world a waste, overturning its towns; who did not let his prisoners loose from the prison-house.

chinese: 列國的君王俱各在自己陰宅的榮耀中安睡。
english: All the kings of the earth are at rest in glory, every man in his house,

chinese: 惟獨你被拋棄，不得入你的墳墓，好像可憎的枝子，以被殺的人為衣，就是被刀刺透，墜落坑中石頭那裡的；你又像被踐踏的屍首一樣。
english: But you, like a birth before its time, are stretched out with no resting-place in the earth; clothed with the bodies of the dead who have been put to the sword, who go down to the lowest parts of the underworld; a dead body, crushed under foot.

chinese: 你不得與君王同葬；因為你敗壞你的國，殺戮你的民。惡人後裔的名，必永不提說。
english: As for your fathers, you will not be united with them in their resting-place, because you have been the cause of destruction to your land, and of death to your people; the seed of the evil-doer will have no place in the memory of man.

chinese: 先人既有罪孽，就要預備殺戮他的子孫，免得他們興起來，得了遍地，在世上修滿城邑。
english: Make ready a place of death for his children, because of the evil-doing of their father; so that they may not come up and take the earth for their heritage, covering the face of the world with waste places.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必興起攻擊他們，將巴比倫的名號和所餘剩的人，連子帶孫一併剪除。這是耶和華說的。
english: For I will come up against them, says the Lord of armies, cutting off from Babylon name and offspring, son and son's son, says the Lord.

chinese: 我必使巴比倫為箭豬所得，又變為水池；我要用滅亡的掃帚掃淨他。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And I will make you a heritage for the hedgehog, and pools of water: and I will go through it with the brush of destruction, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華起誓說：我怎樣思想，必照樣成就；我怎樣定意，必照樣成立，
english: The Lord has taken an oath, saying, My design will certainly come about, and my purpose will be effected:

chinese: 就是在我地上打折亞述人，在我山上將他踐踏。他加的軛必離開以色列人；他加的重擔必離開他們的肩頭。
english: To let the Assyrian be broken in my land, and crushed under foot on my mountains: there will his yoke be taken away from them, and his rule over them come to an end.

chinese: 這是向全地所定的旨意；這是向萬國所伸出的手。
english: This is the purpose for all the earth: and this is the hand stretched out over all nations.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華既然定意，誰能廢棄呢？他的手已經伸出，誰能轉回呢？
english: For it is the purpose of the Lord of armies, and who will make it of no effect? when his hand is stretched out, by whom may it be turned back?

chinese: 亞哈斯王崩的那年，就有以下的默示：
english: In the year of the death of King Ahaz this word came to the prophet:

chinese: 非利士全地啊，不要因擊打你的杖折斷就喜樂。因為從蛇的根必生出毒蛇；他所生的是火燄的飛龍。
english: Be not glad, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod which was on you is broken: for out of the snake's root will come a poison-snake, and its fruit will be a winged poison-snake.

chinese: 貧寒人的長子必有所食；窮乏人必安然躺臥。我必以饑荒治死你的根；你所餘剩的人必被殺戮。
english: And the poorest of the land will have food, and those in need will be given a safe resting-place: but your seed will come to an end for need of food, and the rest of you will be put to the sword.

chinese: 門哪，應當哀號！城啊，應當呼喊！非利士全地啊，你都消化了！因為有煙從北方出來，他行伍中並無亂隊的。
english: Send out a cry, O door! Make sounds of sorrow, O town! All your land has come to nothing, O Philistia; for there comes a smoke out of the north, and everyone keeps his place in the line.

chinese: 可怎樣回答外邦（或指非利士）的使者呢？必說：耶和華建立了錫安；他百姓中的困苦人必投奔在其中。
english: What answer, then, will my people give to the representatives of the nation? That the Lord is the builder of Zion, and she will be a safe place for the poor of his people.

chinese: 論摩押的默示：一夜之間，摩押的亞珥變為荒廢，歸於無有；一夜之間，摩押的基珥變為荒廢，歸於無有。
english: The word about Moab. For in a night Ar of Moab has become waste, and is seen no longer; for in a night Kir of Moab has become waste, and is seen no longer.

chinese: 他們上巴益，又往底本，到高處去哭泣。摩押人因尼波和米底巴哀號，各人頭上光禿，鬍鬚剃淨。
english: The daughter of Dibon has gone up to the high places, weeping: Moab is sounding her cry of sorrow over Nebo, and over Medeba: everywhere the hair of the head and of the face is cut off.

chinese: 他們在街市上都腰束麻布，在房頂上和寬闊處俱各哀號，眼淚汪汪。
english: In their streets they are covering themselves with haircloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their public places, there is crying and bitter weeping.

chinese: 希實本和以利亞利悲哀的聲音達到雅雜，所以摩押帶兵器的高聲喊嚷，人心戰兢。
english: Heshbon is crying out, and Elealeh; their voice is sounding even to Jahaz: for this cause the heart of Moab is shaking; his soul is shaking with fear.

chinese: 我心為摩押悲哀；他的貴冑（或譯：逃民）逃到瑣珥，到伊基拉施利施亞。他們上魯希坡，隨走隨哭。在何羅念的路上，因毀滅舉起哀聲。
english: My heart is crying out for Moab; her people go in flight to Zoar, and to Eglath-shelishiyah: for they go up with weeping by the slope of Luhith; on the way to Horonaim they send up a cry of destruction.

chinese: 因為寧林的水成為乾涸，青草枯乾，嫩草滅沒，青綠之物，一無所有。
english: The waters of Nimrim will become dry: for the grass is burned up, the young grass is coming to an end, every green thing is dead.

chinese: 因此，摩押人所得的財物和所積蓄的都要運過柳樹河。
english: For this cause they will take away their wealth, and the stores they have got together, over the stream of the water-plants.

chinese: 哀聲遍聞摩押的四境；哀號的聲音達到以基蓮；哀號的聲音達到比珥以琳。
english: For the cry has gone round the limits of Moab; as far as to Eglaim and Beer-elim.

chinese: 底們的水充滿了血；我還要加增底們的災難，叫獅子來追上摩押逃脫的民和那地上所餘剩的人。
english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood: and I'm sending even more on Moab, a lion on those of Moab who go in flight, and on the rest of the land.

chinese: 你們當將羊羔奉給那地掌權的，從西拉往曠野，送到錫安城（原文是女子）的山。
english: And they will send ... to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

chinese: 摩押的居民（原文是女子）在亞嫩渡口，必像遊飛的鳥，如拆窩的雛。
english: For the daughters of Moab will be like wandering birds, like a place from which the young birds have gone in flight, at the ways across the Arnon.

chinese: 求你獻謀略，行公平，使你的影子在午間如黑夜，隱藏被趕散的人，不可顯露逃民。
english: Give wise directions, make a decision; let your shade be as night in full day: keep safe those who are in flight; do not give up the wandering ones.

chinese: 求你容我這被趕散的人和你同居。至於摩押，求你作他的隱密處，脫離滅命者的面。勒索人的歸於無有，毀滅的事止息了，欺壓人的從國中除滅了，
english: Let those who have been forced out of Moab have a resting-place with you; be a cover to them from him who is making waste their land: till the cruel ones are cut off, and wasting has come to an end, and those who take pleasure in crushing the poor are gone from the land.

chinese: 必有寶座因慈愛堅立；必有一位誠誠實實坐在其上，在大衛帳幕中施行審判，尋求公平，速行公義。
english: Then a king's seat will be based on mercy, and one will be seated on it in the tent of David for ever; judging uprightly, and quick to do righteousness.

chinese: 我們聽說摩押人驕傲，是極其驕傲；聽說他狂妄、驕傲、忿怒；他誇大的話是虛空的。
english: We have had word of the pride of Moab, how great it is; how he is lifted up in pride and passion: his high words about himself are false.

chinese: 因此，摩押人必為摩押哀號；人人都要哀號。你們摩押人要為吉珥哈列設的葡萄餅哀歎，極其憂傷。
english: For this cause everyone in Moab will give cries of grief for Moab: crushed to the earth, they will be weeping for the men of Kir-hareseth.

chinese: 因為希實本的田地和西比瑪的葡萄樹都衰殘了。列國的君主折斷其上美好的枝子；這枝子長到雅謝延到曠野，嫩枝向外探出，直探過鹽海。
english: For the fields of Heshbon are waste, the vine of Sibmah is dead; the lords of nations were overcome by the produce of her vines; her vine-plants went as far as Jazer, and came even to the waste land; her branches were stretched out to the sea.

chinese: 因此，我要為西比瑪的葡萄樹哀哭，與雅謝人哀哭一樣。希實本、以利亞利啊，我要以眼淚澆灌你；因為有交戰吶喊的聲音臨到你夏天的果子，並你收割的莊稼。
english: For this cause my sorrow for the vine of Sibmah will be like the weeping for Jazer: my eyes are dropping water on you, O Heshbon and Elealeh! For they are sounding the war-cry over your summer fruits and the getting in of your grain;

chinese: 從肥美的田中奪去了歡喜快樂；在葡萄園裡必無歌唱，也無歡呼的聲音。踹酒的在酒醡中不得踹出酒來；我使他歡呼的聲音止息。
english: And all joy is gone; no longer are they glad for the fertile field; and in the vine-gardens there are no songs or sounds of joy: the crushing of grapes has come to an end, and its glad cry has been stopped.

chinese: 因此，我心腹為摩押哀鳴如琴；我心腸為吉珥哈列設也是如此。
english: For this cause the cords of my heart are sounding for Moab, and I am full of sorrow for Kir-heres.

chinese: 摩押人朝見的時候，在高處疲乏，又到他聖所祈禱，也不蒙應允。
english: And when Moab goes up to the high place, and makes prayer in the house of his god, it will have no effect.

chinese: 這是耶和華從前論摩押的話。
english: This is the word which the Lord said about Moab in the past.

chinese: 但現在耶和華說：三年之內，照雇工的年數，摩押的榮耀與他的群眾必被藐視，餘剩的人甚少無幾。
english: But now the Lord has said, In three years, the years of a servant working for payment, the glory of Moab, all that great people, will be turned to shame, and the rest of Moab will be very small and without honour.

chinese: 論大馬色的默示：看哪，大馬色已被廢棄，不再為城，必變作亂堆。
english: The word about Damascus. See, they have made Damascus a town no longer; it has become a waste place.

chinese: 亞羅珥的城邑已被撇棄，必成為牧羊之處；羊在那裡躺臥，無人驚嚇。
english: Her towns are unpeopled for ever; there the flocks take their rest in peace, without fear.

chinese: 以法蓮不再有保障；大馬色不再有國權；亞蘭所剩下的必像以色列人的榮耀消滅一樣。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: The strong tower has gone from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus: the rest of Aram will come to destruction, and be made like the glory of the children of Israel, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 到那日，雅各的榮耀必至枵薄；他肥胖的身體必漸瘦弱。
english: And it will be in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made small, and the strength of his body will become feeble.

chinese: 就必像收割的人收斂禾稼，用手割取穗子，又像人在利乏音谷拾取遺落的穗子。
english: And it will be like a man cutting the growth of his grain, pulling together the heads of the grain with his arm; even as when they get in the grain in the valley of Rephaim.

chinese: 其間所剩下的不多，好像人打橄欖樹─在儘上的枝梢上只剩兩三個果子；在多果樹的旁枝上只剩四五個果子。這是耶和華─以色列的神說的。
english: But it will be like a man shaking an olive-tree, something will still be there, two or three berries on the top of the highest branch, four or five on the outside branches of a fertile tree, says the Lord, the God of Israel.

chinese: 當那日，人必仰望造他們的主，眼目重看以色列的聖者。
english: In that day a man's heart will be turned to his Maker, and his eyes to the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 他們必不仰望祭壇，就是自己手所築的，也不重看自己指頭所做的，無論是木偶是日像。
english: He will not be looking to the altars, the work of his hands, or to the wood pillars or to the sun-images which his fingers have made.

chinese: 在那日，他們的堅固城必像樹林中和山頂上所撇棄的地方，就是從前在以色列人面前被人撇棄的。這樣，地就荒涼了。
english: In that day your towns will be like the waste places of the Hivites and the Amorites which the children of Israel took for a heritage, and they will come to destruction.

chinese: 因你忘記救你的神，不記念你能力的磐石；所以，你栽上佳美的樹秧子，插上異樣的栽子。
english: For you have not given honour to the God of your salvation, and have not kept in mind the Rock of your strength; for this cause you made a garden of Adonis, and put in it the vine-cuttings of a strange god;

chinese: 栽種的日子，你周圍圈上籬笆，又到早晨使你所種的開花；但在愁苦極其傷痛的日子，所收割的都飛去了。
english: In the day of your planting you were watching its growth, and in the morning your seed was flowering: but its fruit is wasted away in the day of grief and bitter sorrow.

chinese: 唉！多民鬨嚷，好像海浪匉訇；列邦奔騰，好像猛水滔滔；
english: Ah! the voice of peoples, like the loud sounding of the seas, and the thundering of great nations rushing on like the bursting out of waters!

chinese: 列邦奔騰，好像多水滔滔；但神斥責他們，他們就遠遠逃避，又被追趕，如同山上的風前糠，又如暴風前的旋風土。
english: But he will put a stop to them, and make them go in flight far away, driving them like the waste of the grain on the tops of the mountains before the wind, and like the circling dust before the storm.

chinese: 到晚上有驚嚇，未到早晨他們就沒有了。這是擄掠我們之人所得的分，是搶奪我們之人的報應。
english: In the evening there is fear, and in the morning they are gone. This is the fate of those who take our goods, and the reward of those who violently take our property for themselves.

chinese: 唉！古實河外翅膀刷刷響聲之地，
english: Ho! land of the sounding of wings, on the other side of the rivers of Ethiopia:

chinese: 差遣使者在水面上，坐蒲草船過海。先知說：你們快行的使者，要到高大光滑的民那裡去。自從開國以來，那民極其可畏，是分地界踐踏人的；他們的地有江河分開。
english: Which sends its representatives by the sea, even in ships of papyrus on the waters. Go back quickly, O representatives, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people causing fear through all their history; a strong nation, crushing down its haters, whose land is cut through by rivers.

chinese: 世上一切的居民和地上所住的人哪，山上豎立大旗的時候你們要看；吹角的時候你們要聽。
english: All you peoples of the world, and you who are living on the earth, when a flag is lifted up on the mountains, give attention; and when the horn is sounded, give ear.

chinese: 耶和華對我這樣說：我要安靜，在我的居所觀看，如同日光中的清熱，又如露水的雲霧在收割的熱天。
english: For this is what the Lord has said to me: I will be quiet, watching from my place; like the clear heat when the sun is shining, like a mist of dew in the heat of summer.

chinese: 收割之先，花開已謝，花也成了將熟的葡萄；他必用鐮刀削去嫩枝，又砍掉蔓延的枝條，
english: For before the time of getting in the grapes, after the opening of the bud, when the flower has become a grape ready for crushing, he will take away the small branches with knives, cutting down and taking away the wide-stretching branches.

chinese: 都要撇給山間的鷙鳥和地上的野獸。夏天，鷙鳥要宿在其上；冬天，野獸都臥在其中。
english: They will be for the birds of the mountains, and for the beasts of the earth: the birds will come down on them in the summer, and the beasts of the earth in the winter.

chinese: 到那時，這高大光滑的民，就是從開國以來極其可畏、分地界踐踏人的，他們的地有江河分開；他們必將禮物奉給萬軍之耶和華，就是奉到錫安山─耶和華安置他名的地方。
english: In that time an offering will be made to the Lord of armies from a people tall and smooth, causing fear through all their history; a strong nation, crushing down its haters, whose land is cut through by rivers, an offering taken to the place of the name of the Lord of armies, even Mount Zion.

chinese: 論埃及的默示：看哪，耶和華乘駕快雲，臨到埃及。埃及的偶像在他面前戰兢；埃及人的心在裡面消化。
english: The word about Egypt. See, the Lord is seated on a quick-moving cloud, and is coming to Egypt: and the false gods of Egypt will be troubled at his coming, and the heart of Egypt will be turned to water.

chinese: 我必激動埃及人攻擊埃及人─弟兄攻擊弟兄，鄰舍攻擊鄰舍；這城攻擊那城，這國攻擊那國。
english: And I will send the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they will be fighting every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; town against town, and kingdom against kingdom.

chinese: 埃及人的心神必在裡面耗盡；我必敗壞他們的謀略。他們必求問偶像和念咒的、交鬼的、行巫術的。
english: And the spirit of Egypt will be troubled in her, and I will make her decisions without effect: and they will be turning to the false gods, and to those who make hollow sounds, and to those who have control of spirits, and to those who are wise in secret arts.

chinese: 我必將埃及人交在殘忍主的手中；強暴王必轄制他們。這是主─萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And I will give the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord; and a hard king will be their ruler, says the Lord, the Lord of armies.

chinese: 海中的水必絕盡，河也消沒乾涸。
english: And the waters of the sea will be cut off, and the river will become dry and waste:

chinese: 江河要變臭；埃及的河水都必減少枯乾。葦子和蘆荻都必衰殘；
english: And the rivers will have an evil smell; the stream of Egypt will become small and dry: all the water-plants will come to nothing.

chinese: 靠尼羅河旁的草田，並沿尼羅河所種的田，都必枯乾。莊稼被風吹去，歸於無有。
english: The grass-lands by the Nile, and everything planted by the Nile, will become dry, or taken away by the wind, and will come to an end.

chinese: 打魚的必哀哭。在尼羅河一切釣魚的必悲傷；在水上撒網的必都衰弱。
english: The fishermen will be sad, and all those who put fishing-lines into the Nile will be full of grief, and those whose nets are stretched out on the waters will have sorrow in their hearts.

chinese: 用梳好的麻造物的和織白布的都必羞愧；
english: And all the workers in linen thread, and those who make cotton cloth, will be put to shame.

chinese: 國柱必被打碎，所有傭工的，心必愁煩。
english: And the makers of twisted thread will be crushed, and those who ... will be sad in heart.

chinese: 瑣安的首領極其愚昧；法老大有智慧的謀士，所籌劃的成為愚謀。你們怎敢對法老說：我是智慧人的子孫，我是古王的後裔？
english: The chiefs of Zoan are completely foolish; the wisest guides of Pharaoh have become like beasts: how do you say to Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the offspring of early kings?

chinese: 你的智慧人在哪裡呢？萬軍之耶和華向埃及所定的旨意，他們可以知道，可以告訴你吧！
english: Where, then, are your wise men? let them make clear to you, let them give you knowledge of the purpose of the Lord of armies for Egypt.

chinese: 瑣安的首領都變為愚昧；挪弗的首領都受了迷惑。當埃及支派房角石的，使埃及人走錯了路。
english: The chiefs of Zoan have become foolish, the chiefs of Noph are tricked, the heads of her tribes are the cause of Egypt's wandering out of the way.

chinese: 耶和華使乖謬的靈攙入埃及中間；首領使埃及一切所做的都有差錯，好像醉酒之人嘔吐的時候東倒西歪一樣。
english: The Lord has sent among them a spirit of error: and by them Egypt is turned out of the right way in all her doings, as a man overcome by wine is uncertain in his steps.

chinese: 埃及中，無論是頭與尾，棕枝與蘆葦，所做之工都不成就。
english: And in Egypt there will be no work for any man, head or tail, high or low, to do.

chinese: 到那日，埃及人必像婦人一樣，他們必因萬軍之耶和華在埃及以上所掄的手，戰兢懼怕。
english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women: and the land will be shaking with fear because of the waving of the Lord's hand stretched out over it.

chinese: 猶大地必使埃及驚恐，向誰提起猶大地，誰就懼怕。這是因萬軍之耶和華向埃及所定的旨意。
english: And the land of Judah will become a cause of great fear to Egypt; whenever its name comes to mind, Egypt will be in fear before the Lord of armies because of his purpose against it.

chinese: 當那日，埃及地必有五城的人說迦南的方言，又指著萬軍之耶和華起誓。有一城必稱為滅亡城。
english: In that day there will be five towns in the land of Egypt using the language of Canaan, and making oaths to the Lord of armies; and one of them will be named, The Town of the Sun.

chinese: 當那日，在埃及地中必有為耶和華築的一座壇；在埃及的邊界上必有為耶和華立的一根柱。
english: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the Lord at the edge of the land.

chinese: 這都要在埃及地為萬軍之耶和華作記號和證據。埃及人因為受人的欺壓哀求耶和華，他就差遣一位救主作護衛者，拯救他們。
english: And it will be a sign and a witness to the Lord of armies in the land of Egypt: when they are crying out to the Lord because of their cruel masters, then he will send them a saviour and a strong one to make them free.

chinese: 耶和華必被埃及人所認識。在那日，埃及人必認識耶和華，也要獻祭物和供物敬拜他，並向耶和華許願還願。
english: And the Lord will give the knowledge of himself to Egypt, and the Egyptians will give honour to the Lord in that day; they will give him worship with offerings and meal offerings, and will take an oath to the Lord and give effect to it.

chinese: 耶和華必擊打埃及，又擊打又醫治，埃及人就歸向耶和華。他必應允他們的禱告，醫治他們。
english: And the Lord will send punishment on Egypt, and will make them well again; and when they come back to the Lord he will give ear to their prayer and take away their disease.

chinese: 當那日，必有從埃及通亞述去的大道。亞述人要進入埃及，埃及人也進入亞述；埃及人要與亞述人一同敬拜耶和華。
english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and Assyria will come into Egypt, and Egypt will come into Assyria; and the Egyptians will give worship to the Lord together with the Assyrians.

chinese: 當那日，以色列必與埃及、亞述三國一律，使地上的人得福；
english: In that day Israel will be the third together with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the earth:

chinese: 因為萬軍之耶和華賜福給他們，說：埃及─我的百姓，亞述─我手的工作，以色列─我的產業，都有福了！
english: Because of the blessing of the Lord of armies which he has given them, saying, A blessing on Egypt my people, and on Assyria the work of my hands, and on Israel my heritage.

chinese: 亞述王撒珥根打發他珥探到亞實突的那年，他珥探就攻打亞實突，將城攻取。
english: In the year when the Tartan came to Ashdod, sent by Sargon, king of Assyria, and made war against it and took it;

chinese: 那時，耶和華曉諭亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞說：你去解掉你腰間的麻布，脫下你腳上的鞋。以賽亞就這樣做，露身赤腳行走。
english: At that time the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saying, Go, and take off your robe, and your shoes from your feet; and he did so, walking unclothed and without shoes on his feet.

chinese: 耶和華說：我僕人以賽亞怎樣露身赤腳行走三年，作為關乎埃及和古實的預兆奇蹟。
english: And the Lord said, As my servant Isaiah has gone unclothed and without shoes for three years as a sign and a wonder to Egypt and Ethiopia,

chinese: 照樣，亞述王也必擄去埃及人，掠去古實人，無論老少，都露身赤腳，現出下體，使埃及蒙羞。
english: So will the king of Assyria take away the prisoners of Egypt and those forced out of Ethiopia, young and old, unclothed and without shoes, and with backs uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

chinese: 以色列人必因所仰望的古實，所誇耀的埃及，驚惶羞愧。
english: And they will be full of fear, and will no longer have faith in Ethiopia which was their hope, or in Egypt which was their glory.

chinese: 那時，這沿海一帶的居民必說：看哪，我們素所仰望的，就是我們為脫離亞述王逃往求救的，不過是如此！我們怎能逃脫呢？
english: And those living by the sea will say in that day, See the fate of our hope to whom we went for help and salvation from the king of Assyria: what hope have we then of salvation?

chinese: 論海旁曠野的默示：有仇敵從曠野，從可怕之地而來，好像南方的旋風，猛然掃過。
english: The word about the waste land. As storm-winds in the South go rushing through, it comes from the waste land, from the land greatly to be feared.

chinese: 令人悽慘的異象已默示於我。詭詐的行詭詐，毀滅的行毀滅。以攔哪，你要上去！瑪代啊，你要圍困！主說：我使一切歎息止住。
english: A vision of fear comes before my eyes; the worker of deceit goes on in his false way, and the waster goes on making waste. Up! Elam; to the attack! Media; I have put an end to her sorrow.

chinese: 所以，我滿腰疼痛；痛苦將我抓住，好像產難的婦人一樣。我疼痛甚至不能聽；我驚惶甚至不能看。
english: For this cause I am full of bitter grief; pains like the pains of a woman in childbirth have come on me: I am bent down with sorrow at what comes to my ears; I am shocked by what I see.

chinese: 我心慌張，驚恐威嚇我。我所羨慕的黃昏，變為我的戰兢。
english: My mind is wandering, fear has overcome me: the evening of my desire has been turned into shaking for me.

chinese: 他們擺設筵席，派人守望，又吃，又喝。首領啊，你們起來，用油抹盾牌。
english: They make ready the table, they put down the covers, they take food and drink. Up! you captains; put oil on your breastplates.

chinese: 主對我如此說：你去設立守望的，使他將所看見的述說。
english: For so has the Lord said to me, Go, let a watchman be placed; let him give word of what he sees:

chinese: 他看見軍隊，就是騎馬的一對一對地來，又看見驢隊，駱駝隊，就要側耳細聽。
english: And when he sees war-carriages, horsemen by twos, war-carriages with asses, war-carriages with camels, let him give special attention.

chinese: 他像獅子吼叫，說：主啊，我白日常站在望樓上，整夜立在我守望所。
english: And the watchman gave a loud cry, O my lord, I am on the watchtower all day, and am placed in my watch every night:

chinese: 看哪，有一隊軍兵騎著馬，一對一對地來。他就說：巴比倫傾倒了！傾倒了！他一切雕刻的神像都打碎於地。
english: See, here come war-carriages with men, horsemen by twos: and in answer he said, Babylon is made low, is made low, and all her images are broken on the earth.

chinese: 我被打的禾稼，我場上的穀啊，我從萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神那裡所聽見的，都告訴你們了。
english: O my crushed ones, the grain of my floor! I have given you the word which came to me from the Lord of armies, the God of Israel.

chinese: 論度瑪的默示：有人聲從西珥呼問我說：守望的啊，夜裡如何？守望的啊，夜裡如何？
english: The word about Edom. A voice comes to me from Seir, Watchman, how far gone is the night? how far gone is the night?

chinese: 守望的說：早晨將到，黑夜也來。你們若要問就可以問，可以回頭再來。
english: The watchman says, The morning has come, but night is still to come: if you have questions to put, put them, and come back again.

chinese: 論亞拉伯的默示：底但結伴的客旅啊，你們必在亞拉伯的樹林中住宿。
english: The word about Arabia. In the thick woods of Arabia will be your night's resting-place, O travelling bands of Dedanites!

chinese: 提瑪地的居民拿水來，送給口渴的，拿餅來迎接逃避的。
english: Give water to him who is in need of water; give bread, O men of the land of Tema, to those in flight.

chinese: 因為他們逃避刀劍和出了鞘的刀，並上了弦的弓與刀兵的重災。
english: For they are in flight from the sharp sword, and the bent bow, and from the trouble of war.

chinese: 主對我這樣說：一年之內，照雇工的年數，基達的一切榮耀必歸於無有。
english: For so has the Lord said to me, In a year, by the years of a servant working for payment, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end:

chinese: 弓箭手所餘剩的，就是基達人的勇士，必然稀少，因為這是耶和華─以色列的神說的。
english: And the rest of the bowmen, the men of war of the children of Kedar, will be small in number: for the Lord, the God of Israel, has said it.

chinese: 論異象谷的默示：有甚麼事使你這滿城的人都上房頂呢？
english: The word about the valley of vision. Why have all your people gone up to the house-tops?

chinese: 你這滿處吶喊、大有喧嘩的城，歡樂的邑啊，你中間被殺的並不是被刀殺，也不是因打仗死亡。
english: You, who are full of loud voices, a town of outcries, given up to joy; your dead men have not been put to the sword, or come to their death in war.

chinese: 你所有的官長一同逃跑，都為弓箭手所捆綁。你中間一切被找到的都一同被捆綁；他們本是逃往遠方的。
english: All your rulers ... have gone in flight; all your strong ones have gone far away.

chinese: 所以我說：你們轉眼不看我，我要痛哭。不要因我眾民（原文是民女）的毀滅，就竭力安慰我。
english: For this cause I have said, Let your eyes be turned away from me in my bitter weeping; I will not be comforted for the wasting of the daughter of my people.

chinese: 因為主─萬軍之耶和華使異象谷有潰亂、踐踏、煩擾的日子。城被攻破，哀聲達到山間。
english: For it is a day of trouble and of crushing down and of destruction from the Lord, the Lord of armies, in the valley of vision; ...

chinese: 以攔帶著箭袋，還有坐戰車的和馬兵；吉珥揭開盾牌。
english: And Elam was armed with arrows, and Aram came on horseback; and the breastplate of Kir was uncovered.

chinese: 你嘉美的谷遍滿戰車，也有馬兵在城門前排列。
english: And your most fertile valleys were full of war-carriages, and the horsemen took up their positions in front of the town.

chinese: 他去掉猶大的遮蓋。那日，你就仰望林庫內的軍器。
english: He took away the cover of Judah; and in that day you were looking with care at the store of arms in the house of the woods.

chinese: 你們看見大衛城的破口很多，便聚積下池的水，
english: And you saw all the broken places in the wall of the town of David: and you got together the waters of the lower pool.

chinese: 又數點耶路撒冷的房屋，將房屋拆毀，修補城牆，
english: And you had the houses of Jerusalem numbered, pulling down the houses to make the wall stronger.

chinese: 又在兩道城牆中間挖一個聚水池可盛舊池的水，卻不仰望做這事的主，也不顧念從古定這事的。
english: And you made a place between the two walls for storing the waters of the old pool: but you gave no thought to him who had done this, and were not looking to him by whom it had been purposed long before.

chinese: 當那日，主─萬軍之耶和華叫人哭泣哀號，頭上光禿，身披麻布。
english: And in that day the Lord, the Lord of armies, was looking for weeping, and cries of sorrow, cutting off of the hair, and putting on the clothing of grief:

chinese: 誰知，人倒歡喜快樂，宰牛殺羊，吃肉喝酒，說：我們吃喝吧！因為明天要死了。
english: But in place of these there was joy and delight, oxen and sheep were being made ready for food, there was feasting and drinking: men said, Now is the time for food and wine, for tomorrow death comes.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華親自默示我說：這罪孽直到你們死，斷不得赦免！這是主─萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And the Lord of armies said to me secretly, Truly, this sin will not be taken from you till your death, says the Lord, the Lord of armies.

chinese: 主─萬軍之耶和華這樣說：你去見掌銀庫的，就是家宰舍伯那，對他說：
english: The Lord, the Lord of armies, says, Go to this person in authority, this Shebna, who is over the house; who has made himself a resting-place on high, cutting out a place for himself in the rock, and say,

chinese: 你在這裡做甚麼呢？有甚麼人竟在這裡鑿墳墓，就是在高處為自己鑿墳墓，在磐石中為自己鑿出安身之所？
english: Who are you, and by what right have you made for yourself a resting-place here?

chinese: 看哪，耶和華必像大有力的人，將你緊緊纏裹，竭力拋去。
english: See, O strong man, the Lord will send you violently away, gripping you with force,

chinese: 他必將你滾成一團，拋在寬闊之地，好像拋球一樣。你這主人家的羞辱，必在那裡坐你榮耀的車，也必在那裡死亡。
english: Twisting you round and round like a ball he will send you out into a wide country: there you will come to your end, and there will be the carriages of your pride, O shame of your lord's house!

chinese: 我必趕逐你離開官職；你必從你的原位撤下。
english: And I will have you forced out of your place of authority, and pulled down from your position.

chinese: 到那日，我必召我僕人希勒家的兒子以利亞敬來，
english: And in that day I will send for my servant, Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah:

chinese: 將你的外袍給他穿上，將你的腰帶給他繫緊，將你的政權交在他手中。他必作耶路撒冷居民和猶大家的父。
english: And I will put your robe on him, and put your band about him, and I will give your authority into his hand: and he will be a father to the men of Jerusalem, and to the family of Judah.

chinese: 我必將大衛家的鑰匙放在他肩頭上。他開，無人能關；他關，無人能開。
english: And I will give the key of the family of David into his care; and what he keeps open will be shut by no one, and what he keeps shut no one will make open.

chinese: 我必將他安穩，像釘子釘在堅固處；他必作為他父家榮耀的寶座。
english: And I will put him like a nail in a safe place; and he will be for a seat of glory to his father's family.

chinese: 他父家所有的榮耀，連兒女帶子孫，都掛在他身上，好像一切小器皿，從杯子到酒瓶掛上一樣。
english: And all the glory of his father's family will be hanging on him, all their offspring, every small vessel, even the cups and the basins.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：當那日，釘在堅固處的釘子必壓斜，被砍斷落地；掛在其上的重擔必被剪斷。因為這是耶和華說的。
english: In that day, says the Lord of armies, will the nail fixed in a safe place give way; and it will be cut down, and in its fall the weight hanging on it will be cut off, for the Lord has said it.

chinese: 論推羅的默示：他施的船隻都要哀號；因為羅變為荒場，甚至沒有房屋，沒有可進之路。這消息是從基提地得來的。
english: The word about Tyre. Let a cry of sorrow go up, O ships of Tarshish, because your strong place is made waste; on the way back from the land of Kittim the news is given to them.

chinese: 沿海的居民，就是素來靠航海西頓的商家得豐盛的，你們當靜默無言。
english: Send out a cry of grief, you men of the sea-land, traders of Zidon, who go over the sea, whose representatives are on great waters;

chinese: 在大水之上，西曷的糧食、尼羅河的莊稼是推羅的進項；他作列國的大碼頭。
english: Who get in the seed of Shihor, whose wealth is the trade of the nations.

chinese: 西頓哪，你當慚愧；因為大海說，就是海中的保障說：我沒有劬勞，也沒有生產，沒有養育男子，也沒有撫養童女。
english: Be shamed, O Zidon: for the sea, the strong place of the sea has said, I have not been with child, or given birth; I have not taken care of young men, or kept watch over the growth of virgins.

chinese: 這風聲傳到埃及；埃及人為推羅的風聲極其疼痛。
english: When the news comes to Egypt they will be bitterly pained at the fate of Tyre.

chinese: 推羅人哪，你們當過到他施去；沿海的居民哪，你們都當哀號。
english: Go over to Tarshish; give cries of sorrow, O men of the sea-land.

chinese: 這是你們歡樂的城，從上古而有的嗎？其中的居民往遠方寄居。
english: Is this the town which was full of joy, whose start goes back to times long past, whose wanderings took her into far-off countries?

chinese: 推羅本是賜冠冕的。他的商家是王子；他的買賣人是世上的尊貴人。遭遇如此是誰定的呢？
english: By whom was this purposed against Tyre, the crowning town, whose traders are chiefs, whose business men are honoured in the land?

chinese: 是萬軍之耶和華所定的！為要污辱一切高傲的榮耀，使地上一切的尊貴人被藐視。
english: It was the purpose of the Lord of armies to put pride to shame, to make sport of the glory of those who are honoured in the earth.

chinese: 他施的民（原文是女）哪，可以流行你的地，好像尼羅河；不再有腰帶拘緊你。
english: Let your land be worked with the plough, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer any harbour.

chinese: 耶和華已經向海伸手，震動列國。至於迦南，他已經吩咐拆毀其中的保障。
english: His hand is stretched out over the sea, the kingdoms are shaking: the Lord has given orders about Canaan, to make waste its strong places.

chinese: 他又說：受欺壓西頓的居民（原文是處女）哪，你必不得再歡樂。起來！過到基提去；就是在那裡也不得安歇。
english: And he said, There is no more joy for you, O crushed virgin daughter of Zidon: up! go over to Kittim; even there you will have no rest.

chinese: （看哪，迦勒底人之地向來沒有這民，這國是亞述人為住曠野的人所立的。現在他們建築戍樓，拆毀推羅的宮殿，使他成為荒涼。）
他施的船隻都要哀號，因為你們的保障變為荒場。
english: Let a cry of sorrow go up, O ships of Tarshish: because your strong place is made waste.

chinese: 到那時，推羅必被忘記七十年，照著一王的年日。七十年後，推羅的景況必像妓女所唱的歌：
english: And it will be in that day that Tyre will go out of mind for seventy years, that is, the days of one king: after the end of seventy years it will be for Tyre as in the song of the loose woman.

chinese: 你這被忘記的妓女啊，拿琴周流城內，巧彈多唱，使人再想念你。
english: Take an instrument of music, go about the town, O loose woman who has gone out from the memory of man; make sweet melody with songs, so that you may come back to men's minds.

chinese: 七十年後，耶和華必眷顧推羅，他就仍得利息（原文是雇價；下同），與地上的萬國交易（原文是行淫）。
english: And it will be after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will have mercy on Tyre, and she will go back to her trade, acting as a loose woman with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

chinese: 他的貨財和利息要歸耶和華為聖，必不積攢存留；因為他的貨財必為住在耶和華面前的人所得，使他們吃飽，穿耐久的衣服。
english: And her goods and her trade will be holy to the Lord: they will not be kept back or stored up; for her produce will be for those living in the Lord's land, to give them food for their needs, and fair clothing.

chinese: 看哪，耶和華使地空虛，變為荒涼；又翻轉大地，將居民分散。
english: See, the Lord is making the earth waste and unpeopled, he is turning it upside down, and sending the people in all directions.

chinese: 那時百姓怎樣，祭司也怎樣；僕人怎樣，主人也怎樣；婢女怎樣，主母也怎樣；買物的怎樣，賣物的也怎樣；放債的怎樣，借債的也怎樣；取利的怎樣，出利的也怎樣。
english: And it will be the same for the people as for the priest; for the servant as for his master; and for the woman-servant as for her owner; the same for the one offering goods for a price as for him who takes them; the same for him who gives money at interest and for him who takes it; the same for him who lets others have the use of his property as for those who make use of it.

chinese: 地必全然空虛，盡都荒涼；因為這話是耶和華說的。
english: The earth will be completely waste and without men; for this is the word of the Lord.

chinese: 地上悲哀衰殘，世界敗落衰殘；地上居高位的人也敗落了。
english: The earth is sorrowing and wasting away, the world is full of grief and wasting away, the high ones of the earth come to nothing.

chinese: 地被其上的居民污穢；因為他們犯了律法，廢了律例，背了永約。
english: The earth has been made unclean by those living in it; because the laws have not been kept by them, the orders have been changed, and the eternal agreement has been broken.

chinese: 所以，地被咒詛吞滅；住在其上的顯為有罪。地上的居民被火焚燒，剩下的人稀少。
english: For this cause the earth is given up to the curse, and those in it are judged as sinners: for this cause those living on the earth are burned up, and the rest are small in number.

chinese: 新酒悲哀，葡萄樹衰殘；心中歡樂的俱都歎息。
english: The new wine is thin, the vine is feeble, and all the glad-hearted make sounds of grief.

chinese: 擊鼓之樂止息；宴樂人的聲音完畢，彈琴之樂也止息了。
english: The pleasing sound of all instruments of music has come to an end, and the voices of those who are glad.

chinese: 人必不得飲酒唱歌；喝濃酒的，必以為苦。
english: There is no more drinking of wine with a song; strong drink will be bitter to those who take it.

chinese: 荒涼的城拆毀了；各家關門閉戶，使人都不得進去。
english: The town is waste and broken down: every house is shut up, so that no man may come in.

chinese: 在街上因酒有悲歎的聲音；一切喜樂變為昏暗；地上的歡樂歸於無有。
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine; there is an end of all delight, the joy of the land is gone.

chinese: 城中只有荒涼；城門拆毀淨盡。
english: In the town all is waste, and in the public place is destruction.

chinese: 在地上的萬民中，必像打過的橄欖樹，又像已摘的葡萄所剩無幾。
english: For it will be in the heart of the earth among the peoples, like the shaking of an olive-tree, as the last of the grapes after the getting-in is done.

chinese: 這些人要高聲歡呼；他們為耶和華的威嚴，從海那裡揚起聲來。
english: But those will be making sounds of joy; they will be crying loudly from the sea for the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 因此，你們要在東方榮耀耶和華；在眾海島榮耀耶和華─以色列神的名。
english: Give praise to the Lord in the east, to the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, in the sea-lands.

chinese: 我們聽見從地極有人歌唱，說：榮耀歸於義人。我卻說：我消滅了！我消滅了，我有禍了！詭詐的行詭詐；詭詐的大行詭詐。
english: From the farthest part of the earth comes the sound of songs, glory to the upright. But I said, I am wasting away, wasting away, the curse is on me! The false ones go on in their false way, yes, they go on acting falsely.

chinese: 地上的居民哪，恐懼、陷坑、網羅都臨近你。
english: Fear, and death, and the net, are come on you, O people of the earth.

chinese: 躲避恐懼聲音的必墜入陷坑；從陷坑上來的必被網羅纏住；因為天上的窗戶都開了，地的根基也震動了。
english: And it will be that he who goes in flight from the sound of fear will be overtaken by death; and he who gets free from death will be taken in the net: for the windows on high are open, and the bases of the earth are shaking.

chinese: 地全然破壞，盡都崩裂，大大地震動了。
english: The earth is completely broken, it is parted in two, it is violently moved.

chinese: 地要東倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；又搖來搖去，好像吊床。罪過在其上沉重，必然塌陷，不能復起。
english: The earth will be moving uncertainly, like a man overcome by drink; it will be shaking like a tent; and the weight of its sin will be on it, crushing it down so that it will not get up again.

chinese: 到那日，耶和華在高處必懲罰高處的眾軍，在地上必懲罰地上的列王。
english: And in that day the Lord will send punishment on the army of the high ones on high, and on the kings of the earth on the earth.

chinese: 他們必被聚集，像囚犯被聚在牢獄中，並要囚在監牢裡，多日之後便被討罪（或譯：眷顧）。
english: And they will be got together, like prisoners in the prison-house; and after a long time they will have their punishment.

chinese: 那時，月亮要蒙羞，日頭要慚愧；因為萬軍之耶和華必在錫安山，在耶路撒冷作王；在敬畏他的長老面前，必有榮耀。
english: Then the moon will be veiled, and the sun put to shame; for the Lord of armies will be ruling in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before his judges he will let his glory be seen.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你是我的神；我要尊崇你，我要稱讚你的名。因為你以忠信誠實行過奇妙的事，成就你古時所定的。
english: O Lord, you are my God; I will give praise to you, I will give honour to your name; for you have done great acts of power; your purposes in the past have been made true and certain in effect.

chinese: 你使城變為亂堆，使堅固城變為荒場，使外邦人宮殿的城不再為城，永遠不再建造。
english: For you have made a town a waste place: a strong town a mass of broken walls; the tower of the men of pride has come to an end; it will never be put up again.

chinese: 所以，剛強的民必榮耀你；強暴之國的城必敬畏你。
english: For this cause will the strong people give glory to you, the town of the cruel ones will be in fear of you.

chinese: 因為當強暴人催逼人的時候，如同暴風直吹牆壁，你就作貧窮人的保障，作困乏人急難中的保障，作躲暴風之處，作避炎熱的陰涼。
english: For you have been a strong place for the poor and the crushed in their trouble, a safe place from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the wrath of the cruel ones is like a winter storm.

chinese: 你要壓制外邦人的喧嘩，好像乾燥地的熱氣下落；禁止強暴人的凱歌，好像熱氣被雲影消化。
english: As heat by the shade of a cloud, the noise of the men of pride has been made quiet by you; as heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the cruel ones has been stopped.

chinese: 在這山上，萬軍之耶和華必為萬民用肥甘設擺筵席，用陳酒和滿髓的肥甘，並澄清的陳酒，設擺筵席。
english: And in this mountain will the Lord of armies make for all peoples a feast of good things, a feast of wines long stored, of good things sweet to the taste, of wines long kept and tested.

chinese: 他又必在這山上除滅遮蓋萬民之物和遮蔽萬國蒙臉的帕子。
english: And in this mountain he will put an end to the shade covering the face of all peoples, and the veil which is stretched over all nations.

chinese: 他已經吞滅死亡直到永遠。主耶和華必擦去各人臉上的眼淚，又除掉普天下他百姓的羞辱，因為這是耶和華說的。
english: He has put an end to death for ever; and the Lord God will take away all weeping; and he will put an end to the shame of his people in all the earth: for the Lord has said it.

chinese: 到那日，人必說：看哪，這是我們的神；我們素來等候他，他必拯救我們。這是耶和華，我們素來等候他，我們必因他的救恩歡喜快樂。
english: And in that day it will be said, See, this is our God; we have been waiting for him, and he will be our saviour: this is the Lord in whom is our hope; we will be glad and have delight in his salvation.

chinese: 耶和華的手必按在這山上；摩押人在所居之地必被踐踏，好像乾草被踐踏在糞池的水中。
english: For in this mountain will the hand of the Lord come to rest, and Moab will be crushed down in his place, even as the dry stems of the grain are crushed under foot in the waste place.

chinese: 他必在其中伸開手，好像洑水的伸開手洑水一樣；但耶和華必使他的驕傲和他手所行的詭計一併敗落。
english: And if he puts out his hands, like a man stretching out his hands in swimming, the Lord will make low his pride, however expert his designs.

chinese: 耶和華使你城上的堅固高臺傾倒，拆平，直到塵埃。
english: And the strong tower of your walls has been broken by him, made low, and crushed even to the dust.

chinese: 當那日，在猶大地人必唱這歌說：我們有堅固的城。耶和華要將救恩定為城牆，為外郭。
english: In that day will this song be made in the land of Judah: We have a strong town; he will make salvation our walls and towers.

chinese: 敞開城門，使守信的義民得以進入。
english: Let the doors be open, so that the upright nation which keeps faith may come in.

chinese: 堅心倚賴你的，你必保守他十分平安，因為他倚靠你。
english: The man whose heart is unmoved you will keep in peace, because his hope is in you.

chinese: 你們當倚靠耶和華直到永遠，因為耶和華是永久的磐石。
english: Let your hope be in the Lord for ever: for the Lord Jah is an unchanging Rock.

chinese: 他使住高處的與高城一併敗落，將城拆毀，拆平，直到塵埃，
english: For he has made low those who are lifted up, all the people of the town of pride: he makes it low, crushing it down to the earth; he makes it low in the dust.

chinese: 要被腳踐踏，就是被困苦人的腳和窮乏人的腳踐踏。
english: It will be crushed under the feet of the poor and the steps of those who are in need.

chinese: 義人的道是正直的；你為正直的主，必修平義人的路。
english: The way of the good man is straight; the road of the upright is made smooth by you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我們在你行審判的路上等候你；我們心裡所羨慕的是你的名，就是你那可記念的名。
english: We have been waiting for you, O Lord; the desire of our soul is for the memory of your name.

chinese: 夜間，我心中羨慕你；我裡面的靈切切尋求你。因為你在世上行審判的時候，地上的居民就學習公義。
english: In the night the desire of my soul has been for you; early will my spirit be searching for you; for when your punishments come on the earth, the people of the world will get the knowledge of righteousness.

chinese: 以恩惠待惡人，他仍不學習公義；在正直的地上，他必行事不義，也不注意耶和華的威嚴。
english: Even if you are kind to the evil-doer, he will not go after righteousness; even in the land of the upright he will still go on in his wrongdoing, and will not see the glory of the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你的手高舉，他們仍然不看；卻要看你為百姓發的熱心，因而抱愧，並且有火燒滅你的敵人。
english: Lord, your hand is lifted up, but they do not see: let them see ... yes, your haters will be burned up in the fire.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你必派定我們得平安，因為我們所做的事都是你給我們成就的。
english: Lord, you will give us peace: for all our works are the outcome of your purpose.

chinese: 耶和華─我們的神啊，在你以外曾有別的主管轄我們，但我們專要倚靠你，提你的名。
english: O Lord, our God, other lords than you have had rule over us; but in you only is our salvation, and no other name will we take on our lips.

chinese: 他們死了，必不能再活；他們去世，必不能再起；因為你刑罰他們，毀滅他們，他們的名號就全然消滅。
english: The dead will not come back to life: their spirits will not come back to earth; for this cause you have sent destruction on them, so that the memory of them is dead.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你增添國民，你增添國民；你得了榮耀，又擴張地的四境。
english: You have made the nation great, O Lord, you have made it great; glory is yours: you have made wide the limits of the land.

chinese: 耶和華啊，他們在急難中尋求你；你的懲罰臨到他們身上，他們就傾心吐膽禱告你。
english: Lord, in trouble our eyes have been turned to you, we sent up a prayer when your punishment was on us.

chinese: 婦人懷孕，臨產疼痛，在痛苦之中喊叫；耶和華啊，我們在你面前也是如此。
english: As a woman with child, whose time is near, is troubled, crying out in her pain; so have we been before you, O Lord.

chinese: 我們也曾懷孕疼痛，所產的竟像風一樣。我們在地上未曾行甚麼拯救的事；世上的居民也未曾敗落。
english: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have given birth to wind; no salvation has come to the earth through us, and no children have come into the world.

chinese: 死人（原文是你的死人）要復活，屍首（原文是我的屍首）要興起。睡在塵埃的啊，要醒起歌唱！因你的甘露好像菜蔬上的甘露，地也要交出死人來。
english: Your dead will come back; their dead bodies will come to life again. Those in the dust, awaking from their sleep, will send out a song; for your dew is a dew of light, and the earth will give birth to the shades.

chinese: 我的百姓啊，你們要來進入內室，關上門，隱藏片時，等到忿怒過去。
english: Come, my people, into your secret places, and let your doors be shut: keep yourself safe for a short time, till his wrath is over.

chinese: 因為耶和華從他的居所出來，要刑罰地上居民的罪孽。地也必露出其中的血，不再掩蓋被殺的人。
english: For the Lord is coming out of his place to send punishment on the people of the earth for their evil-doing: the earth will let the blood drained out on her be seen, and will keep her dead covered no longer.

chinese: 到那日，耶和華必用他剛硬有力的大刀刑罰鱷魚─就是那快行的蛇，刑罰鱷魚─就是那曲行的蛇，並殺海中的大魚。
english: In that day the Lord, with his great and strong and cruel sword, will send punishment on Leviathan, the quick-moving snake, and on Leviathan, the twisted snake; and he will put to death the dragon which is in the sea.

chinese: 當那日，有出酒的葡萄園，你們要指這園唱歌說：
english: In that day it will be said, A vine-garden of delight, make a song about it.

chinese: 我─耶和華是看守葡萄園的；我必時刻澆灌，晝夜看守，免得有人損害。
english: I, the Lord, am watching it; I will give it water at all times: I will keep it night and day, for fear that any damage comes to it.

chinese: 我心中不存忿怒。惟願荊棘蒺藜與我交戰，我就勇往直前，把他一同焚燒。
english: My passion is over: if the thorns were fighting against me, I would make an attack on them, and they would be burned up together.

chinese: 不然，讓他持住我的能力，使他與我和好，願他與我和好。
english: Or let him put himself under my power, and make peace with me.

chinese: 將來雅各要扎根，以色列要發芽開花；他們的果實必充滿世界。
english: In days to come Jacob will take root: Israel will put out buds and flowers; and the face of the world will be full of fruit.

chinese: 主擊打他們，豈像擊打那些擊打他們的人嗎？他們被殺戮，豈像被他們所殺戮的嗎？
english: Is his punishment like the punishment of those who overcame him? or are his dead as great in number as those he put to the sword?

chinese: 你打發他們去，是相機宜與他們相爭；颳東風的日子，就用暴風將他們逐去。
english: Your anger against her has been made clear by driving her away; he has taken her away with his storm-wind in the day of his east wind.

chinese: 所以，雅各的罪孽得赦免，他的罪過得除掉的果效，全在乎此：就是他叫祭壇的石頭變為打碎的灰石，以致木偶和日像不再立起。
english: So by this will the sin of Jacob be covered, and this is all the fruit of taking away his punishment; when all the stones of the altar are crushed together, so that the wood pillars and the sun-images will not be put up again.

chinese: 因為堅固城變為淒涼，成了撇下離棄的居所，像曠野一樣；牛犢必在那裡吃草，在那裡躺臥，並吃盡其中的樹枝。
english: For the strong town is without men, an unpeopled living-place; and she has become a waste land: there the young ox will take his rest, and its branches will be food for him.

chinese: 枝條枯乾，必被折斷；婦女要來點火燒著。因為這百姓蒙昧無知，所以，創造他們的必不憐恤他們；造成他們的也不施恩與他們。
english: When its branches are dry they will be broken off; the women will come and put fire to them: for it is a foolish people; for this cause he who made them will have no mercy on them, and he whose work they are will not have pity on them.

chinese: 以色列人哪，到那日，耶和華必從大河，直到埃及小河，將你們一一地收集，如同人打樹拾果一樣。
english: And it will be in that day that the Lord will get together his grain, from the River to the stream of Egypt, and you will be got together with care, O children of Israel.

chinese: 當那日，必大發角聲，在亞述地將要滅亡的，並在埃及地被趕散的，都要來，他們就在耶路撒冷聖山上敬拜耶和華。
english: And it will be in that day that a great horn will be sounded; and those who were wandering in the land of Assyria, and those who had been sent away into the land of Egypt, will come; and they will give worship to the Lord in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

chinese: 禍哉！以法蓮的酒徒，住在肥美谷的山上，他們心裡高傲，以所誇的為冠冕，猶如將殘之花。
english: Ho! crown of pride of those who are given up to wine in Ephraim, and the dead flower of his glory which is on the head of those who are overcome by strong drink!

chinese: 看哪，主有一大能大力者，像一陣冰雹，像毀滅的暴風，像漲溢的大水，他必用手將冠冕摔落於地。
english: See, the Lord has a strong and cruel one; like a rain of ice, a storm of destruction, like the overflowing of a strong river, he will violently overcome them.

chinese: 以法蓮高傲的酒徒，他的冠冕必被踏在腳下。
english: The crown of pride of those who are given up to wine in Ephraim will be crushed under foot;

chinese: 那榮美將殘之花，就是在肥美谷山上的，必像夏令以前初熟的無花果；看見這果的就注意，一到手中就吞吃了。
english: And the dead flower of his glory, which is on the head of the fertile valley, will be like the first early fruit before the summer; which a man takes and puts in his mouth the minute he sees it.

chinese: 到那日，萬軍之耶和華必作他餘剩之民的榮冠華冕，
english: In that day will the Lord of armies be a crown of glory, and a fair ornament, to the rest of his people;

chinese: 也作了在位上行審判者公平之靈，並城門口打退仇敵者的力量。
english: And a spirit of wisdom to the judge, and strength to those who keep back the attackers at the door of the town.

chinese: 就是這地的人也因酒搖搖晃晃，因濃酒東倒西歪。祭司和先知因濃酒搖搖晃晃，被酒所困，因濃酒東倒西歪。他們錯解默示，謬行審判。
english: And further, these are uncertain through wine, and have gone out of the right way through strong drink: the priest and the prophet are uncertain through strong drink, they are overcome by wine, they have gone out of the way through strong drink; their vision is false, they go wrong in their decisions.

chinese: 因為各席上滿了嘔吐的污穢，無一處乾淨。
english: For all the tables are covered with coughed-up food, so that there is not a clean place.

chinese: 譏誚先知的說：他要將知識指教誰呢？要使誰明白傳言呢？是那剛斷奶離懷的麼？
english: To whom will he give knowledge? and to whom will he make clear the word? Will it be to those who have newly given up milk, and who have only now been taken from the breast?

chinese: 他竟命上加命，令上加令，律上加律，例上加例，這裡一點，那裡一點。
english: For it is one rule after another; one line after another; here a little, there a little.

chinese: 先知說：不然，主要藉異邦人的嘴唇和外邦人的舌頭對這百姓說話。
english: No, but with broken talk, and with a strange tongue, he will give his word to this people:

chinese: 他曾對他們說：你們要使疲乏人得安息，這樣才得安息，才得舒暢，他們卻不肯聽。
english: To whom he said, This is the rest, give rest to him who is tired; and by this you may get new strength; but they would not give ear.

chinese: 所以，耶和華向他們說的話是命上加命，令上加令，律上加律，例上加例，這裡一點，那裡一點，以致他們前行仰面跌倒，而且跌碎，並陷入網羅被纏住。
english: For this cause the word of the Lord will be to them rule after rule, line after line, here a little, there a little; so that they may go on their way, and falling back may be broken, and taken in the net.

chinese: 所以，你們這些褻慢的人，就是轄管住在耶路撒冷這百姓的，要聽耶和華的話。
english: Give ear then to the word of the Lord, you men of pride, the rulers of this people in Jerusalem:

chinese: 你們曾說：我們與死亡立約，與陰間結盟；敵軍（原文是鞭子）如水漲漫經過的時候，必不臨到我們；因我們以謊言為避所，在虛假以下藏身。
english: Because you have said, We have made death our friend, and with the underworld we have made an agreement; when the overflowing waters come through they will not come near us; for we are looking to false words for help, taking cover in what is untrue:

chinese: 所以，主耶和華如此說：看哪，我在錫安放一塊石頭作為根基，是試驗過的石頭，是穩固根基，寶貴的房角石；信靠的人必不著急。
english: For this cause says the Lord God, See, I am placing in Zion as a base, a stone, a tested stone, an angle-stone which is certain and of great value: and he who has faith will not give way.

chinese: 我必以公平為準繩，以公義為線鉈。冰雹必沖去謊言的避所；大水必漫過藏身之處。
english: And I will make right decision the measuring-line, and righteousness the weight: and the ice-storm will take away the safe place of false words, and the secret place will be covered by the flowing waters.

chinese: 你們與死亡所立的約必然廢掉，與陰間所結的盟必立不住。敵軍（原文是鞭子）如水漲漫經過的時候，你們必被他踐踏；
english: And the help you were looking for from death will come to nothing, and your agreement with the underworld will be broken; when the overflowing waters come through, then you will be overcome by them.

chinese: 每逢經過必將你們擄去。因為每早晨他必經過，白晝黑夜都必如此。明白傳言的必受驚恐。
english: Whenever they come through they will overtake you; for they will come through morning after morning, by day and by night: and the news will be nothing but fear.

chinese: 原來，床榻短，使人不能舒身；被窩窄，使人不能遮體。
english: For the bed is not long enough for a man to be stretched out on: and the cover is not wide enough for him to be covered with.

chinese: 耶和華必興起，像在毗拉心山；他必發怒，像在基遍谷，好做成他的工，就是非常的工；成就他的事，就是奇異的事。
english: For the Lord will come up as on Mount Perazim, he will be moved to wrath as in the valley of Gibeon; so that he may do his work--strange is his work; and give effect to his act--unnatural is his act.

chinese: 現在你們不可褻慢，恐怕捆你們的綁索更結實了；因為我從主─萬軍之耶和華那裡聽見，已經決定在全地上施行滅絕的事。
english: And now, take care that you do not make sport of him, or your bands will be made strong; for I have had word from the Lord, the Lord of armies, of an end, of a complete end, which is to come on all the land.

chinese: 你們當側耳聽我的聲音，留心聽我的言語。
english: Let your ears be open to my voice; give attention to what I say.

chinese: 那耕地為要撒種的，豈是常常耕地呢？豈是常常開墾耙地呢？
english: Is the ploughman for ever ploughing? does he not get the earth ready and broken up for the seed?

chinese: 他拉平了地面，豈不就撒種小茴香，播種大茴香，按行列種小麥，在定處種大麥，在田邊種粗麥呢？
english: When the face of the earth has been levelled, does he not put in the different sorts of seed, and the grain in lines, and the barley in its place, and the spelt at the edge?

chinese: 因為他的神教導他務農相宜，並且指教他。
english: For his God is his teacher, giving him the knowledge of these things.

chinese: 原來打小茴香，不用尖利的器具，軋大茴香，也不用碌碡（原文是車輪；下同）；但用杖打小茴香，用棍打大茴香。
english: For the fitches are not crushed with a sharp instrument, and a cart-wheel is not rolled over the cummin; but the grain of the fitches is hammered out with a stick, and of the cummin with a rod.

chinese: 做餅的糧食是用磨磨碎，因他不必常打；雖用碌碡和馬打散，卻不磨他。
english: Is the grain for bread crushed? He does not go on crushing it for ever, but he lets his cart-wheels and his horses go over it without crushing it.

chinese: 這也是出於萬軍之耶和華─他的謀略奇妙；他的智慧廣大。
english: This comes from the Lord of armies, purposing wonders, and wise in all his acts.

chinese: 唉！亞利伊勒，亞利伊勒，大衛安營的城，任憑你年上加年，節期照常周流。
english: Ho! Ariel, Ariel, the town against which David made war; put year to year, let the feasts come round:

chinese: 我終必使亞利伊勒困難；他必悲傷哀號，我卻仍以他為亞利伊勒。
english: And I will send trouble on Ariel, and there will be weeping and cries of grief; and she will be to me as Ariel.

chinese: 我必四圍安營攻擊你，屯兵圍困你，築壘攻擊你。
english: And I will make war on you like David, and you will be shut in by earthworks, and I will make towers round you.

chinese: 你必敗落，從地中說話；你的言語必微細出於塵埃。你的聲音必像那交鬼者的聲音出於地；你的言語低低微微出於塵埃。
english: And you will be made low, and your voice will come out of the earth, and your words will be low out of the dust; and your voice will come out of the earth like that of a spirit, making bird-like noises out of the dust.

chinese: 你仇敵的群眾，卻要像細塵；強暴人的群眾，也要像飛糠。這事必頃刻之間忽然臨到。
english: And the army of your attackers will be like small dust, and all the cruel ones like dry stems gone before the wind; suddenly it will come about.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華必用雷轟、地震、大聲、旋風、暴風，並吞滅的火燄，向他討罪。
english: The Lord of armies will come in with thunder and earth-shaking and great noise, with rushing wind and storm, and the flame of burning fire.

chinese: 那時，攻擊亞利伊勒列國的群眾，就是一切攻擊亞利伊勒和他的保障，並使他困難的，必如夢景，如夜間的異象；
english: And all the nations making war on Ariel, and all those who are fighting against her and shutting her in with their towers, will be like a dream, like a vision of the night.

chinese: 又必像飢餓的人夢中吃飯，醒了仍覺腹空；或像口渴的人夢中喝水，醒了仍覺發昏，心裡想喝。攻擊錫安山列國的群眾也必如此。
english: And it will be like a man desiring food, and dreaming that he is feasting; but when he is awake there is nothing in his mouth: or like a man in need of water, dreaming that he is drinking; but when he is awake he is feeble and his soul is full of desire: so will all the nations be which make war on Mount Zion.

chinese: 你們等候驚奇吧！你們宴樂昏迷吧！他們醉了，卻非因酒；他們東倒西歪，卻非因濃酒。
english: Be surprised and full of wonder; let your eyes be covered and be blind: be overcome, but not with wine; go with uncertain steps, but not because of strong drink.

chinese: 因為耶和華將沉睡的靈澆灌你們，封閉你們的眼，蒙蓋你們的頭。你們的眼就是先知；你們的頭就是先見。
english: For the Lord has sent on you a spirit of deep sleep; and by him your eyes, the prophets, are shut, and your heads, the seers, are covered.

chinese: 所有的默示，你們看如封住的書卷，人將這書卷交給識字的，說：請念吧！他說：我不能念，因為是封住了。
english: And the vision of all this has become to you like the words of a book which is shut, which men give to one who has knowledge of writing, saying, Make clear to us what is in the book: and he says, I am not able to, for the book is shut:

chinese: 又將這書卷交給不識字的人，說：請念吧！他說：我不識字。
english: And they give it to one without learning, saying, Make clear to us what is in the book: and he says, I have no knowledge of writing.

chinese: 主說：因為這百姓親近我，用嘴唇尊敬我，心卻遠離我；他們敬畏我，不過是領受人的吩咐。
english: And the Lord said, because this people come near to me with their mouths, and give honour to me with their lips, but their heart is far from me, and their fear of me is false, a rule given them by the teaching of men;

chinese: 所以，我在這百姓中要行奇妙的事，就是奇妙又奇妙的事。他們智慧人的智慧必然消滅，聰明人的聰明必然隱藏。
english: For this cause I will again do a strange thing among this people, a thing to be wondered at: and the wisdom of their wise men will come to nothing, and the sense of their guides will no longer be seen.

chinese: 禍哉！那些向耶和華深藏謀略的，又在暗中行事，說：誰看見我們呢？誰知道我們呢？
english: Cursed are those who go deep to keep their designs secret from the Lord, and whose works are in the dark, and who say, Who sees us? and who has knowledge of our acts?

chinese: 你們把事顛倒了，豈可看窯匠如泥嗎？被製作的物豈可論製作物的說：他沒有製作我？或是被創造的物論造物的說：他沒有聰明。
english: You are turning things upside down! Is the wet earth the same to you as the one who is forming it? will the thing made say of him who made it, He made me not: or the thing formed say of him who gave it form, He has no knowledge?

chinese: 利巴嫩變為肥田，肥田看如樹林，不是只有一點點時候嗎？
english: In a very short time Lebanon will become a fertile field, and the fertile field will seem like a wood.

chinese: 那時，聾子必聽見這書上的話；瞎子的眼必從迷矇黑暗中得以看見。
english: And in that day those whose ears are stopped will be hearing the words of the book; and the eyes of the blind will see through the mist and the dark.

chinese: 謙卑人必因耶和華增添歡喜；人間貧窮的必因以色列的聖者快樂。
english: And the poor will have their joy in the Lord increased, and those in need will be glad in the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 因為，強暴人已歸無有，褻慢人已經滅絕，一切找機會作孽的都被剪除。
english: For the cruel one has come to nothing; and those who make sport of the Lord are gone; and those who are watching to do evil are cut off:

chinese: 他們在爭訟的事上定無罪的為有罪，為城門口責備人的設下網羅，用虛無的事屈枉義人。
english: Who give help to a man in a wrong cause, and who put a net for the feet of him who gives decisions in the public place, taking away a man's right without cause.

chinese: 所以，救贖亞伯拉罕的耶和華論雅各家如此說：雅各必不再羞愧，面容也不致變色。
english: For this reason the Lord, the saviour of Abraham, says about the family of Jacob, Jacob will not now be put to shame, or his face be clouded with fear.

chinese: 但他看見他的眾子，就是我手的工作在他那裡，他們必尊我的名為聖，必尊雅各的聖者為聖，必敬畏以色列的神。
english: But when they, the children of Jacob, see the work of my hands among them, they will give honour to my name; yes, they will give honour to the Holy One of Jacob, and go in fear of the God of Israel.

chinese: 心中迷糊的必得明白；發怨言的必受訓誨。
english: Those whose hearts were turned away from him will get knowledge, and those who made an outcry against him will give attention to his teaching.

chinese: 耶和華說：禍哉！這悖逆的兒女。他們同謀，卻不由於我，結盟，卻不由於我的靈，以致罪上加罪；
english: Ho! uncontrolled children, says the Lord, who give effect to a purpose which is not mine, and who make an agreement, but not by my spirit, increasing their sin:

chinese: 起身下埃及去，並沒有求問我；要靠法老的力量加添自己的力量，並投在埃及的蔭下。
english: Who make a move to go down into Egypt, without authority from me; who are looking to the strength of Pharaoh for help, and whose hope is in the shade of Egypt.

chinese: 所以，法老的力量必作你們的羞辱；投在埃及的蔭下，要為你們的慚愧。
english: And the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and your hope in the shade of Egypt will come to nothing.

chinese: 他們的首領已在瑣安；他們的使臣到了哈內斯。
english: For his chiefs are at Zoan, and his representatives have come to Hanes.

chinese: 他們必因那不利於他們的民蒙羞。那民並非幫助，也非利益，只作羞恥凌辱。
english: For they have all come with offerings to a people of no use to them, in whom is no help or profit, but only shame and a bad name.

chinese: 論南方牲畜的默示：他們把財物馱在驢駒的脊背上，將寶物馱在駱駝的肉鞍上，經過艱難困苦之地，就是公獅、母獅、蝮蛇、火燄的飛龍之地，往那不利於他們的民那裡去。
english: The word about the Beasts of the South. Through the land of trouble and grief, the land of the she-lion and the voice of the lion, of the snake and the burning winged snake, they take their wealth on the backs of young asses, and their stores on camels, to a people in whom is no profit.

chinese: 埃及的幫助是徒然無益的；所以我稱他為坐而不動的拉哈伯。
english: For there is no use or purpose in the help of Egypt: so I have said about her, She is Rahab, who has come to an end.

chinese: 現今你去，在他們面前將這話刻在版上，寫在書上，以便傳留後世，直到永永遠遠。
english: Now go, put it in writing before them on a board, and make a record of it in a book, so that it may be for the future, a witness for all time to come.

chinese: 因為他們是悖逆的百姓、說謊的兒女，不肯聽從耶和華訓誨的兒女。
english: For they are an uncontrolled people, false-hearted, who will not give ear to the teaching of the Lord:

chinese: 他們對先見說：不要望見不吉利的事，對先知說：不要向我們講正直的話；要向我們說柔和的話，言虛幻的事。
english: Who say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Do not give us word of what is true, but say false things to give us pleasure:

chinese: 你們要離棄正道，偏離直路，不要在我們面前再提說以色列的聖者。
english: Get out of the good way, turning from the right road; do not keep the Holy One of Israel before our minds.

chinese: 所以，以色列的聖者如此說：因為你們藐視這訓誨的話，倚賴欺壓和乖僻，以此為可靠的，
english: For this cause the Holy One of Israel says, Because you will not give ear to this word, and are looking for help in ways of deceit and evil, and are putting your hope in them:

chinese: 故此，這罪孽在你們身上，好像將要破裂凸出來的高牆，頃刻之間忽然坍塌；
english: This sin will be to you like a crack in a high wall, causing its fall suddenly and in a minute.

chinese: 要被打碎，好像把窯匠的瓦器打碎，毫不顧惜，甚至碎塊中找不到一片可用以從爐內取火，從池中舀水。
english: And he will let it be broken as a potter's vessel is broken: it will be smashed to bits without mercy; so that there will not be a bit in which one may take fire from the fireplace, or water from the spring.

chinese: 主耶和華─以色列的聖者曾如此說：你們得救在乎歸回安息；你們得力在乎平靜安穩；你們竟自不肯。
english: For the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, said, In quiet and rest is your salvation: peace and hope are your strength: but you would not have it so.

chinese: 你們卻說：不然，我們要騎馬奔走。所以你們必然奔走；又說：我們要騎飛快的牲口。所以追趕你們的，也必飛快。
english: Saying, No, for we will go in flight on horses; so you will certainly go in flight: and, We will go on the backs of quick-running beasts; so those who go after you will be quick-footed.

chinese: 一人叱喝，必令千人逃跑；五人叱喝，你們都必逃跑；以致剩下的，好像山頂的旗杆，岡上的大旗。
english: A thousand will go in fear before one; even before five you will go in flight: till you are like a pillar by itself on the top of a mountain, and like a flag on a hill.

chinese: 耶和華必然等候，要施恩給你們；必然興起，好憐憫你們。因為耶和華是公平的神；凡等候他的都是有福的！
english: For this cause the Lord will be waiting, so that he may be kind to you; and he will be lifted up, so that he may have mercy on you; for the Lord is a God of righteousness: there is a blessing on all whose hope is in him.

chinese: 百姓必在錫安、在耶路撒冷居住；你不要哭泣。主必因你哀求的聲音施恩給你；他聽見的時候就必應允你。
english: O people, living in Zion, at Jerusalem, your weeping will be ended; he will certainly have mercy on you at the sound of your cry; when it comes to his ear, he will give you an answer.

chinese: 主雖以艱難給你當餅，以困苦給你當水，你的教師卻不再隱藏；你眼必看見你的教師。
english: And though the Lord will give you the bread of trouble and the water of grief, you will no longer put your teacher on one side, but you will see your teacher:

chinese: 你或向左或向右，你必聽見後邊有聲音說：這是正路，要行在其間。
english: And at your back, when you are turning to the right hand or to the left, a voice will be sounding in your ears, saying, This is the way in which you are to go.

chinese: 你雕刻偶像所包的銀子和鑄造偶像所鍍的金子，你要玷污，要拋棄，好像污穢之物，對偶像說：去罷！
english: And you will make unclean what is covering your pictured images of silver, and the plating of your images of gold: you will send them away as an unclean thing, saying, Be gone!

chinese: 你將種子撒在地裡，主必降雨在其上，並使地所出的糧肥美豐盛。到那時，你的牲畜必在寬闊的草場吃草。
english: And he will give rain for your seed, so that you may put it in the earth; and you will have bread from the produce of the earth, good and more than enough for your needs: in that day the cattle will get their food in wide grass-lands.

chinese: 耕地的牛和驢駒必吃加鹽的料；這料是用木杴和杈子揚淨的。
english: And the oxen and the young asses which are used for ploughing, will have salted grain which has been made free from the waste with fork and basket.

chinese: 在大行殺戮的日子，高臺倒塌的時候，各高山岡陵必有川流河湧。
english: And there will be rivers and streams of water on every tall mountain and on every high hill, in the day when great numbers are put to the sword, when the towers come down.

chinese: 當耶和華纏裹他百姓的損處，醫治他民鞭傷的日子，月光必像日光，日光必加七倍，像七日的光一樣。
english: And the light of the moon will be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times greater, as the light of seven days, in the day when the Lord puts oil on the wounds of his people, and makes them well from the blows they have undergone.

chinese: 看哪，耶和華的名從遠方來，怒氣燒起，密煙上騰。他的嘴唇滿有忿恨；他的舌頭像吞滅的火。
english: See, the name of the Lord is coming from far, burning with his wrath, with thick smoke going up: his lips are full of passion, and his tongue is like a burning fire:

chinese: 他的氣如漲溢的河水，直漲到頸項，要用毀滅的篩籮篩淨列國，並且在眾民的口中必有使人錯行的嚼環。
english: And his breath is as an overflowing stream, coming up even to the neck, shaking the nations for their destruction, like the shaking of grain in a basket: and he will put a cord in the mouths of the people, turning them out of their way.

chinese: 你們必唱歌，像守聖節的夜間一樣，並且心中喜樂，像人吹笛，上耶和華的山，到以色列的磐石那裡。
english: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept; and you will be glad in heart, as when they go with music of the pipe to the mountain of the Lord, the Rock of Israel.

chinese: 耶和華必使人聽他威嚴的聲音，又顯他降罰的膀臂和他怒中的忿恨，並吞滅的火燄與霹雷、暴風、冰雹。
english: And the Lord will send out the sound of his great voice, and they will see his arm stretched out, with the heat of his wrath, and the flame of a burning fire; with a cloud-burst, and storm, and a rain of ice.

chinese: 亞述人必因耶和華的聲音驚惶；耶和華必用杖擊打他。
english: For through the voice of the Lord the Assyrian will be broken, and the Lord's rod will be lifted up against him.

chinese: 耶和華必將命定的杖加在他身上；每打一下，人必擊鼓彈琴。打杖的時候，耶和華必掄起手來，與他交戰。
english: And every blow of the rod of his punishment, which the Lord will send on him, will be with the sound of music: and with the waving of his sword the Lord will make war against him.

chinese: 原來陀斐特又深又寬，早已為王預備好了；其中堆的是火與許多木柴。耶和華的氣如一股硫磺火使他著起來。
english: For a place of fire has long been ready; yes, it has been made ready for the king; he has made it deep and wide: it is massed with fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord, like a stream of fire, puts a light to it.

chinese: 禍哉！那些下埃及求幫助的，是因仗賴馬匹，倚靠甚多的車輛，並倚靠強壯的馬兵，卻不仰望以色列的聖者，也不求問耶和華。
english: Cursed are those who go down to Egypt for help, and who put their faith in horses; looking to war-carriages for salvation, because of their numbers; and to horsemen, because they are very strong; but they are not looking to the Holy One of Israel, or turning their hearts to the Lord;

chinese: 其實，耶和華有智慧；他必降災禍，並不反悔自己的話，卻要興起攻擊那作惡之家，又攻擊那作孽幫助人的。
english: Though he is wise, and able to send evil, and his purpose will not be changed; but he will go against the house of the evil-doers, and against those to whom they are looking for help.

chinese: 埃及人不過是人，並不是神；他們的馬不過是血肉，並不是靈。耶和華一伸手，那幫助人的必絆跌，那受幫助的也必跌倒，都一同滅亡。
english: For the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses are flesh, and not spirit: and when the Lord's hand is stretched out, the helper and he who is helped will come down together.

chinese: 耶和華對我如此說：獅子和少壯獅子護食咆哮，就是喊許多牧人來攻擊他，他總不因他們的聲音驚惶，也不因他們的喧嘩縮伏。如此，萬軍之耶和華也必降臨在錫安山岡上爭戰。
english: For the Lord has said to me, As a lion, or a young lion, makes an angry noise over his food, and if a band of herdsmen come out against him, he will not be in fear of their voices, or give up his food for their noise: so the Lord of armies will come down to make war against Mount Zion and its hill.

chinese: 雀鳥怎樣搧翅覆雛，萬軍之耶和華也要照樣保護耶路撒冷。他必保護拯救，要越門保守。
english: Like birds with outstretched wings, so will the Lord of armies be a cover to Jerusalem; he will be a cover and salvation for it, going over it he will keep it from danger.

chinese: 以色列人哪，你們深深地悖逆耶和華，現今要歸向他。
english: Come back to him who has been so deeply sinned against by the children of Israel.

chinese: 到那日，各人必將他金偶像銀偶像，就是親手所造、陷自己在罪中的，都拋棄了。
english: For in that day they will all give up their images of silver and of gold, the sin which they made for themselves.

chinese: 亞述人必倒在刀下，並非人的刀；有刀要將他吞滅，並非人的刀。他必逃避這刀；他的少年人必成為服苦的。
english: Then the Assyrian will come down by the sword, but not of man; the sword, not of men, will be the cause of his destruction: and he will go in flight from the sword, and his young men will be put to forced work.

chinese: 他的磐石必因驚嚇挪去；他的首領必因大旗驚惶。這是那有火在錫安、有爐在耶路撒冷的耶和華說的。
english: And his rock will come to nothing because of fear, and his chiefs will go in flight from the flag, says the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, and his altar in Jerusalem.

chinese: 看哪，必有一王憑公義行政；必有首領藉公平掌權。
english: See, a king will be ruling in righteousness, and chiefs will give right decisions.

chinese: 必有一人像避風所和避暴雨的隱密處，又像河流在乾旱之地，像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。
english: And a man will be as a safe place from the wind, and a cover from the storm; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shade of a great rock in a waste land.

chinese: 那能看的人，眼不再昏迷；能聽的人，耳必得聽聞。
english: And the eyes of those who see will not be shut, and those who have hearing will give ear to the word.

chinese: 冒失人的心必明白知識；結巴人的舌必說話通快。
english: The man of sudden impulses will become wise in heart, and he whose tongue is slow will get the power of talking clearly.

chinese: 愚頑人不再稱為高明，吝嗇人不再稱為大方。
english: The foolish man will no longer be named noble, and they will not say of the false man that he is a man of honour.

chinese: 因為愚頑人必說愚頑話，心裡想作罪孽，慣行褻瀆的事，說錯謬的話攻擊耶和華，使飢餓的人無食可吃，使口渴的人無水可喝。
english: For the foolish man will say foolish things, having evil thoughts in his heart, working what is unclean, and talking falsely about the Lord, to keep food from him who is in need of it, and water from him whose soul is desiring it.

chinese: 吝嗇人所用的法子是惡的；他圖謀惡計，用謊言毀滅謙卑人；窮乏人講公理的時候，他也是這樣行。
english: The designs of the false are evil, purposing the destruction of the poor man by false words, even when he is in the right.

chinese: 高明人卻謀高明事，在高明事上也必永存。
