english: But the noble-hearted man has noble purposes, and by these he will be guided.

chinese: 安逸的婦女啊，起來聽我的聲音！無慮的女子啊，側耳聽我的言語！
english: Give ear to my voice, you women who are living in comfort; give attention to my words, you daughters who have no fear of danger.

chinese: 無慮的女子啊，再過一年多，必受騷擾；因為無葡萄可摘，無果子（或譯：禾稼）可收。
english: In not much more than a year, you, who are not looking for evil, will be troubled: for the produce of the vine-gardens will be cut off, and there will be no getting in of the grapes.

chinese: 安逸的婦女啊，要戰兢；無慮的女子啊，要受騷擾。脫去衣服，赤著身體，腰束麻布。
english: Be shaking with fear, you women who are living in comfort; be troubled, you who have no fear of danger: take off your robes and put on clothing of grief.

chinese: 他們必為美好的田地和多結果的葡萄樹，搥胸哀哭。
english: Have sorrow for the fields, the pleasing fields, the fertile vine;

chinese: 荊棘蒺藜必長在我百姓的地上，又長在歡樂的城中和一切快樂的房屋上。
english: And for the land of my people, where thorns will come up; even for all the houses of joy in the glad town.

chinese: 因為宮殿必被撇下，多民的城必被離棄；山岡望樓永為洞穴，作野驢所喜樂的，為羊群的草場。
english: For the fair houses will have no man living in them; the town which was full of noise will become a waste; the hill and the watchtower will be unpeopled for ever, a joy for the asses of the woods, a place of food for the flocks;

chinese: 等到聖靈從上澆灌我們，曠野就變為肥田，肥田看如樹林。
english: Till the spirit comes on us from on high, and the waste land becomes a fertile field, and the fertile field is changed into a wood.

chinese: 那時，公平要居在曠野；公義要居在肥田。
english: Then in the waste land there will be an upright rule, and righteousness will have its place in the fertile field.

chinese: 公義的果效必是平安；公義的效驗必是平穩，直到永遠。
english: And the work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of an upright rule will be to take away fear for ever.

chinese: 我的百姓必住在平安的居所，安穩的住處，平靜的安歇所。
english: And my people will be living in peace, in houses where there is no fear, and in quiet resting-places.

chinese: （但要降冰雹打倒樹林；城必全然拆平。）
english: But the tall trees will come down with a great fall, and the town will be low in a low place.

chinese: 你們在各水邊撒種、牧放牛驢的有福了！
english: Happy are you who are planting seed by all the waters, and sending out the ox and the ass.

chinese: 禍哉！你這毀滅人的，自己倒不被毀滅；行事詭詐的，人倒不以詭詐待你。你毀滅罷休了，自己必被毀滅；你行完了詭詐，人必以詭詐待你。
english: Ho! you who make waste those who did not make you waste; acting falsely to those who were not false to you. When you have come to an end of wasting, you will be made waste, and after your false acts, they will do the same to you.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你施恩於我們；我們等候你。求你每早晨作我們的膀臂，遭難的時候為我們的拯救。
english: O Lord, have mercy on us; for we have been waiting for your help: be our strength every morning, our salvation in time of trouble.

chinese: 喧嚷的響聲一發，眾民奔逃；你一興起，列國四散。
english: At the loud noise the peoples have gone in flight; at your coming up the nations have gone in all directions.

chinese: 你們所擄的必被斂盡，好像螞蚱吃（原文是斂）盡禾稼。人要蹦在其上，好像蝗蟲一樣。
english: And the goods taken in war will be got together like the massing of young locusts; men will be rushing on them like the rushing of locusts.

chinese: 耶和華被尊崇，因他居在高處；他以公平公義充滿錫安。
english: The Lord is lifted up; his place is on high: he has made Zion full of righteousness and true religion.

chinese: 你一生一世必得安穩─有豐盛的救恩，並智慧和知識；你以敬畏耶和華為至寶。
english: And she will have no more fear of change, being full of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge: the fear of the Lord is her wealth.

chinese: 看哪，他們的豪傑在外頭哀號；求和的使臣痛痛哭泣。
english: See, the men of war are sorrowing outside the town: those who came looking for peace are weeping bitterly.

chinese: 大路荒涼，行人止息；敵人背約，藐視城邑，不顧人民。
english: The highways are waste, no man is journeying there: the agreement is broken, he has made sport of the towns, he has no thought for man.

chinese: 地上悲哀衰殘；利巴嫩羞愧枯乾；沙崙像曠野；巴珊和迦密的樹林凋殘。
english: The earth is sorrowing and wasting away; Lebanon is put to shame and has become waste; Sharon is like the Arabah; and in Bashan and Carmel the leaves are falling.

chinese: 耶和華說：現在我要起來；我要興起；我要勃然而興。
english: Now will I come forward, says the Lord; now will I be lifted up; now will my power be seen.

chinese: 你們要懷的是糠秕，要生的是碎秸；你們的氣就是吞滅自己的火。
english: Your designs will be without profit, and their effect will be nothing: you will be burned up by the fire of my breath.

chinese: 列邦必像已燒的石灰，像已割的荊棘在火中焚燒。
english: And the peoples will be like the burning of chalk: as thorns cut down, which are burned in the fire.

chinese: 你們遠方的人當聽我所行的；你們近處的人當承認我的大能。
english: Give ear, you who are far off, to what I have done: see my power, you who are near.

chinese: 錫安中的罪人都懼怕；不敬虔的人被戰兢抓住。我們中間誰能與吞滅的火同住？我們中間誰能與永火同住呢？
english: The sinners in Zion are full of fear; the haters of God are shaking with wonder. Who among us may keep his place before the burning fire? who among us may see the eternal burnings?

chinese: 行事公義、說話正直、憎惡欺壓的財利、擺手不受賄賂、塞耳不聽流血的話，閉眼不看邪惡事的，
english: He whose ways are true, and whose words are upright; he who gives no thought to the profits of false acts, whose hands have not taken rewards, who will have no part in putting men to death, and whose eyes are shut against evil;

chinese: 他必居高處；他的保障是磐石的堅壘；他的糧必不缺乏（原文是賜給）；他的水必不斷絕。
english: He will have a place on high: he will be safely shut in by the high rocks: his bread will be given to him; his waters will be certain.

chinese: 你的眼必見王的榮美，必見遼闊之地。
english: Your eyes will see the king in his glory: they will be looking on a far-stretching land.

chinese: 你的心必思想那驚嚇的事，自問說：記數目的在哪裡呢？平貢銀的在哪裡呢？數戍樓的在哪裡呢？
english: Your heart will give thought to the cause of your fear: where is the scribe, where is he who made a record of the payments, where is he by whom the towers were numbered?

chinese: 你必不見那強暴的民，就是說話深奧，你不能明白，言語呢喃，你不能懂得的。
english: Never again will you see the cruel people, a people whose tongue has no sense for you; whose language is strange to you.

chinese: 你要看錫安─我們守聖節的城！你的眼必見耶路撒冷為安靜的居所，為不挪移的帳幕，橛子永不拔出，繩索一根也不折斷。
english: Let your eyes be resting on Zion, the town of our holy feasts: you will see Jerusalem, a quiet resting-place, a tent which will not be moved, whose tent-pins will never be pulled up, and whose cords will never be broken.

chinese: 在那裡，耶和華必顯威嚴與我們同在，當作江河寬闊之地；其中必沒有盪槳搖櫓的船來往，也沒有威武的船經過。
english: But there the Lord will be with us in his glory, ... wide rivers and streams; where no boat will go with blades, and no fair ship will be sailing.

chinese: 因為，耶和華是審判我們的；耶和華是給我們設律法的；耶和華是我們的王；他必拯救我們。
english: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our law-giver, the Lord is our king; he will be our saviour.

chinese: 你的繩索鬆開：不能栽穩桅杆，也不能揚起篷來。那時許多擄來的物被分了；瘸腿的把掠物奪去了。
english: Your cords have become loose; they were not able to make strong the support of their sails, the sail was not stretched out: then the blind will take much property, the feeble-footed will make division of the goods of war.

chinese: 城內居民必不說：我病了；其中居住的百姓，罪孽都赦免了。
english: And the men of Zion will not say, I am ill: for its people will have forgiveness for their sin.

chinese: 列國啊，要近前來聽！眾民哪，要側耳而聽！地和其上所充滿的，世界和其中一切所出的都應當聽！
english: Come near, you nations, and give ear; take note, you peoples: let the earth and everything in it give ear; the world and all those living in it.

chinese: 因為耶和華向萬國發忿恨，向他們的全軍發烈怒，將他們滅盡，交出他們受殺戮。
english: For the Lord is angry with all the nations, and his wrath is burning against all their armies: he has put them to the curse, he has given them to destruction.

chinese: 被殺的必然拋棄，屍首臭氣上騰；諸山被他們的血融化。
english: Their dead bodies will be thick on the face of the earth, and their smell will come up, and the mountains will be flowing with their blood, and all the hills will come to nothing.

chinese: 天上的萬象都要消沒；天被捲起，好像書卷。其上的萬象要殘敗，像葡萄樹的葉子殘敗，又像無花果樹的葉子殘敗一樣。
english: And the heavens will be rolled together like the roll of a book: and all their army will be gone, like a dead leaf from the vine, or a dry fruit from the fig-tree.

chinese: 因為我的刀在天上已經喝足；這刀必臨到以東和我所咒詛的民，要施行審判。
english: For my sword in heaven is full of wrath: see, it is coming down on Edom, in punishment on the people of my curse.

chinese: 耶和華的刀滿了血，用脂油和羊羔、公山羊的血，並公綿羊腰子的脂油滋潤的；因為耶和華在波斯拉有獻祭的事，在以東地大行殺戮。
english: The sword of the Lord is full of blood, it is fat with the best of the meat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the best parts of the sheep: for the Lord has a feast in Bozrah, and much cattle will be put to death in the land of Edom.

chinese: 野牛、牛犢，和公牛要一同下來。他們的地喝醉了血；他們的塵土因脂油肥潤。
english: And the strong oxen will go down to death together with the smaller cattle.

chinese: 因耶和華有報仇之日，為錫安的爭辯有報應之年。
english: For it is the day of the Lord's punishment, when he gives payment for the wrongs done to Zion.

chinese: 以東的河水要變為石油，塵埃要變為硫磺；地土成為燒著的石油，
english: And its streams will be turned into boiling oil, and its dust into burning stone, and all the land will be on fire.

chinese: 晝夜總不熄滅，煙氣永遠上騰，必世世代代成為荒廢，永永遠遠無人經過。
english: It will not be put out day or night; its smoke will go up for ever: it will be waste from generation to generation; no one will go through it for ever.

chinese: 鵜鶘、箭豬卻要得為業；貓頭鷹、烏鴉要住在其間。耶和華必將空虛的準繩，混沌的線鉈，拉在其上。
english: But the birds of the waste land will have their place there; it will be a heritage for the bittern and the raven: and it will be measured out with line and weight as a waste land.

chinese: 以東人要召貴冑來治國；那裡卻無一個，首領也都歸於無有。
english: The jackals will be there, and her great ones will be gone; they will say, There is no longer a kingdom there, and all her chiefs will have come to an end.

chinese: 以東的宮殿要長荊棘；保障要長蒺藜和刺草；要作野狗的住處，鴕鳥的居所。
english: And thorns will come up in her fair houses, and waste plants in her strong towers: and foxes will make their holes there, and it will be a meeting-place for ostriches.

chinese: 曠野的走獸要和豺狼相遇；野山羊要與伴偶對叫。夜間的怪物必在那裡棲身，自找安歇之處。
english: And the beasts of the waste places will come together with the jackals, and the evil spirits will be crying to one another, even the night-spirit will come and make her resting-place there.

chinese: 箭蛇要在那裡做窩，下蛋，菢蛋，生子，聚子在其影下；鷂鷹各與伴偶聚集在那裡。
english: The arrowsnake will make her hole and put her eggs there, and get her young together under her shade: there the hawks will come together by twos.

chinese: 你們要查考宣讀耶和華的書。這都無一缺少，無一沒有伴偶；因為我的口已經吩咐，他的靈將他們聚集。
english: See what is recorded in the book of the Lord: all these will be there, not one without the other: the mouth of the Lord has given the order, and his spirit has made them come together.

chinese: 他也為他們拈鬮，又親手用準繩給他們分地；他們必永得為業，世世代代住在其間。
english: And he has given them their heritage, and by his hand it has been measured out to them: it will be theirs for ever, their resting-place from generation to generation.

chinese: 曠野和乾旱之地必然歡喜；沙漠也必快樂；又像玫瑰開花，
english: The waste land and the dry places will be glad; the lowland will have joy and be full of flowers.

chinese: 必開花繁盛，樂上加樂，而且歡呼。利巴嫩的榮耀，並迦密與沙崙的華美，必賜給他。人必看見耶和華的榮耀，我們神的華美。
english: It will be flowering like the rose; it will be full of delight and songs; the glory of Lebanon will be given to it; the pride of Carmel and Sharon: they will see the glory of the Lord, the power of our God.

chinese: 你們要使軟弱的手堅壯，無力的膝穩固。
english: Make strong the feeble hands, give support to the shaking knees.

chinese: 對膽怯的人說：你們要剛強，不要懼怕。看哪，你們的神必來報仇，必來施行極大的報應；他必來拯救你們。
english: Say to those who are full of fear, Be strong and take heart: see, your God will give punishment; the reward of God will come; he himself will come to be your saviour.

chinese: 那時，瞎子的眼必睜開；聾子的耳必開通。
english: Then the eyes of the blind will see, and the ears which are stopped will be open.

chinese: 那時，瘸子必跳躍像鹿；啞巴的舌頭必能歌唱。在曠野必有水發出；在沙漠必有河湧流。
english: Then will the feeble-footed be jumping like a roe, and the voice which was stopped will be loud in song: for in the waste land streams will be bursting out, and waters in the dry places.

chinese: 發光的沙（或譯：蜃樓）要變為水池；乾渴之地要變為泉源。在野狗躺臥之處，必有青草、蘆葦，和蒲草。
english: And the burning sand will become a pool, and the dry earth springs of waters: the fields where the sheep take their food will become wet land, and water-plants will take the place of grass.

chinese: 在那裡必有一條大道，稱為聖路。污穢人不得經過，必專為贖民行走；行路的人雖愚昧，也不致失迷。
english: And a highway will be there; its name will be, The Holy Way; the unclean and the sinner may not go over it, and those who go on it will not be turned out of the way by the foolish.

chinese: 在那裡必沒有獅子，猛獸也不登這路；在那裡都遇不見，只有贖民在那裡行走。
english: No lion will be there, or any cruel beast; they will not be seen there; but those for whom the Lord has given a price,

chinese: 並且耶和華救贖的民必歸回，歌唱來到錫安；永樂必歸到他們的頭上；他們必得著歡喜快樂，憂愁歎息盡都逃避。
english: Even those whom he has made free, will come back again; they will come with songs to Zion; on their heads will be eternal joy; delight and joy will be theirs, and sorrow and sounds of grief will be gone for ever.

chinese: 希西家王十四年，亞述王西拿基立上來攻擊猶大的一切堅固城，將城攻取。
english: And it came about in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah that Sennacherib, king of Assyria, came up against all the walled towns of Judah and took them.

chinese: 亞述王從拉吉差遣拉伯沙基率領大軍往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那裡去。他就站在上池的水溝旁，在漂布地的大路上。
english: And the king of Assyria sent the Rab-shakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a strong force, and he took up his position by the stream of the higher pool, by the highway of the washerman's

chinese: 於是希勒家的兒子家宰以利亞敬，並書記舍伯那和亞薩的兒子史官約亞，出來見拉伯沙基。
english: And there came out to him Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder.

chinese: 拉伯沙基對他們說：你們去告訴希西家說，亞述大王如此說：你所倚靠的有甚麼可仗賴的呢？
english: And the Rab-shakeh said to them, Say now to Hezekiah, These are the words of the great king, the king of Assyria: In what are you placing your hope?

chinese: 你說，有打仗的計謀和能力，我看不過是虛話。你到底倚靠誰才背叛我呢？
english: You say you have a design and strength for war, but these are only words: now to whom are you looking for support, that you have gone against my authority?

chinese: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那壓傷的葦杖，人若靠這杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是這樣。
english: See, you are basing your hope on that broken rod of Egypt, which will go into a man's hand if he makes use of it for a support; for so is Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to all who put their faith in him.

chinese: 你若對我說：我們倚靠耶和華─我們的神。希西家豈不是將　神的邱壇和祭壇廢去，且對猶大和耶路撒冷的人說：你們當在這壇前敬拜麼？
english: And if you say to me, Our hope is in the Lord our God; is it not he whose high places and altars Hezekiah has taken away, saying to Judah and Jerusalem that worship may only be given before this altar?

chinese: 現在你把當頭給我主亞述王，我給你二千匹馬，看你這一面騎馬的人夠不夠。
english: And now, take a chance with my master, the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able to put horsemen on them.

chinese: 若不然，怎能打敗我主臣僕中最小的軍長呢？你竟倚靠埃及的戰車馬兵麼？
english: How then may you put to shame the least of my master's servants? and you have put your hope in Egypt for war-carriages and horsemen:

chinese: 現在我上來攻擊毀滅這地，豈沒有耶和華的意思麼？耶和華吩咐我說，你上去攻擊毀滅這地罷！
english: And have I now come to send destruction on this land without the Lord's authority? It was the Lord himself who said to me, Go up against this land and make it waste.

chinese: 以利亞敬、舍伯那、約亞對拉伯沙基說：求你用亞蘭言語和僕人說話，因為我們懂得；不要用猶大言語和我們說話，達到城上百姓的耳中。
english: Then Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to the Rab-shakeh, Please make use of the Aramaean language in talking to your servants, for we are used to it, and do not make use of the Jews' language in the hearing of the people on the wall.

chinese: 拉伯沙基說：我主差遣我來，豈是單對你和你的主說這些話麼？不也是對這些坐在城上、要與你們一同吃自己糞喝自己尿的人說麼？
english: But the Rab-shakeh said, Is it to your master or to you that my master has sent me to say these words? has he not sent me to the men seated on the wall? for they are the people who will be short of food with you when the town is shut in.

chinese: 於是，拉伯沙基站著，用猶大言語大聲喊著說：你們當聽亞述大王的話。
english: Then the Rab-shakeh got up and said with a loud voice in the Jews' language, Give ear to the words of the great king, the king of Assyria:

chinese: 王如此說：你們不要被希西家欺哄了，因他不能拯救你們。
english: This is what the king says: Do not be tricked by Hezekiah, for there is no salvation for you in him.

chinese: 也不要聽希西家使你們倚靠耶和華說：耶和華必要拯救我們，這城必不交在亞述王的手中。
english: And do not let Hezekiah make you put your faith in the Lord, saying, The Lord will certainly keep us safe, and this town will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.

chinese: 不要聽希西家的話，因亞述王如此說：你們要與我和好。出來投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄樹和無花果樹的果子，喝自己井裡的水。
english: Do not give ear to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says, Make peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone will be free to take the fruit of his vine and of his fig-tree, and the water of his spring;

chinese: 等我來領你們到一個地方，與你們本地一樣，就是有五殼和新酒之地，有糧食和葡萄園之地。
english: Till I come and take you away to a land like yours, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vine-gardens.

chinese: 你們要謹防，恐怕希西家勸導你們說：耶和華必拯救我們。列國的神有哪一個救他本國脫離亞述王的手呢？
english: Give no attention to Hezekiah when he says to you, The Lord will keep us safe. Has any one of the gods of the nations kept his land from falling into the hands of the king of Assyria?

chinese: 哈馬和亞珥拔的神在哪裡呢？西法瓦音的　神在哪裡呢？他們曾救撒瑪利亞脫離我的手麼？
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? where are the gods of Samaria? and have they kept Samaria out of my hand?

chinese: 這些國的神有誰曾救自己的國脫離我的手呢？難道耶和華能救耶路撒冷脫離我的手麼？
english: Who among all the gods of these countries have kept their country from falling into my hand, to give cause for the thought that the Lord will keep Jerusalem from falling into my hand?

chinese: 百姓靜默不言，並不回答一句，因為王曾吩咐說：不要回答他。
english: But they kept quiet and gave him no answer: for the king's order was, Give him no answer.

chinese: 當下希勒家的兒子家宰以利亞敬和書記舍伯那，並亞薩的兒子史官約亞，都撕裂衣服，來到希西家那裡，將拉伯沙基的話告訴了他。
english: Then Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothing parted as a sign of grief, and gave him an account of what the Rab-shakeh had said.

chinese: 希西家王聽見就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，進了耶和華的殿，
english: And on hearing it Hezekiah took off his robe and put on haircloth and went into the house of the Lord.

chinese: 使家宰以利亞敬和書記舍伯那，並祭司中的長老，都披上麻布，去見亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞，
english: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and the chief priests, dressed in haircloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

chinese: 對他說：希西家如此說：今日是急難、責罰、凌辱的日子，就如婦人將要生產嬰孩，卻沒有力量生產。
english: And they said to him, Hezekiah says, This day is a day of trouble and punishment and shame: for the children are ready to come to birth, but there is no strength to give birth to them.

chinese: 或者耶和華─你的神聽見拉伯沙基的話，就是他主人亞述王打發他來辱罵永生　神的話；耶和華─你的　神聽見這話就發斥責。故此，求你為餘剩的民揚聲禱告。
english: It may be that the Lord your God will give ear to the words of the Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria, his master, has sent to say evil things against the living God, and will make his words come to nothing: so make your prayer for the rest of the people.

chinese: 希西家王的臣僕就去見以賽亞。
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

chinese: 以賽亞對他們說：要這樣對你們的主人說，耶和華如此說：你聽見亞述王的僕人褻瀆我的話，不要懼怕。
english: And Isaiah said to them, This is what you are to say to your master: The Lord says, Be not troubled by the words which the servants of the king of Assyria have said against me in your hearing.

chinese: 我必驚動（原文是使靈進入）他的心；他要聽見風聲就歸回本地，我必使他在那裡倒在刀下。
english: See, I will put a spirit into him, and bad news will come to his ears, and he will go back to his land; and there I will have him put to death.

chinese: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇見亞述王攻打立拿；原來他早聽見亞述王拔營離開拉吉。
english: So the Rab-shakeh went back, and when he got there the king of Assyria was making war against Libnah: for it had come to his ears that the king of Assyria had gone away from Lachish.

chinese: 亞述王聽見人論古實王特哈加說：他出來要與你爭戰。亞述王一聽見，就打發使者去見希西家，吩咐他們說：
english: And when news came to him that Tirhakah, king of Ethiopia, had made an attack on him, ... And he sent representatives to Hezekiah, king of Judah, saying,

chinese: 你們對猶大王希西家如此說：不要聽你所倚靠的神欺哄你說：耶路撒冷必不交在亞述王的手中。
english: This is what you are to say to Hezekiah, king of Judah: Let not your God, in whom is your faith, give you a false hope, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.

chinese: 你總聽說亞述諸王向列國所行的乃是盡行滅絕，難道你還能得救嗎？
english: No doubt the story has come to your ears of what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, putting them to the curse: and will you be kept safe from their fate?

chinese: 我列祖所毀滅的，就是歌散、哈蘭、利色，和屬提拉撒的伊甸人；這些國的神何曾拯救這些國呢？
english: Did the gods of the nations keep safe those on whom my fathers sent destruction, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

chinese: 哈馬的王，亞珥拔的王，西法瓦音城的王，希拿和以瓦的王，都在哪裡呢？
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the town of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivva?

chinese: 希西家從使者手裡接過書信來，看完了，就上耶和華的殿，將書信在耶和華面前展開。
english: And Hezekiah took the letter from the hands of those who had come with it; and after reading it, Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord, opening the letter there before the Lord,

chinese: 希西家向耶和華禱告說：
english: And he made prayer to the Lord, saying,

chinese: 坐在二基路伯上萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神啊，你─惟有你是天下萬國的　神，你曾創造天地。
english: O Lord of armies, the God of Israel, seated between the winged ones, you only are the God of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made heaven and earth.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你側耳而聽；耶和華啊，求你睜眼而看，要聽西拿基立的一切話，他是打發使者來辱罵永生神的。
english: Let your ear be turned to us, O Lord; let your eyes be open, O Lord, and see: take note of all the words of Sennacherib who has sent men to say evil against the living God.

chinese: 耶和華啊，亞述諸王果然使列國和列國之地變為荒涼，
english: Truly, O Lord, the kings of Assyria have made waste all the nations and their lands,

chinese: 將列國的神像都扔在火裡；因為他本不是　神，乃是人手所造的，是木頭、石頭的，所以滅絕他。
english: And have given their gods to the fire: for they were no gods, but wood and stone, the work of men's hands; so they have given them to destruction.

chinese: 耶和華─我們的神啊，現在求你救我們脫離亞述王的手，使天下萬國都知道唯有你是耶和華。
english: But now, O Lord our God, give us salvation from his hand, so that it may be clear to all the kingdoms of the earth that you, and you only, are the Lord.

chinese: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞就打發人去見希西家，說：耶和華─以色列的神如此說，你既然求我攻擊亞述王西拿基立，
english: Then Isaiah, the son of Amoz, sent to Hezekiah, saying, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, The prayer you have made to me against Sennacherib, king of Assyria, has come to my ears.

chinese: 所以耶和華論他這樣說：錫安的處女藐視你，嗤笑你；耶路撒冷的女子向你搖頭。
english: This is the word which the Lord has said about him: In the eyes of the virgin daughter of Zion you are shamed and laughed at; the daughter of Jerusalem has made sport of you.

chinese: 你辱罵誰，褻瀆誰？揚起聲來，高舉眼目攻擊誰呢？乃是攻擊以色列的聖者。
english: Against whom have you said evil and bitter things? and against whom has your voice been loud and your eyes lifted up? even against the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 你藉你的臣僕辱罵主說：我率領許多戰車上山頂，到利巴嫩極深之處；我要砍伐其中高大的香柏樹和佳美的松樹。我必上極高之處，進入肥田的樹林。
english: You have sent your servants with evil words against the Lord, and have said, With all my war-carriages I have come up to the top of the mountains, to the inmost parts of Lebanon; and its tall cedars will be cut down, and the best trees of its woods: I will come up into his highest places, into his thick woods.

chinese: 我已經挖井喝水；我必用腳掌踏乾埃及的一切河。
english: I have made water-holes and taken their waters, and with my foot I have made all the rivers of Egypt dry.

chinese: 耶和華說：你豈沒有聽見我早先所做的，古時所立的嗎？現在藉你使堅固城荒廢，變為亂堆。
english: Has it not come to your ears how I did it long before, purposing it in times long past? Now I have given effect to my design, so that by you strong towns might be turned into masses of broken walls.

chinese: 所以其中的居民力量甚小，驚惶羞愧。他們像野草，像青菜，如房頂上的草，又如田間未長成的禾稼。
english: This is why their townsmen had no power, they were broken and put to shame; they were like the grass of the field, or a green plant; like the grass on the house-tops, which a cold wind makes waste.

chinese: 你坐下，你出去，你進來，你向我發烈怒，我都知道。
english: But I have knowledge of your getting up and your resting, of your going out and your coming in.

chinese: 因你向我發烈怒，又因你狂傲的話達到我耳中，我就要用鉤子鉤上你的鼻子，把嚼環放在你口裡，使你從原路轉回去。
english: Because your wrath against me and your pride have come to my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my cord in your lips, and I will make you go back by the way you came.

chinese: 以色列人哪，我賜你們一個證據：你們今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自長的，至於後年，你們要耕種收割，栽植葡萄園，吃其中的果子。
english: And this will be the sign to you: you will get your food this year from what comes up of itself, and in the second year from the produce of the same; and in the third year you will put in your seed, and get in the grain, and make vine-gardens, and take of their fruit.

chinese: 猶大家所逃脫餘剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上結果。
english: And those of Judah who are still living will again take root in the earth, and give fruit.

chinese: 必有餘剩的民從耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脫的人從錫安山而來。萬軍之耶和華的熱心必成就這事。
english: For from Jerusalem those who have been kept safe will go out, and those who are still living will go out of Mount Zion: by the fixed purpose of the Lord of armies this will be done.

chinese: 所以耶和華論亞述王如此說：他必不得來到這城，也不在這裡射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不築壘攻城。
english: For this cause the Lord says about the king of Assyria, He will not come into this town, or send an arrow against it; he will not come before it with arms, or put up an earthwork against it.

chinese: 他從哪條路來，必從那條路回去，必不得來到這城。這是耶和華說的。
english: By the way he came he will go back, and he will not get into this town.

chinese: 因我為自己的緣故，又為我僕人大衛的緣故，必保護拯救這城。
english: For I will keep this town safe, for my honour, and for the honour of my servant David.

chinese: 耶和華的使者出去，在亞述營中殺了十八萬五千人。清早有人起來一看，都是死屍了。
english: And the angel of the Lord went out and put to death in the army of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand men: and when the people got up early in the morning, there was nothing to be seen but dead bodies.

chinese: 亞述王西拿基立就拔營回去，住在尼尼微。
english: Sennacherib, king of Assyria, went back to his place at Nineveh.

chinese: 一日在他的神─尼斯洛廟裡叩拜，他兒子亞得米勒和沙利色用刀殺了他，就逃到亞拉臘地。他兒子以撒哈頓接續他作王。
english: And it came about, when he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer put him to death with the sword, and they went in flight into the land of Ararat. And Esar-haddon, his son, became king in his place.

chinese: 那時希西家病得要死，亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞去見他，對他說：耶和華如此說：你當留遺命與你的家，因為你必死不能活了。
english: In those days Hezekiah was ill and near death. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, The Lord says, Put your house in order; for your death is near.

chinese: 希西家就轉臉朝牆，禱告耶和華說：
english: And Hezekiah, turning his face to the wall, made his prayer to the Lord, saying,

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你記念我在你面前怎樣存完全的心，按誠實行事，又做你眼中所看為善的。希西家就痛哭了。
english: O Lord, keep in mind how I have been true to you with all my heart, and have done what is good in your eyes. And Hezekiah gave way to bitter weeping.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到以賽亞說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,

chinese: 你去告訴希西家說，耶和華─你祖大衛的神如此說：我聽見了你的禱告，看見了你的眼淚。我必加增你十五年的壽數；
english: Go to Hezekiah, and say, The Lord, the God of David, your father, says, Your prayer has come to my ears, and I have seen your weeping: see, I will give you fifteen more years of life.

chinese: 並且我要救你和這城脫離亞述王的手，也要保護這城。
english: And I will keep you and this town safe from the hands of the king of Assyria: and I will keep watch over this town.

chinese: 我─耶和華必成就我所說的。我先給你一個兆頭，
english: And Isaiah said, This is the sign the Lord will give you, that he will do what he has said:

chinese: 就是叫亞哈斯的日晷，向前進的日影往後退十度。於是，前進的日影果然在日晷上往後退了十度。
english: See, I will make the shade which has gone down on the steps of Ahaz with the sun, go back ten steps. So the shade went back the ten steps by which it had gone down.

chinese: 猶大王希西家患病已經痊愈，就作詩說：
english: The writing of Hezekiah, king of Judah, after he had been ill, and had got better from his disease.

chinese: 我說：正在我中年（或譯：晌午）之日必進入陰間的門；我餘剩的年歲不得享受。
english: I said, In the quiet of my days I am going down into the underworld: the rest of my years are being taken away from me.

chinese: 我說：我必不得見耶和華，就是在活人之地不見耶和華；我與世上的居民不再見面。
english: I said, I will not see the Lord, even the Lord in the land of the living: I will not see man again or those living in the world.

chinese: 我的住處被遷去離開我，好像牧人的帳棚一樣；我將性命捲起，像織布的捲布一樣。耶和華必將我從機頭剪斷，從早到晚，他要使我完結。
english: My resting-place is pulled up and taken away from me like a herdsman's tent: my life is rolled up like a linen-worker's thread; I am cut off from the cloth on the frame: from day even to night you give me up to pain.

chinese: 我使自己安靜直到天亮；他像獅子折斷我一切的骨頭，從早到晚，他要使我完結。
english: I am crying out with pain till the morning; it is as if a lion was crushing all my bones.

chinese: 我像燕子呢喃，像白鶴鳴叫，又像鴿子哀鳴；我因仰觀，眼睛困倦。耶和華啊，我受欺壓，求你為我作保。
english: I make cries like a bird; I give out sounds of grief like a dove: my eyes are looking up with desire; O Lord, I am crushed, take up my cause.

chinese: 我可說甚麼呢？他應許我的，也給我成就了。我因心裡的苦楚，在一生的年日必悄悄而行。
english: What am I to say? seeing that it is he who has done it: all my time of sleeping I am turning from side to side without rest.

chinese: 主啊，人得存活乃在乎此。我靈存活也全在此。所以求你使我痊愈，仍然存活。
english: O Lord, for this cause I am waiting for you, give rest to my spirit: make me well again, and let me come back to life.

chinese: 看哪，我受大苦，本為使我得平安；你因愛我的靈魂（或譯：生命）便救我脫離敗壞的坑，因為你將我一切的罪扔在你的背後。
english: See, in place of peace my soul had bitter sorrow. but you have kept back my soul from the underworld; for you have put all my sins out of your memory.

chinese: 原來，陰間不能稱謝你，死亡不能頌揚你；下坑的人不能盼望你的誠實。
english: For the underworld is not able to give you praise, death gives you no honour: for those who go down into the underworld there is no hope in your mercy.

chinese: 只有活人，活人必稱謝你，像我今日稱謝你一樣。為父的，必使兒女知道你的誠實。
english: The living, the living man, he will give you praise, as I do this day: the father will give the story of your mercy to his children.

chinese: 耶和華肯救我，所以，我們要一生一世在耶和華殿中用絲弦的樂器唱我的詩歌。
english: O Lord, quickly be my saviour; so we will make my songs to corded instruments all the days of our lives in the house of the Lord.

chinese: 以賽亞說：當取一塊無花果餅來，貼在瘡上，王必痊愈。
english: And Isaiah said, Let them take a cake of figs, and put it on the diseased place, and he will get well.

chinese: 希西家問說：我能上耶和華的殿，有甚麼兆頭呢？
english: And Hezekiah said, What is the sign that I will go up to the house of the Lord?

chinese: 那時，巴比倫王巴拉但的兒子米羅達巴拉但聽見希西家病而痊愈，就送書信和禮物給他。
english: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters with an offering to Hezekiah, because he had news that Hezekiah had been ill, and was well again.

chinese: 希西家喜歡見使者，就把自己寶庫的金子、銀子、香料、貴重的膏油，和他武庫的一切軍器，並所有的財寶都給他們看；他家中和全國之內，希西家沒有一樣不給他們看的。
english: And Hezekiah was glad at their coming, and let them see all his store of wealth, the silver and the gold and the spices and the oil, and all the house of his arms, and everything there was in his stores: there was nothing in all his house or his kingdom which he did not let them see.

chinese: 於是先知以賽亞來見希西家王，問他說：這些人說甚麼？他們從哪裡來見你？希西家說：他們從遠方的巴比倫來見我。
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, What did these men say, and where did they come from? And Hezekiah said, They came from a far country, even from Babylon.

chinese: 以賽亞說：他們在你家裡看見了甚麼？希西家說：凡我家中所有的，他們都看見了；我財寶中沒有一樣不給他們看的。
english: And he said, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah said in answer, They saw everything in my house: there is nothing among my stores which I did not let them see.

chinese: 以賽亞對希西家說：你要聽萬軍之耶和華的話：
english: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Give ear to the word of the Lord of armies:

chinese: 日子必到，凡你家裡所有的，並你列祖積蓄到如今的，都要被擄到巴比倫去，不留下一樣；這是耶和華說的。
english: Truly, the days are coming when everything in your house, and whatever your fathers have put in store till this day, will be taken away to Babylon: all will be gone.

chinese: 並且從你本身所生的眾子，其中必有被擄去、在巴比倫王宮裡當太監的。
english: And your sons, even your offspring, will they take away to be unsexed servants in the house of the king of Babylon.

chinese: 希西家對以賽亞說：你所說耶和華的話甚好，因為在我的年日中必有太平和穩固的景況。
english: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which you have said. And he said in his heart, There will be peace and quiet in my days.

chinese: 你們的神說：你們要安慰，安慰我的百姓。
english: Give comfort, give comfort, to my people, says your God.

chinese: 要對耶路撒冷說安慰的話，又向他宣告說，他爭戰的日子已滿了；他的罪孽赦免了；他為自己的一切罪，從耶和華手中加倍受罰。
english: Say kind words to the heart of Jerusalem, crying out to her that her time of trouble is ended, that her punishment is complete; that she has been rewarded by the Lord's hand twice over for all her sins.

chinese: 有人聲喊著說：在曠野預備耶和華的路（或譯：在曠野，有人聲喊著說：當預備耶和華的路），在沙漠地修平我們神的道。
english: A voice of one crying, Make ready in the waste land the way of the Lord, make level in the lowland a highway for our God.

chinese: 一切山窪都要填滿，大小山岡都要削平；高高低低的要改為平坦，崎崎嶇嶇的必成為平原。
english: Let every valley be lifted up, and every mountain and hill be made low, and let the rough places become level, and the hilltops become a valley,

chinese: 耶和華的榮耀必然顯現；凡有血氣的必一同看見；因為這是耶和華親口說的。
english: And the glory of the Lord will be made clear, and all flesh will see it together, for the mouth of the Lord has said it.

chinese: 有人聲說：你喊叫罷！有一個說：我喊叫甚麼呢？說：凡有血氣的盡都如草；他的美容都像野地的花。
english: A voice of one saying, Give a cry! And I said, What is my cry to be? All flesh is grass, and all its strength like the flower of the field.

chinese: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘，因為耶和華的氣吹在其上；百姓誠然是草。
english: The grass becomes dry, the flower is dead; because the breath of the Lord goes over it: truly the people is grass.

chinese: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘，惟有我們神的話必永遠立定。
english: The grass is dry, the flower is dead; but the word of our God is eternal.

chinese: 報好信息給錫安的啊，你要登高山；報好信息給耶路撒冷的啊，你要極力揚聲。揚聲不要懼怕，對猶大的城邑說：看哪，你們的神！
english: You who give good news to Zion, get up into the high mountain; you who give good news to Jerusalem, let your voice be strong; let it be sounding without fear; say to the towns of Judah, See, your God!

chinese: 主耶和華必像大能者臨到；他的膀臂必為他掌權。他的賞賜在他那裡；他的報應在他面前。
english: See, the Lord God will come as a strong one, ruling in power: see, those made free by him are with him, and those whom he has made safe go before him.

chinese: 他必像牧人牧養自己的羊群，用膀臂聚集羊羔抱在懷中，慢慢引導那乳養小羊的。
english: He will give food to his flock like a keeper of sheep; with his arm he will get it together, and will take up the lambs on his breast, gently guiding those which are with young.

chinese: 誰曾用手心量諸水，用手虎口量蒼天，用升斗盛大地的塵土，用秤稱山嶺，用天平平岡陵呢？
english: In the hollow of whose hand have the waters been measured? and who is able to take the heavens in his stretched-out fingers? who has got together the dust of the earth in a measure? who has taken the weight of the mountains, or put the hills into the scales?

chinese: 誰曾測度耶和華的心（或譯：誰曾指示耶和華的靈），或作他的謀士指教他呢？
english: By whom has the spirit of the Lord been guided, or who has been his teacher?

chinese: 他與誰商議，誰教導他，誰將公平的路指示他，又將知識教訓他，將通達的道指教他呢？
english: Who gave him suggestions, and made clear to him the right way? who gave him knowledge, guiding him in the way of wisdom?

chinese: 看哪，萬民都像水桶的一滴，又算如天平上的微塵；他舉起眾海島，好像極微之物。
english: See, the nations are to him like a drop hanging from a bucket, and like the small dust in the scales: he takes up the islands like small dust.

chinese: 利巴嫩的樹林不夠當柴燒；其中的走獸也不夠作燔祭。
english: And Lebanon is not enough to make a fire with, or all its cattle enough for a burned offering.

chinese: 萬民在他面前好像虛無，被他看為不及虛無，乃為虛空。
english: All the nations are as nothing before him; even less than nothing, a thing of no value.

chinese: 你們究竟將誰比神，用甚麼形像與神比較呢？
english: Whom then is God like, in your opinion? or what will you put forward as a comparison with him?

chinese: 偶像是匠人鑄造，銀匠用金包裹，為他鑄造銀鍊。
english: The workman makes an image, and the gold-worker puts gold plates over it, and makes silver bands for it.

chinese: 窮乏獻不起這樣供物的，就揀選不能朽壞的樹木，為自己尋找巧匠，立起不能搖動的偶像。
english: The wise workman makes selection of the mulberry-tree of the offering, a wood which will not become soft; so that the image may be fixed to it and not be moved.

chinese: 你們豈不曾知道麼？你們豈不曾聽見麼？從起初豈沒有人告訴你們麼？自從立地的根基，你們豈沒有明白麼？
english: Have you no knowledge of it? has it not come to your ears? has not news of it been given to you from the first? has it not been clear to you from the time when the earth was placed on its base?

chinese: 神坐在地球大圈之上；地上的居民好像蝗蟲。他鋪張穹蒼如幔子，展開諸天如可住的帳棚。
english: It is he who is seated over the arch of the earth, and the people in it are as small as locusts; by him the heavens are stretched out like an arch, and made ready like a tent for a living-place.

chinese: 他使君王歸於虛無，使地上的審判官成為虛空。
english: He makes rulers come to nothing; the judges of the earth are of no value.

chinese: 他們是剛才（或譯：不曾；下同）栽上，剛才種上，根也剛才扎在地裡，他一吹在其上，便都枯乾；旋風將他們吹去，像碎秸一樣。
english: They have only now been planted, and their seed put into the earth, and they have only now taken root, when he sends out his breath over them and they become dry, and the storm-wind takes them away like dry grass.

chinese: 那聖者說：你們將誰比我，叫他與我相等呢？
english: Who then seems to you to be my equal? says the Holy One.

chinese: 你們向上舉目，看誰創造這萬象，按數目領出，他一一稱其名；因他的權能，又因他的大能大力，連一個都不缺。
english: Let your eyes be lifted up on high, and see: who has made these? He who sends out their numbered army: who has knowledge of all their names: by whose great strength, because he is strong in power, all of them are in their places.

chinese: 雅各啊，你為何說，我的道路向耶和華隱藏？以色列啊，你為何言，我的冤屈神並不查問？
english: Why do you say, O Jacob, such words as these, O Israel, The Lord's eyes are not on my way, and my God gives no attention to my cause?

chinese: 你豈不曾知道麼？你豈不曾聽見麼？永在的神耶和華，創造地極的主，並不疲乏，也不困倦；他的智慧無法測度。
english: Have you no knowledge of it? has it not come to your ears? The eternal God, the Lord, the Maker of the ends of the earth, is never feeble or tired; there is no searching out of his wisdom.

chinese: 疲乏的，他賜能力；軟弱的，他加力量。
english: He gives power to the feeble, increasing the strength of him who has no force.

chinese: 就是少年人也要疲乏困倦；強壯的也必全然跌倒。
english: Even the young men will become feeble and tired, and the best of them will come to the end of his strength;

chinese: 但那等候耶和華的必從新得力。他們必如鷹展翅上騰；他們奔跑卻不困倦，行走卻不疲乏。
english: But those who are waiting for the Lord will have new strength; they will get wings like eagles: running, they will not be tired, and walking, they will have no weariness.

chinese: 眾海島啊，當在我面前靜默；眾民當從新得力，都要近前來才可以說話，我們可以彼此辯論。
english: Come quietly before me, O sea-lands, and let the peoples get together their strength: let them come near; then let them say what they have to say: let us put forward our cause against one another.

chinese: 誰從東方興起一人，憑公義召他來到腳前呢？耶和華將列國交給他，使他管轄君王，把他們如灰塵交與他的刀，如風吹的碎秸交與他的弓。
english: Who sent out from the east one who is right wherever he goes? he gives the nations into his hands, and makes him ruler over kings; he gives them as the dust to his sword, as dry stems before the wind to his bow.

chinese: 他追趕他們，走他所未走的道，坦然前行。
english: He goes after them safely, not touching the road with his feet.

chinese: 誰行做成就這事，從起初宣召歷代呢？就是我─耶和華！我是首先的，也與末後的同在。
english: Whose purpose and work was it? His who sent out the generations from the start. I the Lord, the first, and with the last, I am he.

chinese: 海島看見就都害怕；地極也都戰兢，就近前來。
english: The sea-lands saw it, and were in fear; the ends of the earth were shaking: they came near.

chinese: 他們各人幫助鄰舍，各人對弟兄說：壯膽罷！
english: They gave help everyone to his neighbour; and everyone said to his brother, Take heart!

chinese: 木匠勉勵銀匠，用鎚打光的勉勵打砧的，論銲工說，銲得好；又用釘子釘穩，免得偶像動搖。
english: So the metal-worker put heart into the gold-worker, and he who was hammering the metal smooth said kind words to the iron-worker, saying of the plate, It is ready: and he put it together with nails, so that there might be no slipping.

chinese: 惟你以色列─我的僕人，雅各─我所揀選的，我朋友亞伯拉罕的後裔，
english: But as for you, Israel, my servant, and you, Jacob, whom I have taken for myself, the seed of Abraham my friend:

chinese: 你是我從地極所領（原文是抓）來的，從地角所召來的，且對你說：你是我的僕人；我揀選你，並不棄絕你。
english: You whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and sent for from its farthest parts, saying to you, You are my servant, whom I have taken for myself, and whom I have not given up:

chinese: 你不要害怕，因為我與你同在；不要驚惶，因為我是你的神。我必堅固你，我必幫助你；我必用我公義的右手扶持你。
english: Have no fear, for I am with you; do not be looking about in trouble, for I am your God; I will give you strength, yes, I will be your helper; yes, my true right hand will be your support.

chinese: 凡向你發怒的必都抱愧蒙羞；與你相爭的必如無有，並要滅亡。
english: Truly, all those who are angry with you will be made low and put to shame: those desiring to do you wrong will come to nothing and never again be seen.

chinese: 與你爭競的，你要找他們也找不著；與你爭戰的必如無有，成為虛無。
english: You will make search for your haters but they will not be there; those who make war against you will be as nothing and will come to destruction.

chinese: 因為我耶和華─你的神必攙扶你的右手，對你說：不要害怕！我必幫助你。
english: For I, the Lord your God, have taken your right hand in mine, saying to you, Have no fear; I will be your helper.

chinese: 你這蟲雅各和你們以色列人，不要害怕！耶和華說：我必幫助你。你的救贖主就是以色列的聖者。
english: Have no fear, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel; I will be your helper, says the Lord, even he who takes up your cause, the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 看哪，我已使你成為有快齒打糧的新器具；你要把山嶺打得粉碎，使岡陵如同糠秕。
english: See, I will make you like a new grain-crushing instrument with teeth, crushing the mountains small, and making the hills like dry stems.

chinese: 你要把他簸揚，風要吹去；旋風要把他颳散。你倒要以耶和華為喜樂，以色列的聖者為誇耀。
english: You will send the wind over them, and it will take them away; they will go in all directions before the storm-wind: you will have joy in the Lord, and be glad in the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 困苦窮乏人尋求水卻沒有；他們因口渴，舌頭乾燥。我─耶和華必應允他們；我─以色列的神必不離棄他們。
english: The poor and crushed are looking for water where no water is, and their tongue is dry for need of it: I the Lord will give ear to their prayer, I the God of Israel will not give them up.

chinese: 我要在淨光的高處開江河，在谷中開泉源；我要使沙漠變為水池，使乾地變為湧泉。
english: I will make rivers on the dry mountain-tops, and fountains in the valleys: I will make the waste land a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

chinese: 我要在曠野種上香柏樹、皂莢樹、番石榴樹，和野橄欖樹。我在沙漠要把松樹、杉樹，並黃楊樹一同栽植；
english: I will put in the waste land the cedar, the acacia, the myrtle, and the olive-tree; and in the lowland will be planted the fir-tree, the plane, and the cypress together:

chinese: 好叫人看見、知道、思想、明白；這是耶和華的手所做的，是以色列的聖者所造的。
english: So that they may see and be wise and give their mind to it, and that it may be clear to them all that the hand of the Lord has done this, and that the Holy One of Israel has made it.

chinese: 耶和華對假神說：你們要呈上你們的案件；雅各的君說：你們要聲明你們確實的理由。
english: Put forward your cause, says the Lord; let your strong argument come out, says the King of Jacob.

chinese: 可以聲明，指示我們將來必遇的事，說明先前的是甚麼事，好叫我們思索，得知事的結局，或者把將來的事指示我們。
english: Let the future be made clear to us: give us news of the past things, so that we may give thought to them; or of the things to come, so that we may see if they are true.

chinese: 要說明後來的事，好叫我們知道你們是神。你們或降福，或降禍，使我們驚奇，一同觀看。
english: Give us word of what will be after this, so that we may be certain that you are gods: yes, do good or do evil, so that we may all see it and be surprised.

chinese: 看哪，你們屬乎虛無；你們的作為也屬乎虛空。那選擇你們的是可憎惡的。
english: But you are nothing, and your work is of no value: foolish is he who takes you for his gods.

chinese: 我從北方興起一人；他是求告我名的，從日出之地而來。他必臨到掌權的，好像臨到灰泥，彷彿窯匠踹泥一樣。
english: I have sent for one from the north, and from the dawn he has come; in my name he will get rulers together and go against them; they will be like dust, even as the wet earth is stamped on by the feet of the potter.

chinese: 誰從起初指明這事，使我們知道呢？誰從先前說明，使我們說他不錯呢？誰也沒有指明，誰也沒有說明。誰也沒有聽見你們的話。
english: Who has given knowledge of it from the first, so that we may be certain of it? and from the start, so that we may say, His word is true? There is no one who gives news, or says anything, or who gives ear to your words.

chinese: 我首先對錫安說：看哪，我要將一位報好信息的賜給耶路撒冷。
english: I was the first to give word of it to Zion, and I gave the good news to Jerusalem.

chinese: 我看的時候並沒有人；我問的時候，他們中間也沒有謀士可以回答一句。
english: And I saw that there was no man, even no wise man among them, who might give an answer to my questions.

chinese: 看哪，他們和他們的工作都是虛空，且是虛無。他們所鑄的偶像都是風，都是虛的。
english: Truly they are all nothing, their works are nothing and of no value: their metal images are of no more use than wind.

chinese: 看哪，我的僕人─我所扶持所揀選、心裡所喜悅的！我已將我的靈賜給他；他必將公理傳給外邦。
english: See my servant, whom I am supporting, my loved one, in whom I take delight: I have put my spirit on him; he will give the knowledge of the true God to the nations.

chinese: 他不喧嚷，不揚聲，也不使街上聽見他的聲音。
english: He will make no cry, his voice will not be loud: his words will not come to men's ears in the streets.

chinese: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷；將殘的燈火，他不吹滅。他憑真實將公理傳開。
english: He will not let a crushed stem be quite broken, and he will not let a feebly burning light be put out: he will go on sending out the true word to the peoples.

chinese: 他不灰心，也不喪膽，直到他在地上設立公理；海島都等候他的訓誨。
english: His light will not be put out, and he will not be crushed, till he has given the knowledge of the true God to the earth, and the sea-lands will be waiting for his teaching.

chinese: 創造諸天，鋪張穹蒼，將地和地所出的一併鋪開，賜氣息給地上的眾人，又賜靈性給行在其上之人的神耶和華，他如此說：
english: God the Lord, even he who made the heavens, measuring them out on high; stretching out the earth, and giving its produce; he who gives breath to the people on it, and life to those who go about on it, says:

chinese: 我─耶和華憑公義召你，必攙扶你的手，保守你，使你作眾民的中保（中保：原文是約），作外邦人的光，
english: I the Lord have made you the vessel of my purpose, I have taken you by the hand, and kept you safe, and I have given you to be an agreement to the people, and a light to the nations:

chinese: 開瞎子的眼，領被囚的出牢獄，領坐黑暗的出監牢。
english: To give eyes to the blind, to make free the prisoners from the prison, to let out those who are shut up in the dark.

chinese: 我是耶和華，這是我的名；我必不將我的榮耀歸給假神，也不將我的稱讚歸給雕刻的偶像。
english: I am the Lord; that is my name: I will not give my glory to another, or my praise to pictured images.

chinese: 看哪，先前的事已經成就，現在我將新事說明，這事未發以先，我就說給你們聽。
english: See, the things said before have come about, and now I give word of new things: before they come I give you news of them.

chinese: 航海的和海中所有的，海島和其上的居民，都當向耶和華唱新歌，從地極讚美他。
english: Make a new song to the Lord, and let his praise be sounded from the end of the earth; you who go down to the sea, and everything in it, the sea-lands and their people.

chinese: 曠野和其中的城邑，並基達人居住的村莊都當揚聲；西拉的居民當歡呼，在山頂上吶喊。
english: Let the waste land and its flocks be glad, the tent-circles of Kedar; let the people of the rock give a glad cry, from the top of the mountains let them make a sound of joy.

chinese: 他們當將榮耀歸給耶和華，在海島中傳揚他的頌讚。
english: Let them give glory to the Lord, sounding his praise in the sea-lands.

chinese: 耶和華必像勇士出去，必像戰士激動熱心，要喊叫，大聲吶喊，要用大力攻擊仇敵。
english: The Lord will go out as a man of war, he will be moved to wrath like a fighting-man: his voice will be strong, he will give a loud cry; he will go against his attackers like a man of war.

chinese: 我許久閉口不言，靜默不語；現在我要喊叫，像產難的婦人；我要急氣而喘哮。
english: I have long been quiet, I have kept myself in and done nothing: now I will make sounds of pain like a woman in childbirth, breathing hard and quickly.

chinese: 我要使大山小岡變為荒場，使其上的花草都枯乾；我要使江河變為洲島，使水池都乾涸。
english: I will make waste mountains and hills, drying up all their plants; and I will make rivers dry, and pools dry land.

chinese: 我要引瞎子行不認識的道，領他們走不知道的路；在他們面前使黑暗變為光明，使彎曲變為平直。這些事我都要行，並不離棄他們。
english: And I will take the blind by a way of which they had no knowledge, guiding them by roads strange to them: I will make the dark places light before them, and the rough places level. These things will I do and will not give them up.

chinese: 倚靠雕刻的偶像，對鑄造的偶像說：你是我們的神；這等人要退後，全然蒙羞。
english: They will be turned back and be greatly shamed who put their hope in pictured images, who say to metal images, You are our gods.

chinese: 你們這耳聾的，聽罷！你們這眼瞎的，看罷！使你們能看見。
english: Give ear, you whose ears are shut; and let your eyes be open, you blind, so that you may see.

chinese: 誰比我的僕人眼瞎呢？誰比我差遣的使者耳聾呢？誰瞎眼像那與我和好的？誰瞎眼像耶和華的僕人呢？
english: Who is blind, but my servant? who has his ears stopped, but he whom I send? who is blind as my true one, or who has his ears shut like the Lord's servant?

chinese: 你看見許多事卻不領會，耳朵開通卻不聽見。
english: Seeing much, but keeping nothing in mind; his ears are open, but there is no hearing.

chinese: 耶和華因自己公義的緣故，喜歡使律法（或譯：訓誨）為大，為尊。
english: It was the Lord's pleasure, because of his righteousness, to make the teaching great and give it honour.

chinese: 但這百姓是被搶被奪的，都牢籠在坑中，隱藏在獄裡；他們作掠物，無人拯救，作擄物，無人說交還。
english: But this is a people whose property has been taken away from them by force; they are all taken in holes, and shut up in prisons: they are made prisoners, and no one makes them free; they are taken by force and no one says, Give them back.

chinese: 你們中間誰肯側耳聽此，誰肯留心而聽，以防將來呢？
english: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? who will give attention to it for the time to come?

chinese: 誰將雅各交出當作擄物，將以色列交給搶奪的呢？豈不是耶和華麼？就是我們所得罪的那位。他們不肯遵行他的道，也不聽從他的訓誨。
english: Who gave up Jacob to those who took away his goods, and Israel to his attackers? Did not the Lord? he against whom they did wrong, and in whose ways they would not go, turning away from his teaching.

chinese: 所以，他將猛烈的怒氣和爭戰的勇力傾倒在以色列的身上。在他四圍如火著起，他還不知道，燒著他，他也不介意。
english: For this reason he let loose on him the heat of his wrath, and his strength was like a flame; and it put fire round about him, but he did not see it; he was burned, but did not take it to heart.

chinese: 雅各啊，創造你的耶和華，以色列啊，造成你的那位，現在如此說：你不要害怕！因為我救贖了你。我曾提你的名召你，你是屬我的。
english: But now, says the Lord your Maker, O Jacob, and your life-giver, O Israel: have no fear, for I have taken up your cause; naming you by your name, I have made you mine.

chinese: 你從水中經過，我必與你同在；你逿過江河，水必不漫過你；你從火中行過，必不被燒，火燄也不著在你身上。
english: When you go through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not go over you: when you go through the fire, you will not be burned; and the flame will have no power over you.

chinese: 因為我是耶和華─你的神，是以色列的聖者─你的救主；我已經使埃及作你的贖價，使古實和西巴代替你。
english: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your saviour; I have given Egypt as a price for you, Ethiopia and Seba for you.

chinese: 因我看你為寶為尊；又因我愛你，所以我使人代替你，使列邦人替換你的生命。
english: Because of your value in my eyes, you have been honoured, and loved by me; so I will give men for you, and peoples for your life.

chinese: 不要害怕，因我與你同在；我必領你的後裔從東方來，又從西方招聚你。
english: Have no fear, for I am with you: I will take your seed from the east, and get you together from the west;

chinese: 我要對北方說，交出來！對南方說，不要拘留！將我的眾子從遠方帶來，將我的眾女從地極領回，
english: I will say to the north, Give them up; and to the south, Do not keep them back; send back my sons from far, and my daughters from the end of the earth;

chinese: 就是凡稱為我名下的人，是我為自己的榮耀創造的，是我所做成，所造作的。
english: Every one who is named by my name, and whom I have made for my glory, who has been formed and designed by me.

chinese: 你要將有眼而瞎、有耳而聾的民都帶出來！
english: Send out the blind people who have eyes, and those who have ears, but they are shut.

chinese: 任憑萬國聚集；任憑眾民會合。其中誰能將此聲明，並將先前的事說給我們聽呢？他們可以帶出見證來，自顯為是；或者他們聽見便說：這是真的。
english: Let all the nations come together, and let the peoples be present: who among them is able to make this clear, and give us word of earlier things? let their witnesses come forward, so that they may be seen to be true, and that they may give ear, and say, It is true.

chinese: 耶和華說：你們是我的見證，我所揀選的僕人。既是這樣，便可以知道，且信服我，又明白我就是耶和華。在我以前沒有真神（真：原文是造作的）；在我以後也必沒有。
english: You are my witnesses, says the Lord, and my servant whom I have taken for myself: so that you may see and have faith in me, and that it may be clear to you that I am he; before me there was no God formed, and there will not be after me.

chinese: 惟有我是耶和華；除我以外沒有救主。
english: I, even I, am the Lord; and there is no saviour but me.

chinese: 我曾指示，我曾拯救，我曾說明，並且在你們中間沒有別神。所以耶和華說：你們是我的見證。我也是神；
english: I gave the word, and made it clear, and there was no strange god among you: for this reason you are my witnesses, says the Lord.

chinese: 自從有日子以來，我就是神；誰也不能救人脫離我手。我要行事誰能阻止呢？
english: From time long past I am God, and from this day I am he: there is no one who is able to take you out of my hand: when I undertake a thing, by whom will my purpose be changed?

chinese: 耶和華─你們的救贖主、以色列的聖者如此說：因你們的緣故，我已經打發人到巴比倫去；並且我要使迦勒底人如逃民，都坐自己喜樂的船下來。
english: The Lord, who has taken up your cause, the Holy One of Israel, says, Because of you I have sent to Babylon, and made all their seers come south, and the Chaldaeans whose cry is in the ships.

chinese: 我是耶和華─你們的聖者，是創造以色列的，是你們的君王。
english: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the Maker of Israel, your King.

chinese: 耶和華在滄海中開道，在大水中開路，
english: This is the word of the Lord, who makes a way in the sea, and a road through the deep waters;

chinese: 使車輛、馬匹、軍兵、勇士都出來，一同躺下，不再起來；他們滅沒，好像熄滅的燈火。
english: Who sends out the war-carriages and the horses, the army with all its force; they have come down, they will not get up again; like a feebly burning light they are put out.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：你們不要記念從前的事，也不要思想古時的事。
english: Give no thought to the things which are past; let the early times go out of your minds.

chinese: 看哪，我要做一件新事；如今要發現，你們豈不知道麼？我必在曠野開道路，在沙漠開江河。
english: See, I am doing a new thing; now it is starting; will you not take note of it? I will even make a way in the waste land, and rivers in the dry country.

chinese: 野地的走獸必尊重我；野狗和鴕鳥也必如此。因我使曠野有水，使沙漠有河，好賜給我的百姓、我的選民喝。
english: The beasts of the field will give me honour, the jackals and the ostriches: because I send out waters in the waste land, and rivers in the dry country, to give drink to the people whom I have taken for myself:

chinese: 這百姓是我為自己所造的，好述說我的美德。
english: Even the people whom I made to be the witnesses of my praise.

chinese: 雅各啊，你並沒有求告我；以色列啊，你倒厭煩我。
english: But you have made no prayer to me, O Jacob: and you have given no thought to me, O Israel.

chinese: 你沒有將你的羊帶來給我作燔祭，也沒有用祭物尊敬我；我沒有因供物使你服勞，也沒有因乳香使你厭煩。
english: You have not made me burned offerings of sheep, or given me honour with your offerings of beasts; I did not make you servants to give me an offering, and I did not make you tired with requests for perfumes.

chinese: 你沒有用銀子為我買菖蒲，也沒有用祭物的脂油使我飽足；倒使我因你的罪惡服勞，使我因你的罪孽厭煩。
english: You have not got me sweet-smelling plants with your money, or given me pleasure with the fat of your offerings: but you have made me a servant to your sins, and you have made me tired with your evil doings.

chinese: 惟有我為自己的緣故塗抹你的過犯；我也不記念你的罪惡。
english: I, even I, am he who takes away your sins; and I will no longer keep your evil doings in mind.

chinese: 你要提醒我，你我可以一同辯論；你可以將你的理陳明，自顯為義。
english: Put me in mind of this; let us take up the cause between us: put forward your cause, so that you may be seen to be in the right.

chinese: 你的始祖犯罪；你的師傅違背我。
english: Your first father was a sinner, and your guides have gone against my word.

chinese: 所以，我要辱沒聖所的首領，使雅各成為咒詛，使以色列成為辱罵。
english: Your chiefs have made my holy place unclean, so I have made Jacob a curse, and Israel a thing of shame.

chinese: 我的僕人雅各，我所揀選的以色列啊，現在你當聽。
english: And now, give ear, O Jacob my servant, and Israel whom I have taken for myself:

chinese: 造做你，又從你出胎造就你，並要幫助你的耶和華如此說：我的僕人雅各，我所揀選的耶書崙哪，不要害怕！
english: The Lord who made you, forming you in your mother's body, the Lord, your helper, says, Have no fear, O Jacob my servant, and you, Jeshurun, whom I have taken for myself.

chinese: 因為我要將水澆灌口渴的人，將河澆灌乾旱之地。我要將我的靈澆灌你的後裔，將我的福澆灌你的子孫。
english: For I will send water on the land needing it, and streams on the dry earth: I will let my spirit come down on your seed, and my blessing on your offspring.

chinese: 他們要發生在草中，像溪水旁的柳樹。
english: And they will come up like grass in a well-watered field, like water-plants by the streams.

chinese: 這個要說：我是屬耶和華的；那個要以雅各的名自稱；又一個要親手寫：歸耶和華的（或譯：在手上寫歸耶和華），並自稱為以色列。
english: One will say, I am the Lord's; and another will give himself the name, Jacob; another will put a mark on his hand, I am the Lord's, and another will take the name of Israel for himself.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的君，以色列的救贖主─萬軍之耶和華如此說：我是首先的，我是末後的；除我以外再沒有真神。
english: The Lord, the King of Israel, even the Lord of armies who has taken up his cause, says, I am the first and the last, and there is no God but me.

chinese: 自從我設立古時的民，誰能像我宣告，並且指明，又為自己陳說呢？讓他將未來來的事和必成的事說明。
english: If there is one like me, let him come forward and say it, let him make it clear and put it in order before me: who has made clear in the past the things to come? let him make clear the future to me.

chinese: 你們不要恐懼，也不要害怕。我豈不是從上古就說明指示你們麼？並且你們是我的見證！除我以外，豈有真神麼？誠然沒有磐石，我不知道一個！
english: Have no fear, be strong in heart; have I not made it clear to you in the past, and let you see it? and you are my witnesses. Is there any God but me, or a Rock of whom I have no knowledge?

chinese: 製造雕刻偶像的盡都虛空；他們所喜悅的都無益處；他們的見證無所看見，無所知曉，他們便覺羞愧。
english: Those who make a pictured image are all of them as nothing, and the things of their desire will be of no profit to them: and their servants see not, and have no knowledge; so they will be put to shame.

chinese: 誰製造神像，鑄造無益的偶像？
english: Whoever makes a god, makes nothing but a metal image in which there is no profit.

chinese: 看哪，他的同伴都必羞愧。工匠也不過是人，任他們聚會，任他們站立，都必懼怕，一同羞愧。
english: Truly, all those who make use of secret arts will be put to shame, and their words of power are only words of men: let them all come forward together; they will all be in fear and be put to shame.

chinese: 鐵匠把鐵在火炭中燒熱，用鎚打鐵器，用他有力的膀臂錘成；他飢餓而無力，不喝水而發倦。
english: The iron-worker is heating the metal in the fire, giving it form with his hammers, and working on it with his strong arm: then for need of food his strength gives way, and for need of water he becomes feeble.

chinese: 木匠拉線，用筆劃出樣子，用鉋子鉋成形狀，用圓尺劃了模樣，仿照人的體態，做成人形，好住在房屋中。
english: The woodworker is measuring out the wood with his line, marking it out with his pencil: after smoothing it with his plane, and making circles on it with his instrument, he gives it the form and glory of a man, so that it may be placed in the house.

chinese: 他砍伐香柏樹，又取柞（或譯：青桐）樹和橡樹，在樹林中選定了一棵。他栽種松樹，得雨長養。
english: He has cedars cut down for himself, he takes an oak and lets it get strong among the trees of the wood; he has an ash-tree planted, and the rain gives it growth.

chinese: 這樹，人可用以燒火；他自己取些烤火，又燒著烤餅，而且做神像跪拜，做雕刻的偶像向他叩拜。
english: Then it will be used to make a fire, so that a man may get warm; he has the oven heated with it and makes bread: he makes a god with it, to which he gives worship: he makes a pictured image out of it, and goes down on his face before it.

chinese: 他把一分燒在火中，把一分烤肉吃飽。自己烤火說：啊哈，我暖和了，我見火了。
english: With part of it he makes a fire, and on the fire he gets meat cooked and takes a full meal: he makes himself warm, and says, Aha! I am warm, I have seen the fire:

chinese: 他用剩下的做了一神，就是雕刻的偶像。他向這偶像俯伏叩拜，禱告他說：求你拯救我，因你是我的神。
english: And the rest of it he makes into a god, even his pictured image: he goes down on his face before it, giving worship to it, and making prayer to it, saying, Be my saviour; for you are my god.

chinese: 他們不知道，也不思想；因為耶和華閉住他們的眼，不能看見，塞住他們的心，不能明白。
english: They have no knowledge or wisdom; for he has put a veil over their eyes, so that they may not see; and on their hearts, so that they may not give attention.

chinese: 誰心裡也不醒悟，也沒有知識，沒有聰明，能說：我曾拿一分在火中燒了，在炭火上烤過餅；我也烤過肉吃。這剩下的，我豈要作可憎的物嗎？我豈可向木丕子叩拜呢？
english: And no one takes note, no one has enough knowledge or wisdom to say, I have put part of it in the fire, and made bread on it; I have had a meal of the flesh cooked with it: and am I now to make the rest of it into a false god? am I to go down on my face before a bit of wood?

chinese: 他以灰為食，心中昏迷，使他偏邪，他不能自救，也不能說：我右手中豈不是有虛謊麼？
english: As for him whose food is the dust of a dead fire, he has been turned from the way by a twisted mind, so that he is unable to keep himself safe by saying, What I have here in my hand is false.

chinese: 雅各，以色列啊，你是我的僕人，要記念這些事。以色列啊，你是我的僕人，我造就你必不忘記你。
english: Keep these things in mind, O Jacob; and you Israel, for you are my servant: I have made you; you are my servant; O Israel, I will not let you go out of my memory.

chinese: 我塗抹了你的過犯，像厚雲消散；我塗抹了你的罪惡，如薄雲滅沒。你當歸向我，因我救贖了你。
english: I have put your evil doings out of my mind like a thick cloud, and your sins like a mist: come back to me; for I have taken up your cause.

chinese: 諸天哪，應當歌唱，因為耶和華做成這事。地的深處啊，應當歡呼；眾山應當發聲歌唱；樹林和其中所有的樹都當如此！因為耶和華救贖了雅各，並要因以色列榮耀自己。
english: Make a song, O heavens, for the Lord has done it: give a loud cry, you deep parts of the earth: let your voices be loud in song, you mountains, and you woods with all your trees: for the Lord has taken up the cause of Jacob, and will let his glory be seen in Israel.

chinese: 從你出胎，造就你的救贖主─耶和華如此說：我─耶和華是創造萬物的，是獨自鋪張諸天、鋪開大地的。誰與我同在呢？
english: The Lord, who has taken up your cause, and who gave you life in your mother's body, says, I am the Lord who makes all things; stretching out the heavens by myself, and giving the earth its limits; who was with me?

chinese: 使說假話的兆頭失效，使占卜的癲狂，使智慧人退後，使他的知識變為愚拙；
english: Who makes the signs of those who give word of the future come to nothing, so that those who have knowledge of secret arts go off their heads; turning the wise men back, and making their knowledge foolish:

chinese: 使我僕人的話語立定，我使者的謀算成就。論到耶路撒冷說：必有人居住；論到猶大的城邑說：必被建造，其中的荒場我也必興起。
english: Who makes the word of his servants certain, and gives effect to the purposes of his representatives; who says of Jerusalem, Her people will come back to her; and of the towns of Judah, I will give orders for their building, and will make her waste places fertile again:

chinese: 對深淵說：你乾了罷！我也要使你的江河乾涸。
english: Who says to the deep, Be dry, and I will make your rivers dry:

chinese: 論古列說：他是我的牧人，必成就我所喜悅的，必下令建造耶路撒冷，發命立穩聖殿的根基。
english: Who says of Cyrus, He will take care of my sheep, and will do all my pleasure: who says of Jerusalem, I will give the word for your building; and of the Temple, Your bases will be put in place.

chinese: 我─耶和華所膏的古列；我攙扶他的右手，使列國降伏在他面前。我也要放鬆列王的腰帶，使城門在他面前敞開，不得關閉。我對他如此說：
english: The Lord says to the man of his selection, to Cyrus, whom I have taken by the right hand, putting down nations before him, and taking away the arms of kings; making the doors open before him, so that the ways into the towns may not be shut;

chinese: 我必在你前面行，修平崎嶇之地。我必打破銅門，砍斷鐵閂。
english: I will go before you, and make the rough places level: the doors of brass will be broken, and the iron rods cut in two:

chinese: 我要將暗中的寶物和隱密的財寶賜給你，使你知道提名召你的，就是我─耶和華、以色列的神。
english: And I will give you the stores of the dark, and the wealth of secret places, so that you may be certain that I am the Lord, who gave you your name, even the God of Israel.

chinese: 因我僕人雅各，我所揀選以色列的緣故，我就提名召你；你雖不認識我，我也加給你名號。
english: Because of Jacob my servant, and Israel whom I have taken for myself, I have sent for you by name, giving you a name of honour, though you had no knowledge of me.

chinese: 我是耶和華，在我以外並沒有別神；除了我以外再沒有神。你雖不認識我，我必給你束腰。
english: I am the Lord, and there is no other; there is no God but me: I will make you ready for war, though you had no knowledge of me:

chinese: 從日出之地到日落之處使人都知道除了我以外，沒有別神。我是耶和華；在我以外並沒有別神。
english: So that they may see from the east and from the west that there is no God but me: I am the Lord, and there is no other.

chinese: 我造光，又造暗；我施平安，又降災禍；造作這一切的是我─耶和華。
english: I am the giver of light and the maker of the dark; causing blessing, and sending troubles; I am the Lord, who does all these things.

chinese: 諸天哪，自上而滴，穹蒼降下公義；地面開裂，產出救恩，使公義一同發生；這都是我─耶和華所造的。
english: Let righteousness come down, O heavens, from on high, and let the sky send it down like rain: let the earth be open to give the fruit of salvation, causing righteousness to come up with it; I the Lord have made it come about.

chinese: 禍哉，那與造他的主爭論的！他不過是地上瓦片中的一塊瓦片。泥土豈可對摶弄他的說：你做甚麼呢？所做的物豈可說：你沒有手呢？
english: Cursed is he who has an argument with his Maker, the pot which has an argument with the Potter! Will the wet earth say to him who is working with it, What are you doing, that your work has nothing by which it may be gripped?

chinese: 禍哉，那對父親說：你生的是甚麼呢？或對母親（原文是婦人）說：你產的是甚麼呢？
english: Cursed is he who says to a father, To what are you giving life? or to a woman, What are you in birth-pains with?

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的聖者，就是造就以色列的如此說：將來的事，你們可以問我；至於我的眾子，並我手的工作，你們可以求我命定（原文是吩咐我）。
english: The Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, says, Will you put a question to me about the things which are to come, or will you give me orders about my sons, and the work of my hands?

chinese: 我造地，又造人在地上。我親手鋪張諸天；天上萬象也是我所命定的。
english: I have made the earth, forming man on it: by my hands the heavens have been stretched out, and all the stars put in their ordered places.

chinese: 我憑公義興起古列（原文是他），又要修直他一切道路。他必建造我的城，釋放我被擄的民；不是為工價，也不是為賞賜。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: I have sent him out to overcome the nations, and I will make all his ways straight: I will give him the work of building my town, and he will let my prisoners go free, without price or reward, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：埃及勞碌得來的和古實的貨物必歸你；身量高大的西巴人必投降你，也要屬你。他們必帶著鎖鍊過來隨從你，又向你下拜，祈求你說：神真在你們中間，此外再沒有別神；再沒有別的　神。
english: The Lord says, The workmen of Egypt, and the traders of Ethiopia, and the tall Sabaeans, will come over the sea to you, and they will be yours; they will go after you; in chains they will come over: and they will go down on their faces before you, and will make prayer to you, saying, Truly, God is among you; and there is no other God.

chinese: 救主─以色列的神啊，你實在是自隱的神。
english: Truly, you have a secret God, the God of Israel is a Saviour!

chinese: 凡製造偶像的都必抱愧蒙羞，都要一同歸於慚愧。
english: All those who have gone against him will be put to shame; the makers of images will be made low.

chinese: 惟有以色列必蒙耶和華的拯救，得永遠的救恩。你們必不蒙羞，也不抱愧，直到永世無盡。
english: But the Lord will make Israel free with an eternal salvation: you will not be put to shame or made low for ever and ever.

chinese: 創造諸天的耶和華，製造成全大地的神，他創造堅定大地，並非使地荒涼，是要給人居住。他如此說：我是耶和華，再沒有別神。
english: For this is the word of the Lord who made the heavens; he is God; the maker and designer of the earth; who made it not to be a waste, but as a living-place for man: I am the Lord, and there is no other.

chinese: 我沒有在隱密黑暗之地說話；我沒有對雅各的後裔說：你們尋求我是徒然的。我─耶和華所講的是公義，所說的是正直。
english: I have not given my word in secret, in a place in the underworld; I did not say to the seed of Jacob, Go into a waste land to make request of me: I the Lord say what is true, my word is righteousness.

chinese: 你們從列國逃脫的人，要一同聚集前來。那些抬著雕刻木偶、禱告不能救人之神的，毫無知識。
english: Come together, even come near, you nations who are still living: they have no knowledge who take up their image of wood, and make prayer to a god in whom is no salvation.

chinese: 你們要述說陳明你們的理，讓他們彼此商議。誰從古時指明，誰從上古述說？不是我─耶和華麼？除了我以外，再沒有神；我是公義的神，又是救主；除了我以外，再沒有別神。
english: Give the word, put forward your cause, let us have a discussion together: who has given news of this in the past? who made it clear in early times? did not I, the Lord? and there is no God but me; a true God and a saviour; there is no other.

chinese: 地極的人都當仰望我，就必得救；因為我是神，再沒有別神。
english: Let your hearts be turned to me, so that you may have salvation, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is no other.

chinese: 我指著自己起誓，我口所出的話是憑公義，並不反回：萬膝必向我跪拜；萬口必憑我起誓。
english: By myself have I taken an oath, a true word has gone from my mouth, and will not be changed, that to me every knee will be bent, and every tongue will give honour.

chinese: 人論我說，公義、能力，惟獨在乎耶和華；人都必歸向他。凡向他發怒的必至蒙羞。
english: Only in the Lord will Jacob overcome and be strong: together all those who were angry with him will be put to shame and come to destruction.

chinese: 以色列的後裔都必因耶和華得稱為義，並要誇耀。
english: In the Lord will all the seed of Israel get their rights, and they will give glory to him.

chinese: 彼勒屈身，尼波彎腰；巴比倫的偶像馱在獸和牲畜上。他們所抬的如今成了重馱，使牲畜疲乏，
english: Bel is bent down, Nebo is falling; their images are on the beasts and on the cattle: the things which you took about have become a weight to the tired beast.

chinese: 都一同彎腰屈身，不能保全重馱，自己倒被擄去。
english: They are bent down, they are falling together: they were not able to keep their images safe, but they themselves have been taken prisoner.

chinese: 雅各家，以色列家一切餘剩的要聽我言：你們自從生下，就蒙我保抱，自從出胎，便蒙我懷搋。
english: Give ear to me, O family of Jacob, and all the rest of the people of Israel, who have been supported by me from their birth, and have been my care from their earliest days:

chinese: 直到你們年老，我仍這樣；直到你們髮白，我仍懷搋。我已造作，也必保抱；我必懷抱，也必拯救。
english: Even when you are old I will be the same, and when you are grey-haired I will take care of you: I will still be responsible for what I made; yes, I will take you and keep you safe.

chinese: 你們將誰與我相比，與我同等，可以與我比較，使我們相同呢？
english: Who in your eyes is my equal? or what comparison will you make with me?

chinese: 那從囊中抓金子，用天平平銀子的人，雇銀匠製造神像，他們又俯伏，又叩拜。
english: As for those who take gold out of a bag, and put silver in the scales, they give payment to a gold-worker, to make it into a god; they go down on their faces and give it worship.

chinese: 他們將神像抬起，扛在肩上，安置在定處，他就站立，不離本位；人呼求他，他不能答應，也不能救人脫離患難。
english: They put him on their backs, and take him up, and put him in his fixed place, from which he may not be moved; if a man gives a cry for help to him, he is unable to give an answer, or get him out of his trouble.

chinese: 你們當想念這事，自己作大丈夫。悖逆的人哪，要心裡思想。
english: Keep this in mind and be shamed; let it come back to your memory, you sinners.

chinese: 你們要追念上古的事。因為我是神，並無別神；我是神，再沒有能比我的。
english: Let the things which are past come to your memory: for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is no one like me;

chinese: 我從起初指明末後的事，從古時言明未成的事，說：我的籌算必立定；凡我所喜悅的，我必成就。
english: Making clear from the first what is to come, and from past times the things which have not so far come about; saying, My purpose is fixed, and I will do all my pleasure;

chinese: 我召鷙鳥從東方來，召那成就我籌算的人從遠方來。我已說出，也必成就；我已謀定，也必做成。
english: Sending for a bird of strong flight from the east, the man of my purpose from a far country; I have said it, and I will give effect to it; the thing designed by me will certainly be done.

chinese: 你們這些心中頑梗、遠離公義的，當聽我言。
english: Give ear to me, you feeble-hearted, who have no faith in my righteousness:

chinese: 我使我的公義臨近，必不遠離。我的救恩必不遲延；我要為以色列─我的榮耀，在錫安施行救恩。
english: My righteousness is near, it is not far off; salvation will come quickly; and I will make Zion free, and give Israel my glory.

chinese: 巴比倫的處女啊，下來坐在塵埃；迦勒底的閨女啊，沒有寶座，要坐在地上；因為你不再稱為柔弱嬌嫩的。
english: Come and take your seat in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; come down from your seat of power, and take your place on the earth, O daughter of the Chaldaeans: for you will never again seem soft and delicate.

chinese: 要用磨磨麵，揭去帕子，脫去長衣，露腿逿河。
english: Take the crushing-stones and get the meal crushed: take off your veil, put away your robe, let your legs be uncovered, go through the rivers.

chinese: 你的下體必被露出；你的醜陋必被看見。我要報仇，誰也不寬容。
english: The shame of your unclothed condition will be seen by all: I will give punishment without mercy,

chinese: 我們救贖主的名是萬軍之耶和華─以色列的聖者。
english: Says the Lord who takes up our cause; the Lord of armies is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

chinese: 迦勒底的閨女啊，你要默然靜坐，進入暗中，因為你不再稱為列國的主母。
english: Be seated in the dark without a word, O daughter of the Chaldaeans: for you will no longer be named, The Queen of Kingdoms.

chinese: 我向我的百姓發怒，使我的產業被褻瀆，將他們交在你手中，你毫不憐憫他們，把極重的軛加在老年人身上。
english: I was angry with my people, I put shame on my heritage, and gave them into your hands: you had no mercy on them; you put a cruel yoke on those who were old;

chinese: 你自己說：我必永為主母，所以你不將這事放在心上，也不想這事的結局。
english: And you said, I will be a queen for ever: you did not give attention to these things, and did not keep in mind what would come after.

chinese: 你這專好宴樂、安然居住的，現在當聽這話。你心中說：惟有我，除我以外再沒有別的。我必不致寡居，也不遭喪子之事。
english: So now take note of this, you who are given up to pleasure, living without fear of evil, saying in your heart, I am, and there is no one like me; I will never be a widow, or have my children taken from me.

chinese: 哪知，喪子、寡居這兩件事在一日轉眼之間必臨到你；正在你多行邪術、廣施符咒的時候，這兩件事必全然臨到你身上。
english: But these two things will come on you suddenly in one day, the loss of children and of husband: in full measure they will come on you, for all your secret arts, and all your wonders.

chinese: 你素來倚仗自己的惡行，說：無人看見我。你的智慧聰明使你偏邪，並且你心裡說：惟有我，除我以外再沒有別的。
english: For you had faith in your evil-doing; you said, No one sees me; by your wisdom and knowledge you have been turned out of the way: and you have said in your heart, I am, and there is no other.

chinese: 因此，禍患要臨到你身；你不知何時發現（或譯：如何驅逐）災害落在你身上，你也不能除掉；所不知道的毀滅也必忽然臨到你身。
english: Because of this evil will come on you, which may not be turned away for any price: and trouble will overtake you, from which no money will give salvation: destruction will come on you suddenly, without your knowledge.

chinese: 站起來罷！用你從幼年勞神施行的符咒和你許多的邪術；或者可得益處，或者可得強勝。
english: Go on now with your secret arts, and all your wonder-working, to which you have given yourself up from your earliest days; it may be that they will be of profit to you, or by them you may put fear into your attackers.

chinese: 你籌劃太多，以致疲倦。讓那些觀天象的，看星宿的，在月朔說預言的，都站起來，救你脫離所要臨到你的事。
english: But your mind is troubled by the number of your guides: let them now come forward for your salvation: the measurers of the heavens, the watchers of the stars, and those who are able to say from month to month what things are coming on you.

chinese: 他們要像碎秸被火焚燒，不能救自己脫離火燄之力；這火並非可烤的炭火，也不是可以坐在其前的火。
english: Truly, they have become like dry stems, they have been burned in the fire; they are not able to keep themselves safe from the power of the flame: it is not a coal for warming them, or a fire by which a man may be seated.

chinese: 你所勞神的事都要這樣與你無益；從幼年與你貿易的也都各奔各鄉，無人救你。
english: Small profit have you had from those who, from your earliest days, got great profit out of you; they have gone in flight, every one straight before him, and you have no saviour.

chinese: 雅各家，稱為以色列名下，從猶大水源出來的，當聽我言！你們指著耶和華的名起誓，提說以色列的神，卻不憑誠實，不憑公義。
english: Give ear to this, O family of Jacob, you who are named by the name of Israel, and have come out of the body of Judah; who take oaths by the name of the Lord, and make use of the name of the God of Israel, but not truly and not in good faith.

chinese: 他們自稱為聖城的人，所倚靠的是名為萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神。
english: For they say that they are of the holy town, and put their faith in the God of Israel: the Lord of armies is his name.

chinese: 主說：早先的事，我從古時說明，已經出了我的口，也是我所指示的；我忽然行做，事便成就。
english: I gave word in the past of the things which came about; they came from my mouth, and I made them clear: suddenly I did them, and they came about.

chinese: 因為我素來知道你是頑梗的─你的頸項是鐵的；你的額是銅的。
english: Because I saw that your heart was hard, and that your neck was an iron cord, and your brow brass;

chinese: 所以，我從古時將這事給你說明，在未成以先指示你，免得你說：這些事是我的偶像所行的，是我雕刻的偶像和我鑄造的偶像所命定的。
english: For this reason I made it clear to you in the past, before it came I gave you word of it: for fear that you might say, My god did these things, and my pictured and metal images made them come about.

chinese: 你已經聽見，現在要看見這一切；你不說明麼？從今以後，我將新事，就是你所不知道的隱密事指示你。
english: All this has come to your ears and you have seen it; will you not give witness to it? I am now making clear new things, even secret things, of which you had no knowledge.

chinese: 這事是現今造的，並非從古就有；在今日以先，你也未曾聽見，免得你說：這事我早已知道了。
english: They have only now been effected, and not in the past: and before this day they had not come to your ears; for fear that you might say, I had knowledge of them.

chinese: 你未曾聽見，未曾知道；你的耳朵從來未曾開通。我原知道你行事極其詭詐，你自從出胎以來，便稱為悖逆的。
english: Truly you had no word of them, no knowledge of them; no news of them in the past had come to your ears; because I saw how false was your behaviour, and that your heart was turned against me from your earliest days.

chinese: 我為}我的名暫且忍怒，為我的頌讚向你容忍，不將你剪除。
english: Because of my name I will put away my wrath, and for my praise I will keep myself from cutting you off.

chinese: 我熬煉你，卻不像熬煉銀子；你在苦難的爐中，我揀選你。
english: See, I have been testing you for myself like silver; I have put you through the fire of trouble.

chinese: 我為自己的緣故必行這事，我焉能使我的名被褻瀆？我必不將我的榮耀歸給假神。
english: For myself, even because of my name, I will do it; for I will not let my name be shamed; and my glory I will not give to another.

chinese: 雅各─我所選召的以色列啊，當聽我言：我是耶和華，我是首先的，也是末後的。
english: Give ear to me, Jacob, and Israel, my loved one; I am he, I am the first and I am the last.

chinese: 我手立了地的根基；我右手鋪張諸天；我一招呼便都立住。
english: Yes, by my hand was the earth placed on its base, and by my right hand the heavens were stretched out; at my word they take up their places.

chinese: 你們都當聚集而聽，他們（或譯：偶像）內中誰說過這些事？耶和華所愛的人必向巴比倫行他所喜悅的事；他的膀臂也要加在迦勒底人身上。
english: Come together, all of you, and give ear; who among you has given news of these things? the Lord's loved one will do his pleasure with Babylon, and with the seed of the Chaldaeans.

chinese: 惟有我曾說過，我又選召他，領他來，他的道路就必亨通。
english: I, even I, have given the word; I have sent for him: I have made him come, and have given effect to his undertakings.

chinese: 你們要就近我來聽這話：我從起頭並未曾在隱密處說話；自從有這事，我就在那裡。現在，主耶和華差遣我和他的靈來（或譯：耶和華和他的靈差遣我來）。
english: Come near to me, and give ear to this; from the start I did not keep it secret; from the time of its coming into existence I was there: and now the Lord God has sent me, and given me his spirit.

chinese: 耶和華─你的救贖主，以色列的聖者如此說：我是耶和華─你的神，教訓你，使你得益處，引導你所當行的路。
english: The Lord who takes up your cause, the Holy One of Israel, says, I am the Lord your God, who is teaching you for your profit, guiding you by the way in which you are to go.

chinese: 甚願你素來聽從我的命令！你的平安就如河水；你的公義就如海浪。
english: If only you had given ear to my orders, then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness as the waves of the sea:

chinese: 你的後裔也必多如海沙；你腹中所生的也必多如沙粒。他的名在我面前必不剪除，也不滅絕。
english: Your seed would have been like the sand, and your offspring like the dust: your name would not be cut off or come to an end before me.

chinese: 你們要從巴比倫出來，從迦勒底人中逃脫，以歡呼的聲音傳揚說：耶和華救贖了他的僕人雅各！你們要將這事宣揚到地極。
english: Go out of Babylon, go in flight from the Chaldaeans; with the sound of song make it clear, give the news, let the word go out even to the end of the earth: say, The Lord has taken up the cause of his servant Jacob.

chinese: 耶和華引導他們經過沙漠。他們並不乾渴；他為他們使水從磐石而流，分裂磐石，水就湧出。
english: They had no need of water when he was guiding them through the waste lands: he made water come out of the rock for them: the rock was parted and the waters came flowing out.

chinese: 耶和華說：惡人必不得平安！
english: There is no peace, says the Lord, for the evil-doers.

chinese: 眾海島啊，當聽我言！遠方的眾民哪，留心而聽！自我出胎，耶和華就選召我；自出母腹，他就提我的名。
english: Give ear, O sea-lands, to me; and take note, you peoples from far: I have been marked out by the Lord from the first; when I was still in my mother's body, he had my name in mind:

chinese: 他使我的口如快刀，將我藏在他手蔭之下；又使我成為磨亮的箭，將我藏在他箭袋之中；
english: And he has made my mouth like a sharp sword, in the shade of his hand he has kept me; and he has made me like a polished arrow, keeping me in his secret place;

chinese: 對我說：你是我的僕人以色列；我必因你得榮耀。
english: And he said to me, You are my servant, Israel, in whom my glory will be seen;

chinese: 我卻說：我勞碌是徒然；我盡力是虛無虛空。然而，我當得的理必在耶和華那裡；我的賞賜必在我神那裡。
english: And I said, I have undergone weariness for nothing, I have given my strength for no purpose or profit: but still the Lord will take up my cause, and my God will give me my reward.

chinese: 耶和華從我出胎，造就我作他的僕人，要使雅各歸向他，使以色列到他那裡聚集。原來耶和華看我為尊貴；我的神也成為我的力量。
english: And now, says the Lord, who made me his servant when I was still in my mother's body, so that I might make Jacob come back to him, and so that Israel might come together to him: and I was honoured in the eyes of the Lord, and my God became my strength.

chinese: 現在他說：你作我的僕人，使雅各眾支派復興，使以色列中得保全的歸回尚為小事，我還要使你作外邦人的光，叫你施行我的救恩，直到地極。
english: It is not enough for one who is my servant to put the tribes of Jacob again in their place, and to get back those of Israel who have been sent away: my purpose is to give you as a light to the nations, so that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.

chinese: 救贖主─以色列的聖者耶和華對那被人所藐視、本國所憎惡、官長所虐待的如此說：君王要看見就站起，首領也要下拜；都因信實的耶和華，就是揀選你─以色列的聖者。
english: The Lord who takes up Israel's cause, even his Holy One, says to him whom men make sport of, who is hated by the nations, a servant of rulers: Kings will see and get up from their places, and chiefs will give worship: because of the Lord who keeps faith; even the Holy One of Israel who has taken you for himself.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：在悅納的時候，我應允了你；在拯救的日子，我濟助了你。我要保護你，使你作眾民的中保（中保：原文是約）；復興遍地，使人承受荒涼之地為業。
