english: I said to myself, The Lord is my heritage; and because of this I will have hope in him.

chinese: 凡等候耶和華，心裡尋求他的，耶和華必施恩給他。
english: The Lord is good to those who are waiting for him, to the soul which is looking for him.

chinese: 人仰望耶和華，靜默等候他的救恩，這原是好的。
english: It is good to go on hoping and quietly waiting for the salvation of the Lord.

chinese: 人在幼年負軛，這原是好的。
english: It is good for a man to undergo the yoke when he is young.

chinese: 他當獨坐無言，因為這是耶和華加在他身上的。
english: Let him be seated by himself, saying nothing, because he has put it on him.

chinese: 他當口貼塵埃，或者有指望。
english: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if by chance there may be hope.

chinese: 他當由人打他的腮頰，要滿受凌辱。
english: Let his face be turned to him who gives him blows; let him be full of shame.

chinese: 因為主必不永遠丟棄人。
english: For the Lord does not give a man up for ever.

chinese: 主雖使人憂愁，還要照他諸般的慈愛發憐憫。
english: For though he sends grief, still he will have pity in the full measure of his love.

chinese: 因他並不甘心使人受苦，使人憂愁。
english: For he has no pleasure in troubling and causing grief to the children of men.

chinese: 人將世上被囚的踹（原文是壓）在腳下，
english: In a man's crushing under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

chinese: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，
english: In his turning away the right of a man before the face of the Most High.

chinese: 或在人的訟事上顛倒是非，這都是主看不上的。
english: In his doing wrong to a man in his cause, the Lord has no pleasure.

chinese: 除非主命定，誰能說成就成呢？
english: Who is able to say a thing, and give effect to it, if it has not been ordered by the Lord?

chinese: 禍福不都出於至高者的口嗎？
english: Do not evil and good come from the mouth of the Most High?

chinese: 活人因自己的罪受罰，為何發怨言呢？
english: What protest may a living man make, even a man about the punishment of his sin?

chinese: 我們當深深考察自己的行為，再歸向耶和華。
english: Let us make search and put our ways to the test, turning again to the Lord;

chinese: 我們當誠心向天上的神舉手禱告。
english: Lifting up our hearts with our hands to God in the heavens.

chinese: 我們犯罪背逆，你並不赦免。
english: We have done wrong and gone against your law; we have not had your forgiveness.

chinese: 你自被怒氣遮蔽，追趕我們；你施行殺戮，並不顧惜。
english: Covering yourself with wrath you have gone after us, cutting us off without pity;

chinese: 你以黑雲遮蔽自己，以致禱告不得透入。
english: Covering yourself with a cloud, so that prayer may not get through.

chinese: 你使我們在萬民中成為污穢和渣滓。
english: You have made us like waste and that for which there is no use, among the peoples.

chinese: 我們的仇敵都向我們大大張口。
english: The mouths of all our haters are open wide against us.

chinese: 恐懼和陷坑，殘害和毀滅，都臨近我們。
english: Fear and deep waters have come on us, wasting and destruction.

chinese: 因我眾民遭的毀滅，我就眼淚下流如河。
english: Rivers of water are running down from my eyes, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

chinese: 我的眼多多流淚，總不止息，
english: My eyes are streaming without stopping, they have no rest,

chinese: 直等耶和華垂顧，從天觀看。
english: Till the Lord's eye is turned on me, till he sees my trouble from heaven.

chinese: 因我本城的眾民，我的眼，使我的心傷痛。
english: The Lord is unkind to my soul, more than all the daughters of my town.

chinese: 無故與我為仇的追逼我，像追雀鳥一樣。
english: They who are against me without cause have gone hard after me as if I was a bird;

chinese: 他們使我的命在牢獄中斷絕，並將一塊石頭拋在我身上。
english: They have put an end to my life in the prison, stoning me with stones.

chinese: 眾水流過我頭，我說：我命斷絕了！
english: Waters were flowing over my head; I said, I am cut off.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我從深牢中求告你的名。
english: I was making prayer to your name, O Lord, out of the lowest prison.

chinese: 你曾聽見我的聲音；我求你解救，你不要掩耳不聽。
english: My voice came to you; let not your ear be shut to my breathing, to my cry.

chinese: 我求告你的日子，你臨近我，說：不要懼怕！
english: You came near in the day when I made my prayer to you: you said, Have no fear.

chinese: 主啊，你伸明了我的冤；你救贖了我的命。
english: O Lord, you have taken up the cause of my soul, you have made my life safe.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你見了我受的委屈；求你為我伸冤。
english: O Lord, you have seen my wrong; be judge in my cause.

chinese: 他們仇恨我，謀害我，你都看見了。
english: You have seen all the evil rewards they have sent on me, and all their designs against me.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你聽見他們辱罵我的話，知道他們向我所設的計，
english: Their bitter words have come to your ears, O Lord, and all their designs against me;

chinese: 並那些起來攻擊我的人口中所說的話，以及終日向我所設的計謀。
english: The lips of those who came up against me, and their thoughts against me all the day.

chinese: 求你觀看，他們坐下，起來，都以我為歌曲。
english: Take note of them when they are seated, and when they get up; I am their song.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你要按著他們手所做的向他們施行報應。
english: You will give them their reward, O Lord, answering to the work of their hands.

chinese: 你要使他們心裡剛硬，使你的咒詛臨到他們。
english: You will let their hearts be covered over with your curse on them.

chinese: 你要發怒追趕他們，從耶和華的天下除滅他們。
english: You will go after them in wrath, and put an end to them from under the heavens of the Lord.

chinese: 黃金何其失光！純金何其變色！聖所的石頭倒在各市口上。
english: How dark has the gold become! how changed the best gold! the stones of the holy place are dropping out at the top of every street.

chinese: 錫安寶貴的眾子好比精金，現在何竟算為窯匠手所做的瓦瓶？
english: The valued sons of Zion, whose price was the best gold, are looked on as vessels of earth, the work of the hands of the potter!

chinese: 野狗尚且把奶乳哺其子，我民的婦人倒成為殘忍，好像曠野的鴕鳥一般。
english: Even the beasts of the waste land have full breasts, they give milk to their young ones: the daughter of my people has become cruel like the ostriches in the waste land.

chinese: 吃奶孩子的舌頭因乾渴貼住上膛；孩童求餅，無人擘給他們。
english: The tongue of the child at the breast is fixed to the roof of his mouth for need of drink: the young children are crying out for bread, and no man gives it to them.

chinese: 素來吃美好食物的，現今在街上變為孤寒；素來臥朱紅褥子的，現今躺臥糞堆。
english: Those who were used to feasting on delicate food are wasted in the streets: those who as children were dressed in purple are stretched out on the dust.

chinese: 都因我眾民的罪孽比所多瑪的罪還大；所多瑪雖然無人加手於他，還是轉眼之間被傾覆。
english: For the punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overturned suddenly without any hand falling on her.

chinese: 錫安的貴冑素來比雪純淨，比奶更白；他們的身體比紅寶玉（或譯：珊瑚）更紅，像光潤的藍寶石一樣。
english: Her holy ones were cleaner than snow, they were whiter than milk, their bodies were redder than corals, their form was as the sapphire:

chinese: 現在他們的面貌比煤炭更黑，以致在街上無人認識；他們的皮膚緊貼骨頭，枯乾如同槁木。
english: Their face is blacker than night; in the streets no one has knowledge of them: their skin is hanging on their bones, they are dry, they have become like wood.

chinese: 餓死的不如被刀殺的，因為這是缺了田間的土產，就身體衰弱，漸漸消滅。
english: Those who have been put to the sword are better off than those whose death is caused by need of food; for these come to death slowly, burned up like the fruit of the field.

chinese: 慈悲的婦人，當我眾民被毀滅的時候，親手煮自己的兒女作為食物。
english: The hands of kind-hearted women have been boiling their children; they were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

chinese: 耶和華發怒成就他所定的，倒出他的烈怒；在錫安使火著起，燒燬錫安的根基。
english: The Lord has given full effect to his passion, he has let loose his burning wrath; he has made a fire in Zion, causing the destruction of its bases.

chinese: 地上的君王和世上的居民都不信敵人和仇敵能進耶路撒冷的城門。
english: To the kings of the earth and to all the people of the world it did not seem possible that the attackers and the haters would go into the doors of Jerusalem.

chinese: 這都因他先知的罪惡和祭司的罪孽；他們在城中流了義人的血。
english: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the evil-doing of her priests, by whom the blood of the upright has been drained out in her.

chinese: 他們在街上如瞎子亂走，又被血玷污，以致人不能摸他們的衣服。
english: They are wandering like blind men in the streets, they are made unclean with blood, so that their robes may not be touched by men.

chinese: 人向他們喊著說：！不潔淨的，躲開，躲開！不要挨近我！他們逃走飄流的時候，列國中有人說：他們不可仍在這裡寄居。
english: Away! unclean! they were crying out to them, Away! away! let there be no touching: when they went away in flight and wandering, men said among the nations, There is no further resting-place for them.

chinese: 耶和華發怒，將他們分散，不再眷顧他們；人不重看祭司，也不厚待長老。
english: The face of the Lord has sent them in all directions; he will no longer take care of them: they had no respect for the priests, they gave no honour to the old men.

chinese: 我們仰望人來幫助，以致眼目失明，還是枉然；我們所盼望的，竟盼望一個不能救人的國！
english: Our eyes are still wasting away in looking for our false help: we have been watching for a nation unable to give salvation.

chinese: 仇敵追趕我們的腳步像打獵的，以致我們不敢在自己的街上行走。我們的結局臨近；我們的日子滿足；我們的結局來到了。
english: They go after our steps so that we may not go in our streets: our end is near, our days are numbered; for our end has come.

chinese: 追趕我們的比空中的鷹更快；他們在山上追逼我們，在曠野埋伏，等候我們。
english: Those who went after us were quicker than the eagles of the heaven, driving us before them on the mountains, waiting secretly for us in the waste land.

chinese: 耶和華的受膏者好比我們鼻中的氣，在他們的坑中被捉住；我們曾論到他說：我們必在他蔭下，在列國中存活。
english: Our breath of life, he on whom the holy oil was put, was taken in their holes; of whom we said, Under his shade we will be living among the nations.

chinese: 住烏斯地的以東民哪，只管歡喜快樂；苦杯也必傳到你那裡；你必喝醉，以致露體。
english: Have joy and be glad, O daughter of Edom, living in the land of Uz: the cup will be given to you in your turn, and you will be overcome with wine and your shame will be seen.

chinese: 錫安的民哪，你罪孽的刑罰受足了，耶和華必不使你再被擄去。以東的民哪，他必追討你的罪孽，顯露你的罪惡。
english: The punishment of your evil-doing is complete, O daughter of Zion; never again will he take you away as a prisoner: he will give you the reward of your evil-doing, O daughter of Edom; he will let your sin be uncovered.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你記念我們所遭遇的事，觀看我們所受的凌辱。
english: Keep in mind, O Lord, what has come to us: take note and see our shame.

chinese: 我們的產業歸與外邦人；我們的房屋歸與外路人。
english: Our heritage is given up to men of strange lands, our houses to those who are not our countrymen.

chinese: 我們是無父的孤兒；我們的母親好像寡婦。
english: We are children without fathers, our mothers are like widows.

chinese: 我們出錢才得水喝；我們的柴是人賣給我們的。
english: We give money for a drink of water, we get our wood for a price.

chinese: 追趕我們的，到了我們的頸項上；我們疲乏不得歇息。
english: Our attackers are on our necks: overcome with weariness, we have no rest.

chinese: 我們投降埃及人和亞述人，為要得糧吃飽。
english: We have given our hands to the Egyptians and to the Assyrians so that we might have enough bread.

chinese: 我們列祖犯罪，而今不在了；我們擔當他們的罪孽。
english: Our fathers were sinners and are dead; and the weight of their evil-doing is on us.

chinese: 奴僕轄制我們，無人救我們脫離他們的手。
english: Servants are ruling over us, and there is no one to make us free from their hands.

chinese: 因為曠野的刀劍，我們冒著險才得糧食。
english: We put our lives in danger to get our bread, because of the sword of the waste land.

chinese: 因飢餓燥熱，我們的皮膚就黑如爐。
english: Our skin is heated like an oven because of our burning heat from need of food.

chinese: 敵人在錫安玷污婦人，在猶大的城邑玷污處女。
english: They took by force the women in Zion, the virgins in the towns of Judah.

chinese: 他們吊起首領的手，也不尊敬老人的面。
english: Their hands put princes to death by hanging: the faces of old men were not honoured.

chinese: 少年人扛磨石，孩童背木柴，都絆跌了。
english: The young men were crushing the grain, and the boys were falling under the wood.

chinese: 老年人在城門口斷絕；少年人不再作樂。
english: The old men are no longer seated in the doorway, and the music of the young men has come to an end.

chinese: 我們心中的快樂止息，跳舞變為悲哀。
english: The joy of our hearts is ended; our dancing is changed into sorrow.

chinese: 冠冕從我們的頭上落下；我們犯罪了，我們有禍了！
english: The crown has been taken from our head: sorrow is ours, for we are sinners.

chinese: 這些事我們心裡發昏，我們的眼睛昏花。
english: Because of this our hearts are feeble; for these things our eyes are dark;

chinese: 錫安山荒涼，野狗（或譯：狐狸）行在其上。
english: Because of the mountain of Zion which is a waste; jackals go over it.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你存到永遠；你的寶座存到萬代。
english: You, O Lord, are seated as King for ever; the seat of your power is eternal.

chinese: 你為何永遠忘記我們？為何許久離棄我們？
english: Why have we gone from your memory for ever? why have you been turned away from us for so long?

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你使我們向你回轉，我們便得回轉。求你復新我們的日子，像古時一樣。
english: Make us come back to you, O Lord, and let us be turned; make our days new again as in the past.

chinese: 你竟全然棄絕我們，向我們大發烈怒？
english: But you have quite given us up; you are full of wrath against us.

chinese: 當三十年四月初五日，以西結（原文是我）在迦巴魯河邊被擄的人中，天就開了，得見神的異象。
english: Now it came about in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, while I was by the river Chebar among those who had been made prisoners, that the heavens were made open and I saw visions of God.

chinese: 正是約雅斤王被擄去第五年四月初五日，
english: On the fifth day of the month, in the fifth year after King Jehoiachin had been made a prisoner,

chinese: 在迦勒底人之地、迦巴魯河邊，耶和華的話特特臨到布西的兒子祭司以西結；耶和華的靈（原文是手）降在他身上。
english: The word of the Lord came to me, Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldaeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was on me there.

chinese: 我觀看，見狂風從北方颳來，隨著有一朵包括閃爍火的大雲，周圍有光輝；從其中的火內發出好像光耀的精金；
english: And, looking, I saw a storm-wind coming out of the north, a great cloud with flames of fire coming after one another, and a bright light shining round about it and in the heart of it was something coloured like electrum.

chinese: 又從其中顯出四個活物的形像來。他們的形狀是這樣：有人的形像，
english: And in the heart of it were the forms of four living beings. And this was what they were like; they had the form of a man.

chinese: 各有四個臉面，四個翅膀。
english: And every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.

chinese: 他們的腿是直的，腳掌好像牛犢之蹄，都燦爛如光明的銅。
english: And their feet were straight feet; and the under sides of their feet were like the feet of oxen; and they were shining like polished brass.

chinese: 在四面的翅膀以下有人的手。這四個活物的臉和翅膀乃是這樣：
english: And they had the hands of a man under their wings; the four of them had faces on their four sides.

chinese: 翅膀彼此相接，行走並不轉身，俱各直往前行。
english: They went without turning, every one went straight forward.

chinese: 至於臉的形像：前面各有人的臉，右面各有獅子的臉，左面各有牛的臉，後面各有鷹的臉。
english: As for the form of their faces, they had the face of a man, and the four of them had the face of a lion on the right side, and the four of them had the face of an ox on the left side, and the four of them had the face of an eagle.

chinese: 各展開上邊的兩個翅膀相接，各以下邊的兩個翅膀遮體。
english: And their wings were separate at the top; two of the wings of every one were joined one to another, and two were covering their bodies.

chinese: 他們俱各直往前行。靈往哪裡去，他們就往那裡去，行走並不轉身。
english: Every one of them went straight forward; wherever the spirit was to go they went; they went on without turning.

chinese: 至於四活物的形像，就如燒著火炭的形狀，又如火把的形狀。火在四活物中間上去下來，這火有光輝，從火中發出閃電。
english: And between the living beings it was like burning coals of fire, as if flames were going one after the other between the living beings; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went thunder-flames.

chinese: 這活物往來奔走，好像電光一閃。
english: And the living beings went out and came back as quickly as a thunder-flame.

chinese: 我正觀看活物的時候，見活物的臉旁各有一輪在地上。
english: Now while I was looking at the four living beings, I saw one wheel on the earth, by the side of the living beings, for the four of them.

chinese: 輪的形狀和顏色（原文是作法）好像水蒼玉。四輪都是一個樣式，形狀和作法好像輪中套輪。
english: The form of the wheels and their work was like a beryl; the four of them had the same form and design, and they were like a wheel inside a wheel.

chinese: 輪行走的時候，向四方都能直行，並不掉轉。
english: The four of them went straight forward without turning to one side.

chinese: 至於輪輞，高而可畏；四個輪輞周圍滿有眼睛。
english: And I saw that they had edges, and their edges, even of the four, were full of eyes round about.

chinese: 活物行走，輪也在旁邊行走；活物從地上升，輪也都上升。
english: And when the living beings went on, the wheels went by their side; and when the living beings were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

chinese: 靈往哪裡去，活物就往那裡去；活物上升，輪也在活物旁邊上升，因為活物的靈在輪中。
english: Wherever the spirit was to go they went; and the wheels were lifted up by their side: for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.

chinese: 那些行走，這些也行走；那些站住，這些也站住；那些從地上升，輪也在旁邊上升，因為活物的靈在輪中。
english: When these went on, the others went; and when these came to rest, the others came to rest; and when these were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up by their side: for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.

chinese: 活物的頭以上有穹蒼的形像，看著像可畏的水晶，鋪張在活物的頭以上。
english: And over the heads of the living beings there was the form of an arch, looking like ice, stretched out over their heads on high.

chinese: 穹蒼以下，活物的翅膀直張，彼此相對；每活物有兩個翅膀遮體。
english: Under the arch their wings were straight, one stretched out to another: every one had two wings covering their bodies on this side and two covering their bodies on that side.

chinese: 活物行走的時候，我聽見翅膀的響聲，像大水的聲音，像全能者的聲音，也像軍隊鬨嚷的聲音。活物站住的時候，便將翅膀垂下。
english: And when they went, the sound of their wings was like the sound of great waters to my ears, like the voice of the Ruler of all, a sound like the rushing of an army: when they came to rest they let down their wings.

chinese: 在他們頭以上的穹蒼之上有聲音。他們站住的時候，便將翅膀垂下。
english: And there was a voice from the top of the arch which was over their heads: when they came to rest they let down their wings.

chinese: 在他們頭以上的穹蒼之上有寶座的形像，彷彿藍寶石；在寶座形像以上有彷彿人的形狀。
english: And on the top of the arch which was over their heads was the form of a king's seat, like a sapphire stone; and on the form of the seat was the form of a man seated on it on high.

chinese: 我見從他腰以上有彷彿光耀的精金，周圍都有火的形狀，又見從他腰以下有彷彿火的形狀，周圍也有光輝。
english: And I saw it coloured like electrum, with the look of fire in it and round it, going up from what seemed to be the middle of his body; and going down from what seemed to be the middle of his body I saw what was like fire, and there was a bright light shining round him.

chinese: 下雨的日子，雲中虹的形狀怎樣，周圍光輝的形狀也是怎樣。這就是耶和華榮耀的形像。我一看見就俯伏在地，又聽見一位說話的聲音。
english: Like the bow in the cloud on a day of rain, so was the light shining round him. And this is what the glory of the Lord was like. And when I saw it I went down on my face, and the voice of one talking came to my ears.

chinese: 他對我說：人子啊，你站起來，我要和你說話。
english: And he said to me, Son of man, get up on your feet, so that I may say words to you.

chinese: 他對我說話的時候，靈就進入我裡面，使我站起來，我便聽見那位對我說話的聲音。
english: And at his words the spirit came into me and put me on my feet; and his voice came to my ears.

chinese: 他對我說：人子啊，我差你往悖逆的國民以色列人那裡去。他們是悖逆我的，他們和他們的列祖違背我，直到今日。
english: And he said to me, Son of man, I am sending you to the children of Israel, to an uncontrolled nation which has gone against me: they and their fathers have been sinners against me even to this very day.

chinese: 這眾子面無羞恥，心裡剛硬。我差你往他們那裡去，你要對他們說：主耶和華如此說。
english: And the children are hard and stiff-hearted; I am sending you to them: and you are to say to them, These are the words of the Lord.

chinese: 他們或聽，或不聽，（他們是悖逆之家），必知道在他們中間有了先知。
english: And they, if they give ear to you or if they do not give ear (for they are an uncontrolled people), will see that there has been a prophet among them.

chinese: 人子啊，雖有荊棘和蒺藜在你那裡，你又住在蠍子中間，總不要怕他們，也不要怕他們的話；他們雖是悖逆之家，還不要怕他們的話，也不要因他們的臉色驚惶。
english: And you, son of man, have no fear of them or of their words, even if sharp thorns are round you and you are living among scorpions: have no fear of their words and do not be overcome by their looks, for they are an uncontrolled people.

chinese: 他們或聽，或不聽，你只管將我的話告訴他們；他們是極其悖逆的。
english: And you are to give them my words, if they give ear to you or if they do not: for they are uncontrolled.

chinese: 人子啊，要聽我對你所說的話，不要悖逆像那悖逆之家，你要開口吃我所賜給你的。
english: But you, son of man, give ear to what I say to you, and do not be uncontrolled like that uncontrolled people: let your mouth be open and take what I give you.

chinese: 我觀看，見有一隻手向我伸出來，手中有一書卷。
english: And looking, I saw a hand stretched out to me, and I saw the roll of a book in it;

chinese: 他將書卷在我面前展開，內外都寫著字，其上所寫的有哀號、歎息、悲痛的話。
english: And he put it open before me, and it had writing on the front and on the back; words of grief and sorrow and trouble were recorded in it.

chinese: 他對我說：人子啊，要吃你所得的，要吃這書卷，好去對以色列家講說。
english: And he said to me, Son of man, take this roll for your food, and go and say my words to the children of Israel.

chinese: 於是我開口，他就使我吃這書卷，
english: And, on my opening my mouth, he made me take the roll as food.

chinese: 又對我說：人子啊，要吃我所賜給你的這書卷，充滿你的肚腹。我就吃了，口中覺得其甜如蜜。
english: And he said to me, Son of man, let your stomach make a meal of it and let your inside be full of this roll which I am giving you. Then I took it, and it was sweet as honey in my mouth.

chinese: 他對我說：人子啊，你往以色列家那裡去，將我的話對他們講說。
english: And he said to me, Son of man, go now to the children of Israel, and say my words to them.

chinese: 你奉差遣不是往那說話深奧、言語難懂的民那裡去，乃是往以色列家去；
english: For you are not sent to a people whose talk is strange and whose language is hard, but to the children of Israel;

chinese: 不是往那說話深奧、言語難懂的多國去，他們的話語是你不懂得的。我若差你往他們那裡去，他們必聽從你。
english: Not to a number of peoples whose talk is strange and whose language is hard and whose words are not clear to you. Truly, if I sent you to them they would give ear to you.

chinese: 以色列家卻不肯聽從你，因為他們不肯聽從我；原來以色列全家是額堅心硬的人。
english: But the children of Israel will not give ear to you; for they have no mind to give ear to me: for all the children of Israel have a hard brow and a stiff heart.

chinese: 看哪，我使你的臉硬過他們的臉，使你的額硬過他們的額。
english: See, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your brow hard against their brows.

chinese: 我使你的額像金鋼鑽，比火石更硬。他們雖是悖逆之家，你不要怕他們，也不要因他們的臉色驚惶。
english: Like a diamond harder than rock I have made your brow: have no fear of them and do not be overcome by their looks, for they are an uncontrolled people.

chinese: 他又對我說：人子啊，我對你所說的一切話，要心裡領會，耳中聽聞。
english: Then he said to me, Son of man, take into your heart all my words which I am about to say to you, and let your ears be open to them.

chinese: 你往你本國被擄的子民那裡去，他們或聽，或不聽，你要對他們講說，告訴他們這是主耶和華說的。
english: And go now to those who have been taken away as prisoners, to the children of your people, and say to them, This is what the Lord has said; if they give ear or if they do not.

chinese: 那時，靈將我舉起，我就聽見在我身後有震動轟轟的聲音，說：從耶和華的所在顯出來的榮耀是該稱頌的！
english: Then I was lifted up by the wind, and at my back the sound of a great rushing came to my ears when the glory of the Lord was lifted up from his place.

chinese: 我又聽見那活物翅膀相碰，與活物旁邊輪子旋轉震動轟轟的響聲。
english: And there was the sound of the wings of the living beings touching one another, and the sound of the wheels at their side, the sound of a great rushing.

chinese: 於是靈將我舉起，帶我而去。我心中甚苦，靈性忿激，並且耶和華的靈（原文是手）在我身上大有能力。
english: And the wind, lifting me up, took me away: and I went in the heat of my spirit, and the hand of the Lord was strong on me.

chinese: 我就來到提勒亞畢，住在迦巴魯河邊被擄的人那裡，到他們所住的地方，在他們中間憂憂悶悶地坐了七日。
english: Then I came to those who had been taken away as prisoners, who were at Telabib by the river Chebar, and I was seated among them full of wonder for seven days.

chinese: 過了七日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And at the end of seven days, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，我立你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要聽我口中的話，替我警戒他們。
english: Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the children of Israel: so give ear to the word of my mouth, and give them word from me of their danger.

chinese: 我何時指著惡人說：他必要死；你若不警戒他，也不勸戒他，使他離開惡行，拯救他的性命，這惡人必死在罪孽之中；我卻要向你討他喪命的罪（原文是血）。
english: When I say to the evil-doer, Death will certainly be your fate; and you give him no word of it and say nothing to make clear to the evil-doer the danger of his evil way, so that he may be safe; that same evil man will come to death in his evil-doing; but I will make you responsible for his blood.

chinese: 倘若你警戒惡人，他仍不轉離罪惡，也不離開惡行，他必死在罪孽之中，你卻救自己脫離了罪。
english: But if you give the evil-doer word of his danger, and he is not turned from his sin or from his evil way, death will overtake him in his evil-doing; but your life will be safe.

chinese: 再者，義人何時離義而犯罪，我將絆腳石放在他面前，他就必死；因你沒有警戒他，他必死在罪中，他素來所行的義不被記念；我卻要向你討他喪命的罪（原文是血）。
english: Again, when an upright man, turning away from his righteousness, does evil, and I put a cause of falling in his way, death will overtake him: because you have given him no word of his danger, death will overtake him in his evil-doing, and there will be no memory of the upright acts which he has done; but I will make you responsible for his blood.

chinese: 倘若你警戒義人，使他不犯罪，他就不犯罪；他因受警戒就必存活，你也救自己脫離了罪。
english: But if you say to the upright man that he is not to do evil, he will certainly keep his life because he took note of your word; and your life will be safe.

chinese: 耶和華的靈（原文是手）在那裡降在我身上。他對我說：你起來往平原去，我要在那裡和你說話。
english: And the hand of the Lord was on me there; and he said, Get up and go out into the valley and there I will have talk with you.

chinese: 於是我起來往平原去，不料，耶和華的榮耀正如我在迦巴魯河邊所見的一樣，停在那裡，我就俯伏於地。
english: Then I got up and went out into the valley; and I saw the glory of the Lord resting there as I had seen it by the river Chebar; and I went down on my face.

chinese: 靈就進入我裡面，使我站起來。耶和華對我說：你進房屋去，將門關上。
english: Then the spirit came into me and put me on my feet; and he had talk with me and said to me, Go and keep yourself shut up inside your house.

chinese: 人子啊，人必用繩索捆綁你，你就不能出去在他們中間來往。
english: But see, O son of man, I will put bands on you, prisoning you in them, and you will not go out among them:

chinese: 我必使你的舌頭貼住上膛，以致你啞口，不能作責備他們的人；他們原是悖逆之家。
english: And I will make your tongue fixed to the roof of your mouth, so that you have no voice and may not make protests to them: for they are an uncontrolled people.

chinese: 但我對你說話的時候，必使你開口，你就要對他們說：主耶和華如此說。聽的可以聽，不聽的任他不聽，因為他們是悖逆之家。
english: But when I have talk with you I will make your mouth open, and you are to say to them, This is what the Lord has said: Let the hearer give ear; and as for him who will not, let him keep his ears shut: for they are an uncontrolled people.

chinese: 人子啊，你要拿一塊磚，擺在你面前，將一座耶路撒冷城畫在其上，
english: And you, son of man, take a back and put it before you and on it make a picture of a town, even Jerusalem.

chinese: 又圍困這城，造臺築壘，安營攻擊，在四圍安設撞錘攻城，
english: And make an attack on it, shutting it in, building strong places against it, and making high an earthwork against it; and put up tents against it, placing engines all round it for smashing down its walls.

chinese: 又要拿個鐵鏊，放在你和城的中間，作為鐵牆。你要對面攻擊這城，使城被困；這樣，好作以色列家的預兆。
english: And take a flat iron plate, and put it for a wall of iron between you and the town: and let your face be turned to it, and it will be shut in and you will make an attack on it. This will be a sign to the children of Israel.

chinese: 你要向左側臥，承當以色列家的罪孽；要按你向左側臥的日數，擔當他們的罪孽。
english: Then, stretching yourself out on your left side, take the sin of the children of Israel on yourself: for as long as you are stretched out, so long will the sin of the children of Israel be on you.

chinese: 因為我已將他們作孽的年數定為你向左側臥的日數，就是三百九十日，你要這樣擔當以色列家的罪孽。
english: For I have had the years of their sin measured for you by a number of days, even three hundred and ninety days: and you will take on yourself the sin of the children of Israel.

chinese: 再者，你滿了這些日子，還要向右側臥，擔當猶大家的罪孽。我給你定規側臥四十日，一日頂一年。
english: And when these days are ended, turning on your right side, you are to take on yourself the sin of the children of Judah: forty days, a day for a year, I have had it fixed for you.

chinese: 你要露出膀臂，面向被困的耶路撒冷，說預言攻擊這城。
english: And let your face be turned to where Jerusalem is shut in, with your arm uncovered, and be a prophet against it.

chinese: 我用繩索捆綁你，使你不能輾轉，直等你滿了困城的日子。
english: And see, I will put bands on you; and you will be stretched out without turning from one side to the other till the days of your attack are ended.

chinese: 你要取小麥、大麥、豆子、紅豆、小米、粗麥，裝在一個器皿中，用以為自己做餅；要按你側臥的三百九十日吃這餅。
english: And take for yourself wheat and barley and different sorts of grain, and put them in one vessel and make bread for yourself from them; all the days when you are stretched on your side it will be your food.

chinese: 你所吃的要按分兩吃，每日二十舍客勒，按時而吃。
english: And you are to take your food by weight, twenty shekels a day: you are to take it at regular times.

chinese: 你喝水也要按制子，每日喝一欣六分之一，按時而喝。
english: And you are to take water by measure, the sixth part of a hin: you are to take it at regular times.

chinese: 你吃這餅像吃大麥餅一樣，要用人糞在眾人眼前燒烤。
english: And let your food be barley cakes, cooking it before their eyes with the waste which comes out of a man.

chinese: 耶和華說：以色列人在我所趕他們到的各國中，也必這樣吃不潔淨的食物。
english: And the Lord said, Even so the children of Israel will have unclean bread for their food among the nations where I am driving them.

chinese: 我說：哎！主耶和華啊，我素來未曾被玷污，從幼年到如今沒有吃過自死的，或被野獸撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。
english: Then I said, Ah, Lord! see, my soul has never been unclean, and I have never taken as my food anything which has come to a natural death or has been broken by beasts, from the time when I was young even till now; no disgusting flesh has ever come into my mouth.

chinese: 於是他對我說：看哪，我給你牛糞代替人糞，你要將你的餅烤在其上。
english: Then he said to me, See, I have given you cow's waste in place of man's waste, and you will make your bread ready on it.

chinese: 他又對我說：人子啊，我必在耶路撒冷折斷他們的杖，就是斷絕他們的糧。他們吃餅要按分兩，憂慮而吃；喝水也要按制子，驚惶而喝；
english: And he said to me, Son of man, see, I will take away from Jerusalem her necessary bread: they will take their bread by weight and with care, measuring out their drinking-water with fear and wonder:

chinese: 使他們缺糧缺水，彼此驚惶，因自己的罪孽消滅。
english: So that they may be in need of bread and water and be wondering at one another, wasting away in their sin.

chinese: 人子啊，你要拿一把快刀，當作剃頭刀，用這刀剃你的頭髮和你的鬍鬚，用天平將鬚髮平分。
english: And you, son of man, take a sharp sword, using it like a haircutter's blade, and making it go over your head and the hair of your chin: and take scales for separating the hair by weight.

chinese: 圍困城的日子滿了，你要將三分之一在城中用火焚燒，將三分之一在城的四圍用刀砍碎，將三分之一任風吹散；我也要拔刀追趕。
english: You are to have a third part burned with fire inside the town, when the days of the attack are ended; and a third part you are to take and give blows with the sword round about it; and give a third part for the wind to take away, and let loose a sword after them.

chinese: 你要從其中取幾根包在衣襟裡，
english: And take from them a small number of hairs, folding them in your skirts.

chinese: 再從這幾根中取些扔在火中焚燒，從裡面必有火出來燒入以色列全家。
english: And again take some of these and put them in the fire, burning them up in the fire; and say to all the children of Israel,

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：這就是耶路撒冷。我曾將他安置在列邦之中；列國都在他的四圍。
english: This is what the Lord has said: This is Jerusalem: I have put her among the nations, and countries are round her on every side;

chinese: 他行惡，違背我的典章，過於列國；干犯我的律例，過於四圍的列邦，因為他棄掉我的典章。至於我的律例，他並沒有遵行。
english: And she has gone against my orders by doing evil more than the nations, and against my rules more than the countries round her: for they have given up my orders, and as for my rules, they have not gone in the way of them.

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：因為你們紛爭過於四圍的列國，也不遵行我的律例，不謹守我的典章，並以遵從四圍列國的惡規尚不滿意，
english: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have been more uncontrolled than the nations round about you, and have not been guided by my rules or kept my orders, but have kept the orders of the nations round about you;

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：看哪，我與你反對，必在列國的眼前，在你中間，施行審判；
english: For this cause the Lord has said: See, I, even I, am against you; and I will be judging among you before the eyes of the nations.

chinese: 並且因你一切可憎的事，我要在你中間行我所未曾行的，以後我也不再照著行。
english: And I will do in you what I have not done and will not do again, because of all your disgusting ways.

chinese: 在你中間父親要吃兒子，兒子要吃父親。我必向你施行審判，我必將你所剩下的分散四方（方：原文是風）。
english: For this cause fathers will take their sons for food among you, and sons will make a meal of their fathers; and I will be judge among you, and all the rest of you I will send away to every wind.

chinese: 主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，因你用一切可憎的物、可厭的事玷污了我的聖所，故此，我定要使你人數減少，我眼必不顧惜你，也不可憐你。
english: For this cause, by my life, says the Lord, because you have made my holy place unclean with all your hated things and all your disgusting ways, you will become disgusting to me; my eye will have no mercy and I will have no pity.

chinese: 你的民三分之一必遭瘟疫而死，在你中間必因饑荒消滅；三分之一必在你四圍倒在刀下；我必將三分之一分散四方（方：原文是風），並要拔刀追趕他們。
english: A third of you will come to death from disease, wasting away among you through need of food; a third will be put to the sword round about you; and a third I will send away to every wind, letting loose a sword after them.

chinese: 我要這樣成就怒中所定的；我向他們發的忿怒止息了，自己就得著安慰。我在他們身上成就怒中所定的那時，他們就知道我─耶和華所說的是出於熱心；
english: So my wrath will be complete and my passion will come to rest on them; and they will be certain that I the Lord have given the word of decision, when my wrath against them is complete.

chinese: 並且我必使你在四圍的列國中，在經過的眾人眼前，成了荒涼和羞辱。
english: And I will make you a waste and a name of shame among the nations round about you, in the eyes of everyone who goes by.

chinese: 這樣，我必以怒氣和忿怒，並烈怒的責備，向你施行審判。那時，你就在四圍的列國中成為羞辱、譏刺、警戒、驚駭。這是我─耶和華說的。
english: And you will be a name of shame and a cause of bitter words, an example and a wonder to the nations round about you, when I give effect to my judging among you in wrath and in passion and in burning protests: I the Lord have said it:

chinese: 那時，我要將滅人、使人饑荒的惡箭，就是射去滅人的，射在你們身上，並要加增你們的饑荒，斷絕你們所倚靠的糧食；
english: When I send on you the evil arrows of disease, causing destruction, which I will send to put an end to you; and, further, I will take away your necessary food.

chinese: 又要使饑荒和惡獸到你那裡，叫你喪子，瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那裡；我也要使刀劍臨到你。這是我─耶和華說的。
english: And I will send on you need of food and evil beasts, and they will be a cause of loss to you; and disease and violent death will go through you; and I will send the sword on you: I the Lord have said it.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要面向以色列的眾山說預言，
english: Son of man, let your face be turned to the mountains of Israel, and be a prophet to them, and say,

chinese: 說：以色列的眾山哪，要聽主耶和華的話。主耶和華對大山、小岡、水溝、山谷如此說：我必使刀劍臨到你們，也必毀滅你們的邱壇。
english: You mountains of Israel, give ear to the words of the Lord: this is what the Lord has said to the mountains and the hills, to the waterways and the valleys: See, I, even I, am sending on you a sword for the destruction of your high places.

chinese: 你們的祭壇必然荒涼，你們的日像必被打碎。我要使你們被殺的人倒在你們的偶像面前；
english: And your altars will be made waste, and your sun-images will be broken: and I will have your dead men placed before your images.

chinese: 我也要將以色列人的屍首放在他們的偶像面前，將你們的骸骨拋散在你們祭壇的四圍。
english: And I will put the dead bodies of the children of Israel in front of their images, sending your bones in all directions about your altars.

chinese: 在你們一切的住處，城邑要變為荒場，邱壇必然淒涼，使你們的祭壇荒廢，將你們的偶像打碎。你們的日像被砍倒，你們的工作被毀滅。
english: In all your living-places the towns will become broken walls, and the high places made waste; so that your altars may be broken down and made waste, and your images broken and ended, and so that your sun-images may be cut down and your works rubbed out.

chinese: 被殺的人必倒在你們中間，你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And the dead will be falling down among you, and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 你們分散在各國的時候，我必在列邦中使你們有剩下脫離刀劍的人。
english: But still, I will keep a small band safe from the sword among the nations, when you are sent wandering among the countries.

chinese: 那脫離刀劍的人必在所擄到的各國中記念我，為他們心中何等傷破，是因他們起淫心，遠離我，眼對偶像行邪淫。他們因行一切可憎的惡事，必厭惡自己。
english: And those of you who are kept safe will have me in mind among the nations where they have been taken away as prisoners, how I sent punishment on their hearts which were untrue to me, and on their eyes which were turned to their false gods: and they will be full of hate for themselves because of the evil things which they have done in all their disgusting ways.

chinese: 他們必知道我是耶和華；我說要使這災禍臨到他們身上，並非空話。
english: And they will be certain that I am the Lord: not for nothing did I say that I would do this evil to them.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：你當拍手頓足，說：哀哉！以色列家行這一切可憎的惡事，他們必倒在刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫之下。
english: This is what the Lord has said: Give blows with your hand, stamping with your foot, and say, O sorrow! because of all the evil and disgusting ways of the children of Israel: for death will overtake them by the sword and through need of food and by disease.

chinese: 在遠處的，必遭瘟疫而死；在近處的，必倒在刀劍之下；那存留被圍困的，必因饑荒而死；我必這樣在他們身上成就我怒中所定的。
english: He who is far away will come to his death by disease; he who is near will be put to the sword; he who is shut up will come to his death through need of food; and I will give full effect to my passion against them.

chinese: 他們被殺的人倒在他們祭壇四圍的偶像中，就是各高岡、各山頂、各青翠樹下、各茂密的橡樹下，乃是他們獻馨香的祭牲給一切偶像的地方。那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord, when their dead men are stretched among their images round about their altars on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, and under every branching tree, and under every thick oak-tree, the places where they made sweet smells to all their images.

chinese: 我必伸手攻擊他們，使他們的地從曠野到第伯拉他一切住處極其荒涼，他們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And my hand will be stretched out against them, making the land waste and unpeopled, from the waste land to Riblah, through all their living-places: and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，主耶和華對以色列地如此說：結局到了，結局到了地的四境！
english: And you, son of man, say, This is what the Lord has said to the land of Israel: An end has come, the end has come on the four quarters of the land.

chinese: 現在你的結局已經臨到，我必使我的怒氣歸與你，也必按你的行為審判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罰你。
english: Now the end has come on you, and I will send my wrath on you, judging you for your ways, I will send punishment on you for all your disgusting acts.

chinese: 我眼必不顧惜你，也不可憐你，卻要按你所行的報應你，照你中間可憎的事刑罰你。你就知道我是耶和華。
english: My eye will not have mercy on you, and I will have no pity: but I will send the punishment of your ways on you, and your disgusting works will be among you: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：有一災，獨有一災；看哪，臨近了！
english: This is what the Lord has said: An evil, even one evil; see, it is coming.

chinese: 結局來了，結局來了，向你興起。看哪，來到了！
english: An end has come, the end has come; see, it is coming on you.

chinese: 境內的居民哪，所定的災臨到你，時候到了，日子近了，乃是鬨嚷並非在山上歡呼的日子。
english: The crowning time has come on you, O people of the land: the time has come, the day is near; the day will not be slow in coming, it will not keep back.

chinese: 我快要將我的忿怒傾在你身上，向你成就我怒中所定的，按你的行為審判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罰你。
english: Now, in a little time, I will let loose my passion on you, and give full effect to my wrath against you, judging you for your ways, and sending punishment on you for all your disgusting works.

chinese: 我眼必不顧惜你，也不可憐你，必按你所行的報應你，照你中間可憎的事刑罰你。你就知道擊打你的是我耶和華。
english: My eye will not have mercy, and I will have no pity: I will send on you the punishment of your ways, and your disgusting works will be among you; and you will see that I am the Lord who gives punishment.

chinese: 看哪，看哪，日子快到了，所定的災已經發出。杖已經開花，驕傲已經發芽。
english: See, the day; see, it is coming: the crowning time has gone out; the twisted way is flowering, pride has put out buds.

chinese: 強暴興起，成了罰惡的杖。以色列人，或是他們的群眾，或是他們的財寶，無一存留，他們中間也沒有得尊榮的。
english: Violent behaviour has been lifted up into a rod of evil; it will not be slow in coming, it will not keep back.

chinese: 時候到了，日子近了，買主不可歡喜，賣主不可愁煩，因為烈怒已經臨到他們眾人身上。
english: The time has come, the day is near: let not him who gives a price for goods be glad, or him who gets the price have sorrow:

chinese: 賣主雖然存活，卻不能歸回再得所賣的，因為這異象關乎他們眾人。誰都不得歸回，也沒有人在他的罪孽中堅立自己。
english: For the trader will not go back to the things for which he had his price, even while he is still living:

chinese: 他們已經吹角，預備齊全，卻無一人出戰，因為我的烈怒臨到他們眾人身上。
english: And he who has given a price for goods will not get them, for my wrath is on all of them.

chinese: 在外有刀劍，在內有瘟疫、饑荒；在田野的，必遭刀劍而死；在城中的，必有饑荒、瘟疫吞滅他。
english: Outside is the sword, and inside disease and need of food: he who is in the open country will be put to the sword; he who is in the town will come to his end through need of food and disease.

chinese: 其中所逃脫的就必逃脫，各人因自己的罪孽在山上發出悲聲，好像谷中的鴿子哀鳴。
english: And those of them who get away safely will go and be in the secret places like the doves of the valleys, all of them will come to death, every one in his sin.

chinese: 手都發軟，膝弱如水。
english: All hands will be feeble and all knees without strength, like water.

chinese: 要用麻布束腰，被戰兢所蓋；各人臉上羞愧，頭上光禿。
english: And they will put haircloth round them, and deep fear will be covering them; and shame will be on all faces, and the hair gone from all their heads.

chinese: 他們要將銀子拋在街上，金子看如污穢之物。當耶和華發怒的日子，他們的金銀不能救他們，不能使心裡知足，也不能使肚腹飽滿，因為這金銀作了他們罪孽的絆腳石。
english: They will put out their silver into the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold will not be able to keep them safe in the day of the wrath of the Lord; they will not get their desire or have food for their need: because it has been the cause of their falling into sin.

chinese: 論到耶和華妝飾華美的殿，他建立得威嚴，他們卻在其中製造可憎可厭的偶像，所以這殿我使他們看如污穢之物。
english: As for their beautiful ornament, they had put it on high, and had made the images of their disgusting and hated things in it: for this cause I have made it an unclean thing to them.

chinese: 我必將這殿交付外邦人為掠物，交付地上的惡人為擄物；他們也必褻瀆這殿。
english: And I will give it into the hands of men from strange lands who will take it by force, and to the evil-doers of the earth to have for themselves; and they will make it unholy.

chinese: 我必轉臉不顧以色列人，他們褻瀆我隱密之所，強盜也必進去褻瀆。
english: And my face will be turned away from them, and they will make my secret place unholy: violent men will go into it and make it unholy.

chinese: 要製造鎖鍊；因為這地遍滿流血的罪，城邑充滿強暴的事，
english: Make the chain: for the land is full of crimes of blood, and the town is full of violent acts.

chinese: 所以我必使列國中最惡的人來佔據他們的房屋；我必使強暴人的驕傲止息，他們的聖所都要被褻瀆。
english: For this reason I will send the worst of the nations and they will take their houses for themselves: I will make the pride of their strength come to an end; and their holy places will be made unclean.

chinese: 毀滅臨近了，他們要求平安，卻無平安可得。
english: Shaking fear is coming; and they will be looking for peace, and there will be no peace.

chinese: 災害加上災害，風聲接連風聲；他們必向先知求異象，但祭司講的律法、長老設的謀略都必斷絕。
english: Destruction will come on destruction, and one story after another; and the vision of the prophet will be shamed, and knowledge of the law will come to an end among the priests, and wisdom among the old.

chinese: 君要悲哀，王要披淒涼為衣，國民的手都發顫。我必照他們的行為待他們，按他們應得的審判他們，他們就知道我是耶和華。
english: The king will give himself up to sorrow, and the ruler will be clothed with wonder, and the hands of the people of the land will be troubled: I will give them punishment for their ways, judging them as it is right for them to be judged; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 第六年六月初五日，我坐在家中；猶大的眾長老坐在我面前。在那裡主耶和華的靈（原文是手）降在我身上。
english: Now in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, when I was in my house and the responsible men of Judah were seated before me, the hand of the Lord came on me there.

chinese: 我觀看，見有形像彷彿火的形狀，從他腰以下的形狀有火，從他腰以上有光輝的形狀，彷彿光耀的精金。
english: And looking, I saw a form like fire; from the middle of his body and down there was fire: and up from the middle of his body a sort of shining, like electrum.

chinese: 他伸出彷彿一隻手的樣式，抓住我的一綹頭髮，靈就將我舉到天地中間，在神的異象中，帶我到耶路撒冷朝北的內院門口，在那裡有觸動主怒偶像的坐位，就是惹動忌邪的。
english: And he put out the form of a hand and took me by the hair of my head; and the wind, lifting me up between the earth and the heaven, took me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the way into the inner door facing to the north; where was the seat of the image of envy.

chinese: 誰知，在那裡有以色列神的榮耀，形狀與我在平原所見的一樣。
english: And I saw the glory of the Lord there, as in the vision which I saw in the valley.

chinese: 神對我說：人子啊，你舉目向北觀看。我就舉目向北觀看，見祭壇門的北邊，在門口有這惹忌邪的偶像；
english: Then he said to me, Son of man, now let your eyes be lifted up in the direction of the north; and on looking in the direction of the north, to the north of the doorway of the altar, I saw this image of envy by the way in.

chinese: 又對我說：人子啊，以色列家所行的，就是在此行這大可憎的事，使我遠離我的聖所，你看見了麼？你還要看見另有大可憎的事。
english: And he said to me, Son of man, do you see what they are doing? even the very disgusting things which the children of Israel are doing here, causing me to go far away from my holy place? but you will see other most disgusting things.

chinese: 他領我到院門口。我觀看，見牆上有個窟窿。
english: And he took me to the door of the open place; and looking, I saw a hole in the wall.

chinese: 他對我說：人子啊，你要挖牆。我一挖牆，見有一門。
english: And he said to me, Son of man, make a hole in the wall: and after making a hole in the wall I saw a door.

chinese: 他說：你進去，看他們在這裡所行可憎的惡事。
english: And he said to me, Go in and see the evil and disgusting things which they are doing here.

chinese: 我進去一看，誰知，在四面牆上畫著各樣爬物和可憎的走獸，並以色列家一切的偶像。
english: So I went in and saw; and there every sort of living thing which goes flat on the earth, and unclean beasts, and all the images of the children of Israel, were pictured round about on the wall.

chinese: 在這些像前有以色列家的七十個長老站立，沙番的兒子雅撒尼亞也站在其中。各人手拿香爐，煙雲的香氣上騰。
english: And before them seventy of the responsible men of the children of Israel had taken their places, every man with a vessel for burning perfumes in his hand, and in the middle of them was Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan; and a cloud of smoke went up from the burning perfume.

chinese: 他對我說：人子啊，以色列家的長老暗中在各人畫像屋裡所行的，你看見了麼？他們常說：耶和華看不見我們；耶和華已經離棄這地。
english: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what the responsible men of the children of Israel do in the dark, every man in his room of pictured images? for they say, The Lord does not see us; the Lord has gone away from the land.

chinese: 他又說：你還要看見他們另外行大可憎的事。
english: Then he said to me, You will see even more disgusting things which they do.

chinese: 他領我到耶和華殿外院朝北的門口。誰知，在那裡有婦女坐著，為搭模斯哭泣。
english: Then he took me to the door of the way into the Lord's house looking to the north; and there women were seated weeping for Tammuz.

chinese: 他對我說：人子啊，你看見了麼？你還要看見比這更可憎的事。
english: Then he said to me, Have you seen this, O son of man? you will see even more disgusting things than these.

chinese: 他又領我到耶和華殿的內院。誰知，在耶和華的殿門口、廊子和祭壇中間，約有二十五個人背向耶和華的殿，面向東方拜日頭。
english: And he took me into the inner square of the Lord's house, and at the door of the Temple of the Lord, between the covered way and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs turned to the Temple of the Lord and their faces turned to the east; and they were worshipping the sun, turning to the east.

chinese: 他對我說：人子啊，你看見了麼？猶大家在此行這可憎的事還算為小麼？他們在這地遍行強暴，再三惹我發怒，他們手拿枝條舉向鼻前。
english: Then he said to me, Have you seen this, O son of man? is it a small thing to the children of Judah that they do the disgusting things which they are doing here? for they have made the land full of violent behaviour, making me angry again and again: and see, they put the branch to my nose.

chinese: 因此，我也要以忿怒行事，我眼必不顧惜，也不可憐他們；他們雖向我耳中大聲呼求，我還是不聽。
english: For this reason I will let loose my wrath: my eye will not have mercy, and I will have no pity.

chinese: 他向我耳中大聲喊叫說：要使那監管這城的人手中各拿滅命的兵器前來。
english: Then crying out in my hearing in a loud voice, he said, Let the overseers of the town come near, every man armed.

chinese: 忽然有六個人從朝北的上門而來，各人手拿殺人的兵器；內中有一人身穿細麻衣，腰間帶著墨盒子。他們進來，站在銅祭壇旁。
english: And six men came from the way of the higher doorway looking to the north, every man with his axe in his hand: and one man among them was clothed in linen, with a writer's inkpot at his side. And they went in and took their places by the brass altar.

chinese: 以色列神的榮耀本在基路伯上，現今從那裡升到殿的門檻。　神將那身穿細麻衣、腰間帶著墨盒子的人召來。
english: And the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from the winged ones on which it was resting, to the doorstep of the house. And crying out to the man clothed in linen who had the writer's inkpot at his side,

chinese: 耶和華對他說：你去走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行可憎之事歎息哀哭的人，畫記號在額上。
english: The Lord said to him, Go through the town, through the middle of Jerusalem, and put a mark on the brows of the men who are sorrowing and crying for all the disgusting things which are done in it.

chinese: 我耳中聽見他對其餘的人說：要跟隨他走遍全城，以行擊殺。你們的眼不要顧惜，也不要可憐他們。
english: And to these he said in my hearing, Go through the town after him using your axes: do not let your eyes have mercy, and have no pity:

chinese: 要將年老的、年少的，並處女、嬰孩，和婦女，從聖所起全都殺盡，只是凡有記號的人不要挨近他。於是他們從殿前的長老殺起。
english: Give up to destruction old men and young men and virgins, little children and women: but do not come near any man who has the mark on him: and make a start at my holy place. So they made a start with the old men who were before the house.

chinese: 他對他們說：要污穢這殿，使院中充滿被殺的人。你們出去罷！他們就出去，在城中擊殺。
english: And he said to them, Make the house unclean, make the open places full of dead: go forward and send destruction on the town.

chinese: 他們擊殺的時候，我被留下，我就俯伏在地，說：哎！主耶和華啊，你將忿怒傾在耶路撒冷，豈要將以色列所剩下的人都滅絕麼？
english: Now while they were doing so, and I was untouched, I went down on my face, and crying out, I said, Ah, Lord! will you give all the rest of Israel to destruction in letting loose your wrath on Jerusalem?

chinese: 他對我說：以色列家和猶大家的罪孽極其重大。遍地有流血的事，滿城有冤屈，因為他們說：耶和華已經離棄這地，他看不見我們。
english: Then he said to me, The sin of the children of Israel and Judah is very, very great, and the land is full of blood and the town full of evil ways: for they say, The Lord has gone away from the land, and the Lord does not see.

chinese: 故此，我眼必不顧惜，也不可憐他們，要照他們所行的報應在他們頭上。
english: And as for me, my eye will not have mercy, and I will have no pity, but I will send the punishment of their ways on their heads.

chinese: 那穿細麻衣、腰間帶著墨盒子的人將這事回覆說：我已經照你所吩咐的行了。
english: Then the man clothed in linen, who had the inkpot at his side, came back and said, I have done what you gave me orders to do.

chinese: 我觀看，見基路伯頭上的穹蒼之中，顯出藍寶石的形狀，彷彿寶座的形像。
english: Then looking, I saw that on the arch which was over the head of the winged ones there was seen over them what seemed like a sapphire stone, having the form of a king's seat.

chinese: 主對那穿細麻衣的人說：你進去，在旋轉的輪內基路伯以下，從基路伯中間將火炭取滿兩手，撒在城上。我就見他進去。
english: And he said to the man clothed in linen, Go in between the wheels, under the winged ones, and get your two hands full of burning coals from between the winged ones and send them in a shower over the town. And he went in before my eyes.

chinese: 那人進去的時候，基路伯站在殿的右邊，雲彩充滿了內院。
english: Now the winged ones were stationed on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the inner square was full of the cloud.

chinese: 耶和華的榮耀從基路伯那裡上升，停在門檻以上；殿內滿了雲彩，院宇也被耶和華榮耀的光輝充滿。
english: And the glory of the Lord went up from the winged ones and came to rest over the doorstep of the house; and the house was full of the cloud and the open square was full of the shining of the Lord's glory.

chinese: 基路伯翅膀的響聲聽到外院，好像全能神說話的聲音。
english: And the sound of the wings of the winged ones was clear even in the outer square, like the voice of the Ruler of all.

chinese: 他吩咐那穿細麻衣的人說：要從旋轉的輪內基路伯中間取火。那人就進去站在一個輪子旁邊。
english: And when he gave orders to the man clothed in linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the winged ones, then he went in and took his place at the side of a wheel.

chinese: 有一個基路伯從基路伯中伸手到基路伯中間的火那裡，取些放在那穿細麻衣的人兩手中，那人就拿出去了。
english: And stretching out his hand to the fire which was between the winged ones, he took some of it and went out.

chinese: 在基路伯翅膀之下，顯出有人手的樣式。
english: And I saw the form of a man's hands among the winged ones under their wings.

chinese: 我又觀看，見基路伯旁邊有四個輪子。這基路伯旁有一個輪子，那基路伯旁有一個輪子，每基路伯都是如此；輪子的顏色（原文是形狀）彷彿水蒼玉。
english: And looking, I saw four wheels by the side of the winged ones, one wheel by the side of a winged one and another wheel by the side of another: and the wheels were like the colour of a beryl stone to the eye.

chinese: 至於四輪的形狀，都是一個樣式，彷彿輪中套輪。
english: In form the four of them were all the same, they seemed like a wheel inside a wheel.

chinese: 輪行走的時候，向四方都能直行，並不掉轉。頭向何方，他們也隨向何方，行走的時候並不掉轉。
english: When they were moving, they went on their four sides without turning; they went after the head in the direction in which it was looking; they went without turning.

chinese: 他們全身，連背帶手和翅膀，並輪周圍都滿了眼睛。這四個基路伯的輪子都是如此。
english: And the edges of the four wheels were full of eyes round about.

chinese: 至於這些輪子，我耳中聽見說是旋轉的。
english: As for the wheels, they were named in my hearing, the circling wheels.

chinese: 基路伯各有四臉：第一是基路伯的臉，第二是人的臉，第三是獅子的臉，第四是鷹的臉。
english: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a winged one, and the second was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

chinese: 基路伯升上去了；這是我在迦巴魯河邊所見的活物。
english: And the winged ones went up on high: this is the living being which I saw by the river Chebar.

chinese: 基路伯行走，輪也在旁邊行走。基路伯展開翅膀，離地上升，輪也不轉離他們旁邊。
english: And when the winged ones went, the wheels went by their side: and when their wings were lifted to take them up from the earth, the wheels were not turned from their side.

chinese: 那些站住，這些也站住；那些上升，這些也一同上升，因為活物的靈在輪中。
english: When they were at rest in their place, these were at rest; when they were lifted up, these went up with them: for the spirit of life was in them.

chinese: 耶和華的榮耀從殿的門檻那裡出去，停在基路伯以上。
english: Then the glory of the Lord went out from the doorstep of the house, and came to rest over the winged ones.

chinese: 基路伯出去的時候，就展開翅膀，在我眼前離地上升。輪也在他們的旁邊，都停在耶和華殿的東門口。在他們以上有以色列神的榮耀。
english: And the winged ones, lifting up their wings, went up from the earth before my eyes, with the wheels by their side: and they came to rest at the east doorway of the Lord's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them on high.

chinese: 這是我在迦巴魯河邊所見、以色列神榮耀以下的活物，我就知道他們是基路伯。
english: This is the living being which I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and it was clear to me that they were the winged ones.

chinese: 各有四個臉面，四個翅膀，翅膀以下有人手的樣式。
english: Every one had four faces and every one had four wings; and hands like a man's hands were under their wings.

chinese: 至於他們臉的模樣，並身體的形像，是我從前在迦巴魯河邊所看見的。他們俱各直往前行。
english: As for the form of their faces, they were the faces whose form I saw by the river Chebar; when they went, every one of them went straight forward.

chinese: 靈將我舉起，帶到耶和華殿向東的東門。誰知，在門口有二十五個人，我見其中有民間的首領押朔的兒子雅撒尼亞和比拿雅的兒子毗拉提。
english: And the wind, lifting me up, took me to the east doorway of the Lord's house, looking to the east: and at the door I saw twenty-five men; and among them I saw Jaazaniah, the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah, the son of Benaiah, rulers of the people.

chinese: 耶和華對我說：人子啊，這就是圖謀罪孽的人，在這城中給人設惡謀。
english: Then he said to me, Son of man, these are the men who are designing evil, who are teaching evil ways in this town:

chinese: 他們說：蓋房屋的時候尚未臨近；這城是鍋，我們是肉。
english: Who say, This is not the time for building houses: this town is the cooking-pot and we are the flesh.

chinese: 人子啊，因此你當說預言，說預言攻擊他們。
english: For this cause be a prophet against them, be a prophet, O son of man.

chinese: 耶和華的靈降在我身上，對我說：你當說，耶和華如此說：以色列家啊，你們口中所說的，心裡所想的，我都知道。
english: And the spirit of the Lord came on me, and he said to me, Say, These are the words of the Lord: This is what you have said, O children of Israel; what comes into your mind is clear to me.

chinese: 你們在這城中殺人增多，使被殺的人充滿街道。
english: You have made great the number of your dead in this town, you have made its streets full of dead men.

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：你們殺在城中的人就是肉，這城就是鍋；你們卻要從其中被帶出去。
english: For this reason the Lord has said: Your dead whom you have put down in its streets, they are the flesh, and this town is the cooking-pot: but I will make you come out from inside it.

chinese: 你們怕刀劍，我必使刀劍臨到你們。這是主耶和華說的。
english: You have been fearing the sword, and I will send the sword on you, says the Lord.

chinese: 我必從這城中帶出你們去，交在外邦人的手中，且要在你們中間施行審判。
english: I will make you come out from inside the town and will give you up into the hands of men from other lands, and will be judge among you.

chinese: 你們必倒在刀下；我必在以色列的境界審判你們，你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: You will come to your death by the sword; and I will be your judge in the land of Israel; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 這城必不作你們的鍋，你們也不作其中的肉。我必在以色列的境界審判你們，
english: This town will not be your cooking-pot, and you will not be the flesh inside it; I will be your judge at the limit of the land of Israel;

chinese: 你們就知道我是耶和華；因為你們沒有遵行我的律例，也沒有順從我的典章，卻隨從你們四圍列國的惡規。
english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord: for you have not been guided by my rules or given effect to my orders, but you have been living by the orders of the nations round about you.

chinese: 我正說預言的時候，比拿雅的兒子毗拉提死了。於是我俯伏在地，大聲呼叫說：哎！主耶和華啊，你要將以色列剩下的人滅絕淨盡麼？
english: Now while I was saying these things, death came to Pelatiah, the son of Benaiah. Then falling down on my face and crying out with a loud voice, I said, Ah, Lord! will you put an end to all the rest of Israel?

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，耶路撒冷的居民對你的弟兄、你的本族、你的親屬、以色列全家，就是對大眾說：你們遠離耶和華罷！這地是賜給我們為業的。
english: Son of man, your countrymen, your relations, and all the children of Israel, all of them, are those to whom the people of Jerusalem have said, Go far from the Lord; this land is given to us for a heritage:

chinese: 所以你當說：耶和華如此說：我雖將以色列全家遠遠遷移到列國中，將他們分散在列邦內，我還要在他們所到的列邦，暫作他們的聖所。
english: For this reason say, This is what the Lord has said: Though I have had them moved far off among the nations, and though I have sent them wandering among the countries, still I have been a safe place for them for a little time in the countries where they have come.

chinese: 你當說：主耶和華如此說：我必從萬民中招聚你們，從分散的列國內聚集你們，又要將以色列地賜給你們。
english: Then say, This is what the Lord has said: I will get you together from the peoples, and make you come out of the countries where you have been sent in flight, and I will give you the land of Israel.

chinese: 他們必到那裡，也必從其中除掉一切可憎可厭的物。
english: And they will come there, and take away all the hated and disgusting things from it.

chinese: 我要使他們有合一的心，也要將新靈放在他們裡面，又從他們肉體中除掉石心，賜給他們肉心，
english: And I will give them a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in them; and I will take the heart of stone out of their flesh and give them a heart of flesh:

chinese: 使他們順從我的律例，謹守遵行我的典章。他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的神。
english: So that they may be guided by my rules and keep my orders and do them: and they will be to me a people, and I will be to them a God.

chinese: 至於那些心中隨從可憎可厭之物的，我必照他們所行的報應在他們頭上。這是主耶和華說的。
english: But as for those whose heart goes after their hated and disgusting things, I will send on their heads the punishment of their ways, says the Lord.

chinese: 於是，基路伯展開翅膀，輪子都在他們旁邊；在他們以上有以色列神的榮耀。
english: Then the wings of the winged ones were lifted up, and the wheels were by their side; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them on high.

chinese: 耶和華的榮耀從城中上升，停在城東的那座山上。
english: And the glory of the Lord went up from inside the town, and came to rest on the mountain on the east side of the town.

chinese: 靈將我舉起，在異象中藉著神的靈將我帶進迦勒底地，到被擄的人那裡；我所見的異象就離我上升去了。
english: And the wind, lifting me up, took me in the visions of God into Chaldaea, to those who had been taken away as prisoners. So the vision which I had seen went away from me.

chinese: 我便將耶和華所指示我的一切事都說給被擄的人聽。
english: Then I gave an account to those who had been taken prisoners of all the things which the Lord had made me see.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你住在悖逆的家中。他們有眼睛看不見，有耳朵聽不見，因為他們是悖逆之家。
english: Son of man, you are living among an uncontrolled people, who have eyes to see but see not, and ears for hearing but they do not give ear; for they are an uncontrolled people.

chinese: 所以人子啊，你要預備擄去使用的物件，在白日當他們眼前從你所住的地方移到別處去；他們雖是悖逆之家，或者可以揣摩思想。
english: And you, O son of man, by day, before their eyes, get ready the vessels of one who is taken away, and go away from your place to another place before their eyes: it may be that they will see, though they are an uncontrolled people.

chinese: 你要在白日當他們眼前帶出你的物件去，好像預備擄去使用的物件。到了晚上，你要在他們眼前親自出去，像被擄的人出去一樣。
english: By day, before their eyes, take out your vessels like those of one who is taken away: and go out in the evening before their eyes, like those who are taken away as prisoners.

chinese: 你要在他們眼前挖通了牆，從其中將物件帶出去。
english: Make a hole in the wall, before their eyes, and go out through it.

chinese: 到天黑時，你要當他們眼前搭在肩頭上帶出去，並要蒙住臉看不見地，因為我立你作以色列家的預兆。
english: And before their eyes, take your goods on your back and go out in the dark; go with your face covered: for I have made you a sign to the children of Israel.

chinese: 我就照著所吩咐的去行，白日帶出我的物件，好像預備擄去使用的物件。到了晚上，我用手挖通了牆。天黑的時候，就當他們眼前搭在肩頭上帶出去。
english: And I did as I was ordered: I took out my vessels by day, like those of one who is taken away, and in the evening I made a hole through the wall with a tent-pin; and in the dark I went out, taking my things on my back before their eyes.

chinese: 次日早晨，耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And in the morning the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，以色列家，就是那悖逆之家，豈不是問你說：你做什麼呢？
english: Son of man, has not Israel, the uncontrolled people, said to you, What are you doing?

chinese: 你要對他們說：主耶和華如此說：這是關乎耶路撒冷的君王和他周圍以色列全家的預表（原文是擔子）。
english: You are to say to them, This is what the Lord has said: This word has to do with the ruler in Jerusalem and all the children of Israel in it.

chinese: 你要說：我作你們的預兆：我怎樣行，他們所遭遇的也必怎樣，他們必被擄去。
english: Say, I am your sign: as I have done, so will it be done to them: they will go away as prisoners.

chinese: 他們中間的君王也必在天黑的時候將物件搭在肩頭上帶出去。他們要挖通了牆，從其中帶出去。他必蒙住臉，眼看不見地。
english: And the ruler who is among them will take his goods on his back in the dark and go out: he will make a hole in the wall through which to go out: he will have his face covered so that he may not be seen.

chinese: 我必將我的網撒在他身上，他必在我的網羅中纏住。我必帶他到迦勒底人之地的巴比倫；他雖死在那裡，卻看不見那地。
english: And my net will be stretched out on him, and he will be taken in my cords: and I will take him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldaeans; but he will not see it, and there death will come to him.

chinese: 周圍一切幫助他的和他所有的軍隊，我必分散四方（方：原文是風），也要拔刀追趕他們。
english: And all his helpers round about him and all his armies I will send in flight to every wind; and I will let loose a sword after them.

chinese: 我將他們四散在列國、分散在列邦的時候，他們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And they will be certain that I am the Lord, when I send them in flight among the nations, driving them out through the countries.

chinese: 我卻要留下他們幾個人得免刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫，使他們在所到的各國中述說他們一切可憎的事，人就知道我是耶和華。
english: But a small number of them I will keep from the sword, from the need of food, and from disease, so that they may make clear all their disgusting ways among the nations where they come; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你吃飯必膽戰，喝水必惶惶憂慮。
english: Son of man, take your food with shaking fear, and your water with trouble and care;

chinese: 你要對這地的百姓說：主耶和華論耶路撒冷和以色列地的居民如此說，他們吃飯必憂慮，喝水必驚惶。因其中居住的眾人所行強暴的事，這地必然荒廢，一無所存。
english: And say to the people of the land, This is what the Lord has said about the people of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: They will take their food with care and their drink with wonder, so that all the wealth of their land may be taken from it because of the violent ways of the people living in it.

chinese: 有居民的城邑必變為荒場，地也必變為荒廢；你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And the peopled towns will be made waste, and the land will become a wonder; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，在你們以色列地怎麼有這俗語，說日子遲延，一切異象都落了空呢？
english: Son of man, what is this saying which you have about the land of Israel, The time is long and every vision comes to nothing?

chinese: 你要告訴他們說：主耶和華如此說：我必使這俗語止息，以色列中不再用這俗語。你卻要對他們說：日子臨近，一切的異象必都應驗。
english: For this cause say to them, This is what the Lord has said: I have made this saying come to an end, and it will no longer be used as a common saying in Israel; but say to them, The days are near, and the effect of every vision.

chinese: 從此，在以色列家中必不再有虛假的異象和奉承的占卜。
english: For there will be no more false visions or smooth use of secret arts in Israel.

chinese: 我─耶和華說話，所說的必定成就，不再耽延。你們這悖逆之家，我所說的話必趁你們在世的日子成就。這是主耶和華說的。
english: For I am the Lord; I will say the word and what I say I will do; it will not be put off: for in your days, O uncontrolled people, I will say the word and do it, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，以色列家的人說：他所見的異象是關乎後來許多的日子，所說的預言是指著極遠的時候。
english: Son of man, see, the children of Israel say, The vision which he sees is for the days which are a long way off, and his words are of times still far away.

chinese: 所以你要對他們說：主耶和華如此說：我的話沒有一句再耽延的，我所說的必定成就。這是主耶和華說的。
english: Say to them then, This is what the Lord has said: Not one of my words will be put off any longer, but what I say I will do, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要說預言攻擊以色列中說預言的先知，對那些本己心發預言的說：你們當聽耶和華的話。
english: Son of man, be a prophet against the prophets of Israel, and say to those prophets whose words are the invention of their hearts, Give ear to the word of the Lord;

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：愚頑的先知有禍了，他們隨從自己的心意，卻一無所見。
english: This is what the Lord has said: A curse on the foolish prophets who go after the spirit which is in them and have seen nothing!

chinese: 以色列啊，你的先知好像荒場中的狐狸，
english: O Israel, your prophets have been like jackals in the waste places.

chinese: 沒有上去堵擋破口，也沒有為以色列家重修牆垣，使他們當耶和華的日子在陣上站立得住。
english: You have not gone up into the broken places or made up the wall for the children of Israel to take your place in the fight in the day of the Lord.

chinese: 這些人所見的是虛假，是謊詐的占卜。他們說是耶和華說的，其實耶和華並沒有差遣他們，他們倒使人指望那話必然立定。
english: They have seen visions without substance and made use of secret arts, who say, The Lord has said; and the Lord has not sent them: hoping that the word would have effect.

chinese: 你們豈不是見了虛假的異象麼？豈不是說了謊詐的占卜麼？你們說，這是耶和華說的，其實我沒有說。
english: Have you not seen a vision without substance and have you not falsely made use of secret arts, when you say, The Lord has said; though I have said nothing?

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：因你們說的是虛假，見的是謊詐，我就與你們反對。這是主耶和華說的。
english: So this is what the Lord has said: Because your words are without substance and your visions are false, see, I am against you, says the Lord.

chinese: 我的手必攻擊那見虛假異象、用謊詐占卜的先知，他們必不列在我百姓的會中，不錄在以色列家的冊上，也不進入以色列地；你們就知道我是主耶和華。
english: And my hand will be against the prophets who see visions without substance and who make false use of secret arts: they will not be in the secret of my people, and they will not be recorded in the list of the children of Israel, and they will not come into the land of Israel; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord.

chinese: 因為他們誘惑我的百姓，說：平安！其實沒有平安，就像有人立起牆壁，他們倒用未泡透的灰抹上。
english: Because, even because they have been guiding my people into error, saying, Peace; when there is no peace; and in the building of a division wall they put whitewash on it:

chinese: 所以你要對那些抹上未泡透灰的人說：牆要倒塌，必有暴雨漫過。大冰雹啊，你們要降下，狂風也要吹裂這牆。
english: Say to those who put whitewash on it, There will be an overflowing shower; and you, O ice-drops, will come raining down; and it will be broken in two by the storm-wind.

chinese: 這牆倒塌之後，人豈不問你們說：你們抹上未泡透的灰在哪裡呢？
english: And when the wall has come down, will they not say to you, Where is the whitewash which you put on it?

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：我要發怒，使狂風吹裂這牆，在怒中使暴雨漫過，又發怒降下大冰雹，毀滅這牆。
english: For this reason, the Lord has said: I will have it broken in two by a storm-wind in my passion; and there will be an overflowing shower in my wrath, and you, O ice-drops, will come raining angrily down.

chinese: 我要這樣拆毀你們那未泡透灰所抹的牆，拆平到地，以致根基露出，牆必倒塌，你們也必在其中滅亡；你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: So I will let the wall, which you were covering with whitewash, be broken down; I will have it levelled to the earth so that its base is uncovered: it will come down, and destruction will come on you with it; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord.

chinese: 我要這樣向牆和用未泡透灰抹牆的人成就我怒中所定的，並要對你們說：牆和抹牆的人都沒有了。
english: So I will let loose my passion on the wall in full measure, and on those who put whitewash on it; and I will say to you, Where is the wall, and where are those who put whitewash on it?

chinese: 這抹牆的就是以色列的先知，他們指著耶路撒冷說預言，為這城見了平安的異象，其實沒有平安。這是主耶和華說的。
english: Even the prophets of Israel who say words to Jerusalem, who see visions of peace for her when there is no peace, says the Lord.

chinese: 人子啊，你要面向本民中、從己心發預言的女子說預言，攻擊他們，
english: And you, son of man, let your face be turned against the daughters of your people, who are acting the part of prophets at their pleasure; be a prophet against them, and say,

chinese: 說主耶和華如此說：這些婦女有禍了！他們為眾人的膀臂縫靠枕，給高矮之人做下垂的頭巾，為要獵取人的性命。難道你們要獵取我百姓的性命，為利己將人救活麼？
english: This is what the Lord has said: A curse is on the women who are stitching bands on all arms and putting veils on the heads of those of every size, so that they may go after souls! Will you go after the souls of my people and keep yourselves safe from death?

chinese: 你們為兩把大麥，為幾塊餅，在我民中褻瀆我，對肯聽謊言的民說謊，殺死不該死的人，救活不該活的人。
english: And you have put me to shame among my people for a little barley and some bits of bread, sending death on souls for whom there is no cause of death, and keeping those souls living who have no right to life, by the false words you say to my people who give ear to what is false.

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：看哪，我與你們的靠枕反對，就是你們用以獵取人、使人的性命如鳥飛的。我要將靠枕從你們的膀臂上扯去，釋放你們獵取如鳥飛的人。
english: For this cause the Lord has said: See, I am against your bands with which you go after souls, and I will violently take them off their arms; and I will let loose the souls, even the souls whom you go after freely.

chinese: 我也必撕裂你們下垂的頭巾，救我百姓脫離你們的手，不再被獵取，落在你們手中。你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And I will have your veils violently parted in two, and will make my people free from your hands, and they will no longer be in your power for you to go after them; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 我不使義人傷心，你們卻以謊話使他傷心，又堅固惡人的手，使他不回頭離開惡道得以救活。
english: Because with your false words you have given pain to the heart of the upright man when I had not made him sad; in order to make strong the hands of the evil-doer so that he may not be turned from his evil way and get life:

chinese: 你們就不再見虛假的異象，也不再行占卜的事；我必救我的百姓脫離你們的手；你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: For this cause you will see no more foolish visions or make false use of secret arts: and I will make my people free from your power; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 有幾個以色列長老到我這裡來，坐在我面前。
english: Then certain of the responsible men of Israel came to me and took their seats before me.

chinese: 耶和華的話就臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，這些人已將他們的假神接到心裡，把陷於罪的絆腳石放在面前，我豈能絲毫被他們求問麼？
english: Son of man, these men have taken their false gods into their hearts and put before their faces the sin which is the cause of their fall: am I to give ear when they come to me for directions?

chinese: 所以你要告訴他們：主耶和華如此說：以色列家的人中，凡將他的假神接到心裡，把陷於罪的絆腳石放在面前，又就了先知來的，我─耶和華在他所求的事上，必按他眾多的假神回答他（或譯：必按他拜許多假神的罪報應他），
english: For this cause say to them, These are the words of the Lord: Every man of Israel who has taken his false god into his heart, and put before his face the sin which is the cause of his fall, and comes to the prophet; I the Lord will give him an answer by myself in agreement with the number of his false gods;

chinese: 好在以色列家的心事上捉住他們，因為他們都藉著假神與我生疏。
english: So as to take the children of Israel in the thoughts of their hearts, because they have become strange to me through their false gods.

chinese: 所以你要告訴以色列家說：主耶和華如此說：回頭罷！離開你們的偶像，轉臉莫從你們一切可憎的事。
english: For this cause say to the children of Israel, These are the words of the Lord: Come back and give up your false gods and let your faces be turned from your disgusting things.

chinese: 因為以色列家的人，或在以色列中寄居的外人，凡與我隔絕，將他的假神接到心裡，把陷於罪的絆腳石放在面前，又就了先知來要為自己的事求問我的，我─耶和華必親自回答他。
english: When any one of the men of Israel, or of those from other lands who are living in Israel, who has become strange to me, and takes his false gods into his heart, and puts before his face the sin which is the cause of his fall, comes to the prophet to get directions from me; I the Lord will give him an answer by myself:

chinese: 我必向那人變臉，使他作了警戒，笑談，令人驚駭，並且我要將他從我民中剪除；你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And my face will be turned against that man, and I will make him a sign and a common saying, cutting him off from among my people; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 先知若被迷惑說一句預言，是我─耶和華任那先知受迷惑，我也必向他伸手，將他從我民以色列中除滅。
english: And if the prophet, tricked by deceit, says anything, it is I the Lord by whom he has been tricked, and I will put out my hand against him, and he will be cut off from among my people Israel.

chinese: 他們必擔當自己的罪孽。先知的罪孽和求問之人的罪孽都是一樣，
english: And the punishment of their sin will be on them: the sin of the prophet will be the same as the sin of him who goes to him for directions;

chinese: 好使以色列家不再走迷離開我，不再因各樣的罪過玷污自己，只要作我的子民，我作他們的神。這是主耶和華說的。
english: So that the children of Israel may no longer go wandering away from me, or make themselves unclean with all their wrongdoing; but they will be my people, and I will be their God, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，若有一國犯罪干犯我，我也向他伸手折斷他們的杖，就是斷絕他們的糧，使饑荒臨到那地，將人與牲畜從其中剪除；
english: Son of man, when a land, sinning against me, does wrong, and my hand is stretched out against it, and the support of its bread is broken, and I make it short of food, cutting off man and beast from it:

chinese: 其中雖有挪亞、但以理、約伯這三人，他們只能因他們的義救自己的性命。這是主耶和華說的。
english: Even if these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, only themselves would they keep safe by their righteousness, says the Lord.

chinese: 我若使惡獸經過糟踐那地，使地荒涼，以致因這些獸，人都不得經過；
english: Or if I send evil beasts through the land causing destruction and making it waste, so that no man may go through because of the beasts:

chinese: 雖有這三人在其中，主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，他們連兒帶女都不能得救，只能自己得救，那地仍然荒涼。
english: Even if these three men were in it, by my life, says the Lord, they would not keep safe their sons or daughters, but only themselves, and the land would be made waste.

chinese: 或者我使刀劍臨到那地，說：刀劍哪，要經過那地，以致我將人與牲畜從其中剪除；
english: Or if I send a sword against that land, and say, Sword, go through the land, cutting off from it man and beast:

chinese: 雖有這三人在其中，主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，他們連兒帶女都不能得救，只能自己得救。
english: Even if these three men were in it, by my life, says the Lord, they would not keep safe their sons or daughters, but only themselves.

chinese: 或者我叫瘟疫流行那地，使我滅命（原文是帶血）的忿怒傾在其上，好將人與牲畜從其中剪除；
english: Or if I send disease into that land, letting loose my wrath on it in blood, cutting off from it man and beast:

chinese: 雖有挪亞、但以理、約伯在其中，主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，他們連兒帶女都不能救，只能因他們的義救自己的性命。
english: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, by my life, says the Lord, they would not keep son or daughter safe; only themselves would they keep safe through their righteousness.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：我將這四樣大災─就是刀劍、饑荒、惡獸、瘟疫降在耶路撒冷，將人與牲畜從其中剪除，豈不更重麼？
english: For this is what the Lord has said: How much more when I send my four bitter punishments on Jerusalem, the sword and need of food and evil beasts and disease, cutting off from it man and beast?

chinese: 然而其中必有剩下的人，他們連兒帶女必帶到你們這裡來，你們看見他們所行所為的，要因我降給耶路撒冷的一切災禍，便得了安慰。
english: But truly, there will still be a small band who will be safe, even sons and daughters: and they will come out to you, and you will see their ways and their doings: and you will be comforted about the evil which I have sent on Jerusalem, even about everything I have sent on it.

chinese: 你們看見他們所行所為的，得了安慰，就知道我在耶路撒冷中所行的並非無故。這是主耶和華說的。
english: They will give you comfort when you see their ways and their doings: and you will be certain that not for nothing have I done all the things I have done in it, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，葡萄樹比別樣樹有甚麼強處？葡萄枝比眾樹枝有甚麼好處？
english: Son of man, what is the vine-tree more than any branching tree which is among the trees of the woods?

chinese: 其上可以取木料做甚麼工用，可以取來做釘子掛甚麼器皿麼？
english: Will its wood be used for any work? do men make of it a pin for hanging any vessel on?

chinese: 看哪，已經拋在火中當作柴燒，火既燒了兩頭，中間也被燒了，還有益於工用麼？
english: See, it is put into the fire for burning: the fire has made a meal of its two ends and the middle part of it is burned; is it good for any work?

chinese: 完全的時候尚且不合乎甚麼工用，何況被火燒壞，還能合乎甚麼工用麼？
english: Truly, before it was cut down, it was not used for any purpose: how much less, when the fire has made a meal of it and it is burned, will it be made into anything?

chinese: 所以，主耶和華如此說：眾樹以內的葡萄樹，我怎樣使他在火中當柴，也必照樣待耶路撒冷的居民。
english: For this cause the Lord has said: Like the vine-tree among the trees of the woods which I have given to the fire for burning, so will I give the people of Jerusalem.

chinese: 我必向他們變臉；他們雖從火中出來，火卻要燒滅他們。我向他們變臉的時候，你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And my face will be turned against them; and though they have come out of the fire they will be burned up by it; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord when my face is turned against them.

chinese: 我必使地土荒涼，因為他們行事干犯我。這是主耶和華說的。
english: And I will make the land a waste because they have done evil, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要使耶路撒冷知道他那些可憎的事，
english: Son of man, make clear to Jerusalem her disgusting ways,

chinese: 說主耶和華對耶路撒冷如此說：你根本，你出世，是在迦南地；你父親是亞摩利人，你母親是赫人。
english: And say, This is what the Lord has said to Jerusalem: Your start and your birth was from the land of the Canaanite; an Amorite was your father and your mother was a Hittite.

chinese: 論到你出世的景況，在你初生的日子沒有為你斷臍帶，也沒有用水洗你，使你潔淨，絲毫沒有撒鹽在你身上，也沒有用布裹你。
english: As for your birth, on the day of your birth your cord was not cut and you were not washed in water to make you clean; you were not salted or folded in linen bands.

chinese: 誰的眼也不可憐你，為你做一件這樣的事憐恤你；但你初生的日子扔在田野，是因你被厭惡。
english: No eye had pity on you to do any of these things to you or to be kind to you; but you were put out into the open country, because your life was hated at the time of your birth.

chinese: 我從你旁邊經過，見你滾在血中，就對你說：你雖在血中，仍可存活；你雖在血中，仍可存活。
english: And when I went past you and saw you stretched out in your blood, I said to you, Though you are stretched out in your blood, have life;

chinese: 我使你生長好像田間所長的，你就漸漸長大，以致極其俊美，兩乳成形，頭髮長成，你卻仍然赤身露體。
english: And be increased in number like the buds of the field; and you were increased and became great, and you came to the time of love: your breasts were formed and your hair was long; but you were uncovered and without clothing.

chinese: 我從你旁邊經過，看見你的時候正動愛情，便用衣襟搭在你身上，遮蓋你的赤體；又向你起誓，與你結盟，你就歸於我。這是主耶和華說的。
english: Now when I went past you, looking at you, I saw that your time was the time of love; and I put my skirts over you, covering your unclothed body: and I gave you my oath and made an agreement with you, says the Lord, and you became mine.

chinese: 那時我用水洗你，洗淨你身上的血，又用油抹你。
english: Then I had you washed with water, washing away all your blood and rubbing you with oil.

chinese: 我也使你身穿繡花衣服，腳穿海狗皮鞋，並用細麻布給你束腰，用絲綢為衣披在你身上，
english: And I had you clothed with needlework, and put leather shoes on your feet, folding fair linen about you and covering you with silk.

chinese: 又用妝飾打扮你，將鐲子戴在你手上，將金鍊戴在你項上。
english: And I made you fair with ornaments and put jewels on your hands and a chain on your neck.

chinese: 我也將環子戴在你鼻子上，將耳環戴在你耳朵上，將華冠戴在你頭上。
english: And I put a ring in your nose and ear-rings in your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.

chinese: 這樣，你就有金銀的妝飾，穿的是細麻衣和絲綢，並繡花衣；吃的是細麵、蜂蜜，並油。你也極其美貌，發達到王后的尊榮。
english: So you were made beautiful with gold and silver; and your clothing was of the best linen and silk and needlework; your food was the best meal and honey and oil: and you were very beautiful.

chinese: 你美貌的名聲傳在列邦中，你十分美貌，是因我加在你身上的威榮。這是主耶和華說的。
english: You were so beautiful that the story of you went out into all nations; you were completely beautiful because of my glory which I had put on you, says the Lord.

chinese: 只是你仗著自己的美貌，又因你的名聲就行邪淫。你縱情淫亂，使過路的任意而行。
english: But you put your faith in the fact that you were beautiful, acting like a loose woman because you were widely talked of, and offering your cheap love to everyone who went by, whoever it might be.

chinese: 你用衣服為自己在高處結彩，在其上行邪淫。這樣的事將來必沒有，也必不再行了。
english: And you took your robes and made high places for yourself ornamented with every colour, acting like a loose woman on them, without shame or fear.

chinese: 你又將我所給你那華美的金銀、寶器為自己製造人像，與他行邪淫；
