english: And you took the fair jewels, my silver and gold which I had given to you, and made for yourself male images, acting like a loose woman with them;

chinese: 又用你的繡花衣服給他披上，並將我的膏油和香料擺在他跟前；
english: And you took your robes of needlework for their clothing, and put my oil and my perfume before them.

chinese: 又將我賜給你的食物，就是我賜給你吃的細麵、油，和蜂蜜，都擺在他跟前為馨香的供物。這是主耶和華說的。
english: And my bread which I gave you, the best meal and oil and honey which I gave you for your food, you put it before them for a sweet smell, says the Lord.

chinese: 並且你將給我所生的兒女焚獻給他。
english: And you took your sons and your daughters whom I had by you, offering even these to them to be their food. Was your loose behaviour so small a thing,

chinese: 你行淫亂豈是小事，竟將我的兒女殺了，使他們經火歸與他麼？
english: That you put my children to death and gave them up to go through the fire to them?

chinese: 你行這一切可憎和淫亂的事，並未追念你幼年赤身露體滾在血中的日子。
english: And in all your disgusting and false behaviour you had no memory of your early days, when you were uncovered and without clothing, stretched out in your blood.

chinese: 你行這一切惡事之後（主耶和華說：你有禍了！有禍了！）
english: And it came about, after all your evil-doing, says the Lord,

chinese: 又為自己建造圓頂花樓，在各街上做了高臺。
english: That you made for yourself an arched room in every open place.

chinese: 你在一切市口上建造高臺，使你的美貌變為可憎的，又與一切過路的多行淫亂。
english: You put up your high places at the top of every street, and made the grace of your form a disgusting thing, opening your feet to everyone who went by, increasing your loose ways.

chinese: 你也和你鄰邦放縱情慾的埃及人行淫，加增你的淫亂，惹我發怒。
english: And you went with the Egyptians, your neighbours, great of flesh; increasing your loose ways, moving me to wrath.

chinese: 因此我伸手攻擊你，減少你應用的糧食，又將你交給恨你的非利士眾女（眾女是城邑的意思；本章下同），使他們任意待你。他們見你的淫行，為你羞恥。
english: Now, then, my hand is stretched out against you, cutting down your fixed amount, and I have given you up to the desire of your haters, the daughters of the Philistines who are shamed by your loose ways.

chinese: 你因貪色無厭，又與亞述人行淫，與他們行淫之後，仍不滿意，
english: And you went with the Assyrians, because of your desire which was without measure; you were acting like a loose woman with them, and still you had not enough.

chinese: 並且多行淫亂，直到那貿易之地，就是迦勒底，你仍不滿意。
english: And you went on in your loose ways, even as far as the land of Chaldaea, and still you had not enough.

chinese: 主耶和華說：你行這一切事，都是不知羞恥妓女所行的，可見你的心是何等懦弱！
english: How feeble is your heart, says the Lord, seeing that you do all these things, the work of a loose and overruling woman;

chinese: 因你在一切市口上建造圓頂花樓，在各街上做了高臺，你卻藐視賞賜，不像妓女。
english: For you have made your arched room at the top of every street, and your high place in every open place; though you were not like a loose woman in getting together your payment.

chinese: 哎！你這行淫的妻啊，寧肯接外人，不接丈夫。
english: The untrue wife who takes strange lovers in place of her husband!

chinese: 凡妓女是得人贈送，你反倒贈送你所愛的人，賄賂他們從四圍來與你行淫。
english: They give payment to all loose women: but you give rewards to your lovers, offering them payment so that they may come to you on every side for your cheap love.

chinese: 你行淫與別的婦女相反，因為不是人從你行淫；你既贈送人，人並不贈送你；所以你與別的婦女相反。
english: And in your loose behaviour you are different from other women, for no one goes after you to make love to you: and because you give payment and no payment is given to you, in this you are different from them.

chinese: 你這妓女啊，要聽耶和華的話。
english: For this cause, O loose woman, give ear to the voice of the Lord:

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：因你的污穢傾洩了，你與你所愛的行淫露出下體，又因你拜一切可憎的偶像，流兒女的血獻給他，
english: This is what the Lord has said: Because your unclean behaviour was let loose and your body uncovered in your loose ways with your lovers and with your disgusting images, and for the blood of your children which you gave to them;

chinese: 我就要將你一切相歡相愛的和你一切所恨的都聚集來，從四圍攻擊你；又將你的下體露出，使他們看盡了。
english: For this cause I will get together all your lovers with whom you have taken your pleasure, and all those to whom you have given your love, with all those who were hated by you; I will even make them come together against you on every side, and I will have you uncovered before them so that they may see your shame.

chinese: 我也要審判你，好像官長審判淫婦和流人血的婦女一樣。我因忿怒忌恨，使流血的罪歸到你身上。
english: And you will be judged by me as women are judged who have been untrue to their husbands and have taken life; and I will let loose against you passion and bitter feeling.

chinese: 我又要將你交在他們手中；他們必拆毀你的圓頂花樓，毀壞你的高臺，剝去你的衣服，奪取你的華美寶器，留下你赤身露體。
english: I will give you into their hands, and your arched room will be overturned and your high places broken down; they will take your clothing off you and take away your fair jewels: and when they have done, you will be uncovered and shamed.

chinese: 他們也必帶多人來攻擊你，用石頭打死你，用刀劍刺透你，
english: And they will get together a meeting against you, stoning you with stones and wounding you with their swords.

chinese: 用火焚燒你的房屋，在許多婦人眼前向你施行審判。我必使你不再行淫，也不再贈送與人。
english: And they will have you burned with fire, sending punishments on you before the eyes of great numbers of women; and I will put an end to your loose ways, and you will no longer give payment.

chinese: 這樣，我就止息向你發的忿怒，我的忌恨也要離開你，我要安靜不再惱怒。
english: And the heat of my wrath against you will have an end, and my bitter feeling will be turned away from you, and I will be quiet and will be angry no longer.

chinese: 因你不追念你幼年的日子，在這一切的事上向我發烈怒，所以我必照你所行的報應在你頭上，你就不再貪淫，行那一切可憎的事。這是主耶和華說的。
english: Because you have not kept in mind the days when you were young, but have been troubling me with all these things; for this reason I will make the punishment of your ways come on your head, says the Lord, because you have done this evil thing in addition to all your disgusting acts.

chinese: 凡說俗語的必用俗語攻擊你，說：母親怎樣，女兒也怎樣。
english: See, in every common saying about you it will be said, As the mother is, so is her daughter.

chinese: 你正是你母親的女兒，厭棄丈夫和兒女；你正是你姊妹的姊妹，厭棄丈夫和兒女。你母親是赫人，你父親是亞摩利人。
english: You are the daughter of your mother whose soul is turned in disgust from her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters who were turned in disgust from their husbands and their children: your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

chinese: 你的姊姊是撒瑪利亞，他和他的眾女住在你左邊；你的妹妹是所多瑪，他和他的眾女住在你右邊。
english: Your older sister is Samaria, living at your left hand, she and her daughters: and your younger sister, living at your right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

chinese: 你沒有效法他們的行為，也沒有照他們可憎的事去做，你以那為小事，你一切所行的倒比他們更壞。
english: Still you have not gone in their ways or done the disgusting things which they have done; but, as if that was only a little thing, you have gone deeper in evil than they in all your ways.

chinese: 主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，你妹妹所多瑪與他的眾女尚未行你和你眾女所行的事。
english: By my life, says the Lord, Sodom your sister never did, she or her daughters, what you and your daughters have done.

chinese: 看哪，你妹妹所多瑪的罪孽是這樣：他和他的眾女都心驕氣傲，糧食飽足，大享安逸，並沒有扶助困苦和窮乏人的手。
english: Truly, this was the sin of your sister Sodom: pride, a full measure of food, and the comforts of wealth in peace, were seen in her and her daughters, and she gave no help to the poor or to those in need.

chinese: 他們狂傲，在我面前行可憎的事，我看見便將他們除掉。
english: They were full of pride and did what was disgusting to me: and so I took them away as you have seen.

chinese: 撒瑪利亞沒有犯你一半的罪，你行可憎的事比他更多，使你的姊妹因你所行一切可憎的事，倒顯為義。
english: And Samaria has not done half your sins; but you have made the number of your disgusting acts greater than theirs, making your sisters seem more upright than you by all the disgusting things which you have done.

chinese: 你既斷定你姊妹為義（為義：或譯當受羞辱），就要擔當自己的羞辱；因你所犯的罪比他們更為可憎，他們就比你更顯為義；你既使你的姊妹顯為義，你就要抱愧擔當自己的羞辱。
english: And you yourself will be put to shame, in that you have given the decision for your sisters; through your sins, which are more disgusting than theirs, they are more upright than you: truly, you will be shamed and made low, for you have made your sisters seem upright.

chinese: 我必叫他們被擄的歸回，就是叫所多瑪和他的眾女，撒瑪利亞和他的眾女，並你們中間被擄的，都要歸回，
english: And I will let their fate be changed, the fate of Sodom and her daughters, and the fate of Samaria and her daughters, and your fate with theirs.

chinese: 好使你擔當自己的羞辱，並因你一切所行的使他們得安慰，你就抱愧。
english: So that you will be shamed and made low because of all you have done, when I have mercy on you.

chinese: 你的妹妹所多瑪和他的眾女必歸回原位；撒瑪利亞和他的眾女，你和你的眾女，也必歸回原位。
english: And your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will go back to their first condition, and Samaria and her daughters will go back to their first condition, and you and your daughters will go back to your first condition.

chinese: 在你驕傲的日子，你的惡行沒有顯露以先，你的口就不提你的妹妹所多瑪。那受了凌辱的亞蘭眾女和亞蘭四圍非利士的眾女都恨惡你，藐視你。
english: Was not your sister Sodom an oath in your mouth in the day of your pride,

Before your shame was uncovered? Now you have become like her a word of shame to the daughters of Edom and all who are round about you, the daughters of the Philistines who put shame on you round about.

chinese: 耶和華說：你貪淫和可憎的事，你已經擔當了。
english: The reward of your evil designs and your disgusting ways has come on you, says the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：你這輕看誓言、背棄盟約的，我必照你所行的待你。
english: For this is what the Lord has said: I will do to you as you have done, you who, putting the oath on one side, have let the agreement be broken.

chinese: 然而我要追念在你幼年時與你所立的約，也要與你立定永約。
english: But still I will keep in mind the agreement made with you in the days when you were young, and I will make with you an eternal agreement.

chinese: 你接待你姊姊和你妹妹的時候，你要追念你所行的，自覺慚愧；並且我要將他們賜你為女兒，卻不是按著前約。
english: Then at the memory of your ways you will be overcome with shame, when I take your sisters, the older and the younger, and give them to you for daughters, but not by your agreement.

chinese: 我要堅定與你所立的約（你就知道我是耶和華），
english: And I will make my agreement with you; and you will be certain that I am the Lord:

chinese: 好使你在我赦免你一切所行的時候，心裡追念，自覺抱愧，又因你的羞辱就不再開口。這是主耶和華說的。
english: So that, at the memory of these things, you may be at a loss, never opening your mouth because of your shame; when you have my forgiveness for all you have done, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要向以色列家出謎語，設比喻，
english: Son of man, give out a dark saying, and make a comparison for the children of Israel,

chinese: 說主耶和華如此說：有一大鷹，翅膀大，翎毛長，羽毛豐滿，彩色俱備，來到利巴嫩，將香柏樹梢擰去，
english: And say, This is what the Lord has said: A great eagle with great wings, full of long feathers of different colours, came to Lebanon, and took the top of the cedar:

chinese: 就是折去香柏樹儘尖的嫩枝，叼到貿易之地，放在買賣城中；
english: Biting off the highest of its young branches, he took it to the land of Canaan, and put it in a town of traders.

chinese: 又將以色列地的枝子栽於肥田裡，插在大水旁，如插柳樹，
english: And he took some of the seed of the land, planting it in fertile earth, placing it by great waters; he put it in like a willow-tree.

chinese: 就漸漸生長，成為蔓延矮小的葡萄樹。其枝轉向那鷹，其根在鷹以下，於是成了葡萄樹，生出枝子，發出小枝。
english: And its growth went on and it became a vine, low and widely stretching, whose branches were turned to him and its roots were under him: so it became a vine, putting out branches and young leaves.

chinese: 又有一大鷹，翅膀大，羽毛多。這葡萄樹從栽種的畦中向這鷹彎過根來，發出枝子，好得他的澆灌。
english: And there was another eagle with great wings and thick feathers: and now this vine, pushing out its roots to him, sent out its branches in his direction from the bed where it was planted, so that he might give it water.

chinese: 這樹栽於肥田多水的旁邊，好生枝子，結果子，成為佳美的葡萄樹。
english: He had it planted in a good field by great waters so that it might put out branches and have fruit and be a strong vine.

chinese: 你要說，主耶和華如此說：這葡萄樹豈能發旺呢？鷹豈不拔出他的根來，芟除他的果子，使他枯乾，使他發的嫩葉都枯乾了麼？也不用大力和多民，就拔出他的根來。
english: Say, This is what the Lord has said: Will it do well? will he not have its roots pulled up and its branches cut off, so that all its young leaves may become dry and it may be pulled up by its roots?

chinese: 葡萄樹雖然栽種，豈能發旺呢？一經東風，豈不全然枯乾麼？必在生長的畦中枯乾了。
english: And if it is planted will it do well? will it not become quite dry at the touch of the east wind, drying up in the bed where it was planted?

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 你對那悖逆之家說：你們不知道這些事是甚麼意思麼？你要告訴他們說，巴比倫王曾到耶路撒冷，將其中的君王和首領帶到巴比倫自己那裡去。
english: Say now to this uncontrolled people, Are these things not clear to you? Say to them, See, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and took its king and its rulers away with him to Babylon;

chinese: 從以色列的宗室中取一人與他立約，使他發誓，並將國中有勢力的人擄去，
english: And he took one of the sons of the king and made an agreement with him; and he put him under an oath, and took away the great men of the land:

chinese: 使國低微不能自強，惟因守盟約得以存立。
english: So that the kingdom might be made low with no power of lifting itself up, but might keep his agreement to be his servants.

chinese: 他卻背叛巴比倫王，打發使者往埃及去，要他們給他馬匹和多民。他豈能亨通呢？行這樣事的人豈能逃脫呢？他背約豈能逃脫呢？
english: But he went against his authority in sending representatives to Egypt to get from them horses and a great army. Will he do well? will he be safe who does such things? if the agreement is broken will he be safe?

chinese: 他輕看向王所起的誓，背棄王與他所立的約。主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，他定要死在立他作王、巴比倫王的京都。
english: By my life, says the Lord, truly in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he put on one side and let his agreement with him be broken, even in Babylon he will come to his death.

chinese: 敵人築壘造臺，與他打仗的時候，為要剪除多人，法老雖領大軍隊和大群眾，還是不能幫助他。
english: And Pharaoh with his strong army and great forces will be no help to him in the war, when they put up earthworks and make strong walls for the cutting off of lives:

chinese: 他輕看誓言，背棄盟約，已經投降，卻又做這一切的事，他必不能逃脫。
english: For he put his oath on one side in letting the agreement be broken; and though he had given his hand to it, he did all these things; he will not get away safe.

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：我指著我的永生起誓，他既輕看指我所起的誓，背棄指我所立的約，我必要使這罪歸在他頭上。
english: And so the Lord has said, By my life, truly, for my oath which he put on one side, and my agreement which has been broken, I will send punishment on his head.

chinese: 我必將我的網撒在他身上，他必在我的網羅中纏住。我必帶他到巴比倫，並要在那裡因他干犯我的罪刑罰他。
english: My net will be stretched out over him, and he will be taken in my cords, and I will send him to Babylon, and there I will be his judge for the wrong which he has done against me.

chinese: 他的一切軍隊，凡逃跑的，都必倒在刀下；所剩下的，也必分散四方（方：原文是風）。你們就知道說這話的是我─耶和華。
english: All his best fighting-men will be put to the sword, and the rest will be sent away to every wind: and you will be certain that I the Lord have said it.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：我要將香柏樹梢擰去栽上，就是從儘尖的嫩枝中折一嫩枝，栽於極高的山上；
english: This is what the Lord has said: Further, I will take the highest top of the cedar and put it in the earth; cutting off from the highest of his young branches a soft one, I will have it planted on a high and great mountain;

chinese: 在以色列高處的山栽上。他就生枝子，結果子，成為佳美的香柏樹，各類飛鳥都必宿在其下，就是宿在枝子的蔭下。
english: It will be planted on the high mountain of Israel: it will put out branches and have fruit and be a fair cedar: under it all birds of every sort will make their living-place, resting in the shade of its branches.

chinese: 田野的樹木都必知道我─耶和華使高樹矮小，矮樹高大；青樹枯乾，枯樹發旺。我─耶和華如此說，也如此行了。
english: And it will be clear to all the trees of the field that I the Lord have made low the high tree and made high the low tree, drying up the green tree and making the dry tree full of growth; I the Lord have said it and have done it.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,

chinese: 你們在以色列地怎麼用這俗語說父親吃了酸葡萄，兒子的牙酸倒了呢？
english: Why do you make use of this saying about the land of Israel, The fathers have been tasting bitter grapes and the children's teeth are on edge?

chinese: 主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，你們在以色列中，必不再有用這俗語的因由。
english: By my life, says the Lord, you will no longer have this saying in Israel.

chinese: 看哪，世人都是屬我的；為父的怎樣屬我，為子的也照樣屬我；犯罪的，他必死亡。
english: See, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so the soul of the son is mine: death will be the fate of the sinner's soul.

chinese: 人若是公義，且行正直與合理的事：
english: But if a man is upright, living rightly and doing righteousness,

chinese: 未曾在山上吃過祭偶像之物，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污鄰舍的妻，未曾在婦人的經期內親近他，
english: And has not taken flesh with the blood for food, or given worship to the images of the children of Israel; if he has not had connection with his neighbour's wife, or come near to a woman at the time when she is unclean;

chinese: 未曾虧負人，乃將欠債之人的當頭還給他；未曾搶奪人的物件，卻將食物給飢餓的人吃，將衣服給赤身的人穿；
english: And has done no wrong to any, but has given back to the debtor what is his, and has taken no one's goods by force, and has given food to him who was in need of it, and clothing to him who was without it;

chinese: 未曾向借錢的弟兄取利，也未曾向借糧的弟兄多要，縮手不作罪孽，在兩人之間，按至理判斷；
english: And has not given his money out at interest or taken great profits, and, turning his hand from evil-doing, has kept faith between man and man,

chinese: 遵行我的律例，謹守我的典章，按誠實行事─這人是公義的，必定存活。這是主耶和華說的。
english: And has been guided by my rules and has kept my laws and done them: he is upright, life will certainly be his, says the Lord.

chinese: 他若生一個兒子，作強盜，是流人血的，不行以上所說之善，反行其中之惡，乃在山上吃過祭偶像之物，並玷污鄰舍的妻，
english: If he has a son who is a thief, a taker of life, who does any of these things,
Who has taken flesh with the blood as food, and has had connection with his neighbour's wife,

chinese: 虧負困苦和窮乏的人，搶奪人的物，未曾將當頭還給人，仰望偶像，並行可憎的事，
english: Has done wrong to the poor and to him who is in need, and taken property by force, and has not given back to one in his debt what is his, and has given worship to images and has done disgusting things,

chinese: 向借錢的弟兄取利，向借糧的弟兄多要─這人豈能存活呢？他必不能存活。他行這一切可憎的事，必要死亡，他的罪（原文是血）必歸到他身上。
english: And has given out his money at interest and taken great profits: he will certainly not go on living: he has done all these disgusting things: death will certainly be his fate; his blood will be on him.

chinese: 他若生一個兒子，見父親所犯的一切罪便懼怕（有古卷：思量），不照樣去做；
english: Now if he has a son who sees all his father's sins which he has done, and in fear does not do the same:

chinese: 未曾在山上吃過祭偶像之物，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污鄰舍的妻，
english: Who has not taken the flesh with the blood for food, or given worship to the images of the children of Israel, and has not had connection with his neighbour's wife,

chinese: 未曾虧負人，未曾取人的當頭，未曾搶奪人的物件，卻將食物給飢餓的人吃，將衣服給赤身的人穿，
english: Or done wrong to any, or taken anything from one in his debt, or taken goods by force, but has given food to him who was in need of it, and clothing to him who was without it;

chinese: 縮手不害貧窮人，未曾向借錢的弟兄取利，也未曾向借糧的弟兄多要；他順從我的典章，遵行我的律例，就不因父親的罪孽死亡，定要存活。
english: Who has kept his hand from evil-doing and has not taken interest or great profits, who has done my orders and been guided by my rules: he will certainly not be put to death for the evil-doing of his father; life will certainly be his.

chinese: 至於他父親；因為欺人太甚，搶奪弟兄，在本國的民中行不善，他必因自己的罪孽死亡。
english: As for his father, because he was cruel, took goods by force, and did what is not good among his people, truly, death will overtake him in his evil-doing.

chinese: 你們還說：兒子為何不擔當父親的罪孽呢？兒子行正直與合理的事，謹守遵行我的一切律例，他必定存活。
english: But you say, Why does not the son undergo punishment for the evil-doing of the father? When the son has done what is ordered and right, and has kept my rules and done them, life will certainly be his.

chinese: 惟有犯罪的，他必死亡。兒子必不擔當父親的罪孽，父親也不擔當兒子的罪孽。義人的善果必歸自己，惡人的惡報也必歸自己。
english: The soul which does sin will be put to death: the son will not be made responsible for the evil-doing of the father, or the father for the evil-doing of the son; the righteousness of the upright will be on himself, and the evil-doing of the evil-doer on himself.

chinese: 惡人若回頭離開所做的一切罪惡，謹守我一切的律例，行正直與合理的事，他必定存活，不致死亡。
english: But if the evil-doer, turning away from all the sins which he has done, keeps my rules and does what is ordered and right, life will certainly be his; death will not be his fate.

chinese: 他所犯的一切罪過都不被記念，因所行的義，他必存活。
english: Not one of the sins which he has done will be kept in memory against him: in the righteousness which he has done he will have life.

chinese: 主耶和華說：惡人死亡，豈是我喜悅的麼？不是喜悅他回頭離開所行的道存活麼？
english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the evil-doer? says the Lord: am I not pleased if he is turned from his way so that he may have life?

chinese: 義人若轉離義行而作罪孽，照著惡人所行一切可憎的事而行，他豈能存活麼？他所行的一切義都不被記念；他必因所犯的罪、所行的惡死亡。
english: But when the upright man, turning away from his righteousness, does evil, like all the disgusting things which the evil man does, will he have life? Not one of his upright acts will be kept in memory: in the wrong which he has done and in his sin death will overtake him.

chinese: 你們還說：主的道不公平！以色列家啊，你們當聽，我的道豈不公平麼？你們的道豈不是不公平麼？
english: But you say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Give ear, now, O children of Israel; is my way not equal? are not your ways unequal?

chinese: 義人若轉離義行而作罪孽死亡，他是因所作的罪孽死亡。
english: When the upright man, turning away from his righteousness, does evil, death will overtake him; in the evil which he has done death will overtake him.

chinese: 再者，惡人若回頭離開所行的惡，行正直與合理的事，他必將性命救活了。
english: Again, when the evil-doer, turning away from the evil he has done, does what is ordered and right, he will have life for his soul.

chinese: 因為他思量，回頭離開所犯的一切罪過，必定存活，不致死亡。
english: Because he had fear and was turned away from all the wrong which he had done, life will certainly be his, death will not be his fate.

chinese: 以色列家還說：主的道不公平！以色列家啊，我的道豈不公平麼？你們的道豈不是不公平麼？
english: But still the children of Israel say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O children of Israel, are my ways not equal? are not your ways unequal?

chinese: 所以主耶和華說：以色列家啊，我必按你們各人所行的審判你們。你們當回頭離開所犯的一切罪過。這樣，罪孽必不使你們敗亡。
english: For this cause I will be your judge, O children of Israel, judging every man by his ways, says the Lord. Come back and be turned from all your sins; so that they may not be the cause of your falling into evil.

chinese: 你們要將所犯的一切罪過盡行拋棄，自做一個新心和新靈。以色列家啊，你們何必死亡呢？
english: Put away all your evil-doing in which you have done sin; and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit: why are you desiring death, O children of Israel?

chinese: 主耶和華說：我不喜悅那死人之死，所以你們當回頭而存活。
english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him on whom death comes, says the Lord: be turned back then, and have life.

chinese: 你當為以色列的王作起哀歌，
english: Take up now a song of grief for the ruler of Israel, and say,

chinese: 說：你的母親是甚麼呢？是個母獅子，蹲伏在獅子中間，在少壯獅子中養育小獅子。
english: What was your mother? Like a she-lion among lions, stretched out among the young lions she gave food to her little ones.

chinese: 在他小獅子中養大一個，成了少壯獅子，學會抓食而吃人。
english: And one of her little ones came to growth under her care, and became a young lion, learning to go after beasts for his food; and he took men for his meat.

chinese: 列國聽見了就把他捉在他們的坑中，用鉤子拉到埃及地去。
english: And the nations had news of him; he was taken in the hole they had made: and, pulling him with hooks, they took him into the land of Egypt.

chinese: 母獅見自己等候失了指望，就從他小獅子中又將一個養為少壯獅子。
english: Now when she saw that her hope was made foolish and gone, she took another of her little ones and made him into a young lion.

chinese: 他在眾獅子中走來走去，成了少壯獅子，學會抓食而吃人。
english: And he went up and down among the lions and became a young lion, learning to go after beasts for his food; and he took men for his meat.

chinese: 他知道列國的宮殿，又使他們的城邑變為荒場；因他咆哮的聲音，遍地和其中所有的就都荒廢。
english: And he sent destruction on their widows and made waste their towns; and the land and everything in it became waste because of the loud sound of his voice.

chinese: 於是四圍邦國各省的人來攻擊他，將網撒在他身上，捉在他們的坑中。
english: Then the nations came against him from the kingdoms round about: their net was stretched over him and he was taken in the hole they had made.

chinese: 他們用鉤子鉤住他，將他放在籠中，帶到巴比倫王那裡，將他放入堅固之所，使他的聲音在以色列山上不再聽見。
english: They made him a prisoner with hooks, and took him to the king of Babylon; they put him in the strong place so that his voice might be sounding no longer on the mountains of Israel.

chinese: 你的母親先前如葡萄樹，極其茂盛（原文是在你血中），栽於水旁。因為水多，就多結果子，滿生枝子；
english: Your mother was in comparison like a vine, planted by the waters: she was fertile and full of branches because of the great waters.

chinese: 生出堅固的枝幹，可作掌權者的杖。這枝幹高舉在茂密的枝中，而且他生長高大，枝子繁多，遠遠可見。
english: And she had a strong rod for a rod of authority for the rulers, and it became tall among the clouds and it was seen lifted up among the number of its branches.

chinese: 但這葡萄樹因忿怒被拔出摔在地上；東風吹乾其上的果子，堅固的枝幹折斷枯乾，被火燒燬了；
english: But she was uprooted in burning wrath, and made low on the earth; the east wind came, drying her up, and her branches were broken off; her strong rod became dry, the fire made a meal of it.

chinese: 如今栽於曠野乾旱無水之地。
english: And now she is planted in the waste land, in a dry and unwatered country.

chinese: 火也從他枝幹中發出，燒滅果子，以致沒有堅固的枝幹可作掌權者的杖。這是哀歌，也必用以作哀歌。
english: And fire has gone out from her rod, causing the destruction of her branches, so that there is no strong rod in her to be the ruler's rod of authority. This is a song of grief, and it was for a song of grief.

chinese: 第七年五月初十日，有以色列的幾個長老來求問耶和華，坐在我面前。
english: Now it came about in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, that certain of the responsible men of Israel came to get directions from the Lord and were seated before me.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要告訴以色列的長老說，主耶和華如此說：你們來是求問我麼？主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，我必不被你們求問。
english: Son of man, say to the responsible men of Israel, This is what the Lord has said: Have you come to get directions from me? By my life, says the Lord, you will get no directions from me.

chinese: 人子啊，你要審問審問他們麼？你當使他們知道他們列祖那些可憎的事，
english: Will you be their judge, O son of man, will you be their judge? make clear to them the disgusting ways of their fathers,

chinese: 對他們說，主耶和華如此說：當日我揀選以色列，向雅各家的後裔起誓，在埃及地將自己向他們顯現，說：我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: And say to them, This is what the Lord has said: In the day when I took Israel for myself, when I made an oath to the seed of the family of Jacob, and I gave them knowledge of myself in the land of Egypt, saying to them with an oath, I am the Lord your God;

chinese: 那日我向他們起誓，必領他們出埃及地，到我為他們察看的流奶與蜜之地；那地在萬國中是有榮耀的。
english: In that day I gave my oath to take them out of the land of Egypt into a land which I had been searching out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands:

chinese: 我對他們說，你們各人要拋棄眼所喜愛那可憎之物，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己。我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: And I said to them, Let every man among you put away the disgusting things to which his eyes are turned, and do not make yourselves unclean with the images of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 他們卻悖逆我，不肯聽從我，不拋棄他們眼所喜愛那可憎之物，不離棄埃及的偶像。我就說，我要將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，在埃及地向他們成就我怒中所定的。
english: But they would not be controlled by me, and did not give ear to me; they did not put away the disgusting things to which their eyes were turned, or give up the images of Egypt: then I said I would let loose my passion on them to give full effect to my wrath against them in the land of Egypt.

chinese: 我卻為我名的緣故沒有這樣行，免得我名在他們所住的列國人眼前被褻瀆；我領他們出埃及地，在這列國人的眼前將自己向他們顯現。
english: And I was acting for the honour of my name, so that it might not be made unclean before the eyes of the nations among whom they were, and before whose eyes I gave them knowledge of myself, by taking them out of the land of Egypt.

chinese: 這樣，我就使他們出埃及地，領他們到曠野，
english: So I made them go out of the land of Egypt and took them into the waste land.

chinese: 將我的律例賜給他們，將我的典章指示他們；人若遵行就必因此活著。
english: And I gave them my rules and made clear to them my orders, which, if a man keeps them, will be life to him.

chinese: 又將我的安息日賜給他們，好在我與他們中間為證據，使他們知道我─耶和華是叫他們成為聖的。
english: And further, I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, so that it might be clear that I, who make them holy, am the Lord.

chinese: 以色列家卻在曠野悖逆我，不順從我的律例，厭棄我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活著），大大干犯我的安息日。我就說，要在曠野將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，滅絕他們。
english: But the children of Israel would not be controlled by me in the waste land: they were not guided by my rules, and they were turned away from my orders, which, if a man does them, will be life to him; and they had no respect for my Sabbaths: then I said that I would let loose my passion on them in the waste land, and put an end to them.

chinese: 我卻為我名的緣故，沒有這樣行，免得我的名在我領他們出埃及的列國人眼前被褻瀆。
english: And I was acting for the honour of my name, so that it might not be made unclean in the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had taken them out.

chinese: 並且我在曠野向他們起誓，必不領他們進入我所賜給他們流奶與蜜之地（那地在萬國中是有榮耀的）；
english: And further, I gave my oath to them in the waste land, that I would not take them into the land which I had given them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands;

chinese: 因為他們厭棄我的典章，不順從我的律例，干犯我的安息日，他們的心隨從自己的偶像。
english: Because they were turned away from my orders, and were not guided by my rules, and had no respect for my Sabbaths: for their hearts went after their images.

chinese: 雖然如此，我眼仍顧惜他們，不毀滅他們，不在曠野將他們滅絕淨盡。
english: But still my eye had pity on them and I kept them from destruction and did not put an end to them completely in the waste land.

chinese: 我在曠野對他們的兒女說：不要遵行你們父親的律例，不要謹守他們的惡規，也不要因他們的偶像玷污自己。
english: And I said to their children in the waste land, Do not be guided by the rules of your fathers or keep their orders or make yourselves unclean with their images:

chinese: 我是耶和華─你們的神，你們要順從我的律例，謹守遵行我的典章，
english: I am the Lord your God; be guided by my rules and keep my orders and do them:

chinese: 且以我的安息日為聖。這日在我與你們中間為證據，使你們知道我是耶和華─你們的神。
english: And keep my Sabbaths holy; and they will be a sign between me and you so that it may be clear to you that I am the Lord your God.

chinese: 只是他們的兒女悖逆我，不順從我的律例，也不謹守遵行我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活著），干犯我的安息日。我就說，要將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，在曠野向他們成就我怒中所定的。
english: But the children would not be controlled by me; they were not guided by my rules, and they did not keep and do my orders, which, if a man does them, will be life to him; and they had no respect for my Sabbaths: then I said I would let loose my passion on them to give full effect to my wrath against them in the waste land.

chinese: 雖然如此，我卻為我名的緣故縮手沒有這樣行，免得我的名在我領他們出埃及的列國人眼前被褻瀆。
english: And I was acting for the honour of my name, so that it might not be made unclean in the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had taken them out.

chinese: 並且我在曠野向他們起誓，必將他們分散在列國，四散在列邦；
english: Further, I gave my oath to them in the waste land that I would send them wandering among the nations, driving them out among the countries;

chinese: 因為他們不遵行我的典章，竟厭棄我的律例，干犯我的安息日，眼目仰望他們父親的偶像。
english: Because they had not done my orders, but had been turned away from my rules, and had not given respect to my Sabbaths, and their eyes were turned to the images of their fathers.

chinese: 我也任他們遵行不美的律例，謹守不能使人活著的惡規。
english: And further, I gave them rules which were not good and orders in which there was no life for them;

chinese: 因他們將一切頭生的經火，我就任憑他們在這供獻的事上玷污自己，好叫他們淒涼，使他們知道我是耶和華。
english: I made them unclean in the offerings they gave, causing them to make every first child go through the fire, so that I might put an end to them.

chinese: 人子啊，你要告訴以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：你們的列祖在得罪我的事上褻瀆我；
english: For this cause, son of man, say to the children of Israel, This is what the Lord has said: In this your fathers have further put shame on my name by doing wrong against me.

chinese: 因為我領他們到了我起誓應許賜給他們的地，他們看見各高山、各茂密樹，就在那裡獻祭，奉上惹我發怒的供物，也在那裡焚燒馨香的祭牲，並澆上奠祭。
english: For when I had taken them into the land which I made an oath to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every branching tree and made their offerings there, moving me to wrath by their offerings; and there the sweet smell of their offerings went up and their drink offerings were drained out.

chinese: 我就對他們說：你們所上的那高處叫甚麼呢？（那高處的名字叫巴麻直到今日。）
english: Then I said to them, What is this high place where you go to no purpose? And it is named Bamah to this day.

chinese: 所以你要對以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：你們仍照你們列祖所行的玷污自己麼？仍照他們可憎的事行邪淫麼？
english: For this cause say to the children of Israel, This is what the Lord has said: Are you making yourselves unclean as your fathers did? are you being untrue to me by going after their disgusting works?

chinese: 你們奉上供物使你們兒子經火的時候，仍將一切偶像玷污自己，直到今日麼？以色列家啊，我豈被你們求問麼？主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，我必不被你們求問。
english: And when you give your offerings, causing your sons to go through the fire, you make yourselves unclean with all your images to this day; and will you come to me for directions, O children of Israel? By my life, says the Lord, you will get no direction from me.

chinese: 你們說：我們要像外邦人和列國的宗族一樣，去事奉木頭與石頭。你們所起的這心意萬不能成就。
english: And that which comes into your minds will never take place; when you say, We will be like the nations, like the families of the countries, servants of wood and stone;

chinese: 主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，我總要作王，用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，並傾出來的忿怒，治理你們。
english: By my life, says the Lord, truly, with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with burning wrath let loose, I will be King over you:

chinese: 我必用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，並傾出來的忿怒，將你們從萬民中領出來，從分散的列國內聚集你們。
english: And I will take you out from the peoples and get you together out of the countries where you are wandering, with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with burning wrath let loose:

chinese: 我必帶你們到外邦人的曠野，在那裡當面刑罰你們。
english: And I will take you into the waste land of the peoples, and there I will take up the cause with you face to face.

chinese: 我怎樣在埃及地的曠野刑罰你們的列祖，也必照樣刑罰你們。這是主耶和華說的。
english: As I took up the cause with your fathers in the waste land of the land of Egypt, so will I take up the cause with you says the Lord.

chinese: 我必使你們從杖下經過，使你們被約拘束。
english: And I will make you go under the rod and will make you small in number:

chinese: 我必從你們中間除淨叛逆和得罪我的人，將他們從所寄居的地方領出來，他們卻不得入以色列地。你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: Clearing out from among you all those who are uncontrolled and who are sinning against me; I will take them out of the land where they are living, but they will not come into the land of Israel: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 以色列家啊，至於你們，主耶和華如此說：從此以後若不聽從我，就任憑你們去事奉偶像，只是不可再因你們的供物和偶像褻瀆我的聖名。
english: As for you, O children of Israel, the Lord has said: Let every man completely put away his images and give ear to me: and let my holy name no longer be shamed by your offerings and your images.

chinese: 主耶和華說：在我的聖山，就是以色列高處的山，所有以色列的全家都要事奉我。我要在那裡悅納你們，向你們要供物和初熟的土產，並一切的聖物。
english: For in my holy mountain, in the high mountain of Israel, says the Lord, there all the children of Israel, all of them, will be my servants in the land; there I will take pleasure in them, and there I will be worshipped with your offerings and the first-fruits of the things you give, and with all your holy things.

chinese: 我從萬民中領你們出來，從分散的列國內聚集你們，那時我必悅納你們好像馨香之祭，要在外邦人眼前在你們身上顯為聖。
english: I will take pleasure in you as in a sweet smell, when I take you out from the peoples and get you together from the countries where you have been sent in flight; and I will make myself holy in you before the eyes of the nations.

chinese: 我領你們進入以色列地，就是我起誓應許賜給你們列祖之地，那時你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord, when I take you into the land of Israel, into the country which I made an oath to give to your fathers.

chinese: 你們在那裡要追念玷污自己的行動作為，又要因所做的一切惡事厭惡自己。
english: And there, at the memory of your ways and of all the things you did to make yourselves unclean, you will have bitter hate for yourselves because of all the evil things you have done.

chinese: 主耶和華說：以色列家啊，我為我名的緣故，不照著你們的惡行和你們的壞事待你們；你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord, when I take you in hand for the honour of my name, and not for your evil ways or your unclean doings, O children of Israel, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要面向南方，向南滴下預言攻擊南方田野的樹林。
english: Son of man, let your face be turned to the south, let your words be dropped to the south, and be a prophet against the woodland of the South;

chinese: 對南方的樹林說，要聽耶和華的話。主耶和華如此說：我必使火在你中間著起，燒滅你中間的一切青樹和枯樹，猛烈的火燄必不熄滅。從南到北，人的臉面都被燒焦。
english: And say to the woodland of the South, Give ear to the words of the Lord: this is what the Lord has said: See, I will have a fire lighted in you, for the destruction of every green tree in you and every dry tree: the flaming flame will not be put out, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.

chinese: 凡有血氣的都必知道是我─耶和華使火著起，這火必不熄滅。
english: And all flesh will see that I the Lord have had it lighted: it will not be put out.

chinese: 於是我說：哎！主耶和華啊，人都指著我說：他豈不是說比喻的麼？
english: Then I said, Ah, Lord! they say of me, Is he not a maker of stories?

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要面向耶路撒冷和聖所滴下預言，攻擊以色列地。
english: Son of man, let your face be turned to Jerusalem, let your words be dropped in the direction of her holy place, and be a prophet against the land of Israel;

chinese: 對以色列地說，耶和華如此說：我與你為敵，並要拔刀出鞘，從你中間將義人和惡人一併剪除。
english: And say to the land of Israel, These are the words of the Lord: See, I am against you, and I will take my sword out of its cover, cutting off from you the upright and the evil.

chinese: 我既要從你中間剪除義人和惡人，所以我的刀要出鞘，自南至北攻擊一切有血氣的；
english: Because I am going to have the upright and the evil cut off from you, for this cause my sword will go out from its cover against all flesh from the south to the north:

chinese: 一切有血氣的就知道我─耶和華已經拔刀出鞘，必不再入鞘。
english: And all flesh will see that I the Lord have taken my sword out of its cover: and it will never go back.

chinese: 人子啊，你要歎息，在他們眼前彎著腰，苦苦地歎息。
english: Make sounds of grief, son of man; with body bent and a bitter heart make sounds of grief before their eyes.

chinese: 他們問你說：為何歎息呢﹖你就說：因為有風聲、災禍要來。人心都必消化，手都發軟，精神衰敗，膝弱如水。看哪，這災禍臨近，必然成就。這是主耶和華說的。
english: And when they say to you, Why are you making sounds of grief? then say, Because of the news, for it is coming: and every heart will become soft, and all hands will be feeble, and every spirit will be burning low, and all knees will be turned to water: see, it is coming and it will be done, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要預言。耶和華吩咐我如此說：有刀、有刀，是磨快擦亮的；
english: Son of man, say as a prophet, These are the words of the Lord: Say, A sword, a sword which has been made sharp and polished:

chinese: 磨快為要行殺戮，擦亮為要像閃電。我們豈可快樂麼﹖罰我子的杖藐視各樹。
english: It has been made sharp to give death; it is polished so that it may be like a thunder-flame: ...

chinese: 這刀已經交給人擦亮，為要應手使用。這刀已經磨快擦亮，好交在行殺戮的人手中。
english: And I have given it to the polisher so that it may be taken in the hand: he has made the sword sharp, he has had it polished, to put it into the hand of him who gives death.

chinese: 人子啊，你要呼喊哀號，因為這刀臨到我的百姓和以色列一切的首領。他們和我的百姓都交在刀下，所以你要拍腿歎息。
english: Give loud cries and make sounds of grief, O son of man: for it has come on my people, it has come on all the rulers of Israel: fear of the sword has come on my people: for this cause give signs of grief.

chinese: 有試驗的事；若那藐視的杖歸於無有，怎麼樣呢﹖這是主耶和華說的。
人子啊，你要拍掌預言。我─耶和華要使這刀，就是致死傷的刀，一連三次加倍刺人，進入他們的內屋，使大人受死傷的就是這刀。
english: So then, son of man, be a prophet, and put your hands together with a loud sound, and give two blows with the sword, and even three; it is the sword of those who are wounded, even the sword of the wounded; the great sword which goes round about them.

chinese: 我設立這恐嚇人的刀，攻擊他們的一切城門，使他們的心消化，加增他們跌倒的事。哎！這刀造得像閃電，磨得尖利，要行殺戮。
english: In order that hearts may become soft, and the number of those who are falling may be increased, I have sent death by the sword against all their doors: you are made like a flame, you are polished for death.

chinese: 刀啊，你歸在右邊，擺在左邊；你面向哪方，就向那方殺戮。
english: Be pointed to the right, to the left, wherever your edge is ordered.

chinese: 我也要拍掌，並要使我的忿怒止息。這是我─耶和華說的。
english: And I will put my hands together with a loud sound, and I will let my wrath have rest: I the Lord have said it.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me again, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要定出兩條路，好使巴比倫王的刀來。這兩條路必從一地分出來，又要在通城的路口上畫出一隻手來。
english: And you, son of man, have two ways marked out, so that the sword of the king of Babylon may come; let the two of them come out of one land: and let there be a pillar at the top of the road:

chinese: 你要定出一條路，使刀來到亞捫人的拉巴；又要定出一條路，使刀來到猶大的堅固城耶路撒冷。
english: Put a pillar at the top of the road for the sword to come to Rabbah in the land of the children of Ammon, and to Judah and to Jerusalem in the middle of her.

chinese: 因為巴比倫王站在岔路那裡，在兩條路口上要占卜。他搖籤（原文是箭）求問神像，察看犧牲的肝；
english: For the king of Babylon took his place at the parting of the ways, at the top of the two roads, to make use of secret arts: shaking the arrows this way and that, he put questions to the images of his gods, he took note of the inner parts of dead beasts.

chinese: 在右手中拿著為耶路撒冷占卜的籤，使他安設撞城錘，張口叫殺，揚聲吶喊，築壘造臺，以撞城錘，攻打城門。
english: At his right hand was the fate of Jerusalem, to give orders for destruction, to send up the war-cry, to put engines of war against the doors, lifting up earthworks, building walls.

chinese: 據那些曾起誓的猶大人看來，這是虛假的占卜；但巴比倫王要使他們想起罪孽，以致將他們捉住。
english: And this answer given by secret arts will seem false to those who have given their oaths and have let them be broken: but he will keep the memory of evil-doing so that they may be taken.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：因你們的過犯顯露，使你們的罪孽被記念，以致你們的罪惡在行為上都彰顯出來；又因你們被記念，就被捉住。
english: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have made your evil-doing come to mind by the uncovering of your wrongdoing, causing your sins to be seen in all your evil-doings; because you have come to mind, you will be taken in them.

chinese: 你這受死傷行惡的以色列王啊，罪孽的盡頭到了，受報的日子已到。
english: And you, O evil one, wounded to death, O ruler of Israel, whose day has come in the time of the last punishment;

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：當除掉冠，摘下冕，景況必不再像先前；要使卑者升為高，使高者降為卑。
english: This is what the Lord has said: Take away the holy head-dress, take off the crown: this will not be again: let that which is low be lifted up, and that which is high be made low.

chinese: 我要將這國傾覆，傾覆，而又傾覆；這國也必不再有，直等到那應得的人來到，我就賜給他。
english: I will let it be overturned, overturned, overturned: this will not be again till he comes whose right it is; and I will give it to him.

chinese: 人子啊，要發預言說：主耶和華論到亞捫人和他們的凌辱，吩咐我如此說：有刀，有拔出來的刀，已經擦亮，為行殺戮，使他像閃電以行吞滅。
english: And you, son of man, say as a prophet, This is what the Lord has said about the children of Ammon and about their shame: Say, A sword, even a sword let loose, polished for death, to make it shining so that it may be like a flame:

chinese: 人為你見虛假的異象，行謊詐的占卜，使你倒在受死傷之惡人的頸項上。他們罪孽到了盡頭，受報的日子已到。
english: Your vision is to no purpose, your use of secret arts gives a false answer, to put it on the necks of evil-doers who are wounded to death, whose day has come, in the time of the last punishment.

chinese: 你將刀收入鞘罷！在你受造之處、生長之地，我必刑罰你。
english: Go back into your cover. In the place where you were made, in the land from which you were taken, I will be your judge.

chinese: 我必將我的惱恨倒在你身上，將我烈怒的火噴在你身上；又將你交在善於殺滅的畜類人手中。
english: And I will let loose my burning passion on you, breathing out on you the fire of my wrath: and I will give you up into the hands of men like beasts, trained to destruction.

chinese: 你必當柴被火焚燒，你的血必流在國中，你必不再被記念，因為這是我─耶和華說的。
english: You will be food for the fire; your blood will be drained out in the land; there will be no more memory of you: for I the Lord have said it.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要審問審問這流人血的城麼﹖當使他知道他一切可憎的事。
english: And you, son of man, will you be a judge, will you be a judge of the town of blood? then make clear to her all her disgusting ways.

chinese: 你要說，主耶和華如此說：哎！這城有流人血的事在其中，叫他受報的日期來到，又做偶像玷污自己，陷害自己。
english: And you are to say, This is what the Lord has said: A town causing blood to be drained out in her streets so that her time may come, and making images in her to make her unclean!

chinese: 你因流了人的血，就為有罪；你做了偶像，就玷污自己，使你受報之日臨近，報應之年來到。所以我叫你受列國的凌辱和列邦的譏誚。
english: You are responsible for the blood drained out by you, and you are unclean through the images which you have made; and you have made your day come near, and the time of your judging has come; for this cause I have made you a name of shame to the nations and a cause of laughing to all countries.

chinese: 你這名臭、多亂的城啊，那些離你近、離你遠的都必譏誚你。
english: Those who are near and those who are far from you will make sport of you; your name is unclean, you are full of sounds of fear.

chinese: 看哪，以色列的首領各逞其能，在你中間流人之血。
english: See, the rulers of Israel, every one in his family, have been causing death in you.

chinese: 在你中間有輕慢父母的，有欺壓寄居的，有虧負孤兒寡婦的。
english: In you they have had no respect for father and mother; in you they have been cruel to the man from a strange land; in you they have done wrong to the child without a father and to the widow.

chinese: 你藐視了我的聖物，干犯了我的安息日。
english: You have made little of my holy things, and have made my Sabbaths unclean.

chinese: 在你中間有讒謗人、流人血的；有在山上吃過祭偶像之物的，有行淫亂的。
english: In you there are men who say evil of others, causing death; in you they have taken the flesh with the blood for food; in your streets they have put evil designs into effect.

chinese: 在你中間有露繼母下體羞辱父親的，有玷辱月經不潔淨之婦人的。
english: In you they have let the shame of their fathers be seen; in you they have done wrong to a woman at the time when she was unclean.

chinese: 這人與鄰舍的妻行可憎的事；那人貪淫玷污兒婦；還有玷辱同父之姊妹的。
english: And in you one man has done what was disgusting with his neighbour's wife; and another has made his daughter-in-law unclean; and another has done wrong to his sister, his father's daughter.

chinese: 在你中間有為流人血受賄賂的；有向借錢的弟兄取利，向借糧的弟兄多要的。且因貪得無饜，欺壓鄰舍奪取財物，竟忘了我。這是主耶和華說的。
english: In you they have taken rewards as the price of blood; you have taken interest and great profits, and you have taken away your neighbours' goods by force, and have not kept me in mind, says the Lord.

chinese: 看哪，我因你所得不義之財和你中間所流的血，就拍掌歎息。
english: See, then, I have made my hands come together in wrath against your taking of goods by force and against the blood which has been flowing in you.

chinese: 到了我懲罰你的日子，你的心還能忍受麼﹖你的手還能有力麼﹖我─耶和華說了這話，就必照著行。
english: Will your heart be high or your hands strong in the days when I take you in hand? I the Lord have said it and will do it.

chinese: 我必將你分散在列國，四散在列邦。我也必從你中間除掉你的污穢。
english: And I will send you in flight among the nations and wandering among the countries; and I will completely take away out of you everything which is unclean.

chinese: 你必在列國人的眼前因自己所行的被褻瀆，你就知道我是耶和華。
english: And you will be made low before the eyes of the nations; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，以色列家在我看為渣滓。他們都是爐中的銅、錫、鐵、鉛，都是銀渣滓。
english: Son of man, the children of Israel have become like the poorest sort of waste metal to me: they are all silver and brass and tin and iron and lead mixed with waste.

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：因你們都成為渣滓，我必聚集你們在耶路撒冷中。
english: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have all become waste metal, see, I will get you together inside Jerusalem.

chinese: 人怎樣將銀、銅、鐵、鉛、錫聚在爐中，吹火鎔化；照樣，我也要發怒氣和忿怒，將你們聚集放在城中，鎔化你們。
english: As they put silver and brass and iron and lead and tin together inside the oven, heating up the fire on it to make it soft; so will I get you together in my wrath and in my passion, and, heating the fire with my breath, will make you soft.

chinese: 我必聚集你們，把我烈怒的火吹在你們身上，你們就在其中鎔化。
english: Yes, I will take you, breathing on you the fire of my wrath, and you will become soft in it.

chinese: 銀子怎樣鎔化在爐中，你們也必照樣鎔化在城中，你們就知道我─耶和華是將忿怒倒在你們身上了。
english: As silver becomes soft in the oven, so you will become soft in it; and you will be certain that I the Lord have let loose my passion on you.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要對這地說：你是未得潔淨之地，在惱恨的日子也沒有雨下在你以上。
english: Son of man, say to her, You are a land on which no rain or thunderstorm has come in the day of wrath.

chinese: 其中的先知同謀背叛，如咆哮的獅子抓撕掠物。他們吞滅人民，搶奪財寶，使這地多有寡婦。
english: Her rulers in her are like a loud-voiced lion violently taking his food; they have made a meal of souls; they have taken wealth and valued property; they have made great the number of widows in her.

chinese: 其中的祭司強解我的律法，褻瀆我的聖物，不分別聖的和俗的，也不使人分辨潔淨的和不潔淨的，又遮眼不顧我的安息日；我也在他們中間被褻慢。
english: Her priests have been acting violently against my law; they have made my holy things unclean: they have made no division between what is holy and what is common, and they have not made it clear that the unclean is different from the clean, and their eyes have been shut to my Sabbaths, and I am not honoured among them.

chinese: 其中的首領彷彿豺狼抓撕掠物，殺人流血，傷害人命，要得不義之財。
english: Her rulers in her are like wolves violently taking their food; putting men to death and causing the destruction of souls, so that they may get their profit.

chinese: 其中的先知為百姓用未泡透的灰抹牆，就是為他們見虛假的異象，用謊詐的占卜，說：主耶和華如此說，其實耶和華沒有說。
english: And her prophets have been using whitewash, seeing foolish visions and making false use of secret arts, saying, This is what the Lord has said, when the Lord has said nothing.

chinese: 國內眾民一味地欺壓，慣行搶奪，虧負困苦窮乏的，背理欺壓寄居的。
english: The people of the land have been acting cruelly, taking men's goods by force; they have been hard on the poor and those in need, and have done wrong to the man from a strange land.

chinese: 我在他們中間尋找一人重修牆垣，在我面前為這國站在破口防堵，使我不滅絕這國，卻找不著一個。
english: And I was looking for a man among them who would make up the wall and take his station in the broken place before me for the land, so that I might not send destruction on it: but there was no one.

chinese: 所以我將惱恨倒在他們身上，用烈怒的火滅了他們，照他們所行的報應在他們頭上。這是主耶和華說的。
english: And I let loose my passion on them, and have put an end to them in the fire of my wrath: I have made the punishment of their ways come on their heads, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，有兩個女子，是一母所生，
english: Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother:

chinese: 他們在埃及行邪淫，在幼年時行邪淫。他們在那裡作處女的時候，有人擁抱他們的懷，撫摸他們的乳。
english: They were acting like loose women in Egypt; when they were young their behaviour was loose: there their breasts were crushed, even the points of their young breasts were crushed.

chinese: 他們的名字，姊姊名叫阿荷拉，妹妹名叫阿荷利巴。他們都歸於我，生了兒女。論到他們的名字，阿荷拉就是撒瑪利亞，阿荷利巴就是耶路撒冷。
english: Their names were Oholah, the older, and Oholibah, her sister: and they became mine, and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem, Oholibah.

chinese: 阿荷拉歸我之後行邪淫，貪戀所愛的人，就是他的鄰邦亞述人。
english: And Oholah was untrue to me when she was mine; she was full of desire for her lovers, even for the Assyrians, her neighbours,

chinese: 這些人都穿藍衣，作省長、副省長，都騎著馬，是可愛的少年人。
english: Who were clothed in blue, captains and rulers, all of them young men to be desired, horsemen seated on horses.

chinese: 阿荷拉就與亞述人中最美的男子放縱淫行，他因所戀愛之人的一切偶像，玷污自己。
english: And she gave her unclean love to them, all of them the noblest men of Assyria: and she made herself unclean with the images of all who were desired by her.

chinese: 自從在埃及的時候，他就沒有離開淫亂，因為他年幼作處女的時候，埃及人與他行淫，撫摸他的乳，縱慾與他行淫。
english: And she has not given up her loose ways from the time when she was in Egypt; for when she was young they were her lovers, and by them her young breasts were crushed, and they let loose on her their unclean desire.

chinese: 因此，我將他交在他所愛的人手中，就是他所戀愛的亞述人手中。
english: For this cause I gave her up into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the Assyrians on whom her desire was fixed.

chinese: 他們就露了他的下體，擄掠他的兒女，用刀殺了他，使他在婦女中留下臭名，因他們向他施行審判。
english: By these her shame was uncovered: they took her sons and daughters and put her to death with the sword: and she became a cause of wonder to women; for they gave her the punishment which was right.

chinese: 他妹妹阿荷利巴雖然看見了，卻還貪戀，比他姊姊更醜；行淫亂比他姊姊更多。
english: And her sister Oholibah saw this, but her desire was even more unmeasured, and her loose behaviour was worse than that of her sister.

chinese: 他貪戀鄰邦的亞述人，就是穿極華美的衣服，騎著馬的省長、副省長，都是可愛的少年人。
english: She was full of desire for the Assyrians, captains and rulers, her neighbours, clothed in blue, horsemen going on horses, all of them young men to be desired.

chinese: 我看見他被玷污了，他姊妹二人同行一路。
english: And I saw that she had become unclean; the two of them went the same way.

chinese: 阿荷利巴又加增淫行，因他看見人像畫在牆上，就是用丹色所畫迦勒底人的像，
english: And her loose behaviour became worse; for she saw men pictured on a wall, pictures of the Chaldaeans painted in bright red,

chinese: 腰間繫著帶子，頭上有下垂的裹頭巾，都是軍長的形狀，仿照巴比倫人的形像；他們的故土就是迦勒底。
english: With bands round their bodies and with head-dresses hanging round their heads, all of them looking like rulers, like the Babylonians, the land of whose birth is Chaldaea.

chinese: 阿荷利巴一看見就貪戀他們，打發使者往迦勒底去見他們。
english: And when she saw them she was full of desire for them, and sent servants to them in Chaldaea.

chinese: 巴比倫人就來登他愛情的床，與他行淫玷污他。他被玷污，隨後心裡與他們生疏。
english: And the Babylonians came to her, into the bed of love, and made her unclean with their loose desire, and she became unclean with them, and her soul was turned from them.

chinese: 這樣，他顯露淫行，又顯露下體；我心就與他生疏，像先前與他姊姊生疏一樣。
english: So her loose behaviour was clearly seen and her shame uncovered: then my soul was turned from her as it had been turned from her sister.

chinese: 他還加增他的淫行，追念他幼年在埃及地行邪淫的日子，
english: But still she went on the more with her loose behaviour, keeping in mind the early days when she had been a loose woman in the land of Egypt.

chinese: 貪戀情人身壯精足，如驢如馬。
english: And she was full of desire for her lovers, whose flesh is like the flesh of asses and whose seed is like the seed of horses.

chinese: 這樣，你就想起你幼年的淫行。那時，埃及人擁抱你的懷，撫摸你的乳。
english: And she made the memory of the loose ways of her early years come back to mind, when her young breasts were crushed by the Egyptians.

chinese: 阿荷利巴啊，主耶和華如此說：我必激動你先愛而後生疏的人來攻擊你。我必使他們來，在你四圍攻擊你。
english: For this cause, O Oholibah, this is what the Lord has said: See, I will make your lovers come up against you, even those from whom your soul is turned away in disgust; and I will make them come up against you on every side;

chinese: 所來的就是巴比倫人、迦勒底的眾人、比割人、書亞人、哥亞人，同著他們的還有亞述眾人，乃是作省長、副省長、作軍長有名聲的，都騎著馬，是可愛的少年人。
english: The Babylonians and all the Chaldaeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: young men to be desired, captains and rulers all of them, and chiefs, her neighbours, all of them on horseback.

chinese: 他們必帶兵器、戰車、輜重車，率領大眾來攻擊你。他們要拿大小盾牌，頂盔擺陣，在你四圍攻擊你。我要將審判的事交給他們，他們必按著自己的條例審判你。
english: And they will come against you from the north on horseback, with war-carriages and a great band of peoples; they will put themselves in order against you with breastplate and body-cover and metal head-dress round about you: and I will make them your judges, and they will give their decision against you as seems right to them.

chinese: 我必以忌恨攻擊你；他們必以忿怒辦你。他們必割去你的鼻子和耳朵；你遺留（或譯：餘剩；下同）的人必倒在刀下。他們必擄去你的兒女；你所遺留的必被火焚燒。
english: And my bitter feeling will be working against you, and they will take you in hand with passion; they will take away your nose and your ears, and the rest of you will be put to the sword: they will take your sons and daughters, and the rest of you will be burned up in the fire.

chinese: 他們必剝去你的衣服，奪取你華美的寶器。
english: And they will take all your clothing off you and take away your ornaments.

chinese: 這樣，我必使你的淫行和你從埃及地染來的淫亂止息了，使你不再仰望亞述，也不再追念埃及。
english: So I will put an end to your evil ways and your loose behaviour which came from the land of Egypt: and your eyes will never be lifted up to them again, and you will have no more memory of Egypt.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：我必將你交在你所恨惡的人手中，就是你心與他生疏的人手中。
english: For this is what the Lord has said: See, I will give you up into the hands of those who are hated by you, into the hands of those from whom your soul is turned away in disgust:

chinese: 他們必以恨惡辦你，奪取你一切勞碌得來的，留下你赤身露體。你淫亂的下體，連你的淫行，帶你的淫亂，都被顯露。
english: And they will take you in hand with hate, and take away all the fruit of your work, and let you be unveiled and without clothing: and the shame of your loose behaviour will be uncovered, your evil designs and your loose ways.

chinese: 人必向你行這些事；因為你隨從外邦人行邪淫，被他們的偶像玷污了。
english: They will do these things to you because you have been untrue to me, and have gone after the nations, and have become unclean with their images.

chinese: 你走了你姊姊所走的路，所以我必將他的杯交在你手中。
english: You have gone in the way of your sister; and I will give her cup into your hand.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：你必喝你姊姊所喝的杯；那杯又深又廣，盛得甚多，使你被人嗤笑譏刺。
english: This is what the Lord has said: You will take a drink from your sister's cup, which is deep and wide: you will be laughed at and looked down on, more than you are able to undergo.

chinese: 你必酩酊大醉，滿有愁苦，喝乾你姊姊撒瑪利亞的杯，就是令人驚駭淒涼的杯。
english: You will be broken and full of sorrow, with the cup of wonder and destruction, with the cup of your sister Samaria.

chinese: 你必喝這杯，以致喝盡。杯破又齦杯片，撕裂自己的乳；因為這事我曾說過。這是主耶和華說的。
english: And after drinking it and draining it out, you will take the last drops of it to the end, pulling off your breasts: for I have said it, says the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：因你忘記我，將我丟在背後，所以你要擔當你淫行和淫亂的報應。
english: So this is what the Lord has said: Because you have not kept me in your memory, and because your back has been turned to me, you will even undergo the punishment of your evil designs and your loose ways.

chinese: 耶和華又對我說：人子啊，你要審問阿荷拉與阿荷利巴麼﹖當指出他們所行可憎的事。
english: Then the Lord said to me: Son of man, will you be the judge of Oholibah? then make clear to her the disgusting things she has done.

chinese: 他們行淫，手中有殺人的血，又與偶像行淫，並使他們為我所生的兒女經火燒給偶像。
english: For she has been false to me, and blood is on her hands, and with her images she has been untrue; and more than this, she made her sons, whom she had by me, go through the fire to them to be burned up.

chinese: 此外，他們還有向我所行的，就是同日玷污我的聖所，干犯我的安息日。
english: Further, this is what she has done to me: she has made my holy place unclean and has made my Sabbaths unclean.

chinese: 他們殺了兒女獻與偶像，當天又入我的聖所，將聖所褻瀆了。他們在我殿中所行的乃是如此。
english: For when she had made an offering of her children to her images, she came into my holy place to make it unclean; see, this is what she has done inside my house.

chinese: 況且你們二婦打發使者去請遠方人。使者到他們那裡，他們就來了。你們為他們沐浴己身，粉飾眼目，佩戴妝飾，
english: And she even sent for men to come from far away, to whom a servant was sent, and they came: for whom she was washing her body and painting her eyes and making herself fair with ornaments.

chinese: 坐在華美的床上，前面擺設桌案，將我的香料膏油擺在其上。
english: And she took her seat on a great bed, with a table put ready before it on which she put my perfume and my oil.

chinese: 在那裡有群眾安逸歡樂的聲音，並有粗俗的人和酒徒從曠野同來，把鐲子戴在二婦的手上，把華冠戴在他們的頭上。
english: ... and they put jewels on her hands and beautiful crowns on her head.

chinese: 我論這行淫衰老的婦人說：現在人還要與他行淫，他也要與人行淫。
english: Then I said ... now she will go on with her loose ways.

chinese: 人與阿荷拉，並阿荷利巴二淫婦茍合，好像與妓女苟合。
english: And they went in to her, as men go to a loose woman: so they went in to Oholibah, the loose woman.

chinese: 必有義人，照審判淫婦和流人血的婦人之例，審判他們；因為他們是淫婦，手中有殺人的血。
english: And upright men will be her judges, judging her as false wives and women who take lives are judged; because she has been untrue to me and blood is on her hands.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：我必使多人來攻擊他們，使他們拋來拋去，被人搶奪。
english: For this is what the Lord has said: I will make a great meeting of the people come together against her, and will send on her shaking fear and take everything from her.

chinese: 這些人必用石頭打死他們，用刀劍殺害他們，又殺戮他們的兒女，用火焚燒他們的房屋。
english: And the meeting, after stoning her with stones, will put an end to her with their swords; they will put her sons and daughters to death and have her house burned up with fire.

chinese: 這樣，我必使淫行從境內止息，好叫一切婦人都受警戒，不效法你們的淫行。
english: And I will put an end to evil in all the land, teaching all women not to do as you have done.

chinese: 人必照著你們的淫行報應你們；你們要擔當拜偶像的罪，就知道我是主耶和華。
english: And I will send on you the punishment of your evil ways, and you will be rewarded for your sins with your images: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 第九年十月初十日，耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，今日正是巴比倫王就近耶路撒冷的日子，你要將這日記下，
english: Son of man, put down in writing this very day: The king of Babylon let loose the weight of his attack against Jerusalem on this very day.

chinese: 要向這悖逆之家設比喻說，主耶和華如此說：將鍋放在火上，放好了，就倒水在其中；
english: And make a comparison for this uncontrolled people, and say to them, This is what the Lord has said: Put on the cooking-pot, put it on the fire and put water in it:

chinese: 將肉塊，就是一切肥美的肉塊、腿，和肩都聚在其中，拿美好的骨頭把鍋裝滿；
english: And get the bits together, the fat tail, every good part, the leg and the top part of it: make it full of the best bones.

chinese: 取羊群中最好的，將柴堆在鍋下，使鍋開滾，好把骨頭煮在其中。
english: Take the best of the flock, put much wood under it: see that its bits are boiling well; let the bones be cooked inside it.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：禍哉！這流人血的城，就是長鏽的鍋。其中的鏽未曾除掉，須要將肉塊從其中一一取出來，不必為他拈鬮。
english: For this is what the Lord has said: A curse is on the town of blood, the cooking-pot which is unclean inside, which has never been made clean! take out its bits; its fate is still to come on it.

chinese: 城中所流的血倒在淨光的磐石上，不倒在地上，用土掩蓋。
english: For her blood is in her; she has put it on the open rock not draining it on to the earth so that it might be covered with dust;

chinese: 這城中所流的血倒在淨光的磐石上，不得掩蓋，乃是出於我，為要發忿怒施行報應。
english: In order that it might make wrath come up to give punishment, she has put her blood on the open rock, so that it may not be covered.

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：禍哉！這流人血的城，我也必大堆火柴，
english: For this cause the Lord has said: A curse is on the town of blood! and I will make great the burning mass.

chinese: 添上木柴，使火著旺，將肉煮爛，把湯熬濃，使骨頭烤焦；
english: Put on much wood, heating up the fire, boiling the flesh well, and making the soup thick, and let the bones be burned.

chinese: 把鍋倒空坐在炭火上，使鍋燒熱，使銅燒紅，鎔化其中的污穢，除淨其上的鏽。
english: And I will put her on the coals so that she may be heated and her brass burned, so that what is unclean in her may become soft and her waste be completely taken away.

chinese: 這鍋勞碌疲乏，所長的大鏽仍未除掉；這鏽就是用火也不能除掉。
english: I have made myself tired to no purpose: still all the waste which is in her has not come out, it has an evil smell.

chinese: 在你污穢中有淫行，我潔淨你，你卻不潔淨。你的污穢再不能潔淨，直等我向你發的忿怒止息。
english: As for your unclean purpose: because I have been attempting to make you clean, but you have not been made clean from it, you will not be made clean till I have let loose my passion on you in full measure.

chinese: 我─耶和華說過的必定成就，必照話而行，必不返回，必不顧惜，也不後悔。人必照你的舉動行為審判你。這是主耶和華說的。
english: I the Lord have said the word and I will do it; I will not go back or have mercy, and my purpose will not be changed; in the measure of your ways and of your evil doings you will be judged, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，我要將你眼目所喜愛的忽然取去，你卻不可悲哀哭泣，也不可流淚，
english: Son of man, see, I am taking away the desire of your eyes by disease: but let there be no sorrow or weeping or drops running from your eyes.

chinese: 只可歎息，不可出聲，不可辦理喪事；頭上仍勒裹頭巾，腳上仍穿鞋，不可蒙著嘴唇，也不可吃弔喪的食物。
english: Let there be no sound of sorrow; make no weeping for your dead, put on your head-dress and your shoes on your feet, let not your lips be covered, and do not take the food of those in grief.

chinese: 於是我將這事早晨告訴百姓，晚上我的妻就死了。次日早晨我便遵命而行。
english: So in the morning I was teaching the people and in the evening death took my wife; and in the morning I did what I had been ordered to do.

chinese: 百姓問我說：你這樣行與我們有甚麼關係，你不告訴我們麼﹖
english: And the people said to me, Will you not make clear to us the sense of these things; is it for us you do them?

chinese: 我回答他們：耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: Then I said to them, The word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 你告訴以色列家，主耶和華如此說：我必使我的聖所，就是你們勢力所誇耀、眼裡所喜愛、心中所愛惜的被褻瀆，並且你們所遺留的兒女必倒在刀下。
english: Say to the people of Israel, The Lord has said, See, I will make my holy place unclean, the pride of your strength, the pleasure of your eyes, and the desire of your soul; and your sons and daughters, who did not come with you here, will be put to the sword.

chinese: 那時，你們必行我僕人所行的，不蒙著嘴唇，也不吃弔喪的食物。
english: And you will do as I have done, not covering your lips or taking the food of those in grief.

chinese: 你們仍要頭上勒裹頭巾，腳上穿鞋；不可悲哀哭泣。你們必因自己的罪孽相對歎息，漸漸消滅。
english: And your head-dresses will be on your heads and your shoes on your feet: there will be no sorrow or weeping; but you will be wasting away in the punishment of your evil-doing, and you will be looking at one another in wonder.

chinese: 以西結必這樣為你們作預兆；凡他所行的，你們也必照樣行。那事來到，你們就知道我是主耶和華。
english: And Ezekiel will be a sign to you; everything he has done you will do: when this takes place, you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 人子啊，我除掉他們所倚靠、所歡喜的榮耀，並眼中所喜愛、心裡所重看的兒女。
english: And as for you, son of man, your mouth will be shut in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that on which their hearts are fixed, and their sons and daughters.

chinese: 那日逃脫的人豈不來到你這裡，使你耳聞這事麼﹖
english: In that day, one who has got away safe will come to you to give you news of it.

chinese: 你必向逃脫的人開口說話，不再啞口。你必這樣為他們作預兆，他們就知道我是耶和華。
english: In that day your mouth will be open to him who has got away safe, and you will say words to him and your lips will no longer be shut: so you will be a sign to them and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，你要面向亞捫人說預言，攻擊他們，
english: Son of man, let your face be turned to the children of Ammon, and be a prophet against them:

chinese: 說：你們當聽主耶和華的話。主耶和華如此說：我的聖所被褻瀆，以色列地變荒涼，猶大家被擄掠；那時，你便因這些事說：阿哈！
english: And say to the children of Ammon, Give ear to the word of the Lord; this is what the Lord has said: Because you said, Aha! against my holy place when it was made unclean, and against the land of Israel when it was made waste, and against the people of Judah when they were taken away as prisoners;

chinese: 所以我必將你的地交給東方人為業；他們必在你的地上安營居住，吃你的果子，喝你的奶。
english: For this cause I will give you up to the children of the east for their heritage, and they will put their tent-circles in you and make their houses in you; they will take your fruit for their food and your milk for their drink.

chinese: 我必使拉巴為駱駝場，使亞捫人的地為羊群躺臥之處，你們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And I will make Rabbah a place for housing camels, and the children of Ammon a resting-place for flocks: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：因你拍手頓足，以滿心的恨惡向以色列地歡喜，
english: For the Lord has said, Because you have made sounds of joy with your hands, stamping your feet, and have been glad, putting shame with all your soul on the land of Israel;

chinese: 所以我伸手攻擊你，將你交給列國作為擄物。我必從萬民中剪除你，使你從萬國中敗亡。我必除滅你，你就知道我是耶和華。
english: For this cause my hand has been stretched out against you, and I will give up your goods to be taken by the nations; I will have you cut off from the peoples and will put an end to you among the countries: I will give you up to destruction; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：因摩押和西珥人說：看哪，猶大家與列國無異，
english: This is what the Lord has said: Because Moab and Seir are saying, See, the people of Judah are like all the nations;

chinese: 所以我要破開摩押邊界上的城邑，就是摩押人看為本國之榮耀的伯耶西末、巴力免、基列亭，
english: For this cause, I will let the side of Moab be uncovered, and his towns on every side, the glory of the land, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and as far as Kiriathaim.

chinese: 好使東方人來攻擊亞捫人。我必將亞捫人之地交給他們為業，使亞捫人在列國中不再被記念。
english: To the children of the east I have given her for a heritage, as well as the children of Ammon, so that there may be no memory of her among the nations:

chinese: 我必向摩押施行審判，他們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And I will be the judge of Moab; and they will see that I am the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：因為以東報仇雪恨，攻擊猶大家，向他們報仇，大大有罪，
english: This is what the Lord has said: Because Edom has taken his payment from the people of Judah, and has done great wrong in taking payment from them;

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必伸手攻擊以東，剪除人與牲畜，使以東從提幔起，人必倒在刀下，地要變為荒涼，直到底但。
english: The Lord has said, My hand will be stretched out against Edom, cutting off from it man and beast: and I will make it waste, from Teman even as far as Dedan they will be put to the sword.

chinese: 我必藉我民以色列的手報復以東；以色列民必照我的怒氣，按我的忿怒在以東施報，以東人就知道是我施報。這是主耶和華說的。
english: I will take payment from Edom because of my people Israel; and I will take Edom in hand in my wrath and in my passion: and they will have experience of my reward, says the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：因非利士人向猶大人報仇，就是以恨惡的心報仇雪恨，永懷仇恨，要毀滅他們，
english: This is what the Lord has said: Because the Philistines have taken payment, with the purpose of causing shame and destruction with unending hate;

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必伸手攻擊非利士人，剪除基利提人，滅絕沿海剩下的居民。
english: The Lord has said, See, my hand will be stretched out against the Philistines, cutting off the Cherethites and sending destruction on the rest of the sea-land.

chinese: 我向他們大施報應，發怒斥責他們。我報復他們的時候，他們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And I will take great payment from them with acts of wrath; and they will be certain that I am the Lord when I send my punishment on them.

chinese: 第十一年十一月初一日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: Now in the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，因推羅向耶路撒冷說：阿哈，那作眾民之門的已經破壞，向我開放；他既變為荒場，我必豐盛。
english: Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, Aha, she who was the doorway of the peoples is broken; she is turned over to them; she who was full is made waste;

chinese: 所以，主耶和華如此說：推羅啊，我必與你為敵，使許多國民上來攻擊你，如同海使波浪湧上來一樣。
english: For this cause the Lord has said, See, I am against you, O Tyre, and will send up a number of nations against you as the sea sends up its waves.

chinese: 他們必破壞推羅的牆垣，拆毀他的城樓。我也要刮淨塵土，使他成為淨光的磐石。
english: And they will give the walls of Tyre to destruction and have its towers broken: and I will take even her dust away from her, and make her an uncovered rock

chinese: 他必在海中作曬網的地方，也必成為列國的擄物。這是主耶和華說的。
english: She will be a place for the stretching out of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have said it, says the Lord: and her goods will be given over to the nations.

chinese: 屬推羅城邑的居民（原文是田間的眾女；八節同）必被刀劍殺滅，他們就知道我是耶和華。
english: And her daughters in the open country will be put to the sword: and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：我必使諸王之王的巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領馬匹車輛、馬兵、軍隊，和許多人民從北方來攻擊你推羅。
english: For this is what the Lord has said: See, I will send up from the north Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, king of kings, against Tyre, with horses and war-carriages and with an army and great numbers of people.

chinese: 他必用刀劍殺滅屬你城邑的居民，也必造臺築壘舉盾牌攻擊你。
english: He will put to the sword your daughters in the open country: he will make strong walls against you and put up an earthwork against you, arming himself for war against you.

chinese: 他必安設撞城錘攻破你的牆垣，用鐵器拆毀你的城樓。
english: He will put up his engines of war against your walls, and your towers will be broken down by his axes.

chinese: 因他的馬匹眾多，塵土揚起遮蔽你。他進入你的城門，好像人進入已有破口之城。那時，你的牆垣必因騎馬的和戰車、輜重車的響聲震動。
english: Because of the number of his horses you will be covered with their dust: your walls will be shaking at the noise of the horsemen and of the wheels and of the war-carriages, when he comes through your doorways, as into a town which has been broken open.

chinese: 他的馬蹄必踐踏你一切的街道，他必用刀殺戮你的居民；你堅固的柱子（或譯：柱像）必倒在地上。
english: Your streets will be stamped down by the feet of his horses: he will put your people to the sword, and will send down the pillars of your strength to the earth.

chinese: 人必以你的財寶為擄物，以你的貨財為掠物，破壞你的牆垣，拆毀你華美的房屋，將你的石頭、木頭、塵土都拋在水中。
english: They will take by force all your wealth and go off with the goods with which you do trade: they will have your walls broken down and all the houses of your desire given up to destruction: they will put your stones and your wood and your dust deep in the water.

chinese: 我必使你唱歌的聲音止息，人也不再聽見你彈琴的聲音。
english: I will put an end to the noise of your songs, and the sound of your instruments of music will be gone for ever.

chinese: 我必使你成為淨光的磐石，作曬網的地方；你不得再被建造，因為這是主耶和華說的。
english: I will make you an uncovered rock: you will be a place for the stretching out of nets; there will be no building you up again: for I the Lord have said it, says the Lord.

chinese: 主耶和華對推羅如此說：在你中間行殺戮，受傷之人唉哼的時候，因你傾倒的響聲，海島豈不都震動麼﹖
english: This is what the Lord has said to Tyre: Will not the sea-lands be shaking at the sound of your fall, when the wounded give cries of pain, when men are put to the sword in you?

chinese: 那時靠海的君王必都下位，除去朝服，脫下花衣，披上戰兢，坐在地上，時刻發抖，為你驚駭。
english: Then all the rulers of the sea will come down from their high seats, and put away their robes and take off their clothing of needlework: they will put on the clothing of grief, they will take their seats on the earth, shaking with fear every minute and overcome with wonder at you.

chinese: 他們必為你作起哀歌說：你這有名之城，素為航海之人居住，在海上為最堅固的；平日你和居民使一切住在那裡的人無不驚恐；現在何竟毀滅了﹖
english: And they will send up a song of grief for you, and say to you, What destruction has come on you, how are you cut off from the sea, the noted town, which was strong in the sea, she and her people, causing the fear of them to come on all the dry land!

chinese: 如今在你這傾覆的日子，海島都必戰兢；海中的群島見你歸於無有就都驚惶。
english: Now the sea-lands will be shaking in the day of your fall; and all the ships on the sea will be overcome with fear at your going.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：推羅啊，我使你變為荒涼，如無人居住的城邑；又使深水漫過你，大水淹沒你。
english: For this is what the Lord has said: I will make you a waste town, like the towns which are unpeopled; when I make the deep come upon you, covering you with great waters.

chinese: 那時，我要叫你下入陰府，與古時的人一同在地的深處、久已荒涼之地居住，使你不再有居民。我也要在活人之地顯榮耀（我也……榮耀：或譯在活人之地不再有榮耀）。
english: Then I will make you go down with those who go down into the underworld, to the people of the past, causing your living-place to be in the deepest parts of the earth, in places long unpeopled, with those who go down into the deep, so that there will be no one living in you; and you will have no glory in the land of the living.

chinese: 我必叫你令人驚恐，不再存留於世；人雖尋找你，卻永尋不見。這是主耶和華說的。
english: I will make you a thing of fear, and you will come to an end: even if you are looked for, you will not be seen again for ever, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,

chinese: 人子啊，要為推羅作起哀歌，
english: And you, son of man, make a song of grief for Tyre;

chinese: 說：你居住海口，是眾民的商埠；你的交易通到許多的海島。主耶和華如此說：推羅啊，你曾說：我是全然美麗的。
english: And say to Tyre, O you who are seated at the doorway of the sea, trading for the peoples with the great sea-lands, these are the words of the Lord: You, O Tyre, have said, I am a ship completely beautiful.

chinese: 你的境界在海中，造你的使你全然美麗。
english: Your builders have made your outlines in the heart of the seas, they have made you completely beautiful.

chinese: 他們用示尼珥的松樹做你的一切板，用利巴嫩的香柏樹做桅杆，
english: They have made all your boards of fir-trees from Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make the supports for your sails.

chinese: 用巴珊的橡樹做你的槳，用象牙鑲嵌基提海島的黃楊木為坐板（或譯：艙板）。
english: Of oak-trees from Bashan they have made your driving blades; they have made your floors of ivory and boxwood from the sea-lands of Kittim.

chinese: 你的篷帆是用埃及繡花細麻布做的，可以做你的大旗；你的涼棚是用以利沙島的藍色、紫色布做的。
english: The best linen with needlework from Egypt was your sail, stretched out to be a flag for you; blue and purple from the sea-lands of Elishah gave you shade.

chinese: 西頓和亞發的居民作你盪槳的。推羅啊，你中間的智慧人作掌舵的。
english: The people of Zidon and Arvad were your boatmen; the wise men of Zemer were in you; they were guiding your ships;

chinese: 迦巴勒的老者和聰明人都在你中間作補縫的；一切泛海的船隻和水手都在你中間經營交易的事。
english: The responsible men of Gebal and its wise men were in you, making your boards watertight: all the ships of the sea with their seamen were in you trading in your goods.

chinese: 波斯人、路德人、弗人在你軍營中作戰士；他們在你中間懸掛盾牌和頭盔，彰顯你的尊榮。
english: Cush and Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war, hanging up their body-covers and head-dresses of war in you: they gave you your glory.

chinese: 亞發人和你的軍隊都在你四圍的牆上，你的望樓也有勇士；他們懸掛盾牌，成全你的美麗。
english: The men of Arvad in your army were on your walls, and were watchmen in your towers, hanging up their arms on your walls round about; they made you completely beautiful.

chinese: 他施人因你多有各類的財物，就作你的客商，拿銀、鐵、錫、鉛兌換你的貨物。
english: Tarshish did business with you because of the great amount of your wealth; they gave silver, iron, tin, and lead for your goods.

chinese: 雅完人、土巴人、米設人都與你交易；他們用人口和銅器兌換你的貨物。
english: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders; they gave living men and brass vessels for your goods.

chinese: 陀迦瑪族用馬和戰馬並騾子兌換你的貨物。
english: The people of Togarmah gave horses and war-horses and transport beasts for your goods.

chinese: 底但人與你交易，許多海島作你的碼頭；他們拿象牙、烏木與你兌換（或譯：進貢）。
english: The men of Rodan were your traders: a great number of sea-lands did business with you: they gave you horns of ivory and ebony as an offering.

chinese: 亞蘭人因你的工作很多，就作你的客商；他們用綠寶石、紫色布繡貨、細麻布、珊瑚、紅寶石兌換你的貨物。
english: Edom did business with you because of the great number of things which you made; they gave emeralds, purple, and needlework, and the best linen and coral and rubies for your goods.

chinese: 猶大和以色列地的人都與你交易；他們用米匿的麥子、餅、蜜、油、乳香兌換你的貨物。
english: Judah and the land of Israel were your traders; they gave grain of Minnith and sweet cakes and honey and oil and perfume for your goods.

chinese: 大馬色人因你的工作很多，又因你多有各類的財物，就拿黑本酒和白羊毛與你交易。
english: Damascus did business with you because of the great amount of your wealth, with wine of Helbon and white wool.

chinese: 威但人和雅完人拿紡成的線、亮鐵、桂皮、菖蒲兌換你的貨物。
english: ... for your goods: they gave polished iron and spices for your goods.

chinese: 底但人用高貴的毯子、鞍、屜與你交易。
english: Dedan did trade with you in cloths for the backs of horses.

chinese: 亞拉伯人和基達的一切首領都作你的客商，用羊羔、公綿羊、公山羊與你交易。
english: Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar did business with you; in lambs and sheep and goats, in these they did business with you.

chinese: 示巴和拉瑪的商人與你交易，他們用各類上好的香料、各類的寶石，和黃金兌換你的貨物。
english: The traders of Sheba and Raamah did trade with you; they gave the best of all sorts of spices and all sorts of stones of great price and gold for your goods.

chinese: 哈蘭人、干尼人、伊甸人、示巴的商人，和亞述人、基抹人與你交易。
english: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traders of Asshur and all the Medes:

chinese: 這些商人以美好的貨物包在繡花藍色包袱內，又有華麗的衣服裝在香柏木的箱子裡，用繩捆著與你交易。
english: These were your traders in beautiful robes, in rolls of blue and needlework, and in chests of coloured cloth, corded with cords and made of cedar-wood, in them they did trade with you.

chinese: 他施的船隻接連成幫為你運貨，你便在海中豐富極其榮華。
english: Tarshish ships did business for you in your goods: and you were made full, and great was your glory in the heart of the seas.

chinese: 盪槳的已經把你盪到大水之處，東風在海中將你打破。
english: Your boatmen have taken you into great waters: you have been broken by the east wind in the heart of the seas.

chinese: 你的資財、物件、貨物、水手、掌舵的、補縫的、經營交易的，並你中間的戰士和人民，在你破壞的日子必都沉在海中。
english: Your wealth and your goods, the things in which you do trade, your seamen and those guiding your ships, those who make your boards watertight, and those who do business with your goods, and all your men of war who are in you, with all who have come together in you, will go down into the heart of the seas in the day of your downfall.

chinese: 你掌舵的呼號之聲一發，郊野都必震動。
english: At the sound of the cry of your ships' guides, the boards of the ship will be shaking.

chinese: 凡盪槳的和水手，並一切泛海掌舵的，都必下船登岸。
english: And all the boatmen, the seamen and those who are expert at guiding a ship through the sea, will come down from their ships and take their places on the land;

chinese: 他們必為你放聲痛哭，把塵土撒在頭上，在灰中打滾；
english: And their voices will be sounding over you, and crying bitterly they will put dust on their heads, rolling themselves in the dust:

chinese: 又為你使頭上光禿，用麻布束腰，號咷痛哭，苦苦悲哀。
english: And they will have the hair of their heads cut off because of you, and will put haircloth on their bodies, weeping for you with bitter grief in their souls, even with bitter sorrow.

chinese: 他們哀號的時候，為你作起哀歌哀哭，說：有何城如推羅﹖有何城如他在海中成為寂寞的呢﹖
english: And in their weeping they will make a song of grief for you, sorrowing over you and saying, Who is like Tyre, who has come to an end in the deep sea?

chinese: 你由海上運出貨物，就使許多國民充足；你以許多資財、貨物使地上的君王豐富。
english: When your goods went out over the seas, you made numbers of peoples full; the wealth of the kings of the earth was increased with your great wealth and all your goods.

chinese: 你在深水中被海浪打破的時候，你的貨物和你中間的一切人民，就都沉下去了。
