english: The days of punishment, the days of reward are come; Israel will be put to shame; the prophet is foolish, the man who has the spirit is off his head, because of your great sin.

chinese: 以法蓮曾作我神守望的；至於先知，在他一切的道上作為捕鳥人的網羅，在他神的家中懷怨恨。
english: There is great hate against the watchman of Ephraim, the people of my God; as for the prophet, there is a net in all his ways, and hate in the house of his God.

chinese: 以法蓮深深地敗壞，如在基比亞的日子一樣。耶和華必記念他們的罪孽，追討他們的罪惡。
english: They have gone deep in evil as in the days of Gibeah; he will keep in mind their wrongdoing, he will give them punishment for their sins.

chinese: 主說：我遇見以色列如葡萄在曠野；我看見你們的列祖如無花果樹上春季初熟的果子。他們卻來到巴力毗珥專拜那可羞恥的，就成為可憎惡的，與他們所愛的一樣。
english: I made discovery of Israel as of grapes in the waste land; I saw your fathers as the first-fruits of the fig-tree in her early fruit time; but they came to Baal-peor, and made themselves holy to the thing of shame, and became disgusting like that to which they gave their love.

chinese: 至於以法蓮人，他們的榮耀必如鳥飛去，必不生產，不懷胎，不成孕。
english: As for Ephraim, their glory will go in flight like a bird: there will be no birth and no one with child and no giving of life.

chinese: 縱然養大兒女，我卻必使他們喪子，甚至不留一個。我離棄他們，他們就有禍了。
english: Even though their children have come to growth I will take them away, so that not a man will be there; for their evil-doing will be complete and they will be put to shame because of it.

chinese: 我看以法蓮如推羅栽於美地。以法蓮卻要將自己的兒女帶出來，交與行殺戮的人。
english: As I have seen a beast whose young have been taken from her, so Ephraim will give birth to children only for them to be put to death.

chinese: 耶和華啊，求你加給他們─加甚麼呢？要使他們胎墜乳乾。
english: O Lord, what will you give them? Give them bodies which may not give birth and breasts without milk.

chinese: 耶和華說：他們一切的惡事都在吉甲；我在那裡憎惡他們。因他們所行的惡，我必從我地上趕出他們去，不再憐愛他們；他們的首領都是悖逆的。
english: All their evil-doing is in Gilgal; there I had hate for them; because of their evil-doing I will send them out of my house; they will no longer be dear to me; all their rulers are uncontrolled.

chinese: 以法蓮受責罰，根本枯乾，必不能結果，即或生產，我必殺他們所生的愛子。
english: The rod has come on Ephraim, their root is dry, let them have no fruit; even though they give birth, I will put to death the dearest fruit of their bodies.

chinese: 我的神必棄絕他們，因為他們不聽從他；他們也必飄流在列國中。
english: My God will give them up because they did not give ear to him; they will be wandering among the nations.

chinese: 以色列是茂盛的葡萄樹，結果繁多。果子越多，就越增添祭壇；地土越肥美，就越造美麗的柱像。
english: Israel is a branching vine, full of fruit; as his fruit is increased, so the number of his altars is increased; as the land is fair, so they have made fair pillars.

chinese: 他們心懷二意，現今要定為有罪。耶和華必拆毀他們的祭壇，毀壞他們的柱像。
english: Their mind is taken away; now they will be made waste: he will have their altars broken down, he will give their pillars to destruction.

chinese: 他們必說：我們沒有王，因為我們不敬畏耶和華。王能為我們做甚麼呢？
english: Now, truly, they will say, We have no king, we have no fear of the Lord; and the king, what is he able to do for us?

chinese: 他們為立約說謊言，起假誓；因此，災罰如苦菜滋生在田間的犁溝中。
english: Their words are foolish; they make agreements with false oaths, so punishment will come up like a poison-plant in a ploughed field.

chinese: 撒瑪利亞的居民必因伯亞文的牛犢驚恐；崇拜牛犢的民和喜愛牛犢的祭司都必因榮耀離開他，為他悲哀。
english: The people of Samaria will be full of fear because of the ox of Beth-aven; its people will have sorrow for it, and its priests will give cries of grief for its glory, for the glory has gone in flight.

chinese: 牛犢帶到亞述當作禮物，獻給耶雷布王。以法蓮必蒙羞；以色列必因自己的計謀慚愧。
english: And they will take it to Assyria and give it to the great king; shame will come on Ephraim, and Israel will be shamed because of its image.

chinese: 至於撒瑪利亞，他的王必滅沒，如水面的沫子一樣。
english: As for Samaria, her king is cut off, like mist on the water.

chinese: 伯亞文的邱壇─就是以色列取罪的地方必被毀滅；荊棘和蒺藜必長在他們的祭壇上。他們必對大山說：遮蓋我們！對小山說：倒在我們身上！
english: And the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, will come to destruction; thorns and waste plants will come up on their altars; they will say to the mountains, Be a cover over us; and to the hills, Come down on us.

chinese: 以色列啊，你從基比亞的日子以來時常犯罪。你們的先人曾站在那裡，現今住基比亞的人以為攻擊罪孽之輩的戰事臨不到自己。
english: O Israel, you have done evil from the days of Gibeah; there they took up their position, so that the fighting against the children of evil might not overtake them in Gibeah.

chinese: 我必隨意懲罰他們。他們為兩樣的罪所纏；列邦的民必聚集攻擊他們。
english: I will come and give them punishment; and the peoples will come together against them when I give them the reward of their two sins.

chinese: 以法蓮是馴良的母牛犢，喜愛踹穀，我卻將軛加在他肥美的頸項上，我要使以法蓮拉套（或作：被騎）。猶大必耕田；雅各必耙地。
english: And Ephraim is a trained cow, taking pleasure in crushing the grain; but I have put a yoke on her fair neck; I will put a horseman on the back of Ephraim; Judah will be working the plough, Jacob will be turning up the earth.

chinese: 你們要為自己栽種公義，就能收割慈愛。現今正是尋求耶和華的時候；你們要開墾荒地，等他臨到，使公義如雨降在你們身上。
english: Put in the seed of righteousness, get in your grain in mercy, let your unploughed earth be turned up: for it is time to make search for the Lord, till he comes and sends righteousness on you like rain.

chinese: 你們耕種的是奸惡，收割的是罪孽，吃的是謊話的果子。因你倚靠自己的行為，仰賴勇士眾多，
english: You have been ploughing sin, you have got in a store of evil, the fruit of deceit has been your food: for you put faith in your way, in the number of your men of war.

chinese: 所以在這民中必有鬨嚷之聲，你一切的保障必被拆毀，就如沙勒幔在爭戰的日子拆毀伯亞比勒，將其中的母子一同摔死。
english: So a great outcry will go up from among your people, and all your strong places will be broken, as Beth-arbel was broken by Shalman in the day of war, as the mother was broken on the rocks with her children.

chinese: 因他們的大惡，伯特利必使你們遭遇如此。到了黎明，以色列的王必全然滅絕。
english: So will Beth-el do to you because of your evil-doing; at dawn will the king of Israel be cut off completely.

chinese: 以色列年幼的時候，我愛他，就從埃及召出我的兒子來。
english: When Israel was a child he was dear to me; and I took my son out of Egypt.

chinese: 先知越發招呼他們，他們越發走開，向諸巴力獻祭，給雕刻的偶像燒香。
english: When I sent for them, then they went away from me; they made offerings to the Baals, burning perfumes to images.

chinese: 我原教導以法蓮行走，用膀臂抱著他們，他們卻不知道是我醫治他們。
english: But I was guiding Ephraim's footsteps; I took them up in my arms, but they were not conscious that I was ready to make them well.

chinese: 我用慈繩（慈：原文是人的）愛索牽引他們；我待他們如人放鬆牛的兩腮夾板，把糧食放在他們面前。
english: I made them come after me with the cords of a man, with the bands of love; I was to them as one who took the yoke from off their mouths, putting meat before them.

chinese: 他們必不歸回埃及地，亞述人卻要作他們的王，因他們不肯歸向我。
english: He will go back to the land of Egypt and the Assyrian will be his king, because they would not come back to me.

chinese: 刀劍必臨到他們的城邑，毀壞門閂，把人吞滅，都因他們隨從自己的計謀。
english: And the sword will go through his towns, wasting his children and causing destruction because of their evil designs.

chinese: 我的民偏要背道離開我；眾先知雖然招呼他們歸向至上的主，卻無人尊崇主。
english: My people are given up to sinning against me; though their voice goes up on high, no one will be lifting them up.

chinese: 以法蓮哪，我怎能捨棄你？以色列啊，我怎能棄絕你？我怎能使你如押瑪？怎能使你如洗扁？我回心轉意，我的憐愛大大發動。
english: How may I give you up, O Ephraim? how may I be your saviour, O Israel? how may I make you like Admah? how may I do to you as I did to Zeboim? My heart is turned in me, it is soft with pity.

chinese: 我必不發猛烈的怒氣，也不再毀滅以法蓮。因我是神，並非世人，是你們中間的聖者；我必不在怒中臨到你們。
english: I will not put into effect the heat of my wrath; I will not again send destruction on Ephraim; for I am God and not man, the Holy One among you; I will not put an end to you.

chinese: 耶和華必如獅子吼叫，子民必跟隨他。他一吼叫，他們就從西方急速而來。
english: They will go after the Lord; his cry will be like that of a lion; his cry will be loud, and the children will come from the west, shaking with fear;

chinese: 他們必如雀鳥從埃及急速而來，又如鴿子從亞述地來到。我必使他們住自己的房屋。這是耶和華說的。
english: Shaking with fear like a bird, they will come out of Egypt, like a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will give them rest in their houses, says the Lord.

chinese: 以法蓮用謊話，以色列家用詭計圍繞我；猶大卻靠神掌權，向聖者有忠心（或譯：猶大向神，向誠實的聖者猶疑不定）。
english: The deceit of Ephraim and the false words of Israel are about me on every side. ...

chinese: 以法蓮吃風，且追趕東風，時常增添虛謊和強暴，與亞述立約，把油送到埃及。
english: Ephraim's food is the wind, and he goes after the east wind: deceit and destruction are increasing day by day; they make an agreement with Assyria, and take oil into Egypt.

chinese: 耶和華與猶大爭辯，必照雅各所行的懲罰他，按他所做的報應他。
english: The Lord has a cause against Judah, and will give punishment to Jacob for his ways; he will give him the reward of his acts.

chinese: 他在腹中抓住哥哥的腳跟，壯年的時候與神較力，
english: In the body of his mother he took his brother by the foot, and in his strength he was fighting with God;

chinese: 與天使較力，並且得勝，哭泣懇求，在伯特利遇見耶和華。耶和華─萬軍之神在那裡曉諭我們以色列人；耶和華是他可記念的名。
english: He had a fight with the angel and overcame him; he made request for grace to him with weeping; he came face to face with him in Beth-el and there his words came to him;
Even the Lord, the God of armies; the Lord is his name.

chinese: 所以你當歸向你的神，謹守仁愛、公平，常常等候你的神。
english: So then, come back to your God; keep mercy and right, and be waiting at all times on your God.

chinese: 以法蓮是商人，手裡有詭詐的天平，愛行欺騙。
english: As for Canaan, the scales of deceit are in his hands; he takes pleasure in twisted ways.

chinese: 以法蓮說：我果然成了富足，得了財寶；我所勞碌得來的，人必不見有甚麼不義，可算為罪的。
english: And Ephraim said, Now I have got wealth and much property; in all my works no sin may be seen in me.

chinese: 自從你出埃及地以來，我就是耶和華─你的神；我必使你再住帳棚，如在大會的日子一樣。
english: But I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt; I will give you tents for your living-places again as in the days of the holy meeting.

chinese: 我已曉諭眾先知，並且加增默示，藉先知設立比喻。
english: My word came to the ears of the prophets and I gave them visions in great number, and by the mouths of the prophets I made use of comparisons.

chinese: 基列人沒有罪孽麼？他們全然是虛假的。人在吉甲獻牛犢為祭，他們的祭壇好像田間犁溝中的亂堆。
english: In Gilead there is evil. They are quite without value; in Gilgal they make offerings of oxen; truly their altars are like masses of stones in the hollows of a ploughed field.

chinese: 從前雅各逃到亞蘭地，以色列為得妻服事人，為得妻與人放羊。
english: And Jacob went in flight into the field of Aram, and Israel became a servant for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.

chinese: 耶和華藉先知領以色列從埃及上來；以色列也藉先知而得保存。
english: And by a prophet the Lord made Israel come up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept safe.

chinese: 以法蓮大大惹動主怒，所以他流血的罪必歸在他身上。主必將那因以法蓮所受的羞辱歸還他。
english: I have been bitterly moved to wrath by Ephraim; so that his blood will be on him, and the Lord will make his shame come back on him.

chinese: 從前以法蓮說話，人都戰兢，他在以色列中居處高位；但他在事奉巴力的事上犯罪就死了。
english: When the words of my law came from Ephraim, he was lifted up in Israel; but when he did evil through the Baal, death overtook him.

chinese: 現今他們罪上加罪，用銀子為自己鑄造偶像，就是照自己的聰明製造，都是匠人的工作。有人論說，獻祭的人可以向牛犢親嘴。
english: And now their sins are increased; they have made themselves a metal image, false gods from their silver, after their designs, all of them the work of the metal-workers; they say of them, Let them give offerings, let men give kisses to the oxen.

chinese: 因此，他們必如早晨的雲霧，又如速散的甘露，像場上的糠秕被狂風吹去，又像煙氣騰於窗外。
english: So they will be like the morning cloud, like the dew which goes early away, like the dust of the grain which the wind is driving out of the crushing-floor, like smoke going up from the fireplace.

chinese: 自從你出埃及地以來，我就是耶和華─你的神。在我以外，你不可認識別　神；除我以外並沒有救主。
english: But I am the Lord your God, from the land of Egypt; you have knowledge of no other God and there is no saviour but me.

chinese: 我曾在曠野乾旱之地認識你。
english: I had knowledge of you in the waste land where no water was.

chinese: 這些民照我所賜的食物得了飽足；既得飽足，心就高傲，忘記了我。
english: When I gave them food they were full, and their hearts were full of pride, and they did not keep me in mind.

chinese: 因此，我向他們如獅子，又如豹伏在道旁。
english: So I will be like a lion to them; as a cruel beast I will keep watch by the road;

chinese: 我遇見他們必像丟崽子的母熊，撕裂他們的胸膛（或譯：心膜）。在那裡，我必像母獅吞吃他們；野獸必撕裂他們。
english: I will come face to face with them like a bear whose young ones have been taken from her, and their inmost hearts will be broken; there the dogs will make a meal of them; they will be wounded by the beasts of the field.

chinese: 以色列啊，你與我反對，就是反對幫助你的，自取敗壞。
english: I have sent destruction on you, O Israel; who will be your helper?

chinese: 你曾求我說：給我立王和首領。現在你的王在哪裡呢？治理你的在哪裡呢？讓他在你所有的城中拯救你罷！
english: Where is your king, that he may be your saviour? and all your rulers, that they may take up your cause? of whom you said, Give me a king and rulers.

chinese: 我在怒氣中將王賜你，又在烈怒中將王廢去。
english: I have given you a king, because I was angry, and have taken him away in my wrath.

chinese: 以法蓮的罪孽包裹；他的罪惡收藏。
english: The wrongdoing of Ephraim is shut up; his sin is put away in secret.

chinese: 產婦的疼痛必臨到他身上；他是無智慧之子，到了產期不當遲延。
english: The pains of a woman in childbirth will come on him: he is an unwise son, for at this time it is not right for him to keep his place when children come to birth.

chinese: 我必救贖他們脫離陰間，救贖他們脫離死亡。死亡啊，你的災害在哪裡呢？陰間哪，你的毀滅在哪裡呢？在我眼前絕無後悔之事。
english: I will give the price to make them free from the power of the underworld, I will be their saviour from death: O death! where are your pains? O underworld! where is your destruction? my eyes will have no pity.

chinese: 他在弟兄中雖然茂盛，必有東風颳來，就是耶和華的風從曠野上來。他的泉源必乾；他的源頭必竭；仇敵必擄掠他所積蓄的一切寶器。
english: Though he gives fruit among his brothers, an east wind will come, the wind of the Lord coming up from the waste land, and his spring will become dry, his fountain will be without water: it will make waste the store of all the vessels of his desire.

chinese: 撒瑪利亞必擔當自己的罪，因為悖逆他的神。他必倒在刀下；嬰孩必被摔死；孕婦必被剖開。
english: Samaria will be made waste, for she has gone against her God: they will be cut down by the sword, their little children will be broken on the rocks, their women who are with child will be cut open.

chinese: 以色列啊，你要歸向耶和華─你的神；你是因自己的罪孽跌倒了。
english: O Israel, come back to the Lord your God; for your evil-doing has been the cause of your fall.

chinese: 當歸向耶和華，用言語禱告他說：求你除淨罪孽，悅納善行；這樣，我們就把嘴唇的祭代替牛犢獻上。
english: Take with you words, and come back to the Lord; say to him, Let there be forgiveness for all wrongdoing, so that we may take what is good, and give in payment the fruit of our lips.

chinese: 我們不向亞述求救，不騎埃及的馬，也不再對我們手所造的說：你是我們的神。因為孤兒在你─耶和華那裡得蒙憐憫。
english: Assyria will not be our salvation; we will not go on horses; we will not again say to the work of our hands, You are our gods; for in you there is mercy for the child who has no father.

chinese: 我必醫治他們背道的病，甘心愛他們；因為我的怒氣向他們轉消。
english: I will put right their errors; freely will my love be given to them, for my wrath is turned away from him.

chinese: 我必向以色列如甘露；他必如百合花開放，如利巴嫩的樹木扎根。
english: I will be as the dew to Israel; he will put out flowers like a lily, and send out his roots like Lebanon.

chinese: 他的枝條必延長；他的榮華如橄欖樹；他的香氣如利巴嫩的香柏樹。
english: His branches will be stretched out, he will be beautiful as the olive-tree and sweet-smelling as Lebanon.

chinese: 曾住在他蔭下的必歸回，發旺如五穀，開花如葡萄樹。他的香氣如利巴嫩的酒。
english: They will come back and have rest in his shade; their life will be made new like the grain, and they will put out flowers like the vine; his name will be like the wine of Lebanon.

chinese: 以法蓮必說：我與偶像還有甚麼關涉呢？我─耶和華回答他，也必顧念他。我如青翠的松樹；你的果子從我而得。
english: As for Ephraim, what has he to do with false gods any longer? I have given an answer and I will keep watch over him; I am like a branching fir-tree, from me comes your fruit.

chinese: 誰是智慧人，可以明白這些事；誰是通達人，可以知道這一切。因為，耶和華的道是正直的；義人必在其中行走，罪人卻在其上跌倒。
english: He who is wise will see these things; he who has good sense will have knowledge of them. For the ways of the Lord are straight, and the upright will go in them, but sinners will be falling in them.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到毗土珥的兒子約珥。
english: The word of the Lord which came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.

chinese: 老年人哪，當聽我的話；國中的居民哪，都要側耳而聽。在你們的日子，或你們列祖的日子，曾有這樣的事麼？
english: Give ear to this, you old men, and take note, you people of the land. Has this ever been in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

chinese: 你們要將這事傳與子，子傳與孫，孫，傳與後代。
english: Give the story of it to your children, and let them give it to their children, and their children to another generation.

chinese: 剪蟲剩下的，蝗蟲來吃；蝗蟲剩下的，蝻子來吃；蝻子剩下的，螞蚱來吃。
english: What the worm did not make a meal of, has been taken by the locust; and what the locust did not take, has been food for the plant-worm; and what the plant-worm did not take, has been food for the field-fly.

chinese: 酒醉的人哪，要清醒哭泣；好酒的人哪，都要為甜酒哀號，因為從你們的口中斷絕了。
english: Come out of your sleep, you who are overcome with wine, and give yourselves to weeping; give cries of sorrow, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine; for it has been cut off from your mouths.

chinese: 有一隊蝗蟲（原文是民）又強盛又無數，侵犯我的地；他的牙齒如獅子的牙齒，大牙如母獅的大牙。
english: For a nation has come up over my land, strong and without number; his teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the back teeth of a great lion.

chinese: 他毀壞我的葡萄樹，剝了我無花果樹的皮，剝盡而丟棄，使枝條露白。
english: By him my vine is made waste and my fig-tree broken: he has taken all its fruit and sent it down to the earth; its branches are made white.

chinese: 我的民哪，你當哀號，像處女腰束麻布，為幼年的丈夫哀號。
english: Make sounds of grief like a virgin dressed in haircloth for the husband of her early years.

chinese: 素祭和奠祭從耶和華的殿中斷絕；事奉耶和華的祭司都悲哀。
english: The meal offering and the drink offering have been cut off from the house of the Lord; the priests, the Lord's servants, are sorrowing.

chinese: 田荒涼，地悲哀；因為五穀毀壞，新酒乾竭，油也缺乏。
english: The fields are wasted, the land has become dry; for the grain is wasted, the new wine is kept back, the oil is poor.

chinese: 農夫啊，你們要慚愧,修理葡萄園的啊，你們要哀號；因為大麥小麥與田間的莊稼都滅絕了。
english: The farmers are shamed, the workers in the vine-gardens give cries of grief, for the wheat and the barley; for the produce of the fields has come to destruction.

chinese: 葡萄樹枯乾；無花果樹衰殘。石榴樹、棕樹、蘋果樹，連田野一切的樹木也都枯乾；眾人的喜樂盡都消滅。
english: The vine has become dry and the fig-tree is feeble; the pomegranate and the palm-tree and the apple-tree, even all the trees of the field, are dry: because joy has gone from the sons of men.

chinese: 祭司啊，你們當腰束麻布痛哭；伺候祭壇的啊，你們要哀號；事奉我神的啊，你們要來披上麻布過夜，因為素祭和奠祭從你們　神的殿中斷絕了。
english: Put haircloth round you and give yourselves to sorrow, you priests; give cries of grief, you servants of the altar: come in, and, clothed in haircloth, let the night go past, you servants of my God: for the meal offering and the drink offering have been kept back from the house of your God.

chinese: 你們要分定禁食的日子，宣告嚴肅會，招聚長老和國中的一切居民到耶和華─你們神的殿，向耶和華哀求。
english: Let a time be fixed for going without food, have a holy meeting, let the old men, even all the people of the land, come together to the house of the Lord your God, crying out to the Lord.

chinese: 哀哉!耶和華的日子臨近了。這日來到，好像毀滅從全能者來到。
english: Sorrow for the day! for the day of the Lord is near, and as destruction from the Ruler of all it will come.

chinese: 糧食不是在我們眼前斷絕了嗎？歡喜快樂不是從我們神的殿中止息了嗎？
english: Is not food cut off before our eyes? joy and delight from the house of our God?

chinese: 穀種在土塊下朽爛；倉也荒涼，廩也破壞；因為五穀枯乾了。
english: The grains have become small and dry under the spade; the store-houses are made waste, the grain-stores are broken down; for the grain is dry and dead.

chinese: 牲畜哀鳴；牛群混亂，因為無草；羊群也受了困苦。
english: What sounds of pain come from the beasts! the herds of cattle are at a loss because there is no grass for them; even the flocks of sheep are no longer to be seen.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我向你求告，因為火燒滅曠野的草場；火焰燒盡田野的樹木。
english: O Lord, my cry goes up to you: for fire has put an end to the grass-lands of the waste, and all the trees of the field are burned with its flame.

chinese: 田野的走獸向你發喘；因為溪水乾涸，火也燒滅曠野的草場。
english: The beasts of the field are turning to you with desire: for the water-streams are dry and fire has put an end to the grass-lands of the waste.

chinese: 你們要在錫安吹角，在我聖山吹出大聲。國中的居民都要發顫；因為耶和華的日子將到，已經臨近。
english: Let the horn be sounded in Zion, and a war-cry in my holy mountain; let all the people of the land be troubled: for the day of the Lord is coming;

chinese: 那日是黑暗、幽冥、密雲、烏黑的日子，好像晨光鋪滿山嶺。有一隊蝗蟲（原文是民）又大又強；從來沒有這樣的，以後直到萬代也必沒有。
english: For a day of dark and deep shade is near, a day of cloud and black night: like a black cloud a great and strong people is covering the mountains; there has never been any like them and will not be after them again, from generation to generation.

chinese: 他們前面如火燒滅，後面如火燄燒盡。未到以前，地如伊甸園；過去以後，成了荒涼的曠野；沒有一樣能躲避他們的。
english: Before them fire sends destruction, and after them flame is burning: the land is like the garden of Eden before them, and after them an unpeopled waste; truly, nothing has been kept safe from them.

chinese: 他們的形狀如馬，奔跑如馬兵。
english: Their form is like the form of horses, and they are running like war-horses.

chinese: 在山頂蹦跳的響聲，如車輛的響聲，又如火燄燒碎秸的響聲，好像強盛的民擺陣預備打仗。
english: Like the sound of war-carriages they go jumping on the tops of the mountains; like the noise of a flame of fire burning up the grain-stems, like a strong people lined up for the fight.

chinese: 他們一來，眾民傷慟，臉都變色。
english: At their coming the people are bent with pain: all faces become red together.

chinese: 他們如勇士奔跑，像戰士爬城；各都步行，不亂隊伍。
english: They are running like strong men, they go over the wall like men of war; every man goes straight on his way, their lines are not broken.

chinese: 彼此並不擁擠，向前各行其路，直闖兵器，不偏左右。
english: No one is pushing against another; everyone goes straight on his way: bursting through the sword points, their order is not broken.

chinese: 他們蹦上城，躥上牆，爬上房屋，進入窗戶如同盜賊。
english: They make a rush on the town, running on the wall; they go up into the houses and in through the windows like a thief.

chinese: 他們一來，地震天動，日月昏暗，星宿無光。
english: The earth is troubled before them and the heavens are shaking: the sun and the moon have become dark, and the stars keep back their shining:

chinese: 耶和華在他軍旅前發聲，他的隊伍甚大；成就他命的是強盛者。因為耶和華的日子大而可畏，誰能當得起呢？
english: And the Lord is thundering before his forces; for very great is his army; for he is strong who gives effect to his word: for the day of the Lord is great and greatly to be feared, and who has strength against it?

chinese: 耶和華說：雖然如此，你們應當禁食、哭泣、悲哀，一心歸向我。
english: But even now, says the Lord, come back to me with all your heart, keeping from food, with weeping and with sorrow:

chinese: 你們要撕裂心腸，不撕裂衣服。歸向耶和華─你們的神；因為他有恩典，有憐憫，不輕易發怒，有豐盛的慈愛，並且後悔不降所說的災。
english: Let your hearts be broken, and not your clothing, and come back to the Lord your God: for he is full of grace and pity, slow to be angry and great in mercy, ready to be turned from his purpose of punishment.

chinese: 或者他轉意後悔，留下餘福，就是留下獻給耶和華─你們神的素祭和奠祭，也未可知。
english: May it not be that he will again let his purpose be changed and let a blessing come after him, even a meal offering and a drink offering for the Lord your God?

chinese: 你們要在錫安吹角，分定禁食的日子，宣告嚴肅會。
english: Let a horn be sounded in Zion, let a time be fixed for going without food, have a holy meeting:

chinese: 聚集眾民，使會眾自潔：招聚老者，聚集孩童和吃奶的；使新郎出離洞房，新婦出離內室。
english: Get the people together, make the mass of the people holy, send for the old men, get together the children and babies at the breast: let the newly married man come out of his room and the bride from her tent.

chinese: 事奉耶和華的祭司要在廊子和祭壇中間哭泣，說：耶和華啊，求你顧惜你的百姓，不要使你的產業受羞辱，列邦管轄他們。為何容列國的人說：他們的神在哪裡呢？
english: Let the priests, the servants of the Lord, be weeping between the covered way and the altar, and let them say, Have mercy on your people, O Lord, do not give up your heritage to shame, so that the nations become their rulers: why let them say among the peoples, Where is their God?

chinese: 耶和華就為自己的地發熱心，憐恤他的百姓。
english: Then the Lord had a care for the honour of his land and had pity on his people.

chinese: 耶和華應允他的百姓說：我必賜給你們五穀、新酒，和油，使你們飽足；我也不再使你們受列國的羞辱；
english: And the Lord made answer and said to his people, See, I will send you grain and wine and oil in full measure: and I will no longer let you be shamed among the nations:

chinese: 卻要使北方來的軍隊遠離你們，將他們趕到乾旱荒廢之地：前隊趕入東海，後隊趕入西海；因為他們所行的大惡（原文作事），臭氣上升，腥味騰空。
english: I will send the one from the north far away from you, driving him into a dry and waste land, with his front to the sea of the east and his back to the sea of the west, and the smell of him will go up, even his evil smell will go up.

chinese: 地土啊，不要懼怕；要歡喜快樂，因為耶和華行了大事。
english: Have no fear, O land; be glad with great joy; for the Lord has done great things.

chinese: 田野的走獸啊，不要懼怕；因為，曠野的草發生，樹木結果，無花果樹、葡萄樹也都效力。
english: Have no fear, you beasts of the field, for the grass-lands of the waste are becoming green, for the trees are producing fruit, the fig-tree and the vine give out their strength.

chinese: 錫安的民哪，你們要快樂，為耶和華─你們的神歡喜；因他賜給你們合宜的秋雨，為你們降下甘霖，就是秋雨、春雨，和先前一樣。
english: Be glad, then, you children of Zion, and have joy in the Lord your God: for he gives you food in full measure, making the rain come down for you, the early and the late rain as at the first.

chinese: 禾場必滿了麥子；酒醡與油醡必有新酒和油盈溢。
english: And the floors will be full of grain, and the crushing-places overflowing with wine and oil.

chinese: 我打發到你們中間的大軍隊，就是蝗蟲、蝻子、螞蚱、剪蟲，那些年所吃的，我要補還你們。
english: I will give back to you the years which were food for the locust, the plant-worm, the field-fly, and the worm, my great army which I sent among you.

chinese: 你們必多吃而得飽足就讚美為你們行奇妙事之耶和華─你們神的名。我的百姓必永遠不至羞愧。
english: You will have food in full measure, and give praise to the name of the Lord your God, who has done wonders for you:

chinese: 你們必知道我是在以色列中間，又知道我是耶和華─你們的神；在我以外並無別神。我的百姓必永遠不致羞愧。
english: And you will be certain that I am in Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and there is no other: and my people will never be shamed.

chinese: 以後，我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。你們的兒女要說預言；你們的老年人要做異夢，少年人要見異象。
english: And after that, it will come about, says the Lord, that I will send my spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will be prophets, your old men will have dreams, your young men will see visions:

chinese: 在那些日子，我要將我的靈澆灌我的僕人和使女。
english: And on the servants and the servant-girls in those days I will send my spirit.

chinese: 在天上地下，我要顯出奇事，有血，有火，有煙柱。
english: And I will let wonders be seen in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and pillars of smoke.

chinese: 日頭要變為黑暗，月亮要變為血，這都在耶和華大而可畏的日子未到以前。
english: The sun will be made dark and the moon turned to blood, before the great day of the Lord comes, a day to be feared.

chinese: 到那時候，凡求告耶和華名的就必得救；因為照耶和華所說的，在錫安山，耶路撒冷必有逃脫的人，在剩下的人中必有耶和華所召的。
english: And it will be that whoever makes his prayer to the name of the Lord will be kept safe: for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem some will be kept safe, as the Lord has said, and will be among the small band marked out by the Lord.

chinese: 到那日，我使猶大和耶路撒冷被擄之人歸回的時候，
english: For in those days and in that time, when I let the fate of Judah and Jerusalem be changed,

chinese: 我要聚集萬民，帶他們下到約沙法谷，在那裡施行審判；因為他們將我的百姓，就是我的產業以色列，分散在列國中，又分取我的地土，
english: I will get together all the nations, and make them come down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and there I will take up with them the cause of my people and of my heritage Israel, whom they have sent wandering among the nations, and of my land which has been parted by them.

chinese: 且為我的百姓拈鬮，將童子換妓女，賣童女買酒喝。
english: And they have put the fate of my people to the decision of chance: giving a boy for the price of a loose woman and a girl for a drink of wine.

chinese: 推羅、西頓，和非利士四境的人哪，你們與我何干？你們要報復我麼？若報復我，我必使報應速速歸到你們的頭上。
english: And further, what are you to me, O Tyre and Zidon and all the circle of Philistia? will you give me back any payment? and if you do, quickly and suddenly I will send it back on your head,

chinese: 你們既然奪取我的金銀，又將我可愛的寶物帶入你們宮殿（或譯：廟中），
english: For you have taken my silver and my gold, putting in the houses of your gods my beautiful and pleasing things.

chinese: 並將猶大人和耶路撒冷人賣給希利尼人（原文是雅完人），使他們遠離自己的境界。
english: And the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem you have given for a price to the sons of the Greeks, to send them far away from their land:

chinese: 我必激動他們離開你們所賣到之地，又必使報應歸到你們的頭上。
english: See, I will have them moved from the place where you have sent them, and will let what you have done come back on your head;

chinese: 我必將你們的兒女賣在猶大人的手中，他們必賣給遠方示巴國的人。這是耶和華說的。
english: I will give your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah for a price, and they will give them for a price to the men of Sheba, a nation far off: for the Lord has said it.

chinese: 當在萬民中宣告說：要預備打仗；激動勇士，使一切戰士上前來。
english: Give this out among the nations; make ready for war: get the strong men awake; let all the men of war come near, let them come up.

chinese: 要將犁頭打成刀劍，將鐮刀打成戈矛；軟弱的要說：我有勇力。
english: Get your plough-blades hammered into swords, and your vine-knives into spears: let the feeble say, I am strong.

chinese: 四圍的列國啊，你們要速速地來，一同聚集。耶和華啊，求你使你的大能者降臨。
english: Come quickly, all you nations round about, and get yourselves together there: make your strong ones come down, O Lord.

chinese: 萬民都當興起，上到約沙法谷；因為我必坐在那裡，審判四圍的列國。
english: Let the nations be awake, and come to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there I will be seated as judge of all the nations round about.

chinese: 開鐮罷！因為莊稼熟了；踐踏罷！因為酒醡滿了。酒池盈溢；他們的罪惡甚大。
english: Put in the blade, for the grain is ready: come, get you down, for the wine-crusher is full, the vessels are overflowing; for great is their evil-doing.

chinese: 許多許多的人在斷定谷，因為耶和華的日子臨近斷定谷。
english: Masses on masses in the valley of decision! for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.

chinese: 日月昏暗，星宿無光。
english: The sun and the moon have become dark, and the stars keep back their shining.

chinese: 耶和華必從錫安吼叫，從耶路撒冷發聲，天地就震動。耶和華卻要作他百姓的避難所，作以色列人的保障。
english: And the Lord will be thundering from Zion, and his voice will be sounding from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will be shaking: but the Lord will be a breastplate for his people and a strong place for the children of Israel.

chinese: 你們就知道我是耶和華─你們的神，且又住在錫安─我的聖山。那時，耶路撒冷必成為聖；外邦人不再從其中經過。
english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord your God, living in Zion, my holy mountain: and Jerusalem will be holy, and no strange person will ever again go through her.

chinese: 到那日，大山要滴甜酒；小山要流奶子；猶大溪河都有水流。必有泉源從耶和華的殿中流出來，滋潤什亭谷。
english: And it will come about in that day that the mountains will be dropping sweet wine, and the hills will be flowing with milk, and all the streams of Judah will be flowing with water; and a fountain will come out from the house of the Lord, watering the valley of acacia-trees.

chinese: 埃及必然荒涼，以東變為悽涼的曠野，都因向猶大人所行的強暴，又因在本地流無辜人的血。
english: Egypt will be a waste and Edom a land of destruction, because of the evil done to the children of Judah, because they have let blood be drained out in their land without cause.

chinese: 但猶大必存到永遠；耶路撒冷必存到萬代。
english: But Judah will be peopled for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

chinese: 我未曾報復（或譯：洗除；下同）流血的罪，現在我要報復，因為耶和華住在錫安。
english: And I will send punishment for their blood, for which punishment has not been sent, for the Lord is living in Zion.

chinese: 當猶大王烏西雅，以色列王約阿施的兒子耶羅波安在位的時候，大地震前二年，提哥亞牧人中的阿摩司得默示論以色列。
english: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa; what he saw about Israel in the days of Uzziah, king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam, the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earth-shock.

chinese: 他說：耶和華必從錫安吼叫，從耶路撒冷發聲；牧人的草場要悲哀；迦密的山頂要枯乾。
english: And he said, The Lord will give a lion's cry from Zion, his voice will be sounding from Jerusalem; and the fields of the keepers of sheep will become dry, and the top of Carmel will be wasted away.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：大馬色三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他的刑罰；因為他以打糧食的鐵器打過基列。
english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Damascus, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they have been crushing Gilead with iron grain-crushing instruments.

chinese: 我卻要降火在哈薛的家中，燒滅便哈達的宮殿。
english: And I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, burning up the great houses of Ben-hadad.

chinese: 我必折斷大馬色的門閂，剪除亞文平原的居民和伯伊甸掌權的。亞蘭人必被擄到吉珥。這是耶和華說的。
english: And I will have the locks of the door of Damascus broken, and him who is seated in power cut off from the valley of Aven, and him in whose hand is the rod from the house of Eden; and the people of Aram will go away as prisoners into Kir, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：迦薩三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他的刑罰；因為他擄掠眾民交給以東。
english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Gaza, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they took all the people away prisoners, to give them up to Edom.

chinese: 我卻要降火在迦薩的城內，燒滅其中的宮殿。
english: And I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, burning up its great houses:

chinese: 我必剪除亞實突的居民和亞實基倫掌權的，也必反手攻擊以革倫。非利士人所餘剩的必都滅亡。這是主耶和華說的。
english: Him who is seated in power I will have cut off from Ashdod, and him in whose hand is the rod from Ashkelon; and my hand will be turned against Ekron, and the rest of the Philistines will come to destruction, says the Lord God.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：推羅三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他的刑罰；因為他將眾民交給以東，並不記念弟兄的盟約。
english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Tyre, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they gave up all the people prisoners to Edom, without giving a thought to the brothers' agreement between them.

chinese: 我卻要降火在推羅的城內，燒滅其中的宮殿。
english: And I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, burning up its great houses.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：以東三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他的刑罰；因為他拿刀追趕兄弟，毫無憐憫，發怒撕裂，永懷忿怒。
english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Edom, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because his sword was turned against his brother, without pity, and his wrath was burning at all times, and he was angry for ever.

chinese: 我卻要降火在提幔，燒滅波斯拉的宮殿。
english: And I will send a fire on Teman, burning up the great houses of Bozrah.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：亞捫人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他們的刑罰；因為他們剖開基列的孕婦，擴張自己的境界。
english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because in Gilead they had women with child cut open, so that they might make wider the limits of their land.

chinese: 我卻要在爭戰吶喊的日子，旋風狂暴的時候，點火在拉巴的城內，燒滅其中的宮殿。
english: And I will make a fire in the wall of Rabbah, burning up its great houses, with loud cries in the days of war, with a storm in the day of the great wind:

chinese: 他們的王和首領必一同被擄去。這是耶和華說的。
english: And their king will be made prisoner, he and his captains together, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：摩押三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他的刑罰；因為他將以東王的骸骨焚燒成灰。
english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Moab, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because he had the bones of the king of Edom burned to dust.

chinese: 我卻要降火在摩押，燒滅加略的宮殿。摩押必在鬨嚷吶喊吹角之中死亡。
english: And I will send a fire on Moab, burning up the great houses of Kerioth: and death will come on Moab with noise and outcries and the sound of the horn:

chinese: 我必剪除摩押中的審判者，將其中的一切首領和他一同殺戮。這是耶和華說的。
english: And I will have the judge cut off from among them, and all their captains I will put to death with him, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：猶大人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他們的刑罰；因為他們厭棄耶和華的訓誨，不遵守他的律例。他們列祖所隨從虛假的偶像使他們走迷了。
english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Judah, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they have given up the law of the Lord, and have not kept his rules; and their false ways, in which their fathers went, have made them go out of the right way.

chinese: 我卻要降火在猶大，燒滅耶路撒冷的宮殿。
english: And I will send a fire on Judah, burning up the great houses of Jerusalem.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：以色列人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他們的刑罰；因他們為銀子賣了義人，為一雙鞋賣了窮人。
english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Israel, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they have given the upright man for silver, and the poor for the price of two shoes;

chinese: 他們見窮人頭上所蒙的灰也都垂涎，阻礙謙卑人的道路。父子同一個女子行淫，褻瀆我的聖名。
english: Crushing the head of the poor, and turning the steps of the gentle out of the way: and a man and his father go in to the same young woman, putting shame on my holy name:

chinese: 他們在各壇旁鋪人所當的衣服，臥在其上，又在他們神的廟中喝受罰之人的酒。
english: By every altar they are stretched on clothing taken from those who are in their debt, drinking in the house of their god the wine of those who have made payment for wrongdoing.

chinese: 我從以色列人面前除滅亞摩利人。他雖高大如香柏樹，堅固如橡樹，我卻上滅他的果子，下絕他的根本。
english: Though I sent destruction on the Amorite before them, who was tall as the cedar and strong as the oak-tree, cutting off his fruit from on high and his roots from under the earth.

chinese: 我也將你們從埃及地領上來，在曠野引導你們四十年，使你們得亞摩利人之地為業。
english: And I took you up out of the land of Egypt, guiding you for forty years in the waste land, so that you might take for your heritage the land of the Amorite.

chinese: 我從你們子弟中興起先知，又從你們少年人中興起拿細耳人。以色列人哪，不是這樣麼？這是耶和華說的。
english: And some of your sons I made prophets, and some of your young men I made separate for myself. Is it not even so, O children of Israel? says the Lord.

chinese: 你們卻給拿細耳人酒喝，囑咐先知說：不要說預言。
english: But to those who were separate you gave wine for drink; and to the prophets you said, Be prophets no longer.

chinese: 看哪，在你們所住之地，我必壓你們，如同裝滿禾捆的車壓物一樣。
english: See, I am crushing you down, as one is crushed under a cart full of grain.

chinese: 快跑的不能逃脫；有力的不能用力；剛勇的也不能自救。
english: And flight will be impossible for the quick-footed, and the force of the strong will become feeble, and the man of war will not get away safely:

chinese: 拿弓的不能站立；腿快的不能逃脫；騎馬的也不能自救。
english: And the bowman will not keep his place; he who is quick-footed will not get away safely: and the horseman will not keep his life.

chinese: 到那日，勇士中最有膽量的，必赤身逃跑。這是耶和華說的。
english: And he who is without fear among the fighting men will go in flight without his clothing in that day, says the Lord.

chinese: 以色列人哪，你們全家是我從埃及地領上來的，當聽耶和華攻擊你們的話：
english: Give ear to this word which the Lord has said against you, O children of Israel, against all the family which I took up out of the land of Egypt, saying,

chinese: 在地上萬族中，我只認識你們；因此，我必追討你們的一切罪孽。
english: You only of all the families of the earth have I taken care of: for this reason I will send punishment on you for all your sins.

chinese: 二人若不同心，豈能同行呢？
english: Is it possible for two to go walking together, if not by agreement?

chinese: 獅子若非抓食，豈能在林中咆哮呢？少壯獅子若無所得，豈能從洞中發聲呢？
english: Will a lion give his loud cry in the woodland when no food is there? will the voice of the young lion be sounding from his hole if he has taken nothing?

chinese: 若沒有機檻，雀鳥豈能陷在網羅裡呢？網羅若無所得，豈能從地上翻起呢？
english: Is it possible for a bird to be taken in a net on the earth where no net has been put for him? will the net come up from the earth if it has taken nothing at all?

chinese: 城中若吹角，百姓豈不驚恐呢？災禍若臨到一城，豈非耶和華所降的麼？
english: If the horn is sounded in the town will the people not be full of fear? will evil come on a town if the Lord has not done it?

chinese: 主耶和華若不將奧秘指示他的僕人─眾先知，就一無所行。
english: Certainly the Lord will do nothing without making clear his secret to his servants, the prophets.

chinese: 獅子吼叫，誰不懼怕呢？主耶和華發命，誰能不說預言呢？
english: The cry of the lion is sounding; who will not have fear? The Lord God has said the word; is it possible for the prophet to keep quiet?

chinese: 要在亞實突的宮殿中和埃及地的宮殿裡傳揚說：你們要聚集在撒瑪利亞的山上，就看見城中有何等大的擾亂與欺壓的事。
english: Give out the news in the great houses of Assyria and in the land of Egypt, and say, Come together on the mountains of Samaria, and see what great outcries are there, and what cruel acts are done in it.

chinese: 那些以強暴搶奪財物、積蓄在自己家中的人不知道行正直的事。這是耶和華說的。
english: For they have no knowledge of how to do what is right, says the Lord, who are storing up violent acts and destruction in their great houses.

chinese: 所以主耶和華如此說：敵人必來圍攻這地，使你的勢力衰微，搶掠你的家宅。
english: For this reason, says the Lord, an attacker will come, shutting in the land on every side; and your strength will come down and your great houses will be made waste.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：牧人怎樣從獅子口中搶回兩條羊腿或半個耳朵，住撒瑪利亞的以色列人躺臥在床角上或鋪繡花毯的榻上，他們得救也不過如此。
english: These are the words of the Lord: As the keeper of sheep takes out of the mouth of the lion two legs or part of an ear; so will the children of Israel be made safe, who are resting in Samaria on seats of honour or on the silk cushions of a bed.

chinese: 主耶和華─萬軍之神說：當聽這話，警戒雅各家。
english: Give ear now, and give witness against the family of Jacob, says the Lord God, the God of armies;

chinese: 我討以色列罪的日子，也要討伯特利祭壇的罪；壇角必被砍下，墜落於地。
english: For in the day when I give Israel punishment for his sins, I will send punishment on the altars of Beth-el, and the horns of the altar will be cut off and come down to the earth.

chinese: 我要拆毀過冬和過夏的房屋。象牙的房屋也必毀滅；高大的房屋都歸無有。這是耶和華說的。
english: And I will send destruction on the winter house with the summer house; the ivory houses will be falling down and the great houses will come to an end, says the Lord.

chinese: 你們住撒瑪利亞山如巴珊母牛的啊，當聽我的話─你們欺負貧寒的，壓碎窮乏的，對家主說：拿酒來，我們喝罷！
english: Give ear to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are in the hill of Samaria, by whom the poor are kept down, and those in need are crushed; who say to their lords, Get out the wine and give us drink.

chinese: 主耶和華指著自己的聖潔起誓說：日子快到，人必用鉤子將你們鉤去，用魚鉤將你們餘剩的鉤去。
english: The Lord God has taken an oath by his holy name, that the days are coming when they will take you away with hooks, and the rest of you with fish-hooks.

chinese: 你們各人必從破口直往前行，投入哈門。這是耶和華說的。
english: And you will go out through the broken places, every one going straight before her, and you will be sent into Harmon, says the Lord.

chinese: 以色列人哪，任你們往伯特利去犯罪，到吉甲加增罪過；每日早晨獻上你們的祭物，每三日奉上你們的十分之一。
english: Come to Beth-el and do evil; to Gilgal, increasing the number of your sins; come with your offerings every morning and your tenths every three days:

chinese: 任你們獻有酵的感謝祭，把甘心祭宣傳報告給眾人，因為是你們所喜愛的。這是主耶和華說的。
english: Let that which is leavened be burned as a praise-offering, let the news of your free offerings be given out publicly; for this is pleasing to you, O children of Israel, says the Lord.

chinese: 我使你們在一切城中牙齒乾淨，在你們各處糧食缺乏，你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
english: But in all your towns I have kept food from your teeth, and in all your places there has been need of bread: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

chinese: 在收割的前三月，我使雨停止，不降在你們那裡；我降雨在這城，不降雨在那城；這塊地有雨，那塊地無雨；無雨的就枯乾了。
english: And I have kept back the rain from you, when it was still three months before the grain-cutting: I sent rain on one town and kept it back from another: one part was rained on, and the part where there was no rain became a waste.

chinese: 這樣，兩三城的人湊到一城去找水，卻喝不足；你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
english: So two or three towns went wandering to one town looking for water, and did not get enough: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

chinese: 我以旱風、霉爛攻擊你們，你們園中許多菜蔬、葡萄樹、無花果樹、橄欖樹都被剪蟲所吃；你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
english: I have sent destruction on your fields by burning and disease: the increase of your gardens and your vine-gardens, your fig-trees and your olive-trees, has been food for worms: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

chinese: 我降瘟疫在你們中間，像在埃及一樣；用刀殺戮你們的少年人，使你們的馬匹被擄掠，營中屍首的臭氣撲鼻；你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
english: I have sent disease among you, as it was in Egypt: I have put your young men to the sword, and have taken away your horses; I have made the evil smell from your tents come up to your noses: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

chinese: 我傾覆你們中間的城邑，如同我從前傾覆所多瑪、蛾摩拉一樣，使你們好像從火中抽出來的一根柴；你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
english: And I have sent destruction among you, as when God sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick pulled out of the fire: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

chinese: 以色列啊，我必向你如此行；以色列啊，我既這樣行，你當預備迎見你的神。
english: So this is what I will do to you, O Israel: and because I will do this to you, be ready for a meeting with your God, O Israel.

chinese: 那創山、造風、將心意指示人、使晨光變為幽暗、腳踏在地之高處的，他的名是耶和華─萬軍之神。
english: For see, he who gave form to the mountains and made the wind, giving knowledge of his purpose to man, who makes the morning dark, and is walking on the high places of the earth: the Lord, the God of armies, is his name.

chinese: 以色列家啊，要聽我為你們所作的哀歌：
english: Give ear to this word, my song of sorrow over you, O children of Israel.

chinese: 以色列民（原文是處女）跌倒，不得再起；躺在地上，無人攙扶。
english: The virgin of Israel has been made low, never again to be lifted up: she is stretched out by herself on her land; there is no one to put her on her feet again.

chinese: 主耶和華如此說：以色列家的城發出一千兵的，只剩一百；發出一百的，只剩十個。
english: For these are the words of the Lord God: The town which was able to send out a thousand, will have only a hundred; and that which sent out a hundred, will have only ten, in Israel.

chinese: 耶和華向以色列家如此說：你們要尋求我，就必存活。
english: For these are the words of the Lord to the children of Israel: Let your hearts be turned to me, so that you may have life:

chinese: 不要往伯特利尋求，不要進入吉甲，不要過到別是巴；因為吉甲必被擄掠，伯特利也必歸於無有。
english: Do not be looking for help to Beth-el, and do not go to Gilgal, or make your way to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal will certainly be taken prisoner, and Beth-el will come to nothing.

chinese: 要尋求耶和華，就必存活，免得他在約瑟家像火發出，在伯特利焚燒，無人撲滅。
english: Go to the Lord for help so that you may have life; for fear that he may come like fire bursting out in the family of Joseph, causing destruction, and there will be no one to put it out in Beth-el.

chinese: 你們這使公平變為茵蔯、將公義丟棄於地的，
english: You who make the work of judging a bitter thing, crushing down righteousness to the earth;

chinese: 要尋求那造昴星和參星，使死蔭變為晨光，使白日變為黑夜，命海水來澆在地上的─耶和華是他的名；
english: Go for help to him who makes Orion and the Pleiades, by whom the deep dark is turned into morning, who makes the day black with night; whose voice goes out to the waters of the sea, sending them out over the face of the earth: the Lord is his name;

chinese: 他使力強的忽遭滅亡，以致保障遭遇毀壞。
english: Who sends sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the walled town.

chinese: 你們怨恨那在城門口責備人的，憎惡那說正直話的。
english: They have hate for him who makes protest against evil in the public place, and he whose words are upright is disgusting to them.

chinese: 你們踐踏貧民，向他們勒索麥子；你們用鑿過的石頭建造房屋，卻不得住在其內；栽種美好的葡萄園，卻不得喝所出的酒。
english: So because the poor man is crushed under your feet, and you take taxes from him of grain: you have made for yourselves houses of cut stone, but you will not take your rest in them; the fair vine-gardens planted by your hands will not give you wine.

chinese: 我知道你們的罪過何等多，你們的罪惡何等大。你們苦待義人，收受賄賂，在城門口屈枉窮乏人。
english: For I have seen how your evil-doing is increased and how strong are your sins, you troublers of the upright, who take rewards and do wrong to the cause of the poor in the public place.

chinese: 所以通達人見這樣的時勢必靜默不言，因為時勢真惡。
english: So the wise will say nothing in that time; for it is an evil time.

chinese: 你們要求善，不要求惡，就必存活。這樣，耶和華─萬軍之神必照你們所說的與你們同在。
english: Go after good and not evil, so that life may be yours: and so the Lord, the God of armies, will be with you, as you say.

chinese: 要惡惡好善，在城門口秉公行義；或者耶和華─萬軍之神向約瑟的餘民施恩。
english: Be haters of evil and lovers of good, and let right be done in the public place: it may be that the Lord, the God of armies, will have mercy on the rest of Joseph.

chinese: 主耶和華─萬軍之神如此說：在一切寬闊處必有哀號的聲音；在各街市上必有人說：哀哉！哀哉！又必叫農夫來哭號，叫善唱哀歌的來舉哀。
english: So these are the words of the Lord, the God of armies, the Lord: There will be weeping in all the open spaces; and in all the streets they will say, Sorrow! sorrow! and they will get in the farmer to the weeping, and the makers of sad songs to give cries of grief.

chinese: 在各葡萄園必有哀號的聲音，因為我必從你中間經過。這是耶和華說的。
english: In all the vine-gardens there will be cries of grief: for I will go through among you, says the Lord.

chinese: 想望耶和華日子來到的有禍了！你們為何想望耶和華的日子呢？那日黑暗沒有光明，
english: Sorrow to you who are looking for the day of the Lord! what is the day of the Lord to you? it is dark and not light.

chinese: 景況好像人躲避獅子又遇見熊，或是進房屋以手靠牆，就被蛇咬。
english: As if a man, running away from a lion, came face to face with a bear; or went into the house and put his hand on the wall and got a bite from a snake.

chinese: 耶和華的日子不是黑暗沒有光明麼？不是幽暗毫無光輝麼？
english: Will not the day of the Lord be dark and not light? even very dark, with no light shining in it?

chinese: 我厭惡你們的節期，也不喜悅你們的嚴肅會。
english: Your feasts are disgusting to me, I will have nothing to do with them; I will take no delight in your holy meetings.

chinese: 你們雖然向我獻燔祭和素祭，我卻不悅納，也不顧你們用肥畜獻的平安祭；
english: Even if you give me your burned offerings and your meal offerings, I will not take pleasure in them: I will have nothing to do with the peace-offerings of your fat beasts.

chinese: 要使你們歌唱的聲音遠離我，因為我不聽你們彈琴的響聲。
english: Take away from me the noise of your songs; my ears are shut to the melody of your instruments.

chinese: 惟願公平如大水滾滾，使公義如江河滔滔。
english: But let the right go rolling on like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.

chinese: 以色列家啊，你們在曠野四十年，豈是將祭物和供物獻給我呢？
english: Did you come to me with offerings of beasts and meal offerings in the waste land for forty years, O Israel?

chinese: 你們抬著為自己所造之摩洛的帳幕和偶像的龕，並你們的神星。
english: Truly, you will take up Saccuth your king and Kaiwan your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.

chinese: 所以我要把你們擄到大馬色以外。這是耶和華、名為萬軍之神說的。
english: And I will send you away as prisoners farther than Damascus, says the Lord, whose name is the God of armies.

chinese: 國為列國之首，人最著名，且為以色列家所歸向，在錫安和撒瑪利亞山安逸無慮的，有禍了！
english: Sorrow to those who are resting in comfort in Zion, and to those who have no fear of danger in the mountain of Samaria, the noted men of the chief of the nations, to whom the people of Israel come!

chinese: 你們要過到甲尼察看，從那裡往大城哈馬去，又下到非利士人的迦特。看那些比你們的國還強嗎？境界比你們的境界還寬嗎？
english: Go on to Calneh and see; and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines: are you better than these kingdoms? or is your land wider than theirs?

chinese: 你們以為降禍的日子還遠，坐在位上盡行強暴（或譯：行強暴使審判臨近）。
english: You who put far away the evil day, causing the rule of the violent to come near;

chinese: 你們躺臥在象牙床上，舒身在榻上，吃群中的羊羔，棚裡的牛犢；
english: Who are resting on beds of ivory, stretched out on soft seats, feasting on lambs from the flock and young oxen from the cattle-house;

chinese: 彈琴鼓瑟，唱消閑的歌曲，為自己製造樂器，如同大衛所造的；
english: Making foolish songs to the sound of corded instruments, and designing for themselves instruments of music, like David;

chinese: 以大碗喝酒，用上等的油抹身，卻不為約瑟的苦難擔憂。
english: Drinking wine in basins, rubbing themselves with the best oils; but they have no grief for the destruction of Joseph.

chinese: 所以這些人必在被擄的人中首先被擄，舒身的人荒宴之樂必消滅了。
english: So now they will go away prisoners with the first of those who are made prisoners, and the loud cry of those who were stretched out will come to an end.

chinese: 主耶和華萬軍之神指著自己起誓說，我憎惡雅各的榮華，厭棄他的宮殿；因此我必將城和其中所有的都交付敵人。
english: The Lord God has taken an oath by himself, says the Lord, the God of armies: the pride of Jacob is disgusting to me, and I have hate for his great houses: so I will give up the town with everything in it.

chinese: 那時，若在一房之內剩下十個人，也都必死。
english: Then it will come about that if there are still ten men in a house, death will overtake them.

chinese: 死人的伯叔，就是燒他屍首的，要將這屍首搬到房外，問房屋內間的人說：你那裡還有人沒有？他必說：沒有；又說：，不要作聲，因為我們不可提耶和華的名。
english: And when a man's relation, even the one who is responsible for burning his body, lifting him up to take his bones out of the house, says to him who is in the inmost part of the house, Is there still anyone with you? and he says, No; then he will say, Keep quiet, for the name of the Lord may not be named.

chinese: 看哪，耶和華出令，大房就被攻破，小屋就被打裂。
english: For see, at the order of the Lord the great house will be full of cracks and the little house will be broken.

chinese: 馬豈能在崖石上奔跑？人豈能在那裡用牛耕種呢？你們卻使公平變為苦膽，使公義的果子變為茵蔯。
english: Is it possible for horses to go running on the rock? may the sea be ploughed with oxen? for the right to be turned by you into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into a bitter plant?

chinese: 你們喜愛虛浮的事，自誇說，我們不是憑自己的力量取了角麼？
english: You whose joy is in a thing of no value, who say, Have we not taken for ourselves horns by the strength which is ours?

chinese: 耶和華萬軍之神說：，以色列家阿，我必興起一國攻擊你們；他們必欺壓你們，從哈馬口直到亞拉巴的河。
english: For see, I will send against you a nation, O Israel, says the Lord, the God of armies, ruling you cruelly from the way into Hamath as far as the stream of the Arabah.

chinese: 主耶和華指示我一件事：為王割菜（或譯：草）之後，菜又發生；剛發生的時候，主造蝗蟲。
english: This is what the Lord God let me see: and I saw that, when the growth of the late grass was starting, he made locusts; it was the late growth after the king's cutting was done.

chinese: 蝗蟲吃盡那地的青物，我就說：主耶和華啊，求你赦免；因為雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？
english: And it came about that after they had taken all the grass of the land, I said, O Lord God, have mercy: how will Jacob be able to keep his place? for he is small.

chinese: 耶和華就後悔，說：這災可以免了。
english: The Lord, changing his purpose about this, said, It will not be.

chinese: 主耶和華又指示我一件事：他命火來懲罰以色列，火就吞滅深淵，險些將地燒滅。
english: This is what the Lord let me see: and I saw that the Lord God sent for a great fire to be the instrument of his punishment; and, after burning up the great deep, it was about to put an end to the Lord's heritage.

chinese: 我就說：主耶和華啊，求你止息；因為雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？
english: Then said I, O Lord God, let there be an end: how will Jacob be able to keep his place? for he is small.

chinese: 耶和華就後悔，說：這災也可免了。
english: The Lord, changing his purpose about this, said, And this will not be.

chinese: 他又指示我一件事：有一道牆是按準繩建築的，主手拿準繩站在其上。
english: This is what he let me see: and I saw the Lord stationed by a wall made straight by a weighted line, and he had a weighted line in his hand.

chinese: 耶和華對我說：阿摩司啊，你看見甚麼？我說：看見準繩。主說：我要吊起準繩在我民以色列中，我必不再寬恕他們。
english: And the Lord said to me, Amos, what do you see? And I said, A weighted line. Then the Lord said, See, I will let down a weighted line among my people Israel; never again will my eyes be shut to their sin:

chinese: 以撒的邱壇必然淒涼，以色列的聖所必然荒廢。我必興起，用刀攻擊耶羅波安的家。
english: And the high places of Isaac will be unpeopled, and the holy places of Israel will be made waste; and I will come up against the family of Jeroboam with the sword.

chinese: 伯特利的祭司亞瑪謝打發人到以色列王耶羅波安那裡，說：阿摩司在以色列家中圖謀背叛你；他所說的一切話，這國擔當不起；
english: Then Amaziah, the priest of Beth-el, sent to Jeroboam, king of Israel, saying, Amos has made designs against you among the people of Israel: the land is troubled by his words.

chinese: 因為阿摩司如此說：耶羅波安必被刀殺，以色列民定被擄去離開本地。
english: For Amos has said, Jeroboam will be put to the sword, and Israel will certainly be taken away as a prisoner out of his land.

chinese: 亞瑪謝又對阿摩司說：你這先見哪，要逃往猶大地去，在那裡糊口，在那裡說預言，
english: And Amaziah said to Amos, O seer, go in flight into the land of Judah, and there get your living by working as a prophet:

chinese: 卻不要在伯特利再說預言；因為這裡有王的聖所，有王的宮殿。
english: But be a prophet no longer at Beth-el: for it is the holy place of the king, and the king's house.

chinese: 阿摩司對亞瑪謝說：我原不是先知，也不是先知的門徒（原文是兒子）。我是牧人，又是修理桑樹的。
english: Then Amos in answer said to Amaziah, I am no prophet, or one of the sons of the prophets; I am a herdman and one who takes care of sycamore-trees:

chinese: 耶和華選召我，使我不跟從羊群，對我說：你去向我民以色列說預言。
english: And the Lord took me from the flock, and the Lord said to me, Go, be a prophet to my people Israel.

chinese: 亞瑪謝啊，現在你要聽耶和華的話。你說：不要向以色列說預言，也不要向以撒家滴下預言。
english: Now then, give ear to the word of the Lord: You say, Be no prophet to Israel, and say not a word against the people of Isaac.

chinese: 所以耶和華如此說：你的妻子必在城中作妓女，你的兒女必倒在刀下；你的地必有人用繩子量了分取，你自己必死在污穢之地。以色列民定被擄去離開本地。
english: So this is what the Lord has said: Your wife will be a loose woman in the town, and your sons and your daughters will be put to the sword, and your land will be cut up into parts by a line; and you yourself will come to your end in an unclean land, and Israel will certainly be taken away a prisoner out of his land.

chinese: 主耶和華又指示我一件事：我看見一筐夏天的果子。
english: This is what the Lord God let me see: and I saw a basket of summer fruit.

chinese: 他說：阿摩司啊，你看見甚麼？我說：看見一筐夏天的果子。耶和華說：我民以色列的結局到了，我必不再寬恕他們。
english: And he said, Amos, what do you see? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then the Lord said to me, The end has come to my people Israel; never again will my eyes be shut to their sin.

chinese: 主耶和華說：那日，殿中的詩歌變為哀號；必有許多屍首在各處拋棄，無人作聲。
english: And the songs of the king's house will be cries of pain in that day, says the Lord God: great will be the number of the dead bodies, and everywhere they will put them out without a word.

chinese: 你們這些要吞吃窮乏人、使困苦人衰敗的，當聽我的話！
english: Give ear to this, you who are crushing the poor, and whose purpose is to put an end to those who are in need in the land,

chinese: 你們說：月朔幾時過去，我們好賣糧；安息日幾時過去，我們好擺開麥子；賣出用小升斗，收銀用大戥子，用詭詐的天平欺哄人，
english: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, so that we may do trade in grain? and the Sabbath, so that we may put out in the market the produce of our fields? making the measure small and the price great, and trading falsely with scales of deceit;

chinese: 好用銀子買貧寒人，用一雙鞋換窮乏人，將壞了的麥子賣給人。
english: Getting the poor for silver, and him who is in need for the price of two shoes, and taking a price for the waste parts of the grain.

chinese: 耶和華指著雅各的榮耀起誓說：他們的一切行為，我必永遠不忘。
english: The Lord has taken an oath by the pride of Jacob, Truly I will ever keep in mind all their works.

chinese: 地豈不因這事震動？其上的居民不也悲哀嗎？地必全然像尼羅河漲起，如同埃及河湧上落下。
english: Will not the land be shaking with fear because of this, and everyone in it have sorrow? and all of it will be overflowing like the River; and it will be troubled and go down again like the River of Egypt.

chinese: 主耶和華說：到那日，我必使日頭在午間落下，使地在白晝黑暗。
english: And it will come about in that day, says the Lord God, that I will make the sun go down in the middle of the day, and I will make the earth dark in daylight:

chinese: 我必使你們的節期變為悲哀，歌曲變為哀歌。眾人腰束麻布，頭上光禿，使這場悲哀如喪獨生子，至終如痛苦的日子一樣。
english: Your feasts will be turned into sorrow and all your melody into songs of grief; everyone will be clothed with haircloth, and the hair of every head will be cut; I will make the weeping like that for an only son, and the end of it like a bitter day.

chinese: 主耶和華說：日子將到，我必命饑荒降在地上。人飢餓非因無餅，乾渴非因無水，乃因不聽耶和華的話。
english: See, the days are coming, says the Lord God, when I will send times of great need on the land, not need of food or desire for water, but for hearing the words of the Lord.

chinese: 他們必飄流，從這海到那海，從北邊到東邊，往來奔跑，尋求耶和華的話，卻尋不著。
english: And they will go wandering from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, running here and there in search of the word of the Lord, and they will not get it.

chinese: 當那日，美貌的處女和少年的男子必因乾渴發昏。
english: In that day the fair virgins and the young men will be feeble from need of water.

chinese: 那指著撒瑪利亞牛犢（原文是罪）起誓的說：但哪，我們指著你那裡的活神起誓；又說：我們指著別是巴的神道（神：原文是活）起誓。這些人都必仆倒，永不再起來。
english: Those who make their oaths by the sin of Samaria and say, By the life of your God, O Dan; and, By the living way of Beer-sheba; even they will go down, never again to be lifted up.

chinese: 我看見主站在祭壇旁邊；他說：你要擊打柱頂，使門檻震動，打碎柱頂，落在眾人頭上；所剩下的人，我必用刀殺戮，無一人能逃避，無一人能逃脫。
english: I saw the Lord stationed by the side of the altar, giving blows to the tops of the pillars so that the doorsteps were shaking: and he said, I will let all of them be broken with earth-shocks; I will put the last of them to the sword: if any one of them goes in flight he will not get away, not one of them will be safe.

chinese: 他們雖然挖透陰間，我的手必取出他們來；雖然爬上天去，我必拿下他們來；
english: Even if they go deep into the underworld, my hand will take them up from there; if they go up to heaven, I will get them down:

chinese: 雖然藏在迦密山頂，我必搜尋，捉出他們來；雖然從我眼前藏在海底，我必命蛇咬他們；
english: Though they take cover on the top of Carmel, I will go in search of them and get them out; though they keep themselves from my eyes in the bed of the sea, I will give orders to the great snake there and he will give them a bite:

chinese: 雖被仇敵擄去，我必命刀劍殺戮他們；我必向他們定住眼目，降禍不降福。
english: And though they are taken away as prisoners by their attackers, even there will I give orders to the sword to put them to death: my eyes will be fixed on them for evil and not for good.

chinese: 主─萬軍之耶和華摸地，地就消化，凡住在地上的都必悲哀。地必全然像尼羅河漲起，如同埃及河落下。
english: For the Lord, the God of armies, is he at whose touch the land is turned to water, and everyone in it will be given up to sorrow; all of it will be overflowing like the River, and will go down again like the River of Egypt;

chinese: 那在天上建造樓閣、在地上安定穹蒼、命海水澆在地上的─耶和華是他的名。
english: It is he who makes his rooms in the heaven, basing his arch on the earth; whose voice goes out to the waters of the sea, and sends them flowing over the face of the earth; the Lord is his name.

chinese: 耶和華說：以色列人哪，我豈不看你們如古實人嗎？我豈不是領以色列人出埃及地，領非利士人出迦斐託，領亞蘭人出吉珥嗎？
english: Are you not as the children of the Ethiopians to me, O children of Israel? says the Lord. Have I not taken Israel up out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Aramaeans from Kir?

chinese: 主耶和華的眼目察看這有罪的國，必將這國從地上滅絕，卻不將雅各家滅絕淨盡。這是耶和華說的。
english: See, the eyes of the Lord are on the evil kingdom, and I will put an end to it in all the earth; but I will not send complete destruction on Jacob, says the Lord.

chinese: 我必出令，將以色列家分散在列國中，好像用篩子篩穀，連一粒也不落在地上。
english: For see, I will give orders, and I will have Israel moved about among all the nations, as grain is moved about by the shaking of the tray, but not the smallest seed will be dropped on the earth.

chinese: 我民中的一切罪人說：災禍必追不上我們，也迎不著我們。他們必死在刀下。
english: All those sinners among my people will be put to the sword who say, Evil will not overtake us or come face to face with us.

chinese: 到那日，我必建立大衛倒塌的帳幕，堵住其中的破口，把那破壞的建立起來，重新修造，像古時一樣，
english: In that day I will put up the tent of David which has come down, and make good its broken places; and I will put up again his damaged walls, building it up as in the past;

chinese: 使以色列人得以東所餘剩的和所有稱為我名下的國。此乃行這事的耶和華說的。
english: So that the rest of Edom may be their heritage, and all the nations who have been named by my name, says the Lord, who is doing this.

chinese: 耶和華說：日子將到，耕種的必接續收割的；踹葡萄的必接續撒種的；大山要滴下甜酒；小山都必流奶（原文是消化，見約珥三章十八節）。
english: See, the days will come, says the Lord, when the ploughman will overtake him who is cutting the grain, and the crusher of the grapes him who is planting seed; and sweet wine will be dropping from the mountains, and the hills will be turned into streams of wine.

chinese: 我必使我民以色列被擄的歸回；他們必重修荒廢的城邑居住，栽種葡萄園，喝其中所出的酒，修造果木園，吃其中的果子。
english: And I will let the fate of my people Israel be changed, and they will be building up again the waste towns and living in them; they will again be planting vine-gardens and taking the wine for their drink; and they will make gardens and get the fruit of them.

chinese: 我要將他們栽於本地，他們不再從我所賜給他們的地上拔出來。這是耶和華─你的神說的。
english: And I will have them planted in their land, and never again will they be uprooted from their land which I have given them, says the Lord your God.

chinese: 俄巴底亞得了耶和華的默示。論以東說：我從耶和華那裡聽見信息，並有使者被差往列國去，說：起來罷，一同起來與以東爭戰！
english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord has said about Edom: We have had word from the Lord, and a representative has been sent among the nations, saying, Up! and let us make war against her.

chinese: 我使你─以東在列國中為最小的，被人大大藐視。
english: See, I have made you small among the nations: you are much looked down on.

chinese: 住在山穴中、居所在高處的啊，你因狂傲自欺，心裡說：誰能將我拉下地去呢？
english: You have been tricked by the pride of your heart, O you whose living-place is in the cracks of the rock, whose house is high up; who has said in his heart, Who will make me come down to earth?

chinese: 你雖如大鷹高飛，在星宿之間搭窩，我必從那裡拉下你來。這是耶和華說的。
english: Though you go up on high like an eagle, though your house is placed among the stars, I will make you come down from there, says the Lord.

chinese: 盜賊若來在你那裡，或強盜夜間而來─你何竟被剪除─豈不偷竊直到夠了呢？摘葡萄的若來到你那裡，豈不剩下些葡萄呢？
english: If thieves came, attacking you by night, (how are you cut off!) would they not go on taking till they had enough? if men came cutting your grapes would they take them all?

chinese: 以掃的隱密處何竟被搜尋？他隱藏的寶物何竟被查出？
english: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his secret stores looked for!

chinese: 與你結盟的都送你上路，直到交界；與你和好的欺騙你，且勝過你；與你一同吃飯的設下網羅陷害你；在你心裡毫無聰明。
english: All the men who were united with you have been false to you, driving you out to the edge of the land: the men who were at peace with you have overcome you; they have taken their heritage in your place.

chinese: 耶和華說：到那日，我豈不從以東除滅智慧人？從以掃山除滅聰明人？
english: Will I not, in that day, says the Lord, take away the wise men out of Edom, and wisdom out of the mountain of Esau?

chinese: 提幔哪，你的勇士必驚惶，甚至以掃山的人都被殺戮剪除。
english: And your men of war, O Teman, will be overcome with fear, so that every one of them may be cut off from the mountain of Esau.

chinese: 因你向兄弟雅各行強暴，羞愧必遮蓋你，你也必永遠斷絕。
english: Because you were the cause of violent death and because of your cruel behaviour to your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and will be cut off for ever.

chinese: 當外人擄掠雅各的財物，外邦人進入他的城門，為耶路撒冷拈鬮的日子，你竟站在一旁，像與他們同夥。
english: Because you were there watching when men from other lands took away his goods, and strange men came into his doors, and put the fate of Jerusalem to the decision of chance; you were like one of them.

chinese: 你兄弟遭難的日子，你不當瞪眼看著；猶大人被滅的日子，你不當因此歡樂；他們遭難的日子，你不當說狂傲的話。
english: Do not see with pleasure your brother's evil day, the day of his fate, and do not be glad over the children of Judah on the day of their destruction, or make wide your mouth on the day of trouble.

chinese: 我民遭災的日子，你不當進他們的城門；他們遭災的日子，你不當瞪眼看著他們受苦；他們遭災的日子，你不當伸手搶他們的財物；
english: Do not go into the doors of my people on the day of their downfall; do not be looking on their trouble with pleasure on the day of their downfall, or put your hands on their goods on the day of their downfall.

chinese: 你不當站在岔路口剪除他們中間逃脫的；他們遭難的日子，你不當將他們剩下的人交付仇敵。
english: And do not take your place at the cross-roads, cutting off those of his people who get away; and do not give up to their haters those who are still there in the day of trouble.

chinese: 耶和華降罰的日子臨近萬國。你怎樣行，他也必照樣向你行；你的報應必歸到你頭上。
english: For the day of the Lord is coming quickly on all nations: as you have done it will be done to you; the reward of your acts will come on your head.

chinese: 你們猶大人在我聖山怎樣喝了苦杯，萬國也必照樣常常地喝；且喝且咽，他們就歸於無有。
english: For as you have been drinking on my holy mountain, so will all the nations go on drinking without end; they will go on drinking and the wine will go down their throats, and they will be as if they had never been.

chinese: 在錫安山必有逃脫的人，那山也必成聖；雅各家必得原有的產業。
english: But in Mount Zion some will be kept safe, and it will be holy; and the children of Jacob will take their heritage.

chinese: 雅各家必成為大火；約瑟家必為火燄；以掃家必如碎秸；火必將他燒著吞滅。以掃家必無餘剩的。這是耶和華說的。
english: And the children of Jacob will be a fire and those of Joseph a flame, and the children of Esau dry stems of grass, burned up by them till all is gone: and there will be no people living in Esau; for the Lord has said it.

chinese: 南地的人必得以掃山；高原的人必得非利士地，也得以法蓮地和撒瑪利亞地；便雅憫人必得基列。
english: And they will take the South, and the lowland, and the country of Ephraim, and Gilead, as their heritage.

chinese: 在迦南人中被擄的以色列眾人必得地直到撒勒法；在西法拉中被擄的耶路撒冷人必得南地的城邑。
english: And those of the children of Israel who were the first to be taken away as prisoners, will have their heritage among the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and those who were taken away from Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will have the towns of the South.

chinese: 必有拯救者上到錫安山，審判以掃山；國度就歸耶和華了。
english: And those who have been kept safe will come up from Mount Zion to be judges of the mountain of Esau; and the kingdom will be the Lord's.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到亞米太的兒子約拿，說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to Jonah, the son of Amittai, saying,

chinese: 你起來往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民呼喊，因為他們的惡達到我面前。
english: Up! go to Nineveh, that great town, and let your voice come to it; for their evil-doing has come up before me.

chinese: 約拿卻起來，逃往他施去躲避耶和華；下到約帕，遇見一隻船，要往他施去。他就給了船價，上了船，要與船上的人同往他施去躲避耶和華。
english: And Jonah got up to go in flight to Tarshish, away from the Lord; and he went down to Joppa, and saw there a ship going to Tarshish: so he gave them the price of the journey and went down into it to go with them to Tarshish, away from the Lord.

chinese: 然而耶和華使海中起大風，海就狂風大作，甚至船幾乎破壞。
english: And the Lord sent out a great wind on to the sea and there was a violent storm in the sea, so that the ship seemed in danger of being broken.

chinese: 水手便懼怕，各人哀求自己的神。他們將船上的貨物拋在海中，為要使船輕些。約拿已下到底艙，躺臥沉睡。
english: Then the sailors were full of fear, every man crying to his god; and the goods in the ship were dropped out into the sea to make the weight less. But Jonah had gone down into the inmost part of the ship where he was stretched out in a deep sleep.

chinese: 船主到他那裡對他說：你這沉睡的人哪，為何這樣呢？起來，求告你的神，或者　神顧念我們，使我們不致滅亡。
english: And the ship's captain came to him and said to him, What are you doing sleeping? Up! say a prayer to your God, if by chance God will give a thought to us, so that we may not come to destruction.

chinese: 船上的人彼此說：來吧，我們掣籤，看看這災臨到我們是因誰的緣故。於是他們掣籤，掣出約拿來。
english: And they said to one another, Come, let us put this to the decision of chance and see on whose account this evil has come on us. So they did so, and Jonah was seen to be the man.

chinese: 眾人對他說：請你告訴我們，這災臨到我們是因誰的緣故？你以何事為業？你從哪裡來？你是哪一國？屬哪一族的人？
english: Then they said to him, Now make clear to us what is your work, and where you come from? what is your country, and who are your people?

chinese: 他說：我是希伯來人。我敬畏耶和華─那創造滄海旱地之天上的神。
english: And he said to them, I am a Hebrew, a worshipper of the Lord, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.

chinese: 他們就大大懼怕，對他說：你做的是甚麼事呢？他們已經知道他躲避耶和華，因為他告訴了他們。
english: And the men were in great fear, and they said to him, What is this you have done? For the men had knowledge of his flight from the Lord because he had not kept it from them.

chinese: 他們問他說：我們當向你怎樣行，使海浪平靜呢？這話是因海浪越發翻騰。
english: And they said to him, What are we to do to you so that the sea may become calm for us? For the sea was getting rougher and rougher.

chinese: 他對他們說：你們將我抬起來，拋在海中，海就平靜了；我知道你們遭這大風是因我的緣故。
english: And he said to them, Take me up and put me into the sea, and the sea will become calm for you: for I am certain that because of me this great storm has come on you.

chinese: 然而那些人竭力盪槳，要把船攏岸，卻是不能，因為海浪越發向他們翻騰。
english: And the men were working hard to get back to the land, but they were not able to do so: for the sea got rougher and rougher against them.

chinese: 他們便求告耶和華說：耶和華啊，我們懇求你，不要因這人的性命使我們死亡，不要使流無辜血的罪歸與我們；因為你─耶和華是隨自己的意旨行事。
english: So, crying to the Lord, they said, Give ear to our prayer, O Lord, give ear, and do not let destruction overtake us because of this man's life; do not put on us the sin of taking life without cause: for you, O Lord, have done what seemed good to you.

chinese: 他們遂將約拿抬起，拋在海中，海的狂浪就平息了。
english: So they took Jonah up and put him into the sea: and the sea was no longer angry.

chinese: 那些人便大大敬畏耶和華，向耶和華獻祭，並且許願。
english: Then great was the men's fear of the Lord; and they made an offering to the Lord and took oaths to him.

chinese: 耶和華安排一條大魚吞了約拿，他在魚腹中三日三夜。
english: And the Lord made ready a great fish to take Jonah into its mouth; and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.

chinese: 約拿在魚腹中禱告耶和華─他的神，
english: Then Jonah made prayer to the Lord his God from the inside of the fish, and said,

chinese: 說：我遭遇患難求告耶和華，你就應允我；從陰間的深處呼求，你就俯聽我的聲音。
english: In my trouble I was crying to the Lord, and he gave me an answer; out of the deepest underworld I sent up a cry, and you gave ear to my voice.

chinese: 你將我投下深淵，就是海的深處；大水環繞我，你的波浪洪濤都漫過我身。
english: For you have put me down into the deep, into the heart of the sea; and the river was round about me; all your waves and your rolling waters went over me.

chinese: 我說：我從你眼前雖被驅逐，我仍要仰望你的聖殿。
english: And I said, I have been sent away from before your eyes; how may I ever again see your holy Temple?

chinese: 諸水環繞我，幾乎淹沒我；深淵圍住我；海草纏繞我的頭。
english: The waters were circling round me, even to the neck; the deep was about me; the sea-grass was twisted round my head.

chinese: 我下到山根，地的門將我永遠關住。耶和華─我的神啊，你卻將我的性命從坑中救出來。
english: I went down to the bases of the mountains; as for the earth, her walls were about me for ever: but you have taken up my life from the underworld, O Lord my God.

chinese: 我心在我裡面發昏的時候，我就想念耶和華。我的禱告進入你的聖殿，達到你的面前。
english: When my soul in me was overcome, I kept the memory of the Lord: and my prayer came in to you, into your holy Temple.

chinese: 那信奉虛無之神的人，離棄憐愛他們的主；
english: The worshippers of false gods have given up their only hope.

chinese: 但我必用感謝的聲音獻祭與你。我所許的願，我必償還。救恩出於耶和華。
english: But I will make an offering to you with the voice of praise; I will give effect to my oaths. Salvation is the Lord's.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐魚，魚就把約拿吐在旱地上。
english: And at the Lord's order, the fish sent Jonah out of its mouth on to the dry land.

chinese: 耶和華的話二次臨到約拿說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to Jonah a second time, saying,

chinese: 你起來！往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的話。
english: Up! go to Nineveh, that great town, and give it the word which I have given you.

chinese: 約拿便照耶和華的話起來，往尼尼微去。這尼尼微是極大的城，有三日的路程。
english: So Jonah got up and went to Nineveh as the Lord had said. Now Nineveh was a very great town, three days' journey from end to end.

chinese: 約拿進城走了一日，宣告說：再等四十日，尼尼微必傾覆了！
english: And Jonah first of all went a day's journey into the town, and crying out said, In forty days destruction will overtake Nineveh.

chinese: 尼尼微人信服神，便宣告禁食，從最大的到至小的都穿麻衣（或譯：披上麻布）。
english: And the people of Nineveh had belief in God; and a time was fixed for going without food, and they put on haircloth, from the greatest to the least.

chinese: 這信息傳到尼尼微王的耳中，他就下了寶座，脫下朝服，披上麻布，坐在灰中。
english: And the word came to the king of Nineveh, and he got up from his seat of authority, and took off his robe, and covering himself with haircloth, took his seat in the dust.

chinese: 他又使人遍告尼尼微通城，說：王和大臣有令，人不可嘗甚麼，牲畜、牛羊不可吃草，也不可喝水。
english: And he had it given out in Nineveh, By the order of the king and his great men, no man or beast, herd or flock, is to have a taste of anything; let them have no food or water:

chinese: 人與牲畜都當披上麻布；人要切切求告神。各人回頭離開所行的惡道，丟棄手中的強暴。
english: And let man and beast be covered with haircloth, and let them make strong prayers to God: and let everyone be turned from his evil way and the violent acts of their hands.

chinese: 或者神轉意後悔，不發烈怒，使我們不致滅亡，也未可知。
english: Who may say that God will not be turned, changing his purpose and turning away from his burning wrath, so that destruction may not overtake us?

chinese: 於是神察看他們的行為，見他們離開惡道，他就後悔，不把所說的災禍降與他們了。
english: And God saw what they did, how they were turned from their evil way; and God's purpose was changed as to the evil which he said he would do to them, and he did it not.

chinese: 這事約拿大大不悅，且甚發怒，
english: But this seemed very wrong to Jonah, and he was angry.

chinese: 就禱告耶和華說：耶和華啊，我在本國的時候，豈不是這樣說嗎？我知道你是有恩典、有憐憫的神，不輕易發怒，有豐盛的慈愛，並且後悔不降所說的災，所以我急速逃往他施去。
english: And he made prayer to the Lord and said, O Lord, is this not what I said when I was still in my country? This is why I took care to go in flight to Tarshish: for I was certain that you were a loving God, full of pity, slow to be angry and great in mercy, and ready to be turned from your purpose of evil.

chinese: 耶和華啊，現在求你取我的命吧！因為我死了比活著還好。
english: So now, O Lord, give ear to my prayer and take my life from me; for death is better for me than life.

chinese: 耶和華說：你這樣發怒合乎理嗎？
english: And the Lord said, Have you any right to be angry?

chinese: 於是約拿出城，坐在城的東邊，在那裡為自己搭了一座棚，坐在棚的蔭下，要看看那城究竟如何。
english: Then Jonah went out of the town, and took his seat on the east side of the town and made himself a roof of branches and took his seat under its shade till he saw what would become of the town.

chinese: 耶和華神安排一棵蓖麻，使其發生高過約拿，影兒遮蓋他的頭，救他脫離苦楚；約拿因這棵蓖麻大大喜樂。
english: And the Lord God made a vine come up over Jonah to give him shade over his head. And Jonah was very glad because of the vine.

chinese: 次日黎明，神卻安排一條蟲子咬這蓖麻，以致枯槁。
english: But early on the morning after, God made ready a worm for the destruction of the vine, and it became dry and dead.

chinese: 日頭出來的時候，神安排炎熱的東風，日頭曝曬約拿的頭，使他發昏，他就為自己求死，說：我死了比活著還好！
english: Then when the sun came up, God sent a burning east wind: and so great was the heat of the sun on his head that Jonah was overcome, and, requesting death for himself, said, Death is better for me than life.

chinese: 神對約拿說：你因這棵蓖麻發怒合乎理嗎？他說：我發怒以至於死，都合乎理！
english: And the Lord said to Jonah, Have you any right to be angry about the vine? And he said, I have a right to be truly angry.

chinese: 耶和華說：這蓖麻，不是你栽種的，也不是你培養的；一夜發生，一夜乾死，你尚且愛惜；
english: And the Lord said, You had pity on the vine, for which you did no work and for the growth of which you were not responsible; which came up in a night and came to an end in a night;

chinese: 何況這尼尼微大城，其中不能分辨左手右手的有十二萬多人，並有許多牲畜，我豈能不愛惜呢？
english: And am I not to have mercy on Nineveh, that great town, in which there are more than a hundred and twenty thousand persons without the power of judging between right and left, as well as much cattle?

chinese: 當猶大王約坦、亞哈斯、希西家在位的時候，摩利沙人彌迦得耶和華的默示，論撒瑪利亞和耶路撒冷。
english: The word of the Lord which came to Micah the Morashtite, in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah: his vision about Samaria and Jerusalem.

chinese: 萬民哪，你們都要聽！地和其上所有的，也都要側耳而聽！主耶和華從他的聖殿要見證你們的不是。
english: Give ear, you peoples, all of you; give attention, O earth and everything in it: let the Lord God be witness against you, the Lord from his holy Temple.

chinese: 看哪，耶和華出了他的居所，降臨步行地的高處。
english: For see, the Lord is coming out from his place, and will come down, stepping on the high places of the earth.

chinese: 眾山在他以下必消化，諸谷必崩裂，如蠟化在火中，如水沖下山坡。
english: And the mountains will be turned to water under him, and the deep valleys will be broken open, like wax before the fire, like waters flowing down a slope.

chinese: 這都因雅各的罪過，以色列家的罪惡。雅各的罪過在哪裡呢？豈不是在撒瑪利亞麼？猶大的邱壇在哪裡呢？豈不是在耶路撒冷麼？
english: All this is because of the wrongdoing of Jacob and the sins of the children of Israel. What is the wrongdoing of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?

chinese: 所以我必使撒瑪利亞變為田野的亂堆，又作為種葡萄之處；也必將她的石頭倒在谷中，露出根基來。
english: So I will make Samaria into a field and the plantings of a vine-garden: I will send its stones falling down into the valley, uncovering its bases.

chinese: 她一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎；她所得的財物必被火燒；所有的偶像我必毀滅；因為是從妓女雇價所聚來的，後必歸為妓女的雇價。
english: And all her pictured images will be hammered into bits, and all the payments for her loose ways will be burned with fire, and all the images of her gods I will make waste: for with the price of a loose woman she got them together, and as the price of a loose woman will they be given back.

chinese: 先知說：因此我必大聲哀號，赤腳露體而行；又要呼號如野狗，哀鳴如鴕鳥。
english: For this I will be full of sorrow and give cries of grief; I will go uncovered and unclothed: I will give cries of grief like the jackals and will be in sorrow like the ostriches.

chinese: 因為撒瑪利亞的傷痕無法醫治，延及猶大和耶路撒冷我民的城門。
english: For her wounds may not be made well: for it has come even to Judah, stretching up to the doorway of my people, even to Jerusalem.

chinese: 不要在迦特報告這事，總不要哭泣；我在伯亞弗拉滾於灰塵之中。
english: Give no word of it in Gath, let there be no weeping at all: at Beth-le-aphrah be rolling in the dust.

chinese: 沙斐的居民哪，你們要赤身蒙羞過去。撒南的居民不敢出來。伯以薛人的哀哭使你們無處可站。
english: Be uncovered and go away, you who are living in Shaphir: the one living in Zaanan has not come out of her town; Beth-ezel is taken away from its base, even from its resting-place.

chinese: 瑪律的居民心甚憂急，切望得好處，因為災禍從耶和華那裡臨到耶路撒冷的城門。
english: For the one living in Maroth is waiting for good: for evil has come down from the Lord to the doorways of Jerusalem.

chinese: 拉吉的居民哪，要用快馬套車；錫安民（原文是女子）的罪由你而起；以色列人的罪過在你那裡顯出。
english: Let the war-carriage be yoked to the quick-running horse, you who are living in Lachish: she was the first cause of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the wrongdoings of Israel were seen in you.

chinese: 猶大啊，你要將禮物送給摩利設迦特。亞革悉的眾族必用詭詐待以色列諸王。
english: For this cause give a parting offering to Moresheth-gath: the daughter of Achzib will be a deceit to the king of Israel.

chinese: 瑪利沙的居民哪，我必使那奪取你的來到你這裡；以色列的尊貴人（原文是榮耀）必到亞杜蘭。
english: Even now will the taker of your heritage come to you, you who are living in Mareshah: the glory of Israel will come to destruction for ever.

chinese: 猶大啊，要為你所喜愛的兒女剪除你的頭髮，使頭光禿，要大大地光禿，如同禿鷹，因為他們都被擄去離開你。
english: Let your head be uncovered and your hair cut off in sorrow for the children of your delight: let the hair be pulled from your head like an eagle's; for they have been taken away from you as prisoners.

chinese: 禍哉，那些在床上圖謀罪孽、造作奸惡的！天一發亮，因手有能力就行出來了。
