english: A curse on the designers of evil, working on their beds! in the morning light they do it, because it is in their power.

chinese: 他們貪圖田地就佔據，貪圖房屋便奪取；他們欺壓人，霸佔房屋和產業。
english: They have a desire for fields and take them by force; and for houses and take them away: they are cruel to a man and his family, even to a man and his heritage.

chinese: 所以耶和華如此說：我籌劃災禍降與這族；這禍在你們的頸項上不能解脫；你們也不能昂首而行，因為這時勢是惡的。
english: For this cause the Lord has said, See, against this family I am purposing an evil from which you will not be able to take your necks away, and you will be weighted down by it; for it is an evil time.

chinese: 到那日，必有人向你們提起悲慘的哀歌，譏刺說：我們全然敗落了！耶和華將我們的分轉歸別人，何竟使這分離開我們？他將我們的田地分給悖逆的人。
english: In that day this saying will be said about you, and this song of grief will be made: The heritage of my people is measured out, and there is no one to give it back; those who have made us prisoners have taken our fields from us, and complete destruction has come to us.

chinese: 所以在耶和華的會中，你必沒有人拈鬮拉準繩。
english: For this cause you will have no one to make the decision by the measuring line in the meeting of the Lord.

chinese: 他們（或譯：假先知）說：你們不可說預言；不可向這些人說預言，不住地羞辱我們。
english: Let not words like these be dropped, they say: Shame and the curse will not come to the family of Jacob!

chinese: 雅各家啊，豈可說耶和華的心不忍耐麼（或譯：心腸狹窄麼）？這些事是他所行的麼？我─耶和華的言語豈不是與行動正直的人有益麼？
english: Is the Lord quickly made angry? are these his doings? do not his words do good to his people Israel?

chinese: 然而，近來我的民興起如仇敵，從那些安然經過不願打仗之人身上剝去外衣。
english: As for you, you have become haters of those who were at peace with you: you take the clothing of those who go by without fear, and make them prisoners of war.

chinese: 你們將我民中的婦人從安樂家中趕出，又將我的榮耀從她們的小孩子盡行奪去。
english: The women of my people you have been driving away from their dearly loved children; from their young ones you are taking my glory for ever.

chinese: 你們起來去罷！這不是你們安息之所；因為污穢使人（或譯：地）毀滅，而且大大毀滅。
english: Up! and go; for this is not your rest: because it has been made unclean, the destruction ordered will come on you.

chinese: 若有人心存虛假，用謊言說：我要向你們預言得清酒和濃酒。那人就必作這民的先知。
english: If a man came with a false spirit of deceit, saying, I will be a prophet to you of wine and strong drink: he would be the sort of prophet for this people.

chinese: 雅各家啊，我必要聚集你們，必要招聚以色列剩下的人，安置在一處，如波斯拉的羊，又如草場上的羊群；因為人數眾多就必大大喧嘩。
english: I will certainly make all of you, O Jacob, come together; I will get together the rest of Israel; I will put them together like the sheep in their circle: like a flock in their green field; they will be full of the noise of men.

chinese: 開路的（或譯：破城的）在他們前面上去；他們直闖過城門，從城門出去。他們的王在前面行；耶和華引導他們。
english: The opener of the way will go up before them: forcing their way out they will go on to the doorway and out through it: their king will go on before them, and the Lord at their head.

chinese: 我說：雅各的首領，以色列家的官長啊，你們要聽！你們不當知道公平麼？
english: And I said, Give ear, now, you heads of Jacob and rulers of the people of Israel: is it not for you to have knowledge of what is right?

chinese: 你們惡善好惡，從人身上剝皮，從人骨頭上剔肉，
english: You who are haters of good and lovers of evil, pulling off their skin from them and their flesh from their bones;

chinese: 吃我民的肉，剝他們的皮，打折他們的骨頭，分成塊子像要下鍋，又像釜中的肉。
english: Like meat they take the flesh of my people for their food, skinning them and crushing their bones, yes, cutting them up as if for the pot, like flesh inside the cooking-pot.

chinese: 到了遭災的時候，這些人必哀求耶和華，他卻不應允他們。那時他必照他們所行的惡事向他們掩面。
english: Then they will be crying to the Lord for help, but he will not give them an answer: yes, he will keep his face veiled from them at that time, because their acts have been evil.

chinese: 論到使我民走差路的先知─他們牙齒有所嚼的，他們就呼喊說：平安了！凡不供給他們吃的，他們就預備攻擊他（預備攻擊他：或譯說必遭遇刀兵）─耶和華如此說：
english: This is what the Lord has said about the prophets by whom my people have been turned from the right way; who, biting with their teeth, say, Peace; and if anyone puts nothing in their mouths they make ready for war against him.

chinese: 你們必遭遇黑夜，以致不見異象；又必遭遇幽暗，以致不能占卜。日頭必向你們沉落，白晝變為黑暗。
english: For this cause it will be night for you, without a vision; and it will be dark for you, without knowledge of the future; the sun will go down over the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

chinese: 先見必抱愧，占卜的必蒙羞，都必摀著嘴唇，因為神不應允他們。
english: And the seers will be shamed, and the readers of the future will be at a loss, all of them covering their lips; for there is no answer from God.

chinese: 至於我，我藉耶和華的靈，滿有力量、公平、才能，可以向雅各說明他的過犯，向以色列指出他的罪惡。
english: But I truly am full of the spirit of the Lord, with power of judging and with strength to make clear to Jacob his wrongdoing and to Israel his sin.

chinese: 雅各家的首領、以色列家的官長啊，當聽我的話！你們厭惡公平，在一切事上屈枉正直；
english: Then give ear to this, you heads of the children of Jacob, you rulers of the children of Israel, hating what is right, twisting what is straight.

chinese: 以人血建立錫安，以罪孽建造耶路撒冷。
english: They are building up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with evil-doing.

chinese: 首領為賄賂行審判；祭司為雇價施訓誨；先知為銀錢行占卜。他們卻倚賴耶和華，說：耶和華不是在我們中間麼？災禍必不臨到我們。
english: Its heads take rewards for judging, and the priests take payment for teaching, and the prophets get silver for reading the future: but still, supporting themselves on the Lord, they say, Is not the Lord among us? no evil will overtake us.

chinese: 所以因你們的緣故，錫安必被耕種像一塊田，耶路撒冷必變為亂堆；這殿的山必像叢林的高處。
english: For this reason, Zion will be ploughed like a field because of you, and Jerusalem will become a mass of broken walls, and the mountain of the house like a high place in the woods.

chinese: 末後的日子，耶和華殿的山必堅立，超乎諸山，高舉過於萬嶺；萬民都要流歸這山。
english: But in the last days it will come about that the mountain of the Lord's house will be placed on the top of the mountains, and be lifted up over the hills; and peoples will be flowing to it.

chinese: 必有許多國的民前往，說：來吧，我們登耶和華的山，奔雅各神的殿。主必將他的道教訓我們；我們也要行他的路。因為訓誨必出於錫安；耶和華的言語必出於耶路撒冷。
english: And a number of nations will go and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will give us knowledge of his ways and we will be guided by his word: for from Zion the law will go out, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

chinese: 他必在多國的民中施行審判，為遠方強盛的國斷定是非。他們要將刀打成犁頭，把槍打成鐮刀。這國不舉刀攻擊那國；他們也不再學習戰事。
english: And he will be judge between great peoples, and strong nations far away will be ruled by his decisions; their swords will be hammered into plough-blades and their spears into vine-knives: nations will no longer be lifting up their swords against one another, and knowledge of war will have gone for ever.

chinese: 人人都要坐在自己葡萄樹下和無花果樹下，無人驚嚇。這是萬軍之耶和華親口說的。
english: But every man will be seated under his vine and under his fig-tree, and no one will be a cause of fear to them: for the mouth of the Lord of armies has said it.

chinese: 萬民各奉己神的名而行；我們卻永永遠遠奉耶和華─我們　神的名而行。
english: For all the peoples will be walking, every one in the name of his god, and we will be walking in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.

chinese: 耶和華說：到那日，我必聚集瘸腿的，招聚被趕出的和我所懲治的。
english: In that day, says the Lord, I will get together her who goes with uncertain steps, I will get together her who has been sent away, and her on whom I have sent evil;

chinese: 我必使瘸腿的為餘剩之民，使趕到遠方的為強盛之民。耶和華要在錫安山作王治理他們，從今直到永遠。
english: And I will make her whose steps were uncertain a small band, and her who was feeble a strong nation: and the Lord will be their King in Mount Zion from now and for ever.

chinese: 你這羊群的高臺、錫安城（原文是女子）的山哪，，從前的權柄─就是耶路撒冷民（原文是女子）的國權─必歸與你。
english: And you, O tower of the flock, Ophel of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come, even the earlier authority, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

chinese: 現在你為何大聲哭號呢？疼痛抓住你彷彿產難的婦人，是因你中間沒有君王麼？你的謀士滅亡了麼？
english: Now why are you crying so loudly? is there no king in you? has destruction come on your wise helper? so that pains have taken you like the pains of a woman in childbirth:

chinese: 錫安的民（原文是女子）哪，你要疼痛劬勞，彷彿產難的婦人；因為你必從城裡出來，住在田野，到巴比倫去。在那裡要蒙解救；在那裡耶和華必救贖你脫離仇敵的手。
english: Be in pain, make sounds of grief, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in childbirth: for now you will go out of the town, living in the open country, and will come even to Babylon; there you will have salvation; there the Lord will make you free from the hands of your haters.

chinese: 現在有許多國的民聚集攻擊你，說：願錫安被玷污！願我們親眼見他遭報！
english: And now a number of nations have come together against you, and they say, Let her be made unclean and let our eyes see the fate of Zion.

chinese: 他們卻不知道耶和華的意念，也不明白他的籌劃。他聚集他們，好像把禾捆聚到禾場一樣。
english: But they have no knowledge of the thoughts of the Lord, their minds are not able to see his purpose: for he has got them together like stems of grain to the crushing-floor.

chinese: 錫安的民（原文作女子）哪，起來踹穀罷！我必使你的角成為鐵，使你的蹄成為銅。你必打碎多國的民，將他們的財獻與耶和華，將他們的貨獻與普天下的主。
english: Up! and let the grain be crushed, O daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron and your feet brass, and a number of peoples will be broken by you, and you will give up their increase to the Lord and their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.

chinese: 成群的民（原文是女子）哪，現在你要聚集成隊；因為仇敵圍攻我們，要用杖擊打以色列審判者的臉。
english: Now you will give yourselves deep wounds for grief; they will put up a wall round us: they will give the judge of Israel a blow on the face with a rod.

chinese: 伯利恆、以法他啊，你在猶大諸城中為小，將來必有一位從你那裡出來，在以色列中為我作掌權的；他的根源從亙古，從太初就有。
english: And you, Beth-lehem Ephrathah, the least among the families of Judah, out of you one will come to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose going out has been purposed from time past, from the eternal days.

chinese: 耶和華必將以色列人交付敵人，直等那生產的婦人生下子來。那時掌權者（原文是他）其餘的弟兄必歸到以色列人那裡。
english: For this cause he will give them up till the time when she who is with child has given birth: then the rest of his brothers will come back to the children of Israel.

chinese: 他必起來，倚靠耶和華的大能，並耶和華─他神之名的威嚴，牧養他的羊群。他們要安然居住；因為他必日見尊大，直到地極。
english: And he will take his place and give food to his flock in the strength of the Lord, in the glory of the name of the Lord his God; and their resting-place will be safe: for now he will be great to the ends of the earth.

chinese: 這位必作我們的平安。當亞述人進入我們的地境，踐踏宮殿的時候，我們就立起七個牧者，八個首領攻擊他。
english: And this will be our peace: when the Assyrian comes into our country and his feet are in our land, then we will put up against him seven keepers of the flocks and eight chiefs among men.

chinese: 他們必用刀劍毀壞亞述地和寧錄地的關口。亞述人進入我們的地境踐踏的時候，他必拯救我們。
english: And they will make waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod with the edge of the sword: he will give us salvation from the Assyrian when he comes into our country, when his feet come inside the limit of our land.

chinese: 雅各餘剩的人必在多國的民中，如從耶和華那裡降下的露水，又如甘霖降在草上；不仗賴人力，也不等候世人之功。
english: And the rest of Jacob will be among the mass of peoples like dew from the Lord, like showers on the grass, which may not be kept back by man, or be waiting for the sons of men.

chinese: 雅各餘剩的人必在多國多民中，如林間百獸中的獅子，又如少壯獅子在羊群中。他若經過就必踐踏撕裂，無人搭救。
english: And the rest of Jacob will be among the nations, in the middle of the mass of peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the woods, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep: if he goes through, they will be crushed under foot and pulled to bits, and there will be no saviour.

chinese: 願你的手舉起，高過敵人！願你的仇敵都被剪除！
english: Your hand is lifted up against those who are against you, and all your haters will be cut off.

chinese: 耶和華說：到那日，我必從你中間剪除馬匹，毀壞車輛，
english: And it will come about in that day, says the Lord, that I will take away your horses from you, and will give your war-carriages to destruction:

chinese: 也必從你國中除滅城邑，拆毀一切的保障，
english: I will have the towns of your land cut off and all your strong places pulled down:

chinese: 又必除掉你手中的邪術；你那裡也不再有占卜的。
english: I will put an end to your use of secret arts, and you will have no more readers of signs:

chinese: 我必從你中間除滅雕刻的偶像和柱像，你就不再跪拜自己手所造的。
english: And I will have your images and your pillars cut off from you; and you will no longer give worship to the work of your hands.

chinese: 我必從你中間拔出木偶，又毀滅你的城邑。
english: I will have your Asherahs pulled up from among you: and I will send destruction on your images.

chinese: 我也必在怒氣和忿怒中向那不聽從的列國施報。
english: And my punishment will be effected on the nations with such burning wrath as they have not had word of.

chinese: 以色列人哪，當聽耶和華的話！要起來向山嶺爭辯，使岡陵聽你的話。
english: Give ear now to the words of the Lord: Up! put forward your cause before the mountains, let your voice be sounding among the hills.

chinese: 山嶺和地永久的根基啊，要聽耶和華爭辯的話！因為耶和華要與他的百姓爭辯，與以色列爭論。
english: Give ear, O you mountains, to the Lord's cause, and take note, you bases of the earth: for the Lord has a cause against his people, and he will take it up with Israel.

chinese: 我的百姓啊，我向你做了甚麼呢？我在甚麼事上使你厭煩？你可以對我證明。
english: O my people, what have I done to you? how have I been a weariness to you? give answer against me.

chinese: 我曾將你從埃及地領出來，從作奴僕之家救贖你；我也差遣摩西、亞倫，和米利暗在你前面行。
english: For I took you up out of the land of Egypt and made you free from the prison-house; I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

chinese: 我的百姓啊，你們當追念摩押王巴勒所設的謀和比珥的兒子巴蘭回答他的話，並你們從什亭到吉甲所遇見的事，好使你們知道耶和華公義的作為。
english: O my people, keep in mind now what was designed by Balak, king of Moab, and the answer which Balaam, son of Beor, gave him; the events, from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may be certain of the upright acts of the Lord.

chinese: 我朝見耶和華，在至高神面前跪拜，當獻上甚麼呢？豈可獻一歲的牛犢為燔祭麼？
english: With what am I to come before the Lord and go with bent head before the high God? am I to come before him with burned offerings, with young oxen a year old?

chinese: 耶和華豈喜悅千千的公羊，或是萬萬的油河麼？我豈可為自己的罪過獻我的長子麼？為心中的罪惡獻我身所生的麼？
english: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of sheep or with ten thousand rivers of oil? am I to give my first child for my wrongdoing, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

chinese: 世人哪，耶和華已指示你何為善。他向你所要的是甚麼呢？只要你行公義，好憐憫，存謙卑的心，與你的神同行。
english: He has made clear to you, O man, what is good; and what is desired from you by the Lord; only doing what is right, and loving mercy, and walking without pride before your God.

chinese: 耶和華向這城呼叫，智慧人必敬畏他的名。你們當聽是誰派定刑杖的懲罰。
english: The voice of the Lord is crying out to the town: Give ear, you tribes and the meeting of the town.

chinese: 惡人家中不仍有非義之財和可惡的小升斗麼？
english: Am I to let the stores of the evil-doer go out of my memory, and the short measure, which is cursed?

chinese: 我若用不公道的天平和囊中詭詐的法碼，豈可算為清潔呢？
english: Is it possible for me to let wrong scales and the bag of false weights go without punishment?

chinese: 城裡的富戶滿行強暴；其中的居民也說謊言，口中的舌頭是詭詐的。
english: For its men of wealth are cruel, and its people have said what is not true, and their tongue is false in their mouth.

chinese: 因此，我擊打你，使你的傷痕甚重，使你因你的罪惡荒涼。
english: So I have made a start with your punishment; I have made you waste because of your sins.

chinese: 你要吃，卻吃不飽；你的虛弱必顯在你中間。你必挪去，卻不得救護；所救護的，我必交給刀劍。
english: You will have food, but not enough; your shame will be ever with you: you will get your goods moved, but you will not take them away safely; and what you do take away I will give to the sword.

chinese: 你必撒種，卻不得收割；踹橄欖，卻不得油抹身；踹葡萄，卻不得酒喝。
english: You will put in seed, but you will not get in the grain; you will be crushing olives, but your bodies will not be rubbed with the oil; and you will get in the grapes, but you will have no wine.

chinese: 因為你守暗利的惡規，行亞哈家一切所行的，順從他們的計謀；因此，我必使你荒涼，使你的居民令人嗤笑，你們也必擔當我民的羞辱。
english: For you have kept the laws of Omri and all the works of the family of Ahab, and you have been guided by their designs: so that I might make you a cause of wonder and your people a cause of hisses; and the shame of my people will be on you.

chinese: 哀哉！我（或譯：以色列）好像夏天的果子已被收盡，又像摘了葡萄所剩下的，沒有一掛可吃的；我心羨慕初熟的無花果。
english: Sorrow is mine! for I am as when they have got in the summer fruits, like the last of the grapes: there is nothing for food, not even an early fig for my desire.

chinese: 地上虔誠人滅盡；世間沒有正直人；各人埋伏，要殺人流血，都用網羅獵取弟兄。
english: The good man is gone from the earth, there is no one upright among men: they are all waiting secretly for blood, every man is going after his brother with a net.

chinese: 他們雙手作惡；君王徇情面，審判官要賄賂；位分大的吐出惡意，都彼此結聯行惡。
english: Their hands are made ready to do evil; the ruler makes requests for money, and the judge is looking for a reward; and the great man gives decisions at his pleasure, and the right is twisted.

chinese: 他們最好的，不過是蒺藜；最正直的，不過是荊棘籬笆。你守望者說，降罰的日子已經來到。他們必擾亂不安。
english: The best of them is like a waste plant, and their upright ones are like a wall of thorns. Sorrow! the day of their fate has come; now will trouble come on them.

chinese: 不要倚賴鄰舍；不要信靠密友。要守住你的口；不要向你懷中的妻提說。
english: Put no faith in a friend, do not let your hope be placed in a relation: keep watch on the doors of your mouth against her who is resting on your breast.

chinese: 因為，兒子藐視父親；女兒抗拒母親；媳婦抗拒婆婆；人的仇敵就是自己家裡的人。
english: For the son puts shame on his father, the daughter goes against her mother and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; and a man's haters are those of his family.

chinese: 至於我，我要仰望耶和華，要等候那救我的神；我的　神必應允我。
english: But as for me, I am looking to the Lord; I am waiting for the God of my salvation: the ears of my God will be open to me.

chinese: 我的仇敵啊，不要向我誇耀。我雖跌倒，卻要起來；我雖坐在黑暗裡，耶和華卻作我的光。
english: Do not be glad because of my sorrow, O my hater: after my fall I will be lifted up; when I am seated in the dark, the Lord will be a light to me.

chinese: 我要忍受耶和華的惱怒；因我得罪了他，直等他為我辨屈，為我伸冤。他必領我到光明中；我必得見他的公義。
english: I will undergo the wrath of the Lord, because of my sin against him; till he takes up my cause and does what is right for me: when he makes me come out into the light, I will see his righteousness;

chinese: 那時我的仇敵，就是曾對我說耶和華─你神在哪裡的，他一看見這事就被羞愧遮蓋。我必親眼見他遭報；他必被踐踏，如同街上的泥土。
english: And my hater will see it and be covered with shame; she who said to me, Where is the Lord your God? my eyes will see their desire effected on her, now she will be crushed under foot like the dust of the streets.

chinese: 以色列啊，日子必到，你的牆垣必重修；到那日，你的境界必開展（或譯：命令必傳到遠方）。
english: A day for building your walls! in that day will your limits be stretched far and wide.

chinese: 當那日，人必從亞述，從埃及的城邑，從埃及到大河，從這海到那海，從這山到那山，都歸到你這裡。
english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the towns of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.

chinese: 然而，這地因居民的緣故，又因他們行事的結果，必然荒涼。
english: But the land will become a waste because of its people, as the fruit of their works.

chinese: 求耶和華在迦密山的樹林中，用你的杖牧放你獨居的民，就是你產業的羊群。求你容他們在巴珊和基列得食物，像古時一樣。
english: Keep your people safe with your rod, the flock of your heritage, living by themselves in the woods in the middle of Carmel: let them get their food in Bashan and Gilead as in the past.

chinese: 耶和華說：我要把奇事顯給他們看，好像出埃及地的時候一樣。
english: As in the days when you came out from the land of Egypt, let us see things of wonder.

chinese: 列國看見這事，就必為自己的勢力慚愧；他們必用手摀口，掩耳不聽。
english: The nations will see and be shamed because of all their strength; they will put their hands on their mouths, their ears will be stopped.

chinese: 他們必舔土如蛇，又如土中腹行的物，戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。他們必戰懼投降耶和華，也必因我們的神而懼怕。
english: They will take dust as their food like a snake, like the things which go flat on the earth; they will come shaking with fear out of their secret places: they will come with fear to the Lord our God, full of fear because of you.

chinese: 神啊，有何神像你，赦免罪孽，饒恕你產業之餘民的罪過，不永遠懷怒，喜愛施恩？
english: Who is a God like you, offering forgiveness for evil-doing and overlooking the sins of the rest of his heritage? he does not keep his wrath for ever, because his delight is in mercy.

chinese: 必再憐憫我們，將我們的罪孽踏在腳下，又將我們的一切罪投於深海。
english: He will again have pity on us; he will put our sins under his feet: and you will send all our sins down into the heart of the sea.

chinese: 你必按古時起誓應許我們列祖的話，向雅各發誠實，向亞伯拉罕施慈愛。
english: You will make clear your good faith to Jacob and your mercy to Abraham, as you gave your oath to our fathers from times long past.

chinese: 論尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鴻所得的默示。
english: The word about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

chinese: 耶和華是忌邪施報的神。耶和華施報大有忿怒；向他的敵人施報，向他的仇敵懷怒。
english: The Lord is a God who takes care of his honour and gives punishment for wrong; the Lord gives punishment and is angry; the Lord sends punishment on those who are against him, being angry with his haters.

chinese: 耶和華不輕易發怒，大有能力，萬不以有罪的為無罪。他乘旋風和暴風而來，雲彩為他腳下的塵土。
english: The Lord is slow to get angry and great in power, and will not let the sinner go without punishment: the way of the Lord is in the wind and the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

chinese: 他斥責海，使海乾了，使一切江河乾涸。巴珊和迦密的樹林衰殘；利巴嫩的花草也衰殘了。
english: He says sharp words to the sea and makes it dry, drying up all the rivers: Bashan is feeble, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon is without strength.

chinese: 大山因他震動；小山也都消化。大地在他面前突起；世界和住在其間的也都如此。
english: The mountains are shaking because of him, and the hills flowing away; the earth is falling to bits before him, the world and all who are in it.

chinese: 他發忿恨，誰能立得住呢？他發烈怒，誰能當得起呢？他的忿怒如火傾倒；磐石因他崩裂。
english: Who may keep his place before his wrath? and who may undergo the heat of his passion? his wrath is let loose like fire and the rocks are broken open by him.

chinese: 耶和華本為善，在患難的日子為人的保障，並且認得那些投靠他的人。
english: The Lord is good, a strong place in the day of trouble; and he has knowledge of those who take him for their safe cover.

chinese: 但他必以漲溢的洪水淹沒尼尼微，又驅逐仇敵進入黑暗。
english: But like water overflowing he will take them away; he will put an end to those who come up against him, driving his haters into the dark.

chinese: 尼尼微人哪，設何謀攻擊耶和華呢？他必將你們滅絕淨盡；災難不再興起。
english: What are you designing against the Lord? he will put an end to it: his haters will not come up again a second time.

chinese: 你們像叢雜的荊棘，像喝醉了的人，又如枯乾的碎秸全然燒滅。
english: For though they are like twisted thorns, and are overcome as with drink, they will come to destruction like stems of grass fully dry.

chinese: 有一人從你那裡出來，圖謀邪惡，設惡計攻擊耶和華。
english: One has gone out from you who is designing evil against the Lord, whose purposes are of no value.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：尼尼微雖然勢力充足，人數繁多，也被剪除，歸於無有。猶大啊，我雖然使你受苦，卻不再使你受苦。
english: This is what the Lord has said: The days of my cause against you are ended; they are cut off and past. Though I have sent trouble on you, you will no longer be troubled.

chinese: 現在我必從你頸項上折斷他的軛，扭開他的繩索。
english: And now I will let his yoke be broken off you, and your chains be parted.

chinese: 耶和華已經出令，指著尼尼微說：你名下的人必不留後；我必從你神的廟中除滅雕刻的偶像和鑄造的偶像；我必因你鄙陋，使你歸於墳墓。
english: The Lord has given an order about you, that no more of your name are to be planted: from the house of your gods I will have the pictured and metal images cut off; I will make your last resting-place a place of shame; for you are completely evil.

chinese: 看哪，有報好信傳平安之人的腳登山，說：猶大啊，可以守你的節期，還你所許的願吧！因為那惡人不再從你中間經過，他已滅絕淨盡了。
english: See on the mountains the feet of him who comes with good news, giving word of peace! Keep your feasts, O Judah, give effect to your oaths: for the good-for-nothing man will never again go through you; he is completely cut off.

chinese: 尼尼微啊，那打碎邦國的上來攻擊你。你要看守保障，謹防道路，使腰強壯，大大勉力。
english: A crusher has come up before your face: keep a good look-out, let the way be watched, make yourself strong, let your power be greatly increased.

chinese: 耶和華復興雅各的榮華，好像以色列的榮華一樣；因為使地空虛的，已經使雅各和以色列空虛，將他們的葡萄枝毀壞了。
english: For the Lord will make good the vine of Jacob, as well as the vine of Israel: for the wasters have made them waste and sent destruction on the branches of their vine.

chinese: 他勇士的盾牌是紅的，精兵都穿朱紅衣服。在他預備爭戰的日子，戰車上的鋼鐵閃爍如火，柏木把的槍也掄起來了。
english: The body-covers of his fighting men have been made red, the men of war are clothed in bright red: the war-carriages are like flames of fire in the day when he gets ready, the horses are shaking.

chinese: 車輛在街上（或譯：城外）急行，在寬闊處奔來奔去，形狀如火把，飛跑如閃電。
english: The war-carriages are rushing through the streets, pushing against one another in the wide ways, looking like burning lights, running like thunder-flames.

chinese: 尼尼微王招聚他的貴冑；他們步行絆跌，速上城牆，預備擋牌。
english: He takes the record of his great men: they go falling on their way; they go quickly to the wall, the cover is made ready.

chinese: 河閘開放，宮殿沖沒。
english: The river doorways are forced open, and the king's house is flowing away.

chinese: 王后蒙羞，被人擄去；宮女搥胸，哀鳴如鴿。此乃命定之事。
english: And the queen is uncovered, she is taken away and her servant-girls are weeping like the sound of doves, hammering on their breasts.

chinese: 尼尼微自古以來充滿人民，如同聚水的池子；現在居民卻都逃跑。雖有人呼喊說：站住！站住！卻無人回顧。
english: But Nineveh is like a pool of water whose waters are flowing away; Keep your place, they say; but no one is turning back.

chinese: 你們搶掠金銀罷！因為所積蓄的無窮，華美的寶器無數。
english: Take silver, take gold; for there is no end to the store; take for yourselves a weight of things to be desired.

chinese: 尼尼微現在空虛荒涼，人心消化，雙膝相碰，腰都疼痛，臉都變色。
english: Everything has been taken from her, all is gone, she has nothing more: the heart is turned to water, the knees are shaking, all are twisted in pain, and colour has gone from all faces.

chinese: 獅子的洞和少壯獅子餵養之處在哪裡呢？公獅母獅小獅遊行、無人驚嚇之地在哪裡呢？
english: Where is the lions' hole, the place where the young lions got their food, where the lion and the she-lion were walking with their young, without cause for fear?

chinese: 公獅為小獅撕碎許多食物，為母獅掐死活物，把撕碎的、掐死的充滿他的洞穴。
english: Food enough for his young and for his she-lions was pulled down by the lion; his hole was full of flesh and his resting-place stored with meat.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我與你為敵，必將你的車輛焚燒成煙，刀劍也必吞滅你的少壯獅子。我必從地上除滅你所撕碎的，你使者的聲音必不再聽見。
english: See, I am against you, says the Lord of armies, and I will have your war-carriages burned in the smoke, and your young lions will be food for the sword: you will no longer get your food by force on the earth, and the voice of your she-lions will be stopped for ever.

chinese: 禍哉！這流人血的城，充滿謊詐和強暴，搶奪的事總不止息。
english: A curse is on the town of blood; it is full of deceit and violent acts; and there is no end to the taking of life.

chinese: 鞭聲響亮，車輪轟轟，馬匹踢跳，車輛奔騰，
english: The noise of the whip, and the noise of thundering wheels; horses rushing and war-carriages jumping,

chinese: 馬兵爭先，刀劍發光，槍矛閃爍，被殺的甚多，屍首成了大堆，屍骸無數，人碰著而跌倒，
english: Horsemen driving forward, and the shining sword and the bright spear: and a great number of wounded, and masses of dead bodies; they are falling over the bodies of the dead:

chinese: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行，慣行邪術，藉淫行誘惑列國，用邪術誘惑（原文是賣）多族。
english: Because of all the false ways of the loose woman, expert in attraction and wise in secret arts, who takes nations in the net of her false ways, and families through her secret arts.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我與你為敵；我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你臉上，使列國看見你的赤體，使列邦觀看你的醜陋。
english: See, I am against you, says the Lord of armies, and I will have your skirts pulled over your face, and let the nations see you unclothed, and the kingdoms your shame.

chinese: 我必將可憎污穢之物拋在你身上，辱沒你，為眾目所觀。
english: I will make you completely disgusting and full of shame, and will put you up to be looked at by all.

chinese: 凡看見你的，都必逃跑離開你，說：尼尼微荒涼了！有誰為你悲傷呢？我何處尋得安慰你的人呢？
english: And it will come about that all who see you will go in flight from you and say, Nineveh is made waste: who will be weeping for her? where am I to get comforters for her?

chinese: 你豈比挪亞們（或）強呢？挪亞們坐落在眾河之間，周圍有水；海（指尼羅河）作他的濠溝，又作他的城牆。
english: Are you better than No-amon, seated on the Nile streams, with waters all round her; whose wall was the sea and her earthwork the waters?

chinese: 古實和埃及是他無窮的力量；弗人和路比族是他的幫手。
english: Ethiopia was her strength and Egyptians without number; Put and Lubim were her helpers.

chinese: 但他被遷移，被擄去；他的嬰孩在各市口上也被摔死。人為他的尊貴人拈鬮；他所有的大人都被鍊子鎖著。
english: But even she has been taken away, she has gone away as a prisoner: even her young children are smashed to bits at the top of all the streets: the fate of her honoured men is put to the decision of chance, and all her great men are put in chains.

chinese: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏，並因仇敵的緣故尋求避難所。
english: And you will be overcome with wine, you will become feeble; you will be looking for a safe place from those who are fighting against you.

chinese: 你一切保障必像無花果樹上初熟的無花果，若一搖撼就落在想吃之人的口中。
english: All your walled places will be like fig-trees and your people like the first figs, falling at a shake into the mouth which is open for them.

chinese: 你地上的人民如同婦女；你國中的關口向仇敵敞開；你的門閂被火焚燒。
english: See, the people who are in you are women; the doorways of your land are wide open to your attackers: the locks of your doors have been burned away in the fire.

chinese: 你要打水預備受困；要堅固你的保障，踹土和泥，修補磚窯。
english: Get water for the time when you are shut in, make strong your towns: go into the potter's earth, stamping it down with your feet, make strong the brickworks.

chinese: 在那裡，火必燒滅你；刀必殺戮你，吞滅你如同蝻子。任你加增人數多如蝻子，多如蝗蟲罷！
english: There the fire will make you waste; you will be cut off by the sword: make yourself as great in number as the worms, as great in number as the locusts.

chinese: 你增添商賈，多過天上的星；蝻子吃盡而去。
english: Let your traders be increased more than the stars of heaven:

chinese: 你的首領多如蝗蟲；你的軍長彷彿成群的螞蚱，天涼的時候齊落在籬笆上，日頭一出便都飛去，人不知道落在何處。
english: Your crowned ones are like the locusts, and your scribes like the clouds of insects which take cover in the walls on a cold day, but when the sun comes up they go in flight, and are seen no longer in their place.

chinese: 亞述王啊，你的牧人睡覺；你的貴冑安歇；你的人民散在山間，無人招聚。
english: Sorrow! how are the keepers of your flock sleeping, O king of Assyria! your strong men are at rest; your people are wandering on the mountains, and there is no one to get them together.

chinese: 你的損傷無法醫治；你的傷痕極其重大。凡聽你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。你所行的惡誰沒有時常遭遇呢？
english: Your pain may not be made better; you are wounded to death: all those hearing the news about you will be waving their hands in joy over you: for who has not undergone the weight of your evil-doing again and again?

chinese: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。
english: The word which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

chinese: 他說：耶和華啊！我呼求你，你不應允，要到幾時呢？我因強暴哀求你，你還不拯救。
english: How long, O Lord, will your ears be shut to my voice? I make an outcry to you about violent behaviour, but you do not send salvation.

chinese: 你為何使我看見罪孽？你為何看著奸惡而不理呢？毀滅和強暴在我面前，又起了爭端和相鬥的事。
english: Why do you make me see evil-doing, and why are my eyes fixed on wrong? for wasting and violent acts are before me: and there is fighting and bitter argument.

chinese: 因此律法放鬆，公理也不顯明，惡人圍困義人，所以公理顯然顛倒。
english: For this reason the law is feeble and decisions are not effected: for the upright man is circled round by evil-doers; because of which right is twisted.

chinese: 耶和華說：你們要向列國中觀看，大大驚奇；因為在你們的時候，我行一件事，雖有人告訴你們，你們總是不信。
english: See among the nations, and take note, and be full of wonder: for in your days I am doing a work in which you will have no belief, even if news of it is given to you.

chinese: 我必興起迦勒底人，就是那殘忍暴躁之民，通行遍地，佔據那不屬自己的住處。
english: For see, I am sending the Chaldaeans, that bitter and quick-moving nation; who go through the wide spaces of the earth to get for themselves living-places which are not theirs.

chinese: 他威武可畏，判斷和勢力都任意發出。
english: They are greatly to be feared: their right comes from themselves.

chinese: 他的馬比豹更快，比晚上的豺狼更猛。馬兵踴躍爭先，都從遠方而來；他們飛跑如鷹抓食，
english: And their horses are quicker than leopards and their horsemen more cruel than evening wolves; they come from far away, like an eagle in flight rushing on its food.

chinese: 都為行強暴而來，定住臉面向前，將擄掠的人聚集，多如塵沙。
english: They are coming all of them with force; the direction of their faces is forward, the number of their prisoners is like the sands of the sea.

chinese: 他們譏誚君王，笑話首領，嗤笑一切保障，築壘攻取。
english: He makes little of kings, rulers are a sport to him; all the strong places are to be laughed at; for he makes earthworks and takes them.

chinese: 他以自己的勢力為神，像風猛然掃過，顯為有罪。
english: Then his purpose will be changed, over-stepping the limit; he will make his strength his god.

chinese: 耶和華─我的神，我的聖者啊，你不是從亙古而有麼？我們必不致死。耶和華啊，你派定他為要刑罰人；磐石啊，你設立他為要懲治人。
english: Are you not eternal, O Lord my God, my Holy One? for you there is no death. O Lord, he has been ordered by you for our punishment; and by you, O Rock, he has been marked out to put us right.

chinese: 你眼目清潔，不看邪僻，不看奸惡；行詭詐的，你為何看著不理呢？惡人吞滅比自己公義的，你為何靜默不語呢？
english: Before your holy eyes sin may not be seen, and you are unable to put up with wrong; why, then, are your eyes on the false? why do you say nothing when the evil-doer puts an end to one who is more upright than himself?

chinese: 你為何使人如海中的魚，又如沒有管轄的爬物呢？
english: He has made men like the fishes of the sea, like the worms which have no ruler over them.

chinese: 他用鉤鉤住，用網捕獲，用拉網聚集他們；因此，他歡喜快樂，
english: He takes them all up with his hook, he takes them in his net, getting them together in his fishing-net: for which cause he is glad and full of joy.

chinese: 就向網獻祭，向網燒香，因他由此得肥美的分和富裕的食物。
english: For this reason he makes an offering to his net, burning perfume to his fishing-net; because by them he gets much food and his meat is fat.

chinese: 他豈可屢次倒空網羅，將列國的人時常殺戮，毫不顧惜呢？
english: For this cause his net is ever open, and there is no end to his destruction of the nations.

chinese: 我要站在守望所，立在望樓上觀看，看耶和華對我說甚麼話，我可用甚麼話向他訴冤（向他訴冤：或譯回答所疑問的）。
english: I will take my position and be on watch, placing myself on my tower, looking out to see what he will say to me, and what answer he will give to my protest.

chinese: 他對我說：將這默示明明地寫在版上，使讀的人容易讀（或譯：隨跑隨讀）。
english: And the Lord gave me an answer, and said, Put the vision in writing and make it clear on stones, so that the reader may go quickly.

chinese: 因為這默示有一定的日期，快要應驗，並不虛謊。雖然遲延，還要等候；因為必然臨到，不再遲延。
english: For the vision is still for the fixed time, and it is moving quickly to the end, and it will not be false: even if it is slow in coming, go on waiting for it; because it will certainly come, it will not be kept back.

chinese: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直；惟義人因信得生。
english: As for the man of pride, my soul has no pleasure in him; but the upright man will have life through his good faith.

chinese: 迦勒底人因酒詭詐，狂傲，不住在家中，擴充心欲，好像陰間。他如死不能知足，聚集萬國，堆積萬民都歸自己。
english: A curse on the cruel and false one! the man full of pride, who never has enough; who makes his desires wide as the underworld! he is like death; he is never full, but he makes all nations come to him, getting all peoples together to himself.

chinese: 這些國的民豈不都要提起詩歌並俗語譏刺他說：禍哉！迦勒底人，你增添不屬自己的財物，多多取人的當頭，要到幾時為止呢？
english: Will not all these take up a word of shame against him and a bitter saying against him, and say, A curse on him who goes on taking what is not his and is weighted down with the property of debtors!

chinese: 咬傷你的豈不忽然起來，擾害你的豈不興起，你就作他們的擄物麼？
english: Will not your creditors suddenly be moved against you, and your troublers get up from their sleep, and you will be to them like goods taken in war?

chinese: 因你搶奪許多的國，殺人流血，向國內的城並城中一切居民施行強暴，所以各國剩下的民都必搶奪你。
english: Because you have taken their goods from great nations, all the rest of the peoples will take your goods from you; because of men's blood and violent acts against the land and the town and all who are living in it.

chinese: 為本家積蓄不義之財、在高處搭窩、指望免災的有禍了！
english: A curse on him who gets evil profits for his family, so that he may put his resting-place on high and be safe from the hand of the wrongdoer!

chinese: 你圖謀剪除多國的民，犯了罪，使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。
english: You have been a cause of shame to your house by cutting off a number of peoples, and sinning against your soul.

chinese: 牆裡的石頭必呼叫；房內的棟梁必應聲。
english: For the stone will give a cry out of the wall, and it will be answered by the board out of the woodwork.

chinese: 以人血建城、以罪孽立邑的有禍了！
english: A curse on him who is building a place with blood, and basing a town on evil-doing!

chinese: 眾民所勞碌得來的被火焚燒，列國由勞乏而得的歸於虛空，不都是出於萬軍之耶和華麼？
english: See, is it not the pleasure of the Lord of armies that the peoples are working for the fire and using themselves up for nothing?

chinese: 認識耶和華榮耀的知識要充滿遍地，好像水充滿洋海一般。
english: For the earth will be full of the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the sea is covered by the waters.

chinese: 給人酒喝、又加上毒物、使他喝醉、好看見他下體的有禍了！
english: A curse on him who gives his neighbour the wine of his wrath, making him overcome with strong drink from the cup of his passion, so that you may be a witness of their shame!

chinese: 你滿受羞辱，不得榮耀；你也喝吧，顯出是未受割禮的！耶和華右手的杯必傳到你那裡；你的榮耀就變為大大地羞辱。
english: You are full of shame in place of glory: take your part in the drinking, and let your shame be uncovered: the cup of the Lord's right hand will come round to you and your glory will be covered with shame.

chinese: 你向利巴嫩行強暴與殘害驚嚇野獸的事必遮蓋你；因你殺人流血，向國內的城並城中一切居民施行強暴。
english: For the violent acts against Lebanon will come on you, and the destruction of the cattle will be a cause of fear to you, because of men's blood and the violent acts against the land and the town and all who are living in it.

chinese: 雕刻的偶像，人將他刻出來，有甚麼益處呢？鑄造的偶像就是虛謊的師傅。製造者倚靠這啞巴偶像有甚麼益處呢？
english: What profit is the pictured image to its maker? and as for the metal image, the false teacher, why does its maker put his faith in it, making false gods without a voice?

chinese: 對木偶說：醒起！對啞巴石像說：起來！那人有禍了！這個還能教訓人麼？看哪，是包裹金銀的，其中毫無氣息。
english: A curse on him who says to the wood, Awake! to the unbreathing stone, Up! let it be a teacher! See, it is plated with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all inside it.

chinese: 惟耶和華在他的聖殿中；全地的人都當在他面前肅敬靜默。
english: But the Lord is in his holy Temple: let all the earth be quiet before him.

chinese: 先知哈巴谷的禱告，調用流離歌。
english: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, put to Shigionoth.

chinese: 耶和華啊，我聽見你的名聲（或譯：言語）就懼怕。耶和華啊，求你在這些年間復興你的作為，在這些年間顯明出來；在發怒的時候以憐憫為念。
english: O Lord, word of you has come to my ears; I have seen your work, O Lord; when the years come near make it clear; in wrath keep mercy in mind.

chinese: 神從提幔而來；聖者從巴蘭山臨到。（細拉）他的榮光遮蔽諸天；頌讚充滿大地。
english: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. The heavens were covered with his glory, and the earth was full of his praise.

chinese: 他的輝煌如同日光；從他手裡射出光線，在其中藏著他的能力。
english: He was shining like the light; he had rays coming out from his hand: there his power was kept secret.

chinese: 在他前面有瘟疫流行；在他腳下有熱症發出。
english: Before him went disease, and flames went out at his feet.

chinese: 他站立，量了大地（或譯：使地震動），觀看，趕散萬民。永久的山崩裂；長存的嶺塌陷；他的作為與古時一樣。
english: From his high place he sent shaking on the earth; he saw and nations were suddenly moved: and the eternal mountains were broken, the unchanging hills were bent down; his ways are eternal.

chinese: 我見古珊的帳棚遭難，米甸的幔子戰兢。
english: The curtains of Cushan were troubled, and the tents of Midian were shaking.

chinese: 耶和華啊，你乘在馬上，坐在得勝的車上，豈是不喜悅江河、向江河發怒氣、向洋海發憤恨麼？
english: Was your wrath burning against the rivers? were you angry with the sea, that you went on your horses, on your war-carriages of salvation?

chinese: 你的弓全然顯露，向眾支派所起的誓都是可信的。（細拉）你以江河分開大地。
english: Your bow was quite uncovered. Selah. By you the earth was cut through with rivers.

chinese: 山嶺見你，無不戰懼；大水氾濫過去，深淵發聲，洶湧翻騰（原文是向上舉手）。
english: The mountains saw you and were moved with fear; the clouds were streaming with water: the voice of the deep was sounding; the sun did not come up, and the moon kept still in her place.

chinese: 因你的箭射出，發光，你的槍閃出光耀，日月都在本宮停住。
english: At the light of your arrows they went away, at the shining of your polished spear.

chinese: 你發憤恨通行大地，發怒氣責打列國，如同打糧。
english: You went stepping through the land in wrath, crushing the nations in your passion.

chinese: 你出來要拯救你的百姓，拯救你的受膏者，打破惡人家長的頭，露出他的腳（原文是根基），直到頸項。（細拉）
english: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of the one on whom your holy oil was put; wounding the head of the family of the evil-doer, uncovering the base even to the neck. Selah.

chinese: 你用敵人的戈矛刺透他戰士的頭；他們來如旋風，要將我們分散。他們所喜愛的是暗中吞吃貧民。
english: You have put your spears through his head, his horsemen were sent in flight like dry stems; they had joy in driving away the poor, in making a meal of them secretly.

chinese: 你乘馬踐踏紅海，就是踐踏洶湧的大水。
english: The feet of your horses were on the sea, on the mass of great waters.

chinese: 我聽見耶和華的聲音，身體戰兢，嘴唇發顫，骨中朽爛；我在所立之處戰兢。我只可安靜等候災難之日臨到，犯境之民上來。
english: Hearing it, my inner parts were moved, and my lips were shaking at the sound; my bones became feeble, and my steps were uncertain under me: I gave sounds of grief in the day of trouble, when his forces came up against the people in bands.

chinese: 雖然無花果樹不發旺，葡萄樹不結果，橄欖樹也不效力，田地不出糧食，圈中絕了羊，棚內也沒有牛；
english: For though the fig-tree has no flowers, and there is no fruit on the vine, and work on the olive comes to nothing, and the fields give no food; and the flock is cut off from its resting-place, and there is no herd in the cattle-house:

chinese: 然而，我要因耶和華歡欣，因救我的神喜樂。
english: Still, I will be glad in the Lord, my joy will be in the God of my salvation.

chinese: 主耶和華是我的力量；他使我的腳快如母鹿的蹄，又使我穩行在高處。這歌交與伶長，用絲弦的樂器。
english: The Lord God is my strength, and he makes my feet like roes' feet, guiding me on my high places. For the chief music-maker on corded instruments.

chinese: 當猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞在位的時候，耶和華的話臨到希西家的玄孫，亞瑪利雅的曾孫，基大利的孫子，古示的兒子西番雅。
english: The word of the Lord which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

chinese: 耶和華說：我必從地上除滅萬類。
english: I will take away everything from the face of the earth, says the Lord.

chinese: 我必除滅人和牲畜，與空中的鳥、海裡的魚，以及絆腳石和惡人；我必將人從地上剪除。這是耶和華說的。
english: I will take away man and beast; I will take away the birds of the heaven and the fishes of the sea; causing the downfall of the evil-doers, and cutting man off from the face of the earth, says the Lord.

chinese: 我必伸手攻擊猶大和耶路撒冷的一切居民，也必從這地方剪除所剩下的巴力，並基瑪林的名和祭司，
english: And my hand will be stretched out on Judah and on all the people of Jerusalem, cutting off the name of the Baal from this place, and the name of the false priests,

chinese: 與那些在房頂上敬拜天上萬象的，並那些敬拜耶和華指著他起誓，又指著瑪勒堪起誓的，
english: And the worshippers of the army of heaven on the house-tops, and the Lord's worshippers who take oaths by Milcom,

chinese: 與那些轉去不跟從耶和華的，和不尋求耶和華也不訪問他的。
english: And those who are turned back from going after the Lord, and those who have not made prayer to the Lord or got directions from him.

chinese: 你要在主耶和華面前靜默無聲，因為耶和華的日子快到。耶和華已經預備祭物，將他的客分別為聖。
english: Let there be no sound before the Lord God: for the day of the Lord is near: for the Lord has made ready an offering, he has made his guests holy.

chinese: 到了我─耶和華獻祭的日子，必懲罰首領和王子，並一切穿外邦衣服的。
english: And it will come about in the day of the Lord's offering, that I will send punishment on the rulers and the king's sons and all who are clothed in robes from strange lands.

chinese: 到那日，我必懲罰一切跳過門檻、將強暴和詭詐得來之物充滿主人房屋的。
english: And in that day I will send punishment on all those who come jumping over the doorstep and make their master's house full of violent behaviour and deceit.

chinese: 耶和華說：當那日，從魚門必發出悲哀的聲音，從二城發出哀號的聲音，從山間發出大破裂的響聲。
english: And in that day, says the Lord, there will be the sound of a cry from the fish doorway, and an outcry from the new town, and a great thundering from the hills, and cries of grief from the people of the Hollow;

chinese: 瑪革提施的居民哪，你們要哀號，因為迦南的商民都滅亡了！凡搬運銀子的都被剪除。
english: Because of the downfall of all the people of Canaan: all those who were weighted down with silver have been cut off.

chinese: 那時，我必用燈巡查耶路撒冷；我必懲罰那些如酒在渣滓上澄清的；他們心裡說：耶和華必不降福，也不降禍。
english: And it will come about at that time, that I will go searching through Jerusalem with lights; and I will send punishment on the men who have become like wine stored over-long, who say to themselves, The Lord will not do good and will not do evil.

chinese: 他們的財寶必成為掠物；他們的房屋必變為荒場。他們必建造房屋，卻不得住在其內；栽種葡萄園，卻不得喝所出的酒。
english: And their wealth will be violently taken away, and their houses will be made waste: they will go on building houses and never living in them, and planting vine-gardens but not drinking the wine from them.

chinese: 耶和華的大日臨近，臨近而且甚快，乃是耶和華日子的風聲；勇士必痛痛地哭號。
english: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near and coming very quickly; the bitter day of the Lord is near, coming on more quickly than a man of war.

chinese: 那日是忿怒的日子，是急難困苦的日子，是荒廢淒涼的日子，是黑暗幽冥、密雲烏黑的日子，
english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and sorrow, a day of wasting and destruction, a day of dark night and deep shade, a day of cloud and thick dark.

chinese: 是吹角吶喊的日子，要攻擊堅固城和高大的城樓。
english: A day of sounding the horn and the war-cry against the walled towns and the high towers.

chinese: 我必使災禍臨到人身上，使他們行走如同瞎眼的，因為得罪了我。他們的血必倒出如灰塵；他們的肉必拋棄如糞土。
english: And I will send trouble on men so that they will go about like the blind, because they have done evil against the Lord: and their blood will be drained out like dust, and their strength like waste.

chinese: 當耶和華發怒的日子，他們的金銀不能救他們；他的忿怒如火必燒滅全地，毀滅這地的一切居民，而且大大毀滅。
english: Even their silver and their gold will not be able to keep them safe in the day of the Lord's wrath; but all the land will be burned up in the fire of his bitter wrath: for he will put an end, even suddenly, to all who are living in the land.

chinese: 不知羞恥的國民哪，你們應當聚集！趁命令沒有發出，日子過去如風前的糠，耶和華的烈怒未臨到你們，他發怒的日子未到以先，你們應當聚集前來。
english: Come together, make everyone come together, O nation without shame;
Before the Lord sends you violently away in flight like the waste from the grain; before the burning wrath of the Lord comes on you, before the day of the Lord's wrath comes on you.

chinese: 世上遵守耶和華典章的謙卑人哪，你們都當尋求耶和華！當尋求公義謙卑，或者在耶和華發怒的日子可以隱藏起來。
english: Make search for the Lord, all you quiet ones of the earth, who have done what is right in his eyes; make search for righteousness and a quiet heart: it may be that you will be safely covered in the day of the Lord's wrath.

chinese: 迦薩必致見棄；亞實基倫必然荒涼。人在正午必趕出亞實突的民；以革倫也被拔出根來。
english: For Gaza will be given up and Ashkelon will become waste: they will send Ashdod out in the middle of the day, and Ekron will be uprooted.

chinese: 住沿海之地的基利提族有禍了！迦南、非利士人之地啊，耶和華的話與你反對，說：我必毀滅你，以致無人居住。
english: Sorrow to the people living by the sea, the nation of the Cherethites! The word of the Lord is against you, O Canaan, the land of the Philistines; I will send destruction on you till there is no one living in you.

chinese: 沿海之地要變為草場，其上有牧人的住處和羊群的圈。
english: And the land by the sea will be grass-land, with houses for keepers of sheep and walled places for flocks.

chinese: 這地必為猶大家剩下的人所得；他們必在那裡牧放群羊，晚上必躺臥在亞實基倫的房屋中；因為耶和華─他們的神必眷顧他們，使他們被擄的人歸回。
english: The land by the sea will be for the rest of the children of Judah; by the sea they will give their flocks food: in the houses of Ashkelon they will take their rest in the evening; for the Lord their God will take them in hand and their fate will be changed.

chinese: 我聽見摩押人的毀謗和亞捫人的辱罵，就是毀謗我的百姓，自誇自大，侵犯他們的境界。
english: My ears have been open to the bitter words of Moab and the words of shame of the children of Ammon, which they have said against my people, lifting themselves up against the limit of their land.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神說：我指著我的永生起誓：摩押必像所多瑪，亞捫人必像蛾摩拉，都變為刺草、鹽坑、永遠荒廢之地。我百姓所剩下的必擄掠他們；我國中所餘剩的必得著他們的地。
english: For this cause, by my life, says the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, truly Moab will become like Sodom and the children of Ammon like Gomorrah, given up to waste plants and salt pools and unpeopled for ever: the rest of my people will take their property, the overflow of my nation will take their heritage.

chinese: 這事臨到他們是因他們驕傲，自誇自大，毀謗萬軍之耶和華的百姓。
english: This will be their fate because of their pride, because they have said evil, lifting themselves up against the people of the Lord of armies.

chinese: 耶和華必向他們顯可畏之威，因他必叫世上的諸神瘦弱。列國海島的居民各在自己的地方敬拜他。
english: The Lord will let himself be seen by them: for he will make all the gods of the earth feeble; and men will go down before him in worship, everyone from his place, even all the sea-lands of the nations.

chinese: 古實人哪，你們必被我的刀所殺。
english: And you Ethiopians will be put to death by my sword.

chinese: 耶和華必伸手攻擊北方，毀滅亞述，使尼尼微荒涼，又乾旱如曠野。
english: And his hand will be stretched out against the north, for the destruction of Assyria; and he will make Nineveh unpeopled and dry like the waste land.

chinese: 群畜，就是各國（國：或譯類）的走獸必臥在其中；鵜鶘和箭豬要宿在柱頂上。在窗戶內有鳴叫的聲音；門檻都必毀壞，香柏木已經露出。
english: And herds will take their rest in the middle of her, all the beasts of the valley: the pelican and the porcupine will make their living-places on the tops of its pillars; the owl will be crying in the window; the raven will be seen on the doorstep.

chinese: 這是素來歡樂安然居住的城，心裡說：惟有我，除我以外再沒有別的；現在何竟荒涼成為野獸躺臥之處！凡經過的人都必搖手嗤笑他。
english: This is the town which was full of joy, living without fear of danger, saying in her heart, I am, and there is no other: how has she been made waste, a place for beasts to take their rest in! everyone who goes by her will make hisses, waving his hand.

chinese: 這悖逆、污穢、欺壓的城有禍了！
english: Sorrow to her who is uncontrolled and unclean, the cruel town!

chinese: 他不聽從命令，不領受訓誨，不倚靠耶和華，不親近他的神。
english: She gave no attention to the voice, she had no use for teaching, she put no faith in the Lord, she did not come near to her God.

chinese: 他中間的首領是咆哮的獅子；他的審判官是晚上的豺狼，一點食物也不留到早晨。
english: Her rulers are like loud-voiced lions in her; her judges are wolves of the evening, crushing up the bones before the morning.

chinese: 他的先知是虛浮詭詐的人；他的祭司褻瀆聖所，強解律法。
english: Her prophets are good-for-nothing persons, full of deceit: her priests have made the holy place unclean and have gone violently against the law.

chinese: 耶和華在他中間是公義的，斷不做非義的事，每早晨顯明他的公義，無日不然；只是不義的人不知羞恥。
english: The Lord in her is upright; he will not do evil; every morning he lets his righteousness be seen, he is unchanging; but the evil-doer has no sense of shame.

chinese: 我─耶和華已經除滅列國的民；他們的城樓毀壞。我使他們的街道荒涼，以致無人經過；他們的城邑毀滅，以致無人，也無居民。
english: I have had the nations cut off, their towers are broken down; I have made their streets a waste so that no one goes through them: destruction has overtaken their towns, so that there is no man living in them.

chinese: 我說：你只要敬畏我，領受訓誨；如此，你的住處不致照我所擬定的除滅。只是你們從早起來就在一切事上敗壞自己。
english: I said, Certainly you will go in fear of me, and come under my training, so that whatever I may send on her may not be cut off before her eyes: but they got up early and made all their works evil.

chinese: 耶和華說：你們要等候我，直到我興起擄掠的日子；因為我已定意招聚列國，聚集列邦，將我的惱怒─就是我的烈怒都傾在他們身上。我的忿怒如火，必燒滅全地。
english: For this reason, go on waiting for me, says the Lord, till the day when I come up as a witness: for my purpose is to send for the nations and to get the kingdoms together, so that I may let loose on them my passion, even all my burning wrath: for all the earth will be burned up in the fire of my bitter passion.

chinese: 那時，我必使萬民用清潔的言語好求告我─耶和華的名，同心合意地事奉我。
english: For then I will give the people a clean language, so that they may all make prayer to the Lord and be his servants with one mind.

chinese: 祈禱我的，就是我所分散的民（原文是女子；下同），必從古實河外來，給我獻供物。
english: From over the rivers of Ethiopia, and from the sides of the north, they will come to me with an offering.

chinese: 當那日，你必不因你一切得罪我的事自覺羞愧；因為那時我必從你中間除掉矜誇高傲之輩，你也不再於我的聖山狂傲。
english: In that day you will have no shame on account of all the things in which you did evil against me: for then I will take away from among you those who were lifted up in pride, and you will no longer be lifted up with pride in my holy mountain.

chinese: 我卻要在你中間留下困苦貧寒的民；他們必投靠我─耶和華的名。
english: But I will still have among you a quiet and poor people, and they will put their faith in the name of the Lord.

chinese: 以色列所剩下的人必不作罪孽，不說謊言，口中也沒有詭詐的舌頭；而且吃喝躺臥，無人驚嚇。
english: The rest of Israel will do no evil and say no false words; the tongue of deceit will not be seen in their mouth: for they will take their food and their rest, and no one will be a cause of fear to them.

chinese: 錫安的民哪，應當歌唱！以色列啊，應當歡呼！耶路撒冷的民哪，應當滿心歡喜快樂！
english: Make melody, O daughter of Zion; give a loud cry, O Israel; be glad and let your heart be full of joy, O daughter of Jerusalem.

chinese: 耶和華已經除去你的刑罰，趕出你的仇敵。以色列的王─耶和華在你中間；你必不再懼怕災禍。
english: The Lord has taken away those who were judging you, he has sent your haters far away: the King of Israel, even the Lord, is among you: you will have no more fear of evil.

chinese: 當那日，必有話向耶路撒冷說：不要懼怕！錫安哪；不要手軟！
english: In that day it will be said to Jerusalem, Have no fear: O Zion, let not your hands be feeble.

chinese: 耶和華─你的神是施行拯救、大有能力的主。他在你中間必因你歡欣喜樂，默然愛你，且因你喜樂而歡呼。
english: The Lord your God is among you, as a strong saviour: he will be glad over you with joy, he will make his love new again, he will make a song of joy over you as in the time of a holy feast.

chinese: 那些屬你、為無大會愁煩、因你擔當羞辱的，我必聚集他們。
english: I will take away your troubles, lifting up your shame from off you.

chinese: 那時，我必罰辦一切苦待你的人，又拯救你瘸腿的，聚集你被趕出的。那些在全地受羞辱的，我必使他們得稱讚，有名聲。
english: See, at that time I will put an end to all who have been troubling you: I will give salvation to her whose steps are uncertain, and get together her who has been sent in flight; and I will make them a cause of praise and an honoured name in all the earth, when I let their fate be changed.

chinese: 那時，我必領你們進來，聚集你們；我使你們被擄之人歸回的時候，就必使你們在地上的萬民中有名聲，得稱讚。這是耶和華說的。
english: At that time I will make you come in, at that time I will get you together: for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth when I let your fate be changed before your eyes, says the Lord.

chinese: 大利烏王第二年六月初一日，耶和華的話藉先知哈該向猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞說：
english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, ruler of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：這百姓說，建造耶和華殿的時候尚未來到。
english: These are the words of the Lord of armies: These people say, The time has not come for building the Lord's house.

chinese: 那時耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

chinese: 這殿仍然荒涼，你們自己還住天花板的房屋麼？
english: Is it a time for you to be living in roofed houses while this house is a waste?

chinese: 現在萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要省察自己的行為。
english: For this cause the Lord of armies has said, Give thought to your ways.

chinese: 你們撒的種多，收的卻少；你們吃，卻不得飽；喝，卻不得足；穿衣服，卻不得暖；得工錢的，將工錢裝在破漏的囊中。
english: Much has been planted, but little got in; you take food, but have not enough; you take drink, but are not full; you are clothed, but no one is warm; and he who gets payment for his work, gets it to put it into a bag full of holes.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要省察自己的行為。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Give thought to your ways.

chinese: 你們要上山取木料，建造這殿，我就因此喜樂，且得榮耀。這是耶和華說的。
english: Go up to the hills and get wood and put up the house; and I will take pleasure in it and be honoured, says the Lord.

chinese: 你們盼望多得，所得的卻少；你們收到家中，我就吹去。這是為甚麼呢？因為我的殿荒涼，你們各人卻顧（原文是奔）自己的房屋。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: You were looking for much, and it came to little; and when you got it into your house, I took it away with a breath. Why? says the Lord of armies. Because of my house which is a waste, while every man takes care of the house which is his.

chinese: 所以為你們的緣故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土產。
english: For this cause the heaven over you is kept from giving dew, and the earth from giving her fruit.

chinese: 我命乾旱臨到地土、山岡、五穀、新酒，和油，並地上的出產、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切勞碌得來的。
english: And by my order no rain came on the land or on the mountains or the grain or the wine or the oil or the produce of the earth or on men or cattle or on any work of man's hands.

chinese: 那時，撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下的百姓，都聽從耶和華─他們神的話和先知哈該奉耶和華─他們　神差來所說的話；百姓也在耶和華面前存敬畏的心。
english: Then Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the rest of the people, gave ear to the voice of the Lord their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, because the Lord their God had sent him, and the people were in fear before the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華的使者哈該奉耶和華差遣對百姓說：耶和華說：我與你們同在。
english: Then Haggai, whom the Lord had sent to give his words to the people, said, I am with you, says the Lord.

chinese: 耶和華激動猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下之百姓的心，他們就來為萬軍之耶和華─他們神的殿做工。
english: And the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, ruler of Judah, was moved by the Lord, as was the spirit of Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the rest of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of armies, their God.

chinese: 這是在大利烏王第二年六月二十四日。
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

chinese: 七月二十一日，耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
english: In the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

chinese: 你要曉諭猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下的百姓，說：
english: Say now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, ruler of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the rest of the people,

chinese: 你們中間存留的，有誰見過這殿從前的榮耀呢？現在你們看著如何？豈不在眼中看如無有麼？
english: Who is there still among you who saw this house in its first glory? and how do you see it now? is it not in your eyes as nothing?

chinese: 耶和華說：所羅巴伯啊，雖然如此，你當剛強！約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞啊，你也當剛強！這地的百姓，你們都當剛強作工，因為我與你們同在。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel, says the Lord; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all you people of the land, says the Lord, and get to work: for I am with you, says the Lord of armies:

chinese: 這是照著你們出埃及我與你們立約的話。那時，我的靈住在你們中間，你們不要懼怕。
english: The agreement which I made with you when you came out of Egypt, and my spirit, are with you still; have no fear.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：過不多時，我必再一次震動天地、滄海，與旱地。
english: For this is what the Lord of armies has said: In a short time I will make a shaking of the heavens and the earth and the sea and the dry land;

chinese: 我必震動萬國；萬國的珍寶必都運來（或譯：萬國所羨慕的必來到），我就使這殿滿了榮耀。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And I will make a shaking of all the nations, and the desired things of all nations will come: and I will make this house full of my glory, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：銀子是我的，金子也是我的。
english: The silver is mine and the gold is mine, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 這殿後來的榮耀必大過先前的榮耀；在這地方我必賜平安。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: The second glory of this house will be greater than the first, says the Lord of armies: and in this place I will give peace, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 大利烏王第二年九月二十四日，耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：你要向祭司問律法，
english: These are the words of the Lord of armies: Put now a point of law to the priests, saying,

chinese: 說：若有人用衣襟兜聖肉，這衣襟挨著餅，或湯，或酒，或油，或別的食物，便算為聖麼？祭司說：不算為聖。
english: If anyone has some holy flesh folded in the skirt of his robe, will bread or soup or wine or oil or any other food be made holy if touched by his skirt? And the priests answering said, No.

chinese: 哈該又說：若有人因摸死屍染了污穢，然後挨著這些物的哪一樣，這物算污穢麼？祭司說：必算污穢。
english: Then Haggai said, Will any of these be made unclean by the touch of one who is unclean through touching a dead body? And the priests answering said, It will be made unclean.

chinese: 於是哈該說：耶和華說：這民這國，在我面前也是如此；他們手下的各樣工作都是如此；他們在壇上所獻的也是如此。
english: Then Haggai said, So is this people and so is this nation before me, says the Lord; and so is every work of their hands; and the offering they give there is unclean.

chinese: 現在你們要追想，此日以前，耶和華的殿沒有一塊石頭壘在石頭上的光景。
english: And now, give thought, looking back from this day to the time before one stone was put on another in the Temple of the Lord:

chinese: 在那一切日子，有人來到穀堆，想得二十斗，只得了十斗。有人來到酒池，想得五十桶，只得了二十桶。
english: How, when anyone came to a store of twenty measures, there were only ten: when anyone went to the wine-store to get fifty vessels full, there were only twenty.

chinese: 在你們手下的各樣工作上，我以旱風、霉爛、冰雹攻擊你們，你們仍不歸向我。這是耶和華說的。
english: And I sent burning and wasting and a rain of ice-drops on all the works of your hands; but still you were not turned to me, says the Lord.

chinese: 你們要追想此日以前，就是從這九月二十四日起，追想到立耶和華殿根基的日子。
english: And now, give thought; looking on from this day, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, from the time when the base of the Lord's house was put in its place, give thought to it.

chinese: 倉裡有穀種麼？葡萄樹、無花果樹、石榴樹、橄欖樹都沒有結果子。從今日起，我必賜福與你們。
english: Is the seed still in the store-house? have the vine and the fig-tree, the pomegranate and the olive-tree, still not given their fruit? from this day I will send my blessing on you.

chinese: 這月二十四日，耶和華的話二次臨到哈該說：
english: And the word of the Lord came a second time to Haggai, on the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

chinese: 你要告訴猶大省長所羅巴伯說：我必震動天地。
english: Say to Zerubbabel, ruler of Judah, I will make a shaking of the heavens and the earth,

chinese: 我必傾覆列國的寶座，除滅列邦的勢力，並傾覆戰車和坐在其上的。馬必跌倒，騎馬的敗落，各人被弟兄的刀所殺。
english: Overturning the power of kingdoms; and I will send destruction on the strength of the kingdoms of the nations; by me war-carriages will be overturned with those who are in them; and the horses and the horsemen will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我僕人撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯啊，到那日，我必以你為印，因我揀選了你。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: In that day, says the Lord of armies, I will take you, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, says the Lord, and will make you as a jewelled ring: for I have taken you to be mine, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 大利烏王第二年八月，耶和華的話臨到易多的孫子、比利家的兒子先知撒迦利亞，說：
english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

chinese: 耶和華曾向你們列祖大大發怒。
english: The Lord has been very angry with your fathers:

chinese: 所以你要對以色列人說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要轉向我，我就轉向你們。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And you are to say to them, These are the words of the Lord of armies: Come back to me, says the Lord of armies, and I will come back to you.

chinese: 不要效法你們列祖。從前的先知呼叫他們說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要回頭離開你們的惡道惡行。他們卻不聽，也不順從我。這是耶和華說的。
english: Be not like your fathers, to whom the voice of the earlier prophets came, saying, Be turned now from your evil ways and from your evil doings: but they did not give ear to me or take note, says the Lord.

chinese: 你們的列祖在哪裡呢？那些先知能永遠存活麼？
english: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they go on living for ever?

chinese: 只是我的言語和律例，就是所吩咐我僕人眾先知的，豈不臨到你們列祖麼？他們就回頭，說：萬軍之耶和華定意按我們的行動作為向我們怎樣行，他已照樣行了。
english: But my words and my orders, which I gave to my servants the prophets, have they not overtaken your fathers? and turning back they said, As it was the purpose of the Lord of armies to do to us, in reward for our ways and our doings, so has he done.

chinese: 大利烏第二年十一月，就是細罷特月二十四日，耶和華的話臨到易多的孫子、比利家的兒子先知撒迦利亞，說：
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

chinese: 我夜間觀看，見一人騎著紅馬，站在窪地番石榴樹中間。在他身後又有紅馬、黃馬，和白馬。
english: I saw in the night a man on a red horse, between the mountains in the valley, and at his back were horses, red, black, white, and of mixed colours.

chinese: 我對與我說話的天使說：主啊，這是甚麼意思？他說：我要指示你這是甚麼意思。
english: Then I said, O my lord, what are these? And the angel who was talking to me said to me, I will make clear to you what they are.

chinese: 那站在番石榴樹中間的人說：這是奉耶和華差遣在遍地走來走去的。
english: And the man who was between the mountains, answering me, said, These are those whom the Lord has sent to go up and down through the earth.

chinese: 那些騎馬的對站在番石榴樹中間耶和華的使者說：我們已在遍地走來走去，見全地都安息平靜。
english: And the man who was between the mountains, answering, said to the angel of the Lord, We have gone up and down through the earth, and all the earth is quiet and at rest.

chinese: 於是，耶和華的使者說：萬軍之耶和華啊，你惱恨耶路撒冷和猶大的城邑已經七十年，你不施憐憫要到幾時呢？
english: Then the angel of the Lord, answering, said, O Lord of armies, how long will it be before you have mercy on Jerusalem and on the towns of Judah against which your wrath has been burning for seventy years?

chinese: 耶和華就用美善的安慰話回答那與我說話的天使。
english: And the Lord gave an answer in good and comforting words to the angel who was talking to me.

chinese: 與我說話的天使對我說：你要宣告說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：我為耶路撒冷為錫安，心裡極其火熱。
english: And the angel who was talking to me said to me, Let your voice be loud and say, These are the words of the Lord of armies: I am greatly moved about the fate of Jerusalem and of Zion.

chinese: 我甚惱怒那安逸的列國，因我從前稍微惱怒我民，他們就加害過分。
english: And I am very angry with the nations who are living untroubled: for when I was only a little angry, they made the evil worse.

chinese: 所以耶和華如此說：現今我回到耶路撒冷，仍施憐憫，我的殿必重建在其中，準繩必拉在耶路撒冷之上。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: So this is what the Lord has said: I have come back to Jerusalem with mercies; my house is to be put up in her, says the Lord of armies, and a line is to be stretched out over Jerusalem.

chinese: 你要再宣告說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：我的城邑必再豐盛發達。耶和華必再安慰錫安，揀選耶路撒冷。
english: And again let your voice be loud and say, This is what the Lord of armies has said: My towns will again be overflowing with good things, and again the Lord will give comfort to Zion and take Jerusalem for himself.

chinese: 我舉目觀看，見有四角。
english: And lifting up my eyes I saw four horns.

chinese: 我就問與我說話的天使說：這是甚麼意思？他回答說：這是打散猶大、以色列，和耶路撒冷的角。
english: And I said to the angel who was talking to me, What are these? And he said to me, These are the horns which have sent Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem in flight.

chinese: 耶和華又指四個匠人給我看。
english: And the Lord gave me a vision of four metal-workers.

chinese: 我說：他們來做甚麼呢？他說：這是打散猶大的角，使人不敢抬頭；但這些匠人來威嚇列國，打掉他們的角，就是舉起打散猶大地的角。
english: Then I said, What have these come to do? And he said, These are the horns which sent Judah in flight, and kept him from lifting up his head: but these men have come to send fear on them and to put down the nations who are lifting up their horns against the land of Judah to send it in flight.

chinese: 我又舉目觀看，見一人手拿準繩。
english: And lifting up my eyes, I saw a man with a measuring-line in his hand.

chinese: 我說：你往哪裡去？他對我說：要去量耶路撒冷，看有多寬多長。
english: And I said to him, Where are you going? And he said to me, To take the measure of Jerusalem, to see how wide and how long it is.

chinese: 與我說話的天使去的時候，又有一位天使迎著他來，
english: And the angel who was talking to me went out, and another angel went out, and, meeting him,

chinese: 對他說：你跑去告訴那少年人說，耶路撒冷必有人居住，好像無城牆的鄉村，因為人民和牲畜甚多。
english: Said to him, Go quickly and say to this young man, Jerusalem will be an unwalled town, because of the great number of men and cattle in her.

chinese: 耶和華說：我要作耶路撒冷四圍的火城，並要作其中的榮耀。
english: For I, says the Lord, will be a wall of fire round about her, and I will be the glory inside her.

chinese: 耶和華說：我從前分散你們在天的四方（原文是猶如天的四風），現在你們要從北方之地逃回。這是耶和華說的。
english: Ho, ho! go in flight from the land of the north, says the Lord: for I have sent you far and wide to the four winds of heaven, says the Lord.

chinese: 與巴比倫人同住的錫安民哪，應當逃脫。
english: Ho! Zion, go in flight from danger, you who are living with the daughter of Babylon.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說，在顯出榮耀之後，差遣我去懲罰那擄掠你們的列國，摸你們的就是摸他眼中的瞳人。
english: For this is what the Lord of armies has said: In the way of glory he has sent me to the nations which have taken your goods: for anyone touching you is touching what is most dear to him.

chinese: 看哪，我（或譯：他）要向他們掄手，他們就必作服事他們之人的擄物，你們便知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我了。
english: For at the shaking of my hand over them, their goods will be taken by those who were their servants: and you will see that the Lord of armies has sent me.

chinese: 錫安城啊，應當歡樂歌唱，因為我來要住在你中間。這是耶和華說的。
english: Give songs of joy, O daughter of Zion: for I come, and I will make my resting-place among you, says the Lord.

chinese: 那時，必有許多國歸附耶和華，作他（原文是我）的子民。他（原文是我）要住在你中間，你就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你那裡去了。
english: And a number of nations will be joined to the Lord in that day, and will become my people; and I will be living among you, and you will see that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.

chinese: 耶和華必收回猶大作他聖地的分，也必再揀選耶路撒冷。
english: And Judah will be the Lord's heritage in the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his.

chinese: 凡有血氣的都當在耶和華面前靜默無聲；因為他興起，從聖所出來了。
english: Let all flesh be quiet and make no sound before the Lord: for he is awake and has come from his holy resting-place.

chinese: 天使（原文是他）又指給我看：大祭司約書亞站在耶和華的使者面前；撒但也站在約書亞的右邊，與他作對。
english: And he let me see Joshua, the high priest, in his place before the angel of the Lord, and the Satan at his right hand ready to take up a cause against him.

chinese: 耶和華向撒但說：撒但哪，耶和華責備你！就是揀選耶路撒冷的耶和華責備你！這不是從火中抽出來的一根柴麼？
english: And the Lord said to the Satan, May the Lord's word be sharp against you, O Satan, the word of the Lord who has taken Jerusalem for himself: is this not a burning branch pulled out of the fire?

chinese: 約書亞穿著污穢的衣服站在使者面前。
english: Now Joshua was clothed in unclean robes, and he was in his place before the angel.

chinese: 使者吩咐站在面前的說：你們要脫去他污穢的衣服；又對約書亞說：我使你脫離罪孽，要給你穿上華美的衣服。
english: And he made answer and said to those who were there before him, Take the unclean robes off him, and let him be clothed in clean robes;

chinese: 我說：要將潔淨的冠冕戴在他頭上。他們就把潔淨的冠冕戴在他頭上，給他穿上華美的衣服，耶和華的使者在旁邊站立。
english: And let them put a clean head-dress on his head. So they put a clean head-dress on his head, clothing him with clean robes: and to him he said, See, I have taken your sin away from you.

chinese: 耶和華的使者告誡約書亞說：
english: And the angel of the Lord made a statement to Joshua, and said,

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：你若遵行我的道，謹守我的命令，你就可以管理我的家，看守我的院宇；我也要使你在這些站立的人中間來往。
english: These are the words of the Lord of armies: If you will go in my ways and keep what I have put in your care, then you will be judge over my Temple and have the care of my house, and I will give you the right to come in among those who are there.

chinese: 大祭司約書亞啊，你和坐在你面前的同伴都當聽。他們是作預兆的。我必使我僕人大衛的苗裔發出。
english: Give ear now, O Joshua, the high priest, you and your friends who are seated before you; for these are men who are a sign: for see, I will let my servant the Branch be seen.

chinese: 看哪，我在約書亞面前所立的石頭，在一塊石頭上有七眼。萬軍之耶和華說：我要親自雕刻這石頭，並要在一日之間除掉這地的罪孽。
english: For see, the stone which I have put before Joshua; on one stone are seven eyes: see, the design cut on it will be my work, says the Lord of armies, and I will take away the sin of that land in one day.

chinese: 當那日，你們各人要請鄰舍坐在葡萄樹和無花果樹下。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: In that day, says the Lord of armies, you will be one another's guests under the vine and under the fig-tree.

chinese: 那與我說話的天使又來叫醒我，好像人睡覺被喚醒一樣。
english: And the angel who was talking to me came again, awaking me as a man out of his sleep.

chinese: 他問我說：你看見了甚麼？我說：我看見了一個純金的燈臺，頂上有盞燈，燈臺上有七盞燈，每盞有七個管子。
english: And he said to me, What do you see? And I said, I see a light-support, made all of gold, with its cup on the top of it and seven lights on it; and there are seven pipes to every one of the lights which are on the top of it;

chinese: 旁邊有兩棵橄欖樹，一棵在燈盞的右邊，一棵在燈盞的左邊。
english: And two olive-trees by it, one on the right side of the cup and one on the left.

chinese: 我問與我說話的天使說：主啊，這是甚麼意思？
english: And I made answer and said to the angel who was talking to me, What are these, my lord?

chinese: 與我說話的天使回答我說：你不知道這是甚麼意思麼？我說：主啊，我不知道。
english: Then the angel who was talking to me, answering me, said, Have you no knowledge of what these are? And I said, No, my lord.

chinese: 他對我說：這是耶和華指示所羅巴伯的。萬軍之耶和華說：不是倚靠勢力，不是倚靠才能，乃是倚靠我的靈方能成事。
english: This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel, saying, Not by force or by power, but by my spirit, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 大山哪，你算甚麼呢？在所羅巴伯面前，你必成為平地。他必搬出一塊石頭，安在殿頂上。人且大聲歡呼說：願恩惠恩惠歸與這殿（殿：或譯石）！
english: Who are you, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel you will become level: and he will let all see the headstone, with cries of Grace, grace, to it.

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 所羅巴伯的手立了這殿的根基，他的手也必完成這工，你就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你們這裡來了。
english: The hands of Zerubbabel have put the base of this house in place, and his hands will make it complete; and it will be clear to you that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.

chinese: 誰藐視這日的事為小呢？這七眼乃是耶和華的眼睛，遍察全地，見所羅巴伯手拿線鉈就歡喜。
english: For who has had a poor opinion of the day of small things? for they will be glad when they see the weighted measuring-line in the hand of Zerubbabel. Then he said in answer to me, These seven lights are the eyes of the Lord which go quickly up and down through all the earth.

chinese: 我又問天使說：這燈臺左右的兩棵橄欖樹是甚麼意思？
english: And I made answer and said to him, What are these two olive-trees on the right side of the light-support and on the left?

chinese: 我二次問他說：這兩根橄欖枝在兩個流出金色油的金嘴旁邊是甚麼意思？
english: And answering a second time, I said to him, What are these two olive branches, through whose gold pipes the oil is drained out?

chinese: 他對我說：你不知道這是甚麼意思麼？我說：主啊，我不知道。
english: And he said in answer to me, Have you no knowledge what these are? And I said, No, my lord.

chinese: 他說：這是兩個受膏者站在普天下主的旁邊。
english: And he said, These are the two sons of oil, whose place is by the Lord of all the earth.

chinese: 我又舉目觀看，見有一飛行書卷。
english: Then again lifting up my eyes I saw a roll in flight through the air.

chinese: 他問我說：你看見甚麼？我回答說：我看見一飛行的書卷，長二十肘，寬十肘。
english: And he said to me, What do you see? And I said, A roll going through the air; it is twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.

chinese: 他對我說：這是發出行在遍地上的咒詛。凡偷竊的必按卷上這面的話除滅；凡起假誓的必按卷上那面的話除滅。
english: Then he said to me, This is the curse which goes out over the face of all the land: for long enough has every thief gone without punishment, and long enough has every taker of false oaths gone without punishment.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必使這書卷出去，進入偷竊人的家和指我名起假誓人的家，必常在他家裡，連房屋帶木石都毀滅了。
english: And I will send it out, says the Lord of armies, and it will go into the house of the thief and into the house of him who takes a false oath by my name: and it will be in his house, causing its complete destruction, with its woodwork and its stones.

chinese: 與我說話的天使出來，對我說：你要舉目觀看，見所出來的是甚麼？
english: And the angel who was talking to me went out and said to me, Let your eyes be lifted up now, and see the ephah which is going out.

chinese: 我說：這是甚麼呢？他說：這出來的是量器。他又說：這是惡人在遍地的形狀。
english: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah which is going out. And he said further, This is their evil-doing in all the land.

chinese: （我見有一片圓鉛被舉起來。）這坐在量器中的是個婦人。
english: And I saw a round cover of lead lifted up; and a woman was seated in the middle of the ephah.

chinese: 天使說：這是罪惡。他就把婦人扔在量器中，將那片圓鉛扔在量器的口上。
english: And he said, This is Sin; and pushing her down into the ephah, he put the weight of lead on the mouth of it.

chinese: 我又舉目觀看，見有兩個婦人出來，在他們翅膀中有風，飛得甚快，翅膀如同鸛鳥的翅膀。他們將量器抬起來，懸在天地中間。
english: And lifting up my eyes I saw two women coming out, and the wind was in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they took the ephah, lifting it up between earth and heaven.

chinese: 我問與我說話的天使說：他們要將量器抬到哪裡去呢？
english: And I said to the angel who was talking to me, Where are they taking the ephah?

chinese: 他對我說：要往示拿地去，為他蓋造房屋；等房屋齊備，就把他安置在自己的地方。
english: And he said to me, To make a house for her in the land of Shinar: and they will make a place ready, and put her there in the place which is hers.

chinese: 我又舉目觀看，見有四輛車從兩山中間出來；那山是銅山。
english: And again lifting up my eyes I saw four war-carriages coming out from between the two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.

chinese: 第一輛車套著紅馬，第二輛車套著黑馬。
english: In the first war-carriage were red horses; and in the second, black horses;

chinese: 第三輛車套著白馬，第四輛車套著有斑點的壯馬。
english: And in the third, white horses; and in the fourth, horses of mixed colour.

chinese: 我就問與我說話的天使說：主啊，這是甚麼意思？
english: And I made answer and said to the angel who was talking to me, What are these, my lord?

chinese: 天使回答我說：這是天的四風，是從普天下的主面前出來的。
english: And the angel, answering, said to me, These go out to the four winds of heaven from their place before the Lord of all the earth.

chinese: 套著黑馬的車往北方去，白馬跟隨在後；有斑點的馬往南方去。
english: The carriage in which are the black horses goes in the direction of the north country; the white go to the west; and those of mixed colour go in the direction of the south country.

chinese: 壯馬出來，要在遍地走來走去。天使說：你們只管在遍地走來走去。他們就照樣行了。
english: And the red ones go to the east; and they made request that they might go up and down through the earth: and he said, Go up and down through the earth. So they went up and down through the earth.

chinese: 他又呼叫我說：看哪，往北方去的已在北方安慰我的心。
english: Then crying out to me, he said, See, those who are going to the north country have given rest to the spirit of the Lord in the north country.

chinese: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

chinese: 你要從被擄之人中取黑玳、多比雅、耶大雅的金銀。這三人是從巴比倫來到西番雅的兒子約西亞的家裡。當日你要進他的家，
english: Take the offerings of those who went away as prisoners, from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, and from the family of Josiah, the son of Zephaniah, who have come from Babylon;

chinese: 取這金銀做冠冕，戴在約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞的頭上，
english: And take silver and gold and make a crown and put it on the head of Zerubbabel;

chinese: 對他說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：看哪，那名稱為大衛苗裔的，他要在本處長起來，並要建造耶和華的殿。
english: And say to him, These are the words of the Lord of armies: See, the man whose name is the Branch, under whom there will be fertile growth.

chinese: 他要建造耶和華的殿，並擔負尊榮，坐在位上掌王權；又必在位上作祭司，使兩職之間籌定和平。
english: And he will be the builder of the Temple of the Lord; and the glory will be his, and he will take his place as ruler on the seat of power; and Joshua will be a priest at his right hand, and between them there will be a design of peace.

chinese: 這冠冕要歸希連（就是黑玳）、多比雅、耶大雅，和西番雅的兒子賢（就是約西亞），放在耶和華的殿裡為記念。
english: And the crown will be for grace to Heldai and Tobijah and Jedaiah and the son of Zephaniah, to keep their memory living in the house of the Lord.

chinese: 遠方的人也要來建造耶和華的殿，你們就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你們這裡來。你們若留意聽從耶和華─你們神的話，這事必然成就。
english: And those who are far away will come and be builders in the Temple of the Lord, and it will be clear to you that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.

chinese: 大利烏王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和華的話臨到撒迦利亞。
english: And it came about in the fourth year of King Darius, that the word of the Lord came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month Chislev.

chinese: 那時伯特利人已經打發沙利亞和利堅米勒，並跟從他們的人，去懇求耶和華的恩，
english: Now they of Beth-el had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech to make a request for grace from the Lord,

chinese: 並問萬軍之耶和華殿中的祭司和先知說：我歷年以來，在五月間哭泣齋戒，現在還當這樣行麼？
english: And to say to the priests of the house of the Lord of armies and to the prophets, Am I to go on weeping in the fifth month, separating myself as I have done in past years?

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華的話就臨到我說：
english: Then the word of the Lord of armies came to me, saying

chinese: 你要宣告國內的眾民和祭司，說：你們這七十年，在五月、七月禁食悲哀，豈是絲毫向我禁食麼？
english: Say to all the people of the land and to the priests, When you went without food and gave yourselves to grief in the fifth and the seventh months for these seventy years, did you ever do it because of me?

chinese: 你們吃喝，不是為自己吃，為自己喝麼？
english: And when you are feasting and drinking, are you not doing it only for yourselves?

chinese: 當耶路撒冷和四圍的城邑有居民，正興盛，南地高原有人居住的時候，耶和華藉從前的先知所宣告的話，你們不當聽麼？
english: Are not these the words which the Lord said to you by the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem was full of people and wealth, and the towns round about her and the South and the Lowland were peopled?

chinese: 耶和華的話又臨到撒迦利亞說：
english: And the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, saying,

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華曾對你們的列祖如此說：要按至理判斷，各人以慈愛憐憫弟兄。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Let your judging be upright and done in good faith, let every man have mercy and pity for his brother:

chinese: 不可欺壓寡婦、孤兒、寄居的，和貧窮人。誰都不可心裡謀害弟兄。
english: Do not be hard on the widow, or the child without a father, on the man from a strange country, or on the poor; let there be no evil thought in your heart against your brother.

chinese: 他們卻不肯聽從，扭轉肩頭，塞耳不聽，
english: But they would not give attention, turning their backs and stopping their ears from hearing;

chinese: 使心硬如金鋼石，不聽律法和萬軍之耶和華用靈藉從前的先知所說的話。故此，萬軍之耶和華大發烈怒。
english: And they made their hearts like the hardest stone, so that they might not give ear to the law and the words which the Lord of armies had said by the earlier prophets: and there came great wrath from the Lord of armies.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我曾呼喚他們，他們不聽；將來他們呼求我，我也不聽！
english: And it came about that as they would not give ear to his voice, so I would not give ear to their voice, says the Lord of armies:

chinese: 我必以旋風吹散他們到素不認識的萬國中。這樣，他們的地就荒涼，甚至無人來往經過，因為他們使美好之地荒涼了。
english: But with a storm-wind I sent them in flight among all the nations of whom they had no knowledge. So the land was waste after them, so that no man went through or came back: for they had made waste the desired land.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華的話臨到我說：
