english: And the word of the Lord of armies came to me, saying,

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：我為錫安心裡極其火熱，我為他火熱，向他的仇敵發烈怒。
english: These are the words of the Lord of armies: I am angry about the fate of Zion, I am angry about her with great wrath.

chinese: 耶和華如此說：我現在回到錫安，要住在耶路撒冷中。耶路撒冷必稱為誠實的城，萬軍之耶和華的山必稱為聖山。
english: This is what the Lord has said: I have come back to Zion, and will make my living-place in Jerusalem: and Jerusalem will be named The town of good faith; and the mountain of the Lord of armies The holy mountain.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：將來必有年老的男女坐在耶路撒冷街上，因為年紀老邁就手拿柺杖。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: There will again be old men and old women seated in the open spaces of Jerusalem, every man with his stick in his hand because he is so old.

chinese: 城中街上必滿有男孩女孩玩耍。
english: And the open spaces of the town will be full of boys and girls playing in its open spaces.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：到那日，這事在餘剩的民眼中看為希奇，在我眼中也看為希奇麼？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: If this is a wonder to the rest of this people, is it a wonder to me? says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：我要從東方從西方救回我的民。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: See, I will be the saviour of my people from the east country, and from the west country;

chinese: 我要領他們來，使他們住在耶路撒冷中。他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的神，都憑誠實和公義。
english: And I will make them come and be living in Jerusalem and they will be to me a people and I will be to them a God, in good faith and in righteousness.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：當建造萬軍之耶和華的殿，立根基之日的先知所說的話，現在你們聽見，應當手裡強壯。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Let your hands be strong, you who are now hearing these words from the mouths of the prophets, that is to say, in the days when the base of the house of the Lord of armies has been put in place for the building of the house, that is the Temple.

chinese: 那日以先，人得不著雇價，牲畜也是如此；且因敵人的緣故，出入之人不得平安，乃因我使眾人互相攻擊。
english: For before those days there was no payment for a man's work, or for the use of a beast, and there was no peace for him who went out or him who came in, because of the attacker: for I had every man turned against his neighbour.

chinese: 但如今，我待這餘剩的民必不像從前。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: But now I will not be to the rest of this people as I was in the past, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 因為他們必平安撒種，葡萄樹必結果子，地土必有出產，天也必降甘露。我要使這餘剩的民享受這一切的福。
english: For I will let the seed of peace be planted; the vine will give her fruit and the land will give her increase and the heavens will give their dew; and I will give to the rest of this people all these things for their heritage.

chinese: 猶大家和以色列家啊，你們從前在列國中怎樣成為可咒詛的；照樣，我要拯救你們，使人稱你們為有福的（或譯：使你們叫人得福）。你們不要懼怕，手要強壯。
english: And it will come about that, as you were a curse among the nations, O children of Judah and children of Israel, so I will give you salvation and you will be a blessing: have no fear and let your hands be strong.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們列祖惹我發怒的時候，我怎樣定意降禍，並不後悔。
english: For this is what the Lord of armies has said: As it was my purpose to do evil to you when your fathers made me angry, says the Lord of armies, and my purpose was not changed:

chinese: 現在我照樣定意施恩與耶路撒冷和猶大家，你們不要懼怕。
english: So in these days it is again my purpose to do good to Jerusalem and to the children of Judah: have no fear.

chinese: 你們所當行的是這樣：各人與鄰舍說話誠實，在城門口按至理判斷，使人和睦。
english: These are the things which you are to do: Let every man say what is true to his neighbour; and let your judging give peace in your towns.

chinese: 誰都不可心裡謀害鄰舍，也不可喜愛起假誓，因為這些事都為我所恨惡。這是耶和華說的。
english: Let no one have any evil thought in his heart against his neighbour; and have no love for false oaths: for all these things are hated by me, says the Lord.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華的話臨到我說：
english: And the word of the Lord of armies came to me, saying,

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：四月、五月禁食的日子，七月、十月禁食的日子，必變為猶大家歡喜快樂的日子和歡樂的節期；所以你們要喜愛誠實與和平。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: The times of going without food in the fourth month and in the fifth and the seventh and the tenth months, will be for the people of Judah times of joy and happy meetings; so be lovers of good faith and of peace.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：將來必有列國的人和多城的居民來到。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: It will again come about that when peoples and those living in great towns come,

chinese: 這城的居民必到那城，說：我們要快去懇求耶和華的恩，尋求萬軍之耶和華；我也要去。
english: And the people of one town go to another and say, Let us certainly go with a request for grace from the Lord, and to give worship to the Lord of armies, then I will go with you.

chinese: 必有列邦的人和強國的民來到耶路撒冷尋求萬軍之耶和華，懇求耶和華的恩。
english: And great peoples and strong nations will come to give worship to the Lord of armies in Jerusalem and to make requests for grace from the Lord.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：在那些日子，必有十個人從列國諸族（原文是方言）中出來，拉住一個猶大人的衣襟，說：我們要與你們同去，因為我們聽見神與你們同在了。
english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: In those days, ten men from all the languages of the nations will put out their hands and take a grip of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, We will go with you, for it has come to our ears that God is with you.

chinese: 耶和華的默示應驗在哈得拉地大馬色─世人和以色列各支派的眼目都仰望耶和華─
english: A word of the Lord: The Lord has come to the land of Hadrach, and Damascus is his resting-place: for the towns of Aram are the Lord's,

chinese: 和靠近的哈馬，並推羅、西頓；因為這二城的人大有智慧。
english: As well as Hamath, which is by its limit, and Tyre and Zidon, because they are very wise.

chinese: 推羅為自己修築保障，積蓄銀子如塵沙，堆起精金如街上的泥土。
english: And Tyre made for herself a strong place, and got together silver like dust and the best gold like the earth of the streets.

chinese: 主必趕出他，打敗他海上的權利；他必被火燒滅。
english: See, the Lord will take away her heritage, overturning her power in the sea; and she will be burned up with fire.

chinese: 亞實基倫看見必懼怕；迦薩看見甚痛苦；以革倫因失了盼望蒙羞。迦薩必不再有君王；亞實基倫也不再有居民。
english: Ashkelon will see it with fear, and Gaza, bent with pain; and Ekron, for her hope will be shamed: and the king will be cut off from Gaza, and Ashkelon will be unpeopled.

chinese: 私生子（或譯：外族人）必住在亞實突；我必除滅非利士人的驕傲。
english: And a mixed people will be living in Ashdod, and I will have the pride of the Philistines cut off.

chinese: 我必除去他口中帶血之肉和牙齒內可憎之物。他必作為餘剩的人歸與我們的神，必在猶大像族長；以革倫人必如耶布斯人。
english: And I will take away his blood from his mouth, and his disgusting things from between his teeth; and some of his people will be kept for our God: and he will be as a family in Judah, and Ekron as one living in Jerusalem.

chinese: 我必在我家的四圍安營，使敵軍不得任意往來，暴虐的人也不再經過，因為我親眼看顧我的家。
english: And I will put my forces in position round my house, so that there may be no coming and going: and no cruel master will again go through them: for now I have seen his trouble.

chinese: 錫安的民哪，應當大大喜樂；耶路撒冷的民哪，應當歡呼。看哪，你的王來到你這裡！他是公義的，並且施行拯救，謙謙和和地騎著驢，就是騎著驢的駒子。
english: Be full of joy, O daughter of Zion; give a glad cry, O daughter of Jerusalem: see, your king comes to you: he is upright and has overcome; gentle and seated on an ass, on a young ass.

chinese: 我必除滅以法蓮的戰車和耶路撒冷的戰馬；爭戰的弓也必除滅。他必向列國講和平；他的權柄必從這海管到那海，從大河管到地極。
english: And he will have the war-carriage cut off from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the bow of war will be cut off: and he will say words of peace to the nations: and his rule will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

chinese: 錫安哪，我因與你立約的血，將你中間被擄而囚的人從無水的坑中釋放出來。
english: And as for you, because of the blood of your agreement, I have sent out your prisoners from the deep hole in which there is no water.

chinese: 你們被囚而有指望的人都要轉回保障。我今日說明，我必加倍賜福給你們。
english: And they will come back to you, O daughter of Zion, as prisoners of hope: today I say to you that I will give you back twice as much;

chinese: 我拿猶大作上弦的弓；我拿以法蓮為張弓的箭。錫安哪，我要激發你的眾子，攻擊希利尼（原文是雅完）的眾子，使你如勇士的刀。
english: For I have made Judah a bow bent for my use, I have made Ephraim the arrows of the bow; I will make your sons, O Zion, take up arms against your sons, O Greece, and will make you like the sword of a man of war.

chinese: 耶和華必顯現在他們以上；他的箭必射出像閃電。主耶和華必吹角，乘南方的旋風而行。
english: And the Lord will be seen over them, and his arrow will go out like the thunder-flame: and the Lord God, sounding the war-horn, will go in the storm-winds of the South.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華必保護他們；他們必吞滅仇敵，踐踏彈石。他們必喝血吶喊，猶如飲酒；他們必像盛滿血的碗，又像壇的四角滿了血。
english: The Lord of armies will be a cover for them; and they will overcome, crushing under foot the armed men; they will take their blood for drink like wine: they will be full like the sides of the altar.

chinese: 當那日，耶和華─他們的神必看他的民如群羊，拯救他們；因為他們必像冠冕上的寶石，高舉在他的地以上（或譯：在他的地上發光輝）。
english: And the Lord their God will be their saviour in that day, giving them food like the flock of his people: for they will be like the jewels of a crown shining over his land.

chinese: 他的恩慈何等大！他的榮美何其盛！五穀健壯少男；新酒培養處女。
english: For how good it is and how beautiful! grain will make the young men strong and new wine the virgins.

chinese: 當春雨的時候，你們要向發閃電的耶和華求雨。他必為眾人降下甘霖，使田園生長菜蔬。
english: Make your request to the Lord for rain in the time of the spring rains, even to the Lord who makes the thunder-flames; and he will give them showers of rain, to every man grass in the field.

chinese: 因為，家神所言的是虛空；卜士所見的是虛假；做夢者所說的是假夢。他們白白地安慰人，所以眾人如羊流離，因無牧人就受苦。
english: For the images have said what is not true, and the readers of signs have seen deceit; they have given accounts of false dreams, they give comfort to no purpose: so they go out of the way like sheep, they are troubled because they have no keeper.

chinese: 我的怒氣向牧人發作；我必懲罰公山羊；因我─萬軍之耶和華眷顧自己的羊群，就是猶大家，必使他們如駿馬在陣上。
english: My wrath is burning against the keepers of the flock, and I will send punishment on the he-goats: for the Lord of armies takes care of his flock, the people of Judah, and will make them like the horse of his pride in the fight.

chinese: 房角石、釘子、爭戰的弓，和一切掌權的都從他而出。
english: From him will come the keystone, from him the nail, from him the bow of war, from him will come every ruler;

chinese: 他們必如勇士在陣上將仇敵踐踏在街上的泥土中。他們必爭戰，因為耶和華與他們同在；騎馬的也必羞愧。
english: Together they will be like men of war, crushing down their haters into the earth of the streets in the fight; they will make war because the Lord is with them: and the horsemen will be shamed.

chinese: 我要堅固猶大家，拯救約瑟家，要領他們歸回。我要憐恤他們；他們必像未曾棄絕的一樣，都因我是耶和華─他們的神，我必應允他們的禱告。
english: And I will make the children of Judah strong, and I will be the saviour of the children of Joseph, and I will make them come back again, for I have had mercy on them: they will be as if I had not given them up: for I am the Lord their God and I will give them an answer.

chinese: 以法蓮人必如勇士；他們心中暢快如同喝酒；他們的兒女必看見而快活；他們的心必因耶和華喜樂。
english: And Ephraim will be like a man of war, and their hearts will be glad as with wine; and their children will see it with joy; their hearts will be glad in the Lord.

chinese: 我要發嘶聲，聚集他們，因我已經救贖他們。他們的人數必加增，如從前加增一樣。
english: With the sound of the pipe I will get them together; for I have given the price to make them free: and they will be increased as they were increased.

chinese: 我雖然（或譯：必）播散他們在列國中，他們必在遠方記念我。他們與兒女都必存活，且得歸回。
english: Though I had them planted among the peoples, they will keep me in mind in far countries: and they will take care of their children and will come back.

chinese: 我必再領他們出埃及地，招聚他們出亞述，領他們到基列和利巴嫩；這地尚且不夠他們居住。
english: And I will make them come back out of the land of Egypt, and will get them together out of Assyria; and I will take them into the land of Gilead, and it will not be wide enough for them.

chinese: 耶和華必經過苦海，擊打海浪，使尼羅河的深處都枯乾。亞述的驕傲必致卑微；埃及的權柄必然滅沒。
english: And they will go through the sea of Egypt, and all the deep waters of the Nile will become dry: and the pride of Assyria will be made low, and the power of Egypt will be taken away.

chinese: 我必使他們倚靠我，得以堅固；一舉一動必奉我的名。這是耶和華說的。
english: And their strength will be in the Lord; and their pride will be in his name, says the Lord.

chinese: 利巴嫩哪，開開你的門，任火燒滅你的香柏樹。
english: Let your doors be open, O Lebanon, so that fire may be burning among your cedars.

chinese: 松樹啊，應當哀號；因為香柏樹傾倒，佳美的樹毀壞。巴珊的橡樹啊，應當哀號，因為茂盛的樹林已經倒了。
english: Give a cry of grief, O fir-tree, for the fall of the cedar, because the great ones have been made low: give cries of grief, O you oaks of Bashan, for the strong trees of the wood have come down.

chinese: 聽啊，有牧人哀號的聲音，因他們榮華的草場毀壞了。有少壯獅子咆哮的聲音，因約但河旁的叢林荒廢了。
english: The sound of the crying of the keepers of the flock! for their glory is made waste: the sound of the loud crying of the young lions! for the pride of Jordan is made waste.

chinese: 耶和華─我的神如此說：你─撒迦利亞要牧養這將宰的群羊。
english: This is what the Lord my God has said: Take care of the flock of death;

chinese: 買他們的宰了他們，以自己為無罪；賣他們的說：耶和華是應當稱頌的，因我成為富足。牧養他們的並不憐恤他們。
english: Whose owners put them to death and have no sense of sin; and those who get a price for them say, May the Lord be praised for I have much wealth: and the keepers of the flock have no pity for them.

chinese: 耶和華說：我不再憐恤這地的居民，必將這民交給各人的鄰舍和他們王的手中。他們必毀滅這地，我也不救這民脫離他們的手。
english: For I will have no more pity for the people of the land, says the Lord; but I will give up everyone into his neighbour's hand and into the hand of his king: and they will make the land waste, and I will not keep them safe from their hands.

chinese: 於是，我牧養這將宰的群羊，就是群中最困苦的羊。我拿著兩根杖，一根我稱為榮美，一根我稱為聯索。這樣，我牧養了群羊。
english: So I took care of the flock of death, for those who made profit out of the flock; and I took for myself two rods, naming one Beautiful, and the other Bands; and I took care of the flock.

chinese: 一月之內，我除滅三個牧人，因為我的心厭煩他們；他們的心也憎嫌我。
english: And in one month I put an end to the three keepers of the flock; for my soul was tired of them, and their souls were disgusted with me.

chinese: 我就說：我不牧養你們。要死的，由他死；要喪亡的，由他喪亡；餘剩的，由他們彼此相食。
english: And I said, I will not take care of you: If death comes to any, let death be its fate; if any is cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest take one another's flesh for food.

chinese: 我折斷那稱為榮美的杖，表明我廢棄與萬民所立的約。
english: And I took my rod Beautiful, cutting it in two, so that the Lord's agreement, which he had made with all the peoples, might be broken.

chinese: 當日就廢棄了。這樣，那些仰望我的困苦羊就知道所說的是耶和華的話。
english: And it was broken on that day: and the sheep-traders, who were watching me, were certain that it was the word of the Lord.

chinese: 我對他們說：你們若以為美，就給我工價。不然，就罷了！於是他們給了三十塊錢作為我的工價。
english: And I said to them, If it seems good to you, give me my payment; and if not, do not give it. So they gave me my payment by weight, thirty shekels of silver.

chinese: 耶和華吩咐我說：要把眾人所估定美好的價值丟給窯戶。我便將這三十塊錢，在耶和華的殿中丟給窯戶了。
english: And the Lord said to me, Put it into the store-house, the price at which I was valued by them. And I took the thirty shekels of silver and put them into the store-house in the house of the Lord.

chinese: 我又折斷稱為聯索的那根杖，表明我廢棄猶大與以色列弟兄的情誼。
english: Then I took my other rod, the one named Bands, cutting it in two, so that the relation of brothers between Judah and Israel might be broken.

chinese: 耶和華又吩咐我說：你再取愚昧人所用的器具，
english: And the Lord said to me, Take again the instruments of a foolish keeper of sheep.

chinese: 因我要在這地興起一個牧人。他不看顧喪亡的，不尋找分散的，不醫治受傷的，也不牧養強壯的；卻要吃肥羊的肉，撕裂他的蹄子。
english: For see, I will put a sheep-keeper over the land, who will have no care for that which is cut off, and will not go in search of the wanderers, or make well what is broken, and he will not give food to that which is ill, but he will take for his food the flesh of the fat, and let their feet be broken.

chinese: 無用的牧人丟棄羊群有禍了！刀必臨到他的膀臂和右眼上。他的膀臂必全然枯乾；他的右眼也必昏暗失明。
english: A curse on the foolish keeper who goes away from the flock! the sword will be on his arm and on his right eye: his arm will become quite dry and his eye will be made completely dark.

chinese: 耶和華論以色列的默示。鋪張諸天、建立地基、造人裡面之靈的耶和華說：
english: The word of the Lord about Israel. The Lord by whom the heavens are stretched out and the bases of the earth put in place, and the spirit of man formed inside him, has said:

chinese: 我必使耶路撒冷被圍困的時候，向四圍列國的民成為令人昏醉的杯；這默示也論到猶大（或譯：猶大也是如此）。
english: See, I will make Jerusalem a cup of shaking fear to all the peoples round about, when Jerusalem is shut in.

chinese: 那日，我必使耶路撒冷向聚集攻擊他的萬民當作一塊重石頭；凡舉起的必受重傷。
english: And it will come about in that day that I will make Jerusalem a stone of great weight for all the peoples; all those who take it up will be badly wounded; and all the nations of the earth will come together against it.

chinese: 耶和華說：到那日，我必使一切馬匹驚惶，使騎馬的顛狂。我必看顧猶大家，使列國的一切馬匹瞎眼。
english: In that day, says the Lord, I will put fear into every horse and make every horseman go off his head: and my eyes will be open on the people of Judah, and I will make every horse of the peoples blind.

chinese: 猶大的族長必心裡說：耶路撒冷的居民倚靠萬軍之耶和華─他們的神，就作我們的能力。
english: And the families of Judah will say in their hearts, The people of Jerusalem have their strength in the Lord of armies, their God.

chinese: 那日，我必使猶大的族長如火盆在木柴中，又如火把在禾捆裡；他們必左右燒滅四圍列國的民。耶路撒冷人必仍住本處，就是耶路撒冷。
english: In that day I will make the families of Judah like a pot with fire in it among trees, and like a flaming stick among cut grain; they will send destruction on all the peoples round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem will be living again in the place which is hers, that is, in Jerusalem.

chinese: 耶和華必先拯救猶大的帳棚，免得大衛家的榮耀和耶路撒冷居民的榮耀勝過猶大。
english: And the Lord will give salvation to the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the family of David and the glory of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.

chinese: 那日，耶和華必保護耶路撒冷的居民。他們中間軟弱的必如大衛；大衛的家必如神，如行在他們前面之耶和華的使者。
english: In that day the Lord will be a cover over the people of Jerusalem; and he who is feeble among them in that day will be as strong as David, and the family of David will be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.

chinese: 那日，我必定意滅絕來攻擊耶路撒冷各國的民。
english: And it will come about on that day that I will take in hand the destruction of all the nations who come against Jerusalem.

chinese: 我必將那施恩叫人懇求的靈，澆灌大衛家和耶路撒冷的居民。他們必仰望我（或譯：他；本節同），就是他們所扎的；必為我悲哀，如喪獨生子，又為我愁苦，如喪長子。
english: And I will send down on the family of David and on the people of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of prayer; and their eyes will be turned to the one who was wounded by their hands: and they will be weeping for him as for an only son, and their grief for him will be bitter, like the grief of one sorrowing for his oldest son.

chinese: 那日，耶路撒冷必有大大的悲哀，如米吉多平原之哈達臨門的悲哀。
english: In that day there will be a great weeping in Jerusalem, like the weeping of Hadad-rimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

chinese: 境內一家一家地都必悲哀。大衛家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。拿單家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
english: And the land will give itself to weeping, every family separately; the family of David by themselves, and their wives by themselves; the family of Nathan by themselves, and their wives by themselves;

chinese: 利未家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。示每家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
english: The family of Levi by themselves, and their wives by themselves; the family of Shimei by themselves, and their wives by themselves;

chinese: 其餘的各家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
english: And all the other families by themselves, and their wives by themselves.

chinese: 那日，必給大衛家和耶路撒冷的居民開一個泉源，洗除罪惡與污穢。
english: In that day there will be a fountain open to the family of David and to the people of Jerusalem, for sin and for that which is unclean.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：那日，我必從地上除滅偶像的名，不再被人記念；也必使這地不再有假先知與污穢的靈。
english: And it will come about on that day, says the Lord of armies, that I will have the names of the images cut off out of the land, and there will be no more memory of them: and I will send all the prophets and the unclean spirit away from the land.

chinese: 若再有人說預言，生他的父母必對他說：你不得存活，因為你託耶和華的名說假預言。生他的父母在他說預言的時候，要將他刺透。
english: And if anyone goes on acting as a prophet, then his father and his mother who gave him life will say to him, You may not go on living, for you are saying what is false in the name of the Lord; and his father and his mother will put a sword through him when he does so.

chinese: 那日，凡作先知說預言的必因他所論的異象羞愧，不再穿毛衣哄騙人。
english: And it will come about in that day that the prophets will be shamed, every man on account of his vision, when he is talking as a prophet; and they will not put on a robe of hair for purposes of deceit:

chinese: 他必說：我不是先知，我是耕地的；我從幼年作人的奴僕。
english: But he will say, I am no prophet, but a worker on the land; for I have been an owner of land from the time when I was young.

chinese: 必有人問他說：你兩臂中間是甚麼傷呢？他必回答說：這是我在親友家中所受的傷。
english: And if anyone says to him, What are these wounds between your hands? then he will say, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：刀劍哪，應當興起，攻擊我的牧人和我的同伴。擊打牧人，羊就分散；我必反手加在微小者的身上。
english: Awake! O sword, against the keeper of my flock, and against him who is with me, says the Lord of armies: put to death the keeper of the sheep, and the sheep will go in flight: and my hand will be turned against the little ones.

chinese: 耶和華說：這全地的人，三分之二必剪除而死，三分之一仍必存留。
english: And it will come about that in all the land, says the Lord, two parts of it will be cut off and come to an end; but the third will be still living there.

chinese: 我要使這三分之一經火，熬煉他們，如熬煉銀子；試煉他們，如試煉金子。他們必求告我的名，我必應允他們。我要說：這是我的子民。他們也要說：耶和華是我們的神。
english: And I will make the third part go through the fire, cleaning them as silver is made clean, and testing them as gold is tested: and they will make their prayer to me and I will give them an answer: I will say, It is my people; and they will say, The Lord is my God.

chinese: 耶和華的日子臨近，你的財物必被搶掠，在你中間分散。
english: See, a day of the Lord is coming when they will make division of your goods taken by force before your eyes.

chinese: 因為我必聚集萬國與耶路撒冷爭戰，城必被攻取，房屋被搶奪，婦女被玷污，城中的民一半被擄去；剩下的民仍在城中，不致剪除。
english: For I will get all the nations together to make war against Jerusalem; and the town will be overcome, and the goods taken from the houses, and the women taken by force: and half the town will go away as prisoners, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the town.

chinese: 那時，耶和華必出去與那些國爭戰，好像從前爭戰一樣。
english: Then the Lord will go out and make war against those nations, as he did in the day of the fight.

chinese: 那日，他的腳必站在耶路撒冷前面朝東的橄欖山上。這山必從中間分裂，自東至西成為極大的谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。
english: And in that day his feet will be on the Mount of Olives, which is opposite Jerusalem on the east, and the Mount of Olives will be parted in the middle to the east and to the west, forming a very great valley; and half the mountain will be moved to the north and half of it to the south.

chinese: 你們要從我山的谷中逃跑，因為山谷必延到亞薩。你們逃跑，必如猶大王烏西雅年間的人逃避大地震一樣。耶和華─我的神必降臨，有一切聖者同來。
english: And the valley will be stopped ... and you will go in flight as you went in flight from the earth-shock in the days of Uzziah, king of Judah: and the Lord my God will come, and all his holy ones with him.

chinese: 那日，必沒有光，三光必退縮。
english: And in that day there will be no heat or cold or ice;

chinese: 那日，必是耶和華所知道的，不是白晝，也不是黑夜，到了晚上才有光明。
english: And it will be unbroken day, such as the Lord has knowledge of, without change of day and night, and even at nightfall it will be light.

chinese: 那日，必有活水從耶路撒冷出來，一半往東海流，一半往西海流；冬夏都是如此。
english: And on that day living waters will go out from Jerusalem; half of them flowing to the sea on the east and half to the sea on the west: in summer and in winter it will be so.

chinese: 耶和華必作全地的王。那日耶和華必為獨一無二的，他的名也是獨一無二的。
english: And the Lord will be King over all the earth: in that day there will be one Lord and his name one.

chinese: 全地，從迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的臨門，要變為亞拉巴。耶路撒冷必仍居高位，就是從便雅憫門到第一門之處，又到角門，並從哈楠業樓，直到王的酒醡。
english: And all the land will become like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and be living in her place; from the doorway of Benjamin to the place of the first doorway, to the doorway of the angle, and from the tower of Hananel to the king's wine-crushing places, men will be living in her.

chinese: 人必住在其中，不再有咒詛。耶路撒冷人必安然居住。
english: And there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will be living without fear of danger.

chinese: 耶和華用災殃攻擊那與耶路撒冷爭戰的列國人，必是這樣：他們兩腳站立的時候，肉必消沒，眼在眶中乾癟，吞在口中潰爛。
english: And this will be the disease which the Lord will send on all the peoples which have been warring against Jerusalem: their flesh will be wasted away while they are on their feet, their eyes will be wasted in their heads and their tongues in their mouths.

chinese: 那日，耶和華必使他們大大擾亂。他們各人彼此揪住，舉手攻擊。
english: And it will be on that day that a great fear will be sent among them from the Lord; and everyone will take his neighbour's hand, and every man's hand will be lifted against his neighbour's.

chinese: 猶大也必在耶路撒冷爭戰。那時四圍各國的財物，就是許多金銀衣服，必被收聚。
english: And even Judah will be fighting against Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the nations round about will be massed together, a great store of gold and silver and clothing.

chinese: 那臨到馬匹、騾子、駱駝、驢，和營中一切牲畜的災殃是與那災殃一般。
english: And the horses and the transport beasts, the camels and the asses and all the beasts in those tents will be attacked by the same disease.

chinese: 所有來攻擊耶路撒冷列國中剩下的人，必年年上來敬拜大君王─萬軍之耶和華，並守住棚節。
english: And it will come about that everyone who is still living, of all those nations who came against Jerusalem, will go up from year to year to give worship to the King, the Lord of armies, and to keep the feast of tents.

chinese: 地上萬族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王─萬軍之耶和華的，必無雨降在他們的地上。
english: And it will be that if any one of all the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to give worship to the King, the Lord of armies, on them there will be no rain.

chinese: 埃及族若不上來，雨也不降在他們的地上；凡不上來守住棚節的列國人，耶和華也必用這災攻擊他們。
english: And if the family of Egypt does not go up or come there, they will be attacked by the disease which the Lord will send on the nations:

chinese: 這就是埃及的刑罰和那不上來守住棚節之列國的刑罰。
english: This will be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations who do not go up to keep the feast of tents.

chinese: 當那日，馬的鈴鐺上必有歸耶和華為聖的這句話。耶和華殿內的鍋必如祭壇前的碗一樣。
english: On that day all the bells of the horses will be holy to the Lord, and the pots in the Lord's house will be like the basins before the altar.

chinese: 凡耶路撒冷和猶大的鍋都必歸萬軍之耶和華為聖。凡獻祭的都必來取這鍋，煮肉在其中。當那日，在萬軍之耶和華的殿中必不再有迦南人。
english: And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the Lord of armies: and all those who make offerings will come and take them for boiling their offerings: in that day there will be no more traders in the house of the Lord of armies.

chinese: 耶和華藉瑪拉基傳給以色列的默示。
english: The word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.

chinese: 耶和華說：我曾愛你們。你們卻說：你在何事上愛我們呢？耶和華說：以掃不是雅各的哥哥麼？我卻愛雅各，
english: You have been loved by me, says the Lord. But you say, Where was your love for us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? says the Lord: but Jacob was loved by me,

chinese: 惡以掃，使他的山嶺荒涼，把他的地業交給曠野的野狗。
english: And Esau was hated, and I sent destruction on his mountains, and gave his heritage to the beasts of the waste land.

chinese: 以東人說：我們現在雖被毀壞，卻要重建荒廢之處。萬軍之耶和華如此說：任他們建造，我必拆毀；人必稱他們的地為罪惡之境；稱他們的民為耶和華永遠惱怒之民。
english: Though Edom says, We are crushed down but we will come back, building up the waste places; this is what the Lord of armies has said: They may put up buildings, but I will have them pulled down; and they will be named The land of evil-doing, and The people against whom the Lord keeps his wrath for ever.

chinese: 你們必親眼看見，也必說：願耶和華在以色列境界之外被尊為大！
english: And your eyes will see it; and you will say, The Lord is great even outside the limits of Israel.

chinese: 藐視我名的祭司啊，萬軍之耶和華對你們說：兒子尊敬父親，僕人敬畏主人；我既為父親，尊敬我的在哪裡呢？我既為主人，敬畏我的在哪裡呢？你們卻說：我們在何事上藐視你的名呢？
english: A son gives honour to his father, and a servant has fear of his master: if then I am a father, where is my honour? and if I am a master, where is the fear of me? says the Lord of armies to you, O priests, who give no value to my name. And you say, How have we not given value to your name?

chinese: 你們將污穢的食物獻在我的壇上，且說：我們在何事上污穢你呢？因你們說，耶和華的桌子是可藐視的。
english: You put unclean bread on my altar. And you say, How have we made it unclean? By your saying, The table of the Lord is of no value.

chinese: 你們將瞎眼的獻為祭物，這不為惡麼？將瘸腿的、有病的獻上，這不為惡麼？你獻給你的省長，他豈喜悅你，豈能看你的情面麼？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And when you give what is blind for an offering, it is no evil! and when you give what is damaged and ill, it is no evil! Give it now to your ruler; will he be pleased with you, or will you have his approval? says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 現在我勸你們懇求神，他好施恩與我們。這妄獻的事，既由你們經手，他豈能看你們的情面麼？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And now, make request for the grace of God so that he may have mercy on us: this has been your doing: will he give his approval to any of you? says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 甚願你們中間有一人關上殿門，免得你們徒然在我壇上燒火。萬軍之耶和華說：我不喜悅你們，也不從你們手中收納供物。
english: If only there was one among you who would see that the doors were shut, so that you might not put a light to the fire on my altar for nothing! I have no pleasure in you, says the Lord of armies, and I will not take an offering from your hands.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：從日出之地到日落之處，我的名在外邦中必尊為大。在各處，人必奉我的名燒香，獻潔淨的供物，因為我的名在外邦中必尊為大。
english: For, from the coming up of the sun till its going down, my name is great among the Gentiles; and in every place the smell of burning flesh is offered to my name, and a clean offering: for my name is great among the Gentiles, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 你們卻褻瀆我的名，說：耶和華的桌子是污穢的，其上的食物是可藐視的。
english: But you make it unholy by saying, The Lord's table has become unclean, and his food is of no value.

chinese: 你們又說：這些事何等煩瑣！並嗤之以鼻。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。你們把搶奪的、瘸腿的、有病的拿來獻上為祭。我豈能從你們手中收納呢？這是耶和華說的。
english: And you say, See, what a weariness it is! and you let out your breath at it, says the Lord of armies; and you have given what has been cut about by beasts, and what is damaged in its feet and ill; this is the offering you give: will this be pleasing to me from your hands? says the Lord.

chinese: 行詭詐的在群中有公羊，他許願卻用有殘疾的獻給主，這人是可咒詛的。因為我是大君王，我的名在外邦中是可畏的。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: A curse on the false man who has a male in his flock, and takes his oath, and gives to the Lord a damaged thing: for I am a great King, says the Lord of armies, and my name is to be feared among the Gentiles.

chinese: 眾祭司啊，這誡命是傳給你們的。
english: And now, O you priests, this order is for you.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：你們若不聽從，也不放在心上，將榮耀歸與我的名，我就使咒詛臨到你們，使你們的福分變為咒詛；因你們不把誡命放在心上，我已經咒詛你們了。
english: If you will not give ear and take it to heart, to give glory to my name, says the Lord of armies, then I will send the curse on you and will put a curse on your blessing: truly, even now I have put a curse on it, because you do not take it to heart.

chinese: 我必斥責你們的種子，又把你們犧牲的糞抹你們的臉上；你們要與糞一同除掉。
english: See, I will have your arm cut off, and will put waste on your faces, even the waste from your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

chinese: 你們就知道我傳這誡命給你們，使我與利未（或譯：利未人）所立的約可以常存。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And you will be certain that I have sent this order to you, so that it might be my agreement with Levi, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 我曾與他立生命和平安的約。我將這兩樣賜給他，使他存敬畏的心，他就敬畏我，懼怕我的名。
english: My agreement with him was on my side life and peace, and I gave them to him; on his side fear, and he had fear of me and gave honour to my name.

chinese: 真實的律法在他口中，他嘴裡沒有不義的話。他以平安和正直與我同行，使多人回頭離開罪孽。
english: True teaching was in his mouth, and no evil was seen on his lips: he was walking with me in peace and righteousness, turning numbers of people away from evil-doing.

chinese: 祭司的嘴裡當存知識，人也當由他口中尋求律法，因為他是萬軍之耶和華的使者。
english: For it is right for the priest's lips to keep knowledge, and for men to be waiting for the law from his mouth: for he is the servant sent from the Lord of armies.

chinese: 你們卻偏離正道，使許多人在律法上跌倒。你們廢棄我與利未所立的約。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: But you are turned out of the way; you have made the law hard for numbers of people; you have made the agreement of Levi of no value, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 所以我使你們被眾人藐視，看為下賤；因你們不守我的道，竟在律法上瞻徇情面。
english: And so I have taken away your honour and made you low before all the people, even as you have not kept my ways, and have given no thought to me in using the law.

chinese: 我們豈不都是一位父麼？豈不是一位神所造的麼？我們各人怎麼以詭詐待弟兄，背棄了神與我們列祖所立的約呢？
english: Have we not all one father? has not one God made us? why are we, every one of us, acting falsely to his brother, putting shame on the agreement of our fathers?

chinese: 猶大人行事詭詐，並且在以色列和耶路撒冷中行一件可憎的事；因為猶大人褻瀆耶和華所喜愛的聖潔（或譯：聖地），娶事奉外邦神的女子為妻。
english: Judah has been acting falsely, and a disgusting thing has been done in Jerusalem; for Judah has made unclean the holy place of the Lord which is dear to him, and has taken as his wife the daughter of a strange god.

chinese: 凡行這事的，無論何人（何人：原文是叫醒的，答應的），就是獻供物給萬軍之耶和華，耶和華也必從雅各的帳棚中剪除他。
english: The Lord will have the man who does this cut off root and branch out of the tents of Jacob, and him who makes an offering to the Lord of armies.

chinese: 你們又行了一件這樣的事，使前妻歎息哭泣的眼淚遮蓋耶和華的壇，以致耶和華不再看顧那供物，也不樂從你們手中收納。
english: And this again you do: covering the altar of the Lord with weeping and with grief, so that he gives no more thought to the offering, and does not take it with pleasure from your hand.

chinese: 你們還說：這是為甚麼呢？因耶和華在你和你幼年所娶的妻中間作見證。他雖是你的配偶，又是你盟約的妻，你卻以詭詐待他。
english: But you say, For what reason? Because the Lord has been a witness between you and the wife of your early years, to whom you have been untrue, though she is your friend and the wife to whom you have given your word.

chinese: 雖然神有靈的餘力能造多人，他不是單造一人麼？為何只造一人呢？乃是他願人得虔誠的後裔。所以當謹守你們的心，誰也不可以詭詐待幼年所娶的妻。
english: ... So give thought to your spirit, and let no one be false to the wife of his early years.

chinese: 耶和華─以色列的神說：休妻的事和以強暴待妻的人都是我所恨惡的！所以當謹守你們的心，不可行詭詐。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: For I am against the putting away of a wife, says the Lord, the God of Israel, and against him who is clothed with violent acts, says the Lord of armies: so give thought to your spirit and do not be false in your acts.

chinese: 你們用言語煩瑣耶和華，你們還說：我們在何事上煩瑣他呢？因為你們說：凡行惡的，耶和華眼看為善，並且他喜悅他們；或說：公義的神在哪裡呢？
english: You have made the Lord tired with your words. And still you say, How have we made him tired? By your saying, Everyone who does evil is good in the eyes of the Lord, and he has delight in them; or, Where is God the judge?

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我要差遣我的使者在我前面預備道路。你們所尋求的主必忽然進入他的殿；立約的使者，就是你們所仰慕的，快要來到。
english: See, I am sending my servant, and he will make ready the way before me; and the Lord, whom you are looking for, will suddenly come to his Temple; and the angel of the agreement, in whom you have delight, see, he is coming, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 他來的日子，誰能當得起呢？他顯現的時候，誰能立得住呢？因為他如煉金之人的火，如漂布之人的鹼。
english: But by whom may the day of his coming be faced? and who may keep his place when he is seen? for he is like the metal-tester's fire and the cleaner's soap.

chinese: 他必坐下如煉淨銀子的，必潔淨利未人，熬煉他們像金銀一樣；他們就憑公義獻供物給耶和華。
english: He will take his seat, testing and cleaning the sons of Levi, burning away the evil from them as from gold and silver; so that they may make offerings to the Lord in righteousness.

chinese: 那時，猶大和耶路撒冷所獻的供物必蒙耶和華悅納，彷彿古時之日、上古之年。
english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to the Lord, as in days gone by, and as in past years.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必臨近你們，施行審判。我必速速作見證，警戒行邪術的、犯姦淫的、起假誓的、虧負人之工價的、欺壓寡婦孤兒的、屈枉寄居的，和不敬畏我的。
english: And I will come near to you for judging; I will quickly be a witness against the wonder-workers, against those who have been untrue in married life, against those who take false oaths; against those who keep back from the servant his payment, and who are hard on the widow and the child without a father, who do not give his rights to the man from a strange country, and have no fear of me, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 因我─耶和華是不改變的，所以你們雅各之子沒有滅亡。
english: For I am the Lord, I am unchanged; and so you, O sons of Jacob, have not been cut off.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：從你們列祖的日子以來，你們常常偏離我的典章而不遵守。現在你們要轉向我，我就轉向你們。你們卻問說：我們如何才是轉向呢？
english: From the days of your fathers you have been turned away from my rules and have not kept them. Come back to me, and I will come back to you, says the Lord of armies. But you say, How are we to come back?

chinese: 人豈可奪取神之物呢？你們竟奪取我的供物。你們卻說：我們在何事上奪取你的供物呢？就是你們在當納的十分之一和當獻的供物上。
english: Will a man keep back from God what is right? But you have kept back what is mine. But you say, What have we kept back from you? Tenths and offerings.

chinese: 因你們通國的人都奪取我的供物，咒詛就臨到你們身上。
english: You are cursed with a curse; for you have kept back from me what is mine, even all this nation.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：你們要將當納的十分之一全然送入倉庫，使我家有糧，以此試試我，是否為你們敞開天上的窗戶，傾福與你們，甚至無處可容。
english: Let your tenths come into the store-house so that there may be food in my house, and put me to the test by doing so, says the Lord of armies, and see if I do not make the windows of heaven open and send down such a blessing on you that there is no room for it.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必為你們斥責蝗蟲（原文是吞噬者），不容他毀壞你們的土產。你們田間的葡萄樹在未熟之先也不掉果子。
english: And on your account I will keep back the locusts from wasting the fruits of your land; and the fruit of your vine will not be dropped on the field before its time, says the Lord of armies

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：萬國必稱你們為有福的，因你們的地必成為喜樂之地。
english: And you will be named happy by all nations: for you will be a land of delight, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 耶和華說：你們用話頂撞我，你們還說：我們用甚麼話頂撞了你呢？
english: Your words have been strong against me, says the Lord. And still you say, What have we said against you?

chinese: 你們說：事奉神是徒然的，遵守神所吩咐的，在萬軍之耶和華面前苦苦齋戒，有甚麼益處呢？
english: You have said, It is no use worshipping God: what profit have we had from keeping his orders, and going in clothing of sorrow before the Lord of armies?

chinese: 如今我們稱狂傲的人為有福，並且行惡的人得建立；他們雖然試探神，卻得脫離災難。
english: And now to us the men of pride seem happy; yes, the evil-doers are doing well; they put God to the test and are safe.

chinese: 那時，敬畏耶和華的彼此談論，耶和華側耳而聽，且有紀念冊在他面前，記錄那敬畏耶和華、思念他名的人。
english: Then those in whom was the fear of the Lord had talk together: and the Lord gave ear, and it was recorded in a book to be kept in mind before him, for those who had the fear of the Lord and gave thought to his name.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：在我所定的日子，他們必屬我，特特歸我。我必憐恤他們，如同人憐恤服事自己的兒子。
english: And they will be mine, says the Lord, in the day when I make them my special property; and I will have mercy on them as a man has mercy on his son who is his servant.

chinese: 那時你們必歸回，將善人和惡人，事奉神的和不事奉神的，分別出來。
english: Then you will again see how the upright man is different from the sinner, and the servant of God from him who is not.

chinese: 萬軍之耶和華說：那日臨近，勢如燒著的火爐，凡狂傲的和行惡的必如碎秸，在那日必被燒盡，根本枝條一無存留。
english: For see, the day is coming, it is burning like an oven; all the men of pride and all who do evil will be dry stems of grass: and in the day which is coming they will be burned up, says the Lord of armies, till they have not a root or a branch.

chinese: 但向你們敬畏我名的人必有公義的日頭出現，其光線（原文是翅膀）有醫治之能。你們必出來跳躍如圈裡的肥犢。
english: But to you who give worship to my name, the sun of righteousness will come up with new life in its wings; and you will go out, playing like young oxen full of food.

chinese: 你們必踐踏惡人；在我所定的日子，他們必如灰塵在你們腳掌之下。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
english: And the evil-doers will be crushed under you, they will be dust under your feet, in the day when I do my work, says the Lord of armies.

chinese: 你們當記念我僕人摩西的律法，就是我在何烈山為以色列眾人所吩咐他的律例典章。
english: Keep in mind the law of Moses, my servant, which I gave him in Horeb for all Israel, even the rules and the decisions.

chinese: 看哪，耶和華大而可畏之日未到以前，我必差遣先知以利亞到你們那裡去。
english: See, I am sending you Elijah the prophet before the day of the Lord comes, that great day, greatly to be feared.

chinese: 他必使父親的心轉向兒女，兒女的心轉向父親，免得我來咒詛遍地。
english: And by him the hearts of fathers will be turned to their children, and the hearts of children to their fathers; for fear that I may come and put the earth under a curse.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕的後裔，大衛的子孫（後裔子孫原文都作兒子下同），耶穌基督的家譜：
english: The book of the generations of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生猶大和他的弟兄；
english: The son of Abraham was Isaac; and the son of Isaac was Jacob; and the sons of Jacob were Judah and his brothers;

chinese: 猶大從他瑪氏生法勒斯和謝拉；法勒斯生希斯崙；希斯崙生亞蘭；
english: And the sons of Judah were Perez and Zerah by Tamar; and the son of Perez was Hezron; and the son of Hezron was Ram;

chinese: 亞蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順；拿順生撒門；
english: And the son of Ram was Amminadab; and the son of Amminadab was Nahshon; and the son of Nahshon was Salmon;

chinese: 撒門從喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯從路得氏生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；
english: And the son of Salmon by Rahab was Boaz; and the son of Boaz by Ruth was Obed; and the son of Obed was Jesse;

chinese: 耶西生大衛王。大衛從烏利亞的妻子生所羅門；
english: And the son of Jesse was David the king; and the son of David was Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah;

chinese: 所羅門生羅波安；羅波安生亞比雅；亞比雅生亞撒；
english: And the son of Solomon was Rehoboam; and the son of Rehoboam was Abijah; and the son of Abijah was Asa;

chinese: 亞撒生約沙法；約沙法生約蘭；約蘭生烏西亞；
english: And the son of Asa was Jehoshaphat; and the son of Jehoshaphat was Joram; and the son of Joram was Uzziah;

chinese: 烏西亞生約坦；約坦生亞哈斯；亞哈斯生希西家；
english: And the son of Uzziah was Jotham; and the son of Jotham was Ahaz; and the son of Ahaz was Hezekiah;

chinese: 希西家生瑪拿西；瑪拿西生亞們；亞們生約西亞；
english: And the son of Hezekiah was Manasseh; and the son of Manasseh was Amon; and the son of Amon was Josiah;

chinese: 百姓被遷到巴比倫的時候，約西亞生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。
english: And the sons of Josiah were Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the taking away to Babylon.

chinese: 遷到巴比倫之後，耶哥尼雅生撒拉鐵；撒拉鐵生所羅巴伯；
english: And after the taking away to Babylon, Jechoniah had a son Shealtiel; and Shealtiel had Zerubbabel;

chinese: 所羅巴伯生亞比玉；亞比玉生以利亞敬；以利亞敬生亞所；
english: And Zerubbabel had Abiud; and Abiud had Eliakim; and Eliakim had Azor;

chinese: 亞所生撒督；撒督生亞金；亞金生以律；
english: And Azor had Zadok; and Zadok had Achim; and Achim had Eliud;

chinese: 以律生以利亞撒；以利亞撒生馬但；馬但生雅各；
english: And Eliud had Eleazar; and Eleazar had Matthan; and Matthan had Jacob;

chinese: 雅各生約瑟，就是馬利亞的丈夫。那稱為基督的耶穌是從馬利亞生的。
english: And the son of Jacob was Joseph the husband of Mary, who gave birth to Jesus, whose name is Christ.

chinese: 這樣，從亞伯拉罕到大衛共有十四代；從大衛到遷至巴比倫的時候也有十四代；從遷至巴比倫的時候到基督又有十四代。
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David to the taking away to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the taking away to Babylon to the coming of Christ, fourteen generations.

chinese: 耶穌基督降生的事記在下面：他母親馬利亞已經許配了約瑟，還沒有迎娶，馬利亞就從聖靈懷了孕。
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was in this way: when his mother Mary was going to be married to Joseph, before they came together the discovery was made that she was with child by the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 他丈夫約瑟是個義人，不願意明明的羞辱他，想要暗暗的把他休了。
english: And Joseph, her husband, being an upright man, and not desiring to make her a public example, had a mind to put her away privately.

chinese: 正思念這事的時候，有主的使者向他夢中顯現，說：大衛的子孫約瑟，不要怕！只管娶過你的妻子馬利亞來，因他所懷的孕是從聖靈來的。
english: But when he was giving thought to these things, an angel of the Lord came to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, have no fear of taking Mary as your wife; because that which is in her body is of the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 他將要生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫耶穌，因他要將自己的百姓從罪惡裡救出來。
english: And she will give birth to a son; and you will give him the name Jesus; for he will give his people salvation from their sins.

chinese: 這一切的事成就是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，
english: Now all this took place so that the word of the Lord by the prophet might come true,

chinese: 說：必有童女懷孕生子；人要稱他的名為以馬內利。（以馬內利翻出來就是神與我們同在。）
english: See, the virgin will be with child, and will give birth to a son, and they will give him the name Immanuel, that is, God with us.

chinese: 約瑟醒了，起來，就遵著主使者的吩咐把妻子娶過來；
english: And Joseph did as the angel of the Lord had said to him, and took her as his wife;

chinese: 只是沒有和他同房，等他生了兒子（有古卷：等他生了頭胎的兒子），就給他起名叫耶穌。
english: And he had no connection with her till she had given birth to a son; and he gave him the name Jesus.

chinese: 當希律王的時候，耶穌生在猶太的伯利恆。有幾個博士從東方來到耶路撒冷，說：
english: Now when the birth of Jesus took place in Beth-lehem of Judaea, in the days of Herod the king, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

chinese: 那生下來作猶太人之王的在那裡？我們在東方看見他的星，特來拜他。
english: Saying, Where is the King of the Jews whose birth has now taken place? We have seen his star in the east and have come to give him worship.

chinese: 希律王聽見了，就心裡不安；耶路撒冷合城的人也都不安。
english: And when it came to the ears of Herod the king, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

chinese: 他就召齊了祭司長和民間的文士，問他們說：基督當生在何處？
english: And he got together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, questioning them as to where the birth-place of the Christ would be.

chinese: 他們回答說：在猶太的伯利恆。因為有先知記著，說：
english: And they said to him, In Beth-lehem of Judaea; for so it is said in the writings of the prophet,

chinese: 猶大地的伯利恆阿，你在猶大諸城中並不是最小的；因為將來有一位君王要從你那裡出來，牧養我以色列民。
english: You Beth-lehem, in the land of Judah, are not the least among the chiefs of Judah: out of you will come a ruler, who will be the keeper of my people Israel.

chinese: 當下，希律暗暗的召了博士來，細問那星是甚麼時候出現的，
english: Then Herod sent for the wise men privately, and put questions to them about what time the star had been seen.

chinese: 就差他們往伯利恆去，說：你們去仔細尋訪那小孩子，尋到了，就來報信，我也好去拜他。
english: And he sent them to Beth-lehem and said, Go and make certain where the young child is; and when you have seen him, let me have news of it, so that I may come and give him worship.

chinese: 他們聽見王的話就去了。在東方所看見的那星忽然在他們前頭行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上頭停住了。
english: And after hearing the king, they went on their way; and the star which they saw in the east went before them, till it came to rest over the place where the young child was.

chinese: 他們看見那星，就大大的歡喜；
english: And when they saw the star they were full of joy.

chinese: 進了房子，看見小孩子和他母親馬利亞，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭開寶盒，拿黃金、乳香、沒藥為禮物獻給他。
english: And they came into the house, and saw the young child with Mary, his mother; and falling down on their faces they gave him worship; and from their store they gave him offerings of gold, perfume, and spices.

chinese: 博士因為在夢中被主指示不要回去見希律，就從別的路回本地去了。
english: And it was made clear to them by God in a dream that they were not to go back to Herod; so they went into their country by another way.

chinese: 他們去後，有主的使者向約瑟夢中顯現，說：起來！帶著小孩子同他母親逃往埃及，住在那裡，等我吩咐你；因為希律必尋找小孩子，要除滅他。
english: And when they had gone, an angel of the Lord came to Joseph in a dream, saying, Get up and take the young child and his mother, and go into Egypt, and do not go from there till I give you word; for Herod will be searching for the young child to put him to death.

chinese: 約瑟就起來，夜間帶著小孩子和他母親往埃及去，
english: So he took the young child and his mother by night, and went into Egypt;

chinese: 住在那裡，直到希律死了。這是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，說：我從埃及召出我的兒子來。
english: And was there till the death of Herod; so that the word of the Lord through the prophet might come true, Out of Egypt have I sent for my son.

chinese: 希律見自己被博士愚弄，就大大發怒，差人將伯利恆城裡並四境所有的男孩，照著他向博士仔細查問的時候，凡兩歲以裡的，都殺盡了。
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he had been tricked by the wise men, was very angry; and he sent out, and put to death all the male children in Beth-lehem and in all the parts round about it, from two years old and under, acting on the knowledge which he had got with care from the wise men.

chinese: 這就應了先知耶利米的話，說：
english: Then the word of Jeremiah the prophet came true,

chinese: 在拉瑪聽見號咷大哭的聲音，是拉結哭他兒女，不肯受安慰，因為他們都不在了。
english: In Ramah there was a sound of weeping and great sorrow, Rachel weeping for her children, and she would not be comforted for their loss.

chinese: 希律死了以後，有主的使者在埃及向約瑟夢中顯現，說：
english: But when Herod was dead, an angel of the Lord came in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

chinese: 起來！帶著小孩子和他母親往以色列地去，因為要害小孩子性命的人已經死了。
english: Saying, Get up and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: because they who were attempting to take the young child's life are dead.

chinese: 約瑟就起來，把小孩子和他母親帶到以色列地去；
english: And he got up, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

chinese: 只因聽見亞基老接著他父親希律作了猶太王，就怕往那裡去，又在夢中被主指示，便往加利利境內去了，
english: But when it came to his ears that Archelaus was ruling over Judaea in the place of his father Herod, he was in fear of going there; and God having given him news of the danger in a dream, he went out of the way into the country parts of Galilee.

chinese: 到了一座城，名叫拿撒勒，就住在那裡。這是要應驗先知所說，他將稱為拿撒勒人的話了。
english: And he came and was living in a town named Nazareth: so that the word of the prophets might come true, He will be named a Nazarene.

chinese: 那時，有施洗的約翰出來，在猶太的曠野傳道，說：
english: And in those days John the Baptist came preaching in the waste land of Judaea,

chinese: 天國近了，你們應當悔改！
english: Saying, Let your hearts be turned from sin; for the kingdom of heaven is near.

chinese: 這人就是先知以賽亞所說的。他說：在曠野有人聲喊著說：預備主的道，修直他的路！
english: For this is he of whom Isaiah the prophet said, The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight.

chinese: 這約翰身穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
english: Now John was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.

chinese: 那時，耶路撒冷和猶太全地，並約但河一帶地方的人，都出去到約翰那裡，
english: Then Jerusalem and all Judaea went out to him, and all the people from near Jordan;

chinese: 承認他們的罪，在約但河裡受他的洗。
english: And they were given baptism by him in the river Jordan, saying openly that they had done wrong.

chinese: 約翰看見許多法利賽人和撒都該人也來受洗，就對他們說：毒蛇的種類！誰指示你們逃避將來的忿怒呢？
english: But when he saw a number of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, Offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?

chinese: 你們要結出果子來，與悔改的心相稱。
english: Let your change of heart be seen in your works:

chinese: 不要自己心裡說：有亞伯拉罕為我們的祖宗。我告訴你們，神能從這些石頭中給亞伯拉罕興起子孫來。
english: And say not to yourselves, We have Abraham for our father; because I say to you that God is able from these stones to make children for Abraham.

chinese: 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裡。
english: And even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; every tree then which does not give good fruit is cut down, and put into the fire.

chinese: 我是用水給你們施洗，叫你們悔改。但那在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是給他提鞋也不配。他要用聖靈與火給你們施洗。
english: Truly, I give baptism with water to those of you whose hearts are changed; but he who comes after me is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to take up: he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit and with fire:

chinese: 他手裡拿著簸箕，要揚淨他的場，把麥子收在倉裡，把糠用不滅的火燒盡了。
english: In whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned up in the fire which will never be put out.

chinese: 當下耶穌從加利利來到約但河，見了約翰，要受他的洗。
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to John at the Jordan, to be given baptism by him.

chinese: 約翰想要攔住他，說：我當受你的洗，你反倒上我這裡來麼？
english: But John would have kept him back, saying, It is I who have need of baptism from you, and do you come to me?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你暫且許我，因為我們理當這樣盡諸般的義（或作：禮）。於是約翰許了他。
english: But Jesus made answer, saying to him, Let it be so now: because so it is right for us to make righteousness complete. Then he gave him baptism.

chinese: 耶穌受了洗，隨即從水裡上來。天忽然為他開了，他就看見神的靈彷彿鴿子降下，落在他身上。
english: And Jesus, having been given baptism, straight away went up from the water; and, the heavens opening, he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him as a dove;

chinese: 從天上有聲音說：這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。
english: And a voice came out of heaven, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

chinese: 當時，耶穌被聖靈引到曠野，受魔鬼的試探。
english: Then Jesus was sent by the Spirit into the waste land to be tested by the Evil One.

chinese: 他禁食四十晝夜，後來就餓了。
english: And after going without food for forty days and forty nights, he was in need of it.

chinese: 那試探人的進前來，對他說：你若是神的兒子，可以吩咐這些石頭變成食物。
english: And the Evil One came and said to him, If you are the Son of God, give the word for these stones to become bread.

chinese: 耶穌卻回答說：經上記著說：人活著，不是單靠食物，乃是靠神口裡所出的一切話。
english: But he made answer and said, It is in the Writings, Bread is not man's only need, but every word which comes out of the mouth of God.

chinese: 魔鬼就帶他進了聖城，叫他站在殿頂（頂：原文是翅）上，
english: Then the Evil One took him to the holy town; and he put him on the highest point of the Temple and said to him,

chinese: 對他說：你若是神的兒子，可以跳下去，因為經上記著說：主要為你吩咐他的使者用手托著你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。
english: If you are the Son of God, let yourself go down; for it is in the Writings, He will give his angels care over you; and, In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：經上又記著說：不可試探主─你的神。
english: Jesus said to him, Again it is in the Writings, You may not put the Lord your God to the test.

chinese: 魔鬼又帶他上了一座最高的山，將世上的萬國與萬國的榮華都指給他看，
english: Again, the Evil One took him up to a very high mountain, and let him see all the kingdoms of the world and the glory of them;

chinese: 對他說：你若俯伏拜我，我就把這一切都賜給你。
english: And he said to him, All these things will I give you, if you will go down on your face and give me worship.

chinese: 耶穌說：撒但（撒但就是抵擋的意思，乃魔鬼的別名），退去罷！因為經上記著說：當拜主你的神，單要事奉他。
english: Then said Jesus to him, Away, Satan: for it is in the Writings, Give worship to the Lord your God and be his servant only.

chinese: 於是，魔鬼離了耶穌，有天使來伺候他。
english: Then the Evil One went away from him, and angels came and took care of him.

chinese: 耶穌聽見約翰下了監，就退到加利利去；
english: Now when it came to his ears that John had been put in prison, he went away to Galilee;

chinese: 後又離開拿撒勒，往迦百農去，就住在那裡。那地方靠海，在西布倫和拿弗他利的邊界上。
english: And going away from Nazareth, he came and made his living-place in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the country of Zebulun and Naphtali:

chinese: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，
english: So that the word of the prophet Isaiah might come true,

chinese: 說：西布倫地，拿弗他利地，就是沿海的路，約但河外，外邦人的加利利地。
english: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, by the way of the sea, the other side of Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

chinese: 那坐在黑暗裡的百姓看見了大光；坐在死蔭之地的人有光發現照著他們。
english: The people who were in the dark saw a great light, and to those in the land of the shade of death did the dawn come up.

chinese: 從那時候，耶穌就傳起道來，說：天國近了，你們應當悔改！
english: From that time Jesus went about preaching and saying, Let your hearts be turned from sin, for the kingdom of heaven is near.

chinese: 耶穌在加利利海邊行走，看見弟兄二人，就是那稱呼彼得的西門和他兄弟安得烈，在海裡撒網；他們本是打魚的。
english: And when he was walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon, whose other name was Peter, and Andrew, his brother, who were putting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。
english: And he said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

chinese: 他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。
english: And straight away they let go the nets and went after him.

chinese: 從那裡往前走，又看見弟兄二人，就是西庇太的兒子雅各和他兄弟約翰，同他們的父親西庇太在船上補網，耶穌就招呼他們，
english: And going on from there he saw two other brothers, James, the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, in the boat with their father, stitching up their nets; and he said, Come.

chinese: 他們立刻捨了船，別了父親，跟從了耶穌。
english: And they went straight from the boat and their father and came after him.

chinese: 耶穌走遍加利利，在各會堂裡教訓人，傳天國的福音，醫治百姓各樣的病症。
english: And Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their Synagogues and preaching the good news of the kingdom, and making well those who were ill with any disease among the people.

chinese: 他的名聲就傳遍了敘利亞。那裡的人把一切害病的，就是害各樣疾病、各樣疼痛的和被鬼附的、癲癇的、癱瘓的，都帶了來，耶穌就治好了他們。
english: And news of him went out through all Syria; and they took to him all who were ill with different diseases and pains, those having evil spirits and those who were off their heads, and those who had no power of moving. And he made them well.

chinese: 當下，有許多人從加利利、低加波利、耶路撒冷、猶太、約但河外來跟著他。
english: And there went after him great numbers from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judaea and from the other side of Jordan.

chinese: 耶穌看見這許多的人，就上了山，既已坐下，門徒到他跟前來，
english: And seeing great masses of people he went up into the mountain; and when he was seated his disciples came to him.

chinese: 他就開口教訓他們，說：
english: And with these words he gave them teaching, saying,

chinese: 虛心的人有福了！因為天國是他們的。
english: Happy are the poor in spirit: for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.

chinese: 哀慟的人有福了！因為他們必得安慰。
english: Happy are those who are sad: for they will be comforted.

chinese: 溫柔的人有福了！因為他們必承受地土。
english: Happy are the gentle: for the earth will be their heritage.

chinese: 飢渴慕義的人有福了！因為他們必得飽足。
english: Happy are those whose heart's desire is for righteousness: for they will have their desire.

chinese: 憐恤人的人有福了！因為他們必蒙憐恤。
english: Happy are those who have mercy: for they will be given mercy.

chinese: 清心的人有福了！因為他們必得見神。
english: Happy are the clean in heart: for they will see God.

chinese: 使人和睦的人有福了！因為他們必稱為神的兒子。
english: Happy are the peacemakers: for they will be named sons of God.

chinese: 為義受逼迫的人有福了！因為天國是他們的。
english: Happy are those who are attacked on account of righteousness: for the kingdom of heaven will be theirs.

chinese: 人若因我辱罵你們，逼迫你們，捏造各樣壞話毀謗你們，你們就有福了！
english: Happy are you when men give you a bad name, and are cruel to you, and say all evil things against you falsely, because of me.

chinese: 應當歡喜快樂，因為你們在天上的賞賜是大的。在你們以前的先知，人也是這樣逼迫他們。
english: Be glad and full of joy; for great is your reward in heaven: for so were the prophets attacked who were before you.

chinese: 你們是世上的鹽。鹽若失了味，怎能叫他再鹹呢？以後無用，不過丟在外面，被人踐踏了。
english: You are the salt of the earth; but if its taste goes from the salt, how will you make it salt again? it is then good for nothing but to be put out and crushed under foot by men.

chinese: 你們是世上的光。城造在山上是不能隱藏的。
english: You are the light of the world. A town put on a hill may be seen by all.

chinese: 人點燈，不放在斗底下，是放在燈臺上，就照亮一家的人。
english: And a burning light is not put under a vessel, but on its table; so that its rays may be shining on all who are in the house.

chinese: 你們的光也當這樣照在人前，叫他們看見你們的好行為，便將榮耀歸給你們在天上的父。
english: Even so let your light be shining before men, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.

chinese: 莫想我來要廢掉律法和先知。我來不是要廢掉，乃是要成全。
english: Let there be no thought that I have come to put an end to the law or the prophets. I have not come for destruction, but to make complete.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，就是到天地都廢去了，律法的一點一畫也不能廢去，都要成全。
english: Truly I say to you, Till heaven and earth come to an end, not the smallest letter or part of a letter will in any way be taken from the law, till all things are done.

chinese: 所以，無論何人廢掉這誡命中最小的一條，又教訓人這樣作，他在天國要稱為最小的。但無論何人遵行這誡命，又教訓人遵行，他在天國要稱為大的。
english: Whoever then goes against the smallest of these laws, teaching men to do the same, will be named least in the kingdom of heaven; but he who keeps the laws, teaching others to keep them, will be named great in the kingdom of heaven.

chinese: 我告訴你們，你們的義若不勝於文士和法利賽人的義，斷不能進天國。
english: For I say to you, If your righteousness is not greater than the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never go into the kingdom of heaven.

chinese: 你們聽見有吩咐古人的話，說：不可殺人；又說：凡殺人的難免受審判。
english: You have knowledge that it was said in old times, You may not put to death; and, Whoever puts to death will be in danger of being judged:

chinese: 只是我告訴你們：凡（有古卷在凡字下加：無緣無故地）向弟兄動怒的，難免受審斷；凡罵弟兄是拉加的，難免公會的審斷；凡罵弟兄是魔利的，難免地獄的火。
english: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother will be in danger of being judged; and he who says to his brother, Raca, will be in danger from the Sanhedrin; and whoever says, You foolish one, will be in danger of the hell of fire.

chinese: 所以，你在祭壇上獻禮物的時候，若想起弟兄向你懷怨，
english: If then you are making an offering at the altar and there it comes to your mind that your brother has something against you,

chinese: 就把禮物留在壇前，先去同弟兄和好，然後來獻禮物。
english: While your offering is still before the altar, first go and make peace with your brother, then come and make your offering.

chinese: 你同告你的對頭還在路上，就趕緊與他和息，恐怕他把你送給審判官，審判官交付衙役，你就下在監裡了。
english: Come to an agreement quickly with him who has a cause against you at law, while you are with him on the way, for fear that he may give you up to the judge and the judge may give you to the police and you may be put into prison.

chinese: 我實在告訴你，若有一文錢沒有還清，你斷不能從那裡出來。
english: Truly I say to you, You will not come out from there till you have made payment of the very last farthing.

chinese: 你們聽見有話說：不可姦淫。
english: You have knowledge that it was said, You may not have connection with another man's wife:

chinese: 只是我告訴你們，凡看見婦女就動淫念的，這人心裡已經與他犯姦淫了。
english: But I say to you that everyone whose eyes are turned on a woman with desire has had connection with her in his heart.

chinese: 若是你的右眼叫你跌倒，就剜出來丟掉，寧可失去百體中的一體，不叫全身丟在地獄裡。
english: And if your right eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out and put it away from you; because it is better to undergo the loss of one part, than for all your body to go into hell.

chinese: 若是右手叫你跌倒，就砍下來丟掉，寧可失去百體中的一體，不叫全身下入地獄。
english: And if your right hand is a cause of trouble to you, let it be cut off and put it away from you; because it is better to undergo the loss of one part, than for all your body to go into hell.

chinese: 又有話說：人若休妻，就當給他休書。
english: Again, it was said, Whoever puts away his wife has to give her a statement in writing for this purpose:

chinese: 只是我告訴你們，凡休妻的，若不是為淫亂的緣故，就是叫他作淫婦了；人若娶這被休的婦人，也是犯姦淫了。
english: But I say to you that everyone who puts away his wife for any other cause but the loss of her virtue, makes her false to her husband; and whoever takes her as his wife after she is put away, is no true husband to her.

chinese: 你們又聽見有吩咐古人的話，說：不可背誓，所起的誓總要向主謹守。
english: Again, you have knowledge that it was said in old times, Do not take false oaths, but give effect to your oaths to the Lord:

chinese: 只是我告訴你們，甚麼誓都不可起。不可指著天起誓，因為天是神的座位；
english: But I say to you, Take no oaths at all: not by the heaven, because it is the seat of God;

chinese: 不可指著地起誓，因為地是他的腳凳；也不可指著耶路撒冷起誓，因為耶路撒冷是大君的京城；
english: Or by the earth, because it is the resting-place for his foot; or by Jerusalem, because it is the town of the great King.

chinese: 又不可指著你的頭起誓，因為你不能使一根頭髮變黑變白了。
english: You may not take an oath by your head, because you are not able to make one hair white or black.

chinese: 你們的話，是，就說是；不是，就說不是；若再多說，就是出於那惡者（或作：就是從惡裡出來的）。
english: But let your words be simply, Yes or No: and whatever is more than these is of the Evil One.

chinese: 你們聽見有話說：以眼還眼，以牙還牙。
english: You have knowledge that it was said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

chinese: 只是我告訴你們，不要與惡人作對。有人打你的右臉，連左臉也轉過來由他打；
english: But I say to you, Do not make use of force against an evil man; but to him who gives you a blow on the right side of your face let the left be turned.

chinese: 有人想要告你，要拿你的裡衣，連外衣也由他拿去；
english: And if any man goes to law with you and takes away your coat, do not keep back your robe from him.

chinese: 有人強逼你走一里路，你就同他走二里；
english: And whoever makes you go one mile, go with him two.

chinese: 有求你的，就給他；有向你借貸的，不可推辭。
english: Give to him who comes with a request, and keep not your property from him who would for a time make use of it.

chinese: 你們聽見有話說：當愛你的鄰舍，恨你的仇敵。
english: You have knowledge that it was said, Have love for your neighbour, and hate for him who is against you:

chinese: 只是我告訴你們，要愛你們的仇敵，為那逼迫你們的禱告。
english: But I say to you, Have love for those who are against you, and make prayer for those who are cruel to you;

chinese: 這樣就可以作你們天父的兒子；因為他叫日頭照好人，也照歹人；降雨給義人，也給不義的人。
english: So that you may be the sons of your Father in heaven; for his sun gives light to the evil and to the good, and he sends rain on the upright man and on the sinner.

chinese: 你們若單愛那愛你們的人，有甚麼賞賜呢？就是稅吏不也是這樣行麼？
english: For if you have love for those who have love for you, what credit is it to you? do not the tax-farmers the same?

chinese: 你們若單請你弟兄的安，比人有甚麼長處呢？就是外邦人不也是這樣行麼？
english: And if you say, Good day, to your brothers only, what do you do more than others? do not even the Gentiles the same?

chinese: 所以，你們要完全，像你們的天父完全一樣。
english: Be then complete in righteousness, even as your Father in heaven is complete.

chinese: 你們要小心，不可將善事行在人的面前，故意叫他們看見，若是這樣，就不能得你們天父的賞賜了。
english: Take care not to do your good works before men, to be seen by them; or you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.

chinese: 所以，你施捨的時候，不可在你面前吹號，像那假冒為善的人在會堂裡和街道上所行的，故意要得人的榮耀。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
english: When then you give money to the poor, do not make a noise about it, as the false-hearted men do in the Synagogues and in the streets, so that they may have glory from men. Truly, I say to you, They have their reward.

chinese: 你施捨的時候，不要叫左手知道右手所做的，
english: But when you give money, let not your left hand see what your right hand does:

chinese: 要叫你施捨的事行在暗中。你父在暗中察看，必然報答你（有古卷：必在明處報答你）。
english: So that your giving may be in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.

chinese: 你們禱告的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，愛站在會堂裡和十字路口上禱告，故意叫人看見。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
english: And when you make your prayers, be not like the false-hearted men, who take pleasure in getting up and saying their prayers in the Synagogues and at the street turnings so that they may be seen by men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.

chinese: 你禱告的時候，要進你的內屋，關上門，禱告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。
english: But when you make your prayer, go into your private room, and, shutting the door, say a prayer to your Father in secret, and your Father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.

chinese: 你們禱告，不可像外邦人，用許多重複話，他們以為話多了必蒙垂聽。
english: And in your prayer do not make use of the same words again and again, as the Gentiles do: for they have the idea that God will give attention to them because of the number of their words.

chinese: 你們不可效法他們；因為你們沒有祈求以先，你們所需用的，你們的父早已知道了。
english: So be not like them; because your Father has knowledge of your needs even before you make your requests to him.

chinese: 所以，你們禱告要這樣說：我們在天上的父：願人都尊你的名為聖。
english: Let this then be your prayer: Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

chinese: 願你的國降臨；願你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。
english: Let your kingdom come. Let your pleasure be done, as in heaven, so on earth.

chinese: 我們日用的飲食，今日賜給我們。
english: Give us this day bread for our needs.

chinese: 免我們的債，如同我們免了人的債。
english: And make us free of our debts, as we have made those free who are in debt to us.

chinese: 不叫我們遇見試探；救我們脫離兇惡（或作：脫離惡者）。因為國度、權柄、榮耀，全是你的，直到永遠。阿們（有古卷沒有因為……阿們等字）！
english: And let us not be put to the test, but keep us safe from the Evil One.

chinese: 你們饒恕人的過犯，你們的天父也必饒恕你們的過犯；
english: For if you let men have forgiveness for their sins, you will have forgiveness from your Father in heaven.

chinese: 你們不饒恕人的過犯，你們的天父也必不饒恕你們的過犯。
english: But if you do not let men have forgiveness for their sins, you will not have forgiveness from your Father for your sins.

chinese: 你們禁食的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，臉上帶著愁容；因為他們把臉弄得難看，故意叫人看出他們是禁食。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
english: And when you go without food, be not sad-faced as the false-hearted are. For they go about with changed looks, so that men may see that they are going without food. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.

chinese: 你禁食的時候，要梳頭洗臉，
english: But when you go without food, put oil on your head and make your face clean;

chinese: 不叫人看出你禁食來，只叫你暗中的父看見；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。
english: So that no one may see that you are going without food, but your Father in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.

chinese: 不要為自己積儹財寶在地上；地上有蟲子咬，能�壞，也有賊挖窟窿來偷。
english: Make no store of wealth for yourselves on earth, where it may be turned to dust by worms and weather, and where thieves may come in by force and take it away.

chinese: 只要積儹財寶在天上；天上沒有蟲子咬，不能�壞，也沒有賊挖窟窿來偷。
english: But make a store for yourselves in heaven, where it will not be turned to dust and where thieves do not come in to take it away:

chinese: 因為你的財寶在那裡，你的心也在那裡。
english: For where your wealth is, there will your heart be.

chinese: 眼睛就是身上的燈。你的眼睛若瞭亮，全身就光明；
english: The light of the body is the eye; if then your eye is true, all your body will be full of light.

chinese: 你的眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。你裡頭的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等大呢！
english: But if your eye is evil, all your body will be dark. If then the light which is in you is dark, how dark it will be!

chinese: 一個人不能事奉兩個主；不是惡這個，愛那個，就是重這個，輕那個。你們不能又事奉神，又事奉瑪門（瑪門：財利的意思）。
english: No man is able to be a servant to two masters: for he will have hate for the one and love for the other, or he will keep to one and have no respect for the other. You may not be servants of God and of wealth.

chinese: 所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮吃甚麼，喝甚麼；為身體憂慮穿甚麼。生命不勝於飲食麼？身體不勝於衣裳麼？
english: So I say to you, Take no thought for your life, about food or drink, or about clothing for your body. Is not life more than food, and the body more than its clothing?

chinese: 你們看那天上的飛鳥，也不種，也不收，也不積蓄在倉裡，你們的天父尚且養活他。你們不比飛鳥貴重得多麼？
english: See the birds of heaven; they do not put seeds in the earth, they do not get in grain, or put it in store-houses; and your Father in heaven gives them food. Are you not of much more value than they?

chinese: 你們那一個能用思慮使壽數多加一刻呢（或作：使身量多加一肘呢）？
english: And which of you by taking thought is able to make himself a cubit taller?

chinese: 何必為衣裳憂慮呢？你想野地裡的百合花怎麼長起來；他也不勞苦，也不紡線。
english: And why are you troubled about clothing? See the flowers of the field, how they come up; they do no work, they make no thread:

chinese: 然而我告訴你們，就是所羅門極榮華的時候，他所穿戴的，還不如這花一朵呢！
english: But I say to you that even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.

chinese: 你們這小信的人哪！野地裡的草今天還在，明天就丟在爐裡，神還給他這樣的妝飾，何況你們呢！
english: But if God gives such clothing to the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is put into the oven, will he not much more give you clothing, O you of little faith?

chinese: 所以，不要憂慮說：吃甚麼？喝甚麼？穿甚麼？
english: Then do not be full of care, saying, What are we to have for food or drink? or, With what may we be clothed?

chinese: 這都是外邦人所求的，你們需用的這一切東西，你們的天父是知道的。
english: Because the Gentiles go in search of all these things: for your Father in heaven has knowledge that you have need of all these things:

chinese: 你們要先求他的國和他的義，這些東西都要加給你們了。
english: But let your first care be for his kingdom and his righteousness; and all these other things will be given to you in addition.

chinese: 所以，不要為明天憂慮，因為明天自有明天的憂慮；一天的難處一天當就夠了。
english: Then have no care for tomorrow: tomorrow will take care of itself. Take the trouble of the day as it comes.

chinese: 你們不要論斷人，免得你們被論斷。
english: Be not judges of others, and you will not be judged.

chinese: 因為你們怎樣論斷人，也必怎樣被論斷；你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。
english: For as you have been judging, so you will be judged, and with your measure will it be measured to you.

chinese: 為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中有刺，卻不想自己眼中有梁木呢？
english: And why do you take note of the grain of dust in your brother's eye, but take no note of the bit of wood which is in your eye?

chinese: 你自己眼中有梁木，怎能對你弟兄說：容我去掉你眼中的刺呢？
english: Or how will you say to your brother, Let me take out the grain of dust from your eye, when you yourself have a bit of wood in your eye?

chinese: 你這假冒為善的人！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，然後才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。
english: You false one, first take out the bit of wood from your eye, then will you see clearly to take out the grain of dust from your brother's eye.

chinese: 不要把聖物給狗，也不要把你們的珍珠丟在豬前，恐怕他踐踏了珍珠，轉過來咬你們。
english: Do not give that which is holy to the dogs, or put your jewels before pigs, for fear that they will be crushed under foot by the pigs whose attack will then be made against you.

chinese: 你們祈求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
english: Make a request, and it will be answered; what you are searching for you will get; give the sign, and the door will be open to you:

chinese: 因為凡祈求的，就得著；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。
english: Because to everyone who makes a request, it will be given; and he who is searching will get his desire, and to him who gives the sign, the door will be open.

chinese: 你們中間誰有兒子求餅，反給他石頭呢？
english: Or which of you, if his son makes a request for bread, will give him a stone?

chinese: 求魚，反給他蛇呢？
english: Or if he makes a request for a fish, will give him a snake?

chinese: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道拿好東西給兒女，何況你們在天上的父，豈不更把好東西給求他的人麼？
english: If you, then, being evil, are able to give good things to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who make requests to him?

chinese: 所以，無論何事，你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人，因為這就是律法和先知的道理。
english: All those things, then, which you would have men do to you, even so do you to them: because this is the law and the prophets.

chinese: 你們要進窄門。因為引到滅亡，那門是寬的，路是大的，進去的人也多；
english: Go in by the narrow door; for wide is the door and open is the way which goes to destruction, and great numbers go in by it.

chinese: 引到永生，那門是窄的，路是小的，找著的人也少。
english: For narrow is the door and hard the road to life, and only a small number make discovery of it.

chinese: 你們要防備假先知。他們到你們這裡來，外面披著羊皮，裡面卻是殘暴的狼。
english: Be on the watch for false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inside they are cruel wolves.

chinese: 憑著他們的果子，就可以認出他們來。荊棘上豈能摘葡萄呢？蒺藜裡豈能摘無花果呢？
english: By their fruits you will get knowledge of them. Do men get grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

chinese: 這樣，凡好樹都結好果子，惟獨壞樹結壞果子。
english: Even so, every good tree gives good fruit; but the bad tree gives evil fruit.

chinese: 好樹不能結壞果子；壞樹不能結好果子。
english: It is not possible for a good tree to give bad fruit, and a bad tree will not give good fruit.

chinese: 凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裡。
english: Every tree which does not give good fruit is cut down and put in the fire.

chinese: 所以，憑著他們的果子就可以認出他們來。
english: So by their fruits you will get knowledge of them.

chinese: 凡稱呼我主阿，主阿的人不能都進天國；惟獨遵行我天父旨意的人才能進去。
english: Not everyone who says to me, Lord, Lord, will go into the kingdom of heaven; but he who does the pleasure of my Father in heaven.

chinese: 當那日必有許多人對我說：主阿，主阿，我們不是奉你的名傳道，奉你的名趕鬼，奉你的名行許多異能麼？
english: A great number will say to me on that day, Lord, Lord, were we not prophets in your name, and did we not by your name send out evil spirits, and by your name do works of power?

chinese: 我就明明的告訴他們說：我從來不認識你們，你們這些作惡的人，離開我去罷！
english: And then will I say to them, I never had knowledge of you: go from me, you workers of evil.

chinese: 所以，凡聽見我這話就去行的，好比一個聰明人，把房子蓋在磐石上；
english: Everyone, then, to whom my words come and who does them, will be like a wise man who made his house on a rock;

chinese: 雨淋，水沖，風吹，撞著那房子，房子總不倒塌，因為根基立在磐石上。
english: And the rain came down and there was a rush of waters and the winds were driving against that house, but it was not moved; because it was based on the rock.

chinese: 凡聽見我這話不去行的，好比一個無知的人，把房子蓋在沙土上；
english: And everyone to whom my words come and who does them not, will be like a foolish man who made his house on sand;

chinese: 雨淋，水沖，風吹，撞著那房子，房子就倒塌了，並且倒塌得很大。
english: And the rain came down and there was a rush of waters and the winds were driving against that house; and it came down and great was its fall.

chinese: 耶穌講完了這些話，眾人都希奇他的教訓；
english: And it came about, when Jesus had come to the end of these words, that the people were surprised at his teaching,

chinese: 因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像他們的文士。
english: for he was teaching as one having authority, and not as their scribes.

chinese: 耶穌下了山，有許多人跟著他。
english: And when he had come down from the mountain, great numbers of people came after him.

chinese: 有一個長大痲瘋的來拜他，說：主若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。
english: And a leper came and gave him worship, saying, Lord, if it is your pleasure, you have power to make me clean.

chinese: 耶穌伸手摸他，說：我肯，你潔淨了罷！他的大痲瘋立刻就潔淨了。
english: And he put his hand on him, saying, It is my pleasure; be clean. And straight away he was made clean.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你切不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，獻上摩西所吩咐的禮物，對眾人作證據。
english: And Jesus said to him, See that you say nothing about this to anyone; but go and let the priest see you and make the offering which was ordered by Moses, for a witness to them.

chinese: 耶穌進了迦百農，有一個百夫長進前來，求他說：
english: And when Jesus was come into Capernaum, a certain captain came to him with a request,

chinese: 主阿，我的僕人害癱瘓病，躺在家裡，甚是疼苦。
english: Saying, Lord, my servant is ill in bed at the house, with no power in his body, and in great pain.

chinese: 耶穌說：我去醫治他。
english: And he said to him, I will come and make him well.

chinese: 百夫長回答說：主阿，你到我舍下，我不敢當；只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必好了。
english: And the captain in answer said, Lord, I am not good enough for you to come under my roof; but only say the word, and my servant will be made well.

chinese: 因為我在人的權下，也有兵在我以下；對這個說：去！他就去；對那個說：來！他就來；對我的僕人說：你作這事！他就去作。
english: Because I myself am a man under authority, having under me fighting men; and I say to this one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.

chinese: 耶穌聽見就希奇，對跟從的人說：我實在告訴你們，這麼大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也沒有遇見過。
english: And when these words came to the ears of Jesus he was surprised, and said to those who came after him, Truly I say to you, I have not seen such great faith, no, not in Israel.

chinese: 我又告訴你們，從東從西，將有許多人來，在天國裡與亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各一同坐席；
english: And I say to you that numbers will come from the east and the west, and will take their seats with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven:

chinese: 惟有本國的子民竟被趕到外邊黑暗裡去，在那裡必要哀哭切齒了。
english: But the sons of the kingdom will be put out into the dark, and there will be weeping and cries of pain.

chinese: 耶穌對百夫長說：你回去罷！照你的信心，給你成全了。那時，他的僕人就好了。
english: And Jesus said to the captain, Go in peace; as your faith is, so let it be done to you. And the servant was made well in that hour.

chinese: 耶穌到了彼得家裡，見彼得的岳母害熱病躺著。
english: And when Jesus had come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother in bed, very ill.

chinese: 耶穌把他的手一摸，熱就退了；他就起來服事耶穌。
english: And he put his hand on hers and the disease went from her, and she got up and took care of his needs.

chinese: 到了晚上，有人帶著許多被鬼附的來到耶穌跟前，他只用一句話就把鬼都趕出去，並且治好了一切有病的人。
english: And in the evening, they took to him a number of people who had evil spirits; and he sent the spirits out of them with a word, and made well all who were ill;

chinese: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：他代替我們的軟弱，擔當我們的疾病。
english: So that the word of Isaiah the prophet might come true: He himself took our pains and our diseases.

chinese: 耶穌見許多人圍著他，就吩咐渡到那邊去。
english: Now when Jesus saw a great mass of people about him, he gave an order to go to the other side.

chinese: 有一個文士來，對他說：夫子，你無論往那裡去，我要跟從你。
english: And there came a scribe and said to him, Master, I will come after you wherever you go.

chinese: 耶穌說：狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，人子卻沒有枕頭的地方。
english: And Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of heaven have a resting-place; but the Son of man has nowhere to put his head.

chinese: 又有一個門徒對耶穌說：主阿，容我先回去埋葬我的父親。
english: And another of the disciples said to him, Lord, let me first go and give the last honours to my father.

chinese: 耶穌說：任憑死人埋葬他們的死人；你跟從我罷！
english: But Jesus said to him, Come after me; and let the dead take care of their dead.

chinese: 耶穌上了船，門徒跟著他。
english: And when he had got into a boat, his disciples went after him.

chinese: 海裡忽然起了暴風，甚至船被波浪掩蓋；耶穌卻睡著了。
english: And there came up a great storm in the sea, so that the boat was covered with the waves: but he was sleeping.

chinese: 門徒來叫醒了他，說：主阿，救我們，我們喪命啦！
english: And they came to him, and, awaking him, said, Help, Lord; destruction is near.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們這小信的人哪，為甚麼膽怯呢？於是起來，斥責風和海，風和海就大大的平靜了。
english: And he said to them, Why are you full of fear, O you of little faith? Then he got up and gave orders to the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

chinese: 眾人希奇，說：這是怎樣的人？連風和海也聽從他了！
english: And the men were full of wonder, saying, What sort of man is this, that even the winds and the sea do his orders?

chinese: 耶穌既渡到那邊去，來到加大拉人的地方，就有兩個被鬼附的人從墳塋裡出來迎著他，極其兇猛，甚至沒有人能從那條路上經過。
english: And when he had come to the other side, to the country of the Gadarenes, there came out to him from the place of the dead, two who had evil spirits, so violent that no man was able to go that way.

chinese: 他們喊著說：神的兒子，我們與你有甚麼相干？時候還沒有到，你就上這裡來叫我們受苦麼？
english: And they gave a loud cry, saying, What have we to do with you, you Son of God? Have you come here to give us punishment before the time?

chinese: 離他們很遠，有一大群豬吃食。
english: Now there was, some distance away, a great herd of pigs taking their food.

chinese: 鬼就央求耶穌，說：若把我們趕出去，就打發我們進入豬群罷！
english: And the evil spirits made strong prayers to him, saying, If you send us out, let us go into the herd of pigs.

chinese: 耶穌說：去罷！鬼就出來，進入豬群。全群忽然闖下山崖，投在海裡淹死了。
english: And he said to them, Go. And they came out, and went into the pigs; and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the sea and came to their end in the water.

chinese: 放豬的就逃跑進城，將這一切事和被鬼附的人所遭遇的都告訴人。
english: And their keepers went in flight to the town and gave an account of everything, and of the men who had the evil spirits.

chinese: 合城的人都出來迎見耶穌，既見了就央求他離開他們的境界。
