english: And all the town came out to Jesus; and seeing him they made request that he would go away from their part of the country.

chinese: 耶穌上了船，渡過海，來到自己的城裡。
english: And he got into a boat and went across and came to his town.

chinese: 有人用褥子抬著一個癱子到耶穌跟前來。耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：小子，放心罷！你的罪赦了。
english: And they took to him a man stretched on a bed who had no power of moving; and Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the man who was ill, Son, take heart; you have forgiveness for your sins.

chinese: 有幾個文士心裡說：這個人說僭妄的話了。
english: And some of the scribes said among themselves, This man has no respect for God.

chinese: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就說：你們為甚麼心裡懷著惡念呢？
english: And Jesus, having knowledge of what was in their minds, said, Why are your thoughts evil?

chinese: 或說：你的罪赦了，或說：你起來行走，那一樣容易呢？
english: For which is the simpler, to say, You have forgiveness for your sins; or to say, Get up and go?

chinese: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄；就對癱子說：起來！拿你的褥子回家去罷。
english: But so that you may see that on earth the Son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins, (then said he to the man who was ill,) Get up, and take up your bed, and go to your house.

chinese: 那人就起來，回家去了。
english: And he got up and went away to his house.

chinese: 眾人看見都驚奇，就歸榮耀與神，因為他將這樣的權柄賜給人。
english: But when the people saw it they were full of fear, and gave glory to God who had given such authority to men.

chinese: 耶穌從那裡往前走，看見一個人名叫馬太，坐在稅關上，就對他說：你跟從我來。他就起來跟從了耶穌。
english: And when Jesus was going from there, he saw a man whose name was Matthew, seated at the place where taxes were taken; and he said to him, Come after me. And he got up and went after him.

chinese: 耶穌在屋裡坐席的時候，有好些稅吏和罪人來，與耶穌和他的門徒一同坐席。
english: And it came about, when he was in the house taking food, that a number of tax-farmers and sinners came and took their places with Jesus and his disciples.

chinese: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌的門徒說：你們的先生為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同吃飯呢？
english: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, Why does your Master take food with tax-farmers and sinners?

chinese: 耶穌聽見，就說：康健的人用不著醫生，有病的人才用得著。
english: But on hearing this he said, Those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill.

chinese: 經上說：我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。這句話的意思，你們且去揣摩。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。
english: But go and take to heart the sense of these words, My desire is for mercy, not offerings: for I have come not to get the upright, but sinners.

chinese: 那時，約翰的門徒來見耶穌，說：我們和法利賽人常常禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食，這是為甚麼呢？
english: Then the disciples of John came to him, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees frequently go without food, but your disciples do not?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，陪伴之人豈能哀慟呢？但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那時候他們就要禁食。
english: And Jesus said to them, Will the friends of the newly-married man be sad as long as he is with them? But the days will come when he will be taken away from them, and then will they go without food.

chinese: 沒有人把新布補在舊衣服上；因為所補上的反帶壞了那衣服，破的就更大了。
english: And no man puts a bit of new cloth on an old coat, for by pulling away from the old, it makes a worse hole.

chinese: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裡；若是這樣，皮袋就裂開，酒漏出來，連皮袋也壞了。惟獨把新酒裝在新皮袋裡，兩樣就都保全了。
english: And men do not put new wine into old wine-skins; or the skins will be burst and the wine will come out, and the skins are of no more use: but they put new wine into new wine-skins, and so the two will be safe.

chinese: 耶穌說這話的時候，有一個管會堂的來拜他，說：我女兒剛才死了，求你去按手在他身上，他就必活了。
english: While he was saying these things to them, there came a ruler and gave him worship, saying, My daughter is even now dead; but come and put your hand on her, and she will come back to life.

chinese: 耶穌便起來跟著他去；門徒也跟了去。
english: And Jesus got up and went after him, and so did his disciples.

chinese: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，來到耶穌背後，摸他的衣裳繸子；
english: And a woman, who for twelve years had had a flow of blood, came after him, and put her hand on the edge of his robe:

chinese: 因為他心裡說：我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。
english: Because, she said to herself, if I may but put my hand on his robe, I will be made well.

chinese: 耶穌轉過來，看見他，就說：女兒，放心！你的信救了你。從那時候，女人就痊愈了。
english: But Jesus, turning and seeing her, said, Daughter, take heart; your faith has made you well. And the woman was made well from that hour.

chinese: 耶穌到了管會堂的家裡，看見有吹手，又有許多人亂嚷，
english: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house and saw the players with their instruments and the people making a noise,

chinese: 就說：退去罷！這閨女不是死了，是睡著了。他們就嗤笑他。
english: He said, Make room; for the girl is not dead, but sleeping. And they were laughing at him.

chinese: 眾人既被攆出，耶穌就進去，拉著閨女的手，閨女便起來了。
english: But when the people were sent out, he went in and took her by the hand; and the girl got up.

chinese: 於是這風聲傳遍了那地方。
english: And the news of it went out into all that land.

chinese: 耶穌從那裡往前走，有兩個瞎子跟著他，喊叫說：大衛的子孫，可憐我們罷！
english: And when Jesus went on from there, two blind men came after him, crying out, Have mercy on us, you Son of David.

chinese: 耶穌進了房子，瞎子就來到他跟前。耶穌說：你們信我能作這事麼？他們說：主阿，我們信。
english: And when he had come into the house, the blind men came to him; and Jesus said to them, Have you faith that I am able to do this? They said to him, Yes, Lord.

chinese: 耶穌就摸他們的眼睛，說：照著你們的信給你們成全了罷。
english: Then he put his hand on their eyes, saying, As your faith is, let it be done to you.

chinese: 他們的眼睛就開了。耶穌切切的囑咐他們說：你們要小心，不可叫人知道。
english: And their eyes were made open. And Jesus said to them sharply, Let no man have knowledge of it.

chinese: 他們出去，竟把他的名聲傳遍了那地方。
english: But they went out and gave news of him in all that land.

chinese: 他們出去的時候，有人將鬼所附的一個啞吧帶到耶穌跟前來。
english: And while they were going away, there came to him a man without the power of talking, and with an evil spirit.

chinese: 鬼被趕出去，啞吧就說出話來。眾人都希奇，說：在以色列中，從來沒有見過這樣的事。
english: And when the evil spirit had been sent out, the man had the power of talking: and they were all surprised, saying, Such a thing has never been seen in Israel.

chinese: 法利賽人卻說：他是靠著鬼王趕鬼。
english: But the Pharisees said, By the ruler of evil spirits, he sends evil spirits out of men.

chinese: 耶穌走遍各城各鄉，在會堂裡教訓人，宣講天國的福音，又醫治各樣的病症。
english: And Jesus went about all the towns and small places, teaching in their Synagogues and preaching the good news of the kingdom and making well all sorts of disease and pain.

chinese: 他看見許多的人，就憐憫他們；因為他們困苦流離，如同羊沒有牧人一般。
english: But when he saw all the people he was moved with pity for them, because they were troubled and wandering like sheep without a keeper.

chinese: 於是對門徒說：要收的莊稼多，作工的人少。
english: Then he said to his disciples, There is much grain but not enough men to get it in.

chinese: 所以，你們當求莊稼的主打發工人出去收他的莊稼。
english: Make prayer, then, to the Lord of the grain-fields, that he may send out workers to get in his grain.

chinese: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，給他們權柄，能趕逐污鬼，並醫治各樣的病症。
english: And he got together his twelve disciples and gave them the power of driving out unclean spirits, and of making well all sorts of disease and pain.

chinese: 這十二使徒的名：頭一個叫西門、又稱彼得，還有他兄弟安得烈，西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰，
english: Now the names of the twelve are these: The first, Simon, who is named Peter, and Andrew, his brother; James, the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother;

chinese: 腓力和巴多羅買，多馬和稅吏馬太，亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太，
english: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew, the tax-farmer; James, the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

chinese: 奮銳黨的西門，還有賣耶穌的加略人猶大。
english: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who was false to him.

chinese: 耶穌差這十二個人去，吩咐他們說：外邦人的路，你們不要走；撒瑪利亞人的城，你們不要進；
english: These twelve Jesus sent out and gave them orders, saying, Do not go among the Gentiles, or into any town of Samaria,

chinese: 寧可往以色列家迷失的羊那裡去。
english: But go to the wandering sheep of the house of Israel,

chinese: 隨走隨傳，說天國近了！
english: And, on your way, say, The kingdom of heaven is near.

chinese: 醫治病人，叫死人復活，叫長大痲瘋的潔淨，把鬼趕出去。你們白白的得來，也要白白的捨去。
english: Make well those who are ill, give life to the dead, make lepers clean, send evil spirits out of men; freely it has been given to you, freely give.

chinese: 腰袋裡不要帶金銀銅錢。
english: Take no gold or silver or copper in your pockets;

chinese: 行路不要帶口袋；不要帶兩件褂子，也不要帶鞋和柺杖。因為工人得飲食是應當的。
english: Take no bag for your journey and do not take two coats or shoes or a stick: for the workman has a right to his food.

chinese: 你們無論進那一城，那一村，要打聽那裡誰是好人，就住在他家，直住到走的時候。
english: And into whatever town or small place you go, make search there for someone who is respected, and make his house your resting-place till you go away.

chinese: 進他家裡去，要請他的安。
english: And when you go in, say, May peace be on this house.

chinese: 那家若配得平安，你們所求的平安就必臨到那家；若不配得，你們所求的平安仍歸你們。
english: And if the house is good enough, let your peace come on it: but if not, let your peace come back to you.

chinese: 凡不接待你們、不聽你們話的人，你們離開那家，或是那城的時候，就把腳上的塵土跺下去。
english: And whoever will not take you in, or give ear to your words, when you go out from that house or that town, put off its dust from your feet.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪和蛾摩拉所受的，比那城還容易受呢！
english: Truly I say to you, It will be better for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of God's judging than for that town.

chinese: 我差你們去，如同羊進入狼群；所以你們要靈巧像蛇，馴良像鴿子。
english: See, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Be then as wise as snakes, and as gentle as doves.

chinese: 你們要防備人；因為他們要把你們交給公會，也要在會堂裡鞭打你們，
english: But be on the watch against men: for they will give you up to the Sanhedrins, and in their Synagogues they will give you blows;

chinese: 並且你們要為我的緣故被送到諸侯君王面前，對他們和外邦人作見證。
english: And you will come before rulers and kings because of me, for a witness to them and to the Gentiles.

chinese: 你們被交的時候，不要思慮怎樣說話，或說甚麼話。到那時候，必賜給你們當說的話；
english: But when you are given up into their hands, do not be troubled about what to say or how to say it: for in that hour what you are to say will be given to you;

chinese: 因為不是你們自己說的，乃是你們父的靈在你們裡頭說的。
english: Because it is not you who say the words, but the Spirit of your Father in you.

chinese: 弟兄要把弟兄，父親要把兒子，送到死地；兒女要與父母為敵，害死他們；
english: And brother will give up brother to death, and the father his child: and children will go against their fathers and mothers, and put them to death.

chinese: 並且你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡。惟有忍耐到底的必然得救。
english: And you will be hated by all men because of my name: but he who is strong to the end will have salvation.

chinese: 有人在這城裡逼迫你們，就逃到那城裡去。我實在告訴你們，以色列的城邑，你們還沒有走遍，人子就到了。
english: But when they are cruel to you in one town, go in flight to another: for truly, I say to you, You will not have gone through the towns of Israel before the Son of man comes.

chinese: 學生不能高過先生；僕人不能高過主人。
english: A disciple is not greater than his master, or a servant than his lord.

chinese: 學生和先生一樣，僕人和主人一樣，也就罷了。人既罵家主是別西卜（別西卜：是鬼王的名），何況他的家人呢？
english: It is enough for the disciple that he may be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have given the name Beelzebub to the master of the house, how much more to those of his house!

chinese: 所以，不要怕他們；因為掩蓋的事沒有不露出來的，隱藏的事沒有不被人知道的。
english: Have, then, no fear of them: because nothing is covered which will not come to light, or secret which will not be made clear.

chinese: 我在暗中告訴你們的，你們要在明處說出來；你們耳中所聽的，要在房上宣揚出來。
english: What I say to you in the dark, say in the light: and what comes to your ear secretly, say publicly from the house-tops.

chinese: 那殺身體，不能殺靈魂的，不要怕他們；惟有能把身體和靈魂都滅在地獄裡的，正要怕他。
english: And have no fear of those who put to death the body, but are not able to put to death the soul. But have fear of him who has power to give soul and body to destruction in hell.

chinese: 兩個麻雀不是賣一分銀子麼？若是你們的父不許，一個也不能掉在地上；
english: Are not sparrows two a farthing? and not one of them comes to an end without your Father:

chinese: 就是你們的頭髮也都被數過了。
english: But the hairs of your head are all numbered.

chinese: 所以，不要懼怕，你們比許多麻雀還貴重！
english: Then have no fear; you are of more value than a flock of sparrows.

chinese: 凡在人面前認我的，我在我天上的父面前也必認他；
english: To everyone, then, who gives witness to me before men, I will give witness before my Father in heaven.

chinese: 凡在人面前不認我的，我在我天上的父面前也必不認他。
english: But if anyone says before men that he has no knowledge of me, I will say that I have no knowledge of him before my Father in heaven.

chinese: 你們不要想我來是叫地上太平；我來並不是叫地上太平，乃是叫地上動刀兵。
english: Do not have the thought that I have come to send peace on the earth; I came not to send peace but a sword.

chinese: 因為我來是叫人與父親生疏，女兒與母親生疏，媳婦與婆婆生疏。
english: For I have come to put a man against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law:

chinese: 人的仇敵就是自己家裡的人。
english: And a man will be hated by those of his house.

chinese: 愛父母過於愛我的，不配作我的門徒；愛兒女過於愛我的，不配作我的門徒；
english: He who has more love for his father or mother than for me is not good enough for me; he who has more love for son or daughter than for me is not good enough for me.

chinese: 不背著他的十字架跟從我的，也不配作我的門徒。
english: And he who does not take his cross and come after me is not good enough for me.

chinese: 得著生命的，將要失喪生命；為我失喪生命的，將要得著生命。
english: He who has the desire to keep his life will have it taken from him, and he who gives up his life because of me will have it given back to him.

chinese: 人接待你們就是接待我；接待我就是接待那差我來的。
english: He who gives honour to you gives honour to me; and he who gives honour to me gives honour to him who sent me.

chinese: 人因為先知的名接待先知，必得先知所得的賞賜；人因為義人的名接待義人，必得義人所得的賞賜。
english: He who gives honour to a prophet, in the name of a prophet, will be given a prophet's reward; and he who gives honour to an upright man, in the name of an upright man, will be given an upright man's reward.

chinese: 無論何人，因為門徒的名，只把一杯涼水給這小子裡的一個喝，我實在告訴你們，這人不能不得賞賜。
english: And whoever gives to one of these little ones a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, truly I say to you, he will not go without his reward.

chinese: 耶穌吩咐完了十二個門徒，就離開那裡，往各城去傳道，教訓人。
english: And it came about that when Jesus had come to the end of giving these orders to his twelve disciples, he went away from there, teaching and preaching in their towns.

chinese: 約翰在監裡聽見基督所作的事，就打發兩個門徒去，
english: Now when John had news in prison of the works of the Christ, he sent his disciples

chinese: 問他說：那將要來的是你麼？還是我們等候別人呢？
english: To say to him, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們去，把所聽見，所看見的事告訴約翰。
english: And Jesus, answering, said to them, Go and give news to John of the things which you are seeing and hearing:

chinese: 就是瞎子看見，瘸子行走，長大痲瘋的潔淨，聾子聽見，死人復活，窮人有福音傳給他們。
english: The blind see; those who were not able to, are walking; lepers are made clean; those who were without hearing, now have their ears open; the dead come to life again, and the poor have the good news given to them.

chinese: 凡不因我跌倒的就有福了！
english: And a blessing will be on him who has no doubts about me.

chinese: 他們走的時候，耶穌就對眾人講論約翰說：你們從前出到曠野是要看甚麼呢？要看風吹動的蘆葦麼？
english: And when they were going away, Jesus, talking of John, said to all the people, What went you out into the waste land to see? a tall stem moving in the wind?

chinese: 你們出去到底是要看甚麼？要看穿細軟衣服的人麼？那穿細軟衣服的人是在王宮裡。
english: But what went you out to see? a man delicately clothed? Those who have fair robes are in kings' houses.

chinese: 你們出去究竟是為甚麼？是要看先知麼？我告訴你們，是的，他比先知大多了。
english: But why did you go out? to see a prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.

chinese: 經上記著說：我要差遣我的使者在你前面預備道路，所說的就是這個人。
english: This is he of whom it has been said, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way before you.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，凡婦人所生的，沒有一個興起來大過施洗約翰的；然而天國裡最小的比他還大。
english: Truly I say to you, Among the sons of women there has not been a greater than John the Baptist: but he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

chinese: 從施洗約翰的時候到如今，天國是努力進入的，努力的人就得著了。
english: And from the days of John the Baptist till now, the kingdom of heaven is forcing its way in, and men of force take it.

chinese: 因為眾先知和律法說預言，到約翰為止。
english: For all the prophets and the law were in force till John.

chinese: 你們若肯領受，這人就是那應當來的以利亞。
english: And if you are able to see it, this is Elijah who was to come.

chinese: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
english: He who has ears, let him give ear.

chinese: 我可用甚麼比這世代呢？好像孩童坐在街市上招呼同伴，說：
english: But what comparison may I make of this generation? It is like children seated in the market-places, crying out to one another,

chinese: 我們向你們吹笛，你們不跳舞；我們向你們舉哀，你們不捶胸。
english: We made music for you and you did not take part in the dance; we gave cries of sorrow and you made no signs of grief.

chinese: 約翰來了，也不吃也不喝，人就說他是被鬼附著的；
english: For John came, taking no food or drink, and they say, He has an evil spirit.

chinese: 人子來了，也吃也喝，人又說他是貪食好酒的人，是稅吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧之子總以智慧為是（有古卷：但智慧在行為上就顯為是）。
english: The Son of man has come feasting, and they say, See, a lover of food and wine, a friend of tax-farmers and sinners! And wisdom is judged to be right by her works.

chinese: 耶穌在諸城中行了許多異能，那些城的人終不悔改，就在那時候責備他們，說：
english: Then he went on to say hard things to the towns where most of his works of power were done, because they had not been turned from their sins.

chinese: 哥拉汛哪，你有禍了！伯賽大阿，你有禍了！因為在你們中間所行的異能，若行在推羅、西頓，他們早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。
english: Unhappy are you, Chorazin! Unhappy are you, Beth-saida! For if the works of power which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have been turned from their sins in days gone by, clothing themselves in haircloth and putting dust on their heads.

chinese: 但我告訴你們，當審判的日子，推羅、西頓所受的，比你們還容易受呢！
english: But I say to you, It will be better for Tyre and Sidon in the day of judging, than for you.

chinese: 迦百農阿，你已經升到天上（或作：你將要升到天上麼），將來必墜落陰間；因為在你那裡所行的異能，若行在所多瑪，他還可以存到今日。
english: And you, Capernaum, were you not to be lifted up to heaven? you will go down into hell: for if the works of power which were done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have been here to this day.

chinese: 但我告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪所受的，比你還容易受呢！
english: But I say to you that it will be better for the land of Sodom in the day of judging, than for you.

chinese: 那時，耶穌說：父阿，天地的主，我感謝你！因為你將這些事向聰明通達人就藏起來，向嬰孩就顯出來。
english: At that time Jesus made answer and said, I give praise to you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have kept these things secret from the wise and the men of learning, and have made them clear to little children.

chinese: 父阿，是的，因為你的美意本是如此。
english: Yes, Father, for so it was pleasing in your eyes.

chinese: 一切所有的，都是我父交付我的；除了父，沒有人知道子；除了子和子所願意指示的，沒有人知道父。
english: All things have been given to me by my Father; and no one has knowledge of the Son, but the Father; and no one has knowledge of the Father, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will make it clear.

chinese: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裡來，我就使你們得安息。
english: Come to me, all you who are troubled and weighted down with care, and I will give you rest.

chinese: 我心裡柔和謙卑，你們當負我的軛，學我的樣式；這樣，你們心裡就必得享安息。
english: Take my yoke on you and become like me, for I am gentle and without pride, and you will have rest for your souls;

chinese: 因為我的軛是容易的，我的擔子是輕省的。
english: For my yoke is good, and the weight I take up is not hard.

chinese: 那時，耶穌在安息日從麥地經過。他的門徒餓了，就掐起麥穗來吃。
english: At that time Jesus went through the fields on the Sabbath day; and his disciples, being in need of food, were taking the heads of grain.

chinese: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌說：看哪，你的門徒作安息日不可作的事了！
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, See, your disciples do that which it is not right to do on the Sabbath.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：經上記著大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所作的事，你們沒有念過麼？
english: But he said to them, Have you no knowledge of what David did when he had need of food, and those who were with him?

chinese: 他怎麼進了神的殿，吃了陳設餅，這餅不是他和跟從他的人可以吃得，惟獨祭司才可以吃。
english: How he went into the house of God and took for food the holy bread which it was not right for him or for those who were with him to take, but only for the priests?

chinese: 再者，律法上所記的，當安息日，祭司在殿裡犯了安息日還是沒有罪，你們沒有念過麼？
english: Or is it not said in the law, how the Sabbath is broken by the priests in the Temple and they do no wrong?

chinese: 但我告訴你們，在這裡有一人比殿更大。
english: But I say to you that a greater thing than the Temple is here.

chinese: 我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。你們若明白這話的意思，就不將無罪的當作有罪的了。
english: But if these words had been in your minds, My desire is for mercy and not for offerings, you would not have been judging those who have done no wrong.

chinese: 因為人子是安息日的主。
english: For the Son of man is lord of the Sabbath.

chinese: 耶穌離開那地方，進了一個會堂。
english: And he went from there into their Synagogue:

chinese: 那裡有一個人枯乾了一隻手。有人問耶穌說：安息日治病可以不可以？意思是要控告他。
english: And there was a man with a dead hand. And they put a question to him, saying, Is it right to make a man well on the Sabbath day? so that they might have something against him.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們中間誰有一隻羊，當安息日掉在坑裡，不把他抓住，拉上來呢？
english: And he said to them, Which of you, having a sheep, if it gets into a hole on the Sabbath day, will not put out a helping hand and get it back?

chinese: 人比羊何等貴重呢！所以，在安息日作善事是可以的。
english: Of how much more value is a man than a sheep! For this reason it is right to do good on the Sabbath day.

chinese: 於是對那人說：伸出手來！他把手一伸，手就復了原，和那隻手一樣。
english: Then said he to the man, Put out your hand. And he put it out, and it was made as well as the other.

chinese: 法利賽人出去，商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。
english: But the Pharisees went out and made designs against him, how they might put him to death.

chinese: 耶穌知道了，就離開那裡，有許多人跟著他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；
english: And Jesus, having knowledge of this, went away from there, and a great number went after him; and he made them all well,

chinese: 又囑咐他們，不要給他傳名。
english: Ordering them not to give people word of him:

chinese: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：
english: So that what was said by Isaiah the prophet might come true,

chinese: 看哪！我的僕人，我所揀選，所親愛，心裡所喜悅的，我要將我的靈賜給他；他必將公理傳給外邦。
english: See my servant, the man of my selection, my loved one in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him, and he will make my decision clear to the Gentiles.

chinese: 他不爭競，不喧嚷；街上也沒有人聽見他的聲音。
english: His coming will not be with fighting or loud cries; and his voice will not be lifted up in the streets.

chinese: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷；將殘的燈火，他不吹滅；等他施行公理，叫公理得勝。
english: The crushed stem will not be broken by him; and the feebly burning light will he not put out, till he has made righteousness overcome all.

chinese: 外邦人都要仰望他的名。
english: And in his name will the Gentiles put their hope.

chinese: 當下，有人將一個被鬼附著、又瞎又啞的人帶到耶穌那裡，耶穌就醫治他，甚至那啞吧又能說話，又能看見。
english: Then they took to him one with an evil spirit, who was blind and had no power of talking: and he made him well so that he had the power of talking and seeing.

chinese: 眾人都驚奇，說：這不是大衛的子孫麼？
english: And all the people were surprised and said, Is not this the Son of David?

chinese: 但法利賽人聽見，就說：這個人趕鬼，無非是靠著鬼王別西卜阿。
english: But the Pharisees, hearing of it, said, This man only sends evil spirits out of men by Beelzebub, the ruler of evil spirits.

chinese: 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對他們說：凡一國自相紛爭，就成為荒場；一城一家自相紛爭，必站立不住；
english: And having knowledge of their thoughts he said to them, Every kingdom having division in itself is made waste, and every town or house having division in itself will come to destruction.

chinese: 若撒但趕逐撒但，就是自相紛爭，他的國怎能站得住呢？
english: And if Satan sends out Satan, he makes war against himself; how then will he keep his kingdom?

chinese: 我若靠著別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟趕鬼又靠著誰呢？這樣，他們就要斷定你們的是非。
english: And if I by Beelzebub send evil spirits out of men, by whom do your sons send them out? So let them be your judges.

chinese: 我若靠著神的靈趕鬼，這就是神的國臨到你們.了。
english: But if I by the Spirit of God send out evil spirits, then is the kingdom of God come on you.

chinese: 人怎能進壯士家裡，搶奪他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的家財。
english: Or how may one go into a strong man's house and take his goods, if he does not first put cords round the strong man? and then he may take his goods.

chinese: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
english: Whoever is not with me is against me; and he who does not take part with me in getting people together, is driving them away.

chinese: 所以我告訴你們：人一切的罪和褻瀆的話都可得赦免，惟獨褻瀆聖靈，總不得赦免。
english: So I say to you, Every sin and every evil word against God will have forgiveness; but for evil words against the Spirit there will be no forgiveness.

chinese: 凡說話干犯人子的，還可得赦免；惟獨說話干犯聖靈的，今世來世總不得赦免。
english: And whoever says a word against the Son of man, will have forgiveness; but whoever says a word against the Holy Spirit, will not have forgiveness in this life or in that which is to come.

chinese: 你們或以為樹好，果子也好；樹壞，果子也壞；因為看果子就可以知道樹。
english: Make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree bad, and its fruit bad; for by its fruit you will get knowledge of the tree.

chinese: 毒蛇的種類！你們既是惡人，怎能說出好話來呢？因為心裡所充滿的，口裡就說出來。
english: You offspring of snakes, how are you, being evil, able to say good things? because out of the heart's store come the words of the mouth.

chinese: 善人從他心裡所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他心裡所存的惡就發出惡來。
english: The good man out of his good store gives good things; and the evil man out of his evil store gives evil things.

chinese: 我又告訴你們，凡人所說的閒話，當審判的日子，必要句句供出來；
english: And I say to you that in the day when they are judged, men will have to give an account of every foolish word they have said.

chinese: 因為要憑你的話定你為義，也要憑你的話定你有罪。
english: For by your words will your righteousness be seen, and by your words you will be judged.

chinese: 當時，有幾個文士和法利賽人對耶穌說：夫子，我們願意你顯個神蹟給我們看。
english: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees, hearing this, said to him, Master, we are looking for a sign from you.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：一個邪惡淫亂的世代求看神蹟，除了先知約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他們看。
english: But he, answering, said to them, An evil and false generation is looking for a sign; and no sign will be given to it but the sign of the prophet Jonah:

chinese: 約拿三日三夜在大魚肚腹中，人子也要這樣三日三夜在地裡頭。
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the stomach of the great fish, so will the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

chinese: 當審判的時候，尼尼微人要起來定這世代的罪，因為尼尼微人聽了約拿所傳的就悔改了。看哪，在這裡有一人比約拿更大！
english: The men of Nineveh will come up in the day of judging and give their decision against this generation: because they were turned from their sins at the preaching of Jonah; and now a greater than Jonah is here.

chinese: 當審判的時候，南方的女王要起來定這世代的罪，因為他從地極而來，要聽所羅門的智慧話。看哪！在這裡有一人比所羅門更大。
english: The queen of the South will come up in the day of judging and give her decision against this generation: for she came from the ends of the earth to give ear to the wisdom of Solomon; and now a greater than Solomon is here.

chinese: 污鬼離了人身，就在無水之地過來過去，尋求安歇之處，卻尋不著。
english: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of a man, goes through dry places looking for rest, and getting it not.

chinese: 於是說：我要回到我所出來的屋裡去。到了，就看見裡面空閒，打掃乾淨，修飾好了，
english: Then he says, I will go back into my house from which I came out; and when he comes, he sees that there is no one in it, but that it has been made fair and clean.

chinese: 便去另帶了七個比自己更惡的鬼來，都進去住在那裡。那人末後的景況比先前更不好了。這邪惡的世代也要如此。
english: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits worse than himself, and they go in and make it their living-place: and the last condition of that man is worse than the first. Even so will it be with this evil generation.

chinese: 耶穌還對眾人說話的時候，不料他母親和他弟兄站在外邊，要與他說話。
english: While he was still talking to the people, his mother and his brothers came, desiring to have talk with him.

chinese: 有人告訴他說：看哪，你母親和你弟兄站在外邊，要與你說話。
english: And one said to him, See, your mother and your brothers are outside, desiring to have talk with you.

chinese: 他卻回答那人說：誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？
english: But he in answer said to him who gave the news, Who is my mother and who are my brothers?

chinese: 就伸手指著門徒，說：看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。
english: And he put out his hand to his disciples and said, See, my mother and my brothers!

chinese: 凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姐妹和母親了。
english: For whoever does the pleasure of my Father in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.

chinese: 當那一天，耶穌從房子裡出來，坐在海邊。
english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and was seated by the seaside.

chinese: 有許多人到他那裡聚集，他只得上船坐下，眾人都站在岸上。
english: And great numbers of people came together to him, so that he got into a boat; and the people took up their position by the sea.

chinese: 他用比喻對他們講許多道理，說：有一個撒種的出去撒種；
english: And he gave them teaching in the form of a story, saying, A man went out to put seed in the earth;

chinese: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；
english: And while he did so, some seeds were dropped by the wayside, and the birds came and took them for food:

chinese: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，
english: And some of the seed went among the stones, where it had not much earth, and straight away it came up because the earth was not deep:

chinese: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；
english: And when the sun was high, it was burned; and because it had no root it became dry and dead.

chinese: 有落在荊棘裡的，荊棘長起來，把他擠住了；
english: And some seeds went among thorns, and the thorns came up and they had no room for growth:

chinese: 又有落在好土裡的，就結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。
english: And some, falling on good earth, gave fruit, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times as much.

chinese: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
english: He who has ears, let him give ear.

chinese: 門徒進前來，問耶穌說：對眾人講話，為甚麼用比喻呢？
english: And the disciples came and said to him, Why do you say things to them in the form of stories?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：因為天國的奧祕只叫你們知道，不叫他們知道。
english: And he said to them in answer, To you is given the knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

chinese: 凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；凡沒有的，連他所有的，也要奪去。
english: Because whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have more; but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.

chinese: 所以我用比喻對他們講，是因他們看也看不見，聽也聽不見，也不明白。
english: For this reason I put things into the form of stories; because they see without seeing, and give ear without hearing, and the sense is not clear to them.

chinese: 在他們身上，正應了以賽亞的預言，說：你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白；看是要看見，卻不曉得；
english: And for them the words of Isaiah have come true, Though you give ear, you will not get knowledge; and seeing, you will see, but the sense will not be clear to you:

chinese: 因為這百姓油蒙了心，耳朵發沉，眼睛閉著，恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裡明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。
english: For the heart of this people has become fat and their ears are slow in hearing and their eyes are shut; for fear that they might see with their eyes and give hearing with their ears and become wise in their hearts and be turned again to me, so that I might make them well.

chinese: 但你們的眼睛是有福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵也是有福的，因為聽見了。
english: But a blessing be on your eyes, because they see; and on your ears, because they are open.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，從前有許多先知和義人要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。
english: For truly, I say to you that prophets and upright men had a desire to see the things which you see, and saw them not; and to have knowledge of the words which have come to your ears, and they had it not.

chinese: 所以，你們當聽這撒種的比喻。
english: Give ear, then, to the story of the man who put the seed in the earth.

chinese: 凡聽見天國道理不明白的，那惡者就來，把所撒在他心裡的奪了去；這就是撒在路旁的了。
english: When the word of the kingdom comes to anyone, and the sense of it is not clear to him, then the Evil One comes, and quickly takes away that which was put in his heart. He is the seed dropped by the wayside.

chinese: 撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，當下歡喜領受，
english: And that which went on the stones, this is he who, hearing the word, straight away takes it with joy;

chinese: 只因心裡沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
english: But having no root in himself, he goes on for a time; and when trouble comes or pain, because of the word, he quickly becomes full of doubts.

chinese: 撒在荊棘裡的，就是人聽了道，後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑把道擠住了，不能結實。
english: And that which was dropped among the thorns, this is he who has the word; and the cares of this life, and the deceits of wealth, put a stop to the growth of the word and it gives no fruit.

chinese: 撒在好地上的，就是人聽道明白了，後來結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。
english: And the seed which was put in good earth, this is he who gives ear to the word, and gets the sense of it; who gives fruit, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times as much.

chinese: 耶穌又設個比喻對他們說：天國好像人撒好種在田裡，
english: And he gave them another story, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a man who put good seed in his field:

chinese: 及至人睡覺的時候，有仇敵來，將稗子撒在麥子裡就走了。
english: But while men were sleeping, one who had hate for him came and put evil seeds among the grain, and went away.

chinese: 到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。
english: But when the green stem came up and gave fruit, the evil plants were seen at the same time.

chinese: 田主的僕人來告訴他說：主阿，你不是撒好種在田裡麼？從那裡來的稗子呢？
english: And the servants of the master of the house came and said to him, Sir, did you not put good seed in your field? how then has it evil plants?

chinese: 主人說：這是仇敵做的。僕人說：你要我們去薅出來麼？
english: And he said, Someone has done this in hate. And the servants say to him, Is it your pleasure that we go and take them up?

chinese: 主人說：不必，恐怕薅稗子，連麥子也拔出來。
english: But he says, No, for fear that by chance while you take up the evil plants, you may be rooting up the grain with them.

chinese: 容這兩樣一齊長，等著收割。當收割的時候，我要對收割的人說，先將稗子薅出來，捆成捆，留著燒；惟有麥子要收在倉裡。
english: Let them come up together till the getting in of the grain; and then I will say to the workers, Take up first the evil plants, and put them together for burning: but put the grain into my store-house.

chinese: 他又設個比喻對他們說：天國好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在田裡。
english: He put another story before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his field:

chinese: 這原是百種裡最小的，等到長起來，卻比各樣的菜都大，且成了樹，天上的飛鳥來宿在他的枝上。
english: Which is smaller than all seeds; but when it has come up it is greater than the plants, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of heaven come and make their resting-places in its branches.

chinese: 他又對他們講個比喻說：天國好像麵酵，有婦人拿來，藏在三斗麵裡，直等全團都發起來。
english: Another story he gave to them: The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took, and put in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.

chinese: 這都是耶穌用比喻對眾人說的話；若不用比喻，就不對他們說甚麼。
english: All these things Jesus said to the people in the form of stories; and without a story he said nothing to them:

chinese: 這是要應驗先知的話，說：我要開口用比喻，把創世以來所隱藏的事發明出來。
english: That it might come true which was said by the prophet, Opening my mouth, I will give out stories; I will give knowledge of things kept secret from before all time.

chinese: 當下，耶穌離開眾人，進了房子。他的門徒進前來，說：請把田間稗子的比喻講給我們聽。
english: Then he went away from the people, and went into the house; and his disciples came to him, saying, Make clear to us the story of the evil plants in the field.

chinese: 他回答說：那撒好種的就是人子；
english: And he made answer and said, He who puts the good seed in the earth is the Son of man;

chinese: 田地就是世界；好種就是天國之子；稗子就是那惡者之子；
english: And the field is the world; and the good seed is the sons of the kingdom; and the evil seeds are the sons of the Evil One;

chinese: 撒稗子的仇敵就是魔鬼；收割的時候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。
english: And he who put them in the earth is Satan; and the getting in of the grain is the end of the world; and those who get it in are the angels.

chinese: 將稗子薅出來用火焚燒，世界的末了也要如此。
english: As then the evil plants are got together and burned with fire, so will it be in the end of the world.

chinese: 人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作惡的，從他國裡挑出來，
english: The Son of man will send out his angels, and they will take out of his kingdom everything which is a cause of error, and all those who do wrong,

chinese: 丟在火爐裡；在那裡必要哀哭切齒了。
english: And will put them into the fire; there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

chinese: 那時，義人在他們父的國裡，要發出光來，像太陽一樣。有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
english: Then will the upright be shining as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him give ear.

chinese: 天國好像寶貝藏在地裡，人遇見了就把他藏起來，歡歡喜喜的去變賣一切所有的，買這塊地。
english: The kingdom of heaven is like a secret store of wealth in a field, which a man came across and put back again; and in his joy he goes and gives all he has, to get that field.

chinese: 天國又好像買賣人尋找好珠子，
english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a trader searching for beautiful jewels.

chinese: 遇見一顆重價的珠子，就去變賣他一切所有的，買了這顆珠子。
english: And having come across one jewel of great price, he went and gave all he had in exchange for it.

chinese: 天國又好像網撒在海裡，聚攏各樣水族，
english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net, which was put into the sea and took in every sort of fish:

chinese: 網既滿了，人就拉上岸來，坐下，揀好的收在器具裡，將不好的丟棄了。
english: When it was full, they took it up on the sands; and seated there they put the good into vessels, but the bad they put away.

chinese: 世界的末了也要這樣。天使要出來，從義人中把惡人分別出來，
english: So will it be in the end of the world: the angels will come and take out the bad from the good,

chinese: 丟在火爐裡；在那裡必要哀哭切齒了。
english: And will put them into the fire: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

chinese: 耶穌說：這一切的話你們都明白了麼？他們說：我們明白了。
english: Are all these things now clear to you? They say to him, Yes.

chinese: 他說：凡文士受教作天國的門徒，就像一個家主從他庫裡拿出新舊的東西來。
english: And he said to them, For this reason every scribe who has become a disciple of the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house, who gives out from his store things new and old.

chinese: 耶穌說完了這些比喻，就離開那裡，
english: And when Jesus had come to the end of these stories he went away from there.

chinese: 來到自己的家鄉，在會堂裡教訓人，甚至他們都希奇，說：這人從那裡有這等智慧和異能呢？
english: And coming into his country, he gave them teaching in their Synagogue, so that they were greatly surprised and said, Where did this man get this wisdom and these works of power?

chinese: 這不是木匠的兒子麼？他母親不是叫馬利亞麼？他弟兄們不是叫雅各、約西（有古卷：約瑟）、西門、猶大麼？
english: Is not this the woodworker's son? is not his mother named Mary? and his brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas?

chinese: 他妹妹們不是都在我們這裡麼？這人從那裡有這一切的事呢？
english: And his sisters, are they not all with us? from where, then, has he all these things?

chinese: 他們就厭棄他（厭棄他：原文是因他跌倒）。耶穌對他們說：大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。
english: And they were bitter against him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is nowhere without honour but in his country and among his family.

chinese: 耶穌因為他們不信，就在那裡不多行異能了。
english: And the works of power which he did there were small in number because they had no faith.

chinese: 那時，分封的王希律聽見耶穌的名聲，
english: At that time news of Jesus came to Herod the king;

chinese: 就對臣僕說：這是施洗的約翰從死裡復活，所以這些異能從他裡面發出來。
english: And he said to his servants, This is John the Baptist; he has come back from the dead, and so these powers are working in him.

chinese: 起先，希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，把約翰拿住，鎖在監裡。
english: For Herod had taken John and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

chinese: 因為約翰曾對他說：你娶這婦人是不合理的。
english: Because John had said to him, It is not right for you to have her.

chinese: 希律就想要殺他，只是怕百姓，因為他們以約翰為先知。
english: And he would have put him to death, but for his fear of the people, because in their eyes John was a prophet.

chinese: 到了希律的生日，希羅底的女兒在眾人面前跳舞，使希律歡喜。
english: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias was dancing before them, and Herod was pleased with her.

chinese: 希律就起誓，應許隨他所求的給他。
english: So he gave her his word with an oath to let her have whatever she might make request for.

chinese: 女兒被母親所使，就說：請把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裡，拿來給我。
english: And she, at her mother's suggestion, said, Give me here on a plate the head of John the Baptist.

chinese: 王便}憂愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐給他；
english: And the king was sad; but because of his oaths and because of his guests, he gave the order for it to be given to her;

chinese: 於是打發人去，在監裡斬了約翰，
english: And he sent and had John's head cut off in the prison.

chinese: 把頭放在盤子裡，拿來給了女子；女子拿去給他母親。
english: And his head was put on a plate and given to the girl; and she took it to her mother.

chinese: 約翰的門徒來，把屍首領去埋葬了，就去告訴耶穌。
english: And his disciples came, and took up his body and put it in the earth; and they went and gave Jesus news of what had taken place.

chinese: 耶穌聽見了，就上船從那裡獨自退到野地裡去。眾人聽見，就從各城裡步行跟隨他。
english: Now when it came to the ears of Jesus, he went away from there in a boat, to a waste place by himself: and the people hearing of it, went after him on foot from the towns.

chinese: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，治好了他們的病人。
english: And he came out and saw a great number of people and he had pity on them, and made well those of them who were ill.

chinese: 天將晚的時候，門徒進前來，說：這是野地，時候已經過了，請叫眾人散開，他們好往村子裡去，自己買吃的。
english: And when evening had come, the disciples came to him, saying, This place is waste land, and the time is now past; send the people away so that they may go into the towns and get themselves food.

chinese: 耶穌說：不用他們去，你們給他們吃罷！
english: But Jesus said to them, There is no need for them to go away; give them food yourselves.

chinese: 門徒說：我們這裡只有五個餅，兩條魚。
english: And they say to him, We have here but five cakes of bread and two fishes.

chinese: 耶穌說：拿過來給我。
english: And he said, Give them to me.

chinese: 於是吩咐眾人坐在草地上，就拿著這五個餅，兩條魚，望著天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，門徒又遞給眾人。
english: And he gave orders for the people to be seated on the grass; and he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing, and made division of the food, and gave it to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.

chinese: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了；把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
english: And they all took of the food and had enough: and they took up twelve baskets full of broken bits which were not used.

chinese: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，約有五千。
english: And those who had food were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

chinese: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊去，等他叫眾人散開。
english: And straight away he made the disciples get into the boat and go before him to the other side, till he had sent the people away.

chinese: 散了眾人以後，他就獨自上山去禱告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那裡。
english: And after he had sent the people away, he went up into the mountain by himself for prayer: and when evening was come, he was there by himself.

chinese: 那時船在海中，因風不順，被浪搖撼。
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, and was troubled by the waves: for the wind was against them.

chinese: 夜裡四更天，耶穌在海面上走，往門徒那裡去。
english: And in the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea.

chinese: 門徒看見他在海面上走，就驚慌了，說：是個鬼怪！便害怕，喊叫起來。
english: And when they saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they gave cries of fear.

chinese: 耶穌連忙對他們說：你們放心！是我，不要怕！
english: But straight away Jesus said to them, Take heart; it is I, have no fear.

chinese: 彼得說：主，如果是你，請叫我從水面上走到你那裡去。
english: And Peter, answering, said to him, Lord, if it is you, give me the order to come to you on the water.

chinese: 耶穌說：你來罷。彼得就從船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶穌那裡去；
english: And he said, Come. And Peter got out of the boat, and walking on the water, went to Jesus.

chinese: 只因見風甚大，就害怕，將要沉下去，便喊著說：主阿，救我！
english: But when he saw the wind he was in fear and, starting to go down, he gave a cry, saying, Help, Lord.

chinese: 耶穌趕緊伸手拉住他，說：你這小信的人哪，為甚麼疑惑呢？
english: And straight away Jesus put out his hand and took a grip of him, and said to him, O man of little faith, why were you in doubt?

chinese: 他們上了船，風就住了。
english: And when they had got into the boat, the wind went down.

chinese: 在船上的人都拜他，說：你真是神的兒子了。
english: And those who were in the boat gave him worship, saying, Truly you are the Son of God.

chinese: 他們過了海，來到革尼撒勒地方。
english: And when they had gone across, they came to land at Gennesaret.

chinese: 那裡的人一認出是耶穌，就打發人到周圍地方去，把所有的病人帶到他那裡，
english: And when the men of that place had news of him, they sent into all the country round about, and took to him all who were ill,

chinese: 只求耶穌准他們摸他的衣裳繸子；摸著的人就都好了。
english: With the request that they might only put their hands on the edge of his robe: and all those who did so were made well.

chinese: 那時，有法利賽人和文士從耶路撒冷來見耶穌，說：
english: Then there came to Jesus from Jerusalem Pharisees and scribes, saying,

chinese: 你的門徒為甚麼犯古人的遺傳呢？因為吃飯的時候，他們不洗手。
english: Why do your disciples go against the teaching of the fathers? for they take food with unwashed hands.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們為甚麼因著你們的遺傳犯神的誡命呢？
english: And in answer he said to them, Why do you, yourselves, go against the word of God on account of the teaching which has been handed down to you?

chinese: 神說：當孝敬父母；又說：咒罵父母的，必治死他。
english: For God said, Give honour to your father and mother: and, He who says evil of father or mother will be put to death.

chinese: 你們倒說：無論何人對父母說：我所當奉給你的已經作了供獻，
english: But you say, If a man says to his father or his mother, That by which you might have had profit from me is given to God;

chinese: 他就可以不孝敬父母。這就是你們藉著遺傳，廢了神的誡命。
english: There is no need for him to give honour to his father. And you have made the word of God without effect because of your teaching.

chinese: 假冒為善的人哪，以賽亞指著你們說的預言是不錯的。他說：
english: You false ones, well did Isaiah say of you,

chinese: 這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我，心卻遠離我；
english: These people give me honour with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

chinese: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人，所以拜我也是枉然。
english: But their worship is to no purpose, while they give as their teaching the rules of men.

chinese: 耶穌就叫了眾人來，對他們說：你們要聽，也要明白。
english: And he got the people together and said to them, Give ear, and let my words be clear to you:

chinese: 入口的不能污穢人，出口的乃能污穢人。
english: Not that which goes into the mouth makes a man unclean, but that which comes out of the mouth.

chinese: 當時，門徒進前來對他說：法利賽人聽見這話，不服（原文是跌倒），你知道麼？
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, Did you see that the Pharisees were troubled when these words came to their ears?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：凡栽種的物，若不是我天父栽種的，必要拔出來。
english: But he said in answer, Every plant which my Father in heaven has not put in the earth, will be taken up by the roots.

chinese: 任憑他們罷！他們是瞎眼領路的；若是瞎子領瞎子，兩個人都要掉在坑裡。
english: Let them be: they are blind guides. And if a blind man is guiding a blind man, the two will go falling into a hole together.

chinese: 彼得對耶穌說：請將這比喻講給我們聽。
english: Then Peter said to him, Make the story clear to us.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們到如今還不明白麼？
english: And he said, Are you, like them, still without wisdom?

chinese: 豈不知凡入口的，是運到肚子裡，又落在茅廁裡麼？
english: Do you not see that whatever goes into the mouth goes on into the stomach, and is sent out as waste?

chinese: 惟獨出口的，是從心裡發出來的，這才污穢人。
english: But the things which come out of the mouth come from the heart; and they make a man unclean.

chinese: 因為從心裡發出來的，有惡念、兇殺、姦淫、苟合、偷盜、妄證、謗讟。
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, the taking of life, broken faith between the married, unclean desires of the flesh, taking of property, false witness, bitter words:

chinese: 這都是污穢人的；至於不洗手吃飯，那卻不污穢人。
english: These are the things which make a man unclean; but to take food with unwashed hands does not make a man unclean.

chinese: 耶穌離開那裡，退到推羅、西頓的境內去。
english: And Jesus went away from there into the country of Tyre and Sidon.

chinese: 有一個迦南婦人，從那地方出來，喊著說：主阿，大衛的子孫，可憐我！我女兒被鬼附得甚苦。
english: And a woman of Canaan came out from those parts, crying and saying, Have pity on me, O Lord, Son of David; my daughter is greatly troubled with an unclean spirit.

chinese: 耶穌卻一言不答。門徒進前來，求他說：這婦人在我們後頭喊叫，請打發他走罷。
english: But he gave her no answer. And his disciples came and said to him, Send her away, for she is crying after us.

chinese: 耶穌說：我奉差遣不過是到以色列家迷失的羊那裡去。
english: But he made answer and said, I was sent only to the wandering sheep of the house of Israel.

chinese: 那婦人來拜他，說：主阿，幫助我！
english: But she came and gave him worship, saying, Help, Lord.

chinese: 他回答說：不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。
english: And he made answer and said, It is not right to take the children's bread and give it to the dogs.

chinese: 婦人說：主阿，不錯；但是狗也吃他主人桌子上掉下來的碎渣兒。
english: But she said, Yes, Lord: but even the dogs take the bits from under their masters' table.

chinese: 耶穌說：婦人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，給你成全了罷。從那時候，他女兒就好了。
english: Then Jesus, answering, said to her, O woman, great is your faith: let your desire be done. And her daughter was made well from that hour.

chinese: 耶穌離開那地方，來到靠近加利利的海邊，就上山坐下。
english: And Jesus went from there and came to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and took his seat there.

chinese: 有許多人到他那裡，帶著瘸子、瞎子、啞吧、有殘疾的，和好些別的病人，都放在他腳前；他就治好了他們。
english: And there came to him great numbers of people having with them those who were broken in body, or blind, or without voice, or wounded, or ill in any way, and a number of others; they put them down at his feet and he made them well:

chinese: 甚至眾人都希奇；因為看見啞吧說話，殘疾的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看見，他們就歸榮耀給以色列的神。
english: So that the people were full of wonder when they saw that those who had no voice were talking, the feeble were made strong, those whose bodies were broken had the power of walking, and the blind were able to see: and they gave glory to the God of Israel.

chinese: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：我憐憫這眾人，因為他們同我在這裡已經三天，也沒有吃的了。我不願意叫他們餓著回去，恐怕在路上困乏。
english: And Jesus got his disciples together and said, I have pity for the people, because they have now been with me three days and have no food: and I will not send them away without food, or they will have no strength for the journey.

chinese: 門徒說：我們在這野地，那裡有這麼多的餅叫這許多人吃飽呢？
english: And the disciples say to him, How may we get enough bread in a waste place, to give food to such a number of people?

chinese: 耶穌說：你們有多少餅？他們說：有七個，還有幾條小魚。
english: And Jesus says to them, How much bread have you? And they said, Seven cakes, and some small fishes.

chinese: 他就吩咐眾人坐在地上，
english: Then he gave an order to the people to be seated on the earth,

chinese: 拿著這七個餅和幾條魚，祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒；門徒又遞給眾人。
english: And he took the seven cakes of bread and the fishes; and having given praise, he gave the broken bread to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.

chinese: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，裝滿了七個筐子。
english: And they all took food, and had enough; and they took up of the broken bits, seven baskets full.

chinese: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，共有四千。
english: And there were four thousand men who took food, together with women and children.

chinese: 耶穌叫眾人散去，就上船，來到馬加丹的境界。
english: And when he had sent the people away, he got into the boat, and came into the country of Magadan.

chinese: 法利賽人和撒都該人來試探耶穌，請他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看。
english: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came and, testing him, made a request to him to give them a sign from heaven.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：晚上天發紅，你們就說：天必要晴。
english: But in answer he said to them, At nightfall you say, The weather will be good, for the sky is red.

chinese: 早晨天發紅，又發黑，你們就說：今日必有風雨。你們知道分辨天上的氣色，倒不能分辨這時候的神蹟。
english: And in the morning, The weather will be bad today, for the sky is red and angry. You are able to see the face of heaven, but not the signs of the times.

chinese: 一個邪惡淫亂的世代求神蹟，除了約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他看。耶穌就離開他們去了。
english: An evil and false generation is searching after a sign; and no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah. And he went away from them.

chinese: 門徒渡到那邊去，忘了帶餅。
english: And when the disciples came to the other side they had not taken thought to get bread.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵。
english: And Jesus said to them, Take care to have nothing to do with the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

chinese: 門徒彼此議論說：這是因為我們沒有帶餅罷。
english: And they were reasoning among themselves, saying, We took no bread.

chinese: 耶穌看出來，就說：你們這小信的人，為甚麼因為沒有餅彼此議論呢？
english: And Jesus, seeing it, said, O you of little faith, why are you reasoning among yourselves, because you have no bread?

chinese: 你們還不明白麼？不記得那五個餅分給五千人、又收拾了多少籃子的零碎麼？
english: Do you still not see, or keep in mind the five cakes of bread of the five thousand, and the number of baskets you took up?

chinese: 也不記得那七個餅分給四千人、又收拾了多少筐子的零碎麼？
english: Or the seven cakes of bread of the four thousand, and the number of baskets you took up?

chinese: 我對你們說：要防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵，這話不是指著餅說的，你們怎麼不明白呢？
english: How is it that you do not see that I was not talking to you about bread, but about keeping away from the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees?

chinese: 門徒這才曉得他說的不是叫他們防備餅的酵，乃是防備法利賽人和撒都該人的教訓。
english: Then they saw that it was not the leaven of bread which he had in mind, but the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

chinese: 耶穌到了該撒利亞腓立比的境內，就問門徒說：人說我（有古卷沒有我字）人子是誰？
english: Now when Jesus had come into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he said, questioning his disciples, Who do men say that the Son of man is?

chinese: 他們說：有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是耶利米或是先知裡的一位。
english: And they said, Some say, John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們說我是誰？
english: He says to them, But who do you say that I am?

chinese: 西門彼得回答說：你是基督，是永生神的兒子。
english: And Simon Peter made answer and said, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：西門巴約拿，你是有福的！因為這不是屬血肉的指示你的，乃是我在天上的父指示的。
english: And Jesus made answer and said to him, A blessing on you, Simon Bar-jonah: because this knowledge has not come to you from flesh and blood, but from my Father in heaven.

chinese: 我還告訴你，你是彼得，我要把我的教會建造在這磐石上；陰間的權柄（權柄：原文是門），不能勝過他。
english: And I say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock will my church be based, and the doors of hell will not overcome it.

chinese: 我要把天國的鑰匙給你，凡你在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。
english: I will give to you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatever is fixed by you on earth will be fixed in heaven: and whatever you make free on earth will be made free in heaven.

chinese: 當下，耶穌囑咐門徒，不可對人說他是基督。
english: Then he gave orders to the disciples to give no man word that he was the Christ.

chinese: 從此，耶穌才指示門徒，他必須上耶路撒冷去，受長老、祭司長、文士許多的苦，並且被殺，第三日復活。
english: From that time Jesus went on to make clear to his disciples how he would have to go up to Jerusalem, and undergo much at the hands of those in authority and the chief priests and scribes, and be put to death, and the third day come again from the dead.

chinese: 彼得就拉著他，勸他說：主阿，萬不可如此！這事必不臨到你身上。
english: And Peter, protesting, said to him, Be it far from you, Lord; it is impossible that this will come about.

chinese: 耶穌轉過來，對彼得說：撒但，退我後邊去罷！你是絆我腳的；因為你不體貼神的意思，只體貼人的意思。
english: But he, turning to Peter, said, Get out of my way, Satan: you are a danger to me because your mind is not on the things of God, but on the things of men.

chinese: 於是耶穌對門徒說：若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, If any man would come after me, let him give up all, and take up his cross, and come after me.

chinese: 因為，凡要救自己生命（生命：或作靈魂；下同）的，必喪掉生命；凡為我喪掉生命的，必得著生命。
english: Because whoever has a desire to keep his life safe will have it taken from him; but whoever gives up his life because of me, will have it given back to him.

chinese: 人若賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
english: For what profit has a man, if he gets all the world with the loss of his life? or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

chinese: 人子要在他父的榮耀裡，同著眾使者降臨；那時候，他要照各人的行為報應各人。
english: For the Son of man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he will give to every man the reward of his works.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，站在這裡的，有人在沒嘗死味以前必看見人子降臨在他的國裡。
english: Truly I say to you, There are some of those here who will not have a taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

chinese: 過了六天，耶穌帶著彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，暗暗的上了高山，
english: And after six days Jesus takes with him Peter, and James, and John, his brother, and makes them go up with him into a high mountain by themselves.

chinese: 就在他們面前變了形像，臉面明亮如日頭，衣裳潔白如光。
english: And he was changed in form before them; and his face was shining like the sun, and his clothing became white as light.

chinese: 忽然，有摩西、以利亞向他們顯現，同耶穌說話。
english: And Moses and Elijah came before their eyes, talking with him.

chinese: 彼得對耶穌說：主阿，我們在這裡真好！你若願意，我就在這裡搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。
english: And Peter made answer and said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will let me, I will make here three tents, one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

chinese: 說話之間，忽然有一朵光明的雲彩遮蓋他們，且有聲音從雲彩裡出來，說：這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。你們要聽他！
english: While he was still talking, a bright cloud came over them: and a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased; give ear to him.

chinese: 門徒聽見﹐就俯伏在地，極其害怕。
english: And at these words the disciples went down on their faces in great fear.

chinese: 耶穌進前來，摸他們，說：起來，不要害怕！
english: And Jesus came and put his hand on them and said, Get up and have no fear.

chinese: 他們舉目不見一人，只見耶穌在那裡。
english: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, but Jesus only.

chinese: 下山的時候，耶穌吩咐他們說：人子還沒有從死裡復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。
english: And when they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus gave them orders, saying, Let no man have word of what you have seen, till the Son of man has come again from the dead.

chinese: 門徒問耶穌說：文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？
english: And his disciples, questioning him, said, Why then do the scribes say that Elijah has to come first?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：以利亞固然先來，並要復興萬事；
english: And in answer he said, Elijah truly has to come and put all things right:

chinese: 只是我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，人卻不認識他，竟任意待他。人子也將要這樣受他們的害。
english: But I say to you that Elijah has come, and they had no knowledge of him, but did to him whatever they were pleased to do; the same will the Son of man undergo at their hands.

chinese: 門徒這才明白耶穌所說的是指著施洗的約翰。
english: Then the disciples saw that he was talking to them of John the Baptist.

chinese: 耶穌和門徒到了眾人那裡，有一個人來見耶穌，跪下，說：
english: And when they came to the people, a man went down on his knees to him, saying,

chinese: 主阿，憐憫我的兒子。他害癲癇的病很苦，屢次跌在火裡，屢次跌在水裡。
english: Lord have mercy on my son: for he is off his head, and is in great pain; and frequently he goes falling into the fire, and frequently into the water.

chinese: 我帶他到你門徒那裡，他們卻不能醫治他。
english: And I took him to your disciples, and they were not able to make him well.

chinese: 耶穌說：噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代阿，我在你們這裡要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裡來罷！
english: And Jesus, answering, said, O false and foolish generation, how long will I be with you? how long will I put up with you? let him come here to me.

chinese: 耶穌斥責那鬼，鬼就出來；從此孩子就痊愈了。
english: And Jesus gave orders to the unclean spirit, and it went out of him: and the boy was made well from that hour.

chinese: 門徒暗暗的到耶穌跟前，說：我們為甚麼不能趕出那鬼呢？
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, Why were we not able to send it out?

chinese: 耶穌說：是因你們的信心小。我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，像一粒芥菜種，就是對這座山說：你從這邊挪到那邊。他也必挪去；並且你們沒有一件不能做的事了。
english: And he says to them, Because of your little faith: for truly I say to you, If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, Be moved from this place to that; and it will be moved; and nothing will be impossible to you.

chinese: 至於這一類的鬼，若不禱告、禁食，他就不出來（或作：不能趕他出來）。
他們還住在加利利的時候，耶穌對門徒說：人子將要被交在人手裡。
english: And while they were going about in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of man will be given up into the hands of men;

chinese: 他們要殺害他，第三日他要復活。門徒就大大的憂愁。
english: And they will put him to death, and the third day he will come again from the dead. And they were very sad.

chinese: 到了迦百農，有收丁稅的人來見彼得，說：你們的先生不納丁稅（丁稅約有半塊錢）麼？
english: And when they had come to Capernaum, those who took the Temple tax came to Peter and said, Does not your master make payment of the Temple tax?

chinese: 彼得說：納。他進了屋子，耶穌先向他說：西門﹐你的意思如何？世上的君王向誰徵收關稅、丁稅？是向自己的兒子呢？是向外人呢？
english: He says, Yes. And when he came into the house, Jesus said to him, What is your opinion, Simon? from whom do the kings of the earth get payment or tax? from their sons or from other people?

chinese: 彼得說：是向外人。耶穌說：既然如此，兒子就可以免稅了。
english: And when he said, From other people, Jesus said to him, Then are the sons free.

chinese: 但恐怕觸犯（觸犯：原文是絆倒）他們，你且往海邊去釣魚，把先釣上來的魚拿起來，開了他的口，必得一塊錢，可以拿去給他們，作你我的稅銀。
english: But, so that we may not be a cause of trouble to them, go to the sea, and let down a hook, and take the first fish which comes up; and in his mouth you will see a bit of money: take that, and give it to them for me and you.

chinese: 當時，門徒進前來，問耶穌說：天國裡誰是最大的？
english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

chinese: 耶穌便叫一個小孩子來，使他站在他們當中，
english: And he took a little child, and put him in the middle of them,

chinese: 說：我實在告訴你們，你們若不回轉，變成小孩子的樣式，斷不得進天國。
english: And said, Truly, I say to you, If you do not have a change of heart and become like little children, you will not go into the kingdom of heaven.

chinese: 所以，凡自己謙卑像這小孩子的，他在天國裡就是最大的。
english: Whoever, then, will make himself as low as this little child, the same is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

chinese: 凡為我的名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我。
english: And whoever gives honour to one such little child in my name, gives honour to me:

chinese: 凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，沉在深海裡。
english: But whoever is a cause of trouble to one of these little ones who have faith in me, it would be better for him to have a great stone fixed to his neck, and to come to his end in the deep sea.

chinese: 這世界有禍了，因為將人絆倒；絆倒人的事是免不了的，但那絆倒人的有禍了！
english: A curse is on the earth because of trouble! for it is necessary for trouble to come; but unhappy is that man through whom the trouble comes.

chinese: 倘若你一隻手，或是一隻腳，叫你跌倒，就砍下來丟掉。你缺一隻手，或是一隻腳，進入永生，強如有兩手兩腳被丟在永火裡。
english: And if your hand or your foot is a cause of trouble, let it be cut off and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with the loss of a hand or a foot than, having two hands or two feet, to go into the eternal fire.

chinese: 倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就把他剜出來丟掉。你只有一隻眼進入永生，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄的火裡。
english: And if your eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out, and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with one eye than, having two eyes, to go into the hell of fire.

chinese: 你們要小心，不可輕看這小子裡的一個；我告訴你們，他們的使者在天上，常見我天父的面。（有古卷在此有
english: Let it not seem to you that one of these little ones is of no value; for I say to you that in heaven their angels see at all times the face of my Father in heaven.

chinese: 人子來，為要拯救失喪的人。）
一個人若有一百隻羊，一隻走迷了路，你們的意思如何？他豈不撇下這九十九隻，往山裡去找那隻迷路的羊麼？
english: What would you say now? if a man has a hundred sheep, and one of them has gone wandering away, will he not let the ninety-nine be, and go to the mountains in search of the wandering one?

chinese: 若是找著了，我實在告訴你們，他為這一隻羊歡喜，比為那沒有迷路的九十九隻歡喜還大呢！
english: And if he comes across it, truly I say to you, he has more joy over it than over the ninety-nine which have not gone out of the way.

chinese: 你們在天上的父也是這樣，不願意這小子裡失喪一個。
english: Even so it is not the pleasure of your Father in heaven for one of these little ones to come to destruction.

chinese: 倘若你的弟兄得罪你，你就去，趁著只有他和你在一處的時候，指出他的錯來。他若聽你，你便得了你的弟兄；
english: And if your brother does wrong to you, go, make clear to him his error between you and him in private: if he gives ear to you, you have got your brother back again.

chinese: 他若不聽，你就另外帶一兩個人同去，要憑兩三個人的口作見證，句句都可定準。
english: But if he will not give ear to you, take with you one or two more, that by the lips of two or three witnesses every word may be made certain.

chinese: 若是不聽他們，就告訴教會；若是不聽教會，就看他像外邦人和稅吏一樣。
english: And if he will not give ear to them, let it come to the hearing of the church: and if he will not give ear to the church, let him be to you as a Gentile and a tax-farmer.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，凡你們在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你們在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。
english: Truly I say to you, Whatever things are fixed by you on earth will be fixed in heaven: and whatever you make free on earth will be made free in heaven.

chinese: 我又告訴你們，若是你們中間有兩個人在地上同心合意的求甚麼事，我在天上的父必為他們成全。
english: Again, I say to you, that if two of you are in agreement on earth about anything for which they will make a request, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven.

chinese: 因為無論在那裡，有兩三個人奉我的名聚會，那裡就有我在他們中間。
english: For where two or three are come together in my name, there am I among them.

chinese: 那時，彼得進前來，對耶穌說：主阿，我弟兄得罪我，我當饒恕他幾次呢？到七次可以麼？
english: Then Peter came and said to him, Lord, what number of times may my brother do wrong against me, and I give him forgiveness? till seven times?

chinese: 耶穌說：我對你說，不是到七次，乃是到七十個七次。
english: Jesus says to him, I say not to you, Till seven times; but, Till seventy times seven.

chinese: 天國好像一個王要和他僕人算賬。
english: For this reason the kingdom of heaven is like a king, who went over his accounts with his servants.

chinese: 才算的時候，有人帶了一個欠一千萬銀子的來。
english: And at the start, one came to him who was in his debt for ten thousand talents.

chinese: 因為他沒有甚麼償還之物，主人吩咐把他和他妻子兒女，並一切所有的都賣了償還。
english: And because he was not able to make payment, his lord gave orders for him, and his wife, and his sons and daughters, and all he had, to be given for money, and payment to be made.

chinese: 那僕人就俯伏拜他，說：主阿，寬容我，將來我都要還清。
english: So the servant went down on his face and gave him worship, saying, Lord, give me time to make payment and I will give you all.

chinese: 那僕人的主人就動了慈心，把他釋放了，並且免了他的債。
english: And the lord of that servant, being moved with pity, let him go, and made him free of the debt.

chinese: 那僕人出來，遇見他的一個同伴欠他十兩銀子，便揪著他，掐住他的喉嚨，說：你把所欠的還我！
english: But that servant went out, and meeting one of the other servants, who was in debt to him for one hundred pence, he took him by the throat, saying, Make payment of your debt.

chinese: 他的同伴就俯伏央求他，說：寬容我罷，將來我必還清。
english: So that servant went down on his face, requesting him and saying, Give me time and I will make payment to you.

chinese: 他不肯，竟去把他下在監裡，等他還了所欠的債。
english: And he would not: but went and put him into prison till he had made payment of the debt.

chinese: 眾同伴看見他所做的事就甚憂愁，去把這事都告訴了主人。
english: So when the other servants saw what was done they were very sad, and came and gave word to their lord of what had been done.

chinese: 於是主人叫了他來，對他說：你這惡奴才！你央求我，我就把你所欠的都免了，
english: Then his lord sent for him and said, You evil servant; I made you free of all that debt, because of your request to me:

chinese: 你不應當憐恤你的同伴，像我憐恤你麼？
english: Was it not right for you to have mercy on the other servant, even as I had mercy on you?

chinese: 主人就大怒，把他交給掌刑的，等他還清了所欠的債。
english: And his lord was very angry, and put him in the hands of those who would give him punishment till he made payment of all the debt.

chinese: 你們各人若不從心裡饒恕你的弟兄，我天父也要這樣待你們了。
english: So will my Father in heaven do to you, if you do not everyone, from your hearts, give forgiveness to his brother.

chinese: 耶穌說完了這些話，就離開加利利，來到猶太的境界約但河外。
english: And it came about that after saying these words, Jesus went away from Galilee, and came into the parts of Judaea on the other side of Jordan.

chinese: 有許多人跟著他，他就在那裡把他們的病人治好了。
english: And a great number went after him; and he made them well there.

chinese: 有法利賽人來試探耶穌，說：人無論甚麼緣故都可以休妻麼？
english: And certain Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, Is it right for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：那起初造人的，是造男造女，
english: And he said in answer, Have you not seen in the Writings, that he who made them at the first made them male and female, and said,

chinese: 並且說：因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。這經你們沒有念過麼？
english: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother, and be joined to his wife; and the two will become one flesh?

chinese: 既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。所以，神配合的，人不可分開。
english: So that they are no longer two, but one flesh. Then let not that which has been joined by God be parted by man.

chinese: 法利賽人說：這樣，摩西為甚麼吩咐給妻子休書，就可以休他呢？
english: They say to him, Why then did Moses give orders that a husband might give her a statement in writing and be free from her?

chinese: 耶穌說：摩西因為你們的心硬，所以許你們休妻，但起初並不是這樣。
english: He says to them, Moses, because of your hard hearts, let you put away your wives: but it has not been so from the first.

chinese: 我告訴你們，凡休妻另娶的，若不是為淫亂的緣故，就是犯姦淫了；有人娶那被休的婦人，也是犯姦淫了。
english: And I say to you, Whoever puts away his wife for any other cause than the loss of her virtue, and takes another, is a false husband: and he who takes her as his wife when she is put away, is no true husband to her.

chinese: 門徒對耶穌說：人和妻子既是這樣，倒不如不娶。
english: The disciples say to him, If this is the position of a man in relation to his wife, it is better not to be married.

chinese: 耶穌說：這話不是人都能領受的，惟獨賜給誰，誰才能領受。
english: But he said to them, Not all men are able to take in this saying, but only those to whom it is given.

chinese: 因為有生來是閹人，也有被人閹的，並有為天國的緣故自閹的。這話誰能領受就可以領受。
english: For there are men who, from birth, were without sex: and there are some who were made so by men: and there are others who have made themselves so for the kingdom of heaven. He who is able to take it, let him take it.

chinese: 那時，有人帶著小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌給他們按手禱告，門徒就責備那些人。
english: Then some people took little children to him, so that he might put his hands on them in blessing: and the disciples said sharp words to them.

chinese: 耶穌說：讓小孩子到我這裡來，不要禁止他們；因為在天國的，正是這樣的人。
english: But Jesus said, Let the little ones come to me, and do not keep them away: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

chinese: 耶穌給他們按手，就離開那地方去了。
english: And he put his hands on them, and went away.

chinese: 有一個人來見耶穌，說：夫子（有古卷：良善的夫子），我該做甚麼善事才能得永生？
english: And one came to him and said, Master, what good thing have I to do, so that I may have eternal life?

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你為甚麼以善事問我呢？只有一位是善的（有古卷：你為什麼稱我是良善的？除了神以外，沒有一個良善的）。你若要進入永生，就當遵守誡命。
english: And he said to him, Why are you questioning me about what is good? One there is who is good: but if you have a desire to go into life, keep the rules of the law.

chinese: 他說：甚麼誡命？耶穌說：就是不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；
english: He says to him, Which? And Jesus said, Do not put anyone to death, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not take what is not yours, Do not give false witness,

chinese: 當孝敬父母，又當愛人如己。
english: Give honour to your father and your mother: and, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

chinese: 那少年人說：這一切我都遵守了，還缺少甚麼呢？
english: The young man says to him, All these things have I done: what more is there?

chinese: 耶穌說：你若願意作完全人，可去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。
english: Jesus said to him, If you have a desire to be complete, go, get money for your property, and give it to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven: and come after me.

chinese: 那少年人聽見這話，就憂憂愁愁的走了，因為他的產業很多。
english: But hearing these words the young man went away sorrowing: for he had much property.

chinese: 耶穌對門徒說：我實在告訴你們，財主進天國是難的。
english: And Jesus said to his disciples, Truly I say to you, It is hard for a man with much money to go into the kingdom of heaven.

chinese: 我又告訴你們，駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進神的國還容易呢！
english: And again I say to you, It is simpler for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a man with much money to go into the kingdom of God.

chinese: 門徒聽見這話，就希奇得很，說：這樣誰能得救呢？
english: And the disciples, hearing this, were greatly surprised, saying, Who then may have salvation?

chinese: 耶穌看著他們，說：在人這是不能的，在神凡事都能。
english: And Jesus, looking at them, said, With men this is not possible; but with God all things are possible.

chinese: 彼得就對他說：看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你，將來我們要得甚麼呢？
english: Then Peter said to him, See, we have given up everything and have come after you; what then will we have?

chinese: 耶穌說：我實在告訴你們，你們這跟從我的人，到復興的時候，人子坐在他榮耀的寶座上，你們也要坐在十二個寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。
english: And Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that in the time when all things are made new, and the Son of man is seated in his glory, you who have come after me will be seated on twelve seats, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

chinese: 凡為我的名撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姐妹、父親、母親、（有古卷在此有：妻子）兒女、田地的，必要得著百倍，並且承受永生。
english: And everyone who has given up houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or child, or land, for my name, will be given a hundred times as much, and have eternal life.

chinese: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後；在後的，將要在前。
english: But a great number who are first will be last, and some who are last will be first.

chinese: 因為天國好像家主清早去雇人進他的葡萄園做工，
english: For the kingdom of heaven is like the master of a house, who went out early in the morning to get workers into his vine-garden.

chinese: 和工人講定一天一錢銀子，就打發他們進葡萄園去。
english: And when he had made an agreement with the workmen for a penny a day, he sent them into his vine-garden.

chinese: 約在巳初出去，看見市上還有閒站的人，
english: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others in the market-place doing nothing;

chinese: 就對他們說：你們也進葡萄園去，所當給的，我必給你們。他們也進去了。
english: And he said to them, Go into the vine-garden with the others, and whatever is right I will give you. And they went to work.

chinese: 約在午正和申初又出去，也是這樣行。
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did the same.

chinese: 約在酉初出去，看見還有人站在那裡，就問他們說：你們為甚麼整天在這裡閒站呢？
english: And about the eleventh hour he went out and saw others doing nothing; and he says to them, Why are you here all the day doing nothing?

chinese: 他們說：因為沒有人雇我們。他說：你們也進葡萄園去。
english: They say to him, Because no man has given us work. He says to them, Go in with the rest, into the vine-garden.

chinese: 到了晚上，園主對管事的說：叫工人都來，給他們工錢，從後來的起，到先來的為止。
english: And when evening came, the lord of the vine-garden said to his manager, Let the workers come, and give them their payment, from the last to the first.

chinese: 約在酉初雇的人來了，各人得了一錢銀子。
english: And when those men came who had gone to work at the eleventh hour, they were given every man a penny.

chinese: 及至那先雇的來了，他們以為必要多得；誰知也是各得一錢。
english: Then those who came first had the idea that they would get more; and they, like the rest, were given a penny.

chinese: 他們得了，就埋怨家主說：
english: And when they got it, they made a protest against the master of the house,

chinese: 我們整天勞苦受熱，那後來的只做了一小時，你竟叫他們和我們一樣麼？
english: Saying, These last have done only one hour's work, and you have made them equal to us, who have undergone the hard work of the day and the burning heat.

chinese: 家主回答其中的一人說：朋友，我不虧負你，你與我講定的不是一錢銀子麼？
english: But he in answer said to one of them, Friend, I do you no wrong: did you not make an agreement with me for a penny?

chinese: 拿你的走罷！我給那後來的和給你一樣，這是我願意的。
english: Take what is yours, and go away; it is my pleasure to give to this last, even as to you.

chinese: 我的東西難道不可隨我的意思用麼？因為我作好人，你就紅了眼麼？
english: Have I not the right to do as seems good to me in my house? or is your eye evil, because I am good?

chinese: 這樣，那在後的，將要在前；在前的，將要在後了。（有古卷在此有：因為被召的人多，選上的人少。）
english: So the last will be first, and the first last.

chinese: 耶穌上耶路撒冷去的時候，在路上把十二個門徒帶到一邊，對他們說：
english: And when Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples on one side, and said to them,

chinese: 看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交給祭司長和文士。他們要定他死罪，
english: See, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man will be given into the hands of the chief priests and scribes; and they will give orders for him to be put to death,

chinese: 又交給外邦人，將他戲弄，鞭打，釘在十字架上；第三日他要復活。
english: And will give him up to the Gentiles to be made sport of and to be whipped and to be put to death on the cross: and the third day he will come back again from the dead.

chinese: 那時，西庇太兒子的母親同他兩個兒子上前來拜耶穌，求他一件事。
english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, giving him worship and making a request of him.

chinese: 耶穌說：你要甚麼呢？他說：願你叫我這兩個兒子在你國裡，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。
english: And he said to her, What is your desire? She says to him, Let my two sons be seated, the one at your right hand, and the other at your left, in your kingdom.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們不知道所求的是甚麼；我將要喝的杯，你們能喝麼？他們說：我們能。
english: But Jesus made answer and said, You have no idea what you are requesting. Are you able to take of the cup which I am about to take?

chinese: 耶穌說：我所喝的杯，你們必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是我父為誰預備的，就賜給誰。
english: They say to him, We are able. He says to them, Truly, you will take of my cup: but to be seated at my right hand and at my left is not for me to give, but it is for those for whom my Father has made it ready.

chinese: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒他們弟兄二人。
english: And when it came to the ears of the ten, they were angry with the two brothers.

chinese: 耶穌叫了他們來，說：你們知道外邦人有君王為主治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
english: But Jesus said to them, You see that the rulers of the Gentiles are lords over them, and their great ones have authority over them.

chinese: 只是在你們中間，不可這樣；你們中間誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
english: Let it not be so among you: but if anyone has a desire to become great among you, let him be your servant;

chinese: 誰願為首，就必作你們的僕人。
english: And whoever has a desire to be first among you, let him take the lowest place:

chinese: 正如人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命，作多人的贖價。
english: Even as the Son of man did not come to have servants, but to be a servant, and to give his life for the salvation of men.

chinese: 他們出耶利哥的時候，有極多的人跟隨他。
english: And when they were going out from Jericho, a great number went after him.

chinese: 有兩個瞎子坐在路旁，聽說是耶穌經過，就喊著說：主阿，大衛的子孫，可憐我們罷！
english: And two blind men seated by the wayside, when they had the news that Jesus was going by, gave a loud cry, saying, Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us.

chinese: 眾人責備他們，不許他們作聲；他們卻越發喊著說：主阿，大衛的子孫，可憐我們罷！
english: And the people gave them orders to be quiet; but they went on crying even louder, Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us.

chinese: 耶穌就站住，叫他們來，說：要我為你們做甚麼？
english: And Jesus, stopping, sent for them, and said, What would you have me do to you?

chinese: 他們說：主阿，要我們的眼睛能看見！
english: They say to him, Lord, that our eyes may be open.

chinese: 耶穌就動了慈心，把他們的眼睛一摸，他們立刻看見，就跟從了耶穌。
english: And Jesus, being moved with pity, put his fingers on their eyes: and straight away they were able to see, and went after him.

chinese: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄欖山那裡。
english: And when they were near Jerusalem, and had come to Beth-phage, to the Mountain of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,

chinese: 耶穌就打發兩個門徒，對他們說：你們往對面村子裡去，必看見一匹驢拴在那裡，還有驢駒同在一處；你們解開，牽到我這裡來。
english: Saying to them, Go into the little town in front of you, and straight away you will see an ass with a cord round her neck, and a young one with her; let them loose and come with them to me.

chinese: 若有人對你們說甚麼，你們就說：主要用他。那人必立時讓你們牽來。
english: And if anyone says anything to you, you will say, The Lord has need of them; and straight away he will send them.

chinese: 這事成就是要應驗先知的話，說：
english: Now this took place so that these words of the prophet might come true,

chinese: 要對錫安的居民（原文是女子）說：看哪，你的王來到你這裡，是溫柔的，又騎著驢，就是騎著驢駒子。
english: Say to the daughter of Zion, See, your King comes to you, gentle and seated on an ass, and on a young ass.

chinese: 門徒就照耶穌所吩咐的去行，
english: And the disciples went and did as Jesus had given them orders,

chinese: 牽了驢和驢駒來，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
english: And got the ass and the young one, and put their clothing on them, and he took his seat on it.

chinese: 眾人多半把衣服鋪在路上；還有人砍下樹枝來鋪在路上。
english: And all the people put their clothing down in the way; and others got branches from the trees, and put them down in the way.

chinese: 前行後隨的眾人喊著說：和散那（原有求救的意思，在此是稱頌的話）歸於大衛的子孫！奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！高高在上和散那！
english: And those who went before him, and those who came after, gave loud cries, saying, Glory to the Son of David: A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord: Glory in the highest.

chinese: 耶穌既進了耶路撒冷，合城都驚動了，說：這是誰？
english: And when he came into Jerusalem, all the town was moved, saying, Who is this?

chinese: 眾人說：這是加利利拿撒勒的先知耶穌。
english: And the people said, This is the prophet Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.

chinese: 耶穌進了神的殿，趕出殿裡一切作買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子，和賣鴿子之人的凳子；
english: And Jesus went into the Temple and sent out all who were trading there, overturning the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those trading in doves.

chinese: 對他們說：經上記著說：我的殿必稱為禱告的殿，你們倒使他成為賊窩了。
english: And he said to them, It is in the Writings, My house is to be named a house of prayer, but you are making it a hole of thieves.

chinese: 在殿裡有瞎子、瘸子到耶穌跟前，他就治好了他們.。
english: And the blind and the broken in body came to him in the Temple, and he made them well.

chinese: 祭司長和文士看見耶穌所行的奇事，又見小孩子在殿裡喊著說：和散那歸於大衛的子孫！就甚惱怒，
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the works of power which he did, and the children crying out in the Temple, Glory to the son of David, they were angry and said to him,

chinese: 對他說：這些人所說的，你聽見了麼？耶穌說：是的。經上說你從嬰孩和吃奶的口中完全了讚美的話，你們沒有念過麼？
english: Have you any idea what these are saying? And Jesus said to them, Yes: have you not seen in the Writings, From the lips of children and babies at the breast you have made your praise complete?

chinese: 於是離開他們，出城到伯大尼去，在那裡住宿。
english: And he went away from them, and went out of the town to Bethany, and was there for the night.

chinese: 早晨回城的時候，他餓了，
english: Now in the morning when he was coming back to the town, he had a desire for food.

chinese: 看見路旁有一棵無花果樹，就走到跟前，在樹上找不著甚麼，不過有葉子，就對樹說：從今以後，你永不結果子。那無花果樹就立刻枯乾了。
english: And seeing a fig-tree by the wayside, he came to it, and saw nothing on it but leaves only; and he said to it, Let there be no fruit from you from this time forward for ever. And straight away the fig-tree became dry and dead.

chinese: 門徒看見了﹐便希奇說：無花果樹怎麼立刻枯乾了呢？
english: And when the disciples saw it they were surprised, saying, How did the fig-tree become dry in so short a time?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行無花果樹上所行的事，就是對這座山說：你挪開此地，投在海裡！也必成就。
english: And Jesus in answer said to them, Truly I say to you, If you have faith, without doubting, not only may you do what has been done to the fig-tree, but even if you say to this mountain, Be taken up and put into the sea, it will be done.

chinese: 你們禱告，無論求甚麼，只要信，就必得著。
