english: And all things, whatever you make request for in prayer, having faith, you will get.

chinese: 耶穌進了殿，正教訓人的時候，祭司長和民間的長老來問他說：你仗著甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？
english: And when he had come into the Temple, the chief priests and those in authority over the people came to him while he was teaching, and said, By what authority do you do these things? and who gave you this authority?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我也要問你們一句話，你們若告訴我，我就告訴你們我仗著甚麼權柄做這些事。
english: And Jesus said to them in answer, I will put one question to you, and if you give me the answer, I will say by what authority I do these things.

chinese: 約翰的洗禮是從那裡來的？是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？他們彼此商議說：我們若說從天上來，他必對我們說：這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？
english: The baptism of John, where did it come from? from heaven or from men? And they were reasoning among themselves, saying, If we say, From heaven; he will say to us, Why then did you not have faith in him?

chinese: 若說從人間來，我們又怕百姓，因為他們都以約翰為先知。
english: But if we say, From men; we are in fear of the people, because all take John to be a prophet.

chinese: 於是回答耶穌說：我們不知道。耶穌說：我也不告訴你們我仗著甚麼權柄做這些事。
english: And they made answer and said, We have no idea. Then he said to them, And I will not say to you by what authority I do these things.

chinese: 又說：一個人有兩個兒子。他來對大兒子說：我兒，你今天到葡萄園裡去做工。
english: But how does it seem to you? A man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go and do work today in the vine-garden.

chinese: 他回答說：我不去，以後自己懊悔，就去了。
english: And he said in answer, I will not: but later, changing his decision, he went.

chinese: 又來對小兒子也是這樣說。他回答說：父阿，我去，他卻不去。
english: And he came to the second and said the same. And he made answer and said, I go, sir: and went not.

chinese: 你們想，這兩個兒子是那一個遵行父命呢？他們說：大兒子。耶穌說：我實在告訴你們，稅吏和娼妓倒比你們先進神的國。
english: Which of the two did his father's pleasure? They say, The first. Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, that tax-farmers and loose women are going into the kingdom of God before you.

chinese: 因為約翰遵著義路到你們這裡來，你們卻不信他；稅吏和娼妓倒信他。你們看見了，後來還是不懊悔去信他。
english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you had no faith in him, but the tax-farmers and the loose women had faith in him: and you, when you saw it, did not even have regret for your sins, so as to have faith in him.

chinese: 你們再聽一個比喻：有個家主栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，裡面挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
english: Give ear to another story. A master of a house made a vine garden, and put a wall round it, and made a place for crushing out the wine, and made a tower, and let it out to field-workers, and went into another country.

chinese: 收果子的時候近了，就打發僕人到園戶那裡去收果子。
english: And when the time for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the workmen, to get the fruit.

chinese: 園戶拿住僕人，打了一個，殺了一個，用石頭打死一個。
english: And the workmen made an attack on his servants, giving blows to one, putting another to death, and stoning another.

chinese: 主人又打發別的僕人去，比先前更多；園戶還是照樣待他們。
english: Again, he sent other servants more in number than the first: and they did the same to them.

chinese: 後來打發他的兒子到他們那裡去，意思說：他們必尊敬我的兒子。
english: But after that he sent his son to them, saying, They will have respect for my son.

chinese: 不料，園戶看見他兒子，就彼此說：這是承受產業的。來罷，我們殺他，佔他的產業！
english: But when the workmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is he who will one day be the owner of the property; come, let us put him to death and take his heritage.

chinese: 他們就拿住他，推出葡萄園外，殺了。
english: And they took him and, driving him out of the vine-garden, put him to death.

chinese: 園主來的時候要怎樣處治這些園戶呢？
english: When, then, the lord of the vine-garden comes, what will he do to those workmen?

chinese: 他們說：要下毒手除滅那些惡人，將葡萄園另租給那按著時候交果子的園戶。
english: They say to him, He will put those cruel men to a cruel death, and will let out the vine-garden to other workmen, who will give him the fruit when it is ready.

chinese: 耶穌說：經上寫著：匠人所棄的石頭已作了房角的頭塊石頭。這是主所做的，在我們眼中看為希奇。這經你們沒有念過麼？
english: Jesus says to them, Did you never see in the Writings, The stone which the builders put on one side, the same has been made the chief stone of the building: this was the Lord's doing, and it is a wonder in our eyes?

chinese: 所以我告訴你們，神的國必從你們奪去，賜給那能結果子的百姓。
english: For this reason I say to you, The kingdom of God will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation producing the fruits of it.

chinese: 誰掉在這石頭上，必要跌碎；這石頭掉在誰的身上，就要把誰砸得稀爛。
english: Any man falling on this stone will be broken, but he on whom it comes down will be crushed to dust.

chinese: 祭司長和法利賽人聽見他的比喻，就看出他是指著他們說的。
english: And when his stories came to the ears of the chief priests and the Pharisees, they saw that he was talking of them.

chinese: 他們想要捉拿他，只是怕眾人，因為眾人以他為先知。
english: And though they had a desire to take him, they were in fear of the people, because in their eyes he was a prophet.

chinese: 耶穌又用比喻對他們說：
english: And Jesus, talking to them again in stories, said:

chinese: 天國好比一個王為他兒子擺設娶親的筵席，
english: The kingdom of heaven is like a certain king, who made a feast when his son was married,

chinese: 就打發僕人去，請那些被召的人來赴席，他們卻不肯來。
english: And sent out his servants to get in the guests to the feast: and they would not come.

chinese: 王又打發別的僕人，說：你們告訴那被召的人，我的筵席已經預備好了，牛和肥畜已經宰了，各樣都齊備，請你們來赴席。
english: Again he sent out other servants, with orders to say to the guests, See, I have made ready my feast: my oxen and my fat beasts have been put to death, and all things are ready: come to the feast.

chinese: 那些人不理就走了；一個到自己田裡去；一個作買賣去；
english: But they gave no attention, and went about their business, one to his farm, another to his trade:

chinese: 其餘的拿住僕人，凌辱他們，把他們殺了。
english: And the rest put violent hands on his servants, and did evil to them, and put them to death.

chinese: 王就大怒，發兵除滅那些兇手，燒燬他們的城。
english: But the king was angry; and he sent his armies, and those who had put his servants to death he gave to destruction, burning down their town with fire.

chinese: 於是對僕人說：喜筵已經齊備，只是所召的人不配。
english: Then he said to his servants, The feast is ready but the guests were not good enough.

chinese: 所以你們要往岔路口上去，凡遇見的，都召來赴席。
english: Go then to the cross-roads, and get all those whom you see to come to the bride-feast.

chinese: 那些僕人就出去，到大路上，凡遇見的，不論善惡都召聚了來，筵席上就坐滿了客。
english: And those servants went out into the streets, and got together all those whom they came across, bad and good: and the feast was full of guests.

chinese: 王進來觀看賓客，見那裡有一個沒有穿禮服的，
english: But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who had not on a guest's robe;

chinese: 就對他說：朋友，你到這裡來怎麼不穿禮服呢？那人無言可答。
english: And he says to him, Friend, how came you in here not having a guest's robe? And he had nothing to say.

chinese: 於是王對使喚的人說：捆起他的手腳來，把他丟在外邊的黑暗裡；在那裡必要哀哭切齒了。
english: Then the king said to the servants, Put cords round his hands and feet and put him out into the dark; there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

chinese: 因為被召的人多，選上的人少。
english: For out of all to whom the good news has come, only a small number will get salvation.

chinese: 當時，法利賽人出去商議，怎樣就著耶穌的話陷害他，
english: Then the Pharisees went and had a meeting to see how they might make use of his words to take him.

chinese: 就打發他們的門徒同希律黨的人去見耶穌，說：夫子，我們知道你是誠實人，並且誠誠實實傳神的道，甚麼人你都不徇情面，因為你不看人的外貌。
english: And they sent to him their disciples, with the Herodians, saying, Master, we see that you are true, and that you are teaching the true way of God, and have no fear of anyone, because you have no respect for a man's position.

chinese: 請告訴我們，你的意見如何？納稅給該撒可以不可以？
english: Give us, then, your opinion of this: Is it right to give tax to Caesar, or not?

chinese: 耶穌看出他們的惡意，就說：假冒為善的人哪，為甚麼試探我？
english: But Jesus saw their trick and said, Oh false ones, why are you attempting to put me in the wrong?

chinese: 拿一個上稅的錢給我看！他們就拿一個銀錢來給他。
english: Let me see the tax money. And they gave him a penny.

chinese: 耶穌說：這像和這號是誰的？
english: And he said to them, Whose is this image and name on it?

chinese: 他們說：是該撒的。耶穌說：這樣，該撒的物當歸給該撒；神的物當歸給神。
english: They say to him, Caesar's. Then he said to them, Give to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's.

chinese: 他們聽見就希奇，離開他走了。
english: And hearing it, they were full of wonder, and went away from him.

chinese: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。那天，他們來問耶穌說：
english: On the same day there came to him the Sadducees, who say that there is no coming back from the dead: and they put a question to him, saying,

chinese: 夫子，摩西說：人若死了，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。
english: Master, Moses said, If a man, at the time of his death, has no children, let his brother take his wife, and get a family for his brother;

chinese: 從前，在我們這裡有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有孩子，撇下妻子給兄弟。
english: Now there were among us seven brothers; and the first was married and at his death, having no seed, gave his wife to his brother;

chinese: 第二、第三、直到第七個，都是如此。
english: In the same way the second and the third, up to the seventh.

chinese: 末後，婦人也死了。
english: And last of all the woman came to her end.

chinese: 這樣，當復活的時候，他是七個人中那一個的妻子呢？因為他們都娶過他。
english: When they come back from the dead, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? because they all had her.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們錯了；因為不明白聖經，也不曉得神的大能。
english: But Jesus said to them in answer, You are in error, not having knowledge of the Writings, or of the power of God.

chinese: 當復活的時候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
english: For when they come back from the dead there are no husbands and wives, but they are as the angels in heaven.

chinese: 論到死人復活，神在經上向你們所說的，你們沒有念過麼？
english: But about the dead coming back to life, have you no knowledge of what was said to you by God in the Writings:

chinese: 他說：我是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。神不是死人的神，乃是活人的神。
english: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead but of the living.

chinese: 眾人聽見這話，就希奇他的教訓。
english: And the people hearing it were surprised at his teaching.

chinese: 法利賽人聽見耶穌堵住了撒都該人的口，他們就聚集。
english: But the Pharisees, hearing how the mouths of the Sadducees had been stopped, came together;

chinese: 內中有一個人是律法師，要試探耶穌，就問他說：
english: And one of them, a teacher of the law, put a question to him, testing him, and saying,

chinese: 夫子，律法上的誡命，那一條是最大的呢？
english: Master, which is the chief rule in the law?

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你要盡心、盡性、盡意愛主─你的神。
english: And he said to him, Have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.

chinese: 這是誡命中的第一，且是最大的。
english: This is the first and greatest rule.

chinese: 其次也相倣，就是要愛人如己。
english: And a second like it is this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

chinese: 這兩條誡命是律法和先知一切道理的總綱。
english: On these two rules all the law and the prophets are based.

chinese: 法利賽人聚集的時候，耶穌問他們說：
english: Now while the Pharisees were together, Jesus put a question to them, saying,

chinese: 論到基督，你們的意見如何？他是誰的子孫呢？他們回答說：是大衛的子孫。
english: What is your opinion of the Christ? whose son is he? They say to him, The Son of David.

chinese: 耶穌說：這樣，大衛被聖靈感動，怎麼還稱他為主，說：
english: He says to them, How then does David in the Spirit give him the name of Lord, saying,

chinese: 主對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，等我把你仇敵放在你的腳下。
english: The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put under your feet all those who are against you?

chinese: 大衛既稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？
english: If David then gives him the name of Lord, how is he his son?

chinese: 他們沒有一個人能回答一言。從那日以後，也沒有人敢再問他甚麼。
english: And no one was able to give him an answer, and so great was their fear of him, that from that day no one put any more questions to him.

chinese: 那時﹐耶穌對眾人和門徒講論，
english: Then Jesus said to the people and to his disciples:

chinese: 說：文士和法利賽人坐在摩西的位上，
english: The scribes and the Pharisees have the authority of Moses;

chinese: 凡他們所吩咐你們的，你們都要謹守遵行；但不要效法他們的行為；因為他們能說，不能行。
english: All things, then, which they give you orders to do, these do and keep: but do not take their works as your example, for they say and do not.

chinese: 他們把難擔的重擔捆起來，擱在人的肩上，但自己一個指頭也不肯動。
english: They make hard laws and put great weights on men's backs; but they themselves will not put a finger to them.

chinese: 他們一切所做的事都是要叫人看見，所以將佩戴的經文做寬了，衣裳的繸子做長了，
english: But all their works they do so as to be seen by men: for they make wide their phylacteries, and the edges of their robes,

chinese: 喜愛筵席上的首座，會堂裡的高位，
english: And the things desired by them are the first places at feasts, and the chief seats in the Synagogues,

chinese: 又喜愛人在街市上問他安，稱呼他拉比（拉比就是夫子）。
english: And words of respect in the market-places, and to be named by men, Teacher.

chinese: 但你們不要受拉比的稱呼，因為只有一位是你們的夫子；你們都是弟兄。
english: But you may not be named Teacher: for one is your teacher, and you are all brothers.

chinese: 也不要稱呼地上的人為父，因為只有一位是你們的父，就是在天上的父。
english: And give no man the name of father on earth: because one is your Father, who is in heaven.

chinese: 也不要受師尊的稱呼，因為只有一位是你們的師尊，就是基督。
english: And you may not be named guides: because one is your Guide, even Christ.

chinese: 你們中間誰為大，誰就要作你們的用人。
english: But let the greatest among you be your servant.

chinese: 凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。
english: And whoever makes himself high will be made low, and whoever makes himself low will be made high.

chinese: 你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們正當人前，把天國的門關了，自己不進去，正要進去的人，你們也不容他們進去。（有古卷在此有
english: But a curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! because you are shutting the kingdom of heaven against men: for you do not go in yourselves, and those who are going in, you keep back.

chinese: 你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們侵吞寡婦的家產，假意做很長的禱告，所以要受更重的刑罰。）
你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們走遍洋海陸地，勾引一個人入教，既入了教，卻使他作地獄之子，比你們還加倍。
english: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you go about land and sea to get one disciple and, having him, you make him twice as much a son of hell as yourselves.

chinese: 你們這瞎眼領路的有禍了！你們說：凡指著殿起誓的，這算不得甚麼；只是凡指著殿中金子起誓的，他就該謹守。
english: A curse is on you, blind guides, who say, Whoever takes an oath by the Temple, it is nothing; but whoever takes an oath by the gold of the Temple, he is responsible.

chinese: 你們這無知瞎眼的人哪，甚麼是大的？是金子呢？還是叫金子成聖的殿呢？
english: You foolish ones and blind: which is greater, the gold, or the Temple which makes the gold holy?

chinese: 你們又說：凡指著壇起誓的，這算不得甚麼；只是凡指著壇上禮物起誓的，他就該謹守。
english: And, Whoever takes an oath by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever takes an oath by the offering which is on it, he is responsible.

chinese: 你們這瞎眼的人哪，甚麼是大的？是禮物呢？還是叫禮物成聖的壇呢？
english: You blind ones: which is greater, the offering, or the altar which makes the offering holy?

chinese: 所以，人指著壇起誓，就是指著壇和壇上一切所有的起誓；
english: He, then, who takes an oath by the altar, takes it by the altar and by all things on it.

chinese: 人指著殿起誓，就是指著殿和那住在殿裡的起誓；
english: And he who takes an oath by the Temple, takes it by the Temple and by him whose house it is.

chinese: 人指著天起誓，就是指著神的寶座和那坐在上面的起誓。
english: And he who takes an oath by heaven, takes it by the seat of God, and by him who is seated on it.

chinese: 你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們將薄荷、茴香、芹菜，獻上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，就是公義、憐憫、信實，反倒不行了。這更重的是你們當行的；那也是不可不行的。
english: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you make men give a tenth of all sorts of sweet-smelling plants, but you give no thought to the more important things of the law, righteousness, and mercy, and faith; but it is right for you to do these, and not to let the others be undone.

chinese: 你們這瞎眼領路的，蠓蟲你們就濾出來，駱駝你們倒吞下去。
english: You blind guides, who take out a fly from your drink, but make no trouble over a camel.

chinese: 你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們洗淨杯盤的外面，裡面卻盛滿了勒索和放蕩。
english: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you make clean the outside of the cup and of the plate, but inside they are full of violent behaviour and uncontrolled desire.

chinese: 你這瞎眼的法利賽人，先洗淨杯盤的裡面，好叫外面也乾淨了。
english: You blind Pharisee, first make clean the inside of the cup and of the plate, so that the outside may become equally clean.

chinese: 你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們好像粉飾的墳墓，外面好看，裡面卻裝滿了死人的骨頭和一切的污穢。
english: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you are like the resting-places of the dead, which are made white, and seem beautiful on the outside, but inside are full of dead men's bones and of all unclean things.

chinese: 你們也是如此，在人前，外面顯出公義來，裡面卻裝滿了假善和不法的事。
english: Even so you seem to men to be full of righteousness, but inside you are all false and full of wrongdoing.

chinese: 你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們建造先知的墳，修飾義人的墓，說：
english: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! because you put up buildings for housing the dead bodies of the prophets, and make fair the last resting-places of good men, and say,

chinese: 若是我們在我們祖宗的時候，必不和他們同流先知的血。
english: If we had been living in the days of our fathers, we would not have taken part with them in the blood of the prophets.

chinese: 這就是你們自己證明是殺害先知者的子孫了。
english: So that you are witnesses against yourselves that you are the sons of those who put the prophets to death.

chinese: 你們去充滿你們祖宗的惡貫罷！
english: Make full, then, the measure of your fathers.

chinese: 你們這些蛇類、毒蛇之種阿，怎能逃脫地獄?的刑罰呢？
english: You snakes, offspring of snakes, how will you be kept from the punishment of hell?

chinese: 所以我差遣先知和智慧人並文士到你們這裡來，有的你們要殺害，要釘十字架；有的你們要在會堂裡鞭打，從這城追逼到那城，
english: For this reason, I send you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: some of them you will put to death and put on the cross, and to some of them you will give blows in your Synagogues, driving them from town to town;

chinese: 叫世上所流義人的血都歸到你們身上，從義人亞伯的血起，直到你們在殿和壇中間所殺的巴拉加的兒子撒迦利亞的血為止。
english: So that on you may come all the blood of the upright on the earth, from the blood of upright Abel to the blood of Zachariah, son of Barachiah, whom you put to death between the Temple and the altar.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，這一切的罪都要歸到這世代了。
english: Truly I say to you, All these things will come on this generation.

chinese: 耶路撒冷阿，耶路撒冷阿，你常殺害先知，又用石頭打死那奉差遣到你這裡來的人。我多次願意聚集你的兒女，好像母雞把小雞聚集在翅膀底下，只是你們不願意。
english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, putting to death the prophets, and stoning those who are sent to her! Again and again would I have taken your children to myself as a bird takes her young ones under her wings, and you would not!

chinese: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。
english: See, your house is made waste.

chinese: 我告訴你們，從今以後，你們不得再見我，直等到你們說：奉主名來的是應當稱頌的。
english: For I say to you, You will not see me from this time till you say, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord.

chinese: 耶穌出了聖殿，正走的時候，門徒進前來，把殿宇指給他看。
english: And Jesus went out of the Temple, and on the way his disciples came to him, pointing out the buildings of the Temple.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們不是看見這殿宇麼？我實在告訴你們，將來在這裡沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。
english: But he, answering, said to them, See you not all these things? truly I say to you that here there will not be one stone resting on another, which will not be pulled down.

chinese: 耶穌在橄欖山上坐著，門徒暗暗的來說：請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事？你降臨和世界的末了有甚麼豫兆呢？
english: And while he was seated on the Mountain of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, Make clear to us, when will these things be? and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
english: And Jesus said to them in answer, Take care that you are not tricked.

chinese: 因為將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：我是基督，並且要迷惑許多人。
english: For people will come in my name, saying, I am the Christ; and a number will be turned from the true way through them.

chinese: 你們也要聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，總不要驚慌；因為這些事是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
english: And news will come to you of wars and talk of wars: do not be troubled, for these things have to be; but it is still not the end.

chinese: 民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有饑荒、地震。
english: For nation will be moved against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and men will be without food, and the earth will be shaking in different places;

chinese: 這都是災難（災難：原文是生產之難）的起頭。
english: But all these things are the first of the troubles.

chinese: 那時，人要把你們陷在患難裡，也要殺害你們；你們又要為我的名被萬民恨惡。
english: Then they will be cruel to you, and will put you to death: and you will be hated by all nations because of my name.

chinese: 那時，必有許多人跌倒，也要彼此陷害，彼此恨惡；
english: And numbers of people will be turned from the right way, and will give one another up and have hate for one another.

chinese: 且有好些假先知起來，迷惑多人。
english: And a number of false prophets will come, causing error.

chinese: 只因不法的事增多，許多人的愛心才漸漸冷淡了。
english: And because wrongdoing will be increased, the love of most people will become cold.

chinese: 惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
english: But he who goes through to the end will get salvation.

chinese: 這天國的福音要傳遍天下，對萬民作見證，然後末期才來到。
english: And this good news of the kingdom will be given through all the world for a witness to all nations; and then the end will come.

chinese: 你們看見先知但以理所說的那行毀壞可憎的站在聖地（讀這經的人須要會意）。
english: When, then, you see in the holy place the unclean thing which makes destruction, of which word was given by Daniel the prophet (let this be clear to the reader),

chinese: 那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
english: Then let those who are in Judaea go in flight to the mountains:

chinese: 在房上的，不要下來拿家裡的東西；
english: Let not him who is on the house-top go down to take anything out of his house:

chinese: 在田裡的，也不要回去取衣裳。
english: And let not him who is in the field go back to get his coat.

chinese: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了。
english: But it will be hard for women who are with child and for those with babies at the breast in those days.

chinese: 你們應當祈求，叫你們逃走的時候，不遇見冬天或是安息日。
english: And say a prayer that your flight may not be in the winter, or on a Sabbath.

chinese: 因為那時必有大災難，從世界的起頭直到如今，沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
english: Because in those days there will be great sorrow, such as there has not been from the start of the world till now, or ever will be.

chinese: 若不減少那日子，凡有血氣的總沒有一個得救的；只是為選民，那日子必減少了。
english: And if those days had not been made short there would have been no salvation for any, but because of the saints those days will be made short.

chinese: 那時，若有人對你們說：基督在這裡，或說：基督在那裡，你們不要信！
english: Then if any man says to you, See, here is the Christ, or, Here; do not put faith in him;

chinese: 因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯大神蹟、大奇事，倘若能行，連選民也就迷惑了。
english: For there will come up false Christs, and false prophets, who will do great signs and wonders; so that if possible even the saints might be tricked.

chinese: 看哪，我預先告訴你們了。
english: See, I have made it clear to you before it comes about.

chinese: 若有人對你們說：看哪，基督在曠野裡，你們不要出去！或說：看哪，基督在內屋中，你們不要信！
english: If, then, they say to you, See, he is in the waste land; go not out: See, he is in the inner rooms; put no faith in it.

chinese: 閃電從東邊發出，直照到西邊。人子降臨，也要這樣。
english: Because as in a thunderstorm the bright light coming from the east is seen even in the west; so will be the coming of the Son of man.

chinese: 屍首在那裡，鷹也必聚在那裡。
english: Wherever the dead body is, there will the eagles come together.

chinese: 那些日子的災難一過去，日頭就變黑了，月亮也不放光，眾星要從天上墜落，天勢都要震動。
english: But straight away, after the trouble of those days, the sun will be made dark and the moon will not give her light and the stars will come down from heaven and the powers of heaven will be moved:

chinese: 那時，人子的兆頭要顯在天上，地上的萬族都要哀哭。他們要看見人子，有能力，有大榮耀.，駕著天上的雲降臨。
english: And then the sign of the Son of man will be seen in heaven: and then all the nations of the earth will have sorrow, and they will see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

chinese: 他要差遣使者，用號筒的大聲，將他的選民，從四方（方：原文是風），從天這邊到天那邊，都招聚了來。
english: And he will send out his angels with a great sound of a horn, and they will get his saints together from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

chinese: 你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
english: Now take an example from the fig-tree: when her branch has become soft and puts out its leaves, you are certain that the summer is near;

chinese: 這樣，你們看見這一切的事，也該知道人子近了，正在門口了。
english: Even so, when you see all these things, you may be certain that he is near, even at the doors.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
english: Truly I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all these things are complete.

chinese: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。
english: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.

chinese: 那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟獨父知道。
english: But of that day and hour no one has knowledge, not even the angels in heaven, or the Son, but the Father only.

chinese: 挪亞的日子怎樣，人子降臨也要怎樣。
english: And as were the days of Noah, so will be the coming of the Son of man.

chinese: 當洪水以前的日子，人照常吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亞進方舟的那日；
english: Because as in those days before the overflowing of the waters, they were feasting and taking wives and getting married, till the day when Noah went into the ark,

chinese: 不知不覺洪水來了，把他們全都沖去。人子降臨也要這樣。
english: And they had no care till the waters came and took them all away; so will be the coming of the Son of man.

chinese: 那時，兩個人在田裡，取去一個，撇下一個。
english: Then two men will be in the field; one is taken, and one let go;

chinese: 兩個女人推磨，取去一個，撇下一個。
english: Two women will be crushing grain; one is taken, and one let go.

chinese: 所以，你們要儆醒，因為不知道你們的主是那一天來到。
english: Be watching, then! for you have no knowledge on what day your Lord will come.

chinese: 家主若知道幾更天有賊來，就必儆醒，不容人挖透房屋；這是你們所知道的。
english: But be certain of this, that if the master of the house had had knowledge of the time when the thief was coming, he would have been watching, and would not have let his house be broken into.

chinese: 所以，你們也要預備，因為你們想不到的時候，人子就來了。
english: Be ready then; for at a time which you have no thought of the Son of man will come.

chinese: 誰是忠心有見識的僕人，為主人所派，管理家裡的人，按時分糧給他們呢？
english: Who is the true and wise servant, whom his lord has put over those in his house, to give them their food at the right time?

chinese: 主人來到，看見他這樣行，那僕人就有福了。
english: A blessing on that servant, who will be doing so when his lord comes.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
english: Truly, I say to you, he will put him over all he has.

chinese: 倘若那惡僕心裡說：我的主人必來得遲，
english: But if that evil servant says in his heart, My lord is a long time in coming;

chinese: 就動手打他的同伴，又和酒醉的人一同吃喝。
english: And is cruel to the other servants, taking his pleasure with those who are overcome with wine;

chinese: 在想不到的日子，不知道的時辰，那僕人的主人要來，
english: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he is not looking for him, and in an hour of which he has no knowledge,

chinese: 重重的處治他（或作：把他腰斬了），定他和假冒為善的人同罪；在那裡必要哀哭切齒了。
english: And will have him cut in two, and will give him a part in the fate of the false ones: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

chinese: 那時，天國好比十個童女拿著燈出去迎接新郎。
english: Then the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins, the friends of the bride, who took their lights, and went out with the purpose of meeting the husband.

chinese: 其中有五個是愚拙的，五個是聰明的。
english: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

chinese: 愚拙的拿著燈，卻不預備油；
english: For the foolish, when they took their lights, took no oil with them.

chinese: 聰明的拿著燈，又預備油在器皿裡。
english: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lights.

chinese: 新郎遲延的時候，他們都打盹，睡著了。
english: Now the husband was a long time in coming, and they all went to sleep.

chinese: 半夜有人喊著說：新郎來了，你們出來迎接他！
english: But in the middle of the night there is a cry, The husband comes! Go out to him.

chinese: 那些童女就都起來收拾燈。
english: Then all those virgins got up, and made ready their lights.

chinese: 愚拙的對聰明的說：請分點油給我們，因為我們的燈要滅了。
english: And the foolish said to the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lights are going out.

chinese: 聰明的回答說：恐怕不夠你我用的；不如你們自己到賣油的那裡去買罷。
english: But the wise made answer, saying, There may not be enough for us and you; it would be better for you to go to the traders and get oil for yourselves.

chinese: 他們去買的時候，新郎到了。那預備好了的，同他進去坐席，門就關了。
english: And while they went to get oil, the master came; and those who were ready went in with him to the feast: and the door was shut.

chinese: 其餘的童女隨後也來了，說：主阿，主阿，給我們開門！
english: After that the other virgins came, saying, Lord, Lord, let us in.

chinese: 他卻回答說：我實在告訴你們，我不認識你們。
english: But he made answer and said, Truly I say to you, I have no knowledge of you.

chinese: 所以，你們要儆醒；因為那日子，那時辰，你們不知道。
english: Keep watch, then, because you are not certain of the day or of the hour.

chinese: 天國又好比一個人要往外國去，就叫了僕人來，把他的家業交給他們，
english: For it is as when a man, about to take a journey, got his servants together, and gave them his property.

chinese: 按著各人的才幹給他們銀子：一個給了五千，一個給了二千，一個給了一千，就往外國去了。
english: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to everyone as he was able; and he went on his journey.

chinese: 那領五千的隨即拿去做買賣，另外賺了五千。
english: Straight away he who had been given the five talents went and did trade with them, and made five more.

chinese: 那領二千的也照樣另賺了二千。
english: In the same way he who had been given the two got two more.

chinese: 但那領一千的去掘開地，把主人的銀子埋藏了。
english: But he who was given the one went away and put it in a hole in the earth, and kept his lord's money in a secret place.

chinese: 過了許久，那些僕人的主人來了，和他們算賬。
english: Now after a long time the lord of those servants comes, and makes up his account with them.

chinese: 那領五千銀子的又帶著那另外的五千來，說：主阿，你交給我五千銀子。請看，我又賺了五千。
english: And he who had the five talents came with his other five talents, saying, Lord, you gave into my care five talents: see, I have got five more.

chinese: 主人說：好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。
english: His lord said to him, Well done, good and true servant: you have been true in a small thing, I will give you control over great things: take your part in the joy of your lord.

chinese: 那領二千的也來，說：主阿，你交給我二千銀子。請看，我又賺了二千。
english: And he who had the two talents came and said, Lord, you gave into my care two talents: see, I have got two more.

chinese: 主人說：好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。
english: His lord said to him, Well done, good and true servant: you have been true in a small thing, I will give you control over great things: take your part in the joy of your lord.

chinese: 那領一千的也來，說：主阿，我知道你是忍心的人，沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，
english: And he who had had the one talent came and said, Lord, I had knowledge that you are a hard man, getting in grain where you have not put seed, and making profits for which you have done no work:

chinese: 我就害怕，去把你的一千銀子埋藏在地裡。請看，你的原銀子在這裡。
english: And I was in fear, and went away, and put your talent in the earth: here is what is yours.

chinese: 主人回答說：你這又惡又懶的僕人，你既知道我沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，
english: But his lord in answer said to him, You are a bad and unready servant; if you had knowledge that I get in grain where I did not put seed, and make profits for which I have done no work,

chinese: 就當把我的銀子放給兌換銀錢的人，到我來的時候，可以連本帶利收回。
english: Why, then, did you not put my money in the bank, and at my coming I would have got back what is mine with interest?

chinese: 奪過他這一千來，給那有一萬的。
english: Take away, then, his talent and give it to him who has the ten talents.

chinese: 因為凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪過來。
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have more: but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.

chinese: 把這無用的僕人丟在外面黑暗裡；在那裡必要哀哭切齒了。
english: And put out the servant who is of no profit into the outer dark: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

chinese: 當人子在他榮耀裡、同著眾天使降臨的時候，要坐在他榮耀的寶座上。
english: But when the Son of man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then will he be seated in his glory:

chinese: 萬民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他們分別出來，好像牧羊的分別綿羊山羊一般，
english: And before him all the nations will come together; and they will be parted one from another, as the sheep are parted from the goats by the keeper.

chinese: 把綿羊安置在右邊，山羊在左邊。
english: And he will put the sheep on his right, but the goats on the left.

chinese: 於是王要向那右邊的說：你們這蒙我父賜福的，可來承受那創世以來為你們所預備的國；
english: Then will the King say to those on his right, Come, you who have the blessing of my Father, into the kingdom made ready for you before the world was:

chinese: 因為我餓了，你們給我吃，渴了，你們給我喝；我作客旅，你們留我住；
english: For I was in need of food, and you gave it to me: I was in need of drink, and you gave it to me: I was wandering, and you took me in;

chinese: 我赤身露體，你們給我穿；我病了、你們看顧我；我在監裡，你們來看我。
english: I had no clothing, and you gave it to me: when I was ill, or in prison, you came to me.

chinese: 義人就回答說：主阿，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，給你吃，渴了，給你喝？
english: Then will the upright make answer to him, saying, Lord, when did we see you in need of food, and give it to you? or in need of drink, and give it to you?

chinese: 甚麼時候見你作客旅，留你住，或是赤身露體，給你穿？
english: And when did we see you wandering, and take you in? or without clothing, and give it to you?

chinese: 又甚麼時候見你病了，或是在監裡，來看你呢？
english: And when did we see you ill, or in prison, and come to you?

chinese: 王要回答說：我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。
english: And the King will make answer and say to them, Truly I say to you, Because you did it to the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.

chinese: 王又要向那左邊的說：你們這被咒詛的人，離開我！進入那為魔鬼和他的使者所預備的永火裡去！
english: Then will he say to those on the left, Go from me, you cursed ones, into the eternal fire which is ready for the Evil One and his angels:

chinese: 因為我餓了，你們不給我吃，渴了，你們不給我喝；
english: For I was in need of food, and you gave it not to me; I was in need of drink, and you gave it not to me:

chinese: 我作客旅，你們不留我住；我赤身露體，你們不給我穿；我病了，我在監裡，你們不來看顧我。
english: I was wandering, and you took me not in; without clothing, and you gave me no clothing; ill, and in prison, and you came not to me.

chinese: 他們也要回答說：主阿，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露體，或病了，或在監裡，不伺候你呢？
english: Then will they make answer, saying, Lord, when did we see you in need of food or drink, or wandering, or without clothing, or ill, or in prison, and did not take care of you?

chinese: 王要回答說：我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既不做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是不做在我身上了。
english: Then will he make answer to them, saying, Truly I say to you, Because you did it not to the least of these, you did it not to me.

chinese: 這些人要往永刑裡去；那些義人要往永生裡去。
english: And these will go away into eternal punishment; but the upright into eternal life.

chinese: 耶穌說完了這一切的話，就對門徒說：
english: And when Jesus had come to the end of all these words, he said to his disciples,

chinese: 你們知道，過兩天是逾越節，人子將要被交給人，釘在十字架上。
english: After two days is the Passover, and the Son of man will be given up to the death of the cross.

chinese: 那時，祭司長和民間的長老聚集在大祭司稱為該亞法的院裡。
english: Then the chief priests and the rulers of the people came together in the house of the high priest, who was named Caiaphas.

chinese: 大家商議要用詭計拿住耶穌，殺他，
english: And they made designs together to take Jesus by some trick, and put him to death.

chinese: 只是說：當節的日子不可，恐怕民間生亂。
english: But they said, Not while the feast is going on, for fear of trouble among the people.

chinese: 耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裡，
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper,

chinese: 有一個女人拿著一玉瓶極貴的香膏來，趁耶穌坐席的時候，澆在他的頭上。
english: There came to him a woman having a bottle of perfume of great price, and she put the perfume on his head when he was seated at table.

chinese: 門徒看見就很不喜悅，說：何用這樣的枉費呢！
english: But when the disciples saw it they were angry, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

chinese: 這香膏可以賣許多錢，賙濟窮人。
english: For we might have got much money for this and given it to the poor.

chinese: 耶穌看出他們的意思，就說：為甚麼難為這女人呢？他在我身上做的是一件美事。
english: But Jesus, seeing it, said to them, Why are you troubling the woman? she has done a kind act to me.

chinese: 因為常有窮人和你們同在；只是你們不常有我。
english: For the poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.

chinese: 他將這香膏澆在我身上是為我安葬做的。
english: For in putting this perfume on my body, she did it to make me ready for my last resting-place.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所行的，作個紀念。
english: Truly I say to you, Wherever this good news goes out in all the world, what this woman has done will be talked of in memory of her.

chinese: 當下，十二門徒裡有一個稱為加略人猶大的，去見祭司長，
english: Then one of the twelve, who was named Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests and said,

chinese: 說：我把他交給你們，你們願意給我多少錢？他們就給了他三十塊錢。
english: What will you give me, if I give him up to you? And the price was fixed at thirty bits of silver.

chinese: 從那時候，他就找機會要把耶穌交給他們。
english: And from that time he was watching for a chance to give him into their hands.

chinese: 除酵節的第一天，門徒來問耶穌說：你吃逾越節的筵席，要我們在那裡給你預備？
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where are we to make ready for you to take the Passover meal?

chinese: 耶穌說：你們進城去，到某人那裡，對他說：夫子說：我的時候快到了，我與門徒要在你家裡守逾越節。
english: And he said to them, Go into the town to such a man, and say to him, The Master says, My time is near: I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.

chinese: 門徒遵著耶穌所吩咐的就去預備了逾越節的筵席。
english: And the disciples did as Jesus had said to them; and they made ready the Passover.

chinese: 到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒坐席。
english: Now when evening was come, he was seated at table with the twelve disciples;

chinese: 正吃的時候，耶穌說：我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。
english: And while they were taking food, he said, Truly I say to you that one of you will be false to me.

chinese: 他們就甚憂愁，一個一個的問他說：主，是我麼？
english: And they were very said, and said to him, one by one, Is it I, Lord?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：同我蘸手在盤子裡的，就是他要賣我。
english: And he made answer and said, He who puts his hand into the plate with me, the same will be false to me.

chinese: 人子必要去世，正如經上指著他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。
english: The Son of man goes, even as the Writings say of him: but a curse is on that man through whom the Son of man is given up; it would have been well for that man if he had never come into the world.

chinese: 賣耶穌的猶大問他說：拉比，是我麼？耶穌說：你說的是。
english: And Judas, who was false to him, made answer and said, Is it I, Master? He says to him, Yes.

chinese: 他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝福，就擘開，遞給門徒，說：你們拿著吃，這是我的身體；
english: And when they were taking food, Jesus took bread and, after blessing it, he gave the broken bread to the disciples and said, Take it; this is my body.

chinese: 又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們，說：你們都喝這個；
english: And he took a cup and, having given praise, he gave it to them, saying,

chinese: 因為這是我立約的血，為多人流出來，使罪得赦。
english: Take of it, all of you, for this is my blood of the testament, which is given for men for the forgiveness of sins.

chinese: 但我告訴你們，從今以後，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在我父的國裡同你們喝新的那日子。
english: But I say to you that from now I will not take of this fruit of the vine, till that day when I take it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

chinese: 他們唱了詩，就出來往橄欖山去。
english: And after a song of praise to God, they went out to the Mountain of Olives.

chinese: 那時，耶穌對他們說：今夜，你們為我的緣故都要跌倒。因為經上記著說：我要擊打牧人，羊就分散了。
english: Then said Jesus to them, All of you will be turned away from me this night: for it is said in the Writings, I will put to death the keeper of the sheep, and the sheep of the flock will be put to flight.

chinese: 但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。
english: But after I am come back from the dead, I will go before you into Galilee.

chinese: 彼得說：眾人雖然為你的緣故跌倒，我卻永不跌倒。
english: But Peter made answer and said to him, Though all may be turned away from you, I will never be turned away.

chinese: 耶穌說：我實在告訴你，今夜雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。
english: Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you that this night, before the hour of the cock's cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.

chinese: 彼得說：我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。眾門徒都是這樣說。
english: Peter says to him, Even if I am put to death with you, I will not be false to you. So said all the disciples.

chinese: 耶穌同門徒來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼，就對他們說：你們坐在這裡，等我到那邊去禱告。
english: Then comes Jesus with them to a place named Gethsemane, and says to his disciples, Be seated here, while I go over there for prayer.

chinese: 於是帶著彼得和西庇太的兩個兒子同去，就憂愁起來，極其難過，
english: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and became sad and very troubled.

chinese: 便對他們說：我心裡甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裡等候，和我一同儆醒。
english: Then says he to them, My soul is very sad, even to death: keep watch with me here.

chinese: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：我父阿，倘若可行，求你叫這杯離開我。然而，不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。
english: And he went forward a little, and falling down on his face in prayer, he said, O my Father, if it is possible, let this cup go from me; but let not my pleasure, but yours be done.

chinese: 來到門徒那裡，見他們睡著了，就對彼得說：怎麼樣？你們不能同我儆醒片時麼？
english: And he comes to the disciples, and sees that they are sleeping, and says to Peter, What, were you not able to keep watch with me one hour?

chinese: 總要儆醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。
english: Keep watch with prayer, so that you may not be put to the test: the spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is feeble.

chinese: 第二次又去禱告說：我父阿，這杯若不能離開我，必要我喝，就願你的意旨成全。
english: Again, a second time he went away, and said in prayer, O my Father, if this may not go from me without my taking it, let your pleasure be done.

chinese: 又來，見他們睡著了，因為他們的眼睛困倦。
english: And he came again and saw them sleeping, for their eyes were tired.

chinese: 耶穌又離開他們去了。第三次禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣。
english: And he went away from them again, and a third time said the same prayer.

chinese: 於是來到門徒那裡，對他們說：現在你們仍然睡覺安歇罷（罷：或作麼？）！時候到了，人子被賣在罪人手裡了。
english: Then he comes to the disciples; and says to them, Go on sleeping now, and take your rest: for the hour is come, and the Son of man is given into the hands of evil men.

chinese: 起來！我們走罷。看哪，賣我的人近了。
english: Up, let us be going: see, he who gives me up is near.

chinese: 說話之間，那十二個門徒裡的猶大來了，並有許多人帶著刀棒，從祭司長和民間的長老那裡與他同來。
english: And while he was still talking, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a band armed with swords and sticks, from the chief priests and those in authority over the people.

chinese: 那賣耶穌的給了他們一個暗號，說：我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們可以拿住他。
english: Now the false one had given them a sign saying, The one to whom I give a kiss, that is he: take him.

chinese: 猶大隨即到耶穌跟前，說：請拉比安，就與他親嘴。
english: And straight away he came to Jesus and said, Master! and gave him a kiss.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：朋友，你來要做的事，就做罷。於是那些人上前，下手拿住耶穌。
english: And Jesus said to him, Friend, do that for which you have come. Then they came and put hands on Jesus, and took him.

chinese: 有跟隨耶穌的一個人伸手拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。
english: And one of those who were with Jesus put out his hand, and took out his sword and gave the servant of the high priest a blow, cutting off his ear.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：收刀入鞘罷！凡動刀的，必死在刀下。
english: Then says Jesus to him, Put up your sword again into its place: for all those who take the sword will come to death by the sword.

chinese: 你想，我不能求我父現在為我差遣十二營多天使來麼？
english: Does it not seem possible to you that if I make request to my Father he will even now send me an army of angels?

chinese: 若是這樣，經上所說，事情必須如此的話怎麼應驗呢？
english: But how then would the Writings come true, which say that so it has to be?

chinese: 當時，耶穌對眾人說：你們帶著刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜麼？我天天坐在殿裡教訓人，你們並沒有拿我。
english: In that hour Jesus said to the people, Have you come out as against a thief with swords and sticks to take me? I was teaching every day in the Temple and you took me not.

chinese: 但這一切的事成就了，為要應驗先知書上的話。當下，門徒都離開他逃走了。
english: But all this has taken place so that the writings of the prophets might come true. Then all his disciples went from him in flight.

chinese: 拿耶穌的人把他帶到大祭司該亞法那裡去；文士和長老已經在那裡聚會。
english: And those who had made Jesus prisoner took him away to the house of Caiaphas, the high priest, where the scribes and those in authority over the people had come together.

chinese: 彼得遠遠的跟著耶穌，直到大祭司的院子，進到裡面，就和差役同坐，要看這事到底怎樣。
english: But Peter went after him at a distance, to the house of the high priest, and went in and took his seat with the servants, to see the end.

chinese: 祭司長和全公會尋找假見證控告耶穌，要治死他。
english: Now the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin were looking for false witness against Jesus, so that they might put him to death;

chinese: 雖有好些人來作假見證，總得不著實據。末後有兩個人前來，說：
english: And they were not able to get it, though a number of false witnesses came.

chinese: 這個人曾說：我能拆毀神的殿，三日內又建造起來。
english: But later there came two who said, This man said, I am able to give the Temple of God to destruction, and to put it up again in three days.

chinese: 大祭司就站起來，對耶穌說：你甚麼都不回答麼？這些人作見證告你的是甚麼呢？
english: And the high priest got up and said to him, Have you no answer? what is it which these say against you?

chinese: 耶穌卻不言語。大祭司對他說：我指著永生神叫你起誓告訴我們，你是神的兒子基督不是？
english: But Jesus said not a word. And the high priest said to him, I put you on oath, by the living God, that you will say to us if you are the Christ, the Son of God.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你說的是。然而，我告訴你們，後來你們要看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕著天上的雲降臨。
english: Jesus says to him, You say so: but I say to you, From now you will see the Son of man seated at the right hand of power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.

chinese: 大祭司就撕開衣服，說：他說了僭妄的話，我們何必再用見證人呢？這僭妄的話，現在你們都聽見了。
english: Then the high priest, violently parting his robes, said, He has said evil against God: what more need have we of witnesses? for now his words against God have come to your ears:

chinese: 你們的意見如何？他們回答說：他是該死的。
english: What is your opinion? They made answer and said, It is right for him to be put to death.

chinese: 他們就吐唾沫在他臉上，用拳頭打他；也有用手掌打他的，說：
english: Then they put shame on him, and were cruel to him: and some gave him blows, saying,

chinese: 基督阿！你是先知，告訴我們打你的是誰？
english: Be a prophet, O Christ, and say who gave you a blow!

chinese: 彼得在外面院子裡坐著，有一個使女前來，說：你素來也是同那加利利人耶穌一夥的。
english: Now Peter was seated in the open square outside the house: and a servant-girl came to him, saying, You were with Jesus the Galilaean.

chinese: 彼得在眾人面前卻不承認，說：我不知道你說的是甚麼！
english: But he said before them all that it was false, saying, I have no knowledge of what you say.

chinese: 既出去，到了門口，又有一個使女看見他，就對那裡的人說：這個人也是同拿撒勒人耶穌一夥的。
english: And when he had gone out into the doorway, another saw him and says to those who were there, This man was with Jesus the Nazarene.

chinese: 彼得又不承認，並且起誓說：我不認得那個人。
english: And again he said with an oath, I have no knowledge of the man.

chinese: 過了不多的時候，旁邊站著的人前來，對彼得說：你真是他們一黨的，你的口音把你露出來了。
english: And after a little time those who were near came and said to Peter, Truly you are one of them; because your talk is witness against you.

chinese: 彼得就發咒起誓的說：我不認得那個人。立時，雞就叫了。
english: Then with curses and oaths he said, I have no knowledge of the man. And straight away there came the cry of a cock.

chinese: 彼得想起耶穌所說的話：雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。他就出去痛哭。
english: And the word of Jesus came back to Peter, when he said, Before the hour of the cock's cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me. And he went out, weeping bitterly.

chinese: 到了早晨，眾祭司長和民間的長老大家商議要治死耶穌，
english: Now when it was morning, all the chief priests and those in authority took thought together with the purpose of putting Jesus to death.

chinese: 就把他捆綁，解去，交給巡撫彼拉多。
english: And they put cords on him and took him away, and gave him up to Pilate, the ruler.

chinese: 這時候，賣耶穌的猶大看見耶穌已經定了罪，就後悔，把那三十塊錢拿回來給祭司長和長老，說：
english: Then Judas, who was false to him, seeing that he was to be put to death, in his regret took back the thirty bits of silver to the chief priests and those in authority,

chinese: 我賣了無辜之人的血是有罪了。他們說：那與我們有甚麼相干？你自己承當罷！
english: Saying, I have done wrong in giving into your hands an upright man. But they said, What is that to us? it is your business.

chinese: 猶大就把那銀錢丟在殿裡，出去吊死了。
english: And he put down the silver in the Temple and went out, and put himself to death by hanging.

chinese: 祭司長拾起銀錢來，說：這是血價，不可放在庫裡。
english: And the chief priests took the silver and said, It is not right to put it in the Temple store for it is the price of blood.

chinese: 他們商議，就用那銀錢買了窯戶的一塊田，為要埋葬外鄉人。
english: And they made a decision to get with the silver the potter's field, as a place for the dead of other countries.

chinese: 所以那塊田直到今日還叫做血田。
english: For this cause that field was named, The field of blood, to this day.

chinese: 這就應驗了先知耶利米的話，說：他們用那三十塊錢，就是被估定之人的價錢，是以色列人中所估定的，
english: Then came true that which was said by Jeremiah the prophet, And they took the thirty bits of silver, the price of him who was valued by the children of Israel;

chinese: 買了窯戶的一塊田；這是照著主所吩咐我的。
english: And they gave them for the potter's field, as I had word from the Lord.

chinese: 耶穌站在巡撫面前；巡撫問他說：你是猶太人的王麼？耶穌說：你說的是。
english: And Jesus was before the ruler, who put a question to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And Jesus said to him, You say so.

chinese: 他被祭司長和長老控告的時候，甚麼都不回答。
english: But when the chief priests and those in authority made statements against him, he gave no answer.

chinese: 彼拉多就對他說：他們作見證告你這麼多的事，你沒有聽見麼？
english: Then says Pilate to him, Do you give no attention to what their witnesses say against you?

chinese: 耶穌仍不回答，連一句話也不說，以致巡撫甚覺希奇。
english: And he gave him no answer, not even a word: so that the ruler was greatly surprised.

chinese: 巡撫有一個常例，每逢這節期，隨眾人所要的釋放一個囚犯給他們。
english: Now at the feast it was the way for the ruler to let free to the people one prisoner, at their selection.

chinese: 當時有一個出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。
english: And they had then an important prisoner, whose name was Barabbas.

chinese: 眾人聚集的時候，彼拉多就對他們說：你們要我釋放那一個給你們？是巴拉巴呢？是稱為基督的耶穌呢？
english: So when they came together, Pilate said to them, Whom will you have? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is named Christ?

chinese: 巡撫原知道他們是因為嫉妒才把他解了來。
english: For he saw that for envy they had given him up.

chinese: 正坐堂的時候，他的夫人打發人來說：這義人的事，你一點不可管，因為我今天在夢中為他受了許多的苦。
english: And while he was on the judge's seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have nothing to do with that upright man, for I have had much trouble this day in a dream because of him.

chinese: 祭司長和長老挑唆眾人，求釋放巴拉巴，除滅耶穌。
english: Now the chief priests and those in authority got the people to make request for Barabbas, and for Jesus to be put to death.

chinese: 巡撫對眾人說：這兩個人，你們要我釋放那一個給你們呢？他們說：巴拉巴。
english: But the ruler made answer and said to them, Which of the two is it your pleasure that I let go free? And they said, Barabbas.

chinese: 彼拉多說：這樣，那稱為基督的耶穌我怎麼辦他呢？他們都說：把他釘十字架！
english: Pilate says to them, What, then, am I to do with Jesus, who is named Christ? They all say, Let him be put to death on the cross.

chinese: 巡撫說：為甚麼呢？他作了甚麼惡事呢？他們便極力的喊著說：把他釘十字架！
english: And he said, Why, what evil has he done? But they gave loud cries, saying, To the cross with him!

chinese: 彼拉多見說也無濟於事，反要生亂，就拿水在眾人面前洗手，說：流這義人的血，罪不在我，你們承當罷。
english: So when Pilate saw that he was able to do nothing, but that trouble was working up, he took water and, washing his hands before the people, said, The blood of this upright man is not on my hands: you are responsible.

chinese: 眾人都回答說：他的血歸到我們和我們的子孫身上。
english: And all the people made answer and said, Let his blood be on us, and on our children.

chinese: 於是彼拉多釋放巴拉巴給他們，把耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。
english: Then he let Barabbas go free: but after having Jesus whipped, he gave him up to be put to death on the cross.

chinese: 巡撫的兵就把耶穌帶進衙門，叫全營的兵都聚集在他那裡。
english: Then the ruler's armed men took Jesus into the open square, and got all their band together.

chinese: 他們給他脫了衣服，穿上一件朱紅色袍子，
english: And they took off his clothing, and put on him a red robe.

chinese: 用荊棘編做冠冕，戴在他頭上，拿一根葦子放在他右手裡，跪在他面前，戲弄他，說：恭喜，猶太人的王阿！
english: And they made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and put a rod in his right hand, and they went down on their knees before him, and made sport of him, saying, Long life to the King of the Jews.

chinese: 又吐唾沫在他臉上，拿葦子打他的頭。
english: And they put shame on him, and gave him blows on the head with the rod.

chinese: 戲弄完了，就給他脫了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，帶他出去，要釘十字架。
english: And when they had made sport of him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothing on him, and took him away to put him on the cross.

chinese: 他們出來的時候，遇見一個古利奈人，名叫西門，就勉強他同去，好背著耶穌的十字架。
english: And while they were coming out, they saw a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they made him go with them, so that he might take up his cross.

chinese: 到了一個地方名叫各各他，意思就是髑髏地。
english: And when they came to the place named Golgotha, that is to say, Dead Man's Head,

chinese: 兵丁拿苦膽調和的酒給耶穌喝。他嘗了，就不肯喝。
english: They gave him wine mixed with bitter drink: and after tasting it, he took no more.

chinese: 他們既將他釘在十字架上，就拈鬮分他的衣服，
english: And when they had put him on the cross, they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.

chinese: 又坐在那裡看守他。
english: And they were seated there watching him.

chinese: 在他頭以上安一個牌子，寫著他的罪狀，說：這是猶太人的王耶穌。
english: And they put up over his head the statement of his crime in writing, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

chinese: 當時，有兩個強盜和他同釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。
english: Then two thieves were put on crosses with him, one on the right and one on the left.

chinese: 從那裡經過的人譏誚他，搖著頭，說：
english: And those who went by said bitter words to him, shaking their heads and saying,

chinese: 你這拆毀聖殿、三日又建造起來的，可以救自己罷！你如果是神的兒子，就從十字架上下來罷！
english: You who would give the Temple to destruction and put it up again in three days, get yourself free: if you are the Son of God, come down from the cross.

chinese: 祭司長和文士並長老也是這樣戲弄他，說：
english: In the same way, the chief priests, making sport of him, with the scribes and those in authority, said,

chinese: 他救了別人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，現在可以從十字架上下來，我們就信他。
english: A saviour of others, he has no salvation for himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will have faith in him.

chinese: 他倚靠神，神若喜悅他，現在可以救他；因為他曾說：我是神的兒子。
english: He put his faith in God; let God be his saviour now, if he will have him; for he said, I am the Son of God.

chinese: 那和他同釘的強盜也是這樣的譏誚他。
english: And the thieves who were on the crosses said evil words to him.

chinese: 從午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
english: Now from the sixth hour it was dark over all the land till the ninth hour.

chinese: 約在申初，耶穌大聲喊著說：以利！以利！拉馬撒巴各大尼？就是說：我的神！我的神！為甚麼離棄我？
english: And about the ninth hour Jesus gave a loud cry, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is, My God, my God, why are you turned away from me?

chinese: 站在那裡的人，有的聽見就說：這個人呼叫以利亞呢！
english: And some of those who were near by, hearing it, said, This man is crying to Elijah.

chinese: 內中有一個人趕緊跑去，拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝。
english: And straight away one of them went quickly, and took a sponge, and made it full of bitter wine, and put it on a rod and gave him drink.

chinese: 其餘的人說：且等著，看以利亞來救他不來。
english: And the rest said, Let him be; let us see if Elijah will come to his help.

chinese: 耶穌又大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。
english: And Jesus gave another loud cry, and gave up his spirit.

chinese: 忽然，殿裡的幔子從上到下裂為兩半，地也震動，磐石也崩裂，
english: And the curtain of the Temple was parted in two from end to end; and there was an earth-shock; and the rocks were broken;

chinese: 墳墓也開了，已睡聖徒的身體多有起來的。
english: And the resting-places of the dead came open; and the bodies of a number of sleeping saints came to life;

chinese: 到耶穌復活以後，他們從墳墓裡出來，進了聖城，向許多人顯現。
english: And coming out of their resting-places, after he had come again from the dead, they went into the holy town and were seen by a number of people.

chinese: 百夫長和一同看守耶穌的人看見地震並所經歷的事，就極其害怕，說：這真是神的兒子了！
english: Now the captain and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earth-shock and the things which were done, were in great fear and said, Truly this was a son of God.

chinese: 有好些婦女在那裡，遠遠的觀看；他們是從加利利跟隨耶穌來服事他的。
english: And a number of women were there, watching from a distance, who had come with Jesus from Galilee, waiting on his needs.

chinese: 內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有西庇太兩個兒子的母親。
english: Among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary, the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

chinese: 到了晚上，有一個財主，名叫約瑟，是亞利馬太來的，他也是耶穌的門徒。
english: And in the evening, there came a man of wealth from Arimathaea, Joseph by name, who was a disciple of Jesus:

chinese: 這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；彼拉多就吩咐給他。
english: This man went in to Pilate, and made a request for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate gave orders for it to be given to him.

chinese: 約瑟取了身體，用乾淨細麻布裹好，
english: And Joseph took the body, folding it in clean linen,

chinese: 安放在自己的新墳墓裡，就是他鑿在磐石裡的。他又把大石頭滾到墓門口，就去了。
english: And put it in the resting-place which had been cut out of the rock for himself; and after rolling a great stone to the door of it he went away.

chinese: 有抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞在那裡，對著墳墓坐著。
english: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, seated by the place of the dead.

chinese: 次日，就是預備日的第二天，祭司長和法利賽人聚集來見彼拉多，說：
english: Now on the day after the getting ready of the Passover, the chief priests and Pharisees came together to Pilate,

chinese: 大人，我們記得那誘惑人的還活著的時候曾說：三日後我要復活。
english: Saying, Sir, we have in mind how that false man said, while he was still living, After three days I will come again from the dead.

chinese: 因此，請吩咐人將墳墓把守妥當，直到第三日，恐怕他的門徒來，把他偷了去，就告訴百姓說：他從死裡復活了。這樣，那後來的迷惑比先前的更利害了！
english: Give orders, then, that the place where his body is may be made safe till the third day, for fear that his disciples come and take him away secretly and say to the people, He has come back from the dead: and the last error will be worse than the first.

chinese: 彼拉多說：你們有看守的兵，去罷！盡你們所能的把守妥當。
english: Pilate said to them, You have watchmen; go and make it as safe as you are able.

chinese: 他們就帶著看守的兵同去，封了石頭，將墳墓把守妥當。
english: So they went, and made safe the place where his body was, putting a stamp on the stone, and the watchmen were with them.

chinese: 安息日將盡，七日的頭一日，天快亮的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞來看墳墓。
english: Now late on the Sabbath, when the dawn of the first day of the week was near, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the place where his body was.

chinese: 忽然，地大震動；因為有主的使者從天上下來，把石頭滾開，坐在上面。
english: And there was a great earth-shock; for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, rolling back the stone, took his seat on it.

chinese: 他的像貌如同閃電，衣服潔白如雪。
english: His form was shining like the light, and his clothing was white as snow:

chinese: 看守的人就因他嚇得渾身亂戰，甚至和死人一樣。
english: And for fear of him the watchmen were shaking, and became as dead men.

chinese: 天使對婦女說：不要害怕！我知道你們是尋找那釘十字架的耶穌。
english: And the angel said to the women, Have no fear: for I see that you are searching for Jesus, who was put to death on the cross.

chinese: 他不在這裡，照他所說的，已經復活了。你們來看安放主的地方。
english: He is not here, for he has come to life again, even as he said. Come, see the Lord's resting-place.

chinese: 快去告訴他的門徒，說他從死裡復活了，並且在你們以先往加利利去，在那裡你們要見他。看哪，我已經告訴你們了。
english: And go quickly and give his disciples the news that he has come back from the dead, and is going before you into Galilee; there you will see him, as I have said to you.

chinese: 婦女們就急忙離開墳墓，又害怕，又大大的歡喜，跑去要報給他的門徒。
english: And they went away quickly, with fear and great joy, to give his disciples the news.

chinese: 忽然，耶穌遇見他們，說：願你們平安！他們就上前抱住他的腳拜他。
english: And on the way, Jesus came to them, saying, Be glad. And they came and put their hands on his feet, and gave him worship.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：不要害怕！你們去告訴我的弟兄，叫他們往加利利去，在那裡必見我。
english: Then said Jesus to them, Have no fear: go and give word to my brothers to go into Galilee, and there they will see me.

chinese: 他們去的時候，看守的兵有幾個進城去，將所經歷的事都報給祭司長。
english: Now, while they were going, some of the watchmen came into the town and gave news to the chief priests of all the things which had taken place.

chinese: 祭司長和長老聚集商議，就拿許多銀錢給兵丁，說：
english: And when they had come together with those in authority, and had made their decision, they gave much money to the watchmen, saying,

chinese: 你們要這樣說：夜間我們睡覺的時候，他的門徒來，把他偷去了。
english: Say, His disciples came by night and took him away secretly while we were sleeping.

chinese: 倘若這話被巡撫聽見，有我們勸他，保你們無事。
english: And if this comes to the ruler's ears, we will see that he does not make you responsible.

chinese: 兵丁受了銀錢，就照所囑咐他們的去行。這話就傳說在猶太人中間，直到今日。
english: So they took the money, and did as they had been ordered: and this account has been current among the Jews till the present time.

chinese: 十一個門徒往加利利去，到了耶穌約定的山上。
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had given them orders to go.

chinese: 他們見了耶穌就拜他，然而還有人疑惑。
english: And when they saw him they gave him worship: but some were in doubt.

chinese: 耶穌進前來，對他們說：天上地下所有的權柄都賜給我了。
english: And Jesus came to them and said, All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

chinese: 所以，你們要去，使萬民作我的門徒，奉父、子、聖靈的名給他們施洗（或作：給他們施洗，歸於父、子、聖靈的名）。
english: Go then, and make disciples of all the nations, giving them baptism in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:

chinese: 凡我所吩咐你們的，都教訓他們遵守，我就常與你們同在，直到世界的末了。
english: Teaching them to keep all the rules which I have given you: and see, I am ever with you, even to the end of the world.

chinese: 神的兒子，耶穌基督福音的起頭。
english: The first words of the good news of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

chinese: 正如先知以賽亞（有古卷無以賽亞三個字）書上記著說：看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面，預備道路。
english: Even as it is said in the book of Isaiah the prophet, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way;

chinese: 在曠野有人聲喊著說：預備主的道，修直他的路。
english: The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight;

chinese: 照這話，約翰來了，在曠野施洗，傳悔改的洗禮，使罪得赦。
english: John came, and gave baptism in the waste land, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.

chinese: 猶太全地和耶路撒冷的人都出去到約翰那裡，承認他們的罪，在約但河裡受他的洗。
english: And there went out to him all the people of Judaea, and all those of Jerusalem, and they were given baptism by him in the river Jordan, saying that they were sinners.

chinese: 約翰穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
english: And John was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.

chinese: 他傳道說：有一位在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是彎腰給他解鞋帶也是不配的。
english: And he said to them all, There is one coming after me who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo.

chinese: 我是用水給你們施洗，他卻要用聖靈給你們施洗。
english: I have given you baptism with water, but he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 那時，耶穌從加利利的拿撒勒來，在約但河裡受了約翰的洗。
english: And it came about in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was given baptism by John in the Jordan.

chinese: 他從水裡一上來，就看見天裂開了，聖靈彷彿鴿子，降在他身上。
english: And straight away, coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens broken open and the Spirit coming down on him as a dove:

chinese: 又有聲音從天上來，說：你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。
english: And a voice came out of heaven, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

chinese: 聖靈就把耶穌催到曠野裡去。
english: And straight away the Spirit sent him out into the waste land.

chinese: 他在曠野四十天，受撒但的試探，並與野獸同在一處，且有天使來伺候他。
english: And he was in the waste land for forty days, being tested by Satan; and he was with the beasts; and the angels took care of him.

chinese: 約翰下監以後，耶穌來到加利利，宣傳神的福音，
english: Now after John had been put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the good news of God,

chinese: 說：日期滿了，神的國近了。你們當悔改，信福音！
english: And saying, The time has come, and the kingdom of God is near: let your hearts be turned from sin and have faith in the good news.

chinese: 耶穌順著加利利的海邊走，看見西門和西門的兄弟安得烈在海裡撒網；他們本是打魚的。
english: And going by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon, and Andrew, the brother of Simon, putting a net into the sea: for they were fishermen.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。
english: And Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

chinese: 他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。
english: And they went straight from their nets, and came after him.

chinese: 耶穌稍往前走，又見西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰在船上補網。
english: And going on a little farther, he saw James, the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were in their boat stitching up their nets.

chinese: 耶穌隨即招呼他們，他們就把父親西庇太和雇工人留在船上，跟從耶穌去了。
english: And he said, Come after me: and they went away from their father Zebedee, who was in the boat with the servants, and came after him.

chinese: 到了迦百農，耶穌就在安息日進了會堂教訓人。
english: And they came to Capernaum; and on the Sabbath he went into the Synagogue and gave teaching.

chinese: 眾人很希奇他的教訓；因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像文士。
english: And they were full of wonder at his teaching, because he gave it as one having authority, and not like the scribes.

chinese: 在會堂裡，有一個人被污鬼附著。他喊叫說：
english: And there was in their Synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he gave a cry,

chinese: 拿撒勒人耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們麼？我知道你是誰，乃是神的聖者。
english: Saying, What have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? have you come to put an end to us? I see well who you are, the Holy One of God.

chinese: 耶穌責備他說：不要作聲！從這人身上出來罷。
english: And Jesus said to him sharply, Be quiet, and come out of him.

chinese: 污鬼叫那人抽了一陣瘋，大聲喊叫，就出來了。
english: And the unclean spirit, shaking him violently, and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

chinese: 眾人都驚訝，以致彼此對問說：這是甚麼事？是個新道理阿！他用權柄吩咐污鬼，連污鬼也聽從了他。
english: And they were all greatly surprised, so that they put questions to one another, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he gives orders even to the unclean spirits, and they do what he says.

chinese: 耶穌的名聲就傳遍了加利利的四方。
english: And news of him went out quickly everywhere into all parts of Galilee round about.

chinese: 他們一出會堂，就同著雅各、約翰，進了西門和安得烈的家。
english: And when they came out of the Synagogue, they went into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

chinese: 西門的岳母正害熱病躺著，就有人告訴耶穌。
english: Now Simon's wife's mother was ill, with a burning heat; and they gave him word of her:

chinese: 耶穌進前拉著他的手，扶他起來，熱就退了，他就服事他們。
english: And he came and took her by the hand, lifting her up; and she became well, and took care of their needs.

chinese: 天晚日落的時候，有人帶著一切害病的，和被鬼附的，來到耶穌跟前。
english: And in the evening, at sundown, they took to him all who were diseased, and those who had evil spirits.

chinese: 合城的人都聚集在門前。
english: And all the town had come together at the door.

chinese: 耶穌治好了許多害各樣病的人，又趕出許多鬼，不許鬼說話，因為鬼認識他。
english: And a number, who were ill with different diseases, he made well, and sent out evil spirits; but he did not let the evil spirits say anything, because they had knowledge of him.

chinese: 次日早晨，天未亮的時候，耶穌起來，到曠野地方去，在那裡禱告。
english: And in the morning, a long time before daylight, he got up and went out to a quiet place, and there he gave himself up to prayer.

chinese: 西門和同伴追了他去，
english: And Simon and those who were with him came after him.

chinese: 遇見了就對他說：眾人都找你。
english: And when they came up with him, they said to him, Everyone is looking for you.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：我們可以往別處去，到鄰近的鄉村，我也好在那裡傳道，因為我是為這事出來的。
english: And he said to them, Let us go to other parts into the nearest towns, so that I may give teaching there, because for this purpose I came.

chinese: 於是在加利利全地，進了會堂，傳道，趕鬼。
english: And he went into their Synagogues in every part of Galilee, preaching and driving out evil spirits.

chinese: 有一個長大痲瘋的來求耶穌，向他跪下，說：你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。
english: And a leper came to him and, going down on his knees before him, made a request, saying, If it is your pleasure, you have the power to make me clean.

chinese: 耶穌動了慈心，就伸手摸他，說：我肯，你潔淨了罷！
english: And being moved with pity, he put out his hand, and touching him said to him, It is my pleasure; be made clean.

chinese: 大痲瘋即時離開他，他就潔淨了。
english: And straight away the disease went from him, and he was made clean.

chinese: 耶穌嚴嚴的囑咐他，就打發他走，
english: And he sent him away, saying to him very sharply,

chinese: 對他說：你要謹慎，甚麼話都不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又因為你潔淨了，獻上摩西所吩咐的禮物，對眾人作證據。
english: See that you say nothing to any man: but go and let the priest see you, and make yourself clean by an offering of the things ordered by Moses, for a witness to them.

chinese: 那人出去，倒說許多的話，把這件事傳揚開了，叫耶穌以後不得再明明的進城，只好在外邊曠野地方。人從各處都就了他來。
english: But he went out, and made it public, giving an account of it everywhere, so that Jesus was no longer able to go openly into a town, but was outside in the waste land; and they came to him from every part.

chinese: 過了些日子，耶穌又進了迦百農。人聽見他在房子裡，
english: And when he came into Capernaum again after some days, the news went about that he was in the house.

chinese: 就有許多人聚集，甚至連門前都沒有空地；耶穌就對他們講道。
english: And a great number had come together, so that there was no longer room for them, no, not even about the door: and he gave them teaching.

chinese: 有人帶著一個癱子來見耶穌，是用四個人抬來的；
english: And four men came to him with one on a bed who had no power of moving.

chinese: 因為人多，不得近前，就把耶穌所在的房子，拆了房頂，既拆通了，就把癱子連所躺臥的褥子都縋下來。
english: And when they were unable to get near him because of all the people, they got the roof uncovered where he was: and when it was broken up, they let down the bed on which the man was.

chinese: 耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：小子，你的罪赦了。
english: And Jesus, seeing their faith, said to him, Son, you have forgiveness for your sins.

chinese: 有幾個文士坐在那裡，心裡議論，說：
english: But there were certain of the scribes seated there, and reasoning in their hearts,

chinese: 這個人為甚麼這樣說呢？他說僭妄的話了。除了神以外，誰能赦罪呢？
english: Why does this man say such things? he has no respect for God: from whom does forgiveness come but from God only?

chinese: 耶穌心中知道他們心裡這樣議論，就說：你們心裡為甚麼這樣議論呢？
english: And Jesus, having knowledge in his spirit of their thoughts, said to them, Why are you reasoning about these things in your hearts?

chinese: 或對癱子說你的罪赦了，或說起來！拿你的褥子行走；那一樣容易呢？
english: Which is the simpler, to say to a man who is ill, You have forgiveness for your sins, or, Get up, take up your bed, and go?

chinese: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄。就對癱子說：
english: But so that you may see that the Son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins on earth, (he said to the man,)

chinese: 我吩咐你，起來！拿你的褥子回家去罷。
english: I say to you, Get up, take up your bed, and go to your house.

chinese: 那人就起來，立刻拿著褥子，當眾人面前出去了，以致眾人都驚奇，歸榮耀與神，說：我們從來沒有見過這樣的事！
english: And he got up, and straight away took up the bed and went out before them all, so that they were all full of wonder, and gave glory to God, saying, We have never seen anything like this.

chinese: 耶穌又出到海邊去，眾人都就了他來，他便教訓他們。
english: And he went out again by the seaside; and all the people came to him, and he gave them teaching.

chinese: 耶穌經過的時候，看見亞勒腓的兒子利未坐在稅關上，就對他說：你跟從我來。他就起來，跟從了耶穌。
english: And when he went by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, seated at the place where taxes were taken, and he said to him, Come with me. And he got up, and went with him.

chinese: 耶穌在利未家裡坐席的時候，有好些稅吏和罪人與耶穌並門徒一同坐席；因為這樣的人多，他們也跟隨耶穌。
english: And it came about that he was seated at meat in his house, and a number of tax-farmers and sinners were at table with Jesus and his disciples: for there were a great number of them, and they came after him.

chinese: 法利賽人中的文士（有古卷：文士和法利賽人）看見耶穌和罪人並稅吏一同吃飯，就對他門徒說：他和稅吏並罪人一同吃喝麼？
english: And the scribes of the Pharisees, when they saw that he was taking food with the tax-farmers and sinners, said to his disciples, Why does he take food and drink with such men?

chinese: 耶穌聽見，就對他們說：康健的人用不著醫生，有病的人才用得著。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。
english: And Jesus, hearing it, said to them, Those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill: I have come not to get the upright but sinners.

chinese: 當下，約翰的門徒和法利賽人禁食。他們來問耶穌說：約翰的門徒和法利賽人的門徒禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食，這是為甚麼呢？
english: And John's disciples and the Pharisees were taking no food: and they came and said to him, Why do John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees go without food, but your disciples do not?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，陪伴之人豈能禁食呢？新郎還同在，他們不能禁食。
english: And Jesus said to them, Will the friends of a newly-married man go without food while he is with them? as long as they have him with them they will not go without food.

chinese: 但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那日他們就要禁食。
english: But the days will come when the husband will be taken away from them, and then they will go without food.

chinese: 沒有人把新布縫在舊衣服上，恐怕所補上的新布帶壞了舊衣服，破的就更大了。
english: No man puts a bit of new cloth on an old coat: or the new, by pulling away from the old, makes a worse hole.

chinese: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裡，恐怕酒把皮袋裂開，酒和皮袋就都壞了；惟把新酒裝在新皮袋裡。
english: And no man puts new wine into old wine-skins: or the skins will be burst by the wine, and the wine and the skins will be wasted: but new wine has to be put into new wine-skins.

chinese: 耶穌當安息日從麥地經過。他門徒行路的時候，掐了麥穗。
english: And it came about that on the Sabbath day he was going through the grain-fields; and while they were walking, his disciples took the heads of grain.

chinese: 法利賽人對耶穌說：看哪，他們在安息日為甚麼做不可做的事呢？
english: And the Pharisees said to him, Why are they doing what it is not right to do on the Sabbath?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：經上記著大衛和跟從他的人缺乏飢餓之時所做的事，你們沒有念過麼？
english: And he said to them, Have you no knowledge of what David did, when he had need and was without food, he, and those who were with him?

chinese: 他當亞比亞他作大祭司的時候，怎麼進了神的殿，吃了陳設餅，又給跟從他的人吃。這餅除了祭司以外，人都不可吃。
english: How he went into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and took for food the holy bread, which only the priests may take, and gave it to those who were with him?

chinese: 又對他們說：安息日是為人設立的，人不是為安息日設立的。
english: And he said to them, The Sabbath was made for man, and not man for the Sabbath;

chinese: 所以，人子也是安息日的主。
english: So that the Son of man is lord even of the Sabbath.

chinese: 耶穌又進了會堂，在那裡有一個人枯乾了一隻手。
english: And he went again into the Synagogue; and there was a man there whose hand was dead.

chinese: 眾人窺探耶穌，在安息日醫治不醫治，意思是要控告耶穌。
english: And they were watching him to see if he would make him well on the Sabbath day, so that they might have something against him.

chinese: 耶穌對那枯乾一隻手的人說：起來，站在當中。
english: And he said to the man, Get up and come forward.

chinese: 又問眾人說：在安息日行善行惡，救命害命，那樣是可以的呢？他們都不作聲。
english: And he said to them, Is it right to do good on the Sabbath or to do evil? to give life or to put to death? But they said nothing.

chinese: 耶穌怒目周圍看他們，憂愁他們的心剛硬，就對那人說：伸出手來！他把手一伸，手就復了原。
english: And looking round on them he was angry, being sad because of their hard hearts; and he said to the man, Put out your hand. And he put it out, and his hand was made well.

chinese: 法利賽人出去，同希律一黨的人商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。
english: And the Pharisees went out, and straight away made designs with the Herodians about how they might put him to death.

chinese: 耶穌和門徒退到海邊去，有許多人從加利利跟隨他。
english: And Jesus went away with his disciples to the sea, and a great number from Galilee came after him: and from Judaea,

chinese: 還有許多人聽見他所做的大事，就從猶太、耶路撒冷、以土買、約但河外，並推羅、西頓的四方來到他那裡。
english: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and the other side of Jordan, and the country about Tyre and Sidon, a great number, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

chinese: 他因為人多，就吩咐門徒叫一隻小船伺候著，免得眾人擁擠他。
english: And he made a request to his disciples to have a little boat ready for him, so that he might not be crushed by the people;

chinese: 他治好了許多人，所以凡有災病的，都擠進來要摸他。
english: For he had made such a great number well that all those who were diseased were falling down before him for the purpose of touching him.

chinese: 污鬼無論何時看見他，就俯伏在他面前，喊著說：你是神的兒子。
english: And the unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, went down before him, crying out, and saying, You are the Son of God.

chinese: 耶穌再三的囑咐他們，不要把他顯露出來。
english: And he gave them special orders not to say who he was.

chinese: 耶穌上了山，隨自己的意思叫人來；他們便來到他那裡。
english: And he went up into the mountain, and sent for those whom it was his pleasure to have with him: and they went to him.

chinese: 他就設立十二個人，要他們常和自己同在，也要差他們去傳道，
english: And he took twelve to be with him, so that he might send them out as preachers,

chinese: 並給他們權柄趕鬼。
english: And give them the power of driving out evil spirits:

chinese: 這十二個人有西門─耶穌又給他起名叫彼得，
english: To Simon he gave the second name of Peter;

chinese: 還有西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰，又給這兩個人起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思，
english: And to James, the son of Zebedee, and John, the brother of James, he gave the second name of Boanerges, which is, Sons of thunder:

chinese: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多羅買、馬太、多馬、亞勒腓的兒子雅各、和達太，並奮銳黨的西門；
english: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James, the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Zealot;

chinese: 還有賣耶穌的加略人猶大。
english: And Judas Iscariot, who was false to him.

chinese: 耶穌進了一個屋子，眾人又聚集，甚至他連飯也顧不得吃。
english: And he went into a house. And the people came together again, so that they were not even able to take bread.

chinese: 耶穌的親屬聽見，就出來要拉住他，因為他們說他癲狂了。
english: And when his friends had news of it, they went out to get him, saying, He is off his head.

chinese: 從耶路撒冷下來的文士說：他是被別西卜附著；又說：他是靠著鬼王趕鬼。
english: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem, said, He has Beelzebub, and, By the ruler of evil spirits he sends evil spirits out of men.

chinese: 耶穌叫他們來，用比喻對他們說：撒但怎能趕出撒但呢？
english: And turning to them, he said to them in the form of a story, How is it possible for Satan to put out Satan?

chinese: 若一國自相分爭，那國就站立不住；
english: If there is division in a kingdom, that kingdom will come to destruction;

chinese: 若一家自相分爭，那家就站立不住。
english: And if there is division in a house, that house will come to destruction;

chinese: 若撒但自相攻打分爭，他就站立不住，必要滅亡。
english: And if Satan is at war with himself, and there is division in him, he will not keep his place but will come to an end.

chinese: 沒有人能進壯士家裡，搶奪他的家具；必先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的家。
english: But no one is able to go into the house of the strong man and take his goods, without first putting cords round the strong man, and then he will take his goods.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，世人一切的罪和一切褻瀆的話都可得赦免；
english: Truly, I say to you, The sons of men will have forgiveness for all their sins and for all the evil words they say:

chinese: 凡褻瀆聖靈的，卻永不得赦免，乃要擔當永遠的罪。
english: But whoever says evil things against the Holy Spirit will never have forgiveness, but the evil he has done will be with him for ever:

chinese: 這話是因為他們說：他是被污鬼附著的。
english: Because they said, He has an unclean spirit.

chinese: 當下，耶穌的母親和弟兄來，站在外邊，打發人去叫他。
english: And his mother and brothers came and were outside, and sent for him, requesting to see him.

chinese: 有許多人在耶穌周圍坐著，他們就告訴他說：看哪，你母親和你弟兄在外邊找你。
english: And a great number were seated round him; and they said to him, See, your mother and your brothers are outside looking for you.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？
english: And he said in answer, Who are my mother and my brothers?

chinese: 就四面觀看那周圍坐著的人，說：看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。
english: And looking round at those who were seated about him, he said, See, my mother and my brothers!

chinese: 凡遵行神旨意的人就是我的弟兄姐妹和母親了。
english: Whoever does God's pleasure, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

chinese: 耶穌又在海邊教訓人。有許多人到他那裡聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海裡，眾人都靠近海，站在岸上。
english: And again he was teaching by the seaside. And a very great number of people had come to him, so that he got into a boat on the sea and took his seat; and all the people were on the land by the seaside.

chinese: 耶穌就用比喻教訓他們許多道理。在教訓之間，對他們說：
english: And he gave them teaching about a number of things in the form of stories, and said to them in his teaching, Give ear:

chinese: 你們聽阿！有一個撒種的出去撒種。
english: A man went out to put seed in the earth:

chinese: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；
english: And while he was doing it, some was dropped by the wayside, and the birds came and took it for food.

chinese: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，
english: And some went on the stones, where it had not much earth; and it came up straight away, because the earth was not deep:

chinese: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；
english: And when the sun was high, it was burned; and because it had no root, it became dry and dead.

chinese: 有落在荊棘裡的，荊棘長起來，把他擠住了，就不結實；
english: And some went among the thorns, and the thorns came up, and it had no room for growth and gave no fruit.

chinese: 又有落在好土裡的，就發生長大，結實有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的；
english: And some, falling on good earth, gave fruit, coming up and increasing, and giving thirty, sixty, and a hundred times as much.

chinese: 又說：有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
english: And he said to them, Whoever has ears, let him give ear.

chinese: 無人的時候，跟隨耶穌的人和十二個門徒問他這比喻的意思。
english: And when he was by himself, those who were round him with the twelve put questions to him about the purpose of the stories.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：神國的奧祕只叫你們知道，若是對外人講，凡事就用比喻，
english: And he said to them, To you is given the secret of the kingdom of God, but to those who are outside, all things are given in the form of stories;

chinese: 叫他們看是看見，卻不曉得；聽是聽見，卻不明白；恐怕他們回轉過來，就得赦免。
english: So that seeing they may see, and it will not be clear to them; and hearing it, they will not get the sense; for fear that they may be turned again to me and have forgiveness.

chinese: 又對他們說：你們不明白這比喻麼？這樣怎能明白一切的比喻呢？
english: And he said to them, If you are not clear about this story, how will you be clear about the others?

chinese: 撒種之人所撒的就是道。
english: The seed is the word.

chinese: 那撒在路旁的，就是人聽了道，撒但立刻來，把撒在他心裡的道奪了去。
english: And these are they by the wayside, where the word is planted; and when they have given ear, the Evil One comes straight away and takes away the word which has been planted in them.

chinese: 那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，
english: And in the same way, these are they who are planted on the stones, who, when the word has come to their ears, straight away take it with joy;

chinese: 但他心裡沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
english: And they have no root in themselves, but go on for a time; then, when trouble comes or pain, because of the word, they quickly become full of doubts.

chinese: 還有那撒在荊棘裡的，就是人聽了道，
english: And others are those planted among the thorns; these are they who have given ear to the word,

chinese: 後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑，和別樣的私慾進來，把道擠住了，就不能結實。
