english: And the cares of this life, and the deceits of wealth, and the desire for other things coming in, put a stop to the growth of the word, and it gives no fruit.

chinese: 那撒在好地上的，就是人聽道，又領受，並且結實，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。
english: And these are they who were planted on the good earth; such as give ear to the word, and take it into their hearts, and give fruit, thirty and sixty and a hundred times as much.

chinese: 耶穌又對他們說：人拿燈來，豈是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在燈臺上麼？
english: And he said to them, When the light comes in, do people put it under a vessel, or under the bed, and not on its table?

chinese: 因為掩藏的事，沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事，沒有不露出來的。
english: There is nothing covered which will not be seen openly, and nothing has been made secret which will not come to light.

chinese: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
english: If any man has ears, let him give ear.

chinese: 又說：你們所聽的要留心。你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們，並且要多給你們。
english: And he said to them, Take care what you give ear to: in the same measure as you give you will get, and more will be given to you.

chinese: 因為有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪去。
english: He who has, to him will be given: and he who has not, from him will be taken even that which he has.

chinese: 又說：神的國如同人把種撒在地上。
english: And he said, Such is the kingdom of God, as if a man put seed in the earth,

chinese: 黑夜睡覺，白日起來，這種就發芽漸長，那人卻不曉得如何這樣。
english: And went to sleep and got up, night and day, and the seed came to growth, though he had no idea how.

chinese: 地生五穀是出於自然的：先發苗，後長穗，再後穗上結成飽滿的子粒；
english: The earth gives fruit by herself; first the leaf, then the head, then the full grain.

chinese: 穀既熟了，就用鐮刀去割，因為收成的時候到了。
english: But when the grain is ready, he quickly sends men to get it cut, because the time for cutting has come.

chinese: 又說：神的國，我們可用甚麼比較呢？可用甚麼比喻表明呢？
english: And he said, What picture may we give of the kingdom of God, or with what story may we make it clear?

chinese: 好像一粒芥菜種，種在地裡的時候，雖比地上的百種都小，
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is put in the earth, is smaller than all the seeds on the earth,

chinese: 但種上以後，就長起來，比各樣的菜都大，又長出大枝來，甚至天上的飛鳥可以宿在他的蔭下。
english: But when it is planted, it comes up, and becomes taller than all the plants, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of heaven are able to take rest in its shade.

chinese: 耶穌用許多這樣的比喻，照他們所能聽的，對他們講道。
english: And with a number of such stories he gave them his teaching, as they were able to take it:

chinese: 若不用比喻，就不對他們講；沒有人的時候，就把一切的道講給門徒聽。
english: And without a story he said nothing to them: but privately to his disciples he made all things clear.

chinese: 當那天晚上，耶穌對門徒說：我們渡到那邊去罷。
english: And on that day, when the evening had come, he said to them, Let us go over to the other side.

chinese: 門徒離開眾人，耶穌仍在船上，他們就把他一同帶去；也有別的船和他同行。
english: And going away from the people, they took him with them, as he was, in the boat. And other boats were with him.

chinese: 忽然起了暴風，波浪打入船內，甚至船要滿了水。
english: And a great storm of wind came up, and the waves came into the boat, so that the boat was now becoming full.

chinese: 耶穌在船尾上，枕著枕頭睡覺。門徒叫醒了他，說：夫子！我們喪命，你不顧麼？
english: And he himself was in the back of the boat, sleeping on the cushion: and they, awaking him, said, Master, is it nothing to you that we are in danger of destruction?

chinese: 耶穌醒了，斥責風，向海說：住了罷！靜了罷！風就止住，大大的平靜了。
english: And he came out of his sleep, and gave strong orders to the wind, and said to the sea, Peace, be at rest. And the wind went down, and there was a great calm.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：為甚麼膽怯？你們還沒有信心麼？
english: And he said to them, Why are you full of fear? have you still no faith?

chinese: 他們就大大的懼怕，彼此說：這到底是誰，連風和海也聽從他了。
english: And their fear was great, and they said one to another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea do his orders?

chinese: 他們來到海那邊格拉森人的地方。
english: And they came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gerasenes.

chinese: 耶穌一下船，就有一個被污鬼附著的人從墳塋裡出來迎著他。
english: And when he had got out of the boat, straight away there came to him from the place of the dead a man with an unclean spirit.

chinese: 那人常住在墳塋裡，沒有人能捆住他，就是用鐵鍊也不能；
english: He was living in the place of the dead: and no man was able to keep him down, no, not with a chain;

chinese: 因為人屢次用腳鐐和鐵鍊捆鎖他，鐵鍊竟被他掙斷了，腳鐐也被他弄碎了；總沒有人能制伏他。
english: Because he had frequently been prisoned in chains and iron bands, and the chains had been parted and the bands broken by him: and no man was strong enough to make him quiet.

chinese: 他晝夜常在墳塋裡和山中喊叫，又用石頭砍自己。
english: And all the time, by day and by night, in the place of the dead, and in the mountains, he was crying out and cutting himself with stones.

chinese: 他遠遠的看見耶穌，就跑過去拜他，
english: And when he saw Jesus from far off, he went quickly to him and gave him worship;

chinese: 大聲呼叫說：至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你有甚麼相干？我指著神懇求你，不要叫我受苦！
english: And crying out with a loud voice he said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God's name, do not be cruel to me.

chinese: 是因耶穌曾吩咐他說：污鬼阿，從這人身上出來罷！
english: For Jesus had said to him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit.

chinese: 耶穌問他說：你名叫甚麼？回答說：我名叫群，因為我們多的緣故；
english: And Jesus said, What is your name? And he made answer, My name is Legion, because there are a great number of us.

chinese: 就再三的求耶穌，不要叫他們離開那地方。
english: And he made strong prayers to him not to send them away out of the country.

chinese: 在那裡山坡上，有一大群豬吃食；
english: Now on the mountain side there was a great herd of pigs getting their food.

chinese: 鬼就央求耶穌說：求你打發我們往豬群裡，附著豬去。
english: And they said to him, Send us into the pigs, so that we may go into them.

chinese: 耶穌准了他們，污鬼就出來，進入豬裡去。於是那群豬闖下山崖，投在海裡，淹死了。豬的數目約有二千。
english: And he let them do it. And the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs; and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the sea, about two thousand of them; and they came to their death in the sea.

chinese: 放豬的就逃跑了，去告訴城裡和鄉下的人。眾人就來，要看是甚麼事。
english: And their keepers went running and gave an account of it in the town and in the country. And people came to see what had taken place.

chinese: 他們來到耶穌那裡，看見那被鬼附著的人，就是從前被群鬼所附的，坐著，穿上衣服，心裡明白過來，他們就害怕。
english: And they came to Jesus, and saw the man in whom had been the evil spirits seated, clothed and with full use of his senses, and they were full of fear.

chinese: 看見這事的，便將鬼附之人所遇見的和那群豬的事都告訴了眾人；
english: And those who had seen it gave them an account of what had been done to him who had the evil spirits, and of the fate of the pigs.

chinese: 眾人就央求耶穌離開他們的境界。
english: And they made a request to him to go out of their country.

chinese: 耶穌上船的時候，那從前被鬼附著的人懇求和耶穌同在。
english: And when he was getting into the boat, the man in whom had been the evil spirits had a great desire to come with him.

chinese: 耶穌不許，卻對他說：你回家去，到你的親屬那裡，將主為你所做的是何等大的事，是怎樣憐憫你，都告訴他們。
english: And he would not let him, but said to him, Go to your house, to your friends, and give them news of the great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.

chinese: 那人就走了，在低加波利傳揚耶穌為他做了何等大的事，眾人就都希奇。
english: And he went on his way, and made public in the country of Decapolis what great things Jesus had done for him: and all men were full of wonder.

chinese: 耶穌坐船又渡到那邊去，就有許多人到他那裡聚集；他正在海邊上。
english: And when Jesus had gone over again in the boat to the other side, a great number of people came to him: and he was by the sea.

chinese: 有一個管會堂的人，名叫睚魯，來見耶穌，就俯伏在他腳前，
english: And one of the rulers of the Synagogue, Jairus by name, came, and seeing him, went down at his feet,

chinese: 再三的求他，說：我的小女兒快要死了，求你去按手在他身上，使他痊愈，得以活了。
english: And made strong prayers to him, saying, My little daughter is near to death: it is my prayer that you will come and put your hands on her, so that she may be made well, and have life.

chinese: 耶穌就和他同去。有許多人跟隨擁擠他。
english: And he went with him; and a great number of people went after him, and came round him.

chinese: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，
english: And a woman, who had had a flow of blood for twelve years,

chinese: 在好些醫生手裡受了許多的苦，又花盡了他所有的，一點也不見好，病勢反倒更重了。
english: And had undergone much at the hands of a number of medical men, and had given all she had, and was no better, but even worse,

chinese: 他聽見耶穌的事，就從後頭來，雜在眾人中間，摸耶穌的衣裳，
english: When she had news of the things which Jesus did, went among the people coming after him, and put her hand on his robe.

chinese: 意思說：我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。
english: For she said, If I may only put my hand on his robe, I will be made well.

chinese: 於是他血漏的源頭立刻乾了；他便覺得身上的災病好了。
english: And straight away the fountain of her blood was stopped, and she had a feeling in her body that her disease had gone and she was well.

chinese: 耶穌頓時心裡覺得有能力從自己身上出去，就在眾人中間轉過來，說：誰摸我的衣裳？
english: And straight away Jesus was conscious that power had gone out of him; and, turning to the people, he said, Who was touching my robe?

chinese: 門徒對他說：你看眾人擁擠你，還說誰摸我麼？
english: And his disciples said to him, You see the people round you on every side, and you say, Who was touching me?

chinese: 耶穌周圍觀看，要見做這事的女人。
english: And on his looking round to see her who had done this thing,

chinese: 那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐懼戰兢，來俯伏在耶穌跟前，將實情全告訴他。
english: The woman, shaking with fear, conscious of what had been done to her, came and, falling on her face before him, gave him a true account of everything.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：女兒，你的信救了你，平平安安的回去罷！你的災病痊愈了。
english: And he said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be free from your disease.

chinese: 還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裡來，說：你的女兒死了，何必還勞動先生呢？
english: And while he was still talking, they came from the ruler of the Synagogue's house, saying, Your daughter is dead: why are you still troubling the Master?

chinese: 耶穌聽見所說的話，就對管會堂的說：不要怕，只要信！
english: But Jesus, giving no attention to their words, said to the ruler of the Synagogue, Have no fear, only have faith.

chinese: 於是帶著彼得、雅各、和雅各的兄弟約翰同去，不許別人跟隨他。
english: And he did not let anyone come with him, but Peter and James and John, the brother of James.

chinese: 他們來到管會堂的家裡；耶穌看見那裡亂嚷，並有人大大的哭泣哀號，
english: And they came to the house of the ruler of the Synagogue; and he saw people running this way and that, and weeping and crying loudly.

chinese: 進到裡面，就對他們說：為甚麼亂嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡著了。
english: And when he had gone in, he said to them, Why are you making such a noise and weeping? The child is not dead, but sleeping.

chinese: 他們就嗤笑耶穌。耶穌把他們都攆出去，就帶著孩子的父母，和跟隨的人進了孩子所在的地方，
english: And they were laughing at him. But he, having sent them all out, took the father of the child and her mother and those who were with him, and went in where the child was.

chinese: 就拉著孩子的手，對他說：大利大，古米！繙出來就是說：閨女，我吩咐你起來！
english: And taking her by the hand, he said to her, Talitha cumi, which is, My child, I say to you, Get up.

chinese: 那閨女立時起來走。他們就大大的驚奇；閨女已經十二歲了。
english: And the young girl got up straight away, and was walking about; she being twelve years old. And they were overcome with wonder.

chinese: 耶穌切切的囑咐他們，不要叫人知道這事，又吩咐給他東西吃。
english: And he gave them special orders that they were not to say anything of this; and he said that some food was to be given to her.

chinese: 耶穌離開那裡，來到自己的家鄉；門徒也跟從他。
english: And he went away from there, and came into his country; and his disciples went with him.

chinese: 到了安息日，他在會堂裡教訓人。眾人聽見，就甚希奇，說：這人從那裡有這些事呢？所賜給他的是甚麼智慧？他手所做的是何等的異能呢？
english: And when the Sabbath day had come, he was teaching in the Synagogue; and a number of people hearing him were surprised, saying, From where did this man get these things? and, What is the wisdom given to this man, and what are these works of power done by his hands?

chinese: 這不是那木匠麼？不是馬利亞的兒子雅各、約西、猶大、西門的長兄麼？他妹妹們不也是在我們這裡麼？他們就厭棄他。（厭棄他：原文是因他跌倒）
english: Is not this the woodworker, the son of Mary, and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were bitter against him.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：大凡先知，除了本地、親屬、本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。
english: And Jesus said to them, A prophet is nowhere without honour, but in his country, and among his relations, and in his family.

chinese: 耶穌就在那裡不得行甚麼異能，不過按手在幾個病人身上，治好他們。
english: And he was unable to do any work of power there, but only to put his hands on one or two persons who were ill, and make them well.

chinese: 他也詫異他們不信，就往周圍鄉村教訓人去了。
english: And he was greatly surprised because they had no faith. And he went about the country places teaching.

chinese: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，差遣他們兩個兩個的出去，也賜給他們權柄，制伏污鬼；
english: And he gave orders to the twelve, and sent them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;

chinese: 並且囑咐他們：行路的時候不要帶食物和口袋，腰袋裡也不要帶錢，除了柺杖以外，甚麼都不要帶；
english: And he said that they were to take nothing for their journey, but a stick only; no bread, no bag, no money in their pockets;

chinese: 只要穿鞋，也不要穿兩件掛子，
english: They were to go with common shoes on their feet, and not to take two coats.

chinese: 又對他們說：你們無論到何處，進了人的家，就住在那裡，直到離開那地方。
english: And he said to them, Wherever you go into a house, make that your resting-place till you go away.

chinese: 何處的人不接待你們，不聽你們，你們離開那裡的時候，就把腳上的塵土跺下去，對他們作見證。
english: And whatever place will not take you in and will not give ear to you, when you go away, put off the dust from your feet as a witness against them.

chinese: 門徒就出去傳道，叫人悔改，
english: And they went out, preaching the need for a change of heart in men.

chinese: 又趕出許多的鬼，用油抹了許多病人，治好他們。
english: And they sent out a number of evil spirits, and put oil on a great number who were ill, and made them well.

chinese: 耶穌的名聲傳揚出來。希律王聽見了，就說：施洗的約翰從死裡復活了，所以這些異能由他裡面發出來。
english: And king Herod had news of him, because his name was on the lips of all; and he said, John the Baptist has come back from the dead, and for this reason these powers are working in him.

chinese: 但別人說：是以利亞。又有人說：是先知，正像先知中的一位。
english: But others said, It is Elijah. And others said, It is a prophet, even like one of the prophets.

chinese: 希律聽見卻說：是我所斬的約翰，他復活了。
english: But Herod, when he had news of it, said, John, whom I put to death, has come back from the dead.

chinese: 先是希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，差人去拿住約翰，鎖在監裡，因為希律已經娶了那婦人。
english: For Herod himself had sent men out to take John and put him in prison, because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, whom he had taken for himself.

chinese: 約翰曾對希律說：你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。
english: For John said to Herod, It is wrong for you to have your brother's wife.

chinese: 於是希羅底懷恨他，想要殺他，只是不能；
english: And Herodias was bitter against him, desiring to put him to death; but she was not able;

chinese: 因為希律知道約翰是義人，是聖人，所以敬畏他，保護他，聽他講論，就多照著行（有古卷：游移不定），並且樂意聽他。
english: For Herod was in fear of John, being conscious that he was an upright and holy man, and kept him safe. And hearing him, he was much troubled; and he gave ear to him gladly.

chinese: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律擺設筵席，請了大臣和千夫長，並加利利作首領的。
english: And the chance came when Herod on his birthday gave a feast to his lords, and the high captains, and the chief men of Galilee;

chinese: 希羅底的女兒進來跳舞，使希律和同席的人都歡喜。王就對女子說：你隨意向我求甚麼，我必給你；
english: And when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and did a dance, Herod and those who were at table with him were pleased with her; and the king said to the girl, Make a request for anything and I will give it you.

chinese: 又對他起誓說：隨你向我求甚麼，就是我國的一半，我也必給你。
english: And he took an oath, saying to her, Whatever is your desire I will give it to you, even half of my kingdom.

chinese: 他就出去對他母親說：我可以求甚麼呢？他母親說：施洗約翰的頭。
english: And she went out and said to her mother, What is my request to be? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

chinese: 他就急忙進去見王，求他說：我願王立時把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裡給我。
english: And she came in quickly to the king, and said, My desire is that you give me straight away on a plate the head of John the Baptist.

chinese: 王就甚憂愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辭，
english: And the king was very sad; but because of his oaths, and those who were with him at table, he would not say 'No' to her.

chinese: 隨即差一個護衛兵，吩咐拿約翰的頭來。護衛兵就去，在監裡斬了約翰，
english: And straight away the king sent out one of his armed men, and gave him an order to come back with the head: and he went and took off John's head in prison,

chinese: 把頭放在盤子裡，拿來給女子，女子就給他母親。
english: And came back with the head on a plate, and gave it to the girl; and the girl gave it to her mother.

chinese: 約翰的門徒聽見了，就來把他的屍首領去，葬在墳墓裡。
english: And when his disciples had news of it, they came and took up his body, and put it in its last resting-place.

chinese: 使徒聚集到耶穌那裡，將一切所做的事、所傳的道全告訴他。
english: And the twelve came together to Jesus; and they gave him an account of all the things they had done, and all they had been teaching.

chinese: 他就說：你們來，同我暗暗的到曠野地方去歇一歇。這是因為來往的人多，他們連吃飯也沒有工夫。
english: And he said to them, Come away by yourselves to a quiet place, and take a rest for a time. Because there were a great number coming and going, and they had no time even for food.

chinese: 他們就坐船，暗暗的往曠野地方去。
english: And they went away in the boat to a waste place by themselves.

chinese: 眾人看見他們去，有許多認識他們的，就從各城步行，一同跑到那裡，比他們先趕到了。
english: And the people saw them going, and a number of them, having knowledge who they were, went running there together on foot from all the towns, and got there before them.

chinese: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，因為他們如同羊沒有牧人一般，於是開口教訓他們許多道理。
english: And he got out, and saw a great mass of people, and he had pity on them, because they were like sheep without a keeper: and he gave them teaching about a number of things.

chinese: 天已經晚了，門徒進前來，說：這是野地，天已經晚了，
english: And at the end of the day, his disciples came to him and said, This place is waste land, and it is late:

chinese: 請叫眾人散開，他們好往四面鄉村裡去，自己買甚麼吃。
english: Send them away, so that they may go into the country and small towns round about, and get some food for themselves.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們給他們吃罷。門徒說：我們可以去買二十兩銀子的餅，給他們吃麼？
english: But he said to them in answer, Give them food yourselves. And they said to him, Are we to go and get bread for two hundred pence, and give it to them?

chinese: 耶穌說：你們有多少餅，可以去看看。他們知道了，就說：五個餅，兩條魚。
english: And he said to them, How much bread have you? go and see. And when they had seen, they said, Five cakes of bread and two fishes.

chinese: 耶穌吩咐他們，叫眾人一幫一幫的坐在青草地上。
english: And he made them all be seated in groups on the green grass.

chinese: 眾人就一排一排的坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。
english: And they were placed in groups, by hundreds and by fifties.

chinese: 耶穌拿著這五個餅，兩條魚，望著天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前，也把那兩條魚分給眾人。
english: And he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing over them; and when the cakes were broken, he gave them to the disciples to put before the people; and he made division of the two fishes among them all.

chinese: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了。
english: And they all took of the food and had enough.

chinese: 門徒就把碎餅碎魚收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
english: And they took up twelve baskets full of the broken bits and of the fishes.

chinese: 吃餅的男人共有五千。
english: And those who took of the bread were five thousand men.

chinese: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊伯賽大去，等他叫眾人散開。
english: And straight away he made his disciples get into the boat, and go before him to the other side to Beth-saida, while he himself sent the people away.

chinese: 他既辭別了他們，就往山上去禱告。
english: And after he had sent them away, he went up into a mountain for prayer.

chinese: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶穌獨自在岸上；
english: And by evening, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he by himself on the land.

chinese: 看見門徒因風不順，搖櫓甚苦。夜裡約有四更天，就在海面上走，往他們那裡去，意思要走過他們去。
english: And seeing that they had trouble in getting their boat through the water, because the wind was against them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have gone past them;

chinese: 但門徒看見他在海面上走，以為是鬼怪，就喊叫起來；
english: But they, when they saw him walking on the sea, took him for a spirit, and gave a loud cry:

chinese: 因為他們都看見了他，且甚驚慌。耶穌連忙對他們說：你們放心！是我，不要怕！
english: For they all saw him, and were troubled. But straight away he said to them, Take heart, it is I, have no fear.

chinese: 於是到他們那裡，上了船，風就住了；他們心裡十分驚奇。
english: And he went to them into the boat, and the wind went down, and they were full of wonder in themselves;

chinese: 這是因為他們不明白那分餅的事，心裡還是愚頑。
english: For it was not clear to them about the bread; but their hearts were hard.

chinese: 既渡過去，來到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，
english: And when they had gone across, they came to Gennesaret, and got their boat to land.

chinese: 一下船，眾人認得是耶穌，
english: And when they had got out of the boat, the people quickly had news of him,

chinese: 就跑遍那一帶地方，聽見他在何處，便將有病的人用褥子抬到那裡。
english: And went running through all the country round about, and took on their beds those who were ill, to where it was said that he was.

chinese: 凡耶穌所到的地方，或村中，或城裡，或鄉間，他們都將病人放在街市上，求耶穌只容他們摸他的衣裳繸子；凡摸著的人就都好了。
english: And wherever he went, into small towns, or great towns, or into the country, they took those who were ill into the market-places, requesting him that they might put their hands even on the edge of his robe: and all those who did so were made well.

chinese: 有法利賽人和幾個文士從耶路撒冷來，到耶穌那裡聚集。
english: And there came together to him the Pharisees and certain of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem,

chinese: 他們曾看見他的門徒中有人用俗手，就是沒有洗的手，吃飯。
english: And had seen that some of his disciples took their bread with unclean, that is, unwashed, hands.

chinese: （原來法利賽人和猶太人都拘守古人的遺傳，若不仔細洗手就不吃飯；
english: Now the Pharisees, and all the Jews, do not take food without washing their hands with care, keeping the old rule which has been handed down to them:

chinese: 從市上來，若不洗浴也不吃飯；還有好些別的規矩，他們歷代拘守，就是洗杯、罐、銅器等物。）
english: And when they come from the market-place, they take no food till their hands are washed; and a number of other orders there are, which have been handed down to them to keep--washings of cups and pots and brass vessels.

chinese: 法利賽人和文士問他說：你的門徒為甚麼不照古人的遺傳，用俗手吃飯呢？
english: And the Pharisees and the scribes put the question to him, Why do your disciples not keep the rules of the fathers, but take their bread with unwashed hands?

chinese: 耶穌說：以賽亞指著你們假冒為善之人所說的預言是不錯的。如經上說：這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我，心卻遠離我。
english: And he said, Well did Isaiah say of you, you false ones: These people give me honour with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

chinese: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人，所以拜我也是枉然。
english: But their worship is to no purpose, while they give as their teaching the rules of men.

chinese: 你們是離棄神的誡命，拘守人的遺傳；
english: For, turning away from the law of God, you keep the rules of men.

chinese: 又說：你們誠然是廢棄神的誡命，要守自己的遺傳。
english: And he said to them, Truly you put on one side the law of God, so that you may keep the rules which have been handed down to you.

chinese: 摩西說：當孝敬父母；又說：咒罵父母的，必治死他。
english: For Moses said, Give honour to your father and mother, and, He who says evil of father or mother, let him have the punishment of death:

chinese: 你們倒說：人若對父母說：我所當奉給你的，已經作了各耳板（各耳板就是供獻的意思），
english: But you say, If a man says to his father or his mother, That by which you might have had profit from me is Corban, that is to say, Given to God,

chinese: 以後你們就不容他再奉養父母。
english: You no longer let him do anything for his father or his mother;

chinese: 這就是你們承接遺傳，廢了神的道。你們還做許多這樣的事。
english: Making the word of God of no effect by your rule, which you have given: and a number of other such things you do.

chinese: 耶穌又叫眾人來，對他們說：你們都要聽我的話，也要明白。
english: And turning to the people again, he said to them, Give ear to me all of you, and let my words be clear to you:

chinese: 從外面進去的不能污穢人，惟有從裡面出來的乃能污穢人。（有古卷在此有：
english: There is nothing outside the man which, going into him, is able to make him unclean: but the things which come out of the man are those which make the man unclean.

chinese: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！）
耶穌離開眾人，進了屋子，門徒就問他這比喻的意思。
english: And when he had gone into the house away from all the people, his disciples put questions to him about the saying.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們也是這樣不明白麼？豈不曉得凡從外面進入的，不能污穢人，
english: And he said to them, Have even you so little wisdom? Do you not see that whatever goes into a man from outside is not able to make him unclean,

chinese: 因為不是入他的心，乃是入他的肚腹，又落到茅廁裡。這是說，各樣的食物都是潔淨的；
english: Because it goes not into the heart but into the stomach, and goes out with the waste? He said this, making all food clean.

chinese: 又說：從人裡面出來的，那才能污穢人；
english: And he said, That which comes out of the man, that makes the man unclean.

chinese: 因為從裡面，就是從人心裡，發出惡念、苟合、
english: Because from inside, from the heart of men, come evil thoughts and unclean pleasures,

chinese: 偷盜、兇殺、姦淫、貪婪、邪惡、詭詐、淫蕩、嫉妒、謗讟、驕傲、狂妄。
english: The taking of goods and of life, broken faith between husband and wife, the desire of wealth, wrongdoing, deceit, sins of the flesh, an evil eye, angry words, pride, foolish acts:

chinese: 這一切的惡都是從裡面出來，且能污穢人。
english: All these evil things come from inside, and make the man unclean.

chinese: 耶穌從那裡起身，往推羅、西頓的境內去，進了一家，不願意人知道，卻隱藏不住。
english: And he went away from there to the country of Tyre and Sidon. And he went into a house, desiring that no man might have knowledge of it: and he was not able to keep it secret.

chinese: 當下，有一個婦人，他的小女兒被污鬼附著，聽見耶穌的事，就來俯伏在他腳前。
english: But a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having had news of him, came straight away and went down at his feet.

chinese: 這婦人是希利尼人，屬敘利腓尼基族。他求耶穌趕出那鬼離開他的女兒。
english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syro-phoenician by birth: and she made a request to him that he would send the evil spirit out of her daughter.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：讓兒女們先吃飽，不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。
english: And he said to her, Let the children first have their food: for it is not right to take the children's bread and give it to the dogs.

chinese: 婦人回答說：主阿，不錯；但是狗在桌子底下也吃孩子們的碎渣兒。
english: But she said to him in answer, Yes, Lord: even the dogs under the table take the bits dropped by the children.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：因這句話，你回去罷；鬼已經離開你的女兒了。
english: And he said to her, For this saying go your way; the evil spirit has gone out of your daughter.

chinese: 他就回家去，見小孩子躺在床上，鬼已經出去了。
english: And she went away to her house, and saw the child on the bed, and the evil spirit gone out.

chinese: 耶穌又離了推羅的境界，經過西頓，就從低加波利境內來到加利利海。
english: And again he went out from Tyre, and came through Sidon to the sea of Galilee, through the country of Decapolis.

chinese: 有人帶著一個耳聾舌結的人來見耶穌，求他按手在他身上。
english: And they came to him with one who had no power of hearing and had trouble in talking; and they made a request to him to put his hands on him.

chinese: 耶穌領他離開眾人，到一邊去，就用指頭探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌頭，
english: And he took him on one side from the people privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he put water from his mouth on the man's tongue with his finger;

chinese: 望天歎息，對他說：以法大！就是說：開了罷！
english: And looking up to heaven, he took a deep breath, and said to him, Ephphatha, that is, Be open.

chinese: 他的耳朵就開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。
english: And his ears became open, and the band of his tongue was made loose, and his words became clear.

chinese: 耶穌囑咐他們不要告訴人；但他越發囑咐，他們越發傳揚開了。
english: And he gave them orders not to give news of it to anyone; but the more he made this request, so much the more they made it public.

chinese: 眾人分外希奇，說：他所做的事都好，他連聾子也叫他們聽見，啞吧也叫他們說話。
english: And they were overcome with wonder, saying, He has done all things well: he even gives back the power of hearing and the power of talking to those who have been without them.

chinese: 那時，又有許多人聚集，並沒有甚麼吃的。耶穌叫門徒來，說：
english: In those days again, when there was a great mass of people and they had no food, he made his disciples come to him and said to them,

chinese: 我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裡已經三天，也沒有吃的了。
english: I have pity for these people because they have been with me now three days, and have no food;

chinese: 我若打發他們餓著回家，就必在路上困乏，因為其中有從遠處來的。
english: If I send them away to their houses with no food, they will be overcome by weariness on the way; and some of them have come from far.

chinese: 門徒回答說：在這野地，從那裡能得餅，叫這些人吃飽呢？
english: And his disciples said in answer, How will it be possible to get enough bread for these men here in a waste place?

chinese: 耶穌問他們說：你們有多少餅？他們說：七個。
english: And he put the question, How much bread have you? And they said, Seven cakes.

chinese: 他吩咐眾人坐在地上，就拿著這七個餅祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，叫他們擺開，門徒就擺在眾人面前。
english: And he made the people be seated on the earth: and he took the seven cakes and, having given praise, he gave the broken bread to his disciples to put before them; and they put it before the people.

chinese: 又有幾條小魚；耶穌祝了福，就吩咐也擺在眾人面前。
english: And they had some small fishes; and blessing them he had them put before the people in the same way.

chinese: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。
english: And they took the food, and had enough; and they took up seven baskets full of the broken bits.

chinese: 人數約有四千。耶穌打發他們走了，
english: And there were about four thousand people: and he sent them away.

chinese: 隨即同門徒上船，來到大瑪努他境內。
english: And he got into the boat with his disciples straight away, and came into the country of Dalmanutha.

chinese: 法利賽人出來盤問耶穌，求他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看，想要試探他。
english: And the Pharisees came out and put questions to him, requesting from him a sign from heaven, testing him.

chinese: 耶穌心裡深深的歎息，說：這世代為甚麼求神蹟呢？我實在告訴你們，沒有神蹟給這世代看。
english: And he was very sad in spirit, and said, Why is this generation looking for a sign? truly, I say to you, No sign will be given to this generation.

chinese: 他就離開他們，又上船往海那邊去了。
english: And he went away from them, and again got into the boat and went across to the other side.

chinese: 門徒忘了帶餅；在船上除了一個餅，沒有別的食物。
english: And they had taken no thought to get bread; and they had only one cake of bread with them in the boat.

chinese: 耶穌囑咐他們說：你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人的酵和希律的酵。
english: And he said to them, Take care to be on the watch against the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.

chinese: 他們彼此議論說：這是因為我們沒有餅罷。
english: And they said to one another, We have no bread.

chinese: 耶穌看出來，就說：你們為甚麼因為沒有餅就議論呢？你們還不省悟，還不明白麼？你們的心還是愚頑麼？
english: And Jesus, hearing it, said to them, Why are you reasoning among yourselves because you have no bread? do you still not see, and is it still not clear to you? are your hearts so hard?

chinese: 你們有眼睛，看不見麼？有耳朵，聽不見麼？也不記得麼？
english: Having eyes, do you not see? and having ears, have you no hearing? and have you no memory?

chinese: 我擘開那五個餅分給五千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少籃子呢？他們說：十二個。
english: When I made a division of the five cakes of bread among the five thousand, what number of baskets full of broken bits did you take up? They said to him, Twelve.

chinese: 又擘開那七個餅分給四千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少筐子呢？他們說：七個。
english: And when the seven among the four thousand, what number of baskets full of broken bits did you take up? And they said to him, Seven.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們還是不明白麼？
english: And he said to them, Is it still not clear to you?

chinese: 他們來到伯賽大，有人帶一個瞎子來，求耶穌摸他。
english: And they came to Beth-saida. And they took a blind man to him, requesting him to put his hands on him.

chinese: 耶穌拉著瞎子的手，領他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，問他說：你看見甚麼了？
english: And he took the blind man by the hand, and went with him out of the town; and when he had put water from his mouth on his eyes, and put his hands on him, he said, Do you see anything?

chinese: 他就抬頭一看，說：我看見人了；他們好像樹木，並且行走。
english: And looking up, he said, I see men; I see them like trees, walking.

chinese: 隨後又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就復了原，樣樣都看得清楚了。
english: Then again he put his hands on his eyes; and looking hard, he was able to see, and saw all things clearly.

chinese: 耶穌打發他回家，說：連這村子你也不要進去。
english: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Do not even go into the town.

chinese: 耶穌和門徒出去，往該撒利亞腓立比的村莊去；在路上問門徒說：人說我是誰？
english: And Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the little towns round Caesarea Philippi; and on the way he put a question to his disciples, saying, Who do men say that I am?

chinese: 他們說：有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是先知裡的一位。
english: And they made answer, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, One of the prophets.

chinese: 又問他們說：你們說我是誰？彼得回答說：你是基督。
english: And he said to them, But who do you say I am? Peter said in answer, You are the Christ.

chinese: 耶穌就禁戒他們，不要告訴人。
english: And he put them under orders not to say this of him to anyone.

chinese: 從此，他教訓他們說：人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長，和文士棄絕，並且被殺，過三天復活。
english: And teaching them, he said that the Son of man would have to undergo much, and be hated by those in authority, and the chief priests, and the scribes, and be put to death, and after three days come back from the dead.

chinese: 耶穌明明的說這話，彼得就拉著他，勸他。
english: And he said this openly. And Peter took him, and was protesting.

chinese: 耶穌轉過來，看著門徒，就責備彼得說：撒但，退我後邊去罷！因為你不體貼神的意思，只體貼人的意思。
english: But he, turning about, and seeing his disciples, said sharply to Peter, Get out of my way, Satan: for your mind is not on the things of God, but on the things of men.

chinese: 於是叫眾人和門徒來，對他們說：若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
english: And turning to the mass of people with his disciples, he said to them, If any man has the desire to come after me, let him give up all other desires, and take up his cross and come after me.

chinese: 因為，凡要救自己生命（或作：靈魂；下同）的，必喪掉生命；凡為我和福音喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
english: Whoever has a desire to keep his life, will have it taken from him; and whoever gives up his life because of me and the good news, will keep it.

chinese: 人就是賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？
english: What profit has a man if he gets all the world with the loss of his life?

chinese: 人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
english: And what would a man give in exchange for his life?

chinese: 凡在這淫亂罪惡的世代，把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在他父的榮耀裡，同聖天使降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。
english: Whoever has a feeling of shame because of me and my words in this false and evil generation, the Son of man will have a feeling of shame because of him, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

chinese: 耶穌又對他們說：我實在告訴你們，站在這裡的，有人在沒嘗死味以前，必要看見神的國大有能力臨到。
english: And he said to them, Truly I say to you, There are some here who will have no taste of death till they see the kingdom of God come with power.

chinese: 過了六天，耶穌帶著彼得、雅各、約翰暗暗的上了高山，就在他們面前變了形像，
english: And after six days Jesus took with him Peter and James and John, and made them go up with him into a high mountain by themselves: and he was changed in form before them:

chinese: 衣服放光，極其潔白，地上漂布的，沒有一個能漂得那樣白。
english: And his clothing became shining, very white, as no cleaner on earth would make it.

chinese: 忽然，有以利亞同摩西向他們顯現，並且和耶穌說話。
english: And there came before them Elijah with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus.

chinese: 彼得對耶穌說：拉比（就是夫子），我們在這裡真好！可以搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。
english: And Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tents; one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

chinese: 彼得不知道說甚麼才好，因為他們甚是懼怕。
english: Because he was not certain what to say, for they were in great fear.

chinese: 有一朵雲彩來遮蓋他們；也有聲音從雲彩裡出來，說：這是我的愛子，你們要聽他。
english: And a cloud came over them; and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, give ear to him.

chinese: 門徒忽然周圍一看，不再見一人，只見耶穌同他們在那裡。
english: And suddenly looking round about, they saw no one any longer, but Jesus only with themselves.

chinese: 下山的時候，耶穌囑咐他們說：人子還沒有從死裡復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。
english: And while they were coming down from the mountain, he gave them orders not to give word to any man of the things they had seen, till the Son of man had come back from the dead.

chinese: 門徒將這話存記在心，彼此議論從死裡復活是甚麼意思。
english: And they kept the saying, questioning among themselves what the coming back from the dead might be.

chinese: 他們就問耶穌說：文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？
english: And they put a question to him, saying, Why do the scribes say that Elijah has to come first?

chinese: 耶穌說：以利亞固然先來復興萬事；經上不是指著人子說，他要受許多的苦被人輕慢呢？
english: And he said to them, Truly, Elijah does come first, and puts all things in order; and how is it said in the Writings that the Son of man will go through much sorrow and be made as nothing?

chinese: 我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，他們也任意待他，正如經上所指著他的話。
english: But I say to you that Elijah has come, and they have done to him whatever they were pleased to do, even as the Writings say about him.

chinese: 耶穌到了門徒那裡，看見有許多人圍著他們，又有文士和他們辯論。
english: And when they came to the disciples, they saw a great mass of people about them, and scribes questioning them.

chinese: 眾人一見耶穌，都甚希奇，就跑上去問他的安。
english: And straight away all the people, when they saw him, were full of wonder, and running to him, gave him worship.

chinese: 耶穌問他們說：你們和他們辯論的是甚麼？
english: And he said, What are you questioning them about?

chinese: 眾人中間有一個人回答說：夫子，我帶了我的兒子到你這裡來，他被啞吧鬼附著。
english: And one of the number said to him in answer, Master, I came to you with my son, who has in him a spirit which takes away his power of talking;

chinese: 無論在那裡，鬼捉弄他，把他摔倒，他就口中流沫，咬牙切齒，身體枯乾。我請過你的門徒把鬼趕出去，他們卻是不能。
english: And wherever it takes him, it puts him down violently, streaming at the lips and twisted with pain; and his strength goes from him; and I made a request to your disciples to send it out, and they were not able.

chinese: 耶穌說：噯！不信的世代阿，我在你們這裡要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裡來罷。
english: And he said to them in answer, O generation without faith, how long will I have to be with you? how long will I put up with you? let him come to me.

chinese: 他們就帶了他來。他一見耶穌，鬼便叫他重重的抽瘋，倒在地上，翻來覆去，口中流沫。
english: And they took him to him: and when he saw him, the spirit in him straight away became violent; and he went down on the earth, rolling about and streaming at the lips.

chinese: 耶穌問他父親說：他得這病有多少日子呢？回答說：從小的時候。
english: And Jesus questioning the father said, How long has he been like this? And he said, From a child.

chinese: 鬼屢次把他扔在火裡、水裡，要滅他。你若能做甚麼，求你憐憫我們，幫助我們。
english: And frequently it has sent him into the fire and into the water, for his destruction; but if you are able to do anything, have pity on us, and give us help.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你若能信，在信的人，凡事都能。
english: And Jesus said to him, If you are able! All things are possible to him who has faith.

chinese: 孩子的父親立時喊著說（有古卷：立時流淚的喊著說）：我信！但我信不足，求主幫助。
english: Straight away the father of the child gave a cry, saying, I have faith; make my feeble faith stronger.

chinese: 耶穌看見眾人都跑上來，就斥責那污鬼說：你這聾啞的鬼，我吩咐你從他裡頭出來，再不要進去！
english: And when Jesus saw that the people came running together, he gave orders to the unclean spirit, saying to him, You, spirit, who are the cause of his loss of voice and hearing, I say to you, come out of him, and never again go into him.

chinese: 那鬼喊叫，使孩子大大的抽了一陣瘋，就出來了。孩子好像死了一般。以致眾人多半說：他是死了。
english: And after crying out and shaking him violently, it came out: and the child became like one dead; so that most of them said, He is dead.

chinese: 但耶穌拉著他的手，扶他起來，他就站起來了。
english: But Jesus took him by the hand, lifting him up; and he got up.

chinese: 耶穌進了屋子，門徒就暗暗的問他說：我們為甚麼不能趕出他去呢？
english: And when he had gone into the house, his disciples said to him privately, Why were we unable to send it out?

chinese: 耶穌說：非用禱告（有古卷在此有：禁食二字），這一類的鬼總不能出來（或作：不能趕出他去來）。
english: And he said to them, Nothing will make this sort come out but prayer.

chinese: 他們離開那地方，經過加利利；耶穌不願意人知道。
english: And they went out from there, through Galilee; and it was his desire that no man might have knowledge of it;

chinese: 於是教訓門徒，說：人子將要被交在人手裡，他們要殺害他；被殺以後，過三天他要復活。
english: For he was giving his disciples teaching, and saying to them, The Son of man is given up into the hands of men, and they will put him to death; and when he is dead, after three days he will come back from the dead.

chinese: 門徒卻不明白這話，又不敢問他。
english: But the saying was not clear to them, and they were in fear of questioning him about it.

chinese: 他們來到迦百農，耶穌在屋裡問門徒說：你們在路上議論的是甚麼？
english: And they came to Capernaum: and when he was in the house, he put the question to them, What were you talking about on the way?

chinese: 門徒不作聲，因為他們在路上彼此爭論誰為大。
english: But they said nothing: because they had had an argument between themselves on the way, about who was the greatest.

chinese: 耶穌坐下，叫十二個門徒來，說：若有人願意作首先的，他必作眾人末後的，作眾人的用人。
english: And seating himself, he made the twelve come to him; and he said to them, If any man has the desire to be first, he will be last of all and servant of all.

chinese: 於是領過一個小孩子來，叫他站在門徒中間，又抱起他來，對他們說：
english: And he took a little child, and put him in the middle of them; and taking him in his arms, he said to them,

chinese: 凡為我名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，乃是接待那差我來的。
english: Whoever will give honour to one such little child in my name, gives honour to me: and whoever gives honour to me, gives honour not to me, but to him who sent me.

chinese: 約翰對耶穌說：夫子，我們看見一個人奉你的名趕鬼，我們就禁止他，因為他不跟從我們。
english: John said to him, Master, we saw one driving out evil spirits in your name: and we said that he might not, because he is not one of us.

chinese: 耶穌說：不要禁止他；因為沒有人奉我名行異能，反倒輕易毀謗我。
english: But Jesus said, Say not so: for there is no man who will do a great work in my name, and be able at the same time to say evil of me.

chinese: 不敵擋我們的，就是幫助我們的。
english: He who is not against us is for us.

chinese: 凡因你們是屬基督，給你們一杯水喝的，我實在告訴你們，他不能不得賞賜。
english: Whoever gives you a cup of water, because you are Christ's, truly I say to you, he will in no way be without his reward.

chinese: 凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，扔在海裡。
english: And whoever is a cause of trouble to one of these little ones who have faith in me, it would be better for him if a great stone was put round his neck and he was dropped into the sea.

chinese: 倘若你一隻手叫你跌倒，就把他砍下來；
english: And if your hand is a cause of trouble to you, let it be cut off; it is better for you to go into life with one hand than to have two hands and go into hell, into the eternal fire.

chinese: 你缺了肢體進入永生，強如有兩隻手落到地獄，入那不滅的火裡去。
倘若你一隻腳叫你跌倒，就把他砍下來；
english: And if your foot is a cause of trouble to you, let it be cut off: it is better for you to go into life with one foot than to have two feet and go into hell.

chinese: 你瘸腿進入永生，強如有兩隻腳被丟在地獄裡。
倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就去掉他；你只有一隻眼進入神的國，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄裡。
english: And if your eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out: it is better for you to go into the kingdom of God with one eye than, having two eyes, to go into hell,

chinese: 在那裡，蟲是不死的，火是不滅的。
english: Where their worm is ever living and the fire is not put out.

chinese: 因為必用火當鹽醃各人。（有古卷在此有：凡祭物必用鹽醃。）
english: Everyone will be salted with fire.

chinese: 鹽本是好的，若失了味，可用甚麼叫他再鹹呢？你們裡頭應當有鹽，彼此和睦。
english: Salt is good; but if the taste goes from it, how will you make it salt again? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace one with another.

chinese: 耶穌從那裡起身，來到猶太的境界並約但河外。眾人又聚集到他那裡，他又照常教訓他們。
english: And he got up, and went into the country of Judaea on the other side of Jordan: and great numbers of people came together to him again; and, as was his way, he gave them teaching.

chinese: 有法利賽人來問他說：人休妻可以不可以？意思要試探他。
english: And Pharisees came to him, testing him with the question, Is it right for a man to put away his wife?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：摩西吩咐你們的是甚麼？
english: And he said to them in answer, What did Moses say you were to do?

chinese: 他們說：摩西許人寫了休書便可以休妻。
english: And they said to him, Moses let us give her a statement in writing, and be free from her.

chinese: 耶穌說：摩西因為你們的心硬，所以寫這條例給你們；
english: But Jesus said to them, Because of your hard hearts he gave you this law.

chinese: 但從起初創造的時候，神造人是造男造女。
english: But from the first, male and female made he them.

chinese: 因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
english: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother, and be joined to his wife;

chinese: 既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。
english: And the two will become one flesh; so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

chinese: 所以神配合的，人不可分開。
english: Let not that which has been joined together by God be parted by man.

chinese: 到了屋裡，門徒就問他這事。
english: And in the house the disciples put questions to him again about this thing.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：凡休妻另娶的，就是犯姦淫，辜負他的妻子；
english: And he said to them, Whoever puts away his wife and takes another, is false to his wife;

chinese: 妻子若離棄丈夫另嫁，也是犯姦淫了。
english: And if she herself puts away her husband and takes another, she is false to her husband.

chinese: 有人帶著小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌摸他們，門徒便責備那些人。
english: And they took to him little children, so that he might put his hands on them: and the disciples said sharp words to them.

chinese: 耶穌看見就惱怒，對門徒說：讓小孩子到我這裡來，不要禁止他們；因為在神國的，正是這樣的人。
english: And when Jesus saw it, he was angry, and said to them, Let the little children come to me, and do not keep them away; for of such is the kingdom of God.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，凡要承受神國的，若不像小孩子，斷不能進去。
english: Truly I say to you, Whoever does not put himself under the kingdom of God like a little child, will not come into it at all.

chinese: 於是抱著小孩子，給他們按手，為他們祝福。
english: And he took them in his arms, and gave them a blessing, putting his hands on them.

chinese: 耶穌出來行路的時候，有一個人跑來，跪在他面前，問他說：良善的夫子，我當作甚麼事才可以承受永生？
english: And while he was going out into the way, a man came running to him, and went down on his knees, saying, Good Master, what have I to do so that I may have eternal life?

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你為甚麼稱我是良善的？除了神一位之外，再沒有良善的。
english: And Jesus said to him, Why do you say I am good? no one is good but one, and that is God.

chinese: 誡命你是曉得的：不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；不可虧負人；當孝敬父母。
english: You have knowledge of what is said in the law, Do not put any one to death, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not take what is not yours, Do not give false witness, Do not get money by deceit, Give honour to your father and mother.

chinese: 他對耶穌說：夫子，這一切我從小都遵守了。
english: And he said to him, Master, all these laws I have kept from the time when I was young.

chinese: 耶穌看著他，就愛他，對他說：你還缺少一件：去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。
english: And Jesus, looking on him and loving him, said, There is one thing needed: go, get money for your goods, and give it to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven: and come with me.

chinese: 他聽見這話，臉上就變了色，憂憂愁愁的走了，因為他的產業很多。
english: But his face became sad at the saying, and he went away sorrowing: for he was one who had much property.

chinese: 耶穌周圍一看，對門徒說：有錢財的人進神的國是何等的難哪！
english: And Jesus, looking round about, said to his disciples, How hard it is for those who have wealth to come into the kingdom of God!

chinese: 門徒希奇他的話。耶穌又對他們說：小子，倚靠錢財的人進神的國是何等的難哪！
english: And the disciples were full of wonder at his words. But Jesus said to them again, Children, how hard it is for those who put faith in wealth to come into the kingdom of God!

chinese: 駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進神的國還容易呢。
english: It is simpler for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a man of wealth to come into the kingdom of God.

chinese: 門徒就分外希奇，對他說：這樣誰能得救呢？
english: And they were greatly surprised, saying to him, Who then may have salvation?

chinese: 耶穌看著他們，說：在人是不能，在神卻不然，因為神凡事都能。
english: Jesus, looking on them, said, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for all things are possible with God.

chinese: 彼得就對他說：看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你了。
english: Peter said to him, See, we have given up everything, and come after you.

chinese: 耶穌說：我實在告訴你們，人為我和福音撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姐妹、父母、兒女、田地，
english: Jesus said, Truly I say to you, There is no man who has given up house, or brothers, or sisters, or mother, or father, or children, or land, because of me and the good news,

chinese: 沒有不在今世得百倍的，就是房屋、弟兄、姐妹、母親、兒女、田地，並且要受逼迫，在來世必得永生。
english: Who will not get a hundred times as much now in this time, houses, and brothers, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and land--though with great troubles; and, in the world to come, eternal life.

chinese: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後，在後的，將要在前。
english: But a great number who are first will be last: and those who are last will be first.

chinese: 他們行路上耶路撒冷去。耶穌在前頭走，門徒就希奇，跟從的人也害怕。耶穌又叫過十二個門徒來，把自己將要遭遇的事告訴他們說：
english: And they were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going before them: and they were full of wonder; but those who came after him were in fear. And again he took the twelve, and gave them word of the things which were to come on him,

chinese: 看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子將要被交給祭司長和文士，他們要定他死罪，交給外邦人。
english: Saying, See, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man will be given up to the chief priests and the scribes; and they will give an order for his death, and will give him up to the Gentiles:

chinese: 他們要戲弄他，吐唾沫在他臉上，鞭打他，殺害他。過了三天，他要復活。
english: And they will make sport of him, and put shame on him, and give him cruel blows, and will put him to death; and after three days he will come back from the dead.

chinese: 西庇太的兒子雅各、約翰進前來，對耶穌說：夫子，我們無論求你甚麼，願你給我們作。
english: And there came to him James and John, the sons of Zebedee, saying to him, Master, will you give us whatever may be our request?

chinese: 耶穌說：要我給你們作甚麼？
english: And he said to them, What would you have me do for you?

chinese: 他們說：賜我們在你的榮耀裡，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。
english: And they said to him, Let us be seated, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your glory.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們不知道所求的是甚麼，我所喝的杯，你們能喝麼？我所受的洗，你們能受麼？
english: But Jesus said to them, You have no knowledge of what you are saying. Are you able to take of my cup? or to undergo the baptism which I am to undergo?

chinese: 他們說：我們能。耶穌說：我所喝的杯，你們也要喝；我所受的洗，你們也要受；
english: And they said to him, We are able. And Jesus said to them, You will take of the cup from which I take; and the baptism which I am about to undergo you will undergo:

chinese: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是為誰預備的，就賜給誰。
english: But to be seated at my right hand or at my left is not for me to give: but it is for those for whom it has been made ready.

chinese: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒雅各、約翰。
english: And hearing this, the ten became very angry with James and John.

chinese: 耶穌叫他們來，對他們說：你們知道，外邦人有尊為君王的，治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
english: And Jesus made them come to him, and said to them, You see that those who are made rulers over the Gentiles are lords over them, and their great ones have authority over them.

chinese: 只是在你們中間，不是這樣。你們中間，誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
english: But it is not so among you: but whoever has a desire to become great among you, let him be your servant:

chinese: 在你們中間，誰願為首，就必作眾人的僕人。
english: And whoever has a desire to be first among you, let him be servant of all.

chinese: 因為人子來，並不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命作多人的贖價。
english: For truly the Son of man did not come to have servants, but to be a servant, and to give his life for the salvation of men.

chinese: 到了耶利哥；耶穌同門徒並許多人出耶利哥的時候，有一個討飯的瞎子，是底買的兒子巴底買，坐在路旁。
english: And they came to Jericho: and when he was going out of Jericho, with his disciples and a great number of people, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind man, was seated by the wayside, with his hand out for money.

chinese: 他聽見是拿撒勒的耶穌，就喊著說：大衛的子孫耶穌阿！可憐我罷！
english: And when it came to his ears that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he gave a cry, and said, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

chinese: 有許多人責備他，不許他作聲。他卻越發大聲喊著說：大衛的子孫哪，可憐我罷！
english: And some of them, turning in protest, gave him an order to be quiet: but he went on crying out all the more, Son of David, have mercy on me.

chinese: 耶穌就站住，說：叫過他來。他們就叫那瞎子，對他說：放心，起來！他叫你啦。
english: And Jesus came to a stop and said, Let him come. And crying out to the blind man, they said to him, Be comforted: come, he has sent for you.

chinese: 瞎子就丟下衣服，跳起來，走到耶穌那裡。
english: And he, putting off his coat, got up quickly, and came to Jesus.

chinese: 耶穌說：要我為你作甚麼？瞎子說：拉波尼（就是夫子），我要能看見。
english: And Jesus said to him, What would you have me do to you? And the blind man said, Master, make me able to see.

chinese: 耶穌說：你去罷！你的信救了你了。瞎子立刻看見了，就在路上跟隨耶穌。
english: And Jesus said to him, Go on your way; your faith has made you well. And straight away he was able to see, and went after him in the way.

chinese: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄欖山那裡；耶穌就打發兩個門徒，
english: And when they came near to Jerusalem, to Beth-phage and Bethany, at the Mountain of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

chinese: 對他們說：你們往對面村子裡去，一進去的時候，必看見一匹驢駒拴在那裡，是從來沒有人騎過的，可以解開，牽來。
english: And said to them, Go into the little town opposite: and when you come to it, you will see a young ass with a cord round his neck, on which no man has ever been seated; let him loose, and come back with him.

chinese: 若有人對你們說：為甚麼作這事？你們就說：主要用他。那人必立時讓你們牽來。
english: And if anyone says to you, Why are you doing this? say, The Lord has need of him and will send him back straight away.

chinese: 他們去了，便看見一匹驢駒拴在門外街道上，就把他解開。
english: And they went away and saw a young ass by the door outside in the open street; and they were getting him loose.

chinese: 在那裡站著的人，有幾個說：你們解驢駒作甚麼？
english: And some of those who were there said to them, What are you doing, taking the ass?

chinese: 門徒照著耶穌所說的回答，那些人就任憑他們牽去了。
english: And they said to them the words which Jesus had said; and they let them go.

chinese: 他們把驢駒牽到耶穌那裡，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
english: And they took the young ass to Jesus, and put their clothing on him, and he got on his back.

chinese: 有許多人把衣服鋪在路上，也有人把田間的樹枝砍下來，鋪在路上。
english: And a great number put down their clothing in the way; and others put down branches which they had taken from the fields.

chinese: 前行後隨的人都喊著說：和散那（和散那：原有求救的意思，在此乃是稱頌的話）！奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！
english: And those who went in front, and those who came after, were crying, Glory: A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord:

chinese: 那將要來的我祖大衛之國是應當稱頌的！高高在上和散那！
english: A blessing on the coming kingdom of our father David: Glory in the highest.

chinese: 耶穌進了耶路撒冷，入了聖殿，周圍看了各樣物件。天色已晚，就和十二個門徒出城，往伯大尼去了。
english: And he went into Jerusalem into the Temple; and after looking round about on all things, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

chinese: 第二天，他們從伯大尼出來，耶穌餓了。
english: And on the day after, when they had come out from Bethany, he was in need of food.

chinese: 遠遠的看見一棵無花果樹，樹上有葉子，就往那裡去，或者在樹上可以找著甚麼。到了樹下，竟找不著甚麼，不過有葉子，因為不是收無花果的時候。
english: And seeing a fig-tree in the distance with leaves, he went to see if by chance it had anything on it: and when he came to it, he saw nothing but leaves, for it was not the time for the fruit.

chinese: 耶穌就對樹說：從今以後，永沒有人吃你的果子。他的門徒也聽見了。
english: And he said to it, Let no man take fruit from you for ever. And his disciples took note of his words.

chinese: 他們來到耶路撒冷。耶穌進入聖殿，趕出殿裡作買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子，和賣鴿子之人的凳子；
english: And they came to Jerusalem; and he went into the Temple, and sent out those who were trading there, overturning the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who were offering doves for money;

chinese: 也不許人拿著器具從殿裡經過；
english: And he would not let any man take a vessel through the Temple.

chinese: 便教訓他們說：經上不是記著說：我的殿必稱為萬國禱告的殿麼？你們倒使他成為賊窩了。
english: And he gave them teaching, and said to them, Is it not in the Writings, My house is to be named a house of prayer for all the nations? but you have made it a hole of thieves.

chinese: 祭司長和文士聽見這話，就想法子要除滅耶穌，卻又怕他，因為眾人都希奇他的教訓。
english: And it came to the ears of the chief priests and scribes, and they took thought how they might put him to death; being in fear of him, because all the people were full of wonder at his teaching.

chinese: 每天晚上，耶穌出城去。
english: And every evening he went out of the town.

chinese: 早晨，他們從那裡經過，看見無花果樹連根都枯乾了。
english: And when they were going by in the morning, they saw the fig-tree dead from the roots.

chinese: 彼得想起耶穌的話來，就對他說：拉比，請看！你所咒詛的無花果樹，已經枯乾了。
english: And Peter, having a memory of it, said to him, Master, see, the tree which was cursed by you is dead.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們當信服神。
english: And Jesus, answering, said to them, Have God's faith.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，無論何人對這座山說：你挪開此地，投在海裡！他若心裡不疑惑，只信他所說的必成，就必給他成了。
english: Truly I say to you, Whoever says to this mountain, Be taken up and be put into the sea; and has no doubt in his heart, but has faith that what he says will come about, he will have his desire.

chinese: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信是得著的，就必得著。
english: For this reason I say to you, Whatever you make a request for in prayer, have faith that it has been given to you, and you will have it.

chinese: 你們站著禱告的時候，若想起有人得罪你們，就當饒恕他，好叫你們在天上的父也饒恕你們的過犯。
english: And whenever you make a prayer, let there be forgiveness in your hearts, if you have anything against anyone; so that you may have forgiveness for your sins from your Father who is in heaven.

chinese: 你們若不饒恕人，你們在天上的父也不饒恕你們的過犯。（有古卷無此節）
他們又來到耶路撒冷。耶穌在殿裡行走的時候，祭司長和文士並長老進前來，
english: And they came again to Jerusalem: and while he was walking in the Temple, there came to him the chief priests and the scribes and those in authority:

chinese: 問他說：你仗著甚麼權柄作這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？
english: And they said to him, By what authority do you do these things? or who gave you authority to do these things?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：我要問你們一句話，你們回答我，我就告訴你們我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。
english: And Jesus said to them, I will put to you one question; give me an answer, and I will say by what authority I do these things.

chinese: 約翰的洗禮是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？你們可以回答我。
english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven or from men? give me an answer.

chinese: 他們彼此商議說：我們若說從天上來，他必說：這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？
english: And they gave thought to it among themselves, saying, If we say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did you not have faith in him?

chinese: 若說從人間來，卻又怕百姓，因為眾人真以約翰為先知。
english: But if we say, From men--they were in fear of the people, because all took John to be truly a prophet.

chinese: 於是回答耶穌說：我們不知道。耶穌說：我也不告訴你們我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。
english: And they said in answer to Jesus, We have no idea. And Jesus said to them, And I will not say to you by what authority I do these things.

chinese: 耶穌就用比喻對他們說：有人栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
english: And he gave them teaching in the form of stories. A man had a vine-garden planted, and put a wall about it, and made a place for crushing out the wine, and put up a tower, and let it out to field-workers, and went into another country.

chinese: 到了時候，打發一個僕人到園戶那裡，要從園戶收葡萄園的果子。
english: And when the time came, he sent a servant to get from the workmen some of the fruit of the garden.

chinese: 園戶拿住他，打了他，叫他空手回去。
english: And they took him, and gave him blows, and sent him away with nothing.

chinese: 再打發一個僕人到他們那裡。他們打傷他的頭，並且凌辱他。
english: And again he sent to them another servant; and they gave him wounds on the head, and were very cruel to him.

chinese: 又打發一個僕人去，他們就殺了他。後又打發好些僕人去，有被他們打的，有被他們殺的。
english: And he sent another; and they put him to death: and a number of others, whipping some, and putting some to death.

chinese: 園主還有一位是他的愛子，末後又打發他去，意思說：他們必尊敬我的兒子。
english: He still had one, a dearly loved son: he sent him last to them, saying, They will have respect for my son.

chinese: 不料，那些園戶彼此說：這是承受產業的。來罷，我們殺他，產業就歸我們了！
english: But those workmen said among themselves, This is he who will one day be the owner of the property; come, let us put him to death, and the heritage will be ours.

chinese: 於是拿住他，殺了他，把他丟在園外。
english: And they took him and put him to death, pushing his body out of the garden.

chinese: 這樣，葡萄園的主人要怎麼辦呢？他要來除滅那些園戶，將葡萄園轉給別人。
english: What then will the master of the garden do? He will come and put the workmen to death, and will give the garden into the hands of others.

chinese: 經上寫著說：匠人所棄的石頭，已作了房角的頭塊石頭。
english: Have you not seen this which is in the Writings: The stone which the builders put on one side, the same was made the chief stone of the building:

chinese: 這是主所作的，在我們眼中看為希奇。這經你們沒有念過麼？
english: This was the Lord's doing, and it is a wonder in our eyes?

chinese: 他們看出這比喻是指著他們說的，就想要捉拿他，只是懼怕百姓，於是離開他走了。
english: And they made attempts to take him; but they were in fear of the people, because they saw that the story was against them; and they went away from him.

chinese: 後來，他們打發幾個法利賽人和幾個希律黨的人到耶穌那裡，要就著他的話陷害他。
english: Then they sent to him certain of the Pharisees and the Herodians, so that they might make use of his words to take him by a trick.

chinese: 他們來了，就對他說：夫子，我們知道你是誠實的，甚麼人你都不徇情面；因為你不看人的外貌，乃是誠誠實實傳神的道。納稅給該撒可以不可以？
english: And when they had come, they said to him, Master, we are certain that you are true, and have no fear of anyone: you have no respect for a man's position, but you are teaching the true way of God: Is it right to give taxes to Caesar or not?

chinese: 我們該納不該納？耶穌知道他們的假意，就對他們說：你們為甚麼試探我？拿一個銀錢來給我看！
english: Are we to give or not to give? But he, conscious of their false hearts, said to them, Why do you put me to the test? give me a penny, so that I may see it.

chinese: 我們該納不該納？耶穌知道他們的假意，就對他們說：你們為甚麼試探我？拿一個銀錢來給我看！
english: And they gave him one. And he said to them, Whose is this image and name on it? And they said to him, Caesar's.

chinese: 耶穌說：該撒的物當歸給該撒，神的物當歸給神。他們就很希奇他。
english: And Jesus said to them, Give to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's. And they were full of wonder at him.

chinese: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。他們來問耶穌說：
english: And there came to him Sadducees, who say there is no coming back from the dead; and they put a question to him, saying,

chinese: 夫子，摩西為我們寫著說：人若死了，撇下妻子，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。
english: Master, in the law Moses says, If a man's brother comes to his end, and has a wife still living and no child, it is right for his brother to take his wife, and get a family for his brother.

chinese: 有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有留下孩子。
english: There were seven brothers: and the first took a wife, and at his death there were no offspring;

chinese: 第二個娶了他，也死了，沒有留下孩子。第三個也是這樣。
english: And the second took her, and at his death there were no offspring; and the third the same:

chinese: 那七個人都沒有留下孩子；末了，那婦人也死了。
english: And all the seven had no seed. Last of all the woman herself came to her death.

chinese: 當復活的時候，他是那一個的妻子呢？因為他們七個人都娶過他。
english: In the future life, when they come back from the dead, whose wife will she be? for the seven had her for a wife.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們所以錯了，豈不是因為不明白聖經，不曉得神的大能麼？
english: Jesus said to them, Is not this the reason for your error, that you have no knowledge of the holy Writings or of the power of God?

chinese: 人從死裡復活，也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
english: When they come back from the dead, they do not get married, but are like the angels in heaven.

chinese: 論到死人復活，你們沒有念過摩西的書荊棘篇上所載的麼？神對摩西說：我是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。
english: But as to the dead coming back to life; have you not seen in the book of Moses, about the burning thorn-tree, how God said to him, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

chinese: 神不是死人的神，乃是活人的神。你們是大錯了。
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living: you are greatly in error.

chinese: 有一個文士來，聽見他們辯論，曉得耶穌回答的好，就問他說：誡命中那是第一要緊的呢？
english: And one of the scribes came, and hearing their argument together, and seeing that he had given them a good answer, put the question to him, Which law is the first of all?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：第一要緊的就是說：以色列阿，你要聽，主─我們神是獨一的主。
english: Jesus said in answer, The first is, Give ear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord;

chinese: 你要盡心、盡性、盡意、盡力愛主─你的神。
english: And you are to have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.

chinese: 其次就是說：要愛人如己。再沒有比這兩條誡命更大的了。
english: The second is this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself. There is no other law greater than these.

chinese: 那文士對耶穌說：夫子說，神是一位，實在不錯；除了他以外，再沒有別的神；
english: And the scribe said to him, Truly, Master, you have well said that he is one, and there is no other but he:

chinese: 並且盡心、盡智、盡力愛他，又愛人如己，就比一切燔祭和各樣祭祀好的多。
english: And to have love for him with all the heart, and with all the mind, and with all the strength, and to have the same love for his neighbour as for himself, is much more than all forms of offerings.

chinese: 耶穌見他回答的有智慧，就對他說：你離神的國不遠了。從此以後，沒有人敢再問他甚麼。
english: And when Jesus saw that he gave a wise answer, he said to him, You are not far from the kingdom of God. And every man after that was in fear of questioning him any more.

chinese: 耶穌在殿裡教訓人，就問他們說：文士怎麼說基督是大衛的子孫呢？
english: And Jesus, when he was teaching in the Temple, said, How do the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?

chinese: 大衛被聖靈感動，說：主對我主說，你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
english: David himself said in the Holy Spirit, The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put those who are against you under your feet.

chinese: 大衛既自己稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？眾人都喜歡聽他。
english: David himself gives him the name of Lord; and how then is he his son? And the common people gave ear to him gladly.

chinese: 耶穌在教訓之間，說：你們要防備文士；他們好穿長衣遊行，喜愛人在街市上問他們的安，
english: And in his teaching he said, Be on your watch against the scribes, whose pleasure it is to go about in long robes and be respected in the market-places,

chinese: 又喜愛會堂裡的高位，筵席上的首座。
english: And to have the chief seats in the Synagogues and the first places at feasts;

chinese: 他們侵吞寡婦的家產，假意作很長的禱告。這些人要受更重的刑罰！
english: Who take away the property of widows, and before the eyes of men make long prayers; these will be judged more hardly.

chinese: 耶穌對銀庫坐著，看眾人怎樣投錢入庫。有好些財主往裡投了若干的錢。
english: And he took a seat by the place where the money was kept, and saw how the people put money into the boxes: and a number who had wealth put in much.

chinese: 有一個窮寡婦來，往裡投了兩個小錢，就是一個大錢。
english: And there came a poor widow, and she put in two little bits of money, which make a farthing.

chinese: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：我實在告訴你們，這窮寡婦投入庫裡的，比眾人所投的更多。
english: And he made his disciples come to him, and said to them, Truly I say to you, This poor widow has put in more than all those who are putting money into the box:

chinese: 因為，他們都是自己有餘，拿出來投在裡頭；但這寡婦是自己不足，把他一切養生的都投上了。
english: Because they all put in something out of what they had no need for; but she out of her need put in all she had, even all her living.

chinese: 耶穌從殿裡出來的時候，有一個門徒對他說：夫子，請看，這是何等的石頭！何等的殿宇！
english: And when he was going out of the Temple, one of his disciples said to him, Master, see, what stones and what buildings!

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你看見這大殿宇麼？將來在這裡沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。
english: And Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? there is not one stone here resting on another which will not be overturned.

chinese: 耶穌在橄欖山上對聖殿而坐，彼得、雅各、約翰，和安得烈暗暗的問他說：
english: And while he was seated on the Mountain of Olives opposite the Temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew said to him privately,

chinese: 請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事呢？這一切事將成的時候有甚麼豫兆呢？
english: Say when these things will be, and what will be the sign when these things are all about to be done.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
english: And Jesus said to them, Take care that you are not tricked by anyone.

chinese: 將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：我是基督，並且要迷惑許多人。
english: People will come in my name, saying, I am he; and a number will be turned from the true way.

chinese: 你們聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，不要驚慌。這些事是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
english: And when you have news of wars and talk of wars, do not be troubled; these things have to be, but it is still not the end.

chinese: 民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有地震、饑荒。這都是災難（災難：原文是生產之難）的起頭。
english: Nation will go to war with nation, and kingdom with kingdom: there will be earth-shocks in different places; there will be times when there is no food; these things are the first of the troubles.

chinese: 但你們要謹慎；因為人要把你們交給公會，並且你們在會堂裡要受鞭打，又為我的緣故站在諸侯與君王面前，對他們.作見證。
english: But take care: for they will give you up to the Sanhedrins; and in Synagogues you will be whipped; and you will be taken before rulers and kings because of me, for a sign to them.

chinese: 然而，福音必須先傳給萬民。
english: And the good news has first to be given to all the nations.

chinese: 人把你們拉去交官的時候，不要預先思慮說甚麼；到那時候，賜給你們甚麼話，你們就說甚麼；因為說話的不是你們，乃是聖靈。
english: And when you are taken and given up to be judged, do not be troubled about what to say: but whatever is given to you in that hour, say: because it is not you who say it, but the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 弟兄要把弟兄，父親要把兒子，送到死地；兒女要起來與父母為敵，害死他們；
english: And brother will give up brother to death, and the father his child; and children will go against their fathers and mothers, and put them to death.

chinese: 並且你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡。惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
english: And you will be hated by all men, because of my name; but he who goes through to the end will have salvation.

chinese: 你們看見那行毀壞可憎的，站在不當站的地方（讀這經的人須要會意）。那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
english: But when you see the unclean thing which makes destruction, in the place where it has no right to be (let this be clear to the reader), then let those who are in Judaea go quickly to the mountains:

chinese: 在房上的，不要下來，也不要進去拿家裡的東西；
english: And let him who is on the house-top not go down, or go in, to take anything out of his house:

chinese: 在田裡的，也不要回去取衣裳。
english: And let not him who is in the field go back to take his coat.

chinese: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了！
english: And it will be hard for women who are with child and for her who has a baby at the breast in those days.

chinese: 你們應當祈求，叫這些事不在冬天臨到。
english: And say a prayer that it may not be in the winter.

chinese: 因為在那些日子必有災難，自從神創造萬物直到如今，並沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
english: For in those days there will be sorrow, such as there has not been from the time when God made the world till now, and will not ever be again.

chinese: 若不是主減少那日子，凡有血氣的，總沒有一個得救的；只是為主的選民，他將那日子減少了。
english: And if the Lord had not made the time short, no flesh would have been kept from destruction; but because of the saints he has made the time short.

chinese: 那時若有人對你們說：看哪，基督在這裡，或說：基督在那裡，你們不要信！
english: And then if any man says to you, See, here is Christ; or, See, there; have no faith in it:

chinese: 因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯神蹟奇事，倘若能行，就把選民迷惑了。
english: Because there will be false Christs and false prophets, and they will give signs and wonders in the hope of turning even the saints from the true way.

chinese: 你們要謹慎。看哪，凡事我都預先告訴你們了。
english: But take care; see, I have made all things clear to you before the time.

chinese: 在那些日子，那災難以後，日頭要變黑了，月亮也不放光，
english: But in those days, after that time of trouble, the sun will be made dark and the moon will not give her light,

chinese: 眾星要從天上墜落，天勢都要震動。
english: And the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers which are in the heavens will be moved.

chinese: 那時，他們（馬太二十四章三十節是地上的萬族）要看見人子有大能力、大榮耀，駕雲降臨。
english: And then they will see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

chinese: 他要差遣天使，把他的選民，從四方（方：原文是風），從地極直到天邊，都招聚了來。
english: And then he will send out the angels, and will get together his saints from the four winds, from the farthest part of the earth to the farthest part of heaven.

chinese: 你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
english: Take an example from the fig-tree: when its branches become soft and put out their leaves, you see that the summer is near;

chinese: 這樣，你們幾時看見這些事成就，也該知道人子（人子：或作神的國）近了，正在門口了。
english: Even so, when you see these things taking place, you may be certain that he is near, even at the doors.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
english: Truly, I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all these things are complete.

chinese: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。
english: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.

chinese: 但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。
english: But of that day or that hour no one has knowledge, not even the angels in heaven, or the Son, but the Father.

chinese: 你們要謹慎，儆醒祈禱，因為你們不曉得那日期幾時來到。
english: Take care, keep watch with prayer: for you are not certain when the time will be.

chinese: 這事正如一個人離開本家，寄居外邦，把權柄交給僕人，分派各人當作的工又吩咐看門的儆醒。
english: It is as when a man who is in another country for a time, having gone away from his house, and given authority to his servants and to everyone his work, gives the porter an order to keep watch.

chinese: 所以，你們要儆醒；因為你們不知道家主甚麼時候來，或晚上，或半夜，或雞叫，或早晨；
english: So you are to keep watch: because you are not certain when the master of the house is coming, in the evening, or in the middle of the night, or at the cock's cry, or in the morning;

chinese: 恐怕他忽然來到，看見你們睡著了。
english: For fear that, coming suddenly, he sees you sleeping.

chinese: 我對你們所說的話，也是對眾人說：要儆醒！
english: And what I say to you, I say to all, Keep watch.

chinese: 過兩天是逾越節，又是除酵節，祭司長和文士想法子怎麼用詭計捉拿耶穌，殺他。
english: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes made designs how they might take him by deceit and put him to death:

chinese: 只是說：當節的日子不可，恐怕百姓生亂。
english: But they said, Not while the feast is going on, for fear there may be trouble among the people.

chinese: 耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裡坐席的時候，有一個女人拿著一玉瓶至貴的真哪噠香膏來，打破玉瓶，把膏澆在耶穌的頭上。
english: And while he was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, seated at table, there came a woman with a bottle of perfumed oil of great price; and when the bottle was broken she put the perfume on his head.

chinese: 有幾個人心中很不喜悅，說：何用這樣枉費香膏呢？
english: But some of them were angry among themselves, saying, For what purpose has this oil been wasted?

chinese: 這香膏可以賣三十多兩銀子賙濟窮人。他們就向那女人生氣。
english: We might have got more than three hundred pence for it, and given the money to the poor. And they said things against her among themselves.

chinese: 耶穌說：由他罷！為甚麼難為他呢？他在我身上作的是一件美事。
english: But Jesus said, Let her be; why are you troubling her? she has done a kind act to me.

chinese: 因為常有窮人和你們同在，要向他們行善隨時都可以；只是你們不常有我。
english: The poor you have ever with you, and whenever you have the desire you may do them good: but me you have not for ever.

chinese: 他所作的，是盡他所能的；他是為我安葬的事把香膏預先澆在我身上。
english: She has done what she was able: she has put oil on my body to make it ready for its last resting-place.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所作的，以為記念。
english: And truly I say to you, Wherever the good news goes out through all the earth, what this woman has done will be talked of in memory of her.

chinese: 十二門徒之中，有一個加略人猶大去見祭司長，要把耶穌交給他們。
english: And Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, so that he might give him up to them.

chinese: 他們聽見就歡喜，又應許給他銀子；他就尋思如何得便把耶穌交給他們。
english: And hearing what he said, they were glad, and gave him their word to make him a payment of money. And he took thought how he might best give him up to them.

chinese: 除酵節的第一天，就是宰逾越羊羔的那一天，門徒對耶穌說：你吃逾越節的筵席要我們往那裡去預備呢？
english: And on the first day of unleavened bread, when the Passover lamb is put to death, his disciples said to him, Where are we to go and make ready for you to take the Passover meal?

chinese: 耶穌就打發兩個門徒，對他們說：你們進城去，必有人拿著一瓶水迎面而來，你們就跟著他。
english: And he sent two of his disciples, and said to them, Go into the town, and there will come to you a man with a vessel of water: go after him;

chinese: 他進那家去，你們就對那家的主人說：夫子說：客房在那裡？我與門徒好在那裡吃逾越節的筵席。
english: And wherever he goes in, say to the owner of the house, The Master says, Where is my guest-room, where I may take the Passover with my disciples?

chinese: 他必指給你們擺設整齊的一間大樓，你們就在那裡為我們預備。
english: And he will take you up himself to a great room with a table and seats: there make ready for us.

chinese: 門徒出去，進了城，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的。他們就預備了逾越節的筵席。
english: And the disciples went out and came into the town, and saw that it was as he had said: and they made ready the Passover.

chinese: 到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒都來了。
english: And when it was evening he came with the twelve.

chinese: 他們坐席正吃的時候，耶穌說：我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個與我同吃的人要賣我了。
english: And while they were seated taking food, Jesus said, Truly I say to you, One of you will be false to me, one who is taking food with me.

chinese: 他們就憂愁起來，一個一個的問他說：是我麼？
english: They were sad, and said to him one by one, Is it I?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：是十二個門徒中同我蘸手在盤子裡的那個人。
english: And he said to them, It is one of the twelve, one who is putting his bread with me into the same plate.

chinese: 人子必要去世，正如經上指著他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。
english: The Son of man goes, even as the Writings say of him: but cursed is that man through whom the Son of man is given up! It would have been well for that man if he had never been given birth.

chinese: 他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝了福，就擘開，遞給他們，說：你們拿著吃，這是我的身體；
english: And while they were taking food, he took bread, and after blessing it, he gave the broken bread to them, and said, Take it: this is my body.

chinese: 又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們；他們都喝了。
english: And he took a cup, and when he had given praise, he gave it to them: and they all had a drink from it.

chinese: 耶穌說：這是我立約的血，為多人流出來的。
english: And he said to them, This is my blood of the testament, which is given for men.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在神的國裡喝新的那日子。
english: Truly I say to you, I will take no more of the fruit of the vine till the day when I take it new in the kingdom of God.

chinese: 他們唱了詩，就出來，往橄欖山去。
english: And after a song of praise to God they went out to the Mountain of Olives.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們都要跌倒了，因為經上記著說：我要擊打牧人，羊就分散了。
english: And Jesus said to them, You will all be turned away from me: for it is in the Writings, I will put the keeper of the sheep to death, and the sheep will be put to flight.

chinese: 但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。
english: But after I have come back from the dead, I will go before you into Galilee.

chinese: 彼得說：眾人雖然跌倒，我總不能。
english: But Peter said to him, Though the others may be turned away from you, I will not.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：我實在告訴你，就在今天夜裡，雞叫兩遍以先，你要三次不認我。
english: And Jesus said to him, Truly, I say to you that you, today, even this night, before the cock's second cry, will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.

chinese: 彼得卻極力的說：我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。眾門徒都是這樣說。
english: But he said with passion, If I have to be put to death with you, I will not be false to you. And they all said the same.

chinese: 他們來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼。耶穌對門徒說：你們坐在這裡，等我禱告。
english: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he said to his disciples, Be seated here while I say a prayer.

chinese: 於是帶著彼得、雅各、約翰同去，就驚恐起來，極其難過，
english: And he took with him Peter and James and John, and grief and great trouble came on him.

chinese: 對他們說：我心裡甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裡等候，儆醒。
english: And he said to them, My soul is very sad, even to death: be here a little time, and keep watch.

chinese: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：倘若可行，便叫那時候過去。
english: And he went forward a little, and falling down on the earth, made request that, if possible, the hour might go from him.

chinese: 他說：阿爸！父阿！在你凡事都能；求你將這杯撤去。然而，不要從我的意思，只要從你的意思。
english: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible to you; take away this cup from me: but even so let not my pleasure, but yours be done.

chinese: 耶穌回來，見他們睡著了，就對彼得說：西門，你睡覺麼？不能儆醒片時麼？
english: And he came, and saw them sleeping, and said to Peter, Simon, are you sleeping? were you not able to keep watch one hour?

chinese: 總要儆醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。
english: Keep watch with prayer, so that you may not be put to the test; the spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is feeble.

chinese: 耶穌又去禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣，
english: And again he went away, and said a prayer, using the same words.

chinese: 又來見他們睡著了，因為他們的眼睛甚是困倦；他們也不知道怎麼回答。
english: And again he came and saw them sleeping, because their eyes were very tired; and they had nothing to say in answer.

chinese: 第三次來，對他們說：現在你們仍然睡覺安歇罷（或作麼？）！夠了，時候到了。看哪，人子被賣在罪人手裡了。
english: And he came the third time, and said to them, Go on sleeping now and take your rest: it is enough; the hour has come; see, the Son of man is given up into the hands of evil men.

chinese: 起來！我們走罷。看哪，那賣我的人近了。
english: Get up, let us be going; see, he who gives me up is near.

chinese: 說話之間，忽然那十二個門徒裡的猶大來了，並有許多人帶著刀棒，從祭司長和文士並長老那裡與他同來。
english: And straight away, while he was still talking, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great band with swords and sticks, from the chief priests and the scribes and those in authority.

chinese: 賣耶穌的人曾給他們一個暗號，說：我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們把他拿住，牢牢靠靠的帶去。
english: Now he who had been false to him had given them a sign, saying, The one to whom I give a kiss, that is he; take him, and get him away safely.

chinese: 猶大來了，隨即到耶穌跟前，說：拉比，便與他親嘴。
english: And when he had come, he went straight to him and said, Master; and gave him a kiss.

chinese: 他們就下手拿住他。
english: And they put their hands on him, and took him.

chinese: 旁邊站著的人，有一個拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。
english: But a certain one of those who were near took out his sword, and gave the servant of the high priest a blow, cutting off his ear.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們帶著刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜麼？
english: And Jesus said to them, Have you come out as against a thief, with swords and sticks to take me?

chinese: 我天天教訓人，同你們在殿裡，你們並沒有拿我。但這事成就，為要應驗經上的話。
english: I was with you every day in the Temple teaching, and you did not take me; but this is done so that the Writings may come true.

chinese: 門徒都離開他，逃走了。
english: And they all went away from him in fear.

chinese: 有一個少年人，赤身披著一塊麻布，跟隨耶穌，眾人就捉拿他。
english: And a certain young man went after him, with only a linen cloth about his body; and they put their hands on him;

chinese: 他卻丟了麻布，赤身逃走了。
english: But he got away unclothed, without the linen cloth.

chinese: 他們把耶穌帶到大祭司那裡，又有眾祭司長和長老並文士都來和大祭司一同聚集。
english: And they took Jesus away to the high priest; and there came together with him all the chief priests and those in authority and the scribes.

chinese: 彼得遠遠的跟著耶穌，一直進入大祭司的院裡，和差役一同坐在火光.裡烤火。
english: And Peter had come after him at a distance, even into the house of the high priest; and he was seated with the captains, warming himself in the light of the fire.

chinese: 祭司長和全公會尋找見證控告耶穌，要治死他，卻尋不著。
english: Now the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin were looking for witness against Jesus so that they might put him to death; and they were unable to get any.

chinese: 因為有好些人作見證告他，只是他們的見證各不相合。
english: For a number gave false witness against him and their witness was not in agreement.

chinese: 又有幾個人站起來作假見證告他，說：
