english: Then some got up and gave false witness against him, saying,

chinese: 我們聽見他說：我要拆毀這人手所造的殿，三日內就另造一座不是人手所造的。
english: He said in our hearing, I will put an end to this Temple which is made with hands, and in three days I will make another without hands.

chinese: 他們就是這麼作見證，也是各不相合。
english: And even so their witness was not in agreement.

chinese: 大祭司起來站在中間，問耶穌說：你甚麼都不回答麼？這些人作見證告你?的是甚麼呢？
english: And the high priest got up in the middle of them, and said to Jesus, Do you say nothing in answer? what is it which these say against you?

chinese: 耶穌卻不言語，一句也不回答。大祭司又問他說：你是那當稱頌者的兒子基督不是？
english: But he kept quiet and said nothing. Again the high priest questioning him said, Are you the Christ, the son of the Holy One?

chinese: 耶穌說：我是。你們必看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕著天上的雲降臨。
english: And Jesus said, I am: and you will see the Son of man seated at the right hand of power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.

chinese: 大祭司就撕開衣服，說：我們何必再用見證人呢？
english: And the high priest, violently parting his robes, said, What more need have we of witnesses?

chinese: 你們已經聽見他這僭妄的話了。你們的意見如何？他們都定他該死的罪。
english: His words against God have come to your ears: what is your opinion? And they all said it was right for him to be put to death.

chinese: 就有人吐唾沫在他臉上，又蒙著他的臉，用拳頭打他，對他說：你說預言罷！差役接過他來，用手掌打他。
english: And some put shame on him and, covering his face, gave him blows and said to him, Now say what is to come: and the captains took him and gave him blows with their hands.

chinese: 彼得在下邊院子裡；來了大祭司的一個使女，
english: And while Peter was down in the open square of the building, one of the servant-girls of the high priest came;

chinese: 見彼得烤火，就看著他，說：你素來也是同拿撒勒人耶穌一夥的。
english: And seeing Peter warming himself by the fire, she gave him a look, and said, You were with this Nazarene, even Jesus.

chinese: 彼得卻不承認，說：我不知道，也不明白你說的是甚麼。於是出來，到了前院，雞就叫了。
english: But he said, I have no knowledge of him, or of what you are saying: and he went out into the doorway; and there came the cry of a cock.

chinese: 那使女看見他，又對旁邊站著的人說：這也是他們一黨的。
english: And the girl saw him, and said again to those who were near, This is one of them.

chinese: 彼得又不承認。過了不多的時候，旁邊站著的人又對彼得說：你真是他們一黨的！因為你是加利利人。
english: But again he said it was not so. And after a little time, again those who were near said to Peter, Truly you are one of them; for you are a Galilaean.

chinese: 彼得就發咒起誓的說：我不認得你們說的這個人。
english: But, with curses and oaths, he said, I have no knowledge of the man about whom you are talking.

chinese: 立時雞叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶穌對他所說的話：雞叫兩遍以先，你要三次不認我。思想起來，就哭了。
english: And in the same minute, the cock gave a second cry. And it came to Peter's mind how Jesus had said to him, Before the cock's second cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me. And at this thought he was overcome with weeping.

chinese: 一到早晨，祭司長和長老、文士、全公會的人大家商議，就把耶穌捆綁，解去交給彼拉多。
english: And the first thing in the morning the chief priests, with those in authority and the scribes and all the Sanhedrin, had a meeting, and put cords round Jesus, and took him away, and gave him up to Pilate.

chinese: 彼拉多問他說：你是猶太人的王麼？耶穌回答說：你說的是。
english: And Pilate put a question to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And he, answering, said to him, You say so.

chinese: 祭司長告他許多的事。
english: And the chief priests said a number of things against him.

chinese: 彼拉多又問他說：你看，他們告你這麼多的事，你甚麼都不回答麼？
english: And Pilate again put a question, Do you say nothing in answer? see how much evil they say you have done.

chinese: 耶穌仍不回答，以致彼拉多覺得希奇。
english: But Jesus gave no more answers, so that Pilate was full of wonder.

chinese: 每逢這節期，巡撫照眾人所求的，釋放一個囚犯給他們。
english: Now at the feast every year he let one prisoner go free at their request.

chinese: 有一個人名叫巴拉巴，和作亂的人一同捆綁。他們作亂的時候，曾殺過人。
english: And there was one named Barabbas, in prison with those who had gone against the government and in the fight had taken life.

chinese: 眾人上去求巡撫，照常例給他們辦。
english: And the people went up, requesting him to do as he had done for them in other years.

chinese: 彼拉多說：你們要我釋放猶太人的王給你們麼？
english: And Pilate said in answer to them, Is it your desire that I let the King of the Jews go free?

chinese: 他原曉得，祭司長是因為嫉妒才把耶穌解了來。
english: For he saw that the chief priests had given him up through envy.

chinese: 只是祭司長挑唆眾人，寧可釋放巴拉巴給他們。
english: But the people were moved by the chief priests to make him let Barabbas go free.

chinese: 彼拉多又說：那麼樣，你們所稱為猶太人的王，我怎麼辦他呢？
english: And Pilate again said in answer to them, What then am I to do to him to whom you give the name of the King of the Jews?

chinese: }他們又喊著說：把他釘十字架！
english: And they said again loudly, To the cross with him!

chinese: 彼拉多說：為甚麼呢？他作了甚麼惡事呢？他們便極力的喊著說：把他釘十字架！
english: And Pilate said to them, Why, what evil has he done? But their cry was the louder, To the cross!

chinese: 彼拉多要叫眾人喜悅，就釋放巴拉巴給他們，將耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。
english: And Pilate, desiring to do what was pleasing to the people, let Barabbas go free, and gave up Jesus, when he had been whipped, to be put to death on the cross.

chinese: 兵丁把耶穌帶進衙門院裡，叫齊了全營的兵.。
english: And the men of the army took him away into the square in front of the building which is the Praetorium, and they got together all the band.

chinese: 他們給他穿上紫袍，又用荊棘編作冠冕給他戴上，
english: And they put a purple robe on him, and twisting a crown of thorns, they put it on him;

chinese: 就慶賀他說：恭喜，猶太人的王阿！
english: And, as if honouring him, they said, Long life to the King of the Jews!

chinese: 又拿一根葦子打他的頭，吐唾沫在他臉上，屈膝拜他。
english: And they gave him blows on the head with a stick and put shame on him and, going down on their knees, gave him worship.

chinese: 戲弄完了，就給他脫了紫袍，仍穿上他自己的衣服，帶他出去，要釘十字架。
english: And when they had made sport of him, they took the purple robe off him and put his clothing on him. And they took him out to put him to death on the cross.

chinese: 有一個古利奈人西門，就是亞力山大和魯孚的父親，從鄉下來，經過那地方，他們就勉強他同去，好背著耶穌的十字架。
english: And they made one, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, who was going by, coming from the country, go with them, so that he might take his cross.

chinese: 他們帶耶穌到了各各他地方（各各他繙出來就是髑髏地），
english: And they took him to the place named Golgotha, which is, Dead Man's Head.

chinese: 拿沒藥調和的酒給耶穌，他卻不受。
english: And they gave him wine mixed with myrrh; but he did not take it.

chinese: 於是將他釘在十字架上，拈鬮分他的衣服，看是誰得甚麼。
english: And he was nailed to the cross; and they made a division of his clothing among them, putting to the decision of chance what everyone was to take.

chinese: 釘他在十字架上是已初的時候。
english: And it was the third hour when they put him on the cross.

chinese: 在上面有他的罪狀，寫的是：猶太人.的王。
english: And the statement of his crime was put in writing on the cross, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

chinese: 他們又把兩個強盜和他同釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。（有古卷在此有：
english: And they put two thieves on crosses with him, one on his right side, and one on his left.

chinese: 這就應了經上的話說：他被列在罪犯之中。）
從那裡經過的人辱罵他，搖著頭說：咳！你這拆毀聖殿、三日又建造起來的，
english: And those who went by made sport of him, shaking their heads, and saying, Ha! you who give the Temple to destruction, and put it up again in three days,

chinese: 可以救自己，從十字架上下來罷！
english: Keep yourself from death, and come down from the cross.

chinese: 祭司長和文士也是這樣戲弄他，彼此說：他救了別人，不能救自己。
english: In the same way the chief priests, laughing at him among themselves with the scribes, said, A saviour of others, he has no salvation for himself.

chinese: 以色列的王基督，現在可以從十字架上下來，叫我們看見，就信了。那和他同釘的人也是譏誚他。
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and have belief. And those who were put on crosses with him said evil things against him.

chinese: 從午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
english: And when the sixth hour had come, it was dark over all the land till the ninth hour.

chinese: 申初的時候，耶穌大聲喊著說：以羅伊！以羅伊！拉馬撒巴各大尼？繙出來就是：我的神！我的神！為甚麼離棄我？
english: And at the ninth hour, Jesus said in a loud voice, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, My God, my God, why are you turned away from me?

chinese: 旁邊站著的人，有的聽見就說：看哪，他叫以利亞呢！
english: And some of those who were near, hearing it, said, See, he is crying to Elijah.

chinese: 有一個人跑去，把海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝，說：且等著，看以利亞來不來把他取下。
english: And one of them went quickly and, getting a sponge full of bitter wine, put it on a rod, and gave it to him for drink, saying, Let be; let us see if Elijah will come to take him down.

chinese: 耶穌大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。
english: And Jesus gave a loud cry, and gave up his spirit.

chinese: 殿裡的幔子從上到下裂為兩半。
english: And the curtain of the Temple was parted in two from end to end.

chinese: 對面站著的百夫長看見耶穌這樣喊叫（有古卷沒有喊叫二字）斷氣，就說：這人真是神的兒子！
english: And when the captain, who was near, saw how he gave up his spirit, he said, Truly this man was a son of God.

chinese: 還有些婦女遠遠的觀看；內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有小雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有撒羅米，
english: And there were women watching from a distance: among them were Mary Magdalene, and Mary, the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome,

chinese: 就是耶穌在加利利的時候，跟隨他、服事他的那些人，還有同耶穌上耶路撒冷的好些婦女在那裡觀看。
english: Who went with him when he was in Galilee and took care of him; and a number of other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

chinese: 到了晚上，因為這是預備日，就是安息日的前一日，
english: And when it was evening, because it was the time of getting ready, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

chinese: 有亞利馬太的約瑟前來，他是尊貴的議士，也是等候神國的。他放膽進去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；
english: There came Joseph of Arimathaea, a responsible man in high honour, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God; and he went in to Pilate without fear, and made a request for the body of Jesus.

chinese: 彼拉多詫異耶穌已經死了，便叫百夫長來，問他耶穌死了久不久。
english: And Pilate was surprised that he was dead; and, sending for the captain, he put a question to see if he had been dead for long.

chinese: 既從百夫長得知實情，就把耶穌的屍首賜給約瑟。
english: And when he had news of it from the captain, he let Joseph have the body.

chinese: 約瑟買了細麻布，把耶穌取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在磐石中鑿出來的墳墓裡，又輥過一塊石頭來擋住墓門。
english: And he got a linen cloth and, taking him down, put the linen cloth round him, and put him in a place for the dead which had been cut out of a rock; and a stone was rolled against the door.

chinese: 抹大拉的馬利亞和約西的母親馬利亞都看見安放他的地方。
english: And Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was put.

chinese: 過了安息日，抹大拉的馬利亞和雅各的母親馬利亞並撒羅米，買了香膏要去膏耶穌的身體。
english: And when the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of James, and Salome, got spices, so that they might come and put them on him.

chinese: 七日的第一日清早，出太陽的時候，他們來到墳墓那裡，
english: And very early after dawn on the first day of the week, they came at the time of the coming up of the sun to the place where the body had been put.

chinese: 彼此說：誰給我們把石頭從墓門輥開呢？
english: And they were saying among themselves, Who will get the stone rolled away from the door for us?

chinese: 那石頭原來很大，他們抬頭一看，卻見石頭已經輥開了。
english: And looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back; and it was of great size.

chinese: 他們進了墳墓，看見一個少年人坐在右邊，穿著白袍，就甚驚恐。
english: And when they went in, they saw a young man seated on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were full of wonder.

chinese: 那少年人對他們說：不要驚恐！你們尋找那釘十字架的拿撒勒人耶穌，他已經復活了，不在這裡。請看安放他的地方。
english: And he said to them, Do not be troubled: you are looking for Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been put to death on the cross; he has come back from the dead; he is not here: see, the place where they put him!

chinese: 你們可以去告訴他的門徒和彼得，說：他在你們以先往加利利去。在那裡你們要見他，正如他從前所告訴你們的。
english: But go, say to his disciples and to Peter, He goes before you into Galilee: there you will see him, as he said to you.

chinese: 他們就出來，從墳墓那裡逃跑，又發抖又驚奇，甚麼也不告訴人，因為他們害怕。
english: And they went out quickly from the place, because fear and great wonder had come on them: and they said nothing to anyone, because they were full of fear that ...

chinese: 在七日的第一日清早，耶穌復活了，就先向抹大拉的馬利亞顯現。耶穌從他身上曾趕出七個鬼。
english: Now when he came back from the dead early on the first day of the week, he went first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had sent out seven evil spirits.

chinese: 他去告訴那向來跟隨耶穌的人；那時他們正哀慟哭泣。
english: She went and gave news of it to those who had been with him, while they were sorrowing and weeping.

chinese: 他們聽見耶穌活了，被馬利亞看見，卻是不信。
english: And they, when it came to their ears that he was living, and had been seen by her, had no belief in it.

chinese: 這事以後，門徒中間有兩個人往鄉下去。走路的時候，耶穌變了形像，向他們顯現。
english: And after these things he was seen in another form by two of them, while they were walking on their way into the country.

chinese: 他們就去告訴其餘的門徒；其餘的門徒也是不信。
english: And they went away and gave news of it to the rest; and they had no belief in what was said.

chinese: 後來，十一個門徒坐席的時候，耶穌向他們顯現，責備他們不信，心裡剛硬，因為他們不信那些在他復活以後看見他的人。
english: And later he was seen by the eleven themselves while they were taking food; and he said sharp words to them because they had no faith and their hearts were hard, and because they had no belief in those who had seen him after he had come back from the dead.

chinese: 他又對他們說：你們往普天下去，傳福音給萬民（萬民：原文是凡受造的）聽。
english: And he said to them, Go into all the world, and give the good news to everyone.

chinese: 信而受洗的，必然得救；不信的，必被定罪。
english: He who has faith and is given baptism will get salvation; but he who has not faith will be judged.

chinese: 信的人必有神蹟隨著他們，就是奉我的名趕鬼；說新方言；
english: And these signs will be with those who have faith: in my name they will send out evil spirits; and they will make use of new languages;

chinese: 手能拿蛇；若喝了甚麼毒物，也必不受害；手按病人，病人就必好了。
english: They will take up snakes, and if there is poison in their drink, it will do them no evil; they will put their hands on those who are ill, and they will get well.

chinese: 主耶穌和他們說完了話，後來被接到天上，坐在神的右邊。
english: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had said these words to them, was taken up into heaven and took his seat at the right hand of God.

chinese: 門徒出去，到處宣傳福音。主和他們同工，用神蹟隨著，證實所傳的道。阿們！
english: And they went out, preaching everywhere, the Lord working with them, and giving witness to the word by the signs which came after. So be it.

chinese: 提阿非羅大人哪，有好些人提筆作書，述說在我們中間所成就的事，是照傳道的人從起初親眼看見又傳給我們的。
english: As a number of attempts have been made to put together in order an account of those events which took place among us,
As they were handed down to us by those who saw them from the first and were preachers of the word,

chinese: 這些事我既從起頭都詳細考察了，就定意要按著次序寫給你，
english: It seemed good to me, having made observation, with great care, of the direction of events in their order, to put the facts in writing for you, most noble Theophilus;

chinese: 使你知道所學之道都是確實的。
english: So that you might have certain knowledge of those things about which you were given teaching.

chinese: 當猶太王希律的時候，亞比雅班裡有一個祭司，名叫撒迦利亞；他妻子是亞倫的後人，名叫以利沙伯。
english: In the days of Herod, king of Judaea, there was a certain priest, by name Zacharias, of the order of Abijah; and he had a wife of the family of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

chinese: 他們二人在神面前都是義人，遵行主的一切誡命禮儀，沒有可指摘的，
english: They were upright in the eyes of God, keeping all the rules and orders of God, and doing no wrong.

chinese: 只是沒有孩子；因為以利沙伯不生育，兩個人又年紀老邁了。
english: And they were without children, because Elisabeth had never given birth, and they were at that time very old.

chinese: 撒迦利亞按班次在神面前供祭司的職分，
english: Now it came about that in his turn he was acting as priest before God,

chinese: 照祭司的規矩掣籤，得進主殿燒香。
english: And as was the way of the priests, he had to go into the Temple to see to the burning of perfumes.

chinese: 燒香的時候，眾百姓在外面禱告。
english: And all the people were offering prayers outside, at the time of the burning of perfumes.

chinese: 有主的使者站在香壇的右邊，向他顯現。
english: And he saw an angel of the Lord in his place on the right side of the altar.

chinese: 撒迦利亞看見，就驚慌害怕。
english: And Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear came on him.

chinese: 天使對他說：撒迦利亞，不要害怕，因為你的祈禱已經被聽見了。你的妻子以利沙伯要給你生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫約翰。
english: But the angel said, Have no fear, Zacharias, for your prayer has come to the ears of God, and your wife Elisabeth will have a son, and his name will be John.

chinese: 你必歡喜快樂；有許多人因他出世，也必喜樂。
english: And you will be glad and have great delight; and numbers of people will have joy at his birth.

chinese: 他在主面前將要為大，淡酒濃酒都不喝，從母腹裡就被聖靈充滿了。
english: For he will be great in the eyes of the Lord; he will not take wine or strong drink; and he will be full of the Spirit of God from his birth.

chinese: 他要使許多以色列人回轉，歸於主─他們的神。
english: And through him great numbers of the children of Israel will be turned to the Lord their God.

chinese: 他必有以利亞的心志能力，行在主的前面，叫為父的心轉向兒女，叫悖逆的人轉從義人的智慧，又為主預備合用的百姓。
english: And he will go before his face in the spirit and power of Elijah, turning the hearts of fathers to their children, and wrongdoers to the way of righteousness; to make ready a people whose hearts have been turned to the Lord.

chinese: 撒迦利亞對天使說：我憑著甚麼可知道這事呢？我已經老了，我的妻子也年紀老邁了。
english: And Zacharias said to the angel, How may I be certain of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is far on in years.

chinese: 天使回答說：我是站在神面前的加百列，奉差而來對你說話，將這好信息報給你。
english: And the angel, answering, said, I am Gabriel, whose place is before God; I have been sent to say these words to you and to give you this good news.

chinese: 到了時候，這話必然應驗；只因你不信，你必啞吧，不能說話，直到這事成就的日子。
english: Now, see, you will be without voice or language till the day when these things come about, because you had not faith in my words, which will have effect at the right time.

chinese: 百姓等候撒迦利亞，詫異他許久在殿裡。
english: And the people were waiting for Zacharias and were surprised because he was in the Temple for such a long time.

chinese: 及至他出來，不能和他們說話，他們就知道他在殿裡見了異象；因為他直向他們打手式，竟成了啞吧。
english: And when he came out he was not able to say anything, and they saw that he had seen a vision in the Temple; and he was making signs to them without words.

chinese: 他供職的日子已滿，就回家去了。
english: And when the days of his work in the Temple were ended, he went back to his house.

chinese: 這些日子以後，他的妻子以利沙伯懷了孕，就隱藏了五個月，
english: After that time, Elisabeth, being certain that she was to become a mother, kept herself from men's eyes for five months, saying,

chinese: 說：主在眷顧我的日子，這樣看待我，要把我在人間的羞恥除掉。
english: The Lord has done this to me, for his eyes were on me, to take away my shame in the eyes of men.

chinese: 到了第六個月，天使加百列奉神的差遣往加利利的一座城去，這城名叫拿撒勒，
english: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a town in Galilee, named Nazareth,

chinese: 到一個童女那裡，是已經許配大衛家的一個人，名叫約瑟。童女的名字叫馬利亞；
english: To a virgin who was to be married to a man named Joseph, of the family of David; and the name of the virgin was Mary.

chinese: 天使進去，對他說：蒙大恩的女子，我問你安，主和你同在了！
english: And the angel came in to her and said, Peace be with you, to whom special grace has been given; the Lord is with you.

chinese: 馬利亞因這話就很驚慌，又反復思想這樣問安是甚麼意思。
english: But she was greatly troubled at his words, and said to herself, What may be the purpose of these words?

chinese: 天使對他說：馬利亞，不要怕！你在神面前已經蒙恩了。
english: And the angel said to her, Have no fear, Mary, for you have God's approval.

chinese: 你要懷孕生子，可以給他起名叫耶穌。
english: And see, you will give birth to a son, and his name will be Jesus.

chinese: 他要為大，稱為至高者的兒子；主神要把他祖大衛的位給他。
english: He will be great, and will be named the Son of the Most High: and the Lord God will give him the kingdom of David, his father:

chinese: 他要作雅各家的王，直到永遠；他的國也沒有窮盡。
english: He will have rule over the house of Jacob for ever, and of his kingdom there will be no end.

chinese: 馬利亞對天使說：我沒有出嫁，怎麼有這事呢？
english: And Mary said to the angel, How may this be, because I have had no knowledge of a man?

chinese: 天使回答說：聖靈要臨到你身上，至高者的能力要蔭庇你，因此所要生的聖者必稱為神的兒子（或作：所要生的，必稱為聖，稱為神的兒子）。
english: And the angel in answer said to her, The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will come to rest on you, and so that which will come to birth will be named holy, Son of God.

chinese: 況且你的親戚以利沙伯，在年老的時候也懷了男胎，就是那素來稱為不生育的，現在有孕六個月了。
english: Even now Elisabeth, who is of your family, is to be a mother, though she is old: and this is the sixth month with her who was without children.

chinese: 因為，出於神的話，沒有一句不帶能力的。
english: For there is nothing which God is not able to do.

chinese: 馬利亞說：我是主的使女，情願照你的話成就在我身上。天使就離開他去了。
english: And Mary said: I am the servant of the Lord; may it be to me as you say. And the angel went away.

chinese: 那時候，馬利亞起身，急忙往山地裡去，來到猶大的一座城；
english: Then Mary got up and went quickly into the high lands, to a town of Judah;

chinese: 進了撒迦利亞的家，問以利沙伯安。
english: And went into the house of Zacharias and took Elisabeth in her arms.

chinese: 以利沙伯一聽馬利亞問安，所懷的胎就在腹裡跳動。以利沙伯且被聖靈充滿，
english: And when the voice of Mary came to the ears of Elisabeth, the baby made a sudden move inside her; then Elisabeth was full of the Holy Spirit,

chinese: 高聲喊著說：你在婦女中是有福的！你所懷的胎也是有福的！
english: And she said with a loud voice: May blessing be on you among women, and a blessing on the child of your body.

chinese: 我主的母到我這裡來，這是從那裡得的呢？
english: How is it that the mother of my Lord comes to me?

chinese: 因為你問安的聲音一入我耳，我腹裡的胎就歡喜跳動。
english: For, truly, when the sound of your voice came to my ears, the baby in my body made a sudden move for joy.

chinese: 這相信的女子是有福的！因為主對他所說的話都要應驗。
english: Happy will she be who had faith that the things which the Lord has said to her will be done.

chinese: 馬利亞說：我心尊主為大；
english: And Mary said: My soul gives glory to God;

chinese: 我靈以神我的救主為樂；
english: My spirit is glad in God my Saviour.

chinese: 因為他顧念他使女的卑微；從今以後，萬代要稱我有福。
english: For he has had pity on his servant, though she is poor and lowly placed: and from this hour will all generations give witness to the blessing which has come to me.

chinese: 那有權能的，為我成就了大事；他的名為聖。
english: For he who is strong has done great things for me; and holy is his name.

chinese: 他憐憫敬畏他的人，直到世世代代。
english: His mercy is for all generations in whom is the fear of him.

chinese: 他用膀臂施展大能；那狂傲的人正心裡妄想就被他趕散了。
english: With his arm he has done acts of power; he has put to flight those who have pride in their hearts.

chinese: 他叫有權柄的失位，叫卑賤的升高；
english: He has put down kings from their seats, lifting up on high the men of low degree.

chinese: 叫飢餓的得飽美食，叫富足的空手回去。
english: Those who had no food he made full of good things; the men of wealth he sent away with nothing in their hands;

chinese: 他扶助了他的僕人以色列，
english: His help he has given to Israel, his servant, so that he might keep in mind his mercy to Abraham and his seed for ever,

chinese: 為要記念亞伯拉罕和他的後裔，施憐憫直到永遠，正如從前對我們列祖所說的話。
english: As he gave his word to our fathers.

chinese: 馬利亞和以利沙伯同住，約有三個月，就回家去了。
english: And Mary was with her for about three months and then went back to her house.

chinese: 以利沙伯的產期到了，就生了一個兒子。
english: Now it was time for Elisabeth to give birth, and she had a son.

chinese: 鄰里親族聽見主向他大施憐憫，就和他一同歡樂。
english: And it came to the ears of her neighbours and relations that the Lord had been very good to her, and they took part in her joy.

chinese: 到了第八日，他們來要給孩子行割禮，並要照他父親的名字叫他撒迦利亞。
english: And on the eighth day they came to see to the circumcision of the child, and they would have given him the name of Zacharias, his father's name;

chinese: 他母親說：不可！要叫他約翰。
english: But his mother made answer and said, No, his name is John.

chinese: 他們說：你親族中沒有叫這名字的。
english: And they said, Not one of your relations has that name.

chinese: 他們就向他父親打手式，問他要叫這孩子甚麼名字。
english: And they made signs to his father, to say what name was to be given to him.

chinese: 他要了一塊寫字的板，就寫上，說：他的名字是約翰。他們便都希奇。
english: And he sent for writing materials and put down: His name is John; and they were all surprised.

chinese: 撒迦利亞的口立時開了，舌頭也舒展了，就說出話來，稱頌神。
english: And straight away his mouth was open and his tongue was free and he gave praise to God.

chinese: 周圍居住的人都懼怕；這一切的事就傳遍了猶太的山地。
english: And fear came on all those who were living round about them: and there was much talk about all these things in all the hill-country of Judaea.

chinese: 凡聽見的人都將這事放在心裡，說：這個孩子將來怎麼樣呢？因為有主與他同在。
english: And all who had word of them kept them in their minds and said, What will this child be? For the hand of the Lord was with him.

chinese: 他父親撒迦利亞被聖靈充滿了，就預言說：
english: And his father, Zacharias, was full of the Holy Spirit, and with the voice of a prophet said these words:

chinese: 主─以色列的神是應當稱頌的！因他眷顧他的百姓，為他們施行救贖，
english: Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has come to his people and made them free,

chinese: 在他僕人大衛家中，為我們興起了拯救的角，
english: Lifting up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David,

chinese: 正如主藉著從創世以來聖先知的口所說的話，
english: (As he said, by the mouth of his holy prophets, from the earliest times,)

chinese: 拯救我們脫離仇敵和一切恨我們之人的手，
english: Salvation from those who are against us, and from the hands of those who have hate for us;

chinese: 向我們列祖施憐憫，記念他的聖約─
english: To do acts of mercy to our fathers and to keep in mind his holy word,

chinese: 就是他對我們祖宗亞伯拉罕所起的誓─
english: The oath which he made to Abraham, our father,

chinese: 叫我們既從仇敵手中被救出來，
english: That we, being made free from the fear of those who are against us, might give him worship,

chinese: 就可以終身在他面前，坦然無懼的用聖潔、公義事奉他。
english: In righteousness and holy living before him all our days.

chinese: 孩子阿！你要稱為至高者的先知；因為你要行在主的前面，預備他的道路，
english: And you, child, will be named the prophet of the Most High: you will go before the face of the Lord, to make ready his ways;

chinese: 叫他的百姓因罪得赦，就知道救恩。
english: To give knowledge of salvation to his people, through the forgiveness of sins,

chinese: 因我們神憐憫的心腸，叫清晨的日光從高天臨到我們，
english: Because of the loving mercies of our God, by which the dawn from heaven has come to us,

chinese: 要照亮坐在黑暗中死蔭裡的人，把我們的腳引到平安的路上。
english: To give light to those in dark places, and in the shade of death, so that our feet may be guided into the way of peace.

chinese: 那孩子漸漸長大，心靈強健，住在曠野，直到他顯明在以色列人面前的日子。
english: And the child became tall, and strong in spirit; and he was living in the waste land till the day when he came before the eyes of Israel.

chinese: 當那些日子，該撒亞古士督有旨意下來，叫天下人民都報名上冊。
english: Now it came about in those days that an order went out from Caesar Augustus that there was to be a numbering of all the world.

chinese: 這是居里扭作敘利亞巡撫的時候，頭一次行報名上冊的事。
english: This was the first numbering, which was made when Quirinius was ruler of Syria.

chinese: 眾人各歸各城，報名上冊。
english: And all men went to be numbered, everyone to his town.

chinese: 約瑟也從加利利的拿撒勒城上猶太去，到了大衛的城，名叫伯利恆，因他本是大衛一族一家的人，
english: And Joseph went up from Galilee, out of the town of Nazareth, into Judaea, to Beth-lehem, the town of David, because he was of the house and family of David,

chinese: 要和他所聘之妻馬利亞一同報名上冊。那時馬利亞的身孕已經重了。
english: To be put on the list with Mary, his future wife, who was about to become a mother.

chinese: 他們在那裡的時候，馬利亞的產期到了，
english: And while they were there, the time came for her to give birth.

chinese: 就生了頭胎的兒子，用布包起來，放在馬槽裡，因為客店裡沒有地方。
english: And she had her first son; and folding him in linen, she put him to rest in the place where the cattle had their food, because there was no room for them in the house.

chinese: 在伯利恆之野地裡有牧羊的人，夜間按著更次看守羊群。
english: And in the same country there were keepers of sheep in the fields, watching over their flock by night.

chinese: 有主的使者站在他們旁邊，主的榮光四面照著他們；牧羊的人就甚懼怕。
english: And an angel of the Lord came to them, and the glory of the Lord was shining round about them: and fear came on them.

chinese: 那天使對他們說：不要懼怕！我報給你們大喜的信息，是關乎萬民的；
english: And the angel said, Have no fear; for truly, I give you good news of great joy which will be for all the people:

chinese: 因今天在大衛的城裡，為你們生了救主，就是主基督。
english: For on this day, in the town of David, a Saviour has come to birth, who is Christ the Lord.

chinese: 你們要看見一個嬰孩，包著布，臥在馬槽裡，那就是記號了。
english: And this is the sign to you: you will see a young child folded in linen, in the place where the cattle have their food.

chinese: 忽然，有一大隊天兵同那天使讚美神說：
english: And suddenly there was with the angel a great band of spirits from heaven, giving praise to God, and saying,

chinese: 在至高之處榮耀歸與神！在地上平安歸與他所喜悅的人（有古卷作：喜悅歸與人）！
english: Glory to God in the highest, and on the earth peace among men with whom he is well pleased.

chinese: 眾天使離開他們，升天去了。牧羊的人彼此說：我們往伯利恆去，看看所成的事，就是主所指示我們的。
english: And when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, the keepers of the sheep said to one another, Let us go now to Beth-lehem, and see this thing which has come about, which the Lord has made clear to us.

chinese: 他們急忙去了，就尋見馬利亞和約瑟，又有那嬰孩臥在馬槽裡；
english: And they came quickly, and saw Mary and Joseph, and the child in the place where the cattle had their food.

chinese: 既然看見，就把天使論這孩子的話傳開了。
english: And when they saw it, they gave them an account of the things which had been said to them about the child.

chinese: 凡聽見的，就詫異牧羊之人對他們所說的話。
english: And all those to whose ears it came were full of wonder at the things said by the keepers of the sheep.

chinese: 馬利亞卻把這一切的事存在心裡，反復思想。
english: But Mary kept all these words in her heart, and gave much thought to them.

chinese: 牧羊的人回去了，因所聽見所看見的一切事，正如天使向他們所說的，就歸榮耀與神，讚美他。
english: Then the keepers of the sheep went back, giving glory and praise to God for all the things which had come to their ears and which they had seen, as it had been said to them.

chinese: 滿了八天，就給孩子行割禮，與他起名叫耶穌；這就是沒有成胎以前，天使所起的名。
english: And when, after eight days, the time came for his circumcision, he was named Jesus, the name which the angel had given to him before his birth.

chinese: 按摩西律法滿了潔淨的日子，他們帶著孩子上耶路撒冷去，要把他獻與主。
english: And when the necessary days for making them clean by the law of Moses had come to an end, they took him to Jerusalem to give him to the Lord

chinese: （正如主的律法上所記：凡頭生的男子必稱聖歸主；）
english: (As it says in the law of the Lord, Every mother's first male child is to be holy to the Lord),

chinese: 又要照主的律法上所說，或用一對班鳩，或用兩隻雛鴿獻祭。
english: And to make an offering, as it is ordered in the law of the Lord, of two doves or other young birds.

chinese: 在耶路撒冷有一個人，名叫西面；這人又公義又虔誠，素常盼望以色列的安慰者來到，又有聖靈在他身上。
english: And there was then in Jerusalem a man whose name was Simeon; and he was an upright man, fearing God and waiting for the comfort of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was on him.

chinese: 他得了聖靈的啟示，知道自己未死以前，必看見主所立的基督。
english: And he had knowledge, through the Holy Spirit, that he would not see death till he had seen the Lord's Christ.

chinese: 他受了聖靈的感動，進入聖殿，正遇見耶穌的父母抱著孩子進來，要照律法的規矩辦理。
english: And full of the Spirit he came into the Temple; and when the father and mother came in with the child Jesus, to do with him what was ordered by the law,

chinese: 西面就用手接過他來，稱頌神說：
english: Then he took him in his arms and gave praise to God and said,

chinese: 主阿！如今可以照你的話，釋放僕人安然去世；
english: Now you are letting your servant go in peace, O Lord, as you have said;

chinese: 因為我的眼睛已經看見你的救恩─
english: For my eyes have seen your salvation,

chinese: 就是你在萬民面前所預備的：
english: Which you have made ready before the face of all nations;

chinese: 是照亮外邦人的光，又是你民以色列的榮耀。
english: A light of revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.

chinese: 孩子的父母因這論耶穌的話就希奇。
english: And his father and mother were full of wonder at the things which were said about him.

chinese: 西面給他們祝福，又對孩子的母親馬利亞說：這孩子被立，是要叫以色列中許多人跌倒，許多人興起；又要作毀謗的話柄，叫許多人心裡的意念顯露出來；你自己的心也要被刀刺透。
english: And Simeon gave them his blessing and said to Mary, his mother, See, this child will be the cause of the downfall and the lifting up of great numbers of people in Israel, and he will be a sign against which hard words will be said;
(And a sword will go through your heart;) so that the secret thoughts of men may come to light.

chinese: 又有女先知，名叫亞拿，是亞設支派法內力的女兒，年紀已經老邁，從作童女出嫁的時候，同丈夫住了七年就寡居了，
english: And there was one, Anna, a woman prophet, the daughter of Phanuel, of the family of Asher (she was very old, and after seven years of married life

chinese: 現在已經八十四歲（或作：就寡居了八十四年），並不離開聖殿，禁食祈求，晝夜事奉神。
english: She had been a widow for eighty-four years); she was in the Temple at all times, worshipping with prayers and going without food, night and day.

chinese: 正當那時，他進前來稱謝神，將孩子的事對一切盼望耶路撒冷得救贖的人講說。
english: And coming up at that time, she gave praise to God, talking of him to all those who were waiting for the freeing of Jerusalem.

chinese: 約瑟和馬利亞照主的律法辦完了一切的事，就回加利利，到自己的城拿撒勒去了。
english: And when they had done all the things which were ordered by the law of the Lord, they went back to Galilee, to Nazareth, the town where they were living.

chinese: 孩子漸漸長大，強健起來，充滿智慧，又有神的恩在他身上。
english: And the child became tall and strong and full of wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.

chinese: 每年到逾越節，他父母就上耶路撒冷去。
english: And every year his father and mother went to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

chinese: 當他十二歲的時候，他們按著節期的規矩上去。
english: And when he was twelve years old, they went up, as their way was, to the feast;

chinese: 守滿了節期，他們回去，孩童耶穌仍舊在耶路撒冷。他的父母並不知道，
english: And when the days of the feast came to an end and they were going back, the boy Jesus was still in Jerusalem, but they had no knowledge of it:

chinese: 以為他在同行的人中間，走了一天的路程，就在親族和熟識的人中找他，
english: And in the belief that he was with some of their number, they went a day's journey; and after looking for him among their relations and friends,

chinese: 既找不著，就回耶路撒冷去找他。
english: And seeing that he was not there, they went back to Jerusalem, to make search for him.

chinese: 過了三天，就遇見他在殿裡，坐在教師中間，一面聽，一面問。
english: And after three days they came across him in the Temple, seated among the wise men, giving ear to their words and putting questions to them.

chinese: 凡聽見他的，都希奇他的聰明和他的應對。
english: And all to whose ears it came were full of wonder at his knowledge and the answers which he gave.

chinese: 他父母看見就很希奇。他母親對他說：我兒！為甚麼向我們這樣行呢？看哪！你父親和我傷心來找你！
english: And when they saw him they were surprised, and his mother said to him, Son, why have you done this to us? see, your father and I have been looking for you with sorrow.

chinese: 耶穌說：為甚麼找我呢？豈不知我應當以我父的事為念麼（或作：豈不知我應當在我父的家裡麼）？
english: And he said to them, Why were you looking for me? was it not clear to you that my right place was in my Father's house?

chinese: 他所說的這話，他們不明白。
english: And his words seemed strange to them.

chinese: 他就同他們下去，回到拿撒勒，並且順從他們。他母親把這一切的事都存在心裡。
english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth; and did as he was ordered: and his mother kept all these words in her heart.

chinese: 耶穌的智慧和身量（或作：年紀），並神和人喜愛他的心，都一齊增長。
english: And Jesus was increasing in wisdom and in years, and in grace before God and men.

chinese: 該撒提庇留在位第十五年，本丟彼拉多作猶太巡撫，希律作加利利分封的王，他兄弟腓力作以士利亞和特拉可尼地方分封的王，呂撒聶作亞比利尼分封的王，
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the rule of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being ruler of Judaea, and Herod being king of Galilee, his brother Philip king of the country of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias king of Abilene,

chinese: 亞那和該亞法作大祭司。那時，撒迦利亞的兒子約翰在曠野裡，神的話臨到他。
english: When Annas and Caiaphas were high priests, the word of the Lord came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the waste land.

chinese: 他就來到約但河一帶地方，宣講悔改的洗禮，使罪得赦。
english: And he came into all the country round about Jordan, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.

chinese: 正如先知以賽亞書上所記的話，說：在曠野有人聲喊著說：預備主的道，修直他的路！
english: As it says in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight.

chinese: 一切山窪都要填滿；大小山岡都要削平！彎彎曲曲的地方要改為正直；高高低低的道路要改為平坦！
english: Every valley will be lifted up, and all the mountains and hills made low, and the twisted will be made straight, and the rough ways smooth;

chinese: 凡有血氣的，都要見神的救恩！
english: And all flesh will see the salvation of God.

chinese: 約翰對那出來要受他洗的眾人說：毒蛇的種類！誰指示你們逃避將來的忿怒呢？
english: So he said to the people who went out to him for baptism: You offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?

chinese: 你們要結出果子來，與悔改的心相稱。不要自己心裡說：有亞伯拉罕為我們的祖宗。我告訴你們，神能從這些石頭中，給亞伯拉罕興起子孫來。
english: Make clear by your acts that your hearts have been changed; and do not say to yourselves, We have Abraham for our father: for I say to you that God is able from these stones to make children of Abraham.

chinese: 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裡。
english: And even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; and every tree which does not have good fruit will be cut down and put into the fire.

chinese: 眾人問他說：這樣，我們當作甚麼呢？
english: And the people put questions to him, saying, What have we to do?

chinese: 約翰回答說：有兩件衣裳的，就分給那沒有的；有食物的，也當這樣行。
english: And he made answer and said to them, He who has two coats, let him give to him who has not even one; and he who has food, let him do the same.

chinese: 又有稅吏來要受洗，問他說：夫子，我們當作甚麼呢？
english: Then tax-farmers came to him for baptism and said to him, Master, what have we to do?

chinese: 約翰說：除了例定的數目，不要多取。
english: And he said to them, Do not make an attempt to get more money than the right amount.

chinese: 又有兵丁問他說：我們當作甚麼呢？約翰說：不要以強暴待人，也不要訛詐人，自己有錢糧就當知足。
english: And men of the army put questions to him, saying, And what have we to do? And he said to them, Do no violent acts to any man, and do not take anything without right, and let your payment be enough for you.

chinese: 百姓指望基督來的時候，人都心裡猜疑，或者約翰是基督。
english: And while the people were waiting, and all men were questioning in their hearts about John, if he was the Christ or not,

chinese: 約翰說：我是用水給你們施洗，但有一位能力比我更大的要來，我就是給他解鞋帶也不配。他要用聖靈與火給你們施洗。
english: John made answer, saying to them all, Truly, I give you baptism with water, but one is coming who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo: he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit, and with fire:

chinese: 他手裡拿著簸箕，要揚淨他的場，把麥子收在倉裡，把糠用不滅的火燒盡了。
english: In whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned in the fire which will never be put out.

chinese: 約翰又用許多別的話勸百姓，向他們傳福音。
english: And so comforting them with these and other words, he gave the good news to the people;

chinese: 只是分封的王希律，因他兄弟之妻希羅底的緣故，並因他所行的一切惡事，受了約翰的責備；
english: But Herod the king, because John had made a protest on account of Herodias, his brother's wife, and other evil things which Herod had done,

chinese: 又另外添了一件，就是把約翰收在監裡。
english: Did this most evil thing of all, and had John shut up in prison.

chinese: 眾百姓都受了洗，耶穌也受了洗。正禱告的時候，天就開了，
english: Now it came about that when all the people had been given baptism, Jesus, having had baptism with them, was in prayer, when, the heaven being open,

chinese: 聖靈降臨在他身上，形狀彷彿鴿子；又有聲音從天上來，說：你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。
english: The Holy Spirit came down in the form of a dove, and a voice came from heaven, saying, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

chinese: 耶穌開頭傳道，年紀約有三十歲。依人看來，他是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是希里的兒子；
english: And Jesus at this time was about thirty years old, being the son (as it seemed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

chinese: 希里是瑪塔的兒子；瑪塔是利未的兒子；利未是麥基的兒子；麥基是雅拿的兒子；雅拿是約瑟的兒子；
english: The son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

chinese: 約瑟是瑪他提亞的兒子；瑪他提亞是亞摩斯的兒子；亞摩斯是拿鴻的兒子；拿鴻是以斯利的兒子；以斯利是拿該的兒子；
english: The son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

chinese: 拿該是瑪押的兒子；瑪押是瑪他提亞的兒子；瑪他提亞是西美的兒子；西美是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是猶大的兒子；猶大是約亞拿的兒子；
english: The son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,

chinese: 約亞拿是利撒的兒子；利撒是所羅巴伯的兒子；所羅巴伯是撒拉鐵的兒子；撒拉鐵是尼利的兒子；尼利是麥基的兒子；
english: The son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

chinese: 麥基是亞底的兒子；亞底是哥桑的兒子；哥桑是以摩當的兒子；以摩當是珥的兒子；珥是約細的兒子；
english: The son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,

chinese: 約細是以利以謝的兒子；以利以謝是約令的兒子；約令是瑪塔的兒子；瑪塔是利未的兒子；
english: The son of Jesus, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

chinese: 利未是西緬的兒子；西緬是猶大的兒子；猶大是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是約南的兒子；約南是以利亞敬的兒子；
english: The son of Symeon, the son of Judas, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,

chinese: 以利亞敬是米利亞的兒子；米利亞是買南的兒子；買南是瑪達他的兒子；瑪達他是拿單的兒子；拿單是大衛的兒子；
english: The son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

chinese: 大衛是耶西的兒子；耶西是俄備得的兒子；俄備得是波阿斯的兒子；波阿斯是撒門的兒子；撒門是拿順的兒子；
english: The son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

chinese: 拿順是亞米拿達的兒子；亞米拿達是亞蘭的兒子；亞蘭是希斯崙的兒子；希斯崙是法勒斯的兒子；法勒斯是猶大的兒子；
english: The son of Amminadab, the son of Arni, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

chinese: 猶大是雅各的兒子；雅各是以撒的兒子；以撒是亞伯拉罕的兒子；亞伯拉罕是他拉的兒子；他拉是拿鶴的兒子；
english: The son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

chinese: 拿鶴是西鹿的兒子；西鹿是拉吳的兒子；拉吳是法勒的兒子；法勒是希伯的兒子；希伯是沙拉的兒子；
english: The son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

chinese: 沙拉是該南的兒子；該南是亞法撒的兒子；亞法撒是閃的兒子；閃是挪亞的兒子；挪亞是拉麥的兒子；
english: The son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

chinese: 拉麥是瑪土撒拉的兒子；瑪土撒拉是以諾的兒子；以諾是雅列的兒子；雅列是瑪勒列的兒子；瑪勒列是該南的兒子；該南是以挪士的兒子；
english: The son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

chinese: 以挪士是塞特的兒子；塞特是亞當的兒子；亞當是神的兒子。
english: The son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

chinese: 耶穌被聖靈充滿，從約但河回來，聖靈將他引到曠野，四十天受魔鬼的試探。
english: And Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, came back from the Jordan, and was guided by the Spirit in the waste land

chinese: 那些日子沒有吃甚麼；日子滿了，他就餓了。
english: For forty days, being tested by the Evil One. And he had no food in those days; and when they came to an end, he was in need of food.

chinese: 魔鬼對他說：你若是神的兒子，可以吩咐這塊石頭變成食物。
english: And the Evil One said to him, If you are the Son of God, give orders to this stone to become bread.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：經上記著說：人活著不是單靠食物，乃是靠神口裡所出的一切話。
english: And Jesus made answer to him, It has been said in the Writings, Bread is not man's only need.

chinese: 魔鬼又領他上了高山，霎時間把天下的萬國都指給他看，
english: And he took him up and let him see all the kingdoms of the earth in a minute of time.

chinese: 對他說：這一切權柄、榮華，我都要給你，因為這原是交付我的，我願意給誰就給誰。
english: And the Evil One said, I will give you authority over all these, and the glory of them, for it has been given to me, and I give it to anyone at my pleasure.

chinese: 你若在我面前下拜，這都要歸你。
english: If then you will give worship to me, it will all be yours.

chinese: 耶穌說：經上記著說：當拜主─你的神，單要事奉他。
english: And Jesus in answer said to him, It has been said in the Writings, Give worship to the Lord your God, and be his servant only.

chinese: 魔鬼又領他到耶路撒冷去，叫他站在殿頂（頂：原文是翅）上，對他說：你若是神的兒子，可以從這裡跳下去；
english: And he took him to Jerusalem and put him on the highest point of the Temple and said to him, If you are the Son of God, let yourself go down from here; for it is said in the Writings,

chinese: 因為經上記著說：主要為你吩咐他的使者保護你；
english: He will give his angels orders to take care of you:

chinese: 他們要用手托著你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。
english: And, In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：經上說：不可試探主─你的神。
english: And Jesus made answer and said to him, It is said in the Writings, You may not put the Lord your God to the test.

chinese: 魔鬼用完了各樣的試探，就暫時離開耶穌。
english: And when all these tests were ended the Evil One went away from him for a time.

chinese: 耶穌滿有聖靈的能力，回到加利利；他的名聲就傳遍了四方。
english: And Jesus came back to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news of him went through all the country round about.

chinese: 他在各會堂裡教訓人，眾人都稱讚他。
english: And he was teaching in their Synagogues and all men gave him praise.

chinese: 耶穌來到拿撒勒，就是他長大的地方。在安息日，照他平常的規矩進了會堂，站起來要念聖經。
english: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been as a child, and he went, as his way was, into the Synagogue on the Sabbath, and got up to give a reading.

chinese: 有人把先知以賽亞的書交給他，他就打開，找到一處寫著說：
english: And the book of the prophet Isaiah was given to him and, opening the book, he came on the place where it is said,

chinese: 主的靈在我身上，因為他用膏膏我，叫我傳福音給貧窮的人；差遣我報告：被擄的得釋放，瞎眼的得看見，叫那受壓制的得自由，
english: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because I am marked out by him to give good news to the poor; he has sent me to make well those who are broken-hearted; to say that the prisoners will be let go, and the blind will see, and to make the wounded free from their chains,

chinese: 報告神悅納人的禧年。
english: To give knowledge that the year of the Lord's good pleasure is come.

chinese: 於是把書捲起來，交還執事，就坐下。會堂裡的人都定睛看他。
english: And shutting the book he gave it back to the servant and took his seat: and the eyes of all in the Synagogue were fixed on him.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：今天這經應驗在你們耳中了。
english: Then he said to them, Today this word has come true in your hearing.

chinese: 眾人都稱讚他，並希奇他口中所出的恩言；又說：這不是約瑟的兒子麼？
english: And they were all giving witness, with wonder, to the words of grace which came from his mouth: and they said, Is not this the son of Joseph?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們必引這俗語向我說：醫生，你醫治自己罷！我們聽見你在迦百農所行的事，也當行在你自己家鄉裡；
english: And he said to them, Without doubt you will say to me, Let the medical man make himself well: the things which to our knowledge were done at Capernaum, do them here in your country.

chinese: 又說：我實在告訴你們，沒有先知在自己家鄉被人悅納的。
english: And he said to them, Truly I say to you, No prophet is honoured in his country.

chinese: 我對你們說實話，當以利亞的時候，天閉塞了三年零六個月，遍地有大饑荒，那時，以色列中有許多寡婦，
english: Truly I say to you, There were a number of widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up for three years and six months and there was no food in the land;

chinese: 以利亞並沒有奉差往他們一個人那裡去，只奉差往西頓的撒勒法一個寡婦那裡去。
english: But Elijah was not sent to one of them, but only to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

chinese: 先知以利沙的時候，以色列中有許多長大痲瘋的，但內中除了敘利亞國的乃縵，沒有一個得潔淨的。
english: And there were a number of lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, and not one of them was made clean, but only Naaman the Syrian.

chinese: 會堂裡的人聽見這話，都怒氣滿胸，
english: And all who were in the Synagogue were very angry when these things were said to them.

chinese: 就起來攆他出城，他們的城造在山上；他們帶他到山崖，要把他推下去。
english: And they got up and took him out of the town to the edge of the mountain on which their town was, so that they might send him down to his death.

chinese: 他卻從他們中間直行，過去了。
english: But he came through them and went on his way.

chinese: 耶穌下到迦百農，就是加利利的一座城，在安息日教訓眾人。
english: And he came down to Capernaum, a town of Galilee; and he was giving them teaching on the Sabbath.

chinese: 他們很希奇他的教訓，因為他的話裡有權柄。
english: And they were surprised at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

chinese: 在會堂裡有一個人，被污鬼的精氣附著，大聲喊叫說：
english: And there was a man in the Synagogue who had an unclean spirit; and he gave a loud cry and said,

chinese: 唉！拿撒勒的耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們麼？我知道你是誰，乃是神的聖者。
english: Let us be! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? have you come to put an end to us? I have knowledge who you are, the Holy One of God.

chinese: 耶穌責備他說：不要作聲，從這人身上出來罷！鬼把那人摔倒在眾人中間，就出來了，卻也沒有害他。
english: And Jesus said to him, Be quiet, and come out of him. And when the evil spirit had put him down on the earth in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no damage.

chinese: 眾人都驚訝，彼此對問說：這是甚麼道理呢？因為他用權柄能力吩咐污鬼，污鬼就出來。
english: And wonder came on them all and they said to one another, What are these words? for with authority and power he gives orders to the evil spirits and they come out.

chinese: 於是耶穌的名聲傳遍了周圍地方。
english: And there was much talk about him in all the places round about.

chinese: 耶穌出了會堂，進了西門的家。西門的岳母害熱病甚重，有人為他求耶穌。
english: And he got up and went out of the Synagogue and went into the house of Simon. And Simon's wife's mother was very ill with a burning heat; and in answer to their prayers for her

chinese: 耶穌站在他旁邊，斥責那熱病，熱就退了。他立刻起來服事他們。
english: He went near her, and with a sharp word he gave orders to the disease and it went away from her; and straight away she got up and took care of their needs.

chinese: 日落的時候，凡有病人的，不論害甚麼病，都帶到耶穌那裡。耶穌按手在他們各人身上，醫好他們。
english: And at sundown all those who had anyone ill with any sort of disease, took them to him, and he put his hands on every one of them and made them well.

chinese: 又有鬼從好些人身上出來，喊著說：你是神的兒子。耶穌斥責他們，不許他們說話。因為他們知道他是基督。
english: And evil spirits came out of a number of them, crying out and saying, You are the Son of God. But he gave them sharp orders not to say a word, because they had knowledge that he was the Christ.

chinese: 天亮的時候，耶穌出來，走到曠野地方。眾人去找他，到了他那裡，要留住他，不要他離開他們。
english: And when it was day, he came out and went to a waste place; and great numbers of people came looking for him, and they came to him and would have kept him from going away.

chinese: 但耶穌對他們說：我也必須在別城傳神國的福音，因我奉差原是為此。
english: But he said to them, I have to give the good news of the kingdom of God in other towns, because that is why I was sent.

chinese: 於是耶穌在加利利的各會堂傳道。
english: And he was teaching in the Synagogues of Galilee.

chinese: 耶穌站在革尼撒勒湖邊，眾人擁擠他，要聽神的道。
english: Now it came about that while the people came pushing to be near him, and to have knowledge of the word of God, he was by a wide stretch of water named Gennesaret;

chinese: 他見有兩隻船灣在湖邊；打魚的人卻離開船洗網去了。
english: And he saw two boats by the edge of the water, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

chinese: 有一隻船是西門的，耶穌就上去，請他把船撐開，稍微離岸，就坐下，從船上教訓眾人。
english: And he got into one of the boats, the property of Simon, and made a request to him to go a little way out from the land. And being seated he gave the people teaching from the boat.

chinese: 講完了，對西門說：把船開到水深之處，下網打魚。
english: And when his talk was ended, he said to Simon, Go out into deep water, and let down your nets for fish.

chinese: 西門說：夫子，我們整夜勞力，並沒有打著甚麼。但依從你的話，我就下網。
english: And Simon, answering, said, Master, we were working all night and we took nothing: but at your word I will let down the nets.

chinese: 他們下了網，就圈住許多魚，網險些裂開，
english: And when they had done this, they got such a great number of fish that it seemed as if their nets would be broken;

chinese: 便招呼那隻船上的同伴來幫助。他們就來，把魚裝滿了兩隻船，甚至船要沉下去。
english: And they made signs to their friends in the other boat to come to their help. And they came, and the two boats were so full that they were going down.

chinese: 西門彼得看見，就俯伏在耶穌膝前，說：主阿！離開我，我是個罪人！
english: But Simon, when he saw it, went down at the knees of Jesus and said, Go away from me, O Lord, for I am a sinner.

chinese: 他和一切同在的人都驚訝這一網所打的魚。
english: For he was full of wonder and so were all those who were with him, at the number of fish which they had taken;

chinese: 他的夥伴西庇太的兒子雅各、約翰，也是這樣。耶穌對西門說：不要怕！從今以後，你要得人了。
english: And so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were working with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, Have no fear; from this time forward you will be a fisher of men.

chinese: 他們把兩隻船攏了岸，就撇下所有的，跟從了耶穌。
english: And when they had got their boats to the land, they gave up everything and went after him.

chinese: 有一回，耶穌在一個城裡，有人滿身長了大痲瘋，看見他，就俯伏在地，求他說：主若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。
english: And it came about that while he was in one of the towns, there was a leper there: and when he saw Jesus he went down on his face in prayer to him, saying, Lord, if it is your pleasure, you have power to make me clean.

chinese: 耶穌伸手摸他，說：我肯，你潔淨了罷！大痲瘋立刻就離了他的身。
english: And he put out his hand to him and said, It is my pleasure; be clean. And straight away his disease went from him.

chinese: 耶穌囑咐他：你切不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又要為你得了潔淨，照摩西所吩咐的獻上禮物，對眾人作證據。
english: And he gave him orders: Say nothing to any man, but let the priest see you and give an offering so that you may be made clean, as the law of Moses says, and for a witness to them.

chinese: 但耶穌的名聲越發傳揚出去。有極多的人聚集來聽道，也指望醫治他們的病。
english: But news of him went out all the more, in every direction, and great numbers of people came together to give hearing to his words and to be made well from their diseases.

chinese: 耶穌卻退到曠野去禱告。
english: But he went away by himself to a waste place for prayer.

chinese: 有一天，耶穌教訓人，有法利賽人和教法師在旁邊坐著；他們是從加利利各鄉村和猶太並耶路撒冷來的。主的能力與耶穌同在，使他能醫治病人。
english: And it came about that on one of these days he was teaching; and some Pharisees and teachers of the law were seated there, who had come from every town of Galilee and Judaea and from Jerusalem; and the power of the Lord was with him, to make those who were ill free from their diseases.

chinese: 有人用褥子抬著一個癱子，要抬進去放在耶穌面前，
english: And some men had with them, on a bed, a man who was ill, without power of moving; and they made attempts to get him in and put him before Jesus.

chinese: 卻因人多，尋不出法子抬進去，就上了房頂，從瓦間把他連褥子縋到當中，正在耶穌面前。
english: And because of the mass of people, there was no way to get him in; so they went up on the top of the house and let him down through the roof, on his bed, into the middle in front of Jesus.

chinese: 耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：你的罪赦了。
english: And seeing their faith he said, Man, you have forgiveness for your sins.

chinese: 文士和法利賽人就議論說：這說僭妄話的是誰？除了神以外，誰能赦罪呢？
english: And the scribes and Pharisees were having an argument, saying, Who is this, who has no respect for God? who is able to give forgiveness for sins, but God only?

chinese: 耶穌知道他們所議論的，就說：你們心裡議論的是甚麼呢？
english: But Jesus, who had knowledge of their thoughts, said to them, Why are you reasoning in your hearts?

chinese: 或說你的罪赦了，或說你起來行走，那一樣容易呢？
english: Which is the simpler: to say, You have forgiveness for your sins; or to say, Get up and go?

chinese: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄。就對癱子說：我吩咐你，起來，拿你的褥子回家去罷！
english: But so that you may see that on earth the Son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins, (he said to the man who was ill,) I say to you, Get up, and take up your bed, and go into your house.

chinese: 那人當眾人面前立刻起來，拿著他所躺臥的褥子回家去，歸榮耀與神。
english: And straight away he got up before them, and took up his bed and went away to his house giving praise to God.

chinese: 眾人都驚奇，也歸榮耀與神，並且滿心懼怕，說：我們今日看見非常的事了。
english: And wonder overcame them all, and they gave glory to God; and they were full of fear, saying, We have seen strange things today.

chinese: 這事以後，耶穌出去，看見一個稅吏，名叫利未，坐在稅關上，就對他說：你跟從我來。
english: And after these things he went out, and saw Levi, a tax-farmer, seated at the place where taxes were taken, and said to him, Come after me.

chinese: 他就撇下所有的，起來，跟從了耶穌。
english: And giving up his business, he got up and went after him.

chinese: 利未在自己家裡為耶穌大擺筵席，有許多稅吏和別人與他們一同坐席。
english: And Levi made a great feast for him in his house: and a great number of tax-farmers and others were seated at table with them.

chinese: 法利賽人和文士就向耶穌的門徒發怨言說：你們為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同吃喝呢？
english: And the Pharisees and their scribes made protests against his disciples, saying, Why do you take food and drink with tax-farmers and sinners?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：無病的人用不著醫生；有病的人才用得著。
english: And Jesus, answering, said to them, Those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill.

chinese: 我來本不是召義人悔改，乃是召罪人悔改。
english: I have come, not to get the upright, but sinners, so that they may be turned from their sins.

chinese: 他們說：約翰的門徒屢次禁食祈禱，法利賽人的門徒也是這樣；惟獨你的門徒又吃又喝。
english: And they said to him, The disciples of John frequently go without food, and make prayers, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees; but your disciples take food and drink.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，豈能叫陪伴之人禁食呢？
english: And Jesus said, Are you able to make the friends of the newly-married man go without food when he is with them?

chinese: 但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那日他們就要禁食了。
english: But the days will come when he will be taken away from them, and then they will go without food.

chinese: 耶穌又設一個比喻，對他們說：沒有人把新衣服撕下一塊來補在舊衣服上；若是這樣，就把新的撕破了，並且所撕下來的那塊新的和舊的也不相稱。
english: And he said to them, in a story, No man takes a bit of cloth from a new coat and puts it on to an old coat, for so the new coat would be damaged and the bit from the new would not go well with the old.

chinese: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裡；若是這樣，新酒必將皮袋裂開，酒便漏出來，皮袋也就壞了。
english: And no man puts new wine into old wine-skins, for fear that the skins will be burst by the new wine, and the wine be let out, and the skins come to destruction.

chinese: 但新酒必須裝在新皮袋裡。
english: But new wine has to be put into new wine-skins.

chinese: 沒有人喝了陳酒又想喝新的；他總說陳的好。
english: And no man, having had old wine, has any desire for new, for he says, The old is better.

chinese: 有一個安息日，耶穌從麥地經過。他的門徒掐了麥穗，用手搓著吃。
english: Now it came about that on the Sabbath he was going through the fields of grain, and his disciples took the heads of the grain for food, crushing them in their hands.

chinese: 有幾個法利賽人說：你們為甚麼作安息日不可作的事呢？
english: But some of the Pharisees said, Why do you do what it is not right to do on the Sabbath?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：經上記著大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所作的事，連這個你們也沒有念過麼？
english: And Jesus said, Have you not seen in the Writings what David did when he was in need of food, he, and those who were with him;

chinese: 他怎麼進了神的殿，拿陳設餅吃，又給跟從的人吃？這餅除了祭司以外，別人都不可吃。
english: How he went into the house of God and took for food the holy bread, which only the priests may take, and gave it to those who were with him?

chinese: 又對他們說：人子是安息日的主。
english: And he said, The Son of man is lord even of the Sabbath.

chinese: 又有一個安息日，耶穌進了會堂教訓人，在那裡有一個人右手枯乾了。
english: And it came about, on another Sabbath, that he went into the Synagogue and was teaching there. And a man was there whose right hand was dead.

chinese: 文士和法利賽人窺探耶穌，在安息日治病不治病，要得把柄去告他。
english: And the scribes and Pharisees were watching him to see if he would make him well on the Sabbath, so that they might be able to say something against him.

chinese: 耶穌卻知道他們的意念，就對那枯乾一隻手的人說：起來！站在當中。那人就起來，站著。
english: But he had knowledge of their thoughts; and he said to the man whose hand was dead, Get up and come into the middle. And he got up and came forward.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：我問你們，在安息日行善行惡，救命害命，那樣是可以的呢？
english: And Jesus said, I put the question to you, Is it right to do good on the Sabbath or to do evil? to give life or to take it away?

chinese: 他就周圍看著他們眾人，對那人說：伸出手來！他把手一伸，手就復了原。
english: And looking round on all of them, he said to him, Put out your hand. And he did so: and his hand was made well.

chinese: 他們就滿心大怒，彼此商議怎樣處治耶穌。
english: But they were full of wrath, and were talking together about what they might do to Jesus.

chinese: 那時，耶穌出去，上山禱告，整夜禱告神；
english: And it came about in those days that he went out to the mountain for prayer; and he was all night in prayer to God.

chinese: 到了天亮，叫他的門徒來，就從他們中間挑選十二個人，稱他們為使徒。
english: And the day came and, turning to his disciples, he made a selection from among them of twelve, to whom he gave the name of Apostles;

chinese: 這十二個人有西門，耶穌又給他起名叫彼得，還有他兄弟安得烈，又有雅各和約翰，腓力和巴多羅買，
english: Simon, to whom he gave the name of Peter, and Andrew, his brother, and James and John and Philip and Bartholomew

chinese: 馬太和多馬，亞勒腓的兒子雅各和奮銳黨的西門，
english: And Matthew and Thomas and James, the son of Alphaeus, and Simon, who was named the Zealot,

chinese: 雅各的兒子（或作：兄弟）猶大，和賣主的加略人猶大。
english: And Judas, the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, he who was false to him.

chinese: 耶穌和他們下了山，站在一塊平地上；同站的有許多門徒，又有許多百姓，從猶太全地和耶路撒冷，並推羅、西頓的海邊來，都要聽他講道，又指望醫治他們的病；
english: And he came down with them to a level place, and a great band of his disciples, and a very great number of people from all Judaea and Jerusalem and from the parts of Tyre and Sidon by the sea, came to give hearing to him, and to be made well from their diseases;

chinese: 還有被污鬼纏磨的，也得了醫治。
english: And those who were troubled with unclean spirits were made well.

chinese: 眾人都想要摸他；因為有能力從他身上發出來，醫好了他們。
english: And all the people were desiring to be touched by him, for power came from him and made them all well.

chinese: 耶穌舉目看著門徒，說：你們貧窮的人有福了！因為神的國是你們的。
english: And turning his eyes to his disciples he said, Happy are you who are poor: for the kingdom of God is yours.

chinese: 你們飢餓的人有福了！因為你們將要飽足。你們哀哭的人有福了！因為你們將要喜笑。
english: Happy are you who are in need of food now: for you will be made full. Happy are you who are weeping now; for you will be glad.

chinese: 人為人子恨惡你們，拒絕你們，辱罵你們，棄掉你們的名，以為是惡，你們就有福了！
english: Happy are you, when men have hate for you, and put you away from among them and say angry words to you, turning away in disgust at your name, because of the Son of man.

chinese: 當那日，你們要歡喜跳躍，因為你們在天上的賞賜是大的。他們的祖宗待先知也是這樣。
english: Be glad in that day, and be lifted up for joy, for your reward in heaven will be great: for their fathers did these same things to the prophets.

chinese: 但你們富足的人有禍了！因為你們受過你們的安慰。
english: But unhappy are you who have wealth: for you have been comforted now.

chinese: 你們飽足的人有禍了！因為你們將要飢餓。你們喜笑的人有禍了！因為你們將要哀慟哭泣。
english: Unhappy are you who are full of food now: for you will be in need. Unhappy are you who are laughing now: for you will be crying in sorrow.

chinese: 人都說你們好的時候，你們就有禍了！因為他們的祖宗待假先知也是這樣。
english: Unhappy are you when all men give you their approval: for so their fathers did to the false prophets.

chinese: 只是我告訴你們這聽道的人，你們的仇敵，要愛他！恨你們的，要待他好！
english: But I say to you who give ear to me, Have love for those who are against you, do good to those who have hate for you,

chinese: 咒詛你們的，要為他祝福！凌辱你們的，要為他禱告！
english: Give blessing to those who give you curses, say prayers for those who are cruel to you.

chinese: 有人打你這邊的臉，連那邊的臉也由他打。有人奪你的外衣，連裡衣也由他拿去。
english: If a man gives you a blow on one side of your face, then let the other side be turned to him; from him who takes away your coat, do not keep back your robe.

chinese: 凡求你的，就給他。有人奪你的東西去，不用再要回來。
english: Give to everyone who comes with a request, and if a man takes away your property, make no attempt to get it back again.

chinese: 你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人。
english: Do to others as you would have them do to you.

chinese: 你們若單愛那愛你們的人，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也愛那愛他們的人。
english: If you have love for those who have love for you, what credit is it to you? for even sinners have love for those who have love for them.

chinese: 你們若善待那善待你們的人，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也是這樣行。
english: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is it to you? for even sinners do the same.

chinese: 你們若借給人，指望從他收回，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也借給罪人，要如數收回。
english: And if you let those have the use of your money, from whom you are hoping to get it back, what credit is it to you? even sinners do so to sinners, hoping to get back as much as they gave.

chinese: 你們倒要愛仇敵，也要善待他們，並要借給人不指望償還，你們的賞賜就必大了，你們也必作至高者的兒子；因為他恩待那忘恩的和作惡的。
english: But be loving to those who are against you and do them good, and give them your money, not giving up hope, and your reward will be great and you will be the sons of the Most High: for he is kind to evil men, and to those who have hard hearts.

chinese: 你們要慈悲，像你們的父慈悲一樣。
english: Be full of pity, even as your Father is full of pity.

chinese: 你們不要論斷人，就不被論斷；你們不要定人的罪，就不被定罪；你們要饒恕人，就必蒙饒恕（饒恕：原文作釋放）；
english: Be not judges of others, and you will not be judged: do not give punishment to others, and you will not get punishment yourselves: make others free, and you will be made free:

chinese: 你們要給人，就必有給你們的，並且用十足的升斗，連搖帶按，上尖下流的倒在你們懷裡；因為你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。
english: Give, and it will be given to you; good measure, crushed down, full and running over, they will give to you. For in the same measure as you give, it will be given to you again.

chinese: 耶穌又用比喻對他們說：瞎子豈能領瞎子，兩個人不是都要掉在坑裡麼？
english: And he gave them teaching in the form of a story, saying, Is it possible for one blind man to be guide to another? will they not go falling together into a hole?

chinese: 學生不能高過先生；凡學成了的不過和先生一樣。
english: The disciple is not greater than his master, but everyone whose learning is complete will be like his master.

chinese: 為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中有刺，卻不想自己眼中有梁木呢？
english: And why do you take note of the grain of dust in your brother's eye, but take no note of the bit of wood which is in your eye?

chinese: 你不見自己眼中有梁木，怎能對你弟兄說：容我去掉你眼中的刺呢？你這假冒為善的人！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，然後才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。
english: How will you say to your brother, Brother, let me take the grain of dust out of your eye, when you yourself do not see the bit of wood in your eye? O false one! first take the wood out of your eye and then you will see clearly to take the dust out of your brother's eye.

chinese: 因為，沒有好樹結壞果子，也沒有壞樹結好果子。
english: For no good tree gives bad fruit, and no bad tree gives good fruit.

chinese: 凡樹木看果子，就可以認出他來。人不是從荊棘上摘無花果，也不是從蒺藜裡摘葡萄。
english: For every tree is judged by its fruit. Men do not get figs from thorns, or grapes from blackberry plants.

chinese: 善人從他心裡所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他心裡所存的惡就發出惡來；因為心裡所充滿的，口裡就說出來。
english: The good man, out of the good store of his heart, gives good things; and the evil man, out of his evil store, gives evil: for out of the full store of the heart come the words of the mouth.

chinese: 你們為甚麼稱呼我主阿，主阿，卻不遵我的話行呢？
english: Why do you say to me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

chinese: 凡到我這裡來，聽見我的話就去行的，我要告訴你們他像甚麼人：
english: Everyone who comes to me and gives ear to my words and does them, I will make clear to you what he is like:

chinese: 他像一個人蓋房子，深深的挖地，把根基安在磐石上；到發大水的時候，水沖那房子，房子總不能搖動，因為根基立在磐石上（有古卷：因為蓋造得好）。
english: He is like a man building a house, who went deep and put the base of it on a rock; and when the water came up and the river was driving against that house, it was not moved, because the building was good.

chinese: 惟有聽見不去行的，就像一個人在土地上蓋房子，沒有根基；水一沖，隨即倒塌了，並且那房子壞的很大。
english: But he who gives hearing, without doing, is like a man building a house on the earth without a base for it; and when the force of the river came against it, straight away it came down; and the destruction of that house was great.

chinese: 耶穌對百姓講完了這一切的話，就進了迦百農。
english: After he had come to the end of all his words in the hearing of the people, he went into Capernaum.

chinese: 有一個百夫長所寶貴的僕人害病，快要死了。
english: And a certain captain had a servant who was very dear to him; this servant was ill and near to death.

chinese: 百夫長風聞耶穌的事，就託猶太人的幾個長老去求耶穌來救他的僕人。
english: And when news of Jesus came to his ears, he sent to him rulers of the Jews, requesting that he would come and make his servant well.

chinese: 他們到了耶穌那裡，就切切的求他說：你給他行這事是他所配得的；
english: And they, when they came to Jesus, made their request warmly, saying,

chinese: 因為他愛我們的百姓，給我們建造會堂。
english: It is right for you to do this for him, because he is a friend to our nation, and himself has put up a Synagogue for us.

chinese: 耶穌就和他們同去。離那家不遠，百夫長託幾個朋友去見耶穌，對他說：主阿！不要勞動；因你到我舍下，我不敢當。
english: And Jesus went with them. And when he was not far from the house, the man sent friends to him, saying, Lord, do not give yourself trouble: for I am not important enough for you to come into my house:

chinese: 我也自以為不配去見你，只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必好了。
english: And I had the feeling that I was not even good enough to come to you: but say the word only, and my servant will be well.

chinese: 因為我在人的權下，也有兵在我以下，對這個說：去！他就去；對那個說：來！他就來；對我的僕人說：你作這事！他就去作。
english: For I, myself, am a man under authority, having men under me; and I say to this one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.

chinese: 耶穌聽見這話，就希奇他，轉身對跟隨的眾人說：我告訴你們，這麼大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也沒有遇見過。
english: And when these things were said to Jesus, he was surprised, and, turning to the mass of people coming after him, said, I have not seen such great faith, no, not in Israel.

chinese: 那託來的人回到百夫長家裡，看見僕人已經好了。
english: And when those who were sent came back to the house they saw that the servant was well.

chinese: 過了不多時（有古卷：次日），耶穌往一座城去，這城名叫拿因，他的門徒和極多的人與他同行。
english: And it came about, after a little time, that he went to a town named Nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great number of people.

chinese: 將近城門，有一個死人被抬出來。這人是他母親獨生的兒子；他母親又是寡婦。有城裡的許多人同著寡婦送殯。
english: Now when he came near the door of the town, a dead man was being taken out, the only son of his mother, who was a widow: and a great number of people from the town were with her.

chinese: 主看見那寡婦，就憐憫他，對他說：不要哭！
english: And when the Lord saw her, he had pity on her and said to her, Be not sad.

chinese: 於是進前按著槓，抬的人就站住了。耶穌說：少年人，我吩咐你，起來！
english: And he came near, and put his hand on the stretcher where the dead man was: and those who were moving it came to a stop. And he said, Young man, I say to you, Get up.

chinese: 那死人就坐起，並且說話。耶穌便把他交給他母親。
english: And the dead man got up, and words came from his lips. And he gave him to his mother.

chinese: 眾人都驚奇，歸榮耀與神，說：有大先知在我們中間興起來了！又說：神眷顧了他的百姓！
english: And fear came on all, and they gave praise to God, saying, A great prophet is among us: and, God has given thought to his people.

chinese: 他這事的風聲就傳遍了猶太和周圍地方。
english: And this story about him went through all Judaea and the places round about.

chinese: 約翰的門徒把這些事都告訴約翰。
english: And the disciples of John gave him an account of all these things.

chinese: 他便叫了兩個門徒來，打發他們到主那裡去，說：那將要來的是你麼？還是我們等候別人呢？
english: Then John sent two of his disciples to the Lord, saying, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?

chinese: 那兩個人來到耶穌那裡，說：施洗的約翰打發我們來問你：那將要來的是你麼？還是我們等候別人呢？
english: And when the men came to him they said, John the Baptist has sent us to you, saying, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?

chinese: 正當那時候，耶穌治好了許多有疾病的，受災患的，被惡鬼附著的，又開恩叫好些瞎子能看見。
english: At that time, he made a number of people free from their diseases and their pains, and from evil spirits; and to others who were blind he gave back the use of their eyes.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們去，把所看見所聽見的事告訴約翰，就是瞎子看見，瘸子行走，長大痲瘋的潔淨，聾子聽見，死人復活，窮人有福音傳給他們。
english: And answering them he said, Go back and give news to John of what you have seen, and the things which have come to your ears; the blind now see, those who had no power in their legs are walking, lepers are made clean, those who had no hearing now have their ears open, dead men come to life again, and the poor have the good news given to them.

chinese: 凡不因我跌倒的，就有福了！
english: And a blessing will be on him who has no doubts about me.

chinese: 約翰所差來的人既走了，耶穌就對眾人講論約翰說：你們從前出去到曠野，是要看甚麼呢？要看風吹動的蘆葦麼？
english: And when the men who were sent by John had gone away, he said to the people, about John, What did you go out into the waste land to see? a tall stem moving in the wind?

chinese: 你們出去，到底是要看甚麼？要看穿細軟衣服的人麼？那穿華麗衣服、宴樂度日的人是在王宮裡。
english: But what did you go out to see? a man in soft clothing? See now, those who have beautiful clothing and delicate food are in kings' houses.

chinese: 你們出去，究竟是要看甚麼？要看先知麼？我告訴你們，是的，他比先知大多了。
english: But what did you go out to see? a prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.

chinese: 經上記著說：我要差遣我的使者在你前面預備道路，所說的就是這個人。
english: This is he of whom it has been said, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way before you.

chinese: 我告訴你們，凡婦人所生的，沒有一個大過約翰的；然而神國裡最小的比他還大。
english: I say to you, Among all the sons of women, not one is greater than John: but he who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

chinese: 眾百姓和稅吏既受過約翰的洗，聽見這話，就以神為義；
english: (And all the people, and the tax-farmers, to whom John had given baptism, when they had knowledge of these things, gave glory to God.

chinese: 但法利賽人和律法師沒有受過約翰的洗，竟為自己廢棄了神的旨意。（29，30兩節或作：眾百姓和稅吏聽見了約翰的話，就受了他的洗，便以神為義；但法利賽人和律法師不受約翰的洗，竟為自己廢棄了神的旨意。）
english: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were against the purpose of God for themselves, not having had his baptism.)

chinese: 主又說：這樣，我可用甚麼比這世代的人呢？他們好像甚麼呢？
english: What comparison am I to make of the men of this generation? what are they like?

chinese: 好像孩童坐在街市上，彼此呼叫說：我們向你們吹笛，你們不跳舞；我們向你們舉哀，你們不啼哭。
english: They are like children who are seated in the market-place, crying out to one another, and saying, We made music for you, but you did not take part in the dance; we gave cries of sorrow, but you were not sad.

chinese: 施洗的約翰來，不吃餅，不喝酒，你們說他是被鬼附著的。
english: For John the Baptist came, taking no food or drink, and you say, He has an evil spirit.

chinese: 人子來，也吃也喝，你們說他是貪食好酒的人，是稅吏和罪人的朋友。
english: The Son of man came feasting, and you say, Here is a lover of food and wine, a friend of tax-farmers and sinners.

chinese: 但智慧之子都以智慧為是。
english: But wisdom is judged to be right by all her children.

chinese: 有一個法利賽人請耶穌和他吃飯；耶穌就到法利賽人家裡去坐席。
english: And one of the Pharisees made a request that he would take a meal with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house and took his seat at the table.

chinese: 那城裡有一個女人，是個罪人，知道耶穌在法利賽人家裡坐席，就拿著盛香膏的玉瓶，
english: And there was a woman in the town who was a sinner; and when she had news that he was a guest in the Pharisee's house, she took a bottle of perfume,

chinese: 站在耶穌背後，挨著他的腳哭，眼淚溼了耶穌的腳，就用自己的頭髮擦乾，又用嘴連連親他的腳，把香膏抹上。
english: And went in and took her place at the back of him, near his feet, weeping, so that his feet were washed with the drops from her eyes, and with her hair she made them dry, and kissing his feet she put the perfume on them.

chinese: 請耶穌的法利賽人看見這事，心裡說：這人若是先知，必知道摸他的是誰，是個怎樣的女人，乃是個罪人。
english: Now when the Pharisee in whose house he was saw it, he said to himself, This man, if he was a prophet, would be conscious what sort of woman this is who has put her hands on him, that she is a sinner.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：西門！我有句話要對你說。西門說：夫子，請說。
english: And Jesus, answering, said, Simon, I have something to say to you. And he said, Master, say on.

chinese: 耶穌說：一個債主有兩個人欠他的債；一個欠五十兩銀子，一個欠五兩銀子；
english: And he said, Two men were in debt to a certain man of business: one had a debt of five hundred pence, and the other of fifty.

chinese: 因為他們無力償還，債主就開恩免了他們兩個人的債。這兩個人那一個更愛他呢？
english: When they were unable to make payment, he made the two of them free of their debts. Which of them, now, will have the greater love for him?

chinese: 西門回答說：我想是那多得恩免的人。耶穌說：你斷的不錯。
english: Simon, in answer, said, It seems he whose debt was greater. And he said, Your decision is right.

chinese: 於是轉過來向著那女人，便對西門說：你看見這女人麼？我進了你的家，你沒有給我水洗腳；但這女人用眼淚溼了我的腳，用頭髮擦乾。
english: And turning to the woman he said to Simon, You see this woman? I came into your house; you did not give me water for my feet: but she has been washing my feet with the drops from her eyes, and drying them with her hair.

chinese: 你沒有與我親嘴；但這女人從我進來的時候就不住的用嘴親我的腳。
english: You did not give me a kiss: but she, from the time when I came in, has gone on kissing my feet.

chinese: 你沒有用油抹我的頭；但這女人用香膏抹我的腳。
english: You put no oil on my head: but she has put perfume on my feet.

chinese: 所以我告訴你，他許多的罪都赦免了，因為他的愛多；但那赦免少的，他的愛就少。
english: And so I say to you, She will have forgiveness for her sins which are great in number, because of her great love: but he who has small need of forgiveness gives little love.

chinese: 於是對那女人說：你的罪赦免了。
english: And he said to her, You have forgiveness for your sins.

chinese: 同席的人心裡說：這是甚麼人，竟赦免人的罪呢？
english: And those who were seated at table with him said to themselves, Who is this who even gives forgiveness of sins?

chinese: 耶穌對那女人說：你的信救了你；平平安安的回去罷！
english: And he said to the woman, By your faith you have salvation; go in peace.

chinese: 過了不多日，耶穌周遊各城各鄉傳道，宣講神國的福音。和他同去的有十二個門徒，
english: And it came about, after a short time, that he went through town and country giving the good news of the kingdom of God, and with him were the twelve,

chinese: 還有被惡鬼所附、被疾病所累、已經治好的幾個婦女，內中有稱為抹大拉的馬利亞，曾有七個鬼從他身上趕出來，
english: And certain women who had been made free from evil spirits and diseases, Mary named Magdalene, from whom seven evil spirits had gone out,

chinese: 又有希律的家宰苦撒的妻子約亞拿，並蘇撒拿，和好些別的婦女，都是用自己的財物供給耶穌和門徒。
english: And Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod's chief house-servant, and Susanna and a number of others, who gave him of their wealth for his needs.

chinese: 當許多人聚集、又有人從各城裡出來見耶穌的時候，耶穌就用比喻說：
english: And when a great number of people came together, and men from every town went out to him, he gave them teaching in the form of a story:

chinese: 有一個撒種的出去撒種。撒的時候，有落在路旁的，被人踐踏，天上的飛鳥又來吃盡了。
english: A man went out to put in seed, and while he was doing it, some was dropped by the wayside and it was crushed under foot, and was taken by the birds of heaven.

chinese: 有落在磐石上的，一出來就枯乾了，因為得不著滋潤。
english: And some went on the rock, and when it came up it became dry and dead because it had no water.

chinese: 有落在荊棘裡的，荊棘一同生長，把他擠住了。
english: And some went among thorns, and the thorns came up with it and it had no room for growth.

chinese: 又有落在好土裡的，生長起來，結實百倍。耶穌說了這些話，就大聲說：有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
english: And some falling on good earth, came up and gave fruit a hundred times as much. And with these words he said in a loud voice, He who has ears, let him give ear.

chinese: 門徒問耶穌說：這比喻是甚麼意思呢？
english: And his disciples put questions to him about the point of the story.

chinese: 他說：神國的奧祕只叫你們知道；至於別人，就用比喻，叫他們看也看不見，聽也聽不明。
english: And he said, To you is given knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God; but to the others, they are given in stories, so that seeing, they may not see, and though they give hearing, the sense will not be clear to them.

chinese: 這比喻乃是這樣：種子就是神的道。
english: Now this is the point of the story: The seed is the word of God.

chinese: 那些在路旁的，就是人聽了道，隨後魔鬼來，從他們心裡把道奪去，恐怕他們信了得救.
english: Those by the side of the road are those who have given hearing; then the Evil One comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not have faith and get salvation.

chinese: 那些在磐石上的，就是人聽道，歡喜領受，但心中沒有根，不過暫時相信，及至遇見試煉就退後了。
english: And those on the rock are those who with joy give hearing to the word; but having no root, they have faith for a time, and when the test comes they give up.

chinese: 那落在荊棘裡的，就是人聽了道，走開以後，被今生的思慮、錢財、宴樂擠住了，便結不出成熟的子粒來。
english: And those which went among thorns are those who have given hearing, and go on their way, but they are overcome by cares and wealth and the pleasures of life, and they give no fruit.

chinese: 那落在好土裡的，就是人聽了道，持守在誠實善良的心裡，並且忍耐著結實。
english: And those in the good earth are those who, having given ear to the word, keep it with a good and true heart, and in quiet strength give fruit.

chinese: 沒有人點燈用器皿蓋上，或放在床底下，乃是放在燈臺上，叫進來的人看見亮光。
english: No man, when the light is lighted, puts a cover over it, or puts it under a bed, but he puts it on its table, so that those who come in may see the light.

chinese: 因為掩藏的事沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事沒有不露出來被人知道的。
english: For nothing is put out of view which will not be made clear, and nothing is secret of which the knowledge will not come to light.

chinese: 所以，你們應當小心怎樣聽；因為凡有的，還要加給他；凡沒有的，連他自以為有的，也要奪去。
english: So take care how you give hearing, for to him who has will be given, and from him who has not will be taken even what he seems to have.

chinese: 耶穌的母親和他弟兄來了，因為人多，不得到他跟前。
english: And his mother and his brothers came to him, and they were not able to get near him because of the great number of people.

chinese: 有人告訴他說：你母親和你弟兄站在外邊，要見你。
english: And someone said to him, Your mother and your brothers are outside desiring to see you.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：聽了神之道而遵行的人就是我的母親，我的弟兄了。
english: But he said to them in answer, My mother and my brothers are those who have knowledge of the word of God and do it.

chinese: 有一天，耶穌和門徒上了船，對門徒說：我們可以渡到湖那邊去。他們就開了船。
english: Now it came about on one of those days that he got into a boat with his disciples; and he said to them, Let us go over to the other side of the water: and they put out the boat.

chinese: 正行的時候，耶穌睡著了。湖上忽然起了暴風，船將滿了水，甚是危險。
english: But while they were sailing he went to sleep: and a storm of wind came down on the sea, and the boat became full of water and they were in danger.

chinese: 門徒來叫醒了他，說：夫子！夫子！我們喪命啦！耶穌醒了，斥責那狂風大浪；風浪就止住，平靜了。
english: Then they came to him and, awaking him out of his sleep, said, Master, Master, destruction is near. And he, when he was awake, gave orders to the wind and the rolling waves, and the storm came to an end, and all was calm.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們的信心在那裡呢？他們又懼怕又希奇，彼此說：這到底是誰？他吩咐風和水，連風和水也聽從他了。
english: And he said to them, Where is your faith? And fear and wonder overcame them, and they said to one another, Who then is this, who gives orders even to the winds and the water and they do what he says?

chinese: 他們到了格拉森（有古卷：加大拉）人的地方，就是加利利的對面。
english: And they came to the country of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.

chinese: 耶穌上了岸，就有城裡一個被鬼附著的人迎面而來。這個人許久不穿衣服，不住房子，只住在墳塋裡。
english: And when he had come to the land, there came to him a certain man from the town who had evil spirits; and for a long time he had had no clothing on, and was not living in a house but in the place of the dead.

chinese: 他見了耶穌，就俯伏在他面前，大聲喊叫，說：至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你有甚麼相干？求你不要叫我受苦！
english: And when he saw Jesus, he gave a loud cry and went down on the earth before him and in a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? Do not be cruel to me.

chinese: 是因耶穌曾吩咐污鬼從那人身上出來。原來這鬼屢次抓住他；他常被人看守，又被鐵鍊和腳鐐捆鎖，他竟把鎖鍊掙斷，被鬼趕到曠野去。
english: For he gave an order to the evil spirit to come out of the man. For frequently it would take a grip of him: and he was kept under control, and prisoned with chains; but parting the chains in two, he would be sent by the driving of the evil spirit into waste places.

chinese: 耶穌問他說：你名叫甚麼？他說：我名叫群；這是因為附著他的鬼多。
english: And Jesus said to him, What is your name? And he said, Legion; for a number of spirits had gone into him.

chinese: 鬼就央求耶穌，不要吩咐他們到無底坑裡去。
english: And they made a request to him that he would not give them an order to go away into the deep.
