chinese: 那裡有一大群豬在山上吃食。鬼央求耶穌，准他們進入豬裡去。耶穌准了他們，
english: Now there was a great herd of pigs in that place, getting food on the mountain: and the evil spirits made a request to him that he would let them go into the pigs, and he let them.

chinese: 鬼就從那人出來，進入豬裡去。於是那群豬闖下山崖，投在湖裡淹死了。
english: And the evil spirits came out of the man and went into the pigs: and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the water and came to destruction.

chinese: 放豬的看見這事就逃跑了，去告訴城裡和鄉下的人。
english: And when the men who took care of them saw what had come about, they went quickly and gave news of it in the town and the country.

chinese: 眾人出來要看是甚麼事；到了耶穌那裡，看見鬼所離開的那人，坐在耶穌腳前，穿著衣服，心裡明白過來，他們就害怕。
english: And they went out to see what had taken place, and they came to Jesus and saw the man out of whom the evil spirits had gone, seated, clothed and with full use of his senses, at the feet of Jesus; and fear came on them.

chinese: 看見這事的便將被鬼附著的人怎麼得救告訴他們。
english: And those who had seen it gave them an account of how the man who had the evil spirits was made well.

chinese: 格拉森四圍的人，因為害怕得很，都求耶穌離開他們；耶穌就上船回去了。
english: And all the people of the country of the Gerasenes made a request to him to go away from them; for they were in great fear: and he got into a boat and went back.

chinese: 鬼所離開的那人懇求和耶穌同在；耶穌卻打發他回去，說：
english: But the man from whom the evil spirits had gone out had a great desire to be with him, but he sent him away, saying,

chinese: 你回家去，傳說神為你作了何等大的事。他就去，滿城裡傳揚耶穌為他作了何等大的事。
english: Go back to your house and let them have news of all the great things which God has done for you. And he went away, giving word through all the town of the great things which Jesus had done for him.

chinese: 耶穌回來的時候，眾人迎接他，因為他們都等候他。
english: And when Jesus went back, the people were glad to see him, for they were all waiting for him.

chinese: 有一個管會堂的，名叫睚魯，來俯伏在耶穌腳前，求耶穌到他家裡去；
english: Then there came a man named Jairus, who was a ruler in the Synagogue: and he went down at the feet of Jesus, desiring him to come to his house;

chinese: 因他有一個獨生女兒，約有十二歲，快要死了。耶穌去的時候，眾人擁擠他。
english: For he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was near to death. But while he was on his way, the people were pushing to be near him.

chinese: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，在醫生手裡花盡了他一切養生的，並沒有一人能醫好他。
english: And a woman, who had had a flow of blood for twelve years, and had given all her money to medical men, and not one of them was able to make her well,

chinese: 他來到耶穌背後，摸他的衣裳繸子，血漏立刻就止住了。
english: Came after him and put her hand on the edge of his robe, and straight away the flowing of her blood was stopped.

chinese: 耶穌說：摸我的是誰？眾人都不承認。彼得和同行的人都說：夫子，眾人擁擁擠擠緊靠著你。（有古卷在此有：你還問摸我的是誰麼？
english: And Jesus said, Who was touching me? And when they all said, It is not I, Peter and those who were with him said, Master, the people are pushing round you on every side.

chinese: 耶穌說：總有人摸我，因我覺得有能力從我身上出去。
english: But Jesus said, Someone was touching me, for I had the feeling that power had gone out from me.

chinese: 那女人知道不能隱藏，就戰戰兢兢的來俯伏在耶穌腳前，把摸他的緣故和怎樣立刻得好了，當著眾人都說出來。
english: And when the woman saw that she was not able to keep it secret, she came, shaking with fear, and falling down before him she made clear before all the people the reason for her touching him, and how she was made well straight away.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：女兒，你的信救了你；平平安安的去罷！
english: And he said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace.

chinese: 還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裡來，說：你的女兒死了，不要勞動夫子。
english: While he was still talking, someone came from the house of the ruler of the Synagogue, saying, Your daughter is dead; do not go on troubling the Master.

chinese: 耶穌聽見就對他說：不要怕，只要信！你的女兒就必得救。
english: But Jesus at these words said to him, Have no fear, only have faith, and she will be made well.

chinese: 耶穌到了他的家，除了彼得、約翰、雅各，和女兒的父母，不許別人同他進去。
english: And when he came to the house he did not let any man go in with him, but only Peter and John and James, and the father of the girl and her mother.

chinese: 眾人都為這女兒哀哭捶胸。耶穌說：不要哭。他不是死了，是睡著了。
english: And all the people were weeping and crying for her; but he said, Do not be sad, for she is not dead, but sleeping.

chinese: 他們曉得女兒已經死了，就嗤笑耶穌。
english: And they were laughing at him, being certain that she was dead.

chinese: 耶穌拉著他的手，呼叫說：女兒，起來罷！
english: But he, taking her hand, said to her, My child, get up.

chinese: 他的靈魂便回來，他就立刻起來了。耶穌吩咐給他東西吃。
english: And her spirit came back to her and she got up straight away: and he gave orders that food was to be given to her.

chinese: 他的父母驚奇得很；耶穌囑咐他們，不要把所作的事告訴人。
english: And her father and mother were full of wonder, but he gave orders to them to say nothing about it to anyone.

chinese: 耶穌叫齊了十二個門徒，給他們能力、權柄，制伏一切的鬼，醫治各樣的病，
english: And getting the twelve together, he gave them power and authority over all evil spirits and over diseases, to make them well.

chinese: 又差遣他們去宣傳神國的道，醫治病人，
english: And he sent them out to be preachers of the kingdom of God, and to make well those who were ill.

chinese: 對他們說：行路的時候，不要帶柺杖和口袋，不要帶食物和銀子，也不要帶兩件褂子。
english: And he said to them, Take nothing for your journey, no stick or bag or bread or money, and do not take two coats.

chinese: 無論進那一家，就住在那裡，也從那裡起行。
english: And if you go into a house, let that house be your resting-place till you go away.

chinese: 凡不接待你們的，你們離開那城的時候，要把腳上的塵土跺下去，見證他們的不是。
english: And if any people will not take you in, when you go away from that town, put off its dust from your feet for a witness against them.

chinese: 門徒就出去，走遍各鄉宣傳福音，到處治病。
english: And they went away, journeying through all the towns, preaching the good news and making people free from diseases in all places.

chinese: 分封的王希律聽見耶穌所作的一切事，就游移不定；因為有人說：是約翰從死裡復活；
english: Now Herod the king had news of all these things: and he was in doubt, because it was said by some people that John had come back from the dead;

chinese: 又有人說：是以利亞顯現；還有人說：是古時的一個先知又活了。
english: And by some, that Elijah had come; and by others, that one of the old prophets had come back to life.

chinese: 希律說：約翰我已經斬了，這卻是甚麼人？我竟聽見他這樣的事呢？就想要見他。
english: And Herod said, I put John to death: but who is this, of whom such stories are given to me? And he had a desire to see him.

chinese: 使徒回來，將所作的事告訴耶穌，耶穌就帶他們暗暗的離開那裡，往一座城去；那城名叫伯賽大。
english: And the twelve, when they came back, gave him an account of what they had done. And he took them with him and went away from the people to a town named Beth-saida.

chinese: 但眾人知道了，就跟著他去；耶穌便接待他們，對他們講論神國的道，醫治那些需醫的人。
english: But the people, getting news of it, went after him: and he was pleased to see them, and gave them teaching about the kingdom of God, and made those well who were in need of it.

chinese: 日頭快要平西，十二個門徒來對他說：請叫眾人散開，他們好往四面鄉村裡去借宿找吃的，因為我們這裡是野地。
english: And the day went on; and the twelve came to him and said, Send these people away so that they may go into the towns and the country round about and get resting-places and food for themselves, for we are in a waste place.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們給他們吃罷！門徒說：我們不過有五個餅，兩條魚，若不去為這許多人買食物就不夠。
english: But he said, Give them food yourselves. And they said, We have only five cakes of bread and two fishes, if we do not go and get food for all these people.

chinese: 那時，人數約有五千。耶穌對門徒說：叫他們一排一排的坐下，每排大約五十個人。
english: For there were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them be seated in groups, about fifty to a group.

chinese: 門徒就如此行，叫眾人都坐下。
english: And they did so, and made them all be seated.

chinese: 耶穌拿著這五個餅，兩條魚，望著天祝福，擘開，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前。
english: And he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing over them, and when they had been broken, he gave them to the disciples to give to the people.

chinese: 他們就吃，並且都吃飽了；把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二籃子。
english: And they all took the food and had enough; and they took up of the broken bits which were over, twelve baskets full.

chinese: 耶穌自己禱告的時候，門徒也同他在那裡。耶穌問他們說：眾人說我是誰？
english: And it came about that when he was in prayer, by himself, and the disciples were with him, he put a question to them, saying, Who do the people say I am?

chinese: 他們說：有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；還有人說是古時的一個先知又活了。
english: And they, answering, said, John the Baptist; but others say Elijah; and others, that one of the old prophets has come back.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們說我是誰？彼得回答說：是神所立的基督。
english: And he said, But who do you say that I am? And Peter, answering, said, The Christ of God.

chinese: 耶穌切切的囑咐他們，不可將這事告訴人，
english: But he gave them special orders, not to say this to any man;

chinese: 又說：人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長、和文士棄絕，並且被殺，第三日復活。
english: Saying, The Son of man will undergo much and be put on one side by the rulers and the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and be put to death, and on the third day he will come back to life.

chinese: 耶穌又對眾人說：若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，天天背起他的十字架來跟從我。
english: And he said to them all, If any man has a desire to come after me, let him give up all, and take up his cross every day, and come after me.

chinese: 因為，凡要救自己生命（生命：或作靈魂；下同）的，必喪掉生命；凡為我喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
english: For whoever has a desire to keep his life will have it taken from him, but whoever gives up his life because of me, will keep it.

chinese: 人若賺得全世界，卻喪了自己，賠上自己，有甚麼益處呢？
english: For what profit will a man have if he gets all the world, but undergoes loss or destruction himself?

chinese: 凡把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在自己的榮耀裡，並天父與聖天使的榮耀裡降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。
english: For if any man has a feeling of shame because of me or of my words, the Son of man will have shame because of him when he comes in his glory and the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，站在這裡的，有人在沒嘗死味以前，必看見神的國。
english: But truly I say to you, Some of those who are here now will have no taste of death till they see the kingdom of God.

chinese: 說了這話以後約有八天，耶穌帶著彼得、約翰、雅各上山去禱告。
english: And about eight days after he had said these things, he took Peter and John and James with him and went up into the mountain for prayer.

chinese: 正禱告的時候，他的面貌就改變了，衣服潔白放光。
english: And while he was in prayer, his face was changed and his clothing became white and shining.

chinese: 忽然有摩西、以利亞兩個人同耶穌說話；
english: And two men, Moses and Elijah, were talking with him;

chinese: 他們在榮光裡顯現，談論耶穌去世的事，就是他在耶路撒冷將要成的事。
english: Who were seen in glory and were talking of his death which was about to take place in Jerusalem.

chinese: 彼得和他的同伴都打盹，既清醒了，就看見耶穌的榮光，並同他站著的那兩個人。
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were overcome with sleep: but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men who were with him.

chinese: 二人正要和耶穌分離的時候，彼得對耶穌說：夫子，我們在這裡真好！可以搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。他卻不知道所說的是甚麼。
english: And when they were about to go away from him, Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here; let us make three tents, one for you and one for Moses and one for Elijah: having no knowledge of what he was saying.

chinese: 說這話的時候，有一朵雲彩來遮蓋他們；他們進入雲彩裡就懼怕。
english: And while he said these things, the shade of a cloud came over them, and they were full of fear when they went into the cloud.

chinese: 有聲音從雲彩裡出來，說：這是我的兒子，我所揀選的（有古卷：這是我的愛子），你們要聽他。
english: And there was a voice from the cloud saying, This is my Son, the man of my selection; give ear to him.

chinese: 聲音住了，只見耶穌一人在那裡。當那些日子，門徒不提所看見的事，一樣也不告訴人。
english: And after the voice was gone they saw that Jesus was by himself. And they kept quiet, and said nothing at that time to anyone of the things which they had seen.

chinese: 第二天，他們下了山，就有許多人迎見耶穌。
english: And on the day after, when they came down from the mountain, a great band of people came to him.

chinese: 其中有一人喊叫說：夫子！求你看顧我的兒子，因為他是我的獨生子。
english: And a man from among them, crying out, said, Master, I make a request to you, give a thought to my son, for he is my only child:

chinese: 他被鬼抓住就忽然喊叫；鬼又叫他抽瘋，口中流沫，並且重重的傷害他，難以離開他。
english: And see, a spirit takes him, and suddenly he gives a cry, twisted in pain and streaming at the lips, and when it goes away from him at last, he is marked as from blows.

chinese: 我求過你的門徒，把鬼趕出去，他們卻是不能。
english: And I made a request to your disciples to send it out of him, but they were not able to do it.

chinese: 耶穌說：噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代阿，我在你們這裡，忍耐你們要到幾時呢？將你的兒子帶到這裡來罷！
english: And Jesus said, O generation without faith and false in heart, how long will I have to be with you and put up with you? let your son come here.

chinese: 正來的時候，鬼把他摔倒，叫他重重的抽瘋。耶穌就斥責那污鬼，把孩子治好了，交給他父親。
english: And while he was coming, he was pushed violently down and twisted by the evil spirit. But Jesus gave sharp orders to the unclean spirit, and made the boy well, and gave him back to his father.

chinese: 眾人都詫異神的大能（大能：或作威榮）。耶穌所作的一切事，眾人正希奇的時候，耶穌對門徒說：
english: And they were full of wonder at the great power of God. But while they were all wondering at all the things which he did, he said to his disciples,

chinese: 你們要把這些話存在耳中，因為人子將要被交在人手裡。
english: Let these words go deep into your ears, for the Son of man will be given up into the hands of men.

chinese: 他們不明白這話，意思乃是隱藏的，叫他們不能明白，他們也不敢問這話的意思。
english: But this saying was not clear to them and its sense was kept secret from them so that they were not able to see it: and they had fear of questioning him about it.

chinese: 門徒中間起了議論，誰將為大。
english: Now there was a discussion among them about which of them would be the greatest.

chinese: 耶穌看出他們心中的議論，就領一個小孩子來，叫他站在自己旁邊，
english: But when Jesus saw the reasoning of their hearts, he took a small child and put him by his side,

chinese: 對他們說：凡為我名接待這小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，就是接待那差我來的。你們中間最小的，他便為大。
english: And said to them, Whoever gives honour to this child in my name, gives honour to me: and whoever gives honour to me, gives honour to him who sent me: for whoever is least among you all, that man is great.

chinese: 約翰說：夫子，我們看見一個人奉你的名趕鬼，我們就禁止他，因為他不與我們一同跟從你。
english: And John, answering, said, Master, we saw a man driving out evil spirits in your name, and we did not let him do it, because he was not one of us.

chinese: 耶穌說：不要禁止他；因為不敵擋你們的，就是幫助你們的。
english: But Jesus said to him, Let him do it, for he who is not against you is for you.

chinese: 耶穌被接上升的日子將到，他就定意向耶路撒冷去，
english: And it came about that when the days were near for him to be taken up, his face was turned to go to Jerusalem,

chinese: 便打發使者在他前頭走。他們到了撒瑪利亞的一個村莊，要為他預備。
english: And he sent men before: and they came to a small town of Samaria to make ready for him.

chinese: 那裡的人不接待他，因他面向耶路撒冷去。
english: But they would not have him there, because he was clearly going to Jerusalem.

chinese: 他的門徒雅各、約翰看見了，就說：主阿，你要我們吩咐火從天上降下來燒滅他們，像以利亞所作的（有古卷無「像以利亞所作的」數字）麼？
english: And when his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, Lord, may we send fire from heaven and put an end to them?

chinese: 耶穌轉身責備兩個門徒，說：你們的心如何，你們並不知道。
english: But turning round he said sharp words to them.

chinese: 人子來不是要滅人的性命（或作：靈魂；下同），是要救人的性命。說著就往別的村莊去了（有古卷只有五十五節首句，五十六節末句）。
english: And they went to another small town.

chinese: 他們走路的時候，有一人對耶穌說：你無論往那裡去，我要跟從你。
english: And when they were on the way, a certain man said to him, I will come after you wherever you go.

chinese: 耶穌說：狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，只是人子沒有枕頭的地方。
english: And Jesus said to him, Foxes have holes and the birds of the air have resting-places, but the Son of man has nowhere to put his head.

chinese: 又對一個人說：跟從我來！那人說：主，容我先回去埋葬我的父親。
english: And he said to another, Come after me. But he said, Lord, let me first go and give the last honours to my father.

chinese: 耶穌說：任憑死人埋葬他們的死人，你只管去傳揚神國的道。
english: But he said to him, Let the dead take care of their dead; it is for you to go and give news of the kingdom of God.

chinese: 又有一人說：主，我要跟從你，但容我先去辭別我家裡的人。
english: And another man said, I will come with you, Lord, but first let me say a last good-day to those who are at my house.

chinese: 耶穌說：手扶著犁向後看的，不配進神的國。
english: But Jesus said, No man, having put his hand to the plough and looking back, is good enough for the kingdom of God.

chinese: 這事以後，主又設立七十個人，差遣他們兩個兩個的在他前面，往自己所要到的各城各地方去，
english: Now after these things, the Lord made selection of seventy others and sent them before him, two together, into every town and place where he himself was about to come.

chinese: 就對他們說：要收的莊稼多，作工的人少。所以，你們當求莊稼的主打發工人出去收他的莊稼。
english: And he said to them, There is much grain ready to be cut, but not enough workers: so make prayer to the Lord of the grain-fields that he will send workers to get in the grain.

chinese: 你們去罷！我差你們出去，如同羊羔進入狼群。
english: Go on your way: see, I send you out like lambs among wolves.

chinese: 不要帶錢囊，不要帶口袋，不要帶鞋；在路上也不要問人的安。
english: Take no bag for money or for food, and no shoes; say no word to any man on the way.

chinese: 無論進那一家，先要說：願這一家平安。
english: And whenever you go into a house, first say, Peace be to this house.

chinese: 那裡若有當得平安的人（當得平安的人：原文是平安之子），你們所求的平安就必臨到那家；不然，就歸與你們了。
english: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will be with him: but if not, it will come back to you again.

chinese: 你們要住在那家，吃喝他們所供給的，因為工人得工價是應當的；不要從這家搬到那家。
english: And keep in that same house, taking what food and drink they give you: for the worker has a right to his reward. Do not go from house to house.

chinese: 無論進那一城，人若接待你們，給你們擺上甚麼，你們就吃甚麼。
english: And into whatever town you go, if they take you in, take whatever food is given to you:

chinese: 要醫治那城裡的病人，對他們說：神的國臨近你們了。
english: And make well those in it who are ill and say to them, The kingdom of God is near to you.

chinese: 無論進那一城，人若不接待你們，你們就到街上去，
english: But if you go into a town where they will not have you, go out into the streets of it and say,

chinese: 說：就是你們城裡的塵土黏在我們的腳上，我們也當著你們擦去。雖然如此，你們該知道神的國臨近了。
english: Even the dust of your town, which is on our feet, we put off as a witness against you; but be certain of this, that the kingdom of God is near.

chinese: 我告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪所受的，比那城還容易受呢！
english: I say to you, It will be better in that day for Sodom than for that town.

chinese: 哥拉汛哪，你有禍了！伯賽大阿，你有禍了！因為在你們中間所行的異能若行在推羅、西頓，他們早已披麻蒙灰，坐在地上悔改了。
english: A curse is on you, Chorazin! A curse is on you, Beth-saida! For if such works of power had been done in Tyre and Sidon as have been done in you, they would have been turned from their sins, in days gone by, seated in the dust.

chinese: 當審判的日子，推羅、西頓所受的，比你們還容易受呢！
english: But it will be better for Tyre and Sidon, in the day of judging, than for you.

chinese: 迦百農阿，你已經升到天上（或作：你將要升到天上麼），將來必推下陰間。
english: And you, Capernaum, were you not lifted up to heaven? you will go down to hell.

chinese: 又對門徒說：聽從你們的就是聽從我；棄絕你們的就是棄絕我；棄絕我的就是棄絕那差我來的。
english: Whoever gives ear to you, gives ear to me; and whoever is against you, is against me; and whoever is against me, is against him who sent me.

chinese: 那七十個人歡歡喜喜的回來，說：主阿！因你的名，就是鬼也服了我們。
english: And the seventy came back with joy, saying, Lord, even the evil spirits are under our power in your name.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：我曾看見撒但從天上墜落，像閃電一樣。
english: And he said, I was watching for Satan, falling from heaven like a star.

chinese: 我已經給你們權柄可以踐踏蛇和蠍子，又勝過仇敵一切的能力，斷沒有甚麼能害你們。
english: See, I have given you power to put your feet on snakes and evil beasts, and over all the strength of him who is against you: and nothing will do you damage.

chinese: 然而，不要因鬼服了你們就歡喜，要因你們的名記錄在天上歡喜。
english: Do not be glad, however, because you have power over spirits, but because your names are recorded in heaven.

chinese: 正當那時，耶穌被聖靈感動就歡樂，說：父阿，天地的主，我感謝你！因為你將這些事向聰明通達人就藏起來，向嬰孩就顯出來。父阿！是的，因為你的美意本是如此。
english: In that same hour he was full of joy in the Holy Spirit and said, I give praise to you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have kept these things secret from the wise and the men of learning, and have made them clear to little children: for so, O Father, it was pleasing in your eyes.

chinese: 一切所有的都是我父交付我的；除了父，沒有人知道子是誰；除了子和子所願意指示的，沒有人知道父是誰。
english: All things have been given to me by my Father: and no one has knowledge of the Son, but only the Father: and of the Father, but only the Son, and he to whom the Son will make it clear.

chinese: 耶穌轉身暗暗的對門徒說：看見你們所看見的，那眼睛就有福了。
english: And, turning to the disciples, he said privately, Happy are the eyes which see the things you see:

chinese: 我告訴你們，從前有許多先知和君王要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。
english: For I say to you that numbers of prophets and kings have had a desire to see the things which you see, and have not seen them, and to have knowledge of the things which have come to your ears, and they had it not.

chinese: 有一個律法師起來試探耶穌，說：夫子！我該作甚麼才可以承受永生？
english: And a certain teacher of the law got up and put him to the test, saying, Master, what have I to do so that I may have eternal life?

chinese: 耶穌對他說：律法上寫的是甚麼？你念的是怎樣呢？
english: And he said to him, What does the law say, in your reading of it?

chinese: 他回答說：「你要盡心、盡性、盡力、盡意愛主─你的神；又要愛鄰舍如同自己。」
english: And he, answering, said, Have love for the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind; and for your neighbour as for yourself.

chinese: 耶穌說：「你回答的是；你這樣行，就必得永生。」
english: And he said, You have given the right answer: do this and you will have life.

chinese: 那人要顯明自己有理，就對耶穌說：誰是我的鄰舍呢？
english: But he, desiring to put himself in the right, said to Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：有一個人從耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在強盜手中。他們剝去他的衣裳，把他打個半死，就丟下他走了。
english: And Jesus, answering him, said, A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he got into the hands of thieves, who took his clothing and gave him cruel blows, and when they went away, he was half dead.

chinese: 偶然有一個祭司從這條路下來，看見他就從那邊過去了。
english: And by chance a certain priest was going down that way: and when he saw him, he went by on the other side.

chinese: 又有一個利未人來到這地方，看見他，也照樣從那邊過去了。
english: And in the same way, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, went by on the other side.

chinese: 惟有一個撒瑪利亞人行路來到那裡，看見他就動了慈心，
english: But a certain man of Samaria, journeying that way, came where he was, and when he saw him, he was moved with pity for him,

chinese: 上前用油和酒倒在他的傷處，包裹好了，扶他騎上自己的牲口，帶到店裡去照應他。
english: And came to him and put clean linen round his wounds, with oil and wine; and he put him on his beast and took him to a house and took care of him.

chinese: 第二天拿出二錢銀子來，交給店主，說：你且照應他；此外所費用的，我回來必還你。
english: And the day after he took two pennies and gave them to the owner of the house and said, Take care of him; and if this money is not enough, when I come again I will give you whatever more is needed.

chinese: 你想，這三個人那一個是落在強盜手中的鄰舍呢？
english: Which of these three men, in your opinion, was neighbour to the man who came into the hands of thieves?

chinese: 他說：是憐憫他的。耶穌說：你去照樣行罷。
english: And he said, The one who had mercy on him. And Jesus said, Go and do the same.

chinese: 他們走路的時候，耶穌進了一個村莊。有一個女人，名叫馬大，接他到自己家裡。
english: Now, while they were on their way, he came to a certain town; and a woman named Martha took him into her house.

chinese: 他有一個妹子，名叫馬利亞，在耶穌腳前坐著聽他的道。
english: And she had a sister, by name Mary, who took her seat at the Lord's feet and gave attention to his words.

chinese: 馬大伺候的事多，心裡忙亂，就進前來，說：主阿，我的妹子留下我一個人伺候，你不在意麼？請吩咐他來幫助我。
english: But Martha had her hands full of the work of the house, and she came to him and said, Lord, is it nothing to you that my sister has let me do all the work? Say to her that she is to give me some help.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：馬大！馬大！你為許多的事思慮煩擾，
english: But the Lord, answering, said to her, Martha, Martha, you are full of care and troubled about such a number of things:

chinese: 但是不可少的只有一件；馬利亞已經選擇那上好的福分，是不能奪去的。
english: Little is needed, or even one thing only: for Mary has taken that good part, which will not be taken away from her.

chinese: 耶穌在一個地方禱告；禱告完了，有個門徒對他說：求主教導我們禱告，像約翰教導他的門徒。
english: And it came about that he was in prayer in a certain place, and when he came to an end, one of his disciples said to him, Lord, will you give us teaching about prayer, as John did to his disciples?

chinese: 耶穌說：你們禱告的時候，要說：我們在天上的父（有古卷只作：父阿）：願人都尊你的名為聖。願你的國降臨；願你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上（有古卷無願你的旨意云云）。
english: And he said to them, When you say your prayers, say, Father, may your name be kept holy and your kingdom come.

chinese: 我們日用的飲食，天天賜給我們。
english: Give us every day bread for our needs.

chinese: 赦免我們的罪，因為我們也赦免凡虧欠我們的人。不叫我們遇見試探；救我們脫離兇惡（有古卷無末句）。
english: May we have forgiveness for our sins, as we make free all those who are in debt to us. And let us not be put to the test.

chinese: 耶穌又說：你們中間誰有一個朋友半夜到他那裡去，說：朋友！請借給我三個餅；
english: And he said to them, Which of you, having a friend, would go to him in the middle of the night and say to him, Friend, let me have three cakes of bread;

chinese: 因為我有一個朋友行路，來到我這裡，我沒有甚麼給他擺上。
english: Because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to put before him;

chinese: 那人在裡面回答說：不要攪擾我，門已經關閉，孩子們也同我在床上了，我不能起來給你。
english: And he, from inside the house, would say in answer, Do not be a trouble to me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; it is not possible for me to get up and give to you?

chinese: 我告訴你們，雖不因他是朋友起來給他，但因他情詞迫切的直求，就必起來照他所需用的給他。
english: I say to you, Though he will not get up and give to him, because he is his friend, still, if he keeps on making his request, he will get up and give him as much as he has need of.

chinese: 我又告訴你們，你們祈求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
english: And I say to you, Make requests, and they will be answered; what you are searching for, you will get; when you give the sign, the door will be open to you.

chinese: 因為，凡祈求的，就得著；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。
english: For to everyone who makes a request, it will be given; and he who is searching will get his desire; and to him who gives the sign, the door will be open.

chinese: 你們中間作父親的，誰有兒子求餅，反給他石頭呢？求魚，反拿蛇當魚給他呢？
english: And which of you, being a father, will give a stone to his son, who makes request for bread? or for a fish, will give him a snake?

chinese: 求雞蛋，反給他蠍子呢？
english: Or for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

chinese: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道拿好東西給兒女；何況天父，豈不更將聖靈給求他的人麼？
english: If, then, you who are evil are able to give good things to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who make request to him?

chinese: 耶穌趕出一個叫人啞吧的鬼，鬼出去了，啞吧就說出話來；眾人都希奇。
english: And he was sending an evil spirit out of a man who was without the power of talking. And it came about that when the spirit had gone the man had the power of talking; and the people were full of wonder.

chinese: 內中卻有人說：他是靠著鬼王別西卜趕鬼。
english: But some of them said, He sends out evil spirits by Beelzebul, the ruler of evil spirits.

chinese: 又有人試探耶穌，向他求從天上來的神蹟。
english: And others, testing him, were looking for a sign from heaven from him.

chinese: 他曉得他們的意念，便對他們說：凡一國自相紛爭，就成為荒場；凡一家自相紛爭，就必敗落。
english: But he, having knowledge of their thoughts, said to them, Every kingdom in which there is division is made waste; and a house in which there is division comes to destruction.

chinese: 若撒但自相紛爭，他的國怎能站得住呢？因為你們說我是靠著別西卜趕鬼。
english: If, then, Satan is at war with himself, how will he keep his kingdom? because you say that I send evil spirits out of men by the help of Beelzebul.

chinese: 我若靠著別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟趕鬼又靠著誰呢？這樣，他們就要斷定你們的是非。
english: And if I, by Beelzebul, send out evil spirits, by whose help do your sons send them out? so let them be your judges.

chinese: 我若靠著神的能力趕鬼，這就是神的國臨到你們了。
english: But if I, by the finger of God, send out evil spirits, then the kingdom of God has overtaken you.

chinese: 壯士披掛整齊，看守自己的住宅，他所有的都平安無事；
english: When the strong man armed keeps watch over his house, then his goods are safe:

chinese: 但有一個比他更壯的來，勝過他，就奪去他所倚靠的盔甲兵器，又分了他的贓。
english: But when one who is stronger makes an attack on him and overcomes him, he takes away his instruments of war, in which he had put his faith, and makes division of his goods.

chinese: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
english: He who is not with me is against me, and he who will not give me help in getting people together is driving them away.

chinese: 污鬼離了人身，就在無水之地過來過去，尋求安歇之處；既尋不著，便說：我要回到我所出來的屋裡去。
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of a man, goes through dry places, looking for rest; and when he does not get it, he says, I will go back to my house from which I came.

chinese: 到了，就看見裡面打掃乾淨，修飾好了，
english: And when he comes, he sees that it has been made fair and clean.

chinese: 便去另帶了七個比自己更惡的鬼來，都進去住在那裡。那人末後的景況比先前更不好了。
english: Then he goes and gets seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they go in, and take their places there: and the last condition of that man is worse than the first.

chinese: 耶穌正說這話的時候，眾人中間有一個女人大聲說：懷你胎的和乳養你的有福了！
english: And it came about that when he said these things, a certain woman among the people said in a loud voice, Happy is the body which gave you birth, and the breasts from which you took milk.

chinese: 耶穌說：是，卻還不如聽神之道而遵守的人有福。
english: But he said, More happy are they who give hearing to the word of God and keep it.

chinese: 當眾人聚集的時候，耶穌開講說：這世代是一個邪惡的世代。他們求看神蹟，除了約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他們看。
english: And when a great number of people came together to him, he said, This generation is an evil generation: it is looking for a sign and no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah.

chinese: 約拿怎樣為尼尼微人成了神蹟，人子也要照樣為這世代的人成了神蹟。
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will the Son of man be to this generation.

chinese: 當審判的時候，南方的女王要起來定這世代的罪；因為他從地極而來，要聽所羅門的智慧話。看哪！在這裡有一人比所羅門更大。
english: The queen of the South will come up on the day of judging and give her decision against the men of this generation: for she came from the ends of the earth to give ear to the wisdom of Solomon; and now something greater than Solomon is here.

chinese: 當審判的時候，尼尼微人要起來定這世代的罪，因為尼尼微人聽了約拿所傳的就悔改了。看哪！在這裡有一人比約拿更大。
english: The men of Nineveh will come up in the day of judging and give their decision against this generation: for they were turned away from their sins at the preaching of Jonah; but now something greater than Jonah is here.

chinese: 沒有人點燈放在地窨子裡，或是斗底下，總是放在燈臺上，使進來的人得見亮光。
english: No man, when the light has been lighted, puts it in a secret place, or under a vessel, but on its table, so that those who come in may see the light.

chinese: 你眼睛就是身上的燈。你的眼睛若瞭亮，全身就光明；眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。
english: The light of the body is the eye: when your eye is true, all your body is full of light; but when it is evil, your body is dark.

chinese: 所以，你要省察，恐怕你裡頭的光或者黑暗了。
english: So take care that the light which is in you is not dark.

chinese: 若是你全身光明，毫無黑暗，就必全然光明，如同燈的明光照亮你。
english: If, then, all your body is light, with no part of it dark, it will be completely full of light, as when a flame with its bright shining gives you light.

chinese: 說話的時候，有一個法利賽人請耶穌同他吃飯，耶穌就進去坐席。
english: Now, while he was talking, a Pharisee made a request that he would come to a meal with him; and he went in and took his seat at the meal.

chinese: 這法利賽人看見耶穌飯前不洗手便詫異。
english: And when the Pharisee saw it, he was surprised because he came to the meal without first washing himself.

chinese: 主對他說：如今你們法利賽人洗淨杯盤的外面，你們裡面卻滿了勒索和邪惡。
english: And the Lord said to him, You Pharisees make the outside of the cup and the plate clean; but inside you are thieves and full of evil.

chinese: 無知的人哪，造外面的，不也造裡面麼？
english: O you foolish ones! did not he who made the outside in the same way make the inside?

chinese: 只要把裡面的施捨給人，凡物於你們就都潔淨了。
english: But if you give to the poor such things as you are able, then all things are clean to you.

chinese: 你們法利賽人有禍了！因為你們將薄荷、芸香並各樣菜蔬獻上十分之一，那公義和愛神的事反倒不行了。這原是你們當行的；那也是不可不行的。
english: But a curse is on you, Pharisees! for you make men give a tenth of every sort of plant, and give no thought to right and the love of God; but it is right for you to do these things, and not let the others be undone.

chinese: 你們法利賽人有禍了！因為你們喜愛會堂裡的首位，又喜愛人在街市上問你們的安。
english: A curse is on you, Pharisees! for your desires are for the most important seats in the Synagogues and for words of respect said to you in the market-place.

chinese: 你們有禍了！因為你們如同不顯露的墳墓，走在上面的人並不知道。
english: A curse is on you! for you are like the resting-places of dead men, which are not seen, and men go walking over them without knowledge of it.

chinese: 律法師中有一個回答耶穌說：夫子！你這樣說也把我們糟蹋了。
english: And one of the teachers of the law, answering, said to him, Master, in saying this, you give a bad name to us as to them.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們律法師也有禍了！因為你們把難擔的擔子放在人身上，自己一個指頭卻不肯動。
english: And he said, A curse is on you, teachers of the law! for while other men are crushed under the weight of the rules you make for them, you yourselves do not put so much as one finger to them.

chinese: 你們有禍了！因為你們修造先知的墳墓，那先知正是你們的祖宗所殺的。
english: A curse is on you! for you make resting-places for the bodies of the prophets, but your fathers put them to death.

chinese: 可見你們祖宗所作的事，你們又證明又喜歡；因為他們殺了先知，你們修造先知的墳墓。
english: So you are witnesses and give approval to the work of your fathers; for they put them to death and you make their last resting-places.

chinese: 所以，神用智慧（用智慧：或作的智者）曾說：我要差遣先知和使徒到他們那裡去，有的他們要殺害，有的他們要逼迫，
english: For this reason the wisdom of God has said, I will send them prophets and teachers, and to some of them they will give death and cruel pains;

chinese: 使創世以來所流眾先知血的罪都要問在這世代的人身上，
english: So that punishment may come on this generation for the blood of all the prophets which was given from the earliest days;

chinese: 就是從亞伯的血起，直到被殺在壇和殿中間撒迦利亞的血為止。我實在告訴你們，這都要問在這世代的人身上。
english: From the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who was put to death between the altar and the Temple. Yes, I say to you, It will come on this generation.

chinese: 你們律法師有禍了！因為你們把知識的鑰匙奪了去，自己不進去，正要進去的人你們也阻擋他們。
english: A curse is on you, teachers of the law! for you have taken away the key of knowledge: you did not go in yourselves, and you got in the way of those who were going in.

chinese: 耶穌從那裡出來，文士和法利賽人就極力的催逼他，引動他多說話，
english: And when he had come out of that place, the scribes and the Pharisees came round him angrily, questioning him about more things;

chinese: 私下窺聽，要拿他的話柄。
english: And watching him, for a chance to get something from his words which might be used against him.

chinese: 這時，有幾萬人聚集，甚至彼此踐踏。耶穌開講，先對門徒說：你們要防備法利賽人的酵，就是假冒為善。
english: At that time, when thousands of the people had come together, in such numbers that they were crushing one another, he said first to his disciples, Have nothing to do with the leaven of the Pharisees, which is deceit.

chinese: 掩蓋的事沒有不露出來的；隱藏的事，沒有不被人知道的。
english: But nothing is covered up, which will not come to light, or secret, which will not be made clear.

chinese: 因此，你們在暗中所說的，將要在明處被人聽見；在內室附耳所說的，將要在房上被人宣揚。
english: So, whatever you have said in the dark, will come to men's hearing in the light, and what you have said secretly inside the house, will be made public from the house-tops.

chinese: 我的朋友，我對你們說，那殺身體以後不能再作甚麼的，不要怕他們。
english: And I say to you, my friends, Have no fear of those who may put the body to death, and are able to do no more than that.

chinese: 我要指示你們當怕的是誰：當怕那殺了以後又有權柄丟在地獄裡的。我實在告訴你們，正要怕他。
english: But I will make clear to you of whom you are to be in fear: of him who after death has power to send you to hell; yes, truly I say, Have fear of him.

chinese: 五個麻雀不是賣二分銀子麼？但在神面前，一個也不忘記；
english: Are not five sparrows given in exchange for two farthings? and God has every one of them in mind.

chinese: 就是你們的頭髮，也都被數過了。不要懼怕，你們比許多麻雀還貴重！
english: But even the hairs of your head are numbered. Have no fear: you are of more value than a flock of sparrows.

chinese: 我又告訴你們，凡在人面前認我的，人子在神的使者面前也必認他；
english: And I say to you that to everyone who gives witness to me before men, the Son of man will give witness before the angels of God.

chinese: 在人面前不認我的，人子在神的使者面前也必不認他。
english: But if anyone says before men that he has no knowledge of me, I will say that I have no knowledge of him before the angels of God.

chinese: 凡說話干犯人子的，還可得赦免；惟獨褻瀆聖靈的，總不得赦免。
english: And if anyone says a word against the Son of man, he will have forgiveness: but for him who says evil words against the Holy Spirit, there will be no forgiveness.

chinese: 人帶你們到會堂，並官府和有權柄的人面前，不要思慮怎麼分訴，說甚麼話；
english: And when they take you before the Synagogues and the authorities and the rulers, take no thought about what answers you will give, or what you will say:

chinese: 因為正在那時候，聖靈要指教你們當說的話。
english: For the Holy Spirit will make clear to you in that very hour what to say.

chinese: 眾人中有一個人對耶穌說：夫子！請你吩咐我的兄長和我分開家業。
english: And one of the people said to him, Master, give an order to my brother to make division of the heritage with me.

chinese: 耶穌說：你這個人！誰立我作你們斷事的官，給你們分家業呢？
english: But he said, Man, who made me a judge or a maker of decisions for you?

chinese: 於是對眾人說：你們要謹慎自守，免去一切的貪心，因為人的生命不在乎家道豐富。
english: And he said to them, Take care to keep yourselves free from the desire for property; for a man's life is not made up of the number of things which he has.

chinese: 就用比喻對他們說：有一個財主田產豐盛；
english: And he said to them, in a story, The land of a certain man of great wealth was very fertile:

chinese: 自己心裡思想說：我的出產沒有地方收藏，怎麼辦呢？
english: And he said to himself, What is to be done? for I have no place in which to put all my fruit.

chinese: 又說：我要這麼辦：要把我的倉房拆了，另蓋更大的，在那裡好收藏我一切的糧食和財物，
english: And he said, This I will do: I will take down my store-houses and make greater ones, and there I will put all my grain and my goods.

chinese: 然後要對我的靈魂說：靈魂哪，你有許多財物積存，可作多年的費用，只管安安逸逸的吃喝快樂罷！
english: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have a great amount of goods in store, enough for a number of years; be at rest, take food and wine and be happy.

chinese: 神卻對他說：無知的人哪，今夜必要你的靈魂；你所預備的要歸誰呢？
english: But God said to him, You foolish one, tonight I will take your soul from you, and who then will be the owner of all the things which you have got together?

chinese: 凡為自己積財，在神面前卻不富足的，也是這樣。
english: So that is what comes to the man who gets wealth for himself, and has not wealth in the eyes of God.

chinese: 耶穌又對門徒說：所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮吃甚麼，為身體憂慮穿甚麼；
english: And he said to his disciples, For this reason I say to you, Take no thought for your life, about what food you will take, or for your body, how it may be clothed.

chinese: 因為生命勝於飲食，身體勝於衣裳。
english: Is not life more than food, and the body than its clothing?

chinese: 你想烏鴉，也不種也不收，又沒有倉又沒有庫，神尚且養活他。你們比飛鳥是何等的貴重呢！
english: Give thought to the ravens; they do not put seeds into the earth, or get together grain; they have no store-houses or buildings; and God gives them their food: of how much greater value are you than the birds!

chinese: 你們那一個能用思慮使壽數多加一刻呢（或作：使身量多加一肘呢）？
english: And which of you by taking thought is able to make himself any taller?

chinese: 這最小的事，你們尚且不能作，為甚麼還憂慮其餘的事呢？
english: If, then, you are not able to do even that which is least, why are you troubled about the rest?

chinese: 你想百合花怎麼長起來；他也不勞苦，也不紡線。然而我告訴你們，就是所羅門極榮華的時候，他所穿戴的，還不如這花一朵呢！
english: Give thought to the flowers: they do no work, they make no thread; and still I say to you, Even Solomon, in all his glory, was not clothed like one of these.

chinese: 你們這小信的人哪，野地裡的草今天還在，明天就丟在爐裡，神還給他這樣的妝飾，何況你們呢！
english: But if God gives such clothing to the grass in the field, which today is living, and tomorrow will be burned in the oven, how much more will he give clothing to you, O men of little faith?

chinese: 你們不要求吃甚麼，喝甚麼，也不要罣心；
english: And do not give overmuch thought to your food and drink, and let not your mind be full of doubts.

chinese: 這都是外邦人所求的。你們必須用這些東西，你們的父是知道的。
english: For the nations of the world go in search of all these things: but your Father has knowledge that you have need of them.

chinese: 你們只要求他的國，這些東西就必加給你們了。
english: But let your chief care be for his kingdom, and these other things will be given to you in addition.

chinese: 你們這小群，不要懼怕，因為你們的父樂意把國賜給你們。
english: Have no fear, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

chinese: 你們要變賣所有的賙濟人，為自己預備永不壞的錢囊，用不盡的財寶在天上，就是賊不能近、蟲不能蛀的地方。
english: Give what property you have in exchange for money, and give the money to the poor; make for yourselves money-bags which will not get old, wealth stored up in heaven which will be yours for ever, where thieves will not come nor worms put it to destruction.

chinese: 因為，你們的財寶在那裡，你們的心也在那裡。
english: For where your wealth is, there will your heart be.

chinese: 你們腰裡要束上帶，燈也要點著，
english: Be ready, dressed as for a journey, with your lights burning.

chinese: 自己好像僕人等候主人從婚姻的筵席上回來。他來到，叩門，就立刻給他開門。
english: And be like men who are looking for their lord, when he comes back from the bride-feast; so that when he comes to the door, it will be open to him quickly.

chinese: 主人來了，看見僕人儆醒，那僕人就有福了。我實在告訴你們，主人必叫他們坐席，自己束上帶，進前伺候他們。
english: Happy are those servants who are watching when the lord comes; truly I say to you, he will make himself their servant and, placing them at the table, he will come out and give them food.

chinese: 或是二更天來，或是三更天來，看見僕人這樣，那僕人就有福了。
english: And if he comes in the second division of the night or in the third, and they are watching for him, happy are those servants.

chinese: 家主若知道賊甚麼時候來，就必儆醒，不容賊挖透房屋，這是你們所知道的。
english: But be certain of this, that if the master of the house had had knowledge of the time when the thief was coming, he would have been watching, and would not have let his house be broken into.

chinese: 你們也要預備；因為你們想不到的時候，人子就來了。
english: So be ready: for the Son of man is coming at a time when you are not looking for him.

chinese: 彼得說：主阿，這比喻是為我們說的呢？還是為眾人呢？
english: And Peter said to him, Lord, are these words said to us only, or to all men?

chinese: 主說：誰是那忠心有見識的管家，主人派他管理家裡的人，按時分糧給他們呢？
english: And the Lord said, Who then is the wise and responsible servant whom his lord will put in control of his family, to give them their food at the right time?

chinese: 主人來到，看見僕人這樣行，那僕人就有福了。
english: Happy is that servant who, when his lord comes, is doing so.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
english: Truly I say to you, he will put him in control of all his goods.

chinese: 那僕人若心裡說：我的主人必來得遲，就動手打僕人和使女，並且吃喝醉酒；
english: But if that servant says to himself, My lord is a long time coming; and goes about giving blows to the men-servants and the women-servants, feasting and taking overmuch wine;

chinese: 在他想不到的日子，不知道的時辰，那僕人的主人要來，重重的處治他（或作：把他腰軋了），定他和不忠心的人同罪。
english: The lord of that servant will come at a time when he is not looking for him, and at an hour when he is not ready for him, and he will have him cut in two and will give him his part in the fate of those who have no faith;

chinese: 僕人知道主人的意思，卻不預備，又不順他的意思行，那僕人必多受責打；
english: And the servant who had knowledge of his lord's desires and was not ready for him and did not do as he was ordered, will be given a great number of blows;

chinese: 惟有那不知道的，做了當受責打的事，必少受責打；因為多給誰，就向誰多取；多託誰，就向誰多要。
english: But he who, without knowledge, did things for which punishment is given, will get only a small number of blows. The man to whom much is given, will have to give much; if much is given into his care, of him more will be requested.

chinese: 我來要把火丟在地上，倘若已經著起來，不也是我所願意的麼？
english: I came to send a fire on the earth, and it may even now have been lighted.

chinese: 我有當受的洗還沒有成就，我是何等的迫切呢？
english: But there is a baptism which I have to undergo; and how am I kept back till it is complete!

chinese: 你們以為我來，是叫地上太平麼？我告訴你們，不是，乃是叫人分爭。
english: Is it your opinion that I have come to give peace on earth? I say to you, No, but division:

chinese: 從今以後，一家五個人將要分爭：三個人和兩個人相爭，兩個人和三個人相爭；
english: For from this time, a family of five in one house will be on opposite sides, three against two and two against three.

chinese: 父親和兒子相爭，兒子和父親相爭；母親和女兒相爭，女兒和母親相爭；婆婆和媳婦相爭，媳婦和婆婆相爭。
english: They will be at war, the father against his son, and the son against his father; mother against daughter, and daughter against mother; mother-in-law against daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.

chinese: 耶穌又對眾人說：你們看見西邊起了雲彩，就說：要下一陣雨；果然就有。
english: Then he said to the people, When you see a cloud coming up in the west, straight away you say, There will be rain; and so it is.

chinese: 起了南風，就說：將要燥熱；也就有了。
english: And when you see a south wind blowing, you say, There will be heat; and so it is.

chinese: 假冒為善的人哪，你們知道分辨天地的氣色，怎麼不知道分辨這時候呢？
english: O false ones! the face of the earth and the heaven is clear to you; how is it that the signs of these times are not as clear to you?

chinese: 你們又為何不自己審量甚麼是合理的呢？
english: And why are you, in your hearts, unable to be judges of what is right?

chinese: 你同告你的對頭去見官，還在路上，務要盡力的和他了結；恐怕他拉你到官面前，官交付差役，差役把你下在監裡。
english: For if anyone has a cause at law against you, and you are going with him before the ruler, make an attempt, on the way, to come to an agreement with him, for if you do not, he may take you before the judge and the judge will give you up to the police, and they will put you in prison.

chinese: 我告訴你，若有半文錢沒有還清，你斷不能從那裡出來。
english: I say to you, You will not come out of it till you have made payment to the very last farthing.

chinese: 正當那時，有人將彼拉多使加利利人的血攙雜在他們祭物中的事告訴耶穌。
english: Now some people who were there at that time, gave him an account of how the blood of some Galilaeans had been mixed by Pilate with their offerings.

chinese: 耶穌說；你們以為這些加利利人比眾加利利人更有罪，所以受這害麼？
english: And he, in answer, said to them, Are you of the opinion that these Galilaeans were worse than all other Galilaeans, because these things were done to them?

chinese: 我告訴你們，不是的！你們若不悔改，都要如此滅亡！
english: I say to you, It is not so: but if your hearts are not changed, you will all come to the same end.

chinese: 從前西羅亞樓倒塌了，壓死十八個人；你們以為那些人比一切住在耶路撒冷的人更有罪麼？
english: Or those eighteen men who were crushed by the fall of the tower of Siloam, were they worse than all the other men living in Jerusalem?

chinese: 我告訴你們，不是的！你們若不悔改，都要如此滅亡！
english: I say to you, It is not so: but if your hearts are not changed, you will all come to an end in the same way.

chinese: 於是用比喻說：一個人有一棵無花果樹栽在葡萄園裡。他來到樹前找果子，卻找不著。
english: And he made up this story for them: A certain man had a fig-tree in his garden, and he came to get fruit from it, and there was no fruit.

chinese: 就對管園的說：看哪，我這三年來到這無花果樹前找果子，竟找不著。把他砍了罷，何必白佔地土呢！
english: And he said to the gardener, See, for three years I have been looking for fruit from this tree, and I have not had any: let it be cut down; why is it taking up space?

chinese: 管園的說：主阿，今年且留著，等我周圍掘開土，加上糞；
english: And he said, Lord, let it be for this year, and I will have the earth turned up round it, and put animal waste on it, to make it fertile:

chinese: 以後若結果子便罷，不然再把他砍了。
english: And if, after that, it has fruit, it is well; if not, let it be cut down.

chinese: 安息日，耶穌在會堂裡教訓人。
english: And he was teaching in one of the Synagogues on the Sabbath.

chinese: 有一個女人被鬼附著，病了十八年，腰彎得一點直不起來。
english: And there was a woman who had had a disease for eighteen years; she was bent, and was not able to make herself straight.

chinese: 耶穌看見，便叫過他來，對他說：女人，你脫離這病了！
english: And when Jesus saw her, he said to her, Woman, you are made free from your disease.

chinese: 於是用兩隻手按著他；他立刻直起腰來，就歸榮耀與神。
english: And he put his hands on her, and she was made straight, and gave praise to God.

chinese: 管會堂的因為耶穌在安息日治病，就氣忿忿的對眾人說：有六日應當做工；那六日之內可以來求醫，在安息日卻不可。
english: And the ruler of the Synagogue was angry because Jesus had made her well on the Sabbath, and he said to the people, There are six days in which men may do work: so come on those days to be made well, and not on the Sabbath.

chinese: 主說：假冒為善的人哪，難道你們各人在安息日不解開槽上的牛、驢，牽去飲麼？
english: But the Lord gave him an answer and said, O you false men! do you not, every one of you, on the Sabbath, let loose his ox and his ass and take it to the water?

chinese: 況且這女人本是亞伯拉罕的後裔，被撒但捆綁了這十八年，不當在安息日解開他的綁麼？
english: And is it not right for this daughter of Abraham, who has been in the power of Satan for eighteen years, to be made free on the Sabbath?

chinese: 耶穌說這話，他的敵人都慚愧了；眾人因他所行一切榮耀的事，就都歡喜了。
english: And when he said these things, those who were against him were shamed, and all the people were full of joy because of the great things which were done by him.

chinese: 耶穌說：神的國好像甚麼？我拿甚麼來比較呢？
english: Then he said, What is the kingdom of God like? what comparison may I make of it?

chinese: 好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在園子裡，長大成樹，天上的飛鳥宿在他的枝上。
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his garden, and it became a tree, and the birds of heaven made their resting-places in its branches.

chinese: 又說：我拿甚麼來比神的國呢？
english: And again he said, What is the kingdom of God like?

chinese: 好比麵酵，有婦人拿來藏在三斗麵裡，直等全糰都發起來。
english: It is like leaven, which a woman put into three measures of meal, and it was all leavened.

chinese: 耶穌往耶路撒冷去，在所經過的各城各鄉教訓人。
english: And he went on his way, through towns and country places, teaching and journeying to Jerusalem.

chinese: 有一個人問他說：主阿，得救的人少麼？
english: And someone said to him, Lord, will only a small number have salvation? And he said to them,

chinese: 耶穌對眾人說：你們要努力進窄門。我告訴你們，將來有許多人想要進去，卻是不能。
english: Do your best to go in by the narrow door, for I say to you, A number will make the attempt to go in, but will not be able to do so.

chinese: 及至家主起來關了門，你們站在外面叩門，說：主阿，給我們開門！他就回答說：我不認識你們，不曉得你們是那裡來的！
english: When the master of the house has got up, and the door has been shut, and you, still outside, give blows on the door, saying, Lord, let us in; he will make answer and say, I have no knowledge of where you come from.

chinese: 那時，你們要說：我們在你面前吃過喝過，你也在我們的街上教訓過人。
english: Then you will say, We have taken food and drink with you, and you were teaching in our streets.

chinese: 他要說：我告訴你們，我不曉得你們是那裡來的。你們這一切作惡的人，離開我去罷！
english: But he will say, Truly, I have no knowledge of you or where you come from; go away from me, you workers of evil.

chinese: 你們要看見亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，和眾先知都在神的國裡，你們卻被趕到外面，在那裡必要哀哭切齒了。
english: There will be weeping and cries of sorrow when you see Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are shut outside.

chinese: 從東、從西、從南、從北將有人來，在神的國裡坐席。
english: And they will come from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south, and take their places in the kingdom of God.

chinese: 只是有在後的，將要在前；有在前的，將要在後。
english: And the last will be first, and the first will be last.

chinese: 正當那時，有幾個法利賽人來對耶穌說：離開這裡去罷，因為希律想要殺你。
english: At that time, certain Pharisees came to him and said, Go away from this place, because Herod's purpose is to put you to death.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們去告訴那個狐狸說：今天、明天我趕鬼治病，第三天我的事就成全了。
english: And he said, Go and say to that fox, I send out evil spirits and do works of mercy today and tomorrow, and on the third day my work will be complete.

chinese: 雖然這樣，今天、明天、後天，我必須前行，因為先知在耶路撒冷之外喪命是不能的。
english: But I have to go on my way today and tomorrow and the third day, for it is not right for a prophet to come to his death outside Jerusalem.

chinese: 耶路撒冷阿！耶路撒冷阿！你常殺害先知，又用石頭打死那奉差遣到你這裡來的人。我多次願意聚集你的兒女，好像母雞把小雞聚集在翅膀底下，只是你們不願意。
english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, putting to death the prophets, and stoning those who were sent to her! again and again would I have taken your children to myself, as a bird takes her young ones under her wings, but you would not!

chinese: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。我告訴你們，從今以後你們不得再見我，直等到你們說：奉主名來的是應當稱頌的。
english: Now see, your house is waste, and I say to you, You will not see me again till you say, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord.

chinese: 安息日，耶穌到一個法利賽人的首領家裡去吃飯，他們就窺探他。
english: And it came about that when he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees on the Sabbath, to have a meal, they were watching him.

chinese: 在他面前有一個患水臌的人。
english: And a certain man was there who had a disease.

chinese: 耶穌對律法師和法利賽人說：安息日治病，可以不可以？
english: And Jesus, answering, said to the scribes and Pharisees, Is it right to make people well on the Sabbath or not?

chinese: 他們卻不言語。耶穌就治好那人，叫他走了；
english: But they said nothing. And he made him well and sent him away.

chinese: 便對他們說：你們中間誰有驢或有牛，在安息日掉在井裡，不立時拉他上來呢？
english: And he said to them, Which of you, whose ox or ass has got into a water-hole, will not straight away get him out on the Sabbath?

chinese: 他們不能對答這話。
english: And they had no answer to that question.

chinese: 耶穌見所請的客揀擇首位，就用比喻對他們說：
english: And he gave teaching in the form of a story to the guests who came to the feast, when he saw how they took the best seats; saying to them,

chinese: 你被人請去赴婚姻的筵席，不要坐在首位上，恐怕有比你尊貴的客被他請來；
english: When you get a request to come to a feast, do not take the best seat, for a more important man than you may be coming,

chinese: 那請你們的人前來對你說：讓座給這一位罷！你就羞羞慚慚的退到末位上去了。
english: And then the giver of the feast will come to you and say, Give your place to this man; and you, with shame, will have to take the lowest seat.

chinese: 你被請的時候，就去坐在末位上，好叫那請你的人來對你說：朋友，請上坐。那時，你在同席的人面前就有光彩了。
english: But when you come, go and take the lowest seat, so that when the giver of the feast comes, he may say to you, Friend, come up higher; and then you will have honour in the eyes of all the others who are there.

chinese: 因為，凡自高的，必降為卑，自卑的，必升為高。
english: For every man who gives himself a high place will be put down, but he who takes a low place will be lifted up.

chinese: 耶穌又對請他的人說：你擺設午飯或晚飯，不要請你的朋友、弟兄、親屬，和富足的鄰舍，恐怕他們也請你，你就得了報答。
english: And he said to the master of the house, When you give a feast, do not send for your friends and your brothers and your family or your neighbours who have wealth, for they may give a feast for you, and so you will get a reward.

chinese: 你擺設筵席，倒要請那貧窮的、殘廢的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，你就有福了！
english: But when you give a feast, send for the poor and the blind and those who are broken in body:

chinese: 因為他們沒有甚麼可報答你。到義人復活的時候，你要得著報答。
english: And you will have a blessing, because they will not be able to give you any payment, and you will get your reward when the upright come back from the dead.

chinese: 同席的有一人聽見這話，就對耶穌說：在神國裡吃飯的有福了！
english: And, hearing these words, one of those who were at table with him said to him, Happy is the man who will be a guest in the kingdom of God.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：有一人擺設大筵席，請了許多客。
english: And he said to them, A certain man gave a great feast, and sent word of it to a number of people.

chinese: 到了坐席的時候，打發僕人去對所請的人說：請來罷！樣樣都齊備了。
english: And when the time had come, he sent his servants to say to them, Come, for all things are now ready.

chinese: 眾人一口同音的推辭。頭一個說：我買了一塊地，必須去看看。請你准我辭了。
english: And they all gave reasons why they were not able to come. The first said to him, I have got a new field, and it is necessary for me to go and see it: I am full of regret that I am unable to come.

chinese: 又有一個說：我買了五對牛，要去試一試。請你准我辭了。
english: And another said, I have got some cattle, and I am going to make a test of them: I am full of regret that I am unable to come.

chinese: 又有一個說：我才娶了妻，所以不能去。
english: And another said, I have been married, and so I am not able to come.

chinese: 那僕人回來，把這事都告訴了主人。家主就動怒，對僕人說：快出去，到城裡大街小巷，領那貧窮的、殘廢的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的來。
english: And the servant came back and gave his master an account of these things. Then the master of the house was angry and said to the servant, Go out quickly into the streets of the town and get the poor, the blind, and those who are broken in body.

chinese: 僕人說：主阿，你所吩咐的已經辦了，還有空座。
english: And the servant said, Lord, your orders have been done, and still there is room.

chinese: 主人對僕人說，你出去到路上和籬笆那裡，勉強人進來，坐滿我的屋子。
english: And the lord said to the servant, Go out into the roads and the fields, and make them come in, so that my house may be full.

chinese: 我告訴你們，先前所請的人，沒有一個得嘗我的筵席。
english: For I say to you that not one of those who were requested to come will have a taste of my feast.

chinese: 有極多的人和耶穌同行。他轉過來對他們說：
english: Now a great number of people went with him.

chinese: 人到我這裡來，若不愛我勝過愛（愛我勝過愛：原文是恨）自己的父母、妻子、兒女、弟兄、姐妹，和自己的性命，就不能作我的門徒。
english: And turning round, he said to them, If any man comes to me, and has not hate for his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters, and even for his life, he may not be my disciple.

chinese: 凡不背著自己十字架跟從我的，也不能作我的門徒。
english: Whoever does not take up his cross and come after me may not be my disciple.

chinese: 你們那一個要蓋一座樓，不先坐下算計花費，能蓋成不能呢？
english: For which of you, desiring to put up a tower, does not first give much thought to the price, if he will have enough to make it complete?

chinese: 恐怕安了地基，不能成功，看見的人都笑話他，說：
english: For fear that if he makes a start and is not able to go on with it to the end, all who see it will be laughing at him,

chinese: 這個人開了工，卻不能完工。
english: And saying, This man made a start at building and is not able to make it complete.

chinese: 或是一個王出去和別的王打仗，豈不先坐下酌量，能用一萬兵去敵那領二萬兵來攻打他的麼？
english: Or what king, going to war with another king, will not first take thought if he will be strong enough, with ten thousand men, to keep off him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

chinese: 若是不能，就趁敵人還遠的時候，派使者去求和息的條款。
english: Or while the other is still a great distance away, he sends representatives requesting conditions of peace.

chinese: 這樣，你們無論甚麼人，若不撇下一切所有的，就不能作我的門徒。
english: And so whoever is not ready to give up all he has may not be my disciple.

chinese: 鹽本是好的；鹽若失了味，可用甚麼叫他再鹹呢？
english: For salt is good, but if the taste goes from it, of what use is it?

chinese: 或用在田裡，或堆在糞裡，都不合式，只好丟在外面。有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
english: It is no good for the land or for the place of waste; no one has a use for it. He who has ears, let him give ear.

chinese: 眾稅吏和罪人都挨近耶穌，要聽他講道。
english: Now all the tax-farmers and sinners came near to give ear to him.

chinese: 法利賽人和文士私下議論說：這個人接待罪人，又同他們吃飯。
english: And the Pharisees and scribes were angry, saying, This man gives approval to sinners, and takes food with them.

chinese: 耶穌就用比喻說：
english: And he made a story for them, saying,

chinese: 你們中間誰有一百隻羊失去一隻，不把這九十九隻撇在曠野、去找那失去的羊，直到找著呢？
english: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if one of them gets loose and goes away, will not let the ninety-nine be in the waste land by themselves, and go after the wandering one, till he sees where it is?

chinese: 找著了，就歡歡喜喜的扛在肩上，回到家裡，
english: And when he has got it again, he takes it in his arms with joy.

chinese: 就請朋友鄰舍來，對他們說：我失去的羊已經找著了，你們和我一同歡喜罷！
english: And when he gets back to his house, he sends for his neighbours and friends, saying to them, Be glad with me, for I have got back my sheep which had gone away.

chinese: 我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在天上也要這樣為他歡喜，較比為九十九個不用悔改的義人歡喜更大。
english: I say to you that even so there will be more joy in heaven when one sinner is turned away from his wrongdoing, than for ninety-nine good men, who have no need of a change of heart.

chinese: 或是一個婦人有十塊錢，若失落一塊，豈不點上燈，打掃屋子，細細的找，直到找著麼？
english: Or what woman, having ten bits of silver, if one bit has gone from her hands, will not get a light, and go through her house, searching with care till she sees it?

chinese: 找著了，就請朋友鄰舍來，對他們說：我失落的那塊錢已經找著了，你們和我一同歡喜罷！
english: And when she has it again, she gets her friends and neighbours together, saying, Be glad with me, for I have got back the bit of silver which had gone from me.

chinese: 我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在神的使者面前也是這樣為他歡喜。」
english: Even so, I say to you, There is joy among the angels of God, when one sinner is turned away from his wrongdoing.

chinese: 耶穌又說：一個人有兩個兒子。
english: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

chinese: 小兒子對父親說：父親，請你把我應得的家業分給我。他父親就把產業分給他們。
english: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me that part of your property which will be mine. And he made division of his goods between them.

chinese: 過了不多幾日，小兒子就把他一切所有的都收拾起來，往遠方去了。在那裡任意放蕩，浪費貲財。
english: And not long after, the younger son got together everything which was his and took a journey into a far-away country, and there all his money went in foolish living.

chinese: 既耗盡了一切所有的，又遇著那地方大遭饑荒，就窮苦起來。
english: And when everything was gone, there was no food to be had in that country, and he was in need.

chinese: 於是去投靠那地方的一個人；那人打發他到田裡去放豬。
english: And he went and put himself into the hands of one of the people of that country, and he sent him into his fields to give the pigs their food.

chinese: 他恨不得拿豬所吃的豆莢充飢，也沒有人給他。
english: And so great was his need that he would have been glad to take the pigs' food, and no one gave him anything.

chinese: 他醒悟過來，就說：我父親有多少的雇工，口糧有餘，我倒在這裡餓死麼？
english: But when he came to his senses, he said, What numbers of my father's servants have bread enough, and more, while I am near to death here through need of food!

chinese: 我要起來，到我父親那裡去，向他說：父親！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will say to him, Father, I have done wrong, against heaven and in your eyes:

chinese: 從今以後，我不配稱為你的兒子，把我當作一個雇工罷！
english: I am no longer good enough to be named your son: make me like one of your servants.

chinese: 於是起來，往他父親那裡去。相離還遠，他父親看見，就動了慈心，跑去抱著他的頸項，連連與他親嘴。
english: And he got up and went to his father. But while he was still far away, his father saw him and was moved with pity for him and went quickly and took him in his arms and gave him a kiss.

chinese: 兒子說：父親！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；從今以後，我不配稱為你的兒子。
english: And his son said to him, Father, I have done wrong, against heaven and in your eyes: I am no longer good enough to be named your son.

chinese: 父親卻吩咐僕人說：把那上好的袍子快拿出來給他穿；把戒指戴在他指頭上；把鞋穿在他腳上；
english: But the father said to his servants, Get out the first robe quickly, and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand and shoes on his feet:

chinese: 把那肥牛犢牽來宰了，我們可以吃喝快樂；
english: And get the fat young ox and put it to death, and let us have a feast, and be glad.

chinese: 因為我這個兒子是死而復活，失而又得的。他們就快樂起來。
english: For this, my son, who was dead, is living again; he had gone away from me, and has come back. And they were full of joy.

chinese: 那時，大兒子正在田裡。他回來，離家不遠，聽見作樂跳舞的聲音，
english: Now the older son was in the field: and when he came near the house, the sounds of music and dancing came to his ears.

chinese: 便叫過一個僕人來，問是甚麼事。
english: And he sent for one of the servants, questioning him about what it might be.

chinese: 僕人說：你兄弟來了；你父親因為得他無災無病的回來，把肥牛犢宰了。
english: And he said to him, Your brother has come; and your father has had the young ox put to death because he has come back safely.

chinese: 大兒子卻生氣，不肯進去；他父親就出來勸他。
english: But he was angry and would not go in; and his father came out and made a request to him to come in.

chinese: 他對父親說：我服事你這多年，從來沒有違背過你的命，你並沒有給我一隻山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同快樂。
english: But he made answer and said to his father, See, all these years I have been your servant, doing your orders in everything: and you never gave me even a young goat so that I might have a feast with my friends:

chinese: 但你這個兒子和娼妓吞盡了你的產業，他一來了，你倒為他宰了肥牛犢。
english: But when this your son came, who has been wasting your property with bad women, you put to death the fat young ox for him.

chinese: 父親對他說：兒阿！你常和我同在，我一切所有的都是你的；
english: And he said to him, Son, you are with me at all times, and all I have is yours.

chinese: 只是你這個兄弟是死而復活、失而又得的，所以我們理當歡喜快樂。
english: But it was right to be glad and to have a feast; for this your brother, who was dead, is living again; he had gone away and has come back.

chinese: 耶穌又對門徒說：有一個財主的管家，別人向他主人告他浪費主人的財物。
english: And another time he said to the disciples, There was a certain man of great wealth who had a servant; and it was said to him that this servant was wasting his goods.

chinese: 主人叫他來，對他說：我聽見你這事怎麼樣呢？把你所經管的交代明白，因你不能再作我的管家。
english: And he sent for him and said, What is this which is said about you? give me an account of all you have done, for you will no longer be the manager of my property.

chinese: 那管家心裡說：主人辭我，不用我再作管家，我將來作甚麼？鋤地呢？無力；討飯呢？怕羞。
english: And the servant said to himself, What am I to do now that my lord takes away my position? I have not enough strength for working in the fields, and I would be shamed if I made requests for money from people in the streets.

chinese: 我知道怎麼行，好叫人在我不作管家之後，接我到他們家裡去。
english: I have come to a decision what to do, so that when I am put out of my position they will take me into their houses.

chinese: 於是把欠他主人債的，一個一個的叫了來，問頭一個說：你欠我主人多少？
english: And sending for every one who was in debt to his lord he said to the first, What is the amount of your debt to my lord?

chinese: 他說：一百簍（每簍約五十斤）油。管家說：拿你的賬，快坐下，寫五十。
english: And he said, A hundred measures of oil. And he said, Take your account straight away and put down fifty.

chinese: 又問一個說：你欠多少？他說：一百石麥子。管家說：拿你的賬，寫八十。
english: Then he said to another, What is the amount of your debt? And he said, A hundred measures of grain. And he said to him, Take your account and put down eighty.

chinese: 主人就誇獎這不義的管家做事聰明。因為今世之子，在世事之上，較比光明之子更加聰明。
english: And his lord was pleased with the false servant, because he had been wise; for the sons of this world are wiser in relation to their generation than the sons of light.

chinese: 我又告訴你們，要藉著那不義的錢財結交朋友，到了錢財無用的時候，他們可以接你們到永存的帳幕裡去。
english: And I say to you, Make friends for yourselves through the wealth of this life, so that when it comes to an end, you may be taken into the eternal resting-places.

chinese: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不義，在大事上也不義。
english: He who is true in a little, is true in much; he who is false in small things, is false in great.

chinese: 倘若你們在不義的錢財上不忠心，誰還把那真實的錢財託付你們呢？
english: If, then, you have not been true in your use of the wealth of this life, who will give into your care the true wealth?

chinese: 倘若你們在別人的東西上不忠心，誰還把你們自己的東西給你們呢？
english: And if you have not been true in your care of the property of other people, who will give you that which is yours?

chinese: 一個僕人不能事奉兩個主；不是惡這個愛那個，就是重這個輕那個。你們不能又事奉神，又事奉瑪門。
english: No man may be a servant to two masters: for he will have hate for the one and love for the other; or he will keep to the one and have no respect for the other. You may not be servants of God and of wealth.

chinese: 法利賽人是貪愛錢財的，他們聽見這一切話，就嗤笑耶穌。
english: And the Pharisees, who had a great love of money, hearing these things, were making sport of him.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們是在人面前自稱為義的，你們的心，神卻知道；因為人所尊貴的，是神看為可憎惡的。
english: And he said, You take care to seem right in the eyes of men, but God sees your hearts: and those things which are important in the opinion of men, are evil in the eyes of God.

chinese: 律法和先知到約翰為止，從此神國的福音傳開了，人人努力要進去。
english: The law and the prophets were till John: but then came the preaching of the kingdom of God, and everyone makes his way into it by force.

chinese: 天地廢去較比律法的一點一畫落空還容易。
english: But heaven and earth will come to an end before the smallest letter of the law may be dropped out.

chinese: 凡休妻另娶的就是犯姦淫；娶被休之妻的也是犯姦淫。
english: Everyone who puts away his wife and takes another, is a false husband: and he who is married to a woman whose husband has put her away, is no true husband to her.

chinese: 有一個財主穿著紫色袍和細麻布衣服，天天奢華宴樂。
english: Now there was a certain man of great wealth, who was dressed in fair clothing of purple and delicate linen, and was shining and glad every day.

chinese: 又有一個討飯的，名叫拉撒路，渾身生瘡，被人放在財主門口，
english: And a certain poor man, named Lazarus, was stretched out at his door, full of wounds,

chinese: 要得財主桌子上掉下來的零碎充飢；並且狗來餂他的瘡。
english: Desiring the broken bits of food which came from the table of the man of wealth; and even the dogs came and put their tongues on his wounds.

chinese: 後來那討飯的死了，被天使帶去放在亞伯拉罕的懷裡。財主也死了，並且埋葬了。
english: And in time the poor man came to his end, and angels took him to Abraham's breast. And the man of wealth came to his end, and was put in the earth.

chinese: 他在陰間受痛苦，舉目遠遠的望見亞伯拉罕，又望見拉撒路在他懷裡，
english: And in hell, being in great pain, lifting up his eyes he saw Abraham, far away, and Lazarus on his breast.

chinese: 就喊著說：我祖亞伯拉罕哪，可憐我罷！打發拉撒路來，用指頭尖蘸點水，涼涼我的舌頭；因為我在這火燄裡，極其痛苦。
english: And he gave a cry and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus, so that he may put the end of his finger in water and put it on my tongue, for I am cruelly burning in this flame.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：兒阿，你該回想你生前享過福，拉撒路也受過苦；如今他在這裡得安慰，你倒受痛苦。
english: But Abraham said, Keep in mind, my son, that when you were living, you had your good things, while Lazarus had evil things: but now, he is comforted and you are in pain.

chinese: 不但這樣，並且在你我之間，有深淵限定，以致人要從這邊過到你們那邊是不能的；要從那邊過到我們這邊也是不能的。
english: And in addition, there is a deep division fixed between us and you, so that those who might go from here to you are not able to do so, and no one may come from you to us.

chinese: 財主說：我祖阿！既是這樣，求你打發拉撒路到我父家去；
english: And he said, Father, it is my request that you will send him to my father's house;

chinese: 因為我還有五個弟兄，他可以對他們作見證，免得他們也來到這痛苦的地方。
english: For I have five brothers; and let him give them an account of these things, so that they may not come to this place of pain.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：他們有摩西和先知的話可以聽從。
english: But Abraham said, They have Moses and the prophets; let them give ear to what they say.

chinese: 他說：我祖亞伯拉罕哪，不是的，若有一個從死裡復活的，到他們那裡去的，他們必要悔改。
english: And he said, No, father Abraham, but if someone went to them from the dead, their hearts would be changed.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕說：若不聽從摩西和先知的話，就是有一個從死裡復活的，他們也是不聽勸。
english: And he said to him, If they will not give attention to Moses and the prophets, they will not be moved even if someone comes back from the dead.

chinese: 耶穌又對門徒說：絆倒人的事是免不了的；但那絆倒人的有禍了。
english: And he said to his disciples, It is necessary for causes of trouble to come about, but unhappy is he by whom they come.

chinese: 就是把磨石拴在這人的頸項上，丟在海裡，還強如他把這小子裡的一個絆倒了。
english: It would be well for him if a great stone was put round his neck and he was dropped into the sea, before he made trouble for any of these little ones.

chinese: 你們要謹慎！若是你的弟兄得罪你，就勸戒他；他若懊悔，就饒恕他。
english: Give attention to yourselves: if your brother does wrong, say a sharp word to him; and if he has sorrow for his sin, let him have forgiveness.

chinese: 倘若他一天七次得罪你，又七次回轉，說：我懊悔了，你總要饒恕他。
english: And if he does you wrong seven times in a day, and seven times comes to you and says, I have regret for what I have done; let him have forgiveness.

chinese: 使徒對主說：求主加增我們的信心。
english: And the twelve said to the Lord, Make our faith greater.

chinese: 主說：你們若有信心像一粒芥菜種，就是對這棵桑樹說：你要拔起根來，栽在海裡，他也必聽從你們。
english: And the Lord said, If your faith was only as great as a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this tree, Be rooted up and planted in the sea; and it would be done.

chinese: 你們誰有僕人耕地或是放羊，從田裡回來，就對他說：你快來坐下吃飯呢？
english: But which of you, having a servant who is ploughing or keeping sheep, will say to him, when he comes in from the field, Come now and be seated and have a meal,

chinese: 豈不對他說：你給我預備晚飯，束上帶子伺候我，等我吃喝完了，你才可以吃喝麼？
english: Will he not say, Get a meal for me, and make yourself ready and see to my needs till I have had my food and drink; and after that you may have yours?

chinese: 僕人照所吩咐的去做，主人還謝謝他麼？
english: Does he give praise to the servant because he did what was ordered?

chinese: 這樣，你們做完了一切所吩咐的，只當說：我們是無用的僕人，所做的本是我們應分做的。
english: In the same way, when you have done all the things which are given you to do, say, There is no profit in us, for we have only done what we were ordered to do.

chinese: 耶穌往耶路撒冷去，經過撒瑪利亞和加利利。
english: And it came about that when they were on the way to Jerusalem he went through Samaria and Galilee.

chinese: 進入一個村子，有十個長大痲瘋的，迎面而來，遠遠的站著，
english: And when he went into a certain small town he came across ten men who were lepers, and they, keeping themselves at a distance,

chinese: 高聲說：耶穌，夫子，可憐我們罷！
english: Said, in loud voices, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

chinese: 耶穌看見，就對他們說：你們去把身體給祭司察看。他們去的時候就潔淨了。
english: And when he saw them he said, Go, and let the priests see you. And, while they were going, they were made clean.

chinese: 內中有一個見自己已經好了，就回來大聲歸榮耀與神，
english: And one of them, when he saw that he was clean, turning back, gave praise to God in a loud voice;

chinese: 又俯伏在耶穌腳前感謝他；這人是撒瑪利亞人。
english: And, falling down on his face at the feet of Jesus, he gave the credit to him; and he was a man of Samaria.

chinese: 耶穌說：潔淨了的不是十個人麼？那九個在那裡呢？
english: And Jesus said, Were there not ten men who were made clean? where are the nine?

chinese: 除了這外族人，再沒有別人回來歸榮耀與神麼？
english: Have not any of them come back to give glory to God, but only this one from a strange land?

chinese: 就對那人說：起來，走罷！你的信救了你了。
english: And he said to him, Get up, and go on your way; your faith has made you well.

chinese: 法利賽人問：神的國幾時來到？耶穌回答說：神的國來到不是眼所能見的。
english: And when the Pharisees put questions to him about when the kingdom of God would come, he gave them an answer and said, The kingdom of God will not come through observation:

chinese: 人也不得說：看哪，在這裡！看哪，在那裡！因為神的國就在你們心裡（心裡：或作中間）。
english: And men will not say, See, it is here! or, There! for the kingdom of God is among you.

chinese: 他又對門徒說：日子將到，你們巴不得看見人子的一個日子，卻不得看見。
english: And he said to his disciples, The time will come when you will have a great desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, but you will not see it.

chinese: 人將要對你們說：看哪，在那裡！看哪，在這裡！你們不要出去，也不要跟隨他們！
english: And if they say to you, See, it is there! or, It is here! do not go away, or go after them.

chinese: 因為人子在他降臨的日子，好像閃電從天這邊一閃直照到天那邊。
english: For as in a thunderstorm the bright light is seen from one end of the sky to the other, so will the Son of man be when his time comes.

chinese: 只是他必須先受許多苦，又被這世代棄絕。
english: But first, he will have to undergo much and be put on one side by this generation.

chinese: 挪亞的日子怎樣，人子的日子也要怎樣。
english: And as it was in the days of Noah, so will it be in the day of the Son of man.

chinese: 那時候的人又吃又喝，又娶又嫁，到挪亞進方舟的那日，洪水就來，把他們全都滅了。
english: They were feasting and taking wives and getting married, till the day of the overflowing of the waters, when Noah went into the ark, and they all came to destruction.

chinese: 又好像羅得的日子；人又吃又喝，又買又賣，又耕種又蓋造。
english: In the same way, in the days of Lot; they were feasting and trading, they were planting and building;

chinese: 到羅得出所多瑪的那日，就有火與硫磺從天上降下來，把他們全都滅了。
english: But on the day when Lot went out of Sodom, fire came down from heaven and destruction came on them all.

chinese: 人子顯現的日子也要這樣。
english: So will it be in the day of the revelation of the Son of man.

chinese: 當那日，人在房上，器具在屋裡，不要下來拿；人在田裡，也不要回家。
english: On that day, if anyone is on the roof of the house, and his goods are in the house, let him not go down to take them away; and let him who is in the field not go back to his house.

chinese: 你們要回想羅得的妻子。
english: Keep in mind Lot's wife.

chinese: 凡想要保全生命的，必喪掉生命；凡喪掉生命的，必救活生命。
english: If anyone makes an attempt to keep his life, it will be taken from him, but if anyone gives up his life, he will keep it.

chinese: 我對你們說，當那一夜，兩個人在一個床上，要取去一個，撇下一個。
english: I say to you, In that night there will be two men sleeping in one bed, and one will be taken away and the other let go.

chinese: 兩個女人一同推磨；要取去一個，撇下一個。（有古卷在此有：
english: Two women will be crushing grain together; one will be taken away and the other let go.

chinese: 兩個人在田裡，要取去一個，撇下一個。）
門徒說：主阿，在那裡有這事呢？耶穌說：屍首在那裡，鷹也必聚在那裡。
english: And they, answering him, said, Where, Lord? And he said to them, Where the body is, there will the eagles come together.

chinese: 耶穌設一個比喻，是要人常常禱告，不可灰心。
english: And he made a story for them, the point of which was that men were to go on making prayer and not get tired;

chinese: 說：某城裡有一個官，不懼怕神，也不尊重世人。
english: Saying, There was a judge in a certain town, who had no fear of God or respect for man:

chinese: 那城裡有個寡婦，常到他那裡，說：我有一個對頭，求你給我伸冤。
english: And there was a widow in that town, and she kept on coming to him and saying, Give me my right against the man who has done me wrong.

chinese: 他多日不准。後來心裡說：我雖不懼怕神，也不尊重世人，
english: And for a time he would not: but later, he said to himself, Though I have no fear of God or respect for man,

chinese: 只因這寡婦煩擾我，我就給他伸冤罷，免得他常來纏磨我！
english: Because this widow is a trouble to me, I will give her her right; for if not, I will be completely tired out by her frequent coming.

chinese: 主說：你們聽這不義之官所說的話。
english: And the Lord said, Give ear to the words of the evil judge.

chinese: 神的選民晝夜呼籲他，他縱然為他們忍了多時，豈不終久給他們伸冤麼？
english: And will not God do right in the cause of his saints, whose cries come day and night to his ears, though he is long in doing it?

chinese: 我告訴你們，要快快的給他們伸冤了。然而，人子來的時候，遇得見世上有信德麼？
english: I say to you that he will quickly do right in their cause. But when the Son of man comes, will there be any faith on earth?

chinese: 耶穌向那些仗著自己是義人，藐視別人的，設一個比喻，
english: And he made this story for some people who were certain that they were good, and had a low opinion of others:

chinese: 說：有兩個人上殿裡去禱告：一個是法利賽人，一個是稅吏。
english: Two men went up to the Temple for prayer; one a Pharisee, and the other a tax-farmer.

chinese: 法利賽人站著，自言自語的禱告說：神阿，我感謝你，我不像別人勒索、不義、姦淫，也不像這個稅吏。
english: The Pharisee, taking up his position, said to himself these words: God, I give you praise because I am not like other men, who take more than their right, who are evil-doers, who are untrue to their wives, or even like this tax-farmer.

chinese: 我一個禮拜禁食兩次，凡我所得的都捐上十分之一。
english: Twice in the week I go without food; I give a tenth of all I have.

chinese: 那稅吏遠遠的站著，連舉目望天也不敢，只捶著胸說：神阿，開恩可憐我這個罪人！
english: The tax-farmer, on the other hand, keeping far away, and not lifting up even his eyes to heaven, made signs of grief and said, God, have mercy on me, a sinner.

chinese: 我告訴你們，這人回家去比那人倒算為義了；因為，凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。
english: I say to you, This man went back to his house with God's approval, and not the other: for everyone who makes himself high will be made low and whoever makes himself low will be made high.

chinese: 有人抱著自己的嬰孩來見耶穌，要他摸他們；門徒看見就責備那些人。
english: And they took their children to him, so that he might put his hands on them: but when the disciples saw it, they said sharp words to them

chinese: 耶穌卻叫他們來，說：讓小孩子到我這裡來，不要禁止他們；因為在神國的正是這樣的人。
english: But Jesus sent for them, saying, Let the children come to me, and do not keep them away, for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，凡要承受神國的，若不像小孩子，斷不能進去。
english: Truly I say to you, Whoever does not put himself under the kingdom of God like a little child, will not come into it at all.

chinese: 有一個官問耶穌說：良善的夫子，我該做甚麼事才可以承受永生？
english: And a certain ruler put a question to him, saying, Good Master, what have I to do so that I may have eternal life?

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你為甚麼稱我是良善的？除了神一位之外，再沒有良善的。
english: And Jesus said to him, Why do you say that I am good? No one is good, but only God.

chinese: 誡命你是曉得的：不可姦淫；不可殺人；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；當孝敬父母。
english: You have knowledge of what the law says: Do not be untrue to your wife, Do not put anyone to death, Do not take what is not yours, Do not give false witness, Give honour to your father and mother.

chinese: 那人說：這一切我從小都遵守了。
english: And he said, All these things I have done from the time when I was a boy.

chinese: 耶穌聽見了，就說：你還缺少一件：要變賣你一切所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。
english: And Jesus, hearing it, said to him, One thing you still have need of; get money for your goods, and give it away to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven; and come after me.

chinese: 他聽見這話，就甚憂愁，因為他很富足。
english: But at these words he became very sad, for he had great wealth.

chinese: 耶穌看見他，就說：有錢財的人進神的國是何等的難哪！
english: And Jesus, looking at him, said, How hard it is for those who have wealth to get into the kingdom of God!

chinese: 駱駝穿過針的眼比財主進神的國還容易呢！
english: It is simpler for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a man who has much money to come into the kingdom of God.

chinese: 聽見的人說：這樣，誰能得救呢？
english: And those who were present said, Then who may have salvation?

chinese: 耶穌說：在人所不能的事，在神卻能。
english: But he said, Things which are not possible with man are possible with God.

chinese: 彼得說：看哪，我們已經撇下自己所有的跟從你了。
english: And Peter said, See, we have given up what is ours to come after you.

chinese: 耶穌說：我實在告訴你們，人為神的國撇下房屋，或是妻子、弟兄、父母、兒女，
english: And he said to them, Truly I say to you, There is no man who has given up house or wife or brothers or father or mother or children, because of the kingdom of God,

chinese: 沒有在今世不得百倍，在來世不得永生的。
english: Who will not get much more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.

chinese: 耶穌帶著十二個門徒，對他們說：看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，先知所寫的一切事都要成就在人子身上。
english: And he took with him the twelve and said to them, Now we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things which were said by the prophets will be done to the Son of man.

chinese: 他將要被交給外邦人，他們要戲弄他，凌辱他，吐唾沫在他臉上，
english: For he will be given up to the Gentiles, and will be made sport of and put to shame:

chinese: 並要鞭打他，殺害他；第三日他要復活。
english: And he will be given cruel blows and put to death, and on the third day he will come back to life.

chinese: 這些事門徒一樣也不懂得，意思乃是隱藏的；他們不曉得所說的是甚麼。
english: But they did not take in the sense of any of these words, and what he said was not clear to them, and their minds were not able to see it.

chinese: 耶穌將近耶利哥的時候，有一個瞎子坐在路旁討飯。
english: And it came about that when he got near Jericho, a certain blind man was seated by the side of the road, making requests for money from those who went by.

chinese: 聽見許多人經過，就問是甚麼事。
english: And hearing the sound of a great number of people going by, he said, What is this?

chinese: 他們告訴他，是拿撒勒人耶穌經過。
english: And they said to him, Jesus of Nazareth is going by.
