chinese: 他就呼叫說：大衛的子孫耶穌阿，可憐我罷！
english: And he said in a loud voice, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

chinese: 在前頭走的人就責備他，不許他作聲；他卻越發喊叫說：大衛的子孫，可憐我罷！
english: And those who were in front made protests and said to him, Be quiet: but he said all the more, O Son of David, have mercy on me.

chinese: 耶穌站住，吩咐把他領過來，到了跟前，就問他說：
english: And Jesus, stopping, gave orders that he was to come to him, and when he came near, he said to him,

chinese: 你要我為你做甚麼？他說：主阿，我要能看見。
english: What would you have me do for you? And he said, Lord, that I may be able to see again.

chinese: 耶穌說：你可以看見！你的信救了你了。
english: And Jesus said, See again: your faith has made you well.

chinese: 瞎子立刻看見了，就跟隨耶穌，一路歸榮耀與神。眾人看見這事，也讚美神。
english: And straight away he was able to see, and he went after him, giving glory to God; and all the people when they saw it gave praise to God.

chinese: 耶穌進了耶利哥，正經過的時候，
english: And he went into Jericho, and when he was going through it,

chinese: 有一個人名叫撒該，作稅吏長，是個財主。
english: A man, named Zacchaeus, who was the chief tax-farmer, and a man of wealth,

chinese: 他要看看耶穌是怎樣的人；只因人多，他的身量又矮，所以不得看見，
english: Made an attempt to get a view of Jesus, and was not able to do so, because of the people, for he was a small man.

chinese: 就跑到前頭，爬上桑樹，要看耶穌，因為耶穌必從那裡經過。
english: And he went quickly in front of them and got up into a tree to see him, for he was going that way.

chinese: 耶穌到了那裡，抬頭一看，對他說：撒該，快下來！今天我必住在你家裡。
english: And when Jesus came to the place, looking up, he said to him, Zacchaeus, be quick and come down, for I am coming to your house today.

chinese: 他就急忙下來，歡歡喜喜的接待耶穌。
english: And he came down quickly, and took him into his house with joy.

chinese: 眾人看見，都私下議論說：他竟到罪人家裡去住宿。
english: And when they saw it, they were all angry, saying, He has gone into the house of a sinner.

chinese: 撒該站著對主說：主阿，我把所有的一半給窮人；我若訛詐了誰，就還他四倍。
english: And Zacchaeus, waiting before him, said to the Lord, See, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor, and if I have taken anything from anyone wrongly, I give him back four times as much.

chinese: 耶穌說：今天救恩到了這家，因為他也是亞伯拉罕的子孫。
english: And Jesus said to him, Today salvation has come to this house, for even he is a son of Abraham.

chinese: 人子來，為要尋找，拯救失喪的人。
english: For the Son of man came to make search for those who are wandering from the way, and to be their Saviour.

chinese: 眾人正在聽見這些話的時候，耶穌因為將近耶路撒冷，又因他們以為神的國快要顯出來，就另設一個比喻，說：
english: And while they were giving ear to these words, he made another story for them, because he was near Jerusalem, and because they were of the opinion that the kingdom of God was coming straight away.

chinese: 有一個貴冑往遠方去，要得國回來，
english: So he said, A certain man of high birth went into a far-away country to get a kingdom for himself, and to come back.

chinese: 便叫了他的十個僕人來，交給他們十錠（錠：原文作彌拿約銀十兩）銀子，說：你們去作生意，直等我回來。
english: And he sent for ten of his servants and gave them ten pounds and said to them, Do business with this till I come.

chinese: 他本國的人卻恨他，打發使者隨後去，說：我們不願意這個人作我們的王。
english: But his people had no love for him, and sent representatives after him, saying, We will not have this man for our ruler.

chinese: 他既得國回來，就吩咐叫那領銀子的僕人來，要知道他們做生意賺了多少。
english: And when he came back again, having got his kingdom, he gave orders for those servants to whom he had given the money to come to him, so that he might have an account of what business they had done.

chinese: 頭一個上來，說：主阿，你的一錠銀子已經賺了十錠。
english: And the first came before him, saying, Lord, your pound has made ten pounds.

chinese: 主人說：好！良善的僕人，你既在最小的事上有忠心，可以有權柄管十座城。
english: And he said to him, You have done well, O good servant: because you have done well in a small thing you will have authority over ten towns.

chinese: 第二個來，說：主阿！你的一錠銀子，已經賺了五錠。
english: And another came, saying, Your pound has made five pounds.

chinese: 主人說：你也可以管五座城。
english: And he said, You will be ruler over five towns.

chinese: 又有一個來說：主阿，看哪，你的一錠銀子在這裡，我把他包在手巾裡存著。
english: And another came, saying, Lord, here is your pound, which I put away in a cloth;

chinese: 我原是怕你，因為你是嚴厲的人；沒有放下的，還要去拿；沒有種下的，還要去收。
english: Because I was in fear of you, for you are a hard man: you take up what you have not put down, and get in grain where you have not put seed.

chinese: 主人對他說：你這惡僕，我要憑你的口定你的罪。你既知道我是嚴厲的人，沒有放下的，還要去拿，沒有種下的，還要去收，
english: He said to him, By the words of your mouth you will be judged, you bad servant. You had knowledge that I am a hard man, taking up what I have not put down and getting in grain where I have not put seed;

chinese: 為甚麼不把我的銀子交給銀行，等我來的時候，連本帶利都可以要回來呢？
english: Why then did you not put my money in a bank, so that when I came I would get it back with interest?

chinese: 就對旁邊站著的人說：奪過他這一錠來，給那有十錠的。
english: And he said to the others who were near, Take the pound away from him, and give it to the man who has ten.

chinese: 他們說：主阿，他已經有十錠了。
english: And they say to him, Lord, he has ten pounds.

chinese: 主人說：我告訴你們，凡有的，還要加給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪過來。
english: And I say to you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.

chinese: 至於我那些仇敵，不要我作他們王的，把他們拉來，在我面前殺了罷！
english: And as for those who were against me, who would not have me for their ruler, let them come here, and be put to death before me.

chinese: 耶穌說完了這話，就在前面走，上耶路撒冷去。
english: And when he had said this, he went on in front of them, going up to Jerusalem.

chinese: 將近伯法其和伯大尼，在一座山名叫橄欖山那裡，就打發兩個門徒，說：
english: And it came about that when he got near Beth-phage and Bethany by the mountain which is named the Mountain of Olives, he sent two of the disciples,

chinese: 你們往對面村子裡去，進去的時候，必看見一匹驢駒拴在那裡，是從來沒有人騎過的，可以解開牽來。
english: Saying, Go into the little town in front of you, and on going in you will see a young ass fixed with a cord, on which no man has ever been seated; let him loose and take him.

chinese: 若有人問為甚麼解他，你們就說：主要用他。
english: And if anyone says to you, Why are you taking him? say, The Lord has need of him.

chinese: 打發的人去了，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的。
english: And those whom he sent went away, and it was as he said.

chinese: 他們解驢駒的時候，主人問他們說：解驢駒做甚麼？
english: And when they were getting the young ass, the owners of it said to them, Why are you taking the young ass?

chinese: 他們說：主要用他。
english: And they said, The Lord has need of him.

chinese: 他們牽到耶穌那裡，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶著耶穌騎上。
english: And they took him to Jesus, and they put their clothing on the ass, and Jesus got on to him.

chinese: 走的時候，眾人把衣服鋪在路上。
english: And while he went on his way they put their clothing down on the road in front of him.

chinese: 將近耶路撒冷，正下橄欖山的時候，眾門徒因所見過的一切異能，都歡樂起來，大聲讚美神，
english: And when he came near the foot of the Mountain of Olives, all the disciples with loud voices gave praise to God with joy, because of all the great works which they had seen;

chinese: 說：奉主名來的王是應當稱頌的！在天上有和平；在至高之處有榮光。
english: Saying, A blessing on the King who comes in the name of the Lord; peace in heaven and glory in the highest.

chinese: 眾人中有幾個法利賽人對耶穌說：夫子，責備你的門徒罷！
english: And some of the Pharisees among the people said to him, Master, make your disciples be quiet.

chinese: 耶穌說：我告訴你們，若是他們閉口不說，這些石頭必要呼叫起來。
english: And he said in answer, I say to you, if these men keep quiet, the very stones will be crying out.

chinese: 耶穌快到耶路撒冷，看見城，就為他哀哭，
english: And when he got near and saw the town, he was overcome with weeping for it,

chinese: 說：巴不得你在這日子知道關係你平安的事；無奈這事現在是隱藏的，叫你的眼看不出來。
english: Saying, If you, even you, had knowledge today, of the things which give peace! but you are not able to see them.

chinese: 因為日子將到，你的仇敵必築起土壘，周圍環繞你，四面困住你，
english: For the time will come when your attackers will put a wall round you, and come all round you and keep you in on every side,

chinese: 並要掃滅你和你裡頭的兒女，連一塊石頭也不留在石頭上，因你不知道眷顧你的時候。
english: And will make you level with the earth, and your children with you; and there will not be one stone resting on another in you, because you did not see that it was your day of mercy.

chinese: 耶穌進了殿，趕出裡頭做買賣的人，
english: And he went into the Temple and put out those who were trading there,

chinese: 對他們說：經上說：我的殿必作禱告的殿，你們倒使他成為賊窩了。
english: Saying to them, It has been said, My house is to be a house of prayer, but you have made it a hole of thieves.

chinese: 耶穌天天在殿裡教訓人。祭司長和文士與百姓的尊長都想要殺他，
english: And every day he was teaching in the Temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the rulers of the people were attempting to put him to death;

chinese: 但尋不出法子來，因為百姓都側耳聽他。
english: But they were not able to do anything, because the people all kept near him, being greatly interested in his words.

chinese: 有一天，耶穌在殿裡教訓百姓，講福音的時候，祭司長和文士並長老上前來，
english: And it came about on one of those days, when he was teaching the people in the Temple and preaching the good news,

chinese: 問他說：你告訴我們，你仗著甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？
english: That the chief priests and the scribes and the rulers of the people came to him and said, Make clear to us by what authority you do these things and who gave you this authority.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我也要問你們一句話，你們且告訴我。
english: And in answer he said to them, I will put a question to you, and do you give me an answer:

chinese: 約翰的洗禮是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？
english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven or of men?

chinese: 他們彼此商議說：我們若說從天上來，他必說：你們為甚麼不信他呢？
english: And they said among themselves, If we say, From heaven; he will say, Why did you not have faith in him?

chinese: 若說從人間來，百姓都要用石頭打死我們，因為他們信約翰是先知。
english: But if we say, Of men; we will be stoned by the people, for they are certain that John was a prophet.

chinese: 於是回答說：不知道是從那裡來的。
english: And they made answer that they had no idea where it came from.

chinese: 耶穌說：我也不告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄做這些事。
english: And Jesus said, And I will not make clear to you by what authority I do these things.

chinese: 耶穌就設比喻對百姓說：有人栽了一個葡萄園，租給園戶，就往外國去住了許久。
english: And he gave the people this story: A man made a vine-garden and gave the use of it to some field-workers and went into another country for a long time.

chinese: 到了時候，打發一個僕人到園戶那裡去，叫他們把園中當納的果子交給他；園戶竟打了他，叫他空手回去。
english: And at the right time he sent a servant to the workers to get part of the fruit from the vines; but the workmen gave him blows and sent him away with nothing.

chinese: 又打發一個僕人去，他們也打了他，並且凌辱他，叫他空手回去。
english: And he sent another servant, and they gave blows to him in the same way, and put shame on him, and sent him away with nothing.

chinese: 又打發第三個僕人去，他們也打傷了他，把他推出去了。
english: And he sent a third, and they gave him wounds and put him out.

chinese: 園主說：我怎麼辦呢？我要打發我的愛子去，或者他們尊敬他。
english: And the lord of the garden said, What am I to do? I will send my dearly loved son; they may give respect to him.

chinese: 不料，園戶看見他，就彼此商量說：這是承受產業的，我們殺他罷，使產業歸於我們！
english: But when the workmen saw him, they said to one another, This is he who will one day be the owner of the property: let us put him to death and the heritage will be ours.

chinese: 於是把他推出葡萄園外，殺了。這樣，葡萄園的主人要怎樣處治他們呢？
english: And driving him out of the garden they put him to death. Now what will the lord do to these workmen?

chinese: 他要來除滅這些園戶，將葡萄園轉給別人。聽見的人說：這是萬不可的！
english: He will come and put them to destruction and give the garden to others. And when he said this, they said, May it not be so.

chinese: 耶穌看著他們說：經上記著：匠人所棄的石頭已作了房角的頭塊石頭。這是甚麼意思呢？
english: But he, looking on them, said, Is it not in the Writings, The stone which the builders put on one side, the same has become the chief stone of the building?

chinese: 凡掉在那石頭上的，必要跌碎；那石頭掉在誰的身上，就要把誰砸得稀爛。
english: Everyone falling on that stone will be broken, but the man on whom the stone comes down will be crushed to dust.

chinese: 文士和祭司長看出這比喻是指著他們說的，當時就想要下手拿他，只是懼怕百姓。
english: And the chief priests and the scribes made attempts to get their hands on him in that very hour; and they were in fear of the people, for they saw that he had made up this story against them.

chinese: 於是窺探耶穌，打發奸細裝作好人，要在他的話上得把柄，好將他交在巡撫的政權之下。
english: And they kept watch on him, and sent out secret representatives, who were acting the part of good men, in order that they might get something from his words, on account of which they might give him up to the government and into the power of the ruler.

chinese: 奸細就問耶穌說：夫子，我們曉得你所講所傳都是正道，也不取人的外貌，乃是誠誠實實傳神的道。
english: And they put a question to him, saying, Master, we are certain that your teaching and your words are right, and that you have no respect for a man's position, but you are teaching the true way of God:

chinese: 我們納稅給該撒，可以不可以？
english: Is it right for us to make payment of taxes to Caesar or not?

chinese: 耶穌看出他們的詭詐，就對他們說：
english: But he saw through their trick and said to them,

chinese: 拿一個銀錢來給我看。這像和這號是誰的？他們說：是該撒的。
english: Let me see a penny. Whose image and name are on it? And they said, Caesar's.

chinese: 耶穌說：這樣，該撒的物當歸給該撒，神的物當歸給神。
english: And he said, Then give to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's.

chinese: 他們當著百姓，在這話上得不著把柄，又希奇他的應對，就閉口無言了。
english: And they were not able to get anything from these words before the people: but they were full of wonder at his answer, and said nothing.

chinese: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。有幾個來問耶穌說：
english: And some of the Sadducees came to him, who say that there is no coming back from the dead; and they said to him,

chinese: 夫子！摩西為我們寫著說：人若有妻無子就死了，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。
english: Master, Moses said that if a man's brother comes to his end, having a wife, but no children, his brother is to take the wife, and get a family for his brother.

chinese: 有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，沒有孩子死了；
english: Now there were seven brothers, and the first had a wife and came to his end, having no children;

chinese: 第二個、第三個也娶過他；
english: And the second;

chinese: 那七個人都娶過他，沒有留下孩子就死了。
english: And the third took her; and in the same way, all the seven, without having any children, came to their end.

chinese: 後來婦人也死了。
english: And last of all, the woman came to her end.

chinese: 這樣，當復活的時候，他是那一個的妻子呢？因為他們七個人都娶過他。
english: When they come back from the dead, whose wife will she be? for all the seven had her.

chinese: 耶穌說：這世界的人有娶有嫁；
english: And Jesus said to them, The sons of this world are married and have wives;

chinese: 惟有算為配得那世界，與從死裡復活的人也不娶也不嫁；
english: But those to whom is given the reward of the world to come, and to come back from the dead, have no wives, and are not married;

chinese: 因為他們不能再死，和天使一樣；既是復活的人，就為神的兒子。
english: And death has no more power over them, for they are equal to the angels, and are sons of God, being of those who will come back from the dead.

chinese: 至於死人復活，摩西在荊棘篇上，稱主是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，就指示明白了。
english: But even Moses made it clear that the dead come back to life, saying, in the story of the burning thorn-tree, The Lord, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

chinese: 神原不是死人的神，乃是活人的神；因為在他那裡（那裡：或作看來），人都是活的。
english: Now he is not the God of the dead but of the living: for all men are living to him.

chinese: 有幾個文士說：夫子！你說得好。
english: And some of the scribes, in answer to this, said, Master, you have said well.

chinese: 以後他們不敢再問他甚麼。
english: And they had fear of putting any more questions to him.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：人怎麼說基督是大衛的子孫呢？
english: And he said to them, Why do they say that the Christ is the son of David?

chinese: 詩篇上大衛自己說：主對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，
english: For David himself says in the book of Psalms, The Lord said to my Lord, Take your seat at my right hand,

chinese: 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
english: Till I put under your feet all those who are against you.

chinese: 大衛既稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？
english: David then gives him the name of Lord, so how is it possible for him to be his son?

chinese: 眾百姓聽的時候，耶穌對門徒說：
english: And in the hearing of all the people he said to his disciples,

chinese: 你們要防備文士。他們好穿長衣遊行，喜愛人在街市上問他們安，又喜愛會堂裡的高位，筵席上的首座；
english: Keep away from the scribes, whose pleasure it is to go about in long robes, and to have words of respect said to them in the market-places, and to take the chief seats in the Synagogues and the first places at feasts;

chinese: 他們侵吞寡婦的家產，假意作很長的禱告。這些人要受更重的刑罰！
english: Who take the property of widows and before the eyes of men make long prayers; they will get a greater punishment.

chinese: 耶穌抬頭觀看，見財主把捐項投在庫裡，
english: And looking up, he saw the men of wealth putting their offerings in the money-box.

chinese: 又見一個窮寡婦投了兩個小錢，
english: And he saw a certain poor widow putting in a farthing.

chinese: 就說：我實在告訴你們，這窮寡婦所投的比眾人還多；
english: And he said, Truly I say to you, This poor widow has given more than all of them:

chinese: 因為眾人都是自己有餘，拿出來投在捐項裡，但這寡婦是自己不足，把他一切養生的都投上了。
english: For they gave out of their wealth, having more than enough for themselves: but she, even out of her need, has put in all her living.

chinese: 有人談論聖殿是用美石和供物妝飾的；
english: And some were talking about the Temple, how it was made fair with beautiful stones and with offerings, but he said,

chinese: 耶穌就說：論到你們所看見的這一切，將來日子到了，在這裡沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。
english: As for these things which you see, the days will come when not one stone will be resting on another, but all will be broken down.

chinese: 他們問他說：夫子！甚麼時候有這事呢？這事將到的時候有甚麼豫兆呢？
english: And they said to him, Master, when will these things be? and what sign will there be when these events are to take place?

chinese: 耶穌說：你們要謹慎，不要受迷惑；因為將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：我是基督，又說：時候近了，你們不要跟從他們！
english: And he said, Take care that you are not tricked: for a number of people will come in my name, saying, I am he; and, The time is near: do not go after them.

chinese: 你們聽見打仗和擾亂的事，不要驚惶；因為這些事必須先有，只是末期不能立時就到。
english: And when news of wars and troubled times comes to your ears, have no fear; for these things have to be, but the end will not be now.

chinese: 當時，耶穌對他們說：民要攻打民，國要攻打國；
english: Then he said to them, Nation will be moved against nation and kingdom against kingdom:

chinese: 地要大大震動，多處必有饑荒、瘟疫，又有可怕的異象和大神蹟從天上顯現。
english: There will be great earth-shocks and outbursts of disease in a number of places, and men will be without food; and there will be wonders and great signs from heaven.

chinese: 但這一切的事以先，人要下手拿住你們，逼迫你們，把你們交給會堂，並且收在監裡，又為我的名拉你們到君王諸侯面前。
english: But before all this, they will take you and be very cruel to you, giving you up to the Synagogues and to prisons, taking you before kings and rulers, because of my name.

chinese: 但這些事終必為你們的見證。
english: And it will be turned to a witness for you.

chinese: 所以，你們當立定心意，不要預先思想怎樣分訴；
english: So take care not to be troubled before the time comes, about what answers you will give:

chinese: 因為我必賜你們口才、智慧，是你們一切敵人所敵不住、駁不倒的。
english: For I will give you words and wisdom, so that not one of those who are against you will be able to get the better of you, or to put you in the wrong.

chinese: 連你們的父母、弟兄、親族、朋友也要把你們交官；你們也有被他們害死的。
english: But you will be given up even by your fathers and mothers, your brothers and relations and friends; and some of you will be put to death.

chinese: 你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡，
english: And you will be hated by all men, because of me.

chinese: 然而，你們連一根頭髮也必不損壞。
english: But not a hair of your head will come to destruction.

chinese: 你們常存忍耐，就必保全靈魂（或作：必得生命）。
english: By going through all these things, you will keep your lives.

chinese: 你們看見耶路撒冷被兵圍困，就可知道他成荒場的日子近了。
english: But when you see armies all round about Jerusalem, then be certain that her destruction is near.

chinese: 那時，在猶太的應當逃到山上；在城裡的應當出來；在鄉下的不要進城；
english: Then let those who are in Judaea go in flight to the mountains; and those who are in the middle of the town go out; and let not those who are in the country come in.

chinese: 因為這是報應的日子，使經上所寫的都得應驗。
english: For these are the days of punishment, in which all the things in the Writings will be put into effect.

chinese: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了！因為將有大災難降在這地方，也有震怒臨到這百姓。
english: It will be hard for women who are with child, and for her with a baby at the breast, in those days. For great trouble will come on the land, and wrath on this people.

chinese: 他們要倒在刀下，又被擄到各國去。耶路撒冷要被外邦人踐踏，直到外邦人的日期滿了。
english: And they will be put to death with the sword, and will be taken as prisoners into all the nations; and Jerusalem will be crushed under the feet of the Gentiles, till the times of the Gentiles are complete.

chinese: 日、月、星辰要顯出異兆，地上的邦國也有困苦；因海中波浪的響聲，就慌慌不定。
english: And there will be signs in the sun and moon and stars; and on the earth, fear among the nations and doubt because of the loud noise of the sea and the waves;

chinese: 天勢都要震動，人想起那將要臨到世界的事，就都嚇得魂不附體。
english: Men's strength will go from them in fear and in waiting for the things which are coming on the earth; for the powers of the heavens will be moved.

chinese: 那時，他們要看見人子有能力，有大榮耀駕雲降臨。
english: And then they will see the Son of man coming in a cloud, with power and great glory.

chinese: 一有這些事，你們就當挺身昂首，因為你們得贖的日子近了。
english: But when these things come about, let your heads be lifted up, because your salvation is near.

chinese: 耶穌又設比喻對他們說：你們看無花果樹和各樣的樹；他發芽的時候，你們一看見，自然曉得夏天近了。
english: And he made a story for them: See the fig-tree, and all the trees;
When they put out their young leaves, you take note of it, and it is clear to you that summer is coming.

chinese: 這樣，你們看見這些事漸漸的成就，也該曉得神的國近了。
english: In the same way, when you see these things taking place you may be certain that the kingdom of God is near.

chinese: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
english: Truly I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all things are complete.

chinese: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。
english: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.

chinese: 你們要謹慎，恐怕因貪食、醉酒，並今生的思慮累住你們的心，那日子就如同網羅忽然臨到你們；
english: But give attention to yourselves, for fear that your hearts become over-full of the pleasures of food and wine, and the cares of this life, and that day may come on you suddenly, and take you as in a net:

chinese: 因為那日子要這樣臨到全地上一切居住的人。
english: For so it will come on all those who are living on the face of all the earth.

chinese: 你們要時時儆醒，常常祈求，使你們能逃避這一切要來的事，得以站立在人子面前。
english: But keep watch at all times with prayer, that you may be strong enough to come through all these things and take your place before the Son of man.

chinese: 耶穌每日在殿裡教訓人，每夜出城在一座山，名叫橄欖山住宿。
english: And every day he was teaching in the Temple and every night he went out to the mountain which is named the Mountain of Olives to take his rest.

chinese: 眾百姓清早上聖殿，到耶穌那裡，要聽他講道。
english: And all the people came early in the morning to give ear to his words in the Temple.

chinese: 除酵節，又名逾越節，近了。
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread was near, which is called the Passover.

chinese: 祭司長和文士想法子怎麼才能殺害耶穌，是因他們懼怕百姓。
english: And the chief priests and the scribes were looking for a chance to put him to death, but they went in fear of the people.

chinese: 這時，撒但入了那稱為加略人猶大的心；他本是十二門徒裡的一個。
english: And Satan came into Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve.

chinese: 他去和祭司長並守殿官商量，怎麼可以把耶穌交給他們。
english: And he went away and had a discussion with the chief priests and the rulers, about how he might give him up to them.

chinese: 他們歡喜，就約定給他銀子。
english: And they were glad, and undertook to give him money.

chinese: 他應允了，就找機會，要趁眾人不在跟前的時候把耶穌交給他們。
english: And he made an agreement with them to give him up to them, if he got a chance, when the people were not present.

chinese: 除酵節，須宰逾越羊羔的那一天到了。
english: And the day of unleavened bread came, when the Passover lamb is put to death.

chinese: 耶穌打發彼得、約翰，說：你們去為我們預備逾越節的筵席，好叫我們吃。
english: And Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make the Passover ready for us, so that we may take it.

chinese: 他們問他說：要我們在那裡預備？
english: And they said to him, Where are we to get it ready?

chinese: 耶穌說：你們進了城，必有人拿著一瓶水迎面而來，你們就跟著他，到他所進的房子裡去，
english: And he said to them, When you go into the town you will see a man coming to you with a vessel of water; go after him into the house into which he goes.

chinese: 對那家的主人說：夫子說：客房在那裡？我與門徒好在那裡吃逾越節的筵席。
english: And say to the master of the house, The Master says, Where is the guest-room, where I may take the Passover with my disciples?

chinese: 他必指給你們擺設整齊的一間大樓，你們就在那裡預備。
english: And he will take you up to a great room with a table and seats: there make ready.

chinese: 他們去了，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的；他們就預備了逾越節的筵席。
english: And they went, and it was as he had said: and they made the Passover ready.

chinese: 時候到了，耶穌坐席，使徒也和他同坐。
english: And when the time had come, he took his seat, and the Apostles with him.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：我很願意在受害以先和你們吃這逾越節的筵席。
english: And he said, I have had a great desire to keep this Passover with you before I come to my death;

chinese: 我告訴你們，我不再吃這筵席，直到成就在神的國裡。
english: For I say to you, I will not take it till it is made complete in the kingdom of God.

chinese: 耶穌接過杯來，祝謝了，說：你們拿這個，大家分著喝。
english: And he took a cup and, having given praise, he said, Make division of this among yourselves;

chinese: 我告訴你們，從今以後，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直等神的國來到。
english: For I say to you, I will not take of the fruit of the vine till the kingdom of God has come.

chinese: 又拿起餅來，祝謝了，就擘開，遞給他們，說：這是我的身體，為你們捨的，你們也應當如此行，為的是記念我。
english: And he took bread and, having given praise, he gave it to them when it had been broken, saying, This is my body, which is given for you: do this in memory of me.

chinese: 飯後也照樣拿起杯來，說：這杯是用我血所立的新約，是為你們流出來的。
english: And in the same way, after the meal, he took the cup, saying, This cup is the new testament, made with my blood which is given for you.

chinese: 看哪！那賣我之人的手與我一同在桌子上。
english: But the hand of him who is false to me is with me at the table.

chinese: 人子固然要照所預定的去世，但賣人子的人有禍了！
english: For it will be done to the Son of man after the purpose of God, but unhappy is that man by whom he is given up.

chinese: 他們就彼此對問，是那一個要做這事。
english: And they were wondering among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

chinese: 門徒起了爭論，他們中間那一個可算為大。
english: And there was an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.

chinese: 耶穌說：外邦人有君王為主治理他們，那掌權管他們的稱為恩主。
english: And he said, The kings of the Gentiles are lords over them, and those who have authority are given names of honour.

chinese: 但你們不可這樣；你們裡頭為大的，倒要像年幼的；為首領的，倒要像服事人的。
english: But let it not be so with you; but he who is greater, let him become like the younger; and he who is chief, like a servant.

chinese: 是誰為大？是坐席的呢？是服事人的呢？不是坐席的大麼？然而，我在你們中間如同服事人的。
english: For which is greater, the guest who is seated at a meal or the servant who is waiting on him? is it not the guest? but I am among you as a servant.

chinese: 我在磨煉之中，常和我同在的就是你們。
english: But you are those who have kept with me through my troubles;

chinese: 我將國賜給你們，正如我父賜給我一樣，
english: And I will give you a kingdom as my Father has given one to me,

chinese: 叫你們在我國裡，坐在我的席上吃喝，並且坐在寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。
english: So that you may take food and drink at my table in my kingdom, and be seated like kings, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

chinese: 主又說：西門！西門！撒但想要得著你們，好篩你們像篩麥子一樣；
english: Simon, Simon, Satan has made a request to have you, so that he may put you to the test as grain is tested:

chinese: 但我已經為你祈求，叫你不至於失了信心，你回頭以後，要堅固你的弟兄。
english: But I have made prayer for you, that your faith may not go from you: and when you are turned again, make your brothers strong.

chinese: 彼得說：主阿，我就是同你下監，同你受死，也是甘心！
english: And he said to him, Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death.

chinese: 耶穌說：彼得，我告訴你，今日雞還沒有叫，你要三次說不認得我。
english: And he said, I say to you, Peter, before the cock's second cry today, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.

chinese: 耶穌又對他們說：我差你們出去的時候，沒有錢囊，沒有口袋，沒有鞋，你們缺少甚麼沒有？他們說：沒有。
english: And he said to them, When I sent you out without money or bag or shoes, were you in need of anything? And they said, Nothing.

chinese: 耶穌說：但如今有錢囊的可以帶著，有口袋的也可以帶著，沒有刀的要賣衣服買刀。
english: And he said to them, But now, he who has a money-bag, or a bag for food, let him take it: and he who has not, let him give his coat for money and get a sword.

chinese: 我告訴你們，經上寫著說：他被列在罪犯之中。這話必應驗在我身上；因為那關係我的事必然成就。
english: For I say to you that these words will be put into effect in me, And he was numbered among the evil-doers: for what has been said in the Writings about me has an end.

chinese: 他們說：主阿，請看！這裡有兩把刀。耶穌說：夠了。
english: And they said, Lord, here are two swords. And he said, It is enough.

chinese: 耶穌出來，照常往橄欖山去，門徒也跟隨他。
english: And he came out, and went, as his way was, to the Mountain of Olives, and the disciples went with him.

chinese: 到了那地方，就對他們說：你們要禱告，免得入了迷惑。
english: And when he came to the place, he said to them, Make a prayer that you may not be put to the test.

chinese: 於是離開他們約有扔一塊石頭那麼遠，跪下禱告，
english: And he went a little distance away from them and, falling on his knees in prayer, he said,

chinese: 說：父阿！你若願意，就把這杯撤去；然而，不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。
english: Father, if it is your pleasure, take this cup from me: but still, let your pleasure, not mine, be done.

chinese: 有一位天使從天上顯現，加添他的力量。
english: And an angel from heaven came to him, to give him strength.

chinese: 耶穌極其傷痛，禱告更加懇切，汗珠如大血點滴在地上。
english: And being in great trouble of soul, the force of his prayer became stronger, and great drops, like blood, came from him, falling to the earth.

chinese: 禱告完了，就起來，到門徒那裡，見他們因為憂愁都睡著了，
english: And, getting up from prayer, he came to the disciples, and saw that they were sleeping for sorrow.

chinese: 就對他們說：你們為甚麼睡覺呢？起來禱告，免得入了迷惑！
english: And he said, Why are you sleeping? Get up, and give yourselves to prayer, so that you may not be put to the test.

chinese: 說話之間，來了許多人。那十二個門徒裡名叫猶大的，走在前頭，就近耶穌，要與他親嘴。
english: And while he was saying these words, there came a band of people, and Judas, one of the twelve, was in front of them, and he came near to Jesus to give him a kiss.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：猶大！你用親嘴的暗號賣人子麼？
english: But Jesus said to him, Judas, will you be false to the Son of man with a kiss?

chinese: 左右的人見光景不好，就說：主阿﹗我們拿刀砍可以不可以？
english: And when those who were with him saw what was coming, they said, Lord, may we not make use of our swords?

chinese: 內中有一個人把大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他的右耳。
english: And one of them gave a blow to the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

chinese: 耶穌說：到了這個地步，由他們罷！就摸那人的耳朵，把他治好了。
english: But Jesus, answering, said, Put up with this, at least. And touching his ear, he made it well.

chinese: 耶穌對那些來拿他的祭司長和守殿官並長老說：你們帶著刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜麼？
english: And Jesus said to the chief priests and the captains of the Temple and the rulers, who had come against him, Have you come out as against a thief, with swords and sticks?

chinese: 我天天同你們在殿裡，你們不下手拿我。現在卻是你們的時候，黑暗掌權了。
english: When I was in the Temple with you every day, your hands were not stretched out against me: but this is your hour, and the authority of the dark power.

chinese: 他們拿住耶穌，把他帶到大祭司的宅裡。彼得遠遠的跟著。
english: And they made him a prisoner and took him away to the house of the high priest. But Peter went after them at a distance.

chinese: 他們在院子裡生了火，一同坐著；彼得也坐在他們中間。
english: And a fire was lighted in the middle of the open square, and they were seated together, and Peter was among them.

chinese: 有一個使女看見彼得坐在火光裡，就定睛看他，說：這個人素來也是同那人一夥的。
english: And a certain woman-servant, seeing him in the light of the fire, and looking at him with attention, said, This man was with him.

chinese: 彼得卻不承認，說：女子，我不認得他。
english: But he said, Woman, it is not true; I have no knowledge of him.

chinese: 過了不多的時候，又有一個人看見他，說：你也是他們一黨的。彼得說：你這個人！我不是。
english: And after a little time, another saw him and said, You are one of them; and he said, Man, I am not.

chinese: 約過了一小時，又有一個人極力的說：他實在是同那人一夥的，因為他也是加利利人。
english: And after about an hour, another man said, with decision, Certainly this man was with him, for he is a Galilaean.

chinese: 彼得說：你這個人！我不曉得你說的是甚麼！正說話之間，雞就叫了。
english: And Peter said, Man, I have no knowledge of these things of which you are talking. And straight away, while he was saying these words, there came the cry of a cock.

chinese: 主轉過身來看彼得。彼得便想起主對他所說的話：今日雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。
english: And the Lord, turning, gave Peter a look. And the words of the Lord came to Peter's mind, how he had said, This night, before the hour of the cock's cry, you will be false to me three times.

chinese: 他就出去痛哭。
english: And he went out, weeping bitterly.

chinese: 看守耶穌的人戲弄他，打他，
english: And the men in whose hands Jesus was, made sport of him and gave him blows.

chinese: 又蒙著他的眼，問他說：你是先知，告訴我們打你的是誰？
english: And, covering his eyes, they said to him, Are you prophet enough to say who gave you that blow?

chinese: 他們還用許多別的話辱罵他。
english: And they said a number of other evil things against him.

chinese: 天一亮，民間的眾長老連祭司長帶文士都聚會，把耶穌帶到他們的公會裡，
english: And when it was day, the rulers of the people came together, with the chief priests and the scribes, and they took him before their Sanhedrin, saying,

chinese: 說：你若是基督，就告訴我們。耶穌說：我若告訴你們，你們也不信；
english: If you are the Christ, say so. But he said, If I say so you will not have belief;

chinese: 我若問你們，你們也不回答。
english: And if I put a question to you, you will not give an answer.

chinese: 從今以後，人子要坐在神權能的右邊。
english: But in the future the Son of man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.

chinese: 他們都說：這樣，你是神的兒子麼？耶穌說：你們所說的是。
english: And they all said, Are you then the Son of God? and he said, You say that I am.

chinese: 他們說：何必再用見證呢？他親口所說的，我們都親自聽見了。
english: And they said, What more need have we of witness? we have the very words of his mouth.

chinese: 眾人都起來，把耶穌解到彼拉多面前，
english: And they all went and took him before Pilate.

chinese: 就告他說：我們見這人誘惑國民，禁止納稅給該撒，並說自己是基督，是王。
english: And they made statements against him, saying, This man has to our knowledge been teaching our nation to do wrong, and not to make payment of taxes to Caesar, even saying that he himself is Christ, a king.

chinese: 彼拉多問耶穌說：你是猶太人的王麼？耶穌回答說：你說的是。
english: And Pilate said to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And he said in answer, You say so.

chinese: 彼拉多對祭司長和眾人說：我查不出這人有甚麼罪來。
english: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the people, In my opinion this man has done no wrong.

chinese: 但他們越發極力的說：他煽惑百姓，在猶太遍地傳道，從加利利起，直到這裡了。
english: But they became more violent than before, saying, He has made trouble among the people, teaching through all Judaea from Galilee to this place.

chinese: 彼拉多一聽見，就問：這人是加利利人麼？
english: But at these words Pilate said, Is the man a Galilaean?

chinese: 既曉得耶穌屬希律所管，就把他送到希律那裡去。那時希律正在耶路撒冷。
english: And when he saw that he was under the authority of Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was in Jerusalem himself at that time.

chinese: 希律看見耶穌，就很歡喜；因為聽見過他的事，久已想要見他，並且指望看他行一件神蹟。
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus he was very glad, having for a long time had a desire to see him, for he had had accounts of him, and was hoping to see some wonders done by him.

chinese: 於是問他許多的話；耶穌卻一言不答。
english: And he put a great number of questions to him, but he said nothing.

chinese: 祭司長和文士都站著，極力的告他。
english: And the chief priests and the scribes were there, making statements against him violently.

chinese: 希律和他的兵丁就藐視耶穌，戲弄他，給他穿上華麗衣服，把他送回彼拉多那裡去。
english: And Herod, with the men of his army, put shame on him and made sport of him, and dressing him in shining robes, he sent him back to Pilate.

chinese: 從前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇，在那一天就成了朋友。
english: And that day Herod and Pilate became friends with one another, for before they had been against one another.

chinese: 彼拉多傳齊了祭司長和官府並百姓，
english: And Pilate sent for the chief priests and the rulers and the people, and said to them,

chinese: 就對他們說：你們解這人到我這裡，說他是誘惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾將你們告他的事，在你們面前審問他，並沒有查出他甚麼罪來；
english: You say that this man has been teaching the people evil things: now I, after going into the question before you, see nothing wrong in this man in connection with the things which you have said against him:

chinese: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回來。可見他沒有做甚麼該死的事。
english: And Herod is of the same opinion, for he has sent him back to us; for, you see, he has done nothing for which I might put him to death.

chinese: 故此，我要責打他，把他釋放了。（有古卷在此有：
english: And so I will give him punishment and let him go.

chinese: 每逢這節期，巡撫必須釋放一個囚犯給他們。）
眾人卻一齊喊著說：除掉這個人！釋放巴拉巴給我們！
english: But with loud voices they said all together, Put this man to death, and make Barabbas free.

chinese: 這巴拉巴是因在城裡作亂殺人，下在監裡的。
english: Now this man was in prison because of an attack against the government in the town, in which there had been loss of life.

chinese: 彼拉多願意釋放耶穌，就又勸解他們。
english: And Pilate again said to them that it was his desire to let Jesus go free.

chinese: 無奈他們喊著說：釘他十字架！釘他十字架！
english: But crying out they said, To the cross with him!

chinese: 彼拉多第三次對他們說：為甚麼呢？這人作了甚麼惡事呢？我並沒有查出他甚麼該死的罪來。所以，我要責打他，把他釋放了。
english: And he said to them a third time, Why, what evil has he done? I see no reason for putting him to death: I will give him punishment and let him go.

chinese: 他們大聲催逼彼拉多，求他把耶穌釘在十字架上。他們的聲音就得了勝。
english: But they went on crying out loudly, Let him be put to death on the cross. And they had their way.

chinese: 彼拉多這才照他們所求的定案，
english: And Pilate gave his decision for their desire to be put into effect.

chinese: 把他們所求的那作亂殺人、下在監裡的釋放了，把耶穌交給他們，任憑他們的意思行。
english: And in answer to their request, he let that man go free who had been in prison for acting against the government and causing death, and Jesus he gave up to their pleasure.

chinese: 帶耶穌去的時候，有一個古利奈人西門，從鄉下來；他們就抓住他，把十字架擱在他身上，叫他背著跟隨耶穌。
english: And while they were taking him away, they put their hands on Simon of Cyrene, who was coming from the country, and made him take the cross after Jesus.

chinese: 有許多百姓跟隨耶穌，內中有好些婦女；婦女們為他號咷痛哭。
english: And a great band of people went after him, and of women making signs of grief and weeping for him.

chinese: 耶穌轉身對他們說：耶路撒冷的女子，不要為我哭，當為自己和自己的兒女哭。
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, Daughters of Jerusalem, let not your weeping be for me, but for yourselves and for your children.

chinese: 因為日子要到，人必說：不生育的，和未曾懷胎的，未曾乳養嬰孩的，有福了！
english: For the days are coming in which they will say, Happy are those who have had no children, whose bodies have never given birth, whose breasts have never given milk.

chinese: 那時，人要向大山說：倒在我們身上！向小山說：遮蓋我們！
english: And they will say to the mountains, Come down on us, and to the hills, Be a cover over us.

chinese: 這些事既行在有汁水的樹上，那枯乾的樹將來怎麼樣呢？
english: For if they do these things when the tree is green, what will they do when it is dry?

chinese: 又有兩個犯人，和耶穌一同帶來處死。
english: And two others, evil-doers, were taken with him to be put to death.

chinese: 到了一個地方，名叫髑髏地，就在那裡把耶穌釘在十字架上，又釘了兩個犯人：一個在左邊，一個在右邊。
english: And when they came to the place which is named Golgotha, they put him on the cross, and the evil-doers, one on the right side, and the other on the left.

chinese: 當下耶穌說：父阿！赦免他們；因為他們所做的，他們不曉得。兵丁就拈鬮分他的衣服。
english: And Jesus said, Father, let them have forgiveness, for they have no knowledge of what they are doing. And they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.

chinese: 百姓站在那裡觀看。官府也嗤笑他，說：他救了別人；他若是基督，神所揀選的，可以救自己罷！
english: And the people were looking on. And the rulers made sport of him, saying, He was a saviour of others; let him do something for himself, if he is the Christ, the man of God's selection.

chinese: 兵丁也戲弄他，上前拿醋送給他喝，
english: And the men of the army made sport of him, coming to him and giving him bitter wine,

chinese: 說：你若是猶太人的王，可以救自己罷！
english: And saying, If you are the King of the Jews, get yourself free.

chinese: 在耶穌以上有一個牌子（有古卷在此有：用希利尼、羅馬、希伯來的文字）寫著：這是猶太人的王。
english: And these words were put in writing over him, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

chinese: 那同釘的兩個犯人有一個譏誚他，說：你不是基督麼？可以救自己和我們罷！
english: And one of the evil-doers on the cross, with bitter feeling, said to him, Are you not the Christ? Get yourself and us out of this.

chinese: 那一個就應聲責備他，說：你既是一樣受刑的，還不怕神麼？
english: But the other, protesting, said, Have you no fear of God? for you have a part in the same punishment,

chinese: 我們是應該的，因我們所受的與我們所做的相稱，但這個人沒有做過一件不好的事。
english: And with reason; for we have the right reward of our acts, but this man has done nothing wrong.

chinese: 就說：耶穌阿，你得國降臨的時候，求你記念我！
english: And he said, Jesus, keep me in mind when you come in your kingdom.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：我實在告訴你，今日你要同我在樂園裡了。
english: And he said to him, Truly I say to you, Today you will be with me in Paradise.

chinese: 那時約有午正，遍地都黑暗了，直到申初，
english: And it was now about the sixth hour; and all the land was dark till the ninth hour;

chinese: 日頭變黑了；殿裡的幔子從當中裂為兩半。
english: The light of the sun went out, and the curtain in the Temple was parted in two.

chinese: 耶穌大聲喊著說：父阿！我將我的靈魂交在你手裡。說了這話，氣就斷了。
english: And Jesus gave a loud cry and said, Father, into your hands I give my spirit: and when he had said this, he gave up his spirit.

chinese: 百夫長看見所成的事，就歸榮耀與神，說：這真是個義人！
english: And when the captain saw what was done, he gave praise to God, saying, Without doubt this was an upright man.

chinese: 聚集觀看的眾人見了這所成的事都捶著胸回去了。
english: And all the people who had come together to see it, when they saw the things which were done, went back again making signs of grief.

chinese: 還有一切與耶穌熟識的人，和從加利利跟著他來的婦女們，都遠遠的站著看這些事。
english: And all his friends and the women who came with him from Galilee, were waiting at a distance, watching these things.

chinese: 有一個人名叫約瑟，是個議士，為人善良公義；
english: Now there was a man named Joseph, a man of authority and a good and upright man

chinese: 眾人所謀所為，他並沒有附從。他本是猶太、亞利馬太城裡素常盼望神國的人。
english: (He had not given his approval to their decision or their acts), of Arimathaea, a town of the Jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of God:

chinese: 這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體，
english: This man went to Pilate and made a request for the body of Jesus.

chinese: 就取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在石頭鑿成的墳墓裡；那裡頭從來沒有葬過人。
english: And he took it down, and folding it in a linen cloth, he put it in a place cut in the rock for a dead body; and no one had ever been put in it.

chinese: 那日是預備日，安息日也快到了。
english: Now it was the day of making ready and the Sabbath was coming on.

chinese: 那些從加利利和耶穌同來的婦女跟在後面，看見了墳墓和他的身體怎樣安放。
english: And the women who had come with him from Galilee went after him and saw the place and how his body had been put to rest;

chinese: 他們就回去，預備了香料香膏。他們在安息日，便遵著誡命安息了。
english: And they went back and got ready spices and perfumes; and on the Sabbath they took their rest, in agreement with the law.

chinese: 七日的頭一日，黎明的時候，那些婦女帶著所預備的香料來到墳墓前，
english: But on the first day of the week, at dawn, they came to the place where his body had been put, taking the spices which they had got ready.

chinese: 看見石頭已經從墳墓輥開了，
english: And they saw that the stone had been rolled away.

chinese: 他們就進去，只是不見主耶穌的身體。
english: And they went in, but the body of the Lord Jesus was not there.

chinese: 正在猜疑之間，忽然有兩個人站在旁邊，衣服放光。
english: And while they were in doubt about it, they saw two men in shining clothing by them:

chinese: 婦女們驚怕，將臉伏地。那兩個人就對他們說：為甚麼在死人中找活人呢？
english: And while their faces were bent down to the earth in fear, these said to them, Why are you looking for the living among the dead?

chinese: 他不在這裡，已經復活了。當記念他還在加利利的時候怎樣告訴你們，
english: He is not here, he has come back to life: have in mind what he said to you when he was still in Galilee, saying,

chinese: 說：人子必須被交在罪人手裡，釘在十字架上，第三日復活。
english: The Son of man will be given up into the hands of evil-doers, and be put to death on the cross, and on the third day he will come back to life.

chinese: 他們就想起耶穌的話來，
english: And his words came back into their minds,

chinese: 便從墳墓那裡回去，把這一切事告訴十一個使徒和其餘的人。
english: And they went away from that place and gave an account of all these things to the eleven disciples and all the others.

chinese: 那告訴使徒的就是抹大拉的馬利亞和約亞拿，並雅各的母親馬利亞，還有與他們在一處的婦女。
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary, the mother of James: and the other women with them said these things to the Apostles.

chinese: 他們這些話，使徒以為是胡言，就不相信。
english: But these words seemed foolish to them, and they had no belief in them.

chinese: 彼得起來，跑到墳墓前，低頭往裡看，見細麻布獨在一處，就回去了，心裡希奇所成的事。
english: But Peter got up and went to the place where the body had been put, and looking in he saw nothing but the linen cloths, and he went to his house full of wonder at what had taken place.

chinese: 正當那日，門徒中有兩個人往一個村子去；這村子名叫以馬忤斯，離耶路撒冷約有二十五里。
english: And then, two of them, on that very day, were going to a little town named Emmaus, which was about seven miles from Jerusalem.

chinese: 他們彼此談論所遇見的這一切事。
english: And they were talking together about all those things which had taken place.

chinese: 正談論相問的時候，耶穌親自就近他們，和他們同行；
english: And while they were talking and questioning together, Jesus himself came near and went with them.

chinese: 只是他們的眼睛迷糊了，不認識他。
english: But their eyes were not open that they might have knowledge of him.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們走路彼此談論的是甚麼事呢？他們就站住，臉上帶著愁容。
english: And he said to them, What are you talking about together while you go?

chinese: 二人中有一個名叫革流巴的回答說：你在耶路撒冷作客，還不知道這幾天在那裡所出的事麼？
english: Then stopping, and looking sadly at him, one of them, named Cleopas, said to him, Are you the only man living in Jerusalem who has not had news of the things which have taken place there at this time?

chinese: 耶穌說：甚麼事呢？他們說：就是拿撒勒人耶穌的事。他是個先知，在神和眾百姓面前，說話行事都有大能。
english: And he said to them, What things? And they said, The things to do with Jesus of Nazareth, who was a prophet, great in his acts and his words, before God and all the people:

chinese: 祭司長和我們的官府竟把他解去，定了死罪，釘在十字架上。
english: And how the chief priests and our rulers gave him up to be put to death on the cross.

chinese: 但我們素來所盼望、要贖以色列民的就是他！不但如此，而且這事成就，現在已經三天了。
english: But we were hoping that he would be the Saviour of Israel. In addition to all this he has now let three days go by from the time when these things took place;

chinese: 再者，我們中間有幾個婦女使我們驚奇；他們清早到了墳墓那裡，
english: And certain women among us gave us cause for wonder, for they went early to the place where his body had been put,

chinese: 不見他的身體，就回來告訴我們，說看見了天使顯現，說他活了。
english: And it was not there; then they came saying that they had seen a vision of angels who said that he was living.

chinese: 又有我們的幾個人往墳墓那裡去，所遇見的正如婦女們所說的，只是沒有看見他。
english: And some of those who were with us went to the place, and saw that it was as the women had said, but him they did not see.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：無知的人哪，先知所說的一切話，你們的心信得太遲鈍了。
english: And he said, O foolish men! how slow you are to give belief to what the prophets have said.

chinese: 基督這樣受害，又進入他的榮耀，豈不是應當的麼？
english: Was it not necessary for the Christ to go through these things, and to come into his glory?

chinese: 於是從摩西和眾先知起，凡經上所指著自己的話都給他們講解明白了。
english: And he made clear to them all the things in the Writings, from Moses and from all the prophets, which had to do with himself.

chinese: 將近他們所去的村子，耶穌好像還要往前行，
english: And they came near the town to which they were going, and he seemed as if he was going on;

chinese: 他們卻強留他，說：時候晚了，日頭已經平西了，請你同我們住下罷！耶穌就進去，要同他們住下。
english: But they kept him back, saying, Do not go, for evening is near, the day is almost gone. And he went in with them.

chinese: 到了坐席的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，擘開，遞給他們。
english: And when he was seated with them at table, he took the bread, and said words of blessing and, making division of it, he gave it to them.

chinese: 他們的眼睛明亮了，這才認出他來。忽然耶穌不見了。
english: And then their eyes were open, and they had knowledge of him, but he went from their view.

chinese: 他們彼此說：在路上，他和我們說話，給我們講解聖經的時候，我們的心豈不是火熱的麼？
english: And they said to one another, Were not our hearts burning in us while he was talking to us on the way, making clear to us the holy Writings?

chinese: 他們就立時起身，回耶路撒冷去，正遇見十一個使徒和他們的同人聚集在一處，
english: And that very hour they got up and went back to Jerusalem, where the eleven and the others had come together.

chinese: 說：主果然復活，已經現給西門看了。
english: And they said to them, The Lord has truly come back to life again, and Simon has seen him.

chinese: 兩個人就把路上所遇見，和擘餅的時候怎麼被他們認出來的事，都述說了一遍。
english: And they gave an account of the things which had taken place on the way, and how, when he gave them bread, they had knowledge of him.

chinese: 正說這話的時候，耶穌親自站在他們當中，說：願你們平安！
english: And while they were saying these things, he himself was among them, and said to them, Peace be with you!

chinese: 他們卻驚慌害怕，以為所看見的是魂。
english: But they were full of fear, being of the opinion that they were seeing a spirit.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們為甚麼愁煩？為甚麼心裡起疑念呢？
english: And he said to them, Why are you troubled, and why are your hearts full of doubt?

chinese: 你們看我的手，我的腳，就知道實在是我了。摸我看看！魂無骨無肉，你們看，我是有的。
english: See; my hands and my feet: it is I myself; put your hands on me and make certain; for a spirit has not flesh and bones as you see that I have.

chinese: 說了這話，就把手和腳給他們看。
english: And when he had said this, he let them see his hands and his feet.

chinese: 他們正喜得不敢信，並且希奇；耶穌就說：你們這裡有甚麼吃的沒有？
english: And because, for joy and wonder, they were still in doubt, he said to them, Have you any food here?

chinese: 他們便給他一片燒魚。（有古卷在此有：和一塊蜜房。）
english: And they gave him a bit of cooked fish.

chinese: 他接過來，在他們面前吃了。
english: And before their eyes he took a meal.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：這就是我從前與你們同在之時所告訴你們的話說：摩西的律法、先知的書，和詩篇上所記的，凡指著我的話都必須應驗。
english: And he said to them, These are the words which I said to you when I was still with you, how it was necessary for all the things which are in the writings of Moses and the prophets and in the Psalms about me, to be put into effect.

chinese: 於是耶穌開他們的心竅，使他們能明白聖經，
english: Then he made the holy Writings clear to their minds.

chinese: 又對他們說：照經上所寫的，基督必受害，第三日從死裡復活，
english: And he said to them, So it is in the Writings that the Christ would undergo death, and come back to life again on the third day;

chinese: 並且人要奉他的名傳悔改、赦罪的道，從耶路撒冷起直傳到萬邦。
english: And that teaching about a change of heart and forgiveness of sins is to be given to Jerusalem first and to all nations in his name.

chinese: 你們就是這些事的見證。
english: You are witnesses of these things.

chinese: 我要將我父所應許的降在你們身上，你們要在城裡等候，直到你們領受從上頭來的能力。
english: And now I will send to you what my father has undertaken to give you, but do not go from the town, till the power from heaven comes to you.

chinese: 耶穌領他們到伯大尼的對面，就舉手給他們祝福。
english: And he took them out till they were near Bethany, and lifting up his hands, he gave them a blessing.

chinese: 正祝福的時候，他就離開他們，被帶到天上去了。
english: And while he was doing so, he went from them and was taken up into heaven.

chinese: 他們就拜他，大大的歡喜，回耶路撒冷去，
english: And they gave him worship and went back to Jerusalem with great joy.

chinese: 常在殿裡稱頌神。
english: And they were in the Temple at all times, giving praise to God.

chinese: 太初有道，道與神同在，道就是神。
english: From the first he was the Word, and the Word was in relation with God and was God.

chinese: 這道太初與神同在。
english: This Word was from the first in relation with God.

chinese: 萬物是藉著他造的；凡被造的，沒有一樣不是藉著他造的。
english: All things came into existence through him, and without him nothing was.

chinese: 生命在他裡頭，這生命就是人的光。
english: What came into existence in him was life, and the life was the light of men.

chinese: 光照在黑暗裡，黑暗卻不接受光。
english: And the light goes on shining in the dark; it is not overcome by the dark.

chinese: 有一個人，是從神那裡差來的，名叫約翰。
english: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

chinese: 這人來，為要作見證，就是為光作見證，叫眾人因他可以信。
english: He came for witness, to give witness about the light, so that all men might have faith through him.

chinese: 他不是那光，乃是要為光作見證。
english: He himself was not the light: he was sent to give witness about the light.

chinese: 那光是真光，照亮一切生在世上的人。
english: The true light, which gives light to every man, was then coming into the world.

chinese: 他在世界，世界也是藉著他造的，世界卻不認識他。
english: He was in the world, the world which came into being through him, but the world had no knowledge of him.

chinese: 他到自己的地方來，自己的人倒不接待他。
english: He came to the things which were his and his people did not take him to their hearts.

chinese: 凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，他就賜他們權柄，作神的兒女。
english: To all those who did so take him, however, he gave the right of becoming children of God--that is, to those who had faith in his name:

chinese: 這等人不是從血氣生的，不是從情慾生的，也不是從人意生的，乃是從神生的。
english: Whose birth was from God and not from blood, or from an impulse of the flesh and man's desire.

chinese: 道成了肉身，住在我們中間，充充滿滿的有恩典有真理。我們也見過他的榮光，正是父獨生子的榮光。
english: And so the Word became flesh and took a place among us for a time; and we saw his glory--such glory as is given to an only son by his father--saw it to be true and full of grace.

chinese: 約翰為他作見證，喊著說：「這就是我曾說：『那在我以後來的，反成了在我以前的，因他本來在我以前。』」
english: John gave witness about him, crying, This is he of whom I said, He who is coming after me is put over me because he was in existence before me.

chinese: 從他豐滿的恩典裡，我們都領受了，而且恩上加恩。
english: From his full measure we have all been given grace on grace.

chinese: 律法本是藉著摩西傳的；恩典和真理都是由耶穌基督來的。
english: For the law was given through Moses; grace and the true way of life are ours through Jesus Christ.

chinese: 從來沒有人看見神，只有在父懷裡的獨生子將他表明出來。
english: No man has seen God at any time; the only Son, who is on the breast of the Father, he has made clear what God is.

chinese: 約翰所作的見證記在下面：猶太人從耶路撒冷差祭司和利未人到約翰那裡，問他說：「你是誰？」
english: And this is the witness of John when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to him with the question, Who are you?

chinese: 他就明說，並不隱瞞，明說：「我不是基督。」
english: He said quite openly and straightforwardly, I am not the Christ.

chinese: 他們又問他說：「這樣，你是誰呢？是以利亞嗎？」他說：「我不是。」「是那先知嗎？」他回答說：「不是。」
english: And they said to him, What then? Are you Elijah? And he said, I am not. Are you the prophet? And his answer was, I am not.

chinese: 於是他們說：「你到底是誰，叫我們好回覆差我們來的人。你自己說，你是誰？」
english: So they said to him, Who are you then? We have to give some answer to those who sent us. What have you to say about yourself?

chinese: 他說：「我就是那在曠野有人聲喊著說：『修直主的道路』，正如先知以賽亞所說的。」
english: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the waste land, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.

chinese: 那些人是法利賽人差來的（或作：那差來的是法利賽人）；
english: Those who had been sent came from the Pharisees.

chinese: 他們就問他說：「你既不是基督，不是以利亞，也不是那先知，為甚麼施洗呢？」
english: And they put this question to him, saying, Why then are you giving baptism if you are not the Christ, or Elijah, or the prophet?

chinese: 約翰回答說：「我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你們中間，是你們不認識的，
english: John's answer was: I give baptism with water; but there is one among you of whom you have no knowledge;

chinese: 就是那在我以後來的，我給他解鞋帶也不配。」
english: It is he who is coming after me; I am not good enough to undo his shoes.

chinese: 這是在約但河外伯大尼（有古卷：伯大巴喇），約翰施洗的地方作的見證。
english: These things took place at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was giving baptism.

chinese: 次日，約翰看見耶穌來到他那裡，就說：「看哪，神的羔羊，除去（或譯：背負）世人罪孽的！
english: The day after, John sees Jesus coming to him and says, See, here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!

chinese: 這就是我曾說：『有一位在我以後來、反成了在我以前的，因他本來在我以前。』
english: This is he of whom I said, One is coming after me who is put over me because he was in existence before me.

chinese: 我先前不認識他，如今我來用水施洗，為要叫他顯明給以色列人。」
english: I myself had no knowledge of him, but I came giving baptism with water so that he might be seen openly by Israel.

chinese: 約翰又作見證說：「我曾看見聖靈，彷彿鴿子從天降下，住在他的身上。
english: And John gave this witness, saying, I saw the Spirit coming down from heaven like a dove and resting on him.

chinese: 我先前不認識他，只是那差我來用水施洗的、對我說：『你看見聖靈降下來，住在誰的身上，誰就是用聖靈施洗的。』
english: I had no knowledge who he was, but he who sent me to give baptism with water said to me, The one on whom you see the Spirit coming down and resting, it is he who gives baptism with the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 我看見了，就證明這是神的兒子。」
english: This I saw myself and my witness is that he is the Son of God.

chinese: 再次日，約翰同兩個門徒站在那裡。
english: The day after, John was there again with two of his disciples;

chinese: 他見耶穌行走，就說：「看哪，這是神的羔羊！」
english: And looking at Jesus while he was walking he said, See, there is the Lamb of God!

chinese: 兩個門徒聽見他的話，就跟從了耶穌。
english: Hearing what he said, the two disciples went after Jesus.

chinese: 耶穌轉過身來，看見他們跟著，就問他們說：「你們要甚麼？」他們說：「拉比，在哪裡住？」（拉比翻出來就是夫子。）
english: And Jesus, turning round, saw them coming after him and said to them, What are you looking for? They said to him, Rabbi (which is to say, Master), where are you living?

chinese: 耶穌說：「你們來看。」他們就去看他在那裡住，這一天便與他同住；那時約有申正了。
english: He said to them, Come and see. They went with him then and saw where he was living; and they were with him all that day: it was then about the tenth hour of the day.

chinese: 聽見約翰的話跟從耶穌的那兩個人，一個是西門彼得的兄弟安得烈。
english: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two men who, hearing what John said, went after Jesus.

chinese: 他先找著自己的哥哥西門，對他說：「我們遇見彌賽亞了。」（彌賽亞繙出來就是基督。）
english: Early in the morning he came across his brother and said to him, We have made discovery! It is the Messiah! (which is to say, the Christ).

chinese: 於是領他去見耶穌。耶穌看著他，說：「你是約翰的兒子西門（約翰在馬太16：17稱約拿），你要稱為磯法。」（磯法翻出來就是彼得。）
english: And he took him to Jesus. Looking at him fixedly Jesus said, You are Simon, the son of John; your name will be Cephas (which is to say, Peter).

chinese: 又次日，耶穌想要往加利利去，遇見腓力，就對他說：「來跟從我吧。」
english: The day after this, Jesus had a desire to go into Galilee. He came across Philip and said to him, Come and be my disciple.

chinese: 這腓力是伯賽大人，和安得烈、彼得同城。
english: Now Philip's town was Beth-saida, where Andrew and Peter came from.

chinese: 腓力找著拿但業，對他說「摩西在律法上所寫的和眾先知所記的那一位，我們遇見了，就是約瑟的兒子拿撒勒人耶穌。」
english: Philip came across Nathanael and said to him, We have made a discovery! It is he of whom Moses, in the law, and the prophets were writing, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

chinese: 拿但業對他說：「拿撒勒還能出甚麼好的嗎？」腓力說：「你來看！」
english: Nazareth! said Nathanael, Is it possible for any good to come out of Nazareth? Philip said to him, Come and see.

chinese: 耶穌看見拿但業來，就指著他說：「看哪，這是個真以色列人，他心裡是沒有詭詐的。」
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and said of him, See, here is a true son of Israel in whom there is nothing false.

chinese: 拿但業對耶穌說：「你從哪知道我呢？」耶穌回答說：「腓力還沒有招呼你，你在無花果樹底下，我就看見你了。」
english: Nathanael said to him, Where did you get knowledge of me? In answer Jesus said, Before Philip was talking with you, while you were still under the fig-tree, I saw you.

chinese: 拿但業說：「拉比，你是神的兒子，你是以色列的王！」
english: Nathanael said to him, Rabbi, you are the Son of God, you are King of Israel!

chinese: 耶穌對他說：「因為我說『在無花果樹底下看見你』，你就信嗎？你將要看見比這更大的事」；
english: In answer Jesus said to him, You have faith because I said to you, I saw you under the fig-tree. You will see greater things than these.

chinese: 又說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們將要看見天開了，神的使者上去下來在人子身上。」
english: And he said to him, Truly I say to you all, You will see heaven opening and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of man.

chinese: 第三日，在加利利的迦拿有娶親的筵席，耶穌的母親在那裡。
english: On the third day two people were going to be married at Cana in Galilee. The mother of Jesus was there:

chinese: 耶穌和他的門徒也被請去赴席。
english: And Jesus with his disciples came as guests.

chinese: 酒用盡了，耶穌的母親對他說：「他們沒有酒了。」
english: When they had not enough wine, the mother of Jesus said to him, They have no wine.

chinese: 耶穌說：「母親（原文是婦人），我與你有甚麼相干？我的時候還沒有到。」
english: Jesus said to her, Woman, this is not your business; my time is still to come.

chinese: 他母親對用人說：「他告訴你們甚麼，你們就做甚麼。」
english: His mother said to the servants, Whatever he says to you, do it.

chinese: 照猶太人潔淨的規矩，有六口石缸擺在那裡，每口可以盛兩三桶水。
english: Now six pots of stone, every one taking two or three firkins of water, were placed there for the purpose of washing, as is the way of the Jews.

chinese: 耶穌對用人說：「把缸倒滿了水。他們就倒滿了，直到缸口。」
english: Jesus said to the servants, Make the pots full of water. And they made them full to the top.

chinese: 耶穌又說：「現在可以舀出來，送給管筵席的。他們就送了去。」
english: Then he said to them, Now take some, and give it to the master of the feast. So they took it to him.

chinese: 管筵席的嘗了那水變的酒，並不知道是那裡來的，只有舀水的用人知道。管筵席的便叫新郎來，
english: After tasting the water which had now become wine, the master of the feast (having no idea where it came from, though it was clear to the servants who took the water out) sent for the newly-married man,

chinese: 對他說：「人都是先擺上好酒，等客喝足了，才擺上次的，你倒把好酒留到如今！」
english: And said to him, Every man first puts out his best wine and when all have had enough he puts out what is not so good; but you have kept the good wine till now.

chinese: 這是耶穌所行的頭一件神蹟，是在加利利的迦拿行的，顯出他的榮耀來；他的門徒就信他了。
english: This, the first of his signs, Jesus did at Cana in Galilee and let his glory be seen openly; and his disciples put their faith in him.

chinese: 這事以後，耶穌與他的母親、弟兄、和門徒都下迦百農去，在那裡住了不多幾日。
english: After this he went down to Capernaum, with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples, and they were there not more than two or three days.

chinese: 猶太人的逾越節近了，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。
english: The time of the Passover of the Jews was near and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

chinese: 看見殿裡有賣牛、羊、鴿子的，並有兌換銀錢的人坐在那裡，
english: And there in the Temple he saw men trading in oxen and sheep and doves, and he saw the changers of money in their seats:

chinese: 耶穌就拿繩子做成鞭子，把牛羊都趕出殿去，倒出兌換銀錢之人的銀錢，推翻他們的桌子，
english: And he made a whip of small cords and put them all out of the Temple, with the sheep and the oxen, sending in all directions the small money of the changers and overturning their tables;

chinese: 又對賣鴿子的說：「把這些東西拿去！不要將我父的殿當作買賣的地方。」
english: And to those who were trading in doves he said, Take these things away; do not make my Father's house a market.

chinese: 他的門徒就想起經上記著說：「我為你的殿心裡焦急，如同火燒。」
english: And it came to the minds of the disciples that the Writings say, I am on fire with passion for your house.

chinese: 因此猶太人問他說：「你既做這些事，還顯甚麼神蹟給我們看呢？」
english: Then the Jews put this question to him: What sign of authority have you to give us, seeing that you do these things?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：「你們拆毀這殿，我三日內要再建立起來。」
english: And Jesus said to them, Send destruction on this Temple and I will put it up again in three days.

chinese: 猶太人便說：「這殿是四十六年才造成的，你三日內就再建立起來嗎？」
english: The Jews said, The building of this Temple took forty-six years; and you will put it up in three days!

chinese: 但耶穌這話是以他的身體為殿。
english: But his words were about that holy building which was his body.

chinese: 所以到他從死裡復活以後，門徒就想起他說過這話，便信了聖經和耶穌所說的。
english: So when he had come back again from the dead, the memory of these words came back to the disciples, and they had faith in the holy Writings and in the word which Jesus had said.

chinese: 當耶穌在耶路撒冷過逾越節的時候，有許多人看見他所行的神蹟，就信了他的名。
english: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover, a great number of people came to have faith in his name, after seeing the signs which he did.

chinese: 耶穌卻不將自己交託他們；因為他知道萬人，
english: But Jesus did not have faith in them, because he had knowledge of them all.

chinese: 也用不著誰見證人怎樣，因他知道人心裡所存的。
english: He had no need for any witness about man; for he himself had knowledge of what was in man.

chinese: 有一個法利賽人，名叫尼哥底母，是猶太人的官。
english: Now there was among the Pharisees a man named Nicodemus, who was one of the rulers of the Jews.

chinese: 這人夜裡來見耶穌，說「拉比，我們知道你是由神那來作師傅的；因為你所行的神蹟，若沒有神同在，無人能行。」
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, Rabbi, we are certain that you have come from God as a teacher, because no man would be able to do these signs which you do if God was not with him.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不重生，就不能見神的國。」
english: Jesus said to him, Truly, I say to you, Without a new birth no man is able to see the kingdom of God.

chinese: 尼哥底母說：「人已經老了，如何能重生呢？豈能再進母腹生出來嗎？」
english: Nicodemus said to him, How is it possible for a man to be given birth when he is old? Is he able to go into his mother's body a second time and come to birth again?

chinese: 耶穌說：「我實實在在的告訴你，人若不是從水和聖靈生的，就不能進神的國。
english: Jesus said in answer, Truly, I say to you, If a man's birth is not from water and from the Spirit, it is not possible for him to go into the kingdom of God.

chinese: 從肉身生的就是肉身；從靈生的就是靈。
english: That which has birth from the flesh is flesh, and that which has birth from the Spirit is spirit.

chinese: 我說：『你們必須重生』，你不要以為希奇。
english: Do not be surprised that I say to you, It is necessary for you to have a second birth.

chinese: 風隨著意思吹，你聽見風的響聲，卻不曉得從那裡來，往那裡去；凡從聖靈生的，也是如此。」
english: The wind goes where its pleasure takes it, and the sound of it comes to your ears, but you are unable to say where it comes from and where it goes: so it is with everyone whose birth is from the Spirit.

chinese: 尼哥底母問他說：「怎能有這事呢？」
english: And Nicodemus said to him, How is it possible for these things to be?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：「你是以色列人的先生，還不明白這事嗎？
english: And Jesus, answering, said, Are you the teacher of Israel and have no knowledge of these things?

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你，我們所說的是我們知道的；我們所見證的是我們見過的；你們卻不領受我們的見證。
english: Truly, I say to you, We say that of which we have knowledge; we give witness of what we have seen; and you do not take our witness to be true.

chinese: 我對你們說地上的事，你們尚且不信，若說天上的事，如何能信呢？
english: If you have no belief when my words are about the things of earth, how will you have belief if my words are about the things of heaven?

chinese: 除了從天降下、仍舊在天的人子，沒有人升過天。
english: And no one has ever gone up to heaven but he who came down from heaven, the Son of man.

chinese: 摩西在曠野怎樣舉蛇，人子也必照樣被舉起來，
english: As the snake was lifted up by Moses in the waste land, even so it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up:

chinese: 叫一切信他的都得永生（或作：叫一切信的人在他裡面得永生）。
english: So that whoever has faith may have in him eternal life.

chinese: 「神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們，叫一切信他的，不至滅亡，反得永生。
english: For God had such love for the world that he gave his only Son, so that whoever has faith in him may not come to destruction but have eternal life.

chinese: 因為神差他的兒子降世，不是要定世人的罪（或作：審判世人；下同），乃是要叫世人因他得救。
english: God did not send his Son into the world to be judge of the world; he sent him so that the world might have salvation through him.

chinese: 信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，罪已經定了，因為他不信神獨生子的名。
english: The man who has faith in him does not come up to be judged; but he who has no faith in him has been judged even now, because he has no faith in the name of the only Son of God.

chinese: 光來到世間，世人因自己的行為是惡的，不愛光，倒愛黑暗，定他們的罪就是在此。
english: And this is the test by which men are judged: the light has come into the world and men have more love for the dark than for the light, because their acts are evil.

chinese: 凡作惡的便恨光，並不來就光，恐怕他的行為受責備。
english: The light is hated by everyone whose acts are evil and he does not come to the light for fear that his acts will be seen.

chinese: 但行真理的必來就光，要顯明他所行的是靠神而行。」
english: But he whose life is true comes to the light, so that it may be clearly seen that his acts have been done by the help of God.

chinese: 這事以後，耶穌和門徒到了猶太地，在那裡居住，施洗。
english: After these things Jesus and his disciples went into the land of Judaea, and there he was with them for some time, giving baptism.

chinese: 約翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗；因為那裡水多，眾人都去受洗。
english: Now John was then giving baptism at Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there; and people came and were given baptism.

chinese: （那時約翰還沒有下在監計。）
english: For at this time John had not been put into prison.

chinese: 約翰的門徒和一個猶太人辯論潔淨的禮，
english: Then a question came up between John's disciples and a Jew about washing.

chinese: 就來見約翰，說：「拉比，從前同你在約旦河外、你所見證的那位，現在施洗，眾人都往他那裡去了。」
english: And they went to John and said to him, Rabbi, the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan, the man to whom you gave witness, is now giving baptism, and everyone is going to him.

chinese: 約翰說：「若不是從天上賜的，人就不能得甚麼。
english: And this was John's answer: A man is unable to have anything if it is not given to him from heaven.

chinese: 我曾說：『我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的』，你們自己可以給我作見證。
english: You yourselves give witness that I said, I am not the Christ. What I said was, I am sent before the Christ.

chinese: 娶新婦的就是新郎；新郎的朋友站著，聽見新郎的聲音就甚喜樂。故此，我這喜樂滿足了。
english: He who has the bride is the husband: but the husband's friend, whose place is by his side and whose ears are open to him, is full of joy because of the husband's voice: such is my joy, and it is complete.

chinese: 他必興旺，我必衰微。」
english: He has to become greater while I become less.

chinese: 「從天上來的是在萬有之上；從地上來的是屬乎地，他所說的也是屬乎地。從天上來的是在萬有之上。
english: He who comes from heaven is greater than all others: he who comes from earth is of the earth, and of the earth are his words: he who comes from heaven is over all.

chinese: 他將所見所聞的見證出來，只是沒有人領受他的見證。
english: He gives witness of what he has seen and of what has come to his ears; and no man takes his witness as true.

chinese: 那領受他見證的，就印上印，證明神是真的。
english: He who so takes his witness has made clear his faith that God is true.

chinese: 神所差來的就說神的話，因為神賜聖靈給他是沒有限量的。
english: For he whom God has sent says God's words; and God does not give him the Spirit by measure.

chinese: 父愛子，已將萬有交在他手裡。
english: The Father has love for the Son and has put all things into his hands.

chinese: 信子的人有永生；不信子的人得不著永生（原文作不得見永生），神的震怒常在他身上。」
english: He who has faith in the Son has eternal life; but he who has not faith in the Son will not see life; God's wrath is resting on him.

chinese: 主知道法利賽人聽見他收門徒，施洗，比約翰還多，
english: Now when it was clear to the Lord that word had come to the ears of the Pharisees that Jesus was making more disciples than John and was giving them baptism

chinese: （其實不是耶穌親自施洗，乃是他的門徒施洗，）
english: (Though, in fact, it was his disciples who gave baptism, not Jesus himself),

chinese: 他就離了猶太，又往加利利去。
english: He went out of Judaea into Galilee again.

chinese: 必須經過撒瑪利亞，
english: And it was necessary for him to go through Samaria.

chinese: 於是到了撒瑪利亞的一座城，名叫敘加，靠近雅各給他兒子約瑟的那塊地。
english: So he came to a town of Samaria which was named Sychar, near to the bit of land which Jacob gave to his son Joseph:

chinese: 在那裡有雅各井；耶穌因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那時約有午正。
english: Now Jacob's fountain was there. Jesus, being tired after his journey, was resting by the fountain. It was about the sixth hour.

chinese: 有一個撒瑪利亞的婦人來打水。耶穌對他說：「請你給我水喝。」
english: A woman of Samaria came to get water, and Jesus said to her, Give me some water.

chinese: （那時門徒進城買食物去了。〉
english: For his disciples had gone to the town to get food.

chinese: 撒瑪利亞的婦人對他說：「你既是猶太人，怎麼向我一個撒馬利亞婦人要水喝呢？」原來猶太人和撒瑪利亞人沒有來往。
english: The woman of Samaria said to him, Why do you, a Jew, make a request for water to me, a woman of Samaria? She said this because Jews have nothing to do with the people of Samaria.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：「你若知道神的恩賜，和對你說『給我水喝』的是誰，你必早求他，他也必早給了你活水。」
english: In answer Jesus said, If you had knowledge of what God gives freely and who it is who says to you, Give me water, you would make your prayer to him, and he would give you living water.

chinese: 婦人說：「先生，沒有打水的器具，井又深，你從那裡得活水呢？
english: The woman said to him, Sir, you have no vessel and the fountain is deep; from where will you get the living water?

chinese: 我們的祖宗雅各將這井留給我們，他自己和兒子並牲畜也都喝這井裡的水，難道你比他還大嗎？」
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob who gave us the fountain and took the water of it himself, with his children and his cattle?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：凡喝這水的還要再渴；
english: Jesus said to her, Everyone who takes this water will be in need of it again:

chinese: 人若喝我所賜的水就永遠不渴。我所賜的水要在他裡頭成為泉源，直湧到永生。」
english: But whoever takes the water I give him will never be in need of drink again; for the water I give him will become in him a fountain of eternal life.

chinese: 婦人說：「先生，請把這水賜給我，叫我不渴，也不用來這麼遠打水。」
english: The woman said to him, Sir, give me this water, so that I may not be in need again of drink and will not have to come all this way for it.

chinese: 耶穌說：「你去叫你丈夫也到這裡來。」
english: Jesus said to her, Go, get your husband and come back here with him.

chinese: 婦人說：「我沒有丈夫。」耶穌說：「你說沒有丈夫是不錯的。
english: In answer, the woman said, I have no husband. Jesus said to her, You have said rightly, I have no husband:

chinese: 你已經有五個丈夫，你現在有的並不是你的丈夫。你這話是真的。」
english: You have had five husbands, and the man you have now is not your husband: that was truly said.

chinese: 婦人說：先生，我看出你是先知。
english: The woman said to him, Sir, I see that you are a prophet.

chinese: 我們的祖宗在這山上禮拜，你們倒說，應當禮拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」
english: Our fathers gave worship on this mountain, but you Jews say that the right place for worship is in Jerusalem.

chinese: 耶穌說：婦人，你當信我。時候將到，你們拜父，也不在這山上，也不在耶路撒冷。
english: Jesus said to her, Woman, take my word for this; the time is coming when you will not give worship to the Father on this mountain or in Jerusalem.

chinese: 你們所拜的，你們不知道；我們所拜的，我們知道，因為救恩是從猶太人出來的。
english: You give worship, but without knowledge of what you are worshipping: we give worship to what we have knowledge of: for salvation comes from the Jews.

chinese: 時候將到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心靈和誠實拜他，因為父要這樣的人拜他。
english: But the time is coming, and is even now here, when the true worshippers will give worship to the Father in the true way of the spirit, for these are the worshippers desired by the Father.

chinese: 神是個靈（或無個字），所以拜他的必須用心靈和誠實拜他。」
english: God is Spirit: then let his worshippers give him worship in the true way of the spirit.

chinese: 婦人說：「我知道彌賽亞（就是那稱為基督的）要來；他來了，必將一切的事都告訴我們。」
english: The woman said to him, I am certain that the Messiah, who is named Christ, is coming; when he comes he will make all things clear to us.

chinese: 耶穌說：「這和你說話的就是他！」
english: Jesus said to her, I, who am talking to you, am he.

chinese: 當下門徒回來，就希奇耶穌和一個婦人說話；只是沒有人說：「你是要甚麼？」或說：「你為甚麼和他說話？」
english: At that point the disciples came back, and they were surprised to see him talking to a woman; but not one of them said to him, What is your purpose? or, Why are you talking to her?

chinese: 那婦人就留下水罐子，往城裡去，對眾人說：
english: Then the woman put down her water-pot and went into the town, and said to the people,

chinese: 「你們來看！有一個人將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了，莫非這就是基督嗎？」
english: Come and see a man who has been talking to me of everything I ever did! Is it possible that this is the Christ?

chinese: 眾人就出城，往耶穌那裡去。
english: So they went out of the town and came to him.

chinese: 這其間，門徒對耶穌說：「拉比，請吃。」
english: While this was taking place, the disciples were saying to Jesus, Master, take some food.

chinese: 耶穌說：「我有食物吃，是你們不知道的。」
english: But he said to them, I have food of which you have no knowledge.

chinese: 門徒就彼此對問說：「莫非有人拿甚麼給他吃嗎？」
english: So the disciples said one to another, Did anyone give him food?

chinese: 耶穌說：「我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意，做成他的工。
english: Jesus said, My food is to do the pleasure of him who sent me and to make his work complete.

chinese: 你們豈不說『到收割的時候還有四個月』嗎？我告訴你們，舉目向田觀看，莊稼已經熟了（原文是發白），可以收割了。
english: You would say, Four months from now is the time of the grain-cutting. Take a look, I say to you, at the fields; they are even now white for cutting.

chinese: 收割的人得工價，積蓄五穀到永生，叫撒種的和收割的一同快樂。
english: He who does the cutting now has his reward; he is getting together fruit for eternal life, so that he who did the planting and he who gets in the grain may have joy together.

chinese: 俗語說：：『那人撒種，這人收割』，這話可見是真的。
english: In this the saying is a true one, One does the planting, and another gets in the grain.

chinese: 我差你們去收你們所沒有勞苦的；別人勞苦，你們享受他們所勞苦的。」
english: I sent you to get in grain which you had no hand in planting: other men did that work, and you take the reward.

chinese: 那城裡有好些撒瑪利亞人信了耶穌，因為那婦人作見證說：「他將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了。」
english: Now a number of the people of that town had faith in him because of the woman's witness: He has been talking to me of everything I ever did.

chinese: 於是撒瑪利亞人來見耶穌，求他在他們那裡住下，他便在那裡住了兩天。
english: So when the people came to him they made request to him to be among them for a time, and he was there two days.

chinese: 因耶穌的話，信的人就更多了，
english: And a great number more of them came to have faith in him because of what he himself said.

chinese: 便對婦人說：「現在我們信，不是因為你的話，是我們親自聽見了，知道這真是救世主。」
english: And they said to the woman, Now we have faith, but not because of your story: we ourselves have given ear to his words, and we are certain that he is truly the Saviour of the world.

chinese: 過了那兩天，耶穌離了那地方，往加利利去。
english: And after the two days he went on from there into Galilee.

chinese: 因為耶穌自己作過見證說：「先知在本地是沒有人尊敬的。」
english: For Jesus himself said that a prophet has no honour in the country of his birth.

chinese: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看見他在耶路撒冷過節所行的一切事，就接待他，因為他們也是上去過節。
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galilaeans took him to their hearts because of the things which they had seen him do in Jerusalem at the feast--they themselves having been there at the feast.

chinese: 耶穌又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他從前變水為酒的地方。有一個大臣，他的兒子在迦百農患病。
english: So he came to Cana in Galilee, where he had made the water wine. And there was a certain man of high position whose son was ill at Capernaum.

chinese: 他聽見耶穌從猶太到了加利利，就來見他，求他下去醫治他的兒子，因為他兒子快要死了。
english: When it came to his ears that Jesus had come from Judaea into Galilee, he went to him and made a request that he would come down to his son, who was near to death, and make him well.

chinese: 耶穌就對他說：「若不看見神蹟奇事，你們總是不信。」
english: Then Jesus said to him, You will not have faith if you do not see signs and wonders.

chinese: 那大臣說：「先生，求你趁著我的孩子還沒有死就下去。」
english: The man said, Sir, come down before my boy is dead.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：「回去吧，你的兒子活了！」那人信耶穌所說的話就回去了。
english: And Jesus said, Go in peace; your son is living. The man had faith in the word which Jesus said to him and went away.

chinese: 正下去的時候，他的僕人迎見他，說他的兒子活了。
english: And while he was going down, his servants came to him and said, Your boy is living.

chinese: 他就問甚麼時候見好的。他們說：「昨日未時熱就退了。」
english: So he put a question to them as to the hour when he became better; and they said to him, The disease went from him yesterday at the seventh hour.

chinese: 他便知道這正是耶穌對他說「你兒子活了」的時候；他自己和全家就都信了。
english: It was clear then to the father that this was the very time at which Jesus said to him, Your son is living. And he had faith in Jesus, he and all his family.

chinese: 這是耶穌在加利利行的第二件神蹟，是他從猶太回去以後行的。
english: Now this is the second sign which Jesus did after he had come out of Judaea into Galilee.

chinese: 這事以後，到了猶太人的一個節期，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。
english: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

chinese: 在耶路撒冷，靠近羊門有一個池子，希伯來話叫作畢士大，旁邊有五個廊子；
english: Now in Jerusalem near the sheep-market there is a public bath which in Hebrew is named Beth-zatha. It has five doorways.

chinese: 裡面躺著瞎眼的、瘸腿的、血氣枯乾的許多病人。（有古卷在此有：等候水動；
english: In these doorways there were a great number of people with different diseases: some unable to see, some without the power of walking, some with wasted bodies.

chinese: 因為有天使按時下池子攪動那水，水動之後，誰先下去，無論害甚麼病就痊愈了。）
在那裡有一個人，病了三十八年。
english: One man was there who had been ill for thirty-eight years.

chinese: 耶穌看見他躺著，知道他病了許久，就問他說：你要痊瘉麼？
english: When Jesus saw him there on the floor it was clear to him that he had been now a long time in that condition, and so he said to the man, Is it your desire to get well?

chinese: 病人回答說：先生，水動的時候，沒有人把我放在池子裡；我正去的時候，就有別人比我先下去。
english: The ill man said in answer, Sir, I have nobody to put me into the bath when the water is moving; and while I am on the way down some other person gets in before me.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：起來，拿你的褥子走罷！
english: Jesus said to him, Get up, take your bed and go.

chinese: 那人立刻痊愈，就拿起褥子來走了。
english: And the man became well straight away, and took up his bed and went. Now that day was the Sabbath.

chinese: 那天是安息日，所以猶太人對那醫好的人說：今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。
english: So the Jews said to the man who had been made well, It is the Sabbath; and it is against the law for you to take up your bed.

chinese: 他卻回答說：那使我痊愈的，對我說：拿你的褥子走罷。
english: He said to them, But he who made me well, said to me, Take up your bed and go.

chinese: 他們問他說：對你說拿褥子走的是甚麼人？
english: Then they put to him the question: Who is the man who said to you, Take it up and go?

chinese: 那醫好的人不知道是誰；因為那裡的人多，耶穌已經躲開了。
english: Now he who had been made well had no knowledge who it was, Jesus having gone away because of the number of people who were in that place.

chinese: 後來耶穌在殿裡遇見他，對他說：你已經痊愈了，不要再犯罪，恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。
english: After a time Jesus came across him in the Temple and said to him, See, you are well and strong; do no more sin for fear a worse thing comes to you.

chinese: 那人就去告訴猶太人，使他痊愈的是耶穌。
english: The man went away and said to the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

chinese: 所以猶太人逼迫耶穌，因為他在安息日做了這事。
english: And for this reason the Jews were turned against Jesus, because he was doing these things on the Sabbath.

chinese: 耶穌就對他們說：我父做事直到如今，我也做事。
english: But his answer was: My Father is still working even now, and so I am working.

chinese: 所以猶太人越發想要殺他；因他不但犯了安息日，並且稱神為他的父，將自己和神當作平等。
english: For this cause the Jews had an even greater desire to put Jesus to death, because not only did he not keep the Sabbath but he said God was his Father, so making himself equal with God.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：我實實在在的告訴你們，子憑著自己不能做甚麼，惟有看見父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照樣做。
english: So Jesus made answer and said, Truly I say to you, The Son is not able to do anything himself; he is able to do only what he sees the Father doing; whatever the Father does the Son does it in the same way.

chinese: 父愛子，將自己所做的一切事指給他看，還要將比這更大的事指給他看，叫你們希奇。
english: For the Father has love for the Son and lets him see everything which he does: and he will let him see greater works than these so that you may be full of wonder.

chinese: 父怎樣叫死人起來，使他們活著，子也照樣隨自己的意思使人活著。
