english: In the same way, as the Father gives life to the dead, even so the Son gives life to those to whom he is pleased to give it.

chinese: 父不審判甚麼人，乃將審判的事全交與子，
english: The Father is not the judge of men, but he has given all decisions into the hands of the Son;

chinese: 叫人都尊敬子如同尊敬父一樣。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子來的父。
english: So that all men may give honour to the Son even as they give honour to the Father. He who gives no honour to the Son gives no honour to the Father who sent him.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，那聽我話、又信差我來者的，就有永生；不至於定罪，是已經出死入生了。
english: Truly I say to you, The man whose ears are open to my word and who has faith in him who sent me, has eternal life; he will not be judged, but has come from death into life.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，時候將到，現在就是了，死人要聽見神兒子的聲音，聽見的人就要活了。
english: Truly I say to you, The time is coming, it has even now come, when the voice of the Son of God will come to the ears of the dead, and those hearing it will have life.

chinese: 因為父怎樣在自己有生命，就賜給他兒子也照樣在自己有生命，
english: For even as the Father has life in himself, so he has given to the Son to have life in himself.

chinese: 並且因為他是人子，就賜給他行審判的權柄。
english: And he has given him authority to be judge because he is the Son of man.

chinese: 你們不要把這事看作希奇。時候要到，凡在墳墓裡的，都要聽見他的聲音，就出來；
english: Do not be surprised at this: for the time is coming when his voice will come to all who are in the place of the dead,

chinese: 行善的，復活得生；作惡的，復活定罪。
english: And they will come out; those who have done good, into the new life; and those who have done evil, to be judged.

chinese: 我憑著自己不能做甚麼，我怎麼聽見就怎麼審判。我的審判也是公平的；因為我不求自己的意思，只求那差我來者的意思。
english: Of myself I am unable to do anything: as the voice comes to me so I give a decision: and my decision is right because I have no desire to do what is pleasing to myself, but only what is pleasing to him who sent me.

chinese: 我若為自己作見證，我的見證就不真。
english: If I gave witness about myself, my witness would not be true.

chinese: 另有一位給我作見證，我也知道他給我作的見證是真的。
english: There is another who gives witness about me and I am certain that the witness he gives about me is true.

chinese: 你們曾差人到約翰那裡，他為真理作過見證。
english: You sent to John and he gave true witness.

chinese: 其實，我所受的見證不是從人來的；然而，我說這些話，為要叫你們得救。
english: But I have no need of a man's witness: I only say these things so that you may have salvation.

chinese: 約翰是點著的明燈，你們情願暫時喜歡他的光。
english: He was a burning and shining light, and for a time you were ready to be happy in his light.

chinese: 但我有比約翰更大的見證；因為父交給我要我成就的事，就是我所做的事，這便見證我是父所差來的。
english: But the witness which I have is greater than that of John: the work which the Father has given me to do, the very work which I am now doing, is a witness that the Father has sent me.

chinese: 差我來的父也為我作過見證。你們從來沒有聽見他的聲音，也沒有看見他的形像。
english: And the Father himself who sent me has given witness about me. Not one of you has ever given ear to his voice; his form you have not seen.

chinese: 你們並沒有他的道存在心裡；因為他所差來的，你們不信。
english: And you have not kept his word in your hearts, because you have not faith in him whom he has sent.

chinese: 你們查考聖經（或作：應當查考聖經），因你們以為內中有永生；給我作見證的就是這經。
english: You make search in the holy Writings, in the belief that through them you get eternal life; and it is those Writings which give witness about me.

chinese: 然而，你們不肯到我這裡來得生命。
english: And still you have no desire to come to me so that you may have life.

chinese: 我不受從人來的榮耀。
english: I do not take honour from men;

chinese: 但我知道，你們心裡沒有神的愛。
english: But I have knowledge of you that you have no love for God in your hearts.

chinese: 我奉我父的名來，你們並不接待我；若有別人奉自己的名來，你們倒要接待他。
english: I have come in my Father's name, and your hearts are not open to me. If another comes with no other authority but himself, you will give him your approval.

chinese: 你們互相受榮耀，卻不求從獨一之神來的榮耀，怎能信我呢？
english: How is it possible for you to have faith while you take honour one from another and have no desire for the honour which comes from the only God?

chinese: 不要想我在父面前要告你們；有一位告你們的，就是你們所仰賴的摩西。
english: Put out of your minds the thought that I will say things against you to the Father: the one who says things against you is Moses, on whom you put your hopes.

chinese: 你們如果信摩西，也必信我，因為他書上有指著我寫的話。
english: If you had belief in Moses you would have belief in me; for his writings are about me.

chinese: 你們若不信他的書，怎能信我的話呢？
english: If you have no belief in his writings, how will you have belief in my words?

chinese: 這事以後，耶穌渡過加利利海，就是提比哩亞海。
english: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee--that is, the sea of Tiberias.

chinese: 有許多人因為看見他在病人身上所行的神蹟，就跟隨他。
english: And a great number of people went after him because they saw the signs which he did on those who were ill.

chinese: 耶穌上了山，和門徒一同坐在那裡。
english: Then Jesus went up the mountain and was seated there with his disciples.

chinese: 那時猶太人的逾越節近了。
english: Now the Passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.

chinese: 耶穌舉目看見許多人來，就對腓力說：我們從那裡買餅叫這些人吃呢？
english: Lifting up his eyes, Jesus saw a great number of people coming to where he was, and he said to Philip, Where may we get bread for all these people?

chinese: 他說這話是要試驗腓力；他自己原知道要怎樣行。
english: This he said, testing him: for he had no doubt what he himself would do.

chinese: 腓力回答說：就是二十兩銀子的餅，叫他們各人吃一點也是不夠的。
english: Philip made answer, Bread to the value of two hundred pence would not be enough even to give everyone a little.

chinese: 有一個門徒，就是西門彼得的兄弟安得烈，對耶穌說：
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, said to Jesus,

chinese: 在這裡有一個孩童，帶著五個大麥餅、兩條魚，只是分給這許多人還算甚麼呢？
english: There is a boy here with five barley cakes and two fishes: but what is that among such a number?

chinese: 耶穌說：你們叫眾人坐下。原來那地方的草多，眾人就坐下，數目約有五千。
english: Jesus said, Let the people be seated. Now there was much grass in that place. And those seated on the grass were about five thousand.

chinese: 耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，就分給那坐著的人；分魚也是這樣，都隨著他們所要的。
english: Then Jesus took the cakes and having given praise to God, he gave them to the people who were seated, and the fishes in the same way, as much as they had need of.

chinese: 他們吃飽了，耶穌對門徒說：把剩下的零碎收拾起來，免得有糟蹋的。
english: And when they had had enough, Jesus said to his disciples, Take up the broken bits which are over, so that nothing may be wasted.

chinese: 他們便將那五個大麥餅的零碎，就是眾人吃了剩下的，收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
english: So they took them up: twelve baskets full of broken bits of the five cakes which were over after the people had had enough.

chinese: 眾人看見耶穌所行的神蹟，就說：這真是那要到世間來的先知！
english: And when the people saw the sign which he had done, they said, Truly, this is the prophet who is to come into the world.

chinese: 耶穌既知道眾人要來強逼他作王，就獨自又退到山上去了。
english: Now when Jesus saw that the people were about to come and take him by force to make him a king, he went away again up the mountain by himself.

chinese: 到了晚上，他的門徒下海邊去，
english: When evening came the disciples went down to the sea;

chinese: 上了船，要過海往迦百農去。天已經黑了，耶穌還沒有來到他們那裡。
english: And they took a boat and went across the sea in the direction of Capernaum. By then it was dark and still Jesus had not come to them.

chinese: 忽然狂風大作，海就翻騰起來。
english: The sea was getting rough because of a strong wind which was blowing.

chinese: 門徒搖櫓，約行了十里多路，看見耶穌在海面上走，漸漸近了船，他們就害怕。
english: After they had gone three or four miles they saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near to the boat; and they had great fear.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：是我，不要怕！
english: But he said to them, It is I, have no fear.

chinese: 門徒就喜歡接他上船，船立時到了他們所要去的地方。
english: Then they readily took him into the boat: and straight away the boat was at the land to which they were going.

chinese: 第二日，站在海那邊的眾人知道那裡沒有別的船，只有一隻小船，又知道耶穌沒有同他的門徒上船，乃是門徒自己去的。
english: The day after, the people who were on the other side of the sea saw that only one small boat had been there, that Jesus had not gone in that boat with the disciples, but that the disciples had gone away by themselves.

chinese: 然而，有幾隻小船從提比哩亞來，靠近主祝謝後分餅給人吃的地方。
english: Some other boats, however, came from Tiberias near to the place where they had taken the bread after the Lord had given praise.

chinese: 眾人見耶穌和門徒都不在那裡，就上了船，往迦百農去找耶穌。
english: So when the people saw that Jesus was not there, or his disciples, they got into those boats and went over to Capernaum looking for Jesus.

chinese: 既在海那邊找著了，就對他說：拉比，是幾時到這裡來的？
english: And when they came across him on the other side of the sea they said, Rabbi, when did you come here?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我實實在在的告訴你們，你們找我，並不是因見了神蹟，乃是因吃餅得飽。
english: Jesus, answering them, said, Truly I say to you, You come after me, not because you saw signs, but because you were given the bread and had enough.

chinese: 不要為那必壞的食物勞力，要為那存到永生的食物勞力，就是人子要賜給你們的，因為人子是父神所印證的。
english: Let your work not be for the food which comes to an end, but for the food which goes on for eternal life, which the Son of man will give to you, for on him has God the Father put his mark.

chinese: 眾人問他說：我們當行甚麼，才算做神的工呢？
english: Then they said to him, How may we do the works of God?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：信神所差來的，這就是做神的工。
english: Jesus, answering, said to them, This is to do the work of God: to have faith in him whom God has sent.

chinese: 他們又說：你行甚麼神蹟，叫我們看見就信你；你到底做甚麼事呢？
english: So they said, What sign do you give us, so that we may see and have faith in you? What do you do?

chinese: 我們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，如經上寫著說：他從天上賜下糧來給他們吃。
english: Our fathers had the manna in the waste land, as the Writings say, He gave them bread from heaven.

chinese: 耶穌說：我實實在在的告訴你們，那從天上來的糧不是摩西賜給你們的，乃是我父將天上來的真糧賜給你們。
english: Jesus then said to them, Truly I say to you, What Moses gave you was not the bread from heaven; it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

chinese: 因為神的糧就是那從天上降下來、賜生命給世界的。
english: The bread of God is the bread which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.

chinese: 他們說：主阿，常將這糧賜給我們！
english: Ah, Lord, they said, give us that bread for ever!

chinese: 耶穌說：我就是生命的糧。到我這裡來的，必定不餓；信我的，永遠不渴。
english: And this was the answer of Jesus: I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will never be in need of food, and he who has faith in me will never be in need of drink.

chinese: 只是我對你們說過，你們已經看見我，還是不信。
english: But it is as I said to you: you have seen me, and still you have no faith.

chinese: 凡父所賜給我的人必到我這裡來；到我這裡來的，我總不丟棄他。
english: Whatever the Father gives to me will come to me; and I will not send away anyone who comes to me.

chinese: 因為我從天上降下來，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我來者的意思行。
english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my pleasure, but the pleasure of him who sent me.

chinese: 差我來者的意思就是：他所賜給我的，叫我一個也不失落，在末日卻叫他復活。
english: And this is the pleasure of him who sent me, that I am not to let out of my hands anything which he has given me, but I am to give it new life on the last day.

chinese: 因為我父的意思是叫一切見子而信的人得永生，並且在末日我要叫他復活。
english: This, I say, is my Father's pleasure, that everyone who sees the Son and has faith in him may have eternal life: and I will take him up on the last day.

chinese: 猶太人因為耶穌說我是從天上降下來的糧，就私下議論他，
english: Now the Jews said bitter things about Jesus because of his words, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

chinese: 說：這不是約瑟的兒子耶穌麼？他的父母我們豈不認得麼？他如今怎麼說我是從天上降下來的呢？
english: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we have seen? How is it then that he now says, I have come down from heaven?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：你們不要大家議論。
english: Jesus made answer and said, Do not say things against me, one to another.

chinese: 若不是差我來的父吸引人，就沒有能到我這裡來的；到我這裡來的，在末日我要叫他復活。
english: No man is able to come to me if the Father who sent me does not give him the desire to come: and I will take him up from the dead on the last day.

chinese: 在先知書上寫著說：他們都要蒙神的教訓。凡聽見父之教訓又學習的，就到我這裡來。
english: The writings of the prophets say, And they will all have teaching from God. Everyone whose ears have been open to the teaching of the Father comes to me.

chinese: 這不是說有人看見過父；惟獨從神來的，他看見過父。
english: Not that anyone has ever seen the Father; only he who is from God, he has seen the Father.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，信的人有永生。
english: Truly I say to you, He who has faith in me has eternal life.

chinese: 我就是生命的糧。
english: I am the bread of life.

chinese: 你們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，還是死了。
english: Your fathers took the manna in the waste land--and they are dead.

chinese: 這是從天上降下來的糧，叫人吃了就不死。
english: The bread which comes from heaven is such bread that a man may take it for food and never see death.

chinese: 我是從天上降下來生命的糧；人若吃這糧，就必永遠活著。我所要賜的糧就是我的肉，為世人之生命所賜的。
english: I am the living bread which has come from heaven: if any man takes this bread for food he will have life for ever: and more than this, the bread which I will give is my flesh which I will give for the life of the world.

chinese: 因此，猶太人彼此爭論說：這個人怎能把他的肉給我們吃呢？
english: Then the Jews had an angry discussion among themselves, saying, How is it possible for this man to give us his flesh for food?

chinese: 耶穌說：我實實在在的告訴你們，你們若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就沒有生命在你們裡面。
english: Then Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, If you do not take the flesh of the Son of man for food, and if you do not take his blood for drink, you have no life in you.

chinese: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他復活。
english: He who takes my flesh for food and my blood for drink has eternal life: and I will take him up from the dead at the last day.

chinese: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。
english: My flesh is true food and my blood is true drink.

chinese: 吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我裡面，我也常在他裡面。
english: He who takes my flesh for food and my blood for drink is in me and I in him.

chinese: 永活的父怎樣差我來，我又因父活著；照樣，吃我肉的人也要因我活著。
english: As the living Father has sent me, and I have life because of the Father, even so he who takes me for his food will have life because of me.

chinese: 這就是從天上降下來的糧。吃這糧的人就永遠活著，不像你們的祖宗吃過嗎哪還是死了。
english: This is the bread which has come down from heaven. It is not like the food which your fathers had: they took of the manna, and are dead; but he who takes this bread for food will have life for ever.

chinese: 這些話是耶穌在迦百農會堂裡教訓人說的。
english: Jesus said these things in the Synagogue while he was teaching at Capernaum.

chinese: 他的門徒中有好些人聽見了，就說：這話甚難，誰能聽呢？
english: Then, hearing this, a number of his disciples said, This is a hard saying; who is able to take in such teaching?

chinese: 耶穌心裡知道門徒為這話議論，就對他們說：這話是叫你們厭棄（原文是跌倒）麼？
english: When Jesus became conscious that his disciples were protesting about what he said, he said to them, Does this give you trouble?

chinese: 倘或你們看見人子升到他原來所在之處，怎麼樣呢？
english: What then will you say if you see the Son of man going up to where he was before?

chinese: 叫人活著的乃是靈，肉體是無益的。我對你們所說的話就是靈，就是生命。
english: The spirit is the life giver; the flesh is of no value: the words which I have said to you are spirit and they are life.

chinese: 只是你們中間有不信的人。耶穌從起頭就知道誰不信他，誰要賣他。
english: But still some of you have no faith. For it was clear to Jesus from the first who they were who had no faith, and who it was who would be false to him.

chinese: 耶穌又說：所以我對你們說過，若不是蒙我父的恩賜，沒有人能到我這裡來。
english: And he said, This is why I said to you, No man is able to come to me if he is not given the power to do so by the Father.

chinese: 從此，他門徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。
english: Because of what he said, a number of the disciples went back and would no longer go with him.

chinese: 耶穌就對那十二個門徒說：你們也要去麼？
english: So Jesus said to the twelve, Have you a desire to go away?

chinese: 西門彼得回答說：主阿，你有永生之道，我們還歸從誰呢？
english: Then Simon Peter gave this answer: Lord, to whom are we to go? you have the words of eternal life;

chinese: 我們已經信了，又知道你是神的聖者。
english: And we have faith and are certain that you are the Holy One of God.

chinese: 耶穌說：我不是揀選了你們十二個門徒麼？但你們中間有一個是魔鬼。
english: Then Jesus said, Did I not make a selection of you, the twelve, and one of you is a son of the Evil One?

chinese: 耶穌這話是指著加略人西門的兒子猶大說的；他本是十二個門徒裡的一個，後來要賣耶穌的。
english: He was talking of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. It was he who was to be false to Jesus--one of the twelve.

chinese: 這事以後，耶穌在加利利遊行，不願在猶太遊行，因為猶太人想要殺他。
english: After this, Jesus went from place to place in Galilee. He did not go about in Judaea, because the Jews were looking for a chance to put him to death.

chinese: 當時猶太人的住棚節近了。
english: But the feast of the Jews, the feast of tents, was near.

chinese: 耶穌的弟兄就對他說：你離開這裡上猶太去罷，叫你的門徒也看見你所行的事。
english: So his brothers said to him, Go away from here into Judaea so that your disciples may see the works which you do.

chinese: 人要顯揚名聲，沒有在暗處行事的；你如果行這些事，就當將自己顯明給世人看。
english: Because no man does things secretly if he has a desire that men may have knowledge of him. If you do these things, let yourself be seen by all men.

chinese: 因為連他的弟兄說這話，是因為不信他。
english: For even his brothers had no belief in him.

chinese: 耶穌就對他們說：我的時候還沒有到；你們的時候常是方便的。
english: Jesus said to them, My time is still to come, but any time is good for you.

chinese: 世人不能恨你們，卻是恨我，因為我指證他們所做的事是惡的。
english: It is not possible for you to be hated by the world; but I am hated by it, because I give witness that what it does is evil.

chinese: 你們上去過節罷，我現在不上去過這節，因為我的時候還沒有滿。
english: Go you up to the feast: I am not going up now to the feast because my time has not fully come.

chinese: 耶穌說了這話，仍舊住在加利利。
english: Having said these things to them, he still kept in Galilee.

chinese: 但他弟兄上去以後，他也上去過節，不是明去，似乎是暗去的。
english: But after his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he went up, not publicly, but in secret.

chinese: 正在節期，猶太人尋找耶穌，說：他在那裡？
english: At the feast the Jews were looking for him and saying, Where is he?

chinese: 眾人為他紛紛議論，有的說：他是好人。有的說：不然，他是迷惑眾人的。
english: And there was much discussion about him among the mass of the people. Some said, He is a good man; but others said, No, he is giving people false ideas.

chinese: 只是沒有人明明的講論他，因為怕猶太人。
english: But no man said anything about him openly for fear of the Jews.

chinese: 到了節期，耶穌上殿裡去教訓人。
english: Now in the middle of the feast Jesus went up to the Temple and was teaching.

chinese: 猶太人就希奇，說：這個人沒有學過，怎麼明白書呢？
english: Then the Jews were surprised and said, How has this man got knowledge of books? He has never been to school.

chinese: 耶穌說：我的教訓不是我自己的，乃是那差我來者的。
english: Jesus gave them this answer: It is not my teaching, but his who sent me.

chinese: 人若立志遵著他的旨意行，就必曉得這教訓或是出於神，或是我憑著自己說的。
english: If any man is ready to do God's pleasure he will have knowledge of the teaching and of where it comes from--from God or from myself.

chinese: 人憑著自己說，是求自己的榮耀；惟有求那差他來者的榮耀，這人是真的，在他心裡沒有不義。
english: The man whose words come from himself is looking for glory for himself, but he who is looking for the glory of him who sent him--that man is true and there is no evil in him.

chinese: 摩西豈不是傳律法給你們麼？你們卻沒有一個人守律法。為甚麼想要殺我呢？
english: Did not Moses give you the law? Even so, not one of you keeps the law. Why have you a desire to put me to death?

chinese: 眾人回答說：你是被鬼附著了！誰想要殺你？
english: The people said in answer, You have an evil spirit: who has any desire to put you to death?

chinese: 耶穌說：我做了一件事，你們都以為希奇。
english: This was the answer of Jesus: I have done one work and you are all surprised at it.

chinese: 摩西傳割禮給你們（其實不是從摩西起的，乃是從祖先起的），因此你們也在安息日給人行割禮。
english: Moses gave you circumcision--not that it comes from Moses, but from the fathers--and even on the Sabbath you give a child circumcision.

chinese: 人若在安息日受割禮，免得違背摩西的律法，我在安息日叫一個人全然好了，你們就向我生氣麼？
english: If a child is given circumcision on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me because I made a man completely well on the Sabbath?

chinese: 不可按外貌斷定是非，總要按公平斷定是非。
english: Let not your decisions be based on what you see, but on righteousness.

chinese: 耶路撒冷人中有的說：這不是他們想要殺的人麼？
english: Then some of the people of Jerusalem said, Is not this the man whose death is desired?

chinese: 你看他還明明的講道，他們也不向他說甚麼，難道官長真知道這是基督麼？
english: And here he is talking openly and they say nothing to him! Is it possible that the rulers have knowledge that this is truly the Christ?

chinese: 然而，我們知道這個人從那裡來；只是基督來的時候，沒有人知道他從那裡來。
english: However, it is clear to us where this man comes from: but when the Christ comes no one will have knowledge where he comes from.

chinese: 那時，耶穌在殿裡教訓人，大聲說：你們也知道我，也知道我從那裡來；我來並不是由於自己。但那差我來的是真的。你們不認識他，
english: Then, when he was teaching in the Temple, Jesus said with a loud voice, You have knowledge of me and you have knowledge of where I come from; and I have not come of myself; but there is One who has sent me; he is true, but you have no knowledge of him.

chinese: 我卻認識他；因為我是從他來的，他也是差了我來。
english: I have knowledge of him because I came from him and he sent me.

chinese: 他們就想要捉拿耶穌；只是沒有人下手，因為他的時候還沒有到。
english: Then they had a desire to take him: but no man put hands on him because his hour was still to come.

chinese: 但眾人中間有好些信他的，說：基督來的時候，他所行的神蹟豈能比這人所行的更多麼？
english: And numbers of the people had belief in him, and they said, When the Christ comes will he do more signs than this man has done?

chinese: 法利賽人聽見眾人為耶穌這樣紛紛議論，祭司長和法利賽人就打發差役去捉拿他。
english: This discussion of the people came to the ears of the Pharisees; and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent servants to take him.

chinese: 於是耶穌說：我還有不多的時候和你們同在，以後就回到差我來的那裡去。
english: Then Jesus said, I will be with you a little longer and then I go to him who sent me.

chinese: 你們要找我，卻找不著；我所在的地方你們不能到。
english: You will be looking for me, and you will not see me: and where I am you may not come.

chinese: 猶太人就彼此對問說：這人要往那裡去，叫我們找不著呢？難道他要往散住希利尼中的猶太人那裡去教訓希利尼人麼？
english: So the Jews said among themselves, To what place is he going where we will not see him? will he go to the Jews living among the Greeks and become the teacher of the Greeks?

chinese: 他說：你們要找我，卻找不著；我所在的地方，你們不能到，這話是甚麼意思呢？
english: What is this saying of his, You will be looking for me and will not see me, and where I am you may not come?

chinese: 節期的末日，就是最大之日，耶穌站著高聲說：人若渴了，可以到我這裡來喝。
english: On the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus got up and said in a loud voice, If any man is in need of drink let him come to me and I will give it to him.

chinese: 信我的人就如經上所說：從他腹中要流出活水的江河來。
english: He who has faith in me, out of his body, as the Writings have said, will come rivers of living water.

chinese: 耶穌這話是指著信他之人要受聖靈說的。那時還沒有賜下聖靈來，因為耶穌尚未得著榮耀。
english: This he said of the Spirit which would be given to those who had faith in him: the Spirit had not been given then, because the glory of Jesus was still to come.

chinese: 眾人聽見這話，有的說：這真是那先知。
english: When these words came to their ears, some of the people said, This is certainly the prophet.

chinese: 有的說：這是基督。但也有的說：基督豈是從加利利出來的麼？
english: Others said, This is the Christ. But others said, Not so; will the Christ come from Galilee?

chinese: 經上豈不是說基督是大衛的後裔，從大衛本鄉伯利恆出來的麼？
english: Do not the Writings say that the Christ comes of the seed of David and from Beth-lehem, the little town where David was?

chinese: 於是眾人因著耶穌起了分爭。
english: So there was a division among the people because of him.

chinese: 其中有人要捉拿他，只是無人下手。
english: And some of them had a desire to take him; but no man put hands on him.

chinese: 差役回到祭司長和法利賽人那裡。他們對差役說；你們為甚麼沒有帶他來呢？
english: Then the servants went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, Why have you not got him with you?

chinese: 差役回答說：從來沒有像他這樣說話的！
english: The servants made answer, No man ever said things like this man.

chinese: 法利賽人說：你們也受了迷惑麼？
english: Then the Pharisees said to them, Have you, like the others, been given false ideas?

chinese: 官長或是法利賽人豈有信他的呢？
english: Have any of the rulers belief in him, or any one of the Pharisees?

chinese: 但這些不明白律法的百姓是被咒詛的！
english: But these people who have no knowledge of the law are cursed.

chinese: 內中有尼哥底母，就是從前去見耶穌的，對他們說：
english: Nicodemus--he who had come to Jesus before, being himself one of them--said to them,

chinese: 不先聽本人的口供，不知道他所做的事，難道我們的律法還定他的罪麼？
english: Is a man judged by our law before it has given him a hearing and has knowledge of what he has done?

chinese: 他們回答說：你也是出於加利利麼？你且去查考，就可知道加利利沒有出過先知。
english: This was their answer: And do you come from Galilee? Make search and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.

chinese: 於是各人都回家去了；耶穌卻往橄欖山去，
english: But Jesus went to the Mountain of Olives.

chinese: 清早又回到殿裡。眾百姓都到他那裡去，他就坐下，教訓他們。
english: And early in the morning he came again into the Temple and all the people came to him and he was seated teaching them.

chinese: 文士和法利賽人帶著一個行淫時被拿的婦人來，叫他站在當中，
english: Now the scribes and Pharisees came, with a woman who had been taken in the act of sinning against the married relation;

chinese: 就對耶穌說：夫子，這婦人是正行淫之時被拿的。
english: And putting her forward, they said to him, Master, this woman has been taken in the very act of sinning against the married relation.

chinese: 摩西在律法上吩咐我們把這樣的婦人用石頭打死。你說該把他怎麼樣呢？
english: Now in the law Moses gave directions that such women were to be stoned; what do you say about it?

chinese: 他們說這話，乃試探耶穌，要得著告他的把柄。耶穌卻彎著腰，用指頭在地上畫字。
english: They said this, testing him, so that they might have something against him. But Jesus, with his head bent down, made letters on the floor with his finger.

chinese: 他們還是不住的問他，耶穌就直起腰來，對他們說：你們中間誰是沒有罪的，誰就可以先拿石頭打他。
english: But when they went on with their questions, he got up and said to them, Let him among you who is without sin be the first to send a stone at her.

chinese: 於是又彎著腰，用指頭在地上畫字。
english: And again, with bent head, he made letters on the floor.

chinese: 他們聽見這話，就從老到少，一個一個的都出去了，只剩下耶穌一人，還有那婦人仍然站在當中。
english: And when his words came to their ears, they went out one by one, starting with the oldest even to the last, because they were conscious of what was in their hearts: and Jesus was there by himself with the woman before him.

chinese: 耶穌就直起腰來，對他說：婦人，那些人在那裡呢？沒有人定你的罪麼？
english: Then Jesus got up, and seeing nobody but the woman, he said to her, Where are the men who said things against you? did no one give a decision against you?

chinese: 他說：主阿，沒有。耶穌說：我也不定你的罪。去罷，從此不要再犯罪了！
english: And she said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said, And I do not give a decision against you: go, and never do wrong again.]

chinese: 耶穌又對眾人說：我是世界的光。跟從我的，就不在黑暗裡走，必要得著生命的光。
english: Then again Jesus said to them, I am the light of the world; he who comes with me will not be walking in the dark but will have the light of life.

chinese: 法利賽人對他說：你是為自己作見證，你的見證不真。
english: So the Pharisees said to him, The witness you give is about yourself: your witness is not true.

chinese: 耶穌說：我雖然為自己作見證，我的見證還是真的；因我知道我從那裡來，往那裡去；你們卻不知道我從那裡來，往那裡去。
english: Jesus said in answer, Even if I give witness about myself, my witness is true, because I have knowledge of where I came from and where I am going; but you have no knowledge of where I come from or of where I am going.

chinese: 你們是以外貌（原文是憑肉身）判斷人，我卻不判斷人。
english: You are judging from what you see; I am judging no man.

chinese: 就是判斷人，我的判斷也是真的；因為不是我獨自在這裡，還有差我來的父與我同在。
english: Even if I am judging, my decision is right, because I am not by myself--with me is the Father who sent me.

chinese: 你們的律法上也記著說：兩個人的見證是真的。
english: Even in your law it is said that the witness of two men is true.

chinese: 我是為自己作見證，還有差我來的父也是為我作見證。
english: I give witness about myself and the Father who sent me gives witness about me.

chinese: 他們就問他說：你的父在那裡？耶穌回答說：你們不認識我，也不認識我的父；若是認識我，也就認識我的父。
english: Then they said to him, Where is your Father? Jesus said in answer, You have no knowledge of me or of my Father: if you had knowledge of me you would have knowledge of my Father.

chinese: 這些話是耶穌在殿裡的庫房、教訓人時所說的，也沒有人拿他，因為他的時候還沒有到。
english: Jesus said these words in the place where the offerings were stored, while he was teaching in the Temple: but no man took him because his time was still to come.

chinese: 耶穌又對他們說：我要去了，你們要找我，並且你們要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你們不能到。
english: Then he said to them again, I am going away and you will be looking for me, but death will overtake you in your sins. It is not possible for you to come where I am going.

chinese: 猶太人說：他說：我所去的地方，你們不能到，難道他要自盡麼？
english: So the Jews said, Will he take his life? Is that why he says, Where I go it is not possible for you to come?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們是從下頭來的，我是從上頭來的；你們是屬這世界的，我不是屬這世界的。
english: And he said to them, You are of the earth; I am from heaven: you are of this world; I am not of this world.

chinese: 所以我對你們說，你們要死在罪中。你們若不信我是基督，必要死在罪中。
english: For this reason I said to you that death will overtake you in your sins: for if you have not faith that I am he, death will come to you while you are in your sins.

chinese: 他們就問他說：你是誰？耶穌對他們說：就是我從起初所告訴你們的。
english: Then they said to him, Who are you? Jesus said, What I said to you from the first.

chinese: 我有許多事講論你們，判斷你們；但那差我來的是真的，我在他那裡所聽見的，我就傳給世人。
english: I have much to say about you and against you: but he who sent me is true and what he has said to me I say to the world.

chinese: 他們不明白耶穌是指著父說的。
english: They did not see that his words were about the Father.

chinese: 所以耶穌說：你們舉起人子以後，必知道我是基督，並且知道我沒有一件事是憑著自己作的。我說這些話乃是照著父所教訓我的。
english: So Jesus said, When the Son of man has been lifted up by you, then it will be clear to you who I am, and that I do nothing of myself, but say as the Father gave me teaching.

chinese: 那差我來的是與我同在；他沒有撇下我獨自在這裡，因為我常做他所喜悅的事。
english: He who sent me is with me; he has not gone from me, because at all times I do the things which are pleasing to him.

chinese: 耶穌說這話的時候，就有許多人信他。
english: When he said this a number came to have faith in him.

chinese: 耶穌對信他的猶太人說：你們若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的門徒；
english: Then Jesus said to the Jews who had faith in him, If you keep my word, then you are truly my disciples;

chinese: 你們必曉得真理，真理必叫你們得以自由。
english: And you will have knowledge of what is true, and that will make you free.

chinese: 他們回答說：我們是亞伯拉罕的後裔，從來沒有作過誰的奴僕。你怎麼說你們必得自由呢？
english: They said to him in answer, We are Abraham's seed and have never been any man's servant: why do you say, You will become free?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我實實在在的告訴你們，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴僕。
english: And this was the answer Jesus gave them: Truly I say to you, Everyone who does evil is the servant of sin.

chinese: 奴僕不能永遠住在家裡；兒子是永遠住在家裡。
english: Now the servant does not go on living in the house for ever, but the son does.

chinese: 所以天父的兒子若叫你們自由，你們就真自由了。
english: If then the son makes you free, you will be truly free.

chinese: 我知道你們是亞伯拉罕的子孫，你們卻想要殺我，因為你們心裡容不下我的道。
english: I am conscious that you are Abraham's seed; but you have a desire to put me to death because my word has no place in you.

chinese: 我所說的是在我父那裡看見的；你們所行的是在你們的父那裡聽見的。
english: I say the things which I have seen in my Father's house: and you do the things which come to you from your father's house.

chinese: 他們說：我們的父就是亞伯拉罕。耶穌說：你們若是亞伯拉罕的兒子，就必行亞伯拉罕所行的事。
english: In answer they said to him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus said to them, If you were Abraham's children you would do what Abraham did.

chinese: 我將在神那裡所聽見的真理告訴了你們，現在你們卻想要殺我，這不是亞伯拉罕所行的事。
english: But now you have a desire to put me to death, a man who has said to you what is true, as I had it from God: Abraham did not do that.

chinese: 你們是行你們父所行的事。他們說：我們不是從淫亂生的；我們只有一位父，就是神。
english: You are doing the works of your father. They said to him, We are true sons of Abraham; we have one Father, who is God.

chinese: 耶穌說：倘若神是你們的父，你們就必愛我；因為我本是出於神，也是從神而來，並不是由著自己來，乃是他差我來。
english: Jesus said to them, If God was your Father you would have love for me, because it was from God I came and am here. I did not come of myself, but he sent me.

chinese: 你們為甚麼不明白我的話呢？無非是因你們不能聽我的道。
english: Why are my words not clear to you? It is because your ears are shut to my teaching.

chinese: 你們是出於你們的父魔鬼，你們父的私慾你們偏要行。他從起初是殺人的，不守真理，因他心裡沒有真理。他說謊是出於自己；因他本來是說謊的，也是說謊之人的父。
english: You are the children of your father the Evil One and it is your pleasure to do his desires. From the first he was a taker of life; and he did not go in the true way because there is no true thing in him. When he says what is false, it is natural to him, for he is false and the father of what is false.

chinese: 我將真理告訴你們，你們就因此不信我。
english: But because I say what is true, you have no belief in me.

chinese: 你們中間誰能指證我有罪呢？我既然將真理告訴你們，為甚麼不信我呢？
english: Which of you is able truly to say that I am a sinner? If I say what is true, why have you no belief in me?

chinese: 出於神的，必聽神的話；你們不聽，因為你們不是出於神。
english: He who is a child of God gives ear to the words of God: your ears are not open to them because you are not from God.

chinese: 猶太人回答說：我們說你是撒瑪利亞人，並且是鬼附著的，這話豈不正對麼？
english: The Jews said to him in answer, Are we not right in saying that you are of Samaria and have an evil spirit?

chinese: 耶穌說：我不是鬼附著的；我尊敬我的父，你們倒輕慢我。
english: And this was the answer of Jesus: I have not an evil spirit; but I give honour to my Father and you do not give honour to me.

chinese: 我不求自己的榮耀，有一位為我求榮耀、定是非的。
english: I, however, am not in search of glory for myself: there is One who is searching for it and he is judge.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，人若遵守我的道，就永遠不見死。
english: Truly I say to you, If a man keeps my word he will never see death.

chinese: 猶太人對他說：現在我們知道你是鬼附著的。亞伯拉罕死了，眾先知也死了，你還說：人若遵守我的道，就永遠不嘗死味。
english: The Jews said to him, Now we are certain that you have an evil spirit. Abraham is dead, and the prophets are dead; and you say, If a man keeps my word he will never see death.

chinese: 難道你比我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕還大麼？他死了，眾先知也死了，你將自己當作甚麼人呢？
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? and the prophets are dead: who do you say that you are?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我若榮耀自己，我的榮耀就算不得甚麼；榮耀我的乃是我的父，就是你們所說是你們的神。
english: Jesus said in answer, If I take glory for myself, my glory is nothing: it is my Father who gives me glory, of whom you say that he is your God.

chinese: 你們未曾認識他；我卻認識他。我若說不認識他，我就是說謊的，像你們一樣；但我認識他，也遵守他的道。
english: You have no knowledge of him, but I have knowledge of him; and if I said I have no knowledge of him I would be talking falsely like you: but I have full knowledge of him, and I keep his word.

chinese: 你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕歡歡喜喜的仰望我的日子，既看見了就快樂。
english: Your father Abraham was full of joy at the hope of seeing my day: he saw it and was glad.

chinese: 猶太人說：你還沒有五十歲，豈見過亞伯拉罕呢？
english: Then the Jews said to him, You are not fifty years old; have you seen Abraham?

chinese: 耶穌說：我實實在在的告訴你們，還沒有亞伯拉罕就有了我。
english: Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, Before Abraham came into being, I am.

chinese: 於是他們拿石頭要打他；耶穌卻躲藏，從殿去了。
english: So they took up stones to send at him: but Jesus got secretly out of their way and went out of the Temple.

chinese: 耶穌過去的時候，看見一個人生來是瞎眼的。
english: And when he went on his way, he saw a man blind from birth.

chinese: 門徒問耶穌說：拉比，這人生來是瞎眼的，是誰犯了罪？是這人呢？是他父母呢？
english: And his disciples put a question to him, saying, Master, was it because of this man's sin, or the sin of his father and mother, that he has been blind from birth?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：也不是這人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上顯出神的作為來。
english: Jesus said in answer, It was not because of his sin, or because of his father's or mother's; it was so that the works of God might be seen openly in him.

chinese: 趁著白日，我們必須做那差我來者的工；黑夜將到，就沒有人能做工了。
english: While it is day we have to do the works of him who sent me: the night comes when no work may be done.

chinese: 我在世上的時候，是世上的光。
english: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

chinese: 耶穌說了這話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
english: Having said these words, he put earth, mixed with water from his mouth, on the man's eyes,

chinese: 對他說：你往西羅亞池子裡去洗（西羅亞繙出來就是奉差遣）。他去一洗，回頭就看見了。
english: And said to him, Go and make yourself clean in the bath of Siloam (the sense of the name is, Sent). So he went away and, after washing, came back able to see.

chinese: 他的鄰舍和那素常見他是討飯的，就說：這不是那從前坐著討飯的人麼？
english: Then the neighbours and others who had seen him before in the street, with his hand out for money, said, Is not this the man who got money from people?

chinese: 有人說：是他；又有人說；不是，卻是像他。他自己說：是我。
english: Some said, It is he: others said, No, but he is like him. He said, I am he.

chinese: 他們對他說：你的眼睛是怎麼開的呢？
english: So they said to him, How then were your eyes made open?

chinese: 他回答說：有一個人，名叫耶穌，他和泥抹我的眼睛，對我說：你往西羅亞池子去洗。我去一洗，就看見了。
english: His answer was: The man who is named Jesus put earth mixed with water on my eyes, and said to me, Go and make yourself clean in Siloam: so I went away and, after washing, am now able to see.

chinese: 他們說：那個人在那裡？他說：我不知道。
english: And they said to him, Where is he? His answer was: I have no knowledge.

chinese: 他們把從前瞎眼的人帶到法利賽人那裡。
english: They took him before the Pharisees--this man who had been blind.

chinese: 耶穌和泥開他眼睛的日子是安息日。
english: Now the day on which the earth was mixed by Jesus and the man's eyes were made open was the Sabbath.

chinese: 法利賽人也問他是怎麼得看見的。瞎子對他們說：他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看見了。
english: So the Pharisees put more questions to him about how his eyes had been made open. And he said to them, He put earth on my eyes, and I had a wash and am able to see.

chinese: 法利賽人中有的說：這個人不是從神來的，因為他不守安息日。又有人說：一個罪人怎能行這樣的神蹟呢？他們就起了分爭。
english: Then some of the Pharisees said, That man has not come from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath. Others said, How is it possible for a sinner to do such signs? So there was a division among them.

chinese: 他們又對瞎子說：他既然開了你的眼睛，你說他是怎樣的人呢？他說：是個先知。
english: Again they said to the blind man, What have you to say about him for opening your eyes? And he said, He is a prophet.

chinese: 猶太人不信他從前是瞎眼，後來能看見的，等到叫了他的父母來，
english: Now the Jews had no belief in the statement that he had been blind and was now able to see, till they sent for the father and mother of the man whose eyes had been made open,

chinese: 問他們說：這是你們的兒子麼？你們說他生來是瞎眼的，如今怎麼能看見了呢？
english: And put the question to them, saying, Is this your son, of whom you say that he was blind at birth? how is it then that he is now able to see?

chinese: 他父母回答說：他是我們的兒子，生來就瞎眼，這是我們知道的。
english: In answer his father and mother said, We are certain that this is our son and that he was blind at birth:

chinese: 至於他如今怎麼能看見，我們卻不知道；是誰開了他的眼睛，我們也不知道。他已經成了人，你們問他罷，他自己必能說。
english: But how it is he is now able to see, or who made his eyes open, we are not able to say: put the question to him; he is old enough to give an answer for himself.

chinese: 他父母說這話，是怕猶太人；因為猶太人已經商議定了，若有認耶穌是基督的，要把他趕出會堂。
english: They said this because of their fear of the Jews: for the Jews had come to an agreement that if any man said that Jesus was the Christ he would be put out of the Synagogue.

chinese: 因此他父母說：他已經成了人，你們問他罷。
english: That was the reason why they said, He is old enough; put the question to him.

chinese: 所以法利賽人第二次叫了那從前瞎眼的人來，對他說：你該將榮耀歸給神，我們知道這人是個罪人。
english: So they sent a second time for the man who had been blind and they said to him, Give glory to God: it is clear to us that this man is a sinner.

chinese: 他說：他是個罪人不是，我不知道；有一件事我知道，從前我是眼瞎的，如今能看見了。
english: He said in answer, I have no knowledge if he is a sinner or not, but one thing I am certain about; I was blind, and now I see.

chinese: 他們就問他說：他向你做甚麼？是怎麼開了你的眼睛呢？
english: Then they said to him, What did he do to you? how did he give you the use of your eyes?

chinese: 他回答說：我方才告訴你們，你們不聽，為甚麼又要聽呢？莫非你們也要作他的門徒麼？
english: His answer was: I have said it before, but your ears were shut: why would you have me say it again? is it your desire to become his disciples?

chinese: 他們就罵他說：你是他的門徒；我們是摩西的門徒。
english: And they were angry with him and said, You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

chinese: 神對摩西說話是我們知道的；只是這個人，我們不知道他從那裡來！
english: We are certain that God gave his word to Moses: but as for this man, we have no knowledge where he comes from.

chinese: 那人回答說：他開了我的眼睛，你們竟不知道他從那裡來，這真是奇怪！
english: The man said in answer, Why, here is a strange thing! You have no knowledge where he comes from though he gave me the use of my eyes.

chinese: 我們知道神不聽罪人，惟有敬奉神、遵行他旨意的，神才聽他。
english: We have knowledge that God does not give ear to sinners, but if any man is a worshipper of God and does his pleasure, to him God's ears are open.

chinese: 從創世以來，未曾聽見有人把生來是瞎子的眼睛開了。
english: In all the years nobody has ever before seen the eyes of a man blind from birth made open.

chinese: 這人若不是從神來的，甚麼也不能做。
english: If this man did not come from God he would be unable to do anything.

chinese: 他們回答說：你全然生在罪孽中，還要教訓我們麼？於是把他趕出去了。
english: Their answer was: You came to birth through sin; do you make yourself our teacher? And they put him out of the Synagogue.

chinese: 耶穌聽說他們把他趕出去，後來遇見他，就說：你信神的兒子麼？
english: It came to the ears of Jesus that they had put him out, and meeting him he said, Have you faith in the Son of man?

chinese: 他回答說：主阿，誰是神的兒子，叫我信他呢？
english: He said in answer, And who is he, Lord? Say, so that I may have faith in him.

chinese: 耶穌說：你已經看見他，現在和你說話的就是他。
english: Jesus said to him, You have seen him; it is he who is talking to you.

chinese: 他說：主阿，我信！就拜耶穌。
english: And he said, Lord, I have faith. And he gave him worship.

chinese: 耶穌說：我為審判到這世上來，叫不能看見的，可以看見；能看見的，反瞎了眼。
english: And Jesus said, I came into this world to be a judge, so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind.

chinese: 同他在那裡的法利賽人聽見這話，就說：難道我們也瞎了眼麼？
english: These words came to the ears of the Pharisees who were with him and they said to him, Are we, then, blind?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：你們若瞎了眼，就沒有罪了；但如今你們說我們能看見，所以你們的罪還在。
english: Jesus said to them, If you were blind you would have no sin: but now that you say, We see; your sin is there still.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，人進羊圈，不從門進去，倒從別處爬進去，那人就是賊，就是強盜。
english: Truly I say to you, He who does not go through the door into the place where the sheep are kept, but gets in by some other way, is a thief and an outlaw.

chinese: 從門進去的，才是羊的牧人。
english: He who goes in by the door is the keeper of the sheep.

chinese: 看門的就給他開門；羊也聽他的聲音。他按著名叫自己的羊，把羊領出來。
english: The porter lets him in; and the sheep give ear to his voice; he says over the names of the sheep, and takes them out.

chinese: 既放出自己的羊來，就在前頭走，羊也跟著他，因為認得他的聲音。
english: When he has got them all out, he goes before them, and the sheep go after him, for they have knowledge of his voice.

chinese: 羊不跟著生人；因為不認得他的聲音。必要逃跑。
english: They will not go after another who is not their keeper, but will go from him in flight, because his voice is strange to them.

chinese: 耶穌將這比喻告訴他們，但他們不明白所說的是甚麼意思。
english: In this Jesus was teaching them in the form of a story: but what he said was not clear to them.

chinese: 所以，耶穌又對他們說：我實實在在的告訴你們，我就是羊的門。
english: So Jesus said again, Truly I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

chinese: 凡在我以先來的都是賊，是強盜；羊卻不聽他們。
english: All who came before me are thieves and outlaws: but the sheep did not give ear to them.

chinese: 我就是門；凡從我進來的，必然得救，並且出入得草吃。
english: I am the door: if any man goes in through me he will have salvation, and will go in and go out, and will get food.

chinese: 盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞；我來了，是要叫羊（或作：人）得生命，並且得的更豐盛。
english: The thief comes only to take the sheep and to put them to death: he comes for their destruction: I have come so that they may have life and have it in greater measure.

chinese: 我是好牧人；好牧人為羊捨命。
english: I am the good keeper of sheep: the good keeper gives his life for the sheep.

chinese: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看見狼來，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，趕散了羊群。
english: He who is a servant, and not the keeper or the owner of the sheep, sees the wolf coming and goes in flight, away from the sheep; and the wolf comes down on them and sends them in all directions:

chinese: 雇工逃走，因他是雇工，並不顧念羊。
english: Because he is a servant he has no interest in the sheep.

chinese: 我是好牧人；我認識我的羊，我的羊也認識我，
english: I am the good keeper; I have knowledge of my sheep, and they have knowledge of me,

chinese: 正如父認識我，我也認識父一樣；並且我為羊捨命。
english: Even as the Father has knowledge of me and I of the Father; and I am giving my life for the sheep.

chinese: 我另外有羊，不是這圈裡的；我必須領他們來，他們也要聽我的聲音，並且要合成一群，歸一個牧人了。
english: And I have other sheep which are not of this field: I will be their guide in the same way, and they will give ear to my voice, so there will be one flock and one keeper.

chinese: 我父愛我；因我將命捨去，好再取回來。
english: For this reason am I loved by the Father, because I give up my life so that I may take it again.

chinese: 沒有人奪我的命去，是我自己捨的。我有權柄捨了，也有權柄取回來。這是我從我父所受的命令。
english: No one takes it away from me; I give it up of myself. I have power to give it up, and I have power to take it again. These orders I have from my Father.

chinese: 猶太人為這些話又起了分爭。
english: There was a division again among the Jews because of these words.

chinese: 內中有好些人說：他是被鬼附著，而且瘋了，為甚麼聽他呢？
english: And a number of them said, He has an evil spirit and is out of his mind; why do you give ear to him?

chinese: 又有人說：這不是鬼附之人所說的話。鬼豈能叫瞎子的眼睛開了呢？
english: Others said, These are not the words of one who has an evil spirit. Is it possible for an evil spirit to make blind people see?

chinese: 在耶路撒冷有修殿節，是冬天的時候。
english: Then came the feast of the opening of the Temple in Jerusalem: it was winter;

chinese: 耶穌在殿裡所羅門的廊下行走。
english: And Jesus was walking in the Temple, in Solomon's covered way.

chinese: 猶太人圍著他，說：你叫我們猶疑不定到幾時呢？你若是基督，就明明的告訴我們。
english: Then the Jews came round him, saying, how long are you going to keep us in doubt? If you are the Christ, say so clearly.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我已經告訴你們，你們不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以為我作見證；
english: Jesus said in answer, I have said it and you have no belief: the works which I do in my Father's name, these give witness about me.

chinese: 只是你們不信，因為你們不是我的羊。
english: But you have no belief because you are not of my sheep.

chinese: 我的羊聽我的聲音，我也認識他們，他們也跟著我。
english: My sheep give ear to my voice, and I have knowledge of them, and they come after me:

chinese: 我又賜給他們永生；他們永不滅亡，誰也不能從我手裡把他們奪去。
english: And I give them eternal life; they will never come to destruction, and no one will ever take them out of my hand.

chinese: 我父把羊賜給我，他比萬有都大，誰也不能從我父手裡把他們奪去。
english: That which my Father has given to me has more value than all; and no one is able to take anything out of the Father's hand.

chinese: 我與父原為一。
english: I and my Father are one.

chinese: 猶太人又拿起石頭來要打他。
english: Then the Jews took up stones again to send at him.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：我從父顯出許多善事給你們看，你們是為那一件拿石頭打我呢？
english: Jesus said to them in answer, I have let you see a number of good works from the Father; for which of those works are you stoning me?

chinese: 猶太人回答說：我們不是為善事拿石頭打你，是為你說僭妄的話；又為你是個人，反將自己當作神。
english: This was their answer: We are not stoning you for a good work but for evil words; because being a man you make yourself God.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們的律法上豈不是寫著我曾說你們是神麼？
english: In answer, Jesus said, Is there not a saying in your law, I said, You are gods?

chinese: 經上的話是不能廢的；若那些承受神道的人尚且稱為神，
english: If he said they were gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Writings may not be broken),

chinese: 父所分別為聖、又差到世間來的，他自稱是神的兒子，你們還向他說你說僭妄的話麼？
english: Do you say of him whom the Father made holy and sent into the world, Your words are evil; because I said, I am God's Son?

chinese: 我若不行我父的事，你們就不必信我；
english: If I am not doing the works of my Father, do not have belief in me;

chinese: 我若行了，你們縱然不信我，也當信這些事，叫你們又知道又明白父在我裡面，我也在父裡面。
english: But if I am doing them, then have belief in the works even if you have no belief in me; so that you may see clearly and be certain that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.

chinese: 他們又要拿他，他卻逃出他們的手走了。
english: Then again they made an attempt to take him; but he got away from them.

chinese: 耶穌又往約但河外去，到了約翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那裡。
english: And he went again to the other side of the Jordan, to the place where John first gave baptism; and he was there for a time.

chinese: 有許多人來到他那裡。他們說：約翰一件神蹟沒有行過，但約翰指著這人所說的一切話都是真的。
english: And a great number of people came to him, saying, John did no sign: but everything John said of this man was true.

chinese: 在那裡，信耶穌的人就多了。
english: And a number came to have faith in him there.

chinese: 有一個患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是馬利亞和他姐姐馬大的村莊。
english: Now a certain man named Lazarus was ill; he was of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

chinese: 這馬利亞就是那用香膏抹主，又用頭髮擦他腳的；患病的拉撒路是他的兄弟。
english: (The Mary whose brother Lazarus was ill, was the Mary who put perfumed oil on the Lord and made his feet dry with her hair.)

chinese: 他姐妹兩個就打發人去見耶穌，說：主阿，你所愛的人病了。
english: So the sisters sent to him, saying, Lord, your dear friend is ill.

chinese: 耶穌聽見，就說：這病不至於死，乃是為神的榮耀，叫神的兒子因此得榮耀。
english: When this came to his ears, Jesus said, The end of this disease is not death, but the glory of God, so that the Son of God may have glory because of it.

chinese: 耶穌素來愛馬大和他妹子並拉撒路。
english: Now Jesus had love in his heart for Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

chinese: 聽見拉撒路病了。就在所居之地仍住了兩天。
english: So when the news came to him that Lazarus was ill, he did not go from the place where he was for two days.

chinese: 然後對門徒說：我們再往猶太去罷。
english: Then after that time he said to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

chinese: 門徒說：拉比，猶太人近來要拿石頭打你，你還往那裡去麼？
english: The disciples said to him, Master, the Jews were attempting only the other day to have you stoned, and are you going back there again?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：白日不是有十二小時麼？人在白日走路，就不至跌倒，因為看見這世上的光。
english: Then Jesus said in answer, Are there not twelve hours in the day? A man may go about in the day without falling, because he sees the light of this world.

chinese: 若在黑夜走路，就必跌倒，因為他沒有光。
english: But if a man goes about in the night, he may have a fall because the light is not in him.

chinese: 耶穌說了這話，隨後對他們說：我們的朋友拉撒路睡了，我去叫醒他。
english: These things said he: and after that he said to them, Lazarus our friend is at rest; but I go so that I may make him come out of his sleep.

chinese: 門徒說：主阿，他若睡了，就必好了。
english: Then his disciples said to him, Lord, if he is resting he will get well.

chinese: 耶穌這話是指著他死說的，他們卻以為是說照常睡了。
english: Jesus, however, was talking of his death: but they had the idea that he was talking about taking rest in sleep.

chinese: 耶穌就明明的告訴他們說：拉撒路死了。
english: Then Jesus said to them clearly, Lazarus is dead.

chinese: 我沒有在那裡就歡喜，這是為你們的緣故，好叫你們相信。如今我們可以往他那裡去罷。
english: And because of you I am glad I was not there, so that you may have faith; but let us go to him.

chinese: 多馬，又稱為低土馬，就對那同作門徒的說：我們也去和他同死罷。
english: Then Thomas, who was named Didymus, said to the other disciples, Let us go so that we may be with him in death.

chinese: 耶穌到了，就知道拉撒路在墳墓裡已經四天了。
english: Now when Jesus came, he made the discovery that Lazarus had been put into the earth four days before.

chinese: 伯大尼離耶路撒冷不遠，約有六里路。
english: Now Bethany was near to Jerusalem, about two miles away;

chinese: 有好些猶太人來看馬大和馬利亞，要為他們的兄弟安慰他們。
english: And a number of Jews had come to Martha and Mary to give them comfort about their brother.

chinese: 馬大聽見耶穌來了，就出去迎接他；馬利亞卻仍然坐在家裡。
english: When Martha had the news that Jesus was on the way, she went out to him, but Mary did not go from the house.

chinese: 馬大對耶穌說：主阿，你若早在這裡，我兄弟必不死。
english: Then Martha said to Jesus, Lord, if you had been here my brother would not be dead.

chinese: 就是現在，我也知道，你無論向神求甚麼，神也必賜給你。
english: But I am certain that, even now, whatever request you make to God, God will give it to you.

chinese: 耶穌說：你兄弟必然復活。
english: Jesus said to her, Your brother will come to life again.

chinese: 馬大說：我知道在末日復活的時候，他必復活。
english: Martha said to him, I am certain that he will come to life again when all come back from the dead at the last day.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：復活在我，生命也在我。信我的人雖然死了，也必復活，
english: Jesus said to her, I am myself that day and that life; he who has faith in me will have life even if he is dead;

chinese: 凡活著信我的人必永遠不死。你信這話麼？
english: And no one who is living and has faith in me will ever see death. Is this your faith?

chinese: 馬大說：主阿，是的，我信你是基督，是神的兒子，就是那要臨到世界的。
english: She said to him, Yes, Lord: my faith is that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.

chinese: 馬大說了這話，就回去暗暗的叫他妹子馬利亞，說：夫子來了，叫你。
english: And having said this, she went away and said secretly to her sister Mary, The Master is here and has sent for you.

chinese: 馬利亞聽見了，就急忙起來，到耶穌那裡去。
english: And Mary, hearing this, got up quickly and went to him.

chinese: 那時，耶穌還沒有進村子，仍在馬大迎接他的地方。
english: Now Jesus had not at this time come into the town, but was still in the place where Martha had seen him.

chinese: 那些同馬利亞在家裡安慰他的猶太人，見他急忙起來出去，就跟著他，以為他要往墳墓那裡去哭。
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, comforting her, when they saw Mary get up quickly and go out, went after her in the belief that she was going to the place of the dead and would be weeping there.

chinese: 馬利亞到了耶穌那裡，看見他，就俯伏在他腳前，說：主阿，你若早在這裡，我兄弟必不死。
english: When Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she went down at his feet, saying, Lord, if you had been here my brother would not be dead.

chinese: 耶穌看見他哭，並看見與他同來的猶太人也哭，就心裡悲歎，又甚憂愁，
english: And when Jesus saw her weeping, and saw the Jews weeping who came with her, his spirit was moved and he was troubled,

chinese: 便說：你們把他安放在那裡？他們回答說：請主來看。
english: And said, Where have you put him? They said, Come and see, Lord.

chinese: 耶穌哭了。
english: And Jesus himself was weeping.

chinese: 猶太人就說：你看他愛這人是何等懇切。
english: So the Jews said, See how dear he was to him!

chinese: 其中有人說：他既然開了瞎子的眼睛，豈不能叫這人不死麼？
english: But some of them said, This man, who made open the eyes of the blind man, was he not able to keep his friend from death?

chinese: 耶穌又心裡悲歎，來到墳墓前；那墳墓是個洞，有一塊石頭擋著。
english: So Jesus, deeply troubled in heart, came to the place of the dead. It was a hole in the rock, and a stone was over the opening.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們把石頭挪開。那死人的姐姐馬大對他說：主阿，他現在必是臭了，因為他死了已經四天了。
english: Jesus said, Take away the stone. Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said, Lord, by this time the body will be smelling, for he has been dead four days.

chinese: 耶穌說：我不是對你說過，你若信，就必看見神的榮耀麼？
english: Jesus said to her, Did I not say to you that if you had faith you would see the glory of God?

chinese: 他們就把石頭挪開。耶穌舉目望天，說：父阿，我感謝你，因為你已經聽我。
english: So they took away the stone. And Jesus, looking up to heaven, said, Father, I give praise to you for hearing me.

chinese: 我也知道你常聽我，但我說這話是為周圍站著的眾人，叫他們信是你差了我來。
english: I was certain that your ears are at all times open to me, but I said it because of these who are here, so that they may see that you sent me.

chinese: 說了這話，就大聲呼叫說：拉撒路出來！
english: Then he said in a loud voice, Lazarus, come out!

chinese: 那死人就出來了，手腳裹著布，臉上包著手巾。耶穌對他們說，解開，叫他走！
english: And he who was dead came out, with linen bands folded tightly about his hands and feet, and a cloth about his face. Jesus said to them, Make him free and let him go.

chinese: 那些來看馬利亞的猶太人見了耶穌所做的事，就多有信他的；
english: Then a number of the Jews who had come to Mary and had seen the things which Jesus did had belief in him.

chinese: 但其中也有去見法利賽人的，將耶穌所做的事告訴他們。
english: But some of them went to the Pharisees with the news of what Jesus had done.

chinese: 祭司長和法利賽人聚集公會，說：這人行好些神蹟，我們怎麼辦呢？
english: Then the high priests and the Pharisees had a meeting and said, What are we doing? This man is doing a number of signs.

chinese: 若這樣由著他，人人都要信他，羅馬人也要來奪我們的地土和我們的百姓。
english: If we let him go on in this way, everybody will have belief in him and the Romans will come and take away our place and our nation.

chinese: 內中有一個人，名叫該亞法，本年作大祭司，對他們說：你們不知道甚麼。
english: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, You have no knowledge of anything;

chinese: 獨不想一個人替百姓死，免得通國滅亡，就是你們的益處。
english: You do not see that it is in your interest for one man to be put to death for the people, so that all the nation may not come to destruction.

chinese: 他這話不是出於自己，是因他本年作大祭司，所以預言耶穌將要替這一國死；
english: He did not say this of himself, but being the high priest that year he said, as a prophet, that Jesus would be put to death for the nation;

chinese: 也不但替這一國死，並要將神四散的子民都聚集歸一。
english: And not for that nation only, but for the purpose of uniting in one body the children of God all over the world.

chinese: 從那日起，他們就商議要殺耶穌。
english: And from that day they took thought together how to put him to death.

chinese: 所以，耶穌不再顯然行在猶太人中間，就離開那裡往靠近曠野的地方去，到了一座城，名叫以法蓮，就在那裡和門徒同住。
english: So Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but went from there into the country near to the waste land, to a town named Ephraim, where he was for some time with the disciples.

chinese: 猶太人的逾越節近了，有許多人從鄉下上耶路撒冷去，要在節前潔淨自己。
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and numbers of people went up from the country to Jerusalem to make themselves clean before the Passover.

chinese: 他們就尋找耶穌，站在殿裡彼此說：你們的意思如何，他不來過節麼？
english: They were looking for Jesus and saying to one another while they were in the Temple, What is your opinion? Will he not come to the feast?

chinese: 那時，祭司長和法利賽人早已吩咐說，若有人知道耶穌在那裡，就要報明，好去拿他。
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone had knowledge where he was, he was to give them word, so that they might take him.

chinese: 逾越節前六日，耶穌來到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路從死裡復活之處。
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had made to come back from the dead.

chinese: 有人在那裡給耶穌預備筵席；馬大伺候，拉撒路也在那同耶穌坐席的人中。
english: So they made him a meal there, and he was waited on by Martha, and Lazarus was among those who were seated with him at table.

chinese: 馬利亞就拿著一斤極貴的真哪噠香膏，抹耶穌的腳，又用自己頭髮去擦，屋裡就滿了膏的香氣。
english: Then Mary, taking a pound of perfumed oil of great value, put it on the feet of Jesus and made them dry with her hair: and the house became full of the smell of the perfume.

chinese: 有一個門徒，就是那將要賣耶穌的加略人猶大，
english: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot (who was to give him up), said,

chinese: 說：這香膏為甚麼不賣三十兩銀子賙濟窮人呢？
english: Why was not this perfume traded for three hundred pence, and the money given to the poor?

chinese: 他說這話，並不是掛念窮人，乃因他是個賊，又帶著錢囊，常取其中所存的。
english: (He said this, not because he had any love for the poor; but because he was a thief, and, having the money-bag, took for himself what was put into it.)

chinese: 耶穌說：由他罷！他是為我安葬之日存留的。
english: Then Jesus said, Let her be. Let her keep what she has for the day of my death.

chinese: 因為常有窮人和你們同在，只是你們不常有我。
english: The poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.

chinese: 有許多猶太人知道耶穌在那裡，就來了，不但是為耶穌的緣故，也是要看他從死裡所復活的拉撒路。
english: Then a great number of the Jews had news that he was there: and they came, not only because of Jesus, but so that they might see Lazarus who had been dead and to whom he had given life.

chinese: 但祭司長商議連拉撒路也要殺了；
english: Now there was talk among the chief priests of putting Lazarus to death;

chinese: 因有好些猶太人為拉撒路的緣故，回去信了耶穌。
english: For because of him a great number of the Jews went away and had belief in Jesus.

chinese: 第二天，有許多上來過節的人聽見耶穌將到耶路撒冷，
english: The day after, a great number of people who were there for the feast, when they had the news that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

chinese: 就拿著棕樹枝出去迎接他，喊著說：和散那！奉主名來的以色列王是應當稱頌的！
english: Took branches of palm-trees and went out to him, crying, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!

chinese: 耶穌得了一個驢駒，就騎上，如經上所記的說：
english: And Jesus saw a young ass and took his seat on it; as the Writings say,

chinese: 錫安的民（原文作女子）哪，不要懼怕！你的王騎著驢駒來了。
english: Have no fear, daughter of Zion: see your King is coming, seated on a young ass.

chinese: 這些事門徒起先不明白，等到耶穌得了榮耀以後才想起這話是指著他寫的，並且眾人果然向他這樣行了。
english: (These things were not clear to his disciples at first: but when Jesus had been lifted up into his glory, then it came to their minds that these things in the Writings were about him and that they had been done to him.)

chinese: 當耶穌呼喚拉撒路，叫他從死復活出墳墓的時候，同耶穌在那裡的眾人就作見證。
english: Now the people who were with him when his voice came to Lazarus in the place of the dead, and gave him life again, had been talking about it.

chinese: 眾人因聽見耶穌行了這神蹟，就去迎接他。
english: And that was the reason the people went out to him, because it had come to their ears that he had done this sign.

chinese: 法利賽人彼此說：看哪，你們是徒勞無益，世人都隨從他去了。
english: Then the Pharisees said one to another, You see, you are unable to do anything: the world has gone after him.

chinese: 那時，上來過節禮拜的人中，有幾個希利尼人。
english: Now there were some Greeks among the people who had come up to give worship at the feast:

chinese: 他們來見加利利伯賽大的腓力，求他說：先生，我們願意見耶穌。
english: They came to Philip, who was of Beth-saida in Galilee, and made a request, saying, Sir, we have a desire to see Jesus.

chinese: 腓力去告訴安得烈，安得烈同腓力去告訴耶穌。
english: Philip went and gave word of it to Andrew; and Andrew went with Philip to Jesus.

chinese: 耶穌說：人子得榮耀的時候到了。
english: And Jesus said to them in answer, The hour of the glory of the Son of man has come.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，一粒麥子不落在地裡死了，仍舊是一粒，若是死了，就結出許多子粒來。
english: Truly I say to you, If a seed of grain does not go into the earth and come to an end, it is still a seed and no more; but through its death it gives much fruit.

chinese: 愛惜自己生命的，就失喪生命；在這世上恨惡自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。
english: He who is in love with life will have it taken from him; and he who has no care for his life in this world will keep it for ever and ever.

chinese: 若有人服事我，就當跟從我；我在那裡，服事我的人也要在那裡；若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。
english: If any man is my servant, let him come after me; and where I am, there will my servant be. If any man becomes my servant, my Father will give him honour.

chinese: 我現在心裡憂愁，我說甚麼才好呢？父阿，救我脫離這時候；但我原是為這時候來的。
english: Now is my soul troubled; and what am I to say? Father, keep me from this hour. No: for this purpose have I come to this hour.

chinese: 父阿，願你榮耀你的名！當時就有聲音從天上來，說：我已經榮耀了我的名，還要再榮耀。
english: Father, give glory to your name. Then there came a voice out of heaven, saying, I have given it glory, and I will give it glory again.

chinese: 站在旁邊的眾人聽見，就說：打雷了。還有人說：有天使對他說話。
english: Hearing the sound, a number of people who were there said that it was thunder: others said, An angel was talking to him.

chinese: 耶穌說：這聲音不是為我，是為你們來的。
english: Jesus said in answer, This voice came not for me but for you.

chinese: 現在這世界受審判，這世界的王要被趕出去。
english: Now is this world to be judged: now will the ruler of this world be sent out.

chinese: 我若從地上被舉起來，就要吸引萬人來歸我。
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will make all men come to me.

chinese: 耶穌這話原是指著自己將要怎樣死說的。
english: (This he said, pointing to the sort of death he would have.)

chinese: 眾人回答說：我們聽見律法上有話說，基督是永存的，你怎麼說人子必須被舉起來呢？這人子是誰呢？
english: Then the people in answer said to him, The law says that the Christ will have life without end: how say you then that it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：光在你們中間還有不多的時候，應當趁著有光行走，免得黑暗臨到你們；那在黑暗裡行走的，不知道往何處去。
english: Jesus said to them, For a little time longer the light will be among you; while you have the light go on walking in it, so that the dark may not overtake you: one walking in the dark has no knowledge of where he is going.

chinese: 你們應當趁著有光，信從這光，使你們成為光明之子。耶穌說了這話，就離開隱藏了。
english: In so far as you have the light, put your faith in the light so that you may become sons of light. With these words Jesus went away and for a time was not seen again by them.

chinese: 他雖然在他們面前行了許多神蹟，他們還是不信他。
english: But though he had done such a number of signs before them, they still had no belief in him:

chinese: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：主阿，我們所傳的有誰信呢？主的膀臂向誰顯露呢？
english: So that the words of the prophet Isaiah might come true, when he said, Lord, who has any belief in our preaching? and the arm of the Lord, to whom has it been unveiled?

chinese: 他們所以不能信，因為以賽亞又說：
english: For this reason they were unable to have belief, because Isaiah said again,

chinese: 主叫他們瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他們眼睛看見，心裡明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。
english: He has made their eyes blind, and their hearts hard; for fear that they might see with their eyes and get knowledge with their hearts, and be changed, and I might make them well.

chinese: 以賽亞因為看見他的榮耀，就指著他說這話。
english: (Isaiah said these words because he saw his glory. His words were about him.)

chinese: 雖然如此，官長中卻有好些信他的，只因法利賽人的緣故，就不承認，恐怕被趕出會堂。
english: However, a number even of the rulers had belief in him, but because of the Pharisees they did not say so openly for fear that they might be shut out from the Synagogue:

chinese: 這是因他們愛人的榮耀過於愛神的榮耀。
english: For the praise of men was dearer to them than the approval of God.

chinese: 耶穌大聲說：信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我來的。
english: Then Jesus said with a loud voice, He who has faith in me, has faith not in me, but in him who sent me.

chinese: 人看見我，就是看見那差我來的。
english: And he who sees me, sees him who sent me.

chinese: 我到世上來，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗裡。
english: I have come as a light into the world, so that no one who has faith in me will go on living in the dark.

chinese: 若有人聽見我的話不遵守，我不審判他。我來本不是要審判世界，乃是要拯救世界。
english: And if any man gives ear to my words and does not keep them, I am not his judge: I did not come to be judge of the world but to give salvation to the world.

chinese: 棄絕我、不領受我話的人，有審判他的─就是我所講的道在末日要審判他。
english: He who puts me on one side and does not take my words to heart, is not without a judge: the word which I have said will be his judge on the last day.

chinese: 因為我沒有憑著自己講，惟有差我來的父已經給我命令，叫我說甚麼，講甚麼。
english: For I have not said it on my authority, but the Father who sent me gave me orders what to say and how to say it.

chinese: 我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此，我所講的話正是照著父對我所說的。
english: And I have knowledge that his order is eternal life: so that the things which I say, I say them even as the Father says them to me.

chinese: 逾越節以前，耶穌知道自己離世歸父的時候到了。他既然愛世間屬自己的人，就愛他們到底。
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, it was clear to Jesus that the time had come for him to go away from this world to the Father. Having once had love for those in the world who were his, his love for them went on to the end.

chinese: 吃晚飯的時候，魔鬼已將賣耶穌的意思放在西門的兒子加略人猶大心裡。
english: So while a meal was going on, the Evil One having now put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to be false to him,

chinese: 耶穌知道父已將萬有交在他手裡，且知道自己是從神出來的，又要歸到神那裡去，
english: Jesus, being conscious that the Father had put everything into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

chinese: 就離席站起來，脫了衣服，拿一條手巾束腰，
english: Got up from table, put off his robe and took a cloth and put it round him.

chinese: 隨後把水倒在盆裡，就洗門徒的腳，並用自己所束的手巾擦乾。
english: Then he put water into a basin and was washing the feet of the disciples and drying them with the cloth which was round him.

chinese: 挨到西門彼得，彼得對他說：主阿，你洗我的腳麼？
english: So he came to Simon Peter. Peter said, Lord, are my feet to be washed by you?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我所做的，你如今不知道，後來必明白。
english: And Jesus, answering, said to him, What I do is not clear to you now, but it will be clear to you in time to come.

chinese: 彼得說：你永不可洗我的腳！耶穌說：我若不洗你，你就與我無分了。
english: Peter said, I will never let my feet be washed by you, never. Jesus said in answer, If I do not make you clean you have no part with me.

chinese: 西門彼得說：主阿，不但我的腳，連手和頭也要洗。
english: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, not my feet only, but my hands and my head.

chinese: 耶穌說：凡洗過澡的人，只要把腳一洗，全身就乾淨了。你們是乾淨的，然而不都是乾淨的。
english: Jesus said to him, He who is bathed has need only to have his feet washed and then he is clean all over: and you, my disciples, are clean, but not all of you.

chinese: 耶穌原知道要賣他的是誰，所以說：你們不都是乾淨的。
english: (He had knowledge who was false to him; that is why he said, You are not all clean.)

chinese: 耶穌洗完了他們的腳，就穿上衣服，又坐下，對他們說：我向你們所做的，你們明白麼？
english: Then, after washing their feet and putting on his robe again, he took his seat and said to them, Do you see what I have done to you?

chinese: 你們稱呼我夫子，稱呼我主，你們說的不錯，我本來是。
english: You give me the name of Master and Lord: and you are right; that is what I am.

chinese: 我是你們的主，你們的夫子，尚且洗你們的腳，你們也當彼此洗腳。
english: If then I, the Lord and the Master, have made your feet clean, it is right for you to make one another's feet clean.

chinese: 我給你們做了榜樣，叫你們照著我向你們所做的去做。
english: I have given you an example, so that you may do what I have done to you.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，僕人不能大於主人，差人也不能大於差他的人。
english: Truly I say to you, A servant is not greater than his lord; and he who is sent is not greater than the one who sent him.

chinese: 你們既知道這事，若是去行就有福了。
english: If these things are clear to you, happy are you if you do them.

chinese: 我這話不是指著你們眾人說的，我知道我所揀選的是誰。現在要應驗經上的話，說：同我吃飯的人用腳踢我。
english: I am not talking of you all: I have knowledge of my true disciples, but things are as they are, so that the Writings may come true, The foot of him who takes bread with me is lifted up against me.

chinese: 如今事情還沒有成就，我要先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候可以信我是基督。
english: From this time forward, I give you knowledge of things before they come about, so that when they come about you may have belief that I am he.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。
english: Truly I say to you, He who takes to his heart anyone whom I send, takes me to his heart; and he who so takes me, takes him who sent me.

chinese: 耶穌說了這話，心裡憂愁，就明說：我實實在在的告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。
english: When Jesus had said this he was troubled in spirit, and gave witness, saying, Truly I say to you, that one of you will be false to me.

chinese: 門徒彼此對看，猜不透所說的是誰。
english: Then the eyes of the disciples were turned on one another, in doubt as to whom he had in mind.

chinese: 有一個門徒，是耶穌所愛的，側身挨近耶穌的懷裡。
english: There was at table one of his disciples, the one dear to Jesus, resting his head on Jesus' breast.

chinese: 西門彼得點頭對他說：你告訴我們，主是指著誰說的。
english: Making a sign to him, Simon Peter said, Who is it he is talking about?

chinese: 那門徒便就勢靠著耶穌的胸膛，問他說：主阿，是誰呢？
english: He, then, resting his head on Jesus' breast, said to him, Lord, who is it?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我蘸一點餅給誰，就是誰。耶穌就蘸了一點餅，遞給加略人西門的兒子猶大。
english: This was the answer Jesus gave: It is the one to whom I will give this bit of bread after I have put it in the vessel. Then he took the bit of bread, put it into the vessel, and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

chinese: 他吃了以後，撒但就入了他的心。耶穌便對他說：你所做的，快做罷！
english: And when Judas took the bread Satan went into him. Then Jesus said to him, Do quickly what you have to do.

chinese: 同席的人沒有一個知道是為甚麼對他說這話。
english: Now it was not clear to anyone at table why he said this to him.

chinese: 有人因猶大帶著錢囊，以為耶穌是對他說：你去買我們過節所應用的東西，或是叫他拿甚麼賙濟窮人。
english: Some were of the opinion that because Judas kept the money-bag Jesus said to him, Get the things we have need of for the feast; or, that he was to give something to the poor.

chinese: 猶大受了那點餅，立刻就出去。那時候是夜間了。
english: So Judas, having taken the bit of bread, straight away went out: and it was night.

chinese: 他既出去，耶穌就說：如今人子得了榮耀，神在人子身上也得了榮耀。
english: Then when he had gone out, Jesus said, Now is glory given to the Son of man, and God is given glory in him.

chinese: 神要因自己榮耀人子，並且要快快的榮耀他。
english: If God is given glory in him, God will give him glory in himself, and will give him glory even now.

chinese: 小子們，我還有不多的時候與你們同在；後來你們要找我，但我所去的地方你們不能到。這話我曾對猶太人說過，如今也照樣對你們說。
english: My dear children, I am only to be with you a little longer. Then you will be looking for me: and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you, Where I am going you may not come.

chinese: 我賜給你們一條新命令，乃是叫你們彼此相愛；我怎樣愛你們，你們也要怎樣相愛。
english: I give you a new law: Have love one for another; even as I have had love for you, so are you to have love one for another.

chinese: 你們若有彼此相愛的心，眾人因此就認出你們是我的門徒了。
english: By this it will be clear to all men that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another.

chinese: 西門彼得問耶穌說：主往那裡去？耶穌回答說：我所去的地方，你現在不能跟我去，後來卻要跟我去。
english: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, where are you going? Jesus said in answer, Where I am going you may not come with me now, but you will come later.

chinese: 彼得說：主阿，我為甚麼現在不能跟你去？我願意為你捨命！
english: Peter said to him, Why may I not come with you even now? I will give up my life for you.

chinese: 耶穌說：你願意為我捨命麼？我實實在在的告訴你，雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。
english: Jesus said in answer, Will you give up your life for me? Truly I say to you, Before the cry of the cock you will have said three times that you are not my disciple.

chinese: 你們心裡不要憂愁；你們信神，也當信我。
english: Let not your heart be troubled: have faith in God and have faith in me.

chinese: 在我父的家裡有許多住處；若是沒有，我就早已告訴你們了。我去原是為你們預備地方去。
english: In my Father's house are rooms enough; if it was not so, would I have said that I am going to make ready a place for you?

chinese: 我若去為你們預備了地方，就必再來接你們到我那裡去，我在那裡，叫你們也在那裡。
english: And if I go and make ready a place for you, I will come back again and will take you to be with me, so that you may be where I am.

chinese: 我往那裡去，你們知道；那條路，你們也知道（有古卷作：我往那裡去，你們知道那條路）。
english: And you all have knowledge of where I am going, and of the way to it.

chinese: 多馬對他說：主阿，我們不知道你往那裡去，怎麼知道那條路呢？
english: Thomas said, Lord, we have no knowledge of where you are going; how may we have knowledge of the way?

chinese: 耶穌說我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裡去。
english: Jesus said to him, I am the true and living way: no one comes to the Father but by me.

chinese: 你們若認識我，也就認識我的父。從今以後，你們認識他，並且已經看見他。
english: If you had knowledge of me, you would have knowledge of my Father: you have knowledge of him now and have seen him.

chinese: 腓力對他說：求主將父顯給我們看，我們就知足了。
english: Philip said to him, Lord, let us see the Father, and we have need of nothing more.

chinese: 耶穌對他說：腓力，我與你們同在這樣長久，你還不認識我麼？人看見了我，就是看見了父；你怎麼說將父顯給我們看呢？
english: Jesus said to him, Philip, have I been with you all this time, and still you have no knowledge of me? He who has seen me has seen the Father. Why do you say, Let us see the Father?

chinese: 我在父裡面，父在我裡面，你不信麼？我對你們所說的話，不是憑著自己說的，乃是住在我裡面的父做他自己的事。
english: Have you not faith that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words which I say to you, I say not from myself: but the Father who is in me all the time does his works.

chinese: 你們當信我，我在父裡面，父在我裡面；即或不信，也當因我所做的事信我。
english: Have faith that I am in the Father and that the Father is in me: at least, have faith in me because of what I do.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，並且要做比這更大的事，因為我往父那裡去。
english: Truly I say to you, He who puts his faith in me will do the very works which I do, and he will do greater things than these, because I am going to my Father.

chinese: 你們奉我的名無論求甚麼，我必成就，叫父因兒子得榮耀。
english: And whatever request you make in my name, that I will do, so that the Father may have glory in the Son.

chinese: 你們若奉我的名求甚麼，我必成就。
english: If you make any request to me in my name, I will do it.

chinese: 你們若愛我，就必遵守我的命令。
english: If you have love for me, you will keep my laws.

chinese: 我要求父，父就另外賜給你們一位保惠師（或作：訓慰師；下同），叫他永遠與你們同在，
english: And I will make prayer to the Father and he will give you another Helper to be with you for ever,

chinese: 就是真理的聖靈，乃世人不能接受的；因為不見他，也不認識他。你們卻認識他，因他常與你們同在，也要在你們裡面。
english: Even the Spirit of true knowledge. That Spirit the world is not able to take to its heart because it sees him not and has no knowledge of him: but you have knowledge of him, because he is ever with you and will be in you.

chinese: 我不撇下你們為孤兒，我必到你們這裡來。
english: I will not let you be without a friend: I am coming to you.

chinese: 還有不多的時候，世人不再看見我，你們卻看見我；因為我活著，你們也要活著。
english: A little time longer, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me; and you will be living because I am living.

chinese: 到那日，你們就知道我在父裡面，你們在我裡面，我也在你們裡面。
english: At that time it will be clear to you that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I in you.

chinese: 有了我的命令又遵守的，這人就是愛我的；愛我的必蒙我父愛他，我也要愛他，並且要向他顯現。
english: He who has my laws and keeps them, he it is who has love for me: and he who has love for me will be loved by my Father, and I will have love for him and will let myself be seen clearly by him.

chinese: 猶大（不是加略人猶大）問耶穌說：主阿，為甚麼要向我們顯現，不向世人顯現呢？
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, How is it that you will let yourself be seen clearly by us and not by the world?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：人若愛我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必愛他，並且我們要到他那裡去，與他同住。
english: Jesus said to him in answer, If anyone has love for me, he will keep my words: and he will be dear to my Father; and we will come to him and make our living-place with him.

chinese: 不愛我的人就不遵守我的道。你們所聽見的道不是我的，乃是差我來之父的道。
english: He who has no love for me does not keep my words; and the word which you are hearing is not my word but the Father's who sent me.

chinese: 我還與你們同住的時候，已將這些話對你們說了。
english: I have said all this to you while I am still with you.

chinese: 但保惠師，就是父因我的名所要差來的聖靈，他要將一切的事指教你們，並且要叫你們想起我對你們所說的一切話。
english: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will be your teacher in all things and will put you in mind of everything I have said to you.

chinese: 我留下平安給你們；我將我的平安賜給你們。我所賜的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裡不要憂愁，也不要膽怯。
english: May peace be with you; my peace I give to you: I give it not as the world gives. Let not your heart be troubled; let it be without fear.

chinese: 你們聽見我對你們說了，我去還要到你們這裡來。你們若愛我，因我到父那裡去，就必喜樂，因為父是比我大的。
english: Keep in mind how I said to you, I go away and come to you again. If you had love for me you would be glad, because I am going to the Father: for the Father is greater than I.

chinese: 現在事情還沒有成就，我預先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候就可以信。
english: And now I have given you word of it before it comes, so that, when it comes, you may have faith.

chinese: 以後我不再和你們多說話，因為這世界的王將到。他在我裡面是毫無所有；
english: After this I will not say much to you, because the ruler of this world comes: and he has no power over me;

chinese: 但要叫世人知道我愛父，並且父怎樣吩咐我，我就怎樣行。起來，我們走罷！
english: But he comes so that the world may see that I have love for the Father, and that I am doing as I am ordered by the Father. Get up, and let us go.

chinese: 我是真葡萄樹，我父是栽培的人。
english: I am the true vine and my Father is the gardener.

chinese: 凡屬我不結果子的枝子，他就剪去；凡結果子的，他就修理乾淨，使枝子結果子更多。
english: He takes away every branch in me which has no fruit, and every branch which has fruit he makes clean, so that it may have more fruit.

chinese: 現在你們因我講給你們的道，已經乾淨了。
english: You are clean, even now, through the teaching which I have given you.

chinese: 你們要常在我裡面，我也常在你們裡面。枝子若不常在葡萄樹上，自己就不能結果子；你們若不常在我裡面，也是這樣。
english: Be in me at all times as I am in you. As the branch is not able to give fruit of itself, if it is not still on the vine, so you are not able to do so if you are not in me.

chinese: 我是葡萄樹，你們是枝子。常在我裡面的，我也常在他裡面，這人就多結果子；因為離了我，你們就不能做甚麼。
english: I am the vine, you are the branches: he who is in me at all times as I am in him, gives much fruit, because without me you are able to do nothing.

chinese: 人若不常在我裡面，就像枝子丟在外面枯乾，人拾起來，扔在火裡燒了。
english: If a man does not keep himself in me, he becomes dead and is cut off like a dry branch; such branches are taken up and put in the fire and burned.

chinese: 你們若常在我裡面，我的話也常在你們裡面，凡你們所願意的，祈求，就給你們成就。
english: If you are in me at all times, and my words are in you, then anything for which you make a request will be done for you.

chinese: 你們多結果子，我父就因此得榮耀，你們也就是我的門徒了。
english: Here is my Father's glory, in that you give much fruit and so are my true disciples.

chinese: 我愛你們，正如父愛我一樣；你們要常在我的愛裡。
english: Even as the Father has given me his love, so I have given my love to you: be ever in my love.

chinese: 你們若遵守我的命令，就常在我的愛裡，正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的愛裡。
english: If you keep my laws, you will be ever in my love, even as I have kept my Father's laws, and am ever in his love.

chinese: 這些事我已經對你們說了，是要叫我的喜樂存在你們心裡，並叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
english: I have said these things to you so that I may have joy in you and so that your joy may be complete.

chinese: 你們要彼此相愛，像我愛你們一樣；這就是我的命令。
english: This is the law I give you: Have love one for another, even as I have love for you.

chinese: 人為朋友捨命，人的愛心沒有比這個大的。
english: Greater love has no man than this, that a man gives up his life for his friends.

chinese: 你們若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。
english: You are my friends, if you do what I give you orders to do.

chinese: 以後我不再稱你們為僕人，因僕人不知道主人所做的事。我乃稱你們為朋友；因我從我父所聽見的，已經都告訴你們了。
english: No longer do I give you the name of servants; because a servant is without knowledge of what his master is doing: I give you the name of friends, because I have given you knowledge of all the things which my Father has said to me.

chinese: 不是你們揀選了我，是我揀選了你們，並且分派你們去結果子，叫你們的果子常存，使你們奉我的名，無論向父求甚麼，他就賜給你們。
english: You did not take me for yourselves, but I took you for myself; and I gave you the work of going about and producing fruit which will be for ever; so that whatever request you make to the Father in my name he may give it to you.

chinese: 我這樣吩咐你們，是要叫你們彼此相愛。
english: So this is my law for you: Have love one for another.

chinese: 世人若恨你們，你們知道（或作：該知道），恨你們以先已經恨我了。
english: If you are hated by the world, keep in mind that I was hated by the world before you.

chinese: 你們若屬世界，世界必愛屬自己的；只因你們不屬世界，乃是我從世界中揀選了你們，所以世界就恨你們。
english: If you were of the world, you would be loved by the world: but because you are not of the world, but I have taken you out of the world, you are hated by the world.

chinese: 你們要記念我從前對你們所說的話：僕人不能大於主人。他們若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你們；若遵守了我的話，也要遵守你們的話。
english: Keep in mind the words I said to you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they were cruel to me, they will be cruel to you; if they kept my words, they will keep yours.

chinese: 但他們因我的名要向你們行這一切的事，因為他們不認識那差我來的。
english: They will do all this to you because of my name--because they have no knowledge of him who sent me.

chinese: 我若沒有來教訓他們，他們就沒有罪；但如今他們的罪無可推諉了。
