english: If I had not come and been their teacher they would have had no sin: but now they have no reason to give for their sin.

chinese: 恨我的，也恨我的父。
english: He who has hate for me has hate for my Father.

chinese: 我若沒有在他們中間行過別人未曾行的事，他們就沒有罪；但如今連我與我的父，他們也看見也恨惡了。
english: If I had not done among them the works which no other man ever did, they would have had no sin: but now they have seen, and they have had hate in their hearts for me and my Father.

chinese: 這要應驗他們律法上所寫的話，說：他們無故的恨我。
english: This comes about so that the writing in their law may be made true, Their hate for me was without cause.

chinese: 但我要從父那裡差保惠師來，就是從父出來真理的聖靈；他來了，就要為我作見證。
english: When the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father even the Spirit of true knowledge who comes from the Father--he will give witness about me;

chinese: 你們也要作見證，因為你們從起頭就與我同在。
english: And you, in addition, will give witness because you have been with me from the first.

chinese: 我已將這些事告訴你們，使你們不至於跌倒。
english: I have said these things to you so that you may not be in doubt.

chinese: 人要把你們趕出會堂，並且時候將到，凡殺你們的就以為是事奉神。
english: They will put you out of the Synagogues: yes, the time is coming when whoever puts you to death will have the belief that he is doing God's pleasure.

chinese: 他們這樣行，是因未曾認識父，也未曾認識我。
english: They will do these things to you because they have not had knowledge of the Father or of me.

chinese: 我將這事告訴你們，是叫你們到了時候可以想起我對你們說過了。我起先沒有將這事告訴你們，因為我與你們同在。
english: I have said these things to you so that when the time comes, what I have said may come to your mind. I did not say them to you at the first, because then I was still with you.

chinese: 現今我往差我來的父那裡去，你們中間並沒有人問我：你往那裡去？
english: But now I am going to him who sent me; and not one of you says to me, Where are you going?

chinese: 只因我將這事告訴你們，你們就滿心憂愁。
english: But your hearts are full of sorrow because I have said these things.

chinese: 然而，我將真情告訴你們，我去是與你們有益的；我若不去，保惠師就不到你們這裡來；我若去，就差他來。
english: But what I am saying is true: my going is for your good: for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

chinese: 他既來了，就要叫世人為罪、為義、為審判，自己責備自己。
english: And he, when he comes, will make the world conscious of sin, and of righteousness, and of being judged:

chinese: 為罪，是因他們不信我；
english: Of sin, because they have not faith in me;

chinese: 為義，是因我往父那裡去，你們就不再見我；
english: Of righteousness, because I go to the Father and you will see me no more;

chinese: 為審判，是因這世界的王受了審判。
english: Of being judged, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

chinese: 我還有好些事要告訴你們，但你們現在擔當不了（或作：不能領會）。
english: I have still much to say to you, but you are not strong enough for it now.

chinese: 只等真理的聖靈來了，他要引導你們明白（原文作進入）一切的真理；因為他不是憑自己說的，乃是把他所聽見的都說出來，並要把將來的事告訴你們。
english: However, when he, the Spirit of true knowledge, has come, he will be your guide into all true knowledge: for his words will not come from himself, but whatever has come to his hearing, that he will say: and he will make clear to you the things to come.

chinese: 他要榮耀我，因為他要將受於我的告訴你們。
english: He will give me glory, because he will take of what is mine, and make it clear to you.

chinese: 凡父所有的，都是我的；所以我說，他要將受於我的告訴你們。
english: Everything which the Father has is mine: that is why I say, He will take of what is mine and will make it clear to you.

chinese: 等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我。
english: After a little time you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me.

chinese: 有幾個門徒就彼此說：他對我們說：等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我；又說：因我往父那裡去。這是甚麼意思呢？
english: So some of the disciples said one to another, What is this he is saying, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me? and, I am going to the Father?

chinese: 門徒彼此說：他說等不多時到底是甚麼意思呢？我們不明白他所說的話。
english: So they said again and again, What is this he is saying, A little time? His words are not clear to us.

chinese: 耶穌看出他們要問他，就說：我說等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我，你們為這話彼此相問麼？
english: Jesus saw that they had a desire to put the question to him, so he said to them, Is this what you are questioning one with another, why I said, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me?

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你們，你們將要痛哭、哀號，世人倒要喜樂；你們將要憂愁，然而你們的憂愁要變為喜樂。
english: Truly I say to you, You will be weeping and sorrowing, but the world will be glad: you will be sad, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

chinese: 婦人生產的時候就憂愁，因為他的時候到了；既生了孩子，就不再記念那苦楚，因為歡喜世上生了一個人。
english: When a woman is about to give birth she has sorrow, because her hour is come; but when she has given birth to the child, the pain is put out of her mind by the joy that a man has come into the world.

chinese: 你們現在也是憂愁，但我要再見你們，你們的心就喜樂了；這喜樂也沒有人能奪去。
english: So you have sorrow now: but I will see you again, and your hearts will be glad, and no one will take away your joy.

chinese: 到那日，你們甚麼也就不問我了。我實實在在的告訴你們，你們若向父求甚麼，他必因我的名賜給你們。
english: And on that day you will put no questions to me. Truly I say to you, Whatever request you make to the Father, he will give it to you in my name.

chinese: 向來你們沒有奉我的名求甚麼，如今你們求，就必得著，叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
english: Up to now you have made no request in my name: do so, and it will be answered, so that your hearts may be full of joy.

chinese: 這些事，我是用比喻對你們說的；時候將到，我不再用比喻對你們說，乃要將父明明的告訴你們。
english: All this I have said to you in veiled language: but the time is coming when I will no longer say things in veiled language but will give you knowledge of the Father clearly.

chinese: 到那日，你們要奉我的名祈求；我並不對你們說，我要為你們求父。
english: In that day you will make requests in my name: and I do not say that I will make prayer to the Father for you,

chinese: 父自己愛你們；因為你們已經愛我，又信我是從父出來的。
english: For the Father himself gives his love to you, because you have given your love to me and have had faith that I came from God.

chinese: 我從父出來，到了世界；我又離開世界，往父那裡去。
english: I came out from the Father and have come into the world: again, I go away from the world and go to the Father.

chinese: 門徒說：如今你是明說，並不用比喻了。
english: His disciples said, Now you are talking clearly and not in veiled language.

chinese: 現在我們曉得你凡事都知道，也不用人問你，因此我們信你是從神出來的。
english: Now we are certain that you have knowledge of all things and have no need for anyone to put questions to you: through this we have faith that you came from God.

chinese: 耶穌說：現在你們信麼？
english: Jesus made answer, Have you faith now?

chinese: 看哪，時候將到，且是已經到了，你們要分散，各歸自己的地方去，留下我獨自一人；其實我不是獨自一人，因為有父與我同在。
english: See, a time is coming, yes, it is now here, when you will go away in all directions, every man to his house, and I will be by myself: but I am not by myself, because the Father is with me.

chinese: 我將這些事告訴你們，是要叫你們在我裡面有平安。在世上，你們有苦難；但你們可以放心，我已經勝了世界。
english: I have said all these things to you so that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble: but take heart! I have overcome the world.

chinese: 耶穌說了這話，就舉目望天，說：父阿，時候到了，願你榮耀你的兒子，使兒子也榮耀你；
english: Jesus said these things; then, lifting his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the time has now come; give glory to your Son, so that the Son may give glory to you:

chinese: 正如你曾賜給他權柄管理凡有血氣的，叫他將永生賜給你所賜給他的人。
english: Even as you gave him authority over all flesh, to give eternal life to all those whom you have given to him.

chinese: 認識你─獨一的真神，並且認識你所差來的耶穌基督，這就是永生。
english: And this is eternal life: to have knowledge of you, the only true God, and of him whom you have sent, even Jesus Christ.

chinese: 我在地上已經榮耀你，你所託付我的事，我已成全了。
english: I have given you glory on the earth, having done all the work which you gave me to do.

chinese: 父阿，現在求你使我同你享榮耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的榮耀。
english: And now, Father, let me have glory with you, even that glory which I had with you before the world was.

chinese: 你從世上賜給我的人，我已將你的名顯明與他們。他們本是你的，你將他們賜給我，他們也遵守了你的道。
english: I have given knowledge of your name to the men whom you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your words.

chinese: 如今他們知道，凡你所賜給我的，都是從你那裡來的；
english: Now it is clear to them that whatever you have given to me comes from you:

chinese: 因為你所賜給我的道，我已經賜給他們，他們也領受了，又確實知道，我是從你出來的，並且信你差了我來。
english: Because I have given them the words which you gave to me; and they have taken them to heart, and have certain knowledge that I came from you, and they have faith that you sent me.

chinese: 我為他們祈求，不為世人祈求，卻為你所賜給我的人祈求，因他們本是你的。
english: My prayer is for them: my prayer is not for the world, but for those whom you have given to me, because they are yours

chinese: 凡是我的，都是你的；你的也是我的，並且我因他們得了榮耀。
english: (All mine are yours, and yours are mine) and I have glory in them.

chinese: 從今以後，我不在世上，他們卻在世上；我往你那裡去。聖父阿，求你因你所賜給我的名保守他們，叫他們合而為一像我們一樣。
english: And now I will be no longer in the world, but they are in the world and I come to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name which you have given to me, so that they may be one even as we are one.

chinese: 我與他們同在的時候，因你所賜給我的名保守了他們，我也護衛了他們；其中除了那滅亡之子，沒有一個滅亡的，好叫經上的話得應驗。
english: While I was with them I kept them safe in your name which you have given to me: I took care of them and not one of them has come to destruction, but only the son of destruction, so that the Writings might come true.

chinese: 現在我往你那裡去，我還在世上說這話，是叫他們心裡充滿我的喜樂。
english: And now I come to you; and these things I say in the world so that they may have my joy complete in them.

chinese: 我已將你的道賜給他們。世界又恨他們；因為他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。
english: I have given your word to them; and they are hated by the world, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

chinese: 我不求你叫他們離開世界，只求你保守他們脫離那惡者（或作：脫離罪惡）。
english: My prayer is not that you will take them out of the world, but that you will keep them from the Evil One.

chinese: 他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。
english: They are not of the world any more than I am of the world.

chinese: 求你用真理使他們成聖；你的道就是真理。
english: Make them holy by the true word: your word is the true word.

chinese: 你怎樣差我到世上，我也照樣差他們到世上。
english: Even as you have sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.

chinese: 我為他們的緣故，自己分別為聖，叫他們也因真理成聖。
english: And for them I make myself holy, so that they may be made truly holy.

chinese: 我不但為這些人祈求，也為那些因他們的話信我的人祈求，
english: My prayer is not for them only, but for all who will have faith in me through their word;

chinese: 使他們都合而為一。正如你父在我裡面，我在你裡面，使他們也在我們裡面，叫世人可以信你差了我來。
english: May they all be one! Even as you, Father, are in me and I am in you, so let them be in us, so that all men may come to have faith that you sent me.

chinese: 你所賜給我的榮耀，我已賜給他們，使他們合而為一，像我們合而為一。
english: And the glory which you have given to me I have given to them, so that they may be one even as we are one;

chinese: 我在他們裡面，你在我裡面，使他們完完全全的合而為一，叫世人知道你差了我來，也知道你愛他們如同愛我一樣。
english: I in them, and you in me, so that they may be made completely one, and so that it may become clear to all men that you have sent me and that they are loved by you as I am loved by you.

chinese: 父阿，我在那裡，願你所賜給我的人也同我在那裡，叫他們看見你所賜給我的榮耀；因為創立世界以前，你已經愛我了。
english: Father, it is my desire that these whom you have given to me may be by my side where I am, so that they may see my glory which you have given to me, because you had love for me before the world came into being.

chinese: 公義的父阿，世人未曾認識你，我卻認識你；這些人也知道你差了我來。
english: Father of righteousness, I have knowledge of you, though the world has not; and to these it is clear that you sent me;

chinese: 我已將你的名指示他們，還要指示他們，使你所愛我的愛在他們裡面，我也在他們裡面。
english: And I have given to them knowledge of your name, and will give it, so that the love which you have for me may be in them and I in them.

chinese: 耶穌說了這話，就同門徒出去，過了汲淪溪。在那裡有一個園子，他和門徒進去了。
english: When Jesus had said these words he went out with his disciples over the stream Kedron to a garden, into which he went with his disciples.

chinese: 賣耶穌的猶大也知道那地方，因為耶穌和門徒屢次上那裡去聚集。
english: And Judas, who was false to him, had knowledge of the place because Jesus went there frequently with his disciples.

chinese: 猶大領了一隊兵，和祭司長並法利賽人的差役，拿著燈籠、火把、兵器，就來到園裡。
english: So Judas, getting a band of armed men and police from the chief priests and Pharisees, went there with lights and with arms.

chinese: 耶穌知道將要臨到自己的一切事，就出來對他們說：你們找誰？
english: Then Jesus, having knowledge of everything which was coming on him, went forward and said to them, Who are you looking for?

chinese: 他們回答說：找拿撒勒人耶穌。耶穌說：我就是。賣他的猶大也同他們站在那裡。
english: Their answer was, Jesus the Nazarene. Jesus said, I am he. And Judas, who was false to him, was there at their side.

chinese: 耶穌一說我就是，他們就退後倒在地上。
english: And when he said to them, I am he, they went back, falling to the earth.

chinese: 他又問他們說：你們找誰？他們說：找拿撒勒人耶穌。
english: So again he put the question to them, Who are you looking for? And they said, Jesus the Nazarene.

chinese: 耶穌說：我已經告訴你們，我就是。你們若找我，就讓這些人去罷。
english: Jesus made answer, I have said that I am he; if you are looking for me, let these men go away.

chinese: 這要應驗耶穌從前的話，說：你所賜給我的人，我沒有失落一個。
english: (He said this so that his words might come true, I have kept safe all those whom you gave to me.)

chinese: 西門彼得帶著一把刀，就拔出來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那僕人名叫馬勒古。
english: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, took it out and gave the high priest's servant a blow, cutting off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

chinese: 耶穌就對彼得說：收刀入鞘罷，我父所給我的那杯，我豈可不喝呢？
english: Then Jesus said to Peter, Put back your sword: am I not to take the cup which my Father has given to me?

chinese: 那隊兵和千夫長，並猶太人的差役就拿住耶穌，把他捆綁了，
english: Then the band and the chief captain and the police took Jesus and put cords round him.

chinese: 先帶到亞那面前，因為亞那是本年作大祭司該亞法的岳父。
english: They took him first to Annas, because Annas was the father-in-law of Caiaphas who was the high priest that year.

chinese: 這該亞法就是從前向猶太人發議論說一個人替百姓死是有益的那位。
english: It was Caiaphas who had said to the Jews that it was in their interest for one man to be put to death for the people.

chinese: 西門彼得跟著耶穌，還有一個門徒跟著。那門徒是大祭司所認識的，他就同耶穌進了大祭司的院子。
english: And Simon Peter went after Jesus with another disciple. Now that disciple was a friend of the high priest and he went in with Jesus into the house of the high priest;

chinese: 彼得卻站在門外。大祭司所認識的那個門徒出來，和看門的使女說了一聲，就領彼得進去。
english: But Peter was kept outside at the door. Then this other disciple, who was a friend of the high priest, came out and had a word with the girl who kept the door, and took Peter in.

chinese: 那看門的使女對彼得說：你不也是這人的門徒麼？他說：我不是。
english: Then the girl who was the door-keeper said to Peter, Are you not one of this man's disciples? In answer he said, I am not.

chinese: 僕人和差役因為天冷，就生了炭火，站在那裡烤火；彼得也同他們站著烤火。
english: Now the servants and the police had made a fire of coals because it was cold; they were warming themselves in front of it and Peter was there with them, warming himself.

chinese: 大祭司就以耶穌的門徒和他的教訓盤問他。
english: Then the high priest put questions to Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我從來是明明的對世人說話。我常在會堂和殿裡，就是猶太人聚集的地方教訓人；我在暗地裡並沒有說甚麼。
english: Jesus made answer, I said things openly to the world at all times; I have given my teaching in the Synagogues and in the Temple to which all the Jews come; and I have said nothing secretly.

chinese: 你為甚麼問我呢？可以問那聽見的人，我對他們說的是甚麼；我所說的，他們都知道。
english: Why are you questioning me? put questions to my hearers about what I have said to them: they have knowledge of what I said.

chinese: 耶穌說了這話，旁邊站著的一個差役用手掌打他，說：你這樣回答大祭司麼？
english: When he said this, one of the police by his side gave him a blow with his open hand, saying, Do you give such an answer to the high priest?

chinese: 耶穌說：我若說的不是，你可以指證那不是；我若說的是，你為甚麼打我呢？
english: Jesus said in answer, If I have said anything evil, give witness to the evil: but if I said what is true, why do you give me blows?

chinese: 亞那就把耶穌解到大祭司該亞法那裡，仍是捆著解去的。
english: Then Annas sent him chained to Caiaphas, the high priest.

chinese: 西門彼得正站著烤火，有人對他說：你不也是他的門徒麼？彼得不承認，說：我不是。
english: But Simon Peter was still there warming himself by the fire. They said to him, Are you not one of his disciples? He said, No, I am not.

chinese: 有大祭司的一個僕人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的親屬，說：我不是看見你同他在園子裡麼？
english: One of the servants of the high priest, a relation of him whose ear had been cut off by Peter, said, Did I not see you with him in the garden?

chinese: 彼得又不承認。立時雞就叫了。
english: Then again Peter said, No. And straight away a cock gave its cry.

chinese: 眾人將耶穌從該亞法那裡往衙門內解去，那時天還早。他們自己卻不進衙門，恐怕染了污穢，不能吃逾越節的筵席。
english: So they took Jesus from the house of Caiaphas to the Praetorium. It was early. They themselves did not go into the Praetorium, so that they might not become unclean, but might take the Passover.

chinese: 彼拉多就出來，到他們那裡，說：你們告這人是為甚麼事呢？
english: So Pilate came out to them and put the question: What have you to say against this man?

chinese: 他們回答說：這人若不是作惡的，我們就不把他交給你。
english: They said to him in answer, If the man was not a wrongdoer we would not have given him up to you.

chinese: 彼拉多說：你們自己帶他去，按著你們的律法審問他罷。猶太人說：我們沒有殺人的權柄。
english: Then Pilate said to them, Take him yourselves and let him be judged by your law. But the Jews said to him, We have no right to put any man to death.

chinese: 這要應驗耶穌所說自己將要怎樣死的話了。
english: (That the word of Jesus might come true, pointing to the sort of death he would have.)

chinese: 彼拉多又進了衙門，叫耶穌來，對他說：你是猶太人的王麼？
english: Then Pilate went back into the Praetorium and sent for Jesus and said to him, Are you the King of the Jews?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：這話是你自己說的，還是別人論我對你說的呢？
english: Jesus made answer, Do you say this of yourself, or did others say it about me?

chinese: 彼拉多說：我豈是猶太人呢？你本國的人和祭司長把你交給我。你做了甚麼事呢？
english: Pilate said, Am I a Jew? Your nation and the chief priests have given you into my hands: what have you done?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：我的國不屬這世界；我的國若屬這世界，我的臣僕必要爭戰，使我不至於被交給猶太人。只是我的國不屬這世界。
english: Jesus said in answer, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom was of this world, my disciples would have made a good fight to keep me out of the hands of the Jews: but my kingdom is not here.

chinese: 彼拉多就對他說：這樣，你是王麼？耶穌回答說：你說我是王。我為此而生，也為此來到世間，特為給真理作見證。凡屬真理的人就聽我的話。
english: Then Pilate said to him, Are you then a king? Jesus made answer, You say that I am a king. For this purpose was I given birth, and for this purpose I came into the world, that I might give witness to what is true. Every lover of what is true gives ear to my voice.

chinese: 彼拉多說：真理是甚麼呢？說了這話，又出來到猶太人那裡，對他們說：我查不出他有甚麼罪來。
english: Pilate said to him, True? what is true? Having said this he went out again to the Jews and said to them, I see no wrong in him.

chinese: 但你們有個規矩，在逾越節要我給你們釋放一個人，你們要我給你們釋放猶太人的王麼？
english: But every year you make a request to me to let a prisoner go free at the Passover. Is it your desire that I let the King of the Jews go free?

chinese: 他們又喊著說：不要這人，要巴拉巴！這巴拉巴是個強盜。
english: Then again they gave a loud cry, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was an outlaw.

chinese: 當下彼拉多將耶穌鞭打了。
english: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him whipped with cords.

chinese: 兵丁用荊棘編作冠冕戴在他頭上，給他穿上紫袍，
english: And the men of the army made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and they put a purple robe on him.

chinese: 又挨近他，說：恭喜，猶太人的王阿！他們就用手掌打他。
english: And they kept coming and saying, Long life to the King of the Jews! And they gave him blows with their hands.

chinese: 彼拉多又出來對眾人說：我帶他出來見你們，叫你們知道我查不出他有甚麼罪來。
english: And Pilate went out again and said to them, See, I let him come out to you to make it clear to you that I see no wrong in him.

chinese: 耶穌出來，戴著荊棘冠冕，穿著紫袍。彼拉多對他們說：你們看這個人！
english: Then Jesus came out with the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said to them, Here is the man!

chinese: 祭司長和差役看見他，就喊著說：釘他十字架！釘他十字架！彼拉多說：你們自己把他釘十字架罷！我查不出他有甚麼罪來。
english: So when the chief priests and the police saw him they gave a loud cry, To the cross! to the cross! Pilate said to them, Take him yourselves and put him on the cross: I see no crime in him.

chinese: 猶太人回答說：我們有律法，按那律法，他是該死的，因他以自己為神的兒子。
english: And the Jews made answer, We have a law, and by that law it is right for him to be put to death because he said he was the Son of God.

chinese: 彼拉多聽見這話，越發害怕，
english: When this saying came to Pilate's ears his fear became greater;

chinese: 又進衙門，對耶穌說：你是那裡來的？耶穌卻不回答。
english: And he went again into the Praetorium and said to Jesus, Where do you come from? But Jesus gave him no answer.

chinese: 彼拉多說：你不對我說話麼？你豈不知我有權柄釋放你，也有權柄把你釘十字架麼？
english: Then Pilate said to him, You say nothing to me? is it not clear to you that I have power to let you go free and power to put you to death on the cross?

chinese: 耶穌回答說：若不是從上頭賜給你的，你就毫無權柄辦我。所以，把我交給你的那人罪更重了。
english: Jesus gave this answer: You would have no power at all over me if it was not given to you by God; so that he who gave me up to you has the greater sin.

chinese: 從此，彼拉多想要釋放耶穌，無奈猶太人喊著說：你若釋放這個人，就不是該撒的忠臣（原文作朋友）。凡以自己為王的，就是背叛該撒了。
english: Hearing this, Pilate had a desire to let him go free, but the Jews said in a loud voice, If you let this man go, you are not Caesar's friend: everyone who makes himself a king goes against Caesar.

chinese: 彼拉多聽見這話，就帶耶穌出來，到了一個地方，名叫鋪華石處，希伯來話叫厄巴大，就在那裡坐堂。
english: So when these words came to Pilate's ear, he took Jesus out, seating himself in the judge's seat in a place named in Hebrew, Gabbatha, or the Stone Floor.

chinese: 那日是預備逾越節的日子，約有午正。彼拉多對猶太人說：看哪，這是你們的王！
english: (It was the day when they made ready for the Passover; and it was about the sixth hour.) And he said to the Jews, There is your King!

chinese: 他們喊著說：除掉他！除掉他！釘他在十字架上！彼拉多說：我可以把你們的王釘十字架麼？祭司長回答說：除了該撒，我們沒有王。
english: Then they gave a loud cry, Away with him! away with him! to the cross! Pilate said to them, Am I to put your King to death on the cross? The chief priests said in answer, We have no king but Caesar.

chinese: 於是彼拉多將耶穌交給他們去釘十字架。
english: So then he gave him up to them to be put to death on the cross. And they took Jesus away;

chinese: 他們就把耶穌帶了去。耶穌背著自己的十字架出來，到了一個地方，名叫髑髏地，希伯來話叫各各他。
english: And he went out with his cross on him to the place which is named Dead Man's Head (in Hebrew, Golgotha):

chinese: 他們就在那裡釘他在十字架上，還有兩個人和他一同釘著，一邊一個，耶穌在中間。
english: Where they put him on the cross with two others, one on this side and one on that, and Jesus in the middle.

chinese: 彼拉多又用牌子寫了一個名號，安在十字架上，寫的是：猶太人的王，拿撒勒人耶穌。
english: And Pilate put on the cross a statement in writing. The writing was: JESUS THE NAZARENE, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

chinese: 有許多猶太人念這名號；因為耶穌被釘十字架的地方與城相近，並且是用希伯來、羅馬、希利尼三樣文字寫的。
english: The writing was seen by a number of the Jews, for the place where Jesus was put to death on the cross was near the town; and the writing was in Hebrew and Latin and Greek.

chinese: 猶太人的祭司長就對彼拉多說：不要寫猶太人的王，要寫他自己說：我是猶太人的王。
english: Then the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, Do not put, The King of the Jews, but, He said, I am the King of the Jews.

chinese: 彼拉多說：我所寫的，我已經寫上了。
english: But Pilate made answer, What I have put in writing will not be changed.

chinese: 兵丁既然將耶穌釘在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分為四分，每兵一分；又拿他的裡衣，這件裡衣原來沒有縫兒，是上下一片織成的。
english: And when Jesus was nailed to the cross, the men of the army took his clothing, and made a division of it into four parts, to every man a part, and they took his coat: now the coat was without a join, made out of one bit of cloth.

chinese: 他們就彼此說：我們不要撕開，只要拈鬮，看誰得著。這要應驗經上的話說：他們分了我的外衣，為我的裡衣拈鬮。兵丁果然做了這事。
english: So they said among themselves, Let this not be cut up, but let us put it to the decision of chance and see who gets it. (They did this so that the Writings might come true, which say, They made a distribution of my clothing among them, and my coat they put to the decision of chance.) This was what the men of the army did.

chinese: 站在耶穌十字架旁邊的，有他母親與他母親的姊妹，並革羅罷的妻子馬利亞，和抹大拉的馬利亞。
english: Now by the side of the cross of Jesus were his mother, and his mother's sister Mary, the wife of Cleopas, and Mary Magdalene.

chinese: 耶穌見母親和他所愛的那門徒站在旁邊，就對他母親說：母親（原文作婦人），看，你的兒子！
english: So when Jesus saw his mother and the disciple who was dear to him, he said to his mother, Mother, there is your son!

chinese: 又對那門徒說：看，你的母親！從此，那門徒就接他到自己家裡去了。
english: Then he said to the disciple, There is your mother! And from that hour the disciple took her to his house.

chinese: 這事以後，耶穌知道各樣的事已經成了，為要使經上的話應驗，就說：我渴了。
english: After this, being conscious that all things had now been done so that the Writings might come true, Jesus said, Give me water.

chinese: 有一個器皿盛滿了醋，放在那裡；他們就拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在牛膝草上，送到他口。
english: Now there was a vessel ready, full of bitter wine, and they put a sponge full of it on a stick and put it to his mouth.

chinese: 耶穌嘗（原文作受）了那醋，就說：成了！便低下頭，將靈魂交付神了。
english: So when Jesus had taken the wine he said, All is done. And with his head bent he gave up his spirit.

chinese: 猶太人因這日是預備日，又因那安息日是個大日，就求彼拉多叫人打斷他們的腿，把他們拿去，免得屍首當安息日留在十字架上。
english: Now it was the day of getting ready for the Passover, and so that the bodies might not be on the cross on the Sabbath (because the day of that Sabbath was a great day), the Jews made a request to Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

chinese: 於是兵丁來，把頭一個人的腿，並與耶穌同釘第二個人的腿，都打斷了。
english: So the men of the army came, and the legs of the first were broken and then of the other who was put to death on the cross with Jesus:

chinese: 只是來到耶穌那裡，見他已經死了，就不打斷他的腿。
english: But when they came to Jesus, they saw that he was dead by this time, and so his legs were not broken;

chinese: 惟有一個兵拿槍扎他的肋旁，隨即有血和水流出來。
english: But one of the men made a wound in his side with a spear, and straight away there came out blood and water.

chinese: 看見這事的那人就作見證─他的見證也是真的，並且他知道自己所說的是真的─叫你們也可以信。
english: And he who saw it has given witness (and his witness is true; he is certain that what he says is true) so that you may have belief.

chinese: 這些事成了，為要應驗經上的話說：他的骨頭一根也不可折斷。
english: These things came about so that the Writings might be true, No bone of his body will be broken.

chinese: 經上又有一句說：他們要仰望自己所扎的人。
english: And again another verse says, They will see him who was wounded by their spears.

chinese: 這些事以後，有亞利馬太人約瑟，是耶穌的門徒，只因怕猶太人，就暗暗的作門徒。他來求彼拉多，要把耶穌的身體領去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶穌的身體領去了。
english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, who was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, made a request to Pilate to let him take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate said he might do so. So he went and took away his body.

chinese: 又有尼哥底母，就是先前夜裡去見耶穌的，帶著沒藥和沉香約有一百斤前來。
english: And Nicodemus came (he who had first come to Jesus by night) with a roll of myrrh and aloes mixed, about a hundred pounds.

chinese: 他們就照猶太人殯葬的規矩，把耶穌的身體用細麻布加上香料裹好了。
english: Then they took the body of Jesus, folding linen about it with the spices, as is the way of the Jews when they put the dead to rest.

chinese: 在耶穌釘十字架的地方有一個園子，園子裡有一座新墳墓，是從來沒有葬過人的。
english: Now there was a garden near the cross, and in the garden a new place for the dead in which no man had ever been put.

chinese: 只因是猶太人的預備日，又因那墳墓近，他們就把耶穌安放在那裡。
english: So they put Jesus there, because it was the Jews' day of getting ready for the Passover, and the place was near.

chinese: 七日的第一日清早，天還黑的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞來到墳墓那裡，看見石頭從墳墓挪開了，
english: Now on the first day of the week, very early, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the place and saw that the stone had been taken away from it.

chinese: 就跑來見西門彼得和耶穌所愛的那個門徒，對他們說：有人把主從墳墓裡挪了去，我們不知道放在那裡。
english: Then she went running to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple who was loved by Jesus, and said to them, They have taken away the Lord out of the place of the dead and we have no knowledge where they have put him.

chinese: 彼得和那門徒就出來，往墳墓那裡去。
english: So Peter and the other disciple went out to the place of the dead.

chinese: 兩個人同跑，那門徒比彼得跑的更快，先到了墳墓，
english: They went running together, and the other disciple got in front of Peter and came first to the hole in the rock;

chinese: 低頭往裡看，就見細麻布還放在那裡，只是沒有進去。
english: And looking in, he saw the linen bands on the earth; but he did not go in,

chinese: 西門彼得隨後也到了，進墳墓裡去，就看見細麻布還放在那裡，
english: Then Simon Peter came after him and went into the hole in the rock; and he saw the linen bands on the earth,

chinese: 又看見耶穌的裹頭巾沒有和細麻布放在一處，是另在一處捲著。
english: And the cloth, which had been round his head, not with the linen bands but rolled up in a place by itself.

chinese: 先到墳墓的那門徒也進去，看見就信了。
english: Then the other disciple who came there first went in; and he saw and belief came to him.

chinese: 因為他們還不明白聖經的意思，就是耶穌必要從死裡復活。
english: For at that time they had no knowledge that the Writings said that he would have to come again from the dead.

chinese: 於是兩個門徒回自己的住處去了。
english: So then the disciples went away again to their houses.

chinese: 馬利亞卻站在墳墓外面哭。哭的時候，低頭往墳墓裡看，
english: But Mary was still there outside the hole in the rock, weeping; and while she was weeping and looking into the hole,

chinese: 就見兩個天使，穿著白衣，在安放耶穌身體的地方坐著，一個在頭，一個在腳。
english: She saw two angels in white seated where the body of Jesus had been, one at the head and the other at the feet.

chinese: 天使對他說：婦人，你為甚麼哭？他說：因為有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在那裡。
english: They said to her, Woman, why are you weeping? She said to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I have no knowledge where they have put him.

chinese: 說了這話，就轉過身來，看見耶穌站在那裡，卻不知道是耶穌。
english: And then looking round, she saw Jesus there, but had no idea that it was Jesus.

chinese: 耶穌問他說：婦人，為甚麼哭？你找誰呢？馬利亞以為是看園的，就對他說：先生，若是你把他移了去，請告訴我，你把他放在那裡，我便去取他。
english: Jesus said to her, Woman, why are you weeping? who are you looking for? She, taking him for the gardener, said to him, Sir, if you have taken him away from here, say where you have put him and I will take him away.

chinese: 耶穌說：馬利亞。馬利亞就轉過來，用希伯來話對他說：拉波尼！（拉波尼就是夫子的意思。）
english: Jesus said to her, Mary! Turning, she said to him in Hebrew, Rabboni! (which is to say, Master).

chinese: 耶穌說：不要摸我，因我還沒有升上去見我的父。你往我弟兄那裡去，告訴他們說，我要升上去見我的父，也是你們的父，見我的神，也是你們的神。
english: Jesus said to her, Do not put your hand on me, for I have not gone up to the Father: but go to my brothers and say to them, I go up to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.

chinese: 抹大拉的馬利亞就去告訴門徒說：我已經看見了主。他又將主對他說的這話告訴他們。
english: Mary Magdalene went with the news to the disciples, and said she had seen the Lord and that he had said these things to her.

chinese: 那日（就是七日的第一日）晚上，門徒所在的地方，因怕猶太人，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中，對他們說：願你們平安！
english: At evening on that day, the first day of the week, when, for fear of the Jews, the doors were shut where the disciples were, Jesus came among them and said to them, May peace be with you!

chinese: 說了這話，就把手和肋旁指給他們看。門徒看見主，就喜樂了。
english: And when he had said this, he let them see his hands and his side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.

chinese: 耶穌又對他們說：願你們平安！父怎樣差遣了我，我也照樣差遣你們。
english: And Jesus said to them again, May peace be with you! As the Father sent me, even so I now send you.

chinese: 說了這話，就向他們吹一口氣，說：你們受聖靈！
english: And when he had said this, breathing on them, he said to them, Let the Holy Spirit come on you:

chinese: 你們赦免誰的罪，誰的罪就赦免了；你們留下誰的罪，誰的罪就留下了。
english: Any to whom you give forgiveness, will be made free from their sins; and any from whom you keep back forgiveness, will still be in their sins.

chinese: 那十二個門徒中，有稱為低土馬的多馬；耶穌來的時候，他沒有和他們同在。
english: Now Thomas, one of the twelve, named Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

chinese: 那些門徒就對他說：我們已經看見主了。多馬卻說：我非看見他手上的釘痕，用指頭探入那釘痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我總不信。
english: So the other disciples said to him, We have seen the Lord. But he said to them, If I do not see in his hands the print of the nails and put my finger into the print of the nails, and if I do not put my hand into his side, I will never have belief.

chinese: 過了八日，門徒又在屋裡，多馬也和他們同在，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中說：願你們平安！
english: And after eight days, his disciples were again in the house and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were shut, Jesus came, and taking his place in the middle of them, he said, May peace be with you!

chinese: 就對多馬說：伸過你的指頭來，摸（原文是看）我的手；伸出你的手來，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，總要信。
english: Then he said to Thomas, Put out your finger, and see my hands; and put your hand here into my side: and be no longer in doubt but have belief.

chinese: 多馬說：我的主！我的神！
english: And Thomas said in answer, My Lord and my God!

chinese: 耶穌對他說：你因看見了我才信；那沒有看見就信的有福了。
english: Jesus said to him, Because you have seen me you have belief: a blessing will be on those who have belief though they have not seen me!

chinese: 耶穌在門徒面前另外行了許多神蹟，沒有記在這書上。
english: A number of other signs Jesus did before his disciples which are not recorded in this book:

chinese: 但記這些事要叫你們信耶穌是基督，是神的兒子，並且叫你們信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。
english: But these are recorded, so that you may have faith that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and so that, having this faith you may have life in his name.

chinese: 這些事以後，耶穌在提比哩亞海邊又向門徒顯現。他怎樣顯現記在下面：
english: After these things Jesus let himself be seen again by the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and it came about in this way.

chinese: 有西門彼得和稱為低土馬的多馬，並加利利的迦拿人拿但業，還有西庇太的兩個兒子，又有兩個門徒，都在一處。
english: Simon Peter, Thomas named Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were all together.

chinese: 西門彼得對他們說：我打魚去。他們說：我們也和你同去。他們就出去，上了船；那一夜並沒有打著甚麼。
english: Simon Peter said to them, I am going fishing. They said to him, And we will come with you. They went out and got into the boat; but that night they took no fish.

chinese: 天將亮的時候，耶穌站在岸上，門徒卻不知道是耶穌。
english: Now very early in the morning Jesus was there by the edge of the sea (though the disciples were not conscious that it was Jesus).

chinese: 耶穌就對他們說：小子！你們有吃的沒有？他們回答說：沒有。
english: So Jesus said to them, Children, have you taken any fish? They made answer, No.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們把網撒在船的右邊，就必得著。他們便撒下網去，竟拉不上來了，因為魚甚多。
english: And he said to them, Let down the net on the right side of the boat and you will get some. So they put it in the water and now they were not able to get it up again because of the great number of fish.

chinese: 耶穌所愛的那門徒對彼得說：是主！那時西門彼得赤著身子，一聽見是主，就束上一件外衣，跳在海裡。
english: So the disciple who was dear to Jesus said to Peter, It is the Lord! Hearing that it was the Lord, Peter put his coat round him (because he was not clothed) and went into the sea.

chinese: 其餘的門徒離岸不遠，約有二百肘（古代以肘為尺，一肘約有今時尺半），就在小船上把那網魚拉過來。
english: And the other disciples came in the little boat (they were not far from land, only about two hundred cubits off) pulling the net full of fish.

chinese: 他們上了岸，就看見那裡有炭火，上面有魚，又有餅。
english: When they got to land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish cooking on it, and bread.

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：把剛才打的魚拿幾條來。
english: Jesus said to them, Get some of the fish which you have now taken.

chinese: 西門彼得就去（或作：上船），把網拉到岸上。那網滿了大魚，共一百五十三條；魚雖這樣多，網卻沒有破。
english: So Peter went to the boat and came back pulling the net to land, full of great fish, a hundred and fifty-three; and though there was such a number the net was not broken.

chinese: 耶穌說：你們來吃早飯。門徒中沒有一個敢問他：你是誰？因為知道是主。
english: Jesus said to them, Come and take some food. And all the disciples were in fear of putting the question, Who are you? being conscious that it was the Lord.

chinese: 耶穌就來拿餅和魚給他們。
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and the fish in the same way.

chinese: 耶穌從死裡復活以後，向門徒顯現，這是第三次。
english: Now this was the third time that Jesus let himself be seen by the disciples after he had come back from the dead.

chinese: 他們吃完了早飯，耶穌對西門彼得說：約翰（在太16：17稱約拿）的兒子西門，你愛我比這些更深麼？彼得說：主阿，是的，你知道我愛你。耶穌對他說：你餵養我的小羊。
english: Then when they had taken food, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, son of John, is your love for me greater than the love of these others? He said to him, Yes, Lord; you are certain of my love for you. He said to him, Then give my lambs food.

chinese: 耶穌第二次又對他說：約翰的兒子西門，你愛我麼？彼得說：主阿，是的，你知道我愛你。耶穌說：你牧養我的羊。
english: Again, a second time, he said to him, Simon, son of John, have you any love for me? Yes, Lord, he said, you are certain of my love for you. Then take care of my sheep, said Jesus.

chinese: 第三次對他說：約翰的兒子西門﹐你愛我麼？彼得因為耶穌第三次對他說你愛我麼，就憂愁，對耶穌說：主阿，你是無所不知的；你知道我愛你。耶穌說：你餵養我的羊。
english: He said to him a third time, Simon, son of John, am I dear to you? Now Peter was troubled in his heart because he put the question a third time, Am I dear to you? And he said to him, Lord, you have knowledge of all things; you see that you are dear to me. Jesus said to him, Then give my sheep food.

chinese: 我實實在在的告訴你，你年少的時候，自己束上帶子，隨意往來；但年老的時候，你要伸出手來，別人要把你束上，帶你到不願意去的地方。
english: Truly I say to you, When you were young, you made yourself ready and went wherever you had a desire to go: but when you are old, you will put out your hands and another will make you ready, and you will be taken where you have no desire to go.

chinese: 耶穌說這話是指著彼得要怎樣死，榮耀神。說了這話，就對他說：你跟從我罷！
english: Now this he said, pointing out the sort of death by which he would give God glory. And after saying this, he said to him, Come after me.

chinese: 彼得轉過來，看見耶穌所愛的那門徒跟著，就是在晚飯的時候，靠著耶穌胸膛說：主阿，賣你的是誰？的那門徒。
english: Then Peter, turning round, saw the disciple who was dear to Jesus coming after them--the disciple who was resting on his breast at the last meal, and said, Lord, who is it who will be false to you?

chinese: 彼得看見他，就問耶穌說：主阿，這人將來如何？
english: Seeing him, Peter said to Jesus, What about this man?

chinese: 耶穌對他說：我若要他等到我來的時候，與你何干？你跟從我罷！
english: Jesus said to him, If it is my desire for him to be here till I come back, what is that to you? come yourself after me.

chinese: 於是這話傳在弟兄中間，說那門徒不死。其實，耶穌不是說他不死，乃是說：我若要他等到我來的時候，與你何干？
english: So this saying went about among the brothers that this disciple would not undergo death: Jesus, however, did not say that he would not undergo death, but, If it is my desire for him to be here till I come back, what is that to you?

chinese: 為這些事作見證，並且記載這些事的就是這門徒；我們也知道他的見證是真的。
english: This is the disciple who gives witness about these things and who put them in writing: and we have knowledge that his witness is true.

chinese: 耶穌所行的事還有許多，若是一一的都寫出來，我想，所寫的書就是世界也容不下了。
english: And Jesus did such a number of other things that, if every one was recorded, it is my opinion that even the world itself is not great enough for the books there would be.

chinese: 提阿非羅阿，我已經作了前書，論到耶穌開頭一切所行所教訓的，
english: I have given an earlier account, O Theophilus, of all the things which Jesus did, and of his teaching from the first,

chinese: 直到他藉著聖靈吩咐所揀選的使徒，以後被接上升的日子為止。
english: Till the day when he was taken up to heaven after he had given his orders, through the Holy Spirit, to the Apostles of whom he had made selection:

chinese: 他受害之後，用許多的憑據將自己活活的顯給使徒看，四十天之久向他們顯現，講說神國的事。
english: And to whom he gave clear and certain signs that he was living, after his death; for he was seen by them for forty days, and gave them teaching about the kingdom of God:

chinese: 耶穌和他們聚集的時候，囑咐他們說：不要離開耶路撒冷，要等候父所應許的，就是你們聽見我說過的。
english: And when they were all together, with him, he gave them orders not to go away from Jerusalem, but to keep there, waiting till the word of the Father was put into effect, of which, he said, I have given you knowledge:

chinese: 約翰是用水施洗，但不多幾日，你們要受聖靈的洗。
english: For the baptism of John was with water, but you will have baptism with the Holy Spirit, after a little time.

chinese: 他們聚集的時候，問耶穌說：主阿，你復興以色列國就在這時候麼？
english: So, when they were together, they said to him, Lord, will you at this time give back the kingdom to Israel?

chinese: 耶穌對他們說：父憑著自己的權柄所定的時候、日期，不是你們可以知道的。
english: And he said to them, It is not for you to have knowledge of the time and the order of events which the Father has kept in his control.

chinese: 但聖靈降臨在你們身上，你們就必得著能力，並要在耶路撒冷、猶太全地，和撒瑪利亞，直到地極，作我的見證。
english: But you will have power, when the Holy Spirit has come on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and all Judaea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.

chinese: 說了這話，他們正看的時候，他就被取上升，有一朵雲彩把他接去，便看不見他了。
english: And when he had said these things, while they were looking, he was taken up, and went from their view into a cloud.

chinese: 當他往上去，他們定睛望天的時候，忽然有兩個人身穿白衣，站在旁邊，說：
english: And while they were looking up to heaven with great attention, two men came to them, in white clothing,

chinese: 加利利人哪，你們為甚麼站著望天呢？這離開你們被接升天的耶穌，你們見他怎樣往天上去，他還要怎樣來。
english: And said, O men of Galilee, why are you looking up into heaven? This Jesus, who was taken from you into heaven, will come again, in the same way as you saw him go into heaven.

chinese: 有一座山，名叫橄欖山，離耶路撒冷不遠，約有安息日可走的路程。當下，門徒從那裡回耶路撒冷去，
english: Then they went back to Jerusalem from the mountain named Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.

chinese: 進了城，就上了所住的一間樓房；在那裡有彼得、約翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多馬、巴多羅買、馬太、亞勒腓的兒子雅各、奮銳黨的西門，和雅各的兒子（或作：兄弟）猶大。
english: And when they came in, they went up into the room where they were living; Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James, the son of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas, the son of James.

chinese: 這些人同著幾個婦人和耶穌的母親馬利亞，並耶穌的弟兄，都同心合意的恆切禱告。
english: And they all with one mind gave themselves up to prayer, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.

chinese: 那時，有許多人聚會，約有一百二十名，彼得就在弟兄中間站起來，說：
english: And in those days Peter got up among the brothers (there were about one hundred and twenty of them), and said,

chinese: 弟兄們！聖靈藉大衛的口，在聖經上預言領人捉拿耶穌的猶大，這話是必須應驗的。
english: My brothers, the word of God had to be put into effect, which the Holy Spirit had said before, by the mouth of David, about Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus,

chinese: 他本來列在我們數中，並且在使徒的職任上得了一分。
english: For he was numbered among us, and had his part in our work.

chinese: 這人用他作惡的工價買了一塊田，以後身子仆倒，肚腹崩裂，腸子都流出來。
english: (Now this man, with the reward of his evil-doing, got for himself a field, and falling head first, came to a sudden and violent end there.

chinese: 住在耶路撒冷的眾人都知道這事，所以按著他們那裡的話給那塊田起名叫亞革大馬，就是血田的意思。
english: And this came to the knowledge of all those who were living in Jerusalem, so that the field was named in their language, Akel-dama, or, The field of blood.)

chinese: 因為詩篇上寫著，說：願他的住處變為荒場，無人在內居住；又說：願別人得他的職分。
english: For in the book of Psalms it says, Let his house be waste, and let no man be living in it: and, Let his position be taken by another.

chinese: 所以，主耶穌在我們中間始終出入的時候，
english: For this reason, of the men who have been with us all the time, while the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

chinese: 就是從約翰施洗起，直到主離開我們被接上升的日子為止，必須從那常與我們作伴的人中立一位與我們同作耶穌復活的見證。
english: Starting from the baptism of John till he went up from us, one will have to be a witness with us of his coming back from death.

chinese: 於是選舉兩個人，就是那叫作巴撒巴，又稱呼猶士都的約瑟，和馬提亞。
english: And they made selection of two, Joseph, named Barsabbas, whose other name was Justus, and Matthias.

chinese: 眾人就禱告說：主阿，你知道萬人的心，求你從這兩個人中，指明你所揀選的是誰，叫他得這使徒的位分。這位分猶大已經丟棄，往自己的地方去了。
english: And they made prayers and said, Lord, having knowledge of the hearts of all men, make clear which of these two has been marked out by you,
To take that position as a servant and Apostle, from which Judas by his sin was shut out, so that he might go to his place.

chinese: 於是眾人為他們搖籤，搖出馬提亞來；他就和十一個使徒同列。
english: And they put it to the decision of chance, and the decision was given for Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven Apostles.

chinese: 五旬節到了，門徒都聚集在一處。
english: And when the day of Pentecost was come, they were all together in one place.

chinese: 忽然，從天上有響聲下來，好像一陣大風吹過，充滿了他們所坐的屋子，
english: And suddenly there came from heaven a sound like the rushing of a violent wind, and all the house where they were was full of it.

chinese: 又有舌頭如火燄顯現出來，分開落在他們各人頭上。
english: And they saw tongues, like flames of fire, coming to rest on every one of them.

chinese: 他們就都被聖靈充滿，按著聖靈所賜的口才說起別國的話來。
english: And they were all full of the Holy Spirit, and were talking in different languages, as the Spirit gave them power.

chinese: 那時，有虔誠的猶太人從天下各國來，住在耶路撒冷。
english: Now there were living at Jerusalem, Jews, God-fearing men, from every nation under heaven.

chinese: 這聲音一響，眾人都來聚集，各人聽見門徒用眾人的鄉談說話，就甚納悶；
english: And when this sound came to their ears, they all came together, and were greatly surprised because every man was hearing the words of the disciples in his special language.

chinese: 都驚訝希奇說：看哪，這說話的不都是加利利人麼？
english: And they were full of wonder and said, Are not all these men Galilaeans?

chinese: 我們各人，怎麼聽見他們說我們生來所用的鄉談呢？
english: And how is it that every one of us is hearing their words in the language which was ours from our birth?

chinese: 我們帕提亞人、瑪代人、以攔人，和住在米所波大米、猶太、加帕多家、本都、亞西亞、
english: Men of Parthia, Media, and Elam, and those living in Mesopotamia, in Judaea and Cappadocia, in Pontus and Asia,

chinese: 弗呂家、旁非利亞、埃及的人，並靠近古利奈的呂彼亞一帶地方的人，從羅馬來的客旅中，或是猶太人，或是進猶太教的人，
english: In Phrygia and Pamphylia, in Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and those who have come from Rome, Jews by birth and others who have become Jews,

chinese: 革哩底和亞拉伯人，都聽見他們用我們的鄉談，講說神的大作為。
english: Men of Crete and Arabia, to all of us they are talking in our different languages, of the great works of God.

chinese: 眾人就都驚訝猜疑，彼此說：這是甚麼意思呢？
english: And they were all surprised and in doubt saying to one another, What is the reason of this?

chinese: 還有人譏誚說：他們無非是新酒灌滿了。
english: But others, making sport of them, said, They are full of new wine.

chinese: 彼得和十一個使徒站起，高聲說：猶太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，這件事你們當知道，也當側耳聽我的話。
english: But Peter, getting up, with the eleven, said in a loud voice, O men of Judaea, and all you who are living in Jerusalem, take note of this and give ear to my words.

chinese: 你們想這些人是醉了；其實不是醉了，因為時候剛到巳初。
english: For these men are not overcome with wine, as it seems to you, for it is only the third hour of the day;

chinese: 這正是先知約珥所說的：
english: But this is the thing which was said by the prophet Joel;

chinese: 神說：在末後的日子，我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。你們的兒女要說預言；你們的少年人要見異象；老年人要做異夢。
english: And it will come about, in the last days, says God, that I will send out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will be prophets, and your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams:

chinese: 在那些日子，我要將我的靈澆灌我的僕人和使女，他們就要說預言。
english: And on my men-servants and my women-servants I will send my Spirit, and they will be prophets.

chinese: 在天上、我要顯出奇事；在地下、我要顯出神蹟；有血，有火，有煙霧。
english: And wonders will be seen in heaven, and signs on the earth, blood and fire and smoke:

chinese: 日頭要變為黑暗，月亮要變為血；這都在主大而明顯的日子未到以前。
english: The sun will become dark and the moon will be turned to blood, before that great day of the Lord comes in glory:

chinese: 到那時候，凡求告主名的，就必得救。
english: And whoever makes his prayer to the Lord will have salvation.

chinese: 以色列人哪，請聽我的話：神藉著拿撒勒人耶穌在你們中間施行異能、奇事神蹟，將他證明出來，這是你們自己知道的。
english: Men of Israel, give ear to these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man who had the approval of God, as was made clear to you by the great works and signs and wonders which God did by him among you, as you yourselves have knowledge,

chinese: 他既按著神的定旨先見被交與人，你們就藉著無法之人的手，把他釘在十字架上，殺了。
english: Him, when he was given up, by the decision and knowledge of God, you put to death on the cross, by the hands of evil men:

chinese: 神卻將死的痛苦解釋了，叫他復活，因為他原不能被死拘禁。
english: But God gave him back to life, having made him free from the pains of death because it was not possible for him to be overcome by it.

chinese: 大衛指著他說：我看見主常在我眼前；他在我右邊，叫我不至於搖動。
english: For David said of him, I saw the Lord before my face at all times, for he is at my right hand, so that I may not be moved:

chinese: 所以，我心裡歡喜，我的靈（原文是舌）快樂；並且我的肉身要安居在指望中。
english: And for this cause my heart was glad and my tongue full of joy, and my flesh will be resting in hope:

chinese: 因你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間，也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
english: For you will not let my soul be in hell and you will not give up your Holy One to destruction.

chinese: 你已將生命的道路指示我，必叫我因見你的面（或作：叫我在你面前）得著滿足的快樂。
english: You have made me see the ways of life; I will be full of joy when I see your face.

chinese: 弟兄們！先祖大衛的事，我可以明明的對你們說：他死了，也葬埋了，並且他的墳墓直到今日還在我們這裡。
english: My brothers, I may say to you openly that David came to his death, and was put in the earth, and his resting-place is with us today.

chinese: 大衛既是先知，又曉得神曾向他起誓，要從他的後裔中立一位坐在他的寶座上，
english: But being a prophet, and having in mind the oath which God had given to him, that of the fruit of his body one would take his place as a king,

chinese: 就預先看明這事，講論基督復活說：他的靈魂不撇在陰間；他的肉身也不見朽壞。
english: He, having knowledge of the future, was talking of the coming again of Christ from the dead, that he was not kept in hell and his body did not see destruction.

chinese: 這耶穌，神已經叫他復活了，我們都為這事作見證。
english: This Jesus God has given back to life, of which we all are witnesses.

chinese: 他既被神的右手高舉（或作：他既高舉在神的右邊），又從父受了所應許的聖靈，就把你們所看見所聽見的，澆灌下來。
english: And so, being lifted up to the right hand of God, and having the Father's word that the Holy Spirit would come, he has sent this thing, which now you see and have knowledge of.

chinese: 大衛並沒有升到天上，但自己說：主對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，
english: For David has not gone up into heaven, but says, himself, The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand,

chinese: 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
english: Till I put all those who are against you under your feet.

chinese: 故此，以色列全家當確實的知道，你們釘在十字架上的這位耶穌，神已經立他為主，為基督了。
english: For this reason, let all Israel be certain that this Jesus, whom you put to death on the cross, God has made Lord and Christ.

chinese: 眾人聽見這話，覺得扎心，就對彼得和其餘的使徒說：弟兄們，我們當怎樣行？
english: Now when these words came to their ears their hearts were troubled, and they said to Peter and the other Apostles, Brothers, what are we to do?

chinese: 彼得說：你們各人要悔改，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦，就必領受所賜的聖靈；
english: And Peter said, Let your hearts be changed, every one of you, and have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ, for the forgiveness of your sins; and you will have the Holy Spirit given to you.

chinese: 因為這應許是給你們和你們的兒女，並一切在遠方的人，就是主─我們神所召來的。
english: For the word of God is for you and for your children and for all those who are far off, even all those who may be marked out by the Lord our God.

chinese: 彼得還用許多話作見證，勸勉他們說：你們當救自己脫離這彎曲的世代。
english: And with more such words he gave his witness, offering them salvation and saying, Come out from this evil generation.

chinese: 於是領受他話的人就受了洗。那一天，門徒約添了三千人，
english: Then those who gave hearing to his words had baptism: and about three thousand souls were joined to them that day.

chinese: 都恆心遵守使徒的教訓，彼此交接，擘餅，祈禱。
english: And they kept their attention fixed on the Apostles' teaching and were united together in the taking of broken bread and in prayer.

chinese: 眾人都懼怕；使徒又行了許多奇事神蹟。
english: But fear came on every soul: and all sorts of wonders and signs were done by the Apostles.

chinese: 信的人都在一處，凡物公用；
english: And all those who were of the faith kept together, and had all things in common;

chinese: 並且賣了田產，家業，照各人所需用的分給各人。
english: And exchanging their goods and property for money, they made division of it among them all, as they had need.

chinese: 他們天天同心合意恆切的在殿裡，且在家中擘餅，存著歡喜、誠實的心用飯，
english: And day by day, going in agreement together regularly to the Temple and, taking broken bread together in their houses, they took their food with joy and with true hearts,

chinese: 讚美神，得眾民的喜愛。主將得救的人天天加給他們。
english: Giving praise to God, and having the approval of all the people; and every day the number of those who had salvation was increased by the Lord.

chinese: 申初禱告的時候，彼得、約翰上聖殿去。
english: Now Peter and John were going up to the Temple at the ninth hour, the hour of prayer;

chinese: 有一個人，生來是瘸腿的，天天被人抬來，放在殿的一個門口，那門名叫美門，要求進殿的人賙濟。
english: And a certain man who from birth had had no power in his legs, was taken there every day, and put down at the door of the Temple which is named Beautiful, requesting money from those who went into the Temple;

chinese: 他看見彼得、約翰將要進殿，就求他們賙濟。
english: He then, seeing Peter and John going into the Temple, made a request to them.

chinese: 彼得約翰定睛看他；彼得說：你看我們！
english: And Peter, looking at him, with John, said, Keep your eyes on us.

chinese: 那人就留意看他們，指望得著甚麼。
english: And he gave attention to them, hoping to get something from them.

chinese: 彼得說：金銀我都沒有，只把我所有的給你：我奉拿撒勒人耶穌基督的名，叫你起來行走！
english: But Peter said, I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up on your feet.

chinese: 於是拉著他的右手，扶他起來；他的腳和踝子骨立刻健壯了，
english: And he took him by his right hand, lifting him up; and straight away his feet and the bones of his legs became strong,

chinese: 就跳起來，站著，又行走，同他們進了殿，走著，跳著，讚美神。
english: And, jumping up, he got on to his feet and went into the Temple with them, walking and jumping and giving praise to God.

chinese: 百姓都看見他行走，讚美神；
english: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

chinese: 認得他是那素常坐在殿的美門口求賙濟的，就因他所遇著的事滿心希奇、驚訝。
english: And they saw that it was the man who made requests for money at the door of the Temple, and they were full of wonder and surprise at what had taken place.

chinese: 那人正在稱為所羅門的廊下，拉著彼得、約翰；眾百姓一齊跑到他們那裡，很覺希奇。
english: And while he kept his hands on Peter and John, all the people came running together to the covered way which is named Solomon's, full of wonder.

chinese: 彼得看見，就對百姓說：以色列人哪，為甚麼把這事當作希奇呢？為甚麼定睛看我們，以為我們憑自己的能力和虔誠使這人行走呢？
english: And when Peter saw it he said to the people, You men of Israel, why are you so greatly surprised at this man? or why are you looking at us as if by our power or virtue we had given him the use of his legs?

chinese: 亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神，就是我們列祖的神，已經榮耀了他的僕人（或作：兒子）耶穌；你們卻把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要釋放他，你們竟在彼拉多面前棄絕了他。
english: The God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, has given glory to his servant Jesus; whom you gave up, turning your backs on him, when Pilate had made the decision to let him go free.

chinese: 你們棄絕了那聖潔公義者，反求著釋放一個兇手給你們。
english: But you would have nothing to do with the Holy and Upright One, and made request for a man of blood to be given to you,

chinese: 你們殺了那生命的主，神卻叫他從死裡復活了；我們都是為這事作見證。
english: And put to death the Lord of life; whom God gave back from the dead; of which fact we are witnesses.

chinese: 我們因信他的名，他的名便叫你們所看見所認識的這人健壯了；正是他所賜的信心，叫這人在你們眾人面前全然好了。
english: And his name, through faith in his name, has made this man strong, whom you see and have knowledge of: yes, the faith which is through him has made him well, before you all.

chinese: 弟兄們，我曉得你們做這事是出於不知，你們的官長也是如此。
english: And now, my brothers, I am conscious that you did this, as did your rulers, without knowledge.

chinese: 但神曾藉眾先知的口，預言基督將要受害，就這樣應驗了。
english: But the things which God had made clear before, by the mouth of all the prophets, that the Christ would have to undergo, he has put into effect in this way.

chinese: 所以，你們當悔改歸正，使你們的罪得以塗抹，這樣，那安舒的日子就必從主面前來到；
english: So then, let your hearts be changed and be turned to God, so that your sins may be completely taken away, and times of blessing may come from the Lord;

chinese: 主也必差遣所預定給你們的基督耶穌降臨。
english: And that he may send the Christ who was marked out for you from the first, even Jesus:

chinese: 天必留他，等到萬物復興的時候，就是神從創世以來、藉著聖先知的口所說的。
english: Who is to be kept in heaven till the time when all things are put right, of which God has given word by the mouth of his holy prophets, who have been from the earliest times.

chinese: 摩西曾說：主─神要從你們弟兄中間給你們興起一位先知像我，凡他向你們所說的，你們都要聽從。
english: For Moses said, The Lord will give you a prophet from among your people, like me; you will give ear to everything which he will say to you.

chinese: 凡不聽從那先知的，必要從民中全然滅絕。
english: And every soul who does not give attention to that prophet, will be cut off from among the people.

chinese: 從撒母耳以來的眾先知，凡說預言的，也都說到這些日子。
english: And all the prophets from Samuel and those who came after, every one of them, gave word of these days.

chinese: 你們是先知的子孫，也承受神與你們祖宗所立的約，就是對亞伯拉罕說：地上萬族都要因你的後裔得福。
english: You are the sons of the prophets, and of the agreement which God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, Through your seed a blessing will come on all the families of the earth.

chinese: 神既興起他的僕人，（或作：兒子），就先差他到你們這裡來，賜福給你們，叫你們各人回轉，離開罪惡。
english: To you, first, God sent his servant, blessing you by turning every one of you from his sins.

chinese: 使徒對百姓說話的時候，祭司們和守殿官，並撒都該人忽然來了。
english: And while they were talking to the people, the priests and the captain of the Temple and the Sadducees came up to them,

chinese: 因他們教訓百姓，本著耶穌，傳說死人復活，就很煩惱，
english: Being greatly troubled because they were teaching the people and preaching Jesus as an example of the coming back from the dead.

chinese: 於是下手拿住他們；因為天已經晚了，就把他們押到第二天。
english: And they took them and put them in prison till the morning, for it was now evening.

chinese: 但聽道之人有許多信的，男丁數目約到五千。
english: But a number of those who gave hearing to the word had faith; and they were now about five thousand.

chinese: 第二天，官府、長老，和文士在耶路撒冷聚會，
english: And on the day after, the rulers and those in authority and the scribes came together in Jerusalem;

chinese: 又有大祭司亞那和該亞法、約翰、亞力山大，並大祭司的親族都在那裡，
english: And Annas, the high priest, was there, and Caiaphas and John and Alexander, and all the relations of the high priest.

chinese: 叫使徒站在當中，就問他們說：你們用甚麼能力，奉誰的名做這事呢？
english: Then sending for Peter and John, they said, By what power and in whose name have you done this?

chinese: 那時彼得被聖靈充滿，對他們說：
english: Then Peter, being full of the Holy Spirit, said to them, O you rulers of the people and men of authority,

chinese: 治民的官府和長老阿，倘若今日因為在殘疾人身上所行的善事查問我們他是怎麼得了痊愈，
english: If we are questioned today about a good work done to a man who was ill, as to how he has been made well,

chinese: 你們眾人和以色列百姓都當知道，站在你們面前的這人得痊愈是因你們所釘十字架、神叫他從死裡復活的拿撒勒人耶穌基督的名。
english: Take note, all of you, and all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you put to death on the cross, whom God gave back from the dead, even through him is this man now before you completely well.

chinese: 他是你們匠人所棄的石頭，已成了房角的頭塊石頭。
english: He is the stone which you builders had no use for, but which has been made the chief stone of the building.

chinese: 除他以外，別無拯救；因為在天下人間，沒有賜下別的名，我們可以靠著得救。
english: And in no other is there salvation: for there is no other name under heaven, given among men, through which we may have salvation.

chinese: 他們見彼得、約翰的膽量，又看出他們原是沒有學問的小民，就希奇，認明他們是跟過耶穌的；
english: Now when they saw that Peter and John were without fear, though they were men of no education or learning, they were greatly surprised; and they took note of them that they had been with Jesus.

chinese: 又看見那治好了的人和他們一同站著，就無話可駁。
english: And, seeing that the man who had been made well was there with them, they were not able to say anything against it.

chinese: 於是吩咐他們從公會出去，就彼此商議說：
english: But when they had given them orders to go out of the Sanhedrin, they had a discussion among themselves,

chinese: 我們當怎樣辦這兩個人呢？因為他們誠然行了一件明顯的神蹟，凡住耶路撒冷的人都知道，我們也不能說沒有。
english: Saying, What are we to do with these men? for certainly it is clear to all who are living in Jerusalem that a most important sign has been done by them, and it is not possible to say that it is not so.

chinese: 惟恐這事越發傳揚在民間，我們必須恐嚇他們，叫他們不再奉這名對人講論。
english: But so that it may not go farther among the people, let us put them in fear of punishment if they say anything in future in this name.

chinese: 於是叫了他們來，禁止他們總不可奉耶穌的名講論教訓人。
english: And they sent for them, and gave them orders not to make statements or give teaching in the name of Jesus.

chinese: 彼得、約翰說：聽從你們，不聽從神，這在神面前合理不合理，你們自己酌量罷！
english: But Peter and John in answer said to them, It is for you to say if it is right in the eyes of God to give attention to you more than to God:

chinese: 我們所看見所聽見的，不能不說。
english: For it is not possible for us to keep from saying what we have seen and have knowledge of.

chinese: 官長為百姓的緣故，想不出法子刑罰他們，又恐嚇一番，把他們釋放了。這是因眾人為所行的奇事都歸榮耀與神。
english: And when they had said more sharp words to them, they let them go, not seeing what punishment they might give them, because of the people; for all men were giving praise to God for what had taken place.

chinese: 原來藉著神蹟醫好的那人有四十多歲了。
english: For the man on whom this act of power was done was more than forty years old.

chinese: 二人既被釋放，就到會友那裡去，把祭司長和長老所說的話都告訴他們。
english: And when they had been made free, they came back to their friends, and gave an account of all the things which the chief priests and the authorities had said to them.

chinese: 他們聽見了，就同心合意的高聲向神說：主阿！你是造天、地、海，和其中萬物的，
english: And hearing it, they all, with one mind, made prayer to God and said, O Lord, maker of heaven and earth and the sea and all things in them:

chinese: 你曾藉著聖靈，託你僕人─我們祖宗大衛的口，說：外邦為甚麼爭鬧？萬民為甚麼謀算虛妄的事？
english: Who has said, by the Holy Spirit, through the mouth of our father David your servant, Why are the nations so violently moved, and why are the thoughts of the people so foolish?

chinese: 世上的君王一齊起來，臣宰也聚集，要敵擋主，並主的受膏者（或作：基督）。
english: The kings of the earth were lifted up, the rulers came together, against the Lord, and against his Christ:

chinese: 希律和本丟彼拉多，外邦人和以色列民，果然在這城裡聚集，要攻打你所膏的聖僕（僕：或作子）耶穌，
english: For, truly, in this town, against your holy servant, Jesus, who was marked out by you as Christ, Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, came together,

chinese: 成就你手和你意旨所預定必有的事。
english: To do that which had been fixed before by your hand and your purpose.

chinese: 他們恐嚇我們，現在求主鑒察，一面叫你僕人大放膽量講你的道，一面伸出你的手來醫治疾病，並且使神蹟奇事因著你聖僕（僕：或作子）耶穌的名行出來。
english: And now, Lord, take note of their cruel words, and give your servants power to be preachers of your word without fear,
While your hand is stretched out to do works of mercy; so that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy servant Jesus.

chinese: 禱告完了，聚會的地方震動，他們就都被聖靈充滿，放膽講論神的道。
english: And when their prayer was ended, the place where they were was violently moved, and they all became full of the Holy Spirit, preaching the word of God without fear.

chinese: 那許多信的人都是一心一意的，沒有一人說他的東西有一樣是自己的，都是大家公用。
english: And all those who were of the faith were one in heart and soul: and not one of them said that any of the things which he had was his property only; but they had all things in common.

chinese: 使徒大有能力，見證主耶穌復活；眾人也都蒙大恩。
english: And with great power the Apostles gave witness of the coming back of the Lord Jesus from the dead; and grace was on them all.

chinese: 內中也沒有一個缺乏的，因為人人將田產房屋都賣了，把所賣的價銀拿來，放在使徒腳前，
english: And no one among them was in need; for everyone who had land or houses, exchanging them for money, took the price of them,

chinese: 照各人所需用的，分給各人。
english: And put it at the feet of the Apostles for distribution to everyone as he had need.

chinese: 有一個利未人，生在居比路，名叫約瑟，使徒稱他為巴拿巴（巴拿巴翻出來就是勸慰子）。
english: And Joseph, who was given by the Apostles the name of Barnabas (the sense of which is, Son of comfort), a Levite and a man of Cyprus by birth,

chinese: 他有田地，也賣了，把價銀拿來，放在使徒腳前。
english: Having a field, got money for it and put the money at the feet of the Apostles.

chinese: 有一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，同他的妻子撒非喇賣了田產，
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, got money for his property,

chinese: 把價銀私自留下幾分，他的妻子也知道，其餘的幾分拿來放在使徒腳前。
english: And kept back part of the price, his wife having knowledge of it, and took the rest and put it at the feet of the Apostles.

chinese: 彼得說：亞拿尼亞！為甚麼撒但充滿了你的心，叫你欺哄聖靈，把田地的價銀私自留下幾分呢？
english: But Peter said, Ananias, why has the Evil One put it into your heart to be false to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

chinese: 田地還沒有賣，不是你自己的麼？既賣了，價銀不是你作主麼？你怎麼心裡起這意念呢？你不是欺哄人，是欺哄神了。
english: While you had it, was it not your property? and after you had given it in exchange, was it not still in your power? how has this purpose come into your mind? you have been false, not to men, but to God.

chinese: 亞拿尼亞聽見這話，就仆倒，斷了氣；聽見的人都甚懼怕r。
english: And at these words, Ananias went down on the earth, and his life went from him: and great fear came on all who were present.

chinese: 有些少年人起來，把他包裹，抬出去埋葬了。
english: And the young men went and made ready his body, and took it out, and put it in the earth.

chinese: 約過了三小時，他的妻子進來，還不知道這事。
english: And about three hours after, his wife, having no knowledge of what had taken place, came in.

chinese: 彼得對他說：你告訴我，你們賣田地的價銀就是這些麼？他說：就是這些。
english: And Peter said to her, Give me an answer: was this amount of money the price of the land? And she said, Yes, it was.

chinese: 彼得說：你們為甚麼同心試探主的靈呢？埋葬你丈夫之人的腳已到門口，他們也要把你抬出去。
english: But Peter said to her, Why have you made an agreement together to be false to the Spirit of the Lord? See, the feet of the young men who have put the body of your husband in the earth, are at the door, and they will take you out.

chinese: 婦人立刻仆倒在彼得腳前，斷了氣。那些少年人進來，見他已經死了，就抬出去，埋在他丈夫旁邊。
english: And straight away she went down at his feet, and her life went from her: and the young men came in and saw her dead, and they took her out and put her in the earth with her husband.

chinese: 全教會和聽見這事的人都甚懼怕。
english: Then great fear came on all the church and on all who had knowledge of these things.

chinese: 主藉使徒的手在民間行了許多神蹟s奇事；他們（或作：信的人）都同心合意的在所羅門的廊下.。
english: Now a number of signs and wonders were done among the people by the hands of the Apostles; and they were all together in Solomon's covered way.

chinese: 其餘的人沒有一個敢貼近他們百姓卻尊重他們。
english: The others, in fear, kept back from joining them: but the people made much of them;

chinese: 信而歸主的人越發增添，連男帶女很多。
english: And a great number of men and women had faith, and were joined to the Lord;

chinese: 甚至有人將病人抬到街上，放在床上或褥子上，指望彼得過來的時候，或者得他的影兒照在甚麼人身上。
english: And they even took into the streets people who were ill, and put them on beds, so that when Peter went by, some of them might be in his shade.

chinese: 還有許多人帶著病人和被污鬼纏磨的，從耶路撒冷四圍的城邑來，全都得了醫治。
english: And numbers of people came together from the towns round about Jerusalem, with those who were ill and those who were troubled with unclean spirits: and they were all made well.

chinese: 大祭司和他的一切同人，就是撒都該教門的人，都起來，滿心忌恨，
english: But the high priest and those who were with him (the Sadducees) were full of envy,

chinese: 就下手拿住使徒，收在外監。
english: And they took the Apostles and put them in the common prison.

chinese: 但主的使者夜間開了監門，領他們出來，
english: But in the night an angel of the Lord, opening the doors of the prison, took them out and said,

chinese: 說：你們去站在殿裡，把這生命的道都講給百姓聽。
english: Go, take your place in the Temple and give the people all the teaching about this Life.

chinese: 使徒聽了這話，天將亮的時候就進殿裡去教訓人。大祭司和他的同人來了，叫齊公會的人，和以色列族的眾長老，就差人到監裡去，要把使徒提出來。
english: And hearing this, they went into the Temple at dawn, and were teaching. But the high priest and those who were with him got together the Sanhedrin and the representatives of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to get them.

chinese: 但差役到了，不見他們在監裡，就回來稟報說：
english: But the men who were sent saw that they were not in the prison, and came back with the news,

chinese: 我們看見監牢關得極妥當，看守的人也站在門外；及至開了門，裡面一個人都不見。
english: Saying, The doors of the prison were safely shut, and the keepers were at the doors, but when they were open, there was nobody inside.

chinese: 守殿官和祭司長聽見這話，心裡犯難，不知這事將來如何。
english: Now, at these words, the captain of the Temple and the chief priests were greatly troubled about what might be the end of this business.

chinese: 有一個人來稟報說：你們收在監裡的人，現在站在殿裡教訓百姓。
english: And someone came and said to them, The men, whom you put in prison, are in the Temple teaching the people.

chinese: 於是守殿官和差役去帶使徒來，並沒有用強暴，因為怕百姓用石頭打他們。
english: Then the captain and some of the police went and took them, but not violently, for fear that they might be stoned by the people.

chinese: 帶到了，便叫使徒站在公會前；大祭司問他們說：
english: And they took them into the Sanhedrin, and the high priest said to them,

chinese: 我們不是嚴嚴的禁止你們，不可奉這名教訓人麼？你們倒把你們的道理充滿了耶路撒冷，想要叫這人的血歸到我們身上！
english: We gave you very clear orders not to give teaching in this name: and now Jerusalem is full of your teaching, and you are attempting to make us responsible for this man's death.

chinese: 彼得和眾使徒回答說：順從神，不順從人，是應當的。
english: But Peter and the Apostles, answering, said, We have to do the orders of God, not of man.

chinese: 你們掛在木頭上殺害的耶穌，我們祖宗的神已經叫他復活。
english: The God of our fathers gave Jesus back to life, whom you had put to death, hanging him on a tree.

chinese: 神且用右手將他高舉（或作：他就是神高舉在自己的右邊），叫他作君王，作救主，將悔改的心和赦罪的恩賜給以色列人。
english: Him God has put on high at his right hand, as a Ruler and a Saviour, to give to Israel a change of heart and forgiveness of sins.

chinese: 我們為這事作見證；神賜給順從之人的聖靈也為這事作見證。
english: And we are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who keep his laws.

chinese: 公會的人聽見就極其惱怒，想要殺他們。
english: But when these words came to their ears, they were cut to the heart, and had a mind to put them to death.

chinese: 但有一個法利賽人，名叫迦瑪列，是眾百姓所敬重的教法師，在公會中站起來，吩咐人把使徒暫且帶到外面去，
english: But one of the Sanhedrin, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a man of learning in the law, of whom all the people had a high opinion, got up and made a suggestion for the men to be put outside for a little time.

chinese: 就對眾人說：以色列人哪，論到這些人，你們應當小心怎樣辦理。
english: And he said to them, Men of Israel, take care what you do about these men.

chinese: 從前丟大起來，自誇為大；附從他的人約有四百，他被殺後，附從他的全都散了，歸於無有。
english: For before this there was Theudas, who said he was someone important, to whom about four hundred men gave their support: he was put to death, and his band was broken up and came to nothing.

chinese: 此後，報名上冊的時候，又有加利利的猶大起來，引誘些百姓跟從他；他也滅亡，附從他的人也都四散了。
english: After this man, there was Judas of Galilee, at the time of the numbering, and some of the people went after him: he was put to death, and all his supporters were put to flight.

chinese: 現在，我勸你們不要管這些人，任憑他們罷！他們所謀的、所行的，若是出於人，必要敗壞；
english: And now I say to you, Do nothing to these men, but let them be: for if this teaching or this work is of men, it will come to nothing:

chinese: 若是出於神，你們就不能敗壞他們，恐怕你們倒是攻擊神了。
english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overcome them, and you are in danger of fighting against God.

chinese: 公會的人聽從了他，便叫使徒來，把他們打了，又吩咐他們不可奉耶穌的名講道，就把他們釋放了。
english: And he seemed to them to be right: and they sent for the Apostles, and, after having them whipped and giving them orders to give no teaching in the name of Jesus, they let them go.

chinese: 他們離開公會，心裡歡喜，因被算是配為這名受辱。
english: So they went away from the Sanhedrin, happy to undergo shame for the Name.

chinese: 他們就每日在殿裡、在家裡、不住的教訓人，傳耶穌是基督。
english: And every day, in the Temple and privately, they went on teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ.

chinese: 那時，門徒增多，有說希利尼話的猶太人向希伯來人發怨言，因為在天天的供給上忽略了他們的寡婦。
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was increasing, protests were made by the Greek Jews against the Hebrews, because their widows were not taken care of in the distribution of food every day.

chinese: 十二使徒叫眾門徒來，對他們說：我們撇下神的道去管理飯食，原是不合宜的。
english: And the Apostles sent for all the disciples and said, It is not right for us to give up preaching the word of God in order to make distribution of food.

chinese: 所以弟兄們，當從你們中間選出七個有好名聲、被聖靈充滿、智慧充足的人，我們就派他們管理這事。
english: Take then from among you seven men of good name, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, to whom we may give control of this business.

chinese: 但我們要專心以祈禱、傳道為事。
english: Then we will give all our time to prayer and the teaching of the word.

chinese: 大眾都喜悅這話，就揀選了司提反，乃是大有信心、聖靈充滿的人，又揀選腓利、伯羅哥羅、尼迦挪、提門、巴米拿，並進猶太教的安提阿人尼哥拉，
english: And this saying was pleasing to all of them: and they made selection of Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip and Prochorus and Nicanor and Timon and Parmenas and Nicolas of Antioch, who had become a Jew:

chinese: 叫他們站在使徒面前。使徒禱告了，就按手在他們頭上。
english: These they took to the Apostles, who, after prayer, put their hands on them.

chinese: 神的道興旺起來；在耶路撒冷門徒數目加增的甚多，也有許多祭司信從了這道。
english: And the word of God was increasing in power; and the number of the disciples in Jerusalem became very great, and a great number of priests were in agreement with the faith.

chinese: 司提反滿得恩惠、能力，在民間行了大奇事和神蹟。
english: And Stephen, full of grace and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.

chinese: 當時有稱利百地拿會堂的幾個人，並有古利奈、亞力山太、基利家、亞西亞、各處會堂的幾個人，都起來和司提反辯論。
english: But some of those who were of the Synagogue named that of the Libertines, and some of the men of Cyrene and of Alexandria and those from Cilicia and Asia, had arguments with Stephen.

chinese: 司提反是以智慧和聖靈說話，眾人敵擋不住，
english: But they were not able to get the better of him, for his words were full of wisdom and of the Spirit.

chinese: 就買出人來說：我們聽見他說謗讟摩西和神的話。
english: Then they got men to say, He has said evil against Moses and against God, in our hearing.

chinese: 他們又聳動了百姓、長老，並文士，就忽然來捉拿他，把他帶到公會去，
english: And the people, with the rulers and the scribes, were moved against him, and they came and took him before the Sanhedrin,

chinese: 設下假見證，說：這個人說話，不住的蹧踐聖所和律法。
english: And they got false witnesses who said, This man is for ever saying things against this holy place and against the law:

chinese: 我們曾聽見他說：這拿撒勒人耶穌要毀壞此地，也要改變摩西所交給我們的規條。
english: For he has said in our hearing that this Jesus of Nazareth will put this place to destruction and make changes in the rules which were handed down to us by Moses.

chinese: 在公會裡坐著的人都定睛看他，見他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。
english: And all those who were in the Sanhedrin, looking at him, saw that his face was like the face of an angel.

chinese: 大祭司就說：這些事果然有麼？
english: Then the high priest said, Are these things true?

chinese: 司提反說：諸位父兄請聽！當日我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕在米所波大米還未住哈蘭的時候，榮耀的神向他顯現，
english: And he said, My brothers and fathers, give hearing. The God of glory came to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he was living in Haran,

chinese: 對他說：你要離開本地和親族，往我所要指示你的地方去。
english: And said to him, Go out of your land, and away from your family, and come into the land to which I will be your guide.

chinese: 他就離開迦勒底人之地，住在哈蘭。他父親死了以後，神使他從那裡搬到你們現在所住之地。
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and went into Haran; and from there, when his father was dead, he was guided by God into this land, where you are living now:

chinese: 在這地方，神並沒有給他產業，連立足之地也沒有給他；但應許要將這地賜給他和他的後裔為業；那時他還沒有兒子。
english: And God gave him no heritage in it, not even enough to put his foot on: but he gave him an undertaking that he would give it to him and to his children after him, though he had no child at that time.

chinese: 神說：他的後裔必寄居外邦，那裡的人要叫他們作奴僕，苦待他們四百年。
english: And God said that his seed would be living in a strange land, and that they would make them servants, and be cruel to them for four hundred years.

chinese: 神又說：使他們作奴僕的那國，我要懲罰。以後他們要出來，在這地方事奉我。
english: And I will be the judge, said God, of that nation which made them servants: and after that, they will come out and give me worship in this place.

chinese: 神又賜他割禮的約。於是亞伯拉罕生了以撒，第八日給他行了割禮。以撒生雅各，雅各生十二位先祖。
english: And he made with him the agreement of which circumcision was the sign. And so Abraham had a son, Isaac, and gave him circumcision on the eighth day; and Isaac had a son, Jacob, and Jacob was the father of the twelve heads of the families of Israel.

chinese: 先祖嫉妒約瑟，把他賣到埃及去；神卻與他同在，
english: And the brothers, moved with envy against Joseph, gave him to the Egyptians for money: but God was with him,

chinese: 救他脫離一切苦難，又使他在埃及王法老面前得恩典，有智慧。法老就派他作埃及國的宰相兼管全家。
english: And made him free from all his troubles, and gave him wisdom and the approval of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who made him ruler over Egypt and all his house.

chinese: 後來埃及和迦南全地遭遇饑荒，大受艱難，我們的祖宗就絕了糧。
english: Now there was no food to be had in all Egypt and Canaan, and there was great trouble: and our fathers were not able to get food.

chinese: 雅各聽見在埃及有糧，就打發我們的祖宗初次往那裡去。
english: But Jacob, hearing that there was grain in Egypt, sent out our fathers the first time.

chinese: 第二次約瑟與弟兄們相認，他的親族也被法老知道了。
english: And the second time his brothers had a meeting with Joseph, and Pharaoh had knowledge of Joseph's family.

chinese: 約瑟就打發弟兄請父親雅各和全家七十五個人都來。
english: Then Joseph sent for Jacob his father and all his family, seventy-five persons.

chinese: 於是雅各下了埃及，後來他和我們的祖宗都死在那裡；
english: And Jacob went down to Egypt, and came to his end there, and so did our fathers;

chinese: 又被帶到示劍，葬於亞伯拉罕在示劍用銀子從哈抹子孫買來的墳墓裡。
english: And they were taken over to Shechem, and put to rest in the place which Abraham got for a price in silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.

chinese: 及至神應許亞伯拉罕的日期將到，以色列民在埃及興盛眾多，
english: But when the time was near for putting into effect the undertaking which God had given to Abraham, the people were increasing in Egypt,

chinese: 直到有不曉得約瑟的新王興起。
english: Till another king came to power, who had no knowledge of Joseph.

chinese: 他用詭計待我們的宗族，苦害我們的祖宗，叫他們丟棄嬰孩，使嬰孩不能存活。
english: He, having evil designs against our nation, was cruel to our fathers, and they were forced to put out their young children, so that they might not go on living.

chinese: 那時，摩西生下來，俊美非凡，在他父親家裡撫養了三個月。
english: At which time Moses came to birth, and he was very beautiful; and he was kept for three months in his father's house:

chinese: 他被丟棄的時候，法老的女兒拾了去，養為自己的兒子。
english: And when he was put out, Pharaoh's daughter took him and kept him as her son.

chinese: 摩西學了埃及人一切的學問，說話行事都有才能。
english: And Moses was trained in all the wisdom of Egypt, and was great in his words and works.

chinese: 他將到四十歲，心中起意去看望他的弟兄以色列人；
english: But when he was almost forty years old, it came into his heart to go and see his brothers, the children of Israel.

chinese: 到了那裡，見他們一個人受冤屈，就護庇他，為那受欺壓的人報仇，打死了那埃及人。
english: And seeing one of them being attacked, he went to his help and gave the Egyptian a death-blow:

chinese: 他以為弟兄必明白神是藉他的手搭救他們；他們卻不明白。
english: And he was hoping that his brothers would see that God had sent him to be their saviour; but they did not see.

chinese: 第二天，遇見兩個以色列人爭鬥，就勸他們和睦，說：你們二位是弟兄，為甚麼彼此欺負呢？
english: And the day after, he came to them, while they were having a fight, and would have made peace between them, saying, Sirs, you are brothers; why do you do wrong to one another?

chinese: 那欺負鄰舍的把他推開，說：誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？
english: But the man who was doing wrong to his neighbour, pushing him away, said, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

chinese: 難道你要殺我，像昨天殺那埃及人麼？
english: Will you put me to death as you did the Egyptian yesterday?

chinese: 摩西聽見這話就逃走了，寄居於米甸；在那裡生了兩個兒子。
english: And at these words, Moses went in flight to the land of Midian, and was living there for a time, and had two sons.

chinese: 過了四十年，在西乃山的曠野，有一位天使從荊棘火燄中向摩西顯現。
english: At the end of forty years, an angel came to him in the waste land of Sinai, in the flame of a burning thorn-tree.

chinese: 摩西見了那異象，便覺希奇，正進前觀看的時候，有主的聲音說：
english: And Moses, seeing it, was full of wonder, and when he came up to have a nearer view of it, the voice of the Lord came to him, saying,

chinese: 我是你列祖的神，就是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。摩西戰戰兢兢，不敢觀看。
english: I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob. And Moses, shaking with fear, kept his eyes from looking at it.

chinese: 主對他說：把你腳上的鞋脫下來；因為你所站之地是聖地。
english: And the Lord said, Take off the shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy.

chinese: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我實在看見了，他們悲歎的聲音，我也聽見了。我下來要救他們。你來！我要差你往埃及去。
english: Truly, I have seen the sorrows of my people in Egypt, and their cries have come to my ears, and I have come down to make them free: and now, come, I will send you to Egypt.

chinese: 這摩西就是百姓棄絕說誰立你作我們的首領和審判官的；神卻藉那在荊棘中顯現之使者的手差派他作首領、作救贖的。
english: This Moses, whom they would not have, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? him God sent to be a ruler and a saviour, by the hand of the angel whom he saw in the thorn-tree.

chinese: 這人領百姓出來，在埃及，在紅海、在曠野，四十年間行了奇事神蹟。
english: This man took them out, having done wonders and signs in Egypt and in the Red Sea and in the waste land, for forty years.

chinese: 那曾對以色列人說神要從你們弟兄中間給你們興起一位先知像我的，就是這位摩西。
english: This is the same Moses, who said to the children of Israel, God will give you a prophet from among your brothers, like me.

chinese: 這人曾在曠野會中和西乃山上，與那對他說話的天使同在，又與我們的祖宗同在，並且領受活潑的聖言傳給我們。
english: This is the man who was in the church in the waste land with the angel who was talking to him in Sinai, and with our fathers; and to him were given the living words of God, so that he might give them to you.

chinese: 我們的祖宗不肯聽從，反棄絕他，心裡歸向埃及，
english: By whom our fathers would not be controlled; but they put him on one side, turning back in their hearts to Egypt,

chinese: 對亞倫說：你且為我們造些神像，在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。
english: And saying to Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has become of him.

chinese: 那時，他們造了一個牛犢，又拿祭物獻給那像，歡喜自己手中的工作。
english: And they made the image of a young ox in those days, and made an offering to it, and had joy in the work of their hands.

chinese: 神就轉臉不顧，任憑他們事奉天上的日月星辰，正如先知書上所寫的說：以色列家阿，你們四十年間在曠野，豈是將犧牲和祭物獻給我麼？
