english: But God was turned from them and let them give worship to the stars of heaven, as it says in the book of the prophets, Did you make offerings to me of sheep and oxen for forty years in the waste land, O house of Israel?

chinese: 你們抬著摩洛的帳幕和理番神的星，就是你們所造為要敬拜的像。因此，我要把你們遷到巴比倫外去。
english: And you took up the tent of Moloch and the star of the god Rephan, images which you made to give worship to them: and I will take you away, farther than Babylon.

chinese: 我們的祖宗在曠野，有法櫃的帳幕，是神吩咐摩西叫他照所看見的樣式做的。
english: Our fathers had the Tent of witness in the waste land, as God gave orders to Moses to make it after the design which he had seen.

chinese: 這帳幕，我們的祖宗相繼承受。當神在他們面前趕出外邦人去的時候，他們同約書亞把帳幕搬進承受為業之地，直存到大衛的日子。
english: Which our fathers, in their turn, took with them when, with Joshua, they came into the heritage of the nations whom God was driving out before the face of our fathers, till the time of David,

chinese: 大衛在神面前蒙恩，祈求為雅各的神預備居所；
english: Who was pleasing to God; and he had a desire to make a holy tent for the God of Jacob.

chinese: 卻是所羅門為神造成殿宇。
english: But Solomon was the builder of his house.

chinese: 其實，至高者並不住人手所造的，就如先知所言：
english: But still, the Most High has not his resting-place in houses made with hands, as the prophet says,

chinese: 主說：天是我的座位，地是我的腳凳；你們要為我造何等的殿宇？那裡是我安息的地方呢？
english: Heaven is the seat of my power, and earth is a resting-place for my feet: what sort of house will you make for me, says the Lord, or what is my place of rest?

chinese: 這一切不都是我手所造的麼？
english: Did not my hand make all these things?

chinese: 你們這硬著頸項、心與耳未受割禮的人，常時抗拒聖靈！你們的祖宗怎樣，你們也怎樣。
english: You whose hearts are hard and whose ears are shut to me; you are ever working against the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you.

chinese: 那一個先知不是你們祖宗逼迫呢？他們也把預先傳說那義者要來的人殺了；如今你們又把那義者賣了，殺了。
english: Which of the prophets was not cruelly attacked by your fathers? and they put to death those who gave them the news of the coming of the Upright One; whom you have now given up and put to death;

chinese: 你們受了天使所傳的律法，竟不遵守。
english: You, to whom the law was given as it was ordered by angels, and who have not kept it.

chinese: 眾人聽見這話就極其惱怒，向司提反咬牙切齒。
english: Hearing these things, they were cut to the heart and moved with wrath against him.

chinese: 但司提反被聖靈充滿，定睛望天，看見神的榮耀，又看見耶穌站在神的右邊，
english: But he was full of the Holy Spirit, and looking up to heaven, he saw the glory of God and Jesus at the right hand of God.

chinese: 就說：我看見天開了，人子站在神的右邊。
english: And he said, Now I see heaven open, and the Son of man at the right hand of God.

chinese: 眾人大聲喊叫，摀著耳朵，齊心擁上前去，
english: But with loud cries, and stopping their ears, they made an attack on him all together,

chinese: 把他推到城外，用石頭打他。作見證的人把衣裳放在一個少年人名叫掃羅的腳前。
english: Driving him out of the town and stoning him: and the witnesses put their clothing at the feet of a young man named Saul.

chinese: 他們正用石頭打的時候，司提反呼籲主說：求主耶穌接收我的靈魂！
english: And Stephen, while he was being stoned, made prayer to God, saying, Lord Jesus, take my spirit.

chinese: 又跪下大聲喊著說：主阿，不要將這罪歸於他們！說了這話，就睡了。掃羅也喜悅他被害。
english: And going down on his knees, he said in a loud voice, Lord, do not make them responsible for this sin. And when he had said this, he went to his rest.

chinese: 從這日起，耶路撒冷的教會大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，門徒都分散在猶太和撒瑪利亞各處。
english: And Saul gave approval to his death. Now at that time a violent attack was started against the church in Jerusalem; and all but the Apostles went away into all parts of Judaea and Samaria.

chinese: 有虔誠的人把司提反埋葬了，為他捶胸大哭。
english: And God-fearing men put Stephen's body in its last resting-place, making great weeping over him.

chinese: 掃羅卻殘害教會，進各人的家，拉著男女下在監裡。
english: But Saul was burning with hate against the church, going into every house and taking men and women and putting them in prison.

chinese: 那些分散的人往各處去傳道。
english: But those who had gone in flight went everywhere preaching the word.

chinese: 腓利下撒瑪利亞城去，宣講基督。
english: And Philip went down to Samaria and was teaching them about Christ.

chinese: 眾人聽見了，又看見腓利所行的神蹟，就同心合意的聽從他的話。
english: And all the people gave attention to the words which Philip said, when they saw the signs which he did.

chinese: 因為有許多人被污鬼附著，那些鬼大聲呼叫，從他們身上出來；還有許多癱瘓的，瘸腿的，都得了醫治。
english: For unclean spirits came out from those who had them, crying with a loud voice; and a number of those who were ill and broken in body were made well.

chinese: 在那城裡，就大有歡喜。
english: And there was much joy in that town.

chinese: 有一個人，名叫西門，向來在那城裡行邪術，妄自尊大，使撒瑪利亞的百姓驚奇；
english: But there was a certain man named Simon, who in the past had been a wonder-worker and a cause of surprise to the people of Samaria, saying that he himself was a great man:

chinese: 無論大小都聽從他，說：這人就是那稱為神的大能者。
english: To whom they all gave attention, from the smallest to the greatest, saying, This man is that power of God which is named Great.

chinese: 他們聽從他，因他久用邪術，使他們驚奇。
english: And they gave attention to him, because for a long time his wonder-working powers had kept them under his control.

chinese: 及至他們信了腓利所傳神國的福音和耶穌基督的名，連男帶女就受了洗。
english: But when they had faith in the good news given by Philip about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, a number of men and women had baptism.

chinese: 西門自己也信了；既受了洗，就常與腓利在一處，看見他所行的神蹟和大異能，就甚驚奇。
english: And Simon himself had faith and, having had baptism, he went with Philip and, seeing the signs and the great wonders which he did, he was full of surprise.

chinese: 使徒在耶路撒冷聽見撒瑪利亞人領受了神的道，就打發彼得、約翰往他們那裡去。
english: Now when the Apostles at Jerusalem had news that the people of Samaria had taken the word of God into their hearts, they sent to them Peter and John;

chinese: 兩個人到了，就為他們禱告，要叫他們受聖靈。
english: Who, when they came there, made prayer for them, that the Holy Spirit might be given to them:

chinese: 因為聖靈還沒有降在他們一個人身上，他們只奉主耶穌的名受了洗。
english: For up to that time he had not come on any of them; only baptism had been given to them in the name of the Lord Jesus.

chinese: 於是使徒按手在他們頭上，他們就受了聖靈。
english: Then they put their hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came on them.

chinese: 西門看見使徒按手，便有聖靈賜下，就拿錢給使徒，
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the touch of the Apostles' hands, he made them an offering of money, saying,

chinese: 說：把這權柄也給我，叫我手按著誰，誰就可以受聖靈。
english: Give me this power, so that when I put my hands on anyone he may get the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 彼得說：你的銀子和你一同滅亡罷！因你想神的恩賜是可以用錢買的。
english: But Peter said, May your money come to destruction with you, because you had the idea that what is freely given by God may be got for a price.

chinese: 你在這道上無分無關；因為在神面前，你的心不正。
english: You have no part in this business, because your heart is not right before God.

chinese: 你當懊悔你這罪惡，祈求主，或者你心裡的意念可得赦免。
english: Let your heart be changed, and make prayer to God that you may have forgiveness for your evil thoughts.

chinese: 我看出你正在苦膽之中，被罪惡捆綁。
english: For I see that you are prisoned in bitter envy and the chains of sin.

chinese: 西門說：願你們為我求主，叫你們所說的，沒有一樣臨到我身上。
english: And Simon, answering, said, Make prayer for me to the Lord, so that these things which you have said may not come on me.

chinese: 使徒既證明主道，而且傳講，就回耶路撒冷去，一路在撒瑪利亞好些村莊傳揚福音。
english: So they, having given their witness and made clear the word of the Lord, went back to Jerusalem, giving the good news on their way in a number of the small towns of Samaria.

chinese: 有主的一個使者對腓利說：起來！向南走，往那從耶路撒冷下迦薩的路上去。那路是曠野。
english: But an angel of the Lord said to Philip, Get up, and go to the south, to the road which goes from Jerusalem to Gaza, through the waste land.

chinese: 腓利就起身去了，不料，有一個埃提阿伯（即古實，見以賽亞十八章一節）人，是個有大權的太監，在埃提阿伯女王干大基的手下總管銀庫，他上耶路撒冷禮拜去了。
english: And he went and there was a man of Ethiopia, a servant of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, and controller of all her property, who had come up to Jerusalem for worship;

chinese: 現在回來，在車上坐著，念先知以賽亞的書。
english: He was going back, seated in his carriage, and was reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.

chinese: 聖靈對腓利說：你去！貼近那車走。
english: And the Spirit said to Philip, Go near, and get on his carriage.

chinese: 腓利就跑到太監那裡，聽見他念先知以賽亞的書，便問他說：你所念的，你明白麼？
english: And Philip, running up to him, saw that he was reading Isaiah the prophet, and said to him, Is the sense of what you are reading clear to you?

chinese: 他說：沒有人指教我，怎能明白呢？於是請腓利上車，與他同坐。
english: And he said, How is that possible when I have no guide? And he made Philip get up by his side.

chinese: 他所念的那段經，說：他像羊被牽到宰殺之地，又像羊羔在剪毛的人手下無聲；他也是這樣不開口。
english: Now the place in the book where he was reading was this: He was taken, like a sheep, to be put to death; and as a lamb is quiet when its wool is being cut, so he made no sound:

chinese: 他卑微的時候，人不按公義審判他（原文是他的審判被奪去）；誰能述說他的世代，因為他的生命從地上奪去。
english: Being of low degree, his cause was not given a hearing: who has knowledge of his family? for his life is cut off from the earth.

chinese: 太監對腓利說：請問，先知說這話是指著誰？是指著自己呢？是指著別人呢？
english: And the Ethiopian said to Philip, About whom are these words said by the prophet? about himself, or some other?

chinese: 腓利就開口從這經上起，對他傳講耶穌。
english: So Philip, starting from this writing, gave him the good news about Jesus.

chinese: 二人正往前走，到了有水的地方，太監說：看哪，這裡有水，我受洗有甚麼妨礙呢？（有古卷在此有：
english: And while they were going on their way, they came to some water, and the Ethiopian said, See, here is water; why may I not have baptism?

chinese: 腓利說：你若是一心相信，就可以。他回答說：我信耶穌基督是神的兒子。）
於是吩咐車站住，腓利和太監二人同下水裡去，腓利就給他施洗。
english: And he gave orders for the carriage to be stopped, and the two of them went down into the water, and Philip gave him baptism.

chinese: 從水裡上來，主的靈把腓利提了去，太監也不再見他了，就歡歡喜喜的走路。
english: And when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord took Philip away; and the Ethiopian saw him no more, for he went on his way full of joy.

chinese: 後來有人在亞鎖都遇見腓利；他走遍那地方，在各城宣傳福音，直到該撒利亞。
english: But Philip came to Azotus, and went through all the towns, preaching the good news, till he came to Caesarea.

chinese: 掃羅仍然向主的門徒口吐威嚇兇殺的話，去見大祭司，
english: But Saul, still burning with desire to put to death the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,

chinese: 求文書給大馬色的各會堂，若是找著信奉這道的人，無論男女，都准他捆綁帶到耶路撒冷。
english: And made a request for letters from him to the Synagogues of Damascus, so that if there were any of the Way there, men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

chinese: 掃羅行路，將到大馬色，忽然從天上發光，四面照著他；
english: And while he was journeying, he came near Damascus; and suddenly he saw a light from heaven shining round him;

chinese: 他就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對他說：掃羅！掃羅！你為甚麼逼迫我？
english: And he went down on the earth, and a voice said to him, Saul, Saul, why are you attacking me so cruelly?

chinese: 他說：主阿！你是誰？主說：我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
english: And he said, Who are you, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus, whom you are attacking:

chinese: 起來！進城去，你所當做的事，必有人告訴你。
english: But get up, and go into the town, and it will be made clear to you what you have to do.

chinese: 同行的人站在那裡，說不出話來，聽見聲音，卻看不見人。
english: And the men who were with him were not able to say anything; hearing the voice, but seeing no one.

chinese: 掃羅從地上起來，睜開眼睛，竟不能看見甚麼。有人拉他的手，領他進了大馬色；
english: And Saul got up from the earth, and when his eyes were open, he saw nothing; and he was guided by the hand into Damascus.

chinese: 三日不能看見，也不吃也不喝。
english: And for three days he was not able to see, and he took no food or drink.

chinese: 當下，在大馬色有一個門徒，名叫亞拿尼亞。主在異象中對他說：亞拿尼亞。他說：主，我在這裡。
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and the Lord said to him in a vision, Ananias! and he said, Here I am, Lord.

chinese: 主對他說：起來！往直街去，在猶大的家裡，訪問一個大數人，名叫掃羅。他正禱告，
english: And the Lord said to him, Get up, and go to the street which is named Straight, and make search at the house of Judas for one named Saul of Tarsus: for he is at prayer;

chinese: 又看見了一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，進來按手在他身上，叫他能看見。
english: And he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and putting his hands on him, so that he may be able to see.

chinese: 亞拿尼亞回答說：主阿，我聽見許多人說：這人怎樣在耶路撒冷多多苦害你的聖徒，
english: But Ananias said, Lord, I have had accounts of this man from a number of people, how much evil he has done to your saints at Jerusalem:

chinese: 並且他在這裡有從祭司長得來的權柄捆綁一切求告你名的人。
english: And here he has authority from the chief priests to make prisoners all who give worship to your name.

chinese: 主對亞拿尼亞說：你只管去！他是我所揀選的器皿，要在外邦人和君王，並以色列人面前宣揚我的名。
english: But the Lord said, Go without fear: for he is a special vessel for me, to give to the Gentiles and kings and to the children of Israel the knowledge of my name:

chinese: 我也要指示他，為我的名必須受許多的苦難。
english: For I will make clear to him what troubles he will have to undergo for me.

chinese: 亞拿尼亞就去了，進入那家，把手按在掃羅身上，說：兄弟掃羅，在你來的路上向你顯現的主，就是耶穌，打發我來，叫你能看見，又被聖靈充滿。
english: And Ananias went out and came to the house, and putting his hands on him, said, Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, whom you saw when you were on your journey, has sent me, so that you may be able to see, and be full of the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 掃羅的眼睛上，好像有鱗立刻掉下來，他就能看見。於是起來受了洗；
english: And straight away it seemed as if a veil was taken from his eyes, and he was able to see; and he got up, and had baptism;

chinese: 吃過飯就健壯了。掃羅和大馬色的門徒同住了些日子，
english: And when he had taken food his strength came back. And for some days he kept with the disciples who were in Damascus.

chinese: 就在各會堂裡宣傳耶穌，說他是神的兒子。
english: And straight away, in the Synagogues, he was preaching Jesus as the Son of God.

chinese: 凡聽見的人都驚奇，說：在耶路撒冷殘害求告這名的，不是這人麼？並且他到這裡來，特要捆綁他們，帶到祭司長那裡。
english: And all those hearing him were full of wonder and said, Is not this the man who in Jerusalem was attacking all the worshippers of this name? and he had come here so that he might take them as prisoners before the chief priests.

chinese: 但掃羅越發有能力，駁倒住大馬色的猶太人，證明耶穌是基督。
english: But Saul went on increasing in power, and the Jews in Damascus were not able to give answers to the arguments by which he made it clear that Jesus was the Christ.

chinese: 過了好些日子，猶太人商議要殺掃羅，
english: Then, after some days, the Jews made an agreement together to put him to death:

chinese: 但他們的計謀被掃羅知道了。他們又晝夜在城門守候，要殺他。
english: But Saul got knowledge of their design. And they kept watch day and night on the roads out of the town, so that they might put him to death:

chinese: 他的門徒就在夜間用筐子把他從城牆上縋下去。
english: But his disciples took him by night and let him down from the wall in a basket.

chinese: 掃羅到了耶路撒冷，想與門徒結交，他們卻都怕他，不信他是門徒。
english: And when he came to Jerusalem, he made an attempt to be joined to the disciples, but they were all in fear of him, not taking him for a disciple.

chinese: 惟有巴拿巴接待他，領去見使徒，把他在路上怎麼看見主，主怎麼向他說話，他在大馬色怎麼奉耶穌的名放膽傳道，都述說出來。
english: But Barnabas took him to the Apostles and gave them an account of how he had seen the Lord on the road, and had given hearing to his words, and how at Damascus he had been preaching in the name of Jesus without fear.

chinese: 於是掃羅在耶路撒冷和門徒出入來往，
english: And he was with them, going in and out at Jerusalem,

chinese: 奉主的名放膽傳道，並與說希利尼話的猶太人講論辯駁；他們卻想法子要殺他。
english: Preaching in the name of the Lord without fear; and he had discussions with the Greek Jews; but they were working for his death.

chinese: 弟兄們知道了就送他下該撒利亞，打發他往大數去。
english: And when the brothers had knowledge of it, they took him to Caesarea and sent him to Tarsus.

chinese: 那時，猶太加利利、撒瑪利亞各處的教會都得平安，被建立；凡事敬畏主，蒙聖靈的安慰，人數就增多了。
english: And so the church through all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria had peace and was made strong; and, living in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, was increased greatly.

chinese: 彼得周流四方的時候，也到了居住呂大的聖徒那裡；
english: And it came about that while Peter was going through all parts of the country he came to the saints who were living at Lydda.

chinese: 遇見一個人，名叫以尼雅，得了癱瘓，在褥子上躺臥八年。
english: And there was a certain man there, named Aeneas, who for eight years had been in bed, without power of moving.

chinese: 彼得對他說：以尼雅，耶穌基督醫好你了；起來！收拾你的褥子。他就立刻起來了。
english: And Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ makes you well: get up and make your bed. And straight away he got up.

chinese: 凡住呂大和沙崙的人都看見了他，就歸服主。
english: And all those living in Lydda and Sharon saw him, and were turned to the Lord.

chinese: 在約帕有一個女徒，名叫大比大，繙希利尼話就是多加（就是羚羊的意思）；他廣行善事，多施賙濟。
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, that is, Dorcas: this woman was given to good works and acts of mercy at all times.

chinese: 當時，他患病而死，有人把他洗了，停在樓上。
english: And it came about, in those days, that she got ill and came to her death: and when she had been washed, they put her in a room which was high up.

chinese: 呂大原與約帕相近；門徒聽見彼得在那裡，就打發兩個人去見他，央求他說：快到我們那裡去，不要耽延。
english: And because Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, having knowledge that Peter was there, sent two men to him, requesting him to come to them straight away.

chinese: 彼得就起身和他們同去；到了，便有人領他上樓。眾寡婦都站在彼得旁邊哭，拿多加與他們同在時所做的裡衣外衣給他看。
english: And Peter went with them. And when he had come, they took him into the room: and all the widows were there, weeping and putting before him the coats and clothing which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

chinese: 彼得叫他們都出去，就跪下禱告，轉身對著死人說：大比大，起來！他就睜開眼睛，見了彼得，便坐起來。
english: But Peter made them all go outside, and went down on his knees in prayer; and turning to the body, he said, Tabitha, get up. And, opening her eyes, she saw Peter and got up.

chinese: 彼得伸手扶他起來，叫眾聖徒和寡婦進去，把多加活活的交給他們。
english: And he took her hand, lifting her up; and, sending for the saints and widows, he gave her to them, living.

chinese: 這事傳遍了約帕，就有許多人信了主。
english: And news of it went all through Joppa, and a number of people had faith in the Lord.

chinese: 此後，彼得在約帕一個硝皮匠西門的家裡住了多日。
english: And he was living in Joppa for some time with Simon, a leather-worker.

chinese: 在該撒利亞有一個人，名叫哥尼流，是義大利營的百夫長。
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, named Cornelius, the captain of the Italian band of the army;

chinese: 他是個虔誠人，他和全家都敬畏神，多多賙濟百姓，常常禱告神。
english: A serious-minded man, fearing God with all his family; he gave much money to the poor, and made prayer to God at all times.

chinese: 有一天，約在申初，他在異象中明明看見神的一個使者進去，到他那裡，說：哥尼流。
english: He saw in a vision, clearly, at about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of the Lord coming to him and saying to him, Cornelius!

chinese: 哥尼流定睛看他，驚怕說：主阿，甚麼事呢？天使說：你的禱告和你的賙濟達到神面前，已蒙記念了。
english: And he, looking on him in fear, said, What is it, Lord? And he said to him, Your prayers and your offerings have come up to God, and he has kept them in mind.

chinese: 現在你當打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來。
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get one Simon, named Peter,

chinese: 他住在海邊一個硝皮匠西門的家裡，房子在海邊上。
english: Who is living with Simon, a leather-worker, whose house is by the sea.

chinese: 向他說話的天使去後，哥尼流叫了兩個家人和常伺候他的一個虔誠兵來，
english: And when the angel who said these words to him had gone away, he sent for two of his house-servants, and a God-fearing man of the army, one of those who were waiting on him at all times;

chinese: 把這事都述說給他們聽，就打發他們往約帕去。
english: And having given them an account of everything, he sent them to Joppa.

chinese: 第二天，他們行路將近那城。彼得約在午正，上房頂去禱告，
english: Now the day after, when they were on their journey and were near the town, Peter went up to the top of the house for prayer, about the sixth hour:

chinese: 覺得餓了，想要吃。那家的人正預備飯的時候，彼得魂遊象外，
english: And he was in need of food: but while they were getting it ready, a deep sleep came on him;

chinese: 看見天開了，有一物降下，好像一塊大布，繫著四角，縋在地上，
english: And he saw the heavens opening, and a vessel coming down, like a great cloth let down on the earth,

chinese: 裡面有地上各樣四足的走獸和昆蟲，並天上的飛鳥；
english: In which were all sorts of beasts and birds.

chinese: 又有聲音向他說：彼得，起來，宰了吃！
english: And a voice came to him, saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.

chinese: 彼得卻說：主阿，這是不可的！凡俗物和不潔淨的物，我從來沒有吃過。
english: But Peter said, No, Lord; for I have never taken food which is common or unclean.

chinese: 第二次有聲音向他說：神所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。
english: And the voice came to him a second time, What God has made clean, do not you make common.

chinese: 這樣一連三次，那物隨即收回天上去了。
english: And this was done three times: and then the vessel was taken back into heaven.

chinese: 彼得心裡正在猜疑之間，不知所看見的異象是甚麼意思。哥尼流所差來的人已經訪問到西門的家，站在門外，
english: Now while Peter was in doubt as to the purpose of this vision, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made search for Simon's house, came to the door,

chinese: 喊著問：有稱呼彼得的西門住在這裡沒有？
english: To see if Simon, named Peter, was living there.

chinese: 彼得還思想那異象的時候，聖靈向他說：有三個人來找你。
english: And, while Peter was turning the vision over in his mind, the Spirit said to him, See, three men are looking for you.

chinese: 起來，下去，和他們同往，不要疑惑，因為是我差他們來的。
english: Go down, then, and go with them, doubting nothing, for I have sent them.

chinese: 於是彼得下去見那些人，說：我就是你們所找的人。你們來是為甚麼緣故？
english: And Peter went down to the men, and said, I am the man you are looking for: why have you come?

chinese: 他們說：百夫長哥尼流是個義人，敬畏神，為猶太通國所稱讚。他蒙一位聖天使指示，叫他請你到他家裡去，聽你的話。
english: And they said, Cornelius, a captain, an upright and God-fearing man, respected by all the nation of the Jews, had word from God by an angel to send for you to his house, and to give hearing to your words.

chinese: 彼得就請他們進去，住了一宿。次日，起身和他們同去，還有約帕的幾個弟兄同著他去；
english: So he took them in for the night. And the day after, he went with them, taking some of the brothers from Joppa with him.

chinese: 又次日，他們進入該撒利亞，哥尼流已經請了他的親屬密友等候他們。
english: And the day after that, they came to Caesarea. And Cornelius was waiting for them, having got together his relations and his near friends.

chinese: 彼得一進去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他腳前拜他。
english: And when Peter came in, Cornelius came to him and, falling down at his feet, gave him worship.

chinese: 彼得拉他，說：你起來，我也是人。
english: But Peter, lifting him up, said, Get up, for I am a man as you are.

chinese: 彼得和他說著話進去，見有好些人在那裡聚集，
english: And saying these words, he went in, and saw that a great number of people had come together;

chinese: 就對他們說：你們知道，猶太人和別國的人親近來往本是不合例的，但神已經指示我，無論甚麼人都不可看作俗而不潔淨的。
english: And he said to them, You yourselves have knowledge that it is against the law for a man who is a Jew to be in the company of one who is of another nation; but God has made it clear to me that no man may be named common or unclean:

chinese: 所以我被請的時候，就不推辭而來。現在請問：你們叫我來有甚麼意思呢？
english: And so I came without question, when I was sent for. What then is your purpose in sending for me?

chinese: 哥尼流說：前四天，這個時候，我在家中守著申初的禱告，忽然有一個人穿著光明的衣裳，站在我面前，
english: And Cornelius said, Four days from now I was in my house in prayer at the ninth hour; and I saw before me a man in shining clothing,

chinese: 說：哥尼流，你的禱告已蒙垂聽，你的賙濟達到神面前已蒙記念了。
english: Who said, Cornelius, your prayer has come to the ears of God, and your offerings are kept in his memory.

chinese: 你當打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來，他住在海邊一個硝皮匠西門的家裡。
english: Send, then, to Joppa, and get Simon, named Peter, to come to you; he is living in the house of Simon, a leather-worker, by the sea.

chinese: 所以我立時打發人去請你。你來了很好；現今我們都在神面前，要聽主所吩咐你的一切話。
english: So, straight away, I sent for you; and you have done well to come. And now, we are all present before God, ready to give attention to all the things which the Lord has given you to say.

chinese: 彼得就開口說：我真看出神是不偏待人。
english: Then Peter said, Truly, I see clearly that God is no respecter of persons:

chinese: 原來，各國中那敬畏主、行義的人都為主所悅納。
english: But in every nation, the man who has fear of him and does righteousness is pleasing to him.

chinese: 神藉著耶穌基督（他是萬有的主）傳和平的福音，將這道賜給以色列人。
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, giving the good news of peace through Jesus Christ (who is Lord of all)--

chinese: 這話在約翰宣傳洗禮以後，從加利利起，傳遍了猶太。
english: That word you yourselves have knowledge of, which was made public through all Judaea, starting from Galilee, after the baptism of which John was the preacher,

chinese: 神怎樣以聖靈和能力膏拿撒勒人耶穌，這都是你們知道的。他周流四方，行善事，醫好凡被魔鬼壓制的人，因為神與他同在。
english: About Jesus of Nazareth, how God gave the Holy Spirit to him, with power: and how he went about doing good and making well all who were troubled by evil spirits, for God was with him.

chinese: 他在猶太人之地，並耶路撒冷所行的一切事，有我們作見證。他們竟把他掛在木頭上殺了。
english: And we are witnesses of all the things which he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they put to death, hanging him on a tree.

chinese: 第三日，神叫他復活，顯現出來；
english: On the third day God gave him back to life, and let him be seen,

chinese: 不是顯現給眾人看，乃是顯現給神預先所揀選為他作見證的人看，就是我們這些在他從死裡復活以後和他同吃同喝的人。
english: Not by all the people, but by witnesses marked out before by God, even by us, who took food and drink with him after he came back from the dead.

chinese: 他吩咐我們傳道給眾人，證明他是神所立定的，要作審判活人、死人的主。
english: And he gave us orders to give news of this to the people, and to give public witness that this is he whom God has made judge of the living and the dead.

chinese: 眾先知也為他作見證說：凡信他的人必因他的名得蒙赦罪。
english: To him all the prophets give witness, that through his name everyone who has faith in him will have forgiveness of sins.

chinese: 彼得還說這話的時候，聖靈降在一切聽道的人身上。
english: While Peter was saying these words, the Holy Spirit came on all those who were hearing the word.

chinese: 那些奉割禮、和彼得同來的信徒，見聖靈的恩賜也澆在外邦人身上，就都希奇；
english: And the Jews of the faith, who had come with Peter, were full of wonder, because the Holy Spirit was given to the Gentiles,

chinese: 因聽見他們說方言，稱讚神為大。
english: And they were talking in tongues, and giving glory to God. Then Peter said,

chinese: 於是彼得說：這些人既受了聖靈，與我們一樣，誰能禁止用水給他們施洗呢？
english: Will any man say that these may not have baptism who have been given the Holy Spirit as we have?

chinese: 就吩咐奉耶穌基督的名給他們施洗。他們又請彼得住了幾天。
english: And he gave orders for them to have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they kept him with them for some days.

chinese: 使徒和在猶太的眾弟兄聽說外邦人也領受了神的道。
english: Now the Apostles and the brothers who were in Judaea had news that the word of God had been given to the Gentiles.

chinese: 及至彼得上了耶路撒冷，那些奉割禮的門徒和他爭辯說：
english: And when Peter came to Jerusalem, those who kept the rule of circumcision had an argument with him,

chinese: 你進入未受割禮之人的家和他們一同吃飯了。
english: Saying, You went to men without circumcision, and took food with them.

chinese: 彼得就開口把這事挨次給他們講解說：
english: But Peter gave them an account of it all in order, saying to them,

chinese: 我在約帕城裡禱告的時候，魂遊象外，看見異象，有一物降下，好像一塊大布，繫著四角，從天縋下，直來到我跟前。
english: I was in the town of Joppa, at prayer: and falling into a deep sleep, I saw in a vision a vessel like a great cloth let down from heaven, and it came down to me:

chinese: 我定睛觀看，見內中有地上四足的牲畜和野獸、昆蟲，並天上的飛鳥。
english: And looking on it with attention I saw in it all sorts of beasts and birds.

chinese: 我且聽見有聲音向我說：彼得，起來，宰了吃！
english: And a voice came to my ears saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.

chinese: 我說：主阿，這是不可的！凡俗而不潔淨的物從來沒有入過我的口。
english: But I said, No, Lord; for nothing common or unclean has ever come into my mouth.

chinese: 第二次，有聲音從天上說：神所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。
english: But the voice, coming a second time from heaven, said, What God has made clean, do not you make common.

chinese: 這樣一連三次，就都收回天上去了。
english: And this was done three times, and they were all taken up again into heaven.

chinese: 正當那時，有三個人站在我們所住的房門前，是從該撒利亞差來見我的。
english: And at that minute, three men, sent from Caesarea, came to the house where we were.

chinese: 聖靈吩咐我和他們同去，不要疑惑。（或作：不要分別等類）。同著我去的，還有這六位弟兄；我們都進了那人的家，
english: And the Spirit gave me orders to go with them, doubting nothing. And these six brothers came with me; and we went into that man's house:

chinese: 那人就告訴我們，他如何看見一位天使，站在他屋裡，說：你打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來；
english: And he gave us an account of how he had seen the angel in his house, saying, Send to Joppa, and get Simon, named Peter, to come to you;

chinese: 他有話告訴你，可以叫你和你的全家得救。
english: Who will say words to you through which you and all your family may get salvation.

chinese: 我一開講，聖靈便降在他們身上，正像當初降在我們身上一樣。
english: And, while I was talking to them, the Holy Spirit came on them, as on us at first.

chinese: 我就想起主的話說：約翰是用水施洗，但你們要受聖靈的洗。
english: And the words of the Lord came into my mind, how he said, The baptism of John was with water, but you will have baptism with the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 神既然給他們恩賜，像在我們信主耶穌基督的時候給了我們一樣；我是誰，能攔阻神呢！
english: If then God gave them, when they had faith in the Lord Jesus Christ, the same as he gave to us, who was I to go against God?

chinese: 眾人聽見這話，就不言語了，只歸榮耀與神，說：這樣看來，神也賜恩給外邦人，叫他們悔改得生命了。
english: And hearing these things they said nothing more, but gave glory to God, saying, Then to the Gentiles as to us has God given a change of heart, so that they may have life.

chinese: 那些因司提反的事遭患難四散的門徒直走到腓尼基和居比路，並安提阿；他們不向別人講道，只向猶太人講。
english: Then those who had gone away at the time of the trouble about Stephen, went as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus, preaching to the Jews only.

chinese: 但內中有居比路和古利奈人，他們到了安提阿也向希利尼人傳講主耶穌（有古卷作：也向說希利尼話的猶太人傳講主耶穌）。
english: But some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, when they came to Antioch, gave the good news about the Lord Jesus to the Greeks.

chinese: 主與他們同在，信而歸主的人就很多了。
english: And the power of the Lord was with them, and a great number had faith and were turned to the Lord.

chinese: 這風聲傳到耶路撒冷教會人的耳中，他們就打發巴拿巴出去，走到安提阿為止。
english: And news of them came to the ears of the church at Jerusalem: and they sent Barnabas as far as Antioch:

chinese: 他到了那裡，看見神所賜的恩就歡喜，勸勉眾人，立定心志，恆久靠主。
english: Who, when he came and saw the grace of God, was glad; and he made clear to them the need of keeping near the Lord with all the strength of their hearts:

chinese: 這巴拿巴原是個好人，被聖靈充滿，大有信心。於是有許多人歸服了主。
english: For he was a good man and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith: and a great number were joined to the Lord.

chinese: 他又往大數去找掃羅，
english: Then he went on to Tarsus, looking for Saul;

chinese: 找著了，就帶他到安提阿去。他們足有一年的工夫和教會一同聚集，教訓了許多人。門徒稱為基督徒是從安提阿起首。
english: And when he had come across him, he took him to Antioch. And they were with the church there for a year, teaching the people; and the disciples were first given the name of Christians in Antioch.

chinese: 當那些日子，有幾位先知從耶路撒冷下到安提阿。
english: Now in those days prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch.

chinese: 內中有一位，名叫亞迦布，站起來，藉著聖靈指明天下將有大饑荒。這事到革老丟年間果然有了。
english: And one of them, named Agabus, said publicly through the Spirit that there would be serious need of food all over the earth: which came about in the time of Claudius.

chinese: 於是門徒定意照各人的力量捐錢，送去供給住在猶太的弟兄。
english: And the disciples, everyone as he was able, made a decision to send help to the brothers living in Judaea:

chinese: 他們就這樣行，把捐項託巴拿巴和掃羅送到眾長老那裡。
english: Which they did, sending it to the rulers of the church by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.

chinese: 那時，希律王下手苦害教會中幾個人，
english: Now, about that time, Herod the king made cruel attacks on the Christians.

chinese: 用刀殺了約翰的哥哥雅各。
english: And he put James, the brother of John, to death with the sword.

chinese: 他見猶太人喜歡這事，又去捉拿彼得。那時正是除酵的日子。
english: And when he saw that this was pleasing to the Jews he went on to take Peter in addition. This was at the time of the feast of unleavened bread.

chinese: 希律拿了彼得，收在監裡，交付四班兵丁看守，每班四個人，意思要在逾越節後把他提出來，當著百姓辦他。
english: And having taken him, he put him in prison, with four bands of armed men to keep watch over him; his purpose being to take him out to the people after the Passover.

chinese: 於是彼得被囚在監裡；教會卻為他切切的禱告神。
english: So Peter was kept in prison: but the church made strong prayer to God for him.

chinese: 希律將要提他出來的前一夜，彼得被兩條鐵鍊鎖著，睡在兩個兵丁當中；看守的人也在門外看守。
english: And when Herod was about to take him out, the same night Peter was sleeping in chains between two armed men, and the watchmen were keeping watch before the door of the prison.

chinese: 忽然，有主的一個使者站在旁邊，屋裡有光照耀，天使拍彼得的肋旁，拍醒了他，說：快快起來！那鐵鍊就從他手上脫落下來。
english: And a great light was seen shining in the room, and an angel of the Lord came to Peter and, touching him on his side so that he came out of his sleep, said, Get up quickly. And his chains came off his hands.

chinese: 天使對他說：束上帶子，穿上鞋。他就那樣做。天使又說：披上外衣，跟著我來。
english: Then the angel said, Put on your shoes and get ready to go. And he did so. And he said, Put your coat round you and come with me.

chinese: 彼得就出來跟著他，不知道天使所做是真的，只當見了異象。
english: And he went out after him; and he was not certain if what was done by the angel was a fact, for it seemed to him that he was seeing a vision.

chinese: 過了第一層第二層監牢，就來到臨街的鐵門，那門自己開了。他們出來，走過一條街，天使便離開他去了。
english: And when they had gone past the first and second watchmen they came to the iron door into the town, which came open by itself: and they went out and down one street; and then the angel went away.

chinese: 彼得醒悟過來，說：我現在真知道主差遣他的使者，救我脫離希律的手和猶太百姓一切所盼望的。
english: And when Peter came to his senses he said, Now, truly, I am certain that the Lord has sent his angel and taken me out of the hands of Herod, against all the hopes of the Jews.

chinese: 想了一想，就往那稱呼馬可的約翰、他母親馬利亞家去，在那裡有好些人聚集禱告。
english: And when he became clear about this, he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John named Mark, where a number of them had come together for prayer.

chinese: 彼得敲外門，有一個使女，名叫羅大，出來探聽，
english: And he gave a blow on the door, and a young girl came to it, named Rhoda.

chinese: 聽得是彼得的聲音，就歡喜的顧不得開門，跑進去告訴眾人說：彼得站在門外。
english: And hearing the voice of Peter, in her joy she went running, without opening the door, to say that Peter was outside.

chinese: 他們說：你是瘋了！使女極力的說：真是他！他們說：必是他的天使！
english: And they said to her, You are off your head. But still she said, with decision, that it was so. And they said, It is his angel.

chinese: 彼得不住的敲門。他們開了門，看見他，就甚驚奇。
english: But Peter went on giving blows on the door: and when it was open and they saw him, they were full of wonder.

chinese: 彼得擺手，不要他們作聲，就告訴他們主怎樣領他出監；又說：你們把這事告訴雅各和眾弟兄。於是出去，往別處去了。
english: But he made a sign to them with his hand to be quiet, and gave them an account of how the Lord had taken him out of prison. And he said, Give the news to James and the brothers. And then he went away.

chinese: 到了天亮，兵丁擾亂得很，不知道彼得往那裡去了。
english: Now when it was day, the armed men were greatly troubled about what had become of Peter.

chinese: 希律找他，找不著，就審問看守的人，吩咐把他們拉去殺了。後來希律離開猶太，下該撒利亞去，住在那裡。
english: And Herod, when he sent for him, and he was not there, after questioning the watchmen, gave orders that they were to be put to death. Then he went down from Judaea to Caesarea for a time.

chinese: 希律惱怒推羅、西頓的人。他們那一帶地方是從王的地土得糧，因此就託了王的內侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心來求和。
english: Now he was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon: and they came to him, all together, and having made friends with Blastus, the controller of the king's house, they made a request for peace, because their country was dependent on the king's country for its food.

chinese: 希律在所定的日子，穿上朝服，坐在位上，對他們講論一番。
english: And on the day which had been fixed, Herod, dressed in his robes and seated in his place, made a public statement to them.

chinese: 百姓喊著說：這是神的聲音，不是人的聲音。
english: And the people, with loud cries, said, It is the voice of a god, not of a man.

chinese: 希律不歸榮耀給神，所以主的使者立刻罰他，他被蟲所咬，氣就絕了。
english: And straight away the angel of the Lord sent a disease on him, because he did not give the glory to God: and his flesh was wasted away by worms, and so he came to his end.

chinese: 神的道日見興旺，越發廣傳。
english: But the word of the Lord went on increasing.

chinese: 巴拿巴和掃羅辦完了他們供給的事，就從耶路撒冷回來，帶著稱呼馬可的約翰同去。
english: And Barnabas and Saul came back from Jerusalem, when their work was ended, taking with them John named Mark.

chinese: 在安提阿的教會中，有幾位先知和教師，就是巴拿巴和稱呼尼結的西面、古利奈人路求，與分封之王希律同養的馬念，並掃羅。
english: Now there were at Antioch, in the church there, prophets and teachers, Barnabas, and Symeon who was named Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, a relation of Herod the king, and Saul.

chinese: 他們事奉主、禁食的時候，聖靈說：要為我分派巴拿巴和掃羅，去做我召他們所做的工。
english: And while they were doing the Lord's work, and going without food, the Holy Spirit said, Let Barnabas and Saul be given to me for the special work for which they have been marked out by me.

chinese: 於是禁食禱告，按手在他們頭上，就打發他們去了。
english: Then, after prayer and going without food they put their hands on them, and sent them away.

chinese: 他們既被聖靈差遣，就下到西流基，從那裡坐船往居比路去。
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia; and from there they went by ship to Cyprus.

chinese: 到了撒拉米，就在猶太人各會堂裡傳講神的道，也有約翰作他們的幫手。
english: And at Salamis they were preaching the word of God in the Synagogues of the Jews: and John was with them, helping them.

chinese: 經過全島，直到帕弗，在那裡遇見一個有法術，假充先知的猶太人，名叫巴耶穌。
english: And when they had gone through all the island to Paphos, they came across a certain wonder-worker and false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar-Jesus;

chinese: 這人常和方伯士求保羅同在。士求保羅是個通達人，他請了巴拿巴和掃羅來，要聽神的道。
english: Who was with the ruler, Sergius Paulus, an able man. This man sent for Barnabas and Saul, desiring to have knowledge of the word of God.

chinese: 只是那行法術的以呂馬（這名翻出來就是行法術的意思）敵擋使徒，要叫方伯不信真道。
english: But Elymas, the wonder-worker (for that is the sense of his name), put himself against them, with the purpose of turning the ruler from the faith.

chinese: 掃羅又名保羅，被聖靈充滿，定睛看他，
english: But Saul, whose other name is Paul, being full of the Holy Spirit, looking hard at him, said,

chinese: 說：你這充滿各樣詭詐奸惡，魔鬼的兒子，眾善的仇敵，你混亂主的正道還不止住麼？
english: O you, who are full of false tricks and evil ways, a son of the Evil One, hating all righteousness, will you for ever be turning people from the right ways of the Lord?

chinese: 現在主的手加在你身上，你要瞎眼，暫且不見日光。他的眼睛立刻昏蒙黑暗，四下裡求人拉著手領他。
english: And now, see, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind and not able to see the sun for a time. And straight away a dark mist came down on him; and he went about looking for a guide.

chinese: 方伯看見所做的事，很希奇主的道，就信了。
english: Then the ruler, when he saw what was done, had faith, being full of wonder at the teaching of the Lord.

chinese: 保羅和他的同人從帕弗開船，來到旁非利亞的別加，約翰就離開他們，回耶路撒冷去。
english: Then Paul and those who were with him went by ship from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia: and there John went away from them and came back to Jerusalem.

chinese: 他們離了別加往前行，來到彼西底的安提阿，在安息日進會堂坐下。
english: But they, going through from Perga, came to Antioch in Pisidia; and they went into the Synagogue on the Sabbath and were seated.

chinese: 讀完了律法和先知的書，管會堂的，叫人過去，對他們說：二位兄台，若有甚麼勸勉眾人的話，請說。
english: And after the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the Synagogue sent to them, saying, Brothers, if you have a word of comfort for the people, say on.

chinese: 保羅就站起來，舉手，說：以色列人和一切敬畏神的人，請聽。
english: And Paul, getting up and making a sign with his hand, said, Men of Israel, and you who have the fear of God, give ear.

chinese: 這以色列民的神揀選了我們的祖宗，當民寄居埃及的時候抬舉他們，用大能的手領他們出來；
english: The God of this people Israel made selection of our fathers, lifting the people up from their low condition when they were living in the land of Egypt, and with a strong arm took them out of it.

chinese: 又在曠野容忍（或作：撫養）他們，約有四十年。
english: And for about forty years he put up with their ways in the waste land.

chinese: 既滅了迦南地七族的人，就把那地分給他們為業；
english: And having put to destruction seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them the land for their heritage for about four hundred and fifty years.

chinese: 此後給他們設立士師，約有四百五十年，直到先知撒母耳的時候。
english: And after these things he gave them judges, till the time of Samuel the prophet.

chinese: 後來他們求一個王，神就將便雅憫支派中基士的兒子掃羅，給他們作王四十年。
english: Then at their request for a king, God gave them Saul, the son of Kish, a man of the family of Benjamin, who was their king for forty years.

chinese: 既廢了掃羅，就選立大衛作他們的王，又為他作見證說：我尋得耶西的兒子大衛，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。
english: And having put him on one side, he made David their king, to whom he gave witness, saying, I have taken David, the son of Jesse, a man dear to my heart, who will do all my pleasure.

chinese: 從這人的後裔中，神已經照著所應許的，為以色列人立了一位救主，就是耶穌。
english: From this man's seed has God given to Israel a Saviour, even Jesus, as he gave his word;

chinese: 在他沒有出來以先，約翰向以色列眾民宣講悔改的洗禮。
english: For whose coming John made ready the way by preaching to all the people of Israel the baptism which goes with a change of heart.

chinese: 約翰將行盡他的程途說：你們以為我是誰？我不是基督；只是有一位在我以後來的，我解他腳上的鞋帶也是不配的。
english: And when John was completing his work, he said, What do I seem to you to be? I am not he; but one is coming after me, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo.

chinese: 弟兄們，亞伯拉罕的子孫和你們中間敬畏神的人哪，這救世的道是傳給我們的。
english: My brothers, children of the family of Abraham, and those among you who have the fear of God, to us the word of this salvation is sent.

chinese: 耶路撒冷居住的人和他們的官長，因為不認識基督，也不明白每安息日所讀眾先知的書，就把基督定了死罪，正應了先知的預言；
english: For the men of Jerusalem and their rulers, having no knowledge of him, or of the sayings of the prophets which come to their ears every Sabbath day, gave effect to them by judging him.

chinese: 雖然查不出他有當死的罪來，還是求彼拉多殺他；
english: And though no cause of death was seen in him, they made a request to Pilate that he might be put to death.

chinese: 既成就了經上指著他所記的一切話，就把他從木頭上取下來，放在墳墓裡。
english: And when they had done all the things said in the Writings about him, they took him down from the tree, and put him in the place of the dead.

chinese: 神卻叫他從死裡復活。
english: But God gave him back from the dead:

chinese: 那從加利利同他上耶路撒冷的人多日看見他，這些人如今在民間是他的見證。
english: And for a number of days he was seen by those who came with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now his witnesses before the people.

chinese: 我們也報好信息給你們，就是那應許祖宗的話，
english: And we are giving you the good news of the undertaking made to the fathers,

chinese: 神已經向我們這作兒女的應驗，叫耶穌復活了。正如詩篇第二篇上記著說：你是我的兒子，我今日生你。
english: Which God has now put into effect for our children, by sending Jesus; as it says in the second Psalm, You are my Son; this day I have given you being.

chinese: 論到神叫他從死裡復活，不再歸於朽壞，就這樣說：我必將所應許大衛那聖潔、可靠的恩典賜給你們。
english: And about his coming back from the dead, never again to go to destruction, he has said these words, I will give you the holy and certain mercies of David.

chinese: 又有一篇上說：你必不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
english: Because he says in another Psalm, You will not let your Holy One see destruction.

chinese: 大衛在世的時候遵行了神的旨意，就睡了（或作：大衛按神的旨意服事了他那一世的人，就睡了），歸到他祖宗那裡，已見朽壞；
english: Now David, having done God's work for his generation, went to sleep, and was put with his fathers, and his body came to destruction:

chinese: 惟獨神所復活的，他並未見朽壞。
english: But he, who was lifted up by God, did not see destruction.

chinese: 所以，弟兄們，你們當曉得：赦罪的道是由這人傳給你們的。
english: And so, let it be clear to you, my brothers, that through this man forgiveness of sins is offered to you:

chinese: 你們靠摩西的律法，在一切不得稱義的事上信靠這人，就都得稱義了。
english: And through him everyone who has faith is made free from all those things, from which the law of Moses was not able to make you free.

chinese: 所以，你們務要小心，免得先知書上所說的臨到你們。
english: So take care that these words of the prophets do not come true for you;

chinese: 主說：你們這輕慢的人要觀看，要驚奇，要滅亡；因為在你們的時候，我行一件事，雖有人告訴你們，你們總是不信。
english: See, you doubters, have wonder and come to your end; for I will do a thing in your days to which you will not give belief, even if it is made clear to you.

chinese: 他們出會堂的時候，眾人請他們到下安息日再講這話給他們聽。
english: And when they went out, they made a request that these words might be said to them again on the Sabbath after.

chinese: 散會以後，猶太人和敬虔進猶太教的人多有跟從保羅、巴拿巴的。二人對他們講道，勸他們務要恆久在神的恩中。
english: Now when the meeting was ended, a number of the Jews and of the God-fearing Gentiles who had become Jews, went after Paul and Barnabas: who put before them how important it was to keep on in the grace of God.

chinese: 到下安息日，合城的人幾乎都來聚集，要聽神的道。
english: And on the Sabbath after, almost all the town came together to give hearing to the word of God.

chinese: 但猶太人看見人這樣多，就滿心嫉妒，硬駁保羅所說的話，並且毀謗。
english: But when the Jews saw such a great number of people, they were full of envy and said evil words against Paul's preaching.

chinese: 保羅和巴拿巴放膽說：神的道先講給你們原是應當的；只因你們棄絕這道，斷定自己不配得永生，我們就轉向外邦人去。
english: Then Paul and Barnabas without fear said, It was necessary for the word of God to be given to you first; but because you will have nothing to do with it, and have no desire for eternal life, it will now be offered to the Gentiles.

chinese: 因為主曾這樣吩咐我們說：我已經立你作外邦人的光，叫你施行救恩，直到地極。
english: For so the Lord has given us orders, saying, I have given you for a light to the Gentiles so that you may be for salvation to the ends of the earth.

chinese: 外邦人聽見這話，就歡喜了，讚美神的道；凡預定得永生的人都信了。
english: And the Gentiles, hearing this, were glad and gave glory to the word of God: and those marked out by God for eternal life had faith.

chinese: 於是主的道傳遍了那一帶地方。
english: And the word of the Lord went through all the country.

chinese: 但猶太人挑唆虔敬、尊貴的婦女和城內有名望的人，逼迫保羅、巴拿巴，將他們趕出境外。
english: But the Jews, working up the feelings of the God-fearing women of high position and of the chief men of the town, got an attack started against Paul and Barnabas, driving them out of those parts.

chinese: 二人對著眾人跺下腳上的塵土，就往以哥念去了。
english: But they, shaking off the dust of that place from their feet, came to Iconium.

chinese: 門徒滿心喜樂，又被聖靈充滿。
english: And the disciples were full of joy and of the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 二人在以哥念同進猶太人的會堂，在那裡講的，叫猶太人和希利尼人信的很多。
english: Now in Iconium they went together to the Synagogue of the Jews and gave such teaching that a great number of Jews and Greeks had faith.

chinese: 但那不順從的猶太人聳動外邦人，叫他們心裡惱恨弟兄。
english: But those Jews who had not the faith, made the minds of the Gentiles bitter against the brothers.

chinese: 二人在那裡住了多日，倚靠主放膽講道；主藉他們的手施行神蹟奇事，證明他的恩道。
english: So they kept there for a long time, taking heart in the Lord, who gave witness to the word of his grace by causing signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

chinese: 城裡的眾人就分了黨，有附從猶太人的，有附從使徒的。
english: But there was a division among the people of the town; some were on the side of the Jews and some on the side of the Apostles.

chinese: 那時，外邦人和猶太人，並他們的官長，一齊擁上來，要凌辱使徒，用石頭打他們。
english: And when a violent attempt was made by the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, to make an attack on them and have them stoned,

chinese: 使徒知道了，就逃往呂高尼的路司得、特庇兩個城和周圍地方去，
english: Having got news of it, they went in flight to the towns of Lycaonia, Lystra, and Derbe, and the country round about:

chinese: 在那裡傳福音。
english: And went on preaching the good news there.

chinese: 路司得城裡坐著一個兩腳無力的人，生來是瘸腿的，從來沒有走過。
english: And at Lystra there was a certain man, who from birth had been without the use of his feet, never having had the power of walking.

chinese: 他聽保羅講道，保羅定睛看他，見他有信心，可得痊愈，
english: This man was giving ear to the preaching of Paul, who, looking at him, and seeing that he had faith to be made well,

chinese: 就大聲說：你起來，兩腳站直！那人就跳起來，而且行走。
english: Said in a loud voice, Get up on your feet. And, jumping up, he went walking about.

chinese: 眾人看見保羅所做的事，就用呂高尼的話大聲說：有神藉著人形降臨在我們中間了。
english: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they said in a loud voice, in the language of Lycaonia, The gods have come down to us in the form of men.

chinese: 於是稱巴拿巴為丟斯，稱保羅為希耳米，因為他說話領首。
english: And they gave the name of Jupiter to Barnabas, and to Paul that of Mercury, because he was the chief talker.

chinese: 有城外丟斯廟的祭司牽著牛，拿著花圈，來到門前，要同眾人向使徒獻祭。
english: And the priest of the image of Jupiter, which was before the town, took oxen and flowers to the doors of the town, and was about to make an offering with the people.

chinese: 巴拿巴、保羅二使徒聽見，就撕開衣裳，跳進眾人中間，喊著說：
english: But when this came to the ears of the Apostles, Paul and Barnabas, they went running out among the people, parting their clothing, and crying out,

chinese: 諸君，為甚麼做這事呢？我們也是人，性情和你們一樣。我們傳福音給你們，是叫你們離棄這些虛妄，歸向那創造天、地、海、和其中萬物的永生神。
english: Good people, why are you doing these things? We are men with the same feelings as you, and we give you the good news so that you may be turned away from these foolish things to the living God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all things in them:

chinese: 他在從前的世代，任憑萬國各行其道；
english: Who in the past let all nations go in the ways which seemed good to them.

chinese: 然而為自己未嘗不顯出證據來，就如常施恩惠，從天降雨，賞賜豐年，叫你們飲食飽足，滿心喜樂。
english: But he was not without witness, because he did good, and gave you rain from heaven and times of fruit, making your hearts full of food and joy.

chinese: 二人說了這些話，僅僅的攔住眾人不獻祭與他們。
english: And even with these words, it was hard for them to keep the people from making an offering to them.

chinese: 但有些猶太人從安提阿和以哥念來，挑唆眾人，就用石頭打保羅，以為他是死了，便拖到城外。
english: But some Jews came to that place from Antioch and Iconium, and got control over the people; and after stoning Paul, they had him pulled out of the town, taking him for dead.

chinese: 門徒正圍著他，他就起來，走進城去。第二天，同巴拿巴往特庇去，
english: But when the disciples came round him, he got up and went into the town: and the day after he went away with Barnabas to Derbe.

chinese: 對那城裡的人傳了福音，使好些人作門徒，就回路司得、以哥念、安提阿去，
english: And having made a number of disciples through the preaching of the good news in that town, they went back to Lystra and Iconium and Antioch,

chinese: 堅固門徒的心，勸他們恆守所信的道；又說：我們進入神的國，必須經歷許多艱難。
english: Making strong the souls of the disciples, saying to them that they were to keep the faith, and that we have to go through troubles of all sorts to come into the kingdom of God.

chinese: 二人在各教會中選立了長老，又禁食禱告，就把他們交託所信的主。
english: And when they had made selection of some to be rulers in every church, and had given themselves to prayer and kept themselves from food, they put them into the care of the Lord in whom they had faith.

chinese: 二人經過彼西底，來到旁非利亞。
english: And they went through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

chinese: 在別加講了道，就下亞大利去，
english: And, after preaching the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia;

chinese: 從那裡坐船，往安提阿去。當初，他們被眾人所託、蒙神之恩，要辦現在所做之工，就是在這地方。
english: And from there they went by ship to Antioch, where they had been handed over to the grace of God for the work which they had not done.

chinese: 到了那裡，聚集了會眾，就述說神藉他們所行的一切事，並神怎樣為外邦人開了信道的門。
english: And when they came there, and had got the church together, they gave them an account of all the things which God had done through them, and how he had made open a door of faith to the Gentiles.

chinese: 二人就在那裡同門徒住了多日。
english: And they were with the disciples there for a long time.

chinese: 有幾個人從猶太下來，教訓弟兄們說：你們若不按摩西的規條受割禮，不能得救。
english: Now certain men came down from Judaea, teaching the brothers and saying that without circumcision, after the rule of Moses, there is no salvation.

chinese: 保羅、巴拿巴與他們大大的分爭辯論；眾門徒就定規，叫保羅、巴拿巴和本會中幾個人，為所辯論的，上耶路撒冷去見使徒和長老。
english: And after Paul and Barnabas had had no little argument and discussion with them, the brothers made a decision to send Paul and Barnabas and certain others of them to the Apostles and the rulers of the church at Jerusalem about this question.

chinese: 於是教會送他們起行。他們經過腓尼基、撒瑪利亞，隨處傳說外邦人歸主的事，叫眾弟兄都甚歡喜。
english: So they, being sent on their way by the church, went through Phoenicia and Samaria, giving news of the salvation of the Gentiles, to the great joy of all the brothers.

chinese: 到了耶路撒冷，教會和使徒並長老都接待他們，他們就述說神同他們所行的一切事。
english: And when they came to Jerusalem, they had a meeting with the church and the Apostles and the rulers, and they gave an account of all the things which God had done through them.

chinese: 惟有幾個信徒、是法利賽教門的人，起來說：必須給外邦人行割禮，吩咐他們遵守摩西的律法。
english: But some of the Pharisees, who were of the faith, got up and said, It is necessary for these to have circumcision and to keep the law of Moses.

chinese: 使徒和長老聚會商議這事；
english: And the Apostles and the rulers of the church came together and gave thought to the question.

chinese: 辯論已經多了，彼得就起來，說：諸位弟兄，你們知道神早已在你們中間揀選了我，叫外邦人從我口中得聽福音之道，而且相信。
english: And when there had been much discussion, Peter got up and said to them, My brothers, you have knowledge that some time back it was God's pleasure that by my mouth the good news might be given to the Gentiles so that they might have faith.

chinese: 知道人心的神也為他們作了見證，賜聖靈給他們，正如給我們一樣；
english: And God, the searcher of hearts, was a witness to them, giving them the Holy Spirit even as he did to us;

chinese: 又藉著信潔淨了他們的心，並不分他們我們。
english: Making no division between them and us, but making clean their hearts by faith.

chinese: 現在為甚麼試探神，要把我們祖宗和我們所不能負的軛放在門徒的頸項上呢？
english: Why then are you testing God, by putting on the neck of the disciples a yoke so hard that not even our fathers or we were strong enough for it?

chinese: 我們得救乃是因主耶穌的恩，和他們一樣，這是我們所信的。
english: But we have faith that we will get salvation through the grace of the Lord Jesus in the same way as they.

chinese: 眾人都默默無聲，聽巴拿巴和保羅述說神藉他們在外邦人中所行的神蹟奇事。
english: And all the people were quiet while Barnabas and Paul gave an account of the signs and wonders which God had done among the Gentiles by them.

chinese: 他們住了聲，雅各就說：諸位弟兄，請聽我的話。
english: And when they had come to an end, James, answering, said, My brothers, give ear to me:

chinese: 方才西門述說神當初怎樣眷顧外邦人，從他們中間選取百姓歸於自己的名下；
english: Symeon has given an account of how God was first pleased to take from among the Gentiles a people for himself.

chinese: 眾先知的話也與這意思相合。
english: And this is in agreement with the words of the prophets, as it is said,

chinese: 正如經上所寫的：此後，我要回來，重新修造大衛倒塌的帳幕，把那破壞的重新修造建立起來，
english: After these things I will come back, and will put up the tent of David which has been broken down, building up again its broken parts and making it complete:

chinese: 叫餘剩的人，就是凡稱為我名下的外邦人，都尋求主。
english: So that the rest of men may make search for the Lord, and all the Gentiles on whom my name is named,

chinese: 這話是從創世以來，顯明這事的主說的。
english: Says the Lord, who has made these things clear from the earliest times.

chinese: 所以據我的意見，不可難為那歸服神的外邦人；
english: For this reason my decision is, that we do not put trouble in the way of those who from among the Gentiles are turned to God;

chinese: 只要寫信，吩咐他們禁戒偶像的污穢和姦淫，並勒死的牲畜和血。
english: But that we give them orders to keep themselves from things offered to false gods, and from the evil desires of the body, and from the flesh of animals put to death in ways against the law, and from blood.

chinese: 因為從古以來，摩西的書在各城有人傳講，每逢安息日，在會堂裡誦讀。
english: For Moses, from times long past, has his preachers in every town, reading his law in the Synagogues every Sabbath.

chinese: 那時，使徒和長老並全教會定意從他們中間揀選人，差他們和保羅、巴拿巴同往安提阿去；所揀選的就是稱呼巴撒巴的猶大和西拉。這兩個人在弟兄中是作首領的。
english: Then it seemed good to the Apostles and the rulers and all the church, to send men from among them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; Judas, named Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers:

chinese: 於是寫信交付他們，內中說：使徒和作長老的弟兄們問安提阿、敘利亞、基利家外邦眾弟兄的安。
english: And they sent a letter by them, saying, The Apostles and the older brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia, may joy be with you:

chinese: 我們聽說，有幾個人從我們這裡出去，用言語攪擾你們，惑亂你們的心。（有古卷在此有：你們必須受割禮，守摩西的律法。）其實我們並沒有吩咐他們。
english: Because we have knowledge that some who went from us have been troubling you with their words, putting your souls in doubt; to whom we gave no such order;

chinese: 所以，我們同心定意，揀選幾個人，差他們同我們所親愛的巴拿巴和保羅往你們那裡去。
english: It seemed good to us, having come to an agreement together, to send these men to you, with our well loved Barnabas and Paul,

chinese: 這二人是為我主耶穌基督的名不顧性命的。
english: Men who have given up their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 我們就差了猶大和西拉，他們也要親口訴說這些事。
english: And so we have sent Judas and Silas, who will say the same things to you themselves, by word of mouth.

chinese: 因為聖靈和我們定意不將別的重擔放在你們身上；惟有幾件事是不可少的，
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us, to put on you nothing more than these necessary things;

chinese: 就是禁戒祭偶像的物和血，並勒死的牲畜和姦淫。這幾件你們若能自己禁戒不犯就好了。願你們平安！
english: To keep from things offered to false gods, and from blood, and from things put to death in ways which are against the law, and from the evil desires of the body; if you keep yourselves from these, you will do well. May you be happy.

chinese: 他們既奉了差遣，就下安提阿去，聚集眾人，交付書信。
english: So they, being sent away, came down to Antioch, and having got the people together, they gave them the letter.

chinese: 眾人念了，因為信上安慰的話就歡喜了。
english: And after reading it, they were glad of its comfort.

chinese: 猶大和西拉也是先知，就用許多話勸勉弟兄，堅固他們。
english: And Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, gave teaching to the brothers and made them strong in the faith.

chinese: 住了些日子，弟兄們打發他們平平安安的回到差遣他們的人那裡去。（有古卷在此有：
english: And when they had been there for some time, they were sent back in peace by the brothers to those who had sent them.

chinese: 惟有西拉定意仍住在那裡。）
但保羅和巴拿巴仍住在安提阿，和許多別人一同教訓人，傳主的道。
english: But Paul and Barnabas kept on in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of God, with a number of others.

chinese: 過了些日子，保羅對巴拿巴說：我們可以回到從前宣傳主道的各城，看望弟兄們景況如何。
english: And after some days, Paul said to Barnabas, Let us go back and see the brothers in every town where we have given the word of God, and see how they are.

chinese: 巴拿巴有意要帶稱呼馬可的約翰同去；
english: And Barnabas had a desire to take with them John, named Mark.

chinese: 但保羅因為馬可從前在旁非利亞離開他們，不和他們同去做工，就以為不可帶他去。
english: But Paul was of the opinion that it was not right to take with them one who had gone away from them in Pamphylia, and had not gone on with the work.

chinese: 於是二人起了爭論，甚至彼此分開。巴拿巴帶著馬可，坐船往居比路去；
english: And there was a sharp argument between them, so that they were parted from one another, and Barnabas took Mark with him and went by ship to Cyprus;

chinese: 保羅揀選了西拉，也出去，蒙弟兄們把他交於主的恩中。
english: But Paul took Silas and went away with the blessing of the brothers.

chinese: 他就走遍敘利亞、基利家，堅固眾教會。
english: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, making the churches stronger in the faith.

chinese: 保羅來到特庇，又到路司得。在那裡有一個門徒，名叫提摩太，是信主之猶太婦人的兒子，他父親卻是希利尼人。
english: And he came to Derbe and Lystra: and there was a certain disciple there named Timothy, whose mother was one of the Jews of the faith, but his father was a Greek;

chinese: 路司得和以哥念的弟兄都稱讚他。
english: Of whom the brothers at Lystra and Iconium had a high opinion.

chinese: 保羅要帶他同去，只因那些地方的猶太人都知道他父親是希利尼人，就給他行了割禮。
english: Paul had a desire for him to go with him, and he gave him circumcision because of the Jews who were in those parts: for they all had knowledge that his father was a Greek.

chinese: 他們經過各城，把耶路撒冷使徒和長老所定的條規交給門徒遵守。
english: And on their way through the towns, they gave them the rules which had been made by the Apostles and the rulers of the church at Jerusalem, so that they might keep them.

chinese: 於是眾教會信心越發堅固，人數天天加增。
english: So the churches were made strong in the faith and were increased in number every day.

chinese: 聖靈既然禁止他們在亞西亞講道，他們就經過弗呂家、加拉太一帶地方。
english: And after they had gone through the land of Phrygia and Galatia, the Holy Spirit did not let them take the word into Asia;

chinese: 到了每西亞的邊界，他們想要往庇推尼去，耶穌的靈卻不許。
english: And having come to Mysia, they made an attempt to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus did not let them;

chinese: 他們就越過每西亞，下到特羅亞去。
english: And going past Mysia, they came down to Troas.

chinese: 在夜間有異象現與保羅。有一個馬其頓人站著求他說：請你過到馬其頓來幫助我們。
english: And Paul had a vision in the night; a man of Macedonia came, requesting him, and saying, Come over into Macedonia and give us help.

chinese: 保羅既看見這異象，我們隨即想要往馬其頓去，以為神召我們傳福音給那裡的人聽。
english: And when he had seen the vision, straight away we made the decision to go into Macedonia, for it seemed certain to us that God had sent us to give the good news to them.

chinese: 於是從特羅亞開船，一直行到撒摩特喇，第二天到了尼亞波利。
english: So, from Troas we went straight by ship to Samothrace and the day after to Neapolis;

chinese: 從那裡來到腓立比，就是馬其頓這一方的頭一個城，也是羅馬的駐防城。我們在這城裡住了幾天。
english: And from there to Philippi, which is the most important town of Macedonia and a Roman colony: and we were there for some days.

chinese: 當安息日，我們出城門，到了河邊，知道那裡有一個禱告的地方，我們就坐下對那聚會的婦女講道。
english: And on the Sabbath we went outside the town, by the river, where we had an idea that there would be a place of prayer; and, being seated, we had talk with the women who had come together.

chinese: 有一個賣紫色布疋的婦人，名叫呂底亞，是推雅推喇城的人，素來敬拜神。他聽見了，主就開導他的心，叫他留心聽保羅所講的話。
english: And a certain woman named Lydia, a trader in purple cloth of the town of Thyatira, and a God-fearing woman, gave ear to us: whose heart the Lord made open to give attention to the things which Paul was saying.

chinese: 他和他一家既領了洗，便求我們說：你們若以為我是真信主的（或作：你們若以為我是忠心事主的），請到我家裡來住。於是強留我們。
english: And when she and her family had had baptism, she made a request to us, saying, If it seems to you that I am true to the Lord, come into my house and be my guests. And she made us come.

chinese: 後來，我們往那禱告的地方去。有一個使女迎著面來，他被巫鬼所附，用法術，叫他主人們大得財利。
english: And when we were going to the place of prayer, we came across a girl with a spirit which gave knowledge of the future, whose masters made great profit from her power.

chinese: 他跟隨保羅和我們，喊著說：這些人是至高神的僕人，對你們傳說救人的道。
english: She came after Paul and us, crying out and saying, These men are the servants of the Most High God, who are giving you news of the way of salvation.

chinese: 他一連多日這樣喊叫，保羅就心中厭煩，轉身對那鬼說：我奉耶穌基督的名，吩咐你從他身上出來！那鬼當時就出來了。
english: And this she did on a number of days. But Paul was greatly troubled and, turning, said to the spirit, I give you orders in the name of Jesus Christ, to come out of her. And it came out that very hour.

chinese: 使女的主人們見得利的指望沒有了，便揪住保羅和西拉，拉他們到市上去見首領；
english: But when her masters saw that their hope of profit was gone, they took Paul and Silas, pulling them into the market-place before the rulers;

chinese: 又帶到官長面前說：這些人原是猶太人，竟騷擾我們的城，
english: And when they had taken them before the authorities, they said, These men, who are Jews, are greatly troubling our town;

chinese: 傳我們羅馬人所不可受不可行的規矩。
english: Teaching rules of living which it is not right for us to have or to keep, being Romans.

chinese: 眾人就一同起來攻擊他們。官長吩咐剝了他們的衣裳，用棍打；
english: And the people made an attack on them all together: and the authorities took their clothing off them, and gave orders for them to be whipped.

chinese: 打了許多棍，便將他們下在監裡，囑咐禁卒嚴緊看守。
english: And when they had given them a great number of blows, they put them in prison, giving orders to the keeper of the prison to keep them safely:

chinese: 禁卒領了這樣的命，就把他們下在內監裡，兩腳上了木狗。
english: And he, having such orders, put them into the inner prison with chains on their feet.

chinese: 約在半夜，保羅和西拉禱告，唱詩讚美神，眾囚犯也側耳而聽。
english: But about the middle of the night, Paul and Silas were making prayers and songs to God in the hearing of the prisoners;

chinese: 忽然，地大震動，甚至監牢的地基都搖動了，監門立刻全開，眾囚犯的鎖鍊也都鬆開了。
english: And suddenly there was an earth-shock, so that the base of the prison was moved: and all the doors came open, and everyone's chains came off.

chinese: 禁卒一醒，看見監門全開，以為囚犯已經逃走，就拔刀要自殺。
english: And the keeper, coming out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, took his sword and was about to put himself to death, fearing that the prisoners had got away.

chinese: 保羅大聲呼叫說：不要傷害自己！我們都在這裡。
english: But Paul said in a loud voice, Do yourself no damage, for we are all here.

chinese: 禁卒叫人拿燈來，就跳進去，戰戰兢兢的俯伏在保羅、西拉面前；
english: And he sent for lights and came rushing in and, shaking with fear, went down on his face before Paul and Silas,

chinese: 又領他們出來，說：二位先生，我當怎樣行才可以得救？
english: And took them out and said, Sirs, what have I to do to get salvation?

chinese: 他們說：當信主耶穌，你和你一家都必得救。
english: And they said, Have faith in the Lord Jesus, and you and your family will have salvation.

chinese: 他們就把主的道講給他和他全家的人聽。
english: And they gave the word of the Lord to him and to all who were in his house.

chinese: 當夜，就在那時候，禁卒把他們帶去，洗他們的傷；他和屬乎他的人立時都受了洗。
english: And that same hour of the night, he took them, and when he had given attention to their wounds, he and all his family had baptism straight away.

chinese: 於是禁卒領他們上自己家裡去，給他們擺上飯。他和全家，因為信了神，都很喜樂。
english: And he took them into his house and gave them food, and he was full of joy, having faith in God with all his family.

chinese: 到了天亮，官長打發差役來，說：釋放那兩個人罷。
english: But when it was day, the authorities sent the police, saying, Let these men go.

chinese: 禁卒就把這話告訴保羅說：官長打發人來叫釋放你們，如今可以出監，平平安安的去罷。
english: And the keeper said to Paul, The authorities have given orders to let you go: come out now, and go in peace.

chinese: 保羅卻說：我們是羅馬人，並沒有定罪，他們就在眾人面前打了我們，又把我們下在監裡，現在要私下攆我們出去麼？這是不行的。叫他們自己來領我們出去罷！
english: But Paul said to them, They have given us who are Romans a public whipping without judging us, and have put us in prison. Will they now send us out secretly? no, truly, let them come themselves and take us out.

chinese: 差役把這話回稟官長。官長聽見他們是羅馬人，就害怕了，
english: And the police gave an account of these words to the authorities, and they were full of fear on hearing that they were Romans;

chinese: 於是來勸他們，領他們出來，請他們離開那城。
english: Then they came and made prayers to them, requesting them, when they had taken them out, to go away from the town.

chinese: 二人出了監，往呂底亞家裡去；見了弟兄們，勸慰他們一番，就走了。
english: And they came out of the prison and went to the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brothers they gave them comfort and went away.

chinese: 保羅和西拉經過暗妃波里、亞波羅尼亞，來到帖撒羅尼迦，在那裡有猶太人的會堂。
english: Now when they had gone through Amphipolis and Apollonia they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Synagogue of the Jews:

chinese: 保羅照他素常的規矩進去，一連三個安息日，本著聖經與他們辯論，
english: And Paul, as he generally did, went in to them, and on three Sabbath days had discussions with them from the holy Writings,

chinese: 講解陳明基督必須受害，從死裡復活；又說：我所傳與你們的這位耶穌就是基督。
english: Saying to them clearly and openly that Christ had to be put to death and come back to life again; and that this Jesus, whom, he said, I am preaching to you, is the Christ.

chinese: 他們中間有些人聽了勸，就附從保羅和西拉，並有許多虔敬的希利尼人，尊貴的婦女也不少。
english: And some of them had faith, and were joined to Paul and Silas; and a number of the God-fearing Greeks, and some of the chief women.

chinese: 但那不信的猶太人心裡嫉妒，招聚了些市井匪類，搭夥成群，聳動合城的人闖進耶孫的家，要將保羅、西拉帶到百姓那裡。
english: But the Jews, being moved with envy, took with them certain low persons from among the common people, and getting together a great number of people, made an outcry in the town, attacking the house of Jason with the purpose of taking them out to the people.

chinese: 找不著他們，就把耶孫和幾個弟兄拉到地方官那裡，喊叫說：那攪亂天下的也到這裡來了，
english: And when they were not able to get them, they took Jason and some of the brothers by force before the rulers of the town, crying, These men, who have made trouble all over the world have now come here;

chinese: 耶孫收留他們。這些人都違背該撒的命令，說另有一個王耶穌。
english: Whom Jason has taken into his house: and they are acting against the orders of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus.

chinese: 眾人和地方官聽見這話，就驚慌了；
english: And hearing these things the people and the rulers of the town were troubled.

chinese: 於是取了耶孫和其餘之人的保狀，就釋放了他們。
english: And having made Jason and the others give an undertaking to keep the peace, they let them go.

chinese: 弟兄們隨即在夜間打發保羅和西拉往庇哩亞去。二人到了，就進入猶太人的會堂。
english: And the brothers straight away sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea: and they, when they came there, went to the Synagogue of the Jews.

chinese: 這地方的人賢於帖撒羅尼迦的人，甘心領受這道，天天考查聖經，要曉得這道是與不是。
english: Now these were more noble than the Jews of Thessalonica, for they gave serious attention to the word, searching in the holy Writings every day, to see if these things were so.

chinese: 所以他們中間多有相信的，又有希利尼尊貴的婦女，男子也不少。
english: And a number of them had faith, and no small number of the Greek women of high position and of the men.

chinese: 但帖撒羅尼迦的猶太人知道保羅又在庇哩亞傳神的道，也就往那裡去，聳動攪擾眾人。
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had news that Paul was preaching the word at Beroea, they came there, troubling the people and working them up.

chinese: 當時弟兄們便打發保羅往海邊去，西拉和提摩太仍住在庇哩亞。
english: So the brothers sent Paul straight away to the sea: but Silas and Timothy kept there still.

chinese: 送保羅的人帶他到了雅典，既領了保羅的命，叫西拉和提摩太速速到他這裡來，就回去了。
english: But those who went with Paul took him as far as Athens, and then went away, with orders from him to Silas and Timothy to come to him quickly.

chinese: 保羅在雅典等候他們的時候，看見滿城都是偶像，就心裡著急；
english: Now while Paul was waiting for them at Athens, his spirit was troubled, for he saw all the town full of images of the gods.

chinese: 於是在會堂裡與猶太人和虔敬的人，並每日在市上所遇見的人，辯論。
english: So he had discussions in the Synagogue with the Jews and God-fearing Gentiles, and every day in the market-place with those who were there.

chinese: 還有以彼古羅和斯多亞兩門的學士，與他爭論。有的說：這胡言亂語的要說甚麼？有的說：他似乎是傳說外邦鬼神的。這話是因保羅傳講耶穌與復活的道。
english: And some of those who were supporters of the theories of the Epicureans and the Stoics, had a meeting with him. And some said, What is this talker of foolish words saying? And others, He seems to be a preacher of strange gods: because he was preaching of Jesus and his coming back from the dead.

chinese: 他們就把他帶到亞略巴古，說：你所講的這新道，我們也可以知道麼？
english: And they took him to Mars' Hill, saying, Will you make clear to us what is this new teaching of yours?

chinese: 因為你有些奇怪的事傳到我們耳中，我們願意知道這些事是甚麼意思。
english: For you seem to us to say strange things, and we have a desire to get the sense of them.

chinese: （雅典人和住在那裡的客人都不顧別的事，只將新聞說說聽聽。）
english: (Now all the Athenians and the men from other lands who come there were giving all their time to talking or hearing of anything new.)

chinese: 保羅站在亞略巴古當中，說：眾位雅典人哪，我看你們凡事很敬畏鬼神。
english: And Paul got to his feet on Mars' Hill and said, O men of Athens, I see that you are overmuch given to fear of the gods.

chinese: 我遊行的時候，觀看你們所敬拜的，遇見一座壇，上面寫著未識之神。你們所不認識而敬拜的，我現在告訴你們。
english: For when I came by, I was looking at the things to which you give worship, and I saw an altar with this writing on it, TO THE GOD OF WHOM THERE IS NO KNOWLEDGE. Now, what you, without knowledge, give worship to, I make clear to you.

chinese: 創造宇宙和其中萬物的神，既是天地的主，就不住人手所造的殿，
english: The God who made the earth and everything in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, is not housed in buildings made with hands;

chinese: 也不用人手服事，好像缺少甚麼；自己倒將生命、氣息、萬物，賜給萬人。
english: And he is not dependent on the work of men's hands, as if he had need of anything, for he himself gives to all life and breath and all things;

chinese: 他從一本（有古卷作血脈）造出萬族的人，住在全地上，並且預先定準他們的年限和所住的疆界，
english: And he has made of one blood all the nations of men living on all the face of the earth, ordering their times and the limits of their lands,

chinese: 要叫他們尋求神，或者可以揣摩而得，其實他離我們各人不遠；
english: So that they might make search for God, in order, if possible, to get knowledge of him and make discovery of him, though he is not far from every one of us:

chinese: 我們生活、動作、存留，都在乎他。就如你們作詩的，有人說：我們也是他所生的。
english: For in him we have life and motion and existence; as certain of your verse writers have said, For we are his offspring.

chinese: 我們既是神所生的，就不當以為神的神性像人用手藝、心思所雕刻的金、銀、石。
english: If then we are the offspring of God, it is not right for us to have the idea that God is like gold or silver or stone, formed by the art or design of man.

chinese: 世人蒙昧無知的時候，神並不監察，如今卻吩咐各處的人都要悔改。
english: Those times when men had no knowledge were overlooked by God; but now he gives orders to all men in every place to undergo a change of heart:

chinese: 因為他已經定了日子，要藉著他所設立的人按公義審判天下，並且叫他從死裡復活，給萬人作可信的憑據。
english: Because a day has been fixed in which all the world will be judged in righteousness by the man who has been marked out by him for this work; of which he has given a sign to all men by giving him back from the dead.

chinese: 眾人聽見從死裡復活的話，就有譏誚他的；又有人說：我們再聽你講這個罷！
english: Now on hearing about the coming back from death, some of them made sport of it, but others said, Let us go more fully into this another time.

chinese: 於是保羅從他們當中出去了。
english: And so Paul went away from among them.

chinese: 但有幾個人貼近他，信了主，其中有亞略巴古的官丟尼修，並一個婦人，名叫大馬哩，還有別人一同信從。
english: But some men gave him their support: among whom was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

chinese: 這事以後，保羅離了雅典，來到哥林多。
english: After these things, he went away from Athens, and came to Corinth.

chinese: 遇見一個猶太人，名叫亞居拉，他生在本都；因為革老丟命猶太人都離開羅馬，新近帶著妻百基拉，從義大利來。保羅就投奔了他們。
english: And there he came across a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by birth, who not long before had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had given orders that all Jews were to go away from Rome: and he came to them;

chinese: 他們本是製造帳棚為業。保羅因與他們同業，就和他們同住做工。
english: And because he was of the same trade, he was living with them, and they did their work together; for by trade they were tent-makers.

chinese: 每逢安息日，保羅在會堂裡辯論，勸化猶太人和希利尼人。
english: And every Sabbath he had discussions in the Synagogue, turning Jews and Greeks to the faith.

chinese: 西拉和提摩太從馬其頓來的時候，保羅為道迫切，向猶太人證明耶穌是基督。
english: And when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was completely given up to the word, preaching to the Jews that the Christ was Jesus.

chinese: 他們既抗拒、毀謗，保羅就抖著衣裳，說：你們的罪（原文作血）歸到你們自己頭上，與我無干（原文是我卻乾淨）。從今以後，我要往外邦人那裡去。
english: And when they put themselves against him, and said evil words, he said, shaking his clothing, Your blood be on your heads, I am clean: from now I will go to the Gentiles.

chinese: 於是離開那裡，到了一個人的家中；這人名叫提多猶士都，是敬拜神的，他的家靠近會堂。
english: And moving from there, he went into the house of a man named Titus Justus, a God-fearing man, whose house was very near the Synagogue.

chinese: 管會堂的基利司布和全家都信了主，還有許多哥林多人聽了，就相信受洗。
english: And Crispus, the ruler of the Synagogue, with all his family, had faith in the Lord; and a great number of the people of Corinth, hearing the word, had faith and were given baptism.

chinese: 夜間，主在異象中對保羅說：不要怕，只管講，不要閉口，
english: And the Lord said to Paul in the night, in a vision, Have no fear and go on preaching:

chinese: 有我與你同在，必沒有人下手害你，因為在這城裡我有許多的百姓。
english: For I am with you, and no one will make an attack on you to do you damage: for I have a number of people in this town.

chinese: 保羅在那裡住了一年零六個月，將神的道教訓他們。
english: And he was there for a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

chinese: 到迦流作亞該亞方伯的時候，猶太人同心起來攻擊保羅，拉他到公堂，
english: But when Gallio was ruler of Achaia, all the Jews together made an attack on Paul, and took him to the judge's seat,

chinese: 說：這個人勸人不按著律法敬拜神。
english: Saying, This man is teaching the people to give worship to God in a way which is against the law.

chinese: 保羅剛要開口，迦流就對猶太人說：你們這些猶太人！如果是為冤枉或奸惡的事，我理當耐性聽你們。
english: But when Paul was about to say something, Gallio said to the Jews, If this was anything to do with wrongdoing or crime, there would be a reason for me to give you a hearing:

chinese: 但所爭論的，若是關乎言語、名目，和你們的律法，你們自己去辦罷！這樣的事我不願意審問；
english: But if it is a question of words or names or of your law, see to it yourselves; I will not be a judge of such things.

chinese: 就把他們攆出公堂。
english: And he sent them away from the judge's seat.

chinese: 眾人便揪住管會堂的所提尼，在堂前打他。這些事迦流都不管。
english: And they all made an attack on Sosthenes, the ruler of the Synagogue, and gave him blows before the judge's seat; but Gallio gave no attention to these things.

chinese: 保羅又住了多日，就辭別了弟兄，坐船往敘利亞去；百基拉、亞居拉和他同去。他因為許過願，就在堅革哩剪了頭髮。
english: And Paul, after waiting some days, went away from the brothers and went by ship to Syria, Priscilla and Aquila being with him; and he had had his hair cut off in Cenchrea, for he had taken an oath.

chinese: 到了以弗所，保羅就把他們留在那裡，自己進了會堂，和猶太人辯論。
english: And they came down to Ephesus and he left them there: and he himself went into the Synagogue and had a discussion with the Jews.

chinese: 眾人請他多住些日子，他卻不允，
english: And being requested by them to be there for a longer time, he said, No;

chinese: 就辭別他們，說：神若許我，我還要回到你們這裡；於是開船離了以弗所。
english: And went from them, saying, I will come back to you if God lets me; and he took ship from Ephesus.

chinese: 在該撒利亞下了船，就上耶路撒冷去問教會安，隨後下安提阿去。
english: And when he had come to land at Caesarea, he went to see the church, and then went down to Antioch.

chinese: 住了些日子，又離開那裡，挨次經過加拉太和弗呂家地方，堅固眾門徒。
english: And having been there for some time, he went through the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, making the disciples strong in the faith.

chinese: 有一個猶太人，名叫亞波羅，來到以弗所。他生在亞力山太，是有學問（或作：口才）的，最能講解聖經。
english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by birth, and a man of learning, came to Ephesus; and he had great knowledge of the holy Writings.

chinese: 這人已經在主的道上受了教訓，心裡火熱，將耶穌的事詳細講論教訓人；只是他單曉得約翰的洗禮。
english: This man had been trained in the way of the Lord; and burning in spirit, he gave himself up to teaching the facts about Jesus, though he had knowledge only of John's baptism:

chinese: 他在會堂裡放膽講道；百基拉，亞居拉聽見，就接他來，將神的道給他講解更加詳細。
english: And he was preaching in the Synagogue without fear. But Priscilla and Aquila, hearing his words, took him in, and gave him fuller teaching about the way of God.

chinese: 他想要往亞該亞去，弟兄們就勉勵他，並寫信請門徒接待他（或作：弟兄們就寫信勸門徒接待他）。他到了那裡，多幫助那蒙恩信主的人，
english: And when he had a desire to go over into Achaia, the brothers gave him help, and sent letters to the disciples requesting them to take him in among them: and when he had come, he gave much help to those who had faith through grace:

chinese: 在眾人面前極有能力駁倒猶太人，引聖經證明耶穌是基督。
english: For he overcame the Jews in public discussion, making clear from the holy Writings that the Christ was Jesus.

chinese: 亞波羅在哥林多的時候，保羅經過了上邊一帶地方，就來到以弗所；在那裡遇見幾個門徒，
english: And it came about that while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having gone through the higher country, came to Ephesus, where there were certain disciples:

chinese: 問他們說：你們信的時候受了聖靈沒有？他們回答說：沒有，也未曾聽見有聖靈賜下來。
english: And he said to them, Did you get the Holy Spirit when you had faith? And they said to him, No, we have had no knowledge of the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 保羅說：這樣，你們受的是甚麼洗呢？他們說：是約翰的洗。
english: And he said, What sort of baptism did you have? And they said, The baptism of John.

chinese: 保羅說：約翰所行的是悔改的洗，告訴百姓當信那在他以後要來的，就是耶穌。
english: And Paul said, John gave a baptism which goes with a change of heart, saying to the people that they were to have faith in him who was coming after him, that is, in Jesus.

chinese: 他們聽見這話，就奉主耶穌的名受洗。
english: And hearing this, they had baptism in the name of the Lord Jesus.

chinese: 保羅按手在他們頭上，聖靈便降在他們身上，他們就說方言，又說預言（或作：又講道）
english: And when Paul had put his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them; and they had the power of talking in tongues, and acting like prophets.

chinese: 一共約有十二個人。
english: And there were about twelve of these men.

chinese: 保羅進會堂，放膽講道，一連三個月，辯論神國的事，勸化眾人。
english: And he went into the Synagogue, and for three months he was preaching there without fear, reasoning and teaching about the kingdom of God.

chinese: 後來，有些人心裡剛硬不信，在眾人面前毀謗這道，保羅就離開他們，也叫門徒與他們分離，便在推喇奴的學房天天辯論。
english: But because some of the people were hard-hearted and would not give hearing, saying evil words about the Way before the people, he went away from them, and kept the disciples separate, reasoning every day in the school of Tyrannus.

chinese: 這樣有兩年之久，叫一切住在亞西亞的，無論是猶太人，是希利尼人，都聽見主的道。
english: And this went on for two years, so that all those who were living in Asia had knowledge of the word of the Lord, Greeks as well as Jews.

chinese: 神藉保羅的手行了些非常的奇事；
english: And God did special works of power by the hands of Paul:

chinese: 甚至有人從保羅身上拿手巾或圍裙放在病人身上，病就退了，惡鬼也出去了。
english: So that bits of linen and clothing from his body were taken to people who were ill, and their diseases went away from them and the evil spirits went out.

chinese: 那時，有幾個遊行各處、念咒趕鬼的猶太人，向那被惡鬼附的人擅自稱主耶穌的名，說：我奉保羅所傳的耶穌勒令你們出來！
english: But some of the Jews who went from place to place driving out evil spirits, took it on themselves to make use of the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had evil spirits, saying, I give you orders, by Jesus, whom Paul is preaching.

chinese: 做這事的，有猶太祭司長士基瓦的七個兒子。
english: And there were seven sons of a man named Sceva, a Jew and a chief priest, who did this.

chinese: 惡鬼回答他們說：耶穌我認識，保羅我也知道。你們卻是誰呢？
english: And the evil spirit, answering, said to them, I have knowledge of Jesus, and of Paul, but who are you?

chinese: 惡鬼所附的人就跳在他們身上，勝了其中二人，制伏他們，叫他們赤著身子受了傷，從那房子裡逃出去了。
english: And the man in whom the evil spirit was, jumping on them, was stronger than the two of them, and overcame them, so that they went running from that house, wounded and without their clothing.

chinese: 凡住在以弗所的，無論是猶太人，是希利尼人，都知道這事，也都懼怕；主耶穌的名從此就尊大了。
english: And this came to the ears of all those, Jews and Greeks, who were living at Ephesus; and fear came on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was made great.

chinese: 那已經信的，多有人來承認訴說自己所行的事。
english: And a number of those who had faith came and made a public statement of their sins and all their acts.

chinese: 平素行邪術的，也有許多人把書拿來，堆積在眾人面前焚燒。他們算計書價，便知道共合五萬塊錢。
english: And a great number of those who were experts in strange arts took their books and put them on the fire in front of everyone: and when the books were valued they came to fifty thousand bits of silver.

chinese: 主的道大大興旺，而且得勝，就是這樣。
english: So the word of the Lord was increased very greatly and was full of power.

chinese: 這些事完了，保羅心裡定意經過了馬其頓、亞該亞，就往耶路撒冷去；又說：我到了那裡以後，也必須往羅馬去看看。
