english: Now after these things were ended, Paul came to a decision that when he had gone through Macedonia and Achaia he would go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I have a desire to see Rome.

chinese: 於是從幫助他的人中打發提摩太、以拉都二人往馬其頓去，自己暫時等在亞西亞。
english: And having sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, into Macedonia, he himself went on living in Asia for a time.

chinese: 那時，因為這道起的擾亂不小。
english: And about that time a great outcry took place about the Way.

chinese: 有一個銀匠，名叫底米丟，是製造亞底米神銀龕的，他使這樣手藝人生意發達。
english: For there was a certain man named Demetrius, a silver-worker, who made silver boxes for the images of Diana, and gave no small profit to the workmen;

chinese: 他聚集他們和同行的工人，說：眾位，你們知道我們是倚靠這生意發財。
english: Whom he got together, with other workmen of the same trade, and said to them, Men, it is clear that from this business we get our wealth.

chinese: 這保羅不但在以弗所，也幾乎在亞西亞全地，引誘迷惑許多人，說：人手所做的，不是神。這是你們所看見所聽見的。
english: And you see, for it has come to your ears, that not only at Ephesus, but almost all through Asia, this Paul has been teaching numbers of people and turning them away, saying that those are not gods who are made by men's hands:

chinese: 這樣，不獨我們這事業被人藐視，就是大女神亞底米的廟也要被人輕忽，連亞西亞全地和普天下所敬拜的大女神之威榮也要消滅了。
english: And there is danger, not only that our trade may be damaged in the opinion of men, but that the holy place of the great goddess Diana may be no longer honoured, and that she to whom all Asia and the world give worship, will be put down from her high position.

chinese: 眾人聽見，就怒氣填胸，喊著說：大哉，以弗所人的亞底米阿！
english: And hearing this, they were very angry, crying out and saying, Great is Diana of Ephesus.

chinese: 滿城都轟動起來。眾人拿住與保羅同行的馬其頓人該猶和亞里達古，齊心擁進戲園裡去。
english: And the town was full of noise and trouble, and they all came running into the theatre, having taken by force Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia who were journeying in company with Paul.

chinese: 保羅想要進去，到百姓那裡，門徒卻不許他去。
english: And when Paul was about to go in to the people, the disciples did not let him.

chinese: 還有亞西亞幾位首領，是保羅的朋友，打發人來勸他，不要冒險到戲園裡去。
english: And some of the rulers of Asia, being his friends, sent to him, requesting him seriously not to put himself in danger by going into the theatre.

chinese: 聚集的人紛紛亂亂，有喊叫這個的，有喊叫那個的，大半不知道是為甚麼聚集。
english: And some said one thing, and some another: for there was no order in the meeting; and most of them had no idea why they had come together.

chinese: 有人把亞力山大從眾人中帶出來，猶太人推他往前，亞力山大就擺手，要向百姓分訴；
english: Then they took Alexander out from among the people, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander, making a sign with his hand, was about to make a statement to the people in answer:

chinese: 只因他們認出他是猶太人，就大家同聲喊著說：大哉！以弗所人的亞底米阿。如此約有兩小時。
english: But when they saw that he was a Jew, all of them with one voice went on crying out for about two hours, Great is Diana of Ephesus.

chinese: 那城裡的書記安撫了眾人，就說：以弗所人哪，誰不知道以弗所人的城是看守大亞底米的廟和從丟斯那裡落下來的像呢？
english: And when the chief secretary had got the people quiet, he said, Men of Ephesus, is any man without knowledge that the town of Ephesus is the keeper of the holy place of the great Diana, who was sent down from Jupiter?

chinese: 這事既是駁不倒的，你們就當安靜，不可造次。
english: So then, because these things may not be doubted, it would be better for you to be quiet, and do nothing unwise.

chinese: 你們把這些人帶來，他們並沒有偷竊廟中之物，也沒有謗讟我們的女神。
english: For you have taken these men, who are not doing damage to the holy place or talking against our goddess.

chinese: 若是底米丟和他同行的人有控告人的事，自有放告的日子（或作：自有公堂），也有方伯可以彼此對告。
english: If, then, Demetrius and the workmen who are with him have a protest to make against any man, the law is open to them, and there are judges; let them put up a cause at law against one another.

chinese: 你們若問別的事，就可以照常例聚集斷定。
english: But if any other business is in question, let it be taken up in the regular meeting.

chinese: 今日的擾亂本是無緣無故，我們難免被查問。論到這樣聚眾，我們也說不出所以然來。
english: For, truly, we are in danger of being made responsible for this day's trouble, there being no cause for it: and we are not able to give any reason for this coming together.

chinese: 說了這話，便叫眾人散去。
english: And when he had said this, he sent the meeting away.

chinese: 亂定之後，保羅請門徒來，勸勉他們，就辭別起行，往馬其頓去。
english: And after the noise had come to an end, Paul, having sent for the disciples and given them comfort, went away from them to Macedonia.

chinese: 走遍了那一帶地方，用許多話勸勉門徒。（或作：眾人），然後來到希臘。
english: And when he had gone through those parts and given them much teaching, he came into Greece.

chinese: 在那裡住了三個月，將要坐船往敘利亞去，猶太人設計要害他，他就定意從馬其頓回去。
english: And when he had been there three months, because the Jews had made a secret design against him when he was about to take ship for Syria, he made a decision to go back through Macedonia.

chinese: 同他到亞西亞去的，有庇哩亞人畢羅斯的兒子所巴特，帖撒羅尼迦人亞里達古和西公都，還有特庇人該猶，並提摩太，又有亞西亞人推基古和特羅非摩。
english: And Sopater of Beroea, the son of Pyrrhus, and Aristarchus and Secundus of Thessalonica, and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia, went with him as far as Asia.

chinese: 這些人先走，在特羅亞等候我們。
english: But these had gone before, and were waiting for us at Troas.

chinese: 過了除酵的日子，我們從腓立比開船，五天到了特羅亞，和他們相會，在那裡住了七天。
english: And we went away from Philippi by ship after the days of unleavened bread, and came to them at Troas in five days; and we were there for seven days.

chinese: 七日的第一日，我們聚會擘餅的時候，保羅因為要次日起行，就與他們講論，直講到半夜。
english: And on the first day of the week, when we had come together for the holy meal, Paul gave them a talk, for it was his purpose to go away on the day after; and he went on talking till after the middle of the night.

chinese: 我們聚會的那座樓上，有好些燈燭。
english: And there were a number of lights in the room where we had come together.

chinese: 有一個少年人，名叫猶推古，坐在窗臺上，困倦沉睡。保羅講了多時，少年人睡熟了，就從三層樓上掉下去；扶起他來，已經死了。
english: And a certain young man named Eutychus, who was seated in the window, went into a deep sleep; and while Paul went on talking, being overcome by sleep, he had a fall from the third floor, and was taken up dead.

chinese: 保羅下去，伏在他身上，抱著他，說：你們不要發慌，他的靈魂還在身上。
english: And Paul went down and, falling on him, took him in his arms and said, Do not be troubled, for his life is in him.

chinese: 保羅又上去，擘餅，吃了，談論許久，直到天亮，這才走了。
english: And when he had gone up, and had taken the broken bread, he went on talking to them for a long time, even till dawn, and then he went away.

chinese: 有人把那童子活活的領來，得的安慰不小。
english: And they took the boy in, living, and were greatly comforted.

chinese: 我們先上船，開往亞朔去，意思要在那裡接保羅；因為他是這樣安排的，他自己打算要步行。
english: But we, going before him by ship, went to Assos with the purpose of taking Paul in there: for so he had given orders, because he himself was coming by land.

chinese: 他既在亞朔與我們相會，我們就接他上船，來到米推利尼。
english: And when he came up with us at Assos, we took him in the ship and went on to Mitylene.

chinese: 從那裡開船，次日到了基阿的對面；又次日，在撒摩靠岸；又次日，來到米利都。
english: And going from there by sea, we came on the day after opposite Chios, and touching at Samos on the day after that, we came on the third day to Miletus.

chinese: 乃因保羅早已定意越過以弗所，免得在亞西亞耽延，他急忙前走，巴不得趕五旬節能到耶路撒冷。
english: For Paul's purpose was to go past Ephesus, so that he might not be kept in Asia; for he was going quickly, in order, if possible, to be at Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

chinese: 保羅從米利都打發人往以弗所去，請教會的長老來。
english: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus for the rulers of the church.

chinese: 他們來了，保羅就說：你們知道，自從我到亞西亞的日子以來，在你們中間始終為人如何，
english: And when they had come, he said to them, You yourselves have seen what my life has been like all the time from the day when I first came into Asia,

chinese: 服事主，凡事謙卑，眼中流淚，又因猶太人的謀害，經歷試煉。
english: Doing the Lord's work without pride, through all the sorrow and troubles which came on me because of the evil designs of the Jews:

chinese: 你們也知道，凡與你們有益的，我沒有一樣避諱不說的，或在眾人面前，或在各人家裡，我都教導你們；
english: And how I kept back nothing which might be of profit to you, teaching you publicly and privately,

chinese: 又對猶太人和希利尼人證明當向神悔改，信靠我主耶穌基督。
english: Preaching to Jews and to Greeks the need for a turning of the heart to God, and faith in the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 現在我往耶路撒冷去，心甚迫切（原文是心被捆綁），不知道在那裡要遇見甚麼事；
english: And now, as you see, I am going to Jerusalem, a prisoner in spirit, having no knowledge of what will come to me there:

chinese: 但知道聖靈在各城裡向我指證，說有捆鎖與患難等待我。
english: Only that the Holy Spirit makes clear to me in every town that prison and pains are waiting for me.

chinese: 我卻不以性命為念，也不看為寶貴，只要行完我的路程，成就我從主耶穌所領受的職事，證明神恩惠的福音。
english: But I put no value on my life, if only at the end of it I may see the work complete which was given to me by the Lord Jesus, to be a witness of the good news of the grace of God.

chinese: 我素常在你們中間來往，傳講神國的道；如今我曉得，你們以後都不得再見我的面了。
english: And now I am conscious that you, among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom, will not see my face again.

chinese: 所以我今日向你們證明，你們中間無論何人死亡，罪不在我身上（原文是我於眾人的血是潔淨的）。
english: And so I say to you this day that I am clean from the blood of all men.

chinese: 因為神的旨意，我並沒有一樣避諱不傳給你們的。
english: For I have not kept back from you anything of the purpose of God.

chinese: 聖靈立你們作全群的監督，你們就當為自己謹慎，也為全群謹慎，牧養神的教會，就是他用自己血所買來的（或作：救贖的）。
english: Give attention to yourselves, and to all the flock which the Holy Spirit has given into your care, to give food to the church of God, for which he gave his blood.

chinese: 我知道，我去之後必有兇暴的豺狼進入你們中間，不愛惜羊群。
english: I am conscious that after I am gone, evil wolves will come in among you, doing damage to the flock;

chinese: 就是你們中間，也必有人起來說悖謬的話，要引誘門徒跟從他們。
english: And from among yourselves will come men who will give wrong teaching, turning away the disciples after them.

chinese: 所以你們應當儆醒，記念我三年之久晝夜不住的流淚、勸戒你們各人。
english: So keep watch, having in mind that for three years without resting I was teaching every one of you, day and night, with weeping.

chinese: 如今我把你們交託神和他恩惠的道；這道能建立你們，叫你們和一切成聖的人同得基業。
english: And now, I give you into the care of God and the word of his grace, which is able to make you strong and to give you your heritage among all the saints.

chinese: 我未曾貪圖一個人的金、銀、衣服。
english: I have had no desire for any man's silver or gold or clothing.

chinese: 我這兩隻手常供給我和同人的需用，這是你們自己知道的。
english: You yourselves have seen that with these hands I got what was necessary for me and those who were with me.

chinese: 我凡事給你們作榜樣，叫你們知道應當這樣勞苦，扶助軟弱的人，又當記念主耶穌的話，說：施比受更為有福。
english: In all things I was an example to you of how, in your lives, you are to give help to the feeble, and keep in memory the words of the Lord Jesus, how he himself said, There is a greater blessing in giving than in getting.

chinese: 保羅說完了這話，就跪下同眾人禱告。
english: And having said these words, he went down on his knees in prayer with them all.

chinese: 眾人痛哭，抱著保羅的頸項，和他親嘴。
english: And they were all weeping, falling on Paul's neck and kissing him,

chinese: 叫他們最傷心的，就是他說：以後不能再見我的面那句話，於是送他上船去了。
english: Being sad most of all because he had said that they would not see his face again. And so they went with him to the ship.

chinese: 我們離別了眾人，就開船一直行到哥士。第二天到了羅底，從那裡到帕大喇，
english: And after parting from them, we put out to sea and came straight to Cos, and the day after to Rhodes, and from there to Patara:

chinese: 遇見一隻船要往腓尼基去，就上船起行。
english: And as there was a ship going to Phoenicia, we went in it.

chinese: 望見居比路，就從南邊行過，往敘利亞去，我們就在推羅上岸，因為船要在那裡卸貨。
english: And when we had come in view of Cyprus, going past it on our left, we went on to Syria, and came to land at Tyre: for there the goods which were in the ship had to be taken out.

chinese: 找著了門徒，就在那裡住了七天。他們被聖靈感動，對保羅說：不要上耶路撒冷去。
english: And meeting the disciples we were there for seven days: and they gave Paul orders through the Spirit not to go up to Jerusalem.

chinese: 過了這幾天，我們就起身前行。他們眾人同妻子兒女，送我們到城外，我們都跪在岸上禱告，彼此辭別。
english: And when these days came to an end, we went on our journey; and they all, with their wives and children, came with us on our way till we were out of the town: and after going on our knees in prayer by the sea,

chinese: 我們上了船，他們就回家去了。
english: We said our last words to one another, and got into the ship, and they went back to their houses.

chinese: 我們從推羅行盡了水路，來到多利買，就問那裡的弟兄安，和他們同住了一天。
english: And journeying by ship from Tyre we came to Ptolemais; and there we had talk with the brothers and were with them for one day.

chinese: 第二天，我們離開那裡，來到該撒利亞，就進了傳福音的腓利家裡，和他同住。他是那七個執事裡的一個。
english: And on the day after, we went away and came to Caesarea, where we were guests in the house of Philip, the preacher, who was one of the seven.

chinese: 他有四個女兒，都是處女，是說預言的。
english: And he had four daughters, virgins, who were prophets.

chinese: 我們在那裡多住了幾天，有一個先知，名叫亞迦布，從猶太下來，
english: And while we were waiting there for some days, a certain prophet, named Agabus, came down from Judaea.

chinese: 到了我們這裡，就拿保羅的腰帶捆上自己的手腳，說：聖靈說：猶太人在耶路撒冷，要如此捆綁這腰帶的主人，把他交在外邦人手裡。
english: And he came to us, and took the band of Paul's clothing, and putting it round his feet and hands, said, The Holy Spirit says these words, So will the Jews do to the man who is the owner of this band, and they will give him up into the hands of the Gentiles.

chinese: 我們和那本地的人聽見這話，都苦勸保羅不要上耶路撒冷去。
english: And hearing these things, we and those who were living in that place made request to him not to go to Jerusalem.

chinese: 保羅說：你們為甚麼這樣痛哭，使我心碎呢？我為主耶穌的名，不但被人捆綁，就是死在耶路撒冷也是願意的。
english: Then Paul said, What are you doing, weeping and wounding my heart? for I am ready, not only to be a prisoner, but to be put to death at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

chinese: 保羅既不聽勸，我們便住了口，只說：願主的旨意成就，便了。
english: And as he might not be moved we did no more, saying, Let the purpose of God be done.

chinese: 過了幾日，我們收拾行李上耶路撒冷去。
english: And after these days we got ready and went up to Jerusalem.

chinese: 有該撒利亞的幾個門徒和我們同去，帶我們到一個久為（久為：或作老）門徒的家裡，叫我們與他同住；他名叫拿孫，是居比路人。
english: And some of the disciples from Caesarea went with us, taking a certain Mnason of Cyprus, one of the early disciples, in whose house we were to be living.

chinese: 到了耶路撒冷，弟兄們歡歡喜喜的接待我們。
english: And when we came to Jerusalem, the brothers were pleased to see us.

chinese: 第二天，保羅同我們去見雅各；長老們也都在那裡。
english: And on the day after, Paul went with us to James, and all the rulers of the church were present.

chinese: 保羅問了他們安，便將神用他傳教，在外邦人中間所行之事，一一的述說了。
english: And when he had said how glad he was to see them, he gave them a detailed account of the things which God had done through his work among the Gentiles.

chinese: 他們聽見，就歸榮耀與神，對保羅說：兄台，你看猶太人中信主的有多少萬，並且都為律法熱心。
english: And hearing it, they gave praise to God; and they said to him, You see, brother, what thousands there are among the Jews, who have the faith; and they all have a great respect for the law:

chinese: 他們聽見人說：你教訓一切在外邦的猶太人離棄摩西，對他們說：不要給孩子行割禮，也不要遵行條規。
english: And they have had news of you, how you have been teaching all the Jews among the Gentiles to give up the law of Moses, and not to give circumcision to their children, and not to keep the old rules.

chinese: 眾人必聽見你來了，這可怎麼辦呢？
english: What then is the position? They will certainly get news that you have come.

chinese: 你就照著我們的話行罷？我們這裡有四個人，都有願在身。
english: Do this, then, which we say to you: We have four men who have taken an oath;

chinese: 你帶他們去，與他們一同行潔淨的禮，替他們拿出規費，叫他們得以剃頭。這樣，眾人就可知道，先前所聽見你的事都是虛的；並可知道，你自己為人，循規蹈矩，遵行律法。
english: Go with these, and make yourself clean with them, and make the necessary payments for them, so that they may be free from their oath: and everyone will see that the statements made about you are not true, but that you put yourself under rule, and keep the law.

chinese: 至於信主的外邦人，我們已經寫信擬定，叫他們謹忌那祭偶像之物，和血，並勒死的牲畜，與姦淫。
english: But as to the Gentiles who have the faith, we sent a letter, giving our decision that they were to keep themselves from offerings made to false gods, and from blood, and from the flesh of animals put to death in ways against the law, and from the evil desires of the body.

chinese: 於是保羅帶著那四個人，第二天與他們一同行了潔淨的禮，進了殿，報明潔淨的日期滿足，只等祭司為他們各人獻祭。
english: Then Paul took the men, and on the day after, making himself clean with them, he went into the Temple, giving out the statement that the days necessary for making them clean were complete, till the offering was made for every one of them.

chinese: 那七日將完，從亞西亞來的猶太人看見保羅在殿裡，就聳動了眾人，下手拿他，
english: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews from Asia, seeing him in the Temple, got the people together and put their hands on him,

chinese: 喊叫說：以色列人來幫助，這就是在各處教訓眾人蹧踐我們百姓和律法，並這地方的。他又帶著希利尼人進殿，污穢了這聖地。
english: Crying out, Men of Israel, come to our help: this is the man who is teaching all men everywhere against the people and the law and this place: and in addition, he has taken Greeks into the Temple, and made this holy place unclean.

chinese: 這話是因他們曾看見以弗所人特羅非摩同保羅在城裡，以為保羅帶他
english: For they had seen him before in the town with Trophimus of Ephesus, and had the idea that Paul had taken him with him into the Temple.

chinese: 合城都震動，百姓一齊跑來，拿住保羅，拉他出殿，殿門立刻都關了。
english: And all the town was moved, and the people came running together and put their hands on Paul, pulling him out of the Temple: and then the doors were shut.

chinese: 他們正想要殺他，有人報信給營裡的千夫長說：耶路撒冷合城都亂了。
english: And while they were attempting to put him to death, news came to the chief captain of the band that all Jerusalem was out of control.

chinese: 千夫長立時帶著兵丁和幾個百夫長，跑下去到他們那裡。他們見了千夫長和兵丁，就止住不打保羅。
english: And straight away he took some armed men and went quickly down to them: and the Jews, seeing them, gave no more blows to Paul.

chinese: 於是千夫長上前拿住他，吩咐用兩條鐵鍊捆鎖；又問他是甚麼人，做的是甚麼事。
english: Then the chief captain came near and took him, and gave orders for him to be put in chains, questioning them as to who he was and what he had done.

chinese: 眾人有喊叫這個的，有喊叫那個的；千夫長因為這樣亂嚷，得不著實情，就吩咐人將保羅帶進營樓去。
english: And some said one thing and some another, among the people: and as he was not able to get a knowledge of the facts because of the noise, he gave orders for Paul to be taken into the army building.

chinese: 到了臺階上，眾人擠得兇猛，兵丁只得將保羅抬起來。
english: And when he came on to the steps, he was lifted up by the armed men, because of the force of the people;

chinese: 眾人跟在後面，喊著說：除掉他！
english: For a great mass of people came after them, crying out, Away with him!

chinese: 將要帶他進營樓，保羅對千夫長說：我對你說句話可以不可以？他說：你懂得希利尼話麼？
english: And when Paul was about to be taken into the building, he said to the chief captain, May I say something to you? And he said, Have you a knowledge of Greek?

chinese: 你莫非是從前作亂、帶領四千兇徒往曠野去的那埃及人麼？
english: Are you by chance the Egyptian who, before this, got the people worked up against the government and took four thousand men of the Assassins out into the waste land?

chinese: 保羅說：我本是猶太人，生在基利家的大數，並不是無名小城的人。求你准我對百姓說話。
english: But Paul said, I am a Jew of Tarsus in Cilicia, which is not an unimportant town: I make a request to you to let me say a word to the people.

chinese: 千夫長准了。保羅就站在臺階上，向百姓擺手，他們都靜默無聲，保羅便用希伯來話對他們說：
english: And when he let him do so, Paul, from the steps, made a sign with his hand to the people, and when they were all quiet, he said to them in the Hebrew language,

chinese: 諸位父兄請聽，我現在對你們分訴。
english: My brothers and fathers, give ear to the story of my life which I now put before you.

chinese: 眾人聽他說的是希伯來話，就更加安靜了。
english: And, hearing him talking in the Hebrew language, they became the more quiet, and he said,

chinese: 保羅說：我原是猶太人，生在基利家的大數，長在這城裡，在迦瑪列門下，按著我們祖宗嚴緊的律法受教，熱心事奉神，像你們眾人今日一樣。
english: I am a Jew of Tarsus in Cilicia by birth, but I had my education in this town at the feet of Gamaliel, being trained in the keeping of every detail of the law of our fathers; given up to the cause of God with all my heart, as you are today.

chinese: 我也曾逼迫奉這道的人，直到死地，無論男女都鎖拿下監。
english: And I made attacks on this Way, even to death, taking men and women and putting them in prison.

chinese: 這是大祭司和眾長老都可以給我作見證的。我又領了他們達與弟兄的書信，往大馬色去，要把在那裡奉這道的人鎖拿，帶到耶路撒冷受刑。
english: Of which the high priest will be a witness, and all the rulers, from whom I had letters to the brothers; and I went into Damascus, to take those who were there as prisoners to Jerusalem for punishment.

chinese: 我將到大馬色，正走的時候，約在晌午，忽然從天上發大光，四面照著我。
english: And it came about that while I was on my journey, coming near to Damascus, about the middle of the day, suddenly I saw a great light from heaven shining round me.

chinese: 我就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對我說：掃羅！掃羅！你為甚麼逼迫我？
english: And when I went down on the earth, a voice came to my ears saying to me, Saul, Saul, why are you attacking me so cruelly?

chinese: 我回答說：主阿，你是誰？他說：我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶穌。
english: And I, answering, said, Who are you; Lord? And he said to me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are attacking.

chinese: 與我同行的人看見了那光，卻沒有聽明那位對我說話的聲音。
english: And those who were with me saw the light, but the voice of him who was talking to me came not to their ears.

chinese: 我說：主阿，我當做甚麼？主說：起來，進大馬色去，在那裡，要將所派你做的一切事告訴你。
english: And I said, What have I to do, Lord? And the Lord said to me, Get up, and go into Damascus; and it will be made clear to you what you have to do.

chinese: 我因那光的榮耀不能看見，同行的人就拉著我手進了大馬色。
english: And because I was unable to see because of the glory of that light, those who were with me took me by the hand, and so I came to Damascus.

chinese: 那裡有一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，按著律法是虔誠人，為一切住在那裡的猶太人所稱讚。
english: And one Ananias, a God-fearing man, who kept the law, and of whom all the Jews in that place had a high opinion,

chinese: 他來見我，站在旁邊，對我說：兄弟掃羅，你可以看見。我當時往上一看，就看見了他。
english: Came to my side and said, Brother Saul, let your eyes be open. And in that very hour I was able to see him.

chinese: 他又說：我們祖宗的神揀選了你，叫你明白他的旨意，又得見那義者，聽他口中所出的聲音。
english: And he said, You have been marked out by the God of our fathers to have knowledge of his purpose, and to see the Upright One and to give ear to the words of his mouth.

chinese: 因為你要將所看見的，所聽見的，對著萬人為他作見證。
english: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and of what has come to your ears.

chinese: 現在你為甚麼耽延呢？起來，求告他的名受洗，洗去你的罪。
english: And now, why are you waiting? get up, and have baptism, for the washing away of your sins, giving worship to his name.

chinese: 後來，我回到耶路撒冷，在殿裡禱告的時候，魂遊象外，
english: And it came about that when I had come back to Jerusalem, while I was at prayer in the Temple, my senses became more than naturally clear,

chinese: 看見主向我說：你趕緊的離開耶路撒冷，不可遲延；因你為我作的見證，這裡的人必不領受。
english: And I saw him saying to me, Go out of Jerusalem straight away because they will not give hearing to your witness about me.

chinese: 我就說：主阿，他們知道我從前把信你的人收在監裡，又在各會堂裡鞭打他們。
english: And I said, Lord, they themselves have knowledge that I went through the Synagogues putting in prison and whipping all those who had faith in you:

chinese: 並且你的見證人司提反被害流血的時候，我也站在旁邊歡喜；又看守害死他之人的衣裳。
english: And when Stephen your witness was put to death, I was there, giving approval, and looking after the clothing of those who put him to death.

chinese: 主向我說：你去罷！我要差你遠遠的往外邦人那裡去。
english: And he said to me, Go, for I will send you far away to the Gentiles.

chinese: 眾人聽他說到這句話，就高聲說：這樣的人，從世上除掉他罷！他是不當活著的。
english: And they gave him a hearing as far as this word; then with loud voices they said, Away with this man from the earth; it is not right for him to be living.

chinese: 眾人喧嚷，摔掉衣裳，把塵土向空中揚起來。
english: And while they were crying out, and pulling off their clothing, and sending dust into the air,

chinese: 千夫長就吩咐將保羅帶進營樓去，叫人用鞭子拷問他，要知道他們向他這樣喧嚷是為甚麼緣故。
english: The chief captain gave orders for him to be taken into the army building, saying that he would put him to the test by whipping, so that he might have knowledge of the reason why they were crying out so violently against him.

chinese: 剛用皮條捆上，保羅對旁邊站著的百夫長說：人是羅馬人，又沒有定罪，你們就鞭打他，有這個例麼？
english: And when they had put leather bands round him, Paul said to the captain who was present, Is it the law for you to give blows to a man who is a Roman and has not been judged?

chinese: 百夫長聽見這話，就去見千夫長，告訴他說：你要做甚麼？這人是羅馬人。
english: And hearing this, the man went to the chief captain and gave him an account of it, saying, What are you about to do? for this man is a Roman.

chinese: 千夫長就來問保羅說：你告訴我，你是羅馬人麼？保羅說：是。
english: And the chief captain came to him and said, Give me an answer, are you a Roman? And he said, Yes.

chinese: 千夫長說：我用許多銀子才入了羅馬的民籍。保羅說：我生來就是。
english: And the chief captain said, I got Roman rights for myself at a great price. And Paul said, But I had them by birth.

chinese: 於是那些要拷問保羅的人就離開他去了。千夫長既知道他是羅馬人，又因為捆綁了他，也害怕了。
english: Then those who were about to put him to the test went away: and the chief captain was in fear, seeing that he was a Roman, and that he had put chains on him.

chinese: 第二天，千夫長為要知道猶太人控告保羅的實情，便解開他，吩咐祭司長和全公會的人都聚集，將保羅帶下來，叫他站在他們面前。
english: But on the day after, desiring to have certain knowledge of what the Jews had to say against him, he made him free, and gave orders for the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin to come together, and he took Paul and put him before them.

chinese: 保羅定睛看著公會的人，說：弟兄們，我在神面前行事為人都是憑著良心，直到今日。
english: And Paul, looking fixedly at the Sanhedrin, said, My brothers, my life has been upright before God till this day.

chinese: 大祭司亞拿尼亞就吩咐旁邊站著的人打他的嘴。
english: And the high priest, Ananias, gave orders to those who were near him to give him a blow on the mouth.

chinese: 保羅對他說：你這粉飾的牆，神要打你！你坐堂為的是按律法審問我，你竟違背律法，吩咐人打我麼？
english: Then Paul said to him, God will give blows to you, you whitewashed wall: are you here to be my judge by law, and by your orders am I given blows against the law?

chinese: 站在旁邊的人說：你辱罵神的大祭司麼？
english: And those who were near said, Do you say such words against God's high priest?

chinese: 保羅說：弟兄們，我不曉得他是大祭司；經上記著說：不可毀謗你百姓的官長。
english: And Paul said, Brother, I had no idea that he was the high priest: for it has been said, You may not say evil about the ruler of your people.

chinese: 保羅看出大眾一半是撒都該人，一半是法利賽人，就在公會中大聲說：弟兄們，我是法利賽人，也是法利賽人的子孫。我現在受審問，是為盼望死人復活。
english: But when Paul saw that half of them were Sadducees and the rest Pharisees, he said in the Sanhedrin, Brothers, I am a Pharisee, and the son of Pharisees: I am here to be judged on the question of the hope of the coming back from the dead.

chinese: 說了這話，法利賽人和撒都該人就爭論起來，會眾分為兩黨。
english: And when he had said this, there was an argument between the Pharisees and the Sadducees, and a division in the meeting.

chinese: 因為撒都該人說，沒有復活，也沒有天使和鬼魂；法利賽人卻說，兩樣都有。
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no coming back from the dead, and no angels or spirits: but the Pharisees have belief in all these.

chinese: 於是大大的喧嚷起來。有幾個法利賽黨的文士站起來爭辯說：我們看不出這人有甚麼惡處，倘若有鬼魂或是天使對他說過話，怎麼樣呢？
english: And there was a great outcry: and some of the scribes on the side of the Pharisees got up and took part in the discussion, saying, We see no evil in this man: what if he has had a revelation from an angel or a spirit?

chinese: 那時大起爭吵，千夫長恐怕保羅被他們扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他從眾人當中搶出來，帶進營樓去。
english: And when the argument became very violent, the chief captain, fearing that Paul would be pulled in two by them, gave orders to the armed men to take him by force from among them, and take him into the army building.

chinese: 當夜，主站在保羅旁邊，說：放心罷！你怎樣在耶路撒冷為我作見證，也必怎樣在羅馬為我作見證。
english: And the night after, the Lord came to his side and said, Be of good heart, for as you have been witnessing for me in Jerusalem, so will you be my witness in Rome.

chinese: 到了天亮，猶太人同謀起誓，說：若不先殺保羅就不吃不喝。
english: And when it was day, the Jews came together and put themselves under an oath that they would take no food or drink till they had put Paul to death.

chinese: 這樣同心起誓的有四十多人。
english: And more than forty of them took this oath.

chinese: 他們來見祭司長和長老，說：我們已經起了一個大誓，若不先殺保羅就不吃甚麼。
english: And they came to the chief priests and the rulers and said, We have taken a great oath to take no food till we have put Paul to death

chinese: 現在你們和公會要知會千夫長，叫他帶下保羅到你們這裡來，假作要詳細察考他的事；我們已經預備好了，不等他來到跟前就殺他。
english: So now, will you and the Sanhedrin make a request to the military authorities to have him sent down to you, as if you were desiring to go into the business in greater detail; and we, before ever he gets to you, will be waiting to put him to death.

chinese: 保羅的外甥聽見他們設下埋伏，就來到營樓裡告訴保羅。
english: But Paul's sister's son had word of their design, and he came into the army building and gave news of it to Paul.

chinese: 保羅請一個百夫長來，說：你領這少年人去見千夫長，他有事告訴他。
english: And Paul sent for a captain and said, Take this young man to your chief, for he has news for him.

chinese: 於是把他領去見千夫長，說：被囚的保羅請我到他那裡，求我領這少年人來見你；他有事告訴你。
english: So he took him to the chief captain and said, Paul, the prisoner, made a request to me to take this young man to you, for he has something to say to you.

chinese: 千夫長就拉著他的手，走到一旁，私下問他說：你有甚麼事告訴我呢？
english: And the chief took him by the hand and, going on one side, said to him privately, What is it you have to say to me?

chinese: 他說：猶太人已經約定，要求你明天帶下保羅到公會裡去，假作要詳細查問他的事。
english: And he said, The Jews are in agreement together to make a request to you for Paul to be taken, on the day after this, into the Sanhedrin, to be questioned in greater detail.

chinese: 你切不要隨從他們；因為他們有四十多人埋伏，已經起誓說：若不先殺保羅就不吃不喝。現在預備好了，只等你應允。
english: But do not give way to them, for more than forty of them are waiting for him, having taken an oath not to take food or drink till they have put him to death: and now they are ready, waiting for your order.

chinese: 於是千夫長打發少年人走，囑咐他說：不要告訴人你將這事報給我了。
english: So the chief captain let the young man go, saying to him, Do not say to anyone that you have given me word of these things.

chinese: 千夫長便叫了兩個百夫長來，說：預備步兵二百，馬兵七十，長槍手二百，今夜亥初往該撒利亞去；
english: And he sent for two captains and said, Make ready two hundred men, with seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen, to go to Caesarea, at the third hour of the night:

chinese: 也要預備牲口叫保羅騎上，護送到巡撫腓力斯那裡去。
english: And get beasts so that they may put Paul on them, and take him safely to Felix, the ruler.

chinese: 千夫長又寫了文書，
english: And he sent a letter in these words:

chinese: 大略說：革老丟呂西亞，請巡撫腓力斯大人安。
english: Claudius Lysias, to the most noble ruler, Felix, peace be with you.

chinese: 這人被猶太人拿住，將要殺害，我得知他是羅馬人，就帶兵丁下去救他出來。
english: This man was taken by the Jews, and was about to be put to death by them, when I came on them with the army and took him out of danger, having knowledge that he was a Roman.

chinese: 因要知道他們告他的緣故，我就帶他下到他們的公會去，
english: And, desiring to get at the reason for their attack on him, I took him down to their Sanhedrin:

chinese: 便查知他被告是因他們律法的辯論，並沒有甚麼該死該綁的罪名。
english: Then it became clear to me that it was a question of their law, and that nothing was said against him which might be a reason for prison or death.

chinese: 後來有人把要害他的計謀告訴我，我就立時解他到你那裡去，又吩咐告他的人在你面前告他。（有古卷在此有：願你平安！）
english: And when news was given to me that a secret design was being made against the man, I sent him straight away to you, giving orders to those who are against him to make their statements before you.

chinese: 於是，兵丁照所吩咐他們的，將保羅夜裡帶到安提帕底。
english: So the armed men, as they were ordered, took Paul and came by night to Antipatris.

chinese: 第二天，讓馬兵護送，他們就回營樓去。
english: But on the day after, they sent the horsemen on with him, and went back to their place:

chinese: 馬兵來到該撒利亞，把文書呈給巡撫，便叫保羅站在他面前。
english: And they, when they came to Caesarea, gave the letter to the ruler, and took Paul before him.

chinese: 巡撫看了文書，問保羅是那省的人，既曉得他是基利家人，
english: And after reading it, he said, What part of the country do you come from? And, hearing that he was from Cilicia,

chinese: 就說：等告你的人來到，我要細聽你的事；便吩咐人把他看守在希律的衙門裡。
english: I will give hearing to your cause, he said, when those who are against you have come. And he gave orders for him to be kept in Herod's Praetorium.

chinese: 過了五天，大祭司亞拿尼亞同幾個長老，和一個辯士帖士羅下來，向巡撫控告保羅。
english: And after five days, the high priest, Ananias, came with certain of the rulers, and an expert talker, one Tertullus; and they made a statement to Felix against Paul.

chinese: 保羅被提了來，帖士羅就告他說：
english: And when he had been sent for, Tertullus, starting his statement, said, Because by you we are living in peace, and through your wisdom wrongs are put right for this nation,

chinese: 腓力斯大人，我們因你得以大享太平，並且這一國的弊病，因著你的先見得以更正了；我們隨時隨地滿心感謝不盡。
english: In all things and in all places we are conscious of our great debt to you, most noble Felix.

chinese: 惟恐多說，你嫌煩絮，只求你寬容聽我們說幾句話。
english: But, so that I may not make you tired, I make a request to you of your mercy, to give hearing to a short statement.

chinese: 我們看這個人，如同瘟疫一般，是鼓動普天下眾猶太人生亂的，又是拿撒勒教黨裡的一個頭目，
english: For this man, in our opinion, is a cause of trouble, a maker of attacks on the government among Jews through all the empire, and a chief mover in the society of the Nazarenes:

chinese: 連聖殿他也想要污穢；我們把他捉住了。（有古卷在此有：要按我們的律法審問，
english: Who, in addition, was attempting to make the Temple unclean: whom we took,

chinese: 不料千夫長呂西亞前來，甚是強橫，從我們手中把他奪去，吩咐告他的人到你這裡來。）
你自己究問他，就可以知道我們告他的一切事了。
english: And from whom you will be able, by questioning him yourself, to get knowledge of all the things which we say against him.

chinese: 眾猶太人也隨著告他說：事情誠然是這樣。
english: And the Jews were in agreement with his statement, saying that these things were so.

chinese: 巡撫點頭叫保羅說話。他就說：我知道你在這國裡斷事多年，所以我樂意為自己分訴。
english: Then when the ruler had given him a sign to make his answer, Paul said, Because I have knowledge that you have been a judge over this nation for a number of years, I am glad to make my answer:

chinese: 你查問就可以知道，從我上耶路撒冷禮拜到今日不過有十二天。
english: Seeing that you are able to make certain of the fact that it is not more than twelve days from the time when I came up to Jerusalem for worship;

chinese: 他們並沒有看見我在殿裡，或是在會堂裡，或是在城裡，和人辯論，聳動眾人。
english: And they have not seen me in argument with any man in the Temple, or working up the feelings of the people, in the Synagogues or in the town:

chinese: 他們現在所告我的事並不能對你證實了。
english: And they are not able to give facts in support of the things which they say against me now.

chinese: 但有一件事，我向你承認，就是他們所稱為異端的道，我正按著那道事奉我祖宗的神，又信合乎律法的和先知書上一切所記載的，
english: But this I will say openly to you, that I do give worship to the God of our fathers after that Way, which to them is not the true religion: but I have belief in all the things which are in the law and in the books of the prophets:

chinese: 並且靠著神，盼望死人，無論善惡，都要復活，就是他們自己也有這個盼望。
english: Hoping in God for that which they themselves are looking for, that there will be a coming back from the dead for upright men and wrongdoers.

chinese: 我因此自己勉勵，對神對人，常存無虧的良心。
english: And in this, I do my best at all times to have no reason for shame before God or men.

chinese: 過了幾年，我帶著賙濟本國的捐項和供獻的物上去。
english: Now after a number of years I came to give help and offerings to my nation:

chinese: 正獻的時候，他們看見我在殿裡已經潔淨了，並沒有聚眾，也沒有吵嚷，惟有幾個從亞西亞來的猶太人。
english: And having been made clean, I was in the Temple, but not with a great number of people, and not with noise: but there were certain Jews from Asia,

chinese: 他們若有告我的事，就應當到你面前來告我。
english: And it would have been better if they had come here to make a statement, if they have anything against me.

chinese: 即或不然，這些人若看出我站在公會前，有妄為的地方，他們自己也可以說明。
english: Or let these men here present say what wrongdoing was seen in me when I was before the Sanhedrin,

chinese: 縱然有，也不過一句話，就是我站在他們中間大聲說：我今日在你們面前受審，是為死人復活的道理。
english: But only this one thing which I said among them in a loud voice, I am this day being judged on the question of the coming back from the dead.

chinese: 腓力斯本是詳細曉得這道，就支吾他們說：且等千夫長呂西亞下來，我要審斷你們的事。
english: But Felix, who had a more detailed knowledge of the Way, put them off, saying, When Lysias, the chief captain, comes down, I will give attention to your business.

chinese: 於是吩咐百夫長看守保羅，並且寬待他，也不攔阻他的親友來供給他。
english: And he gave orders to the captain to keep Paul under his control, and to let him have everything he had need of; and not to keep his friends from coming to see him.

chinese: 過了幾天，腓力斯和他夫人─猶太的女子土西拉─一同來到，就叫了保羅來，聽他講論信基督耶穌的道。
english: But after some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was of the Jews by birth, and sent for Paul, and gave hearing to him about faith in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 保羅講論公義、節制，和將來的審判。腓力斯甚覺恐懼，說：你暫且去罷，等我得便再叫你來。保羅講論公義、節制，和將來的審判。腓力斯甚覺恐懼，說：你暫且去罷，等我得便再叫你來。
english: And while he was talking about righteousness and self-control and the judging which was to come, Felix had great fear and said, Go away for the present, and when the right time comes I will send for you.

chinese: 腓力斯又指望保羅送他銀錢，所以屢次叫他來，和他談論。
english: For he was hoping that Paul would give him money: so he sent for him more frequently and had talk with him.

chinese: 過了兩年，波求非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要討猶太人的喜歡，就留保羅在監裡。
english: But after two years Porcius Festus took the place of Felix, who, desiring to have the approval of the Jews, kept Paul in chains.

chinese: 非斯都到了任，過了三天，就從該撒利亞上耶路撒冷去。
english: So Festus, having come into that part of the country which was under his rule, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

chinese: 祭司長和猶太人的首領向他控告保羅，
english: And the chief priests and the chief men of the Jews made statements against Paul,

chinese: 又央告他，求他的情，將保羅提到耶路撒冷來，他們要在路上埋伏殺害他。
english: Requesting Festus to give effect to their design against him, and send him to Jerusalem, when they would be waiting to put him to death on the way.

chinese: 非斯都卻回答說：保羅押在該撒利亞，我自己快要往那裡去；
english: But Festus, in answer, said that Paul was being kept in prison at Caesarea, and that in a short time he himself was going there.

chinese: 又說：你們中間有權勢的人與我一同下去，那人若有甚麼不是，就可以告他。
english: So, he said, let those who have authority among you go with me, and if there is any wrong in the man, let them make a statement against him.

chinese: 非斯都在他們那裡住了不過十天八天，就下該撒利亞去；第二天坐堂，吩咐將保羅提上來。
english: And when he had been with them not more than eight or ten days, he went down to Caesarea; and on the day after, he took his place on the judge's seat, and sent for Paul.

chinese: 保羅來了，那些從耶路撒冷下來的猶太人周圍站著，將許多重大的事控告他，都是不能證實的。
english: And when he came, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem came round him, and made all sorts of serious statements against him, which were not supported by the facts.

chinese: 保羅分訴說：無論猶太人的律法，或是聖殿，或是該撒，我都沒有干犯。
english: Then Paul, in his answer to them, said, I have done no wrong against the law of the Jews, or against the Temple, or against Caesar.

chinese: 但非斯都要討猶太人的喜歡，就問保羅說：你願意上耶路撒冷去，在那裡聽我審斷這事麼？
english: But Festus, desiring to get the approval of the Jews, said to Paul, Will you go up to Jerusalem, and be judged before me there in connection with these things?

chinese: 保羅說：我站在該撒的堂前，這就是我應當受審的地方。我向猶太人並沒有行過甚麼不義的事，這也是你明明知道的。
english: And Paul said, I am before the seat of Caesar's authority where it is right for me to be judged: I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you are well able to see.

chinese: 我若行了不義的事，犯了甚麼該死的罪，就是死，我也不辭。他們所告我的事若都不實，就沒有人可以把我交給他們。我要上告於該撒。
english: If, then, I am a wrongdoer and there is a cause of death in me, I am ready for death: if it is not as they say against me, no man may give me up to them. Let my cause come before Caesar.

chinese: 非斯都和議會商量了，就說：你既上告於該撒，可以往該撒那裡去。
english: Then Festus, having had a discussion with the Jews, made answer, You have said, Let my cause come before Caesar; to Caesar you will go.

chinese: 過了些日子，亞基帕王和百尼基氏來到該撒利亞，問非斯都安。
english: Now when some days had gone by, King Agrippa and Bernice came to Caesarea and went to see Festus.

chinese: 在那裡住了多日，非斯都將保羅的事告訴王，說：這裡有一個人，是腓力斯留在監裡的。
english: And as they were there for some days, Festus gave them Paul's story, saying, There is a certain man here who was put in prison by Felix:

chinese: 我在耶路撒冷的時候，祭司長和猶太的長老將他的事稟報了我，求我定他的罪。
english: Against whom the chief priests and the rulers of the Jews made a statement when I was at Jerusalem, requesting me to give a decision against him.

chinese: 我對他們說，無論甚麼人，被告還沒有和原告對質，未得機會分訴所告他的事，就先定他的罪，這不是羅馬人的條例。
english: To whom I gave answer that it is not the Roman way to give a man up, till he has been face to face with those who are attacking him, and has had a chance to give an answer to the statements made against him.

chinese: 及至他們都來到這裡，我就不耽延，第二天便坐堂，吩咐把那人提上來。
english: So, when they had come together here, straight away, on the day after, I took my place on the judge's seat and sent for the man.

chinese: 告他的人站著告他；所告的，並沒有我所逆料的那等惡事。
english: But when they got up they said nothing about such crimes as I had in mind:

chinese: 不過是有幾樣辯論，為他們自己敬鬼神的事，又為一個人名叫耶穌，是已經死了，保羅卻說他是活著的。
english: But had certain questions against him in connection with their religion, and about one Jesus, now dead, who, Paul said, was living.

chinese: 這些事當怎樣究問，我心裡作難，所以問他說：你願意上耶路撒冷去，在那裡為這些事聽審麼？
english: And as I had not enough knowledge for the discussion of these things, I made the suggestion to him to go to Jerusalem and be judged there.

chinese: 但保羅求我留下他，要聽皇上審斷，我就吩咐把他留下，等我解他到該撒那裡去。
english: But when Paul made a request that he might be judged by Caesar, I gave orders for him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.

chinese: 亞基帕對非斯都說：我自己也願聽這人辯論。非斯都說：明天你可以聽。
english: And Agrippa said to Festus, I have a desire to give the man a hearing myself. Tomorrow, he said, you may give him a hearing.

chinese: 第二天，亞基帕和百尼基大張威勢而來，同著眾千夫長和城裡的尊貴人進了公廳。非斯都吩咐一聲，就有人將保羅帶進來。
english: So on the day after, when Agrippa and Bernice in great glory had come into the public place of hearing, with the chief of the army and the chief men of the town, at the order of Festus, Paul was sent for.

chinese: 非斯都說：亞基帕王和在這裡的諸位阿，你們看這人，就是一切猶太人，在耶路撒冷和這裡，曾向我懇求、呼叫說：不可容他再活著。
english: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all those who are present here with us, you see this man, about whom all the Jews have made protests to me, at Jerusalem and in this place, saying that it is not right for him to be living any longer.

chinese: 但我查明他沒有犯甚麼該死的罪，並且他自己上告於皇帝，所以我定意把他解去。
english: But, in my opinion, there is no cause of death in him, and as he himself has made a request to be judged by Caesar, I have said that I would send him.

chinese: 論到這人，我沒有確實的事可以奏明主上。因此，我帶他到你們面前，也特意帶他到你亞基帕王面前，為要在查問之後有所陳奏。
english: But I have no certain account of him to send to Caesar. So I have sent for him to come before you, and specially before you, King Agrippa, so that after the business has been gone into, I may have something to put in writing.

chinese: 據我看來，解送囚犯，不指明他的罪案是不合理的。
english: For it seems to me against reason to send a prisoner without making clear what there is against him.

chinese: 亞基帕對保羅說：准你為自己辯明。於是保羅伸手分訴，說：
english: And Agrippa said to Paul, You may put your cause before us. Then Paul, stretching out his hand, made his answer, saying:

chinese: 亞基帕王阿，猶太人所告我的一切事，今日得在你面前分訴，實為萬幸；
english: In my opinion I am happy, King Agrippa, to be able to give my answer before you today to all these things which the Jews say against me:

chinese: 更可幸的，是你熟悉猶太人的規矩和他們的辯論；所以求你耐心聽我。
english: The more so, because you are expert in all questions to do with the Jews and their ways: so I make my request to you to give me a hearing to the end.

chinese: 我從起初在本國的民中，並在耶路撒冷，自幼為人如何，猶太人都知道。
english: All the Jews have knowledge of my way of life from my early years, as it was from the start among my nation, and at Jerusalem;

chinese: 他們若肯作見證就曉得，我從起初是按著我們教中最嚴緊的教門作了法利賽人。
english: And they are able to say, if they would give witness, that I was living as a Pharisee, in that division of our religion which is most regular in the keeping of the law.

chinese: 現在我站在這裡受審，是因為指望神向我們祖宗所應許的；
english: And now I am here to be judged because of the hope given by God's word to our fathers;

chinese: 這應許，我們十二個支派，晝夜切切的事奉神，都指望得著。王阿，我被猶太人控告，就是因這指望。
english: For the effecting of which our twelve tribes have been working and waiting night and day with all their hearts. And in connection with this hope I am attacked by the Jews, O king!

chinese: 神叫死人復活，你們為甚麼看作不可信的呢？
english: Why, in your opinion, is it outside belief for God to make the dead come to life again?

chinese: 從前我自己以為應當多方攻擊拿撒勒人耶穌的名，
english: For I, truly, was of the opinion that it was right for me to do a number of things against the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

chinese: 我在耶路撒冷也曾這樣行了。既從祭司長得了權柄，我就把許多聖徒囚在監裡。他們被殺，我也出名定案。
english: And this I did in Jerusalem: and numbers of the saints I put in prison, having had authority given to me from the chief priests, and when they were put to death, I gave my decision against them.

chinese: 在各會堂，我屢次用刑強逼他們說褻瀆的話，又分外惱恨他們，甚至追逼他們，直到外邦的城邑。
english: And I gave them punishment frequently, in all the Synagogues, forcing them to say things against God; and burning with passion against them, I went after them even into far-away towns.

chinese: 那時，我領了祭司長的權柄和命令，往大馬色去。
english: Then, when I was journeying to Damascus with the authority and orders of the chief priests,

chinese: 王阿，我在路上，晌午的時候，看見從天發光，比日頭還亮，四面照著我並與我同行的人。
english: In the middle of the day, on the road I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, shining round me and those who were journeying with me.

chinese: 我們都仆倒在地，我就聽見有聲音用希伯來話向我說：掃羅！掃羅！為甚麼逼迫我？你用腳踢刺是難的！
english: And when we had all gone down on the earth, a voice came to me, saying in the Hebrew language, Saul, Saul, why are you attacking me so cruelly? It is hard for you to go against the impulse which is driving you.

chinese: 我說：主阿，你是誰？主說：我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
english: And I said, Who are you, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus, whom you are attacking.

chinese: 你起來站著，我特意向你顯現，要派你作執事，作見證，將你所看見的事和我將要指示你的事證明出來；
english: But get up on your feet: for I have come to you for this purpose, to make you a servant and a witness of the things in which you have seen me, and of those in which you will see me;

chinese: 我也要救你脫離百姓和外邦人的手。
english: And I will keep you safe from the people, and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,

chinese: 我差你到他們那裡去，要叫他們的眼睛得開，從黑暗中歸向光明，從撒但權下歸向神；又因信我，得蒙赦罪，和一切成聖的人同得基業。
english: To make their eyes open, turning them from the dark to the light, and from the power of Satan to God, so that they may have forgiveness of sins and a heritage among those who are made holy by faith in me.

chinese: 亞基帕王阿，我故此沒有違背那從天上來的異象；
english: So, then, King Agrippa, I did not go against the vision from heaven;

chinese: 先在大馬色，後在耶路撒冷和猶太全地，以及外邦，勸勉他們應當悔改歸向神，行事與悔改的心相稱。
english: But I went about, first to those in Damascus and Jerusalem, and through all the country of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, preaching a change of heart, so that they, being turned to God, might give, in their works, the fruits of a changed heart.

chinese: 因此，猶太人在殿裡拿住我，想要殺我。
english: For this reason, the Jews took me in the Temple, and made an attempt to put me to death.

chinese: 然而我蒙神的幫助，直到今日還站得住，對著尊貴、卑賤、老幼作見證；所講的並不外乎眾先知和摩西所說將來必成的事，
english: And so, by God's help, I am here today, witnessing to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would come about;

chinese: 就是基督必須受害，並且因從死裡復活，要首先把光明的道傳給百姓和外邦人。
english: That the Christ would go through pain, and being the first to come back from the dead, would give light to the people and to the Gentiles.

chinese: 保羅這樣分訴，非斯都大聲說：保羅，你癲狂了罷。你的學問太大，反叫你癲狂了！
english: And when he made his answer in these words, Festus said in a loud voice, Paul, you are off your head; your great learning has made you unbalanced.

chinese: 保羅說：非斯都大人，我不是癲狂，我說的乃是真實明白話。
english: Then Paul said, I am not off my head, most noble Festus, but my words are true and wise.

chinese: 王也曉得這些事，所以我向王放膽直言，我深信這些事沒有一件向王隱藏的，因都不是在背地裡做的。
english: For the king has knowledge of these things, to whom I am talking freely; being certain that all this is common knowledge to him; for it has not been done in secret.

chinese: 亞基帕王阿，你信先知麼？我知道你是信的。
english: King Agrippa, have you faith in the prophets? I am certain that you have.

chinese: 亞基帕對保羅說：你想少微一勸，便叫我作基督徒阿（或作：你這樣勸我，幾乎叫我作基督徒了）！
english: And Agrippa said to Paul, A little more and you will be making me a Christian.

chinese: 保羅說：無論是少勸是多勸，我向神所求的，不但你一個人，就是今天一切聽我的，都要像我一樣，只是不要像我有這些鎖鍊。
english: And Paul said, It is my prayer to God that, in little or great measure, not only you, but all those hearing me today might be even as I am, but for these chains.

chinese: 於是，王和巡撫並百尼基與同坐的人都起來，
english: And the king and the ruler and Bernice and those who were seated with them got up;

chinese: 退到裡面，彼此談論說：這人並沒有犯甚麼該死該綁的罪。
english: And when they had gone away they said to one another, This man has done nothing which might give cause for death or prison.

chinese: 亞基帕又對非斯都說：這人若沒有上告於該撒，就可以釋放了。
english: And Agrippa said to Festus, This man might have been made free, if he had not put his cause before Caesar.

chinese: 非斯都既然定規了，叫我們坐船往義大利去，便將保羅和別的囚犯交給御營裡的一個百夫長，名叫猶流。
english: And when the decision had been made that we were to go by sea to Italy, they gave Paul and certain other prisoners into the care of a captain named Julius, of the Augustan band.

chinese: 有一隻亞大米田的船，要沿著亞西亞一帶地方的海邊走，我們就上了那船開行；有馬其頓的帖撒羅尼迦人亞里達古和我們同去。
english: And we went to sea in a ship of Adramyttium which was sailing to the sea towns of Asia, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

chinese: 第二天，到了西頓；猶流寬待保羅，准他往朋友那裡去，受他們的照應。
english: And on the day after, we came to Sidon; and Julius was kind to Paul, and let him go to see his friends and take a rest.

chinese: 從那裡又開船，因為風不順，就貼著居比路背風岸行去。
english: And sailing again from there, we went on under cover of Cyprus, because the wind was against us.

chinese: 過了基利家、旁非利亞前面的海，就到了呂家的每拉。
english: And having gone across the sea off Cilicia and Pamphylia we came to Myra, in Lycia.

chinese: 在那裡，百夫長遇見一隻亞力山大的船，要往義大利去，便叫我們上了那船。
english: And there the captain came across a ship of Alexandria, sailing for Italy, and put us in it.

chinese: 一連多日，船行得慢，僅僅來到革尼土的對面。因為被風攔阻，就貼著革哩底背風岸，從撒摩尼對面行過。
english: And when we had gone on slowly for a long time, and had had hard work getting across to Cnidus, for the wind was against us, we went under cover of Crete, in the direction of Salmone;

chinese: 我們沿岸行走，僅僅來到一個地方，名叫佳澳；離那裡不遠，有拉西亞城。
english: And sailing down the side of it, as well as we were able, we came to a certain place named Fair Havens, near which was the town of Lasea.

chinese: 走的日子多了，已經過了禁食的節期，行船又危險，保羅就勸眾人說：
english: And as a long time had gone by, and the journey was now full of danger, because it was late in the year, Paul put the position before them,

chinese: 眾位，我看這次行船，不但貨物和船要受傷損，大遭破壞，連我們的性命也難保。
english: Saying, Friends, I see that this journey will be one of great damage and loss, not only to the goods and the ship, but to ourselves.

chinese: 但百夫長信從掌船的和船主，不信從保羅所說的。
english: But the captain gave more attention to the master and the owner of the ship than to what Paul said.

chinese: 且因在這海口過冬不便，船上的人就多半說：不如開船離開這地方，或者能到非尼基過冬。非尼基是革哩底的一個海口，一面朝東北，一面朝東南。
english: And as the harbour was not a good one in which to be for the winter, the greater number of them were for going out to sea, in order, if possible, to put in for the winter at Phoenix, a harbour of Crete, looking to the north-east and south-east.

chinese: 這時，微微起了南風，他們以為得意，就起了錨，貼近革哩底行去。
english: And when the south wind came softly, being of the opinion that their purpose might be effected, they let the ship go and went sailing down the side of Crete, very near to the land.

chinese: 不多幾時，狂風從島上撲下來；那風名叫友拉革羅。
english: But after a little time, a very violent wind, named Euraquilo, came down from it with great force.

chinese: 船被風抓住，敵不住風，我們就任風颳去。
english: And when the ship got into the grip of it, and was not able to make headway into the wind, we gave way, and went before it.

chinese: 貼著一個小島的背風岸奔行，那島名叫高大，在那裡僅僅收住了小船。
english: And, sailing near the side of a small island named Cauda, we were able, though it was hard work, to make the ship's boat safe:

chinese: 既然把小船拉上來，就用纜索捆綁船底，又恐怕在賽耳底沙灘上擱了淺，就落下篷來，任船飄去。
english: And having got it up, they put cords under and round the ship; but fearing that they might be pushed on to the Syrtis, they let down the sails and so went running before the wind.

chinese: 我們被風浪逼得甚急，第二天眾人就把貨物拋在海裡。
english: And, still fighting the storm with all our strength, the day after they made a start at getting the goods out of the ship;

chinese: 到第三天，他們又親手把船上的器具拋棄了。
english: And on the third day, they let all the sailing apparatus go over the side.

chinese: 太陽和星辰多日不顯露，又有狂風大浪催逼，我們得救的指望就都絕了。
english: And as we had not seen the sun or stars for a long time, and a great storm was on us, all hope of salvation was gone.

chinese: 眾人多日沒有吃甚麼，保羅就出來站在他們中間，說：眾位，你們本該聽我的話，不離開革哩底，免得遭這樣的傷損破壞。
english: And when they had been without food for a long time, Paul got up among them and said, Friends, it would have been better if you had given attention to me and not gone sailing out from Crete, to undergo this damage and loss.

chinese: 現在我還勸你們放心，你們的性命一個也不失喪，惟獨失喪這船。
english: But now, I say to you, be of good heart, for there will be no loss of life, but only of the ship.

chinese: 因我所屬所事奉的神，他的使者昨夜站在我旁邊，說：
english: For this night there came to my side an angel of the God who is my Master and whose servant I am,

chinese: 保羅，不要害怕，你必定站在該撒面前，並且與你同船的人，神都賜給你了。
english: Saying, Have no fear, Paul, for you will come before Caesar, and God has given to you all those who are sailing with you.

chinese: 所以眾位可以放心，我信神他怎樣對我說：事情也要怎樣成就。
english: And so, O men, be of good heart, for I have faith in God that it will be as he said to me.

chinese: 只是我們必要撞在一個島上。
english: But we will be sent on to a certain island.

chinese: 到了第十四天夜間，船在亞底亞海飄來飄去。約到半夜，水手以為漸近旱地，
english: But when the fourteenth day came, while we were going here and there in the Adriatic sea, about the middle of the night the sailors had an idea that they were getting near land;

chinese: 就探深淺，探得有十二丈；稍往前行，又探深淺，探得有九丈。
english: And they let down the lead, and saw that the sea was a hundred and twenty feet deep; and after a little time they did it again and it was ninety feet.

chinese: 恐怕撞在石頭上，就從船尾拋下四個錨，盼望天亮。
english: Then, fearing that by chance we might come on to the rocks, they let down four hooks from the back of the ship, and made prayers for the coming of day.

chinese: 水手想要逃出船去，把小船放在海裡，假作要從船頭拋錨的樣子。
english: Then the sailors made attempts secretly to get away from the ship, letting down a boat as if they were about to put down hooks from the front of the ship;

chinese: 保羅對百夫長和兵丁說：這些人若不等在船上，你們必不能得救。
english: But Paul said to the captain and his men, If you do not keep these men in the ship, you will not be safe.

chinese: 於是兵丁砍斷小船的繩子，由他飄去。
english: Then the armed men, cutting the cords of the boat, let her go.

chinese: 天漸亮的時候，保羅勸眾人都吃飯，說：你們懸望忍餓不吃甚麼，已經十四天了。
english: And when dawn was near, Paul gave them all orders to take food, saying, This is the fourteenth day you have been waiting and taking no food.

chinese: 所以我勸你們吃飯，這是關乎你們救命的事；因為你們各人連一根頭髮也不至於損壞。
english: So I make request to you to take food; for this is for your salvation: not a hair from the head of any of you will come to destruction.

chinese: 保羅說了這話，就拿著餅，在眾人面前祝謝了神，擘開吃。
english: And when he had said this and had taken bread, he gave praise to God before them all, and took a meal of the broken bread.

chinese: 於是他們都放下心，也就吃了。
english: Then they all took heart and did the same.

chinese: 我們在船上的共有二百七十六個人。
english: And we were, in the ship, two hundred and seventy-six persons.

chinese: 他們吃飽了，就把船上的麥子拋在海裡，為要叫船輕一點。
english: And when they had had enough food, they made the weight of the ship less, turning the grain out into the sea.

chinese: 到了天亮，他們不認識那地方，但見一個海灣，有岸可登，就商議能把船攏進去不能。
english: And when it was day, they had no knowledge of the land, but they saw an inlet of the sea with a floor of sand, and they had the idea of driving the ship up on to it if possible.

chinese: 於是砍斷纜索，棄錨在海裡；同時也鬆開舵繩，拉起頭篷，順著風向岸行去。
english: So cutting away the hooks, and letting them go into the sea, and freeing the cords of the guiding-blades, and lifting up the sail to the wind, they went in the direction of the inlet.

chinese: 但遇著兩水夾流的地方，就把船擱了淺；船頭膠住不動，船尾被浪的猛力衝壞。
english: And coming to a point between two seas, they got the ship to land; and the front part was fixed in the sand and not able to be moved, but the back part was broken by the force of the waves.

chinese: 兵丁的意思要把囚犯殺了，恐怕有洑水脫逃的。
english: Then the armed men were for putting the prisoners to death, so that no one would get away by swimming.

chinese: 但百夫長要救保羅，不准他們任意而行，就吩咐會洑水的，跳下水去先上岸；
english: But the captain, desiring to keep Paul safe, kept them from their purpose, and gave orders that those who had knowledge of swimming were to go off the ship and get first to land:

chinese: 其餘的人可以用板子或船上的零碎東西上岸。這樣，眾人都得了救，上了岸。
english: And the rest, some on boards and some on things from the ship. And so it came about that they all got safe to land.

chinese: 我們既已得救，才知道那島名叫米利大。
english: And when we were safe, we made the discovery that the island was named Melita.

chinese: 土人看待我們，有非常的情分；因為當時下雨，天氣又冷，就生火接待我們眾人。
english: And the simple people living there were uncommonly kind to us, for they made a fire for us, and took us in, because it was raining and cold.

chinese: 那時，保羅拾起一捆柴，放在火上，有一條毒蛇，因為熱了出來，咬住他的手。
english: But when Paul had got some sticks together and put them on the fire, a snake came out, because of the heat, and gave him a bite on the hand.

chinese: 土人看見那毒蛇懸在他手上，就彼此說：這人必是個兇手，雖然從海裡救上來，天理還不容他活著。
english: And when the people saw it hanging on his hand, they said to one another, Without doubt this man has put someone to death, and though he has got safely away from the sea, God will not let him go on living.

chinese: 保羅竟把那毒蛇甩在火裡，並沒有受傷。
english: But shaking off the beast into the fire, he got no damage.

chinese: 土人想他必要腫起來，或是忽然仆倒死了；看了多時，見他無害，就轉念，說：他是個神。
english: But they had the idea that they would see him becoming ill, or suddenly falling down dead; but after waiting a long time, and seeing that no damage came to him, changing their opinion, they said he was a god.

chinese: 離那地方不遠，有田產是島長部百流的；他接納我們，盡情款待三日。
english: Now near that place there was some land, the property of the chief man of the island, who was named Publius; who very kindly took us into his house as his guests for three days.

chinese: 當時，部百流的父親患熱病和痢疾躺著。保羅進去，為他禱告，按手在他身上，治好了他。
english: And the father of Publius was ill, with a disease of the stomach; to whom Paul went, and put his hands on him, with prayer, and made him well.

chinese: 從此，島上其餘的病人也來，得了醫治。
english: And when this took place, all the others in the island who had diseases came and were made well.

chinese: 他們又多方的尊敬我們；到了開船的時候，也把我們所需用的送到船上。
english: Then they gave us great honour, and, when we went away, they put into the ship whatever things we were in need of.

chinese: 過了三個月，我們上了亞力山大的船往前行；這船以丟斯雙子為記，是在那海島過了冬的。
english: And after three months we went to sea in a ship of Alexandria sailing under the sign of the Dioscuri, which had been at the island for the winter.

chinese: 到了敘拉古，我們停泊三日；
english: And going into the harbour at Syracuse, we were waiting there for three days.

chinese: 又從那裡繞行，來到利基翁。過了一天，起了南風，第二天就來到部丟利。
english: And from there, going about in a curve, we came to Rhegium: and after one day a south wind came up and on the day after we came to Puteoli:

chinese: 在那裡遇見弟兄們，請我們與他們同住了七天。這樣，我們來到羅馬。
english: Where we came across some of the brothers, who kept us with them for seven days; and so we came to Rome.

chinese: 那裡的弟兄們一聽見我們的信息就出來，到亞比烏市和三館地方迎接我們。保羅見了他們，就感謝神，放心壯膽。
english: And the brothers, when they had news of us, came out from town as far as Appii Forum and the Three Taverns to have a meeting with us: and Paul, seeing them, gave praise to God and took heart.

chinese: 進了羅馬城，（有古卷在此有：百夫長把眾囚犯交給御營的統領，惟有）保羅蒙准和一個看守他的兵另住在一處。
english: And when we came into Rome, they let Paul have a house for himself and the armed man who kept watch over him.

chinese: 過了三天，保羅請猶太人的首領來。他們來了，就對他們說：弟兄們，我雖沒有做甚麼事干犯本國的百姓和我們祖宗的規條，卻被鎖綁，從耶路撒冷解在羅馬人的手裡。
english: Then after three days he sent for the chief men of the Jews: and when they had come together, he said to them, My brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the ways of our fathers, I was given, a prisoner from Jerusalem, into the hands of the Romans.

chinese: 他們審問了我，就願意釋放我；因為在我身上，並沒有該死的罪。罪。
english: Who, when they had put questions to me, were ready to let me go free, because there was no cause of death in me.

chinese: 無奈猶太人不服，我不得已，只好上告於該撒，並非有甚麼事要控告我本國的百姓。
english: But when the Jews made protest against it, I had to put my cause into Caesar's hands; not because I have anything to say against my nation.

chinese: 因此，我請你們來見面說話，我原為以色列人所指望的，被這鍊子捆鎖。
english: But for this reason I sent for you, to see and have talk with you: for because of the hope of Israel I am in these chains.

chinese: 他們說：我們並沒有接著從猶太來論你的信，也沒有弟兄到這裡來報給我們說你有甚麼不好處。
english: And they said to him, We have not had letters from Judaea about you, and no one of the brothers has come to us here to give an account or say any evil about you.

chinese: 但我們願意聽你的意見如何；因為這教門，我們曉得是到處被毀謗的。
english: But we have a desire to give hearing to your opinion: for as to this form of religion, we have knowledge that in all places it is attacked.

chinese: 他們和保羅約定了日子，就有許多人到他的寓處來。保羅從早到晚，對他們講論這事，證明神國的道，引摩西的律法和先知的書，以耶穌的事勸勉他們。
english: And when a day had been fixed, they came to his house in great numbers; and he gave them teaching, giving witness to the kingdom of God, and having discussions with them about Jesus, from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning till evening.

chinese: 他所說的話，有信的，有不信的。
english: And some were in agreement with what he said, but some had doubts.

chinese: 他們彼此不合，就散了；未散以先，保羅說了一句話，說：聖靈藉先知以賽亞向你們祖宗所說的話是不錯的。
english: And they went away, for there was a division among them after Paul had said this one thing: Well did the Holy Spirit say by the prophet Isaiah to your fathers,

chinese: 他說：你去告訴這百姓說：你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白；看是要看見，卻不曉得；
english: Go to this people and say, Though you give ear, you will not get knowledge; and seeing, you will see, but the sense will not be clear to you:

chinese: 因為這百姓油蒙了心，耳朵發沉，眼睛閉著；恐怕眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裡明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。
english: For the heart of this people has become fat and their ears are slow in hearing and their eyes are shut; for fear that they might see with their eyes and give hearing with their ears and become wise in their hearts and be turned again to me, so that I might make them well.

chinese: 所以你們當知道，神這救恩，如今傳給外邦人，他們也必聽受。（有古卷在此有：
english: Be certain, then, that the salvation of God is sent to the Gentiles, and they will give hearing.

chinese: 保羅說了這話，猶太人議論紛紛的就走了。）
保羅在自己所租的房子裡住了足足兩年。凡來見他的人，他全都接待，
english: And for the space of two years, Paul was living in the house of which he had the use, and had talk with all those who went in to see him,

chinese: 放膽傳講神國的道，將主耶穌基督的事教導人，並沒有人禁止。
english: Preaching the kingdom of God and teaching about the Lord Jesus Christ without fear, and no orders were given that he was not to do so.

chinese: 耶穌基督的僕人保羅，奉召為使徒，特派傳神的福音。
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, an Apostle by the selection of God, given authority as a preacher of the good news,

chinese: 這福音是神從前藉眾先知在聖經上所應許的，
english: Of which God had given word before by his prophets in the holy Writings,

chinese: 論到他兒子─我主耶穌基督。按肉體說，是從大衛後裔生的；
english: About his Son who, in the flesh, came from the family of David,

chinese: 按聖善的靈說，因從死裡復活，以大能顯明是神的兒子。
english: But was marked out as Son of God in power by the Holy Spirit through the coming to life again of the dead; Jesus Christ our Lord,

chinese: 我們從他受了恩惠並使徒的職分，在萬國之中叫人為他的名信服真道；
english: Through whom grace has been given to us, sending us out to make disciples to the faith among all nations, for his name:

chinese: 其中也有你們這蒙召屬耶穌基督的人。
english: Among whom you in the same way have been marked out to be disciples of Jesus Christ:

chinese: 我寫信給你們在羅馬、為神所愛、奉召作聖徒的眾人。願恩惠、平安從我們的父神並主耶穌基督歸與你們！
english: To all those who are in Rome, loved by God, marked out as saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 第一，我靠著耶穌基督，為你們眾人感謝我的神，因你們的信德傳遍了天下。
english: First of all, I give praise to my God through Jesus Christ for you all, because news of your faith has gone into all the world.

chinese: 我在他兒子福音上，用心靈所事奉的神，可以見證我怎樣不住的提到你們；
english: For God is my witness, whose servant I am in spirit in the good news of his Son, that you are at all times in my memory and in my prayers,

chinese: 在禱告之間常常懇求，或者照神的旨意，終能得平坦的道路往你們那裡去。
english: And that I am ever making prayers that God will give me a good journey to you.

chinese: 因為我切切的想見你們，要把些屬靈的恩賜分給你們，使你們可以堅固。
english: For I have a strong desire to see you, and to give you some grace of the spirit, so that you may be made strong;

chinese: 這樣，我在你們中間，因你與我彼此的信心，就可以同得安慰。
english: That is to say, that all of us may be comforted together by the faith which is in you and in me.

chinese: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不知道，我屢次定意往你們那裡去，要在你們中間得些果子，如同在其餘的外邦人中一樣；只是到如今仍有阻隔。
english: You may be certain, my brothers, that it has frequently been in my mind to come to you (but till now I was kept from it), so that I might have some fruit from you in the same way as I have had it from the other nations.

chinese: 無論是希利尼人、化外人、聰明人、愚拙人，我都欠他們的債，
english: I have a debt to Greeks and to the nations outside; to the wise and to those who have no learning.

chinese: 所以情願盡我的力量，將福音也傳給你們在羅馬的人。
english: For which reason I have the desire, as far as I am able, to give the knowledge of the good news to you who are in Rome.

chinese: 我不以福音為恥；這福音本是神的大能，要救一切相信的，先是猶太人，後是希利尼人。
english: For I have no feeling of shame about the good news, because it is the power of God giving salvation to everyone who has faith, to the Jew first, and then to the Greek.

chinese: 因為神的義正在這福音上顯明出來；這義是本於信，以致於信。如經上所記：義人必因信得生。
english: For in it there is the revelation of the righteousness of God from faith to faith: as it is said in the holy Writings, The man who does righteousness will be living by his faith.

chinese: 原來，神的忿怒從天上顯明在一切不虔不義的人身上，就是那些行不義阻擋真理的人。
english: For there is a revelation of the wrath of God from heaven against all the wrongdoing and evil thoughts of men who keep down what is true by wrongdoing;

chinese: 神的事情，人所能知道的，原顯明在人心裡，因為神已經給他們顯明。
english: Because the knowledge of God may be seen in them, God having made it clear to them.

chinese: 自從造天地以來，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，雖是眼不能見，但藉著所造之物就可以曉得，叫人無可推諉。
english: For from the first making of the world, those things of God which the eye is unable to see, that is, his eternal power and existence, are fully made clear, he having given the knowledge of them through the things which he has made, so that men have no reason for wrongdoing:

chinese: 因為，他們雖然知道神，卻不當作神榮耀他，也不感謝他。他們的思念變為虛妄，無知的心就昏暗了。
english: Because, having the knowledge of God, they did not give glory to God as God, and did not give praise, but their minds were full of foolish things, and their hearts, being without sense, were made dark.

chinese: 自稱為聰明，反成了愚拙，
english: Seeming to be wise, they were in fact foolish,

chinese: 將不能朽壞之神的榮耀變為偶像，彷彿必朽壞的人和飛禽、走獸、昆蟲的樣式。
english: And by them the glory of the eternal God was changed and made into the image of man who is not eternal, and of birds and beasts and things which go on the earth.

chinese: 所以，神任憑他們逞著心裡的情慾行污穢的事，以致彼此玷辱自己的身體。
english: For this reason God gave them up to the evil desires of their hearts, working shame in their bodies with one another:

chinese: 他們將神的真實變為虛謊，去敬拜事奉受造之物，不敬奉那造物的主；主乃是可稱頌的，直到永遠。阿們！
english: Because by them the true word of God was changed into that which is false, and they gave worship and honour to the thing which is made, and not to him who made it, to whom be blessing for ever. So be it.

chinese: 因此，神任憑他們放縱可羞恥的情慾。他們的女人把順性的用處變為逆性的用處；
english: For this reason God gave them up to evil passions, and their women were changing the natural use into one which is unnatural:

chinese: 男人也是如此，棄了女人順性的用處，慾火攻心，彼此貪戀，男和男行可羞恥的事，就在自己身上受這妄為當得的報應。
english: And in the same way the men gave up the natural use of the woman and were burning in their desire for one another, men doing shame with men, and getting in their bodies the right reward of their evil-doing.

chinese: 他們既然故意不認識神，神就任憑他們存邪僻的心，行那些不合理的事；
english: And because they had not the mind to keep God in their knowledge, God gave them up to an evil mind, to do those things which are not right;

chinese: 裝滿了各樣不義、邪惡、貪婪、惡毒（或作：陰毒），滿心是嫉妒、兇殺、爭競、詭詐、毒恨；
english: Being full of all wrongdoing, evil, desire for the goods of others, hate, envy, putting to death, fighting, deceit, cruel ways, evil talk, and false statements about others;

chinese: 又是讒毀的、背後說人的、怨恨神的（或作：被神所憎惡的）、侮慢人的、狂傲的、自誇的、捏造惡事的、違背父母的。
english: Hated by God, full of pride, without respect, full of loud talk, given to evil inventions, not honouring father or mother,

chinese: 無知的，背約的，無親情的，不憐憫人的。
english: Without knowledge, not true to their undertakings, unkind, having no mercy:

chinese: 他們雖知道神判定行這樣事的人是當死的，然而他們不但自己去行，還喜歡別人去行。
english: Who, though they have knowledge of the law of God, that the fate of those who do these things is death, not only go on doing these things themselves, but give approval to those who do them.

chinese: 你這論斷人的，無論你是誰，也無可推諉。你在甚麼事上論斷人，就在甚麼事上定自己的罪；因你這論斷人的，自己所行卻和別人一樣。
english: So you have no reason, whoever you are, for judging: for in judging another you are judging yourself, for you do the same things.

chinese: 我們知道這樣行的人，神必照真理審判他。
english: And we are conscious that God is a true judge against those who do such things.

chinese: 你這人哪，你論斷行這樣事的人，自己所行的卻和別人一樣，你以為能逃脫神的審判麼？
english: But you who are judging another for doing what you do yourself, are you hoping that God's decision will not take effect against you?

chinese: 還是你藐視他豐富的恩慈、寬容、忍耐，不曉得他的恩慈是領你悔改呢？
english: Or is it nothing to you that God had pity on you, waiting and putting up with you for so long, not seeing that in his pity God's desire is to give you a change of heart?

chinese: 你竟任著你剛硬不悔改的心，為自己積蓄忿怒，以致神震怒，顯他公義審判的日子來到。
english: But by your hard and unchanged heart you are storing up wrath for yourself in the day of the revelation of God's judging in righteousness;

chinese: 他必照各人的行為報應各人。
english: Who will give to every man his right reward:

chinese: 凡恆心行善、尋求榮耀、尊貴，和不能朽壞之福的，就以永生報應他們；
english: To those who go on with good works in the hope of glory and honour and salvation from death, he will give eternal life:

chinese: 惟有結黨、不順從真理、反順從不義的，就以忿怒、惱恨報應他們。
english: But to those who, from a love of competition, are not guided by what is true, will come the heat of his wrath,

chinese: 將患難、困苦加給一切作惡的人，先是猶太人，後是希利尼人；
english: Trouble and sorrow on all whose works are evil, to the Jew first and then to the Greek;

chinese: 卻將榮耀、尊貴、平安加給一切行善的人，先是猶太人，後是希利尼人。
english: But glory and honour and peace to all whose works are good, to the Jew first and then to the Greek:

chinese: 因為神不偏待人。
english: For one man is not different from another before God.

chinese: 凡沒有律法犯了罪的，也必不按律法滅亡；凡在律法以下犯了罪的，也必按律法受審判。
english: All those who have done wrong without the law will get destruction without the law: and those who have done wrong under the law will have their punishment by the law;

chinese: （原來在神面前，不是聽律法的為義，乃是行律法的稱義。
english: For it is not the hearers of the law who will be judged as having righteousness before God, but only the doers:

chinese: 沒有律法的外邦人若順著本性行律法上的事，他們雖然沒有律法，自己就是自己的律法。
english: For when the Gentiles without the law have a natural desire to do the things in the law, they are a law to themselves;

chinese: 這是顯出律法的功用刻在他們心裡，他們是非之心同作見證，並且他們的思念互相較量，或以為是，或以為非。）
english: Because the work of the law is seen in their hearts, their sense of right and wrong giving witness to it, while their minds are at one time judging them and at another giving them approval;

chinese: 就在神藉耶穌基督審判人隱祕事的日子，照著我的福音所言。
english: In the day when God will be a judge of the secrets of men, as it says in the good news of which I am a preacher, through Jesus Christ.

chinese: 你稱為猶太人，又倚靠律法，且指著神誇口；
english: But as for you who have the name of Jew, and are resting on the law, and take pride in God,

chinese: 既從律法中受了教訓，就曉得神的旨意，也能分別是非（或作：也喜愛那美好的事）；
english: And have knowledge of his desires, and are a judge of the things which are different, having the learning of the law,

chinese: 又深信自己是給瞎子領路的，是黑暗中人的光，
english: In the belief that you are a guide to the blind, a light to those in the dark,

chinese: 是蠢笨人的師傅，是小孩子的先生，在律法上有知識和真理的模範。
english: A teacher of the foolish, having in the law the form of knowledge and of what is true;

chinese: 你既是教導別人，還不教導自己麼？你講說人不可偷竊，自己還偷竊麼？
english: You who give teaching to others, do you give it to yourself? you who say that a man may not take what is not his, do you take what is not yours?

chinese: 你說人不可姦淫，自己還姦淫麼？你厭惡偶像，自己還偷竊廟中之物麼？
english: You who say that a man may not be untrue to his wife, are you true to yours? you who are a hater of images, do you do wrong to the house of God?

chinese: 你指著律法誇口，自己倒犯律法，玷辱神麼？
english: You who take pride in the law, are you doing wrong to the honour of God by behaviour which is against the law?

chinese: 神的名在外邦人中，因你們受了褻瀆，正如經上所記的。
english: For the name of God is shamed among the Gentiles because of you, as it is said in the holy Writings.

chinese: 你若是行律法的，割禮固然於你有益；若是犯律法的，你的割禮就算不得割禮。
english: It is true that circumcision is of use if you keep the law, but if you go against the law it is as if you had it not.

chinese: 所以那未受割禮的，若遵守律法的條例，他雖然未受割禮，豈不算是有割禮麼？
english: If those who have not circumcision keep the rules of the law, will it not be credited to them as circumcision?

chinese: 而且那本來未受割禮的，若能全守律法，豈不是要審判你這有儀文和割禮竟犯律法的人麼？
english: And they, by their keeping of the law without circumcision, will be judges of you, by whom the law is broken though you have the letter of the law and circumcision.

chinese: 因為外面作猶太人的，不是真猶太人；外面肉身的割禮，也不是真割禮。
english: The true Jew is not one who is only so publicly, and circumcision is not that which may be seen in the flesh:

chinese: 惟有裡面作的，才是真猶太人；真割禮也是心裡的，在乎靈，不在乎儀文。這人的稱讚不是從人來的，乃是從神來的。
english: But he is a Jew who is a secret one, whose circumcision is of the heart, in the spirit and not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

chinese: 這樣說來，猶太人有甚麼長處？割禮有甚麼益處呢？
english: How then is the Jew better off? or what profit is there in circumcision?

chinese: 凡事大有好處：第一是神的聖言交託他們。
english: Much in every way: first of all because the words of God were given to them.

chinese: 即便有不信的，這有何妨呢？難道他們的不信就廢掉神的信麼？
english: And if some have no faith, will that make the faith of God without effect?

chinese: 斷乎不能！不如說，神是真實的，人都是虛謊的。如經上所記：你責備人的時候，顯為公義；被人議論的時候，可以得勝。
english: In no way: but let God be true, though every man is seen to be untrue; as it is said in the Writings, That your words may be seen to be true, and you may be seen to be right when you are judged.

chinese: 我且照著人的常話說，我們的不義若顯出神的義來，我們可以怎麼說呢？神降怒，是他不義麼？
english: But if the righteousness of God is supported by our wrongdoing what is to be said? is it wrong for God to be angry (as men may say)?

chinese: 斷乎不是！若是這樣，神怎能審判世界呢？
english: In no way: because if it is so, how is God able to be the judge of all the world?

chinese: 若神的真實，因我的虛謊越發顯出他的榮耀，為甚麼我還受審判，好像罪人呢？
english: But if, because I am untrue, God being seen to be true gets more glory, why am I to be judged as a sinner?

chinese: 為甚麼不說，我們可以作惡以成善呢？這是毀謗我們的人說我們有這話。這等人定罪是該當的。
english: Let us not do evil so that good may come (a statement which we are falsely said by some to have made), because such behaviour will have its right punishment.

chinese: 這卻怎麼樣呢？我們比他們強麼？決不是的！因我們已經證明，猶太人和希利尼人都在罪惡之下。
english: What then? are we worse off than they? In no way: because we have before made it clear that Jews as well as Greeks are all under the power of sin;

chinese: 就如經上所記：沒有義人，連一個也沒有。
english: As it is said in the holy Writings, There is not one who does righteousness;

chinese: 沒有明白的；沒有尋求神的；
english: Not one who has the knowledge of what is right, not one who is a searcher after God;

chinese: 都是偏離正路，一同變為無用。沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
english: They have all gone out of the way, there is no profit in any of them; there is not one who does good, not so much as one:

chinese: 他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓；他們用舌頭弄詭詐，嘴唇裡有虺蛇的毒氣，
english: Their throat is like an open place of death; with their tongues they have said what is not true: the poison of snakes is under their lips:

chinese: 滿口是咒罵苦毒。
english: Whose mouth is full of curses and bitter words:

chinese: 殺人流血，他們的腳飛跑，
english: Their feet are quick in running after blood;

chinese: 所經過的路便行殘害暴虐的事。
english: Destruction and trouble are in their ways;

chinese: 平安的路，他們未曾知道；
english: And of the way of peace they have no knowledge:

chinese: 他們眼中不怕神。
english: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

chinese: 我們曉得律法上的話都是對律法以下之人說的，好塞住各人的口，叫普世的人都伏在神審判之下。
english: Now, we have knowledge that what the law says is for those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be stopped, and all men may be judged by God:

chinese: 所以凡有血氣的，沒有一個因行律法能在神面前稱義，因為律法本是叫人知罪。
english: Because by the works of the law no man is able to have righteousness in his eyes, for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

chinese: 但如今，神的義在律法以外已經顯明出來，有律法和先知為證：
english: But now without the law there is a revelation of the righteousness of God, to which witness is given by the law and the prophets;

chinese: 就是神的義，因信耶穌基督加給一切相信的人，並沒有分別。
english: That is, the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ, to all those who have faith; and one man is not different from another,

chinese: 因為世人都犯了罪，虧缺了神的榮耀；
english: For all have done wrong and are far from the glory of God;

chinese: 如今卻蒙神的恩典，因基督耶穌的救贖，就白白的稱義。
english: And they may have righteousness put to their credit, freely, by his grace, through the salvation which is in Christ Jesus:

chinese: 神設立耶穌作挽回祭，是憑著耶穌的血，藉著人的信，要顯明神的義；因為他用忍耐的心寬容人先時所犯的罪，
english: Whom God has put forward as the sign of his mercy, through faith, by his blood, to make clear his righteousness when, in his pity, God let the sins of earlier times go without punishment;

chinese: 好在今時顯明他的義，使人知道他自己為義，也稱信耶穌的人為義。
english: And to make clear his righteousness now, so that he might himself be upright, and give righteousness to him who has faith in Jesus.

chinese: 既是這樣，那裡能誇口呢？沒有可誇的了。用何法沒有的呢？是用立功之法麼？不是，乃用信主之法。
english: What reason, then, is there for pride? It is shut out. By what sort of law? of works? No, but by a law of faith.

chinese: 所以（有古卷：因為）我們看定了：人稱義是因著信，不在乎遵行律法。
english: For this reason, then, a man may get righteousness by faith without the works of the law.

chinese: 難道神只作猶太人的神麼？不也是作外邦人的神麼？是的，也作外邦人的神。
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? is he not in the same way the God of Gentiles? Yes, of Gentiles:

chinese: 神既是一位，他就要因信稱那受割禮的為義，也要因信稱那未受割禮的為義。
english: If God is one; and he will give righteousness because of faith to those who have circumcision, and through faith to those who have not circumcision.

chinese: 這樣，我們因信廢了律法麼？斷乎不是！更是堅固律法。
english: Do we, then, through faith make the law of no effect? in no way: but we make it clear that the law is important.

chinese: 如此說來，我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕憑著肉體得了甚麼呢？
english: What, then, may we say that Abraham, our father after the flesh, has got?

chinese: 倘若亞伯拉罕是因行為稱義，就有可誇的；只是在神面前並無可誇。
english: For if Abraham got righteousness by works, he has reason for pride; but not before God.

chinese: 經上說甚麼呢？說：亞伯拉罕信神，這就算為他的義。
english: But what does it say in the holy Writings? And Abraham had faith in God, and it was put to his account as righteousness.

chinese: 做工的得工價，不算恩典，乃是該得的；
english: Now, the reward is credited to him who does works, not as of grace but as a debt.

chinese: 惟有不做工的，只信稱罪人為義的神，他的信就算為義。
english: But to him who without working has faith in him who gives righteousness to the evil-doer, his faith is put to his account as righteousness.

chinese: 正如大衛稱那在行為以外蒙神算為義的人是有福的。
english: As David says that there is a blessing on the man to whose account God puts righteousness without works, saying,

chinese: 他說：得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的，這人是有福的。
english: Happy are those who have forgiveness for their wrongdoing, and whose sins are covered.

chinese: 主不算為有罪的，這人是有福的。
english: Happy is the man against whom no sin is recorded by the Lord.

chinese: 如此看來，這福是單加給那受割禮的人麼？不也是加給那未受割禮的人麼？因我們所說，亞伯拉罕的信，就算為他的義，
english: Is this blessing, then, for the circumcision only, or in the same way for those who have not circumcision? for we say that the faith of Abraham was put to his account as righteousness.

chinese: 是怎麼算的呢？是在他受割禮的時候呢？是在他未受割禮的時候呢？不是在受割禮的時候，乃是在未受割禮的時候。
english: How, then, was it judged? when he had circumcision, or when he had it not? Not when he had it, but when he did not have it:

chinese: 並且他受了割禮的記號，作他未受割禮的時候因信稱義的印證，叫他作一切未受割禮而信之人的父，使他們也算為義；
english: And he was given the sign of circumcision as a witness of the faith which he had before he underwent circumcision: so that he might be the father of all those who have faith, though they have not circumcision, and so that righteousness might be put to their account;

chinese: 又作受割禮之人的父，就是那些不但受割禮，並且按我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕未受割禮而信之蹤跡去行的人。
english: And the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who keep to the way of that faith which our father Abraham had before he underwent circumcision.

chinese: 因為神應許亞伯拉罕和他後裔，必得承受世界，不是因律法，乃是因信而得的義。
