english: For God's word, that the earth would be his heritage, was given to Abraham, not through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

chinese: 若是屬乎律法的人才得為後嗣，信就歸於虛空，應許也就廢棄了。
english: For if they who are of the law are the people who get the heritage, then faith is made of no use, and the word of God has no power;

chinese: 因為律法是惹動忿怒的（或作：叫人受刑的）；那裡沒有律法，那裡就沒有過犯。
english: For the outcome of the law is wrath; but where there is no law it will not be broken.

chinese: 所以人得為後嗣是本乎信，因此就屬乎恩，叫應許定然歸給一切後裔；不但歸給那屬乎律法的，也歸給那效法亞伯拉罕之信的。
english: For this reason it is of faith, so that it may be through grace; and so that the word of God may be certain to all the seed; not only to that which is of the law, but to that which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all,

chinese: 亞伯拉罕所信的，是那叫死人復活、使無變為有的神，他在主面前作我們世人的父。如經上所記：我已經立你作多國的父。
english: (As it is said in the holy Writings, I have made you a father of a number of nations) before him in whom he had faith, that is, God, who gives life to the dead, and to whom the things which are not are as if they were.

chinese: 他在無可指望的時候，因信仍有指望，就得以作多國的父，正如先前所說，你的後裔將要如此。
english: Who without reason for hope, in faith went on hoping, so that he became the father of a number of nations, as it had been said, So will your seed be.

chinese: 他將近百歲的時候，雖然想到自己的身體如同已死，撒拉的生育已經斷絕，他的信心還是不軟弱；
english: And not being feeble in faith though his body seemed to him little better than dead (he being about a hundred years old) and Sarah was no longer able to have children:

chinese: 並且仰望神的應許，總沒有因不信心裡起疑惑，反倒因信心裡得堅固，將榮耀歸給神，
english: Still, he did not give up faith in the undertaking of God, but was made strong by faith, giving glory to God,

chinese: 且滿心相信神所應許的必能做成。
english: And being certain that God was able to keep his word.

chinese: 所以，這就算為他的義。
english: For which reason it was put to his account as righteousness.

chinese: 算為他義的這句話不是單為他寫的，
english: Now, it was not because of him only that this was said,

chinese: 也是為我們將來得算為義之人寫的，就是我們這信神使我們的主耶穌從死裡復活的人。
english: But for us in addition, to whose account it will be put, if we have faith in him who made Jesus our Lord come back again from the dead,

chinese: 耶穌被交給人，是為我們的過犯；復活，是為叫我們稱義（或作：耶穌是為我們的過犯交付了，是為我們稱義復活了）。
english: Who was put to death for our evil-doing, and came to life again so that we might have righteousness.

chinese: 我們既因信稱義，就藉著我們的主耶穌基督得與神相和。
english: For which reason, because we have righteousness through faith, let us be at peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

chinese: 我們又藉著他，因信得進入現在所站的這恩典中，並且歡歡喜喜盼望神的榮耀。
english: Through whom, in the same way, we have been able by faith to come to this grace in which we now are; and let us have joy in hope of the glory of God.

chinese: 不但如此，就是在患難中也是歡歡喜喜的；因為知道患難生忍耐，
english: And not only so, but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;

chinese: 忍耐生老練，老練生盼望；
english: And waiting gives experience; and experience, hope:

chinese: 盼望不至於羞恥，因為所賜給我們的聖靈將神的愛澆灌在我們心裡。
english: And hope does not put to shame; because our hearts are full of the love of God through the Holy Spirit which is given to us.

chinese: 因我們還軟弱的時候，基督就按所定的日期為罪人死。
english: For when we were still without strength, at the right time Christ gave his life for evil-doers.

chinese: 為義人死，是少有的；為仁人死、或者有敢做的。
english: Now it is hard for anyone to give his life even for an upright man, though it might be that for a good man someone would give his life.

chinese: 惟有基督在我們還作罪人的時候為我們死，神的愛就在此向我們顯明了。
english: But God has made clear his love to us, in that, when we were still sinners, Christ gave his life for us.

chinese: 現在我們既靠著他的血稱義，就更要藉著他免去神的忿怒。
english: Much more, if we now have righteousness by his blood, will salvation from the wrath of God come to us through him.

chinese: 因為我們作仇敵的時候，且藉著神兒子的死，得與神和好；既已和好，就更要因他的生得救了。
english: For if, when we were haters of God, the death of his Son made us at peace with him, much more, now that we are his friends, will we have salvation through his life;

chinese: 不但如此，我們既藉著我主耶穌基督得與神和好，也就藉著他以神為樂。
english: And not only so, but we have joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we are now at peace with God.

chinese: 這就如罪是從一人入了世界，死又是從罪來的；於是死就臨到眾人，因為眾人都犯了罪。
english: For this reason, as through one man sin came into the world, and death because of sin, and so death came to all men, because all have done evil:

chinese: 沒有律法之先，罪已經在世上；但沒有律法，罪也不算罪。
english: Because, till the law came, sin was in existence, but sin is not put to the account of anyone when there is no law to be broken.

chinese: 然而從亞當到摩西，死就作了王，連那些不與亞當犯一樣罪過的，也在他的權下。亞當乃是那以後要來之人的豫像。
english: But still death had power from Adam till Moses, even over those who had not done wrong like Adam, who is a picture of him who was to come.

chinese: 只是過犯不如恩賜，若因一人的過犯，眾人都死了，何況神的恩典，與那因耶穌基督一人恩典中的賞賜，豈不更加倍的臨到眾人麼？
english: But the free giving of God is not like the wrongdoing of man. For if, by the wrongdoing of one man death came to numbers of men, much more did the grace of God, and the free giving by the grace of one man, Jesus Christ, come to men.

chinese: 因一人犯罪就定罪，也不如恩賜，原來審判是由一人而定罪，恩賜乃是由許多過犯而稱義。
english: And the free giving has not the same effect as the sin of one: for the effect of one man's sin was punishment by the decision of God, but the free giving had power to give righteousness to wrongdoers in great number.

chinese: 若因一人的過犯，死就因這一人作了王，何況那些受洪恩又蒙所賜之義的，豈不更要因耶穌基督一人在生命中作王麼？
english: For, if by the wrongdoing of one, death was ruling through the one, much more will those to whom has come the wealth of grace and the giving of righteousness, be ruling in life through the one, even Jesus Christ.

chinese: 如此說來，因一次的過犯，眾人都被定罪；照樣，因一次的義行，眾人也就被稱義得生命了。
english: So then, as the effect of one act of wrongdoing was that punishment came on all men, even so the effect of one act of righteousness was righteousness of life for all men.

chinese: 因一人的悖逆，眾人成為罪人；照樣，因一人的順從，眾人也成為義了。
english: Because, as numbers of men became sinners through the wrongdoing of one man, even so will great numbers get righteousness through the keeping of the word of God by one man.

chinese: 律法本是外添的，叫過犯顯多；只是罪在那裡顯多，恩典就更顯多了。
english: And the law came in addition, to make wrongdoing worse; but where there was much sin, there was much more grace:

chinese: 就如罪作王叫人死；照樣，恩典也藉著義作王，叫人因我們的主耶穌基督得永生。
english: That, as sin had power in death, so grace might have power through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

chinese: 這樣，怎麼說呢？我們可以仍在罪中、叫恩典顯多麼？
english: What may we say, then? are we to go on in sin so that there may be more grace?

chinese: 斷乎不可！我們在罪上死了的人豈可仍在罪中活著呢？
english: In no way. How may we, who are dead to sin, be living in it any longer?

chinese: 豈不知我們這受洗歸入基督耶穌的人是受洗歸入他的死麼？
english: Or are you without the knowledge that all we who had baptism into Christ Jesus, had baptism into his death?

chinese: 所以，我們藉著洗禮歸入死，和他一同埋葬，原是叫我們一舉一動有新生的樣式，像基督藉著父的榮耀從死裡復活一樣。
english: We have been placed with him among the dead through baptism into death: so that as Christ came again from the dead by the glory of the Father, we, in the same way, might be living in new life.

chinese: 我們若在他死的形狀上與他聯合，也要在他復活的形狀上與他聯合；
english: For, if we have been made like him in his death, we will, in the same way, be like him in his coming to life again;

chinese: 因為知道我們的舊人和他同釘十字架，使罪身滅絕，叫我們不再作罪的奴僕；
english: Being conscious that our old man was put to death on the cross with him, so that the body of sin might be put away, and we might no longer be servants to sin.

chinese: 因為已死的人是脫離了罪。
english: Because he who is dead is free from sin.

chinese: 我們若是與基督同死，就信必與他同活。
english: But if we are dead with Christ, we have faith that we will be living with him;

chinese: 因為知道基督既從死裡復活，就不再死，死也不再作他的主了。
english: Having knowledge that because Christ has come back from the dead, he will never again go down to the dead; death has no more power over him.

chinese: 他死是向罪死了，只有一次；他活是向神活著。
english: For his death was a death to sin, but his life now is a life which he is living to God.

chinese: 這樣，你們向罪也當看自己是死的；向神在基督耶穌裡，卻當看自己是活的。
english: Even so see yourselves as dead to sin, but living to God in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 所以，不要容罪在你們必死的身上作王，使你們順從身子的私慾。
english: For this cause do not let sin be ruling in your body which is under the power of death, so that you give way to its desires;

chinese: 也不要將你們的肢體獻給罪作不義的器具；倒要像從死裡復活的人，將自己獻給神，並將肢體作義的器具獻給神。
english: And do not give your bodies to sin as the instruments of wrongdoing, but give yourselves to God, as those who are living from the dead, and your bodies as instruments of righteousness to God.

chinese: 罪必不能作你們的主，因你們不在律法之下，乃在恩典之下。
english: For sin may not have rule over you: because you are not under law, but under grace.

chinese: 這卻怎麼樣呢？我們在恩典之下，不在律法之下，就可以犯罪麼？斷乎不可！
english: What then? are we to go on in sin because we are not under law but under grace? Let it not be so.

chinese: 豈不曉得你們獻上自己作奴僕，順從誰，就作誰的奴僕麼？或作罪的奴僕，以至於死；或作順命的奴僕，以至成義。
english: Are you not conscious that you are the servants of him to whom you give yourselves to do his desire? if to sin, the end being death, or if to do the desire of God, the end being righteousness.

chinese: 感謝神！因為你們從前雖然作罪的奴僕，現今卻從心裡順服了所傳給你們道理的模範。
english: But praise be to God that though you were the servants of sin, you have now given yourselves freely to that form of teaching under which you were placed;

chinese: 你們既從罪裡得了釋放，就作了義的奴僕。
english: And being made free from sin you have been made the servants of righteousness.

chinese: 我因你們肉體的軟弱，就照人的常話對你們說。你們從前怎樣將肢體獻給不潔不法作奴僕，以至於不法；現今也要照樣將肢體獻給義作奴僕，以至於成聖。
english: I am using words in the way of men, because your flesh is feeble: as you gave your bodies as servants to what is unclean, and to evil to do evil, so now give them as servants to righteousness to do what is holy.

chinese: 因為你們作罪之奴僕的時候，就不被義約束了。
english: When you were servants of sin you were free from righteousness.

chinese: 你們現今所看為羞恥的事，當日有甚麼果子呢？那些事的結局就是死。
english: What fruit had you at that time in the things which are now a shame to you? for the end of such things is death.

chinese: 但現今，你們既從罪裡得了釋放，作了神的奴僕，就有成聖的果子，那結局就是永生。
english: But now, being free from sin, and having been made servants to God, you have your fruit in that which is holy, and the end is eternal life.

chinese: 因為罪的工價乃是死；惟有神的恩賜，在我們的主基督耶穌裡，乃是永生。
english: For the reward of sin is death; but what God freely gives is eternal life in Jesus Christ our Lord.

chinese: 弟兄們，我現在對明白律法的人說，你們豈不曉得律法管人是在活著的時候麼？
english: Is it not clear, my brothers (I am using an argument to those who have knowledge of the law), that the law has power over a man as long as he is living?

chinese: 就如女人有了丈夫，丈夫還活著，就被律法約束；丈夫若死了，就脫離了丈夫的律法。
english: For the woman who has a husband is placed by the law under the power of her husband as long as he is living; but if her husband is dead, she is free from the law of the husband.

chinese: 所以丈夫活著，他若歸於別人，便叫淫婦；丈夫若死了，他就脫離了丈夫的律法，雖然歸於別人，也不是淫婦。
english: So if, while the husband is living, she is joined to another man, she will get the name of one who is untrue to her husband: but if the husband is dead, she is free from the law, so that she is not untrue, even if she takes another man.

chinese: 我的弟兄們，這樣說來，你們藉著基督的身體，在律法上也是死了，叫你們歸於別人，就是歸於那從死裡復活的，叫我們結果子給神。
english: In the same way, my brothers, you were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, so that you might be joined to another, even to him who came again from the dead, so that we might give fruit to God.

chinese: 因為我們屬肉體的時候，那因律法而生的惡慾就在我們肢體中發動，以致結成死亡的果子。
english: For when we were in the flesh, the evil passions which came into being through the law were working in our bodies to give the fruit of death.

chinese: 但我們既然在捆我們的律法上死了，現今就脫離了律法，叫我們服事主，要按著心靈（心靈：或作聖靈）的新樣，不按著儀文的舊樣。
english: But now we are free from the law, having been made dead to that which had power over us; so that we are servants in the new way of the spirit, not in the old way of the letter.

chinese: 這樣，我們可說甚麼呢？律法是罪麼？斷乎不是！只是非因律法，我就不知何為罪。非律法說不可起貪心，我就不知何為貪心。
english: What then is to be said? is the law sin? in no way. But I would not have had knowledge of sin but for the law: for I would not have been conscious of desire if the law had not said, You may not have a desire for what is another's.

chinese: 然而罪趁著機會，就藉著誡命叫諸般的貪心在我裡頭發動；因為沒有律法，罪是死的。
english: But sin, taking its chance through that which was ordered by the law, was working in me every form of desire: because without the law sin is dead.

chinese: 我以前沒有律法是活著的；但是誡命來到，罪又活了，我就死了。
english: And there was a time when I was living without the law: but when the law gave its orders, sin came to life and put me to death;

chinese: 那本來叫人活的誡命，反倒叫我死；
english: And I made the discovery that the law whose purpose was to give life had become a cause of death:

chinese: 因為罪趁著機會，就藉著誡命引誘我，並且殺了我。
english: For I was tricked and put to death by sin, which took its chance through the law.

chinese: 這樣看來，律法是聖潔的，誡命也是聖潔、公義、良善的。
english: But the law is holy, and its orders are holy, upright, and good.

chinese: 既然如此，那良善的是叫我死麼？斷乎不是！叫我死的乃是罪。但罪藉著那良善的叫我死，就顯出真是罪，叫罪因著誡命更顯出是惡極了。
english: Was then that which is good, death to me? In no way. But the purpose was that sin might be seen to be sin by working death to me through that which is good; so that through the orders of the law sin might seem much more evil.

chinese: 我們原曉得律法是屬乎靈的，但我是屬乎肉體的，是已經賣給罪了。
english: For we are conscious that the law is of the spirit; but I am of the flesh, given into the power of sin.

chinese: 因為我所做的，我自己不明白；我所願意的，我並不做；我所恨惡的，我倒去做。
english: And I have no clear knowledge of what I am doing, for that which I have a mind to do, I do not, but what I have hate for, that I do.

chinese: 若我所做的，是我所不願意的，我就應承律法是善的。
english: But, if I do that which I have no mind to do, I am in agreement with the law that the law is good.

chinese: 既是這樣，就不是我做的，乃是住在我裡頭的罪做的。
english: So it is no longer I who do it, but the sin living in me.

chinese: 我也知道在我裡頭，就是我肉體之中，沒有良善。因為，立志為善由得我，只是行出來由不得我。
english: For I am conscious that in me, that is, in my flesh, there is nothing good: I have the mind but not the power to do what is right.

chinese: 故此，我所願意的善，我反不做；我所不願意的惡，我倒去做。
english: For the good which I have a mind to do, I do not: but the evil which I have no mind to do, that I do.

chinese: 若我去做所不願意做的，就不是我做的，乃是住在我裡頭的罪做的。
english: But if I do what I have no mind to do, it is no longer I who do it, but the sin living in me.

chinese: 我覺得有個律，就是我願意為善的時候，便有惡與我同在。
english: So I see a law that, though I have a mind to do good, evil is present in me.

chinese: 因為按著我裡面的意思（原文是人），我是喜歡神的律；
english: In my heart I take pleasure in the law of God,

chinese: 但我覺得肢體中另有個律和我心中的律交戰，把我擄去，叫我附從那肢體中犯罪的律。
english: But I see another law in my body, working against the law of my mind, and making me the servant of the law of sin which is in my flesh.

chinese: 我真是苦阿！誰能救我脫離這取死的身體呢？
english: How unhappy am I! who will make me free from the body of this death?

chinese: 感謝神，靠著我們的主耶穌基督就能脫離了。這樣看來，我以內心順服神的律，我肉體卻順服罪的律了。
english: I give praise to God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So with my mind I am a servant to the law of God, but with my flesh to the law of sin.

chinese: 如今，那些在基督耶穌裡的就不定罪了。
english: For this cause those who are in Christ Jesus will not be judged as sinners.

chinese: 因為賜生命聖靈的律，在基督耶穌裡釋放了我，使我脫離罪和死的律了。
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.

chinese: 律法既因肉體軟弱，有所不能行的，神就差遣自己的兒子，成為罪身的形狀，作了贖罪祭，在肉體中定了罪案，
english: For what the law was not able to do because it was feeble through the flesh, God, sending his Son in the image of the evil flesh, and as an offering for sin, gave his decision against sin in the flesh:

chinese: 使律法的義成就在我們這不隨從肉體、只隨從聖靈的人身上。
english: So that what was ordered by the law might be done in us, who are living, not in the way of the flesh, but in the way of the Spirit.

chinese: 因為隨從肉體的人體貼肉體的事，隨從聖靈的人體貼聖靈的事。
english: For those who are living in the way of the flesh give their minds to the things of the flesh, but those who go in the way of the Spirit, to the things of the Spirit.

chinese: 體貼肉體的，就是死；體貼聖靈的，乃是生命、平安。
english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace:

chinese: 原來體貼肉體的，就是與神為仇；因為不服神的律法，也是不能服，
english: Because the mind of the flesh is opposite to God; it is not under the law of God, and is not able to be:

chinese: 而且屬肉體的人不能得神的喜歡。
english: So that those who are in the flesh are not able to give pleasure to God.

chinese: 如果神的靈住在你們心裡，你們就不屬肉體，乃屬聖靈了。人若沒有基督的靈，就不是屬基督的。
english: You are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if the Spirit of God is in you. But if any man has not the Spirit of Christ he is not one of his.

chinese: 基督若在你們心裡，身體就因罪而死，心靈卻因義而活。
english: And if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

chinese: 然而，叫耶穌從死裡復活者的靈若住在你們心裡，那叫基督耶穌從死裡復活的，也必藉著住在你們心裡的聖靈，使你們必死的身體又活過來。
english: But if the Spirit of him who made Jesus come again from the dead is in you, he who made Christ Jesus come again from the dead will in the same way, through his Spirit which is in you, give life to your bodies which now are under the power of death.

chinese: 弟兄們，這樣看來，我們並不是欠肉體的債去順從肉體活著。
english: So then, my brothers, we are in debt, not to the flesh to be living in the way of the flesh:

chinese: 你們若順從肉體活著，必要死；若靠著聖靈治死身體的惡行，必要活著。
english: For if you go in the way of the flesh, death will come on you; but if by the Spirit you put to death the works of the body, you will have life.

chinese: 因為凡被神的靈引導的，都是神的兒子。
english: And all those who are guided by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

chinese: 你們所受的，不是奴僕的心，仍舊害怕；所受的，乃是兒子的心，因此我們呼叫：阿爸！父！
english: For you did not get the spirit of servants again to put you in fear, but the spirit of sons was given to you, by which we say, Abba, Father.

chinese: 聖靈與我們的心同證我們是神的兒女；
english: The Spirit is witness with our spirit that we are children of God:

chinese: 既是兒女，便是後嗣，就是神的後嗣，和基督同作後嗣。如果我們和他一同受苦，也必和他一同得榮耀。
english: And if we are children, we have a right to a part in the heritage; a part in the things of God, together with Christ; so that if we have a part in his pain, we will in the same way have a part in his glory.

chinese: 我想，現在的苦楚若比起將來要顯於我們的榮耀就不足介意了。
english: I am of the opinion that there is no comparison between the pain of this present time and the glory which we will see in the future.

chinese: 受造之物切望等候神的眾子顯出來。
english: For the strong desire of every living thing is waiting for the revelation of the sons of God.

chinese: 因為受造之物服在虛空之下，不是自己願意，乃是因那叫他如此的。
english: For every living thing was put under the power of change, not by its desire, but by him who made it so, in hope

chinese: 但受造之物仍然指望脫離敗壞的轄制，得享（享：原文是入）神兒女自由的榮耀。
english: That all living things will be made free from the power of death and will have a part with the free children of God in glory.

chinese: 我們知道一切受造之物一同歎息、勞苦，直到如今。
english: For we are conscious that all living things are weeping and sorrowing in pain together till now.

chinese: 不但如此，就是我們這有聖靈初結果子的，也是自己心裡歎息，等候得著兒子的名分，乃是我們的身體得贖。
english: And not only so, but we who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we have sorrow in our minds, waiting for the time when we will take our place as sons, that is, the salvation of our bodies.

chinese: 我們得救是在乎盼望；只是所見的盼望不是盼望，誰還盼望他所見的呢（有古卷作：人所看見的何必再盼望呢）？
english: For our salvation is by hope: but hope which is seen is not hope: for who is hoping for what he sees?

chinese: 但我們若盼望那所不見的，就必忍耐等候。
english: But if we have hope for that which we see not, then we will be able to go on waiting for it.

chinese: 況且我們的軟弱有聖靈幫助，我們本不曉得當怎樣禱告，只是聖靈親自用說不出來的歎息替我們禱告。
english: And in the same way the Spirit is a help to our feeble hearts: for we are not able to make prayer to God in the right way; but the Spirit puts our desires into words which are not in our power to say;

chinese: 鑒察人心的，曉得聖靈的意思，因為聖靈照著神的旨意替聖徒祈求。
english: And he who is the searcher of hearts has knowledge of the mind of the Spirit, because he is making prayers for the saints in agreement with the mind of God.

chinese: 我們曉得萬事都互相效力，叫愛神的人得益處，就是按他旨意被召的人。
english: And we are conscious that all things are working together for good to those who have love for God, and have been marked out by his purpose.

chinese: 因為他預先所知道的人，就預先定下效法他兒子的模樣，使他兒子在許多弟兄中作長子。
english: Because those of whom he had knowledge before they came into existence, were marked out by him to be made like his Son, so that he might be the first among a band of brothers:

chinese: 預先所定下的人又召他們來；所召來的人又稱他們為義；所稱為義的人又叫他們得榮耀。
english: And those who were marked out by him were named; and those who were named were given righteousness; and to those to whom he gave righteousness, in the same way he gave glory.

chinese: 既是這樣，還有甚麼說的呢？神若幫助我們，誰能敵擋我們呢？
english: What may we say about these things? If God is for us, who is against us?

chinese: 神既不愛惜自己的兒子，為我們眾人捨了，豈不也把萬物和他一同白白的賜給我們麼？
english: He who did not keep back his only Son, but gave him up for us all, will he not with him freely give us all things?

chinese: 誰能控告神所揀選的人呢？有神稱他們為義了（或作：是稱他們為義的神麼）
english: Who will say anything against the saints of God? It is God who makes us clear from evil;

chinese: 誰能定他們的罪呢？有基督耶穌已經死了，而且從死裡復活，現今在神的右邊，也替我們祈求（有基督....或作是已經死了，而且從死裡復活，現今在神的右邊，也替我們祈求的基督耶穌麼）
english: Who will give a decision against us? It is Christ Jesus who not only was put to death, but came again from the dead, who is now at the right hand of God, taking our part.

chinese: 誰能使我們與基督的愛隔絕呢？難道是患難麼？是困苦麼？是逼迫麼？是飢餓麼？是赤身露體麼？是危險麼？是刀劍麼？
english: Who will come between us and the love of Christ? Will trouble, or pain, or cruel acts, or the need of food or of clothing, or danger, or the sword?

chinese: 如經上所記：我們為你的緣故終日被殺；人看我們如將宰的羊。
english: As it is said in the holy Writings, Because of you we are put to death every day; we are like sheep ready for destruction.

chinese: 然而，靠著愛我們的主，在這一切的事上已經得勝有餘了。
english: But we are able to overcome all these things and more through his love.

chinese: 因為我深信無論是死，是生，是天使，是掌權的，是有能的，是現在的事，是將來的事，
english: For I am certain that not death, or life, or angels, or rulers, or things present, or things to come, or powers,

chinese: 是高處的，是低處的，是別的受造之物，都不能叫我們與神的愛隔絕；這愛是在我們的主基督耶穌裡的。
english: Or things on high, or things under the earth, or anything which is made, will be able to come between us and the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

chinese: 我在基督裡說真話，並不謊言，有我良心被聖靈感動，給我作見證；
english: I say what is true in Christ, and not what is false, my mind giving witness with me in the Holy Spirit,

chinese: 我是大有憂愁，心裡時常傷痛；
english: That I am full of sorrow and pain without end.

chinese: 為我弟兄，我骨肉之親，就是自己被咒詛，與基督分離，我也願意。
english: For I have a desire to take on myself the curse for my brothers, my family in the flesh:

chinese: 他們是以色列人；那兒子的名分、榮耀、諸約、律法、禮儀、應許都是他們的。
english: Who are Israelites: who have the place of sons, and the glory, and the agreements with God, and the giving of the law, and the worship, and the hope offered by God:

chinese: 列祖就是他們的祖宗，按肉體說，基督也是從他們出來的，他是在萬有之上，永遠可稱頌的神。阿們！
english: Whose are the fathers, and of whom came Christ in the flesh, who is over all, God, to whom be blessing for ever. So be it.

chinese: 這不是說神的話落了空。因為從以色列生的不都是以色列人，
english: But it is not as if the word of God was without effect. For they are not all Israel, who are of Israel:

chinese: 也不因為是亞伯拉罕的後裔就都作他的兒女；惟獨從以撒生的才要稱為你的後裔。
english: And they are not all children because they are the seed of Abraham; but, In Isaac will your seed be named.

chinese: 這就是說，肉身所生的兒女不是神的兒女，惟獨那應許的兒女才算是後裔。
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh, but the children of God's undertaking, who are named as the seed.

chinese: 因為所應許的話是這樣說：到明年這時候我要來，撒拉必生一個兒子。
english: For this is the word of God's undertaking, At this time will I come, and Sarah will have a son.

chinese: 不但如此，還有利百加，既從一個人，就是從我們的祖宗以撒懷了孕，
english: And not only so, but Rebecca being about to have a child by our father Isaac--

chinese: （雙子還沒有生下來，善惡還沒有做出來，只因要顯明神揀選人的旨意，不在乎人的行為，乃在乎召人的主。）
english: Before the children had come into existence, or had done anything good or bad, in order that God's purpose and his selection might be effected, not by works, but by him whose purpose it is,

chinese: 神就對利百加說：將來大的要服事小的。
english: It was said to her, The older will be the servant of the younger.

chinese: 正如經上所記：雅各是我所愛的；以掃是我所惡的。
english: Even as it is said, I had love for Jacob, but for Esau I had hate.

chinese: 這樣，我們可說甚麼呢？難道神有甚麼不公平麼？斷乎沒有！
english: What may we say then? is God not upright? let it not be said.

chinese: 因他對摩西說：我要憐憫誰就憐憫誰，要恩待誰就恩待誰。
english: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and pity on whom I will have pity.

chinese: 據此看來，這不在乎那定意的，也不在乎那奔跑的，只在乎發憐憫的神。
english: So then, it is not by the desire or by the attempt of man, but by the mercy of God.

chinese: 因為經上有話向法老說：我將你興起來，特要在你身上彰顯我的權能，並要使我的名傳遍天下。
english: For the holy Writings say to Pharaoh, For this same purpose did I put you on high, so that I might make my power seen in you, and that there might be knowledge of my name through all the earth.

chinese: 如此看來，神要憐憫誰就憐憫誰，要叫誰剛硬就叫誰剛硬。
english: So then, at his pleasure he has mercy on a man, and at his pleasure he makes the heart hard.

chinese: 這樣，你必對我說：他為甚麼還指責人呢？有誰抗拒他的旨意呢？
english: But you will say to me, Why does he still make us responsible? who is able to go against his purpose?

chinese: 你這個人哪，你是誰，竟敢向神強嘴呢？受造之物豈能對造他的說：你為甚麼這樣造我呢？
english: But, O man, who are you, to make answer against God? May the thing which is made say to him who made it, Why did you make me so?

chinese: 窯匠難道沒有權柄從一團泥裡拿一塊做成貴重的器皿，又拿一塊做成卑賤的器皿麼？
english: Or has not the potter the right to make out of one part of his earth a vessel for honour, and out of another a vessel for shame?

chinese: 倘若神要顯明他的忿怒，彰顯他的權能，就多多忍耐寬容那可怒預備遭毀滅的器皿，
english: What if God, desiring to let his wrath and his power be seen, for a long time put up with the vessels of wrath which were ready for destruction:

chinese: 又要將他豐盛的榮耀彰顯在那蒙憐憫早預備得榮耀的器皿上。
english: And to make clear the wealth of his glory to vessels of mercy, which he had before made ready for glory,

chinese: 這器皿就是我們被神所召的，不但是從猶太人中，也是從外邦人中。這有甚麼不可呢？
english: Even us, who were marked out by him, not only from the Jews, but from the Gentiles?

chinese: 就像神在何西阿書上說：那本來不是我子民的，我要稱為我的子民；本來不是蒙愛的，我要稱為蒙愛的。
english: As he says in Hosea, They will be named my people who were not my people, and she will be loved who was not loved.

chinese: 從前在甚麼地方對他們說：你們不是我的子民，將來就在那裡稱他們為永生神的兒子。
english: And in the place where it was said to them, You are not my people, there they will be named the sons of the living God.

chinese: 以賽亞指著以色列人喊著說：以色列人雖多如海沙，得救的不過是剩下的餘數；
english: And Isaiah says about Israel, Even if the number of the children of Israel is as the sand of the sea, only a small part will get salvation:

chinese: 因為主要在世上施行他的話，叫他的話都成全，速速的完結。
english: For the Lord will give effect to his word on the earth, putting an end to it and cutting it short.

chinese: 又如以賽亞先前說過：若不是萬軍之主給我們存留餘種，我們早已像所多瑪，蛾摩拉的樣子了。
english: And, as Isaiah had said before, If the Lord of armies had not given us a seed, we would have been like Sodom and Gomorrah.

chinese: 這樣，我們可說甚麼呢？那本來不追求義的外邦人反得了義，就是因信而得的義。
english: What then may we say? That the nations who did not go after righteousness have got righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith:

chinese: 但以色列人追求律法的義，反得不著律法的義。
english: But Israel, going after a law of righteousness, did not get it.

chinese: 這是甚麼緣故呢？是因為他們不憑著信心求，只憑著行為求，他們正跌在那絆腳石上。
english: Why? Because they were not searching for it by faith, but by works. They came up against the stone which was in the way;

chinese: 就如經上所記：我在錫安放一塊絆腳的石頭，跌人的磐石；信靠他的人必不至於羞愧。
english: As it is said, See, I am putting in Zion a stone causing a fall, and a rock in the way: but he who has faith in him will not be put to shame.

chinese: 弟兄們，我心裡所願的，向神所求的，是要以色列人得救。
english: Brothers, my heart's desire and my prayer to God for them is, that they may get salvation.

chinese: 我可以證明他們向神有熱心，但不是按著真知識；
english: For I give witness of them that they have a strong desire for God, but not with knowledge.

chinese: 因為不知道神的義，想要立自己的義，就不服神的義了。
english: Because, not having knowledge of God's righteousness, and desiring to give effect to their righteousness, they have not put themselves under the righteousness of God.

chinese: 律法的總結就是基督，使凡信他的都得著義。
english: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who has faith.

chinese: 摩西寫著說：人若行那出於律法的義，就必因此活著。
english: For Moses says that the man who does the righteousness which is of the law will get life by it.

chinese: 惟有出於信心的義如此說：你不要心裡說：誰要升到天上去呢？就是要領下基督來；
english: But the righteousness which is of faith says these words, Say not in your heart, Who will go up to heaven? (that is, to make Christ come down:)

chinese: 誰要下到陰間去呢？就是要領基督從死裡上來。
english: Or, Who will go down into the deep? (that is, to make Christ come again from the dead:)

chinese: 他到底怎麼說呢？他說：這道離你不遠，正在你口裡，在你心裡。就是我們所傳信主的道。
english: But what does it say? The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart: that is, the word of faith of which we are the preachers:

chinese: 你若口裡認耶穌為主，心裡信神叫他從死裡復活，就必得救。
english: Because, if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead, you will have salvation:

chinese: 因為人心裡相信，就可以稱義；口裡承認，就可以得救。
english: For with the heart man has faith to get righteousness, and with the mouth he says that Jesus is Lord to get salvation.

chinese: 經上說：凡信他的人必不至於羞愧。
english: Because it is said in the holy Writings, Whoever has faith in him will not be shamed.

chinese: 猶太人和希利尼人並沒有分別，因為眾人同有一位主；他也厚待一切求告他的人。
english: And the Jew is not different from the Greek: for there is the same Lord of all, who is good to all who have hope in his name:

chinese: 因為凡求告主名的，就必得救。
english: Because, Whoever will give worship to the name of the Lord will get salvation.

chinese: 然而，人未曾信他，怎能求他呢？未曾聽見他，怎能信他呢？沒有傳道的，怎能聽見呢？
english: But how will they give worship to him in whom they have no faith? and how will they have faith in him of whom they have not had news? and how will they have news without a preacher?

chinese: 若沒有奉差遣，怎能傳道呢？如經上所記：報福音、傳喜信的人，他們的腳蹤何等佳美。
english: And how will there be preachers if they are not sent? As it is said, How beautiful are the feet of those who give the glad news of good things.

chinese: 只是人沒有都聽從福音，因為以賽亞說：主阿，我們所傳的有誰信呢？
english: But they have not all given ear to the good news. For Isaiah says, Lord, who has had faith in our word?

chinese: 可見信道是從聽道來的，聽道是從基督的話來的。
english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.

chinese: 但我說，人沒有聽見麼？誠然聽見了。他們的聲音傳遍天下；他們的言語傳到地極。
english: But I say, Did not the word come to their ears? Yes, certainly: Their sound has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.

chinese: 我再說，以色列人不知道麼？先有摩西說：我要用那不成子民的，惹動你們的憤恨；我要用那無知的民觸動你們的怒氣。
english: But I say, Had Israel no knowledge? First Moses says, You will be moved to envy by that which is not a nation, and by a foolish people I will make you angry.

chinese: 又有以賽亞放膽說：沒有尋找我的，我叫他們遇見；沒有訪問我的，我向他們顯現。
english: And Isaiah says without fear, Those who were not searching for me made discovery of me; and I was seen by those whose hearts were turned away from me.

chinese: 至於以色列人，他說：我整天伸手招呼那悖逆頂嘴的百姓。
english: But about Israel he says; All the day my hands have been stretched out to a people whose hearts were turned away, and who put themselves against my word.

chinese: 我且說，神棄絕了他的百姓麼？斷乎沒有！因為我也是以色列人，亞伯拉罕的後裔，屬便雅憫支派的。
english: So I say, Has God put his people on one side? Let there be no such thought. For I am of Israel, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

chinese: 神並沒有棄絕他預先所知道的百姓。你們豈不曉得經上論到以利亞是怎麼說的呢？他在神面前怎樣控告以色列人說：
english: God has not put away the people of his selection. Or have you no knowledge of what is said about Elijah in the holy Writings? how he says words to God against Israel,

chinese: 主阿，他們殺了你的先知，拆了你的祭壇，只剩下我一個人，他們還要尋索我的命。
english: Lord, they have put your prophets to death, and made waste your altars, and now I am the last, and they are searching for me to take away my life.

chinese: 神的回話是怎麼說的呢？他說：我為自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的。
english: But what answer does God make to him? I have still seven thousand men whose knees have not been bent to Baal.

chinese: 如今也是這樣，照著揀選的恩典，還有所留的餘數。
english: In the same way, there are at this present time some who are marked out by the selection of grace.

chinese: 既是出於恩典，就不在乎行為；不然，恩典就不是恩典了。
english: But if it is of grace, then it is no longer of works: or grace would not be grace.

chinese: 這是怎麼樣呢？以色列人所求的，他們沒有得著，惟有蒙揀選的人得著了；其餘的就成了頑梗不化的。
english: What then? That which Israel was searching for he did not get, but those of the selection got it and the rest were made hard.

chinese: 如經上所記：神給他們昏迷的心，眼睛不能看見，耳朵不能聽見，直到今日。
english: As it was said in the holy Writings, God gave them a spirit of sleep, eyes which might not see, and ears which have no hearing, to this day.

chinese: 大衛也說：願他們的筵席變為網羅，變為機檻，變為絆腳石，作他們的報應。
english: And David says, Let their table be made a net for taking them, and a stone in their way, and a punishment:

chinese: 願他們的眼睛昏矇，不得看見；願你時常彎下他們的腰。
english: Let their eyes be made dark so that they may not see, and let their back be bent down at all times.

chinese: 我且說，他們失腳是要他們跌倒麼？斷乎不是！反倒因他們的過失，救恩便臨到外邦人，要激動他們發憤。
english: So I say, Were their steps made hard in order that they might have a fall? In no way: but by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, so that they might be moved to envy.

chinese: 若他們的過失，為天下的富足，他們的缺乏，為外邦人的富足；何況他們的豐滿呢？
english: Now, if their fall is the wealth of the world, and their loss the wealth of the Gentiles, how much greater will be the glory when they are made full?

chinese: 我對你們外邦人說這話；因我是外邦人的使徒，所以敬重（原文作：榮耀）我的職分，
english: But I say to you, Gentiles, in so far as I am the Apostle of the Gentiles, I make much of my position:

chinese: 或者可以激動我骨肉之親發憤，好救他們一些人。
english: If in any way those who are of my flesh may be moved to envy, so that some of them may get salvation by me.

chinese: 若他們被丟棄，天下就得與神和好；他們被收納，豈不是死而復生麼？
english: For, if by their putting away, the rest of men have been made friends with God, what will their coming back again be, but life from the dead?

chinese: 所獻的新麵若是聖潔，全團也就聖潔了；樹根若是聖潔，樹枝也就聖潔了。
english: And if the first-fruit is holy, so is the mass: and if the root is holy, so are the branches.

chinese: 若有幾根枝子被折下來，你這野橄欖得接在其中，一同得著橄欖根的肥汁，
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, an olive-tree of the fields, were put in among them, and were given a part with them in the root by which the olive-tree is made fertile,

chinese: 你就不可向舊枝子誇口；若是誇口，當知道不是你托著根，乃是根托著你。
english: Do not be uplifted in pride over the branches: because it is not you who are the support of the root, but it is by the root that you are supported.

chinese: 你若說，那枝子被折下來是特為叫我接上。
english: You will say, Branches were broken off so that I might be put in.

chinese: 不錯！他們因為不信，所以被折下來；你因為信，所以立得住；你不可自高，反要懼怕。
english: Truly, because they had no faith they were broken off, and you have your place by reason of your faith. Do not be lifted up in pride, but have fear;

chinese: 神既不愛惜原來的枝子，也必不愛惜你。
english: For, if God did not have mercy on the natural branches, he will not have mercy on you.

chinese: 可見神的恩慈和嚴厲，向那跌倒的人是嚴厲的，向你是有恩慈的；只要你長久在他的恩慈裡，不然，你也要被砍下來。
english: See then that God is good but his rules are fixed: to those who were put away he was hard, but to you he has been good, on the condition that you keep in his mercy; if not, you will be cut off as they were.

chinese: 而且他們若不是長久不信，仍要被接上，因為神能夠把他們從新接上。
english: And they, if they do not go on without faith, will be united to the tree again, because God is able to put them in again.

chinese: 你是從那天生的野橄欖上砍下來的，尚且逆著性得接在好橄欖上，何況這本樹的枝子，要接在本樹上呢！
english: For if you were cut out of a field olive-tree, and against the natural use were united to a good olive-tree, how much more will these, the natural branches, be united again with the olive-tree which was theirs?

chinese: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不知道這奧祕（恐怕你們自以為聰明），就是以色列人有幾分是硬心的，等到外邦人的數目添滿了，
english: For it is my desire, brothers, that this secret may be clear to you, so that you may not have pride in your knowledge, that Israel has been made hard in part, till all the Gentiles have come in;

chinese: 於是以色列全家都要得救。如經上所記：必有一位救主從錫安出來，要消除雅各家的一切罪惡；
english: And so all Israel will get salvation: as it is said in the holy Writings, There will come out of Zion the One who makes free; by him wrongdoing will be taken away from Jacob:

chinese: 又說：我除去他們罪的時候，這就是我與他們所立的約。
english: And this is my agreement with them, when I will take away their sins.

chinese: 就著福音說，他們為你們的緣故是仇敵；就著揀選說，他們為列祖的緣故是蒙愛的。
english: As far as the good news is in question, they are cut off from God on account of you, but as far as the selection is in question, they are loved on account of the fathers.

chinese: 因為神的恩賜和選召是沒有後悔的。
english: Because God's selection and his mercies may not be changed.

chinese: 你們從前不順服神，如今因他們的不順服，你們倒蒙了憐恤。
english: For as you, in time past, were not under the rule of God, but now have got mercy through their turning away,

chinese: 這樣，他們也是不順服，叫他們因著施給你們的憐恤，現在也就蒙憐恤。
english: So in the same way these have gone against the orders of God, so that by the mercy given to you they may now get mercy.

chinese: 因為神將眾人都圈在不順服之中，特意要憐恤眾人。
english: For God has let them all go against his orders, so that he might have mercy on them all.

chinese: 深哉，神豐富的智慧和知識！他的判斷何其難測！他的蹤跡何其難尋！
english: O how deep is the wealth of the wisdom and knowledge of God! no one is able to make discovery of his decisions, and his ways may not be searched out.

chinese: 誰知道主的心？誰作過他的謀士呢？
english: Who has knowledge of the mind of the Lord? or who has taken part in his purposes?

chinese: 誰是先給了他，使他後來償還呢？
english: Or who has first given to him, and it will be given back to him again?

chinese: 因為萬有都是本於他，倚靠他，歸於他。願榮耀歸給他，直到永遠。阿們！
english: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever. So be it.

chinese: 所以弟兄們，我以神的慈悲勸你們，將身體獻上，當作活祭，是聖潔的，是神所喜悅的；你們如此事奉乃是理所當然的。
english: For this reason I make request to you, brothers, by the mercies of God, that you will give your bodies as a living offering, holy, pleasing to God, which is the worship it is right for you to give him.

chinese: 不要效法這個世界，只要心意更新而變化，叫你們察驗何為神的善良、純全、可喜悅的旨意。
english: And let not your behaviour be like that of this world, but be changed and made new in mind, so that by experience you may have knowledge of the good and pleasing and complete purpose of God.

chinese: 我憑著所賜我的恩對你們各人說：不要看自己過於所當看的，要照著神所分給各人信心的大小，看得合乎中道。
english: But I say to every one of you, through the grace given to me, not to have an over-high opinion of himself, but to have wise thoughts, as God has given to every one a measure of faith.

chinese: 正如我們一個身子上有好些肢體，肢體也不都是一樣的用處。
english: For, as we have a number of parts in one body, but all the parts have not the same use,

chinese: 我們這許多人，在基督裡成為一身，互相聯絡作肢體，也是如此。
english: So we, though we are a number of persons, are one body in Christ, and are dependent on one another;

chinese: 按我們所得的恩賜，各有不同。或說預言，就當照著信心的程度說預言，
english: And having different qualities by reason of the grace given to us, such as the quality of a prophet, let it be made use of in relation to the measure of our faith;

chinese: 或作執事，就當專一執事；或作教導的，就當專一教導；
english: Or the position of a Deacon of the church, let a man give himself to it; or he who has the power of teaching, let him make use of it;

chinese: 或作勸化的，就當專一勸化；施捨的，就當誠實；治理的，就當殷勤；憐憫人的，就當甘心。
english: He who has the power of comforting, let him do so; he who gives, let him give freely; he who has the power of ruling, let him do it with a serious mind; he who has mercy on others, let it be with joy.

chinese: 愛人不可虛假；惡要厭惡，善要親近。
english: Let love be without deceit. Be haters of what is evil; keep your minds fixed on what is good.

chinese: 愛弟兄，要彼此親熱；恭敬人，要彼此推讓。
english: Be kind to one another with a brother's love, putting others before yourselves in honour;

chinese: 殷勤不可懶惰。要心裡火熱，常常服事主。
english: Be not slow in your work, but be quick in spirit, as the Lord's servants;

chinese: 在指望中要喜樂，在患難中要忍耐，禱告要恆切。
english: Being glad in hope, quiet in trouble, at all times given to prayer,

chinese: 聖徒缺乏要幫補；客要一味的款待。
english: Giving to the needs of the saints, ready to take people into your houses.

chinese: 逼迫你們的，要給他們祝福；只要祝福，不可咒詛。
english: Give blessing and not curses to those who are cruel to you.

chinese: 與喜樂的人要同樂；與哀哭的人要同哭。
english: Take part in the joy of those who are glad, and in the grief of those who are sorrowing.

chinese: 要彼此同心；不要志氣高大，倒要俯就卑微的人（人：或作事）；不要自以為聰明。
english: Be in harmony with one another. Do not have a high opinion of yourselves, but be in agreement with common people. Do not give yourselves an air of wisdom.

chinese: 不要以惡報惡；眾人以為美的事要留心去做。
english: Do not give evil for evil to any man. Let all your business be well ordered in the eyes of all men.

chinese: 若是能行，總要盡力與眾人和睦。
english: As far as it is possible for you be at peace with all men.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄，不要自己伸冤，寧可讓步，聽憑主怒（或作：讓人發怒）；因為經上記著：主說：伸冤在我；我必報應。
english: Do not give punishment for wrongs done to you, dear brothers, but give way to the wrath of God; for it is said in the holy Writings, Punishment is mine, I will give reward, says the Lord.

chinese: 所以，你的仇敵若餓了，就給他吃，若渴了，就給他喝；因為你這樣行就是把炭火堆在他的頭上。
english: But if one who has hate for you is in need of food or of drink, give it to him, for in so doing you will put coals of fire on his head.

chinese: 你不可為惡所勝，反要以善勝惡。
english: Do not let evil overcome you, but overcome evil by good.

chinese: 在上有權柄的，人人當順服他，因為沒有權柄不是出於神的。凡掌權的都是神所命的。
english: Let everyone put himself under the authority of the higher powers, because there is no power which is not of God, and all powers are ordered by God.

chinese: 所以，抗拒掌權的就是抗拒神的命；抗拒的必自取刑罰。
english: For which reason everyone who puts himself against the authority puts himself against the order of God: and those who are against it will get punishment for themselves.

chinese: 作官的原不是叫行善的懼怕，乃是叫作惡的懼怕。你願意不懼怕掌權的麼？你只要行善，就可得他的稱讚；
english: For rulers are not a cause of fear to the good work but to the evil. If you would have no fear of the authority, do good and you will have praise;

chinese: 因為他是神的用人，是與你有益的。你若作惡，卻當懼怕；因為他不是空空的佩劍，他是神的用人，是伸冤的，刑罰那作惡的。
english: For he is the servant of God to you for good. But if you do evil, have fear; for the sword is not in his hand for nothing: he is God's servant, making God's punishment come on the evil-doer.

chinese: 所以你們必須順服，不但是因為刑罰，也是因為良心。
english: So put yourselves under the authority, not for fear of wrath, but because you have the knowledge of what is right.

chinese: 你們納糧，也為這個緣故；因他們是神的差役，常常特管這事。
english: For the same reason, make payment of taxes; because the authority is God's servant, to take care of such things at all times.

chinese: 凡人所當得的，就給他。當得糧的，給他納糧；當得稅的，給他上稅；當懼怕的，懼怕他；當恭敬的，恭敬他。
english: Give to all what is their right: taxes to him whose they are, payment to him whose right it is, fear to whom fear, honour to whom honour is to be given.

chinese: 凡事都不可虧欠人，惟有彼此相愛要常以為虧欠，因為愛人的就完全了律法。
english: Be in debt for nothing, but to have love for one another: for he who has love for his neighbour has kept all the law.

chinese: 像那不可姦淫，不可殺人，不可偷盜，不可貪婪，或有別的誡命，都包在愛人如己這一句話之內了。
english: And this, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not put to death, Do not take what is another's, Do not have desire for what is another's, and if there is any other order, it is covered by this word, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

chinese: 愛是不加害與人的，所以愛就完全了律法。
english: Love does no wrong to his neighbour, so love makes the law complete.

chinese: 再者，你們曉得現今就是該趁早睡醒的時候；因為我們得救，現今比初信的時候更近了。
english: See then that the time has come for you to be awake from sleep: for now is your salvation nearer than when you first had faith.

chinese: 黑夜已深，白晝將近；我們就當脫去暗昧的行為，帶上光明的兵器。
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near: so let us put off the works of the dark, arming ourselves with light,

chinese: 行事為人要端正，好像行在白晝。不可荒宴醉酒，不可好色邪蕩，不可爭競嫉妒；
english: With right behaviour as in the day; not in pleasure-making and drinking, not in bad company and unclean behaviour, not in fighting and envy.

chinese: 總要披戴主耶穌基督，不要為肉體安排，去放縱私慾。
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not give thought to the flesh to do its desires.

chinese: 信心軟弱的，你們要接納，但不要辯論所疑惑的事。
english: Do not put on one side him who is feeble in faith, and do not put him in doubt by your reasonings.

chinese: 有人信百物都可吃；但那軟弱的，只吃蔬菜。
english: One man has faith to take all things as food: another who is feeble in faith takes only green food.

chinese: 吃的人不可輕看不吃的人；不吃的人不可論斷吃的人；因為神已經收納他了。
english: Let not him who takes food have a low opinion of him who does not: and let not him who does not take food be a judge of him who does; for he has God's approval.

chinese: 你是誰，竟論斷別人的僕人呢？他或站住，或跌倒，自有他的主人在；而且他也必要站住，因為主能使他站住。
english: Who are you to make yourself a judge of another man's servant? it is to his master that he is responsible for good or bad. Yes, his place will be safe, because the Lord is able to keep him from falling.

chinese: 有人看這日比那日強；有人看日日都是一樣。只是各人心裡要意見堅定。
english: This man puts one day before another: to that man they are the same. Let every man be certain in his mind.

chinese: 守日的人是為主守的；吃的人是為主吃的，因他感謝神；不吃的人是為主不吃的，也感謝神。
english: He who keeps the day, keeps it to the Lord; and he who takes food, takes it as to the Lord, for he gives praise to God; and he who does not take food, to the Lord he takes it not, and gives praise to God.

chinese: 我們沒有一個人為自己活，也沒有一個人為自己死。
english: For every man's life and every man's death has a relation to others as well as to himself.

chinese: 我們若活著，是為主而活；若死了，是為主而死。所以，我們或活或死總是主的人。
english: As long as we have life we are living to the Lord; or if we give up our life it is to the Lord; so if we are living, or if our life comes to an end, we are the Lord's.

chinese: 因此基督死了又活了，為要作死人並活人的主。
english: And for this purpose Christ went into death and came back again, that he might be the Lord of the dead and of the living.

chinese: 你這個人，為甚麼論斷弟兄呢？又為甚麼輕看弟兄呢？因我們都要站在神的臺前。
english: But you, why do you make yourself your brother's judge? or again, why have you no respect for your brother? because we will all have to take our place before God as our judge.

chinese: 經上寫著：主說：我憑著我的永生起誓：萬膝必向我跪拜；萬口必向我承認。
english: For it is said in the holy Writings, By my life, says the Lord, to me every knee will be bent, and every tongue will give worship to God.

chinese: 這樣看來，我們各人必要將自己的事在神面前說明。
english: So every one of us will have to give an account of himself to God.

chinese: 所以，我們不可再彼此論斷，寧可定意誰也不給弟兄放下絆腳跌人之物。
english: Then let us not be judges of one another any longer: but keep this in mind, that no man is to make it hard for his brother, or give him cause for doubting.

chinese: 我憑著主耶穌確知深信，凡物本來沒有不潔淨的；惟獨人以為不潔淨的，在他就不潔淨了。
english: I am conscious of this, and am certain in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean in itself; but for the man in whose opinion it is unclean, for him it is unclean.

chinese: 你若因食物叫弟兄憂愁，就不是按著愛人的道理行。基督已經替他死，你不可因你的食物叫他敗壞。
english: And if because of food your brother is troubled, then you are no longer going on in the way of love. Do not let your food be destruction to him for whom Christ went into death.

chinese: 不可叫你的善被人毀謗；
english: Let it not be possible for men to say evil about your good:

chinese: 因為神的國不在乎吃喝，只在乎公義、和平，並聖靈中的喜樂。
english: For the kingdom of God is not food and drink, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 在這幾樣上服事基督的，就為神所喜悅，又為人所稱許。
english: And he who in these things is Christ's servant, is pleasing to God and has the approval of men.

chinese: 所以，我們務要追求和睦的事與彼此建立德行的事。
english: So then, let us go after the things which make peace, and the things by which we may be a help to one another.

chinese: 不可因食物毀壞神的工程。凡物固然潔淨，但有人因食物叫人跌倒，就是他的罪了。
english: Do not let the work of God come to nothing on account of food. All things are certainly clean; but it is evil for that man who by taking food makes it hard for another.

chinese: 無論是吃肉，是喝酒，是甚麼別的事，叫弟兄跌倒，一概不做才好。
english: It is better not to take meat or wine or to do anything which might be a cause of trouble to your brother.

chinese: 你有信心，就當在神面前守著。人在自己以為可行的事上能不自責，就有福了。
english: The faith which you have, have it to yourself before God. Happy is the man who is not judged by that to which he gives approval.

chinese: 若有疑心而吃的，就必有罪，因為他吃不是出於信心。凡不出於信心的都是罪。
english: But he who is in doubt is judged if he takes food, because he does it not in faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

chinese: 我們堅固的人應該擔代不堅固人的軟弱，不求自己的喜悅。
english: We who are strong have to be a support to the feeble, and not give pleasure to ourselves.

chinese: 我們各人務要叫鄰舍喜悅，使他得益處，建立德行。
english: Let every one of us give pleasure to his neighbour for his good, to make him strong.

chinese: 因為基督也不求自己的喜悅，如經上所記：辱罵你人的辱罵都落在我身上。
english: For Christ did not give pleasure to himself, but, as it is said, The bitter words of those who were angry with you came on me.

chinese: 從前所寫的聖經都是為教訓我們寫的，叫我們因聖經所生的忍耐和安慰可以得著盼望。
english: Now those things which were put down in writing before our time were for our learning, so that through quiet waiting and through the comfort of the holy Writings we might have hope.

chinese: 但願賜忍耐安慰的神叫你們彼此同心，效法基督耶穌，
english: Now may the God who gives comfort and strength in waiting make you of the same mind with one another in harmony with Christ Jesus:

chinese: 一心一口榮耀神─我們主耶穌基督的父！
english: So that with one mouth you may give glory to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 所以，你們要彼此接納，如同基督接納你們一樣，使榮耀歸與神。
english: So then, take one another to your hearts, as Christ took us, to the glory of God.

chinese: 我說，基督是為神真理作了受割禮人的執事，要證實所應許列祖的話，
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision to give effect to the undertakings given by God to the fathers,

chinese: 並叫外邦人因他的憐憫榮耀神。如經上所記：因此，我要在外邦中稱讚你，歌頌你的名；
english: And so that the Gentiles might give glory to God for his mercy; as it is said, For this reason I will give praise to you among the Gentiles, and I will make a song to your name.

chinese: 又說：你們外邦人當與主的百姓一同歡樂；
english: And again he says, Take part, you Gentiles, in the joy of his people.

chinese: 又說：外邦阿，你們當讚美主！萬民哪，你們都當頌讚他！
english: And again, Give praise to the Lord, all you Gentiles; and let all the nations give praise to him.

chinese: 又有以賽亞說：將來有耶西的根，就是那興起來要治理外邦的；外邦人要仰望他。
english: And again Isaiah says, There will be the root of Jesse, and he who comes to be the ruler over the Gentiles; in him will the Gentiles put their hope.

chinese: 但願使人有盼望的神，因信將諸般的喜樂、平安充滿你們的心，使你們藉著聖靈的能力大有盼望。
english: Now may the God of hope make you full of joy and peace through faith, so that all hope may be yours in the power of the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 弟兄們，我自己也深信你們是滿有良善，充足了諸般的知識，也能彼此勸戒。
english: And I myself am certain of you, brothers, that you are full of what is good, complete in all knowledge, able to give direction to one another.

chinese: 但我稍微放膽寫信給你們，是要提醒你們的記性，特因神所給我的恩典，
english: But I have, in some measure, less fear in writing to you to put these things before you again, because of the grace which was given to me by God,

chinese: 使我為外邦人作基督耶穌的僕役，作神福音的祭司，叫所獻上的外邦人，因著聖靈成為聖潔，可蒙悅納。
english: To be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, doing the work of a priest in the good news of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles might be pleasing to God, being made holy by the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 所以論到神的事，我在基督耶穌裡有可誇的。
english: So I have pride in Christ Jesus in the things which are God's.

chinese: 除了基督藉我做的那些事，我甚麼都不敢提，只提他藉我言語作為，用神蹟奇事的能力，並聖靈的能力，使外邦人順服；
english: And I will keep myself from talking of anything but those things which Christ has done by me to put the Gentiles under his rule in word and in act,

chinese: 甚至我從耶路撒冷，直轉到以利哩古，到處傳了基督的福音。
english: By signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and round about as far as Illyricum I have given all the good news of Christ;

chinese: 我立了志向，不在基督的名被稱過的地方傳福音，免得建造在別人的根基上。
english: Making it my purpose not to take the good news where Christ was named, so that my work might not be resting on that of others;

chinese: 就如經上所記：未曾聞知他信息的，將要看見；未曾聽過的，將要明白。
english: But as it is said in the holy Writings, They will see, to whom the news of him had not been given, and those to whose ears it had not come will have knowledge.

chinese: 我因多次被攔阻，總不得到你們那裡去。
english: For which reason I was frequently kept from coming to you:

chinese: 但如今，在這裡再沒有可傳的地方，而且這好幾年，我切心想望到士班雅去的時候，可以到你們那裡，
english: But now, having no longer any place in these parts and having had for a number of years a great desire to come to you,

chinese: 盼望從你們那裡經過，得見你們，先與你們彼此交往，心裡稍微滿足，然後蒙你們送行。
english: Whenever I go to Spain (for it is my hope to see you on my way, and to be sent on there by you, if first I may in some measure have been comforted by your company)--

chinese: 但現在，我往耶路撒冷去供給聖徒。
english: But now I go to Jerusalem, taking help for the saints.

chinese: 因為馬其頓和亞該亞人樂意湊出捐項給耶路撒冷聖徒中的窮人。
english: For it has been the good pleasure of those of Macedonia and Achaia to send a certain amount of money for the poor among the saints at Jerusalem.

chinese: 這固然是他們樂意的，其實也算是所欠的債；因外邦人既然在他們屬靈的好處上有分，就當把養身之物供給他們。
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure; and they are in their debt. For if the Gentiles have had a part in the things of the Spirit which were theirs, it is right for them, in the same way, to give them help in the things of the flesh.

chinese: 等我辦完了這事，把這善果向他們交付明白，我就要路過你們那裡，往士班雅去。
english: So when I have done this, and have given them this fruit of love, I will go on by you into Spain.

chinese: 我也曉得去的時候，必帶著基督豐盛的恩典而去。
english: And I am certain that when I come, I will be full of the blessing of Christ.

chinese: 弟兄們，我藉著我們主耶穌基督，又藉著聖靈的愛，勸你們與我一同竭力，為我祈求神，
english: Now I make request to you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you will be working together with me in your prayers to God for me;

chinese: 叫我脫離在猶太不順從的人，也叫我為耶路撒冷所辦的捐項可蒙聖徒悅納，
english: So that I may be kept safe from those in Judaea who have not put themselves under the rule of God, and that the help which I am taking for Jerusalem may be pleasing to the saints;

chinese: 並叫我順著神的旨意，歡歡喜喜的到你們那裡，與你們同得安息。
english: So that I may come to you in joy by the good pleasure of God, and have rest with you.

chinese: 願賜平安的神常和你們眾人同在。阿們！
english: Now may the God of peace be with you all. So be it.

chinese: 我對你們舉薦我們的姊妹非比，他是堅革哩教會中的女執事。
english: It is my desire to say a good word for Phoebe, who is a servant of the church in Cenchreae:

chinese: 請你們為主接待他，合乎聖徒的體統。他在何事上要你們幫助，你們就幫助他，因他素來幫助許多人，也幫助了我。
english: That you will take her in kindly, after the way of the saints, as one who is the Lord's, and give her help in anything in which she may have need of you: because she has been a help to a great number and to myself.

chinese: 問百基拉和亞居拉安。他們在基督耶穌裡與我同工，
english: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila, workers with me in Christ Jesus,

chinese: 也為我的命將自己的頸項置之度外。不但我感謝他們，就是外邦的眾教會也感謝他們。
english: Who for my life put their necks in danger; to whom not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are in debt:

chinese: 又問在他們家中的教會安。問我所親愛的以拜尼土安；他在亞西亞是歸基督初結的果子。
english: And say a kind word to the church which is in their house. Give my love to my dear Epaenetus, who is the first fruit of Asia to Christ.

chinese: 又問馬利亞安；他為你們多受勞苦。
english: Give my love to Mary, who gave much care to you.

chinese: 又問我親屬與我一同坐監的安多尼古和猶尼亞安；他們在使徒中是有名望的，也是比我先在基督裡。
english: Give my love to Andronicus and Junia, my relations, who were in prison with me, who are noted among the Apostles, and who were in Christ before me.

chinese: 又問我在主裡面所親愛的暗伯利安。
english: Give my love to Ampliatus, who is dear to me in the Lord,

chinese: 又問在基督裡與我們同工的耳巴奴，並我所親愛的士大古安。
english: Give my love to Urbanus, a worker in Christ with us, and to my dear Stachys.

chinese: 又問在基督裡經過試驗的亞比利安。問亞利多布家裡的人安。
english: Give my love to Apelles, who has the approval of Christ. Say a kind word to those who are of the house of Aristobulus.

chinese: 又問我親屬希羅天安。問拿其數家在主裡的人安。
english: Give my love to Herodion, my relation. Say a kind word to those of the house of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

chinese: 又問為主勞苦的土非拿氏和土富撒氏安。問可親愛為主多受勞苦的彼息氏安。
english: Give my love to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, workers in the Lord. Give my love to my dear Persis, who did much work in the Lord.

chinese: 又問在主蒙揀選的魯孚和他母親安；他的母親就是我的母親。
english: Give my love to Rufus, one of the Lord's selection, and to his mother and mine.

chinese: 又問亞遜其土、弗勒干、黑米、八羅巴、黑馬，並與他們在一處的弟兄們安。
english: Give my love to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

chinese: 又問非羅羅古和猶利亞，尼利亞和他姊妹，同阿林巴並與他們在一處的眾聖徒安。
english: Give my love to Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

chinese: 你們親嘴問安，彼此務要聖潔。基督的眾教會都問你們安。
english: Give one another a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send their love to you.

chinese: 弟兄們，那些離間你們、叫你們跌倒、背乎所學之道的人，我勸你們要留意躲避他們。
english: Now, it is my desire, brothers, that you will take note of those who are causing division and trouble among you, quite against the teaching which was given to you: and keep away from them.

chinese: 因為這樣的人不服事我們的主基督，只服事自己的肚腹，用花言巧語誘惑那些老實人的心。
english: For such people are not servants of the Lord Christ, but of their stomachs; and by their smooth and well-said words the hearts of those who have no knowledge of evil are tricked.

chinese: 你們的順服已經傳於眾人，所以我為你們歡喜；但我願意你們在善上聰明，在惡上愚拙。
english: For all have knowledge of how you do what you are ordered. For this reason I have joy in you, but it is my desire that you may be wise in what is good, and without knowledge of evil.

chinese: 賜平安的神快要將撒但踐踏在你們腳下。願我主耶穌基督的恩常和你們同在！
english: And the God of peace will be crushing Satan under your feet before long. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

chinese: 與我同工的提摩太，和我的親屬路求、耶孫、所西巴德，問你們安。
english: Timothy, who is working with me, sends his love to you, so do Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my relations.

chinese: 我這代筆寫信的德丟，在主裡面問你們安。
english: I, Tertius, who have done the writing of this letter, send love in the Lord.

chinese: 那接待我、也接待全教會的該猶問你們安。
english: Gaius, with whom I am living, whose house is open to all the church, sends his love, so does Erastus, the manager of the accounts of the town, and Quartus, the brother.

chinese: 城內管銀庫的以拉都，和兄弟括土問你們安。
惟有神能照我所傳的福音和所講的耶穌基督，並照永古隱藏不言的奧祕，堅固你們的心。
english: Now to him who is able to make you strong in agreement with the good news which I gave you and the preaching of Jesus Christ, in the light of the revelation of that secret which has been kept through times eternal,

chinese: 這奧祕如今顯明出來，而且按著永生神的命，藉眾先知的書指示萬國的民，使他們信服真道。
english: But is now made clear; and by the writings of the prophets, by the order of the eternal God, the knowledge of it has been given to all the nations, so that they may come under the rule of the faith;

chinese: 願榮耀因耶穌基督歸與獨一全智的神，直到永遠。阿們！
english: To the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, be the glory for ever. So be it.

chinese: 奉神旨意，蒙召作耶穌基督使徒的保羅，同兄弟所提尼，
english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, and Sosthenes the brother,

chinese: 寫信給在哥林多神的教會，就是在基督耶穌裡成聖、蒙召作聖徒的，以及所有在各處求告我主耶穌基督之名的人。基督是他們的主，也是我們的主。
english: To the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who have been made holy in Christ Jesus, saints by the selection of God, with all those who in every place give honour to the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:

chinese: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父並主耶穌基督歸與你們。
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 我常為你們感謝我的神，因神在基督耶穌裡所賜給你們的恩惠；
english: I give praise to my God for you at all times, because of the grace of God which has been given to you in Christ Jesus;

chinese: 又因你們在他裡面凡事富足，口才、知識都全備，
english: So that in him you have wealth in all things, in word and in knowledge of every sort;

chinese: 正如我為基督作的見證，在你們心裡得以堅固，
english: Even as the witness of the Christ has been made certain among you:

chinese: 以致你們在恩賜上沒有一樣不及人的，等候我們的主耶穌基督顯現。
english: So that having every grace you are living in the hope of the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;

chinese: 他也必堅固你們到底，叫你們在我們主耶穌基督的日子無可責備。
english: Who will give you strength to the end, to be free from all sin in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 神是信實的，你們原是被他所召，好與他兒子─我們的主耶穌基督一同得分。
english: God is true, through whom you have been given a part with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

chinese: 弟兄們，我藉我們主耶穌基督的名勸你們都說一樣的話。你們中間也不可分黨，只要一心一意，彼此相合。
english: Now I make request to you, my brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you will all say the same thing, and that there may be no divisions among you, so that you may be in complete agreement, in the same mind and in the same opinion.

chinese: 因為革來氏家裡的人曾對我題起弟兄們來，說你們中間有分爭。
english: Because it has come to my knowledge, through those of the house of Chloe, that there are divisions among you, my brothers.

chinese: 我的意思就是你們各人說：我是屬保羅的；我是屬亞波羅的；我是屬磯法的；我是屬基督的。
english: That is, that some of you say, I am of Paul; some say, I am of Apollos; some say, I am of Cephas; and some say, I am Christ's.

chinese: 基督是分開的麼？保羅為你們釘了十字架麼？你們是奉保羅的名受了洗麼？
english: Is there a division in Christ? was Paul nailed to the cross for you? or were you given baptism in the name of Paul?

chinese: 我感謝神，除了基利司布並該猶以外，我沒有給你們一個人施洗；
english: I give praise to God that not one of you had baptism from me, but Crispus and Gaius;

chinese: 免得有人說，你們是奉我的名受洗。
english: So that no one may be able to say that you had baptism in my name.

chinese: 我也給司提反家施過洗，此外給別人施洗沒有，我卻記不清。
english: And I gave baptism to the house of Stephanas; but I am not certain that any others had baptism from me.

chinese: 基督差遣我，原不是為施洗，乃是為傳福音，並不用智慧的言語，免得基督的十字架落了空。
english: For Christ sent me, not to give baptism, but to be a preacher of the good news: not with wise words, for fear that the cross of Christ might be made of no value.

chinese: 因為十字架的道理，在那滅亡的人為愚拙；在我們得救的人，卻為神的大能。
english: For the word of the cross seems foolish to those who are on the way to destruction; but to us who are on the way to salvation it is the power of God.

chinese: 就如經上所記：我要滅絕智慧人的智慧，廢棄聰明人的聰明。
english: As it says in the holy Writings, I will put an end to the wisdom of the wise, and will put on one side the designs of those who have knowledge.

chinese: 智慧人在那裡？文士在那裡？這世上的辯士在那裡？神豈不是叫這世上的智慧變成愚拙麼？
english: Where is the wise? where is he who has knowledge of the law? where is the man of this world who has a love of discussion? has not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

chinese: 世人憑自己的智慧，既不認識神，神就樂意用人所當作愚拙的道理，拯救那些信的人；這就是神的智慧了。
english: For because, by the purpose of God, the world, with all its wisdom, had not the knowledge of God, it was God's pleasure, by so foolish a thing as preaching, to give salvation to those who had faith in him.

chinese: 猶太人是要神蹟，希利尼人是求智慧，
english: Seeing that the Jews make request for signs, and the Greeks are looking for knowledge:

chinese: 我們卻是傳釘十字架的基督，在猶太人為絆腳石，在外邦人為愚拙；
english: But we give the good news of Christ on the cross, a hard thing to the Jews, and a foolish thing to the Gentiles;

chinese: 但在那蒙召的，無論是猶太人、希利尼人，基督總為神的能力，神的智慧。
english: But to those of God's selection, Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power and the wisdom of God.

chinese: 因神的愚拙總比人智慧，神的軟弱總比人強壯。
english: Because what seems foolish in God is wiser than men; and what seems feeble in God is stronger than men.

chinese: 弟兄們哪，可見你們蒙召的，按著肉體有智慧的不多，有能力的不多，有尊貴的也不多。
english: For you see God's design for you, my brothers, that he has not taken a great number of the wise after the flesh, not the strong, not the noble:

chinese: 神卻揀選了世上愚拙的，叫有智慧的羞愧；又揀選了世上軟弱的，叫那強壯的羞愧。
english: But God made selection of the foolish things of this world so that he might put the wise to shame; and the feeble things that he might put to shame the strong;

chinese: 神也揀選了世上卑賤的，被人厭惡的，以及那無有的，為要廢掉那有的。
english: And the low things of the world, and the things without honour, did God make selection of, yes, even the things which are not, so that he might make as nothing the things which are:

chinese: 使一切有血氣的，在神面前一個也不能自誇。
english: So that no flesh might have glory before God.

chinese: 但你們得在基督耶穌裡，是本乎神，神又使他成為我們的智慧、公義、聖潔、救贖。
english: But God has given you a place in Christ Jesus, through whom God has given us wisdom and righteousness and salvation, and made us holy:

chinese: 如經上所記：誇口的，當指著主誇口。
english: So that, as it is said in the holy Writings, Whoever has a desire for glory, let his glory be in the Lord.

chinese: 弟兄們，從前我到你們那裡去，並沒有用高言大智對你們宣傳神的奧祕。
english: And when I came to you, my brothers, I did not come with wise words of knowledge, putting before you the secret of God.

chinese: 因為我曾定了主意，在你們中間不知道別的，只知道耶穌基督並他釘十字架。
english: For I had made the decision to have knowledge of nothing among you but only of Jesus Christ on the cross.

chinese: 我在你們那裡，又軟弱又懼怕，又甚戰兢。
english: And I was with you without strength, in fear and in doubt.

chinese: 我說的話、講的道，不是用智慧委婉的言語，乃是用聖靈和大能的明證，
english: And in my preaching there were no honeyed words of wisdom, but I was dependent on the power of the Spirit to make it clear to you:

chinese: 叫你們的信不在乎人的智慧，只在乎神的大能。
english: So that your faith might be based not on man's wisdom but on the power of God.

chinese: 然而，在完全的人中，我們也講智慧。但不是這世上的智慧，也不是這世上有權有位、將要敗亡之人的智慧。
english: But still we have wisdom for those who are complete in knowledge, though not the wisdom of this world, and not of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing:

chinese: 我們講的，乃是從前所隱藏、神奧祕的智慧，就是神在萬世以前預定使我們得榮耀的。
english: But we give the news of the secret wisdom of God, which he had kept in store before the world came into existence, for our glory;

chinese: 這智慧世上有權有位的人沒有一個知道的、他們若知道，就不把榮耀的主釘在十字架上了。
english: Of which not one of the rulers of this world had knowledge: for if they had, they would not have put the Lord of glory on the cross:

chinese: 如經上所記：神為愛他的人所預備的是眼睛未曾看見，耳朵未曾聽見，人心也未曾想到的。
english: But as it says in the holy Writings, Things which the eye saw not, and which had not come to the ears or into the heart of man, such things as God has made ready for those who have love for him.

chinese: 只有神藉著聖靈向我們顯明了，因為聖靈參透萬事，就是神深奧的事也參透了。
english: But God has given us the revelation of these things through his Spirit, for the Spirit makes search into all things, even the deep things of God.

chinese: 除了在人裡頭的靈，誰知道人的事；像這樣，除了神的靈，也沒有人知道神的事。
english: For who has knowledge of the things of a man but the spirit of the man which is in him? in the same way, no one has knowledge of the things of God but the Spirit of God.

chinese: 我們所領受的，並不是世上的靈，乃是從神來的靈，叫我們能知道神開恩賜給我們的事。
english: But we have not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which comes from God, so that we may have knowledge of the things which are freely given to us by God.

chinese: 並且我們講說這些事，不是用人智慧所指教言語，乃是用聖靈所指教的言語，將屬靈的話解釋屬靈的事。（或作：將屬靈的事講與屬靈的人）
english: And these are the things which we say, not in the language of man's wisdom, but in words given to us by the Spirit, judging the things of the spirit by the help of the Spirit.

chinese: 然而，屬血氣的人不領會神聖靈的事，反倒以為愚拙，並且不能知道，因為這些事惟有屬靈的人才能看透。
english: For the natural man is not able to take in the things of the Spirit of God: for they seem foolish to him, and he is not able to have knowledge of them, because such knowledge comes only through the Spirit.

chinese: 屬靈的人能看透萬事，卻沒有一人能看透了他。
english: But he who has the Spirit, though judging all things, is himself judged by no one.

chinese: 誰曾知道主的心去教導他呢？但我們是有基督的心了。
english: For who has knowledge of the mind of the Lord, so as to be his teacher? But we have the mind of Christ.

chinese: 弟兄們，我從前對你們說話，不能把你們當作屬靈的，只得把你們當作屬肉體，在基督裡為嬰孩的。
english: And the teaching I gave you, my brothers, was such as I was able to give, not to those who have the Spirit, but to those who are still in the flesh, even to children in Christ.

chinese: 我是用奶餵你們，沒有用飯餵你們。那時你們不能吃，就是如今還是不能。
english: I gave you milk and not meat, because you were, then, unable to take it, and even now you are not able;

chinese: 你們仍是屬肉體的，因為在你們中間有嫉妒、分爭，這豈不是屬乎肉體、照著世人的樣子行麼？
english: Because you are still in the flesh: for when there is envy and division among you, are you not still walking after the way of the flesh, even as natural men?

chinese: 有說：我是屬保羅的；有說：我是屬亞波羅的。這豈不是你們和世人一樣麼？
english: For when one says, I am of Paul; and another says, I am of Apollos; are you not talking like natural men?

chinese: 亞波羅算甚麼？保羅算甚麼？無非是執事，照主所賜給他們各人的，引導你們相信。
english: What then is Apollos? and what is Paul? They are but servants who gave you the good news as God gave it to them.

chinese: 我栽種了，亞波羅澆灌了，惟有神叫他生長。
english: I did the planting, Apollos did the watering, but God gave the increase.

chinese: 可見栽種的，算不得甚麼，澆灌的，也算不得甚麼；只在那叫他生長的神。
english: So then the planter is nothing, and the waterer is nothing; but God who gives the increase.

chinese: 栽種的和澆灌的，都是一樣，但將來各人要照自己的工夫得自己的賞賜。
english: Now the planter and the waterer are working for the same end: but they will have their separate rewards in the measure of their work.

chinese: 因為我們是與神同工的；你們是神所耕種的田地，所建造的房屋。
english: For we are workers with God: you are God's planting, God's building.

chinese: 我照神所給我的恩，好像一個聰明的工頭，立好了根基，有別人在上面建造；只是各人要謹慎怎樣在上面建造。
english: In the measure of the grace given to me, I, as a wise master-builder, have put the base in position, and another goes on building on it. But let every man take care what he puts on it.

chinese: 因為那已經立好的根基就是耶穌基督，此外沒有人能立別的根基。
english: For there is no other base for the building but that which has been put down, which is Jesus Christ.

chinese: 若有人用金、銀、寶石、草木，禾秸在這根基上建造，
english: But on the base a man may put gold, silver, stones of great price, wood, dry grass, cut stems;

chinese: 各人的工程必然顯露，因為那日子要將他表明出來，有火發現；這火要試驗各人的工程怎樣。
english: Every man's work will be made clear in that day, because it will be tested by fire; and the fire itself will make clear the quality of every man's work.

chinese: 人在那根基上所建造的工程若存得住，他就要得賞賜。
english: If any man's work comes through the test, he will have a reward.

chinese: 人的工程若被燒了，他就要受虧損，自己卻要得救；雖然得救，乃像從火裡經過的一樣。
english: If the fire puts an end to any man's work, it will be his loss: but he will get salvation himself, though as by fire.

chinese: 豈不知你們是神的殿，神的靈住在你們裡頭麼？
english: Do you not see that you are God's holy house, and that the Spirit of God has his place in you?

chinese: 若有人毀壞神的殿，神必要毀壞那人；因為神的殿是聖的，這殿就是你們。
english: If anyone makes the house of God unclean, God will put an end to him; for the house of God is holy, and you are his house.

chinese: 人不可自欺。你們中間若有人在這世界自以為有智慧，倒不如變作愚拙，好成為有智慧的。
english: Let no man have a false idea. If any man seems to himself to be wise among you, let him become foolish, so that he may be wise.

chinese: 因這世界的智慧，在神看是愚拙。如經上記著說：主叫有智慧的，中了自己的詭計；
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolish before God. As it is said in the holy Writings, He who takes the wise in their secret designs:

chinese: 又說：主知道智慧人的意念是虛妄的。
english: And again, The Lord has knowledge of the reasonings of the wise, that they are nothing.

chinese: 所以無論誰，都不可拿人誇口，因為萬有全是你們的。
english: So let no one take pride in men. For all things are yours;

chinese: 或保羅，或亞波羅，或磯法，或世界，或生，或死，或現今的事，或將來的事，全是你們的；
english: Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;

chinese: 並且你們是屬基督的，基督又是屬神的。
english: And you are Christ's; and Christ is God's.

chinese: 人應當以我們為基督的執事，為神奧祕事的管家。
english: Let us be judged as servants of Christ, and as those who are responsible for the secret things of God.

chinese: 所求於管家的，是要他有忠心。
english: And it is right for such servants to be safe persons.

chinese: 我被你們論斷，或被別人論斷，我都以為極小的事；連我自己也不論斷自己。
english: But it is a small thing to me that I am judged by you or by man's judging; I am not even a judge of myself.

chinese: 我雖不覺得自己有錯，卻也不能因此得以稱義；但判斷我的乃是主。
english: For I am not conscious of any wrong in myself; but this does not make me clear, for it is the Lord who is my judge.

chinese: 所以，時候未到，甚麼都不要論斷，只等主來，他要照出暗中的隱情，顯明人心的意念。那時，各人要從神那裡得著稱讚。
english: For this reason let there be no judging before the time, till the Lord comes, who will make clear the secret things of the dark, and the designs of the heart; and then will every man have his praise from God.

chinese: 弟兄們，我為你們的緣故，拿這些事轉比自己和亞波羅，叫你們效法我們不可過於聖經所記，免得你們自高自大，貴重這個，輕看那個。
english: My brothers, it is because of you that I have taken Apollos and myself as examples of these things, so that in us you might see that it is not wise to go farther than what is in the holy Writings, so that no one of you may be lifted up against his brother.

chinese: 使你與人不同的是誰呢？你有甚麼不是領受的呢；若是領受的，為何自誇，彷彿不是領受的呢？
english: For who made you better than your brother? or what have you that has not been given to you? but if it has been given to you, what cause have you for pride, as if it had not been given to you?

chinese: 你們已經飽足了！已經豐富了！不用我們，自己就作王了！我願意你們果真作王，叫我們也得與你們一同作王。
english: For even now you are full, even now you have wealth, you have been made kings without us: truly, I would be glad if you were kings, so that we might be kings with you.

chinese: 我想神把我們使徒明明列在末後，好像定死罪的囚犯；因為我們成了一臺戲，給世人和天使觀看。
english: For it seems to me that God has put us the Apostles last of all, as men whose fate is death: for we are put on view to the world, and to angels, and to men.

chinese: 我們為基督的緣故算是愚拙的，你們在基督裡倒是聰明的；我們軟弱，你們倒強壯；你們有榮耀，我們倒被藐視。
english: We are made to seem foolish for Christ, but you are wise in Christ; we are feeble, but you are strong; you have glory, but we have shame.

chinese: 直到如今，我們還是又飢又渴，又赤身露體，又挨打，又沒有一定的住處，
english: Even to this hour we are without food, drink, and clothing, we are given blows and have no certain resting-place;

chinese: 並且勞苦，親手做工。被人咒罵，我們就祝福；被人逼迫，我們就忍受；
english: And with our hands we do the hardest work: when they give us curses we give blessings, when we undergo punishment we take it quietly;

chinese: 被人毀謗，我們就善勸。直到如今，人還把我們看作世界上的污穢，萬物中的渣滓。
english: When evil things are said about us we give gentle answers: we are made as the unclean things of the world, as that for which no one has any use, even till now.

chinese: 我寫這話，不是叫你們羞愧，乃是警戒你們，好像我所親愛的兒女一樣。
english: I am not saying these things to put you to shame, but so that, as my dear children, you may see what is right.

chinese: 你們學基督的，師傅雖有一萬，為父的卻是不多，因我在基督耶穌裡用福音生了你們。
english: For even if you had ten thousand teachers in Christ, you have not more than one father: for in Christ Jesus I have given birth to you through the good news.

chinese: 所以，我求你們效法我。
english: So my desire is that you take me as your example.

chinese: 因此我已打發提摩太到你們那裡去。他在主裡面，是我所親愛，有忠心的兒子。他必提醒你們，記念我在基督裡怎樣行事，在各處各教會中怎樣教導人。
english: For this cause I have sent Timothy to you, who is my dear and true child in the Lord; he will make clear to you my ways in Christ, even as I am teaching everywhere in every church.

chinese: 有些人自高自大，以為我不到你們那裡去；
english: Now some are full of pride, as if I was not coming to you.

chinese: 然而，主若許我，我必快到你們那裡去，並且我所要知道的，不是那些自高自大之人的言語，乃是他們的權能。
english: But I will come to you in a short time, if it is pleasing to the Lord, and I will take note, not of the word of those who are full of pride, but of the power.

chinese: 因為神的國不在乎言語，乃在乎權能。
english: For the kingdom of God is not in word but in power.

chinese: 你們願意怎麼樣呢？是願意我帶著刑杖到你們那裡去呢？還是要我存慈愛溫柔的心呢？
english: What is your desire? is my coming to be with punishment, or is it to be in love and a gentle spirit?

chinese: 風聞在你們中間有淫亂的事。這樣的淫亂連外邦人中也沒有，就是有人收了他的繼母。
english: It is said, in fact, that there is among you a sin of the flesh, such as is not seen even among the Gentiles, that one of you has his father's wife.

chinese: 你們還是自高自大，並不哀痛，把行這事的人從你們中間趕出去。
english: And in place of feeling sorrow, you are pleased with yourselves, so that he who has done this thing has not been sent away from among you.

chinese: 我身子雖不在你們那裡，心卻在你們那裡，好像我親自與你們同在，已經判斷了行這事的人。
english: For I myself, being present in spirit though not in body, have come to a decision about him who has done this thing;

chinese: 就是你們聚會的時候，我的心也同在。奉我們主耶穌的名，並用我們主耶穌的權能，
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus, when you have come together with my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus,

chinese: 要把這樣的人交給撒但，敗壞他的肉體，使他的靈魂在主耶穌的日子可以得救。
english: That this man is to be handed over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may have forgiveness in the day of the Lord Jesus.

chinese: 你們這自誇是不好的。豈不知一點麵酵能使全團發起來麼？
english: This pride of yours is not good. Do you not see that a little leaven makes a change in all the mass?

chinese: 你們既是無酵的麵，應當把舊酵除淨，好使你們成為新團；因為我們逾越節的羔羊基督已經被殺獻祭了。
english: Take away, then, the old leaven, so that you may be a new mass, even as you are without leaven. For Christ has been put to death as our Passover.

chinese: 所以，我們守這節不可用舊酵，也不可用惡毒（或作：陰毒）、邪惡的酵，只用誠實真正的無酵餅。
english: Let us then keep the feast, not with old leaven, and not with the leaven of evil thoughts and acts, but with the unleavened bread of true thoughts and right feelings.

chinese: 我先前寫信給你們說，不可與淫亂的人相交。
english: In my letter I said to you that you were not to keep company with those who go after the desires of the flesh;

chinese: 此話不是指這世上一概行淫亂的，或貪婪的，勒索的，或拜偶像的；若是這樣，你們除非離開世界方可。
english: But I had not in mind the sinners who are outside the church, or those who have a desire for and take the property of others, or those who give worship to images; for it is not possible to keep away from such people without going out of the world completely:

chinese: 但如今我寫信給你們說，若有稱為弟兄是行淫亂的，或貪婪的，或拜偶像的，或辱罵的，或醉酒的，或勒索的，這樣的人不可與他相交，就是與他吃飯都不可。
english: But the sense of my letter was that if a brother had the name of being one who went after the desires of the flesh, or had the desire for other people's property, or was in the way of using violent language, or being the worse for drink, or took by force what was not his, you might not keep company with such a one, or take food with him.

chinese: 因為審判教外的人與我何干？教內的人豈不是你們審判的麼？
english: For it is no business of mine to be judging those who are outside; but it is yours to be judging those who are among you;

chinese: 至於外人有神審判他們。你們應當把那惡人從你們中間趕出去。
english: As for those who are outside, God is their judge. So put away the evil man from among you.

chinese: 你們中間有彼此相爭的事，怎敢在不義的人面前求審，不在聖徒面前求審呢？
english: How is it, that if any one of you has a cause at law against another, he takes it before a Gentile judge and not before the saints?

chinese: 豈不知聖徒要審判世界麼？若世界為你們所審，難道你們不配審判這最小的事麼？
english: Is it not certain that the saints will be the judges of the world? if then the world will be judged by you, are you unable to give a decision about the smallest things?

chinese: 豈不知我們要審判天使麼？何況今生的事呢？
english: Is it not certain that we are to be the judges of angels? how much more then of the things of this life?

chinese: 既是這樣，你們若有今生的事當審判，是派教會所輕看的人審判麼？
english: If then there are questions to be judged in connection with the things of this life, why do you put them in the hands of those who have no position in the church?

chinese: 我說這話是要叫你們羞恥。難道你們中間沒有一個智慧人能審斷弟兄們的事麼？
english: I say this to put you to shame. Is there not among you one wise man who may be able to give a decision between his brothers?

chinese: 你們竟是弟兄與弟兄告狀，而且告在不信主的人面前。
english: But a brother who has a cause at law against another takes it before Gentile judges.

chinese: 你們彼此告狀，這已經是你們的大錯了。為甚麼不情願受欺呢？為甚麼不情願吃虧呢？
english: More than this, it is not to your credit to have causes at law with one another at all. Why not put up with wrong? why not undergo loss?

chinese: 你們倒是欺壓人、虧負人，況且所欺壓所虧負的就是弟兄。
english: So far from doing this, you yourselves do wrong and take your brothers' property.

chinese: 你們豈不知不義的人不能承受神的國麼？不要自欺！無論是淫亂的、拜偶像的、姦淫的、作孌童的、親男色的、
english: Have you not knowledge that evil-doers will have no part in the kingdom of God? Have no false ideas about this: no one who goes after the desires of the flesh, or gives worship to images, or is untrue when married, or is less than a man, or makes a wrong use of men,

chinese: 偷竊的、貪婪的、醉酒的、辱罵的、勒索的，都不能承受神的國。
english: Or is a thief, or the worse for drink, or makes use of strong language, or takes by force what is not his, will have any part in the kingdom of God.

chinese: 你們中間也有人從前是這樣；但如今你們奉主耶穌基督的名，並藉著我們神的靈，已經洗淨，成聖，稱義了。
english: And such were some of you; but you have been washed, you have been made holy, you have been given righteousness in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and in the Spirit of our God.

chinese: 凡事我都可行，但不都有益處。凡事我都可行，但無論那一件，我總不受他的轄制。
english: I am free to do all things; but not all things are wise. I am free to do all things; but I will not let myself come under the power of any.

chinese: 食物是為肚腹，肚腹是為食物；但神要叫這兩樣都廢壞。身子不是為淫亂，乃是為主；主也是為身子。
english: Food is for the stomach and the stomach for food, and God will put an end to them together. But the body is not for the desires of the flesh, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body:
