chinese: 並且神已經叫主復活，也要用自己的能力叫我們復活。
english: And God who made the Lord Jesus come back from the dead will do the same for us by his power.

chinese: 豈不知你們的身子是基督的肢體麼？我可以將基督的肢體作為娼妓的肢體麼？斷乎不可！
english: Do you not see that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? how then may I take what is a part of the body of Christ and make it a part of the body of a loose woman? such a thing may not be.

chinese: 豈不知與娼妓聯合的，便是與他成為一體麼？因為主說﹕二人要成為一體。
english: Or do you not see that he who is joined to a loose woman is one body with her? for God has said, The two of them will become one flesh.

chinese: 但與主聯合的，便是與主成為一靈。
english: But he who is united to the Lord is one spirit.

chinese: 你們要逃避淫行。人所犯的，無論甚麼罪，都在身子以外，惟有行淫的，是得罪自己的身子。
english: Keep away from the desires of the flesh. Every sin which a man does is outside of the body; but he who goes after the desires of the flesh does evil to his body.

chinese: 豈不知你們的身子就是聖靈的殿麼？這聖靈是從神而來，住在你們裡頭的；並且你們不是自己的人；
english: Or are you not conscious that your body is a house for the Holy Spirit which is in you, and which has been given to you by God? and you are not the owners of yourselves;

chinese: 因為你們是重價買來的。所以，要在你們的身子上榮耀神。
english: For a payment has been made for you: let God be honoured in your body.

chinese: 論到你們信上所提的事，我說男不近女倒好。
english: Now, as to the things in your letter to me: It is good for a man to have nothing to do with a woman.

chinese: 但要免淫亂的事，男子當各有自己的妻子；女子也當各有自己的丈夫。
english: But because of the desires of the flesh, let every man have his wife, and every woman her husband.

chinese: 丈夫當用合宜之分待妻子；妻子待丈夫也要如此。
english: Let the husband give to the wife what is right; and let the wife do the same to the husband.

chinese: 妻子沒有權柄主張自己的身子，乃在丈夫；丈夫也沒有權柄主張自己的身子，乃在妻子。
english: The wife has not power over her body, but the husband; and in the same way the husband has not power over his body, but the wife.

chinese: 夫妻不可彼此虧負，除非兩相情願，暫時分房，為要專心禱告方可；以後仍要同房，免得撒但趁著你們情不自禁，引誘你們。
english: Do not keep back from one another what is right, but only for a short time, and by agreement, so that you may give yourselves to prayer, and come together again; so that Satan may not get the better of you through your loss of self-control.

chinese: 我說這話，原是准你們的，不是命你們的。
english: But this I say as my opinion, and not as an order of the Lord.

chinese: 我願意眾人像我一樣；只是各人領受神的恩賜，一個是這樣，一個是那樣。
english: It is my desire that all men might be even as I am. But every man has the power of his special way of life given him by God, one in this way and one in that.

chinese: 我對著沒有嫁娶的和寡婦說，若他們常像我就好。
english: But I say to the unmarried and to the widows, It is good for them to be even as I am.

chinese: 倘若自己禁止不住，就可以嫁娶。與其慾火攻心，倒不如嫁娶為妙。
english: But if they have not self-control let them get married; for married life is better than the burning of desire.

chinese: 至於那已經嫁娶的，我吩咐他們；其實不是我吩咐，乃是主吩咐說：妻子不可離開丈夫，
english: But to the married I give orders, though not I but the Lord, that the wife may not go away from her husband

chinese: 若是離開了，不可再嫁，或是仍同丈夫和好。丈夫也不可離棄妻子。
english: (Or if she goes away from him, let her keep unmarried, or be united to her husband again); and that the husband may not go away from his wife.

chinese: 我對其餘的人說，不是主說，：倘若某弟兄有不信的妻子，妻子也情願和他同住，他就不要離棄妻子。
english: But to the rest I say, and not the Lord; If a brother has a wife who is not a Christian, and it is her desire to go on living with him, let him not go away from her.

chinese: 妻子有不信的丈夫，丈夫也情願和他同住，他就不要離棄丈夫。
english: And if a woman has a husband who is not a Christian, and it is his desire to go on living with her, let her not go away from her husband.

chinese: 因為不信的丈夫就因著妻子成了聖潔，並且不信的妻子就因著丈夫（原文是弟兄）成了聖潔；不然，你們的兒女就不潔淨，但如今他們是聖潔的了。
english: For the husband who has not faith is made holy through his Christian wife, and the wife who is not a Christian is made holy through the brother: if not, your children would be unholy, but now are they holy.

chinese: 倘若那不信的人要離去，就由他離去罷！無論是弟兄，是姐妹，遇著這樣的事都不必拘束。神召我們原是要我們和睦。
english: But if the one who is not a Christian has a desire to go away, let it be so: the brother or the sister in such a position is not forced to do one thing or the other: but it is God's pleasure that we may be at peace with one another.

chinese: 你這作妻子的，怎麼知道不能救你的丈夫呢？你這作丈夫的，怎麼知道不能救你的妻子呢？
english: For how may you be certain, O wife, that you will not be the cause of salvation to your husband? or you, O husband, that you may not do the same for your wife?

chinese: 只要照主所分給各人的，和神所召各人的而行。我吩咐各教會都是這樣。
english: Only, as the Lord has given to a man, and as is the purpose of God for him, so let him go on living. And these are my orders for all the churches.

chinese: 有人已受割禮蒙召呢，就不要廢割禮；有人未受割禮蒙召呢，就不要受割禮。
english: If any man who is a Christian has had circumcision, let him keep so; and if any man who is a Christian has not had circumcision, let him make no change.

chinese: 受割禮算不得甚麼，不受割禮也算不得甚麼，只要守神的誡命就是了。
english: Circumcision is nothing, and its opposite is nothing, but only doing the orders of God is of value.

chinese: 各人蒙召的時候是甚麼身分，仍要守住這身分。
english: Let every man keep the position in which he has been placed by God.

chinese: 你是作奴隸蒙召的麼？不要因此憂慮；若能以自由，就求自由更好。
english: If you were a servant when you became a Christian, let it not be a grief to you; but if you have a chance to become free, make use of it.

chinese: 因為作奴僕蒙召於主的，就是主所釋放的人；作自由之人蒙召的，就是基督的奴僕。
english: For he who was a servant when he became a Christian is the Lord's free man; and he who was free when he became a Christian is the Lord's servant.

chinese: 你們是重價買來的，不要作人的奴僕。
english: It is the Lord who has made payment for you: be not servants of men.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們各人蒙召的時候是甚麼身分，仍要在神面前守住這身分。
english: My brothers, let every man keep in that condition which is the purpose of God for him.

chinese: 論到童身的人，我沒有主的命令，但我既蒙主憐恤能作忠心的人，就把自己的意見告訴你們。
english: Now about virgins I have no orders from the Lord: but I give my opinion as one to whom the Lord has given mercy to be true to him.

chinese: 因現今的艱難，據我看來，人不如守素安常才好。
english: In my opinion then, because of the present trouble, it is good for a man to keep as he is.

chinese: 你有妻子纏著呢，就不要求脫離；你沒有妻子纏著呢，就不要求妻子。
english: If you are married to a wife, make no attempt to get free from her: if you are free from a wife, do not take a wife.

chinese: 你若娶妻，並不是犯罪；處女若出嫁，也不是犯罪。然而這等人肉身必受苦難，我卻願意你們免這苦難。
english: If you get married it is not a sin; and if an unmarried woman gets married it is not a sin. But those who do so will have trouble in the flesh. But I will not be hard on you.

chinese: 弟兄們，我對你們說，時候減少了。從此以後，那有妻子的，要像沒有妻子；
english: But I say this, my brothers, the time is short; and from now it will be wise for those who have wives to be as if they had them not;

chinese: 哀哭的，要像不哀哭；快樂的，要像不快樂；置買的，要像無有所得；
english: And for those who are in sorrow, to give no signs of it; and for those who are glad, to give no signs of joy; and for those who are getting property, to be as if they had nothing;

chinese: 用世物的，要像不用世物，因為這世界的樣子將要過去了。
english: And for those who make use of the world, not to be using it fully; for this world's way of life will quickly come to an end.

chinese: 我願你們無所罣慮。沒有娶妻的，是為主的事罣慮，想怎樣叫主喜悅。
english: But it is my desire for you to be free from cares. The unmarried man gives his mind to the things of the Lord, how he may give pleasure to the Lord:

chinese: 娶了妻的，是為世上的事罣慮，想怎樣叫妻子喜悅。
english: But the married man gives his attention to the things of this world, how he may give pleasure to his wife.

chinese: 婦人和處女也有分別。沒有出嫁的，是為主的事罣慮，要身體、靈魂都聖潔；已經出嫁的，是為世上的事罣慮，想怎樣叫丈夫喜悅。
english: And the wife is not the same as the virgin. The virgin gives her mind to the things of the Lord, so that she may be holy in body and in spirit: but the married woman takes thought for the things of the world, how she may give pleasure to her husband.

chinese: 我說這話是為你們的益處，不是要牢籠你們，乃是要叫你們行合宜的事，得以殷勤服事主，沒有分心的事。
english: Now I say this for your profit; not to make things hard for you, but because of what is right, and so that you may be able to give all your attention to the things of the Lord.

chinese: 若有人以為自己待他的女兒不合宜，女兒也過了年歲，事又當行，他就可隨意辦理，不算有罪，叫二人成親就是了。
english: But if, in any man's opinion, he is not doing what is right for his virgin, if she is past her best years, and there is need for it, let him do what seems right to him; it is no sin; let them be married.

chinese: 倘若人心裡堅定，沒有不得已的事，並且由得自己作主，心裡又決定了留下女兒不出嫁，如此行也好。
english: But the man who is strong in mind and purpose, who is not forced but has control over his desires, does well if he comes to the decision to keep her a virgin.

chinese: 這樣看來，叫自己的女兒出嫁是好，不叫他出嫁更是好。
english: So then, he who gets married to his virgin does well, and he who keeps her unmarried does better.

chinese: 丈夫活著的時候，妻子是被約束的；丈夫若死了，妻子就可以自由，隨意再嫁，只是要嫁這在主裡面的人。
english: It is right for a wife to be with her husband as long as he is living; but when her husband is dead, she is free to be married to another; but only to a Christian.

chinese: 然而按我的意見，若常守節更有福氣。我也想自己是被神的靈感動了。
english: But it will be better for her to keep as she is, in my opinion: and it seems to me that I have the Spirit of God.

chinese: 論到祭偶像之物，我們曉得我們都有知識。但知識是叫人自高自大，惟有愛心能造就人。
english: Now about things offered to images: we all seem to ourselves to have knowledge. Knowledge gives pride, but love gives true strength.

chinese: 若有人以為自己知道甚麼，按他所當知道的，他仍是不知道。
english: If anyone seems to himself to have knowledge, so far he has not the right sort of knowledge about anything;

chinese: 若有人愛神，這人乃是神所知道的。
english: But if anyone has love for God, God has knowledge of him.

chinese: 論到吃祭偶像之物，我們知道偶像在世上算不得甚麼，也知道神只有一位，再沒有別的神。
english: So, then, as to the question of taking food offered to images, we are certain that an image is nothing in the world, and that there is no God but one.

chinese: 雖有稱為神的，或在天，或在地，就如那許多的神，許多的主；
english: For though there are those who have the name of gods, in heaven or on earth, as there are a number of gods and a number of lords,

chinese: 然而我們只有一位神，就是父，萬物都本於他；我們也歸於他─並有一位主，就是耶穌基督─萬物都是藉著他有的；我們也是藉著他有的。
english: There is for us only one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we are for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we have our being through him.

chinese: 但人不都有這等知識。有人到如今因拜慣了偶像，就以為所吃的是祭偶像之物。他們的良心既然軟弱，也就污穢了。
english: Still, all men have not that knowledge: but some, being used till now to the image, are conscious that they are taking food which has been offered to the image; and because they are not strong in the faith, their minds are troubled.

chinese: 其實食物不能叫神看中我們，因為我們不吃也無損，吃也無益。
english: But God's approval of us is not based on the food we take: if we do not take it we are no worse for it; and if we take it we are no better.

chinese: 只是你們要謹慎，恐怕你們這自由竟成了那軟弱人的絆腳石。
english: But take care that this power of yours does not give cause for trouble to the feeble.

chinese: 若有人見你這有知識的，在偶像的廟裡坐席，這人的良心，若是軟弱，豈不放膽去吃那祭偶像之物麼？
english: For if a man sees you, who have knowledge, taking food as a guest in the house of an image, will it not give him, if he is feeble, the idea that he may take food offered to images?

chinese: 因此，基督為他死的那軟弱弟兄，也就因你的知識沉淪了。
english: And so, through your knowledge, you are the cause of destruction to your brother, for whom Christ underwent death.

chinese: 你們這樣得罪弟兄們，傷了他們軟弱的良心，就是得罪基督。
english: And in this way, doing evil to the brothers, and causing trouble to those whose faith is feeble, you are sinning against Christ.

chinese: 所以，食物若叫我弟兄跌倒，我就永遠不吃肉，免得叫我弟兄跌倒了。
english: For this reason, if food is a cause of trouble to my brother, I will give up taking meat for ever, so that I may not be a cause of trouble to my brother.

chinese: 我不是自由的麼？我不是使徒麼？我不是見過我們的主耶穌麼？你們不是我在主裡面所做之工麼？
english: Am I not free? am I not an Apostle? have I not seen Jesus our Lord? are you not my work in the Lord?

chinese: 假若在別人，我不是使徒，在你們，我總是使徒，因為你們在主裡正是我作使徒的印證。
english: If to others I am not an Apostle, at least I am one to you: for the fact that you are Christians is the sign that I am an Apostle.

chinese: 我對那盤問我的人就是這樣分訴：
english: My answer to those who are judging me is this.

chinese: 難道我們沒有權柄靠福音吃喝麼？
english: Have we no right to take food and drink?

chinese: 難道我們沒有權柄娶信主的姊妹為妻，帶著一同往來，彷彿其餘的使徒和主的弟兄並磯法一樣麼？
english: Have we no right to take about with us a Christian wife, like the rest of the Apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

chinese: 獨有我與巴拿巴沒有權柄不做工麼？
english: Or I only and Barnabas, have we no right to take a rest from work?

chinese: 有誰當兵自備糧餉呢？有誰栽葡萄園不吃園裡的果子呢？有誰牧養牛羊不吃牛羊的奶呢？
english: Who ever goes to war without looking to someone to be responsible for his payment? who puts in vines and does not take the fruit of them? or who takes care of sheep without drinking of their milk?

chinese: 我說這話，豈是照人的意見；律法不也是這樣說麼？
english: Am I talking as a man? does not the law say the same?

chinese: 就如摩西的律法記著說：牛在場上踹穀的時候，不可籠住他的嘴。難道神所掛念的是牛麼？
english: For it says in the law of Moses, It is not right to keep the ox from taking the grain when he is crushing it. Is it for the oxen that God is giving orders?

chinese: 不全是為我們說的麼？分明是為我們說的。因為耕種的當存著指望去耕種；打場的也當存得糧的指望去打場。
english: Or has he us in mind? Yes, it was said for us; because it is right for the ploughman to do his ploughing in hope, and for him who is crushing the grain to do his work hoping for a part in the fruits of it.

chinese: 我們若把屬靈的種子撒在你們中間，就是從你們收割奉養肉身之物這還算大事麼？
english: If we have been planting the things of the Spirit for you, does it seem a great thing for you to give us a part in your things of this world?

chinese: 若別人在你們身上有這權柄，何況我們呢？然而，我們沒有用過這權柄，倒凡事忍受，免得基督的福音被阻隔。
english: If others have a part in this right over you, have we not even more? But we did not make use of our right, so that we might put nothing in the way of the good news of Christ.

chinese: 你們豈不知為聖事勞碌的就吃殿中的物麼？伺候祭壇的就分領壇上的物麼？
english: Do you not see that the servants of the holy things get their living from the Temple, and the servants of the altar have their part in the food which is offered on the altar?

chinese: 主也是這樣命定，叫傳福音的靠著福音養生。
english: Even so did the Lord give orders that the preachers of the good news might get their living from the good news.

chinese: 但這權柄我全沒有用過。我寫這話，並非要你們這樣待我，因為我寧可死也不叫人使我所誇的落了空。
english: But I have not made use of any of these things: and I am not writing this in the hope that it may be so for me: for it would be better for me to undergo death, than for any man to make this pride of mine of no effect.

chinese: 我傳福音原沒有可誇的，因為我是不得已的。若不傳福音，我便有禍了。
english: For if I am a preacher of the good news, I have no cause for pride in this; because I am forced to do so, for a curse is on me if I do not.

chinese: 我若甘心做這事，就有賞賜；若不甘心，責任卻已經託付我了。
english: But if I do it gladly, I have a reward; and if not, I am under orders to do it.

chinese: 既是這樣，我的賞賜是甚麼呢？就是我傳福音的時候叫人不花錢得福音，免得用盡我傳福音的權柄。
english: What then is my reward? This, that when I am giving the good news, I may give it without payment, not making use of my rights as a preacher of the good news.

chinese: 我雖是自由的，無人轄管；然而我甘心作了眾人的僕人，為要多得人。
english: For though I was free from all men, I made myself a servant to all, so that more might have salvation.

chinese: 向猶太人，我就作猶太人，為要得猶太人；向律法以下的人，我雖不在律法以下，還是作律法以下的人，為要得律法以下的人。
english: And to the Jews I was as a Jew, so that I might give the good news to them; to those under the law I was the same, not as being myself under the law, but so that I might give the good news to those under the law.

chinese: 向沒有律法的人，我就作沒有律法的人，為要得沒有律法的人；其實我在神面前，不是沒有律法；在基督面前，正在律法之下。
english: To those without the law I was as one without the law, not as being without law to God, but as under law to Christ, so that I might give the good news to those without the law.

chinese: 向軟弱的人，我就作軟弱的人，為要得軟弱的人。向甚麼樣的人，我就作甚麼樣的人。無論如何，總要救些人。
english: To the feeble, I was as one who is feeble, so that they might have salvation: I have been all things to all men, so that some at least might have salvation.

chinese: 凡我所行的，都是為福音的緣故，為要與人同得這福音的好處。
english: And I do all things for the cause of the good news, so that I may have a part in it.

chinese: 豈不知在場上賽跑的都跑，但得獎賞的只有一人？你們也當這樣跑，好叫你們得著獎賞。
english: Do you not see that in a running competition all take part, but only one gets the reward? So let your minds be fixed on the reward.

chinese: 凡較力爭勝的，諸事都有節制，他們不過是要得能壞的冠冕；我們卻是要得不能壞的冠冕。
english: And every man who takes part in the sports has self-control in all things. Now they do it to get a crown which is of this world, but we for an eternal crown.

chinese: 所以，我奔跑不像無定向的；我鬥拳不像打空氣的。
english: So then I am running, not uncertainly; so I am fighting, not as one who gives blows in the air:

chinese: 我是攻克己身，叫身服我，恐怕我傳福音給別人，自己反被棄絕了。
english: But I give blows to my body, and keep it under control, for fear that, after having given the good news to others, I myself might not have God's approval.

chinese: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不曉得，我們的祖宗從前都在雲下，都從海中經過，
english: For it is my desire, my brothers, that you may keep in mind how all our fathers were under the cloud, and they all went through the sea;

chinese: 都在雲裡、海裡受洗歸了摩西；
english: And they all had baptism from Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

chinese: 並且都吃了一樣的靈食，
english: And they all took the same holy food;

chinese: 也都喝了一樣的靈水。所喝的，是出於隨著他們的靈磐石；那磐石就是基督。
english: And the same holy drink: for they all took of the water from the holy rock which came after them: and the rock was Christ.

chinese: 但他們中間多半是神不喜歡的人，所以在曠野倒斃。
english: But with most of them God was not pleased: for they came to their end in the waste land.

chinese: 這些事都是我們的鑑戒，叫我們不要貪戀惡事，像他們那樣貪戀的；
english: Now these things were for an example to us, so that our hearts might not go after evil things, as they did.

chinese: 也不要拜偶像，像他們有人拜的。如經上所記：百姓坐下吃喝，起來玩耍。
english: Then do not go after false gods, as some of them did; as it is said in the holy Writings, After resting and feasting, the people got up to take their pleasure.

chinese: 我們也不要行姦淫，像他們有人行的，一天就倒斃了二萬三千人；
english: Again, let us not give way to the desires of the flesh, as some of them did, of whom twenty-three thousand came to their end in one day.

chinese: 也不要試探主（有古卷：基督），像他們有人試探的，就被蛇所滅。
english: And let us not put the Lord to the test, as some of them did, and came to their death by snakes.

chinese: 你們也不要發怨言，像他們有發怨言的，就被滅命的所滅。
english: And do not say evil things against the Lord, as some of them did, and destruction overtook them.

chinese: 他們遭遇這些事，都要作為鑑戒；並且寫在經上，正是警戒我們這末世的人。
english: Now these things were done as an example; and were put down in writing for our teaching, on whom the last days have come.

chinese: 所以，自己以為站得穩的，須要謹慎，免得跌倒。
english: So let him who seems to himself to be safe go in fear of a fall.

chinese: 你們所遇見的試探，無非是人所能受的。神是信實的，必不叫你們受試探過於所能受的；在受試探的時候，總要給你們開一條出路，叫你們能忍受得住。
english: You have been put to no test but such as is common to man: and God is true, who will not let any test come on you which you are not able to undergo; but he will make with the test a way out of it, so that you may be able to go through it.

chinese: 我所親愛的弟兄阿，你們要逃避拜偶像的事。
english: For this cause, my dear brothers, give no worship to false gods.

chinese: 我好像對明白人說的，你們要審察我的話。
english: What I am saying is for wise men, do you be the judges of it.

chinese: 我們所祝福的杯，豈不是同領基督的血麼？我們所擘開的餅，豈不是同領基督的身體麼？
english: The cup of blessing which we take, does it not give us a part in the blood of Christ? and is not the broken bread a taking part in the body of Christ?

chinese: 我們雖多，仍是一個餅，一個身體，因為我們都是分受這一個餅。
english: Because we, being a number of persons, are one bread, we are one body: for we all take part in the one bread.

chinese: 你們看屬肉體的以色列人，那吃祭物的豈不是在祭壇上有分麼？
english: See Israel after the flesh: do not those who take as food the offerings of the altar take a part in the altar?

chinese: 我是怎麼說呢？豈是說祭偶像之物算得甚麼呢？或說偶像算得甚麼呢？
english: Do I say, then, that what is offered to images is anything, or that the image is anything?

chinese: 我乃是說，外邦人所獻的祭是祭鬼，不是祭神。我不願意你們與鬼相交。
english: What I say is that the things offered by the Gentiles are offered to evil spirits and not to God; and it is not my desire for you to have any part with evil spirits.

chinese: 你們不能喝主的杯又喝鬼的杯，不能吃主的筵席又吃鬼的筵席。
english: It is not possible for you, at the same time, to take the cup of the Lord and the cup of evil spirits; you may not take part in the table of the Lord and the table of evil spirits.

chinese: 我們可惹主的憤恨麼？我們比他還有能力麼？
english: Or may we be the cause of envy to the Lord? are we stronger than he?

chinese: 凡事都可行，但不都有益處。凡事都可行，但不都造就人。
english: We are free to do all things, but there are things which it is not wise to do. We are free to do all things, but not all things are for the common good.

chinese: 無論何人，不要求自己的益處，乃要求別人的益處。
english: Let a man give attention not only to what is good for himself, but equally to his neighbour's good.

chinese: 凡市上所賣的，你們只管吃，不要為良心的緣故問甚麼話，
english: Whatever meat may be had at the public market, take as food without question of right or wrong;

chinese: 因為地和其中所充滿的都屬乎主。
english: For the earth is the Lord's and all things in it.

chinese: 倘有一個不信的人請你們赴席，你們若願意去，凡擺在你們面前的，只管吃，不要為良心的緣故問甚麼話。
english: If a Gentile makes a feast for you, and you are pleased to go as a guest, take whatever is put before you, without question of right or wrong.

chinese: 若有人對你們說：這是獻過祭的物，就要為那告訴你們的人，並為良心的緣故不吃。
english: But if anyone says to you, This food has been used as an offering, do not take it, on account of him who said it, and on account of his sense of right and wrong:

chinese: 我說的良心不是你的，乃是他的。我這自由為甚麼被別人的良心論斷呢？
english: Right and wrong, I say, not for you, but for the other man; for the fact that I am free is not dependent on another man's sense of right or wrong.

chinese: 我若謝恩而吃，為甚麼因我謝恩的物被人毀謗呢？
english: But if I give praise to God for the food which I take, let no man say evil of me for that reason.

chinese: 所以，你們或吃或喝，無論做甚麼，都要為榮耀神而行。
english: So then, if it is a question of food or drink, or any other thing, whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

chinese: 不拘是猶太人，是希利尼人，是神的教會，你們都不要使他跌倒；
english: Give no cause of trouble to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the church of God.

chinese: 就好像我凡事都叫眾人喜歡，不求自己的益處，只求眾人的益處，叫他們得救。
english: Even as I give way to all men in all things, not looking for profit for myself, but for the good of others, that they may get salvation.

chinese: 你們該效法我，像我效法基督一樣。
english: So take me for your example, even as I take Christ for mine.

chinese: 我稱讚你們，因你們凡事記念我，又堅守我所傳給你們的。
english: Now I am pleased to see that you keep me in memory in all things, and that you give attention to the teaching which was handed down from me to you.

chinese: 我願意你們知道，基督是各人的頭；男人是女人的頭；神是基督的頭。
english: But it is important for you to keep this fact in mind, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.

chinese: 凡男人禱告或是講道（或作：說預言；下同），若蒙著頭，就羞辱自己的頭。
english: Every man who takes part in prayer, or gives teaching as a prophet, with his head covered, puts shame on his head.

chinese: 凡女人禱告或是講道，若不蒙著頭，就羞辱自己的頭，因為這就如同剃了頭髮一樣。
english: But every woman who does so with her head unveiled, puts shame on her head: for it is the same as if her hair was cut off.

chinese: 女人若不蒙著頭，就該剪了頭髮；女人若以剪髮、剃髮為羞愧，就該蒙著頭。
english: For if a woman is not veiled, let her hair be cut off; but if it is a shame to a woman to have her hair cut off, let her be veiled.

chinese: 男人本不該蒙著頭，因為他是神的形像和榮耀；但女人是男人的榮耀。
english: For it is not right for a man to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

chinese: 起初，男人不是由女人而出，女人乃是由男人而出。
english: For the man did not come from the woman, but the woman from the man.

chinese: 並且男人不是為女人造的；女人乃是為男人造的。
english: And the man was not made for the woman, but the woman for the man.

chinese: 因此，女人為天使的緣故，應當在頭上有服權柄的記號。
english: For this reason it is right for the woman to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.

chinese: 然而照主的安排，女也不是無男，男也不是無女。
english: But the woman is not separate from the man, and the man is not separate from the woman in the Lord.

chinese: 因為女人原是由男人而出，男人也是由女人而出；但萬有都是出乎神。
english: For as the woman is from the man, so the man is through the woman; but all things are from God.

chinese: 你們自己審察，女人禱告神，不蒙著頭是合宜的麼？
english: Be judges yourselves of the question: does it seem right for a woman to take part in prayer unveiled?

chinese: 你們的本性不也指示你們，男人若有長頭髮，便是他的羞辱麼？
english: Does it not seem natural to you that if a man has long hair, it is a cause of shame to him?

chinese: 但女人有長頭髮，乃是他的榮耀，因為這頭髮是給他作蓋頭的。
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given to her for a covering.

chinese: 若有人想要辯駁，我們卻沒有這樣的規矩，神的眾教會也是沒有的。
english: But if any man will not be ruled in this question, this is not our way of doing things, and it is not done in the churches of God.

chinese: 我現今吩咐你們的話，不是稱讚你們；因為你們聚會不是受益，乃是招損。
english: But in giving you this order, there is one thing about which I am not pleased: it is that when you come together it is not for the better but for the worse.

chinese: 第一，我聽說，你們聚會的時候彼此分門別類，我也稍微的信這話。
english: For first of all, it has come to my ears that when you come together in the church, there are divisions among you, and I take the statement to be true in part.

chinese: 在你們中間不免有分門結黨的事，好叫那些有經驗的人顯明出來。
english: For divisions are necessary among you, in order that those who have God's approval may be clearly seen among you.

chinese: 你們聚會的時候，算不得吃主的晚餐；
english: But now, when you come together, it is not possible to take the holy meal of the Lord:

chinese: 因為吃的時候，各人先吃自己的飯，甚至這個飢餓，那個酒醉。
english: For when you take your food, everyone takes his meal before the other; and one has not enough food, and another is the worse for drink.

chinese: 你們要吃喝，難道沒有家麼？還是藐視神的教會，叫那沒有的羞愧呢？我向你們可怎麼說呢？可因此稱讚你們麼？我不稱讚！
english: What? have you not houses to take your meals in? or have you no respect for the church of God, putting the poor to shame? What am I to say to you? am I to give you praise? certainly not.

chinese: 我當日傳給你們的，原是從主領受的，就是主耶穌被賣的那一夜，拿起餅來，
english: For it was handed down to me from the Lord, as I gave it to you, that the Lord Jesus, on the night when Judas was false to him, took bread,

chinese: 祝謝了，就擘開，說：這是我的身體，為你們捨（有古卷：擘開）的，你們應當如此行，為的是記念我。
english: And when it had been broken with an act of praise, he said, This is my body which is for you: do this in memory of me.

chinese: 飯後，也照樣拿起杯來，說：這杯是用我的血所立的新約，你們每逢喝的時候，要如此行，為的是記念我。
english: In the same way, with the cup, after the meal, he said, This cup is the new testament in my blood: do this, whenever you take it, in memory of me.

chinese: 你們每逢吃這餅，喝這杯，是表明主的死，直等到他來。
english: For whenever you take the bread and the cup you give witness to the Lord's death till he comes.

chinese: 所以，無論何人，不按理吃主的餅，喝主的杯，就是干犯主的身、主的血了。
english: If, then, anyone takes the bread or the cup of the Lord in the wrong spirit, he will be responsible for the body and blood of the Lord.

chinese: 人應當自己省察，然後吃這餅、喝這杯。
english: But let no man take of the bread and the cup without testing himself.

chinese: 因為人吃喝，若不分辨是主的身體，就是吃喝自己的罪了。
english: For a man puts himself in danger, if he takes part in the holy meal without being conscious that it is the Lord's body.

chinese: 因此，在你們中間有好些軟弱的與患病的，死（原文是睡）的也不少。
english: For this cause a number of you are feeble and ill, and a number are dead.

chinese: 我們若是先分辨自己，就不至於受審。
english: But if we were true judges of ourselves, punishment would not come on us.

chinese: 我們受審的時候，乃是被主懲治，免得我們和世人一同定罪。
english: But if punishment does come, it is sent by the Lord, so that we may be safe when the world is judged.

chinese: 所以我弟兄們，你們聚會吃的時候，要彼此等待。
english: So then, my brothers, when you come together to the holy meal of the Lord, let there be waiting for one another.

chinese: 若有人飢餓，可以在家裡先吃，免得你們聚會，自己取罪。其餘的事，我來的時候再安排。
english: If any man is in need of food, let him take his meal in his house; so that you may not come together to your damage. And the rest I will put in order when I come.

chinese: 弟兄們，論到屬靈的恩賜，我不願意你們不明白。
english: But about the things of the spirit, my brothers, it is not right for you to be without teaching.

chinese: 你們作外邦人的時候，隨事被牽引，受迷惑，去服事那啞吧偶像，這是你們知道的。
english: You are conscious that when you were Gentiles, in whatever way you were guided, you went after images without voice or power.

chinese: 所以我告訴你們，被神的靈感動的，沒有說耶穌是可咒詛的；若不是被聖靈感動的，也沒有能說耶穌是主的。
english: So it is my desire for you to be clear about this; that no one is able to say by the Spirit of God that Jesus is cursed; and no one is able to say that Jesus is Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 恩賜原有分別，聖靈卻是一位。
english: Now there are different qualities given to men, but the same Spirit.

chinese: 職事也有分別，主卻是一位。
english: And there are different sorts of servants, but the same Lord.

chinese: 功用也有分別，神卻是一位，在眾人裡面運行一切的事。
english: And there are different operations, but the same God, who is working all things in all.

chinese: 聖靈顯在各人身上，是叫人得益處。
english: But to every man some form of the Spirit's working is given for the common good.

chinese: 這人蒙聖靈賜他智慧的言語，那人也蒙這位聖靈賜他知識的言語，
english: For to one are given words of wisdom through the Spirit; and to another words of knowledge through the same Spirit:

chinese: 又有一人蒙這位聖靈賜他信心，還有一人蒙這位聖靈賜他醫病的恩賜，
english: To another faith in the same Spirit; and to another the power of taking away disease, by the one Spirit;

chinese: 又叫一人能行異能，又叫一人能作先知，又叫一人能辨別諸靈，又叫一人能說方言，又叫一人能繙方言。
english: And to another the power of working wonders; and to another the prophet's word; and to another the power of testing spirits; to another different sorts of tongues; and to another the power of making clear the sense of the tongues:

chinese: 這一切都是這位聖靈所運行、隨己意分給各人的。
english: But all these are the operations of the one and the same Spirit, giving to every man separately as his pleasure is.

chinese: 就如身子是一個，卻有許多肢體；而且肢體雖多，仍是一個身子；基督也是這樣。
english: For as the body is one, and has a number of parts, and all the parts make one body, so is Christ.

chinese: 我們不拘是猶太人，是希利尼人，是為奴的，是自主的，都從一位聖靈受洗，成了一個身體，飲於一位聖靈。
english: For through the baptism of the one Spirit we were all formed into one body, Jews or Greeks, servants or free men, and were all made full of the same Spirit.

chinese: 身子原不是一個肢體，乃是許多肢體。
english: For the body is not one part, but a number of parts.

chinese: 設若腳說：我不是手，所以不屬乎身子；他不能因此就不屬乎身子。
english: If the foot says, Because I am not the hand, I am not a part of the body; it is no less a part of the body.

chinese: 設若耳說：我不是眼，所以不屬乎身子；他也不能因此就不屬乎身子。
english: And if the ear says, Because I am not the eye, I am not a part of the body; it is a part of the body all the same.

chinese: 若全身是眼，從那裡聽聲呢？若全身是耳，從那裡聞味呢？
english: If all the body was an eye, where would be the hearing? if all was hearing, where would be the smelling?

chinese: 但如今，神隨自己的意思把肢體俱各安排在身上了。
english: But now God has put every one of the parts in the body as it was pleasing to him.

chinese: 若都是一個肢體，身子在那裡呢？
english: And if they were all one part, where would the body be?

chinese: 但如今肢體是多的，身子卻是一個。
english: But now they are all different parts, but one body.

chinese: 眼不能對手說：我用不著你；頭也不能對腳說：我用不著你。
english: And the eye may not say to the hand, I have no need of you: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

chinese: 不但如此，身上肢體人以為軟弱的，更是不可少的。
english: No, those parts which seem to be feeble are the more necessary;

chinese: 身上肢體，我們看為不體面的，越發給他加上體面；不俊美的，越發得著俊美。
english: And to those parts of the body which seem to have less honour we give all the more honour; and to those parts of the body which are a cause of shame to us we give the greater respect;

chinese: 我們俊美的肢體，自然用不著裝飾；但神配搭這身子，把加倍的體面給那有缺欠的肢體，
english: But those parts of the body which are beautiful have no need of such care: and so the body has been joined together by God in such a way as to give more honour to those parts which had need of it;

chinese: 免得身上分門別類，總要肢體彼此相顧。
english: So that there might be no division in the body; but all the parts might have the same care for one another.

chinese: 若一個肢體受苦，所有的肢體就一同受苦；若一個肢體得榮耀，所有的肢體就一同快樂。
english: And if there is pain in one part of the body, all the parts will be feeling it; or if one part is honoured, all the parts will be glad.

chinese: 你們就是基督的身子，並且各自作肢體。
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and every one of you the separate parts of it.

chinese: 神在教會所設立的：第一是使徒，第二是先知，第三是教師，其次是行異能的，再次是得恩賜醫病的，幫助人的，治理事的，說方言的。
english: And God has put some in the church, first, Apostles; second, prophets; third, teachers; then those with wonder-working powers, then those with the power of taking away disease, helpers, wise guides, users of strange tongues.

chinese: 豈都是使徒麼？豈都是先知麼？豈都是教師麼？豈都是行異能的麼？
english: Are all Apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? have all the power of working wonders?

chinese: 豈都是得恩賜醫病的麼？豈都是說方言的麼？豈都是繙方言的麼？
english: Are all able to take away disease? have all the power of tongues? are all able to give their sense?

chinese: 你們要切切的求那更大的恩賜。我現今把最妙的道指示你們。
english: But let your desires be turned to the more important things given by the Spirit. And now I am pointing out to you an even better way.

chinese: 我若能說萬人的方言，並天使的話語，卻沒有愛，我就成了鳴的鑼，響的鈸一般。
english: If I make use of the tongues of men and of angels, and have not love, I am like sounding brass, or a loud-tongued bell.

chinese: 我若有先知講道之能，也明白各樣的奧祕，各樣的知識，而且有全備的信，叫我能夠移山，卻沒有愛，我就算不得甚麼。
english: And if I have a prophet's power, and have knowledge of all secret things; and if I have all faith, by which mountains may be moved from their place, but have not love, I am nothing.

chinese: 我若將所有的賙濟窮人，又捨己身叫人焚燒，卻沒有愛，仍然與我無益。
english: And if I give all my goods to the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it is of no profit to me.

chinese: 愛是恆久忍耐，又有恩慈；愛是不嫉妒；愛是不自誇，不張狂，
english: Love is never tired of waiting; love is kind; love has no envy; love has no high opinion of itself, love has no pride;

chinese: 不做害羞的事，不求自己的益處，不輕易發怒，不計算人的惡，
english: Love's ways are ever fair, it takes no thought for itself; it is not quickly made angry, it takes no account of evil;

chinese: 不喜歡不義，只喜歡真理；
english: It takes no pleasure in wrongdoing, but has joy in what is true;

chinese: 凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。
english: Love has the power of undergoing all things, having faith in all things, hoping all things.

chinese: 愛是永不止息。先知講道之能終必歸於無有；說方言之能終必停止；知識也終必歸於無有。
english: Though the prophet's word may come to an end, tongues come to nothing, and knowledge have no more value, love has no end.

chinese: 我們現在所知道的有限，先知所講的也有限，
english: For our knowledge is only in part, and the prophet's word gives only a part of what is true:

chinese: 等那完全的來到，這有限的必歸於無有了。
english: But when that which is complete is come, then that which is in part will be no longer necessary.

chinese: 我作孩子的時候，話語像孩子，心思像孩子，意念像孩子，既成了人，就把孩子的事丟棄了。
english: When I was a child, I made use of a child's language, I had a child's feelings and a child's thoughts: now that I am a man, I have put away the things of a child.

chinese: 我們如今彷彿對著鏡子觀看，糢糊不清（原文作：如同猜謎）；到那時就要面對面了。我如今所知道的有限，到那時就全知道，如同主知道我一樣。
english: For now we see things in a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now my knowledge is in part; then it will be complete, even as God's knowledge of me.

chinese: 如今常存的有信，有望，有愛這三樣，其中最大的是愛。
english: But now we still have faith, hope, love, these three; and the greatest of these is love.

chinese: 你們要追求愛，也要切慕屬靈的恩賜，其中更要羨慕的，是作先知講道（原文作：是說預言；下同）
english: Go after love; still desiring to have the things which the Spirit gives, but most of all that you may have the prophet's power.

chinese: 那說方言的，原不是對人說，乃是對神說，因為沒有人聽出來。然而，他在心靈裡卻是講說各樣的奧祕。
english: For he who makes use of tongues is not talking to men but to God; because no one has the sense of what he is saying; but in the Spirit he is talking of secret things.

chinese: 但作先知講道的，是對人說，要造就、安慰、勸勉人。
english: But the word of the prophet gives men knowledge and comfort and strength.

chinese: 說方言的，是造就自己；作先知講道的，乃是造就教會。
english: He who makes use of tongues may do good to himself; but he who gives the prophet's word does good to the church.

chinese: 我願意你們都說方言，更願意你們作先知講道；因為說方言的，若不繙出來，使教會被造就，那作先知講道的，就比他強了。
english: Now though it is my desire for you all to have the power of tongues, it would give me more pleasure to be hearing the prophet's word from you; for this is a greater thing than using tongues, if the sense is not given at the same time, for the good of the church.

chinese: 弟兄們，我到你們那裡去，若只說方言，不用啟示，或知識，或預言，或教訓，給你們講解，我與你們有甚麼益處呢？
english: But, now, my brothers, if I come to you using tongues, what profit will it be to you, if I do not give you a revelation, or knowledge, or the word of the prophet, or teaching?

chinese: 就是那有聲無氣的物，或簫，或琴，若發出來的聲音沒有分別，怎能知道所吹所彈的是甚麼呢？
english: Even things without life, having a voice, such as a music-pipe or other instrument, if they do not give out different sounds, who may be certain what is being played?

chinese: 若吹無定的號聲，誰能預備打仗呢？
english: For if the war-horn gives out an uncertain note, who will get ready for the fight?

chinese: 你們也是如此。舌頭若不說容易明白的話，怎能知道所說的是甚麼呢？這就是向空說話了。
english: So if you, in using a strange tongue, say words which have no sense, how will anyone take in what you are saying? for you will be talking to the air.

chinese: 世上的聲音，或者甚多，卻沒有一樣是無意思的。
english: There are, it may be, a number of different voices in the world, and no voice is without sense.

chinese: 我若不明白那聲音的意思，這說話的人必以我為化外之人，我也以他為化外之人。
english: But if the sense of the voice is not clear to me, I am like a man from a strange country to him who is talking, and he will be the same to me.

chinese: 你們也是如此，既是切慕屬靈的恩賜，就當求多得造就教會的恩賜。
english: So if you are desiring the things which the Spirit gives, let your minds be turned first to the things which are for the good of the church.

chinese: 所以那說方言的，就當求著能繙出來。
english: For this reason, let the man who has the power of using tongues make request that he may, at the same time, be able to give the sense.

chinese: 我若用方言禱告，是我的靈禱告，但我的悟性沒有果效。
english: For if I make use of tongues in my prayers, my spirit makes the prayer, but not my mind.

chinese: 這卻怎麼樣呢？我要用靈禱告，也要用悟性禱告；我要用靈歌唱，也要用悟性歌唱。
english: What then? let my prayer be from the spirit, and equally from the mind; let my song be from the spirit, and equally from mind.

chinese: 不然，你用靈祝謝，那在座不通方言的人，既然不明白你的話，怎能在你感謝的時候說阿們呢？
english: For if you give a blessing with the spirit, how will the man who has no knowledge say, So be it, after your prayer, seeing that he has not taken in what you are saying?

chinese: 你感謝的固然是好，無奈不能造就別人。
english: For your giving of the blessing is certainly well done, but of no profit to the man without knowledge.

chinese: 我感謝神，我說方言比你們眾人還多。
english: I give praise to God that I am able to make use of tongues more than you all:

chinese: 但在教會中，寧可用悟性說五句教導人的話，強如說萬句方言。
english: But in the church it would be better for me to make use of five words of which the sense was clear, so that others might have profit, than ten thousand words in a strange tongue.

chinese: 弟兄們，在心志上不要作小孩子。然而，在惡事上要作嬰孩，在心志上總要作大人。
english: My brothers, do not be children in mind: in evil be as little children, but in mind be of full growth.

chinese: 律法上記著：主說：我要用外邦人的舌頭和外邦人的嘴唇向這百姓說話；雖然如此，他們還是不聽從我。
english: In the law it is said, By men of other tongues and by strange lips will my words come to this people; and not even so will they give ear to me, says the Lord.

chinese: 這樣看來，說方言不是為信的人作證據，乃是為不信的人；作先知講道不是為不信的人作證據，乃是為信的人。
english: For this reason tongues are for a sign, not to those who have faith, but to those who have not: but the prophet's word is for those who have faith, and not for the rest who have not.

chinese: 所以，全教會聚在一處的時候，若都說方言，偶然有不通方言的，或是不信的人進來，豈不說你們癲狂了麼？
english: If, then, the church has come together, and all are using tongues, and there come in men without knowledge or faith, will they not say that you are unbalanced?

chinese: 若都作先知講道，偶然有不信的，或是不通方言的人進來，就被眾人勸醒，被眾人審明，
english: But if all are teaching as prophets, and a man without faith or knowledge comes in, he is tested by all, he is judged by all;

chinese: 他心裡的隱情顯露出來，就必將臉伏地，敬拜神，說：神真是在你們中間了。
english: The secrets of his heart are made clear; and he will go down on his face and give worship to God, saying that God is truly among you.

chinese: 弟兄們，這卻怎麼樣呢？你們聚會的時候，各人或有詩歌，或有教訓，或有啟示，或有方言，或有繙出來的話，凡事都當造就人。
english: What is it then, my brothers? when you come together everyone has a holy song, or a revelation, or a tongue, or is giving the sense of it. Let everything be done for the common good.

chinese: 若有說方言的，只好兩個人，至多三個人，且要輪流著說，也要一個人繙出來。
english: If any man makes use of a tongue, let it not be more than two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let someone give the sense:

chinese: 若沒有人繙，就當在會中閉口，只對自己和神說就是了。
english: But if there is no one to give the sense, let him keep quiet in the church; and let his words be to himself and to God.

chinese: 至於作先知講道的，只好兩個人或是三個人，其餘的就當慎思明辨。
english: And let the prophets give their words, but not more than two or three, and let the others be judges of what they say.

chinese: 若旁邊坐著的得了啟示，那先說話的就當閉口不言。
english: But if a revelation is given to another who is seated near, let the first be quiet.

chinese: 因為你們都可以一個一個的作先知講道，叫眾人學道理，叫眾人得勸勉。
english: For you may all be prophets in turn so that all may get knowledge and comfort;

chinese: 先知的靈原是順服先知的；
english: And the spirits of the prophets are controlled by the prophets;

chinese: 因為神不是叫人混亂，乃是叫人安靜。
english: For God is not a God whose ways are without order, but a God of peace; as in all the churches of the saints.

chinese: 婦女在會中要閉口不言，像在聖徒的眾教會一樣，因為不准他們說話。他們總要順服，正如律法所說的。
english: Let women keep quiet in the churches: for it is not right for them to be talking; but let them be under control, as it says in the law.

chinese: 他們若要學甚麼，可以在家裡問自己的丈夫，因為婦女在會中說話原是可恥的。
english: And if they have a desire for knowledge about anything, let them put questions to their husbands privately: for talking in the church puts shame on a woman.

chinese: 神的道理豈是從你們出來麼？豈是單臨到你們麼？
english: What? was it from you that the word of God went out? or did it only come in to you?

chinese: 若有人以為自己是先知，或是屬靈的，就該知道，我所寫給你們的是主的命令。
english: If any man seems to himself to be a prophet or to have the Spirit, let him take note of the things which I am writing to you, as being the word of the Lord.

chinese: 若有不知道的，就由他不知道罷！
english: But if any man is without knowledge, let him be so.

chinese: 所以我弟兄們，你們要切慕作先知講道，也不要禁止說方言。
english: So then, my brothers, let it be your chief desire to be prophets; but let no one be stopped from using tongues.

chinese: 凡事都要規規矩矩的按著次序行。
english: Let all things be done in the right and ordered way.

chinese: 弟兄們，我如今把先前所傳給你們的福音告訴你們知道；這福音你們也領受了，又靠著站立得住，
english: Now I am going to make clear to you, my brothers, what the good news was which I gave to you, and which you took, and on which your faith is based,

chinese: 並且你們若不是徒然相信，能以持守我所傳給你們的，就必因這福音得救。
english: By which you have salvation; that is to say, the form in which it was given to you, if it is fixed in your minds, and if your faith in it is not without effect.

chinese: 我當日所領受又傳給你們的：第一，就是基督照聖經所說，為我們的罪死了，
english: For I gave to you first of all what was handed down to me, how Christ underwent death for our sins, as it says in the Writings;

chinese: 而且埋葬了；又照聖經所說，第三天復活了，
english: And he was put in the place of the dead; and on the third day he came back from the dead, as it says in the Writings;

chinese: 並且顯給磯法看，然後顯給十二使徒看；
english: And he was seen by Cephas; then by the twelve;

chinese: 後來一時顯給五百多弟兄看，其中一大半到如今還在，卻也有已經睡了的。
english: Then by more than five hundred brothers at the same time, most of whom are still living, but some are sleeping;

chinese: 以後顯給雅各看，再顯給眾使徒看，
english: Then he was seen by James; then by all the Apostles.

chinese: 末了也顯給我看；我如同未到產期而生的人一般。
english: And last of all, as by one whose birth was out of the right time, he was seen by me.

chinese: 我原是使徒中最小的，不配稱為使徒，因為我從前逼迫神的教會。
english: For I am the least of the Apostles, having no right to be named an Apostle, because of my cruel attacks on the church of God.

chinese: 然而，我今日成了何等人，是蒙神的恩才成的，並且他所賜我的恩不是徒然的。我比眾使徒格外勞苦；這原不是我，乃是神的恩與我同在。
english: But by the grace of God, I am what I am: and his grace which was given to me has not been for nothing; for I did more work than all of them; though not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

chinese: 不拘是我，是眾使徒，我們如此傳，你們也如此信了。
english: If then it is I who am the preacher, or they, this is our word, and to this you have given your faith.

chinese: 既傳基督是從死裡復活了，怎麼在你們中間有人說沒有死人復活的事呢？
english: Now if the good news says that Christ came back from the dead, how do some of you say that there is no coming back from the dead?

chinese: 若沒有死人復活的事，基督也就沒有復活了。
english: But if there is no coming back from the dead, then Christ has not come back from the dead:

chinese: 若基督沒有復活，我們所傳的便是枉然，你們所信的也是枉然；
english: And if Christ did not come again from the dead, then our good news and your faith in it are of no effect.

chinese: 並且明顯我們是為神妄作見證的，因我們見證神是叫基督復活了。若死人真不復活，神也就沒有叫基督復活了。
english: Yes, and we are seen to be false witnesses of God; because we gave witness of God that by his power Christ came again from the dead: which is not true if there is no coming back from the dead.

chinese: 因為死人若不復活，基督也就沒有復活了。
english: For if it is not possible for the dead to come to life again, then Christ has not come to life again:

chinese: 基督若沒有復活，你們的信便是徒然，你們仍在罪裡。
english: And if that is so, your faith is of no effect; you are still in your sins.

chinese: 就是在基督裡睡了的人也滅亡了。
english: And, in addition, the dead in Christ have gone to destruction.

chinese: 我們若靠基督，只在今生有指望，就算比眾人更可憐。
english: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most unhappy.

chinese: 但基督已經從死裡復活，成為睡了之人初熟的果子。
english: But now Christ has truly come back from the dead, the first-fruits of those who are sleeping.

chinese: 死既是因一人而來，死人復活也是因一人而來。
english: For as by man came death, so by man there is a coming back from the dead.

chinese: 在亞當裡眾人都死了；照樣，在基督裡眾人也都要復活。
english: For as in Adam death comes to all, so in Christ will all come back to life.

chinese: 但各人是按著自己的次序復活：初熟的果子是基督；以後，在他來的時候，是那些屬基督的。
english: But every man in his right order: Christ the first-fruits; then those who are Christ's at his coming.

chinese: 再後，末期到了，那時基督既將一切執政的、掌權的、有能的、都毀滅了，就把國交與父神。
english: Then comes the end, when he will give up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he will have put an end to all rule and to all authority and power.

chinese: 因為基督必要作王，等神把一切仇敵都放在他的腳下。
english: For his rule will go on till he has put all those who are against him under his feet.

chinese: 儘末了所毀滅的仇敵，就是死。
english: The last power to come to an end is death.

chinese: 因為經上說：神叫萬物都服在他的腳下。既說萬物都服了他，明顯那叫萬物服他的，不在其內了。
english: For, as it says, He has put all things under his feet. But when he says, All things are put under him, it is clear that it is not said about him who put all things under him.

chinese: 萬物既服了他，那時子也要自己服那叫萬物服他的，叫神在萬物之上，為萬物之主。
english: And when all things have been put under him, then will the Son himself be under him who put all things under him, so that God may be all in all.

chinese: 不然，那些為死人受洗的，將來怎樣呢？若死人總不復活，因何為他們受洗呢？
english: Again, what will they do who are given baptism for the dead? if the dead do not come back at all, why are people given baptism for them?

chinese: 我們又因何時刻冒險呢？
english: And why are we in danger every hour?

chinese: 弟兄們，我在我主基督耶穌裡，指著你們所誇的口極力的說，我是天天冒死。
english: Yes, truly, by your pride in me, my brothers in Christ Jesus our Lord, my life is one long death.

chinese: 我若當日像尋常人，在以弗所同野獸戰鬥，那於我有甚麼益處呢？若死人不復活，我們就吃吃喝喝罷！因為明天要死了。
english: If, after the way of men, I was fighting with beasts at Ephesus, what profit is it to me? If the dead do not come to life again, let us take our pleasure in feasting, for tomorrow we come to an end.

chinese: 你們不要自欺；濫交是敗壞善行。
english: Do not be tricked by false words: evil company does damage to good behaviour.

chinese: 你們要醒悟為善，不要犯罪，因為有人不認識神。我說這話是要叫你們羞愧。
english: Be awake to righteousness and keep yourselves from sin; for some have no knowledge of God: I say this to put you to shame.

chinese: 或有人問：死人怎樣復活，帶著甚麼身體來呢？
english: But someone will say, How do the dead come back? and with what sort of body do they come?

chinese: 無知的人哪，你所種的，若不死就不能生。
english: Foolish man, it is necessary for the seed which you put into the earth to undergo death in order that it may come to life again:

chinese: 並且你所種的不是那將來的形體，不過是子粒，即如麥子，或是別樣的穀。
english: And when you put it into the earth, you do not put in the body which it will be, but only the seed, of grain or some other sort of plant;

chinese: 但神隨自己的意思給他一個形體，並叫各等子粒各有自己的形體。
english: But God gives it a body, as it is pleasing to him, and to every seed its special body.

chinese: 凡肉體各有不同：人是一樣，獸又是一樣，鳥又是一樣，魚又是一樣。
english: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one flesh of men, another of beasts, another of birds, and another of fishes.

chinese: 有天上的形體，也有地上的形體；但天上形體的榮光是一樣，地上形體的榮光又是一樣。
english: And there are bodies of heaven and bodies of earth, but the glory of the one is different from that of the other.

chinese: 日有日的榮光，月有月的榮光，星有星的榮光。這星和那星的榮光也有分別。
english: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for the glory of one star is different from that of another.

chinese: 死人復活也是這樣：所種的是必朽壞的，復活的是不朽壞的；
english: So is it with the coming back from the dead. It is planted in death; it comes again in life:

chinese: 所種的是羞辱的，復活的是榮耀的；所種的是軟弱的，復活的是強壯的；
english: It is planted in shame; it comes again in glory: feeble when it is planted, it comes again in power:

chinese: 所種的是血氣的身體，復活的是靈性的身體。若有血氣的身體，也必有靈性的身體。
english: It is planted a natural body; it comes again as a body of the spirit. If there is a natural body, there is equally a body of the spirit.

chinese: 經上也是這樣記著說：首先的人亞當成了有靈（靈：或作血氣）的活人；末後的亞當成了叫人活的靈。
english: And so it is said, The first man Adam was a living soul. The last Adam is a life-giving spirit.

chinese: 但屬靈的不在先，屬血氣的在先，以後才有屬靈的。
english: But that which is natural comes before that which is of the spirit.

chinese: 頭一個人是出於地，乃屬土；第二個人是出於天。
english: The first man is from the earth, and of the earth: the second man is from heaven.

chinese: 那屬土的怎樣，凡屬土的也就怎樣；屬天的怎樣，凡屬天的也就怎樣。
english: Those who are of the earth are like the man who was from the earth: and those who are of heaven are like the one from heaven.

chinese: 我們既有屬土的形狀，將來也必有屬天的形狀。
english: And in the same way as we have taken on us the image of the man from the earth, so we will take on us the image of the one from heaven.

chinese: 弟兄們，我告訴你們說，血肉之體不能承受神的國，必朽壞的不能承受不朽壞的。
english: Now I say this, my brothers, that it is not possible for flesh and blood to have a part in the kingdom of God; and death may not have a part in life.

chinese: 我如今把一件奧祕的事告訴你們：我們不是都要睡覺，乃是都要改變，
english: See, I am giving you the revelation of a secret: we will not all come to the sleep of death, but we will all be changed.

chinese: 就在一霎時，眨眼之間，號筒末次吹響的時候。因號筒要響，死人要復活成為不朽壞的，我們也要改變。
english: In a second, in the shutting of an eye, at the sound of the last horn: for at that sound the dead will come again, free for ever from the power of death, and we will be changed.

chinese: 這必朽壞的總要變成（變成：原文是穿；下同）不朽壞的，這必死的總要變成不死的。
english: For this body which comes to destruction will be made free from the power of death, and the man who is under the power of death will put on eternal life.

chinese: 這必朽壞的既變成不朽壞的，這必死的既變成不死的，那時經上所記死被得勝吞滅的話就應驗了。
english: But when this has taken place, then that which was said in the Writings will come true, Death is overcome by life.

chinese: 死阿！你得勝的權勢在那裡？死阿！你的毒鉤在那裡？
english: O death, where is your power? O death, where are your pains?

chinese: 死的毒鉤就是罪，罪的權勢就是律法。
english: The pain of death is sin; and the power of sin is the law:

chinese: 感謝神，使我們藉著我們的主耶穌基督得勝。
english: But praise be to God who gives us strength to overcome through our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 所以，我親愛的弟兄們，你們務要堅固，不可搖動，常常竭力多做主工；因為知道，你們的勞苦在主裡面不是徒然的。
english: For this cause, my dear brothers, be strong in purpose and unmoved, ever giving yourselves to the work of the Lord, because you are certain that your work is not without effect in the Lord.

chinese: 論到為聖徒捐錢，我從前怎樣吩咐加拉太的眾教會，你們也當怎樣行。
english: Now about the giving of money for the saints, as I gave orders to the churches of Galatia, so do you.

chinese: 每逢七日的第一日，各人要照自己的進項抽出來留著，免得我來的時候現湊。
english: On the first day of the week, let every one of you put by him in store, in measure as he has done well in business, so that it may not be necessary to get money together when I come.

chinese: 及至我來到了，你們寫信舉薦誰，我就打發他們，把你們的捐資送到耶路撒冷去。
english: And when I come, I will send the men of your selection with letters to take the money you have got together to Jerusalem.

chinese: 若我也該去，他們可以和我同去。
english: And if it is possible for me to go there, they will go with me.

chinese: 我要從馬其頓經過；既經過了，就要到你們那裡去，
english: But I will come to you after I have gone through Macedonia, for that is my purpose;

chinese: 或者和你們同住幾時，或者也過冬。無論我往那裡去，你們就可以給我送行。
english: But I may be with you for a time, or even for the winter, so that you may see me on my way, wherever I go.

chinese: 我如今不願意路過見你們；主若許我，我就指望和你們同住幾時。
english: For it is not my desire to see you now, on my way; because it is my hope to be with you for some time, if that is the Lord's pleasure.

chinese: 但我要仍舊住在以弗所，直等到五旬節；
english: But I will be at Ephesus till Pentecost;

chinese: 因為有寬大又有功效的門為我開了，並且反對的人也多。
english: For a great and important door there is open to me, and there are a number of people against me.

chinese: 若是提摩太來到，你們要留心，叫他在你們那裡無所懼怕；因為他勞力做主的工，像我一樣。
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear; because he is doing the Lord's work, even as I am:

chinese: 所以，無論誰都不可藐視他，只要送他平安前行，叫他到我這裡來，因我指望他和弟兄們同來。
english: See then that he has the honour which is right. But send him on his way in peace, so that he may come to me: for I am looking for him with the brothers.

chinese: 至於兄弟亞波羅，我再三的勸他同弟兄們到你們那裡去；但這時他決不願意去，幾時有了機會他必去。
english: But as for Apollos, the brother, I had a great desire for him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not his pleasure to come now; but he will come when he has a chance.

chinese: 你們務要儆醒，在真道上站立得穩，要作大丈夫，要剛強。
english: Be on the watch, unmoved in the faith, and be strong like men.

chinese: 凡你們所做的都要憑愛心而做。
english: Let all you do be done in love.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們曉得司提反一家，是亞該亞初結的果子，並且他們專以服事聖徒為念。
english: Now I make my request to you, my brothers, for you have knowledge that the house of Stephanas is the first-fruits of Achaia, and that they have made themselves the servants of the saints,

chinese: 我勸你們順服這樣的人，並一切同工同勞的人。
english: That you put yourselves under such, and under everyone who is helping the Lord's work.

chinese: 司提反和福徒拿都，並亞該古到這裡來，我很喜歡；因為你們待我有不及之處，他們補上了。
english: And I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for they have done what was needed to make your work complete.

chinese: 他們叫我和你們心裡都快活。這樣的人，你們務要敬重。
english: For they gave comfort to my spirit and to yours: for which cause give respect to such people.

chinese: 亞西亞的眾教會問你們安。亞居拉和百基拉並在他們家裡的教會，因主多多的問你們安。
english: The churches of Asia send their love to you. So do Aquila and Prisca, with the church which is in their house.

chinese: 眾弟兄都問你們安。你們要親嘴問安，彼此務要聖潔。
english: All the brothers send their love to you. Give one another a holy kiss.

chinese: 我─保羅親筆問安。
english: I, Paul, send you these words of love in my writing.

chinese: 若有人不愛主，這人可詛可咒。主必要來！
english: If any man has not love for the Lord, let him be cursed. Maran atha (our Lord comes).

chinese: 願主耶穌基督的恩常與你們眾人同在！
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

chinese: 我在基督耶穌裡的愛與你們眾人同在。阿們！
english: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. So be it.

chinese: 奉神旨意作基督耶穌使徒的保羅和兄弟提摩太，寫信給在哥林多神的教會，並亞該亞遍處的眾聖徒。
english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, and Timothy the brother, to the church of God which is in Corinth, with all the saints who are in all Achaia:

chinese: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 願頌讚歸與我們的主耶穌基督的父神，就是發慈悲的父，賜各樣安慰的神。
english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort;

chinese: 我們在一切患難中，他就安慰我們，叫我們能用神所賜的安慰去安慰那遭各樣患難的人。
english: Who gives us comfort in all our troubles, so that we may be able to give comfort to others who are in trouble, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

chinese: 我們既多受基督的苦楚，就靠基督多得安慰。
english: For as we undergo more of the pain which Christ underwent, so through Christ does our comfort become greater.

chinese: 我們受患難呢，是為叫你們得安慰，得拯救；我們得安慰呢，也是為叫你們得安慰；這安慰能叫你們忍受我們所受的那樣苦楚。
english: But if we are troubled, it is for your comfort and salvation; or if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which takes effect through your quiet undergoing of the same troubles which we undergo:

chinese: 我們為你們所存的盼望是確定的，因為知道你們既是同受苦楚，也必同得安慰。
english: And our hope for you is certain; in the knowledge that as you take part in the troubles, so you will take part in the comfort.

chinese: 弟兄們，我們不要你們不曉得，我們從前在亞西亞遭遇苦難，被壓太重，力不能勝，甚至連活命的指望都絕了；
english: For it is our desire that you may not be without knowledge of our trouble which came on us in Asia, that the weight of it was very great, more than our power, so that it seemed that we had no hope even of life:

chinese: 自己心裡也斷定是必死的，叫我們不靠自己，只靠叫死人復活的神。
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the answer of death in ourselves, so that our hope might not be in ourselves, but in God who is able to give life to the dead:

chinese: 他曾救我們脫離那極大的死亡，現在仍要救我們，並且我們指望他將來還要救我們。
english: Who gave us salvation from so great a death: on whom we have put our hope that he will still go on to give us salvation;

chinese: 你們以祈禱幫助我們，好叫許多人為我們謝恩，就是為我們因許多人所得的恩。
english: You at the same time helping together by your prayer for us; so that for what has been given to us through a number of persons, praise may go up to God for us from all of them.

chinese: 我們所誇的是自己的良心，見證我們憑著神的聖潔和誠實；在世為人不靠人的聰明，乃靠神的恩惠，向你們更是這樣。
english: For our glory is in this, in the knowledge which we have that our way of life in the world, and most of all in relation to you, has been holy and true in the eyes of God; not in the wisdom of the flesh, but in the grace of God.

chinese: 我們現在寫給你們的話，並不外乎你們所念的，所認識的，我也盼望你們到底還是要認識；
english: For in our letters we say no other things to you, but those which you are reading, and to which you give agreement, and, it is my hope, will go on doing so to the end:

chinese: 正如你們已經有幾分認識我們，以我們誇口，好像我們在我們主耶穌的日子以你們誇口一樣。
english: Even as you have been ready, in part, to say that we are your glory, in the same way that you are ours, in the day of the Lord Jesus.

chinese: 我既然這樣深信，就早有意到你們那裡去，叫你們再得益處；
english: And being certain of this, it was my purpose to come to you before, so that you might have a second grace;

chinese: 也要從你們那裡經過，往馬其頓去，再從馬其頓回到你們那裡，叫你們給我送行往猶太去。
english: And by way of Corinth to go into Macedonia, and from there to come back again to you, so that you might send me on my way to Judaea.

chinese: 我有此意，豈是反復不定麼？我所起的意，豈是從情慾起的，叫我忽是忽非麼？
english: If then I had such a purpose, did I seem to be changing suddenly? or am I guided in my purposes by the flesh, saying, Yes, today, and, No, tomorrow?

chinese: 我指著信實的神說，我們向你們所傳的道，並沒有是而又非的。
english: As God is true, our word to you is not Yes and No.

chinese: 因為我和西拉並提摩太，在你們中間所傳神的兒子耶穌基督，總沒有是而又非的，在他只有一是。
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, whom we were preaching among you, even I and Silvanus and Timothy, was not Yes and No, but in him is Yes.

chinese: 神的應許，不論有多少，在基督都是是的。所以藉著他也都是實在（實在：原文是阿們）的，叫神因我們得榮耀。
english: For he is the Yes to all the undertakings of God: and by him all the words of God are made certain and put into effect, to the glory of God through us.

chinese: 那在基督裡堅固我們和你們，並且膏我們的就是神。
english: Now he who makes our faith strong together with you, in Christ, and has given us of his grace, is God;

chinese: 他又用印印了我們，並賜聖靈在我們心裡作憑據（原文是質）。
english: And it is he who has put his stamp on us, even the Spirit, as the sign in our hearts of the coming glory.

chinese: 我呼籲神給我的心作見證，我沒有往哥林多去是為要寬容你們。
english: But God is my witness that it was in pity for you that I did not come to Corinth at that time.

chinese: 我們並不是轄管你們的信心，乃是幫助你們的快樂，因為你們憑信才站立得住。
english: Not that we have authority over your faith, but we are helpers of your joy: for it is faith which is your support.

chinese: 我自己定了主意再到你們那裡去，必須大家沒有憂愁。
english: But it was my decision for myself, not to come again to you with sorrow.

chinese: 倘若我叫你們憂愁，除了我叫那憂愁的人以外，誰能叫我快樂呢？
english: For if I give you sorrow, who then will make me glad, but he who is made sad by me?

chinese: 我曾把這事寫給你們，恐怕我到的時候，應該叫我快樂的那些人，反倒叫我憂愁。我也深信，你們眾人都以我的快樂為自己的快樂。
english: And I said this very thing in my letter, for fear that when I came I might have sorrow from those from whom it was right for me to have joy; being certain of this, that my joy is the joy of you all.

chinese: 我先前心裡難過痛苦，多多的流淚，寫信給你們，不是叫你們憂愁，乃是叫你們知道我格外的疼愛你們。
english: For out of much trouble and pain of heart and much weeping I sent my letter to you; not to give you sorrow, but so that you might see how great is the love which I have to you.

chinese: 若有叫人憂愁的，他不但叫我憂愁，也是叫你們眾人有幾分憂愁。我說幾分，恐怕說得太重。
english: But if anyone has been a cause of sorrow, he has been so, not to me only, but in some measure to all of you (I say this that I may not be over-hard on you).

chinese: 這樣的人受了眾人的責罰也就夠了，
english: Let it be enough for such a man to have undergone the punishment which the church put on him;

chinese: 倒不如赦免他，安慰他，免得他憂愁太過，甚至沉淪了。
english: So that now, on the other hand, it is right for him to have forgiveness and comfort from you, for fear that his sorrow may be over-great.

chinese: 所以我勸你們，要向他顯出堅定不移的愛心來。
english: For which cause my desire is that you will make your love to him clear by your acts.

chinese: 為此我先前也寫信給你們，要試驗你們，看你們凡事順從不順從。
english: And for the same reason I sent you a letter so that I might be certain of your desire to do my orders in all things.

chinese: 你們赦免誰，我也赦免誰。我若有所赦免的，是在基督面前為你們赦免的；
english: But if you give forgiveness to anyone, I do the same: for if I have given forgiveness for anything, I have done it because of you, in the person of Christ;

chinese: 免得撒但趁著機會勝過我們，因我們並非不曉得他的詭計。
english: So that Satan may not get the better of us: for we are not without knowledge of his designs.

chinese: 我從前為基督的福音到了特羅亞，主也給我開了門。
english: Now when I came to Troas for the good news of Christ, and there was an open door for me in the Lord,

chinese: 那時，因為沒有遇見兄弟提多，我心裡不安，便辭別那裡的人往馬其頓去了。
english: I had no rest in my spirit because Titus my brother was not there: so I went away from them, and came into Macedonia.

chinese: 感謝神！常帥領我們在基督裡誇勝，並藉著我們在各處顯揚那因認識基督而有的香氣。
english: But praise be to God who makes us strong to overcome in Christ, and makes clear through us in every place the value of the knowledge of him.

chinese: 因為我們在神面前，無論在得救的人身上或滅亡的人身上，都有基督馨香之氣。
english: For we are a sweet perfume of Christ to God in those who are getting salvation and in those who are going to destruction;

chinese: 在這等人，就作了死的香氣叫他死；在那等人，就作了活的香氣叫他活。這事誰能當得起呢？
english: To the one it is a perfume of death to death; to the other a perfume of life to life. And who is enough for such things?

chinese: 我們不像那許多人，為利混亂神的道；乃是由於誠實，由於神，在神面前憑著基督講道。
english: For we are not like the great number who make use of the word of God for profit: but our words are true, as from God, being said as before God in Christ.

chinese: 我們豈是又舉薦自己麼？豈像別人用人的薦信給你們或用你們的薦信給人麼？
english: Do we seem to be again attempting to put ourselves in the right? or have we need, as some have, of letters of approval to you or from you?

chinese: 你們就是我們的薦信，寫在我們的心裡，被眾人所知道所念誦的。
english: You yourselves are our letter, whose writing is in our heart, open for every man's reading and knowledge;

chinese: 你們明顯是基督的信，藉著我們修成的。不是用墨寫的，乃是用永生神的靈寫的；不是寫在石版上，乃是寫在心版上。
english: For you are clearly a letter of Christ, the fruit of our work, recorded not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in stone, but in hearts of flesh.

chinese: 我們因基督，所以在神面前才有這樣的信心。
english: And this is the certain faith which we have in God through Christ:

chinese: 並不是我們憑自己能承擔甚麼事；我們所能承擔的，乃是出於神。
english: Not as if we were able by ourselves to do anything for which we might take the credit; but our power comes from God;

chinese: 他叫我們能承當這新約的執事，不是憑著字句，乃是憑著精意；因為那字句是叫人死，精意（或作：聖靈）是叫人活。
english: Who has made us able to be servants of a new agreement; not of the letter, but of the Spirit: for the letter gives death, but the Spirit gives life.

chinese: 那用字刻在石頭上屬死的職事尚且有榮光，甚至以色列人因摩西面上的榮光，不能定睛看他的臉；這榮光原是漸漸退去的，
english: For if the operation of the law, giving death, recorded in letters on stone, came with glory, so that the eyes of the children of Israel had to be turned away from the face of Moses because of its glory, a glory which was only for a time:

chinese: 何況那屬靈的職事豈不更有榮光麼？
english: Will not the operation of the Spirit have a much greater glory?

chinese: 若是定罪的職事有榮光，那稱義的職事榮光就越發大了。
english: For if the operation of the law, producing punishment, had its glory, how much greater will be the operation of the Spirit causing righteousness?

chinese: 那從前有榮光的，因這極大的榮光就算不得有榮光了；
english: For the glory of the first no longer seems to be glory, because of the greater glory of that which comes after.

chinese: 若那廢掉的有榮光，這長存的就更有榮光了。
english: For if the order which was for a time had its glory, much more will the eternal order have its glory.

chinese: 我們既有這樣的盼望，就大膽講說，
english: Having then such a hope, we keep nothing back,

chinese: 不像摩西將帕子蒙在臉上，叫以色列人不能定睛看到那將廢者的結局。
english: And are not like Moses, who put a veil on his face, so that the children of Israel might not see clearly to the end of the present order of things:

chinese: 但他們的心地剛硬，直到今日誦讀舊約的時候，這帕子還沒有揭去。這帕子在基督裡已經廢去了。
english: But their minds were made hard: for to this very day at the reading of the old agreement the same veil is still unlifted; though it is taken away in Christ.

chinese: 然而直到今日，每逢誦讀摩西書的時候，帕子還在他們心上。
english: But to this day, at the reading of the law of Moses, a veil is over their heart.

chinese: 但他們的心幾時歸向主，帕子就幾時除去了。
english: But when it is turned to the Lord, the veil will be taken away.

chinese: 主就是那靈；主的靈在那裡，那裡就得以自由。
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there the heart is free.

chinese: 我們眾人既然敞著臉得以看見主的榮光，好像從鏡子裡返照，就變成主的形狀，榮上加榮，如同從主的靈變成的。
english: But we all, with unveiled face giving back as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord who is the Spirit.

chinese: 我們既然蒙憐憫，受了這職分，就不喪膽，
english: For this reason, because we have been made servants of this new order, through the mercy given to us, we are strong:

chinese: 乃將那些暗昧可恥的事棄絕了；不行詭詐，不謬講神的道理，只將真理表明出來，好在神面前把自己薦與各人的良心。
english: And we have given up the secret things of shame, not walking in false ways, and not making use of the word of God with deceit; but by the revelation of what is true, as before God, we have the approval of every man's sense of right and wrong.

chinese: 如果我們的福音蒙蔽，就是蒙蔽在滅亡的人身上。
english: But if our good news is veiled, it is veiled from those who are on the way to destruction:

chinese: 此等不信之人被這世界的神弄瞎了心眼，不叫基督榮耀福音的光照著他們。基督本是神的像。
english: Because the god of this world has made blind the minds of those who have not faith, so that the light of the good news of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, might not be shining on them.

chinese: 我們原不是傳自己，乃是傳基督耶穌為主，並且自己因耶穌作你們的僕人。
english: For our preaching is not about ourselves, but about Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants through Jesus.

chinese: 那吩咐光從黑暗裡照出來的神，已經照在我們心裡，叫我們得知神榮耀的光顯在耶穌基督的面上。
english: Seeing that it is God who said, Let light be shining out of the dark, who has put in our hearts the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

chinese: 我們有這寶貝放在瓦器裡，要顯明這莫大的能力是出於神，不是出於我們。
english: But we have this wealth in vessels of earth, so that it may be seen that the power comes not from us but from God;

chinese: 我們四面受敵，卻不被困住；心裡作難，卻不至失望；
english: Troubles are round us on every side, but we are not shut in; things are hard for us, but we see a way out of them;

chinese: 遭逼迫，卻不被丟棄；打倒了，卻不至死亡。
english: We are cruelly attacked, but not without hope; we are made low, but we are not without help;

chinese: 身上常帶著耶穌的死，使耶穌的生也顯明在我們身上。
english: In our bodies there is ever the mark of the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may be seen in our bodies.

chinese: 因為我們這活著的人是常為耶穌被交於死地，使耶穌的生在我們這必死的身上顯明出來。
english: For, while living, we are still being given up to death because of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may be seen in our flesh, though it is under the power of death.

chinese: 這樣看來，死是在我們身上發動，生卻在你們身上發動。
english: So then, death is working in us, but life in you.

chinese: 但我們既有信心，正如經上記著說：我因信，所以如此說話。我們也信，所以也說話。
english: But having the same spirit of faith, as it is said in the Writings, The words of my mouth came from the faith in my heart; in the same way, our words are the outcome of our faith;

chinese: 自己知道那叫主耶穌復活的，也必叫我們與耶穌一同復活，並且叫我們與你們一同站在他面前。
english: Because we are certain that he who made the Lord Jesus come back from the dead, will do the same for us, and will give us a place in his glory with you.

chinese: 凡事都是為你們，好叫恩惠因人多越發加增，感謝格外顯多，以致榮耀歸與神。
english: For we go through all things on account of you, because the greater the number to whom the grace is given, the greater is the praise to the glory of God.

chinese: 所以，我們不喪膽。外體雖然毀壞，內心卻一天新似一天。
english: For which cause we do not give way to weariness; but though our outer man is getting feebler, our inner man is made new day by day.

chinese: 我們這至暫至輕的苦楚，要為我們成就極重無比、永遠的榮耀。
english: For our present trouble, which is only for a short time, is working out for us a much greater weight of glory;

chinese: 原來我們不是顧念所見的，乃是顧念所不見的；因為所見的是暫時的，所不見的是永遠的。
english: While our minds are not on the things which are seen, but on the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are for a time; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

chinese: 我們原知道，我們這地上的帳棚若拆毀了，必得神所造，不是人手所造，在天上永存的房屋。
english: For we are conscious that if this our tent of flesh is taken down, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in heaven.

chinese: 我們在這帳棚裡歎息，深想得那從天上來的房屋，好像穿上衣服；
english: For in this we are crying in weariness, greatly desiring to be clothed with our house from heaven:

chinese: 倘若穿上，被遇見的時候就不至於赤身了。
english: So that our spirits may not be unclothed.

chinese: 我們在這帳棚裡歎息勞苦，並非願意脫下這個，乃是願意穿上那個，好叫這必死的被生命吞滅了。
english: For truly, we who are in this tent do give out cries of weariness, for the weight of care which is on us; not because we are desiring to be free from the body, but so that we may have our new body, and death may be overcome by life.

chinese: 為此，培植我們的就是神，他又賜給我們聖靈作憑據（原文是質）。
english: Now he who has made us for this very thing is God, who has given us the Spirit as a witness of what is to come.

chinese: 所以，我們時常坦然無懼，並且曉得我們住在身內，便與主相離。
english: So, then, we are ever without fear, and though conscious that while we are in the body we are away from the Lord,

chinese: 因我們行事為人是憑著信心，不是憑著眼見。
english: (For we are walking by faith, not by seeing,)

chinese: 我們坦然無懼，是更願意離開身體與主同住。
english: We are without fear, desiring to be free from the body, and to be with the Lord.

chinese: 所以，無論是住在身內，離開身外，我們立了志向，要得主的喜悅。
english: For this reason we make it our purpose, in the body or away from it, to be well-pleasing to him.

chinese: 因為我們眾人必要在基督臺前顯露出來，叫各人按著本身所行的，或善或惡受報。
english: For we all have to come before Christ to be judged; so that every one of us may get his reward for the things done in the body, good or bad.

chinese: 我們既知道主是可畏的，所以勸人。但我們在神面前是顯明的，盼望在你們的良心裡也是顯明的。
english: Having in mind, then, the fear of the Lord, we put these things before men, but God sees our hearts; and it is my hope that we may seem right in your eyes.

chinese: 我們不是向你們再舉薦自己，乃是叫你們因我們有可誇之處，好對那憑外貌不憑內心誇口的人，有言可答。
english: We are not again requesting your approval, but we are giving you the chance of taking pride in us, so that you may be able to give an answer to those whose glory is in seeming, and not in the heart.

chinese: 我們若果顛狂，是為神；若果謹守，是為你們。
english: For if we are foolish, it is to God; or if we are serious, it is for you.

chinese: 原來基督的愛激勵我們；因我們想，一人既替眾人死，眾人就都死了；
english: For it is the love of Christ which is moving us; because we are of the opinion that if one was put to death for all, then all have undergone death;

chinese: 並且他替眾人死，是叫那些活著的人不再為自己活，乃為替他們死而復活的主活。
english: And that he underwent death for all, so that the living might no longer be living to themselves, but to him who underwent death for them and came back from the dead.

chinese: 所以，我們從今以後，不憑著外貌（原文是肉體；本節同）認人了。雖然憑著外貌認過基督，如今卻不再這樣認他了。
english: For this reason, from this time forward we have knowledge of no man after the flesh: even if we have had knowledge of Christ after the flesh, we have no longer any such knowledge.

chinese: 若有人在基督裡，他就是新造的人，舊事已過，都變成新的了。
english: So if any man is in Christ, he is in a new world: the old things have come to an end; they have truly become new.

chinese: 一切都是出於神；他藉著基督使我們與他和好，又將勸人與他和好的職分賜給我們。
english: But all things are of God, who has made us at peace with himself through Christ, and has given to us the work of making peace;

chinese: 這就是神在基督裡，叫世人與自己和好，不將他們的過犯歸到他們身上，並且將這和好的道理託付了我們。
english: That is, that God was in Christ making peace between the world and himself, not putting their sins to their account, and having given to us the preaching of this news of peace.

chinese: 所以，我們作基督的使者，就好像神藉我們勸你們一般。我們替基督求你們與神和好。
english: So we are the representatives of Christ, as if God was making a request to you through us: we make our request to you, in the name of Christ, be at peace with God.

chinese: 神使那無罪（無罪：原文是不知罪）的，替我們成為罪，好叫我們在他裡面成為神的義。
english: For him who had no knowledge of sin God made to be sin for us; so that we might become the righteousness of God in him.

chinese: 我們與神同工的，也勸你們不可徒受他的恩典。
english: We then, working together with God, make our request to you not to take the grace of God to no purpose.

chinese: 因為他說：在悅納的時候，我應允了你；在拯救的日子，我搭救了你。看哪！現在正是悅納的時候；現在正是拯救的日子。
english: (For he says, I have given ear to you at a good time, and I have been your helper in a day of salvation: see, now is the good time; now is the day of salvation):

chinese: 我們凡事都不叫人有妨礙，免得這職分被人毀謗；
english: Giving no cause for trouble in anything, so that no one may be able to say anything against our work;

chinese: 反倒在各樣的事上表明自己是神的用人，就如在許多的忍耐、患難、窮乏、困苦、
english: But in everything making it clear that we are the servants of God, in quiet strength, in troubles, in need, in sorrow,

chinese: 鞭打、監禁、擾亂、勤勞、儆醒、不食、
english: In blows, in prisons, in attacks, in hard work, in watchings, in going without food;

chinese: 廉潔、知識、恆忍、恩慈、聖靈的感化、無偽的愛心、
english: In a clean heart, in knowledge, in long waiting, in being kind, in the Holy Spirit, in true love,

chinese: 真實的道理、神的大能；仁義的兵器在左在右；
english: In the true word, in the power of God; with the arms of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

chinese: 榮耀、羞辱，惡名、美名；似乎是誘惑人的，卻是誠實的；
english: By glory and by shame, by an evil name and a good name; as untrue, and still true;

chinese: 似乎不為人所知，卻是人所共知的；似乎要死，卻是活著的；似乎受責罰，卻是不至喪命的；
english: Unnoted, but still kept fully in mind; as near to death, but still living; as undergoing punishment, but not put to death;

chinese: 似乎憂愁，卻是常常快樂的；似乎貧窮，卻是叫許多人富足的；似乎一無所有，卻是樣樣都有的。
english: As full of sorrow, but ever glad; as poor, but giving wealth to others; as having nothing, but still having all things.

chinese: 哥林多人哪，我們向你們，口是張開的，心是寬宏的。
english: Our mouth is open to you, O Corinthians, our heart is wide.

chinese: 你們狹窄，原不在乎我們，是在乎自己的心腸狹窄。
english: It is not our feelings to you which are narrow, but yours to us.

chinese: 你們也要照樣用寬宏的心報答我。我這話正像對自己的孩子說的。
english: Now to give me back payment of the same sort (I am talking as to my children), let your hearts be wide open to me.

chinese: 你們和不信的原不相配，不要同負一軛。義和不義有甚麼相交呢？光明和黑暗有甚麼相通呢？
english: Do not keep company with those who have not faith: for what is there in common between righteousness and evil, or between light and dark?

chinese: 基督和彼列（彼列就是撒但的別名）有甚麼相和呢？信主的和不信主的有甚麼相干呢？
english: And what agreement is there between Christ and the Evil One? or what part has one who has faith with one who has not?

chinese: 神的殿和偶像有甚麼相同呢？因為我們是永生神的殿，就如神曾說：我要在他們中間居住，在他們中間來往；我要作他們的神；他們要作我的子民。
english: And what agreement has the house of God with images? for we are a house of the living God; even as God has said, I will be living among them, and walking with them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.

chinese: 又說：你們務要從他們中間出來，與他們分別；不要沾不潔淨的物，我就收納你們。
english: For which cause, Come out from among them, and be separate, says the Lord, and let no unclean thing come near you; and I will take you for myself,

chinese: 我要作你們的父；你們要作我的兒女。這是全能的主說的。
english: And will be a Father to you; and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord, the Ruler of all.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，我們既有這等應許，就當潔淨自己，除去身體、靈魂一切的污穢，敬畏神，得以成聖。
english: Because God, then, will give us such rewards, dear brothers, let us make ourselves clean from all evil of flesh and spirit, and become completely holy in the fear of God.

chinese: 你們要心地寬大收納我們。我們未曾虧負誰，未曾敗壞誰，未曾佔誰的便宜。
english: Let your hearts be open to us: we have done no man wrong, no man has been damaged by us, we have made no profit out of any man,

chinese: 我說這話，不是要定你們的罪。我已經說過，你們常在我們心裡，情願與你們同生同死。
english: It is not with the purpose of judging you that I say this: for I have said before that you are in our hearts for life and death together.

chinese: 我大大的放膽，向你們說話；我因你們多多誇口，滿得安慰；我們在一切患難中分外的快樂。
english: My words to you are without fear, I am full of pride on account of you: I have great comfort and joy in all our troubles.

chinese: 我們從前就是到了馬其頓的時候，身體也不得安寧，周圍遭患難，外有爭戰，內有懼怕。
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; there were fightings outside and fears inside.

chinese: 但那安慰喪氣之人的神藉著提多來安慰了我們；
english: But God who gives comfort to the poor in spirit gave us comfort by the coming of Titus;

chinese: 不但藉著他來，也藉著他從你們所得的安慰，安慰了我們；因他把你們的想念、哀慟，和向我的熱心，都告訴了我，叫我更加歡喜。
english: And not by his coming only, but by the comfort which he had in you, while he gave us word of your desire, your sorrow, your care for me; so that I was still more glad.

chinese: 我先前寫信叫你們憂愁，我後來雖然懊悔，如今卻不懊悔；因我知道，那信叫你們憂愁不過是暫時的。
english: For though my letter gave you pain, I have no regret for it now, though I had before; for I see that the letter gave you pain, but only for a time.

chinese: 如今我歡喜，不是因你們憂愁，是因你們從憂愁中生出懊悔來。你們依著神的意思憂愁，凡事就不至於因我們受虧損了。
english: Now I am glad, not that you had sorrow, but that your sorrow was the cause of a change of heart; for yours was a holy sorrow so that you might undergo no loss by us in anything.

chinese: 因為依著神的意思憂愁，就生出沒有後悔的懊悔來。以致得救；但世俗的憂愁是叫人死。
english: For the sorrow which God gives is the cause of salvation through a change of heart, in which there is no reason for grief: but the sorrow of the world is a cause of death.

chinese: 你看，你們依著神的意思憂愁，從此就生出何等的慇懃、自訴、自恨、恐懼、想念、熱心、責罰（或作：自責）。在這一切事上，你們都表明自己是潔淨的。
english: For you see what care was produced in you by this very sorrow of yours before God, what clearing of yourselves, what wrath against sin, what fear, what desire, what serious purpose, what punishment. In everything you have made it clear that you are free from sin in this business.

chinese: 我雖然從前寫信給你們，卻不是為那虧負人的，也不是為那受人虧負的，乃要在神面前把你們顧念我們的熱心表明出來。
english: So though I sent you a letter, it was not only because of the man who did the wrong, or because of him to whom the wrong was done, but so that your true care for us might be made clear in the eyes of God.

chinese: 故此，我們得了安慰。並且在安慰之中，因你們眾人使提多心裡暢快歡喜，我們就更加歡喜了。
english: So we have been comforted: and we had the greater joy in our comfort because of the joy of Titus, for his spirit had been made glad by you all.

chinese: 我若對提多誇獎了你們甚麼，也覺得沒有慚愧；因我對提多誇獎你們的話成了真的，正如我對你們所說的話也都是真的。
english: For I was not put to shame in anything in which I may have made clear to him my pride in you; but as we said nothing to you but what was true, so the good things which I said to Titus about you were seen by him to be true.

chinese: 並且提多想起你們眾人的順服，是怎樣恐懼戰兢的接待他，他愛你們的心腸就越發熱了。
english: And his love to you is the more increased by his memory of you all, how you gave way to his authority, and how you took him to your hearts with fear and honour.

chinese: 我如今歡喜，能在凡事上為你們放心。
english: It gives me great joy to see you answering to my good opinion of you in every way.

chinese: 弟兄們，我把神賜給馬其頓眾教會的恩告訴你們，
english: And now we give you news, brothers, about the grace of God which has been given to the churches of Macedonia;

chinese: 就是他們在患難中受大試煉的時候，仍有滿足的快樂，在極窮之間還格外顯出他們樂捐的厚恩。
english: How while they were undergoing every sort of trouble, and were in the greatest need, they took all the greater joy in being able to give freely to the needs of others.
