chinese: 我可以證明，他們是按著力量，而且也過了力量，自己甘心樂意的捐助，
english: For I give them witness, that as they were able, and even more than they were able, they gave from the impulse of their hearts,

chinese: 再三的求我們，准他們在這供給聖徒的恩情上有分；
english: Seriously requesting us that they might have a part in this grace of being servants to the needs of the saints:

chinese: 並且他們所做的，不但照我們所想望的，更照神的旨意先把自己獻給主，又歸附了我們。
english: And going even farther than our hope, they first gave themselves to the Lord and to us after the purpose of God.

chinese: 因此我勸提多，既然在你們中間開辦這慈惠的事，就當辦成了。
english: So that we made a request to Titus that, as he had made a start before, so he might make this grace complete in you.

chinese: 你們既然在信心、口才、知識、熱心，和待我們的愛心上，都格外顯出滿足來，就當在這慈惠的事上也格外顯出滿足來。
english: And that as you are full of every good thing, of faith, of the word, of knowledge, of a ready mind, and of love to us, so you may be full of this grace in the same way.

chinese: 我說這話，不是吩咐你們，乃是藉著別人的熱心試驗你們愛心的實在。
english: I am not giving you an order, but using the ready mind of others as a test of the quality of your love.

chinese: 你們知道我們主耶穌基督的恩典：他本來富足，卻為你們成了貧窮，叫你們因他的貧窮，可以成為富足。
english: For you see the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, how though he had wealth, he became poor on your account, so that through his need you might have wealth.

chinese: 我在這事上把我的意見告訴你們，是與你們有益；因為你們下手辦這事，而且起此心意，已經有一年了，
english: And in this I give my opinion: for it is to your profit, who were the first to make a start a year before, not only to do this, but to make clear that your minds were more than ready to do it.

chinese: 如今就當辦成這事。既有願做的心，也當照你們所有的去辦成。
english: Then make the doing of it complete; so that as you had a ready mind, you may give effect to it as you are able.

chinese: 因為人若有願做的心，必蒙悅納，乃是照他所有的，並不是照他所無的。
english: For if there is a ready mind, a man will have God's approval in the measure of what he has, and not of what he has not.

chinese: 我原不是要別人輕省，你們受累，
english: And I am not saying this so that others may get off free, while the weight comes on you:

chinese: 乃要均平，就是要你們的富餘，現在可以補他們的不足，使他們的富餘，將來也可以補你們的不足，這就均平了。
english: But so that things may be equal; that from those things of which you have more than enough at the present time their need may be helped, and that if you are in any need they may be a help to you in the same way, making things equal.

chinese: 如經上所記：多收的也沒有餘；少收的也沒有缺。
english: As it says in the Writings, He who had taken up much had nothing over and he who had little had enough.

chinese: 多謝神，感動提多的心，叫他待你們殷勤，像我一樣。
english: But praise be to God, who puts the same care for you into the heart of Titus.

chinese: 他固然是聽了我的勸，但自己更是熱心，情願往你們那裡去。
english: For while he gladly gave ear to our request, he was interested enough to go to you from the impulse of his heart.

chinese: 我們還打發一位兄弟和他同去，這人在福音上得了眾教會的稱讚。
english: And with him we have sent a brother whose praise in the good news has gone through all the churches;

chinese: 不但這樣，他也被眾教會挑選，和我們同行，把所託與我們的這捐貲送到了，可以榮耀主，又表明我們樂意的心。
english: And not only so, but he was marked out by the churches to go with us in the grace of this giving which we have undertaken to the glory of the Lord and to make clear that our mind was ready:

chinese: 這就免得有人因我們收的捐銀很多，就挑我們的不是。
english: And so that no man might be able to say anything against us in the business of this giving which has been put into our hands:

chinese: 我們留心行光明的事，不但在主面前，就在人面前也是這樣。
english: For the business has been so ordered by us as to have the approval, not only of the Lord, but of men.

chinese: 我們又打發一位兄弟同去；這人的熱心，我們在許多事上屢次試驗過。現在他因為深信你們，就更加熱心了。
english: And we have sent with them our brother, whose ready spirit has been made clear to us at times and in ways without number, but it is now all the more so because of the certain faith which he has in you.

chinese: 論到提多，他是我的同伴，一同為你們勞碌的。論到那兩位兄弟，他們是眾教會的使者，是基督的榮耀。
english: If any question comes up about Titus, he is my brother-worker, working with me for you; or about the others, they are the representatives of the churches to the glory of Christ.

chinese: 所以，你們務要在眾教會面前顯明你們愛心的憑據，並我所誇獎你們的憑據。
english: Make clear then to them, as representatives of the churches, the quality of your love, and that the things which we have said about you are true.

chinese: 論到供給聖徒的事，我不必寫信給你們；
english: But there is no need for me to say anything in my letter about the giving to the saints:

chinese: 因為我知道你們樂意的心，常對馬其頓人誇獎你們，說亞該亞人預備好了，已經有一年了；並且你們的熱心激動了許多人。
english: For I have before made clear to those of Macedonia my pride in your ready mind, saying to them that Achaia has been ready for a year back; and a great number have been moved to do the same by your example.

chinese: 但我打發那幾位弟兄去，要叫你們照我的話預備妥當；免得我們在這事上誇獎你們的話落了空。
english: But I have sent the brothers, so that the good things we said about you may be seen to be true, and that, as I said, you may be ready:

chinese: 萬一有馬其頓人與我同去，見你們沒有預備，就叫我們所確信的，反成了羞愧；你們羞愧，更不用說了。
english: For fear that, if any from Macedonia come with me, and you are not ready, we (not to say, you) might be put to shame in this thing.

chinese: 因此，我想不得不求那幾位弟兄先到你們那裡去，把從前所應許的捐貲預備妥當，就顯出你們所捐的是出於樂意，不是出於勉強。
english: So it seemed to me wise for the brothers to go before, and see that the amount which you had undertaken to give was ready, so that it might be a cause for praise, and not as if we were making profit out of you.

chinese: 少種的少收，多種的多收，這話是真的。
english: But in the Writings it says, He who puts in only a small number of seeds, will get in the same; and he who puts them in from a full hand, will have produce in full measure from them.

chinese: 各人要隨本心所酌定的，不要作難，不要勉強，因為捐得樂意的人是神所喜愛的。
english: Let every man do after the purpose of his heart; not giving with grief, or by force: for God takes pleasure in a ready giver.

chinese: 神能將各樣的恩惠多多的加給你們，使你們凡事常常充足，能多行各樣善事。
english: And God is able to give you all grace in full measure; so that ever having enough of all things, you may be full of every good work:

chinese: 如經上所記：他施捨錢財，賙濟貧窮；他的仁義存到永遠。
english: As it is said in the Writings, He has sent out far and wide, he has given to the poor; his righteousness is for ever.

chinese: 那賜種給撒種的，賜糧給人吃的，必多多加給你們種地的種子，又增添你們仁義的果子；
english: And he who gives seed for putting into the field and bread for food, will take care of the growth of your seed, at the same time increasing the fruits of your righteousness;

chinese: 叫你們凡事富足，可以多多施捨，就藉著我們使感謝歸於神。
english: Your wealth being increased in everything, with a simple mind, causing praise to God through us.

chinese: 因為辦這供給的事，不但補聖徒的缺乏，而且叫許多人越發感謝神。
english: For this work of giving not only takes care of the needs of the saints, but is the cause of much praise to God;

chinese: 他們從這供給的事上得了憑據，知道你們承認基督順服他的福音，多多的捐錢給他們和眾人，便將榮耀歸與神。
english: For when, through this work of giving, they see what you are, they give glory to God for the way in which you have given yourselves to the good news of Christ, and for the wealth of your giving to them and to all;

chinese: 他們也因神極大的恩賜顯在你們心裡，就切切的想念你們，為你們祈禱。
english: While their hearts go out to you in love and in prayer for you, because of the great grace of God which is in you.

chinese: 感謝神，因他有說不盡的恩賜！
english: Praise be to God for what he has given, which words have no power to say.

chinese: 我保羅，就是與你們見面的時候是謙卑的，不在你們那裡的時候向你們是勇敢的，如今親自藉著基督的溫柔、和平勸你們。
english: Now I, Paul, myself make request to you by the quiet and gentle behaviour of Christ, I who am poor in spirit when with you, but who say what is in my mind to you without fear when I am away from you:

chinese: 有人以為我是憑著血氣行事，我也以為必須用勇敢待這等人；求你們不要叫我在你們那裡的時候，有這樣的勇敢。
english: Yes, I make my request to you, so that when I am with you I may not have to make use of the authority which may be needed against some to whom we seem to be walking after the flesh.

chinese: 因為我們雖然在血氣中行事，卻不憑著血氣爭戰。
english: For though we may be living in the flesh, we are not fighting after the way of the flesh

chinese: 我們爭戰的兵器本不是屬血氣的，乃是在神面前有能力，可以攻破堅固的營壘，
english: (For the arms with which we are fighting are not those of the flesh, but are strong before God for the destruction of high places);

chinese: 將各樣的計謀，各樣攔阻人認識神的那些自高之事，一概攻破了，又將人所有的心意奪回，使他都順服基督。
english: Putting an end to reasonings, and every high thing which is lifted up against the knowledge of God, and causing every thought to come under the authority of Christ;

chinese: 並且我已經預備好了，等你們十分順服的時候，要責罰那一切不順服的人。
english: Being ready to give punishment to whatever is against his authority, after you have made it clear that you are completely under his control.

chinese: 你們是看眼前的麼？倘若有人自信是屬基督的，他要再想想，他如何屬基督，我們也是如何屬基督的。
english: Give attention to the things which are before you. If any man seems to himself to be Christ's, let him keep in mind that we are as much Christ's as he is.

chinese: 主賜給我們權柄，是要造就你們，並不是要敗壞你們；我就是為這權柄稍微誇口，也不至於慚愧。
english: For though I might take pride in our authority (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for your destruction), it will not be a cause of shame to me:

chinese: 我說這話，免得你們以為我寫信是要威嚇你們；
english: That I may not seem to have the desire of causing you fear by my letters.

chinese: 因為有人說：他的信又沉重又利害，及至見面，卻是氣貌不揚，言語粗俗的。
english: For his letters, they say, have weight and are strong; but in body he is feeble, and his way of talking has little force.

chinese: 這等人當想，我們不在那裡的時候，信上的言語如何，見面的時候，行事也必如何。
english: Let those who say this keep in mind that, what we are in word by letters when we are away, so will we be in act when we are present.

chinese: 因為我們不敢將自己和那自薦的人同列相比。他們用自己度量自己，用自己比較自己，乃是不通達的。
english: For we will not make comparison of ourselves with some of those who say good things about themselves: but these, measuring themselves by themselves, and making comparison of themselves with themselves, are not wise.

chinese: 我們不願意分外誇口，只要照神所量給我們的界限搆到你們那裡。
english: We will not give glory to ourselves in over-great measure, but after the measure of the rule which God has given us, a measure which comes even to you.

chinese: 我們並非過了自己的界限，好像搆不到你們那裡；因為我們早到你們那裡，傳了基督的福音。
english: For we have no need to make ourselves seem more than we are, as if our authority did not come as far as to you: for we came even as far as you with the good news of Christ:

chinese: 我們不仗著別人所勞碌的，分外誇口；但指望你們信心增長的時候，所量給我們的界限，就可以因著你們更加開展，
english: Not taking credit to ourselves for what is not our business, that is, for the work of others; but having hope that, with the growth of your faith, we may get the credit for an increase which is the effect of our work,

chinese: 得以將福音傳到你們以外的地方；並不是在別人界限之內，藉著他現成的事誇口。
english: So that we may be able to go on and take the good news to countries still farther away than you are, and not take credit for another man's work in making things ready to our hand.

chinese: 但誇口的，當指著主誇口。
english: But whoever has a desire for glory, let his glory be in the Lord.

chinese: 因為蒙悅納的，不是自己稱許的，乃是主所稱許的。
english: For the Lord's approval of a man is not dependent on his opinion of himself, but on the Lord's opinion of him.

chinese: 但願你們寬容我這一點愚妄，其實你們原是寬容我的。
english: Put up with me if I am a little foolish: but, truly, you do put up with me.

chinese: 我為你們起的憤恨，原是神那樣的憤恨。因為我曾把你們許配一個丈夫，要把你們如同貞潔的童女，獻給基督。
english: For I have a very great care for you: because you have been married by me to one husband, and it is my desire to give you completely holy to Christ.

chinese: 我只怕你們的心或偏於邪，失去那向基督所存純一清潔的心，就像蛇用詭詐誘惑了夏娃一樣。
english: But I have a fear, that in some way, as Eve was tricked by the deceit of the snake, your minds may be turned away from their simple and holy love for Christ.

chinese: 假如有人來另傳一個耶穌，不是我們所傳過的；或者你們另受一個靈，不是你們所受過的；或者另得一個福音，不是你們所得過的；你們容讓他也就罷了。
english: For if anyone comes preaching another Jesus from the one whose preachers we are, or if you have got a different spirit, or a different sort of good news from those which came to you, how well you put up with these things.

chinese: 但我想，我一點不在那些最大的使徒以下。
english: For in my opinion, I am in no way less than the most important of the Apostles.

chinese: 我的言語雖然粗俗，我的知識卻不粗俗。這是我們在凡事上向你們眾人顯明出來的。
english: But though I am rough in my way of talking, I am not so in knowledge, as we have made clear to all by our acts among you.

chinese: 我因為白白傳神的福音給你們，就自居卑微，叫你們高升，這算是我犯罪麼？
english: Or did I do wrong in making myself low so that you might be lifted up, because I gave you the good news of God without reward?

chinese: 我虧負了別的教會，向他們取了工價來給你們效力。
english: I took money from other churches as payment for my work, so that I might be your servant;

chinese: 我在你們那裡缺乏的時候，並沒有累著你們一個人；因我所缺乏的，那從馬其頓來的弟兄們都補足了。我向來凡事謹守，後來也必謹守，總不至於累著你們。
english: And when I was present with you, and was in need, I let no man be responsible for me; for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, gave me whatever was needed; and in everything I kept myself from being a trouble to you, and I will go on doing so.

chinese: 既有基督的誠實在我裡面，就無人能在亞該亞一帶地方阻擋我這自誇。
english: As the true word of Christ is in me, I will let no man take from me this my cause of pride in the country of Achaia.

chinese: 為甚麼呢？是因我不愛你們麼？這有神知道。
english: Why? because I have no love for you? let God be judge.

chinese: 我現在所做的，後來還要做，為要斷絕那些尋機會人的機會，使他們在所誇的事上也不過與我們一樣。
english: But what I do, that I will go on doing, so that I may give no chance to those who are looking for one; so that, in the cause of their pride, they may be seen to be the same as we are.

chinese: 那等人是假使徒，行事詭詐，裝作基督使徒的模樣。
english: For such men are false Apostles, workers of deceit, making themselves seem like Apostles of Christ.

chinese: 這也不足為怪，因為連撒但也裝作光明的天使。
english: And it is no wonder; for even Satan himself is able to take the form of an angel of light.

chinese: 所以他的差役，若裝作仁義的差役，也不算希奇。他們的結局必然照著他們的行為。
english: So it is no great thing if his servants make themselves seem to be servants of righteousness; whose end will be the reward of their works.

chinese: 我再說，人不可把我看作愚妄的。縱然如此，也要把我當作愚妄人接納，叫我可以略略自誇。
english: I say again, Let me not seem foolish to anyone; but if I do, put up with me as such, so that I may take a little glory to myself.

chinese: 我說的話不是奉主命說的，乃是像愚妄人放膽自誇；
english: What I am now saying is not by the order of the Lord, but as a foolish person, taking credit to myself, as it seems.

chinese: 既有好些人憑著血氣自誇，我也要自誇了。
english: Seeing that there are those who take credit to themselves after the flesh, I will do the same.

chinese: 你們既是精明人，就能甘心忍耐愚妄人。
english: For you put up with the foolish gladly, being wise yourselves.

chinese: 假若有人強你們作奴僕，或侵吞你們，或擄掠你們，或侮慢你們，或打你們的臉，你們都能忍耐他。
english: You put up with a man if he makes servants of you, if he makes profit out of you, if he makes you prisoners, if he puts himself in a high place, if he gives you blows on the face.

chinese: 我說這話是羞辱自己，好像我們從前是軟弱的。然而，人在何事上勇敢，（我說句愚妄話，）我也勇敢。
english: I say this by way of shaming ourselves, as if we had been feeble. But if anyone puts himself forward (I am talking like a foolish person), I will do the same.

chinese: 他們是希伯來人麼？我也是。他們是以色列人麼？我也是。他們是亞伯拉罕的後裔麼？我也是。
english: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they of Israel? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

chinese: 他們是基督的僕人麼？（我說句狂話，）我更是。我比他們多受勞苦，多下監牢，受鞭打是過重的，冒死是屢次有的。
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I am talking foolishly) I am more so; I have had more experience of hard work, of prisons, of blows more than measure, of death.

chinese: 被猶太人鞭打五次，每次四十減去一下；
english: Five times the Jews gave me forty blows but one.

chinese: 被棍打了三次；被石頭打了一次，遇著船壞三次，一晝一夜在深海裡。
english: Three times I was whipped with rods, once I was stoned, three times the ship I was in came to destruction at sea, a night and a day I have been in the water;

chinese: 又屢次行遠路，遭江河的危險、盜賊的危險，同族的危險、外邦人的危險、城裡的危險、曠野的危險、海中的危險、假弟兄的危險。
english: In frequent travels, in dangers on rivers, in dangers from outlaws, in dangers from my countrymen, in dangers from the Gentiles, in dangers in the town, in dangers in the waste land, in dangers at sea, in dangers among false brothers;

chinese: 受勞碌、受困苦，多次不得睡，又飢又渴，多次不得食，受寒冷，赤身露體。
english: In hard work and weariness, in frequent watchings, going without food and drink, cold and in need of clothing.

chinese: 除了這外面的事，還有為眾教會掛心的事，天天壓在我身上。
english: In addition to all the other things, there is that which comes on me every day, the care of all the churches.

chinese: 有誰軟弱，我不軟弱呢？有誰跌倒，我不焦急呢？
english: Who is feeble and I am not feeble? who is in danger of falling, and I am not angry?

chinese: 我若必須自誇，就誇那關乎我軟弱的事便了。
english: If I have to take credit to myself, I will do so in the things in which I am feeble.

chinese: 那永遠可稱頌之主耶穌的父神知道我不說謊。
english: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, to whom be praise for ever, is witness that the things which I say are true.

chinese: 在大馬色亞哩達王手下的提督把守大馬色城，要捉拿我，
english: In Damascus, the ruler under Aretas the king kept watch over the town of the people of Damascus, in order to take me:

chinese: 我就從窗戶中，在筐子裡，從城牆上被人縋下去，脫離了他的手。
english: And being let down in a basket from the wall through a window, I got free from his hands.

chinese: 我自誇固然無益，但我是不得已的。如今我要說到主的顯現和啟示。
english: As it is necessary for me to take glory to myself, though it is not a good thing, I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

chinese: 我認得一個在基督裡的人，他前十四年被提到第三層天上去；或在身內，我不知道；或在身外，我也不知道；只有神知道。
english: I have knowledge of a man in Christ, fourteen years back (if he was in the body, or out of the body, I am not able to say, but God only), who was taken up to the third heaven.

chinese: 我認得這人；或在身內，或在身外，我都不知道，只有神知道。
english: And I have knowledge of such a man (if he was in the body, or out of the body, I am not able to say, but God only),

chinese: 他被提到樂園裡，聽見隱祕的言語，是人不可說的。
english: How he was taken up into Paradise, and words came to his ears which may not be said, and which man is not able to say.

chinese: 為這人，我要誇口；但是為我自己，除了我的軟弱以外，我並不誇口。
english: On account of such a one I will have glory: for myself I will take no glory, but only in my feeble body.

chinese: 我就是願意誇口也不算狂，因為我必說實話；只是我禁止不說，恐怕有人把我看高了，過於他在我身上所看見所聽見的。
english: For if I had a desire to take credit to myself, it would not be foolish, for I would be saying what is true: but I will not, for fear that I might seem to any man more than he sees me to be, or has word from me that I am.

chinese: 又恐怕我因所得的啟示甚大，就過於自高，所以有一根刺加在我肉體上，就是撒但的差役要攻擊我，免得我過於自高。
english: And because the revelations were so very great, in order that I might not be overmuch lifted up, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, one sent from Satan to give me pain.

chinese: 為這事，我三次求過主，叫這刺離開我。
english: And about this thing I made request to the Lord three times that it might be taken away from me.

chinese: 他對我說：我的恩典夠你用的，因為我的能力是在人的軟弱上顯得完全。所以，我更喜歡誇自己的軟弱，好叫基督的能力覆庇我。
english: And he said to me, My grace is enough for you, for my power is made complete in what is feeble. Most gladly, then, will I take pride in my feeble body, so that the power of Christ may be on me.

chinese: 我為基督的緣故，就以軟弱、凌辱、急難、逼迫、困苦為可喜樂的；因我甚麼時候軟弱，甚麼時候就剛強了。
english: So I take pleasure in being feeble, in unkind words, in needs, in cruel attacks, in troubles, on account of Christ: for when I am feeble, then am I strong.

chinese: 我成了愚妄人，是被你們強逼的。我本該被你們稱許才是。我雖算不了甚麼，卻沒有一件事在那些最大的使徒以下。
english: I have been forced by you to become foolish, though it was right for my praise to have come from you: for in no way was I less than the chief of the Apostles, though I am nothing.

chinese: 我在你們中間，用百般的忍耐，藉著神蹟、奇事、異能，顯出使徒的憑據來。
english: Truly the signs of an Apostle were done among you in quiet strength, with wonders and acts of power.

chinese: 除了我不累著你們這一件事，你們還有甚麼事不及別的教會呢？這不公之處，求你們饒恕我罷。
english: For what is there in which you were made less than the other churches, but in the one thing that I was not a trouble to you? Let me have forgiveness for this wrong.

chinese: 如今，我打算第三次到你們那裡去，也必不累著你們；因我所求的是你們，不是你們的財物。兒女不該為父母積財，父母該為兒女積財。
english: This is now the third time that I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a trouble to you: my desire is for you, not for your property: for it is not the children's business to make store for their fathers, but the fathers for the children.

chinese: 我也甘心樂意為你們的靈魂費財費力。難道我越發愛你們，就越發少得你們的愛麼？
english: And I will gladly give all I have for your souls. If I have the more love for you, am I to be loved the less?

chinese: 罷了，我自己並沒有累著你們，你們卻有人說，我是詭詐，用心計牢籠你們。
english: But let it be so, that I was not a trouble to you myself; but (someone may say) being false, I took you with deceit.

chinese: 我所差到你們那裡去的人，我藉著他們一個人佔過你們的便宜麼？
english: Did I make a profit out of you by any of those whom I sent to you?

chinese: 我勸了提多到你們那裡去；又差那位兄弟與他同去。提多佔過你們的便宜麼？我們行事，不同是一個心靈（或作：聖靈）麼？不同是一個腳蹤麼？
english: I gave orders to Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus make any profit out of you? were we not guided by the same Spirit, in the same ways?

chinese: 你們到如今，還想我們是向你們分訴；我們本是在基督裡當神面前說話。親愛的弟兄阿，一切的事都是為造就你們。
english: It may seem to you that all this time we have been attempting to put ourselves in the right; but we are saying these things before God in Christ. For all things, dear brothers, are for your profit.

chinese: 我怕我再來的時候，見你們不合我所想望的，你們見我也不合你們所想望的；又怕有紛爭、嫉妒、惱怒、結黨、毀謗、讒言、狂傲、混亂的事。
english: For I have a fear that, when I come, you may not be answering to my desire, and that I may not be answering to yours; that there may be fighting, hate, angry feeling, divisions, evil talk about others, secrets, thoughts of pride, outbursts against authority;

chinese: 且怕我來的時候，我的神叫我在你們面前慚愧，又因許多人從前犯罪，行污穢、姦淫、邪蕩的事不肯悔改，我就憂愁。
english: And that when I come again, my God may put me to shame among you, and I may have grief for those who have done wrong before and have had no regret for their unclean ways, and for the evil desires of the flesh to which they have given way.

chinese: 這是我第三次要到你們那裡去。憑兩三個人的口作見證，句句都要定準。
english: This is the third time that I am coming to you. From the mouth of two or three witnesses will every word be made certain.

chinese: 我從前說過，如今不在你們那裡又說，正如我第二次見你們的時候所說的一樣，就是對那犯了罪的和其餘的人說：我若再來，必不寬容。
english: I said before, and still say it before I come, as being present for the second time, though I am still away from you, to those who have done wrong before, and to all the others, that if I come again I will not have pity;

chinese: 你們既然尋求基督在我裡面說話的憑據，我必不寬容。因為，基督在你們身上不是軟弱的，在你們裡面是有大能的。
english: Seeing that you are looking for a sign of Christ giving out his word in me; who is not feeble in relation to you, but is strong in you:

chinese: 他因軟弱被釘在十字架上，卻因神的大能仍然活著。我們也是這樣同他軟弱，但因神向你們所顯的大能，也必與他同活。
english: For he was feeble in that he was put to death on the cross, but he is living by the power of God. And we are feeble in him, but we will be living with him through the power of God in relation to you.

chinese: 你們總要自己省察有信心沒有，也要自己試驗。豈不知你們若不是可棄絕的，就有耶穌基督在你們心裡麼？
english: Make a test of yourselves, if you are in the faith; make certain of yourselves. Or are you not conscious in yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you, if you are truly Christ's?

chinese: 我卻盼望你們曉得，我們不是可棄絕的人。
english: But it is my hope that you will have no doubt that we are truly Christ's.

chinese: 我們求神，叫你們一件惡事都不做；這不是要顯明我們是蒙悅納的，是要你們行事端正，任憑人看我們是被棄絕的罷！
english: Now our prayer to God is that you may do no evil; not in order that it may be put to our credit, but so that you may do what is right, whatever we may seem.

chinese: 我們凡事不能敵擋真理，只能扶助真理。
english: Because we are able to do nothing against what is true, but only for it.

chinese: 即使我們軟弱，你們剛強，我們也歡喜；並且我們所求的，就是你們作完全人。
english: For we are glad when we are feeble and you are strong: and this is our prayer, even that you may be made complete.

chinese: 所以，我不在你們那裡的時候，把這話寫給你們，好叫我見你們的時候，不用照主所給我的權柄嚴厲的待你們；這權柄原是為造就人，並不是為敗壞人。
english: For this cause I am writing these things while I am away, so that there may be need for me, when I am present, to make use of sharp measures, by the authority which the Lord has given me for building up and not for destruction.

chinese: 還有末了的話：願弟兄們都喜樂。要作完全人；要受安慰；要同心合意；要彼此和睦。如此，仁愛和平的神必常與你們同在。
english: Let this be my last word, brothers; be glad; be complete; be comforted; be of the same mind; be at peace with one another: and the God of love and peace will be with you.

chinese: 你們親嘴問安，彼此務要聖潔。
english: Give one another a holy kiss.

chinese: 眾聖徒都問你們安。
english: All the saints send their love to you.

chinese: 願主耶穌基督的恩惠、神的慈愛、聖靈的感動，常與你們眾人同在！
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the harmony of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.

chinese: 作使徒的保羅（不是由於人，也不是藉著人，乃是藉著耶穌基督，與叫他從死裡復活的父神）
english: Paul, an Apostle (not from men, and not through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who made him come back from the dead),

chinese: 和一切與我同在的眾弟兄，寫信給加拉太的各教會。
english: And all the brothers who are with me, to the churches of Galatia:

chinese: 願恩惠、平安從父神與我們的主耶穌基督歸與你們！
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

chinese: 基督照我們父神的旨意，為我們的罪捨己，要救我們脫離這罪惡的世代。
english: Who gave himself for our sins, so that he might make us free from this present evil world, after the purpose of our God and Father:

chinese: 但願榮耀歸於神，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
english: To whom be the glory for ever and ever. So be it.

chinese: 我希奇你們這麼快離開那藉著基督之恩召你們的，去從別的福音。
english: I am surprised that you are being so quickly turned away from him whose word came to you in the grace of Christ, to good news of a different sort;

chinese: 那並不是福音，不過有些人攪擾你們，要把基督的福音更改了。
english: Which is not another sort: only there are some who give you trouble, desiring to make changes in the good news of Christ.

chinese: 但無論是我們，是天上來的使者，若傳福音給你們，與我們所傳給你們的不同，他就應當被咒詛。
english: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, were to be a preacher to you of good news other than that which we have given you, let there be a curse on him.

chinese: 我們已經說了，現在又說，若有人傳福音給你們，與你們所領受的不同，他就應當被咒詛。
english: As we have said before, so say I now again, If any man is a preacher to you of any good news other than that which has been given to you, let there be a curse on him.

chinese: 我現在是要得人的心呢？還是要得神的心呢？我豈是討人的喜歡麼？若仍舊討人的喜歡，我就不是基督的僕人了。
english: Am I now using arguments to men, or God? or is it my desire to give men pleasure? if I was still pleasing men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

chinese: 弟兄們，我告訴你們，我素來所傳的福音不是出於人的意思。
english: Because I say to you, my brothers, that the good news of which I was the preacher is not man's.

chinese: 因為我不是從人領受的，也不是人教導我的，乃是從耶穌基督啟示來的。
english: For I did not get it from man, and I was not given teaching in it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

chinese: 你們聽見我從前在猶太教中所行的事，怎樣極力逼迫殘害神的教會。
english: For news has come to you of my way of life in the past in the Jews' religion, how I was cruel without measure to the church of God, and did great damage to it:

chinese: 我又在猶太教中，比我本國許多同歲的人更有長進，為我祖宗的遺傳更加熱心。
english: And I went farther in the Jews' religion than a number of my generation among my countrymen, having a more burning interest in the beliefs handed down from my fathers.

chinese: 然而，那把我從母腹裡分別出來、又施恩召我的神，
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, by whom I was marked out even from my mother's body, through his grace,

chinese: 既然樂意將他兒子啟示在我心裡，叫我把他傳在外邦人中，我就沒有與屬血氣的人商量，
english: To give the revelation of his Son in me, so that I might give the news of him to the Gentiles; then I did not take the opinion of flesh and blood,

chinese: 也沒有上耶路撒冷去見那些比我先作使徒的，惟獨往亞拉伯去，後又回到大馬色。
english: And I went not up to Jerusalem to those who were Apostles before me; but I went away into Arabia, and again I came back to Damascus.

chinese: 過了三年，才上耶路撒冷去見磯法，和他同住了十五天。
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Cephas, and was there with him fifteen days.

chinese: 至於別的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都沒有看見。
english: But of the other Apostles I saw only James, the Lord's brother.

chinese: 我寫給你們的不是謊話，這是我在神面前說的。
english: Now God is witness that the things which I am writing to you are true.

chinese: 以後我到了敘利亞和基利家境內。
english: Then I came to the parts of Syria and Cilicia.

chinese: 那時，猶太信基督的各教會都沒有見過我的面。
english: And the churches of Judaea which were in Christ still had no knowledge of my face or person:

chinese: 不過聽說那從前逼迫我們的，現在傳揚他原先所殘害的真道。
english: Only it came to their ears that he who at one time was cruel to us is now preaching the faith which before had been attacked by him;

chinese: 他們就為我的緣故，歸榮耀給神。
english: And they gave glory to God in me.

chinese: 過了十四年，我同巴拿巴又上耶路撒冷去，並帶著提多同去。
english: Then after the space of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus with me.

chinese: 我是奉啟示上去的，把我在外邦人中所傳的福音，對弟兄們陳說；卻是背地裡對那有名望之人說的，惟恐我現在，或是從前，徒然奔跑。
english: And I went up by revelation; and I put before them the good news which I was preaching among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were of good name, so that the work which I was or had been doing might not be without effect.

chinese: 但與我同去的提多，雖是希利尼人，也沒有勉強他受割禮；
english: But not even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, was made to undergo circumcision:

chinese: 因為有偷著引進來的假弟兄，私下窺探我們在基督耶穌裡的自由，要叫我們作奴僕。
english: And that because of the false brothers let in secretly, who came searching out our free condition which we have in Christ Jesus, so that they might make servants of us;

chinese: 我們就是一刻的工夫也沒有容讓順服他們，為要叫福音的真理仍存在你們中間。
english: To whom we gave way not even for an hour; so that the true words of the good news might still be with you.

chinese: 至於那些有名望的，不論他是何等人，都與我無干。神不以外貌取人。那些有名望的，並沒有加增我甚麼，
english: But from those who seemed to be important (whatever they were has no weight with me: God does not take man's person into account): those who seemed to be important gave nothing new to me;

chinese: 反倒看見了主託我傳福音給那未受割禮的人，正如託彼得傳福音給那受割禮的人。
english: But, quite the opposite, when they saw that I had been made responsible for preaching the good news to those without circumcision, even as Peter had been for those of the circumcision

chinese: （那感動彼得、叫他為受割禮之人作使徒的，也感動我，叫我為外邦人作使徒；）
english: (Because he who was working in Peter as the Apostle of the circumcision was working no less in me among the Gentiles);

chinese: 又知道所賜給我的恩典，那稱為教會柱石的雅各、磯法、約翰，就向我和巴拿巴用右手行相交之禮，叫我們往外邦人那裡去，他們往受割禮的人那裡去。
english: When they saw the grace which was given to me, James and Cephas and John, who had the name of being pillars, gave to me and Barnabas their right hands as friends so that we might go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision;

chinese: 只是願意我們記念窮人；這也是我本來熱心去行的。
english: Only it was their desire that we would give thought to the poor; which very thing I had much in mind to do.

chinese: 後來，磯法到了安提阿；因他有可責之處，我就當面抵擋他。
english: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I made a protest against him to his face, because he was clearly in the wrong.

chinese: 從雅各那裡來的人未到以先，他和外邦人一同吃飯，及至他們來到，他因怕奉割禮的人，就退去與外邦人隔開了。
english: For before certain men came from James, he did take food with the Gentiles: but when they came, he went back and made himself separate, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

chinese: 其餘的猶太人也都隨著他裝假，甚至連巴拿巴也隨夥裝假。
english: And the rest of the Jews went after him, so that even Barnabas was overcome by their false ways.

chinese: 但我一看見他們行的不正，與福音的真理不合，就在眾人面前對磯法說：你既是猶太人，若隨外邦人行事，不隨猶太人行事，怎麼還勉強外邦人隨猶太人呢？
english: But when I saw that they were not living uprightly in agreement with the true words of the good news, I said to Cephas before them all, If you, being a Jew, are living like the Gentiles, and not like the Jews, how will you make the Gentiles do the same as the Jews?

chinese: 我們這生來的猶太人，不是外邦的罪人；
english: We being Jews by birth, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

chinese: 既知道人稱義不是因行律法，乃是因信耶穌基督，連我們也信了基督耶穌，使我們因信基督稱義，不因行律法稱義；因為凡有血氣的，沒有一人因行律法稱義。
english: Being conscious that a man does not get righteousness by the works of the law, but through faith in Jesus Christ, we had faith in Christ Jesus, so that we might get righteousness by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law: because by the works of the law will no flesh get righteousness.

chinese: 我們若求在基督裡稱義，卻仍舊是罪人，難道基督是叫人犯罪的麼？斷乎不是！
english: But if, while we were desiring to get righteousness through Christ, we ourselves were seen to be sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? In no way!

chinese: 我素來所拆毀的，若重新建造，這就證明自己是犯罪的人。
english: For if I put up again those things which I gave to destruction, I am seen to be a wrongdoer.

chinese: 我因律法，就向律法死了，叫我可以向神活著。
english: For I, through the law, have become dead to the law, so that I might be living to God.

chinese: 我已經與基督同釘十字架，現在活著的不再是我，乃是基督在我裡面活著；並且我如今在肉身活著，是因信神的兒子而活；他是愛我，為我捨己。
english: I have been put to death on the cross with Christ; still I am living; no longer I, but Christ is living in me; and that life which I now am living in the flesh I am living by faith, the faith of the Son of God, who in love for me, gave himself up for me.

chinese: 我不廢掉神的恩；義若是藉著律法得的，基督就是徒然死了。
english: I do not make the grace of God of no effect: because if righteousness is through the law, then Christ was put to death for nothing.

chinese: 無知的加拉太人哪，耶穌基督釘十字架，已經活畫在你們眼前，誰又迷惑了你們呢？
english: O foolish Galatians, by what strange powers have you been tricked, to whom it was made clear that Jesus Christ was put to death on the cross?

chinese: 我只要問你們這一件：你們受了聖靈，是因行律法呢？是因聽信福音呢？
english: Give me an answer to this one question, Did the Spirit come to you through the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

chinese: 你們既靠聖靈入門，如今還靠肉身成全麼？你們是這樣的無知麼？
english: Are you so foolish? having made a start in the Spirit, will you now be made complete in the flesh?

chinese: 你們受苦如此之多，都是徒然的麼？難道果真是徒然的麼？
english: Did you undergo such a number of things to no purpose? if it is in fact to no purpose.

chinese: 那賜給你們聖靈，又在你們中間行異能的，是因你們行律法呢？是因你們聽信福音呢？
english: He who gives you the Spirit, and does works of power among you, is it by the works of law, or by the hearing of faith?

chinese: 正如亞伯拉罕信神，這就算為他的義。
english: Even as Abraham had faith in God, and it was put to his account as righteousness.

chinese: 所以，你們要知道：那以信為本的人，就是亞伯拉罕的子孫。
english: Be certain, then, that those who are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.

chinese: 並且聖經既然預先看明，神要叫外邦人因信稱義，就早已傳福音給亞伯拉罕，說：萬國都必因你得福。
english: And the holy Writings, seeing before the event that God would give the Gentiles righteousness by faith, gave the good news before to Abraham, saying, In you will all the nations have a blessing.

chinese: 可見那以信為本的人和有信心的亞伯拉罕一同得福。
english: So then those who are of faith have a part in the blessing of Abraham who was full of faith.

chinese: 凡以行律法為本的，都是被咒詛的；因為經上記著：凡不常照律法書上所記一切之事去行的，就被咒詛。
english: For all who are of the works of the law are under a curse: because it is said in the Writings, A curse is on everyone who does not keep on doing all the things which are ordered in the book of the law.

chinese: 沒有一個人靠著律法在神面前稱義，這是明顯的；因為經上說，義人必因信得生。
english: Now that no man gets righteousness by the law in the eyes of God, is clear; because, The upright will be living by faith.

chinese: 律法原不本乎信，只說：行這些事的，就必因此活著。
english: And the law is not of faith; but, He who does them will have life by them.

chinese: 基督既為我們受（原文是成）了咒詛，就贖出我們脫離律法的咒詛；因為經上記著：凡掛在木頭上都是被咒詛的。
english: Christ has made us free from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us: because it is said in the Writings, A curse on everyone who is put to death by hanging on a tree:

chinese: 這便叫亞伯拉罕的福，因基督耶穌可以臨到外邦人，使我們因信得著所應許的聖靈。
english: So that on the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; in order that we through faith might have the Spirit which God had undertaken to give.

chinese: 弟兄們，我且照著人的常話說：雖然是人的文約，若已經立定了，就沒有能廢棄或加增的。
english: Brothers, as men would say, even a man's agreement, when it has been made certain, may not be put on one side, or have additions made to it.

chinese: 所應許的原是向亞伯拉罕和他子孫說的。神並不是說眾子孫，指著許多人，乃是說你那一個子孫，指著一個人，就是基督。
english: Now to Abraham were the undertakings given, and to his seed. He says not, And to seeds, as of a great number; but as of one, he says, And to your seed, which is Christ.

chinese: 我是這麼說，神預先所立的約，不能被那四百三十年以後的律法廢掉，叫應許歸於虛空。
english: Now this I say: The law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, does not put an end to the agreement made before by God, so as to make the undertaking without effect.

chinese: 因為承受產業，若本乎律法，就不本乎應許；但神是憑著應許把產業賜給亞伯拉罕。
english: Because if the heritage is by the law, it is no longer dependent on the word of God; but God gave it to Abraham by his word.

chinese: 這樣說來，律法是為甚麼有的呢？原是為過犯添上的，等候那蒙應許的子孫來到，並且是藉天使經中保之手設立的。
english: What then is the law? It was an addition made because of sin, till the coming of the seed to whom the undertaking had been given; and it was ordered through angels by the hand of a go-between.

chinese: 但中保本不是為一面作的；神卻是一位。
english: Now a go-between is not a go-between of one; but God is one.

chinese: 這樣，律法是與神的應許反對麼？斷乎不是！若曾傳一個能叫人得生的律法，義就誠然本乎律法了。
english: Is the law then against the words of God? in no way; because if there had been a law which was able to give life, truly righteousness would have been by the law.

chinese: 但聖經把眾人都圈在罪裡，使所應許的福因信耶穌基督，歸給那信的人。
english: However, the holy Writings have put all things under sin, so that that for which God gave the undertaking, based on faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who have such faith.

chinese: 但這因信得救的理還未來以先，我們被看守在律法之下，直圈到那將來的真道顯明出來。
english: But before faith came, we were kept in prison under the law, waiting for the revelation of the faith which was to come.

chinese: 這樣，律法是我們訓蒙的師傅，引我們到基督那裡，使我們因信稱義。
english: So the law has been a servant to take us to Christ, so that we might have righteousness by faith.

chinese: 但這因信得救的理既然來到，我們從此就不在師傅的手下了。
english: But now that faith is come, we are no longer under a servant.

chinese: 所以，你們因信基督耶穌都是神的兒子。
english: Because you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 你們受洗歸入基督的都是披戴基督了。
english: For all those of you who were given baptism into Christ did put on Christ.

chinese: 並不分猶太人、希利尼人，自主的、為奴的，或男或女，因為你們在基督耶穌裡都成為一了。
english: There is no Jew or Greek, servant or free, male or female: because you are all one in Jesus Christ.

chinese: 你們既屬乎基督，就是亞伯拉罕的後裔，是照著應許承受產業的了。
english: And if you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed, and yours is the heritage by the right of God's undertaking given to Abraham.

chinese: 我說那承受產業的，雖然是全業的主人，但為孩童的時候卻與奴僕毫無分別，
english: But I say that as long as the son is a child, he is in no way different from a servant, though he is lord of all;

chinese: 乃在師傅和管家的手下，直等他父親預定的時候來到。
english: But is under keepers and managers till the time fixed by the father.

chinese: 我們為孩童的時候，受管於世俗小學之下，也是如此。
english: So we, when we were young, were kept under the first rules of the world;

chinese: 及至時候滿足，神就差遣他的兒子，為女子所生，且生在律法以下，
english: But when the time had come, God sent out his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

chinese: 要把律法以下的人贖出來，叫我們得著兒子的名分。
english: That he might make them free who were under the law, and that we might be given the place of sons.

chinese: 你們既為兒子，神就差他兒子的靈進入你們（原文作我們）的心，呼叫：阿爸！父！
english: And because you are sons, God has sent out the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, saying, Abba, Father.

chinese: 可見，從此以後，你不是奴僕，乃是兒子了；既是兒子，就靠著神為後嗣。
english: So that you are no longer a servant, but a son; and if a son, then the heritage of God is yours.

chinese: 但從前你們不認識神的時候，是給那些本來不是神的作奴僕；
english: But at that time, having no knowledge of God, you were servants to those who by right are no gods:

chinese: 現在你們既然認識神，更可說是被神所認識的，怎麼還要歸回那懦弱無用的小學，情願再給他作奴僕呢？
english: But now that you have come to have knowledge of God, or more truly, God has knowledge of you, how is it that you go back again to the poor and feeble first things, desiring to be servants to them again?

chinese: 你們謹守日子、月分、節期、年分。
english: You keep days, and months, and fixed times, and years.

chinese: 我為你們害怕、惟恐我在你們身上是枉費了工夫。
english: I am in fear of you, that I may have been working for you to no purpose.

chinese: 弟兄們，我勸你們要像我一樣，因為我也像你們一樣。你們一點沒有虧負我。
english: My desire for you, brothers, is that you may be as I am, because I am as you are. You have done me no wrong;

chinese: 你們知道我頭一次傳福音給你們，是因為身體有疾病。
english: But you have knowledge that with a feeble body I was preaching the good news to you the first time;

chinese: 你們為我身體的緣故受試煉，沒有輕看我，也沒有厭棄我，反倒接待我，如同神的使者，如同基督耶穌。
english: And you did not have a poor opinion of me because of the trouble in my flesh, or put shame on it; but you took me to your hearts as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

chinese: 你們當日所誇的福氣在那裡呢？那時你們若能行，就是把自己的眼睛剜出來給我，也都情願。這是我可以給你們作見證的。
english: Where then is that happy condition of yours? because I give you witness, that, if possible, you would have taken out your eyes and given them to me.

chinese: 如今我將真理告訴你們，就成了你們的仇敵麼？
english: So then am I no longer your friend, because I give you true words?

chinese: 那些人熱心待你們，卻不是好意，是要離間你們（原文是把你們關在外面），叫你們熱心待他們。
english: Their interest in you is not good; but their desire is that you may be shut out, so that you may go after them.

chinese: 在善事上，常用熱心待人原是好的，卻不單我與你們同在的時候才這樣。
english: But it is good to have an interest in a good cause at all times, and not only when I am present with you.

chinese: 我小子阿，我為你們再受生產之苦，直等到基督成形在你們心裡。
english: My children, of whom I am again in birth-pains till Christ is formed in you,

chinese: 我巴不得現今在你們那裡，改換口氣，因我為你們心裡作難。
english: Truly my desire is to be present with you now, using a changed voice; for I am troubled about you.

chinese: 你們這願意在律法以下的人，請告訴我，你們豈沒有聽見律法麼？
english: Say, you whose desire it is to be under the law, do you not give ear to the law?

chinese: 因為律法上記著，亞伯拉罕有兩個兒子，一個是使女生的，一個是自主之婦人生的。
english: Because it is in the Writings, that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant-woman, and one by the free woman.

chinese: 然而，那使女所生的是按著血氣生的；那自主之婦人所生的是憑著應許生的。
english: Now the son by the servant-woman has his birth after the flesh; but the son by the free woman has his birth through the undertaking of God.

chinese: 這都是比方：那兩個婦人就是兩約。一約是出於西乃山，生子為奴，乃是夏甲。
english: Which things have a secret sense; because these women are the two agreements; one from the mountain of Sinai, giving birth to servants, which is Hagar.

chinese: 這夏甲二字是指著亞拉伯的西乃山，與現在的耶路撒冷同類，因耶路撒冷和他的兒女都是為奴的。
english: Now this Hagar is the mountain Sinai in Arabia, and is the image of the Jerusalem which now is: which is a servant with her children.

chinese: 但那在上的耶路撒冷是自主的，他是我們的母。
english: But the Jerusalem on high is free, which is our mother.

chinese: 因為經上記著：不懷孕、不生養的，你要歡樂；未曾經過產難的，你要高聲歡呼；因為沒有丈夫的，比有丈夫的兒女更多。
english: For it is in the Writings, You who have never given birth, be glad; give cries of joy, you who have had no birth-pains; for the children of her who has been given up by her husband are more than those of the woman who has a husband.

chinese: 弟兄們，我們是憑著應許作兒女，如同以撒一樣。
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are the children of the undertaking of God.

chinese: 當時，那按著血氣生的逼迫了那按著聖靈生的，現在也是這樣。
english: But as in those days he who had birth after the flesh was cruel to him who had birth after the Spirit, even so it is now.

chinese: 然而經上是怎麼說的呢？是說：把使女和他兒子趕出去！因為使女的兒子不可與自主婦人的兒子一同承受產業。
english: What then do the Writings say? Send away the servant-woman and her son; for the son of the servant-woman will not have a part in the heritage with the son of the free woman.

chinese: 弟兄們，這樣看來，我們不是使女的兒女，乃是自主婦人的兒女了。
english: So, brothers, we are not children of the servant-woman, but of the free woman.

chinese: 基督釋放了我們，叫我們得以自由。所以要站立得穩，不要再被奴僕的軛挾制。
english: Christ has truly made us free: then keep your free condition and let no man put a yoke on you again.

chinese: 我保羅告訴你們，若受割禮，基督就與你們無益了。
english: See, I Paul say to you, that if you undergo circumcision, Christ will be of no use to you.

chinese: 我再指著凡受割禮的人確實的說，他是欠著行全律法的債。
english: Yes, I give witness again to every man who undergoes circumcision, that he will have to keep all the law.

chinese: 你們這要靠律法稱義的，是與基督隔絕，從恩典中墜落了。
english: You are cut off from Christ, you who would have righteousness by the law; you are turned away from grace.

chinese: 我們靠著聖靈，憑著信心，等候所盼望的義。
english: For we through the Spirit by faith are waiting for the hope of righteousness.

chinese: 原來在基督耶穌裡，受割禮不受割禮全無功效，惟獨使人生發仁愛的信心才有功效。
english: Because in Christ Jesus, having circumcision or not having circumcision are equally of no profit; but only faith working through love.

chinese: 你們向來跑得好，有誰攔阻你們，叫你們不順從真理呢？
english: You were going on well; who was the cause of your not giving ear to what is true?

chinese: 這樣的勸導不是出於那召你們的。
english: This ready belief did not come from him who had made you his.

chinese: 一點麵酵能使全團都發起來。
english: A little leaven makes a change in all the mass.

chinese: 我在主裡很信你們必不懷別樣的心；但攪擾你們的，無論是誰，必擔當他的罪名。
english: I am certain about you in the Lord, that you will be of no other mind; but he who is troubling you will have his punishment, whoever he is.

chinese: 弟兄們，我若仍舊傳割禮，為甚麼還受逼迫呢？若是這樣，那十字架討厭的地方就沒有了。
english: But I, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still attacked? then has the shame of the cross been taken away.

chinese: 恨不得那攪亂你們的人把自己割絕了。
english: My desire is that they who give you trouble might even be cut off themselves.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們蒙召是要得自由，只是不可將你們的自由當作放縱情慾的機會，總要用愛心互相服事。
english: Because you, brothers, were marked out to be free; only do not make use of your free condition to give the flesh its chance, but through love be servants one to another.

chinese: 因為全律法都包在「愛人如己」這一句話之內了。
english: For all the law is made complete in one word, even in this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

chinese: 你們要謹慎，若相咬相吞，只怕要彼此消滅了。
english: But if you are given to fighting with one another, take care that you are not the cause of destruction one to another.

chinese: 我說，你們當順著聖靈而行，就不放縱肉體的情慾了。
english: But I say, Go on in the Spirit, and you will not come under the rule of the evil desires of the flesh.

chinese: 因為情慾和聖靈相爭，聖靈和情慾相爭，這兩個是彼此相敵，使你們不能做所願意做的。
english: For the flesh has desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; because these are opposite the one to the other; so that you may not do the things which you have a mind to do.

chinese: 但你們若被聖靈引導，就不在律法以下。
english: But if you are guided by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

chinese: 情慾的事都是顯而易見的，就如姦淫、污穢、邪蕩、
english: Now the works of the flesh are clear, which are these: evil desire, unclean things, wrong use of the senses,

chinese: 拜偶像、邪術、仇恨、爭競、忌恨、惱怒、結黨、紛爭、異端、
english: Worship of images, use of strange powers, hates, fighting, desire for what another has, angry feelings, attempts to get the better of others, divisions, false teachings,

chinese: 嫉妒（有古卷在此有：兇殺二字）、醉酒、荒宴等類。我從前告訴你們，現在又告訴你們，行這樣事的人必不能承受神的國。
english: Envy, uncontrolled drinking and feasting, and such things: of which I give you word clearly, even as I did in the past, that they who do such things will have no part in the kingdom of God.

chinese: 聖靈所結的果子，就是仁愛、喜樂、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信實、
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, a quiet mind, kind acts, well-doing, faith,

chinese: 溫柔、節制。這樣的事沒有律法禁止。
english: Gentle behaviour, control over desires: against such there is no law.

chinese: 凡屬基督耶穌的人，是已經把肉體連肉體的邪情私慾同釘在十字架上了。
english: And those who are Christ's have put to death on the cross the flesh with its passions and its evil desires.

chinese: 我們若是靠聖靈得生，就當靠聖靈行事。
english: If we are living by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us be guided.

chinese: 不要貪圖虛名，彼此惹氣，互相嫉妒。
english: Let us not be full of self-glory, making one another angry, having envy of one another.

chinese: 弟兄們，若有人偶然被過犯所勝，你們屬靈的人就當用溫柔的心把他挽回過來；又當自己小心，恐怕也被引誘。
english: Brothers, if a man is taken in any wrongdoing, you who are of the Spirit will put such a one right in a spirit of love; keeping watch on yourself, for fear that you yourself may be tested.

chinese: 你們各人的重擔要互相擔當，如此，就完全了基督的律法。
english: Take on yourselves one another's troubles, and so keep the law of Christ.

chinese: 人若無有，自己還以為有，就是自欺了。
english: For if a man has an idea that he is something when he is nothing, he is tricked by himself.

chinese: 各人應當察驗自己的行為；這樣，他所誇的就專在自己，不在別人了，
english: But let every man make test of his work, and then will his cause for glory be in himself only, and not in his neighbour.

chinese: 因為各人必擔當自己的擔子。
english: Because every man is responsible for his part of the work.

chinese: 在道理上受教的，當把一切需用的供給施教的人。
english: But let him who gets teaching in the word give a part in all good things to his teacher.

chinese: 不要自欺，神是輕慢不得的。人種的是甚麼，收的也是甚麼。
english: Be not tricked; God is not made sport of: for whatever seed a man puts in, that will he get back as grain.

chinese: 順著情慾撒種的，必從情慾收敗壞；順著聖靈撒種的，必從聖靈收永生。
english: Because he who puts in the seed of the flesh will of the flesh get the reward of death; but he who puts in the seed of the Spirit will of the Spirit get the reward of eternal life.

chinese: 我們行善，不可喪志；若不灰心，到了時候就要收成。
english: And let us not get tired of well-doing; for at the right time we will get in the grain, if we do not give way to weariness.

chinese: 所以，有了機會就當向眾人行善，向信徒一家的人更當這樣。
english: So then, as we have the chance, let us do good to all men, and specially to those who are of the family of the faith.

chinese: 請看我親手寫給你們的字是何等的大呢！
english: See the size of the handwriting which I myself have made use of in writing to you.

chinese: 凡希圖外貌體面的人都勉強你們受割禮，無非是怕自己為基督的十字架受逼迫。
english: Those who have the desire to seem important in the flesh, put force on you to undergo circumcision; only that they may not be attacked because of the cross of Christ.

chinese: 他們那些受割禮的，連自己也不守律法；他們願意你們受割禮，不過要藉著你們的肉體誇口。
english: Because even those who undergo circumcision do not themselves keep the law; but they would have you undergo circumcision, so that they may have glory in your flesh.

chinese: 但我斷不以別的誇口，只誇我們主耶穌基督的十字架；因這十字架，就我而論，世界已經釘在十字架上；就世界而論，我已經釘在十字架上。
english: But far be it from me to have glory in anything, but only in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which this world has come to an end on the cross for me, and I for it.

chinese: 受割禮不受割禮都無關緊要，要緊的就是作新造的人。
english: For having circumcision is nothing, and not having circumcision is nothing, but only a new order of existence.

chinese: 凡照此理而行的，願平安、憐憫加給他們，和神的以色列民。
english: And on all who are guided by this rule be peace and mercy, and on the Israel of God.

chinese: 從今以後，人都不要攪擾我，因為我身上帶著耶穌的印記。
english: From this time on let no man be a trouble to me; because my body is marked with the marks of Jesus.

chinese: 弟兄們，願我主耶穌基督的恩常在你們心裡。阿們！
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. So be it.

chinese: 奉神旨意，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅，寫信給在以弗所的聖徒，就是在基督耶穌裡有忠心的人。
english: Paul, an Apostle of Christ Jesus by the purpose of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and those who have faith in Christ Jesus:

chinese: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 願頌讚歸與我們主耶穌基督的父神！他在基督裡曾賜給我們天上各樣屬靈的福氣：
english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has given us every blessing of the Spirit in the heavens in Christ:

chinese: 就如神從創立世界以前，在基督裡揀選了我們，使我們在他面前成為聖潔，無有瑕疵；
english: Even as he made selection of us in him from the first, so that we might be holy and free from all evil before him in love:

chinese: 又因愛我們，就按著自己意旨所喜悅的，預定我們藉著耶穌基督得兒子的名分，
english: As we were designed before by him for the position of sons to himself, through Jesus Christ, in the good pleasure of his purpose,

chinese: 使他榮耀的恩典得著稱讚；這恩典是他在愛子裡所賜給我們的。
english: To the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely gave to us in the Loved One:

chinese: 我們藉這愛子的血得蒙救贖，過犯得以赦免，乃是照他豐富的恩典。
english: In whom we have salvation through his blood, the forgiveness of our sins, through the wealth of his grace,

chinese: 這恩典是神用諸般智慧聰明，充充足足賞給我們的；
english: Which he gave us in full measure in all wisdom and care;

chinese: 都是照他自己所預定的美意，叫我們知道他旨意的奧祕，
english: Having made clear to us the secret of his purpose, in agreement with the design which he had in mind, to put into his hands

chinese: 要照所安排的，在日期滿足的時候，使天上、地上、一切所有的都在基督裡面同歸於一。
english: The ordering of the times when they are complete, so that all things might come to a head in Christ, the things in heaven and the things on the earth; in him, I say,

chinese: 我們也在他裡面得（或作：成）了基業；這原是那位隨己意行、做萬事的，照著他旨意所預定的，
english: In whom we have a heritage, being marked out from the first in his purpose who does all things in agreement with his designs;

chinese: 叫他的榮耀從我們這首先在基督裡有盼望的人可以得著稱讚。
english: So that his glory might have praise through us who first had hope in Christ:

chinese: 你們既聽見真理的道，就是那叫你們得救的福音，也信了基督，既然信他，就受了所應許的聖靈為印記。
english: In whom you, having been given the true word, the good news of your salvation, and through your faith in him, were given the sign of the Holy Spirit of hope,

chinese: 這聖靈是我們得基業的憑據（原文作：質），直等到神之民（原文作：產業）被贖，使他的榮耀得著稱讚。
english: Which is the first-fruit of our heritage, till God gets back that which is his, to the praise of his glory.

chinese: 因此，我既聽見你們信從主耶穌，親愛眾聖徒，
english: For this cause I, having had news of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and which you make clear to all the saints,

chinese: 就為你們不住的感謝神。禱告的時候，常題到你們，
english: Give praise without end for you, keeping you in mind in my prayers;

chinese: 求我們主耶穌基督的神，榮耀的父，將那賜人智慧和啟示的靈賞給你們，使你們真知道他，
english: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

chinese: 並且照明你們心中的眼睛，使你們知道他的恩召有何等指望，他在聖徒中得的基業有何等豐盛的榮耀；
english: And that having the eyes of your heart full of light, you may have knowledge of what is the hope of his purpose, what is the wealth of the glory of his heritage in the saints,

chinese: 並知道他向我們這信的人所顯的能力是何等浩大，
english: And how unlimited is his power to us who have faith, as is seen in the working of the strength of his power,

chinese: 就是照他在基督身上所運行的大能大力，使他從死裡復活，叫他在天上坐在自己的右邊，
english: By which he made Christ come back from the dead, and gave him a place at his right hand in heaven,

chinese: 遠超過一切執政的、掌權的、有能的、主治的，和一切有名的；不但是今世的，連來世的也都超過了。
english: Far over all rule and authority and power and every name which is named, not only in the present order, but in that which is to come:

chinese: 又將萬有服在他的腳下，使他為教會作萬有之首。
english: And he has put all things under his feet, and has made him to be head over all things to the church,

chinese: 教會是他的身體，是那充滿萬有者所充滿的。
english: Which is his body, the full measure of him in whom all things are made complete.

chinese: 你們死在過犯罪惡之中，他叫你們活過來。
english: And to you did he give life, when you were dead through your wrongdoing and sins,

chinese: 那時，你們在其中行事為人，隨從今世的風俗，順服空中掌權者的首領，就是現今在悖逆之子心中運行的邪靈。
english: In which you were living in the past, after the ways of this present world, doing the pleasure of the lord of the power of the air, the spirit who is now working in those who go against the purpose of God;

chinese: 我們從前也都在他們中間，放縱肉體的私慾，隨著肉體和心中所喜好的去行，本為可怒之子，和別人一樣。
english: Among whom we all at one time were living in the pleasures of our flesh, giving way to the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and the punishment of God was waiting for us even as for the rest.

chinese: 然而，神既有豐富的憐憫，因他愛我們的大愛，
english: But God, being full of mercy, through the great love which he had for us,

chinese: 當我們死在過犯中的時候，便叫我們與基督一同活過來。你們得救是本乎恩。
english: Even when we were dead through our sins, gave us life together with Christ (by grace you have salvation),

chinese: 他又叫我們與基督耶穌一同復活，一同坐在天上，
english: So that we came back from death with him, and are seated with him in the heavens, in Christ Jesus;

chinese: 要將他極豐富的恩典，就是他在基督耶穌裡向我們所施的恩慈，顯明給後來的世代看。
english: That in the time to come he might make clear the full wealth of his grace in his mercy to us in Christ Jesus:

chinese: 你們得救是本乎恩，也因著信；這並不是出於自己，乃是神所賜的；
english: Because by grace you have salvation through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is given by God:

chinese: 也不是出於行為，免得有人自誇。
english: Not by works, so that no man may take glory to himself.

chinese: 我們原是他的工作，在基督耶穌裡造成的，為要叫我們行善，就是神所預備叫我們行的。
english: For by his act we were given existence in Christ Jesus to do those good works which God before made ready for us so that we might do them.

chinese: 所以你們應當記念：你們從前按肉體是外邦人，是稱為沒受割禮的；這名原是那些憑人手在肉身上稱為受割禮之人所起的。
english: For this reason keep it in mind that in the past you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are looked on as being outside the circumcision by those who have circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;

chinese: 那時，你們與基督無關，在以色列國民以外，在所應許的諸約上是局外人，並且活在世上沒有指望，沒有神。
english: That you were at that time without Christ, being cut off from any part in Israel's rights as a nation, having no part in God's agreement, having no hope, and without God in the world.

chinese: 你們從前遠離神的人，如今卻在基督耶穌裡，靠著他的血，已經得親近了。
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who at one time were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

chinese: 因他使我們和睦（原文作：因他是我們的和睦），將兩下合而為一，拆毀了中間隔斷的牆；
english: For he is our peace, who has made the two into one, and by whom the middle wall of division has been broken down,

chinese: 而且以自己的身體廢掉冤仇，就是那記在律法上的規條，為要將兩下藉著自己造成一個新人，如此便成就了和睦。
english: Having in his flesh put an end to that which made the division between us, even the law with its rules and orders, so that he might make in himself, of the two, one new man, so making peace;

chinese: 既在十字架上滅了冤仇，便藉這十字架使兩下歸為一體，與神和好了，
english: And that the two might come into agreement with God in one body through the cross, so putting an end to that division.

chinese: 並且來傳和平的福音給你們遠處的人，也給那近處的人。
english: And he came preaching peace to you who were far off, and to those who were near;

chinese: 因為我們兩下藉著他被一個聖靈所感，得以進到父面前。
english: Because through him the two of us are able to come near in one Spirit to the Father.

chinese: 這樣，你們不再作外人和客旅，是與聖徒同國，是神家裡的人了；
english: So then you are no longer as those who have no part or place in the kingdom of God, but you are numbered among the saints, and of the family of God,

chinese: 並且被建造在使徒和先知的根基上，有基督耶穌自己為房角石，
english: Resting on the base of the Apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief keystone,

chinese: 各（或作：全）房靠他聯絡得合式，漸漸成為主的聖殿。
english: In whom all the building, rightly joined together, comes to be a holy house of God in the Lord;

chinese: 你們也靠他同被建造，成為神藉著聖靈居住的所在。
english: In whom you, with the rest, are united together as a living-place of God in the Spirit.

chinese: 因此，我─保羅為你們外邦人作了基督耶穌被囚的，替你們祈禱（此句乃照對十四節所加）。
english: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you Gentiles,

chinese: 諒必你們曾聽見神賜恩給我，將關切你們的職分託付我，
english: If that ordering of the grace of God has come to your knowledge, which was given to me for you,

chinese: 用啟示使我知道福音的奧祕，正如我以前略略寫過的。
english: How by revelation the secret was made clear to me, as I said before in a short letter,

chinese: 你們念了，就能曉得我深知基督的奧祕。
english: By the reading of which you will be clear about my knowledge of the secret of Christ;

chinese: 這奧祕在以前的世代沒有叫人知道，像如今藉著聖靈啟示他的聖使徒和先知一樣。
english: Which in other generations was not given to the sons of men, but the revelation of it has now been made to his holy Apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

chinese: 這奧祕就是外邦人在基督耶穌裡，藉著福音，得以同為後嗣，同為一體，同蒙應許。
english: Which is that the Gentiles have a part in the heritage, and in the same body, and in the same hope in Christ through the good news,

chinese: 我作了這福音的執事，是照神的恩賜，這恩賜是照他運行的大能賜給我的。
english: Of which I was made a preacher, through that grace of God which was given to me in the measure of the working of his power.

chinese: 我本來比眾聖徒中最小的還小，然而他還賜我這恩典，叫我把基督那測不透的豐富傳給外邦人，
english: To me, who am less than the least of all the saints, was this grace given, so that I might make clear to the Gentiles the good news of the unending wealth of Christ:

chinese: 又使眾人都明白，這歷代以來隱藏在創造萬物之神裡的奧祕是如何安排的，
english: And make all men see what is the ordering of the secret which from the first has been kept in God who made all things;

chinese: 為要藉著教會使天上執政的、掌權的，現在得知神百般的智慧。
english: So that now to the rulers and the authorities in the heavens might be made clear through the church the wide-shining wisdom of God,

chinese: 這是照神從萬世以前，在我們主基督耶穌裡所定的旨意。
english: Which is seen in his eternal purpose in Christ Jesus our Lord:

chinese: 我們因信耶穌，就在他裡面放膽無懼，篤信不疑的來到神面前。
english: By whom we come near to God without fear through faith in him.

chinese: 所以，我求你們不要因我為你們所受的患難喪膽，這原是你們的榮耀。
english: For this reason it is my prayer that you may not become feeble because of my troubles for you, which are your glory.

chinese: 因此，我在父面前屈膝，
english: For this cause I go down on my knees before the Father,

chinese: （天上地上的各（或作：全）家，都是從他得名。）
english: From whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

chinese: 求他按著他豐盛的榮耀，藉著他的靈，叫你們心裡的力量剛強起來，
english: That in the wealth of his glory he would make you strong with power through his Spirit in your hearts;

chinese: 使基督因你們的信，住在你們心裡，叫你們的愛心有根有基，
english: So that Christ may have his place in your hearts through faith; and that you, being rooted and based in love,

chinese: 能以和眾聖徒一同明白基督的愛是何等長闊高深，
english: May have strength to see with all the saints how wide and long and high and deep it is,

chinese: 並知道這愛是過於人所能測度的，便叫神一切所充滿的，充滿了你們。
english: And to have knowledge of the love of Christ which is outside all knowledge, so that you may be made complete as God himself is complete.

chinese: 神能照著運行在我們心裡的大力充充足足的成就一切，超過我們所求所想的。
english: Now to him who is able to do in full measure more than all our desires or thoughts, through the power which is working in us,

chinese: 但願他在教會中，並在基督耶穌裡，得著榮耀，直到世世代代，永永遠遠。阿們！
english: To him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations for ever and ever. So be it.

chinese: 我為主被囚的勸你們：既然蒙召，行事為人就當與蒙召的恩相稱。
english: I then, the prisoner in the Lord, make this request from my heart, that you will see that your behaviour is a credit to the position which God's purpose has given you,

chinese: 凡事謙虛、溫柔、忍耐，用愛心互相寬容，
english: With all gentle and quiet behaviour, taking whatever comes, putting up with one another in love;

chinese: 用和平彼此聯絡，竭力保守聖靈所賜合而為一的心。
english: Taking care to keep the harmony of the Spirit in the yoke of peace.

chinese: 身體只有一個，聖靈只有一個，正如你們蒙召同有一個指望。
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you have been marked out by God in the one hope of his purpose for you;

chinese: 一主，一信，一洗，
english: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

chinese: 一神，就是眾人的父，超乎眾人之上，貫乎眾人之中，也住在眾人之內。
english: One God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in all.

chinese: 我們各人蒙恩，都是照基督所量給各人的恩賜。
english: But to every one of us has grace been given in the measure of the giving of Christ.

chinese: 所以經上說：他升上高天的時候，擄掠了仇敵，將各樣的恩賜賞給人。
english: For this reason he says, He went up on high, taking his prisoners with him, and gave freely to men.

chinese: （既說升上，豈不是先降在地下麼？
english: (Now this, He went up, what is it but that he first went down into the lower parts of the earth?

chinese: 那降下的，就是遠升諸天之上要充滿萬有的。）
english: He who went down is the same who went up far over all the heavens so that he might make all things complete.)

chinese: 他所賜的，有使徒，有先知，有傳福音的，有牧師和教師，
english: And he gave some as Apostles, and some, prophets; and some, preachers of the good news; and some to give care and teaching;

chinese: 為要成全聖徒，各盡其職，建立基督的身體，
english: For the training of the saints as servants in the church, for the building up of the body of Christ:

chinese: 直等到我們眾人在真道上同歸於一，認識神的兒子，得以長大成人，滿有基督長成的身量，
english: Till we all come to the harmony of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to full growth, to the full measure of Christ:

chinese: 使我們不再作小孩子，中了人的詭計和欺騙的法術，被一切異教之風搖動，飄來飄去，就隨從各樣的異端；
english: So that we may be no longer children, sent this way and that, turned about by every wind of teaching, by the twisting and tricks of men, by the deceits of error;

chinese: 惟用愛心說誠實話，凡事長進，連於元首基督，
english: But saying true words in love, may come to full growth in him, who is the head, even Christ;

chinese: 全身都靠他聯絡得合式，百節各按各職，照著各體的功用彼此相助，便叫身體漸漸增長，在愛中建立自己。
english: Through whom all the body, being rightly formed and united together, by the full working of every part, is increased to the building up of itself in love.

chinese: 所以我說，且在主裡確實的說，你們行事不要再像外邦人存虛妄的心行事。
english: This I say, then, and give witness in the Lord, that you are to go no longer in the way of the Gentiles whose minds are turned to that which has no profit,

chinese: 他們心地昏昧，與神所賜的生命隔絕了，都因自己無知，心裡剛硬；
english: Whose thoughts are dark, to whom the life of God is strange because they are without knowledge, and their hearts have been made hard;

chinese: 良心既然喪盡，就放縱私慾，貪行種種的污穢。
english: Who having no more power of feeling, have given themselves up to evil passions, to do all unclean things with overmuch desire.

chinese: 你們學了基督，卻不是這樣。
english: For this was not the teaching of Christ which was given to you;

chinese: 如果你們聽過他的道，領了他的教，學了他的真理，
english: If in fact you gave ear to him, and were given teaching in him, even as what is true is made clear in Jesus:

chinese: 就要脫去你們從前行為上的舊人，這舊人是因私慾的迷惑漸漸變壞的；
english: That you are to put away, in relation to your earlier way of life, the old man, which has become evil by love of deceit;

chinese: 又要將你們的心志改換一新，
english: And be made new in the spirit of your mind,

chinese: 並且穿上新人；這新人是照著神的形像造的，有真理的仁義和聖潔。
english: And put on the new man, to which God has given life, in righteousness and a true and holy way of living.

chinese: 所以你們要棄絕謊言，各人與鄰舍說實話，因為我們是互相為肢體。
english: And so, putting away false words, let everyone say what is true to his neighbour: for we are parts one of another.

chinese: 生氣卻不要犯罪；不可含怒到日落，
english: Be angry without doing wrong; let not the sun go down on your wrath;

chinese: 也不可給魔鬼留地步。
english: And do not give way to the Evil One.

chinese: 從前偷竊的，不要再偷；總要勞力，親手做正經事，就可有餘分給那缺少的人。
english: Let him who was a thief be so no longer, but let him do good work with his hands, so that he may have something to give to him who is in need.

chinese: 污穢的言語一句不可出口，只要隨事說造就人的好話，叫聽見的人得益處。
english: Let no evil talk come out of your mouth, but only what is good for giving necessary teaching, and for grace to those who give ear.

chinese: 不要叫神的聖靈擔憂；你們原是受了他的印記，等候得贖的日子來到。
english: And do not give grief to the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were marked for the day of salvation.

chinese: 一切苦毒、惱恨、忿怒、嚷鬧、毀謗，並一切的惡毒（或作：陰毒），都當從你們中間除掉；
english: Let all bitter, sharp and angry feeling, and noise, and evil words, be put away from you, with all unkind acts;

chinese: 並要以恩慈相待，存憐憫的心，彼此饒恕，正如神在基督裡饒恕了你們一樣。
english: And be kind to one another, full of pity, having forgiveness for one another, even as God in Christ had forgiveness for you.

chinese: 所以，你們該效法神，好像蒙慈愛的兒女一樣。
english: Let it then be your desire to be like God, as well-loved children;

chinese: 也要憑愛心行事，正如基督愛我們，為我們捨了自己，當作馨香的供物和祭物，獻與神。
english: And be living in love, even as Christ had love for you, and gave himself up for us, an offering to God for a perfume of a sweet smell.

chinese: 至於淫亂並一切污穢，或是貪婪，在你們中間連題都不可，方合聖徒的體統。
english: But evil acts of the flesh and all unclean things, or desire for others' property, let it not even be named among you, as is right for saints;

chinese: 淫詞、妄語，和戲笑的話都不相宜；總要說感謝的話。
english: And let there be no low behaviour, or foolish talk, or words said in sport, which are not right, but in place of them the giving of praise.

chinese: 因為你們確實的知道，無論是淫亂的，是污穢的，是有貪心的，在基督和神的國裡都是無分的。有貪心的，就與拜偶像的一樣。
english: Being certain of this, that no man who gives way to the passions of the flesh, no unclean person, or one who has desire for the property of others, or who gives worship to images, has any heritage in the kingdom of Christ and God.

chinese: 不要被人虛浮的話欺哄；因這些事，神的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。
english: Do not be turned from the right way by foolish words; for because of these things the punishment of God comes on those who do not put themselves under him.

chinese: 所以，你們不要與他們同夥。
english: Have no part with such men;

chinese: 從前你們是暗昧的，但如今在主裡面是光明的，行事為人就當像光明的子女。
english: For you at one time were dark, but now are light in the Lord: let your behaviour be that of children of light

chinese: 光明所結的果子就是一切良善、公義、誠實。
english: (Because the fruit of the light is in all righteousness and in everything which is good and true),

chinese: 總要察驗何為主所喜悅的事。
english: Testing by experience what is well-pleasing to the Lord;

chinese: 那暗昧無益的事，不要與人同行，倒要責備行這事的人；
english: And have no company with the works of the dark, which give no fruit, but make their true quality clear;

chinese: 因為他們暗中所行的，就是題起來也是可恥的。
english: For the things which are done by them in secret it is shame even to put into words.

chinese: 凡事受了責備，就被光顯明出來，因為一切能顯明的就是光。
english: But all things, when their true quality is seen, are made clear by the light: because everything which is made clear is light.

chinese: 所以主說：你這睡著的人當醒過來，從死裡復活！基督就要光照你了。
english: For this reason he says, Be awake, you who are sleeping, and come up from among the dead, and Christ will be your light.

chinese: 你們要謹慎行事，不要像愚昧人，當像智慧人。
english: Take care then how you are living, not as unwise, but as wise;

chinese: 要愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代邪惡。
english: Making good use of the time, because the days are evil.

chinese: 不要作糊塗人，要明白主的旨意如何。
english: For this reason, then, do not be foolish, but be conscious of the Lord's pleasure.

chinese: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放蕩；乃要被聖靈充滿。
english: And do not take overmuch wine by which one may be overcome, but be full of the Spirit;

chinese: 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌、彼此對說，口唱心和的讚美主。
english: Joining with one another in holy songs of praise and of the Spirit, using your voice in songs and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

chinese: 凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常常感謝父神。
english: Giving praise at all times for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

chinese: 又當存敬畏基督的心，彼此順服。
english: Letting yourselves be ruled by one another in the fear of Christ.

chinese: 你們作妻子的，當順服自己的丈夫，如同順服主。
english: Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as of the Lord.

chinese: 因為丈夫是妻子的頭，如同基督是教會的頭；他又是教會全體的救主。
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is the head of the church, being himself the saviour of the body.

chinese: 教會怎樣順服基督，妻子也要怎樣凡事順服丈夫。
english: And as the church is under Christ's authority, so let wives be under the rule of their husbands in all things.

chinese: 你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，正如基督愛教會，為教會捨己。
english: Husbands, have love for your wives, even as Christ had love for the church, and gave himself for it;

chinese: 要用水藉著道把教會洗淨，成為聖潔，
english: So that he might make it holy, having made it clean with the washing of water by the word,

chinese: 可以獻給自己，作個榮耀的教會，毫無玷污、皺紋等類的病，乃是聖潔沒有瑕疵的。
english: And might take it for himself, a church full of glory, not having one mark or fold or any such thing; but that it might be holy and complete.

chinese: 丈夫也當照樣愛妻子，如同愛自己的身子；愛妻子便是愛自己了。
english: Even so it is right for husbands to have love for their wives as for their bodies. He who has love for his wife has love for himself:

chinese: 從來沒有人恨惡自己的身子，總是保養顧惜，正像基督待教會一樣，
english: For no man ever had hate for his flesh; but he gives it food and takes care of it, even as Christ does for the church;

chinese: 因我們是他身上的肢體（有古卷在此有：就是他的骨他的肉）。
english: Because we are parts of his body.

chinese: 為這個緣故，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
english: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.

chinese: 這是極大的奧祕，但我是指著基督和教會說的。
english: This is a great secret: but my words are about Christ and the church.

chinese: 然而，你們各人都當愛妻子，如同愛自己一樣。妻子也當敬重他的丈夫。
english: But do you, everyone, have love for his wife, even as for himself; and let the wife see that she has respect for her husband.

chinese: 你們作兒女的，要在主裡聽從父母，這是理所當然的。
english: Children, do what is ordered by your fathers and mothers in the Lord: for this is right.

chinese: 要孝敬父母，使你得福，在世長壽。這是第一條帶應許的誡命。
english: Give honour to your father and mother (which is the first rule having a reward),
So that all may be well for you, and your life may be long on the earth.

chinese: 你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，只要照著主的教訓和警戒養育他們。
english: And, you fathers, do not make your children angry: but give them training in the teaching and fear of the Lord.

chinese: 你們作僕人的，要懼怕戰兢，用誠實的心聽從你們肉身的主人，好像聽從基督一般。
english: Servants, do what is ordered by those who are your natural masters, having respect and fear for them, with all your heart, as to Christ;

chinese: 不要只在眼前事奉，像是討人喜歡的，要像基督的僕人，從心裡遵行神的旨意。
english: Not only under your master's eye, as pleasers of men; but as servants of Christ, doing the pleasure of God from the heart;

chinese: 甘心事奉，好像服事主，不像服事人。
english: Doing your work readily, as to the Lord, and not to men:

chinese: 因為曉得各人所行的善事，不論是為奴的，是自主的，都必按所行的得主的賞賜。
english: In the knowledge that for every good thing anyone does, he will have his reward from the Lord, If he is a servant or if he is free.

chinese: 你們作主人的，待僕人也是一理，不要威嚇他們。因為知道，他們和你們同有一位主在天上；他並不偏待人。
english: And, you masters, do the same things to them, not making use of violent words: in the knowledge that their Master and yours is in heaven, and he has no respect for a man's position.

chinese: 我還有末了的話：你們要靠著主，倚賴他的大能大力作剛強的人。
english: Lastly, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his power.

chinese: 要穿戴神所賜的全副軍裝，就能抵擋魔鬼的詭計。
english: Take up God's instruments of war, so that you may be able to keep your position against all the deceits of the Evil One.

chinese: 因我們並不是與屬血氣的爭戰（原文作摔跤；下同），乃是與那些執政的、掌權的、管轄這幽暗世界的，以及天空屬靈氣的惡魔爭戰。
english: For our fight is not against flesh and blood, but against authorities and powers, against the world-rulers of this dark night, against the spirits of evil in the heavens.

chinese: 所以，要拿起神所賜的全副軍裝，好在磨難的日子抵擋仇敵，並且成就了一切，還能站立得住。
english: For this reason take up all the arms of God, so that you may be able to be strong in the evil day, and, having done all, to keep your place.

chinese: 所以要站穩了，用真理當作帶子束腰，用公義當作護心鏡遮胸，
english: Take your place, then, having your body clothed with the true word, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness;

chinese: 又用平安的福音當作預備走路的鞋穿在腳上。
english: Be ready with the good news of peace as shoes on your feet;

chinese: 此外，又拿著信德當作籐牌，可以滅盡那惡者一切的火箭；
english: And most of all, using faith as a cover to keep off all the flaming arrows of the Evil One.

chinese: 並戴上救恩的頭盔，拿著聖靈的寶劍，就是神的道；
english: And take salvation for your head-dress and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

chinese: 靠著聖靈，隨時多方禱告祈求；並要在此儆醒不倦，為眾聖徒祈求，
english: With prayers and deep desires, making requests at all times in the Spirit, and keeping watch, with strong purpose, in prayer for all the saints,

chinese: 也為我祈求，使我得著口才，能以放膽開口講明福音的奧祕，
english: And for me, that words may be given to me in the opening of my mouth, to make clear without fear the secret of the good news,

chinese: 我為這福音的奧祕作了帶鎖鍊的使者，並使我照著當盡的本分放膽講論。
english: For which I am a representative in chains, and that I may say without fear the things which it is right for me to say.

chinese: 今有所親愛、忠心事奉主的兄弟推基古，他要把我的事情，並我的景況如何全告訴你們，叫你們知道。
english: But so that you may have knowledge of my business, and how I am, Tychicus, the well-loved brother and tested servant in the Lord, will give you news of all things:

chinese: 我特意打發他到你們那裡去，好叫你們知道我們的光景，又叫他安慰你們的心。
english: Whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, so that you may have knowledge of our position, and that he may give comfort to your hearts.

chinese: 願平安、仁愛、信心、從父神和主耶穌基督歸與弟兄們！
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 並願所有誠心愛我們主耶穌基督的人都蒙恩惠！
english: Grace be with all those who have true love for our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 基督耶穌的僕人保羅和提摩太寫信給凡住腓立比、在基督耶穌裡的眾聖徒，和諸位監督，諸位執事。
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, with the Bishops and Deacons of the church:

chinese: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父並主耶穌基督歸與你們！
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 我每逢想念你們，就感謝我的神；
english: I give praise to my God at every memory of you,

chinese: 每逢為你們眾人祈求的時候，常是歡歡喜喜的祈求。
english: And in all my prayers for you all, making my request with joy,

chinese: 因為從頭一天直到如今，你們是同心合意的興旺福音。
english: Because of your help in giving the good news from the first day till now;

chinese: 我深信那在你們心裡動了善工的，必成全這工，直到耶穌基督的日子。
english: For I am certain of this very thing, that he by whom the good work was started in you will make it complete till the day of Jesus Christ:

chinese: 我為你們眾人有這樣的意念，原是應當的；因你們常在我心裡，無論我是在捆鎖之中，是辯明證實福音的時候，你們都與我一同得恩。
english: So it is right for me to take thought for you all in this way, because I have you in my heart; for in my chains, and in my arguments before the judges in support of the good news, making clear that it is true, you all have your part with me in grace.

chinese: 我體會基督耶穌的心腸，切切的想念你們眾人；這是神可以給我作見證的。
english: For God is my witness, how my love goes out to you all in the loving mercies of Christ Jesus.

chinese: 我所禱告的，就是要你們的愛心在知識和各樣見識上多而又多，
english: And my prayer is that you may be increased more and more in knowledge and experience;

chinese: 使你們能分別是非（或作：喜愛那美好的事），作誠實無過的人，直到基督的日子；
english: So that you may give your approval to the best things; that you may be true and without wrongdoing till the day of Christ;

chinese: 並靠著耶穌基督結滿了仁義的果子，叫榮耀稱讚歸與神。
english: Being full of the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

chinese: 弟兄們，我願意你們知道，我所遭遇的事更是叫福音興旺，
english: Now it is my purpose to make clear to you, brothers, that the cause of the good news has been helped by my experiences;

chinese: 以致我受的捆鎖在御營全軍和其餘的人中，已經顯明是為基督的緣故。
english: So that it became clear through all the Praetorium, and to all the rest, that I was a prisoner on account of Christ;

chinese: 並且那在主裡的弟兄多半因我受的捆鎖就篤信不疑，越發放膽傳神的道，無所懼怕。
english: And most of the brothers in the Lord, taking heart because of my chains, are all the stronger to give the word of God without fear.

chinese: 有的傳基督是出於嫉妒紛爭，也有的是出於好意。
english: Though some are preaching Christ out of envy and competition, others do it out of a good heart:

chinese: 這一等是出於愛心，知道我是為辯明福音設立的；
english: These do it from love, conscious that I am responsible for the cause of the good news:

chinese: 那一等傳基督是出於結黨，並不誠實，意思要加增我捆鎖的苦楚。
english: But those are preaching Christ in a spirit of competition, not from their hearts, but with the purpose of giving me pain in my prison.

chinese: 這有何妨呢？或是假意，或是真心，無論怎樣，基督究竟被傳開了。為此，我就歡喜，並且還要歡喜；
english: What then? only that in every way, falsely or truly, the preaching of Christ goes on; and in this I am glad, and will be glad.

chinese: 因為我知道，這事藉著你們的祈禱和耶穌基督之靈的幫助，終必叫我得救。
english: For I am conscious that this will be for my salvation, through your prayer and the giving out of the stored wealth of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

chinese: 照著我所切慕、所盼望的，沒有一事叫我羞愧。只要凡事放膽，無論是生是死，總叫基督在我身上照常顯大。
english: In the measure of my strong hope and belief that in nothing will I be put to shame, but that without fear, as at all times, so now will Christ have glory in my body, by life or by death.

chinese: 因我活著就是基督，我死了就有益處。
english: For to me life is Christ and death is profit.

chinese: 但我在肉身活著，若成就我工夫的果子，我就不知道該挑選甚麼。
english: But if I go on living in the flesh--if this is the fruit of my work--then I do not see what decision to make.

chinese: 我正在兩難之間，情願離世與基督同在，因為這是好得無比的。
english: I am in a hard position between the two, having a desire to go away and be with Christ, which is very much better:

chinese: 然而，我在肉身活著，為你們更是要緊的。
english: Still, to go on in the flesh is more necessary because of you.

chinese: 我既然這樣深信，就知道仍要住在世間，且與你們眾人同住，使你們在所信的道上又長進又喜樂，
english: And being certain of this, I am conscious that I will go on, yes, and go on with you all, for your growth and joy in the faith;

chinese: 叫你們在基督耶穌裡的歡樂，因我再到你們那裡去，就越發加增。
english: So that your pride in me may be increased in Christ Jesus through my being present with you again.

chinese: 只要你們行事為人與基督的福音相稱，叫我或來見你們，或不在你們那裡，可以聽見你們的景況，知道你們同有一個心志，站立得穩，為所信的福音齊心努力。
english: Only let your behaviour do credit to the good news of Christ, so that if I come and see you or if I am away from you, I may have news of you that you are strong in one spirit, working together with one soul for the faith of the good news;

chinese: 凡事不怕敵人的驚嚇，這是證明他們沉淪，你們得救都是出於神。
english: Having no fear of those who are against you; which is a clear sign of their destruction, but of your salvation, and that from God;

chinese: 因為你們蒙恩，不但得以信服基督，並要為他受苦。
english: Because to you it has been given in the cause of Christ not only to have faith in him, but to undergo pain on his account:

chinese: 你們的爭戰，就與你們在我身上從前所看見、現在所聽見的一樣。
english: Fighting the same fight which you saw in me, and now have word of in me.

chinese: 所以，在基督裡若有甚麼勸勉，愛心有甚麼安慰，聖靈有甚麼交通，心中有甚麼慈悲憐憫，
english: If then there is any comfort in Christ, any help given by love, any uniting of hearts in the Spirit, any loving mercies and pity,

chinese: 你們就要意念相同，愛心相同，有一樣的心思，有一樣的意念，使我的喜樂可以滿足。
english: Make my joy complete by being of the same mind, having the same love, being in harmony and of one mind;

chinese: 凡事不可結黨，不可貪圖虛浮的榮耀；只要存心謙卑，各人看別人比自己強。
english: Doing nothing through envy or through pride, but with low thoughts of self let everyone take others to be better than himself;

chinese: 各人不要單顧自己的事，也要顧別人的事。
english: Not looking everyone to his private good, but keeping in mind the things of others.

chinese: 你們當以基督耶穌的心為心：
