english: Let this mind be in you which was in Christ Jesus,

chinese: 他本有神的形像，不以自己與神同等為強奪的；
english: To whom, though himself in the form of God, it did not seem that to take for oneself was to be like God;

chinese: 反倒虛己，取了奴僕的形像，成為人的樣式；
english: But he made himself as nothing, taking the form of a servant, being made like men;

chinese: 既有人的樣子，就自己卑微，存心順服，以至於死，且死在十字架上。
english: And being seen in form as a man, he took the lowest place, and let himself be put to death, even the death of the cross.

chinese: 所以，神將他升為至高，又賜給他那超乎萬名之上的名，
english: For this reason God has put him in the highest place and has given to him the name which is greater than every name;

chinese: 叫一切在天上的、地上的，和地底下的，因耶穌的名無不屈膝，
english: So that at the name of Jesus every knee may be bent, of those in heaven and those on earth and those in the underworld,

chinese: 無不口稱耶穌基督為主，使榮耀歸與父神。
english: And that every tongue may give witness that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

chinese: 這樣看來，我親愛的弟兄，你們既是常順服的，不但我在你們那裡，就是我如今不在你們那裡，更是順服的，就當恐懼戰兢做成你們得救的工夫。
english: So then, my loved ones, as you have at all times done what I say, not only when I am present, but now much more when I am not with you, give yourselves to working out your salvation with fear in your hearts;

chinese: 因為你們立志行事都是神在你們心裡運行，為要成就他的美意。
english: For it is God who is the cause of your desires and of your acts, for his good pleasure.

chinese: 凡所行的，都不要發怨言，起爭論，
english: Do all things without protests and arguments;

chinese: 使你們無可指摘，誠實無偽，在這彎曲悖謬的世代作神無瑕疵的兒女。你們顯在這世代中，好像明光照耀，
english: So that you may be holy and gentle, children of God without sin in a twisted and foolish generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

chinese: 將生命的道表明出來，叫我在基督的日子好誇我沒有空跑，也沒有徒勞。
english: Offering the word of life; so that I may have glory in you in the day of Christ, because my running was not for nothing and my work was not without effect.

chinese: 我以你們的信心為供獻的祭物，我若被澆奠在其上，也是喜樂，並且與你們眾人一同喜樂。
english: And even if I am offered like a drink offering, giving myself for the cause and work of your faith, I am glad and have joy with you all:

chinese: 你們也要照樣喜樂，並且與我一同喜樂。
english: And in the same way do you be glad and have a part in my joy.

chinese: 我靠主耶穌指望快打發提摩太去見你們，叫我知道你們的事，心裡就得著安慰。
english: But I am hoping in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you before long, so that I may be comforted when I have news of you.

chinese: 因為我沒有別人與我同心，實在罣念你們的事。
english: For I have no man of like mind who will truly have care for you.

chinese: 別人都求自己的事，並不求耶穌基督的事。
english: For they all go after what is theirs, not after the things of Christ.

chinese: 但你們知道提摩太的明證；他興旺福音，與我同勞，待我像兒子待父親一樣。
english: But his quality is clear to you; how, as a child is to its father, so he was a help to me in the work of the good news.

chinese: 所以，我一看出我的事要怎樣了結，就盼望立刻打發他去；
english: Him then I am hoping to send as quickly as possible, when I am able to see how things will go for me:

chinese: 但我靠著主自信我也必快去。
english: But I have faith in the Lord that I myself will come before long.

chinese: 然而，我想必須打發以巴弗提到你們那裡去。他是我的兄弟，與我一同做工，一同當兵，是你們所差遣的，也是供給我需用的。
english: But it seemed to me necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, who has taken part with me in the work and in the fight, and your servant, sent by you for help in my need;

chinese: 他很想念你們眾人，並且極其難過，因為你們聽見他病了。
english: Because his heart was with you all, and he was greatly troubled because you had news that he was ill:

chinese: 他實在是病了，幾乎要死；然而神憐恤他，不但憐恤他，也憐恤我，免得我憂上加憂。
english: For in fact he was ill almost to death: but God had mercy on him; and not only on him but on me, so that I might not have grief on grief.

chinese: 所以我越發急速打發他去，叫你們再見他，就可以喜樂，我也可以少些憂愁。
english: I have sent him, then, the more gladly, so that when you see him again, you may be happy and I may have the less sorrow.

chinese: 故此，你們要在主裡歡歡樂樂的接待他，而且要尊重這樣的人；
english: So take him to your hearts in the Lord with all joy, and give honour to such as he is:

chinese: 因他為做基督的工夫，幾乎至死，不顧性命，要補足你們供給我的不及之處。
english: Because for the work of Christ he was near to death, putting his life in danger to make your care for me complete.

chinese: 弟兄們，我還有話說，你們要靠主喜樂。我把這話再寫給你們，於我並不為難，於你們卻是妥當。
english: For the rest, my brothers, be glad in the Lord. Writing the same things to you is no trouble to me, and for you it is safe.

chinese: 應當防備犬類，防備作惡的，防備妄自行割的。
english: Be on the watch against dogs, against the workers of evil, against those of the circumcision:

chinese: 因為真受割禮的，乃是我們這以神的靈敬拜、在基督耶穌裡誇口、不靠著肉體的。
english: For we are the circumcision, who give worship to God and have glory in Jesus Christ, and have no faith in the flesh:

chinese: 其實，我也可以靠肉體；若是別人想他可以靠肉體，我更可以靠著了。
english: Even though I myself might have faith in the flesh: if any other man has reason to have faith in the flesh, I have more:

chinese: 我第八天受割禮；我是以色列族、便雅憫支派的人，是希伯來人所生的希伯來人。就律法說，我是法利賽人；
english: Being given circumcision on the eighth day, of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; in relation to the law, a Pharisee:

chinese: 就熱心說，我是逼迫教會的；就律法上的義說，我是無可指摘的。
english: In bitter hate I was cruel to the church; I kept all the righteousness of the law to the last detail.

chinese: 只是我先前以為與我有益的，我現在因基督都當作有損的。
english: But those things which were profit to me, I gave up for Christ.

chinese: 不但如此，我也將萬事當作有損的，因我以認識我主基督耶穌為至寶。我為他已經丟棄萬事，看作糞土，為要得著基督；
english: Yes truly, and I am ready to give up all things for the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, which is more than all: for whom I have undergone the loss of all things, and to me they are less than nothing, so that I may have Christ as my reward,

chinese: 並且得以在他裡面，不是有自己因律法而得的義，乃是有信基督的義，就是因信神而來的義，
english: And be seen in him, not having my righteousness which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

chinese: 使我認識基督，曉得他復活的大能，並且曉得和他一同受苦，效法他的死，
english: That I may have knowledge of him, and of the power of his coming back from the dead, and a part with him in his pains, becoming like him in his death;

chinese: 或者我也得以從死裡復活。
english: If in any way I may have the reward of life from the dead.

chinese: 這不是說我已經得著了，已經完全了；我乃是竭力追求，或者可以得著基督耶穌所以得著我的（或作：所要我得的）。
english: Not as if I had even now got the reward or been made complete: but I go on in the hope that I may come to the knowledge of that for which I was made the servant of Christ Jesus.

chinese: 弟兄們，我不是以為自己已經得著了；我只有一件事，就是忘記背後，努力面前的，
english: Brothers, it is clear to me that I have not come to that knowledge; but one thing I do, letting go those things which are past, and stretching out to the things which are before,

chinese: 向著標竿直跑，要得神在基督耶穌裡從上面召我來得的獎賞。
english: I go forward to the mark, even the reward of the high purpose of God in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 所以我們中間，凡是完全人總要存這樣的心；若在甚麼事上存別樣的心，神也必以此指示你們。
english: Then let us all, who have come to full growth, be of this mind: and if in anything you are of a different mind, even this will God make clear to you:

chinese: 然而，我們到了甚麼地步，就當照著甚麼地步行。
english: Only, as far as we have got, let us be guided by the same rule.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們要一同效法我，也當留意看那些照我們榜樣行的人。
english: Brothers, take me as your example, and take note of those who are walking after the example we have given.

chinese: 因為有許多人行事是基督十字架的仇敵。我屢次告訴你們，現在又流淚的告訴你們：
english: For there are those, of whom I have given you word before, and do so now with sorrow, who are haters of the cross of Christ;

chinese: 他們的結局就是沉淪；他們的神就是自己的肚腹。他們以自己的羞辱為榮耀，專以地上的事為念。
english: Whose end is destruction, whose god is the stomach, and whose glory is in their shame, whose minds are fixed on the things of the earth.

chinese: 我們卻是天上的國民，並且等候救主，就是主耶穌基督從天上降臨。
english: For our country is in heaven; from where the Saviour for whom we are waiting will come, even the Lord Jesus Christ:

chinese: 他要按著那能叫萬有歸服自己的大能，將我們這卑賤的身體改變形狀，和他自己榮耀的身體相似。
english: By whom this poor body of ours will be changed into the image of the body of his glory, in the measure of the working by which he is able to put all things under himself.

chinese: 我所親愛、所想念的弟兄們，你們就是我的喜樂，我的冠冕。我親愛的弟兄，你們應當靠主站立得穩。
english: So my brothers, well loved and very dear to me, my joy and crown, be strong in the Lord, my loved ones.

chinese: 我勸友阿爹和循都基，要在主裡同心。
english: I make request to Euodias and Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.

chinese: 我也求你這真實同負一軛的，幫助這兩個女人，因為他們在福音上曾與我一同勞苦；還有革利免，並其餘和我一同做工的，他們的名字都在生命冊上。
english: And I make request to you, true helper in my work, to see to the needs of those women who took part with me in the good news, with Clement and the rest of my brother-workers whose names are in the book of life.

chinese: 你們要靠主常常喜樂。我再說，你們要喜樂。
english: Be glad in the Lord at all times: again I say, Be glad.

chinese: 當叫眾人知道你們謙讓的心。主已經近了。
english: Let your gentle behaviour be clear to all men. The Lord is near.

chinese: 應當一無罣慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求，和感謝，將你們所要的告訴神。
english: Have no cares; but in everything with prayer and praise put your requests before God.

chinese: 神所賜、出人意外的平安必在基督耶穌裡保守你們的心懷意念。
english: And the peace of God, which is deeper than all knowledge, will keep your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 弟兄們，我還有未盡的話：凡是真實的、可敬的、公義的、清潔的、可愛的、有美名的，若有甚麼德行，若有甚麼稱讚，這些事你們都要思念。
english: For the rest, my brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things have honour, whatever things are upright, whatever things are holy, whatever things are beautiful, whatever things are of value, if there is any virtue and if there is any praise, give thought to these things.

chinese: 你們在我身上所學習的，所領受的，所聽見的，所看見的，這些事你們都要去行，賜平安的神就必與你們同在。
english: The things which came to you by my teaching and preaching, and which you saw in me, these things do, and the God of peace will be with you.

chinese: 我靠主大大的喜樂，因為你們思念我的心如今又發生；你們向來就思念我，只是沒得機會。
english: But I am very glad in the Lord that your care for me has come to life again; though you did in fact take thought for me, but you were not able to give effect to it.

chinese: 我並不是因缺乏說這話；我無論在甚麼景況都可以知足，這是我已經學會了。
english: But I will not say anything about my needs, for I am able, wherever I am, to be dependent on myself.

chinese: 我知道怎樣處卑賤，也知道怎樣處豐富；或飽足，或飢餓；或有餘，或缺乏，隨事隨在，我都得了祕訣。
english: It is the same to me if I am looked down on or honoured; everywhere and in all things I have the secret of how to be full and how to go without food; how to have wealth and how to be in need.

chinese: 我靠著那加給我力量的，凡事都能做。
english: I am able to do all things through him who gives me strength.

chinese: 然而，你們和我同受患難原是美事。
english: But you did well to have care for me in my need.

chinese: 腓立比人哪，你們也知道我初傳福音離了馬其頓的時候，論到授受的事，除了你們以外，並沒有別的教會供給我。
english: And you have knowledge, Philippians, that when the good news first came to you, when I went away from Macedonia, no church took part with me in the business of giving to the saints, but you only;

chinese: 就是我在帖撒羅尼迦，你們也一次兩次的打發人供給我的需用。
english: Because even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to me in my need.

chinese: 我並不求甚麼餽送，所求的就是你們的果子漸漸增多，歸在你們的賬上。
english: Not that I am looking for an offering, but for fruit which may be put to your credit.

chinese: 但我樣樣都有，並且有餘。我已經充足，因我從以巴弗提受了你們的餽送，當作極美的香氣，為神所收納、所喜悅的祭物。
english: I have all things and more than enough: I am made full, having had from Epaphroditus the things which came from you, a perfume of a sweet smell, an offering well pleasing to God.

chinese: 我的神必照他榮耀的豐富，在基督耶穌裡，使你們一切所需用的都充足。
english: And my God will give you all you have need of from the wealth of his glory in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 願榮耀歸給我們的父神，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
english: Now to God our Father be glory for ever and ever. So be it.

chinese: 請問在基督耶穌裡的各位聖徒安。在我這裡的眾弟兄都問你們安。
english: Give words of love to every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you their love.

chinese: 眾聖徒都問你們安。在該撒家裡的人特特的問你們安。
english: All the saints send their love to you, specially those who are of Caesar's house.

chinese: 願主耶穌基督的恩常在你們心裡！
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

chinese: 奉神旨意，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅和兄弟提摩太
english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, by the purpose of God, and Timothy our brother,

chinese: 寫信給歌羅西的聖徒，在基督裡有忠心的弟兄。願恩惠、平安從神我們的父歸與你們！
english: To the saints and true brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.

chinese: 我們感謝神、我們主耶穌基督的父，常常為你們禱告；
english: We give praise to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, making prayer for you at all times,

chinese: 因聽見你們在基督耶穌裡的信心，並向眾聖徒的愛心，
english: After hearing of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have for all the saints,

chinese: 是為那給你們存在天上的盼望；這盼望就是你們從前在福音真理的道上所聽見的。
english: Through the hope which is in store for you in heaven; knowledge of which was given to you before in the true word of the good news,

chinese: 這福音傳到你們那裡，也傳到普天之下，並且結果，增長，如同在你們中間，自從你們聽見福音，真知道神恩惠的日子一樣。
english: Which has come to you; and which in all the world is giving fruit and increase, as it has done in you from the day when it came to your ears and you had true knowledge of the grace of God;

chinese: 正如你們從我們所親愛、一同作僕人的以巴弗所學的。他為我們（有古卷：你們）作了基督忠心的執事，
english: As it was given to you by Epaphras, our well-loved helper, who is a true servant of Christ for us,

chinese: 也把你們因聖靈所存的愛心告訴了我們。
english: And who, himself, made clear to us your love in the Spirit.

chinese: 因此，我們自從聽見的日子，也就為你們不住的禱告祈求，願你們在一切屬靈的智慧悟性上，滿心知道神的旨意；
english: For this reason, we, from the day when we had word of it, keep on in prayer for you, that you may be full of the knowledge of his purpose, with all wisdom and experience of the Spirit,

chinese: 好叫你們行事為人對得起主，凡事蒙他喜悅，在一切善事上結果子，漸漸的多知道神；
english: Living uprightly in the approval of the Lord, giving fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

chinese: 照他榮耀的權能，得以在各樣的力上加力，好叫你們凡事歡歡喜喜的忍耐寬容；
english: Full of strength in the measure of the great power of his glory, so that you may undergo all troubles with joy;

chinese: 又感謝父，叫我們能與眾聖徒在光明中同得基業。
english: Giving praise to the Father who has given us a part in the heritage of the saints in light;

chinese: 他救了我們脫離黑暗的權勢，把我們遷到他愛子的國裡；
english: Who has made us free from the power of evil and given us a place in the kingdom of the Son of his love;

chinese: 我們在愛子裡得蒙救贖，罪過得以赦免。
english: In whom we have our salvation, the forgiveness of sins:

chinese: 愛子是那不能看見之神的像，是首生的，在一切被造的以先。
english: Who is the image of the unseen God coming into existence before all living things;

chinese: 因為萬有都是靠他造的，無論是天上的，地上的；能看見的，不能看見的；或是有位的，主治的，執政的，掌權的；一概都是藉著他造的，又是為他造的。
english: For by him all things were made, in heaven and on earth, things seen and things unseen, authorities, lords, rulers, and powers; all things were made by him and for him;

chinese: 他在萬有之先；萬有也靠他而立。
english: He is before all things, and in him all things have being.

chinese: 他也是教會全體之首。他是元始，是從死裡首先復生的，使他可以在凡事上居首位。
english: And he is the head of the body, the church: the starting point of all things, the first to come again from the dead; so that in all things he might have the chief place.

chinese: 因為父喜歡叫一切的豐盛在他裡面居住。
english: For God in full measure was pleased to be in him;

chinese: 既然藉著他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平，便藉著他叫萬有─無論是地上的、天上的─都與自己和好了。
english: Through him uniting all things with himself, having made peace through the blood of his cross; through him, I say, uniting all things which are on earth or in heaven.

chinese: 你們從前與神隔絕，因著惡行，心裡與他為敵。
english: And you, who in the past were cut off and at war with God in your minds through evil works, he has now made one

chinese: 但如今他藉著基督的肉身受死，叫你們與自己和好，都成了聖潔，沒有瑕疵，無可責備，把你們引到自己面前。
english: In the body of his flesh through death, so that you might be holy and without sin and free from all evil before him:

chinese: 只要你們在所信的道上恆心，根基穩固，堅定不移，不至被引動失去（原文是離開）福音的盼望。這福音就是你們所聽過的，也是傳與普天下萬人聽的（原文是凡受造的），我保羅也作了這福音的執事。
english: If you keep yourselves safely based in the faith, not moved from the hope of the good news which came to you, and which was given to every living being under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

chinese: 現在我為你們受苦，倒覺歡樂；並且為基督的身體，就是為教會，要在我肉身上補滿基督患難的缺欠。
english: Now I have joy in my pain because of you, and in my flesh I undergo whatever is still needed to make the sorrows of Christ complete, for the salvation of his body, the church;

chinese: 我照神為你們所賜我的職分作了教會的執事，要把神的道理傳得全備，
english: Of which I became a servant by the purpose of God which was given to me for you, to give effect to the word of God,

chinese: 這道理就是歷世歷代所隱藏的奧祕；但如今向他的聖徒顯明了。
english: The secret which has been kept from all times and generations, but has now been made clear to his saints,

chinese: 神願意叫他們知道，這奧祕在外邦人中有何等豐盛的榮耀，就是基督在你們心裡成了有榮耀的盼望。
english: To whom God was pleased to give knowledge of the wealth of the glory of this secret among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

chinese: 我們傳揚他，是用諸般的智慧，勸戒各人，教導各人，要把各人在基督裡完完全全的引到神面前。
english: Whom we are preaching; guiding and teaching every man in all wisdom, so that every man may be complete in Christ;

chinese: 我也為此勞苦，照著他在我�面運用的大能盡心竭力。
english: And for this purpose I am working, using all my strength by the help of his power which is working in me strongly.

chinese: 我願意你們曉得，我為你們和老底嘉人，並一切沒有與我親自見面的人，是何等的盡心竭力；
english: For it is my desire to give you news of the great fight I am making for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not seen my face in the flesh;

chinese: 要叫他們的心得安慰，因愛心互相聯絡，以致豐豐足足在悟性中有充足的信心，使他們真知神的奧祕，就是基督；
english: So that their hearts may be comforted, and that being joined together in love, they may come to the full wealth of the certain knowledge of the secret of God, even Christ,

chinese: 所積蓄的一切智慧知識，都在他裡面藏著。
english: In whom are all the secret stores of wisdom and knowledge.

chinese: 我說這話，免得有人用花言巧語迷惑你們。
english: I say this so that you may not be turned away by any deceit of words.

chinese: 我身子雖與你們相離，心卻與你們同在，見你們循規蹈矩，信基督的心也堅固，我就歡喜了。
english: For though I am not present in the flesh, still I am with you in the spirit, seeing with joy your order, and your unchanging faith in Christ.

chinese: 你們既然接受了主基督耶穌，就當遵他而行，
english: As, then, you took Christ Jesus the Lord, so go on in him,

chinese: 在他裡面生根建造，信心堅固，正如你們所領的教訓，感謝的心也更增長了。
english: Rooted and based together in him, strong in the faith which the teaching gave you, giving praise to God at all times.

chinese: 你們要謹慎，恐怕有人用他的理學和虛空的妄言，不照著基督，乃照人間的遺傳和世上的小學就把你們擄去。
english: Take care that no one takes you away by force, through man's wisdom and deceit, going after the beliefs of men and the theories of the world, and not after Christ:

chinese: 因為神本性一切的豐盛都有形有體的居住在基督裡面，
english: For in him all the wealth of God's being has a living form,

chinese: 你們在他裡面也得了豐盛。他是各樣執政掌權者的元首。
english: And you are complete in him, who is the head of all rule and authority:

chinese: 你們在他裡面也受了不是人手所行的割禮，乃是基督使你們脫去肉體情慾的割禮。
english: In whom you had a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

chinese: 你們既受洗與他一同埋葬，也就在此與他一同復活，都因信那叫他從死裡復活神的功用。
english: Having been put to death with him in baptism, by which you came to life again with him, through faith in the working of God, who made him come back from the dead.

chinese: 你們從前在過犯和未受割禮的肉體中死了，神赦免了你們（或作：我們）一切過犯，便叫你們與基督一同活過來；
english: And you, being dead through your sins and the evil condition of your flesh, to you, I say, he gave life together with him, and forgiveness of all our sins;

chinese: 又塗抹了在律例上所寫攻擊我們，有礙於我們的字據，把他撤去，釘在十字架上。
english: Having put an end to the handwriting of the law which was against us, taking it out of the way by nailing it to his cross;

chinese: 既將一切執政的、掌權的擄來，明顯給眾人看，就仗著十字架誇勝。
english: Having made himself free from the rule of authorities and powers, he put them openly to shame, glorying over them in it.

chinese: 所以，不拘在飲食上，或節期、月朔、安息日都不可讓人論斷你們。
english: For this reason let no man be your judge in any question of food or drink or feast days or new moons or Sabbaths:

chinese: 這些原是後事的影兒；那形體卻是基督。
english: For these are an image of the things which are to come; but the body is Christ's.

chinese: 不可讓人因著故意謙虛和敬拜天使，就奪去你們的獎賞。這等人拘泥在所見過的（有古卷作：這等人窺察所沒有見過的），隨著自己的慾心，無故的自高自大，
english: Let no man take your reward from you by consciously making little of himself and giving worship to angels; having his thoughts fixed on the things which he has seen, being foolishly lifted up in his natural mind,

chinese: 不持定元首。全身既然靠著他，筋節得以相助聯絡，就因神大得長進。
english: And not joined to the Head, from whom all the body, being given strength and kept together through its joins and bands, has its growth with the increase of God.

chinese: 你們若是與基督同死，脫離了世上的小學，為甚麼仍像在世俗中活著、服從那不可拿、不可嘗、不可摸等類的規條呢？
english: If you were made free, by your death with Christ, from the rules of the world, why do you put yourselves under the authority of orders
Which say there may be no touching, tasting, or taking in your hands,

chinese: 這都是照人所吩咐、所教導的。說到這一切，正用的時候就都敗壞了。
english: (Rules which are all to come to an end with their use) after the orders and teaching of men?

chinese: 這些規條使人徒有智慧之名，用私意崇拜，自表謙卑，苦待己身，其實在克制肉體的情慾上是毫無功效。
english: These things seem to have a sort of wisdom in self-ordered worship and making little of oneself, and being cruel to the body, not honouring it by giving it its natural use.

chinese: 所以，你們若真與基督一同復活，就當求在上面的事；那裡有基督坐在神的右邊。
english: If then you have a new life with Christ, give your attention to the things of heaven, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

chinese: 你們要思念上面的事，不要思念地上的事。
english: Keep your mind on the higher things, not on the things of earth.

chinese: 因為你們已經死了，你們的生命與基督一同藏在神裡面。
english: For your life on earth is done, and you have a secret life with Christ in God.

chinese: 基督是我們的生命，他顯現的時候，你們也要與他一同顯現在榮耀裡。
english: At the coming of Christ who is our life, you will be seen with him in glory.

chinese: 所以，要治死你們在地上的肢體，就如淫亂、污穢、邪情、惡慾，和貪婪。貪婪就與拜偶像一樣。
english: Then put to death your bodies which are of the earth; wrong use of the flesh, unclean things, passion, evil desires and envy, which is the worship of strange gods;

chinese: 因這些事，神的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。
english: Because of which the wrath of God comes on those who go against his orders;

chinese: 當你們在這些事中活著的時候，也曾這樣行過。
english: Among whom you were living in the past, when you did such things.

chinese: 但現在你們要棄絕這一切的事，以及惱恨、忿怒、惡毒（或作：陰毒）、毀謗，並口中污穢的言語。
english: But now it is right for you to put away all these things; wrath, passion, bad feeling, curses, unclean talk;

chinese: 不要彼此說謊；因你們已經脫去舊人和舊人的行為，
english: Do not make false statements to one another; because you have put away the old man with all his doings,

chinese: 穿上了新人。這新人在知識上漸漸更新，正如造他主的形像。
english: And have put on the new man, which has become new in knowledge after the image of his maker;

chinese: 在此並不分希利尼人、猶太人，受割禮的、未受割禮的，化外人，西古提人，為奴的、自主的，惟有基督是包括一切，又住在各人之內。
english: Where there is no Greek or Jew, no one with circumcision or without circumcision, no division between nations, no servant or free man: but Christ is all and in all.

chinese: 所以，你們既是神的選民，聖潔蒙愛的人，就要存（原文作穿；下同）憐憫、恩慈、謙虛、溫柔、忍耐的心。
english: As saints of God, then, holy and dearly loved, let your behaviour be marked by pity and mercy, kind feeling, a low opinion of yourselves, gentle ways, and a power of undergoing all things;

chinese: 倘若這人與那人有嫌隙，總要彼此包容，彼此饒恕；主怎樣饒恕了你們，你們也要怎樣饒恕人。
english: Being gentle to one another and having forgiveness for one another, if anyone has done wrong to his brother, even as the Lord had forgiveness for you:

chinese: 在這一切之外，要存著愛心，愛心就是聯絡全德的。
english: And more than all, have love; the only way in which you may be completely joined together.

chinese: 又要叫基督的平安在你們心裡作主；你們也為此蒙召，歸為一體；且要存感謝的心。
english: And let the peace of Christ be ruling in your hearts, as it was the purpose of God for you to be one body; and give praise to God at all times.

chinese: 當用各樣的智慧，把基督的道理豐豐富富的存在心裡，（或作：當把基督的道理豐豐富富的存在心裡，以各樣的智慧），用詩章、頌詞、靈歌，彼此教導，互相勸戒，心被恩感，歌頌神。
english: Let the word of Christ be in you in all wealth of wisdom; teaching and helping one another with songs of praise and holy words, making melody to God with grace in your hearts.

chinese: 無論做甚麼，或說話或行事，都要奉主耶穌的名，藉著他感謝父神。
english: And whatever you do, in word or in act, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving praise to God the Father through him.

chinese: 你們作妻子的，當順服自己的丈夫，這在主裡面是相宜的。
english: Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as is right in the Lord.

chinese: 你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，不可苦待他們。
english: Husbands, have love for your wives, and be not bitter against them.

chinese: 你們作兒女的，要凡事聽從父母，因為這是主所喜悅的。
english: Children, do the orders of your fathers and mothers in all things, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

chinese: 你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，恐怕他們失了志氣。
english: Fathers, do not be hard on your children, so that their spirit may not be broken.

chinese: 你們作僕人的，要凡事聽從你們肉身的主人，不要只在眼前事奉，像是討人喜歡的，總要存心誠實敬畏主。
english: Servants, in all things do the orders of your natural masters; not only when their eyes are on you, as pleasers of men, but with all your heart, fearing the Lord:

chinese: 無論做甚麼，都要從心裡做，像是給主做的，不是給人做的，
english: Whatever you do, do it readily, as to the Lord and not to men;

chinese: 因你們知道從主那裡必得著基業為賞賜；你們所事奉的乃是主基督。
english: Being certain that the Lord will give you the reward of the heritage: for you are the servants of the Lord Christ.

chinese: 那行不義的必受不義的報應；主並不偏待人。
english: For the wrongdoer will have punishment for the wrong he has done, without respect for any man's position.

chinese: 你們作主人的，要公公平平的待僕人，因為知道你們也有一位主在天上。
english: Masters, give your servants what is right and equal, conscious that you have a Master in heaven.

chinese: 你們要恆切禱告，在此儆醒感恩。
english: Give yourselves to prayer at all times, keeping watch with praise;

chinese: 也要為我們禱告，求神給我們開傳道的門，能以講基督的奧祕（我為此被捆鎖），
english: And making prayer for us, that God may give us an open door for the preaching of the word, the secret of Christ, for which I am now in chains;

chinese: 叫我按著所該說的話將這奧祕發明出來。
english: So that I may make it clear, as it is right for me to do.

chinese: 你們要愛惜光陰，用智慧與外人交往。
english: Be wise in your behaviour to those who are outside, making good use of the time.

chinese: 你們的言語要常常帶著和氣，好像用鹽調和，就可知道該怎樣回答各人。
english: Let your talk be with grace, mixed with salt, so that you may be able to give an answer to everyone.

chinese: 有我親愛的兄弟推基古要將我一切的事都告訴你們。他是忠心的執事，和我一同作主的僕人，
english: Tychicus will give you news of all my business: he is a dear brother and true servant and helper in the word;

chinese: 我特意打發他到你們那裡去，好叫你們知道我們的光景，又叫他安慰你們的心。
english: And I have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may have news of how we are, and so that he may give your hearts comfort;

chinese: 我又打發一位親愛忠心的兄弟阿尼西母同去；他也是你們那裡的人。他們要把這裡一切的事都告訴你們。
english: And with him I have sent Onesimus, the true and well-loved brother, who is one of you. They will give you word of everything which is taking place here.

chinese: 與我一同坐監的亞里達古問你們安。巴拿巴的表弟馬可也問你們安。（說到這馬可，你們已經受了吩咐；他若到了你們那裡，你們就接待他。）
english: Aristarchus, my brother-prisoner, sends his love to you, and Mark, a relation of Barnabas (about whom you have been given orders: if he comes to you, be kind to him),

chinese: 耶數又稱為猶士都，也問你們安。奉割禮的人中，只有這三個人是為神的國與我一同做工的，也是叫我心裡得安慰的。
english: And Jesus, whose other name is Justus; these are of the circumcision: they are my only brother-workers for the kingdom of God, who have been a comfort to me.

chinese: 有你們那裡的人，作基督耶穌僕人的以巴弗問你們安。他在禱告之間，常為你們竭力的祈求，願你們在神一切的旨意上得以完全，信心充足，能站立得穩。
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you his love, ever taking thought for you in his prayers, that you may be complete and fully certain of all the purpose of God.

chinese: 他為你們和老底嘉並希拉波立的弟兄多多的勞苦，這是我可以給他作見證的。
english: For I give witness of him that he has undergone much trouble for you and for those in Laodicea and in Hierapolis.

chinese: 所親愛的醫生路加和底馬問你們安。
english: Luke, our well-loved medical friend, and Demas, send you their love.

chinese: 請問老底嘉的弟兄和寧法，並他家裡的教會安。
english: Give my love to the brothers in Laodicea and to Nymphas and the church in their house.

chinese: 你們念了這書信，便交給老底嘉的教會，叫他們也念；你們也要念從老底嘉來的書信。
english: And when this letter has been made public among you, let the same be done in the church of Laodicea; and see that you have the letter from Laodicea.

chinese: 要對亞基布說：務要謹慎，盡你從主所受的職分。
english: Say to Archippus, See that you do the work which the Lord has given you to do.

chinese: 我保羅親筆問你們安。你們要記念我的捆鎖。願恩惠常與你們同在！
english: I, Paul, give you this word of love in my handwriting. Keep in memory that I am a prisoner. Grace be with you.

chinese: 保羅、西拉、提摩太寫信給帖撒羅尼迦在父神和主耶穌基督裡的教會。願恩惠平安歸與你們！
english: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.

chinese: 我們為你們眾人常常感謝神，禱告的時候提到你們，
english: We give praise to God at all times for you, keeping you in memory in our prayers;

chinese: 在神我們的父面前，不住的記念你們因信心所做的工夫，因愛心所受的勞苦，因盼望我們主耶穌基督所存的忍耐。
english: Having ever in mind your work of faith and acts of love and the strength of your hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;

chinese: 被神所愛的弟兄阿，我知道你們是蒙揀選的；
english: Being conscious, my brothers, dear to God, that you have been marked out by God's purpose;

chinese: 因為我們的福音傳到你們那裡，不獨在乎言語，也在乎權能和聖靈，並充足的信心，正如你們知道、我們在你們那裡，為你們的緣故是怎樣為人。
english: Because our good news came to you, not in word only, but in power, and in the Holy Spirit, so that you were completely certain of it; even as you saw what our behaviour to you was like from our love to you.

chinese: 並且你們在大難之中，蒙了聖靈所賜的喜樂，領受真道就效法我們，也效法了主；
english: And you took us and the Lord as your example, after the word had come to you in much trouble, with joy in the Holy Spirit;

chinese: 甚至你們作了馬其頓和亞該亞所有信主之人的榜樣。
english: So that you became an example to all those who have faith in Christ in Macedonia and Achaia.

chinese: 因為主的道從你們那裡已經傳揚出來。你們向神的信心不但在馬其頓和亞該亞，就是在各處也都傳開了；所以不用我們說甚麼話。
english: For not only was the word of the Lord sounding out from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith in God is made clear; so that we have no need to say anything.

chinese: 因為他們自己已經報明我們是怎樣進到你們那裡，你們是怎樣離棄偶像，歸向神，要服事那又真又活的神，
english: For they themselves give the news of how we came among you; and how you were turned from images to God, to the worship of a true and living God,

chinese: 等候他兒子從天降臨，就是他從死裡復活的─那位救我們脫離將來忿怒的耶穌。
english: Waiting for his Son from heaven, who came back from the dead, even Jesus, our Saviour from the wrath to come.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們自己原曉得我們進到你們那裡並不是徒然的。
english: For you yourselves, brothers, are conscious that our coming among you was not without effect:

chinese: 我們從前在腓立比被害受辱，這是你們知道的；然而還是靠我們的神放開膽量，在大爭戰中把神的福音傳給你們。
english: But after we had first undergone much pain and been cruelly attacked as you saw, at Philippi, by the help of God we gave you the good news without fear, though everything was against us.

chinese: 我們的勸勉不是出於錯誤，不是出於污穢，也不是用詭詐。
english: For our witness does not come from error or from an unclean heart or from deceit:

chinese: 但神既然驗中了我們，把福音託付我們，我們就照樣講，不是要討人喜歡，乃是要討那察驗我們心的神喜歡。
english: But even as the good news was given to us by the approval of God, so we give it out; not as pleasing men, but God by whom our hearts are tested.

chinese: 因為我們從來沒有用過諂媚的話，這是你們知道的；也沒有藏著貪心，這是神可以作見證的。
english: For it is common knowledge among you that we never made use of smooth-sounding false words, and God is witness that at no time were we secretly desiring profit for ourselves,

chinese: 我們作基督的使徒，雖然可以叫人尊重，卻沒有向你們或向別人求榮耀；
english: Or looking for glory from men, from you or from others, when we might have made ourselves a care to you as Apostles of Christ.

chinese: 只在你們中間存心溫柔，如同母親乳養自己的孩子。
english: But we were gentle among you, like a woman caring for her little ones:

chinese: 我們既是這樣愛你們，不但願意將神的福音給你們，連自己的性命也願意給你們，因你們是我們所疼愛的。
english: Even so, being full of loving desire for you, we took delight in giving you not only God's good news, but even our lives, because you were dear to us.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們記念我們的辛苦勞碌，晝夜做工，傳神的福音給你們，免得叫你們一人受累。
english: For you have the memory, my brothers, of our trouble and care; how, working night and day, so that we might not be a trouble to any of you, we gave you the good news of God.

chinese: 我們向你們信主的人，是何等聖潔、公義、無可指摘，有你們作見證，也有神作見證。
english: You are witnesses, with God, how holy and upright and free from all evil was our way of life among you who have faith;

chinese: 你們也曉得我們怎樣勸勉你們，安慰你們，囑咐你們各人，好像父親待自己的兒女一樣，
english: Even as you saw how, like a father with his children, we were teaching and comforting you all, and giving witness,

chinese: 要叫你們行事對得起那召你們進他國、得他榮耀的神。
english: So that your lives might be pleasing to God, who has given you a part in his kingdom and his glory.

chinese: 為此，我們也不住的感謝神，因你們聽見我們所傳神的道就領受了；不以為是人的道，乃以為是神的道。這道實在是神的，並且運行在你們信主的人心中。
english: And for this cause we still give praise to God, that, when the word came to your ears through us, you took it, not as the word of man, but, as it truly is, the word of God, which has living power in you who have faith.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們曾效法猶太中在基督耶穌裡神的各教會；因為你們也受了本地人的苦害，像他們受了猶太人的苦害一樣。
english: For you, my brothers, took as your examples the churches of God which are in Judaea in Christ Jesus; because you underwent the same things from your countrymen as they did from the Jews;

chinese: 這猶太人殺了主耶穌和先知，又把我們趕出去。他們不得神的喜悅，且與眾人為敵；
english: Who put to death the Lord Jesus and the prophets, violently driving us out; who are unpleasing to God and against all men;

chinese: 不許我們傳道給外邦人使外邦人得救，常常充滿自己的罪惡。神的忿怒臨在他們身上已經到了極處。
english: Who, to make the measure of their sins complete, kept us from giving the word of salvation to the Gentiles: but the wrath of God is about to come on them in the fullest degree.

chinese: 弟兄們，我們暫時與你們離別，是面目離別，心裡卻不離別；我們極力的想法子，很願意見你們的面。
english: But we, my brothers, being away from you for a short time, in body but not in heart, had all the more desire to see your face;

chinese: 所以我們有意到你們那裡；我保羅有一兩次要去，只是撒但阻擋了我們。
english: For which reason we made attempts to come to you, even I, Paul, once and again; but Satan kept us from coming.

chinese: 我們的盼望和喜樂，並所誇的冠冕是甚麼呢？豈不是我們主耶穌來的時候，你們在他面前站立得住麼？
english: For what is our hope or joy or crown of glory? Are not even you, before our Lord Jesus, at his coming?

chinese: 因為你們就是我們的榮耀，我們的喜樂。
english: For you are our glory and our joy.

chinese: 我們既不能再忍，就願意獨自等在雅典，
english: At last our desire to have news of you was so strong that, while we ourselves were waiting at Athens,

chinese: 打發我們的兄弟在基督福音上作神執事的（有古卷作：與神同工的）提摩太前去，堅固你們，並在你們所信的道上勸慰你們，
english: We sent Timothy, our brother and God's servant in the good news of Christ, to give you strength and comfort in your faith;

chinese: 免得有人被諸般患難搖動。因為你們自己知道我們受患難原是命定的。
english: So that no man might be moved by these troubles; because you see that these things are part of God's purpose for us.

chinese: 我們在你們那裡的時候，預先告訴你們，我們必受患難，以後果然應驗了，你們也知道。
english: And when we were with you, we said to you that trouble was before us; and so it came about, as you see.

chinese: 為此，我既不能再忍，就打發人去，要曉得你們的信心如何，恐怕那誘惑人的到底誘惑了你們，叫我們的勞苦歸於徒然。
english: For this reason, when I was no longer able to keep quiet, I sent to get news of your faith, fearing that you might be tested by the Evil One and that our work might come to nothing.

chinese: 但提摩太剛才從你們那裡回來，將你們信心和愛心的好消息報給我們，又說你們常常記念我們，切切的想見我們，如同我們想見你們一樣。
english: But now that Timothy has come to us from you, and has given us good news of your faith and love, and that you have happy memories of us, desiring greatly to see us, even as we do to see you;

chinese: 所以弟兄們，我們在一切困苦患難之中，因著你們的信心就得了安慰。
english: For this cause, brothers, in all our trouble and grief we were comforted about you because of your faith;

chinese: 你們若靠主站立得穩，我們就活了。
english: For it is life to us if you keep your faith in the Lord unchanged.

chinese: 我們在神面前，因著你們甚是喜樂，為這一切喜樂，可用何等的感謝為你們報答神呢？
english: For how great is the praise which we give to God for you, and how great the joy with which we are glad because of you before our God;

chinese: 我們晝夜切切的祈求，要見你們的面，補滿你們信心的不足。
english: Night and day requesting God again and again that we may see your face and make your faith complete.

chinese: 願神我們的父和我們的主耶穌一直引領我們到你們那裡去。
english: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus make a way for us to come to you;

chinese: 又願主叫你們彼此相愛的心，並愛眾人的心都能增長、充足，如同我們愛你們一樣；
english: And the Lord give you increase of love in fullest measure to one another and to all men, even as our love to you;

chinese: 好使你們當我們主耶穌同他眾聖徒來的時候，在我們父神面前，心裡堅固，成為聖潔，無可責備。
english: So that your hearts may be strong and free from all sin before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

chinese: 弟兄們，我還有話說：我們靠著主耶穌求你們，勸你們，你們既然受了我們的教訓，知道該怎樣行可以討神的喜悅，就要照你們現在所行的更加勉勵。
english: And last of all, the prayer which we make to you from our heart and in the name of the Lord Jesus, is this: that as we made clear to you what sort of behaviour is pleasing to God, as in fact you are doing now, so you will go on in these ways, but more and more.

chinese: 你們原曉得我們憑主耶穌傳給你們甚麼命令。
english: Because you have in mind the orders we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

chinese: 神的旨意就是要你們成為聖潔，遠避淫行；
english: For the purpose of God for you is this: that you may be holy, and may keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh;

chinese: 要你們各人曉得怎樣用聖潔、尊貴守著自己的身體。
english: So that every one of you may keep his body holy and in honour;

chinese: 不放縱私慾的邪情，像那不認識神的外邦人。
english: Not in the passion of evil desires, like the Gentiles, who have no knowledge of God;

chinese: 不要一個人在這事上越分，欺負他的弟兄；因為這一類的事，主必報應，正如我預先對你們說過，又切切囑咐你們的。
english: And that no man may make attempts to get the better of his brother in business: for the Lord is the judge in all these things, as we said to you before and gave witness.

chinese: 神召我們，本不是要我們沾染污穢，乃是要我們成為聖潔。
english: Because it is God's purpose that our way of life may be not unclean but holy.

chinese: 所以那棄絕的，不是棄絕人，乃是棄絕那賜聖靈給你們的神。
english: Whoever, then, goes against this word, goes against not man but God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.

chinese: 論到弟兄們相愛，不用人寫信給你們；因為你們自己蒙了神的教訓，叫你們彼此相愛。
english: But about loving the brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you in this letter: for you have the teaching of God that love for one another is right and necessary;

chinese: 你們向馬其頓全地的眾弟兄固然是這樣行，但我勸弟兄們要更加勉勵。
english: And, truly, you are lovers of all the brothers in Macedonia; but it is our desire that your love may be increased still more;

chinese: 又要立志作安靜人，辦自己的事，親手做工，正如我們從前所吩咐你們的，
english: And that you may take pride in being quiet and doing your business, working with your hands as we gave you orders;

chinese: 叫你們可以向外人行事端正，自己也就沒有甚麼缺乏了。
english: That you may be respected by those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

chinese: 論到睡了的人，我們不願意弟兄們不知道，恐怕你們憂傷，像那些沒有指望的人一樣。
english: But it is our desire, brothers, that you may be certain about those who are sleeping; so that you may have no need for sorrow, as others have who are without hope.

chinese: 我們若信耶穌死而復活了，那已經在耶穌裡睡了的人，神也必將他與耶穌一同帶來。
english: For if we have faith that Jesus underwent death and came back again, even so those who are sleeping will come again with him by God's power.

chinese: 我們現在照主的話告訴你們一件事：我們這活著還存留到主降臨的人，斷不能在那已經睡了的人之先。
english: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are still living at the coming of the Lord, will not go before those who are sleeping.

chinese: 因為主必親自從天降臨，有呼叫的聲音和天使長的聲音，又有神的號吹響；那在基督裡死了的人必先復活。
english: Because the Lord himself will come down from heaven with a word of authority, with the voice of the chief angel, with the sound of a horn: and the dead in Christ will come to life first;

chinese: 以後我們這活著還存留的人必和他們一同被提到雲裡，在空中與主相遇。這樣，我們就要和主永遠同在。
english: Then we who are still living will be taken up together with them into the clouds to see the Lord in the air: and so will we be for ever with the Lord.

chinese: 所以，你們當用這些話彼此勸慰。
english: So then, give comfort to one another with these words.

chinese: 弟兄們，論到時候、日期，不用寫信給你們；
english: But about the times and their order, my brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you.

chinese: 因為你們自己明明曉得，主的日子來到，好像夜間的賊一樣。
english: For you yourselves have the knowledge that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

chinese: 人正說平安穩妥的時候，災禍忽然臨到他們，如同產難臨到懷胎的婦人一樣。他們絕不能逃脫。
english: When they say, There is peace and no danger, then sudden destruction will come on them, as birth-pains on a woman with child; and they will not be able to get away from it.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們卻不在黑暗裡，叫那日子臨到你們像賊一樣。
english: But you, my brothers, are not in the dark, for that day to overtake you like a thief:

chinese: 你們都是光明之子，都是白晝之子。我們不是屬黑夜的，也不是屬幽暗的。
english: For you are all sons of light and of the day: we are not of the night or of the dark.

chinese: 所以我們不要睡覺像別人一樣，總要儆醒謹守。
english: So then, let us not take our rest as the others do, but let us be self-controlled and awake.

chinese: 因為睡了的人是在夜間睡，醉了的人是在夜間醉。
english: For those who are sleeping do so in the night; and those who are the worse for drink are so in the night;

chinese: 但我們既然屬乎白晝，就應當謹守，把信和愛當作護心鏡遮胸，把得救的盼望當作頭盔戴上。
english: But let us, who are of the day, be serious, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and on our heads, the hope of salvation.

chinese: 因為神不是預定我們受刑，乃是預定我們藉著我們主耶穌基督得救。
english: For God's purpose for us is not wrath, but salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

chinese: 他替我們死，叫我們無論醒著、睡著，都與他同活。
english: Who was put to death for us, so that, awake or sleeping, we may have a part in his life.

chinese: 所以，你們該彼此勸慰，互相建立，正如你們素常所行的。
english: So then, go on comforting and building up one another, as you have been doing.

chinese: 弟兄們，我們勸你們敬重那在你們中間勞苦的人，就是在主裡面治理你們、勸戒你們的。
english: But we make this request to you, my brothers: give attention to those who are working among you, who are over you in the Lord to keep order among you;

chinese: 又因他們所做的工，用愛心格外尊重他們。你們也要彼此和睦。
english: And have a high opinion of them in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.

chinese: 我們又勸弟兄們，要警戒不守規矩的人，勉勵灰心的人，扶助軟弱的人，也要向眾人忍耐。
english: And our desire is that you will keep control over those whose lives are not well ordered, giving comfort to the feeble-hearted, supporting those with little strength, and putting up with much from all.

chinese: 你們要謹慎，無論是誰都不可以惡報惡；或是彼此相待，或是待眾人，常要追求良善。
english: Let no one give evil for evil; but ever go after what is good, for one another and for all.

chinese: 要常常喜樂，
english: Have joy at all times.

chinese: 不住的禱告，
english: Keep on with your prayers.

chinese: 凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裡向你們所定的旨意。
english: In everything give praise: for this is the purpose of God in Christ Jesus for you.

chinese: 不要銷滅聖靈的感動；
english: Do not put out the light of the Spirit;

chinese: 不要藐視先知的講論。
english: Do not make little of the words of the prophets;

chinese: 但要凡事察驗，善美的要持守，
english: Let all things be tested; keep to what is good;

chinese: 各樣的惡事要禁戒不做。
english: Keep from every form of evil.

chinese: 願賜平安的神親自使你們全然成聖！又願你們的靈與魂與身子得蒙保守，在我主耶穌基督降臨的時候，完全無可指摘！
english: And may the God of peace himself make you holy in every way; and may your spirit and soul and body be free from all sin at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 那召你們的本是信實的，他必成就這事。
english: God, by whom you have been marked out in his purpose, is unchanging and will make it complete.

chinese: 請弟兄們為我們禱告。
english: Brothers, keep us in mind in your prayers.

chinese: 與眾弟兄親嘴問安，務要聖潔。
english: Give all the brothers a holy kiss.

chinese: 我指著主囑咐你們，要把這信念給眾弟兄聽。
english: I give orders in the name of the Lord that all the brothers are to be present at the reading of this letter.

chinese: 願我主耶穌基督的恩常與你們同在！
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

chinese: 保羅、西拉、提摩太寫信給帖撒羅尼迦在神我們的父與主耶穌基督裡的教會。
english: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

chinese: 願恩惠、平安從父神和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 弟兄們，我們該為你們常常感謝神，這本是合宜的；因你們的信心格外增長，並且你們眾人彼此相愛的心也都充足。
english: It is right for us to give praise to God at all times for you, brothers, because of the great increase of your faith, and the wealth of your love for one another;

chinese: 甚至我們在神的各教會裡為你們誇口，都因你們在所受的一切逼迫患難中，仍舊存忍耐和信心。
english: So that we ourselves take pride in you in the churches of God for your untroubled mind and your faith in all the troubles and sorrows which you are going through;

chinese: 這正是神公義判斷的明證，叫你們可算配得神的國；你們就是為這國受苦。
english: Which is a clear sign of the decision which God in his righteousness has made; to give you a part in his kingdom, for which you have undergone this pain;

chinese: 神既是公義的，就必將患難報應那加患難給你們的人；
english: For it is an act of righteousness on God's part to give trouble as their reward to those who are troubling you,

chinese: 也必使你們這受患難的人與我們同得平安。那時，主耶穌同他有能力的天使從天上在火燄中顯現，
english: And to you who are troubled, rest with us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with the angels of his power in flames of fire,

chinese: 要報應那不認識神和那不聽從我主耶穌福音的人。
english: To give punishment to those who have no knowledge of God, and to those who do not give ear to the good news of our Lord Jesus:

chinese: 他們要受刑罰，就是永遠沉淪，離開主的面和他權能的榮光。
english: Whose reward will be eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his strength,

chinese: 這正是主降臨、要在他聖徒的身上得榮耀，又在一切信的人身上顯為希奇的那日子。（我們對你們作的見證，你們也信了。）
english: At his coming, when he will have glory in his saints, and will be a cause of wonder in all those who had faith (because our witness among you had effect) in that day.

chinese: 因此，我們常為你們禱告，願我們的神看你們配得過所蒙的召，又用大能成就你們一切所羨慕的良善和一切因信心所做的工夫；
english: For this reason, you are ever in our prayers, that you may seem to our God such as may have a part in his purpose and that by his power he will make all his good purpose, and the work of faith, complete;

chinese: 叫我們主耶穌的名在你們身上得榮耀，你們也在他身上得榮耀，都照著我們的神並主耶穌基督的恩。
english: So that glory may be given to the name of our Lord Jesus through you, and you may have glory in him, by the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 弟兄們，論到我們主耶穌基督降臨和我們到他那裡聚集，
english: Now as to the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ, and our meeting with him, it is our desire, my brothers,

chinese: 我勸你們：無論有靈、有言語、有冒我名的書信，說主的日子現在（或作：就）到了，不要輕易動心，也不要驚慌。
english: That you may not be moved in mind or troubled by a spirit, or by a word, or by a letter as from us, with the suggestion that the day of the Lord is even now come;

chinese: 人不拘用甚麼法子，你們總不要被他誘惑；因為那日子以前，必有離道反教的事，並有那大罪人，就是沉淪之子，顯露出來。
english: Give no belief to false words: because there will first be a falling away from the faith, and the revelation of the man of sin, the son of destruction,

chinese: 他是抵擋主，高抬自己，超過一切稱為神的和一切受人敬拜的，甚至坐在神的殿裡，自稱是神。
english: Who puts himself against all authority, lifting himself up over all which is named God or is given worship; so that he takes his seat in the Temple of God, putting himself forward as God.

chinese: 我還在你們那裡的時候，曾把這些事告訴你們，你們不記得麼？
english: Have you no memory of what I said when I was with you, giving you word of these things?

chinese: 現在你們也知道，那攔阻他的是甚麼，是叫他到了的時候才可以顯露。
english: And now it is clear to you what is keeping back his revelation till the time comes for him to be seen.

chinese: 因為那不法的隱意已經發動，只是現在有一個攔阻的，等到那攔阻的被除去，
english: For the secret of evil is even now at work: but there is one who is keeping back the evil till he is taken out of the way.

chinese: 那時這不法的人必顯露出來。主耶穌要用口中的氣滅絕他，用降臨的榮光廢掉他。
english: And then will come the revelation of that evil one, whom the Lord Jesus will put to death with the breath of his mouth, and give to destruction by the revelation of his coming;

chinese: 這不法的人來，是照撒但的運動，行各樣的異能、神蹟，和一切虛假的奇事，
english: Even the one whose coming is marked by the working of Satan, with all power and signs and false wonders,

chinese: 並且在那沉淪的人身上行各樣出於不義的詭詐；因他們不領受愛真理的心，使他們得救。
english: And with every deceit of wrongdoing among those whose fate is destruction; because they were quite without that love of the true faith by which they might have salvation.

chinese: 故此，神就給他們一個生發錯誤的心，叫他們信從虛謊，
english: And for this cause, God will give them up to the power of deceit and they will put their faith in what is false:

chinese: 使一切不信真理、倒喜愛不義的人都被定罪。
english: So that they all may be judged, who had no faith in what is true, but took pleasure in evil.

chinese: 主所愛的弟兄們哪，我們本該常為你們感謝神；因為他從起初揀選了你們，叫你們因信真道，又被聖靈感動，成為聖潔，能以得救。
english: But it is right for us to give praise to God at all times for you, brothers, loved by the Lord, because it was the purpose of God from the first that you might have salvation, being made holy by the Spirit and by faith in what is true:

chinese: 神藉我們所傳的福音召你們到這地步，好得著我們主耶穌基督的榮光。
english: And in this purpose he gave you a part through the good news of which we were the preachers, even that you might have part in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 所以，弟兄們，你們要站立得穩，凡所領受的教訓，不拘是我們口傳的，是信上寫的，都要堅守。
english: So then, brothers, be strong in purpose, and keep the teaching which has been given to you by word or by letter from us.

chinese: 但願我們主耶穌基督和那愛我們、開恩將永遠的安慰並美好的盼望賜給我們的父神，
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who had love for us and has given us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

chinese: 安慰你們的心，並且在一切善行善言上堅固你們。
english: Give you comfort and strength in every good work and word.

chinese: 弟兄們，我還有話說：請你們為我們禱告，好叫主的道理快快行開，得著榮耀，正如在你們中間一樣。
english: For the rest, my brothers, let there be prayer for us that the word of the Lord may go forward with increasing glory, even as it does with you;

chinese: 也叫我們脫離無理之惡人的手，因為人不都是有信心。
english: And that we may be made free from foolish and evil men; for not all have faith.

chinese: 但主是信實的，要堅固你們，保護你們脫離那惡者。（或作：脫離兇惡）。
english: But the Lord is true, who will give you strength and keep you safe from evil.

chinese: 我們靠主深信，你們現在是遵行我們所吩咐的，後來也必要遵行。
english: And we have faith in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things about which we give you orders.

chinese: 願主引導你們的心，叫你們愛神，並學基督的忍耐。
english: And may your hearts be guided by the Lord into the love of God and quiet waiting for Christ.

chinese: 弟兄們，我們奉主耶穌基督的名吩咐你們，凡有弟兄不按規矩而行，不遵守從我們所受的教訓，就當遠離他。
english: Now we give you orders, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from all those whose behaviour is not well ordered and in harmony with the teaching which they had from us.

chinese: 你們自己原知道應當怎樣效法我們。因為我們在你們中間，未嘗不按規矩而行，
english: For you yourselves are used to taking us as your example, because our life among you was ruled by order,

chinese: 也未嘗白吃人的飯，倒是辛苦勞碌，晝夜做工，免得叫你們一人受累。
english: And we did not take food from any man for nothing, but were working hard night and day not to be a trouble to any of you:

chinese: 這並不是因我們沒有權柄，乃是要給你們作榜樣，叫你們效法我們。
english: Not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, so that you might do the same.

chinese: 我們在你們那裡的時候，曾吩咐你們說，若有人不肯做工，就不可吃飯。
english: For even when we were with you we gave you orders, saying, If any man does no work, let him not have food.

chinese: 因我們聽說，在你們中間有人不按規矩而行，甚麼工都不做，反倒專管閒事。
english: For it has come to our ears that there are some among you whose behaviour is uncontrolled, who do no work at all, but are over-interested in the business of others.

chinese: 我們靠主耶穌基督吩咐、勸戒這樣的人，要安靜做工，吃自己的飯。
english: Now to such we give orders and make request in the Lord Jesus, that, working quietly, they get their living.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們行善不可喪志。
english: And you, my brothers, do not get tired of well-doing.

chinese: 若有人不聽從我們這信上的話，要記下他，不和他交往，叫他自覺羞愧。
english: And if any man does not give attention to what we have said in this letter, take note of that man, and keep away from him, so that he may be shamed.

chinese: 但不要以他為仇人，要勸他如弟兄。
english: Have no feeling of hate for him, but take him in hand seriously as a brother.

chinese: 願賜平安的主隨時隨事親自給你們平安！願主常與你們眾人同在！
english: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. May the Lord be with you all.

chinese: 我保羅親筆問你們安。凡我的信都以此為記，我的筆跡就是這樣。
english: These words of love to you at the end are in my writing, Paul's writing, and this is the mark of every letter from me.

chinese: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩常與你們眾人同在！
english: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

chinese: 奉我們救主神和我們的盼望基督耶穌之命，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅，
english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, by the order of God our Saviour and Christ Jesus our hope;

chinese: 寫信給那因信主作我真兒子的提摩太。願恩惠、憐憫、平安從父神和我們主基督耶穌歸與你！
english: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

chinese: 我往馬其頓去的時候，曾勸你仍住在以弗所，好囑咐那幾個人不可傳異教，
english: It was my desire, when I went on into Macedonia, that you might make a stop at Ephesus, to give orders to certain men not to put forward a different teaching,

chinese: 也不可聽從荒渺無憑的話語和無窮的家譜；這等事只生辯論，並不發明神在信上所立的章程。
english: Or to give attention to stories and long lists of generations, from which come questionings and doubts, in place of God's ordered way of life which is in faith;

chinese: 但命令的總歸就是愛；這愛是從清潔的心和無虧的良心，無偽的信心生出來的。
english: But the effect of the order is love coming from a clean heart, and a knowledge of what is right, and true faith:

chinese: 有人偏離這些，反去講虛浮的話，
english: From which some have been turned away, giving themselves to foolish talking;

chinese: 想要作教法師，卻不明白自己所講說的所論定的。
english: Desiring to be teachers of the law, though they have no knowledge of what they say or of the statements which they make so certainly.

chinese: 我們知道律法原是好的，只要人用得合宜；
english: We are conscious that the law is good, if a man makes a right use of it,

chinese: 因為律法不是為義人設立的，乃是為不法和不服的，不虔誠和犯罪的，不聖潔和戀世俗的，弒父母和殺人的，
english: With the knowledge that the law is made, not for the upright man, but for those who have no respect for law and order, for evil men and sinners, for the unholy and those who have no religion, for those who put their fathers or mothers to death, for takers of life,

chinese: 行淫和親男色的，搶人口和說謊話的，並起假誓的，或是為別樣敵正道的事設立的。
english: For those who go after loose women, for those with unnatural desires, for those who take men prisoners, who make false statements and false oaths, and those who do any other things against the right teaching,

chinese: 這是照著可稱頌之神交託我榮耀福音說的。
english: Which may be seen in the good news of the glory of the great God, which was given into my care.

chinese: 我感謝那給我力量的我們主基督耶穌，因他以我有忠心，派我服事他。
english: I give praise to him who gave me power, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he took me to be true, making me his servant,

chinese: 我從前是褻瀆神的，逼迫人的，侮慢人的；然而我還蒙了憐憫，因我是不信不明白的時候而做的。
english: Though I had said violent words against God, and done cruel acts, causing great trouble: but I was given mercy, because I did it without knowledge, not having faith;

chinese: 並且我主的恩是格外豐盛，使我在基督耶穌裡有信心和愛心。
english: And the grace of our Lord was very great, with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 基督耶穌降世，為要拯救罪人。這話是可信的，是十分可佩服的。在罪人中我是個罪魁。
english: It is a true saying, in which all may put their faith, that Christ Jesus came into the world to give salvation to sinners, of whom I am the chief:

chinese: 然而，我蒙了憐憫，是因耶穌基督要在我這罪魁身上顯明他一切的忍耐，給後來信他得永生的人作榜樣。
english: But for this reason I was given mercy, so that in me, the chief of sinners, Jesus Christ might make clear all his mercy, as an example to those who in the future would have faith in him to eternal life.

chinese: 但願尊貴、榮耀歸與那不能朽壞、不能看見、永世的君王、獨一的神，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
english: Now to the King eternal, ever-living, unseen, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. So be it.

chinese: 我兒提摩太阿，我照從前指著你的預言，將這命令交託你，叫你因此可以打那美好的仗。
english: This order I give to you, Timothy my son, in harmony with the words of the prophets about you, so that by them you may be strong, fighting the good fight,

chinese: 常存信心和無虧的良心。有人丟棄良心，就在真道上如同船破壞了一般。
english: Keeping faith, and being conscious of well-doing; for some, by not doing these things, have gone wrong in relation to the faith:

chinese: 其中有許米乃和亞力山大；我已經把他們交給撒但，使他們受責罰就不再謗瀆了。
english: Such are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have given up to Satan, so that they may say no more evil words against God.

chinese: 我勸你，第一要為萬人懇求、禱告、代求、祝謝；
english: My desire is, first of all, that you will make requests and prayers and give praise for all men;

chinese: 為君王和一切在位的，也該如此，使我們可以敬虔、端正、平安無事的度日。
english: For kings and all those in authority; so that we may have a calm and quiet life in all fear of God and serious behaviour.

chinese: 這是好的，在神我們救主面前可蒙悅納。
english: This is good and pleasing in the eyes of God our Saviour;

chinese: 他願意萬人得救，明白真道。
english: Whose desire is that all men may have salvation and come to the knowledge of what is true.

chinese: 因為只有一位神，在神和人中間，只有一位中保，乃是降世為人的基督耶穌；
english: For there is one God and one peacemaker between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

chinese: 他捨自己作萬人的贖價，到了時候，這事必證明出來。
english: Who gave himself as an offering for all; witness of which was to be given at the right time;

chinese: 我為此奉派作傳道的，作使徒，作外邦人的師傅，教導他們相信，學習真道。我說的是真話，並不是謊言。
english: And of this I became a preacher and an Apostle (what I say is true, not false,) and a teacher of the Gentiles in the true faith.

chinese: 我願男人無忿怒，無爭論（或作：疑惑），舉起聖潔的手，隨處禱告。
english: It is my desire, then, that in every place men may give themselves to prayer, lifting up holy hands, without wrath or argument.

chinese: 又願女人廉恥、自守，以正派衣裳為妝飾，不以編髮、黃金、珍珠，和貴價的衣裳為妝飾；
english: And that women may be dressed in simple clothing, with a quiet and serious air; not with twisted hair and gold or jewels or robes of great price;

chinese: 只要有善行，這才與自稱是敬神的女人相宜。
english: But clothed with good works, as is right for women who are living in the fear of God.

chinese: 女人要沉靜學道，一味的順服。
english: Let a woman quietly take the place of a learner and be under authority.

chinese: 我不許女人講道，也不許他轄管男人，只要沉靜。
english: In my opinion it is right for a woman not to be a teacher, or to have rule over a man, but to be quiet.

chinese: 因為先造的是亞當，後造的是夏娃；
english: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;

chinese: 且不是亞當被引誘，乃是女人被引誘，陷在罪裡。
english: And Adam was not taken by deceit, but the woman, being tricked, became a wrongdoer.

chinese: 然而，女人若常存信心、愛心，又聖潔自守，就必在生產上得救。
english: But if they go on in faith and love and holy self-control, she will be kept safe at the time of childbirth.

chinese: 人若想要得監督的職分，就是羨慕善工。這話是可信的。
english: This is a true saying, A man desiring the position of a Bishop has a desire for a good work.

chinese: 作監督的，必須無可指責，只作一個婦人的丈夫，有節制，自守，端正，樂意接待遠人，善於教導；
english: The Bishop, then, is to be a man of good name, the husband of one wife, self-controlled, serious-minded, having respect for order, opening his house freely to guests, a ready teacher;

chinese: 不因酒滋事，不打人，只要溫和，不爭競，不貪財；
english: Not quickly moved to wrath or blows, but gentle; no fighter, no lover of money;

chinese: 好好管理自己的家，使兒女凡事端莊順服（或作：端端莊莊地使兒女順服）。
english: Ruling his house well, having his children under control with all serious behaviour;

chinese: 人若不知道管理自己的家，焉能照管神的教會呢？
english: (For if a man has not the art of ruling his house, how will he take care of the church of God?)

chinese: 初入教的不可作監督，恐怕他自高自大，就落在魔鬼所受的刑罰裡。
english: Not one newly taken into the church, for fear that, through his high opinion of himself, he may come into the same sin as the Evil One.

chinese: 監督也必須在教外有好名聲，恐怕被人毀謗，落在魔鬼的網羅裡。
english: And he is to have a good name among those outside the church, so that nothing may be said against him and he may not be taken by the designs of the Evil One.

chinese: 作執事的，也是如此：必須端莊，不一口兩舌，不好喝酒，不貪不義之財；
english: Deacons, in the same way, are to be serious in their behaviour, not false in word, not given to taking much wine or greatly desiring the wealth of this world;

chinese: 要存清潔的良心，固守真道的奧祕。
english: Keeping the secret of the faith in a heart free from sin.

chinese: 這等人也要先受試驗，若沒有可責之處，然後叫他們作執事。
english: And let these first be put to the test; then let them become Deacons if there is nothing against them.

chinese: 女執事（原文是女人）也是如此：必須端莊，不說讒言，有節制，凡事忠心。
english: Women are to be serious in behaviour, saying no evil of others, controlling themselves, true in all things.

chinese: 執事只要作一個婦人的丈夫，好好管理兒女和自己的家。
english: Let Deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their houses well.

chinese: 因為善作執事的，自己就得到美好的地步，並且在基督耶穌裡的真道上大有膽量。
english: For those who have done good work as Deacons get for themselves a good position and become free from fear in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 我指望快到你那裡去，所以先將這些事寫給你。
english: I am writing these things to you, though I am hoping to come to you before long;

chinese: 倘若我耽延日久，你也可以知道在神的家中當怎樣行。這家就是永生神的教會，真理的柱石和根基。
english: But if I am long in coming, this will make clear to you what behaviour is right for men in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and base of what is true.

chinese: 大哉，敬虔的奧祕！無人不以為然：就是神在肉身顯現，被聖靈稱義（或作：在靈性稱義），被天使看見，被傳於外邦，被世人信服，被接在榮耀裡。
english: And without argument, great is the secret of religion: He who was seen in the flesh, who was given God's approval in the spirit, was seen by the angels, of whom the good news was given among the nations, in whom the world had faith, who was taken up in glory.

chinese: 聖靈明說，在後來的時候，必有人離棄真道，聽從那引誘人的邪靈和鬼魔的道理。
english: But the Spirit says clearly that in later times some will be turned away from the faith, giving their minds to spirits of deceit, and the teachings of evil spirits,

chinese: 這是因為說謊之人的假冒；這等人的良心如同被熱鐵烙慣了一般。
english: Through the false ways of men whose words are untrue, whose hearts are burned as with a heated iron;

chinese: 他們禁止嫁娶，又禁戒食物（或作：又叫人戒葷），就是神所造、叫那信而明白真道的人感謝著領受的。
english: Who keep men from being married and from taking food which God made to be taken with praise by those who have faith and true knowledge.

chinese: 凡神所造的物都是好的，若感謝著領受，就沒有一樣可棄的，
english: Because everything which God has made is good, and nothing is evil, if it is taken with praise:

chinese: 都因神的道和人的祈求成為聖潔了。
english: For it is made holy by the word of God and by prayer.

chinese: 你若將這些事提醒弟兄們，便是基督耶穌的好執事，在真道的話語和你向來所服從的善道上得了教育。
english: If you keep these things before the minds of the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, trained in the words of the faith and of the right teaching which has been your guide:

chinese: 只是要棄絕那世俗的言語和老婦荒渺的話，在敬虔上操練自己。
english: But have nothing to do with unclean and foolish stories. Give yourself training in religion:

chinese: 操練身體，益處還少；惟獨敬虔，凡事都有益處，因有今生和來生的應許。
english: For the training of the body is of profit for a little, but religion is of profit in every way, giving hope for the life which now is, and for that which is to come.

chinese: 這話是可信的，是十分可佩服的。
english: This is a true saying, in which all may put their faith.

chinese: 我們勞苦努力，正是為此，因我們的指望在乎永生的神；他是萬人的救主，更是信徒的救主。
english: And this is the purpose of all our work and our fighting, because our hope is in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, and specially of those who have faith.

chinese: 這些事，你要吩咐人，也要教導人。
english: Let these be your orders and your teaching.

chinese: 不可叫人小看你年輕，總要在言語、行為、愛心、信心、清潔上，都作信徒的榜樣。
english: Let no one make little of you because you are young, but be an example to the church in word, in behaviour, in love, in faith, in holy living.

chinese: 你要以宣讀、勸勉、教導為念，直等到我來。
english: Till I come, give attention to the reading of the holy Writings, to comforting the saints, and to teaching.

chinese: 你不要輕忽所得的恩賜，就是從前藉著預言、在眾長老按手的時候賜給你的。
english: Make use of that grace in you, which was given to you by the word of the prophets, when the rulers of the church put their hands on you.

chinese: 這些事你要殷勤去做，並要在此專心，使眾人看出你的長進來。
english: Have a care for these things; give yourself to them with all your heart, so that all may see how you go forward.

chinese: 你要謹慎自己和自己的教訓，要在這些事上恆心；因為這樣行，又能救自己，又能救聽你的人。
english: Give attention to yourself and your teaching. Go on in these things; for in doing so you will get salvation for yourself and for those who give hearing to you.

chinese: 不可嚴責老年人，只要勸他如同父親；勸少年人如同弟兄；
english: Do not say sharp words to one who has authority in the church, but let your talk be as to a father, and to the younger men as to brothers:

chinese: 勸老年婦女如同母親；勸少年婦女如同姐妹；總要清清潔潔的。
english: To the older women as to mothers, to the younger as to sisters, with a clean heart.

chinese: 要尊敬那真為寡婦的。
english: Give honour to widows who are truly widows.

chinese: 若寡婦有兒女，或有孫子孫女，便叫他們先在自己家中學著行孝，報答親恩，因為這在神面前是可悅納的。
english: But if any widow has children or children's children, let these see that it is right to take care of their family and their fathers and mothers: for this is pleasing in the eyes of God.

chinese: 那獨居無靠、真為寡婦的，是仰賴神，晝夜不住的祈求禱告。
english: Now she who is truly a widow and without family puts her hope in God, giving herself to prayer day and night.

chinese: 但那好宴樂的寡婦正活著的時候也是死的。
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she is living.

chinese: 這些事你要囑咐他們，叫他們無可指責。
english: Give orders to this effect, so that no evil may be said of anyone.

chinese: 人若不看顧親屬，就是背了真道，比不信的人還不好，不看顧自己家裡的人，更是如此。
english: If anyone has no care for his family and those in his house, he is false to the faith, and is worse than one who has no faith.

chinese: 寡婦記在冊子上，必須年紀到六十歲，從來只作一個丈夫的妻子，
english: Let no woman be numbered among the widows who is under sixty years old, and only if she has been the wife of one man,

chinese: 又有行善的名聲，就如養育兒女，接待遠人，洗聖徒的腳，救濟遭難的人，竭力行各樣善事。
english: And if witness is given of her good works; if she has had the care of children, if she has been kind to travellers, washing the feet of the saints, helping those who are in trouble, giving herself to good works.

chinese: 至於年輕的寡婦，就可以辭他；因為他們的情慾發動，違背基督的時候就想要嫁人。
english: But to the younger widows say No: for when their love is turned away from Christ, they have a desire to be married;

chinese: 他們被定罪，是因廢棄了當初所許的願；
english: And they are judged because they have been false to their first faith;

chinese: 並且他們又習慣懶惰，挨家閒遊；不但是懶惰，又說長道短，好管閒事，說些不當說的話。
english: And they get into the way of doing no work, going about from house to house; and not only doing no work, but talking foolishly, being over-interested in the business of others, saying things which they have no right to say.

chinese: 所以我願意年輕的寡婦嫁人，生養兒女，治理家務，不給敵人辱罵的把柄。
english: So it is my desire that the younger widows may be married and have children, controlling their families, and giving the Evil One no chance to say anything against them,

chinese: 因為已經有轉去隨從撒但的。
english: For even now some are turned away to Satan.

chinese: 信主的婦女，若家中有寡婦，自己就當救濟他們，不可累著教會，好使教會能救濟那真無倚靠的寡婦。
english: If any woman of the faith has relations who are widows, let her give them help, so that the care of them does not come on the church, and so it may give help to those who are truly widowed.

chinese: 那善於管理教會的長老，當以為配受加倍的敬奉；那勞苦傳道教導人的，更當如此。
english: Let rulers whose rule is good be honoured twice over, specially those whose work is preaching and teaching.

chinese: 因為經上說：牛在場上踹穀的時候，不可籠住他的嘴；又說：工人得工價是應當的。
english: For the Writings say, It is not right to keep the ox from taking the grain when he is crushing it. And, The worker has a right to his reward.

chinese: 控告長老的呈子，非有兩三個見證就不要收。
english: Do not take as true any statement made against one in authority, but only if two or three give witness to it.

chinese: 犯罪的人，當在眾人面前責備他，叫其餘的人也可以懼怕。
english: Say sharp words to sinners when all are present, so that the rest may be in fear.

chinese: 我在神和基督耶穌並蒙揀選的天使面前囑咐你：要遵守這些話，不可存成見，行事也不可有偏心。
english: I give you orders before God and Christ Jesus and the angels of God's selection, to keep these orders without giving thought to one side more than another.

chinese: 給人行按手的禮，不可急促；不要在別人的罪上有分，要保守自己清潔。
english: Do not put hands on any man without thought, and have no part in other men's sins: keep yourself clean.

chinese: 因你胃口不清，屢次患病，再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用點酒。
english: Do not take only water as your drink, but take a little wine for the good of your stomach, and because you are frequently ill.

chinese: 有些人的罪是明顯的，如同先到審判案前；有些人的罪是隨後跟了去的。
english: The sins of some men are clearly seen, going before them to be judged; but with others, their sins go after them.

chinese: 這樣，善行也有明顯的，那不明顯的也不能隱藏。
english: In the same way, there are good works which are clearly seen; and those which are not so, may not be kept secret.

chinese: 凡在軛下作僕人的，當以自己主人配受十分的恭敬，免得神的名和道理被人褻瀆。
english: Let all who are servants under the yoke give all honour to their masters, so that no evil may be said against the name of God and his teaching.

chinese: 僕人有信道的主人，不可因為與他是弟兄就輕看他；更要加意服事他；因為得服事之益處的，是信道蒙愛的。你要以此教訓人，勸勉人。
english: And let those whose masters are of the faith have respect for them because they are brothers, working for them the more readily, because those who take part in the good work are of the faith and are dear. Give orders and teaching about these things.

chinese: 若有人傳異教，不服從我們主耶穌基督純正的話與那合乎敬虔的道理，
english: If any man gives different teaching, not in agreement with the true words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and with the teaching which is in agreement with true religion,

chinese: 他是自高自大，一無所知，專好問難，爭辯言詞，從此就生出嫉妒、分爭、毀謗、妄疑，
english: He has an over-high opinion of himself; being without knowledge, having only an unhealthy love of questionings and wars of words, from which come envy, fighting, cruel words, evil thoughts,

chinese: 並那壞了心術、失喪真理之人的爭競。他們以敬虔為得利的門路。
english: Bitter talk of men who, being evil in mind and dead to what is true, take the faith to be a way of making profit.

chinese: 然而，敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了；
english: But true faith, with peace of mind, is of great profit:

chinese: 因為我們沒有帶甚麼到世上來，也不能帶甚麼去。
english: For we came into the world with nothing, and we are not able to take anything out;

chinese: 只要有衣有食，就當知足。
english: But if we have food and a roof over us, let that be enough.

chinese: 但那些想要發財的人，就陷在迷惑、落在網羅和許多無知有害的私慾裡，叫人沉在敗壞和滅亡中。
english: But those who have a desire for wealth are falling into danger, and are taken as in a net by a number of foolish and damaging desires, through which men are overtaken by death and destruction.

chinese: 貪財是萬惡之根。有人貪戀錢財，就被引誘離了真道，用許多愁苦把自己刺透了。
english: For the love of money is a root of all evil: and some whose hearts were fixed on it have been turned away from the faith, and been wounded with unnumbered sorrows.

chinese: 但你這屬神的人要逃避這些事，追求公義、敬虔、信心、愛心、忍耐、溫柔。
english: But you, O man of God, keep yourself from these things, and go after righteousness, religion, faith, love, a quiet mind, gentle behaviour.

chinese: 你要為真道打那美好的仗，持定永生。你為此被召，也在許多見證人面前，已經作了那美好的見證。
english: Be fighting the good fight of the faith; take for yourself the life eternal, for which you were marked out, and of which you gave witness in the eyes of all.

chinese: 我在叫萬物生活的神面前，並在向本丟彼拉多作過那美好見證的基督耶穌面前囑咐你：
english: I give you orders before God, the giver of life, and Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate gave witness to the faith,

chinese: 要守這命令，毫不玷污，無可指責，直到我們的主耶穌基督顯現。
english: To keep the word untouched by evil, clear from all shame, till the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ:

chinese: 到了日期，那可稱頌、獨有權能的萬王之王、萬主之主，
english: Which at the right time he will make clear, who is the eternal and only Ruler, King of kings, and Lord of lords;

chinese: 就是那獨一不死、住在人不能靠近的光裡，是人未曾看見、也是不能看見的，要將他顯明出來。但願尊貴和永遠的權能都歸給他。阿們！
english: Who only has life for ever, living in light to which no man may come near; whom no man has seen or is able to see: to whom be honour and power for ever. So be it.

chinese: 你要囑咐那些今世富足的人，不要自高，也不要倚靠無定的錢財；只要倚靠那厚賜百物給我們享受的神。
english: Give orders to those who have money and goods in this life, not to be lifted up in their minds, or to put their hope in the uncertain chances of wealth, but in God who gives us in full measure all things for our use;

chinese: 又要囑咐他們行善，在好事上富足，甘心施捨，樂意供給（或作：體貼）人，
english: And to do good, having wealth in good works, being quick to give, taking part with one another;

chinese: 為自己積成美好的根基，預備將來，叫他們持定那真正的生命。
english: Making ready for themselves a safe place for the time to come, so that the true life may be theirs.

chinese: 提摩太阿，你要保守所託付你的，躲避世俗的虛談和那敵真道、似是而非的學問。
english: O Timothy, take good care of that which is given to you, turning away from the wrong and foolish talk and arguments of that knowledge which is falsely so named;

chinese: 已經有人自稱有這學問，就偏離了真道。願恩惠常與你們同在！
english: Through which some, who gave their minds to it, have been turned away from the faith. Grace be with you.

chinese: 奉神旨意，照著在基督耶穌裡生命的應許，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅，
english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, in the hope of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

chinese: 寫信給我親愛的兒子提摩太。願恩惠、憐憫、平安從父神和我們主基督耶穌歸與你！
english: To Timothy, my well-loved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

chinese: 我感謝神，就是我接續祖先用清潔的良心所事奉的神。祈禱的時候，不住的想念你！
english: I give praise to God, whose servant I have been, with a heart free from sin, from the time of my fathers, because in my prayers at all times the thought of you is with me, night and day

chinese: 記念你的眼淚，晝夜切切的想要見你，好叫我滿心快樂。
english: Desiring to see you, keeping in my memory your weeping, so that I may be full of joy;

chinese: 想到你心裡無偽之信，這信是先在你外祖母羅以和你母親友尼基心裡的，我深信也在你的心裡。
english: Having in mind your true faith, which first was in your mother's mother Lois, and in your mother Eunice, and, I am certain, is now in you.

chinese: 為此我提醒你，使你將神藉我按手所給你的恩賜再如火挑旺起來。
english: For this reason I say to you, Let that grace of God which is in you, given to you by my hands, have living power.

chinese: 因為神賜給我們，不是膽怯的心，乃是剛強、仁愛、謹守的心。
english: For God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of self-control.

chinese: 你不要以給我們的主作見證為恥，也不要以我這為主被囚的為恥；總要按神的能力，與我為福音同受苦難。
english: Have no feeling of shame, then, for the witness of our Lord or for me, his prisoner: but undergo all things for the good news in the measure of the power of God;

chinese: 神救了我們，以聖召召我們，不是按我們的行為，乃是按他的旨意和恩典；這恩典是萬古之先，在基督耶穌裡賜給我們的，
english: Who gave us salvation, marking us out for his purpose, not on account of our works, but in the measure of his purpose and his grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

chinese: 但如今藉著我們救主基督耶穌的顯現才表明出來了。他已經把死廢去，藉著福音，將不能壞的生命彰顯出來。
english: But has now been made clear by the revelation of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who put an end to death and made life unending come to light through the good news,

chinese: 我為這福音奉派作傳道的，作使徒，作師傅。
english: Of which I was made a preacher and an Apostle and a teacher;

chinese: 為這緣故，我也受這些苦難。然而我不以為恥；因為知道我所信的是誰，也深信他能保全我所交付他的（或作：他所交託我的），直到那日。
english: And for which I undergo these things: but I have no feeling of shame. For I have knowledge of him in whom I have faith, and I am certain that he is able to keep that which I have given into his care till that day.

chinese: 你從我聽的那純正話語的規模，要用在基督耶穌裡的信心和愛心，常常守著。
english: Keep the form of those true words which you had from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 從前所交託你的善道，你要靠著那住在我們裡面的聖靈牢牢的守著。
english: That good thing which was given to you keep safe, through the Holy Spirit which is in us.

chinese: 凡在亞西亞的人都離棄我，這是你知道的，其中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。
english: You have had news that all those in Asia went away from me; among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes:

chinese: 願主憐憫阿尼色弗一家的人；因他屢次使我暢快，不以我的鎖鍊為恥，
english: May the Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus because he frequently gave me help, and had no feeling of shame because I was in chains;

chinese: 反倒在羅馬的時候，殷勤的找我，並且找著了。
english: But when he was in Rome, he went in search of me everywhere, and came to me

chinese: 願主使他在那日得主的憐憫。他在以弗所怎樣多多的服事我，是你明明知道的。
english: (May he have the Lord's mercy in that day); and of all he did for me at Ephesus you have full knowledge.

chinese: 我兒阿，你要在基督耶穌的恩典上剛強起來。
english: So then, my child, be strong in the grace which is in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 你在許多見證人面前聽見我所教訓的，也要交託那忠心能教導別人的人。
english: And the things which I have said to you before a number of witnesses, give to those of the faith, so that they may be teachers of others.

chinese: 你要和我同受苦難，好像基督耶穌的精兵。
english: Be ready to do without the comforts of life, as one of the army of Christ Jesus.

chinese: 凡在軍中當兵的，不將世務纏身，好叫那招他當兵的人喜悅。
english: A fighting man, when he is with the army, keeps himself free from the business of this life so that he may be pleasing to him who has taken him into his army.

chinese: 人若在場上比武，非按規矩，就不能得冠冕。
english: And if a man takes part in a competition he does not get the crown if he has not kept the rules.

chinese: 勞力的農夫，理當先得糧食。
english: It is right for the worker in the fields to be the first to take of the fruit.

chinese: 我所說的話你要思想，因為凡事主必給你聰明。
english: Give thought to what I say; for the Lord will give you wisdom in all things.

chinese: 你要記念耶穌基督乃是大衛的後裔，他從死裡復活，正合乎我所傳的福音。
english: Keep in mind Jesus Christ, of the seed of David, who came back from the dead, as my good news gives witness:

chinese: 我為這福音受苦難，甚至被捆綁，像犯人一樣。然而神的道卻不被捆綁。
english: In which I put up with the hardest conditions, even prison chains, like one who has done a crime; but the word of God is not in chains.

chinese: 所以我為選民凡事忍耐，叫他們也可以得著那在基督耶穌裡的救恩和永遠的榮耀。
english: But I undergo all things for the saints, so that they may have salvation in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

chinese: 有可信的話說：我們若與基督同死，也必與他同活；
english: This is a true saying: If we undergo death with him, then will we be living with him:

chinese: 我們若能忍耐，也必和他一同作王；我們若不認他，他也必不認我們；
english: If we go on to the end, then we will be ruling with him: if we say we have no knowledge of him, then he will say he has no knowledge of us:

chinese: 我們縱然失信，他仍是可信的，因為他不能背乎自己。
english: If we are without faith, still he keeps faith, for he will never be untrue to himself.

chinese: 你要使眾人回想這些事，在主面前囑咐他們：不可為言語爭辯；這是沒有益處的，只能敗壞聽見的人。
english: Put these things before them, giving them orders in the name of the Lord to keep themselves from fighting about words, which is of no profit, only causing error in their hearers.

chinese: 你當竭力在神面前得蒙喜悅，作無愧的工人，按著正意分解真理的道。
english: Let it be your care to get the approval of God, as a workman who has no cause for shame, giving the true word in the right way.

chinese: 但要遠避世俗的虛談，因為這等人必進到更不敬虔的地步。
english: But take no part in wrong and foolish talk, for those who do so will go farther into evil,

chinese: 他們的話如同毒瘡，越爛越大；其中有許米乃和腓理徒，
english: And their words will be like poisoned wounds in the flesh: such are Hymenaeus and Philetus;

chinese: 他們偏離了真道，說復活的事已過，就敗壞好些人的信心。
english: Men whose ideas are all false, who say that the coming back from the dead has even now taken place, overturning the faith of some.

chinese: 然而，神堅固的根基立住了；上面有這印記說：主認識誰是他的人；又說：凡稱呼主名的人總要離開不義。
english: But God's strong base is unchanging, having this sign, The Lord has knowledge of those who are his: and, Let everyone by whom the name of the Lord is named be turned away from evil.

chinese: 在大戶人家，不但有金器銀器，也有木器瓦器；有作為貴重的，有作為卑賤的。
english: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver, but others of wood and earth, and some which are honoured and some without honour.

chinese: 人若自潔，脫離卑賤的事，就必作貴重的器皿，成為聖潔，合乎主用，預備行各樣的善事。
english: If a man makes himself clean from these, he will be a vessel for honour, made holy, ready for the master's use, ready for every good work.

chinese: 你要逃避少年的私慾，同那清心禱告主的人追求公義、信德、仁愛、和平。
english: But keep yourself from those desires of the flesh which are strong when the body is young, and go after righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those whose prayers go up to the Lord from a clean heart.

chinese: 惟有那愚拙無學問的辯論，總要棄絕，因為知道這等事是起爭競的。
english: And put away foolish and uncontrolled questionings, seeing that they are a cause of trouble.

chinese: 然而主的僕人不可爭競，只要溫溫和和的待眾人，善於教導，存心忍耐，
english: For it is not right for the Lord's servant to make trouble, but he is to be gentle to all, ready in teaching, putting up with wrong,

chinese: 用溫柔勸戒那抵擋的人；或者神給他們悔改的心，可以明白真道，
english: Gently guiding those who go against the teaching; if by chance God may give them a change of heart and true knowledge,

chinese: 叫他們這已經被魔鬼任意擄去的，可以醒悟，脫離他的網羅。
english: And so they may get themselves free from the net of the Evil One, being made the prisoners of the Lord's servant, for the purpose of God.

chinese: 你該知道，末世必有危險的日子來到。
english: But be certain of this, that in the last days times of trouble will come.

chinese: 因為那時人要專顧自己、貪愛錢財、自誇、狂傲、謗讟、違背父母、忘恩負義、心不聖潔、
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, uplifted in pride, given to bitter words, going against the authority of their fathers, never giving praise, having no religion,

chinese: 無親情、不解怨、好說讒言、不能自約、性情兇暴、不愛良善、
english: Without natural love, bitter haters, saying evil of others, violent and uncontrolled, hating all good,

chinese: 賣主賣友、任意妄為、自高自大、愛宴樂、不愛神，
english: False to their friends, acting without thought, lifted up in mind, loving pleasure more than God;

chinese: 有敬虔的外貌，卻背了敬虔的實意；這等人你要躲開。
english: Having a form of religion, but turning their backs on the power of it: go not with these.

chinese: 那偷進人家、牢籠無知婦女的，正是這等人。這些婦女擔負罪惡，被各樣的私慾引誘，
english: For these are they who go secretly into houses, making prisoners of foolish women, weighted down with sin, turned from the way by their evil desires,

chinese: 常常學習，終久不能明白真道。
english: Ever learning, and never coming to the knowledge of what is true.
