chinese: 從前雅尼和佯庇怎樣敵擋摩西，這等人也怎樣敵擋真道。他們的心地壞了，在真道上是可廢棄的。
english: And as James and Jambres went against Moses, so do these go against what is true: men of evil minds, who, tested by faith, are seen to be false.

chinese: 然而他們不能再這樣敵擋；因為他們的愚昧必在眾人面前顯露出來，像那二人一樣。
english: But they will go no farther: for their foolish behaviour will be clear to all men, as theirs was in the end.

chinese: 但你已經服從了我的教訓、品行、志向、信心、寬容、愛心、忍耐，
english: But you took as your example my teaching, behaviour, purpose, and faith; my long waiting, my love, my quiet undergoing of trouble;

chinese: 以及我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所遭遇的逼迫，苦難。我所忍受是何等的逼迫；但從這一切苦難中，主都把我救出來了。
english: My punishments and pain; the things which came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; the cruel attacks made on me: and the Lord made me free from them all.

chinese: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶穌裡敬虔度日的也都要受逼迫。
english: Yes, and all whose purpose is to be living in the knowledge of God in Christ Jesus, will be cruelly attacked.

chinese: 只是作惡的和迷惑人的，必越久越惡，他欺哄人，也被人欺哄。
english: Evil and false men will become worse and worse, using deceit and themselves overcome by deceit.

chinese: 但你所學習的，所確信的，要存在心裡；因為你知道是跟誰學的，
english: But see that you keep to the teaching you have been given and the things of which you are certain, conscious of who has been your teacher;

chinese: 並且知道你是從小明白聖經，這聖經能使你因信基督耶穌，有得救的智慧。
english: And that from the time when you were a child, you have had knowledge of the holy Writings, which are able to make you wise to salvation, through faith in Christ Jesus.

chinese: 聖經都是神所默示的（或作：凡神所默示的聖經），於教訓、督責、使人歸正、教導人學義都是有益的，
english: Every holy Writing which comes from God is of profit for teaching, for training, for guiding, for education in righteousness:

chinese: 叫屬神的人得以完全，預備行各樣的善事。
english: So that the man of God may be complete, trained and made ready for every good work.

chinese: 我在神面前，並在將來審判活人死人的基督耶穌面前，憑著他的顯現和他的國度囑咐你：
english: I give you orders, before God and Christ Jesus, who will be the judge of the living and the dead, and by his revelation and his kingdom;

chinese: 務要傳道，無論得時不得時，總要專心；並用百般的忍耐，各樣的教訓，責備人、警戒人、勸勉人。
english: Be preaching the word at all times, in every place; make protests, say sharp words, give comfort, with long waiting and teaching;

chinese: 因為時候要到，人必厭煩純正的道理，耳朵發癢，就隨從自己的情慾，增添好些師傅，
english: For the time will come when they will not take the true teaching; but, moved by their desires, they will get for themselves a great number of teachers for the pleasure of hearing them;

chinese: 並且掩耳不聽真道，偏向荒渺的言語。
english: And shutting their ears to what is true, will be turned away to belief in foolish stories.

chinese: 你卻要凡事謹慎，忍受苦難，做傳道的工夫，盡你的職分。
english: But be self-controlled in all things, do without comfort, go on preaching the good news, completing the work which has been given you to do.

chinese: 我現在被澆奠，我離世的時候到了。
english: For I am even now being offered, and my end is near.

chinese: 那美好的仗我已經打過了，當跑的路我已經跑盡了，所信的道我已經守住了。
english: I have made a good fight, I have come to the end of my journey, I have kept the faith:

chinese: 從此以後，有公義的冠冕為我存留，就是按著公義審判的主到了那日要賜給我的；不但賜給我，也賜給凡愛慕他顯現的人。
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is made ready for me, which the Lord, the upright judge, Will give to me at that day: and not only to me, but to all those who have had love for his revelation.

chinese: 你要趕緊的到我這裡來。
english: Do your best to come to me before long:

chinese: 因為底馬貪愛現今的世界，就離棄我往帖撒羅尼迦去了，革勒士往加拉太去，提多往撻馬太去，
english: For Demas has gone away from me, for love of this present life, and has gone to Thessalonica: Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

chinese: 獨有路加在我這裡。你來的時候，要把馬可帶來，因為他在傳道（或作：服事我）的事上於我有益處。
english: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and take him with you; for he is of use to me in the work.

chinese: 我已經打發推基古往以弗所去。
english: Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

chinese: 我在特羅亞留於加布的那件外衣，你來的時候可以帶來，那些書也要帶來，更要緊的是那些皮卷。
english: The coat which I did not take from Troas and which is with Carpus, get when you come, and the books, specially the papers.

chinese: 銅匠亞力山大多多的害我；主必照他所行的報應他。
english: Alexander the copper-worker did me much wrong: the Lord will give him the reward of his works:

chinese: 你也要防備他，因為他極力敵擋了我們的話。
english: But be on the watch for him, for he was violent in his attacks on our teaching.

chinese: 我初次申訴，沒有人前來幫助，竟都離棄我；但願這罪不歸與他們。
english: At my first meeting with my judges, no one took my part, but all went away from me. May it not be put to their account.

chinese: 惟有主站在我旁邊，加給我力量，使福音被我盡都傳明，叫外邦人都聽見；我也從獅子口裡被救出來。
english: But the Lord was by my side and gave me strength; so that through me the news might be given out in full measure, and all the Gentiles might give ear: and I was taken out of the mouth of the lion.

chinese: 主必救我脫離諸般的兇惡，也必救我進他的天國。願榮耀歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
english: The Lord will keep me safe from every evil work and will give me salvation in his kingdom in heaven: to whom be glory for ever and ever. So be it.

chinese: 問百基拉、亞居拉，和阿尼色弗一家的人安。
english: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila and those of the house of Onesiphorus.

chinese: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特羅非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。
english: Erastus was stopping at Corinth; but Trophimus, when I last saw him was at Miletus, ill.

chinese: 你要趕緊在冬天以前到我這裡來。有友布羅、布田、利奴、革老底亞，和眾弟兄都問你安。
english: Do your best to come before the winter. Eubulus sends you his love, and Pudens and Linus and Claudia, and all the brothers.

chinese: 願主與你的靈同在。願恩惠常與你們同在！
english: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.

chinese: 神的僕人，耶穌基督的使徒保羅，憑著神選民的信心與敬虔真理的知識，
english: Paul, a servant of God, and an Apostle of Jesus Christ, in agreement with the faith of the saints of God and the full knowledge of what is true in harmony with religion,

chinese: 盼望那無謊言的神在萬古之先所應許的永生，
english: In the hope of eternal life, which was made certain before eternal time, by the word of God who is ever true;

chinese: 到了日期，藉著傳揚的工夫把他的道顯明了；這傳揚的責任是按著神我們救主的命令交託了我。
english: Who, in his time, made clear his word in the good news, of which, by the order of God our Saviour, I became a preacher;

chinese: 現在寫信給提多，就是照著我們共信之道作我真兒子的。願恩惠、平安從父神和我們的救主基督耶穌歸與你！
english: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.

chinese: 我從前留你在革哩底，是要你將那沒有辦完的事都辦整齊了，又照我所吩咐你的，在各城設立長老。
english: I did not take you with me when I went away from Crete, so that you might do what was necessary to put things in order there, placing men in authority over the churches in every town, as I said to you;

chinese: 若有無可指責的人，只作一個婦人的丈夫，兒女也是信主的，沒有人告他們是放蕩不服約束的，就可以設立。
english: Men having a good record, husbands of one wife, whose children are of the faith, children of whom it may not be said that they are given to loose living or are uncontrolled.

chinese: 監督既是神的管家，必須無可指責，不任性，不暴躁，不因酒滋事，不打人，不貪無義之財；
english: For it is necessary for a Bishop to be a man of virtue, as God's servant; not pushing himself forward, not quickly moved to wrath or blows, not desiring profit for himself;

chinese: 樂意接待遠人，好善，莊重，公平，聖潔自持；
english: But opening his house freely to guests; a lover of what is good, serious-minded, upright, holy, self-controlled;

chinese: 堅守所教真實的道理，就能將純正的教訓勸化人，又能把爭辯的人駁倒了。
english: Keeping to the true word of the teaching, so that he may be able to give comfort by right teaching and overcome the arguments of the doubters.

chinese: 因為有許多人不服約束，說虛空話欺哄人；那奉割禮的更是這樣。
english: For there are men who are not ruled by law; foolish talkers, false teachers, specially those of the circumcision,

chinese: 這些人的口總要堵住。他們因貪不義之財，將不該教導的教導人，敗壞人的全家。
english: By whom some families have been completely overturned; who take money for teaching things which are not right; these will have to be stopped.

chinese: 有革哩底人中的一個本地先知說：革哩底人常說謊話，乃是惡獸又饞又懶。
english: One of their prophets has said, The men of Crete are ever false, evil beasts, lovers of food, hating work.

chinese: 這個見證是真的。所以，你要嚴嚴的責備他們，使他們在真道上純全無疵，
english: This witness is true. So say sharp words to them so that they may come to the right faith,

chinese: 不聽猶太人荒渺的言語和離棄真道之人的誡命。
english: Giving no attention to the fictions of the Jews and the rules of men who have no true knowledge.

chinese: 在潔淨的人，凡物都潔淨；在污穢不信的人，甚麼都不潔淨，連心地和天良也都污穢了。
english: To the clean in heart all things are clean: but to those who are unclean and without faith nothing is clean; they become unclean in mind and in thought.

chinese: 他們說是認識神，行事卻和他相背；本是可憎惡的，是悖逆的，在各樣善事上是可廢棄的。
english: They say that they have knowledge of God, while by their acts they are turning their backs on him; they are hated by all, hard-hearted, and judged to be without value for any good work.

chinese: 但你所講的總要合乎那純正的道理。
english: But let your words be in agreement with true and right teaching:

chinese: 勸老年人要有節制、端莊、自守，在信心、愛心、忍耐上都要純全無疵。
english: That old men are to be simple in their tastes, serious, wise, true in faith, in love, and of a quiet mind.

chinese: 又勸老年婦人，舉止行動要恭敬，不說讒言，不給酒作奴僕，用善道教訓人，
english: That old women are to be self-respecting in behaviour, not saying evil of others, not given to taking much wine, teachers of that which is good,

chinese: 好指教少年婦人，愛丈夫，愛兒女，
english: Training the younger women to have love for their husbands and children,

chinese: 謹守，貞潔，料理家務，待人有恩，順服自己的丈夫，免得神的道理被毀謗。
english: To be wise in mind, clean in heart, kind; working in their houses, living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.

chinese: 又勸少年人要謹守。
english: To the young men give orders to be wise and serious-minded:

chinese: 你自己凡事要顯出善行的榜樣；在教訓上要正直、端莊，
english: In all things see that you are an example of good works; holy in your teaching, serious in behaviour,

chinese: 言語純全，無可指責，叫那反對的人，既無處可說我們的不是，便自覺羞愧。
english: Saying true and right words, against which no protest may be made, so that he who is not on our side may be put to shame, unable to say any evil of us.

chinese: 勸僕人要順服自己的主人，凡事討他的喜歡，不可頂撞他，
english: Servants are to be under the authority of their masters, pleasing them in all things, without argument;

chinese: 不可私拿東西；要顯為忠誠，以致凡事尊榮我們救主神的道。
english: Not taking what is not theirs, but giving clear signs of their good faith, in all things doing credit to the teaching of God our Saviour.

chinese: 因為神救眾人的恩典已經顯明出來，
english: For the grace of God has come, giving salvation to all men,

chinese: 教訓我們除去不敬虔的心和世俗的情慾，在今世自守、公義、敬虔度日，
english: Training us so that, turning away from evil and the desires of this world, we may be living wisely and uprightly in the knowledge of God in this present life;

chinese: 等候所盼望的福，並等候至大的神和我們（或作：神─我們）救主耶穌基督的榮耀顯現。
english: Looking for the glad hope, the revelation of the glory of our great God and Saviour Jesus Christ;

chinese: 他為我們捨了自己，要贖我們脫離一切罪惡，又潔淨我們，特作自己的子民，熱心為善。
english: Who gave himself for us, so that he might make us free from all wrongdoing, and make for himself a people clean in heart and on fire with good works.

chinese: 這些事你要講明，勸戒人，用各等權柄責備人；不可叫人輕看你。
english: On all these points give teaching and help, and make clear what is right with all authority. Let all men give you honour.

chinese: 你要提醒眾人，叫他們順服作官的、掌權的，遵他的命，預備行各樣的善事。
english: Make clear to them that they are to put themselves under rulers and authorities, to do what they are ordered, to be ready for every good work,

chinese: 不要毀謗，不要爭競，總要和平，向眾人大顯溫柔。
english: To say no evil of any man, not to be fighters, to give way to others, to be gentle in behaviour to all men.

chinese: 我們從前也是無知、悖逆、受迷惑、服事各樣私慾，和宴樂，常存惡毒（或作：陰毒）嫉妒的心，是可恨的，又是彼此相恨。
english: For in the past we were foolish, hard in heart, turned from the true way, servants of evil desires and pleasures, living in bad feeling and envy, hated and hating one another.

chinese: 但到了神─我們救主的恩慈和他向人所施的慈愛顯明的時候，
english: But when the mercy of God our Saviour, and his love to man was seen,

chinese: 他便救了我們；並不是因我們自己所行的義，乃是照他的憐憫，藉著重生的洗和聖靈的更新。
english: Not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but in the measure of his mercy, he gave us salvation, through the washing of the new birth and the giving of new life in the Holy Spirit,

chinese: 聖靈就是神藉著耶穌基督我們救主厚厚澆灌在我們身上的，
english: Which he gave us freely through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

chinese: 好叫我們因他的恩得稱為義，可以憑著永生的盼望成為後嗣。（或作：可以憑著盼望承受永生）。
english: So that, having been given righteousness through grace, we might have a part in the heritage, the hope of eternal life.

chinese: 這話是可信的。我也願你把這些事切切實實的講明，使那些已信神的人留心做正經事業（或作：留心行善）。這都是美事，並且與人有益。
english: This is a true saying; and it is my desire that you may give certain witness about these things, so that those who have had faith in God may give attention to good works. These things are good and of profit to men;

chinese: 要遠避無知的辯論和家譜的空談，以及分爭，並因律法而起的爭競，因為這都是虛妄無益的。
english: But have nothing to do with foolish questionings, and lists of generations, and fights and arguments about the law; for they are of no profit and foolish.

chinese: 分門結黨的人，警戒過一兩次，就要棄絕他。
english: A man whose opinions are not those of the church, after a first and second protest, is to be kept out of your society;

chinese: 因為知道這等人已經背道，犯了罪，自己明知不是，還是去做。
english: Clearly he is in error and a sinner, being self-judged.

chinese: 我打發亞提馬或是推基古到你那裡去的時候，你要趕緊往尼哥波立去見我，因為我已經定意在那裡過冬。
english: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis: for it is my purpose to be there for the winter.

chinese: 你要趕緊給律師西納和亞波羅送行，叫他們沒有缺乏。
english: Send Zenas, the man of law, and Apollos on their journey with all care, so that they may be in need of nothing.

chinese: 並且我們的人要學習正經事業（或作：要學習行善），預備所需用的，免得不結果子。
english: And let our people go on with good works for necessary purposes, so that they may not be without fruit.

chinese: 同我在一處的人都問你安。請代問那些因有信心愛我們的人安。願恩惠常與你們眾人同在！
english: All who are with me send you their love. Give our love to our friends in the faith. Grace be with you all.

chinese: 為基督耶穌被囚的保羅，同兄弟提摩太寫信給我們所親愛的同工腓利門，
english: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our dear helper in the faith,

chinese: 和妹子亞腓亞並與我們同當兵的亞基布，以及在你家的教會。
english: And to Apphia, our sister, and to Archippus, our brother in God's army, and to the church in your house:

chinese: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 我禱告的時候提到你，常為你感謝我的神；
english: I give praise to God at all times and make prayer for you,

chinese: 因聽說你的愛心並你向主耶穌和眾聖徒的信心（或作：因聽說你向主耶穌和眾聖徒有愛心有信心）。
english: Hearing of the love and the faith which you have to the Lord Jesus and to all the saints;

chinese: 願你與人所同有的信心顯出功效，使人知道你們各樣善事都是為基督做的。
english: That the faith which you have in common with them may be working with power, in the knowledge of every good thing in you, for Christ.

chinese: 兄弟阿，我為你的愛心，大有快樂，大得安慰，因眾聖徒的心從你得了暢快。
english: For I had great joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been made strong again through you, brother.

chinese: 我雖然靠著基督能放膽吩咐你合宜的事；
english: And so, though I might, in the name of Christ, give you orders to do what is right,

chinese: 然而像我這有年紀的保羅，現在又是為基督耶穌被囚的，寧可憑著愛心求你，
english: Still, because of love, in place of an order, I make a request to you, I, Paul, an old man and now a prisoner of Christ Jesus:

chinese: 就是為我在捆鎖中所生的兒子阿尼西母（就是有益處的意思）求你。
english: My request is for my child Onesimus, the child of my chains,

chinese: 他從前與你沒有益處，但如今與你我都有益處。
english: Who in the past was of no profit to you, but now is of profit to you and to me:

chinese: 我現在打發他親自回你那裡去，他是我心上的人。
english: Whom I have sent back to you, him who is my very heart:

chinese: 我本來有意將他留下，在我為福音所受的捆鎖中替你伺候我。
english: Though my desire was to keep him with me, to be my servant in the chains of the good news, in your place:

chinese: 但不知道你的意思，我就不願意這樣行，叫你的善行不是出於勉強，乃是出於甘心。
english: But without your approval I would do nothing; so that your good works might not be forced, but done freely from your heart.

chinese: 他暫時離開你，或者是叫你永遠得著他，
english: For it is possible that for this reason he was parted from you for a time, so that you might have him for ever;

chinese: 不再是奴僕，乃是高過奴僕，是親愛的兄弟。在我實在是如此，何況在你呢！這也不拘是按肉體說，是按主說，
english: No longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother, very dear to me specially, but much more to you, in the flesh as well as in the Lord.

chinese: 你若以我為同伴，就收納他，如同收納我一樣。
english: If then you take me to be your friend and brother, take him in as myself.

chinese: 他若虧負你，或欠你甚麼，都歸在我的賬上，
english: If he has done you any wrong or is in debt to you for anything, put it to my account.

chinese: 我必償還。這是我保羅親筆寫的。我並不用對你說，連你自己也是虧欠於我。
english: I, Paul, writing this myself, say, I will make payment to you: and I do not say to you that you are in debt to me even for your life.

chinese: 兄弟阿，望你使我在主裡因你得快樂（或作：益處）並望你使我的心在基督裡得暢快。
english: So brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: give new life to my heart in Christ.

chinese: 我寫信給你，深信你必順服，知道你所要行的，必過於我所說的。
english: Being certain that you will do my desire, I am writing to you, in the knowledge that you will do even more than I say.

chinese: 此外你還要給我預備住處；因為我盼望藉著你們的禱告，必蒙恩到你們那裡去。
english: And make a room ready for me; for I am hoping that through your prayers I will be given to you.

chinese: 為基督耶穌與我同坐監的以巴弗問你安。
english: Epaphras, my brother-prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you his love;

chinese: 與我同工的馬可、亞里達古、底馬、路加、也都問你安。
english: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my brother-workers.

chinese: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩常在你的心裡。阿們！
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. So be it.

chinese: 神既在古時藉著眾先知多次多方的曉諭列祖，
english: In times past the word of God came to our fathers through the prophets, in different parts and in different ways;

chinese: 就在這末世藉著他兒子曉諭我們；又早已立他為承受萬有的，也曾藉著他創造諸世界。
english: But now, at the end of these days, it has come to us through his Son, to whom he has given all things for a heritage, and through whom he made the order of the generations;

chinese: 他是神榮耀所發的光輝，是神本體的真像，常用他權能的命令托住萬有。他洗淨了人的罪，就坐在高天至大者的右邊。
english: Who, being the outshining of his glory, the true image of his substance, supporting all things by the word of his power, having given himself as an offering making clean from sins, took his seat at the right hand of God in heaven;

chinese: 他所承受的名，既比天使的名更尊貴，就遠超過天使。
english: Having become by so much better than the angels, as the name which is his heritage is more noble than theirs.

chinese: 所有的天使，神從來對那一個說，你是我的兒子，我今日生你？又指著那一個說：我要作他的父，他要作我的子？
english: To which of the angels did God say at any time, You are my Son, this day I have given you being? or, I will be his Father, and he will be my Son?

chinese: 再者，神使長子到世上來的時候（或作：神再使長子到世上來的時候），就說：神的使者都要拜他。
english: And again, when he is sending his only Son into the world, he says, Let all the angels of God give him worship.

chinese: 論到使者，又說：神以風為使者，以火燄為僕役；
english: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels winds, and his servants flames of fire:

chinese: 論到子卻說：神阿，你的寶座是永永遠遠的；你的國權是正直的。
english: But of the Son he says, Your seat of power, O God, is for ever and ever; and the rod of your kingdom is a rod of righteousness.

chinese: 你喜愛公義，恨惡罪惡；所以神，就是你的神，用喜樂油膏你，勝過膏你的同伴；
english: You have been a lover of righteousness and a hater of evil; and so God, your God, has put the oil of joy on your head more than on the heads of those who are with you.

chinese: 又說：主阿，你起初立了地的根基；天也是你手所造的。
english: You, Lord, at the first did put the earth on its base, and the heavens are the works of your hands:

chinese: 天地都要滅沒，你卻要長存。天地都要像衣服漸漸舊了；
english: They will come to their end; but you are for ever; they will become old as a robe;

chinese: 你要將天地捲起來，像一件外衣，天地就都改變了。惟有你永不改變；你的年數沒有窮盡。
english: They will be rolled up like a cloth, even like a robe, and they will be changed: but you are the same and your years will have no end.

chinese: 所有的天使，神從來對那一個說：你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳？
english: But of which of the angels has he said at any time, Take your seat at my right hand till I put all those who are against you under your feet?

chinese: 天使豈不都是服役的靈、奉差遣為那將要承受救恩的人效力麼？
english: Are they not all helping spirits, who are sent out as servants to those whose heritage will be salvation?

chinese: 所以，我們當越發鄭重所聽見的道理，恐怕我們隨流失去。
english: For this reason there is the more need for us to give attention to the things which have come to our ears, for fear that by chance we might be slipping away.

chinese: 那藉著天使所傳的話既是確定的；凡犯悖逆的都受了該受的報應。
english: Because if the word which came through the angels was fixed, and in the past every evil act against God's orders was given its full punishment;

chinese: 我們若忽略這麼大的救恩，怎能逃罪呢？這救恩起先是主親自講的，後來是聽見的人給我們證實了。
english: What will come on us, if we do not give our minds to such a great salvation? a salvation of which our fathers first had knowledge through the words of the Lord, and which was made certain to us by those to whom his words came;

chinese: 神又按自己的旨意，用神蹟、奇事和百般的異能，並聖靈的恩賜，同他們作見證。
english: And God was a witness with them, by signs and wonders, and by more than natural powers, and by his distribution of the Holy Spirit at his pleasure.

chinese: 我們所說將來的世界，神原沒有交給天使管轄。
english: For he did not make the angels rulers over the world to come, of which I am writing.

chinese: 但有人在經上某處證明說：人算甚麼，你竟顧念他？世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他？
english: But a certain writer has given his witness, saying, What is man, that you keep him in mind? what is the son of man, that you take him into account?

chinese: 你叫他比天使微小一點（或作：你叫他暫時比天使小），賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕，並將你手所造的都派他管理，
english: You made him a little lower than the angels; you gave him a crown of glory and honour, and made him ruler over all the works of your hands:

chinese: 叫萬物都服在他的腳下。既叫萬物都服他，就沒有剩下一樣不服他的。只是如今我們還不見萬物都服他。
english: You put all things under his feet. For in making man the ruler over all things, God did not put anything outside his authority; though we do not see everything under him now.

chinese: 惟獨見那成為比天使小一點的耶穌（或作：惟獨見耶穌暫時比天使小）；因為受死的苦，就得了尊貴榮耀為冠冕，叫他因著神的恩，為人人嘗了死味。
english: But we see him who was made a little lower than the angels, even Jesus, crowned with glory and honour, because he let himself be put to death so that by the grace of God he might undergo death for all men.

chinese: 原來那為萬物所屬為萬物所本的，要領許多的兒子進榮耀裡去，使救他們的元帥，因受苦難得以完全，本是合宜的。
english: Because it was right for him, for whom and through whom all things have being, in guiding his sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation complete through pain.

chinese: 因那使人成聖的和那些得以成聖的，都是出於一。所以，他稱他們為弟兄也不以為恥，
english: For he who makes holy and those who are made holy are all of one family; and for this reason it is no shame for him to give them the name of brothers,

chinese: 說：我要將你的名傳與我的弟兄，在會中我要頌揚你；
english: Saying, I will give the knowledge of your name to my brothers, I will make a song of praise to you before the church.

chinese: 又說：我要倚賴他；又說：看哪，我與神所給我的兒女。
english: And again he says, I will put my faith in him. And again, See, I am here, and the children which God has given to me.

chinese: 兒女既同有血肉之體，他也照樣親自成了血肉之體，特要藉著死敗壞那掌死權的，就是魔鬼，
english: And because the children are flesh and blood, he took a body himself and became like them; so that by his death he might put an end to him who had the power of death, that is to say, the Evil One;

chinese: 並要釋放那些一生因怕死而為奴僕的人。
english: And let those who all their lives were in chains because of their fear of death, go free.

chinese: 他並不救拔天使，乃是救拔亞伯拉罕的後裔。
english: For, truly, he does not take on the life of angels, but that of the seed of Abraham.

chinese: 所以，他凡事該與他的弟兄相同，為要在神的事上成為慈悲忠信的大祭司，為百姓的罪獻上挽回祭。
english: Because of this it was necessary for him to be made like his brothers in every way, so that he might be a high priest full of mercy and keeping faith in everything to do with God, making offerings for the sins of the people.

chinese: 他自己既然被試探而受苦，就能搭救被試探的人。
english: For having been put to the test himself, he is able to give help to others when they are tested.

chinese: 同蒙天召的聖潔弟兄阿，你們應當思想我們所認為使者、為大祭司的耶穌。
english: For this reason, holy brothers, marked out to have a part in heaven, give thought to Jesus the representative and high priest of our faith;

chinese: 他為那設立他的盡忠，如同摩西在神的全家盡忠一樣。
english: Who kept faith with God who gave him his place, even as Moses did in all his house.

chinese: 他比摩西算是更配多得榮耀，好像建造房屋的比房屋更尊榮；
english: And it was right for this man to have more honour than Moses, even as the builder of a house has more honour than the house.

chinese: 因為房屋都必有人建造，但建造萬物的就是神。
english: For every house has a builder; but the builder of all things is God.

chinese: 摩西為僕人，在神的全家誠然盡忠，為要證明將來必傳說的事。
english: And Moses certainly kept faith as a servant, in all his house, and as a witness of those things which were to be said later;

chinese: 但基督為兒子，治理神的家；我們若將可誇的盼望和膽量堅持到底，便是他的家了。
english: But Christ as a son, over his house; whose house are we, if we keep our hearts fixed in the glad and certain hope till the end.

chinese: 聖靈有話說：你們今日若聽他的話，
english: And so, as the Holy Spirit says, Today if you let his voice come to your ears,

chinese: 就不可硬著心，像在曠野惹他發怒、試探他的時候一樣。
english: Be not hard of heart, as when you made me angry, on the day of testing in the waste land,

chinese: 在那裡，你們的祖宗試我探我，並且觀看我的作為有四十年之久。
english: When your fathers put me to the test, and saw my works for forty years.

chinese: 所以，我厭煩那世代的人，說：他們心裡常常迷糊，竟不曉得我的作為！
english: So that I was angry with this generation, and I said, Their hearts are in error at all times, and they have no knowledge of my ways;

chinese: 我就在怒中起誓說；他們斷不可進入我的安息。
english: And being angry I made an oath, saying, They may not come into my rest.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們要謹慎，免得你們中間或有人存著不信的惡心，把永生神離棄了。
english: My brothers, take care that there is not by chance in any one of you an evil heart without belief, turning away from the living God:

chinese: 總要趁著還有今日，天天彼此相勸，免得你們中間有人被罪迷惑，心裡就剛硬了。
english: But give comfort to one another every day as long as it is still Today; so that no one among you may be made hard by the deceit of sin:

chinese: 我們若將起初確實的信心堅持到底，就在基督裡有分了。
english: For if we keep the substance of the faith which we had at the start, even till the end, we have a part with Christ;

chinese: 經上說：你們今日若聽他的話，就不可硬著心，像惹他發怒的日子一樣。
english: As it is said, Today if you will let his voice come to your ears, be not hard of heart, as when you made him angry.

chinese: 那時，聽見他話惹他發怒的是誰呢？豈不是跟著摩西從埃及出來的眾人麼？
english: Who made him angry when his voice came to them? was it not all those who came out of Egypt with Moses?

chinese: 神四十年之久，又厭煩誰呢？豈不是那些犯罪、屍首倒在曠野的人麼？
english: And with whom was he angry for forty years? was it not with those who did evil, who came to their deaths in the waste land?

chinese: 又向誰起誓，不容他們進入他的安息呢；豈不是向那些不信從的人麼？
english: And to whom did he make an oath that they might not come into his rest? was it not to those who went against his orders?

chinese: 這樣看來，他們不能進入安息是因為不信的緣故了。
english: So we see that they were not able to go in because they had no belief.

chinese: 我們既蒙留下，有進入他安息的應許，就當畏懼，免得我們（原文是你們）中間或有人似乎是趕不上了。
english: Let us then, though we still have God's word that we may come into his rest, go in fear that some of you may be unable to do so.

chinese: 因為有福音傳給我們，像傳給他們一樣；只是所聽見的道與他們無益，因為他們沒有信心與所聽見的道調和。
english: And, truly, the good news came to us, even as it did to them; but the hearing of the word did them no good, because they were not united in faith with the true hearers.

chinese: 但我們已經相信的人得以進入那安息，正如神所說：我在怒中起誓說：他們斷不可進入我的安息！其實造物之工，從創世以來已經成全了。
english: For those of us who have belief come into his rest; even as he has said, As I said in my oath when I was angry, They may not come into my rest: though the works were done from the time of the making of the world.

chinese: 論到第七日，有一處說，到第七日神就歇了他一切的工。
english: For in one place he has said of the seventh day, And God had rest from all his works on the seventh day;

chinese: 又有一處說：他們斷不可進入我的安息！
english: And in the same place he says again, They will not come into my rest.

chinese: 既有必進安息的人，那先前聽見福音的，因為不信從，不得進去。
english: So that as it is clear that some have to go in, and that the first hearers of the good news were not able to go in because they went against God's orders,

chinese: 所以過了多年，就在大衛的書上，又限定一日，如以上所引的說：你們今日若聽他的話，就不可硬著心。
english: After a long time, again naming a certain day, he says in David, Today (as he had said before), Today if you will let his voice come to your ears, be not hard of heart,

chinese: 若是約書亞已叫他們享了安息，後來神就不再提別的日子了。
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have said anything about another day.

chinese: 這樣看來，必另有一安息日的安息為神的子民存留。
english: So that there is still a Sabbath-keeping for the people of God.

chinese: 因為那進入安息的，乃是歇了自己的工，正如神歇了他的工一樣。
english: For the man who comes into his rest has had rest from his works, as God did from his.

chinese: 所以，我們務必竭力進入那安息，免得有人學那不信從的樣子跌倒了。
english: Because of this, let us have a strong desire to come into that rest, and let no one go after the example of those who went against God's orders.

chinese: 神的道是活潑的，是有功效的，比一切兩刃的劍更快，甚至魂與靈，骨節與骨髓，都能刺入、剖開，連心中的思念和主意都能辨明。
english: For the word of God is living and full of power, and is sharper than any two-edged sword, cutting through and making a division even of the soul and the spirit, the bones and the muscles, and quick to see the thoughts and purposes of the heart.

chinese: 並且被造的沒有一樣在他面前不顯然的；原來萬物在那與我們有關係的主眼前，都是赤露敞開的。
english: And there is nothing made which is not completely clear to him; there is nothing covered, but all things are open to the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

chinese: 我們既然有一位已經升入高天尊榮的大祭司，就是神的兒子耶穌，便當持定所承認的道。
english: Having then a great high priest, who has made his way through the heavens, even Jesus the Son of God, let us be strong in our faith.

chinese: 因我們的大祭司並非不能體恤我們的軟弱。他也曾凡事受過試探，與我們一樣，只是他沒有犯罪。
english: For we have not a high priest who is not able to be touched by the feelings of our feeble flesh; but we have one who has been tested in all points as we ourselves are tested, but without sin.

chinese: 所以，我們只管坦然無懼的來到施恩的寶座前，為要得憐恤，蒙恩惠，作隨時的幫助。
english: Then let us come near to the seat of grace without fear, so that mercy may be given to us, and we may get grace for our help in time of need.

chinese: 凡從人間挑選的大祭司，是奉派替人辦理屬神的事，為要獻上禮物和贖罪祭（或作：要為罪獻上禮物和祭物）。
english: Every high priest who is taken from among men is given his position to take care of the interests of men in those things which have to do with God, so that he may make offerings for sins.

chinese: 他能體諒那愚蒙的和失迷的人，因為他自己也是被軟弱所困。
english: He is able to have feeling for those who have no knowledge and for those who are wandering from the true way, because he himself is feeble;

chinese: 故此，他理當為百姓和自己獻祭贖罪。
english: And being feeble, he has to make sin-offerings for himself as well as for the people.

chinese: 這大祭司的尊榮，沒有人自取。惟要蒙神所召，像亞倫一樣。
english: And no man who is not given authority by God, as Aaron was, takes this honour for himself.

chinese: 如此，基督也不是自取榮耀作大祭司，乃是在乎向他說你是我的兒子，我今日生你的那一位；
english: In the same way Christ did not take for himself the glory of being made a high priest, but was given it by him who said, You are my Son, this day I have given you being:

chinese: 就如經上又有一處說：你是照著麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。
english: As he says in another place, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

chinese: 基督在肉體的時候，既大聲哀哭，流淚禱告，懇求那能救他免死的主，就因他的虔誠蒙了應允。
english: Who in the days of his flesh, having sent up prayers and requests with strong crying and weeping to him who was able to give him salvation from death, had his prayer answered because of his fear of God.

chinese: 他雖然為兒子，還是因所受的苦難學了順從。
english: And though he was a Son, through the pain which he underwent, the knowledge came to him of what it was to be under God's orders;

chinese: 他既得以完全，就為凡順從他的人成了永遠得救的根源、
english: And when he had been made complete, he became the giver of eternal salvation to all those who are under his orders;

chinese: 並蒙神照著麥基洗德的等次稱他為大祭司。
english: Being named by God a high priest of the order of Melchizedek.

chinese: 論到麥基洗德，我們有好些話，並且難以解明，因為你們聽不進去。
english: Of whom we have much to say which it is hard to make clear, because you are slow of hearing.

chinese: 看你們學習的工夫，本該作師傅，誰知還得有人將神聖言小學的開端另教導你們，並且成了那必須吃奶，不能吃乾糧的人。
english: And though by this time it would be right for you to be teachers, you still have need of someone to give you teaching about the first simple rules of God's revelation; you have become like babies who have need of milk, and not of solid food.

chinese: 凡只能吃奶的都不熟練仁義的道理，因為他是嬰孩；
english: For everyone who takes milk is without experience of the word of righteousness: he is a child.

chinese: 惟獨長大成人的才能吃乾糧；他們的心竅習練得通達，就能分辨好歹了。
english: But solid food is for men of full growth, even for those whose senses are trained by use to see what is good and what is evil.

chinese: 所以，我們應當離開基督道理的開端，竭力進到完全的地步，不必再立根基，就如那懊悔死行，信靠神、
english: For this reason let us go on from the first things about Christ to full growth; not building again that on which it is based, that is, the turning of the heart from dead works, and faith in God,

chinese: 各樣洗禮、按手之禮、死人復活，以及永遠審判各等教訓。
english: The teaching of baptisms, and of the putting on of hands, and of the future life of the dead, and of the judging on the last day.

chinese: 神若許我們，我們必如此行。
english: Now we will do this, if God lets us.

chinese: 論到那些已經蒙了光照、嘗過天恩的滋味、又於聖靈有分，
english: As for those who at one time saw the light, tasting the good things from heaven, and having their part in the Holy Spirit,

chinese: 並嘗過神善道的滋味、覺悟來世權能的人，
english: With knowledge of the good word of God, and of the powers of the coming time,

chinese: 若是離棄道理，就不能叫他們從新懊悔了。因為他們把神的兒子重釘十字架，明明的羞辱他。
english: And then let themselves be turned away, it is not possible for their hearts to be made new a second time; because they themselves put the Son of God on the cross again, openly shaming him.

chinese: 就如一塊田地，吃過屢次下的雨水，生長菜蔬，合乎耕種的人用，就從神得福；
english: For a land, drinking in the frequent rain and producing good plants for those for whom it is worked, has a blessing from God:

chinese: 若長荊棘和蒺藜，必被廢棄，近於咒詛，結局就是焚燒。
english: But if it sends up thorns and evil plants, it is of no use and is ready to be cursed; its only end is to be burned.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄們，我們雖是這樣說，卻深信你們的行為強過這些，而且近乎得救。
english: But, my loved ones, though we say this, we are certain that you have better things in you, things which go with salvation;

chinese: 因為神並非不公義，竟忘記你們所做的工和你們為他名所顯的愛心，就是先前伺候聖徒，如今還是伺候。
english: For God is true, and will not put away from him the memory of your work and of your love for his name, in the help which you gave and still give to the saints.

chinese: 我們願你們各人都顯出這樣的殷勤，使你們有滿足的指望，一直到底。
english: And it is our desire that you may all keep the same high purpose in certain hope to the end:

chinese: 並且不懈怠，總要效法那些憑信心和忍耐承受應許的人。
english: So that you may not be slow in heart, but may take as your example those to whom God has given their heritage, because of their faith and their long waiting.

chinese: 當初神應許亞伯拉罕的時候，因為沒有比自己更大可以指著起誓的，就指著自己起誓，說：
english: For when God made his oath to Abraham, because there was no greater oath, he made it by himself,

chinese: 論福，我必賜大福給你；論子孫，我必叫你的子孫多起來。
english: Saying, Be certain that I will give you my blessing, and make your numbers very great.

chinese: 這樣，亞伯拉罕既恆久忍耐，就得了所應許的。
english: And so, when he had been waiting calmly for a long time, God's word to him was put into effect.

chinese: 人都是指著比自己大的起誓，並且以起誓為實據，了結各樣的爭論。
english: For men at all times make their oaths by what is greater; and any argument is ended by the decision of the oath.

chinese: 照樣，神願意為那承受應許的人格外顯明他的旨意是不更改的，就起誓為證。
english: So that when it was God's desire to make it specially clear to those who by his word were to have the heritage, that his purpose was fixed, he made it more certain with an oath;

chinese: 藉這兩件不更改的事，神決不能說謊，好叫我們這逃往避難所、持定擺在我們前頭指望的人可以大得勉勵。
english: So that we, who have gone in flight from danger to the hope which has been put before us, may have a strong comfort in two unchanging things, in which it is not possible for God to be false;

chinese: 我們有這指望，如同靈魂的錨，又堅固又牢靠，且通入幔內。
english: And this hope is like a strong band for our souls, fixed and certain, and going in to that which is inside the veil;

chinese: 作先鋒的耶穌，既照著麥基洗德的等次成了永遠的大祭司，就為我們進入幔內。
english: Where Jesus has gone before us, as a high priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

chinese: 這麥基洗德就是撒冷王，又是至高神的祭司，本是長遠為祭司的。他當亞伯拉罕殺敗諸王回來的時候，就迎接他，給他祝福。
english: For this Melchizedek, the king of Salem, a priest of the Most High God, who gave Abraham his blessing, meeting him when he came back after putting the kings to death,

chinese: 亞伯拉罕也將自己所得來的，取十分之一給他。他頭一個名繙出來就是仁義王，他又名撒冷王，就是平安王的意思。
english: And to whom Abraham gave a tenth part of everything which he had, being first named King of righteousness, and then in addition, King of Salem, that is to say, King of peace;

chinese: 他無父，無母，無族譜，無生之始，無命之終，乃是與神的兒子相似。
english: Being without father or mother, or family, having no birth or end to his life, being made like the Son of God, is a priest for ever.

chinese: 你們想一想，先祖亞伯拉罕將自己所擄來上等之物取十分之一給他，這人是何等尊貴呢！
english: Now see how great this man was, to whom our father Abraham gave a tenth part of what he had got in the fight.

chinese: 那得祭司職任的利未子孫，領命照例向百姓取十分之一，這百姓是自己的弟兄，雖是從亞伯拉罕身（原文是腰）中生的，還是照例取十分之一；
english: And it is true that by the law, those of the sons of Levi who have the position of priests may take a tenth part of the people's goods; that is to say, they take it from their brothers though these are the sons of Abraham.

chinese: 獨有麥基洗德，不與他們同譜，倒收納亞伯拉罕的十分之一，為那蒙應許的亞伯拉罕祝福。
english: But this man, who was not of their family, took the tenth from Abraham, and gave a blessing to him to whom God had given his undertaking.

chinese: 從來位分大的給位分小的祝福，這是駁不倒的理。
english: But there is no doubt that the less gets his blessing from the greater.

chinese: 在這裡收十分之一的都是必死的人；但在那裡收十分之一的，有為他作見證的說，他是活的；
english: Now at the present time, men over whom death has power take the tenth; but then it was taken by one of whom it is witnessed that he is living.

chinese: 並且可說那受十分之一的利未，也是藉著亞伯拉罕納了十分之一。
english: And we may say that in Abraham, even Levi, who has a right to take the tenth part, gave it;

chinese: 因為麥基洗德迎接亞伯拉罕的時候，利未已經在他先祖的身（原文是腰）中。
english: Because he was still in his father's body when Melchizedek came to him.

chinese: 從前百姓在利未人祭司職任以下受律法，倘若藉這職任能得完全，又何用另外興起一位祭司，照麥基洗德的等次，不照亞倫的等次呢？
english: Now if it was possible for things to be made complete through the priests of the house of Levi (for the law was given to the people in connection with them), what need was there for another priest who was of the order of Melchizedek and not of the order of Aaron?

chinese: 祭司的職任既已更改，律法也必須更改。
english: Because if the priests are changed, it is necessary to make a change in the law.

chinese: 因為這話所指的人本屬別的支派，那支派裡從來沒有一人伺候祭壇。
english: For he of whom these things are said comes of another tribe, of which no man has ever made offerings at the altar.

chinese: 我們的主分明是從猶大出來的；但這支派，摩西並沒有提到祭司。
english: Because it is clear that our Lord comes out of Judah, and Moses said nothing about priests from that tribe.

chinese: 倘若照麥基洗德的樣式，另外興起一位祭司來，我的話更是顯而易見的了。
english: And this is even more clear if a second priest has come up who is like Melchizedek,

chinese: 他成為祭司，並不是照屬肉體的條例，乃是照無窮（原文是不能毀壞）之生命的大能。
english: That is to say, not made by a law based on the flesh, but by the power of a life without end:

chinese: 因為有給他作見證的說：你是照著麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。
english: For it has been witnessed of him, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

chinese: 先前的條例，因軟弱無益，所以廢掉了，
english: So the law which went before is put on one side, because it was feeble and without profit.

chinese: （律法原來一無所成）就引進了更美的指望；靠這指望，我們便可以進到神面前。
english: (Because the law made nothing complete), and in its place there is a better hope, through which we come near to God.

chinese: 再者，耶穌為祭司，並不是不起誓立的。
english: And as this is not without the taking of an oath

chinese: 至於那些祭司，原不是起誓立的，只有耶穌是起誓立的；因為那立他的對他說：主起了誓，決不後悔，你是永遠為祭司。
english: (For those were made priests without an oath, but this one was made a priest with an oath by him who says of him, The Lord gave his oath, which he will not take back, that you are a priest for ever);

chinese: 既是起誓立的，耶穌就作了更美之約的中保。
english: By so much is it a better agreement which we have through Jesus.

chinese: 那些成為祭司的，數目本來多，是因為有死阻隔，不能長久。
english: And it is true that there have been a great number of those priests, because death does not let them go on for ever;

chinese: 這位既是永遠常存的，他祭司的職任就長久不更換。
english: But this priest, because his life goes on for ever, is unchanging.

chinese: 凡靠著他進到神面前的人，他都能拯救到底；因為他是長遠活著，替他們祈求。
english: So that he is fully able to be the saviour of all who come to God through him, because he is ever living to make prayer to God for them.

chinese: 像這樣聖潔、無邪惡、無玷污、遠離罪人、高過諸天的大祭司，原是與我們合宜的。
english: It was right for us to have such a high priest, one who is holy and without evil, doing no wrong, having no part with sinners, and made higher than the heavens:

chinese: 他不像那些大祭司，每日必須先為自己的罪，後為百姓的罪獻祭；因為他只一次將自己獻上，就把這事成全了。
english: Who has no need to make offerings for sins every day, like those high priests, first for himself, and then for the people; because he did this once and for ever when he made an offering of himself.

chinese: 律法本是立軟弱的人為大祭司；但在律法以後起誓的話，是立兒子為大祭司，乃是成全到永遠的。
english: The law makes high priests of men who are feeble; but the word of the oath, which was made after the law, gives that position to a Son, in whom all good is for ever complete.

chinese: 我們所講的事，其中第一要緊的，就是我們有這樣的大祭司，已經坐在天上至大者寶座的右邊，
english: Now of the things we are saying this is the chief point: We have such a high priest, who has taken his place at the right hand of God's high seat of glory in heaven,

chinese: 在聖所，就是真帳幕裡，作執事；這帳幕是主所支的，不是人所支的。
english: As a servant of the holy things and of the true Tent, which was put up by God, not by man.

chinese: 凡大祭司都是為獻禮物和祭物設立的，所以這位大祭司也必須有所獻的。
english: Now every high priest is given authority to take to God the things which are given and to make offerings; so that it is necessary for this man, like them, to have something for an offering.

chinese: 他若在地上，必不得為祭司，因為已經有照律法獻禮物的祭司。
english: If he had been on earth he would not have been a priest at all, because there are other priests who make the offerings ordered by the law;

chinese: 他們供奉的事本是天上事的形狀和影像，正如摩西將要造帳幕的時候，蒙神警戒他，說：你要謹慎，作各樣的物件都要照著在山上指示你的樣式。
english: Being servants of that which is a copy and an image of the things in heaven, as Moses, when he was about to make the Tent, had special orders from God: for, See, he said, that you make everything like the design which you saw in the mountain.

chinese: 如今耶穌所得的職任是更美的，正如他作更美之約的中保；這約原是憑更美之應許立的。
english: But now his position as priest is higher. because through him God has made a better agreement with man, based on the giving of better things.

chinese: 那前約若沒有瑕疵，就無處尋求後約了。
english: For if that first agreement had been as good as possible, there would have been no place for a second.

chinese: 所以主指責他的百姓說（或作：所以主指前約的缺欠說）：日子將到，我要與以色列家和猶大家另立新約，
english: For, protesting against them, he says, See, the days are coming when I will make a new agreement with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah;

chinese: 不像我拉著他們祖宗的手，領他們出埃及的時候，與他們所立的約。因為他們不恆心守我的約，我也不理他們。這是主說的。
english: Not like the agreement which I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand, to be their guide out of the land of Egypt; for they did not keep the agreement with me, and I gave them up, says the Lord.

chinese: 主又說：那些日子以後，我與以色列家所立的約乃是這樣：我要將我的律法放在他們裡面，寫在他們心上；我要作他們的神；他們要作我的子民。
english: For this is the agreement which I will make with the people of Israel after those days: I will put my laws into their minds, writing them in their hearts: and I will be their God, and they will be my people:

chinese: 他們不用各人教導自己的鄉鄰和自己的弟兄，說：你該認識主；因為他們從最小的到至大的，都必認識我。
english: And there will be no need for every man to be teaching his brother, or his neighbour, saying, This is the knowledge of the Lord: for they will all have knowledge of me, great and small.

chinese: 我要寬恕他們的不義，不再記念他們的罪愆。
english: And I will have mercy on their evil-doing, and I will not keep their sins in mind.

chinese: 既說新約。就以前約為舊了；但那漸舊漸衰的，就必快歸無有了。
english: When he says, A new agreement, he has made the first agreement old. But anything which is getting old and past use will not be seen much longer.

chinese: 原來前約有禮拜的條例和屬世界的聖幕。
english: Now the first agreement had its rules of worship, and a holy order.

chinese: 因為有預備的帳幕，頭一層叫作聖所，裡面有燈臺、桌子，和陳設餅。
english: For the first Tent was made ready, having in it the vessels for the lights and the table and the ordering of the bread; and this is named the holy place.

chinese: 第二幔子後又有一層帳幕，叫作至聖所，
english: And inside the second veil was the place which is named the Holy of holies;

chinese: 有金香爐（或作：壇），有包金的約櫃，櫃裡有盛嗎哪的金罐和亞倫發過芽的杖，並兩塊約版；
english: Having a vessel of gold in it for burning perfumes, and the ark of the agreement, which was covered with gold and which had in it a pot made of gold for the manna, and Aaron's rod which put out buds, and the stones with the writing of the agreement;

chinese: 櫃上面有榮耀基路伯的影罩著施恩（原文作：蔽罪）座。這幾件我現在不能一一細說。
english: And over it were the winged ones of glory with their wings covering the mercy-seat; about which it is not possible now to say anything in detail.

chinese: 這些物件既如此預備齊了，眾祭司就常進頭一層帳幕，行拜神的禮。
english: Now while these things were in existence, the priests went into the first Tent at all times, for prayer and the making of offerings.

chinese: 至於第二層帳幕，惟有大祭司一年一次獨自進去，沒有不帶著血為自己和百姓的過錯獻上。
english: But only the high priest went into the second, once a year, not without making an offering of blood for himself and for the errors of the people:

chinese: 聖靈用此指明，頭一層帳幕仍存的時候，進入至聖所的路還未顯明。
english: The Holy Spirit witnessing by this that the way into the holy place had not at that time been made open, while the first Tent was still in being;

chinese: 那頭一層帳幕作現今的一個表樣，所獻的禮物和祭物，就著良心說，都不能叫禮拜的人得以完全。
english: And this is an image of the present time; when the offerings which are given are not able to make the heart of the worshipper completely clean,

chinese: 這些事，連那飲食和諸般洗濯的規矩，都不過是屬肉體的條例，命定到振興的時候為止。
english: Because they are only rules of the flesh, of meats and drinks and washings, which have their place till the time comes when things will be put right.

chinese: 但現在基督已經來到，作了將來美事的大祭司，經過那更大更全備的帳幕，不是人手所造、也不是屬乎這世界的；
english: But now Christ has come as the high priest of the good things of the future, through this greater and better Tent, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this world,

chinese: 並且不用山羊和牛犢的血，乃用自己的血，只一次進入聖所，成了永遠贖罪的事。
english: And has gone once and for ever into the holy place, having got eternal salvation, not through the blood of goats and young oxen, but through his blood.

chinese: 若山羊和公牛的血，並母牛犢的灰，灑在不潔的人身上，尚且叫人成聖，身體潔淨，
english: For if the blood of goats and oxen, and the dust from the burning of a young cow, being put on the unclean, make the flesh clean:

chinese: 何況基督藉著永遠的靈，將自己無瑕無疵獻給神，他的血豈不更能洗淨你們的心（原文是良心），除去你們的死行，使你們事奉那永生神麼？
english: How much more will the blood of Christ, who, being without sin, made an offering of himself to God through the Holy Spirit, make your hearts clean from dead works to be servants of the living God?

chinese: 為此，他作了新約的中保，既然受死贖了人在前約之時所犯的罪過，便叫蒙召之人得著所應許永遠的產業。
english: And for this cause it is through him that a new agreement has come into being, so that after the errors under the first agreement had been taken away by his death, the word of God might have effect for those who were marked out for an eternal heritage.

chinese: 凡有遺命必須等到留遺命（遺命：原文與約字同）的人死了；
english: Because where there is a testament, there has to be the death of the man who made it.

chinese: 因為人死了，遺命才有效力，若留遺命的尚在，那遺命還有用處麼？
english: For a testament has effect after death; for what power has it while the man who made it is living?

chinese: 所以，前約也不是不用血立的；
english: So that even the first agreement was not made without blood.

chinese: 因為摩西當日照著律法將各樣誡命傳給眾百姓，就拿朱紅色絨和牛膝草，把牛犢山羊的血和水灑在書上，又灑在眾百姓身上，說：
english: For when Moses had given all the rules of the law to the people, he took the blood of goats and young oxen, with water and red wool and hyssop, and put it on the book itself and on all the people,

chinese: 這血就是神與你們立約的憑據。
english: Saying, This blood is the sign of the agreement which God has made with you.

chinese: 他又照樣把血灑在帳幕和各樣器皿上。
english: And the blood was put on the Tent and all the holy vessels in the same way.

chinese: 按著律法，凡物差不多都是用血潔淨的；若不流血，罪就不得赦免了。
english: And by the law almost all things are made clean with blood, and without blood there is no forgiveness.

chinese: 照著天上樣式作的物件必須用這些祭物去潔淨；但那天上的本物自然當用更美的祭物去潔淨。
english: For this cause it was necessary to make the copies of the things in heaven clean with these offerings; but the things themselves are made clean with better offerings than these.

chinese: 因為基督並不是進了人手所造的聖所（這不過是真聖所的影像），乃是進了天堂，如今為我們顯在神面前；
english: For Christ did not go into a holy place which had been made by men's hands as the copy of the true one; but he went into heaven itself, and now takes his place before the face of God for us.

chinese: 也不是多次將自己獻上，像那大祭司每年帶著牛羊的血（牛羊的血：原文作不是自己的血）進入聖所，
english: And he did not have to make an offering of himself again and again, as the high priest goes into the holy place every year with blood which is not his;

chinese: 如果這樣，他從創世以來，就必多次受苦了。但如今在這末世顯現一次，把自己獻為祭，好除掉罪。
english: For then he would have undergone a number of deaths from the time of the making of the world: but now he has come to us at the end of the old order, to put away sin by the offering of himself.

chinese: 按著定命，人人都有一死，死後且有審判。
english: And because by God's law death comes to men once, and after that they are judged;

chinese: 像這樣，基督既然一次被獻，擔當了多人的罪，將來要向那等候他的人第二次顯現，並與罪無關，乃是為拯救他們。
english: So Christ, having at his first coming taken on himself the sins of men, will be seen a second time, without sin, by those who are waiting for him, for their salvation.

chinese: 律法既是將來美事的影兒，不是本物的真像，總不能藉著每年常獻一樣的祭物叫那近前來的人得以完全。
english: For the law, being only a poor copy of the future good things, and not the true image of those things, is never able to make the people who come to the altar every year with the same offerings completely clean.

chinese: 若不然，獻祭的事豈不早已止住了麼？因為禮拜的人，良心既被潔淨，就不再覺得有罪了。
english: For if this had been possible, would there not have been an end of those offerings, because the worshippers would have been made completely clean and would have been no longer conscious of sins?

chinese: 但這些祭物是叫人每年想起罪來；
english: But year by year there is a memory of sins in those offerings.

chinese: 因為公牛和山羊的血，斷不能除罪。
english: Because it is not possible for the blood of oxen and goats to take away sins.

chinese: 所以基督到世上來的時候，就說：神阿，祭物和禮物是你不願意的；你曾給我預備了身體。
english: So that when he comes into the world, he says, You had no desire for offerings, but you made a body ready for me;

chinese: 燔祭和贖罪祭是你不喜歡的。
english: You had no joy in burned offerings or in offerings for sin.

chinese: 那時我說：神阿，我來了，為要照你的旨意行；我的事在經卷上已經記載了。
english: Then I said, See, I have come to do your pleasure, O God (as it is said of me in the roll of the book).

chinese: 以上說：祭物和禮物，燔祭和贖罪祭，是你不願意的，也是你不喜歡的（這都是按著律法獻的）；
english: After saying, You had no desire for offerings, for burned offerings or offerings for sin (which are made by the law) and you had no pleasure in them,

chinese: 後又說：我來了為要照你的旨意行；可見他是除去在先的，為要立定在後的。
english: Then he said, See, I have come to do your pleasure. He took away the old order, so that he might put the new order in its place.

chinese: 我們憑這旨意，靠耶穌基督，只一次獻上他的身體，就得以成聖。
english: By that pleasure we have been made holy, by the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once and for ever.

chinese: 凡祭司天天站著事奉神，屢次獻上一樣的祭物，這祭物永不能除罪。
english: And every priest takes his place at the altar day by day, doing what is necessary, and making again and again the same offerings which are never able to take away sins.

chinese: 但基督獻了一次永遠的贖罪祭，就在神的右邊坐下了。
english: But when Jesus had made one offering for sins for ever, he took his place at the right hand of God;

chinese: 從此，等候他仇敵成了他的腳凳。
english: And has been waiting there from that time, till all who are against him are made a foot-rest for his feet.

chinese: 因為他一次獻祭，便叫那得以成聖的人永遠完全。
english: Because by one offering he has made complete for ever those who are made holy.

chinese: 聖靈也對我們作見證；因為他既已說過：
english: And the Holy Spirit is a witness for us: for after he had said,

chinese: 主說：那些日子以後，我與他們所立的約乃是這樣：我要將我的律法寫在他們心上，又要放在他們的裡面。
english: This is the agreement which I will make with them after those days, says the Lord; I will put my laws in their hearts, writing them in their minds; he said,

chinese: 以後就說：我不再記念他們的罪愆和他們的過犯。
english: And I will keep no more memory of their sins and of their evil-doings.

chinese: 這些罪過既已赦免，就不用再為罪獻祭了。
english: Now where there is forgiveness of these, there is no more offering for sin.

chinese: 弟兄們，我們既因耶穌的血得以坦然進入至聖所，
english: So then, my brothers, being able to go into the holy place without fear, because of the blood of Jesus,

chinese: 是藉著他給我們開了一條又新又活的路，從幔子經過，這幔子就是他的身體。
english: By the new and living way which he made open for us through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

chinese: 又有一位大祭司治理神的家！
english: And having a great priest over the house of God,

chinese: 並我們心中天良的虧欠已經灑去，身體用清水洗淨了，就當存著誠心和充足的信心來到神面前；
english: Let us go in with true hearts, in certain faith, having our hearts made free from the sense of sin and our bodies washed with clean water:

chinese: 也要堅守我們所承認的指望，不至搖動，因為那應許我們的是信實的。
english: Let us keep the witness of our hope strong and unshaking, for he is true who has given his word:

chinese: 又要彼此相顧，激發愛心，勉勵行善。
english: And let us be moving one another at all times to love and good works;

chinese: 你們不可停止聚會，好像那些停止慣了的人，倒要彼此勸勉，既知道（原文是看見）那日子臨近，就更當如此。
english: Not giving up our meetings, as is the way of some, but keeping one another strong in faith; and all the more because you see the day coming near.

chinese: 因為我們得知真道以後，若故意犯罪，贖罪的祭就再沒有了；
english: For if we do evil on purpose after we have had the knowledge of what is true, there is no more offering for sins,

chinese: 惟有戰懼等候審判和那燒滅眾敵人的烈火。
english: But only a great fear of being judged, and of the fire of wrath which will be the destruction of the haters of God.

chinese: 人干犯摩西的律法，憑兩三個見證人，尚且不得憐恤而死，
english: A man who has gone against the law of Moses is put to death without pity on the word of two or three witnesses:

chinese: 何況人踐踏神的兒子，將那使他成聖之約的血當作平常，又褻慢施恩的聖靈，你們想，他要受的刑罰該怎樣加重呢！
english: But will not the man by whom the Son of God has been crushed under foot, and the blood of the agreement with which he was washed clean has been taken as an unholy thing, and who has had no respect for the Spirit of grace, be judged bad enough for a very much worse punishment?

chinese: 因為我們知道誰說：伸冤在我，我必報應；又說：主要審判他的百姓。
english: For we have had experience of him who says, Punishment is mine, I will give reward. And again, The Lord will be judge of his people.

chinese: 落在永生神的手裡，真是可怕的！
english: We may well go in fear of falling into the hands of the living God.

chinese: 你們要追念往日，蒙了光照以後所忍受大爭戰的各樣苦難：
english: But give thought to the days after you had seen the light, when you went through a great war of troubles;

chinese: 一面被毀謗，遭患難，成了戲景，叫眾人觀看；一面陪伴那些受這樣苦難的人。
english: In part, in being attacked by angry words and cruel acts, before the eyes of everyone, and in part, in being united with those who were attacked in this way.

chinese: 因為你們體恤了那些被捆鎖的人，並且你們的家業被人搶去，也甘心忍受，知道自己有更美長存的家業。
english: For you had pity on those who were in prison, and had joy in the loss of your property, in the knowledge that you still had a better property and one which you would keep for ever.

chinese: 所以，你們不可丟棄勇敢的心；存這樣的心必得大賞賜。
english: So do not give up your hope which will be greatly rewarded.

chinese: 你們必須忍耐，使你們行完了神的旨意，就可以得著所應許的。
english: For, having done what was right in God's eyes, you have need of waiting before his word has effect for you.

chinese: 因為還有一點點時候，那要來的就來，並不遲延；
english: In a very little time he who is coming will come; he will not be slow.

chinese: 只是義人（有古卷：我的義人）必因信得生。他若退後，我心裡就不喜歡他。
english: But the upright man will be living by his faith; and if he goes back, my soul will have no pleasure in him.

chinese: 我們卻不是退後入沉淪的那等人，乃是有信心以致靈魂得救的人。
english: But we are not of those who go back to destruction; but of those who have faith even to the salvation of the soul.

chinese: 信就是所望之事的實底，是未見之事的確據。
english: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, and the sign that the things not seen are true.

chinese: 古人在這信上得了美好的證據。
english: For by it our fathers had God's approval.

chinese: 我們因著信，就知道諸世界是藉神話造成的；這樣，所看見的，並不是從顯然之物造出來的。
english: By faith it is clear to us that the order of events was fixed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made from things which only seem to be.

chinese: 亞伯因著信，獻祭與神，比該隱所獻的更美，因此便得了稱義的見證，就是神指他禮物作的見證。他雖然死了，卻因這信，仍舊說話。
english: By faith Abel made a better offering to God than Cain, and he had witness through it of his righteousness, God giving his approval of his offering: and his voice still comes to us through it though he is dead.

chinese: 以諾因著信，被接去，不至於見死，人也找不著他，因為神已經把他接去了；只是他被接去以先，已經得了神喜悅他的明證。
english: By faith Enoch was taken up to heaven so that he did not see death; he was seen no longer, for God took him away: for before he was taken, witness had been given that he was well-pleasing to God:

chinese: 人非有信，就不能得神的喜悅；因為到神面前來的人必須信有神，且信他賞賜那尋求他的人。
english: And without faith it is not possible to be well-pleasing to him, for it is necessary for anyone who comes to God to have the belief that God is, and that he is a rewarder of all those who make a serious search for him.

chinese: 挪亞因著信，既蒙神指示他未見的事，動了敬畏的心，預備了一隻方舟，使他全家得救。因此就定了那世代的罪，自己也承受了那從信而來的義。
english: By faith Noah, being moved by the fear of God, made ready an ark for the salvation of his family, because God had given him news of things which were not seen at the time; and through it the world was judged by him, and he got for his heritage the righteousness which is by faith.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕因著信，蒙召的時候就遵命出去，往將來要得為業的地方去；出去的時候，還不知往那裡去。
english: By faith Abraham did as God said when he was ordered to go out into a place which was to be given to him as a heritage, and went out without knowledge of where he was going.

chinese: 他因著信，就在所應許之地作客，好像在異地居住帳棚，與那同蒙一個應許的以撒、雅各一樣。
english: By faith he was a wanderer in the land of the agreement, as in a strange land, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, who had a part with him in the same heritage:

chinese: 因為他等候那座有根基的城，就是神所經營所建造的。
english: For he was looking for the strong town, whose builder and maker is God.

chinese: 因著信，連撒拉自己，雖然過了生育的歲數，還能懷孕，因他以為那應許他的是可信的。
english: And by faith Sarah herself had power to give birth, when she was very old, because she had faith in him who gave his word;

chinese: 所以從一個彷彿已死的人就生出子孫，如同天上的星那樣眾多，海邊的沙那樣無數。
english: So that from one man, who was near to death, came children in number as the stars in heaven, or as the sand by the seaside, which may not be numbered.

chinese: 這些人都是存著信心死的，並沒有得著所應許的；卻從遠處望見，且歡喜迎接，又承認自己在世上是客旅，是寄居的。
english: All these came to their end in faith, not having had the heritage; but having seen it with delight far away, they gave witness that they were wanderers and not of the earth.

chinese: 說這樣話的人是表明自己要找一個家鄉。
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are searching for a country for themselves.

chinese: 他們若想念所離開的家鄉，還有可以回去的機會。
english: And truly if they had kept in mind the country from which they went out, they would have had chances of turning back.

chinese: 他們卻羨慕一個更美的家鄉，就是在天上的。所以神被稱為他們的神，並不以為恥，因為他已經給他們預備了一座城。
english: But now their desire is for a better country, that is to say, for one in heaven; and so it is no shame to God to be named their God; for he has made ready a town for them.

chinese: 亞伯拉罕因著信，被試驗的時候，就把以撒獻上；這便是那歡喜領受應許的，將自己獨生的兒子獻上。
english: By faith Abraham made an offering of Isaac, when he was tested: and he with whom the agreement had been made gave up as an offering the only son of his body,

chinese: 論到這兒子，曾有話說：從以撒生的才要稱為你的後裔。
english: Of whom it had been said, From Isaac will your seed take their name:

chinese: 他以為神還能叫人從死裡復活；他也彷彿從死中得回他的兒子來。
english: Judging that God was able to give life even to the dead; and because of this he did get him back as if from death.

chinese: 以撒因著信，就指著將來的事給雅各、以掃祝福。
english: By faith Isaac, blessing Jacob and Esau, gave news of things to come.

chinese: 雅各因著信，臨死的時候，給約瑟的兩個兒子各自祝福，扶著杖頭敬拜神。
english: By faith Jacob gave a blessing to the two sons of Joseph, when he was near to death; and gave God worship, supported by his stick.

chinese: 約瑟因著信，臨終的時候，提到以色列族將來要出埃及，並為自己的骸骨留下遺命。
english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, said that the children of Israel would go out of Egypt; and gave orders about his bones.

chinese: 摩西生下來，他的父母見他是個俊美的孩子，就因著信，把他藏了三個月，並不怕王命。
english: By faith Moses was kept secretly by his father and mother for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a fair child; and they had no fear of the king's orders.

chinese: 摩西因著信，長大了就不肯稱為法老女兒之子。
english: By faith Moses, when he became a man, had no desire to be named the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

chinese: 他寧可和神的百姓同受苦害，也不願暫時享受罪中之樂。
english: Feeling that it was better to undergo pain with the people of God, than for a short time to have a taste of the pleasures of sin;

chinese: 他看為基督受的凌辱比埃及的財物更寶貴，因他想望所要得的賞賜。
english: Judging a part in the shame of Christ to be better than all the wealth of Egypt; for he was looking forward to his reward.

chinese: 他因著信，就離開埃及，不怕王怒；因為他恆心忍耐，如同看見那不能看見的主。
english: By faith he went out of Egypt, not being turned from his purpose by fear of the wrath of the king; for he kept on his way, as seeing him who is unseen.

chinese: 他因著信，就守（或作：立）逾越節，行灑血的禮，免得那滅長子的臨近以色列人。
english: By faith he kept the Passover, and put the sign of the blood on the houses, so that the angel of destruction might not put their oldest sons to death.

chinese: 他們因著信，過紅海如行乾地；埃及人試著要過去，就被吞滅了。
english: By faith they went through the Red Sea as if it had been dry land, though the Egyptians were overcome by the water when they made an attempt to do the same.

chinese: 以色列人因著信，圍繞耶利哥城七日，城牆就倒塌了。
english: By faith the walls of Jericho came down, after they had been circled for seven days.

chinese: 妓女喇合因著信，曾和和平平的接待探子，就不與那些不順從的人一同滅亡。
english: By faith Rahab, the loose woman, was not put to death with those who had gone against God's orders, because she had taken into her house in peace those sent to see the land.

chinese: 我又何必再說呢？若要一一細說，基甸、巴拉、參孫、耶弗他、大衛、撒母耳，和眾先知的事，時候就不夠了。
english: What more am I to say? For there would not be time to give the stories of Gideon, Barak, Samson, and Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets:

chinese: 他們因著信，制伏了敵國，行了公義，得了應許，堵了獅子的口，
english: Who through faith overcame kingdoms, did righteousness, got their reward, kept the mouths of lions shut,

chinese: 滅了烈火的猛勢，脫了刀劍的鋒刃；軟弱變為剛強，爭戰顯出勇敢，打退外邦的全軍。
english: Put out the power of fire, got safely away from the edge of the sword, were made strong when they had been feeble, became full of power in war, and put to flight the armies of the nations.

chinese: 有婦人得自己的死人復活。又有人忍受嚴刑，不肯苟且得釋放（原文是贖），為要得著更美的復活。
english: Women had their dead given back to them living; others let themselves be cruelly attacked, having no desire to go free, so that they might have a better life to come;

chinese: 又有人忍受戲弄、鞭打、捆鎖、監禁、各等的磨煉，
english: And others were tested by being laughed at or by blows, and even with chains and prisons:

chinese: 被石頭打死，被鋸鋸死，受試探，被刀殺，披著綿羊山羊的皮各處奔跑，受窮乏、患難、苦害，
english: They were stoned, they were cut up with knives, they were tested, they were put to death with the sword, they went about in sheepskins and in goatskins; being poor and in pain and cruelly attacked,

chinese: 在曠野、山嶺、山洞、地穴，飄流無定，本是世界不配有的人。
english: Wandering in waste places and in mountains and in holes in the rocks; for whom the world was not good enough.

chinese: 這些人都是因信得了美好的證據，卻仍未得著所應許的；
english: And not one of these got the good things of the agreement, though they all had a good record through faith,

chinese: 因為神給我們預備了更美的事，叫他們若不與我們同得，就不能完全。
english: Because God had kept some better thing for us, so that it was not possible for them to become complete without us.

chinese: 我們既有這許多的見證人，如同雲彩圍著我們，就當放下各樣的重擔，脫去容易纏累我們的罪，存心忍耐，奔那擺在我們前頭的路程，
english: For this reason, as we are circled by so great a cloud of witnesses, putting off every weight, and the sin into which we come so readily, let us keep on running in the way which is marked out for us,

chinese: 仰望為我們信心創始成終的耶穌（或作：仰望那將真道創始成終的耶穌）。他因那擺在前面的喜樂，就輕看羞辱，忍受了十字架的苦難，便坐在神寶座的右邊。
english: Having our eyes fixed on Jesus, the guide and end of our faith, who went through the pains of the cross, not caring for the shame, because of the joy which was before him, and who has now taken his place at the right hand of God's seat of power.

chinese: 那忍受罪人這樣頂撞的，你們要思想，免得疲倦灰心。
english: Give thought to him who has undergone so much of the hate of sinners against himself, so that you may not be tired and feeble of purpose.

chinese: 你們與罪惡相爭，還沒有抵擋到流血的地步。
english: Till now you have not given your blood in your fight against sin:

chinese: 你們又忘了那勸你們如同勸兒子的話，說：我兒，你不可輕看主的管教，被他責備的時候也不可灰心；
english: And you have not kept in mind the word which says to you as to sons, My son, do not make little of the Lord's punishment, and do not give up hope when you are judged by him;

chinese: 因為主所愛的，他必管教，又鞭打凡所收納的兒子。
english: For the Lord sends punishment on his loved ones; everyone whom he takes as his son has experience of his rod.

chinese: 你們所忍受的，是神管教你們，待你們如同待兒子。焉有兒子不被父親管教的呢？
english: It is for your training that you undergo these things; God is acting to you as a father does to his sons; for what son does not have punishment from his father?

chinese: 管教原是眾子所共受的，你們若不受管教，就是私子，不是兒子了。
english: But if you have not that punishment of which we all have our part, then you are not true sons, but children of shame.

chinese: 再者，我們曾有生身的父管教我們，我們尚且敬重他，何況萬靈的父，我們豈不更當順服他得生麼？
english: And again, if the fathers of our flesh gave us punishment and had our respect, how much more will we be under the authority of the Father of spirits, and have life?

chinese: 生身的父都是暫隨己意管教我們；惟有萬靈的父管教我們，是要我們得益處，使我們在他的聖潔上有分。
english: For they truly gave us punishment for a short time, as it seemed good to them; but he does it for our profit, so that we may become holy as he is.

chinese: 凡管教的事，當時不覺得快樂，反覺得愁苦；後來卻為那經練過的人結出平安的果子，就是義。
english: At the time all punishment seems to be pain and not joy: but after, those who have been trained by it get from it the peace-giving fruit of righteousness.

chinese: 所以，你們要把下垂的手、發酸的腿、挺起來；
english: For this cause let the hands which are hanging down be lifted up, and let the feeble knees be made strong,

chinese: 也要為自己的腳，把道路修直了，使瘸子不至歪腳（或作：差路），反得痊愈。
english: And make straight roads for your feet, so that the feeble may not be turned out of the way, but may be made strong.

chinese: 你們要追求與眾人和睦，並要追求聖潔；非聖潔沒有人能見主。
english: Let your desire be for peace with all men, and to be made holy, without which no man may see the Lord;

chinese: 又要謹慎，恐怕有人失了神的恩；恐怕有毒根生出來擾亂你們，因此叫眾人沾染污穢；
english: Looking with care to see that no man among you in his behaviour comes short of the grace of God; for fear that some bitter root may come up to be a trouble to you, and that some of you may be made unclean by it;

chinese: 恐怕有淫亂的，有貪戀世俗如以掃的，他因一點食物把自己長子的名分賣了。
english: And that there may not be any evil liver, or any man without respect for God, like Esau, who let his birthright go for a plate of food.

chinese: 後來想要承受父所祝的福，竟被棄絕，雖然號哭切求，卻得不著門路使他父親的心意回轉。這是你們知道的。
english: For you have knowledge that even long after, when he was desiring the blessing for his heritage, he was turned away, though he made his request frequently and with weeping; because the past might not be changed.

chinese: 你們原不是來到那能摸的山；此山有火燄、密雲、黑暗、暴風、
english: You have not come to a mountain which may be touched, and is burning with fire, and to a black cloud, and a dark smoke, and a violent wind,

chinese: 角聲與說話的聲音。那些聽見這聲音的，都求不要再向他們說話；
english: And to the sound of a horn, and the voice of words, the hearers of which made request that not a word more might be said to them:

chinese: 因為他們當不起所命他們的話，說：靠近這山的，即便是走獸，也要用石頭打死。
english: For the order which said, If the mountain is touched even by a beast, the beast is to be stoned, seemed hard to them;

chinese: 所見的極其可怕，甚至摩西說：我甚是恐懼戰兢。
english: And the vision was so overpowering that even Moses said, I am shaking and full of fear.

chinese: 你們乃是來到錫安山，永生神的城邑，就是天上的耶路撒冷。那裡有千萬的天使，
english: But you have come to the mountain of Zion, to the place of the living God, to the Jerusalem which is in heaven, and to an army of angels which may not be numbered,

chinese: 有名錄在天上諸長子之會所共聚的總會，有審判眾人的神和被成全之義人的靈魂，
english: To the great meeting and church of the first of those who are named in heaven, and to God the judge of all, and to the spirits of good men made complete,

chinese: 並新約的中保耶穌，以及所灑的血；這血所說的比亞伯的血所說的更美。
english: And to Jesus by whom the new agreement has been made between God and man, and to the sign of the blood which says better things than Abel's blood.

chinese: 你們總要謹慎，不可棄絕那向你們說話的。因為，那些棄絕在地上警戒他們的尚且不能逃罪，何況我們違背那從天上警戒我們的呢？
english: See that you give ear to his voice which comes to you. For if those whose ears were shut to the voice which came to them on earth did not go free from punishment, what chance have we of going free if we give no attention to him whose voice comes from heaven?

chinese: 當時他的聲音震動了地，但如今他應許說：再一次我不單要震動地，還要震動天。
english: Whose voice was the cause of the shaking of the earth; but now he has made an oath, saying, There will be still one more shaking, not only of the earth, but of heaven.

chinese: 這再一次的話，是指明被震動的，就是受造之物都要挪去，使那不被震動的常存。
english: And the words, Still one more, make it clear that there will be a taking away of those things which are shaking, as of things which are made, so that there may be only those things of which no shaking is possible.

chinese: 所以我們既得了不能震動的國，就當感恩，照神所喜悅的，用虔誠、敬畏的心事奉神。
english: If then, we have a kingdom which will never be moved, let us have grace, so that we may give God such worship as is pleasing to him with fear and respect:

chinese: 因為我們的神乃是烈火。
english: For our God is an all-burning fire.

chinese: 你們務要常存弟兄相愛的心。
english: Go on loving your brothers in the faith.

chinese: 不可忘記用愛心接待客旅；因為曾有接待客旅的，不知不覺就接待了天使。
english: Take care to keep open house: because in this way some have had angels as their guests, without being conscious of it.

chinese: 你們要記念被捆綁的人，好像與他們同受捆綁；，也要記念遭苦害的人，想到自己也在肉身之內。
english: Keep in mind those who are in chains, as if you were chained with them, and those who are in trouble, as being yourselves in the body.

chinese: 婚姻，人人都當尊重，床也不可污穢；因為苟合行淫的人，神必要審判。
english: Let married life be honoured among all of you and not made unclean; for men untrue in married life will be judged by God.

chinese: 你們存心不可貪愛錢財，要以自己所有的為足；因為主曾說：我總不撇下你，也不丟棄你。
english: Be free from the love of money and pleased with the things which you have; for he himself has said, I will be with you at all times.

chinese: 所以我們可以放膽說：主是幫助我的，我必不懼怕；人能把我怎麼樣呢？
english: So that we say with a good heart, The Lord is my helper; I will have no fear: what is man able to do to me?

chinese: 從前引導你們、傳神之道給你們的人，你們要想念他們，效法他們的信心，留心看他們為人的結局。
english: Keep in mind those who were over you, and who gave you the word of God; seeing the outcome of their way of life, let your faith be like theirs.

chinese: 耶穌基督，昨日、今日、一直到永遠、是一樣的。
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and for ever.

chinese: 你們不要被那諸般怪異的教訓勾引了去；因為人心靠恩得堅固才是好的，並不是靠飲食。那在飲食上專心的從來沒有得著益處。
english: Do not be turned away by different strange teachings, because it is good for your hearts to be made strong by grace, and not by meats, which were of no profit to those who took so much trouble over them.

chinese: 我們有一祭壇，上面的祭物是那些在帳幕中供職的人不可同吃的。
english: We have an altar from which those priests who are servants in the Tent may not take food.

chinese: 原來牲畜的血被大祭司帶入聖所作贖罪祭；牲畜的身子被燒在營外。
english: For the bodies of the beasts whose blood is taken into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin are burned outside the circle of the tents.

chinese: 所以，耶穌要用自己的血叫百姓成聖，也就在城門外受苦。
english: For this reason Jesus was put to death outside the walls, so that he might make the people holy by his blood.

chinese: 這樣，我們也當出到營外，就了他去，忍受他所受的凌辱。
english: Let us then go out to him outside the circle of the tents, taking his shame on ourselves.

chinese: 我們在這裡本沒有常存的城，乃是尋求那將來的城。
english: For here we have no fixed resting-place, but our search is for the one which is to come.

chinese: 我們應當靠著耶穌，常常以頌讚為祭獻給神，這就是那承認主名之人嘴唇的果子。
english: Let us then make offerings of praise to God at all times through him, that is to say, the fruit of lips giving witness to his name.

chinese: 只是不可忘記行善和捐輸的事；因為這樣的祭，是神所喜悅的。
english: But go on doing good and giving to others, because God is well-pleased with such offerings.

chinese: 你們要依從那些引導你們的，且要順服；因他們為你們的靈魂時刻儆醒，好像那將來交賬的人。你們要使他們交的時候有快樂，不至憂愁；若憂愁就與你們無益了。
english: Give ear to those who are rulers over you, and do as they say: for they keep watch over your souls, ready to give an account of them; let them be able to do this with joy and not with grief, because that would be of no profit to you.

chinese: 請你們為我們禱告，因我們自覺良心無虧，願意凡事按正道而行。
english: Make prayers for us, for we are certain that our hearts are free from the sense of sin, desiring the right way of life in all things.

chinese: 我更求你們為我禱告，使我快些回到你們那裡去。
english: I make this request more strongly, in the hope of coming back to you more quickly.

chinese: 但願賜平安的神，就是那憑永約之血、使群羊的大牧人─我主耶穌從死裡復活的神，
english: Now may the God of peace, who made that great keeper of his flock, even our Lord Jesus, come back from the dead through the blood of the eternal agreement,

chinese: 在各樣善事上成全你們，叫你們遵行他的旨意；又藉著耶穌基督在你們心裡行他所喜悅的事。願榮耀歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
english: Make you full of every good work and ready to do all his desires, working in us whatever is pleasing in his eyes through Jesus Christ; and may the glory be given to him for ever and ever. So be it.

chinese: 弟兄們，我略略寫信給你們，望你們聽我勸勉的話。
english: But, brothers, take kindly the words which I have said for your profit; for I have not sent you a long letter.

chinese: 你們該知道，我們的兄弟提摩太已經釋放了；他若快來，我必同他去見你們。
english: Our brother Timothy has been let out of prison; and if he comes here in a short time, he and I will come to you together.

chinese: 請你們問引導你們的諸位和眾聖徒安。從義大利來的人也問你們安。
english: Give words of love from me to those who are rulers over you, and to all the saints. Those who are in Italy send you their love.

chinese: 願恩惠常與你們眾人同在。阿們！
english: May grace be with you all.

chinese: 作神和主耶穌基督僕人的雅各請散住十二個支派之人的安。
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, sends words of love to the twelve tribes of the Jews living in all parts of the earth.

chinese: 我的弟兄們，你們落在百般試煉中，都要以為大喜樂；
english: Let it be all joy to you, my brothers, when you undergo tests of every sort;

chinese: 因為知道你們的信心經過試驗，就生忍耐。
english: Because you have the knowledge that the testing of your faith gives you the power of going on in hope;

chinese: 但忍耐也當成功，使你們成全、完備，毫無缺欠。
english: But let this power have its full effect, so that you may be made complete, needing nothing.

chinese: 你們中間若有缺少智慧的，應當求那厚賜與眾人、也不斥責人的神，主就必賜給他。
english: But if any man among you is without wisdom, let him make his request to God, who gives freely to all without an unkind word, and it will be given to him.

chinese: 只要憑著信心求，一點不疑惑；因為那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被風吹動翻騰。
english: Let him make his request in faith, doubting nothing; for he who has doubt in his heart is like the waves of the sea, which are troubled by the driving of the wind.

chinese: 這樣的人不要想從主那裡得甚麼。
english: Let it not seem to such a man that he will get anything from the Lord;

chinese: 心懷二意的人，在他一切所行的路上都沒有定見。
english: For there is a division in his mind, and he is uncertain in all his ways.

chinese: 卑微的弟兄升高，就該喜樂；
english: But let the brother of low position be glad that he is lifted up;

chinese: 富足的降卑，也該如此；因為他必要過去，如同草上的花一樣。
english: But the man of wealth, that he is made low; because like the flower of the grass he will come to his end.

chinese: 太陽出來，熱風颳起，草就枯乾，花也凋謝，美容就消沒了；那富足的人，在他所行的事上也要這樣衰殘。
english: For when the sun comes up with its burning heat, the grass gets dry and the grace of its form is gone with the falling flower; so the man of wealth comes to nothing in his ways.

chinese: 忍受試探的人是有福的，因為他經過試驗以後，必得生命的冠冕；這是主應許給那些愛他之人的。
english: There is a blessing on the man who undergoes testing; because, if he has God's approval, he will be given the crown of life, which the Lord has said he will give to those who have love for him.

chinese: 人被試探，不可說：「我是被神試探」；因為神不能被惡試探，他也不試探人。
english: Let no man say when he is tested, I am tested by God; for it is not possible for God to be tested by evil, and he himself puts no man to such a test:

chinese: 但各人被試探，乃是被自己的私慾牽引誘惑的。
english: But every man is tested when he is turned out of the right way by the attraction of his desire.

chinese: 私慾既懷了胎，就生出罪來；罪既長成，就生出死來。
english: Then when its time comes, desire gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is of full growth, gives birth to death.

chinese: 我親愛的弟兄們，不要看錯了。
english: Do not be turned from the right way, dear brothers.

chinese: 各樣美善的恩賜和各樣全備的賞賜都是從上頭來的，從眾光之父那裡降下來的；在他並沒有改變，也沒有轉動的影兒。
english: Every good and true thing is given to us from heaven, coming from the Father of lights, with whom there is no change or any shade made by turning.

chinese: 他按自己的旨意，用真道生了我們，叫我們在他所造的萬物中好像初熟的果子。
english: Of his purpose he gave us being, by his true word, so that we might be, in a sense, the first-fruits of all the things which he had made.

chinese: 我親愛的弟兄們，這是你們所知道的，但你們各人要快快的聽，慢慢的說，慢慢的動怒，
english: You have knowledge of this, dear brothers. But let every man be quick in hearing, slow in words, slow to get angry;

chinese: 因為人的怒氣並不成就神的義。
english: For the righteousness of God does not come about by the wrath of man.

chinese: 所以，你們要脫去一切的污穢和盈餘的邪惡，存溫柔的心領受那所栽種的道，就是能救你們靈魂的道。
english: For this reason, putting away all dirty behaviour and the overweight of evil, take into your souls without pride the word which, being planted there, is able to give you salvation.

chinese: 只是你們要行道，不要單單聽道，自己欺哄自己。
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers of it, blinding yourselves with false ideas.

chinese: 因為聽道而不行道的，就像人對著鏡子看自己本來的面目，
english: Because if any man is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a glass;

chinese: 看見，走後，隨即忘了他的相貌如何。
english: For after looking at himself he goes away, and in a short time he has no memory of what he was like.

chinese: 惟有詳細察看那全備、使人自由之律法的，並且時常如此，這人既不是聽了就忘，乃是實在行出來，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
english: But he who goes on looking into the true law which makes him free, being not a hearer without memory but a doer putting it into effect, this man will have a blessing on his acts.

chinese: 若有人自以為虔誠，卻不勒住他的舌頭，反欺哄自己的心，這人的虔誠是虛的。
english: If a man seems to have religion and has no control over his tongue but lets himself be tricked by what is false, this man's religion is of no value.

chinese: 在神我們的父面前，那清潔沒有玷污的虔誠，就是看顧在患難中的孤兒寡婦，並且保守自己不沾染世俗。
english: The religion which is holy and free from evil in the eyes of our God and Father is this: to take care of children who have no fathers and of widows who are in trouble, and to keep oneself untouched by the world.

chinese: 我的弟兄們，你們信奉我們榮耀的主耶穌基督，便不可按著外貌待人。
english: My brothers, if you have the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory, do not take a man's position into account.

chinese: 若有一個人帶著金戒指，穿著華美衣服，進你們的會堂去；又有一個窮人穿著骯髒衣服也進去；
english: For if a man comes into your Synagogue in fair clothing and with a gold ring, and a poor man comes in with dirty clothing,

chinese: 你們就重看那穿華美衣服的人，說「請坐在這好位上」；又對那窮人說：「你站在那裡」，或「坐在我腳凳下邊。」
english: And you do honour to the man in fair clothing and say, Come here and take this good place; and you say to the poor man, Take up your position there, or be seated at my feet;

chinese: 這豈不是你們偏心待人，用惡意斷定人麼？
english: Is there not a division in your minds? have you not become judges with evil thoughts?

chinese: 我親愛的弟兄們，請聽，神豈不是揀選了世上的貧窮人，叫他們在信上富足，並承受他所應許給那些愛他之人的國麼？
english: Give ear, my dear brothers; are not those who are poor in the things of this world marked out by God to have faith as their wealth, and for their heritage the kingdom which he has said he will give to those who have love for him?

chinese: 你們反倒羞辱貧窮人。那富足人豈不是欺壓你們、拉你們到公堂去麼？
english: But you have put the poor man to shame. Are not the men of wealth rulers over you? do they not take you by force before their judges?

chinese: 他們不是褻瀆你們所敬奉（所敬奉：或作被稱）的尊名麼？
english: Do they not say evil of the holy name which was given to you?

chinese: 經上記著說：「要愛人如己。」你們若全守這至尊的律法，才是好的。
english: But if you keep the greatest law of all, as it is given in the holy Writings, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself, you do well:

chinese: 但你們若按外貌待人，便是犯罪，被律法定為犯法的。
english: But if you take a man's position into account, you do evil, and are judged as evil-doers by the law.

chinese: 因為凡遵守全律法的，只在一條上跌倒，他就是犯了眾條。
