english: For anyone who keeps all the law, but makes a slip in one point, is judged to have gone against it all.

chinese: 原來那說「不可姦淫」的，也說「不可殺人」；你就是不姦淫，卻殺人，仍是成了犯律法的。
english: For he who said, Do not be untrue in married life, is the same who said, Put no man to death. Now if you are not untrue in married life, but you put a man to death, the law is broken.

chinese: 你們既然要按使人自由的律法受審判，就該照這律法說話行事。
english: Let your words and your acts be those of men who are to be judged by the law which makes free.

chinese: 因為那不憐憫人的，也要受無憐憫的審判；憐憫原是向審判誇勝。
english: For the man who has had no mercy will be judged without mercy, but mercy takes pride in overcoming judging.

chinese: 我的弟兄們，若有人說自己有信心，卻沒有行為，有甚麼益處呢？這信心能救他麼？
english: What use is it, my brothers, for a man to say that he has faith, if he does nothing? will such a faith give him salvation?

chinese: 若是弟兄或是姐妹，赤身露體，又缺了日用的飲食；
english: If a brother or a sister is without clothing and in need of the day's food,

chinese: 你們中間有人對他們說：「平平安安的去罷！願你們穿得暖，吃得飽」；卻不給他們身體所需用的，這有甚麼益處呢？
english: And one of you says to them, Go in peace, be warm and full of food; but you do not give them the things of which their bodies have need, what profit is there in this?

chinese: 這樣，信心若沒有行為就是死的。
english: Even so faith without works is dead.

chinese: 必有人說：「你有信心，我有行為；你將你沒有行為的信心指給我看，我便藉著我的行為，將我的信心指給你看。」
english: But a man may say, You have faith and I have works; let me see your faith without your works, and I will make my faith clear to you by my works.

chinese: 你信神只有一位，你信的不錯；鬼魔也信，卻是戰驚。
english: You have the belief that God is one, and you do well: the evil spirits have the same belief, shaking with fear.

chinese: 虛浮的人哪，你願意知道沒有行為的信心是死的麼？
english: Do you not see, O foolish man, that faith without works is of no use?

chinese: 我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕把他兒子以撒獻在壇上，豈不是因行為稱義麼？
english: Was not the righteousness of Abraham our father judged by his works, when he made an offering of Isaac his son on the altar?

chinese: 可見，信心是與他的行為並行，而且信心因著行為才得成全。
english: You see that his faith was helping his works and was made complete by them;

chinese: 這就應驗經上所說：「亞伯拉罕信神，這就算為他的義。」他又得稱為神的朋友。
english: And the holy Writings were put into effect which said, And Abraham had faith in God and it was put to his account as righteousness; and he was named the friend of God.

chinese: 這樣看來，人稱義是因著行為，不是單因著信。
english: You see that a man's righteousness is judged by his works and not by his faith only.

chinese: 妓女喇合接待使者，又放他們從別的路上出去，不也是一樣因行為稱義麼？
english: And in the same way, was not the righteousness of Rahab, the loose woman, judged by her works, when she took into her house those who were sent and let them go out by another way?

chinese: 身體沒有靈魂是死的，信心沒有行為也是死的。
english: For as the body without the spirit is dead even so faith without works is dead.

chinese: 我的弟兄們，不要多人作師傅，因為曉得我們要受更重的判斷。
english: Do not all be teachers, my brothers, because we teachers will be judged more hardly than others.

chinese: 原來我們在許多事上都有過失；若有人在話語上沒有過失，他就是完全人，也能勒住自己的全身。
english: For we all go wrong in a number of things. If a man never makes a slip in his talk, then he is a complete man and able to keep all his body in control.

chinese: 我們若把嚼環放在馬嘴裡，叫牠順服，就能調動牠的全身。
english: Now if we put bits of iron into horses' mouths so that they may be guided by us, we have complete control of their bodies.

chinese: 看哪，船隻雖然甚大，又被大風催逼，只用小小的舵，就隨著掌舵的意思轉動。
english: And again ships, though they are so great and are moved by violent winds, are turned by a very small guiding-blade, at the impulse of the man who is using it.

chinese: 這樣，舌頭在百體裡也是最小的，卻能說大話。看哪，最小的火能點著最大的樹林。
english: Even so the tongue is a small part of the body, but it takes credit for great things. How much wood may be lighted by a very little fire!

chinese: 舌頭就是火，在我們百體中，舌頭是個罪惡的世界，能污穢全身，也能把生命的輪子點起來，並且是從地獄裡點著的。
english: And the tongue is a fire; it is the power of evil placed in our bodies, making all the body unclean, putting the wheel of life on fire, and getting its fire from hell.

chinese: 各類的走獸、飛禽、昆蟲，水族，本來都可以制伏，也已經被人制伏了；
english: For every sort of beast and bird and every living thing on earth and in the sea has been controlled by man and is under his authority;

chinese: 惟獨舌頭沒有人能制伏，是不止息的惡物，滿了害死人的毒氣。
english: But the tongue may not be controlled by man; it is an unresting evil, it is full of the poison of death.

chinese: 我們用舌頭頌讚那為主、為父的，又用舌頭咒詛那照著神形像被造的人。
english: With it we give praise to our Lord and Father; and with it we put a curse on men who are made in God's image.

chinese: 頌讚和咒詛從一個口裡出來！我的弟兄們，這是不應當的！
english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, it is not right for these things to be so.

chinese: 泉源從一個眼裡能發出甜苦兩樣的水麼？
english: Does the fountain send from the same outlet sweet and bitter water?

chinese: 我的弟兄們，無花果樹能生橄欖麼？葡萄樹能結無花果麼？鹹水裡也不能發出甜水來。
english: Is a fig-tree able to give us olives, my brothers, or do we get figs from a vine, or sweet water from the salt sea?

chinese: 你們中間誰是有智慧有見識的呢？他就當在智慧的溫柔上顯出他的善行來。
english: Who has wisdom and good sense among you? let him make his works clear by a life of gentle wisdom.

chinese: 你們心裡若懷著苦毒的嫉妒和分爭，就不可自誇，也不可說謊話抵擋真道。
english: But if you have bitter envy in your heart and the desire to get the better of others, have no pride in this, talking falsely against what is true.

chinese: 這樣的智慧不是從上頭來的，乃是屬地的，屬情慾的，屬鬼魔的。
english: This wisdom is not from heaven, but is of the earth and the flesh and the Evil One.

chinese: 在何處有嫉妒、分爭，就在何處有擾亂和各樣的壞事。
english: For where envy is, and the desire to get the better of others, there is no order, but every sort of evil-doing.

chinese: 惟獨從上頭來的智慧，先是清潔，後是和平，溫良柔順，滿有憐憫，多結善果，沒有偏見，沒有假冒。
english: But the wisdom which is from heaven is first holy, then gentle, readily giving way in argument, full of peace and mercy and good works, not doubting, not seeming other than it is.

chinese: 並且使人和平的，是用和平所栽種的義果。
english: And the fruit of righteousness is planted in peace for those who make peace.

chinese: 你們中間的爭戰鬥毆是從那裡來的呢？不是從你們百體中戰鬥之私慾來的麼？
english: What is the cause of wars and fighting among you? is it not in your desires which are at war in your bodies?

chinese: 你們貪戀，還是得不著；你們殺害嫉妒，又鬥毆爭戰，也不能得。你們得不著，是因為你們不求。
english: You are burning with desire, and have not your desire, so you put men to death; you are full of envy, and you are not able to get your desire, so you are fighting and making war; you have not your desire, because you do not make request for it.

chinese: 你們求也得不著，是因為你們妄求，要浪費在你們的宴樂中。
english: You make your request but you do not get it, because your request has been wrongly made, desiring the thing only so that you may make use of it for your pleasure.

chinese: 你們這些淫亂的人（原文是淫婦）哪，豈不知與世俗為友就是與神為敵麼？所以凡想要與世俗為友的，就是與神為敵了。
english: O you who are false to God, do you not see that the friends of this world are not God's friends? Every man desiring to be a friend of this world makes himself a hater of God.

chinese: 你們想經上所說是徒然的麼？神所賜、住在我們裡面的靈，是戀愛至於嫉妒麼？
english: Or does it seem to you that it is for nothing that the holy Writings say, The spirit which God put into our hearts has a strong desire for us?

chinese: 但他賜更多的恩典，所以經上說：神阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
english: But he gives more grace. So that the Writings say, God is against the men of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low before him.

chinese: 故此，你們要順服神。務要抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就必離開你們逃跑了。
english: For this cause be ruled by God; but make war on the Evil One and he will be put to flight before you.

chinese: 你們親近神，神就必親近你們。有罪的人哪，要潔淨你們的手！心懷二意的人哪，要清潔你們的心！
english: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Make your hands clean, you evil-doers; put away deceit from your hearts, you false in mind.

chinese: 你們要愁苦、悲哀、哭泣，將喜笑變作悲哀，歡樂變作愁悶。
english: Be troubled, with sorrow and weeping; let your laughing be turned to sorrow and your joy to grief.

chinese: 務要在主面前自卑，主就必叫你們升高。
english: Make yourselves low in the eyes of the Lord and you will be lifted up by him.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們不可彼此批評。人若批評弟兄，論斷弟兄，就是批評律法，論斷律法。你若論斷律法，就不是遵行律法，乃是判斷人的。
english: Do not say evil against one another, my brothers. He who says evil against his brother or makes himself his brother's judge, says evil against the law and is judging the law: and in judging the law you become, not a doer of the law but a judge.

chinese: 設立律法和判斷人的，只有一位，就是那能救人也能滅人的。你是誰，竟敢論斷別人呢？
english: There is only one judge and law-giver, even he who has the power of salvation and of destruction; but who are you to be your neighbour's judge?

chinese: 嗐！你們有話說：「今天明天我們要往某城裡去，在那裡住一年，做買賣得利。」
english: How foolish it is to say, Today or tomorrow we will go into this town, and be there for a year and do business there and get wealth:

chinese: 其實明天如何，你們還不知道。你們的生命是甚麼呢？你們原來是一片雲霧，出現少時就不見了。
english: When you are not certain what will take place tomorrow. What is your life? It is a mist, which is seen for a little time and then is gone.

chinese: 你們只當說：「主若願意，我們就可以活著，也可以做這事，或做那事。」
english: But the right thing to say would be, If it is the Lord's pleasure and if we are still living, we will do this and that.

chinese: 現今你們竟以張狂誇口；凡這樣誇口都是惡的。
english: But now you go on glorying in your pride: and all such glorying is evil.

chinese: 人若知道行善，卻不去行，這就是他的罪了。
english: The man who has knowledge of how to do good and does not do it, to him it is sin.

chinese: 嗐！你們這些富足人哪，應當哭泣、號咷，因為將有苦難臨到你們身上。
english: Come now, you men of wealth, give yourselves to weeping and crying because of the bitter troubles which are coming to you.

chinese: 你們的財物壞了，衣服也被蟲子咬了。
english: Your wealth is unclean and insects have made holes in your clothing.

chinese: 你們的金銀都長了�；那�要證明你們的不是，又要吃你們的肉，如同火燒。你們在這末世只知積儹錢財。
english: Your gold and your silver are wasted and their waste will be a witness against you, burning into your flesh. You have put by your store in the last days.

chinese: 工人給你們收割莊稼，你們虧欠他們的工錢，這工錢有聲音呼叫，並且那收割之人的冤聲已經入了萬軍之主的耳了。
english: See, the money which you falsely kept back from the workers cutting the grass in your field, is crying out against you; and the cries of those who took in your grain have come to the ears of the Lord of armies.

chinese: 你們在世上享美福，好宴樂，當宰殺的日子竟嬌養你們的心。
english: You have been living delicately on earth and have taken your pleasure; you have made your hearts fat for a day of destruction.

chinese: 你們定了義人的罪，把他殺害，他也不抵擋你們。
english: You have given your decision against the upright man and have put him to death. He puts up no fight against you.

chinese: 弟兄們哪，你們要忍耐，直到主來。看哪，農夫忍耐等候地裡寶貴的出產，直到得了秋雨春雨。
english: Go on waiting calmly, my brothers, till the coming of the Lord, like the farmer waiting for the good fruit of the earth till the early and late rains have come.

chinese: 你們也當忍耐，堅固你們的心，因為主來的日子近了。
english: Be as calm in your waiting; let your hearts be strong: because the coming of the Lord is near.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們不要彼此埋怨，免得受審判。看哪，審判的主站在門前了。
english: Say no hard things against one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged; see, the judge is waiting at the doors.

chinese: 弟兄們，你們要把那先前奉主名說話的眾先知當作能受苦能忍耐的榜樣。
english: Take as an example of pain nobly undergone and of strength in trouble, the prophets who gave to men the words of the Lord.

chinese: 那先前忍耐的人，我們稱他們是有福的。你們聽見過約伯的忍耐，也知道主給他的結局，明顯主是滿心憐憫，大有慈悲。
english: We say that those men who have gone through pain are happy: you have the story of Job and the troubles through which he went and have seen that the Lord was full of pity and mercy in the end.

chinese: 我的弟兄們，最要緊的是不可起誓；不可指著天起誓，也不可指著地起誓，無論何誓都不可起。你們說話，是，就說是；不是，就說不是，免得你們落在審判之下。
english: But most of all, my brothers, do not take oaths, not by the heaven, or by the earth, or by any other thing: but let your Yes be Yes, and your No be No: so that you may not be judged.

chinese: 你們中間有受苦的呢，他就該禱告；有喜樂的呢，他就該歌頌。
english: Is anyone among you in trouble? let him say prayers. Is anyone glad? let him make a song of praise.

chinese: 你們中間有病了的呢，他就該請教會的長老來；他們可以奉主的名用油抹他，為他禱告。
english: Is anyone among you ill? let him send for the rulers of the church; and let them say prayers over him, putting oil on him in the name of the Lord.

chinese: 出於信心的祈禱要救那病人，主必叫他起來；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
english: And by the prayer of faith the man who is ill will be made well, and he will be lifted up by the Lord, and for any sin which he has done he will have forgiveness.

chinese: 所以你們要彼此認罪，互相代求，使你們可以得醫治。義人祈禱所發的力量是大有功效的。
english: So then, make a statement of your sins to one another, and say prayers for one another so that you may be made well. The prayer of a good man is full of power in its working.

chinese: 以利亞與我們是一樣性情的人，他懇切禱告，求不要下雨，雨就三年零六個月不下在地上。
english: Elijah was a man of flesh and blood as we are, and he made a strong prayer that there might be no rain; and there was no rain on the earth for three years and six months.

chinese: 他又禱告，天就降下雨來，地也生出土產。
english: And he made another prayer, and the heaven sent down rain and the earth gave her fruit.

chinese: 我的弟兄們，你們中間若有失迷真道的，有人使他回轉，
english: My brothers, if one of you has gone out of the way of the true faith and another has made him see his error,

chinese: 這人該知道：叫一個罪人從迷路上轉回便是救一個靈魂不死，並且遮蓋許多的罪。
english: Be certain that he through whom a sinner has been turned from the error of his way, keeps a soul from death and is the cause of forgiveness for sins without number.

chinese: 耶穌基督的使徒彼得寫信給那分散在本都、加拉太、加帕多家、亞西亞、庇推尼寄居的，
english: Peter, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, to the saints who are living in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

chinese: 就是照父神的先見被揀選，藉著聖靈得成聖潔，以致順服耶穌基督，又蒙他血所灑的人。願恩惠、平安多多的加給你們。
english: Who, through the purpose of God, have been made holy by the Spirit, disciples of Jesus, made clean by his blood: May you have grace and peace in full measure.

chinese: 願頌讚歸與我們主耶穌基督的父神！他曾照自己的大憐憫，藉耶穌基督從死裡復活，重生了我們，叫我們有活潑的盼望，
english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who through his great mercy has given us a new birth and a living hope by the coming again of Jesus Christ from the dead,

chinese: 可以得著不能朽壞、不能玷污、不能衰殘、為你們存留在天上的基業。
english: And a heritage fair, holy and for ever new, waiting in heaven for you,

chinese: 你們這因信蒙神能力保守的人，必能得著所預備、到末世要顯現的救恩。
english: Who, by the power of God are kept, through faith, for that salvation, which will be seen at the last day.

chinese: 因此，你們是大有喜樂；但如今，在百般的試煉中暫時憂愁，
english: You have cause for great joy in this, though it may have been necessary for you to be troubled for a little time, being tested in all sorts of ways,

chinese: 叫你們的信心既被試驗，就比那被火試驗仍然能壞的金子更顯寶貴，可以在耶穌基督顯現的時候得著稱讚、榮耀、尊貴。
english: So that the true metal of your faith, being of much greater value than gold (which, though it comes to an end, is tested by fire), may come to light in praise and glory and honour, at the revelation of Jesus Christ:

chinese: 你們雖然沒有見過他，卻是愛他；如今雖不得看見，卻因信他就有說不出來、滿有榮光的大喜樂；
english: To whom your love is given, though you have not seen him; and the faith which you have in him, though you do not see him now, gives you joy greater than words and full of glory:

chinese: 並且得著你們信心的果效，就是靈魂的救恩。
english: For so you have the true end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

chinese: 論到這救恩，那預先說你們要得恩典的眾先知早已詳細的尋求考察，
english: For the prophets who gave the news of the grace which would come to you, made search with all care for knowledge of this salvation;

chinese: 就是考察在他們心裡基督的靈，預先證明基督受苦難，後來得榮耀，是指著甚麼時候，並怎樣的時候。
english: Attempting to see what sort of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them was pointing to, when it gave witness to the pains which Christ would undergo and the glories which would come after them.

chinese: 他們得了啟示，知道他們所傳講（原文是服事）的一切事，不是為自己，乃是為你們。那靠著從天上差來的聖靈傳福音給你們的人，現在將這些事報給你們；天使也願意詳細察看這些事。
english: And it was made clear to those prophets that they were God's servants not for themselves but for you, to give you word of the things which have now come to your ears from the preachers of the good news through the Holy Spirit sent down from heaven; things which even angels have a desire to see.

chinese: 所以要約束你們的心，（原文是束上你們心中的腰），謹慎自守，專心盼望耶穌基督顯現的時候所帶來給你們的恩。
english: So make your minds ready, and keep on the watch, hoping with all your power for the grace which is to come to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

chinese: 你們既作順命的兒女，就不要效法從前蒙昧無知的時候那放縱私慾的樣子。
english: Like children ruled by God, do not go back to the old desires of the time when you were without knowledge:

chinese: 那召你們的既是聖潔，你們在一切所行的事上也要聖潔。
english: But be holy in every detail of your lives, as he, whose servants you are, is holy;

chinese: 因為經上記著說：「你們要聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。」
english: Because it has been said in the Writings, You are to be holy, for I am holy.

chinese: 你們既稱那不偏待人、按各人行為審判人的主為父，就當存敬畏的心度你們在世寄居的日子，
english: And if you give the name of Father to him who, judging every man by his acts, has no respect for a man's position, then go in fear while you are on this earth:

chinese: 知道你們得贖，脫去你們祖宗所傳流虛妄的行為，不是憑著能壞的金銀等物，
english: Being conscious that you have been made free from that foolish way of life which was your heritage from your fathers, not through a payment of things like silver or gold which come to destruction,

chinese: 乃是憑著基督的寶血，如同無瑕疵、無玷污的羔羊之血。
english: But through holy blood, like that of a clean and unmarked lamb, even the blood of Christ:

chinese: 基督在創世以前是預先被神知道的，卻在這末世才為你們顯現。
english: Who was marked out by God before the making of the world, but was caused to be seen in these last times for you,

chinese: 你們也因著他，信那叫他從死裡復活、又給他榮耀的神，叫你們的信心和盼望都在於神。
english: Who through him have faith in God who took him up again from the dead into glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

chinese: 你們既因順從真理，潔淨了自己的心，以致愛弟兄沒有虛假，就當從心裡（從心裡：有古卷是從清潔的心）彼此切實相愛。
english: And as you have made your souls clean, being ruled by what is true, and loving one another without deceit, see that your love is warm and from the heart:

chinese: 你們蒙了重生，不是由於能壞的種子，乃是由於不能壞的種子，是藉著神活潑常存的道。
english: Because you have had a new birth, not from the seed of man, but from eternal seed, through the word of a living and unchanging God.

chinese: 因為凡有血氣的，盡都如草；他的美榮都像草上的花。草必枯乾，花必凋謝；
english: For it is said, All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flower of the grass. The grass becomes dry and the flower dead:

chinese: 惟有主的道是永存的。所傳給你們的福音就是這道。
english: But the word of the Lord is eternal. And this is the word of the good news which was given to you.

chinese: 所以，你們既除去一切的惡毒（或譯：陰毒）、詭詐，並假善、嫉妒，和一切毀謗的話，
english: So putting away all wrongdoing, and all tricks and deceits and envies and evil talk,

chinese: 就要愛慕那純淨的靈奶，像才生的嬰孩愛慕奶一樣，叫你們因此漸長，以致得救。
english: Be full of desire for the true milk of the word, as babies at their mothers' breasts, so that you may go on to salvation;

chinese: 你們若嘗過主恩的滋味，就必如此。
english: If you have had a taste of the grace of the Lord:

chinese: 主乃活石，固然是被人所棄的，卻是被神所揀選、所寶貴的。
english: To whom you come, as to a living stone, not honoured by men, but of great and special value to God;

chinese: 你們來到主面前，也就像活石，被建造成為靈宮，作聖潔的祭司，藉著耶穌基督奉獻神所悅納的靈祭。
english: You, as living stones, are being made into a house of the spirit, a holy order of priests, making those offerings of the spirit which are pleasing to God through Jesus Christ.

chinese: 因為經上說：看哪，我把所揀選、所寶貴的房角石安放在錫安；信靠他的人必不至於羞愧。
english: Because it is said in the Writings, See, I am placing a keystone in Zion, of great and special value; and the man who has faith in him will not be put to shame.

chinese: 所以，他在你們信的人就為寶貴，在那不信的人有話說：匠人所棄的石頭已作了房角的頭塊石頭。
english: And the value is for you who have faith; but it is said for those without faith, The very stone which the builders put on one side, was made the chief stone of the building;

chinese: 又說：作了絆腳的石頭，跌人的磐石。他們既不順從，就在道理上絆跌（或譯：他們絆跌都因不順從道理）；他們這樣絆跌也是預定的。
english: And, A stone of falling, a rock of trouble; the word is the cause of their fall, because they go against it, and this was the purpose of God.

chinese: 惟有你們是被揀選的族類，是有君尊的祭司，是聖潔的國度，是屬神的子民，要叫你們宣揚那召你們出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。
english: But you are a special people, a holy nation, priests and kings, a people given up completely to God, so that you may make clear the virtues of him who took you out of the dark into the light of heaven.

chinese: 你們從前算不得子民，現在卻作了神的子民；從前未曾蒙憐恤，現在卻蒙了憐恤。
english: In the past you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; then there was no mercy for you, but now mercy has been given to you.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，你們是客旅，是寄居的。我勸你們要禁戒肉體的私慾；這私慾是與靈魂爭戰的。
english: My loved ones, I make this request with all my heart, that, as those for whom this world is a strange country, you will keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh which make war against the soul;

chinese: 你們在外邦人中，應當品行端正，叫那些毀謗你們是作惡的，因看見你們的好行為，便在鑒察（或作：眷顧）的日子歸榮耀給神。
english: Being of good behaviour among the Gentiles; so that though they say now that you are evil-doers, they may see your good works and give glory to God when he comes to be their judge.

chinese: 你們為主的緣故，要順服人的一切制度，或是在上的君王，
english: Keep all the laws of men because of the Lord; those of the king, who is over all,

chinese: 或是君王所派罰惡賞善的臣宰。
english: And those of the rulers who are sent by him for the punishment of evil-doers and for the praise of those who do well.

chinese: 因為神的旨意原是要你們行善，可以堵住那糊塗無知人的口。
english: Because it is God's pleasure that foolish and narrow-minded men may be put to shame by your good behaviour:

chinese: 你們雖是自由的，卻不可藉著自由遮蓋惡毒（或譯：陰毒），總要作神的僕人。
english: As those who are free, not using your free position as a cover for wrongdoing, but living as the servants of God;

chinese: 務要尊敬眾人，親愛教中的弟兄，敬畏神，尊敬君王。
english: Have respect for all, loving the brothers, fearing God, honouring the king.

chinese: 你們作僕人的，凡事要存敬畏的心順服主人；不但順服那善良溫和的，就是那乖僻的也要順服。
english: Servants, take orders from your masters with all respect; not only if they are good and gentle, but even if they are bad-humoured.

chinese: 倘若人為叫良心對得住神，就忍受冤屈的苦楚，這是可喜愛的。
english: For it is a sign of grace if a man, desiring to do right in the eyes of God, undergoes pain as punishment for something which he has not done.

chinese: 你們若因犯罪受責打，能忍耐，有甚麼可誇的呢？但你們若因行善受苦，能忍耐，這在神看是可喜愛的。
english: What credit is it if, when you have done evil, you take your punishment quietly? but if you are given punishment for doing right, and take it quietly, this is pleasing to God.

chinese: 你們蒙召原是為此；因基督也為你們受過苦，給你們留下榜樣，叫你們跟隨他的腳蹤行。
english: This is God's purpose for you: because Jesus himself underwent punishment for you, giving you an example, so that you might go in his footsteps:

chinese: 他並沒有犯罪，口裡也沒有詭詐。
english: Who did no evil, and there was no deceit in his mouth:

chinese: 他被罵不還口；受害不說威嚇的話，只將自己交託那按公義審判人的主。
english: To sharp words he gave no sharp answer; when he was undergoing pain, no angry word came from his lips; but he put himself into the hands of the judge of righteousness:

chinese: 他被掛在木頭上，親身擔當了我們的罪，使我們既然在罪上死，就得以在義上活。因他受的鞭傷，你們便得了醫治。
english: He took our sins on himself, giving his body to be nailed on the tree, so that we, being dead to sin, might have a new life in righteousness, and by his wounds we have been made well.

chinese: 你們從前好像迷路的羊，如今卻歸到你們靈魂的牧人監督了。
english: Because, like sheep, you had gone out of the way; but now you have come back to him who keeps watch over your souls.

chinese: 你們作妻子的要順服自己的丈夫；這樣，若有不信從道理的丈夫，他們雖然不聽道，也可以因妻子的品行被感化過來；
english: Wives, be ruled by your husbands; so that even if some of them give no attention to the word, their hearts may be changed by the behaviour of their wives,

chinese: 這正是因看見你們有貞潔的品行和敬畏的心。
english: When they see your holy behaviour in the fear of God.

chinese: 你們不要以外面的辮頭髮，戴金飾，穿美衣為妝飾，
english: Do not let your ornaments be those of the body such as dressing of the hair, or putting on of jewels of gold or fair clothing;

chinese: 只要以裡面存著長久溫柔、安靜的心為妝飾；這在神面前是極寶貴的。
english: But let them be those of the unseen man of the heart, the ever-shining ornament of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great price in the eyes of God.

chinese: 因為古時仰賴神的聖潔婦人正是以此為妝飾，順服自己的丈夫，
english: And these were the ornaments of the holy women of the past, whose hope was in God, being ruled by their husbands:

chinese: 就如撒拉聽從亞伯拉罕，稱他為主。你們若行善，不因恐嚇而害怕，便是撒拉的女兒了。
english: As Sarah was ruled by Abraham, naming him lord; whose children you are if you do well, and are not put in fear by any danger.

chinese: 你們作丈夫的，也要按情理（原文是知識）和妻子同住；因他比你軟弱（比你軟弱：原文作是軟弱的器皿），與你一同承受生命之恩的，所以要敬重他。這樣，便叫你們的禱告沒有阻礙。
english: And you husbands, give thought to your way of life with your wives, giving honour to the woman who is the feebler vessel, but who has an equal part in the heritage of the grace of life; so that you may not be kept from prayer.

chinese: 總而言之，你們都要同心，彼此體恤，相愛如弟兄，存慈憐謙卑的心。
english: Last of all, see that you are all in agreement; feeling for one another, loving one another like brothers, full of pity, without pride:

chinese: 不以惡報惡，以辱罵還辱罵，倒要祝福；因你們是為此蒙召，好叫你們承受福氣。
english: Not giving back evil for evil, or curse for curse, but in place of cursing, blessing; because this is the purpose of God for you that you may have a heritage of blessing.

chinese: 因為經上說：人若愛生命，願享美福，須要禁止舌頭不出惡言，嘴唇不說詭詐的話；
english: For it is said, Let the man who has a love of life, desiring to see good days, keep his tongue from evil and his lips from words of deceit:

chinese: 也要離惡行善，尋求和睦，一心追趕。
english: And let him be turned from evil and do good; searching for peace and going after it with all his heart.

chinese: 因為，主的眼看顧義人；主的耳聽他們的祈禱。惟有行惡的人，主向他們變臉。
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the upright, and his ears are open to their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.

chinese: 你們若是熱心行善，有誰害你們呢？
english: Who will do you any damage if you keep your minds fixed on what is good?

chinese: 你們就是為義受苦，也是有福的。不要怕人的威嚇（的威嚇：或譯所怕的），也不要驚慌；
english: But you are happy if you undergo pain because of righteousness; have no part in their fear and do not be troubled;

chinese: 只要心裡尊主基督為聖。有人問你們心中盼望的緣由，就要常作準備，以溫柔、敬畏的心回答各人；
english: But give honour to Christ in your hearts as your Lord; and be ready at any time when you are questioned about the hope which is in you, to give an answer in the fear of the Lord and without pride;

chinese: 存著無虧的良心，叫你們在何事上被毀謗，就在何事上可以叫那誣賴你們在基督裡有好品行的人自覺羞愧。
english: Being conscious that you have done no wrong; so that those who say evil things about your good way of life as Christians may be put to shame.

chinese: 神的旨意若是叫你們因行善受苦，總強如因行惡受苦。
english: Because if it is God's purpose for you to undergo pain, it is better to do so for well-doing than for evil-doing.

chinese: 因基督也曾一次為罪受苦（有古卷作：受死），就是義的代替不義的，為要引我們到神面前。按著肉體說，他被治死；按著靈性說，他復活了。
english: Because Christ once went through pain for sins, the upright one taking the place of sinners, so that through him we might come back to God; being put to death in the flesh, but given life in the Spirit;

chinese: 他藉這靈曾去傳道給那些在監獄裡的靈聽，
english: By whom he went to the spirits in prison, preaching to those

chinese: 就是那從前在挪亞預備方舟、神容忍等待的時候，不信從的人。當時進入方舟，藉著水得救的不多，只有八個人。
english: Who, in the days of Noah, went against God's orders; but God in his mercy kept back the punishment, while Noah got ready the ark, in which a small number, that is to say eight persons, got salvation through water:

chinese: 這水所表明的洗禮，現在藉著耶穌基督復活也拯救你們；這洗禮本不在乎除掉肉體的污穢，只求在神面前有無虧的良心。
english: And baptism, of which this is an image, now gives you salvation, not by washing clean the flesh, but by making you free from the sense of sin before God, through the coming again of Jesus Christ from the dead;

chinese: 耶穌已經進入天堂，在神的右邊；眾天使和有權柄的，並有能力的，都服從了他。
english: Who has gone into heaven, and is at the right hand of God, angels and authorities and powers having been put under his rule.

chinese: 基督既在肉身受苦，你們也當將這樣的心志作為兵器，因為在肉身受過苦的，就已經與罪斷絕了。
english: So that as Jesus was put to death in the flesh, do you yourselves be of the same mind; for the death of the flesh puts an end to sin;

chinese: 你們存這樣的心，從今以後就可以不從人的情慾，只從神的旨意在世度餘下的光陰。
english: So that you may give the rest of your lives in the flesh, not to the desires of men, but to the purpose of God.

chinese: 因為往日隨從外邦人的心意行邪淫、惡慾、醉酒、荒宴、群飲，並可惡拜偶像的事，時候已經夠了。
english: Because for long enough, in times past, we have been living after the way of the Gentiles, given up to the desires of the flesh, to drinking and feasting and loose behaviour and unclean worship of images;

chinese: 他們在這些事上，見你們不與他們同奔那放蕩無度的路，就以為怪，毀謗你們。
english: And they are wondering that you no longer go with them in this violent wasting of life, and are saying evil things of you:

chinese: 他們必在那將要審判活人死人的主面前交賬。
english: But they will have to give an account of themselves to him who is ready to be the judge of the living and the dead.

chinese: 為此，就是死人也曾有福音傳給他們，要叫他們的肉體按著人受審判，他們的靈性卻靠神活著。
english: For this was the reason why the good news of Jesus was given even to the dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but might be living before God in the spirit.

chinese: 萬物的結局近了。所以，你們要謹慎自守，儆醒禱告。
english: But the end of all things is near: so be serious in your behaviour and keep on the watch with prayer;

chinese: 最要緊的是彼此切實相愛，因為愛能遮掩許多的罪。
english: And most of all be warm in your love for one another; because in love there is forgiveness for sins without number:

chinese: 你們要互相款待，不發怨言。
english: Keep open house for all with a glad heart;

chinese: 各人要照所得的恩賜彼此服事，作神百般恩賜的好管家。
english: Making distribution among one another of whatever has been given to you, like true servants of the unmeasured grace of God;

chinese: 若有講道的，要按著神的聖言講；若有服事人的，要按著神所賜的力量服事，叫神在凡事上因耶穌基督得榮耀。原來榮耀、權能都是他的，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
english: If anyone has anything to say, let it be as the words of God; if anyone has the desire to be the servant of others, let him do it in the strength which is given by God; so that in all things God may have the glory through Jesus Christ, whose are the glory and the power for ever.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，有火煉的試驗臨到你們，不要以為奇怪（似乎是遭遇非常的事），
english: Dear brothers, do not be surprised, as if it was something strange, if your faith is tested as by fire:

chinese: 倒要歡喜；因為你們是與基督一同受苦，使你們在他榮耀顯現的時候，也可以歡喜快樂。
english: But be glad that you are given a part in the pains of Christ; so that at the revelation of his glory you may have great joy.

chinese: 你們若為基督的名受辱罵，便是有福的；因為神榮耀的靈常住在你們身上。
english: If men say evil things of you because of the name of Christ, happy are you; for the Spirit of glory and of God is resting on you.

chinese: 你們中間卻不可有人因為殺人、偷竊、作惡、好管閒事而受苦。
english: Let no one among you undergo punishment as a taker of life, or as a thief, or as an evil-doer, or as one who is over-interested in other men's business;

chinese: 若為作基督徒受苦，卻不要羞恥，倒要因這名歸榮耀給神。
english: But if he undergoes punishment as a Christian, that is no shame to him; let him give glory to God in this name.

chinese: 因為時候到了，審判要從神的家起首。若是先從我們起首，那不信從神福音的人將有何等的結局呢？
english: For the time has come for the judging, starting with the church of God; but if it makes a start with us, what will be the end of those who are not under the rule of God?

chinese: 若是義人僅僅得救，那不虔敬和犯罪的人將有何地可站呢？
english: And if it is hard for even the good man to get salvation, what chance has the man without religion or the sinner?

chinese: 所以，那照神旨意受苦的人要一心為善，將自己靈魂交與那信實的造化之主。
english: For this reason let those who by the purpose of God undergo punishment, keep on in well-doing and put their souls into the safe hands of their Maker.

chinese: 我這作長老、作基督受苦的見證、同享後來所要顯現之榮耀的，勸你們中間與我同作長老的人：
english: I who am myself one of the rulers of the church, and a witness of the death of Christ, having my part in the coming glory, send this serious request to the chief men among you:

chinese: 務要牧養在你們中間神的群羊，按著神旨意照管他們；不是出於勉強，乃是出於甘心；也不是因為貪財，乃是出於樂意；
english: Keep watch over the flock of God which is in your care, using your authority, not as forced to do so, but gladly; and not for unclean profit but with a ready mind;

chinese: 也不是轄制所託付你們的，乃是作群羊的榜樣。
english: Not as lords over God's heritage, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

chinese: 到了牧長顯現的時候，你們必得那永不衰殘的榮耀冠冕。
english: And at the coming of the chief Keeper of the sheep, you will be given the eternal crown of glory.

chinese: 你們年幼的，也要順服年長的。就是你們眾人也都要以謙卑束腰，彼此順服；因為神阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
english: And in the same way, let the younger men be ruled by the older ones. Let all of you put away pride and make yourselves ready to be servants: for God is a hater of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low.

chinese: 所以，你們要自卑，服在神大能的手下，到了時候他必叫你們升高。
english: For this cause make yourselves low under the strong hand of God, so that when the time comes you may be lifted up;

chinese: 你們要將一切的憂慮卸給神，因為他顧念你們。
english: Putting all your troubles on him, for he takes care of you.

chinese: 務要謹守，儆醒。因為你們的仇敵魔鬼，如同吼叫的獅子，遍地遊行，尋找可吞吃的人。
english: Be serious and keep watch; the Evil One, who is against you, goes about like a lion with open mouth in search of food;

chinese: 你們要用堅固的信心抵擋他，因為知道你們在世上的眾弟兄也是經歷這樣的苦難。
english: Do not give way to him but be strong in your faith, in the knowledge that your brothers who are in the world undergo the same troubles.

chinese: 那賜諸般恩典的神曾在基督裡召你們，得享他永遠的榮耀，等你們暫受苦難之後，必要親自成全你們，堅固你們，賜力量給你們。
english: And after you have undergone pain for a little time, the God of all grace who has given you a part in his eternal glory through Christ Jesus, will himself give you strength and support, and make you complete in every good thing;

chinese: 願權能歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
english: His is the power for ever. So be it.

chinese: 我略略的寫了這信，託我所看為忠心的兄弟西拉轉交你們，勸勉你們，又證明這恩是神的真恩。你們務要在這恩上站立得住。
english: I have sent you this short letter by Silvanus, a true brother, in my opinion; comforting you and witnessing that this is the true grace of God; keep to it.

chinese: 在巴比倫與你們同蒙揀選的教會問你們安。我兒子馬可也問你們安。
english: She who is in Babylon, who has a part with you in the purpose of God, sends you her love; and so does my son Mark.

chinese: 你們要用愛心彼此親嘴問安。願平安歸與你們凡在基督裡的人！
english: Give one another the kiss of love. Peace be to you all in Christ.

chinese: 作耶穌基督僕人和使徒的西門。彼得寫信給那因我們的神和（有古卷沒有和字）救主耶穌基督之義，與我們同得一樣寶貴信心的人。
english: Simon Peter, a servant and Apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who with us have a part in the same holy faith in the righteousness of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ:

chinese: 願恩惠、平安，因你們認識神和我們主耶穌，多多的加給你們。
english: May grace and peace ever be increasing in you, in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;

chinese: 神的神能已將一切關乎生命和虔敬的事賜給我們，皆因我們認識那用自己榮耀和美德召我們的主。
english: Because by his power he has given us everything necessary for life and righteousness, through the knowledge of him who has been our guide by his glory and virtue;

chinese: 因此，他已將又寶貴又極大的應許賜給我們，叫我們既脫離世上從情慾來的敗壞，就得與神的性情有分。
english: And through this he has given us the hope of great rewards highly to be valued; so that by them we might have our part in God's being, and be made free from the destruction which is in the world through the desires of the flesh.

chinese: 正因這緣故，你們要分外地殷勤；有了信心，又要加上德行；有了德行，又要加上知識；
english: So, for this very cause, take every care; joining virtue to faith, and knowledge to virtue,

chinese: 有了知識，又要加上節制；有了節制，又要加上忍耐；有了忍耐，又要加上虔敬；
english: And self-control to knowledge, and a quiet mind to self-control, and fear of God to a quiet mind,

chinese: 有了虔敬，又要加上愛弟兄的心；有了愛弟兄的心，又要加上愛眾人的心；
english: And love of the brothers to fear of God, and to love of the brothers, love itself.

chinese: 你們若充充足足的有這幾樣，就必使你們在認識我們的主耶穌基督上不至於閒懶不結果子了。
english: For if you have these things in good measure, they will make you fertile and full of fruit in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 人若沒有這幾樣，就是眼瞎，只看見近處的，忘了他舊日的罪已經得了潔淨。
english: For the man who has not these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having no memory of how he was made clean from his old sins.

chinese: 所以弟兄們，應當更加殷勤，使你們所蒙的恩召和揀選堅定不移。你們若行這幾樣，就永不失腳。
english: For this reason, my brothers, take all the more care to make your selection and approval certain; for if you do these things you will never have a fall:

chinese: 這樣，必叫你們豐豐富富的得以進入我們主─救主耶穌基督永遠的國。
english: For so the way will be open to you into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

chinese: 你們雖然曉得這些事，並且在你們已有的真道上堅固，我卻要將這些事常常提醒你們。
english: For this reason I will be ready at all times to keep your memory of these things awake, though you have the knowledge of them now and are well based in your present faith.

chinese: 我以為應當趁我還在這帳棚的時候提醒你們，激發你們。
english: And it seems right to me, as long as I am in this tent of flesh, to keep your minds awake by working on your memory;

chinese: 因為知道我脫離這帳棚的時候快到了，正如我們主耶穌基督所指示我的。
english: For I am conscious that in a short time I will have to put off this tent of flesh, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

chinese: 並且，我要盡心竭力，使你們在我去世以後時常記念這些事。
english: And I will take every care so that you may have a clear memory of these things after my death.

chinese: 我們從前將我們主耶穌基督的大能和他降臨的事告訴你們，並不是隨從乖巧捏造的虛言，乃是親眼見過他的威榮。
english: For when we gave you news of the power and the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, our teaching was not based on stories put together by art, but we were eye-witnesses of his glory.

chinese: 他從父神得尊貴榮耀的時候，從極大榮光之中有聲音出來，向他說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。」
english: For God the Father gave him honour and glory, when such a voice came to him out of the great glory, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

chinese: 我們同他在聖山的時候，親自聽見這聲音從天上出來。
english: And this voice came from heaven even to our ears, when we were with him on the holy mountain.

chinese: 我們並有先知更確的預言，如同燈照在暗處。你們在這預言上留意，直等到天發亮，晨星在你們心裡出現的時候，才是好的。
english: And so the words of the prophets are made more certain; and it is well for you to give attention to them as to a light shining in a dark place, till the dawn comes and the morning star is seen in your hearts;

chinese: 第一要緊的，該知道經上所有的預言沒有可隨私意解說的；
english: Being conscious in the first place that no man by himself may give a special sense to the words of the prophets.

chinese: 因為預言從來沒有出於人意的，乃是人被聖靈感動，說出神的話來。
english: For these words did not ever come through the impulse of men: but the prophets had them from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

chinese: 從前在百姓中有假先知起來，將來在你們中間也必有假師傅，私自引進陷害人的異端，連買他們的主他們也不承認，自取速速的滅亡。
english: But there were false prophets among the people, as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly put forward wrong teachings for your destruction, even turning away from the Lord who gave himself for them; whose destruction will come quickly, and they themselves will be the cause of it.

chinese: 將有許多人隨從他們邪淫的行為，便叫真道因他們的緣故被毀謗。
english: And a great number will go with them in their evil ways, through whom the true way will have a bad name.

chinese: 他們因有貪心，要用捏造的言語在你們身上取利。他們的刑罰，自古以來並不遲延；他們的滅亡也必速速來到（原文是不打盹）。
english: And in their desire for profit they will come to you with words of deceit, like traders doing business in souls: whose punishment has been ready for a long time and their destruction is watching for them.

chinese: 就是天使犯了罪，神也沒有寬容，曾把他們丟在地獄，交在黑暗坑中，等候審判。
english: For if God did not have pity for the angels who did evil, but sent them down into hell, to be kept in chains of eternal night till they were judged;

chinese: 神也沒有寬容上古的世代，曾叫洪水臨到那不敬虔的世代，卻保護了傳義道的挪亞一家八口。
english: And did not have mercy on the world which then was, but only kept safe Noah, a preacher of righteousness, with seven others, when he let loose the waters over the world of the evil-doers;

chinese: 又判定所多瑪、蛾摩拉，將二城傾覆，焚燒成灰，作為後世不敬虔人的鑑戒；
english: And sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah, burning them up with fire as an example to those whose way of life might in the future be unpleasing to him;

chinese: 只搭救了那常為惡人淫行憂傷的義人羅得。
english: And kept safe Lot, the upright man, who was deeply troubled by the unclean life of the evil-doers

chinese: （因為那義人住在他們中間，看見聽見他們不法的事，他的義心就天天傷痛。）
english: (Because the soul of that upright man living among them was pained from day to day by seeing and hearing their crimes):

chinese: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脫離試探，把不義的人留在刑罰之下，等候審判的日子。
english: The Lord is able to keep the upright safe in the time of testing, and to keep evil-doers under punishment till the day of judging;

chinese: 那些隨肉身、縱污穢的情慾、輕慢主治之人的，更是如此。他們膽大任性，毀謗在尊位的，也不知懼怕。
english: But specially those who go after the unclean desires of the flesh, and make sport of authority. Ready to take chances, uncontrolled, they have no fear of saying evil of those in high places:

chinese: 就是天使，雖然力量權能更大，還不用毀謗的話在主面前告他們。
english: Though the angels, who are greater in strength and power, do not make use of violent language against them before the Lord.

chinese: 但這些人好像沒有靈性，生來就是畜類，以備捉拿宰殺的。他們毀謗所不曉得的事，正在敗壞人的時候，自己必遭遇敗壞。
english: But these men, like beasts without reason, whose natural use is to be taken and put to death, crying out against things of which they have no knowledge, will undergo that same destruction which they are designing for others;

chinese: 行的不義，就得了不義的工價。這些人喜愛白晝宴樂，他們已被玷污，又有瑕疵，正與你們一同坐席，就以自己的詭詐為快樂。
english: For the evil which overtakes them is the reward of their evil-doing: such men take their pleasure in the delights of the flesh even in the daytime; they are like the marks of a disease, like poisoned wounds among you, feasting together with you in joy;

chinese: 他們滿眼是淫色（原文是淫婦），止不住犯罪，引誘那心不堅固的人，心中習慣了貪婪，正是被咒詛的種類。
english: Having eyes full of evil desire, never having enough of sin; turning feeble souls out of the true way; they are children of cursing, whose hearts are well used to bitter envy;

chinese: 他們離棄正路，就走差了，隨從比珥之子巴蘭的路。巴蘭就是那貪愛不義之工價的先知，
english: Turning out of the true way, they have gone wandering in error, after the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who was pleased to take payment for wrongdoing;

chinese: 他卻為自己的過犯受了責備；那不能說話的驢以人言攔阻先知的狂妄。
english: But his wrongdoing was pointed out to him: an ass, talking with a man's voice, put a stop to the error of the prophet.

chinese: 這些人是無水的井，是狂風催逼的霧氣，有墨黑的幽暗為他們存留。
english: These are fountains without water, and mists before a driving storm; for whom the eternal night is kept in store.

chinese: 他們說虛妄矜誇的大話，用肉身的情慾和邪淫的事引誘那些剛才脫離妄行的人。
english: For with high-sounding false words, making use of the attraction of unclean desires of the flesh, they get into their power those newly made free from those who are living in error;

chinese: 他們應許人得以自由，自己卻作敗壞的奴僕，因為人被誰制伏就是誰的奴僕。
english: Saying that they will be free, while they themselves are the servants of destruction; because whatever gets the better of a man makes a servant of him.

chinese: 倘若他們因認識主─救主耶穌基督，得以脫離世上的污穢，後來又在其中被纏住、制伏，他們末後的景況就比先前更不好了。
english: For if, after they have got free from the unclean things of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again taken in the net and overcome, their last condition is worse than their first.

chinese: 他們曉得義路，竟背棄了傳給他們的聖命，倒不如不曉得為妙。
english: For it would have been better for them to have had no knowledge of the way of righteousness, than to go back again from the holy law which was given to them, after having knowledge of it.

chinese: 俗語說得真不錯：狗所吐的，他轉過來又吃；豬洗淨了又回到泥裡去輥；這話在他們身上正合式。
english: They are an example of that true saying, The dog has gone back to the food it had put out, and the pig which had been washed to its rolling in the dirty earth.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，我現在寫給你們的是第二封信。這兩封都是提醒你們，激發你們誠實的心，
english: My loved ones, this is now my second letter to you, and in this as in the first, I am attempting to keep your true minds awake;

chinese: 叫你們記念聖先知預先所說的話和主救主的命令，就是使徒所傳給你們的。
english: So that you may keep in mind the words of the holy prophets in the past, and the law of the Lord and Saviour which was given to you by his Apostles.

chinese: 第一要緊的，該知道在末世必有好譏誚的人隨從自己的私慾出來譏誚說：
english: Having first of all the knowledge that in the last days there will be men who, ruled by their evil desires, will make sport of holy things,

chinese: 「主要降臨的應許在那裡呢？因為從列祖睡了以來，萬物與起初創造的時候仍是一樣。」
english: Saying, Where is the hope of his coming? From the death of the fathers till now everything has gone on as it was from the making of the world.

chinese: 他們故意忘記，從太古，憑神的命有了天，並從水而出、藉水而成的地。
english: But in taking this view they put out of their minds the memory that in the old days there was a heaven, and an earth lifted out of the water and circled by water, by the word of God;

chinese: 故此，當時的世界被水淹沒就消滅了。
english: And that the world which then was came to an end through the overflowing of the waters.

chinese: 但現在的天地還是憑著那命存留，直留到不敬虔之人受審判遭沉淪的日子，用火焚燒。
english: But the present heaven and the present earth have been kept for destruction by fire, which is waiting for them on the day of the judging and destruction of evil men.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，有一件事你們不可忘記，就是主看一日如千年，千年如一日。
english: But, my loved ones, keep in mind this one thing, that with the Lord one day is the same as a thousand years, and a thousand years are no more than one day.

chinese: 主所應許的尚未成就，有人以為他是耽延，其實不是耽延，乃是寬容你們，不願有一人沉淪，乃願人人都悔改。
english: The Lord is not slow in keeping his word, as he seems to some, but he is waiting in mercy for you, not desiring the destruction of any, but that all may be turned from their evil ways.

chinese: 但主的日子要像賊來到一樣。那日，天必大有響聲廢去，有形質的都要被烈火銷化，地和其上的物都要燒盡了。
english: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief; and in that day the heavens will be rolled up with a great noise, and the substance of the earth will be changed by violent heat, and the world and everything in it will be burned up.

chinese: 這一切既然都要如此銷化，你們為人該當怎樣聖潔，怎樣敬虔，
english: Seeing then that all these things are coming to such an end, what sort of persons is it right for you to be, in all holy behaviour and righteousness,

chinese: 切切仰望神的日子來到。在那日，天被火燒就銷化了，有形質的都要被烈火鎔化。
english: Looking for and truly desiring the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will come to an end through fire, and the substance of the earth will be changed by the great heat?

chinese: 但我們照他的應許，盼望新天新地，有義居在其中。
english: But having faith in his word, we are looking for a new heaven and a new earth, which will be the resting-place of righteousness.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，你們既盼望這些事，就當殷勤，使自己沒有玷污，無可指摘，安然見主；
english: For this reason, my loved ones, as you are looking for these things, take great care that when he comes you may be in peace before him, free from sin and every evil thing.

chinese: 並且要以我主長久忍耐為得救的因由，就如我們所親愛的兄弟保羅，照著所賜給他的智慧寫了信給你們。
english: And be certain that the long waiting of the Lord is for salvation; even as our brother Paul has said in his letters to you, from the wisdom which was given to him;

chinese: 他一切的信上也都是講論這事。信中有些難明白的，那無學問、不堅固的人強解，如強解別的經書一樣，就自取沉淪。
english: And as he said in all his letters, which had to do with these things; in which are some hard sayings, so that, like the rest of the holy Writings, they are twisted by those who are uncertain and without knowledge, to the destruction of their souls.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，你們既然預先知道這事，就當防備，恐怕被惡人的錯謬誘惑，就從自己堅固的地步上墜落。
english: For this reason, my loved ones, having knowledge of these things before they take place, take care that you are not turned away by the error of the uncontrolled, so falling from your true faith.

chinese: 你們卻要在我們主─救主耶穌基督的恩典和知識上有長進。願榮耀歸給他，從今直到永遠。阿們！
english: But be increased in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. May he have glory now and for ever. So be it.

chinese: 論到從起初原有的生命之道，就是我們所聽見、所看見、親眼看過、親手摸過的。
english: That which was from the first, which has come to our ears, and which we have seen with our eyes, looking on it and touching it with our hands, about the Word of life

chinese: 這生命已經顯現出來，我們也看見過，現在又作見證，將原與父同在、且顯現與我們那永遠的生命、傳給你們。
english: (And the life was made clear to us, and we have seen it and are witnessing to it and giving you word of that eternal life which was with the Father and was seen by us);

chinese: 我們將所看見、所聽見的傳給你們，使你們與我們相交。我們乃是與父並他兒子耶穌基督相交的。
english: We give you word of all we have seen and everything which has come to our ears, so that you may be united with us; and we are united with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ:

chinese: 我們將這些話寫給你們，使你們（有古卷作：我們）的喜樂充足。
english: And we are writing these things to you so that our joy may be made complete.

chinese: 神就是光，在他毫無黑暗。這是我們從主所聽見、又報給你們的信息。
english: This is the word which came to us from him and which we give to you, that God is light and in him there is nothing dark.

chinese: 我們若說是與神相交，卻仍在黑暗裡行，就是說謊話，不行真理了。
english: If we say we are joined to him, and are walking still in the dark, our words are false and our acts are untrue:

chinese: 我們若在光明中行，如同神在光明中，就彼此相交，他兒子耶穌的血也洗淨我們一切的罪。
english: But if we are walking in the light, as he is in the light, we are all united with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son makes us clean from all sin.

chinese: 我們若說自己無罪，便是自欺，真理不在我們心裡了。
english: If we say that we have no sin, we are false to ourselves and there is nothing true in us.

chinese: 我們若認自己的罪，神是信實的，是公義的，必要赦免我們的罪，洗淨我們一切的不義。
english: If we say openly that we have done wrong, he is upright and true to his word, giving us forgiveness of sins and making us clean from all evil.

chinese: 我們若說自己沒有犯過罪，便是以神為說謊的，他的道也不在我們心裡了。
english: If we say that we have no sin, we make him false and his word is not in us.

chinese: 我小子們哪，我將這些話寫給你們，是要叫你們不犯罪。若有人犯罪，在父那裡我們有一位中保，就是那義者耶穌基督。
english: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may be without sin. And if any man is a sinner, we have a friend and helper with the Father, Jesus Christ, the upright one:

chinese: 他為我們的罪作了挽回祭，不是單為我們的罪，也是為普天下人的罪。
english: He is the offering for our sins; and not for ours only, but for all the world.

chinese: 我們若遵守他的誡命，就曉得是認識他。
english: And by this we may be certain that we have knowledge of him, if we keep his laws.

chinese: 人若說我認識他，卻不遵守他的誡命，便是說謊話的，真理也不在他心裡了。
english: The man who says, I have knowledge of him, and does not keep his laws, is false, and there is nothing true in him:

chinese: 凡遵守主道的，愛神的心在他裡面實在是完全的。從此我們知道我們是在主裡面。
english: But in every man who keeps his word, the love of God is made complete. By this we may be certain that we are in him:

chinese: 人若說他住在主裡面，就該自己照主所行的去行。
english: He who says that he is living in him, will do as he did.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，我寫給你們的，不是一條新命令，乃是你們從起初所受的舊命令；這舊命令就是你們所聽見的道。
english: My loved ones, I do not give you a new law, but an old law which you had from the first; this old law is the word which came to your ears.

chinese: 再者，我寫給你們的，是一條新命令，在主是真的，在你們也是真的；因為黑暗漸漸過去，真光已經照耀。
english: Again, I give you a new law, which is true in him and in you; for the night is near its end and the true light is even now shining out.

chinese: 人若說自己在光明中，卻恨他的弟兄，他到如今還是在黑暗裡。
english: He who says that he is in the light, and has hate in his heart for his brother, is still in the dark.

chinese: 愛弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在他並沒有絆跌的緣由。
english: He who has love for his brother is in the light, and there is no cause of error in him.

chinese: 惟獨恨弟兄的，是在黑暗裡，且在黑暗裡行，也不知道往那裡去，因為黑暗叫他眼睛瞎了。
english: But he who has hate for his brother is in the dark, walking in the dark with no knowledge of where he is going, unable to see because of the dark.

chinese: 小子們哪，我寫信給你們，因為你們的罪藉著主名得了赦免。
english: I am writing to you, my children, because you have forgiveness of sins through his name.

chinese: 父老阿，我寫信給你們，因為你們認識那從起初原有的。少年人哪，我寫信給你們，因為你們勝了那惡者。小子們哪，我曾寫信給你們，因為你們認識父。
english: I am writing to you, fathers, because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the Evil One. I have sent a letter to you, children, because you have knowledge of the Father.

chinese: 父老阿，我曾寫信給你們，因為，你們認識那從起初原有的。少年人哪，我曾寫信給你們；因為，你們剛強，神的道常存在你們心裡；你們也勝了那惡者。
english: I have sent a letter to you, fathers, because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I have sent a letter to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God is in you, and because you have overcome the Evil One.

chinese: 不要愛世界和世界上的事。人若愛世界，愛父的心就不在他裡面了。
english: Have no love for the world or for the things which are in the world. If any man has love for the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

chinese: 因為凡世界上的事，就像肉體的情慾，眼目的情慾，並今生的驕傲，都不是從父來的，乃是從世界來的。
english: Because everything in the world, the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father but of the world.

chinese: 這世界和其上的情慾都要過去，惟獨遵行神旨意的，是永遠常存。
english: And the world and its desires is coming to an end: but he who does God's pleasure is living for ever.

chinese: 小子們哪，如今是末時了。你們曾聽見說，那敵基督的要來；現在已經有好些敵基督的出來了，從此我們就知道如今是末時了。
english: Little children, it is the last hour; and as you were given word that the Antichrist would come, so now a number of Antichrists have come to you; and by this we are certain that it is the last hour.

chinese: 他們從我們中間出去，卻不是屬我們的；若是屬我們的，就必仍舊與我們同在；他們出去，顯明都不是屬我們的。
english: They went out from us but they were not of us; if they had been of us they would still be with us: but they went out from us so that it might be made clear that they were not of us.

chinese: 你們從那聖者受了恩膏，並且知道這一切的事（或作：都有知識）。
english: And you have the Spirit from the Holy One and you all have knowledge.

chinese: 我寫信給你們，不是因你們不知道真理，正是因你們知道，並且知道沒有虛謊是從真理出來的。
english: I have not sent you this letter because you have no knowledge of what is true, but because you have knowledge, and because that which is false has nothing in common with that which is true.

chinese: 誰是說謊話的呢？不是那不認耶穌為基督的麼？不認父與子的，這就是敵基督的。
english: Who is false but he who says that Jesus is not the Christ? He is the Antichrist who has no belief in the Father or the Son.

chinese: 凡不認子的，就沒有父；認子的，連父也有了。
english: He who has no belief in the Son has not the Father: he who makes clear his belief in the Son has the Father.

chinese: 論到你們，務要將那從起初所聽見的，常存在心裡。若將從起初所聽見的存在心裡，你們就必住在子裡面，也必住在父裡面。
english: But as for you, keep in your hearts the things which were made clear to you from the first. If you keep these things in your hearts you will be kept in the Father and the Son.

chinese: 主所應許我們的就是永生。
english: And this is the hope which he gave you, even eternal life.

chinese: 我將這些話寫給你們，是指著那引誘你們的人說的。
english: I am writing these things to you about those whose purpose is that you may be turned out of the true way.

chinese: 你們從主所受的恩膏常存在你們心裡，並不用人教訓你們，自有主的恩膏在凡事上教訓你們。這恩膏是真的，不是假的；你們要按這恩膏的教訓住在主裡面。
english: As for you, the Spirit which he gave you is still in you, and you have no need of any teacher; but as his Spirit gives you teaching about all things, and is true and not false, so keep your hearts in him, through the teaching which he has given you.

chinese: 小子們哪，你們要住在主裡面。這樣，他若顯現，我們就可以坦然無懼；當他來的時候，在他面前也不至於慚愧。
english: And now, my children, keep your hearts in him; so that at his revelation, we may have no fear or shame before him at his coming.

chinese: 你們若知道他是公義的，就知道凡行公義之人都是他所生的。
english: If you have knowledge that he is upright, it is clear to you that everyone who does righteousness is his offspring.

chinese: 你看父賜給我們是何等的慈愛，使我們得稱為神的兒女；我們也真是他的兒女。世人所以不認識我們，是因未曾認識他。
english: See what great love the Father has given us in naming us the children of God; and such we are. For this reason the world does not see who we are, because it did not see who he was.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，我們現在是神的兒女，將來如何，還未顯明；但我們知道，主若顯現，我們必要像他、因為必得見他的真體。
english: My loved ones, now we are children of God, and at present it is not clear what we are to be. We are certain that at his revelation we will be like him; for we will see him as he is.

chinese: 凡向他有這指望的，就潔淨自己，像他潔淨一樣。
english: And everyone who has this hope in him makes himself holy, even as he is holy.

chinese: 凡犯罪的，就是違背律法；違背律法就是罪。
english: Everyone who is a sinner goes against the law, for sin is going against the law.

chinese: 你們知道主曾顯現，是要除掉人的罪；在他並沒有罪。
english: And you have knowledge that he came to take away sin: and in him there is no sin.

chinese: 凡住在他裡面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾看見他，也未曾認識他。
english: Anyone who is in him does no sin; anyone who is a sinner has not seen him and has no knowledge of him.

chinese: 小子們哪，不要被人誘感，行義的才是義人，正如主是義的一樣。
english: My little children, let no man take you out of the true way: he who does righteousness is upright, even as he is upright;

chinese: 犯罪的是屬魔鬼，因為魔鬼從起初就犯罪。神的兒子顯現出來，為要除滅魔鬼的作為。
english: The sinner is a child of the Evil One; for the Evil One has been a sinner from the first. And the Son of God was seen on earth so that he might put an end to the works of the Evil One.

chinese: 凡從神生的，就不犯罪，因神的道（原文作種）存在他心裡；他也不能犯罪，因為他是由神生的。
english: Anyone who is a child of God does no sin, because he still has God's seed in him; he is not able to be a sinner, because God is his Father.

chinese: 從此就顯出誰是神的兒女，。誰是魔鬼的兒女。凡不行義的就不屬神，不愛弟兄的也是如此。
english: In this way it is clear who are the children of God and who are the children of the Evil One; anyone who does not do righteousness or who has no love for his brother, is not a child of God.

chinese: 我們應當彼此相愛。這就是你們從起初所聽見的命令。
english: Because this is the word which was given to you from the first, that we are to have love for one another;

chinese: 不可像該隱；他是屬那惡者，殺了他的兄弟。為甚麼殺了他呢？因自己的行為是惡的，兄弟的行為是善的。
english: Not being of the Evil One like Cain, who put his brother to death. And why did he put him to death? Because his works were evil and his brother's works were good.

chinese: 弟兄們，世人若恨你們，不要以為希奇。
english: Do not be surprised, my brothers, if the world has no love for you.

chinese: 我們因為愛弟兄，就曉得是已經出死入生了。沒有愛心的，仍住在死中。
english: We are conscious that we have come out of death into life because of our love for the brothers. He who has no love is still in death.

chinese: 凡恨他弟兄的，就是殺人的；你們曉得凡殺人的，沒有永生存在他裡面。
english: Anyone who has hate for his brother is a taker of life, and you may be certain that no taker of life has eternal life in him.

chinese: 主為我們捨命，我們從此就知道何為愛；我們也當為弟兄捨命。
english: In this we see what love is, because he gave his life for us; and it is right for us to give our lives for the brothers.

chinese: 凡有世上財物的，看見弟兄窮乏，卻塞住憐恤的心，愛神的心怎能存在他裡面呢？
english: But if a man has this world's goods, and sees that his brother is in need, and keeps his heart shut against his brother, how is it possible for the love of God to be in him?

chinese: 小子們哪，我們相愛，不要只在言語和舌頭上，總要在行為和誠實上。
english: My little children, do not let our love be in word and in tongue, but let it be in act and in good faith.

chinese: 從此就知道我們是屬真理的，並且我們的心在神面前可以安穩。
english: In this way we may be certain that we are true, and may give our heart comfort before him,

chinese: 我們的心若責備我們，神比我們的心大，一切事沒有不知道的。
english: When our heart says that we have done wrong; because God is greater than our heart, and has knowledge of all things.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，我們的心若不責備我們，就可以向神坦然無懼了。
english: My loved ones, if our heart does not say that we have done wrong, we have no fear before him;

chinese: 並且我們一切所求的，就從他得著；因為我們遵守他的命令，行他所喜悅的事。
english: And he gives us all our requests, because we keep his laws and do the things which are pleasing in his eyes.

chinese: 神的命令就是叫我們信他兒子耶穌基督的名，且照他所賜給我們的命令彼此相愛。
english: And this is his law, that we have faith in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love for one another, even as he said to us.

chinese: 遵守神命令的，就住在神裡面；神也住在他裡面。我們所以知道神住在我們裡面是因他所賜給我們的聖靈。
english: He who keeps his laws is in God and God is in him. And the Spirit which he gave us is our witness that he is in us.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，一切的靈，你們不可都信，總要試驗那些靈是出於神的不是，因為世上有許多假先知已經出來了。
english: My loved ones, do not put your faith in every spirit, but put them to the test, to see if they are from God: because a great number of false prophets have gone out into the world.

chinese: 凡靈認耶穌基督是成了肉身來，就是出於神的的；從此你們可以認出神的靈來。
english: By this you may have knowledge of the Spirit of God: every spirit which says that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God:

chinese: 凡靈不認耶穌，就不是出於神；這是那敵基督者的靈。你們從前聽見他要來，現在已經在世上了。
english: And every spirit which does not say this is not from God: this is the spirit of Antichrist, of which you have had word; and it is in the world even now.

chinese: 小子們哪，你們是屬神的，並且勝了他們；因為那在你們裡面的，比那在世界上的更大。
english: You are of God, my little children, and you have overcome them because he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.

chinese: 他們是屬世界的，所以論世界的事，世人也聽從他們。
english: They are of the world, so their talk is the world's talk, and the world gives ear to them.

chinese: 我們是屬神的，認識神的就聽從我們；不屬神的就不聽從我們。從此我們可以認出真理的靈和謬妄的靈來。
english: We are of God: he who has the knowledge of God gives ear to us; he who is not of God does not give ear to us. By this we may see which is the true spirit, and which is the spirit of error.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，我們應當彼此相愛，因為愛是從神來的。凡有愛心的，都是由神而生，並且認識神。
english: My loved ones, let us have love for one another: because love is of God, and everyone who has love is a child of God and has knowledge of God.

chinese: 沒有愛心的，就不認識神，因為神就是愛。
english: He who has no love has no knowledge of God, because God is love.

chinese: 神差他獨生子到世間來，使我們藉著他得生，神愛我們的心在此就顯明了。
english: And the love of God was made clear to us when he sent his only Son into the world so that we might have life through him.

chinese: 不是我們愛神，乃是神愛我們，差他的兒子為我們的罪作了挽回祭，這就是愛了。
english: And this is love, not that we had love for God, but that he had love for us, and sent his Son to be an offering for our sins.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，神既是這樣愛我們，我們也當彼此相愛。
english: My loved ones, if God had such love for us, it is right for us to have love for one another.

chinese: 從來沒有人見過神，我們若彼此相愛，神就住在我們裡面，愛他的心在我們裡面得以完全了。
english: No man has ever seen God: if we have love for one another, God is in us and his love is made complete in us:

chinese: 神將他的靈賜給我們，從此就知道我們是住在他裡面，他也住在我們裡面。
english: And his Spirit which he has given us is the witness that we are in him and he is in us.

chinese: 父差子作世人的救主；這是我們所看見且作見證的。
english: And we have seen and give witness that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

chinese: 凡認耶穌為神兒子的，神就住在他裡面，他也住在神裡面。
english: Everyone who says openly that Jesus is the Son of God, has God in him and is in God.

chinese: 神愛我們的心，我們也知道也信。神就是愛；住在愛裡面的，就是住在神裡面，神也住在他裡面。
english: And we have seen and had faith in the love which God has for us. God is love, and everyone who has love is in God, and God is in him.

chinese: 這樣，愛在我們裡面得以完全，我們就可以在審判的日子坦然無懼。因為他如何，我們在這世上也如何。
english: In this way love is made complete in us, so that we may be without fear on the day of judging, because as he is, so are we in this world.

chinese: 愛裡沒有懼怕；愛既完全，就把懼怕除去。因為懼怕裡含著刑罰，懼怕的人在愛裡未得完全。
english: There is no fear in love: true love has no room for fear, because where fear is, there is pain; and he who is not free from fear is not complete in love.

chinese: 我們愛，因為神先愛我們。
english: We have the power of loving, because he first had love for us.

chinese: 人若說我愛神，卻恨他的弟兄，就是說謊話的；不愛他所看見的弟兄，就不能愛沒有看見的神（有古卷作：怎能愛沒有看見的神呢）。
english: If a man says, I have love for God, and has hate for his brother, his words are false: for how is the man who has no love for his brother whom he has seen, able to have love for God whom he has not seen?

chinese: 愛神的，也當愛弟兄，這是我們從神所受的命令。
english: And this is the word which we have from him, that he who has love for God is to have the same love for his brother.

chinese: 凡信耶穌是基督的，都是從神而生，凡愛生他之神的，也必愛從神生的。
english: Everyone who has faith that Jesus is the Christ is a child of God: and everyone who has love for the Father has love for his child.

chinese: 我們若愛神，又遵守他的誡命，從此就知道我們愛神的兒女。
english: In this way, we are certain that we have love for the children of God, when we have love for God and keep his laws.

chinese: 我們遵守神的誡命，這就是愛他了，並且他的誡命不是難守的。
english: For loving God is keeping his laws: and his laws are not hard.

chinese: 因為凡從神生的，就勝過世界；使我們勝了世界的，就是我們的信心。
english: Anything which comes from God is able to overcome the world: and the power by which we have overcome the world is our faith.

chinese: 勝過世界的是誰呢？不是那信耶穌是神兒子的麼？
english: Who is able to overcome the world but the man who has faith that Jesus is the Son of God?

chinese: 這藉著水和血而來的，就是耶穌基督；不是單用水，乃是用水又用血，
english: This is he who came by water and by blood, Jesus Christ; not by water only but by water and by blood.

chinese: 並且有聖靈作見證，因為聖靈就是真理。
english: And the Spirit is the witness, because the Spirit is true.

chinese: 作見證的原來有三：就是聖靈、水，與血，這三樣也都歸於一。
english: There are three witnesses, the Spirit, the water, and the blood: and all three are in agreement.

chinese: 我們既領受人的見證，神的見證更該領受了（該領受：原文作大），因神的見證是為他兒子作的。
english: If we take the witness of men to be true, the witness of God is greater: because this is the witness which God has given about his Son.

chinese: 信神兒子的，就有這見證在他心裡；不信神的，就是將神當作說謊的，因不信神為他兒子作的見證。
english: He who has faith in the Son of God has the witness in himself: he who has not faith in God makes him false, because he has not faith in the witness which God has given about his Son.

chinese: 這見證就是神賜給我們永生；這永生也是在他兒子裡面。
english: And his witness is this, that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

chinese: 人有了神的兒子就有生命，沒有神的兒子就沒有生命。
english: He who has the Son has the life; he who has not the Son of God has not the life.

chinese: 我將這些話寫給你們信奉神兒子之名的人，要叫你們知道自己有永生。
english: I have put these things in writing for you who have faith in the name of the Son of God, so that you may be certain that you have eternal life.

chinese: 我們若照他的旨意求甚麼，他就聽我們，這是我們向他所存坦然無懼的心。
english: And we are certain that if we make any request to him which is right in his eyes, he will give ear to us:

chinese: 既然知道他聽我們一切所求的，就知道我們所求於他的，無不得著。
english: And if we are certain that he gives ear to all our requests, we are equally certain that we will get our requests.

chinese: 人若看見弟兄犯了不至於死的罪，就當為他祈求，神必將生命賜給他；有至於死的罪，我不說當為這罪祈求。
english: If a man sees his brother doing a sin which is not bad enough for death, let him make a prayer to God, and God will give life to him whose sin was not bad enough for death. There is a sin whose punishment is death: I do not say that he may make such a request then.

chinese: 凡不義的事都是罪，也有不至於死的罪。
english: All evil-doing is sin: but death is not the punishment for every sort of sin.

chinese: 我們知道凡從神生的，必不犯罪，從神生的，必保守自己（有古卷作：那從神生的必保護他），那惡者也就無法害他。
english: We are certain that one who is a child of God will do no sin, but the Son of God keeps him so that he is not touched by the Evil One.

chinese: 我們知道，我們是屬神的，全世界都臥在那惡者手下。
english: We are certain that we are of God, but all the world is in the power of the Evil One.

chinese: 我們也知道，神的兒子已經來到，且將智慧賜給我們，使我們認識那位真實的，我們也在那位真實的裡面，就是在他兒子耶穌基督裡面。這是真神，也是永生。
english: And we are certain that the Son of God has come, and has given us a clear vision, so that we may see him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

chinese: 小子們哪，你們要自守，遠避偶像！
english: My little children, keep yourselves from false gods.

chinese: 作長老的寫信給蒙揀選的太太（或作：教會；下同），和他的兒女，就是我誠心所愛的；不但我愛，也是一切知道真理之人所愛的。
english: I, a ruler in the church, send word to the noble sister who is of God's selection, and to her children, for whom I have true love; and not only I, but all who have knowledge of what is true;

chinese: 愛你們是為真理的緣故，這真理存在我們裡面，也必永遠與我們同在。
english: Because of this true knowledge which is in us, and will be with us for ever:

chinese: 恩惠，憐憫，平安從父神和他兒子耶穌基督在真理和愛心上必常與我們同在！
english: May grace, mercy, and peace be with us from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in all true love.

chinese: 我見你的兒女，有照我們從父所受之命令遵行真理的，就甚歡喜。
english: It gave me great joy to see some of your children walking in the true way, even as we were ordered to do by the Father.

chinese: 太太阿，我現在勸你，我們大家要彼此相愛。這並不是我寫一條新命令給你，乃是我們從起初所受的命令。
english: And now, my sister, I make a request to you, not sending you a new law, but the law which we had from the first, that we have love for one another.

chinese: 我們若照他的命令行，這就是愛。你們從起初所聽見當行的，就是這命令。
english: And love is the keeping of his laws. This is the law which was given to you from the first, so that you might keep it.

chinese: 因為世上有許多迷惑人的出來，他們不認耶穌基督是成了肉身來的；這就是那迷惑人、敵基督的。
english: Because a number of false teachers have gone out into the world, who do not give witness that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Such a one is a false teacher and Antichrist.

chinese: 你們要小心，不要失去你們（有古卷：我們）所做的工，乃要得著滿足的賞賜。
english: Keep watch over yourselves, so that you do not make our work of no effect, but may get your full reward.

chinese: 凡越過基督的教訓、不常守著的，就沒有神；常守這教訓的，就有父又有子。
english: Anyone who goes on and does not keep to the teaching of Christ, has not God: he who keeps to the teaching has the Father and the Son.

chinese: 若有人到你們那裡，不是傳這教訓，不要接他到家裡，也不要問他的安；
english: If anyone comes to you not having this teaching, do not take him into your house or give him words of love:

chinese: 因為問他安的，就在他的惡行上有分。
english: For he who gives him words of love has a part in his evil works.

chinese: 我還有許多事要寫給你們，卻不願意用紙墨寫出來，但盼望到你們那裡，與你們當面談論，使你們的喜樂滿足。
english: Having much to say to you, it is not my purpose to put it all down with paper and ink: but I am hoping to come to you, and to have talk with you face to face, so that your joy may be full.

chinese: 你那蒙揀選之姊妹的兒女都問你安。
english: The children of your noble sister, who is of God's selection, send you their love.

chinese: 作長老的寫信給親愛的該猶，就是我誠心所愛的。
english: I, a ruler in the church, send word to the well loved Gaius, for whom I have true love.

chinese: 親愛的兄弟阿，我願你凡事興盛，身體健壯，正如你的靈魂興盛一樣。
english: My loved one, it is my prayer that you may do well in all things, and be healthy in body, even as your soul does well.

chinese: 有弟兄來證明你心裡存的真理，正如你按真理而行，我就甚喜樂。
english: For it gave me great joy when some of the brothers came and gave witness that you had the true faith and were walking in the true way.

chinese: 我聽見我的兒女們按真理而行，我的喜樂就沒有比這個大的。
english: I have no greater joy than to have news that my children are walking in the true way.

chinese: 親愛的兄弟阿，凡你向作客旅之弟兄所行的都是忠心的。
english: My loved one, you are doing a good work in being kind to those brothers who come from other places;

chinese: 他們在教會面前證明了你的愛；你若配得過神，幫助他們往前行，這就好了。
english: Who have given witness to the church of your love for them: and you will do well to send them on their way well cared for, as is right for servants of God:

chinese: 因他們是為主的名（原文是那名）出外，對於外邦人一無所取。
english: For they went out for love of the Name, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

chinese: 所以我們應該接待這樣的人，叫我們與他們一同為真理做工。
english: So it is right for us to take in such men as guests, so that we may take our part in the work of the true faith.

chinese: 我曾略略的寫信給教會，但那在教會中好為首的丟特腓不接待我們。
english: I sent a letter to the church, but Diotrephes, whose desire is ever to have the first place among them, will not have us there.

chinese: 所以我若去，必要提說他所行的事，就是他用惡言妄論我們。還不以此為足，他自己不接待弟兄，有人願意接待，他也禁止，並且將接待弟兄的人趕出教會。
english: So if I come, I will keep in mind the things he does, talking against us with evil words: and as if this was not enough, he does not take the brothers into his house, and those who are ready to take them in, he keeps from doing so, putting them out of the church if they do.

chinese: 親愛的兄弟阿，不要效法惡，只要效法善。行善的屬乎神；行惡的未曾見過神。
english: My loved one, do not be copying what is evil, but what is good. He who does good is of God: he who does evil has not seen God.

chinese: 低米丟行善，有眾人給他作見證，又有真理給他作見證；就是我們也給他作見證。你也知道我們的見證是真的。
english: Demetrius has the approval of all men and of what is true: and we give the same witness, and you are certain that our witness is true.

chinese: 我原有許多事要寫給你，卻不願意用筆墨寫給你，
english: I had much to say to you, but it is not my purpose to put it all down with ink and pen:

chinese: 但盼望快快的見你，我們就當面談論。[(IIIJohn1:15)願你平安。眾位朋友都問你安。請你替我按著姓名問眾位朋友安。]
english: But I am hoping to see you in a short time, and to have talk with you face to face.

chinese: 耶穌基督的僕人，雅各的弟兄猶大，寫信給那被召、在父神裡蒙愛、為耶穌基督保守的人。
english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James, to those of God's selection who have been made holy by God the Father and are kept safe for Jesus Christ:

chinese: 願憐恤、平安、慈愛多多的加給你們。
english: May mercy and peace and love be increased in you.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，我想盡心寫信給你們，論我們同得救恩的時候，就不得不寫信勸你們，要為從前一次交付聖徒的真道竭力的爭辯。
english: My loved ones, while my thoughts were full of a letter which I was going to send you about our common salvation, it was necessary for me to send you one requesting you with all my heart to go on fighting strongly for the faith which has been given to the saints once and for ever.

chinese: 因為有些人偷著進來，就是自古被定受刑罰的，是不虔誠的，將我們神的恩變放縱情慾的機會，並且不認獨一的主宰─我們（或作和我們）主耶穌基督。
english: For certain men have come among you secretly, marked out before in the holy Writings for this evil fate, men without the fear of God, turning his grace into an unclean thing, and false to our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

chinese: 從前主救了他的百姓出埃及地，後來就把那些不信的滅絕了。這一切的事，你們雖然都知道，我卻仍要提醒你們。
english: Now it is my purpose to put you in mind, though you once had knowledge of all these things, of how the Lord, having taken a people safely out of Egypt, later sent destruction on those who had no faith;

chinese: 又有不守本位、離開自己住處的天使，主用鎖鍊把他們永遠拘留在黑暗裡，等候大日的審判。
english: And the angels who did not keep to their kingdom but went out from the place which was theirs, he has put in eternal chains and in dark night till the great day of the judging.

chinese: 又如所多瑪、蛾摩拉和周圍城邑的人也照他們一味的行淫，隨從逆性的情慾，就受永火的刑罰，作為鑑戒。
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the towns near them, having like these, given themselves up to unclean desires and gone after strange flesh, have been made an example, undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.

chinese: 這些做夢的人也像他們污穢身體，輕慢主治的，毀謗在尊位的。
english: In the same way these dreamers make the flesh unclean, having no respect for authorities, and say evil of rulers.

chinese: 天使長米迦勒{為摩西的屍首與魔鬼爭辯的時候，尚且不敢用毀謗的話罪責他，只說：主責備你罷！
english: Now when Michael, one of the chief angels, was fighting against the Evil One for the body of Moses, fearing to make use of violent words against him, he only said, May the Lord be your judge.

chinese: 但這些人毀謗他們所不知道的。他們本性所知道的事與那沒有靈性的畜類一樣，在這事上竟敗壞了自己。
english: But these men say evil about such things as they have no knowledge of; and the things of which they have natural knowledge, like beasts without reason, are the cause of their destruction.

chinese: 他們有禍了！因為走了該隱的道路，又為利往巴蘭的錯謬裡直奔，並在可拉的背叛中滅亡了。
english: A curse on them! They have gone in the way of Cain, running uncontrolled into the error of Balaam for reward, and have come to destruction by saying evil against the Lord, like Korah.

chinese: 這樣的人在你們的愛席上與你們同吃的時候，正是礁石（或作：玷污）。他們作牧人，只知餧養自己，無所懼怕；是沒有雨的雲彩，被風飄蕩；是秋天沒有果子的樹，死而又死，連根被拔出來；
english: These men are unseen rocks at your love-feasts, when they take part in them with you, keepers of sheep who without fear take the food of the sheep; clouds without water rushing before the wind, wasted trees without fruit, twice dead, pulled up by the roots,

chinese: 是海裡的狂浪，湧出自己可恥的沫子來；是流蕩的星，有墨黑的幽暗為他們永遠存留。
english: Violent waves of the sea, streaming with their shame, wandering stars for whom the darkest night is kept in store for ever.

chinese: 亞當的七世孫以諾，曾預言這些人說：看哪，主帶著他的千萬聖者降臨，
english: The prophet Enoch, who was the seventh after Adam, said of these men, The Lord came with tens of thousands of his saints,

chinese: 要在眾人身上行審判，證實那一切不敬虔的人，所妄行一切不敬虔的事，又證實不敬虔之罪人所說頂撞他的剛愎話。
english: To be the judge of all, and to give a decision against all those whose lives are unpleasing to him, because of the evil acts which they have done, and because of all the hard things which sinners without fear of God have said against him.

chinese: 這些人是私下議論，常發怨言的，隨從自己的情慾而行，口中說誇大的話，為得便宜諂媚人。
english: These are the men who make trouble, ever desiring change, going after evil pleasures, using high-sounding words, respecting men's position in the hope of reward.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，你們要記念我們主耶穌基督之使徒從前所說的話。
english: But you, my loved ones, keep in memory the words which were said before by the Apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,

chinese: 他們曾對你們說過，末世必有好譏誚的人隨從自己不敬虔的私慾而行。
english: How they said to you, In the last days there will be men who, guided by their evil desires, will make sport of holy things.

chinese: 這就是那些引人結黨、屬乎血氣、沒有聖靈的人。
english: These are the men who make divisions, natural men, not having the Spirit.

chinese: 親愛的弟兄阿，你們卻要在至聖的真道上造就自己，在聖靈裡禱告，
english: But you, my loved ones, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, and making prayers in the Holy Spirit,

chinese: 保守自己常在神的愛中，仰望我們主耶穌基督的憐憫，直到永生。
english: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for life eternal through the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ.

chinese: 有些人存疑心，你們要憐憫他們；
english: And have pity on those who are in doubt;

chinese: 有些人你們要從火中搶出來，搭救他們；有些人你們要存懼怕的心憐憫他們，連那被情慾沾染的衣服也當厭惡。
english: And to some give salvation, pulling them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear, hating even the clothing which is made unclean by the flesh.

chinese: 那能保守你們不失腳、叫你們無瑕無疵、歡歡喜喜站在他榮耀之前的我們的救主─獨一的神，
english: Now to him who is able to keep you from falling, and to give you a place in his glory, free from all evil, with great joy,

chinese: 願榮耀、威嚴、能力、權柄，因我們的主耶穌基督歸與他，從萬古以前並現今，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
english: To the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, let us give glory and honour and authority and power, before all time and now and for ever. So be it.

chinese: 耶穌基督的啟示，就是神賜給他，叫他將必要快成的事指示他的眾僕人。他就差遣使者曉諭他的僕人約翰。
english: The Revelation of Jesus Christ which God gave him so that his servants might have knowledge of the things which will quickly take place: and he sent and made it clear by his angel to his servant John;

chinese: 約翰便將神的道和耶穌基督的見證，凡自己所看見的都證明出來。
english: Who gave witness of the word of God, and of the witness of Jesus Christ, even of all the things which he saw.

chinese: 念這書上預言的和那些聽見又遵守其中所記載的，都是有福的，因為日期近了。
english: A blessing be on the reader, and on those who give ear to the prophet's words, and keep the things which he has put in the book: for the time is near.

chinese: 約翰寫信給亞西亞的七個教會。但願從那昔在、今在、以後永在的神，和他寶座前的七靈，
english: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and was and is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his high seat;

chinese: 並那誠實作見證的、從死裡首先復活、為世上君王元首的耶穌基督，有恩惠、平安歸與你們！他愛我們，用自己的血使我們脫離（有古卷作：洗去）罪惡，
english: And from Jesus Christ, the true witness, the first to come back from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who had love for us and has made us clean from our sins by his blood;

chinese: 又使我們成為國民，作他父神的祭司。但願榮耀、權能歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
english: And has made us to be a kingdom and priests to his God and Father; to him let glory and power be given for ever and ever. So be it.

chinese: 看哪，他駕雲降臨！眾目要看見他，連刺他的人也要看見他；地上的萬族都要因他哀哭。這話是真實的。阿們！
english: See, he comes with the clouds, and every eye will see him, and those by whom he was wounded; and all the tribes of the earth will be sorrowing because of him. Yes, so be it.

chinese: 主神說：我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛，（阿拉法，俄梅戛：是希利尼字母首末二字），是昔在、今在、以後永在的全能者。
english: I am the First and the Last, says the Lord God who is and was and is to come, the Ruler of all.

chinese: 我─約翰就是你們的弟兄，和你們在耶穌的患難、國度、忍耐裡一同有分，為神的道，並為給耶穌作的見證，曾在那名叫拔摩的海島上。
english: I, John, your brother, who have a part with you in the trouble and the kingdom and the quiet strength of Jesus, was in the island which is named Patmos, for the word of God and the witness of Jesus.

chinese: 當主日，我被聖靈感動，聽見在我後面有大聲音如吹號，說：
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and a great voice at my back, as of a horn, came to my ears,

chinese: 你所看見的當寫在書上，達與以弗所、士每拿、別迦摩、推雅推喇、撒狄、非拉鐵非、老底嘉、那七個教會。
english: Saying, What you see, put in a book, and send it to the seven churches; to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamos and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.

chinese: 我轉過身來，要看是誰發聲與我說話；既轉過來，就看見七個金燈臺。
english: And turning to see the voice which said these words to me, I saw seven gold vessels with lights burning in them;

chinese: 燈臺中間有一位好像人子，身穿長衣，直垂到腳，胸間束著金帶。
english: And in the middle of them one like a son of man, clothed with a robe down to his feet, and with a band of gold round his breasts.

chinese: 他的頭與髮皆白，如白羊毛，如雪；眼目如同火燄；
english: And his head and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

chinese: 腳好像在爐中煆煉光明的銅；聲音如同眾水的聲音。
english: And his feet like polished brass, as if it had been burned in a fire; and his voice was as the sound of great waters.

chinese: 他右手拿著七星，從他口中出來一把兩刃的利劍；面貌如同烈日放光。
english: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword: and his face was like the sun shining in its strength.

chinese: 我一看見，就仆倒在他腳前，像死了一樣。他用右手按著我，說：不要懼怕！我是首先的，我是末後的，
english: And when I saw him, I went down on my face at his feet as one dead. And he put his right hand on me, saying, Have no fear; I am the first and the last and the Living one;

chinese: 又是那存活的；我曾死過，現在又活了，直活到永永遠遠；並且拿著死亡和陰間的鑰匙。
english: And I was dead, and see, I am living for ever, and I have the keys of death and of Hell.

chinese: 所以你要把所看見的，和現在的事，並將來必成的事，都寫出來。
english: Put in writing, then, the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will be after these;

chinese: 論到你所看見、在我右手中的七星和七個金燈臺的奧祕，那七星就是七個教會的使者，七燈臺就是七個教會。
english: The secret of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and of the seven gold vessels with burning lights. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven lights are the seven churches.

chinese: 你要寫信給以弗所教會的使者，說：那右手拿著七星、在七個金燈臺中間行走的，說：
english: To the angel of the church in Ephesus say: These things says he who has the seven stars in his right hand, who is walking in the middle of the seven gold lights:
