chinese: 我知道你的行為、勞碌、忍耐，也知道你不能容忍惡人。你也曾試驗那自稱為使徒卻不是使徒的，看出他們是假的來。
english: I have knowledge of your doings, and of your hard work and long waiting, and that you will not put up with evil men, and have put to the test those who say they are Apostles and are not, and have seen that they are false;

chinese: 你也能忍耐，曾為我的名勞苦，並不乏倦。
english: And you have the power of waiting, and have undergone trouble because of my name, without weariness.

chinese: 然而有一件事我要責備你，就是你把起初的愛心離棄了。
english: But I have this against you, that you are turned away from your first love.

chinese: 所以，應當回想你是從那裡墜落的，並要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就臨到你那裡，把你的燈臺從原處挪去。
english: So keep in mind where you were at first, and be changed in heart and do the first works; or I will come to you, and will take away your light from its place, if your hearts are not changed.

chinese: 然而你還有一件可取的事，就是你恨惡尼哥拉一黨人的行為，這也是我所恨惡的。
english: But at least you have the credit of hating the works of the Nicolaitans, as I do.

chinese: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，我必將神樂園中生命樹的果子賜給他吃。
english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give of the fruit of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.

chinese: 你要寫信給士每拿教會的使者，說：那首先的、末後的、死過又活的，說：
english: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna say: These things says the first and the last, who was dead and is living:

chinese: 我知道你的患難，你的貧窮（你卻是富足的），也知道那自稱是猶太人所說的毀謗話，其實他們不是猶太人，乃是撒但一會的人。
english: I have knowledge of your troubles and how poor you are (but you have true wealth), and the evil words of those who say they are Jews, and are not, but are a Synagogue of Satan.

chinese: 你將要受的苦你不用怕。魔鬼要把你們中間幾個人下在監裡，叫你們被試煉，你們必受患難十日。你務要至死忠心，我就賜給你那生命的冠冕。
english: Have no fear of the things which you will have to undergo: see, the Evil One will send some of you into prison, so that you may be put to the test; and you will have great trouble for ten days. Be true till death, and I will give you the crown of life.

chinese: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，必不受第二次死的害。
english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes will not come under the power of the second death.

chinese: 你要寫信給別迦摩教會的使者，說：那有兩刃利劍的，說：
english: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos say: These things says he who has the sharp two-edged sword:

chinese: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之處；當我忠心的見證人安提帕在你們中間、撒但所住的地方被殺之時，你還堅守我的名，沒有棄絕我的道。
english: I have knowledge that your living-place is where Satan has his seat: and you are true to my name, and were not turned away from your faith in me, even in the days of Antipas, my true witness, who was put to death among you, where Satan has his place.

chinese: 然而，有幾件事我要責備你：因為在你那裡有人服從了巴蘭的教訓；這巴蘭曾教導巴勒將絆腳石放在以色列人面前，叫他們吃祭偶像之物，行姦淫的事。
english: But I have some things against you, because you have with you those who keep the teaching of Balaam, by whose suggestion Balak made the children of Israel go out of the right way, taking food which was offered to false gods, and going after the desires of the flesh.

chinese: 你那裡也有人照樣服從了尼哥拉一黨人的教訓。
english: And you have those who keep the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

chinese: 所以，你當悔改；若不悔改，我就快臨到你那裡，用我口中的劍攻擊他們。
english: See, then, that you have a change of heart; or I will come to you quickly, and will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

chinese: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，我必將那隱藏的嗎哪賜給他，並賜他一塊白石，石上寫著新名；除了那領受的以外，沒有人能認識。
english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give of the secret manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name, of which no one has knowledge but he to whom it is given.

chinese: 你要寫信給推雅推喇教會的使者，說：那眼目如火燄、腳像光明銅的神之子說：
english: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira say: These things says the Son of God, whose eyes are like a flame of fire, and his feet like polished brass:

chinese: 我知道你的行為、愛心、信心、勤勞、忍耐，又知道你末後所行的善事，比起初所行的更多。
english: I have knowledge of your works, and your love and faith and help and strength in trouble, and that your last works are more than the first.

chinese: 然而，有一件事我要責備你，就是你容讓那自稱是先知的婦人耶洗別教導我的僕人，引誘他們行姦淫，吃祭偶像之物。
english: But I have this against you, that you let the woman Jezebel say she is a prophet and give false teaching, making my servants go after the desires of the flesh and take food offered to false gods.

chinese: 我曾給他悔改的機會，他卻不肯悔改他的淫行。
english: And I gave her time for a change of heart, but she has no mind to give up her unclean ways.

chinese: 看哪，我要叫他病臥在床。那些與他行淫的人，若不悔改所行的，我也要叫他們同受大患難。
english: See, I will put her into a bed, and those who make themselves unclean with her, into great trouble, if they go on with her works.

chinese: 我又要殺死他的黨類（原文是兒女），叫眾教會知道，我是那察看人肺腑心腸的，並要照你們的行為報應你們各人。
english: And I will put her children to death; and all the churches will see that I am he who makes search into the secret thoughts and hearts of men: and I will give to every one of you the reward of your works.

chinese: 至於你們推雅推喇其餘的人，就是一切不從那教訓、不曉得他們素常所說撒但深奧之理的人，我告訴你們，我不將別的擔子放在你們身上。
english: But to you I say, to the rest in Thyatira, even to those who have not this teaching, and have no knowledge of the secrets of Satan, as they say; I put on you no other weight.

chinese: 但你們已經有的，總要持守，直等到我來。
english: But what you have, keep safe till I come.

chinese: 那得勝又遵守我命令到底的，我要賜給他權柄制伏列國；
english: He who overcomes, and keeps my works to the end, to him I will give rule over the nations,

chinese: 他必用鐵杖轄管（轄管：原文是牧）他們，將他們如同窯戶的瓦器打得粉碎，像我從我父領受的權柄一樣。
english: And he will be ruling them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of the potter they will be broken, even as I have power from my Father:

chinese: 我又要把晨星賜給他。
english: And I will give him the morning star.

chinese: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！
english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.

chinese: 你要寫信給撒狄教會的使者，說：那有神的七靈和七星的，說：我知道你的行為，按名你是活的，其實是死的。
english: And to the angel of the church in Sardis say: These things says he who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I have knowledge of your works, that you seem to be living but are dead.

chinese: 你要儆醒，堅固那剩下將要衰微（原文是死）的；因我見你的行為，在我神面前，沒有一樣是完全的。
english: Be on the watch, and make strong the rest of the things which are near to death; because as judged by me your works have not come up to God's measure.

chinese: 所以要回想你是怎樣領受、怎樣聽見的、又要遵守，並要悔改。若不儆醒，我必臨到你那裡，如同賊一樣。我幾時臨到，你也決不能知道。
english: Keep in mind, then, the teaching which was given to you, and be ruled by it and have a change of heart. If then you do not keep watch, I will come like a thief, and you will have no knowledge of the hour when I will come on you.

chinese: 然而在撒狄，你還有幾名是未曾污穢自己衣服的，他們要穿白衣與我同行，因為他們是配得過的。
english: But you have some names in Sardis who have kept clean their robes; and as a reward they will go in white with me.

chinese: 凡得勝的必這樣穿白衣，我也必不從生命冊上塗抹他的名；且要在我父面前，和我父眾使者面前，認他的名。
english: He who overcomes will be dressed in white, and I will not take his name from the book of life, and I will give witness to his name before my Father, and before his angels.

chinese: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！
english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.

chinese: 你要寫信給非拉鐵非教會的使者，說：那聖潔、真實、拿著大衛的鑰匙、開了就沒有人能關、關了就沒有人能開的，說：
english: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia say: These things says he who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, opening the door so that it may be shut by no one, and shutting it so that it may be open to no one.

chinese: 我知道你的行為，你略有一點力量，也曾遵守我的道，沒有棄絕我的名。看哪，我在你面前給你一個敞開的門，是無人能關的。
english: I have knowledge of your works (see, I have put before you an open door which may be shut by no one), and that you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and have been true to my name.

chinese: 那撒但一會的，自稱是猶太人，其實不是猶太人，乃是說謊話的，我要使他們來，在你腳前下拜，也使他們知道我是已經愛你了。
english: See, I will make those of the Synagogue of Satan who say they are Jews, and are not, but say what is false; I will make them come and give worship before your feet, and see my love for you.

chinese: 你既遵守我忍耐的道，我必在普天下人受試煉的時候，保守你免去你的試煉。
english: Because you have kept my word in quiet strength, I will keep you from the hour of testing which is coming on all the world, to put to the test those who are on earth.

chinese: 我必快來，你要持守你所有的，免得人奪去你的冠冕。
english: I come quickly: keep that which you have, so that no one may take your crown.

chinese: 得勝的，我要叫他在我神殿中作柱子，他也必不再從那裡出去。我又要將我神的名和我神城的名（這城就是從天上、從我神那裡降下來的新耶路撒冷），並我的新名，都寫在他上面。
english: Him who overcomes I will make a pillar in the house of my God, and he will go out no more: and I will put on him the name of my God, and the name of the town of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my new name.

chinese: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！
english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.

chinese: 你要寫信給老底嘉教會的使者，說：那為阿們的，為誠信真實見證的，在神創造萬物之上為元首的，說：
english: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea say: These things says the true and certain witness, the head of God's new order:

chinese: 我知道你的行為，你也不冷也不熱；我巴不得你或冷或熱。
english: I have knowledge of your works, that you are not cold or warm: it would be better if you were cold or warm.

chinese: 你既如溫水，也不冷也不熱，所以我必從我口中把你吐出去。
english: So because you are not one thing or the other, I will have no more to do with you.

chinese: 你說：我是富足，已經發了財，一樣都不缺；卻不知道你是那困苦、可憐、貧窮、瞎眼、赤身的。
english: For you say, I have wealth, and have got together goods and land, and have need of nothing; and you are not conscious of your sad and unhappy condition, that you are poor and blind and without clothing.

chinese: 我勸你向我買火煉的金子，叫你富足；又買白衣穿上，叫你赤身的羞恥不露出來；又買眼藥擦你的眼睛，使你能看見。
english: If you are wise you will get from me gold tested by fire, so that you may have true wealth; and white robes to put on, so that your shame may not be seen; and oil for your eyes, so that you may see.

chinese: 凡我所疼愛的，我就責備管教他；所以你要發熱心，也要悔改。
english: To all those who are dear to me, I give sharp words and punishment: then with all your heart have sorrow for your evil ways.

chinese: 看哪，我站在門外叩門，若有聽見我聲音就開門的，我要進到他那裡去，我與他他與我一同坐席。
english: See, I am waiting at the door and giving the sign; if my voice comes to any man's ears and he makes the door open, I will come in to him, and will take food with him and he with me.

chinese: 得勝的，我要賜他在我寶座上與我同坐，就如我得了勝，在我父的寶座上與他同坐一般。
english: To him who overcomes I will give a place with me on my high seat, even as I overcame, and am seated with my Father on his high seat.

chinese: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！
english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.

chinese: 此後，我觀看，見天上有門開了。我初次聽見好像吹號的聲音，對我說：你上到這裡來，我要將以後必成的事指示你。
english: After these things I saw a door open in heaven, and the first voice came to my ears, like the sound of a horn, saying, Come up here, and I will make clear to you the things which are to come.

chinese: 我立刻被聖靈感動，見有一個寶座安置在天上，又有一位坐在寶座上。
english: Straight away I was in the Spirit: and I saw a high seat in heaven, and one was seated on it;

chinese: 看那坐著的，好像碧玉和紅寶石；又有虹圍著寶座，好像綠寶石。
english: And to my eyes he was like a jasper and a sardius stone: and there was an arch of light round the high seat, like an emerald.

chinese: 寶座的周圍又有二十四個座位；其上坐著二十四位長老，身穿白衣，頭上戴著金冠冕。
english: And round about the high seat were four and twenty seats: and on them I saw four and twenty rulers seated, clothed in white robes; and on their heads crowns of gold.

chinese: 有閃電、聲音、雷轟從寶座中發出；又有七盞火燈在寶座前點著；這七燈就是神的七靈。
english: And out of the high seat came flames and voices and thunders. And seven lights of fire were burning before the high seat, which are the seven Spirits of God;

chinese: 寶座前好像一個玻璃海，如同水晶。寶座中和寶座周圍有四個活物，前後遍體都滿了眼睛。
english: And before the high seat there was, as it seemed, a clear sea of glass; and in the middle of the high seat, and round about it, four beasts full of eyes round about.

chinese: 第一個活物像獅子，第二個像牛犢，第三個臉面像人，第四個像飛鷹。
english: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second like an ox, and the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.

chinese: 四活物各有六個翅膀，遍體內外都滿了眼睛。他們晝夜不住的說：聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！主神是昔在、今在、以後永在的全能者。
english: And the four beasts, having every one of them six wings, are full of eyes round about and inside: and without resting day and night, they say, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God, Ruler of all, who was and is and is to come.

chinese: 每逢四活物將榮耀、尊貴、感謝歸給那坐在寶座上、活到永永遠遠者的時候，
english: And when the beasts give glory and honour to him who is seated on the high seat, to him who is living for ever and ever,

chinese: 那二十四位長老就俯伏在坐寶座的面前敬拜那活到永永遠遠的，又把他們的冠冕放在寶座前，說：
english: The four and twenty rulers go down on their faces before him who is seated on the high seat, and give worship to him who is living for ever and ever, and take off their crowns before the high seat, saying,

chinese: 我們的主，我們的神，你是配得榮耀、尊貴、權柄的；因為你創造了萬物，並且萬物是因你的旨意被創造而有的。
english: It is right, our Lord and our God, for you to have glory and honour and power: because by you were all things made, and by your desire they came into being.

chinese: 我看見坐寶座的右手中有書卷，裡外都寫著字，用七印封嚴了。
english: And I saw in the right hand of him who was seated on the high seat, a book with writing inside it and on the back, shut with seven stamps of wax.

chinese: 我又看見一位大力的天使大聲宣傳說：有誰配展開那書卷，揭開那七印呢？
english: And I saw a strong angel saying in a loud voice, Who is able to make the book open, and to undo its stamps?

chinese: 在天上、地上、地底下，沒有能展開、能觀看那書卷的。
english: And no one in heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to get the book open, or to see what was in it.

chinese: 因為沒有配展開、配觀看那書卷的，我就大哭。
english: And I was very sad, because there was no one able to get the book open or to see what was in it.

chinese: 長老中有一位對我說：不要哭。看哪，猶大支派中的獅子，大衛的根，他已得勝，能以展開那書卷，揭開那七印。
english: And one of the rulers said to me, Do not be sad: see, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome, and has power to undo the book and its seven stamps.

chinese: 我又看見寶座與四活物，並長老之中有羔羊站立，像是被殺過的，有七角七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往普天下去的。
english: And I saw in the middle of the high seat and of the four beasts, and in the middle of the rulers, a Lamb in his place, which seemed as if it had been put to death, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

chinese: 這羔羊前來，從坐寶座的右手裡拿了書卷。
english: And he came and took it out of the right hand of him who was seated on the high seat.

chinese: 他既拿了書卷，四活物和二十四位長老就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿著琴和盛滿了香的金爐；這香就是眾聖徒的祈禱。
english: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and the four and twenty rulers went down on their faces before the Lamb, having every one an instrument of music, and gold vessels full of perfumes, which are the prayers of the saints.

chinese: 他們唱新歌，說：你配拿書卷，配揭開七印；因為你曾被殺，用自己的血從各族、各方、各民、各國中買了人來，叫他們歸於神，
english: And their voices are sounding in a new song, saying, It is right for you to take the book and to make it open: for you were put to death and have made an offering to God of your blood for men of every tribe, and language, and people, and nation,

chinese: 又叫他們成為國民，作祭司歸於神，在地上執掌王權。
english: And have made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they are ruling on the earth.

chinese: 我又看見且聽見，寶座與活物並長老的周圍有許多天使的聲音；他們的數目有千千萬萬，
english: And I saw, and there came to my ears the sound of a great number of angels round about the high seat and the beasts and the rulers; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

chinese: 大聲說：曾被殺的羔羊是配得權柄、豐富、智慧、能力、尊貴、榮耀、頌讚的。
english: Saying with a great voice, It is right to give to the Lamb who was put to death, power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and blessing.

chinese: 我又聽見在天上、地上、地底下、滄海裡，和天地間一切所有被造之物，都說：但願頌讚、尊貴、榮耀、權勢都歸給坐寶座的和羔羊，直到永永遠遠！
english: And to my ears came the voice of everything in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and of all things which are in them, saying, To him who is seated on the high seat, and to the Lamb, may blessing and honour and glory and power be given for ever and ever.

chinese: 四活物就說：阿們！眾長老也俯伏敬拜。
english: And the four beasts said, So be it. And the rulers went down on their faces and gave worship.

chinese: 我看見羔羊揭開七印中第一印的時候，就聽見四活物中的一個活物，聲音如雷，說：你來！
english: And I saw when the Lamb undid one of the stamps, and the voice of one of the four beasts came to my ears, saying as with a voice of thunder, Come and see.

chinese: 我就觀看，見有一匹白馬；騎在馬上的，拿著弓，並有冠冕賜給他。他便出來，勝了又要勝。
english: And I saw a white horse, and he who was seated on it had a bow; and there was given to him a crown: and he went out with power to overcome.

chinese: 揭開第二印的時候，我聽見第二個活物說：你來。
english: And when the second stamp was undone, the voice of the second beast came to my ears, saying, Come and see.

chinese: 就另有一匹馬出來，是紅的，有權柄給了那騎馬的，可以從地上奪去太平，使人彼此相殺；又有一把大刀賜給他。
english: And another horse came out, a red horse; and it was given to him who was seated on it to take peace from the earth, so that people might put one another to death: and there was given to him a great sword.

chinese: 揭開第三印的時候，我聽見第三個活物說：你來！我就觀看，見有一匹黑馬；騎在馬上的，手裡拿著天平。
english: And when the third stamp was undone, the voice of the third beast came to my ears, saying, Come and see. And I saw a black horse; and he who was seated on it had scales in his hand.

chinese: 我聽見在四活物中似乎有聲音說：一錢銀子買一升麥子，一錢銀子買三升大麥；油和酒不可糟蹋。
english: And a voice came to my ears, from the middle of the four beasts, saying, A measure of grain for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny: and see that you do no damage to the oil and the wine.

chinese: 揭開第四印的時候，我聽見第四個活物說：你來！
english: And when the fourth stamp was undone, the voice of the fourth beast came to my ears, saying, Come and see.

chinese: 我就觀看，見有一匹灰色馬；騎在馬上的，名字叫作死，陰府也隨著他；有權柄賜給他們，可以用刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫（或作：死亡）、野獸，殺害地上四分之一的人。
english: And I saw a grey horse, and the name of him who was seated on it was Death; and Hell came after him. And there was given to them authority over the fourth part of the earth, to put to destruction by the sword, and by taking away their food, and by death, and by the beasts of the earth.

chinese: 揭開第五印的時候，我看見在祭壇底下，有為神的道、並為作見證被殺之人的靈魂，
english: And when the fifth stamp was undone, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been put to death for the word of God, and for the witness which they kept.

chinese: 大聲喊著說：聖潔真實的主阿，你不審判住在地上的人，給我們伸流血的冤，要等到幾時呢？
english: And they gave a great cry, saying, How long will it be, O Ruler, holy and true, before you take your place as judge and give punishment for our blood to those on the earth?

chinese: 於是有白衣賜給他們各人；又有話對他們說，還要安息片時，等著一同作僕人的和他們的弟兄也像他們被殺，滿足了數目。
english: And there was given to every one a white robe, and they were ordered to take their rest for a little time, till the number was complete of the other servants, their brothers, who would be put to death, even as they had been.

chinese: 揭開第六印的時候，我又看見地大震動，日頭變黑像毛布，滿月變紅像血，
english: And I saw when the sixth stamp was undone, and there was a great earth-shock; and the sun became black as haircloth, and all the moon became as blood;

chinese: 天上的星辰墜落於地，如同無花果樹被大風搖動，落下未熟的果子一樣。
english: And the stars of heaven were falling to the earth, like green fruit from a tree before the force of a great wind.

chinese: 天就挪移，好像書卷被捲起來；山嶺海島都被挪移離開本位。
english: And the heaven was taken away like the roll of a book when it is rolled up; and all the mountains and islands were moved out of their places.

chinese: 地上的君王、臣宰、將軍、富戶、壯士，和一切為奴的、自主的，都藏在山洞和巖石穴裡，
english: And the kings of the earth, and the rulers, and the chief captains, and the men of wealth, and the strong, and every servant and free man, took cover in the holes and the rocks of the mountains;

chinese: 向山和巖石說：倒在我們身上罷！把我們藏起來，躲避坐寶座者的面目和羔羊的忿怒；
english: And they say to the mountains and to the rocks, Come down on us, covering us from the face of him who is seated on the high seat, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

chinese: 因為他們忿怒的大日到了，誰能站得住呢？
english: For the great day of their wrath is come, and who may keep his place?

chinese: 此後，我看見四位天使站在地的四角，執掌地上四方的風，叫風不吹在地上、海上，和樹上。
english: After this I saw four angels in their places at the four points of the earth, keeping back the four winds in their hands, so that there might be no moving of the wind on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

chinese: 我又看見另有一位天使，從日出之地上來，拿著永生神的印。他就向那得著權柄能傷害地和海的四位天使大聲喊著說：
english: And I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the mark of the living God: and he said with a great voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to do damage to the earth and the sea,

chinese: 地與海並樹木，你們不可傷害，等我們印了我們神眾僕人的額。
english: Do no damage to the earth, or the sea, or the trees, till we have put a mark on the servants of our God.

chinese: 我聽見以色列人各支派中受印的數目有十四萬四千。
english: And there came to my ears the number of those who had the mark on their brows, a hundred and forty-four thousand, who were marked out of every tribe of the people of Israel.

chinese: 猶大支派中受印的有一萬二千；流便支派中有一萬二千；迦得支派中有一萬二千；
english: Of the tribe of Judah were marked twelve thousand: of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand: of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand:

chinese: 亞設支派中有一萬二千；拿弗他利支派中有一萬二千；瑪拿西支派中有一萬二千；
english: Of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand: of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand: of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand:

chinese: 西緬支派中有一萬二千；利未支派中有一萬二千；以薩迦支派中有一萬二千；
english: Of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand: of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand: of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand:

chinese: 西布倫支派中有一萬二千；約瑟支派中有一萬二千；便雅憫支派中受印的有一萬二千。
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand: of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand: of the tribe of Benjamin were marked twelve thousand.

chinese: 此後，我觀看，見有許多的人，沒有人能數過來，是從各國、各族、各民、各方來的，站在寶座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕樹枝，
english: After these things I saw a great army of people more than might be numbered, out of every nation and of all tribes and peoples and languages, taking their places before the high seat and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, and with branches in their hands,

chinese: 大聲喊著說：願救恩歸與坐在寶座上我們的神，也歸與羔羊！
english: Saying with a loud voice, Salvation to our God who is seated on the high seat, and to the Lamb.

chinese: 眾天使都站在寶座和眾長老並四活物的周圍，在寶座前，面伏於地，敬拜神，
english: And all the angels were round about the high seat, and about the rulers and the four beasts; and they went down on their faces before the high seat, and gave worship to God, saying,

chinese: 說：阿們！頌讚、榮耀、智慧、感謝、尊貴、權柄、大力都歸與我們的神，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
english: So be it. Let blessing and glory and wisdom and praise and honour and power and strength be given to our God for ever and ever. So be it.

chinese: 長老中有一位問我說：這些穿白衣的是誰？是從那裡來的？
english: And one of the rulers made answer, saying to me, These who have on white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?

chinese: 我對他說：我主，你知道。他向我說：這些人是從大患難中出來的，曾用羔羊的血把衣裳洗白淨了。
english: And I said to him, My lord, you have knowledge. And he said to me, These are they who came through the great testing, and their robes have been washed and made white in the blood of the Lamb.

chinese: 所以，他們在神寶座前，晝夜在他殿中事奉他。坐寶座的要用帳幕覆庇他們。
english: This is why they are before the high seat of God; and they are his servants day and night in his house: and he who is seated on the high seat will be a tent over them.

chinese: 他們不再飢，不再渴；日頭和炎熱也必不傷害他們。
english: They will never be in need of food or drink: and they will never again be troubled by the burning heat of the sun:

chinese: 因為寶座中的羔羊必牧養他們，領他們到生命水的泉源；神也必擦去他們一切的眼淚。
english: For the Lamb who is on the high seat will be their keeper and their guide to fountains of living water: and God will make glad their eyes for ever.

chinese: 羔羊揭開第七印的時候，天上寂靜約有二刻。
english: And when the seventh stamp was undone there was quiet in heaven for about half an hour.

chinese: 我看見那站在神面前的七位天使，有七枝號賜給他們。
english: And I saw the seven angels who had their place before God; and seven horns were given to them.

chinese: 另有一位天使，拿著金香爐來，站在祭壇旁邊。有許多香賜給他，要和眾聖徒的祈禱一同獻在寶座前的金壇上。
english: And another angel came and took his place at the altar, having a gold vessel for burning perfume; and there was given to him much perfume, so that he might put it with the prayers of all the saints on the gold altar which was before the high seat.

chinese: 那香的煙和眾聖徒的祈禱從天使的手中一同升到神面前。
english: And the smoke of the perfume, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel's hand.

chinese: 天使拿著香爐，盛滿了壇上的火，倒在地上；隨有雷轟、大聲、閃電、地震。
english: And the angel took the vessel; and he made it full of the fire of the altar, and sent it down on the earth: and there came thunders and voices and flames and a shaking of the earth.

chinese: 拿著七枝號的七位天使就預備要吹。
english: And the seven angels who had the seven horns made ready for sounding them.

chinese: 第一位天使吹號，就有雹子與火攙著血丟在地上；地的三分之一和樹的三分之一被燒了，一切的青草也被燒了。
english: And at the sounding of the first, a rain of ice and fire, mixed with blood, was sent on the earth: and a third part of the earth, and of the trees, and all green grass was burned up.

chinese: 第二位天使吹號，就有彷彿火燒著的大山扔在海中；海的三分之一變成血，
english: And at the sounding of the second angel, it was as if a great mountain burning with fire was sent into the sea: and a third part of the sea became blood,

chinese: 海中的活物死了三分之一，船隻也壞了三分之一。
english: And destruction came on a third part of the living things which were in the sea, and on a third part of the ships.

chinese: 第三位天使吹號，就有燒著的大星，好像火把從天上落下來，落在江河的三分之一和眾水的泉源上。
english: And at the sounding of the third angel, there went down from heaven a great star, burning like a flame, and it came on a third part of the rivers, and on the fountains of water.

chinese: 這星名叫茵蔯。眾水的三分之一變為茵蔯；因水變苦，就死了許多人。
english: And the name of the star is Wormwood: and a third part of the waters became bitter; and a number of men came to their end because of the waters, for they were made bitter.

chinese: 第四位天使吹號，日頭的三分之一，月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一都被擊打，以致日月星的三分之一黑暗了，白晝的三分之一沒有光，黑夜也是這樣。
english: And at the sounding of the fourth angel, a third part of the sun, and of the moon, and of the stars was made dark, so that there was no light for a third part of the day and of the night.

chinese: 我又看見一個鷹飛在空中，並聽見他大聲說：三位天使要吹那其餘的號。你們住在地上的民，禍哉！禍哉！禍哉！
english: And there came to my ears the cry of an eagle in flight in the middle of heaven, saying with a great voice, Trouble, trouble, trouble, to all on the earth, because of the other voices of the horns of the three angels, whose sounding is still to come.

chinese: 第五位天使吹號，我就看見一個星從天落到地上，有無底坑的鑰匙賜給他。
english: And at the sounding of the fifth angel I saw a star falling from heaven to the earth: and there was given to him the key of the great deep.

chinese: 他開了無底坑，便有煙從坑裡往上冒，好像大火爐的煙；日頭和天空都因這煙昏暗了。
english: And he made the great deep open and a smoke went up from it, like the smoke of a great oven; and the sun and the air were made dark because of the smoke.

chinese: 有蝗蟲從煙中出來，飛到地上；有能力賜給他們，好像地上蠍子的能力一樣，
english: And from the smoke locusts came out on the earth; and power was given them, like the power of scorpions.

chinese: 並且吩咐他們說，不可傷害地上的草和各樣青物，並一切樹木，惟獨要傷害額上沒有神印記的人。
english: And they were ordered to do no damage to the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only to such men as have not the mark of God on their brows.

chinese: 但不許蝗蟲害死他們，只叫他們受痛苦五個月。這痛苦就像蠍子螫人的痛苦一樣。
english: And orders were given them not to put them to death, but to give them great pain for five months: and their pain was as the pain from the wound of a scorpion.

chinese: 在那些日子，人要求死，決不得死；願意死，死卻遠避他們。
english: And in those days men will be hoping for death, and it will not come to them; and they will have a great desire for death, and death will go in flight from them.

chinese: 蝗蟲的形狀，好像預備出戰的馬一樣，頭上戴的好像金冠冕，臉面好像男人的臉面，
english: And the forms of the locusts were like horses made ready for war; and on their heads they had crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.

chinese: 頭髮像女人的頭髮，牙齒像獅子的牙齒。
english: And they had hair like the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

chinese: 胸前有甲，好像鐵甲。他們翅膀的聲音，好像許多車馬奔跑上陣的聲音。
english: And they had breastplates like iron, and the sound of their wings was as the sound of carriages, like an army of horses rushing to the fight.

chinese: 有尾巴像蠍子，尾巴上的毒鉤能傷人五個月。
english: And they have pointed tails like scorpions; and in their tails is their power to give men wounds for five months.

chinese: 有無底坑的使者作他們的王，按著希伯來話，名叫亞巴頓，希利尼話，名叫亞玻倫。
english: They have over them as king the angel of the great deep: his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in the Greek language Apollyon.

chinese: 第一樣災禍過去了，還有兩樣災禍要來。
english: The first Trouble is past: see, there are still two Troubles to come.

chinese: 第六位天使吹號，我就聽見有聲音從神面前金壇的四角出來，
english: And at the sounding of the sixth angel a voice came to my ears from the horns of the gold altar which is before God,

chinese: 吩咐那吹號的第六位天使，說：把那捆綁在伯拉大河的四個使者釋放了。
english: Saying to the sixth angel who had the horn, Make free the four angels who are chained at the great river Euphrates.

chinese: 那四個使者就被釋放；他們原是預備好了，到某年某月某日某時，要殺人的三分之一。
english: And the four angels were made free, who were ready for the hour and day and month and year, that they might put to death a third part of men.

chinese: 馬軍有二萬萬；他們的數目我聽見了。
english: And the number of the armies of the horsemen was twice ten thousand times ten thousand: the number of them came to my ears.

chinese: 我在異象中看見那些馬和騎馬的，騎馬的胸前有甲如火，與紫瑪瑙並硫磺。馬的頭好像獅子頭，有火、有煙、有硫磺從馬的口中出來。
english: And so I saw the horses in the vision, and those who were seated on them, having breastplates of fire and glass and of burning stone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths came fire and smoke and a smell of burning.

chinese: 口中所出來的火與煙並硫磺，這三樣災殺了人的三分之一。
english: By these evils a third part of men was put to death, by the fire, and the smoke, and the burning smell which came out of their mouths.

chinese: 這馬的能力是在口裡和尾巴上；因這尾巴像蛇，並且有頭用以害人。
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails: because their tails are like snakes, and have heads, and with them they give wounds.

chinese: 其餘未曾被這些災所殺的人仍舊不悔改自己手所做的，還是去拜鬼魔和那些不能看、不能聽、不能走，金、銀、銅、木、石的偶像，
english: And the rest of the people, who were not put to death by these evils, were not turned from the works of their hands, but went on giving worship to evil spirits, and images of gold and silver and brass and stone and wood which have no power of seeing or hearing or walking:

chinese: 又不悔改他們那些兇殺、邪術、姦淫、偷竊的事。
english: And they had no regret for putting men to death, or for their use of secret arts, or for the evil desires of the flesh, or for taking the property of others.

chinese: 我又看見另有一位大力的天使從天降下，披著雲彩，頭上有虹，臉面像日頭，兩腳像火柱。
english: And I saw another strong angel coming down out of heaven, clothed with a cloud; and an arch of coloured light was round his head, and his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire;

chinese: 他手裡拿著小書卷，是展開的。他右腳踏海，左腳踏地，
english: And he had in his hand a little open book: and he put his right foot on the sea, and his left on the earth;

chinese: 大聲呼喊，好像獅子吼叫。呼喊完了，就有七雷發聲。
english: And he gave a loud cry, like the angry voice of a lion: and at his cry the voices of the seven thunders were sounding.

chinese: 七雷發聲之後，我正要寫出來，就聽見從天上有聲音說：七雷所說的，你要封上，不可寫出來。
english: And when the seven thunders had given out their voices, I was about to put their words down: and a voice from heaven came to my ears, saying, Keep secret the things which the seven thunders said, and do not put them in writing.

chinese: 我所看見的那踏海踏地的天使向天舉起右手來，
english: And the angel which I saw taking his position on the sea and on the earth, put up his right hand to heaven,

chinese: 指著那創造天和天上之物，地和地上之物，海和海中之物，直活到永永遠遠的，起誓說：不再有時日了（或作：不再耽延了）。
english: And took his oath by him who is living for ever and ever, who made the heaven and the things in it, and the earth and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it, that there would be no more waiting:

chinese: 但在第七位天使吹號發聲的時候，神的奧祕就成全了，正如神所傳給他僕人眾先知的佳音。
english: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when the sound of his horn is about to come, then will the secret of God be complete, of which he gave the good news to his servants the prophets.

chinese: 我先前從天上所聽見的那聲音又吩咐我說：你去，把那踏海踏地之天使手中展開的小書卷取過來。
english: And the voice came to me again from heaven, saying, Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who has his place on the sea and on the earth.

chinese: 我就走到天使那裡，對他說：請你把小書卷給我。他對我說：你拿著吃盡了，便叫你肚子發苦，然而在你口中要甜如蜜。
english: And I went to the angel, and said to him, Give me the little book. And he said to me: Put it in your mouth; and it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.

chinese: 我從天使手中把小書卷接過來，吃盡了，在我口中果然甜如蜜，吃了以後，肚子覺得發苦了。
english: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand and did as he said; and it was sweet as honey in my mouth: and when I had taken it, my stomach was made bitter.

chinese: 天使（原文是他們）對我說：你必指著多民、多國、多方、多王再說預言。
english: And they said to me, You are to give word again of what is coming in the future to the peoples and nations and languages and kings.

chinese: 有一根葦子賜給我，當作量度的杖，且有話說：起來！將神的殿和祭壇，並在殿中禮拜的人都量一量。
english: And there was given to me a measuring rod: and one said, Go up and take the measure of the house of God, and the altar, and the worshippers in it.

chinese: 只是殿外的院子要留下不用量，因為這是給了外邦人的；他們要踐踏聖城四十二個月。
english: But do not take the measure of the space outside the house; because it has been given to the nations: and the holy town will be under their feet for forty-two months.

chinese: 我要使我那兩個見證人，穿著毛衣，傳道一千二百六十天。
english: And I will give orders to my two witnesses, and they will be prophets for a thousand, two hundred and sixty days, clothed with haircloth.

chinese: 他們就是那兩棵橄欖樹，兩個燈臺，立在世界之主面前的。
english: These are the two olive-trees and the two lights, which are before the Lord of the earth.

chinese: 若有人想要害他們，就有火從他們口中出來，燒滅仇敵。凡想要害他們的都必這樣被殺。
english: And if any man would do them damage, fire comes out of their mouth and puts an end to those who are working against them: and if any man has a desire to do them damage, in this way will he be put to death.

chinese: 這二人有權柄，在他們傳道的日子叫天閉塞不下雨；又有權柄叫水變為血，並且能隨時隨意用各樣的災殃攻擊世界。
english: These have the power to keep the heaven shut, so that there may be no rain in the days when they are prophets: and they have power over the waters to make them into blood, and to send every sort of disease on the earth as their pleasure is.

chinese: 他們作完見證的時候，那從無底坑裡上來的獸必與他們交戰，並且得勝，把他們殺了。
english: And when they have come to the end of their witness, the beast which comes up out of the great deep will make war on them and overcome them and put them to death.

chinese: 他們的屍首就倒在大城裡的街上；這城按著靈意叫所多瑪，又叫埃及，就是他們的主釘十字架之處。
english: And their dead bodies will be in the open street of the great town, which in the spirit is named Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord was put to death on the cross.

chinese: 從各民、各族、各方、各國中，有人觀看他們的屍首三天半，又不許把屍首放在墳墓裡。
english: And the peoples and tribes and languages and nations will be looking on their dead bodies three days and a half, and will not let their dead bodies be put in the earth.

chinese: 住在地上的人就為他們歡喜快樂，互相餽送禮物，因這兩位先知曾叫住在地上的人受痛苦。
english: And those who are on the earth will have pleasure and delight over them; and they will send offerings one to another because these two prophets gave great trouble to all on the earth.

chinese: 過了這三天半，有生氣從神那裡進入他們裡面，他們就站起來；看見他們的人甚是害怕。
english: And after three days and a half the breath of life from God went into them, and they got up on their feet; and great fear came on those who saw them.

chinese: 兩位先知聽見有大聲音從天上來，對他們說：上到這裡來。他們就駕著雲上了天，他們的仇敵也看見了。
english: And a great voice from heaven came to their ears, saying to them, Come up here. And they went up into heaven in the cloud, and were seen by those desiring their death.

chinese: 正在那時候，地大震動，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的有七千人；其餘的都恐懼，歸榮耀給天上的神。
english: And in that hour there was a great earth-shock and a tenth part of the town came to destruction; and in the earth-shock seven thousand persons came to their end: and the rest were in fear, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

chinese: 第二樣災禍過去，第三樣災禍快到了。
english: The second Trouble is past: see, the third Trouble comes quickly.

chinese: 第七位天使吹號，天上就有大聲音說：世上的國成了我主和主基督的國；他要作王，直到永永遠遠。
english: And at the sounding of the seventh angel there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ, and he will have rule for ever and ever.

chinese: 在神面前，坐在自己位上的二十四位長老，就面伏於地，敬拜神，
english: And the four and twenty rulers, who are seated before God on their high seats, went down on their faces and gave worship to God, saying,

chinese: 說：昔在、今在的主神─全能者阿，我們感謝你！因你執掌大權作王了。
english: We give you praise, O Lord God, Ruler of all, who is and who was; because you have taken up your great power and are ruling your kingdom.

chinese: 外邦發怒，你的忿怒也臨到了；審判死人的時候也到了。你的僕人眾先知和眾聖徒，凡敬畏你名的人，連大帶小得賞賜的時候也到了。你敗壞那些敗壞世界之人的時候也就到了。
english: And the nations were angry, and your wrath has come, and the time for the dead to be judged, and the time of reward for your servants, the prophets, and for the saints, and for those in whom is the fear of your name, small and great, and the time of destruction for those who made the earth unclean.

chinese: 當時，神天上的殿開了，在他殿中現出他的約櫃。隨後有閃電、聲音、雷轟、地震、大雹。
english: And the house of God which is in heaven was open; and the ark of his agreement was seen in his house, and there were flames and voices and thunders and an earth-shock and a rain of ice.

chinese: 天上現出大異象來：有一個婦人身披日頭，腳踏月亮，頭戴十二星的冠冕。
english: And a great sign was seen in heaven: a A woman clothed with the sun, and with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

chinese: 他懷了孕，在生產的艱難中疼痛呼叫。
english: And she was with child; and she gave a cry, in the pains of childbirth.

chinese: 天上又現出異象來：有一條大紅龍，七頭十角；七頭上戴著七個冠冕。
english: And there was seen another sign in heaven; a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

chinese: 他的尾巴拖拉著天上星辰的三分之一，摔在地上。龍就站在那將要生產的婦人面前，等他生產之後，要吞吃他的孩子。
english: And his tail was pulling a third part of the stars of heaven down to the earth, and the dragon took his place before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when the birth had taken place he might put an end to her child.

chinese: 婦人生了一個男孩子，是將來要用鐵杖轄管（轄管：原文是牧）萬國的；他的孩子被提到神寶座那裡去了。
english: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who was to have rule over all the nations with a rod of iron: and her child was taken up to God and to his high seat.

chinese: 婦人就逃到曠野，在那裡有神給他預備的地方，使他被養活一千二百六十天。
english: And the woman went in flight to the waste land, where she has a place made ready by God, so that there they may give her food a thousand, two hundred and sixty days.

chinese: 在天上就有了爭戰。米迦勒同他的使者與龍爭戰，龍也同他的使者去爭戰，
english: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels going out to the fight with the dragon; and the dragon and his angels made war,

chinese: 並沒有得勝，天上再沒有他們的地方。
english: And they were overcome, and there was no more place for them in heaven.

chinese: 大龍就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的。他被摔在地上，他的使者也一同被摔下去。
english: And the great dragon was forced down, the old snake, who is named the Evil One and Satan, by whom all the earth is turned from the right way; he was forced down to the earth, and his angels were forced down with him.

chinese: 我聽見在天上有大聲音說：我神的救恩、能力、國度、並他基督的權柄，現在都來到了！因為那在我們神面前晝夜控告我們弟兄的，已經被摔下去了。
english: And a great voice in heaven came to my ears, saying, Now is come the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ: because he who says evil against our brothers before our God day and night is forced down.

chinese: 弟兄勝過他，是因羔羊的血和自己所見證的道。他們雖至於死，也不愛惜性命。
english: And they overcame him through the blood of the Lamb and the word of their witness; and loving not their lives they freely gave themselves up to death.

chinese: 所以，諸天和住在其中的，你們都快樂罷！只是地與海有禍了！因為魔鬼知道自己的時候不多，就氣忿忿的下到你們那裡去了。
english: Be glad then, O heavens, and you who are in them. But there is trouble for the earth and the sea: because the Evil One has come down to you, being very angry, having the knowledge that he has but a short time.

chinese: 龍見自己被摔在地上，就逼迫那生男孩子的婦人。
english: And when the dragon saw that he was forced down to the earth, he made cruel attacks on the woman who gave birth to the male child.

chinese: 於是有大鷹的兩個翅膀賜給婦人，叫他能飛到曠野，到自己的地方，躲避那蛇；他在那裡被養活一載二載半載。
english: And there were given to the woman two wings of a great eagle, so that she might go in flight into the waste land, to her place, where she is given food for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the snake.

chinese: 蛇就在婦人身後，從口中吐出水來，像河一樣，要將婦人沖去。
english: And the snake sent out of his mouth after the woman a river of water, so that she might be taken away by the stream.

chinese: 地卻幫助婦人，開口吞了從龍口吐出來的水（原文作河）。
english: And the earth gave help to the woman, and with open mouth took up the river which the dragon sent out of his mouth.

chinese: 龍向婦人發怒，去與他其餘的兒女爭戰，這兒女就是那守神誡命、為耶穌作見證的。那時龍就站在海邊的沙上。
english: And the dragon was angry with the woman and went away to make war on the rest of her seed, who keep the orders of God, and the witness of Jesus:

chinese: 我又看見一個獸從海中上來，有十角七頭，在十角上戴著十個冠冕，七頭上有褻瀆的名號。
english: And he took his place on the sand of the sea. And I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and on his horns ten crowns, and on his heads unholy names.

chinese: 我所看見的獸，形狀像豹，腳像熊的腳，口像獅子的口。那龍將自己的能力、座位、和大權柄都給了他。
english: And the beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power and his seat and great authority.

chinese: 我看見獸的七頭中，有一個似乎受了死傷，那死傷卻醫好了。全地的人都希奇跟從那獸，
english: And I saw one of his heads as if it had been given a death-wound; and his death-wound was made well: and all the earth was wondering at the beast.

chinese: 又拜那龍─因為他將自己的權柄給了獸，也拜獸，說：誰能比這獸，誰能與他交戰呢？
english: And they gave worship to the dragon, because he gave authority to the beast; and worshipping the beast, they said, Who is like the beast? and who is able to go to war with him?

chinese: 又賜給他說誇大褻瀆話的口，又有權柄賜給他，可以任意而行四十二個月。
english: And there was given to him a mouth to say words of pride against God; and there was given to him authority to go on for forty-two months.

chinese: 獸就開口向神說褻瀆的話，褻瀆神的名並他的帳幕，以及那些住在天上的。
english: And his mouth was open to say evil against God, and against his name and his Tent, even against those who are in heaven.

chinese: 又任憑他與聖徒爭戰，並且得勝；也把權柄賜給他，制伏各族、各民、各方、各國。
english: And it was given to him to make war on the saints and to overcome them: and there was given to him authority over every tribe and people and language and nation.

chinese: 凡住在地上、名字從創世以來沒有記在被殺之羔羊生命冊上的人，都要拜他。
english: And all who are on the earth will give him worship, everyone whose name has not been from the first in the book of life of the Lamb who was put to death.

chinese: 凡有耳的，就應當聽！
english: If any man has ears, let him give ear.

chinese: 擄掠人的，必被擄掠；用刀殺人的，必被刀殺。聖徒的忍耐和信心就是在此。
english: If any man sends others into prison, into prison he will go: if any man puts to death with the sword, with the sword will he be put to death. Here is the quiet strength and the faith of the saints.

chinese: 我又看見另有一個獸從地中上來有兩角如同羊羔，說話好像龍。
english: And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and his voice was like that of a dragon.

chinese: 他在頭一個獸面前，施行頭一個獸所有的權柄，並且叫地和住在地上的人拜那死傷醫好的頭一個獸。
english: And he makes use of all the authority of the first beast before his eyes. And he makes the earth and those who are in it give worship to the first beast, whose death-wound was made well.

chinese: 又行大奇事，甚至在人面前，叫火從天降在地上。
english: And he does great signs, even making fire come down from heaven on the earth before the eyes of men.

chinese: 他因賜給他權柄在獸面前能行奇事，就迷惑住在地上的人，說：要給那受刀傷還活著的獸作個像。
english: And those who are on the earth are turned from the true way by him through the signs which he was given power to do before the beast; giving orders to those who are on the earth to make an image to the beast, who was wounded by the sword, and came to life.

chinese: 又有權柄賜給他，叫獸像有生氣，並且能說話，又叫所有不拜獸像的人都被殺害。
english: And he had power to give breath to the image of the beast, so that words might come from the image of the beast, and that he might have all those who did not give worship to the image of the beast put to death.

chinese: 他又叫眾人，無論大小、貧富、自主的、為奴的，都在右手上或是在額上受一個印記。
english: And he gives to all, small and great, the poor and those who have wealth, the free and those who are not free, a mark on their right hand or on their brows;

chinese: 除了那受印記、有了獸名或有獸名數目的，都不得做買賣。
english: So that no man might be able to do trade but he who has the mark, even the name of the beast or the number of his name.

chinese: 在這裡有智慧：凡有聰明的，可以算計獸的數目；因為這是人的數目，他的數目是六百六十六。
english: Here is wisdom. He who has knowledge let him get the number of the beast; because it is the number of a man: and his number is Six hundred and sixty-six.

chinese: 我又觀看，見羔羊站在錫安山，同他又有十四萬四千人，都有他的名和他父的名寫在額上。
english: And I saw the Lamb on the mountain of Zion, and with him a hundred and forty-four thousand, marked on their brows with his name and the name of his Father.

chinese: 我聽見從天上有聲音，像眾水的聲音和大雷的聲音，並且我所聽見的好像彈琴的所彈的琴聲。
english: And a voice from heaven came to my ears, like the sound of great waters, and the sound of loud thunder: and the voice which came to me was like the sound of players, playing on instruments of music.

chinese: 他們在寶座前，並在四活物和眾長老前唱歌，彷彿是新歌；除了從地上買來的那十四萬四千人以外，沒有人能學這歌。
english: And they made as it seemed a new song before the high seat, and before the four beasts and the rulers: and no man might have knowledge of the song but the hundred and forty-four thousand, even those from the earth whom God has made his for a price.

chinese: 這些人未曾沾染婦女，他們原是童身。羔羊無論往那裡去，他們都跟隨他。他們是從人間買來的，作初熟的果子歸與神和羔羊。
english: These are they who have not made themselves unclean with women; for they are virgins. These are they who go after the Lamb wherever he goes. These were taken from among men to be the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

chinese: 在他們口中察不出謊言來；他們是沒有瑕疵的。
english: And in their mouth there was no false word, for they are untouched by evil.

chinese: 我又看見另有一位天使飛在空中，有永遠的福音要傳給住在地上的人，就是各國、各族、各方、各民。
english: And I saw another angel in flight between heaven and earth, having eternal good news to give to those who are on the earth, and to every nation and tribe and language and people,

chinese: 他大聲說：應當敬畏神，將榮耀歸給他！因他施行審判的時候已經到了。應當敬拜那創造天地海和眾水泉源的。
english: Saying with a loud voice, Have fear of God and give him glory; because the hour of his judging is come; and give worship to him who made heaven and earth and the sea and the fountains of water.

chinese: 又有第二位天使接著說：叫萬民喝邪淫、大怒之酒的巴比倫大城傾倒了！傾倒了！
english: And a second angel came after, saying, Destruction has come to Babylon the great, which gave to all the nations the wine of the wrath of her evil ways.

chinese: 又有第三位天使接著他們，大聲說：若有人拜獸和獸像，在額上或在手上受了印記，
english: And a third angel came after them, saying with a loud voice, If any man gives worship to the beast and his image, and has his mark on his brow or on his hand,

chinese: 這人也必喝神大怒的酒；此酒斟在神忿怒的杯中純一不雜。他要在聖天使和羔羊面前，在火與硫磺之中受痛苦。
english: To him will be given of the wine of God's wrath which is ready unmixed in the cup of his wrath and he will have cruel pain, burning with fire before the holy angels and before the Lamb:

chinese: 他受痛苦的煙往上冒，直到永永遠遠。那些拜獸和獸像，受他名之印記的，晝夜不得安寧。
english: And the smoke of their pain goes up for ever and ever; and they have no rest day and night, who give worship to the beast and his image, and have on them the mark of his name.

chinese: 聖徒的忍耐就在此；他們是守神誡命和耶穌真道的。
english: Here is the quiet strength of the saints, who keep the orders of God, and the faith of Jesus.

chinese: 我聽見從天上有聲音說：你要寫下：從今以後，在主裡面而死的人有福了！聖靈說：是的，他們息了自己的勞苦，作工的果效也隨著他們。
english: And a voice from heaven came to my ears, saying, Put in writing, There is a blessing on the dead who from now on come to their end in the Lord: yes, says the Spirit, that they may have rest from their troubles; for their works go with them.

chinese: 我又觀看，見有一片白雲，雲上坐著一位好像人子，頭上戴著金冠冕，手裡拿著快鐮刀。
english: And I saw a white cloud, and on the cloud I saw one seated, like a son of man, having on his head a crown of gold, and in his hand a sharp curved blade.

chinese: 又有一位天使從殿中出來，向那坐在雲上的大聲喊著說：伸出你的鐮刀來收割；因為收割的時候已經到了，地上的莊稼已經熟透了。
english: And another angel came out from the house of God, crying with a loud voice to him who was seated on the cloud, Put in your blade, and let the grain be cut: because the hour for cutting it is come; for the grain of the earth is over-ready.

chinese: 那坐在雲上的，就把鐮刀扔在地上，地上的莊稼就被收割了。
english: And he who was seated on the cloud sent in his blade on the earth; and the grain of the earth was cut.

chinese: 又有一位天使從天上的殿中出來，他也拿著快鐮刀。
english: And another angel came out from the house of God which is in heaven, having a sharp curved blade.

chinese: 又有一位天使從祭壇中出來，是有權柄管火的，向拿著快鐮刀的大聲喊著說：伸出快鐮刀來，收取地上葡萄樹的果子，因為葡萄熟透了！
english: And another angel came out from the altar, who has power over fire; and he gave a loud cry to him who had the sharp curved blade, saying, Put in your sharp blade, and let the grapes of the vine of the earth be cut; for her grapes are fully ready.

chinese: 那天使就把鐮刀扔在地上，收取了地上的葡萄，丟在神忿怒的大酒醡中。
english: And the angel sent his blade into the earth, and the vine of the earth was cut, and he put it into the great wine-crusher of the wrath of God.

chinese: 那酒醡踹在城外，就有血從酒醡裡流出來，高到馬的嚼環，遠有六百里。
english: And the grapes were crushed under foot outside the town, and blood came out from them, even to the head-bands of the horses, two hundred miles.

chinese: 我又看見在天上有異象，大而且奇，就是七位天使掌管末了的七災，因為神的大怒在這七災中發盡了。
english: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and strange; seven angels having the seven last punishments, for in them the wrath of God is complete.

chinese: 我看見彷彿有玻璃海，其中有火攙雜。又看見那些勝了獸和獸的像並他名字數目的人，都站在玻璃海上，拿著神的琴，
english: And I saw a sea which seemed like glass mixed with fire; and those who had overcome the beast and his image and the number of his name, were in their places by the sea of glass, with God's instruments of music in their hands.

chinese: 唱神僕人摩西的歌，和羔羊的歌，說：主神─全能者阿，你的作為大哉！奇哉！萬世（或作：國）之王阿，你的道途義哉！誠哉！
english: And they give the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and full of wonder are your works, O Lord God, Ruler of all; true and full of righteousness are your ways, eternal King.

chinese: 主阿，誰敢不敬畏你，不將榮耀歸與你的名呢？因為獨有你是聖的。萬民都要來在你面前敬拜，因你公義的作為已經顯出來了。
english: What man is there who will not have fear before you, O Lord, and give glory to your name? because you only are holy; for all the nations will come and give worship before you; for your righteousness has been made clear.

chinese: 此後，我看見在天上那存法櫃的殿開了。
english: And after these things I saw, and the house of the Tent of witness in heaven was open:

chinese: 那掌管七災的七位天使從殿中出來，穿著潔白光明的細麻衣（細麻衣；有古卷是寶石），胸間束著金帶。
english: And the seven angels who had the seven punishments came out from the house of God, clothed with linen, clean and bright and with bands of gold about their breasts.

chinese: 四活物中有一個把盛滿了活到永永遠遠之神大怒的七個金碗給了那七位天使。
english: And one of the four beasts gave to the seven angels seven gold vessels full of the wrath of God, who is living for ever and ever.

chinese: 因神的榮耀和能力，殿中充滿了煙。於是沒有人能以進殿，直等到那七位天使所降的七災完畢了。
english: And the house of God was full of smoke from the glory of God, and from his power, and no one was able to go into the house of God, till the seven punishments of the seven angels were ended.

chinese: 我聽見有大聲音從殿中出來，向那七位天使說：你們去，把盛神大怒的七碗倒在地上。
english: And a great voice out of the house of God came to my ears, saying to the seven angels, Go, and let that which is in the seven vessels of the wrath of God come down on the earth.

chinese: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有惡而且毒的瘡生在那些有獸印記、拜獸像的人身上。
english: And the first went, and let what was in his vessel come down on the earth; and it became an evil poisoning wound on the men who had the mark of the beast, and who gave worship to his image.

chinese: 第二位天使把碗倒在海裡，海就變成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。
english: And the second let what was in his vessel come out into the sea; and it became blood as of a dead man; and every living thing in the sea came to an end.

chinese: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河與眾水的泉源裡，水就變成血了。
english: And the third let what was in his vessel come out into the rivers and the fountains of water; and they became blood.

chinese: 我聽見掌管眾水的天使說：昔在、今在的聖者阿，你這樣判斷是公義的；
english: And the voice of the angel of the waters came to my ears, saying, True and upright is your judging, O Holy One, who is and was from all time:

chinese: 他們曾流聖徒與先知的血，現在你給他們血喝；這是他們所該受的。
english: For they made the blood of saints and prophets come out like a stream, and blood have you given them for drink; which is their right reward.

chinese: 我又聽見祭壇中有聲音說：是的，主神─全能者阿，你的判斷義哉！誠哉！
english: And a voice came from the altar, saying, Even so, O Lord God, Ruler of all, true and full of righteousness is your judging.

chinese: 第四位天使把碗倒在日頭上，叫日頭能用火烤人。
english: And the fourth let what was in his vessel come out on the sun; and power was given to it that men might be burned with fire.

chinese: 人被大熱所烤，就褻瀆那有權掌管這些災的神之名，並不悔改將榮耀歸給神。
english: And men were burned with great heat: and they said evil things against the name of the God who has authority over these punishments; and they were not turned from their evil ways to give him glory.

chinese: 第五位天使把碗倒在獸的座位上，獸的國就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌頭；
english: And the fifth let what was in his vessel come out on the high seat of the beast; and his kingdom was made dark; and they were biting their tongues for pain.

chinese: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的瘡，就褻瀆天上的神，並不悔改所行的。
english: And they said evil things against the God of heaven because of their pain and their wounds; and they were not turned from their evil works.

chinese: 第六位天使把碗倒在伯拉大河上，河水就乾了，要給那從日出之地所來的眾王預備道路。
english: And the sixth let what was in his vessel come out on the great river Euphrates; and it became dry, so that the way might be made ready for the kings from the east.

chinese: 我又看見三個污穢的靈，好像青蛙，從龍口、獸口並假先知的口中出來。
english: And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, like frogs.

chinese: 他們本是鬼魔的靈，施行奇事，出去到普天下眾王那裡，叫他們在神全能者的大日聚集爭戰。
english: For they are evil spirits, working signs; who go out even to the kings of all the earth, to get them together to the war of the great day of God, the Ruler of all.

chinese: （看哪，我來像賊一樣。那儆醒、看守衣服、免得赤身而行、叫人見他羞恥的有福了！）
english: (See, I come as a thief. Happy is he who is watching and keeps his robes, so that he may not go unclothed, and his shame be seen.)

chinese: 那三個鬼魔便叫眾王聚集在一處，希伯來話叫作哈米吉多頓。
english: And they got them together into the place which is named in Hebrew Armageddon.

chinese: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大聲音從殿中的寶座上出來，說：成了！
english: And the seventh let what was in his vessel come out on the air; and there came out a great voice from the house of God, from the high seat, saying, It is done.

chinese: 又有閃電、聲音、雷轟、大地震，自從地上有人以來，沒有這樣大、這樣利害的地震。
english: And there were flames and voices and thunders; and there was a great earth-shock so that never, from the time when men were on the earth, had there been so great an earth-shock, so full of power.

chinese: 那大城裂為三段，列國的城也都倒塌了；神也想起巴比倫大城來，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯遞給他。
english: And the great town was cut into three parts, and the towns of the nations came to destruction: and Babylon the great came into mind before God, to be given the cup of the wine of his wrath.

chinese: 各海島都逃避了，眾山也不見了.。
english: And every island went in flight, and the mountains were seen no longer.

chinese: 又有大雹子從天落在人身上，每一個約重一他連得（一他連得約有九十斤）。為這雹子的災極大，人就褻瀆神。
english: And great drops of ice, every one about the weight of a talent, came down out of heaven on men: and men said evil things against God because of the punishment of the ice-drops; for it is very great.

chinese: 拿著七碗的七位天使中，有一位前來對我說：你到這裡來，我將坐在眾水上的大淫婦所要受的刑罰指給你看。
english: And one of the seven angels who had the seven vessels came and said to me, Come here, so that you may see the judging of the evil woman who is seated on the great waters;

chinese: 地上的君王與他行淫，住在地上的人喝醉了他淫亂的酒。
english: With whom the kings of the earth made themselves unclean, and those who are on the earth were full of the wine of her evil desires.

chinese: 我被聖靈感動，天使帶我到曠野去，我就看見一個女人騎在朱紅色的獸上；那獸有七頭十角，遍體有褻瀆的名號。
english: And he took me away in the Spirit into a waste land: and I saw a woman seated on a bright red beast, full of evil names, having seven heads and ten horns,

chinese: 那女人穿著紫色和朱紅色的衣服，用金子、寶石、珍珠為妝飾；手拿金杯，杯中盛滿了可憎之物，就是他淫亂的污穢。
english: And the woman was clothed in purple and bright red, with ornaments of gold and stones of great price and jewels; and in her hand was a gold cup full of evil things and her unclean desires;

chinese: 在他額上有名寫著說：奧祕哉！大巴比倫，作世上的淫婦和一切可憎之物的母。
english: And on her brow was a name, SECRET, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE EVIL WOMEN AND OF THE UNCLEAN THINGS OF THE EARTH.

chinese: 我又看見那女人喝醉了聖徒的血和為耶穌作見證之人的血。我看見他，就大大的希奇。
english: And I saw the woman overcome as with the wine of the blood of the saints, and the blood of those put to death because of Jesus. And when I saw her, I was overcome with a great wonder.

chinese: 天使對我說：你為甚麼希奇呢？我要將這女人和馱著他的那七頭十角獸的奧祕告訴你。
english: And the angel said to me, Why were you surprised? I will make clear to you the secret of the woman, and of the beast on which she is seated, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

chinese: 你所看見的獸，先前有，如今沒有，將要從無底坑裡上來，又要歸於沉淪。凡住在地上、名字從創世以來沒有記在生命冊上的，見先前有、如今沒有、以後再有的獸，就必希奇。
english: The beast which you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the great deep, and to go into destruction. And those who are on the earth, whose names have not been put in the book of life from the first, will be full of wonder when they see the beast, that he was, and is not, and still will be.

chinese: 智慧的心在此可以思想。那七頭就是女人所坐的七座山，
english: Here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman is seated:

chinese: 又是七位王；五位已經傾倒了，一位還在，一位還沒有來到；他來的時候，必須暫時存留。
english: And they are seven kings; the five have come to an end, the one is, the other has not come; and when he comes, he will have to go on for a little time.

chinese: 那先前有如今沒有的獸，就是第八位；他也和那七位同列，並且歸於沉淪。
english: And the beast which was, and is not, is himself the eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes into destruction.

chinese: 你所看見的那十角就是十王；他們還沒有得國，但他們一時之間要和獸同得權柄，與王一樣。
english: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, which still have been given no kingdom; but they are given authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.

chinese: 他們同心合意將自己的能力、權柄給那獸。
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

chinese: 他們與羔羊爭戰，羔羊必勝過他們，因為羔羊是萬主之主、萬王之王。同著羔羊的，就是蒙召、被選、有忠心的，也必得勝。
english: These will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, because he is the Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are named, marked out, and true.

chinese: 天使又對我說，你所看見那淫婦坐的眾水，就是多民、多人、多國、多方。
english: And he said to me, The waters which you saw, where the evil woman is seated, are peoples, and armies, and nations and languages.

chinese: 你所看見的那十角與獸必恨這淫婦，使他冷落赤身，又要吃他的肉，用火將他燒盡。
english: And the ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will be turned against the evil woman, and will make her waste and uncovered, and will take her flesh for food, and will have her burned with fire.

chinese: 因為神使諸王同心合意，遵行他的旨意，把自己的國給那獸，直等到神的話都應驗了。
english: Because God has put it in their hearts to do his purpose, and to be of one mind, giving their kingdom to the beast, till the words of God have effect and are complete.

chinese: 你所看見的那女人就是管轄地上眾王的大城。
english: And the woman whom you saw is the great town, which is ruling over the kings of the earth.

chinese: 此後，我看見另有一位有大權柄的天使從天降下，地就因他的榮耀發光。
english: After these things I saw another angel coming down out of heaven, having great authority; and the earth was bright with his glory.

chinese: 他大聲喊著說：巴比倫大城傾倒了！傾倒了！成了鬼魔的住處和各樣污穢之靈的巢穴（或作：牢獄；下同），並各樣污穢可憎之雀鳥的巢穴。
english: And he gave a loud cry, saying, Babylon the great has come down from her high place, she has come to destruction and has become a place of evil spirits, and of every unclean spirit, and a hole for every unclean and hated bird.

chinese: 因為列國都被他邪淫大怒的酒傾倒了。地上的君王與他行淫；地上的客商因他奢華太過就發了財。
english: For through the wine of the wrath of her evil desires all the nations have come to destruction; and the kings of the earth made themselves unclean with her, and the traders of the earth had their wealth increased by the power of her evil ways.

chinese: 我又聽見從天上有聲音說：我的民哪，你們要從那城出來，免得與他一同有罪，受他所受的災殃；
english: And another voice from heaven came to my ears, saying, Come out of her, my people, so that you may have no part in her sins and in her punishments.

chinese: 因他的罪惡滔天；他的不義神已經想起來了。
english: For her sins have gone up even to heaven, and God has taken note of her evil-doing.

chinese: 他怎樣待人，也要怎樣待他，按他所行的加倍的報應他；用他調酒的杯加倍的調給他喝。
english: Give to her as she gave, even an increased reward for her works; in the cup which was mixed by her, let there be mixed as much again for herself.

chinese: 他怎樣榮耀自己，怎樣奢華，也當叫他照樣痛苦悲哀，因他心裡說：我坐了皇后的位，並不是寡婦，決不至於悲哀。
english: As she gave glory to herself, and became more evil in her ways, in the same measure give her pain and weeping: for she says in her heart, I am seated here a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see sorrow.

chinese: 所以在一天之內，他的災殃要一齊來到，就是死亡、悲哀、饑荒。他又要被火燒盡了，因為審判他的主神大有能力。
english: For this reason in one day will her troubles come, death and sorrow and need of food; and she will be completely burned with fire; for strong is the Lord God who is her judge.

chinese: 地上的君王，素來與他行淫、一同奢華的，看見燒他的煙，就必為他哭泣哀號。
english: And the kings of the earth, who made themselves unclean with her, and in her company gave themselves up to evil, will be weeping and crying over her, when they see the smoke of her burning,

chinese: 因怕他的痛苦，就遠遠的站著說：哀哉！哀哉！巴比倫大城，堅固的城阿，一時之間你的刑罰就來到了。
english: Watching from far away, for fear of her punishment, saying, Sorrow, sorrow for Babylon, the great town, the strong town! for in one hour you have been judged.

chinese: 地上的客商也都為他哭泣悲哀，因為沒有人再買他們的貨物了；
english: And the traders of the earth are weeping and crying over her, because no man has any more desire for their goods,

chinese: 這貨物就是金、銀、寶石、珍珠、細麻布、紫色料、綢子、朱紅色料、各樣香木、各樣象牙的器皿、各樣極寶貴的木頭，和銅、鐵、漢白玉的器皿，
english: Gold, and silver, and stones of great price, and jewels, and delicate linen, and robes of purple and silk and red; and perfumed wood, and every vessel of ivory, and every vessel made of fair wood, and of brass, and iron, and stone;

chinese: 並肉桂、荳蔻、香料、香膏、乳香、酒、油、細麵、麥子、牛、羊、車、馬，和奴僕、人口。
english: And sweet-smelling plants, and perfumes, and wine, and oil, and well crushed grain, and cattle and sheep; and horses and carriages and servants; and souls of men.

chinese: 巴比倫哪，你所貪愛的果子離開了你；你一切的珍饈美味，和華美的物件也從你中間毀滅，決不能再見了。
english: And the fruit of your soul's desire has gone from you, and all things delicate and shining have come to an end and will never again be seen.

chinese: 販賣這些貨物、藉著他發了財的客商，因怕他的痛苦，就遠遠的站著哭泣悲哀，說：
english: The traders in these things, by which their wealth was increased, will be watching far off for fear of her punishment, weeping and crying;

chinese: 哀哉！哀哉！這大城阿，素常穿著細麻、紫色、朱紅色的衣服，又用金子、寶石，和珍珠為妝飾。
english: Saying, Sorrow, sorrow for the great town, she who was clothed in delicate linen, and purple, and red; with ornaments of gold and stones of great price and jewels!

chinese: 一時之間，這麼大的富厚就歸於無有了。凡船主和坐船往各處去的，並眾水手，連所有靠海為業的，都遠遠的站著，
english: For in one hour such great wealth has come to nothing. And every shipmaster, and all who are sailing on the sea, and sailors and all who get their living by the sea, were watching from far away,

chinese: 看見燒他的煙，就喊著說：有何城能比這大城呢？
english: And crying out when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What town is like the great town?

chinese: 他們又把塵土撒在頭上，哭泣悲哀，喊著說：哀哉！哀哉！這大城阿。凡有船在海中的，都因他的珍寶成了富足！他在一時之間就成了荒場！
english: And they put dust on their heads, and were sad, weeping and crying, and saying, Sorrow, sorrow for the great town, in which was increased the wealth of all who had their ships on the sea because of her great stores! for in one hour she is made waste.

chinese: 天哪，眾聖徒、眾使徒、眾先知阿，你們都要因他歡喜，因為神已經在他身上伸了你們的冤。
english: Be glad over her, heaven, and you saints, and Apostles, and prophets; because she has been judged by God on your account.

chinese: 有一位大力的天使舉起一塊石頭，好像大磨石，扔在海裡，說：巴比倫大城也必這樣猛力的被扔下去，決不能再見了。
english: And a strong angel took up a stone like the great stone with which grain is crushed, and sent it into the sea, saying, So, with a great fall, will Babylon, the great town, come to destruction, and will not be seen any more at all.

chinese: 彈琴、作樂、吹笛、吹號的聲音，在你中間決不能再聽見；各行手藝人在你中間決不能再遇見；推磨的聲音在你中間決不能再聽見；
english: And the voice of players and makers of music will never again be sounding in you: and no worker, expert in art, will ever again be living in you; and there will be no sound of the crushing of grain any more at all in you;

chinese: 燈光在你中間決不能再照耀；新郎和新婦的聲音，在你中間決不能再聽見。你的客商原來是地上的尊貴人；萬國也被你的邪術迷惑了。
english: And never again will the shining of lights be seen in you; and the voice of the newly-married man and the bride will never again be sounding in you: for your traders were the lords of the earth, and by your evil powers were all the nations turned out of the right way.

chinese: 先知和聖徒，並地上一切被殺之人的血，都在這城裡看見了。
english: And in her was seen the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been put to death on the earth.

chinese: 此後，我聽見好像群眾在天上大聲說：哈利路亞（就是要讚美耶和華的意思）！救恩、榮耀、權能都屬乎我們的神！
english: After these things there came to my ears a sound like the voice of a great band of people in heaven, saying, Praise to the Lord; salvation and glory and power be to our God:

chinese: 他的判斷是真實公義的；因他判斷了那用淫行敗壞世界的大淫婦，並且向淫婦討流僕人血的罪，給他們伸冤。
english: For true and upright are his decisions; for by him has the evil woman been judged, who made the earth unclean with the sins of her body; and he has given her punishment for the blood of his servants.

chinese: 又說：哈利路亞！燒淫婦的煙往上冒，直到永永遠遠。
english: And again they said, Praise to the Lord. And her smoke went up for ever and ever.

chinese: 那二十四位長老與四活物就俯伏敬拜坐寶座的神，說：阿們！哈利路亞！
english: And the four and twenty rulers and the four beasts went down on their faces and gave worship to God who was seated on the high seat, saying, Even so, praise to the Lord.

chinese: 有聲音從寶座出來說：神的眾僕人哪，凡敬畏他的，無論大小，都要讚美我們的神！
english: And a voice came from the high seat, saying, Give praise to our God, all you his servants, small and great, in whom is the fear of him.

chinese: 我聽見好像群眾的聲音，眾水的聲音，大雷的聲音，說：哈利路亞！因為主─我們的神、全能者作王了。
english: And there came to my ears the voice of a great army, like the sound of waters, and the sound of loud thunders, saying, Praise to the Lord: for the Lord our God, Ruler of all, is King.

chinese: 我們要歡喜快樂，將榮耀歸給他。因為，羔羊婚娶的時候到了；新婦也自己預備好了，
english: Let us be glad with delight, and let us give glory to him: because the time is come for the Lamb to be married, and his wife has made herself ready.

chinese: 就蒙恩得穿光明潔白的細麻衣。這細麻衣就是聖徒所行的義。
english: And to her it was given to be clothed in delicate linen, clean and shining: for the clean linen is the righteousness of the saints.

chinese: 天使吩咐我說：你要寫上：凡被請赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了！又對我說：這是神真實的話。
english: And he said to me, Put in the book, Happy are the guests at the bride-feast of the Lamb. And he said to me, These are the true words of God.

chinese: 我就俯伏在他腳前要拜他。他說：千萬不可！我和你，並你那些為耶穌作見證的弟兄同是作僕人的，你要敬拜神。因為預言中的靈意乃是為耶穌作見證。
english: And I went on my face before his feet to give him worship. And he said to me, See you do it not: I am a brother-servant with you and with your brothers who keep the witness of Jesus: give worship to God: for the witness of Jesus is the spirit of the prophet's word.

chinese: 我觀看，見天開了。有一匹白馬，騎在馬上的稱為誠信真實，他審判，爭戰，都按著公義。
english: And the heaven was open; and I saw a white horse, and he who was seated on it was named Certain and True; and he is judging and making war in righteousness.

chinese: 他的眼睛如火燄，他頭上戴著許多冠冕；又有寫著的名字，除了他自己沒有人知道。
english: And his eyes are a flame of fire, and crowns are on his head; and he has a name in writing, of which no man has knowledge but himself.

chinese: 他穿著濺了血的衣服；他的名稱為神之道。
english: And he is clothed in a robe washed with blood: and his name is The Word of God.

chinese: 在天上的眾軍騎著白馬，穿著細麻衣，又白又潔，跟隨他。
english: And the armies which are in heaven went after him on white horses, clothed in delicate linen, white and clean.

chinese: 有利劍從他口中出來，可以擊殺列國。他必用鐵杖轄管（轄管：原文是牧）他們，並要踹全能神烈怒的酒醡。
english: And out of his mouth comes a sharp sword, with which he overcomes the nations: and he has rule over them with a rod of iron: and he is crushing with his feet the grapes of the strong wrath of God the Ruler of all.

chinese: 在他衣服和大腿上有名寫著說：萬王之王，萬主之主。
english: And on his robe and on his leg is a name, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

chinese: 我又看見一位天使站在日頭中，向天空所飛的鳥大聲喊著說：你們聚集來赴神的大筵席，
english: And I saw an angel taking his place in the sun; and he was crying with a loud voice, saying to all the birds in flight in the heavens, Come together to the great feast of God;

chinese: 可以吃君王與將軍的肉，壯士與馬和騎馬者的肉，並一切自主的為奴的，以及大小人民的肉。
english: So that you may take for your food the flesh of kings, and of captains, and of strong men, and of horses and of those who are seated on them, and the flesh of all men, free and unfree, small and great.

chinese: 我看見那獸和地上的君王，並他們的眾軍都聚集，要與騎白馬的並他的軍兵爭戰。
english: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, come together to make war against him who was seated on the horse and against his army.

chinese: 那獸被擒拿；那在獸面前曾行奇事、迷惑受獸印記和拜獸像之人的假先知，也與獸同被擒拿。他們兩個就活活的被扔在燒著硫磺的火湖裡；
english: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who did the signs before him, by which they were turned from the true way who had the mark of the beast, and who gave worship to his image: these two were put living into the sea of ever-burning fire.

chinese: 其餘的被騎白馬者口中出來的劍殺了；飛鳥都吃飽了他們的肉。
english: And the rest were put to death with the sword of him who was on the horse, even the sword which came out of his mouth: and all the birds were made full with their flesh.

chinese: 我又看見一位天使從天降下，手裡拿著無底坑的鑰匙和一條大鍊子。
english: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the great deep and a great chain in his hand.

chinese: 他捉住那龍，就是古蛇，又叫魔鬼，也叫撒但，把他捆綁一千年，
english: And he took the dragon, the old snake, which is the Evil One and Satan, and put chains on him for a thousand years,

chinese: 扔在無底坑裡，將無底坑關閉，用印封上，使他不得再迷惑列國。等到那一千年完了，以後必須暫時釋放他。
english: And put him into the great deep, and it was shut and locked over him, so that he might put the nations in error no longer, till the thousand years were ended: after this he will be let loose for a little time.

chinese: 我又看見幾個寶座，也有坐在上面的，並有審判的權柄賜給他們。我又看見那些因為給耶穌作見證，並為神之道被斬者的靈魂，和那沒有拜過獸與獸像，也沒有在額上和手上受過他印記之人的靈魂，他們都復活了，與基督一同作王一千年。
english: And I saw high seats, and they were seated on them, and the right of judging was given to them: and I saw the souls of those who were put to death for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and those who did not give worship to the beast, or to his image, and had not his mark on their brows or on their hands; and they were living and ruling with Christ a thousand years.

chinese: 這是頭一次的復活。其餘的死人還沒有復活，直等那一千年完了。
english: The rest of the dead did not come to life again till the thousand years were ended. This is the first coming back from the dead.

chinese: 在頭一次復活有分的有福了，聖潔了！第二次的死在他們身上沒有權柄。他們必作神和基督的祭司，並要與基督一同作王一千年。
english: Happy and holy is he who has a part in this first coming: over these the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will be ruling with him a thousand years.

chinese: 那一千年完了，撒但必從監牢裡被釋放，
english: And when the thousand years are ended, Satan will be let loose out of his prison,

chinese: 出來要迷惑地上四方（原文是角）的列國，就是歌革和瑪各，叫他們聚集爭戰。他們的人數多如海沙。
english: And will go out to put in error the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to get them together to the war, the number of whom is like the sands of the sea.

chinese: 他們上來遍滿了全地，圍住聖徒的營與蒙愛的城，就有火從天降下，燒滅了他們。
english: And they went up over the face of the earth, and made a circle about the tents of the saints, and the well loved town: and fire came down out of heaven for their destruction.

chinese: 那迷惑他們的魔鬼被扔在硫磺的火湖裡，就是獸和假先知所在的地方。他們必晝夜受痛苦，直到永永遠遠。
english: And the Evil One who put them in error was sent down into the sea of ever-burning fire, where the beast and the false prophet are, and their punishment will go on day and night for ever and ever.

chinese: 我又看見一個白色的大寶座與坐在上面的；從他面前天地都逃避，再無可見之處了。
english: And I saw a great white seat, and him who was seated on it, before whose face the earth and the heaven went in flight; and there was no place for them.

chinese: 我又看見死了的人，無論大小，都站在寶座前。案卷展開了，並且另有一卷展開，就是生命冊。死了的人都憑著這些案卷所記載的，照他們所行的受審判。
english: And I saw the dead, great and small, taking their places before the high seat; and the books were open, and another book was open, which is the book of life; and the dead were judged by the things which were in the books, even by their works.

chinese: 於是海交出其中的死人；死亡和陰間也交出其中的死人；他們都照各人所行的受審判。
english: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and Hell gave up the dead which were in them; and they were judged every man by his works.

chinese: 死亡和陰間也被扔在火湖裡；這火湖就是第二次的死。
english: And death and Hell were put into the sea of fire. This is the second death, even the sea of fire.

chinese: 若有人名字沒記在生命冊上，他就被扔在火湖裡。
english: And if anyone's name was not in the book of life, he went down into the sea of fire.

chinese: 我又看見一個新天新地；因為先前的天地已經過去了，海也不再有了。
english: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were gone; and there was no more sea.

chinese: 我又看見聖城新耶路撒冷由神那裡從天而降，預備好了，就如新婦妝飾整齊，等候丈夫。
english: And I saw the holy town, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, like a bride made beautiful for her husband.

chinese: 我聽見有大聲音從寶座出來說：看哪，神的帳幕在人間。他要與人同住，他們要作他的子民。神要親自與他們同在，作他們的神。
english: And there came to my ears a great voice out of the high seat, saying, See, the Tent of God is with men, and he will make his living-place with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them, and be their God.

chinese: 神要擦去他們一切的眼淚；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭號、疼痛，因為以前的事都過去了。
english: And he will put an end to all their weeping; and there will be no more death, or sorrow, or crying, or pain; for the first things have come to an end.

chinese: 坐寶座的說：看哪，我將一切都更新了！又說：你要寫上；因這些話是可信的，是真實的。
english: And he who is seated on the high seat said, See, I make all things new. And he said, Put it in the book; for these words are certain and true.

chinese: 他又對我說：都成了！我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是初，我是終。我要將生命泉的水白白賜給那口渴的人喝。
english: And he said to me, It is done. I am the First and the Last, the start and the end. I will freely give of the fountain of the water of life to him who is in need.

chinese: 得勝的，必承受這些為業：我要作他的神，他要作我的兒子。
english: He who overcomes will have these things for his heritage; and I will be his God, and he will be my son.

chinese: 惟有膽怯的、不信的、可憎的、殺人的、淫亂的、行邪術的、拜偶像的，和一切說謊話的，他們的分就在燒著硫磺的火湖裡；這是第二次的死。
english: But those who are full of fear and without faith, the unclean and takers of life, those who do the sins of the flesh, and those who make use of evil powers or who give worship to images, and all those who are false, will have their part in the sea of ever-burning fire which is the second death.

chinese: 拿著七個金碗、盛滿末後七災的七位天使中，有一位來對我說：你到這裡來，我要將新婦，就是羔羊的妻，指給你看。
english: And one of the seven angels who had the seven vessels in which were the seven last punishments, came and said to me, Come here, and see the bride, the Lamb's wife.

chinese: 我被聖靈感動，天使就帶我到一座高大的山，將那由神那裡、從天而降的聖城耶路撒冷指示我。
english: And he took me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and let me see the holy town Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

chinese: 城中有神的榮耀；城的光輝如同極貴的寶石，好像碧玉，明如水晶。
english: Having the glory of God: and her light was like a stone of great price, a jasper stone, clear as glass:

chinese: 有高大的牆，有十二個門，門上有十二位天使；門上又寫著以色列十二個支派的名字。
english: She had a wall great and high, with twelve doors, and at the doors twelve angels; and names on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

chinese: 東邊有三門、北邊有三門、南邊有三門、西邊有三門。
english: And on the east were three doors; and on the north three doors; and on the south three doors; and on the west three doors.

chinese: 城牆有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的名字。
english: And the wall of the town had twelve bases, and on them the twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

chinese: 對我說話的，拿著金葦子當尺，要量那城和城門城牆。
english: And he who was talking with me had a gold measuring-rod to take the measure of the town, and of its doors, and its wall.

chinese: 城是四方的，長寬一樣。天使用葦子量那城，共有四千里，長、寬、高都是一樣；
english: And the town is square, as wide as it is long; and he took the measure of the town with the rod, one thousand and five hundred miles: it is equally long and wide and high.

chinese: 又量了城牆，按著人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。
english: And he took the measure of its wall, one hundred and forty-four cubits, after the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

chinese: 牆是碧玉造的；城是精金的，如同明淨的玻璃。
english: And the building of its wall was of jasper, and the town was clear gold, clear as glass.

chinese: 城牆的根基是用各樣寶石修飾的：第一根基是碧玉；第二是藍寶石；第三是綠瑪瑙；第四是綠寶石；
english: The bases of the wall of the town had ornaments of all sorts of beautiful stones. The first base was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

chinese: 第五是紅瑪瑙；第六是紅寶石；第七是黃璧璽；第八是水蒼玉；第九是紅璧璽；第十是翡翠；第十一是紫瑪瑙；第十二是紫晶。
english: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprase; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.

chinese: 十二個門是十二顆珍珠，每門是一顆珍珠。城內的街道是精金，好像明透的玻璃。
english: And the twelve doors were twelve pearls; every door was made of one pearl; and the street of the town was clear gold, as clear as glass.

chinese: 我未見城內有殿，因主神─全能者和羔羊為城的殿。
english: And I saw no Temple there; because the Lord God, the Ruler of all, and the Lamb are its Temple.

chinese: 那城內又不用日月光照；因有神的榮耀光照，又有羔羊為城的燈。
english: And the town has no need of the sun, or of the moon, to give it light: for the glory of God did make it light, and the light of it is the Lamb.

chinese: 列國要在城的光裡行走；地上的君王必將自己的榮耀歸與那城。
english: And the nations will go in its light: and the kings of the earth will take their glory into it.

chinese: 城門白晝總不關閉，在那裡原沒有黑夜。
english: And the doors of it will never be shut by day (for there is no night there):

chinese: 人必將列國的榮耀、尊貴歸與那城。
english: And the glory and honour of the nations will come into it:

chinese: 凡不潔淨的，並那行可憎與虛謊之事的，總不得進那城；只有名字寫在羔羊生命冊上的才得進去。
english: And nothing unclean may come into it, or anyone whose works are cursed or false; but only those whose names are in the Lamb's book of life.

chinese: 天使又指示我在城內街道當中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，從神和羔羊的寶座流出來。
english: And I saw a river of water of life, clear as glass, coming out of the high seat of God and of the Lamb,

chinese: 在河這邊與那邊有生命樹，結十二樣（或作：回）果子，每月都結果子；樹上的葉子乃為醫治萬民。
english: In the middle of its street. And on this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, having twelve sorts of fruits, giving its fruit every month; and the leaves of the tree give life to the nations.

chinese: 以後再沒有咒詛；在城裡有神和羔羊的寶座；他的僕人都要事奉他，
english: And there will be no more curse: and the high seat of God and of the Lamb will be there; and his servants will be worshipping him;

chinese: 也要見他的面。他的名字必寫在他們的額上。
english: And they will see his face; and his name will be on their brows.

chinese: 不再有黑夜；他們也不用燈光、日光，因為主神要光照他們。他們要作王，直到永永遠遠。
english: And there will be no more night; and they have no need of a light or of the shining of the sun; for the Lord God will give them light: and they will be ruling for ever and ever.

chinese: 天使又對我說：這些話是真實可信的。主就是眾先知被感之靈的神，差遣他的使者，將那必要快成的事指示他僕人。
english: And he said to me, These words are certain and true: and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to make clear to his servants the things which are now to come about.

chinese: 看哪，我必快來！凡遵守這書上預言的有福了！
english: See, I come quickly. A blessing on him who keeps the words of this book of the prophet.

chinese: 這些事是我約翰所聽見、所看見的；我既聽見、看見了，就在指示我的天使腳前俯伏要拜他。
english: And I, John, am he who saw these things and to whose ears they came. And when I had seen and given ear, I went down on my face to give worship at the feet of the angel who made these things clear to me.

chinese: 他對我說：千萬不可！我與你和你的弟兄眾先知，並那些守這書上言語的人，同是作僕人的。你要敬拜神。
english: And he said to me, See you do it not; I am a brother-servant with you and with your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book: give worship to God.

chinese: 他又對我說：不可封了這書上的預言，因為日期近了。
english: And he said to me, Let not the words of this prophet's book be kept secret, because the time is near.

chinese: 不義的，叫他仍舊不義；污穢的，叫他仍舊污穢；為義的，叫他仍舊為義；聖潔的，叫他仍舊聖潔。
english: Let the evil man go on in his evil: and let the unclean be still unclean: and let the upright go on in his righteousness: and let the holy be holy still.

chinese: 看哪，我必快來！賞罰在我，要照各人所行的報應他。
english: See, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give to every man the outcome of his works.

chinese: 我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是首先的，我是末後的；我是初，我是終。
english: I am the First and the Last, the start and the end.

chinese: 那些洗淨自己衣服的有福了！可得權柄能到生命樹那裡，也能從門進城。
english: A blessing on those whose robes are washed, so that they may have a right to the tree of life, and may go in by the doors into the town.

chinese: 城外有那些犬類、行邪術的、淫亂的、殺人的、拜偶像的，並一切喜好說謊言、編造虛謊的。
english: Outside are the dogs, and those who make use of evil powers, those who make themselves unclean, and the takers of life, and those who give worship to images, and everyone whose delight is in what is false.

chinese: 我─耶穌差遣我的使者為眾教會將這些事向你們證明。我是大衛的根，又是他的後裔。我是明亮的晨星。
english: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give witness to you of these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright and morning star.

chinese: 聖靈和新婦都說：來！聽見的人也該說：來！口渴的人也當來；願意的，都可以白白取生命的水喝。
english: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him who gives ear, say, Come. And let him who is in need come; and let everyone desiring it take of the water of life freely.

chinese: 我向一切聽見這書上預言的作見證，若有人在這預言上加添甚麼，神必將寫在這書上的災禍加在他身上；
english: For I say to every man to whose ears have come the words of this prophet's book, If any man makes an addition to them, God will put on him the punishments which are in this book:

chinese: 這書上的預言，若有人刪去甚麼，神必從這書上所寫的生命樹和聖城刪去他的分。
english: And if any man takes away from the words of this book, God will take away from him his part in the tree of life and the holy town, even the things which are in this book.

chinese: 證明這事的說：是了，我必快來！阿們！主耶穌阿，我願你來！
english: He who gives witness to these things says, Truly, I come quickly. Even so come, Lord Jesus.

chinese: 願主耶穌的恩惠常與眾聖徒同在。阿們！
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with the saints. So be it.
